en: Aachen was a Free Imperial City of the Holy Roman Empire, grown from the Roman spa town of Aquae Granni at the hot springs of the Wurm valley. Charlemagne made it his favourite residence and built the Palatine Chapel, the core of the present-day cathedral, where he was buried in 814; after Frederick Barbarossa canonized him in 1165 the shrine became a major place of pilgrimage. From the coronation of Otto I in 936 until that of Ferdinand I in 1531, thirty-one kings of the Germans were crowned in the cathedral, and Barbarossa's charter of 1166 gave the city its imperial liberties, defended by walls raised between 1172 and 1176. In 1330 the Carolingian hall was replaced by the present town hall. Religious strife followed the Reformation: in 1598 Protestant office-holders were expelled, and the Spanish siege of 1614 sealed the Catholic restoration. The great fire of 1656 destroyed much of the city, which was rebuilt in the Baroque style, and the congresses of 1668 and 1748 made Aachen the venue of major peace treaties. French revolutionary troops occupied it in 1794, ending its self-rule; the Peace of Lunéville annexed it to France in 1801, and in 1815 the Congress of Vienna assigned it to Prussia.
zh: 亚琛是神圣罗马帝国的帝国自由城市，前身是罗马人在武尔姆河谷温泉边建立的浴场城镇阿奎埃·格拉尼。查理曼把这里定为最喜爱的居所，修建了行宫礼拜堂，即今日亚琛大教堂的核心，并于814年安葬于此；1165年腓特烈·巴巴罗萨将他封圣后，教堂成为重要朝圣地。从936年奥托一世加冕到1531年斐迪南一世加冕，先后有三十一位德意志国王在这座大教堂加冕；巴巴罗萨1166年的特许状赋予城市帝国自由权，1172年至1176年又修筑城墙拱卫。1330年，加洛林时代的大厅被今天的市政厅取代。宗教改革后教派冲突不断：1598年新教官员被驱逐，1614年西班牙军队围城，天主教恢复统治。1656年的大火烧毁大半个城市，重建时采用巴洛克风格；1668年和1748年的两次亚琛会议又使这里成为重要和约的签署地。1794年法国革命军队占领亚琛，城市自治告终；1801年《吕内维尔和约》将其割让给法国，1815年维也纳会议又把它划归普鲁士。

en: Al A'idh is an Arab tribe of central Arabia, whose old genealogies derive them from the Banu A'idh ibn Sa'd, a branch of the Banu Amir ibn Sa'sa'a of the great Hawazin tribal group, although in later centuries they were counted among the Qahtan. They ranged across Najd, Asir and Kuwait, and many clans settled as townsmen in the valleys of Najd, including Sudair, al-Majma'ah, al-Ghat and Zulfi. Their leading houses supplied rulers to the region's small townships: Zamil ibn Uthman of the Al Zamil was emir of al-Kharj in 1687, and Hasan ibn Rashid al-Bajadi of the Al Bajadi held the emirate of al-Yamama until his death in 1781. Another A'idhi family, the Al Ufaysan, rose with the first Saudi state, and Ibrahim ibn Ufaysan became emir of Unaizah in 1814 after leading Saudi campaigns to the Gulf coast.
zh: 阿伊兹是阿拉伯半岛中部的阿拉伯部落，按古老谱系，他们出自巴努·阿伊兹·伊本·萨阿德，属哈瓦津大部落群中巴努·阿米尔·伊本·萨阿萨阿的一支，但在后世被归入盖哈坦人。他们活动于内志、阿西尔和科威特，许多氏族在苏代尔、迈季迈阿、加特和祖勒菲等内志河谷定居为城镇居民。其名门望族为当地小镇提供了统治者：扎米勒家族的扎米勒·伊本·奥斯曼于1687年担任海尔季埃米尔，巴贾迪家族的哈桑·伊本·拉希德·巴贾迪占据耶马迈埃米尔之位，直至1781年去世。另一个阿伊兹家族欧费桑家族随第一沙特王国崛起，易卜拉欣·伊本·欧费桑在率军征战海湾沿岸后，于1814年成为欧奈宰埃米尔。

en: Alastani was a Georgian princely domain in the province of Javakheti, centred on the castle of Alastani north of Akhalkalaki. Early in the thirteenth century it was held by the crown prince Lasha-George, the future King George IV, whose successors bore the title Alastaneli. After David VIII lost the struggle for the Georgian throne to his brother Vakhtang III in 1302, he withdrew to Javakheti and founded a line of provincial kings, nominally subject to the crown at Tbilisi. His son Andronicus died in 1354, and his grandsons David and George the Great held the domain until George fell fighting the Turks in 1373. The Alastaneli line became extinct early in the following century, and Javakheti was eventually absorbed into the neighbouring Jaqeli principality of Samtskhe.
zh: 阿拉斯塔尼是格鲁吉亚贾瓦赫季地区的王公领地，以阿哈尔卡拉基以北的阿拉斯塔尼城堡为中心。13世纪初，它属于王储拉沙-吉奥尔基，即后来的吉奥尔基四世，后继者都拥有“阿拉斯塔尼”的头衔。1302年，达维德八世在与弟弟瓦赫坦格三世争夺格鲁吉亚王位失败后退守贾瓦赫季，开创了一支名义上臣服于第比利斯王权的地方王统。他的儿子安德洛尼卡于1354年去世，孙子达维德与大吉奥尔基相继领有此地，1373年大吉奥尔基在与土耳其人作战时阵亡。阿拉斯塔尼王统在15世纪初绝嗣，贾瓦赫季最终并入邻近的贾凯利家族萨姆茨赫公国。

en: The Al 'Ali were a Bedouin Arab clan of the Banu Rabi'ah, themselves a branch of the great Banu Tayy whose nomads had roamed the northern Arabian oases of Al-Jawf and Wadi Sirhan long before Islam and entered Syria with the Jarrahid dynasty in the tenth and eleventh centuries. When the Ayyubid and Mamluk sultans organized the Syrian desert through the office of amir al-arab, commander of the Bedouins, the Banu Rabi'ah divided into leading houses: the Al Fadl held the northern steppe from Palmyra to the Euphrates, the Al Mira under Ahmad ibn Hajji became virtually independent lords of the southern desert with the title malik al-arab, and emirs of the Al Ali at times secured the amir al-arab for themselves. In 1337 their tents ranged from the Qalamun foothills around Qutayfa on the Damascus road to the ancient oasis of Dumat al-Jandal, and the house held its grazing grounds as Mamluk vassals. Centuries later branches of the tribe migrated to the Arab side of the Gulf: from 1739 an Al Ali chiefdom ruled the Shibkuh coast of Persia, while kinsmen settled at Umm al-Quwain, whose Al Mualla ruling family traces its descent to the same Tayyid stock.
zh: 阿里家族是巴努·拉比阿的一个贝都因阿拉伯氏族，而巴努·拉比阿又是大部落泰伊的分支；泰伊牧民早在伊斯兰教兴起之前就游牧于阿拉伯北部的焦夫绿洲和锡尔汉谷地，并在10至11世纪随贾拉王朝进入叙利亚。阿尤布与马穆鲁克苏丹设立阿拉伯埃米尔一职管理叙利亚沙漠后，巴努·拉比阿分成几个望族：法德勒家族占据从巴尔米拉到幼发拉底河的北部草原，米拉家族在艾哈迈德·伊本·哈吉率领下以阿拉伯人之王的名号成为南方沙漠近乎独立的主人，阿里家族的埃米尔也曾几度取得阿拉伯埃米尔之位。1337年，他们的帐篷从大马士革大道旁库泰法所在的卡拉蒙山麓，一直延伸到古老的杜马詹达勒绿洲，作为马穆鲁克的附庸领有这些牧场。几个世纪后，该部落的支系迁往阿拉伯湾沿岸：1739年起，一个阿里酋长政权统治波斯的希卜库海岸，另一些族人定居乌姆盖万，当地的穆阿拉统治家族自称同属泰伊血统。

en: Abdari denotes a Jurchen clan polity of the lower Tumen River valley, with its seat at Kahari in present-day Yanbian. In 1337 these Tungusic villagers and hunters acknowledged the Yuan as overlords. From 1405 the Ming enrolled Tumen-basin chieftains in guards such as the Maolian Guard, and the local clans were later drawn into the Jianzhou Jurchen consolidation.
zh: 阿卜达里指图们江下游流域的女真氏族政权，治所喀哈里位于今延边境内。1337年，这些通古斯语的村民与猎户奉元朝为宗主。1405年起，明朝把图们江流域的首领编入毛怜卫等卫所，当地各氏族后来被卷入建州女真的整合之中。

en: Alba, the Roman Alba Pompeia on the Tanaro river, was granted town status by the consul Gnaeus Pompeius Strabo and was the birthplace of the emperor Pertinax, who ruled briefly in 193. After the Western Empire fell it was sacked in turn by Ostrogoths, Lombards, Franks, Hungarians and Saracens. In the eleventh century it emerged as a free commune and joined the Lombard League against the Hohenstaufen emperors, but its position in southern Piedmont made it a prize for stronger neighbours: the marquises of Montferrat and the Visconti of Milan fought over it, and it later passed to the Gonzaga of Mantua. Charles Emmanuel I of Savoy twice conquered the town during the Italian wars, and the Treaty of Cherasco in 1631 assigned Alba definitively to Savoy. In 1796 the French revolutionary army set up a short-lived Republic of Alba, then folded the town into the Subalpine Republic and in 1802 into the French Empire; it was restored to the Kingdom of Sardinia in 1814.
zh: 阿尔巴位于塔纳罗河畔，古罗马时称阿尔巴·庞培亚，由执政官格奈乌斯·庞培·斯特拉波授予城市地位，也是193年短暂在位的皇帝佩蒂纳克斯的出生地。西罗马帝国灭亡后，它先后遭东哥特人、伦巴第人、法兰克人、匈牙利人和撒拉森人洗劫。11世纪它成为自由市镇，并加入伦巴第联盟对抗霍亨施陶芬皇朝，但它地处皮埃蒙特南部，遂成强邻争夺的战利品：蒙费拉托侯爵与米兰的维斯孔蒂家族反复交锋，后来它又转入曼图亚的贡扎加家族之手。萨伏依的卡洛·埃马努埃莱一世在意大利战争中两度攻占该城，1631年的《凯拉斯科条约》最终把阿尔巴划归萨伏依。1796年法国革命军在此建立短命的阿尔巴共和国，随后将其并入阿尔卑斯山南共和国，1802年又并入法兰西帝国；1814年它回归撒丁王国。

en: Ambovontany is the chief settlement of Androy, the arid thorn country at the southern tip of Madagascar and homeland of the Tandroy, whose name means people of the thorns and whom seventeenth-century European sailors called the Ampatres. The Tandroy lived mainly by herding zebu and growing drought-resistant tubers and millet, marking their tombs with piles of zebu skulls. Their clans kept separate traditions: the Karimbola of the west claimed always to have lived there, while the eastern Mahandrovato were gradually joined by Antanosy and Bara refugees. In the early eighteenth century the Zafimanara dynasty united the country between the Menarandra and Mendare rivers into a single confederation, but severe flooding around 1790 drove the dynasty to the Manombo plateau and the kingdom broke apart. The harshness of the land afterwards spared the Tandroy from conquest by the expanding Kingdom of Imerina.
zh: 安布翁塔尼是马达加斯加最南端干旱多刺的安坦德鲁伊地区的主要定居点，也是坦德罗伊人的故土；坦德罗伊意为荆棘之地的人，17世纪的欧洲水手称他们为安帕特尔人。坦德罗伊人主要以放牧瘤牛和种植耐旱的块茎与小米为生，墓地上堆饰着瘤牛头骨。他们的氏族各有传统：西部的卡林博拉人自称自古就住在当地，东部的汉德罗瓦托人则逐渐接纳了安塔诺西和巴拉难民。18世纪初，扎菲马纳拉王朝将梅纳兰德拉河与门达雷河之间的地区统一为联盟，但约1790年的特大洪水迫使该王朝逃往马农博高原，联盟随之瓦解。此后严酷的环境又使坦德罗伊人免遭扩张中的伊梅里纳王国征服。

en: Al-Abwab, whose Arabic name means the Gates, was a medieval Nubian Christian kingdom of the Nile-Atbara region in central Sudan, around the later towns of Ed Damer and Shendi. It began as the northernmost province of the great kingdom of Alodia and broke away to emerge as an independent monarchy in 1268 or 1269, as Alodia itself weakened. Its best-known king, Adur, courted the Mamluk sultanate of Egypt: in 1276 he captured King David of Makuria, who had fled south from Baybars's invasion, and handed him over to the Muslims, and in 1286 he sent an embassy bearing an elephant and a giraffe to profess obedience in Cairo. Al-Abwab repeatedly sided with the Mamluks against its northern neighbour Makuria, and in 1317 its king likewise surrendered the fugitive Makurian ruler Kudanbes. Arabic writers of the early fifteenth century still described it as a Christian kingdom with a royal titulature like that of Armenia, even as Arab Bedouin tribes drifted in and gradually Islamised the countryside. It vanishes from written records after 1367, but Christian pottery found alongside Funj wares suggests the realm survived into the fifteenth or even the sixteenth century, when the Funj sultan Amara Dunqas united the Sudanese Nile Valley and absorbed it.
zh: 艾卜瓦卜在阿拉伯语中意为“诸门”，是位于苏丹中部尼罗河与阿特巴拉河之间的中世纪努比亚基督教王国，地当今达米尔、尚迪一带。它本是大国阿洛迪亚最北端的省份，1268至1269年间趁阿洛迪亚衰落而独立。最著名的国王阿杜尔主动结好埃及的马穆鲁克苏丹国：1276年，他俘获了在拜巴尔入侵后南逃的马库里亚国王大卫并将其交给穆斯林；1286年又遣使赴开罗，以大象和长颈鹿为礼表示臣服。艾卜瓦卜一再联合马穆鲁克对付北方邻邦马库里亚，1317年其国王同样交出了逃亡的马库里亚统治者库丹贝斯。15世纪初的阿拉伯作家仍把它记载为基督教王国，国王的头衔制度与亚美尼亚相仿；与此同时，阿拉伯贝都因部落不断迁入，逐步使乡间伊斯兰化。1367年以后它不再见于文字记载，但与丰吉陶器同出的基督教陶器表明，这个国家一直延续到15世纪甚至16世纪，最终被统一苏丹尼罗河谷的丰吉苏丹阿马拉·敦卡斯吞并。

en: Acatic was one of the independent señoríos of the Tecuexe, set in the Los Altos highlands of what is now Mexico on the northern border of the Coca kingdom of Coinan. Like its neighbours Mitic and Xalostotitlan it was remembered as a town raided by the Mexica during their long migration. In August 1530 its cacique offered vassalage to the Spanish captain Pedro Almíndez Chirino as he swept through the region for Nuño de Guzmán. When the Mixtón War erupted in 1541, Acatic did not hold out with the Nochistlan rebels: the holders of the town had already capitulated before the viceroy Antonio de Mendoza's army moved on to besiege Nochistlan and the Mixton stronghold.
zh: 阿卡蒂克是特库埃克人的独立小邦之一，坐落在今墨西哥的阿尔托斯高原，南接科卡人的科伊南王国。与邻邦米蒂克、沙洛斯托蒂特兰一样，相传墨西加人在漫长迁徙途中曾攻掠此地。1530年8月，西班牙队长佩德罗·阿尔门德斯·奇里诺奉努尼奥·德·古斯曼之命横扫该地区时，阿卡蒂克的酋长向他称臣纳贡。1541年米斯特翁战争爆发后，阿卡蒂克没有随诺奇斯特兰的叛军顽抗：总督安东尼奥·德·门多萨的大军进逼诺奇斯特兰和米斯特翁要塞之前，控制该城的人便已经归降。

en: The Principality of Achaea, also called the Principality of the Morea, was the strongest of the crusader states set up in Greece after the Fourth Crusade. It was founded in 1205, when William of Champlitte and Geoffrey I of Villehardouin conquered the Peloponnese with a few hundred knights and men, and was organised from its capital at Andravida into twelve feudal baronies under the Assizes of Romania, growing rich on the wine, oil and silk of the peninsula. Under Prince William II of Villehardouin, who moved the court to the new fortress of Mistra in 1249, the principality reached its height, but his capture at the Battle of Pelagonia in 1259 forced him in 1262 to surrender Mistra and Laconia to the Byzantines, who there built up the Despotate of the Morea. By the Treaty of Viterbo in 1267 Achaea became a fief of Charles of Anjou, king of Sicily, and after William's death in 1278 it was governed through Angevin bailiffs amid long succession disputes. In 1337 its princess was Catherine of Valois, the titular Latin empress of Constantinople, who held the principality as a vassal of the Angevin kings of Naples. Naples annexed it directly in 1383 and in 1404 sold its rights to the Zaccaria family; the Byzantine despots Constantine and Thomas Palaeologus overran its heartland in 1430, and the last prince, Centurione II Zaccaria, died in 1432, leaving Latin rule in the Morea at an end.
zh: 亚该亚亲王国又称摩里亚亲王国，是第四次十字军东征后在希腊建立的最强盛的十字军国家。1205年，尚普利特的威廉和维尔阿杜安的杰弗里一世率数百名骑士和步兵征服伯罗奔尼撒，以安德拉维达为首都，按《罗马尼亚法典》将国家划分为十二个封建男爵领地，凭半岛出产的葡萄酒、橄榄油和丝绸致富。维尔阿杜安家族的威廉二世亲王在位时国势达到顶峰，他于1249年把宫廷迁往新建的米斯特拉斯要塞；但1259年他在佩拉戈尼亚战役中被俘，1262年被迫将米斯特拉斯和拉科尼亚割让给拜占庭，后者在此基础上建立起摩里亚专制国。1267年的《维泰博条约》使亚该亚成为西西里国王安茹的查理的封邑，1278年威廉死后，国家在长期的继承纠纷中由安茹王朝的代理官治理。1337年在位的是名义上的拉丁帝国女皇帝瓦卢瓦的凯瑟琳，她作为那不勒斯安茹国王的附庸领有这个亲王国。1383年那不勒斯将其直接吞并，1404年又把统治权卖给扎卡里亚家族；1430年拜占庭专制君主君士坦丁和托马斯·巴列奥略攻占其腹地，末代亲王琴图廖内二世·扎卡里亚于1432年去世，拉丁人在摩里亚的统治就此终结。

en: Áak'u, better known by its Spanish name Acoma, is a Western Keres pueblo crowning a sheer sandstone mesa west of the Rio Grande in present-day New Mexico, and ranks among the oldest continuously inhabited towns in North America. Acoma tradition dates the Sky City settlement to the eleventh century, and archaeology places its emergence by the thirteenth, when Ancestral Puebloan and Mogollon peoples gathered on the easily defended rock, farming the valley below, trading pottery and keeping watch against Navajo and Apache raiders. Estevanico heard of it in 1539, and Hernando de Alvarado of Coronado's army saw it in 1540, marvelling at a fortress no enemy could take. That independence ended bloodily: after the Acoma killed Juan de Zaldívar and eleven soldiers in December 1598, Vicente de Zaldívar stormed the mesa in January 1599, killing perhaps eight hundred people in three days and enslaving or mutilating the survivors, a brutality that overawed every other pueblo. Rebuilt under mission rule, Áak'u joined the great Pueblo Revolt of 1680 and was not brought back under Spanish control until Diego de Vargas's campaigns of the 1690s, after which its people returned and kept their Keres language and ceremonies alive.
zh: 阿库（西班牙人更熟悉的名字是阿科马）是西凯雷斯人的普韦布洛，雄踞在格兰德河以西一座陡峭的砂岩台地上，位于今新墨西哥州，是北美持续有人居住的最古老城镇之一。阿科马口传将这座“天空之城”的建立追溯到11世纪，考古学则认为它至迟在13世纪已经成形：古普韦布洛人和莫戈永人聚守在易守难攻的巨石上，在台下谷地耕作、以陶器贸易为生，并戒备纳瓦霍人和阿帕奇人的袭扰。1539年埃斯特万尼科最先听到它的消息，1540年科罗纳多麾下的埃尔南多·德·阿尔瓦拉多亲眼见到这座无人能攻陷的堡垒，惊叹不已。这种独立在血泊中终结：1598年12月阿科马人杀死胡安·德·萨尔迪瓦尔等十二名士兵后，维森特·德·萨尔迪瓦尔于1599年1月强攻台地，三天内杀死约八百人，幸存者或被奴役或被断肢，其残酷震慑了所有普韦布洛。阿库在传教统治下重建，又参加了1680年的普韦布洛大起义，直到17世纪90年代迭戈·德·巴尔加斯连年用兵才重新臣服，此后返乡的居民一直保有凯雷斯语与传统仪式。

en: Anding was a Zhuang tusi on the Hongshui River in the Si'en prefecture of central Guangxi, its valley lying in present-day Du'an County under Hechi. It was created in 1528, when Wang Shouren, the grand coordinator who had just pacified the Tianzhou rising, reorganised the former Tianzhou borderlands into nine hereditary chief's offices under Si'en. Anding stood alongside Duyang, Baishan and the other Si'en tusi, and its native chiefs held the office through the Ming and the Qing.
zh: 安定是广西中部思恩府境内、红水河畔的壮族土司，辖地在今河池市都安瑶族自治县一带。1528年，刚刚平定田州变乱的总督王守仁把原田州府边缘的溪洞重新编组，划归思恩府管辖，设立包括安定在内的九个世袭长官司。安定与都阳、白山等土司并列，土官在明、清两代替朝廷治理境内村寨。

en: Ayodhya was a walled town on an island of the lower Chao Phraya, the site that later became Ayutthaya. Thai chronicles place its first settlement, Mueang Nong-sano, in the 930s, founded by the monk Phuttha Sakhon. In 1082 Narai I of Lavo moved his court there from Lavapura and renamed the place Ayodhya, after which the old capital was known as Lopburi. Its position on the river trade routes drew merchants and settlers, and Chinese and Vietnamese records of the period call the polity Xian. Descendants of Sai Nam Peung, later called the Uthong or Lavo dynasty, ruled it until the fourteenth century. In 1337 Ayodhya was a small vassal town of Lavo. In 1351 its lord Uthong V united it with Lavo and Suphannaphum to found the Ayutthaya Kingdom, and the old town was absorbed into the new capital.
zh: 阿踰陀是昭披耶河下游一处岛上城邑，即后来阿瑜陀耶城的所在。按泰国编年史传统，其最早的聚落农萨诺城建于10世纪30年代，由僧人佛陀萨恭创立。1082年，罗涡的那莱一世把宫廷从罗哇补罗迁到此处，改名阿踰陀，旧都此后称华富里。凭借扼守河上商路的位置，这里吸引了商人和移民，中国与安南史籍把这个政权称为暹。赛南蓬的后裔——即后世所称的乌通（罗涡）王朝——在此统治到14世纪。1337年，阿踰陀还是罗涡治下的一座附庸小城。1351年，其领主乌通五世将它与罗涡、素攀那蓬合为一体，建立阿瑜陀耶王国，旧城随之并入新都。

en: Ado, at present-day Ado Ekiti, is an Ekiti-Yoruba kingdom whose rulers hold the title of Ewi. Its founder Ewi Awamaro was descended from a party that left Ile-Ife with Oranmiyan and, after long wanderings through the Benin forests and several interim settlements, finally made his home at Ulesun, the site of the present-day town.
zh: 阿多（即今阿多埃基蒂）是埃基提约鲁巴人的王国，统治者称“埃维”。开国君主埃维·阿瓦马罗的先辈随奥兰米扬离开伊费，在贝宁丛林中长期辗转、几经迁居，最后他在乌莱孙（今阿多埃基蒂所在地）定居建城。

en: Dankali was the Muslim kingdom of the Afar, or Danakil, people, strung along the arid Red Sea coast between the Ethiopian highlands and the sea. The thirteenth-century Andalusian writer Ibn Sa'id already located the Danakil along the shore from Suakin down to the Bab-el-Mandeb, and in the 1470s their ruler sent a horse, a date-laden mule and spears to Emperor Ba'eda Maryam as an offer of help against the neighbouring Dobe'a. The kingdom's wealth rested on the salt plains of Arho in the Afar depression: rock-salt bars called amole were carried by camel caravan to the highland markets and served as currency across Ethiopia. Its kings were vassals of the Ethiopian emperors; in 1620 King Kamil, having been overthrown by his brother, travelled to Emperor Susenyos's camp at Dehana to be restored and crowned, and a Yemeni envoy in 1647 found his son Shuhaym ibn Kamil ruling at Baylul. From the late sixteenth century the Baraytuma Oromo raided repeatedly through the kingdom, reaching the coast near Assab and splitting the Danakil into northern and southern groups. In the eighteenth century the loss of the salt plains and Ottoman control of the ports broke Dankali into petty sultanates, its rulers confined to the Buri Peninsula.
zh: 丹卡利是阿法尔人（又称达纳基尔人）的穆斯林王国，沿埃塞俄比亚高原与大海之间干旱的红海海岸分布。13世纪的安达卢西亚作家伊本·赛义德已记载达纳基尔人居住在从萨瓦金到曼德海峡的沿岸；15世纪70年代，他们的统治者向巴埃达·马里亚姆皇帝献上马匹、驮满椰枣的骡子和长矛，主动请缨助攻邻邦多贝亚。王国的财富仰仗阿法尔洼地的阿尔霍盐原：名为阿莫莱的岩盐条由骆驼商队运往高原集市，在埃塞俄比亚各地充当货币。历代国王是埃塞俄比亚皇帝的附庸：1620年，被兄弟推翻的国王卡米勒前往德哈纳的苏塞尼奥斯皇帝行营，在皇帝支持下复位加冕；1647年一位也门使节发现，卡米勒之子苏海姆·伊本·卡米勒正统治贝卢尔。16世纪末起，巴赖图马奥罗莫人不断袭掠王国，兵锋抵达阿萨布附近海岸，把达纳基尔人割裂为南北两支。18世纪，盐原丧失、港口又被奥斯曼人控制，丹卡利瓦解为若干小苏丹国，统治者退缩到布里半岛。

en: Augsburg was founded by the Romans in 15 BC as Augusta Vindelicorum on the rivers Lech and Wertach, and became the capital of the province of Raetia in 120 AD. On 9 March 1276 it won the status of a Free Imperial City, making it independent of the Prince-Bishop of Augsburg, and its position on the trade routes into Italy turned it into a major manufacturing and trading centre for textiles and metalwork. In the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries the Fugger and Welser banking houses made it one of the richest cities of the Empire; Jakob Fugger founded the Fuggerei, a walled estate of almshouses, in 1516. The Reformation gave the city a central place in German religion: the Augsburg Confession was presented to the emperor at the Diet of 1530, and the Peace of Augsburg of 1555 left a mixed Catholic and Protestant council ruling a mostly Protestant population. Swedish troops occupied the city in 1632, and the imperial siege of 1634 to 1635 cost thousands of lives through hunger and disease. Augsburg kept its self-government until the mediatization of 1803, after which it passed to Bavaria.
zh: 奥格斯堡于公元前15年由罗马人在莱希河与韦尔塔赫河汇流处建立，初名奥古斯塔-温德利科鲁姆，120年成为罗马雷蒂亚行省的首府。1276年3月9日，它取得帝国自由市地位，从此独立于奥格斯堡采邑主教；凭借通往意大利商路上的位置，它发展为纺织和金属加工的重要工商业中心。15至16世纪，富格尔和韦尔泽两大银行家族使它跻身帝国最富庶的城市之列，雅各布·富格尔于1516年捐建了贫民住宅区富格莱。宗教改革使它成为德意志宗教事务的中心：1530年帝国议会在此呈交《奥格斯堡信纲》，1555年的《奥格斯堡和约》之后，由天主教与新教混合的市政厅治理以新教徒为主的市民。1632年瑞典军队占领该城，1634至1635年的帝国围城战中数千人死于饥馑和疫病。奥格斯堡的自治一直维持到1803年的帝国代表会议决议，随后并入巴伐利亚。

en: The Angoche Sultanate was a Swahili Muslim polity on the Angoche islands off the coast of what is now northern Mozambique. The islands had harboured trading communities since around the year 500, and oral tradition holds that refugees from the Kilwa Sultanate founded the sultanate late in the fifteenth century, installing Xosa as its first sultan and establishing ruling noble houses known as the inhapakho. As Kilwa and Sofala declined, Angoche became an alternative port for ivory, ambergris, gold and slaves bound for the Indian Ocean, its craftsmen also famed for straw mats and hats. Portuguese factories on the Zambezi in the 1530s, and Marave control of the hinterland, cut its caravan routes, and after a period of loose Portuguese overlordship the old town was abandoned and rebuilt on a new site. A visitor in 1752 found the sultanate restored and expanding, and from the 1830s Angoche grew wealthy again on ivory, rubber and a slave trade beyond European control.
zh: 安戈谢苏丹国是位于今莫桑比克北部近海安戈谢群岛上的斯瓦希里穆斯林政权。群岛自约500年起就有贸易聚落；据口述传统，基尔瓦苏丹国的流亡者于15世纪末建立苏丹国，拥立霍萨为第一任苏丹，并形成称 inhapakho 的统治贵族家族。随着基尔瓦和索法拉衰落，安戈谢成为输往印度洋的象牙、龙涎香、黄金和奴隶的替代港口，当地工匠编织的草席和草帽也闻名四方。1530年代葡萄牙人在赞比西河沿岸设立商站，马拉维人又控制了内陆，安戈谢的商队通道被切断；在经历一段松散的葡萄牙宗主权后，旧城废弃，城镇迁至新址重建。1752年的来访者发现苏丹国已经复兴并向外扩张；从1830年代起，安戈谢凭借象牙、橡胶和游离于欧洲人控制之外的奴隶贸易再度兴盛。

en: Aning was a Yi tribal polity centred on Ami, the broad basin of present-day Kaiyuan in south-eastern Yunnan. Under the Dali kingdom the Aning tribe was administered through the Zuining garrison, and after the Mongol conquest it was reorganised as the Aning Ten-Thousand-Household. The early Ming turned the territory into Ami Department under Lin'an Prefecture, ruled by hereditary Pu-family native chieftains. In 1631 the Ami chief Pu Mingsheng rose in the great Sha-Pu rebellion that shook southern Yunnan and stormed the neighbouring Mile Department, before Ming forces brought it down. In 1648, after Li Dingguo had crushed the related rising of Sha Dingzhou, the Southern Ming renamed Ami as Kaiyuan County, the first use of the name Kaiyuan; the Qing restored the old name Ami Department when they entered Yunnan in 1659.
zh: 阿宁是以阿迷（今云南东南部开远一带的宽阔坝子）为中心的彝族部落政权。大理国时期，阿宁部归最宁镇管辖；蒙古征服后被改编为阿宁万户府。明初在其地设阿迷州，隶临安府，由普氏土官世袭。1631年，阿迷土酋普名声发动了震动整个滇南的沙普之乱，一度攻陷邻境弥勒州，最终被明军平定。1648年，李定国平定沙定洲之乱后，南明改阿迷州为开远县，开远这个地名由此首次出现；1659年清军入滇，又恢复阿迷州旧名。

en: The Ahis were a fraternity of Muslim craftsmen and merchants who ruled Ankara as a self-governing commonwealth in the late thirteenth and fourteenth centuries. The order grew out of the guilds organised by the preacher Ahi Evran, a leather trader from Kayseri who bound urban workmen into religious and commercial fellowships across Seljuk Anatolia. After the Mongol victory at Kösedağ in 1243 broke Seljuk power, the Ahis of Ankara used the resulting vacuum to declare semi-independence around 1290 under Ilkhanid suzerainty. Unlike the neighbouring Turkmen beyliks, they had no ruling dynasty: their sheikhs, titled ahi baba, governed through a republic-like guild order with ranks from apprentice to master craftsman. The Ottoman ruler Orhan first occupied Ankara in 1354, and after a brief Ahi attempt to restore their rule, Murad I absorbed the commonwealth into the Ottoman state in 1362.
zh: 艾赫是由穆斯林手工业者和商人组成的兄弟会组织，在13世纪末至14世纪以自治共同体的形式统治安卡拉。该组织源于传教士艾赫·埃夫兰在塞尔柱安纳托利亚各城建立的行会：他出身开塞利皮匠，把城市工匠编入兼具宗教与商业性质的互助团体。1243年蒙古人在克塞山战役中击垮塞尔柱后，安卡拉的艾赫人趁权力真空于约1290年宣布半独立，奉伊儿汗国为宗主。与周围的突厥蛮贝伊国不同，他们没有统治王朝，由称艾赫巴巴的长老按行会式的共和体制治理，成员等级从学徒一直到工匠师傅。奥斯曼统治者奥尔汗于1354年首次占领安卡拉，艾赫人一度试图恢复自治，1362年穆拉德一世将这块共同体并入奥斯曼国家。

en:
The Ahom kingdom was a Tai state in the Brahmaputra Valley, founded in 1228 when Sukaphaa, a prince of Möng Mao, crossed the Patkai hills with some nine thousand followers and settled at Charaideo in 1253. Built on wet-rice cultivation and the offices of the Burhagohain and Borgohain nobles, the small realm called itself Mung Dun Shun Kham and slowly absorbed the peoples around it. In 1337 the throne belonged to Sukhrangpha, who ruled from 1332 to 1364 and quieted a revolt by his brother Chao Pulai by creating for him the post of Charing Raja.

The kingdom turned into a major power under Suhungmung, reigning from 1497 to 1539, who annexed the Chutia kingdom in 1523, doubled Ahom territory and took the Hindu title Swarganarayana. Under Pratap Singha the Paik labour system was reorganised in 1609 to meet the Mughal advance, and in 1662 Mir Jumla II's army stormed the capital Garhgaon; the Ahoms recovered at the Battle of Saraighat of 1671, where Lachit Borphukan broke the Mughal fleet, and after the Battle of Itakhuli in 1682 the Mughals were held permanently west of the Manas River. The long Moamoria rebellion of 1769 to 1805 shattered central authority, Burmese armies intervened from 1817, and the Treaty of Yandabo in 1826 handed Assam to the East India Company, ending nearly six centuries of Ahom rule.
zh:
阿洪姆王国是布拉马普特拉河谷的泰人国家。1228年，勐卯的王子苏卡法率约九千部众越过帕特开山，于1253年在查莱碉定居建国。国家以水稻灌溉农业为基础，设有布尔哈戈汉和巴尔戈汉两大贵族职位，自称孟顿顺坎，逐渐吸纳周边各族。1337年在位的是苏克朗帕（1332—1364年在位），他通过设立查林罗阇一职安置起兵的弟弟召布来，平息了这场兄弟之争。

1497至1539年在位的苏洪蒙时期，阿洪姆崛起为强国：1523年吞并久蒂亚王国，疆域扩大一倍，他本人也采用了印度教头衔斯瓦尔加纳拉亚纳。普拉塔普·辛格在位时，为应对莫卧儿的推进，于1609年改组派克劳役制度。1662年米尔·朱马尔二世的军队攻陷首都加尔冈，但阿洪姆人在1671年的萨拉伊加特战役中由拉吉特·巴尔普坎击溃莫卧儿舰队，重振国势；1682年伊塔胡利战役后，莫卧儿势力被永久挡在马纳斯河以西。1769至1805年旷日持久的摩亚马里亚叛乱动摇了中央权威，1817年起缅甸军队多次入侵，1826年的《杨达坡条约》把阿萨姆交给东印度公司，近六百年的阿洪姆统治至此终结。

en: Ahuacatlan was a small indigenous community of the Xalisco country in what is now southeastern Nayarit; its Nahuatl name joins ahua, avocado, and tlan, place, meaning the place of avocados. Its people were the Tecuales, whom Spanish records also labelled Otomies, speaking a language of the Corachol branch closely related to the Huichol of the nearby Wixarika highlanders. Nuno de Guzman's expedition overran the Xalisco region from 1531 and folded it into the kingdom of Nueva Galicia, called Chimalhuacan in Nahuatl; the local peoples joined the Cora, Guachichil and Caxcan rising known as the Mixton War of 1540 to 1541.
zh: 阿瓦卡特兰是今纳亚里特州东南部哈利斯科地区的一个小型原住民聚落，其纳瓦特尔语名称由“阿瓦”（鳄梨）和“特兰”（地方）组成，意为“鳄梨之地”。当地居民是特夸尔人，西班牙文献也曾把他们称作奥托米人，所讲语言属于科拉—维乔尔语支，与邻近维夏里卡斯高地居民的维乔尔语相近。1531年起，努尼奥·德·古斯曼的远征队横扫哈利斯科地区，将其纳入纳瓦特尔语称奇马尔瓦坎的新加利西亚王国；1540至1541年，当地各部族又与科拉人、瓜奇奇尔人和卡克斯坎人联合发动了米斯特顿战争。

en: Antsohihy is a town on the Loza River in northern Madagascar, in a region that in the 1300s belonged to the Antalaotra Muslim Swahili city-state world of Irodo and Mahilaka. The present town was founded at the end of the 1600s by Sakalava, Makua and Tsimihety settlers and named after the local sohihy tree.
zh: 安楚希希是马达加斯加北部洛扎河畔的城镇，1300年代其所在地区属于伊罗多、马希拉卡等安塔拉特拉穆斯林斯瓦希里城邦的圈子。今镇建于1600年代末，由萨卡拉瓦人、马夸人和齐米赫蒂人拓居，得名于当地的索希希树。

en: Aidan denotes a Jurchen clan group settled around present-day Yanji in the Buerhatong and Hailan river valleys, a region the Jin ruled through its Halan route and the Yuan through the Kaiyuan circuit of Liaoyang province. In 1337 it was a small tribal polity under Yuan overlordship, and the Ming later placed the area under its Buerhatu Guard within the Nurgan Regional Military Commission.
zh: 艾丹指定居在今延吉一带、布尔哈通河与海兰江流域的女真氏族群体。这一地区金代由曷懒路管辖，元代划归辽阳行省开元路；1337年它是臣属元朝的小型部族政权，明代当地被纳入奴儿干都司体系下的布尔哈图卫。

en: Axochitlan, whose name was later spelled Asochitlan, Asuchitlan and finally Ajuchitlan, takes its Nahuatl name from atl, water, and xochitl, flower, meaning “water with flowers”. The town lay in the hot Balsas River lowlands of the Tierra Caliente, in what is now north-western Guerrero, and was one of the Cuitlatec-speaking communities of the region, whose older centres also included Cutzamala and Pungarabato. By the late Postclassic period the Balsas basin had fallen under the power of the Purépecha Empire of Michoacán, which kept garrisons and war bands in the jurisdiction and drew tribute from its towns. After the Spanish conquest an encomienda was set over Ajuchitlan in 1528 and resumed by the Crown in 1534; in 1579 it was the head of its own jurisdiction, and the Relación de Ajuchitlán, compiled with the help of interpreters of Tarascan and Cuitlatec, described the district and recorded that the Cuitlatec tongue was still spoken in its villages.
zh: 阿霍奇特兰的名字后来又拼作阿索奇特兰、阿苏奇特兰，最终定名为阿胡奇特兰；其纳瓦特尔语名字由 atl（水）和 xochitl（花）组成，意为“有花的水”。这座城镇位于炎热的巴尔萨斯河低地——火地地区，即今格雷罗州西北部，是当地讲奎特拉特克语的社群之一，同一区域的古老中心还有库察马拉和彭加拉巴托。到后古典期晚期，巴尔萨斯盆地已落入米却肯普雷佩查帝国的势力之下，后者在这一辖区驻扎守军和武士，并向各城镇征收贡赋。西班牙征服后，阿胡奇特兰于1528年被划为监护领地，1534年收归王室；1579年它成为一个辖区的治所，当时在塔拉斯科语和奎特拉特克语译员协助下编写的《阿胡奇特兰记述》描写了该地区，并记录下奎特拉特克语仍在其村庄中使用。

en: The Ajuran Sultanate was a Somali Muslim empire of the Horn of Africa, ruled by the hereditary House of Garen, which had begun as a small kingdom in the thirteenth century and rose to dominate the Banaadir interior from the late 1300s. In 1337 it was already the paramount power along the southern Somali coast, holding the merchant city of Mogadishu as a client and ruling from Merca over a string of coastal and riverine towns. As Africa's only hydraulic empire of the age, it monopolized the Shebelle and Jubba rivers with dykes, dams and limestone wells, levied a regular tribute on neighbouring pastoral peoples and grew rich on Indian Ocean trade, minting its own coinage for commerce that reached Arabia, Persia and even China. At its height its sway ran from Hobyo in the north to Kismayo in the south and Qelafo in the west. It repelled Oromo pressure in the Gaal Madow Wars of the mid-seventeenth century and fought the Portuguese, who sacked Barawa in 1507, but by the end of that century oppressive taxation and revolts tore the empire apart: the Hiraab Imamate seized Mogadishu while Ibrahim Adeer founded the Gobroon dynasty of Geledi inland, and by the early 1700s Ajuran rule had vanished from Banaadir.
zh: 阿朱兰苏丹国是非洲之角的索马里穆斯林帝国，由世袭的加伦家族统治。该家族13世纪时还只是一个小王国，从14世纪末起崛起，主宰了巴纳迪尔内陆。1337年时，它已是索马里南部沿海的头号强权，把商业城市摩加迪沙收为附庸，并以梅尔卡为中心统治着一连串沿海与河畔城镇。作为当时非洲唯一的水利帝国，阿朱兰用堤坝、水坝和石灰岩水井控制谢贝利河与朱巴河，向周边游牧民族定期征收贡赋，还靠印度洋贸易致富，甚至自铸钱币，商路远达阿拉伯、波斯乃至中国。极盛时其势力北起霍比奥，南至基斯马尤，西抵克拉福。它在17世纪中叶的加尔马多战争中击退了奥罗莫人的压力，又与焚毁巴拉韦的葡萄牙人交战（1507年）；但到17世纪末，苛税与起义使帝国四分五裂：希拉卜伊玛目国夺取摩加迪沙，易卜拉欣·阿迪尔在内陆建立戈布龙王朝（格勒迪苏丹国），到18世纪初，阿朱兰在巴纳迪尔的统治已荡然无存。

en: Akure is counted among the sixteen ancient Ekiti kingdoms of the Yoruba, set in the upland country north-east of Ife. An earlier settlement was ruled by a chief called Alakure, but the present dynasty was founded by Omoremilekun Asodeboyede, a prince of Ile-Ife descended from Oduduwa, who passed a test set by Oduduwa himself, migrated into the region and conquered the indigenous ruler. His regnal name was Ekun, meaning leopard, which remains the royal totem and gives the Akure people their praise-name of Omo Ekun, children of the leopard. Their king, the Deji of Akure, is assisted by six high chiefs called the Iwarefa, and the palace at the centre of the town, traditionally dated to 1150, grew into a complex of more than sixteen courtyards, each reserved for a particular rite, court assembly or punishment. Through these institutions the small kingdom preserved its autonomy among the rival Ekiti and Ijesha states.
zh: 阿库雷是约鲁巴人十六个古老埃基提王国之一，地处伊费东北的丘陵地带。当地早先的定居点由一位名叫阿拉库雷的酋长统治，而现存王朝的开创者是奥杜杜瓦的后裔、来自伊莱-伊费的王子奥莫雷米尔昆·阿索德博耶德：他通过了奥杜杜瓦亲自设下的考验，迁徙至此并征服了土著首领。他的王号叫“埃昆”，意为豹，豹从此成为王室图腾，阿库雷人也在颂诗中被称作“奥莫·埃昆”，即豹的子孙。他们的国王称“阿库雷的德吉”，由六位号称“伊瓦雷法”的高级酋长辅政；城中心的王宫相传建于1150年，后来发展成拥有十六处以上庭院的建筑群，每处庭院各有专司，用于特定仪式、朝会或行刑。凭借这套制度，这个小王国在埃基提与伊杰沙诸邦的夹缝中维持了自治。

en: The medieval Kingdom of Albania was a Catholic realm on the Adriatic, ruled from the port of Durrës. Charles of Anjou, King of Sicily, took the former Byzantine coastlands with the backing of local Albanian nobles and was proclaimed king in February 1272, his kingdom stretching from Durrës south to Butrint. His drive toward Constantinople collapsed at the siege of Berat in 1281, and the Sicilian Vespers of 1282 so weakened the Angevins that the Byzantines confined them to Durrës and its district. The city passed through Serbian hands in 1296 before returning to Angevin rule in 1304 under Philip of Taranto, and from 1336 it was held by Charles, Duke of Durazzo, as an appendage of the Neapolitan crown, protected by allied Albanian families such as the Thopia and Muzaka. Serbian pressure under Stefan Dušan brought all Albania under his rule by 1346. After his empire disintegrated, Karl Thopia seized Durrës from the Angevins in 1368, called in Ottoman troops to defeat Balša II at Savra in 1385, and his son Gjergj finally surrendered the city to the Republic of Venice in 1392.
zh: 中世纪阿尔巴尼亚王国是亚得里亚海沿岸的天主教政权，以港口都拉斯为统治中心。西西里国王、安茹的查理在当地阿尔巴尼亚贵族支持下取得这片原属拜占庭的沿海土地，于1272年2月被拥立为王，疆域从都拉斯向南延伸至布特林特。他向君士坦丁堡推进的野心在1281年的培拉围攻战中破灭，1282年的西西里晚祷战争又重创安茹家族，拜占庭人随即将其势力压缩到都拉斯一带。1296年都拉斯一度落入塞尔维亚人之手，1304年塔兰托的腓力重新恢复安茹统治；1336年起由都拉斯公爵查理领有，作为那不勒斯王权的附属，并依靠托皮亚、穆扎卡等阿尔巴尼亚家族的同盟自保。斯特凡·杜尚治下的塞尔维亚不断施压，到1346年整个阿尔巴尼亚都已并入他的版图。杜尚帝国瓦解后，卡尔·托皮亚于1368年从安茹家族手中夺取都拉斯，1385年又请来奥斯曼军队在萨夫拉击败巴尔沙二世；他的儿子乔治最终于1392年把都拉斯交给威尼斯共和国。

en: The County of Alençon, on the border of Normandy and Maine with its main seat at Bellême, was first held by the House of Bellême from the tenth century. It became a royal appanage under the Capetians, granted first to Peter, a son of Louis IX, and in 1293 to Charles of Valois, brother of Philip IV. In 1337 it belonged to his son Charles II of Valois, who held it as a vassal of the French crown and was killed fighting the English at the Battle of Crécy in 1346. The county was raised to a dukedom in 1414, and the first duke, John, died at Agincourt the next year; his son John II was captured when the English took the duchy at the Battle of Verneuil in 1424 and won it back only in 1449. The line ended with the childless Duke Charles IV in 1524, after which Alençon reverted to the French crown, its title later revived as an appanage for younger princes.
zh: 阿朗松伯国地处诺曼底与曼恩交界，主府在贝莱姆，10世纪起由贝莱姆家族领有。卡佩王朝时期它成为王室封禄，先封给路易九世之子皮埃尔，1293年又封给腓力四世之弟瓦卢瓦的查理。1337年在位的是他的儿子瓦卢瓦的查理二世，以法兰西王室封臣的身份领有此地，并在1346年的克雷西战役中与英军作战时阵亡。1414年伯国升为公爵领，首任公爵约翰次年战死于阿金库尔；其子约翰二世在1424年的韦尔讷伊战役中兵败被俘，公爵领被英军占领，直到1449年才将其收复。1524年末代公爵查理四世无嗣而终，阿朗松收归法兰西王室，公爵头衔后来又作为封禄封给年幼的亲王们。

en: Kaili was a Miao tusi south of Pingyue attached to the Bozhou chiefdom; its name is a Miao form meaning the fields of the Mujiu people. The Yuan maintained a Kaili anfusi there, and after several Ming changes of guard jurisdiction it became the Kaili zhangguansi in 1607 under Pingyue Prefecture.
zh: 凯里是平越以南的苗族土司，依附于播州土司；“凯里”为苗语译音，意为木佬人的田地。元代曾设凯里安抚司，明代几经卫所改隶，至1607年降为凯里长官司，划归平越府管辖。

en: Allstedt, south of the Harz in the Saxon Helme valley, grew up around a royal palace first recorded in 777, where Henry the Fowler issued a charter in 935; the Ottonian kings kept it as one of their imperial estates between the Harz, Saale and Unstrut. From the twelfth century the castle and its lands were administered by the ministerial lords of Allstedt, whose line died out in the mid-fourteenth century. Between 1348 and 1356 Emperor Charles IV formed the surrounding estates into the County Palatine of Saxony-Allstedt and enfeoffed the Ascanian Duke Rudolf I of Saxe-Wittenberg with the count palatine's title, the county being first named in a charter of 1363. In 1369 the castle passed to the lords of Querfurt, who held it until 1496, when it fell to the Ernestine Wettins; the town itself received town rights in 1425. Allstedt became an early centre of the Reformation when Thomas Müntzer served as its pastor in 1523 and delivered his Sermon to the Princes in the castle chapel in 1524. The Amt was pledged to the counts of Mansfeld in 1526 and to the counts of Stolberg in 1542, before returning to the Wettin dukes of Saxony in 1575.
zh: 阿尔施泰特位于哈茨山以南的萨克森黑尔姆河谷，围绕一座777年即有记载的王宫发展起来，935年捕鸟者亨利曾在此颁布文书；奥托王朝的国王把它作为哈茨山、萨勒河与温斯特鲁特河之间的帝国领地之一。12世纪起，城堡及其土地由出身家臣的阿尔施泰特贵族管理，该家族于14世纪中叶绝嗣。1348至1356年间，皇帝查理四世把周边领地组建为萨克森—阿尔施泰特行宫伯爵领，将行宫伯爵头衔封给阿斯坎尼家族的萨克森—维滕贝格公爵鲁道夫一世，伯爵领在1363年的一份文书中首次被点名。1369年城堡转入奎尔富特贵族之手，一直持有到1496年，随后落入韦廷家族恩斯特支系；城镇本身则在1425年获得城市权。1523年托马斯·闵采尔在此担任牧师，1524年在城堡小教堂发表《诸侯讲道》，阿尔施泰特由此成为宗教改革早期的中心。1526年该领地被抵押给曼斯费尔德伯爵，1542年又抵押给施托尔贝格伯爵，最终于1575年回到萨克森的韦廷公爵手中。

en: Alania was the medieval kingdom of the Alans, Iranian-speaking horsemen of the Sarmatian world who had settled the North Caucasian plain and foothills from the Kuban to the Darial Pass. Breaking free of Khazar overlordship in the late ninth century, the Alans were converted to Orthodox Christianity by Byzantine missionaries early in the tenth, and under King Durgulel in the eleventh the kingdom reached its peak, rich from the trade road through the Darial Gorge and famed for its cavalry, which served Byzantium and Georgia as mercenaries and carried Christianity to the neighbouring Circassians and Vainakhs. Its capital, Maghas, ruled a dense network of settlements that Arab writers counted at a thousand. The kingdom weakened from the twelfth century, and its best-known prince of that age, David Soslan, married Queen Tamar of Georgia. In 1239 and 1240 the Mongols stormed Maghas and carried off thousands of Alan horsemen to serve as the imperial guard of the Yuan in China, though highland Alans kept their freedom and their faith, as the traveler William of Rubruck, who in 1253 still found them fighting the Tartars, attested. Timur's campaigns of 1395 shattered the lowland remnant: the survivors retreated into the mountain gorges, where they became the Ossetians, divided into Iron and Digor, while groups remaining on the plain merged with the Kabardians and the Karachay-Balkars. The Ossetian highlanders lived in near-isolation until 1774, when they sought Russian protection, and the building of the Vladikavkaz fortress in 1784 opened the Russian conquest of the Caucasus.
zh: 阿兰尼亚是阿兰人的中世纪王国。阿兰人属萨尔马提亚体系的伊朗语骑兵民族，分布在从库班河到达里亚尔山口的北高加索平原与山前地带。9世纪末他们摆脱可萨人的宗主权，10世纪初经拜占庭传教士皈依东正教；11世纪杜尔古列尔王在位时国力鼎盛，凭借达里亚尔峡谷商路致富，其骑兵作为雇佣军效力于拜占庭和格鲁吉亚，并把基督教传给邻近的切尔克斯人和瓦伊纳赫人。阿拉伯作家记载，都城马加斯统辖着上千个聚落，村庄相望。12世纪起王国转弱，这一时期最著名的王公大卫·索斯兰迎娶了格鲁吉亚的塔玛尔女王；1239至1240年蒙古人攻破马加斯，掳走数千阿兰骑兵远赴中国充当元朝的御林护军，但山地阿兰人保住了自由和信仰——旅行家鲁布鲁克1253年仍见到他们在与鞑靼人作战。1395年帖木儿的远征摧毁了平原上的残余势力，幸存者退入高山峡谷，逐渐形成分为伊龙和季戈尔两支的奥塞梯人，留在平原的则融入卡巴尔达人、卡拉恰伊人和巴尔卡尔人。奥塞梯山民几乎与世隔绝，直到1774年主动请求俄罗斯保护；1784年弗拉季高加索要塞的修建，拉开了俄罗斯征服高加索的序幕。

en: Alodia, or Alwa, was the southernmost and for centuries the greatest of the three medieval Christian kingdoms of Nubia, ruling the Gezira and Butana plains of central Sudan from its capital Soba at the meeting of the Blue and White Niles. It emerged after the fall of ancient Kush, is first named in records in 569 and adopted Christianity in 580. Between the ninth and twelfth centuries it outshone its northern neighbour Makuria in size, wealth and arms: Soba was famed for its gold-hung churches and gardens, drew goods from the Middle East, India and China, and nurtured literacy in both Nubian and Greek under a king served by provincial governors and vassal rulers. Decline set in during the twelfth century under southern invasions, long droughts and the rise of rival Red Sea trade cities; by 1276 its northern province al-Abwab had broken away, and in 1337 Alodia was already a shrinking, fragmenting realm. Arab Bedouin migrations from the early fourteenth century steadily eroded what remained, until around 1500 Soba was destroyed, whether by the Arab leader Abdallah Jammah or the Funj king Amara Dunqas, who founded the Funj Sultanate of Sennar on its ruins in 1504. Pockets of Nubian Christianity lingered on, and in 1520 envoys still travelled to Ethiopia begging for priests.
zh: 阿洛迪亚又称阿尔瓦，是中世纪努比亚三个基督教王国中位置最南、也曾是最强大的一个，以青尼罗河与白尼罗河交汇处的索巴为都，统治苏丹中部的杰济拉与布塔纳平原。它在古库施王国灭亡后兴起，569年首见记载，580年皈依基督教。9至12世纪是它的鼎盛期，疆域、财富和军力都超过北方邻邦马库里亚：都城索巴以饰金的教堂和园林闻名，商旅辐辏，货物来自中东、印度乃至中国，在国王和各地总督、附庸君长的治理下，努比亚语与希腊语的书面文化都很繁荣。12世纪起，南方入侵、长期干旱和红海新兴商埠的竞争使它走向衰落；到1276年，北方省份艾卜瓦卜已分裂独立，1337年时的阿洛迪亚已是一个不断萎缩、趋于瓦解的王国。14世纪初以来阿拉伯贝都因人的迁徙逐步侵蚀其残余疆土，约1500年索巴陷落，摧毁它的或为阿拉伯首领阿卜杜拉·贾马，或为丰吉国王阿马拉·敦卡斯；后者于1504年在其废墟上建立丰吉森纳尔苏丹国。努比亚基督教的余脉仍零星存续，1520年还有使者远赴埃塞俄比亚恳求派遣神父。

en: Strasbourgum is the prince-bishopric of Strasbourg, the secular territory ruled by the city's bishop alongside his ancient diocese, which reached back to Roman times and belonged to the province of Mainz. The bishops had held mint rights since 974 and jurisdiction within the city since 982, and between 1223 and 1260 Bishops Berthold I of Teck and Henry III of Stahleck built up a scattered lordship stretching from the Palatinate to the Black Forest. Their hold on Strasbourg itself broke in the Bellum Walterianum: the burghers defeated Bishop Walter of Geroldseck at the Battle of Hausbergen in 1262, and the city became fully imperial in 1352. In 1337 the see was held by Berthold of Buchegg, who ruled until 1353; under his successors the bishops acquired Oberkirch, took the Ortenau in pledge and from 1359 styled themselves Landgraves of Alsace, holding some three hundred villages over about 1,400 square kilometres, with their residence at Saverne from 1444. The Reformation turned the city Protestant and led to a long chapter dispute that ended only in 1604, while the Thirty Years' War drove the bishops from their lands for a time. French pressure then mounted: Louis XIV's reunion policy forced recognition of French sovereignty over the left-bank territories in 1680, confirmed at Ryswick in 1697. After French troops occupied the remainder in 1789, the right-bank lands were secularised to Baden as the Principality of Ettenheim in 1803.
zh: 斯特拉斯堡指斯特拉斯堡采邑主教区，即该城主教在古老教区之外兼领的世俗领地；教区可追溯至罗马时代，教会体系上隶属美因茨教省。主教自974年拥有铸币权、982年起掌握城内司法权；1223至1260年间，泰克的贝特霍尔德一世和施塔莱克的海因里希三世两位主教建起一块从普法尔茨延伸到黑林山的分散领地。他们对斯特拉斯堡城本身的控制却在“瓦尔特战争”中瓦解：1262年市民在豪斯贝根战役击败盖罗尔德塞克的瓦尔特主教，城市最终于1352年成为完全的帝国自由市。1337年坐在主教座上的是布赫格的贝特霍尔德，他一直任职到1353年；其继任者取得奥伯基希、抵押领有奥尔特瑙，并从1359年起自称阿尔萨斯方伯，领有约1400平方公里内的三百个村庄，1444年起主要驻跸萨韦尔讷。宗教改革使城市改宗新教，引发持续的主教座堂纷争，直到1604年才告平息；三十年战争中主教还一度被逐出境。此后法国压力日增：路易十四的重并政策迫使主教区于1680年承认法国对莱茵河左岸领地的主权，1697年的《赖斯韦克条约》予以确认。1789年法军占领剩余领地后，右岸部分于1803年作为埃滕海姆侯国被世俗化，划归巴登。

en: The Alupa dynasty ruled the forested coastal strip of Tulu Nadu, called Alvakheda, from about the year 200 to the fifteenth century. The second-century geographer Ptolemy already knew the land as Olokhoira. The Alupas held their own in the age of the Kadambas of Banavasi, then served in turn as feudatories of the Badami and Western Chalukyas, the Rashtrakutas and the Hoysalas, and finally of Vijayanagara. Their kings ruled first from Mangalore, later from Udyavara in Udupi and then Barkur, and used Kannada as the language of administration; their pagoda and fanam coins carried the Two Fishes emblem. Originally Jain followers with marriage ties to the Santara dynasty of Karkala, many branches later turned to Hinduism. The long line ended with Kulasekharadeva Alupendradeva, whose last inscription was placed in the Jain monastery at Mudabidri in 1444, after which the Alupa lands passed under the direct rule of Vijayanagara.
zh: 阿楼波王朝统治着图卢纳德林木茂密的沿海地带，其地称阿尔瓦凯达，时间从约200年一直延续到15世纪。2世纪的地理学家托勒密已知道此地，称之为奥洛克伊拉。阿楼波人在巴纳瓦西的卡丹巴王朝时代保持自立，此后先后臣属于巴达米与西遮娄其、罗湿陀罗拘陀、曷萨拉，最后又归附毗奢耶那伽罗。其君主先以门格洛尔为都，后来迁往乌杜皮的乌迪亚瓦拉，再迁至巴尔库尔，行政语言用卡纳达语；他们铸造的宝塔金币与法南铜币上刻有“双鱼”王徽。王室原本信奉耆那教，与卡尔卡拉的桑塔拉王朝联姻，后来许多支派改宗印度教。王朝末代君主库拉谢卡拉提婆·阿楼彭陀罗提婆的最后一方铭文于1444年立在穆达比德里的耆那教寺院，此后阿楼波故地被毗奢耶那伽罗直接管辖。

en: Alaiye, the medieval name for the fortress port of Alanya on Anatolia's southern coast, was a Turkmen beylik whose chiefs traced their origin to the Karamanlu branch of the Afshar tribe. After the Seljuk defeat at Kösedağ in 1243 the port slipped from Seljuk control, and in 1293 the Karamanid prince Bedreddin Mahmud captured it and founded the ruling line; the traveller Ibn Battuta later found Yusuf Bey, who reigned from about 1330 to 1337, governing the city as an effectively independent ruler. Christian pressure from the sea continued, with failed attacks by Henry II of Jerusalem in 1291 and Peter I of Cyprus in 1366. In 1427 the Karamanid Ibrahim Bey II sold Alaiye to the Mamluk sultan Barsbay for five thousand gold coins, and in 1471 the Ottoman general Gedik Ahmed Pasha conquered it from the last bey, Kılıç Arslan, ending the principality.
zh: 阿拉耶是地中海岸安纳托利亚要塞港口阿拉尼亚的中世纪名称，统治这里的贝伊国是一个突厥蛮政权，统治家族出自阿夫沙尔部落的卡拉曼卢支系。1243年克塞山战役后，该港脱离塞尔柱控制；1293年卡拉曼王公贝德尔丁·马哈茂德将其攻取，开创了统治世系。旅行家伊本·白图泰后来到访时，见到约1330年至1337年在位的优素福贝伊已在近乎独立地治理此城。基督徒的海上压力持续不断，耶路撒冷国王亨利二世1291年、塞浦路斯国王皮埃尔一世1366年的进攻都以失败告终。1427年，卡拉曼的易卜拉欣贝伊二世以五千枚金币把阿拉耶卖给马穆鲁克苏丹巴尔斯拜；1471年，奥斯曼将领格迪克·艾哈迈德帕夏从末代贝伊克勒奇·阿尔斯兰手中攻克该城，贝伊国灭亡。

en: Armagh was above all an ecclesiastical city, built around the see founded by Saint Patrick around 445 on the hill of Ard-Macha, the height of Macha. Its bishop claimed succession to Patrick and primacy over the whole Irish church; its famous school drew scholars from across Europe, and the Book of Armagh preserved the traditions of the foundation, while Viking raiders sacked the city many times. The Synod of Kells in 1152 made Armagh a metropolitan archbishopric whose holder bore the title Primate of All Ireland, and the archbishops ruled both a diocese and a compact temporal lordship around the city. In 1337 the archbishop was David Mageraghty, who ruled until 1346 and was followed by the renowned theologian Richard FitzRalph. At the Reformation the see split into Catholic and Church of Ireland successions; after the Williamite war Catholic primates were driven into exile or hiding under the penal laws, and only in the nineteenth century could a Catholic archbishop reside openly in Armagh again.
zh: 阿马首先是一座教会之城，围绕圣帕特里克约445年在阿尔德马卡（意为“马查之高地”）建立的主教座发展起来。其主教自称继承帕特里克之位，享有全爱尔兰教会的首席地位；当地的著名学府吸引了欧洲各地的学生，《阿马书》保存了该教区的古老传统，而维京海盗曾多次洗劫这座城市。1152年的凯尔斯宗教会议将阿马升格为都主教大主教区，其主教领有“全爱尔兰首席主教”头衔，大主教们既治理教区，也统治城市周围一片不大的世俗领地。1337年在任的是大卫·马杰拉蒂，他任职至1346年，继任者是著名神学家理查德·菲茨拉尔夫。宗教改革后天主教与爱尔兰国教各有一套主教传承；威廉战争之后，天主教首席主教在宗教迫害法律下被迫流亡或藏身，直到19世纪天主教大主教才能重新公开驻锡阿马。

en: Amdo, also called Domey, is the north-eastern of the three traditional Tibetan regions, reaching from the upper Yellow River and Lake Qinghai to the Yangtze headwaters and bounded on the south by the Bayan Har Mountains; its people are known as Amdowa. Before the Tibetan Empire's rise it held the Sumpa and Tuyuhun powers, both absorbed by Tibet in the seventh century. After the empire's ninth-century collapse, the Tibetan royal descendant Gusiluo built the Tsongkha theocracy there, which lasted from 997 to 1104. The Mongol conquest of the thirteenth century opened the priest-and-patron bond between Tibetan lamas and Mongol khans, and from the fourteenth to the sixteenth centuries the Ming held only its eastern marches while Mongol tribes remained dominant on the grasslands. In 1642 Gushri Khan's Khoshut Mongols occupied the Kokonor pastures, and after the Qing campaign of 1723 the Yongzheng emperor separated Amdo from central Tibet and placed it under the Qinghai amban at Xining, ruling through local Tibetan chiefs and great monasteries. Amdo was the birthplace of Je Tsongkhapa, reformer of the Gelug order.
zh: 安多又称朵麦，是藏族传统三大区域中位于东北方的一个，范围从黄河上游与青海湖一直延伸到长江源头，南以巴颜喀拉山为界，居民称安多人。吐蕃兴起之前，这里有苏毗和吐谷浑等政权，二者都在7世纪被吐蕃吞并。吐蕃帝国于9世纪崩溃后，吐蕃王室后裔唃厮啰在此建立宗喀国，统治时间为997年至1104年。13世纪蒙古征服此地，开启了藏族喇嘛与蒙古汗王之间的供施关系；14至16世纪，明朝只控制安多的东部边缘，蒙古部落仍在草原上称雄。1642年固始汗率领和硕特蒙古占据青海湖牧场，1723年清朝用兵之后，雍正帝将安多从西藏地方划出，交由驻西宁的青海办事大臣管辖，通过当地藏族首领和各大寺院实施统治。安多也是格鲁派改革者宗喀巴的诞生地。

en: Ameca, whose Nahuatl name Amecatl means string of water, was a small Nahua kingdom in the Valles region of western Jalisco, watered by the river that still bears its name. In 1522 the soldier Juan de Anesta entered the town alone and barefoot, sword in hand, and its people, recalling a prophecy of strangers who would come to rule, received him as a son of the sun; the kingdom was brought under Spanish control in 1524. Fray Antonio de Cuellar built an adobe chapel and laid out the central square from 1529, but he was killed by arrow wounds in the Etzatlan mountains during the Mixton War rising of 1541, when Ameca's warriors fought beside those of Tequila and Ahualulco. The town became a Spanish municipal seat in 1549, passed to the Cocula department in 1824, and was declared a city in 1833.
zh: 阿梅卡的纳瓦特尔语原名阿梅卡特，意为“水绳”，是哈利斯科西部巴列斯地区的一个小型纳瓦王国，同名的阿梅卡河穿境而过。1522年，士兵胡安·德·阿内斯塔赤脚孤身、手持长剑走进城中；当地人想起一则预言，说将有外来者前来统治，便把他当作太阳之子迎接，1524年这个小王国正式落入西班牙人控制。1529年起，修士安东尼奥·德·奎利亚尔建起土坯礼拜堂并规划中央广场；1541年米斯特顿战争爆发，阿梅卡战士与特基拉、阿瓦卢尔科的义军并肩作战，奎利亚尔也在这一年于埃察特兰山中中箭身亡。1549年城镇成为西班牙人治下的市政驻地，1824年划入科库拉行政区，1833年正式升格为城市。

en: The County of Armagnac lay between the Adour and Garonne rivers in the foothills of the Pyrenees, with its chief town at Auch, the Roman Civitas Ausciorum. It was split off from the older County of Fezensac in 960 under Count Bernard le Louche, and by the Treaty of Meaux in 1229 it was the strongest fief in Gascony, its rulers ranking with the counts of Foix and the lords of Albret as the great southern princes. In 1337 the count was John I, who had succeeded in 1319 and began the family's fourteenth-century expansion, adding the counties of Rodez and Carlat and the viscounties of Lomagne and Comminges by marriage and purchase. The Treaty of Brétigny in 1360 handed the region to England, but the harsh rule of the Black Prince drove John to seek the protection of Charles V in 1369. Under Count Bernard VII the family led the Armagnac party against Burgundy in the civil wars that lasted until 1435, and its mercenary companies fought the Swiss in the Armagnac War of 1444. Jacques d'Armagnac was attainted in 1477 and his lands were seized by Louis XI; the county finally reverted to the crown in 1751.
zh: 阿马尼亚克伯国位于比利牛斯山北麓的阿杜尔河与加龙河之间，主城欧什即古罗马的欧什城辖区。960年，它在贝尔纳·勒卢什治下从更古老的费藏萨克伯国分出；到1229年《莫城条约》签订时，它已是加斯科涅最强大的封地，其领主与富瓦伯爵、阿尔布雷领主并称南方三大诸侯。1337年在位的让一世于1319年继位，他开启了家族在14世纪的扩张，通过联姻和购地陆续取得罗代兹伯国、卡拉伯国以及洛马涅、科曼日等子爵领。1360年的《布勒丁尼条约》把这一地区割给英格兰，但黑太子的苛政迫使让于1369年向查理五世寻求庇护。贝尔纳七世伯爵时期，家族在延续至1435年的内战中率领阿马尼亚克派对抗勃艮第，其雇佣兵团还在1444年的阿马尼亚克战争中攻入瑞士。雅克·德·阿马尼亚克于1477年被判叛国，领地被路易十一没收；伯国最终于1751年收归王室。

en: Ardmire was the chiefry of the Ó Dochartaigh clan in the fertile Laggan district around Raphoe in eastern Donegal, within the Gaelic kingdom of Tyrconnell. The O'Dohertys, named from the tenth-century Dochartach, were a leading sept of the Cenél Conaill and kinsmen of the O'Donnells, tracing their line to Conall Gulban, son of Niall of the Nine Hostages; the annals style their chiefs Chiefs of Ardmire. Their seat at Raphoe, in Irish Ráth Bhoth, was an old monastic place founded by Saint Columba around 550 and developed by Adamnan, the patron after whom Raphoe's cathedral was named, though John de Courcy's Normans sacked the church there in 1198. In the fourteenth century the clan held these Laggan lands as vassals of the O'Donnells, and only began its move north after 1359 under Conor-an-Einigh O Dochartaigh, the first of the line to settle in Inishowen, where the O'Dohertys became Lords of Inishowen early in the fifteenth century. They kept that lordship until 1608, when Sir Cahir O'Doherty's rebellion ended with his death at the Battle of Kilmacrennan and the confiscation of all the clan's lands for the Ulster plantation.
zh: 阿德迈尔是奥多尔蒂氏族在多尼戈尔东部拉福周围肥沃的拉根地区拥有的酋长领地，地处盖尔人的泰尔康奈尔王国境内。奥多尔蒂氏得名于10世纪的多哈尔塔赫，是康纳尔部族的重要支系，与奥唐纳家族同宗，世系可追溯到“九质之尼尔”之子康纳尔·古尔班；编年史称其首领为“阿德迈尔酋长”。他们的驻地拉福，爱尔兰语意为“堡垒小屋”，是古老的修道院重地，约550年由圣科伦巴建立、阿达姆南扩建，后来的拉福主教座堂即以他为主保命名，不过1198年曾遭约翰·德库西率领的诺曼人洗劫。14世纪时，该氏族作为奥唐纳家族的附庸领有拉根故土，1359年后才在科纳尔·安埃尼·奥多尔蒂带领下开始北迁——他是家族中第一个定居因尼肖温的人，奥多尔蒂氏也于15世纪初成为因尼肖温领主。他们保有该领地直到1608年：卡希尔·奥多尔蒂爵士发动起义，最终在基尔麦克雷南战役中阵亡，氏族全部土地被没收，用于阿尔斯特种植园。

en: Amollan, called Amole in the Spanish accounts, was the leading state of the Amula country in the highlands of what is now southern Jalisco. Two smaller states, Copalla and Teotitlan, depended on it, while Cozolapa and Tuxcacuexco bordered it. Its people spoke Amultecan and other languages of the western Otomi group, distinct from the Otomi of central Mexico. Early in the sixteenth century Amollan and its neighbours fought off attempts by the Purépecha to overrun the region. Spanish forces took the area in 1523, and by the early 1530s its towns had been grouped into the colonial province of Amula; Franciscan friars arrived in the 1540s, although a permanent parish organization was not set up until 1579.
zh: 阿莫兰在西班牙文献中称阿莫尔，是今哈利斯科南部阿穆拉高地最主要的政权。科帕亚和特奥蒂特兰两个小邦附属于它，邻邦则有科索拉帕和图斯卡库埃斯科。居民使用阿莫尔特卡语等西奥托米语支语言，与墨西哥中部的奥托米语不同。16世纪初，阿莫兰与邻邦联手击退了普雷佩查人的多次入侵。1523年西班牙军队夺取该地区，到16世纪30年代初，这些村镇被编入殖民时期的阿穆拉省；方济各会修士在40年代已经到来，固定的教区组织却迟至1579年才建立。

en: Amapila represents the small mountain polity of the Tlacalahuastla district, a Nahuatl name meaning the place where blowguns abound, in the rugged highlands on the border of Colima and Michoacán, around modern Minatitlán. Its scattered villages were inhabited by Otomí-speaking and Nahua groups who kept to the sierras rather than the coastal plains. After the Spanish conquest the district was granted in 1551 to the soldier Francisco de Santos as an encomienda; harsh labour demands drove its people to take refuge in the Telcruz and Tocxin mountains, and the neighbouring Coalcomán range remained a centre of indigenous revolt through the early colonial years.
zh: 阿马皮拉对应特拉卡拉瓦斯特拉地区的山地小邦，这个纳瓦特尔语地名意为“盛产吹箭筒之地”，位于科利马与米却肯交界的崎岖高地，即今米纳蒂特兰一带。散布的村落由说奥托米语的族群和纳瓦人居住，他们固守山区而不下到沿海平原。西班牙征服后，该地区于1551年被作为监护征赋地封给士兵弗朗西斯科·德·桑托斯；沉重的劳役迫使居民逃入特尔克鲁斯山和托克辛山，邻近的科阿尔科曼山区在殖民早期也一直是土著起事的中心。

en: The Al Mira were the leading Bedouin tribe of the Hauran in southern Syria, with grazing grounds that ran from the Golan through the volcanic Harra towards Arabia. With the Al Fadl they formed one of the two main branches of the Banu Rabi'ah, themselves part of the Tayy and descendants of the tenth-century Jarrahids; their forefather Mira was a son of the emir Rabi'ah, who had led tribal cavalry for the Burid and Zengid rulers of Damascus. After the Mamluk conquest of 1260 the Al Mira became known as the muluk al-arab, the kings of the Bedouin of the south, and Sultan Baybars left them practically independent of the Al Fadl amir al-arab who commanded the tribes of northern Syria. From Irbid they policed the desert roads, supplied horses and guarded the Hajj caravans, and in 1281 they fielded some four thousand horsemen against the Ilkhanid Mongols at the Battle of Homs. Around 1389 their emir Anqa joined the rebel Mintash against Sultan Barquq and was killed soon after, and in the wake of Tamerlane's invasion of 1400 to 1401 a Mamluk expedition crushed their rising at Suwayda. Their emir Janbay was still escorting the pilgrimage in the 1480s, but after the Ottoman conquest of 1516 the Al Mira were eclipsed in the Hauran by the Mafarija and Sardiyya tribes.
zh: 米拉人是叙利亚南部豪兰地区首屈一指的贝都因部落，牧场从戈兰经火山遍布的哈拉一直延伸到阿拉伯方向。他们与法德勒人同为巴努·拉比阿的两大支系，而巴努·拉比阿属于塔伊部落，是10世纪贾拉王朝统治者的后裔；始祖米拉是埃米尔拉比阿之子，拉比阿曾率部落骑兵为大马士革的布里德和赞吉王朝效力。1260年马穆鲁克征服后，米拉人被称为南方的贝都因之王，苏丹拜巴尔斯让他们几乎不受统领北叙利亚诸部的法德勒系阿拉伯埃米尔节制。他们以伊尔比德为据点，维持沙漠道路治安、供应马匹并护卫朝觐商队；1281年，他们在霍姆斯战役中出动约四千骑兵对抗伊儿汗国的蒙古人。约1389年，其埃米尔安卡加入叛将蒙塔什一方反对苏丹巴尔库克，不久被杀；1400至1401年帖木儿入侵之后，马穆鲁克远征军在苏韦达镇压了他们的起事。15世纪80年代，埃米尔詹贝仍在护送朝觐者，但1516年奥斯曼征服之后，米拉人在豪兰的地位被马法里贾和萨尔迪耶部落取代。

en: Amacoztitlan was one of the small Nahua altepetl of the Tlalnahuac, the cotton-growing Amatzinac basin of eastern Morelos, whose Tlahuica people had settled there in the early fourteenth century. Like the rest of the Tlalnahuac it entered the Aztec tribute system under Moctezuma I around 1440, and Sandoval's army overran the district in March 1521.
zh: 阿玛科兹蒂特兰是特拉尔纳瓦克的一个纳瓦人小邦，地处莫雷洛斯东部阿马齐纳克河流域的产棉之地，居民属于14世纪初就定居于此的纳瓦支系特拉维卡人。与特拉尔纳瓦克的其他城镇一样，它在1440年前后被蒙特祖马一世纳入阿兹特克贡赋体系，1521年3月又被桑多瓦尔的军队攻占。

en: The County of Arnsberg was a Sauerland lordship between the Ruhr and the Möhne, created in the eleventh century when the counts of Werl, whose older power had once stretched as far as the North Sea, moved their seat to a new castle above Arnsberg. The town grew up beneath that castle, while a junior branch of the family was provided with the County of Rietberg; after Rietberg was ceded in 1237, Arnsberg covered roughly the later Arnsberg and Meschede districts. Hemmed in by the expanding archbishopric of Cologne and the County of Mark, the counts could not enlarge their lands and instead consolidated them internally, keeping one of Westphalia's earliest feudal registers. A feud lost to Cologne had already cost them Hüsten and other rights, and when the last count, Gottfried IV, remained childless, he sold the entire county to the archbishopric in 1368. Arnsberg thereupon became the centre of the Cologne Duchy of Westphalia; in 1437 it also became the seat of the Vehmic court moved from Dortmund, and after the Napoleonic upheaval it was assigned to Prussia in 1815 as an administrative centre of the Province of Westphalia.
zh: 阿恩斯贝格伯国是鲁尔河与默讷河之间绍尔兰山区的领地，11世纪时由韦尔伯爵家族建立：该家族昔日势力一度远及北海，此时把治所迁到阿恩斯贝格上方的新城堡，城镇便在城堡脚下兴起。家族的旁支受封里特贝格伯国；1237年里特贝格被割让后，阿恩斯贝格的疆域大致相当于后来的阿恩斯贝格区和梅舍德区。由于被扩张中的科隆大主教区和马克伯国夹在中间，伯爵们无力向外扩张，转而对内整合领地，并保有威斯特伐利亚最早的封建登记册之一。在一场败给科隆的私战中，他们已失去许斯滕等地的权利；末代伯爵戈特弗里德四世无嗣，遂于1368年把整个伯国出售给科隆大主教区。阿恩斯贝格从此成为科隆属下威斯特伐利亚公国的中心，1437年又成为从多特蒙德迁来的菲姆法庭所在地；拿破仑时代的动荡之后，它于1815年划归普鲁士，成为威斯特伐利亚省的行政中心。

en: Ancona was founded around 387 BC by Greek settlers from Syracuse, who named it after the elbow-shaped promontory guarding its harbour and set up a Tyrian purple dye works there. Under Rome it was the Adriatic naval station nearest Dalmatia; Julius Caesar seized it after crossing the Rubicon, and Trajan enlarged the port, whose Arch of Trajan was raised in 115. After Saracen raiders burned the city in 840, it became the capital of the March of Ancona. From the eleventh century it was a free maritime republic, governed by six Elders, minting its own agontano coin and trading in alliance with Ragusa and Byzantium against Venetian competition; it beat off imperial assaults in 1137, 1167 and 1174 and took the Guelph side. Unlike most Italian cities it never became a signoria, save when the Malatesta exploited the Black Death to seize it in 1348; they were expelled in 1383. In 1532 Pope Clement VII ended its freedom and built the great Citadel, and Ancona remained a fortress of the Papal States, where French troops landed and garrisoned the city in 1832.
zh: 安科纳约在公元前387年由叙拉古的希腊移民建立，因护卫海港的肘形海角得名，当地还设有推罗紫染料作坊。罗马时代它是亚得里亚海距达尔马提亚最近的海军基地；尤利乌斯·恺撒渡过卢比孔河后随即占据此城，图拉真扩建了港口，纪念他的图拉真凯旋门于115年立起。840年撒拉森劫掠者焚毁城市后，它成为安科纳边区的首府。11世纪起它是自由的海洋共和国，由六位长老治理，自铸阿贡塔诺钱币，为抗衡威尼斯而与拉古萨和拜占庭结盟通商，并在1137年、1167年和1174年击退神圣罗马帝国的进攻，政治上站在归尔夫派一边。与多数意大利城市不同，它从未沦为个人独裁，只有马拉泰斯塔家族趁黑死病之乱于1348年夺城，但也在1383年被逐走。1532年教皇克雷芒七世终结其自由，修建宏伟的要塞，安科纳从此成为教皇国的要塞城市，1832年法国军队又在此登陆驻守。

en: The County of Angoulême, the Angoumois, centred on the rocky plateau above the Charente river, began as the Roman town of Iculisma and was taken from the Visigoths by Clovis in 508. Vikings sacked it in 848, and Count William I, who defeated a later Norse band in battle, took the nickname Taillefer, borne by his line of counts until the heiress Isabella of Angoulême married King John of England and then, in 1220, Hugh X of Lusignan. When the Lusignan line died out in 1302, the county reverted to the French crown, which later granted it to Philip of Évreux, the future Philip III of Navarre, and his wife Joan II; in 1337 they held it as a royal appanage. The Treaty of Brétigny ceded Angoumois to Edward III of England in 1360, and John Chandos took possession for the English the next year, until the troops of Charles V drove them out in 1373. In 1394 the county passed to Louis of Orléans, whose grandson Francis of Angoulême inherited the French throne as Francis I in 1515, after which Angoumois became a royal duchy. John Calvin found refuge there in 1533 while drafting his Institutes, and in 1548 the countryside rose in the Revolt of the Pitauds against the salt tax.
zh: 昂古莱姆伯国又称昂古穆瓦，中心是雄踞夏朗德河畔岩石高地上的昂古莱姆城，其前身是罗马城镇伊库利斯马，508年被克洛维从西哥特人手中夺取。848年维京人洗劫了它，伯爵纪尧姆一世在后来一次迎战诺斯人的战斗中获胜，得到“铁裁”的绰号，他的后裔世代袭用此号，直到女继承人伊莎贝尔嫁给英格兰国王约翰，又在1220年改嫁吕西尼昂的于格十世。1302年吕西尼昂家族绝嗣，伯国收归法兰西王室，后来封给埃夫勒的腓力——即后来的纳瓦拉国王腓力三世——及其妻让娜二世；1337年他们以王室封禄的形式领有此地。1360年《布勒丁尼条约》把昂古穆瓦割让给英格兰国王爱德华三世，约翰·钱多斯次年正式接管，直到1373年查理五世的军队将英军逐走。1394年伯国转给奥尔良的路易，他的孙子昂古莱姆的弗朗索瓦于1515年登上法兰西王位，即弗朗索瓦一世，昂古穆瓦随之成为王室公爵领。1533年约翰·加尔文曾在此避难并起草《基督教要义》，1548年乡间又爆发了反抗盐税的皮托起义。

en: Anhalt was the homeland of the Ascanian dynasty, whose ancestors, the counts of Ballenstedt, held lands in Eastphalia from the eleventh century. Count Otto the Rich built Anhalt Castle in the Harz, and his son Albert the Bear went on to found the Margraviate of Brandenburg in 1157. When the Saxon duchy of Henry the Lion was broken up, Bernhard of Ascania's son Henry I secured the Anhalt lands in 1212 and was raised to prince of the Holy Roman Empire in 1218. His sons partitioned the principality in 1252 into the lines of Aschersleben, Bernburg and Zerbst; the Aschersleben line died out in 1315 and its lands passed to Halberstadt. In 1337 the Zerbst line, headed by Prince Albert II and seated at Zerbst, was one of the surviving Ascanian states. The Bernburg line followed in 1468 and its lands fell to Zerbst. Anhalt embraced the Reformation very early: Wolfgang of Anhalt-Köthen was among the first rulers to introduce Protestantism and signed the Augsburg Confession in 1530, and Lutheranism became the faith of all the Ascanian branches. Joachim Ernest briefly united the whole principality in 1570, but it was split again in 1603 and suffered heavily in the Thirty Years' War. When the Holy Roman Empire dissolved in 1806, Napoleon raised the surviving states of Anhalt-Bernburg, Anhalt-Dessau and Anhalt-Köthen to sovereign duchies.
zh: 安哈尔特是阿斯坎尼家族的故土，其先祖巴伦施泰特伯爵家族自11世纪起领有东法伦的土地。富人奥托伯爵在哈茨山区修建了安哈尔特城堡，他的儿子大熊阿尔贝于1157年开创了勃兰登堡藩侯国。狮子亨利的萨克森公国被瓜分后，阿斯坎尼的伯恩哈德之子亨利一世于1212年获得安哈尔特领地，并在1218年受封为神圣罗马帝国的诸侯。他的儿子们于1252年把亲王国分为阿舍斯莱本、贝恩堡和采尔布斯特三支；阿舍斯莱本支系于1315年绝嗣，土地并入哈尔伯施塔特。1337年，以采尔布斯特为都、由阿尔贝二世统领的采尔布斯特支系是尚存的阿斯坎尼邦国之一。贝恩堡本支于1468年绝嗣，领地归入采尔布斯特。安哈尔特很早便接受宗教改革：安哈尔特-克滕的沃尔夫冈是最早推行新教的统治者之一，并于1530年签署《奥格斯堡信纲》，路德宗随后成为阿斯坎尼各支的共同信仰。约阿希姆·恩斯特曾于1570年短暂统一整个亲王国，但1603年再度分裂，并在三十年战争中遭到重创。1806年神圣罗马帝国解体时，拿破仑把尚存的安哈尔特-贝恩堡、安哈尔特-德绍和安哈尔特-克滕升格为拥有主权的公国。

en: The Aruni were a people of the Arequipa region in the southern Peruvian Andes, whose valley settlements lay around the Cotahuasi river country together with the Alca and Kutawasi peoples. After the Inca conquests of the fifteenth century their lands were absorbed into the Inca huamani, or province, of Contisuyo.
zh: 阿鲁尼人是秘鲁南部安第斯山区阿雷基帕一带的族群，与阿尔卡人、科塔瓦西人相邻而居，分布在科塔瓦西河谷地带。15世纪印加征服后，他们的土地被并入印加的孔蒂苏尤行省。

en: Anjou, ruled from Angers on the lower Loire, was the homeland of the Gallic Andes before becoming a Roman civitas and then a Frankish county. Its first comital line sprang from the viscount Ingelger and the counts Fulk, who expanded its borders through the tenth and eleventh centuries. Count Geoffrey the Handsome married his son Henry to Eleanor of Aquitaine and built the nucleus of the Angevin Empire; Henry inherited the English crown in 1154 as Henry II. The French crown retook Anjou from John Lackland under Philip Augustus between 1202 and 1204, and the defeat of the English and imperial allies at La Roche-aux-Moines in 1214 confirmed the loss. Louis IX granted the county as an appanage to his brother Charles of Anjou in 1246, and it passed through Charles of Valois before returning to the crown with Philip VI in 1328. In 1337 it was held by the king's son John, the future John II. John made his own son Louis duke in 1360, founding the Valois-Anjou line, which inherited Provence and a claim to Naples in 1382 and ended with the cultured Good King René, who died in 1480; Louis XI then absorbed the duchy into the royal domain in 1482.
zh: 安茹以卢瓦尔河下游的昂热为中心，其地原为高卢安德斯人的居地，罗马时代成为城邦，法兰克时期又变为伯国。最早的伯爵家族出自子爵安热尔热一系，其后的富尔克诸伯爵在10至11世纪不断扩张疆土。伯爵美男子若弗鲁瓦为儿子亨利迎娶阿基坦的埃莉诺，奠定了安茹帝国的根基；亨利于1154年登上英格兰王位，是为亨利二世。1202至1204年间，腓力·奥古斯都从无地王约翰手中夺回安茹，1214年英军与皇帝联军在拉罗什欧穆瓦讷战败，确认了这一损失。1246年，路易九世把安茹作为封邑赐给弟弟安茹的查理，后来它经瓦卢瓦的查理之手，于1328年随腓力六世重回王室。1337年领有安茹的是王太子约翰，即日后的约翰二世。约翰在1360年封自己的儿子路易为安茹公爵，开创瓦卢瓦-安茹支系；该支系于1382年继承普罗旺斯和对那不勒斯的王位主张，最后一位公爵是素有贤名的勒内，他于1480年去世，路易十一随即在1482年把公国并入王室领地。

en: Annaly was a Gaelic Irish lordship in the midlands, covering roughly the later County Longford around its chief seat at Longford. It was named for Angaile, a king of the Fortuatha who conquered the district in the tenth century; his great-grandson Fearghail became the ancestor of the O Fearghail, or O Farrell, family, which supplied the princes of Annaly for centuries. In 1337 the lordship remained in O Farrell hands, but the coming of Tudor rule broke its independence. From 1552 onward the crown granted large tracts of Annaly to the Nugent barons of Delvin, including Granard and the northern districts in 1556 and 1557, and the territory was shired as County Longford. Further patents under James I between 1605 and 1612 handed over castles, monasteries and market rights, ending the O Farrell principality.
zh: 安纳利是爱尔兰中部的盖尔人领地，范围大致相当于后来的朗福德郡，以朗福德为统治中心。它得名于10世纪征服这一地区的福尔图阿萨国王安盖尔；安盖尔的曾孙费尔盖尔是奥法雷尔家族的始祖，该家族世代担任安纳利的酋长。1337年时，这块领地仍在奥法雷尔家族手中，但都铎王朝的到来终结了它的独立。从1552年起，英格兰王室把安纳利的大片土地封给纽金特家族的德尔文男爵，1556至1557年又封出格拉纳德和北部地区，这片领土随后被划为朗福德郡。1605至1612年间，詹姆斯一世再次颁发特许状，把城堡、修道院和集市经营权一并交出，奥法雷尔的酋长国就此告终。

en: Andorra is a small Pyrenean valley polity that began as part of the Frankish Spanish March and was held by the counts of Urgell until 988, when it passed to the Bishops of Urgell. In 1095 the bishop shared his rights with the Lord of Caboet, whose claim passed by marriage to the Counts of Foix. A dispute after the Cathar Crusade was settled in 1278 by the first paréage, mediated by King Peter III of Aragon, which divided sovereignty between the Count of Foix and the Bishop of Urgell; a second paréage followed in 1288. The Andorrans gained their own representation in 1419 with the Consell de la Terra, later based in the Casa de la Vall from 1702. The Foix title descended through the kings of Navarre, and in 1607 an edict of Henry, King of Navarre and France, fixed the French head of state and the Bishop of Urgell as the two co-lords. Briefly absorbed into the French Empire in 1812 and 1813, Andorra had its independence restored by imperial decree in 1814.
zh: 安道尔是比利牛斯山中的山谷小国，最初是法兰克西班牙边区的一部分，由乌赫利伯爵统治，988年转归乌赫利主教。1095年主教与卡博埃特领主分享统治权，后者的权利经联姻转入富瓦伯爵手中。卡特里十字军之后的争端于1278年经阿拉贡国王彼得三世调解，以第一份《共治契约》解决，主权由富瓦伯爵与乌赫利主教分掌；1288年又签订第二份《共治契约》。1419年安道尔人设立自己的代表机构陆地会议，1702年起以山谷之家为会址。富瓦一方的头衔经纳瓦拉国王传承，1607年身兼纳瓦拉与法国国王的亨利颁布敕令，确定法国国家元首与乌赫利主教为两位共治君主。1812至1813年安道尔曾被并入法兰西帝国，1814年的帝国敕令恢复了它的独立。

en: Ansbach grew up on the Franconian Rezat around a Benedictine abbey founded by Saint Gumbertus in the eighth century and is first documented as a town in 1221. The surrounding lands belonged to the Burgraviate of Nuremberg, held since 1192 by the House of Hohenzollern, who took possession of Ansbach itself from the counts of Oettingen in 1331 and made it their seat. In 1337 the burgrave was John II, called the Acquirer, whose son Frederick V enlarged the family's Franconian estates. In 1398 the burgraviate was partitioned: Frederick VI kept the Ansbach lands and in 1415 became Elector of Brandenburg, carrying the Hohenzollerns into the ranks of prince-electors. After 1440 a younger branch ruled Ansbach as margraves of Brandenburg-Ansbach; Margrave George the Pious introduced the Reformation in 1528 and dissolved Gumbertus Abbey in 1563. The last margrave sold his principality to Prussia in 1791, and under Napoleonic pressure Prussia ceded it to Bavaria in 1806, a transfer confirmed at the Congress of Vienna.
zh: 安斯巴赫位于法兰克尼亚雷扎特河畔，围绕8世纪圣贡贝尔图斯建立的本笃会修道院发展，1221年首见城市记载。周边土地属于纽伦堡城堡伯领，1192年起由霍亨索伦家族执掌；1331年该家族从厄廷根伯爵手中取得安斯巴赫本城，并将其作为驻地。1337年在位的城堡伯爵是人称“获得者”的约翰二世，他的儿子腓特烈五世进一步扩张了家族在法兰克尼亚的产业。1398年城堡伯领一分为二：腓特烈六世分得安斯巴赫，又于1415年成为勃兰登堡选帝侯，霍亨索伦家族由此跻身选侯之列。1440年后，家族的一支幼系以勃兰登堡-安斯巴赫藩侯的身份统治此地；“虔诚者”格奥尔格于1528年引入宗教改革，1563年贡贝尔图斯修道院被解散。末代藩侯于1791年把领地卖给普鲁士，1806年在拿破仑的压力下普鲁士又将它割让给巴伐利亚，维也纳会议确认了这一归属。

en: Arianiti was the lordship of an Albanian noble house whose lands straddled the Shkumbin valley and the old Via Egnatia, the royal road linking the Adriatic to the interior, with the fortress of Sopot as one of its strongholds. The family's wealth came from guarding and taxing the grain and salt convoys on that road. An Alexius Arianiti appears in 1274 among the Albanian nobles swearing allegiance to Charles I of Anjou's new Kingdom of Albania, and the house is again named in Angevin privilege charters of 1304 and in a letter of Pope John XXII in 1319, marking it as one of the leading Catholic families of central Albania under Angevin protection. After the Ottoman conquests cost it its eastern estates, the family fought back: from 1430 Gjergj Arianiti won a series of victories over Ottoman armies, joined the League of Lezhë in 1444, and in 1451 gave his daughter Donika in marriage to Skanderbeg, while another daughter, Angelina, wed the Serbian despot Stefan Branković and was later revered as a saint. In the following generations many Arianiti converted to Islam and took office under the sultans, while others settled in Italy.
zh: 阿里亚尼蒂是一个阿尔巴尼亚贵族家族的领地，其地横跨什昆宾河谷与连接亚得里亚海和内陆的古道埃格纳提亚大道，索波特要塞是其据点之一。家族的财富来自把守这条大道、向粮食和食盐商队征税。1274年，一位名叫亚历克修斯·阿里亚尼蒂的成员已出现在向安茹的查理一世所建阿尔巴尼亚王国宣誓效忠的贵族名单中；1304年的安茹特权文书和1319年教皇约翰二十二世的书信又先后提到这个家族，可见它是安茹庇护下阿尔巴尼亚中部的主要天主教家族之一。奥斯曼征服夺去其东部领地后，家族起兵反抗：1430年起，乔治·阿里亚尼蒂连挫奥斯曼军队，1444年加入莱什联盟，1451年又将女儿多妮卡嫁给斯坎德培；另一个女儿安杰利娜嫁给塞尔维亚专制公斯特凡·布兰科维奇，后来被尊为圣徒。此后几代人里，许多阿里亚尼蒂家族成员改宗伊斯兰教、出仕苏丹，也有人迁居意大利。

en: The Anizah were one of the oldest Arab tribal groupings, counted by the classical genealogists among the Rabi'a branch of the Adnanites, kin to the Banu Bakr and Bani Hanifa. Even before Islam they had split into nomadic clans roaming the steppes toward Syria and Mesopotamia and settled clans in the wadis of Al-Yamama, and four thousand of their armored warriors fought for Caliph Ali at the Battle of Siffin in 657. In the late tenth century they established themselves in the oases of Khaybar in the Hejaz, expelling the descendants of Ja'far al-Tayyar, and the thirteenth-century geographer Ibn Sa'id found them the last Rabi'a tribe still fully living the Bedouin life between Khaybar and the Syrian desert. In the fourteenth century the chronicler al-Umari counts them among the allies of the Al Fadl princes, and under Ottoman rule their camps dominated the oases of Khaybar and Al-Ula and the steppes beyond, levying brotherhood tribute, or khuwwa, on the settled villages and moving each summer as far north as the Hawran.
zh: 阿尼扎是最古老的阿拉伯部落群之一，古典系谱学家把它归入阿德南人的拉比阿支，与巴努·伯克尔、巴努·哈尼法同源。早在伊斯兰教兴起之前，它就分为两支：游牧的氏族漫游在通往叙利亚和美索不达米亚的草原上，定居的氏族居住在内志东部叶麻麦的干谷中；657年，阿尼扎的四千名甲士还曾在隋芬战役中为哈里发阿里作战。10世纪末，他们在汉志的海拜尔绿洲立足，赶走了贾法尔·塔亚尔的后裔；13世纪地理学家伊本·赛义德发现，阿尼扎是拉比阿诸部中最后一个仍在海拜尔与叙利亚沙漠之间完整保持贝都因生活的部落。14世纪的编年史家欧麦里把他们列为法德勒王公的盟友；到奥斯曼时代，他们的营地控制了海拜尔、欧拉等绿洲及更远处的草原，向定居村庄征收名为胡瓦的兄弟贡，每年夏季北上，远至豪兰。

en: The Duchy of Aosta was the Alpine valley state of the House of Savoy, guarding the Great and Little St Bernard passes between Burgundy and Italy. In the tenth century the valley was ruled by its bishops, but on Bishop Anselm's death in 1026 Emperor Conrad II transferred its secular powers to his ally Humbert the White-handed, the founder of Savoyard power; Humbert's son Odo married Adelaide of Turin and added the March of Turin to the family's fortunes. Once part of the kingdom of Burgundy within the Empire, the county was raised to a duchy by Frederick Barbarossa and remained one of the oldest Savoyard possessions, even though its communities kept strong estates-general and a council of their own. In 1337 it was held, together with Savoy and Piedmont, by Count Haimo of Savoy, called the Peaceful. Duke Emmanuel Philibert made French the language of administration in 1561, while the people kept their Arpitan Valdotain speech; the duchy preserved its own institutions and taxation until they were aligned with Piedmont in the later eighteenth century, and Napoleonic troops ended its separate existence in 1798.
zh: 奥斯塔公国是萨伏依家族在阿尔卑斯山区的河谷邦国，扼守连接勃艮第与意大利的大圣贝尔纳和小圣贝尔纳山口。10世纪时河谷由本地主教统治；1026年主教安塞尔姆去世后，皇帝康拉德二世把世俗权力转交给盟友“白手”亨伯特，即萨伏依势力的奠基人。亨伯特之子奥多与都灵的阿德莱德联姻，为家族取得都灵边区。该地原属帝国境内的勃艮第王国，伯国后来被腓特烈·巴巴罗萨升格为公国，是萨伏依最古老的领地之一，而河谷各社区仍保留着强势的三级会议和自己的政务会。1337年，它与萨伏依、皮埃蒙特一同由“和平者”萨伏依伯爵海莫统治。1561年，埃马努埃莱·菲利贝托公爵定法语为行政语言，民间则继续使用阿尔皮坦语的瓦莱达奥斯塔方言；公国保留自身的机构和税制，直到18世纪后期才与皮埃蒙特接轨，1798年拿破仑军队终结了它的独立存在。

en: The Apardi were a Turco-Mongol tribal tumen of the mid-fourteenth-century Chagatai ulus, whose pasturelands lay along the upper Murghab and the desert edge south of the Amu Darya, around Andkhoy and Sheberghan. Their amir Muhammad Khoja governed Sheberghan from at least 1351 and joined Qazaghan's expedition against Herat, but around 1360 he was killed on the Yapaghu plain in Gharchistan while charging the army of the Kart malik of Herat. In the partition of the collapsing Chagatai Khanate in 1359 the Apardi also seized parts of Khuttalan, and their senior amir Oljeitu Apardi led the vanguard of Amir Husayn and Timur at the Battle of the Mire in 1365 before submitting to Timur in 1369. His kinsman Zinda Hasham shut himself in the white fortress of Sheberghan and twice rebelled until his death around 1371, after which the Apardi were absorbed into Timur's tribal following; Apardi amirs continued to hold commands and marry into the Timurid family.
zh: 阿帕儿迪是14世纪中叶察合台兀鲁思的一个突厥-蒙古部落万户，牧场位于穆尔加布河上游与阿姆河以南的沙漠边缘，以安德霍伊和舍巴尔甘为中心。其异密穆罕默德·火者至少从1351年起统治舍巴尔甘，曾随合扎罕远征赫拉特，约1360年在噶尔吉斯坦的亚帕古平原冲锋陷阵时，被赫拉特卡尔特马利克的军队射杀。1359年察合台汗国瓦解后的瓜分中，阿帕儿迪人又夺取了忽都的部分土地；宿老完者都·阿帕儿迪在1365年的泥沼之战中统领异密忽辛与帖木儿的前锋，1369年归附帖木儿。他的族人欣都·哈沙姆据守舍巴尔甘的白色城堡两度反叛，约1371年败亡，阿帕儿迪部随后被并入帖木儿的部落阵营，其异密仍出任军职并与帖木儿家族通婚。

en: Prüm was the territory of Prüm Abbey, a Benedictine imperial abbey in the Eifel whose abbot held the rank of a prince of the Holy Roman Empire. Founded in 721 by the Frankish widow Bertrada and her son Charibert of Laon, it became the favourite monastery of the Carolingians: Pepin the Short enriched it in 762, Pope Leo III consecrated its church in 799, and Charlemagne's son Pepin the Hunchback and the Emperor Lothair I both ended their lives within its walls. Its vast estates grew into an immediate principality, while Abbot Regino of Prüm, who died in 915, won fame as a historian and canonist, and the abbey guarded the relic of the Sandals of Christ. Sacked by the Normans in 882 and 892, Prüm declined in the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, its secular protection falling to the lords of Schönecken, advocati descended from the counts of Vianden. The archbishops of Trier had long coveted the abbey and in 1576 became its perpetual administrators. French troops occupied Prüm in 1794, and in 1801 the abbey was annexed and secularized, its estates sold off; in 1815 the lands passed to Prussia.
zh: 普吕姆是普吕姆修道院的领地：这座位于艾费尔山区的本笃会帝国修道院，院长位列神圣罗马帝国诸侯。修道院由法兰克寡妇贝尔特拉达与其子拉昂的卡里贝尔特于721年创立，后来成为加洛林王朝最宠爱的修道院——矮子丕平于762年大加赏赐，教皇利奥三世于799年为教堂祝圣，查理曼之子驼背丕平和皇帝洛泰尔一世都在此终老。修道院的广袤地产发展成帝国直辖领地，915年去世的院长普吕姆的雷吉诺是著名史学家与教会法学家，院中还珍藏着基督凉鞋圣物。882年和892年修道院两度遭诺曼人劫掠，13至14世纪日渐衰落，世俗护法官之职落入源自菲安登伯爵的舍内肯领主之手。特里尔大主教觊觎已久，于1576年成为修道院的永久管理者。1794年法军占领普吕姆，1801年修道院被吞并并世俗化，地产遭变卖；1815年这片土地转入普鲁士。

en: The Duchy of Aquitaine, ruled from Bordeaux, was the great fief of south-western France, stretching in its heyday from the Loire to the Pyrenees. It grew out of the Roman province of Gallia Aquitania, which the Franks took after the Battle of Vouillé in 507; under Odo the Great it was a nearly independent duchy whose army defeated the Moors at Toulouse in 721, before Pepin the Short broke its power in the 760s. Reconstituted under West Francia after the partition of Verdun of 843, it became famous for its troubadour dukes, beginning with William IX in 1087. The heiress Eleanor of Aquitaine married first Louis VII of France and then, in 1152, Henry Plantagenet, who became Henry II of England, so carrying Aquitaine into the Angevin Empire. The French reconquests of the thirteenth century reduced it to Gascony and a narrower Guyenne defined by the Treaty of Paris of 1259, and the French crown confiscated the fief in 1296 and again in 1324. In 1337 Philip VI reclaimed it once more from Edward III, who answered by claiming the French crown and opening the Hundred Years' War. The Treaty of Brétigny of 1360 gave Edward full sovereignty over an enlarged Aquitaine, ruled for him by the Black Prince, but Bertrand du Guesclin soon reconquered most of it. The French victory at Castillon in 1453 ended English rule, and Aquitaine was absorbed into the royal domain, save for a brief apanage granted by Louis XI in 1469.
zh: 阿基坦公国以波尔多为统治中心，是法兰西西南部的大封建领地，鼎盛时疆域从卢瓦尔河一直延伸到比利牛斯山。它源自罗马的阿基坦高卢行省，507年法兰克人在武耶战役后将其夺取；在伟大的奥多治下，它成为近乎独立的公国，其军队于721年在图卢兹击败摩尔人，直到矮子丕平在760年代将其压服。843年《凡尔登条约》后，它在西法兰克境内重新组建为公国，并以游吟诗人公爵闻名，这一传统自1087年继位的纪尧姆九世开始。女继承人阿基坦的埃莉诺先嫁法兰西国王路易七世，1152年又改嫁金雀花的亨利，即后来的英格兰国王亨利二世，阿基坦由此并入安茹帝国。13世纪法兰西方面的收复行动把它压缩为加斯科涅和范围较小的吉耶讷，1259年的《巴黎条约》划定了新界，法兰西王室又于1296年和1324年两度没收这块封土。1337年，腓力六世再次向爱德华三世收回阿基坦，爱德华遂主张法兰西王位，百年战争由此爆发。1360年的《布勒丁尼条约》使爱德华对扩大后的阿基坦拥有完整主权，由黑太子爱德华代为统治，但贝特朗·迪·盖克兰很快收复了大部分土地。1453年法军在卡斯蒂永获胜，英格兰统治终结，阿基坦被并入王室领地，仅在1469年被路易十一短暂封作亲王封地。

en: Aquileia was the state of its patriarch, one of the great ecclesiastical princes of the Holy Roman Empire. The see, said to have been founded by Saint Mark, became a patriarchate around 560 and fled to Grado when the Lombards took the old Roman city in 568; the line that stayed in Lombard territory later settled at Cividale and then Udine. Its temporal power was born on 3 April 1077, when Henry IV, returning from Canossa, granted Patriarch Sieghard comital rights over Friuli and nominal suzerainty over Istria and Carniola. In 1337 the throne belonged to Bertrand of Saint-Geniès, a Gascon jurist appointed in 1334; he beat Rizzardo da Camino in 1335, forced the counts of Gorizia to a truce in 1341, founded a university at Cividale in 1344 and held reforming councils, until Friulian nobles murdered him at San Giorgio della Richinvelda in 1350. Venice conquered the patriarchal lands in 1420 and stripped the patriarchs of temporal rule, and the see itself was suppressed in 1751.
zh: 阿奎莱亚是其牧首的领地，也是神圣罗马帝国最重要的教会邦国之一。当地主教座相传由圣马可创立，约560年升为牧首区；568年伦巴第人攻占这座古罗马名城后，牧首逃往格拉多，留在伦巴第境内的一支后来驻于奇维达莱，再迁乌迪内。它的世俗政权诞生于1077年4月3日：从卡诺莎返回途中的亨利四世授予牧首西格哈德弗留利的伯爵权，以及对伊斯特拉和卡尼奥拉的名义宗主权。1337年在位的是加斯科涅法学家贝特朗·德·圣热涅，他于1334年受任牧首，1335年击败里扎尔多·达·卡米诺，1341年迫使戈里齐亚伯爵休战，1344年在奇维达莱创办大学，并召开多次改革会议，最终于1350年在圣乔治德拉里钦韦尔达被弗留利贵族刺杀。威尼斯于1420年征服牧首领地，剥夺牧首的世俗权力，牧首座本身也在1751年被废除。

en: Aragon in 1337 was the head of the Crown of Aragon, a composite monarchy born in 1137 from the marriage of Petronilla of Aragon and Ramon Berenguer IV, Count of Barcelona, whose son Alfonso II joined the two titles in 1162. James I conquered Mallorca and Valencia in the thirteenth century, and after the Sicilian Vespers of 1282 Peter III made himself king of Sicily; the pope enfeoffed Aragon with Sardinia and Corsica in 1297, and the Sardinian war began in 1324. Each realm kept its own laws and Corts, while Barcelona served as the real centre of a maritime power spanning the Balearics, Sicily and the Greek duchies of Athens and Neopatras. Under Peter IV, who reigned from 1336, the Kingdom of Mallorca was fully reunited with the Crown in 1349, and Alfonso V added Naples in 1442. The House of Barcelona ended with Martin I in 1410; the Compromise of Caspe in 1412 called the Castilian Trastámara Ferdinand I to the throne. The marriage of Ferdinand II and Isabella of Castile in 1469 joined the two crowns in 1479, though Aragon kept its institutions until Philip V's Nueva Planta decrees of 1707 to 1716.
zh: 1337年的阿拉贡是阿拉贡联合王国的核心。这个复合君主国诞生于1137年阿拉贡的佩德罗尼拉与巴塞罗那伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世的联姻，其子阿方索二世于1162年兼领两衔。13世纪海梅一世征服马略卡和巴伦西亚；1282年西西里晚祷事件后，佩德罗三世登上西西里王位；1297年教皇将撒丁岛和科西嘉册封给阿拉贡，对撒丁岛的战事于1324年打响。各成员邦保留自己的法律和议会，巴塞罗那则是这个海上强权实际的中心，势力遍及巴利阿里、西西里以及希腊的雅典和新帕特拉斯公国。1336年即位的佩德罗四世治下，马略卡王国于1349年完全并回联合王国，阿方索五世又在1442年拿下那不勒斯。巴塞罗那王朝随马丁一世于1410年终结，1412年的《卡斯佩妥协方案》迎立卡斯蒂利亚特拉斯塔马拉家族的费尔南多一世。1469年费尔南多二世与卡斯蒂利亚的伊莎贝拉结婚，两顶王冠于1479年合流，但阿拉贡的制度一直保留到1707至1716年费利佩五世颁布《新基本法令》为止。

en: Arborea was the most enduring of the four Sardinian judicates, the autonomous states that grew out of the Byzantine island administration when Arab and Berber raids cut Sardinia off from Constantinople in the ninth century. Its judges, inheriting the Byzantine title of judex, ruled the centre-west of the island from Oristano, to which Orzocorre I moved the court from the exposed port of Tharros in 1070. Barison II paid Frederick Barbarossa to crown him King of Sardinia in 1164, though the emperor revoked the grant a year later. While the other three judicates fell to Pisa and Genoa by 1300, Arborea kept its freedom under the De Serra-Bas dynasty. In 1337 the judge was Peter III, who had succeeded his father Hugh II the year before. His brother Marianus IV, later called the Great, revolted against Aragonese rule and by the 1360s held the whole island except Cagliari, Alghero and Sassari. The judge Eleanor, ruling from 1387 as regent for her sons, codified Sardinian customary law. Aragon won the Battle of Sanluri in 1409, Oristano fell in 1410, and in 1420 Alfonso V bought the remaining claims; the last revolt ended at Macomer in 1478.
