zh: 阿尔博雷阿是撒丁岛四个“裁判国”中存续最久的一个。9世纪阿拉伯与柏柏尔人的袭扰使撒丁岛与君士坦丁堡失联，岛上的拜占庭行政体系遂演变为这些自治政权。其统治者继承拜占庭“裁判官”头衔，领有岛屿中西部，以奥里斯塔诺为都——1070年奥尔佐科雷一世因旧港塔罗斯屡遭阿拉伯人攻击而迁都于此。1164年，巴里松二世出资请腓特烈·巴巴罗萨加冕他为撒丁国王，但皇帝次年便收回成命。到1300年前后，另外三个裁判国相继落入比萨和热那亚之手，唯有阿尔博雷阿在德·塞拉-巴斯王朝治下保持独立。1337年在位的是彼得三世，他前一年刚继承父亲休二世。其弟马里亚努斯四世后来号称“大帝”，起兵反抗阿拉贡统治，到14世纪60年代已控制全岛，仅余卡利亚里、阿尔盖罗和萨萨里在外。1387年起以摄政身份为诸子执政的女裁判官埃莉奥诺拉将撒丁习惯法编为成文法典。1409年阿拉贡在圣卢里战役中获胜，奥里斯塔诺于1410年陷落，1420年阿方索五世买下剩余权利，最后一次反抗也在1478年的马科梅尔之战后终结。

en: Ardalan was the hereditary Kurdish emirate of the Bani Ardalan tribe in the mountains of western Iran, around Sanandaj and the Sharazor plain. Its ruling family claimed descent from the Marwanid rulers of Diyar Bakr and, more prestigiously, from Saladin; according to the Kurdish historian Sharafkhan Bidlisi, their early chief Bani Ardalan settled among the Goran Kurds and seized Sharazor at the end of the Mongol era, establishing himself as an absolute ruler. In 1337 the emirate was a tribal vassal of the Jalayirids, and Baba Ardalan's successors built it into an independent state whose court used Gorani as its literary language and lingua franca. The Ardalans kept their freedom by switching allegiance between the Safavids and the Ottomans until 1617, when Ahmad Khan submitted to the Safavids as a semi-independent frontier governor. Nader Shah's Ottoman wars repeatedly swept the emirate, and in 1749 Karim Khan Zand sacked Sanandaj; the Ardalans then carried on under Qajar overlordship, with the rival Baban principality pressing from the west.
zh: 阿达兰是巴尼·阿达兰部落的世袭库尔德埃米尔国，位于伊朗西部山区，以萨南达杰和谢赫雷祖尔平原为中心。统治家族自称出自迪亚巴克尔的马尔万王朝，并更显赫地宣称是萨拉丁的后裔；据库尔德史家沙拉夫汗·比特利西记载，其早期首领巴尼·阿达兰在蒙古时代末期定居于戈兰库尔德人之中，夺取谢赫雷祖尔，自立为绝对统治者。1337年时，该埃米尔国是札剌亦儿王朝的部落附庸；巴巴·阿达兰的后继者把它建成独立政权，宫廷以戈拉尼语为书面语和通用语。阿达兰人在萨法维王朝与奥斯曼帝国之间反复改换门庭以维持自由，直到1617年艾哈迈德汗臣服萨法维，成为半独立的边境总督。纳迪尔沙对奥斯曼的战争屡次席卷该埃米尔国，1749年卡里姆汗·赞德洗劫了萨南达杰；此后阿达兰人在卡扎尔王朝宗主权下延续统治，西邻劲敌巴班公国不断施压。

en: The Lordship of Argos and Nauplia was a Frankish fief in the Morea, the southern peninsula of Greece, formed around the two fortresses of Argos and Nauplia. The towns had been the core of the Greek magnate Leo Sgouros's independent domain before the Crusaders took them, Nauplia falling in 1210 and Argos in 1212; Prince Geoffrey I of Villehardouin of Achaea then granted them to Otto de la Roche, Duke of Athens. His heirs, the de la Roche and later the Brienne dukes, kept the fief even after the Catalan Company seized Athens itself in 1311. In 1337 the lord was Walter VI of Brienne, an absentee prince whose attempt to reconquer Athens in 1331 failed. On his death in 1356 the lordship passed to the Enghien family, and through Maria of Enghien's marriage to the Venetian Pietro Cornaro it became a dependency of Venice. Maria sold both cities to the Venetian Republic in 1388; Argos was briefly held by the Byzantine Despot Theodore I Palaiologos until it too was handed to Venice in 1394.
zh: 阿尔戈斯与纳夫普利翁领地是希腊南部摩里亚半岛上的法兰克人封邑，以阿尔戈斯和纳夫普利翁两座要塞为中心。两城本是希腊豪强利奥·斯古罗斯独立领地的核心，十字军先后于1210年攻克纳夫普利翁、1212年攻克阿尔戈斯；亚该亚亲王杰弗里一世·德·维尔阿杜安随即将它们封给雅典公爵奥托·德·拉·罗什。1311年加泰罗尼亚佣兵团攻占雅典本土后，他的后裔拉罗什家族及后来的布里耶纳系公爵仍保有这块封邑。1337年的领主是常年在外的沃尔特六世·德·布里耶纳，他1331年收复雅典的尝试以失败告终。1356年他去世后，领地转入昂吉安家族，又因玛丽亚·德·昂吉安嫁给威尼斯人彼得罗·科尔纳罗而成为威尼斯的附庸。1388年玛丽亚把两城卖给威尼斯共和国；阿尔戈斯一度被拜占庭专制君主狄奥多尔一世·巴列奥略占据，最终也于1394年移交威尼斯。

en: Launggyet was the last Arakanese kingdom of the Lemro period, ruling the fertile Kaladan River valley of northern Rakhine from its walled capital of the same name. The chronicle Rakhine Razawin Thit dates its founding to 1251, when King Alawmaphyu established it after the fall of the earlier Vesali kingdom. Sitting between Burma and Bengal, the city grew rich on the trade in rice, ivory and lacquerware. A Shan invasion of 1294 was driven off, and in 1327 the Pinya kingdom raided Ramree Island; another Shan attack came in 1334, after which King Min Hti sent his army across the Arakan Mountains to raid Thayet and founded the staging town of Ann in 1335. In 1406 the kingdom was sacked by Ava under Crown Prince Minye Kyawswa, and the last king, Min Saw Mon, fled to the Bengal Sultanate. He returned with Bengali troops in 1429 and in 1430 founded a new capital at Mrauk U, where the Arakanese monarchy continued for nearly four more centuries.
zh: 隆邑是莱姆罗时代最后一个阿拉干人王国，以同名都城统治今若开邦北部肥沃的加拉丹河谷。若开编年史《若开瑞汶》将其建国时间系于1251年，由国王阿隆马菲在更早的维沙利王国衰落后建立。隆邑夹在缅甸与孟加拉之间，靠稻米、象牙和漆器贸易致富。1294年掸人的入侵被击退，1327年彬牙王国袭掠兰里岛，1334年掸人再次来攻；闽提王随后派军队越过阿拉干山脉袭击德耶，并于1335年修建了中转城镇安城。1406年，阿瓦王储明耶觉苏瓦率军攻陷隆邑，末代国王敏苏蒙逃往孟加拉苏丹国。1429年他借孟加拉军队复国，1430年在妙乌另建新都，阿拉干王权在那里又延续了近四百年。

en: Armenia in 1337 was the rump of the Zakarid princedom, held by the Armenian Zakarid-Mkhargrdzeli dynasty from fortresses such as Yerevan and Bjni under the overlordship of the Georgian crown. The family's rise began when Queen Tamar of Georgia enfeoffed Zakare with the city of Ani in 1201. The Zakarids then governed northern and eastern Armenia with their own courts and taxes, built the church of Saint Gregory of Tigran Honents at Ani in 1215, and kept vassal houses including the Orbelians and Proshians. The Mongols took Ani in 1236, after which the dynasty ruled as Ilkhanid vassals, Armenian troops marching with the Mongol army to the siege of Baghdad in 1258. When the Ilkhanate collapsed in 1335, Jalayirid and Chobanid factions fought over the country and minted their coinage at Ani, whose Zakarid line ended around 1350 when the Chobanids sacked the city; the Kara Koyunlu soon made it their capital. Timur's raids of 1386 to 1404 then carried the old Zakarid lands into his empire.
zh: 1337年的亚美尼亚是扎卡良公国的残余，由亚美尼亚扎卡良-姆哈尔格尔泽利王朝据守埃里温、布杰尼等要塞，尊格鲁吉亚王室为宗主。这个家族的崛起始于1201年，格鲁吉亚女王塔马尔把阿尼城封给扎卡雷。扎卡良家族此后以自己的法庭和赋税治理北亚美尼亚与东亚美尼亚，1215年在阿尼修建了蒂格兰·霍年茨圣格列高利教堂，麾下还有奥尔贝利扬、普罗什扬等封臣家族。1236年蒙古人攻占阿尼，该家族转而作为伊儿汗国的附庸统治，亚美尼亚军队还随蒙古大军参加了1258年的巴格达之围。1335年伊儿汗国崩溃后，札剌亦儿与楚邦诸派争夺这片土地，在阿尼铸造钱币；1350年前后楚邦王朝洗劫阿尼，扎卡良王统终结，不久黑羊王朝又以该城为都。1386—1404年帖木儿的扫荡最终把扎卡良故地并入他的帝国。

en: The Archbishopric of Riga grew out of the Bishopric of Livonia, founded at Ikšķile on the Daugava in 1186 as the first Christian see among the pagan Livs. Bishop Albert moved its seat to the newly founded city of Riga in 1202, and in 1255 it was raised to an archbishopric covering all of medieval Livonia, with the bishops of Dorpat, Ösel-Wiek and Courland as its suffragans. The archbishop was not only a churchman: he ruled a large secular principality of castles and estates across central Livonia, including Limbaži, Rauna and Koknese, and was the nominal head of the whole Terra Mariana. This made him the chief rival of the Livonian Order, whose knights fought the city and the archbishop for supremacy and seized much archiepiscopal land early in the fourteenth century. Archbishop Frederick von Pernstein, in office from 1304, recovered these properties through a papal ruling in 1335. Later archbishops helped organize the Livonian Confederation, whose diet first met at Walk in 1419. The Reformation ended the see: in 1561, under its last archbishop William of Brandenburg, the territory was secularized amid the Livonian War and absorbed into the new Duchy of Livonia.
zh: 里加大主教区的前身是1186年在道加瓦河畔伊克什基莱建立的利沃尼亚主教区，这是异教利夫人当中的第一个基督教教区。主教阿尔伯特于1202年将教座迁至新建的里加城，1255年升格为大主教区，统辖整个中世纪利沃尼亚，多尔帕特、厄塞尔-维克和库尔兰的主教皆为其副主教。大主教不仅是神职人员，还统治着横跨利沃尼亚中部、由城堡与庄园组成的大片世俗领地，包括林巴日、劳纳和科克内塞，并且是整个玛利亚之地名义上的首脑。这使他成为利沃尼亚骑士团的主要对手：骑士团为争夺最高统治权与城市和大主教交战，在14世纪初夺取了大主教的大量领地；1304年就任的大主教弗雷德里希·冯·佩恩施泰因依据1335年的教皇裁决收回了这些地产。后来的大主教又推动组建利沃尼亚邦联，邦联议会于1419年在瓦尔克首次召开。宗教改革终结了这个教区：1561年，在末任大主教威廉·冯·勃兰登堡任内，其领地在利沃尼亚战争中被世俗化，并入新成立的利沃尼亚公国。

en: The County of Artois, centred on Arras and taking in Calais, Saint-Omer and Béthune, was the northernmost great fief of medieval France, on the border with Flanders and once the land of the Belgic Atrebates. A Carolingian county from the late eighth century, it was absorbed by the counts of Flanders after 898, then returned to France in 1180 as the dowry of Isabelle of Hainaut on her marriage to Philip II, whose victory at Bouvines in 1214 secured the claim. In 1237 Louis VIII made it an appanage for his younger son Robert, founder of the Capetian house of Artois; Count Robert II fell at the Golden Spurs in 1302, and after a succession dispute won by Mahaut of Artois, her granddaughter Joan III inherited in 1330 and, married to Odo IV of Burgundy, ruled the county in 1337. Artois passed to Flanders and in 1384 entered the Burgundian domains of Philip the Bold. After Charles the Bold fell at Nancy in 1477 Louis XI occupied it; the Treaty of Arras of 1482 kept it for France, but the Treaty of Senlis of 1493 gave it to the Habsburgs, under whom it became one of the Seventeen Provinces. Artois joined the loyalist Union of Arras in 1579, was conquered for Louis XIII in 1640, and was confirmed to France by the Treaty of the Pyrenees of 1659.
zh: 阿图瓦伯国以阿拉斯为中心，领有加来、圣奥梅尔和贝蒂讷，是中世纪法兰西最北的大封土，与佛兰德斯接壤，古时为贝尔盖人支系阿特雷巴特人的土地。它自8世纪末成为加洛林王朝的伯国，898年后被佛兰德斯伯爵吞并，1180年作为埃诺的伊莎贝尔嫁给腓力二世的嫁妆回归法兰西，1214年的布汶大捷巩固了这一权利。1237年，路易八世把它封给幼子罗贝尔，开创卡佩支系阿图瓦家族；伯爵罗贝尔二世1302年战死金马刺战役，阿图瓦的玛奥在继承纠纷中胜诉，其孙女让娜三世于1330年继位，她嫁给勃艮第公爵厄德四世，1337年时正统治伯国。阿图瓦后来转入佛兰德斯，1384年并入勇敢的菲利普的勃艮第领地。1477年大胆的查理战死于南锡后，路易十一占领此地；1482年的《阿拉斯条约》使它留在法兰西手中，但1493年的《桑利斯条约》又把它交给哈布斯堡家族，成为十七省之一。1579年阿图瓦加入效忠西班牙的阿拉斯同盟，1640年被路易十三的军队征服，1659年的《比利牛斯条约》确认它归属法兰西。

en: The Arlat, or Arulat, were a Mongol tribe already counted among the clans of the steppe in the age of Genghis Khan. A tumen of the Arlat followed the Mongol conquests west and settled in the western part of the Chagatai ulus, around Maymana and the pastures of eastern Khorasan, where they became one of the semi-nomadic tribal confederations that dominated the khanate after it fractured in the fourteenth century, alongside the Barlas in central Transoxiana and the Jalayir in the north. Arlat amirs later served the Timurids: Yadgarshah Arlat, commander of the Arlat tumen, married a granddaughter of Timur and died in 1438 after serving Shah Rukh. A separate branch ruled Shaki in Azerbaijan as Timurid governors, where Sidi Ali Arlat held out against the campaigns of Miran Shah until he was killed in battle around 1398 and was succeeded by his son Sidi Ahmad.
zh: 阿鲁剌惕又译阿鲁剌，是成吉思汗时代已见记载的蒙古部落。其一个万户随蒙古西征迁居察合台兀鲁思西部，在梅马内和东呼罗珊草原一带游牧；14世纪察合台汗国分裂后，它与河中的巴鲁剌思、北方的札剌伊尔并列为左右汗国的半游牧部落集团。阿鲁剌惕异密后来效力于帖木儿王朝：阿鲁剌惕万户长也的哥儿沙阿黑剌娶帖木儿孙女为妻，历事沙哈鲁，于1438年去世。另有一支以帖木儿地方长官的身份统治阿塞拜疆的舍基，西迪·阿里·阿鲁剌惕曾抵抗米兰沙的进攻，约1398年战死，其子西迪·艾哈迈德继立。

en: Aru, also written Haru, was a Malay kingdom on the eastern coast of North Sumatra, its capital at Kota Rentang near modern Medan, in the later Deli region. Its people were related to the Karo of the Batak interior, and the early kingdom mixed native animism with Hinduism before Islam reached the court in the late thirteenth century. A Chinese Yuan chronicle records that in 1282 Kublai Khan demanded its submission and that Aru sent tribute in 1295. In 1339 a Majapahit naval expedition brought Aru and neighbouring Pannai under Javanese control, and the Nagarakretagama of 1365 lists it among Majapahit's Sumatran vassals. By the time Ma Huan visited with the Zheng He fleets and wrote his Yingya Shenglan in 1416, the king and his people were described as Muslims. In the fifteenth century Aru was a formidable maritime power controlling the northern entrance of the Strait of Malacca, its prestige rivalling Pasai and Malacca. Aceh's rise ended this: the capital withdrew inland from Kota Rentang to the fortress of Benteng Putri Hijau, and Aceh probably took the old port in 1539. Sultan Iskandar Muda of Aceh struck the final blow in 1613, and Aru dissolved, its successor state of Deli becoming first an Acehnese protectorate in 1632 and then a possession of Siak in 1669.
zh: 哑鲁又译哈鲁，是北苏门答腊东海岸的马来人王国，都城哥打兰樟在今棉兰附近，即后来的碟里地区。其居民与内陆巴塔克人的卡罗族群有亲缘关系，早期王国本土万物有灵信仰与印度教并存，13世纪末伊斯兰教传入宫廷。中国元代史籍记载，1282年忽必烈要求哑鲁臣服，哑鲁于1295年遣使朝贡。1339年满者伯夷的海上远征使哑鲁和邻近的潘奈落入爪哇人控制，1365年的《爪哇史颂》把它列为满者伯夷的苏门答腊属国之一。马欢随郑和船队到访，并在1416年写成的《瀛涯胜览》中记载，哑鲁国王和臣民都已信奉伊斯兰教。15世纪的哑鲁是控制马六甲海峡北口的海上强国，声威可与八昔和马六甲比肩。亚齐的崛起终结了这一局面：都城从沿海的哥打兰樟退守内陆的普特里希乔要塞，哥打兰樟约于1539年被亚齐攻占。1613年亚齐苏丹伊斯坎达尔·穆达给予最后一击，哑鲁解体；后继的碟里先于1632年成为亚齐的保护国，1669年又被西亚克吞并。

en: Ascoli, the ancient Asculum, stands on the River Tronto at the eastern edge of the Apennines in the Marche. It was founded by the Piceni and became a nominally independent allied city of Rome after 268 BC, but was the first Italian city to rise in the Social War of 91 BC and was stormed by Roman legions two years later. Ravaged by Ostrogoths and Lombards in the early Middle Ages, it belonged to the Lombard Duchy of Spoleto from 593 to 789, after which Frankish officials and then its bishops held power. A free republican commune was set up in 1189, though family feuds repeatedly opened the door to outside lords. In 1337 Ascoli still ran its affairs as a republic under a hired podestà; within a few years Galeotto I Malatesta, first engaged as a condottiero in the war against Fermo, made himself its tyrant. Cardinal Albornoz restored papal authority over the Marche in the 1350s, and the city then alternated between communal self-rule, local signori and the Papal States. Francesco Sforza was driven out in 1482, after which Ascoli submitted firmly to papal suzerainty and remained part of the Papal States for the rest of its history.
zh: 阿斯科利古称阿斯库卢姆，位于马尔凯地区亚平宁山脉东缘的特龙托河畔。它由皮切尼人建立，公元前268年后成为罗马名义上保持独立的同盟城市，却在公元前91年的同盟者战争中率先发难，两年后被罗马军团攻陷。中世纪早期，城市先后遭东哥特人和伦巴第人蹂躏，593至789年间隶属伦巴第人的斯波莱托公国，此后由法兰克官员、继而由本地主教掌权。1189年，阿斯科利建立自由的共和公社，但家族仇杀一再引外邦领主入城。1337年，它仍是一座靠雇佣执政官治理的共和国；没过几年，最初在对费尔莫的战争中受雇为雇佣兵队长的加莱奥托一世·马拉泰斯塔便自立为城市僭主。14世纪50年代，阿尔沃诺斯枢机在马尔凯恢复了教皇权威，此后城市在公社自治、地方僭主和教皇国之间摇摆。1482年弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎被逐，阿斯科利随后彻底臣服于教皇，在此后的岁月里始终是教皇国的一部分。

en: Alessandria was deliberately founded in 1168, when the communes of the Lombard League built a new fortified town called Civitas Nova between the Tanaro and Bormida rivers, on land facing the pro-imperial March of Montferrat and with Genoese money. Two years later it was entrusted to Pope Alexander III, after whom it was named, to legitimize the communes' resistance to Frederick Barbarossa; the emperor besieged it in 1174 and failed to take it, a prelude to his defeat at Legnano. As a free commune it was torn for generations by Guelph and Ghibelline feuds, and in 1337 it still governed itself as a republic. After the battle of Gamenario in 1345 it passed under the protection of Luchino Visconti of Milan, and the victory of Gian Galeazzo Visconti over the French at the battle of Alessandria in 1391 bound its fate to the new Duchy of Milan. A revolt in 1403 let the condottiero Facino Cane make himself lord, but on his death in 1412 the city returned to the Visconti and later followed the Sforza. With the duchy it passed under Spanish rule, then in 1707 the Peace of Utrecht assigned it to the House of Savoy, which built its great star-shaped citadel. Annexed by revolutionary France after the battle of Marengo in 1800, it was restored to Savoy in 1814.
zh: 亚历山德里亚是一座刻意规划出来的城市：1168年，伦巴第同盟各城邦在塔纳罗河与博尔米达河之间建起一座名为新城的设防城镇，正对着效忠皇帝的蒙费拉托侯国，工程经费来自热那亚。两年后，城市被托付给教皇亚历山大三世并以他的名字命名，为各城邦反抗红胡子腓特烈的事业赋予合法性；1174年皇帝围攻此城却未能得手，这也是他在莱尼亚诺战败的先声。作为自由公社，城市长期被圭尔夫派与吉伯林派的仇杀撕裂，1337年时仍以共和国的形式自治。1345年加梅纳里奥战役后，它转入米兰的卢基诺·维斯孔蒂保护之下；1391年吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂在亚历山德里亚之战中击败法军，城市的命运就此与新生的米兰公国绑在一起。1403年的一场叛乱让雇佣兵队长法奇诺·卡内自立为领主，但他1412年死后城市复归维斯孔蒂家族，后来又随斯福尔扎家族沉浮。它随米兰公国一同转入西班牙统治，1707年《乌得勒支和约》将其划给萨伏依王室，后者在此修建了巨大的星形要塞。1800年马伦戈战役后，城市被革命的法国吞并，1814年又归还萨伏依。

en: Astarābād, on the Caspian-facing plain of ancient Hyrcania, took the place of old Gurgān, which had been destroyed in the thirteenth-century Mongol invasion, and became the chief city of the Gurgān region. In the 1330s it was governed by Shaykh 'Alī Hindu, a supporter of the Il-Khanid claimant Togha Temür, whose power base was Gurgān and western Khorasan. After Togha Temür was murdered by the Sarbadars in 1353 and Astarābād was annexed, Shaykh 'Alī's son Amīr Valī fled to the neighboring Jauni Kurban tribe, then fought his way back: he declared for Shiism to win over the Mazandaranis, seized Astarābād in 1356 and took Bistam and Damghan around 1360. Driven out around 1366, he retook the city by 1374 and even captured the Sarbadar capital Sabzevar around 1380. His long wars with the Sarbadars and Jalayirids ended only with the arrival of Timur, who forced him to flee in 1384 and gave Astarābād to Togha Temür's son Luqman. The city later became a stronghold of the Qajar tribe and an important political centre under the Qajar shahs.
zh: 阿斯塔拉巴德位于濒临里海的古希尔卡尼亚平原，取代了13世纪蒙古入侵中被毁的旧戈尔甘，成为戈尔甘地区的首要城市。14世纪30年代，这里由谢赫·阿里·欣杜管辖，他是伊儿汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿的支持者，后者的势力基础正在戈尔甘和呼罗珊西部。1353年脱合帖木儿被萨尔巴达尔人杀害、阿斯塔拉巴德遭兼并后，谢赫·阿里之子阿米尔·瓦利投奔邻近的札兀尼·库尔班部落，随后又打了回来：他改奉什叶派以争取马赞达兰人，于1356年夺取阿斯塔拉巴德，约1360年又占比斯塔姆和达姆甘。约1366年他被逐出，1374年前再度夺回该城，约1380年甚至攻下萨尔巴达尔人的都城萨卜泽瓦尔。他与萨尔巴达尔人、札剌亦儿人的长期战争直到帖木儿到来才结束：1384年他被迫出逃，帖木儿把阿斯塔拉巴德交给脱合帖木儿之子卢格曼。这座城市后来成为卡扎尔部落的据点，并在卡扎尔王朝诸沙阿治下成为重要的政治中心。

en: The County of Astarac was a hilly Gascon lordship between Armagnac, Bigorre and Comminges, in the basin of the Baïse and Gers rivers, where Gascon was spoken and livestock farming dominated. It was created in the tenth century when the Duchy of Gascony was divided among the sons of García II Sánchez, the youngest, Arnold I, receiving Astarac. Its counts founded the bastide of Mirande in 1280 and made it their capital in 1297; the county was administered through four castellanies. In 1337 the count was Centule IV of the native house of Astarac, a vassal of the French crown. His line held the county until the sixteenth century, when an heiress carried it to the House of Foix in 1536; it later passed through the houses of Roquelaure and Rohan-Chabot. Under the old monarchy Astarac remained part of the province of Gascony.
zh: 阿斯塔拉克伯国是加斯科涅的一处丘陵领地，地处阿马尼亚克、比戈尔与科曼日之间，位于拜斯河和热尔河流域，当地通行加斯科涅语，以畜牧业为生。10世纪加斯科涅公爵加西亚二世·桑切斯去世后，公国被诸子瓜分，幼子阿尔诺一世分得阿斯塔拉克，伯国由此诞生。伯爵们于1280年兴建了设防新城米朗，并在1297年定其为首府；伯国由四个城堡区统辖。1337年在位的是本土阿斯塔拉克家族的桑图勒四世，为法兰西国王的封臣。他的家族一直统治到16世纪，1536年女继承人把伯国带入富瓦家族，后来又先后转入罗克洛尔家族和罗昂—沙博家族手中。旧制度时期，阿斯塔拉克始终是加斯科涅行省的一部分。

en: Asu was a Hurka Jurchen polity centered on Ningguta in the Mudan river basin, whose Manchu name means a group of six. Hurka clans held the wooded Mudan and upper Ussuri country through the Ming, and in 1652 the Qing posted a garrison at Ningguta, making it the chief base on the Amur frontier.
zh: 阿苏是以宁古塔为中心的虎尔哈女真政权，地处牡丹江流域；宁古塔在满语中意为“六”。明代虎尔哈诸部据有这片山林，入清后于1652年向宁古塔派驻重兵，使其成为清朝在黑龙江边疆的首要据点。

en: The Duchy of Athens was a crusader state founded in 1205 after the Fourth Crusade, covering Attica and Boeotia with its capital at Thebes, while the Acropolis in Athens served as the dukes' palace. Its first ruler was the Burgundian knight Otto de la Roche, and his French dynasty held it until 1308, when Walter V of Brienne inherited the duchy. Walter hired the Catalan Company of mercenaries against Epirus, then tried to dismiss them without pay; at the Battle of Halmyros in 1311 the Catalans killed him and most of the Frankish nobility and seized the state. From 1312 they acknowledged the suzerainty of Frederick III of Sicily, and the ducal title passed to the Crown of Aragon, though vicars-general governed on the spot; in 1318 and 1319 the Catalans also conquered southern Thessaly and formed the united Duchy of Neopatras. In 1337 the duke was William of the Aragonese royal house, and Catalan, governed by the Customs of Barcelona, had replaced French as the language of administration. The Florentine Acciaioli family captured Athens in 1388, apart from a brief Venetian interlude from 1395 to 1402, and in 1444 the duchy became tributary to the Byzantine despot Constantine Palaeologus. The Ottomans conquered it in 1458, ending Latin rule over the city.
zh: 雅典公国是1205年第四次十字军东征后建立的十字军国家，疆域包括阿提卡和维奥蒂亚，以底比斯为首都，雅典卫城则是公爵的宫殿所在地。首任统治者是勃艮第骑士奥托·德·拉罗什，其法国裔家族统治到1308年，公国由布列讷的戈蒂埃五世继承。戈蒂埃雇用加泰罗尼亚佣兵团对伊庇鲁斯作战，事后却想赖账遣散他们；1311年的哈尔米罗斯战役中，加泰罗尼亚人杀死戈蒂埃和大部分法兰克贵族，夺取了公国。1312年起他们承认西西里国王腓特烈三世的宗主权，公爵头衔归入阿拉贡王室，实际政务则由历任总代理官处理；1318年至1319年，加泰罗尼亚人又征服色萨利南部，建立与雅典联合的新帕特雷公国。1337年在位的公爵是阿拉贡王室的威廉，按《巴塞罗那习惯法》治理的加泰罗尼亚语已取代法语成为行政语言。1388年佛罗伦萨的阿恰约利家族攻占雅典（1395年至1402年曾被威尼斯短暂接管），1444年公国沦为拜占庭专制君主君士坦丁·巴列奥略的附庸。1458年奥斯曼人征服雅典，拉丁人对这座城市的统治告终。

en: Asti, the Roman Hasta on the Tanaro plain in Piedmont, grew from a Ligurian settlement of the Statielli into a Roman colony and then one of the thirty-six Lombard duchies. The first consuls of its free commune appear in 1095, making it one of the earliest self-governing cities in Italy; it won minting rights, was stormed and burned by Frederick Barbarossa in 1155, joined the Lombard League and gained further privileges under the Peace of Constance of 1183. The thirteenth century was its heyday, as its merchants and bankers prospered on the trade routes from the Ligurian ports and the commune at one point controlled both Chieri and Turin, while rival banking clans split into Guelph and Ghibelline parties. In 1314 the Solari bankers handed the city to King Robert of Naples, so in 1337 Asti kept its communal forms under Neapolitan alignment; a Ghibelline coup in 1339 opened the way to Luchino Visconti of Milan, who took control in 1340. John II of Montferrat seized it in 1356, but in 1379 it returned to the Visconti, and in 1389 it passed to the French dukes of Orléans as the dowry of Valentina Visconti. After long Valois rule it was granted to the House of Savoy in 1531, endured Spanish sieges and plague in the seventeenth century, fell to France in 1703 during the War of the Spanish Succession until Victor Amadeus II retook it in 1705, and after the Napoleonic occupation returned to Savoy in 1814.
zh: 阿斯蒂古称哈斯塔，坐落在皮埃蒙特的塔纳罗平原上，最初是利古里亚人斯塔泰利部的聚落，后来成为罗马殖民地，又成为伦巴第人三十六公国之一。1095年，自由公社的首批执政官出现，阿斯蒂因此跻身意大利最早的自治城市之列。它取得了铸币权，1155年被红胡子腓特烈攻陷焚毁，随后加入伦巴第同盟，并依1183年的《康斯坦茨和约》获得更多特权。13世纪是它的鼎盛期：商人和银行家靠着利古里亚港口北上的商路致富，公社一度控制了基耶里和都灵，而相互竞争的银行家族则分化为圭尔夫与吉伯林两派。1314年，索拉里银行家族把城市交给那不勒斯国王罗贝托，因此1337年时阿斯蒂虽保留公社体制，外交上却倒向那不勒斯；1339年吉伯林派发动政变，为1340年米兰的卢基诺·维斯孔蒂入主铺平了道路。1356年蒙费拉托的乔瓦尼二世夺取此城，但1379年它又回到维斯孔蒂家族手中，1389年作为瓦伦蒂娜·维斯孔蒂嫁妆的一部分转归法国奥尔良公爵。经过瓦卢瓦家族的长期统治，它于1531年被封给萨伏依王室，17世纪历经西班牙人的围攻和瘟疫，1703年西班牙王位继承战争中陷于法国，1705年被维托里奥·阿梅迪奥二世收复，拿破仑时代结束后于1814年复归萨伏依。

en: Aceh occupies the northern tip of Sumatra, ruled from Bandar Aceh, the later Kutaraja. Before the sultanate the region was known as Lamuri or Lambri, a port recorded by Arab geographers from the ninth century where merchants waited out the winter monsoon; its people were first Hindu and Buddhist, and it was among the earliest places in the archipelago to receive Islam, its later rulers being Muslims. In 1520 Ali Mughayat Syah began the campaigns that founded the Aceh Sultanate, conquering Deli, Pedir and Pasai and absorbing Lamuri by the early sixteenth century. His son Alauddin al-Kahar, who died in 1571, pushed south through Sumatra and attacked Johor and Portuguese Malacca with Ottoman support. The sultanate reached its height under Iskandar Muda from 1607, who made most of Sumatra accept his overlordship, conquered the tin region of Pahang in 1617 and issued the Adat Meukuta Alam law code, though his fleet was destroyed before Malacca in 1629. After a line of female sultanas the coastal chiefs became effectively independent, and in 1727 a Bugis dynasty took the throne. In the 1820s Aceh produced more than half the world's pepper, and Tuanku Ibrahim rebuilt the sultan's authority over the pepper-growing rajas.
zh: 亚齐位于苏门答腊岛北端，以班达亚齐（后称哥打拉贾）为统治中心。苏丹国建立之前，这一地区称蓝里或南浡里，9世纪起即见载于阿拉伯地理学家的著作，是商人等候冬季季风的港口；当地居民最初信奉印度教和佛教，这里也是群岛最早接受伊斯兰教的地方之一，后期统治者均为穆斯林。1520年，阿里·穆哈亚特·沙开始扩张，建立亚齐苏丹国，征服了德里、佩迪尔和八昔，并在16世纪初吞并蓝里。其子阿拉丁·卡哈尔（1571年去世）继续向南推进，还在奥斯曼帝国支援下进攻柔佛和葡萄牙人占据的马六甲。1607年即位的伊斯坎达尔·穆达把苏丹国推向鼎盛，使苏门答腊大部承认其宗主权，1617年征服产锡的彭亨，并颁布《穆库塔阿拉姆习惯法》；但他的舰队于1629年在马六甲城下覆灭。此后历经数位女苏丹，沿海酋长纷纷自立，1727年武吉斯王朝登上王位。19世纪20年代，亚齐的胡椒产量占世界一半以上，端古·易卜拉欣重新树立了苏丹对各地胡椒拉贾的权威。

en: Autlán, whose Nahuatl name combines aotli, a water channel, with tlan, a place, and means beside the ditch, was the seat of a lordship in the southern highlands of what is now Jalisco; chiefdoms such as Tenamaxtlán recognised its authority. The wider country was divided among more than thirty tiny states speaking Auteco, Cuyoteco, Cazcan and other languages. Spanish forces overran all of them in 1523 and 1524, and in 1534 the crown established the corregimiento of Autlán, which stretched from the interior around Ameca to the Pacific harbour of Puerto de la Navidad.
zh: 奥特兰的名称来自纳瓦特尔语，由意为水渠的奥特利和意为之地的特兰组成，合指水渠旁的地方。它是今哈利斯科南部高地一个领主邦的治所，特纳马斯特兰等城邦都承认它的权威。更广阔的地区分裂成三十多个小国，通行奥特科语、库约特科语、卡斯坎语等语言。1523—1524年，西班牙军队攻灭这些小国；1534年，王室设立奥特兰督办区，辖地从内陆的阿梅卡一带一直延伸到太平洋的纳维达港。

en: Atocpan, meaning on fertile soil in Nahuatl, was a Chichimeca village in the Milpa Alta valley south of Lake Xochimilco, one of nine villages tradition credits to thirteenth-century Chichimeca migrants and later subject to Xochimilco. In the fifteenth century it came under Mexica rule as part of the altepetl of Malacachtepec Momoxco, until the Spanish takeover of 1529.
zh: 阿托克潘在纳瓦特尔语中意为沃土之上，是霍奇米尔科湖以南米尔帕阿尔塔山谷的奇奇梅卡村落，相传为13世纪奇奇梅卡移民所建九村之一，后来臣属于霍奇米尔科。15世纪它作为马拉卡特佩克-莫莫克斯科阿尔特佩特尔的一部分落入墨西加治下，直到1529年西班牙人接管。

en: Atepec, whose Nahuatl name means the hill where water abounds, was a small mountain community in the Sierra Norte of Oaxaca, between the Zapotec polities of the Oaxaca valley and the unconquered Mixe country. In prehispanic times it was a subject town of neighbouring Teococuilco, whose people honoured the deity Quezelao as provider of the seasonal fields.
zh: 阿特佩克的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“多水之山”，是瓦哈卡州北部山区的一个小型山地聚落，地处瓦哈卡谷地的萨波特克诸邦与东面未被征服的米赫人地区之间的崎岖高地。前西班牙时代，它是邻近中心特奥科奎尔科的附属城镇，居民尊奉克塞劳神，视其为时令农田的赐予者。

en: The Artuqids were a Sunni Turkoman dynasty of the Oghuz Döger tribe, named after Artuk Bey, a Seljuk general who governed Jerusalem from 1086. After Artuk's death his sons Sökmen and Ilghazi were driven out of the city by the Fatimids in 1098 and carved out principalities in al-Jazira, taking Mardin, Hasankeyf and Diyarbakır. Ilghazi of Mardin crushed the Principality of Antioch at the Ager Sanguinis in 1119, and the dynasty later split into Hasankeyf, Harput and Mardin branches. The first two were extinguished by the Ayyubids and the Seljuks of Rum in the 1230s, while the Mardin line endured as a vassal in turn of the Ayyubids, Ilkhanids, Timurids and Qara Qoyunlu. In 1260 Qara Arslan submitted to Hulegu's Mongols, and in 1337 the ruler of Mardin was as-Salih Mahmud, who reigned from 1312 to 1364. The Qara Qoyunlu overran Mardin in 1384 and annexed it outright in 1409, ending three centuries of Artuqid rule.
zh: 阿尔图格王朝是乌古斯都客儿部的逊尼派突厥蛮王朝，得名于塞尔柱将领阿尔图克·贝伊，他于1086年出任耶路撒冷长官。阿尔图克死后，其子索克曼与伊尔加齐在1098年被法蒂玛王朝逐出耶路撒冷，转而在杰济拉开拓领地，据有马尔丁、哈桑凯伊夫和迪亚巴克尔。伊尔加齐于1119年在血田战役中大破安条克公国，王朝随后分裂为哈桑凯伊夫、哈尔普特和马尔丁三支：前两支在13世纪30年代先后被阿尤布王朝和鲁姆塞尔柱人攻灭，马尔丁一支则存续下来，相继向阿尤布王朝、伊儿汗国、帖木儿帝国和黑羊王朝称臣。1260年，卡拉·阿尔斯兰向旭烈兀的蒙古大军投降；1337年在位的是萨利赫·马哈茂德，他的统治从1312年延续到1364年。黑羊王朝于1384年攻陷马尔丁，又在1409年正式吞并该地，延续三百年的阿尔图格统治至此终结。

en: Atitlan was a Mixe mountain town in the Sierra Mixe of northern Oaxaca, a Midland Mixe community between the Choapam highlands and the Isthmus of Tehuantepec. Like all the Mixe, it was never subdued by the Zapotec kingdom of Zaachila or the Aztec Empire, and Spanish arms failed; Dominican friars made the first contact only in 1555.
zh: 阿蒂特兰是瓦哈卡北部米赫山区的一座米赫人山城，属于乔阿潘高地与特万特佩克地峡之间崎岖地带的中部米赫方言聚落。与其他米赫人一样，无论是萨波特克人的萨奇拉王国还是阿兹特克帝国都未能完全征服它的居民，西班牙人的武力征讨也告失败；直到1555年，多明我会修士才与米赫人实现首次和平接触。

en: Artaz was the Armenian principality of the Artazian branch of the Amatuni nakharar house, an ancient noble family attested from the fourth century in the canton of Artaz between lakes Van and Urmia. Its seat was the castle of Shavarshan, the later town of Maku. The Amatuni kept to the Armenian Apostolic Church and held the region through Arab, Seljuk and Mongol overlordship; in 1337 the prince of Artaz was a vassal of the Jalayirids in Baghdad. The dynasty weathered Timur's invasion, when its garrison held out through the siege of Maku castle, an episode recorded by the Castilian envoy Ruy Gonzalez de Clavijo. A branch of the family kept the fief of Artaz until the early sixteenth century, when Ottoman expansion and the arrival of Kurdish tribes ended Armenian rule in the region.
zh: 阿尔塔兹是阿马图尼家族阿尔塔兹支系的亚美尼亚亲王国。阿马图尼是古老的亚美尼亚贵族世家，4世纪时已见载于凡湖与乌尔米耶湖之间的阿尔塔兹地区，其治所在沙瓦尔尚城堡，即后来的马库。阿马图尼家族始终信奉亚美尼亚使徒教会，在阿拉伯人、塞尔柱人和蒙古人的宗主权下保有这片土地；1337年时，阿尔塔兹王公是巴格达札剌亦儿王朝的附庸。帖木儿入侵时，其守军在马库城堡围城战中坚守不退，卡斯蒂利亚使臣克拉维约曾记载此事。该家族的一支继续统治阿尔塔兹领地，直到16世纪初，奥斯曼的扩张和库尔德部落的到来终结了当地的亚美尼亚人统治。

en: The Arundel lordship was the FitzAlan family's marcher estate on the Shropshire border, centred on Oswestry Castle and taking in the Welsh lands around Wrexham. A castle stood at Oswestry by 1086, when Domesday Book records it in Norman hands, and Henry I granted the feudal barony to the Breton knight Alan fitz Flaad, ancestor of the FitzAlans; a younger branch of the same family became the hereditary stewards of Scotland and later the Stuart kings. The Welsh seized Oswestry in 1149 during the Anarchy and held it until 1157. Through marriage the FitzAlans also inherited the earldom of Arundel in Sussex in 1243, combining southern rank with a border power base. In 1337 the lord was the young Richard FitzAlan, whose father had been executed in 1326 but whose titles were restored in 1331; he became an admiral and fought at Sluys in 1340 and Crecy in 1346. Owain Glyndwr's revolt left Oswestry burned in 1400, and the Laws in Wales Acts of 1535 to 1542 ended the marcher jurisdiction.
zh: 阿伦德尔领主领是菲查伦家族在什罗普郡边境的边境领产业，以奥斯沃斯特里城堡为中心，涵盖雷克瑟姆一带的威尔士土地。1086年的《末日审判书》已记载奥斯沃斯特里有一座诺曼人掌管的城堡；亨利一世把这块封建男爵领封给布列塔尼骑士艾伦·菲茨弗拉德，他便是菲查伦家族的祖先，其家族的一支后来成为苏格兰世袭总管，并衍生出斯图亚特王室。1149年英格兰内乱期间，威尔士人攻占奥斯沃斯特里，一直占据到1157年。1243年，菲查伦家族通过婚姻继承了萨塞克斯的阿伦德尔伯爵头衔，把南方的爵位与边境权力根基合为一体。1337年的领主是年轻的理查德·菲查伦，其父于1326年被处决，但家族头衔在1331年恢复；他后来成为海军将领，参加了1340年的斯鲁伊斯海战和1346年的克雷西战役。1400年欧文·格林杜尔起义中奥斯沃斯特里被焚，1535至1542年的《威尔士法令》终结了边境领的独立司法权。

en: Augusta Vindelicorum was the Roman name of Augsburg, and the territory here is the Prince-Bishopric of Augsburg, an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire in Swabia, quite distinct from the free city of the same name; the prince-bishops kept their residence at Dillingen. The see is first documented with Bishop Wikterp around 739, and Saint Ulrich held the city against the Hungarian siege of 955 before the victory on the Lechfeld. In the eleventh century the bishops won the right of coinage, and from then on they were usually chosen from Swabian noble families such as the counts of Dillingen and the Schönegg. In 1337 the see belonged to Ulrich II von Schönegg. During the Reformation Bishop Otto Truchsess von Waldburg led the Catholic revival, founding the university of Dillingen in 1554 and entrusting it to the Jesuits. The Edict of Restitution of 1629 briefly restored lost church lands, but Swedish troops occupied Augsburg in 1632 and the Peace of Westphalia in 1648 fixed a Catholic and Protestant parity. The prince-bishopric was secularized and handed to Bavaria in 1802.
zh: 奥古斯塔-温德利科鲁姆是奥格斯堡的古罗马名称，这里对应的是奥格斯堡采邑主教区——神圣罗马帝国在施瓦本的一个教会邦国，与同名的自由市互不统属，采邑主教驻跸于迪林根。教区最早可考的主教是约739年在任的维克特普；圣乌尔里希在955年马扎尔人围城时坚守城池，为莱希费尔德大捷立下功劳。11世纪主教取得铸币权，此后主教多出自迪林根伯爵、舍内格家族等施瓦本贵族。1337年在任的是乌尔里希二世·冯·舍内格。宗教改革时期，主教奥托·特鲁赫泽斯·冯·瓦尔德堡力推天主教复兴，于1554年在迪林根创办大学并交由耶稣会主持。1629年的《归还敕令》一度恢复了流失的教会地产，但瑞典军队于1632年占领奥格斯堡，1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》确立了天主教与新教的对等地位。1802年，采邑主教区被世俗化并划归巴伐利亚。

en: The County of Aumale, called Alba Marla in Latin and later Albemarle by the English, stood on the River Bresle on the border between Normandy and Picardy. William the Conqueror made the town a county for his half-sister Adelaide of Normandy, and Norman and English lords held it until Philip II of France captured the castle in 1196 during the conquest of Normandy. The crown then granted it through the houses of Dammartin and Castile: the Castilian line, sprung from Ferdinand III of Castile and Joan of Ponthieu, included John I, who fell at the Battle of the Golden Spurs in 1302, and his son John II, count from 1302 until his death in 1343, who held Aumale in 1337 and married Catherine of Artois. During the Hundred Years' War the English kings, claiming Normandy and France, repeatedly granted the title of earl or duke of Aumale to their own magnates, from Thomas of Woodstock in 1385 to Richard Beauchamp in 1422. The French county afterwards passed to the Harcourts and then the Lorraines, and in 1547 it was raised to a duchy for Francis of Lorraine; it later moved to the houses of Savoy and Orléans.
zh: 欧马勒伯国，拉丁语称阿尔巴马拉，英格兰人后来称作阿尔伯马尔，地处诺曼底与皮卡第交界处的布雷勒河畔。征服者威廉把这座城镇封为伯国，授予同父异母的姐姐诺曼底的阿德莱德，此后一直由诺曼和英格兰贵族领有，直到1196年腓力二世在征服诺曼底时攻占其城堡。王室随后将它封给达马尔坦家族和卡斯蒂利亚家族：卡斯蒂利亚支系出自卡斯蒂利亚国王费尔南多三世与蓬蒂约的让娜，其中约翰一世于1302年战死在金马刺战役，其子约翰二世1302年至1343年任伯爵，1337年时正领有欧马勒，并娶了阿图瓦的卡特琳。百年战争期间，英格兰国王以诺曼底和法兰西的继承权为名，屡次把欧马勒伯爵或公爵头衔封给本国重臣，从1385年的伍德斯托克的托马斯到1422年的理查德·博尚。法兰西方面的伯国后来转入阿库尔家族，再归洛林家族，1547年为洛林的弗朗索瓦升格为公国，其后又先后落入萨伏依家族和奥尔良家族之手。

en: Auvergne, a mountainous country in south-central France, takes its name from the Arverni, the Gallic tribe whose chieftain Vercingetorix led the great revolt against Julius Caesar in 52 BC. It passed from the Visigoths to the Franks in 507, and in the High Middle Ages its lands split into four fiefs: the County of Auvergne formed around 980, the bishop's county of Clermont, the dauphinate of Auvergne, and from 1360 the royal duchy. At Clermont in 1095 Pope Urban II preached the First Crusade. Louis VIII granted the county to his son Alfonso in 1225, and it reverted to the crown on his death in 1271. In 1332 the county passed to the child countess Joan I, who by marriage brought it first to Philip of Burgundy and then, in 1350, to the future John II of France, making her queen of France. Raided during the Hundred Years' War, the county later passed to the House of La Tour d'Auvergne and in 1531 to Catherine de' Medici before becoming royal domain; in 1790 the old province was divided into departments.
zh: 奥弗涅是法兰西中南部的山地之地，其名来自高卢部族阿维尔尼人——公元前52年，阿维尔尼首领维钦托利正是在这里领导了反抗尤利乌斯·恺撒的大起义。它507年从西哥特人转入法兰克人之手；中世纪盛期，当地裂为四块封地：约980年形成的奥弗涅伯国、克莱蒙教会伯国、奥弗涅王太子领，以及1360年设立的王室公爵领。1095年，教皇乌尔班二世在克莱蒙布道，号召发起第一次十字军东征。1225年路易八世把伯国封给儿子阿尔方斯，1271年阿尔方斯死后伯国收归王室。1332年伯国传给年幼的女伯爵让娜一世，她先嫁勃艮第的腓力，1350年又改嫁后来的法兰西国王约翰二世，由此成为法兰西王后。百年战争期间此地屡遭袭扰，后来伯国转入拉图尔·德奥弗涅家族之手，1531年归凯瑟琳·德·美第奇所有，最终成为王室领地；1790年，这个旧行省被划分为多个省份。

en: The County of Auxerre, centred on the city of Auxerre on the Yonne river in northern Burgundy, was one of the oldest fiefs of the West Frankish kingdom, its first recorded count being Ermenaud, a companion of Charlemagne. Around 859 King Charles the Bald granted it to his cousin Conrad of the Welf family, and it later passed to Robert the Strong and then into the Burgundian dominion of Richard the Justiciar. For two and a half centuries Auxerre was ruled together with the counties of Nevers and Tonnerre, until the three were divided among the daughters of Countess Mahaut II in 1262. Through the marriage of Alix of Burgundy-Auxerre to John of Chalon it then came to the House of Chalon. In 1337 its count was John II of Chalon, born in 1292, who also held Tonnerre and was held prisoner in London during the Hundred Years' War. His son John III sold the county to King Charles V in 1370; the Treaty of Arras assigned it to the Duchy of Burgundy in 1435, and the French crown recovered it for good in 1477.
zh: 欧塞尔伯国以勃艮第北部约讷河畔的欧塞尔城为中心，是西法兰克王国最古老的封地之一，有记载的首任伯爵是查理曼的同伴埃尔莫诺。约859年，秃头查理把它封给韦尔夫家族的表亲康拉德，其后又经强人罗贝尔之手，并入正义者理查的勃艮第领地。在此后两个半世纪里，欧塞尔与讷韦尔、托内尔两个伯国合并统治，直到1262年女伯爵玛奥二世的女儿们将三地瓜分。后来勃艮第-欧塞尔的阿莉克斯嫁给沙隆的约翰，伯国遂转入沙隆家族。1337年在位的是生于1292年的沙隆的约翰二世，他兼领托内尔，在百年战争中被囚于伦敦。其子约翰三世于1370年把伯国卖给法王查理五世；1435年的《阿拉斯条约》将它划归勃艮第公国，1477年法兰西王室最终将其收回。

en: Avaria, also called the Avar Nutsaldom after its ruler the nutsal, was the highland state of the Avar people in the mountains of Dagestan, with its seat at Khunzakh. Christianity brought from Georgia between the fifth and twelfth centuries lingered in its valleys until the fourteenth or fifteenth, and although the Golden Horde overran the country in 1241, the Avar khans kept their practical independence through the fourteenth century. The rise of the neighbouring Shamkhalate of Kazi-Kumukh after the Golden Horde's fifteenth-century collapse narrowed their power, and the loosely knit khanate left broad autonomy to its mountain communities, the djamaats. Caught between the Ottomans and the Safavids in the sixteenth century, the Avar tribes adopted Islam in the seventeenth. In 1741 they destroyed the army of Nader Shah in the Dagestan mountains, and under Umma-Khan, who ruled from 1775 to 1801, the rulers of Shaki, Quba and Shirvan paid them tribute. The khanate submitted to Russia in 1803, and heavy-handed Russian rule drove the highlanders to join the Muslim imamate's rising from the late 1820s.
zh: 阿瓦尔又称阿瓦尔努茨尔邦，得名于其统治者的称号“努茨尔”，是阿瓦尔人在达吉斯坦山区建立的高地政权，统治中心设在洪扎赫。5至12世纪间由格鲁吉亚传入的基督教在山谷中延续到14、15世纪；1241年金帐汗国曾攻占此地，但阿瓦尔诸汗在14世纪仍保持着实际独立。15世纪金帐汗国崩溃后，邻近的加齐库穆赫沙姆哈尔国兴起，压缩了阿瓦尔汗的权势，这个结构松散的汗国也让山区公社“贾马阿特”享有广泛自治。16世纪它夹在奥斯曼与萨法维两强之间，阿瓦尔诸部于17世纪改宗伊斯兰教。1741年，他们在达吉斯坦山区歼灭了纳迪尔沙的大军；1775—1801年在位的乌玛汗时期国势最盛，沙基、库巴和希尔凡的统治者都向其纳贡。1803年汗国归附俄国，随后俄国的高压统治又迫使山民在19世纪20年代末投身穆斯林伊玛目的起义。

en: The Awori are a subgroup of the Yoruba people whose homeland lies at the southwestern edge of Yorubaland, among the creeks and lagoons of the Guinea coast. Tradition holds that they moved down the Ogun river under their ruler Olofin, and their earliest centre was Isheri on the lower Ogun, where Ogunfunminire, said to have come from Ife, was their first king. As lagoon trade grew, their chief settlements shifted from Ebute-Metta to Iddo and then to the island of Èkó, a fishing and farming hamlet whose name means farmstead in Yoruba. In the sixteenth century the Benin kingdom brought Èkó under its control and installed a line of obas, while Portuguese traders, visiting the coast from about 1472, drew the lagoon towns into Atlantic commerce. Through these changes the Awori kept their Yoruba dialect and Isese faith, living by fishing, farming and waterborne trade that linked them to Ijebu and the wider Yoruba world.
zh: 阿沃里人是约鲁巴人的一支，传统家园在约鲁巴兰西南边缘、几内亚沿海的河汊与潟湖之间。相传他们在首领奥洛芬率领下沿奥贡河迁徙，最早的中心在奥贡河下游的伊谢里，据传来自伊费的奥贡芬米尼尔是他们的第一位国王。随着潟湖贸易兴盛，聚居中心先从埃布特梅塔迁至伊多，最后转到岛村埃科；在约鲁巴语里，埃科意为农庄。16世纪，贝宁王国控制埃科并册立了一脉奥巴；约1472年起葡萄牙商人到访海岸，把潟湖诸城带入大西洋贸易。在此变局中，阿沃里人保留着约鲁巴方言和奥里沙教信仰，以捕鱼、农耕和水上贸易为生，与伊杰布及更广阔的约鲁巴世界往来。

en: Axochiapan, whose Nahuatl name means place of water flowers after the white lilies that carpet its ponds and streams, lies in the warm valley of the Amatzinac River in the southeastern corner of Morelos, hard by the Puebla border. Human settlement in the district goes back to Olmec times, when the nearby centre of Chalcatzingo dominated the area, but the town itself was a Tlahuica community, one of the Nahua groups that settled eastern Morelos from the early fourteenth century. It appears in the Mexica tribute rolls as one of the towns of the Tlalnahuac, the cotton country subdued for the Aztec Empire under Moctezuma I around 1440, and like its neighbours it passed to the Spanish crown when Gonzalo de Sandoval's troops overran the district in March 1521. Franciscan and later Augustinian friars put up its first churches in the sixteenth century.
zh: 阿索奇亚潘的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“水花之地”，得名于铺满池塘溪流的白色睡莲；它坐落在莫雷洛斯东南角、紧邻普埃布拉边界的阿马齐纳克河暖谷中。这一带的人类居住史可上溯到奥尔梅克时期，当时的区域中心是邻近的查尔卡钦戈，但城镇本身是特拉维卡人的聚落——特拉维卡人是14世纪初起定居莫雷洛斯东部的纳瓦支系之一。它出现在墨西加人的贡税册中，是特拉尔纳瓦克的城镇之一，这片产棉之地在1440年前后被蒙特祖马一世为阿兹特克帝国征服。1521年3月桑多瓦尔的军队攻占该地区后，它与邻邦一同转归西班牙王室，16世纪时方济各会及后来的奥斯定会修士在这里建起了最早的教堂。

en: Axocopan, whose Nahuatl name means place of bitter waters, was an Otomi polity in the arid northern region called Teotlalpan, the present-day Mezquital Valley in the state of Hidalgo, a district that also took in the towns of Mixquiahuala and Tecozautla. After the fall of Tula in the twelfth century the region was settled by Otomi and Nahua groups who built a string of small kingdoms; in the later fourteenth century these were conquered by the Tepanecs of Azcapotzalco, and Otomi refugees fleeing the fall of Xaltocan in 1395 swelled their settlements. Axocopan kept its own rulers until the Aztec expansion under Moctezuma I in the middle of the fifteenth century, when it submitted together with Atotonilco and Xilotepec. It became one of the strategic provinces of the Aztec empire, whose hold on the north was fully consolidated only under Ahuitzotl in 1488.
zh: 阿霍科潘的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“苦水之地”，是干旱的北部地区特奥特拉尔潘的一个奥托米人政权，其地即今伊达尔戈州的梅斯基塔尔谷地，辖区还包括米斯基瓦拉和特科绍特拉等镇。12世纪图拉灭亡后，奥托米人和纳瓦人陆续迁入这一地区，建立起一连串小王国；14世纪后期，这些小邦被阿斯卡波察尔科的特帕内克人征服，1395年夏尔托坎陷落后逃出的奥托米难民又壮大了当地聚落。阿霍科潘保留了自己的统治者，直到15世纪中期蒙特祖马一世发动阿兹特克扩张，它才与阿托托尼尔科、希洛特佩克一同臣服。此后它成为阿兹特克帝国的战略行省之一，帝国对北方的控制到1488年阿维索特尔在位时才完全巩固。

en: The Ayarmaca were the leading chiefdom of the Cusco region in the two centuries before Inca supremacy. Emerging around the thirteenth century from the ruins of the Wari culture, they built a state that the Spanish sources credit with eighteen towns, controlling the country north and northwest of Cusco, including Chinchero, Ollantaytambo, Calca and Pisac, the seat assigned to them in 1337. Closely linked with the neighbouring Pinagua kingdom, the Ayarmaca overshadowed the small Inca polity of Cusco and warred against it for roughly two hundred years. Their king Tocay Capac, the ruler shown in 1337, fought the Inca lords Sinchi Roca and Lloque Yupanqui, and the chronicles also make him the rival of Inca Roca for the bride Mama Micay and the captor of the young prince Titu Cusi Huallpa. Towards the end of the fourteenth century the expanding Chankas pressed the Ayarmaca from the south and west. After the Incas under Pachacuti broke Chanka power in the 1430s, the Ayarmaca domains were split into three chiefdoms and then absorbed into the Inca Empire.
zh: 阿亚尔马卡是印卡称霸前库斯科地区首屈一指的酋长国。它约在13世纪从瓦里文化的废墟上兴起，西班牙史料称其拥有十八座城镇，控制着库斯科以北和西北的土地，包括钦切罗、奥兰泰坦博、卡尔卡和1337年作为其治所的皮萨克。阿亚尔马卡与邻近的皮纳瓜王国关系密切，令库斯科的印卡小城邦相形见绌，双方交战约两百年之久。1337年在任的首领托凯·卡帕克曾与印卡首领辛奇·罗卡、略克·尤潘基作战；史籍还记载他是印卡·罗卡争夺新娘玛玛·米凯的对手，并曾俘获年幼的王子蒂图·库西·瓦尔帕。14世纪末，扩张中的昌卡人从南面和西面逼近阿亚尔马卡。1430年代帕查库特克率领印卡人击溃昌卡势力后，阿亚尔马卡的领地被拆成三个酋长国，随后并入印卡帝国。

en: The Aydınids were a Turkoman naval beylik on the Aegean coast of Anatolia, ruled from Birgi and famed across the eastern Mediterranean for seaborne raiding. The dynasty began as a client of the Germiyanids when the sons of Aydın, led by Mehmed Bey, seized Ephesus in 1304; after Mehmed eliminated his rival Sasa Bey in 1308 he made himself an independent emir. His son Umur, called the Lion, completed the long siege of Smyrna in 1329 and turned the port into a pirate base, raiding Negroponte and the Greek mainland in 1332 and 1333. In 1337 Umur commanded a fleet said to number three hundred and fifty ships, and he later backed his friend John VI Kantakouzenos in the Byzantine civil war of 1341 to 1347. His attacks on Christian shipping drew the Smyrniote crusade, proclaimed by Pope Clement VI in 1343: a Venetian, Rhodian and Cypriot coalition took Smyrna in 1348 and Umur died storming its walls. The beylik then passed to his brother Hızır and to İsa, fell to the Ottomans in 1390, was briefly restored by Timur in 1402, and was permanently absorbed after the fall of its last bey Junayd in 1425.
zh: 艾登王朝是安纳托利亚爱琴海沿岸的突厥蛮海上贝伊国，以比尔吉为统治中心，曾以海盗式的海上袭击威震东地中海。该政权起初是格尔米扬的附庸，艾登之子穆罕默德贝伊于1304年攻占以弗所，1308年除掉竞争者萨萨贝伊后自立为埃米尔。他的儿子绰号狮子的乌穆尔于1329年结束对士麦那的长期围攻，把这座港口变成海盗基地，并在1332年和1333年袭掠内格罗蓬特岛与希腊本土。1337年在位的乌穆尔拥有据称多达三百五十艘船的舰队，后来又在1341—1347年的拜占庭内战中支持友人约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯。他对基督徒商船的劫掠招致教宗克雷芒六世于1343年发起的士麦那十字军：1348年，威尼斯、罗德岛与塞浦路斯联军攻陷士麦那，乌穆尔在攻城时战死。贝伊国先后传给他的兄弟赫泽尔和伊萨，1390年被奥斯曼帝国吞并，1402年由帖木儿短暂恢复，末代贝伊居内伊德败亡后于1425年永久并入奥斯曼。

en: Ayotlan, the settlement later known as Ayutla, was a Tlapanec town of the Costa Chica, the hot coastal belt of eastern Guerrero, lying on the border of Yopitzinco, the land of the related Yopi people. Its districts mixed Nahuatl speakers on the coastal plain with Tlapanec, or Me'phaa, speakers in the inland hills, and the region drew wealth from gold and cacao, Ayotlan itself specialising in jaguar skins. Long independent of Tenochtitlan, the area was conquered by the Aztec Empire, probably under Ahuitzotl in the 1480s, and turned into the strategic province of Ayotlan, which ruled over towns including Tonalá, Copala, Jalapa, Nexpa and Cuautepec and sent twice-yearly tribute of cotton, fish, jaguar and deer skins, gourds and thick gold bars. Warfare with the Yopi and with rival towns such as Jalapa and Nexpa led the Mexica to post a garrison and a calpixqui, or tribute steward, in the province. Spanish forces overran the coast in the 1520s and Ayutla became a colonial town of the Costa Chica.
zh: 阿约特兰即后来的阿尤特拉，是科斯塔奇卡（格雷罗东部炎热沿海地带）的一座特拉帕内克人城镇，毗邻同族约皮人的土地约皮钦科。它的辖区里，沿海平原多为纳瓦特尔语居民，内陆山地则讲特拉帕内克语（梅法语）；当地以黄金和可可为财富来源，阿约特兰本身尤以美洲豹皮闻名。这里长期独立于特诺奇蒂特兰之外，约在1480年代阿维索特尔在位时被阿兹特克帝国征服，改设为战略要地阿约特兰省，统辖托纳拉、科帕拉、哈拉帕、内克斯帕、夸乌特佩克等城镇，每年两次缴纳棉花、鱼、美洲豹皮和鹿皮、葫芦以及厚金锭。由于与约皮人及哈拉帕、内克斯帕等敌对城镇交战，墨西加人在该省派驻了守军和名为卡尔皮斯基的贡赋官。1520年代西班牙军队攻占海岸，阿尤特拉成为科斯塔奇卡的一座殖民城镇。

en: Al-Zafir, more fully the Dhafeer, is a Bedouin Arab tribe of the Tayy stock; genealogists from Ibn Fadlallah al-Umari onward derive them from the Banu Lam and place their ancestral grazing grounds at al-Dhaghn, opposite Medina. In that earliest period their camps lay in the desert east of the holy city, around the wells and pastures later represented by Suwaydirah, Rabadha and Hinakiyya. Having no fixed settlements, the tribe spread by raiding and migration, moving first into central Najd and then to the deserts of northern Najd, southern Iraq and Kuwait, earning the nickname People of Flowing Hair and Camel Caravans because even their women and children rode along on their raids. In 1782 a Dhafeer cavalry contingent answered the call of the House of Khalifa of Kuwait, sailed to Bahrain and fought in the Battle of Zubarah, which ended Zand Persian rule over the island.
zh: 扎菲尔，全称达菲尔，是泰伊系的贝都因阿拉伯部落；自伊本·法德拉拉·欧麦里以来的谱系学家都把他们归入巴努·拉姆，并将其祖居牧场定在麦地那对面的达甘。在最早的时期，他们的营地就散布在圣城以东的沙漠里，围绕后来以苏韦迪拉、拉巴扎和希纳基耶为代表的水井与牧场活动。由于没有固定居地，全族靠劫掠和迁徙向外扩散，先进入内志中部，再深入内志北部、伊拉克南部和科威特的沙漠；他们连妇女儿童都随队出征，因而得到“垂发与驼队之民”的绰号。1782年，一支达菲尔骑兵应科威特哈利法家族之召渡海前往巴林，参加祖巴拉战役，此役终结了赞德王朝波斯人对该岛的统治。

en: Aztatlán was a pre-Hispanic señorío on the Pacific coast of north-western Mesoamerica, stretching from the Acaponeta river in what is now northern Nayarit to the San Pedro river in southern Sinaloa; its Nahuatl name means the kingdom of the place of herons. It had no large cities but many small villages, Tecuala and Mexcaltitán among them, and the chiefdoms of Centispac, Acaponeta and Tzapotzinco paid it tribute. Its people spoke Nayarita Nahuatl, while Cora, Tepehuán and Totorame communities also lived within its borders. Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán's expedition overran the señorío in 1530 and pushed on into Sinaloa in 1531. Its coast had earlier been the heartland of the Aztatlán trading culture that flourished from about 850 to 1350.
zh: 阿兹塔特兰是美索美洲西北太平洋沿岸的一个征服前领主邦，辖地从今纳亚里特北部的阿卡波内塔河延伸到锡那罗亚南部的圣佩德罗河，纳瓦特尔语意为苍鹭之地的王国。境内没有大城市，只有众多小村庄，特夸拉和梅斯卡尔蒂坦都在其中，森蒂斯帕克、阿卡波内塔和察波钦科等邦向它纳贡。居民讲纳亚里特纳瓦特尔语，境内还散居着科拉人、特佩万人和托托拉姆人。1530年，努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼的远征军攻灭该邦，并于1531年继续向锡那罗亚推进。更早的时候，这片海岸还是约850—1350年兴盛的阿兹塔特兰贸易文化的中心地带。

en: Bacan was one of the four kingdoms of Maluku, alongside Ternate, Tidore and Jailolo, ruling the mountainous Bacan group south of Ternate from its chief town Amasing on the main island's isthmus; its earliest rulers kept their seat on Kasiruta and drew wealth from cloves and from influence over northern Ceram and the Papuan islands. In 1337 it was still ruled under the old local cults, its elite only accepting Islam around the late fifteenth century. The first Portuguese fleet to reach the Moluccas opened a trading post there in 1513, and in 1557 the missionary Antonio Vaz converted the sultan and his court to Catholicism; invasions from Ternate after 1570 forced the ruler back to Islam and reduced Bacan to intermittent vassalage. A Spanish fort was built in 1606, but after the Dutch East India Company gained hegemony in 1609 its power rested on Fort Barnaveld, and the sultanate became a Dutch protectorate bound by the clove monopoly, whose officers in 1705 seized the English explorer William Dampier for breaking it.
zh: 巴占是摩鹿加四大王国之一，与特尔纳特、蒂多雷和贾伊洛洛并列，统治着特尔纳特以南多山的巴占群岛，重镇是主岛地峡上的阿马辛；最早的君主驻跸于卡斯鲁塔岛，靠丁香贸易以及对斯兰岛北部和巴布亚诸岛的影响致富。1337年时它仍信奉本土古老信仰，统治阶层约在15世纪末才改宗伊斯兰教。1513年，第一支抵达摩鹿加的葡萄牙船队在此设立商馆；1557年传教士安东尼奥·瓦斯使苏丹及其宫廷皈依天主教。1570年以后特尔纳特屡次入侵，迫使君主改回伊斯兰教，巴占也沦为时断时续的附庸。1606年西班牙人在此建堡，但1609年荷兰东印度公司确立霸权后，依托巴尔纳费尔德堡控制此地，巴占苏丹国成为受丁香垄断条约约束的荷兰保护国，1705年其守军还以违反垄断为由扣押了英国探险家威廉·丹皮尔。

en: Baudh, on the middle Mahanadi in western Orissa, grew out of the old Bhanja country of the Khinjali mandala, whose capital Dhritipura stood on the site of modern Boudh. The Bhanjas were an ancient line of local Kshatriya chiefs whose peafowl emblem and peahen founding myth went back to early medieval times; they ruled as feudatories first of the Bhauma-Kara kings and then of the Somavamshis, until the Eastern Gangas absorbed the region and installed local chieftains as tributaries. In the fourteenth century a childless Brahmin chief of Baudh adopted a nephew of the Bhanja raja of Keonjhar; the prince took the name Ananga Deva and made himself raja of Baudh, founding the line that still ruled when the Garhjat chiefs came under Maratha tribute in the eighteenth century and British protection after 1803.
zh: 包特位于奥里萨西部的默哈讷迪河中游，其前身是古老班杰人经营的金贾利曼陀罗，其都城德里蒂普拉就在今包特城一带。班杰人是本地古老的刹帝利首领世系，孔雀徽记和雌孔雀起源传说可追溯到中世纪早期，他们先后作为巴乌马-卡拉诸王和索马瓦姆希王朝的附庸，直到东恒伽王朝吞并该地，改由当地首领纳贡称臣。14世纪，包特一位没有子嗣的婆罗门首领收养了克翁贾尔班杰王的侄子；这位王子取名阿能伽·提婆，自立为包特王，开创的王统一直延续到18世纪——那时迦尔贾德诸邦向马拉塔人纳贡，1803年后又归入英国保护。

en: Banggai was a small island kingdom in the Banggai Archipelago off the eastern peninsula of Celebes, centred on the island of Banggai and ruling also the large island of Peleng. A Chinese document of 1304 and the Majapahit court poem Negarakertagama both name it as a tributary of Majapahit, and Moluccan tradition recorded by the Portuguese in the 1530s made its kings hatch, with those of Bacan and Buton, from serpent eggs, marking the islands as part of the Ternate world. In 1337 it was a pagan seafaring polity whose traders dealt in foodstuffs and sea cucumber. In the sixteenth century the sultanate of Ternate conquered the four small states of the islands under Sultan Babullah, and around 1580 the Javanese-born general Adi Cokro extended its rule to Balantak and other parts of the Celebes mainland; in 1564 the Banggai king had even sent his son to Ternate to weigh Christianity against Islam, choosing Christianity. After the Treaty of Bongaya in 1667 Ternate received Banggai's annual tribute and appointed its rajas, though Bugis traders grew increasingly influential at the court, which moved from Banggai to Mendono in 1690 and to Balantak in 1708 amid raids from Papua and wars with Buton. The Dutch East India Company tried and failed to establish its hold there in this period, and the common people of the interior kept their old beliefs while Islam spread only along the coast.
zh: 邦盖是苏拉威西东部半岛外海邦盖群岛的小岛王国，以邦盖岛为中心，还统治着大岛佩伦。1304年的中国文献和满者伯夷宫廷史诗《爪哇史颂》都把它记为满者伯夷的朝贡邦；16世纪30年代葡萄牙人记录的马鲁古传说称，邦盖诸王与巴占、布顿的君主一样自蛇卵孵化而生，表明这些岛屿属于特尔纳特世界。1337年时它还是信奉本土信仰的航海政权，商人经营粮食和海参贸易。16世纪，特尔纳特苏丹国在巴布乌拉苏丹治下征服了岛上的四个小邦；约1580年，出生于爪哇的将领阿迪·佐克罗把统治扩展到巴兰塔克等苏拉威西本土地区。早在1564年，邦盖国王就曾派儿子前往特尔纳特比较基督教与伊斯兰教，最终选择了基督教。1667年《邦加亚条约》后，特尔纳特每年收取邦盖贡赋并任命其拉查，而布吉商人在宫廷中的影响日增；因巴布亚人的袭击和与布顿的战争，宫廷于1690年从邦盖岛迁至门多诺，1708年再迁至巴兰塔克。这一时期荷兰东印度公司试图控制邦盖却未能成功，伊斯兰教只在沿海传播，内陆平民仍保留古老信仰。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Bamberg was a church state of the Holy Roman Empire in Franconia, ruled from the city of Bamberg. Its diocese was erected at the Frankfurt synod of 1007 at the request of King Henry II, who wanted a missionary base for the still partly pagan lands around the upper Main. Its second bishop, Suidger, became Pope Clement II in 1046 and was buried in Bamberg Cathedral, while Bishop Otto, who died in 1139, earned the name Apostle of the Pomeranians for his missions along the Baltic. Around 1245 the bishops won imperial immediacy and turned their estates into a territorial principality. The bishopric suffered occupation during the Second Margrave War of 1552 to 1554 and afterwards fortified Forchheim. In the early seventeenth century it became a centre of the Counter-Reformation and of notorious witch trials, whose victims included the Bamberg mayor Johannes Junius; Swedish and Weimar troops overran it in the Thirty Years' War until the Catholic victory at Nördlingen in 1634 restored the bishops. A university was founded in 1647. Burdened by the Seven Years' War, the bishops sold their distant Carinthian estates, which included Villach, to the Habsburgs in 1759. In 1802 Bavarian troops occupied the state, and the mediatisation of 1803 annexed it to Bavaria.
zh: 班贝格主教区是神圣罗马帝国在法兰克尼亚的教会邦国，以班贝格城为统治中心。1007年，应国王亨利二世之请，法兰克福宗教会议设立班贝格教区，作为向美因河上游仍有异教残余的地区传教的基地。第二任主教苏伊德格于1046年当选教皇克雷芒二世，身后葬在班贝格主教座堂；1139年去世的奥托主教因在波罗的海沿岸传教，被称为波美拉尼亚人的使徒。约1245年，班贝格主教获得帝国直辖地位，把领地经营成领土邦国。1552—1554年的第二次侯爵战争中，主教区被军队占领，战后主教修建了福希海姆要塞。17世纪初，这里成为反宗教改革的重镇，也因猎巫审判恶名远扬，受害者包括班贝格市长约翰内斯·尤尼乌斯；三十年战争中瑞典和魏玛军队一度攻占此地，直到1634年天主教一方在讷德林根取胜，主教才得以返回。1647年，班贝格大学创立。七年战争的负担迫使主教们在1759年把包括菲拉赫在内的遥远克恩滕领地卖给哈布斯堡家族。1802年巴伐利亚军队占领主教区，1803年的陪臣化决议正式将其并入巴伐利亚。

en: The County of Bar, centered on Bar-le-Duc in the Barrois, began as a principality of the Holy Roman Empire held from the eleventh century by the House of Montbéliard. Its position on the French border split its allegiance: in 1301 Count Henry III had to hold the western part of his lands as a fief of Philip IV of France, while the eastern part remained imperial. In 1337 Henry IV succeeded as count and at once clashed with Duke Rudolph of Lorraine over homage, a quarrel ended by French mediation. The county was raised to a duchy in 1354 under Duke Robert, who became a peer of France. When the Montbéliard line died out in 1430, Bar passed to René of Anjou, already heir to Lorraine, and from 1480 the two duchies were ruled together; René II decreed in 1506 that they should never be separated. Bar followed Lorraine's fate thereafter, going to Stanisław Leszczyński in 1738 and to the French crown on his death in 1766.
zh: 巴尔伯国以巴尔鲁瓦地区的巴勒迪克为中心，本是神圣罗马帝国的一个邦国，11世纪起由蒙贝利亚尔家族统治。地处法兰西边境的位置使它的臣属关系一分为二：1301年，伯爵亨利三世被迫把西部领地作为法兰西国王腓力四世代下的封邑持有，东部则仍隶属帝国。1337年亨利四世继位，随即因臣服礼之争与洛林公爵拉乌尔冲突，最后由法兰西方面调停收场。1354年，伯国在罗贝尔公爵治下升为公国，罗贝尔并成为法兰西世卿。1430年蒙贝利亚尔家族男系断绝，巴尔传给已取得洛林继承权的安茹的勒内；1480年起两个公国合并统治，勒内二世于1506年立下遗嘱，宣布两地永不分离。此后巴尔与洛林同命运：1738年封给斯坦尼斯瓦夫·莱什琴斯基，1766年他去世后归入法兰西王冠。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Basel was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire whose rulers combined the office of bishop with secular lordship over lands in the Upper Rhine and the Jura, including Bienne and Delémont. A Frankish foundation of the eighth century, the see received its first secular territory in 999, when King Rudolph III of Burgundy granted it the Abbey of Moutier-Grandval, and after Burgundy merged into the Empire in 1032 its bishops became imperial princes with a seat in the Imperial Diet. The principality reached the height of its power between the late twelfth and early fourteenth centuries, though money troubles later in that century forced several bishops to sell off districts. The Council of Basel, held in the city from 1431 to 1449 and marked by the election of the antipope Felix V in 1439, made it a centre of Latin Christendom, and Pope Pius II founded the University of Basel in 1459. The city itself won de facto independence by the late fourteenth century and joined the Swiss Confederation in 1501; when it adopted the Reformation under Johannes Oecolampadius in 1528, the bishop withdrew to Porrentruy and ruled only the Jura lands until French revolutionary armies dissolved the state in 1792.
zh: 巴塞尔主教侯国是神圣罗马帝国的一个教会邦国，统治者身兼主教与世俗领主，领有莱茵河上游和侏罗山一带的土地，包括比安和德莱蒙。教区创立于8世纪的法兰克时代；999年勃艮第国王鲁道夫三世把穆捷-格朗瓦勒修道院赠予教区，它才有了第一块世俗领地；1032年勃艮第并入帝国后，巴塞尔主教成为帝国王侯，在帝国议会拥有席位。主教侯国在12世纪末至14世纪初达到权势顶峰，但14世纪后期的财政困难迫使几任主教变卖辖区。1431年至1449年在巴塞尔城召开的巴塞尔公会议使它成为拉丁基督教世界的中心，1439年还选出了对立教宗费利克斯五世；1459年教宗庇护二世创立巴塞尔大学。巴塞尔城本身在14世纪末已获得事实上的独立，1501年加入瑞士邦联；1528年该城在约翰内斯·奥科兰帕迪乌斯主持下改宗新教，主教退往波朗特吕，只统治侏罗山区的领地，直到1792年法国革命军队将这个国家解散。

en: The Baatud were one of the larger tribes of the Oirats, the western Mongols of the Altai and Gobi steppe, grazing around Naomao near Barkul in 1337. The tribe was absorbed into other Oirat groups in the sixteenth century, and many of its people perished in the Qing conquest of Dzungaria of 1755-1758.
zh: 巴图特是瓦剌诸部中的大部落之一，瓦剌即游牧于阿尔泰山与戈壁草原的西部蒙古人；1337年时，巴图特人在巴里坤附近的淖毛一带游牧。16世纪时该部被其他瓦剌部落吞并，到1755—1758年清朝征服准噶尔之际，许多巴图特人又死于战乱之中。

en: Bayan was a Hurka Jurchen polity seated at Bayan Susu on the north bank of the middle Songhua, the place that gives present-day Bayan County its name. Bayan means rich in Mongolian and Manchu, and the surrounding country was held by Hurka and other forest Tungusic clans until their incorporation into the rising Manchu state in the early seventeenth century.
zh: 巴彦是以巴彦苏苏为中心的虎尔哈女真政权，地处松花江中游北岸，今巴彦县即因其得名；巴彦在蒙古语、满语中意为富饶。其地周边本是虎尔哈等森林通古斯氏族的渔猎之区，17世纪初陆续被兴起的满洲政权收服。

en: The County of Blankenburg lay in and around the Harz mountains, centred on Blankenburg Castle, which the Saxon duke Lothair of Supplinburg had built around 1123. His vassal Poppo I is documented as count of the Eastern Harzgau from 1128; after his death his sons split the inheritance, one branch founding the House of Regenstein while Siegfried I kept Blankenburg. When Henry the Lion was deposed in 1180 the Blankenburg counts stayed loyal to their Welf overlord, until the prince-bishop of Halberstadt besieged their castle in 1182 and made the county a fief of Halberstadt, a overlordship long disputed by the dukes of Brunswick-Lüneburg. The town beneath the castle was laid out around 1200. The comital line died out in 1599 and the fief reverted to Halberstadt, then held by the Welf administrator Henry Julius; despite the secularisation of Halberstadt in 1648, the Welfs retained Blankenburg as an eastern exclave of their principality of Wolfenbüttel. In 1707 Emperor Joseph I raised it to an immediate principality, and from 1731 it was ruled in personal union with Wolfenbüttel. Blankenburg was absorbed into Napoleon's Kingdom of Westphalia in 1807, restored after the Battle of Leipzig, and in 1815 became a district of the Duchy of Brunswick.
zh: 布兰肯堡伯国位于哈茨山区一带，以布兰肯堡城堡为中心。这座城堡约1123年由萨克森公爵苏普林堡的洛泰尔下令修建，他的封臣波波一世自1128年起被记载为东哈茨高的伯爵。波波死后诸子分割遗产，一支建立了雷根施泰因家族，齐格弗里德一世则保留了布兰肯堡。1180年狮子亨利被废黜时，布兰肯堡伯爵仍忠于韦尔夫宗主，直到1182年哈尔伯施塔特主教围攻城堡，迫使伯国成为哈尔伯施塔特的封邑，而这一宗主权长期受到不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵们的争夺。城堡脚下的城镇约在1200年营建。1599年伯爵家族绝嗣，封地收归当时由韦尔夫派管理者亨利·尤利乌斯掌管的哈尔伯施塔特；1648年哈尔伯施塔特被世俗化后，韦尔夫家族仍保住布兰肯堡，把它作为沃尔芬比特尔亲王国的东部飞地。1707年，皇帝约瑟夫一世将其升格为直属帝国的亲王国，1731年起与沃尔芬比特尔结成君合国。1807年布兰肯堡被并入拿破仑的威斯特伐利亚王国，莱比锡战役后恢复，1815年成为不伦瑞克公国的一个行政区。

en: Bambuk is the hilly gold-bearing country between the upper Senegal and the Falémé rivers, whose alluvial goldfields made it one of the principal sources of the gold that fed the trans-Saharan trade in the Middle Ages. Carthaginian merchants were said to have opened packhorse routes across the Sahara to reach its gold, and the region was absorbed into the Mali Empire in the thirteenth century. Its Soninke and Malinké villagers lived in largely autonomous settlements scattered through the Bambouk Mountains, whose rugged terrain made the country both a mining district and a refuge. After the conquest the Muslim Diakhanke clerics founded Diakhaba, served the local chiefs and spread trading communities into Bondou and Futa Jallon. Portuguese parties reached the Falémé around 1550 but perished, and the French built Fort Saint Pierre on the river in 1714 and two trading posts in 1724, only to abandon them all by 1759. Bambuk never formed a durable kingdom of its own, and in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries its divided villages were repeatedly preyed on by Khasso and Bundu.
zh: 邦布是塞内加尔河上游与法莱梅河之间的多山产金之地，其砂金矿是中世纪跨撒哈拉贸易黄金的主要来源之一。据说迦太基商人曾开辟穿越撒哈拉的驮马商路到此购金，13世纪该地区被马里帝国吞并。这里的索宁克人和马林克人居住在散布于邦布山区、高度自治的村落中，崎岖的山地既便于采金，也使其成为避难之地。被征服后，穆斯林迪亚汉克神职人员建立迪亚哈巴，为当地酋长服务，并把经商社群扩展到邦杜和富塔贾隆。葡萄牙人约在1550年抵达法莱梅河，但全队覆灭；法国人于1714年在河畔修建圣皮埃尔堡，1724年又设两处商站，最终在1759年前全部放弃。邦布始终没有形成持久的统一王国，18至19世纪，其分裂的村落屡遭卡索和邦杜侵夺。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Chur was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire in the Alpine valleys of Raetia, ruled from the city of Chur. A bishopric existed there in late Roman times, with the bishop Asinio first documented in 451, and Saint Lucius, said to have been martyred at Chur, became its patron saint. In the Middle Ages the bishop ruled much of what is now Graubünden together with Chiavenna, Bormio and the Vinschgau, and Emperor Frederick I raised the see to a prince-bishopric in 1170. Its outlying valleys slipped away early: Chiavenna and Bormio fell to Milan in the fourteenth century, while the Vinschgau and the Lower Engadine, including Tarasp from 1239, passed to the counts of Tyrol. In 1367 the bishop's subjects banded together in the League of God's House, the nucleus of the Three Leagues, which gradually absorbed the bishop's secular powers. Austrian troops seized Chur in 1621 during the Thirty Years' War until a French and Swiss army retook it in 1624. The early modern principality was reduced to the palace district at Chur and scattered rights, its last southern seat, the Fürstenburg, being lost only in 1806.
zh: 库尔采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国在阿尔卑斯山雷蒂亚诸谷地的教会邦国，以库尔城为中心。罗马帝国晚期这里已有教区，主教阿西尼奥于451年首次见诸记载；传说在库尔殉道的圣卢齐乌斯被奉为主保圣人。中世纪时，主教统治着今格劳宾登的大部分土地，以及基亚文纳、博尔米奥和温施高；1170年，皇帝腓特烈一世将该主教区升格为采邑主教区。边缘谷地很早就相继丧失：14世纪基亚文纳和博尔米奥落入米兰之手，温施高和下恩加丁（1239年起包括塔拉斯普）则转归蒂罗尔伯爵。1367年，主教的属民结成上帝之家同盟，即三同盟的雏形，逐步接管了主教的世俗权力。三十年战争期间，奥地利军队于1621年攻占库尔，1624年法国与瑞士联军将其收复。近代的主教区只剩下库尔城内的宫苑辖区和零星权利，它在南方最后的据点菲斯滕堡也于1806年失去。

en: The Margraviate of Baden was the Upper Rhine state of the House of Zähringen, whose lord Herman II built Hohenbaden Castle above the hot springs of Baden and took the title margrave in 1112. Loyal service to the Hohenstaufen let the margraves expand from the edge of the Black Forest into the Breisgau and across the Rhine into Alsace. Around 1200 the lands began to split into lines, including Baden-Baden, Baden-Hochberg, Baden-Sausenberg and Baden-Eberstein; in 1337 Margrave Herman IX ruled the Eberstein line. Bernard I of Baden-Baden gathered most of the territory back together in 1391, but in 1535 it was divided again into Catholic Baden-Baden and Protestant Baden-Durlach, whose rivalry mirrored the religious wars of the age. The two were reunited in 1771 under Margrave Charles Frederick, who was made an elector in 1803 and Grand Duke of Baden in 1806 as the state expanded eastward across Swabia.
zh: 巴登藩侯国是柴林根家族在上莱茵的邦国。1112年，领主赫尔曼二世在巴登温泉上方修建霍亨巴登城堡，并采用藩侯头衔。凭借对霍亨斯陶芬家族的忠诚效力，藩侯们的领地从黑森林边缘扩张到布赖斯高，又跨过莱茵河伸入阿尔萨斯。约1200年起，领地多次分家，先后出现巴登-巴登、巴登-霍赫贝格、巴登-绍森贝格和巴登-埃伯施泰因等支系；1337年，赫尔曼九世藩侯统治的正是埃伯施泰因支。1391年，巴登-巴登的伯恩哈德一世重新合并了大部分领地，但1535年再度分裂为信奉天主教的巴登-巴登和皈依新教的巴登-杜拉赫，两支的对立折射出那个时代的宗教战争。1771年，藩侯卡尔·弗里德里希重新统一两地，他于1803年升为选侯，1806年成为巴登大公，邦国也向东越过施瓦本大幅扩张。

en: The Baduspanids were the longest-lived Iranian dynasty, ruling the mountainous Ruyan district of Tabaristan, known from the Mongol era as Rustamdar, from 665 until the Safavid conquest of 1598. Their founder Baduspan I, a son of the Dabuyid prince Gil Gavbara, received Ruyan from the last Sasanian shahanshah Yazdegerd III, and his heirs kept their highland fastnesses as tributary princes under the caliphs, the Seljuqs and the Mongols, bearing the title ustandar from which Rustamdar takes its name. In 1337 the throne at Kojur belonged to Jalal al-Dawla Iskandar, whose long reign lasted until 1359. The Marashi sayyids occupied Rustamdar between 1379 and 1391, and the restored Baduspanid king Kayumarth I weathered Timur's conquest of Mazandaran and ruled until 1453; after his death the kingdom split into the rival branches of Kojur and Nur, which Shah Abbas I finally extinguished in the 1590s.
zh: 巴杜斯潘王朝是伊朗延续最久的王朝，自665年起统治塔巴里斯坦多山的鲁扬地区，该地区自蒙古时代起称鲁斯塔姆达尔，直到1598年被萨非王朝征服。开国君主巴杜斯潘一世是达布亚王公吉尔·加夫巴拉之子，从末代萨珊万王之王伊嗣俟三世处受封鲁扬，他的后裔作为纳贡王公先后在哈里发、塞尔柱和蒙古人治下守住山地要塞，其头衔乌斯坦达尔正是鲁斯塔姆达尔一名的由来。1337年，科朱尔的王位属于贾拉勒·道莱·伊斯坎达尔，他的漫长统治一直延续到1359年。1379—1391年，马拉什圣裔占领鲁斯塔姆达尔；复国的巴杜斯潘君主卡尤玛尔斯一世熬过了帖木儿对马赞达兰的征服，统治到1453年。他死后王国分裂为科朱尔和努尔两个对立支系，最终在1590年代被阿拔斯一世消灭。

en: Beare was the small Gaelic lordship of the O'Sullivan Beare sept on the Beara Peninsula of west Cork and south Kerry, whose chiefs held Dunboy Castle on Bantry Bay as vassals of the MacCarthy kings of Desmond. The O'Sullivans, of the old Eóganacht line of Munster, were driven from Tipperary by the Normans in the 1190s and split into the O'Sullivan Mór of south Kerry and the O'Sullivan Beare, named for their peninsula. With the MacCarthys and O'Donoghues they defeated the Norman FitzGeralds at Caisglin near Kenmare in 1261 and again in 1262, fixing the border between the Gaelic and Norman parts of Kerry. For three centuries the sept kept its remote hills and harbours, until the Nine Years' War: Donal Cam O'Sullivan Beare fought at Kinsale in 1601, the English slaughtered his people on Dursey Island, and Dunboy Castle was taken and its garrison hanged in the siege of 1602. With his country lost, Donal Cam led roughly a thousand followers on a three-hundred-mile winter march to Leitrim, and died in exile in 1613, the last independent ruler of his clan.
zh: 比尔是奥沙利文·比尔氏族的盖尔人小领地，位于科克西部与克里南部的比尔拉半岛，首领坐镇班特里湾的邓博伊城堡，是德斯蒙德国王麦卡锡氏的附庸。奥沙利文氏出自芒斯特古老的尤甘纳赫特世系，12世纪90年代被诺曼人逐出蒂珀雷里，随后分成两支：南克里的奥沙利文·莫尔，以及以半岛得名的奥沙利文·比尔。1261年和1262年，他们联合麦卡锡氏和奥多诺霍氏，在肯梅尔附近的凯斯格林两度击败诺曼人菲茨杰拉德家族，划定了克里的盖尔区与诺曼区边界。此后三个世纪，该氏族一直保有偏远的山地与港湾，直到九年战争：多纳尔·卡姆·奥沙利文·比尔1601年参战金塞尔，英格兰人在德西岛屠戮他的族人，邓博伊城堡又在1602年的围攻中陷落、守军被绞死。故土尽失后，多纳尔·卡姆率约千名部众在寒冬中跋涉近五百公里前往利特里姆，1613年死于流亡途中，是该氏族最后一位独立首领。

en: Brunei was a Malay trading state on the north coast of Borneo, already known to Chinese merchants as Po-ni: in 977 its ruler sent a letter to the Chinese emperor, and in 1225 the official Zhao Rukuo recorded a rich kingdom with a hundred warships guarding its camphor and pepper trade. A Yuan-dynasty account of the fourteenth century credits Brunei with sway over Sarawak, Sabah and several Philippine islands. The Nagarakretagama of 1365 lists Barune as a tributary of Majapahit, owing forty katis of camphor a year; in 1369 a Sulu raid sacked the capital and carried off its treasure, and a Chinese report of 1371 found the kingdom weakened and poor. Around 1400 Awang Alak Betatar, returning from Johor as Sultan Muhammad Shah, made Brunei an independent Muslim sultanate. Under the fifth sultan, Bolkiah (1485–1528), its sea power covered the coasts of present-day Brunei, Sarawak and Sabah and reached Sulu, and the survivors of Magellan's expedition visited in 1521. Spain seized Manila from Brunei-linked rulers in 1571 and briefly occupied the capital in the Castilian War of 1578. Succession strife, the civil wars of 1660 and 1826, and piracy then drained the sultanate, leaving it a much-shrunken power by the early nineteenth century.
zh: 文莱是婆罗洲北岸的马来贸易国家，中国商人早已以渤泥之名与之往来：977年其君主曾致书中国皇帝，1225年官员赵汝适记载这个富庶王国有上百艘战船护卫樟脑和胡椒贸易。14世纪的元代文献称，文莱曾统辖砂拉越、沙巴和菲律宾若干岛屿。1365年的《爪哇史颂》把婆鲁奈列为满者伯夷的朝贡国，每年纳樟脑四十斤；1369年苏禄人劫掠其都城、夺走财宝，1371年的中国报告已称这个王国贫弱。约1400年，阿旺·阿拉克·贝塔塔尔从柔佛归来，改称苏丹穆罕默德·沙，使文莱成为独立的伊斯兰苏丹国。第五任苏丹博尔基亚（1485—1528年在位）时，文莱的海上势力覆盖今文莱、砂拉越和沙巴海岸，远达苏禄，麦哲伦船队的幸存者于1521年到访。1571年西班牙从与文莱有关系的统治者手中夺取马尼拉，又在1578年的卡斯蒂利亚战争中短暂占领文莱都城。此后，王位纷争、1660年和1826年的内战以及海盗活动不断消耗国力，到19世纪初，苏丹国已大为萎缩。

en: Benin was the kingdom of the Edo people in the forests of southern Nigeria, with no link to the modern Republic of Benin. Its first organized state was Igodomigodo, ruled from about 900 by kings called Ogiso, and after a period of disorder the chiefs invited the Yoruba prince Oranmiyan from Ife, whose line took the title Oba and made the forest city of Ubini, later Benin City, their capital. The kingdom was transformed in 1440 by Oba Ewuare the Great, who rebuilt the city with massive earthen walls and moats and conquered outward from the Edo heartland, turning a city-state into an empire. Portuguese explorers reached the court in 1485 and opened a lasting trade: ivory, pepper and slaves went out while brass manillas, firearms and other European goods came in, the imported Rhineland brass feeding the famous guilds that cast the Benin Bronzes. Under Oba Esigie in the early 1500s an Igala invasion was defeated with the counsel of his mother Queen Idia, later immortalized in the ivory mask, and Benin became the dominant power of the mid-western Nigerian coast, its divine Oba ruling through titled chiefs and city guilds for centuries afterward.
zh: 贝宁是埃多人的王国，位于尼日利亚南部森林之中，与今贝宁共和国并无渊源。当地最早的政权是伊戈多米戈多，约900年起由称“奥吉索”的国王统治；经过一段乱局，酋长们从伊费请来约鲁巴王子奥兰米扬，他的世系采用“奥巴”称号，以森林城市乌比尼（即后来的贝宁城）为都。1440年，奥巴·埃瓦雷大帝改变了王国的面貌：他用宏大的土墙和壕沟重建都城，并从埃多腹地向外征战，把城邦扩张为帝国。1485年葡萄牙探险家抵达王庭，开启了长期贸易：象牙、胡椒和奴隶输出海外，换来了黄铜手镯、火器等欧洲货物，而进口的莱茵黄铜正供养着铸造“贝宁青铜器”的著名行会。16世纪初，奥巴·埃西吉在母后伊迪娅女王的辅佐下击败伊加拉入侵、向东扩张，伊迪娅后来被定格为著名的象牙面具形象；贝宁由此成为尼日利亚中西部沿海的霸主，神格化的奥巴依靠受封酋长和城市行会在此后数百年间维持统治。

en: Beruas, also spelled Bruas, was a Malay settlement on the Perak coast of the Malay Peninsula, taking its name from the bruas, the seashore mangosteen tree common in the local dialect. The Malay Annals remember it as the capital of Gangga Negara, the City of the Ganges, a Hindu Malay kingdom whose lands covered Beruas, the Dindings and Manjung. Tradition in the Kedah Annals credits its founding to Raja Ganjil Sarjuna of Kedah no later than the second century. The old kingdom was overwhelmed around 1025 when the Chola emperor Rajendra I raided across the Strait of Malacca. Small Hindu chiefdoms nevertheless continued along this coast until the remnants of the fallen Malaccan Sultanate formed the Muslim Sultanate of Perak in 1528.
zh: 木威，又译布鲁阿斯，是马来半岛霹雳海岸的一处马来人聚落，名字来自当地马来方言所称的布鲁阿斯树，即海滨山竹。《马来纪年》把它记载为印度教马来古国刚迦的王都，刚迦意为恒河之城，疆域包括木威、天定和曼绒一带。《吉打纪年》的传统说法认为，该国在2世纪以前由吉打的拉者·甘吉尔·萨朱纳建立。1025年前后，注辇国王拉真陀罗越过马六甲海峡发动远征，这个古国被攻灭。但沿海的印度教小邦仍延续下来，直到1528年灭亡的马六甲苏丹国残余势力建立起信奉伊斯兰教的霹雳苏丹国。

en: West Breifne, or Breifne O Rourke, was a Gaelic kingdom of 1256 to 1605 in the country that became County Leitrim, with its chief seat at Dromahair. It grew from the breakup of the older Kingdom of Breifne after its king Tighearnan O Ruairc was killed at a parley with the Normans in 1172; the long succession war that followed ended with the Battle of Magh Slecht in 1256, which left Breifne permanently split between the O Reillys of the east and the O Rourkes of the west. In 1337 the O Rourke king still ruled unchallenged from Lough Gill to the Shannon. English reform reached the kingdom under the Tudors: it was declared County Leitrim in 1565 and folded into the Presidency of Connaught in 1569. Brian na Murtha O Rourke surrendered under the composition policy in 1585, yet sheltered survivors of the Spanish Armada in 1588; driven out in 1590 and handed over by James VI of Scotland, he was hanged, drawn and quartered for treason in 1591. His son fought in the Nine Years War, and after the last O Rourke lord died in 1605 the lands were opened to the Plantation of Leitrim.
zh: 西布雷夫讷，又称奥罗克的布雷夫讷，是1256至1605年间存在的盖尔人王国，疆域即后来的利特里姆郡，以德罗马黑尔为首要驻地。它源出古老的布雷夫讷王国的分裂：1172年，国王蒂尔南·奥罗克在与诺曼人的谈判中被杀，随后的长期继承战争到1256年的马什莱克特战役告终，布雷夫讷从此永久分为东部奥赖利家族与西部奥罗克家族两部分。1337年，奥罗克国王仍稳固地统治着从吉尔湖到香农河之间的土地。都铎王朝时期，英格兰的改制抵达这里：1565年该地被宣布为利特里姆郡，1569年并入康诺特总督区。布莱恩·纳·穆尔萨·奥罗克于1585年按和解政策投降，却在1588年收留西班牙无敌舰队的幸存者；1590年他被逐出国境，又被苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世引渡，1591年以叛国罪被处绞刑并车裂。他的儿子后来投身九年战争；1605年末代奥罗克领主去世，土地被划入利特里姆种植园。

en: The Beylik of Bafra was a small Turkmen principality on the fertile Kızılırmak delta of Anatolia's middle Black Sea coast, one of the cluster of Canik beyliks that emerged after the Mongol victory of 1243. Its people were mostly Chepni Turkmens, settled in the region during the thirteenth century. From the early fourteenth century Bafra belonged to the Pervane rulers, and around 1330 it passed with their lands to the Candarid dynasty. Its own ruling line is poorly recorded; the best-documented bey is Emirza, whose tomb inscription of 1381 shows him ruling an independent and busy market town, while an Egyptian contemporary source names its lord Murad Bey and credits him with about a thousand soldiers. In 1393 the Bafra bey submitted to the Ottoman sultan Bayezid I. The Candarid İsfendiyar briefly seized the town during the Ottoman civil war after 1402, but his son Hızır surrendered it back to the Ottomans in 1419 or 1420, ending the beylik.
zh: 巴夫拉贝伊国是安纳托利亚黑海中部沿岸、克孜勒河肥沃三角洲上的一个突厥蛮小邦，属于1243年蒙古人获胜后兴起的卡尼克贝伊国群。其居民主要是13世纪迁入此地的切普尼部突厥蛮。14世纪初，巴夫拉原属佩尔瓦内家族的贝伊国，约1330年随其土地转入坎达尔王朝之手。本地统治世系记载稀少，可考的贝伊是埃米尔扎：1381年的陵墓铭文显示他以独立君主的身份治理这座集市繁荣的城镇，埃及的同时代史料则称当地统治者为穆拉德贝伊，拥兵约一千人。1393年，巴夫拉贝伊向奥斯曼苏丹巴耶济德一世臣服。1402年安卡拉战役后的奥斯曼内战中，坎达尔的伊斯芬迪亚尔一度夺取该城，但其子赫泽尔在1419或1420年把它交还奥斯曼，贝伊国就此终结。

en: Bangga denotes the Kaili-speaking people of the upper Palu valley around Sigi, behind Donggala Bay, counted as a sub-group of the Kaili. In the fourteenth century their highland villages were ruled by Tomanuru-era aristocratic lineages, and the country later became part of Sigi Dolo, one of the eight small Kaili kingdoms of the Donggala region.
zh: 邦贾指栋加拉湾腹地、帕卢河上游西吉一带讲凯里语的人群，属凯里人的一个支系。14世纪时他们的高地村落由托玛努鲁时代的贵族世系统治，其地后来并入西吉多洛，即栋加拉地区八个凯里小王国之一。

en: The mountain country of Bagelkhand, called Dahala before the twelfth century, took its later name from the Baghela Rajputs, an offshoot of the Vaghela, itself a Solanki branch from Gujarat. Around the middle of the thirteenth century Vyaghra Deo made his way into central India and seized the fort of Marpha near Kalinjar; his son Karan Deo married a Kalachuri Haihaya princess of Mandla and received the strong fortress of Bandhogarh as her dowry. His successor Sohag Deo, ruling from Bandhogarh in 1337, founded the town of Sohagpur, and the Baghelas kept their hill kingdom while the Delhi sultans came and went. Veer Singh Deo joined Rana Sanga with four thousand horsemen at the Battle of Khanwa in 1527, and Virbhan Singh fought beside the Chandelas during the siege of Kalinjar in 1545, when Sher Shah Suri was killed. Akbar's generals took and dismantled Bandhogarh in 1597 after an eight-month siege, and Vikramaditya Deo moved the capital down to the new town of Rewa in 1618. Panna's Harde Sah sacked Rewa about 1731, but the rajas beat off a Maratha army at the Battle of Naikhai in 1796 and accepted a British treaty of protection in 1812, becoming the princely state of Rewa.
zh: 巴格尔坎德是中印度的山区，12世纪以前称达哈拉，后来的国名来自婆稽罗拉杰普特人——他们是从古吉拉特瓦盖拉家族分出的索兰基支系。13世纪中叶，维亚格拉·迪奥深入中印度，夺取卡林贾尔附近的马尔法堡；其子卡兰·迪奥娶门德拉迦罗朱利诃伊诃耶家族的公主，得到坚固的班达迦堡作为嫁妆。继位的苏诃格·迪奥1337年在班达迦执政，兴建了苏诃格布尔城，此后婆稽罗人守着山间王国，历经德里诸苏丹的来去。1527年维尔·辛格·迪奥率四千骑兵随拉纳·桑伽参加坎瓦战役；1545年维尔巴恩·辛格在卡林贾尔围城战中与昌德拉人并肩作战，舍尔沙·苏利即死于此役。1597年阿克巴的将领围城八个月后攻占并拆毁班达迦堡，维克拉马迪亚·迪奥于1618年把都城迁至新建的雷瓦城。约1731年潘纳的哈尔德·萨赫洗劫雷瓦，但诸拉贾于1796年在奈凯战役击退马拉塔大军，又在1812年与英国订约受其保护，成为雷瓦土邦。

en: Baglana was a small hill principality of the northern Deccan, lying on the trade route between Surat and Daulatabad, whose Rathore chiefs claimed descent from the Rathores of Kannauj and ruled from hill forts such as Salher under the title of Baharji. Long accustomed to paying tribute to stronger neighbours, it passed briefly under Bahmani suzerainty in 1340, backed the rebellion of Bahram Khan at Daulatabad in 1366 and was subdued by Muhammad Shah I, and from the late fourteenth century paid tribute chiefly to the Gujarat Sultanate. Attacks by the Khandesh ruler Mubarak in 1453 and 1454 were beaten off with help from Mahmud Khalji of Malwa. In 1637 the Mughal prince Aurangzeb overran the country and took its capital fort of Mulher; the raja Baharji submitted in 1638 and entered Mughal service, while his son converted to Islam. Shivaji's men seized Salher in 1670, and after a century under the Mughals, the Nizam and the Marathas, Baglana passed to the British with the fall of Mulher in 1818.
zh: 巴格拉纳是德干北部的山间小邦，地处苏拉特至道拉塔巴德的商路上，其拉杰普特首领自称出自曲女城的拉托尔人，以萨勒赫尔等山寨为治所，君号为巴哈尔吉。它长期向强邻纳贡：1340年短暂臣服巴赫曼尼，1366年支持道拉塔巴德的巴赫拉姆汗叛乱，被穆罕默德沙一世镇压，14世纪末起主要向古吉拉特苏丹国纳贡。1453至1454年，坎德什统治者穆巴拉克两度来攻，靠马尔瓦的马哈茂德·哈尔吉出兵才将其击退。1637年，莫卧儿皇子奥朗则布攻入境内，夺取都城穆勒赫尔要塞；罗阇巴哈尔吉于1638年归降并进入莫卧儿军籍，其子改宗伊斯兰教。1670年希瓦吉的部将攻占萨勒赫尔，此后历经莫卧儿、尼扎姆与马拉塔人一个多世纪的统治，巴格拉纳随1818年穆勒赫尔陷落而转入英国之手。

en: The County of Boulogne was a feudal county of the Kingdom of France centred on the Channel port of Boulogne-sur-Mer. Its lands had formed a pagus of the Franks before passing to the counts of Flanders in the tenth century, while a separate comital house emerged in the eleventh. Count Eustace II fought beside William of Normandy at Hastings in 1066, and his sons Godfrey of Bouillon and Baldwin of Boulogne led the First Crusade and both wore the crown of Jerusalem. Count Renaud joined the imperial army broken at Bouvines in 1214, after which the French crown tightened its hold, and from 1223 the county was held jure uxoris by Philip Hurepel, a son of King Philip II. Boulogne then entered a long personal union with Auvergne; in 1337 its ruler was the child countess Joan I, who later married John, Duke of Normandy, the future King John II. The La Tour d'Auvergne family succeeded to the county in 1437, and in 1477 Louis XI absorbed Boulogne into the royal domain, with the Treaty of Senlis of 1493 confirming the renunciation of Habsburg claims.
zh: 布洛涅伯国是法兰西王国的封建伯国，以海峡港口滨海布洛涅为中心。其地在法兰克王国时期已是一个地方行政区，10世纪落入佛兰德伯爵之手，11世纪兴起了独立的布洛涅家族。伯爵尤斯塔斯二世曾在1066年随诺曼底的威廉征战黑斯廷斯；他的儿子布永的戈弗雷与布洛涅的鲍德温都是第一次十字军的领袖，先后登上耶路撒冷王位。1214年，伯爵雷诺加入皇帝一方的军队，在布汶战役中被腓力二世击败，法兰西王室此后加紧了控制；1223年，国王腓力二世之子菲利普·于勒佩尔凭婚姻成为布洛涅伯爵。此后伯国长期与奥弗涅结成共主邦联，1337年在位的是年幼的女伯爵让娜一世，她后来嫁给诺曼底公爵约翰，即日后的法兰西国王约翰二世。1437年拉图尔·多韦涅家族继承伯国，1477年路易十一将布洛涅并入王室领地，1493年的《桑利斯条约》又确认哈布斯堡家族放弃对它的权利主张。

en: Bandhugara is a small Marathi-speaking Hindu chiefdom of upper Vidarbha, holding the wooded country around Nagpur, Katol and Dongartal that twelfth-century inscriptions call Jhadimandala, then under the Yadavas of Devagiri. After the Yadava kingdom fell to the Delhi sultans the region broke into local chiefdoms, and in the sixteenth century it was absorbed into the rising Gond kingdom of Deogarh.
zh: 班杜加拉是上维达尔巴地区一个操马拉地语的印度教小首领邦，据有那格浦尔、卡托尔和东加尔塔勒一带的林地；12世纪的碑铭称这片林区为贾迪曼达拉，当时受德瓦吉里的亚达瓦王朝统治。亚达瓦王国被德里苏丹攻灭后，这一带分裂为若干地方小邦，到16世纪被兴起的代奥加尔贡德王国吞并。

en: The Belgutei horde was the appanage ulus founded by Belgutei, son of Yesugei and Sochigel and elder half-brother of Genghis Khan, whose descendants ruled it as a Borjigin princely house. Belgutei served Genghis as a general and trusted envoy, famed for his counsel and for breaking the neck of the wrestler Buri Boko in revenge; the Yuanshi notes he was still alive at Möngke Khan's enthronement in 1251, making him nearly ninety. When the empire was founded he was made a king with three thousand households and lands at Guangning in western Liaoning, later adding the circuits of Xinzhou and Qianshan, while his heirs held the title Prince of Guangning. Along with the descendants of Genghis's other brothers, the house belonged to the Eastern, or Left Wing, princes beyond the Khingan range. After the Yuan withdrew from China in 1368, the Ming reorganised these brotherly Borjigin appanages into the Three Guards of 1389, in which the Belguteid princes held commands alongside the other eastern houses.
zh: 别勒古台汗国是成吉思汗异母兄别勒古台的投下封地，由他的后裔以孛儿只斤王族的身份世代统治。别勒古台是也速该与速赤吉勒之子，在成吉思汗麾下充任大将和亲信使者，以善于谋划闻名，曾在角力中拧断勇士不里·孛阔的脖子报仇；《元史》称1251年蒙哥即位时他仍在世，年近九旬。蒙古建国时他受封为王，领三千户及辽西广宁路和恩城，后又加封信州路与铅山州，其后人世袭广宁王爵位。与成吉思汗诸弟的后裔一样，该家族属于大兴安岭以东的东道诸王（左手诸王）。1368年元朝退出中原后，明朝于1389年将这些孛儿只斤诸弟的封地整编为兀良哈三卫，别勒古台的后裔与其他东部王族一同在三卫中担任指挥。

en: Bhatnir, later called Hanumangarh, was the fortress of the Bhatti Rajputs on the Ghaggar river, guarding the old road between Delhi and Multan. Tradition dates the brick fort to about 295, when King Bhupat of the Bhati dynasty raised it in memory of his father Rao Bhatti, making it one of India's oldest standing forts. By the fourteenth century Muslim Bhatti chiefs held Bhatnir and the settlements round it, and in 1398 it offered Timur his hardest resistance in India: the Bhatti raja Dul Chand led Rajputs and Muslims together in its defence before the fort was stormed and the city sacked. Afterwards Bhatnir passed among Bhatis, Johiyas and Chayals until Rao Jet Singh of Bikaner took it in 1527. It changed hands between Bikaner and the Mughals more than once, until Maharaja Surat Singh of Bikaner secured it permanently in 1805 and renamed it Hanumangarh after the day of Hanuman on which it fell.
zh: 巴特尼尔后称赫努曼格尔，是巴蒂拉杰普特人在加加尔河畔的要塞，扼守德里与木尔坦之间的古道。相传这座砖砌城堡建于295年前后，由巴蒂王朝的国王布帕特为纪念其父拉奥·巴蒂而筑，是印度现存最古老的堡垒之一。到14世纪，穆斯林巴蒂首领占据巴特尼尔及周围聚落；1398年，它给了帖木儿在印度最顽强的抵抗：巴蒂罗阇杜尔·昌德率拉杰普特人与穆斯林共同守城，最终城堡仍被攻陷、城池遭洗劫。此后巴特尼尔在巴蒂人、乔希亚人和查亚尔人之间易手，1527年被比卡内尔的拉奥·杰特·辛格夺取。它又在比卡内尔与莫卧儿之间几度转手，直到1805年比卡内尔的苏拉特·辛格将其永久占据，并因破城之日是哈奴曼神的星期二而改名为赫努曼格尔。

en: Bhanvad was the seat of the Jethwa Rajputs, the oldest ruling clan of the Saurashtra peninsula, who claimed descent from Hanuman's son Makardhwaja and were probably heirs of the Saindhava kings, the old masters of the western sea. From around 900 they ruled western Kathiawar from Morvi, until Qutb-ud-din Aibak drove them out in 1193 and they made Ghumli their capital, where the twelfth-century Navlakha sun temple still recalls their power.
