Rana Bhanji Jethwa, ruling in 1337, had lost Ghumli in 1313 when the Jadeja Jam Barmaniyaji sacked the city after an earlier failed attack by his father; Bhanji fled to Ranpur and founded the fortified town of Bhanvad, named after him, at the foot of the Barda hills. The Jethwas never fully recovered their old supremacy: Jam Raval of Nawanagar overran most of Halar between 1525 and 1535, and only the courage of Bhanji's widow Rani Kalabai, who raised the Mer and Rabari clans, won back the tract around Ranpur. In 1671 Rana Vikmatji took Porbandar from the Mughals, and the dynasty moved its capital there in 1685, entering alliance with the East India Company in 1807 and ruling as the gun-salute Maharajas of Porbandar.
zh: 班瓦德是杰特瓦拉杰普特人的治所。杰特瓦人是萨乌拉施特拉半岛最古老的统治氏族，自称是哈奴曼之子马卡德瓦贾的后裔，很可能继承了自称“西海之主”的赛恩达瓦诸王。约900年起他们以莫尔维为都统治卡提阿瓦西部，1193年被库特布丁·艾伊拜克击败后改以古姆利为都，12世纪修建的纳夫拉卡太阳庙便是其当年强盛的见证。1337年在位的拉纳·班吉·杰特瓦在1313年丢掉了古姆利：贾德贾人的贾姆·巴尔马尼亚吉为报其父先年战败之仇攻破该城，班吉逃往兰布尔，并在巴尔达山脚下修建了以自己名字命名的堡垒城镇班瓦德。杰特瓦人再未能恢复旧日霸业：1525至1535年间，纳瓦讷格尔的贾姆·拉瓦尔吞并了哈拉尔大部，全靠班吉的遗孀卡拉巴伊王后召集梅尔人和拉巴里人起兵，才夺回兰布尔一带。1671年拉纳·维克马特吉从莫卧儿手中夺得博尔本德尔，王朝于1685年迁都于此，1807年与东印度公司结盟，后来以博尔本德尔享有礼炮待遇的土邦罗阇身份延续统治。

en: The County of Beichlingen was a Thuringian lordship centered on Beichlingen Castle above the lower Saale, held by a comital family that traced itself to the early twelfth century and ranked among the Sizzonen kindreds alongside the counts of Schwarzburg. Its estates reached from the Hainleite ridge and the Kyffhauser hills to the southern Harz and the Goldene Aue, but the counts held them as fiefs of the landgraves of Thuringia. By the fourteenth century debt was eroding their power: around 1330 they sold Heringen Castle and began mortgaging pieces of the ancestral county, which in 1337 was still ruled by Count Frederick of Beichlingen. The ruin accelerated after the Saxon Brotherly War of 1446, and in 1448 the indebted counts pledged much of their land to their Stolberg and Schwarzburg kinsmen; those estates passed to them in 1457 as the joint lordship of Frohndorf, wholly Stolberg from 1468. In 1519 Count Adam von Beichlingen sold the remaining county and castle to Hans von Werthern, and the comital family died out in the male line in 1567, its lands absorbed into Electoral Saxony.
zh: 拜希林根伯国是图林根的一个领主邦，以萨勒河下游高地上的拜希林根城堡为中心。统治它的伯爵家族可追溯到12世纪初，与施瓦茨堡伯爵同属西佐亲族集团。其领地从海恩莱特山脊、基夫豪森丘陵一直延伸到南哈茨和金色奥厄谷地，但都是以图林根领地伯爵之封臣的身份持有。14世纪起，债务开始侵蚀他们的权势：约1330年他们卖掉黑林根城堡，并陆续抵押祖传伯国的各个部分；1337年在位的是拜希林根伯爵弗里德里希。1446年萨克森兄弟战争之后局势加速崩坏，1448年负债累累的伯爵把大片土地抵押给姻亲施托尔贝格和施瓦茨堡伯爵，这些地产于1457年正式转封，组成弗罗恩多夫共同领地，1468年起归施托尔贝格独占。1519年，亚当·冯·拜希林根伯爵把剩余的伯国和城堡卖给汉斯·冯·韦尔滕，伯爵家族男嗣于1567年断绝，土地并入萨克森选侯国。

en: Bhamo, known to the Shan as Man Maw or Wanmaw, was a frontier Shan state on the Ayeyarwady River in northern Burma, close to the border with Yunnan. Its name means the potter's village. Legends speak of an earlier Tai kingdom here whose capital, Sampenago, left fifth-century city walls and stupas holding relics of the Buddha a short distance from the later town. A local chronicle records that from 1202 Man Maw was run by ministers sent from Möng Mit, and only in 1470 was it granted to a son of the Möng Mit saopha; Chinese records likewise remember it as once belonging to Möng Mit and, earlier still, to Hsenwi. As the main emporium of the Burma–China trade, it was contested from the 1470s onward by Möng Yang, Möng Mit, Hsenwi and Ava. In 1668 its saopha Sao Ngawk Hpa instigated a Chinese invasion of Burma, which brought Burmese occupation from 1669 to 1685. Ava occupied it again from 1767 to 1770 and annexed the state outright in 1772.
zh: 八莫，掸语称曼茂，是伊洛瓦底江畔的边境掸邦，地处缅甸北部，邻近云南边境，其名意为陶工之村。传说此地早年有一个泰人古国，都城桑佩纳戈的5世纪城墙和藏有佛舍利的佛塔遗址，在后来的城镇附近仍有遗址。据当地编年史记载，1202年起曼茂由猛密派来的官员治理，直到1470年才封给猛密诏法的一个儿子；中国史籍也记载它曾隶属猛密，更早则属兴威。作为缅甸与中国贸易的主要商埠，它从15世纪70年代起被孟养、猛密、兴威和阿瓦等势力反复争夺。1668年，当地诏法索鄂巴怂恿中国出兵入侵缅甸，结果招致缅甸在1669至1685年间占领。阿瓦又于1767至1770年再度占领，并在1772年正式吞并这个邦。

en: Mallabhum, also called the Bishnupur kingdom, was a Hindu kingdom ruled by the Malla rajas from their capital at Bishnupur, in the low hills and forests of what is now Bankura district in south-western Bengal. The dynasty traced its rule back to around the seventh century, and its territory grew to cover Bankura together with parts of Burdwan, Birbhum, Midnapur and Purulia. In 1337 the throne belonged to Dinabandhu Malla, the thirty-ninth king of the line, who set up an image of Vishnu Vasudeva at Lochanpur. The Malla kings were Vaishnavites: in the late sixteenth century Bir Hambir allied with the Mughal general Man Singh during Akbar's wars, and later rulers such as Raghunath Singha Dev and Bir Singha Dev filled Bishnupur with the brick and terracotta Radha and Krishna temples for which the town is known, while royal patronage also produced the Bishnupur gharana of Hindustani music. Maratha raids exhausted the kingdom, and in 1760 Bishnupur was ceded to the East India Company with the rest of the Burdwan chakla; the famine of 1770 and the Chuar risings of 1788 to 1809 completed the reduction of its rajas from kings into zamindars.
zh: 马拉布姆又称毗湿奴普尔王国，是由末罗王族以毗湿奴普尔为都统治的印度教王国，地处今孟加拉西部班库拉一带的低丘与丛林之中。该王朝的统治可追溯到7世纪前后，疆域最广时包括班库拉以及布尔德万、比尔宾、梅迪尼布尔、普鲁利亚的部分地区。1337年在位的是第三十九代国王迪纳班杜·末罗，他在洛昌普尔树立了毗湿奴·婆苏提婆神像。末罗诸王信奉毗湿奴派：16世纪末，比尔·汉比尔在阿克巴的战事中与莫卧儿将领曼·辛格结盟；后来的拉古纳特·辛哈·德夫、比尔·辛哈·德夫等统治者在毗湿奴普尔兴建了大批红砖赤陶的拉达与黑天神庙，使该城以此闻名，王室的赞助还催生了印度斯坦音乐的毗湿奴普尔乐派。马拉塔人的袭掠耗尽了国力，1760年毗湿奴普尔随布尔德万辖区一并割让给东印度公司；1770年的大饥荒和1788—1809年的朱阿尔起义，使末罗王公最终由国王沦为柴明达尔。

en: Bohtan was a Kurdish principality of the Bokhti tribe in the northern Jazira, ruled by the Azizan dynasty and centered on the Tigris town of Cizre, the medieval Jazirat Ibn Umar. Kurdish tradition traced its rulers to the tribal chief Suleman Khalid and his son Abdulaziz, and the emirate took shape between the twelfth and thirteenth centuries as Seljuk and Zengid power receded. In 1336 or 1337 the Bohtan tribesmen seized Cizre with military help from the Ayyubid emir of Hisn Kayfa, who married a daughter to the Bohtan emir Izz al-Din Ahmad, the reigning prince in 1337; the alliance failed to turn Bohtan into a client, and when Hisn Kayfa tried to take Cizre by force in 1384 it was beaten back. At its peak the emirate stretched from Diyarbakır to Van and from Zakho to Sinjar, and in the fourteenth century its official faith was Yazidism, making it one of the principal Yazidi enclaves alongside Shekhan and Sinjar before the ruling family later turned to Sunni Islam. The eighth ruler, Ezzaddin Abdal, submitted to Timur at Mardin in 1394, and after the Bohtan forces fought alongside the Ottomans against the Safavids at Çaldıran in 1514 the emirate was recognized as a hereditary Kurdish hükümet within the Ottoman Empire, an unusual status that preserved its internal autonomy for centuries.
zh: 博赫丹是北杰济拉地区布赫提部落的库尔德人公国，由阿齐赞王朝统治，以底格里斯河畔的吉兹雷（中世纪称贾齐拉特·伊本·欧麦尔）为中心。库尔德传统将其统治者追溯到部落首领苏莱曼·哈立德及其子阿卜杜勒阿齐兹，随着塞尔柱和赞吉势力衰退，埃米尔国在12至13世纪间成形。1336或1337年，博赫丹人在哈桑凯伊夫的阿尤布埃米尔援助下夺取吉兹雷，后者把女儿嫁给1337年在位的博赫丹埃米尔伊兹丁·艾哈迈德；但这层联姻并没能把博赫丹变成附庸，1384年哈桑凯伊夫企图武力夺取吉兹雷，反被击退。极盛时，公国疆域从迪亚巴克尔延伸到凡城，从扎霍延伸到辛贾尔。14世纪它以雅兹迪教为官教，与谢坎和辛贾尔并称雅兹迪人的主要聚居地，后来统治家族才改宗逊尼派。第八代统治者埃扎丁·阿卜达勒于1394年在马尔丁向帖木儿称臣；1514年博赫丹军队在恰尔德兰协助奥斯曼对抗萨法维后，公国被承认为奥斯曼帝国内世袭的库尔德胡库梅特，这一特殊地位使其内部自治维持了数百年之久。

en: Baia stands on the Moldova River in the foothills of the Eastern Carpathians, where a settlement existed from the thirteenth century and iron slag shows early mining, which gave the town its name, for baia in Romanian and bánya in Hungarian both mean mine. It was also called Târgul Moldovei, the market of Moldavia, and in Latin Civitas Moldaviae, and a Polish document of 1335 already mentions a merchant from the town. After the Hungarian army of Louis I drove out the Mongols around 1345 to 1347, Saxon and Hungarian colonists from Transylvania urbanised it, building a wooden church and a central market. When Dragoș of Maramureș founded the Moldavian border voivodate, Baia became its first centre and the early chronicles call it the first capital of Moldavia, though the court soon moved to Siret. The town kept its Saxon community and paved streets, and in 1467 Ștefan the Great burned it during the battle against Matthias Corvinus of Hungary. It declined after the Reformation, its last Catholic bishop being recorded in 1523, and Suceava took over its trade, leaving Baia to shrink into a village.
zh: 巴亚位于东喀尔巴阡山麓的摩尔多瓦河畔，13世纪已有定居点，当地发现的铁渣表明早期存在采矿活动，这也是城名的由来——罗马尼亚语 baia 与匈牙利语 bánya 都意为“矿”。它又称特尔古-摩尔多瓦，即“摩尔达维亚市场”，拉丁名为 Civitas Moldaviae；1335年的一份波兰文献已提到一名来自该城的商人。1345至1347年前后，匈牙利国王拉约什一世的军队赶走蒙古人后，来自特兰西瓦尼亚的撒克逊和匈牙利殖民者把它发展为城镇，建起木教堂和中心市场。马拉穆列什的德拉戈什建立摩尔达维亚边境领地时，巴亚成为其最早的治所，早期编年史称它为摩尔达维亚的第一个首府，不过宫廷很快迁往锡雷特。该城保留了撒克逊人社群和铺砌的街道；1467年，什特凡大公在与匈牙利国王马加什·科尔温交战时焚毁了巴亚。宗教改革后它走向衰落，最后一任天主教主教见于1523年的记载，贸易地位被苏恰瓦取代，巴亚最终缩为一座村庄。

en: Biberach lies on the river Riß in Upper Swabia, on the road between Ulm and Lake Constance. A market settlement grew up there around 1170 and it was first called a town in 1226; in 1281 and 1282 King Rudolf I of Habsburg raised it to a Free Imperial City, and in 1312 it adopted the law code of Ulm. The Reformation left it confessionally divided, and during the Thirty Years' War it changed hands several times, passing between imperial and Swedish armies around the Battle of Nördlingen in 1634. The Peace of Westphalia in 1648 made Biberach one of the four paritetic imperial cities, with every civic office shared equally between Catholics and Protestants; its church of Saint Martin, used by both confessions from 1548, is among the oldest simultaneous churches in Germany. French and Austrian armies fought a battle at its gates in 1796, and after the mediatisation of 1803 it went first to Baden and then, in an exchange of towns in 1806, to Württemberg.
zh: 比伯拉赫坐落在上施瓦本的里斯河畔，地处乌尔姆通往博登湖的大道上。约1170年这里形成集市聚落，1226年首次被称为城市；1281至1282年，哈布斯堡的鲁道夫一世将它升格为帝国自由城市，1312年它采用了乌尔姆的法典。宗教改革使它成为两教混居的城市，三十年战争中它几度易手，在1634年内德林根战役前后于帝国军队和瑞典军队之间反复转手。1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》把比伯拉赫列为四个两教平分制帝国城市之一，所有公职由天主教徒和新教徒均分；城里的圣马丁教堂从1548年起由两教共用，是德国最早的共用教堂之一。1796年法军与奥军在城门外激战；1803年陪臣化后它先归巴登，1806年又在城市交换中转归符腾堡。

en: Dorpat was a prince-bishopric in southeastern Estonia, built on the lands of the Ugaunian tribe around the old stronghold of Yuryev, modern Tartu. It began in 1211 as the Bishopric of Leal on the Estonian coast, but after the Swordbrothers captured Yuryev in 1224 its first bishop, Hermann von Buxhövden, brother of Albert of Riga, moved his seat there and renamed it Dorpat; from 1225 he held it directly as a prince of the Holy Roman Empire. In 1242 Bishop Hermann and his Ugaunian vassals marched with the crusader army defeated by Alexander Nevsky of Novgorod at the Battle on Lake Peipus. The town grew into a major Hanseatic trading centre, and its bishops were among the most assertive rivals of the Livonian Order: Bishop Dietrich Damerow even built a coalition with Lithuania, Mecklenburg and the pirate Victual Brothers and sought the protection of Richard II of England before the Order's invasion of 1379 ended in failure. As a member of the Livonian Confederation the bishopric survived into the sixteenth century, when its quarrel with Tsar Ivan the Terrible, who claimed Dorpat as the ancient Russian town of Yuryev and demanded a huge tribute, helped trigger the Livonian War. Russian troops captured Tartu in 1558 and the bishopric ceased to exist.
zh: 多尔帕特是爱沙尼亚东南部的采邑主教区，建立在乌高尼亚部族的土地上，核心是古老据点尤里耶夫（今塔尔图）。它始于1211年设在爱沙尼亚海岸的利尔主教区；佩剑兄弟会于1224年攻占尤里耶夫后，首任主教——里加的阿尔伯特之弟赫尔曼·冯·布克斯赫夫登——将教座迁至该地并改名为多尔帕特，1225年起他作为神圣罗马帝国的诸侯直接领有此地。1242年，赫尔曼主教率乌高尼亚附庸加入十字军，在楚德湖战役中被诺夫哥罗德的亚历山大·涅夫斯基击败。这座城市后来发展为重要的汉萨贸易中心，历任主教也是利沃尼亚骑士团最强硬的对手之一：主教迪特里希·达梅罗甚至与立陶宛、梅克伦堡和海盗粮食兄弟会结盟，还寻求英格兰国王理查二世的保护，骑士团1379年的入侵最终无果而终。作为利沃尼亚邦联的成员，主教区存续到16世纪；它与沙皇伊凡雷帝的争端——伊凡声称多尔帕特即古罗斯城市尤里耶夫并索取巨额贡金——成为利沃尼亚战争的导火索之一。1558年俄军攻占塔尔图，主教区就此灭亡。

en: Bijaya was the Hafsid appanage centred on the port of Béjaïa on the coast of Kabylia in present-day eastern Algeria. The town had been capital of the Hammadid dynasty since 1067, when Emir Nasir ibn Alnas moved his court there from the Qal'a of Banu Hammad, and under both the Hammadids and the Almohads it was one of the busiest ports of the central Maghreb, thronged by Pisan, Genoese and Catalan merchants; its beeswax exports even gave French the word bougie for candle, and Leonardo Fibonacci learned Arabic numerals there around 1202. After the Almohad collapse the city entered the Hafsid orbit from 1228, ruled by princes of the Tunis dynasty who repeatedly made themselves independent kings of Bougie. In 1337, following the reunification of the Hafsid realm by Abu Yahya Abu Bakr II, it was held as a family governorship under Tunis. The breakaway kingdom of the fifteenth century ended when the Spanish commander Pedro Navarro stormed the city in 1510, and the Ottomans under Salah Raïs expelled the Spanish garrison in 1555 and attached Béjaïa to the Regency of Algiers.
zh: 比贾亚是哈夫斯王朝的支系封地，以今阿尔及利亚东部卡比利亚沿海的贝贾亚港为中心。1067年哈马德王朝埃米尔纳绥尔·伊本·阿勒纳斯把王廷从巴努哈马德城堡迁到这里，此后在哈马德王朝和穆瓦希德王朝治下，它都是中马格里布最繁忙的港口之一，比萨、热那亚和加泰罗尼亚商人云集；当地大量出口蜂蜡，法语中表示蜡烛的“bougie”一词便源自该城的旧称，斐波那契也于1202年前后在这里学到阿拉伯数字。穆瓦希德王朝崩溃后，贝贾亚于1228年进入哈夫斯势力范围，由突尼斯王朝的王公们统治，他们还多次自立为布吉国王。1337年，在阿布·叶海亚·阿布·贝克尔二世重新统一哈夫斯疆域之后，它作为家族封地臣属于突尼斯。15世纪那个割据王国最终在1510年被西班牙将领佩德罗·纳瓦罗攻陷；1555年奥斯曼人萨拉赫赖斯赶走西班牙守军，把贝贾亚并入阿尔及尔摄政王国。

en: Bima, known to its own people as Mbojo, was a kingdom on the eastern half of Sumbawa in the Lesser Sunda Islands, the forerunner of the later Bima Sultanate. Local tradition traces its Hindu-Buddhist origins to the early eighth century and to the legendary brothers Indera Jambrut and Indera Kemala, sons of the hero Bhima, who came from Satonda island and were acknowledged as rulers. By the late fifteenth century Bima had grown into one of the busiest trading centres of the eastern archipelago alongside Gowa and Ternate, a rice storehouse exporting horses, slaves and sappanwood, and its princes had studied in Gowa and returned to lay out wet-rice fields and irrigation works. Its sway reached across the sea to Manggarai, Ende and Larantuka on Flores, and to Sumba, Sawu, Solor and Alor. Makassar fleets campaigned against Sumbawa in 1618, 1619 and 1626; the prince La Kai accepted Islam in 1621 under the missionary Dato' ri Bandang and ruled as Sultan Abdul Kahir, founding the sultanate. When Makassar fell to the Dutch East India Company in the wars of 1667 to 1669, Bima submitted at Batavia in December 1669 and became a Dutch ally with its trade bound by a sappanwood monopoly, and in 1815 the eruption of Mount Tambora brought ruin and famine to the island.
zh: 比马在本地人口中称姆博若，是小巽他群岛松巴哇岛东部的王国，也是后来比马苏丹国的前身。当地传说把它受印度教和佛教影响的起源追溯到8世纪初，以及英雄怖军之子、从萨通达岛而来被奉为首领的传奇兄弟因陀罗·詹布鲁特与因陀罗·克马拉。到15世纪末，比马已与戈瓦、特尔纳特并列为东部群岛最繁忙的贸易中心之一，作为稻米仓储地输出马匹、奴隶和苏木；它的王子曾赴戈瓦求学，回国后规划水田、兴修水利。其势力跨海及于弗洛勒斯的芒加莱、恩德和拉兰图卡，以及松巴、萨武、索洛和阿洛。望加锡舰队于1618年、1619年和1626年征讨松巴哇；王子拉凯在传教士达托·里·班当指引下于1621年改宗伊斯兰教，以苏丹阿卜杜勒·卡希尔之名开创苏丹国。1667至1669年望加锡败于荷兰东印度公司后，比马于1669年12月在巴达维亚投降，成为荷兰的盟友，贸易受苏木专卖约束；1815年坦博拉火山喷发，给全岛带来了破坏与饥荒。

en: Çapakçur, the later Emirate of Bingöl, was a Kurdish principality in the highlands west of Lake Van, centered on the walled town of Çabakçur and the surrounding Genç district. It grew out of Kurdish tribes settled there under Ayyubid rule and was established as a beylik in the 1240s, ruled for most of its history by the Suveydi bey family; Kurdish tradition later claimed the Barmakid viziers of Baghdad as its ancestors. In the Mongol age it survived as a vassal in turn of the Ilkhans, the Kara Koyunlu and the Aq Qoyunlu. Early in the sixteenth century the Safavids seized Çapakçur, but Emir Abdal Bey held its inner stronghold of Hançuk until his death; after the Battle of Chaldiran in 1514 the principality submitted to the Ottoman Empire. Its lands were then split between Genç and Bingöl and in the early seventeenth century fell under the stronger Emirate of Palu, before the Ottomans abolished the remaining emirate in the middle decades of the nineteenth century and exiled its rulers to Harput.
zh: 恰帕克丘尔即后来的宾格尔埃米尔国，是凡湖以西高原上的库尔德政权，以恰巴克丘尔城和周围的根奇地区为中心。它由阿尤布王朝时期迁入的库尔德部落发展而来，13世纪40年代形成贝伊领地，历史上大部分时间由苏韦迪贝伊家族统治；库尔德传统还把巴格达的巴尔马克维齐尔家族奉为其先祖。蒙古时代，它先后作为伊尔汗国、黑羊王朝和白羊王朝的附庸存续下来。16世纪初萨法维王朝攻占恰帕克丘尔，但埃米尔阿卜达尔贝伊死守内堡汉丘克直至去世；1514年查尔迪兰战役后，该公国向奥斯曼帝国臣服。此后其土地被分为根奇和宾格尔两部分，17世纪初落入更强的帕卢埃米尔国之手，残余的埃米尔国最终在19世纪中叶被奥斯曼人废除，统治者被流放至哈尔普特。

en: Ösel-Wiek was the westernmost state of medieval Livonia, taking in the Estonian islands of Ösel (Saaremaa) and Dagö (Hiiumaa) together with the coastal Wiek region of the mainland. The islanders, called Oeselians, were feared Finnic seafarers whose ship-borne raids plagued the whole eastern Baltic. The bishopric was founded in 1228 by the papal legate William of Modena and at the same time recognized as a prince-bishopric of the Holy Roman Empire. Its seat moved several times, from Lihula to Hapsal, where the cathedral chapter stayed, and finally to the castle of Arensburg, modern Kuressaare, on Ösel itself; from 1253 it was a suffragan of the Archbishop of Riga. Ösel kept a large measure of self-rule until the St. George's Night uprising of 1343, after which the Livonian Order suppressed its autonomy. The bishopric survived as a member of the Livonian Confederation until the Livonian War, when in 1560 its last prince-bishop, Johannes von Münchhausen, sold it to Denmark. Duke Magnus of Holstein abolished the see in 1567; Wiek later passed to the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, while Ösel stayed Danish until 1645, when Sweden acquired it by the Treaty of Brömsebro.
zh: 厄塞尔-维克是中世纪利沃尼亚最西端的政权，疆域包括爱沙尼亚的厄塞尔岛（萨雷马岛）、达戈岛（希乌马岛）以及大陆沿岸的维克地区。岛上居民称厄塞尔人，是令整个波罗的海东部闻风丧胆的芬兰语族航海者，常乘船四处劫掠。主教区于1228年由教皇特使摩德纳的威廉设立，同时被承认为神圣罗马帝国的采邑主教区。其教座几经迁移，从利胡拉迁至哈普萨卢——主教座堂参议会一直留在那里——最终移到厄塞尔岛上的阿伦斯堡城堡（今库雷萨雷）；1253年起它成为里加大主教的副主教区。厄塞尔岛在1343年圣乔治之夜起义前保有相当大的自治权，起义之后利沃尼亚骑士团取消了它的自治。作为利沃尼亚邦联的成员，主教区一直存续到利沃尼亚战争：1560年末任采邑主教约翰内斯·冯·明希豪森将其卖给丹麦。荷尔斯泰因的马格努斯公爵于1567年废除教区；维克后来划归波兰立陶宛联邦，厄塞尔则一直属于丹麦，直到1645年依《布勒姆瑟布鲁条约》转归瑞典。

en: Biri is the Tibetan chiefdom of the upper Yellow River bend around Trika, the present-day Guide region in Amdo, recorded in Chinese sources as Bili. Under the Yuan it was the Bili ten-thousand-household office of the Phagpa administration; the early Ming of the late fourteenth century turned it into the Bili guard, and in the Xuande reign of 1426 to 1435 its Buddhist leader was made state preceptor, so that the area was governed by a monastic government under imperial tusi overlordship.
zh: 毕日是安多黄河曲部、贵德（藏语称 Trika）一带的藏族酋长政权，汉文史料记作必里。元代它被编为八思巴治下的必里万户府，14世纪末明初改设必里卫，1426至1435年的宣德年间当地藏传佛教领袖又受封国师，由此在朝廷土司体系的统辖之下形成寺院政教合一的统治。

en: Bitlis is a fortress town in the steep valley linking the Armenian plateau with Mesopotamia, fifteen kilometres west of Lake Van. Kurds settled there in large numbers after the collapse of the Arab emirates in the tenth century, and after spells under the Marwanids, the Shah Armanids of Akhlat, the Ayyubids and the Ilkhans, it emerged in the thirteenth century as a Kurdish emirate ruled by the Ruzaki family. In the fourteenth century the Ruzaki emirs were vassals of the Kara Koyunlu and their state took in the smaller emirates of Ahlat, Mush and Hinis; the emir submitted to Timur in 1394. After the Kara Koyunlu collapse the Aq Qoyunlu needed three sieges in the 1470s to take the town, and the Motikan retook it in 1494. Caught between Safavids and Ottomans, Emir Sheref held out against an Ottoman siege in 1531 but fell in battle in 1533, after which his son submitted and Mush and Hinis became separate sanjaks under Ruzaki beys. Bitlis remained a centre of Persianate letters, home to the historian Idris-i Bidlisi and, later, Sharaf Khan, author of the Sharafname; its Ruzaki dynasty ruled until the Ottomans deposed its last emir in the middle of the nineteenth century.
zh: 比特利斯是一座要塞城镇，位于连接亚美尼亚高原与美索不达米亚的深谷中，在凡湖以西十五公里处。10世纪阿拉伯埃米尔国衰落后，大量库尔德人迁入；此地先后历经马尔万王朝、阿赫拉特的沙阿·阿尔曼王朝、阿尤布王朝和伊尔汗国统治，13世纪成为鲁扎吉家族治下的库尔德埃米尔国。14世纪时，鲁扎吉埃米尔是黑羊王朝的附庸，其国还辖有阿赫拉特、穆什和赫讷斯等较小的埃米尔国；1394年，埃米尔向帖木儿臣服。黑羊王朝崩溃后，白羊王朝在15世纪70年代连攻三次才拿下此城，莫蒂坎部又于1494年将其夺回。在萨法维与奥斯曼两大势力之间，埃米尔沙雷夫于1531年顶住了奥斯曼人的围攻，却在1533年战死，其子随即臣服，穆什和赫讷斯被划为独立的桑贾克，仍由鲁扎吉家族的贝伊管辖。比特利斯长期是波斯文风的中心，史学家伊德里斯·比特利西以及后来撰写《沙雷夫传》的沙拉夫汗都出身于此；鲁扎吉王朝一直延续到19世纪中叶，末代埃米尔被奥斯曼人废黜。

en: Baojing was a Tujia native chieftaincy in the Wuling mountains of northwestern Huguang, on the lands of present-day Baojing County in Hunan, ruled by a branch of the Peng clan that also governed Yongshun. The place was first organized as Baojing Prefecture under the Later Liang in 907 and became Baojing Prefecture under the Yuan. In 1351 the Yongshun chieftain Peng Wanqian made it a pacification commission subordinate to his own chiefdom, and in 1366 it was reorganized as the Baojing Military-Civil Pacification Commission. Under the Ming it rose to a xuanwei commission; the chieftain Peng Jinchen, who took office in 1527, repeatedly led native troops on imperial campaigns, and Baojing soldiers fought beside Yongshun's at the victory over the wokou pirates at Wangjiangjing in 1555. The last chieftain, Peng Yubin, inherited in 1723 but plunged into bloody feuds with his own officers and allied with the Rongmei and Sangzhi chiefs. Impeached for cruelty in 1726, he was removed; gaitu guiliu followed in 1727, Baojing County was created in 1729, and Peng was exiled to Liaoyang.
zh: 保靖是湖广西北武陵山区的土家族土司，其地在今湖南保靖县，由与永顺彭氏同宗的彭氏支系世袭。907年五代后梁时其地称保静州，元代改保靖州；1351年永顺土司彭万潜把它改为隶属永顺的安抚司，1366年置保靖州军民安抚司。明代保靖升为宣慰使司，1527年袭职的彭荩臣多次率土兵从征，1555年保靖土兵又与永顺土兵并肩取得王江泾抗倭大捷。末代宣慰使彭御彬于1723年袭职，随后与属下舍把连年仇杀，并暗中勾结容美、桑植土司；1726年他因贪暴被参革，1727年保靖改土归流，1729年置保靖县，彭御彬被安置到辽阳。

en: Badakhshan is the mountain country of the upper Panj, a tributary of the Oxus in the Pamirs, lying in what is now northeastern Afghanistan and eastern Tajikistan, whose Tajik and Pamiri inhabitants grew wealthy on the Silk Road trade: its lapis lazuli mines were worked as early as the fourth millennium BC, and its balas ruby spinels were famed from Egypt to China when Marco Polo visited in the thirteenth century. Nasir Khusraw spread Isma'ili Islam there in the eleventh century, and the land was long ruled by hereditary mirs who traced their line to Alexander the Great. The last of that line, Sultan Muhammad, was killed by the Timurid Abu Sa'id Mirza, and after Timurid rule the region sent six tributary missions to the Ming between 1420 and 1490. The mir Amir Khusrau submitted to Babur in 1504, who installed Khan Mirza as governor; Mirza Sulaiman then held the country until 1575, until Abdullah Khan II of Bukhara conquered it in 1584. The Mughal emperor Shah Jahan made Badakhshan a province from 1641 to 1647, and after Uzbek rule the local Yarid dynasty set up an independent emirate in 1657. In 1759 the Badakhshani sultan captured and executed the fleeing Khoja brothers for the Qing, briefly becoming a Qing tributary, before pressure from Ahmad Shah Durrani drew the country into the Afghan orbit.
zh: 巴达赫尚是帕米尔高原上、阿姆河支流喷赤河上游的山国，地跨今阿富汗东北部与塔吉克斯坦东部，居民以塔吉克人和帕米尔人为主，因丝绸之路贸易而富庶：早在公元前第四千纪，当地就已开采青金石，13世纪马可·波罗途经时，这里的巴拉斯红宝石（尖晶石）已闻名于从埃及到中国的广大世界。11世纪，纳赛尔·霍斯鲁在此传播伊斯玛仪派伊斯兰教，此地长期由自称亚历山大后裔的世袭密尔统治。这一世系的末代君主苏丹·穆罕默德被帖木儿系的卜撒因杀死；帖木儿王朝统治期间，当地曾在1420—1490年间六次向明朝朝贡。1504年，密尔阿米尔·胡斯劳向巴布尔臣服，巴布尔派汗·米尔咱出任总督，此后米尔咱·苏莱曼一直统治到1575年，1584年布哈拉的阿卜杜拉汗二世将其征服。莫卧儿皇帝沙贾汉曾在1641—1647年把巴达赫尚改为帝国行省，乌兹别克人统治之后，本地的雅里德王朝于1657年建立独立埃米尔国。1759年，巴达赫尚苏丹为清朝擒杀逃亡的大小和卓，一度成为清朝朝贡国，不久在艾哈迈德·沙·杜兰尼的压力下转入阿富汗势力范围。

en: The Banu Kanz were a Muslim dynasty of mixed Arab and Beja descent, born from marriages between Arab tribesmen of the Banu Hanifa and princesses of the Beja Hadariba. From the early eleventh century they ruled the frontier around Aswan, the Wadi Allaqi gold mines and the desert roads leading to the Red Sea port of Aydhab; in 1006 the Fatimid caliph al-Hakim granted their chief the hereditary title Kanz al-Dawla, Treasure of the State. A revolt against the Ayyubids in 1174 ended in defeat at Aswan and drove the dynasty south into the Nubian borderland of Maris, where its rule speeded the spread of Islam. In 1317 the reigning Kanz al-Dawla seized the throne of Christian Makuria and held it against the armies of the Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad, and for decades the Banu Kanz dominated the country between Aydhab and Suakin and the Nile. Repeated raids on Aswan, in 1366 and 1370, drew heavier Mamluk retaliation; after 1365 the sultans loosed the Hawwara Berbers against them, and by the early fifteenth century the Hawwara had displaced the Banu Kanz, whose descendants became the Kunuz tribesmen of Upper Egypt and northern Nubia.
zh: 巴努-坎兹是阿拉伯人与贝贾人混血的穆斯林王朝，源自巴努哈尼法部的阿拉伯男子与贝贾哈达里巴部公主之间的联姻。11世纪初起，他们统治阿斯旺周边的边境地带、瓦迪阿拉基金矿以及通往红海港口阿伊扎布的沙漠商路；1006年，法蒂玛王朝哈里发哈基姆授予其首领世袭头衔坎兹·道拉，意为国家之宝。1174年反抗阿尤布王朝的起义在阿斯旺战败，王朝被迫南迁至努比亚边境的马里斯，其统治加速了伊斯兰教在当地的传播。1317年，时任坎兹·道拉夺取了基督教马库里亚的王位，并顶住马穆鲁克苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德的大军；此后数十年间，巴努-坎兹称雄于阿伊扎布、萨瓦金与尼罗河之间的地区。他们在1366年和1370年两度袭掠阿斯旺，招致马穆鲁克更严厉的报复：1365年后苏丹们驱使哈瓦拉柏柏尔人前来围剿，到15世纪初哈瓦拉人已取而代之，巴努-坎兹的后裔则成为上埃及和北努比亚的库努兹人。

en: Buleda is a highland valley of northern Makran, lying between the central Makran range and the Zamuran Hills north of Turbat. The Gishkaur stream runs through it, feeding irrigation channels that water extensive fields and date groves, and the valley has long been prized for its pasturage. Its inhabitants are Sunni Baloch of the Buledai and neighboring clans, and the cairns scattered along the Dambani Kaur hill mark older settlements. The valley gave its name to the Buledai dynasty, whose chiefs kept Makran independent together with the Gichkis: when the Ain-i-Akbari was compiled in 1590, Makran alone of the Baluch lands still answered to no outside emperor. Their rule ended in the seventeenth century, when Nasir Khan I of Kalat brought the Makran highlands under the growing Brahui khanate.
zh: 布莱达是莫克兰北部的一条高地河谷，位于图尔伯德以北、莫克兰中央山脉与扎穆兰山之间。吉什考尔河穿谷而过，通过灌溉渠滋养着大片农田和椰枣林，这片谷地也历来以牧场丰美著称。居民是信奉逊尼派的俾路支人，分属布莱达等部族，丹巴尼考尔山丘沿岸遍布的石冢标记着更古老的聚落。这条河谷得名的布莱达王朝曾与吉奇基家族共同维持莫克兰的独立：1590年《阿克巴则例》成书时，俾路支诸地中唯有莫克兰仍不臣服于任何外来帝王。他们的统治在17世纪告终，卡拉特的纳西尔汗一世把莫克兰高地纳入了日益扩张的布拉灰汗国。

en: The small Prince-Bishopric of Lebus sat astride the middle Oder, its walled cathedral town of Lebus giving the see its name, and the bishops also ruled a secular lordship of the same extent. Founded around 1125 by the Polish duke Boleslaw III Wrymouth as a suffragan of Gniezno, it was meant to secure both banks of the river. As the Ascanians and then the Wittelsbach margraves of Brandenburg pushed east, the see was drawn into their conflicts with Poland: in 1276 the seat withdrew across the Oder to Gorzyca, and in 1326 Brandenburg troops sacked that town after Bishop Stephan II backed Polish raids into the Neumark. Stephan, the ruling prelate in 1337, spent long years in Polish exile, returned to his diocese in 1333, and died at Breslau in 1345. The seat came back to Lebus in 1354, only for the cathedral to be destroyed by the soldiers of Charles IV in 1373; from 1385 the bishops resided at Furstenwalde on the Spree. The stift estates stayed Catholic when the Reformation reached Brandenburg in 1540, but in 1557 Elector Joachim Frederick imposed the new faith there too, and the diocese was suppressed in 1598, its lands falling to Brandenburg.
zh: 莱布斯是奥得河中游的一个小主教邦，因主教座城莱布斯而得名，主教同时统治着与教区范围相当的世俗领地。它约在1125年由波兰公爵波列斯瓦夫三世设立，隶属格涅兹诺大主教区，初衷是控制奥得河两岸。随着勃兰登堡的阿斯坎尼家族及后来的维特尔斯巴赫家族藩侯向东扩张，主教区被卷入他们与波兰的冲突：1276年主教驻地迁到奥得河东岸的戈里茨；1326年，因主教斯特凡二世支持波兰人袭扰新马克，勃兰登堡军队洗劫了该城。1337年在任的斯特凡长期流亡波兰，1333年才返回教区，1345年死于布雷斯劳。主教驻地1354年迁回莱布斯，但座堂1373年被查理四世的军队摧毁；1385年起主教们驻于施普雷河畔的菲尔斯滕瓦尔德。1540年宗教改革传入勃兰登堡时，主教直辖区仍保住了天主教信仰，但1557年选侯约阿希姆·弗里德里希也在那里强制推行新教，教区于1598年被撤销，领地并入勃兰登堡。

en: Bârlad lies on the river of the same name in the high plains of southern Moldavia, where the trade routes linking central and northern Moldavia with the Black Sea and the Byzantine world met. The Hypatian Codex already knows a market town called Berlad, and the twelfth-century Berladnici, a mixed population of runaway peasants and boyars from Rus' who fished, hunted and raided together with the Cumans, gave the region its Byzantine and papal name of Terra Berladensis, the land of the Berlad people. After Moldavia took shape, Bârlad grew into one of its chief southern markets: a charter of Alexandru cel Bun early in the fifteenth century granted its customs revenue to Bistrița Monastery, and its merchants attended the Church council at Constance in 1418. Under Ștefan the Great it held the seat of the vornic of the Lower Land, and after the battle of Vaslui in 1475 an earth fort was raised in the river meadow against Ottoman armies. Its exposed position on the Tatar invasion route cost it dearly, for the town was sacked and burned in 1440, 1444 and 1450, and again overrun by a large Tatar raid in 1758.
zh: 伯尔拉德坐落在摩尔达维亚南部高平原的同名河畔，地处连接摩尔达维亚中北部与黑海和拜占庭世界的商路要冲。《伊帕季耶夫抄本》已提到一个名为伯尔拉德的市场镇；12世纪的伯尔拉德人是一批从罗斯逃出的农民和波雅尔混合群体，以渔猎为生并与库曼人合伙劫掠，他们活动的地区在拜占庭和教皇文献中被称为 Terra Berladensis，即伯尔拉德人之地。摩尔达维亚成型后，伯尔拉德发展为南部主要市场之一：15世纪初亚历山德鲁大公的特许状把该地关税收入赐给比斯特里察修道院，1418年伯尔拉德商人还派代表出席了康斯坦茨宗教会议。什特凡大公时期，这里是摩尔达维亚下地区总督的驻节地；1475年瓦斯卢伊战役后，河畔草地上修筑了土垒要塞以抵御奥斯曼军队。由于正处在鞑靼人入侵的通道上，该城损失惨重，1440年、1444年和1450年屡遭洗劫焚毁，1758年又在一次大规模鞑靼入侵中被蹂躏。

en: Bale was a Muslim sultanate in the cool, well-watered highlands of southern Ethiopia, covering roughly the present-day Bale Zone of the Oromia Region. It took shape between the eleventh and thirteenth centuries as traders and preachers carried Islam inland from the port of Zeila; the Somali scholar Sheikh Hussein of Merca, whose shrine at Bale became a regional centre of the faith, led this mission. Muslim geographers such as al-Umari ranked Bale as the largest of the Ethiopian Muslim kingdoms, and with Dawaro, Hadiya and Sharkha it belonged to the loose confederation of Zeila. Its people wove cotton cloth and traded mostly by barter, and unusually for the region its rulers were not a hereditary dynasty. In 1332 the Christian emperor Amda Seyon of Ethiopia conquered Bale, which in 1337 was therefore held as an Ethiopian vassal. It remained a restive frontier province under Christian rule into the early sixteenth century, hard pressed by the Adal Sultanate, until the great Oromo migrations of the mid-sixteenth century overran the region and absorbed it into the new Oromo world.
zh: 巴莱是位于埃塞俄比亚南部凉爽湿润高原上的穆斯林苏丹国，疆域大致相当于今天的巴莱地区。11至13世纪，随着商人和传教士从泽拉港把伊斯兰教传入内陆，巴莱逐渐成形；来自梅尔卡的索马里学者谢赫·侯赛因是这场传教活动的核心人物，他在巴莱的圣陵后来成为当地的伊斯兰信仰中心。欧麦里等穆斯林地理学家把巴莱列为埃塞俄比亚各穆斯林王国中最大的一个，它还与达瓦罗、哈迪亚、沙尔哈等国同属松散的“泽拉联盟”。当地人织造棉布，贸易多以物易物；与周边政权不同，巴莱的统治者并非世袭王朝。1332年，埃塞俄比亚的基督教皇帝阿姆达·塞约恩征服巴莱，因此在1337年开局时它是埃塞俄比亚的附庸。此后巴莱作为不安分的边疆省份留在基督教统治下，长期受到阿达尔苏丹国的挤压，直到16世纪中叶奥罗莫人大迁徙席卷该地，将其纳入奥罗莫人的新世界。

en: Bologna began as the Etruscan city of Felsina, passed to the Gallic Boii and became the Roman colony of Bononia in 196 BC. The Lombards took it in 727 and the Franks in 774, but its medieval fame came from law: around 1088 the schools of the glossator Irnerius grew into the University of Bologna, the oldest in Europe. A thriving free commune joined the Lombard League against Frederick Barbarossa and secured its autonomy at the Peace of Constance in 1183; in 1249 its militia captured King Enzo, son of Frederick II, at Fossalta and kept him prisoner for twenty-three years. Family feuds weakened the republic, which briefly accepted the rule of a papal legate in 1327, and in 1334 the banker Taddeo Pepoli made himself lord, the position his house still held in 1337. The Pepoli sold the city to Archbishop Giovanni Visconti of Milan in 1350; Cardinal Albornoz recovered it for the papacy in 1363, though Bologna soon revolted in the War of the Eight Saints and ran itself as an oligarchic republic. After Visconti-backed coups, the Bentivoglio family established a durable signoria from the 1440s until Pope Julius II marched in and annexed the city in 1506. Under papal rule it hosted the last imperial coronation by a pope, that of Charles V in 1530, and nurtured the Bolognese school of painting, until French revolutionary armies arrived in 1796.
zh: 博洛尼亚最初是伊特鲁里亚人的城市菲尔西纳，后落入高卢博伊人之手，公元前196年成为罗马殖民地博诺尼亚。727年伦巴第人攻占此城，774年又转入法兰克人之手，但它在中世纪的名声来自法学：约1088年，注释法学家伊尔内留斯的学堂发展为欧洲最古老的博洛尼亚大学。作为繁荣的自由公社，它加入伦巴第同盟反抗红胡子腓特烈，并在1183年的《康斯坦茨和约》中确立自治；1249年，公社民兵在福尔萨尔塔俘获腓特烈二世之子撒丁国王恩佐，将他关押了二十三年。家族仇杀削弱了共和国，1327年城市一度接受教皇使节的统治，1334年银行家塔代奥·佩波利自立为领主，1337年时佩波利家族仍占据这一位置。1350年佩波利家族把城市卖给米兰大主教乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂；1363年阿尔沃诺斯枢机替教皇国将其收回，但博洛尼亚很快在八圣王战争中起事，以寡头共和国的形式自治。经过米兰支持的数次政变，本蒂沃利奥家族从15世纪40年代起建立起稳固的僭主统治，直到1506年教皇尤利乌斯二世进军吞并此城。教皇统治期间，这里见证了1530年教皇为皇帝加冕的最后一幕——查理五世的加冕礼，并孕育了博洛尼亚画派；1796年，法国革命军的到来结束了这一局面。

en: Bali is a volcanic island in the Lesser Sunda Islands whose Hindu-Buddhist kingdoms drew their court culture from ancient Java. The first named Balinese ruler, Sri Kesari Warmadewa, left the Belanjong pillar inscription near Sanur in 914, and his Warmadewa line married into the royal house of East Java: King Udayana and his Javanese queen Mahendradatta were the parents of Airlangga, who later ruled in Java. In 1284 Kertanegara of Singhasari raided the island and carried off its queen, but Bali regained its independence when Singhasari collapsed in 1292, and on the eve of 1337 it was still ruled by its own kings from the old centre of Bedulu. Majapahit armies under Gajah Mada landed in 1342 and took Bedulu after seven months of fighting in 1343, installing a vassal dynasty at Samprangan, which later moved its seat to Gelgel. When Muslim Demak overran Majapahit in 1527, Hindu nobles, priests and artisans fled to Bali, making it the last stronghold of Indo-Javanese civilisation; the Gelgel court under Dalem Baturenggong drew Lombok, western Sumbawa and Blambangan into its suzerainty and welcomed the Javanese sage Nirartha. After 1651 Gelgel fragmented, and in 1686 a new paramount seat was set up at Klungkung, though the island had in fact split into nine rival kingdoms that warred among themselves until the Dutch conquests of the nineteenth century.
zh: 巴厘是小巽他群岛中的火山岛，岛上的印度教—佛教王国深受古代爪哇宫廷文化影响。第一位有名可考的巴厘君主斯里·克萨里·瓦尔玛德瓦于914年在沙努尔附近留下贝兰琼石柱铭文；他的瓦尔玛德瓦王朝与东爪哇王室联姻，国王乌达亚纳与爪哇王后马亨德拉达塔之子就是后来统治爪哇的艾尔朗加。1284年，信诃沙里的克尔塔纳加腊出兵海岛、掳走巴厘女王，但1292年信诃沙里崩溃后巴厘重获独立；1337年开局前夕，它仍由本族国王以古都贝杜鲁为中心统治。1342年，加札·马达率领的满者伯夷大军登陆，经七个月战事于1343年攻占贝杜鲁，在桑普拉岸扶植附庸王朝，该王朝后来移都格尔格尔。1527年穆斯林的淡目攻灭满者伯夷后，印度教贵族、祭司和工匠纷纷逃到巴厘，使它成为印度—爪哇文明的最后堡垒；格尔格尔朝廷在达伦·巴图伦贡时期把龙目岛、松巴哇岛西部和布兰班甘纳入宗主权之下，并接纳了爪哇圣徒尼拉尔塔。1651年后格尔格尔走向分裂，1686年新的共主驻地在克隆孔设立，但岛上实际已分裂为九个相互征战的小王国，这种局面一直延续到19世纪荷兰人征服之时。

en: The Duchy of Bouillon was a small Ardennes lordship grouped around the castle of Bouillon on the Semois. Held in the eleventh century by the House of Ardennes, it was sold in 1095 by Godfrey of Bouillon to the Prince-Bishopric of Liège to fund his First Crusade, after which he became the first ruler of the Kingdom of Jerusalem. For the rest of the Middle Ages the bishops of Liège were its lords, so in 1337 Bouillon was governed, like Liège itself, by Prince-Bishop Adolf II of the Mark. In 1415 the bishop enfeoffed the castle to the House of La Marck, whose members from 1492 styled themselves dukes of Bouillon; the title passed in 1594 to the La Tour d'Auvergne. The Treaties of Nijmegen in 1678 made Bouillon a sovereign duchy under French protection, French troops annexed it in 1795, and after 1815 it was joined to the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg before passing to Belgium in 1830.
zh: 布永公国是阿登山区以瑟穆瓦河畔布永城堡为中心的小领地。11世纪时它属阿登家族，1095年布永的戈弗雷为筹措第一次十字军东征的军费，将它卖给列日采邑主教区，他本人后来成为耶路撒冷王国的第一位统治者。整个中世纪中后期，列日主教都是布永的领主，因此1337年它与列日一样，由采邑主教马克家族的阿道夫二世管辖。1415年主教把城堡封给马克家族，该家族成员从1492年起自称布永公爵；1594年头衔转入拉图尔多韦涅家族。1678年的《奈梅亨条约》使布永成为受法兰西保护的主权公国，1795年法兰西军队将其吞并，1815年后它并入卢森堡大公国，1830年转归比利时。

en: The Barony of Belmont was held by the free lords of Belmont from their rock castle above Flims in the Vorderrhein valley of Graubünden. The family, whose name is the Romance form of Schönenberg, first appears in the records with Lutefridus de Belmonte in 1137 or 1139, and by the thirteenth century it was among the most powerful noble houses of Raetia, kin to the barons of Vaz. Heinrich von Belmont became the first Raetian student at Bologna in 1267, and Konrad von Belmont ruled as Bishop of Chur from 1273 to 1282. In 1352 Ulrich Walter von Belmont led the Montalt and Rhäzüns families against the Counts of Werdenberg-Heiligenberg, defeating their army at Mundaun near Ilanz, though the victors' town of Ilanz was burned in retaliation. When Ulrich Walter died childless on 11 July 1371, the Belmont lands passed to the Montalt and Sax-Misox families; in 1380 the already ruined castle was traded to Brun von Rhäzüns.
zh: 贝尔蒙男爵领由贝尔蒙自由男爵家族统治，据点是格劳宾登前莱茵河谷弗利姆斯上方的岩石城堡。家族名是“舍嫩贝格”的罗曼什语写法，最早于1137或1139年随“贝尔蒙的卢特弗里德”出现在文献中；到13世纪，它已是雷蒂亚最有权势的贵族家族之一，与瓦兹男爵家族有亲缘。1267年，贝尔蒙的海因里希成为第一个在博洛尼亚求学的雷蒂亚人；贝尔蒙的康拉德则于1273至1282年担任库尔主教。1352年，贝尔蒙的乌尔里希·瓦尔特联合蒙塔尔特和雷岑斯家族起兵对抗韦尔登贝格-海利根贝格伯爵，在伊兰茨附近的蒙道恩击败敌军，但伊兰茨随即遭报复焚毁。1371年7月11日，乌尔里希·瓦尔特无嗣而终，贝尔蒙领地由蒙塔尔特和萨克斯-米索克斯家族继承；1380年，已成废墟的城堡被转手给雷岑斯的布伦。

en: Bolaang was the polity of the Mongondow people on the northern peninsula of Celebes, its name meaning sea in the old Mongondow tongue. Mongondow traditions trace the people to settlers of the Kamasaan highlands who spread to the coast, and by the thirteenth century a line of paramount chiefs titled punu ruled a moving court at Dumoga, Bolaang and the island of Manado Tua; Spanish and Portuguese sailors marked the state on their charts as Rey de Boulan. In 1337 the chief was Mokodoludut, remembered as lord of nine territories, holding both the Mongondow plateau and the harbours that later included Belang and Amurang. In the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries Bolaang's power stretched across much of the northern peninsula, and from 1670 the ruler Loloda Mokoagow styled himself datu, or king. A border treaty of 1694 with the Dutch-backed Minahasan federation, fixed on the Poigar and Buyat rivers, stripped Bolaang of its eastern lands and confined it to the Mongondow plateau, after which it was called Bolaang Mongondow; further VOC contracts reduced it during the eighteenth century. Its rulers bore Christian names from their contacts with Spaniards and Dutchmen, while the old Malesung beliefs of the common people endured in the interior.
zh: 博朗是苏拉威西北部半岛蒙贡多人的政权，其名称在古蒙贡多语中意为海。蒙贡多传说称本族源自卡马桑高地的定居者，后来扩散到沿海；到13世纪，一批号称普努的最高首领把游动的宫廷设在杜莫加、博朗和万鸦老图岛等地，西班牙和葡萄牙水手在海图上把这个政权标为“布兰王”。1337年在位的首领是莫科杜鲁杜特，传说他领有九处疆域，同时掌握蒙贡多高原以及后来包括伯朗、阿穆朗在内的港湾。16至17世纪，博朗的势力横跨北部半岛大部；1670年起，统治者洛洛达·莫科阿果改用达图即王的称号。1694年，它与荷兰人支持的米纳哈萨部落联盟签订边界条约，以波伊加河和布亚特河为界，博朗因此丧失东部土地，被局限在蒙贡多高原，此后便称博朗蒙贡多；18世纪荷兰东印度公司的一系列合约又进一步削弱了它。其统治者因与西班牙人、荷兰人交往而取基督教名字，民间则在内陆长期保留古老的马莱宗信仰。

en: The Principality of Beloozero, the White Lake principality, lay in the forested Russian North around Lake Beloye and the upper Sheksna river, on the fur and grain routes linking the Volga with the Baltic and the White Sea. Its capital was one of the five original Rus towns named in the Primary Chronicle, which legend makes the seat of Rurik's brother Sineus in 862 among the Finnic Ves people. The town long belonged to the princes of Rostov, and only in 1238, amid the Mongol invasion, did Gleb Vasilkovich make Beloozero a separate Rurikid principality; he married a daughter of the Horde khan Sartaq, and later princes could claim descent from Genghis Khan. By the 1330s the small principality had lost much of its weight, and Ivan Kalita of Moscow was already sending governors to administer it alongside its own princes. Beloozero princes fought in the united Rus army at the Battle of Kulikovo in 1380, and in 1389 Dmitry Donskoy subjected the principality to Moscow and granted it to his son Andrey. The great Kirillo-Belozersky and Ferapontov monasteries, founded in 1397 and 1398, became pillars of Muscovite influence in the north, and Ivan III formally annexed the principality in 1486.
zh: 别洛奥泽罗意为“白湖”公国，位于俄罗斯北方的林海之中，环白湖和舍克斯纳河上游而建，扼守着连接伏尔加河、波罗的海与白海的毛皮和粮食商路。它的都城是《往年纪事》所载最早的五座罗斯城镇之一，传说862年留里克之弟西涅乌斯就在芬人的维普斯人中间以此为治所。这座城镇长期归属罗斯托夫王公，直到1238年蒙古入侵之际，格列布·瓦西里科维奇才把别洛奥泽罗建成独立的留里克王公领地；他娶了金帐汗国可汗撒里答的女儿，后来的王公因此自称有成吉思汗的血统。到14世纪30年代，这个小公国已大为衰落，莫斯科的伊凡·卡利塔开始派遣总督，与本地王公一同治理此地。别洛奥泽罗的王公们参加了1380年库里科沃战役的罗斯联军，1389年德米特里·顿斯科伊将公国置于莫斯科治下，封给儿子安德烈。1397年和1398年相继建立的基里洛—别洛泽尔斯基修道院与费拉邦托夫修道院，成为莫斯科向北方扩展影响的支柱，1486年伊凡三世正式吞并了这个公国。

en: The County of Blois, centred on the Loire crossing at Blois south of Paris, was one of the strongest vassal counties of medieval France. From the tenth century its Thibaldian counts built up a wide bloc of lands reaching into Champagne, and after a short Avesnes interlude the county passed in 1241 to the Châtillon line. In 1337 the count was Guy I of Châtillon, who had married Margaret of Valois, sister of King Philip VI; his daughter Marie married Duke Rudolph of Lorraine and his son Charles of Blois fought the War of the Breton Succession until his death at Auray in 1364. With no direct male heir left, Count Guy II surrendered Blois in 1397 to Louis I, Duke of Orléans, who made the castle his residence; Joan of Arc stayed there in 1429 before marching to Orléans. When the last hereditary count, Louis of Orléans, became King Louis XII in 1498, Blois entered the royal domain and became a favoured seat of the early French Renaissance. It was briefly revived as an appanage for Gaston of Orléans and reverted to the crown on his death in 1660.
zh: 布卢瓦伯国以巴黎以南、卢瓦尔河渡口上的布卢瓦为中心，是中世纪法兰西最强大的封臣伯国之一。10世纪起，蒂博家族的伯爵们经营出一片远及香槟的庞大领地；经过阿韦讷支系统治的短暂插曲后，伯国于1241年转入沙蒂永支系手中。1337年在位的居伊一世娶了国王腓力六世的姊妹瓦卢瓦的玛格丽特，他的女儿玛丽嫁给洛林公爵拉乌尔，儿子布卢瓦的夏尔则投身布列塔尼继承战争，直到1364年在欧赖战死。由于没有直系男嗣，伯爵居伊二世于1397年把布卢瓦让给奥尔良公爵路易一世，后者将布卢瓦城堡作为自己的府邸；1429年圣女贞德进军奥尔良前曾驻跸于此。末代世袭伯爵奥尔良的路易于1498年即位为国王路易十二，布卢瓦随之并入王室领地，并成为法国文艺复兴初期深受偏爱的宫廷所在。它曾一度作为封邑重封给奥尔良的加斯东，1660年加斯东死后又重归王冠。

en: The Sultanate of Bambao was one of the Muslim city-states, locally called ntsi, that shared the island of Ngazidja, or Grande Comore, in the Comoros; at times the island was split among as many as eleven such sultanates. Its rulers, styled mfalme, held court at Iconi and, like the other Comorian sultans, enjoyed little real power over a land divided between rival towns. Islam reached the islands by the fifteenth century, and Bambao shared in the Swahili trading world that linked the Comoros with Kilwa, Sofala and Madagascar. Portuguese ships first called in 1503 but never occupied the island, which kept its independence. From the 1790s Malagasy raiders of the Betsimisaraka and Sakalava swept through the Comoros seizing slaves and depopulating whole towns before the raids ended in the 1810s.
zh: 奔巴欧苏丹国是科摩罗群岛恩贾济贾岛（又称大科摩罗岛）上并立的穆斯林城邦（当地称 ntsi）之一，该岛一度分裂为多达十一个这样的苏丹国。其统治者称 mfalme，驻跸于伊科尼，和科摩罗其他苏丹一样，在城邦林立的岛上实际权力有限。伊斯兰教于15世纪传入群岛，奔巴欧参与了把科摩罗与基尔瓦、索法拉和马达加斯加连在一起的斯瓦希里贸易网络。葡萄牙船只1503年首次到访，却从未占领该岛，奔巴欧得以保持独立。1790年代起，贝齐米萨拉卡和萨卡拉瓦的马达加斯加劫掠者横扫科摩罗掳掠奴隶，许多城镇人口一空，劫掠直到1810年代才告结束。

en: Bemanevika is a town on the Bemarivo River in the far northeast of Madagascar, in the northern Betsimisaraka country between the Swahili trading ports of Vohemar and Antongil Bay. This coast was drawn into the Indian Ocean trade from the eleventh century, when Muslim merchant towns such as Mahilaka, Vohemar and Irodo flourished on Madagascar's northern shores and drew Arab and Swahili settlers. Until the early eighteenth century the people of this shore lived in small clan villages under filohany chiefs, each ruling no more than a settlement or two, while European pirates settled among them from the 1680s and fathered the mixed zana-malata communities. In 1710 Ratsimilaho, himself the son of a British pirate, united the coastal clans into the Betsimisaraka kingdom, which held together for his fifty-year reign before his successors weakened it; in 1817 it submitted to Radama I of Imerina.
zh: 贝马内维卡是马达加斯加东北端贝马里武河畔的城镇，地处贝齐米萨拉卡人北境，夹在武海马尔和安通吉尔湾等斯瓦希里贸易港之间。从11世纪起，这片海岸被纳入印度洋贸易圈，马哈伊拉卡、武海马尔和伊鲁杜等穆斯林商业城镇在马达加斯加北方沿海兴盛，吸引阿拉伯和斯瓦希里移民。18世纪初以前，沿岸居民生活在菲洛哈尼酋长治理的小型氏族村落里，每个酋长至多管辖一两个聚落；17世纪80年代起欧洲海盗在此定居，与当地人通婚形成混血的扎纳马拉塔社群。1710年，本身为英国海盗之子的拉齐米拉霍联合沿海诸氏族，建立贝齐米萨拉卡王国，在他长达五十年的统治期内维持统一，后继者却使联盟日趋衰弱；1817年王国归顺伊梅里纳的拉达马一世。

en: Bampūr is an oasis town on the river of the same name in western Baluchistan, whose waters drain west into the Jaz Murian depression. The valley was settled in the Bronze Age and its ancient mound has yielded painted pottery related to the finds at Shahr-e Sukhteh; Greek sources place Pura, capital of Gedrosia, at or near Bampūr, and Alexander the Great's army struggled through the surrounding desert on its march back from the Indus in 325 BCE. The old citadel stood on a hill north of the river before falling into ruin. In later centuries the oasis and the neighboring town of Fahrej were held by Rakshani Baloch chiefs, whose ruler Shah Mihrab Khan led repeated raids against the Persian lands to the west.
zh: 班布尔是西俾路支斯坦同名河畔的绿洲城镇，河水向西注入贾兹穆里安洼地。这一带在青铜时代已有居民，古城丘出土的彩陶与沙赫里索克塔的遗存相近；希腊文献中格德罗西亚的首府普拉就在班布尔或其附近，公元前325年亚历山大的军队从印度河回师时，曾在周边沙漠中艰难跋涉。旧城堡雄踞河北的山丘，后来倾颓。中世纪以后，绿洲和邻近的法赫雷季由拉克沙尼部的俾路支首领占据，其统治者沙赫·梅赫拉卜汗曾多次向西攻略波斯人的土地。

en: The Bambara, or Bamana, are a Mande people of the upper Niger and its inland delta, the country of the market towns of Djenné and Ségou. They began as a royal section of the Mandinka and built their politics on the tòn, armed age-grade brotherhoods, while keeping to their traditional gods and ancestor rites long after their neighbours turned to Islam. Around 1640 Kaladian Coulibaly set up a short-lived Bambara kingdom at Ségou, but the lasting state was founded in 1712 by his descendant Biton Coulibaly, who turned his tòn into the slave-soldier army of the ton djon, took the title faama, armed a canoe navy on the Niger and taxed trade in cowrie shells. He beat off an invasion from Kong in 1725, conquered Djenné, Macina and Bamako, and in 1751 reduced the old mansa of Mali to a vassal. After the civil wars following Biton's death in 1755, the former slave general Ngolo Diarra seized power in 1766 and opened thirty years of renewed conquest and prosperity. In 1818 the jihad of Seku Amadu of Massina defeated the Bambara at Noukouma and took Djenné, stripping the empire of its northern lands.
zh: 班巴拉人（自称巴马纳）是尼日尔河上游及内陆三角洲的曼德族群，世居杰内、塞古等商镇所在之地。他们源出曼丁卡人的王族支系，以名为通的武装年龄结社构筑政治秩序，并在邻人纷纷改宗伊斯兰之后仍长期固守传统神祇和祖先仪礼。约1640年，卡拉迪安·库利巴利在塞古建立了一个短命的班巴拉王国；持久的国家则由其后人比顿·库利巴利于1712年建立，他把自己的通改造成奴隶兵军团通琼，自称法马，在尼日尔河上组建战船水师，并以贝币征收商税。1725年他击退孔格的入侵，继而征服杰内、马西纳和巴马科，1751年又令马里老曼萨沦为附庸。比顿于1755年死后陷入内战，1766年奴隶出身的将领恩戈洛·迪亚拉夺权，开启了三十年的再征服与繁荣。1818年，马西纳的谢赫·阿马杜发动圣战，在努库马击败班巴拉人并夺取杰内，帝国北部疆土自此丧失。

en: Misnia represents the secular lordship of the bishops of Meissen, whose compact estates around Wurzen in the Leipzig Bay made up the core of the Hochstift Meißen. The diocese itself was founded in 968 under Emperor Otto I as a suffragan of Magdeburg, charged with converting the pagan Wends of the eastern marches; Saint Benno of Meissen, bishop from 1066 to 1106, became its most famous pastor. Over the centuries the canons accumulated scattered lands, and in the fourteenth century the prelates consolidated them into two closed territories, the Wurzen land and the Stolpen-Bischofswerda district, though the Wettin margraves of Meissen always disputed their imperial immediacy. In 1337 the see was held by Withego II of Colditz, a former provost of Wurzen, who added the town of Nossen in 1335 and the lordship of Liebethal in 1336. The Reformation ended the prince-bishopric: the last prelate ceded Stolpen and Bischofswerda to the Elector of Saxony in 1559, and in 1581 the Wurzen lands were absorbed into Lutheran Electoral Saxony.
zh: 迈森尼亚即迈森主教的世俗领地，其核心是莱比锡盆地武尔岑周围的地产，称迈森主教直辖区。主教区本身建于968年，由皇帝奥托一世设立，隶属马格德堡大主教区，使命是向东部边区的异教文德人传教；1066至1106年在任的迈森主教圣本诺是其中最著名的人物。历任教士积累了分散的地产，14世纪时主教们把它们整合为武尔岑兰和施托尔彭—比绍夫斯韦尔达两块封闭领地，但其帝国直辖地位始终遭到韦廷家族迈森藩侯的否认。1337年在任的是科尔迪茨家族的维特戈二世，他曾任武尔岑修院院长，1335年购入诺森城，1336年又取得利伯塔尔领地。宗教改革终结了这个主教邦：末任主教于1559年把施托尔彭和比绍夫斯韦尔达割让给萨克森选侯，1581年武尔岑兰被并入信奉路德宗的萨克森选侯国。

en: Bonai was a forested hill chiefdom of the Garjat country west of Orissa, ruled from the fort of Bonaigarh by its Kadamba dynasty. Court tradition makes its founder Pratap Bhanu Deo, who established the state with the help of the local Bhuyan landlords, whose clans kept a strong place at his court; the dynasty took its name from the kadamba tree, which also stood at the centre of Bhuyan founding legends. Its Rathore Rajput rajas were kin to the ruling houses of Seraikela, Kharsawan and Rairakhol, and for centuries Bonai acknowledged the suzerainty of Sambalpur. The long Maratha wars broke that tie: the state was ceded to the British in 1803, handed back to the Marathas in 1818 and placed finally under British protection in 1826, when it became one of the Chota Nagpur Tributary States under the Bengal Presidency.
zh: 钵奈是奥里萨以西迦贾德山区的丛林小邦，由迦丹巴王朝以钵奈加尔堡为中心统治。宫廷传说称开国君主普拉塔普·巴努·迪奥依靠当地布扬地主的帮助建国，布扬诸族在宫廷中一直保有重要地位；王朝得名于卡丹巴树，这种树也处于布扬人开国传说的核心。其拉托尔拉杰普特拉贾与塞赖卡拉、哈尔萨万和莱拉科尔的统治家族同源，钵奈长期承认桑巴尔普尔的宗主权。漫长的马拉塔战争打断了这一关系：该邦于1803年割让给英国，1818年又交回马拉塔人，1826年最终置于英国保护之下，成为孟加拉管辖区治下的乔塔那格浦尔纳贡土邦之一。

en: Bernburg was the Ascanian principality of Anhalt-Bernburg, created in 1252 when the sons of Prince Henry I divided Anhalt into the lines of Aschersleben, Bernburg and Zerbst, with Bernburg falling to Bernhard I. Its lands on the Saale also included the old Ascanian seat of Ballenstedt. When the Aschersleben line died out in 1315, Prince Bernhard II claimed its inheritance but lost out to Albert, bishop of Halberstadt. In 1337 the principality was ruled by Bernhard III, whose successors kept the small state going until the line became extinct with Bernhard VI in 1468, when Bernburg passed to the princes of Anhalt-Dessau. Recreated in the general Ascanian partition of 1603 under Prince Christian I, it again played a part in the Thirty Years' War, and spun off the small principality of Anhalt-Harzgerode in 1635. Bernburg absorbed Anhalt-Plötzkau in 1665 and was raised to a duchy in 1803, confirming that rank under the Confederation of the Rhine in 1806; after 1815 it was one of the duchies of the German Confederation.
zh: 贝恩堡即阿斯坎尼家族的安哈尔特-贝恩堡亲王国，诞生于1252年——亨利一世的儿子们把安哈尔特分为阿舍斯莱本、贝恩堡和采尔布斯特三支，贝恩堡分给了伯恩哈德一世。它位于萨勒河畔的领地还包括阿斯坎尼家族的故地巴伦施泰特。1315年阿舍斯莱本支系绝嗣时，贝恩哈德二世曾主张继承权，却败给了哈尔伯施塔特主教阿尔贝。1337年统治这里的是伯恩哈德三世，其后继者维持这个小国，直到1468年伯恩哈德六世去世、支系绝嗣，贝恩堡转归安哈尔特-德绍的诸侯。1603年阿斯坎尼家族再次分封，贝恩堡在克里斯蒂安一世治下重建，又在三十年战争中扮演了角色，并于1635年分出小邦安哈尔特-哈茨格罗德。1665年贝恩堡兼并安哈尔特-普洛茨考，1803年升格为公国，1806年经莱茵邦联确认公国地位，1815年后成为德意志邦联的公国之一。

en: The upland country of Bundelkhand, the ancient Chedi, took its name from the Bundela Rajputs who carved out its chiefdoms. The clan's name honours the goddess Bind-bhasini Devi of the Vindhya hills, and its rise began in 1288, when Sohanpal, aided by the Panwar chief Panpal, overthrew Naga, the Khangar lord of the fort of Kurar, later called Garh Kundar, which remained the Bundela seat through the fourteenth century. In 1531 Rudra Pratap Singh moved the capital down to Orchha on the Betwa, the parent state from which Datia split in 1626 and Panna in 1657. The Bundela rajas came under Mughal pressure, paying tribute to Akbar and reaching their architectural peak under Vir Singh Deo in Jahangir's reign, though Jhujhar Singh's revolt was crushed by Shah Jahan. Chhatrasal of Panna led a long revolt against Mughal rule from 1675 and built a wide kingdom, which on his death in 1731 was split among his sons, with a third passing to the Maratha Peshwa Bajirao. Orchha alone escaped full Maratha subjection, moved its court to Tehri in 1783 and accepted British protection by treaty in 1812.
zh: 本德尔肯德意为班德拉人的土地，古称车底，因中世纪在此割据的班德拉拉杰普特人而得名。族名来自温迪亚山区的宾德巴希尼女神；其崛起始于1288年，索汉帕尔在潘瓦尔首领潘帕尔协助下推翻昆达尔堡（后来称加尔昆达尔）的汉加尔首领纳加，这座堡垒在整个14世纪都是班德拉人的据点。1531年鲁德拉·普拉塔普·辛格把都城迁到贝特瓦河畔的奥尔恰，建立母邦奥尔恰国，达蒂亚和潘纳后于1626和1657年从中分出。班德拉诸首领随后承受莫卧儿压力，向阿克巴纳贡，在贾汉吉尔时代的维尔·辛格·迪奥治下建筑成就达到顶峰，但朱贾尔·辛格的叛乱被沙贾汉镇压。潘纳的查特拉萨尔自1675年起长期反抗莫卧儿，打下广阔王国，1731年他死后王国被诸子瓜分，其中三分之一归马拉塔佩什瓦巴吉拉奥。唯有奥尔恰未被马拉塔完全征服，1783年宫廷迁往泰赫里，并于1812年订约接受英国保护。

en: Bone was the leading Bugis kingdom of the southwest peninsula of Sulawesi, ruled from Watampone by kings bearing the title Arumpone. Local tradition places its birth in the early fourteenth century, when the heaven-descended ruler Manurung ri Matajang united seven villages and became the first Arumpone, the figure represented in Bone's court at the game's opening. His successors enlarged the realm, and in the early 1500s Bone fought the older kingdom of Luwu for control of the Cenrana river mouth, an important outlet for eastern trade. In 1582 it joined Wajo and Soppeng in the Tellumpocco'e alliance, meaning the Three Summits, to check the rising power of Gowa-Tallo, but Gowa conquered Bone in 1611 and imposed Islam, which became the kingdom's official religion under its twelfth Arumpone. Bone rose again under Arung Palakka, who allied with the Dutch East India Company against Gowa and helped win the Makassar War of 1666 to 1669; the Treaty of Bungaya left Bone the dominant state of South Sulawesi, a position it held until the British interlude of 1814 and the Dutch return in 1816, when a war in 1824 began the steady erosion of its independence.
zh: 波尼是苏拉威西西南半岛上首屈一指的布吉人王国，王都在瓦坦波内，君主称“阿伦波内”。当地传说认为它诞生于14世纪初：天降的统治者马努隆·里·马塔扬联合七个村庄，成为第一代阿伦波内，也就是游戏开局时波尼宫廷所追溯的人物。后继君主不断扩张疆土，16世纪初，波尼为争夺东海岸贸易要冲森拉纳河口而与更古老的卢武王国交战。1582年，波尼与瓦佐、索彭结成意为“三峰”的特伦波科埃同盟，以遏制戈瓦—塔洛的崛起；但1611年戈瓦征服波尼并强迫其接受伊斯兰教，到第十二代阿伦波内时，伊斯兰教正式成为国教。波尼后来在阿伦·帕拉卡率领下复兴，他与荷兰东印度公司结盟对抗戈瓦，在1666至1669年的望加锡战争中取胜；《邦加亚条约》之后，波尼成为南苏拉威西的霸主，这一地位一直维持到1814年英国短暂接管和1816年荷兰人卷土重来，1824年的战争则开启了其独立地位不断削弱的过程。

en: Baini was a zhangguansi of the Bozhou chiefdom, seated at the Baini stockade in present-day Yuqing County of northern Guizhou. Along with Rongshan and the other Bozhou native offices, it was abolished after the Bozhou rebellion of 1600, its territory becoming Yuqing County under Pingyue Prefecture in 1601.
zh: 白泥是播州土司属下的长官司，治所白泥寨在今贵州北部的余庆县境内。1600年播州之乱平定后，白泥与容山等土司一同被废，其地于1601年设置余庆县，隶属平越府。

en: The Banu Lam are a large Qahtanite tribe of the Tayy and Kahlan stock, named after Lam ibn Harita, a chief from the Hejaz. They first dwelt with the Tayy in the Jabal Tayy mountains of northern Arabia, then migrated into Najd and later sent branches into the desert of southern Iraq, where they repeatedly clashed with Safavid and Ottoman authority. In Arabia their tribesmen dominated the western Najd, the steppe between Medina and al-Yamama, for roughly four centuries before the fifteenth century. The tribe divided into four main Bedouin groups, the Fudhool, Al Kathir, Al Mughira and al-Dhafeer, and Najdi chronicles record their raids and long blood-feuds with the Anazzah, Subay and Dawasir across Sudair and al-Kharj: in 1377 the Al Kathir seized a great caravan coming from Basra at al-Lusafa, and in 1613 the Fudhool fought the Mutayr in the long pitched camp at al-Arma. Not all Lam remained nomads, for many clans settled as townspeople in the Najdi valleys, including the Qasim towns around Unaizah.
zh: 巴努·拉姆是盖哈坦系的大部落，属泰伊部落的凯赫兰一支，得名自汉志首领拉姆·伊本·哈里塔。他们最初随泰伊人居住在阿拉伯北部的泰伊山区，随后迁入内志，后来又有支系迁往伊拉克南部沙漠，并在那里屡次与萨法维王朝和奥斯曼帝国的势力冲突。在阿拉伯本土，15世纪以前的约四百年间，拉姆人称雄于麦地那与耶马迈之间的内志西部草原。全族分为富杜勒、卡西尔、穆吉拉和达菲尔四大贝都因支系，内志地方志记载了他们在苏代尔和海尔季一带与阿奈扎、苏拜、达瓦西尔等部落的劫掠和长期仇杀：1377年，卡西尔人在卢萨法截获了一支来自巴士拉的庞大商队；1613年，富杜勒人又在阿尔迈与穆泰尔人展开长期对峙。并非所有拉姆人都保持游牧，许多氏族在内志河谷定居为城镇居民，欧奈宰周围的盖西姆各镇即是其中之一。

en: The County of Bentheim was a small Westphalian state of the Holy Roman Empire in the fenland south-west of Lower Saxony, ruled from the sandstone castle of Bentheim. A county existed there by about 1050; in 1115 it passed to Otto of the House of Salm, whose daughter Sophia married Dirk VI, Count of Holland, linking the ruling dynasty to the Gerulfing counts of Holland. In 1263 Bentheim annexed the County of Tecklenburg, and in 1277 its lands were split between the Bentheim-Bentheim and Bentheim-Tecklenburg lines. In 1337 Count Simon I of the Bentheim-Bentheim line held the original county. The Reformation arrived under Arnold II of Bentheim-Steinfurt, who converted to Lutheranism in 1544, and the territory adopted a Reformed church constitution in 1588. In 1753 the counts mortgaged Bentheim to the Elector of Hanover, who seized it. Mediatised to the Grand Duchy of Berg in 1806 and annexed by France in 1810, Bentheim was assigned to Hanover by the Congress of Vienna.
zh: 本特海姆伯国是神圣罗马帝国在威斯特伐利亚的小邦，位于下萨克森西南部的沼泽地带，以砂岩筑成的本特海姆城堡为统治中心。约1050年此地已有伯国；1115年它传给萨尔姆家族的奥托，其女索菲娅嫁给荷兰伯爵德克六世，使统治家族与荷兰的赫吕尔夫伯爵家族联姻相连。1263年本特海姆吞并泰克伦堡伯国，1277年领地被拆分为本特海姆-本特海姆与本特海姆-泰克伦堡两支。1337年，本特海姆-本特海姆支的西蒙一世领有祖传伯国。宗教改革在本特海姆-斯泰因富特的阿诺尔德二世治下到来，他于1544年改信路德宗，领地又在1588年采用归正宗教会章程。1753年，伯爵们把本特海姆抵押给汉诺威选侯，选侯随即将其接管。1806年它被贝格大公国收并，1810年遭法国吞并，最后由维也纳会议划归汉诺威。

en: The Marquisate of Bodonitsa was a Frankish lordship in northern Greece, seated at the fortress of Bodonitsa near the pass of Thermopylae, in present-day central Greece. After the Fourth Crusade, Boniface of Montferrat, King of Thessalonica, granted it in 1204 to the Italian knight Guy Pallavicini, whose duty was to guard the pass against Byzantine resistance. The marquisate outlasted the fall of Thessalonica and in 1248 became a vassal of the Principality of Achaea. It also survived the Catalan Company's conquest of the surrounding Latin states after 1311, and passed through marriage to the Venetian Cornaro family and then, in 1335, to the Zorzi. In 1337 its margrave was Nicholas I Zorzi, who ruled a small Catholic enclave ringed by Catalan and Byzantine neighbours. The Ottoman Turks under Mehmed I took the fortress in 1414; Nicholas II Zorzi kept the margravial title, but the territory was never recovered.
zh: 博多尼察侯国是希腊北部的法兰克人领地，治所设在温泉关隘口附近的博多尼察要塞，位于今希腊中部。第四次十字军东征后，萨洛尼卡国王蒙费拉托的博尼法乔于1204年把它封给意大利骑士圭多·帕拉维奇尼，命他扼守隘口、防备拜占庭残余势力。侯国在萨洛尼卡王国灭亡后存续下来，1248年成为亚该亚亲王国的附庸；1311年加泰罗尼亚佣兵团征服周边拉丁政权后，它依然保住了地位，后经联姻先后落入威尼斯的科尔纳罗家族和1335年接手的佐尔齐家族之手。1337年在位的侯爵是尼古拉斯一世·佐尔齐，他统治着一块被加泰罗尼亚人与拜占庭邻邦包围的天主教小领地。1414年，奥斯曼苏丹穆罕默德一世攻占要塞；尼古拉斯二世·佐尔齐虽保留侯爵头衔，领土却再未收复。

en: The Kingdom of Bohemia, ruled from Prague, grew out of the Czech duchy of the Přemyslid dynasty, whose duke Ottokar I took the royal title in 1198, confirmed by the Golden Bull of Sicily in 1212. Ottokar II, who died in battle in 1278, carried Bohemian power as far as the Adriatic, but after Wenceslas III was murdered in 1306 the male Přemyslid line died out, and in 1310 the Bohemian estates offered the crown to John of Luxembourg, husband of the Přemyslid heiress Elizabeth. In 1337 John, by then blind, still wore the crown; he died fighting for France at Crécy in 1346. His son Charles IV made Prague an imperial capital: he founded Charles University in 1348, issued the Golden Bull of 1356 that fixed the seven prince-electors, and built up the crown lands of Bohemia, Moravia, Silesia and Lusatia. Reform followed: Jan Hus was burned at Constance in 1415, and in the Hussite wars of 1419 to 1434 Czech armies under Jan Žižka repelled repeated crusades. After the rule of George of Poděbrady and the Jagiellonians, the death of King Louis at Mohács in 1526 brought the Habsburgs to the throne. The Defenestration of Prague in 1618 opened the Bohemian Revolt and the Thirty Years' War, and defeat at the White Mountain in 1620 cost the kingdom its old liberties. Silesia passed to Prussia in 1742, and when the Holy Roman Empire dissolved in 1806, Bohemia became a crown land of the Austrian Empire.
zh: 波希米亚王国以布拉格为都，由普热米斯尔王朝的捷克公国发展而来：公爵奥托卡一世于1198年称王，1212年的《西西里金玺诏书》确认了王国地位。奥托卡二世于1278年战死，他生前把波希米亚的势力一直推进到亚得里亚海；1306年瓦茨拉夫三世遇刺后，普热米斯尔家族男嗣断绝，1310年波希米亚等级会议把王位奉给迎娶普热米斯尔家族女继承人伊丽莎白的卢森堡的约翰。1337年在位的约翰长年征战、双目已经失明，1346年他在克雷西战役中为法国作战而死。其子查理四世把布拉格建成帝国都城：1348年创办查理大学，1356年颁布确立七大选侯的《金玺诏书》，并苦心经营由波希米亚、摩拉维亚、西里西亚和卢萨蒂亚组成的王冠领地。随后是改革的年代：扬·胡斯于1415年在康斯坦茨被处以火刑，1419—1434年的胡斯战争中，捷克军队在扬·杰式卡统率下屡次击退十字军。历经波杰布拉德的伊日和雅盖隆王朝的统治后，国王拉约什于1526年战死莫哈奇，哈布斯堡家族就此登上王位。1618年的布拉格抛窗事件引发波希米亚起义和三十年战争，1620年白山战役失败后，王国的旧有自治特权被剥夺。1742年西里西亚割让给普鲁士，1806年神圣罗马帝国解体，波希米亚成为奥地利帝国的王冠领地。

en: The Kedatuan of Dapitan, also called the Bool kingdom, was a maritime Tagalog-speaking polity centred on Panglao Island and the Dauis and Mansasa shore of Bohol, on the busy trade route between Cebu and Butuan. The Jesuit chronicler Francisco Combes recorded that the people of Panglao had crossed to mainland Bohol and reduced the older inhabitants to vassalage, and under the brother chiefs Dailisan and Pagbuaya the realm grew rich on regional trade, its canals and ten thousand stilt houses earning it the name the Venice of the Visayas. By 1563 its friendship with the Sultanate of Ternate had soured: a Ternatan fleet of twenty joangas, sailing in under the guise of traders and carrying Portuguese guns and muskets, sacked Bohol and killed Dailisan. Pagbuaya judged the island accursed and led the freemen across to the north coast of Mindanao, where they founded the settlement of Dapitan. Their warriors later served the Spaniards, and the chief Pedro Manuel Manooc fought in the capture of Manila in 1570 and the Bicol campaign of 1573.
zh: 达皮丹的卡达图安又称波和王国，是一个以海上贸易为生的他加禄语政权，中心在邦劳岛以及保和岛的道伊斯和曼萨萨海岸，地处宿务与武端之间繁忙的贸易航线上。耶稣会编年史家弗朗西斯科·孔贝斯记载，邦劳人渡海攻入保和本岛，把早先的居民降为附庸；在达伊利桑和帕格布亚亚兄弟两位酋长治下，该国凭区域贸易致富，城内水道纵横、水上高脚屋多达万座，被称为米沙鄢的威尼斯。到1563年，它与特尔纳特苏丹国的交谊破裂：特尔纳特出动二十艘戎克船，伪装成商船，携葡萄牙火炮和火绳枪洗劫保和，达伊利桑战死。帕格布亚亚认为此岛已遭诅咒，率自由民迁往棉兰老岛北岸，在那里建立了达皮丹聚落。他们的战士后来为西班牙人效力，酋长佩德罗·曼努埃尔·马诺克参加了1570年攻取马尼拉和1573年的比科尔征伐。

en: Bonoman, the Bono state, was one of the earliest Akan states, growing up at the northern edge of the Ghanaian forest where pack animals from the Niger could no longer travel south. Bono tradition remembers its people emerging from a sacred cave at Amowi before settling first at Yefri and then at Bono Manso, which became the capital; nearby Begho served as the great market where Bono gold, kola nuts and ivory were exchanged for salt, textiles and metal goods brought by Wangara merchants from the Middle Niger. The state grew mainly by drawing older villages into its orbit through marriage and allegiance rather than conquest, and its rulers Ameyaw and Obunumankoma enlarged it in the later 1400s, when Bono Manso became a busy centre of trade and crafts. Long the leading power of the region, Bono fought wars with the rising Gonja kingdom and then declined during the 1600s under drought, succession disputes and the shift of trade toward the coast, where Denkyira and the Asante Empire gained European firearms. The Asante conquered Bono Manso in 1723 and carried the kingdom into their empire, though the Bono royal line was later re-established at Takyiman.
zh: 博诺曼即博诺国，是最早的阿肯人国家之一，兴起于加纳森林的北缘——尼日尔方向来的驮畜到这里便无法继续南行。博诺传说中，其先民从阿莫维的一处圣洞走出，先定居耶弗里，后来迁至博诺曼索并以此为都；附近的贝戈是大市场，博诺的黄金、柯拉果和象牙在这里与万加拉商人从中尼日尔带来的盐、布匹和金属器交换。这个国家主要靠联姻和效忠把古老村落纳入势力范围，而非武力征服；统治者阿梅尧和奥布努曼科马在15世纪后半叶扩张疆土，博诺曼索也成为繁忙的工商业中心。作为长期的地区首强，博诺曾与崛起的贡贾王国交战，17世纪又在干旱、王位纷争和贸易向沿海转移的打击下衰落——登克伊拉和阿散蒂等南方阿肯政权借沿海之便获得了欧洲火器。1723年，阿散蒂攻陷博诺曼索，将其并入帝国，但博诺王室后来在塔基曼重建了世系。

en: Borgu is the savanna country west of the lower Niger, whose Bariba people, the Baatombu, lived in lineage-based villages before horsemen from the east, the Wasangari, arrived in the fifteenth century. Their conquest is remembered in the Kisra legend, which makes the hero Kisra and his sons the founders of the Borgu kingdoms of Bussa, Illo and Nikki; Nikki became the leading seat of a loose confederacy bound together by kinship and mutual defence. The horsemen kept their traditional rites and long resisted Islam, which made Borgu a target for its Muslim neighbours. In the 1490s the Songhai emperor Sonni Ali invaded and was routed at Gwangwarake, and Askia Muhammad's campaign of 1505 managed only a brief occupation of Bussa; further Songhai raids devastated Bussa in 1558 and 1563. Borgu also held off the Nupe and, in the mid-eighteenth century, Dahomey. After Songhai collapsed in 1591 the Oyo Empire reduced the Bariba kings to vassals until they defeated Oyo at Gberegburu in 1783. During the Fulani jihads Borgu never submitted, though in 1837 Siru Kpera, king of Nikki, fell in battle beside the Alaafin of Oyo while fighting the Muslims of Ilorin, after which the old confederacy began to fragment.
zh: 博尔古是尼日尔河下游以西的草原之国，居民巴里巴人自称巴通布，原本以血缘村落散居；15世纪，来自东方的骑马武士瓦桑加里人到此。他们的征服保存在基斯拉传说中：英雄基斯拉和他的儿子们建立了布萨、伊洛和尼基等博尔古小王国，其中尼基成为这个靠亲缘与共同防御维系的松散联盟的首要都邑。武士们保留传统祭祀，长期抵制伊斯兰教，也因此成为穆斯林强邻的目标。1490年代，桑海皇帝桑尼·阿里入侵，在关瓦拉克被击溃；1505年阿斯基亚·穆罕默德的远征也只短暂占领布萨，1558和1563年桑海人又两度劫掠布萨。博尔古还挡住了努佩人和18世纪中期达荷美的进攻。1591年桑海崩溃后，奥约帝国迫使巴里巴诸王称臣，直到1783年他们在贝雷格布鲁击败奥约才恢复独立。富拉尼圣战期间博尔古始终未被征服，但1837年，尼基国王西鲁·佩拉与奥约阿拉芬并肩作战、攻打伊洛林穆斯林时阵亡，旧联盟自此走向瓦解。

en: Medieval Bosnia was a mountainous Balkan state in the Drina and Vrbas valleys, ruled by a ban who was nominally a vassal of the Kingdom of Hungary but in practice independent. Ban Kulin, ruling from 1180 to 1204, made the country prosper and issued the Charter of Ban Kulin in 1189, its oldest surviving document, regulating trade with Ragusa; his age also saw the rise of the local Bosnian Church, whose Krstjani followers were branded heretics by both Rome and Constantinople and drew a Hungarian crusade in the 1230s. The Kotromanić dynasty restored native rule after the fall of the Croatian Šubić governors, and in 1337 Ban Stephen II Kotromanić governed from the central Bosnian heartland around Zenica, having annexed Usora and Soli in 1324 and the coastal land of Hum in 1326, and welcomed the first Franciscan vicariate in 1339. His nephew Tvrtko I, ban from 1353, crowned himself king in 1377 and built Bosnia into one of the strongest powers of the peninsula, enriched by the silver mines of Srebrenica. Weak successors and feudal strife then opened the door to the Ottomans, who conquered eastern Bosnia in the 1440s and 1450s, captured and beheaded the last king Stephen Tomašević at Jajce in 1463, and took the final fortress of Novi in Hum in 1481.
zh: 中世纪波斯尼亚是巴尔干山区的国家，地处德里纳河与弗尔巴斯河谷，统治者称巴纳，名义上是匈牙利国王的附庸，实际保持独立。库林巴纳于1180至1204年在位，治下国泰民安，1189年颁布的《库林宪章》是该国现存最古老的文献，规定了与拉古萨的贸易；他的时代还兴起了本土的波斯尼亚教会，其克里斯蒂亚尼信徒被罗马和君士坦丁堡双双斥为异端，并在13世纪30年代招致匈牙利十字军的讨伐。克罗地亚舒比奇家族的统治垮台后，科特罗马尼奇王朝恢复了本族人的政权；1337年，巴纳斯特凡二世·科特罗马尼奇以泽尼察一带的波斯尼亚腹地为治所，他已于1324年兼并乌索拉和索利，1326年夺取滨海的胡姆地区，又在1339年接纳了第一个方济各会代牧区。他的侄子特维尔特科一世1353年继任巴纳，1377年加冕为王，靠斯雷布雷尼察的银矿之利把波斯尼亚建成半岛强国之一。然而后继者孱弱、封建内讧给了奥斯曼人可乘之机：15世纪40至50年代奥斯曼征服波斯尼亚东部，1463年在亚伊采俘获并斩首末代国王斯特凡·托马舍维奇，1481年又拿下胡姆的最后一座要塞诺维。

en: The Duchy of Bourbon lay in the Bourbonnais, around the upper Allier river, and grew from a castle called Bourbon, the present-day Bourbon-l'Archambault, whose first known lord Aymon received fiefs there from King Charles the Simple in 913. Its early lords of the House of Bourbon-Archambaud died out in the male line in 1196, and after passing through the houses of Dampierre and Burgundy the lordship came in 1272 to Robert of France, Count of Clermont and youngest son of King Louis IX, through his marriage to Beatrice of Burgundy, heiress of Bourbon. Their son Louis, born in 1279, exchanged Clermont for the County of La Marche with King Charles IV and in 1327 saw Bourbon raised to a duchy-peerage, becoming its first duke. Louis the Lame died in 1341, and his son Peter I was killed at the Battle of Poitiers in 1356; from 1416 the dukes also held the Duchy of Auvergne. The senior line ended with the death of Constable Charles III in 1527, but the cadet branch of La Marche-Vendome inherited the French crown in 1589 with Henry IV, from whom the later kings of France descended.
zh: 波旁公国地处阿列河上游的波旁奈地区，源于一座名为波旁的城堡（即现在的波旁拉尔尚博）：913年，首位有名可考的领主艾蒙从糊涂王查理处受封当地封地。早期的波旁-阿尔尚博家族男系于1196年绝嗣，领地历经当皮埃尔家族和勃艮第家族之手，1272年因法王路易九世的幼子、克莱蒙伯爵罗贝尔迎娶波旁女继承人勃艮第的比阿特丽斯而转入宗室之手。两人之子路易生于1279年，他与查理四世交换领地，以克莱蒙换得拉马什伯国，并在1327年看着波旁被擢升为公爵兼法兰西贵族领地，成为首任波旁公爵。绰号“跛子”的路易于1341年去世，其子皮埃尔一世1356年战死于普瓦捷战役；1416年起波旁公爵又兼领奥弗涅公国。长支于1527年因王室总管夏尔三世之死而绝嗣，但拉马什-旺多姆旁支在1589年由亨利四世继承法国王位，此后的法兰西国王皆出自这一支。

en: Bowontehu was a small Minahasan polity on the northern tip of Sulawesi, around the bay where the city of Manado now stands. Local tradition remembers it as the predecessor of the Kingdom of Manado, one of the competing walak, or independent chiefdoms, of the Minahasan peninsula before the arrival of European traders and the Dutch East India Company.
zh: 博翁特胡是苏拉威西岛北端、今万鸦老湾一带的米纳哈沙小邦。当地传统将它视为万鸦老王国的前身，是欧洲商人和荷兰东印度公司到来之前，米纳哈沙半岛上彼此争战的独立部族政权之一。

en: Prome, modern Pyay, stands on the Irrawaddy beside the ruins of Sri Ksetra, the great circular walled capital of the ancient Pyu city-states. In the centuries after the Pyu decline the city became a strategic southern gateway of the Burmese kingdoms, and for much of the Small Kingdoms period it was a tightly governed vassal, passing from Pagan to Myinsaing and Pinya. Its viceroy in 1337 was Kyaswa, a son of the last great Pagan king Narathihapate, who held the city from about 1305 to 1344. Under the Ava kingdom Prome was the southernmost province facing the Mon kingdom of Hanthawaddy, and the Forty Years' War of 1385 to 1424 made its countryside a recurring battlefield; Ava entrusted the post only to senior princes and refused to allow hereditary rule. That arrangement broke in 1482, when the governor Thado Minsaw seized the city and made himself king of an independent Prome. He later joined the Confederation of Shan States in sacking Ava in 1525, but Prome became a confederation tributary in 1532 and, despite aid from the confederation and Mrauk U, fell to the Toungoo armies in 1542.
zh: 卑谬即今卑谬市，位于伊洛瓦底江畔，紧邻古代骠人城邦大国室利差呾罗的圆形城墙遗址。骠人衰落后，这座城市成为缅甸诸王国南方的战略门户；在小国林立的时代，它长期是受严密控制的附庸，先后归属于蒲甘、敏象和彬牙。1337年坐镇此地的总督加苏瓦是蒲甘末代雄主那罗梯诃波帝之子，约于1305年至1344年管辖该城。阿瓦王国时期，卑谬是直面孟人汉达瓦底王国的最南省份，1385年至1424年的四十年战争使其乡野反复沦为战场；阿瓦只把此职授予资深王子，不许世袭。这一惯例在1482年被打破：总督达多敏索夺取城池，自立为卑谬国王。他后来加入掸邦联盟，于1525年合伙洗劫阿瓦，但卑谬在1532年沦为掸邦联盟的朝贡国，又在掸邦联盟与妙乌的援军相继失败后，于1542年被东吁军队攻灭。

en: Known in antiquity as the Greek Pentapolis of Cyrenaica, the coastal country of Barqa took its Arabic name from its capital Barce after the Muslim conquest of around 642, when the army of Amr ibn al-As added it to the caliphate. With the collapse of Umayyad power it was attached to Egypt and ruled loosely by the Fatimid caliphs; its harbours became bases for piracy in the central Mediterranean, and in 1051 or 1052 its emir Jabbara transferred his allegiance to the Zirids. The mid-eleventh-century migration of the Banu Hilal and Banu Sulaym Arab tribes devastated the old port cities and left the country to the Bedouin Banu Sulaym, whose clans formed the backbone of its population in later centuries. Saladin's Ayyubids reclaimed Barqa as an agricultural base, but the Mamluks who followed them could never control it directly and held its suzerainty only through alliances and subsidies to the local Bedouin. After the Ottoman conquest of Egypt in 1517 the sultans inherited that loose overlordship, and Barqa was in time absorbed into Ottoman Libya, where tribal chiefs kept most of their practical autonomy.
zh: 拜尔盖沿海地区在古代是以希腊五城闻名的昔兰尼加，约642年阿慕尔·本·阿斯的军队将其并入哈里发国家后，它以都城巴尔卡得名，阿拉伯语称拜尔盖。倭马亚政权崩溃后，它被划归埃及，由法蒂玛哈里发松散统治；其港口成为中地中海海盗的巢穴，1051或1052年，当地埃米尔贾巴拉转而效忠齐里德王朝。11世纪中叶巴努希拉尔和巴努苏莱姆等阿拉伯部落的西迁浪潮摧毁了古老的港城，这片土地留给贝都因的巴努苏莱姆人游牧，在此后几个世纪里，他们的部族始终构成当地人口的主干。萨拉丁的阿尤布王朝重新收回拜尔盖作为农业基地，但继之而起的马穆鲁克人始终无法直接统治，只能靠结盟和津贴换取当地贝都因部承认其宗主权。1517年奥斯曼征服埃及后，苏丹继承了这种松散的宗主权，拜尔盖最终被并入奥斯曼利比亚，而部落首领在实际事务中仍保有大部分自治权。

en: Baqlin was one of the six Beja kingdoms of the early medieval Horn of Africa, recorded around 890 by the Arab geographer al-Yaqubi alongside Nagash, Bazin, Jarin and Qita'a. The Beja, Cushitic pastoralists from the Red Sea hills, had drifted into the Eritrean plateau from the late 600s as the old kingdom of Aksum crumbled, with its final collapse coming around 960; the Zanafaj clan led the way through the Gash-Barka valley, and Baqlin grew up in the arid Atbai lowlands of what is now western Eritrea, around the Baraka and Anseba rivers, where it bordered Jarin to the east and the Nubian kingdom of Alodia to the west. Its Beja clans combined herding with farming and grew wealthy from the gold, emeralds and precious stones of their mines, trading with Muslim Arab merchants who settled and worked among them and gradually brought Islam in place of the old Beja pagan cults. Al-Yaqubi called these warlike kingdoms skilled in battle, but from the 1200s their power ebbed: Abyssinian settlers retook the highlands, and the Beja realms were absorbed or displaced by the rising Bellou, or Balaw, kingdom that dominated north-western Eritrea until the 1500s.
zh: 巴格林是中世纪东非之角六个贝贾王国之一，约890年由阿拉伯地理学家雅库比记录在案，与纳加什、巴津、贾林、基塔等国并列。贝贾人本是来自红海山区的库希特语牧民，7世纪末（600年代后期）趁古老的阿克苏姆王国崩溃而进入厄立特里亚高原——阿克苏姆最终约在960年灭亡；扎纳法杰部族率先沿加什-巴尔卡河谷深入，巴格林便兴起在今厄立特里亚西部干旱的阿特拜低地，位于巴拉卡河与安瑟巴河一带，东接贾林，西邻努比亚的阿洛迪亚王国。境内的贝贾诸部族兼营畜牧与农耕，并靠开采金矿、祖母绿和宝石致富，与定居其间的穆斯林阿拉伯商人贸易，阿拉伯人也逐渐带来伊斯兰教，取代了贝贾人原有的多神崇拜。雅库比称这些好战的王国精于战阵，但从13世纪（1200年代）起其势力开始衰退：阿比西尼亚移民夺回高原，贝贾诸邦或被吞并、或被新兴的贝卢（巴劳）王国取代，后者一直主导厄立特里亚西北部到16世纪（1500年代）。

en: In 1337 Brandenburg was held by the Wittelsbach margrave Louis I, son of Emperor Louis IV, who had been enfeoffed with the march in 1323 after its Ascanian rulers died out. His rule was contested from the start by the local nobility and the papacy, and overshadowed by wars with Pomerania and Poland; after the emperor's death an impostor known as the False Waldemar briefly seized the margraviate in 1348 with the backing of Emperor Charles IV. Louis's brother Louis the Roman nonetheless secured Brandenburg's place among the prince-electors through the Golden Bull of 1356, and in 1373 the House of Luxembourg bought the march outright. Under their weak rule the native estates gained the upper hand, until in 1415 the Hohenzollern burgrave Frederick of Nuremberg was enfeoffed with Brandenburg at the Council of Constance, founding the dynasty that would rule for five centuries and making Berlin its capital. The Hohenzollern electors introduced the Reformation in 1539, inherited the Duchy of Prussia in 1618 and, after the ordeal of the Thirty Years' War, acquired Farther Pomerania at the Peace of Westphalia in 1648. Frederick William, the Great Elector, built the scattered lands into a major power and welcomed Huguenot refugees through the Edict of Potsdam of 1685; in 1701 his son crowned himself King in Prussia. Brandenburg remained the power base of the Prussian kingdom of Frederick the Great until the Holy Roman Empire dissolved in 1806, and in 1815 it was reorganized as the Prussian Province of Brandenburg.
zh: 1337年的勃兰登堡掌握在维特尔斯巴赫家族的藩侯路易一世手中，他是皇帝路易四世之子，1323年阿斯坎尼家族绝嗣后受封这片边地。他的统治从一开始就遭到本地贵族和教廷的抵制，又深陷与波美拉尼亚和波兰的战争；皇帝死后，一个自称瓦尔德马的冒名者在皇帝查理四世支持下于1348年一度夺取藩侯之位，史称假瓦尔德马。尽管如此，路易之弟“罗马人”路易仍借1356年的《金玺诏书》确立了勃兰登堡的选侯地位，1373年卢森堡家族干脆买下了这片边地。在卢森堡家族软弱的统治下，本地等级势力坐大，直到1415年，霍亨索伦家族的纽伦堡伯爵腓特烈在康斯坦茨公会议上受封勃兰登堡，开创了延续五个世纪的王朝，并定都柏林。霍亨索伦选侯们于1539年引入宗教改革，1618年继承普鲁士公国；在经历三十年战争的浩劫后，又依1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》取得远波美拉尼亚。“大选侯”腓特烈·威廉把这些分散的领地建设成强国，并以1685年的《波茨坦敕令》接纳胡格诺难民；1701年，他的儿子加冕为“在普鲁士的国王”。勃兰登堡始终是腓特烈大帝时代普鲁士王国的权力根基，直到1806年神圣罗马帝国解体，1815年被改组为普鲁士的勃兰登堡省。

en: The Duchy of Brabant was a Holy Roman Empire state in the Low Countries whose chief cities were Leuven, Brussels, Antwerp and 's-Hertogenbosch. Its name goes back to the Carolingian pagus Bracbatensis, meaning marshy region, between the Scheldt and the Dijle. The counts of Leuven built up the territory, and in 1085 Emperor Henry IV created the Landgraviate of Brabant for Count Henry III; in 1183 Frederick Barbarossa raised it to a duchy under Henry I. Victory at the Battle of Worringen in 1288 brought the dukes the Duchy of Limburg. In 1337 Brabant was ruled by Duke John III of the Leuven line, who in 1354 granted the charter of liberties known as the Joyous Entry. When his line ended, the duchy was inherited in 1430 by Philip the Good of Burgundy, and in 1477 it passed with Mary of Burgundy to the Habsburgs as one of the Seventeen Provinces. The Eighty Years' War split Brabant: the Peace of Westphalia of 1648 gave the north to the Dutch Republic, while the south remained Habsburg. French armies annexed the whole territory in 1794 and dissolved the duchy; after 1815 it belonged to the United Kingdom of the Netherlands, and the southern portion became part of Belgium in 1830.
zh: 布拉班特公国是神圣罗马帝国在低地的邦国，主要城市为勒芬、布鲁塞尔、安特卫普和斯海尔托亨博斯。其名可追溯到加洛林时代位于斯海尔德河与代勒河之间的布拉班特行政区，意为沼泽之地。勒芬伯爵家族逐步经营此地，1085年皇帝亨利四世为亨利三世设立布拉班特藩侯国，1183年红胡子腓特烈一世又将其升为亨利一世名下的公国。1288年公国在沃林根战役获胜，取得林堡公国。1337年统治布拉班特的是勒芬世系的约翰三世，他于1354年向臣民颁发名为《欢乐入城》的自由宪章。该世系终结后，公国于1430年由勃艮第公爵好人腓力继承，1477年随勃艮第的玛丽归入哈布斯堡家族，成为十七省之一。八十年战争使布拉班特分裂：1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》将北部划归联省共和国，南部留在哈布斯堡手中。1794年法兰西军队吞并全境并解散公国，1815年后它归属尼德兰联合王国，南部于1830年成为比利时的一部分。

en: The Prince-Provostry of Berchtesgaden was a small ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire tucked into an almost impregnable Alpine valley south of Salzburg. Count Berengar of Sulzbach founded an Augustinian canons' monastery there in 1102, fulfilling the will of his mother Countess Irmgard, and the house grew rich on the valley's salt deposits while playing its powerful neighbours, the Bavarian dukes and the archbishops of Salzburg, against each other. It became an imperial abbey in 1194, and in 1380 its provost was raised to the rank of an imperial prince; from 1559 the Prince-Provost held a direct vote in the Imperial Diet, one of only two such prelates in the Empire alongside Ellwangen. From 1594 the provostry belonged to the Wittelsbachs, and from 1612 it was held in personal union by the prince-archbishops of Cologne. When the Salzburg archbishop Wolf Dietrich Raitenau invaded in 1611, Duke Maximilian I of Bavaria drove his troops out. The state was secularised in 1802 and 1803, passed to Austria after the Peace of Pressburg in 1805, and finally fell to the Kingdom of Bavaria in 1810.
zh: 贝希特斯加登主教长领地是神圣罗马帝国的一个小型教会邦国，深藏在萨尔茨堡以南一座几乎无懈可击的阿尔卑斯山谷中。1102年，苏尔茨巴赫伯爵贝伦加尔遵照母亲伊尔姆加德伯爵夫人的遗嘱，在此建立奥古斯丁律修会修道院；修道院靠山谷里的盐矿致富，并在强邻巴伐利亚公爵与萨尔茨堡大主教之间左右逢源。它于1194年成为帝国修道院，1380年院长升为帝国王侯；1559年起主教长在帝国议会拥有直接投票权，是帝国仅有的两个此类职位之一，另一个在埃尔旺根。1594年起该领地归维特尔斯巴赫家族所有，1612年起由科隆大主教兼领。1611年萨尔茨堡大主教沃尔夫·迪特里希·冯·赖特瑙入侵，巴伐利亚公爵马克西米利安一世将其军队逐出。这个国家于1802至1803年被世俗化，1805年《普雷斯堡和约》后转归奥地利，最终于1810年并入巴伐利亚王国。

en: The Prince-Archbishopric of Bremen traced its see to the diocese founded in 787 at Charlemagne's instance for the mission of Willehad among the Saxons and Frisians of the lower Weser. From the 840s it was united with Hamburg as the archdiocese of Hamburg-Bremen, the base from which Ansgar and Rimbert launched the conversion of Scandinavia and the Baltic Slavs, with Nordic sees such as Lund as its suffragans until 1104. Over time the archbishops also built up a secular principality, an assemblage of lands and rights between the Weser and the Elbe that included Stade, Bremervörde and, from 1145 to 1526, the free peasant land of Dithmarschen. The city of Bremen governed itself from 1186 and would not harbour the archbishop within its walls after 1313, so the prince-archbishops ruled from Vörde Castle. In 1337 the see was held by Burchard Grelle, a Bremen citizen's son appointed by Pope John XXII in 1327, whose tenure brought unusually good relations between city and cathedral. The territory turned Lutheran in the sixteenth century, suffered heavily in the Thirty Years' War, and under the Peace of Westphalia of 1648 was secularized into the hereditary Duchy of Bremen, awarded to the Swedish crown.
zh: 不来梅亲王大主教区的源头，是787年应查理曼之请、为威利哈德在下威悉河的萨克森人和弗里斯兰人中传教而设立的主教区。9世纪40年代起，它与汉堡合并为汉堡—不来梅大主教区，成为安斯加尔和林贝特向斯堪的纳维亚和波罗的海斯拉夫人传教的基地，隆德等北欧主教区在1104年之前都隶属其下。大主教们还逐渐建立起一块世俗领地，由威悉河与易北河之间的土地和权利拼凑而成，包括施塔德、布雷默弗德，以及1145至1526年间受其管辖的自由农民地区迪特马尔申。不来梅城自1186年起实行自治，1313年后更不允许大主教在城内居住，亲王大主教于是移驻弗德城堡。1337年在任的是布尔夏德·格雷勒，他出身不来梅市民家庭，1327年由教皇约翰二十二世任命，任内城市与教区关系异常融洽。这块领地在16世纪改宗路德宗，三十年战争中饱受蹂躏，1648年依《威斯特伐利亚和约》被世俗化为世袭的不来梅公国，封给瑞典王室。

en: The County of Berg arose in 1101 along the lower Rhine, when a junior line of the powerful Ezzonian dynasty set itself up as counts at Schloss Burg on the Wupper. A partition in 1160 hived off the County of the Mark, and the Berg counts reached their early high point under Engelbert II, who as archbishop of Cologne ruled the see in regency until his assassination in 1225. When the comital line failed, the heiress Irmgard married Henry IV of Limburg in 1217, bringing Berg to the House of Limburg; in 1280 the counts moved their court down to Düsseldorf, and Count Adolf VIII fought on the winning side at the Battle of Worringen in 1288. In 1337 Berg was held by Count Adolf IX, on whose death in 1348 it passed through his daughter to the counts of Jülich. Emperor Wenceslaus raised Jülich-Berg to a duchy in 1380. In 1511 Berg fell, with Jülich and Ravensberg, to the dukes of Cleves, forming the United Duchies of Jülich-Cleves-Berg; the 1614 partition after the united line died out in 1609 assigned Berg to the Wittelsbach counts palatine of Neuburg. Its towns became an early centre of continental industry, with Elberfeld and Barmen making textiles and Solingen forging blades, before Napoleon made Berg a grand duchy in 1806 and Prussia absorbed it in 1815.
zh: 贝格伯国1101年兴起于下莱茵地区，势力强大的埃佐农王朝一支旁系在伍珀河畔的贝格城堡自立为伯爵。1160年的分家分出了马克伯国；贝格伯爵们在恩格尔贝特二世时达到早期鼎盛，他以科隆大主教身份摄政教区，1225年遇刺身亡。伯爵本支绝嗣后，女继承人伊尔姆加德于1217年嫁给林堡公爵亨利四世，贝格由此转入林堡家族；1280年伯爵们把宫廷迁往杜塞尔多夫，伯爵阿道夫八世又在1288年的沃林根战役中站在获胜一方。1337年统治贝格的是伯爵阿道夫九世，他1348年去世后，领地经其女儿传给于利希伯爵家族。1380年文策尔皇帝把于利希—贝格升格为公国。1511年，贝格连同于利希和拉文斯贝格落入克莱沃公爵之手，组成于利希—克莱沃—贝格联合公国；1609年联合支系绝嗣引发争端，1614年的分割把贝格划给维特尔斯巴赫家族的诺伊堡行宫伯爵。境内城镇后来成为欧洲大陆最早的工业区之一：埃尔伯费尔德和巴门经营纺织，索林根锻造刀剑；1806年拿破仑把贝格改为大公国，1815年它被普鲁士吞并。
