en: The Duchy of Brittany occupied the Armorican peninsula of north-western France, where Britons fleeing turmoil in Roman Britain had settled between the fourth and seventh centuries, blending with the local Gauls to become the Bretons. It took shape around 939 after Viking armies were driven out, and the early dukes held little power beyond their own lands. Henry II of England invaded in the mid-twelfth century, and his son Geoffrey ruled through his marriage to the hereditary duchess Constance; Angevin control collapsed only in 1204, leaving the French crown to extend its influence. In 1337 the childless John III of the Dreux dynasty still reigned from Vannes. His death in 1341 opened the War of the Breton Succession, fought until 1365 between Charles of Blois, backed by France, and John of Montfort, backed by England; the Montfort victory at Auray in 1364 nevertheless left the new duke a vassal of the French king. The independent duchy ended when Duke Francis II died in 1488 leaving his daughter Anne, whom Charles VIII of France married; the Estates of Brittany voted union with the French crown in 1532, and the French Revolution later replaced the duchy with departments.
zh: 布列塔尼公国位于法兰西西北的阿摩里卡半岛，4至7世纪间，从不列颠动荡中迁出的布立吞人在此定居，与当地高卢人融合，成为布列塔尼人。公国约在939年维京军队被逐后成形，早期公爵在自家领地之外权力有限。12世纪中叶英格兰国王亨利二世入侵，其子若弗鲁瓦通过与世袭女公爵康斯坦丝的婚姻入主公国；金雀花家族的统治到1204年才瓦解，法兰西王室的影响随之深入。1337年在位的是德勒王朝无嗣的约翰三世，都城在瓦讷。他1341年去世后爆发布列塔尼继承战争，一直打到1365年：法兰西支持的布卢瓦的查理对阵英格兰支持的蒙福尔的约翰；蒙福尔一方虽在1364年的欧赖战役中获胜，新公爵却仍向法兰西国王称臣。1488年公爵弗朗索瓦二世去世，只留下女儿安娜，法兰西国王查理八世娶她为妻，公国的独立就此终结；1532年布列塔尼三级会议投票决定与法兰西王冠合并，法国大革命后公国又被改划为省份。

en: The Barlas were a Mongol tribe of Borjigin stock, first recorded within the Khamag Mongol confederation of the twelfth century. Their ancestor Qachuli was kin to the imperial line, and his great-grandson Qarachar Barlas commanded a tumen under Genghis Khan and was appointed governor of Transoxiana under Chagatai. The tribe settled around Kish, modern Shahrisabz, and unlike most of their pastoral neighbours became largely settled, converting to Islam and exchanging Mongolian for the Turkic Chagatai language. In the fourteenth century the Barlas were one of the four great tribal powers of the crumbling Chagatai ulus: Hajji Beg joined the Suldus revolt against the Qara'unas in 1359, and in 1370 his nephew Timur, born into the tribe near Kish, made himself master of Transoxiana and went on to build the Timurid Empire from Syria to India. Timur's descendant Babur, driven from Samarkand, conquered northern India and in 1526 founded the Mughal Empire, making the Barlas the only Mongol tribe to give rise to two great imperial dynasties.
zh: 巴鲁剌思是出自孛儿只斤血脉的蒙古部落，12世纪已见载于蒙古联盟之中。其始祖合出里与黄金家族同源，曾孙合剌察儿在成吉思汗麾下统领万户，后被任命为察合台治下河中的达鲁花赤。该部定居在渴石（今沙赫里萨布兹）一带，与周边多数游牧部落不同，逐渐走向定居，皈依伊斯兰教，并改用突厥语族的察合台语。14世纪时，巴鲁剌思是衰微的察合台兀鲁思四大部落势力之一：哈吉·伯克于1359年联合速勒都思反抗哈剌兀纳思；1370年，出身该部、生于渴石附近的帖木儿成为河中之主，继而建立起疆域从叙利亚延伸到印度的帖木儿帝国。帖木儿的后裔巴布尔在失国之后南下征服北印度，于1526年建立莫卧儿帝国，巴鲁剌思也因此成为唯一孕育出两大帝国王朝的蒙古部落。

en: Bremen, on the lower Weser, grew up around the bishopric founded in 787 and won its first economic privileges in 888, when King Arnulf allowed it its own markets, mint and customs. Stone walls from 1032 and a stone cathedral from 1042 reflected its growing North Sea trade. The foundation of its liberty was the Gelnhausen Privilege of 1186, granted by Frederick Barbarossa and confirmed by the archbishop, which gave the city its own laws and taxes and freed any serf who dwelt within its walls for a year and a day. Bremen joined the Hanseatic League in 1260, and its merchant guilds made it one of the leading north German trading cities; in 1313 the prince-archbishop abandoned his residence inside the city, which extended its rule along the lower Weser from 1381 and raised the stone Roland, its symbol of civic freedom, in 1404. The city embraced the Reformation in the late 1520s and was mostly Calvinist by the 1590s. It bought off Wallenstein in 1628, and in 1646 the Diploma of Linz recognized Bremen as a Free Imperial City, a standing defended against Swedish Bremen-Verden in the wars of 1654 and 1666 and reaffirmed by Hanover in 1720.
zh: 不来梅位于下威悉河畔，围绕787年设立的主教区发展起来，888年国王阿努尔夫授予其自办市场、自铸钱币和自定关税的权利，这是它最早的经济特权。1032年的石砌城墙和1042年的石建大教堂，反映出北海贸易带来的财富。1186年腓特烈·巴巴罗萨颁布、大主教确认的《格尔恩豪森特权》是其自由的根基：城市拥有自己的法律和税收，农奴在城内住满一年零一天即可获得自由。1260年不来梅加入汉萨同盟，商人行会把它经营成北德首屈一指的贸易城市之一；1313年亲王大主教放弃了城内驻所，城市从1381年起把统治扩展到下威悉河沿线，1404年竖起石雕罗兰像，作为市民自由的象征。16世纪20年代末城市接受宗教改革，到90年代居民多已皈依加尔文宗。1628年它花钱让华伦斯坦退兵，1646年的《林茨诏书》正式承认不来梅为帝国自由城市；它在1654年和1666年的战争中顶住瑞典治下的不来梅—费尔登，1720年其自由地位又得到汉诺威的确认。

en: Bern is a city state on a bend of the river Aare, founded around 1191 by Berthold V of Zähringen; legend says he named it after the first beast of his hunt, a bear, and the bear has marked its seal since the 1220s. When the Zähringen line died out in 1218, Emperor Frederick II's golden charter made Bern a free imperial city. It allied with the Forest Cantons in 1323, and in June 1339 its militia, supported by Uri, Schwyz and Unterwalden, crushed a coalition of Fribourg and Burgundian nobles at the Battle of Laupen, the first battle in which the Swiss white cross is recorded as a field sign; the victory opened the way for Bern to join the Swiss Confederacy in 1353. A great fire in 1405 destroyed the wooden town, which was rebuilt in sandstone. Bern then built a large subject territory: it took the Aargau in 1415, fought Charles the Bold at Grandson and Murten in 1476, secularized Interlaken Abbey when it adopted the Reformation in 1528 and conquered the Vaud in 1536, becoming the largest city state north of the Alps under a closed patrician council. French invasion in 1798 broke its power and split its lands, until the Act of Mediation reunited the canton in 1803.
zh: 伯尔尼是阿勒河河曲上的城市邦国，约1191年由策林根公爵贝特霍尔德五世建立；传说他以狩猎时遇到的第一头野兽——熊——为城市命名，13世纪20年代起熊的图案就出现在城徽上。1218年策林根家族绝嗣，皇帝腓特烈二世以黄金特许状将伯尔尼立为帝国自由城市。1323年它与森林州结盟；1339年6月，伯尔尼民兵在乌利、施维茨和翁特瓦尔登支援下，于劳彭战役击溃弗里堡与勃艮第贵族的联军，这也是瑞士白十字战场标志首次见于记载的战役，此胜为伯尔尼1353年加入瑞士同盟铺平了道路。1405年一场大火烧毁木构旧城，城市此后以砂岩重建。伯尔尼随后建立起庞大的属地：1415年夺取阿尔高，1476年在格朗松和穆尔滕与大胆查理作战，1528年接受宗教改革并没收因特拉肯修道院，1536年征服沃地区，成为阿尔卑斯山以北最大的城市邦国，由封闭的贵族市政会统治。1798年法军入侵摧毁了它的权势并分割其领土，直到1803年《调解法令》才使该州重新统一。

en: Brecknock was a marcher lordship in the hills of south-central Wales, occupying the old Welsh kingdom of Brycheiniog with its chief castle at Brecon. Between 1088 and 1095 the Norman knight Bernard de Neufmarche overran Brycheiniog and built Brecon Castle to hold the land. It passed through the families of Miles of Gloucester and the de Braoses before coming to the Bohun earls of Hereford, whose Humphrey de Bohun walled the town after 1240. In the 1330s Edward III reunited the whole lordship under Humphrey de Bohun, the sixth earl, who held it in 1337. When the Bohun male line failed, Mary de Bohun carried a claim to her husband Henry Bolingbroke, the future Henry IV; the estates later went to the Staffords, dukes of Buckingham, until Edward Stafford was attainted and executed in 1521 and Brecknock fell to the crown. Owain Glyndwr's revolt tested its defences in 1404, and under the Laws in Wales Acts of 1535 to 1542 the lordship became the county of Brecknockshire.
zh: 布雷克诺克是威尔士中南部山区的一个边境领主领，占据古老的威尔士王国布莱切尼奥格，以布雷肯城堡为治所。1088至1095年间，诺曼骑士贝尔纳·德·讷夫马尔什征服布莱切尼奥格，修建布雷肯城堡镇守。领地先后转入格洛斯特的迈尔斯家族和德·布劳斯家族，最后归于赫里福德伯爵博洪家族，汉弗莱·德·博洪在1240年后为布雷肯修筑城墙。14世纪30年代，爱德华三世把整个领主领重新合并给第六代伯爵汉弗莱·德·博洪，他正是1337年的领主。博洪男嗣断绝后，玛丽·德·博洪把继承权带给丈夫博林布鲁克的亨利，即后来的亨利四世；地产后来落入白金汉公爵斯塔福德家族之手，1521年爱德华·斯塔福德被定罪处决，布雷克诺克收归王冠。1404年欧文·格林杜尔的起义考验了它的城防，1535至1542年的《威尔士法令》把该领主领改为布雷克诺克郡。

en: The Viscounty of Béarn was a Pyrenean lordship in south-western Gascony, whose capitals moved from Roman Beneharnum, destroyed by Vikings in the ninth century, to Morlaàs and then Orthez. It emerged from the break-up of the Duchy of Gascony, and its first ruling house was the Centulle family, which absorbed the viscounties of Oloron around 1050 and Montaner in 1085, while the county of Orthez followed in 1194. Caught between the kings of Aragon, England and France, Béarn passed in 1290 to the counts of Foix when Margaret, heiress of Viscount Gaston VII, married Roger-Bernard III of Foix. In 1337 its lord was Gaston II of Foix-Béarn, who was also count of Foix. His son Gaston III Phoebus used the disorder after Crécy to declare in 1347 that he held Béarn from God and from no man on earth, turning it into a de facto sovereign principality. When his line failed, Béarn went to the House of Grailly, whose heirs became kings of Navarre and moved their court from Orthez to Pau in 1464; Henry IV of France was born at the castle of Pau, and Béarn was united to the French crown only in 1620.
zh: 贝阿恩子爵领是加斯科涅西南部的比利牛斯领地，首府先后为9世纪被维京人摧毁的古罗马城贝内阿尔努姆、莫尔拉斯和奥尔泰兹。它是在加斯科涅公国瓦解的过程中形成的，首个统治家族是桑图勒家族，先后于约1050年并入奥洛龙子爵领、1085年并入蒙塔奈子爵领，1194年又取得奥尔泰兹伯国。在阿拉贡、英格兰和法兰西诸王之间周旋的贝阿恩，于1290年因子爵加斯东七世的女继承人玛格丽特嫁给富瓦伯爵罗歇-贝尔纳三世而转入富瓦伯爵家族。1337年的领主是富瓦-贝阿恩的加斯东二世，他同时也是富瓦伯爵。其子加斯东三世·费比斯趁克雷西战役后的乱局，于1347年宣称自己的贝阿恩得自上帝、不属世间任何人，使贝阿恩成为事实上的主权亲王国。费比斯绝嗣后，贝阿恩转入格拉伊家族，其继承人成为纳瓦拉国王，并于1464年把宫廷从奥尔泰兹迁到波城；法王亨利四世就出生在波城城堡，而贝阿恩直到1620年才正式并入法兰西王室。

en: Brunswick was the southern branch of the Welf Duchy of Brunswick-Lüneburg, centred on the old trading city of Brunswick on the Oker. After Emperor Frederick II enfeoffed Otto the Child with the duchy in 1235, his sons divided it in 1267 to 1269, and Albert the Tall received the Brunswick lands, from which the Grubenhagen and Göttingen lines later split off. In 1337 the Brunswick principality was held by Otto the Mild, who had inherited with his brothers in 1318 and briefly held the Altmark before selling it in 1343. Weary of strife with the citizens of Brunswick, the dukes moved their residence to the water castle of Wolfenbüttel in 1432, and from 1495 the state was called Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel. In the Hildesheim Diocesan Feud of 1519 to 1523 it won large territories despite defeat at the Battle of Soltau. During the Thirty Years' War Wolfenbüttel was the strongest fortress in northern Germany, though the old ducal line died out in the conflict; Duke Augustus the Younger then founded the New House of Brunswick and built the largest library in Europe. In 1671 the Welfs finally subdued the self-governing city of Brunswick, and the court returned there in 1753. Occupied by France in 1807 and absorbed into the Kingdom of Westphalia, the state was re-established by the Congress of Vienna in 1815 as the Duchy of Brunswick.
zh: 不伦瑞克是韦尔夫家族不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公国的南部支系，以奥克河畔古老的商业城市不伦瑞克为中心。1235年皇帝腓特烈二世把公国封给孩童奥托后，其子于1267至1269年间分家，高个子阿尔贝特分得不伦瑞克领地，后来又从中分出格鲁本哈根和哥廷根支系。1337年，不伦瑞克侯国由温和者奥托掌领，他于1318年与诸弟共同继位，曾一度取得阿尔特马克，又在1343年将其售出。由于不堪与不伦瑞克市民的纷争，公爵们于1432年把居所迁往沃尔芬比特尔水堡，1495年起该邦定名为不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔。1519至1523年的希尔德斯海姆教区纷争中，它虽在索尔陶战役战败，却获得大片土地。三十年战争期间，沃尔芬比特尔是北德最坚固的要塞，但旧公爵世系也在战火中断绝；小奥古斯特公爵随后建立不伦瑞克新家族，并建成当时欧洲最大的图书馆。1671年韦尔夫家族终于压服自治的不伦瑞克城，宫廷也于1753年迁回该城。1807年它遭法国占领并并入威斯特伐利亚王国，维也纳会议于1815年将其重建为不伦瑞克公国。

en: The Principality of Bryansk was a Rus principality of the thirteenth to fifteenth centuries, centered on Bryansk on the Desna, a fortified town first mentioned in 1146 as an outpost of the princes of Chernihiv. After the Mongols destroyed Vshchizh in 1238, Bryansk became the capital of a wide principality taking in Chernihiv, Novgorod-Seversk, Starodub and Trubchevsk, ruled by Roman Mikhailovich and his descendants, who bore the title of grand prince of Chernihiv; Roman repelled an attack by the Lithuanian king Mindaugas in 1263. In the early fourteenth century the throne passed through marriage to the Rostislavichi of Smolensk, whose succession feuds drew in the Golden Horde. In 1337 Gleb Svyatoslavich of that line held Bryansk, but he was killed by its citizens in 1340. The Lithuanian grand duke Algirdas seized the city in 1356, and after decades of changing rule between Lithuania and Moscow, Bryansk troops fought at Kulikovo in 1380. Ivan III finally took Bryansk for Moscow in 1500.
zh: 布良斯克公国是13至15世纪的罗斯公国，以杰斯纳河畔的布良斯克为中心；这座设防城镇最早在1146年作为切尔尼戈夫王公的前哨见于记载。1238年蒙古人摧毁夫希日后，布良斯克成为一个幅员辽阔的公国的都城，领有切尔尼戈夫、诺夫霍罗德-西韦尔斯基、斯塔罗杜布和特鲁布切夫斯克，由罗曼·米哈伊洛维奇及其后裔统治，他们世袭切尔尼戈夫大公的头衔；罗曼于1263年击退了立陶宛国王明道加斯的进攻。14世纪初，王位通过联姻转入斯摩棱斯克的罗斯季斯拉维奇家族之手，继承纷争把金帐汗国也卷入其中。1337年，该家族的格列布·斯维亚托斯拉维奇占据布良斯克，但他在1340年被布良斯克市民杀死。立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯于1356年攻占该城，此后数十年间统治权在立陶宛与莫斯科之间反复易手，布良斯克军队参加了1380年的库利科沃之战。1500年，伊凡三世最终为莫斯科夺取布良斯克。

en: The Duchy of Brzeg was a Silesian Piast principality on the left bank of the Oder, centered on Brzeg, a trading settlement first recorded in 1234 and granted Magdeburg town rights in 1248. The duchy itself was created in 1311, when the sons of Henry V the Fat divided the Duchy of Legnica into Wrocław, Legnica and Brzeg; Bolesław III the Generous, the eldest, unexpectedly chose the poorest share, Brzeg, for its cash compensation, and in 1329 he declared himself a vassal of King John of Bohemia. Bolesław died in 1352, and Brzeg remained a Bohemian fief ruled by his Piast descendants, reuniting with Legnica in 1419 before splitting again. In 1537 Duke Frederick II signed an inheritance treaty with Elector Joachim II Hector of Brandenburg, promising the duchy to the Hohenzollerns once the Piast line died out, but the Bohemian king Ferdinand I rejected the agreement. After 1526 the overlords were the Habsburgs as kings of Bohemia, and Brzeg, together with Legnica and Wołów, became one of the last autonomous Piast duchies, united under Duke Christian in 1664. When the last Piast, George William, died in 1675, the Habsburgs took direct control; Frederick II of Prussia later cited the disputed 1537 treaty as a pretext for the First Silesian War, and Brzeg passed to Prussia in 1742.
zh: 布热格公国是奥得河左岸的西里西亚皮亚斯特公国，以布热格城为中心；该城是1234年首见记载的贸易聚落，1248年获得马格德堡城市权。公国本身诞生于1311年，当时“胖子”亨利五世的儿子们把莱格尼察公国分为弗罗茨瓦夫、莱格尼察和布热格三份；长子博莱斯拉夫三世（“慷慨者”）出人意料地选了最穷的布热格，为的是取得现金补偿。1329年，他向波希米亚国王约翰称臣，布热格成为波希米亚采邑。博莱斯拉夫于1352年去世，布热格此后一直由他的皮亚斯特后裔统治，1419年与莱格尼察合并，后来又再度分裂。1537年，公爵腓特烈二世与勃兰登堡选帝侯约阿希姆二世（“赫克托尔”）签订继承条约，约定皮亚斯特世系断绝后公国归霍亨索伦家族，但波希米亚国王斐迪南一世拒绝承认。1526年以后，哈布斯堡家族以波希米亚国王的身份领有宗主权；布热格与莱格尼察、沃武夫一起成为最后几个自治的皮亚斯特公国，1664年在公爵克里斯蒂安治下重新合并。1675年末代皮亚斯特格奥尔格·威廉去世，哈布斯堡家族直接接管；后来普鲁士的腓特烈二世以这份有争议的1537年条约为借口发动第一次西里西亚战争，布热格于1742年并入普鲁士。

en: Besançon occupies a closed meander of the Doubs in the Jura, on the site of Vesontio, the chief town of the Gallic tribe of the Sequani, which Julius Caesar described in 58 BC and which remained one of the great cities of Roman Gaul. A Christian archbishopric from the fourth century, it entered the Holy Roman Empire in 1034 and was designated a free imperial city by Emperor Frederick Barbarossa in 1184; after a century of strife with its archbishops, who became imperial princes in 1288, the emperor confirmed the city's independence in 1290. Governed by its own magistracy, Besançon accepted outside protectors rather than masters: the dukes of Burgundy in the fifteenth century and, after Mary of Burgundy married Maximilian in 1477, the Habsburgs. It kept its imperial status even when the surrounding Franche-Comté passed to Spain with Philip II in 1555, and in 1526 it won the right to mint its own coin. That autonomy ended when the city lost its imperial status in 1651, confirmed under Spanish pressure in 1654. Louis XIV's troops first took it in 1668 but handed it back at Aix-la-Chapelle; they returned in 1674, the king abolished the municipal government in 1676, and the Treaty of Nijmegen in 1678 confirmed Besançon to France, which made it the administrative capital of Franche-Comté.
zh: 贝桑松位于汝拉山区杜河的一道封闭河曲中，所在之地古称韦松蒂奥，是高卢塞卡尼人的主城，尤利乌斯·恺撒在公元前58年的《高卢战记》中记述过它，罗马治下它仍是高卢的重镇之一。4世纪起这里成为基督教总主教区，1034年并入神圣罗马帝国，1184年被皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨定为帝国自由市；与1288年成为帝国诸侯的总主教们争斗一个世纪后，皇帝于1290年确认了城市的独立。贝桑松由自己的市政机构治理，只接受外部保护者而非主人：15世纪是勃艮第公爵，1477年勃艮第的玛丽嫁给马克西米利安之后则是哈布斯堡家族。1555年周边的弗朗什-孔泰随腓力二世转归西班牙，城市仍保住帝国自由市身份，并于1526年取得铸币权。这份自治在1651年终结：在西班牙压力下，它于1654年确认丧失帝国城市地位。路易十四的军队1668年首次攻占该城，但依《亚琛条约》退还；1674年法军再度占领，国王于1676年废除市政府，1678年的《奈梅亨条约》确认贝桑松归属法国，法国随后把它设为弗朗什-孔泰的行政首府。

en: The Besüd were a clan of the Nirun Mongols, already named in the Secret History of the Mongols as a small lineage attached to the powerful Tayichiud. Their most famous son was Jebe, the warrior who once wounded Genghis Khan in battle, surrendered and became one of the Four Hounds, the khan's most feared generals, campaigning across northern China and Persia. Besüd mingghan units were distributed among the imperial family after 1206, and branches of the clan followed the Mongol armies west. One branch settled in the mountains of central Afghanistan, in the region around modern Deh Kundi and Behsud, where it became one of the principal tribes of the Hazaras under the name Behsudi; their nomadic forebears wintered toward Jalalabad and summered in the Hazarajat. Other Besüd groups survived among the Khalkha and Ordos Mongols and the Kalmyks, while the Afghan branch kept the clan's name alive in the Hazara tribal structure.
zh: 别速惕是尼伦蒙古的一支，《蒙古秘史》中已有记载，本是依附强大泰赤乌氏的弱小氏族。该部最著名的人物是哲别：他曾在战场上射伤铁木真，归降后受成吉思汗赏识，成为“四犬”之一，随大军征战华北与波斯。1206年编组千户后，别速惕部众被分予黄金家族各支，其中一支随蒙古大军西征，定居在今阿富汗中部德昆迪和贝苏德一带的山区，后来以“贝苏迪”之名成为哈扎拉人的主要部落之一，其游牧先民冬季前往贾拉拉巴德、夏季返回哈扎拉贾特度夏。其余别速惕人则融入喀尔喀、鄂尔多斯蒙古人和卡尔梅克人之中，而阿富汗支系在哈扎拉部落结构里延续了这个古老氏族的名字。

en: Beeskow-Starkow represents the twin lordship of Beeskow and Storkow in Lower Lusatia, a chain of water castles on the Spree held in the fourteenth century by the lords of Strele. Originally imperial ministeriales from Strehla on the Elbe in the service of the Wettin margraves, the Strele had moved north to guard the Lusatian frontier against the Ascanians and the Wends, and they built Beeskow up as a planned town and a mint, its castle first documented in 1316. With no male heirs the line died out in 1384, and the lordship passed by inheritance to the lords of Bieberstein. In 1518 Ulrich von Bieberstein mortgaged it to the bishop of Lebus, who turned Beeskow castle into an episcopal residence; in 1556 it fell to Margrave John of Brandenburg-Kustrin, and in 1575 to the electors of Brandenburg. Held for most of its history as a Bohemian fief, the lordship was only annexed by Prussia in 1742.
zh: 贝斯科即贝斯科与施托尔科双领地，位于下卢萨蒂亚，是施普雷河畔一串水上城堡组成的边防领地，14世纪时为施特雷勒家族所领有。该家族本是易北河畔施特雷拉的帝国陪臣，世代为韦廷藩侯效力，后来北迁守卫卢萨蒂亚边境，抵御阿斯坎尼家族和文德人；他们把贝斯科建设成规划城镇和铸币地，其城堡于1316年首次见于文献。施特雷勒家族男丁在1384年断绝，领地由比伯施泰因家族继承。1518年，乌尔里希·冯·比伯施泰因把领地抵押给莱布斯主教，后者将贝斯科城堡改为主教官邸；1556年它落入勃兰登堡‑屈斯特林藩侯约翰之手，1575年最终归勃兰登堡选侯所有。这片领地在历史上长期是波希米亚的封地，直到1742年才被普鲁士吞并。

en: Boussouma was one of the five principal Mossi kingdoms, alongside Ouagadougou, Tenkodogo, Fada N'gourma and Yatenga, and its ruling line traced itself back to the horseman Ouédraogo and the princess Yennenga, ancestors of all the Mossi dynasties. As the Mossi states built up their power from the 1200s, the line holding the Sandbondtenga country emerged as a separate monarchy, in north-central parts of what is now Burkina Faso, around the towns of Boussouma and Mané. Its oldest capital was Korsimoro, which kept the royal tombs, the royal market and the council that enthroned each new king, and the king's chief ministers held their estates there. The ruler, titled naba like the other Mossi kings, was independent of the Mogho Naaba of Ouagadougou and received the allegiance of the canton and village chiefs at annual festivals such as the Naab Kitoiga, when the royal regalia were displayed. The unbroken line of rulers had reached thirty-one kings by modern times, marking Boussouma as one of the durable Mossi monarchies of the Volta basin.
zh: 布苏马是五大莫西王国之一，与瓦加杜古、滕科多戈、法达恩古尔马和亚滕加并列，其王统追溯到所有莫西王朝的共同祖先——骑手韦德拉奥果与公主延嫩加。13世纪起莫西诸邦逐渐积蓄力量，占据桑邦滕加地区的这一支也成为独立的君主国，领土在今布基纳法索中北部，以布苏马和马内等城镇为中心。最早的都城是科尔西莫罗，那里保存着历代王陵、王家市场以及拥立新王的议事会，国王的主要大臣也都在当地领有封地。统治者与其他莫西君主一样称纳巴，独立于瓦加杜古的莫戈·纳巴之外；每年纳布·基托加等节庆期间，各县长和村长前来宣誓效忠，王家风仪器物也会公开展示。到近代，布苏马的王统已连续传承三十一代国王，是沃尔特河流域存续最久的莫西君主国之一。

en: Bilaspur, long known as Kahlur, was a Chandel Rajput kingdom in the hills above the Sutlej, whose rajas claimed descent from Sisupala of the Lunar dynasty. Tradition places its foundation in about 697 under Raja Bir Chand, and after Raja Kahal Chand built Kahlur Fort around 900 the state and its Kahluria dynasty took their name from it. The seat moved from Jandbari to the fort and finally, under Dip Chand in the 1660s, to the town of Bilaspur. Raja Bhim Chand defeated a Mughal army at the Battle of Nadaun and stood high among the hill rajas before abdicating in 1692; his son Ajmer Chand spent a forty-year reign extending his overlordship over more than a dozen neighbouring states. Their tribute melted away during the eighteenth century, until by 1790 only Mangal still acknowledged Kahlur, though the court became a noted patron of Kangra painting. In 1815 Raja Mahan Chand placed the state under British protection as one of the Simla Hill States.
zh: 比拉斯布尔旧称卡卢尔，是萨特莱杰河上游山区的钱代尔拉杰普特王国，其罗阇自称是月族童护的后裔。相传王国由罗阇比尔·昌德建于697年前后；约900年罗阇卡哈尔·昌德修筑贾罗尔堡后，邦国与卡卢里亚王朝皆由此得名。治所先在詹德巴里，后迁入堡中，最终在17世纪60年代迪普·昌德时迁至比拉斯布尔城。罗阇比姆·昌德在纳道恩之战中击败莫卧儿军队，1692年退位修行前已是诸山邦罗阇中的翘楚；其子阿杰梅尔·昌德在位四十年，将宗主权扩张到十余个邻邦。18世纪间这些贡邦纷纷离散，到1790年只剩曼加尔仍承认卡卢尔的宗主权，不过其宫廷也以赞助冈格拉画派闻名。1815年，罗阇马汉·昌德将本邦置于英国保护之下，成为西姆拉山邦之一。

en: Bastar was a forest kingdom in the hills of south-eastern Gondwana, in the region remembered in the Ramayana as Dandakaranya and earlier ruled by Nala kings such as Bhavadatta Varman around 450. The state was founded around 1324 by Annamadeva, a Telugu warrior who fled Warangal after the fall of the Kakatiya dynasty and set up his seat at Bastar under the protection of the goddess Danteshwari, whose temple at Dantewada became the kingdom's holy centre. His Nagavamsi successors, Hamir Deva and Bhaitai Deva among them, ruled through the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, when Bastar split into two kingdoms, the other centred on Kanker. The capital was later moved from old Bastar to Jagdalpur on the Indravati, and the Halba people trace their origins to the soldiery of these kingdoms. Bastar kept its independence until the Marathas overran Gondwana in the eighteenth century.
zh: 巴斯塔尔是冈瓦纳东南部山区的森林王国，这一带在《罗摩衍那》中被称为丹达卡兰亚，约450年前后曾由那罗国王婆瓦达多·筏尔曼等人统治。约1324年，泰卢固武士阿南马提婆在卡卡提亚王朝灭亡后逃离瓦朗加尔，在丹特什瓦里女神的护佑下定都巴斯塔尔，建立此邦；位于丹特瓦达的丹特什瓦里神庙由此成为王国的圣地中心。他的那伽瓦姆沙继承者——包括哈密尔·提婆和拜太·提婆——在14、15世纪相继统治，其间巴斯塔尔分裂为两个王国，另一支以甘盖尔为中心。都城后来从旧都巴斯塔尔迁至因德拉瓦蒂河畔的贾格达尔布尔，哈尔巴人便自称源出这些王国的军人阶层。巴斯塔尔一直保持独立，直到18世纪马拉塔人席卷冈瓦纳。

en: Bantaeng was a small Makassarese kingdom on the southern coast of Celebes, formed in 1254 when the rulers of seven local chiefdoms, each titled Kare, agreed to merge their lands under a first king, Mula Tau, called To Toa. Its customary council, the Adat Sampuloruwa, made the kingdom's law, and after the court moved from Onto to Karatuang its rulers took the title Karaeng, assisted by a chief minister titled Gallarang. The Majapahit poem Negarakertagama of 1365 records Bantayan, as Bantaeng was then called, among the peninsular powers within Gajah Mada's sphere, and in 1337 it was still a pagan rice-farming polity on the eastern spice route, exchanging its surplus rice for Chinese ceramics at river ports such as Gantarang Keke. In the mid-sixteenth century the expanding kingdom of Gowa, under Karaeng Tunipalangga, seized this rival port and shipbuilding centre, after which Bantaeng served Gowa as its granary and eastern bulwark; Wajo merchants settled in its towns to handle the trade. When Gowa adopted Islam in 1605 Bantaeng followed under its fourteenth king, Karaeng Ma'jombeyya, and in 1666, during the Dutch war on Gowa, Cornelis Speelman burned roughly a hundred rice boats lying off its coast.
zh: 班塔恩是苏拉威西南海岸的望加锡人小王国，1254年，七个地方酋长邦的首领（各称卡雷）商定合并土地，共奉第一位国王穆拉·道（称号托·托阿）而建国。王国的传统议事会“桑普鲁瓦习俗会”负责制定法律，宫廷从翁托迁往卡拉图昂后，统治者改用卡朗称号，由称号加拉朗的首席大臣辅佐。1365年满者伯夷的史诗《爪哇史颂》把当时称班塔延的班塔恩列入加查·玛达势力范围内的半岛强权；1337年时它仍是信奉本土信仰的稻米政权，位于东部香料商路上，在甘塔朗凯凯等河港用富余的稻米交换中国瓷器。16世纪中叶，扩张中的戈瓦王国在卡朗·图尼帕朗加治下夺取了这个与之竞争的港口和造船中心，班塔恩从此成为戈瓦的粮仓和东部屏障，瓦乔商人进驻其城镇经营贸易。1605年戈瓦改奉伊斯兰教后，班塔恩在第十四位国王卡朗·马宗贝治下随之改宗；1666年荷兰对戈瓦开战期间，科内利斯·斯佩尔曼在其外海焚毁了约一百艘运米船。

en: Batang was a Khampa chiefdom on the fertile Batang plain in the lower Jinsha River valley, in present-day western Sichuan, whose Tibetan name means a grassland of sheep. In Han times a Qiang people known as the White Wolf formed a kingdom there, until the Tibetan Empire absorbed it in 667; under the Yuan it was organised as a pacification office, and between 1568 and 1639 the Naxi chiefs of Lijiang controlled it with Ming backing. After Güshi Khan's Khoshut Mongols conquered Kham, Batang was ruled by a Mongol-appointed steward until 1719, when the Qing army advancing on Tibet received its submission. The Qing then set up a grain station and appointed local headmen as the principal and vice tusi of Batang, and the border settlement of 1726 assigned the district to Sichuan, with a boundary pillar raised near the town. By 1764 more than eighty Chinese merchant houses had settled there, and Batang became the key staging post on the Sichuan-Tibet road.
zh: 巴塘是金沙江上游低谷中的康巴酋长政权，地在今四川省西部，藏语意为羊群遍布的草坝。汉代时当地羌人建有白狼国，667年被吐蕃吞并；元代设巴塘招讨司，1568至1639年间，丽江的纳西族木氏土司在明朝支持下统治此地。和硕特蒙古的固始汗征服康区后，巴塘由蒙古委任的第巴掌管，直到1719年清军入藏途经此地，巴塘第巴喀木布投降。清朝随即在巴塘设立粮台，任命当地头人为巴塘正、副土司；1726年勘定川滇藏边界，巴塘正式划归四川，并在镇外立有界碑。到1764年，当地汉商已达八十余家，巴塘成为川藏大道上的咽喉要站。

en: Tellīs was the emirate of the Banu Tellis, a Hawwara Berber dynasty of the steppes of central Tripolitania, whose seat was the walled town of Tellīs, the present-day Bani Walid, lying inland between Tripoli and the Gulf of Sirte. It was founded in 1228 by the Kairouan scholar Ahmed ibn Tellis, who settled in the Wadi Bani Walid and drew the local Hawwara Berbers and Hilalian Arab clans around him. Tradition remembered him as a builder who dug more than three hundred wells, raised palaces and Sufi lodges, and made the emirate a centre of learning as well as of farming, pottery and the caravan trade, with Masalata as its second city. The Banu Tellis ruled the mixed Berber and Arab population of the Misrata and Sirte hinterland under the loose overlordship of the Hafsids of Tunis. They repelled a Spanish attack on Masalata after 1510, and their last prince Ali II held out against the Ottomans for twenty-six years, until an Ottoman army with local tribal allies stormed Qasr Banu Tellis in 1603, burned the capital and largely destroyed the ruling house, after which the district passed under obscure local sheikhs.
zh: 泰利斯是巴努泰利斯家族的酋长国，属豪瓦拉柏柏尔王朝，盘踞在的黎波里塔尼亚中部草原，都城泰利斯即今拜尼沃利德，位于的黎波里与苏尔特湾之间的内陆。1228年，来自凯鲁万的学者艾哈迈德·伊本·泰利斯到拜尼沃利德河谷定居，把当地豪瓦拉柏柏尔人和希拉尔系阿拉伯部落聚集在身边。相传他主持开凿了三百多口水井，修建宫殿和苏菲道堂，使酋长国成为学术中心，农业、制陶和商队贸易也十分兴盛，马斯拉塔是它的第二大城。巴努泰利斯家族在突尼斯哈夫斯王朝的松散宗主权下，统治米苏拉塔和苏尔特腹地柏柏尔与阿拉伯杂处的居民。1510年之后西班牙人进攻马斯拉塔被他们击退；末代君主阿里二世与奥斯曼人周旋了二十六年，直到1603年奥斯曼军队联合本地部落攻陷盖斯尔泰利斯，焚毁都城并几乎屠灭统治家族，此后这一地区便由名不见经传的本地小谢赫们分治。

en: Buton was a kingdom on the island of the same name off the southeast coast of Sulawesi, whose waters and islets were known locally as Liwuto Pataanguna, the Four Islands. The islands appear in the fourteenth-century Javanese poem Nagarakretagama and in Gajah Mada's Palapa oath, marking them as within Majapahit's sphere of influence. Local tradition holds that around the 1300s four leaders called the Mia Patamiana, said to have come from the Malay Peninsula, founded the settlement of Wolio in present-day Baubau, and that several small chiefdoms then joined to elect the first ruler, Queen Wa Kaa Kaa, whose husband was claimed to be of Majapahit descent. The kingdom converted to Islam under King La Kilaponto, who took the title Sultan Murhum Kaimuddin Khalifatul Khamis with the help of a scholar from Johor, and so became the Sultanate of Buton. Unusually for the region, it developed into a constitutional monarchy: the written constitution Murtabat Tujuh, formalized under Sultan La Elangi between 1597 and 1631, provided for legislature, judiciary and executive bodies. In the sixteenth century Baubau was ringed with heavy fortifications, whose remains survive as the Buton Palace Fortress, and the sultanate eventually passed under Dutch administration by treaty.
zh: 布敦是苏拉威西东南近海同名岛屿上的王国，其周边水域与岛屿在当地被称为“四岛”（Liwuto Pataanguna）。这些岛屿已见于14世纪的爪哇史诗《爪哇史颂》和加查·马达的帕拉帕誓言，说明它们曾处在满者伯夷的势力范围内。当地传说约在14世纪，四名据称来自马来半岛的首领“米亚·帕塔米亚纳”建立了沃利奥聚落（今巴务巴务的一部分），随后若干小邦联合选出最早的统治者瓦·卡卡女王，她的丈夫被认为有满者伯夷血统。王国在拉·基拉蓬托国王治下皈依伊斯兰教，他在柔佛学者协助下称苏丹穆尔胡姆·凯穆丁·哈利法图尔·哈米斯，布敦由此成为苏丹国。与众不同的是，它发展为君主立宪制：成文宪法《七级典章》在苏丹拉·埃兰吉治下的1597至1631年间定型，设有立法、司法和行政机构。16世纪的巴务巴务修筑了坚固的城防，其遗存即今天的布敦王宫堡垒；苏丹国最终通过条约转入荷兰殖民当局管辖。

en: Butuan was a Hindu Bisaya lungsod, or polity, on the Agusan River in northeastern Mindanao, famed for its gold mines and goldsmiths and for the balangay outrigger boats excavated along its riverbanks. Chinese annals call it Puduan and record its first tributary mission to the Song court in 1001; its rajahs, including Kiling and Sri Bata Shaja, sent embassies that carried memorials engraved on gold tablets and traded with Champa, Brunei, Srivijaya, Majapahit and even Persia. Between the eleventh and thirteenth centuries it was the dominant port of the Caraga region, reaching into the eastern Visayas, until the Nanhai Zhi records its conquest by Brunei in 1304, after which it later regained its freedom. The Agusan Golden Tara reflects its Hindu-Buddhist culture, though by the sixteenth century Islam had made only superficial headway. In 1521 Rajah Siagu of Butuan and his brother Rajah Colambu of Limasawa met the Magellan expedition at the first Catholic mass in the islands. Spanish encomiendas were assigned in 1571, and a Jesuit mission founded in 1596, with the first church inaugurated in 1597, brought Butuan under colonial rule.
zh: 武端是棉兰老东北部阿古桑河畔的印度教米沙鄢城邦，以金矿、金匠工艺和河岸出土的巴兰盖舷外架木船闻名。中国史籍称其为蒲端，记载它于1001年首次向宋朝朝廷派遣朝贡使团；基灵、斯里·巴塔·沙贾等拉惹多次遣使，携刻字金表来华，并与占城、文莱、室利佛逝、满者伯夷乃至波斯通商。11至13世纪间，它是卡拉加地区首屈一指的港口，势力伸及米沙鄢东部；《南海志》记载它于1304年被文莱征服，后来才重获独立。阿古桑金度母像反映了当地的印度教与佛教文化，而到16世纪伊斯兰教的影响仍很表层。1521年，武端拉惹西亚古与其弟、利马萨瓦的拉惹科兰布在群岛上第一场天主教弥撒中会见了麦哲伦船队。1571年西班牙人将其划为监护征赋地，1596年耶稣会传教团到来，1597年第一座教堂落成，武端就此沦为殖民地。

en:
Büdingen was a small lordship in the Wetterau, east of Frankfurt, whose lords also held the burgraviate of nearby Gelnhausen. The place was first documented in 847 and its own House of Büdingen appeared in 1131, but died out with Gerlach II before 1247. After passing through the houses of Hohenlohe and Trimberg, the lordship came to the Isenburgs, a comital family originating in the Niederlahngau whose inheritance had been partitioned repeatedly since 1137. In 1330 Emperor Louis IV granted Büdingen market-town rights, and in 1353 Burgrave Heinrich II of Isenburg, the head of the house at the time, issued an edict of liberty that bound the townspeople to defend their walls through a marksmen's society.

From 1442 the rulers styled themselves counts of Isenburg-Büdingen, and Count Ludwig II ringed the town with a new wall of twenty-two towers between 1480 and 1510. Büdingen turned Protestant in 1521 and later Calvinist; witch trials claimed over a hundred lives in 1633 and 1634, when imperial troops stormed the town from its Swedish garrison during the Thirty Years' War. Count Ernst Casimir I issued an edict of tolerance in 1712, allowing Huguenots and Waldensians to settle outside the Lower Gate. The county was mediatized to the Principality of Isenburg in 1806 and assigned to Hesse-Darmstadt by the Congress of Vienna in 1816.
zh:
比丁根是法兰克福以东韦特劳地区的一个小领地，其领主还兼任附近盖尔恩豪森的城堡伯爵。该地最早见于847年的文献，本地的比丁根家族1131年首次登场，但在1247年前随格拉赫二世而绝嗣。领地经霍恩洛厄家族和特林姆贝格家族之手后归入伊森堡家族——这是一个发源于下拉恩高的伯爵家族，其遗产自1137年起一再分割。1330年皇帝路易四世授予比丁根集镇权；1353年，时任家族首领、伊森堡的城堡伯爵海因里希二世颁布自由敕令，规定市民须组成射手行会守卫城墙。

1442年起，统治者自称伊森堡-比丁根伯爵；路德维希二世伯爵在1480至1510年间绕城镇筑起一道拥有二十二座塔楼的新城墙。比丁根于1521年改宗新教，后来又信奉加尔文宗；1633至1634年的猎巫行动夺去一百多条人命，1634年三十年战争期间，帝国军队从瑞典守军手中攻占了该镇。1712年恩斯特·卡西米尔一世颁布宽容敕令，准许胡格诺派和韦尔多派在下门外定居。1806年该伯国被调停并入伊森堡亲王国，1816年维也纳会议又把它划归黑森-达姆施塔特。

en: Buganda is the kingdom of the Baganda on the north-western shore of Lake Victoria, which the Ganda call Nalubaale, a country of green hills and reliable rains between the lake and the Victoria Nile. Oral tradition holds that Kato Kintu, a chief born in the Ssese Islands, united the local clans in the late thirteenth century and took the title of Kabaka, ruling from Nnono in Busujju; his son Chwa I Nabakka wore the crown in the mid-fourteenth century, and Chwa's exiled grandson Kimera founded the long line of later kings. In the sixteenth century a Bunyoro invasion killed the Kabaka Nakinge, but Buganda kept its independence and, as Bunyoro-Kitara weakened, turned to conquest under the Kabakas Kimbugwe, Katerega and Mutebi, taking Buddu and parts of Busoga and Karagwe while reducing Kooki to tribute. The armies of Kabaka Mawanda spread Ganda fear across the region, while the early nineteenth-century Kabaka Kamanya waged almost constant war, ruling through appointed chiefs, royal runners and talking drums over a state that had become an embryonic empire by 1837.
zh: 布干达是巴干达人的王国，位于维多利亚湖西北岸；巴干达人称该湖为纳卢巴莱。国土处在大湖与维多利亚尼罗河之间，丘陵青翠、雨水丰沛。口传传统称，出身塞塞群岛的首领卡托·金图于13世纪末统一当地诸氏族，采用卡巴卡称号，以布苏朱的诺诺为都；其子奇瓦一世·纳巴卡于14世纪中叶在位，而奇瓦被放逐的孙子基梅拉开创了此后漫长的王世。16世纪，布尼奥罗入侵并杀死卡巴卡纳金盖，但布干达保住了独立；随着布尼奥罗-基塔拉走向衰落，布干达在金布圭、卡特雷加和穆特比等卡巴卡治下转向扩张，夺取布杜、布索加和卡拉圭的部分土地，迫使科基纳贡。卡巴卡马万达的军队令四邻闻风丧胆，19世纪初的卡巴卡卡曼亚则几乎连年征战，他靠任命的酋长、王室信使和传话鼓治理国家，到1837年布干达已成为一个初具规模的帝国。

en: The Bulgaria of 1337 was the Second Bulgarian Empire, restored in 1185 when the brothers Asen and Peter rose against Byzantine rule and made Tarnovo their capital. Tsar Kaloyan crushed the Latin Empire at Adrianople in 1205, and under Ivan Asen II the realm stretched from the Adriatic to the Black Sea. Mongol, Serbian and Byzantine raids weakened it thereafter, and defeat at the Battle of Velbazhd in 1330 helped bring Ivan Alexander to the throne in 1331. He restored the frontiers after the Battle of Rusokastro in 1332 and presided over a literary and religious renaissance at Tarnovo, yet the Black Death and Ottoman raids sapped the empire, and before his death in 1371 he divided it among his sons, Ivan Shishman at Tarnovo and Ivan Sratsimir at Vidin. The Ottomans took Sofia in 1385, stormed Tarnovo in 1393 and annexed Vidin after the Battle of Nicopolis in 1396, ending the empire, though remnants of resistance held out until 1422.
zh: 1337年的保加利亚是保加利亚第二帝国：1185年阿森与彼得兄弟起兵反抗拜占庭统治、以特尔诺沃为都复国。沙皇卡洛扬于1205年在阿德里安堡重创拉丁帝国，伊凡·阿森二世在位时疆域从亚得里亚海延伸至黑海。此后蒙古、塞尔维亚和拜占庭的不断侵袭削弱了帝国，1330年维尔巴日德战役的败局促使伊凡·亚历山大于1331年登基。他在1332年鲁索卡斯特罗战役后恢复疆界，并在特尔诺沃迎来文学与宗教的复兴；然而黑死病和奥斯曼人的侵袭耗尽了国力，1371年他去世前又将帝国分给诸子——特尔诺沃的伊凡·希什曼和维丁的伊凡·斯拉齐米尔。奥斯曼人于1385年夺取索非亚，1393年攻陷特尔诺沃，1396年尼科波利斯战役后吞并维丁，帝国灭亡，残余抵抗一直坚持到1422年。

en: The Duchy of Burgundy, ruled from Dijon, grew out of the counties of the old Kingdom of the Burgundians, an East Germanic people who settled around Dijon and Chalon-sur-Saône in the fifth century. Richard the Justiciar is the first ruler attested as duke in 918, and in 1032 King Robert II of France made the duchy an appanage for his younger son Robert, ancestor of the ducal House of Burgundy, a cadet branch of the Capetians. In 1337 Duke Odo IV of this line still held the duchy as a French appanage. When Duke Philip I died without male heirs in 1361, the duchy reverted to the crown, and in 1363 John II granted it to his younger son Philip the Bold, whose marriage to Margaret III of Flanders founded the Valois-Burgundy state. Further acquisitions of Flanders, the County of Burgundy, Holland and Luxembourg gave the Valois dukes a chain of lands from the Alps to the North Sea. The last duke, Charles the Bold, was killed at the Battle of Nancy in 1477; Louis XI of France then absorbed the duchy itself, while the Low Country possessions passed to Charles's daughter Mary and her Habsburg descendants.
zh: 勃艮第公国以第戎为都，其疆域脱胎于古勃艮第王国的诸伯国；勃艮第人是5世纪定居在第戎和索恩河畔沙隆一带的东日耳曼部族。918年的理查是史料中首位称公爵的统治者，1032年法兰西国王罗贝尔二世把公国作为封禄赐给幼子罗贝尔，其后代即卡佩家族的支系勃艮第公爵家族。1337年在位的厄德四世仍以法兰西封禄公爵的身份领有此地。1361年公爵腓力一世无男嗣而终，公国被王室收回；1363年约翰二世把它转封给幼子大胆的腓力，后者通过与佛兰德斯女伯爵玛格丽特三世的婚姻开创了瓦卢瓦-勃艮第国家。此后又陆续取得佛兰德斯、勃艮第伯国、荷兰和卢森堡，瓦卢瓦公爵们的领地从阿尔卑斯山一直连到北海。末代公爵大胆的查理于1477年在南锡战役中阵亡，法兰西国王路易十一随即吞并公国本土，而低地的领地则传给查理的女儿玛丽及其哈布斯堡后裔。

en: Barus, also called Fansur in Arabic sources, was a port kingdom on the western coast of North Sumatra, facing the Indian Ocean. It appears in Ptolemy's Geography in the second century as the Barousai islands, and the Tang pilgrim Yijing knew it as Polushi, where monks of the Mulasarvastivada school practiced; the New Book of Tang calls it the western half of the double kingdom of Srivijaya. Its fame rested on camphor, called kapur barus after the town: the Persian writer Sulaiman praised Fansur camphor in 851, Zhao Rugua listed Binsu among camphor-producing countries in his Zhu Fan Zhi, and Marco Polo judged Fansur camphor the finest in the world, sold for its weight in gold. A Tamil inscription of 1088, the Lobu Tua stone, attests a Tamil trading community there, and a Batak chronicle records that the town relocated three times along the coast. The Nagarakretagama of 1365 numbers Barus among Majapahit's Malay vassals. In the early sixteenth century Tomé Pires still described the very rich kingdom of Baros, and the poet Hamzah Fansuri took his name from the town. Aceh absorbed it around the middle of the sixteenth century and posted a panglima there, until the Dutch East India Company ousted the Acehnese governor in 1668.
zh: 巴鲁斯在阿拉伯文献中又称泛涽，是北苏门答腊西海岸、面向印度洋的港口王国。2世纪托勒密的《地理学》已把它记为巴鲁赛群岛，唐代求法僧义净称其为婆鲁师洲，当地盛行说一切有部佛教；《新唐书》则把它称作室利佛逝这个“双头王国”的西半部分。它的名声来自樟脑，马来语把樟脑称为“巴鲁斯石灰”，名字便得自这座城镇：波斯作家苏莱曼在851年称赞泛涽樟脑，赵汝适的《诸蕃志》把宾窣列为樟脑产国，马可·波罗更称泛涽樟脑为天下第一，价值与等重黄金相当。1088年的泰米尔文洛布图阿铭文证明当地有泰米尔商人社群，一部巴塔克编年史还记载该城沿海岸三度迁徙。1365年的《爪哇史颂》把巴鲁斯列为满者伯夷的马来属邦之一。16世纪初托梅·皮莱资仍称它为“极富庶的巴鲁斯王国”，马来诗人哈姆扎·范苏里的名字也得自这座城镇。16世纪中叶前后，亚齐吞并巴鲁斯并派驻司令；1668年荷兰东印度公司赶走亚齐长官，控制了此地。

en: The Beniwal were a Jat clan of the arid Jangladesh region, the dry country of what is now northern Rajasthan, living under their own chiefs long before the Rathore expansion. Their name is said to derive from bani, meaning jungle, and they counted themselves Nagavanshi Jats; tradition brings their ancestors from the Salt Range in the Punjab into Jangladesh alongside kindred Jat clans such as the Sihag, Punia, Godara, Saran and Johiya. A chief named Raisal made Raslana the seat of Beniwal power. In 1337 the clan still held the tract around what later became Rawatsar, but in the fifteenth century Rao Bika's Rathore coalition overran Jangladesh and the Beniwal chieftains had to accept the suzerainty of Bikaner; their prolonged resistance to the Rathores in the following century earned the Beniwal their reputation as warriors.
zh: 贝尼瓦尔是干旱的禅伽罗德什地区的一支贾特人部族，活动在今拉贾斯坦北部的干燥乡野，在拉托尔人扩张之前长期由本族首领治理。其族名据说源自意为丛林的 bani，自认属于那伽族系的贾特人；传说祖先从旁遮普的盐岭迁入禅伽罗德什，与锡哈格、普尼亚、戈达拉、萨兰、卓希亚等贾特支系同行，一位名叫赖萨尔的首领还以拉斯拉纳作为贝尼瓦尔的统治中心。1337年时，贝尼瓦尔人仍占据着后来拉瓦察尔城一带的土地；15世纪拉奥·比卡率领拉托尔联军征服禅伽罗德什，贝尼瓦尔首领被迫接受比卡内尔的宗主权，此后一个世纪里他们与拉托尔人长期对抗，也赢得了善战之名。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Brixen was an ecclesiastical principality of the Holy Roman Empire in the Eisack valley of the Tyrol, the successor of the ancient bishopric of Säben, whose first documented bishop, Ingenuinus, lived around 580. The see was moved to Brixen in the late tenth century, and Bishop Hartwig fortified the new town and raised it to city rank. Emperor Conrad II granted the bishops immediate lordship over the Norital in 1027, Henry IV added the Puster Valley in 1091, and Frederick Barbarossa conferred the title of prince of the Empire in 1179. At the synod of Brixen in 1080 the imperialist bishops declared Pope Gregory VII deposed and raised up the antipope Clement III. In later centuries much of the temporal territory was enfeoffed away to the Counts of Tyrol, and the Habsburgs came to overshadow the see; Cardinal Nicholas of Cusa, bishop from 1450, was even imprisoned by Archduke Sigismund. A peasants' revolt swept the valley in 1525, yet with Habsburg support the Catholic faith was preserved against the Reformation. In 1337 the bishop was Matthäus an der Gassen. The principality was secularized to Austria in 1803, briefly passed to Bavaria after the Peace of Pressburg in 1805, and returned to Austria in 1814.
zh: 布里克森采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国在蒂罗尔埃萨克河谷的教会邦国，前身是古老的萨本主教区，其最早见于记载的主教因格维努斯约在580年在任。10世纪末主教座堂迁至布里克森，主教哈特维希修筑城防，将其提升为城市。1027年皇帝康拉德二世授予主教对诺里塔尔的直辖领主权，1091年亨利四世又添赐普斯特河谷，1179年腓特烈一世·巴巴罗萨授予主教帝国亲王头衔。1080年的布里克森会议上，亲皇帝的主教们宣布废黜教宗格列高利七世，并拥立对立教宗克雷芒三世。此后大量世俗领地被分封给蒂罗尔伯爵，哈布斯堡家族的势力逐渐凌驾于主教区之上；1450年出任主教的库萨的尼古拉甚至被奥地利大公西吉斯蒙德囚禁。1525年农民战争席卷河谷，但在哈布斯堡支持下，天主教信仰抵挡住了宗教改革。1337年在任的主教是马特乌斯·安·德·加森。1803年主教区被世俗化并入奥地利，1805年《普雷斯堡和约》后短暂划归巴伐利亚，1814年重回奥地利。

en: The Duchy of Bytom, known in German as Beuthen, was an Upper Silesian duchy with its capital at Bytom, created around 1281 when the sons of Duke Władysław of Opole divided the Duchy of Opole and Racibórz. Its first Piast duke, Casimir, became in 1289 the first Silesian Piast to place himself under Bohemian overlordship. In 1337 the ruler was Władysław of Bytom, who had reunited the family lands of Bytom, Koźle and Toszek, and in 1327 had paid homage to King John of Bohemia at Opava; chronic money troubles nonetheless made him sell Siewierz to Cieszyn and pledge Toszek to Opole that same year. During the Polish-Bohemian war of 1345 to 1348 he briefly sided with the Polish king before returning to the Bohemian alliance. When his son Bolesław died without heirs in 1355 the Bytom Piast line ended and the duchy was split, Koźle going to Oleśnica and the rest to Cieszyn, until it was reunited under Oleśnica in 1459. Matthias Corvinus of Hungary seized it in 1472, and in 1498 Bytom was absorbed into the Duchy of Opole; after a Hohenzollern interlude it became a Habsburg state country following the Battle of White Mountain in 1620 and passed to Prussia in 1742.
zh: 比托姆公国（德语称博伊滕）是上西里西亚的公国，都于比托姆，约1281年奥波莱公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫的儿子们瓜分奥波莱-拉齐布日公国时形成。首任皮亚斯特公爵卡齐米尔于1289年成为第一位接受波希米亚宗主权的西里西亚皮亚斯特公爵。1337年在位的是比托姆的瓦迪斯瓦夫，他重新统一了家族领地比托姆、科伊兹莱和托谢克，并已于1327年在奥帕瓦向波希米亚国王约翰行臣服礼；但由于常年财政拮据，他在这一年把谢维日卖给切申，又把托谢克抵押给奥波莱。1345年至1348年波兰与波希米亚交战期间，他一度站在波兰国王一边，战后又重新倒向波希米亚。1355年他的儿子博莱斯瓦夫无嗣而终，比托姆的皮亚斯特支系断绝，公国被瓜分：科伊兹莱归奥莱希尼察，其余归切申，直到1459年才在奥莱希尼察治下重新统一。匈牙利国王马加什·科尔温于1472年夺取它，1498年比托姆被并入奥波莱公国；经过霍亨索伦家族的一段统治后，它在1620年白山战役后成为哈布斯堡的直属领地，并于1742年转归普鲁士。

en: The Byzantine Empire, or Eastern Roman Empire, was the Greek-speaking continuation of Rome, ruled from Constantinople, the capital founded by Constantine I in the fourth century. Justinian I reconquered Italy and much of the western Mediterranean in the sixth century, but the Arab conquests of the 630s stripped away Syria, Egypt and Africa. The Macedonian dynasty brought a long revival, crowned when Basil II subdued Bulgaria by 1018, while the defeat at Manzikert in 1071 opened Asia Minor to the Seljuk Turks. The Komnenian emperors restored the state for a century, until the Fourth Crusade sacked Constantinople in 1204 and partitioned the empire into Latin and Greek rump states. Michael VIII Palaiologos recovered the city in 1261, yet his dynasty ruled only a regional power: Andronikos II disbanded the fleet in 1285, and civil wars between 1321 and 1354 drained the treasury. In 1337 Andronikos III still retook Epirus, but after 1354 the Ottoman Turks crossed into Europe, taking Thessalonica in 1387 and besieging the capital. Timur's victory over Sultan Bayezid at Ankara in 1402 granted a reprieve, and John VIII sought union with the Catholic Church at the Council of Florence. Mehmed II then stormed Constantinople on 29 May 1453; the last emperor, Constantine XI, died fighting on the walls and the millennium-old empire came to an end.
zh: 拜占庭帝国又称东罗马帝国，是罗马帝国在东部希腊语世界的延续，以4世纪君士坦丁一世营建的君士坦丁堡为都。6世纪查士丁尼一世一度收复意大利和西地中海大片地区，但7世纪30年代阿拉伯人的征服夺去了叙利亚、埃及和阿非利加。马其顿王朝带来长期复兴，巴西尔二世于1018年攻灭保加利亚；1071年曼齐刻尔特之战的惨败则把小亚细亚向塞尔柱突厥人敞开。科穆宁王朝让帝国中兴了一个世纪，直到1204年第四次十字军洗劫君士坦丁堡，将领土肢解为拉丁政权与希腊人残余政权。米哈伊尔八世·巴列奥略于1261年收复都城，但他的王朝只统治着一个地区性强国：安德洛尼卡二世于1285年解散舰队，1321至1354年间的连场内战耗尽国库。1337年安德洛尼卡三世尚能收复伊庇鲁斯，但1354年后奥斯曼突厥人跨入欧洲，1387年夺取塞萨洛尼基并围攻都城。1402年帖木儿在安卡拉击败苏丹巴耶济德一世，为帝国争得喘息；约翰八世又在佛罗伦萨公会议上谋求与天主教会合一。穆罕默德二世随后于1453年5月29日攻陷君士坦丁堡，末代皇帝君士坦丁十一世战死于城墙之上，延续千年的帝国就此终结。

en: Beisheng was a prefecture on the Jinsha River in north-western Yunnan, the country around modern Yongsheng. Under the Dali kingdom it was the Shanjun commandery, whose chief Gao Jun submitted to the Mongols in 1253; the Yuan created Shizhou in 1278, renamed it Beisheng in 1280 and raised it to a prefecture in 1287. The Ming reduced it to a sub-prefecture in 1382, placed it under the Lancang Guard in 1393 and moved its seat into the guard city in 1496. A great earthquake in 1515, estimated at close to magnitude eight, threw down the north-western stretch of the walls and destroyed more than fifteen hundred houses. Abolished during the late Ming Tianqi reign, Beisheng was restored under the Qing, becoming an independent sub-prefecture in 1692, Yongbei Prefecture in 1698 and the Yongbei independent department in 1770.
zh: 北胜是滇西北金沙江畔的土府，辖地约当今永胜一带。大理国时为善巨郡，1253年善巨酋长高俊内附蒙古；1278年元朝置施州，1280年改名北胜州，1287年升为北胜府。1382年明朝降为北胜州，1393年改属澜沧卫，1496年又把治所迁进澜沧卫城。1515年这里发生估计接近八级的大地震，州城西北城墙倾塌，民房倒塌一千五百余间，大片田亩陷落成湖。北胜在明末天启年间被废，清代恢复建置，1692年升为直隶州，1698年改设永北府，1770年再降为永北直隶厅。

en: The Kingdom of Bazin was one of the Beja polities recorded by the Arab historian al-Yaqubi in the ninth century, when Beja rule stretched from Aswan to the Red Sea coast around Massawa. Its heartland lay in the Gash lowlands in what is now western Eritrea, where the native Kunama, whom the Abyssinians called Bazen, made up most of the population and kept their traditional religion. The Aksumite inscription known as the Ezana Stone already recalls an Aksumite king defending the Bazin from raids by the Noba, and after the collapse of Aksum in 960 Beja clans founded several kingdoms on its former lands, Bazin among them. In al-Yaqubi's day Bazin was at war with the Nubian kingdom of Alodia. Its people combined farming with pastoralism, and roughly six hundred years later the early Beja kingdoms gave way to the Balaw kingdom of the southern Red Sea coast.
zh: 巴津王国是阿拉伯史学家雅库比在9世纪记载的贝贾政权之一，当时贝贾人的统治从阿斯旺一直延伸到马萨瓦一带的红海沿岸。它的核心地带在今厄立特里亚西部的加什低地，被阿比西尼亚人称为巴津人的土著库纳马人构成居民主体，仍保持传统信仰。称作埃扎纳石碑的阿克苏姆铭文早已提到，一位阿克苏姆国王曾庇护巴津人抵御诺巴人的袭扰；阿克苏姆于960年崩溃后，贝贾诸部在其故地上建立了包括巴津在内的若干王国。雅库比的时代，巴津正与努比亚的阿勒底亚王国交战。当地居民兼营农耕与畜牧，约六百年后，早期的贝贾诸王国被红海南岸的巴劳王国取代。

en: Bozhou was a mountainous chiefdom on the border of Sichuan, Guizhou and Huguang, centred on the walled town of Bozhou near present-day Zunyi. The Tang set up a prefecture here in 639, and in 876 the chief Yang Duan drove out a Nanzhao garrison and founded hereditary rule; modern scholarship judges the Yang to have been local Luo, or Yi, chieftains who gradually adopted Chinese culture, rather than the Taiyuan immigrants claimed in their own genealogy. Recognised in turn by the Song, the Mongols from 1277 and the Ming, the Yang governed as pacification commissioners over nineteen lesser native offices, and with Shuixi, Shuidong and Sizhou their chiefdom was counted one of the Four Great Chiefdoms of Guizhou. The last commissioner, Yang Yinglong, inherited in the early 1570s and rose in open revolt in 1590; a death sentence passed in 1593 was bought off with silver and an offer of troops for the Korean war, and fighting resumed once the Japanese withdrew. In 1600 Li Hualong sent eight armies, some 240,000 men, through the mountain passes and stormed the cliff fortress of Hailongtun, where Yang killed himself as the walls fell. The chiefdom was dissolved into the regular prefectures of Zunyi and Pingyue, ending twenty-nine generations and more than seven centuries of Yang rule.
zh: 播州是四川、贵州、湖广交界山区的土司政权，以今遵义附近的播州城为中心。639年唐朝在此置州，876年首领杨端逐走南诏驻军，建立世袭统治；学界考证认为，杨氏本是当地罗族（即彝族）的酋豪，后来逐渐汉化，族谱所称的太原出身实为后人附会。宋、元、明三代相继承认杨氏：1277年杨邦宪降元，其地设安抚司，后升宣抚司，统辖十九个长官司及各处苗峒；入明后仍世为宣慰使，与水西、水东、思州并称贵州四大土司。末代宣慰使杨应龙于16世纪70年代初袭职，1590年公开起兵；1593年他在重庆被判死罪，以献银和请缨赴朝参战赎罪，朝鲜战事一了便再度反叛。1600年，李化龙调集八路大军约24万人攻入山区，强攻悬崖上的海龙屯；城堡陷落时杨应龙自焚而死。播州随即改土归流，分设遵义、平越二府，杨氏二十九代、七百余年的统治至此终结。

en:
Chamba was one of the oldest Hindu hill states, holding the upper Ravi valley in the Punjab Hills from its ancient capital of Brahmapura, later called Bharmaur. Tradition names Maru Varman of the sixth century as its founder, and his Mushana Rajput dynasty, claiming Suryavanshi descent from Ayodhya, ruled without a break for more than a thousand years. Meru Varman enlarged it at Kullu's expense, and around 920 Sahila Varman moved the capital to the warmer plateau of Chamba. Its later Varman rajas fought Kullu, Kangra and Kashmir: Vijaya Varman used the late-twelfth-century turmoil in north-western India to annex neighbours, and Ganesa Varman, reigning from 1512 to 1559, built the fortress of Ganeshgarh.

Its mountain isolation shielded Chamba from the worst of the Muslim conquests. It accepted Mughal suzerainty only under Jahangir; after Raja Janardan's murder around 1623 Nurpur held it for twenty years, until Prithvi Singh restored the dynasty with Mandi and Suket's aid. Chattar Singh defied Aurangzeb's order to destroy Hindu temples and in 1690 joined a hill coalition that threw back a Mughal army. The later eighteenth century brought new conquests: Umed Singh recovered Rihlu in 1750, and Raj Singh took Banghal in 1778 and Bhaderwah in 1783 before falling to Kangra. From 1809 Chamba became a tributary of Ranjit Singh's Sikh Empire, ending the independence of its ancient ruling house.
zh:
昌巴是最古老的印度教山间土邦之一，雄踞旁遮普山丘的拉维河上游，古都为布拉马普拉，后称巴尔毛尔。按传统说法，6世纪的马鲁·瓦尔曼是开国之君，他的穆沙纳拉杰普特王朝自称出自阿约提亚的日族，此后连续统治了一千多年。梅鲁·瓦尔曼从古卢手中扩张领土；约920年，萨希拉·瓦尔曼把都城迁到气候更温暖的昌巴台地。此后历代瓦尔曼罗阇与古卢、冈格拉和克什米尔争战：维贾亚·瓦尔曼趁12世纪末印度西北部的动乱兼并邻邦，1512年至1559年在位的加内沙·瓦尔曼修建了加内什加尔堡垒。

深山的屏障使昌巴未遭穆斯林征服的严重破坏。它直到贾汉吉尔时期才接受莫卧儿宗主权；约1623年罗阇贾纳尔丹被刺后，国家被努尔布尔占据二十年，最后普里特维·辛格借曼迪和苏凯特之力复国。查塔尔·辛格拒绝执行奥朗则布捣毁印度教神庙的命令，并于1690年参加山地联军击退莫卧儿军队。18世纪后期昌巴再度扩张：乌梅德·辛格于1750年收复里卢，拉杰·辛格于1778年夺取邦加尔、1783年夺取巴德瓦，随后在与冈格拉的战争中阵亡。1809年起，昌巴向兰季德·辛格的锡克帝国纳贡，这个古老王朝的独立就此终结。

en: Cambrésis was a county of the Holy Roman Empire centred on the old Roman city of Cambrai, which had become a bishopric before the year 400. After the breakup of the Carolingian empire it passed with Lotharingia to the empire in 925, and in 1007 King Henry II vested the comital rights in the bishop of Cambrai, turning the county into a prince-bishopric like those of Liège and Utrecht; the city itself nevertheless won free imperial city status after repeated revolts against episcopal rule. In 1337 its ruler was Bishop Guillaume d'Auxonne, and two years later the Hundred Years' War reached his walls: Edward III of England laid siege to Cambrai in one of the earliest sieges where cannon are recorded, but the bishop sided with Philip VI of France and held out until the English withdrew in October 1339. From the fifteenth century the Duchy of Burgundy gained a firm grip on Cambrésis, and although Emperor Charles V reasserted imperial rights in 1529 and 1543, the little state remained a neutral bishopric under Habsburg garrison, formally belonging to the Lower Rhenish-Westphalian Circle rather than the Seventeen Provinces. French troops took Cambrai in 1677, and the Peace of Nijmegen of 1678 annexed Cambrésis to France; the French Revolution then dissolved the bishopric's temporal lands in 1789.
zh: 康布雷西斯是神圣罗马帝国的一个伯国，以古罗马城市康布雷为中心，该城在400年以前就已设有主教座。加洛林帝国分裂后，它随洛林于925年并入帝国；1007年国王亨利二世把伯国权利授予康布雷主教，使它像列日和乌得勒支一样成为采邑主教区，不过康布雷城在屡次反抗主教统治后，自身取得了帝国自由城市地位。1337年在位的是主教威廉·德·欧索讷，两年后百年战争的战火烧到他的城下：英格兰国王爱德华三世围攻康布雷，这是有史可考最早使用火炮的围城战之一，但主教选择站在法国国王腓力六世一边，坚守到1339年10月英军撤退。15世纪起勃艮第公国牢牢控制了康布雷西斯；皇帝查理五世虽在1529年和1543年两度重申帝国权利，这个小邦仍是驻有哈布斯堡守军的中立主教区，正式归属下莱茵—威斯特伐利亚行政圈，而非尼德兰十七省之一。1677年法军攻占康布雷，1678年的《奈梅亨和约》把康布雷西斯并入法国；1789年法国大革命又取消了主教区的世俗领地。

en: Castile grew out of a ninth-century frontier county of the Kingdom of León, whose count Fernán González made it autonomous in 931. It became a kingdom in its own right in 1065 and was joined with León from 1072 to 1157; the union became permanent in 1230, when Ferdinand III inherited León to add to the Castile he had held since 1217. Ferdinand pushed the Reconquista through the Guadalquivir valley while his son Alfonso X took the taifa of Murcia. In 1337 the throne belonged to Alfonso XI, who had tamed the nobility after a long minority and defeated the last great Marinid invasion at the Battle of Río Salado in 1340, then conquered Algeciras in 1344 before dying of plague at the siege of Gibraltar in 1350. The civil war after his death brought the Trastámara Henry II to power in 1369 at the expense of his brother Peter. In 1469 Isabella of Castile married Ferdinand II of Aragon at Valladolid, and the two crowns united in 1479; their conquest of Granada in 1492 completed the Reconquista, and in 1516 their grandson Charles I became the first king of both Castile and Aragon.
zh: 卡斯蒂利亚的前身是9世纪莱昂王国的边疆伯国，伯爵费尔南·冈萨雷斯于931年使其获得自治地位。1065年它成为独立王国，1072至1157年间曾与莱昂合并；1230年费尔南多三世继承莱昂，与他自1217年持有的卡斯蒂利亚永久合为一体。费尔南多沿瓜达尔基维尔河谷推进收复失地运动，其子阿方索十世则夺取了穆尔西亚泰法。1337年在位的是阿方索十一世，他在漫长的摄政期结束后压制了贵族，1340年在萨拉多河战役击败马林王朝最后一次大规模入侵，1344年征服阿尔赫西拉斯，最终于1350年在围攻直布罗陀时死于瘟疫。他死后的内战使特拉斯塔马拉家族的恩里克二世于1369年取代兄长佩德罗登上王位。1469年卡斯蒂利亚的伊莎贝拉在巴利亚多利德与阿拉贡的费尔南多二世结婚，两顶王冠于1479年合流；1492年他们征服格拉纳达，完成收复失地运动，1516年其孙卡洛斯一世成为同时统治卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡的第一位国王。

en: Cuauhtlan took its name from its principal town Cuautla, a Nahuatl word meaning the place of eagles, set in the western Sierra of Xalisco in modern Jalisco. The region was settled from the twelfth century by the Cuyuteca, a Nahua tribe who had drifted south from the deserts of Aridoamerica, and it was shared with Coca and Caxcan neighbours; the town served as the head settlement of the cacicazgo of Atenguillo, and the archaeological ruins of Las Águilas stand nearby. In 1525 the captain Francisco Cortés de San Buenaventura passed through on his way to Tepic and brought the district under Spanish rule, after which it was distributed as an encomienda.
zh: 夸乌特兰得名于其主要城镇夸奥特拉，这个纳瓦特尔语词意为“鹰之地”，城镇坐落在今哈利斯科州西部的西马德雷山区。该地区从12世纪起由库尤特卡人定居，他们是从干旱美洲的沙漠南迁的纳瓦部落，此外还有科卡人和卡克斯坎人为邻；夸奥特拉是阿滕吉约酋邦的治所，附近留存有拉斯阿吉拉斯考古遗址。1525年，将领弗朗西斯科·科尔特斯·德·圣布埃纳文图拉在前往特皮克途中经过此地，将该地区纳入西班牙统治，随后这里被作为监护征赋地分封。

en: Calva was the chiefdom of the Calvas, one of the six cacicazgos that made up the Palta nation of southern Ecuador. The Palta were an agricultural people of Amazonian origin, related to the Jivaro peoples, who had crossed the Andes into the Loja highlands, where maize and yuca farming supported large villages without writing, ploughs or coinage. The Calvas held the lands south of the Catamayo river, covering the broad valleys of El Ingenio, Sabiango and Macará in what is now Loja province, and were counted as the second most powerful Palta chiefdom after the confederation's seat at Cuxibamba. The Palta chiefs resisted the Inca armies of Tupac Inca Yupanqui, Sapa Inca from 1471 to 1493, but the region was absorbed into the Tahuantinsuyo and later overrun by the Spanish, under whom the Palta language and the chiefly order disappeared within a few generations.
zh: 卡尔瓦是卡尔瓦斯人的酋长邦，为组成厄瓜多尔南部帕勒塔民族的六个酋长邦之一。帕勒塔人是出自亚马孙的农耕民族，与希瓦罗诸族有亲缘关系，他们翻越安第斯山进入洛哈高地，靠玉米和木薯种植养活了没有文字、犁具和货币的大型村社。卡尔瓦斯人占据卡塔马约河以南的土地，涵盖今洛哈省境内埃尔因亨尼奥、萨比亚戈和马卡拉等宽阔河谷，势力在帕勒塔各酋长邦中仅次于联盟盟主所在的库西班巴。帕勒塔酋长们抵抗过1471年至1493年在位的萨帕·印卡图帕克·印卡·尤潘基的大军，但这一地区最终被并入塔万廷苏尤，后来又遭西班牙人占领；在殖民统治下，帕勒塔语和酋长秩序几代人之内便告消失。

en: Bhimber was the seat of the Chibhal state, a hill kingdom on the southern slopes of the Pir Panjal between the Jhelum and the Chenab, whose people were called Chibhalis after their Chib Rajput rulers. In 1486 its raja Howns defeated a Punjab army trying to force the pass, and the town later became known as the Door to Kashmir, the staging point where Mughal emperors broke their journey to Srinagar; Jahangir mentions it in his memoirs and the Ain-i Akbari of 1595 lists it as a mahal of the Lahore subah. Around the reign of Babur the ruling family turned to Islam: the chief Dharam Chand Chib took the name Shadab Khan, served Humayun and Akbar, and was buried near Bhimber at a shrine that became the pilgrimage place of the Chibs. The hill state fought hard against the Sikhs, and Raja Sultan Khan repulsed Kharak Singh, son of Ranjit Singh, in 1812 before he was lured to Jammu under a truce and imprisoned; his shrunken state was annexed and in 1822 granted as a jagir to Raja Dhyan Singh.
zh: 比姆贝尔是奇巴尔邦的治所，这个山邦位于皮尔潘贾尔山脉南坡、杰赫勒姆河与奇纳布河之间，居民因统治他们的奇布拉杰普特人而被称为奇巴尔人。1486年，罗阇霍恩斯击败了一支企图强入山口的旁遮普军队；此城后来被称为“克什米尔之门”，是莫卧儿皇帝前往斯利那加途中的驻跸之地，贾汉吉尔在回忆录中提到过它，1595年的《阿克巴则例》也把它列为拉合尔苏巴的一个马哈勒。约在巴布尔时期，统治家族改宗伊斯兰教：首领达兰·昌德·奇布改名沙达卜汗，效力于胡马雍与阿克巴，死后葬在比姆贝尔附近，其墓地成为奇布人朝谒的圣所。该山邦顽强抵抗锡克人，罗阇苏丹汗于1812年击退兰吉特·辛格之子卡拉克·辛格，后来却在停战骗局下被诱至查谟囚禁；版图大为缩水的邦国被吞并，1822年作为采邑封给罗阇迪扬·辛格。

en: Ngưu Hống, meaning cobra, was the Vietnamese chronicle name for the Black Tai kingdom of the Black River valley, called the Black River kingdom in Chinese sources; its lands covered the basins of the modern Điện Biên, Lai Châu and Sơn La provinces of northwestern Vietnam. Black Tai traditions relate that in the early eleventh century the chief Lạng Chượng led his people west from Mường Lò, conquering the chiefdoms of the valley and founding his seat at Mường Thanh, later Điện Biên Phủ. The kingdom sent tribute of gold, aromatic woods, rhinoceros horns and ivory to the Ly court of Đại Việt in 1067, but its relations with the Vietnamese fluctuated between tribute and revolt. Around the turn of the fourteenth century its ruler Lò Lẹt clashed with King Trần Minh Tông on the Black River; a royal campaign of 1329 ended in defeat, but in the winter of 1337 another Vietnamese army stormed the Trịnh Kỳ stockade and killed its chieftain, after which Ngưu Hống submitted and never again challenged Đại Việt. The Ming subjugated the Black Tai lands in 1416, and after the Lam Sơn uprising Emperor Lê Lợi's campaigns of 1431 to 1433 folded the old kingdom into the western provinces of Đại Việt.
zh: 牛吼意为眼镜蛇，是越南史籍对沱江流域黑泰人王国的称呼，中国史料则称其为黑水国，其疆域大致相当于今越南西北部的奠边、莱州与山罗等省。据黑泰人的口传历史，11世纪初首领郎壮率领部众从芒路向西迁徙，一路征服沱江流域的大小城邦，最后选定芒青（即后来的奠边府）作为王都。1067年，牛吼向大越李朝宫廷进贡黄金、沉香、犀角和象牙，但它与越南之间始终时贡时叛。13世纪末至14世纪初，首领卢烈与陈明宗在沱江一带发生冲突；1329年陈氏朝廷的亲征以失败收场，1337年冬又一支越军攻入郑旗寨并杀死其酋长，牛吼从此臣服，再未与大越抗衡。1416年明朝征服了黑泰人的土地；蓝山起义之后，黎利在1431年至1433年数次出兵，最终把这个古国并入大越的西部州县。

en: Cocollán, meaning place of undulations in the language of the Coca, was a chiefdom in central Jalisco founded in the twelfth century by Huehuetztlatzin at the head of Coca tribes who had left the chiefdom of Tonalá. Santa Ana Acatlán, Tizapanito, Xilotepetque, Tecolotlán, Atengo and Tenamaxtlán paid it tribute. After the town was destroyed the Cocolláns moved westward in 1509, only to be driven back from Tlajomulco to Santa Ana Acatlán, where they lived until rebuilding Cocollán on a mountain ridge in 1519. In 1521 the conquistador Alonso de Ávalos subdued the chiefdom under its last chief Citlali and incorporated it into his Avalos Province; Citlali later took part in the Salitre War.
zh: 科科兰在科卡语中意为起伏之地，是今哈利斯科中部的一个城邦，12世纪由韦韦特拉钦率领从托纳拉邦迁出的科卡部落建立。圣安娜·阿卡特兰、蒂萨帕尼托、希洛特佩克、特科洛特兰、阿滕戈和特纳马斯特兰都向它纳贡。城邦被毁后，科科兰人于1509年西迁，又被特拉霍穆尔科人赶回圣安娜·阿卡特兰，在那里住到1519年，才在一道山脊上重建科科兰。1521年，征服者阿隆索·德·阿瓦洛斯降服末代酋长西特拉利治下的科科兰，将其并入阿瓦洛斯省；西特拉利后来还参加了萨利特雷战争。

en: Cuicatlan, a Nahuatl name meaning Place of the Song People, was the chief town of the Cuicatecs, an Oto-Manguean people closely related to the Mixtecs, set in the narrow Cuicatlan canyon that links the Tehuacan valley to the Central Valleys of Oaxaca. The canyon had known outside rule long before: between about 100 BCE and 200 CE the Zapotec kings of Monte Alban conquered it, one of the few campaigns named on the conquest slabs of Monte Alban's Building J and confirmed by archaeology. In the Postclassic the Cuicatec kingdom straddled a busy trade road between central Mexico and the Oaxaca coast. After the Mexica overran Coixtlahuaca in 1458, Cuicatlan was attached to the new Aztec tributary province ruled from that city, which was given charge of all the Cuicatec towns. After the Spanish conquest Hernan Cortes granted the town in encomienda, first to Juan Tirado and then in 1524 to Juan de Jaso.
zh: 奎卡特兰是纳瓦特尔语名字，意为“歌者之地”，是奎卡特克人的主城。奎卡特克人属奥托-曼格语系族群，与纽萨维人亲缘很近；城池坐落在连接特瓦坎谷地与瓦哈卡中央谷地的奎卡特兰峡谷中。这条峡谷早有被外力统治的经历：约公元前100年至公元200年，蒙特阿尔班的萨波特克诸王征服了此地，这是蒙特阿尔班J号建筑“征服石板”上所列、且得到考古证实的少数战役之一。后古典期，奎卡特克王国扼守着一条连通墨西哥中部与瓦哈卡沿海的繁忙商道。1458年墨西加人攻灭科伊斯特拉瓦坎后，奎卡特兰被并入以该城为首的阿兹特克纳贡省份，全省奎卡特克城镇都归它管辖。西班牙征服后，埃尔南·科尔特斯先后将此城封赐，最初给了胡安·蒂拉多，1524年改封胡安·德·哈索。

en: Cuauhcuetzpaltepec, better known in colonial records as Guaspaltepec, was the head town of a pre-Hispanic senorio in the Papaloapan lowlands of southern Veracruz, its Nahuatl name meaning hill of the lizards. Colonial records imply a rich and populous state of perhaps eighty thousand people, ruling towns such as Mixtlan, Tesechoacan, Chacaltianguis, Tlacojalpan, Otatitlan and Amatlan, and it was already subject to the Aztec empire when the Spaniards arrived: in 1519 its governor was among the ambassadors Moctezuma sent to meet Hernan Cortes at San Juan de Ulua. After the fall of Tenochtitlan, Gonzalo de Sandoval conquered the Papaloapan basin in 1522 and kept the town as his own encomienda, and in 1531 the Second Audiencia brought it under the crown as one of the first corregimientos in the region. Around 1560 it was merged with Cosamaloapan; the head town itself was abandoned about 1600 and its survivors were resettled at Cacahuaxuchitlan, so that by 1640 the district had become the alcaldia mayor of Cosamaloapan and the old name fell out of use.
zh: 夸乌奎茨帕尔特佩克在殖民文献中更常写作瓜斯帕尔特佩克，是韦拉克鲁斯南部帕帕洛阿潘低地一个先西班牙时期领主邦的首镇，其纳瓦特尔语名字意为“蜥蜴之山”。殖民档案显示这是个富庶而人口稠密的邦国，居民或达八万，统辖米斯特兰、特塞乔阿坎、查卡尔蒂安吉斯、特拉科哈尔潘、奥塔蒂特兰和阿马特兰等镇；西班牙人到来时它已臣属阿兹特克帝国，1519年，其君主正是蒙特苏马派往圣胡安·德·乌卢阿迎接埃尔南·科尔特斯的使者之一。特诺奇蒂特兰陷落后，贡萨洛·德·桑多瓦尔于1522年征服帕帕洛阿潘盆地，并把该镇留作自己的监护征赋地；1531年，第二检审庭把它收归王室，设为该地区最早的督办区之一。约1560年，它与科萨马洛阿潘合并；首镇本身在1600年前后被废弃，幸存者被迁往卡卡瓦苏奇特兰，到1640年该辖区已变成科萨马洛阿潘市长辖区，旧名逐渐停用。

en: Città di Castello occupies the upper Tiber valley in northern Umbria, on the site of the Umbrian and Roman municipium of Tifernum Tiberinum. Gothic wars ruined the old city, and the Lombards refortified it as Castrum Felicitatis, a county under King Liutprand; after the Frankish conquest it passed between imperial and church authority. It became a free commune in the first half of the twelfth century, ruled by consuls and podestàs and torn, like its neighbours, by Guelph and Ghibelline feuds. In 1332 the brothers Guido and Pier Saccone da Pietramala seized it and held lordship for several years, the situation around 1337; thereafter the commune oscillated between submission to Perugia, the papacy and its own tyrants such as Branca Guelfucci, while briefly holding Sansepolcro. Braccio Fortebracco stormed it for Milan in 1422, and from 1440 it leaned on Florentine protection amid constant factional violence. Out of those strifes the Vitelli family emerged as lords: Niccolò Vitelli survived a sixty-seven-day siege by the troops of Pope Sixtus IV in 1474 and returned as recognized lord in 1482. The execution of Vitellozzo Vitelli let Cesare Borgia seize the city in 1502, after which it settled under stable papal government until the Napoleonic upheaval.
zh: 卡斯泰洛位于翁布里亚北部的台伯河上游，前身是翁布里亚人和罗马人的自治城蒂弗努姆·蒂贝里努姆。哥特战争摧毁了旧城，伦巴第人将其重新设防，改称费利奇塔蒂斯堡，并在利乌特普兰德国王治下升格为伯国；法兰克征服之后，它在皇权与教权之间几度易手。12世纪上半叶，这里成为由执政官和市政官治理的自由公社，也和邻邦一样被圭尔夫派与吉伯林派的仇杀撕裂。1332年，达彼得拉马拉家族的圭多与皮尔·萨科内兄弟夺取此城并统治数年，这便是1337年前后的局势；此后公社在臣服佩鲁贾、投靠教皇和屈从本地僭主（如布兰卡·圭尔富奇）之间反复摇摆，还曾一度占据圣塞波尔克罗。1422年，布拉乔·福尔泰布拉乔替米兰攻陷此城，1440年起它在不断的党派暴力中转而依靠佛罗伦萨保护。维泰利家族在内斗中崛起成为领主：尼科洛·维泰利于1474年顶住了教皇西克斯图斯四世军队长达六十七天的围攻，又在1482年以公认领主的身份回城。1502年，维泰洛佐·维泰利被处死，切萨雷·博尔贾趁机夺取城市，卡斯泰洛从此进入稳定的教皇统治，直到拿破仑时代的剧变。

en: Chaudandi was a Sen dynasty hill kingdom in the inner Terai and lower hills of eastern Nepal, ruled from the fort of Chaudandigadhi in what is now Udayapur district; the country was also known as Majhkirat. It arose when Mukunda Sen of Makawanpur, who reigned from 1518 to 1553, partitioned his kingdom among his sons, the Makawanpur branch of the Sen house of Palpa splitting into the two eastern kingdoms of Chaudandi and Vijayapur. The Sen rajas ruled over a largely Kirati population, chiefly the Rai, whose headmen held high office, Agam Singh Rai serving as chief minister under the last king, Karna Sen. During the Gorkha conquests the Gorkha army stormed Hatuwa and took Chaudandi in 1773; Karna Sen fled first to Vijayapur and then into British territory at Purnea, and his kingdom was absorbed into the expanding kingdom of Nepal.
zh: 琼丹迪是尼泊尔东部内特莱平原与低山地带的森王朝山地王国，以今乌达亚普尔县境内的琼丹迪堡为统治中心，该国又称马吉基拉特。它源于马克万普尔的分封：1518至1553年在位的穆昆达·森把王国分给诸子，帕尔帕森氏家族的马克万普尔支系由此分裂为琼丹迪与维贾亚普尔两个东部王国。森氏拉贾治下的人口以基拉蒂人、尤其是拉伊族为主，其首领出任要职，阿加姆·辛格·拉伊就在末代国王卡尔纳·森麾下担任首席大臣。廓尔喀扩张期间，廓尔喀军队于1773年攻陷哈图瓦、夺取琼丹迪；卡尔纳·森先逃维贾亚普尔，再退入英属境内的普尔尼亚，其王国被并入日益扩张的尼泊尔王国。

en: Dali was the Bai kingdom of the Duan clan, founded in 937 by Duan Siping on the ruins of Nanzhao and its three short-lived successor states, and ruled from the old capital of Taihe beside Erhai Lake. Its Buddhist kings styled themselves dharma-raja and took Acuoye Guanyin as their tutelary deity; the Song court, wary of repeating Tang disasters in the southwest, kept the peace and treated the Dadu River as the border. In 1253 Kublai's three columns crossed the Jinsha River and converged on Dali, and the last king Duan Xingzhi, who had fled to Shanchan, surrendered in 1256 and was enfeoffed as Maharaja. The Duan then governed their homeland for eleven generations as hereditary governors-general under Mongol princes and Muslim governors in Kunming, supplying troops to the Yuan. Duan Gong, the tenth governor-general, married Princess Agai, daughter of the Prince of Liang Basalawarmi, but was killed when the Mongols grew wary of his power. When the Ming invaded Yunnan in 1381, Duan Shi, the thirteenth and last governor-general, refused to submit and offered only tributary status; Lan Yu and Mu Ying stormed Dali in 1382, and the last stronghold of Dengchuan fell in February 1383, after which the Duan family was carried captive to Nanjing.
zh: 大理是段氏建立的白人国家。937年段思平在南诏及其后三个短命政权的废墟上建国，以洱海畔的旧都太和为统治中心。大理诸王崇佛，自称护法法王，奉阿嵯耶观音为守护神；宋朝忌惮重蹈唐朝经营西南的覆辙，与其保持和平，以大渡河为界。1253年，忽必烈的三路大军渡过金沙江会师大理，末代国王段兴智从善阐出逃，于1256年投降，受封摩诃罗嵯。此后段氏以世袭总管的身份，在驻昆明的蒙古宗王和回回长官监临下治理故土，共历十一代，并为元朝出兵助战。第十代总管段功娶梁王把匝剌瓦尔密之女阿盖公主为妻，却因蒙古人忌惮其权势而被杀。1381年明军攻入云南，第十三代也是末代总管段世拒绝归附，只愿称臣纳贡；1382年蓝玉、沐英攻破大理，最后的据点邓川于1383年2月陷落，段氏一族被押往南京。

en: Cebu, or Sugbu, was an Indianised port-kingdom on Cebu island in the Visayas, recorded as Suwu in the Chinese Zhu Fan Zhi of 1225 and dated by tradition and early Spanish accounts to the tenth century. Visayan oral legend traces its ruling line to Sri Lumay, a half-Tamil, half-Malay prince from Sumatra, whose scorched-earth defence against Moro slave-raiders from Mindanao gave the town its name Sugbu, 'scorched earth'; his sons divided the island into the southern realm of Sialo and the northern Nahalin. By the fourteenth century it was a long seaside port of some three hundred houses centred on the rajah's palace and plaza at Singhapala, later the Mabolo district of Cebu City, trading cotton, ironwork and local goods with merchants from China, Java, Sumatra and Ayutthaya, as Wang Dayuan noted in 1349. The throne passed from Sri Bantug to his son Rajah Humabon, on whose watch Ferdinand Magellan reached Cebu in 1521 and was killed at Mactan; Humabon's successor Rajah Tupas was defeated by Miguel Lopez de Legazpi in 1565, and the Hindu polity was absorbed into the Spanish Philippines.
zh: 宿务又称苏布，是米沙鄢群岛宿务岛上的印度化港口王国，中国1225年的《诸蕃志》以束务之名记载其地，传说和西班牙人早期记述都把它的历史追溯到10世纪。据米沙鄢口传传说，其统治世系出自苏门答腊的泰米尔—马来混血王子室里·鲁马伊；他以焦土战术抵御棉兰老摩洛奴隶贩子的袭掠，都城也由此得名苏布，意为焦土。他的儿子们把岛屿分作南部的西亚洛和北部的纳哈林。到14世纪，它已是一座沿海岸绵延、约有三百座房屋的港口，中心是辛哈帕拉的拉惹宫殿与广场，即后来宿务市的马博洛一带；汪大渊1349年的《岛夷志略》记载，当地以棉花、铁器和土产与中国、爪哇、苏门答腊和阿瑜陀耶的商人交易。王位经室里·巴图格传给其子拉惹·哈马巴；1521年斐迪南·麦哲伦抵达宿务，随后战死于麦克坦。末代拉惹图帕斯于1565年被米格尔·洛佩斯·德莱加斯皮击败，这个印度教政权遂并入西班牙治下的菲律宾。

en: The Emirate of Çemişgezek was a Kurdish principality in the mountains above the upper Euphrates, holding the towns of Çemişgezek, Mazgirt, Pertek and Sağman between Harput and Erzincan. According to the Sharafnama, it was founded in the thirteenth century by a certain Malik Shah, whose descendants were known to the Kurds as the Malkishi dynasty. In the Mongol age it was repeatedly caught between the Kara Koyunlu and the Aq Qoyunlu, at first siding with the former; Emir Yalman is attested in 1388 as a client of Mutahharten of Erzincan, and in the later fifteenth century Emir Sheikh Hasan came to terms with the Aq Qoyunlu. When the Safavids rose, Sheikh Hasan's grandson Hajji Rustam submitted to Shah Ismail and accepted a Safavid governor, but after the Ottoman victory at Chaldiran in 1514 he sought pardon from Selim I and was executed. His son Pir Husayn nevertheless won recognition of his family's lands as hereditary ocaklik tenure under the Ottomans, until succession disputes split the emirate into separate sanjaks; the last remnant of the principality disappeared in 1663. Its Kurdish population had strong Shiite leanings, later linked to the Alevi communities of nearby Dersim, and lived alongside a large Armenian population.
zh: 切米什盖泽克埃米尔国是幼发拉底河上游山区的库尔德政权，领有哈尔普特与埃尔津詹之间的切米什盖泽克、马兹吉尔特、佩尔泰克和萨阿曼诸城。据《沙拉夫传》记载，它由13世纪一位名叫马利克沙阿的人物建立，其后代被库尔德人称为马尔基希王朝。蒙古时代，它在黑羊王朝与白羊王朝之间反复易手，最初依附黑羊王朝；1388年已有埃米尔亚勒曼作为埃尔津詹埃米尔穆塔哈尔滕附庸的记载，15世纪后期埃米尔谢赫·哈桑又与白羊王朝和解。萨法维王朝兴起后，谢赫·哈桑的孙子哈吉·鲁斯塔姆向沙阿伊斯玛仪臣服并接受萨法维总督，但1514年奥斯曼在查尔迪兰获胜后，他向塞利姆一世求赦却被处死。其子皮尔·侯赛因仍争取到家族土地以奥斯曼世袭领地的形式保留，直到继承纠纷使埃米尔国分裂为若干桑贾克；公国的残余最终于1663年消亡。当地库尔德居民有强烈的什叶派倾向，后来与邻近德尔西姆的阿拉维派社群关系密切，他们与大量亚美尼亚人共同生活。

en: Cephalonia was the seat of the County Palatine of Cephalonia and Zakynthos, which also ruled Zakynthos and Ithaca in the Ionian Islands. The county was created in 1185, when the Norman king of Sicily granted the islands to his admiral Margaritus of Brindisi, and from 1195 it passed to the Roman Orsini family. Count Matthew Orsini secured his hold by acknowledging Venice in 1209, the Papacy in 1216 and the Principality of Achaea in 1236, while the Orthodox sees were replaced by Latin bishoprics and the islands were organised as feudal fiefs. The Orsini also conquered Epirus on the mainland early in the fourteenth century, but after the death of John II Orsini in 1335 the islands were occupied by the Angevin rulers of Naples and Achaea, who held them in 1337 under Robert of Taranto. In 1357 Robert granted the county to Leonardo I Tocco, whose family turned it into a base for mainland conquests: Carlo I Tocco took Ioannina in 1411 and Arta in 1416 and became despot of Epirus. Ottoman pressure later drove the Tocco back to the islands, and in 1479 the county was partitioned between Venice and the Ottoman Empire, with Zakynthos going to Venice.
zh: 凯法洛尼亚是“凯法洛尼亚与扎金索斯行宫伯爵领”的核心，该伯爵领还统治着伊奥尼亚群岛中的扎金索斯和伊萨卡。1185年，西西里的诺曼国王把这片岛屿封给海军将领布林迪西的马加里托，伯爵领由此建立；1195年起转入罗马的奥尔西尼家族之手。伯爵马太·奥尔西尼先后于1209年、1216年和1236年承认威尼斯、教皇国和亚该亚亲王国的宗主权以巩固统治，岛上的东正教主教座则被拉丁主教取代，全岛按封建封邑组织。14世纪初，奥尔西尼家族还征服了大陆上的伊庇鲁斯；1335年约翰二世·奥尔西尼死后，群岛被那不勒斯和亚该亚的安茹统治者接管，1337年时由塔兰托的罗伯特领有。1357年，罗伯特把伯爵领封给莱奥纳多一世·托科，托科家族以此为跳板向大陆扩张：卡洛一世·托科于1411年攻下约阿尼纳、1416年攻下阿尔塔，成为伊庇鲁斯专制君主。后来奥斯曼的压力把托科家族逼回群岛，1479年伯爵领被威尼斯和奥斯曼帝国瓜分，扎金索斯划归威尼斯。

en: The Cheros were a Hindu tribal people of the lower Ganga plain who, after the fall of the Pala Empire in the twelfth century, carved out a string of small chiefdoms across Bhojpur, Saran, Champaran and Muzaffarpur; in 1337 their chiefs still held the hill fort of Rohtas. Rivalry with the neighbouring Ujjainiyas gradually drove them south, and the chiefdom's later centre became Palamu, where Bhagwant Rai, once a captain under the Raksel raja Man Singh, seized power in 1572 and drove his former masters into Surguja. Even Sher Shah Suri had found the Cheros troublesome, sending his commander Khawas Khan against the chief Maharata to seize a prized white elephant. The Mughals hammered at the forest kingdom in vain: Man Singh subjugated Anant Chero in 1590 and carried off fifty-four elephants, but the Cheros retook their independence after Akbar's death, and Shaista Khan needed six months to reduce the Palamu forts under Shah Jahan. Medini Ray, ruling from 1620 to 1634, carried the chiefdom to its height, sacking the Khokhra capital of Navratangarh and raiding as far as Gaya and Hazaribagh. Heavy revenue demands under the East India Company emptied the treasury, and in 1814 Raja Churaman Rai's zamindari was confiscated and the Chero state extinguished.
zh: 哲卢人是恒河下游平原的印度教部族，12世纪波罗王朝衰落后，在博杰普尔、萨兰、坚巴兰和穆扎法尔布尔一带建立了一连串小酋长国；1337年前后，其首领仍据守着罗赫达斯山城。与邻近乌贾伊尼亚人的长期争斗逐渐把他们逼向南方，酋长国的后期中心转到伯拉穆。曾在拉克塞尔首领曼·辛格麾下效力的巴格万特·拉伊于1572年夺取政权，把旧主逐入苏尔古贾。早在舍尔沙·苏尔时代，哲卢人就令其头疼，舍尔沙曾派将领哈瓦斯汗攻打首领马哈拉塔，夺取一头珍贵的白象。莫卧儿人也难以征服这个丛林王国：曼·辛格于1590年降服阿南特·哲卢，掳走五十四头大象，但阿克巴死后哲卢人重获独立；沙贾汗时期，沙伊斯塔汗围攻伯拉穆要塞达六个月才得手。1620至1634年在位的梅迪尼·拉伊把酋长国带到极盛，攻陷科赫罗的都城纳夫拉坦加尔，兵锋远及加雅和哈扎里巴格。东印度公司沉重的税收榨干了国库，1814年丘拉曼·拉伊的柴明达尔领地被没收，哲卢政权就此终结。

en: Cesena, the Roman Caesena near the Adriatic edge of the Apennines, was an Umbrian and Etruscan town before Rome made it a garrison colony; it was destroyed in the wars between Marius and Sulla. In the early Middle Ages it stood on the frontier between the Byzantine Exarchate of Ravenna and the Lombards, and the Donation of Pepin in 754 assigned it to the papacy, though the archbishops of Ravenna long disputed it. A short-lived communal republic of 1183 to 1198 gave way to the long contest between popes and emperors, in which the Ghibelline Ordelaffi of Forlì built up their power: in 1337 Francesco II Ordelaffi held the city, until Cardinal Albornoz retook it for the Church in 1357 after a long siege. During the War of the Eight Saints it revolted again, and in 1377 Breton mercenaries under the Cardinal of Geneva, the future antipope Clement VII, carried out the massacre remembered as the Cesena Bloodbath. In 1378 the ruined city was granted to Galeotto I Malatesta, and under his family it recovered and prospered until 1465; Malatesta Novello built the celebrated Malatestiana Library and the great fortress above the town. Restored to the Papal States, it was seized by Cesare Borgia in 1500 and briefly made capital of his Duchy of Romagna, then settled as a papal city that later produced Popes Pius VI and Pius VII.
zh: 切塞纳古称凯塞纳，位于亚平宁山脉临近亚得里亚海的一侧，本是翁布里亚人和伊特鲁里亚人的城镇，罗马人把它建成驻军殖民地，后在马略与苏拉的内战中被毁。中世纪早期，它处在拜占庭拉文纳总督区与伦巴第人对峙的前沿，754年的丕平献土把它划给教皇，但拉文纳大主教长期对此提出异议。1183至1198年间，这里存在过一个短命的公社共和国，随后陷入教皇与皇帝的长期争夺，弗利的吉伯林派奥尔德拉菲家族趁势崛起：1337年，弗朗切斯科二世·奥尔德拉菲据有此城，直到1357年阿尔沃诺斯枢机经长期围攻替教会将其收复。八圣王战争期间，城市再度反叛，1377年，日内瓦枢机（即后来的对立教皇克雷芒七世）麾下的布列塔尼雇佣兵制造了被称为切塞纳大屠杀的惨案。1378年，残破的城市被封给加莱奥托一世·马拉泰斯塔，在其家族治下恢复元气并繁荣至1465年；马拉泰斯塔·诺韦洛修建了著名的马拉泰斯塔图书馆和俯瞰全城的大要塞。城市重归教皇国后，又于1500年被切萨雷·博尔贾夺取，短暂成为他的罗马涅公国都城，此后成为一座普通的教皇城市，日后还走出了庇护六世和庇护七世两位教皇。

en: Chester, the Roman legionary fortress of Deva Victrix founded around AD 75, guarded the crossing of the Dee and the approach to Wales. After the Roman withdrawal it passed from British Powys to the Mercians: the Northumbrians won the Battle of Chester in 616, and Æthelflæd, Lady of the Mercians, rebuilt the walled burh in 907 and beat off a Viking siege. It was one of the last English cities to submit to the Normans, and William the Conqueror at once raised a castle and made Cheshire a county palatine on the Welsh march, first under Gerbod the Fleming and then Hugh d'Avranches, called Hugh Lupus. The earls of Chester ruled with near-regal powers, holding their own barons, courts and administration, and their lands stretched into Flintshire across the Dee. When the last independent earl, John the Scot, died without heirs in 1237, the palatinate escheated to the Crown; from 1301 it was granted to the heir to the throne, and from the late fourteenth century the earldom of Chester was always joined to the title Prince of Wales. Richard II leaned heavily on a Cheshire bodyguard and in 1397 briefly raised the county to a principality, a distinction undone with his fall in 1399. In the English Civil War Chester held for the king until Parliament's forces starved it into surrender after a long siege.
zh: 切斯特的前身是约公元75年建立的罗马军团要塞德瓦·维克特里克斯，扼守迪河渡口与进入威尔士的通道。罗马撤军后，它先属不列颠人的波伊斯，后落入麦西亚之手：诺森伯里亚人于616年赢得切斯特战役，麦西亚女领主埃塞尔弗莱德于907年重建有墙堡镇，并击退维京人的围攻。它是最后向诺曼人屈服的英格兰城市之一，征服者威廉随即修建城堡，把柴郡设为威尔士边境上的巴拉丁郡，先后封给佛兰德斯人热尔博和人称“灰狼”的于格·达夫朗什。历代切斯特伯爵以近乎君王的权力统治，拥有自己的封臣、法庭和行政体系，领地还跨过迪河延伸到弗林特郡。1237年，最后一位独立伯爵“苏格兰人”约翰无嗣而终，巴拉丁领地收归王室；自1301年起它被封给王储，14世纪末以后切斯特伯爵头衔始终与威尔士亲王头衔联用。理查二世曾倚重一支柴郡卫队，并于1397年一度把该郡升格为亲王国，这一殊荣随他1399年倒台而取消。英国内战中，切斯特站在国王一边，最终在长期围困后被议会军饿降。

en: Ceva, the Roman Ceba on the upper Tanaro in southern Piedmont, was already known for its cheese in Pliny's day. In the Middle Ages it became the seat of a small marquisate of the Aleramic dynasty, created when the heirs of Bonifacio del Vasto partitioned his lands, with Guglielmo I the first attested marquis. The marquisate was weakened by repeated partitions among the many sons of the house, who ruled jointly and switched sides in the wars between Alba, Asti, Genoa and the rival Aleramic branches. The commune of Alba reduced the marquises to vassals in 1257, and in 1260 they commended themselves directly to Charles I of Anjou; from 1295 they were repeatedly bound to the rising commune of Asti. In 1337 the young Boniface II represented the marquisal line in this fragmented hill state, whose lords governed through a podestà and issued the statutes of Ceva in 1358. The Angevin claims in Piedmont were ceded to Amadeus VI of Savoy in 1382, and the marquises then followed the fortunes of Asti between the Visconti and the French dukes of Orléans, into whose hands the territory passed with the dowry of Valentina Visconti. In 1457 the jurisdiction was split into twelve captaincies, and in the early sixteenth century Emperor Charles V assigned Ceva definitively to the Duchy of Savoy, ending the rule of the old Aleramic line.
zh: 切瓦古称切巴，位于皮埃蒙特南部塔纳罗河上游，早在普林尼的时代就以出产奶酪闻名。中世纪时，这里成为阿莱拉米奇王朝一个小侯国的治所：博尼法乔·德尔瓦斯托的后人瓜分遗产时立国，古列尔莫一世是见于记载的第一位侯爵。侯国因家族诸子一再瓜分而日渐衰弱，侯爵们共同执政，在阿尔巴、阿斯蒂、热那亚与阿莱拉米奇其他支系的战争中不断改换阵营。1257年，阿尔巴公社迫使侯爵称臣，1260年他们又直接向安茹的查理一世投献；从1295年起，他们反复受制于日益崛起的阿斯蒂公社。1337年，年轻的博尼法乔二世代表侯爵世系统治着这个四分五裂的山地小国，侯爵们通过市政官治理，并在1358年颁布了切瓦法令。1382年，安茹家族在皮埃蒙特的权利被让给萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥六世，侯爵们此后又随阿斯蒂在维斯孔蒂家族与法国奥尔良公爵之间沉浮，这片土地最终作为瓦伦蒂娜·维斯孔蒂的嫁妆落入法国人之手。1457年，侯国辖区被划分为十二个长官区；16世纪初，皇帝查理五世将切瓦正式判给萨伏依公国，古老的阿莱拉米奇世系统治至此终结。

en: Colmar, a town on the Lauch in Upper Alsace, was first documented in 823, and the Carolingian emperor Charles the Fat held an imperial diet there in 884. Emperor Frederick II raised it to a Free Imperial City in 1226, so that in 1337 it governed itself through a patrician council on the busy Alsatian trade routes, and in 1354 it joined the Décapole, the league of ten Alsatian free cities. Medieval wealth left its mark in convents and churches: the Jewish families persecuted at the time of the Black Death buried the silver and jewellery later known as the Colmar Treasure, and the city's painters and goldsmiths nurtured Martin Schongauer, born there around 1450, the foremost engraver north of the Alps before Dürer. Colmar adopted the Reformation only late, in 1575, and during the Thirty Years' War a Swedish army occupied it from 1632 for two years before imperial forces retook the region. Louis XIV's troops conquered the city in 1673, and the Treaties of Nijmegen in 1679 formally ceded it, with the rest of the Décapole, to France.
zh: 科尔马是上阿尔萨斯拉赫河畔的城镇，823年首见文献记载，加洛林皇帝胖子查理于884年在此召开帝国议会。1226年皇帝弗里德里希二世把它升格为帝国自由市，因此1337年时它由贵族市议会在繁忙的阿尔萨斯商路上自治，1354年又加入阿尔萨斯十城联盟。中世纪的富庶留在修道院和教堂之中：黑死病时期遭迫害的犹太家庭埋下的银器珠宝，后世称为科尔马宝藏；本地的画家和金匠还培育了约1450年出生于此的马丁·施恩告尔，他是阿尔布雷希特·丢勒之前阿尔卑斯山以北最重要的雕版画家。科尔马迟至1575年才接受宗教改革；三十年战争期间，瑞典军队于1632年占领该城达两年，随后帝国军队收复这一地区。路易十四的军队于1673年攻克该城，1679年的《奈梅亨条约》正式把它连同十城联盟其余城市割让给法国。

en: Changzhou was a native department in the Anning River valley of southern Sichuan, in the country south-west of Jianchang that is now southern Dechang County. Its people were the Qu tribe, whose land had fallen to Nanzhao in Tang times. They submitted to the Mongols in 1272, and in 1275 the Qu territory was organised as Changzhou, seat of the new Dingchang Route. When that route was abolished in 1286 Changzhou became the seat of the enlarged Dechang Route, governed from Gelu city and overseeing the four departments of De, Chang, Puji and Weilong, with military farming colonies settled on its lands. The Ming placed Changzhou under Dechang Prefecture in 1382, and in 1404 converted it into the Changzhou Chief's Office, so that hereditary native rule continued under a new title.
zh: 昌州是川西南安宁河谷的土州，在建昌西南，辖境约当今四川德昌县南境，居民为屈部，其地唐代没于南诏。1272年屈部归附蒙古，1275年元朝以屈部之地置昌州，作为新设定昌路的治所。1286年定昌路废罢，并入德昌路，昌州又成为德昌路治所，治于葛鲁城；德昌路领德州、昌州、普济州、威龙州四州，境内还设有军民屯田。1382年明朝将昌州划归德昌府，1404年改昌州为昌州长官司，世袭的土官统治便以新的名号延续下来。

en: Champa was not a single kingdom but a loose federation of seafaring Cham polities strung along the coast of present-day central and southern Vietnam. Its roots lay in the Austronesian Sa Huỳnh culture and in Linyi, a state recorded from 192; Hinduism, adopted from the fourth century, shaped its brick temples and Sanskrit kingship, and Cham ships dominated the trade linking China with the Indian Ocean, carrying the kingdom to its height in the ninth and tenth centuries. The coastal federation fought long wars with the Khmer, who occupied Champa from 1190 to 1203, and with Đại Việt to its north, while also resisting Mongol expeditions in the 1280s.
