In 1471 the Vietnamese emperor Lê Thánh Tông stormed and sacked Vijaya, the chief capital, absorbing the northern Cham lands and leaving only the southern principality of Panduranga. The Nguyễn lords reduced Panduranga to the vassal principality of Thuận Thành in the late seventeenth century, by which time the Cham ruling house had adopted Islam. The last Cham territories were annexed by the emperor Minh Mạng in 1832, ending more than sixteen centuries of Cham statehood.
zh: 占婆并非单一王国，而是由沿海而居、善于航海的占人政权组成的松散联盟，散布在今越南中部和南部海岸。其源头可溯至南岛语系的沙黄文化和始见于192年的林邑；4世纪起接受的印度教塑造了它的砖寺与梵文王权，占人商船长期掌控连接中国与印度洋的贸易，使占婆在9至10世纪达到鼎盛。这个沿海联盟与高棉长期交战，曾在1190年至1203年被高棉占领，又与北方的大越连年构兵，并在13世纪80年代抵御了蒙古远征。1471年，越南皇帝黎圣宗攻破并洗劫占婆首要都城毗阇耶，吞并北方占人土地，只留下南方的宾童龙公国。17世纪末，阮主将宾童龙降为附庸顺城镇，此时占人王室已改奉伊斯兰教。1832年，明命帝兼并最后一批占人领土，延续了一千六百多年的占人政权至此终结。

en: Chanda, later called Chandrapur, was one of the great Gond kingdoms of central India, covering the forested Wardha valley in the Vidarbha country. Its Gond house was founded around 1320 by Bhim Ballal Singh of the Atram clan, who subdued the neighbouring petty chiefs and set his capital at Sirpur, with the hill fortress of Manikgarh as his chief stronghold. His successor Khandkya Ballal Shah built the fort of Ballarpur and founded the city of Chandrapur, which became the seat of the next nine generations of Gond kings; from the time of Surja Ballal Shah the rulers took the title Shah instead of Singh. The Chanda kings developed irrigation works and the first regular revenue system of any Gond state. In the sixteenth century Babji Ballal Shah was recorded in the Ain-i-Akbari as fully independent, though he later paid tribute to the Mughals, and Chanda was enrolled in the Berar Subah. Rivalry with the neighbouring Gond kingdom of Deogarh weakened both, and in the eighteenth century the Bhonsles of Nagpur encroached: Raghoji I forced a treaty in 1749 that took two thirds of the revenue, and in 1751 he deposed Nilkanth Shah and ended Gond rule.
zh: 钱达又称昌德拉布尔，是中印度主要的贡德王国之一，疆域涵盖维达尔巴地区森林密布的瓦尔达河谷。约1320年，阿特拉姆氏族的宾·巴拉拉尔·辛格降服周边小酋长，建立了钱达的贡德王统，定都西尔布尔，以山上的曼尼基尔城堡为主要要塞。继承者坎德克亚·巴拉拉尔·沙修建了巴拉尔布尔堡，并兴建昌德拉布尔城，此后九代贡德国王都以此为都；从苏尔贾·巴拉拉尔·沙开始，君主改用“沙”的称号而不再称“辛格”。钱达诸王兴修灌溉工程，建立了贡德诸邦中第一套规整的税收制度。16世纪时，《阿克巴则例》记载巴卜吉·巴拉拉尔·沙完全独立，但他后来向莫卧儿纳贡，钱达被编入贝拉尔苏巴。与邻邦代奥加尔贡德王国的争斗使两败俱伤，18世纪那格浦尔的邦斯勒家族步步紧逼：拉古吉一世于1749年强迫签约，夺走三分之二的税收，1751年又废黜尼尔坎特·沙，贡德人的统治就此终结。

en: The Chagatai Khanate was the Mongol ulus inherited in 1227 by Chagatai, second son of Genghis Khan, covering Transoxiana, the Tarim Basin and the steppes from the Amu Darya to the Altai, with its capital at Almaliq. It became effectively independent after the Mongol Empire split in 1259, though from 1303 its khans acknowledged the Yuan emperor only nominally, and the Mongol elite slowly Turkified and Islamized. In 1337 the throne belonged to Changshi, one of the last khans to rule effectively; he protected Nestorian Christians and received a letter of thanks from Pope Benedict XII in 1338. After Qazan Khan was killed by the amir Qazaghan in 1346 the khanate broke apart: in 1347 the Dughlat amirs raised Tughlugh Timur over the eastern lands, called Moghulistan, and his conversion in 1354 with 160,000 followers marked the Islamization of the eastern Mongols, while puppet khans in Transoxiana gave way to Timur, who extinguished the western khanate by 1369. The eastern Chagatayids ruled on as the Moghul khans until their realm split into the Turpan and Yarkent khanates, which the Dzungar ruler Galdan overran in 1680.
zh: 察合台汗国是成吉思汗次子察合台于1227年继承的蒙古兀鲁思，领有河中、塔里木盆地以及从阿姆河到阿尔泰山的草原，以阿力麻里为都。1259年蒙古帝国分裂后它实际独立，1303年起仅在名义上尊奉元朝皇帝，境内的蒙古贵族则逐渐突厥化、伊斯兰化。1337年在位的敞失是最后几位仍能有效统治的汗之一，他保护景教徒，1338年还收到教皇本笃十二世的感谢信。1346年合赞算端被异密加兹罕杀害后，汗国瓦解：1347年杜格拉特贵族在东部的蒙兀儿斯坦扶立秃忽鲁帖木儿，他于1354年率十六万部众改宗伊斯兰教，标志着东部蒙古人的伊斯兰化；河中的傀儡诸汗则让位于帖木儿，后者到1369年攻灭了西部汗国。东迁的察合台后裔作为蒙兀儿汗继续存续，后来分裂为吐鲁番汗国和叶尔羌汗国，最终于1680年被准噶尔的噶尔丹攻灭。

en: Chiang Hung, also called Moeng Lü and later Sipsong Panna, was a Tai Lü kingdom on the middle Mekong, whose walled capital of Chiang Hung is the modern city of Jinghong in Yunnan. It was founded in 1180 by the chief Pa Zhen, who led his Tai Lü followers through long wars with the local Akha and other Tai peoples, and under his early successors its overlordship reached as far as Kengtung, Chiang Saen, Meuang Thaeng near modern Dien Bien Phu and Xieng Thong on the site of Luang Prabang. Mongol armies broke its independence in the 1290s: the kingdom submitted to the Yuan in 1292, and in 1296 the Yuan set up the Cheli military-civilian administration and granted its kings the title Chao Saenwi Fa with the Chinese surname Dao. For centuries the rulers were recognized by Chinese dynasties as Cheli tusi while also paying tribute to Lanna, whose king Mangrai once seized the capital. Lanna's decline brought a short spell of autonomy early in the sixteenth century, but after the Toungoo conquest of Lanna in 1558 Bayinnaung made Chiang Hung a Burmese tributary and divided it into twelve districts, the twelve panna that gave the land its later name. It then spent three centuries as a Burmese vassal and a battleground between Burma and the Qing.
zh: 景洪又称勐泐，后来也叫西双版纳，是湄公河中游的傣仂人王国，其王城景洪即今天云南的景洪市。1180年，首领叭真率领傣仂人经过长期征战，击败当地阿卡人和其他台语部族后建国；在其后继者治下，势力范围一度远及景栋、清盛、奠边府附近的孟滕和琅勃拉邦前身孟苏瓦。13世纪90年代蒙古大军打破了它的独立：景陇于1292年归顺元朝，1296年元朝设立车里军民总管府，赐其君长召片领以刀为姓、授车里宣慰使之职。此后历代国王被中原王朝认作车里土司，同时又向兰纳纳贡，兰纳王芒莱还曾攻占景洪。16世纪初兰纳衰落，景洪获得短暂自主；但1558年东吁王朝攻灭兰纳后，勃印曩将景洪降为缅甸属邦，并把它划分为十二个行政区，即十二版纳，西双版纳由此得名。此后三百年间，它一直是缅甸的属国，也是缅甸与清朝反复争夺的战场。

en: The empire ruled from Dadu in 1337 was the Great Yuan, proclaimed by Kublai Khan in 1271 after he moved the Mongol capital from Karakorum and built his capital near modern Beijing; the Southern Song fell in 1279, and Yuan rule extended the Grand Canal, ran much of the economy on paper jiaochao banknotes and hosted visitors such as Marco Polo. Under the last Yuan emperor Toghon Temür, floods and famine fed the Red Turban Rebellion of 1351, and in 1368 the rebel leader Zhu Yuanzhang founded the Ming and took Dadu, the Yuan court fleeing to Mongolia as the Northern Yuan. The Ming's Yongle Emperor made Beijing his capital, building the Forbidden City from 1407, and sent Zheng He on seven great voyages between 1405 and 1433; the Tumu Crisis of 1449, when the Oirats captured the Zhengtong Emperor, drove the later Ming to fortify the Great Wall. In 1616 the Jurchen leader Nurhaci founded the Later Jin, renamed the Great Qing by Hong Taiji in 1636, and in 1644 the Manchus entered Beijing through Shanhai Pass after Li Zicheng's rebels had toppled the Ming. Kangxi crushed the Three Feudatories by 1681, took Taiwan in 1683 and campaigned against the Dzungars; under him and Qianlong the High Qing brought long peace and a population that tripled to some 300 million, while the White Lotus Rebellion of 1796–1804 and the Canton trade system signaled the strains gathering in the new century.
zh: 1337年以大都为都的帝国是大元：忽必烈于1271年定国号为元，此前他已把蒙古都城从哈拉和林迁到今北京一带另建新都；1279年南宋灭亡。元朝重修贯通南北的大运河，以纸钞交钞支撑经济，宫廷中还接待过马可·波罗这样的欧洲来客。末代皇帝妥懽帖睦尔在位时，水患与饥荒催生了1351年的红巾军起义；1368年，义军首领朱元璋建立明朝、攻取大都，元廷北逃草原，史称北元。明朝的永乐帝以北京为都城，1407年起营建紫禁城，并于1405—1433年派郑和七下西洋；1449年瓦剌俘获正统帝的土木之变，促使后世明廷大力修筑长城。1616年女真首领努尔哈赤建立后金，其子皇太极于1636年改国号为大清；1644年李自成的起义军推翻明朝后，满洲人经山海关进入北京。康熙帝于1681年平定三藩，1683年收复台湾，又数次征讨准噶尔；康熙与乾隆治下的盛世带来长期和平，人口增至约三亿，而1796—1804年的白莲教起义和广州一口通商体制，也预示着新世纪正在积聚的危机。

en: The Churajón were a pre-Inca people of the Arequipa region in southern Peru, named after their principal town, the stone-and-mud ruin of Churajón lying at 3,100 metres below the Choquellampa hill. Their farming ancestors moved west from the Lake Titicaca altiplano after the decline of Tiwanaku, and between 600 and 1400 they occupied the Chili and Tambo river valleys, spreading across Arequipa, Moquegua and Tacna and sending settlers down to the warm coastal valleys, where they grew maize and chili peppers. Archaeologists divide their culture into an early phase of 800 to 1200, contemporary with the Wari, an autonomous middle phase of 1200 to 1400, and a late phase under Inca influence. They built terraced fields, canals, reservoirs and roads, buried their nobles in stone chullpas, and made rustic red, black and white pottery painted with geometric motifs. The Inca armies reached the region around 1450, and the coastal Churajón lands were reorganized into the wamani of Atico and Caravelí within Kuntisuyu.
zh: 丘拉洪人是秘鲁南部阿雷基帕地区的前印加族群，得名于他们的主要城镇——坐落在乔克兰帕山脚下、海拔3100米的石土废墟丘拉洪。其务农的先民在蒂亚瓦纳科衰落之后从的的喀喀湖高原西迁，于600年至1400年间占据奇利河与坦博河谷地，足迹遍及阿雷基帕、莫克瓜和塔克纳，并有人下移到温暖的沿海河谷种植玉米和辣椒。考古学家把他们的文化分为三期：800年至1200年与瓦里并存的早期、1200年至1400年的自治中期，以及受印加影响的晚期。他们修筑梯田、灌渠、蓄水池和道路，把贵族葬在石造墓塔丘尔帕中，烧制饰有几何纹样的红、黑、白三色粗陶。1450年前后印加军队进入这一地区，丘拉洪人的沿海故土被改组为孔蒂苏尤下辖的阿蒂科和卡拉韦利两个瓦马尼，即行省。

en:
Cahokia was the greatest city of the Mississippian culture, raised on the Mississippi floodplain in present-day south-western Illinois, near the confluence of the Mississippi, Missouri and Illinois rivers. Farming villages had stood there since about 600, and mound-building began in the ninth century, but around 1050 a planned city of plazas, causeways and earthen pyramids was laid out almost overnight. Its people moved some 55 million cubic feet of earth by basket alone to raise about 120 mounds, together with calendar circles of timber posts known as woodhenges. At its peak around 1100 the city covered six square miles and held 15,000 to 20,000 people, drawing pilgrims and traders from the Great Lakes to the Gulf Coast, whose copper, shark teeth and whelk shells have been found in its burials, including the mass sacrifices of Mound 72.

Decline set in during the late twelfth century: a timber palisade went up around 1175, the population had fallen by half by the mid-thirteenth, and by 1350 the city was abandoned, part of a wider emptying of the middle Mississippi valley amid drought, flooding and warfare. Its original name is lost; later French explorers named the ruins after the Cahokia, an Illiniwek people then living nearby.
zh:
卡霍基亚是密西西比文化最伟大的城市，矗立在今伊利诺伊州西南部的密西西比河冲积平原上，地近密西西比河、密苏里河与伊利诺伊河交汇处。约600年起已有农耕村落，9世纪开始修筑土墩；但在1050年前后，一座由广场、堤道和土质金字塔组成的规划城市几乎在一夜之间铺开。人们仅凭篮筐搬运约5500万立方英尺土方，堆起约120座土墩，并立起被称为木环阵的木柱历法圈。1100年前后的鼎盛期，全城占地六平方英里，人口达1.5万至2万，吸引着从五大湖到墨西哥湾沿岸的朝圣者与商人；来自远方的铜器、鲨鱼牙齿和海螺壳出土于墓葬，包括72号墩的人殉遗迹。

12世纪后期衰败开始：约1175年竖起木栅，13世纪中叶人口减半，到1350年城市已遭废弃，成为密西西比河中游广大地区在干旱、洪水与战乱中空虚化的一部分。它的原名已经失传，后来的法国探险家以当时居住在附近的伊利尼维克人卡霍基亚部落为这些遗迹命名。

en: The Bishopric of Chełmno, or Kulm in German, was the first of the four Prussian dioceses created by the papal legate William of Modena in 1243, the others being Warmia, Pomesania and Samland. Set in Chełmno Land, the earliest foothold won by the Teutonic Knights in Prussia, it was a suffragan of the archbishopric of Riga and, unlike Warmia, its cathedral canons were members of the Order. The chapter kept its cathedral at Chełmża, while from 1257 the bishops resided in the castle of Lubawa, which is why Lubawa was its seat in 1337. As a church territory within the Teutonic monastic state, its bishops and towns joined the Prussian Confederation, and when King Casimir IV reincorporated the region in 1454 the bishopric passed with it; the Second Peace of Thorn of 1466 confirmed it as part of Polish Royal Prussia and assigned it to the ecclesiastical province of Gniezno. After the secularization of the Order's state in 1525 it absorbed neighbouring fragments of the dissolved Pomesanian see. The partitions of Poland carried the diocese to the Kingdom of Prussia in 1772 and 1793, and in 1824 the episcopal seat moved to Pelplin.
zh: 海乌姆诺主教区德语称库尔姆，是1243年教皇使节摩德纳的威廉设立的四个普鲁士主教区中最早的一个，其余三个为瓦尔米亚、波梅萨尼亚和萨姆兰。它地处海乌姆诺地，即条顿骑士团在普鲁士最早的立足点，是里加大主教区的附属教区；与瓦尔米亚不同，这里的参事都是骑士团成员。参事会的主教座堂设在海乌姆扎，而主教自1257年起驻节卢巴瓦城堡，这正是1337年时它以卢巴瓦为首府的原因。作为条顿修道国家境内的教会领地，其主教和城镇加入了普鲁士邦联，1454年卡齐米日四世国王重新兼并该地区时，主教区也随之归入波兰；1466年《第二次托伦和约》确认它属于波兰的王室普鲁士，并划归格涅兹诺教省。1525年骑士团国家世俗化后，它吸收了被解散的波梅萨尼亚主教区的邻近残地。波兰瓜分时，该主教区于1772和1793年被普鲁士王国夺走，1824年主教驻地迁往佩尔普林。

en: The Chimú kingdom of Chimor, centered on the adobe metropolis of Chan Chan in the Moche Valley of northern Peru, arose around 900 on the ruins of the earlier Moche culture. Its founders are remembered as Taycanamo, who tradition says came over the sea on a balsa raft, and his son and grandson, who united the irrigated valley and then pushed beyond it. At its height Chimor stretched roughly a thousand kilometres along the Pacific coast, drawing wealth from irrigation farming, fishing, fine black pottery and gold and copper work, and from trade in Spondylus shells; the Moon, rather than the Sun, headed its pantheon. The Sican lands to the north were taken by conquest, and by the fifteenth century Chimor was the greatest power left on the Peruvian coast. Around 1470 the Inca emperor Topa Inca Yupanqui overran the kingdom, capturing its ruler Minchançaman and carrying him to Cusco; Chimor survived as an Inca client state until the Spanish reached Peru in 1532.
zh: 奇穆人的奇穆王国以今秘鲁北部莫切河谷的土坯大都会昌昌为中心，约在900年承接更早的莫切文化而兴起。传说开国者塔伊卡纳莫乘巴尔萨木筏渡海而来，他的儿子和孙子先统一了灌溉便利的河谷，再向外扩张。极盛时奇穆沿太平洋海岸绵延约一千公里，财富来自灌溉农业、渔业、精美的黑陶与金银铜器，以及海菊蛤贝壳贸易；在它的众神之中，月亮的地位高于太阳。北方的西坎土地被它以武力吞并，到15世纪，奇穆已是秘鲁海岸仅存的最强政权。约1470年，印加皇帝图帕克·印卡·尤潘基攻陷这个王国，俘虏君主明查卡曼并押往库斯科；奇穆作为印加的附庸存续到1532年西班牙人抵达秘鲁。

en: The County of Chiny was a Lotharingian principality of the Holy Roman Empire in the Ardennes, covering the valley of the Chiers and the Gaume uplands, with enclaves on the Meuse at Warcq and Givet. It grew out of the older County of Ivois: Count Otto built the fortress of Warcq in 971 and fixed his seat at Chiny around 980, becoming its first count. When Louis IV died without a male heir in 1226 his daughter Jeanne married Arnulf, Count of Looz, joining the two counties under one dynasty, which made Montmédy its capital; in 1285 Count Louis V held the great tournament of Chauvency, sung by the poet Jacques Bretel. Hard pressed by the Counts of Bar and the Bishops of Liège, the Heinsberg heir Theodoric, who ruled in 1337, sold the provostships of Ivois and Virton and the lordship of La Ferté to Count John I of Luxembourg between 1337 and 1340. In 1364 Wenceslas of Luxembourg bought the last remnants from Arnulf V, and Chiny was absorbed into the Duchy of Luxembourg, whose dukes retained the comital title.
zh: 希尼伯国是神圣罗马帝国在阿登地区的洛塔林吉亚封建邦国，领有希耶尔河谷与戈姆高地，并在默兹河畔的瓦尔克和日韦保有飞地。它由更古老的伊瓦伯国发展而来：奥托伯爵于971年修建瓦尔克要塞，约980年将驻地定在希尼，成为首任希尼伯爵。1226年路易四世无男嗣而终，其女让娜嫁给洛兹伯爵阿尔努，两个伯国由此并入同一家族，该家族定都蒙梅迪；1285年，路易五世伯爵举办盛大的绍旺西骑士比武，诗人雅克·勒泰勒将其写入名篇《绍旺西比武记》。在巴尔伯爵和列日主教的挤压下，1337年在位的海因斯贝格继承人迪特里希于1337至1340年间把伊瓦、维尔通的裁判辖区和拉费泰领地卖给卢森堡伯爵约翰一世。1364年，卢森堡的文策尔从阿尔努五世手中买下残余领地，希尼被并入卢森堡公国，公爵们则保留希尼伯爵的头衔。

en: The Principality of Chernihiv was one of the largest and richest states of Kievan Rus, centered on Chernihiv in the basins of the Desna and the Seim, the land of the Siverian tribe. In 1024 Mstislav, son of Vladimir the Great, made himself prince of Chernihiv and divided the Rus lands with his brother Yaroslav the Wise along the Dnieper; after Mstislav's death in 1036 it reverted to Kiev. The Council of Liubech of 1097 assigned Chernihiv to the sons of Sviatoslav, the Olgovichi, under whose rule it split into the Chernihiv, Novgorod-Seversk and Murom-Ryazan appanages; the failed Cuman campaign of Igor Sviatoslavich in 1185, sung in The Tale of Igor's Campaign, was waged from these lands. After the Mongol invasion the center of the Chernihiv-Severian lands shifted in 1238 to Bryansk, whose princes kept the title of grand prince of Chernihiv. In the early 1320s the principality acknowledged the suzerainty of the Lithuanian grand duke Gediminas, and Algirdas attached it firmly to Lithuania in 1356–1357; the last grand prince, Roman Mikhailovich, was killed in Smolensk in 1401. The war of 1500–1503 brought Chernihiv and the neighboring Severian towns to Ivan III of Moscow.
zh: 切尔尼戈夫公国是基辅罗斯最大、最富庶的国家之一，以杰斯纳河与谢伊姆河流域的切尔尼戈夫为中心，居民以谢韦里亚部落为主。1024年，弗拉基米尔大公之子姆斯季斯拉夫自立为切尔尼戈夫王公，与兄长智者雅罗斯拉夫沿第聂伯河瓜分罗斯国土；1036年姆斯季斯拉夫死后，该地重归基辅。1097年的柳别奇大会把切尔尼戈夫分给斯维亚托斯拉夫的后裔奥利戈维奇家族，治下又分裂出切尔尼戈夫、诺夫霍罗德-西韦尔斯基和穆罗姆-梁赞等封邑；1185年伊戈尔·斯维亚托斯拉维奇征伐波洛伏齐人失败，《伊戈尔远征记》歌咏的正是这场出征。蒙古入侵后，切尔尼戈夫-谢韦里亚诸地的中心于1238年转到布良斯克，布良斯克王公仍保留切尔尼戈夫大公的头衔。14世纪20年代初，公国承认立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯的宗主权，阿尔吉尔达斯又在1356—1357年把它稳固地并入立陶宛；末代大公罗曼·米哈伊洛维奇于1401年在斯摩棱斯克被杀。1500—1503年的战争后，切尔尼戈夫与邻近的谢韦里亚诸城转入莫斯科的伊凡三世之手。

en: The Ch'orti' are a Maya people of the mountainous borderlands where eastern Guatemala meets western Honduras and northern El Salvador, and their tongue is the surviving form of the Classic Maya language carved on the stelae of Copán. That city, called Oxwitik by its rulers, was their ancient cultural center: a dynasty founded by K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo' in 426 ruled there for nearly four hundred years, until in 738 Copán's king was captured and beheaded by his former vassal, the ruler of Quiriguá, and the city was abandoned early in the tenth century. The Ch'orti' themselves lived on in scattered towns reaching from Chiquimula and Ocotepeque to Tejutla, a settlement founded in the fifth century. When the Spanish reached these borderlands in the early sixteenth century, Tejutla was destroyed and the Ch'orti' communities were brought under the new colonial governments of Guatemala and Honduras.
zh: 乔尔蒂人是居住在危地马拉东部、洪都拉斯西部与萨尔瓦多北部交界山区的玛雅民族，他们的语言是古典玛雅语的存留形态，正是科潘石碑铭文所用的语言。科潘被其统治者称为奥克斯维蒂克，是乔尔蒂人古代的文化中心：基尼奇·亚克斯·库克·莫于426年开创的王朝在此统治近四百年；738年，科潘国王被昔日附庸基里瓜的君主俘获并斩首，城市也在10世纪初遭废弃。乔尔蒂人继续生活在从奇基穆拉、奥科特佩克到特胡特拉的分散城镇中，其中特胡特拉建于5世纪。16世纪初西班牙人进入这片边境地带后，特胡特拉被毁，乔尔蒂人的社群被纳入危地马拉和洪都拉斯的新殖民政府治下。

en: Chieri began as Karreum, a hilltop settlement of the Ligurian Taurini, and became the Roman municipium of Carreum Potentia near Turin. In the tenth century Emperor Otto III granted it as a fief to the bishop of Turin, but over the following centuries its citizens quietly built a free commune, with consuls, revenues and a ring of walls, earning it the nickname the city of a hundred towers. It fought alongside Asti against William V of Montferrat in 1154, and Frederick Barbarossa sacked and burned it in January 1155 before doing the same to Asti; the two cities signed a mutual defence pact in 1169 and prospered together on the trade routes from Genoa. In 1238 Emperor Frederick II declared Chieri a camera speciale, subject to the emperor alone, and by the later thirteenth century its republic rivalled Genoa and Pisa in wealth. Factional strife then eroded its autonomy: in 1339, two years after the game's opening, the commune submitted to King Robert of Anjou of Naples and granted half its lands to James of the Savoy-Acaia line. When that line died out the whole city passed to the House of Savoy, under which it knew Renaissance prosperity, brief French rule from 1551 to 1562, and a severe plague in 1630; in 1785 it was made a principality for the Duke of Aosta before the Napoleonic conquest.
zh: 基耶里的前身是利古里亚人陶里尼部在山丘上建立的聚落卡雷乌姆，罗马时代成为都灵附近的自治城卡雷乌姆·波滕提亚。10世纪时，皇帝奥托三世把它封给都灵主教，但在随后的几个世纪里，市民一步步建起拥有执政官、财政收入和环城城墙的自由公社，城里塔楼林立，赢得了百塔之城的绰号。1154年，它与阿斯蒂联手击败蒙费拉托的威廉五世；1155年1月，红胡子腓特烈将其洗劫焚毁，接着又对阿斯蒂如法炮制。1169年，两城签订互助盟约，靠着热那亚方向的商路一同致富。1238年，皇帝腓特烈二世宣布基耶里为特别御辖地，只臣服于皇帝本人；到13世纪后期，这个共和国的富庶已可与热那亚、比萨比肩。此后党派内讧侵蚀了它的自治：1339年，也就是游戏开局两年后，公社向那不勒斯国王安茹的罗贝托称臣，并把一半土地封给萨伏依—阿基亚支系的贾科莫。阿基亚支系绝嗣后，整座城市归入萨伏依王室，此后经历了文艺复兴的繁荣、1551至1562年法国人的短暂统治和1630年的大瘟疫；1785年它被封为奥斯塔公爵的亲王国，随后又被拿破仑征服。

en: Chūzan was the central of the three Okinawan kingdoms of the Sanzan period, formed around 1314 when the lords of Nakijin and Ōzato broke away from Tamagusuku, who kept Urasoe and the center of the island. Tamagusuku died in 1336 and was followed by his young son Seii, whose mother's misrule cost the court its support; around 1350 the Urasoe lord Satto seized the throne. Satto opened tribute and trade across the region, and the first Ming envoys arrived in 1372, beginning the tributary relationship that brought Chinese investiture, immigrants and writing to Okinawa; the Chinese settlement of Kumemura supplied the kingdom's diplomats and officials. Satto's son Bunei succeeded in 1395 and was formally invested by the Ming court in 1406. Shō Hashi, lord of Sashiki, then overthrew Bunei and went on to conquer Hokuzan and Nanzan by 1429, making Chūzan the core of the unified Ryukyu Kingdom.
zh: 中山是三山时代冲绳岛上三个王国中的中央政权，约1314年今归仁和大里的首领脱离玉城后，玉城保有浦添与岛屿中部，中山由此形成。玉城于1336年去世，年幼的儿子西威继位，其母干政乱政，使朝廷尽失人心；约1350年浦添首领察度夺取王位。察度广泛开展朝贡与贸易，1372年明朝首批使节抵达冲绳，开启了中琉朝贡关系，中国的册封、移民与文字随之而来，华人聚居的久米村为王国提供了外交官和官吏。察度之子武宁于1395年继位，1406年接受明朝的正式册封。此后佐敷按司尚巴志推翻武宁，又于1429年前征服北山与南山，以中山为核心建立了统一的琉球王国。

en: The Chincha Kingdom was the state of the Chincha people in the fertile oasis valleys of Peru's southwestern coast, near present-day Chincha Alta. The Chincha culture took shape in the eleventh century, possibly from highland migrants, and during the Late Intermediate Period its rulers, based at the adobe capital of La Centinela, built irrigation works, great adobe pyramids and straight roads into the Andes. The Chincha were above all a trading power: merchants sailed the Pacific on large balsa-log rafts with sails, exchanging Spondylus shells and worked metals from Ecuador to Chile and perhaps as far as Central America, while camelid caravans linked the valley with Cusco and the Collao altiplano. They fertilized their maize fields with guano, consulted the rich oracle of Chinchaycamac and worshipped a jaguar god from whom they claimed descent. An early Spanish census counted thirty thousand households, including six thousand traders. By about 1480 Inca armies under Pachacuti and Tupac Yupanqui had absorbed Chincha into the empire, leaving its rulers broad autonomy and the highest honours at the court of Cusco. The Chincha lord was the only man besides Atahualpa carried in a litter to Cajamarca, where he was killed in the Spanish ambush of 1532. The Spaniards reached the valley in 1534 and had founded a Dominican mission by 1542, and within eighty-five years epidemics and colonial rule had reduced the native population by an estimated ninety-nine percent.
zh: 钦查王国是钦查人在秘鲁西南海岸肥沃绿洲河谷建立的政权，靠近今天的钦查阿尔塔城。钦查文化形成于11世纪，可能源自一波来自高原的移民；在地区国家并立的晚中间时期，其统治者以土坯都城拉森蒂内拉为中心，修筑灌溉工程、巨大的土坯金字塔和通向安第斯山区的笔直道路网。钦查人首先是一个贸易强权：渔民和商人驾驶带帆的大型巴尔沙木筏出海，用海菊蛤贝壳和金属制品沿太平洋海岸往返于厄瓜多尔与智利之间，航程可能远达中美洲；骆马商队又把河谷同库斯科和科利亚奥高原陆路相连。他们用鸟粪肥田，供奉富有的神谕所钦查卡马克，并崇拜自认为祖先的美洲豹神。早期西班牙人口调查记录了三万户，其中六千户是商人。15世纪，帕查库特克与其子图帕克·尤潘基的印加军队进入河谷，到1480年前后钦查被纳入印加帝国，但统治者保留了很大的自治权，并在库斯科宫廷享有最高等级的礼遇。1532年卡哈马卡之变中，钦查首领是除阿塔瓦尔帕外唯一乘轿赴会的人，却在西班牙人的伏击中被杀。西班牙人1534年进入河谷，1542年建立多明我会传教区；八十五年间，疫病和殖民统治使当地人口估计减少了百分之九十九。

en: Cihuatlan, whose Nahuatl name means “place of women”, lay on the Costa Grande of the Pacific coast in what is now Guerrero, around the bay of modern Zihuatanejo. In the Postclassic period its towns, together with Xihuacan and Petatlán, belonged to the Cuitlatec-speaking dominion of Cuitlatepan, whose chief centre was Mexcaltepec; the region drew salt from the coastal lagoons and kept its own pantheon, in which the goddess Cihuateotl was honoured as protector of women who died in childbirth. Long independent of the highland empires, the coast was finally overrun by the Mexica emperor Ahuitzotl between 1497 and 1504, and Cihuatlan was organised as a tribute province of the Aztec Empire, registered as such in the Codex Mendoza and the Matrícula de Tributos, with its territory stretching from the Balsas River to the country around Acapulco. Spanish forces reached the area in the 1520s, and the Cuitlatec population, ravaged by epidemic and war, resisted for more than sixty years before the old towns were abandoned.
zh: 锡瓦特兰的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“女人之地”，位于太平洋岸的科斯塔格兰德，即今格雷罗州锡瓦塔内霍湾一带。后古典期，这里的城镇与锡瓦坎、佩塔特兰同属讲奎特拉特克语的库伊特拉特潘领地，其首要中心是梅斯卡尔特佩克；当地人在沿海潟湖产盐，信奉自己的众神，其中女神西瓦泰奥特被尊为产妇的保护者。这片海岸长期独立于高地帝国之外，直到1497至1504年间被墨西加君主阿维索特尔征服，锡瓦特兰被编为阿兹特克帝国的一个贡赋省，《门多萨手抄本》和《贡税册》都有记载，辖境从巴尔萨斯河一直延伸到阿卡普尔科一带。1520年代西班牙人抵达该地，奎特拉特克人口在疫病和战争中锐减，仍抵抗了六十多年，古城最终遭到废弃。

en: The Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia was founded by Armenian refugees fleeing the Seljuk conquest of the Armenian highlands. Around 1080 the Rubenid dynasty built a principality in the Cilician plain, ruling first from Tarsus and later from Sis, and in 1198 Leo I was crowned king in Tarsus Cathedral with western backing. In 1226 the throne passed to the Hethumid dynasty through Queen Isabella and her husband Hethum I, who allied with the Mongol Ilkhanate against the Egyptian Mamluks; the port of Ayas became a busy hub of trade between Europe and the East, and the seat of the Armenian Catholicos moved to Sis after the Mamluks sacked Hromkla in 1293. In 1337 the kingdom was ruled by Leo IV, pressed by Mamluk raids and dynastic strife. Under the later Lusignan kings, efforts to bring the Armenian Church under Rome deepened internal divisions, while the Mamluks overran one stronghold after another. Sis fell and the kingdom ended in 1375; its last king, Leo V, died in exile in Paris in 1393, and his title passed to the kings of Cyprus.
zh: 奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王国由躲避塞尔柱人征服亚美尼亚高原的亚美尼亚难民建立。约1080年，鲁本王朝在奇里乞亚平原建立公国，先后以塔尔苏斯和锡斯为都；1198年，莱昂一世在西方支持下于塔尔苏斯大教堂加冕为王。1226年，王位经女王伊莎贝拉与其丈夫海屯一世转入海屯王朝，海屯与蒙古伊儿汗国结盟对抗埃及马穆鲁克；阿亚斯港成为欧洲与东方之间繁忙的贸易中心，1293年马穆鲁克劫掠赫罗姆克拉后，亚美尼亚卡托利科斯的教座也迁至锡斯。1337年在位的是莱昂四世，王国饱受马穆鲁克袭扰和王族内争之苦。其后的吕西尼昂诸王试图让亚美尼亚教会归附罗马，加剧了内部分裂，马穆鲁克则接连攻陷要塞。1375年锡斯陷落，王国灭亡；末代国王莱昂五世流亡巴黎，于1393年去世，其头衔转归塞浦路斯国王。

en: Cina was one of the earliest Bugis kingdoms of South Sulawesi, with its heartland in the Walennae valley, in the country that later passed under Soppeng and Bone. Bugis tradition names La Sattumpugi as its first king, and the Bugis still call themselves To Ugi, the followers of La Sattumpugi, in his memory; the kingdom also figures in the La Galigo creation epic. Around 1300 Cina led a loose confederation of communities spread along the Walennae valley, tying the villages of neighboring Soppeng to it through marriage alliances. Its power faded in the mid-1500s, and around 1550 its valley communities were seized by Datu La Mataesso of Soppeng Riaja and absorbed into the newly unified Kingdom of Soppeng, leaving Cina to live on chiefly as a place name in the Bone countryside.
zh: 至那是南苏拉威西最早的布吉人王国之一，核心在瓦伦奈河谷，这片土地后来先后归入索彭和波尼。布吉传说把拉·萨通普吉奉为它的初代国王，布吉人自称“托乌吉”，意为“拉·萨通普吉的追随者”，名称即源于他；这个王国也登场于创世史诗《拉加利戈》。1300年前后，至那在瓦伦奈河谷统领一个松散的聚落联盟，并通过联姻与邻近索彭的各村结成关系。16世纪中叶国势衰落，约1550年，河谷中的聚落被索彭里亚贾的达图·拉·马塔埃索夺取，并入新统一的索彭王国，“至那”之后主要作为波尼乡间的地名留存下来。

en: The Land of Cuijk was a lordship of the Holy Roman Empire in the north-east of the present-day Dutch province of North Brabant, wedged between the Maas and the Peel marshes. Its lords are recorded from the eleventh century. Around 1133 the lord of Cuijk was exiled and his castle destroyed as punishment for the murder of Floris the Black; on his return he built a new castle downstream on the Maas, around which the town of Grave grew up and replaced Cuijk as the seat of government, though the lordship's court remained at Cuijk. Although a vassal of Guelders, the lord fought for Brabant at the Battle of Worringen in 1288, after which the Land of Cuijk came under the Duchy of Brabant. Jan I, who died in 1308, was the most powerful of the line; in 1337 the lordship was held by his son Otto, who had succeeded an uncle in 1319 and also held Mierlo and Asten. Disputed between Guelders and Brabant, the land was sold to the Duke of Guelders at the end of the fourteenth century and returned to Brabant in the fifteenth. In 1559 it was pledged to William of Orange, and after the capture of Grave by Maurice of Nassau in 1602 it passed to the Dutch Republic at the Peace of Münster in 1648, becoming part of the generality lands of States Brabant, until the Batavian Revolution abolished the lordship in 1795.
zh: 克伊克领地是神圣罗马帝国的一处领主地，位于今荷兰北布拉班特省东北部，夹在马斯河与皮尔沼泽之间。克伊克领主自11世纪起见诸记载，后来还自称伯爵，但与周边强邦的关系一直动荡。约1133年，克伊克领主因参与谋杀黑弗洛里斯而被流放，城堡也遭拆毁；他获赦归来后在马斯河下游另筑新城堡，赫拉弗城就在城堡周围兴起，并取代克伊克成为统治中心，不过领地的法庭和议会仍留在克伊克。克伊克本是海尔德的封臣，但领主在1288年沃林根战役中站在布拉班特一方，战后克伊克领地转归布拉班特公国。1308年去世的扬一世是家族中最有权势的领主；1337年在位的是他的儿子奥托，他于1319年继承叔父的位子，同时领有米尔洛和阿斯滕。由于在海尔德与布拉班特之间反复易主，这块领地在14世纪末被卖给海尔德公爵，15世纪又划归布拉班特。1559年它被抵押给奥兰治的威廉；1602年赫拉弗被拿骚的莫里斯攻占后，依据1648年的《明斯特和约》并入尼德兰联省共和国，成为议会直辖地国务布拉班特的一部分。1795年巴达维亚革命爆发，领地制度被彻底废除。

en: Minyag is the game's name for the Kingdom of Chakla, the Mingzheng tusi whose seat was the trading town of Dartsedo on the border between Kham and China proper. A chiefdom had grown up there by the late thirteenth century, and in 1407 the Ming invested its chief Awang Jiancan as Xuanwei commissioner of Changhexi, Yutong and Ningyuan. With Bathang, Lithang and Derge it counted among the Four Great Native Chiefdoms of Kham, and Dartsedo grew rich on the tea-and-horse trade between Tibet and Sichuan. The Ganden Phodrang government stationed a tax commissioner there; resentment of Lhasa's levies drove the Chakla king into alliance with the rising Qing, and after a rebellion in 1666 Lhasa invaded and had the king murdered in 1699. Qing troops killed the commissioner the next year, and an imperial reorganisation of 1725 placed Chakla firmly under Qing tusi rule.
zh: 明正即藏文史料中的查克拉王国、汉文记载里的明正土司，治所是地处康区与汉地交界的商贸重镇打箭炉。13世纪末这里已形成酋长政权，1407年当地土酋阿旺坚参内附，被明朝封为长河西、鱼通、宁远宣慰使。它与巴塘、理塘、德格并称康区四大土司，打箭炉也凭藏川之间的茶马贸易而繁盛。西藏甘丹颇章政权在此派驻征税营官，对拉萨苛税的不满驱使查克拉王与崛起中的清朝结盟；1666年反叛后拉萨出兵，国王于1699年被营官杀害。次年清军诛杀营官，1725年朝廷重整藏区建制，明正被彻底纳入清朝的土司体系。

en: Chakán Putum was a Putún Maya chiefdom on the southwestern Gulf coast, whose capital stood at the mouth of the Champotón River, beneath modern Champotón. The port was said to hold 8,000 buildings and a fishing fleet of more than 2,000 canoes, and it anchored the sea road linking the Chontal towns of Tabasco, such as Potonchán and Xicalango, with the rest of Yucatán. Together with the related Putún of Chactemal, its people traded and migrated along the coast, and the Mexica knew the whole Campeche shore as Chochistán. In 1517 the warriors of Chakán Putum met the first Spanish expedition off their beaches and routed Francisco Hernández de Córdoba in the fight the Castilians called the Mala Pelea; over fifty Spaniards died and Córdoba himself later succumbed to his wounds. Juan de Grijalva returned in 1518 and stormed the town at the cost of some two hundred Maya dead. The Spaniards came back to stay in 1538, when Lorenzo de Godoy moved the settlement of San Pedro Tanoche to the river mouth as their first permanent foothold on the peninsula, renamed Salamanca de Champotón.
zh: 查坎普图姆是普屯玛雅人的城邦，位于尤卡坦西南部的墨西哥湾沿岸，都城坐落在钱波通河口，即今钱波通城下。这座港口据说有八千座建筑和两千多条独木舟组成的渔船队，是塔巴斯科琼塔尔诸城（如波通昌和希卡兰科）通往尤卡坦各地海路的枢纽。它与同族的查克特埃马尔普屯人沿海贸易、彼此迁徙，墨西加人把整个坎佩奇海岸称作乔奇斯坦。1517年，查坎普图姆的战士在海滩迎击首支西班牙远征队，击溃弗朗西斯科·埃尔南德斯·德·科尔多瓦——卡斯蒂利亚人称之为“恶战”——50余名西班牙人毙命，科尔多瓦本人也因伤重不治。1518年胡安·德·格里哈尔瓦卷土重来强攻该城，约200名玛雅人战死。1538年西班牙人再度立足，洛伦索·德·戈多伊把圣佩德罗塔诺切村迁到河口，改名萨拉曼卡·德·钱波通，成为他们在半岛上第一个永久据点。

en: Clandeboye, in Irish Clann Aodha Buí, the family of Hugh the Blond, was a Gaelic Irish kingdom covering southern Antrim and northern Down around Belfast Lough, together with the Loughinsholin district west of the River Bann. Its O'Neill kings descended from Hugh Boy O'Neill, a thirteenth-century king of Tyrone whose branch supplied three kings of Tyrone before losing out to a rival O'Neill line. As the Norman Earldom of Ulster, held by the de Burghs and later the Mortimers, collapsed in the fourteenth century, the O'Neills overran its eastern districts; Niall Mór of Tyrone drove out many Anglo-Norman settlers, and by 1347 Muirchertach Ceannfada O'Neill ruled Clandeboye as a kingdom in its own right, at first as an under-king of Tyrone and soon as an autonomous power balancing the lords of Tyrone, the O'Donnells of Tyrconnell and the English of Dublin. Cattle grazing brought the dynasty wealth, and its chiefs held Shane's Castle and Castle Reagh. The kingdom survived the Tudors but ended with the Ulster plantations: the last chief, Conn O'Neill, was forced to sign away two-thirds of his lands to the Scots Hugh Montgomery and James Hamilton, died in poverty in 1618, and Hamilton was created Viscount Claneboye in 1622.
zh: 克兰迪博伊，爱尔兰语意为“金发休的家族”，是盖尔人的爱尔兰王国，领有贝尔法斯特湾一带的南安特里姆和北唐地区，以及班恩河以西的洛欣肖林。其奥尼尔王族出自13世纪的蒂龙国王休·博伊·奥尼尔，这一支曾出过多位蒂龙国王，后来在家族内争中败给另一支奥尼尔。14世纪，德伯格家族、继而莫蒂默家族把持的诺曼人阿尔斯特伯爵领崩溃，奥尼尔氏趁机吞并其东部领地；蒂龙的尼尔·莫尔驱逐了许多盎格鲁-诺曼定居者，到1347年，穆尔切塔赫·坎法达·奥尼尔已作为独立的国王统治克兰迪博伊——起初还只是蒂龙的附庸小王，很快便自立门户，在蒂龙、泰尔康奈尔的奥唐纳家族和都柏林英格兰政权之间纵横捭阖。牧牛业为这个王朝带来财富，首领们坐镇肖恩城堡和雷城堡。王国挺过了都铎时代，却终结于阿尔斯特种植园：末代首领康恩·奥尼尔被迫把三分之二的土地割让给苏格兰人休·蒙哥马利和詹姆斯·汉密尔顿，1618年在贫困中死去，汉密尔顿则于1622年受封克兰迪博伊子爵。

en: Chalco was a Nahua confederacy on the eastern shore of the lake of the same name in the Valley of Mexico, uniting four sub-kingdoms, Tlalmanalco, Amaquemecan, Tenanco and Chimalhuacan, each with its own tlatoani. Its earliest people were remembered as rain-making sorcerers, and after the fall of Tollan waves of Toltec and Chichimec settlers gave the Chalca their later shape. In 1337 it remained an independent power, and through the fourteenth and early fifteenth centuries it fought repeated flower wars against the rising Aztecs. Open war came in 1446 after the Chalca refused to send stone for the temple of Huitzilopochtli, and Moctezuma I conquered the confederacy around 1465, exiling its kings to Huexotzinco; the musician Quecholcohuatl helped win their restoration under Tizoc in 1486. Chalco then became the valley's heaviest supplier of food tribute to Tenochtitlan. When Pedro de Alvarado arrived in the autumn of 1519 the Chalca turned against the Aztecs and joined the Spanish siege of Tenochtitlan, and by 1533 their land had become a Spanish corregimiento.
zh: 查尔科是墨西哥谷地中同名湖泊东岸的纳瓦人城邦联盟，由特拉尔马纳尔科、阿梅克梅坎、特南科和奇马尔瓦坎四个子城邦组成，各有自己的特拉托阿尼。当地最早的居民以能呼风唤雨的巫师之名传世，图拉城陷落后，一批批托尔特克和奇奇梅克移民涌入，塑造了后来的查尔科人。1337年时它仍是独立强权，在14世纪至15世纪初与崛起的阿兹特克人反复进行荣冠战争。1446年，查尔科人拒绝为威齐洛波奇特利神庙输送石料，双方全面开战；约1465年，蒙特祖马一世征服这个联盟，把它的诸王放逐到韦霍钦戈。乐师克乔尔科瓦特尔从中斡旋，诸王终于在1486年获蒂索克恢复王位。此后查尔科成为墨西哥谷地向特诺奇蒂特兰缴纳粮食贡赋最多的地区。1519年秋佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多到来后，查尔科人倒戈相向，加入西班牙人对特诺奇蒂特兰的围攻；到1533年，他们的土地已成为西班牙的一个督办辖区。

en: Chelei was the country of the Chele branch of the Yi, in the wooded hills north of the Chishui River on the Sichuan-Guizhou border; by the Tang dynasty their lands stretched from Xuyong in Sichuan to Bijie in Guizhou, the country later known as Yongning, in which Gulin lies. The Yuan and Ming enrolled its chiefs as tusi of Yongning, held hereditarily by the Yi She family. In 1621 the Yongning chief She Chongming, pressed for troops and grain for the Ming war in Liaodong, seized Chongqing and had himself proclaimed king; together with the Shuixi regent An Bangyan he opened the eight-year She-An rebellion, which convulsed Sichuan and Guizhou until both leaders were killed in battle in 1629 and their rising was dismantled.
zh: 车勒是彝族恒支车勒一部的故土，地处川黔边界、赤水河以北的山林；到唐代，车勒的势力已从四川叙永延伸到贵州毕节，这一带后来以永宁之名见称，古蔺就在这片山地之中。元、明两代，朝廷封其首领为永宁土司，由彝族奢氏世袭。1621年，永宁土司奢崇明被催调援辽的兵马粮草，遂袭取重庆、拥众称王，又联合水西摄政安邦彦发动历时八年的奢安之乱，兵祸席卷四川、贵州；1629年奢崇明与安邦彦战死，叛乱平定。

en: Cilli, the Slovene Celje in the Savinja valley of Lower Styria, began as the Roman municipium Claudia Celeia, a walled town of marble palaces and a famous temple of Mars that was called the second Troy before the Slavs destroyed it in the sixth century. Rebuilt in the High Middle Ages and first mentioned as Cylie around 1130, it passed to the Lords of Sanneck, who became Habsburg vassals in 1308. Frederick of Sanneck inherited the Heunburg and Celje estates and, as the trusted governor of Carniola, was raised to immediate count of the Empire by Emperor Louis IV at Munich in 1341. Thus began the Counts of Cilli, who soon held more than twenty castles across Styria, Carinthia, Carniola and Croatia and married into the Polish, Hungarian and Bosnian ruling houses. Count Hermann II saved King Sigismund's life at Nicopolis in 1396, gained vast Croatian estates and gave his daughter Barbara to the king in marriage in 1405; the family inherited the Ortenburg lands in 1418 and were raised to imperial princes in 1436. Their peak under Ulrich II ended with his murder in 1456, when the dynasty died out and the Habsburgs, armed with a mutual inheritance treaty of 1443, took Cilli, whose new walls withstood the Ottoman advance and the Slovene peasant revolt of 1515.
zh: 采列（斯洛文尼亚语称采列，德语称齐利）位于下施蒂里亚的萨维尼亚河谷，其前身是罗马自治城克劳狄亚·采莱亚：当年这里城墙环绕、大理石宫殿林立，还有闻名帝国的玛尔斯神庙，被人称作“第二个特洛伊”，6世纪时被斯拉夫人摧毁。中世纪重建后，约1130年以“齐利亚”之名首见记载，后落入桑内克领主之手，该家族于1308年成为哈布斯堡的附庸。桑内克的弗雷德里克继承了霍因堡和采列的地产，作为深受信任的卡尼奥拉总督，于1341年在慕尼黑被皇帝路易四世升为直属帝国的伯爵。采列伯爵家族由此崛起，很快在施蒂里亚、克恩滕、卡尼奥拉和克罗地亚拥有二十多座城堡，并与波兰、匈牙利和波斯尼亚的统治家族联姻。1396年，赫尔曼二世在尼科波利斯救下国王西吉斯蒙德，获得克罗地亚大片地产，1405年又将女儿芭芭拉嫁给国王；1418年家族继承奥尔滕堡领地，1436年晋升为帝国诸侯。乌尔里希二世在位时势力达到顶峰，但他1456年遇刺身亡，家族绝嗣，哈布斯堡凭1443年的相互继承条约取得采列；此后新城墙抵挡住了奥斯曼人的推进和1515年的斯洛文尼亚农民起义。

en: Cholollan, whose ruins lie beneath present-day Cholula just west of present-day Puebla, was one of the oldest continuously occupied cities of Mesoamerica, settled from before the second century BC and dominated by the Great Pyramid of Tlachihualtepetl, the largest pyramid by volume in the Americas. After Tolteca-Chichimeca peoples took the city around 1200, it became a Nahua altepetl governed through the dual rule of the Aquiach and Tlalchiach lords and famed across central Mexico as the chief pilgrimage sanctuary of Quetzalcoatl, its markets linking the Gulf coast, the Valley of Mexico and the routes to the Pacific. In the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries Cholollan was drawn into the orbit of neighboring Tlaxcala and became one of the three cities of the Tlaxcalan Triple Alliance. It broke with Tlaxcala in 1517 to join the Aztec Triple Alliance, and the betrayal was punished in 1519 when the Tlaxcalans guided Hernan Cortes to its gates: the Spaniards killed the city's assembled warriors in the Cholula Massacre, installed a friendly leadership and returned it to the Tlaxcalan alliance. Under Spanish rule Cholollan was overshadowed by the newly founded city of Puebla nearby.
zh: 乔卢拉即今普埃布拉城以西乔卢拉城的前身，是美索美洲最古老的持续有人居住的城市之一，早在公元前2世纪以前便已形成聚落，城中的特拉奇瓦尔特佩特尔大金字塔是美洲体积最大的金字塔。约1200年托尔特卡-奇奇梅卡人夺取该城后，它成为一个纳瓦人的阿尔特佩特尔，由阿基亚奇与特拉尔基亚奇两位首领实行双重统治，并作为魁札尔科亚特尔信仰的首要朝圣圣地名闻整个墨西哥中部，其市场连接着海湾沿岸、墨西哥谷地和通往太平洋的商路。13至14世纪，乔卢拉被邻邦特拉斯卡拉拉入势力范围，成为特拉斯卡拉三城同盟的成员。1517年它脱离特拉斯卡拉、转投阿兹特克三邦同盟；1519年，特拉斯卡拉人把埃尔南·科尔特斯引到城下，为这次背叛报了仇：西班牙人在乔卢拉屠杀中屠戮了集结的武士，换上亲西的领导层，把乔卢拉重新纳回特拉斯卡拉同盟。西班牙殖民时期，乔卢拉的地位被附近新建的普埃布拉城取代。

en: The Señorío of Colima was a Teco, or Colimeca, polity on the Pacific coast of western Mexico, in the region that now forms the state of Colima. Its rulers held the Nahuatl title of huey tlatoani, and the best remembered of them, Colimotl or Rey Colimán, led his people in the Saltpeter War of 1480 to 1510 against the expanding Purépecha Empire. The Purépecha were driven back, and the lords of Sayula, Zapotlán and Amula became Colima's tributaries, making it the dominant power of the coast. When the Spanish arrived, Colima defeated two early expeditions at Trojes and Tecomán before Gonzalo de Sandoval's campaign of 1522 and 1523 broke its resistance. Colimotl was killed at the battle of Alima near modern Tecomán, and later in 1523 Sandoval founded the Villa de Colima at Caxitlán, the first Spanish town in the region.
zh: 科利马邦是西墨西哥太平洋沿岸的特科人（又称科利梅卡人）政权，辖地大致相当于今墨西哥科利马州一带，统治者使用纳瓦特尔语的“伟大发言人”头衔。最著名的统治者科利莫特尔（又称科利马王）在1480至1510年的硝石战争中率众抵御扩张中的普雷佩查帝国，将其逐回，并使萨尤拉、萨波特兰和阿穆拉的首领向科利马纳贡，科利马由此成为沿海最强大的势力。西班牙人到来后，科利马先后在特罗赫斯和特科马击败两支早期远征军，但1522至1523年贡萨洛·德·桑多瓦尔的攻势瓦解了其抵抗：科利莫特尔在今特科马附近的阿利马战役中阵亡，同年桑多瓦尔在卡锡特兰建立科利马镇，这是西班牙人在该地区建立的第一座城镇。

en: Chilapa, called Chilapan in pre-Hispanic times, was a Coixca town in the small valleys of central Guerrero, a multiethnic region where Nahuatl-speaking Coixca communities lived interspersed with Tlapanec, Chontal and Matlame villages; traces of human occupation there reach back to about 1200 BC. Its name refers to the chiles grown in its well-watered ground, and the town traded foodstuffs, honey and woven petate mats to the Pacific coast in exchange for salt and cacao. In 1458 the Aztec tlatoani Moctezuma I sent the lord Texolo Tecutlicute to plant an outpost on the Chilapantepetl hill, bringing the area under Mexica domination and giving Chilapa its first formal charter. Spanish troops under Gonzalo Sandoval took the hill town in 1522, and it was later reorganised as an Augustinian mission settlement in the valley below.
zh: 奇拉帕前西班牙时期称奇拉潘，是格雷罗中部小谷地中的科伊克斯卡人城镇；这是一个多族杂处的地区，讲纳瓦特尔语的科伊克斯卡聚落与特拉帕内克、琼塔尔和马特拉梅人的村落交错分布，当地人类活动的痕迹可追溯到约公元前1200年。它的名字取自水浇地里种植的辣椒；该镇向太平洋沿岸输出粮食、蜂蜜和编织草席，换回盐和可可。1458年，阿兹特克特拉托阿尼蒙特祖马一世派贵族特索洛·特库特利库特南下，在奇拉潘特佩特山上设立前哨，将这一地区纳入墨西加统治，并给奇拉帕颁发了最早的正式建制文书。1522年，贡萨洛·桑多瓦尔率领的西班牙军队攻占这座山城，后来它被改建为山下谷地中的奥古斯丁会传教村镇。

en: Collique, also called Colli, was a lordship of the central Peruvian coast that flourished between about 900 and 1470 in the lower and middle Chillón valley, on land now covered by the northern districts of Lima. Its ruler was the Collicápac, enthroned in the walled fortress of Collique, whose adobe ramparts ran beside the river and out to the beaches of Oquendo, guarding fields watered by springs and canals. A warlike people, the Colli fought the Canta upriver over the waters of the Chillón and, according to the Huarochirí Manuscript, lost highland ground to the Yauyos groups. When the army of Tupac Inca Yupanqui entered the valley around 1470 the Colli refused to submit, trusting in their fortress; the Incas stormed it, killed the Collicápac, resettled the population and installed mitmaq colonies under an Ichma lord, building the tambo of Tambo Inga nearby.
zh: 科利克又称科利，是秘鲁中部海岸的领主邦，约900年至1470年间兴盛于奇永河中下游河谷，其地今为利马北部城区。统治者称科利卡帕克，坐镇城墙环绕的科利克要塞，土坯壁垒沿河一直延伸到奥肯多海滩，护卫着靠泉水和渠道灌溉的农田。科利人尚武，为奇永河河水与上游的坎塔人连年交战；据《瓦罗奇里手稿》记载，他们还在与尧约斯诸族的战争中失去了山地领土。1470年前后，图帕克·印卡·尤潘基的军队进入河谷，科利人自恃要塞坚固拒不臣服，印加人强攻得手，杀死科利卡帕克，迁走居民，安置米特马克移民并委任伊什马首领管辖，又在附近建起坦博·印加驿馆。

en: Clanricarde was the lordship of the Galway Burkes, a fully Gaelicised branch of the Hiberno-Norman House of Burgh, also called Mac William Uachtar, the Upper Mac William. The Burghs reached Connacht with William de Burgh, whose son Richard Mor, lord of Connacht, died in 1243, and his heirs took Galway from the O Flahertys in 1232. The Burke Civil War of 1333 to 1338 split the family into the upper and lower Mac Williams; the southern branch, headed by Ulick Burke of Annaghkeen and first recorded under the title Clanricarde in 1335, ruled eastern County Galway from the Shannon to the Mayo border and claimed overlordship of kingdoms such as Hy Many. In 1543 Henry VIII made Ulick na gCeann Burke the first Earl of Clanricarde. The fifth earl led the Irish Royalists in the 1640s and was created Marquess of Clanricarde in 1646, while the ninth earl fought for James II and was captured at the Battle of Aughrim in 1691.
zh: 克兰里卡德是戈尔韦伯格家族的领地，这一支系已完全盖尔化，又称“上麦克威廉”，出自诺曼裔爱尔兰的伯格家族。伯格人随威廉·德·伯格进入康诺特，其子1243年去世的康诺特领主理查德·莫尔的后嗣于1232年从奥弗莱厄蒂家族手中夺取戈尔韦。1333至1338年的伯格内战把家族分为上、下两支麦克威廉；南支以安纳基恩的乌利克·伯格为首，1335年首次以“克兰里卡德”之号见于记载，统治戈尔韦郡东部，从香农河一直延伸到梅奥边界，并宣称对伊瓦内等王国拥有宗主权。1543年，亨利八世封乌利克·纳·吉安·伯格为第一代克兰里卡德伯爵。第五代伯爵在17世纪40年代领导爱尔兰保王派，1646年受封克兰里卡德侯爵；第九代伯爵为詹姆斯二世作战，1691年在奥赫里姆战役中被俘。

en: The viscounty of Carlat, whose lands took the name Carladès, covered the southern slopes of the Cantal mountains in Upper Auvergne, with its military seat at the rock castle of Carlat and its courts at Vic, while the viscounts did homage to the abbots of nearby Aurillac. It grew in the ninth century out of the hereditary domain of Gerald of Aurillac, granted out by his abbey, and became one of the five Carolingian counties of Auvergne; in 839 the Emperor Louis the Pious besieged and confiscated it. The lordship later passed through the viscounts of Millau and Rodez to the Pons family. In 1337 the viscount was Renaud IV de Pons, a lord suspected of favouring Edward III of England but who fought under the French banner in 1345; he and his son were killed at the Battle of Poitiers in 1356. The region suffered mercenary routiers in the Hundred Years' War and again in the Wars of Religion, when Queen Margaret of Valois was confined at Carlat for more than a year; Henry IV ordered the castle demolished in 1603. In 1643 Louis XIII raised the viscounty to the County of Carladès and granted it to Honoré II Grimaldi of Monaco.
zh: 卡拉子爵领的领地又称卡拉代斯，地处上奥弗涅的康塔尔山南坡，军事中心在山崖上的卡拉堡，司法中心在维克，子爵则向邻近的欧里亚克修道院长行封臣礼。它9世纪时由欧里亚克的热罗的世袭领地经修道院分封发展而来，成为加洛林时代奥弗涅五伯国之一；839年皇帝虔诚者路易曾围攻并没收此地。后来领主权经米约和罗德兹的子爵家族转入庞氏家族。1337年在位的是雷诺四世·德·庞，这位领主被疑亲近英格兰国王爱德华三世，却在1345年打着法兰西王旗作战；1356年他与儿子一同战死于普瓦捷战役。百年战争和后来的宗教战争期间，当地都饱受雇佣兵匪帮蹂躏，宗教战争时瓦卢瓦的玛格丽特王后还被幽禁在卡拉一年多；1603年亨利四世下令拆毁卡拉城堡。1643年，路易十三把子爵领升格为卡拉代斯伯国，封给摩纳哥的奥诺雷二世·格里马尔迪。

en: West Connacht, called Iar Connacht in Irish, was a Gaelic kingdom west of Lough Corrib in the country later known as Connemara, now part of County Galway. Its rulers the O Flahertys, of the Ui Briuin Seola kindred, had held the fertile plain of Maigh Seola east of the lough since the ninth century, until the O Connor kings of Connacht drove them west in 1051; there they built a new kingdom and subordinated the older Delbhna and Conmhaicne Mara clans. Long a subordinate tuath of Connacht, West Connacht became largely independent in the thirteenth century, even as the Norman Burghs of Clanricarde seized Galway in 1232, whose city gate bore the plea, “From the ferocious O Flahertys, O Lord deliver us.” In 1315 the Norman-descended Joyce family settled in the north of the kingdom and became Gaelicised. In 1337 an O Flaherty chief still ruled from Annaghdown, and the district was only loosely brought under the Kingdom of Ireland late in the sixteenth century; as late as 1759 a judge could report that no sheriff dared enter it to serve process.
zh: 西康诺特，爱尔兰语称伊阿尔·康诺特，是科里布湖以西的盖尔人王国，地处后来通称康尼马拉的地区，今属戈尔韦郡。统治者奥弗莱厄蒂家族出自伊布留因·谢奥拉族群，自9世纪起领有湖东肥沃的马伊谢奥拉平原，1051年被康诺特国王奥康纳家族赶到湖西；他们在那里建立新王国，臣服了当地更古老的德尔夫纳和康马克内·马拉诸氏族。西康诺特长期是康诺特的附庸部族，13世纪后大体独立，而诺曼裔的克兰里卡德·伯格家族于1232年夺取戈尔韦，该城城门上挂着祷辞：“主啊，求你使我们脱离凶猛的奥弗莱厄蒂人。”1315年，诺曼血统的乔伊斯家族移居王国北部并逐渐盖尔化。1337年，奥弗莱厄蒂酋长仍以安纳当为治所；直到16世纪末，这一地区才被松散地纳入爱尔兰王国，迟至1759年还有法官奏报，没有任何治安官敢入境执法。

en: Champaner lay beneath the fortified Pavagadh hill in eastern Gujarat. The town was traditionally founded in the eighth century by Vanraj Chavda of Anhilwad and named after his general Champa, remembered also as the Bhil king Champa who built its first fort; a local Bhil dynasty and later the Rajputs of Anhilwad held the tract until Alauddin Khalji's conquest of Gujarat around 1297. In the upheaval that followed, Khichi Chauhan Rajputs settled at Champaner and ruled from the Pavagadh fortress, whose steep flanks made it one of Gujarat's strongest hill strongholds. The Khichis beat off the Rao of Idar in 1418 and the army of Ahmedabad again about 1450, but their luck ended when Mahmud Begada of Gujarat besieged Pavagadh from 1482 and took it on 21 November 1484 after twenty months; the last Chauhan king Jayasimha's fall allowed Begada to rebuild Champaner as Muhammadabad, his new capital. In 1535 the emperor Humayun stormed the same hill fort during his campaign against Bahadur Shah.
zh: 尚庞坐落于古吉拉特东部巴瓦加德山堡之下。相传该城由8世纪安希尔瓦德的万拉杰·查夫达所建，以他的将领占帕命名——此人也被记为修建第一座城堡的比尔王占帕。这片土地先后由本地比尔王朝和安希尔瓦德的拉杰普特人统治，直到1297年前后阿拉乌德丁·卡尔吉征服古吉拉特。随之而来的动荡中，基奇乔赫拉杰普特人定居尚庞，以巴瓦加德堡垒为治所；山崖陡峭，使它成为古吉拉特最坚固的山城之一。基奇人于1418年击退伊德尔的拉奥，又在1450年前后挡住艾哈迈达巴德的军队，但好运终于耗尽：古吉拉特苏丹马哈茂德·贝加达自1482年起围攻巴瓦加德，历时二十个月，于1484年11月21日破城。末代乔汉王贾亚辛哈覆灭后，贝加达把尚庞重建为新都穆罕默达巴德。1535年，皇帝胡马雍在讨伐巴哈杜尔沙时又一次攻克了这座山堡。

en: Camerino, the ancient Camerinum in the Apennines of the Marche, was an Umbrian town that bound itself to Rome by an equal treaty around 310 BC and became a municipium under the empire. It belonged to the Byzantine Exarchate of Ravenna until the Lombards took it in 592, and under them and their Frankish successors it was the seat first of a marquisate and then of a duchy; Matilda of Tuscany later donated it to the Papal States. After the year 1000 it became a free commune, originally Ghibelline and later a stubborn Guelph stronghold, for which the troops of Manfred of Sicily destroyed it in 1256. Gentile da Varano, returning with the refugees in 1262, rebuilt the town and founded the signoria his house was to hold for three centuries. In 1337 his grandson Gentile II ruled a state enlarged with Tolentino, Gualdo Tadino and San Ginesio, and the university was founded there in 1336. His successor Rodolfo II served Cardinal Albornoz as gonfaloniere of the Church against the Ordelaffi and Visconti, and Giovanni da Varano ringed the city with twelve kilometres of walls in 1382. The family reached its Renaissance peak under Giulio Cesare, builder of the ducal palace, until Cesare Borgia captured and killed him with his sons in 1502. Restored briefly under Giovanni Maria, who became duke in 1515, the state lost its independence on his heirless death in 1529 and passed under direct papal administration in the 1540s.
zh: 卡梅里诺古称卡梅里努姆，坐落在马尔凯的亚平宁山区，本是翁布里亚人的城镇，约公元前310年与罗马缔结平等盟约，帝国时期成为自治城。592年伦巴第人攻陷之前，它一直属于拜占庭拉文纳总督区；在伦巴第人及其继承者法兰克人治下，这里先后成为侯爵驻地和公爵驻地，后来托斯卡纳女伯爵玛蒂尔达把它捐给了教皇国。1000年之后，它成为自由公社，最初属吉伯林派，后来转为坚定的圭尔夫派据点，并因此在1256年被西西里国王曼弗雷迪的军队摧毁。1262年，真蒂莱·达瓦拉诺随难民返回家园，重建城市，开创了其家族延续三百年的僭主统治。1337年，他的孙子真蒂莱二世统治着这个已吞并托伦蒂诺、瓜尔多塔迪诺和圣吉内肖的政权，卡梅里诺大学也已于1336年创立。继任者罗道尔弗二世出任教会旗官，协助阿尔沃诺斯枢机对抗奥尔德拉菲和维斯孔蒂家族；1382年，乔瓦尼·达瓦拉诺为城市筑起长达十二公里的城墙。家族在修建公爵宫的朱利奥·切萨雷治下达到文艺复兴时期的顶峰，直到1502年切萨雷·博尔贾攻陷此城，将他连同几个儿子一并处死。乔瓦尼·马里亚一度复国并于1515年受封公爵，但他1529年无嗣而终后，国家丧失独立，在16世纪40年代被教皇直接管辖。

en: Cemais was a marcher lordship on the north Pembrokeshire coast, covering the shore between the Teifi estuary and Fishguard beneath the Preseli Hills. Formerly a Welsh cantref of the kingdom of Dyfed, it was seized around 1094 by the Norman knight Martin de Turribus, who landed at Fishguard, built a castle at Nevern and ruled the territory as the Lordship of Kemes with wide marcher freedoms. Welsh princes repeatedly took it back: Gruffydd ap Rhys expelled the Norman lord in 1136, and Llywelyn the Great and his grandson captured it in 1215 and 1257, but each time the FitzMartin family recovered the lordship, moving its caput from Nevern to Newport. When the last Lord Martin died childless in 1326, Cemais passed to his sister Joan and her husband James Audley, and in 1337 it was held by their son James, the second Baron Audley. The Audleys kept it until 1497, when the seventh baron was executed for rebelling against Henry VII. Restored to the family in 1534 as an ordinary English barony, Cemais became a hundred of Pembrokeshire under the Laws in Wales Acts of 1535 to 1542.
zh: 凯迈斯是北彭布罗克郡沿海的一个边境领主领，涵盖泰菲河口与菲什加德之间、普雷塞利山麓的海岸地带。它原是威尔士德维德王国的一个坎特雷夫，约1094年被诺曼骑士马丁·德·蒂里比斯夺取：他在菲什加德登陆，在内文修建城堡，以享有广泛边境特权的凯迈斯领主领形式统治此地。威尔士王公曾多次收复它：1136年格鲁菲德·阿普·里斯赶走诺曼领主，1215年和1257年卢埃林大王及其孙子又两度攻占，但菲茨马丁家族每次都夺回了领地，并把治所从内文迁至纽波特。1326年末代马丁勋爵无嗣而终，凯迈斯传给其妹琼和丈夫詹姆斯·奥德利，1337年由他们的儿子、第二代奥德利男爵詹姆斯持有。奥德利家族一直保有该地到1497年，第七代男爵因反叛亨利七世被处决。1534年领地作为普通英格兰男爵领归还该家族，1535至1542年的《威尔士法令》把凯迈斯改为彭布罗克郡的一个百户区。

en: The Canchis were an Aymara-speaking highland people of the Vilcanota cordillera south-east of Cusco, whose lordship occupied the country between Combapata and Tinta, in what are now the Canchis and Espinar provinces. They emerged with their neighbours the Canas around 1100, after the collapse of Tiwanaku, and built the hilltop sanctuary of Waqrapukara, the horn fortress, whose circular stone buildings stand at 4,300 metres above the Apurímac river. Before the Inca rise they made themselves valued as mercenary warriors: the Inca ruler Inca Roca hired Canchis and Canas war bands to hurl the Chanca advance back across the Apurímac, and they later served in the invasion of Andahuaylas for war booty. Their autonomy ended around 1480, when the campaigns of the Collao War incorporated the Canchis and the other Aymara lordships into the Inca Empire.
zh: 坎奇人是库斯科东南维尔卡诺塔山脉的艾马拉语高地族群，其酋长国据有孔巴帕塔与廷塔之间的土地，相当于今坎奇斯省和埃斯皮纳尔省一带。他们与邻族卡纳人一样，在约1100年蒂亚瓦纳科帝国崩溃后兴起，并在阿普里马克河畔海拔4300米处修建了山顶圣所瓦克拉普卡拉，意为角堡，堡内的圆形石砌建筑即为他们所建。在印加崛起之前，坎奇人以雇佣兵的身份著称：印加统治者印卡·罗卡曾雇佣坎奇和卡纳战团，把昌卡人的攻势逐回阿普里马克河对岸；后来他们又为战利品随军出征安达韦拉斯。1480年前后，随着科利亚奥战争的一系列战役，坎奇与其他艾马拉酋长国一同被并入印加帝国，自治历史告终。

en: The Candarid beylik was an Oghuz Turkic principality of the Kayı branch, founded in 1291 when the Seljuk sultan Mesud II granted Eflani to the commander Şemseddin Yaman Candar for rescuing him from Mongol captivity. His son Süleyman I, the ruler in 1337, conquered Kastamonu and added Safranbolu and Sinop, governing under Ilkhanid overlordship until the death of Abu Sa'id in 1335. A succession war between his sons followed, and the beylik was repeatedly divided between Kastamonu and Sinop. From the late fourteenth century the Candarids faced Ottoman expansion: Süleyman II died defending Kastamonu against Bayezid I in 1391, while İsfendiyar Bey became an Ottoman vassal and, after Timur's victory over Bayezid in 1402, had his rule confirmed by the conqueror. The dynasty, later also called the Isfendiyarids, kept its autonomy in Sinop until 1461, when Mehmed II captured the city and annexed the beylik to the Ottoman Empire.
zh: 詹达尔贝伊国是凯伊部的乌古斯突厥人政权，1291年，塞尔柱苏丹梅苏德二世为报答将领沙姆斯丁·亚曼·詹达尔将他从蒙古人的囚禁中救出，把埃夫拉尼封给他，贝伊国由此建立。其子苏莱曼一世即1337年在位的统治者，征服了卡斯塔莫努，又夺取萨夫兰博卢和锡诺普，在伊儿汗国宗主权下治理，直到1335年不赛因去世。此后他的几个儿子陷入继承权战争，贝伊国在卡斯塔莫努与锡诺普之间屡次分裂。14世纪末起，詹达尔人面临奥斯曼的扩张：1391年苏莱曼二世在抵御巴耶济德一世攻打卡斯塔莫努时战死；伊斯凡迪亚尔贝伊成为奥斯曼附庸，又在1402年帖木儿击败巴耶济德后获得征服者对其统治权的确认。该王朝后来也被称为伊斯凡迪亚尔王朝，在锡诺普保持自治，直到1461年穆罕默德二世攻占该城，将贝伊国并入奥斯曼帝国。

en: Ah Canul was a Maya kuchkabal of the northwest Yucatán plain, ruled from Calkiní by the Canul lineage. The Canul were guards of foreign origin, perhaps from Tabasco, whom the Cocom of Mayapan had hired as mercenaries in their long feud with the Xiu. When Mayapan fell in the wars of 1441 to 1461, the discharged guards moved west with the allied Canche lineage, and in 1443 their eight local lords met under a ceiba tree at Calkiní to found their own polity; its name means the protectors. They first chose Ah Tzab Canul as halach uinik, but after his death the eight batabob governed as a senate rather than crown a new king. The province grew cotton and traded along the Camino Real. During the third Spanish invasion the lords rejected alliance, and the men of Calkiní fought the column of Francisco de Montejo's nephew before being overwhelmed; the Spaniards entered Tenabo, Hecelchakán and Calkiní in 1541 after their camp at Pocboc had been burned.
zh: 阿卡努尔是尤卡坦平原西北部的玛雅城邦，由卡努尔家族以卡尔基尼为中心统治。卡努尔人是外来的武士，可能来自塔巴斯科，玛雅潘的科科姆家族在与休族的长期争斗中雇他们充当雇佣兵。1441—1461年内战中玛雅潘覆灭，被遣散的武士连同结盟的坎切家族西迁，1443年八位地方首领在卡尔基尼的一棵木棉树下集会，建立自己的城邦，国名意为“守护者”。他们先推举阿·察布·卡努尔为最高统治者，他死后八位首领不再拥立新君，改以元老院议事治国。该邦种植棉花，沿皇家商路贸易。西班牙人第三次入侵时，各首领拒绝结盟，卡尔基尼人迎战弗朗西斯科·德·蒙特霍之侄的部队，最终不敌；1541年，西班牙人在波克博克营地被焚后，仍接连进占特纳博、埃塞尔查坎和卡尔基尼。

en: Connacht, the western fifth of Ireland beyond the Shannon, was the kingdom of the Connachta dynasties. Its ruling house, the O'Conors of Síol Muireadaigh, held the kingship continuously from 1102 and gave Ireland two high kings, Tairrdelbach Ua Conchobair and his son Ruaidrí, the last high king, whose quarrel with Diarmait Mac Murchada brought the Anglo-Normans to Ireland. Dynastic civil war opened Connacht to Richard Mór de Burgh in the 1230s, but after the murder of the Earl of Ulster in 1333 the Norman colony shrank and families such as the Burkes became Gaelicised, allowing the O'Conors to keep a reduced kingdom around Roscommon. The dynasty split into the O'Conor Don and O'Conor Roe branches, and the last fully recognised king of Connacht died in 1474. The Tudors created the Presidency of Connacht in 1569, and the Composition of 1585 turned the chiefs' countries into shired baronies under the crown. In the seventeenth century Connacht was the heartland of Confederate Ireland and suffered the Cromwellian conquest; the Battle of Aughrim in 1691 sealed the defeat of the Jacobite cause, after which the O'Conor Don survived as a landed family seated at Clonalis near Castlerea.
zh: 康诺特是香农河以西的爱尔兰西部省份（“五分之一”），是康诺塔诸王朝的王国。统治家族西尔穆雷达的奥康纳家族自1102年起世袭王位，还出了两位爱尔兰至高王：塔尔德尔巴赫·乌阿·康科巴尔和他的儿子鲁艾德瑞——后者是爱尔兰最后一位至高王，他与迪尔梅德·麦克默罗的冲突把盎格鲁-诺曼人引上了爱尔兰岛。13世纪30年代的王室内战让康诺特向理查德·莫尔·德·伯格敞开大门，但1333年阿尔斯特伯爵遇刺后，诺曼殖民地收缩，伯克等家族反而盖尔化，奥康纳家族得以保住罗斯康芒一带的缩水王国。王朝后来分为奥康纳·唐和奥康纳·罗两支，最后一位得到普遍承认的康诺特国王于1474年去世。都铎王朝于1569年设立康诺特总督区，1585年的《康诺特协定》通过“交土再封”把各首领的领地改为王室治下的郡属男爵区。17世纪康诺特成为天主教联盟爱尔兰的腹地，并遭受克伦威尔的征服；1691年的奥赫里姆之战决定了詹姆斯党人的败局，此后奥康纳·唐家族仅以地主身份存续，定居在卡斯尔雷附近的克洛纳利斯。

en: Cainta was a fortified Tagalog settlement on the river that drains Laguna de Bay, east of Manila. When the Spaniards arrived in the 1570s its people had turned the bamboo groves along the river into a thick lash-and-liana wall behind two ramparts and water-filled moats, with stone bulwarks, wooden towers and bronze lantaka cannon covering the approaches. In August 1571 Miguel López de Legazpi sent his nephew Juan de Salcedo with a galley, sixteen boats, a hundred Spanish soldiers and Visayan allies to subdue Cainta and the neighbouring town of Taytay. The chiefs rejected his offer of peace and fought from their fort, but a mortar bombardment and an assault over the walls carried the town, and Cainta was incorporated into the new Spanish colony; it was formally established as a town on 15 August 1571, making it one of the oldest municipalities in Luzon. During the brief British occupation of Manila of 1762 to 1763, mutinous Tamil sepoys settled in the town and intermarried with the local Tagalog population.
zh: 卡伊安塔是马尼拉以东、内湖出水河畔的一座设防他加禄人聚落。16世纪70年代西班牙人到来时，当地人已把沿河竹林用藤条扎成厚墙，墙内有两道护墙和注满水的壕沟，石砌棱堡、木塔和青铜兰塔卡炮封锁着通道。1571年8月，米格尔·洛佩斯·德·莱加斯皮派侄子胡安·德·萨尔塞多率一艘桨帆船、十六条小船、一百名西班牙士兵和米沙鄢同盟军前来征服卡伊安塔及邻近的泰泰。当地首领拒绝议和，凭要塞据守，但臼炮轰击与越墙强攻最终破城，卡伊安塔被并入新建的西班牙殖民地；它于1571年8月15日正式设镇，是吕宋最古老的市镇之一。1762年至1763年英军短暂占领马尼拉期间，哗变的泰米尔印度兵在该镇定居，与当地他加禄人通婚。

en: Canavese is the hill country between Turin and the Graian Alps, whose chief town is Ivrea, the Roman colony of Eporedia founded in 100 BC to guard the road into the Aosta valley against the Celto-Ligurian Salassi. After the fall of Rome it passed from Byzantine garrisons to the Lombards, who made Ivrea the seat of a duchy, and then to the Franks, under whom it became a county and then the March of Ivrea; its margrave Arduin had himself crowned king of Italy in the early eleventh century. When his line failed, the so-called counts of Canavese, claiming descent from him, split the region among the castles of houses such as the Valperga, San Martino and Castellamonte. Ivrea itself became a free commune in the twelfth century, then submitted to Frederick II and was disputed between its bishops, the marquises of Montferrat and the rising House of Savoy. In 1337 the effective local power was the bishop, Palladio Avogadro of the great Vercellese Avogadro clan, who had taken the see in 1326 and toured its parishes himself. The Green Count, Amadeus VI of Savoy, acquired Ivrea in 1356 and built its brick castle the following year, binding Canavese to Savoyard fortunes; it later shared in the French and Spanish occupations of Piedmont before returning to Savoy in 1814.
zh: 卡纳韦塞是都灵与格拉耶山之间的丘陵地带，首邑伊夫雷亚即公元前100年罗马为扼守通往奥斯塔山谷的道路、压制凯尔特—利古里亚系的萨拉西部而设立的殖民地埃波雷迪亚。罗马灭亡后，它先由拜占庭军队驻守，后被伦巴第人占据，伊夫雷亚成为伦巴第公国之一，接着转入法兰克人之手，先后成为伯国和伊夫雷亚侯国；侯爵阿杜因还在11世纪初加冕为意大利国王。他的王朝绝嗣后，自称其后裔的卡纳韦塞众伯爵把土地瓜分，瓦莱佩尔加、圣马蒂诺、卡斯特拉蒙特等家族各据城堡。伊夫雷亚本身在12世纪成为自由公社，后来臣服于腓特烈二世，又在本地主教、蒙费拉托侯爵和崛起的萨伏依家族之间被反复争夺。1337年当地的实际掌权者是主教帕拉迪奥·阿沃加德罗，他出身韦尔切利望族阿沃加德罗家族，1326年接掌主教区，还亲自巡视各教区。1356年，萨伏依的绿伯爵阿梅迪奥六世取得伊夫雷亚，次年筑起砖砌城堡，卡纳韦塞从此绑定萨伏依的命运，后来又随皮埃蒙特历经法国与西班牙的占领，1814年复归萨伏依。

en: The Cocom were the ruling Maya dynasty of Mayapan, the dominant power of late Postclassic Yucatán. The family rose under Hunac Ceel, who seized control of the League of Mayapan, the confederation that had joined Chichen Itza, Uxmal and Mayapan from the tenth century, and made Mayapan its seat. Cocom power rested on tribute from the provincial towns of the northern plain, from Sotuta to Motul, until 1441, when Ah Xiu Xupan of the rival Xiu lineage massacred the Cocom household; only one heir, away in Honduras, survived. The league collapsed into civil war, and by 1461 Yucatán had split into some seventeen rival kuchkabals. The surviving Cocom built a new seat at Tibolón and ruled the kuchkabal of Sotuta. When the Spaniards invaded, Nachi Cocom, halach uinik of Sotuta, had the Xiu ambassadors massacred in 1536 and led the Maya resistance against Francisco de Montejo the Younger, until his defeat at the ruins of T'ho, the future Mérida, in June 1542. He submitted and was baptized as Juan Cocom, dying in 1562.
zh: 科科姆是玛雅潘的统治王朝，也是后古典期晚期尤卡坦的霸主。该家族在乌纳克·塞尔治下崛起，他掌控了玛雅潘联盟——这个自10世纪起联合奇琴伊察、乌斯马尔和玛雅潘的城邦同盟——并把玛雅潘变成盟主驻地。科科姆的权势建立在北部平原从索图图到莫图尔等城镇的贡赋之上。1441年，敌对的休族首领阿·休·舒潘屠灭科科姆全族，只有一位身在洪都拉斯的继承人幸免。联盟陷入内战，到1461年尤卡坦分裂为约十七个相互竞争的城邦。幸存的科科姆人在蒂沃隆建立新中心，统治索图图城邦。西班牙人入侵时，索图图的最高君主纳奇·科科姆于1536年下令屠杀休族使节，并率众抵抗小弗朗西斯科·德·蒙特霍，直到1542年6月在特奥废墟（即后来的梅里达）战败。他随后臣服，受洗改名胡安·科科姆，于1562年去世。

en: Caotang was an anfusi, a pacification commission, of the Bozhou chiefdom, covering the Wengshui valley in present-day Weng'an County. After the Bozhou rebellion was crushed in 1600, the Caotang and Wengshui native offices were merged into the new Weng'an County under Pingyue Prefecture in 1601.
zh: 草塘是播州土司属下的安抚司，辖有瓮水河谷一带，地当今瓮安县境内。1600年播州之乱被平定后，草塘与瓮水两处土司辖地于1601年合并设置瓮安县，隶属平越府。

en: Yodzo Coo, the Mixtec name for Coixtlahuaca, meaning Plain of Snakes, was a multi-ethnic state of the Mixteca Alta, home to Chochos and Mixtecs and overlord of the Cuicatecs, with Nahuatl as its lingua franca. Its dynasty traced back to a Toltec lord, Four Jaguar Night Face, installed around 1096, and later rulers bore the name Atonal. The city kept a great market linked to the Valley of Mexico, Cholula and the Pacific coast, trading gold, cacao, feathers and cochineal. In the mid-fifteenth century its ruler Atonal II had the Central Mexican merchants in his city killed and their goods seized, drawing the armies of Moctezuma I: in 1458 the Mexica took Coixtlahuaca and executed Atonal II. It then became the seat of an Aztec tributary province covering the whole Nochixtlan valley and the Cuicatlan country, guarded by a Mexica garrison and governor. Envoys of the city surrendered to Hernan Cortes in September 1520.
zh: 尤佐库是科伊斯特拉瓦坎的纽萨维语名字，意为“蛇之平原”，是米斯特卡高地的多民族政权，居民有乔乔人和纽萨维人，还统辖着奎卡特克人，并以纳瓦特尔语为通用语。它的王朝可追溯到约1096年受封的托尔特克贵族虎四日·夜之面容，后来的君主多取名阿托纳尔。城中有大集市，商路连通墨西哥谷地、乔卢拉和太平洋沿岸，交易黄金、可可、羽毛和胭脂虫。15世纪中叶，君主阿托纳尔二世下令处死城中的墨西哥谷地商人并没收其货物，招来莫克特苏马一世的大军：1458年墨西加人攻克科伊斯特拉瓦坎，处死阿托纳尔二世。此后它成为阿兹特克一个纳贡省份的治所，辖区覆盖整个诺奇斯特兰谷地和奎卡特兰地区，由墨西加驻军和总督镇守。1520年9月，该城的使者向埃尔南·科尔特斯投降。

en: The County of Comminges occupied the upper Garonne valley on the northern slopes of the Pyrenees, the land of the ancient Aquitanian Convenae around Lugdunum Convenarum, later Saint-Bertrand-de-Comminges. A county emerged there in the early tenth century, part of Gascony; its counts set their capital at Muret, a strategic bridge town between Gascony and Languedoc, and the viscounties of Nébouzan and Couserans depended on them. In 1337 the count was John I of the native house of Comminges, which had held the county for four centuries. The last hereditary ruler, Countess Margaret, married into the houses of Armagnac and Foix and at her death in 1443 bequeathed her lands to the French king; after the life tenancy of Matthew of Foix, Comminges was incorporated into the royal domain in 1454. It was briefly granted out again, first to John of Lescun in 1462 and then to Odet d'Aydie, before being definitively reunited to the crown by Louis XII in 1498.
zh: 科曼日伯国据有比利牛斯山北坡的加龙河上游谷地，这里古时是阿基坦人孔韦恩部族的土地，以卢格杜努姆·孔韦纳鲁姆（后来的科曼日的圣贝特朗）为中心。10世纪初这里形成伯国，隶属加斯科涅；伯爵们把首府设在米雷——一座扼守加斯科涅与朗格多克之间通道的战略河镇，内布藏和库瑟朗两个子国都是它的附庸。1337年在位的是本土科曼日家族的让一世，该家族统治伯国已有四百年。末代世袭统治者玛格丽特女伯爵先后嫁入阿马尼亚克家族和富瓦家族，1443年去世时把领地遗赠给法兰西国王；在富瓦的马蒂厄终身享有之后，科曼日于1454年并入王室领地。此后它曾两度被封出——1462年封给莱斯坎的让，其后封给奥迪·达迪——最终于1498年由路易十二永久收归王冠。

en: Coinan was a late Postclassic hereditary monarchy on the north-eastern shore of Lake Chapala in what is now Mexico, whose people were the Coca, a western Mexican nation. Its capital stood at Tototlan, with the chiefdoms of Atotonilco, Ocotlan and Ayo-Ayotlan paying it tribute, while its borders met the Tecuexe señoríos of Acatic and Tecpatitlan to the north and the Purépecha Empire to the south. Tradition dated its foundation to 1210, when the leader Xitecomotl defeated the earlier Tecos inhabitants and set up his own dynasty. Its kings kept the Tarascans of the Purépecha Empire in almost constant war, though they held aloof from the Saltpeter War, and honoured the god Ixtlacateotl with a shrine on the hill of Las Villas. In 1541 Coinan joined the Mixtón War beside the Caxcanes and Tecuexe, fielding perhaps fourteen thousand rebels; when the Caxcanes were broken, the Coca surrendered as well.
zh: 科伊南是后古典期晚期的一个世袭君主国，位于今墨西哥查帕拉湖东北岸，居民属墨西哥西部的科卡人。它的首府设在托托特兰，阿托托尼尔科、奥科特兰和阿约—阿约特兰等酋邦向它纳贡；北境与特库埃克人的阿卡蒂克、特克帕蒂特兰两邦相接，南面则毗邻普雷佩查帝国。相传它建于1210年，首领希特科莫特尔击败了更早的特科斯居民，建立起自己的王朝。历代国王与普雷佩查帝国的塔拉斯科人战事不断，却没有卷入硝石战争；他们还在拉斯维利亚斯山上为神祇伊斯特拉卡特奥特尔修建了祭坛。1541年，科伊南与卡什坎人、特库埃克人并肩加入米斯特翁战争，起兵者约一万四千人；卡什坎人战败后，科卡人也随之投降。

en: Cortona is a walled hill town in the Val di Chiana in Tuscany, founded by the Etruscans as one of the twelve cities of the Etruscan League. Its Etruscan circuit of walls went up in the fourth century BC, and the bronze Tabula Cortonensis found here carries one of the longest known Etruscan inscriptions. Under Rome it became the colony of Corito, and it was sacked and destroyed in the final stages of the Gothic War in the sixth century. It re-emerged in the Middle Ages as a Ghibelline commune that minted its own coinage, and from 1325 the Ranieri-Casali family held it as signori, including Ranieri II Casali at the start of 1337. Casali rule ended in 1409 when Ladislaus of Naples seized the town, and in 1411 he sold it to the Medici of Florence, after which Cortona shared the fortunes of the Florentine state. On the extinction of the senior Medici line in 1737 it passed, with the rest of Tuscany, to the House of Lorraine.
zh: 科尔托纳是托斯卡纳基亚纳山谷中的一座山城，由伊特鲁里亚人建立，是伊特鲁里亚联盟十二城之一。公元前4世纪，伊特鲁里亚人修筑了环绕全城的城墙；当地出土的青铜板《科尔托纳表》刻有已知最长的伊特鲁里亚语铭文之一。罗马统治时期它成为名为科里托的殖民地，6世纪哥特战争末期遭洗劫摧毁。中世纪时它重新崛起为吉伯林派的自治公社，自铸货币；1325年起由拉涅里-卡萨利家族作为领主治下，1337年在位的是拉涅里二世·卡萨利。1409年那不勒斯国王拉迪斯劳攻占该城，卡萨利家族的统治结束，1411年他将科尔托纳卖给佛罗伦萨的美第奇家族，此后该城随佛罗伦萨国家一同兴衰。1737年美第奇嫡系绝嗣，它又随托斯卡纳一并转入洛林家族手中。

en: The Principality of Copa was a Circassian feudal state of the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, one of the coastal principalities of Zichia, controlling the shore between the Kuban River and the Sea of Azov from its chief town Copa. Known mainly through Genoese records, Copa was the second largest city of Circassia after Matrega and held a great annual fair each spring, where Genoese merchants bought fish and slaves under a consul sent out from Caffa. In the later fifteenth century it was ruled by Prince Berzebuk, who built a stone castle and in 1471 joined the other Circassian princes in a treaty with Caffa. Ottoman troops sacked Copa in 1475 and returned to storm its fortress in 1479, ending the principality, which is regarded as the forerunner of the sixteenth-century Principality of Zhaney.
zh: 科帕公国是14至15世纪切尔克斯人的封建政权，属于泽希亚沿海诸公国之一，以重镇科帕为中心，控制库班河与亚速海之间的海岸。它的事迹主要见于热那亚文献：科帕是切尔克西亚仅次于马特列加的第二大城，每年春天举办大型集市，热那亚商人在卡法派出的领事监管下在此收购鱼和奴隶。15世纪后期，王公贝尔泽布克统治此地，他修建了石砌城堡，并于1471年与其他切尔克斯王公一起同卡法缔约。1475年奥斯曼军队洗劫科帕，1479年又回师攻占其要塞，公国就此灭亡；它被视为16世纪热内公国的前身。

en: Tzoapan was centred on Choapan, a town in the forested Choapam highlands of northern Oaxaca, in the humid Papaloapan headwaters on the edge of Mixe and Chinantec country. Its people spoke a local Zapotec tongue, Choapan Zapotec; the Popoloca label attached to such neighbours was the Nahuatl exonym for peoples whose speech the Nahua could not understand.
zh: 佐阿潘以乔阿潘为中心，是瓦哈卡北部林木茂密的乔阿潘高地、帕帕洛阿潘河湿润源头上的小邦，与米赫人和奇南特克人的地区相邻。当地居民讲本地的乔阿潘萨波特克语；波波洛卡本是纳瓦人对听不懂其语言的邻族的他称。

en: The Charca were an Aymara-speaking people of the south-eastern Andes, spread across the high plains and temperate valleys of present-day central Bolivia, in the country that became Chuquisaca, northern Potosi and southern Cochabamba. They lived in trading contact with their neighbours but were repeatedly raided from the eastern lowlands by the Ava Guarani, whom they called Chiriguanos. Inca forces first crossed the Desaguadero into their country in the mid-fourteenth century, yet the Charca took up arms and held out through several campaigns; only under Tupac Yupanqui, late in the fifteenth century, did their chief Copacatiraca persuade the elders to submit, and Charca warriors became valued troops in the Inca armies of Collasuyo. The Portuguese castaway Aleixo Garcia, marching with Guarani raiders in search of the legendary Sierra de la Plata, was probably the first European to meet them, around 1520. In 1538 Gonzalo Pizarro entered the region with native allies and the Spanish set up the Provincia de los Charcas, whose silver mines at Porco foreshadowed the great silver mountain of Potosi. On 16 April 1540 Pedro Anzures founded Villa de la Plata there, the future Chuquisaca, later renamed Sucre, and the whole Spanish governorship and Audiencia took the Charca name.
zh: 查克拉人是安第斯东南的一支艾马拉语族群，散居在今玻利维亚中部的高原与温带河谷，即后来的丘基萨卡、波托西北部和科恰班巴南部一带。他们与邻邦保持贸易往来，却不断遭到东部低地阿瓦·瓜拉尼人——他们称之为奇里瓜诺人——的袭掠。14世纪中期，印加军队首次渡过德萨瓜德罗河进入其地，但查克拉人拿起武器，连番鏖战；直到15世纪末图帕克·尤潘基在位时，首领科帕卡蒂拉卡才说服长老们归降，查克拉战士也成为印卡科利亚苏尤军队中受重视的兵员。葡萄牙流落者阿莱绍·加西亚随同瓜拉尼袭掠者寻找传说中的银山，约在1520年成为最早接触他们的欧洲人。1538年，贡萨洛·皮萨罗率土著盟军进入该地区，西班牙人设立查克拉行省，波尔科的银矿预示了后来波托西银山大开发。1540年4月16日，佩德罗·安苏雷斯在此建立拉普拉塔镇，即后来的丘基萨卡，再改名为苏克雷；整个西班牙辖区乃至后来的检审法院都沿用了查克拉之名。

en: Churumekua was a small Purépecha-speaking settlement in the hot lowlands of southeastern Michoacán; its name, carried by the later town of Churumuco, means bird's beak in the Purépecha language. It was one of many minor local communities over which the expanding Purépecha kingdom of Tzintzuntzan claimed dominion before the Spanish arrival.
zh: 楚鲁梅夸是米却肯东南部炎热低地上一个讲普雷佩查语的小聚落，后来的楚鲁穆科镇沿用了这个名字，它在普雷佩查语中意为“鸟喙”。在西班牙人到来之前，它是扩张中的钦聪灿普雷佩查王国所控制的众多地方小社群之一。

en: Urtsun was a Kalash chiefdom in the Urtsun valley of southern Chitral, whose people spoke the Kalasha-mun dialect later called Urtsuniwar and kept the old Kalash beliefs. In the fourteenth century the Rais dynasty of Chitral conquered the Kalash valleys, and Urtsun became a tributary hill domain gradually absorbed into the Chitral kingdom.
zh: 乌尔岑是吉德拉尔南部乌尔岑谷地的卡拉什人酋邦，居民说卡拉什语的乌尔岑方言，信奉卡拉什人的古老信仰。14世纪吉德拉尔的赖莎王朝征服卡拉什诸谷地后，乌尔岑沦为纳贡的山地附庸，逐渐被并入吉德拉尔王国。

en: The Kingdom of Croatia arose from the Slavic duchy settled in the seventh century and was raised to kingship around 925 under Tomislav of the Trpimirović dynasty, which ruled until 1091. A succession crisis then brought the Hungarian king Coloman, crowned King of Croatia and Dalmatia at Biograd in 1102, and the two crowns remained in personal union. Croatia kept its own Sabor assembly and a viceroy, the Ban, while great lords such as Paul I Šubić of Bribir wielded near-independent power; the Mongols sacked Zagreb in 1242, and the coastal cities of Dalmatia were repeatedly disputed with Venice. After the Árpád line ended in 1301 the Angevin Charles Robert wore the crown in 1337, and his son Louis I won Dalmatia from Venice by the Treaty of Zadar in 1358, though Venice regained the coast in 1409. Ottoman conquests shattered the kingdom in the early sixteenth century, and after the Battle of Mohács in 1526 the Croatian crown passed to the Habsburgs.
zh: 克罗地亚王国源于7世纪斯拉夫人定居后建立的公国，约925年在特尔皮米罗维奇王朝的托米斯拉夫治下升格为王国，该王朝一直统治到1091年。随后的继承危机使匈牙利国王卡尔曼于1102年在比奥格勒加冕为克罗地亚和达尔马提亚国王，两顶王冠自此结成君合国。克罗地亚保留了自己的萨博尔议会和称为巴昂的副王，布里比尔的保罗·舒比奇等大贵族权势近乎独立；1242年蒙古人洗劫萨格勒布，达尔马提亚沿海城市则反复与威尼斯争夺。1301年阿尔帕德王朝绝嗣后，1337年在位的是安茹家族的查理·罗贝尔；其子拉约什一世于1358年凭《扎达尔条约》从威尼斯手中取得达尔马提亚，但威尼斯又在1409年夺回海岸。16世纪初奥斯曼人的征服重创王国，1526年莫哈奇战役后，克罗地亚王冠转入哈布斯堡家族手中。

en: The Marquisate of Finale was a small imperial fief on the Ligurian coast, centred on the fortified town of Finalborgo and the inland seat of Cairo Montenotte. It grew out of the vast march granted to Aleramo of Montferrat by Emperor Otto I in 967; after the family lands were partitioned in the twelfth century, Enrico I del Carretto received the March of Savona from Frederick Barbarossa in 1162, and his son Enrico II was the first to style himself Marquis of Finale. The del Carretto marquises, Ghibellines by allegiance, spent much of their history defending their independence against the expanding Republic of Genoa, which in 1385 secured the submission of half their territory. Genoa burned Finalborgo and forced a full submission in 1448, but Giovanni I del Carretto reconquered his capital in 1450. In the sixteenth century Genoa struck again in 1558, and in 1598 the last marquis, Sforza Andrea, sold the state to Philip II of Spain, the transfer taking effect in 1602. After the War of the Spanish Succession it was ceded to Genoa in 1713, keeping its own statutes until the French invasion of 1797.
zh: 菲纳莱侯爵领是利古里亚海岸的一个小型帝国封邑，以设防城镇菲纳尔博尔戈和内陆驻地卡伊罗-蒙泰诺泰为中心。它源于967年皇帝奥托一世封给蒙费拉托的阿莱拉莫的大片边疆领；12世纪家族领地分家后，恩里科一世·德尔·卡雷托于1162年从腓特烈·巴巴罗萨手中接过萨沃纳边疆领，其子恩里科二世最先使用菲纳莱侯爵的头衔。身为吉伯林派，德尔·卡雷托侯爵们在历史上长期抵御热那亚共和国的扩张，1385年半数领土被迫向热那亚臣服。1448年热那亚焚毁菲纳尔博尔戈并迫使侯爵领全面归顺，但乔瓦尼一世·德尔·卡雷托于1450年收复了首府。16世纪热那亚于1558年再度来攻，1598年末代侯爵斯福尔扎·安德烈亚将国家卖给西班牙国王腓力二世，转让于1602年正式生效。西班牙王位继承战争后，它在1713年被割让给热那亚，但保留自身法规，直至1797年法国入侵。

en: The Choros were the ruling clan of the Oirat tribes of the western Mongols, at times leading the whole Four Oirat alliance; their chiefs claimed descent from a baby found lying beneath a sacred tree, after whom the clan was named. In the first half of the fifteenth century the Choros leaders Mahamud, Toghon and his son Esen Taishi built Oirat power over the Mongolian steppe, and Esen had himself enthroned as khagan before the other Oirat tribes overthrew him in 1455. Raids by Khalkha and southwestern Inner Mongolian princes between 1552 and 1628 scattered the clan, some of whom fled as far as Siberia, but around 1620 the Choros recovered and, with the Dörbet and Khoid, settled the Black Irtysh, Ulungur, Emil and Ili river country to found the Dzungar Khanate. Under Khara Khula and Galdan Boshugtu Khan it became the last great nomadic empire, until Galdan's wars with the Qing ended in defeat in 1696 and his death in 1697; the surviving Choros were finally overrun when the Qing destroyed the Dzungar Khanate in 1755 to 1758.
zh: 绰罗斯是西部蒙古瓦剌诸部的统治氏族，曾统领整个卫拉特四部；其首领自称始祖是圣树下捡到的婴儿，氏族也因此得名。15世纪上半叶，绰罗斯的马哈木、脱欢父子及脱欢之子也先太师接连崛起，把瓦剌势力扩张到整个蒙古草原，也先甚至自立为大汗，最终于1455年被其他瓦剌部落推翻。1552—1628年喀尔喀与漠南诸部王公不断侵袭，绰罗斯部众离散，一部分远逃西伯利亚；约1620年他们重新振作，与杜尔伯特、辉特一起在黑额尔齐斯河、乌伦古河、额敏河和伊犁河流域定居，建立准噶尔汗国。在哈喇忽剌和噶尔丹·博硕克图汗治下，它成为最后一个强大的游牧帝国；噶尔丹与清朝连年交战，1696年兵败、1697年身死，幸存的绰罗斯人最终在1755—1758年清朝攻灭准噶尔汗国时被彻底征服。

en: Candia was the name the Venetians gave to Crete during their rule over the island. After the Fourth Crusade broke up the Byzantine Empire in 1204, Crete was allotted to Boniface of Montferrat, who sold his rights to Venice; Venetian troops occupied the island between 1205 and 1212, fighting off Genoese rivals, and organised it as the Kingdom or Duchy of Candia, named after its capital Candia, modern Heraklion. The island was split into provinces named after the sestieri of Venice, and a Venetian duke governed it as the largest overseas colony of the republic. Its Orthodox Greek population rose repeatedly against the Catholic rulers, fourteen times up to the great Revolt of Saint Titus in the 1360s, in which Greek peasants and Venetian settlers joined against the taxes of the mother city. From the fifteenth century the island prospered as an outpost of the Italian Renaissance: the Cretan School of painting blended Byzantine and Italian forms and produced El Greco, while vernacular literature culminated in the romance Erotokritos. After the loss of Cyprus in 1571, Crete was Venice's last major eastern possession. The Ottoman Cretan War of 1645 to 1669 overran the island, and after one of the longest sieges in history the capital Candia surrendered in 1669; the three remaining island fortresses fell to the Turks in 1715.
zh: 干地亚是威尼斯人统治克里特岛期间对该岛的称呼。1204年第四次十字军东征肢解拜占庭帝国后，克里特被分给蒙费拉的博尼法斯，他又把岛上的权利转卖给威尼斯；威尼斯军队在1205年至1212年间占领全岛，击退了竞争者热那亚，并以首府干地亚（今伊拉克利翁）之名建立“干地亚王国”（又称公国），是威尼斯最大的海外殖民地。全岛按威尼斯城区的划分分成若干省，由威尼斯委任的公爵治理。岛上信仰东正教的希腊居民多次起兵反抗天主教统治者，到14世纪60年代的圣提多大起义为止共爆发十四次起义，那次起义中希腊农民与威尼斯移民联手反抗母邦的苛税。15世纪起，该岛作为意大利文艺复兴的前哨而繁荣：克里特画派融合拜占庭与意大利风格，培养出埃尔·格列柯，方言文学则以传奇长诗《埃罗托克里托斯》为顶峰。1571年塞浦路斯失守后，克里特成为威尼斯在东方最后一块主要领地。1645年至1669年的奥斯曼克里特战争席卷全岛，在史上最漫长的围城战之后，首府干地亚于1669年投降；岛上最后三座要塞也于1715年落入土耳其人之手。

en: Cosamaloapan was the head town of a pre-Hispanic Nahua lordship on the Papaloapan river in the warm lowlands of central Veracruz. Between 1452 and 1457 Mexica armies conquered the town and its province, and it was tied to the Aztec empire through the garrison of Tuxtepec, where its tributes were delivered. This arrangement lasted until the Spanish conquest, after which Cosamaloapan became one of the first two Spanish corregimientos of the Papaloapan basin, established around 1534 alongside Guaspaltepec. In 1560 the two districts were merged into a large corregimiento stretching from Chinantla to Tlacotalpan, which for a short time even fell under the jurisdiction of Teutila. Around 1640 the district became an alcaldia mayor and took the name of Cosamaloapan; in 1696 it was attached to the alcaldia mayor of Chinantla, an arrangement that lasted until 1746. The administrative reforms of 1786 turned it into a partido of the Intendancy of Veracruz.
zh: 科萨马洛阿潘是前西班牙时期一座纳瓦领主邦的首镇，位于韦拉克鲁斯中部湿热低地的帕帕洛阿潘河畔。1452至1457年间，墨西加军队征服了这座城镇及其行省，它通过图斯特佩克的驻军与阿兹特克帝国绑定，贡物都交到那里。这一格局一直维持到西班牙征服；此后科萨马洛阿潘成为帕帕洛阿潘盆地最早的两个西班牙督办辖区之一，约1534年与瓜斯帕尔特佩克相继设立。1560年，两个辖区合并为一个大型督办区，范围从奇南特拉一直延伸到特拉科塔尔潘，甚至一度划归特乌蒂拉管辖。约1640年，该辖区改为市长辖区并改用科萨马洛阿潘之名；1696年它被并入奇南特拉市长辖区，这一安排持续到1746年。1786年的行政改革又把它改为韦拉克鲁斯都督府下辖的一个分区。

en: The Kingdom of Qusqu, or Cusco, was the small Andean city-state from which the Inca Empire grew. Tradition holds that Manco Capac led ten kin groups, or ayllus, from Pacaritambo into the Cusco valley, where they defeated or expelled the Huallas, Alcahuisas and other peoples and founded the city around the early thirteenth century. Its first five rulers, the Hurin Cusco dynasty, governed a compact state locked in long rivalry with the larger Ayarmaca kingdom and the surrounding chiefdoms. In 1337 the throne belonged to Capac Yupanqui, who defeated the Cunti peoples, took Anta and Masca, and allied with the Quechua against the expanding Chankas; around 1350 he was poisoned and Inca Roca seized power, opening the Hanan Cusco dynasty and becoming the first ruler to call himself Inka. He and his successors Yahuar Huaca and Viracocha Inca enlarged the city with stone canals and palaces, subdued the Pinagua and Muyna, and intervened in the wars of the Collao. In 1438 a Chanka invasion nearly destroyed Cusco, but the prince Pachacuti defeated the attackers, seized the crown and reorganized the kingdom into the expanding Inca Empire, which endured until the Spanish capture of Cusco in 1533.
zh: 库斯科王国是安第斯山区的一个小城邦，也是后来印卡帝国的前身。相传曼科·卡帕克率领十个称为艾柳的氏族从帕卡里坦博迁入库斯科河谷，击败或驱逐了瓦亚人、阿尔卡维萨人等族群，于13世纪初建城。最初的五位君主属下库斯科王朝，统治着一个与强大的阿亚尔马卡王国及周边酋长国长期争战的小国。1337年在位的是卡帕克·尤潘基，他击败孔蒂人，夺取安塔和马斯卡，并与克丘亚人结盟对抗扩张中的昌卡人；约1350年他被毒杀，印卡·罗卡夺权，开创上库斯科王朝，并成为第一位以印卡为称号的统治者。他和后继的亚瓦尔·瓦卡克、维拉科查·印卡用石砌水渠和宫殿扩建城市，征服皮纳瓜人和穆伊纳人，并插手科利亚奥高原的战事。1438年昌卡人入侵，库斯科几近覆灭，王子帕查库特克击退敌军、夺取王位，把王国改组为不断扩张的印卡帝国；直到1533年西班牙人攻占库斯科，这个帝国才告终结。

en: Coatlicamac, a Nahuatl name hispanized in colonial records as Guatinicamanes, was a lowland kingdom of the swampy frontier between the Aztec province of Tochtepec and the jungles of the Chinantla, in the country where southern Veracruz meets Oaxaca. Its settlements, including Suchilapan, stood in the Gulf Zoquean-speaking belt that stretched toward Coatzacoalcos, where the Zoque peoples, possible kin of the ancient Olmecs, lived from maize farming, river fishing and trade in cacao and rubber. The Mexica knew the district as a restless borderland: after campaigns against the Chinantec towns in the 1470s, the emperor Ahuitzotl defeated the Zoque in 1494 and bound their settlements to pay tribute, though highland and jungle communities kept much of their autonomy. The Spanish conquest of the Zoque lands began in 1523 under Luis Marín, whose encomiendas parceled out the villages, and by 1580 the whole district around Suchilapan and Texistepec had been incorporated into the colonial province of Coatzacoalcos.
zh: 夸特利卡马克是纳瓦特尔语地名，殖民档案中西班牙化拼作瓜蒂尼卡马内斯，是阿兹特克托奇特佩克省与钦安特拉丛林之间沼泽边疆的一个低地王国，地处今韦拉克鲁斯州南部与瓦哈卡州交界。它的聚落（包括苏奇拉潘）位于通向夸察夸尔科的海湾索克语地带；索克人可能是古奥尔梅克人的亲族，以种玉米、河上捕鱼和贸易可可、橡胶为生。墨西加人把这一地区视为难以驾驭的边疆：1470年代对钦安特克城镇用兵之后，皇帝阿维索特尔又于1494年击败索克人，迫使各聚落纳贡称臣，但山地和丛林中的社群仍保留了相当多的自治权。1523年，路易斯·马林开始了对索克土地的西班牙征服，村庄被瓜分为监护领地；到1580年，苏奇拉潘和特克西斯特佩克周边整个地区都被并入殖民时期的夸察夸尔科省。

en: Cuitzeo was a Purépecha lakeside town on the shore of the large shallow lake that bears its name in northern Michoacán. Its name comes from a Purépecha word meaning place of water containers, and in earlier times the area had felt the influence of Chupícuaro, Teotihuacan and Tula. As the kingdom of Tzintzuntzan expanded under Hiripan, son of the founder Tariácuri, the Lake Cuitzeo basin was absorbed into the Purépecha state, whose town it remained at the Spanish arrival. It became an encomienda in 1528, and in 1550 Augustinian friars began the monastery around which the present town grew.
