zh: 奎采奥是米却肯北部同名浅水大湖畔的普雷佩查城镇，其名来自普雷佩查语，意为“水罐之地”；更早的时候，这一地区曾受丘皮夸罗、特奥蒂瓦坎和图拉文化的影响。随着开国君主塔里亚库里之子伊里潘率领钦聪灿王国扩张，奎采奥湖盆地被并入普雷佩查国家，直到西班牙人到来时仍是其属下城镇。1528年它成为委托监护地，1550年奥斯定会修士开始修建修道院，今日的城镇即围绕这座修道院发展起来。

en: Chiyautla, recorded in colonial sources as Chiyahutla, was a Nahua-speaking town in the Mixteca lowlands of southern Puebla, on the frontier between Nahua and Mixtec country. Together with Cuetzallan, Ocotlán and Tzontecomapan it dominated the district, and under Aztec rule it became the seat of a strategic province whose subject towns supplied cotton, copal and salt; the salt, taken from a local salt lake, was traded to towns in the country now called Morelos. Spanish forces seized the town at the end of 1520 and granted it in encomienda to Diego de Ordaz. It became a royal corregimiento in 1534, and silver finds in the 1540s raised it to an alcaldía mayor, with an Augustinian convent founded in 1550.
zh: 奇尧特拉在殖民文献中记作奇亚乌特拉，是普埃布拉州南部米斯特卡低地的纳瓦语城镇，地处纳瓦人与米斯特克人地区之间的边境。它与奎特萨兰、奥科特兰和聪特科马潘一同主宰这一带；阿兹特克统治时期，它成为一个战略省的治所，属下城镇供应棉花、柯巴脂和盐，盐取自当地盐湖，销往今莫雷洛斯一带的城镇。1520年底，西班牙军队攻占此城，把它作为监护征赋地封给迭戈·德·奥尔达斯。1534年它成为王室辖区，16世纪40年代因发现银矿升格为大市镇，1550年奥斯定会在此建立修道院。

en: Chactemal, later called Chetumal, was the southernmost Putún Maya kuchkabal, spanning the coast between southern Quintana Roo and northern Belize. Its capital was a great trading port of some 2,000 households on Chetumal Bay, ringed by cacao orchards, maize fields and stingless-bee apiaries; it was the only notable cacao-growing province of Yucatán, and its merchants exchanged cacao, honey, wax and marine products for obsidian, jade and copper as far away as the Ulúa Valley of Honduras, where they occupied a whole quarter of the port of Nito. Around 1450 to 1500 the Chontal ruler Pachimalahix I of Acalan sailed against the port and exacted tribute. At contact its halach winik was Nachan Kan, whose slave and later son-in-law Gonzalo Guerrero, a Spaniard shipwrecked in 1511, rose to be nacom, or war captain, and organized resistance to the first entradas. Alonso Dávila found the capital deserted and was besieged into retreating by sea in 1531 and 1532, and the province fell only to Gaspar Pacheco's bloody expedition of 1543 and 1544, when its depopulated lands were absorbed into Spanish Yucatán.
zh: 查克特埃马尔后称切图马尔，是普屯玛雅人最南边的城邦，疆域横跨金塔纳罗奥南部与伯利兹北部的海岸。都城是切图马尔湾上一座约两千户的贸易大港，周围环绕可可园、玉米地和无刺蜂蜂场；它是尤卡坦唯一重要的可可产区，商人把可可、蜂蜜、蜂蜡和海产运到远至洪都拉斯乌卢阿河谷的地方，换取黑曜石、玉石和铜器，还在尼托港独占了一片商馆区。约1450—1500年，阿克兰的琼塔尔首领帕奇马拉希一世水师临城，强索贡赋。西班牙人到来时，在位君主是纳昌·坎；他的奴隶、后来的女婿贡萨洛·格雷罗是1511年沉船遇险的西班牙人，后来升任战将，主持了对最初几次入侵的抵抗。1531—1532年，阿隆索·达维拉发现都城已是空城，反被围困，只得从海路撤退；直到1543—1544年加斯帕尔·帕切科的血腥征伐，该邦才告陷落，人口凋零的土地被并入西班牙治下的尤卡坦。

en: Chitral was a mountain kingdom in the Hindu Kush, strung along the Chitral river and the high valleys of Mastuj, Yarkhun and Mulkhow, whose rulers bore the title mehtar. Local chronicles divide its early history into the Kafir, Rais and Kator periods. Before the fourteenth century upper Chitral obeyed the Trakhan rulers of Gilgit while the lower valleys were held by Kalasha chiefs, and tradition says that in 1320 a foreign chief called Shah Nadir Rais, perhaps from Turkestan, arrived to found the Rais dynasty. Islam entered the high valleys in the sixteenth century with Chagatai power, when Mirza Haidar led expeditions from Yarkand into the Hindu Kush between 1520 and 1550 and Muslim garrisons took root at Mastuj and Yasin. The Rais then lost ground to the rival Kator house in a long dynastic struggle fought around Mastuj and the battle of Danin; the last Rais chief was driven into Badakhshan in 1775, and after years of war with his Khushwaqt kinsmen Mohtaram Shah II Kator made himself supreme in Chitral in 1833, ruling a frontier power that stretched from the Kunar valley towards Gilgit.
zh: 吉德拉尔是兴都库什山中的王国，沿吉德拉尔河及马斯图吉、亚尔洪、穆尔科等高山谷地分布，统治者号称梅赫塔尔。本地编年史把其早期历史分为异教时期、赖莎时期和卡托尔时期。14世纪以前，上吉德拉尔臣属吉尔吉特的特剌汗统治者，下游谷地则由卡拉什酋长占据；按传统说法，1320年一位可能来自突厥斯坦、名叫沙·纳迪尔·赖莎的外来首领到此建立赖莎王朝。16世纪，伊斯兰教随察合台势力进入高山谷地：1520年至1550年间，米尔扎·海达尔从叶尔羌数次远征兴都库什山，穆斯林据点在马斯图吉和亚辛扎根。此后赖莎家族在长期王朝战争中被对手卡托尔家族压倒，战事围绕马斯图吉和达宁之战展开；1775年末代赖莎首领被逐往巴达赫尚，又经过与同族胡什瓦克特支系多年的厮杀，莫赫塔兰姆沙二世·卡托尔于1833年成为吉德拉尔唯一的主人，这个边地政权的势力也从库纳尔河谷一直延伸到吉尔吉特方向。

en: Cuetlaxtlan, whose name survives in the modern town of Cotaxtla in the coastal lowlands of Veracruz, was a Nahua-speaking altepetl of the Gulf plain, its population mixed with non-Nahuatl Pinome peoples. In the fifteenth century it lay on the frontier between the expanding Aztec Empire and its rival Tlaxcala, which treated the region as a proxy front. Mexica and Acolhua armies under Moctezuma I and Nezahualcoyotl campaigned there from the 1460s and eventually overran it, and Cuetlaxtlan was organized as an Aztec tributary province paying mantas, cacao, tropical feathers and amber under a Mexica governor styled Pinotecuhtli, lord of the Pinome. It later rebelled, whereupon Axayacatl reconquered the province, replaced its local rulers, stationed a garrison there and sharply increased the tribute, which came to include warrior costumes, precious stones, crystal and amber lip plugs and quetzal-feather regalia. Restive under Tenochtitlan, the coastal towns offered no resistance when Hernan Cortes landed in 1519, and their Mexica watchmen were among the first to report the Spanish ships to Moctezuma II.
zh: 奎特拉斯特兰的名称留存于今墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯州沿海低地的科塔斯特拉，它曾是海湾平原上一个讲纳瓦特尔语的阿尔特佩特尔，即城邦，居民中还混有不讲纳瓦特尔语的皮诺梅人。15世纪时，它处在扩张中的阿兹特克帝国与其宿敌特拉斯卡拉之间的边境地带，特拉斯卡拉把这一地区当作代理人冲突的前沿。从15世纪60年代起，蒙特苏马一世与内萨瓦尔科约特尔麾下的墨西加和阿科瓦军队反复攻入此地并最终将其征服，奎特拉斯特兰被编为阿兹特克的朝贡行省，进献棉布、可可、热带鸟羽和琥珀，由封号为皮诺梅人之主的墨西加总督治理。后来当地起兵反叛，阿萨亚卡特尔再度征服该省，撤换本地统治者、派驻驻军，并大幅加重贡赋，贡品中又增加了武士战袍、宝石、水晶与琥珀唇饰以及格查尔鸟羽仪仗。1519年埃尔南·科尔特斯登陆时，不堪特诺奇蒂特兰压迫的沿海诸城未作抵抗，当地的墨西加瞭望兵也是最早把西班牙船只的消息禀报蒙特苏马二世的人。

en: Coatzacualco, whose Nahuatl name means “where the serpent hides”, stood at the mouth of the river of the same name on the Bay of Campeche, in the old Olmec heartland of southern Veracruz. Local legend made it the place from which the god Quetzalcoatl sailed away to the east and promised to return. By the early sixteenth century the town was the capital of an extensive trading polity covering much of the Olmeca region, with subject and allied settlements such as Acayucan and Texistepec; its people were mostly Nahuas speaking the Isthmus dialect, alongside Popoluca communities speaking Mixe-Zoque languages and smaller Mixtec and Zapotec minorities. River and coastal canoes carried cacao, rubber, feathers and textiles through its markets, and the town's merchants competed with the Mexica pochteca of the Aztec garrison at Tochtepec. There was fighting with that garrison, but Coatzacualco never became an Aztec subject; instead the Mexica negotiated safe passage for their merchants through to Tabasco. In 1522 Hernán Cortés sent Gonzalo de Sandoval to the estuary, where he founded the Spanish town of Villa del Espíritu Santo beside the native capital, bringing the independent polity under colonial rule.
zh: 科亚特萨夸尔科的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“蛇藏匿之处”，位于同名河流注入坎佩切湾的河口，地处韦拉克鲁斯州南部的古奥尔梅克腹地。当地传说认为，神祇克察尔科亚特尔正是从这里扬帆东去，并许诺终将归来。到16世纪初，这座城镇已是一个幅员广阔的贸易政权的首都，势力覆盖奥尔梅卡地区的大部，属镇和盟邦包括阿卡尤坎和特克西斯特佩克；居民以讲地峡方言的纳瓦人为主，也有讲米赫-索克语的波波卢卡人社群以及少数米斯特克人和萨波特克人。河船和海船把可可、橡胶、羽毛和纺织品运经这里的市场，本地商人与托奇特佩克阿兹特克驻军的墨西加商人竞争。双方曾发生冲突，但科亚特萨夸尔科始终没有沦为阿兹特克的臣属，墨西加人反而通过谈判取得了取道此地前往塔巴斯科的安全通行权。1522年，埃尔南·科尔特斯派贡萨洛·德桑多瓦尔前往河口，在本土都城旁建立西班牙城镇圣神镇，这个独立政权就此落入殖民统治。

en: Cuismancu, also called Guzmango, was the kingdom that ruled the Cajamarca highlands of northern Peru from about 1250, in the Final Cajamarca phase of the local tradition. Its hilltop centres included Tantarica and Guzmango Viejo, overlooking the route from the mountains to the coast, while the town of Kasha Marka, the future Cajamarca, had been founded by about 1320. Its rulers bore the title Guzmango Capac; in the first half of the fifteenth century one of them conquered the neighbouring lordship of Huamachuco and allied with Minchancaman of Chimor, and the kingdom's fine kaolin ceramics carried its influence across the northern Andes. The alliance could not stop the Incas: after building the Incahuasi fortress around 1453, the generals Capac Yupanqui and Tupac Inca Yupanqui overwhelmed the confederate army, Cuismanco fell defending Cajamarca in about 1460, and his realm became an Inca province and the base for the later conquest of Chimor.
zh: 奎斯曼库又称古斯曼戈，是1250年前后起统治秘鲁北部卡哈马卡高原的王国，对应当地传统的卡哈马卡末期阶段。它的山城中心包括坦塔里卡和古斯曼戈维霍，扼守山区通往海岸的道路；城镇卡沙马卡即后来的卡哈马卡，约在1320年便已建立。统治者称古斯曼戈·卡帕克，15世纪上半叶，一位古斯曼戈·卡帕克经激烈征战吞并了邻近的瓦马丘科领主邦，并与奇穆的明查卡曼联盟；王国精美的高岭土陶器把它的影响带到整个安第斯北部。但联盟挡不住印加人：1453年前后印加军建起印卡瓦西要塞后，将领卡帕克·尤潘基和图帕克·印卡·尤潘基击溃联军，奎斯曼库约在1460年保卫卡哈马卡时战死，他的国家成为印加行省，也是日后征服奇穆的基地。

en: Culhuacan was a Nahua altepetl on the Ixtapalapa peninsula between Lake Texcoco and Lake Xochimilco, and one of the earliest chinampa towns, with floating gardens dating to around 1100. Tradition held that the Toltecs under Mixcoatl had founded it as their first city, and the Culhua were regarded as heirs of Tollan and the first people to call their ruler tlatoani; the city kept its prestige long after Tollan's fall and into the middle of the fourteenth century. In 1299 its ruler Coxcoxtli joined the Tepanecs in expelling the Mexica from Chapultepec and then settled them at Tizaapan as his vassals and mercenaries. The marriage ties of those years mattered later, for Acamapichtli, the first tlatoani of Tenochtitlan, was Coxcoxtli's grandson. In 1337 the throne belonged to Achitomecatl Teomecatl II. The city's independence ended in 1377, when Azcapotzalco subdued it largely with Mexica troops, and when Itzcoatl overthrew Tepanec power in 1428 he also took the title Ruler of the Culhua.
zh: 库尔瓦坎是位于特斯科科湖与索奇米尔科湖之间伊斯塔帕拉帕半岛上的纳瓦城邦，也是最早的奇南帕城镇之一，浮园耕作的历史可追溯到1100年前后。相传托尔特克人在米斯科瓦特尔率领下建此城作为他们的第一座城市，库尔瓦人因此被视为托兰的继承者，也是最早把君主称为特拉托阿尼的族群；托兰灭亡许久之后，直到14世纪中叶，这座城市仍保持着声望。1299年，统治者科克斯科特里联合特帕内克人把墨西加人逐出查普尔特佩克，随后将他们安置在蒂萨潘，充作自己的附庸和雇佣兵。这段时期结下的联姻关系后来影响深远：特诺奇蒂特兰的第一位特拉托阿尼阿卡马皮奇特利正是科克斯科特里的外孙。1337年在位的是阿奇托梅卡特·特奥梅卡特二世。1377年，阿斯卡波察尔科主要依靠墨西加军队征服库尔瓦坎，城邦的独立就此终结；1428年伊兹科阿特尔推翻特帕内克霸权后，也接过了“库尔瓦人之主”的称号。

en: Cuauhtochco was a Nahuatl-speaking province on the northern bank of the Río Atoyac in the Veracruz lowlands, its capital standing at the site now called Huatusco, near modern Santiago Huatusco. The country had once formed part of the Totonac lands of Totonacapan, and around 1454 a son of the Texcocan ruler Nezahualcóyotl conquered it for the allied Acolhua and Mexica powers. Under Aztec rule it became one of the Gulf-coast tributary provinces, governed from a garrison capital whose nearly intact Postclassic pyramid still stands, and it shipped up the cacao, cotton and vanilla of the warm lowlands. Towns such as Otlaquiquixtla answered to its governor. After the fall of Tenochtitlan the garrison held out until November 1521, when Gonzalo de Sandoval stormed it, and the district quickly lost population in the early colonial years.
zh: 夸赫托奇科是韦拉克鲁斯低地阿托亚克河北岸的一个纳瓦特尔语省份，其都城就在今圣地亚哥·瓦图斯科附近的瓦图斯科遗址。这一地区原属托托纳克人的托托纳卡潘，约1454年，特斯科科君主内萨瓦尔科约特尔的一个儿子替阿科卢阿与墨西卡联军征服了它。在阿兹特克统治下，它成为墨西哥湾沿岸的纳贡省之一，由一座驻军都城管辖，城中有一座保存基本完好的后古典期金字塔，省内向高原输送温暖低地出产的可可、棉花和香荚兰，奥特拉基基斯特拉等城镇都听命于其长官。特诺奇蒂特兰陷落后，这支驻军一直坚守到1521年11月，才被贡萨洛·德·桑多瓦尔攻破；殖民初期该地区人口迅速流失。

en:
The Chutia kingdom, also called Sadiya after its capital, was a late medieval state in the upper Brahmaputra valley, covering the present Lakhimpur, Dhemaji and Tinsukia districts of Assam and the adjoining plains and foothills of Arunachal Pradesh. The Chutias, a confederation of Bodo-Kachari clans, had built a settled kingdom around Sadiya before the Ahoms arrived in 1228, and it grew into the most advanced of the region's tribal states, with trade, surplus agriculture and a Hinduised royal cult; the kings nevertheless also patronised the tribal goddess Dikkaravasini, served by her own Deori priests. The earliest king known from inscriptions is Nandisvara of the later fourteenth century.

Relations with the Ahoms opened badly: the Ahom king Sutuphaa was killed during a Chutia encounter around 1376, and the expedition sent against Sadiya by Tyaokhamti ended in failure. Long border wars followed from 1512, when Suhungmung seized the Chutia dependency of Panbari; King Dhirnarayan was routed in 1523 and fell together with his son, and the Ahoms annexed the kingdom, placing it under a new Sadiakhowa Gohain. Among the spoils were Chutia cannons and thousands of blacksmiths, whose gunmaking skills thereafter supplied the Ahom army.
zh:
久蒂亚王国又称萨地亚，得名于其都城，是布拉马普特拉河上游的中世纪国家，疆域包括今阿萨姆的拉金布尔、德马吉、丁苏吉亚诸县以及相邻的阿鲁纳恰尔平原与山麓地带。久蒂亚人是博多-卡恰尔语族群的联盟，早在1228年阿洪姆人到来之前，便在萨地亚周围建立了定居王国，后来发展为当地诸部族国家中最先进的一个，拥有贸易、剩余农产品和印度教化的王室崇拜；不过历代国王也供奉部落女神迪卡罗瓦西尼，由专属的德奥里祭司主持。碑铭中已知最早的国王是14世纪下半叶的南迪湿婆罗。

久蒂亚与阿洪姆一开始就交恶：约1376年，阿洪姆国王苏图法在一次接触中被杀，陶坎蒂随后征讨萨地亚的远征也无果而终。1512年起边境战火不断，苏洪蒙夺取久蒂亚属地潘巴里；1523年国王迪尔纳拉扬战败，与儿子一同被杀，阿洪姆吞并其国，新设萨迪亚科瓦·戈汉一职管辖故地。战利品中有久蒂亚人的火炮和数千名铁匠，他们的造炮技艺此后为阿洪姆军队所用。

en: Cuauhnahuac, the city the Spaniards renamed Cuernavaca, was the principal town of the Tlahuica, a Nahua people who had held the warm valley of modern Morelos since the twelfth century. Its name means beside the trees, and in 1337 it was still an independent kingdom ruling most of western Morelos; in 1365 its lord Macuilxochitl marched north toward the Valley of Mexico and collided with the equally ambitious lord of Chalco, Tzalcualtitlan. The Aztecs came for its cotton: Huitzilihuitl of Tenochtitlan was refused a marriage alliance with the ruling house, made war, and won in 1396, wedding the princess who would bear Moctezuma I. The conquered province of Tlalnahuac was renamed Cuauhnahuac, and a rebellion under Miquiuix was crushed in 1433 by Totoquihuatzin and Nezahualcoyotl; thereafter its cotton, amate paper and flowers flowed to Tenochtitlan, and its merchants reached Tehuantepec. In April 1521 Gonzalo de Sandoval and Hernán Cortés stormed the city while its ruler Itzohuatzin still reigned, burning it before marching on Tenochtitlan. Cortés later made the valley his favourite seat, building a palace there in 1526, and Franciscan friars founded a monastery in 1529.
zh: 库埃纳瓦卡是特拉维卡人的主城，西班牙人后来把它改名为奎尔纳瓦卡；特拉维卡人是纳瓦人的一支，从12世纪起就占据着今莫雷洛斯州气候温暖的河谷。它的名字意为树木环绕之地，1337年时它还是统治着莫雷洛斯西部大部分地区的独立王国；1365年，君主马基尔索奇特利向北进军墨西哥谷地，与同样雄心勃勃的查尔科君主察尔夸尔蒂特兰迎头相撞。阿兹特克人为它的棉花而来：特诺奇蒂特兰的维齐利维特尔向统治家族求娶公主遭拒，随即开战，并于1396年取胜，随后娶了这位公主，她就是蒙特祖马一世的母亲。被征服的特拉尔纳瓦克省被改名为库埃纳瓦卡；1433年，米基维什领导的叛乱被托托基瓦钦和内萨瓦尔科约特尔镇压。此后当地的棉花、阿玛特树皮纸和花卉源源不断运往特诺奇蒂特兰，商人的足迹远达特万特佩克。1521年4月，君主伊措瓦钦在位时，贡萨洛·德·桑多瓦尔和埃尔南·科尔特斯攻陷此城，将其焚毁后继续向特诺奇蒂特兰进军。科尔特斯后来把这个河谷当作自己最喜爱的居所，于1526年在此修建宫殿；1529年，方济各会修士又在这里建立了修道院。

en: Cutzamala, whose Nahuatl name means place of rainbows and which Purépecha speakers called Apatzingani with the same meaning, lies in the hot lowlands of the Tierra Caliente on the border between Guerrero and Michoacán. During the Postclassic it was the easternmost garrison outpost of the Purépecha kingdom, facing the Aztec Empire across a heavily fortified frontier: the Relaciones geográficas report a standing contingent of up to ten thousand Purépecha warriors stationed there, matched on the Aztec side by the fortress of Oztuma. The border hardened after 1476, when the Tarascan army inflicted on Axayacatl the only major defeat the Aztecs had suffered up to that time, ending Mexica hopes of pushing west into Michoacán. The garrison lost its purpose only when the Purépecha kingdom lost its independence to the Spanish in 1530, and the old frontier town corresponds to present-day Cutzamala de Pinzón, where the first battle of the Tierra Caliente in the independence uprising of 1810 was fought.
zh: 库察马拉的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“彩虹之地”，普雷佩查语称阿帕钦加尼，含义相同，地处气候炎热的暖地、格雷罗与米却肯的交界地带。后古典期，它是普雷佩查王国最东端的驻军要塞，越过重兵把守的边境与阿兹特克帝国相望：《地理记述》记载当地常驻一支多达万人的普雷佩查战士部队，阿兹特克一侧则以奥斯图马要塞相对。1476年，塔拉斯卡军队让阿萨亚卡特尔遭遇阿兹特克人至此唯一一场重大惨败，墨西加人西进米却肯的企图就此终结，此后双方边界更加壁垒森严。直到1530年普雷佩查王国被西班牙人征服、丧失独立，这座要塞才失去原有作用；古城延续为今日的库察马拉-德平松，1810年独立起义中暖地的第一场战斗便发生在这里。

en: East Breifne, or Breifne O Reilly, was a Gaelic kingdom of 1256 to 1607 covering roughly the later County Cavan. The O Reilly clan, of the Ui Briuin kin group, had once been vassals of the O Rourkes of Breifne, but their long revolt ended with the division of 1256 and the Battle of Magh Slecht, after which the O Reillys ruled the eastern half from their castle on Tullymongan Hill. Under Giolla Iosa Ruaidh the market town of Cavan grew up below the castle, and in 1337 his son Richard held the kingship. Unusually for Gaelic Ireland, East Breifne struck its own silver coinage, known as O Reilly money and minted at Cavan from the early fifteenth century; English parliaments outlawed the coins in 1447 and 1456, yet the kingdom remained a prosperous trading country. In 1579 it was shired as County Cavan. The O Reillys joined the Nine Years War, and after the Treaty of Mellifont in 1603 and the Flight of the Earls in 1607 dozens of clansmen were attainted and their lands thrown open to the Plantation of Cavan.
zh: 东布雷夫讷，又称奥赖利的布雷夫讷，是1256至1607年间的盖尔人王国，疆域大致相当于后来的卡文郡。奥赖利家族出自伊布留因族群，原本是布雷夫讷奥罗克家族的附庸，但他们的长期反叛以1256年的分裂和马什莱克特战役告终，此后奥赖利家族在塔利蒙根山上的城堡统治东半部。在吉奥拉·伊奥萨·鲁艾治下，城堡脚下兴起了集市城镇卡文；1337年，他的儿子理查德继任国王。与盖尔爱尔兰其他地区不同，东布雷夫讷铸造自己的银币，即15世纪初起在卡文打造的“奥赖利币”；英格兰议会虽在1447年和1456年两度立法禁用，这个王国仍是富庶的商贸之邦。1579年它被划为卡文郡。奥赖利家族后来加入九年战争，1603年《梅利丰特条约》和1607年“伯爵出逃”之后，数十名族人被褫夺公权，土地被没收并划入卡文种植园。

en: Clanwilliam, in Irish Clann Liam, was the Munster lordship of the junior Burkes of the House of Burgh, taking its name from William de Burgh, founder of the dynasty in Ireland. Its country lay along the Shannon in eastern County Limerick, with Castleconnell as the chief seat. The line descended from Sir Edmond de Burgh, born in 1298, the youngest son of Richard, Earl of Ulster and lord of Connacht, who held his personal estates in Limerick. His grandsons founded the three septs of Castleconnell, Brittas and Muskerryquirk, known together as the Burkes of Clanwilliam. In 1338 Edmond was seized by his rival Edmond Albanach Burke and drowned in Lough Mask with a stone about his neck, yet the sept he founded kept its hold on the Limerick lands. In 1580 Sir William Bourke was created Baron Bourke of Castleconnell in the Peerage of Ireland; the title was forfeited in 1691, when the eighth baron was attainted after the Williamite war.
zh: 克兰威廉，爱尔兰语称克兰·利亚姆，是伯格家族旁支在芒斯特的领地，名称取自伯格王朝在爱尔兰的始祖威廉·德·伯格。其地位于利默里克郡东部、香农河沿岸，以卡斯尔康奈尔为首要驻地。这一支系出自1298年出生的埃德蒙·德·伯格爵士，他是阿尔斯特伯爵兼康诺特领主理查德的幼子，本人的私产就在利默里克。他的孙子们建立了卡斯尔康奈尔、布里塔斯和马斯凯里夸克三个支系，合称克兰威廉的伯格人。1338年，埃德蒙被对手埃德蒙·阿尔巴纳克·伯格擒获，颈上拴石沉入马斯克湖，但他所开创的支系仍保住了利默里克的土地。1580年，威廉·伯格爵士受封爱尔兰贵族序列中的卡斯尔康奈尔伯格男爵；1691年威廉战争结束后，第八代男爵被褫夺公权，男爵爵位遭没收。

en: Sacha-p-qulla is the Quechua name, meaning roughly the qulla people of the woods, for the Chachapoya, the Warriors of the Clouds, who held the misty eastern Andean slopes around the Utcubamba River in northern Peru. Their culture took shape around 800, and its strongholds were walled citadels crowning the ridges; Kuelap, begun in the sixth century and largely built between 900 and 1100, enclosed more than four hundred circular stone houses behind twenty-metre limestone walls and held some three thousand people. The Inca emperor Topa Inca Yupanqui opened a hard campaign of conquest in the 1470s, taking one hill fort after another, and deportations and fresh revolts continued under Huayna Capac. When the Spanish invaded Peru, many Chachapoya sided with the newcomers, who founded the town of Chachapoyas in 1538; Kuelap itself was abandoned in 1570.
zh: 查查波亚的克丘亚语名称原意大致是林中的科利亚人，他们又被称为云中之战士，据守在秘鲁北部乌特库班巴河一带、云雾缭绕的安第斯山东坡。其文化约在800年成形，据点是一座座雄踞山脊的围墙城堡；库埃拉普始建于6世纪，主要建筑完成于900至1100年间，二十米高的石灰岩围墙内有四百多座圆形石屋，居民约三千人。印加皇帝图帕克·印卡·尤潘基于1470年代发动艰苦的征服战，逐个拔除山头堡垒，强制迁徙和新的反抗在瓦伊纳·卡帕克时期仍在继续。西班牙人入侵秘鲁时，许多查查波亚人倒向新来者，西班牙人于1538年建立查查波亚城，库埃拉普本身则在1570年被废弃。

en: The Kingdom of Cyprus was a crusader state ruled by the French House of Lusignan. Richard I of England seized the island from the Byzantine prince Isaac Komnenos in 1191 during the Third Crusade and sold it to the Templars, who in 1192 handed it to Guy of Lusignan, whose successors ruled from Nicosia. After the fall of Acre in 1291 Cyprus became the main Christian trading hub in the eastern Mediterranean, with Famagusta drawing merchants from Genoa, Venice and Florence. In 1337 the throne belonged to Hugh IV, whose reign and that of his son Peter I marked the peak of Cypriot power: Peter captured Antalya on the Anatolian mainland in 1361 and led the sack of Alexandria in 1365, before being murdered by his own knights in 1369. Genoese intervention from 1373 curtailed the kingdom, and a Mamluk invasion in 1426 ended with the capture of King Janus and reduced Cyprus to tributary status. Its last queen, Catherine Cornaro, was forced to sell the island to Venice in 1489.
zh: 塞浦路斯王国是由法兰西吕西尼昂家族统治的十字军国家。第三次十字军东征期间，英格兰国王理查一世于1191年从拜占庭王公伊萨克·科穆宁手中夺取该岛，转卖给圣殿骑士团；骑士团又在1192年把它交给吕西尼昂的居伊，其继承人自此以尼科西亚为都统治。1291年阿卡陷落后，塞浦路斯成为东地中海最主要的基督教贸易枢纽，法马古斯塔云集了热那亚、威尼斯和佛罗伦萨的商人。1337年在位的是于格四世，他与儿子彼得一世统治时期是塞浦路斯国力的顶峰：彼得于1361年攻占安纳托利亚大陆上的安塔利亚，又在1365年领军洗劫亚历山大，1369年却被自己的骑士刺杀。1373年起热那亚人的干涉削弱了王国，1426年马穆鲁克入侵，国王雅努斯被俘，塞浦路斯沦为附庸。1489年末代女王卡特琳娜·科尔纳罗被迫把岛屿卖给威尼斯。

en: The Duchy of Czersk was the southernmost of the Masovian Piast duchies, covering the middle Vistula around the castles of Czersk and Warsaw. It arose from the partition of Mazovia in 1313, when Trojden I, the ruler shown in 1337, received the Czersk lands and held them until his death in 1341. His son Siemowit III inherited Czersk and used it as the base from which he reunited most of Mazovia under his rule and accepted Polish suzerainty in 1351. In the renewed partition of 1381 Czersk went to Janusz I, who in 1413 moved his residence from Czersk castle to the growing town of Warsaw, which then became the permanent capital of the Masovian dukes. The reunited Duchy of Masovia, including the old Czersk lands, was incorporated into the Kingdom of Poland in 1526 after the Masovian Piast line died out.
zh: 切尔斯克公国是马佐夫舍皮亚斯特诸公国中位置最南的一个，领有维斯瓦河中游、切尔斯克城堡与华沙一带。1313年马佐夫舍分封，1337年在任的特罗伊登一世分得切尔斯克领地，统治到1341年去世。其子谢莫维特三世继承切尔斯克，并以此为根基重新统一了马佐夫舍的大部分土地，于1351年接受波兰的宗主权。1381年再度分封时，切尔斯克归雅努什一世所有；1413年他将驻地从切尔斯克城堡迁至日益繁荣的华沙，华沙此后成为马佐夫舍公爵的固定都城。1526年马佐夫舍皮亚斯特血脉断绝，包括旧切尔斯克领地在内、重新统一的马佐夫舍公国并入波兰王国。

en: Cozalapan corresponds to the pre-conquest state of Cozolapa in the Amula highlands of what is now southern Jalisco. Its people spoke the extinct western Otomi language of Jalisco, and Nahuatl was also used in its villages, the chief of which was Cuzalapa. Together with the neighbouring states of Amole and Tuxcacuexco it defeated Purépecha incursions early in the sixteenth century. The Spanish overran Cozolapa with the rest of Amula in 1523 and incorporated it into the colonial province of Amula, where Franciscan friars began missionary work in the 1540s.
zh: 科萨拉潘对应征服前阿穆拉高地的科索拉帕邦，位于今哈利斯科南部。居民使用已消亡的哈利斯科西奥托米语，各村庄同时也通行纳瓦特尔语，其中以库萨拉帕最为重要。16世纪初，它与阿莫兰、图斯卡库埃斯科等邻邦一起击退了普雷佩查人的进犯。1523年，西班牙人在征服阿穆拉各地时拿下科索拉帕，将其并入阿穆拉省，方济各会修士于16世纪40年代进入当地传教。

en: Daura, a small walled town on the desert edge of what is now northwestern Nigeria, was the spiritual home of the Hausa and one of their seven true states, the Hausa Bakwai. Hausa tradition places the founding story of all the Hausa dynasties there in the 800s: the wandering hero Bayajidda reached Daura after crossing the Sahara, slew the serpent Sarki, whose name means king, that guarded the town well and stopped the people drawing water, and married the reigning queen, Magajiya Daurama. The Kusugu well where this happened remained the kingdom's most sacred site, and the sons of Bayajidda's two wives, Daurama and Magira, ruled Daura and the six sister states. Hausa tradition called Daura and Katsina the kings of the market, for its caravan trade carried Sahara salt and potash south and cloth, leather and slaves north; it was also an ancient seat of Islamic learning, though it never matched Kano or Katsina in power. In 1805 the Fulani warrior Malam Ishaku overran it in the jihad and founded an emirate, while displaced Hausa princes kept rival courts at Zango from 1825.
zh: 道拉是今尼日利亚西北部沙漠边缘一座有城墙的小镇，被豪萨人视为精神故乡，也是豪萨七城邦（豪萨·巴克瓦伊）之一。豪萨传统把所有豪萨王朝的起源故事都放在9世纪的道拉：流浪英雄巴亚吉达穿越撒哈拉抵达此地，杀死了盘踞镇中水井、阻止居民取水的巨蛇萨尔基（意为“国王”），并娶了在位女王马加吉亚·道拉马为妻。传说发生地库苏古井长期是王国最神圣的场所，巴亚吉达两位妻子道拉马和马吉拉所生的儿子们分别统治道拉和六个姊妹城邦。豪萨传统把道拉与卡齐纳并称“市场之王”：商队把撒哈拉的盐和钾碱南运，再把布匹、皮革和奴隶北贩；它也是古老的伊斯兰学术中心，只是实力始终不及卡诺和卡齐纳。1805年，富拉尼战士马拉姆·伊沙库在圣战中攻占道拉，建立埃米尔国；流亡的豪萨王公则从1825年起在赞戈维持着对抗的王庭。

en: Đại Việt, centred on the Red River delta at Thăng Long, grew from the Vietnamese kingdoms that won independence from Chinese rule in the tenth century: Đinh Bộ Lĩnh ended the Anarchy of the Twelve Warlords and proclaimed the realm Đại Cồ Việt in 968, a name shortened to Đại Việt in 1054. The Lý and then Trần dynasties ruled from Thăng Long, patronised Mahayana Buddhism and letters in the vernacular chữ Nôm script, and repelled three Mongol invasions, crowned by the Battle of the Bạch Đằng River in 1288. In 1400 the minister Hồ Quý Ly seized the throne, and seven years later the Ming conquered the country and ruled it as Jiaozhi; Lê Lợi's Lam Sơn uprising drove the Ming out in 1427 and founded the Later Lê dynasty, whose emperor Lê Thánh Tông shattered Champa in 1471 and pushed the southern border forward. A Mạc usurpation in 1527 and the later Trịnh–Nguyễn rivalry split the country for two centuries, with the Lê emperors reigning as figureheads. The Tây Sơn rebellion overthrew both lordly houses, but in 1802 the Nguyễn defeated them, founded a new dynasty at Huế, and in 1804 renamed the reunified kingdom Việt Nam.
zh: 大越以红河三角洲的昇龙为中心，由10世纪摆脱中原王朝统治的越南诸政权发展而来：丁部领结束十二使君之乱，于968年建国号大瞿越，1054年改名为大越。李朝和随后的陈朝都以昇龙为都，推崇汉传佛教，扶持字喃文学，并三次击退蒙古入侵，尤以1288年的白藤江之战最为著名。1400年，大臣胡季犛篡位；七年后明朝出兵征服，将其作为交趾管辖。黎利发动蓝山起义，于1427年驱逐明军，建立后黎朝；黎圣宗在位时于1471年击破占婆，大举向南开拓疆土。1527年莫氏篡位，此后郑主与阮主纷争不断，国家分裂两个世纪，黎皇仅存虚名。西山起义虽先后推翻两大权臣世家，阮福映却在1802年攻灭西山，在顺化建立新朝，并于1804年将重新统一的王国改名为越南。

en: The Daju kingdom was the first historically recorded state in Darfur, ruled from the southern slopes of Jebel Marra by the Daju people, who probably entered the region from the Nubian Nile valley and displaced the older Tora culture. The Arab geographer al-Idrisi described it in 1154 as a pagan camel-herding country lying between Kanem and Nubia, with only two towns, Tajuwa and Samna, the latter destroyed by a Nubian governor. A century later Ibn Sa'id found the Daju partly Islamized and tributary to Kanem, and around 1400 al-Maqrizi noted their skill as stoneworkers. Royal power rested on loose military overlordship, with tribal chiefs paying tribute, and the kings may have ruled as divine sovereigns who seldom appeared in public. In the fifteenth century the Tunjur settled northern Jebel Marra and then supplanted the Daju; tradition makes the last king, Ahmad al-Daj, a tyrant driven into exile in Dar Sila, in what is now Chad, where his line ruled as local sultans. His flight likely came in the late fifteenth century, and the Tunjur kingdom inherited Darfur.
zh: 达朱王国是达尔富尔地区第一个见诸史籍的国家，由达朱人在马拉山南麓实施统治；他们很可能来自努比亚的尼罗河谷，迁入后取代了更早的托拉文化。阿拉伯地理学家伊德里西在1154年记载，这是一个位于加涅姆与努比亚之间、信奉异教的游牧之国，以饲养骆驼为生，仅有塔朱瓦和萨姆纳两座城镇，后者还被一位努比亚总督摧毁。一个多世纪后，伊本·赛义德发现达朱人已部分伊斯兰化，并沦为加涅姆的附庸；约1400年的马克里齐则称道他们擅长石工。王权建立在松散的军事支配之上，各部首领仅向国王纳贡，国王还可能以神人形象治国，极少公开露面。15世纪，通朱尔人在马拉山北部定居并最终取代达朱人；口述传统称末代国王艾哈迈德·达吉是个暴君，被逐后流亡到今乍得境内的达尔西拉，他的后裔在那里世代为苏丹。这场流亡很可能发生在15世纪末，通朱尔王国随即继承了达尔富尔。

en: Damot was a medieval kingdom of the western Ethiopian highlands, south of the Blue Nile, whose kings bore the title motalami and held court in a town called Maldarede. Possibly formed in the tenth century, it was a formidable power by the thirteenth: it forced the Muslim Sultanate of Shewa to pay tribute, destroyed the armies the Zagwe dynasty sent against it, and even the ancestors of the Walashma rulers of Ifat were once counted among its tributaries. Its best-remembered king is Motolomi Sato, whom some scholars connect with the Malla dynasty of Wolaita. In 1316 or 1317 the Ethiopian emperor Amda Seyon invaded and annexed Damot, deporting part of its people, though he left the royal line in place and the motalami title survived into the fifteenth century. From the fourteenth century the kingdom weakened as Oromo clans pressed into its lands; by the late sixteenth century the Macha Oromo under Mula'ata Lubas had overrun the region, and much of the population fled across the Blue Nile into Gojjam. A Christian province named Damot survived within the Ethiopian empire, governed by a ras from Gojjam.
zh: 达莫特是埃塞俄比亚西部高原的中世纪王国，地处青尼罗河以南，国王称莫塔拉米，在一座名为马尔达雷德的城镇设朝。它可能形成于10世纪，到13世纪已是强权：迫使穆斯林的绍阿苏丹国纳贡，歼灭了扎格维王朝派来征讨的军队，就连伊法特瓦拉什马统治者的祖先也曾是它的附庸。最著名的国王是莫托洛米·萨托，部分学者把他与沃拉伊塔的马拉王朝联系起来。1316或1317年，埃塞俄比亚皇帝阿姆达·塞翁入侵并吞并达莫特，迁走了部分人口，但保留了王室，莫塔拉米的头衔一直沿用到15世纪。14世纪起，随着奥罗莫诸部进逼，王国日趋衰弱；到16世纪末，穆拉阿塔·卢巴斯率领的马查奥罗莫人席卷该地，许多居民渡过青尼罗河逃入戈贾姆。名为达莫特的基督教省份此后仍留在埃塞俄比亚帝国境内，由一名来自戈贾姆的拉斯治理。

en: The Danish kingdom, based on Jutland, Zealand and the islands between the North Sea and the Baltic, was unified under the Viking kings Gorm the Old and Harald Bluetooth, who Christianized the Danes around 960, as the Jelling stones still proclaim. Under Cnut the Great it briefly led a North Sea empire with England and Norway, and the Valdemars later conquered Estonia in 1219. By 1337 the crown was at its lowest ebb: under Christopher II the realm had been mortgaged piecemeal to German and Danish magnates, Gerhard of Holstein held real power, and Scania had been sold to Sweden. Valdemar IV Atterdag, elected in 1340, restored royal authority, sold Estonia to the Teutonic Order in 1346, recovered Scania by 1360 and seized Gotland and Visby in 1361, though his wars ended in concessions to the Hanseatic League at Stralsund in 1370. His daughter Margaret I built the Kalmar Union of 1397, joining Denmark, Norway and Sweden under one crown. The union survived recurring Swedish revolts until the Stockholm Bloodbath of 1520 and Sweden's breakaway in 1523, and Denmark adopted the Lutheran Reformation in 1536. Repeated wars with Sweden cost it Skåneland under the Treaty of Roskilde in 1658, and after the British bombardment of Copenhagen in 1807 the Treaty of Kiel in 1814 detached Norway, though Iceland, Greenland and the Faroes stayed Danish.
zh: 丹麦王国位于北海与波罗的海之间，以日德兰半岛、西兰岛及其他岛屿为根基，在维京时代的国王老戈姆和蓝牙哈拉尔治下统一，约960年丹麦人皈依基督教，耶灵石上仍记载着此事。克努特大帝在位时，丹麦一度统领涵盖英格兰和挪威的北海帝国；后来瓦尔德马诸王于1219年征服爱沙尼亚。然而到1337年，王权已跌入谷底：克里斯托弗二世治下，国土被一块块抵押给德意志和丹麦贵族，荷尔斯泰因的格哈德成为王国的实际强人，斯堪尼亚也被卖给瑞典。1340年当选国王的瓦尔德马四世·阿道戴重振王权，1346年把爱沙尼亚卖给条顿骑士团，1360年前收复斯堪尼亚，1361年又夺取哥特兰及其商镇维斯比；不过他连年征战，最终于1370年依《施特拉尔松德条约》向汉萨同盟作出让步。他的女儿玛格丽特一世于1397年缔造卡尔马联盟，使丹麦、挪威和瑞典共戴一君。联盟在瑞典人的反复起义中维系，直到1520年斯德哥尔摩惨案和1523年瑞典脱离；丹麦本土则于1536年接受路德宗改革。17世纪与瑞典的连番战争使丹麦在1658年《罗斯基勒条约》中丧失斯堪尼亚诸地；1807年英军炮轰哥本哈根后，1814年的《基尔条约》又把挪威从丹麦王冠下剥离，只有冰岛、格陵兰和法罗群岛仍归丹麦。

en: The lands ruled from Grenoble as the Dauphiné of Viennois grew from the County of Albon, whose lords united a cluster of Alpine and Rhône valley fiefs after the Kingdom of Burgundy passed to the Holy Roman Empire in 1032. Count Guigues IV of Albon put a dolphin on his arms in the twelfth century and was nicknamed le Dauphin, a title his descendants adopted as Dauphin of Viennois. The La Tour du Pin line held it in 1337 in the person of Humbert II, an imperial prince of the Kingdom of Arles whose Alpine towns included Gap, Briançon and Romans-sur-Isère. His only son had died in childhood, and burdened with debt he sold the whole Dauphiné to the French crown on 16 July 1349, surrendering it to the young Prince Charles, the future Charles V. The treaty laid down that the French heir apparent should always bear the title Dauphin, and granted the region wide autonomy and tax exemptions, most of which were withdrawn in 1457. Valentinois and the county of Vienne were added in 1404 and 1450, and the Dauphiné remained a province of France until the Revolution.
zh: 以格勒诺布尔为中心的维埃努瓦多菲内，前身是阿尔邦伯国；1032年勃艮第王国并入神圣罗马帝国后，阿尔蓬伯爵们把阿尔卑斯山区与罗讷河谷的一批小封邑联合成一片领地。12世纪的伯爵吉格四世在纹章上使用海豚图案，得到“多芬”的绰号，他的后代便以维埃努瓦多芬为头衔。1337年在位的是拉图尔迪潘支系的安贝尔二世，他是阿尔勒王国治下的帝国诸侯，领有加普、布里扬松、罗芒等山城。他独子幼年夭折，又债台高筑，遂于1349年7月16日把整个多菲内卖给法兰西王室，交付给年幼的王子查理，即日后的查理五世。条约规定法兰西王太子此后一律称多芬，并给予当地广泛的自治和免税特权，不过这些特权大部分在1457年被收回。瓦朗蒂努瓦和维埃纳伯地又分别于1404年和1450年并入，多菲内作为法兰西的一个省一直延续到法国大革命。

en: Dawaro was a small Muslim principality on the eastern edge of the Ethiopian highlands, lying east of Hadiya and north of Bale across much of the later Arsi country. Its people were Hanafi Muslims who grew cereals and fruit, reared horses and traded with iron pieces called hakuna as a primitive currency. In the late 1320s its ruler Haydara joined the rebellion of Sabr ad-Din of Ifat and put the emperor's envoys to death; Amda Seyon I retaliated by devastating the land and reducing Dawaro to a tributary vassal, the position it holds in 1337. For two centuries it was a tug-of-war frontier: Emperor Zara Yaqob planted Christian garrisons there and in 1445 defeated and killed the Adal sultan Badlay at the Battle of Gomit. The Adal imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi made Dawaro his first target, raiding it in 1526, crushing an imperial army at Shimbra Kure in 1529 and occupying the province in 1531. Emperor Gelawdewos later reconquered it, and a band of Portuguese even held it briefly, but in the 1540s the advancing Oromo swept over Dawaro and the old principality disappeared beneath their settlement.
zh: 达瓦罗是埃塞俄比亚高原东缘的一个小型穆斯林公国，位于哈迪亚以东、巴莱以北，大致覆盖后来的阿尔西地区的大部分。居民是遵奉哈乃斐学派的穆斯林，种植谷物和水果，饲养马匹，用一种叫“哈库纳”的铁条作为原始货币交易。14世纪20年代末，达瓦罗统治者海达拉加入伊法特的萨卜尔丁叛乱，并处死了皇帝的使节；阿姆达·塞约恩一世以蹂躏全境作为报复，把达瓦罗降为纳贡附庸，这正是它在1337年的地位。此后两个世纪里，这里成为拉锯战的边疆：扎拉·雅各布皇帝在此驻扎基督教守军，并于1445年在戈米特战役击败并击毙阿达尔苏丹巴德莱。阿达尔的伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐把达瓦罗作为首个目标，1526年先行劫掠，1529年在辛布拉库雷战役击溃帝国军队，1531年占领该省。后来格拉德沃斯皇帝将其收复，一队葡萄牙人甚至曾短暂据守此地，但到16世纪40年代，西进的奥罗莫人席卷达瓦罗，这个古老公国便在他们的定居浪潮中消失了。

en: The Kingdom of Dambadeniya was the Sinhalese realm that arose after the invader Kalinga Magha shattered Polonnaruwa. Vijayabahu III established his capital at Dambadeniya around 1220 and reunited the scattered Buddhist Sangha at a convention held in 1226. His son Parakramabahu II, a poet whose Kausilumina is a masterpiece of Sinhala literature, repelled the invasion of the Malay chieftain Chandrabhanu. After Vijayabahu IV was crowned in 1270 and murdered by his minister Miththa, Bhuvanekabahu I removed the court to the rock fortress of Yapahuwa in 1273; when the Pandyas raided it in 1284 they carried off the Sacred Tooth Relic, which Parakramabahu III recovered from India in 1288. From 1303 the kings ruled from Kurunegala, where Parakramabahu IV translated the Jataka tales into Sinhala and reorganized the rituals of the Tooth Relic. In 1337 the throne belonged to Vijayabahu V, but the line was nearly spent: around 1341 the court moved again to Gampola, and the Dambadeniya period ended in 1345.
zh: 檀婆提尼耶王国是入侵者卡林加·马加摧毁波隆纳鲁沃之后兴起的僧伽罗政权。维贾雅巴胡三世约于1220年定都檀婆提尼耶，并在1226年召集集会，使四散的佛教僧团重新统一。其子波罗迦罗摩巴忽二世是诗人，所作《考西卢米纳》是僧伽罗文学杰作，他还击退了马来酋长昌德拉巴努的入侵。维贾雅巴胡四世1270年即位，旋即被大臣米塔杀害；布伐奈迦巴忽一世遂于1273年把宫廷迁到磐石要塞亚帕胡瓦。1284年潘地亚人来袭，掠走佛牙舍利，波罗迦罗摩巴忽三世于1288年从印度将其迎回。1303年起诸王以库鲁内格勒为都，波罗迦罗摩巴忽四世在此把《本生经》译为僧伽罗语，并重整佛牙舍利的仪轨。1337年在位的是维贾雅巴胡五世，但王统已近尾声：1341年前后宫廷再迁甘波勒，檀婆提尼耶时代于1345年结束。

en: The Dobe'a were the people of Doba, a country of northeastern Ethiopia between Enderta and Lake Ashenge, on the edge of the highlands above the Afar lowlands. They were pastoralists famous for their large cattle, living partly by raiding and governed by twenty-four leaders, twelve of whom were customarily at war while twelve kept the peace. Their chief town, Manadeley, stood on the trade route down to the Afar country and grew into a great market where merchants from Cairo, Jeddah, Tunis, Morocco and India bought and sold. The Dobe'a enter written history through the campaigns of Emperor Ba'eda Maryam, who reigned from 1468 to 1478: after years of inconclusive expeditions his armies broke their resistance, many Dobe'a accepted Christianity, and the emperor built a church of the Virgin Mary in their land, garrisoned it with soldiers and ordered the people to settle as cultivators. In the 1520s the Portuguese priest Francisco Álvares still found Manadeley a flourishing trading city, though drought and the heavy gold dues levied under Emperor Lebna Dengel, who reigned from 1508 to 1540, had begun to impoverish the region.
zh: 多贝亚人是多巴地区的居民，该地位于埃塞俄比亚东北部恩达尔塔与阿申盖湖之间，坐落在俯瞰阿法尔低地的高原边缘。他们是以高大牛群闻名的牧民，兼以劫掠为生，由二十四名首领治理，按惯例十二人负责征战、十二人维持和平。他们的重镇马纳德利位于通往阿法尔地区的商路上，发展成巨大的集市，开罗、吉达、突尼斯、摩洛哥和印度的商人都在此交易。多贝亚人因1468至1478年在位的巴埃达·马里亚姆皇帝的征讨才进入文字记载：连年远征无果后，皇帝的军队终于击垮其抵抗，许多多贝亚人皈依基督教，皇帝在当地修建圣母教堂、派驻军队，并下令众人定居务农。16世纪20年代，葡萄牙神父弗朗西斯科·阿尔瓦雷斯仍见到马纳德利是繁盛的商业城市，不过旱灾和1508至1540年在位的莱布纳·丹格尔皇帝征收的沉重黄金贡赋，已开始使这一地区贫困。

en: Decies was the anglicised name of the Déisi, a district in western County Waterford that had been the regional kingdom of the Déisi Muman, vassals of the Eóganachta kings at Cashel, since the early Middle Ages. After the Anglo-Norman invasion Henry II granted the country to Sir Roger le Puher in 1177, and his family, later called le Poer or Power, made Curraghmore their seat and became the principal lords of Decies. The territory preserved its ancient identity in the baronies of Decies-within-Drum and Decies-without-Drum. In the fifteenth century a younger son of the Earl of Desmond also held Decies as an appanage, while the le Poer line continued at Curraghmore and was raised to the peerage as Baron la Poer in 1535 and as Viscount Decies and Earl of Tyrone in 1673. The male line of the le Poers died out in 1704, when the Curraghmore inheritance passed through marriage to the Beresford family.
zh: 迪希斯是迪希地区的英语化名称，位于沃特福德郡西部；中世纪早期这里曾是迪希·蒙曼人的地区王国，臣属于卡舍尔的埃奥赫塔诸王。盎格鲁—诺曼入侵后，亨利二世于1177年把这片土地封给罗杰·勒普尔爵士，其家族（后来又称勒普尔或鲍尔）以卡拉莫尔为治所，成为迪希斯的主要领主。这片地区在鼓内迪希和鼓外迪希两个男爵区中保留了古老的地域认同。15世纪，德斯蒙德伯爵的一个幼子也曾以迪希斯为封地，而勒普尔本支则继续盘踞卡拉莫尔，并于1535年受封拉普尔男爵、1673年受封迪希斯子爵和蒂龙伯爵。1704年勒普尔家族男嗣断绝，卡拉莫尔的遗产经婚姻转入贝雷斯福德家族。

en: Dongchuan occupies the Jinsha River valley of northeastern Yunnan, a country the Dali Kingdom knew as the Bipan tribe of the Wuman Yi. The Tang set up Dongchuan Commandery here in the eighth century, and under the Yuan and Ming the hereditary Lu clan of the Yi ruled it as tusi; the Ming made it Dongchuan Prefecture in 1382 but placed it under Sichuan rather than Yunnan. Its copper hills, worked at Tangdan and elsewhere, made it one of the richest mining lands of the southwest. During the Ming-Qing wars the chieftains Lu Wanyi and Lu Wanzhao held the passes against the rebel Western army, whose general Ai Nengqi was ambushed here and died of a poisoned-arrow wound in 1648, and the chieftain Lu Changxian rose in 1665 against the Qing policy of replacing native chiefs with appointed officials. A blood feud over succession inside the Lu clan in 1699 gave the court its opening: appointed officials replaced the native prefect, the prefecture was transferred from Sichuan to Yunnan in 1726, and Huize County was added in 1727 and became the prefectural seat the next year. Through the Qing, Dongchuan copper fed the empire's mints while the old native polity survived only in name.
zh: 东川地处云南东北部的金沙江峡谷，大理国时期是乌蛮彝族閟畔部的居地。唐代中叶在此设东川郡，元明两朝由世袭的彝族禄氏担任土司，1382年明朝置东川府，却划归四川管辖而非云南。境内汤丹等地的铜矿使它成为西南最富庶的矿区之一。明清易代之际，东川土司禄万亿、禄万兆据险抗拒大西军，1648年大西军将领艾能奇进剿时中伏，毒箭伤重而亡；1665年东川土司禄昌贤又举兵反抗清朝的改土归流。1699年禄氏家族为争夺土府继承权自相残杀，朝廷乘机派任流官；1726年东川府由四川改隶云南，1727年置会泽县，次年县治移为府治。清代东川的铜矿源源供应朝廷铸钱，而旧日的土司政权已名存实亡。

en: The marcher lordship of Denbigh grew out of Perfeddwlad, the Welsh patrimony east of Snowdonia where the princes of Gwynedd kept a royal court. Dafydd ap Gruffudd held it from 1277 and rebuilt its stronghold, called Dinbych, meaning little fortress, but after his revolt Edward I's army took the place after a month-long siege in 1282. The king formed a new lordship and granted it to Henry de Lacy, Earl of Lincoln, who raised a great castle and a walled borough planted with English settlers under the direction of the royal mason James of St George. The Welsh briefly seized the castle during the revolt of Madog ap Llywelyn in 1294. On Henry's death in 1311 Denbigh passed to his daughter Alice and her husband Thomas of Lancaster, and after Thomas's execution in 1322 it moved rapidly between Hugh Despenser, Roger Mortimer and William Montagu, the lord shown in 1337. The Mortimers recovered it in 1355; Owain Glyndwr's rebels sacked the town in 1400 but never took the castle, and in 1425 the lordship passed to Richard, Duke of York. During the Wars of the Roses the walled town was burned, and in the English Civil War a royalist Denbigh fell to Parliament in 1646, after which the castle was dismantled.
zh: 登比边区领的前身是佩费斯乌拉德，即斯诺登尼亚以东、圭内斯诸王设有王庭的威尔士世袭领地。1277年起达菲德·阿普·格鲁菲德领有此地，并重修了名为丁比赫（意为“小堡垒”）的要塞；他起兵反叛后，爱德华一世的军队于1282年围攻一个月将其攻克。国王新设一个领地，封给林肯伯爵亨利·德·莱西，由御用石匠圣乔治的詹姆斯主持，修建了宏伟城堡和安置英格兰移民的有墙自治市镇。1294年马多格·阿普·卢埃林起义时，威尔士人一度占领城堡。1311年亨利去世后，登比传给女儿艾丽斯及其丈夫兰开斯特的托马斯；1322年托马斯被处决后，领地在休·德斯潘塞、罗杰·莫蒂默和威廉·蒙塔古（即1337年的领主）之间迅速转手。莫蒂默家族于1355年重新取得领地；1400年欧文·格兰道尔的起义军洗劫了市镇却始终未能攻下城堡，1425年领地传给约克公爵理查。玫瑰战争中市镇被焚毁，英国内战期间保王派据守的登比于1646年落入议会军之手，城堡随后被拆毁。

en: Diafunu, also spelled Diafounou or Dyahunu, is a historical Soninke region on the upper Kolinbiné river in the Sahel west of the Niger, a land its name calls the country of the people of Dia. The Arab geographer al-Bakri already mentioned it in 1068, and between the 900s and 1100s it was a crossroads for the trade in salt, gold, horses and slaves, drawing merchants from Sijilmasa and Ghadames. In the 1100s clans fleeing the decline of Wagadu settled here: the Dukure founded the towns of Tambacara and Gory after the old capital Sain Demba was destroyed, and their elders ruled as tunka, or king. Yaqut al-Hamawi in the 1220s heard of the ruler of Zafunu as a powerful king, received with honour by the Almoravids of Marrakesh. Diafunu had backed Soumaoro Kante and the Sosso against Sundiata Keita, so Mali's victory brought it under Mandinka rule, and in the 1300s it was one of the chief provinces of the Mali Empire. In later centuries it was raided from the desert, fought its neighbour Khasso, and from 1774 paid tribute to the Bambara kingdom of Kaarta.
zh: 贾富努（又译迪亚富努或迪亚胡努）是索宁克人的历史地区，位于尼日尔河以西萨赫勒地带的科兰比内河上游，其地名称意为迪亚人的土地。阿拉伯地理学家巴克里早在1068年就提到过它；10至12世纪间，这里是盐、黄金、马匹和奴隶贸易的枢纽，吸引着来自西吉勒马萨和古达米斯的商人。12世纪，逃避瓦加杜衰乱的诸氏族迁居于此：旧都桑·登巴被毁后，杜库雷氏族建立了坦巴卡拉和戈里两镇，族中长老以通卡（即国王）之号统治。13世纪20年代，雅库特·哈马维笔下的扎富努国王权势显赫，在马拉喀什受到穆拉比特人的隆重接待。贾富努曾支持苏毛罗·坎特的索索对抗松迪亚塔·凯塔，马里获胜后它归入曼丁卡人治下，14世纪时是马里帝国的主要行省之一。此后数百年间，它屡遭沙漠方向的袭掠，与邻邦哈索交战，并从1774年起向班巴拉人的卡尔塔王国纳贡。

en: Dagbon is the kingdom of the Dagomba people in northern Ghana, tracing its ruling line to Naa Gbewaa, the same founder remembered by the Mamprusi and the Mossi. Gbewaa and his successors unified local communities that had been governed loosely by Tindaamba earth priests, and his son Shitobu moved the dynasty south; Shitobu's son Naa Nyagsi, who reigned from 1416 to 1432, conquered the surrounding peoples and built the first capital at Yani Dabari near Tamale, installing his own kin as chiefs over the conquered towns while the surviving tindaamba kept their ritual role. Gonja attacks from the west later forced the court to move east to Yendi, where Naa Zanjina finally defeated the invaders and became the first Muslim Yaa Naa, as the Dagbon ruler is titled. Dyula and Hausa merchants then made Yendi a flourishing market linked by caravan to Fezzan, Egypt and the Bight of Benin; by 1788 it was said to be larger than Kumasi or Salaga, even though the mass of Dagomba kept to their older earth shrines alongside the Islam of the court.
zh: 达格邦是达贡巴人的王国，位于加纳北部，统治世系追溯到纳阿·格贝瓦——曼普鲁西人和莫西人同样尊奉的那位始祖。格贝瓦和他的继承者把原先由廷达阿姆巴土地祭司松散管辖的地方社群统一起来；他的儿子希托布将王廷南移，希托布之子纳阿·尼亚格西（1416—1432年在位）征服周边各族，在塔马利附近的亚尼·达巴里建立首个都城，把亲族分封到被征服的城镇任酋长，而幸存的土地祭司则保留了宗教职能。后来来自西方的贡贾人进攻，迫使王廷东迁至延迪；纳阿·赞吉纳在那里最终击败入侵者，成为第一位穆斯林出身的亚阿·纳（达格邦国王的称号）。迪尤拉和豪萨商人随之把延迪变成繁荣的市场，驼队商路远接费赞、埃及和贝宁湾；到1788年，据说延迪的规模已超过库马西和萨拉加，而广大达贡巴民众在宫廷伊斯兰教之外，仍守着古老的土地神龛。

en: The Döger were one of the twenty-four tribes of the Oghuz Turks, belonging to the Bozok wing, and the eleventh-century scholar Mahmud al-Kashgari ranked them eighteenth among the Oghuz and counted them among the noblest. They supplied warriors to the Seljuk armies that conquered Iran and Anatolia, and the Artuqid dynasty, which ruled a beylik across the Jazira and northern Syria from the late eleventh century, sprang from their stock. In the fourteenth century the Döger pastured their flocks around Urfa, Raqqa and Harran as vassals of the Mamluk sultans. They never joined either of the great Turkoman confederations, though they lent their swords to the Kara Koyunlu and the Ak Koyunlu by turns, and in the early fifteenth century they were among the Mamluks' chief Turkoman allies on the northern frontier. Their last independent feat of arms came in 1435, when Sultan Barsbay ordered them against the Ak Koyunlu near Amid and their victory proved their final appearance as a real power in the region. Under Ottoman rule their clans were later settled around Urfa, Aleppo and Damascus.
zh: 都客儿是乌古斯突厥二十四部之一，属博佐克支系；11世纪的学者马哈茂德·喀什噶里将其列为乌古斯第十八部，并视其为贵种之一。他们为塞尔柱军队征服伊朗和安纳托利亚提供兵源，11世纪末起统辖杰济拉和北叙利亚一带贝伊国的阿尔图格王朝即出自该部。14世纪，都客儿人作为马穆鲁克苏丹的附庸，在乌尔法、拉卡和哈兰周边游牧。他们始终没有加入黑羊或白羊任何一个大的突厥蛮联盟，却轮番向两者借兵助战；15世纪初，他们是马穆鲁克北部边境最重要的突厥蛮盟友之一。他们最后一次独立用兵是在1435年，苏丹巴尔斯拜命他们进攻阿米德附近的白羊部，这场胜利也成了他们作为地区强权的最后亮相。奥斯曼统治时期，其部众后来被安置在乌尔法、阿勒颇和大马士革一带。

en: The Dughlat were a Mongol, later Turco-Mongol, clan that served the Chagatai khans as hereditary lords of the western Tarim cities of Aksu, Kashgar, Yarkand and Khotan from the fourteenth to the sixteenth century. Rashid al-Din lists them as a minor Mongol tribe that had moved into the Chagatai ulus, and when Chagatai power collapsed the Dughlat amirs became kingmakers: in 1347 Amir Bulaji enthroned Tughlugh Timur over Moghulistan, whose conversion to Islam the clan followed while long keeping Genghis Khan's Yasa law. Bulaji's brother Qamar ud-Din then murdered the new khan Ilyas Khoja and proclaimed himself khan, the only Dughlat to take the title, and fought Timur of Transoxiana until he vanished during Timur's invasion of 1390. The clan's senior amir Khudaidad restored the Chagatayid Khizr Khoja and divided the Tarim cities among his kinsmen. Late in the fifteenth century Mirza Aba Bakr built an independent kingdom with Yarkand as its capital and raided as far as Ferghana, Badakhshan and Ladakh, until Sultan Said Khan overthrew him in 1514, ending Dughlat rule in the Tarim. The clan's most famous son, Mirza Muhammad Haidar, fled to the Mughal emperor Humayun, conquered Kashmir in 1541 and ruled it for ten years while writing his Tarikh-i Rashidi, until he was killed in a Kashmiri revolt in 1551.
zh: 朵豁剌惕（又译杜格拉特）是一个蒙古、后来突厥化的蒙古氏族，14至16世纪间作为察合台汗的世袭封臣，统治塔里木盆地西部的阿克苏、喀什噶尔、叶尔羌与和田诸城。拉施德丁的《史集》把它列为迁入察合台兀鲁思的小部落；察合台汗国衰乱后，朵豁剌惕异密成了拥立新汗的人：1347年，异密播鲁只把秃忽鲁·帖木儿扶上蒙兀儿斯坦汗位，全族随新汗改宗伊斯兰教，却长期沿用成吉思汗的《大札撒》。播鲁只之弟哈马儿子随后杀害新汗也里牙思火者，僭称汗号——他是唯一称汗的朵豁剌惕人，并与河中地区的帖木儿连年交战，直到1390年帖木儿再次入侵时失踪。族中长辈异密忽歹达拥立黑的儿火者复位，又把塔里木诸城分给亲族。15世纪末，米尔咱·阿巴·伯克尔建立独立王国，以叶尔羌为都，兵锋远及费尔干纳、巴达赫尚和拉达克，1514年被赛德汗推翻，朵豁剌惕在塔里木的统治至此终结。族中最著名的米尔咱·马黑麻·海答儿逃奔莫卧儿皇帝胡马雍，1541年征服克什米尔并统治十年，其间写成《拉失德史》，最终于1551年在克什米尔人的叛乱中被杀。

en: The Maldives is a chain of twenty-six coral atolls in the Indian Ocean, southwest of India and Sri Lanka, whose rulers held court on Male, the King's Island. Settled more than two and a half thousand years ago by seafarers from the Indian subcontinent, the islands were a Buddhist kingdom for roughly fourteen centuries, during which the Dhivehi language, the early island scripts and the ruling institutions took shape. In 1153 the last Buddhist king, Dhovemi, adopted Islam and reigned as Sultan Muhammad al-Adil, opening the long line of six Muslim dynasties, while Arab and Persian traders made the islands a hub of the cowrie-shell trade. After the Portuguese killed Sultan Ali VI and occupied Male in 1558, Muhammad Thakurufaanu of Utheemu drove them out in 1573 and ruled as sultan, his victory still kept as the national day. The sultanate then passed under Dutch hegemony exercised from Ceylon, and when the British seized Ceylon in 1796 the Maldives entered the British orbit while keeping its own sultans.
zh: 马尔代夫是印度洋上由26个珊瑚环礁组成的岛链，位于印度和斯里兰卡西南方，历代君主在有“国王之岛”之称的马累施治。岛上最早的居民是2500多年前来自印度次大陆的航海者；在长达约1400年的时间里，这里是一个佛教王国，迪维希语、岛屿古文字和统治制度都在这一时期成形。1153年，末代佛教国王多维米改宗伊斯兰教，以苏丹穆罕默德·阿迪勒之名统治，开启了六个穆斯林王朝的漫长世系，阿拉伯和波斯商人则使群岛成为贝币贸易的枢纽。1558年，葡萄牙人杀害苏丹阿里六世并占领马累，乌蒂姆的穆罕默德·塔库鲁法努于1573年将他们逐出，随后即位为苏丹，这一胜利被马尔代夫定为国庆日。此后苏丹国受制于以锡兰为基地的荷兰势力；1796年英国夺取锡兰，马尔代夫转入英国势力范围，但仍保留自己的苏丹。

en: Bagar is the game's name for the Vagad country, the forested southernmost tract of Rajputana, historically the Dungarpur state. In the twelfth century the land was held by Bhil chiefs until Mahup, the disinherited eldest son of Karan Singh of Mewar, took refuge with his mother's Chauhan kin and made himself master of Vagad at their expense; from this Guhila line came the elder Sisodia branch, while Mewar itself passed to his younger brother's line. The early raws ruled from Baroda: Virasimhadeva is attested by Sanskrit inscriptions of 1287 and 1302, and his grandson Dungarasimha founded and named Dungarpur, tradition says after the Bhil chieftain Dungaria. In 1527 Rawal Udai Singh of Vagad died at Khanwa fighting beside Rana Sanga against Babur, and his lands were split between his sons into Dungarpur and Banswara. Dungarpur accepted Mughal suzerainty under Askaran, passed under Maratha pressure from 1736, and came under British treaty protection in 1818.
zh: 婆迦尔是游戏对瓦加德地区的称呼，即拉杰普塔纳最南端林木茂密的地带，历史上即栋格尔布尔土邦。12世纪时这里由比尔人首领占据，后来梅瓦尔王卡兰·辛格被剥夺继承权的长子马胡普投奔母族乔汉人，反客为主夺取瓦加德；这一古希拉支系成为西索迪亚家族的长支，而梅瓦尔本土则传给其弟一系。早期的罗瓦尔以巴罗达为都：维拉辛哈提婆见于1287年和1302年的梵文铭文，其孙栋加拉辛哈建立了以自己名字命名的栋格尔布尔——相传城名来自比尔首领栋加里亚。1527年，瓦加德的罗瓦尔乌代·辛格在坎瓦之战中随拉那·桑伽对抗巴布尔，战死沙场，他的领地被两个儿子分成栋格尔布尔和班斯瓦拉两邦。栋格尔布尔在阿斯卡兰时接受莫卧儿宗主权，1736年起承受马拉塔人的压力，1818年通过条约接受英国保护。

en: Dhofar was the frankincense coast of southern Arabia, whose harbor city of Zafar, the medieval site of al-Baleed near modern Salalah, had exported incense to India and China since antiquity. Around 1300 the Venetian traveler Marco Polo found it a Muslim city whose local lord acknowledged the sultan of Aden, and in the fourteenth century a side-branch of the Yemeni Rasulid dynasty governed this distant province from Zafar, holding the neighboring Mahra coast and the island of Socotra on a loose rein. The incense trade sustained the city's Manjawi civilization until the Kathiri sultanate of Hadhramaut, founded in 1395, seized Dhofar in 1414. Mahri tribesmen then made Socotra their own base around 1480, and a Portuguese fleet stormed the island in 1507 before abandoning it in 1511. Dhofar itself remained under Kathiri rule until the rise of Omani power in the following centuries.
zh: 佐法尔是阿拉伯半岛南部的乳香海岸，治下的港口佐法尔城即今塞拉莱附近的巴利德遗址，自古就向印度和中国输出乳香。约1300年，威尼斯旅行家马可·波罗见到这里已是穆斯林城市，地方首领臣服于亚丁苏丹；14世纪时，也门拉苏尔王朝的一支旁系以佐法尔城统治这个偏远行省，对邻近的迈赫拉海岸和索科特拉岛只维持松散控制。乳香贸易支撑着当地的曼贾维文明，直到1395年建立的哈德拉毛卡西尔苏丹国于1414年夺取佐法尔。此后迈赫拉部落约在1480年把索科特拉岛变成自己的据点，葡萄牙舰队又于1507年攻占该岛，1511年弃守。佐法尔本地则长期归卡西尔人统治，直到此后几个世纪里阿曼苏丹势力兴起。

en: Dahlak was a Muslim sultanate of the Dahlak Archipelago off the Eritrean Red Sea coast, at its height also ruling the mainland port of Massawa through a deputy titled the nai'b. The islands had served the Umayyads and Abbasids as a place of exile before passing under the Abyssinian king in the ninth century. The first sultan known by name is Mubarak, whose funerary stele records his death in 1093, and his line ruled through the islands' golden age. Dahlak grew rich on the monopoly of Ethiopia's foreign trade and the transit traffic between Egypt and India, minting its own coins and serving as the channel for Abyssinian diplomacy with Yemen; the Abyssinians called its ruler the Seyuma Bahr, or Prefect of the Sea. In the mid-thirteenth century the Zagwe kings opened a southern trade route ending at Zeila, and Dahlak lost its monopoly and slipped into dependence on Yemen's Rasulid dynasty. Emperor Zara Yaqob sacked Massawa and the islands in 1464 and 1465, killing the local qadi. The sultanate then became a Tahirid vassal, fought the Portuguese in 1517 and 1520, and Sultan Ahmad joined the Adalite war against Ethiopia before the Portuguese destroyed Dahlak again in 1541. In 1557 the Ottomans annexed the islands into their Habesh Eyalet, and the old trading state disappeared.
zh: 达赫拉克是红海厄立特里亚沿岸达赫拉克群岛上的穆斯林苏丹国，鼎盛时还通过头衔为奈布的副手统治大陆港口马萨瓦。这些岛屿曾被倭马亚王朝和阿拔斯王朝用作流放地，9世纪转归阿比西尼亚国王统辖。第一位有名可考的苏丹是穆巴拉克，其墓碑记载他卒于1093年，他的王朝贯穿了群岛的黄金时代。达赫拉克靠垄断埃塞俄比亚对外贸易、经营埃及与印度之间的转口贸易致富，自铸钱币，还是阿比西尼亚与也门外交往来的通道；阿比西尼亚人称其统治者为塞尤马·巴赫里，意即海之首长。13世纪中期，扎格维王朝开辟了以泽拉为终点的南方商路，达赫拉克丧失垄断地位，沦为也门拉苏里王朝的附庸。1464至1465年，扎拉·雅各布皇帝洗劫马萨瓦和群岛，杀死当地卡迪。此后苏丹国成为塔希尔王朝的属国，1517年和1520年两度与葡萄牙人交战；苏丹艾哈迈德加入阿达尔对埃塞俄比亚的战争，1541年葡萄牙人再度摧毁达赫拉克。1557年，奥斯曼人吞并群岛，将其划入哈贝什省，这个古老的贸易国家就此消亡。

en: Durham was the greatest of England's ecclesiastical palatinates, ruled by its bishop with powers normally reserved to the Crown. Its origins lie in the Patrimony of St Cuthbert, the lands between the Tyne and the Tees held by the community that carried the saint's relics away from Viking raids; the region was so autonomous that it was left out of the Domesday Book. In 1075 Bishop Walcher added the earldom of Northumbria to his see, and by the late thirteenth century the bishop of Durham could raise armies, hold his own courts, mint coinage and appoint judges, guarding the English frontier against Scotland from the fortified city on the Wear. In 1337 the mitre belonged to Richard de Bury, formerly tutor to Edward III and the most celebrated book collector of his age, whose Philobiblon praised the love of learning. The palatinate's border role was proved in 1346, when a Scottish invasion under David II was shattered at Neville's Cross just outside Durham and the Scottish king was captured. From the Act of Resumption of 1536 onward the Crown steadily whittled away the bishop's special rights, and the remaining palatine powers were finally transferred to the Crown in 1836.
zh: 达勒姆是英格兰最大的教会巴拉丁领地，由主教以通常只属于国王的权力统治。它的源头是“圣卡斯伯特遗产”，即携带圣徒遗骨躲避维京人劫掠的教团所拥有的泰恩河与蒂斯河之间的土地；这片地区自治程度极高，甚至没有被载入《末日审判书》。1075年，主教瓦尔赫又为教区取得诺森伯兰伯爵之位；到13世纪末，达勒姆主教已能征召军队、开设法庭、铸造货币、任命法官，并据威尔河畔的设防城市镇守英格兰抵御苏格兰的北疆。1337年戴主教冠的是理查德·德·伯里，他曾任爱德华三世的教师，是当时最负盛名的藏书家，所著《爱书论》颂扬对学问的热爱。1346年，戴维二世率领的苏格兰入侵军在达勒姆城外的内维尔十字之战被击溃，苏格兰国王本人被俘，印证了这块领地的边防价值。自1536年的《权力收回法令》起，王室不断削夺主教的特权，残余的巴拉丁特权最终于1836年全部移交王室。

en: The Kingdom of Amber was the Kachhwaha Rajput state of the Dhundhar region in north-eastern Rajputana, the country that later became Jaipur. Its founder, Rao Dulha Rai, was perhaps a survivor of the Kachchhapaghata dynasty of Gwalior who migrated from Narwar to Dausa in the eleventh century and, with Chauhan backing, conquered Dhundhar from its Meena and Bargujar chiefs; his successor Kakil seized the hill fort of Amber from the Meenas and made it the capital. For centuries a small highland chiefdom, Amber was overshadowed by Mewar and in the fifteenth century paid tribute to Rana Kumbha. Its fortunes changed under Raja Bharmal, who in 1562 offered Akbar a daughter in marriage and became the first Rajput raja to enter Mughal service; Bharmal's son Bhagwant Das and grandson Man Singh I rose to command Mughal armies, and the princess Mariam-uz-Zamani became the mother of the Emperor Jahangir. Mirza Raja Jai Singh I served Shah Jahan as one of his foremost generals but lost Aurangzeb's favour when Shivaji escaped from his custody in 1666. As the empire weakened, Sawai Jai Singh II made himself effectively independent in 1708, laid out the planned city of Jaipur as his new capital in 1727 and built the Jantar Mantar observatories for his astronomical studies. Later succession wars and Maratha tribute demands drained the state, and in 1818 its rulers accepted a subsidiary alliance with the British East India Company, under whom it survived as Jaipur State.
zh: 安泊尔王国是拉杰普塔纳东北部敦达尔地区的卡奇瓦哈拉杰普特政权，即后来斋浦尔土邦的前身。其开创者拉奥·杜尔哈·拉伊可能是瓜廖尔卡奇帕加塔王朝的遗裔，11世纪从纳尔瓦尔迁居道萨，在乔汉人支持下从迷那和巴尔古贾尔首领手中征服敦达尔；继任者卡基尔又从迷那人手里夺取安泊尔山堡，定为都城。此后数百年它只是个高原小邦，在梅瓦尔的阴影下生存，15世纪还向拉纳·昆巴纳贡。拉贾·巴尔马尔时命运扭转：1562年他把女儿嫁给阿克巴，成为最早效力莫卧儿的拉杰普特罗阇；其子巴格万特·达斯和其孙曼·辛格一世都成为莫卧儿军队的统兵大将，这位公主玛丽亚姆·扎马尼正是皇帝贾汉吉尔的生母。米尔扎·罗阇杰伊·辛格一世是沙贾汗麾下最重要的将领之一，却因1666年西瓦吉从其看管下逃脱而失宠于奥朗则布。莫卧儿帝国衰落之际，萨瓦伊·杰伊·辛格二世于1708年取得实际独立，1727年兴建规划之城斋浦尔作为新都，并建造了用于天文观测的詹塔尔·曼塔尔天文台。后来的继承内战和马拉塔人的盘剥使邦国疲敝，1818年其君主接受英国东印度公司的附属同盟，以斋浦尔土邦之名存续。

en:
The County of Diez was a Holy Roman Empire lordship on the river Lahn, first recorded in 1073 and probably built from the former lands of the Conradines in the Niederlahngau. From their castle at Diez the counts held territory stretching up the Lahn to Weilburg and into the Westerwald. They rose as loyal servants of the Hohenstaufen: Henry II of Diez accompanied Frederick Barbarossa on his Italian campaigns and inherited estates in the Wetterau, and the county was known in its heyday as the Golden County. In 1207 the lords exchanged the bailiwick of Mainz-Kastel for imperial immediacy, and in 1289 Count Gerhard VII merged the family's collegiate foundation at Salz into the collegiate church of Diez.

The fall of the Hohenstaufen in 1254 began a long decline, and a collateral Weilnau line split off in 1302. With Count Gottfried judged unfit to rule, Nassau-Hadamar held the guardianship until 1332, when Gottfried's son Gerhard VI, the count ruling in 1337, took over; he died fighting Limburg in 1343. The last count, Gerhard VII, died in 1388, and Diez passed through his daughter Jutta to Adolf I of Nassau-Siegen. The county was then repeatedly partitioned among Nassau, Eppstein, Katzenelnbogen, Hesse and Trier, until the Diez Treaty of 1564 divided it between Nassau-Dillenburg and the Electorate of Trier. From 1606 the Nassau line took the name Nassau-Dietz, ancestor of the House of Orange-Nassau; the lands went to France in 1795 and to the Duchy of Nassau in 1815.
zh:
迪茨伯国是神圣罗马帝国在兰河畔的领地，最早见于1073年的记载，很可能由康拉丁家族在下兰高的旧地发展而来。伯爵们以迪茨城堡为治所，领土沿兰河上溯至威尔堡，并伸入韦斯特林山。他们作为霍亨斯陶芬家族的忠仆而崛起：迪茨的亨利二世随腓特烈·巴巴罗萨出征意大利，又继承了韦特劳的地产，鼎盛时期的伯国被称为“黄金伯国”。1207年，领主们以美因茨-卡斯特尔的管辖权换取帝国直辖地位；1289年，格哈德七世伯爵把家族在萨尔的修道基金会并入迪茨的修道院教堂。

1254年霍亨斯陶芬家族倒台后，伯国长期衰落，1302年旁支韦尔瑙一脉分出。戈特弗里德伯爵被判定无力执政，拿骚-哈达马尔家族监护领地至1332年，其后戈特弗里德之子、1337年在位的格哈德六世亲政，他于1343年与林堡作战时身亡。末代伯爵格哈德七世于1388年去世，迪茨经其女尤塔传给拿骚-锡根的阿道夫一世。此后伯国在拿骚、埃普施泰因、卡岑埃尔恩博根、黑森和特里尔之间一再分割，直到1564年的《迪茨条约》将它分给拿骚-迪伦堡和特里尔选侯国。1606年起，拿骚一支以拿骚-迪茨为号，是奥兰治-拿骚家族的祖先；这片土地1795年落入法国之手，1815年并入拿骚公国。

en: The Dilmaçid beylik was a Turkoman principality born of the Seljuk victory at Manzikert in 1071. Its founder Mehmed Bey, a commander of Alp Arslan, received Bitlis as an iqta grant in 1085, and under his son Togan Arslan the beylik shook off Great Seljuk overlordship and fought the Crusaders alongside the Artukids, notably at Ager Sanguinis in 1119. In 1192 the Ahlatshahs seized Bitlis, after which the Dilmaçids held only Erzen and its countryside, the country around modern Kozluk and Hazo north of Siirt, where the small rump state survived through the fourteenth century under a succession of greater overlords. It disappeared around the 1410s, when the Aq Qoyunlu Turcomans absorbed its lands.
zh: 迪尔马奇贝伊国是1071年塞尔柱人在曼齐刻特获胜后兴起的突厥蛮小邦。开国者穆罕默德贝伊是阿尔普·阿尔斯兰的将领，1085年受封比特利斯作为伊克塔；其子托甘·阿尔斯兰在位时摆脱了大塞尔柱的宗主权，并随同阿尔图格王朝与十字军作战，1119年的血地之战尤为著名。1192年阿赫拉特沙王朝攻占比特利斯，迪尔马奇人只保有埃尔曾及其周边，即锡尔特以北、今科兹卢克和哈佐一带；这个残存小邦在一连串更强宗主的名义统治下延续过整个14世纪，约在1410年代被白羊王朝的突厥蛮人吞并。

en:
The Dimasa kingdom, also called the Kachari kingdom, was a state of the Dimasa people in medieval Assam, known to the Ahom chronicles as Timisa. By the late thirteenth century its rulers held the country between the Dikhu and Kolong rivers, including the Dhansiri valley and the North Cachar hills, with their capital at Dimapur; excavations at the Rajbari citadel show the site was occupied from at least the third century. In 1490 the Dimasa destroyed an Ahom outpost on the Dikhau and forced King Suhenphaa to buy peace with a princess, and in 1520 King Khorapha struck at Dimapur the first Hindu-style coin of the Brahmaputra valley.

Long wars with the Ahoms followed: Suhungmung's armies killed Khorapha, and in 1536 they occupied Dimapur, after which the Dimasa rulers abandoned the city. After a twenty-two-year interregnum Nirbhaya Narayana founded a new capital at Maibang in 1558. The Koch general Chilarai made the kingdom a Koch feudatory in 1564, yet under Satrudaman it grew strong enough to set a client king on Jaintia and strike coins at Sylhet. When Tamradhwaj asserted independence the Ahom king Rudra Singha stormed Maibang in 1706 and reduced the kingdom to vassalage. In 1745 it absorbed the Koch state of Khaspur and moved its court there; Burmese occupation followed, and after the Treaty of Yandabo the British annexed the plains in 1832 and the hills in 1834, ending the Dimasa kingdom.
zh:
底马撒王国又称卡恰尔王国，是底马撒人在中世纪阿萨姆建立的国家，阿洪姆编年史称之为提米萨。13世纪末，其君主据有迪库河与科隆河之间的土地，包括丹西里河谷和北卡恰尔山区，以迪马布尔为都；对拉杰巴里卫城的发掘表明，该遗址至少从3世纪起便有人居住。1490年，底马撒人摧毁了阿洪姆人在迪考河畔的前沿据点，迫使国王苏亨法以公主和亲求和；1520年，国王科拉法在迪马布尔铸出布拉马普特拉河谷第一枚印度教样式的钱币。

此后底马撒与阿洪姆长期交战：苏洪蒙的军队杀死科拉法，又于1536年攻占迪马布尔，底马撒君主被迫弃城而走。经过二十二年的空位期，尼尔巴亚·纳拉扬于1558年在迈邦建立新都。1564年科赫将领奇拉赖将其收为科赫属国，但在萨特鲁达曼治下，王国再度强盛，曾在贾因蒂亚扶立附庸国王，并在锡尔赫特铸币。塔姆拉德瓦杰宣布独立后，阿洪姆国王鲁陀罗·辛格于1706年攻陷迈邦，将其降为附庸。1745年，底马撒吞并科赫人的卡斯布尔邦，把朝廷迁到那里；其后又遭缅甸占领，《杨达坡条约》后，英国于1832年兼并其平原地区、1834年兼并山区，底马撒王国灭亡。

en: Disentis was a Benedictine imperial abbey in the Surselva valley of Graubünden, dedicated to Saint Martin of Tours, around whose walls the town of Disentis grew up. Founded in the early eighth century by the Frankish monk Sigisbert and the local landowner Placidus, it already held great estates when Bishop Tello of Chur drew up his testament in 765, and Charlemagne visited it on his return from Rome in 800. As a Reichskloster it answered directly to the emperor, and its position on the Lukmanier Pass, crossed by Otto I and Frederick Barbarossa on their journeys to Italy, brought it lands reaching into Lombardy; Abbot Udalric I, who ruled from 1031 to 1055, was the first of its abbots to be made a prince of the empire. The abbey's territory, known as Cadi, the House of God, gained its own seal in 1285 and its own Landammann in 1371, and entered the Grey League as an autonomous commune in 1401. The abbey joined the Swiss Benedictine Congregation in 1617, rebuilt its church of Saint Martin in 1712, and was plundered and burned by French troops in 1799.
zh: 迪森蒂斯是格劳宾登苏尔塞尔瓦河谷的一座本笃派帝国修道院，奉图尔的圣马丁为主保，迪森蒂斯镇即围绕修道院的围墙发展起来。它由法兰克修士西吉斯贝特和当地地主普拉西杜斯于8世纪初创建；765年库尔主教特洛立下遗嘱时，修道院已拥有大片地产，查理曼于800年从罗马返程途中曾到此造访。作为直属皇帝的帝国修道院，它扼守奥托一世和腓特烈一世（巴巴罗萨）南下意大利时翻越的卢克马尼尔山口，借此把领地一直扩展到伦巴第；1031至1055年在任的院长乌达尔里克一世是首位受封帝国诸侯的迪森蒂斯院长。修道院的领地称“卡迪”，意为“上帝之屋”，1285年启用自己的印章，1371年有了自己的地方长官，1401年作为自治公社加入灰盟。修道院于1617年加入瑞士本笃会联会，1712年重建圣马丁教堂，1799年遭法军洗劫并焚毁。

en: Dithmarschen was a stretch of marsh and fen on the North Sea coast between the Eider and Elbe estuaries, whose free peasants acknowledged no lord but the remote overlordship of the Prince-Archbishopric of Bremen. From the thirteenth century its parishes and village communes ran their own affairs through elected elders meeting at Heide, making it one of the few peasant republics of the Holy Roman Empire and an ally of Hanseatic towns. Its flooded fields and ditches were its best defense: in 1319 the peasants destroyed a Holstein army under Count Gerhard III at the Battle of Wöhrden, and in 1404 Count Gerhard VI of Holstein-Rendsburg was killed campaigning against them. In 1447 the communes fixed a common government of forty-eight regents, and between 1474 and 1481 they beat Holstein's claims in the imperial courts and won recognition as a direct imperial fief. Their most famous victory came at Hemmingstedt in 1500, when the militia shattered the invading army of King John of Denmark. The republic adopted the Reformation in 1533, but its independence ended in the Last Feud of 1559, when Frederick II of Denmark's general Johan Rantzau took Heide and Meldorf; the peasants kept much of their self-rule under the Danish crown and the Holstein dukes.
zh: 迪特马尔申是北海沿岸、艾德河与易北河河口之间的一片沼泽低地，这里的自由农民不承认任何领主，只名义上尊奉不来梅大主教区的宗主权。从13世纪起，各教区和村社通过推选的长老在海德集会处理公共事务，使它成为神圣罗马帝国境内少有的农民共和国之一，并与汉萨城市结盟。它那片水网密布的沼泽就是最好的防线：1319年农民们在沃尔登战役歼灭了格哈德三世伯爵率领的荷尔斯泰因军队，1404年荷尔斯泰因‑伦茨堡的格哈德六世伯爵又在征讨他们时丧命。1447年，各公社确立了由四十八名摄政组成的共同政府；1474—1481年，他们又在帝国法庭上击败荷尔斯泰因的主权要求，获承认为直属帝国的封地。1500年的黑明施泰特战役是他们最辉煌的胜利：民兵击溃了丹麦国王约翰的入侵大军。共和国于1533年接受宗教改革，但独立在1559年的“最后之争”中终结，丹麦国王弗雷德里克二世的名将约翰·兰曹攻占海德和梅尔多夫；农民们在丹麦王室与荷尔斯泰因公爵治下保留了相当多的自治权。

en: Djerid, the land of palm oases on the Saharan border, has its seat at Ghadames, one of the oldest towns of the desert, set where the borders of modern Libya, Tunisia and Algeria meet. The Romans knew it as Cydamus and kept a garrison there, and it was a Christian bishopric under the Byzantines before the Arab commander Uqba ibn Nafi brought Islam in the 660s. In the Islamic Middle Ages its Berber townspeople lived by the caravan trade: Ghadames was the great junction where the road from Tripoli through the Jabal Nafusa met the routes south to Ghat, the Fezzan and Timbuktu, handling gold, slaves and dates. It belonged to the Ibadi network of oasis communities that stretched from the Tunisian Jerid and Djerba through Ghadames to the M'zab, a region often governed in practice by its own Ibadi imams and council of elders while paying nominal tribute to the Hafsids of Tunis. The town reached its greatest prosperity in the eighteenth century, when the Ottoman rulers of Tripoli made it the leading caravan mart of the western Sahara.
zh: 杰里德是撒哈拉边境的棕榈绿洲之地，其首邑盖达米斯是沙漠中最古老的城镇之一，地处今利比亚、突尼斯和阿尔及利亚三国交界。罗马人称它为西达穆斯并在此驻军，拜占庭时期它是基督教主教区，7世纪60年代阿拉伯将领乌格巴·伊本·纳菲把伊斯兰教带到这里。中世纪伊斯兰时代，城中的柏柏尔居民以商队贸易为生：从的黎波里经奈富塞山而来的道路，在盖达米斯与南往加特、费赞和廷巴克图的商路交汇，经手黄金、奴隶和椰枣。它也是伊巴德派绿洲网络的一环，该网络从突尼斯的杰里德和杰尔巴岛经盖达米斯延伸到姆扎卜，这一带往往由本地伊巴德伊玛目和长老会议实际治理，只向突尼斯的哈夫斯王朝缴纳名义贡赋。18世纪，在的黎波里奥斯曼政权治下，盖达米斯成为西撒哈拉首要的商队贸易城，达到鼎盛。

en: Dala had its seat at Odoli on the Mudan river, one of the Jurchen myriarchies of the late-Yuan lower Songhua country, where five such commands had once stood and only three, Odoli, Huligai and Taowen, survived into the fourteenth century. The Odoli clans counted themselves descendants of the Jin Jurchens and were later revered as the ancestral line of the Aisin Gioro, the Qing imperial house. Hard pressed by Wild Jurchen raiders, Odoli and its neighbour Huligai migrated south around the turn of the fifteenth century to the Tumen river and the Korean borderlands. In 1406 the Ming recognised the Odoli chief Mengge Temur as a Jianzhou Guard commander, and in 1416 his following was split off as the Jianzhou Left Guard. After Mengge Temur was killed in 1433, the remnant moved west in 1440 to the Suzi river in Liaodong and merged with the Huligai into the Jianzhou Jurchens, from whom Nurhaci built the Later Jin.
zh: 达拉以牡丹江边的鄂多理为中心，是元末松花江下游女真五万户府之一斡朵怜万户府的所在地；五万户到14世纪只剩斡朵里、胡里改、桃温三个。斡朵里人自称金朝女真后裔，后被尊为清朝皇室爱新觉罗氏的先祖之部。受野人女真袭扰，斡朵里与邻部胡里改在14、15世纪之交相继南迁到图们江及朝鲜边境一带。1406年明朝封斡朵里酋长猛哥帖木儿为建州卫都指挥使，1416年又析出建州左卫令其专管。1433年猛哥帖木儿被杀，余部于1440年西迁辽东苏子河，与胡里改部重新汇合，形成建州女真，努尔哈赤即在此基础上建立后金。

en:
The Delhi Sultanate was founded in 1206, when after Muhammad of Ghor's victories over the Rajputs at Tarain his Turkic generals divided his Indian conquests and Qutb ud-Din Aibak established the first of five ruling houses, the Mamluk dynasty. The Khaljis, who seized power in 1290, carried Muslim arms deep into the Deccan under Alauddin Khalji and his general Malik Kafur, while also repelling repeated Mongol invasions from the north-west. In 1320 the throne passed to the Tughlaq dynasty, and under Muhammad bin Tughluq, reigning from 1325, the sultanate reached its greatest extent, stretching from the Indus to the Tamil country.

Muhammad bin Tughluq's vast empire proved too costly to hold: his token currency, the forced transfer of the court to Daulatabad and ruinous taxation provoked revolts, and in 1335 Ma'bar broke away while Bengal and the new Bahmani sultanate of 1347 soon followed, as the Hindu empire of Vijayanagara rose in the south. The later Tughlaqs never recovered the lost provinces, and Timur's sack of Delhi in 1398 left the sultanate a shadow of itself. Power passed to the Sayyid dynasty in 1414 and then the Afghan Lodis, until in 1526 Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi at Panipat and replaced the sultanate with the Mughal Empire.
zh:
德里苏丹国建立于1206年：古尔的穆罕默德在塔莱因击败拉杰普特联军后，他的突厥将领们瓜分了印度战果，库特布丁·艾伊拜克由此建立了五个统治王朝中的第一个——马穆鲁克王朝。1290年夺权的卡尔吉王朝在阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉及其将领马利克·卡富尔率领下，把穆斯林的兵锋深入德干，同时还多次击退了来自西北的蒙古入侵。1320年王位转入图格鲁克王朝；在1325年即位的穆罕默德·图格鲁克治下，苏丹国版图达到极盛，疆域从印度河一直延伸到泰米尔地区。

然而这个庞大帝国实在难以维系：代币制度、强迁朝廷到道拉塔巴德以及苛重的赋税激起了一连串反叛，1335年马巴尔独立，孟加拉和1347年新建的巴赫马尼苏丹国相继脱离，南方又兴起印度教的毗奢耶那伽罗帝国。后期的图格鲁克君主再未能收复失地，1398年帖木儿洗劫德里，更使苏丹国一蹶不振。1414年政权落入萨义德王朝，随后是阿富汗人的洛迪王朝；1526年，巴布尔在帕尼帕特击败易卜拉欣·洛迪，以莫卧儿帝国取代了德里苏丹国。

en: Donglan was a Zhuang native prefecture on the Hongshui River in northern Guangxi, covering roughly present-day Donglan County and ruled hereditarily by the Wei clan. The Song created it as Lan Prefecture in 1106, entrusting it to the local chief Wei Aannao, and under the Yuan it was renamed Donglan and placed under the Qingyuan-Nandan commission. It submitted to the Ming in 1379. A disputed succession followed when a household agent, Wei Qianbao, stole the tribute mission and secured the prefect's seal for himself; his exactions drove the legitimate chief Wei Funao into revolt, which was put down in 1385, though the Wei were afterwards confirmed in office alongside an appointed Chinese assistant. Donglan chiefs later joined the Sicheng attack on Tianzhou and sent troops against the Cen Meng rising of 1526. The Wei submitted to the Qing in 1652, and in 1729 the gaitu guiliu reform split the prefecture, leaving the Wei as junior native officers at Fengshan while regular officials took the main seat.
zh: 东兰是广西北部红水河畔的壮族土州，辖境大致在今东兰县一带，由韦氏土司世袭知州。北宋崇宁五年（1106年）纳土置兰州，授当地首领韦宴闹知州事并准世袭；元代改名为东兰州，隶属庆远南丹溪洞等处军民安抚司。明洪武十二年（1379年）东兰归附。其后家人韦钱保隐匿贡物、冒名夺得知州之职，他横征暴敛，逼使土官韦富挠于洪武十八年（1385年）起兵，变乱随即被明军讨平；事后朝廷仍准韦氏袭职，另派流官吏目辅佐。东兰土官后来曾随泗城岑氏攻入田州，又在嘉靖五年（1526年）奉调参与平定岑猛之乱。顺治九年（1652年）韦氏归附清朝；雍正七年（1729年）推行改土归流，东兰内六哨设流官知州，韦氏被降为驻凤山的土州同，分辖外六哨。

en: Domboli-Bokht represents the Bokht branch of the Donboli, a Yazidi Kurdish tribe whose name, Donbol-e Bokht, points to its origin in the Bohtan country between Siirt and Cizre. In the fourteenth century its clans held the hill fortresses around Akre and Hakkari, on the frontier between the Jazira and the Armenian highlands, while its first attested leader, Isa Beg, ruled the district of Sokmanabad. The Donboli long kept to the Yazidi faith before parts of the tribe later converted to Islam, and Sharafkhan Bidlisi records that under the Ilkhans their emir Ibrahim stood high with Ghazan Khan, while his successors Cemşid and Behlül fought and died in the Mongol wars of the 1340s and 1350s. Under the Aq Qoyunlu, Shaikh Ahmad Beg conquered the Hakkari territory southeast of Lake Van and held the castle of Bay. In the following century most of the tribe moved north-west to the Khoy and Salmas districts, where it built the powerful Khoy Khanate, while some Donboli clans remained behind in the Diyarbakr highlands.
zh: 东博利‑博赫特对应敦布利部落的博赫特分支。敦布利是信奉雅兹迪派的库尔德部落，其名“敦博勒‑博赫特”表明它源起于锡尔特与吉兹雷之间的博赫坦地区。14世纪时，其各部族据守阿克拉与哈卡里周围的山间要塞，地处杰济拉与亚美尼亚高地之间的边地；有记载的最早首领伊萨贝伊统治着索克马纳巴德地区。敦布利人长期保持雅兹迪信仰，后来部分部族才改宗伊斯兰教。沙拉夫汗·比特利西记载，伊尔汗国时期他们的埃米尔易卜拉欣深受合赞汗信任，其后继者杰姆希德和贝赫卢勒则在14世纪40至50年代的蒙古战事中先后阵亡。白羊王朝时期，谢赫·艾哈迈德贝伊征服了凡湖东南的哈卡里地区，并长期占据巴伊城堡。进入下一世纪，部落主体西北迁至霍伊和萨尔马斯一带，在那里建立了强盛的霍伊汗国，另有一些敦布利氏族留在迪亚巴克尔山区。

en: The Principality of Dmitrov was a small Rus' principality centered on the town of Dmitrov, founded by Yuri Dolgorukiy in 1154 on the Yakhroma River, north of Moscow. It emerged from the breakup of the Galich-Dmitrov principality, held since the 1240s by a branch of the descendants of Yaroslav II of Vladimir. After the death of Prince David around 1280 his lands split, and by the 1330s Boris ruled at Dmitrov while his kinsman Fyodor held Galich. Boris's son Dmitry Borisovich, the prince of 1337, later moved to the Galich table with the Golden Horde's backing in 1360, and Dmitrov itself was absorbed into the Grand Duchy of Moscow by 1364. Thereafter it served as a Muscovite appanage for younger sons: Vladimir the Bold held it from 1372, the town was granted town rights in 1374 and burned by Tokhtamysh in 1382, and the appanage survived until 1569, when Ivan the Terrible abolished it as one of the last in Rus'.
zh: 德米特罗夫公国是以德米特罗夫城为中心的罗斯小公国。该城位于莫斯科以北的亚赫罗马河畔，1154年由尤里·多尔戈鲁基建立。它出自加利奇-德米特罗夫公国的分裂：13世纪40年代起，弗拉基米尔大公雅罗斯拉夫二世的一支后裔领有这个合二为一的公国，王公达维德约于1280年死后，领地分裂，到14世纪30年代，鲍里斯以德米特罗夫为治所，同族的费奥多尔领有加利奇。鲍里斯之子、1337年在位的德米特里·鲍里索维奇后来于1360年在金帐汗国支持下转赴加利奇继位，德米特罗夫本身则在1364年以前并入莫斯科大公国。此后它成为莫斯科分封给幼支王公的封邑：勇者弗拉基米尔于1372年受封，城镇1374年获得城市权，1382年被脱脱迷失焚毁；这个封邑一直延续到1569年，被伊凡雷帝撤销，是罗斯最后一批封邑之一。

en: The Domboli, or Donboli, were a Kurdish tribal dynasty, originally of the Yazidi faith, who held the highland country around Khoy and Salmas in Azerbaijan from their first rise under Ayyubid overlordship in 1210. Their emir Ibrahim Donboli, who died in 1320, stood well with the Ilkhan Ghazan and was even said to have saved the Ilkhanate, and in 1337 the tribe held Khoy under its own chief as a vassal of the Jalayirids. Ibrahim's successors Jamshid and Behlul fought and then made peace with the Mongols before the line passed under Aq Qoyunlu and Safavid suzerainty. After a Safavid massacre of the tribe in 1548 the Donboli fled to Ottoman territory, but they recovered Khoy by the 1620s and ruled it as hereditary khans. They served Nader Shah on his Indian and Caucasian campaigns, dominated Azerbaijan in the later eighteenth century under Hosayn Qoli and Jafar Qoli Khan, and were finally broken by the Qajar prince Abbas Mirza in 1799.
zh: 东博利，又译敦布利，是一个库尔德部落王朝，最初信奉雅兹迪派，自1210年在阿尤布王朝宗主权下兴起以来，一直领有阿塞拜疆境内霍伊与萨尔马斯一带的山地。埃米尔易卜拉欣·东博利于1320年去世，生前与伊儿汗合赞交好，据说还曾挽救伊儿汗国；1337年时，该部落在自己的首领统领下据有霍伊，是札剌亦儿王朝的附庸。其后继者贾姆希德和贝赫卢勒先与蒙古人交战、后又言和，该家族此后相继臣属于白羊王朝和萨法维王朝。1548年萨法维人大肆屠杀东博利部众，部落逃入奥斯曼境内，但到17世纪20年代他们收复霍伊，以世袭汗号统治。他们曾随纳迪尔沙远征印度和高加索，18世纪后期在侯赛因·戈利汗和贾法尔·戈利汗治下称雄阿塞拜疆，最终于1799年被卡扎尔王子阿巴斯·米尔扎攻灭。

en: Desmond, from the Irish Deasmhumhain, or South Munster, was first a Gaelic kingdom founded in 1118 across what are now County Cork and most of County Kerry. Its eastern half fell to the Anglo-Normans and became the Earldom of Desmond, while the western half survived as a semi-independent Gaelic kingdom until 1596. The earls belonged to the Munster branch of the FitzGeralds, known as the Geraldines, who had crossed from Wales with the Norman invasion of the twelfth century. John FitzThomas received Desmond and Decies from Prince Edward in 1259 and became the first Baron Desmond, and his grandson Maurice FitzGerald was raised to Earl of Desmond in 1329. The earldom came to cover all of County Limerick and large parts of Cork, Kerry and Waterford, bordering Ormond, Thomond and the Gaelic kingdom of the same name. Over generations the Geraldines grew Gaelic in speech and custom, and in the later sixteenth century they led the Desmond Rebellions against the Protestant English crown. The last earl was defeated and killed in 1583, his estates were confiscated and the title suppressed; later recreations after 1600 carried none of the old Geraldine lands.
zh: 德斯蒙德得名于爱尔兰语德斯蒙温，意为南芒斯特，最初是1118年建立的盖尔王国，疆域包括今天的科克郡和凯里郡大部。其东半部被盎格鲁—诺曼人征服，成为德斯蒙德伯爵领，西半部则作为半独立的盖尔王国延续到1596年。伯爵出自菲茨杰拉德家族的芒斯特支系，又称杰拉尔丁人，他们在12世纪诺曼入侵时从威尔士渡海而来。1259年，约翰·菲茨托马斯从爱德华王子手中受封德斯蒙德和迪希斯，成为第一代德斯蒙德男爵；其孙莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德于1329年晋封德斯蒙德伯爵。伯爵领最终覆盖整个利默里克郡以及科克、凯里、沃特福德诸郡的大片土地，与奥蒙德、托蒙德及同名的盖尔王国接壤。世代相传之下，杰拉尔丁人在语言和习俗上日益盖尔化，并于16世纪后期发动反对英格兰新教王室的德斯蒙德叛乱。末代伯爵于1583年兵败身死，领地被没收，头衔遭废止；1600年以后的几次复封都不再附带杰拉尔丁人的旧有土地。

en: Dinkelsbühl stands on the Wörnitz, where a Carolingian royal court existed around 730. The Hohenstaufen fortified the crossing of two long-distance trade routes around 1130, and the town received the municipal rights of Ulm in 1305 before it was raised to a Free Imperial City in 1351. Its walls went up from 1372 and the great Gothic minster of Saint George was finished in 1499, marking the height of the city's late medieval wealth. Around 1534 most citizens turned Protestant, but the Thirty Years' War brought alternating imperial and Swedish garrisons and crippling war contributions; after the Peace of Westphalia in 1648 Dinkelsbühl became one of the Empire's few bi-confessional cities, with Catholic and Lutheran offices shared equally. In 1802 it lost its imperial status to Bavaria, passed briefly to Prussia with the Ansbach-Bayreuth lands in 1804, and was annexed by the Kingdom of Bavaria in 1806.
zh: 丁克尔斯比尔坐落在韦尔尼茨河畔，约730年这里已有一座加洛林王朝的王宫。约1130年，霍亨斯陶芬家族在两条远程商路的渡口修筑要塞；1305年城市取得与乌尔姆相同的市政权利，1351年被升格为自由帝国城市。城墙自1372年起陆续修建，宏伟的哥特式圣乔治大教堂于1499年落成，标志着城市中世纪晚期财富的顶峰。约1534年多数市民改信新教，但三十年战争中帝国军队与瑞典军队轮番驻守，战争摊派沉重；1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》后，丁克尔斯比尔成为帝国少数双教派城市之一，天主教与路德宗的官职名额均分。1802年它失去帝国直辖地位划归巴伐利亚，1804年随安斯巴赫-拜罗伊特领地短暂转交普鲁士，1806年又被巴伐利亚王国吞并。

en: The Dogra hill country, called Duggar after the ancient kingdom of Durgara named in an eleventh-century Chamba inscription, lay between the Chenab and Ravi rivers in the Punjab hills. Its early chiefdoms, among them Vallapura and Babbapura with their temple ruins, appear in Kalhana's Rajatarangini and were later counted by Aurel Stein as some eleven Dogra states, all gradually absorbed by Jammu. Jammu itself, traditionally founded by Raja Jambulochan around 900, was already strong enough for Timur to pass through it on his return from Delhi in 1398. In 1423 the warlord Jasrat killed Raja Bhim Dev and made Jammu his vassal, yet under the Mughals its hill rajas kept broad autonomy as allies of the empire. The Jamwal rulers Dhruv Dev and Ranjit Dev, who reigned from 1728 to 1780, made Jammu supreme among the Dogra states, until the Sikh misls overwhelmed it and Ranjit Singh annexed it in 1808.
zh: 多格拉山地古称杜加尔，得名于11世纪昌巴铜版铭文所记的杜尔加拉王国，地处旁遮普山区奇纳布河与拉维河之间。当地早期的小邦如瓦拉普拉和巴布拉普拉及其寺庙遗迹，见于卡尔哈纳的《王河》；奥里尔·斯坦因后来统计出约十一个多格拉小邦，它们最终都被查谟吞并。查谟相传由罗阇詹布洛钦于900年前后建立，1398年帖木儿从德里回师时即途经此城，足见其地位。1423年，豪强贾斯拉特杀死罗阇比姆·德夫，使查谟沦为附庸；但在莫卧儿治下，这些山区罗阇作为帝国盟友保留了很大自治权。贾姆瓦尔家族的德鲁夫·德夫与1728至1780年在位的兰吉特·德夫使查谟成为多格拉诸邦之首，直到锡克教米斯尔诸邦将其压服，兰吉特·辛格于1808年吞并查谟。

en: Dompu was an old chiefdom, or kedatuan, on the central part of Sumbawa in the Lesser Sunda Islands, lying between the stronger kingdoms of Bima to the east and Sumbawa to the west. The fourteenth-century Javanese poem Negarakertagama already named Dompu among the principalities of eastern Sumbawa, and in its early centuries the court followed Buddhist-influenced native traditions. It was counted among the six historic kingdoms of the island, and in the seventeenth century, amid the Makassar campaigns that spread the faith across Sumbawa, its rulers adopted Islam and Dompu became one of the island's four sultanates, linked by marriage and alliance to the courts of Bima and Sumbawa. Its old royal palace was later replaced by the Grand Mosque of Dompu, and in 1815 the eruption of neighbouring Mount Tambora brought widespread destruction and famine to its lands.
zh: 栋普是小巽他群岛松巴哇岛中部的古老邦国，东邻强国比马，西接松巴哇。14世纪的爪哇史诗《爪哇史颂》已把栋普列为松巴哇东部的邦国之一，早期王廷奉行受佛教影响的本土信仰。它被视为岛上六个历史王国之一；17世纪，在望加锡人征战并向全岛传播伊斯兰教的浪潮中，栋普君主改宗，栋普成为岛上四个苏丹国之一，通过联姻和同盟与比马、松巴哇两廷维系在一起。它的旧王宫后来被改建为栋普大清真寺；1815年邻近的坦博拉火山喷发，使其土地遭受了大面积破坏和饥荒。

en: The County of Diepholz, at first a lordship, was a territory of the Holy Roman Empire in the Lower Rhenish-Westphalian Circle, centred on the town of Diepholz between the Weser and the Dümmer lake. Its rulers, the Noble Lords of Diepholz, belonged to the ancient Saxon Uradel and held their core lands as allodial property rather than as imperial fiefs; the family name first appears in 1160, with a continuous line from Gottschalk I around 1177. In 1291 they acquired the Vicecomitat of Sudholte, giving them full jurisdiction over Drebber, Barnstorf and Goldenstedt. Rudolf IV, who ruled in 1337, enlarged the territory and in 1350 founded the parish church at Diepholz, and his grandson Johann III granted the town its rights in 1380. Threatened by the Bishops of Minden, Rudolf VIII surrendered his sovereignty to the Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg in 1510. The Reformation followed in 1528, and when Friedrich II died in 1585 leaving only a daughter, debarred from succeeding by Saxon inheritance law, most of the county passed to the Welf dukes and the Auburg lands to Hesse.
zh: 迪普霍尔茨伯国（初为领主领地）是神圣罗马帝国下莱茵-威斯特伐利亚行政圈的邦国，以威悉河与迪默湖之间的迪普霍尔茨镇为中心。其统治者迪普霍尔茨的贵族领主出身古老的萨克森世袭贵族，核心领地是自主地而非帝国封邑；家族姓氏于1160年首次出现，约1177年起的戈特沙尔克一世之后世系连续可考。1291年他们取得苏德霍尔特子爵辖区，获得对德雷伯、巴恩斯托夫和戈尔登施泰特的完整司法权。1337年在位的鲁道夫四世扩张领地，并于1350年修建迪普霍尔茨教区教堂，其孙约翰三世于1380年授予迪普霍尔茨城镇权。迫于明登主教的威胁，鲁道夫八世于1510年将主权交给不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵。1528年伯国推行宗教改革；1585年弗里德里希二世去世，只留下一个依萨克森继承法无权继位的女儿，伯国大部并入韦尔夫公爵领地，奥堡一带则归属黑森。

en: The County of Dreux was a small royal appanage on the border between Normandy and the Île-de-France, centred on the castle of Dreux. Its lands passed through the counts of Vexin and the dukes of Normandy until King Robert II confiscated them from Odo II of Blois, and in the twelfth century Louis the Fat granted Dreux as an appanage to his younger son Robert, founder of the Capetian House of Dreux; in the early thirteenth century Peter of Dreux, called Mauclerc, won the Duchy of Brittany by marrying its heiress Alix of Thouars.
