In 1337 the count was Peter I, born in 1298, who had held the county since 1331 and had fought for Philip VI at the Battle of Cassel in 1328. He died in 1345 leaving a daughter, Joan II, whose marriage to Simon de Thouars produced only daughters, and these heiresses eventually sold the county to King Charles VI. In 1382 Dreux went as the dowry of Marguerite de Bourbon to the house of Albret, and it reverted to the French crown in 1556.
zh: 德勒伯国是诺曼底与法兰西岛交界处的小型王室采邑，以德勒城堡为中心。其领地曾先后属于韦克桑伯爵和诺曼底公爵，后来罗贝尔二世从布卢瓦伯爵厄德二世手中将其没收；12世纪，胖子路易把德勒作为封禄赐给幼子罗贝尔，由此开创卡佩旁支德勒家族——13世纪初，该家族的皮埃尔·德·德勒（绰号“莫克莱尔”）还因迎娶女继承人阿丽克斯·德·图阿尔而取得布列塔尼公国。1337年在位的皮埃尔一世生于1298年，1331年起担任伯爵，曾在1328年的卡塞尔战役中为腓力六世作战。他1345年去世，只留下女儿让娜二世；让娜嫁给西蒙·德·图阿尔后仅育有女儿，这些女继承人最终把伯国卖给法王查理六世。1382年，德勒作为玛格丽特·德·波旁的嫁妆转入阿尔布雷家族，1556年复归法兰西王室。

en: The Kingdom of Derge was a Tibetan polity in the Kham region, ruled from the town of Derge in present-day Sichuan by the Gar Clan, which traced its descent from Gar Tongtsen, a minister at the seventh-century court of Songsten Gampo. In the thirteenth century the clan leader Sonam Rinchen won the favour of the Sakya hierarch Phagpa, and in the mid-fifteenth century the family seat was moved to Derge, where its kings later founded Gongchen Monastery. Allied with the Khoshut Khanate, Derge overthrew the Bön Beri polity in 1639, took the title Dharma King around 1640, and expanded until by 1775 it held ten districts stretching from Gonjo to Ganzi. The Qing court recognised its ruler as a tusi in 1728, and King Tenpa Tsering founded the Derge printing house in 1729, whose wooden-block Kangyur made the kingdom a centre of Tibetan learning and later of the Rimé movement. Two queens regnant, Yangchen Drolma and Tsewang Lhamo, ruled between 1774 and 1812, while a family feud in 1799 opened the kingdom's decline.
zh: 德格是康区的藏族政权，统治中心在德格（今四川省境内），统治的噶氏家族自称是7世纪吐蕃松赞干布朝大臣禄东赞的后裔。13世纪，家族首领索郎仁钦受到萨迦派法王八思巴的赏识；15世纪中叶，家族把治所迁到德格，此后历代德格王又在此兴建更庆寺。德格与和硕特汗国结盟，于1639年攻灭信奉苯教的白利土司，约1640年起采用法王称号，并不断扩张，到1775年已领有从贡觉到甘孜的十个地区。1728年清朝封其首领为土司，登巴泽仁于1729年主持创办德格印经院，院藏木刻版《甘珠尔》使德格成为藏学中心，后来又成为利美运动的重镇。1774至1812年间，央珍卓玛与策旺拉姆两位女王先后执政；1799年王族内讧，国势由此转衰。

en: The small kingdom later famous as Dharampur was founded in 1262 under the name Ramnagar, when Ramsingh, a Sisodia Rajput of the Chittor clan and a younger son of the house of Udaipur, overthrew the local tribal chief and made himself ruler of this wooded, hilly corner of south Gujarat. His descendants kept their independence while Muslim sultanates arose all around them in Gujarat, Khandesh and Ahmednagar: the hill state controlled a ring of forts and was never overrun, and its ranas gave shelter and patronage to Parsi refugees and drew revenue from the Portuguese trade of the nearby Gujarat ports. In 1766 the ruler Dharamdevji moved his capital to Mandvegan and renamed it Dharampur, the name by which the state was known thereafter. On the last day of 1802 Dharampur accepted British protection and became a nine-gun-salute princely state, still governed by the same Sisodia line.
zh: 这个后来以达尔兰布尔闻名的小邦，建于1262年，初名拉姆讷格尔：奇托尔出身的西索迪亚拉杰普特人、乌代布尔家族的幼子拉姆辛推翻当地的部落首领，在南古吉拉特这片丛林丘陵之地自立为主。他的后裔在古吉拉特、坎德什和艾哈迈德讷格尔诸穆斯林苏丹国环伺之下保持了独立——这个山地小邦控制着一圈堡垒，从未被外敌攻破；历代拉纳还庇护、资助帕西难民，并从附近港口的葡萄牙贸易中抽取收入。1766年，君主达尔马德夫吉把都城迁往曼德韦甘，并将其改名为达尔兰布尔，土邦此后便以此名行世。1802年最后一天，达尔兰布尔接受英国保护，成为享有九响礼炮待遇的土邦，统治家族仍是同一条西索迪亚世系。

en: The Principality of Drutsk was a small appanage centred on the town of Drutsk on the river Drut, in the borderlands between the later Vitebsk, Minsk and Mogilev regions. It was created in 1101, when the lands of Polotsk were divided among the sons of Prince Vseslav and Drutsk fell to Rogvolod-Boris. The young principality was soon seized by the princes of Minsk under Gleb Vseslavich, taken by Kiev under Vladimir Monomakh in 1116, returned to Minsk in the 1150s and absorbed outright by Minsk in the later thirteenth century, before passing to Vitebsk early in the fourteenth. With the marriage of Grand Duke Algirdas to Maria of Vitebsk, Drutsk entered the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, where it survived as an autonomous appanage until the administrative reform of 1565 and 1566, which merged it into the Orsha county of the Vitebsk Voivodeship.
zh: 德鲁茨克公国是以德鲁季河畔德鲁茨克城为中心的小封邑，地处后来的维捷布斯克、明斯克和莫吉廖夫三地交界。1101年波洛茨克王公弗谢斯拉夫的诸子瓜分父土，德鲁茨克分给罗格沃洛德—鲍里斯，公国由此建立。这个年轻的公国不久便被格列布·弗谢斯拉维奇治下的明斯克公国夺取，1116年又被弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫的基辅大公国占领，12世纪50年代复归明斯克，13世纪下半叶被明斯克彻底吞并，14世纪初转归维捷布斯克。随着立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯迎娶维捷布斯克的玛丽亚，德鲁茨克并入立陶宛大公国，作为自治封邑一直存续到1565年至1566年的行政改革，随后被并入维捷布斯克省的奥尔沙县。

en: Dadrewa was a small Chauhan Rajput chiefdom in the Jangal Desh, the dry country of north-eastern Rajasthan that is now Churu district. It had an old reputation as the home of the Chauhan warrior Goga, later worshipped across northern India as Gogaji, a folk saint held to have ruled Dadrewa in the days of Prithviraj Chauhan. In 1337 its raja was Motay Rao Chauhan, whose son Karamchand embraced Islam at the court of Sultan Firuz Shah Tughluq in about 1352 and took the name Qaim Khan. Rising high in the Delhi sultanate, Qaim Khan was made governor of Hisar Firoza with the title Khan-e Jahan, until he was trapped and murdered on the banks of the Yamuna by Khizr Khan, the future founder of the Sayyid dynasty, in 1419. His Muslim descendants, known as the Qaimkhanis, went on to rule the Shekhawati towns of Fatehpur, Jhunjhunu and Singhana from 1384 until their line ended in 1731.
zh: 陀多瓦是乔诃那拉杰普特人的一个小酋长国，地处拉贾斯坦东北部干旱的“丛林之地”，即今丘鲁县境内。它在传说中是乔诃那武士戈加的故乡，戈加后来被北印度广泛尊为民间圣人戈加吉，相传在普利色毗罗阇·乔诃那时代统治陀多瓦，能庇佑信徒免遭蛇咬。1337年在位的酋长是摩泰·拉奥乔诃那，其子羯罗摩旃陀约于1352年在苏丹菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克的宫廷改宗伊斯兰教，得名凯姆汗。他在德里苏丹国仕途显赫，出任希萨尔菲罗扎总督，封号“世界之汗”，最终于1419年被后来开创萨义德王朝的希兹尔汗设计擒杀于亚穆纳河畔。他的穆斯林后裔称凯姆卡尼家族，从1384年起统治谢卡瓦蒂的法塔赫布尔、琼丘努和辛加纳诸城，直到1731年世系终结。

en: Dasni was the land of the Dasini, the Kurdish tribe from which the Yazidis take their earliest historical name: before the twelfth century Arabic and Syriac sources call the Yazidis simply Dasini, after the Dasin country north-east of Mosul, between the Tigris and the Great Zab. Fourteenth-century writers counted them a branch of the Bokhti Kurds, settled around Duhok, Sheikhan, Sinjar and Akre, where al-Umari found them holding the town in his own day. They were followers of the Adawiyya order of Sheikh Adi ibn Musafir, out of which Yazidism took shape, and as early as 906 they rose against the Hamdanids of Mosul and formed a chiefdom centered on Sheikhan and the Lalish valley. By the early fourteenth century their hereditary Mirs, claiming descent from Sheikh Adi's Qatani clan, ruled as both princes and religious chiefs of the Yazidi communities. In the fifteenth century the Bahdinan emirate attacked their mountain strongholds, and in the seventeenth Dasini princes entered Ottoman service, Ezidi Mirza becoming sanjak governor first of Sinjar in 1644 and then of Mosul in 1650; Istanbul repeatedly tried to reduce the Dasin sanjak, yet its Yazidi emirs kept a measure of self-rule around Sheikhan.
zh: 达斯尼是达斯尼人的土地。达斯尼是一个库尔德部落，雅兹迪人最早的历史称呼就来自它：12世纪以前，阿拉伯和叙利亚语文献直接把雅兹迪人称为达斯尼人，得名于摩苏尔东北、底格里斯河与大扎卜河之间的达斯尼地区。14世纪的作家认为他们是博赫蒂库尔德人的一支，聚居在杜胡克、谢赫坎、辛贾尔和阿克拉一带，欧麦里当时就记载他们占据着阿克拉城。他们信奉谢赫·阿迪·本·穆萨菲尔创立的阿达维教团，雅兹迪派正是在该教团基础上成形；早在906年，他们就起兵反抗摩苏尔的哈姆丹王朝，并在谢赫坎和拉利什山谷一带建立了以谢赫坎为中心的酋邦。到14世纪初，世袭的米尔们自称出自谢赫·阿迪的卡塔尼氏族，既是雅兹迪社群的政教首领。15世纪，巴赫迪南埃米尔国进攻他们的山寨；17世纪，达斯尼王公转入奥斯曼效力，埃齐迪·米尔扎于1644年出任辛贾尔桑贾克总督，1650年又升任摩苏尔总督。伊斯坦布尔屡次试图裁撤达斯尼桑贾克，但雅兹迪埃米尔们在谢赫坎周围仍保留了相当的自治权。

en: The Doti kingdom was a Hindu state in the far west of present-day Nepal, ruled from the hill forts of Ajayameru and Dipayal between the Kali and Karnali rivers. It emerged in the thirteenth century when the Katyuri kingdom of Kumaon split among eight princes; Niranjan Malla Dev, son of the last Katyuri ruler, founded a line whose kings were styled Raika, and the Raikas defeated the Khasa Mallas of the Karnali basin to build a strong hill kingdom. In the sixteenth century a Mughal army under Hussain Khan, sent from Lucknow during the reign of Akbar, sacked Ajayameru and carried off plunder, yet the Raika rulers survived and later adopted the title Shahi. The kingdom lasted until the Gorkha expansion of 1790, when its forces were beaten on the Seti River; the last king, Prithivipati Shahi, fled into the British-held plains and fought the Gorkhalis alongside the British in 1814, while his lands were absorbed into the kingdom of Nepal.
zh: 多提王国是今尼泊尔远西地区的印度教政权，以卡利河与格尔纳利河之间的阿贾梅鲁和迪帕亚尔山城为统治中心。13世纪库马盎的卡图里王国分裂给八位王子，多提即为其中一支；末代卡图里君主之子尼兰詹·马拉·德夫开创了统治者称“拉伊卡”的王朝，拉伊卡诸王击败格尔纳利河流域的卡萨·马拉政权，建立起稳固的山地王国。16世纪阿克巴在位时，驻勒克瑙的莫卧儿将领侯赛因·汗率军洗劫都城阿贾梅鲁，满载战利品而归，但拉伊卡统治者得以存续，后来改用“沙希”称号。1790年廓尔喀扩张，多提军队在塞蒂河畔战败；末代国王普里特维帕蒂·沙希逃入英属平原，并于1814年配合英军对廓尔喀作战，其土地最终并入尼泊尔王国。

en: Dortmund, first recorded around 882 as Throtmanni, grew up beside the Ruhr on the site of the Saxon Sigiburg hillfort, which Charlemagne captured during the Saxon Wars. An imperial church council met there in 1005 and an imperial diet in 1016; after a fire the Emperor Frederick Barbarossa rebuilt the town in 1152 and kept a residence there. It became an Imperial Free City and in 1293 won one of Europe's earliest official brewing rights, and through the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries it was the chief city of the Rhine, Westphalia and Netherlands circle of the Hanseatic League, its merchants rich enough to lend money to Edward III of England against his crown in 1344. When the count of Mark and the archbishop of Cologne besieged it for eighteen months in 1388 and 1389, the city held out, earning the Westphalian motto as firm as Dortmund. In 1400 it hosted the first Vehmic court, and after the Anglo-Hanseatic War it became the circle's capital. The Thirty Years' War shattered its prosperity, and it lost its free-city status under the 1803 Reichsdeputationshauptschluss, passing to Nassau-Orange-Fulda and then in 1808 to the Grand Duchy of Berg as capital of the Ruhr department; the Congress of Vienna assigned it to Prussia in 1815.
zh: 多特蒙德最早于882年前后以 Throtmanni 之名见于记载，位于鲁尔河畔撒克逊人西吉堡山垒的故地，查理曼在撒克逊战争中曾夺取这座山垒。1005年帝国宗教会议在此召开，1016年又举行帝国议会；火灾之后，皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨于1152年重建该城并在此驻跸。它成为帝国自由城市，1293年获得欧洲最早的官方酿酒权之一；13至14世纪，它是汉萨同盟莱茵、威斯特伐利亚与尼德兰分区的首席城市，城中商人极为富有，1344年甚至以王冠为抵押向英格兰国王爱德华三世放贷。1388至1389年，马克伯爵联合科隆大主教围城十八个月，该城坚守不降，由此赢得威斯特伐利亚谚语“坚如多特蒙德”的名声。1400年它设立了第一个菲姆法庭，英荷战争后又成为该分区的首府。三十年战争摧毁了它的繁荣；1803年《帝国代表重要决议》使其失去自由城市地位，划归拿骚-奥兰治-富尔达，1808年又并入贝格大公国，成为鲁尔省的首府；1815年维也纳会议把它划归普鲁士。

en: The Dulkadirid beylik was a Turkoman principality of the Bozok branch of the Oghuz, drawing on the Bayat, Afshar and Begdili clans, which arose in southern Anatolia as the Seljuk Sultanate of Rum collapsed. Its founder, the chieftain Qaraja Bey, installed himself around Elbistan in 1335 and took the town in 1337, the year of the game's start, accepting the title of na'ib from the Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad. For nearly two centuries the beylik balanced between the Mamluks to the south and the Ottomans to the west, controlling the mountain passes from Elbistan and Marash. Its dynasty became closely tied to the Ottoman house through marriage, giving brides to several sultans, among them the mothers of Mehmed II and Selim I. Ottoman-Mamluk rivalry nevertheless ended its independence: after the Battle of Turnadağ in 1515, Selim I and his grand vizier Sinan Pasha annexed the beylik and reorganized it as an Ottoman sanjak.
zh: 杜尔卡迪尔贝伊国是罗姆塞尔柱苏丹国崩溃时兴起于安纳托利亚南部的突厥蛮政权，属乌古斯人的博佐克支，由巴亚特、阿夫沙尔和贝格迪利等部族组成。开国首领卡拉贾贝伊于1335年进驻埃尔比斯坦一带，1337年即游戏开局之年夺取该城，并从马穆鲁克苏丹纳绥尔·穆罕默德手中接受纳伊布头衔。近两个世纪里，贝伊国在南方马穆鲁克与西方奥斯曼之间周旋，凭埃尔比斯坦和马拉什控制山间要道。其王室与奥斯曼家族联姻极深，先后有多位公主嫁入奥斯曼宫廷，穆罕默德二世和塞利姆一世的母亲都出自杜尔卡迪尔家族。但奥斯曼与马穆鲁克的争夺最终终结了它的独立：1515年图尔纳达格战役后，塞利姆一世与大维齐尔锡南帕夏吞并贝伊国，将其改组为奥斯曼的桑贾克。

en: The Lordship of Daun was a small Eifel territory centered on Daun Castle above the river Lieser, the ancestral seat of the lords of Daun, first documented in 1075. The original free lords died out in 1163, and their ministerialis Richardus de Duna took over the castle together with the family name and arms, founding a second dynasty. Wedged between the Electorates of Trier and Cologne, the lordship kept a precarious independence: in 1340 Ägidius von Daun held the town as a fief of King John of Bohemia, but in 1353 the archbishops of Trier and Cologne stormed the castle on the pretext that he was a robber baron, and Daun passed under the overlordship of Trier. The family continued as castle lords, were raised to Imperial counts in 1643, and later supplied the Habsburg army with two field marshals, Wirich Philipp von Daun and his son Leopold Joseph von Daun, famous in the Seven Years' War. French troops destroyed the castle in 1689, and the comital line died out in the eighteenth century.
zh: 道恩领地是艾费尔山区的一块小领地，以利瑟河高地上的道恩城堡为中心，城堡是道恩领主家族的祖堡，最早见于1075年的文献。最初的自由领主家族于1163年绝嗣，其家臣里夏杜斯·德·杜纳接管城堡并沿用旧主的姓氏与纹章，开创了第二个道恩家族。领地夹在特里尔与科隆两个选侯国之间，独立地位朝不保夕：1340年，埃吉迪乌斯·冯·道恩以波希米亚国王约翰封臣的身份领有城镇，但1353年特里尔和科隆的大主教以强盗骑士为由合兵攻破城堡，道恩从此沦为特里尔的附庸。家族继续担任城堡领主，1643年被升为帝国伯爵，后来还为哈布斯堡军队贡献了两位陆军元帅——维里希·菲利普·冯·道恩和他的儿子利奥波德·约瑟夫·冯·道恩，后者在七年战争中名噪一时。1689年法军摧毁了城堡，伯爵支系则在18世纪绝嗣。

en: Centered on the Sanmao cave in the upper Youshui valley, on the lands of present-day Laifeng County in southwestern Hubei, this was a Tujia native chieftaincy of the Wuling mountains. In 1294 the Yuan turned the Sanmao cave into a prefecture under Sichuan Province, and in 1346 reorganized it as the Sanmao Military-Civil Pacification Commission, ruled by the hereditary Tan clan. Early Ming warfare left the office vacant until 1404, when the chieftain Tan Youliang gathered the scattered population and had it restored; the court first reduced it to a longship office under the Datian garrison, then raised it back to a pacification commission in 1406. The chieftaincy lasted until 1735, when the Qing abolished Sanmao and six neighboring tusi in the gaitu guiliu reforms. Laifeng County was founded on its territory in 1736.
zh: 这是武陵山区以散毛洞为中心的土家族土司，地处酉水上游，其地在今湖北西南部的来凤县。1294年元朝以散毛洞置散毛府，隶属四川行省，1346年改置散毛誓崖等处军民宣抚司，由覃氏世袭。明初战乱后诸司荒废，1404年土官覃友谅招回流散人众、奏请复设，朝廷先将散毛降为长官司，隶属大田军民千户所，1406年又升回宣抚司。1735年清朝推行改土归流，废散毛等七个土司，1736年以其地置来凤县。

en: The Dawasir are a large and powerful Arab tribe of southern Najd, whose stronghold is the Wadi al-Dawasir, the well-watered valley once known as al-Aqiq or Aqiq Bani Uqayl, together with the neighbouring districts of al-Sulayyil, al-Aflaj and al-Kharj. Rather than a single lineage, they are a confederation drawn from the Azd and the Banu Taghlib, organized in two great divisions, the Al Zayed and the Taghlib, each grouping many clans; their name is variously derived from an ancestor called Dosser or from an Arabic word for soldiers. Unusually for Bedouin Arabia, the Dawasir combined herding with settled life: part of the tribe pastured camels and flocks in the desert while the rest tended palm groves, wells and farms in one of the most fertile corners of the peninsula, whose oases had earlier supported the Kindite capital of Qaryat al-Faw before that city was abandoned in the 400s. From the rise of the first Saudi state in the mid-1700s the Dawasir were among its closest tribal allies, and marriage ties with the Al Saud made them kinsmen as well as supporters of the ruling house.
zh: 代瓦西尔是内志南部一支强大的阿拉伯大部落，根据地是水源丰沛的代瓦西尔干河——这条河谷旧称阿基克或乌盖勒阿基克——以及相邻的苏莱勒、艾弗拉季和海尔季等地区。它并非单一血缘部落，而是由艾兹德人和巴努·塔格利卜人组成的联盟，全族分为阿勒·扎耶德与塔格利卜两大支系，各统多个氏族；其名称一说来自先祖多塞尔，一说来自阿拉伯语“士兵”一词。与半岛上常见的纯游牧不同，代瓦西尔人兼营游牧与定居：一部分人在沙漠放养骆驼和羊群，另一部分人在半岛最肥沃的角落经营椰枣园、水井和农庄。早在公元5世纪荒废之前，这里的绿洲曾供养肯德王国的都城盖里耶·费乌。从18世纪中叶第一个沙特国家兴起时起，代瓦西尔就是其最亲近的部落盟友之一，与沙特家族的联姻更使他们既是支持者又是统治家族的姻亲。

en: Duyang was a Zhuang tusi of the Si'en prefecture in central Guangxi, seated on the Hongshui River in present-day Du'an County under Hechi. Together with Anding, Baishan and six neighbouring offices, it was set up in 1528 as part of Wang Shouren's settlement after the Tianzhou war, which replaced the broken power of the Cen chiefs with a ring of smaller hereditary chieftaincies. Duyang's native officers answered to the Si'en prefect and kept their hereditary posts through the Ming and the Qing.
zh: 都阳是广西中部思恩府的壮族土司，衙署在红水河畔，辖地在今河池市都安瑶族自治县一带。1528年田州战事结束后，总督王守仁主持善后，设立都阳、安定、白山等九个长官司，用一圈较小的世袭土司取代岑氏留下的权力真空。都阳土官隶属于思恩府，在明、清两代世袭不绝。

en: Duyun, then still written with the cloud character after the cave above the town, is the chief center of the Sui and Bouyei hill country of southern Guizhou. The Tang held it only loosely through the jimi Ying prefecture, and in 1284 the Yuan set up the Duyun military and civilian chief's office, leaving local headmen to rule their stockaded valleys under the tusi system. Ming armies entered Guizhou in the 1380s and created a string of chief's offices and a pacification commission here; after a Miao rising was put down in 1390, the general He Fu had the name's second character changed for luck, and the Duyun Guard was garrisoned from 1395. In 1494 the court converted the garrison into Duyun Prefecture, the regular administrative center for the surrounding native subprefectures, including Dushan. The Qing kept the prefecture and in 1672 attached a Duyun County to it, steadily tightening direct rule over the Sui valleys.
zh: 都匀原名都云，因城东的都云洞得名，是贵州南部水族、布依族山区的中心。唐代朝廷只能通过羁縻应州松散地控制这里；1284年元朝设置都云军民长官司，由本地头人按土司制度统辖寨堡与河谷。1380年代明军进入贵州，在这里次第设立长官司、安抚司；1390年苗民起事被平羌将军何福镇压后，朝廷取均匀之意改都云为都匀，并于1395年驻军设立都匀卫。1494年，朝廷改卫设都匀府，成为管辖独山州等周边土司的正式行政中心。清朝沿用府制，1672年又置都匀县附郭，对水族各河谷的直接统治不断加强。

en: Dǐzhài was a small Miao chieftaincy centered on Longchang, in the Shunyuan hills northwest of Guiyang in present-day Xiuwen County, Guizhou. The country was Shuixi tusi land until the Ming opened the first of the nine Longchang post stations there in 1386.
zh: 底寨是以龙场为中心的苗人小土司，地处今贵州修文县、贵阳西北的顺元山区；在明代于1386年开设龙场九驿之首驿以前，这里一直是水西土司的领地。

en: Durdzuketia was the name given in Georgian, Armenian and Arabic sources to the mountain country of the Durdzuks, the Vainakh ancestors of the Chechens and Ingush, covering the gorges of central and southern Chechnya and parts of Ingushetia. The Georgian Chronicles derive the name from a legendary lord Durdzuk, who settled in the mountains and called his land after himself, and the geographer Vakhushti still described it in 1745 as the three lands of Kisti, Durdzuki and Gligvi. Its warlike clans were old allies of the Georgian kings and fought beside them against the Mongols and the Khwarazmshah Jalal al-Din. The lowlands had earlier been ruled by the Khazars and then by Christian Alania, whose missionaries converted some of a people otherwise faithful to their own pagan gods. The Mongol invasions of the thirteenth century and Timur's fourteenth-century campaigns drove the Durdzuks into the high valleys, where they reorganized into free, egalitarian clans, the teips and tukkhums, under a national council called the Mehk-Khel. Islam, known since the fourteenth century, spread only slowly and long coexisted with the old pagan cults. In the seventeenth century leaders such as Aldaman Gheza kept the mountain clans beyond the reach of neighbouring empires, until Sheikh Mansur's rising in the 1780s and the Russian building of Fort Grozny in 1818 opened the long Caucasian War.
zh: 杜尔祖克是格鲁吉亚、亚美尼亚和阿拉伯文献对杜尔祖克人山地之国的称呼。杜尔祖克人即车臣人和印古什人的瓦伊纳赫祖先，其地据有车臣中南部与印古什部分地区的峡谷。《格鲁吉亚编年史》把这个名字归于传说中的王公杜尔祖克，说他入山定居并以自己的名字命名此地；地理学家瓦胡什季直到1745年仍把它描述为基斯蒂、杜尔祖基和格利格维三部之地。这里善战的氏族是格鲁吉亚诸王的古老盟友，曾与格鲁吉亚人并肩对抗蒙古人和花剌子模沙札兰丁。低地早先先后受可萨人和基督教阿兰尼亚统治，阿兰传教士使部分人皈依东正教，但多数人仍信奉本族的多神信仰。13世纪的蒙古入侵和14世纪帖木儿的征战把杜尔祖克人逼入高山峡谷；他们在那里重建为自由而平等的氏族体系，以泰普和图克洪为单位，由全民议事会梅赫-凯尔治理。伊斯兰教14世纪已传入，但传播缓慢，长期与古老的多神崇拜并存。17世纪，阿尔达曼·格扎等首领使山地氏族置身于周边帝国的掌控之外；18世纪80年代谢赫曼苏尔举兵，1818年俄罗斯修建格罗兹尼要塞，漫长的高加索战争就此开启。

en: Egil was the hill principality of the Bulduqani dynasty, seated at the fortress of Eğil on the Tigris between Harput and Diyarbakr. Its founder Pir Mansur, a Sufi leader born in 989 who claimed descent from the Prophet, came from the Hakkari country with his Kurdish followers and took Eğil around 1049; his son Pir Musa and grandson Pir Bedir built the principality on the support of the local Mirdesan tribe, until Pir Bedir was killed in the Seljuk siege of 1087. The dynasty took its name from the later emir Bulduk, and under Emir Muhammed its lands reached Karaca Dag in the south, Palu and Elazig in the north, Cermik in the west and Lice in the east. In the fifteenth century the Bulduqani were drawn into Aq Qoyunlu politics: Uzun Hasan married a daughter of Emir Dawlatshah, yet her brother Isa fought against him at the Battle on the Tigris in 1457, and the same princess later led the faction that backed her son Ughurlu Muhammad's revolt of 1474 to 1477. After the Safavids held the district briefly, Selim I's conquest left Eğil under Ottoman overlordship with wide self-rule and exemption from the timar system, privileges that survived until the Ottomans dissolved the emirate in the middle of the nineteenth century.
zh: 埃伊尔是布尔杜卡尼王朝的山地公国，都城为埃伊尔要塞，位于哈尔普特与迪亚巴克尔之间的底格里斯河畔。开国者皮尔·曼苏尔是一位生于989年的苏菲首领，自称先知后裔，率库尔德部众从哈卡里地区迁来，约于1049年夺取埃伊尔；其子皮尔·穆萨和孙子皮尔·贝迪尔依靠当地米尔迪桑部落的支持建立公国，皮尔·贝迪尔于1087年在塞尔柱人的围攻中战死。王朝得名于后来的埃米尔布尔杜克；在埃米尔穆罕默德治下，疆土南抵卡拉贾山，北达帕卢和埃拉泽，西至切尔米克，东到利杰一带。15世纪，布尔杜卡尼人被卷入白羊王朝的政治：乌尊·哈桑娶了埃米尔道拉特沙阿的女儿，她的兄弟伊萨却在1457年的底格里斯河战役中与哈桑为敌，这位公主后来还支持其子乌古鲁·穆罕默德在1474至1477年间发动叛乱。萨法维王朝曾短暂占据该地，塞利姆一世征服后，埃伊尔成为奥斯曼的属国，享有广泛自治并免于蒂马尔制度，这些特权一直维持到19世纪中叶埃米尔国被奥斯曼人解散为止。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Eichstätt was a small ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire in the Franconian Jura, centred on the cathedral town of Eichstätt on the Altmühl. Its see was founded in 746, when the Anglo-Saxon missionary Willibald was consecrated its first bishop by Boniface. The bishops won their princely rank by inheriting the Franconian territories of their former advocates, the Counts of Hirschberg, whose castle above Beilngries gave the bishopric its second small town. In 1337 the bishop was Heinrich V Schenk von Reicheneck, imposed by Pope John XXII in 1329; when he accepted the imperial regalia from Louis IV in 1334 the pope excommunicated him, and much of his reign went in quarrels with his cathedral chapter and in pawning lands, among them Schweinfurt, to clear the diocese's debts. Eichstätt remained Catholic at the Reformation, joined the Catholic League in 1617 and became a stronghold of the Counter-Reformation and of witch trials. The bishopric was secularized in 1803 and, after the Treaty of Pressburg of 1805, passed to the Kingdom of Bavaria.
zh: 艾希施泰特采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国位于弗兰肯汝拉山区的一个小型教会邦国，以阿尔特米尔河畔的主教座城艾希施泰特为中心。其教区创立于746年，盎格鲁-撒克逊传教士维利巴尔德由波尼法修祝圣为首任主教。主教们继承了其代行权官希尔施贝格伯爵家族在法兰克尼亚的领地，由此获得诸侯地位；拜尔恩格里斯上方的希尔施贝格城堡也使主教区有了第二座小城。1337年在任的是海因里希五世·申克·冯·赖谢内克，他于1329年由教皇约翰二十二世任命；1334年他接受路易四世授予的帝国领主权，教皇随即将他绝罚，他在位的大部分时间都在与主教座堂参事会争执，并典当包括施韦因富特在内的土地以偿还教区债务。宗教改革时期艾希施泰特仍奉天主教，1617年加入天主教联盟，成为反宗教改革和猎巫审判的重镇。主教区于1803年被世俗化，1805年《普雷斯堡和约》之后并入巴伐利亚王国。

en: Ejimi was a Haixi Jurchen group settled on the Hulan river, called hvlan in Manchu after the word for chimney; the same river gave the Hulun confederation its name. The Hulan basin was occupied at the fall of the Yuan by Weji clans moving south and later entered the Ming Nurgan guard system.
zh: 埃吉米是定居在呼兰河流域的海西女真群体；呼兰河满语称 hvlan，意为烟囱，扈伦之名即来自这条河。呼兰河是松花江左岸支流，其流域是元末南下的兀者诸部占据的核心地带，明代隶属奴儿干都司下辖的羁縻卫所体系。

en: Elayadathu, or the Elayadathu Swaroopam, was a small principality of southern Kerala with its capital at Kottarakkara, the land of palaces east of Kollam. Its ruling house was a collateral branch of the old Venad dynasty, kin to the royal family of Travancore. The court won lasting fame in the seventeenth century when Prince Kottarakkara Thampuran composed the Ramanattam dance plays, the seed from which Kathakali, the classical dance-drama of Kerala, grew. In the 1730s the expansionist Marthanda Varma of Travancore seized Kottarakkara and carried off its chief, who died in confinement in 1739. A princess then claimed the succession and the Dutch governor van Imhoff restored her in 1741, but Marthanda Varma defeated the combined Kottarakkara and Dutch forces and annexed the chiefdom to Travancore, while the queen fled to Cochin.
zh: 伊罗耶达都又称伊罗耶达都斯瓦鲁帕姆，是喀拉拉南部的小邦，首府科塔拉卡拉位于奎隆以东，地名意为宫殿之地。统治家族是古老吠那住王朝的旁支，与特拉凡哥尔王室同宗。17世纪，科塔拉卡拉·坦普兰亲王在宫中创作了罗摩纳塔姆舞剧，喀拉拉古典舞剧卡塔卡利即由此萌芽，这个小朝廷也因此留名。18世纪30年代，锐意扩张的特拉凡哥尔君主马尔坦达·瓦尔马攻占科塔拉卡拉，掳走其酋长，后者于1739年死于囚禁。一位公主随后主张继承权，荷兰总督范·伊姆霍夫出面于1741年扶她复位，但马尔坦达·瓦尔马击溃科塔拉卡拉与荷兰联军，将该邦并入特拉凡哥尔，女王则逃往科钦。

en: Ellwangen, on the river Jagst in Swabia, grew up around the oldest Benedictine monastery in the Duchy of Swabia, said to have been founded around 764 by the brothers Herulph and Ariolf. Emperor Louis the Pious took it under royal protection in 814, and it became an imperial abbey, probably under a privilege of King Henry II in 1011, confirmed by Emperor Charles IV in 1347; in 981 it had to furnish Otto II with thirty armoured riders for his Italian campaign. Its abbots rose high in the Church, among them Archbishops of Mainz Liutbert and Hatto, while Abbot Ermanrich wrote a life of Saint Solus before becoming bishop of Passau. Benedictine observance declined in the fifteenth century, and in 1460 Pope Pius II allowed the abbey to become a college of secular canons under a provost, who took the rank of a prince of the Empire with a vote in the Reichstag, one of only two such prince-provostries besides Berchtesgaden. The territory joined the Catholic League in 1609 and was held by Swedish troops in 1632 during the Thirty Years' War. In the mediatization of 1802 Ellwangen passed to the Duchy of Württemberg.
zh: 埃尔旺根位于施瓦本的亚格斯特河畔，围绕施瓦本公国最古老的本笃会修道院发展起来；据传修道院由黑鲁尔夫与阿里奥夫兄弟于764年前后创立。虔诚者路易于814年将其置于王室保护之下，它后来成为帝国修道院，豁免权可能源于1011年亨利二世的特许，并在1347年由查理四世确认；981年它还须为奥托二世的意大利远征提供三十名铁甲骑兵。历任院长多身居教会高位，如美因茨大主教柳特伯特和哈托，院长埃尔曼里希则在出任帕绍主教前写过圣索鲁斯传。15世纪修院纪律松弛，1460年经教宗庇护二世批准改为世俗咏祷司铎团，由修道长统领，修道长位列帝国王侯并在帝国议会拥有一票，是除贝希特斯加登外仅有的两个帝国修道长邦之一。该邦于1609年加入天主教联盟，三十年战争期间的1632年被瑞典军队占据。1802年德意志调停中，埃尔旺根并入符腾堡公国。

en: Ely, in Irish Eile, was a petty kingdom of Gaelic Ireland between the Slieve Bloom Mountains and the Suir, lying across the later counties of Offaly and Tipperary, with Birr as its principal seat. Its people claimed kinship with the Eoganachta of Munster through Cian, son of Ailill Aulom, and the kingdom housed early monasteries at Birr, where a synod met in 697, Liathmore and Roscrea; the illuminated Book of Dimma was later given a jewelled shrine made for the O Carroll kings. By the twelfth century Ely had shrunk to two lordships, the northern Eile Ui Chearbhaill under the O Carrolls and a southern one under the O Fogartys. The O Carroll king Cearbhall fought alongside Brian Boru at Clontarf in 1014, and in 1337 the sept still held its country around Birr. Gaelic rule ended in 1552, when the last king, Tadhg Cian O Carroll, surrendered his lordship to the Tudor crown and received it back under English tenure.
zh: 伊莱，爱尔兰语称埃莱，是盖尔爱尔兰的小王国，地处斯利夫布卢姆山脉与苏尔河之间，横跨后来的奥法利郡和蒂珀雷里郡，以伯尔为首要驻地。其居民自称通过奥利尔·奥卢姆之子基安与芒斯特的尤加纳赫塔王族同源。王国境内有早期修道院：697年举行宗教会议的伯尔、利亚莫尔和罗斯克雷；带插图的《迪马之书》后来还配有奥卡罗尔国王定制的珠宝书匣。到12世纪，伊莱缩小为两个领地：北部奥卡罗尔家族的埃莱·伊·卡鲁尔和南部奥福加蒂家族的领地。奥卡罗尔国王卡鲁尔曾在1014年随布莱恩·博鲁参加克朗塔夫战役；1337年，该家族仍占据伯尔一带。盖尔人的统治于1552年结束，末代国王泰格·基安·奥卡罗尔向都铎王室交出领地，再以英格兰式的土地保有形式领回。

en: The Kingdom of England took shape in 927, when King Athelstan of Wessex united the Anglo-Saxon and Viking realms of Britain under a single crown. The Norman Conquest of 1066 placed William of Normandy on the throne and brought in a French-speaking ruling class; in 1154 Henry II of Anjou founded the Plantagenet line, whose continental empire was largely lost under King John, who was forced to seal Magna Carta in 1215. Edward I conquered Wales in 1283, and in 1337 the young Edward III still held Gascony and claimed the French throne, opening the Hundred Years' War, which by 1453 had left England with only Calais on the continent. The Wars of the Roses ended when Henry VII founded the Tudor dynasty in 1485; his son Henry VIII broke with Rome in 1534, and Elizabeth I's navy defeated the Spanish Armada in 1588. In 1603 James VI of Scotland inherited the English crown. Civil war, the execution of Charles I in 1649 and the Glorious Revolution of 1688 established parliamentary sovereignty, and the Acts of Union of 1707 merged England with Scotland into the Kingdom of Great Britain.
zh: 英格兰王国成形于927年，威塞克斯国王埃塞尔斯坦把不列颠的盎格鲁-撒克逊诸王国与维京领地统一在一顶王冠之下。1066年诺曼征服使诺曼底的威廉登上王位，带来了讲法语的统治阶层；1154年安茹的亨利二世开创金雀花王朝，他的大陆帝国在约翰王治下大部丧失，约翰还于1215年被迫签署《大宪章》。爱德华一世在1283年征服威尔士；1337年年轻的爱德华三世仍领有加斯科涅并主张法国王位，百年战争由此爆发，到1453年英格兰在大陆只剩加来。玫瑰战争以亨利七世于1485年建立都铎王朝告终；其子亨利八世在1534年与罗马决裂，伊丽莎白一世的舰队于1588年击败西班牙无敌舰队。1603年苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世继承英格兰王位。内战、1649年查理一世被处决和1688年光荣革命确立了议会主权，1707年的《联合法令》使英格兰与苏格兰合并为大不列颠王国。

en: Ennarea, called Hinnario in the Gonga tongue, was a kingdom of the Gibe region in the southwestern Ethiopian highlands, ruled by the Hinnare Bushasho clan. In the thirteenth century it was a province of the motalamis of Damot, but it broke away in the fourteenth century and grew into the strongest state of the non-Muslim south, reducing Kaffa and Bosa to tributaries and replacing Damot as a source of gold and slaves. From the campaigns of Emperor Amda Seyon onward it paid tribute to the Ethiopian emperors, and under Yeshaq I its dues are recorded as gold, slaves and cattle. From 1578 the Borana Oromo and their Sadacha federation overran the Gibe lands: Ennarea was briefly occupied in 1588, the year Emperor Sarsa Dengel marched south and converted its elite to Christianity. Sadacha attacks continued for more than a century, and in the mid-1600s the royal clan of Kaffa seized power and made Kaffa and Sheka independent. Emperor Iyasu I intervened in 1704 during a civil war, but around 1710 the Sadacha overran Ennarea under King Shisafotchi, who led his people into exile in Kaffa. The Oromo who settled the old kingdom later founded the five Gibe kingdoms, among them Limmu-Ennarea and Jimma.
zh: 恩纳雷亚在贡加语中称欣纳里奥，是埃塞俄比亚西南高原吉贝地区的王国，由欣纳雷·布沙绍氏族统治。13世纪时它是达莫特莫塔拉米们的一个省，14世纪独立，随后成长为南方非穆斯林地区最强的国家，迫使卡法和博萨称臣，取代达莫特成为黄金和奴隶的产地。自阿姆达·塞翁皇帝远征以来，它便向埃塞俄比亚皇帝纳贡，叶沙克一世时贡赋被记为黄金、奴隶和牛。1578年起，博兰奥罗莫人及其萨达查联盟席卷吉贝地区：1588年恩纳雷亚一度被占，同年萨尔萨·丹格尔皇帝南下，使其统治阶层皈依基督教。萨达查人的进攻持续了一个多世纪；17世纪中叶，卡法的王室氏族夺权，卡法和谢卡就此独立。1704年伊亚苏一世趁其内战出兵干预，但约1710年，萨达查人还是在国王希萨福奇治下灭了恩纳雷亚，希萨福奇率部流亡卡法。定居在旧王国土地上的奥罗莫人后来建立了五个吉贝王国，利穆-恩纳雷亚和金马便在其中。

en: The Despotate of Epirus was a Greek successor state of the Byzantine Empire, ruled from Arta on the Ionian coast. After the Fourth Crusade seized Constantinople in 1204, Michael I Komnenos Doukas founded it in 1205 as a refuge for Byzantine Greeks, alongside the rival empires of Nicaea and Trebizond. His half-brother Theodore Komnenos Doukas built an empire around Thessalonica in 1224 and was crowned emperor, but his bid for Constantinople ended in defeat by the Bulgarians at Klokotnitsa in 1230. Epirus then shrank to its Albanian and Greek homelands and passed through vassalage to Nicaea and the restored Palaiologan empire. After the Italian Orsini family seized power in 1318, Emperor Andronikos III reannexed the country in 1337 and left Theodore Synadenos to govern it as an imperial appanage. A despotate ruled by Serbian and then Italian lords was revived around Ioannina from 1367, and Carlo I Tocco reunited most of Epirus by 1416, but the Ottoman advance swallowed its towns one by one, with the last fortress, Vonitsa, falling in 1479.
zh: 伊庇鲁斯专制国是拜占庭帝国的希腊人继承政权，以爱奥尼亚海沿岸的阿尔塔为统治中心。1204年第四次十字军攻占君士坦丁堡后，米哈伊尔一世·科穆宁·杜卡斯于1205年建立此国，收留拜占庭希腊难民，与尼西亚帝国、特拉比松帝国并立。他的异母弟狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯于1224年在塞萨洛尼基一带建立帝国并加冕为帝，但他收复君士坦丁堡的图谋在1230年的克洛科特尼察之战中被保加利亚人击碎。此后伊庇鲁斯缩回其在阿尔巴尼亚与希腊的本土，先后臣属尼西亚和复辟的巴列奥略王朝。1318年意大利奥尔西尼家族夺权后，安德洛尼卡三世皇帝于1337年重新兼并该国，由西奥多尔·西纳齐诺斯作为皇室采邑长官治理。1367年起，一个以约阿尼纳为中心、先后由塞尔维亚和意大利贵族统治的专制国复兴，卡洛一世·托科于1416年重新统一伊庇鲁斯大部，但奥斯曼人的推进逐个吞没其城镇，最后一座要塞沃尼察于1479年陷落。

en:
The Lordship of Erbach was an Odenwald territory in the valley of the Mümling, ruled by a Rhine Franconian noble house first documented with Eberhard I of Erbach in 1148. The family began as ministeriales who held the bailiwick of Lorsch Abbey, and around 1226 the Wittelsbach counts palatine of the Rhine made them their hereditary cup-bearers, an office the lords of Erbach kept until 1806 and the origin of their title Schenk von Erbach. In the thirteenth century the house split into the Erbach and Reichenberg lines; its water castle at Erbach, where Schenk Conrad ruled in 1337, was first recorded in 1303.

The lords gained a seat among the imperial estates in 1422, and in 1532 Emperor Charles V raised Erbach to an immediate county of the Empire in reward for Count Eberhard's services in the Palatine Peasants' War. The Reformation was introduced throughout the county in 1544. In 1717 the family divided into the Erbach-Fürstenau, Erbach-Erbach and Erbach-Schönberg lines. Under the Rheinbund act of 1806 the county, by then about five hundred square kilometres with some thirty thousand inhabitants, was mediatized, most of it going to the Grand Duchy of Hesse and the remainder to the Kingdom of Bavaria.
zh:
埃尔巴赫领地是奥登林山米姆灵河谷中的一片领地，统治它的莱茵法兰克贵族家族最早以埃尔巴赫的埃伯哈德一世之名见于1148年的文献。该家族出身家臣，原本担任洛尔施修道院的辖区官；约1226年，维特尔斯巴赫家族的莱茵行宫伯爵把他们变为自家的世袭司酒官，埃尔巴赫领主保有此职直至1806年，“埃尔巴赫司酒”的头衔也由此而来。13世纪，家族分为埃尔巴赫和赖兴贝格两支；其位于埃尔巴赫的水堡最早见于1303年的记载，1337年在位的正是司酒官康拉德。

1422年，领主们取得帝国等级席位；1532年，为酬报埃伯哈德伯爵在普法尔茨农民战争中的功劳，查理五世皇帝将埃尔巴赫升格为帝国直辖伯国。1544年，宗教改革推行到整个伯国。1717年，家族分为埃尔巴赫-菲尔斯滕奥、埃尔巴赫-埃尔巴赫和埃尔巴赫-舍恩贝格三支。根据1806年的《莱茵邦联法案》，这个面积约五百平方公里、人口约三万的伯国被调停瓜分，大部分并入黑森大公国，其余归入巴伐利亚王国。

en: The Eretnid state ruled central and eastern Anatolia from Sivas and Kayseri between 1335 and 1381. Its founder Eretna was an Ilkhanid officer of Uyghur origin who served the Mongol governor Timurtash and then held Anatolia as governor under the Jalayirid ruler Hasan Buzurg. After an unexpected victory at the Battle of Karanbük over rival Mongol warlords, he claimed independence and took the title of sultan; his orderly, prosperous rule earned him the nickname Köse Peygamber, the beardless prophet. Under his son Muhammad I, who ruled from 1352, the emirs grew restive: he was deposed and restored, lost Ankara to the Ottoman Murad I in 1361, and was murdered by his own emirs at Kayseri in 1365. His young son Ali could not check the local lords, the Karamanids or the Dulkadirids, and died on campaign in 1380. The seven-year-old Muhammad II Chelebi reigned only months before his regent, the judge Kadi Burhan al-Din, seized the throne in 1381 and brought the Eretnid dynasty to an end.
zh: 埃雷特纳政权于1335至1381年间以锡瓦斯和开塞利为中心，统治安纳托利亚的中部和东部。开国者埃雷特纳是畏兀儿出身的伊儿汗国将领，曾效力于蒙古总督帖木儿塔什，后来又在贾拉伊尔王朝统治者哈桑·布祖格麾下出任安纳托利亚总督。在卡兰比克战役中出人意料地击败相争的蒙古军阀后，他宣布独立并自称苏丹；其治世安定富庶，为他赢得“无须先知”的绰号。其子穆罕默德一世1352年继位后，埃米尔们日益跋扈：他一度被废又复辟，1361年安卡拉被奥斯曼的穆拉德一世夺走，1365年在开塞利被自己的埃米尔谋杀。年幼的儿子阿里无力约束地方领主，也挡不住卡拉曼和杜尔卡迪尔的蚕食，于1380年死在征战途中。七岁的穆罕默德二世·切莱比在位仅数月，摄政卡迪·布尔汉丁便在1381年篡位，埃雷特纳王朝就此终结。

en: Erfurt, straddling a ford of the Gera on the great Via Regia road, was first mentioned in 742, when Saint Boniface established a diocese there; in 755 the see was absorbed into the Archdiocese of Mainz, whose overlordship shaped the city's whole medieval history. Woad made it the wealthiest of the Thuringian trading towns, and after 1200 a self-governing city council emerged, buying up a territory of nearly a hundred villages while acknowledging the Archbishop of Mainz as its lord. In 1306 Erfurt bound itself to Mühlhausen and Nordhausen in the Thuringian City Alliance, and the three cities entered the Hanseatic League together in 1430. Its Jewish community, one of Germany's oldest, was destroyed in the Black Death pogrom of 1349. The University of Erfurt, founded in 1379, was the earliest university founded in the German lands and counted Martin Luther among its students. Erfurt adopted the Reformation in 1521 and became officially bi-confessional in 1530, but its independence ended in 1664 when Mainz imposed direct rule and built the Petersberg citadel. In 1802 the city passed to Prussia, then became the French-ruled Principality of Erfurt, where Napoleon met Tsar Alexander I at the Congress of Erfurt in 1808.
zh: 爱尔福特扼守格拉河渡口，位于大道“皇帝之路”上，最早见于742年圣博尼法设立教区的记载；755年该教区并入美因茨大主教区，美因茨的宗主权贯穿了它整个中世纪史。菘蓝贸易使它成为图林根最富庶的商贸城市，1200年后自治市议会形成，陆续购入近百个村庄组成的属地，同时奉美因茨大主教为封君。1306年，爱尔福特与米尔豪森、诺德豪森结成图林根城市同盟，三城又于1430年一同加入汉萨同盟。当地犹太社区是德意志最古老的犹太社区之一，在1349年黑死病排犹屠杀中被毁。1379年创立的爱尔福特大学是德意志地区最早建立的大学，马丁·路德曾在此求学。爱尔福特于1521年接受宗教改革，1530年正式成为双信仰并存的城市；1664年美因茨实行直接统治并修建彼得斯贝格要塞，城市独立告终。1802年它划归普鲁士，随后成为法国治下的爱尔福特亲王国，1808年拿破仑与沙皇亚历山大一世在此召开爱尔福特会议。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Warmia, called Ermland in German, was the most independent of the four bishoprics founded in Prussia by the papal legate William of Modena in 1243, alongside Culm, Pomesania and Samland. Its cathedral chapter, constituted in 1260 and seated at Frombork, kept its independence from the Teutonic Order, so its canons freely elected their bishops, who kept residence at Lidzbark and were later recognized as prince-bishops by Emperor Charles IV. For more than two centuries Warmia was a protectorate of the Teutonic state, but in 1440 its nobles and towns joined the Prussian Confederation and in 1454 asked the Polish crown for protection. After siding with Poland in the Thirteen Years' War, Warmia was confirmed as part of the Kingdom of Poland in the Second Peace of Thorn of 1466, forming an autonomous church state within Royal Prussia. A dispute over episcopal elections then kindled the War of the Priests from 1467 to 1479, settled in Poland's favour. Warmia subsequently became a centre of learning and religion, where Nicolaus Copernicus lived and worked at Frombork as a canon of the chapter. The First Partition of Poland in 1772 delivered Warmia to Prussia, which annexed and secularized the prince-bishopric in 1773 and folded it into East Prussia.
zh: 瓦尔米亚采邑主教区德语称埃尔姆兰，是1243年教皇使节摩德纳的威廉在普鲁士设立的四个主教区之一，与海乌姆诺、波梅萨尼亚和萨姆兰并列。它的主教座堂参事会1260年成立，驻于弗龙堡，始终保持着对条顿骑士团的独立，因此参事可以自由选举主教；主教驻节利兹巴克，后来还被皇帝查理四世册封为采邑主教。两个多世纪里，瓦尔米亚是条顿国家的保护领，但1440年其贵族和城镇加入普鲁士邦联，并于1454年请求波兰王冠保护。在十三年战争中倒向波兰后，1466年的《第二次托伦和约》确认瓦尔米亚为波兰王国的一部分，成为王室普鲁士境内一个自治的教会国家。围绕主教选举的争执又引发1467至1479年的教士战争，最终以波兰获胜告终。此后瓦尔米亚成为学术和宗教中心：尼古拉·哥白尼曾作为参事会成员在弗龙堡生活和工作。1772年第一次瓜分波兰使瓦尔米亚落入普鲁士之手，1773年普王兼并并世俗化这个主教邦，将其并入东普鲁士。

en: Essen was the territory of Essen Abbey, a foundation of noble secular canonesses on the Ruhr. The Saxon cleric Altfrid, later bishop of Hildesheim, founded it around 845 beside the royal estate of Astnidhi, and under Ottonian patronage it gained imperial immediacy between 874 and 947. Its golden age came under Abbess Mathilde, granddaughter of Otto I, who ruled from 973 to 1011 and enriched the minster with the treasures still kept in the cathedral treasury, including the Golden Madonna. From 1228 the abbesses bore the title of princess, ruling the lands between the Emscher and the Ruhr and repeatedly defeating the town of Essen's attempts to become a free imperial city, in 1399 and again in 1670. In 1337 Katharina von der Mark, daughter of Count Engelbert II of the Mark, was elected princess-abbess; she secured an imperial confirmation of the abbey's rights from Charles IV in 1357 and ruled until her death in 1360. The abbey's protectors passed from the counts of Berg and Mark to the dukes of Cleves and, after 1609, to Brandenburg, and from 1512 it sat in the Lower Rhenish-Westphalian Circle. Prussian troops occupied it in 1802 and the abbey was dissolved in 1803; after an interlude under the Grand Duchy of Berg, its lands returned to Prussia in 1813.
zh: 埃森是埃森女修院的领地，这座鲁尔河畔的修院由出身高贵的世俗修女组成。撒克逊教士、后来的希尔德斯海姆主教阿尔特弗里德约于845年在王室领地阿斯特尼迪附近创建修院；在奥托皇朝的庇护下，它于874至947年间获得帝国直辖地位。修院的黄金时代在院长玛蒂尔德任内，她是奥托一世的孙女，973至1011年主持修院，为教堂积累了包括黄金圣母像在内、珍藏于主教座堂宝库中的礼器。1228年起，修院院长获封亲王头衔，统治埃姆舍尔河与鲁尔河之间的土地，并于1399年和1670年两度挫败埃森城成为帝国自由城市的企图。1337年，马克伯爵恩格爾贝特二世之女卡特琳娜·冯·德·马克当选亲王女院长；她于1357年取得皇帝卡尔四世对修院各项权利的帝国确认，一直统治到1360年去世。修院的护院领主先后由贝格伯爵、马克伯爵、克莱沃公爵以及1609年后的勃兰登堡担任；1512年起它位列下莱茵-威斯特伐利亚行政区。1802年普鲁士军队占领修院，1803年修院被解散；经过贝格大公国的短暂统治后，其领地于1813年重回普鲁士。

en: The County of Étampes lay in the Hurepoix, south of Paris on the edge of the Beauce, and was an appanage of the French crown. King Philip III gave the lordship to his younger son Louis of Évreux; it was raised to a county in 1327 under Louis's son Charles d'Évreux, who died in 1336 leaving an infant heir, Louis I. Louis fought in the Hundred Years' War, was captured at the Battle of Poitiers in 1356 and later served as one of the royal hostages guaranteeing the Treaty of Brétigny. He died childless in 1400, and the county passed to John, Duke of Berry; Burgundian troops seized the town in 1411 before it reverted to the royal domain. In 1536 Francis I made Étampes a duchy for his mistress Anne de Pisseleu, and the town was badly damaged by royal troops during the Fronde in 1652.
zh: 埃唐普伯国位于巴黎以南、博斯边缘的于尔普瓦，是法兰西王室的封邑。腓力三世把这片领地封给幼子埃夫勒的路易；1327年，在路易之子埃夫勒的查理治下，它被正式升为伯国。查理于1336年去世，继承人路易一世尚在襁褓之中。路易一世参加了百年战争，1356年在普瓦捷战役中被俘，后来又作为保证《布勒丁尼条约》履行的王家人质被送往英格兰。他于1400年去世且无嗣，伯国转入贝里公爵约翰手中；1411年勃艮第军队攻占埃唐普城，此后伯国又重归王室领地。1536年，弗朗索瓦一世把埃唐普升为公国，封给宠姬安妮·德·皮瑟勒；1652年投石党战争期间，该城遭到王军严重破坏。

en:
The Ethiopian Empire, long known abroad as Abyssinia, was the Christian highland state of the Horn of Africa. In 1270 Yekuno Amlak overthrew the Zagwe dynasty and founded the Solomonic line, whose kings claimed descent from King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba. In 1337 the throne belonged to Amda Seyon I, who reigned from 1314 to 1344: when the Sultanate of Ifat seized his envoy, he invaded, killed Sultan Haqq ad-Din I and sacked the Ifat capital, tilting the Horn toward the Christian highlanders for two centuries. The long reign of Zara Yaqob from 1434 to 1468 marked the empire's peak, as he replaced regional warlords with imperial officials and founded churches and monasteries across the land.

In the early sixteenth century the Adalite imam Ahmed Gran, backed by the Ottomans, overran most of the empire until Portuguese musketeers helped defeat him in 1543. The wars and the Oromo migrations that followed cost Ethiopia its southern provinces and its Red Sea coast. Recovery came under Fasilides, who in 1636 founded Gondar as a permanent capital, opening the Gondarine age of palaces, church building and painting around Lake Tana. After the death of Iyasu the Great in 1706 the crown weakened, and from 1769 the Zemene Mesafint, the Era of the Princes, left the emperors puppets of rival ras warlords around Gondar, a fragmentation that still defined the empire in the early nineteenth century.
zh:
埃塞俄比亚帝国在国外旧称阿比西尼亚，是非洲之角的基督教高原国家。1270年，耶库诺·阿姆拉克推翻扎格维王朝，建立所罗门王朝，历代国王自称是所罗门王与示巴女王的后裔。1337年在位的是阿姆达·塞翁一世，他于1314至1344年统治：伊法特苏丹国扣押他的使节，他便挥师入侵，杀死苏丹哈克·丁一世并洗劫伊法特都城，使此后两百年间非洲之角的天平倒向基督教高原一方。1434至1468年扎拉·雅各布的漫长统治是帝国的顶峰，他以帝国官吏取代地方军阀，在各地广建教堂和修道院。

16世纪初，阿达尔的伊玛目艾哈迈德·格兰在奥斯曼人支持下攻陷帝国大部，直到1543年葡萄牙火枪手协助将其击败。连年战争和随后的奥罗莫人迁徙，使埃塞俄比亚丧失了南方诸省和红海沿岸。复兴始于法西利德斯，他于1636年定都贡德尔，开启了贡德尔时代，塔纳湖周围宫殿林立、教堂广建、绘画兴盛。1706年伊亚苏大帝死后王权转弱，1769年起进入泽梅内·梅萨芬特，即王子时代，皇帝沦为贡德尔周围相互争战的拉斯军阀手中的傀儡；这种分裂局面一直延续到19世纪初。

en: Etzatlan, recorded by the first Spaniards as Itzatlan, was a town in the Valles region of western Jalisco, its Nahuatl name read either as place of the Itzas or as the place of bloodied water. Before the conquest its valley had passed under Tarascan power after ten years of border wars, and by 1524 its settlements held Mexica and Toltec communities alongside Caxcan and Chichimeca groups. In that year Francisco Cortes de San Buenaventura, marching toward Tepic, received the submission of the senorio of Etzatlan and assigned it as an encomienda; Nuno de Guzman followed in 1530. A Franciscan convent was begun in 1534, and the town received the rank of villa in 1537. During the Mixton War of 1541 Pedro de Alvarado passed through on campaign, and the friar Juan Calero, killed in the rising, was buried in the Etzatlan convent.
zh: 埃察特兰在最早的西班牙文献中记作伊察特兰，是哈利斯科西部巴列斯地区的一座城镇，其纳瓦特尔语名称或解作“伊察人之地”，或解作“血水之地”。征服之前，经过十年边境战争，这处山谷已落入塔拉斯科人之手；到1524年，境内各聚落除卡克斯坎人和奇奇梅克群体外，还住着墨西卡人和托尔特克人。1524年，向特皮克进军的弗朗西斯科·科尔特斯·德·圣布埃纳文图拉接受了埃察特兰领地的归降，将其封为监护领地，1530年努尼奥·德·古斯曼又接踵而至。方济各会修道院于1534年动工，1537年城镇获封西班牙式城镇名号。1541年米斯特顿战争期间，佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多征战途经此地，在起义中殉道的修士胡安·卡莱罗就葬在埃察特兰修道院。

en: The County of Évreux was a royal fief in Normandy, centred on the city of Évreux, whose earlier counts came of Norman and Montfort-l'Amaury stock. At the end of the thirteenth century it was granted as an appanage to Louis, a younger son of King Philip III, who founded the Capetian House of Évreux. His son Philip inherited the county in 1319, married Joan, daughter of King Louis X, and in 1328 the couple succeeded to the Kingdom of Navarre as Philip III and Joan II, ending the personal union between Navarre and France that had lasted forty-four years. In 1337 Évreux was thus ruled by a king of Navarre who remained a powerful vassal of the Valois crown; Philip died in 1343 while on crusade against Granada. His son Charles II, called the Bad, wove intrigues against the French crown until Charles V seized his Évreux lands in 1378. The line closed when Charles III exchanged Évreux for the Duchy of Nemours in 1404, returning the county to the royal domain.
zh: 埃夫勒伯国是诺曼底境内的王室封邑，以埃夫勒城为中心，早期伯爵出自诺曼人和蒙福尔-拉莫里家族。13世纪末，国王腓力三世的幼子路易受封埃夫勒，开创了卡佩王朝的埃夫勒支系。他的儿子腓力于1319年继承伯国，又娶国王路易十世之女让娜为妻；1328年，夫妇二人一同继承纳瓦拉王位，称腓力三世与让娜二世，结束了纳瓦拉与法兰西持续四十四年的共主邦联。因此在1337年，埃夫勒的统治者是一位纳瓦拉国王，同时又是瓦卢瓦王室麾下强大的封臣；腓力三世于1343年在征讨格拉纳达的十字军途中病逝。他的儿子恶人查理二世一再与法兰西王室勾斗争权，1378年查理五世没收了他在埃夫勒的领地。1404年，卡洛斯三世用埃夫勒换取内穆尔公国，伯国就此重归王室领地。

en: The County of Everstein was the small lordship that the counts of Everstein built from their allodial lands in the Weser hills between Höxter, Holzminden and Hameln. The family, kinsmen and clients of the Hohenstaufen, took its name in 1116 from its two castles on the Großer and Kleiner Everstein above Holzminden, and it rose after the fall of Henry the Lion in 1180, when Albrecht III of Everstein entered the service of the Archbishop of Cologne as Duke of Westphalia and Engern. Its cadres also organized Frankish settlement in the Dobnagau around Plauen, fiefs that Count Hermann III renounced in 1328. When the Staufer collapsed, the Welfs forced the sale of Everstein Castle in 1284 and the counts moved their seat to Polle; around 1335 they also had to surrender Ohsen Castle to the dukes of Brunswick-Lüneburg. The end came through the Everstein succession feud of 1405 to 1407: after Count Hermann VII's only son died, his inheritance treaty with Lippe was overridden by the Welfs, and in 1408 the county with Polle Castle passed to Brunswick-Lüneburg. A Pomeranian branch, Eberstein-Naugard, survived until 1663.
zh: 埃弗施泰因伯国是埃弗施泰因伯爵家族在赫克斯特、霍尔茨明登和哈默尔恩之间的威悉山地，以自家世袭领地建立的小型领邦。该家族是霍亨斯陶芬家族的亲族和附庸，1116年以霍尔茨明登上方大、小埃弗施泰因山上的两座城堡得名；1180年狮子亨利倒台后它趁势崛起，埃弗施泰因的阿尔布雷希特三世作为威斯特伐利亚与恩格恩公爵投身科隆大主教麾下。家族成员还曾在普劳恩一带的多布纳高组织法兰克人垦殖，伯爵赫尔曼三世于1328年放弃了那里的全部封邑。霍亨斯陶芬王朝覆灭后，韦尔夫家族于1284年强迫他们出售埃弗施泰因城堡，伯爵家族遂把驻地迁往波勒；约1335年，他们又被迫把奥克森城堡交给不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵。终局来自1405至1407年的埃弗施泰因继承纷争：伯爵赫尔曼七世的独子夭折后，他与利珀订立的继承条约被韦尔夫家族推翻，1408年，伯国连同波勒城堡一并落入不伦瑞克-吕讷堡之手。家族在波美拉尼亚的支系埃伯施泰因-瑙加德一直延续到1663年。

en: Ewyas was a small marcher lordship in the hills where Herefordshire meets Wales, running from the Vale of Ewyas in the Black Mountains to the castle borough of Longtown. It began as a Welsh commote, and around 1046 Osbern Pentecost raised one of the earliest motte-and-bailey castles in Britain at Ewyas Harold. After the Norman Conquest the de Lacy family held it as a largely autonomous marcher lordship, building Longtown Castle to guard a new borough after 1216. When the de Lacy line failed in 1241, the inheritance passed through the Verdun family, and Elizabeth de Verdun carried Ewyas to her husband Bartholomew Burghersh, who held it in 1337 while also serving Edward III as constable of Dover and warden of the Cinque Ports. Longtown had fallen into decay by the fourteenth century but was briefly reoccupied during Owain Glyndwr's rising in 1403. Under the Laws in Wales Acts of 1536 the lordship was dissolved: Ewyas Lacy was absorbed into Herefordshire and the Vale of Ewyas into Monmouthshire.
zh: 尤亚斯是赫里福德郡与威尔士交界处山区的一个小型边境领主领，从布莱克山的尤亚斯谷一直延伸到城堡市镇朗敦。它最初是威尔士人的康莫特，约1046年奥斯本·彭蒂科斯特在尤亚斯哈罗德建起不列颠最早的土岗城郭式城堡之一。诺曼征服后，德·莱西家族以近乎自治的边境领形式持有此地，并在1216年后修建朗敦城堡守卫新设的市镇。1241年德·莱西家族绝嗣，遗产经韦尔登家族传承，伊丽莎白·德·韦尔登把尤亚斯带给丈夫巴塞洛缪·伯格斯；1337年他领有此地，同时还担任爱德华三世的多佛守备长官和五港总督。到14世纪朗敦城堡已趋荒废，但在1403年欧文·格林杜尔起义期间曾被短暂重新启用。根据1536年的《威尔士法令》，该领主领被撤销：尤亚斯莱西并入赫里福德郡，尤亚斯谷则划入蒙茅斯郡。

en: Faenza, the Roman Faventia, stands on the Lamone River in Romagna on the line of the Via Emilia. In 774 Charlemagne granted the city to the Papal States, but in the communal age it governed itself as a Guelph town and member of the Lombard League, enduring sieges from the armies of Frederick II. From 1319 the Manfredi family made themselves signori, their rule interrupted by periods of direct papal government; Riccardo Manfredi held the lordship in the years around 1337. The Manfredi, who also controlled Imola for several decades, kept Faenza independent until Astorre III was driven out by Cesare Borgia in 1501. After a brief restoration in 1503 the city was absorbed into the Papal States, whose provincial capital it remained through the early modern period. Faenza won lasting fame for its glazed maiolica pottery, so widely exported that the word faience derives from the city's name. Napoleonic armies swept away papal rule in 1797, and after the Napoleonic decade the Congress of Vienna returned Faenza to the Papal States in 1815.
zh: 法恩扎古称罗马时代的法文提亚，位于罗马涅的拉莫内河畔，扼守艾米利亚大道。774年查理曼将该城赠予教皇国，但在自治公社时代它作为圭尔夫派城市和伦巴第联盟成员自行治理，曾多次顶住腓特烈二世军队的围攻。1319年起曼弗雷迪家族成为城市的领主，其统治几度被教皇的直接管辖打断，1337年前后在位的是里卡尔多·曼弗雷迪。曼弗雷迪家族还曾控制伊莫拉数十年，他们对法恩扎的统治一直维持到1501年阿斯托雷三世被切萨雷·博尔贾驱逐。1503年家族短暂复辟后，该城被并入教皇国，近代早期一直是教皇国的行省重镇。法恩扎以锡釉彩陶闻名，产品远销各地，欧洲语言中的“法恩斯陶”（faience）一词便源自该城之名。1797年拿破仑的军队终结了教皇统治，拿破仑时代结束后，1815年的维也纳会议又把法恩扎交还教皇国。

en: Fal was the coastal district around the town of Fal on the hot Garmsirat plain of southern Fars, part of medieval Laristan; its port of Siraf had been a great Sasanian and early Islamic trading city before earthquakes ruined it around the year 970. By the fourteenth century it was a small tribal polity overshadowed by its powerful neighbour, the Kingdom of Hormuz.
zh: 法勒是法尔斯南部炎热的加尔姆西拉特平原上以法勒镇为中心的沿海地区，属中世纪拉里斯坦的一部分；其港口锡拉夫曾是萨珊王朝和早期伊斯兰时代的贸易重镇，约970年毁于地震。到14世纪，它是一个受制于强邻霍尔木兹王国的小部族政权。

en: The County of Freiburg grew out of the Zähringen inheritance: when the Zähringen dukes died out in 1218, Count Egino of Urach, whose mother was Agnes of Zähringen, took Freiburg and the Breisgau and styled himself Count of Freiburg, a line of the counts of Urach known by that name from about 1230. The city itself had been founded as a free market town by the Zähringer Konrad and Duke Berthold III in 1120, and its silver mines on the Schauinsland made it one of the richer towns of the Upper Rhine; in 1327 it began minting the Rappenpfennig, later the basis of a coinage union with Basel, Colmar and Breisach. Rule over the city was never undisputed. In a feud against Count Egino II the burghers battered down his castle on the Schloßberg with catapults, and in 1299 they killed his brother-in-law Conrad of Lichtenberg, Prince-Bishop of Strasbourg, afterwards paying an annual silver tribute of 300 marks. In 1368, after a failed countly night raid two years earlier, Freiburg ransomed itself and placed the city under Habsburg protection. The counts then kept only their Badenweiler estates south of the city, until the last of them, Johann, bequeathed Badenweiler to the margraves of Hachberg-Sausenberg in 1444.
zh: 弗赖堡伯国源自策林根家族的遗产：1218年策林根公爵绝嗣，母亲出身策林根家族的乌拉赫伯爵埃吉诺取得弗赖堡和布赖斯高，自称弗赖堡伯爵；这一支系属乌拉赫伯爵家族，约1230年起以弗赖堡为家族名。城市本身是1120年由策林根的康拉德和公爵贝特霍尔德三世建立的自由集市镇，绍因斯兰山的银矿使它成为上莱茵最富庶的城市之一；1327年它开始铸造拉本芬尼银币，后来还与巴塞尔、科尔马和布赖萨赫结成货币同盟。伯爵对城市的统治始终不稳：在与埃吉诺二世伯爵的冲突中，市民用投石机摧毁了他在城堡山上的城堡，1299年又杀死了他的姻亲、斯特拉斯堡采邑主教利希滕贝格的康拉德，此后每年缴纳300马克白银作为赎罪金。1366年伯爵的一次夜袭失败后，城市于1368年赎身自治，转投哈布斯堡家族保护。伯爵们只保留城南的巴登韦勒领地，末代伯爵约翰于1444年把巴登韦勒遗赠给哈赫贝格-绍森贝格藩侯。

en: The Free County of Burgundy, later called Franche-Comté, lay east of the Saône, across the river from the French Duchy of Burgundy, with the counts ruling from Dole while Besançon stood apart as a free imperial city. The county was formed in 982 around the domains of Count Otto-William, and in 1032 it passed with the Kingdom of Arles to the Emperor Conrad II and became a state of the Holy Roman Empire; its rulers held the German title of Freigraf, or free count, from which the name Franche-Comté derives. From 1295 French influence grew, and in 1330 the county passed to Joan III, daughter of King Philip V of France, whose marriage to Odo IV of Burgundy joined the county to the neighbouring duchy in personal union until 1361. Valois-Burgundy ruled it again from 1405 until the death of Charles the Bold in 1477, when France occupied it; the Treaty of Senlis of 1493 returned it to the Habsburgs. French armies conquered the county in 1674, and the Treaties of Nijmegen of 1678 made French rule permanent.
zh: 勃艮第自由伯国后称弗朗什‑孔泰，位于索恩河以东，与法兰西的勃艮第公国隔河相望；伯爵以多勒为治所，而贝桑松自成自由帝国城市，不在伯爵治下。伯国于982年围绕伯爵奥托-威廉的领地形成，1032年随阿尔勒王国并入皇帝康拉德二世的神圣罗马帝国；其统治者拥有德语“自由伯爵”头衔，弗朗什‑孔泰之名即由此而来。1295年起法兰西影响日深，1330年伯国传给法兰西国王腓力五世之女让娜三世，她嫁给勃艮第公爵厄德四世，使伯国与相邻的公爵领结成共主邦联，一直维持到1361年。1405至1477年它再次由瓦卢瓦-勃艮第家族统治；大胆的查理死后，法兰西于1477年出兵占领，1493年的《桑利斯条约》又把它归还哈布斯堡家族。1674年法军征服伯国，1678年的《奈梅亨条约》使法兰西的统治永久化。

en: Firceall was a Gaelic Irish territory in the south-west of the ancient Kingdom of Meath, centred on Tullamore in what is now County Offaly. Its ruling family, the O'Molloys, claimed descent from Niall of the Nine Hostages, the high king of Tara, and the name Firceall means Men of the Churches, reflecting the many abbeys and monastic churches founded at Rahan, Lynally and Kilcormac. The territory bordered Éile to the south and Uí Failghe to the east. Its chieftains kept their independence through the later Middle Ages, but when the midlands were shired under Mary I in 1556 and planted in the decades that followed, Firceall was broken into the baronies of Ballycowan, Ballyboy and Eglish within the new King's County, and the O'Molloys lost their ancient lordship.
zh: 菲斯卡尔是古米斯王国西南部的一块盖尔人领地，以今奥法利郡境内的塔拉莫尔为中心。统治这里的奥莫洛伊家族自称是塔拉至高王“九质之尼尔”的后裔；“菲斯卡尔”一名意为“教会之人”，得名于拉汉、利纳利和基尔科马克等地众多的修道院与教堂。该地南接埃伊尔，东邻乌伊法尔格。其酋长在中世纪后期一直保持着独立，但在1556年玛丽一世将中部地区设郡、随后开展殖民垦置后，菲斯卡尔被划入新设的国王郡，拆成巴利考恩、巴利博伊和埃格利什三个男爵领，奥莫洛伊家族也丧失了世袭的首领之位。

en: The Al Fadl were an Arab Bedouin dynasty of the Syrian steppe and the senior branch of the Banu Rabi'ah of the Tayy, cousins of the Al Mira who dominated the Hauran. Their ancestor Fadl, a son of the emir Rabi'ah, led mounted auxiliaries for the Burid and Zengid atabegs of Damascus in the twelfth century, and after the Al Mira drove them from the Hauran they moved north to the pastures around Homs and held fiefs at Salamiyah and Palmyra. Under the Ayyubids and then the Mamluks their emirs made the office of amir al-arab, commander of the Bedouin of northern Syria, hereditary in their house; Sultan Baybars confirmed Isa ibn Muhanna in the post after 1260. In 1337 the reigning emir was Musa ibn Muhanna, lord of Salamiyah and Palmyra, who had succeeded his father in 1335 and stood so high in the favour of Sultan an-Nasir Muhammad that in 1337 the sultan granted him a fief worth a million silver dirhams in exchange for one Arabian horse. Musa died in 1341, and his sons and grandsons kept the office through the fourteenth century despite repeated tribal feuds. The Ottomans, who conquered Syria in 1516, preserved the hereditary emirate, but in the later sixteenth century the leading Al Fadl house re-formed as the Al Abu Risha and merged into the Mawali confederation, while rival clans migrated to the Beqaa Valley; by the eighteenth century the Mawali had given way before the advancing Anazzah.
zh: 法德勒是叙利亚草原上的阿拉伯贝都因世家，为塔伊部落巴努·拉比阿的长支，与称雄豪兰的米拉人同宗。其先祖法德勒是埃米尔拉比阿之子，12世纪曾率骑兵辅助大马士革的布里德和赞吉诸阿塔贝格；被米拉人逐出豪兰后，他们北迁到霍姆斯一带的牧场，领有塞莱米耶和巴尔米拉的伊克塔封地。在阿尤布王朝及后来的马穆鲁克王朝治下，其埃米尔使北叙利亚贝都因统帅阿拉伯埃米尔一职成为家族世袭职位，1260年后苏丹拜巴尔斯确认伊萨·伊本·穆海纳担任此职。1337年在位的埃米尔是穆萨·伊本·穆海纳，领有塞莱米耶和巴尔米拉，他于1335年承袭父职，深受苏丹纳绥尔·穆罕默德宠信，苏丹在1337年竟以岁入一百万迪尔汗银币的封地换取他的一匹阿拉伯良马。穆萨于1341年去世，尽管部落内讧不断，他的子孙在整个14世纪仍保有该职。1516年征服叙利亚的奥斯曼人保留了这个世袭埃米尔国，但16世纪后期，法德勒的主支改组为阿布·里沙家族并并入马瓦利联盟，敌对氏族则迁往贝卡谷地；到18世纪，马瓦利又在推进的阿纳扎人面前失势。

en: The Principality of Theodoro, also called Gothia, was a small Greek-speaking state in the mountains of southern Crimea and the last surviving fragment of the Byzantine world, with its capital at the cliff fortress of Mangup, also named Theodoro. It grew out of the old Byzantine theme of Cherson after the Mongol invasion of 1238 left the Crimean highlands to their own devices under a light tribute. Its princes of the Gabras dynasty, known to Russian chronicles as the Khovra family, ruled a population that still included Crimean Goths alongside Greeks, and one of them, Stephen, moved to Moscow with his son around 1402, where the family founded the Simonov Monastery. The principality paid tribute to the Golden Horde and fought the Genoese colonies of the coast for control of Crimean harbors; after Timur's raid of 1395 it recovered to become a minor Black Sea power in the fifteenth century. The Ottomans ended its independence in 1475, when Gedik Ahmed Pasha stormed Mangup and carried off its last prince.
zh: 狄奥多罗公国又称哥提亚，是克里米亚南部山区一个讲希腊语的小国，也是拜占庭世界最后残存的碎片，都城是悬崖要塞曼古普，亦称狄奥多罗。1238年蒙古入侵后，克里米亚高地在轻微的贡赋义务下自行其是，这个公国便从旧时拜占庭的赫尔松军区脱胎而生。统治它的加夫拉斯王朝在罗斯编年史中称作霍夫拉家族，治下居民除希腊人外还有克里米亚哥特人；约1402年，王公斯捷潘携子迁居莫斯科，其后人在那里修建了西蒙诺夫修道院。公国向金帐汗国纳贡，又为争夺克里米亚港口与沿海的热那亚殖民地长期冲突；1395年帖木儿的袭击之后它恢复元气，在15世纪成为黑海地区的一小强权。1475年奥斯曼人终结了它的独立，格迪克·艾哈迈德帕沙攻陷曼古普，掳走末代王公。

en: Ferrara lies on a branch of the Po in Emilia, on land first settled around the Etruscan lagoon town of Spina. The Lombards took it from the Exarchate of Ravenna in 753, and the Franks soon granted it to the Papacy; after a period under the House of Canossa it became a free commune on Matilda of Tuscany's death in 1115. The Este family backed the winning faction in the city's factional strife, and in 1264 Obizzo II d'Este was made lifelong lord, adding Modena in 1288 and Reggio in 1289. In 1337 the signory was held by Obizzo III d'Este, whose descendants made their court one of the most brilliant in Renaissance Italy: Borso d'Este became Duke of Ferrara in 1471, Ercole I commissioned the Erculean Addition city plan of 1484, and writers and painters such as Ariosto and the Ferrarese school flourished under ducal patronage. When the main Este line failed in 1597, Pope Clement VIII brought Ferrara under direct papal rule, while the family kept Modena and Reggio. It remained a papal legation until French armies entered in 1796, and the Congress of Vienna returned it to the Papal States in 1815.
zh: 费拉拉位于艾米利亚的波河支流畔，附近最早的定居点是潟湖畔的伊特鲁里亚城镇斯皮纳。753年伦巴第人从拉文纳总督区夺取该城，法兰克人旋即将它赠予教皇；它一度归卡诺萨家族统治，1115年托斯卡纳女伯爵玛蒂尔达去世后成为自由公社。埃斯特家族在城市党争中押对了阵营，1264年奥比佐二世·德斯特被推举为终身领主，又于1288年和1289年先后取得摩德纳与雷焦。1337年执政的是奥比佐三世·德斯特，他的后裔把宫廷经营成文艺复兴时期意大利最重要的文化中心之一：博尔索·德斯特于1471年成为费拉拉公爵，埃尔科莱一世于1484年下令实施“埃尔科莱扩建”城市规划，阿里奥斯托等作家和费拉拉画派在公爵庇护下盛极一时。1597年埃斯特嫡系绝嗣，教皇克雷芒八世将费拉拉收归教皇直接统治，家族则保留摩德纳和雷焦。此后它作为教皇代牧区直至1796年法军进入，1815年维也纳会议又把它交还教皇国。

en: The County of Flanders, with its capital at Bruges, grew from the small Pagus Flandrensis around that city into one of the richest lordships of medieval Europe, its wealth built on the cloth trade of Ghent, Bruges, Ypres and Lille. Its first count, Baldwin I, received the land from the West Frankish king Charles the Bald in 862. West of the Scheldt the county was a fief of France, east of the river a fief of the Empire. Under the Dampierre dynasty, Count Guy clashed with King Philip IV: in the Franco-Flemish War of 1297 to 1305 the town militias won the Battle of the Golden Spurs in 1302, but the Treaty of Athis-sur-Orge in 1305 cost Flanders Lille, Douai and Orchies. In 1337 it was still a French fief ruled by Louis I of Dampierre. His granddaughter Margaret married the Burgundian duke Philip the Bold, and in 1384 Flanders passed to the Valois dukes of Burgundy, becoming the heart of the Burgundian Netherlands. In 1482 it passed to the Habsburgs, and the Pragmatic Sanction of 1549 made it one of the Seventeen Provinces under the Spanish crown. Reconquered for Spain in the Eighty Years' War, its southern strip was ceded to France in 1678; the rest passed to the Austrian Habsburgs in 1713, was annexed by revolutionary France in 1795, and in 1815 joined the United Kingdom of the Netherlands before becoming part of Belgium after 1830.
zh: 佛兰德伯国以布鲁日为首都，从布鲁日周边的一小块佛兰德旧地发展为中世纪欧洲最富庶的领地之一，财富来自根特、布鲁日、伊珀尔和里尔的呢绒贸易。862年，西法兰克国王秃头查理将这片土地封给第一代伯爵博杜安一世。伯国在斯海尔德河以西是法兰西封邑，河以东是神圣罗马帝国封邑。当皮埃尔家族的居伊伯爵与国王腓力四世冲突，在1297至1305年的佛兰德-法兰西战争中，市民武装于1302年赢得金马刺战役，但1305年的《阿蒂斯条约》使佛兰德失去里尔、杜埃和奥尔希。1337年它仍是法兰西封邑，统治者是当皮埃尔家族的路易一世。他的孙女玛格丽特嫁给勃艮第公爵勇敢的腓力，佛兰德遂于1384年转入瓦卢瓦家族的勃艮第公爵之手，成为勃艮第尼德兰的核心。1482年它归哈布斯堡家族，1549年的《国事诏书》将其定为西班牙王冠治下的十七省之一。八十年战争期间它被西班牙重新征服，南部地带于1678年割让给法兰西；其余部分于1713年转归奥地利哈布斯堡家族，1795年被革命中的法兰西吞并，1815年并入尼德兰联合王国，1830年后成为比利时的一部分。

en: Fulda was a Benedictine monastery and ecclesiastical principality on the river of the same name, founded in 744 by Saint Sturm, a disciple of Saint Boniface. When Boniface was martyred in Frisia in 754, his body was brought back to Fulda, turning the abbey into one of Germany's foremost pilgrimage sites and centres of learning; the Annals of Fulda, a chief source for ninth-century Carolingian history, were compiled in its scriptorium. In 1221 the abbot was granted an imperial estate, and Fulda became a princely abbey whose ruler sat as a prince of the Holy Roman Empire. In 1356 Emperor Charles IV added the honorific title of Archchancellor of the Empress to the prince-abbot's dignities. Growing population and territory brought a final change of status in 1752, when Fulda was raised to a prince-bishopric, until the monastery was dissolved in 1802 and the principality secularized in 1803.
zh: 富尔达是同名河畔的本笃会修道院兼教会邦国，744年由圣博尼法的弟子圣斯图姆创立。754年博尼法在弗里斯兰殉道后，遗体被运回富尔达，使这座修道院成为德意志最重要的朝圣地与学术中心之一；记载9世纪加洛林帝国历史的核心文献《富尔达编年史》便出自它的抄写室。1221年，修道院院长获封帝国领地，富尔达成为亲王修道院，其院长以神圣罗马帝国诸侯的身份位列帝国等级。1356年，皇帝查理四世又将“皇后大总理”的荣誉头衔授予院长。随着人口与领地增长，富尔达于1752年升格为主教采邑区，最终修道院在1802年解散，邦国于1803年被世俗化。

en: Falkenstein was the lordship of the counts of Bolanden-Falkenstein, named after their ancestral castle at Falkenstein in the Palatinate. Philipp of Bolanden, imperial treasurer and keeper of the imperial regalia at Trifels, married Isengard, heiress of the counts of Hagen-Münzenberg, and from 1255 the family held her Münzenberg inheritance in the Wetterau, including the imperial land-vogtei there and the town of Offenbach am Main. The Falkensteins made the Taunus their new centre, building the castle of Neufalkenstein at Königstein, while keeping their Palatine and Rhenish Hesse lands. In 1372 they pledged Offenbach to the imperial city of Frankfurt for one thousand gulden, and Count Werner III ruled as Archbishop of Trier from 1388 to 1418. A side line received the comital title in 1398, but the Hessian Falkensteins died out in 1418, their Rhenish lands passing to the counts of Virneburg. The original Palatine county was sold to the lords of Daun-Oberstein in 1456, raised to a county in 1518, sold to the Dukes of Lorraine in 1667, and finally ceded to France in 1801 under the Peace of Lunéville.
zh: 法尔肯施泰因是博兰登‑法尔肯施泰因伯爵家族的领地，得名于他们在普法尔茨的祖传城堡法尔肯施泰因。博兰登的菲利普曾任帝国司库、在特里费尔斯城堡看管帝国信物，他娶了哈根‑明岑贝格伯爵家族的女继承人伊森加德；1255年起，家族领有她在韦特劳的明岑贝格遗产，包括当地的帝国地方长官职权和美因河畔奥芬巴赫镇。法尔肯施泰因家族把统治中心移到陶努斯山区，在柯尼希施泰因修建新法尔肯施泰因城堡，同时保留普法尔茨和莱茵黑森的祖产。1372年，他们以一千古尔登把奥芬巴赫抵押给帝国城市法兰克福；伯爵维尔纳三世则在1388年至1418年间担任特里尔大主教。家族一支于1398年获得伯爵头衔，但黑森的法尔肯施泰因家族于1418年绝嗣，莱茵地区的产业转入维尔讷堡伯爵家族。原本的普法尔茨伯国于1456年卖给道恩‑奥伯施泰因领主，1518年被正式升格为伯国，1667年售予洛林公爵，最终在1801年依《吕内维尔和约》割让给法国。

en: Fulun was a small Hūrga Jurchen community of the Hailang River valley, a 222-kilometre left-bank tributary of the Hurka, or Mudan, flowing through present Hailin. Its fishing and farming villages belonged to the Hurka tribal world and stood under the loose suzerainty of the Chinese dynasties, like the other Jurchen groups of the Sungari and Ussuri country.
zh: 富伦是海浪河流域的虎尔哈女真小聚落。海浪河长222公里，是流经今海林市的虎尔哈河（即牡丹江）左岸支流，河畔村落兼事渔猎与农耕，属于虎尔哈部落圈，并与松花江、乌苏里江一带的其他女真群体一样，对中原王朝保持松散的臣属关系。

en: Florence was founded as a Roman colony in 59 BC on the Arno, and after the death of Matilda of Tuscany in 1115 it shook off the margravial government and formed a commune, documented as a republic from 1138. Power rested with the merchant guilds, whose elected Signoria and gonfaloniere presided over a city torn for two centuries by Guelph and Ghibelline, then Black and White Guelph, faction wars. Wool manufacturing and the banking houses of the Bardi, Peruzzi and later the Medici made the city rich, and its gold florin, first struck in 1252, became the standard trade coin of Western Europe. From Dante and Giotto onward Florence was the cradle of the Renaissance, a position reinforced after the Medici returned from exile under Cosimo in 1434 and reached its height under Lorenzo the Magnificent. The family was expelled in 1494 amid the preaching of Savonarola, restored in 1512, expelled again in 1527 and imposed once more after the imperial siege of 1529 to 1530. Alessandro de' Medici became hereditary duke in 1532, and Cosimo I conquered Siena in 1555 and was raised to Grand Duke of Tuscany in 1569. The Medici grand dukes ruled until the line died out in 1737, when Tuscany passed to the House of Lorraine.
zh: 佛罗伦萨于公元前59年在阿尔诺河畔作为罗马殖民地建立。1115年托斯卡纳女伯爵玛蒂尔达去世后，它摆脱边疆伯统治、组成自治公社，1138年已有共和国的明确记载。政权掌握在商人行会手中，由选出的执政团和正义旗手主持；两百年间城市深陷圭尔夫派与吉伯林派、以及后来黑党与白党之间的党争。呢绒制造业和巴尔迪、佩鲁齐及后来的美第奇等银行家族使该城富足，1252年开始铸造的金币弗罗林成为西欧通用的贸易货币。从但丁和乔托的时代起，佛罗伦萨就是文艺复兴的摇篮；1434年美第奇家族在科西莫带领下从流放中归来，到“豪华者”洛伦佐时权势达到顶峰，进一步巩固了这一地位。1494年该家族在萨沃纳罗拉的布道声中被驱逐，1512年复辟，1527年再次被逐，1529至1530年帝国军队围城后又被扶立。1532年亚历山德罗·德·美第奇成为世袭公爵，科西莫一世于1555年征服锡耶纳，1569年受封为托斯卡纳大公。美第奇大公的统治延续到1737年嫡系绝嗣，托斯卡纳随后转入洛林家族手中。

en: Offaly preserves the name of Uí Failghe, a Gaelic kingdom in the midlands of Ireland whose lands covered the country east of Tullamore in the present county of the same name, together with western Kildare and parts of north-eastern Laois. It claimed descent from the early sixth-century king Rus Failge and for centuries held its own against the Uí Néill, the Eóganachta and later the Normans, though each round of warfare cost it territory. From the middle of the eleventh century its rulers were the Ó Conchobhair Failghe, or O'Conor Faly, a dynasty unrelated to the O'Conors of Connacht; after the Norman invasion they moved their seat from Rathangan to the fortress at Daingean. The kingdom's long independence ended in the mid-sixteenth century. When its last de facto king, Brian mac Chathaoir, died about 1556, the Parliament of Ireland passed the Settlement of Laois and Offaly Act, and Uí Failghe was partitioned among the King's County, the Queen's County and County Kildare under the Tudor plantations.
zh: 奥法利之名源自乌伊·法尔盖，一个位于爱尔兰中部的盖尔王国，其疆域包括同名郡内图拉莫尔以东的地区，外加基尔代尔西部和莱什东北部一带。王国自称是6世纪初国王拉斯·法尔盖的后裔，数百年来先后顶住了伊·尼尔人、埃奥赫塔人和后来诺曼人的侵逼，尽管每一轮战事都要割让部分土地。11世纪中叶起，统治者是奥康诺·法利家族，与康诺特的奥康诺家族并无亲缘；诺曼入侵后，他们把治所从拉杭根迁到丹甘的要塞。王国的悠久独立在16世纪中叶终结：最后一位实际掌权的国王布莱恩·麦克·卡希尔约于1556年去世，爱尔兰议会随即通过《莱什与奥法利安置法令》，乌伊·法尔盖在都铎殖民过程中被拆分给国王郡、女王郡和基尔代尔郡。

en: Fermanagh, in Irish Fir Manach, was a Gaelic kingdom of the loughs and islands of upper Lough Erne, covering the country that became County Fermanagh. It took shape in the tenth century out of the older kingdom of Ui Chremthainn within the overkingdom of Airgialla, and by the late eleventh century its kings ruled the whole of the later county. Early rulers came from the O Heany, Mulrooney and Darragh branches of Clann Lugainn, until the Mag Uidhir, or Maguire, clan seized the kingship in the late thirteenth century and kept it, apart from challenges from the O Donnells of Tyrconnell, to the end. The Maguires seated themselves at Lisnaskea, with their inauguration mound nearby at Cornashee, and in 1337 Roderick Maguire ruled a kingdom that answered to no English sheriff. That independence ended in the Nine Years War, when Hugh Maguire led Fermanagh against English rule; his successor fled in the Flight of the Earls in 1607, and the kingdom was absorbed into the Kingdom of Ireland as County Fermanagh.
zh: 弗马纳，爱尔兰语称菲尔·马纳赫，是盖尔爱尔兰的王国，位于上厄恩湖的湖泽与岛群之间，疆域即后来的弗马纳郡。它10世纪从更古老的伊赫雷姆坦王国中分出，原属阿吉亚拉霸主联盟；到11世纪末，其国王已统治后来全郡之地。早期国王出自卢甘族的奥希尼、马尔鲁尼和达拉各支，13世纪末马圭尔家族夺取王权，此后除了蒂尔康奈尔的奥唐奈家族几次挑战外，一直掌权到王国终结。马圭尔家族以利斯纳斯基为驻地，加冕土丘设在附近的科尔纳希；1337年，罗德里克·马圭尔统治着一个不受英格兰治安官管辖的王国。这份独立在九年战争中终结：休·马圭尔率弗马纳起兵对抗英格兰统治，他的继承人在1607年的“伯爵出逃”中离开爱尔兰，王国随后被并入爱尔兰王国，改为弗马纳郡。

en: The Fomin-Berezuesk principality was a small Rurikovich appanage of the Smolensk land, centered on the fortified town of Fomin Gorodok on the Vazuza river, in what is now the north-east of the Smolensk region. It split from the Smolensk principality in the first half of the thirteenth century, when it was granted to Yuri, son of the Smolensk prince Konstantin Davydovich, and grew into one of the smallest principalities of Rus. The town of Fomin is first mentioned in writing in 1371. By the fourteenth century the original domain had broken into the Fomin, Berezuy and Rzhev appanages, all held by descendants of the same line, from whom the Rzhevsky boyar family later traced its origin. In the early fifteenth century the Fomin lands were absorbed by the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.
zh: 福明-别列祖斯克公国是斯摩棱斯克领地下属的留里克王朝小封邑，以瓦祖扎河畔的设防城镇福明戈罗多克为中心，地处今斯摩棱斯克州东北部。它在13世纪上半叶从斯摩棱斯克公国分出，封给斯摩棱斯克王公康斯坦丁·达维多维奇之子尤里，后来成为罗斯最小的公国之一。福明镇最早见于1371年的文献记载。到14世纪，原有领地分裂为福明、别列祖伊和勒热夫三个封邑，均由同一家族的后裔统治，后来的勒热夫斯基波雅尔家族便出自这一支。15世纪初，福明诸领地被立陶宛大公国吞并。

en: Fuman is the historic capital of Bia-pas, the western half of Gilan, set in the rice- and silk-growing lowlands west of the Safid Rud. From 660 to 760 it was the seat of the Zoroastrian Dabuyid rulers, and after Gilan's conversion to Islam it became the centre of the Sunni Shafi'ite Eshaqvand dynasty, who ruled all of western Gilan from Fuman from the middle of the thirteenth century. The Ilkhan Öljaitü's campaign of 1306 and 1307 won only nominal submission, and the geographer Hamdallah Mustawfi described Fuman as a large city at the heart of a wealthy region producing wheat, rice and silk. The Eshaqvand rulers kept their autonomy through the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries and briefly acknowledged Ottoman suzerainty in 1534 and 1591, until Jamshid Soltan moved the Bia-pas capital to Rasht in 1572. Shah Abbas I abolished the local dynasties in 1592 and placed Gilan under governors appointed by the Safavid crown.
zh: 富曼是吉兰西半部、萨菲德河以西比亚帕斯地区的历史都城，地处盛产稻米和生丝的低地。660—760年间，它是信奉祆教的达布亚王朝君主的驻地；吉兰改宗伊斯兰后，它又成为持逊尼派沙斐仪教法的埃沙克万德王朝的中心，该王朝自13世纪中叶起在富曼统治整个西吉兰。伊利汗完者都于1306—1307年的远征只换来名义上的臣服；地理学家哈马达拉·穆斯陶菲称富曼是一座大城，位居盛产小麦、稻米和生丝的富庶地区中心。埃沙克万德君主在14、15世纪保持自治，并于1534年和1591年两度短暂承认奥斯曼的宗主权，直到贾姆希德苏丹于1572年把比亚帕斯的都城迁往拉什特。1592年，阿拔斯一世废除地方王朝，吉兰改由萨非王室任命的总督治理。

en: The County of Foix was a Pyrenean fief in southern France, centred on the castle that still dominates the town of Foix in the Ariège valley. Its first count was Roger of Foix, who died around 1064, and his successors were at first vassals of the counts of Toulouse and Barcelona; Count Raymond Roger backed the Cathars in the Albigensian Crusade and temporarily lost his lands to Simon de Montfort before recovering them. In 1290 the counts also acquired the Viscounty of Béarn, which became the centre of their power. In 1337 the ruler was Gaston II, born in 1308, who had succeeded as a child under the regency of his mother Joan of Artois and imprisoned her in the castle of Foix in 1331; through his wife Eleanor of Comminges he claimed Bigorre, and he died at Seville in 1343 after serving at the Siege of Algeciras. His son Gaston III Phoebus, author of the hunting treatise Livre de chasse, ruled until 1391. After a disputed succession the House of Foix-Grailly took over, and its heirs became kings of Navarre; when the last of them inherited the French throne as Henry IV in 1589, Foix was united to the French crown in 1607.
zh: 富瓦伯国是法兰西南部比利牛斯山区的封地，以阿列日河谷中雄踞富瓦城上方的城堡为中心。首任伯爵是约1064年去世的罗歇·德·富瓦，其继任者最初臣属于图卢兹伯爵和巴塞罗那伯爵；伯爵雷蒙·罗歇在阿尔比十字军战争中支持清洁派，领地一度被西蒙·德·孟福尔夺走，后来又被收回。1290年，富瓦伯爵又取得贝阿恩子爵领，那里此后成为他们权势的中心。1337年在位的加斯东二世生于1308年，幼年在母亲阿图瓦的让娜摄政下继位，1331年他把母亲囚禁在富瓦城堡；他凭借妻子科曼日的埃莉诺主张对比戈尔的权利，1343年在参加阿尔赫西拉斯围城战后死于塞维利亚。其子加斯东三世·费比斯著有狩猎专著《狩猎之书》，统治到1391年。经过一场继承纠纷，富瓦-格拉伊家族接管伯国，其继承人后来成为纳瓦拉国王；当最后一位继承人于1589年以亨利四世的身份登上法国王位后，富瓦于1607年并入法兰西王室领地。

en: The Kingdom of France, ruled from Paris, grew out of the West Frankish realm that the Treaty of Verdun assigned to Charles the Bald in 843. The Carolingian line ended in 987, when the magnates elected Hugh Capet, whose Capetian descendants ruled continuously, through the Valois and Bourbon cadet branches, until 1792. Philip II was the first ruler to style himself King of France rather than King of the Franks, and his reign broke the power of the English Plantagenets on the continent. In 1328 the death of Charles IV without a male heir placed Philip VI of Valois on the throne; Edward III of England disputed the succession, opening the Hundred Years' War of 1337 to 1453, from which France emerged with the English holdings reduced to Calais. The Valois then plunged into the Italian Wars of 1494 to 1559, and the later sixteenth century was torn by the Wars of Religion between Catholics and Huguenots, ended by the Edict of Nantes in 1598. Under Louis XIV, who reigned from 1643 to 1715 and built Versailles, the centralized absolute monarchy made France the leading power of Europe, while its colonial empire stretched from New France to the Caribbean and India, though much of the North American territory was lost to Britain by 1763. The French Revolution began in 1789 and the monarchy was abolished in 1792; after the Revolutionary and Napoleonic wars, the Bourbons were restored in 1814 and again after the Hundred Days of 1815.
zh: 法兰西王国以巴黎为统治中心，前身是843年《凡尔登条约》划给秃头查理的西法兰克王国。加洛林王统于987年断绝，贵族选举于格·卡佩为王，他的卡佩家族后裔经瓦卢瓦、波旁等支系统治法兰西，直至1792年。腓力二世是第一个自称法兰西国王而非法兰克人之王的君主，他在位时摧垮了英格兰金雀花家族在大陆的势力。1328年查理四世无男嗣而终，瓦卢瓦的腓力六世继位；英格兰国王爱德华三世争夺继承权，引发1337至1453年的百年战争，法兰西最终获胜，英格兰在大陆的领地只剩加来。此后瓦卢瓦王朝又卷入1494至1559年的意大利战争，16世纪末则深陷天主教徒与胡格诺派之间的宗教战争，直到1598年《南特敕令》颁布才告结束。1643至1715年在位的路易十四修建凡尔赛宫，中央集权的绝对君主制使法兰西成为欧洲首强，其殖民帝国从新法兰西延伸到加勒比和印度，但北美大部分领地在1763年前被不列颠夺取。1789年法国大革命爆发，1792年君主制被废除；历经革命战争与拿破仑战争后，波旁王朝于1814年复辟，并在1815年百日王朝后再度复位。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Freising was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire, a scattered mosaic of small estates reaching from its capital on the Isar in Bavaria to Tyrol, Styria, Carniola and Lower Austria. Saint Corbinian founded a Benedictine abbey there around 724, and Saint Boniface established the diocese in 739; early bishops gathered distant lands such as Innichen in 783, Burgrain in 808 and Bischoflack, the present-day Škofja Loka, granted by Emperor Otto II in 973. The rich County of Werdenfels, with Garmisch and Partenkirchen, followed in the late thirteenth century, and in 1294 the bishop became an imperial prince with a seat in the Imperial Diet. The same prelate ruled a far larger diocese that included Munich, a standing grievance of the Wittelsbach dukes of Bavaria. Freising paid ransom to Gustavus Adolphus in 1632 yet was still sacked, and suffered famine and plague when the Swedes returned in 1646. Its golden age came under Prince-Bishop Johann Franz Ecker von Kapfing, who opened a high school in 1697 and rebuilt the cathedral; the principality was secularised and annexed to Bavaria in 1802 and 1803. Freising also keeps the memory of the Freising Manuscripts, the oldest known text in Slovene, written under Bishop Abraham in the late tenth century.
zh: 弗赖辛主教侯国是神圣罗马帝国的一个教会邦国，领土由零散的小块领地拼成，从伊萨尔河畔的都城所在的巴伐利亚一直延伸到蒂罗尔、施蒂利亚、卡尼鄂拉和下奥地利。圣科尔比尼安约于724年在此创建本笃会修道院，圣博尼法斯于739年建立教区；历任主教陆续取得远方土地：783年获得因尼兴，808年获得布格赖恩，973年皇帝奥托二世赐下卡尼鄂拉的比绍夫拉克，即今什科菲亚洛卡。13世纪末又得到富庶的韦登费尔斯伯国，辖有加米施和帕滕基兴；1294年主教升为帝国王侯，在帝国议会拥有席位。同一位主教还管辖着大得多、连慕尼黑也在其中的教区，这一直让巴伐利亚的维特尔斯巴赫公爵耿耿于怀。1632年弗赖辛向古斯塔夫·阿道夫缴纳赎金仍遭劫掠，1646年瑞典人再犯时又遇上饥荒和瘟疫。它的黄金时代在主教约翰·弗朗茨·埃克尔·冯·卡普芬治下：1697年创办高等学校，重修大教堂；1802至1803年主教侯国被世俗化并并入巴伐利亚。弗赖辛还留有《弗赖辛手稿》的记忆，那是10世纪末亚伯拉罕主教时期写下的现存最古的斯洛文尼亚语文献。

en: In the fourteenth century Frisia was not a monarchy but a network of self-governing communities stretching along the North Sea coast from the Zuiderzee to the Weser. Uniquely in western Europe, feudalism never took root here: there was no prince, no serfdom and no knighthood, and rural communes ran their affairs through public assemblies and elected judges under a system known as the Frisian freedom, which legend traced back to a grant by Charlemagne. The Frisians defended this order in a long series of wars against the counts of Holland, who had already absorbed West Frisia and claimed the title Lord of Frisia; in 1345 the invaders were routed at the Battle of Warns near Stavoren and Count William IV of Holland was killed. From the mid-fourteenth century, however, elected war leaders called hoofdelingen grew into a landed aristocracy and the old equality eroded. In the east the chieftain Ulrich I founded the County of East Frisia in 1464, while in the west civil war between the Schieringer and Vetkoper factions opened the door to the Duke of Saxony, whom the emperor appointed governor in 1498. Saxon rule proved short-lived: the rights were sold to the Habsburgs in 1515, and in 1524 Charles V incorporated the west as the Lordship of Frisia, which joined the Dutch Republic during the revolt against Spain.
zh: 14世纪的弗里西亚并不是一个君主国，而是须德海到威悉河之间北海岸一串自治社群的网络。在西欧绝无仅有的是，封建制度从未在这里扎根：没有诸侯、没有农奴、也没有骑士阶层，乡村公社通过公共集会和民选法官管理事务，这套制度被称为弗里西亚自由，传说其特权来自查理大帝的敕授。弗里斯兰人为保卫这一秩序，同荷兰伯爵进行了一连串战争——荷兰已吞并西弗里斯兰并自称弗里斯兰领主；1345年入侵者在斯塔弗伦附近的瓦恩斯战役中惨败，荷兰伯爵威廉四世阵亡。然而从14世纪中叶起，民选的军事首领霍夫德林根逐渐演变为地产贵族，旧有的平等不断瓦解。东部的首领乌尔里希一世于1464年建立东弗里斯兰伯国；西部希林格派与费特科佩尔派的内战则为萨克森公爵打开大门，皇帝于1498年任命他为总督。萨克森人的统治并不长久，相关权利于1515年被卖给哈布斯堡家族；1524年查理五世把西部整合为弗里斯兰领地，它后来在反抗西班牙的起义中加入尼德兰联省共和国。

en: Fermo sits on a hill in the Marche overlooking the Adriatic, on the site of Firmum Picenum, a Latin colony founded in 264 BC after the Roman conquest of the Picentes. In the eighth century it passed with the Pentapolis to the Holy See and became the chief town of the March of Fermo, its bishops accumulating comital and then princely rights. It made itself a free city in 1199, and its loyalty to the papal cause in the Guelph and Ghibelline wars cost it repeated sieges, including captures by Christian of Mainz in 1176, the Emperor Henry VI in 1192 and Frederick II in 1241. Thereafter a succession of lords, more or less recognised vassals of the papacy, held the city, among them the Monteverde family to which the signore at the start of 1337 belonged, followed by Giovanni Visconti and Francesco Sforza, who was driven out in 1446. Oliverotto Euffreducci seized power in 1495 and was murdered at Cesare Borgia's orders in 1503; his son Ludovico fell at the battle of Montegiorgio in 1520, after which Fermo came under the direct government of the Papal States and remained a provincial capital of the March of Ancona.
zh: 费尔莫坐落在马尔凯大区一座俯瞰亚得里亚海的山丘上，其前身是公元前264年罗马征服皮琴特人后建立的拉丁殖民地皮切努姆的菲尔穆姆。8世纪时，它随五城地区一并划归教廷，成为费尔莫边疆区的首邑，当地主教先后取得伯爵乃至诸侯的权利。1199年它成为自由城市；在圭尔夫与吉伯林战争中，它因站在教皇一边而屡遭围攻，1176年被美因茨的克里斯蒂安、1192年被皇帝亨利六世、1241年被腓特烈二世相继攻占。此后城市先后由多位领主统治，他们大体都是教廷承认的封臣，其中包括1337年开局时执政的蒙泰韦尔德家族，以及后来的乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂和1446年被逐的弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎。奥利韦罗托·欧弗雷杜奇于1495年夺取政权，1503年奉切萨雷·博尔贾之命被谋杀；其子卢多维科1520年战死于蒙泰焦尔焦战役，费尔莫此后由教皇国直接管辖，一直是安科纳边疆区的行省重镇。

en:
Frankfurt grew up at a ford of the Main on the site of a Carolingian royal court, first named in 794 when Charlemagne held a church council there. In 1147 Bernard of Clairvaux preached the Second Crusade in its church, and from the election of Frederick Barbarossa in 1152 it became the customary place where German kings were chosen, a role fixed by the Golden Bull of 1356. Long a self-governing city under imperial protection, it bought the imperial bailiwick and was formally declared a Free Imperial City in 1372. Its trade fairs drew merchants from across Europe, and from the fifteenth to the seventeenth century it hosted Germany's most important book fair.

The city adopted the Lutheran Reformation in 1533, and from 1562 the emperors were crowned in Frankfurt Cathedral instead of Aachen. Guild unrest against the patrician council exploded into the Fettmilch uprising of 1612 to 1614, which ended in a pogrom in the Jewish lane. Frankfurt kept its neutrality through the Thirty Years' War, even when Gustavus Adolphus demanded quarters for his troops, and the Peace of Westphalia confirmed its freedom in 1648. With the collapse of the Empire in 1806 it passed to Karl von Dalberg and became part of the Grand Duchy of Frankfurt in 1810; the Congress of Vienna restored it as a sovereign Free City in 1815 and made it the seat of the German Confederation's diet.
zh:
法兰克福兴起于美因河上的一处渡口，其地原为加洛林王室的行宫，794年查理曼在此召开宗教会议时首次见诸文献。1147年，明谷的伯尔纳在当地教堂鼓动第二次十字军东征；自1152年腓特烈·巴巴罗萨当选以来，这里成为德意志国王选举的惯例地点，1356年的金玺诏书又确认了这一地位。它长期是受皇帝保护的自治城市，1372年买下帝国辖区权后正式成为帝国自由城市。当地的集市吸引了全欧洲的商人，15至17世纪这里还举办德意志最重要的书展。

1533年，城市接受路德宗改革；1562年起，皇帝在法兰克福大教堂而非亚琛加冕。行会对抗贵族市议会的骚动演变为1612至1614年的费特米尔希起义，最终以犹太巷的一场屠杀告终。三十年战争期间，法兰克福保持中立，即便古斯塔夫·阿道夫要求为军队提供驻地也未改其立场，1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》确认了它的自由地位。1806年帝国解体后，它落入卡尔·冯·达尔贝格之手，1810年成为法兰克福大公国的一部分；1815年维也纳会议恢复其主权自由城市地位，并将德意志邦联议会设于此地。
