en: The County of Ferrette, called Pfirt in German, was a feudal lordship of southern Alsace covering much of the Sundgau, with the towns of Ferrette, Altkirch, Thann, Belfort and Rougemont scattered across the southern Vosges and the Burgundian Gate. It took shape in the twelfth century when the old Elsgau district split between the counts of Ferrette and those of Montbéliard, and its rulers, the house of Scarponnois, are recorded from 1105. When Count Ulrich III died without sons in March 1324, his heiress Joanna, born at Basel about 1300, was quickly married to Albert II of Habsburg at Vienna on 26 March; the treaty had been sealed at Thann nine days earlier, and the Prince-Bishop of Basel enfeoffed the Habsburgs with the county in 1325. Joanna ruled the county until her death in 1351 and also became Duchess of Austria, and Ferrette was thereafter administered as part of Further Austria. The Valois dukes of Burgundy long coveted it, and in 1469 Archduke Sigismund mortgaged it, with the Landgraviate of Upper Alsace, to Charles the Bold for 50,000 florins, though it returned to the Habsburgs after Charles's death in 1477. The Peace of Westphalia in 1648 assigned the county to France, which took possession in 1650; in 1659 Louis XIV granted it to Cardinal Mazarin.
zh: 费雷特伯国德语称普法特，是阿尔萨斯南部的封建领地，大体覆盖松德高，费雷特、阿尔特基什、塔恩、贝尔福和鲁日蒙等城镇散布在南孚日山区与勃艮第门之间。12世纪旧埃尔斯加乌区划拆分，费雷特与蒙贝利亚尔两支伯爵分地而立，统治此地的斯卡波努瓦家族自1105年起便有记载。1324年3月乌尔里希三世伯爵无子而终，他的女继承人、约1300年生于巴塞尔的乔安娜很快在3月26日于维也纳嫁给哈布斯堡的阿尔布雷希特二世；相关条约九天前刚在塔恩签署，巴塞尔采邑主教又于1325年把伯国正式封给哈布斯堡家族。乔安娜统治伯国直至1351年去世，同时成为奥地利公爵夫人，费雷特此后作为前奥地利的一部分管理。瓦卢瓦家族的勃艮第公爵对它觊觎已久，1469年奥地利大公西吉斯蒙德以5万弗罗林为押，把它和上阿尔萨斯方伯领地一并抵押给大胆查理；1477年查理死后伯国复归哈布斯堡。1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》把伯国划给法国，法国于1650年实际接管；1659年路易十四又把它赐给红衣主教马扎然。

en: The County of Forez covered the plain of the upper Loire between the Lyonnais and Auvergne, taking its name from Feurs, the Roman forum of the Segusiavi; its counts settled their capital at Montbrison. A comitatus forensis is documented from the tenth century, and from the early twelfth century the county was held by the house of Albon, whose lords long disputed rights over Lyon with its archbishop until an exchange of 1173 left them confined to Forez. In 1337 the count was Guigues VII of Albon, a vassal of the French crown. His son Louis I died fighting the free companies at the Battle of Brignais in 1362, and when the short-lived counts that followed him left no heirs, the county passed in 1372 to Anne Dauphine, whose marriage to Louis II, Duke of Bourbon, carried Forez into the House of Bourbon. It was finally united to the French royal domain in 1531, and later formed the province of Forez.
zh: 福雷伯国据有卢瓦尔河上游的平原，夹在里昂地区与奥弗涅之间，其名得自弗尔——罗马时代塞古西亚维人的集市；伯爵们后来把首府设在蒙布里松。福雷伯国的建制在10世纪已有文献可征，12世纪初起由阿尔邦家族世袭，该家族长期与里昂大主教争夺对里昂的权利，直到1173年双方交换领地，伯爵的势力才被限定在福雷。1337年在位的是阿尔邦家族的吉格七世，为法兰西国王的封臣。他的儿子路易一世于1362年在布里涅战役中讨伐自由佣兵团时阵亡，其后的几位伯爵也都短命无嗣，伯国遂于1372年传给安妮·多菲娜；她嫁给波旁公爵路易二世，福雷由此并入波旁家族的产业。1531年，福雷最终并入法兰西王室领地，后来成为旧制度下的福雷行省。

en: The County of Fürstenberg was a Swabian state of the Holy Roman Empire in the Black Forest and the Baar, near the source of the Danube. It grew from the inheritance of Egino IV, Count of Urach, who acquired large parts of the extinct Duchy of Zähringen when Duke Berthold V died in 1218; the lands were at first called the County of Freiburg, until Egino's grandson Count Henry named himself after his residence at Fürstenberg Castle around 1250. The county was split in 1284, when the lower county of Villingen broke away, and again in 1408 into the Fürstenberg and Wolfach lines, whose branches steadily added the landgraviates of Baar and Stühlingen, the County of Heiligenberg and the Lordship of Meßkirch, as well as Weitra in Austria, acquired in 1607. The Heiligenberg line won princely rank in 1664 and an Imperial Diet vote in 1667; after the other lines had died out, the territories were reunited as the Principality of Fürstenberg in 1744, ruled from Donaueschingen. The Rheinbund Act of 1806 dissolved the state, assigning most of it to Baden and smaller shares to Württemberg, Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen and Bavaria.
zh: 菲尔斯滕贝格伯国是神圣罗马帝国在黑森林与巴尔地区、多瑙河源头附近的一个施瓦本邦国。1218年策林根公爵贝尔托德五世去世后，乌拉赫伯爵埃吉诺四世继承了策林根公国的大片遗产，菲尔斯滕贝格即由此而来；这些领地起初称弗赖堡伯国，直到约1250年，埃吉诺之孙亨利伯爵以自己的驻地菲尔斯滕贝格城堡为家族名号。1284年伯国首次分裂，分出下级的菲林根伯国，1408年又分为菲尔斯滕贝格与沃尔法赫两支。此后各支不断扩张，陆续取得巴尔与施蒂林根两处方伯领、海利根贝格伯国、梅斯基希领地，以及1607年获得的奥地利魏特拉。海利根贝格一支于1664年晋升诸侯，1667年获得帝国议会投票权；其余各支绝嗣后，领地于1744年重新合并为菲尔斯滕贝格亲王国，以多瑙艾辛根为驻地。1806年的《莱茵邦联条约》解散了这个国家，其大部划归巴登，较小部分划归符腾堡、霍亨索伦-锡格马林根和巴伐利亚。

en: Futi was a Jurchen polity on the lower Songhua's southern bank in the Sanjiang plain, centred on the fortified town also recorded as Futiqi, west of present-day Fujin in Heilongjiang. In 1337 its clans lived under Yuan overlordship with the other lower-Songhua tribes. In 1409 the Yongle Emperor split the Futi Guard from the Hurhai Guard and appointed a local chieftain to command it, and Futi officers appear among the Jurchen dignitaries on the Yongning Temple stele erected at the Nurgan headquarters in 1413. Under the Qing the district came under the Ilan Hala commandant in 1715, administered through the three-surname garrison on the lower Songhua.
zh: 弗提是松花江南岸三江平原上的女真政权，治所是又名富提希的城堡，位于今黑龙江省富锦市以西。1337年，其各氏族与松花江下游诸部一样臣属元朝。1409年，永乐帝从忽儿海卫分置弗提卫，任命当地首领为卫指挥；1413年立于黑龙江畔奴儿干驻地的永宁寺碑上，就刻有弗提卫官员的名字。清代这一地区于1715年划归三姓协领，由松花江下游的三姓驻防城管辖。

en: The Fuyu polity took its name from the old kingdom of Fuyu and held the lower Nen River and the Wuyur basin on the northern Songnen plain. In 1389 the Ming dynasty enrolled its Mongol and Tungusic groups as the Fuyu Guard, one of the Three Uriankhai Guards, a loose tribal command whose chiefs claimed descent from Temuge, youngest brother of Chinggis Khan. Pressed by the Eastern Mongols and the Oirats, the guard moved south after the Xuande and Zhengtong reigns of 1426–1449 into the Liaodong marches around Liaoyang, Shenyang, Tieling and Kaiyuan. In 1424 the Khorchin, defeated by the Oirat leader Toghon, sought shelter with Fuyu, and command passed from the Odchigin line to the Khasar line. Fuyu groups later joined Mongol raids on the Ming border and were absorbed by the Khorchin in the mid-sixteenth century.
zh: 福余因古夫余国故地得名，据有松嫩平原北部的嫩江下游与乌裕尔河流域。1389年，明朝将当地蒙古、通古斯部落编为福余卫，为兀良哈三卫之一，属羁縻卫所，其首领自称是成吉思汗之弟铁木哥斡赤斤的后裔。因受东蒙古和瓦剌逼迫，宣德、正统年间（1426—1449）以后福余卫南迁至辽阳、沈阳、铁岭、开原一带。1424年科尔沁部被瓦剌首领脱欢击败后投奔福余卫，卫中首领之位自此由斡赤斤系转入哈萨尔系。此后福余诸部参与蒙古各部对明朝辽东边境的侵扰，16世纪中叶被科尔沁部吞并。

en: Fezzan is the desert region of south-western Libya, where chains of oases such as Murzuk, Sabha and Zella support settled life deep in the Sahara and control the trans-Saharan trade routes. In antiquity it was the country of the Garamantes, who ran the caravan trade between Carthage and Rome and the Sahelian lands to the south from the fifth century BCE to the fifth century CE. Arab armies conquered it in the seventh century, and during the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries it fell under the Kanem Empire, whose power reached as far north as Zella; in 1337 it therefore appears as a dependency ruled from the Lake Chad basin. After wars with Kanem-Bornu in the early sixteenth century the Awlad Muhammad dynasty made Murzuk its capital and ruled the oases until the Ottoman Turks from Tripoli occupied Fezzan in 1574, after which its rulers governed as vassals of the sultan with only intermittent Ottoman interference.
zh: 费赞是今利比亚西南部的沙漠地区，迈尔祖格、塞卜哈、宰拉等一连串绿洲让人得以在撒哈拉腹地定居，并控制着跨撒哈拉商路。上古时代这里是加拉曼特人的国度，公元前5世纪到公元5世纪间，他们经营着迦太基、罗马与南方萨赫勒地区之间的驼队贸易。7世纪阿拉伯军队征服此地；13至14世纪，费赞落入卡涅姆帝国之手，其势力北抵宰拉，因此1337年它表现为受乍得湖盆地政权统辖的附庸。16世纪初，在与卡涅姆-博尔努的战争之后，奥拉德·穆罕默德王朝以迈尔祖格为都统治诸绿洲，直到1574年来自的黎波里的奥斯曼土耳其人占领费赞；此后其统治者以苏丹附庸的身份治理地方，奥斯曼中央只偶尔插手。

en: Fuzhou was the native Zhuang subprefecture covering present-day Funing County in southeastern Yunnan, set up by the Yuan in 1276 under the Guangnan West Route commission. In 1383 the Ming merged the neighboring Luozuo and Anning subprefectures into it, placing Fuzhou under Guangnan Prefecture with its seat at Puting; during the Chongzhen reign the chief's seat was moved to Guichao.
zh: 富州是管辖今云南东南富宁县一带的壮族土州，1276年元朝置州，属广南西路宣抚司。1383年明朝把相邻的罗佐、安宁两州并入富州，改属广南府，州治设在普厅；崇祯年间土州治所又迁往归朝。

en:
Gaur, also called Lakhnauti, was a walled capital on the Ganges in western Bengal and the seat of rulers from the age of the Gauda kingdom. In the seventh century Shashanka founded the Gauda kingdom there, the Pala emperors afterwards styled themselves Lords of Gauda, and under the Sena dynasty the city was renamed Lakhnauti after King Lakshman Sena. Bakhtiyar Khalji conquered it in 1203 and made it the seat of Delhi's governors of Bengal; Nasiruddin Bughra Khan briefly ruled it as an independent king from 1281 before the province returned to Delhi. In 1337 the governor Qadar Khan still held the city for the Delhi sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq.

After Qadar Khan's death his officer Alauddin Ali Shah seized Lakhnauti, until Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah overthrew him in 1342 and united Bengal into an independent sultanate in 1352. The first capital was Pandua, but Sultan Mahmud Shah moved the court back to Gaur in 1453; for more than a century the city flourished with mosques, palaces and Portuguese merchants, who compared its wealth to Lisbon's. Humayun occupied it and renamed it Jannatabad, Sher Shah Suri sacked it, and a Mughal army under Munim Khan took it in 1575. Plague and the shifting course of the Ganges then emptied the city, leaving its walls and the Great Golden Mosque of 1526 as ruins.
zh:
高达又称拉克瑙提，是孟加拉西部恒河畔的设防都城，早在高达王国时代便是君王驻地。7世纪设赏伽在此建立高达王国，后来的波罗王朝君主自称高达之主，犀那王朝时该城依国王拉克什曼·犀那之名改称拉克瑙提。1203年巴赫蒂亚尔·卡尔吉攻克此城，将其作为德里派驻孟加拉的总督驻地；1281年纳绥鲁丁·布格拉汗曾在此独立称王，后来孟加拉又重归德里管辖。1337年，总督卡达尔汗仍为德里苏丹穆罕默德·图格鲁克镇守这座城市。

卡达尔汗死后，他的部将阿拉乌丁·阿里沙占据拉克瑙提，1342年被沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯·沙推翻；后者于1352年统一孟加拉，建立独立的苏丹国。苏丹国最初定都潘杜阿，1453年马哈茂德沙把朝廷迁回高达。此后百余年间，城中清真寺与宫殿林立，葡萄牙商人往来不绝，甚至把它的富庶比作里斯本。胡马雍一度占领该城并改名詹纳塔巴德，舍尔沙又将其洗劫，1575年穆尼姆汗率莫卧儿军队将其攻取。随后瘟疫流行，加上恒河改道，城市逐渐荒废，只留下城墙和1526年的大金清真寺等遗迹。

en: Gazaria was the name given to the Genoese trading colonies strung along the Crimean peninsula and the Black Sea coast, ruled from the great port of Kaffa in the Crimea. Genoa won exclusive Black Sea trading rights from the Byzantine emperor in 1261, and Kaffa itself was granted to Genoese merchants in 1266; other settlements included Vosporo in the Crimea and Tana at the mouth of the Don. Administered by an elected consul and the eight-man Officium Gazarie, with its laws codified in the Liber Gazarie of 1341, the colony grew rich on silk, grain and slaves shipped west through the Bosphorus. Kaffa was stormed by the Golden Horde in 1308 and recovered only in 1313, and a second Mongol siege in 1347 became famous when Genoese ships fleeing the plague carried the Black Death into the Mediterranean. After the fall of Constantinople in 1453 Genoa handed Gazaria to its Bank of Saint George, but the Ottomans took Kaffa in 1475 and ended Genoese rule on the Black Sea.
zh: 加扎里亚是热那亚人在克里米亚半岛和黑海沿岸建立的一系列贸易殖民地的统称，以克里米亚的大港卡法为统治中心。1261年，热那亚从拜占庭皇帝手中取得黑海贸易特权，卡法本身于1266年被授予热那亚商人；其他殖民点还包括克里米亚的沃斯波罗和顿河河口的塔纳。殖民地由民选执政官和八人组成的加扎里亚公署治理，法律于1341年汇编为《加扎里亚法典》，依靠经博斯普鲁斯海峡西运的丝绸、粮食和奴隶贸易致富。1308年金帐汗国攻陷卡法，热那亚直到1313年才将其收回；1347年蒙古人再度围城，逃离瘟疫的热那亚船只把黑死病带入地中海，此役因此闻名。1453年君士坦丁堡陷落后，热那亚把加扎里亚移交圣乔治银行，但奥斯曼人于1475年攻占卡法，终结了热那亚在黑海的统治。

en: The Principality of Grubenhagen, also called Brunswick-Grubenhagen, was the smallest Welf subdivision of the Duchy of Brunswick-Lüneburg, lying on the south-western edge of the Harz. It was split off from Brunswick in 1291 when the sons of Albert the Tall divided their inheritance, the first ruler being Duke Henry the Admirable, whose seat was Grubenhagen Castle near Einbeck. In 1322 his sons partitioned the tiny state again, and in 1337 Henry II held the Einbeck portion, which also included Duderstadt and Herzberg; the continuing fragmentation left the line weak beside its Wolfenbüttel, Lüneburg and Calenberg cousins, and one younger son, Otto, sought his fortune in Italy, where he married Queen Joan I of Naples in 1376. Duderstadt was ceded to Mainz in 1366. The scattered lands were reunited under Duke Philip I in 1526, but when his son Philip II died in 1596 the Grubenhagen line became extinct. An Imperial Chamber Court ruling of 1617 awarded the territory to the Lüneburg branch, and from 1665 it was ruled by the Calenberg dukes, surviving only formally as an imperial estate until 1806.
zh: 格鲁本哈根侯国又称不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根，是韦尔夫家族不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公国最小的支系领地，地处哈茨山西南麓。1291年高个子阿尔贝特的诸子分割遗产时，它从不伦瑞克分出，首任统治者是公爵亨利，居所为艾恩贝克附近的格鲁本哈根城堡。1322年他的儿子们再次瓜分这个小邦，1337年亨利二世领有包括杜德施塔特和黑尔茨贝格在内的艾恩贝克部分；不断的析产使该支系在沃尔芬比特尔、吕讷堡和卡伦贝格诸堂兄弟面前势单力薄，其中幼子奥托远赴意大利求发展，于1376年娶那不勒斯女王乔安娜一世为妻。1366年杜德施塔特被割让给美因茨。1526年菲利普一世公爵重新统一了这些分散的领地，但他的儿子菲利普二世于1596年去世后，格鲁本哈根支系绝嗣。1617年帝国枢密法院裁定将其判给吕讷堡支系，1665年起由卡伦贝格诸公爵统治，仅作为帝国等级名义上存续到1806年。

en: Gabès, the ancient Tacapae, lies on the Gulf of Gabès at the edge of a coastal oasis where the road from Tunis runs south into the Jabal Nafusa and Tripolitania. A Carthaginian foundation and then a Roman trading colony and bishopric, it was conquered with the rest of Ifriqiya in the seventh century, and the Prophet's companion Abu Lubaba al-Ansari is honoured there as its patron. After the Hilalian invasions an Arab dynasty, the Banu Jami', ruled Gabès from about 1096 until the Almohads overthrew it in 1159. Under Hafsid overlordship the local Banu Makki family secured the governorship in 1282 and built an effectively independent power, holding not only Gabès and the Berber hill country of the Jabal Nafusa but also Sfax, Djerba, Tripoli and, from 1380, the Jerid oases of Gafsa and Tozeur. The Hafsid sultan Abu al-Abbas Ahmad II broke their power at the Battle of Gabès in 1387 and restored direct rule by 1394. Praised by al-Idrisi for its orchards and markets and called Little Damascus by the traveller al-Tijani, Gabès passed to the Ottomans with the rest of Tunisia in 1574.
zh: 加贝斯古称塔卡佩，濒临加贝斯湾，地处一片沿海绿洲的边缘，从突尼斯南下奈富塞山和的黎波里塔尼亚的道路由此经过。它先是迦太基人的据点，后成为罗马贸易殖民城和主教区，7世纪随伊弗里基亚一起被阿拉伯征服，先知的伙伴阿布·卢巴巴·安萨里在这里被尊为守护者。希拉尔入侵之后，阿拉伯的巴努贾米王朝约从1096年起统治加贝斯，1159年被穆瓦希德人推翻。在哈夫斯王朝宗主权下，本地的巴努马基家族于1282年取得总督之位，建立起事实上独立的政权，不仅领有加贝斯和柏柏尔人的奈富塞山地，还控制了斯法克斯、杰尔巴岛、的黎波里，并在1380年夺取加夫萨、托泽尔等杰里德绿洲。哈夫斯苏丹阿布·阿拔斯·艾哈迈德二世在1387年的加贝斯战役中击垮其势力，到1394年恢复直接统治。加贝斯的果园和市场闻名于中世纪旅人，伊德里西曾盛赞它，旅行家提贾尼则称它为‘小大马士革’；1574年它随突尼斯一并归入奥斯曼版图。

en: Cuauhchinanco, whose Nahuatl name means within a wall of trees, was a Nahua altepetl in the forested Sierra Norte de Puebla, on the route between the Mexican highlands and the Gulf lowlands. Chichimeca followers of Nopaltzin settled the valley between 1116 and 1121 and built a dominion there, and in the fifteenth century the Acolhua king Nezahualcoyotl of Texcoco conquered it and installed his calpixque tribute stewards. As an Aztec tributary province it sent servants to the palaces of Texcoco, provisioned Mexica armies marching against the Huastecs, and ruled over either thirty-five or sixty-four subject towns; during the reign of Ahuitzotl, from 1486 to 1502, its lord was Xochitl Tecuhtli. Its court produced the poet Tlaltecatzin, who sang at Texcoco in the days of Techotlalatzin. After the Spanish conquest it was granted as an encomienda to Juan de Jaso and kept that status into the eighteenth century, passing to the province of Puebla in 1792.
zh: 夸乌奇南科是林木茂密的普埃布拉北部山区中的一座纳瓦城邦，纳瓦特尔语名称意为“树墙之内”，扼守墨西哥高原与海湾低地之间的通道。1116至1121年间，诺帕尔辛率领的奇奇梅克人进入山谷建立领地；15世纪，特斯科科的阿科尔瓦国王内萨瓦尔科约特尔将其征服，派去卡尔皮斯克贡赋官。作为阿兹特克的纳贡省，它向特斯科科的宫殿输送仆役，为征讨瓦斯特克人的墨西卡军队提供粮草，并统辖着35座或64座属城；1486至1502年奥伊佐特在位时，当地君主是索奇特尔·特库特利。这座城邦还走出了诗人特拉尔特卡钦，他在特乔特拉拉钦时代的特斯科科宫廷吟诗作歌。西班牙征服后，此地被封给胡安·德·哈索作为监护领地，这一身份一直保持到18世纪，1792年划入普埃布拉省。

en: The Godara were a Jat clan whose chieftaincy lay in Jangladesh, the dry country of northern Rajasthan around modern Bikaner. Between the tenth and twelfth centuries the Jats of this region lived under their own chiefs and their own customs, while Bhati Rajputs held much of the north and west. The Godara state kept its seat at Shekhsar, where the chief Pandu Godara is said to have ruled over seven hundred villages. In the fifteenth century a feud with neighbouring Jat rulers drove Pandu to seek the help of Rao Bika, son of the Rathore chief Rao Jodha of Marwar. Bika's coalition of Rathores, Charans and Godara Jats conquered Jangladesh and founded Bikaner, its city established in 1488; Pandu ceded his lands to the Rathores, ending Jat rule in the region and bringing the Godara under the new state of Bikaner.
zh: 果达拉人是贾特人的一支，其首领领地位于禅伽罗德什，即今拉贾斯坦北部比卡内尔一带的干旱地区。10至12世纪间，这一地区的贾特人在本族首领和本族习俗下自治，而巴蒂拉杰普特人控制着北部和西部的大片土地。果达拉政权以谢赫萨尔为治所，据说首领潘杜·果达拉统辖着七百个村庄。15世纪，与邻近贾特诸首领的仇争迫使潘杜向马尔瓦尔拉托尔首领拉奥·乔达之子拉奥·比卡求援。比卡率领拉托尔人、查兰人与果达拉贾特人的联军征服禅伽罗德什并建立比卡内尔，城池于1488年动工；潘杜将土地割让给拉托尔人，贾特人在当地的统治就此终结，果达拉人归入新兴的比卡内尔邦。

en: Gedi was a Swahili stone town set in the forest behind the Kenyan coast near Malindi, whose coral ruins preserve one of the best-preserved medieval settlements of the Swahili world. Founded around the eleventh century, it grew behind inner and outer walls into a grid of stone mosques, a palace, pillar tombs and merchants' houses, and reached its peak of population and wealth in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries. Imports dug from its floors, Chinese celadon and blue-and-white porcelain, Islamic glazed ware, beads and two Chinese coins, show its share in the Indian Ocean trade, and an inscribed pillar tomb bears the date 1399. Gedi left no recorded dynasty and is known almost entirely from archaeology. Its decline came quickly: Portuguese efforts to monopolize coastal trade, a falling water table, the Wazimba raid of 1589 and raids by migrating Oromo from Somalia emptied the town, which was abandoned by the middle of the seventeenth century.
zh: 格迪是一座斯瓦希里石城，隐于肯尼亚沿海马林迪附近的林中，其珊瑚石废墟是斯瓦希里世界保存最完好的中世纪聚落之一。它约建于11世纪，在内墙与外墙之内发展出由石砌清真寺、宫殿、柱墓和商人宅邸组成的网格城市，人口与财富在15至16世纪达到顶峰。遗址中出土的中国青瓷和青花瓷、伊斯兰釉陶、串珠乃至两枚中国钱币，表明它参与了印度洋贸易；一座刻有铭文的柱墓标注着1399年。格迪没有留下王朝记载，世人几乎全凭考古了解它。它的衰落十分迅速：葡萄牙人对沿海贸易的垄断、地下水位下降、1589年的瓦津巴人袭击，以及来自索马里的奥罗莫人迁徙与劫掠，使该城人口流散，到17世纪中叶已遭废弃。

en: Guelders grew from a county on the Lower Maas, first documented around 1096 when Gerard III of Wassenberg styled himself Count of Guelders; in 1127 his son acquired the County of Zutphen by marriage. Loans to the Bishop of Utrecht and the Count of Holland brought in the Veluwe and Nijmegen, while defeat at the Battle of Worringen in 1288 ended its claim to Limburg. Four river-separated quarters centered on Geldern, Zutphen, Arnhem and Nijmegen made up its territory. In 1337 it was held by Reginald II of the House of Wassenberg, raised to duke by Emperor Louis IV in 1339. When the Wassenberg line died out in 1371, the War of the Guelders Succession ended in victory for William of Jülich, who united Guelders and Jülich in 1393. The House of Egmond took over in 1423, but Charles the Bold of Burgundy bought the succession in 1473, and after 1477 the duchy passed to the Habsburgs. Charles of Egmond, ransomed by his townsmen in 1492, ruled as the last independent duke and long defied Emperor Charles V, until the Treaty of Venlo in 1543 surrendered Guelders to the Habsburgs, who folded it into the Seventeen Provinces in 1549. During the Dutch Revolt the three northern quarters joined the United Provinces, while Upper Guelders stayed Spanish until the Treaty of Utrecht in 1713 partitioned it among Prussia, the Dutch Republic, Austria and Jülich; French armies overran the region in 1795.
zh: 海尔雷起源于马斯河下游的一个伯国，约1096年瓦森贝格的格哈德三世首次自称海尔雷伯爵；1127年他的儿子通过联姻取得聚特芬伯国。靠向乌得勒支主教和荷兰伯爵放贷，海尔雷取得费吕沃和奈梅亨，而1288年沃林根战役的失败使其对林堡的继承权落空。领地由盖尔登、聚特芬、阿纳姆和奈梅亨四个被河流隔开的区组成。1337年在位的是瓦森贝格家族的雷金纳德二世，路易四世皇帝于1339年升他为公爵。1371年瓦森贝格支绝嗣，海尔雷继承战争最终以于利希的威廉获胜告终，他于1393年将海尔雷与于利希合并。1423年埃格蒙特家族接手，但勃艮第的大胆查理于1473年买下继承权，1477年后公国转入哈布斯堡手中。1492年被市民赎回的埃格蒙特的查理成为末代独立公爵，长期对抗查理五世皇帝，直到1543年《芬洛条约》把海尔雷割让给哈布斯堡，后者又于1549年将其并入十七省。尼德兰革命期间，北方三区加入联省共和国，上海尔雷则留在西班牙旗下，直到1713年《乌得勒支和约》把它分给普鲁士、荷兰共和国、奥地利和于利希；1795年法军席卷这一地区。

en: Genoa grew from a small Ligurian port, sacked by a Fatimid fleet in 934 to 935, into the self-governing Compagna Communis of the eleventh century, one of the great maritime republics. Its galleys served in the Crusades and built a chain of trading colonies across the Mediterranean and the Black Sea, among them Caffa in the Crimea from 1266 and the islands of Chios and Lesbos. Victory over Pisa at the Battle of Meloria in 1284 made Genoa mistress of the Tyrrhenian Sea, and from 1347 it held Corsica, though its long commercial duel with Venice ended in defeat at Chioggia in 1380. In 1339 the city chose its first doge, an office that became the prize of rival merchant clans such as the Doria, Spinola, Fieschi and Grimaldi. Andrea Doria's reform of the constitution in 1528 settled an oligarchic order with two-year doges, and Genoa remade itself as a banking power, its houses financing the Spanish Empire. Revolt drove it to sell Corsica to France in 1768, and in 1797 Napoleon overthrew the republic and set up the Ligurian Republic, which France annexed in 1805. A brief restoration in 1814 ended when the Congress of Vienna assigned Genoa to the Kingdom of Sardinia in 1815.
zh: 热那亚本是利古里亚的一座小港，934至935年曾遭法蒂玛舰队洗劫，11世纪发展为自治的“公社联合体”，跻身伟大的海上共和国之列。它的桨帆船参加十字军东征，并在地中海和黑海沿岸建起一连串贸易殖民地，包括1266年起占有的克里米亚卡法，以及希俄斯岛和莱斯沃斯岛。1284年热那亚在梅洛里亚海战中击败比萨，成为第勒尼安海的霸主；1347年起它据有科西嘉岛，但与威尼斯的长期商战以1380年基奥贾战败告终。1339年该城选出首任总督，这一职位后来成为多里亚、斯皮诺拉、菲耶斯基和格里马尔迪等商人世家角逐的目标。1528年安德烈亚·多里亚改革宪法，确立了总督任期两年的寡头体制；热那亚由此转型为金融强国，当地银行家族为西班牙帝国提供资金。后来的起义迫使它在1768年把科西嘉卖给法国，1797年拿破仑推翻共和国、另立利古里亚共和国，又于1805年将其并入法国。1814年共和国短暂复辟，1815年维也纳会议将热那亚划归撒丁王国。

en: The Kingdom of Georgia arose around 1008, when Bagrat III united the Iberian and Abkhazian realms under the Bagrationi dynasty, in a land whose kings had accepted Christianity as early as the fourth century. David IV threw off Seljuk overlordship and built a pan-Caucasian empire after his victory at Didgori in 1121, and under Queen Tamar, who reigned from 1184 to 1213, Georgia became the leading Christian power of the Near East, sponsoring the foundation of the Empire of Trebizond. The Mongols reduced it to tributary status in the 1240s, but George V the Brilliant expelled the Mongol garrisons in the 1330s and restored a strong, united kingdom with its capital at Tbilisi. The Black Death of 1346 and Timur's repeated campaigns between 1386 and 1403 then broke its power, and after Turkmen invasions the realm split in 1490 into the kingdoms of Kartli, Kakheti and Imereti. Divided by the 1555 Peace of Amasya between Safavid and Ottoman spheres, the eastern lands were reunited by Heraclius II in 1762; his Treaty of Georgievsk of 1783 made Kartli-Kakheti a Russian protectorate, and after the Qajar sack of Tbilisi in 1795 Russia annexed the kingdom outright in 1801, followed by Imereti in 1810.
zh: 格鲁吉亚王国形成于1008年前后，巴格拉季奥尼王朝的巴格拉特三世将伊比利亚与阿布哈兹诸领地合为一体，而当地国王早在4世纪就已皈依基督教。大卫四世摆脱塞尔柱宗主权，1121年在迪德格里之战获胜后建立起横跨高加索的帝国；1184至1213年塔玛尔女王在位期间，格鲁吉亚成为近东首屈一指的基督教强国，还扶植建立了特拉比松帝国。13世纪40年代蒙古人将其降为附庸，但“明君”乔治五世在14世纪30年代驱逐蒙古驻军，以第比利斯为都重建了统一强盛的王国。1346年的黑死病和1386至1403年帖木儿的反复征伐摧毁了它的国力，土库曼人入侵之后，王国于1490年分裂为卡特利、卡赫季和伊梅列季三个王国。1555年的《阿马西亚和约》将其划入萨法维与奥斯曼两大势力范围；东部诸地于1762年由伊拉克略二世重新统一，他在1783年签订《格奥尔基耶夫斯克条约》，使卡特利-卡赫季成为俄国保护国。1795年卡扎尔军队洗劫第比利斯后，俄国于1801年直接吞并该王国，伊梅列季也在1810年被并入俄国。

en: Gafsa, the ancient Capsa in the oases of the Tunisian Jerid, was a Numidian stronghold where Jugurtha kept his treasure before the Romans under Marius stormed it in 106 BC. Rebuilt as a Roman colonia and later a Byzantine fortress, it was taken by the Arab conqueror Uqba ibn Nafi in 688, and a Latin-speaking Berber population survived there into the thirteenth century. In the eleventh century, as the Banu Hilal overran Ifriqiya, its governor Abdullah ibn al-Rand made himself independent in 1053, and Tozeur, Nefta and the whole Jerid pledged him allegiance; the Banu al-Rand brought the oasis towns a political and economic revival until the Almohad caliph Abd al-Mu'min received the city's surrender in 1159 and crushed an attempt to restore the dynasty in 1168. Under the later Hafsids of Tunis the south remained restive, and the Arab Banu Yamlul held Gafsa in revolt until a Hafsid army retook it in the siege of 1344. The oasis grew dates, henna and cotton, and its fifteenth-century kasbah rose on Byzantine foundations; after the Ottoman conquest of 1574 Gafsa became a provincial garrison on the desert road.
zh: 加夫萨古称卡普萨，坐落于突尼斯杰里德地区的绿洲群中，古时是努米底亚重镇，朱古达曾把财宝藏在这里，公元前106年罗马将领马略攻陷该城。它后来重建为罗马殖民城，又成为拜占庭要塞，688年被阿拉伯征服者乌格巴·伊本·纳菲攻取，当地讲拉丁语的柏柏尔居民一直存续到13世纪。11世纪希拉尔部落席卷伊弗里基亚时，加夫萨总督阿卜杜拉·伊本·兰德于1053年自立，托泽尔、内夫塔和整个杰里德都向他效忠，巴努兰德王朝为绿洲城镇带来政治与经济的复兴，直到1159年穆瓦希德哈里发阿卜杜勒·穆明接受该城投降，并在1168年镇压了复辟该王朝的尝试。此后在突尼斯哈夫斯王朝治下，南方依旧不安分，阿拉伯的巴努亚姆卢勒部落起兵占据加夫萨，哈夫斯军队在1344年的围攻中将其收复。绿洲出产椰枣、指甲花和棉花，15世纪修建的城堡矗立在拜占庭城墙的地基上；1574年奥斯曼征服后，加夫萨成为沙漠商路上的行省驻军城镇。

en: Guangxi is a karst highland region of eastern Yunnan, between Qujing and the border of the southern province of the same name, with which it must not be confused. Under the Dali kingdom its valleys were held by several of the thirty-seven eastern tribes, among them the Jilu at present-day Luxi and the Weimo at Qiubei, whose chiefs took part in the Shicheng alliance of 971. The Mongols formed the territory into Guangxi Route in 1276, and the Ming made it Guangxi Prefecture in 1382, with its seat at Luxi; Shizong, Mile and Weimo were among the subprefectures under its charge, and Qiubei was administered through Weimo. In 1731 the Qing posted an assistant subprefect at Qiubei to tighten control of the hill country, and in 1770 the prefecture was reduced to the Guangxi Independent Subprefecture.
zh: 广西是云南东部的喀斯特高原地区，在曲靖与同名南方省份的边界之间，二者并非一地。大理国时，这里的河谷分属滇东三十七部中的数部，包括治今泸西的际鹿部和治今丘北的维摩部，其酋长参加了971年的石城会盟。1276年元朝将这一带设为广西路，1382年明朝改为广西府，府治在泸西，师宗、弥勒、维摩等州都在其管辖之下，丘北则由维摩州经管。1731年清朝在丘北派驻州同，以加强对山区的控制；1770年广西府降为广西直隶州。

en: Ghana, called Wagadu by its Soninke founders, was the first great empire of the western Sahel, ruling the edge of the Sahara from its capital Koumbi Saleh. Arab writers first noted its dynasty in 830, and its kings, titled Ghana or Kaya Maghan, grew rich by taxing the salt and gold caravans that crossed the desert; in 990 Ghana seized the trading town of Awdaghust. Al-Bakri described Koumbi Saleh around 1068 as two towns ten kilometres apart, one royal and one Muslim, filled with scholars and merchants. The Almoravids took Awdaghust in 1054, and a long-disputed tradition dates an Almoravid sack of the capital to 1076; drought and the southward shift of trade then eroded its power. Ghana later fell under the Sosso of Soumaoro Kante, until his defeat by Sundiata Keita at Kirina in 1235, after which the ruler Soumaba Cisse joined the rising Mali Empire. By 1337 Ghana survived as a vassal kingdom inside Mali, still prestigious: around 1340 al-Umari recorded that its ruler was the only subject king allowed to keep the title malik, though Koumbi Saleh itself was abandoned in the 1400s.
zh: 加纳被它的索宁克建立者称为瓦加杜，是萨赫勒西部第一个大帝国，以沙漠边缘的昆比萨利赫为都统治一方。阿拉伯作家在830年首次记载它的王朝；其国王称号为加纳或卡亚·马甘，靠向穿越沙漠的盐队和金队征税致富，并于990年夺取商镇奥达古斯特。约1068年，巴克里笔下的昆比萨利赫是相距十公里的双城，一为王城，一为穆斯林城，学者与商贾云集。穆拉比特人于1054年攻占奥达古斯特，一个长期有争议的说法称其在1076年洗劫了加纳都城；此后干旱和商路南移不断侵蚀它的国力。加纳一度落入苏毛罗·坎特的索索之手，直到1235年松迪亚塔·凯塔在基里纳战役中取胜，君主苏马巴·西塞遂加入崛起的马里帝国。到1337年，加纳作为马里境内的附庸王国存续，声望犹存：约1340年，欧麦里记载它的君主是唯一获准保留马利克称号的属国国王，不过昆比萨利赫城本身在15世纪已遭废弃。

en: Gohilvad was the land of the Gohil Rajputs, a Suryavanshi clan tracing its line to the Guhilas of Mewar, on the eastern side of the Saurashtra peninsula in what is now Gujarat. Their ancestor Sejakji migrated into Saurashtra around the turn of the thirteenth century, took service with the Chudasama kings of Junagadh and founded Sejakpur, while his descendant Ranoji built Ranpur and took Vala with Koli help. In 1337 the chief was Ranoji's son Mokhdaji, who had seized Umrala and the port of Ghogha, conquered Piram Island in the Gulf of Cambay and turned to sea-raiding; his piracy drew the wrath of the Delhi Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq, who killed him in battle and took Ghogha and Piram in 1347. Mokhdaji's son Dungarji was later reinstated at Ghogha, and Visoji captured Sihor and fortified it as the clan's capital. The Gohils prospered under the long line of chiefs that followed until Bhavsinhji moved the seat to the new city of Bhavnagar in 1723, the region around it keeping the name Gohilvad.
zh: 格锡瓦德是戈希尔拉杰普特人的地盘，位于今古吉拉特萨乌拉施特拉半岛东岸；戈希尔人属日族世系，自称源自梅瓦尔的古希拉王朝。先祖塞贾吉约在13世纪之交迁入萨乌拉施特拉，投效朱纳格特的珠多娑摩诸王，建立塞贾克布尔；后裔拉诺吉修筑兰布尔，并在科利人帮助下夺取瓦拉。1337年在位的是拉诺吉之子莫克达吉，他攻占乌姆拉拉和戈加港，又征服坎贝湾中的皮拉姆岛，干起海上劫掠的营生；海盗行径激怒了德里苏丹穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克，后者在1347年的激战中将他击杀，夺取戈加和皮拉姆。莫克达吉之子东加尔吉后来被放回戈加复位，维索吉则攻取锡霍尔、筑城为都。此后戈希尔首领世代相传，日渐强盛，1723年巴夫辛吉迁都新建的巴夫纳加尔城，周围地区也一直保留着格锡瓦德之名。

en: Garha, later called Garha-Mandla or Garha Katanga, was the first large kingdom built by the RajGond people in central India, covering the Narmada valley and the Satpura hills around Garha and Mandla. Its first Gond king, Jadurai, took power by deposing the Kalachuri rulers whose court he had served, and the small early state was enlarged by Kharji, who built up its army between 1440 and 1460. Its greatest ruler Sangram Shah conquered the Narmada valley, Bhopal, Sagar and Damoh, secured his realm with fifty-two hill forts called garhs, ruled from Singhorgarh, and was a Sanskrit scholar and author. His daughter-in-law Rani Durgavati, a Chandela princess, moved the capital to Chouragarh, defeated the last Malwa sultan Baz Bahadur, and fell fighting the Mughal army sent by Akbar at the Battle of Narrai in 1564. Restored to the Gond raja Chandra Shah as a Mughal fief, the kingdom slowly declined: the Maratha Peshwa reduced it to tribute in 1742, the Sagar Marathas annexed it in 1781, and after rule by the Bhonsles of Nagpur it passed to the British in 1818.
zh: 加尔哈，后称加尔哈-门德拉或加尔哈卡坦加，是拉杰贡德人在中印度建立的第一个大王国，据有讷尔默达河谷与萨特普拉山区，以加尔哈和门德拉为中心。第一代贡德国王贾杜赖本在卡拉丘里王朝宫中效力，后来推翻旧主自立；早期邦国狭小，1440至1460年间在位的卡尔吉扩军拓土。最杰出的君主桑格拉姆沙征服了讷尔默达河谷、博帕尔、萨格尔和达莫，以五十二座被称为加尔的山寨拱卫疆土，定都辛格奥加尔，他还精通梵文、勤于著述。他的儿媳杜尔加瓦蒂是昌德拉王族之女，迁都乔拉加尔，曾击败马尔瓦末代苏丹巴兹·巴哈杜尔，又在1564年的纳赖之战中迎击阿克巴派来的莫卧儿大军，最终战死。王国后来交还贡德罗阇旃陀罗沙，作为莫卧儿封国延续，国势却日渐衰微：1742年马拉塔佩什瓦将其降为纳贡国，1781年萨格尔马拉塔人将其吞并，历经那格浦尔邦斯勒家族统治后，于1818年转入英国之手。

en: The Gilemi, whose Manchu-Chinese name was rendered Gilyak by Russian explorers, were the fishing people of the lower Amur and northern Sakhalin now usually called Nivkh. Chinese records knew them as the Jilimi under the Jin and as Jilimi, Qiliebin or Jiliemie under the Yuan, before the Qing termed them Fiyaka; they lived by fishing, sea-mammal hunting and dog rearing, moving between summer coasts and winter rivers, and practised shamanism centred on the bear festival. After 1291 the Yuan placed a military command at Nurgan near the Amur mouth, partly to check Sakhalin raiders who crossed the sea to plunder the Gilemi. Under the Ming the Nurgan commission of 1409 enrolled their chiefs, and when the Gilemi destroyed the Yongning Temple built there in 1413, the eunuch Yishiha returned in 1432 to find its ruins and pardoned those responsible.
zh: 吉烈迷在满汉文献中作吉里迷，俄罗斯探险家转读为吉利亚克，是黑龙江下游与库页岛北部以渔猎为生的民族，今多称尼夫赫人。中国史籍中，金代称吉里迷，元代又作乞烈宾、吉烈灭，清代定名费雅喀。他们捕鱼、猎取海兽、畜养犬只，夏季居沿海、冬季转往内河，信奉以熊祭为核心的萨满教。1291年后，元朝在黑龙江口附近的奴儿干设立征东元帅府，部分原因是防御渡海掳掠吉烈迷的库页岛骨嵬人。明朝于1409年设奴儿干都司，册封其酋长；1413年所建的永宁寺后被吉烈迷毁去，太监亦失哈1432年再至时只见寺基，便赦免了毁寺者。

en: Glauchau was the chief lordship of the lords of Schönburg, a free-born Saxon-Thuringian noble family first documented in 1130 at their castle of Schönburg on the Saale. In the later twelfth century they shifted their center to the Zwickauer Mulde, entered imperial service as ministeriales under Hermann I of Schönburg, and built Glauchau castle around 1170 to guard a Slavic settlement whose old Sorbian name meant the quiet, wooded place; the town beneath it was first mentioned in 1240. Glauchau became the family's allodial seat in 1256, and the Schönburgs added Lichtenstein in 1286, Waldenburg in 1378 and the county of Hartenstein in 1406. To keep the ambitious Saxon electors at bay, they held Glauchau, Lichtenstein and Waldenburg as sub-fiefs of the Bohemian crown. In 1337 the lord was Frederick VII of Schönburg, head of a house that had already branched into Glauchau, Crimmitschau and Bohemian lines. The Schönburg lands accepted the Reformation from 1542, the whole house was raised to imperial counts in 1700 and its upper line to princes in 1790. By the recess of 1740 the lords had surrendered most of their autonomous rights to Electoral Saxony, whose overlordship the Peace of Teschen confirmed in 1779, and the mediatization of 1803 ended their status as ruling princes.
zh: 格劳豪是舍恩堡领主家族的核心领地。这个出身自由贵族的萨克森-图林根家族最早于1130年因萨勒河畔的舍恩堡城堡见于文献。12世纪后期，他们把重心迁到茨维考穆尔德河流域，在赫尔曼一世·冯·舍恩堡时代成为帝国陪臣，并于约1170年修筑格劳豪城堡，镇守一个旧索布语意为“幽静林地”的斯拉夫聚落；堡下的城镇于1240年首次被记载。1256年格劳豪成为家族的世袭治所，此后舍恩堡家族又于1286年取得利希滕施泰因、1378年取得瓦尔登堡、1406年取得哈尔滕施泰因伯国。为抵御萨克森选侯的扩张，他们把格劳豪、利希滕施泰因和瓦尔登堡作为波希米亚王冠的次级封邑持有。1337年在位的是舍恩堡的弗里德里希七世，当时家族已分出格劳豪、克里米乔和波希米亚等支系。1542年起舍恩堡领地接受宗教改革，整个家族于1700年升为帝国伯爵，1790年长支升为诸侯。1740年的协议迫使领主们把大部分自治权让给萨克森选侯国，1779年《切申和约》确认了萨克森的宗主权，1803年的帝国代表会议决议更终结了他们的统治诸侯地位。

en: The Ulus of Jochi, better known as the Golden Horde or Kipchak Khanate, was the westernmost inheritance of Genghis Khan's eldest son Jochi, enlarged into an empire by his son Batu, whose campaigns of 1237 to 1242 sacked Kiev and made every Rus' principality a tributary ruled from the new capital of Sarai on the lower Volga. After the Mongol Empire split in 1259 the Horde went its own way and gradually Turkicized. Its power peaked under Özbeg Khan, who ruled from 1313 to 1341, adopted Islam as the state religion and in 1337 still received tribute and homage from princes as far away as Moscow and Novgorod. The Great Troubles after 1359 shattered its unity; Tokhtamysh briefly restored it before Timur's invasion of 1395 broke the Horde for good. It splintered into the khanates of Kazan, Crimea and Astrakhan and the rump Great Horde, whose defeat at the Great Stand on the Ugra in 1480 freed Moscow from the Tatar yoke and whose last remnants were destroyed in 1502.
zh: 术赤兀鲁思在史书中更常见的名字是金帐汗国，又称钦察汗国，是成吉思汗长子术赤的西方封地，由其子拔都扩张为庞大帝国：1237—1242年的西征攻陷基辅，使罗斯诸公国全部沦为藩属，统治中心是伏尔加河下游新建的萨莱城。1259年蒙古帝国分裂后，金帐汗国自成一体，并逐渐突厥化。它的国力在月即别汗（1313—1341年在位）时达到顶峰，他立伊斯兰教为国教；1337年时，远至莫斯科和诺夫哥罗德的王公仍要向萨莱纳贡称臣。1359年后的“大动乱”撕裂了汗国的统一，脱脱迷失一度重振，但1395年帖木儿的入侵给了它致命打击。此后它分裂为喀山、克里米亚、阿斯特拉罕等汗国和残余的大帐汗国；1480年的乌格拉河对峙使莫斯科摆脱鞑靼枷锁，最后的残部也于1502年覆灭。

en:
Gilgit was the royal seat of the upper Indus valley, an oasis town where the Gilgit river meets the Hunza, on the Silk Road between Kashmir, Ladakh and the Tarim basin. In the seventh and eighth centuries it was the heart of the Buddhist kingdom called Little Balur in Chinese records, whose Patola Shahi kings followed Vajrayana Buddhism and produced the Gilgit manuscripts; Tang China and the Tibetan Empire fought for its allegiance until Tibetan rule prevailed late in the eighth century.

Muslim rule came with the Trakhan dynasty, which tradition derives from a Persian adventurer called Azur Jamshid: he overthrew Shri Badat, last of the old Hindu Ras, married his daughter Nur Bakht Khatun, and founded a line named after the Ra Trakhan who reigned about 1300. Its rajas governed Gilgit and a ring of tributary valleys including Yasin, Punial, Astore and Chilas. Raja Torra Khan, ruling from 1421 to 1475, split the family when his stepbrother Shah Rais Khan fled to Badakhshan and seized Chitral, where he founded the Rais line. In the seventeenth century Queen Dadi Jawari held Gilgit and built its irrigation canals. The Trakhan dynasty ended about 1810 with the death of Raja Abbas, after which the rival rajas of Yasin, Punial and Nagar fought over the Gilgit oasis.
zh:
吉尔吉特是印度河上游的王权重地，为吉尔吉特河与罕萨河交汇处的绿洲城镇，地处连接克什米尔、拉达克与塔里木盆地的丝绸之路上。7至8世纪，这里是汉文史料所称小勃律佛教王国的核心，帕托拉·沙希诸王信奉金刚乘佛教，留下了吉尔吉特文书；唐朝与吐蕃曾争夺其宗主权，直到8世纪末吐蕃确立统治。

穆斯林时代由特剌汗王朝开启。按传统说法，王朝开创者是来自波斯的冒险者阿祖尔·贾姆希德：他推翻古老印度教罗阇的末代君主什里·巴达特，娶其女努尔·巴赫特·哈敦为妻，其后裔以约1300年在位的名王特剌汗之名为王朝名。历代罗阇统治吉尔吉特，并统辖亚辛、布尼亚尔、阿斯托尔、奇拉斯等一圈朝贡谷地。1421年至1475年在位的托拉汗时期家族分裂，他的异母弟沙·赖莎汗逃奔巴达赫尚并夺取吉德拉尔，在那里开创赖莎支系统治。17世纪，女王达迪·贾瓦里执掌吉尔吉特，主持修建了灌溉渠。约1810年末代罗阇阿巴斯去世，特剌汗王朝终结，此后亚辛、布尼亚尔和讷格尔的罗阇们为争夺吉尔吉特绿洲连年攻战。

en: The Principality of Galich, later called Galich-Mersky after the Merya people of the region, was a Rus' appanage centered on the town of Galich on Lake Galichskoye, in the forest country northeast of Moscow. First recorded in 1234 as Grad Mersky, it grew rich on the salt trade. In 1247 the combined Galich-Dmitrov principality was granted to Konstantin, a son of Yaroslav II of Vladimir and brother of Alexander Nevsky; when it split in the 1330s, Fyodor Davydovich took Galich while his brother Boris took Dmitrov, and in 1337 Fyodor's son Ivan Fyodorovich ruled here. In 1360 the displaced Dmitrov prince Dmitry Borisovich briefly held Galich with the Golden Horde's support, but in 1363 Muscovite governors arrived and the ruling family was driven out to Novgorod. Dmitry Donskoy regranted Galich to his son Yuri in 1389, and Yuri's son Dmitry Shemyaka used its salt wealth to press his claim to the Muscovite throne during the succession war, until Vasily II annexed the principality in 1450.
zh: 加利奇公国，后按当地的梅里亚部落称加利奇-梅尔斯基，是以莫斯科东北林区、加利奇湖畔的加利奇城为中心的罗斯封邑。它1234年以梅尔斯基城之名首见记载，靠盐业贸易致富。1247年，加利奇-德米特罗夫公国封给弗拉基米尔大公雅罗斯拉夫二世之子、亚历山大·涅夫斯基之弟康斯坦丁；14世纪30年代这个合并公国分裂，费奥多尔·达维多维奇分得加利奇，其弟鲍里斯分得德米特罗夫，1337年在位的是费奥多尔之子伊凡·费奥多罗维奇。1360年，失去德米特罗夫的德米特里·鲍里索维奇曾在金帐汗国支持下短暂入主加利奇，但1363年莫斯科总督到来，统治家族被逐往诺夫哥罗德。1389年德米特里·顿斯科伊把加利奇重新封给儿子尤里，尤里之子德米特里·舍米亚卡凭借这里的盐利在莫斯科继承战争中争夺大公之位，直到1450年瓦西里二世吞并公国。

en: The County of Gleichen took its name from Gleichen Castle, first mentioned in 1034, which the archbishop of Mainz granted in 1162 as a fief to the counts of Tonna, his protectors over the city of Erfurt; the enfeoffed branch thereafter called itself counts of Tonna and Gleichen, and finally simply counts of Gleichen. In the thirteenth century they were among the leading Thuringian comital houses, but their ties to Mainz drew them into feud with the Ludovingian landgraves, and mounting debts forced them to sell their Erfurt advocacy in 1290 and their Eichsfeld estates in 1294. The tide turned under Count Hermann, who in 1332 bought the burgrave's office at Ohrdruf and in 1342 received the whole town as a fief from Landgrave Balthasar of Thuringia; Ohrdruf became the new centre of the scattered county, whose lords now held of the Wettin margraves of Meissen. In 1599 the counts abandoned the old hill castle for their palace at Ohrdruf, and when the line died out in 1631 the upper county passed to the counts of Hohenlohe and the lower county to the princes of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen, while Gleichen Castle itself reverted to Mainz.
zh: 格莱兴伯国得名于1034年首次见于记载的格莱兴城堡。1162年，美因茨大主教把这座城堡封给代为保护埃尔福特城的托纳伯爵，受封的支系此后自称托纳与格莱兴伯爵，最终简称格莱兴伯爵。13世纪时他们是图林根最显赫的伯爵家族之一，但与美因茨的封建纽带使他们和路德维希家族的图林根领地伯爵陷入仇争，日益沉重的债务又迫使他们在1290年卖掉在埃尔福特的护佑权，1294年卖掉艾希斯费尔德的地产。后来在赫尔曼伯爵治下出现转机：他于1332年购得奥尔德鲁夫的城堡长官职位，1342年又从图林根领地伯爵巴尔塔萨手中受封全城，奥尔德鲁夫从此成为这块分散伯国的新中心，伯爵们也转为韦廷家族迈森藩侯的封臣。1599年，伯爵们放弃古老的山上城堡，迁入奥尔德鲁夫的宫邸。1631年家族绝嗣，上伯国传给霍恩洛厄伯爵，下伯国传给施瓦茨堡‑松德斯豪森亲王，格莱兴城堡本身则归还美因茨。

en: The Duchy of Głogów, with its capital at Głogów in Lower Silesia, was one of the Silesian duchies created by the medieval fragmentation of Poland. It first appeared in 1177 under the Piast prince Konrad Spindleshanks and was re-established in 1251, when Konrad I received the northern Głogów lands from his brother, the duke of Legnica. Ruled by the Silesian Piasts, it repeatedly split off smaller duchies such as Ścinawa, Żagań and Oleśnica. When Duke Przemko II died without heirs in 1331, King John the Blind of Bohemia seized the duchy as a Bohemian fief and in 1337 enfeoffed it to Henry I of Jawor, the Piast ruler shown on the 1337 map. After Henry died without issue, Emperor Charles IV incorporated half of Głogów into the Bohemian Crown and granted the other half to the dukes of Żagań in 1349. The Głogów Piast line ended in 1476; the succession struggle drew in Brandenburg and the Hungarian king Matthias Corvinus, who conquered the duchy in 1488. In 1506 Głogów became a direct dominion of the Bohemian Crown, passed with it to the Habsburgs in 1526, and was seized by Prussia in 1742 during the First Silesian War, before the old duchy was dissolved in the Prussian administrative reform of 1815.
zh: 格沃古夫公国是中世纪波兰分裂时期产生的西里西亚诸公国之一，首府在下西里西亚的格沃古夫。它最早于1177年在皮亚斯特王公康拉德·斯平德列尚克斯治下出现，1251年再度确立，由康拉德一世从其莱格尼察公爵兄长手中分得北部的格沃古夫领地。公国由西里西亚皮亚斯特家族统治，先后分出希齐纳瓦、扎甘和奥莱希尼察等小公国。1331年普热姆科二世公爵无嗣而终，波希米亚国王盲人约翰趁机将公国收为波希米亚采邑，并于1337年封给1337年地图上的统治者、亚沃尔的亨里克一世。亨里克无后，皇帝查理四世将格沃古夫的一半并入波希米亚王冠领地，另一半于1349年封给扎甘公爵。1476年格沃古夫的皮亚斯特血脉断绝，继承权之争把勃兰登堡和匈牙利国王马加什·科尔温卷入其中，后者于1488年征服公国。1506年格沃古夫成为波希米亚王冠的直属领地，1526年随其落入哈布斯堡家族之手，1742年第一次西里西亚战争中被普鲁士夺取，最终在1815年普鲁士行政改革中被废除。

en: The Glens are the nine wooded valleys of the Antrim coast, stretching between the Antrim Plateau and the North Channel, only eighteen miles from the Mull of Kintyre; with Rathlin Island they formed the lordship of the Glens, seated at Glenarm. The Bissetts, a Norman family from Scotland, arrived in Ulster in the thirteenth century and made themselves its lords, becoming among the most Gaelicised of the Anglo-Norman settler families and known in the Irish annals as Mac Eoin Bissett. Sir Hugh Bisset played both sides in the Scottish wars, opposed Edward Bruce's invasion of Ireland in 1315, and held the barony of Glenarm from 1338. The marriage in 1399 of Margery Byset, heiress of the family, to John Mór MacDonnell of Clan Donald gave the Scottish MacDonnells their claim to the Glens, which they had made good by the early sixteenth century. In 1603 Sir Randal MacDonnell received the Glens and the Route from the crown, founding the fortune of the Earls of Antrim.
zh: 格伦斯指安特里姆海岸的九条林木峡谷，夹在安特里姆高原与北海峡之间，距苏格兰金泰尔角仅十八英里；加上拉斯林岛，构成了以格莱纳姆为治所的峡谷领地。比塞特家族是来自苏格兰的诺曼人，13世纪进入阿尔斯特并成为这里的领主，是盎格鲁-诺曼移民中盖尔化最深的家族之一，在爱尔兰编年史中被称为 Mac Eoin Bissett。休·比塞特爵士在苏格兰战争中反复周旋于英苏之间，1315年抵御了爱德华·布鲁斯对爱尔兰的入侵，1338年受封格莱纳姆男爵区。1399年，家族女继承人玛杰丽·比塞特嫁给唐纳德家族的约翰·莫尔·麦克唐奈，使苏格兰的麦克唐奈家族取得对峡谷的继承权，并在16世纪初实际接管此地。1603年，兰德尔·麦克唐奈爵士从王室手中获封峡谷与鲁特地区，奠定了日后安特里姆伯爵家族的基业。

en: Gaoluo was a Tujia tusi on the upper Qing River in western Hubei, its lands in present Xuan'en County, ruled by a house with the Han surname Tian. Under the Yuan it was ranked as a pacification commission, and during the Xia interlude Ming Yuzhen reduced it to a pacification office. The Ming abolished it in 1373 and restored it in 1406 under the Yongle emperor, one of many chiefdoms reconstituted around the Shizhou guard. Gaoluo then passed peacefully from Ming to Qing as a hereditary Shinan tusi. Its history ended with the Yongzheng reforms of 1735, when the native offices of western Hubei were swept away and replaced by appointed magistrates; Xuan'en County was created on the old tusi lands the following year.
zh: 高罗是鄂西清江上游的土家族土司，辖地在今宣恩县一带，统治者汉姓田。元代它的品级是宣抚司，大夏明玉珍时改为安抚司。新建的明朝于1373年将其废除，又在1406年永乐年间重新设置，是施州卫周边复建的众多土司之一。此后高罗作为施南土司群中的世袭辖地，平稳地由明入清。它的历史终结于1735年雍正朝的改土归流，鄂西的土司机构被流官取代；次年朝廷在旧土司地上设立宣恩县。

en: Glamorgan was the richest and most powerful of the Welsh marcher lordships, seated at Cardiff Castle on the south Wales coast. It was created around 1093, when the Anglo-Norman baron Robert Fitzhamon overthrew Iestyn ap Gwrgant, the last Welsh king of Morgannwg, and divided the lowlands among his followers, the Twelve Knights of Glamorgan. The lordship passed to the earls of Gloucester and then to the de Clare family, whose marcher rights let them wage war, build castles and hold courts without reference to the English crown. When Gilbert de Clare fell at Bannockburn in 1314, his sister Eleanor inherited Glamorgan and carried it to her husband Hugh Despenser the Younger; his hunger for Welsh lands helped provoke the baronial revolt of 1321, and he was executed in 1326. Restored to the Despensers in 1338, the lordship later passed through the Beauchamp and Neville families, was held by Richard III before his fall in 1485, and merged with the crown under Henry VII in 1495. The Laws in Wales Acts of 1535 to 1542 abolished its marcher privileges.
zh: 格拉摩根是威尔士边境领主领中最富庶、最强大的一个，治所设在南威尔士沿海的加的夫城堡。它约于1093年建立：盎格鲁-诺曼贵族罗伯特·菲茨哈蒙推翻了摩根努格末代威尔士国王叶斯汀·阿普·古尔甘特，把低地分封给追随他的“格拉摩根十二骑士”。领地先后传给格洛斯特伯爵家族和德·克莱尔家族，边境领特权使他们可以不经英格兰王权批准便开战、筑城和开设法庭。1314年吉尔伯特·德·克莱尔在班诺克本阵亡后，其妹埃莉诺继承格拉摩根，并把它带给丈夫小休·勒德斯潘塞；他对威尔士土地的贪求成为1321年贵族叛乱的诱因之一，本人于1326年被处决。1338年领地归还勒德斯潘塞家族，此后又经比彻姆和内维尔家族之手，1485年理查三世败亡前曾领有此地，1495年在亨利七世治下并入王冠。1535至1542年的《威尔士法令》废除了它的边境领特权。

en: The County of Mark was a Westphalian state of the Holy Roman Empire straddling the Ruhr river, with its seat at Burg Mark near Hamm. It grew from the Berg-Altena lands of a collateral line of the counts of Berg: Count Frederick I built Mark Castle around 1198, and his son Adolf I founded the town of Hamm in 1226. At the Battle of Worringen in 1288 Count Eberhard II fought alongside Brabant against the archbishop of Cologne, whose defeat left Mark the leading lordship in southern Westphalia; wars against the prince-bishopric of Münster in the fourteenth century added the northern Higher Mark. In 1337 the county was ruled by Count Adolf II. His younger son inherited Cleves in 1368 and then Mark in 1391, uniting the two as Cleves-Mark in 1394. From 1521 Mark was held in the Jülich-Cleves-Berg personal union, and when that dynasty died out in 1609 the succession dispute ended with the 1614 Treaty of Xanten, assigning Mark to the elector of Brandenburg. It passed to France under the 1807 Treaties of Tilsit and to Napoleon's Grand Duchy of Berg in 1808, before returning to Prussia in 1813 and entering the new Province of Westphalia in 1815.
zh: 马克伯国是神圣罗马帝国位于鲁尔河两岸的威斯特伐利亚邦国，治所在哈姆附近的马克城堡。它源自贝格伯爵家族旁支的贝格-阿尔特纳领地：伯爵弗里德里希一世约在1198年修建马克城堡，其子阿道夫一世于1226年建立哈姆城。1288年沃林根战役中，伯爵埃伯哈德二世与布拉班特结盟对抗科隆大主教，大主教战败后马克成为威斯特伐利亚南部首屈一指的领地；14世纪对明斯特主教区的战争又为它夺来北方的上马克。1337年在位的是伯爵阿道夫二世。他的幼子于1368年继承克莱沃，又在1391年继承马克，1394年将两地合并为克莱沃-马克。1521年起马克成为于利希-克莱沃-贝格共主邦联的一部分；该王朝1609年绝嗣后爆发继承纠纷，1614年的《克桑滕条约》把马克划归勃兰登堡选帝侯。1807年《提尔西特条约》将它割让给法国，1808年并入拿破仑的贝格大公国，1813年回归普鲁士，1815年划入新设的威斯特伐利亚省。

en: The Gong tusi in southern Sichuan, with its seat at Luoji in the hills above the Yangtze, was the country of the Bo people and preserves their best-known hanging-coffin cliffs at Matangba. In the early Tang the district was ruled through loose-rein prefectures, and under the Song it answered to the Changning military prefecture. It submitted to the Mongols in 1276, when the Yuan set up the Lower Luoji chief's office to govern the local tribes; when the neighbouring peoples rebelled in 1285, Luoji alone stayed loyal. At the end of the Yuan, Ming Yuzhen of the Xia state reorganized it as Gongzhou, and in 1371 the Ming demoted it to Gong County under Xuzhou. The Bo rising of 1573 reached Gong County, whose cliffs were besieged by imperial troops; afterwards the Bo were absorbed or gone, though their log coffins still mark the gorges.
zh: 珙地土司位于川南，治所罗计地处长江上游的山地，是僰人的故土，麻塘坝的僰人悬棺崖是现存最集中的悬棺遗址。唐初当地以羁縻州治理，宋代归附长宁军。1276年它投降蒙古，元朝设下罗计长官司统辖当地部族；1285年周边诸蛮反元时，唯有下罗计长官司本部没有异志。元末大夏君主明玉珍将其改置为珙州，1371年明朝又把珙州降为珙县，隶属叙州府。1573年僰人起事波及珙县，官军围攻了这里的山崖；此后僰人或被同化或离散，只有一具具整木凿成的悬棺仍留在峡谷之中。

en: Gonjo, called Guanjue in Ming records, was a small Khampa chiefdom in the gorges of eastern Kham, centred on the Gonjo valley in present-day Chamdo, where Kagyu and Sakya monasteries had stood since the thirteenth century. Its ruler was a Karma Kagyu hierarch whose ancestors held the Yuan-era Do-Kham guard commission. In 1406 the monk Nankar Balsang sent tribute to the Yongle emperor's court at Nanjing and received the title State Preceptor, and in 1407 he was enfeoffed as the Guardian King of the Faith with a golden seal. After his death in 1414 his nephew inherited the rank in 1415, but he died without an heir and the Ming title lapsed. Gonjo then remained one of the patchwork of Kham chiefdoms lying between Derge and Chamdo, and in the Qing period fell within the Tibetan-administered portion of Kham.
zh: 贡觉在明代文献中译作馆觉，是康区东部峡谷中的康巴小酋长政权，中心在今昌都市贡觉县一带，13世纪起这里就建有噶举派和萨迦派寺院。其统治者是噶玛噶举派的高僧，祖先曾受封元代的朵甘卫指挥使。1406年，僧人南喀巴藏卜遣使到南京向永乐皇帝朝贡，受封灌顶国师；1407年又被册封为护教王，赐金印诰命。他于1414年去世，侄子斡些儿吉刺思巴藏卜在1415年袭封，死后无嗣，明朝的封爵遂告断绝。此后贡觉仍是康区众酋长政权之一，夹在德格与昌都之间，清代处于拉萨管辖的康区一侧。

en: Guangnan was a Zhuang tusi prefecture in the karst hills of southeastern Yunnan, centered on present-day Guangnan in Wenshan, astride the old routes between Yunnan, Guangxi and Annam. Under the Song the district was the jimi Temo circuit, a stronghold of the Nong clan: Nong Zhigao took refuge there after his great rebellion of 1052 to 1053 was crushed by Di Qing, and his descendants kept the chiefship. In the Zhiyuan reign of the 1270s the Yuan set up the Guangnan West Route pacification commission, which at first oversaw five native subprefectures, including Fuzhou, Anning and Luozuo. The Ming conquest of Yunnan turned it into Guangnan Prefecture, still governed by hereditary Nong native prefects, whose restiveness called for campaigning as late as the 1630s. The Qing brought in circulating officials from 1661, added the Weimo district in 1669, and in 1736 established Baoning County at the prefectural seat, leaving only Fuzhou as a native subprefecture beneath it.
zh: 广南是云南东南喀斯特山区的一个壮族土司府，治所在今文山州广南县，扼守云南、广西与安南之间的古道。宋代这里是羁縻特磨道，为侬氏的大本营：1052至1053年侬智高的大举反宋被狄青镇压后，正是退入特磨道躲避，他的后裔此后世代承袭当地首领。1270年代至元年间，元朝设立广南西路宣抚司，起初统领富州、安宁、罗佐等五个土州。明军平定云南后改设广南府，仍由侬氏世袭土知府治理，直到1630年代，朝廷还需用兵平定岑、侬两姓土官的骚乱。清朝从1661年起派任流官，1669年把维摩州地并入，1736年又在府治设置宝宁县，府下只剩富州一个土州。

en: The County of Geneva emerged in the tenth century within the Burgundian Kingdom of Arles, which passed to the Holy Roman Empire in 1032. The counts ruled the Genevois countryside around Annecy, their capital from 1219, but not the city of Geneva: from 1124 the Bishops of Geneva governed the city, while the expanding Counts of Savoy encircled the county and held its trade routes. In 1337 the count was Amadeus III, whose mother was a daughter of Amadeus V of Savoy; he served the Savoyard court as regent and head of its council. Of his sons, the youngest, Robert, was elected the antipope Clement VII in 1378 and inherited the county in 1392, but his death in 1394 extinguished the House of Geneva. The heiress had married into the lords of Thoire and Villars, and in 1401 their heir Odo sold the county to Amadeus VIII of Savoy, who merged it into the lands that Emperor Sigismund raised to the Duchy of Savoy in 1416.
zh: 日内瓦伯国出现于10世纪，地处勃艮第的阿尔勒王国境内，该王国于1032年并入神圣罗马帝国。伯爵们统治以阿讷西为中心的日内瓦乡野，阿讷西自1219年起成为伯国都城，但他们并不统治日内瓦城：该城从1124年起由日内瓦主教治理，而不断扩张的萨伏依伯爵则四面包围伯国、控制其商路。1337年在位的是阿梅迪奥三世，他的母亲是萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥五世之女，他本人在萨伏依宫廷担任摄政和议事会首席。他的幼子罗贝尔于1378年被选为对立教宗克莱门特七世，又在1392年继承伯国，但他于1394年去世后日内瓦家族绝嗣。女继承人嫁入图瓦尔-维拉尔家族，1401年其继承人奥多把伯国卖给萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥八世，后者将其并入自己的领地，皇帝西吉斯蒙德又于1416年将这些领地升为萨伏依公国。

en: Goa is the island-studded harbour at the heart of the Konkan coast, where the Mandovi and Zuari rivers meet the Arabian Sea. The Kadambas made it a kingdom of their own in 960, when Shashthadeva took Chandrapur from the Shilaharas as a Chalukya feudatory and moved his court from Chandor to the port of Gopakapattana. For more than three centuries Goan ships traded from Zanzibar and the Persian Gulf to Bengal and Sri Lanka, while the Kadamba kings, devout Shaivites, filled the country with Shiva temples and Brahmanical colleges and also patronised the Jains. Their age ended in the early fourteenth century as Delhi's armies reached the Konkan: the Khalji general Malik Kafur sacked Gopakapattana, and on 16 October 1345 the last Kadamba king, Suriya Deva, was assassinated by Muslim invaders. The Bahmani sultans held Goa from 1350 until Vijayanagara retook it in 1370, and for nearly a century its harbours landed the Arabian horses that remounted the Vijayanagara cavalry. Bahmani forces returned in 1469, and when the sultanate split in 1492 Goa passed to the Adil Shahis of Bijapur, who made Old Goa their second capital. In 1510 Afonso de Albuquerque, called in by the local privateer Timoji, seized the city for Portugal after a hard-fought second assault; Goa became the capital of the Portuguese Estado da India, seat of the viceroy and of the Goa Inquisition from 1560 to 1812, and remained in Portuguese hands long after the surrounding lands passed to Britain and the Marathas.
zh: 果阿是孔坎海岸核心地带的岛港群，曼多维河与祖阿里河在此注入阿拉伯海。960年，卡达姆巴首领沙斯塔提婆作为遮娄其封臣，从希拉哈拉人手中夺取钱德拉普尔，又把朝廷从昌多尔迁至戈帕卡帕塔纳港，建立起自己的王国。此后三百多年里，果阿商船的航线从桑给巴尔和波斯湾一直延伸到孟加拉和斯里兰卡；虔诚信奉湿婆的卡达姆巴诸王在境内广建湿婆神庙与婆罗门学府，同时也庇护耆那教。14世纪初德里的兵锋抵达孔坎，卡达姆巴时代走向终结：卡尔吉将领马利克·卡富尔洗劫戈帕卡帕塔纳，1345年10月16日，末代卡达姆巴国王苏利耶提婆被穆斯林入侵者刺杀。巴赫马尼苏丹自1350年统治果阿，1370年毗奢耶那伽罗将其收复，此后近一个世纪，果阿各港输入的阿拉伯战马源源不断装备毗奢耶那伽罗骑兵。1469年巴赫马尼军队再度占领，1492年苏丹国解体后，果阿转入比贾布尔的阿迪勒沙王朝，果阿旧城成为其第二都城。1510年，阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克应本地海上首领蒂莫吉之请，经第二次强攻夺城，果阿从此成为葡萄牙印度领的首府、总督驻地，1560至1812年间又是果阿宗教裁判所的所在地；当周围土地相继落入马拉塔人和英国之手后，它仍长期由葡萄牙人据守。

en: Gobir was the northernmost of the seven true Hausa states, the Hausa Bakwai, charged by tradition as the king of war with guarding Hausaland against the Tuareg, and its people, the Gobirawa, kept a fierce martial reputation across nearly seven centuries. Founded in the 1100s, the kingdom first grew in the Asben, or Aïr, mountains; its ruling house traced itself to the migrant king Bana Turmi and held capitals at Birnin Lalle and Goran Rami. In the 1400s Leo Africanus found Gobir full of herdsmen and linen weavers whose cloth and shoes reached Timbuktu and Gao, but Tuareg pressure and the rise of the Agadez sultanate drove the Gobirawa south, and in the early 1700s they settled on Zamfara land. Sarki Soba launched raids as far as Yorubaland, and Babari, who reigned from 1742 to 1770, destroyed his Zamfara hosts' capital of Birnin Zamfara about 1756 and built a new walled capital at Alkalawa on the Gulbin Rima. Gobir then met its match in the reformer Usman dan Fodio, whom Sarki Bawa had welcomed in 1774: his pupil Yunfa, king from 1803, drove him out, dan Fodio proclaimed the Fulani jihad, and after the battle of Tsuntua his stormers took Alkalawa in 1808 and killed Yunfa. Remnant Gobirawa founded a rival capital at Tibiri in 1836, only for Sokoto to crush them at Gawakuke the same year.
zh: 戈比尔是豪萨七城邦（豪萨·巴克瓦伊）中位置最北的一个，按传统它身为“战争之王”，负责守卫豪萨兰、抵御图阿雷格人；戈比拉瓦人在近七百年里保持着强悍的武名。王国建于12世纪，最初在阿斯本（阿伊尔）山地发展，王室把世系追溯到迁徙而来的国王巴纳·图尔米，先后以比尔宁拉莱和戈兰·拉米为都。15世纪利奥·阿非利加努斯看到的戈比尔遍布牧人和亚麻织工，布匹和鞋子远销廷巴克图和加奥，但图阿雷格人的压迫和阿加德兹苏丹国的崛起迫使戈比拉瓦人南迁，18世纪初他们在扎姆法拉的土地上落脚。萨尔基索巴率军劫掠，兵锋远达约鲁巴兰；1742至1770年在位的巴巴里反噬东道主，约1756年摧毁扎姆法拉都城比尔宁扎姆法拉，并在古尔宾·里马河畔修建有城墙的新都阿尔卡拉瓦。戈比尔随后遇到劲敌——1774年被国王巴瓦迎入的改革者乌斯曼·丹·福迪奥：他的学生云法于1803年继位后将他驱逐，丹·福迪奥遂发起富拉尼圣战；聪图阿战役之后，圣战军于1808年攻破阿尔卡拉瓦，杀死云法。残余的戈比拉瓦人于1836年在蒂比里另立对抗都城，同年便在加瓦库凯被索科托击败。

en: Golog is the loose confederation of Tibetan nomad tribes pasturing around the upper Yellow River and the sacred mountain Amnye Machen in southern Amdo. Its people were not one stock but an amalgam of refugees and migrants drawn from across Amdo and Kham. The Tibetan name mgo log is glossed as turned head or rebellious, and the Golog were famed in both Lhasa and Beijing as fierce fighters whom neither Tibetan nor Chinese power subdued for long; legend remembered rule by a queen, an incarnate goddess whose office passed from mother to daughter. Some tribes gave allegiance to Labrang Monastery while many remained wholly independent. In 1828 they plundered the caravan of the Amdo mystic Shabkar despite letters of passage from the Dalai and Panchen Lamas, and the Qing amban at Xining admitted the tribes lay beyond imperial control.
zh: 果洛是安多南部、黄河上游与圣山阿尼玛卿山一带游牧的藏族部落松散联盟。果洛人并非同族同源，而是从安多和康区各地汇聚而来的避难者与移民融合而成。藏语“果洛”有“掉头”“反叛”之意，无论拉萨还是北京都深知其善战，西藏和中国的势力都无法长久降服他们；传说中果洛曾由一位女王统治，她是化身的女神，权位母女相传。部分部落归附拉卜楞寺，更多的则完全独立。1828年，他们洗劫了安多修行者夏嘎巴的商队，尽管后者持有达赖喇嘛和班禅喇嘛的通行文书；驻西宁的青海办事大臣也承认，这些部落不在朝廷掌控之中。

en: The County of Gorizia was a state of the Holy Roman Empire whose lords, the Meinhardiner counts, held lands split between Gorizia in Friuli and Lienz in the upper Drava valley. Originally stewards, or vogts, of the Patriarchs of Aquileia, the family was enfeoffed with the Gorizia estate early in the twelfth century and reached its height in 1253, when Count Meinhard inherited the County of Tyrol. The heritage was divided in 1271, the Tyrolean branch dying out in 1335 while the Gorizia line kept Lienz and Friuli. After Count Henry III was assassinated in 1323 the lands were split among several heirs, and in 1365 Emperor Charles IV raised Gorizia to a princely county. Pressed by the Habsburgs and by Venice, the Meinhardiner declined until the last count, Leonhard, died in 1500, whereupon the estates passed to the Habsburg emperor Maximilian I.
zh: 戈里齐亚伯国是神圣罗马帝国的一个邦国，统治者迈因哈德家族的伯爵们领有分处弗留利的戈里齐亚与德拉瓦河上游利恩茨的两片土地。该家族本是阿奎莱亚宗主教区的地方长官，12世纪初受封戈里齐亚庄园；1253年迈因哈德伯爵继承蒂罗尔伯国，家族势力达到顶峰。1271年家族遗产被瓜分，蒂罗尔支系于1335年绝嗣，戈里齐亚支系继续领有利恩茨和弗留利。1323年亨利三世伯爵遇刺后，土地又被几位继承人分割；1365年皇帝查理四世将其升格为藩侯伯国。在哈布斯堡家族与威尼斯的夹逼下，迈因哈德家族日渐衰落，末代伯爵莱昂哈德于1500年去世，领地随之归入哈布斯堡皇帝马克西米利安一世。

en: Goslar was a Free Imperial City on the north-western slopes of the Harz, whose wealth came from the silver mines of the nearby Rammelsberg. First mentioned in a deed of Emperor Otto II in 979, it became a favourite Ottonian and Salian residence: Conrad II began the Imperial Palace in 1025, Henry III held court there to envoys from Hungary and Kiev, and Henry IV was born in the palace in 1050. When Hermann of Salm was crowned anti-king in Goslar in 1081 the town gained the status of an Imperial City. Its council, first recorded in 1219, joined the Hanseatic League in 1267 and secured full Vogt rights by 1290, making Goslar a free imperial city whose mining law of 1359 was copied across the region, while its citizens also traded in Gose beer, slate and vitriol. In 1527 Duke Henry V of Wolfenbüttel seized the Rammelsberg mines, opening a feud that dragged on for decades. The Reformation was introduced in 1531 under Nicolaus von Amsdorf, and the city joined the Schmalkaldic League in 1536 before the league's defeat at Mühlberg in 1547. Occupied by Swedish troops from 1632 to 1635 during the Thirty Years' War, Goslar sank into debt and never recovered the mines. Prussian troops annexed it in 1802, the mediatisation of 1803 confirmed the end of its immediacy, and after a spell in the Kingdom of Westphalia the Congress of Vienna assigned it to Hanover in 1815.
zh: 戈斯拉尔是坐落在哈茨山西北麓的帝国自由城市，财富来自附近拉默尔斯贝格的银矿。它最早见于皇帝奥托二世979年的一份文书，后来成为奥托王朝和萨利安王朝最喜爱的驻跸地：康拉德二世于1025年动工兴建帝国行宫，亨利三世在此接见匈牙利和基辅的使节，亨利四世更于1050年出生在行宫里。1081年萨尔姆的赫尔曼在戈斯拉尔加冕为对立国王，该城由此取得帝国城市地位。市议会最早记载于1219年，1267年加入汉萨同盟，1290年前已取得完整的地方长官权，正式成为帝国自由城市；其1359年编纂的矿业法被各地仿效，市民还经营戈泽啤酒、板岩和硫酸贸易。1527年，沃尔芬比特尔公爵亨利五世夺取拉默尔斯贝格银矿，开启了长达数十年的争端。1531年尼古劳斯·冯·阿姆斯多夫在此推行宗教改革，1536年城市加入施马尔卡尔登同盟，直到1547年同盟在米尔贝格战败。三十年战争期间，瑞典军队于1632至1635年占领戈斯拉尔，城市债台高筑，也再未能收回银矿。1802年普鲁士军队吞并该城，1803年的采邑调解确认其帝国直辖地位终结；在短暂并入威斯特伐利亚王国后，维也纳会议于1815年把它划归汉诺威。

en: Gowa was the dominant kingdom of the Makassarese people at the southern tip of Sulawesi. Local tradition traces its first ruler to the queen Tomanurung Baine, and in the fourteenth century Majapahit's court poem Nagarakretagama counted Makassar among its tributaries. Early on the realm split into the two kingdoms of Gowa and Tallo, which were reunited under King Tunipalangga early in the sixteenth century as a twin polity often called Makassar. The rulers welcomed foreign merchants, and Makassar grew into one of the busiest trading ports of eastern Indonesia. In 1605 the fourteenth king accepted Islam and took the name Sultan Alauddin, turning Gowa into a sultanate; the Islamic wars of 1611 brought the rival Bugis state of Bone and the rest of southwest Sulawesi under its sway, and Sumbawa was subdued in 1618. Gowa's power drew it into conflict with the Dutch East India Company: in the Makassar War of 1666 to 1669 the VOC, allied with the Bugis prince Arung Palakka of Bone, defeated Sultan Hasanuddin, imposed the Treaty of Bungaya in 1667 and stormed the fortress of Somba Opu in 1669, after which Gowa ceased to be an independent great power.
zh: 戈瓦是苏拉威西岛南端望加锡人最强盛的王国。当地传说其最早的统治者是女王托马努隆·巴伊内，14世纪满者伯夷的宫廷史诗《爪哇史颂》已把望加锡列为属国。早期王国分裂为戈瓦和塔洛两个王国，16世纪初在国王图尼帕朗加治下重新合并为一个二元政权，常被称作望加锡。历代君主欢迎外国商人，望加锡因此发展为印度尼西亚东部最繁忙的商港之一。1605年，第十四代国王皈依伊斯兰教，改名苏丹阿拉丁，戈瓦成为苏丹国；1611年的“伊斯兰战争”使其世仇布吉人国家波尼及苏拉威西西南部尽入其掌控，松巴哇也于1618年被征服。戈瓦的强盛引来了荷兰东印度公司的对抗：在1666至1669年的望加锡战争中，公司联合波尼的布吉王公阿隆·帕拉卡击败苏丹哈桑丁，1667年迫其签署《邦加亚条约》，又于1669年攻陷松巴奥普要塞，戈瓦从此失去独立强国的地位。

en: Granada was the Nasrid emirate, the last independent Muslim state in the Iberian Peninsula. When the Almohads withdrew in 1228, the commander Muhammad Ibn al-Ahmar was proclaimed emir at Arjona in 1232 and entered Granada in 1238, making it his capital and founding the Alhambra on the Sabika hill. By 1250 his realm was the only Muslim polity left in the peninsula, and the Treaty of Jaén of 1246 had already made it a tributary of Castile. In 1333 the Marinids retook Gibraltar for the Nasrids, and Yusuf I, who reigned from 1333, opened the emirate's golden age, even though the allied Marinid and Granadan army was crushed at the Battle of Río Salado in 1340 and Algeciras fell in 1344. Under Muhammad V, who died in 1391, the Alhambra gained the Palace of the Lions and writers such as Ibn al-Khatib graced its court. Dynastic strife then weakened the emirate, Castile took Gibraltar in 1462, and the Granada War opened in 1482 with the fall of Alhama. After Málaga fell in 1487, Boabdil signed the Treaty of Granada in 1491 and surrendered the city on 2 January 1492.
zh: 格拉纳达是奈斯尔王朝的酋长国，也是伊比利亚半岛最后一个独立穆斯林政权。1228年阿尔摩哈德人撤离后，将领穆罕默德·伊本·艾哈迈尔于1232年在阿尔霍纳被拥立为埃米尔，1238年进入格拉纳达并定都于此，在萨比卡山兴建阿尔罕布拉宫。到1250年，他的国家已是半岛仅存的穆斯林政权，而1246年的《哈恩条约》早已使它成为卡斯蒂利亚的附庸。1333年马林王朝替奈斯尔人夺回直布罗陀；1333年即位的优素福一世开启了酋长国的黄金时代，尽管1340年马林与格拉纳达联军在里奥萨拉多战役惨败，1344年阿尔赫西拉斯也告失守。穆罕默德五世（1391年去世）在位时，阿尔罕布拉宫增建狮子庭院，伊本·哈提卜等文人荟萃于宫廷。此后王朝内讧削弱了国家，1462年卡斯蒂利亚夺取直布罗陀，1482年格拉纳达战争以阿尔阿马失守开局。1487年马拉加陷落后，布阿卜迪勒于1491年签订《格拉纳达条约》，并于1492年1月2日献城投降。

en: The County of Hals was an imperial-immediate lordship of the Bavarian Forest, named after Hals Castle on a narrow loop of the Ilz near its mouth on the Danube, on ground that is now a district of Passau. A noble called Rotbert, also styled of Polsenz, is first attested at Hals in 1112 and probably built the castle. Around 1160 Albert of Kamm inherited the lordship through his marriage to Liukarde of Hals, and in 1280 King Rudolf I of Habsburg raised Albert's successor to the rank of imperial count. The counts pushed their lands north through the undeveloped Nordwald as far as the Bohemian border, secured the Goldener Steig trade route into Bohemia, and in the fourteenth century added the county of Leonberg and the estate of Baumgarten. In 1337 the county was held by Count Johann of Hals, the last of his line; when the family died out in 1375 a succession dispute ended with Landgrave Johann of Leuchtenberg winning the fief through the favour of Emperor Charles IV. Mounting debt then fragmented the county, and the remaining shares were sold to the Wittelsbachs in 1517.
zh: 哈尔斯伯国是拜恩林山中的一个帝国直辖领地，得名于伊尔茨河一处狭窄河弯上的哈尔斯堡，城堡靠近伊尔茨河注入多瑙河的河口，故地今为帕绍的一个城区。1112年，一位名叫罗特贝特、也自称波尔森茨的贵族首见于记载，哈尔斯堡大概就是他所建。约1160年，卡姆的阿尔伯特通过与哈尔斯的柳克德联姻继承了这片领地；1280年，哈布斯堡国王鲁道夫一世把阿尔伯特的继承人封为帝国伯爵。历任伯爵向北穿过尚未开发的北林开拓疆土，一直推进到波希米亚边境，控制了通往波希米亚的“黄金小道”商路，14世纪又兼并莱昂贝格伯国和鲍姆加滕产业。1337年在位的是哈尔斯伯爵约翰，也是家族的末代传人；1375年家族绝嗣，爆发继承纠纷，最终洛伊希滕贝格藩侯约翰凭借皇帝查理四世的恩宠得到采邑。此后债务缠身，伯国四分五裂，剩余份额于1517年卖给维特尔斯巴赫家族。

en: Gurgan was the power base of Togha Temür, the last major Genghisid claimant to the Ilkhanid throne. He was descended from Qasar, a brother of Genghis Khan, and led the Chete, a nomadic tribe that had settled between Astarabad and Gorgan on the south-eastern shore of the Caspian Sea. After Abu Sa'id's death in 1335, the princes of eastern Iran accepted Togha Temür as Ilkhan; in 1337 he marched west and even occupied the old capital Soltaniyeh, but the Jalayirids and Chobanids drove him back, and after 1344 his authority was confined to Gurgan, Mazandaran and much of Khurasan, where rulers such as the Kartids of Herat and, at first, the Sarbadars acknowledged him as suzerain. His reign was consumed by the struggle against the Sarbadar revolt that had begun in his own tax lands: the rebels defeated his armies, killed his brother, and in 1353 their leader Yahya Karawi entered Togha Temür's camp near Astarabad and murdered him, slaughtering his household and troops. His governor's son Amir Vali then seized the Gurgan lands, while Togha Temür's son Luqman-Padishah was restored at Astarabad only in 1384 as Timur's vassal, and his descendants held the town into the early fifteenth century.
zh: 朱里章是脱合帖木儿的权力根基，他是伊儿汗位最后一位有力的成吉思汗家族竞争者。他是成吉思汗之弟合撒儿的后裔，统领一支游牧的切特部，该部已在里海东南岸阿斯塔拉巴德与戈尔甘之间定居。1335年不赛因死后，东伊朗诸王公拥戴脱合帖木儿为伊儿汗；1337年他西征并一度占领旧都苏丹尼耶，但被札剌亦儿王朝与楚邦王朝击退，1344年后其权威仅限于朱里章、马赞达兰和呼罗珊大部，赫拉特的库尔特王朝以及最初的萨尔毕道朗人都奉他为宗主。他的统治耗费在与萨尔毕道朗起义的对抗上，这场起义正爆发于他的税地：起义军屡败其军队、杀死他的兄弟，1353年其首领叶海亚·卡拉维进入脱合帖木儿在阿斯塔拉巴德附近的营帐，将他刺杀并屠戮其家眷部众。此后他的总督之子埃米尔·瓦利篡取了朱里章领地，而脱合帖木儿之子鲁克曼-帕迪沙直到1384年才被帖木儿立为附庸、恢复在阿斯塔拉巴德的统治，其后人保有该城直至15世纪初。

en: Gurk was the small prince-bishopric in the Gurk valley of Carinthia ruled by the bishops of Gurk, suffragans of the Archbishop of Salzburg. Its foundation grew from the piety of the Carinthian countess Hemma, who founded a Benedictine double monastery at Gurk in 1043 and was buried in its church; after her death Archbishop Gebhard of Salzburg dissolved the nunnery and on 6 May 1072 erected the Diocese of Gurk on Hemma's endowment, the first of Salzburg's own bishoprics, with Günther von Krapffeld as its first bishop. The bishops long served as the archbishop's vicars and only received a defined, small diocese in 1131, and their efforts to break free of Salzburg, pursued even through forged charters and litigation at the Council of Basle, never fully succeeded. The Romanesque cathedral was raised between 1140 and 1200, and Hemma's relics were translated to its crypt in 1174 before her beatification in 1287. For centuries the bishops resided at Strassburg Castle near Gurk, moving to Pöckstein in 1783 and then, under the Josephinist church reforms, to Klagenfurt in 1787, when the diocese was greatly enlarged.
zh: 古尔克是克恩滕古尔克河谷的小型主教诸侯邦，由萨尔茨堡大主教的副主教——古尔克主教统治。它的建立源于克恩滕女伯爵赫玛的虔诚：她于1043年在古尔克创办了一座本笃派双修道院，身后葬于院内教堂；她去世后，萨尔茨堡大主教格布哈德解散女修道院，于1072年5月6日用赫玛的遗产建立古尔克教区，这是萨尔茨堡自有教区中的第一个，首任主教为克拉普费尔德的京特。主教们长期只是大主教的代牧，直到1131年才得到划定的狭小教区；他们试图摆脱萨尔茨堡的控制，甚至不惜伪造文书、在巴塞尔公会议上诉讼，但始终未能完全独立。罗曼式的主教座堂建于1140至1200年间，赫玛的遗骸于1174年迁入座堂地宫，她本人于1287年受宣福。数百年间，主教们驻在古尔克附近的施特拉斯堡城堡，1783年迁往珀克施泰因，随后在约瑟夫二世的教会改革中于1787年移驻克拉根福，教区也在此时大幅扩张。

en: Greenland entered medieval history when Erik the Red, exiled from Iceland, led Norse settlers to its ice-free southwestern fjords in 985 or 986. They built two colonies, the Eastern and Western Settlements, with Erik's farm at Brattahlid, and in 1126 Garðar became the seat of Greenland's own bishop, its cathedral dedicated to Saint Nicholas. The settlers kept cattle, exported walrus ivory and furs, and in 1261 accepted the sovereignty of the Norwegian king; around the same time the Thule Inuit, ancestors of the Greenlandic Inuit, spread south along the coast and became the dominant population by 1300. A cooling climate, drifting trade and weakened contacts with Norway and Iceland then doomed the Norse colonies: the Western Settlement was empty by the mid-fourteenth century, and the last written record from the Eastern Settlement is a wedding at Hvalsey in 1408, after which it too was abandoned. For centuries only Inuit remained, while Denmark-Norway kept alive its claim to the island. In 1721 the missionary Hans Egede founded a new colony, finding no Norse survivors, and Danish trading stations and a royal trade monopoly followed; the Treaty of Kiel in 1814 confirmed Greenland as a Danish dependency when Norway was ceded to Sweden.
zh: 格陵兰进入中世纪史，始于985或986年：被冰岛放逐的红发埃里克率领诺斯人移居到岛上无冰的西南峡湾。他们建立了东、西两个殖民地，埃里克的农庄设在布拉塔利德；1126年，加尔扎尔成为格陵兰自己的主教驻地，主教座堂奉圣尼古拉为主保。定居者饲养牲畜，出口海象牙和毛皮，并于1261年接受挪威国王的宗主权；与此同时，格陵兰因纽特人的祖先图勒人沿海岸南下，到1300年已成为占优势的居民。此后气候转冷、贸易萎缩、与挪威和冰岛的联系减弱，诺斯殖民地走向灭亡：西殖民地在14世纪中叶已空无一人，东殖民地留下的最后文字记录是1408年赫瓦尔塞的一场婚礼，随后也遭废弃。此后数百年间岛上只剩因纽特人，而丹麦—挪威始终未放弃对该岛的主权主张。1721年传教士汉斯·埃格德建立新殖民地，却没有找到任何诺斯幸存者；丹麦商站和王室贸易垄断随之而来，1814年《基尔条约》在挪威被割让给瑞典时，确认格陵兰为丹麦属地。

en: The Germiyanid beylik was a Turkoman dynasty that ruled western Anatolia from Kütahya from around 1300 to 1429. First recorded near Malatya in the thirteenth century, where it helped the Seljuks of Rum suppress the Babai revolt in 1239, the tribe moved west under Mongol pressure and, as the Sultanate of Rum dissolved, Yakub I made Germiyan an independent power, warring with the rising Ottomans and the Byzantine Empire. The beylik reached its height in the fourteenth century, and its court at Kütahya became a center of architecture and letters, where Persian works were translated into Turkish. Under Suleiman the marriage of his daughter Devletşah Hatun to the Ottoman prince Bayezid I in 1381 carried Kütahya and much of the realm over as her dowry. Yakub II was imprisoned by Bayezid in 1390 but escaped to Timur, fought at the Battle of Ankara in 1402 and was restored to his lands. After further occupations by the Karamanids and the Ottomans, the heirless Yakub died in 1429, leaving Germiyan to the Ottoman sultan Murad II in his will.
zh: 盖尔米扬贝伊国是约1300至1429年间以屈塔希亚为都、统治安纳托利亚西部的突厥蛮王朝。该部落13世纪首见于马拉蒂亚附近的记载，1239年曾协助罗姆塞尔柱人镇压巴巴起义，后在蒙古压力下西迁；罗姆苏丹国瓦解时，雅各布一世使盖尔米扬成为独立政权，与崛起中的奥斯曼人和拜占庭帝国交战。14世纪是贝伊国的鼎盛期，屈塔希亚宫廷成为建筑和学术中心，多部波斯作品在此被译成土耳其语。苏莱曼在位时，女儿黛夫莱莎哈屯于1381年嫁给奥斯曼王子巴耶济德一世，屈塔希亚和大片国土作为嫁妆转入奥斯曼之手。雅各布二世1390年被巴耶济德囚禁，后逃脱投奔帖木儿，参加1402年的安卡拉战役并得以复国。在又经历卡拉曼人和奥斯曼人的占领之后，没有男性继承人的雅各布于1429年去世，遗嘱中把盖尔米扬留给奥斯曼苏丹穆拉德二世。

en: Garrochamba was one of the chiefdoms of the Palta nation, the agricultural, Amazonian-derived peoples of the Loja highlands in southern Ecuador. Its main town, also called Garrochamba, stood on the summit of the El Cascajo hill at a site called Pueblo Viejo, overlooking the fertile Catamayo valley, which at the time bore the valley's own name. Along with the Calvas, Malacatos and other Palta groups it belonged to the confederation that fought the invading Inca armies of Tupac Inca Yupanqui, Sapa Inca from 1471 to 1493, before being incorporated into the Tahuantinsuyo. After the Spanish conquest the first town of Loja was founded in the Garrochamba valley in 1546, and in 1571 the indigenous settlement was replaced by the reduction town of Catacocha; its people were dispersed and the old chiefdom extinguished.
zh: 加罗钱巴是帕勒塔民族的酋长邦之一，帕勒塔人是渊源于亚马孙的农耕民族，聚居于厄瓜多尔南部的洛哈高地。其主城也叫加罗钱巴，坐落在埃尔卡斯卡霍山顶，遗址名为普埃布洛维霍，意为旧城，俯瞰当时与它同名的肥沃卡塔马约河谷。它与卡尔瓦斯、马拉卡托等帕勒塔族群同属一个联盟，曾抗击1471年至1493年在位的萨帕·印卡图帕克·印卡·尤潘基的入侵大军，最终被并入塔万廷苏尤。西班牙征服后，洛哈城于1546年首次建在加罗钱巴河谷；1571年，原住民聚落被归化城镇卡塔科查取代，居民流散，古老的酋长邦就此消亡。

en: Gorodets, also called Gorodets-Radilov, is a Volga fortress town northwest of Nizhny Novgorod, traditionally founded in 1152 by Yury Dolgoruky and first mentioned in the chronicles in 1172. It served the princes of Vladimir and Suzdal as a base for campaigns against Volga Bulgaria, was burned by Batu Khan in 1239, and in 1263 Alexander Nevsky died there on his return from the Golden Horde. His son Andrey of Gorodets made the town his residence and added Kostroma to his lands, and from his appanage the Gorodets principality emerged in the late thirteenth century. When Andrey's line died out the town escheated to the grand prince of Vladimir in 1320, which is why Ivan I Kalita held it in 1337. In 1341 it passed to Konstantin of Suzdal and became part of the Nizhny Novgorod-Suzdal grand principality, and so was absorbed by Moscow in 1392. In 1408 Edigu's Mongol army razed the town, which lay deserted for two centuries as Gorodets Pustoy, Gorodets the Empty, before being reborn as a trading and handicraft village.
zh: 戈罗杰茨，又称戈罗杰茨-拉季洛夫，是下诺夫哥罗德西北方的伏尔加河要塞城镇，相传1152年由尤里·多尔戈鲁基修建，编年史首次见于1172年。它是弗拉基米尔和苏兹达尔王公征伐伏尔加保加利亚的基地，1239年被拔都汗焚毁；1263年亚历山大·涅夫斯基从金帐汗国返程时在此去世。他的儿子戈罗杰茨的安德烈以该城为治所，并把科斯特罗马纳入领地，13世纪后期戈罗杰茨公国正是从他的封邑中形成。安德烈世系断绝后，城镇于1320年作为绝封领地收归弗拉基米尔大公，这也是1337年伊凡一世·卡利塔持有它的原因；1341年它转归苏兹达尔的康斯坦丁，成为下诺夫哥罗德-苏兹达尔大公国的一部分，随之在1392年被莫斯科吞并。1408年也迪古的蒙古军队将城池夷为平地，此后两个世纪这里荒无人烟，被称为‘空城戈罗杰茨’，后来才作为商贸和手工业村庄复兴。

en: Gorontalo, called Hulontalo in its own tongue, was a kingdom on the northern arm of Celebes, set between the Sulawesi Sea and Gorontalo Bay; its name is held to derive from Huidu Totolu, the three mountains of its peninsula. Local manuscripts place a small realm named Hulontalangi there around 1300 under King Humalanggi, and in the fourteenth century King Ilahudu is said to have bound seventeen hill chiefdoms, or linula, into the kingdom of Gorontalo, a league held together by the kinship order called pohala'a, in which queens might rule as well as kings. In 1337 it was still a pagan inland court, its first town at Hulawa on the Bolango River. Islam reached the court in the early sixteenth century under King Amai, who took the title sultan, and when the Portuguese reached northern Celebes in 1525 the region was already divided among the Muslim states of Gorontalo, Limboto, Suwawa, Boalemo and Atinggola; King Ilato built the Otanaha fortress above the town in 1522. Before the Europeans arrived these states stood under the influence of Ternate, and a later treaty with the Dutch East India Company, arranged through the Ternate governor Patbrugge, folded Gorontalo into the company's administration, while forced labour in the eighteenth century drove many of its people to migrate to Ternate, Ambon and Banggai.
zh: 哥伦打洛在本地语言中称胡隆塔洛，是苏拉威西北部半岛上的王国，夹在苏拉威西海与哥伦打洛湾之间；其名称一般认为源自“三座山”（Huidu Totolu），指半岛上的三座古山。当地手稿记载，1300年前后这里已有一个名为胡隆塔兰吉的小邦，由胡马兰吉王统治；14世纪时，伊拉胡杜王据说把十七个山地酋长邦合并为哥伦打洛王国，靠称为波哈拉的亲缘秩序维系，女子也可即位为王。1337年时它还是信奉本土信仰的内陆朝廷，最早的城镇建在博朗戈河畔的胡拉瓦。16世纪初，阿迈王接受伊斯兰教并采用苏丹称号；1522年伊拉托王在城镇高地上修建奥塔纳哈要塞，到1525年葡萄牙人抵达北苏拉威西时，这一地区已分属哥伦打洛、林博托、苏瓦瓦、博阿勒莫、阿廷戈拉等穆斯林政权。欧洲人到来之前，这些小邦受特尔纳特苏丹国影响；后来荷兰东印度公司通过特尔纳特总督帕特布鲁赫与哥伦打洛签约，将其纳入公司管辖，18世纪的强迫劳役又迫使许多居民迁往特尔纳特、安汶和邦盖。

en: The County of Gruyère was an Alpine lordship in the upper Sarine valley, in what is now the Swiss canton of Fribourg, attested from the middle of the twelfth century as the successor of the old county of Ogoz. Its rulers took their name from the gruerie, the forest-warden's office they held under the kings of Burgundy, and moved their seat from Château-d'Œx to the hilltop castle of Gruyères. In 1244 Count Rudolf III placed the county under the suzerainty of the House of Savoy while keeping broad autonomy, and in 1331 Count Peter III, ruling in 1337, signed a treaty of combourgeoisie with the city of Fribourg; the counts backed Fribourg against Bern at the Battle of Laupen in 1339. In the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries clever marriage politics extended their rule over Vaud lordships such as Oron and Aubonne, but debt then forced piecemeal sales, including Aigremont to Bern in 1502 and Bellegarde to Fribourg in 1504. After 1528 the counts stood against the Reformation, worsening their quarrel with Protestant Bern. The Swiss Confederation recognised Gruyère as an allied land in 1548, yet in 1554 the federal diet declared the county bankrupt, and in 1555 its creditors Bern and Fribourg divided it: Bern took the upper valley with Saanen and Château-d'Œx, while Fribourg kept Gruyères itself as a bailiwick.
zh: 格吕耶尔伯国是萨讷河上游的阿尔卑斯领地，位于今瑞士弗里堡州境内，12世纪中叶已有记载，前身是古老的奥戈伯国。其统治者的名号得自他们在勃艮第国王麾下担任的森林守御官一职，驻地也从厄堡迁至格吕耶尔山顶城堡。1244年鲁道夫三世伯爵把伯国置于萨伏依家族宗主权之下，但保留了很大自治权；1337年在位的彼得三世曾于1331年与弗里堡城签订共同市民同盟条约，1339年伯国又在劳彭战役中支持弗里堡对抗伯尔尼。14至15世纪，借助精明的联姻策略，伯爵们把统治扩展到沃地区的奥龙、奥博讷等领地，但债务随后迫使他们零敲碎打地变卖产业，包括1502年把艾格勒蒙卖给伯尔尼、1504年把贝勒加德卖给弗里堡。1528年后伯爵们反对宗教改革，与改宗新教的伯尔尼关系更加恶化。1548年瑞士邦联承认格吕耶尔为同盟之地，但1554年邦联议会宣布伯国破产，1555年债权人伯尔尼和弗里堡瓜分其地：伯尔尼取得包括萨嫩和厄堡在内的上游河谷，弗里堡则保有格吕耶尔本城，设为辖区。

en: Güstrow was the chief seat of the lordship of Werle, a Wendish principality of the Holy Roman Empire held by a junior line of the Obotrite House of Mecklenburg. Werle was created in 1235 in the partition that followed the death of Prince Henry Borwin II of Mecklenburg, and took its name from the Werle castle near Güstrow, with lands stretching from Güstrow and Parchim east to the Müritz lakes. It split in 1277 into Werle-Güstrow and Werle-Parchim, was reunited by Nicholas II in 1307, and divided again in 1316 into the Güstrow and Goldberg lines. In 1337 Werle-Güstrow was ruled by John II the Bald, who had held it since 1316 and was buried at Doberan Abbey after his death that August; his sons Nicholas III and Bernard II succeeded him. The Waren branch split off the same year. When the last Werle lord, William, died without heirs in 1436, the whole lordship escheated to the Duchy of Mecklenburg, and the title Lord of Werle passed to the Mecklenburg dukes.
zh: 居斯特罗是韦尔莱领地的主要驻地，这块神圣罗马帝国的文德人诸侯领地由奥博特里特人梅克伦堡家族的旁支统治。梅克伦堡王公亨利·博尔温二世去世后，其领地于1235年被瓜分，韦尔莱由此产生，得名于居斯特罗附近的韦尔莱城堡，辖地从居斯特罗、帕尔希姆向东延伸到米里茨湖区。它于1277年分裂为韦尔莱-居斯特罗和韦尔莱-帕尔希姆，1307年由尼古拉斯二世重新合并，1316年又分为居斯特罗和戈德堡两支。1337年统治韦尔莱-居斯特罗的是自1316年在位的秃头约翰二世，他于当年8月去世，葬在多伯兰修道院，其子尼古拉斯三世和伯恩哈德二世继位；瓦伦支系也在同年分出。1436年末代领主威廉无嗣而终，整个韦尔莱领地收归梅克伦堡公国，“韦尔莱领主”头衔此后由梅克伦堡公爵世代承袭。

en: Gubbio occupies the lower slopes of Monte Ingino in Umbria, on the site of Ikuvium, one of the chief towns of the Umbri; the seven bronze Iguvine Tablets unearthed there in 1444 preserve the longest surviving text in the Umbrian language. As Roman Iguvium it became a municipium, and after the Gothic and Lombard upheavals it passed, with the Pentapolis, under papal overlordship in 774. A Hungarian raid largely destroyed it in 917, and the rebuilt town became a free commune in the eleventh century. Under its bishop Saint Ubald it withstood Barbarossa in 1155, and its citizens fought the neighbouring cities in the Guelph and Ghibelline wars. The Gabrielli family came to dominate the signoria: Giovanni Gabrielli held the city with Visconti backing from 1350 until Cardinal Albornoz received it for the papacy in 1354. After further revolts and papal governors, Gubbio submitted to Antonio da Montefeltro in 1387 and entered the Duchy of Urbino, sharing its fate under the Montefeltro and della Rovere dukes, including a brief occupation by Cesare Borgia after 1502. In 1624 the last duke, Francesco Maria II, ceded the whole duchy to the Church, and Gubbio stagnated under direct papal rule until the Napoleonic conquests of 1798 to 1814, after which it returned to the Papal States.
zh: 古比奥位于翁布里亚的因吉诺山低坡上，前身是翁布里人重镇伊库维乌姆；1444年在当地出土的七块伊古维翁铜表，保存着现存最长的翁布里亚语文献。罗马时期它成为自治城伊古维乌姆，经历哥特人与伦巴第人的动荡后，于774年随五城地区转归教皇宗主权之下。917年匈牙利人的入侵几乎将它摧毁，重建后的城镇在11世纪成为自由公社。在主教圣乌巴尔多带领下，它于1155年顶住了巴巴罗萨的围攻，市民们又在圭尔夫与吉伯林战争中与邻邦诸城邦交战。加布里埃利家族逐渐把持领主之位：乔瓦尼·加布里埃利在维斯孔蒂家族支持下于1350年执政，直到1354年枢机主教阿尔沃诺斯代表教皇接收该城。经过又一轮起义和教皇派总督之后，古比奥于1387年臣服于安东尼奥·达·蒙泰费尔特罗，并入乌尔比诺公国，随蒙泰费尔特罗和德拉·罗韦雷两任公爵家族一同兴衰，1502年后还曾被切萨雷·博尔贾短暂占领。1624年末代公爵弗朗切斯科·马里亚二世把整个公国割让给教会，古比奥在教皇直接统治下走向萧条，直到1798至1814年拿破仑征服时期，此后又重归教皇国。

en: Guge was the dynastic kingdom of far western Tibet, spread across the Sutlej valley in Ngari with its capitals at Tholing and the clifftop citadel of Tsaparang. It was founded around 912 by Kyide Nyimagon, a great-grandson of Langdarma, the last king of the old Tibetan Empire, who fled the disorders of Ü-Tsang in 910; his sons divided the inheritance into Ladakh, Guge-Purang and Zanskar. Under King Yeshe-Ö and the translator Rinchen Zangpo the kingdom led the second diffusion of Buddhism in Tibet, and after Yeshe-Ö died a prisoner of the Karluks rather than abandon his faith, his kinsman invited the Indian master Atiśa to Guge in 1040. Reunited by Grags pa lde around 1265, when he subdued the Ya rtse kingdom, Guge passed under Sakya overlordship after 1277, but revived as Yuan power faded, seizing Purang in 1378 and briefly ruling Ladakh. From 1499 its kings acknowledged the Rinpungpa of Tsang, and in 1630 a Ladakhi army, called in by rebel commanders, took Tsaparang and deported the last king; in 1679 and 1680 the Fifth Dalai Lama's government expelled the Ladakhis and annexed Guge to central Tibet.
zh: 古格是西藏西部的王朝，疆域在阿里的象泉河流域，以托林和悬崖上的扎布让城堡为都。910年，吐蕃末代赞普朗达玛的曾孙吉德尼玛衮为避卫藏之乱西逃，约912年建立政权，兼并布让与古格；他的儿子们把家业分为麻域（拉达克）、古格—布让和赞斯喀尔三支。在意希沃王和译师仁钦桑布时期，古格主导了藏传佛教的后弘期复兴；意希沃被葛逻禄人俘虏，不肯弃佛而死，其族人遂于1040年迎请印度大师阿底峡入藏。约1265年扎巴德重新统一古格并征服亚泽王国，1277年后古格沦为萨迦政权的属邦；元朝衰落后它再度振兴，1378年夺取普兰，并曾在14世纪末短暂统治拉达克。1499年起，古格王不得不臣服于藏地的仁蚌巴；17世纪30年代，叛军引来拉达克军队攻陷扎布让，末代国王被掳走，1679年至1680年，五世达赖喇嘛的政权驱逐拉达克人，把古格并入卫藏。

en: Fada N'gourma, known to its own rulers as Nungu, was the capital of the Gurma, or Gourmantché, kingdom in the east of what is now Burkina Faso; its Hausa name means residence of the chief of Gourma. The town was founded as Bingo early in the 1200s by Diaba Lompo, whom Mossi tradition calls the eldest son of the horseman Ouédraogo and a grandson of the princess Yennenga, making this Gurma line a sister dynasty to the Mossi kingdoms. The early rulers kept their court at Pama until the fourteenth successor, Yandabili, who reigned from 1709 to 1736, moved the capital to Nungu, the land of the Nanumba in Gourmantché speech. In the 1500s and 1600s the Gurma state was strong enough to make repeated war on the Songhai Empire to its north, and it kept its own king and ritual life on the eastern edge of the Mossi world long after the Songhai had passed their peak.
