zh: 法达恩古尔马在本国君主口中称农古，是古尔马（古尔芒切）王国的都城，位于今布基纳法索东部；其豪萨语名称意为“古尔马酋长的居所”。13世纪初，迪亚巴·隆波建立此城，当时称宾戈；莫西口传传统把他视为骑手韦德拉奥果的长子、公主延嫩加之孙，因此古尔马王统与诸莫西王国是姊妹王朝。早期君主驻跸于帕马，直到第十四代继承者扬达比利（1709—1736年在位）把都城迁到农古——在古尔芒切语里意为“纳农巴人的土地”。16至17世纪，古尔马国家强盛到屡次北伐桑海帝国；在桑海鼎盛期过后很久，它仍在莫西世界的东缘保有自己的国王和礼仪生活。

en: Gwalior, crowned by one of India's greatest hill forts, stood on the border between Rajputana and the Gangetic plain. Iltutmish of Delhi took the fort in 1231, and through the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries its Tomara chiefs held the surrounding country as feudatories of the Delhi Sultans. In 1394 the Tomara leader Virasimha seized the fortress by a ruse and founded an independent kingdom, which reached its height under Man Singh Tomar, reigning from 1486: he built the Man Mandir palace within the fort and made Gwalior a celebrated centre of Hindu music, seed of the later Gwalior gharana. His long resistance to Sikandar Lodi ended when Ibrahim Lodi forced his son Vikramaditya to surrender the fort, and in 1526 this last Tomar raja died fighting at Panipat. From 1528 Gwalior passed to the Mughals and remained an imperial fortress for two centuries. In 1731 the Maratha general Ranoji Scindia, assigned the revenues of Malwa by the Peshwa, founded the Scindia state with its capital at Ujjain, and his successor Mahadji Scindia, reigning from 1761, built it into the leading Maratha power of central India. Defeat in the Second Anglo-Maratha War of 1803 brought the Scindias under British suzerainty, and Gwalior, its capital now moved beside the old fort, became the largest princely state of the British Central India Agency.
zh: 瓜廖尔扼守拉杰普塔纳与恒河平原之间的通道，山顶堡垒是印度最雄伟的山堡之一。德里的伊勒杜迷失于1231年攻占该堡，此后13至14世纪，本地的都摩罗首领作为德里苏丹的封臣据有周围地区。1394年，都摩罗首领维拉辛哈用计夺取堡垒，建立独立王国；王国在1486年即位的曼·辛格·都摩罗治下达到鼎盛，他在堡内修建曼·曼迪尔宫，并把瓜廖尔经营成印度教音乐的名城，日后的瓜廖尔乐派即发源于此。他长期抵抗西坎达尔·洛迪，但其子维克拉玛蒂亚挡不住易卜拉欣·洛迪，被迫交出堡垒；1526年，这位末代都摩罗罗阇在帕尼帕特之战中战死。1528年瓜廖尔转入莫卧儿之手，作为帝国堡垒延续了两个世纪。1731年，马拉塔将领拉诺吉·辛迪亚受佩什瓦委派掌管马尔瓦税收，开创辛迪亚政权，定都乌贾因；其继任者马哈杰迪·辛迪亚于1761年继位后，把它建成中印度首屈一指的马拉塔强权。1803年第二次英国—马拉塔战争战败后，辛迪亚家族接受英国宗主权，都城迁到古堡附近，瓜廖尔成为英属中印度代理区最大的土邦。

en: Gwiriko was a Dyula kingdom of the upper Mouhoun, the Black Volta, in what is now southwestern Burkina Faso; its name means beyond the forest in Dyula, and its chief city was Sya, the town later called Bobo-Dioulasso. Sia had been founded by Bobo farmers and traders in the 1400s and grew into a horse market on the routes linking Djenné and the Niger bend with Kong and the Gold Coast. In 1710 Sékou Ouattara built the Kong Empire, and around 1714 he sent his brother Famagan Ouattara into the Mouhoun bend, where Gwiriko took shape. Famagan's men conquered Sia in the late 1730s and subdued the Bobo-Dioula and Bobo-Oule, and when Sékou died about 1740 Famagan refused to serve his nephews, seized Tiefo, Dafin and Bwamu and made himself an independent ruler in alliance with the Bobo-Dioula. His Ouattara descendants kept the throne, but their subject peoples revolted again and again, and by the 1830s the Tiefo, Bobo and Bolon were breaking away as the kingdom weakened.
zh: 圭里科是位于穆翁河（黑沃尔特河）上游的迪乌拉人王国，在今布基纳法索西南部；其名称在迪乌拉语中意为“森林之外”，都城是锡亚，即后来的博博迪乌拉索。锡亚由博博人的农民和商人建于15世纪，后来成为马匹市场，处在连接杰内、尼日尔河河曲与孔格、黄金海岸的商路上。1710年塞古·瓦塔拉建立孔格帝国，约1714年他派弟弟法马甘·瓦塔拉进入穆翁河河曲，圭里科由此成形。法马甘的部众在1730年代末攻占锡亚，征服博博-迪乌拉和博博-乌莱人；塞古约1740年死后，法马甘拒绝向侄子们称臣，夺取蒂埃福、达凡和布瓦穆，与博博-迪乌拉人结盟自立。他的瓦塔拉后裔世代在位，但属民一再反叛，到19世纪30年代，蒂埃福人、博博人和博隆人纷纷脱离，王国走向衰弱。

en: The Kingdom of Garhwal was a Himalayan Hindu state in the upper Ganges valley, ruled without interruption by the Panwar dynasty from its traditional founding in 823 until 1803. Its first king Kanak Pal, a prince from Malwa on pilgrimage to Badrinath, married the heiress of Chandpur Garhi, one of the fifty-two hill fortresses, or garhs, that then divided the region; his descendants spent the next centuries subduing the rest. In 1337 the throne belonged to Anant Pal, and in 1358 his successor Ajay Pal merged the remaining chiefdoms into a single kingdom with its capital at Devalgarh and later Srinagar. The mountain state held its own against the Mughals: after Mahipat Shah's death his queen Karnavati ruled as regent and in 1640 broke the army of Najabat Khan, earning the name Nakti Rani for the noses she took from invaders. Fateh Shah fought at Bhangani in 1688 against the Sikh guru Gobind Singh, and in his reign the Sikh leader Ram Rai founded a camp that became the town of Dehradun. Rohilla raiders carried off Dehradun in 1757, but Garhwal retook the Dun valley in 1770. Nepal's Gorkhas overran the kingdom in 1803 and ruled it harshly for twelve years; after the Anglo-Nepalese War the Treaty of Sugauli of 1815 split Garhwal in two, the east going to the British while Sudarshan Shah kept the western half as the princely state of Tehri Garhwal.
zh: 加瓦尔王国是恒河上游河谷的喜马拉雅印度教政权，般婆罗王朝按传统说法自823年起连续统治，直至1803年。初代国王迦纳格·帕尔是来自马尔瓦的王子，前往巴德里纳特朝圣时娶了金德布尔加希的女继承人——那是当时瓜分该地区的五十二座山间要塞之一；其后人数百年间逐一征服其余要塞。1337年在位的是阿南特·帕尔；1358年，继任者阿杰·帕尔把余下小邦合并为统一王国，先后以德沃尔加尔和斯利那加为都。这个山地王国顶住了莫卧儿的压力：马希帕特·沙阿死后，王后卡尔纳瓦蒂临朝称制，于1640年击溃纳贾巴特汗的军队，因割下入侵者的鼻子而得到割鼻王后的绰号。1688年，法塔赫·沙阿在邦加尼战役中与锡克古鲁戈宾德·辛格交战；他在位时，锡克领袖拉姆·拉伊的营地发展为后来的台拉登城。1757年罗希拉人袭占台拉登，但加瓦尔于1770年收复登河谷。1803年尼泊尔的廓尔喀人征服该国，进行了十二年的严酷统治；英国—尼泊尔战争后，1815年的《苏高利条约》把加瓦尔一分为二，东部并入英属印度，苏达尔尚·沙阿保留西半部分，成为特里加瓦尔土邦。

en: Gower was a marcher lordship on the coast of south Wales, covering the Gower Peninsula and the country around its chief castle at Swansea. Once a Welsh commote of the kingdom of Deheubarth, it was overrun by Anglo-Norman invaders around 1106, when Henry de Beaumont, Earl of Warwick, planted Swansea Castle and organized the territory as a lordship nearly independent of the English crown. It passed by marriage to the de Braose family and later to the Mowbrays. A disputed sale of Gower to Hugh Despenser helped spark the baronial revolt of 1321, in which John de Mowbray was executed; his widow Aline recovered the lordship in 1327, and in 1337 it was held by their son John. His descendant Thomas de Mowbray became Duke of Norfolk, but family grip weakened when the lordship passed to William Herbert, Earl of Pembroke, in 1468, and in 1479 Edward IV granted it to his son Prince Edward. The Laws in Wales Acts of 1535 and 1542 ended Gower's separate marcher status and absorbed it into the English county system.
zh: 高尔是南威尔士沿海的一个边境领主领，涵盖高尔半岛及首要城堡斯旺西一带。这里原是德赫巴思王国的威尔士人康莫特，约1106年被盎格鲁-诺曼入侵者攻占，沃里克伯爵亨利·德·博蒙特修建斯旺西城堡，把这片土地组建成一个几乎独立于英格兰王权的领主领。它后来随婚姻转入德·布劳斯家族，再归莫布雷家族。把高尔卖给休·勒德斯潘塞的争议交易成为1321年贵族叛乱的导火索之一，约翰·莫布雷在叛乱中被处决；其遗孀艾琳于1327年收回领地，1337年由他们的儿子约翰持有。他的后裔托马斯·莫布雷受封诺福克公爵，但1468年领地转入彭布罗克伯爵威廉·赫伯特之手，1479年爱德华四世又把它封给儿子爱德华王子。1535年和1542年的《威尔士法令》取消了高尔的边境领独立地位，将其并入英格兰的郡制。

en: Gyelrong, the rGyal-mo tsha-wa rong or valley of the queen, covers the steep gorges of the Dadu River headwaters in north-western Sichuan, home to the Qiangic-speaking Gyalrong people, who call themselves Keru. The region was divided among some eighteen small chiefdoms, each ruled by a hereditary tusi under Ming and then Qing suzerainty. Bön was the dominant faith until Gelug missionaries from central Tibet arrived in the early fifteenth century and founded large monasteries such as Dhe-Tsang against strong Bön opposition. In 1726 the Yongzheng emperor's bureaucratisation drive, meant to replace tusi with imperial officials, met armed resistance in Sichuan. War came openly in 1747, when Slob Dpon of Greater Jinchuan attacked the Chakla chiefdom and surrendered only in 1749; a second rising ended in 1776 with the fall of Sonom after a five-year Qing campaign, among the costliest of the Qianlong emperor's Ten Great Campaigns.
zh: 嘉绒得名于藏语“嘉摩察瓦荣”，意为女王的河谷，地处四川西北部大渡河上游的深峡之中，居民是说羌语支语言的嘉绒人，他们自称“革如”。这一地区分成约十八个小酋长国，各自由世袭土司统治，先后臣属于明朝和清朝。苯教曾是当地的主要信仰，15世纪初来自西藏中部的格鲁派传教士不顾苯教僧侣的强烈反对，建起德桑寺等大寺院。1726年，雍正皇帝推行改土归流、以流官取代土司，在四川遭到武装抵抗。1747年战争公开爆发，大金川土司莎罗奔进攻明正土司，直到1749年才投降；1771年第二次战事再起，索诺木在清军五年征讨后于1776年败亡，此役是乾隆帝“十全武功”中耗费最巨的战争之一。

en: The Gayogohono, the People of the Great Swamp, are the Cayuga, one of the five founding nations of the Haudenosaunee. Their longhouse towns, including Cayuga Castle and Chonodote, stood along Cayuga Lake in the Finger Lakes country of present-day central New York, between the Onondaga to the east and the Seneca to the west. French traders and missionaries coming down the St. Lawrence were their first European contacts, followed by Dutch merchants who supplied the league with gunpowder. During the American Revolution the Cayuga were divided, with warriors serving on both sides, but after Haudenosaunee raids on the frontier in 1778 Washington ordered the Sullivan Expedition, which in 1779 destroyed forty to fifty league villages, among them the principal Cayuga towns, and burned their crops and winter stores. Survivors took refuge with other nations, followed Joseph Brant to the Grand River in Upper Canada, or joined the Mingo bands already settled in the Ohio Country. The New York Cayuga ceded most of their land in the Canandaigua (Pickering) treaty of 1794, their small reservation on Cayuga Lake was soon surrendered, and in 1831 the Ohio bands were removed to Indian Territory, where they became the Seneca-Cayuga.
zh: 加耶戈霍诺意为“大沼泽之人”，即卡尤加人，是霍迪诺肖尼五个创始族之一。他们的长屋村镇——包括卡尤加堡和乔诺多特——坐落在今纽约州中部五指湖地区的卡尤加湖畔，东接奥农达人，西邻居内卡人。沿圣劳伦斯河而来的法国商人与传教士是他们最早接触的欧洲人，随后荷兰商人又向联盟供应火药。美国独立战争期间卡尤加人立场分裂，战士分别为交战双方效力；但1778年霍迪诺肖尼各部袭扰边疆之后，华盛顿下令发动沙利文远征，1779年远征军摧毁了联盟四十至五十座村落，其中包括卡尤加人的主要城镇，还烧掉了他们的庄稼和冬粮。幸存者或投奔其他部族，或随约瑟夫·布兰特前往上加拿大的格兰德河，或加入早已定居俄亥俄地区的明戈群体。纽约的卡尤加人在1794年的卡南代瓜条约（又称皮克林条约）中割让了大部分土地，卡尤加湖畔的小保留地不久也被放弃；1831年俄亥俄的族人被迁往印第安领地，后来形成塞内卡-卡尤加群体。

en: Gyelthang, the royal plain in Tibetan and called Jiantang or Zhongdian in Chinese, was a Tibetan chiefdom on the high plateau of northwestern Yunnan, where Khampa pastoralists met the Naxi and Han trading peoples of the low valleys. In Song times it was known as Dandang under the Dali kingdom, and in 1293 the Yuan placed it under the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs. From the mid-Ming it fell within the Lijiang prefecture of the Naxi Mu chiefs. Khoshut Mongol armies conquered Gyelthang in 1667, and the Fifth Dalai Lama founded the great Gelug monastery of Ganden Sumtseling there in 1679, which became the largest monastery in the region. The Qing brought the district under Lijiang Prefecture in Yunnan in 1726, and in 1756 it was organised as the Zhongdian sub-prefecture under Lijiang.
zh: 建塘藏语意为王者的平川，汉语又作建塘、中甸，是云南西北高原上的藏族土司政权，也是康巴牧人与低地纳西族、汉族商人往来交汇之地。宋代这里称旦当，臣属大理国；1293年元朝将其划归宣政院下属的吐蕃等路宣慰司。明代中叶以后，此地成为纳西族丽江木氏知府辖下的忠甸。1667年和硕特蒙古军队攻占建塘，五世达赖喇嘛于1679年敕建格鲁派大寺噶丹松赞林，它后来成为迪庆最大的寺院。1726年清朝将这一地区划归云南丽江府，1756年正式设中甸厅，置同知管理。

en: Guzhou was a Kam chiefdom in the wooded hills of southeastern Guizhou, its seat at Luoli in present-day Liping County. The Tang dynasty first organised the district as the prefecture of Guzhou in 638, governing the three counties of Leyu, Gushu and Lexing across present-day Congjiang and Rongjiang in Guizhou and Sanjiang in Guangxi, and under the Mongol Yuan it became the Guzhou Bawandong chiefdom, ruled through the Tian family of Sizhou. In 1397 the Kam leader Lin Kuan rose in rebellion here, killing the Ming battalion commander Wu De before the rising was put down. The Ming re-established the domain in 1403 as the Guzhou native long commandery, which became one of the thirteen Kam chieftaincies placed under Liping Prefecture in 1413. In 1729 the Qing created a separate Guzhou sub-prefecture further west at Rongjiang, and the great Miao uprising of 1735 to 1736 broke out in the Guzhou country.
zh: 古州是今贵州东南黎平一带山林中的侗族土司，治所在今黎平县罗里。唐朝于638年在这一地区设古州，领乐预、古书、乐兴三县，辖境横跨今榕江、从江及广西三江；元代改设古州八万洞总管府，由思州田氏统辖。1397年，侗族人林宽在此起兵反明，击杀千户吴得，起义最终被明军镇压。1403年明朝复置古州蛮夷长官司，1413年黎平府设立后，它成为府下十三个长官司之一。1729年，清朝又在更西边的榕江生苗之地另设古州厅，1735—1736年的苗民大起义便自古州九股河一带爆发。

en: The Duchy of Austria was a Holy Roman Empire principality on the Danube, raised from the old Bavarian Eastern March when Emperor Frederick Barbarossa detached it from Bavaria by the Privilegium Minus of 1156 under the Babenberg dukes. When the Babenbergs died out in 1246, King Ottokar II of Bohemia seized the lands, until Rudolf of Habsburg, elected King of the Romans, defeated and killed him at the Battle on the Marchfeld in 1278 and in 1282 enfeoffed Austria to his own sons, making it the homeland of the Habsburg dynasty. In 1337 the duke was Albert II, called the Wise, who held Styria and in 1335 added Carinthia and Carniola, joining the territories later called the Habsburg Hereditary Lands; his son Rudolf IV invented the archducal title through the forged Privilegium Maius of 1359 and gained Tyrol in 1363. The Treaty of Neuberg of 1379 split the lands between Albertinian and Leopoldian lines, but after Duke Albert V was elected King of the Romans in 1438 the imperial crown stayed effectively with the Habsburgs, and Frederick III secured recognition of Austria as an archduchy in 1453.
zh: 奥地利公国是多瑙河畔的神圣罗马帝国邦国，前身是巴伐利亚东部藩侯国；1156年，皇帝红胡子腓特烈一世颁布《小特权》，将它从巴伐利亚分出，升为巴本堡家族统治的独立公国。1246年巴本堡家族绝嗣，波希米亚国王奥托卡二世乘乱夺取其地，直到当选罗马人的国王的哈布斯堡的鲁道夫在1278年的杜恩克鲁特战役中将他击败击杀，并于1282年把奥地利分封给自己的儿子，这里从此成为哈布斯堡家族的祖业。1337年在位的是智者阿尔布雷希特二世，他领有施蒂利亚，又于1335年取得克恩顿和卡尼奥拉，这些土地后来合称哈布斯堡世袭领地；其子鲁道夫四世于1359年以伪造的《大特权》创设大公头衔，并在1363年取得蒂罗尔。1379年的《诺伊贝格条约》把领地分给阿尔布雷希特和利奥波德两个支系，但1438年奥地利公爵阿尔布雷希特五世当选罗马人的国王后，皇位实际落入哈布斯堡家族之手，腓特烈三世又于1453年正式确认奥地利为大公国。

en: The Margraviate of Baden-Hachberg was a territory of the Holy Roman Empire in the Breisgau, between the Black Forest and the upper Rhine, ruled from the Hochburg on the Hachberg above Emmendingen. It arose around 1212 when Henry I and his brother Herman V divided the inheritance of their father Herman IV of Baden, and through the thirteenth century the Hachberg line held its ground against the Counts of Freiburg in the rivalry for the Breisgau. In 1306 a further partition gave Hachberg and Emmendingen to Margrave Henry III, while his brother Rudolf received the southern Lordship of Sausenberg, which also acquired Rötteln in 1315 and survived as the Hachberg-Sausenberg line until 1503. Between 1390 and 1409 Hachberg fought the Counts of Fürstenberg over the Lordship of Prechtal, a dispute settled by turning it into a condominium. In 1415 the last margrave, Otto II, sold the castle and lordship to his kinsman Bernard I of Baden, and with Otto's death in 1418 the Hachberg-Hachberg line became extinct, its lands becoming the Oberamt of Hochberg. A short-lived recreation under Margrave James III lasted only from 1584 to 1590.
zh: 巴登-哈赫贝格藩侯领是神圣罗马帝国在布赖斯高、黑森林与上莱茵之间的一块领地，统治中心是埃门丁根上方哈赫贝格山上的霍赫堡。约1212年，亨利一世与弟弟赫尔曼五世瓜分父亲巴登的赫尔曼四世的遗产，藩侯领由此产生；整个13世纪，哈赫贝格一支在争夺布赖斯高的角力中顶住了弗赖堡伯爵家族的竞争。1306年再次分家：藩侯亨利三世得到哈赫贝格和埃门丁根，其弟鲁道夫得到南方的绍森贝格领地，后者又于1315年取得勒特恩，作为哈赫贝格-绍森贝格支系一直延续到1503年。1390至1409年，哈赫贝格为普雷希塔尔领地与菲尔斯滕贝格伯爵交战，最终以双方共管收场。1415年末代藩侯奥托二世把城堡和领地卖给亲族巴登的伯恩哈德一世，随着奥托于1418年去世，哈赫贝格-哈赫贝格支系绝嗣，其领地成为霍赫堡高级辖区。1584至1590年，藩侯雅各布三世曾短暂重建这一藩侯领。

en: Hadoti is the fertile south-eastern corner of Rajputana, watered by the Chambal and its tributaries and taking its name from the Hada Rajputs, a branch of the Chauhan clan. Before the Rajputs arrived, the country around Bundi was held by Meena and Bhil tribes, and Bundi itself is named after Bunda Meena, a Meena chieftain of the thirteenth century. In 1241 Rao Deva, a Hada Chauhan leader whose kin had fled the victories of Muhammad of Ghor, seized Bundi from the Meenas and made it the capital of the kingdom that became known as Hadoti; his successors took Kota in 1264. For two centuries the Hadas of Bundi ruled as vassals of the Sisodias of Mewar, until Rao Surjan Singh submitted to Akbar after the siege of Ranthambore and received the title of Rao Raja in 1569. Hada troops then served in the Mughal armies, and in 1631 the Emperor Shah Jahan divided the realm by granting Kota to Rao Madho Singh, creating the separate kingdom of Kota. Bundi and Kota flourished as rivals, but both were exposed to the Maratha and Pindari raids of the later eighteenth century, and in 1818 their rulers accepted subsidiary alliances with the British East India Company and continued as princely states under British protection.
zh: 哈多蒂是拉杰普塔纳东南隅的肥沃之地，受昌巴尔河及其支流滋养，得名于乔汉族的分支哈达拉杰普特人。拉杰普特人到来之前，本迪一带由迷那人和比尔部落占据，本迪的名字便来自13世纪的迷那首领本达·迷那。1241年，哈达·乔汉首领拉奥·德瓦——其族人因古尔的穆罕默德节节取胜而逃散——从迷那人手中夺取本迪并定为都城，这个王国后来便称哈多蒂；他的后继者又于1264年攻取科塔。此后两百年间，本迪的哈达人作为梅瓦尔西索迪亚王朝的藩属实施统治，直到拉奥·苏尔詹·辛格在兰坦博尔围城战后归顺阿克巴，于1569年受封拉奥·罗阇称号。哈达军队随后随莫卧儿大军征战；1631年，皇帝沙贾汗分封疆土，把科塔封给拉奥·马多·辛格，由此产生了独立的科塔王国。本迪与科塔两强并立、彼此竞争，却都在18世纪后期遭马拉塔人和平达里人劫掠，1818年两地君主同英国东印度公司缔结附属同盟，作为受英国保护的土邦延续下去。

en: The imperial city of Haguenau in Lower Alsace began early in the twelfth century, when Duke Frederick II the One-Eyed of Swabia built a hunting lodge on an island in the river Moder. The Emperor Frederick I Barbarossa fortified the settlement, granted it town rights in 1154 and raised an imperial palace there, his favourite residence, where the imperial crown, sceptre, orb and sword of Charlemagne were kept. Richard of Cornwall made Haguenau an imperial city in 1257, and under Rudolf I it became the seat of the Landvogt, the emperor's advocate in Lower Alsace. From 1354 it led the Decapole, a league of ten Alsatian imperial cities, whose executive council met within its walls. The Peace of Westphalia in 1648 transferred imperial rights over Alsace to France, and after Louis XIV had the fortifications and the ruined palace razed in 1673, the Treaties of Nijmegen in 1679 ended Haguenau's imperial status and joined it to France.
zh: 阿格诺是下阿尔萨斯的帝国城市，起源于12世纪初士瓦本公爵“独眼龙”腓特烈二世在莫德尔河一座岛上修建的狩猎行宫。皇帝腓特烈一世（巴巴罗萨）加固了聚落，于1154年授予城市权，并在此兴建他最喜爱的帝国宫殿，查理曼的帝国皇冠、权杖、宝球和宝剑都收藏于此。1257年，康沃尔的理查将阿格诺升格为帝国城市；鲁道夫一世时，它成为帝国驻下阿尔萨斯地方总督的驻地。1354年起，它主导由十座阿尔萨斯帝国城市组成的十城联盟，联盟的执行会议就在城内召开。1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》把阿尔萨斯的帝国权利转交给法国；路易十四于1673年下令拆毁城防和宫殿废墟后，1679年的《奈梅亨条约》终结了阿格诺的帝国地位，将其并入法国。

en: The County of Hainaut was a French-speaking lordship of the Holy Roman Empire on the frontier with France, named after the river Haine, with Valenciennes and Mons as its chief towns. It began as a Frankish pagus recorded in the eighth century, passed to Lotharingia after the partition of 843, and was attached to the East Frankish kingdom around 925. The county took roughly its final shape in 1071, and its counts repeatedly held neighbouring lands through inheritance, ruling Flanders for periods and uniting Hainaut with Holland and Zeeland from 1299. In 1337 the count was William I of Avesnes, called the Good, whose daughters Philippa and Margaret married Edward III of England and the Emperor Louis IV. After his son William II fell in battle in 1345, the three counties passed through Margaret II to the Wittelsbach dukes of Bavaria-Straubing in 1356, and in 1432 to the Valois dukes of Burgundy, joining the Burgundian Netherlands that the Habsburgs inherited in the 1470s. Southern Hainaut was ceded to France in 1659 and 1678, while the north remained in the Habsburg Netherlands until French revolutionary armies annexed it in 1797.
zh: 埃诺伯国是神圣罗马帝国位于法兰西边境的法语领地，得名于境内的埃讷河，主要城市为瓦朗谢讷和蒙斯。其前身是8世纪已见记载的法兰克人行政区，843年帝国三分后划归洛塔林吉亚，约925年并入东法兰克王国。伯国疆域在1071年基本定型，历代伯爵常凭继承关系兼领邻近土地，曾阶段性统治佛兰德，并从1299年起将埃诺与荷兰、泽兰合为一体。1337年在位的是阿韦讷家族的威廉一世，绰号好人，他的两个女儿菲莉帕和玛格丽特分别嫁给英格兰国王爱德华三世与皇帝路易四世。其子威廉二世于1345年战死后，三块伯国经玛格丽特二世之手在1356年转入维特尔斯巴赫家族的巴伐利亚-施特劳宾支系统治，1432年又归入瓦卢瓦家族的勃艮第公爵，成为勃艮第尼德兰的一部分，并于15世纪70年代由哈布斯堡家族继承。埃诺南部于1659年和1678年割让给法兰西，北部留在哈布斯堡尼德兰，直到1797年被法兰西革命军吞并。

en: Halych, on the Dniester, was the center of the Principality of Galicia, formed between 1124 and 1144 from the smaller Rus' principalities of Peremyshl, Zvenyhorod and Terebovlia. In 1199 Prince Roman the Great united Galicia with neighboring Volhynia, creating the Kingdom of Galicia-Volhynia, also called the Kingdom of Ruthenia, one of the three chief successor states of Kievan Rus. After the Mongol invasion of 1239 to 1241 its rulers became tributaries of the Golden Horde, though Prince Daniel was crowned King of Ruthenia by the Pope in 1253. When the old Rurikid line failed in 1323, the boyars accepted Boleslaw Jerzy of the Masovian Piasts, a grandson of King Yuri I, who ruled as Yuri II and in 1337 still governed Halych and Volhynia as a Horde tributary. His murder by rebellious Orthodox boyars in 1340 opened the long Galicia-Volhynia Wars, and in 1349 Casimir III of Poland conquered Galicia, adding King of Ruthenia to his titles. In 1434 the land became the Polish Ruthenian Voivodeship, and its last remnants of separate legal status were removed in 1506.
zh: 哈利奇位于德涅斯特河畔，是加利西亚公国的中心；该公国于1124年至1144年间由佩列梅什利、兹韦尼哥罗德和捷列博夫利亚等较小的罗斯公国合并而成。1199年，罗曼大帝将加利西亚与邻近的沃里尼亚合并，建立加利西亚-沃里尼亚王国，又称鲁塞尼亚王国，是基辅罗斯崩溃后三大主要继承国之一。1239年至1241年蒙古入侵后，其统治者成为金帐汗国的附庸，但丹尼尔王公仍于1253年被教皇加冕为鲁塞尼亚国王。1323年留里克旧支绝嗣，波雅尔们迎立马佐夫舍皮亚斯特家族的博莱斯瓦夫·耶日——国王尤里一世的外孙，他改称尤里二世，1337年时仍以金帐汗国附庸的身份统治哈利奇与沃里尼亚。1340年他被反叛的东正教波雅尔毒杀，引发漫长的加利西亚-沃里尼亚继承战争；1349年波兰国王卡齐米日三世征服加利西亚，并在头衔中加上“鲁塞尼亚国王”。1434年该地成为波兰的鲁塞尼亚省，其残存的特殊法律地位也于1506年被废除。

en: Hamburg grew up around the Hammaburg, a fortress built on the marshy ground between the Elbe and the Alster on Charlemagne's orders in 808. A bishopric was founded there in 834 under Ansgar, the Apostle of the North, and soon merged with Bremen to form the archbishopric of Hamburg-Bremen, while the town itself was repeatedly sacked by Vikings and others. In 1189 Frederick Barbarossa granted Hamburg the rights of a free imperial city, including toll-free passage down the Elbe to the North Sea. Its 1241 alliance with Lübeck is regarded as the beginning of the Hanseatic League, and in 1266 its merchants secured their own trading guild, or hanse, in London. Hamburg became one of the leading Hanseatic ports, and the civic compromise of 1410 gave it its first constitution. The city adopted Lutheranism in 1529 and strengthened its walls during the Thirty Years' War, adding the grid-plan Neustadt. On the dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire in 1806 it became the sovereign Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg, was annexed to Napoleon's empire from 1811 to 1814, and had its independence confirmed by the Congress of Vienna in 1815 as one of the states of the German Confederation.
zh: 汉堡起源于808年查理曼下令在易北河与阿尔斯特河之间沼泽地上修建的哈马堡。834年这里在有“北方使徒”之称的安斯加尔主持下设立主教区，不久与不来梅合并为汉堡-不来梅大主教区，而城镇本身屡遭维京人等劫掠。1189年，腓特烈·巴巴罗萨授予汉堡帝国自由城市地位，包括沿易北河直抵北海的免税通行权。1241年它与吕贝克结盟，被视为汉萨同盟的开端；1266年，汉堡商人在伦敦获得了自己的商站“汉萨”。汉堡由此成为汉萨同盟的主要港口之一，1410年的市政妥协案为它带来了第一部宪法。1529年汉堡改宗路德宗，三十年战争期间加固城防并增建了棋盘式布局的新城。1806年神圣罗马帝国解体后，它成为主权独立的自由汉萨城市汉堡，1811至1814年被并入拿破仑的帝国，1815年维也纳会议确认其独立，成为德意志邦联的成员国之一。

en: Hawai'i, the largest of the Hawaiian Islands, was settled by Polynesian voyagers between 940 and 1200 and divided into districts ruled by local chiefs, or ali'i, under a high chief. Its ruling house in this age was the Pili line, founded, according to tradition, by Pilika'aiea, a chief from Samoa brought to the island by the priest Pa'ao. Each island was governed separately, and wars between rival chiefdoms were constant. Early in the fourteenth century the high chief Kalaunuiohua carried Hawai'i's arms across the chain: he defeated and captured the rulers of Maui, Moloka'i and O'ahu, but on Kaua'i his army was routed at the battle of Kawelewele and Kukona of Kaua'i kept him prisoner for several years. Later Pili chiefs included Līloa and his son Umi, who in the sixteenth century became the first ruler to unite almost the whole Big Island. The line's final heir was Kamehameha, who after James Cook's landing in 1778 used European ships and firearms to conquer the islands in 1795 and complete the unified Kingdom of Hawai'i in 1810.
zh: 夏威夷是夏威夷群岛中最大的岛屿，940年至1200年间由波利尼西亚航海者定居，岛上分为若干地区，由地方酋长（阿里伊）在一位最高酋长之下分别治理。这一时代的统治家族是皮利王朝，相传其始祖皮利卡阿伊埃阿是萨摩亚首领，由祭司帕奥带到岛上。各岛各自为政，敌对酋邦之间战争不断。14世纪初，最高酋长卡劳努伊奥华把夏威夷的兵锋带到整个群岛：他击败并俘虏了毛伊、莫洛凯和瓦胡三岛的统治者，但在考艾岛，他的军队于卡韦勒韦勒战役中溃败，本人被考艾酋长库科纳囚禁数年。后来的皮利朝酋长包括利洛阿及其子乌米，后者于16世纪成为第一个几乎统一整座大岛的统治者。该家族最后的继承人是卡美哈梅哈：1778年库克登陆后，他借助欧洲船只和火器于1795年征服群岛，并于1810年建成统一的夏威夷王国。

en: The Lordship of Heinsberg was a small territory of the Holy Roman Empire centred on the town and castle of Heinsberg, west of Cologne in the present-day German state of North Rhine-Westphalia. Its lords first appeared at the end of the eleventh century, when Goswin of the Wassenberg family styled himself lord of Heinsberg and, through his marriage to the heiress Oda, also acquired the neighbouring Land of Valkenburg. Compact though it was, the lordship carried imperial standing, its lords ranking among the empire's princely families, and Philip of Heinsberg became Archbishop of Cologne and archchancellor of the empire in the twelfth century. Heinsberg preserved its independence by attaching itself in turn to the strongest power on the Lower Rhine: the Electorate of Cologne until the Battle of Worringen in 1288, then Brabant, and after the Battle of Baesweiler in 1371 the Duchy of Jülich. In 1336 Dietrich of Heinsberg inherited the counties of Loon and Chiny through his mother, sister of the last count of Loon, though Liège eventually reclaimed them. Later lords fared better in Jülich: Johann II fought at Kleverhamm in 1397 and in 1423 inherited a quarter of the Duchy of Jülich. The main male line died out in 1448, and after a succession through daughters the Duke of Jülich-Berg bought the lordship in 1484 and turned it into an administrative district, the Amt Heinsberg.
zh: 海因斯贝格领地是神圣罗马帝国的一处小邦，以科隆以西、今北莱茵—威斯特伐利亚州的海因斯贝格城和城堡为中心。11世纪末，瓦森贝格家族的戈斯温自称海因斯贝格领主，并通过与女继承人奥达联姻取得了邻近的法尔肯堡领地。领地虽小，领主却具有帝国诸侯等级，家族中的菲利普还在12世纪出任科隆大主教兼帝国首相。海因斯贝格靠依次依附莱茵河下游最强势力维持独立：1288年沃林根战役前投靠科隆选侯国，之后依附布拉班特，1371年巴斯韦勒战役后又改投于利希公国。1336年，海因斯贝格的狄奥多里克凭借母亲是末代洛恩伯爵之妹的身份，继承了洛恩和希尼两个伯国，但列日方面最终将它们收回。后来的领主约翰二世曾参加1397年的克莱弗哈姆之战，并于1423年分得于利希公国四分之一的领地。家族主支男系于1448年断绝，经过女儿一系的继承转手，于利希—贝格公爵于1484年买下这块领地，把它降为名为海因斯贝格辖区的行政单位。

en: The Hasbani were a Kurdish Sunni tribe whose grazing lands centred on Ujan, the old Mongol summer capital on the site of present-day Bostanabad, about fifty-five kilometres south-east of Tabriz, and stretched over the nearby Hashtrud, Malekan and Miandoab country. In 1337 their chief, Abdullah, held the tribe as a vassal of the Jalayirid sultanate in Baghdad.
zh: 哈斯巴尼是信奉逊尼派的库尔德部落，牧场以乌詹为中心，并延伸到附近的哈什特鲁德、马莱坎和米扬杜阿卜一带；乌詹是蒙古人的旧夏都，故地在今大不里士东南约55公里的博斯坦阿巴德。1337年时，其首领阿卜杜拉率部作为巴格达札剌亦儿王朝的部落附庸。

en: Heilbronn stands on the Neckar in northern Swabia, where salt springs and a river harbour gave it an early mint and market rights. It was first mentioned in 741 as villa Helibrunna, and in 1225 the Hohenstaufen made it a fortified town; the Teutonic Knights built their Deutschhof residence there from 1268. Its Jewish community, documented from 1050, suffered the Rintfleisch pogrom of 1298 and was expelled in 1490. In 1371 Emperor Charles IV granted Heilbronn a charter making it a Free Imperial City, answerable only to him, and the surrounding villages were brought under its rule. The city adopted the Reformation in 1528, accepted the Augsburg Confession in 1530 and joined the Schmalkaldic League in 1538. Württemberg troops occupied it in 1802, and in 1803 Heilbronn formally passed to Württemberg, where it became an early centre of industrialisation.
zh: 海尔布隆地处施瓦本北部的内卡河畔，当地的盐泉和河港使它很早就拥有铸币和开市的权利。741年它以海利布伦纳村之名首见记载，1225年霍亨斯陶芬家族将它建为设防城镇；条顿骑士团从1268年起在此修建德意志庄园。1050年即见记载的犹太社区在1298年的林特弗莱希屠杀中遭殃，又于1490年被逐出城。1371年，皇帝查理四世颁赐特许状，使海尔布隆成为只对皇帝负责的帝国自由城市，周围村庄也归入它管辖。1528年城市接受宗教改革，1530年承认《奥格斯堡信纲》，1538年加入施马尔卡尔登同盟。1802年符腾堡军队进驻，1803年海尔布隆正式划归符腾堡，后来成为当地最早工业化的中心之一。

en: Halberstadt began as a missionary diocese founded by Charlemagne in 804 amid the conversion of the pagan Saxons; its seat was soon moved from Osterwieck to Halberstadt, confirmed by Louis the Pious in 814. When Otto I created the archbishopric of Magdeburg in 968, Halberstadt lost the eastern half of its district. After the fall of the Saxon duke Henry the Lion in 1180, the bishops' temporal lands became the prince-bishopric of Halberstadt, an imperial state in its own right. Bishop Conrad joined the Fourth Crusade and the sack of Constantinople in 1204, bringing back relics and booty, and in 1315 the principality of Aschersleben was added to the bishopric's territory. In 1337 the see was held by Albert of the Welf house of Brunswick, whose family long supplied its bishops. During the Reformation the principality turned Lutheran in 1540 and was thereafter ruled by Protestant administrators. The Peace of Westphalia in 1648 secularised Halberstadt as a principality granted to the Hohenzollern rulers of Brandenburg-Prussia, and in 1815 the Congress of Vienna folded its lands into the Prussian province of Saxony.
zh: 哈尔伯施塔特起源于804年查理曼在异教萨克森人皈依过程中设立的传教教区，教座不久从奥斯特维克迁至哈尔伯施塔特，并于814年得到虔诚者路易确认。968年奥托一世设立马格德堡大主教区后，哈尔伯施塔特失去了辖区的东半部分。1180年萨克森公爵狮子亨利倒台后，主教的世俗领地发展为独立的帝国邦国——哈尔伯施塔特主教区邦。主教康拉德参加了第四次十字军，在1204年参与洗劫君士坦丁堡，带回大量圣物和战利品；1315年，阿舍斯莱本亲王国并入主教区领地。1337年在位的是韦尔夫家族不伦瑞克支系的阿尔贝，该家族长期出任这里的主教。宗教改革期间，主教区于1540年改宗路德宗，此后由新教管理者统治。1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》将哈尔伯施塔特世俗化为亲王国，封给霍亨索伦家族统治的勃兰登堡-普鲁士；1815年维也纳会议又把其领地并入普鲁士的萨克森省。

en: Huamachuco was a highland lordship whose seat was the walled sanctuary-city of Markahuamachuco, set on an isolated mesa in what is now the La Libertad region of Peru. Building there began around AD 400, and by the Late Intermediate Period the lords of Huamachuco ruled a Culli-speaking polity whose influence reached across northern Peru and into southern Ecuador. Its wealth rested on the oracle of the thunder god Catequil, whose sanctuary at Namanchugo drew pilgrims from the whole northern Andes, and on trade with the Moche, Recuay and Cajamarca cultures. The autonomous domain survived until about 1470, when the Incas conquered it; its people were resettled in a new Inca administrative town, also called Huamachuco, laid out on the Cusco to Quito highway with more than two hundred storehouses, while Atawallpa destroyed the old Catequil shrine. Augustinian missionaries founded the Spanish town on the Inca site in 1553.
zh: 瓦马丘科是一个高原领主邦，统治中心是建在孤立台地上的城墙圣城马卡瓦马丘科，位于今秘鲁拉利伯塔德省。遗址约在公元400年开始营建，到晚期中间期，瓦马丘科的统治者已建立起讲库利语的政权，势力遍及秘鲁北部并延伸到厄瓜多尔南部。它的财富来自雷神卡特基尔的神谕，其纳曼丘戈神殿吸引着安第斯北部各地的朝圣者，此外还有与莫切、雷夸伊和卡哈马卡诸文化的贸易。这个自主政权存续到约1470年，随后被印加征服；居民被迁往同样名为瓦马丘科的印加行政新城，该城建在库斯科至基多的大道旁，配有两百多座仓库，而阿塔瓦尔帕捣毁了古老的卡特基尔神殿。1553年，奥古斯丁会传教士在印加城址上建立了西班牙城镇。

en: The Hacıemirid beylik, also called the beylik of Bayram and known to Greek sources as Chalybia, was a small Turkoman lordship in the Canik country on the Black Sea coast, ruled by chiefs of the Chepni tribe and seated at Mesudiye. Early in the fourteenth century the region passed from Mongol rule to the Eretnids, but the first bey, Bayram, the ruler in 1337, declared independence during the Mongol civil war of 1335 and 1336 and fought the Empire of Trebizond, joining an unsuccessful siege of the city in 1348. His son Hacıemir married a daughter of Basil of Trebizond in 1358 and, with the backing of the warlord Kadi Burhan al-Din, captured the coastal city of Ordu in 1380. A civil war between Hacıemir and his son Süleyman followed, and Süleyman took Giresun in 1397. After Burhan al-Din's death the beylik accepted Ottoman suzerainty, briefly reasserted itself after Timur's victory at Ankara in 1402, and was finally annexed by the Ottomans in 1427.
zh: 哈吉埃米尔贝伊国又称巴伊拉姆贝伊国，希腊史料称其为哈利比亚，是黑海沿岸贾尼克地区的突厥蛮小邦，由切普尼部首领统治，都城在梅苏迪耶。14世纪初该地区先由蒙古人、后归埃雷特纳人管辖，但首任贝伊巴伊拉姆即1337年在位的统治者，趁1335至1336年蒙古内战宣布独立，并与特拉布宗帝国交战，1348年参与围攻特拉布宗却告失败。其子哈吉埃米尔于1358年迎娶特拉布宗君主瓦西里之女，又在军阀卡迪·布尔汉丁支持下于1380年攻占海滨城市奥尔杜。此后哈吉埃米尔与儿子苏莱曼爆发内战，苏莱曼于1397年夺取吉雷松。布尔汉丁死后，贝伊国接受奥斯曼宗主权，1402年帖木儿在安卡拉获胜后一度重新自立，最终于1427年被奥斯曼人吞并。

en: The Hachiun horde was the eastern appanage of the descendants of Hachiun, full younger brother of Genghis Khan and third son of Yesugei and Hoelun. The Secret History calls him Hachiun-alchi and says he was five when Temujin was nine; he is rarely mentioned in the later campaigns and probably died young, yet in the distribution of 1207 he received his own subjects and pastures, ranked seventh among the imperial family's households. His son Alchidai commanded the house under the Yuan and was enfeoffed as Prince of Jinan, and the family took its place among the Eastern, or Left Wing, princes on the Mongol-Manchurian steppe. In 1337 the horde, still ruled by a Borjigin prince, pastured around Qingzhou in the Songnen country under the great khan's supremacy. When the Yuan fell in 1368, these brotherly appanages were absorbed into the Ming Three Guards of 1389, their princes keeping command over the nomadic guards.
zh: 合赤温汗国是成吉思汗同母弟合赤温后裔的东部投下封地。合赤温是也速该与诃额仑的第三子，《蒙古秘史》称他合赤温·额勒赤，说铁木真九岁时他只有五岁；他在后来的征战中很少被提及，可能早逝，但在1207年分封时仍领有自己的属民和牧场，在皇室各户中位列第七。其子按赤台在元朝承袭家业，受封济南王，该家族也位列蒙古与满洲草原上的东道诸王（左手诸王）。1337年，这个仍由孛儿只斤王公统治的部落游牧于松嫩的庆州一带，奉大汗为宗主。1368年元朝灭亡后，诸弟封地在1389年被明朝整编为兀良哈三卫，这些王公继续统领游牧卫所。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Hildesheim was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire in the Leine valley, south of Hanover. Charlemagne founded a missionary diocese at nearby Elze in 800, and Louis the Pious moved the see to Hildesheim in 815; the cathedral's Thousand-year Rose, a dog rose climbing its apse, was already linked to the founding legend. Under the Ottonian bishops Bernward and Gotthard, around 1000, Hildesheim became a centre of Romanesque art and learning, famed for its bronze doors and the church of Saint Michael. In 1235 Emperor Frederick II recognized Bishop Conrad II as a prince of the Empire, and in 1337 the see was held by Henry III of Brunswick-Lüneburg, a Welf. The Hildesheim Diocesan Feud of 1519 to 1523 against Duke Henry the Younger of Brunswick cost the bishopric much of its land. Although most of its people turned Protestant in the sixteenth century, Wittelsbach prince-bishops from 1573 kept the state Catholic and independent through the Counter-Reformation, the last of them, Clemens August of Bavaria, holding Cologne, Münster and Osnabrück as well. Secularized in 1803 and given to Prussia, Hildesheim passed to the Kingdom of Westphalia in 1807 and finally to Hanover in 1815.
zh: 希尔德斯海姆采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国位于莱讷河谷、汉诺威以南的教会邦国。查理曼于800年在邻近的埃尔策设立传教教区，虔诚者路易于815年把主教座堂迁至希尔德斯海姆；攀附在教堂后殿的一株犬蔷薇被称作千年玫瑰，早已与建城传说联系在一起。约1000年，在奥托王朝的贝尔瓦德和戈特哈德两任主教治下，希尔德斯海姆成为罗马式艺术与学术中心，以青铜大门和圣米迦勒教堂闻名。1235年皇帝腓特烈二世承认主教康拉德二世为帝国诸侯，1337年在任的是韦尔夫家族的不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的亨利三世。1519至1523年与不伦瑞克公爵年轻者亨利的希尔德斯海姆教区纷争，使主教区丧失大片领地。尽管16世纪境内多数居民改宗新教，1573年起的维特尔斯巴赫家族主教仍借反宗教改革保住了邦国的天主教信仰和独立，末任主教巴伐利亚的克莱门斯·奥古斯特还兼领科隆、明斯特和奥斯纳布吕克。1803年主教区被世俗化并划归普鲁士，1807年转属威斯特伐利亚王国，最终于1815年并入汉诺威王国。

en:
Hamedān stands high on the slopes of Mount Alvand in western Iran, on the site of Ecbatana, which Herodotus names as the capital built by the Median king Deioces in the seventh century BCE. It served the Achaemenids as a royal treasury and the Parthians and Sasanians as a summer capital before the Arab victory at Nahavand in 642 opened the city to Islam. Alavid sayyids ruled it from the mid-ninth century, the Ziyarid Mardavij sacked it in 931, and after the Seljuks took the last Kakuyid fortress in 1047 they moved their capital from Baghdad to Hamedān, where Avicenna had earlier served as vizier and written much of his work; the Jewish traveler Benjamin of Tudela found a community of thirty thousand Jews there in 1170. The Mongols destroyed the city in 1220 and Timur's armies destroyed it again.

With the Ilkhanate collapsing after 1335, Hamedān passed to its governor Mahmud ibn Isan Qutlugh, who fought for Ali Padshah at the Battle of Qara Darra in 1336 and afterward joined the cause of the Khorasanid claimant Togha Temür. The city revived under the Safavids, was briefly occupied by the Ottomans in the eighteenth century and recovered by Nader Shah, after Kurdish tribes had seized it in 1719.
zh:
哈马丹雄踞伊朗西部阿尔万德山的山坡上，古城埃克巴坦那即在此地；据希罗多德记载，米底国王戴奥凯斯于公元前7世纪在此建都。阿契美尼德王朝把它用作王室府库，帕提亚和萨珊王朝则以它为夏都，直到642年尼哈旺德战役阿拉伯人获胜，城市随之伊斯兰化。9世纪中叶起阿拉维圣裔在此执政，931年齐亚尔王朝的马尔达维吉纵兵洗劫；1047年塞尔柱人攻克卡库伊德王朝最后一座堡垒后，把首都从巴格达迁到哈马丹，伊本·西那早年曾在此任维齐尔并完成大量著述；1170年犹太旅行家图德拉的本雅明记载城中有三万犹太人。1220年蒙古人摧毁该城，帖木儿的军队又再毁一次。

1335年伊儿汗国崩溃后，哈马丹落入长官马哈茂德·伊本·伊桑·忽都鲁之手，他在1336年的加拉达拉战役中为阿里帕夏作战，战败后转而追随呼罗珊的汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿。城市在萨非王朝时期复兴，18世纪一度被奥斯曼人占领，又由纳迪尔沙收复；此前的1719年，库尔德部落曾趁乱攻占哈马丹。

en: The Hadhur were a Kurdish Sunni tribe of the Shahrizor plain, the fertile valley around present-day Sulaymaniyah whose medieval inhabitants the geographer Yaqut al-Hamawi described as Kurds governing their own country. In 1337 their chief, Taj al-Din Hadhur, held the tribe's seat at Sulaymaniyah as a vassal of the Jalayirid sultanate in Baghdad.
zh: 哈杜尔是活动于谢赫雷祖尔平原的逊尼派库尔德部落；这片肥沃谷地在今苏莱曼尼亚一带，中世纪地理学家雅库特·哈马维曾记载当地居民全是库尔德人，自行治理其地。1337年时，其首领塔杰丁·哈杜尔以苏莱曼尼亚为治所，率部充当巴格达札剌亦儿王朝的附庸。

en: Hadiya was a Muslim kingdom south of Shewa and west of Sharkha, in the fertile highlands of south-central Ethiopia, peopled by Cushitic Hadiyya, Halaba and Kebena groups together with Semitic-speaking Sil'te. Its ruling tradition traced the dynasty to the Harar emir Abadir, who married into the local Sidama, and the kingdom is already named in the thirteenth-century Kebra Nagast. When its king Amano refused tribute, Emperor Amda Seyon I marched in, crushed the revolt and made Hadiya an autonomous tributary of the Christian empire, the standing it has in 1337 under its garad, or ruler. Al-Umari describes a small but rich land of cereals, fruit and horses, trading with iron currency and able to field tens of thousands of cavalry. Under Zara Yaqob another rebellious garad, Mahiko, was deposed and later killed, and the emperor married the Hadiya princess Eleni; the kingdom's ties to Adal helped provoke the Battle of Gomit of 1445. Hadiya welcomed the imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi in the 1520s, parts of it were overrun by the Oromo later in that century, and in the 1600s its garad Sidi Mohammed defeated the army of Emperor Susenyos I, guarding Hadiya's independence for centuries afterward.
zh: 哈迪亚是位于绍阿以南、沙尔哈以西的穆斯林王国，地处埃塞俄比亚中南部肥沃的高原，居民包括操库希特语的哈迪亚、哈拉巴和克贝纳诸族群，以及操闪米特语的锡尔特人。当地传统称王朝源自哈勒尔埃米尔阿巴迪尔与锡达莫人的联姻，而早在13世纪的《众王荣耀》中就已提到这个王国。哈迪亚王阿玛诺拒绝纳贡后，阿姆达·塞约恩一世进军镇压，将其变为基督教帝国的自治纳贡地；1337年时，哈迪亚正是在加拉德阿玛诺的统治下以这一身份存续。欧麦里记载，哈迪亚幅员不大却物产丰饶，出产谷物、水果和马匹，以铁条作货币，能出动数以万计的骑兵。扎拉·雅各布在位时，另一位反叛的加拉德马赫科被废黜并最终被杀，皇帝还迎娶了哈迪亚公主埃莱妮；哈迪亚与阿达尔的关联也是1445年戈米特战役的诱因之一。16世纪20年代，哈迪亚曾迎接伊玛目艾哈迈德·加齐的军队；该世纪后期其部分土地被奥罗莫人占据。17世纪初，加拉德西迪·穆罕默德击败苏塞尼奥斯一世皇帝的军队，在此后数百年间保住了哈迪亚的独立。

en: Heidenheim, on the river Brenz at the eastern edge of the Swabian Alb, grew up beneath Hellenstein Castle, the seat of the lords of Hellenstein. The castle was founded in 1096 by Gozbert de Halensteine, a Staufer follower whose grandson Degenhard of Hellenstein, a retainer of Emperor Frederick Barbarossa, greatly enlarged it, and the town's first wall went up around 1190. The male line of the Hellensteins died out in 1273, after which the lordship passed through several hands; in this period Emperor Charles IV confirmed Heidenheim's market rights in 1356. From 1351 the counts of Helfenstein held the castle, and under their rule Heidenheim passed in 1448 to the Duchy of Teck, then held by Württemberg. It was Bavarian between 1450 and 1504, and in 1503 Hellenstein became the centre of the Württemberg lordship of Heidenheim. The castle burned down in 1530 and was rebuilt by Duke Ulrich of Württemberg, and the Reformation reached the town in the 1520s.
zh: 海登海姆位于施瓦本阿尔布东缘的布伦茨河畔，依山而建，山上是黑伦施泰因领主的居城黑伦施泰因堡。城堡由施陶芬家族的追随者戈茨佩特于1096年始建，其孙德根哈特作为皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的侍从大规模扩建城堡，城镇的第一道城墙约在1190年修筑。黑伦施泰因家族男系于1273年绝嗣，领地此后几度易主；这一时期的1356年，皇帝查理四世确认了海登海姆的集镇权。1351年起黑尔芬施泰因伯爵入主城堡，在他们治下，海登海姆于1448年并入当时由符腾堡执掌的泰克公国。1450年至1504年间它归属巴伐利亚，1503年黑伦施泰因堡成为符腾堡海登海姆领地的中心。城堡于1530年焚毁，由符腾堡公爵乌尔里希重建，宗教改革也在16世纪20年代传入该镇。

en: The Chel were the priestly Maya dynasty that ruled the northern kuchkabal of Ah Kin Chel after the fall of Mayapan. Their founder Mo-Chel was a noble of Mayapan and son-in-law of the high priest Ah Xupan Nauat; foreseeing the civil war between the Cocom and the Xiu, he withdrew with his followers to Tecoh near Izamal and in 1441 set up an independent state, naming it Ah Kin, the high priest's title, and Chel, his own lineage. When the league dissolved in 1461, Ah Kin Chel became one of the seventeen successor kingdoms of Yucatán, and the Chel family held it without interruption down to the Spanish arrival. Its territory covered the dry northern plain around Izamal and the fishing ports of the Dzilam coast. The last ruler, Namux Chel, was already in power when Francisco de Montejo crossed the region in 1527; choosing accommodation over war, he let the Spaniards pass, and the whole peninsula had submitted by 1547.
zh: 切尔人是祭司出身的玛雅王朝，玛雅潘覆灭后统治着北部城邦阿金切尔。开国者莫-切尔是玛雅潘的贵族、大祭司阿·舒潘·纳瓦特的女婿；他预见到科科姆与休族之间的内战，便率追随者退到伊萨马尔附近的特科，于1441年自立国家，国名由大祭司头衔“阿金”加上自己的家族名“切尔”拼成。1461年联盟解体后，阿金切尔成为尤卡坦十七个后继城邦之一，切尔家族世代统治，直至西班牙人到来。其疆域涵盖伊萨马尔周围干旱的北部平原和齐拉姆海岸的渔港。末代君主纳穆什·切尔在1527年弗朗西斯科·德·蒙特霍过境时已在位；他选择妥协而非开战，放西班牙人通行，到1547年整个半岛均已臣服。

en: The Landgraviate of Hesse grew out of the Hessengau, a country named after the ancient Chatti and once belonging to the Frankish stem duchy, which passed to the Landgraves of Thuringia. When Henry Raspe died without heirs in 1247, the War of the Thuringian Succession followed; Sophia of Brabant secured the Hessian lands for her young son Henry the Child, who became the first Landgrave of Hesse in 1264 and founder of the House of Hesse, with King Adolf raising the landgrave to princely rank in 1292. The territory was split into Upper and Lower Hesse more than once before being reunited by Landgrave William II in 1500. In 1337 the reigning lord was Henry II, called the Iron, who ruled from Cassel until 1376 and fought the Dukes of Brunswick over the succession of his nephew Hermann. Under Philip the Magnanimous Hesse embraced Protestantism at the Synod of Homberg in 1526 and led the Protestant princes against Emperor Charles V, but Philip's death in 1567 split the landgraviate among his four sons into Hesse-Kassel, Hesse-Marburg, Hesse-Rheinfels and Hesse-Darmstadt.
zh: 黑森方伯国源于黑森高，其名来自古老的卡蒂人，原属法兰克部落公国，后转入图林根方伯手中。1247年亨利·拉斯佩无嗣而终，引发图林根继承战争；布拉班特的索菲亚为幼子“孩童亨利”保住了黑森领地，亨利于1264年成为首任黑森方伯、黑森家族的始祖，1292年国王阿道夫又将方伯提升为诸侯等级。领地曾不止一次被分为上黑森与下黑森，直到1500年方伯威廉二世重新统一。1337年在位的是绰号“铁人”的亨利二世，他以卡塞勒为治所统治到1376年，曾为侄子赫尔曼的继承权与不伦瑞克诸公爵交战。在“宽宏的”菲利普治下，黑森于1526年的霍姆贝格宗教会议上皈依新教，并率领新教诸侯对抗皇帝查理五世；但菲利普1567年去世后，方伯国被四个儿子分为黑森-卡塞尔、黑森-马尔堡、黑森-莱茵费尔斯和黑森-达姆施塔特四份。

en: Hezhou was the great frontier mart at the upper Yellow River in southwestern Gansu, seated at Fuhan, present-day Linxia, where the road from the Chinese interior enters the Tibetan plateau. Former Liang first made it a prefecture in the fourth century, and after the Tibetan Empire took it in 762 it remained under Tibetan rule until Wang Shao's recovery of 1073. Under the Mongols it became Hezhou Route in 1269, attached to the Tufan Pacification Commission that governed Amdo. In 1370 the Ming general Deng Yu conquered it and accepted the surrender of Sonam Gonpo, marshal of the old commission, who was granted the Chinese surname He and made hereditary assistant commander of the Hezhou Guard founded in 1371, ruling the Dongxiang hills as a native tusi. Guarding one of the state tea-and-horse markets, Hezhou drew streams of migrants and traders; within a century of the Ming conquest its formerly Tibetan population had become predominantly Hui Muslim. Restored as a regular department in 1473, it passed under Lanzhou Prefecture in 1738.
zh: 河州是甘肃西南部黄河上游的边防商贸重镇，治所在枹罕，即今临夏，是内地进入青藏高原的门户。4世纪前凉始置河州；762年被吐蕃王国攻占，此后长期处于吐蕃治下，直到1073年王韶收复。蒙古时期的1269年改设河州路，隶属管辖安多的吐蕃等处宣慰使司。1370年明将邓愈西征，旧任宣慰使都元帅锁南普在河州归降，获赐何姓，并于1371年出任新设河州卫的世袭指挥同知，其家族作为土司治理东乡山地。河州设有官营茶马互市，移民商旅云集，归附后不过百年，原本以藏族为主的居民就转为以回族穆斯林为主。1473年河州复置为普通散州，1738年改属兰州府。

en: The County of Hohenberg was a Swabian lordship of the dynasty that branched off the House of Hohenzollern in the mid-twelfth century, first appearing in a charter of Frederick Barbarossa in 1170. From their castle of Oberhohenberg on the Swabian Jura, the counts expanded northward through marriage: Burchard III gained Nagold and Burchard IV won Horb on the Neckar, both from the inheritance of the counts palatine of Tübingen. The family's standing reached its peak when Gertrud of Hohenberg married Count Rudolf of Habsburg about 1245 and, as Queen Anna, stood beside the new German king after 1273. Count Albert II founded Rottenburg on the Neckar around 1280 as the county's new seat and appears as a minnesinger in the Manesse manuscript. Repeated partitions and debts then eroded the county: parts were sold to Württemberg and the Count Palatine Rupert in the 1360s and 1370s, and in 1381 Rudolf III sold the remaining core, including Hohenberg and Horb, to Duke Leopold III of Austria for 66,000 gold gulden. The main line died with Rudolf in 1389 and the last sideline in 1486, though the county survived in law as a Habsburg possession until 1806.
zh: 霍恩贝格伯国是施瓦本的一块贵族领地，其统治家族于12世纪中叶从霍亨索伦家族分出，1170年首次出现在腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的一份特许状中。伯爵们以施瓦本汝拉山上的上霍恩贝格堡为根基向北扩张：布尔夏德三世取得纳戈尔德，布尔夏德四世取得内卡河畔的霍尔布，两地都来自图宾根行宫伯爵的遗产。家族声望在1245年前后达到顶峰——格特鲁德·冯·霍恩贝格嫁给哈布斯堡伯爵鲁道夫，1273年鲁道夫当选德意志国王后，她以安娜之名成为王后。阿尔伯特二世伯爵约1280年在内卡河畔兴建罗滕堡作为伯国新治所，他还作为恋歌诗人出现在《马内塞手抄本》中。此后反复分家与债务侵蚀了伯国：14世纪60至70年代，多块领地被卖给符腾堡和行宫伯爵鲁普雷希特；1381年，鲁道夫三世以6.6万金古尔登把包括霍恩贝格和霍尔布在内的剩余核心领地卖给奥地利公爵利奥波德三世。主支随鲁道夫于1389年断绝，最后一支旁系也于1486年绝嗣，而伯国作为哈布斯堡的属地在名义上延续到1806年。

en: Hsawng Hsup, recorded as Somsok or Samjok in the Manipur chronicles and called Thaungthut by the Burmese, was one of the most westerly Shan principalities. Its original seat lay in the Kabaw Valley near the Manipur border, and much of its territory was dense forest there; only in the nineteenth century did its saopha move his headquarters east to Thaungdut on the Chindwin. In 1470 the king of Manipur and the ruler of Pong, or Möng Kawng, jointly conquered and partitioned the state, and Manipur kept its claim for centuries. From the time of Bayinnaung in the 1550s the Burmese crown contested that claim, and the little principality became a bone of contention between Ava and Manipur, passing back and forth as each power gained the upper hand in the Kabaw Valley. The long dispute was settled only in 1834, when the British Raj ceded Hsawng Hsup to Burma.
zh: 双肃在曼尼普尔编年史中记作 Somsok 或 Samjok，缅人称之为 Thaungthut，是位置最靠西的掸人小邦之一。它最早的治所在靠近曼尼普尔边界的格包谷地，领土多为密林；直到19世纪，诏法才把治所东迁至钦敦江畔的当都。1470年，曼尼普尔国王与“蓬”（即孟拱）的统治者联手征服并瓜分了该邦，曼尼普尔此后数百年一直保有对它的主张。自16世纪50年代勃印曩时代起，缅甸王室开始挑战这一主张，这个小邦遂成为阿瓦与曼尼普尔反复争夺的对象，随格包谷地的胜负而数易其主。这场长期争端直到1834年才了结，英属印度当局在那一年把双肃割让给缅甸。

en: Hijan was the small Hūrga Jurchen polity seated at Boli, the present-day city of Khabarovsk on the Amur just above its junction with the Ussuri. In 722 the Tang court appointed a Heishui Mohe chieftain prefect of Boli under the Heishui protectorate, and under the Liao the place, renamed Puwali, was one of the Five Nations stations governing the lower Amur. In the fifteenth century the Ming created the Bahulu Guard there within the Nurgan commission, enrolling the local Tungusic chiefs as hereditary tributary officers. In 1643 the Later Jin established a settlement named Bohori at Boli, which later passed under the Sanxing deputy lieutenant-general of the Qing.
zh: 希安是以伯力（今哈巴罗夫斯克）为中心的虎尔哈女真小邦，地处黑龙江与乌苏里江汇流处附近的黑龙江南岸。722年，唐朝封黑水靺鞨酋长为勃利刺史，隶黑水都督府；辽代该地改称剖阿里，是管辖黑龙江下游各部的五国部节度使驻地之一。15世纪，明朝在此设巴忽鲁卫，隶属奴儿干都司，任命当地通古斯酋长为世袭的朝贡官员。1643年，后金在伯力设博和哩噶珊，清代归三姓副都统管辖。

en: Haiyan gathers the Jurchen groups of the northern Hamgyong coast around Gyeongseong and the southern bank of the Tumen, the belt that later held Joseon's six garrisons from Hoeryong to Onseong. In 1258 the Mongols placed the region under the Ssangseong administration, staffed by hereditary Goryeo families under the Liaoyang province, so that in 1337 its Jurchen villagers answered to Yuan commanders. Goryeo retook Ssangseong in 1356. Around 1388 the Odoli tribe led by Mengtemu's father settled at Womuho, present-day Hoeryong; Mengtemu offered tribute to Joseon in 1395, accepted a Ming commission in 1405 and later headed the Jianzhou Left Guard before he and his son were killed in a tribal feud in 1433. That same year King Sejong's Pajiang campaign cleared the Tumen bank of Jurchen strongholds, and the six garrisons built over the following decades fixed Korea's northern frontier.
zh: 哈伊彦指咸镜北部沿海、镜城一带及图们江南岸的女真诸部，这一地带后来设有从会宁到稳城的朝鲜六镇。1258年蒙古在该地设立双城总管府，由辽阳行省治下的高丽降人世袭管领，因此1337年当地的女真村民听命于元朝长官。1356年高丽收复双城。1388年前后，猛哥帖木儿之父率斡朵里部南下，定居在今会宁的斡木河；猛哥帖木儿于1395年向朝鲜朝贡，1405年接受明朝任命，后来掌管建州左卫，1433年他与长子在部落仇杀中身亡。同年，朝鲜世宗发动婆猪江战斗，清除图们江南岸的女真据点，此后数十年间陆续修筑的六镇奠定了朝鲜的北疆。

en: Huexotzinco, meaning the place of small willows in Nahuatl, was a Nahua altepetl on the slopes of the Iztaccihuatl volcano northwest of the modern city of Puebla. Its rulers traced their descent to the Acolhua dynasty of Coatlinchan and honoured Camaxtli, the war god of the Chichimeca, while Nahuatl was the main language alongside an Otomi minority. The dominion reached its height between the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, making treaties with the cities of the Aztec Triple Alliance and with Tlaxcala and joining them in ritual flower wars to take captives for sacrifice. In the fifteenth century it was brought under Aztec domination, but its loyalty to Tenochtitlan remained weak, and in 1520 Huexotzinco sided with Hernan Cortes and the Tlaxcalteca against the Aztecs. Under Spanish rule it first became an encomienda and then, from 1525, the site of a Franciscan monastery around which the old settlement was rebuilt, and its Nahuatl-speaking community kept codices recording its tribute burdens later in the sixteenth century.
zh: 韦霍津戈在纳瓦特尔语中意为小柳树之地，是位于普埃布拉西北、伊斯塔西瓦特尔火山坡上的纳瓦人城邦。当地统治者自称出自科瓦特林昌的阿科尔瓦王朝，尊奉奇奇梅克人的战神卡马斯特利，居民以纳瓦特尔语为主，也有少数奥托米人。13至14世纪，这个政权达到鼎盛，与阿兹特克三国同盟诸城及特拉斯卡兰缔约，并参加各方之间的荣冠战争，以掳获人牲献祭。15世纪它被阿兹特克人征服，但对特诺奇蒂特兰始终离心离德；1520年，韦霍津戈倒向埃尔南·科尔特斯和特拉斯卡兰一方，共同对抗阿兹特克。西班牙统治时期，它先是成为委托监护地，1525年起又有方济各会在此建立修道院，旧聚落被迁建到修道院周围；说纳瓦特尔语的社区在16世纪后期仍以手抄本记录自身的贡赋负担。

en: Hakkari is the mountain country south of Lake Van, centred on the fortress of Çölemerik, also called Julamerk. Its Kurdish Hakkari tribe crossed the Great Zab in 979 and later supplied the Hakkariyya regiment, one of the Kurdish corps that carried the Ayyubids to power in Egypt; its commander Sayf al-Din Mashtub held Acre against the Crusaders in 1191. The emirate itself was founded in the fourteenth century by Izz al-Din Shir, who kept his throne by switching allegiance between the Timurids and the Kara Koyunlu until his death in 1423, until Qara Iskander executed most of his heirs. A descendant, Asad al-Din Zarin Cang, returned from Egypt and stormed the family castles on a Saturday, which gave the restored line its name of Shambo dynasty; his son Izz al-Din Shir II was put to death by the Aq Qoyunlu sultan Yaqub in 1491. Thereafter the emirs of Hakkari balanced between the Ottomans and the Safavids, crowning thirteen rulers in a single turbulent century as sons rebelled against fathers and the emirate fragmented into the fiefs of Van, Khoshab and Berkni. In the early nineteenth century the Soran emir of Rawanduz reduced its ruler to vassalage, and dynastic civil wars between Nurullah Beg and Suleiman Beg opened the way for the Ottomans to absorb the emirate in the Tanzimat era.
zh: 哈卡里是凡湖以南的山地之国，以彻莱梅里克要塞（又名朱拉梅克）为中心。当地的哈卡里库尔德部落于979年渡过大扎卜河，后来组成哈卡里军团——正是这支库尔德劲旅帮助阿尤布王朝在埃及掌权，其统帅赛夫丁·马什图卜曾于1191年据守阿卡抵抗十字军。埃米尔国本身由伊兹丁·希尔在14世纪建立，他在帖木儿王朝与黑羊王朝之间反复改换门庭，维系统治直至1423年去世，此后黑羊的伊斯坎达尔处死了他的大部分继承人。后裔阿萨德丁·扎林·章从埃及返回，在一个星期六突袭收复家族城堡，重建的王统因此得名尚博王朝；其子伊兹丁·希尔二世于1491年被白羊王朝苏丹叶尔孤白处死。此后哈卡里埃米尔们在奥斯曼与萨法维之间周旋，一个世纪里换了十三位统治者，王子反叛父王，埃米尔国也分裂为凡、霍沙普和贝尔克尼等采邑。19世纪初，拉万杜兹的索兰埃米尔将其降为附庸，努鲁拉贝伊与苏莱曼贝伊之间的家族内战又为奥斯曼人在坦志麦特时期吞并该埃米尔国铺平了道路。

en: Hkamti, usually called Hkamti Long, or the Great Place of Gold, was a remote Shan state on the Mali River in the far north of present-day Kachin State, with its chief town at Putao. It began as an outlying territory of Möng Kawng and was settled by the Hkamti, a Tai people whose language likely originated around Mogaung and who in the 1700s also spread as far as the upper Brahmaputra valley in Assam. Rather than a single principality, Hkamti Long was a loose cluster of seven small chiefdoms, Lokhun, Mansi, Lon Kyein, Manse-Hkun, Mannu, Langdao and Mong Yak among them, bound together under a saopha. Its isolation in the Irrawaddy headwaters kept it far from the main Burmese Shan states and from lowland Burmese power, and it was never brought under direct lowland administration; in later centuries its Shan population was gradually absorbed or displaced by the surrounding Kachin.
zh: 坎底常称坎底龙，意为“金地”，是马里河畔一个偏远的掸人邦国，位于今克钦邦最北部，首邑在葡萄。它最初是孟拱的边远属地，居民为坎底人——一支傣语族群，其语言很可能发源于莫冈一带，18世纪时更有支系迁徙到阿萨姆的布拉马普特拉河上游。坎底并非单一公国，而是洛洪、曼西、隆京、曼色昆、曼努、朗道、孟亚等七个小酋邦的松散组合，共同奉一位诏法为首。由于地处伊洛瓦底江源头的深山之中，它远离缅甸各掸邦腹地和低地缅人政权，从未被低地王朝直接管辖；到后来的几个世纪，当地掸人逐渐被周围的克钦人同化或排挤。

en: Hokuzan was the northernmost of the three kingdoms into which Okinawa split after 1314, when the local lord of Nakijin withdrew from Tamagusuku's loose overlordship and built his seat at Nakijin Castle on the Motobu Peninsula. It was the largest but poorest and least populated of the three, with no harbor to match Chūzan's Naha, and its rulers were petty lords with their own retainers and estates rather than true kings. After the Ming received Chūzan's tribute in 1372, Hokuzan gained the same trading status but sent only nine missions to China over the next thirty years. Vassal disputes weakened it in the 1410s, and in 1416 three of its anji lords defected to Chūzan; Nakijin fell after a fierce defense and its king killed himself, the kingdom being annexed by Shō Hashi. In 1337 its lord was Haniji, the first Hokuzan ruler named in Chinese records.
zh: 北山是1314年以后冲绳岛分裂出的三个王国中位置最北的一个：今归仁的地方首领脱离玉城的松散宗主权，率部北上，在本部半岛的今归仁城建立统治。三国之中北山疆域最大，却最贫瘠、人口最稀，也没有可与中山那霸相比的港口；其统治者只是拥有家臣和领地的小领主，并非真正的国王。1372年中山向明朝朝贡后，北山也获得同样的贸易地位，但此后三十年间仅派出九次贡使。15世纪10年代家臣内讧削弱了北山，1416年三名按司投奔中山，今归仁城在激战后陷落，国王自尽，北山被尚巴志吞并。1337年在位的怕尼芝，是中国史籍中留名的第一位北山统治者。

en: Helfenstein was the county of the counts of Helfenstein, named after their ancestral castle above Geislingen an der Steige on the Swabian Alb, built around 1100 by Eberhard the Elder. The castle commanded the imperial road from Brabant to Italy, and the town of Geislingen grew at its foot as a toll station. Around 1200 Count Ludwig IV of Spitzenberg married the Helfenstein heiress and, when his own line failed in 1226, merged the two inheritances as Ludwig I of Helfenstein, adding lands along the Fils valley, at Ulm and Heidenheim, and on the Danube near Sigmaringen. Count Ulrich V served Emperor Charles IV at Prague and married the emperor's kinswoman Maria of Bosnia, an expensive match that began the family's financial decline. In 1356 the house split into the Wiesensteig and Blaubeuren branches. The Wiesensteig branch pledged its Geislingen lands to the imperial city of Ulm in 1382 and, unable to repay a debt of over 123,000 gulden, lost the ancestral castle and twenty-seven villages to the city in 1396. The Blaubeuren branch lost most of its property to Württemberg in 1448. Stripped of political power, the family died out in the male line in 1627.
zh: 黑尔芬施泰因是黑尔芬施泰因伯爵的伯爵领，得名于施瓦本阿尔布山区盖斯林根上方的家族祖堡，该堡约于1100年由埃伯哈德长者修建。城堡扼守从布拉班特通往意大利的帝国大道，盖斯林根镇即在山脚作为税卡发展起来。约1200年，施皮岑贝格伯爵路德维希四世娶黑尔芬施泰因女继承人，1226年其本支绝嗣后，他以黑尔芬施泰因的路德维希一世之名合并两份遗产，把菲尔斯河谷、乌尔姆、海登海姆以及锡格马林根附近多瑙河畔的土地收入囊中。伯爵乌尔里希五世曾在布拉格侍奉皇帝查理四世，并娶皇帝的亲族波斯尼亚的玛丽亚，这场耗费巨大的婚姻成为家族衰败的开端。1356年家族分裂为维森施泰格与布劳博伊伦两支。前者于1382年把盖斯林根领地抵押给帝国自由城市乌尔姆，因无力偿还超过12.3万古尔登的债务，1396年祖堡连同二十七个村庄尽归该城。布劳博伊伦支的大部分产业则于1448年落入符腾堡之手。失去政治权力后，家族男系于1627年断绝。

en: The Hüleguids were the Borjigin descendants of Hülegü Khan, whose Mongol army ended Abbasid rule at Baghdad in 1258 and built the Ilkhanate over Persia and Arab Iraq. Basra and the lower Tigris towns of Wasit and Badra thus became Mongol-governed lands, settled by Mongol soldiery. When Il-Khan Abu Sa'id died without an heir in 1335, the empire shattered into rival amirates, and the surviving Hülegüid princes became puppets of competing emirs. Musa Khan, a grandson of Il-Khan Baydu, was enthroned in 1336 by his patron Ali Padshah after the battle of Jaghatu, but was defeated that July at Qara Darra and fled to Baghdad; in June 1337 he joined the eastern claimant Togha Temür and occupied the old capital Soltaniyeh, only to be captured and killed on 10 July 1337. With the Borjigin claimants exhausted, Arab Iraq passed to the Jalayirids of Hasan Buzurg. In the early fifteenth century the Arab Al-Mughamis tribe held Basra under Qara Qoyunlu and Aq Qoyunlu overlordship, until the Moshasha and then the Safavids under Shah Ismail I took the city in 1508.
zh: 旭烈兀家族是旭烈兀汗的孛儿只斤后裔；1258年，旭烈兀的蒙古大军在巴格达终结了阿拔斯王朝的统治，建立起横跨波斯和阿拉伯伊拉克的伊儿汗国，巴士拉以及底格里斯河下游的瓦西特、巴德拉等城镇由此成为蒙古人治理、蒙古驻军屯居的土地。1335年伊儿汗阿布·赛义德无嗣而终，帝国碎为相互敌对的埃米尔国，残存的旭烈兀诸王沦为各路埃米尔的傀儡。木撒汗是伊儿汗拜都之孙，1336年被其靠山阿里·帕迪沙在贾加图战役后扶上汗位，同年7月便在喀拉达拉战败，逃奔巴格达；1337年6月他与东部的争夺者脱合帖木儿合兵，占领旧都苏丹尼耶，却在7月10日被俘处死。孛儿只斤的争夺者们凋零之后，阿拉伯伊拉克落入哈桑·布祖尔格的札剌亦儿王朝之手。15世纪初，阿拉伯的穆加米斯部落占据巴士拉，先后臣服于黑羊王朝和白羊王朝；此后穆沙沙势力入主，最终沙阿·伊斯玛仪一世于1508年攻占该城，将其纳入萨法维王朝。

en: Al-Hillah, on the Euphrates south of Baghdad and beside the ruins of Babylon, began in 1012 as a settlement founded by Ali ibn Mazyad of the Shia Arab Banu Mazyad dynasty, and became their walled capital under Sadaqa I after 1086. Abbasid forces occupied the city in 1163, ending Mazyadid rule, yet Hillah remained a leading centre of Shia learning and was the birthplace of the theologian Allamah al-Hilli. After the Mongol conquest of 1258 it passed through the Ilkhanate to the Jalayirids of Baghdad, whose last rulers were driven back on Hillah until the Qara Qoyunlu captured the city in 1431.
zh: 希拉位于巴格达以南的幼发拉底河畔，紧邻巴比伦废墟。1012年，什叶派阿拉伯人马兹亚德王朝的阿里·伊本·马兹亚德在此建立定居点；1086年后萨达卡一世为它修筑城墙，希拉成为该王朝的都城。1163年阿拔斯王朝军队占领该城，马兹亚德人的统治结束，但希拉仍是什叶派学术的重镇，神学家阿拉玛·希里就出生于此。1258年蒙古征服后，它先后归伊儿汗国和巴格达的札剌亦儿王朝统治；札剌亦儿末代君主退守希拉，1431年该城被黑羊王朝攻占。

en: Halan takes its name from the Halan country of the Hailan River, called the Helan water in Jin times and the Halan river under the Ming, a Tumen tributary whose Manchu name hailan means elm. The Jin governed the Yanbian region through its Halan route, and the Yuan created Halan Prefecture, with its seat south of present-day Hamhung on Korea's northeast coast, beside the Ssangseong administration. In 1337 the prefecture's Jurchen and Goryeo inhabitants were ruled through the Liaoyang province. Goryeo's northeast campaign of 1356 overran the Yuan border governments and brought the region under Korean rule. In 1407 the Ming set up the Halancheng Guard on the Hailan to keep titles and tribute flowing from the local Jurchen chiefs.
zh: 哈兰得名于海兰江流域的合兰之地，这条图们江支流辽金时称曷懒水，明代称合兰河，满语 hailan 意为榆树。金代通过曷懒路管辖延边一带，元朝设立合兰府，治所在今朝鲜东北沿海咸兴以南，与双城总管府相邻；1337年府内的女真与高丽居民由辽阳行省统辖。1356年高丽向东北用兵，攻灭元朝在当地的边境政权，将这一地区纳入朝鲜版图。1407年，明朝在海兰江设立合兰城卫，以封职和朝贡维系当地女真首领。

en: The Hamidid beylik arose around 1301 in the lakes region of southwestern Anatolia, taking in Isparta, Eğirdir, Burdur and Uluborlu, its first capital. Its founder Dündar Bey, also called Felek al-Din, came of a line of Seljuk frontier lords named after his grandfather Hamid, and the country was known as Hamideli. When Dündar resisted the Ilkhanid strongman Emir Çoban, Çoban's son Timurtash had him killed and handed Antalya to a rival kinsman, from which the separate Teke beylik grew; Dündar's son Hızır recovered the core lands around Eğirdir, where the capital was later moved. In 1374 the later ruler Hüseyin, worn down by Karamanid attacks, sold Akşehir, Beyşehir and other towns to the Ottoman sultan Murad I for eighty thousand gold pieces, retaining only Isparta and Eğirdir. The reduced beylik was annexed by Bayezid I in 1391 and became the Ottoman Sanjak of Hamid, roughly the later Isparta Province.
zh: 哈米德贝伊国约1301年兴起于安纳托利亚西南部的湖区，领有伊斯帕尔塔、埃伊尔迪尔、布尔杜尔和最早的都城乌卢博尔卢。开国者丁达尔贝伊又名费莱克丁，出身塞尔柱边侯世家，国名得自其祖父哈米德，国土被称作哈米德之地。丁达尔抗拒伊儿汗国权臣埃米尔·楚邦，楚邦之子帖木儿塔什将他杀害，并把安塔利亚交给与他争位的同族，泰凯贝伊国由此分立；丁达尔之子赫泽尔收复了埃伊尔迪尔周边的核心疆土，都城后来也迁到那里。1374年，后继统治者侯赛因不堪卡拉曼人的攻扰，以八万金币把阿克谢希尔、贝伊谢希尔等城卖给奥斯曼苏丹穆拉德一世，自己只保留伊斯帕尔塔和埃伊尔迪尔。1391年，萎缩的贝伊国被巴耶济德一世吞并，成为奥斯曼的哈米德桑贾克，大致相当于后来的伊斯帕尔塔省。

en:
The Lordship of Hanau was a Wetterau territory on the lower Main, held by a noble family first recorded in 1166 that took the name of Hanau castle from 1191. Reinhard I married the heiress Adelheid of Münzenberg, and his son Ulrich I wed Elisabeth of Rieneck, whose inheritance brought Steinau in the Kinzig valley in 1290. Ulrich I became governor of the Wetterau in 1300, and in 1303 King Albert I raised the settlement beneath the castle to a market town. In 1320 Emperor Louis IV pledged the Bornheimerberg district to Ulrich II, the lord ruling in 1337, beginning a long feud with Frankfurt. The house adopted one of Germany's earliest primogeniture statutes in 1375 and inherited the Schlüchtern lands of the Rieneck counts in 1377.

Emperor Sigismund raised Hanau to a county in 1429, and in 1458 it split into Hanau-Münzenberg and Hanau-Lichtenberg. The Münzenberg line turned Lutheran in the 1520s and Calvinist in 1593, and settled Walloon and Dutch religious refugees in a fortified New Town from 1597. Hanau endured Swedish occupation and an imperial siege during the Thirty Years' War; Count Friedrich Casimir later founded Germany's first faience factory but nearly bankrupted the county with his Guiana lease scheme of 1669. The male line died out in 1736, when Hanau-Münzenberg passed to Hesse-Kassel and Hanau-Lichtenberg to Hesse-Darmstadt.
zh:
哈瑙领地是韦特劳地区位于美因河下游的一片领地，统治家族最早见于1166年的记载，1191年起以哈瑙城堡为姓。赖因哈德一世娶了女继承人阿德尔海德·冯·明岑贝格，其子乌尔里希一世又娶伊丽莎白·冯·里内克；1290年，后一桩婚姻带来的遗产使哈瑙得到金齐希河谷的施泰瑙。1300年乌尔里希一世出任韦特劳行政长官，1303年国王阿尔布雷希特一世将城堡下的聚落升格为设有集市的城镇。1320年，皇帝路易四世把博恩海姆贝格地区抵押给1337年在位的领主乌尔里希二世，哈瑙与法兰克福由此结下长期纷争。1375年，哈瑙家族订立了德意志最早的长子继承法令之一，1377年又继承了里内克伯爵的施吕希滕领地。

1429年，西吉斯蒙德皇帝将哈瑙升格为伯国，1458年它分裂为哈瑙-明岑贝格和哈瑙-利希滕贝格两支。明岑贝格一支在16世纪20年代改宗路德宗，1593年又改宗加尔文宗，并从1597年起接纳瓦隆和荷兰的宗教难民，在设防的新城安置他们。三十年战争期间，哈瑙经历了瑞典占领和帝国军队的围攻；后来伯爵弗里德里希·卡西米尔建起德意志第一家彩陶工厂，却因1669年的圭亚那租赁计划几乎使伯国破产。1736年男系绝嗣，哈瑙-明岑贝格并入黑森-卡塞尔，哈瑙-利希滕贝格则并入黑森-达姆施塔特。

en: The County of Henneberg was a Franconian comital land between the Thuringian Forest, the Rhön hills and the Main, held by the counts of Henneberg from the late eleventh century and split among several family lines, of which the Schleusingen line was the foremost. In 1310 Emperor Henry VII raised the county to an immediate princely county. In 1337 its ruler was Count Berthold VII of Henneberg-Schleusingen, called the Wise, who had inherited as a child in 1284 and served from 1323 to 1330 as guardian of the Emperor Louis IV's young son Louis V, whom the emperor had made Margrave of Brandenburg. His daughter's marriage to a Hohenzollern Burgrave of Nuremberg made the counts grandparents of the later Brandenburg electors, but the male line of the Hennebergs nevertheless ran out in 1583. The inheritance then fell to the Wettin electors of Saxony, who in 1660 divided the Henneberg lands, including Meiningen and Schleusingen, among their Ernestine duchies.
zh: 亨讷贝格伯国是图林根林山、勒恩山与美因河之间的法兰克尼亚伯爵领地，11世纪末起为亨讷贝格伯爵家族所有，后来分成数支，其中以施莱辛根一支最为显赫。1310年，皇帝亨利七世将该伯国升格为直属于帝国的封侯伯国。1337年在位的是施莱辛根伯爵贝特霍尔德七世，人称智者，他1284年幼年袭爵，1323至1330年又为皇帝路易四世年幼的儿子、被任为勃兰登堡藩侯的路易五世摄政。他的女儿嫁给霍亨索伦家族的纽伦堡城堡伯爵，使亨讷贝格伯爵成为后来勃兰登堡选侯的外祖父母；尽管如此，亨讷贝格的男系仍于1583年断绝。遗产随后落入萨克森韦廷选侯之手，1660年他们把包括迈宁根和施莱辛根在内的亨讷贝格土地分给了恩斯特系的各公国。

en: Huncun was a Jurchen polity at the foot of the Changbai mountains on the lower Tumen, where the present-day borders of China, Korea and Russia meet. The district had held Sushen and Yilou fishing communities in early centuries and became part of Balhae's Nanhai prefecture, with the Balhae eastern capital standing at Baliancheng near the modern town. Under the Jin it belonged to the Hailan route, and under the Yuan to the Kaiyuan province, so in 1337 its clans were tributary Jurchens of the Yuan court. The Ming planted several guards around Hunchun after 1407, among them the Guluhunshan and Tongkuanshan guards, and in the late Ming the area was held by the Manchu Sumuru clan. From 1653 it was administered from Ningguta, and in 1714 the Qing posted a Hunchun commandant, the first official use of the place name.
zh: 珲春是图们江下游、长白山脚下的女真政权，地处今中国、朝鲜、俄罗斯三国交界之地。这一带早有肃慎、挹娄渔猎部落，唐代属渤海国南京南海府，渤海东京城就设在今珲春附近的八连城；金代属海兰路，元代归开元路，1337年当地氏族是向元朝纳贡的女真人。1407年以后，明朝在珲春周围设立古鲁浑山卫、童宽山卫等若干卫所，明末该地为满族舒穆禄氏所据。1653年起由宁古塔统辖，1714年清朝设置珲春协领，这是珲春一名首次见于官方建制。

en: The Hanan Chanka, or Parkos, were the upper and warlike half of the Chanka confederation that arose in the Ayacucho highlands after the collapse of the Wari Empire, with chief seats at Paucara and the market town of Chocquemarca. Tradition credits their founder Uscovilca with beginning Chanka expansion, and colonial chronicles describe a rich, aggressive lordship whose fighters painted their faces, carried the mummies of their ancestors into battle and drank from skull-cups. In 1438 the Hanan commanders Astoy Huaraca and Tomay Huaraca led thirty thousand or more warriors against Cusco, but the Inca prince Cusi Yupanqui, later the emperor Pachacuti, broke the army at the Battle of Yawarpampa and opened the road to empire. The surviving Hanan Chanka were absorbed into the Tahuantinsuyo as soldiers and resettled colonists, and in the Inca civil war they took the side of Huáscar.
zh: 哈南·昌卡又称帕尔科斯，是昌卡联盟中尚武的上半部，兴起于瓦里帝国崩溃后的阿亚库乔高原，主要据点在保卡拉和集镇乔克马尔卡。传说其始祖乌斯科维卡开启了昌卡的扩张，殖民时代的编年史家把它描绘成富庶而好战的领主政权：战士们脸上涂彩，肩扛祖先木乃伊出征，还用敌人的头骨做酒杯。1438年，哈南将领阿斯托伊·瓦拉卡和托马伊·瓦拉卡率三万多将士进攻库斯科，但印加王子库西·尤潘基，即后来的皇帝帕查库特克，在亚瓦尔潘帕战役中将其击溃，由此踏上帝国之路。幸存的哈南·昌卡人被并入塔万廷苏尤，充当士兵和迁徙屯垦者，在后来的印加内战中站在瓦斯卡尔一方。

en: Honnavara, known to medieval Arab sailors as Hinawr, is a sheltered port at the mouth of the Sharavathi river on the Kanara coast, where the Western Ghats meet the Arabian Sea. Its Muslim community, the Nawayath, descended from Arab mariners and merchants from Yemen, Oman and the Persian Gulf who settled among the Konkani population and spoke Nawayathi, a Konkani dialect; by the fourteenth century their chiefs ruled the port as a small Muslim sultanate. When Ibn Battuta visited in 1342 he found Sultan Jamaluddin, whom he called one of the best and most powerful of rulers, governing Hunnur with its mosque and minaret on the strength of the Indian Ocean trade. The Portuguese built a fortress here in the sixteenth century to police their shipping lanes, and English warehouses followed in the eighteenth. The wider Kanara country passed in turn through the Vijayanagara, Bahmani and Bijapuri spheres before the Marathas took it in the 1750s and Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan made Honnavara one of the chief ports of Mysore; after the Fourth Mysore War of 1799 it passed to the British East India Company.
zh: 霍纳沃尔在中世纪阿拉伯海商口中称希瑙尔，是卡纳达海岸沙拉瓦蒂河口的避风良港，西高止山在此俯临阿拉伯海。当地的穆斯林社群纳瓦亚特人源自也门、阿曼和波斯湾的阿拉伯水手与商人，他们定居在康坎人中间，使用以康坎语为基础的纳瓦亚特语；到14世纪，其首领已把这个港口经营成一个穆斯林小苏丹国。1342年伊本·白图泰到访时，在位的是苏丹贾马鲁丁，白图泰称他是最贤明、最强有力的君主之一，依靠印度洋贸易统治着建有清真寺和宣礼塔的胡努尔。16世纪葡萄牙人在此修筑堡垒以管控航道，18世纪英国人又开设商馆。整个卡纳达地区先后处在毗奢耶那伽罗、巴赫马尼和比贾布尔的势力范围内，1750年代被马拉塔人夺取，随后海德尔·阿里和提普苏丹把霍纳沃尔建成迈索尔的主要港口之一；1799年第四次迈索尔战争后，它落入英国东印度公司之手。

en: The name Hasnuya recalls the Hasanwayhids, a Kurdish dynasty of the Barzikani tribe that rose in the mountains of western Iran in the tenth century. Its founder Hasanwayh ibn Husayn gathered fortresses around Kermanshah from the 960s, and his son Badr, honoured with the title Nasir al-Dawla in 998, ruled from Kermanshah and Hulwan to Nahavand and at the height of his power held the Shahrizor plain, the country around later Sulaymaniyah. The dynasty was Shia and coined its own money, but its feud with the rival Annazid Kurds proved fatal: Badr fell fighting in 1014, the Annazids seized Shahrizor and overthrew the family by 1015, and its last heir died at the stronghold of Sarmaj in 1047. In 1337 the name belonged to a Kurdish tribe holding Shahrazur itself as a vassal of the Jalayirids.
zh: 哈斯努亚的名字可追溯到哈桑瓦伊德王朝，即10世纪在伊朗西部山区兴起的巴尔齐卡尼部库尔德王朝。始祖哈桑瓦伊·伊本·侯赛因自960年代起在克尔曼沙阿一带聚堡自立；其子巴德尔于998年获赐纳绥尔丁称号，全盛时疆域从克尔曼沙阿、霍尔万延伸到纳哈万德，并曾据有谢赫雷祖尔平原，也就是后来苏莱曼尼亚周围的土地。该王朝信奉什叶派，自铸钱币，但与宿敌安纳兹库尔德人的争斗最终致命：巴德尔于1014年战死，安纳兹人夺取谢赫雷祖尔并在1015年攻灭其国，末代继承人于1047年死于萨尔马杰堡。1337年时，这个名字属于据守萨赫拉祖尔、臣属札剌亦儿王朝的一个库尔德部落。

en: Hunza was a Burusho kingdom in the Hunza valley, high in the Karakoram ranges of what is now Gilgit-Baltistan in Pakistan, with its seat at the Baltit fort above the river. The principality took shape around 1200 and remained independent for centuries; its rulers bore the title Thum, later Mir, and claimed descent from Alexander the Great, while their people were known as Kanjutis. In 1337 it was still a small isolated mountain monarchy, separated from the neighbouring valley state of Nagar to the south, living from terraced fields and the passes towards Xinjiang; Kanjuti raiders sometimes seized Kirghiz herdsmen in the high pastures and sold them into slavery in China. From 1761 the Mir sent tribute of gold dust to the Qing dynasty and received silk, tea and porcelain in return, a relationship that bound the mountain kingdom to the Chinese empire down to the nineteenth century.
zh: 罕萨是布鲁绍人在罕萨河谷建立的王国，地处今巴基斯坦吉尔吉特-巴尔蒂斯坦的喀喇昆仑群山之中，统治中心是高踞河谷之上的巴勒提特堡。这个约1200年形成的小邦独立存在了数百年：统治者称图姆，后改称弥尔，自称是亚历山大大帝的后裔，居民则被称为坎巨提人。1337年时它仍是一个闭塞的山地君主国，南面与邻邦那迦罗隔河谷相望，靠梯田农业和通往新疆的山口为生；坎巨提骑手还常到高山牧场掳走柯尔克孜牧民，贩卖到中国为奴。1761年起，弥尔向清朝进贡砂金，换回绸缎、茶叶和瓷器，这一朝贡关系把这个山国与清帝国一直维系到19世纪。

en: The County of Hohenzollern was the Swabian ancestral land of the house of Hohenzollern, whose first ancestors are documented in 1061 around Hechingen and whose hilltop castle above the town was praised as the crown of Swabian castles. In the thirteenth century the family split: the younger branch followed Conrad I to the burgraviate of Nuremberg and later to Brandenburg and Prussia, while the senior Swabian line kept the county and remained Catholic. The counts acquired Balingen on the Eyach in the first half of the thirteenth century, made it the seat of their Schalksburg lordship and founded the town there in 1255. In 1339 Frederick IX, called the Black Count, succeeded as count; he led the Swabian noble Lion League and in 1344 divided the inheritance with his brother, founding the line that ended with his son in 1412. Balingen was sold to Württemberg in 1403, and in 1423 the Swabian League of Cities destroyed Hohenzollern Castle after a long siege. In 1576 the county was partitioned into Hohenzollern-Hechingen, Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen and Hohenzollern-Haigerloch, and the three lines were raised to principalities before joining the Confederation of the Rhine in 1806.
zh: 霍亨索伦伯国是霍亨索伦家族在施瓦本的祖产，其先祖于1061年首见于黑兴根一带的文献，家族在黑兴根山顶的城堡被誉为施瓦本城堡之冠。13世纪家族分裂：幼支随康拉德一世出任纽伦堡城堡伯爵，后来走向勃兰登堡与普鲁士；留在本土的施瓦本长支保有伯国并始终信奉天主教。伯爵们在13世纪上半叶取得埃亚赫河畔的巴林根，将其设为沙尔克斯堡领地治所，并于1255年在当地建城。1339年，绰号“黑伯爵”的腓特烈九世继位，他统领施瓦本贵族的狮子同盟，1344年与弟弟分割遗产，他这一支随其子于1412年去世而告终。巴林根于1403年卖给符腾堡；1423年，施瓦本城市同盟经长期围攻摧毁了霍亨索伦城堡。1576年伯国分裂为霍亨索伦-黑兴根、霍亨索伦-锡格马林根和霍亨索伦-海格洛赫，三支先后升为侯国，并于1806年加入莱茵邦联。

en: The County of Holland was a Holy Roman Empire lordship in the Rhine and Meuse delta, its marshy territory corresponding roughly to the present Dutch provinces of North and South Holland. First known as West Frisia, it took the name Holland, meaning woodland in Old Dutch, around 1100 under its native counts, who brought most of Zeeland under their rule and subdued the West Frisians only in 1289 under Count Floris V. When the native line died out in 1299 the county passed to the Avesnes counts of Hainaut, and in 1337 William of Avesnes ruled Holland, Zeeland and Hainaut from The Hague. After William II fell fighting the Frisians in 1345, the counties went to the Wittelsbach dukes of Bavaria-Straubing, whose time saw the Hook and Cod Wars between the cities and the nobility; in 1433 Philip the Good of Burgundy took control, and from 1482 Holland belonged to the Habsburg Netherlands. During the Eighty Years' War the Sea Beggars seized Holland in 1572, and after the Act of Abjuration of 1581 it became the leading province of the Republic of the Seven United Provinces, dominating the Dutch Golden Age of the seventeenth century. The county ended with the Batavian Revolution of 1795, and after 1813 its lands formed a province of the United Kingdom of the Netherlands.
zh: 荷兰伯国是神圣罗马帝国位于莱茵河与默兹河三角洲的领地，所辖沼泽地带大致相当于今天荷兰的北荷兰省和南荷兰省。它最初称西弗里斯兰，约1100年在本土伯爵治下改用意为林地的荷兰一名；历代伯爵逐步征服泽兰大部，直到1289年才由弗洛里斯五世降伏西弗里斯兰人。1299年本土世系绝嗣，伯国转入埃诺的阿韦讷家族；1337年，阿韦讷家族的威廉以海牙为中心统治荷兰、泽兰和埃诺。1345年威廉二世在征讨弗里斯兰人时战死后，伯国归入维特尔斯巴赫家族的巴伐利亚-施特劳宾支系，其间爆发了城市与贵族相争的鱼钩与鳕鱼战争；1433年勃艮第公爵好人腓力取得统治权，1482年起荷兰归属哈布斯堡尼德兰。八十年战争中，海上乞丐于1572年夺取荷兰，1581年《誓绝法案》后它成为七联省共和国的首要省份，主导了17世纪的荷兰黄金时代。伯国随1795年的巴达维亚革命而终结，1813年后其故地成为尼德兰联合王国的一个省。

en: The Hor States, or Five Hors, were the Mongol-derived Tibetan principalities of Tréshö, the upper Yalong valley in northern Kham, covering what are now Garzê, Luhuo and Dawu. In the 1260s the Mongol prince Horsé Gyalpo, sent by Kublai Khan with the Sakya master Phagpa, settled in the region; his son Hor Namgyal subdued the local clans and founded the Hor ruling line, which blended Mongol ancestry with Tibetan culture. The area had earlier produced the first Karmapa, Düsum Khyenpa. In the later fifteenth century Namkha Gyaltsen united the valleys from Garzê to Draggo, and after his death his sons partitioned the realm into Mazur, Khangsar, Trehor, Draggo and Beri, the five Hor states. In 1639 Güshi Khan overthrew Beri and opened Kham to Gelug influence, while the Thirteen Hor Monasteries tied the chiefs closely to Lhasa. Under the Qing the Hor rulers received pacification commissioner titles in 1728, and imperial troops settled a war between Khangsar and Mazur in 1755.
zh: 霍尔巴即“五霍尔”，是康区北部雅砻江上游德雪地区、源出蒙古的西藏诸小邦，地域相当于今甘孜、炉霍和道孚一带。13世纪60年代，忽必烈派蒙古王子霍尔色杰波随萨迦派大师八思巴进驻此地，其子霍尔南嘉征服当地部族，开创霍尔巴王统，蒙古血统此后与西藏文化逐渐融为一体。更早的时候，第一代噶玛巴都松钦巴就出生在这一地区。15世纪后期，南喀坚赞统一了从甘孜到章谷的各河谷；他死后诸子瓜分疆土，形成麻书、孔撒、朱倭、章谷、白利五个霍尔小邦。1639年固始汗攻灭白利，为格鲁派进入康区打开道路，霍尔十三寺又把各部首领与拉萨紧密联系起来。清朝时，霍尔诸首领于1728年受封安抚司；1755年孔撒与麻书交战，清廷出兵平息了纷争。

en: Hotonggi was a Jurchen polity of the upper Songhua valley, named after the Hotonggi River, a forested Songhua tributary, with its seat at Sunggari on the main river, known in Manchu as Sunggari Ula. In 1337 it was a small tribal domain under Yuan overlordship. In 1409 the Ming created the Hotonggi Guard for the basin's chieftains within the Nurgan guard network, and the guard's bronze seal has since been excavated, confirming the station recorded in Ming court annals.
zh: 禾屯吉是松花江上游流域的女真政权，以松花江支流禾屯吉河得名，治所松阿里坐落于干流河畔，松阿里即满语对松花江的称呼。1337年它是臣属元朝的小型部族领地。1409年，明朝在该河流域设立禾屯吉卫，把当地首领纳入奴儿干卫所体系，这一卫所的铜印后来出土，印证了明代实录中的记载。

en: Corvey was a Benedictine imperial abbey and self-ruling ecclesiastical territory on the Weser beside the town of Höxter. Emperor Louis the Pious ordered its foundation in 815; monks from Corbie in Picardy settled at the present site in 822 and named it Nova Corbeia, the new Corbie. It became independent in 826, gained the first minting right east of the Rhine in 833, and in 836 received the relics of Saint Vitus, which made it a major place of pilgrimage and one of the richest abbeys of Central Europe. Its school, founded by Ansgar, the apostle of Scandinavia, educated the Saxon historian Widukind of Corvey, and its westwork, built from 873, is the oldest standing medieval building in Westphalia. The long decline began in 1265, when the men of Höxter and the bishop of Paderborn destroyed the abbey's own town. In 1337 the territory was ruled by Prince-Abbot Dietrich von Dalwigk, elected in 1336, whose right to hold a Vehmic court was confirmed by Charles IV in 1349. Corvey weathered the Reformation as a small self-ruling principality, though its church was sacked in 1634 during the Thirty Years' War and rebuilt only after 1665. It was raised to a prince-bishopric in 1792 and secularised in 1803, when its lands passed to the Principality of Nassau-Orange-Fulda.
zh: 科维是威悉河畔、赫克斯特城旁的本笃会帝国修道院，也是一个自治的教会领地。815年，皇帝虔诚者路易下令建院；822年，来自皮卡第科尔比修院的修士迁到现址，取名“新科尔比”。它于826年成为独立修院，833年获得莱茵河以东的第一项铸币权，836年又迎入圣维特的圣髑，由此成为重要的朝圣地和中欧最富庶的修院之一。修院学校由“斯堪的纳维亚使徒”安斯加尔创办，撒克逊史学家科维的维杜金德即出自其门下；873年起建造的西面结构是威斯特伐利亚现存最古老的中世纪建筑。1265年，赫克斯特市民联合帕德博恩主教摧毁了修院属下的城镇，修院由此步入长期衰落。1337年统治这块领地的是1336年当选的亲王院长迪特里希·冯·达尔维格，1349年皇帝卡尔四世确认了他开设菲姆法庭的权利。宗教改革时期，科维作为小型自治领地存续下来，但教堂在1634年三十年战争中遭劫掠，1665年后才得以重建。1792年它升为主教侯国，1803年被世俗化，领地并入拿骚-奥兰治-富尔达侯国。

en: The County of Hoya was a state of the Holy Roman Empire on the middle Weser in present-day Lower Saxony, centred on the town of Hoya between Bremen and Nienburg, with Nienburg its largest town. A first Count Henry of Hoya appears in 1202 as a vassal of the Archbishop of Bremen, and his family steadily built up its Weser estates, acquiring Nienburg in 1215 and absorbing the lands of the Hodenberg knights by 1313. In 1337 Count Gerhard III ruled at Hoya while his brother John II held the Nienburg portion, and in 1345 the two formally divided the county. The Hoya line became embroiled in the Münster Diocesan Feud of 1450 in a failed bid to place one of its own on the bishop's throne. When the elder branch died out in 1497 the lands were reunited under Count Jobst I at Nienburg. The Welf dukes of Brunswick-Lüneburg occupied the county in 1512 and became its liege lords, and when Otto VIII died without sons in 1582 Hoya was partitioned between the Calenberg and Lüneburg branches of Brunswick-Lüneburg and Hesse-Kassel.
zh: 霍亚伯国是神圣罗马帝国的邦国，位于今德国下萨克森州的威悉河中游，以不来梅与宁堡之间的霍亚镇为中心，宁堡是其最大城镇。1202年，首任霍亚伯爵海因里希作为不来梅大主教的封臣出现于记载，他的家族逐步经营威悉河畔的领地，1215年取得宁堡，到1313年吞并了霍登贝格骑士的地产。1337年，格哈德三世伯爵统治霍亚，其弟约翰二世领有宁堡部分，1345年两人正式瓜分伯国。霍亚支系卷入1450年的明斯特主教区纷争，试图将家族成员推上主教之位却告失败。1497年长支绝嗣，领地在宁堡的约布斯特一世治下重新统一。1512年，不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的韦尔夫公爵占领伯国并成为其宗主；1582年奥托八世无嗣而终，霍亚被不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的卡伦贝格支、吕讷堡支与黑森-卡塞尔瓜分。

en: The County of Holstein-Plön was a small state of the Holy Roman Empire, centered on Plön and the Kiel Fjord and ruled by the House of Schauenburg, whose counts had held Holstein since the early twelfth century. It was created around 1295, when Holstein-Itzehoe was split among the sons of Count Gerhard I into the counties of Plön, Rendsburg and Pinneberg. The first Plön count, Gerhard II the Blind, died in 1312, and in 1314 his son Gerhard IV sold his share to his half-brother John III the Mild, who ruled alone from Plön and also held Kiel and the island of Fehmarn. In 1337 John III was therefore one of the several Schauenburg cousins dividing Holstein between them. His son Gerhard V died without heirs in 1350 and John himself in 1359; when the Plön line ended in 1390, its lands passed to the rival counts of Holstein-Rendsburg. With their extinction in 1459, all of Holstein fell in 1460 to Christian I of Denmark, who in 1474 had the county raised to the Duchy of Holstein, and Plön remained part of the Danish-ruled duchy through the early modern partitions of Schleswig-Holstein.
zh: 荷尔斯泰因‑普伦伯国是神圣罗马帝国的一个小邦，以普伦和基尔峡湾为中心，由绍恩堡家族统治，该家族的伯爵们自12世纪初起便领有荷尔斯泰因。它约在1295年形成：格哈德一世伯爵死后，荷尔斯泰因‑伊策霍被他的儿子们分为普伦、伦茨堡和平讷贝格三个伯国。首任普伦伯爵是“瞎子”格哈德二世，1312年去世；1314年，他的儿子格哈德四世把自己的份额卖给异母弟“温和者”约翰三世，约翰三世独治普伦，还领有基尔和费马恩岛。因此在1337年，约翰三世是瓜分荷尔斯泰因的几位绍恩堡堂亲之一。他的儿子格哈德五世于1350年无嗣而终，约翰本人死于1359年；1390年普伦一系绝嗣，领地落入旁支荷尔斯泰因‑伦茨堡伯爵之手。1459年伦茨堡一系也告断绝，整个荷尔斯泰因于1460年归于丹麦国王克里斯蒂安一世，他又在1474年把伯国升格为荷尔斯泰因公国，普伦在此后石勒苏益格—荷尔斯泰因的历次分封中始终是丹麦统治下公国的一部分。

en: Heqing is a Bai-populated basin north of Dali, in north-western Yunnan. Under the Nanzhao kingdom it was organised as the Moutong Commandery, and under the Dali kingdom as the Moutong Prefecture; the Dali strongman Gao Shengtai enfeoffed his son Gao Taihui there, founding the Gao clan that ruled Heqing for centuries. After the Mongols conquered Dali in 1253 the territory was renamed Hezhou, and in 1271 it became the Heqing Route, still governed by hereditary Gao native chieftains. When Ming armies entered Yunnan in 1382 the court confirmed the Gao as prefects of Heqing, but in 1437 the native prefect Gao Lun was condemned and executed for violence and lawlessness. The native prefecture was then abolished: Lin Daojie arrived in 1443 as its first circulating-official prefect, while the Gao were reduced to hereditary thousand-household officers, and in 1683 demoted again to native assistant sub-prefects. The prefecture itself was downgraded to a department in 1770.
zh: 鹤庆是云南西北、大理以北的白族聚居坝子。南诏时在此设谋统郡，大理国时改为谋统府；大理国权臣高升泰把儿子高泰惠封到鹤庆，高氏从此开始了对鹤庆长达数百年的世代统治。1253年蒙古攻灭大理后改设鹤州，1271年又置鹤庆路，仍由高氏世袭土官治理。1382年明军入滇，朝廷承认高氏为鹤庆世袭土知府。1437年土知府高伦因暴虐不法获罪被诛，鹤庆随即改土归流，1443年林遒节到任为首任流官知府，高氏被降为世袭土千户，1683年再降为世袭土通判。1770年鹤庆府遭裁撤，降为鹤庆州。

en: The Harb are a large Arab tribal federation of the Hejaz, whose genealogists count them as a Qahtanite branch of the Khawlan, tracing descent from Harb ibn Saad ibn Khawlan. Their ancestors moved north from southern Arabia into the Hejaz around 131 AH, or about 749, in search of water and pasture, and fought the established Adnanite tribes of the region, among them the Juhayna, Anazzah, Muzayna and Sulaym, over wells and grazing grounds. After some three centuries of such struggles the Harb had become the dominant tribe of the central Hejaz, holding the country around the holy city of Medina. Their diyar, or tribal lands, ran from the Red Sea coast of the Tihama east into the Najd and from Medina south to al-Qunfudhah, while later branches also settled in Kuwait, Iraq, Bahrain and the Gulf. The whole tribe is divided into two great sections, the Banu Salim and the Masruh, each grouping many clans.
