zh: 哈尔卜是汉志的大型阿拉伯部落联盟，谱系学家将其归入豪兰人的盖哈坦分支，自称先祖为哈尔卜·本·萨阿德·本·豪兰。其祖先约在伊斯兰历131年、即公元749年前后为寻找水源和牧场，从阿拉伯半岛南部北迁汉志，为争夺水井和牧地与当地的阿德南部落长期冲突，对手包括朱海纳、阿纳扎、穆扎伊纳和苏莱姆等部。经过约三个世纪的争斗，哈尔卜成为汉志腹地最强大的部落，占据了圣城麦地那周围的乡野。其部落领地西起帖哈麦的红海沿岸，向东伸入内志，北起麦地那、南至贡富宰，后来还有支系在科威特、伊拉克、巴林和海湾地区落脚。全族分为巴尼·萨利姆和马斯鲁赫两大支，各统众多氏族。

en: Huarco was the coastal confederation of the Cañete valley, south of Lima, uniting the warlike Guarco of the lower valley with the Lunahuaná of the middle reaches. Its curaca Chuquimanco ruled from a string of fortresses, among them Ungará and Canchari behind the great Huarco wall, and its rich irrigated fields made the kingdom a contemporary and rival of Chimor. After absorbing Chincha the Incas invaded in the 1450s under Capac Yupanqui, but four years of campaigning failed to break the valley; they built the citadel of Incahuasi as their base and cut the irrigation canals to starve the defenders out. The end came through a ruse credited to Mama Ocllo Coya: a promised joint fishing rite for the sea goddess Mama Cocha emptied the forts, and the Inca army struck. The surviving leaders were hanged at Canchari, the people were displaced and replaced by mitmaq settlers, and a victory fortress rose at Cerro Azul.
zh: 瓦尔科是利马以南卡涅特河谷的海岸联盟，由下游好战的瓜尔科人与中游的卢纳瓦纳人联合而成。酋长丘基曼科凭借一连串要塞统治，其中包括温加拉、坎查里和巨大的瓦尔科长城，富庶的灌溉农田使这个王国成为与奇穆同时并立的强敌。印加人吞并钦查后，于1450年代在卡帕克·尤潘基率领下发兵来攻，但四年征战仍无法突入河谷；他们建起印卡瓦西城寨作为基地，又截断灌溉渠，想靠饥饿迫使守军屈服。最后破城靠的是玛玛·奥克略·科亚的计谋：印加人提出共同举行祭祀海神玛玛·科查的捕鱼仪式，要塞因此一空，印加军队随即动手。幸存首领在坎查里被绞死，居民被迁往他处，由米特马克移民取代，印加人还在塞罗阿苏尔建起庆功要塞。

en: The Harla were a Muslim people of the eastern Ethiopian lowlands whose kingdom is traced by archaeology to the sixth century, making it the strongest state of the region after the decline of Aksum. Its stone towns, above all the ruined city of Harlaa, or Hubat, northwest of modern Harar, held mosques, fortifications and workshops linked by trade to the Red Sea and the Indian Ocean, and medieval writers credit the Harla with their own coinage and calendar. Their rulers bore the title garad and their scholars the honorific kabir. In the ninth century the Makhzumi dynasty, the first Muslim ruling house of the Horn, arose on Harla soil at Walale, and by the thirteenth century the Harla were subordinates of the Walashma sultans of Ifat; in the fourteenth century their imam Salih joined Ifat's wars against Emperor Amda Seyon I. Under the Adal Sultanate the Harla formed an autonomous tribal confederation and supplied the elite Malassay soldiery: the imam Mahfuz was a Harla, and Ahmed Gran seized power at Harar by executing the Walashma sultan Abu Bakr. Harla clans fought on until the campaigns of Sarsa Dengel late in the sixteenth century, when Oromo invasions and the transfer of Adal's capital to Aussa in 1577 broke their polity. The survivors were absorbed into Somali, Afar and Oromo societies, while the Harari people of walled Harar preserve seven Harla clans as their founding stock.
zh: 哈尔拉人是埃塞俄比亚东部低地的穆斯林民族，考古发现其国家可追溯到6世纪，是阿克苏姆衰落后该地区最强的政权。他们的石砌城镇，尤其是今哈拉尔西北已成废墟的哈拉阿城（即胡巴特），拥有清真寺、防御工事和作坊，贸易远及红海和印度洋；中世纪作家还记载哈尔拉人自铸钱币、自有历法。他们的统治者称加拉德，学者尊号为卡比尔。9世纪，非洲之角第一个穆斯林王室马赫祖米王朝在哈尔拉土地上的瓦拉莱兴起；13世纪时，哈尔拉人沦为伊法特瓦拉什马苏丹的属部，14世纪其伊玛目萨利赫还参加了伊法特对抗阿姆达·塞翁一世的战争。在阿达尔苏丹国治下，哈尔拉人组成自治的部落联盟，并提供精锐的马拉赛部队：伊玛目马赫富兹便是哈尔拉人，艾哈迈德·格兰也是在哈拉尔处死瓦拉什马苏丹阿布·伯克尔后夺取大权。哈尔拉诸部一直战斗到16世纪末萨尔萨·丹格尔的战事，奥罗莫人的入侵和1577年阿达尔迁都奥萨瓦解了他们的政权。幸存者融入索马里、阿法尔和奥罗莫社会，而城墙环绕的哈拉尔城中的哈拉里人，仍以七个哈尔拉氏族作为立族之基。

en: The County of Horne began around the year 1100 as a lordship in the lower Maas valley, taking its name from the village of Horn west of Roermond, whose castle was the family seat. Already by 1243 it was held as a fief of the County of Loon, and through marriage and purchase its lords built up a personal union of neighbouring lordships including Weert and Wessem, becoming vassals at various times of Liège, Guelders, Holland and Brabant. In 1337 the lord was William IV, who had succeeded in 1330. The family rose in standing under the Burgundian dukes: Jacob I, an ally of Philip the Good, was raised to the rank of imperial count in 1450, after which the lordship was known as the County of Horne, and Jacob III was admitted to the Order of the Golden Fleece in 1505. Its most famous lord, Philip de Montmorency, was one of the leaders of the Netherlandish opposition to the religious policy of Philip II of Spain and was beheaded at Brussels in 1568 together with the Count of Egmont. As he left no son, his fiefs were confiscated by the Duke of Alba, and the Loon portion reverted to the Prince-Bishop of Liège, who ruled it in personal union while Horne kept its own laws and finances. French revolutionary troops ended the county in 1795, folding its lands into the département of Meuse-Inférieure, and in 1815 they passed to the United Kingdom of the Netherlands.
zh: 霍恩伯国约于1100年作为马斯河下游的一处领地兴起，得名于鲁尔蒙德以西的霍恩村，村中城堡是家族的祖居。早在1243年它就作为洛恩伯国的封邑被领有，领主们又通过联姻和购地把韦尔特、韦瑟姆等邻近领地拼成一个共主联合体，并先后成为列日、海尔德、荷兰和布拉班特的封臣。1337年在位的是1330年继位的威廉四世。家族在勃艮第公爵治下地位上升：雅各布一世作为好人腓力的盟友，于1450年获封帝国伯爵，领地此后被称为霍恩伯国；雅各布三世则于1505年加入金羊毛骑士团。最知名的领主菲利普·德·蒙莫朗西是尼德兰反对西班牙国王腓力二世宗教裁判政策的领袖之一，1568年在布鲁塞尔与埃格蒙特伯爵一同被斩首。他没有儿子，封邑被阿尔瓦公爵没收，原属洛恩的部分转归列日采邑主教，由主教以共主身份统治，而霍恩仍保留自己的法律和财政。1795年法国革命军终结了伯国，将其土地并入下默兹省，1815年又转入尼德兰联合王国。

en: Horo was the Hūrga Jurchen polity of the Khor River, a 453-kilometre right-bank tributary of the Ussuri rising on the western slopes of the northern Sikhote-Alin, with a trading settlement at its mouth. When the Ming organized the lower Amur and Ussuri country through the Nurgan commission after 1409, the eunuch Yishiha stationed guard units along the Khor as on the neighboring Songari, Muling and Nen. The valley's chiefs held their titles hereditarily as tribute bearers until the wars of 1596 to 1625, in which Nurhaci's Jianzhou armies subdued the Wild Jurchen tribes and drew the Khor people into the Eight Banners.
zh: 霍罗是霍尔河流域的虎尔哈女真小邦。霍尔河发源于锡霍特山脉北坡西麓，长453公里，是乌苏里江右岸支流，河口处有贸易聚落。1409年后明朝以奴儿干都司经营黑龙江下游与乌苏里江地区，太监亦失哈像在松花江、穆棱河、嫩江一样，沿霍尔河部署卫所。河谷酋长以朝贡者身份世袭官职，直到1596—1625年的战事：努尔哈赤的建州军队征服野人女真诸部，霍尔河人也被纳入八旗。

en: Hansca is the game's name for the Golden Horde's western steppe frontier around Orhei and Chișinău, between the Prut and the Dniester, where the garrison town of Shehr al-Jedid stood at Old Orhei. After the Horde's decline in the 1340s the district passed to Moldavia, and Chișinău is first documented in 1436 as a monastery village.
zh: 汉斯卡是游戏对奥尔海伊、基希讷乌一带（普鲁特河与德涅斯特河之间）金帐汗国西部草原边境的称呼，汗国的驻军城镇谢赫里杰迪德就坐落在旧奥尔海伊。14世纪40年代金帐汗国衰落后，该地区并入摩尔达维亚，基希讷乌最早见于1436年的记载，当时是一座修道院村庄。

en: Hsenwi, called Theinni by the Burmese and recorded in Chinese sources as Mubang, was the largest of the Shan states west of the Salween, with its capital at Hsenwi town. Tai tradition traces its predecessor kingdom of Siviratta back to before 650, and at its height the state covered the territories later known as North and South Hsenwi, Kehsi Mansam, Mong Hsu, Mong Sang and Mong Nawng, holding the Wa lands east of the Salween in a loose protectorate. It submitted to the Yuan dynasty as a route command under Yunnan, and the Ming set up first a prefecture and then a pacification office there. During the Ming–Burmese wars of the late sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries the Toungoo dynasty seized Hsenwi and drew it into the Burmese orbit. In the Sino-Burmese War of 1765 to 1769 the Qing general Ming Rui overran Hsenwi in 1767 and turned it into his main supply base before his army was destroyed deeper in Burma, leaving the state under Konbaung rule.
zh: 兴威缅语称兴尼，中国史籍称木邦，是萨尔温江以西最大的掸人邦国，都城在兴威城。据傣族传说，其前身“尸毗国”早在650年以前便已存在；鼎盛时其版图囊括后来的北兴威、南兴威、科西曼桑、孟休、孟桑和孟瑙等地，还以松散的保护关系控制着萨尔温江以东的佤人地区。它归附元朝后被设为云南辖下的木邦路军民总管府，明朝则先置木邦府、后改木邦宣慰司。16世纪末至17世纪初的明缅战争中，东吁王朝攻占木邦，将其纳入缅甸势力范围。1765至1769年清缅战争期间，清将明瑞于1767年攻陷兴威，把它作为主要粮草基地，但清军深入缅甸后覆灭，兴威仍留在贡榜王朝治下。

en: Hersfeld was a Benedictine imperial abbey on the Fulda river in northern Hesse. Saint Sturm made the first foundation before 744 but removed the community to Fulda when Saxon raids made the site unsafe, and around 769 Lullus, Archbishop of Mainz, re-founded the monastery. Charlemagne granted it the status of an imperial abbey in 775, and with papal exemption from episcopal jurisdiction it grew rich, holding more than a thousand hides of land and a hundred and fifty monks. The relics of Saint Wigbert made it a pilgrimage centre from 780, and its library and annals carried its fame as a seat of learning; its abbot Lullus was canonised in 852. In the Investiture Controversy Hersfeld backed Emperor Henry IV, whose son Conrad was born and baptised within the abbey, and after the Concordat of Worms its abbots sat as princes of the empire. In 1371 the town of Hersfeld sought the protection of the Landgraves of Hesse, and by 1513 the community had so decayed that its last abbot resigned and the house was placed under Fulda. From 1606 Hesse administered the abbey territory, which the peace of 1648 converted into the secular Principality of Hersfeld.
zh: 黑斯费尔德是黑森北部富尔达河畔的本笃会帝国修道院。圣斯图姆曾在744年前首次建院，但因萨克森人袭扰、驻地不安全而把修士迁往富尔达；约769年，美因茨大主教卢卢斯重新创立了这座修道院。775年，查理曼赐予它帝国修道院地位，又获教皇豁免、不受主教管辖，黑斯费尔德由此富庶，拥有逾千胡芬土地和一百五十名修士。780年起，圣维格贝特的圣骨使它成为朝圣地，藏书与编年史令它以学术中心闻名；院长卢卢斯于852年被封圣。叙任权斗争中，黑斯费尔德支持皇帝亨利四世，皇帝之子康拉德便出生并受洗于这座修道院；《沃尔姆斯宗教协定》后，院长以帝国诸侯身份列席帝国议会。1371年，黑斯费尔德城转而寻求黑森方伯的保护；到1513年，修院衰败至极，末代院长辞职，修院被交给富尔达管辖。1606年起黑森家族管理修道院领地，1648年的和约将其改为世俗的黑斯费尔德侯国。

en: Hsipaw, also known as Onbaung after its old capital and centered on the town of Hsipaw in the northern Shan highlands, was one of the leading Shan principalities. Local tradition claims a predecessor state named Dutthavati founded in 58 BC, and by the early fourteenth century Onbaung was strong enough to launch attacks on the Burmese kingdom of Pinya, whose king Thihathu repulsed one such raid; another war with Ava followed in 1415. Hsipaw reached the height of its influence in the chaos after Möng Yang overran Ava: in 1543 its saopha Hkonmaing was placed on the Ava throne itself, though the Shan confederation he led collapsed before the Toungoo armies of Bayinnaung, who subjugated Hsipaw with the other Shan states in 1556 and 1557. During the Sino-Burmese War the Qing army of Ming Rui occupied Hsipaw in 1767 on its march down the Namtu river, and the decisive Burmese stand at the Goteik Gorge took place just south of the state. Restored to Burmese rule, it remained among the wealthiest of the sawbwa states.
zh: 昔卜又以旧都之名被称作温巴，核心在掸邦高原北部的昔卜城，是最重要的掸人邦国之一。当地传说其前身“杜达瓦提国”建于公元前58年；14世纪初，温巴已强大到敢于进攻缅甸的彬牙王国，国王底哈都曾击退它的来犯，1415年它又与阿瓦开战。孟养攻陷阿瓦后的乱局中，昔卜势力达到顶峰：1543年其诏法康孟被扶上阿瓦王位，但他领导的掸邦联盟在东吁勃印曩的大军面前瓦解，昔卜也于1556至1557年与其他掸邦一同臣服。清缅战争期间，明瑞的清军于1767年占领昔卜，沿南渡河推进，而缅甸军队关键的戈泰峡谷阻击战就发生在该邦以南。重归缅甸统治后，昔卜仍是最富庶的诏法邦国之一。

en: The Hoysalas arose in the forested Malnad hills of the Western Ghats as feudatories of the Western Chalukyas of Kalyani, claiming descent from the legendary Sala, who was said to have slain a tiger to save his Jain guru. Under Vishnuvardhana, who defeated the Cholas at Talakad in 1116, they became an independent power ruling most of Karnataka from first Belur and then Dvarasamudra, modern Halebidu. Veera Ballala II formally declared independence in 1193 and took the title Emperor of the South after routing the Pandyas in 1217, and his successors pushed into the Tamil country, making Kannanur Kuppam a provincial capital. The Hoysala age was one of South India's great artistic periods: kings and merchants patronised Jain and Vaishnava learning in Kannada and Sanskrit and raised the sculptured temples of Belur, Halebidu and Somanathapura. Disaster came from the north: Malik Kafur sacked Dvarasamudra in 1311 and Delhi forces plundered it again in 1327. By 1336, when the Yadavas, Kakatiyas and Pandyas had all fallen, the Hoysalas were the last Hindu kingdom still resisting. Veera Ballala III, the ruler of 1337, held his court at Tiruvannamalai and fought both the Delhi sultans and the Madurai Sultanate until he was killed at the battle of Madurai in 1343; his domains then passed to his former officers Harihara and Bukka, the founders of the Vijayanagara Empire.
zh: 曷萨拉人崛起于西高止山森林密布的马尔纳德地区，本是格利亚尼西遮娄其王朝的附庸，自称传说是为救耆那教上师而搏杀猛虎的英雄萨拉的后裔。在毗湿奴伐弹那治下，他们于1116年在塔拉卡度击败朱罗人，成为独立强权，以贝鲁尔、后以德瓦拉萨穆德罗（今哈勒比杜）为都，统治卡纳达的大部分土地。毗罗·巴拉拉二世于1193年正式宣布独立，1217年击溃潘地亚人后获得“南方皇帝”的称号，后继者又深入泰米尔地区，以坎纳努尔·库潘为行都。曷萨拉时代是南印度艺术的鼎盛期之一：君主与商人赞助耆那教和毗湿奴派的卡纳达语、梵语学术，建起贝鲁尔、哈勒比杜和索马纳塔普拉那些雕刻繁丽的神庙。灾难来自北方：马利克·卡富尔于1311年洗劫德瓦拉萨穆德罗，德里军队又在1327年再度劫掠。到1336年，耶陀婆、卡卡提亚和潘地亚俱已沦亡，曷萨拉成为唯一仍在抵抗的印度教王国。1337年在位的毗罗·巴拉拉三世以提卢瓦那摩罗为朝廷所在，同时与德里苏丹国和马杜赖苏丹国作战，直到1343年在马杜赖战役中阵亡；他的领地随后归于旧臣诃利诃罗和布卡，也就是毗奢耶那伽罗帝国的缔造者。

en: The Ayyubid emirate of Hasankeyf was the longest-lived remnant of Saladin's Ayyubid state, a Kurdish principality on the Tigris in the Jazira whose meliks claimed descent from the Ayyubid dynasty. It began in 1232, when the Ayyubid prince as-Salih Ayyub, son of Sultan al-Kamil, received Hasankeyf as his appanage. Its citadel town grew into a prosperous center of learning, with madrasas, caravanserais, mosques and libraries patronized by the emirs, and it outlasted the Mongol Ilkhanate under a succession of overlords. In 1337 the throne belonged to al-Adil Shihab al-Din, who ruled until 1349. The emirate later submitted to Timur, and in the 1460s Uzun Hasan of the Aq Qoyunlu besieged Hasankeyf and killed its melik, Khalaf; a restored Ayyubid line retook both Hasankeyf and Siirt, but its last melik was captured by the Safavids and escaped only after the Battle of Chaldiran in 1514. The emirate was finally dissolved by the Ottomans in 1524.
zh: 哈桑凯伊夫阿尤布埃米尔国是萨拉丁建立的阿尤布王朝存续最久的余脉，为底格里斯河畔杰济拉地区的库尔德政权，其梅利克君主都自称阿尤布王室后裔。它始于1232年，阿尤布王子、苏丹卡米勒之子萨利赫·阿尤布受封哈桑凯伊夫作为封地。这座要塞城镇发展成繁荣的学术中心，埃米尔们兴建经学院、商队旅馆、清真寺和图书馆，政权在一连串宗主之间存续下来，熬过了蒙古伊儿汗国。1337年在位的是阿迪勒·谢哈布丁，统治至1349年。埃米尔国后来臣服于帖木儿，1460年代白羊王朝的乌尊·哈桑围攻哈桑凯伊夫，杀梅利克哈拉夫；复辟的阿尤布支系一度夺回哈桑凯伊夫和锡尔特，但末代梅利克被萨法维人俘虏，直到1514年查尔迪兰战役后才逃脱。1524年，埃米尔国最终被奥斯曼人解散。

en: The County of Holstein-Pinneberg was the smallest of the three states carved out of Holstein-Itzehoe in 1290, when the sons of Gerhard I of Schauenburg divided their inheritance. Ruled from Pinneberg by the Pinneberg line of the counts of Schauenburg, who also held the County of Schaumburg on the Weser, it amounted to little more than the Pinneberg lands west of Hamburg; later in the fourteenth century its counts also gained the Haseldorfer Marsh, mortgaged to them by the archbishop of Bremen and never redeemed. In 1337 its ruler was Count Adolf VII of Schauenburg. While Christian III of Denmark imposed the Reformation on the rest of Holstein in 1537, Pinneberg remained Catholic until 1559. When the Schaumburg line died out with Count Otto V in 1640, the county was absorbed into the Duchy of Holstein, and in 1650 its northern third was re-granted as the County of Rantzau.
zh: 荷尔斯泰因‑平讷贝格伯国是1290年荷尔斯泰因‑伊策霍分裂时产生的三个小邦中最小的一个，由绍恩堡的格哈德一世的儿子们瓜分遗产而形成。绍恩堡伯爵的平讷贝格支系以平讷贝格为统治中心，同时领有威悉河畔的绍姆堡伯国；辖地主要是汉堡以西的平讷贝格一带，14世纪后期又获得不来梅大主教抵押的哈泽尔多夫沼泽，此后再未赎回。1337年的统治者是绍恩堡伯爵阿道夫七世。1537年丹麦国王克里斯蒂安三世在荷尔斯泰因其余地区强制推行宗教改革，平讷贝格却一直保持天主教信仰，直到1559年才改宗。1640年绍姆堡支系的奥托五世绝嗣而亡，伯国被并入荷尔斯泰因公国；1650年其北部三分之一的土地被重新封为兰曹伯国。

en: Teayotlan was a Huastec town in the low hills of the northern Veracruz Huasteca, on the route from the highlands down to Tuxpan, and its archaeological site is the present-day Castillo de Teayo. The Huastec name teayoc means on the stone turtle, and the town appears under the Teayotlan glyph in the Tuxpan Canvas. Huastec builders raised its pyramid between the 10th and 12th centuries, when the site was one of the cities of the Huastec lowlands. In the Late Postclassic it came under strong Toltec and Mexica influence, and after the Huastec polities became Aztec tributaries around 1450 the surviving temple was rebuilt in Aztec style, one of the few Huastec pyramid-temples still standing.
zh: 特奥约特兰是韦拉克鲁斯北部瓦斯特卡低丘地带的瓦斯特克城镇，地处高原通往图斯潘的要道上，其考古遗址即今特阿约城堡。瓦斯特克语名字特阿约克意为“石龟之上”，《图斯潘画布》以特奥约特兰象形字记录此地。10至12世纪，瓦斯特克工匠在这里建起金字塔，该城当时是瓦斯特卡低地诸城之一。进入后古典期晚期，它受到托尔特克与墨西加的强烈影响；1450年前后瓦斯特克诸邦沦为阿兹特克藩属后，城中留存的神庙又按阿兹特克风格改建，成为为数不多留存下来的瓦斯特克金字塔神庙之一。

en: Hotin perches on cliffs above a crossing of the Dniester, on the road between the Carpathians and the Black Sea steppe. A Kievan Rus' settlement grew there from the eleventh century and passed to the princes of Halych-Volhynia, whose river crossing drew a Genoese trading colony by the thirteenth century. The town is first named in 1310 as the seat of a Catholic bishop, and the Kingdom of Poland held it and raised its first fortifications in the first half of the fourteenth century. The Grand Duchy of Lithuania took Hotin in 1351 and handed it to the emerging Principality of Moldavia three years later. After 1400 Prince Alexandru cel Bun, aided by Vytautas of Lithuania, built the stone fortress, which Poland occupied during the succession wars after 1433 until Ștefan the Great retook it in 1459 after a two-year siege and made it the strongest bulwark on Moldavia's northern border. As Ottoman power advanced, Hotin became the gate between Christendom and the steppe: Polish-Lithuanian armies defeated the Turks there in 1621 and again in 1673, but the Ottomans finally annexed the fortress in 1713 and held it until Russia's Bessarabian conquest of 1812.
zh: 霍京雄踞德涅斯特河一处渡口上方的悬崖，扼守喀尔巴阡山与黑海草原之间的通道。11世纪起这里形成罗斯定居点，后归属加利奇-沃伦王公；凭借渡口之利，13世纪时已有热那亚贸易殖民点。1310年该地首次见于记载，时为天主教主教驻地；14世纪上半叶，波兰王国占据霍京并修筑了最初的防御工事。1351年立陶宛大公国夺取霍京，三年后将它交给正在兴起的摩尔达维亚公国。1400年后，亚历山德鲁大公在立陶宛的维陶塔斯协助下建成石砌要塞；1433年后的继承战争中波兰一度占领该城，直到1459年什特凡大公经两年围攻将其收复，把它建成摩尔达维亚北境最坚固的堡垒。随着奥斯曼势力推进，霍京成为基督教世界与草原之间的门户：波兰-立陶宛军队曾于1621年和1673年两度在此击败土耳其人，但奥斯曼最终于1713年吞并要塞，并一直据守到1812年俄国征服比萨拉比亚。

en: The County of Holstein-Rendsburg, ruled by the Schauenburg dynasty, was created in 1290 when Holstein-Itzehoe was partitioned into the counties of Rendsburg, Plön and Pinneberg. Its seat was Rendsburg, on the Eider river border with Denmark. In 1337 its count was Gerhard III, called the Great, who had overshadowed all his Schauenburg cousins: in 1326 he helped depose King Christopher II of Denmark and set his own nephew Valdemar of Schleswig on the Danish throne, ruling as regent and securing the Constitutio Valdemariana, which detached Schleswig from Denmark. From 1332 to 1340 Gerhard was the effective ruler of Jutland and Funen, while much of the Danish crown land was mortgaged to the Holstein counts, until a Danish squire, Niels Ebbesen, slew him in his bed at Randers in 1340 and opened the way for Valdemar IV. Later counts kept their hold on Schleswig: Gerhard VI received it as a Danish fief in 1386, and with Hanseatic help the counts forced King Erik of Pomerania to confirm their rule there in 1432. When the last Schauenburg, Adolphus VIII, died childless in 1459, the Schleswig-Holstein estates elected Christian I of Denmark as their lord at Ribe in 1460, on condition that the two lands stay forever undivided; in 1474 the emperor raised Holstein to a duchy.
zh: 荷尔斯泰因‑伦茨堡伯国由绍恩堡家族统治，1290年荷尔斯泰因‑伊策霍被分为伦茨堡、普伦和平讷贝格三个伯国时诞生，治所伦茨堡坐落在与丹麦交界的艾德河畔。1337年在位的是人称“大帝”的格哈德三世，他的声势盖过所有绍恩堡堂亲：1326年他参与废黜丹麦国王克里斯托弗二世，把自己的外甥、石勒苏益格的瓦尔德马扶上丹麦王位，自己出任摄政，并通过《瓦尔德马宪章》使石勒苏益格脱离丹麦。1332—1340年，格哈德实际统治着日德兰和菲英岛，丹麦王室领地大半被抵押给荷尔斯泰因诸伯爵；直到1340年，丹麦乡绅尼尔斯·埃贝森在兰讷斯闯入卧室将他杀死，为瓦尔德马四世扫清了道路。此后的伯爵们保住了石勒苏益格：格哈德六世于1386年以丹麦封臣身份领有该地，又靠汉萨同盟之助，在1432年迫使波美拉尼亚的埃里克国王承认他们的统治。1459年末代绍恩堡阿道夫八世无嗣而终，石勒苏益格—荷尔斯泰因等级会议于1460年在里伯选举丹麦国王克里斯蒂安一世为君主，条件是两地永不分割；1474年，皇帝将荷尔斯泰因升格为公国。

en: The Principality of Hatukay was a Circassian state born in the 1330s, when the Hatukay people split from the neighbouring Chemguy principality. Its princes, the Cherchanuqo, traced their line to Prince Hatuqo, a grandson of the legendary king Inal the Great, who led his followers west to the Black Sea coast near the Taman peninsula, where the Hatukay lived in the fourteenth century. They governed through Circassian customary law and the princes' assembly, the Khase, and were famed as warriors, fighting the Crimean Khanate and rival Circassian principalities; in the sixteenth century a Hatukay prince joined the Kabardians in sacking Astrakhan. Since nobles scorned trade, a large Armenian community, the Cherkesogai, handled commerce in their lands. The principality later moved inland between the Belaya and Pshish rivers, where it fought through the long Russo-Circassian wars of the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries.
zh: 哈图凯公国是切尔克斯人的政权，1330年代哈图凯人从邻近的切姆盖公国分离出来后建立。统治它的切尔恰努科家族把世系追溯到传奇大王伊纳尔之孙哈图科王公：他率部众西迁到塔曼半岛附近的黑海沿岸，14世纪的哈图凯人就生活在这一带。他们依照切尔克斯习惯法和王公会议“哈塞”治理，以善战闻名，长期与克里米亚汗国及切尔克斯诸邻邦交兵；16世纪还有一位哈图凯王公随卡巴尔达人劫掠阿斯特拉罕。由于贵族鄙视经商，境内的商业主要由人数众多的切尔克斯盖伊亚美尼亚人经营。公国后来迁入别拉亚河与普希什河之间的内陆，并在18世纪至19世纪初漫长的俄切尔克斯战争中苦战。

en: Huitzquilic, a Nahuatl name meaning place of thistles, was a chiefdom in the interior of what is now Jalisco, on the site of the later town of San Martín de Hidalgo. It was settled around 1480 by Coca, Purépecha and Tepenahuales peoples, the last a Nahua group that had halted its migration toward Zacatula, and was ruled by the chief Huitzingarit under the overlordship of Amecatl of Ameca. When the first Spaniards arrived in 1540 Huitzingarit submitted peacefully, was baptised Martín Santiago and was recognised as captain of his people. Around his seat the Spanish laid out the town that became San Martín de la Cal.
zh: 惠茨奎利克是纳瓦特尔语地名，意为蓟之地，位于今哈利斯科内陆，即后来圣马丁镇的所在。1480年前后，科卡人、普雷佩查人和特佩纳瓦莱斯人在此定居，其中特佩纳瓦莱斯是一支原本迁往萨卡图拉的纳瓦人队伍，途中留居下来；城邦由酋长维辛加里特统治，奉阿梅卡的阿梅卡特尔为宗主。1540年首批西班牙人到来时，维辛加里特和平归降，受洗改名马丁·圣地亚哥，并被承认为本族人的队长。西班牙人在他的驻地旁建起城镇，后来称为圣马丁·德拉卡尔。

en: The Huiba are the Jurchen tribe recorded as the Hoifa, a Haixi Jurchen group named after the Hoifa river in present-day Huinan county, Jilin. Its ruling house, the Hoifa Nara, descended from the Ikderi clan of the Nimaca tribe in the Heilongjiang region and adopted the Nara surname after migrating south. In the fourteenth century these Jurchens still lived along the lower Songhua under Mongol Yuan overlordship, and their move into the Hoifa valley came only under the Ming. During the Jiajing reign of 1522 to 1566 the first beile Wangginu built a triple-walled fortress on Huerqi mountain, and the Hoifa became one of the Four Hulun tribes alongside the Hada, Ula and Yehe. It joined the nine-tribe coalition that Nurhaci defeated at the battle of Gule Mountain in 1593. In 1607 Nurhaci stormed Hoifa city, put the last beile Baindari to death, and enrolled the tribe in the Eight Banners.
zh: 惠巴即史籍中的辉发部，属海西女真，因世居今吉林省辉南县的辉发河畔而得名。其统治家族辉发那拉氏出自黑龙江地区尼马察部的益克得里氏，南迁后改姓那拉氏。14世纪时，这些女真人还在蒙古元朝治下的松花江下游生活，进入明代才南迁到辉发河流域。嘉靖年间（1522—1566年），初代贝勒王机褚在扈尔奇山修筑三重城墙的辉发城，辉发部从此与哈达、乌拉、叶赫并称扈伦四部。1593年古勒山之战，辉发参加九部联军，被努尔哈赤击败；1607年努尔哈赤攻破辉发城，杀死末代贝勒拜音达里，部众被编入八旗。

en: The Kingdom of Hungary arose when Stephen I was crowned its first Christian king around the year 1000; in 1102 it entered a personal union with Croatia, and Andrew II's Golden Bull of 1222 limited royal power before the Mongol invasion of 1241 to 1242 devastated the realm. When the native dynasty ended in 1301, competing oligarchs tore the kingdom apart until Charles Robert of the Capetian Anjou line, crowned with the Holy Crown in 1310, defeated them at the Battle of Rozgony in 1312 and restored royal authority by 1321. In 1337 this king, Charles I, ruled from Visegrád over a realm made wealthy by its gold mines, though his defeat at Posada in 1330 left Wallachia independent. His son Louis the Great brought Hungary to its peak, and under Sigismund of Luxembourg the Ottoman advance began; John Hunyadi's victory at Belgrade in 1456 held it back for half a century, and Matthias Corvinus made his court a centre of the Renaissance. The Ottoman victory at Mohács in 1526 split Hungary into Habsburg Royal Hungary, Ottoman Hungary and Transylvania, only reunited after the Treaty of Karlowitz of 1699. A revolt led by Francis Rákóczi ended with the Treaty of Szatmár in 1711, and the Diet accepted hereditary Habsburg rule in 1723, the kingdom remaining a separate realm within the Habsburg monarchy.
zh: 匈牙利王国诞生于约1000年伊什特万一世加冕为第一位基督教国王之时，1102年与克罗地亚结成共主邦联；安德烈二世1222年颁布的《金玺诏书》限制了王权，1241至1242年的蒙古入侵又使王国惨遭蹂躏。1301年本土王朝绝嗣，割据寡头瓜分国家，直到卡佩家族安茹支系的查理·罗贝尔于1310年戴上圣冠，1312年在罗日戈尼战役击败群雄，到1321年重建王权。1337年，这位卡罗伊一世以维谢格拉德为都，靠金矿致富的匈牙利国力充盈，但1330年他在波萨达战败，瓦拉几亚由此独立。其子拉约什一世（大王）把匈牙利推向鼎盛；卢森堡的西吉斯蒙德在位时奥斯曼人开始西进，匈雅提·亚诺什1456年在贝尔格莱德获胜，挡住攻势达半个世纪，马加什·科尔温则把宫廷建成文艺复兴中心。1526年奥斯曼在莫哈奇获胜，匈牙利分裂为哈布斯堡治下的皇家匈牙利、奥斯曼属匈牙利和特兰西瓦尼亚三部分，直到1699年《卡尔洛维茨条约》后才重新统一。拉科齐·费伦茨领导的起义以1711年《索特马尔条约》告终，1723年议会接受哈布斯堡家族世袭统治，匈牙利作为独立王国留在哈布斯堡君主国之内。

en: The Hūrga, also recorded as Hurka, Huligai or Kurka, were a Tungusic Jurchen people of the Hurka River, as the Mudan was then called, and the lower Sungari, with their chief seat at Ilan Hala, modern Yilan, at the confluence of the two rivers. Under the Jin a separate Huligai route administered their lands, and in Yuan times they were counted among the tribes settled around Yilan. In 1388 the Hongwu court enlisted the Huligai together with the Odoli and Tuowen, and in 1403 their chief Ahacu was made commander of the Jianzhou Guard; that branch moved south and became part of the Jianzhou Jurchens. The Hūrga who remained in the river valley were later listed by Qing records as the Kurka, one of the three Donghai Jurchen groups alongside the Woji and Warka. Between 1596 and 1625 Nurhaci's campaigns subdued these eastern tribes, enrolling many Hūrga in the Eight Banners, while in 1654 the Qing resettled Ducher farmers from the Amur onto the Sungari and Hurka, and in 1692 made Sanxing, as Yilan was then known, a deputy lieutenant-general's seat.
zh: 虎尔哈（又译虎尔喀、瑚尔喀、库尔喀，即胡里改）是通古斯语族的女真人，居于当时称虎尔哈河的牡丹江及松花江下游一带，核心在两河交汇处的依兰哈喇（今依兰）。金朝曾单设胡里改路管辖其地，元代他们属聚居依兰一带的部落之一。1388年，明朝廷招抚胡里改与斡朵里、托温三部；1403年，其首领阿哈出被任为建州卫指挥使，这一支南迁，融入建州女真。留在河谷的虎尔哈人后被清代文献记为库尔喀部，与渥集、瓦尔喀并列为东海女真三大部。1596—1625年间，努尔哈赤连年用兵征服这些东部部落，许多虎尔哈人被编入八旗；1654年清朝又把黑龙江的杜切尔农民迁到松花江和虎尔哈河一带，1692年在三姓（即依兰）设副都统衙署。

en: Hutaym is not the name of a single genealogical tribe but a derogatory exonym applied across the Arabian Peninsula to independent nomadic groups of low social standing; the word derives from an Arabic adjective meaning a man whose front teeth are broken, that is, one who cannot trace his ancestry. Dominant tribes regarded these groups as neither Qahtanite nor Adnanite and refused to intermarry with them. The principal communities covered by the label were branches of the Rashayida, who claim descent from the Banu Abs, along with other marginalized groups such as the Awazim of eastern Arabia. They bred camels, sheep and goats, were esteemed as hunters, and coastal groups lived by fishing. Their main grounds lay around Khaybar, whose lava field was also called the Harrat Hutaym, in the Nafud desert and at the al-Mustajidda oasis, with groups moving south into the Tihama and others found in Egypt, Sudan and the Red Sea islands. The name first appears in Arabic literature around 1200, and early sixteenth-century Ottoman tax registers list the Hutaym among the five tribes of the sanjak of Gaza paying tribute to the sultan; a register of 1553 records them raiding the sanjak of Ajlun. By the early nineteenth century European travellers used the term plainly as the label of a low caste rather than a tribe.
zh: 胡泰姆并非某个血缘部落的名称，而是阿拉伯半岛对社会地位较低的独立游牧群体使用的贬称；该词来自一个阿拉伯语形容词，意为门牙断裂的人，即无法追溯祖先血脉之人。占主导地位的部落认为这些群体既非盖哈坦人也非阿德南人，拒绝与之通婚。被贴上这一标签的主要是拉沙伊达的各分支，他们自称源自阿卜斯部落，另外还包括阿拉伯东部的阿瓦齐姆等边缘群体。他们饲养骆驼、绵羊和山羊，以善猎著称，沿海群体则以捕鱼为生。其主要活动范围在海拜尔一带——当地的熔岩原野也被称为胡泰姆熔岩区——以及内夫得沙漠和穆斯塔吉达绿洲，部分群体向南进入帖哈麦，另有支系见于埃及、苏丹和红海岛屿。这一名称约在1200年首次出现于阿拉伯语文献；16世纪初的奥斯曼税册把胡泰姆列为加扎桑贾克向苏丹纳贡的五个部落之一，1553年的一份记录还记载他们劫掠阿杰隆桑贾克。到19世纪初，欧洲旅行者已明确把这个词当作低种姓的称呼，而非部落名。

en: Huaxtepec was a large Nahua town of the warm lowland province called Tlalnahuac, south of the Valley of Mexico in what is now the state of Morelos; its Nahuatl name means on the mountain of the huaje tree. In 1337 it was still ruled by its own lords, and its tlatoani bore the title tultecateteutli, or Toltec lord, assisted by twelve judge-officials, while an Aztec calpixqui later stood beside him to watch over tribute. The Aztec emperor Moctezuma I conquered the town between 1440 and 1469 and turned its springs into irrigation channels feeding a royal garden of flowers and medicinal plants, counted as the first botanical garden in the Americas. Huaxtepec sent cotton, cacao, limestone, amate paper and rock crystal to Tenochtitlan, traded in partnership with neighbouring Totolapan, and warred against Jiutepec and the cities of Tlaxcala; its ruler in 1519 was Tizapapalotzin. The Spaniards who entered it with the conquest marvelled at its gardens, and in 1569 the hospital of Santa Cruz was founded there to study the region's medicinal herbs.
zh: 瓦斯特佩克是特拉尔纳瓦克这个温暖低地省份中的一座纳瓦大镇，位于墨西哥谷地以南，在今莫雷洛斯州境内；其纳瓦特尔语名称意为瓦赫树（银合欢）之山。1337年时它仍由本族首领统治，镇中特拉托阿尼拥有“图尔特卡特特乌特利”即托尔特克之主的称号，由十二名法官式官员辅政；阿兹特克人后来又在他身边设置贡赋官卡尔皮斯基监督贡物。1440年至1469年间，阿兹特克皇帝蒙特祖马一世征服此镇，把当地泉水引入灌溉渠，浇灌一座种植花卉与药用植物的王家园林，这被视为美洲第一座植物园。瓦斯特佩克向特诺奇蒂特兰输送棉花、可可、石灰石、阿玛特树皮纸和水晶，与邻近的托托拉潘合伙经商，并同休特佩克及特拉斯卡拉诸城邦交战；1519年在位的君主是蒂萨帕帕洛钦。随征服大军进入此地的西班牙人都惊叹于它的园林；1569年，圣十字医院在此建立，专门研究当地的药用植物。

en: Havelberg was a prince-bishopric of the Holy Roman Empire, seated where the Havel meets the Elbe in the Prignitz. King Otto I founded the diocese in 946 as a suffragan of Mainz, transferred to the new Archdiocese of Magdeburg in 968. The Great Slav Rising of 983 drove the bishops out for a century and a half, until King Lothair III retook the town in 1130 and the margrave Albert the Bear secured the eastern Elbe bank. From 1151 the bishop held princely rank; the Premonstratensian Anselm of Havelberg established the cathedral chapter after the Wendish Crusade of 1147, and St Mary's Cathedral was consecrated in 1170. The bishops later moved their residence to Wittstock, and the Holy Blood shrine at Wilsnack became a major pilgrimage site from 1383. In the Reformation the see turned Lutheran, passed to the Hohenzollerns in 1554, and was secularised into Brandenburg in 1571, the annexation being completed in 1598.
zh: 哈弗尔贝格是神圣罗马帝国的一个主教采邑，主教座位于普里格尼茨地区哈弗尔河汇入易北河之处。国王奥托一世于946年设立教区，初属美因茨教省，968年改隶新建的马格德堡总教区。983年的斯拉夫大起义把主教们赶走了一个半世纪，直到1130年国王洛泰尔三世收复该城，藩侯大熊阿尔布雷希特又平定了易北河东岸。1151年起主教获得诸侯等级；普雷蒙特雷修会的哈弗尔贝格的安塞尔姆在1147年文德十字军之后建立了主教座堂圣职团，圣马利亚主教座堂于1170年祝圣。后来主教们把驻地迁往维特施托克，维尔斯纳克的圣血圣龛从1383年起成为重要的朝圣地。宗教改革中该教区改宗路德宗，1554年落入霍亨索伦家族之手，1571年被世俗化并入勃兰登堡，吞并于1598年最终完成。

en: Hueyacocotla, its Nahuatl name meaning place of the great pine, was a Huastec, or Teenek, town in the pine highlands of the Huasteca Baja, on the Veracruz-Hidalgo frontier. The Huastecs were a Mayan-speaking people long cut off from the other Maya, and around 1450 their towns were subdued by Moctezuma I's Aztec armies and left to rule themselves under tribute.
zh: 韦亚科科特拉的纳瓦特尔语名称意为大松之地，是下瓦斯特卡地区松树高地上的一座瓦斯特克，即特内切，城镇，地处韦拉克鲁斯与伊达尔戈交界。瓦斯特克人属玛雅语族，与其他玛雅人隔绝已久；约1450年，他们的城镇被蒙特苏马一世的阿兹特克军队征服，获准在纳贡条件下保留自治。

en: Hy Many, in Irish Ui Mhaine, was one of the oldest and largest kingdoms of Connacht, spreading across eastern and southern County Galway and southern County Roscommon, with Athlone and Kilconnell at its heart. Tradition made Maine Mor its founder in the fourth century, when his war band conquered the older Fir Bolg holders of the land, and the dynasty later took the O Kelly surname from an eleventh-century chief. The O Kellys ruled over a loose bundle of sub-lordships such as Soghan and Maenmag, and in 1337 their chief still answered only to the king of Connacht. In 1414 William O Kelly founded the Franciscan friary at Kilconnell, which became the burial church of the sept. English government reached the kingdom when Connacht became a Presidency in 1569, and the Composition of Connacht in 1585 turned the O Kelly country into shired baronies; Feardorcha O Kelly was counted the seventy-ninth and last king of Hy Many. The old ruling kindred suffered heavily at the Battle of Aughrim, fought within their former territory in 1691.
zh: 伊瓦内，爱尔兰语称乌伊·瓦内，是康诺特最古老、最大的王国之一，地跨戈尔韦郡东部和南部以及罗斯康芒郡南部，以阿斯隆和基尔康奈尔一带为核心。相传它由4世纪的马内·莫尔建立，他的战团征服了当地更古老的菲尔·博尔格人；王朝后来在11世纪以一位酋长的名字采用奥凯利为姓。奥凯利家族统治着索安、马恩马格等一批松散的次级领地，1337年时，其酋长只听命于康诺特国王。1414年，威廉·奥凯利在基尔康奈尔创建方济各会修道院，后来成为该家族的安葬教堂。1569年康诺特成为英格兰总督区，王国开始受到英格兰管辖；1585年的《康诺特和解协议》把奥凯利的领地改为郡下的男爵区，费尔多卡·奥凯利被列为伊瓦内第79任、也是最后一任国王。1691年，在其故土上打响的奥赫里姆战役中，这个古老的统治族群损失惨重。

en: The Hytuk, also called the Adale or Getici in Italian sources, were a Circassian tribe of the Taman peninsula between the Black Sea and the Sea of Azov, whose name means the islanders or the people by the sea. In the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries their principality was one of the strongest coastal powers of Zichia, centred on the port of Matrega, seat of the Catholic archbishop of the Circassians and the link in the sea trade between Caffa and the northern Black Sea shore. The Genoese Ghisolfi family married into the local princes and governed Matrega from 1419, while Circassian rulers such as Usdemoroch in 1446 were recognised in Italian records as independent lords. Ottoman expansion ended the polity: Matrega fell to the Ottomans on 12 August 1482, though local princes kept parts of the peninsula. The surviving Hytuk later merged into the Natukhaj tribe.
zh: 海图克人又称阿达拉，意大利文献称格蒂奇，是生活在黑海与亚速海之间塔曼半岛上的切尔克斯部落，名字意为“岛民”或“滨海之民”。14至15世纪，他们的公国是泽希亚最强盛的沿海政权之一，以马特列加港为中心；这里是切尔克斯天主教大主教的驻地，也是卡法与黑海北岸海上贸易的枢纽。热那亚的吉索尔菲家族通过联姻加入当地王公行列，自1419年起治理马特列加，而1446年见于记载的乌斯杰莫罗赫等切尔克斯统治者，在意大利档案中被承认为独立王公。奥斯曼的扩张终结了这个政权：1482年8月12日马特列加陷落，但当地王公仍保有半岛的部分土地。幸存的海图克人后来并入纳图哈伊部落。

en: Hongzhou Poli was a Kam native chieftaincy in the southeastern hills of Guizhou, its seat at the Hongzhou stockade in present-day Liping County, close to the Hunan border. The district was drawn into the Ming campaigns against the Kam caves when the general Gu Cheng put down risings at Hongzhou, Poli, Fulu and Yongcong in 1397. The Hongzhou Poli native long commandery was re-established in 1403 under the Guizhou Guard, and in 1414 it became one of the thirteen Kam chieftaincies assigned to the newly created Liping Prefecture. Its neighbouring commandery of Fulu-Yongcong, centred on the walled settlement of Yongcong, was converted into Yongcong County in 1441.
zh: 洪州泊里是贵州东南山区的侗族土司，治所在今黎平县洪州镇，靠近湖南边界。1397年，明将顾成出兵平定了洪州、泊里、福禄、永从一带侗洞的反抗，这一地区由此被纳入明朝对侗寨的经略。1403年，洪州泊里蛮夷长官司重新设置，隶属于贵州卫，1414年又成为新设黎平府下辖的十三个侗族长官司之一。与它相邻、以永从寨为中心的福禄永从长官司，则在1441年改置为永从县。

en: Hizan is a small Kurdish emirate in the steep, oak-covered valley of the Gindig Su, a tributary of the Botan, in the country the ancients called Moxoene. Its rectangular fortress at Eski Hizan may have been founded under Roman rule of the region between 298 and 363, though the standing walls are mostly Kurdish work. From perhaps the mid-thirteenth century the walled town served as the seat of a Kurdish emir whose caravanserais caught the trade from Siirt that avoided the Bitlis pass, while the side valleys sheltered Armenian and Syriac monasteries. The emirs of the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries rebuilt the town's fortifications, and Emir Dawud founded its medrese; under Ottoman rule Hizan also housed an imperial mint. Its Bekiran Kurdish clans lived close to a large Armenian peasant population until the upheavals of the nineteenth century.
zh: 希赞是一个小型库尔德埃米尔国，位于博赫坦河支流金迪格河陡峭多橡的山谷中，这一地区古称莫克索埃内。埃斯基希赞的矩形要塞可能始建于298至363年间罗马统治该地区之时，不过现存城墙大多是库尔德时代的工程。约从13世纪中期起，这座有城墙的城镇成为库尔德埃米尔的驻地，当地商馆承接了避开比特利斯山口、来自锡尔特的商队贸易，两侧山谷中则散布着亚美尼亚和叙利亚语修道院。15至16世纪的埃米尔们重修了城防，埃米尔达乌德还修建了经学院；奥斯曼统治时期，希赞还设有一座皇家铸币厂。当地贝基兰部的库尔德氏族与人数众多的亚美尼亚农户毗邻而居，直到19世纪的动荡来临。

en: The Hazaraspids, also called the Fadluyids, were a Kurdish Sunni dynasty that ruled the Zagros highlands of southwestern Iran as the Atabagate of Greater Lorestan from 1115 to 1424. Their ancestor Fadlawi led his tribe from Syria into Luristan, and Abu Tahir, once a commander of the Salghurids of Fars, made himself independent and took the title atabeg; his son Malik Hazarasp, whose name means thousand horses, gave the dynasty its name. From their capital Idaj, present-day Izeh, the Hazaraspids held the great roads between the Iranian plateau and the lowlands, and under Ilkhanid suzerainty Yusuf Shah I added Khuzestan, Kuhgiluya and Golpayegan to the realm. In 1337 the ruler was Rukn al-Din Yusuf Shah II, who in the first half of the fourteenth century seized Shushtar, Hoveizeh and even Basra. Later reigns brought Muzaffarid invasions and the temporary loss of Idaj, and the dynasty finally fell in 1424 when the Timurid Shahrukh deposed its last prince Ghiyath al-Din, ending three centuries of Lur rule that had done much to sustain Iranian culture under foreign dynasties.
zh: 哈扎拉斯普王朝亦称法德卢伊王朝，是1115至1424年间统治伊朗西南部扎格罗斯山区的库尔德裔逊尼派王朝，国号为大罗里斯坦阿塔贝格国。其先祖法德卢维率部落从叙利亚迁入卢里斯坦，曾为法尔斯萨尔古里王朝将领的阿布·塔希尔后来自立为君、采用阿塔贝格称号；其子马利克·哈扎拉斯普（意为“千骑”）成为王朝名称的由来。王朝以伊达杰（即今伊泽）为都，扼守伊朗高原与低地之间的交通要道，在伊儿汗宗主权下，优素福沙一世又将胡齐斯坦、库赫吉卢耶和戈勒派甘纳入版图。1337年在位的是鲁克纳丁·优素福沙二世，他在14世纪上半叶夺取了舒什塔尔、霍韦伊泽乃至巴士拉。其后穆扎法尔王朝入侵，伊达杰一度失守；1424年帖木儿王朝的沙鲁赫废黜末代王公吉亚斯丁，王朝终结。卢尔人长达三百年的统治，在外族王朝称雄的时代有力维系了伊朗文化的延续。

en: Hazro is a Kurdish tribal chiefdom in the rugged hills north of Diyarbakr, holding the market town of Qasaba Hazru together with Kulp and the high valleys of Sasun, where Kurdish tribes had settled by the end of the thirteenth century and maintained an autonomous emirate down to the nineteenth century. The old town itself had a mixed population of Syriac Orthodox Christians and Kurdish-speaking Armenians under its Kurdish lords. A tax register of 1527 already counted this part of the Vilayet-i Kurdistan among its minor emirates, and a decree of Suleiman I around 1533 confirmed hereditary succession for loyal Kurdish beys. Evliya Celebi, visiting in the mid-seventeenth century, listed Hazo among the five Kurdish hükümets of Diyarbekir: self-governing districts that paid no tax, sent no troops and chose their own rulers, while neighbouring Kulp ranked as a hereditary Kurdish sanjak. This isolation in the Taurus foothills let Hazro keep its autonomy long after the lowland emirates had been reduced to ordinary Ottoman provinces.
zh: 哈兹罗是迪亚巴克尔以北崎岖丘陵中的库尔德部族酋邦，领有集镇哈兹罗、库尔普以及萨松的高山谷地；库尔德部落早在13世纪末就已定居萨松，并在那里维持了一个延续至19世纪的自治埃米尔国。老城本身在库尔德领主之下，居民由叙利亚正教会基督徒和讲库尔德语的亚美尼亚人混合组成。1527年的税册已把这一地区列为库尔德斯坦维拉耶特下的小埃米尔国之一，苏莱曼一世约在1533年颁布的诏令又确认了效忠的库尔德贝伊世袭继承权。17世纪中期到访的埃夫利亚·切莱比把哈佐列为迪亚巴克尔的五个库尔德自治政区（土耳其语 hükümet）之一：它们不纳税、不派兵、自选统治者；邻近的库尔普则是世袭的库尔德桑贾克。正因偏处托罗斯山麓、交通闭塞，在低地埃米尔国纷纷被降为普通奥斯曼行省之后很久，哈兹罗仍保住了自治地位。

en: Iași lies on the Bahlui river in the hills of northern Moldavia, where trade roads from Poland, Hungary, Russia and Constantinople met. Its name is traced to the Sarmatian Iazyges and the Alanic Jassi who once sheltered by the Prut, surviving in the Hungarian Jászvásár and the old Romanian Târgul Ieșilor, both meaning the Jassic market. Sixth-century settlements and a 1395 Armenian church show a town older than its first surviving charter of 1408, when Prince Alexandru cel Bun granted trading privileges to merchants from Lwów. Around 1564 Alexandru Lăpușneanu moved the Moldavian capital from Suceava to Iași, and the city became the seat of its princes and a meeting place of Orthodox, Armenian, Jewish and Greek merchants. Vasile Lupu founded a Romanian school and a press at the Trei Ierarhi Monastery in 1640, and the first book printed in Moldavia appeared there in 1643. Its exposed border position brought repeated disasters, with Tatar sacks in 1513, 1574 and 1593, an Ottoman occupation in 1538 and Polish and Cossack raids later, while the Treaty of Jassy of 1792 ended a Russo-Turkish war on its doorstep. In 1821 Alexandros Ypsilantis raised the banner of Greek independence in the city, before Ottoman troops stormed it the following year.
zh: 雅西位于摩尔达维亚北部丘陵的巴赫卢伊河畔，通往波兰、匈牙利、俄罗斯和君士坦丁堡的商路在此交汇。其城名可追溯到曾寄居于普鲁特河一带的萨尔马提亚人伊阿居格部和阿兰人的雅西部落，匈牙利语名 Jászvásár 与古罗马尼亚语名 Târgul Ieșilor 都意为“雅西人的市场”。6世纪的定居点遗迹和1395年的亚美尼亚教堂表明，该城比现存最早的1408年特许状还要古老——当年亚历山德鲁大公向利沃夫商人授予了贸易特权。约1564年，亚历山德鲁·勒普什尼亚努把摩尔达维亚首都从苏恰瓦迁至雅西，该城从此成为大公驻地和东正教、亚美尼亚、犹太与希腊商人汇聚之地。1640年，瓦西里·卢普在三圣主教修道院开办罗马尼亚语学校和印刷所，1643年摩尔达维亚第一部印刷书籍在此问世。地处边境使它屡遭兵燹：1513年、1574年和1593年鞑靼人洗劫，1538年奥斯曼人占领，后来又有波兰人和哥萨克来袭；1792年的《雅西条约》在城外结束了一场俄土战争。1821年，亚历山德罗斯·伊普西兰蒂斯在此举起希腊独立的旗帜，次年奥斯曼军队便攻破了该城。

en: Ibalon, or Ibalong, was the ancient name of the Bicol Peninsula at the southeastern end of Luzon, its settlements strung along the Bicol River and the slopes of volcanoes such as Mayon. Its pre-colonial society had no king or ruling authority above the datu: family-centered barangays followed whichever chief proved strongest in war, and Islam never reached the peninsula. The people's memory was carried by the Ibalong epic, chanted by bards such as the legendary Kadunung, which tells of the heroes Baltog, Handyong and Bantong clearing the land of monsters and shows the impress of the Indian Ramayana and Mahabharata; their supreme god Gugurang dwelt in Mayon and guarded the sacred fire. Spaniards first landed at Gibal-ong in Sorsogon in 1567, and Augustinian and Franciscan missionaries then founded the churches of Naga and turned the region's hardwood forests to shipyards for the Manila galleons. In 1636 the old name survived only as the Partido de Ibalon when the colony split Bicol into administrative provinces.
zh: 伊巴隆又译伊巴隆格，是吕宋东南端比科尔半岛的古称，当地定居点沿比科尔河和马荣火山等山麓分布。殖民以前，这里没有国王，也没有凌驾于达图之上的权威：以家族为中心的巴朗盖在战时拥戴最强悍的首领，伊斯兰教也从未传入半岛。比科尔人的记忆由《伊巴隆史诗》承载，传说中的吟游诗人卡农农传唱着巴尔托格、汉勇和班通等英雄剪除怪兽的故事，其结构深受印度《罗摩衍那》和《摩诃婆罗多》影响；他们信奉的至高神古古朗居于马荣火山之中，守护着圣火。1567年西班牙人在索索贡的希巴隆首次登陆，随后奥古斯丁会与方济各会传教士建起那牙的教堂，并把当地的硬木森林辟为建造马尼拉大帆船的船厂。1636年殖民地把比科尔划分为若干行政区，伊巴隆这个旧称只保留为“伊巴隆区”。

en: Iceland was settled from the 870s onward, chiefly by Norwegians fleeing the unification of their homeland; tradition calls Ingólfr Arnarson, who made his home at Reykjavík around 874, the first settler. In 930 the chieftains gathered at Thingvellir to found the Althing, one of the oldest parliamentary assemblies in the world, and around the year 1000 the island accepted Christianity by a single arbitrator's ruling. The independent Commonwealth that followed produced the sagas of Icelanders and the works of Snorri Sturluson, but the feuds of the Age of the Sturlungs exhausted it, and in 1262 to 1264 the Old Covenant placed it under the Norwegian crown. With Norway it passed into the Kalmar Union in 1397 and then under Danish rule. The Black Death of 1402 to 1404 carried off perhaps half the population, the Lutheran Reformation was enforced from Copenhagen in 1550 with the execution of the bishop Jón Arason, and from 1602 a strict Danish trade monopoly cramped the island's commerce for nearly two centuries; the Laki eruption of 1783 and the ensuing Mist Hardships brought famine and depopulation. When the Treaty of Kiel separated Norway from Denmark in 1814, Iceland, Greenland and the Faroes remained Danish dependencies.
zh: 冰岛从870年代起有人定居，居民主要是逃避祖国统一战争的挪威人；传统上把约874年在雷克雅未克安家的英戈尔夫·阿纳尔松称为第一位定居者。930年，各族长在辛格韦德利集会，创立阿尔庭，这是世界上最古老的议会之一；约1000年，全岛经一位仲裁者裁决接受基督教。此后独立的自由邦催生了冰岛人萨迦和斯诺里·斯图鲁松的著作，但斯图鲁松时代的长期仇杀耗尽了它的元气，1262至1264年的《旧约》使它臣服于挪威王冠。随挪威之后，它于1397年并入卡尔马联盟，继而受丹麦统治。1402至1404年的黑死病夺走了约半数人口；1550年哥本哈根强行推行路德宗改革，主教永·阿拉松被处死；1602年起，丹麦严格的贸易垄断压制岛上商业近两百年，1783年拉基火山喷发及随之而来的雾灾又造成饥荒和人口锐减。1814年《基尔条约》把挪威与丹麦分开时，冰岛、格陵兰和法罗群岛仍是丹麦的属地。

en: The Ichma, also called the Ychsma or Pachacamac kingdom, grew up around 1100 after the fall of the Wari Empire, holding the Lurín Valley on the desert coast south of present-day Lima and later spreading into the Rímac Valley. Its heart was the ancient oracle city of Pachacamac, seat of the creator god Pacha Kamaq, whose pilgrims came from across the central Andes; Ichma rulers raised at least sixteen adobe pyramids there and watered wide orchards with irrigation canals cut through the desert. Probably Aymara-speaking, the Ichma kept their autonomy until about 1469, when the Inca absorbed them as a province while patronizing the oracle and adding a Temple of the Sun. In 1533 Hernando Pizarro marched to Pachacamac in search of treasure and sacked the sanctuary; two years later the Spanish founded Lima in the neighboring Rímac Valley.
zh: 依其马又称伊奇斯马或帕查卡马克王国，约在1100年瓦里帝国崩溃后兴起，领有今利马以南沙漠海岸的卢林河谷，后来又向北扩入里马克河谷。它的核心是古老的神谕城帕查卡马克，即创世神帕查·卡马克的居所，朝圣者从安第斯中部各地前来；依其马统治者在那里修建了至少十六座土坯金字塔，并用穿凿沙漠的灌溉渠滋养大片果园。依其马人可能说艾马拉语，他们的自治维持到约1469年，随后被印加吞并为一个行省，印加人继续供奉神谕并增建了太阳神庙。1533年，埃尔南多·皮萨罗为搜寻黄金进军帕查卡马克，洗劫了这座圣所；两年后，西班牙人在邻近的里马克河谷建立利马。

en: Idar, a hillfort town at the southern end of the Aravalli range in northern Gujarat, was in early times held by Bhil chiefs and later by Parihar Rajputs. After the Parihar chief fell at the second battle of Tarain in 1192, the Bhil Sord dynasty took over until 1257, when the Rathore prince Rao Sonag killed its chief Samalio and founded the line of Rathore raos that held Idar for twelve generations. The small principality guarded the routes between Gujarat and Rajputana and was repeatedly drawn into the wars of the Gujarat sultans: in the succession struggle of 1515 to 1520, Rana Sanga of Mewar marched in to place Raimal on the Idar throne and chased the sultan's army back to Ahmedabad. In 1656 Mughal forces under Murad Baksh overran Idar and incorporated it into the Gujarat subah; Rathore rule returned only in 1729, when Anand Singh and Rai Singh, brothers of the maharaja of Jodhpur, seized the fort, though their state soon had to surrender districts and tribute to the Marathas.
zh: 伊德尔是古吉拉特北部阿拉瓦利山脉南端的山城，早期由比尔人首领占据，后来转入帕里哈拉杰普特人之手。1192年帕里哈拉首领在第二次塔兰战役中战死后，比尔人的索尔德王朝接管此地；1257年，罗怙罗王子拉奥·索纳格杀死其首领萨马利奥，开创了统治伊德尔十二代的罗怙罗拉奥世系。这个小邦扼守古吉拉特与拉杰普塔纳之间的通道，一再被卷入古吉拉特苏丹国的战争：1515至1520年的继承权之争中，梅瓦尔的拉那·桑伽进军伊德尔，把赖马尔扶上王位，并把苏丹的军队一路追击到艾哈迈达巴德。1656年，穆拉德·巴赫什率领的莫卧儿大军攻陷伊德尔，将其并入古吉拉特苏巴。罗怙罗人的统治直到1729年才恢复——焦特布尔摩诃罗阇的兄弟阿南德·辛格与拉伊·辛格夺取城堡，但新邦不久便被迫向马拉塔人割地纳贡。

en: Ifat was the leading Sunni Muslim state of the Horn of Africa in the fourteenth century, ruled by the Walashma dynasty from the eastern Shewa highlands down to the great port of Zeila. Its founder, Umar Walasma, conquered the older Sultanate of Shewa, and by 1288 his successors had gathered Hubat, Zeila and the neighbouring Muslim lands under one rule; Zeila, whose two-mihrab mosque dated to the seventh century, gave Ifat its wealth as the main gateway for trade and Islam into the Ethiopian interior. The fourteenth-century geographer al-Umari credited the sultan with twenty thousand soldiers and fifteen thousand horsemen. War with Christian Ethiopia began in 1320: after Sultan Haqq ad-Din I seized an imperial envoy, Amda Seyon I invaded, and after the rebellion of Sultan Sabr ad-Din in 1332 he sacked the capital and installed the compliant Jamal ad-Din I, leaving Ifat a tributary of the Ethiopian crown. Later sultans rebelled again: Haqq ad-Din II fought more than twenty battles before his death in 1376 and moved the court toward the Harar plateau, and Sa'ad ad-Din II was run down and killed at Zeila by the armies of Dawit I or Yeshaq around 1403 to 1410. The ruined sultanate was absorbed into Ethiopia, while the Walashma line re-emerged farther east as the Adal Sultanate based at Harar.
zh: 伊法特是14世纪非洲之角首屈一指的逊尼派穆斯林国家，由瓦拉什马王朝统治，疆域从绍阿东部高地一直延伸到大港泽拉。开国之君乌马尔·瓦拉斯马征服了更古老的绍阿苏丹国，到1288年，他的继承者已将胡巴特、泽拉及周边穆斯林地区合为一体；泽拉拥有建于7世纪的双米哈拉布清真寺，是贸易和伊斯兰教进入埃塞俄比亚内陆的主要门户，伊法特因之致富。14世纪的地理学家欧马里记载，苏丹麾下有两万步兵和一万五千骑兵。与基督教埃塞俄比亚的战争始于1320年：苏丹哈克·丁一世扣押帝国使节，阿姆达·塞翁一世随即入侵；1332年萨卜尔·丁苏丹叛乱后，他洗劫都城并改立顺从的贾马勒·丁一世，伊法特从此成为埃塞俄比亚王室的附庸。后来的苏丹再度反叛：哈克·丁二世历经二十余场战斗，于1376年战死，此前已把朝廷迁往哈拉尔高原方向；萨阿德·丁二世则在1403至1410年间被达维特一世或叶沙克的军队追至泽拉杀死。残破的苏丹国被并入埃塞俄比亚，瓦拉什马王族则在更东方复兴，建立以哈拉尔为都的阿达尔苏丹国。

en: Ife, also called Ile-Ife, is one of the oldest Yoruba cities, settled between 1000 and 500 BC and already a flourishing West African emporium by 900 AD. Yoruba tradition calls it the spot where the deity Oduduwa moulded the first land from the primordial sea and founded the first dynasty; its king bears the title of Ooni, and Oduduwa's children and grandchildren are said to have gone out from Ife to found the other Yoruba kingdoms, from Oyo and Ketu to Ilesa, while his son Oranmiyan is also credited with establishing the second dynasty of Benin. Between 1200 and 1400 the city produced its celebrated naturalistic bronze, terracotta and stone heads, among the finest sculpture of medieval West Africa. Ife's early political hegemony gave way to the rising power of Oyo, which dominated the Yoruba city-states from the seventeenth century, but Ife kept its place as the spiritual capital of the Yoruba and the final authority on royal coronations. In the early nineteenth century the collapse of Oyo under Fulani jihad pressure sent waves of refugees into the city and drew Ife into the wars that divided Yorubaland.
zh: 伊费又称伊莱-伊费，是最古老的约鲁巴城市之一，公元前1000年至前500年间已有人定居，到公元900年已是繁荣的西非商贸重镇。约鲁巴传统认为，神祇奥杜杜瓦在此从原始海洋中塑出第一块陆地并建立第一个王朝，伊费国王称“奥尼”；奥杜杜瓦的子孙从伊费出发，建立了奥约、凯图、伊莱沙等其他约鲁巴王国，他的儿子奥兰米扬还被视为贝宁第二个王朝的开创者。1200至1400年间，伊费出产了著名的写实风格青铜、陶土和石雕头像，代表了中世纪西非雕塑的最高水平。伊费早期的政治霸权后来让位于奥约，后者自17世纪起统辖各约鲁巴城邦，但伊费始终是约鲁巴人的精神之都和君王加冕的最高权威所在。19世纪初，奥约在富拉尼圣战的压力下崩溃，大批难民涌入伊费，也把它卷入了撕裂约鲁巴兰的连绵战火。

en: The Ispahbad was the small Talysh principality of the Caspian coastlands between Gilan and Mughan, whose rulers bore the old Iranian military title of ispahbad, or sipahbad. Their first seat was the fortress of Shandan north of the Astara river, and by the fourteenth century they ruled from Astara over the Talysh-speaking coastal strip that also took in Dulab and Lankaran. The line survived under the Mongol Ilkhans: a Malik Ahmad Ispahbad was restored through the intercession of Shaykh Zahid under Ghazan, and in 1307 Rukn al-din Ahmad guided the Ilkhanid army through Gilan. In 1337 the ispahbad held his coast as a vassal of the Jalayirids, and later in the century Jalal al-din Husayn still kept his throne at Astara. Whether the later Talysh khans of Astara continued the dynasty is unknown, but the region became part of the Talysh Khanate and passed to Russia in 1813.
zh: 伊斯帕巴德是里海沿岸、吉兰与穆甘之间的塔雷什人小公国，统治者使用古老的伊朗军事头衔伊斯帕巴德，又称斯帕赫巴德。其早期治所是阿斯塔拉河以北的尚丹堡垒，到14世纪时改以阿斯塔拉为中心，领有说塔雷什语的沿海地带，包括杜拉布和连科兰。这一家族在蒙古伊儿汗国治下延续下来：一位马利克·艾哈迈德·伊斯帕巴德曾因谢赫·扎希德说情而被合赞汗释放，1307年鲁克纳丁·艾哈迈德还为伊儿汗军队进军吉兰引路。1337年，伊斯帕巴德作为札剌亦儿王朝的附庸保有其海岸；14世纪后期，贾拉勒丁·侯赛因仍在阿斯塔拉称尊。后来阿斯塔拉的塔雷什诸汗是否延续了这一世系已不可考，该地区最终成为塔雷什汗国的一部分，并于1813年并入俄国。

en: Ijebu was a Yoruba kingdom of the Guinea coast, ruled from the walled capital of Ijebu-Ode by a king titled the Awujale. Its dynasty traced itself to Obanta, also called Ogborogan, who led his people out of Ilé-Ifè, and the kingdom took shape around the 1400s. Long before that, from about 800 to 1000, its communities had raised Sungbo's Eredo, a ring of walls and ditches enclosing the whole kingdom, one of the largest earthen works in Africa. Power was shared with the Osugbo, the titled men's council that also served as the kingdom's courts, its senior rank the iwarefa under the Oliwa. Portuguese traders sailing the lagoon knew the state well: an account of 1508 calls Geebu a great city surrounded by a great ditch, and a trader wrote in 1620 of Xabu as a small but very warlike kingdom. From the 1700s Ijebu grew rich on the routes between the lagoon ports and the inland Yoruba towns, insisting that all goods pass through Ijebu merchants, a monopoly that made it one of the best-organised states of the coast.
zh: 伊杰布是几内亚沿海的约鲁巴王国，以筑有城墙的伊杰布奥德为都，君主称号阿武贾莱。它的王朝追溯到率领族人离开伊莱伊费的奥班塔（又名奥博罗甘），王国约在15世纪成形。更早在800—1000年间，当地社群已修筑松博壕墙，这道环绕整个王国的墙壕体系是非洲规模最大的土工工程之一。权力由奥苏格博分享，这是由有头衔者组成的议事会，同时承担法庭职能，其最高等级是奥立瓦领导的伊瓦雷法。在潟湖航行的葡萄牙商人熟知这个国家：1508年的记载称格布为被大壕沟环绕的伟大城市，1620年一名商人又把哈布描述为狭小但十分好战的王国。18世纪起，伊杰布凭借潟湖港口与约鲁巴内陆城镇之间的商路致富，规定一切货物都须经伊杰布商人经手，这份垄断使它成为沿海组织最严密的国家之一。

en: Ijero is one of the small Ekiti-Yoruba kingdoms in the hilly country of north-eastern Yorubaland, whose ruler bears the title of Ajero and whose people speak the Ekiti dialect. Like its neighbours it stayed largely independent until the Ekiti towns joined the Ekiti-Parapo coalition against Ibadan in the nineteenth-century Yoruba wars.
zh: 伊杰罗是约鲁巴兰东北部丘陵地带埃基提约鲁巴人的小王国之一，统治者称“阿杰罗”，居民讲埃基提方言。它与邻邦一样长期保持自治，直到19世纪约鲁巴诸邦混战时期，各埃基提城邦结成埃基提-帕拉波联盟共同对抗伊巴丹。

en: L'Isle-Jourdain was a Gascon lordship in the valley of the Save west of Toulouse, taking its name from its island stronghold on the river. A line of seigneurs is recorded from around the year 1000, vassals first of the counts of Toulouse, who enlarged their lands by purchase and marriage around Léguevin, Cadours and Grenade. In 1337 the lord was Bernard IV Jourdain, who had held the barony since about 1306 and married a daughter of the Count of Foix. His son Bertrand had the lordship raised to a county in 1340. The comital line failed with Count Jourdain VI, who died without heirs after selling the fief in 1404 to the Duke of Bourbon, commander of the royal armies in Languedoc; it was resold in 1421 to John IV, Count of Armagnac. The county later reverted to the French crown and formed part of the province of Gascony.
zh: 利勒茹尔丹是加斯科涅的一处领主领地，位于图卢兹以西的萨夫河谷，得名于河上的岛屿要塞。约1000年起，这里就有世代相承的领主，最初臣属于图卢兹伯爵；他们通过购买和联姻，把领地扩展到莱格万、卡杜尔和格勒纳德一带。1337年在位的领主是贝尔纳四世·茹尔丹，他约从1306年起统治这片男爵领地，并娶了富瓦伯爵的女儿。他的儿子贝特朗于1340年把领地升格为伯国。伯爵一脉在茹尔丹六世时断绝：他没有继承人，1404年把封地卖给统领朗格多克王军的波旁公爵；1421年，这块封地又被转卖给阿马尼亚克伯爵让四世。伯国后来重归法兰西王冠，成为加斯科涅行省的一部分。

en: Ijesha is the kingdom of the Ijesha Yoruba, with its capital at Ilesa in the forested heart of Yorubaland, west of the Effon ridge that separates it from the Ekiti. It was founded around 1300 by Ajibogun Ajaka, better known as Owa Obokun, the warlike youngest son of Oduduwa; tradition says he journeyed as far as the sea to bring back salt water that cured his aged father's blindness, and his people are still called Omo Obokun, children of the brine-fetcher. His successors rule as the Owa Obokun Adimula of Ijesaland, and a daughter of one of them, Owa Atakunmosa, became the ancestress of the ruling houses of neighbouring Akure. Hemmed in by Ife to the south, Oyo to the west and the Ekiti to the east, Ijesha lost ground in the wars of the nineteenth century, when it became one of the leading members of the Ekiti-Parapo coalition that fought Ibadan in the long Kiriji War.
zh: 伊杰沙是伊杰沙约鲁巴人的王国，首都伊莱沙位于约鲁巴兰腹地的森林地带，东以埃丰山脊与埃基提为界。王国约于1300年由奥杜杜瓦好战的幼子阿吉博贡·阿贾卡（即奥瓦·奥博昆）建立：相传他曾远行至海边取回海水，治好年迈父亲的眼疾，他的臣民也因此被称为“奥莫·奥博昆”，意为取海水者的子孙。其继承者以“伊杰沙兰的奥瓦·奥博昆·阿迪穆拉”为号统治；其中一位国王奥瓦·阿塔昆莫萨的女儿，后来成为邻邦阿库雷诸王室的女始祖。伊杰沙南接伊费、西连奥约、东邻埃基提，在19世纪的战乱中疆土日蹙，并成为埃基提-帕拉波联盟的核心成员之一，与伊巴丹进行了漫长的基里吉战争。

en: Ilu was a small Hūrga Jurchen group of the Smaller Ussuri country, the forested tributary valleys east of the Ussuri. As one of the Wild Jurchen river tribes its chief held a nominal guard title under the Ming Nurgan commission, like those of the neighboring Yima and Shilimian guards, while its people lived by fishing, hunting and pig farming.
zh: 伊卢是小乌苏里地区的虎尔哈女真小群体，居于乌苏里江以东多林的支流河谷。作为野人女真的河畔部落之一，其酋长在明朝奴儿干都司下领有名义上的卫所官职，与邻近的亦麻河卫、失里绵卫同属羁縻网络，部众以捕鱼、狩猎和养猪为生。

en: Imaal takes its name from the remote Glen of Imaal in the western Wicklow Mountains, the Irish Gleann Uí Mháil, recalling the Uí Máil who dominated the kingship of Leinster in the seventh century. After the Anglo-Norman invasion the O'Tooles, a sept descending from the earlier kings of Leinster, were driven from their lands in southern Kildare and settled in the Wicklow highlands around Glendalough, where by the fourteenth century they held the lordship of the Uí Máil. Glendalough itself had been one of Ireland's greatest monasteries since its foundation by St Kevin in the sixth century, and the O'Tooles gave the Church one of its saints in Laurence O'Toole, abbot of Glendalough and later archbishop of Dublin. From these glens the O'Tooles and their kinsmen the O'Byrnes raided the English Pale for nearly four centuries; they joined the Confederate Catholics of Kilkenny in 1642, and the Cromwellian conquest finally broke the independence of the Wicklow clans.
zh: 伊马尔得名于威克洛山脉西部偏僻的伊马尔谷，爱尔兰语作 Gleann Uí Mháil，名字可追溯到7世纪左右伦斯特王权的乌伊·马伊尔部族。盎格鲁-诺曼入侵后，源出伦斯特历代国王的奥图尔家族被逐出基尔代尔南部故土，退入威克洛高地、在格伦达洛一带定居，到14世纪已接管乌伊·马伊尔部族领地的领主之位。格伦达洛自6世纪圣凯文建院以来就是爱尔兰最重要的修道院之一，奥图尔家族还为教会贡献了一位圣人：曾任格伦达洛修道院长、后任都柏林大主教的劳伦斯·奥图尔。奥图尔家族与同族的奥伯恩家族以这些山谷为据点，袭扰英国人的“佩尔”地区近四百年；1642年他们加入基尔肯尼天主教联盟，最终在克伦威尔征服中丧失了威克洛诸氏族的独立地位。

en: Imanka was the Hūrga Jurchen group of the Iman River valley, a stream rising in the Sikhote-Alin and running west for 440 kilometres to join the Ussuri near the trading town that also bore the name Iman. Across the river, opposite present Hutou, the Ming established the Yima River Guard in the early fifteenth century, one of the Nurgan commission's guards holding the Ussuri line. Its Tungusic chiefs combined fishing, hunting and pig farming with the tribute trade in furs and ginseng. The valley shared the fate of the other Wild Jurchen tribes when Nurhaci's forces subdued the Ussuri country between 1596 and 1625, though some communities stayed outside the banners and survived as the Hezhen and neighboring peoples.
zh: 伊曼卡是伊曼河流域的虎尔哈女真部落。伊曼河发源于锡霍特山脉，西流440公里，在同名城镇伊曼附近注入乌苏里江。15世纪初，明朝在今虎头对岸设亦麻河卫，是奴儿干都司镇守乌苏里江一线的卫所之一。当地通古斯酋长以捕鱼、狩猎和养猪为生，并参与毛皮、人参的朝贡贸易。1596—1625年努尔哈赤征服乌苏里江流域，伊曼卡与其他野人女真部落同归其治下；也有部分聚落未入八旗，保留自身认同，成为赫哲等邻近民族的来源。

en: Imola lies on the Santerno River at the western edge of Romagna. Sulla founded it around 82 BC as Forum Cornelii, and the Lombards gave its present name to the fortress in the seventh century; after the Gothic and Lombard wars it passed with the Exarchate of Ravenna under papal authority. In the communal age its citizens, generally Ghibelline in sympathy, fought Ravenna, Faenza and Bologna while the Castrimolesi and Sancassianesi factions feuded at home, and strongmen such as the Alidosi from 1292 and Maghinardo Pagani repeatedly seized the signoria. Pope Benedict XII enfeoffed the city to Lippo II Alidosi as pontifical vicar, so that in 1337 the Alidosi ruled Imola as papal vassals, and the family kept it until 1424, when Filippo Maria Visconti's condottiere Angelo della Pergola took over. Restored to the Holy See in 1426, it was later granted to the Sforza of Milan and then, as the dowry of Caterina Sforza, to Girolamo Riario, whose principality of Forli and Imola fell to Cesare Borgia in 1499. Imola submitted to Pope Julius II in 1504 and remained a papal provincial town through the early modern centuries. The French set up a provisional government in 1797, and after the Austrian interlude and the Cisalpine Republic the Congress of Vienna returned it to the Papal States in 1815.
zh: 伊莫拉位于圣泰尔诺河畔，扼守罗马涅西大门。公元前82年前后苏拉在此建城，取名科尔内利乌姆广场；7世纪伦巴第人把今名用于当地要塞，城名由此而来。经历哥特战争与伦巴第入侵后，它随拉文纳总督区转归教皇权威之下。公社时代，市民总体倾向吉伯林派，对外与拉文纳、法恩扎和博洛尼亚交兵，城内则有卡斯特里莫莱西与圣卡夏诺两派仇杀；1292年起阿利多西家族和马吉纳尔多·帕加尼等强人几度攫取领主之位。教皇本笃十二世把该城封给利波二世·阿利多西、任为教皇代牧，因此1337年时阿利多西家族以教皇封臣的身份统治伊莫拉，其掌权一直延续到1424年，菲利波·马里亚·维斯孔蒂的雇佣军将领安杰洛·德拉·佩尔戈拉夺取了该城。1426年它重归教廷，后来被封给米兰的斯福尔扎家族，又作为卡泰丽娜·斯福尔扎的嫁妆转给吉罗拉莫·里亚里奥；他的弗利-伊莫拉领地于1499年落入切萨雷·博尔贾之手。1504年伊莫拉臣服于教皇尤利乌斯二世，整个近代早期都是教皇国的行省城镇。1797年法军在此建立临时政府，经历奥地利占领和奇萨尔皮尼共和国阶段后，1815年维也纳会议把它交还教皇国。

en: The İnançids, also called the Beylik of Lâdik, were a Turkoman frontier principality centered on Denizli, the ancient Laodicea on the Lycus from whose name Lâdik derives, in southwestern Anatolia. It emerged around 1261, when Mehmed Bey, a frontier commander of Turkomans who had fled the Mongol advance into the Lâdik, Honaz and Dalaman districts, rebelled against the Seljuk sultan of Rûm and founded a beylik under Ilkhanid overlordship. He was killed by the Ilkhanids in 1262 and his son-in-law Ali Bey succeeded him; after Ali backed the failed Cimri revolt of 1277 he was imprisoned, and the principality passed for a generation under the control of the Sahib Ataids. Around 1310 the Germiyanid ruler Yakup Bey restored the family, placing İnanç Bey, Ali's son, at its head. Under İnanç Bey and his son Murad Arslan, the reigning bey in 1337, the beylik recovered its strength, but in 1368 the Germiyanids annexed Lâdik outright and the İnançid line came to an end.
zh: 伊南奇（伊南奇奥卢）又称拉迪克贝伊国，是位于安纳托利亚西南部、以代尼兹利为中心的突厥蛮边境侯国，代尼兹利古称吕库斯河畔老底嘉，拉迪克一名即由老底嘉演变而来。约1261年，为躲避蒙古兵锋而迁入拉迪克、霍纳兹和达拉曼一带的突厥蛮边防首领穆罕默德贝伊起兵反抗罗姆塞尔柱苏丹，在伊利汗国的宗主权下建立贝伊国。他于1262年被伊利汗国处死，女婿阿里贝伊继位；阿里因支持1277年失败的吉姆里叛乱而入狱，侯国随后由萨希布—阿塔家族接管了一代人之久。约1310年，格尔米扬的雅各布贝伊恢复该家族的统治，立阿里之子伊南奇贝伊为首领。在伊南奇贝伊及其子、1337年在位的穆拉德·阿尔斯兰治下，贝伊国重振势力，但1368年格尔米扬直接吞并拉迪克，伊南奇家族的统治就此告终。

en: Inhambane was a trading settlement on a deep bay of the southern Mozambique coast, one of the oldest ports on that shore. Dhows from Arabia and Persia were calling there by the eleventh century, bartering for pearls and ambergris and dealing through the older northern port of Chibuene, the southernmost node of the Indian Ocean trade network; inland at Manyikeni, Zimbabwe-style stone walls mark a chiefdom that funneled gold and ivory to the coast between about 1200 and 1700. Local Tonga spinners grew and wove cotton, and before the Portuguese arrived Karanga invaders had set up chiefdoms over them and taken charge of the Muslim trade. The port recognized the overlordship of Kilwa, and when Vasco da Gama anchored in the bay he named it Terra de Boa Gente, the Land of the Good People. A ship of Francisco de Almeida's fleet was wrecked nearby in 1505, a permanent Portuguese factory followed in 1534, and in 1560 Inhambane became the first Jesuit mission in southeast Africa. Under mostly Indian merchants it grew in the eighteenth century into an ivory and slave port, until the town was sacked and destroyed in 1834 by the Nguni conqueror Soshangane.
zh: 伊尼扬巴内是莫桑比克南部海岸一处深水港湾上的贸易聚落，也是这片海岸最古老的港口之一。早在11世纪，阿拉伯和波斯的独桅帆船便到此停泊，收购珍珠和龙涎香，并经更古老的北方港口奇布埃内交易，后者是印度洋贸易网络最南端的节点；内陆的马尼凯尼留有大津巴布韦风格的石墙，那是约1200年至1700年间向沿海输送黄金和象牙的酋长国。当地通加人纺纱织棉，在葡萄牙人到来之前，卡兰加入侵者已在他们之上建立若干酋长国，把持了与穆斯林的贸易。这个港口承认基卢瓦的宗主权。瓦斯科·达伽马在此停泊时，将它命名为‘善良人之地’。1505年，弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达舰队的一艘船在附近失事；1534年葡萄牙人设立常驻商馆，1560年伊尼扬巴内成为耶稣会在东南非的第一个传教点。18世纪，在以印度商人为主的经营下，它发展为象牙和奴隶贸易港，直到1834年被恩古尼征服者索尚加内洗劫摧毁。

en: Inishowen, in Irish Inis Eoghain, the island of Eoghan, is the broad peninsula between Lough Foyle and Lough Swilly in northern Donegal, the northernmost point of Ireland. It took its name from Eógan mac Néill, son of Niall of the Nine Hostages, and was the ancient homeland of the Meic Lochlainn, who for centuries ruled from the Grianan of Aileach ringfort at its neck and gave two high kings to Ireland. When their power collapsed after the Battle of Caimeirge in 1241, the Norman Earldom of Ulster moved in and built Greencastle; the Anglo-Norman knight John de Courcy had already harried the peninsula in 1198, only to be checked by the O'Neills. In the fourteenth century, after the Bruce invasion shattered the earldom, the Ó Dochartaigh clan of Tyrconnell gradually conquered Inishowen as they lost their own Laggan lands, and the Mac Lochlainns sank to the status of local under-lords. The Ó Dochartaigh remained Lords of Inishowen until 1608, when Sir Cahir O'Doherty burned Derry in the last Gaelic rising of the north; his defeat cost the clan the peninsula, which passed to the planter Sir Arthur Chichester.
zh: 因尼肖温，爱尔兰语意为“欧文之岛”，是多尼戈尔北部横亘在福伊尔湾与斯威利湾之间的宽阔半岛，也是爱尔兰的最北端。它得名于“九质之尼尔”之子欧文·麦克尼尔，是麦克洛克林氏族的故土；该氏族数百年来以半岛咽喉处的格里阿南环形堡为王庭，曾出过两位爱尔兰至高王。1241年凯梅尔格战役后其权势崩塌，诺曼人的阿尔斯特伯爵领乘机伸入，修建了格林卡斯尔；早在1198年，盎格鲁-诺曼骑士约翰·德库西就曾洗劫半岛，却被奥尼尔氏击退。14世纪布鲁斯入侵摧毁伯爵领后，泰尔康奈尔的奥多尔蒂氏族在失去拉根本土的过程中逐步征服因尼肖温，麦克洛克林氏沦为地方小附庸。奥多尔蒂氏一直保有“因尼肖温领主”之位，直到1608年卡希尔·奥多尔蒂爵士焚毁德里，发动北方最后一次盖尔人起义；起义失败后，半岛被剥夺并转封给殖民者亚瑟·奇切斯特爵士。

en: The Injuids were an Iranian dynasty that ruled the province of Fars from Shiraz in the fourteenth century. Their name comes from the injü, the Mongol word for the royal estates: in 1304 the Ilkhan Öljeitü appointed Sharaf al-Din Mahmud Shah to administer them, and his family soon built a nearly independent grip on the region. After the Ilkhanate collapsed with Abu Sa'id's death in 1335, the Injuids ruled Shiraz and at times Isfahan as sovereign princes, though the sons of Sharaf al-Din fought one another and the Chobanids more than once seized Shiraz. In 1337 the ruler in Shiraz was Ghiyas al-Din Kai-Khusrau, and from 1343 the last Injuid prince, Jamal al-Din Abu Ishaq, held both Shiraz and Isfahan and patronized architecture and the art of the book. His rivalry with the Muzaffarids of Yazd ended in disaster: Mubariz al-Din Muhammad took Shiraz in 1353 and captured Isfahan in 1357, where Abu Ishaq was executed and his lands absorbed, remaining under Muzaffarid rule until Timur's conquests forty years later.
zh: 因珠王朝是14世纪以设拉子为中心统治法尔斯省的伊朗王朝，其名称来自蒙古语对王室领地的称呼“inju”。1304年，伊儿汗完者都任命谢拉夫丁·马哈茂德沙管理这些领地，这个家族很快在当地建立起近乎独立的权势。1335年不赛因死后伊儿汗国瓦解，因珠诸王作为独立君主统治设拉子，并一度据有伊斯法罕，但谢拉夫丁的诸子相互争斗，楚邦王朝也曾多次攻占设拉子。1337年统治设拉子的是吉亚斯丁·凯霍斯鲁；1343年起，末代因珠君主贾马勒丁·阿布·伊沙克同时领有设拉子与伊斯法罕，扶持建筑与书籍艺术。他与亚兹德的穆扎法尔王朝争雄，最终惨败：穆巴里兹丁·穆罕默德于1353年攻占设拉子，1357年拿下伊斯法罕，阿布·伊沙克被处死，领土遭吞并，此后由穆扎法尔王朝统治，直到约四十年后帖木儿的征服。

en: The Duchy of Inowrocław, in the Kuyavian lands around the towns of Inowrocław and Bydgoszcz, was split off from the Duchy of Kuyavia in 1267 and ruled by a junior line of the Piasts. Its last independent duke, Przemysł of Inowrocław, gave up the duchy in 1327 in exchange for Sieradz, and it passed to King Władysław Łokietek. During the Polish-Teutonic War the knights of the Teutonic Order occupied Inowrocław from 1332 to 1337, when it was restored to Casimir III the Great, the Piast king shown holding it on the 1337 map. Casimir formally incorporated the duchy into the Polish Crown in 1364 and established the Inowrocław Voivodeship on its territory; after a brief revival as a fief under collateral Piast princes, the incorporation became final in 1392.
zh: 伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫公国位于库亚维亚地区，领有伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫和比得哥什一带，1267年从库亚维亚公国分出，由皮亚斯特家族的一支旁系统治。末代独立公爵、伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫的普热梅斯乌于1327年以该地换取谢拉兹，公国转入国王瓦迪斯瓦夫·沃凯泰克之手。波兰-条顿战争期间，条顿骑士团于1332年至1337年占领此地，1337年它被归还给1337年地图上领有该地的皮亚斯特国王卡齐米日三世。卡齐米日于1364年正式将公国并入波兰王冠，并在其领土上设立伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫省；其间虽曾短暂作为采邑封给旁支皮亚斯特王公，但并入最终在1392年确定下来。

en: Indragiri was a Malay riverine kingdom on the eastern side of Sumatra, strung along the Batang Kuantan, later called the Indragiri River, whose basin reaches inland toward Lake Singkarak. Its name combines the Sanskrit words Indra and giri, the hill of the god Indra. Malay tradition traces the ruling house to Raja Merlang I, said to have been a prince of Srivijaya who established himself there in 1298, and the polity is recognised in external accounts as a territorial entity from 1347. For long it was a vassal, passing under the overlordship of the Minangkabau kings of Pagaruyung; when Tomé Pires wrote around 1515 it was still counted among the ports subject to the Minangkabau ruler, though it had lately won control of its own affairs, and local tradition dates the independent sultanate to 1508 under Nara Singa II, whose forces fought the Portuguese in 1523 and 1524. The court had accepted Islam by the fifteenth century, when Raja Merlang II married a daughter of Sultan Mansur Shah of Malacca. Later rulers widened its lands by absorbing Kuantan, and Sultan Ibrahim, who reigned from 1784 to 1815, founded the new capital of Rengat in 1786 and joined the 1784 Teluk Ketapang campaign to retake Malacca from the Dutch.
zh: 丁机宜是苏门答腊东部的马来人河港王国，沿巴唐库安坦河（后称丁机宜河）分布，流域一直深入内陆至辛卡拉湖一带。其国名由梵语“因陀罗”和“吉里”（山）拼成，意为神王因陀罗之山。马来传说把王室世系追溯到1298年在此立足的室利佛逝王子拉惹·梅朗一世，外部记载从1347年起把它视为一个政治实体。它长期称臣，后来受巴加鲁永的米南加保诸王统辖；托梅·皮莱资约1515年著书时，仍把它列为米南加保统治者治下的港口，但它新近已掌握自身事务，当地传统把独立苏丹国的开端定于1508年纳拉·辛加二世在位时，其军队还在1523至1524年与葡萄牙人作战。15世纪时宫廷已接受伊斯兰教，拉惹·梅朗二世娶了马六甲苏丹曼苏尔·沙的女儿。后来的统治者吞并库安坦，扩大了疆土；1784至1815年在位的苏丹易卜拉欣于1786年兴建新都冷岳，并参加了1784年从荷兰人手中夺回马六甲的直落克塔邦之战。

en: Irodo is a settlement at the mouth of the river of the same name on the northern tip of Madagascar, beneath the Ambohitra Massif in the country of the Antankarana. On its course to the Indian Ocean the river has cut the red laterite Tsingy Rouge formations near Sadjoavato. A multiethnic stopping place once called Antsampagnamahazo, Irodo grew as a transit point between the northern trading capital of Vohemar and the Antankarana kingdom of the interior, and local tradition remembers its founding ancestor Tsimiendrigny, who rescued five foreigners from a shipwreck. The Antankarana, the people of the limestone tsingy, split from the Sakalava in the sixteenth century under their Zafin'i'fotsy royal line. Their first king Kozobe ruled from 1614 and divided the north among his five sons, and after Sakalava invasions from the south King Andriantsirotso refounded the kingdom around the Ankarana rocks in 1692, sheltering his people in its caves.
zh: 伊鲁杜是马达加斯加最北端同名河流入海口处的定居点，位于安博希特拉山脚下的安坦卡拉纳人之地。这条河在注入印度洋的途中，于萨卓阿瓦托附近侵蚀出红土构成的红色石林。伊鲁杜旧称安察帕格纳马哈佐，是个多民族的中转聚落，作为北方贸易重镇武海马尔与内陆安坦卡拉纳王国之间的转运点而兴起；当地传统还记得其始祖齐米恩德里尼曾从海难中救起五个外乡人。安坦卡拉纳意为石林之人，16世纪随扎菲菲齐王室支系与萨卡拉瓦人分裂而形成。首位国王科佐贝于1614年即位，把北方分给五个儿子；后来萨卡拉瓦人自南方入侵，安德里安齐罗措王于1692年在安卡拉纳石林一带重建王国，把族人安置在岩洞中避难。

en: Shiewhibak, the Southern Tiwa name of the pueblo the Spanish called Isleta, was founded around the fourteenth century on a knife-shaped lava flow in the middle Rio Grande valley, south of present-day Albuquerque. Its name refers to a knife laid on the ground for the whib footrace, and its people speak Isletan Tiwa, a Tanoan language; the Tiwa are regarded as the earliest Pueblo inhabitants of the upper Rio Grande. Francisco Vázquez de Coronado campaigned through their country in the Tiguex War of 1540 and 1541, and Antonio de Espejo visited in 1583, before Juan de Oñate's colony of 1598 brought missions and tribute. During the Pueblo Revolt of 1680 Shiewhibak did not join the rising and instead sheltered refugees from abandoned pueblos; the retreating Spaniards nevertheless burned it in 1681 and carried hundreds of its people south to found Ysleta del Sur near El Paso in 1682. Diego de Vargas reoccupied and rebuilt the pueblo in the 1690s, and the returned community kept its Tiwa speech and ceremonies through the colonial centuries.
zh: 希维巴克是南蒂瓦语名字，西班牙人称这座普韦布洛为伊斯莱塔；它约建于14世纪，坐落在格兰德河中游一道刀形熔岩流上，位于今阿尔伯克基以南。其名字源自为惠布赛跑放在地上的刀，居民讲塔诺语系的伊斯莱塔蒂瓦语；蒂瓦人被视为格兰德河上游最早的普韦布洛居民。1540至1541年，弗朗西斯科·巴斯克斯·德·科罗纳多在蒂格斯战争中横扫这一地区，安东尼奥·德·埃斯佩霍又于1583年到访，1598年奥尼亚特的殖民队伍到来后，传教与贡赋随之而来。1680年普韦布洛起义时，希维巴克没有参与起事，反而收容了从弃守村落逃来的难民；但败退的西班牙人仍于1681年焚毁此镇，并将数百居民裹胁南行，于1682年在埃尔帕索附近建立南伊斯莱塔。17世纪90年代，迭戈·德·巴尔加斯重新占领并重建了这座普韦布洛，返乡的社区在整个殖民时代保留了蒂瓦语和传统仪式。

en: Isedo, fully called Isedo-Olumo, was an ancient kingdom of the Igbomina Yoruba in north-eastern Yorubaland. Oral tradition dates its founding to between 1250 and 1400, while archaeology traces the settlement back to the 10th century, when Obalumo, a hunter-prince from the older Oba civilization further north, led refugees away from its quarrels with neighbouring peoples, including the Nupe. At its height towards the end of the 15th century the city-state grouped thirteen clans under the Obalumo, the royal title still borne by its rulers. It played host to migrants from the collapsing kingdom of Ila Yara, granting them land on which they built first Ila-Magbon and then Ila-Odo, the nucleus of the present-day town of Ila Orangun; in memory of the grant the Orangun of Ila once paid an annual homage to the Obalumo. A branch of the Isedo royalty later joined the founding of Oke-Ila, where its head took the title of Obala. Long overshadowed by its younger neighbours, the old Isedo township was eventually absorbed into Ila Orangun.
zh: 伊塞多全称伊塞多-奥卢莫，是约鲁巴兰东北部伊博米纳约鲁巴人的古老王国。口传传统把建城时间定在1250至1400年间，考古则将定居史追溯到10世纪：创建者奥巴卢莫是来自更北方奥巴古文明的狩猎王子，因奥巴与努佩等邻邦连年冲突而率难民出走。15世纪末鼎盛时，这个城邦在奥巴卢莫（其统治者世代沿用的王号）之下统辖十三个氏族。它曾接纳从覆灭的伊拉雅拉王国逃来的移民，拨出土地让他们先后建立伊拉马格邦和伊拉奥多，后者就是今天伊拉奥朗贡的雏形；为答谢赠地之恩，伊拉的奥兰甘曾每年向奥巴卢莫朝谒。伊塞多王族的一支后来参与创建奥凯伊拉，其首领获封“奥巴拉”头衔。由于长期受年轻邻邦的声势压制，古老的伊塞多城最终并入伊拉奥朗贡。

en: The Itun are the Jurchen group of the Itun river (Manchu Ituŋ ula), which flows past Changchun into the Second Songhua system, where the Buyeo once built a royal city. In the fourteenth century the valley belonged to the Yuan province of Liaoyang, and under the Ming it was held through the Nurgan guards before passing to the Yehe tribe.
zh: 伊图是生活在伊通河（满语伊敦乌拉）畔的女真群体，河流经长春注入第二松花江水系，夫余人曾在河畔修建王城。14世纪这里隶属元朝辽阳行省，明代由奴儿干都司诸卫管辖，明末落入海西女真叶赫部之手。

en: The Itza were a Maya people whose kings, bearing the title Kan Ek', ruled an island kingdom on Lake Petén Itzá in the rainforest of Petén. Descended from the Chanes of the Chontal coast in Tabasco, they migrated into northern Yucatán in the tenth century and became the dominant lineage of Chichen Itza, whose name means at the mouth of the well of the Itza. After their hegemony there ended they lingered at Champotón, and when the Xiu overthrew the Cocom at Mayapan around 1441 to 1446 the Itza fled south and founded Nojpetén, the great island, dividing the city into four lineage quarters. Hernán Cortés crossed the lake during his 1525 march to Honduras, but the Itza kept their independence for another 170 years: Franciscan missions of 1618 and 1619 were expelled, and the 1622 expedition of Francisco de Mirones was massacred. In 1697 Martín de Ursúa y Arizmendi stormed Nojpetén from Yucatán, ending the last independent native kingdom in the Americas.
zh: 伊察人是玛雅人的一支，其君主称坎·埃克，在佩滕雨林的佩滕伊察湖上统治着一个岛国。他们是塔巴斯科琼塔尔海岸查内斯人的后裔，10世纪迁入尤卡坦北部，成为奇琴伊察的统治家族——奇琴伊察的意思正是“伊察人的井口”。霸权结束后他们一度居留于钱波通；约1441—1446年休人在玛雅潘推翻科科姆家族，伊察人随即南逃，建立诺赫佩滕，意为“大岛”，并按血缘把全城分为四区。1525年埃尔南·科尔特斯进军洪都拉斯时曾横渡此湖，但伊察人又保持了约170年独立：1618—1619年的方济各会传教团被驱逐，1622年弗朗西斯科·德·米罗内斯的远征队遭屠杀。1697年，马丁·德·乌尔苏亚·阿里斯门迪从尤卡坦出兵攻陷诺赫佩滕，美洲最后一个独立的本土王国就此灭亡。

en: Iveagh, from the Irish Uíbh Eachach Cobha, was a Gaelic territory in the heart of what is now County Down, originally ruled by the Uí Echach Cobo within the overkingdom of Ulaid. From the twelfth century its chiefs were the Magennis sept, who made their base at Rathfriland and were inaugurated on Knock Iveagh. The Magennises held lands as vassals of the Norman Earldom of Ulster until the earldom collapsed in 1333, after which they expanded Iveagh eastward as far as Dundrum on the Irish Sea. They later came to terms with the English crown under surrender and regrant, several chiefs being knighted in 1542, but Art Roe Magennis joined the Nine Years' War on the side of Hugh O'Neill. After the war the crown broke Iveagh into fifteen freeholds between 1607 and 1610, ending its existence as a single lordship; its bounds later became the baronies of Iveagh Upper and Iveagh Lower.
zh: 艾维得名于爱尔兰语 Uíbh Eachach Cobha，是位于今唐郡腹地的盖尔人领地，最初由属于乌拉德大王权下的 乌伊·埃哈·科博部族统治。12世纪起，马吉尼斯家族成为艾维首领，以拉斯弗赖兰为据点，并在诺克艾维山举行继位仪式。他们原本作为诺曼人的阿尔斯特伯国附庸领有土地，1333年伯国崩溃后趁机向东扩张，直抵爱尔兰海边的邓德拉姆。后来他们通过“交土再封”政策与英国王室和解，数名首领于1542年受封骑士；但阿尔特·罗·马吉尼斯在九年战争中加入了休·奥尼尔一方。战后英国王室于1607至1610年间把艾维拆成十五块自由保有地，统一的领主领地就此终结，其辖境后来演变为上艾维和下艾维两个男爵区。

en: Iztapan, whose Nahuatl name means place of salt, was a small salt-working town on the Costa Grande of Guerrero, on the coast later covered by the Aztec province of Cihuatlan, whose centre in this district was the bay of modern Zihuatanejo. The region's ancient heart was the ceremonial city of Xihuacan, occupied for more than three thousand years and at its height between 200 and 800, whose later users included the Tolimecs, Cuitlatecs and Tepuztecs. According to the sixteenth-century Relaciones geográficas, the town of Iztapan, together with Pantla, spoke Pantec, an otherwise unrecorded language; Tolimec was spoken in the towns to its west, while a variant of Nahuatl served as the lingua franca of the Zacatula district. Long independent of the highland empires, this coast was conquered by the Mexica emperor Ahuitzotl between 1497 and 1504 and registered as the tribute province of Cihuatlan in the Codex Mendoza.
zh: 伊斯塔潘的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“产盐之地”，是格雷罗州科斯塔格兰德海岸的一座小型盐业城镇，所在海岸后来被纳入阿兹特克的锡瓦特兰省，这一带的中心是今日锡瓦塔内霍所在的海湾。该地区古代的核心是礼仪城市锡瓦坎，有人居住的历史超过三千年，在200至800年间达到鼎盛，后来的使用者包括托利梅克人、奎特拉特克人和特普斯特克人。根据16世纪的《地理记述》，伊斯塔潘与潘特拉一带讲潘特克语，一种除此之外没有记录的语言；其西面诸镇讲托利梅克语，纳瓦特尔语的一种变体则是萨卡图拉地区的通用语。这片海岸长期独立于高地帝国之外，直到1497至1504年间被墨西加君主阿维索特尔征服，并在《门多萨手抄本》中被登记为贡赋省锡瓦特兰。

en: Ixtlan was a small Mixtec city-state of the Coixtlahuaca valley in the northern Mixteca Alta of Oaxaca, probably the hill settlement later called Santiago Ihuitlan, whose people paid feather tribute to the Aztecs. Like the rest of the Coixtlahuaca province it passed to the Spaniards after the region's envoys submitted in 1520.
zh: 伊斯特兰是瓦哈卡北部上米斯特卡科伊斯特拉瓦卡谷地的小米斯特克人城邦，很可能即后来称作圣地亚哥·伊维特兰的山城，当地居民曾向阿兹特克人缴纳羽毛贡赋。与科伊斯特拉瓦卡省的其他城镇一样，1520年该地使者向西班牙人投降后，它也被纳入新西班牙。

en: Ixtacamaxtitlan was a Totonac town of the Sierra Norte de Puebla, in the highlands of old Totonacapan on the border with Tlaxcala. Its Nahuatl name refers to Iztacamaxtli, the white Camaxtli, the hunting and war deity also worshipped in Tlaxcala, and to the white crag beside which the settlement was founded.
zh: 伊斯塔卡马什蒂特兰是普埃布拉北部山区、旧托托纳卡潘高地上的一座托托纳克城镇，毗邻特拉斯卡拉。其纳瓦特尔语名称意为“白色的卡马斯特利”，卡马斯特利是特拉斯卡拉等地崇拜的狩猎与战争之神，名字也指城镇始建时所依的白色岩壁。

en: Ila Yara, also called Ila-Iyara, was the original kingdom of the Igbomina Yoruba, founded in about the 1100s by Ajagun-nla, nicknamed Orangun, a legendary grandson of the deity Oduduwa, whose successors kept the title of Orangun. Towards the end of the 1400s, after the sixth Orangun, Apakiimo, took the throne, a rival prince named Arutu lost the contest for the crown and led his supporters out in an exodus: they settled further north near the kingdom of Isedo and built the town that became Ila Orangun. Apakiimo himself soon abandoned Ila Yara and moved east to found Oke-Ila, taking in a segment of the Isedo people along the way. In this way the old kingdom split into two sister states, Ila and Oke-Ila, whose kings both claim the Orangun title, while the original site of Ila Yara was left deserted.
zh: 伊拉雅拉又称伊拉-伊亚拉，是伊博米纳约鲁巴人最初的王国，约在12世纪由阿贾贡拉创建；他绰号“奥兰甘”，传说是神祇奥杜杜瓦的孙子，其继承者世代沿用奥兰甘的王号。15世纪末，第六任奥兰甘阿帕基莫即位后，争夺王位失败的王子阿鲁图率支持者出走，向北迁到伊塞多王国附近定居，建起后来的伊拉奥朗贡。阿帕基莫本人也很快放弃伊拉雅拉东迁，建立奥凯伊拉，并在途中接纳了一部分伊塞多人。古老王国由此分裂为伊拉和奥凯伊拉两个姊妹政权，两国国王都宣称拥有奥兰甘头衔，而伊拉雅拉旧城则被废弃。

en: Iztachacalapan was a small Zoque-speaking community of the Tochtepec lowlands in southern Veracruz, one of the Mixe-Zoque towns of the Papaloapan basin recorded under Nahuatl names. Like the rest of the region it was drawn into the Aztec tribute system in the fifteenth century, before the Spanish conquest of the Papaloapan towns in the early 1520s.
zh: 伊斯塔查卡拉潘是韦拉克鲁斯南部托奇特佩克低地一个讲索克语的小社群，是帕帕洛阿潘盆地以纳瓦特尔语记名的米塞-索克诸镇之一。与该地区其他地方一样，它在15世纪被纳入阿兹特克的朝贡体系，此后又在16世纪20年代初卷入西班牙人对帕帕洛阿潘诸镇的征服。

en: Itzocan, whose Nahuatl name means place of the flint path, was a substantial Nahua altepetl in the Coatlalpan lowlands of southwestern Puebla, on the present-day site of Izúcar de Matamoros. Its people were Nahuatl-speaking Nonoalca, and its ruling dynasty was linked by marriage and descent to those of Tenochtitlan and the neighbouring city of Huaquechula; the region grew cotton and Itzocan's market was known well beyond the district for the slaves sold there. In Mexica foundation lore the town was counted among the cities raised by the giant Xelhua after the great flood. Itzocan was in time conquered by the Aztec Empire, which installed a garrison and made it answer to Tepeaca, though it still waged its own war against the nearby town of Piaxtla. Spanish forces reached the Coatlalpan between 1521 and 1525, and the old name Itzocan was gradually softened to Izúcar; after independence the city added the name of the insurgent hero Mariano Matamoros.
zh: 伊佐坎的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“燧石之路之地”，是普埃布拉西南部科瓦特尔潘低地上一座颇有规模的纳瓦人城邦，旧址即今日的伊苏卡尔-德马塔莫罗斯。当地居民是讲纳瓦特尔语的诺诺阿尔卡人，统治王朝与特诺奇蒂特兰及邻城瓦克丘拉的王朝都有血缘和姻亲关系；这一带种植棉花，伊佐坎的市场更以奴隶买卖闻名遐迩。在墨西加人的起源传说中，该城被列为巨人谢尔瓦在大洪水之后建立的城市之一。伊佐坎后来被阿兹特克帝国征服，帝国在此驻军，并令它臣服于特佩阿卡，但它仍自行对邻近的皮亚斯特拉开战。1521至1525年间，西班牙军队进入科瓦特尔潘，旧名伊佐坎逐渐讹变为伊苏卡尔；独立之后，城市又加上了起义英雄马里亚诺·马塔莫罗斯的名字。

en: The Jalayirid Sultanate was a Mongol dynasty, sprung from the Jalayir tribe of the Onon River in Mongolia, that ruled Iraq and western Iran from Baghdad after the Ilkhanate broke up in the 1330s. By 1337 its head, Hasan Buzurg, held the former Ilkhanid southwestern lands as an essentially independent ruler while fighting rival Mongol amirs for control of Persia. Under his son Shaykh Uways, who reigned from 1356 to 1374, the sultanate reached its height: Tabriz and Azerbaijan were annexed in 1360, the Qara Qoyunlu were beaten at Mush in 1366, and Baghdad and Tabriz became centres of Persianate book painting. After Uways the dynasty weakened, and in 1401 Timur sacked Baghdad and drove Sultan Ahmad into exile. Ahmad returned after Timur died in 1405 but was defeated and killed by the Qara Qoyunlu ruler Qara Yusuf in 1410. The last Jalayirids held only Hillah, Wasit and Basra in southern Iraq until the Qara Qoyunlu overran them in 1432, ending the dynasty.
zh: 札剌亦儿王朝是源自蒙古鄂嫩河流域札剌亦儿部的蒙古王朝，在1330年代伊儿汗国解体后，以巴格达为中心统治伊拉克和伊朗西部。1337年时，其首领哈桑·布祖格已作为实际上独立的统治者掌管伊儿汗国西南部旧地，并与其他蒙古异密争夺波斯。其子谢赫·乌韦斯在位时（1356—1374）王朝达到鼎盛：1360年吞并大不里士和阿塞拜疆，1366年在穆什击败黑羊王朝，巴格达与大不里士成为波斯抄本细密画的中心。乌韦斯死后国势转衰，1401年帖木儿洗劫巴格达，苏丹艾哈迈德被迫流亡。1405年帖木儿死后艾哈迈德一度复国，却在1410年被黑羊王朝首领卡拉·优素福击败身亡。末代札剌亦儿人仅保有伊拉克南部的希拉、瓦西特和巴士拉，1432年被黑羊王朝攻灭，王朝终结。

en: Japan in 1337 stood at the opening of the Ashikaga shogunate: after Emperor Go-Daigo's Kenmu Restoration overthrew the Kamakura shogunate in 1333, his general Ashikaga Takauji turned against him and set up his own military government in Kyoto in 1336, opening the Nanboku-chō war between the Northern and Southern courts, which ended in 1392 when the south submitted. The third shogun Yoshimitsu built his Flower Palace on Muromachi Street in 1379 and promoted trade with Ming China, while Zen Buddhism shaped the tea ceremony, Noh theater and ink painting. The Ōnin War of 1467 shattered Ashikaga authority and began the century of civil war called Sengoku.
