en: Kuhistān, or Quhistan, the mountainous land of southern Khorasan, stretches from the edge of the Dasht-e Kavir to the borders of Sistan, with its chief towns at Qaen, Tun, Tabas, Birjand and Khwaf. At the end of the eleventh century Hassan-i Sabbah sent the da'i Husayn Qa'ini to his home region, and Kuhistān became one of the two heartlands of the Nizari Ismaili state alongside Alamut, ruled by a governor titled muhtasham and studded with mountain castles; scholars such as Nasir al-Din al-Tusi took refuge there before the Mongol storm. Hülegü's campaign against the Nizaris opened with attacks on the strongholds of Kuhistān, and after the imam capitulated in 1256 the Ismaili order was broken and its followers massacred. The province then passed under Il-Khanid rule and, when that empire dissolved, into the hands of local mountain lords. In 1337 it was held by 'Abd-Allah b. Mulai, who joined the other eastern princes in backing the Il-Khanid claimant Togha Temür, while his kinsman Muhammad-i Mulai, sent west as the Jalayirid governor of Khurasan, was defeated and executed by Togha Temür and Arghun Shah in the autumn of that year.
zh: 库希斯坦又称库希斯坦山区，是呼罗珊南部的多山之地，从卡维尔盐漠边缘延伸到锡斯坦边境，主要城镇有加延、图恩、塔巴斯、比尔詹德和哈夫。11世纪末，哈桑·萨巴赫派传道师侯赛因·加伊尼回到家乡，库希斯坦遂与阿拉穆特并列为尼扎里伊斯玛仪国的两大核心，由号称穆赫塔沙姆的长官治理，山中堡垒林立；纳西尔丁·图西等学者曾在蒙古风暴来临前到此避难。旭烈兀征讨尼扎里派时，首先攻打的就是库希斯坦的据点；1256年伊玛目投降后，伊斯玛仪政权被摧毁，信徒遭到屠杀。该省随后归入伊儿汗国，汗国瓦解后又落入本地山区首领之手。1337年，它由阿卜杜拉·本·穆莱把持，他与东部诸王公一同支持伊儿汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿；而他的同族穆罕默德·穆莱被西部的札剌亦儿人派为呼罗珊长官，于同年秋天被脱合帖木儿和阿儿浑沙击败并处死。

en: Khunj is the small highland polity around the town of Khonj in southern Fars, in the medieval district of Irahistan. Its people were the Achomi, also called Khodmooni, Sunni Persians of ancient Zoroastrian background who lived largely by Persian Gulf trade, and the traveler Ibn Battuta visited the town in the fourteenth century and described it in his travelogue.
zh: 洪季是法尔斯南部以洪季城为中心的高地小邦，地处中世纪的伊拉希斯坦地区。居民为阿乔米人（自称霍德穆尼），是有古代琐罗亚斯德教背景的逊尼派波斯人，多以波斯湾贸易为生，14世纪旅行家伊本·白图泰曾到访洪季并在游记中记述。

en:
Khuzdar, the old Qazdar or place of silk, sits in a high narrow valley of central Baluchistan, commanding the routes between the Makran coast, Sindh and the Afghan highlands. It was already the chief city of Turan when that kingdom submitted to Ardashir I in 230 CE, and Shapur I counted Turgistan among the provinces of the Sasanian Empire in his inscription of 262; the caliphate's armies conquered it around 650 and kept it as the capital of the Islamic province of Turan. The Habbari emirs held the district until the late ninth century, and in 994 the Baloch tribes fought Sebuktegin of Ghazna when he stormed the town, after which it passed under Ghaznavid rule and became a link on the caravan road to Multan.

In later centuries Khuzdar rose again as the capital of the Brahui kingdom of Makran, and in the seventeenth century it became the principal city of the Jhalawan country within the expanding Khanate of Kalat, taking in the hill tracts of Wadh and Nal and the road down toward the port of Bela.
zh:
胡兹达尔旧称加兹达尔，意为丝绸之地，坐落在俾路支斯坦中部一条狭窄的高地上，扼守莫克兰海岸、信德与阿富汗高地之间的通道。230年图兰王国向阿尔达希尔一世臣服时，它已是图兰的首要城市；262年沙普尔一世的铭文将图尔吉斯坦列为萨珊帝国行省之一。约650年哈里发的军队攻占此地，仍以它为伊斯兰图兰行省的首府。哈巴里埃米尔们统治该地区直到9世纪末，994年伽色尼的萨布克特勤攻城时，俾路支部落曾奋起抵抗，此后胡兹达尔归入伽色尼王朝，成为通往木尔坦商道上的一环。

此后几个世纪里，胡兹达尔再度兴起，成为布拉灰人莫克兰王国的都城；17世纪它又成为贾拉万地区的首要城市，并入日益扩张的卡拉特汗国，辖有瓦德、纳尔等山地以及通向贝拉港的道路。

en:
The K'iche' are a leading Maya people of the Guatemalan highlands; their name means many trees, and the Nahuatl rendering of it, Cuauhtēmallān, gave the land of Guatemala its name. In the Postclassic they built the most powerful of the highland Maya kingdoms. Its earliest courts sat at Jakawitz and then at Pismachi', and around 1400 King Q'uq'umatz, the Feathered Serpent, founded a new capital at Q'umarkaj, called Utatlán in Nahuatl, immediately north of the old city. Under his son K'iq'ab the kingdom reached its height, drawing central Mexican influences into its art and speech, while four ruling lineages shared the capital around the temples of Tohil, Awilix and Jakawitz. In 1470 a revolt of subject nobles stripped the K'iche' of key allies and began their decline.

When Pedro de Alvarado invaded in 1524, the K'iche' commander Tecun Uman gave battle in the valley of Xelajú and was killed together with close to ten thousand of his men. The lords then invited Alvarado to Q'umarkaj, but he suspected an ambush and burned the city. Under Spanish rule the Dominicans studied the K'iche' language, while K'iche' scribes preserved the creation epic Popol Vuh.
zh:
基切人是危地马拉高地的主要玛雅民族之一，其名称意为“众多树木”，它的纳瓦特尔语译名夸乌特马兰正是“危地马拉”一名的由来。在后古典期，他们建立了高地玛雅最强大的王国。王廷最初设在哈卡维茨，后来迁至皮斯马奇；约1400年，被称为“羽蛇”的国王库库马茨在旧城以北紧邻处建立新都库马尔卡赫，纳瓦特尔语称乌塔特兰。在他的儿子基卡布治下，王国达到鼎盛，艺术和语言吸收了中部墨西哥的影响，四大统治家族围绕托希尔、阿维利什和哈卡维茨等神庙分治都城。1470年，臣属贵族发动叛乱，使基切失去重要盟友，国势由此转衰。

1524年佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多入侵时，基切统帅特昆·乌曼在赫拉胡谷地迎战，兵败身亡，近万名基切人战死。贵族们随后邀请阿尔瓦拉多进入库马尔卡赫，他却怀疑设有埋伏，纵火焚城。西班牙统治时期，多明我会修士研习基切语，基切书吏则保存了创世史诗《波波尔·乌》。

en: Kildare was the chief seat of the senior branch of the FitzGeralds, the Geraldines who came from Wales with the Norman invasion of 1169. The family were Barons of Offaly from about 1193, and John FitzGerald was created Earl of Kildare in 1316, with lands running through the heart of the English Pale around Kildare, Naas and Athy. In 1337 the earl was Maurice FitzGerald, fourth of the line, who suppressed Gaelic risings in Leinster, served Edward III at the siege of Calais in 1347 and was three times appointed Lord Justice of Ireland between 1360 and 1375. The family's power peaked under the eighth and ninth earls, Gearóid Mór and Gearóid Óg, who ruled Ireland as Lord Deputy in the late fifteenth and early sixteenth centuries. Their fall came when the tenth earl, Thomas, called Silken Thomas, rose against Henry VIII in 1534 and was executed three years later. Restored to favour in time, the Kildare Geraldines were made Marquesses of Kildare in 1761 and Dukes of Leinster in 1766, the premier peers of Ireland.
zh: 基尔代尔是菲茨杰拉德家族长支的核心领地，这一支杰拉尔丁人在1169年诺曼入侵时从威尔士而来。家族约自1193年起受封奥法利男爵，约翰·菲茨杰拉德于1316年晋封基尔代尔伯爵，领地横贯英格兰辖区腹地的基尔代尔、纳斯和阿赛一带。1337年在位的是第四代伯爵莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德，他镇压了伦斯特的盖尔人起事，1347年随爱德华三世围攻加来，并在1360年至1375年间三度出任爱尔兰司法官。家族权势在第八代伯爵杰拉德·莫尔和第九代伯爵杰拉德·奥格治下达到顶峰，两人在15世纪末至16世纪初先后以爱尔兰总督之姿统辖爱尔兰。第十代伯爵“绸服托马斯”于1534年起兵反对亨利八世，三年后被处死，家族由盛转衰。基尔代尔杰拉尔丁人后来重获恩宠，于1761年受封基尔代尔侯爵、1766年受封伦斯特公爵，位列爱尔兰首席贵族。

en: The Principality of Kyiv was a Ruthenian principality centered on the city of Kyiv on the Dnieper, carved from the heartland of Kievan Rus' after that state fragmented following the death of Mstislav I in 1132. The Mongol siege of 1240 left the city ruined and its princes tributaries of the Golden Horde, though Kyiv long remained the metropolitan see of the Orthodox church in Rus'. Around 1300 the Olgovichi clan of Chernigov secured the city with the khan's backing, and the chronicles place a Battle on the Irpin River there in 1321, when the Lithuanian grand duke Gediminas is said to have defeated Prince Stanislav; the battle's historicity is disputed. In 1331 Prince Theodore Ivanovich, a Rurikid, is first attested, ruling a diminished duchy caught between Lithuanian and Tatar overlordship. After Grand Duke Algirdas defeated the Horde at the Battle of Blue Waters in 1362 or 1363, Kyiv was incorporated into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. Its princely line ended in 1471, when Casimir IV converted the principality into the Kyiv Voivodeship, which passed to the Polish Crown under the Union of Lublin of 1569.
zh: 基辅公国是以第聂伯河畔的基辅城为中心的鲁塞尼亚公国，1132年姆斯季斯拉夫一世去世后基辅罗斯分裂，它由罗斯的核心领地演变而来。1240年蒙古大军围城使基辅遭到重创，此后基辅王公向金帐汗国纳贡，不过基辅长期仍是罗斯东正教会都主教的驻地。1300年前后，切尔尼戈夫的奥利戈维奇家族在汗王支持下取得该城；编年史记载1321年立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯在伊尔平河之战中击败基辅王公斯坦尼斯拉夫，但此战的真实性存在争议。1331年，留里克家族的西奥多尔·伊万诺维奇首次见于文献，他统治着一个周旋于立陶宛和鞑靼宗主权之间的弱小公国。1362或1363年，阿尔吉尔达斯大公在蓝水之战击败金帐汗国后，基辅被并入立陶宛大公国。1471年，卡齐米日四世废除公国、改设基辅省，王公世系就此终结；1569年《卢布林联合》后，基辅省划归波兰王国。

en: The Kilis emirate was a Kurdish principality of the Kilis and Afrin districts north of Aleppo, whose rulers claimed descent from the Yazidi saint Sheikh Fakhraddin and from his son Sheikh Mend, a Hakkari tribal leader. In the late twelfth century the Ayyubid sultan Saladin, himself a Kurd, made Mend lord of a country stretching from Afrin to Kilis and Maraş, with the title Emir of the Kurds. When Ayyubid power collapsed around 1260 the Mamluks confirmed the family, now led by Mend Kasım, in Kilis. The emirate kept its autonomy under the Ottomans after Selim I's conquest, though Kasım was later executed in Constantinople on the report of the governor of Aleppo; his son Canpolat was restored to Kilis in 1515 and ruled until 1572. Canpolat's son Hüseyin expanded towards Aleppo and was executed by the local pasha, and when Hüseyin's nephew Ali waged a revenge campaign an Ottoman army forced him to flee; he was put to death in Constantinople in 1610 and the emirate was dissolved. His Canbolatoğulları kin fled to Lebanon in 1630, where the Druze Jumblatt family traces its descent to them.
zh: 基利斯埃米尔国是阿勒颇以北、据有基利斯和阿夫林两地的库尔德公国，统治者自称是雅兹迪圣徒谢赫·法赫尔丁及其子、哈卡里部落首领谢赫·门德的后裔。12世纪末，本身是库尔德人的阿尤布苏丹萨拉丁任命门德统治从阿夫林到基利斯和马拉什的土地，封号为“库尔德人的埃米尔”。1260年前后阿尤布王朝崩溃，马穆鲁克确认门德·卡西姆家族在基利斯的统治。塞利姆一世征服此地后，埃米尔国在奥斯曼治下保持自治，但卡西姆后来因阿勒颇总督的告发在君士坦丁堡被处死；他的儿子詹普拉特于1515年获准回到基利斯统治，直至1572年去世。詹普拉特之子侯赛因向阿勒颇扩张，被当地帕夏处死；侯赛因的侄子阿里又起兵复仇，奥斯曼军队前来讨伐，阿里被迫出逃，1610年在君士坦丁堡被处决，埃米尔国就此瓦解。他的族人詹普拉特奥卢拉尔于1630年逃往里巴嫩，德鲁兹派的琼布拉特家族即其后裔。

en: Kiliman was the earlier name of the people who built Buayan, the power of the upper Cotabato valley on Mindanao, whose founding the local Tarsila genealogies place in the mid-fourteenth century. Its first recorded ruler was Datu Mamu, who widened his influence by marrying princesses from neighboring chiefdoms, and its chiefs bore the Indianized title of rajah. The polity centered on Buayan on the Pulangi River, upstream from Maguindanao, and drew wealth from the fertile rice lands of the Sa-raya, or Upper Valley, while keeping a maritime outlet at Sarangani Bay. After the preacher Rajah Baguinda Ali arrived from Basilan, the people accepted Islam and Buayan became one of the four great sultanates of Mindanao, rival to the lower-valley Sultanate of Maguindanao. The Spaniards met it in force under Rajah Silongan, who in 1596 repulsed the combined armies of Maguindanao and Spain and in 1599 joined a three-thousand-strong raid on the coasts of Cebu, Negros and Panay. Buayan kept its independence through the long Spanish-Moro wars that followed.
zh: 奇里曼是建立布阿延的族群的旧称。布阿延是棉兰老哥打巴托谷地上游的强权，当地的《系谱》把它的建立追溯到14世纪中叶。有记载的最早统治者是达图·马穆，他通过迎娶邻近酋邦的公主扩大势力，其首领使用印度化称号“拉惹”。政权以普朗吉河畔的布阿延为中心，地处马京达瑙上游，靠萨莱亚（即上谷地）肥沃的稻田致富，并在萨兰加尼湾保留出海港口。传教者拉惹·巴金达·阿里从巴西兰到来后，居民皈依伊斯兰教，布阿延成为棉兰老四大苏丹国之一，与下谷地的马京达瑙苏丹国长期争雄。西班牙人在拉惹·西隆安在位时与它正面交锋：1596年西隆安击退马京达瑙与西班牙的联军，1599年又参与三千人大举劫掠宿务、内格罗斯和班乃沿海。在此后漫长的西班牙—摩洛战争中，布阿延始终保住了独立。

en: Kipike was a Circassian tribe of the Black Sea coast around the Taman peninsula, recorded in the fifteenth century by the Venetian traveler Giosafat Barbaro, who names the Kippike as Circassians of the Great Sea shore, Christians of the Greek rite. The Taman area, called Matrega by the Genoese, was then ringed by autonomous Circassian tribal principalities.
zh: 奇皮克是黑海沿岸塔曼半岛一带的切尔克斯部落，15世纪威尼斯旅行家巴尔巴罗的游记曾记下“基皮凯”之名，说他们是大海沿岸的切尔克斯人、希腊礼基督徒。当时塔曼被热那亚人称为马特雷加，周围分布着自治的切尔克斯部落公国。

en: Kirchberg was the county of a Swabian high-noble family whose lands lay south of Ulm on both sides of the river Iller, an imperial fief formed from the old Rammachgau. Their seat was the castle of Oberkirchberg, now part of Illerkirchberg, and the family first appears in 1087; in 1093 the brothers Otto and Hartmann of Kirchberg richly endowed the Benedictine abbey of Wiblingen, which became their burial place. Around 1250 the counts split into three lines: the senior line at Oberkirchberg, the Brandenburg line centered on Dietenheim, which died out in 1322, and the Wullenstetten line east of the Iller. When Count William of the senior line died in 1366, his daughter Agnes carried much of the inheritance to her husband Ulrich of Matsch. The Wullenstetten line recovered the old county as a pledge in 1390 and was re-enfeoffed with it by King Sigismund in 1434. Deeply indebted, the last cousins sold their halves to Duke George of Bavaria-Landshut in 1481 and 1498, and after the Landshut War of Succession King Maximilian I in 1507 pledged the lordship to the Fugger, who thereafter styled themselves counts of Kirchberg. The family itself died out in 1510. Its most famous son was the minnesinger Conrad of Kirchberg, portrayed in the Codex Manesse.
zh: 基希贝格是施瓦本高级贵族家族的伯爵领，地处乌尔姆以南、伊勒河两岸，是由古老的拉马赫高东部组成的帝国采邑，治所在上基希贝格堡（今伊勒基希贝格）。该家族1087年首见文献；1093年奥托与哈特曼兄弟斥巨资供养本笃会的维布林根修道院，那里后来成为家族墓地。约1250年伯爵家分为三支：留守上基希贝格的长支、以迪滕海姆为中心并于1322年绝嗣的勃兰登堡支，以及伊勒河以东的武伦施泰滕支。长支威廉伯爵1366年去世后，其女阿格尼丝把大份遗产带给丈夫马奇的乌尔里希。武伦施泰滕支于1390年以抵押方式收回旧伯国，1434年由国王西吉斯蒙德重新册封。末代两位堂兄弟负债累累，分别于1481年和1498年把各自的一半卖给巴伐利亚-兰茨胡特公爵格奥尔格；兰茨胡特继承战争后，国王马克西米利安一世于1507年把领地抵押给富格尔家族，后者此后自称基希贝格伯爵。家族本身于1510年绝嗣，其最有名的成员是《马内塞古抄本》中有画像的恋歌诗人康拉德·冯·基希贝格。

en: Kitara, also called the Chwezi Empire, was the great state of the interlacustrine country around the African Great Lakes, covering much of western Uganda and remembered in the oral traditions of the Banyoro, Batooro and Banyankole. Its rulers held court first at Mubende, where a hilltop palace and the Nakayima shrine still mark the Chwezi presence, and later at Bigo bya Mugenyi on the Katonga River, whose ten kilometres of ditches and banks have been dated to roughly 1300 to 1500. Tradition tells that after the Tembuzi kings the commoner Bukuku seized the throne, and that his grandson Karubumbi, taking the name Ndahura, founded the Chwezi dynasty and campaigned as far as Rwanda, Karagwe and Busoga. The Chwezi, remembered as skilled blacksmiths and now venerated as ancestor spirits by the Rutara peoples, abandoned Kitara under King Wamara after ill omens, and power passed to the Luo Biito dynasty of Isingoma Rukidi, whose kingdom became Bunyoro. Both Bunyoro and, later, Buganda claimed the legacy of Kitara as the source of their kingship.
zh: 基塔拉又称契韦齐帝国，是非洲大湖地区湖间地带的大国，疆域涵盖乌干达西部大部，留在巴尼奥罗人、巴托罗人和巴扬科勒人的口传传统中。统治者先定都穆本德，山顶宫殿遗址和纳卡伊马神龛标示着契韦齐人的踪迹，后迁都卡通加河畔的比戈比亚穆根伊；那里绵延十公里的壕沟与土坝经测定约建于1300至1500年间。相传滕布齐诸王之后，平民布库库篡夺王位，其孙子卡鲁本比后改名恩达胡拉，开创契韦齐王朝，兵锋远达卢旺达、卡拉圭和布索加。契韦齐人以善锻铁器闻名，被鲁塔拉各族奉为祖先神灵；到瓦马拉王时，因种种凶兆，契韦齐人弃基塔拉而去，王权转入卢奥人比伊托王朝的伊辛戈马·鲁基迪之手，其国家即后来的布尼奥罗。布尼奥罗以及后来的布干达都自称继承基塔拉的法统，以此论证自身王权的来历。

en: Keonjhar, also called Kendujhar, was a hill kingdom in northern Orissa, covering the lands that now form Kendujhar district. Its territory fell into two parts: the low valleys of the Baitarani river and the forested highlands of the Gandhamadan range, with the raja's seat at Keonjhar. Tradition places its foundation in the twelfth century, when the Eastern Ganga dynasty ruled the region: Jyoti Bhanja, of the Bhanja dynasty and brother of Adi Bhanja of Mayurbhanj, was enthroned as raja with the backing of the dominant local Bhuyan clans, whose chiefs long kept a role in the coronation ritual. Around the fourteenth century a Keonjhar prince, Ananga Bhanja, was made king of neighbouring Baudh. The Bhanja rulers governed as tributaries under the overlordship of the Orissa kings, and the same dynasty continued to rule Keonjhar without interruption through the Mughal and Maratha centuries, with rajas such as Jagannath Bhanja reigning from 1688.
zh: 盖翁切尔又称肯杜贾尔，是奥里萨北部的山地王国，疆域相当于今印度奥里萨邦的肯杜贾尔县。其地分为两部分：拜塔拉尼河的低缓河谷，以及甘达马丹山脉所在的森林高地，罗阇的都城设在盖翁切尔。相传王国建于12世纪东恒伽王朝统治时期：班贾王朝的乔蒂·班贾是马尤布汉杰的阿迪·班贾之弟，他在当地势力最大的布扬氏族拥戴下登位为罗阇，布扬首领在此后的加冕仪式中长期保有一席之地。约14世纪时，盖翁切尔的王子阿南加·班贾被立为邻近包德的国王。班贾诸王作为奥里萨君主治下的附庸进行统治，同一王朝在莫卧儿和马拉塔的时代里始终未断，例如贾格纳特·班贾于1688年起在位。

en: The Kanien'kehaka, or People of the Flint Place, known to European settlers as the Mohawk, are an Iroquoian people of the Mohawk Valley in present-day upstate New York. Farmers of corn, beans and squash living in stockaded longhouse villages such as Canajoharie, they reckoned descent through the mother's line and, as the easternmost of the Five Nations of the Haudenosaunee, held the title Keepers of the Eastern Door in the league founded through the Great Peacemaker and Hiawatha. In 1609 Samuel de Champlain joined a Wendat war party that fired on Mohawk warriors near Lake Champlain, the nation's first meeting with Europeans. The Dutch at Fort Orange then supplied firearms in exchange for furs, and after defeating the Mohicans in 1628 the Mohawk dominated the regional trade. A French expedition burned their villages in 1666, opening the way for Jesuit missions, while the English later inherited the Dutch alliance; four Mohawk chiefs visited Queen Anne in 1710. Most Mohawk sided with Britain during the American Revolution under Joseph Brant; Sullivan's expedition destroyed their towns in 1779, and the survivors resettled mainly on the Grand River and the Bay of Quinte under the British crown.
zh: 卡尼恩凯哈卡意为“燧石之地的人”，欧洲移民称之为莫霍克人，是生活在今纽约上州莫霍克谷的易洛魁语族民族。他们种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，居住在卡纳乔哈里等设有栅栏的长屋村落，按母系计算世系；作为霍迪诺肖尼（即易洛魁联盟）五族中最靠东的一员，在和平使者与海华沙创立的联盟里号称“东门的守护者”。1609年，塞缪尔·德·尚普兰随一支温达特作战队伍在尚普兰湖畔向莫霍克战士开火，这是他们与欧洲人的第一次接触。此后奥兰治堡的荷兰人用火器换取毛皮，1628年莫霍克人击败莫西干人，垄断了地区贸易。1666年法国远征军焚毁了他们的村庄，耶稣会传教士随之而来；英国人后来接管了荷兰人的同盟关系，1710年四位莫霍克酋长还曾觐见安妮女王。美国独立战争中，多数莫霍克人在约瑟夫·布兰特率领下站在英国一边；1779年沙利文远征摧毁了他们的村镇，幸存者主要在英王授予的格兰德河与昆特湾土地上重新定居。

en: The Killke were the highland people who held the Cusco basin in the centuries before the Incas, their culture lasting from about 900 to 1200, during the Late Intermediate Period. Long before the imperial fortress of Sacsayhuamán rose above Cusco, Killke builders occupied its hilltop from around 900 and, in the twelfth century, raised the first small sections of the fortification, together with its temple, streets and irrigation canals; the Incas later absorbed the site and rebuilt it on a monumental scale in the fifteenth century. John Howland Rowe, who gave the culture its name, first identified its pottery: globular jars with vertical strap handles, slipped in white or buff and painted with simple geometric lines in black and red. When the Inca state formed in the Cusco valley during the thirteenth century, Killke lands and traditions became part of its early heritage.
zh: 基利克人是印加人之前据有库斯科盆地的高地族群，其文化存续于约900年至1200年的晚中间期。早在萨克塞瓦曼雄关耸立于库斯科之前，基利克人已在约900年占据其山头，并在12世纪修筑了防御工事最早的几段，以及神庙、街道和灌渠；印加人后来接管该遗址，于15世纪将其大规模扩建。为该文化命名的约翰·豪兰·罗最先辨认出基利克陶器：器形多为带竖向带状把手的球状罐，施白色或米黄色陶衣，以黑、红两色绘出简洁的几何线条。13世纪印加政权在库斯科河谷形成时，基利克人的土地与传统也汇入了印加早期的遗产。

en: Kutai Kartanegara was a Hindu kingdom founded around 1300 at Kutai Lama, near the mouth of the Mahakam River in eastern Borneo, by Aji Batara Agung Dewa Sakti; its early rulers bore Hindu-Javanese titles reflecting contacts with Majapahit. In 1337 the throne belonged to his son, Aji Batara Agung Paduka Nira. Growing rich on river and coastal trade, the court moved several times along the lower Mahakam, from Jaitan Layar to Jembayan in 1732 and later to Tenggarong. Islam arrived with traders in the sixteenth century, and in 1575 the ruler Aji Raja Mahkota Mulia Alam made the kingdom a Muslim sultanate. In 1635 Kutai Kartanegara defeated its ancient upstream rival Kutai Martapura after seven days and nights of fighting, annexed Muara Kaman and took the combined name Kutai Kartanegara ing Martapura.
zh: 古泰‑卡塔内加拉是约1300年在东婆罗洲马哈坎河口古泰拉玛建立的印度教王国，开国君主是阿吉·巴塔拉·阿贡·德瓦·萨克蒂，早期君主使用印度教—爪哇式头衔，反映出与满者伯夷的往来。1337年在位的是他的儿子阿吉·巴塔拉·阿贡·帕杜卡·尼拉。凭借河流与沿海贸易致富后，王庭在马哈坎河下游多次迁移，1732年迁至占巴延，后来又迁往登加隆。16世纪，伊斯兰教随商人传入；1575年，君主阿吉·拉贾·马赫库塔·穆利亚·阿拉姆将王国改为伊斯兰苏丹国。1635年，古泰‑卡塔内加拉经过七天七夜的激战，击败上游的古老对手古泰‑摩多补罗，吞并穆阿拉卡曼，合并后的国家改称古泰‑卡塔内加拉英摩多补罗。

en: Khalkhal was a highland town and district in Azerbaijan, in the mountains south-west of Ardabil, which had succeeded the older city of Firuzabad as the seat of its province. Around 1340 the chronicler Hamdallah Mustawfi described it as a former town of some size that had shrunk to a village, its province covering roughly a hundred villages in four districts within the Ardabil tuman; in 1337 its local chief held the district as a vassal of the Jalayirids of Baghdad. After Nader Shah was killed in 1747, Amir-Guna Khan of the Afshar tribe founded the Khalkhal Khanate on the same ground, and it stayed semi-independent until Qajar forces absorbed it in 1799.
zh: 哈勒哈里是阿塞拜疆的一处高地城镇与地区，位于阿尔达比勒西南的山区，曾接替更古老的菲鲁扎巴德成为当地的治所。1340年前后，史家哈姆杜拉·穆斯塔菲记载，它曾是颇有规模的城镇，当时已衰落为村庄，其辖区在阿尔达比勒土绵之下约有上百个村庄、分属四个分区；1337年时，当地首领作为巴格达札剌亦儿王朝的附庸领有此地。1747年纳迪尔沙遇刺后，阿夫沙尔部的阿米尔-古纳汗在同一地盘建立哈勒哈里汗国，保持半独立直到1799年被卡扎尔王朝吞并。

en: The Khokhra chieftaincy, better known as the Nagvanshi dynasty, was the Hindu state of the forested Chota Nagpur plateau, centred on Khukhragarh near Ranchi. Local tradition carries its line back to a first-century founder, Phani Mukut Rai, and the family claimed Kshatriya rank, though its early chiefs probably rose from the Munda tribe. In 1337 the rajas still ruled from their hill capital beyond the easy reach of the sultans of Bihar, and their recorded history opens only in the fifteenth century. The Mughals then forced their way into the jungles: Shahbaz Khan Kamboh subjugated Madhukar Rai for Akbar in 1585, and in 1615 the governor Ibrahim Khan annexed the state and carried Durjan Shah to a Mughal prison, from which Jahangir released him after he judged the purity of the emperor's diamonds. Restored rajas became temple builders: Ram Shah raised the Kapilnath temple at Navratangarh in 1643, and Raghunath Shah and his kin added Jagannath temples later in the century. Nagvanshi arms still repulsed an Aurangzeb-era invasion, but in 1719 Sarbuland Khan extracted a lakh of rupees and the capital was moved first to Palkot. After the battle of Buxar the dynasty became an East India Company vassal in 1771, was reduced to zamindar status in 1817, and saw the great Kol tribal rising of 1831 to 1833 sweep the plateau before the British put it down.
zh: 科赫罗酋长国又称那格万希王朝，是以兰契附近的库克拉加尔为中心、据有丛林覆盖的乔塔那格浦尔高原的印度教政权。当地传说把王系追溯到1世纪的始祖帕尼·穆库特·拉伊，家族自称刹帝利，但其早期首领很可能出身蒙达部族。1337年，王公们仍在山城发号施令，比哈尔的苏丹们鞭长莫及；其有文献可考的历史到15世纪才开始。此后莫卧儿人强行进入丛林：1585年，沙赫巴兹汗·坎博替阿克巴降服马杜卡尔·拉伊；1615年，省督易卜拉欣汗吞并该国，把杜尔詹·沙阿押入莫卧儿监狱，后来他因替贾汉吉尔鉴别钻石纯度而获释。复辟后的王公大兴土木：拉姆·沙阿于1643年在纳夫拉坦加尔修建迦毗罗那特神庙，拉古纳特·沙阿及其族人又在该世纪后期增建贾格纳特神庙。那格万希的军队还击退过奥朗则布时期的一次入侵，但1719年萨尔布兰汗勒索了十万卢比，都城也先迁往帕尔科特。伯格萨尔战役后，该王朝于1771年成为英国东印度公司的附庸，1817年被降为柴明达尔；1831至1833年，大规模的科尔人部落起义席卷高原，最终被英国人镇压。

en:
Kalāt, whose name comes from the Arabic word for fortress, lies in the Central Brahui Range south of Quetta. It was anciently called Qiqan or Kaikan and later Kalat-e Sewa, after the Hindu Sewa dynasty whose legendary founder gave the town its name. In 662 the Jat tribesmen of Qiqan defeated an Arab army near the Bolan Pass and killed its commander al-Harith ibn Murra al-Abdi, and Umayyad campaigns against the district dragged on for decades. The Hindu rulers held out until the fifteenth century, when Brahui clans of the Mirwari took Kalat and made it their mountain stronghold above the town of Surab.

From that fortress the Brahui Khans built the first unified state in Baluchistan. Mir Ahmad Khan I declared independence from the Mughals in 1666 and took Quetta, Mastung and Pishin, and under Mir Nasir Khan I, who reigned from 1749 to 1794, the Khanate of Kalat stretched from Kerman to Sindh and from the Helmand to the Arabian Sea. Nasir Khan threw off Afghan suzerainty after the war of 1758, issued his own coinage, and in 1784 granted the port of Gwadar to the fugitive Omani prince Sultan bin Ahmad.
zh:
卡拉特之名源自阿拉伯语的堡垒一词，坐落在奎达以南的布拉灰中央山脉中。它古称凯坎，后来又叫塞瓦堡，得名于传说中奠基此城的印度教塞瓦王朝。662年，凯坎的贾特部落在博兰山口附近击败一支阿拉伯军队，阵斩其统帅哈里斯·伊本·穆拉·阿卜迪，倭马亚王朝对这一地区的征伐此后又延续了数十年。印度教统治者一直坚守到15世纪，才被米尔瓦里氏族的布拉灰人夺取卡拉特，后者把它建成为苏拉卜镇上方的山寨。

布拉灰诸汗正是从这座堡垒出发，建立了俾路支斯坦历史上第一个统一国家。米尔·艾哈迈德汗一世于1666年宣布脱离莫卧儿独立，攻占奎达、马斯通和皮欣；到1749至1794年在位的米尔·纳西尔汗一世时，卡拉特汗国疆域西起克尔曼、东抵信德，北自赫尔曼德河、南达阿拉伯海。纳西尔汗在1758年的战争后摆脱了阿富汗的宗主权，自铸钱币，并于1784年把瓜达尔港赠予避难的阿曼王子苏丹·本·艾哈迈德。

en: The Banu Kilab were a great Bedouin tribe of the Banu Amir, itself part of the Hawazin confederation, whose original homeland was the western Najd. From the mid-sixth century they held the horse-breeding pastures of Dariyya, near later al-Yamama, and under their Ja'far clan led the Banu Amir in the raids and caravan wars of pre-Islamic Arabia, including the Fijar War against the Quraysh of Mecca. They accepted Islam around 630, but Kilabi tribesmen joined the Bedouin rising against the Abbasid caliph al-Wathiq until its suppression by Bugha al-Kabir in 845, when thousands submitted and many were deported. From the ninth and tenth centuries waves of Kilab migrated to northern Syria, where Salih ibn Mirdas founded the Mirdasid emirate of Aleppo in 1025; his dynasty held the city until 1080 and defeated the Byzantine emperor Romanos III at Azaz in 1030. Clans that stayed in Arabia kept the tribe's name alive around its old Najd grazing grounds.
zh: 巴努·基拉卜是贝都因大部落，属巴努·阿米尔，而后者又归入哈瓦津部落联盟；其祖居之地在内志西部。6世纪中叶起，他们占据后来耶马迈附近的迪里耶牧马草场，并在贾法尔氏族率领下引领巴努·阿米尔参与前伊斯兰时代阿拉伯的劫掠与商队战争，包括与麦加古莱什人之间的菲贾尔战争。他们约在630年皈依伊斯兰教，但基拉卜人后来参加了反抗阿拔斯哈里发瓦西格的贝都因起义，直到845年被布加·卡比尔镇压，数千人投降，许多人被流放。9至10世纪，一波波基拉卜人迁往叙利亚北部，萨利赫·伊本·米尔达斯于1025年在那里建立以阿勒颇为都的米尔达西埃米尔国；他的王朝统治该城至1080年，并于1030年在阿扎兹击败拜占庭皇帝罗曼努斯三世。留在阿拉伯的氏族则在旧日的内志牧场周围延续着部落的名号。

en: The County of Cleves was a Lower Rhine state on both sides of the Rhine, centred on the castle of Kleve and the towns of Wesel, Xanten and Duisburg. It grew from the medieval Hettergau after the emperor enfeoffed local nobles with the imperial forest around Kleve in the early eleventh century, with Count Dietrich I first documented in 1092. Cleves joined the war of the Limburg Succession in 1283 against the archbishop of Cologne, and in 1337 its count was Dietrich the Pious, whose long rule lasted until 1347. When his son Count John died without heirs in 1368, Cleves passed to his nephew Adolf III of the Mark; the union with the County of Mark became permanent in 1394, and in 1417 King Sigismund raised the ruler to a duke of the Holy Roman Empire. In 1521 the Cleves-Mark lands were combined with Jülich and Berg into the United Duchies of Jülich-Cleves-Berg, whose princess Anne of Cleves briefly became queen of England in 1540. The dynasty died out in 1609, and the War of the Jülich Succession ended with the 1614 Treaty of Xanten, which gave Cleves and Mark to the elector of Brandenburg; Dutch-occupied districts were recovered in 1666. French troops held it during the Seven Years' War and again after 1795, when the Rhine lands became the French Roer department while the remainder joined the Grand Duchy of Berg. In 1815 the Congress of Vienna returned Cleves to Prussia.
zh: 克莱沃伯国是莱茵河下游两岸的邦国，以克莱沃城堡及韦瑟尔、克桑滕、杜伊斯堡等城镇为中心。11世纪初，皇帝把克莱沃一带的帝国森林封给当地贵族，伯国便在中世纪的黑特高地区发展起来，伯爵狄奥多里克一世于1092年首次见于记载。1283年，克莱沃加入林堡继承战争，对抗科隆大主教；1337年在位的是“虔诚者”狄奥多里克伯爵，他的统治一直延续到1347年。1368年他的儿子约翰伯爵无嗣而终，克莱沃传给外甥马克的阿道夫三世；1394年它与马克伯国永久合并，1417年国王西吉斯蒙德将统治者晋升为神圣罗马帝国公爵。1521年，克莱沃-马克领地与于利希、贝格合并为于利希-克莱沃-贝格联合公国，公国公主克莱沃的安娜还曾于1540年短暂成为英格兰王后。1609年该王朝绝嗣，于利希继承战争之后，1614年的《克桑滕条约》把克莱沃和马克划归勃兰登堡选帝侯；被荷兰占据的地区于1666年收回。七年战争期间法军曾占领此地，1795年后莱茵河沿岸领土成为法国的鲁尔省，其余部分并入贝格大公国。1815年维也纳会议把克莱沃归还普鲁士。

en: Kalahandi is a hilly kingdom of western Orissa, watered by the Tel river and known across ancient sources from Panini to Ptolemy for its gemstones. In earlier centuries its forts at Asurgarh and Belkhandi made it the Mahakantara country, then the Chakrakota Mandala of the Chindaka Nagas; in the twelfth century the Eastern Gangas absorbed it as the Kamala Mandala, ruled for them by Naga chiefs from the stronghold of Kalahandinagara, later called Junagarh. When Ganga power weakened after the fourteenth century, the Naga rajas transferred their allegiance to the Suryavamsi Gajapatis and ruled independently from 1568, claiming eighteen hill forts called garhs and crowning each new raja with the Khond chiefs to legitimize his rule. In 1788 the Nagpur Marathas intervened and Raja Purussottama Deo had to accept recognition as a Maratha tributary, the condition in which the Naga kingdom entered the closing century of its long history.
zh: 卡拉汉迪是奥里萨西部的山间王国，地处泰勒河流域，从波你尼到托勒密的古代文献都称这里盛产宝石。凭借阿苏尔加尔、贝尔坎迪等要塞，此地先后是古称摩诃坎塔拉的要地和钦达卡·那加人的察羯罗科塔曼陀罗；12世纪东恒伽王朝将其并入，改称卡马拉曼陀罗，由那加首领以卡拉汉迪那加拉（后称朱纳加尔）要塞为治所代其统治。14世纪后东恒伽衰微，那加罗阇转投苏利耶万希·伽阇波蒂王朝，1568年起独立称王，号称统辖十八座名为加尔的山寨，并由孔德部落首领为新王行加冕礼以确认其正统。1788年那格浦尔的马拉塔人介入，罗阇普鲁绍塔马·德奥被迫接受其册封，卡拉汉迪沦为马拉塔人的纳贡邦，那加王国由此步入其漫长历史的最后阶段。

en: Karauli was the small Rajput kingdom of the Jadaun clan, who claimed the Yaduvanshi lunar lineage and traced their rule to Raja Vijay Pal, a chief from Mathura who built the fort of Bayana in 1040 and fought the Ghaznavid raiders. His successor Timan Pal, ruling from 1093 to 1159, spread Jadaun power across the Braj country as far as Alwar, Gwalior and Agra. In 1348 Raja Arjun Pal Dev founded a new capital at Kalyanpuri, which in time became known as Karauli. The kingdom's fortunes sank when Sultan Mahmud Khalji of Malwa stormed Karauli in 1454, forcing its rajas to retreat to the small fortress of Untagarh, and the ancestral capital was only recovered under the Mughal emperor Akbar by Raja Gopaldas. Karauli kept its Jadaun rulers through the Mughal centuries and on 9 November 1817 accepted a subsidiary alliance with the East India Company, becoming a princely state of British Rajasthan.
zh: 格劳利是阇豆那（Jadaun）氏族拉杰普特人的小王国，该族自称属于亚杜万什月亮世系，其统治可追溯到来自马图拉的首领毗阇耶·波罗：他于1040年修建巴亚纳堡，并抗击伽色尼劫掠者。后继者提曼·波罗（1093—1159年在位）把阇豆那势力扩展到整个布拉吉地区，远及阿尔瓦尔、瓜廖尔和阿格拉。1348年，拉贾阿尔琼·波罗·提婆在格延普里建立新都，此地后来演变为格劳利。1454年，马尔瓦苏丹马哈茂德·卡尔吉攻陷格劳利，国运由盛转衰，拉贾们退守温塔加尔小堡；直到莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴时代，拉贾戈帕尔达斯才收复故都。格劳利在整个莫卧儿时期都由阇豆那家族统治，并于1817年11月9日与英国东印度公司签订附属同盟，成为英属拉杰普塔纳的一个土邦。

en: The Principality of Klin was a small appanage of the Tver grand princes, centered on the fortress town of Klin on the Sestra River, northwest of Moscow. Klin first appears in the chronicles in 1317, and in 1319 it became the seat of a separate principality granted to Konstantin Mikhailovich, a younger son of Mikhail of Tver. His descendants, the junior branch of the Tver dynasty known as the Dorogobuzh princes, held Klin for the rest of the fourteenth century; its strong walls made it Tver's forward outpost in the long rivalry with Moscow. In 1409 the fortress was sacked during the raid of the Tatar emir Edigu, and the appanage was wound up in 1418. The town itself was annexed by Ivan III of Moscow in 1482, together with the other Tver lands.
zh: 克林公国是特维尔大公治下的小封邑，中心在莫斯科西北方谢斯特拉河畔的要塞城镇克林。克林在编年史中首次出现于1317年，1319年成为独立封邑的治所，封给特维尔王公米哈伊尔·雅罗斯拉维奇的幼子康斯坦丁·米哈伊洛维奇。他的后裔是特维尔王族的幼支，称多罗戈布日王公，在14世纪余下的时间里领有克林；坚固的城墙使它成为特维尔同莫斯科长期对抗中的前哨。1409年，鞑靼首领也迪该入侵时要塞遭洗劫，封邑于1418年被撤销。1482年，克林城与特维尔其他领地一起被莫斯科的伊凡三世吞并。

en: The Kalhor are one of the oldest Kurdish tribes, native to the borderlands between Kermanshah and Khanaqin, where they were long the most powerful tribal group. The late-sixteenth-century chronicle Sharafnama counts them as one of the four great branches of the Kurdish nation, alongside the Goran, Kurmanj and Lur, and their chiefs claimed descent from Gudarz, a hero of the Persian epic Shahnama. Their speech, Kalhori, is a dialect of Southern Kurdish. Branches of the tribe also held the Posht-e Kuh and the country around Hulwan, southwest of Kermanshah. The Kalhor kept a largely independent status until the rise of the Safavids in the early sixteenth century, when they submitted and served as frontier guards against the Ottomans, retaining their own local government until the reign of Shah Tahmasp I; some of their lands passed briefly under Ottoman rule before being restored. After the Safavid collapse they regained much of their autonomy, and under the Zand dynasty they were among the chief allies of Karim Khan, who placed Kermanshah in Kurdish hands and married a Kalhor bride. In 1830 they clashed with the Bakhtiari Lurs, while in the Qajar period gradual sedentarization eroded much of their old tribal cohesion.
zh: 卡尔霍尔人是最古老的库尔德部落之一，世居克尔曼沙阿与哈奈根之间的边境地带，长期是当地最强大的部落集团。16世纪末的编年史《荣誉之书》将其与戈兰、库尔曼吉和卢尔并列，视为库尔德民族的四大支系，其首领还自称是波斯史诗《列王纪》中古达尔兹的后裔。他们使用的卡尔霍尔方言属于南库尔德语，支系还分布在克尔曼沙阿西南的普什特库赫与赫勒万一带。在16世纪初萨非王朝兴起之前，该部落大体保持独立；此后它臣服于萨非，充当抵御奥斯曼人的边防力量，并保留自己的地方政权直至塔赫玛斯普一世在位时期，部分土地还曾短暂落入奥斯曼之手，后来被收回。萨非王朝崩溃后，卡尔霍尔人重获相当大的自治权；赞德王朝时期，他们是卡里木汗最主要的盟友之一，克尔曼沙阿被交到库尔德首领手中，卡里木汗还娶了一位卡尔霍尔新娘。1830年，他们与巴赫蒂亚里的卢尔人交战；卡扎尔王朝时期，定居化逐渐瓦解了其旧有的部落凝聚力。

en: Kalisusu, also spelled Kulisusu and recorded in older sources as Callasusung, was a small kingdom on the northern coast of Buton Island, in present-day North Buton Regency. Its people spoke Kulisusu, a Celebic language of the Austronesian family forming a dialect chain with the neighboring Koroni and Taloki tongues, and counted among the Buton peoples alongside the Wolio, Ciacia and Lasalimu. Within the Sultanate of Buton, Kalisusu held the special status of one of the Four Barata, the four guardian kingdoms, together with Muna, Tiworo and Kaledupa, whose task was to support and defend the sultanate as the outriggers stabilize a canoe. It embraced Islam early: by the 1530s, when the sixth ruler of Buton was converted by the Johor-trained scholar Sheikh Abdul Wahid, the people of Callasusung were already reported to be entirely Muslim, and the former royal hall at Wasalabose long remained a center of Buton ceremonial life.
zh: 卡利苏苏（又拼作库利苏苏，旧文献称卡拉苏松）是布敦岛北海岸的小王国，辖境在今北布敦县一带。居民使用库利苏苏语，这是南岛语系西里伯斯语族的一种语言，与邻近的科罗尼语和塔洛基语构成方言链；卡利苏苏人与沃利奥人、恰恰人、拉萨利穆人同属布敦族群。在布敦苏丹国内，卡利苏苏享有“四大巴拉塔”之一的特殊地位，与穆纳、蒂沃罗、卡莱杜帕并列，如同独木舟的舷外支架，承担辅佐和拱卫苏丹国的职责。它很早就皈依伊斯兰教：1530年代，当布敦第六代统治者在柔佛学者谢赫·阿卜杜勒·瓦希德引导下改宗时，记载中卡拉苏松的居民已全是穆斯林；其在瓦萨拉博塞的旧王家长厅，后来也长期是布敦礼仪活动的中心。

en: Kolathunadu, the kingdom of the Kolattiri rajas, covered North Malabar between the Chandragiri and Korappuzha rivers, with its ancient seat at Ezhimala near Kannur. It grew out of the older Ezhimala and Mushaka chiefdoms and emerged as one of the four great powers of the Malabar coast after the Chera and Pandya kingdoms faded in the twelfth century. Ezhimala was already a trading port known to Roman-era sailors and later to Marco Polo, Ibn Battuta and the Chinese traveller Wang Dayuan. The Kolattiris were the permanent northern rivals of the Zamorins of Kozhikode, while their realm gradually split into vassal chiefdoms such as Cannanore and Wynad. The poet Cherusseri Namboothiri composed the Krishna Gatha at the court of Raja Udayavarman in the fifteenth century. An invasion by the raja of Bednur in 1736 and 1737 broke much of the house's power, and its old title passed to the Chirakkal raja. Between 1766 and 1792 the armies of Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan of Mysore plundered North Malabar and drove the Kolathiri family into refuge in Travancore; after the British defeat of Mysore they returned as landlords under the East India Company.
zh: 科拉舒纳德是科拉蒂里罗阇们的王国，据有北马拉巴尔，地处钱德拉吉里河与科拉普扎河之间，古都埃日马拉坐落在坎努尔附近。它由更古老的埃日马拉和穆沙卡酋长国发展而来，12世纪哲罗与潘地亚王朝衰落后，成为马拉巴尔海岸四大强国之一。埃日马拉早就是罗马时代水手所知的贸易港，后来的马可·波罗、伊本·白图泰和中国旅行家汪大渊都曾提及。科拉蒂里家族一直是南方科泽科德扎莫林的宿敌，其国土则逐渐分裂为坎纳诺尔、瓦亚纳德等附庸小邦。15世纪，诗人切鲁谢里·南布迪里在罗阇乌达亚瓦尔曼的宫廷写成《克里希纳伽陀》。1736至1737年贝德努尔罗阇的入侵重创王室，古老的称号转入吉拉卡尔罗阇一系。1766至1792年间，迈索尔的海德尔·阿里与蒂普苏丹的军队劫掠北马拉巴尔，科拉蒂里家族逃入特拉凡哥尔避难；英国击败迈索尔后，他们作为英国东印度公司治下的地主重返故土。

en: Kullu was a Hindu hill kingdom in the Beas valley of the Punjab Hills, whose rajas held court at Naggar for some fourteen hundred years. Tradition credits Visudh Pal with founding the state and its Naggar seat, where Raja Sidh Singh built the stone castle in the late fifteenth century. In its early centuries Kullu was overshadowed by Chamba: its raja Dateshwar Pal was defeated by Chamba's Meru Varman, and the valley remained under Chamba's sway for six generations before Bushahr helped it regain freedom. The Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang, visiting in 634 or 635, found a fertile enclosed valley with about twenty Buddhist monasteries and fifteen Hindu temples. In the seventeenth century Raja Jagat Singh, ruling from 1637 to 1672, moved the capital to Sultanpur and in 1650 installed an image of Rama in the new Raghunath temple, which became the kingdom's chief shrine; in the same century Kullu also extended its control over the neighbouring valley of Lahul.
zh: 古卢是旁遮普山丘比亚斯河谷中的印度教山间王国，历代罗阇在纳加尔建都约一千四百年。传统认为维苏德·帕尔是国家和纳加尔都城的开创者，15世纪末罗阇西德·辛格又在那里修建了石砌堡垒。建国最初几百年，古卢一直受昌巴压制：罗阇达特什瓦尔·帕尔被昌巴的梅鲁·瓦尔曼击败，谷地此后六代人受制于昌巴，最后靠布沙尔相助才恢复自由。634年或635年，中国求法僧玄奘到此，看到的是一片群山环抱的肥沃谷地，约有二十座佛教寺院和十五座印度教神庙。17世纪，1637年至1672年在位的罗阇贾格特·辛格把都城迁往苏丹布尔，并于1650年在新建的拉古纳特神庙中供奉罗摩像，这座神庙后来成为王国的主神庙；同一世纪，古卢还把势力伸展到邻近的拉胡尔谷地。

en: Kolwa, also written Kolwah, is the inland valley country of eastern Makran, centered on the oases of Awaran, Jhao and Mashkay between the coastal plain and the Khuzdar highlands. It is arid Baloch tribal land, held from the twelfth century onward by the pastoral chiefs who dominated the interior of Baluchistan. The region's most famous son was Mir Chakar Rind, born at Ashal in Kolwah, who succeeded his father as Great Chief of the Baloch around 1487 and built the first unified Baloch confederation with its capital at Sibi, stretching from Kerman to the Sindh border; he died in the Punjab in 1565 after leading the Rind migration eastward.
zh: 戈尔瓦又拼作科尔瓦，是莫克兰东部的内陆河谷地带，以阿瓦兰、焦和马什凯等绿洲为中心，夹在沿海平原与胡兹达尔高地之间。这里是干旱的俾路支部落之地，12世纪以后便由主宰俾路支斯坦内陆的游牧首领们掌握。此地最著名的人物是出生在戈尔瓦阿沙尔的米尔·查卡尔·林德，他约在1487年继承父位成为俾路支人的大首领，建立了第一个统一的俾路支联盟，定都锡比，疆域西起克尔曼、东抵信德边境；后来他率领林德部东迁，于1565年在旁遮普去世。

en:
Kamata was the medieval kingdom that succeeded ancient Kamarupa in western Assam and northern Bengal. It began when Sandhya, ruler of Kamarupanagara, repelled an attack by the Delhi general Malik Ikhtiyaruddin Iuzbak in 1257 and moved his capital west to Kamatapur, styling himself Kamateswara; his realm covered the later districts of Kamrup, Goalpara, Jalpaiguri and Cooch Behar together with Rangpur and northern Mymensingh. In the fourteenth century the Narayan line of kings ruled there, Durlabh Narayan holding Kamatapur in 1337, and court poets such as Hema Saraswati and Harivara Vipra composed the earliest works of Early Assamese literature.

The invasion of Bengal's Sultan Sikandar Shah weakened King Indra Narayan and let the chief Arimatta usurp the throne, and in the mid-fifteenth century the Khen dynasty took over. Its last king Nilambar enlarged the kingdom until Alauddin Husain Shah of Bengal overran Kamatapur in 1498 after a long siege and annexed the country as far as Hajo, though the Baro-Bhuyan landlords soon expelled his garrison. In 1515 Biswa Singha defeated those chiefs and founded the Koch dynasty, ruling from the Karatoya to the Barnadi River; after Nara Narayan's death in 1587 the realm split into Koch Bihar and Koch Hajo, the eastern half being absorbed by the Ahoms during the seventeenth century.
zh:
卡玛塔是继承古迦摩缕波、据有阿萨姆西部与孟加拉北部的中世纪王国。其开国者桑迪亚本是迦摩缕波城的君主，1257年击退德里将领伊兹巴克的进攻后，把都城西迁至迦摩多城，自称迦摩多湿婆罗；疆域包括后来的迦摩缕波、戈瓦尔巴拉、杰尔拜古里、库奇比哈尔以及朗格布尔和迈门辛北部。14世纪，纳拉扬世系的诸王统治此地，1337年杜尔拉布纳拉扬坐镇迦摩多城；赫马·萨拉斯瓦蒂、哈里瓦拉·维普拉等宫廷诗人写下了最早的早期阿萨姆语文学作品。

孟加拉苏丹锡坎达尔沙的入侵削弱了国王因陀罗纳拉扬，首领阿里马塔趁机篡位；15世纪中叶肯王朝取而代之。末代国王尼兰巴尔一度扩张疆土，但孟加拉的阿拉乌丁·侯赛因沙经长期围攻，于1498年攻陷迦摩多城，把疆界推进到哈焦；不过巴罗-布扬地主很快驱逐了苏丹的驻军。1515年比斯瓦·辛格击败这些首领，建立科赫王朝，疆域西起戈罗多亚河、东至巴尔纳迪河。1587年纳拉·纳拉扬死后，王国分裂为科赫比哈尔和科赫哈焦，东半部在17世纪被阿洪姆吞并。

en: Kumalarang, also called Sibuguey, was a Subanon kingdom on the Zamboanga peninsula of Mindanao, recorded in the Ming court annals as early as the fifteenth century. In 1417 the Yongle Emperor sent the eunuch Zhang Qian with brocades and silks to its ruler, Kanlai Ipentun, who travelled to China in 1420 and was received with honours comparable to those given to the king of Sulu; he petitioned to enter the Ming tributary system. On his journey home he fell ill and died in Fujian in May 1421, where the Ming authorities buried him with the posthumous title Kangjing, and his son Lapi succeeded and sent another embassy in 1424. After Sharif Kabungsuwan founded the Sultanate of Maguindanao in 1515, Kumalarang was reduced to a vassal keeping wide local autonomy, and Islam gradually spread until the kingdom itself became a sultanate.
zh: 古麻剌朗又称锡布盖，是棉兰老岛三宝颜半岛上的苏巴农人王国，早在15世纪就见于明朝宫廷的实录。1417年，永乐帝派宦官张谦携带锦绮纱罗出使其王干剌义亦奔敦；干剌义亦奔敦于1420年亲赴中国，受到与苏禄国王同等规格的礼遇，并请求纳入明朝朝贡体系。归国途中他于1421年5月在福建病逝，明朝地方官为其治丧，赐谥号康靖；其子剌苾继位，并于1424年再遣使臣来华。1515年谢里夫·卡本苏万建立马京达瑙苏丹国后，古麻剌朗沦为其附庸，但保留了很大的自治权；伊斯兰教逐渐传播，这个王国最终也转变为苏丹国。

en: Cammin was the church principality of Pomerania, founded as a diocese by a bull of Pope Innocent II in 1140, after the missions of Otto of Bamberg had converted the region between 1124 and 1128. The see moved from Wolin to Grobe Abbey on Usedom and then in 1175 to Cammin on the Oder lagoon, where the cathedral chapter of St John the Baptist was established; the pope made it an exempt diocese directly under Rome. In 1248 the bishops exchanged the Stargard lands with the Griffin dukes for Kolberg, and their secular territory grew to take in Kolberg, Köslin and Bublitz, administered from Köslin; Bishop Hermann von Gleichen granted Köslin its town rights in 1266. The Hochstift remained a subfief of the Duchy of Pomerania, winning imperial immediacy only briefly in 1345, the year after John I of Saxe-Lauenburg of the Ascanian house became bishop. When Pomerania adopted Lutheranism in 1534 the old diocese withered: the last pre-Reformation bishop died in 1544, Griffin dukes held the secular principality as titular bishops from 1556, and in 1650 the last incumbent resigned and Cammin was secularised into Brandenburg-Prussia.
zh: 卡明是波美拉尼亚的教会诸侯领地。班贝格的奥托在1124年至1128年间传教、使该地区皈依基督教之后，教皇英诺森二世于1140年颁布诏书设立教区。主教座堂先设在沃林，后迁至乌泽多姆岛的格罗贝修道院，1175年又迁到奥得河潟湖畔的卡明，并在此建立圣约翰洗者主教座堂圣职团；教皇将其定为直属罗马的豁免教区。1248年，主教们用施塔加德领地与格里芬公爵交换科沃布热格，世俗领地逐渐扩大到科沃布热格、科沙林和博博利采，由科沙林统一管理；赫尔曼·冯·格莱兴主教于1266年授予科沙林城市权。主教采邑始终是波美拉尼亚公国的次级封邑，仅在1345年短暂获得帝国直辖地位；此前一年，阿斯坎尼家族的萨克森-劳恩堡的约翰一世就任主教。1534年波美拉尼亚定路德宗为国教后，旧教区走向衰亡：末位宗教改革前的主教于1544年去世，格里芬公爵自1556年起以领衔主教身份领有这块世俗领地，1650年末位在职主教辞职，卡明被世俗化并入勃兰登堡-普鲁士。

en: The Kingdom of Kumaon, called Kurmanchal in its older records, was a Himalayan Hindu state between the Tons and Karnali rivers. The Katyuri rajas united its valleys in the seventh century from their capital at Baijnath and built the stone temples of Jageshwar and Katarmal, but their collapse in the eleventh century left the hills fragmented. Out of the ruins rose the Chand dynasty: its founder Som Chand, a Rajput immigrant from Jhusi near Kannauj, established himself at Champawat, perhaps in the 1020s, and Chand chiefs appear as feudatories in the Baleshwar temple inscription of 1223. In 1337 the Chand raja held only the Champawat hills, and the dynasty did not reunite all Kumaon until the mid-fifteenth century. Raja Kalyan Chand moved the capital to Almora in 1563. Rudra Chand visited Akbar at Lahore in 1587 and brought Kumaon into the Mughal tribute system, while Baz Bahadur Chand, ruling from 1638, joined Shah Jahan's war on Garhwal in 1655 and carried the frontier to the Karnali. The Rohillas sacked Almora for seven months in 1744 and were bought off with three lakh rupees, and in 1790 the Gorkhas of Nepal overran the country and expelled the last raja Mahendra Chand. After twenty-four years of Gorkha rule, the British took Almora in 1815 and the Treaty of Sugauli in 1816 added Kumaon to British India.
zh: 库马翁王国在古文献中称库尔马查尔，是地处通斯河与格尔纳利河之间的喜马拉雅印度教政权。7世纪，卡蒂乌里王公以拜吉纳特为都统一诸河谷，修建了贾格什瓦尔和卡塔马尔的石庙；该王朝11世纪崩溃后，山地陷入分裂。昌德王朝在废墟中崛起：始祖索姆·昌德是来自卡瑙季附近朱西的拉杰普特移民，约11世纪20年代在恰姆帕瓦蒂立足，1223年的巴莱什瓦尔神庙铭文已把昌德首领列为封臣。1337年，昌德王公仅保有恰姆帕瓦蒂一带山地，直到15世纪中叶才重新统一整个库马翁。1563年，卡尔扬·昌德把都城迁往阿尔莫拉。鲁德拉·昌德于1587年在拉合尔觐见阿克巴，使库马翁进入莫卧儿朝贡体系；1638年即位的巴兹·巴哈杜尔·昌德于1655年参与沙贾汗对加瓦尔的战争，把边界推进到格尔纳利河。1744年罗希拉人攻陷阿尔莫拉并占据七个月，在收受三十万卢比后撤军；1790年尼泊尔廓尔喀人征服该国，末代王公马亨德拉·昌德出逃。廓尔喀统治二十四年后，英军于1815年攻占阿尔莫拉，1816年的《苏高利条约》把库马翁并入英属印度。

en: Kempten in the Allgäu occupies one of the oldest town sites in Germany: the Greek geographer Strabo mentioned a Celtic settlement there in 50 BC, and the Romans built Cambodunum, probably the first capital of the province of Raetia. Around 752 the Benedictine Abbey of Kempten was founded, the first monastery in the Allgäu, and with the patronage of Charlemagne's queen Hildegard it became one of the richest churches in the Carolingian Empire. Saint Ulrich of Augsburg rebuilt it in 941 after the Magyar raids; King Henry IV confirmed its imperial immediacy in 1062, and in 1213 Emperor Frederick II gave its abbots comital rights and the title of duke. In 1289, however, King Rudolf I made the riverside town a Free Imperial City, creating a rival estate enclaved within the abbey's lands. The city turned Protestant in 1527 while the abbey joined the Catholic League, and Swedish troops burned the monastery in 1632; the present Saint Lorenz Basilica rose after 1651. The abbey held the last witch trial of the Holy Roman Empire in 1775 and was secularized to Bavaria in 1803, the two Kemptens being united in 1819.
zh: 阿尔高的肯普滕是德国最古老的城址之一：希腊地理学家斯特拉波早在公元前50年就提到过当地的凯尔特聚落，罗马人后来在此建起坎博杜努姆，它可能是雷蒂亚行省的第一个省会。约752年，本笃会的肯普滕修道院建立，这是阿尔高地区第一座修道院，在查理曼王后希尔德加德的庇佑下成为加洛林帝国最富有的教会之一。马扎尔人劫掠后，奥格斯堡的圣乌尔里希于941年将其重建；1062年国王亨利四世确认其帝国直辖地位，1213年皇帝腓特烈二世又授予修道院长伯爵权利和公爵头衔。但1289年国王鲁道夫一世把河畔城区立为帝国自由城市，在修道院领地内形成一个分庭抗礼的实体。城市于1527年改宗新教，修道院则加入天主教联盟；1632年瑞典军队焚毁修道院，今天的圣洛伦茨大教堂是1651年后重建的。1775年修道院主持了神圣罗马帝国最后一次女巫审判，1803年它被世俗化并划归巴伐利亚，两个肯普滕最终于1819年合二为一。

en: The Kana, better known to the Spanish chroniclers as the Canas, were an Aymara people who took shape after the collapse of Tiwanaku around 1000, living outside the Collao plateau proper in the cold grasslands north of the Vilcanota knot, around the headwaters of the Vilcanota River in what is now the Puno and Cusco regions of Peru; their chief town of Ayaviri became the main Inca centre of this district. Together with their neighbours the Canchis, the Canas dealt freely with the rising Incas: around 1350 Inca Roca hired Canas and Canchis war bands against the Chankas, and they later served as auxiliary troops in the Andahuaylas campaign in exchange for plunder. Earlier they had been defeated by the Lupaca curaca Curi, who seized their lands. When Viracocha Inca marched south against the Collao kingdoms early in the fifteenth century, the Canas submitted without fighting; an Inca temple was built at Ayaviri and the Canas undertook to supply the Inca armies as they passed, after which their lands became part of the Collasuyo quarter of the empire.
zh: 卡纳人在西班牙编年史中更常见的名字是卡纳斯人，是约1000年蒂亚瓦纳科崩溃后形成的一支艾马拉人，不住在科利亚奥高原本体，而是生活在维尔卡诺塔山结以北、维尔卡诺塔河源头一带的寒冷草原，即今秘鲁普诺和库斯科大区境内；他们的治所阿亚维里后来成为印卡时代这一地区的主要中心。卡纳人与邻邦坎奇人都与崛起的印卡人自由往来：约1350年印卡·罗卡曾雇用卡纳和坎奇的战团攻打昌卡人，后来他们又作为辅助部队参加安达瓦伊拉斯之战，以换取战利品。更早时他们被卢皮哈基首领库里击败，土地遭夺占。15世纪初维拉科查·印卡南征科利亚奥诸王国时，卡纳人不战而降；印卡人在阿亚维里修建神庙，卡纳人则承担起为过境印卡军队提供补给的义务，其地后来成为帝国科利亚苏尤的一部分。

en: Kong began as a market town in the grasslands of what is now north-eastern Ivory Coast, a region first farmed by Gur-speaking Senufo and Tyefo villagers. From the 1300s Mandé merchants known as the Dyula moved south from the Mali Empire and founded a string of trading cities including Begho, Bondoukou, Bouna and Kong; the Muslim Dyula settled among animist farming populations and grew rich carrying gold and kola nuts between the Niger bend and the European posts on the Gold Coast. Kong remained a merchant republic of competing war houses and clerical families until the early 1700s, when the Dyula leader Seku Watara united the town's factions and built the Kong, or Wattara, Empire from 1710 onward. His war houses seized the trade routes of the Black Volta, reached Sya in 1737 and campaigned as far as the Niger at Djenné in 1739, while Kong itself became a famed centre of Islamic learning. After Seku's death around 1745 the empire loosened into nearly autonomous Watara fiefs, whose wealth and mosques still drew caravans from across the western Sudan.
zh: 孔格起初是今科特迪瓦东北部草原上的一座商镇，当地最早的居民是讲古尔语的塞努福和提埃福农人。从14世纪起，被称为迪尤拉人的曼德商人从马里帝国南迁，陆续建立了贝戈、邦杜库、布纳和孔格等一串商业城市；穆斯林迪尤拉人定居在信奉万物有灵的农民之中，靠在尼日尔河湾与黄金海岸的欧洲商站之间贩运黄金和柯拉果致富。孔格长期是由彼此竞争的武士家族和宗教世家组成的商人城邦，直到18世纪初，迪尤拉首领谢库·瓦塔拉统一城内各派，于1710年起建立孔格帝国（又称瓦塔拉帝国）。他的武士家族夺取黑沃尔特河商路，1737年兵临西亚，1739年远征至尼日尔河畔的杰内，孔格本身也成为著名的伊斯兰学术中心。1745年前后谢库去世后，帝国松散化为近乎自治的瓦塔拉封地，但这些封地的财富和清真寺仍吸引着西苏丹各地的驼队。

en: The Knights Hospitaller, formally the Order of the Hospital of Saint John of Jerusalem, grew from a hospital for Christian pilgrims founded in Jerusalem by Amalfi merchants and led by the Blessed Gerard. Pope Paschal II recognized it as an order in 1113, and in the 1120s and 1130s it took on military vows to defend the crusader states, fighting until the fall of Acre in 1291. The knights then sheltered in Cyprus, and under Grand Master Foulques de Villaret their fleet conquered the Byzantine island of Rhodes, whose capital surrendered in August 1310; neighbouring islands such as Kos and the Anatolian port of Halicarnassus joined the order's domain. In 1337 the Grand Master was Hélion de Villeneuve, elected in 1319, and the knights policed the Aegean from their Rhodes stronghold, defeating Emperor Andronikos III and his Turkish allies at sea in 1334. They held Smyrna from 1374 until Timur took it in 1402, and repelled assaults on Rhodes by the Mamluks in 1444 and by Mehmed the Conqueror in 1480. In 1522 Suleiman the Magnificent besieged Rhodes for six months until Grand Master Philippe Villiers de L'Isle-Adam surrendered and withdrew with his knights. In 1530 Emperor Charles V gave them Malta, where they survived the Great Siege of 1565 and built Valletta, until Napoleon seized the island in 1798 and dispersed the order.
zh: 医院骑士团全称为耶路撒冷圣约翰医院骑士团，前身是阿马尔菲商人在耶路撒冷创办、由真福杰拉尔德主持的基督教朝圣者医院。1113年教皇帕斯加尔二世正式承认其修会地位，12世纪20至30年代它又许下军事誓愿，担负起保卫十字军国家的职责，一直作战到1291年阿卡陷落。骑士们随后避居塞浦路斯，在大团长富尔克·德·维拉雷率领下出兵攻占拜占庭的罗得岛，岛上首府于1310年8月投降，科斯等邻近岛屿和安纳托利亚港口哈利卡纳苏斯也并入骑士团领地。1337年在任的是1319年当选的大团长埃利翁·德·维尔纳夫，骑士们以罗得岛要塞为基地巡守爱琴海，1334年在海上击败安德洛尼卡三世皇帝及其突厥盟军。他们自1374年据守士麦那，直到1402年被帖木儿攻占；又先后于1444年击退马穆鲁克人、1480年击退征服者穆罕默德二世对罗得岛的进攻。1522年，苏莱曼大帝围攻罗得岛达六个月，大团长菲利普·维利耶·德·利勒-亚当最终投降并率部撤离。1530年皇帝查理五世把马耳他赐给骑士团，他们在那里顶住了1565年的马耳他大围攻并兴建瓦莱塔城，直到1798年拿破仑夺取马耳他，骑士团被迫解散流散。

en: Kanker was a small forest kingdom in the hills north of Bastar, on the upper reaches of the Mahanadi, whose people were mostly Gonds speaking Chhattisgarhi, Halbi and Gondi. It took shape in the fifteenth century, when the old Bastar kingdom was divided into a Bastar branch and a Kanker branch. The rajas of Kanker traced their Chandra dynasty to Veer Kanhar Dev, a prince said to have come from Jagannath Puri and to have ruled at Sihawa until 1404. Under the Haihaiyavansi kings of Chhattisgarh the Kanker raja held the Dhamtari country as a tributary. When the Haihaiyavansi kingdom fell to the Marathas in 1740 Kanker passed under Maratha supremacy, owing a military contingent of five hundred men, and in 1809 it was annexed outright by the Bhonsles of Nagpur. The deposed raja Bhup Deo was restored by the British resident in 1818 against a small tribute, which was remitted in 1823.
zh: 甘盖尔是巴斯塔尔以北山区的森林小邦，地处默哈讷迪河上游，居民多为贡德人，讲切蒂斯格尔语、哈尔比语和贡德语。它形成于15世纪，当时旧巴斯塔尔王国分裂为巴斯塔尔和甘盖尔两支。甘盖尔的罗阇把自己的月族王朝追溯到毗罗·坎哈尔·提婆：相传这位王子来自贾格纳特普里，曾在锡哈瓦统治至1404年。在切蒂斯格尔的海诃耶瓦姆西王朝治下，甘盖尔罗阇领有达姆塔里地区，向其称臣纳贡。1740年海诃耶瓦姆西王国亡于马拉塔人后，甘盖尔转入马拉塔宗主权之下，负有提供五百人军队的义务；1809年它被那格浦尔的邦斯勒家族直接吞并。被废的罗阇布普·提婆于1818年经英国驻扎官协助复位，只需缴纳少量贡赋，这笔贡赋又于1823年免除。

en: Konawe was a Tolaki kingdom on the southeast peninsula of Sulawesi, formed when the small Tolaki chiefdoms of the region, among them Padangguni, Besulutu and Wawolesea, merged into a single confederation. Its founder is named as Wekoila, who ruled first from Olo-oloho on the Konoweha river before the court moved to Unaaha, and its kings bore the title Mokole. Konawe reached its height under Mokole Tebawo, whose power covered the Konawe districts and the port of Kendari; he organized the realm into four provinces under the system called Siwole Mbatohu and a seven-member cabinet, the Pitu Dula Batu, with ministers for foreign affairs, justice, agriculture and the security of palace, land and sea. The people farmed rice, grew cempedak fruit, herded buffalo and fished, and all land was held by the crown and apportioned through the nobility. Originally animist, Konawe first encountered Islam in the 1500s through envoys of the Sultanate of Buton and Muslim traders from Bone, Gowa and Ternate; the ruler Lakidende later converted, and under Lakidende II Islam became the kingdom's official religion.
zh: 哥那威是苏拉威西东南半岛上的托拉基人王国，由当地帕丹古尼、贝苏鲁图、瓦沃勒塞亚等托拉基小邦合并为一个联盟而来。传说建国者为韦科伊拉，最初驻跸于科诺韦哈河畔的奥洛奥洛霍，后来王都迁至乌纳阿哈，君主称“莫科莱”（Mokole）。王国在莫科莱·特巴沃治下达到鼎盛，势力覆盖哥那威诸地区和肯达里港；他把全国划分为四个行省，称西沃莱·姆巴托胡，并设立七人内阁，称皮图·杜拉·巴图，分别掌管外交、司法、农业以及宫廷、陆地和海上的防务。居民种稻、种植菠萝蜜、养水牛和捕鱼，全部土地归国王所有，由贵族负责分配。哥那威原本信奉泛灵论，1500年代（16世纪）通过布敦苏丹国的使者以及来自波尼、戈瓦、特尔纳特的穆斯林商人初次接触伊斯兰教；后来君主拉基登德皈依，到拉基登德二世时，伊斯兰教成为王国的官方宗教。

en: Konstanz stands on the western shore of Lake Constance where the Rhine leaves the lake, on the site of the late Roman fortress of Constantia. A bishopric was established there around 585, and for more than a thousand years the city was the seat of the Diocese of Konstanz, one of the largest in the Holy Roman Empire. Its Rhine bridge and linen trade brought wealth, and in 1192 it became a Free Imperial City, answerable only to the emperor. The Council of Constance met there from 1414 to 1418: it ended the Western Schism by electing Pope Martin V and condemned the reformer Jan Hus, who was burned at the stake in 1415. After the Swiss Confederacy conquered its Thurgau hinterland in 1460, the city sought in vain to join the Confederacy and instead joined the Swabian League. It embraced the Protestant Reformation in the 1520s, but in 1548 Emperor Charles V imposed the imperial ban and handed Konstanz to Habsburg Austria, which re-Catholicised the town. In 1806 it passed to the Grand Duchy of Baden, and the old bishopric was dissolved in 1821.
zh: 康斯坦茨位于博登湖西岸、莱茵河流出湖泊之处，坐落在古罗马要塞孔斯坦提亚的旧址上。约585年这里设立主教区，此后一千多年间，康斯坦茨一直是神圣罗马帝国最大主教区之一的驻地。莱茵河上的桥梁与亚麻贸易为城市带来财富，1192年它成为帝国自由城市，只对皇帝负责。1414至1418年，康斯坦茨宗教会议在此召开：会议选出教宗玛尔定五世，结束了西方教会大分裂，并判处改革者扬·胡斯火刑，他于1415年被烧死在火刑柱上。1460年瑞士同盟征服其图尔高腹地后，康斯坦茨申请加入瑞士同盟未果，转而加入施瓦本同盟。16世纪20年代它皈依新教，但1548年皇帝查理五世对其颁布帝国禁令，将它交给哈布斯堡奥地利，天主教随之恢复。1806年康斯坦茨并入巴登大公国，古老的主教区于1821年被撤销。

en: Cologne was the Electorate of Cologne, the temporal principality of the Archbishop of Cologne, one of the three ecclesiastical prince-electors of the Holy Roman Empire and arch-chancellor of Italy. The see dated to Roman Colonia Agrippina, and in 953 Emperor Otto I made his brother Archbishop Bruno a duke, endowing the church with secular lands along the Lower Rhine and, later, the Duchy of Westphalia. Defeat at the Battle of Worringen in 1288 left the city of Cologne effectively self-governing, and the archbishops kept their court at Bonn; in 1475 the city became a Free Imperial City. In 1337 the elector was Walram of Jülich, a younger son of Count Gerhard V of Jülich, who had won the see in 1332 with his brother's gold and who warred against the Counts of the Mark before founding Cologne Charterhouse in 1334. In 1582 Archbishop Gebhard Truchsess von Waldburg converted to Calvinism and tried to secularize the electorate, triggering the Cologne War; his Bavarian rival Ernst won, and from 1583 to 1761 the see was a Wittelsbach secundogeniture at the heart of the Counter-Reformation. French troops occupied Cologne and Bonn in 1794, the left-bank lands were annexed in 1801, and the remaining territories were secularized in 1803.
zh: 科隆即科隆选侯国，是科隆大主教的世俗领地，也是神圣罗马帝国三个教会选帝侯之一，大主教并兼任意大利首相。主教座可追溯到罗马时代的科隆尼亚·阿格里皮娜；953年，奥托一世皇帝封其兄、大主教布鲁诺为公爵，把莱茵河下游的世俗领地，以及后来的威斯特伐利亚公国授予教会。1288年沃林根战役战败后，科隆城取得近乎自治的地位，大主教转而在波恩宫廷理政；1475年科隆成为帝国自由城市。1337年在任的选侯是于利希的瓦尔拉姆，他是于利希伯爵格哈德五世的幼子，1332年靠兄长花钱运作登上大主教之位，长期与马克伯爵们交战，并于1334年创立科隆加尔都西会修道院。1582年，大主教格布哈德·特鲁赫泽斯·冯·瓦尔德堡改宗加尔文派，企图把选侯国世俗化，引发科隆战争；巴伐利亚竞争者恩斯特最终获胜，1583年至1761年间，该主教座成为维特尔斯巴赫家族的次子世袭领地，处于反宗教改革的核心。1794年法军占领科隆和波恩，莱茵河左岸领土于1801年被吞并，残余领地则在1803年被世俗化。

en: The Kingdom of Goryeo was founded in 918 by the general Wang Kŏn, who ended the division of the Later Three Kingdoms and made Kaesong his capital. Its kings repelled the Khitan Liao invasions of 993–1020 and held off the Jurchen, while Buddhism became the state religion and Goryeo celadon and the Tripitaka Koreana, some 81,000 woodblocks carved from 1236, marked its artistic peak. From 1170 military strongmen, above all the Ch'oe family, held power, and the court took refuge on Ganghwa Island during the Mongol campaigns of 1231–1259, after which Goryeo became a marriage-allied vassal of the Yuan for roughly eighty years, its kings taking Mongol princesses as queens. In 1337 the throne belonged to King Chungsuk. As the Yuan crumbled, King Gongmin purged the pro-Mongol faction in 1356, retook the northern lands, and repelled Red Turban invasions in 1359 and 1361; in the 1380s Goryeo fleets using Ch'oe Musŏn's gunpowder weapons crushed Japanese pirate fleets. In 1388 General Yi Sŏnggye turned back an ordered campaign against the Ming, seized power, and in 1392 founded the Joseon dynasty, ending Goryeo.
zh: 高丽王国由将领王建建于918年，他结束了后三国的分裂，定都开城。高丽击退了993—1020年契丹辽朝的入侵，抵御了女真的进攻；佛教被奉为国教，高丽青瓷与1236年起雕刻的约八万一千块《高丽大藏经》经版代表了其艺术巅峰。1170年起武臣专权，其中以崔氏为最，1231—1259年蒙古屡次入侵时朝廷避居江华岛，此后高丽成为元朝的联姻附庸约八十年，历代国王多娶蒙古公主为后。1337年在位的是忠肃王。元朝衰落后，恭愍王于1356年肃清亲蒙古派、收复北方失地，并在1359年和1361年击退红巾军入侵；14世纪80年代，高丽水师凭借崔茂宣研制的火药武器大破倭寇船队。1388年，将领李成桂在奉命出征明朝途中回师发动政变，于1392年建立朝鲜王朝，高丽灭亡。

en: Kostroma, where the Kostroma River joins the Volga, was officially founded in 1152 by Yury Dolgoruky and, like other towns of the northeast, was sacked by the Mongols in 1238. It then became a small appanage principality: in 1246 Prince Vasily Yaroslavich, the youngest son of Yaroslav II and a brother of Alexander Nevsky, received Kostroma, and when he became grand prince of Vladimir in 1272 he kept his seat there rather than move to Vladimir. His descendants ruled for another half century until Ivan I Kalita of Moscow bought the town, so that in 1337 Kostroma was already a Muscovite possession. Its remote northern location made it a safe retreat for Moscow's grand princes during the sieges of Moscow in 1382, 1408 and 1433, although Novgorod river pirates, the ushkuiniks, sacked it in 1375. In the Time of Troubles the Ipatiev Monastery here sheltered Mikhail Romanov, and in 1612 a Muscovite embassy came to offer him the Russian crown, beginning the Romanov dynasty.
zh: 科斯特罗马位于科斯特罗马河汇入伏尔加河之处，相传1152年由尤里·多尔戈鲁基建立，与东北罗斯其他城镇一样，在1238年遭蒙古人洗劫。此后它成为一个小封邑公国：1246年雅罗斯拉夫二世的幼子、亚历山大·涅夫斯基之弟瓦西里·雅罗斯拉维奇受封科斯特罗马，1272年他成为弗拉基米尔大公后仍留驻此城而不迁往弗拉基米尔。他的后裔又统治了半个世纪，直到莫斯科的伊凡一世·卡利塔买下该城，因此1337年科斯特罗马已是莫斯科的领地。偏远的北方位置使它在1382、1408和1433年莫斯科被围时成为莫斯科大公们安全的退路，不过诺夫哥罗德的河盗乌什库伊尼克人曾在1375年洗劫此城。动荡时期，伊帕季耶夫修道院在此庇护了米哈伊尔·罗曼诺夫，1612年莫斯科使团正是来到这里向他献上俄罗斯皇位，罗曼诺夫王朝由此开端。

en: The Kowoj were a Maya polity of the Petén lakes in northern Guatemala, active from the mid-thirteenth century to the end of the seventeenth. They held that their ancestors had migrated from Mayapán in Yucatán after that city's collapse around 1441, and their towns were distinguished by a C-shaped plaza with a particular temple assemblage that proclaimed this prestigious connection. Their main cities were Zacpetén on Lake Salpetén, Ixlu between Lakes Petén Itzá and Salpetén, and Topoxte on Lake Yaxhá, which had been abandoned before the Spanish arrived. In Petén they competed and warred with neighbouring polities, above all the Itzá. Hernán Cortés crossed the region in 1525, but the lake kingdoms long held out. In 1697 Martín de Ursúa y Arizmendi captured the Itzá island capital Nojpetén and overran the Kowoj towns, making them among the last independent Maya polities to fall to the Spanish Empire.
zh: 科沃伊是危地马拉北部佩滕湖区的玛雅政权，活跃于13世纪中叶至17世纪末。他们自称祖先在约1441年尤卡坦的玛雅潘城陷落后从那里迁来，其城镇以C形广场和独特的神庙组合为标志，借此宣示与玛雅潘的显赫渊源。主要城市包括萨尔佩滕湖畔的萨克佩滕、佩滕伊察湖与萨尔佩滕湖之间的伊什卢，以及亚克萨湖畔的托波斯特，后者在西班牙人到来之前已遭废弃。在佩滕，他们与邻邦尤其是伊察人长期争战。1525年埃尔南·科尔特斯曾穿越这一地区，但湖区诸王国长期坚守。1697年，马丁·德·乌尔苏亚·伊·阿里斯门迪攻陷伊察人的岛都诺赫佩滕，并横扫科沃伊诸城，使他们成为最后并入西班牙帝国的独立玛雅政权之一。

en: Koppula designates the country of the Koppula Velama, a Telugu-speaking Hindu community of farmers and warriors concentrated in the Uttarandhra coast of northern Andhra, with their seat at the old town of Pithapuram. Earlier known as Pishtapura, the town was the first capital of the Eastern Chalukyas before they moved their court to Vengi.
zh: 科普拉指科普拉·韦拉马人的邦国，这是一个操泰卢固语的印度教农耕与武士社群，聚居于安得拉北部沿海的乌塔拉安德拉地区，以古城皮塔普拉姆为治所。该城古称皮什塔普拉，曾是东遮娄其王朝迁都文吉之前的首个都城。

en: The Karasids were a Turkoman dynasty that held ancient Mysia in northwestern Anatolia, with its centre at Balıkesir. Its earliest known rulers, Kalam Shah and his son Karasi Bey, took over the region in the late thirteenth century while nominally serving the Seljuk sultan Mesud II, and the family later claimed legendary descent from the Danishmendids. After Karasi Bey died around 1328 the beylik split between Demir Khan at Balıkesir and Yakhshi Khan, the ruler in 1337, around Pergamon; Demir built a fleet in the Sea of Marmara that raided Cyzicus and the Thracian coast and signed a truce with Emperor Andronikos III in 1328, and he received Ibn Battuta in 1333. A later prince, Suleiman Bey, married a Byzantine noblewoman and intervened in the Byzantine civil wars alongside John Vatatzes. The dynasty's end came through the Ottomans: after a succession quarrel the prince Dursun fled to Sultan Orhan and offered him the Karasid towns, and Ottoman troops occupied Balıkesir, Bergama and Edremit sometime between 1335 and 1349, making the Karasid realm one of the first beyliks absorbed by the Ottomans. Its seasoned sailors and shipyards passed into Ottoman service and supported their first crossings into the Balkans.
zh: 卡拉斯（卡拉斯奥卢）是突厥蛮王朝，据有安纳托利亚西北部的古密细亚地区，以巴勒克埃西尔为中心。已知最早的统治者卡拉姆沙阿及其子卡拉斯贝伊于13世纪末趁效力罗姆苏丹梅苏德二世之机取得这一地区，家族后来还自称传说中达尼什曼德王朝的后裔。约1328年卡拉斯贝伊死后，贝伊国一分为二：德米尔汗据巴勒克埃西尔，1337年在位的亚赫希汗据贝尔加马一带。德米尔在马尔马拉海建立舰队，劫掠库齐库斯和色雷斯海岸，并于1328年与拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡三世签订和约，1333年还接待了伊本·白图泰。后来的王公苏莱曼贝伊迎娶拜占庭贵族之女，曾与约翰·瓦塔采斯一起介入拜占庭内战。该王朝最终亡于奥斯曼：继承纠纷中，王子杜尔松投奔苏丹奥尔汗并献上卡拉斯诸城，奥斯曼军队遂于1335至1349年间占领巴勒克埃西尔、贝尔加马和埃德雷米特，卡拉斯成为最早被奥斯曼吞并的贝伊国之一。其经验丰富的水手和船厂转入奥斯曼麾下，为奥斯曼人首次渡海进军巴尔干提供了助力。

en: Karategin, also spelled Karotegin and often called Garm after its chief town, was a highland principality in the valley of the Vakhsh River, in what is now eastern Tajikistan. Ringed by Ferghana to the east, Darvaz to the south and Hissar to the west, it was ruled for many centuries by native princes who claimed descent from Alexander the Great. Its people wove rough woolen cloth and mohair, mined gold in the hills, worked salt-pits and made firearms. In the sixteenth century some twelve thousand Kyrgyz families from the Karakorum and Kerulen regions migrated into the valley and formed a Kyrgyz-led tribal confederation. In 1636 Nadr Muhammad Khan of Bukhara sent Haji Atalik, governor of Ferghana, to seize Karategin; the valley then became part of the Bukhara Khanate, and the incoming Kyrgyz in time accepted Islam.
zh: 卡拉捷金又译喀尔提锦，常因首府加尔姆而被称为加尔姆地区，是瓦赫什河谷中的一个山地公国，位于今天塔吉克斯坦东部。它东经费尔干纳、南接达尔瓦兹、西连希萨尔，千余年间由自称亚历山大大帝后裔的本地王公统治。当地居民织造粗毛料和马海毛，在山里采金、开盐坑，并能制造火器。16世纪，约一万两千户来自喀喇昆仑与克鲁伦地区的吉尔吉斯人家族迁入谷地，组成以吉尔吉斯人为首的部落联盟。1636年，布哈拉汗纳德尔·穆罕默德派费尔干纳长官哈吉·阿塔里克攻取卡拉捷金，谷地自此并入布哈拉汗国，迁入的吉尔吉斯人后来也皈依了伊斯兰教。

en: The Kurani were a Kurdish tribal chiefdom based at Qasr-e Shirin, on the old Hulwan-Shahrizor frontier. The district had been Annazid Kurdish heartland from the tenth to the twelfth centuries; in 1337 the Kurani held it as Jalayirid vassals, and it later gave rise to the Hamawand tribe.
zh: 库拉尼人是以席林堡为中心的库尔德部落酋长政权，地当赫勒万与谢赫雷祖尔之间的旧边地。这一地区曾是10至12世纪安纳兹库尔德王朝的核心地盘，1337年库拉尼首领作为札剌亦儿王朝的附庸据有该地，后来的哈马万德部落也发源于此。

en: The Karanka, called Carangas in the Spanish chronicles, were one of the largest Aymara lordships of the southern altiplano, emerging after the collapse of Tiwanaku around 1000. Their grazing lands stretched from the Mauri and Desaguadero rivers in the north to Lake Poopo and the Coipasa salt flat in the south, between the western cordillera and the Bolivian high plains, a country of cold puna ideal for llama and alpaca herds; caravan trade linked their homeland with the Pacific valleys, where they kept detached colonies from the Lluta to Tarapaca. Their chief seats are variously given as Hatun Carangas, Corquemarca and Choquecota, and the chullpa burial towers of their necropolises, some still bearing painted walls, mark their territory. Together with the Quillacas the Carangas formed part of the Charca Takusis confederation, and the names of pre-Inca leaders such as Choquichambi and his son Layme survive in the records. The Incas absorbed them into the Collasuyo around the mid-fifteenth century, and Huayna Capac later moved Caranga communities as mitma settlers to the Cochabamba valley. Under Spanish rule their western enclaves were attached to the corregimiento of Arica.
zh: 卡朗卡在西班牙编年史中称为卡兰加斯，是南部高原最大的艾马拉酋长国之一，约在1000年蒂亚瓦纳科崩溃后兴起。其牧场北起毛里河与德萨瓜德罗河，南抵波波湖和科伊帕萨盐沼，夹在西科迪勒拉山与玻利维亚高原之间，是适合放养骆马和羊驼的寒冷普纳草原；商队贸易把本土同太平洋河谷连在一起，他们在从留塔河到塔拉帕卡之间保有分散的殖民聚落。其主要治所有哈通卡朗卡、科尔克马卡和乔克科塔等不同说法，境内的丘尔帕葬塔墓群中，一些塔墙外壁仍留有彩绘。卡朗卡与基利亚卡人同属查尔卡·塔库西斯联盟，史籍中还保存着印卡时代以前首领乔基昌比及其子莱梅等人的名字。15世纪中期，印卡人将其并入科利亚苏尤，后来瓦伊纳·卡帕克又把卡朗卡社群作为米特玛移民迁往科恰班巴河谷。西班牙统治时期，他们在西部的飞地被划归阿里卡督辖区。

en: Kerman, the ancient Carmania, sits on a high plain on the southeastern edge of the Iranian plateau. Its city was founded as Veh-Ardashir by the Sasanian king Ardashir I in the third century, passed to Muslim rule after the battle of Nahavand in 642, and under the Seljuks grew rich enough to conquer Oman and Fars; when Marco Polo passed through in 1271 it was a great emporium linking the Persian Gulf with Khorasan and Central Asia. From 1222 the province was ruled by the Khitan Qutlugh-Khanids, until the Il-Khan Öljaitü deposed their last prince in 1306 and installed his own governor, Nasir al-Din Muhammad ibn Burhan. With the Ilkhanate collapsing after 1335, Kerman was held in 1337 by the governor Qutb al-Din ibn Nasir, whose province also held autonomous non-Muslim Mongol tribes. In 1340 the Muzaffarid ruler Mubariz al-Din Muhammad invaded and seized Kerman; Qutb al-Din briefly won it back with help from the Kartids of Herat, but lost it again before the year ended, and Bam fell soon afterwards. Kerman thereafter shared the fate of the Muzaffarid lands, passing to Timur in 1393 and to the Timurids, and its later prosperity under the Safavids ended for a time with the savage Qajar sack of the city in 1794.
zh: 克尔曼古称卡尔马尼亚，位于伊朗高原东南边缘的高平原上。其城市由萨珊国王阿尔达希尔一世于3世纪以“韦赫-阿尔达希尔”之名建立，642年纳哈万德战役后归入穆斯林统治；塞尔柱时期它富庶到一度征服阿曼和法尔斯，1271年马可·波罗经过时，这里已是连接波斯湾、呼罗珊与中亚的大商埠。1222年起，该省由契丹人的库特鲁汗王朝统治，1306年伊儿汗完者都废黜末代王公，改派纳西尔丁·穆罕默德·伊本·布尔汉为总督。1335年伊儿汗国瓦解后，1337年的克尔曼由总督库特卜丁·伊本·纳西尔掌握，省内还居住着享有自治权的非穆斯林蒙古部落。1340年，穆扎法尔王朝的穆巴里兹丁·穆罕默德入侵并夺取克尔曼；库特卜丁借助赫拉特卡尔提德王朝的援兵一度复国，但当年年底再度失守，巴姆也很快陷落。此后克尔曼随穆扎法尔领土一同在1393年落入帖木儿之手，继而归属帖木儿王朝；它在萨法维时期重现繁荣，却在1794年卡扎尔人血腥屠城后一度衰败。

en: Kuripan was an old Hindu-influenced kingdom of the lower Barito basin in what is now South Kalimantan, with its seat at Danau Panggang in the present North Hulu Sungai regency, downstream from Amuntai. It is thought to be the polity called Tabalong in the Nagarakretagama of 1365, and some historians identify it with the neighbouring Ma'anyan kingdom of Nan Sarunai, while others treat the two as separate states. The chronicle Tutur Candi, a version of the Hikayat Banjar, relates that the last king of Kuripan adopted the Majapahit commander Ampu Jatmika as his heir; when the old king died, Ampu Jatmika renamed the realm Negara Dipa and built the Candi Agung temple at Amuntai. His son Lambung Mangkurat, ruling with the title Ratu Kuripan, extended the kingdom's sway over the Dayak communities of the Kahayan, Sabangau and Mendawai rivers.
zh: 固里班是巴里托河下游的古老王国，受印度教影响，都城在今北河源县的达瑙庞昂，地处阿蒙泰下游。一般认为它就是1365年《爪哇史颂》所载的塔巴隆王国；部分史家认为它与邻近的马安亚人王国楠沙鲁奈本是一国，也有人认为二者并立。《马辰编年史》的异本记载，固里班末代君主收满者伯夷将领安普·贾特米卡为养子兼继承人，老王去世后，安普·贾特米卡将国号改为尼贾拉·蒂帕，并在阿蒙泰修建了阿贡寺。他的儿子兰邦·芒库拉特以固里班之王的头衔，把统治扩展到卡哈扬河、萨邦奥河和门达瓦伊河沿岸的达雅克诸社群。

en: The Kartids were a Sunni Muslim dynasty of Tajik origin, related to the Ghurids, who ruled most of Khorasan from Herat from the mid-thirteenth to the late fourteenth century. Founded by Shams-uddin Muhammad in 1245, the dynasty first served the Ghurids and then ruled as vassal princes under the Mongol Empire and the Ilkhanate; in 1306 Fakhr-uddin destroyed an Ilkhanid army sent against Herat, though the city later submitted to Öljeitü. When the Ilkhanate fragmented after 1335, Mu'izz-uddin Husayn, the Kart malik in 1337, built up an independent principality, allying with and paying tribute to Togha Temür, the Borjigin claimant based in Gurgan. His long reign brought victory over the Sarbadars at the Battle of Zava in 1342, campaigns against the Chagatai Mongols, and a young Timur taken into Kart service; from 1349 Husayn ruled as an independent sultan. After his death in 1370 his son Ghiyas-uddin Pir 'Ali inherited a weakened state. Timur invaded Khorasan and took Herat in 1381, deported its scholars and carried off the Kart princes; Pir 'Ali was executed around 1383 after a revolt, and the last Kart princes were murdered at a banquet in 1396, ending the dynasty amid Timur's first Persian campaign.
zh: 库尔特王朝是与古尔王朝有亲缘关系的塔吉克裔逊尼派王朝，13世纪中叶至14世纪末以赫拉特为都统治呼罗珊大部。王朝由沙姆斯丁·穆罕默德于1245年建立，先后臣属于古尔王朝、蒙古帝国与伊儿汗国；1306年法赫尔丁在赫拉特歼灭来攻的伊儿汗军队，但该城后来仍向完者都臣服。1335年伊儿汗国瓦解后，1337年在位的库尔特马利克穆伊兹丁·侯赛因建立起独立公国，与以朱里章为基地的孛儿只斤氏宗主权贵脱合帖木儿结盟并向其纳贡。他在位时，库尔特人于1342年在扎瓦战役击败萨尔毕道朗人，又多次出征察合台蒙古人，年轻的帖木儿还曾在其麾下效力；1349年起侯赛因改称独立苏丹。他于1370年去世，其子吉亚斯丁·皮尔·阿里继承的国势已衰。1381年帖木儿攻入呼罗珊、夺取赫拉特，放逐城中学者并掳走库尔特王公；皮尔·阿里在叛乱后于约1383年被处死，最后的库尔特王公也于1396年在一次宴会上被杀，王朝亡于帖木儿的第一次波斯征战。

en: Kāshān is an oasis city of central Persia, standing at the foot of the Karkas Mountains on the western edge of the Dasht-e Kavir. The nearby Tepe Sialk, occupied from around the sixth millennium BC, makes it one of the oldest settled places in Iran. In the Islamic period it grew famous for its ceramics: the Seljuk sultan Malik Shah I built the Jalali fortress in the eleventh century, and between the twelfth and fourteenth centuries Kāshān was a leading producer of fine pottery and glazed tiles, the Persian word for a tile, kashi, taking its name from the town, while its lustreware was still prized under the Il-Khans. After the Mongol empire of Persia broke up in the 1330s the city passed through several hands; Ulugh Beg, grandson of Timur, patronized it, and it later fell to the Qara Qoyunlu and then the Aq Qoyunlu. Under the Safavids it became a centre of the silk and brocade trade and a resort of the shahs, who laid out the Fin Garden, before the earthquake of 1778 levelled the city and killed some eight thousand people, after which it was rebuilt.
zh: 卡尚是波斯中部的绿洲城市，背靠卡尔卡斯山，位于卡维尔盐漠西缘。附近的锡亚尔克丘在公元前6000年前后已有人居住，使卡尚成为伊朗最古老的定居地之一。伊斯兰时代它以陶瓷闻名：11世纪塞尔柱苏丹马利克沙一世下令修建贾拉利堡垒；12至14世纪，卡尚是精美陶器和釉砖的重要产地，波斯语中“瓷砖”一词便得名于这座城市，其光泽釉陶在伊儿汗国时期仍受珍视。14世纪30年代波斯的蒙古政权瓦解后，卡尚几经易主，帖木儿之孙兀鲁伯曾对它加以营建，此后又先后落入黑羊王朝和白羊王朝之手。萨法维王朝时期，它成为丝绸与织锦贸易中心和沙阿们的游乐地，菲恩花园即建于此时；1778年的大地震将全城夷平，约八千人罹难，城市此后得以重建。

en: The Kashmir kingdom was the Hindu state of the Kashmir valley behind the western Himalayas, ruled from Srinagar, whose earlier dynasties were chronicled in Kalhana's twelfth-century Sanskrit work Rajatarangini. The Karkotas made the valley a centre of Hindu learning and Kashmir Shaivism, and the Lohara dynasty held the throne from 1003 until the Turkic-Mongol raider Zulju sacked it around 1320 and its last king Suhadeva fled; his widow Kota Rani ruled until 1339 and cut a canal to tame the Jhelum floods at Srinagar. In 1337 the valley was still under this Hindu queen, but the noble Shah Mir, who had entered Kashmiri service in 1313, seized power in 1339 as Shamsu'd-Din Shah and founded the Shah Mir Sultanate. Islam then spread through the valley: Sultan Sikandar, reigning from 1389 to 1413, forced conversions and broke Hindu idols, while Zain-ul-Abidin of 1420 to 1470 brought craftsmen from Persia and patronised shawl-weaving and the arts. After the Mughal general Haidar Dughlat's invasion around 1540, Chak nobles replaced the Shah Miris in 1561, and Akbar annexed Kashmir to the Mughal Empire in 1586. The Afghan Durranis under Ahmad Shah took it in 1752 and taxed it harshly until Ranjit Singh's Sikhs conquered it in 1819 after the Battle of Shopian; a famine in 1832 then drove the Sikh governors to halve the land tax.
zh: 克什米尔王国是喜马拉雅山西麓克什米尔谷地的印度教政权，以斯利那加为都，其历代王朝的事迹保存在卡尔哈纳12世纪用梵语写成的《王河》之中。卡尔科塔王朝时期，这里成为印度教学术和克什米尔湿婆教的中心；洛哈拉王朝自1003年起统治，直到约1320年突厥—蒙古首领祖尔朱洗劫谷地、末代国王苏提婆出逃。他的遗孀科塔·拉尼执政至1339年，还开凿运河疏导杰赫勒姆河、减轻斯利那加的水患。1337年时谷地仍在这位印度教女王治下，但1313年入仕克什米尔的贵族沙阿·米尔已在积蓄力量，他于1339年篡位称沙姆斯丁·沙阿，建立沙米尔苏丹王朝，伊斯兰教随后在谷地传播。1389至1413年在位的西坎达尔苏丹强令改宗、捣毁印度教神像，得了“毁像者”的称号；1420至1470年在位的扎因·乌勒·阿比丁则从波斯请来工匠，推动披肩织造和各项手工业。1540年前后莫卧儿将领海达尔·杜格拉特一度入侵，1561年查克贵族取代沙米尔王朝，1586年阿克巴把克什米尔并入莫卧儿帝国。1752年艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼率阿富汗人夺得此地，苛税统治持续到1819年兰吉特·辛格的锡克军队在绍皮恩战役后征服克什米尔；1832年的饥荒又迫使锡克总督把田赋减半。

en: Kishtwar was a mountain principality in the upper Chenab valley, set between Kashmir to the west, Ladakh to the east and Chamba to the south, with its chief town of the same name above the river gorges. Kalhana's Rajatarangini of the twelfth century calls it Kashthavata and records its chief Uttamaraja joining the hill rulers who paid homage to Raja Kalsa of Kashmir between 1063 and 1089. In later centuries local rana and raja lineages held the valleys, and the Kishtwar rajas extended their power southwards to absorb the neighbouring principality of Bhaderwah. The ruling house kept its independence through the Mughal and Durrani periods under its own rajas, the last of whom was Mohammed Tegh Singh. In 1821 the Dogra maharaja Gulab Singh of Jammu invaded and annexed Kishtwar; its raja was sent to the Lahore fort, where he died by his own hand, and the state was merged into the growing dominions of Jammu.
zh: 吉什德瓦尔是奇纳布河上游的山间土邦，西接克什米尔、东邻拉达克、南连昌巴，同名主城高踞河谷峡谷之上。12世纪卡尔哈纳的《诸王流派》称其为卡什塔瓦塔，并记载其首领乌塔马拉贾曾在1063年至1089年间与其他山地首领一同向克什米尔罗阇卡尔萨朝觐。此后数百年，本地的拉纳、罗阇家族世代统治这些谷地，吉什德瓦尔的罗阇还向南扩张，吞并了邻邦巴德瓦。在莫卧儿和杜兰尼时期，统治家族仍在自己的罗阇治下保持独立，末代罗阇为穆罕默德·特格·辛格。1821年，查谟的多格拉大君古拉卜·辛格出兵吞并吉什德瓦尔，罗阇被押往拉合尔堡垒，在那里自尽，土邦并入日益扩张的查谟领地。

en: Kengtung, also called Chiang Tung or Moeng Khün, was the largest of the Shan states, set in a valley of the Daen Lao Range, east of the Salween and reaching toward the Mekong. Wa tradition remembers the valley as Wa country until Tai princes displaced them. In 1263 King Mangrai of the Yonok polity sent his grandson Mang Kun to conquer the area and found the ruling line; the saopha Nam Nam later built the walled capital at Kengtung. Although ethnically close to the Siamese, Kengtung's rulers preferred to send tribute, often in ritual gold flowers, to the Burmese kings. In 1405 the Ming dynasty recognized it as the tusi prefecture of Menggen. Rivalry over the state helped spark war between the Qianlong Emperor of Qing China and King Hsinbyushin of Burma in 1760. Chiang Mai seized Kengtung in 1802, but Burmese help restored its saopha dynasty in 1814, whereupon Kengtung absorbed the neighboring state of Mongyawng.
zh: 景栋，又名清栋或勐痕，是最大的掸邦，坐落在丹老山脉的一处河谷中，位于萨尔温江以东，疆域一直伸展到湄公河。佤族的传说记得这片河谷本是佤人的土地，后来被泰人王公取代。1263年，庸那伽的孟莱王派孙子孟昆征服此地，开创了统治世系；诏法绍南南后来修筑了景栋城作为都城。尽管在族属上与暹罗人亲近，景栋的统治者却更愿意向缅甸国王进贡，贡品常是仪式用的金金花。1405年，明朝将其封为土司，置孟艮府。对该邦影响力的争夺，促成了1760年清朝乾隆帝与缅甸国王辛标信之间的战争。1802年清迈夺取景栋，但在缅甸援助下，景栋诏法王朝于1814年复辟，随后吞并了邻邦孟勇。

en: Kutlehar was a small Hindu kingdom in the hills between the Sutlej and Beas rivers, in what is now the Una district of Himachal Pradesh. Tradition traces its founding to a raja named Gopal around 750, and it was an established power by the tenth century; under Raja Jas Pal in the eleventh century its rule is said to have stretched across all the land between the two rivers. Its later history was one of defence against the plains empires. In 1337 it fought Muhammad bin Tughlaq, in 1398 it faced Timur's invasion, and in 1556 Akbar reduced its raja to tribute and a hostage prince at the Delhi court. Around 1700 the raja defied Mughal orders to attack the passing Sikh army of Guru Gobind Singh, whom he met at Rewalsar, and his state was cut back to a fraction of its old size as punishment. Gorkha armies from Nepal occupied Kutlehar from 1805 to 1809, and in 1815 Maharaja Ranjit Singh annexed it and exiled its raja; the kingdom was finally absorbed into Punjab in 1825.
zh: 库特勒哈尔是萨特莱杰河与比亚斯河之间丘陵地带的印度教小王国，位于今喜马偕尔邦乌纳县一带。按传统说法，它约于750年由罗阇戈帕尔建立，到10世纪已是一方势力；11世纪杰斯·帕尔在位时，据说其统治遍及两河之间的全部土地。此后它的历史主要是抵御平原帝国：1337年与穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克交战，1398年遭遇帖木儿入侵，1556年阿克巴迫使其罗阇纳贡，并将一位王子作为人质留在德里宫廷。约1700年，时任罗阇违抗莫卧儿命令，没有攻击路过的古鲁·戈宾德·辛格的锡克军队，还在雷瓦尔萨尔与他会面，结果王国被削减到只剩原有领土的一小部分。1805年至1809年，来自尼泊尔的廓尔喀军队占领库特勒哈尔；1815年大君兰季德·辛格将其吞并并流放罗阇，1825年该国最终被并入旁遮普。

en: This Malabar chiefdom had its seat at Ponnani, a port at the mouth of the Bharatappuzha river on the central Kerala coast. The surrounding country was the original home of the Perumpadappu Swaroopam, the dynasty that later founded the Kingdom of Cochin; after the Zamorin of Kozhikode occupied the area its rulers moved south, and Ponnani became the Zamorin's chief military headquarters and a flourishing Muslim trading harbour. Middle Eastern merchants made it one of the busiest spice ports on the Arabian Sea, and the theologians of the Makhdum family taught there, among them Zain-ud-Din Makhdum II, whose chronicle of the jihad against the Portuguese was written in the town; Ponnani became known as the Little Mecca of Malabar, and the Arabi Malayalam script took shape there. Portuguese fleets repeatedly sacked the harbour and built a fort in 1585, and under a treaty of 1604 the Dutch East India Company opened its own factory at the port.
zh: 这个马拉巴尔小邦以蓬纳尼为治所，该港位于喀拉拉中部海岸的巴拉塔普扎河河口。周边一带本是后来建立科钦王国的佩鲁姆帕杜斯瓦鲁帕姆王朝的故地；科泽科德扎莫林占领此地后，其统治者南迁，蓬纳尼成为扎莫林最重要的军事大本营和繁荣的穆斯林商港。中东商人使它成为阿拉伯海最繁忙的香料港之一，马赫杜姆家族的伊斯兰学者在此讲学，其中扎因丁·马赫杜姆二世在城里写成了记述抗击葡萄牙人圣战的编年史，蓬纳尼也被称为马拉巴尔的小麦加，阿拉伯-马拉雅拉姆文字同样诞生于此。葡萄牙舰队多次洗劫此港，并于1585年修筑堡垒；根据1604年的条约，荷兰东印度公司也在港内开设了商馆。

en: Katsina was one of the seven true Hausa states, the Hausa Bakwai, and Hausa tradition gave it the title king of the market, for it guarded the northern trade routes towards the Sahara. The walled town was founded around 1100, its twenty-one-kilometre rampart enclosing a capital whose pre-Islamic ruler, the Sarki, was treated as semi-divine and could be put to death for ruling badly. Islam came with Wangara and Songhai clerics, and tradition makes Muhammadu Korau, a learned cleric, the first Muslim king in 1348, builder of the Gidan Korau palace that still stands at the city's heart. Under the Korau line Katsina drew scholars from Egypt and North Africa and ranked with Kano as a seat of Islamic learning; Ibrahim Maje, who reigned from 1549 to 1566, imposed Muslim marriage law on the kingdom. From the 1600s to the 1700s Katsina was the commercial heart of Hausaland and the largest of the seven city-states, its markets served by the mud-brick Gobarau Minaret. Its independence ended in 1807, when Fulani jihadists overran it and made it an emirate of the Sokoto Caliphate.
zh: 卡齐纳是豪萨七城邦（豪萨·巴克瓦伊）之一，豪萨传统授予它“市场之王”的称号，因为它扼守着通往撒哈拉的北方商路。这座有城墙的城镇约建于1100年，周长21公里的城墙环绕着都城；在伊斯兰化之前，它的统治者萨尔基被视为半神，治国不善便可能被处死。伊斯兰教随万加拉人和桑海学者而来，相传学识渊博的教士穆罕默杜·科劳于1348年成为第一位穆斯林国王，修建了坐落于城中心的科劳宫。在科劳王朝治下，卡齐纳从埃及和北非延揽学者，与卡诺并列为伊斯兰学术中心；1549至1566年在位的易卜拉欣·马杰在王国推行伊斯兰婚姻法。17至18世纪，卡齐纳是豪萨兰的商业心脏和七城邦中最大的一个，泥筑的戈巴劳宣礼塔俯瞰着城中市场。它的独立在1807年终结，富拉尼圣战者攻占该城，把它变成索科托哈里发国的一个埃米尔国。

en: Khuttal, often called Khuttalan, was a medieval region and principality on the north bank of the Oxus, between the Vakhsh and Panj rivers, roughly matching the modern Khatlon region of Tajikistan. Its Iranian princes, titled Khuttalan Shah and Khuttalan Khudah, ruled from Hulbuk near Kulob and long defied the Arab conquest of Transoxiana, calling in the Turgesh khagan Suluk to defeat the Umayyad armies in the 720s and 730s, until the Abbasids imposed direct rule in 751. A branch of the Banijurids then governed under Samanid suzerainty, and the country later passed in turn under Ghaznavid, Seljuq, Ghurid and Khwarazmshah overlordship. The Mongol conquests made Khuttal part of the Chagatai Khanate, and when that state disintegrated in the mid-fourteenth century it re-emerged as an autonomous principality whose lords, such as Kai Khusraw Khuttalani, served and fought in Timur's armies. In the sixteenth century the Shaybanids absorbed it and the old name fell out of use, the region becoming known as Kulob.
zh: 忽都常称忽都兰，是阿姆河北岸、瓦赫什河与喷赤河之间的中世纪地区和公国，大致相当于今塔吉克斯坦的哈特隆一带，唐代汉文文献译作“骨咄”。当地伊朗语诸侯号称“忽都兰沙”和“忽都兰·胡达”，以库洛布附近的胡尔布克为都，曾长期抗拒阿拉伯人对河中的征服，请来突骑施可汗苏禄，在8世纪20至30年代连败倭马亚军队，直到751年阿拔斯王朝才建立直接统治。其后巴尼朱尔王朝的一支在萨曼宗主权下治理该地，忽都又先后落入伽色尼、塞尔柱、古耳和花剌子模沙之手。蒙古征服后它成为察合台汗国的一部分，14世纪中叶汗国瓦解时再度成为自治公国，其领主如凯·胡斯劳·忽塔拉尼等人曾在帖木儿军中效力征战。16世纪，昔班尼王朝吞并该地，“忽都”这一古称逐渐弃用，地区改以库洛布之名为人所知。

en: The Kathmandu valley, known to its rulers as Nepal Mandala, was the heartland of the Newar people and the seat of the Malla dynasty from 1201, when Arimalla first took that title, until 1769. The early reigns were violent: an earthquake in 1255 killed perhaps thirty thousand people, including King Abhaya Malla, though the valley still sent artisans to Tibet, among them Araniko, who rose high in the service of Kublai Khan. In 1337 the throne belonged to Jayari Malla, a king in name only while the noble houses and their queens held real power; the Khasa raiders of the western hills sacked Nuwakot in 1328 under Aditya Malla and burned Sankhu in 1334 under Punya Malla, and the Bengal sultan Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah plundered the valley's shrines in 1345.
