Jayasthiti Malla reunited the towns between 1382 and 1395 and codified its laws, and Yaksha Malla's long reign ended in 1482 with the valley split into the three rival kingdoms of Kathmandu, Patan and Bhaktapur. Their competing courts built the gilded pagodas and Durbar Squares that define the three cities, and Kathmandu's Pratap Malla, ruling from 1641 to 1674, set the age's high point with the Hanuman Dhoka palace and the Rani Pokhari tank while his merchants grew rich on the India-Tibet trade and on minting Tibet's coinage. The rivalry ended when Prithvi Narayan Shah of Gorkha stormed the valley in 1768 and 1769, overthrowing the last three Malla rajas and founding the kingdom of Nepal.
zh: 加德满都谷地被其统治者称为尼波罗曼陀罗，是尼瓦尔人的腹心，也是末罗王朝1201至1769年间的王畿——阿里末罗是第一个使用末罗称号的国王。早期统治充满动荡：1255年的大地震夺去约三万人的生命，国王阿巴亚末罗也在其中；但谷地仍向西藏输出工匠，阿尼哥便在其中，后来在忽必烈的元朝朝廷位居高官。1337年在位的贾亚里·末罗只是名义上的国王，实权落入贵族诸家与王后之手；西部山地的卡萨人连年入寇，1328年阿迪蒂亚·末罗劫掠努瓦科特，1334年普尼亚·末罗焚毁桑库，1345年孟加拉苏丹沙姆苏丁·伊利亚斯沙阿又洗劫了谷地的神庙。贾亚斯提提·末罗于1382至1395年重新统一诸城并编订法典，雅克沙·末罗的长期统治在1482年结束后，谷地分裂为加德满都、帕坦和巴克塔普尔三个相互竞争的王国。三国宫廷竞相营建鎏金宝塔与王宫广场，塑造了诸城的面貌；1641至1674年在位的加德满都国王普拉塔普·末罗修建哈努曼多卡宫和拉尼博卡里水池，代表了这个时代的巅峰，商人则靠印度—西藏贸易和为西藏铸币致富。1768至1769年，廓尔喀的普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿攻入谷地，推翻末代三位末罗王公，终结了这场竞争，也奠定了尼泊尔王国的基础。

en: The Kartawi were a Kurdish tribal chiefdom of the Mukriyan country, the grazing lands south of Lake Urmia around Barza, Bukan and Sardasht. In the fourteenth century local Kurdish lords held the district under Jalayirid overlordship; from the late fourteenth century onward the same country became the heartland of the Mukri principality.
zh: 卡尔塔维人是穆克里扬地区的一个库尔德部落酋长政权，牧地在乌尔米耶湖以南的巴尔扎、布坎和萨尔达什特一带。14世纪时，本地库尔德头人在札剌亦儿王朝的宗主权下统治该地区；14世纪末以后，这片地方成为穆克里埃米尔国的核心地带。

en: The County of Katzenelnbogen was an immediate state of the Holy Roman Empire, split into a lower county around Katzenelnbogen Castle on the Middle Rhine and an upper county south of the Main around Darmstadt. The family's forebear Diether I, Vogt of Prüm Abbey, appears in records around 1070, and from 1094 he and his son built the castle in the Taunus; King Conrad III granted the comital title in 1138. The counts raised Burg Rheinfels and Auerbach Castle in the thirteenth century, completed Burg Katz in 1371, rebuilt the Marksburg and won lucrative Rhine customs rights, extending their lands from the Neckar to the Moselle. In 1260 the county split between two lines, reunited only in 1402 under Count Johann IV. In 1435 Johann IV had the Riesling vine planted at Rüsselsheim, the earliest documented mention of the variety. When Count Philipp died without male heirs in 1479, the inheritance passed through his daughter Anna to the Landgraves of Hesse, provoking the long Katzenelnbogen Succession War against Nassau-Siegen, fought from 1500 to 1557. The former county was annexed by France in 1806 and assigned to the Duchy of Nassau by the Congress of Vienna in 1815.
zh: 卡岑埃尔恩博根伯国是神圣罗马帝国的一个直属邦国，领土分为两块：下伯国以莱茵河中游陶努斯山区的卡岑埃尔恩博根城堡为中心，上伯国位于美因河以南、达姆施塔特一带。家族先祖迪特尔一世曾任普吕姆修道院的护院，约在1070年首见记载；1094年起他与儿子在陶努斯山修筑城堡，1138年国王康拉德三世授予伯爵头衔。伯爵们在13世纪兴建莱茵费尔斯城堡和奥尔巴赫城堡，1371年建成卡茨城堡，又重建马克斯堡，并取得获利丰厚的莱茵河关税权，领地从内卡河一直扩展到摩泽尔河。1260年伯国分给两支家族，直到1402年才由约翰四世伯爵重新统一。1435年，约翰四世命人在吕瑟尔斯海姆栽种雷司令葡萄，这是该品种现存最早的文字记载。1479年菲利普伯爵无男嗣而终，遗产经女儿安娜转入黑森领地伯爵家族，并引发1500年至1557年与拿骚‑锡根之间旷日持久的卡岑埃尔恩博根继承战争。原伯国领土于1806年被法国吞并，1815年维也纳会议将其划归拿骚公国。

en: Courland was the western peninsula of Livonia, home of the Curonians, a Baltic tribe described by medieval writers as warriors, sailors and pirates who raided on both sides of the Baltic. In 1230 the Curonian ruler Lamekinas accepted Christian conversion, and the Bishopric of Courland was established in 1234 as the Livonian Crusade consolidated its conquests; in 1253 the Curonian lands were partitioned between the bishop and the Livonian Order. The bishopric was a scattered state of small enclaves, and after the Order's disaster at the Battle of Durbe in 1260 the bishop fled, only returning once the great Curonian and Semigallian uprisings were crushed in 1290. From that year the cathedral chapter was bound to the Teutonic Order, so the bishopric, seated at Piltene, remained effectively a client of the Livonian Order. In 1521 it was formally raised to a prince-bishopric of the Holy Roman Empire, but the Livonian War soon ended its independence: in 1560 the last bishop sold it to Denmark, which passed the lands to Duke Magnus of Holstein, and in 1585 the Treaty of Kronborg sold them to the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, where they survived as the semi-autonomous District of Pilten.
zh: 库尔兰是利沃尼亚西部的半岛，居民是波罗的海部族库尔兰人，中世纪作家把他们描述为战士、水手和海盗，曾在波罗的海两岸四处劫掠。1230年，库尔兰统治者拉梅基纳斯接受基督教改宗；随着利沃尼亚十字军巩固战果，库尔兰主教区于1234年建立，1253年库尔兰土地被主教与利沃尼亚骑士团瓜分。主教区是由若干小飞地组成的松散政权；1260年骑士团在杜尔贝战役惨败后主教出逃，直到1290年库尔兰人与瑟米加利亚人的大起义被镇压后才返回。从这一年起，主教座堂参议会被纳入条顿骑士团体系，使这个驻节皮尔泰内的主教区实际上一直是利沃尼亚骑士团的附庸。1521年它被正式升格为神圣罗马帝国的采邑主教区，但利沃尼亚战争很快终结了它的独立：1560年末任主教将其卖给丹麦，丹麦又把土地转交给荷尔斯泰因的马格努斯公爵；1585年的克龙堡条约又把这些土地卖给波兰立陶宛联邦，此后作为半自治的皮尔泰内地区存续。

en: Kuskatan, rendered Cuzcatlan by the Spanish, was a confederation of Nahua-speaking Pipil city-states stretching from the Paz to the Lempa rivers across western El Salvador. Nahua migrants from central Mexico, traditionally linked to the Toltec upheavals of the tenth century, settled among earlier Maya and Lenca populations and absorbed towns such as Chalchuapa and Cihuatán; by the thirteenth century the Pipil cities had united, and around 1400 a hereditary monarchy ruled from the capital Kuskatan, supported by irrigated farming, cotton armour and a standing army strong enough to repel Maya attacks. Its lords governed through councils of elders and priests, and Nawat, a southern Nahuatl dialect, served as the language of state. In 1524 Pedro de Alvarado invaded from the Guatemalan highlands and fought the battles of Acajutla and Tacuzcalco, but withdrew within months; San Salvador, founded by Gonzalo de Alvarado in 1525, was overrun in the general rising of 1526. Pedro de Alvarado campaigned again in 1526 and 1528, when Diego de Alvarado re-established San Salvador and the storming of the Peñol de Cinacantan broke the last organized resistance, although the province was not considered fully pacified until 1539.
zh: 库斯卡坦（西班牙文献拼作库斯卡特兰）是皮皮尔人的纳瓦语城邦联盟，疆域从帕斯河延伸到伦帕河，涵盖今萨尔瓦多西部。纳瓦移民相传因10世纪托尔特克人的战乱从墨西哥中部南迁，与早先的玛雅人和伦卡人共处，并吞并了查尔丘阿帕、西瓦坦等城邦；13世纪各皮皮尔城市走向联合，约1400年形成世袭君主制，以都城库斯卡坦为中心，依靠灌溉农业、棉甲和一支足以击退玛雅人入侵的常备军立国。君长由长老与祭司辅佐，南部纳瓦语方言纳瓦特语是其通用语。1524年，佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多从危地马拉高地入侵，在阿卡胡特拉和塔库斯卡尔科连番激战，数月后却被迫撤走；贡萨洛·德·阿尔瓦拉多于1525年建立的圣萨尔瓦多也在1526年的大起义中被摧毁。佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多又于1526年和1528年两度用兵，1528年迭戈·德·阿尔瓦拉多重建圣萨尔瓦多，西纳坎坦岩壁要塞陷落标志着有组织抵抗的终结，但该省直到1539年才被视为彻底平定。

en: The Kingdom of Kutch was a Jadeja Rajput state on the arid peninsula north of the Gulf of Kutch, founded around 1147 when Lakho Jadani, a Samma chief who had migrated from Sindh and been adopted by Jam Jada, built the capital of Lakhiarviro in eastern Kutch. When Raydhan Ratto died in 1215 his lands were divided among his four sons, leaving the senior line at Lakhiarviro at the head of a loose brotherhood of Jadeja branches, the bhayyat, whose junior chiefs held Kanthkot, Gajod and Bara. The Hindu Jadejas worshipped the goddess Ashapura Mata, whose chief temple stood at Mata no Madh. In 1410 Muzaffar Shah I of Gujarat defeated the chief of Kanthkot, and Kutch then paid tribute to the Gujarat sultans while ruling itself; in 1472 Mahmud Begada crossed the Rann of Kutch, scattered a much larger local army at Thar and accepted fresh tribute without annexing the land. Early in the sixteenth century Jam Rawal of Bara seized the country until Khengarji I, holding the fief of Morbi from the sultans of Gujarat, reconquered and united all of Kutch in 1549, while Jam Rawal fled to Saurashtra and founded Nawanagar. In 1819 the kingdom became a British protectorate, the princely state of Cutch.
zh: 卡奇王国是卡奇湾以北干旱半岛上的阇提奢拉杰普特政权。约1147年，从信德迁来、被贾姆·贾达收养的萨姆玛首领拉科·贾达尼在东卡奇兴建都城拉克希亚尔维拉，开创此邦。1215年拉伊丹·拉托死后，领地分给四个儿子，拉克希亚尔维拉的长支成为阇提奢各支松散同盟巴亚特的首领，幼支首领分别据有坎特科特、加乔德和巴拉。印度教的阇提奢人崇奉女神阿沙普拉，其主庙在马塔诺马德。1410年古吉拉特的穆扎法尔沙阿一世击败坎特科特首领，此后卡奇向古吉拉特苏丹纳贡，但实际自行其是；1472年穆罕默德伯克越过卡奇沼泽，在塔尔击溃人数远多于己的当地军队，接受新的贡赋而未兼并其地。16世纪初，巴拉的贾姆·拉瓦尔夺占全国，直到领有古吉拉特苏丹所封莫尔维领地的肯加尔吉一世反攻，于1549年收复并统一整个卡奇，贾姆·拉瓦尔逃往萨乌拉施特拉，另建纳瓦纳加尔。1819年，卡奇王国成为英国保护下的卡奇土邦。

en: The Kingdom of Kottayam, called Cotiote by the British, was a Nair chiefdom of North Malabar whose hills and forests covered the Thalassery country and the Wayanad plateau. Its Purannatt Swarupam dynasty traced its rule of Purainad to the legendary Harischandara Perumal, who built a fort at Puralimala, and the house gradually won independence from the Kolathiri rajas before splitting into eastern, southern and western branches, the last seated at Pazhassi. When Hyder Ali of Mysore overran Malabar in 1773 the raja took refuge in Travancore. Kerala Varma Pazhassi Raja of the western branch then led the kingdom and from 1793 fought the British East India Company in the long guerrilla Cotiote War, first over the government of Kottayam and then over Wayanad. Known as the Lion of Kerala, he was hunted down and killed in 1805, after which his lands were absorbed into British Malabar.
zh: 科塔亚姆王国被英国人称作科蒂奥特，是北马拉巴尔的奈尔人酋长国，山林辖地包括塔拉萨里一带和瓦亚纳德高原。统治王朝为普兰纳特·斯瓦鲁帕姆，自称对普兰纳德的统治可追溯到传奇君主哈里申达拉·佩鲁马尔，他曾在普拉利马拉筑堡；该家族逐渐摆脱科拉蒂里罗阇获得独立，后来分成东、南、西三支，西支驻于帕扎西。1773年迈索尔的海德尔·阿里攻陷马拉巴尔，罗阇逃入特拉凡哥尔避难。西支的凯拉拉·瓦尔马·帕扎西罗阇随后执掌国政，自1793年起以游击战与英国东印度公司展开漫长的科蒂奥特战争，先为科塔亚姆的治权、后为瓦亚纳德的归属而战。他被誉为喀拉拉之狮，于1805年被追兵击杀，其土地随后并入英属马拉巴尔。

en: The county centred on Burgdorf and Thun was the heartland of the counts of Neu-Kyburg, a Habsburg cadet line that carried on the name of the extinct counts of Kyburg, once among the four most powerful noble houses of the Swiss plateau. The old Kyburgs, a branch of the counts of Dillingen, had received Burgdorf and Thun from the Zähringen inheritance in 1218, but their male line died out in 1264. Rudolf of Habsburg, himself a Kyburg grandson through his mother Heilwig, took the lands in ward, and in 1273 the heiress Anna married Eberhard I of Habsburg-Laufenburg, founding the Neu-Kyburg dynasty. From Burgdorf the new counts balanced between Bern, Savoy and Austria, became burghers of Bern in 1311, and from 1313 held the landgraviate of Burgundy as an Austrian fief. Chronic debt forced piecemeal sales and pledges; Eberhard II, who ruled in 1337, had murdered his brother Hartmann II at Thun to seize the inheritance. Count Rudolf II's failed raid on Solothurn in 1382 sparked the Burgdorf War of 1383 to 1384, after which Bern bought Burgdorf and Thun. The last count, Berchtold, died in Bern in 1417 and the line became extinct, though the Habsburgs kept the comital title in their grand style.
zh: 以布格多夫和图恩为核心的伯国，是新基堡伯爵的家业。新基堡家族是哈布斯堡的旁支，以母系延续了当年瑞士高原四大豪门之一基堡伯爵的名号。老基堡家族出身迪林根伯爵支系，1218年在策林根家族的遗产中分得图恩和布格多夫，1264年男系绝嗣。母亲海尔维希出自基堡家族的哈布斯堡的鲁道夫以监护身份接管领地，1273年女继承人安娜嫁给哈布斯堡-劳芬堡的埃伯哈德一世，新基堡王朝由此建立。新伯爵们以布格多夫为中心，在伯尔尼、萨伏依和奥地利之间周旋，1311年取得伯尔尼市民身份，1313年起以奥地利封臣的身份领有勃艮第方伯领。长期入不敷出让他们不断变卖、抵押领地：1337年在位的埃伯哈德二世正是在图恩杀死兄长哈特曼二世后夺得继承权。1382年伯爵鲁道夫二世袭击索洛图恩失败，引发1383至1384年的布格多夫战争，战后伯尔尼买下布格多夫和图恩。末代伯爵贝希托尔德于1417年死于伯尔尼，家族绝嗣，但哈布斯堡仍把基堡伯爵的头衔保留在自己的尊号之中。

en: The Principality of Kozelsk was a Rurikovich appanage centered on the town of Kozelsk, first mentioned in 1146 within the Principality of Chernihiv. It became a separate principality between 1181 and 1201 under Mstislav Svyatoslavich, whose son Dmitry perished at the battle of the Kalka in 1223. Its fame came in the spring of 1238, when the boy prince Vasily and the townspeople held out against Batu's Mongol army for seven weeks; after the storm every inhabitant was killed and the town burned, and Batu is said to have called Kozelsk his evil city. Revived within a few years, the principality kept its own line of princes, and at the turn of the fourteenth century its prince Mikhail Dmitriyevich even occupied the grand-princely throne of Chernihiv. Kozelsk accepted Lithuanian suzerainty in 1371, passed to Moscow in 1408 when Vasily I granted it to Vladimir the Bold of Serpukhov, was retaken by Lithuania in 1445, and was finally confirmed to Moscow in 1494. A branch of its princes, the Gorchakovs, later served the Russian crown.
zh: 科泽利斯克公国是留里克王朝封邑，以科泽利斯克镇为中心；该镇最早在1146年作为切尔尼戈夫公国的一部分见于记载。1181—1201年间，它在姆斯季斯拉夫·斯维亚托斯拉维奇治下成为独立公国，其子德米特里于1223年战死在卡尔卡河。它的声名来自1238年春天：年幼的王公瓦西里与全城居民抵抗拔都的蒙古大军达七周之久；城破后所有居民被杀、城镇被焚，据说拔都把科泽利斯克称为“邪恶之城”。数年后城镇复兴，公国保留了自己的王公世系，13、14世纪之交，其王公米哈伊尔·德米特里耶维奇还曾登上切尔尼戈夫大公之位。科泽利斯克于1371年接受立陶宛宗主权，1408年转归莫斯科，瓦西里一世把它封给谢尔普霍夫的勇者弗拉基米尔；1445年立陶宛重新夺取，1494年才最终确认归属莫斯科。其王公的一支戈尔恰科夫家族后来在俄罗斯宫廷效力。

en: The Sotz'leb, better known as the Tzotzil, are a Maya people of the central Chiapas highlands; both names mean people of the bat, after the word for bat in their language, and they call their tongue Bats'i k'op, the true language. Their ancestors entered Chiapas between 100 BCE and 300 CE, and their speech descends from the proto-Ch'ol used in Late Classic cities such as Palenque and Yaxchilán. On the eve of the conquest they lived in at least seven small hilltop polities ruled by lords called aghauh, exporting quetzal feathers and amber to Tenochtitlán and trading salt from the wells of Ixtapa across the highlands. In 1522 the lord of Zinacantán offered his allegiance to the Spanish and helped Luis Marín subdue neighbouring tribes, while Chamula and Huixtlán fought the invaders and then fled into the wilds. Disease and encomienda labour cut deep into their numbers, and the Sotz'leb rose in revolt in 1528 and again in 1712.
zh: 索茨莱布人又称索西人，是恰帕斯中部高地的玛雅民族，两个名字都意为“蝙蝠之人”，取自他们语言中“蝙蝠”一词；他们把自己的语言称为巴齐科普，意为“真正的语言”。其祖先在公元前1世纪至公元3世纪间进入恰帕斯，他们的语言源自帕伦克和亚克斯奇兰等城市在古典晚期使用的原始乔尔语。征服前夕，他们分裂为至少七个山头小邦，由称阿加乌的首领统治，向特诺奇蒂特兰出口格查尔鸟羽和琥珀，并把伊斯塔帕盐井出产的盐贩卖到整个高地。1522年，西纳坎坦的酋长主动向西班牙人效忠，并协助路易斯·马林征服邻近部落；查穆拉和维斯特兰人则奋起抵抗，随后遁入荒野。疾病与监护征赋制下的劳役使人口锐减，索茨莱布人先后于1528年和1712年起兵反抗。

en: The Lalin are the Jurchen group of the Lalin river, the Manchu lalin bira, a right-bank tributary of the Songhua rising in the Zhangguangcai mountains, whose valley held the old Jin site of Shangjing. This was the founding heartland of the Jin dynasty: Aguda set his capital at Huining in 1115, the imperial city was built in 1124, and in 1138 the site was named Shangjing. When the Jin moved their capital to Yanjing in 1153 the palaces were destroyed and the capital title was revoked, although Emperor Shizong restored it in 1173; during the twelfth century large numbers of Chinese settler households were moved into the region to populate the Jin inner land. At the end of the Jin the Mongols took the area, Huining was abandoned and the circuit abolished, and the valley's Jurchens afterwards lived under Yuan and Ming frontier administration.
zh: 拉林是活动在拉林河流域的女真群体，拉林河满语称拉林比拉，河名意为爽快、欢喜，是发源于张广才岭的松花江右岸支流，河谷中坐落着金朝上京故地。这里是金朝的龙兴之地：1115年阿骨打在会宁府建立都城，1124年修建皇城，1138年加号上京。1153年金朝迁都燕京，上京称号被削、宫殿被毁，直到1173年金世宗时才恢复；12世纪还有大批汉人被迁到这里充实金源内地。金末蒙古入侵，会宁府废弃，河谷里的女真人从此处于元朝和明朝的边卫管辖之下。

en: Lamu is a Swahili town on its own island in the Lamu Archipelago of northern Kenya, called Amu by its own people and believed to have been founded in 1370, making it Kenya's oldest continuously settled town. An Arab traveller first wrote of it in 1441, when he met a Lamu judge on pilgrimage in Mecca. In 1506 Tristão da Cunha's Portuguese fleet blockaded the harbor and forced its king to pay an annual tribute, and for decades Lamu chafed under Portuguese shipping controls, joining the coast-wide revolt of the 1580s and calling on Omani help from 1652. Omani protection from the late seventeenth century opened its golden age: ruled as a republic by a council of elders, the Yumbe, it became a center of Swahili poetry, scholarship and craftsmanship, and its coral-stone houses in the classical Swahili style date from these years. When a Pate-Mazrui army invaded the archipelago and was slaughtered on the beach at the Battle of Shela, Lamu called in an Omani Busaidi garrison and built the seafront Lamu Fort, completed in the early 1820s.
zh: 拉穆是肯尼亚北部拉穆群岛同名岛屿上的斯瓦希里城镇，本地人称之为阿姆，一般认为建于1370年，是肯尼亚连续有人居住的最古老城镇。1441年，一位阿拉伯旅行者在麦加遇到一名前去朝觐的拉穆法官，这是关于它的最早文字记载。1506年，特里斯唐·达·库尼亚的葡萄牙舰队封锁港口，迫使当地国王缴纳年贡；此后数十年间，拉穆不堪葡萄牙的航运管制，参与了16世纪80年代席卷海岸的反抗，并从1652年起向阿曼求援。17世纪末开始的阿曼保护开启了它的黄金时代：它由长老会议云贝以共和方式治理，成为斯瓦希里诗歌、学术和手工艺的中心，城中古典斯瓦希里风格的珊瑚石宅第多建于这一时期。后来帕泰与马兹鲁伊联军入侵群岛，在谢拉之战中被歼灭于海滩，拉穆随即请来阿曼布赛义迪部族的驻军，并兴建临海的拉穆堡，该堡于19世纪20年代初完工。

en: Lancaster began as the honour built around a castle raised on the site of a Roman fort in the 1090s by Roger de Poitou, a son of Roger of Montgomery; when Roger rebelled with the Bellême family in 1102 his lands were forfeited, and in 1164 the Honour of Lancaster came under direct royal control. In 1267 Henry III turned the estates, swollen with lands forfeited by Simon de Montfort and Robert de Ferrers, into the earldom of Lancaster for his youngest son Edmund Crouchback, ancestor of the House of Lancaster. In 1337 the lord was Edmund's son Henry, third earl of Lancaster, whose own son Henry of Grosmont became a royal commander in the Hundred Years' War. In 1351 Edward III made Lancashire a county palatine with its own courts and created Grosmont duke of Lancaster; the title passed in 1362 to John of Gaunt, Edward's third son, through his marriage to Grosmont's daughter Blanche. When John's son Henry Bolingbroke seized the throne as Henry IV in 1399, the duchy was merged with the Crown but deliberately kept as a separate inheritance, so that every later English monarch has held it as Duke of Lancaster. Scottish raiders sacked Lancaster itself in 1322 and again in 1389, and the castle later served as a royalist garrison and prison in the civil wars.
zh: 兰开斯特的前身是围绕一座城堡形成的荣誉领地：11世纪90年代，蒙哥马利的罗杰之子普瓦图的罗杰在罗马要塞旧址上建起城堡；1102年罗杰随贝莱姆家族起兵失败，领地被没收，1164年兰开斯特荣誉领地归于王室直接管辖。1267年，亨利三世把因西蒙·德·孟福尔和罗伯特·德·费勒斯被剥夺而扩充的地产组为兰开斯特伯国，封给幼子“驼背”埃德蒙，他就是兰开斯特家族的始祖。1337年的领主是埃德蒙之子、第三代兰开斯特伯爵亨利，其子格罗斯蒙特的亨利后来成为百年战争中的英军名将。1351年，爱德华三世将兰开夏升格为拥有独立法庭的巴拉丁郡，并封格罗斯蒙特为兰开斯特公爵；1362年，公爵头衔经他女儿布朗什的婚姻传给爱德华三世第三子冈特的约翰。1399年，约翰之子亨利·博林布鲁克夺取王位，是为亨利四世，公国随之并入王权，却被刻意保留为独立遗产，此后每位英格兰君主都以兰开斯特公爵的身份持有它。苏格兰人曾在1322年和1389年两度洗劫兰开斯特城，这座城堡后来在内战中又充当过保王派驻军和监狱。

en: Saxe-Lauenburg was an immediate duchy of the Holy Roman Empire held by the Ascanian descendants of the old Saxon dukes, straddling the lower Elbe around the town of Lauenburg and including the Land of Hadeln at the river's mouth. The Danish king Valdemar II conquered the country in 1203, but it returned to the Ascanians after the Battle of Bornhöved in 1227. In the partition of 1296 the Saxon lands were split between Saxe-Lauenburg and Saxe-Wittenberg, and a further settlement of 1321 divided the Lauenburg line into the Bergedorf-Mölln and Ratzeburg-Lauenburg branches. The two Ascanian lines also claimed the Saxon electoral vote, their quarrel feeding the double royal election of 1314, until the Golden Bull of 1356 awarded the vote permanently to Saxe-Wittenberg. In 1337 the Bergedorf-Mölln branch was held by Albert IV, born in 1315 and ruling since 1321, first under his mother's regency. The duchy turned Lutheran in stages under Duke Magnus I and Francis I, who set up a Lutheran state church in 1585. When the Ascanian male line died out in 1689 the duchy passed to the Welfs and then the House of Hanover; and after the Napoleonic wars it was granted by the Congress of Vienna to the Danish crown in 1815, thereafter ruled in personal union by the kings of Denmark.
zh: 萨克森-劳恩堡是神圣罗马帝国的一个直辖公国，由古萨克森公爵的阿斯坎尼后裔统治，横跨易北河下游，以劳恩堡城为中心，还包括河口的哈德伦地区。丹麦国王瓦尔德马二世于1203年征服此地，但1227年博恩赫沃德战役后它又回到阿斯坎尼家族手中。1296年的分割把萨克森领地分为萨克森-劳恩堡和萨克森-维滕贝格，1321年的再次安排又把劳恩堡一系分为贝格多夫-默尔恩和拉策堡-劳恩堡两支。两支阿斯坎尼家族还争夺萨克森选侯票，争执促成了1314年的双重国王选举，直到1356年的金玺诏书把选侯票永久判给萨克森-维滕贝格。1337年，贝格多夫-默尔恩支系由1315年出生的阿尔布雷希特四世领有，他1321年继位，起初由母亲摄政。公国在马格努斯一世和弗朗茨一世治下逐步改宗路德宗，弗朗茨于1585年建立路德宗国家教会。1689年阿斯坎尼男系绝嗣，公国先后转入韦尔夫家族和汉诺威家族之手；拿破仑战争结束后，维也纳会议于1815年把它划归丹麦王室，此后由丹麦国王以共主邦联的形式统治。

en: The Lavo Kingdom was a mandala of the lower Chao Phraya basin, centred on Lavapura, the site of modern Lopburi. It emerged in the seventh century as one of the Mon cities of the Dvaravati world, known to Tang China as Tou-ho-lo and to later Song and Yuan courts as Luowo or Luohu. In the tenth and eleventh centuries it fell under Angkor's influence: Khmer forces sacked Lavapura in 1001, and Jayavarman VII posted his own kinsman to govern the town late in the twelfth century. Tai settlers then rose to dominance, and by the 1290s a Chinese envoy at Angkor found Siamese holding the chief influence at Lavo. From the 1080s the kingdom's seat had shifted downstream to Ayodhya, whose rulers, later called the Uthong or Lavo dynasty, married into the old Lavapura line. In 1337 Lavo, ruled from Lopburi, was one of the competing Thai-speaking towns of the plain, with Ayodhya among its vassals. In 1351 its line joined Suphannaphum in founding the Ayutthaya Kingdom, and Lavo became an Ayutthayan princely seat; the exiled king Ramesuan held it after 1370 before retaking Ayutthaya in 1388. Lopburi later declined until King Narai rebuilt it as a second capital in the 1660s, spending some eight months of each year there.
zh: 罗涡王国是昭披耶河下游的曼荼罗政权，以罗哇补罗——即今华富里——为中心。它在7世纪兴起，是孟人陀罗钵地文化圈的城邦之一，中国唐代史籍称其为堕和罗，宋、元两代又记作罗涡、罗斛。10至11世纪，罗涡落入吴哥的势力范围：高棉军队于1001年攻破罗哇补罗，12世纪末阇耶跋摩七世还派宗亲出镇该城。此后泰人定居者逐渐掌权，到13世纪90年代，出使吴哥的中国使臣已发现暹人在罗涡居于主导。早在11世纪80年代，王国的统治中心已顺流南移至阿踰陀，其统治者即后世所称的乌通（罗涡）王朝，与罗哇补罗旧王族联姻。1337年，以华富里为都的罗涡是平原上相互角逐的泰语城邦之一，阿踰陀还是它的属邦。1351年，罗涡一系与素攀那蓬联合建立阿瑜陀耶王国，罗涡成为阿瑜陀耶的王子封地；1370年失位的拉梅萱退守于此，并于1388年反攻复国。华富里后来渐趋荒废，17世纪60年代那莱王将其重建为别都，每年在此居住约八个月。

en: Lubeca is the prince-bishopric of Lübeck, a small ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire distinct from the Hanseatic free city of the same name. Its diocese was founded around 970 at Oldenburg in Holstein, once the stronghold of the pagan Wagri, as a mission to the Slavic Obotrites under the Archbishopric of Bremen. The great Slavic uprising of 983 drove the bishops out for generations, and only after the Saxon reconquest of Wagria was a new bishop, the missionary Vicelinus, appointed in 1149. In 1160 Henry the Lion moved the see from Oldenburg to Lübeck, and after Henry's fall in 1180 the bishopric became an immediate imperial state. As the free city of Lübeck won its own imperial immediacy in 1226, the bishops' secular lands lay outside the city walls; in 1309 they fixed their residence at Eutin, which remained the capital of a territory of only about 540 square kilometres. The Reformation reached the cathedral chapter in 1535, when it adopted the Lutheran confession, and from 1586 the prince-bishopric was ruled by Protestant administrators of the Holstein-Gottorp line. After the Peace of Westphalia it was one of only two Protestant prince-bishoprics in the Empire, until the Reichsdeputationshauptschluss of 1803 mediatized it into the Principality of Lübeck under the Duchy of Oldenburg.
zh: 吕贝卡即吕贝克采邑主教区，是神圣罗马帝国的一个小型教会政权，与同名的汉萨自由城市并不是一回事。它的教区约于970年设在荷尔斯泰因的奥尔登堡——那里曾是异教瓦格里人的重镇——隶属不来梅大主教区，负责向斯拉夫人奥博特里特人传教。983年的斯拉夫人大起义迫使主教们出逃达数代之久，直到萨克森人重新征服瓦格里亚后，传教士维切利努斯才于1149年被任命为新主教。1160年，狮子亨利将教座从奥尔登堡迁至吕贝克；1180年狮子亨利倒台后，主教区成为直属皇帝的帝国政权。由于吕贝克自由市在1226年获得帝国直辖地位，主教的世俗领地位于城墙之外；1309年，主教们把驻节地固定在奥伊廷，此后这片仅约540平方公里的领地便以奥伊廷为都。1535年宗教改革波及主教座堂参议会，其改奉信义宗；1586年起采邑主教区由荷尔斯泰因-戈托普家族的新教行政官统治。《威斯特伐利亚和约》之后，它是帝国仅有的两个新教采邑主教区之一，1803年的《帝国代表重要决议》将其裁并，改为吕贝克亲王国，并入奥尔登堡公国。

en: Leibo is a mountainous Yi country on the northern bank of the Jinsha River in the Liangshan, facing Wumeng across the water. The Yuan set up the Leibo tribal chief's office here in 1276, hereditarily held by the local Azhuo clan, and it was later folded into the Manyi chief's office under Mahu. In 1371 the Azhuo chief Piya submitted to the Ming together with the Mahu ruler An Ji; the office was restored and the clan was granted the Chinese surname Yang. Backed by the steep gorges of the Liangshan, the Yang tusi kept broad autonomy even at the height of Ming power. In 1704 the thirteenth-generation chief Yang Lawa submitted to the Qing and was confirmed as chief of the Qianwanguan office. When the chief Yang Mingyi joined a Yi rising against the gaitu guiliu armies in 1728, Qing troops suppressed it and revoked the native title; the next year Leibo was converted into a military guard, and in 1761 into Leibo Hall under an appointed magistrate, while the Yang family was left with only a minor native commission.
zh: 雷波是金沙江北岸、凉山深处的彝族山地，与江对岸的乌蒙相望。1276年元朝置雷波长官司，由当地阿卓部的酋长世袭，后来一度并入马湖属下的蛮夷长官司。1371年阿卓土长匹夜随马湖总管安济归附明朝，长官司得以恢复，阿卓家族还被赐汉姓杨。依仗凉山的险峻峡谷，杨氏土司在明朝盛时仍保有很大的自治权。1704年，阿卓十三世孙杨喇哇向清朝投诚，被授为雷波千万贯正长官司。1728年土司杨明义参与彝民抗拒改土归流的起事，清军剿平，革去土司头衔；次年改土归流，置雷波卫，1761年又升为雷波厅，派通判治理，杨家只保留下一个低级土职。

en: The Duchy of Lower Bavaria was created in 1255 by the first partition of the Wittelsbach lands, when Duke Louis II kept Upper Bavaria and his brother Henry XIII took the eastern country along the lower Danube with his seat at Landshut. In 1337 the duke was Henry XIV, who had inherited as a child in 1310 under the guardianship of his cousin the Emperor Louis IV; his quarrels over the partition with his brother Otto IV and his cousin Henry XV drove him into alliance with his father-in-law John of Bohemia, and early that year he joined the Bohemian king on the Teutonic Order's winter campaign in Prussia. Reconciled with the emperor in 1339, Henry died of leprosy a few months later, and his young son John I followed him to the grave in 1340, whereupon Louis IV inherited Lower Bavaria and reunited the whole Wittelsbach duchy. It was split again after the emperor's death, producing the duchies of Bavaria-Straubing and Bavaria-Landshut in 1353, and the Bavarian lands were only permanently rejoined in 1505 after the Landshut War of Succession. Rival claims to Lower Bavaria later helped provoke the War of the Bavarian Succession of 1778 to 1779.
zh: 下巴伐利亚公国形成于1255年维特尔斯巴赫家族的第一次分邦：路易二世保留上巴伐利亚，其弟亨利十三世取得多瑙河下游的东部疆土，以兰茨胡特为治所。1337年在位的是亨利十四世，他1310年幼年继位，由堂兄皇帝路易四世监护；他因分邦纠纷与弟弟奥托四世、堂兄亨利十五世相争，转而联姻并结盟岳父波希米亚国王约翰，并在这一年年初随约翰参加条顿骑士团在普鲁士的冬季战役。1339年他与皇帝和解，数月后死于麻风病，幼子约翰一世又于1340年夭折，路易四世遂继承下巴伐利亚，重新统一了整个维特尔斯巴赫公国。皇帝死后公国再度分裂，1353年分出巴伐利亚-施特劳宾和巴伐利亚-兰茨胡特两支，直到1505年兰茨胡特继承战争之后，巴伐利亚诸邦才永久合一。后来围绕下巴伐利亚的继承权之争又促成了1778至1779年的巴伐利亚继承战争。

en: The Commune of Como was a Lombard city state on the lake of the same name, whose territory once stretched across the diocese of Como into Bellinzona, Chiavenna and the Valtellina. It fought Milan for mastery of the western Lombard roads and was utterly defeated in the Decennial War of 1118 to 1127, when the Milanese razed the city, sparing only the churches. Emperor Frederick Barbarossa restored its independence and in 1175 granted it an imperial diploma, and Como remained a Ghibelline stronghold against the Guelph cities. From the late twelfth century the Rusca, or Rusconi, family dominated the town as leaders of the Ghibelline faction against the Vitani. Loterio Rusca, acclaimed Lord of the People in 1276, forced Milan to recognize his rule and recovered Bellinzona; the family became lords of Como, Bellinzona, Chiavenna and the Valtellina and counts of Locarno and Lugano. Franchino I Rusca turned this into a personal lordship as imperial vicar, but in 1335 Azzone Visconti of Milan conquered Como and annexed it. Later Rusca attempts to restore the lordship, in 1412 and under the short-lived Republic of Saint Abundius of 1447, ended when Francesco Sforza finally subjected Como to the Duchy of Milan in 1450.
zh: 科莫公社是伦巴第的城市邦国，位于同名湖畔，领土曾横跨科莫教区，远及贝林佐纳、基亚文纳和瓦尔泰利纳。它与米兰争夺伦巴第西部道路的控制权，在1118—1127年的十年战争中惨败，米兰人拆毁全城，只留下教堂。皇帝腓特烈一世恢复了它的独立，并于1175年授予帝国特许状，科莫由此成为对抗归尔甫诸城的吉伯林重镇。12世纪后期起，鲁斯卡（又称鲁斯科尼）家族作为吉伯林派领袖主导该城，与维塔尼家族抗衡。1276年，洛泰里奥·鲁斯卡被拥戴为人民领袖，迫使米兰承认其统治并收回贝林佐纳；家族成为科莫、贝林佐纳、基亚文纳和瓦尔泰利纳的领主，以及洛迦诺和卢加诺的伯爵。弗兰基诺一世·鲁斯卡以帝国代理人身份把这一切变成个人统治，但1335年米兰的阿佐内·维斯康蒂征服并吞并了科莫。此后鲁斯卡家族两度试图恢复统治，包括1412年的起事和1447年短命的圣阿邦迪奥共和国，都在1450年弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎把科莫最终并入米兰公国后告终。

en:
The Khorshidi were the Lur dynasty of Little Lorestan, the mountain country west of the Zagros ruled from Khorramabad, and their state is the polity that bears their name. They sprang from the Salburi clan of the Jangru'i tribe, and it was under their rule that the Lur identity of the region consolidated. Their founder Shoja al-Din Khorshid, once an officer of the Seljuk Turkic lord Husamuddin Shuhli, made himself independent lord of Lur-e Kuchak after 1184, overthrew the Annazid chief Sorkhab Ayyar and drove the raiding Bayat Turks back across the border; he died about 1224. Ruling as atabegs under Mongol overlordship, his descendants survived the purges of the Ilkhans Abaqa and Ghazan, and after 1330 a new Khorshidi line claiming descent from Ali took power, the branch that held Khorramabad in 1337.

Timur's invasion of 1386 wrecked the kingdom: Borujerd was sacked and the fortress of Khorramabad razed, and the atabeg Izz al-Din was deported to Turkestan. The dynasty recovered under the Timurid decline, and in the Safavid age its chiefs played the shahs against the Ottomans until Shahverdi Khan's repeated revolts ended with his capture and execution at Changuleh in 1597, when Shah Abbas dissolved the Khorshidi realm and granted it to the Solvizi family.
zh:
霍什迪是小洛雷斯坦的卢尔人王朝，世代统辖扎格罗斯山脉以西、以霍拉马巴德为都的山地国家。他们出自江鲁伊部落的萨尔布里氏族，洛雷斯坦地区的卢尔族群认同正是在其治下凝聚成型。开国君主舒贾丁·霍尔希德原是塞尔柱突厥领主胡萨姆丁·舒赫利的部将，1184年后自立为小洛雷斯坦之主，推翻安纳兹王朝首领苏尔哈布·阿亚尔，又把劫掠的巴亚特突厥人逐回境外，约1224年去世。其后裔以阿塔贝格身份在蒙古宗主权下存续，熬过了伊儿汗国阿八哈和合赞汗的清洗；1330年后，一支自称阿里后裔的霍什迪新支系掌权，也就是1337年据有霍拉马巴德的王族。

1386年帖木儿入侵重创了这个王国：博鲁杰尔德遭洗劫，霍拉马巴德堡垒被夷平，阿塔贝格伊兹丁被流放突厥斯坦。王朝在帖木儿势力衰落后复兴，到萨非时代又在沙阿与奥斯曼人之间周旋，直到沙维尔迪汗屡次反叛，于1597年在章古莱被俘处死，沙阿·阿拔斯随即解散霍什迪政权，把它封给索尔维齐家族。

en: Lucerne is a city state where the river Reuss leaves Lake Lucerne, grown up around the Benedictine monastery of Saint Leodegar, founded around 750 and later held by Murbach Abbey in Alsace. The town won independence from the abbey in 1178 and prospered as the northern gateway of the St Gotthard trade route. After the Habsburgs took over the monastery's rights, Lucerne swore an eternal alliance with Uri, Schwyz and Unterwalden on 7 November 1332, becoming the first city to join the Swiss Confederacy. Its victory over the Habsburgs at Sempach in 1386 opened an age of expansion, and Emperor Sigismund granted it imperial immediacy in 1415. While neighbouring cities turned Protestant, Lucerne kept the old faith, staging its passion plays from 1453 and welcoming the Jesuits in 1567 with the backing of Cardinal Carlo Borromeo; after the Catholic triumph at Kappel in 1531 it led the Catholic party in the confederacy until the Protestant victory in the Toggenburg War of 1712. A peasant army besieged it during the peasant war of 1653. The medieval Chapel Bridge still spans the Reuss. French troops in 1798 ended the rule of the old patrician government, and Lucerne entered the new Helvetic order.
zh: 卢塞恩是罗伊斯河流出卢塞恩湖处的城市邦国，围绕约750年建立的圣莱奥德加本笃会修道院发展起来，这座修道院后来归阿尔萨斯的米尔巴克修道院所有。1178年，卢塞恩摆脱修道院统治获得自治，并作为圣哥达商道的北大门而繁荣。哈布斯堡接管修道院的权利后，卢塞恩于1332年11月7日与乌利、施维茨和翁特瓦尔登立下永久同盟，成为第一个加入瑞士同盟的城市。1386年它在森帕赫击败哈布斯堡，开启扩张时代；1415年皇帝西吉斯蒙德授予它帝国直辖地位。邻近城市纷纷改宗新教时，卢塞恩坚守旧信仰，1453年起上演受难剧，1567年又在枢机主教卡洛·博罗梅奥支持下迎来耶稣会士；1531年卡佩尔之战天主教一方获胜后，它长期领导同盟中的天主教阵营，直到1712年托根堡战争新教一方取胜。1653年农民战争中，一支农民军队曾围攻该城。中世纪修建的卡佩尔桥横跨罗伊斯河。1798年法军入侵终结了旧贵族政府的统治，卢塞恩被纳入新的海尔维第体制。

en: The Duchy of Łęczyca, centered on the fortified town of Łęczyca in central Poland, took shape around 1231 when Konrad I of Masovia turned the old Łęczyca province of the Seniorate Realm into a hereditary Piast duchy. In 1263 its eastern lands were split off to form the Duchy of Sieradz, and the remaining Łęczyca territory passed through several branches of the dynasty before coming to Władysław the Hunchback, the Piast duke shown ruling in 1337. When he died without heirs in 1352, the duchy escheated to the Polish crown and was reorganized by Casimir III the Great into the Łęczyca Voivodeship, one of the lands of the Polish Crown.
zh: 文奇察公国以波兰中部设防城镇文奇察为中心，约1231年马佐夫舍的康拉德一世将旧日王储领中的文奇察省改为皮亚斯特家族世袭公国时形成。1263年，其东部土地被分出，另立谢拉兹公国，剩余的文奇察领地几经王朝支系转手，最后传到1337年在任的皮亚斯特公爵“驼背者”瓦迪斯瓦夫手中。他于1352年无嗣而终，公国收归波兰王室，被卡齐米日三世改组为文奇察省，成为波兰王冠领地之一。

en: Landau, a wine-town on the Queich in the Palatinate, was first recorded in 1106 and belonged to the counts of Leiningen. King Rudolf I granted it a town charter in 1274 and declared it a Free Imperial Town in 1291, but Prince-Bishop Emich of Speyer seized the town in 1324, so that in 1337 its civic liberties were suspended under episcopal rule. The citizens only recovered their ancient rights from Emperor Maximilian I in 1511. After the Peace of Westphalia in 1648 Landau passed to France, and from 1680 it was one of the Décapole, the ten free cities of Alsace; Louis XIV's engineer Vauban rebuilt its fortifications between 1688 and 1699 into one of Europe's strongest citadels. In the War of the Spanish Succession it changed hands four times through the sieges of 1702, 1703, 1704 and 1713, and the folding hooded carriage first used there by Emperor Joseph I became known across Europe as a landau. The town remained French until 1815, when the Congress of Vienna assigned it to the Kingdom of Bavaria.
zh: 兰道是普法尔茨地区奎希河畔的葡萄酒城镇，1106年首见记载，原属莱宁根伯爵家族。国王鲁道夫一世于1274年授予它城市特许状，1291年又宣布它为帝国自由市，但施派尔采邑主教埃米希于1324年占领该城，因此1337年时它的市民自由权在主教统治下中止。市民直到1511年才从皇帝马克西米利安一世手中恢复旧有权利。1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》后兰道划归法国，1680年起成为阿尔萨斯十城联盟的自由市之一；路易十四的工程师沃邦在1688至1699年间把它的城防重建成欧洲最坚固的要塞之一。西班牙王位继承战争中，它在1702、1703、1704和1713年的四次围攻战中四度易手；皇帝约瑟夫一世在此首次使用的折叠顶篷马车后来在欧洲被称为‘兰道车’。该城一直属于法国，1815年维也纳会议将它划归巴伐利亚王国。

en: The Margraviate of Landsberg took its name from Landsberg Castle above the Saale, in the old Osterland between the Saale and the Mulde. Its lands, the westernmost part of the former March of Lusatia, included Delitzsch, Grimma, Zwickau and the rising town of Leipzig, with Weißenfels as the margravial residence. Margrave Theodoric I of Lusatia built the castle from 1170 and styled himself margrave of Landsberg, but the territory became an imperial state only in 1261, when Margrave Henry the Illustrious of Meissen carved it out of Lusatia for his younger son Theodoric. When Theodoric's son Frederick Tuta died without heirs in 1291, the march was sold to the Ascanian margraves of Brandenburg. In 1327 it passed by marriage to the Welf duke Magnus I of Brunswick-Lüneburg, whose wife Sophia of Brandenburg-Stendal was the last Ascanian heiress; in 1347 Magnus sold Landsberg to Margrave Frederick II of Meissen, returning it to the Wettins, for whom it formed, with Meissen itself, one of the core lands of their later Saxon electorate. Its arms, the Landsberg pales, live on in the city arms of Leipzig, Chemnitz and Dresden.
zh: 兰茨贝格藩侯国得名于萨勒河畔高地上的兰茨贝格城堡，地处萨勒河与穆尔德河之间的旧奥斯特兰地区。它的领土是旧卢萨蒂亚藩侯国最西的部分，包括德利奇、格里马、茨维考和正在兴起的莱比锡，藩侯驻地设在魏森费尔斯。卢萨蒂亚藩侯狄奥多里克一世于1170年起修建这座城堡，并自称兰茨贝格藩侯，但直到1261年，迈森藩侯亨利三世（杰出者）才把这片土地从卢萨蒂亚划出，为幼子狄奥多里克单独立为帝国领地。1291年狄奥多里克之子腓特烈·图塔无嗣而终，藩侯国被卖给勃兰登堡的阿斯坎尼家族。1327年，它通过婚姻转入韦尔夫家族的不伦瑞克—吕讷堡公爵马格努斯一世手中，他的妻子勃兰登堡—施滕达尔的索菲娅是阿斯坎尼家最后的女继承人；1347年马格努斯把兰茨贝格卖给迈森藩侯腓特烈二世，使它重回韦廷家族，并与迈森一起构成后来萨克森选侯国的核心领地之一。它的纹章“兰茨贝格竖条”保存在莱比锡、开姆尼茨和德累斯顿的市徽中。

en: Leinster was one of the traditional provinces of Gaelic Ireland, the kingdom of the Laigin in the east of the island, whose early kings had also been high kings of Ireland. Its later medieval rulers came from the Uí Cheinnselaig dynasty, the MacMurroughs; the most famous of them, Diarmait Mac Murchada, was driven out in 1166 and called in Norman help in 1170, opening the way to the Anglo-Norman invasion, after which most of Leinster passed to the English Pale and the Earls of Kildare. A reduced kingdom survived in Wexford, Carlow and the Wicklow Mountains under the Kavanaghs, descendants of Diarmait's son Domhnall Caomhánach, who kept their seat at Ferns and harried the settler colony for centuries. Art MacMurrough-Kavanagh, king from 1375 to 1417, was the most formidable of the line, tying down Richard II of England on his Irish expeditions of 1394 and 1395. The Tudors gradually absorbed the lordship during the sixteenth century, and the former kingdom lived on only as the English-administered Province of Leinster.
zh: 伦斯特是盖尔爱尔兰的传统省份之一，是爱尔兰东部 莱金人的王国，其早期诸王还曾出任爱尔兰至高王。中世纪后期的统治家族出自 乌伊·肯塞莱格谱系的麦克默罗家族；最著名的迪尔梅德·麦克默罗于1166年被逐，1170年引诺曼援兵回爱尔兰，由此开启盎格鲁-诺曼人的入侵，此后伦斯特大部分土地落入英国人的“佩尔”和基尔代尔伯爵之手。一个缩水的王国在韦克斯福德、卡洛和威克洛山区延续下来，统治者是迪尔梅德之子多纳尔·卡瓦纳的后裔卡瓦纳家族，他们以费恩斯为据点，数百年间不断袭扰殖民区。1375至1417年在位的阿尔特·麦克默罗-卡瓦纳是该家族最强悍的国王，曾牵制住英王理查二世1394和1395年的爱尔兰远征。都铎王朝在16世纪逐步吞并这一领地，古老王国最终只以英国治下的伦斯特省之名留存。

en: Lekia, the kingdom also called Lakz or Lakzan in Arabic writings, was the medieval state of the Lezgic-speaking peoples in the Samur river basin of southern Dagestan, known to Arab geographers as the Land of Lakz. In the eighth century its king Arbis ibn Basbas resisted the Arab commander Marwan ibn Muhammad, and in 1032 Lekian troops fought beside the emirate of Derbent against invaders from the north. The Shirvanshahs later occupied parts of the country and collected tribute, and by the thirteenth century the kingdom was disintegrating into self-governing village unions and hereditary lordships, among them the Kurakh union centered on the mountain settlement of Kurakh. These small Lezgin societies kept their independence through the later Middle Ages and often raided Georgia alongside other Dagestani peoples, until Russian expansion into the Caucasus in the early nineteenth century brought them under imperial rule.
zh: 莱基亚在阿拉伯文献中又称拉克兹或拉克赞，是达吉斯坦南部萨穆尔河流域列兹金语各族的中世纪王国，阿拉伯地理学家称之为拉克兹之地。8世纪时，国王阿尔比斯·伊本·巴斯巴斯曾抵抗阿拉伯统帅马尔万·伊本·穆罕默德的进攻；1032年，莱基亚军队又与杰尔宾特埃米尔国并肩抵御北方来犯者。后来希尔万沙王朝占领其部分领土并征收贡赋。到13世纪，王国逐渐瓦解为自治的村社联盟与世袭领地，以山城库拉赫为中心的库拉赫联盟便是其中之一。这些列兹金小邦在中世纪后期保持独立，常与达吉斯坦其他民族一起袭扰格鲁吉亚，直到19世纪初俄罗斯向高加索扩张，才将它们纳入帝国统治。

en: The Landgraviate of Leuchtenberg was a small state of the Holy Roman Empire in the northern Upper Palatine Forest, east of Amberg, held from Leuchtenberg Castle and later from Pfreimd. Its lords were raised to comital rank in 1158 and named landgraves in 1196, and in the fifteenth century they won a seat among the imperial princes. The native house died with Landgrave Maximilian Adam in 1646, when Leuchtenberg passed to the Bavarian Wittelsbach Albert VI, who had married a Leuchtenberg heiress; from 1650 it was held by the Bavarian duke Maximilian Philipp Hieronymus as Bavaria-Leuchtenberg. During the War of the Spanish Succession the emperor treated the landgraviate as an escheated fief and enfeoffed the Lamberg family between 1708 and 1714, after which the Peace of Rastatt returned it to Bavaria. The territory, only about 250 square kilometres, was dissolved into the Kingdom of Bavaria in 1808. After Napoleon's fall the empty title of Duke of Leuchtenberg was granted to Eugène de Beauharnais.
zh: 洛伊希滕贝格领地伯国是神圣罗马帝国的一个小邦，地处上普法尔茨林山北部、安贝格以东，最初以洛伊希滕贝格城堡为统治中心，后来移治普弗赖姆德。其领主家族于1158年升为伯爵，1196年受封领地伯爵，15世纪又在帝国诸侯院中取得席位。1646年，末代领地伯爵马克西米利安·亚当去世，本家绝嗣，洛伊希滕贝格传给娶了该家族女继承人的巴伐利亚维特尔斯巴赫家族的阿尔布雷希特六世；1650年起由巴伐利亚公爵马克西米利安·菲利普·希罗尼穆斯以巴伐利亚‑洛伊希滕贝格之名领有。西班牙王位继承战争期间，皇帝将这块领地视为收归帝国的采邑，于1708年至1714年封给兰贝格家族，《拉施塔特和约》后又归还巴伐利亚。这片面积仅约250平方公里的领地于1808年并入巴伐利亚王国。拿破仑倒台后，没有实际领地的洛伊希滕贝格公爵头衔被授予欧仁·德·博阿尔内。

en: The Duchy of Legnica, with its capital at Legnica in Lower Silesia, was one of the Silesian duchies ruled by the Silesian Piasts. Nearby Legnickie Pole was the site of the battle of 1241 in which the Mongols defeated High Duke Henry II the Pious. The duchy itself was formed in 1248, when Bolesław II the Bald withdrew to Legnica after ceding Wrocław to his brother. In 1337 its duke was Bolesław III the Generous, who in 1329 had been forced to pay homage to King John of Bohemia, making Legnica a Bohemian fief like most of its Silesian neighbours. The local Piast line grew weak through family partitions, and when it died out in 1419 the duchy passed to the Brzeg branch; Bohemia briefly annexed it as a lapsed fief in 1436. The Reformation reached Legnica as early as 1522 and the population turned Lutheran, after which the 1526 succession of the Habsburgs to Bohemia brought recurring religious and dynastic strife. The last Piast duke, George William, died in 1675 and Legnica fell under direct Habsburg rule, until Frederick the Great of Prussia seized it in the First Silesian War and the peace of 1742 confirmed Prussian control.
zh: 莱格尼察公国是西里西亚诸公国之一，都于下西里西亚的莱格尼察，由皮亚斯特王朝的西里西亚支系统治。1241年，附近的莱格尼茨基波列发生大战，蒙古人击败并杀死了波兰大公亨里克二世。公国本身形成于1248年，博莱斯瓦夫二世“秃子”把弗罗茨瓦夫让给弟弟后退居莱格尼察。1337年在位的是博莱斯瓦夫三世“慷慨者”，他已于1329年被迫向波希米亚国王约翰行臣服礼，莱格尼察因此和多数西里西亚邻邦一样成为波希米亚的封邑。当地的皮亚斯特支系因不断分家而衰弱，1419年绝嗣后公国转入布热格支系手中，1436年还曾被波希米亚作为无主封邑短暂没收。宗教改革早在1522年就传入莱格尼察，居民改信路德宗；1526年哈布斯堡家族继承波希米亚王位后，宗教与王朝纷争不断。末代皮亚斯特公爵格奥尔格·威廉于1675年去世，莱格尼察改由哈布斯堡直接统治，直到普鲁士的腓特烈大帝在第一次西里西亚战争中将其夺取，1742年的和约确认了普鲁士的统治。

en: Linge was a small pre-Islamic kingdom of the Gayo people in the Gayo Highlands of central Aceh, around present-day Linge south of Lake Laut Tawar. Known only from oral tradition, it is said to have arisen in the tenth or eleventh century under King Meurah Adi Genali, before the highlands passed under Aceh's rule.
zh: 邻稽是加约人在亚齐中部加约高地建立的前伊斯兰小王国，地当劳特塔瓦尔湖以南的邻稽一带。其史事仅存于口传，相传于10或11世纪在穆拉·阿迪·格纳利王时兴起，后来高地并入亚齐版图。

en: Langkasuka was one of the earliest Hindu-Buddhist kingdoms of the Malay Peninsula, probably founded in the second century on the coast near modern Pattani, where ruins at Yarang mark its likely heartland. The Chinese Liang shu describes a walled capital rich in camphor and aloeswood, and records embassies from its king Bhagadatta to the Liang court in 515, 523, 531 and 568. Its early power was checked by Funan, and from the eighth century it passed into the shadow of Srivijaya, whose tributary it still was in the twelfth; the Chola king Rajendra I raided it in 1025 during his campaign against Srivijaya. Chinese trade guides of the Song and Yuan still list it as a source of lakawood, ivory and hornbill casques. Its end is obscure: Malay annals place its destruction around 1370, while other accounts have it surviving into the fifteenth century, when the Pattani kingdom arose on its former lands and its people turned to Islam.
zh: 狼牙修是马来半岛最早的印度教—佛教王国之一，约建于2世纪，位于今北大年附近的海岸，也兰一带的遗址很可能就是它的核心地带。中国《梁书》记载它有城墙环绕的国都，盛产樟脑与沉香，国王跋伽达多曾于515、523、531和568年遣使梁朝。它早期的国势受到扶南遏制，8世纪起落入三佛齐的势力范围，到12世纪仍是三佛齐属邦；1025年，朱罗国王拉金德拉一世在征讨三佛齐时曾洗劫此地。宋、元两代的商旅笔记仍把它列为产降真香、象牙和犀鸟盔的地方。它的结局并不清晰：马来史籍称其约在1370年灭亡，也有说法认为它延续到15世纪，故地后来兴起北大年王国，居民也改宗伊斯兰教。

en: Longquan, centred on Longquanping in present-day Fenggang County, was a Yuan-era zhangguansi on the western edge of the Sizhou chiefdom; Longquanping itself briefly served as Sizhou's seat after 1277. The Ming kept the Dabao Longquan zhangguansi until 1601, when it was replaced by Longquan County under Shiqian Prefecture.
zh: 龙泉土司以龙泉坪为治所，当今凤冈县一带，元代处在思州土司的西缘；1277年以后思州的治所也曾一度迁到龙泉坪。明代沿袭设置大保龙泉长官司，至1601年废司置龙泉县，划归石阡府管辖。

en: Lingtsang was one of the five independent kingdoms of Kham, centered on the upper Yangtze valley north of Derge, in what is now southern Sêrxü County. Its Gyelpo rulers claimed descent from the epic hero King Gesar of Ling, and in the Tibetan Empire period its capital Denkok was a leading center of Kham; Lingtsang forces raided the Tsurphu monastery near Lhasa in 1216. Under Sakya rule the local dynasty, whose heads were monks, received overlordship over Domé, and the Yuan knew the territory as Dokham, enfeoffing its lord as chief military commander of the region. After Sakyapa power ended Lingtsang became independent, and in the early fifteenth century the Ming court granted its kings the titles State Master of Consecration and Religious King of Promoting Goodness to keep the Kham caravan routes open. Around 1600 Lingtsang still held Derge under its control, but the rising Derge kingdom eclipsed it after 1630. The Qing enrolled Lingtsang as a pacification commission in 1728, and a mid-eighteenth-century attempt to recover its lost lands ended in defeat by Derge, leaving it a vassal.
zh: 灵藏又译林葱，是康区五个独立王国之一，位于德格以北的长江上游河谷，即今石渠县南部一带。其甲布王统自称出自史诗英雄格萨尔王的岭国王族；吐蕃帝国时期，它的首府登科曾是康区的人文中心，灵藏的军队还在1216年劫掠了拉萨附近的楚布寺。萨迦派掌权时，世代为僧的当地首领受命管辖朵甘思，元朝也以“朵甘思”之名册封其为管军都元帅。萨迦统治结束后灵藏成为独立王国，15世纪初明朝为保障康区商路畅通，册封其王为灌顶国师、赞善教王。1600年前后灵藏仍控制着德格，但1630年前后德格崛起并反超。1728年清朝设林葱安抚司；18世纪中叶，灵藏试图收复失地，被德格击败，沦为德格的附庸。

en: Longzhou was a hill prefecture on the upper Fu River in northern Sichuan, covering the country around present-day Pingwu and Jiangyou, a land of Di and Qiang mountain dwellers. The Shu Han kingdom built the Jiangyou barrier there in 219, and in 263 its keeper Ma Miao surrendered without a fight to the Wei general Deng Ai on the march that destroyed Shu. The Western Wei created Longzhou in 553, with its seat at Nanba; under the Tang it survived as a loose-rein prefecture, and under the Yuan it was called Long'an department. The Ming reorganized it repeatedly after 1373 and in 1432 confirmed the Longzhou pacification commission under the hereditary Xue chieftains, adding the Sinangri chief's office in 1446. In 1566 the tusi Xue Zhaogan rose in revolt and was crushed; the court then replaced native rule with regular officials and created Long'an Prefecture, governing Pingwu, Jiangyou and Shiquan counties. Under the Qing it gained Zhangming County in 1731, while one native office remained within its borders.
zh: 龙州是四川北部涪江上游的山区州，辖今平武、江油一带，本是氐、羌山民的居地。219年蜀汉在此修筑江由关，即后来的江油关；263年守将马邈面对偷渡阴平的魏将邓艾不战而降，蜀汉随之灭亡。553年西魏平蜀后置龙州，治南坝；唐代降为羁縻州，元代称龙安州。明朝在1373年之后屡次调整建置，1432年定为龙州宣抚司，由世袭薛氏土司统领，1446年又增设思囊日安抚司。1566年土司薛兆乾起兵叛乱被讨平，朝廷乘机改土归流，置龙安府，下辖平武、江油、石泉三县，派流官治理。清代沿置，1731年增领彰明县，府境之内仍保留一个土司。

en: Lahijan is the historic capital of Bia-pish, the eastern half of Gilan beyond the Safid Rud, and one of the main silk markets of the Caspian lowlands. In the twelfth century it replaced Hawsam as the seat of the Zaydi Alid sayyids, who governed eastern Gilan through a loose array of local clans, and the Ilkhan Öljaitü's campaign of 1306 and 1307 added Gilan to the Mongol empire only in name. Around 1367 the sayyid Ali Kia founded the Kar-Kiya dynasty, which made Lahijan its capital and united Bia-pish under its rule for more than two centuries. The Kar-Kiya rulers helped Shah Ismail found the Safavid state and became its vassals, but the last of them, Khan Ahmad Khan, turned to Russia for support, so Shah Abbas I conquered Gilan in 1592 and ended both the Kar-Kiya and the western Eshaqvand dynasties. Russian troops occupied Lahijan in 1725 during the collapse of Safavid power.
zh: 拉希詹是萨菲德河以东吉兰东半部比亚皮什地区的历史都城，也是里海低地主要的生丝市场之一。12世纪，它取代豪萨姆成为栽德派阿里德圣裔的驻地，后者在松散的地方氏族格局下治理东吉兰，伊利汗完者都1306—1307年的远征也只是在名义上把吉兰纳入蒙古帝国。约1367年，圣裔阿里·基亚建立卡尔基亚王朝，以拉希詹为都，在此后两个多世纪里统一了比亚皮什。卡尔基亚君主曾帮助伊斯玛仪一世建立萨非国家并成为其附庸，但末代君主汗·艾哈迈德汗转而向俄国求援，阿拔斯一世遂于1592年征服吉兰，终结了卡尔基亚王朝和西吉兰的埃沙克万德王朝。1725年萨非政权崩溃之际，俄国军队占领了拉希詹。

en: Lahul was a high Himalayan valley country around the upper Chandra and Bhaga rivers, whose waters meet at Tandi to form the Chenab; its chief seat was Keylong, reached from the Kullu valley over the Rohtang pass. The thinly populated valleys were Tibetan Buddhist, ruled by local hereditary chiefs titled thakur, whose strongholds included the fort and monastery of Gondhla. Through the Middle Ages Lahul lay within the orbit of the kingdom of Ladakh, although the rajas of Chamba and Kullu repeatedly competed for its tribute. It passed under Kullu's control in the seventeenth century, notably during the reigns of Raja Biddhi Singh from 1672 to 1688 and Raja Man Singh from 1688 to 1719, the decades around the Tibet-Ladakh-Mughal war of 1679 to 1684 that severed Ladakh's old claims. Lahul also grew wealthy on the Central Asian caravan route linking the Punjab and Kullu with Ladakh and Yarkand, until Dogra armies overran the valley in the early nineteenth century.
zh: 拉胡尔是喜马拉雅高山谷地中的小国，地处钱德拉河与巴加河上游，两河在坦迪汇合为奇纳布河；其首要据点是吉隆，取道罗唐山口可与古卢山谷相通。谷地人烟稀少，居民信奉藏传佛教，由世代承袭、称塔库尔的本地酋长统治，贡德拉的堡垒与寺院便是他们的据点之一。中世纪时，拉胡尔一直处在拉达克王国的势力范围内，昌巴和古卢的罗阇则一再争夺它的贡赋。17世纪它转入古卢控制之下，尤其是1672年至1688年罗阇比迪·辛格及其后继者曼·辛格（1688—1719年在位）时期；其间1679年至1684年的西藏—拉达克—莫卧儿战争终结了拉达克旧日的宗主权。连接旁遮普、古卢与拉达克、叶尔羌的中亚商路也给拉胡尔带来财富，直到19世纪初多格拉军队攻占这片谷地。

en: Lahaina, anciently called Lele, is a sheltered anchorage on the dry north-west coast of Maui, famed for its breadfruit groves. It was the seat of the high chiefs of western Maui: the line began with Haho, son of Paumakua, and under Kaka'alaneo the court was fixed at Lele on the hill of Keka'a, while the chiefs of Hana still ruled the eastern half of the island independently. His descendant Pi'ilani, who first united all of Maui, also controlled Lanai, Kahoolawe and parts of Moloka'i from this base. In 1738 the fields above Lahaina saw a series of battles between the Maui chief Kamehamehanui and his half-brother, backed by the rulers of Hawai'i and O'ahu. Captain James Cook's ships appeared off the coast in 1778, and in 1793 George Vancouver found the district impoverished by years of war. After unification Kamehameha I anchored his war-canoe fleet here in 1802, American missionaries opened a station in 1823, and by the 1830s Lahaina was the kingdom's foremost whaling port, guarded after 1831 by a stone fort against riotous sailors.
zh: 拉海纳古称莱莱，是毛伊岛干燥西北海岸一处避风锚地，以面包树林闻名。它曾是西毛伊历代最高酋长的驻地：世系始于保马库阿之子哈霍，到卡卡阿拉内奥时，宫廷定在凯卡阿山丘上的莱莱，而哈纳的酋长们仍独立统治着毛伊东半部。他的后裔皮伊拉尼首次统一全毛伊，并以此为基地控制拉奈、卡霍奥拉韦和莫洛凯的部分地区。1738年，拉海纳以北的土地上爆发了一系列战役，交战双方是毛伊酋长卡美哈梅哈努伊与其异母兄弟，背后分别有夏威夷岛和瓦胡岛的统治者撑腰。1778年，库克船长的船队出现在外海；1793年乔治·温哥华见到的这片地区已因连年战争而贫困。统一之后，卡美哈梅哈一世于1802年将其战舟舰队停泊于此，美国传教士于1823年在此设立传教站；到19世纪30年代，拉海纳已是王国首屈一指的捕鲸港，并自1831年起以一座石堡防备闹事的水手。

en: The Lordship of Lichtenberg was a Lower Alsatian territory of the Holy Roman Empire, clustered around the family castle first recorded in 1206 above the village of Lichtenberg and spreading on both banks of the Rhine near Strasbourg and Hagenau. The lords built their power on toll and escort rights over the Lombardy-to-Flanders roads and on Rhine ferries, buying further castles and acquiring the Werd landgraves' estates in 1332; they also secured two bishoprics of Strasbourg for family members, Conrad III and John, who fed cathedral fiefs back to their kin. Around 1330 the inheritance was split between John II, who headed the elder line in 1337, and Louis III, and a web of internal treaties kept the two branches from drifting apart. By the fifteenth century the lordship covered more than two hundred villages and over thirty castles, but the last lords died without sons: the heiresses Anna and Elisabeth carried it to the counts of Hanau-Babenhausen and Zweibrücken-Bitsch, who partitioned it in 1480, Anna's heirs taking the name Hanau-Lichtenberg. When that Zweibrücken-Bitsch half fell in as well in 1570, the whole Lichtenberg inheritance was reunited under Hanau-Lichtenberg, whose castle surrendered to French troops in 1678.
zh: 利希滕贝格领地是神圣罗马帝国在下阿尔萨斯的一块领土，核心是1206年首见记载、雄踞利希滕贝格村上方的家族城堡，产业分布在斯特拉斯堡和阿格诺附近的莱茵河两岸。领主们凭借对伦巴第至佛兰德商路的征税与护送权以及莱茵河渡口发家，不断购入城堡，并于1332年取得韦尔德方伯的产业；他们还把家族成员康拉德三世和约翰先后推上斯特拉斯堡主教之位，二人又把主教区的封邑回馈亲族。约1330年，遗产在1337年时长系的首领约翰二世与路德维希三世之间瓜分，一系列内部盟约使两支不致离散。到15世纪，该领地已涵盖两百多个村庄和三十多座城堡，但末代领主没有男嗣：女继承人安娜和伊丽莎白把它带给哈瑙—巴本豪森伯爵与茨韦布吕肯—比奇伯爵，两家于1480年瓜分其地，安娜的后代改称哈瑙—利希滕贝格。1570年茨韦布吕肯—比奇分得的那一半也无人继承，利希滕贝格的全部遗产遂在哈瑙—利希滕贝格名下重新合流，其城堡于1678年向法国军队投降。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Liège was an ecclesiastical principality of the Holy Roman Empire, ruled by a bishop who held a seat in the Imperial Diet. Between 980 and 985 Bishop Notker received secular rule of the County of Huy from Emperor Otto II, founding a state that kept its autonomy for nearly eight centuries; its schools made Liège known as the Athens of the North in the eleventh century. The principality grew through purchases and bequests, adding the lordship of Bouillon in 1096 and the county of Loon in 1366. In 1337 its ruler was Adolf II of the Mark, who in 1316 had settled the rights of bishop and towns by the Peace of Fexhe. Burgundian pressure grew after 1384, and the Liège Wars ended with the destruction of Dinant in 1466 and of Liège itself in 1468 by Charles the Bold. Never one of the Seventeen Provinces, the bishopric was later drawn into Habsburg strategy on the Spanish Road and joined the Counter-Reformation. The Liège Revolution of 1789 briefly set up a republic, but imperial troops restored the bishop in 1791; French armies annexed the principality in 1795, and after 1815 its lands passed to the United Kingdom of the Netherlands and in 1830 to Belgium.
zh: 列日采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国的教会邦国，主教作为邦君在帝国议会拥有席位。980至985年间，主教诺特克尔从皇帝奥托二世手中取得于伊伯国的世俗统治权，由此建立的国家在近八百年里维持着自治；11世纪时，列日的学府使它赢得北方的雅典之名。主教区通过购置和遗赠不断扩张，1096年取得布永领地，1366年兼并隆伯国。1337年的统治者是马克家族的阿道夫二世，他曾在1316年通过费克斯和约定下主教与城市的权利边界。1384年后勃艮第的压力日增，列日战争以大胆查理于1466年摧毁迪南、1468年摧毁列日本城告终。主教区从未加入十七省，后来被卷入哈布斯堡的西班牙之路战略并投身反宗教改革。1789年的列日革命一度建立共和国，但帝国军队于1791年恢复主教统治；1795年法兰西军队吞并这个邦国，1815年后其领土并入尼德兰联合王国，1830年成为比利时的一部分。

en: Ligor, later called Nakhon Si Thammarat, was the chief city of the east coast of the Malay Peninsula, on the site of the older Indianised kingdom of Tambralinga. Tambralinga traded with Song China from 1001 and grew rich on the traffic across the Kra Isthmus; in the mid-thirteenth century its king Chandrabhanu carried the throne's power overseas by invading Sri Lanka in 1247. Plague and defeat ended that line, and by the 1280s Tai rulers of the Phetchaburi-Ayodhya clan had taken the city, which appears in the Ramkhamhaeng inscription of 1283 as the southernmost tributary of Sukhothai, its Theravada Buddhist scholarship serving as a model for the whole Sukhothai kingdom. After Ramkhamhaeng's death it regained its independence, and in 1337 it was the dominant Thai mueang of the peninsula, with smaller towns as its own vassals. Majapahit's court poem of 1365 already counted it among Siam's lands, and in 1468 Ayutthaya listed it as one of its eight great cities. It kept its own dynasty under Ayutthayan overlordship, became a first-class province under Naresuan, and twice rebelled, in 1629 and 1688, before Taksin reabsorbed it in 1769. Briefly free again after Ayutthaya's fall, it was reduced to an ordinary governorship under the Bangkok kings, whose forces it led against Kedah in 1821 and 1831.
zh: 洛坤后称那空是贪玛叻，是马来半岛东海岸的首要城市，其前身是印度化古国单马令。单马令自1001年起与中国宋朝通商，凭借克拉地峡的过境贸易致富；13世纪中叶，国王旃陀跋努还在1247年跨海远征锡兰，把国力投到海外。瘟疫与战败终结了这一王族，到13世纪80年代，来自碧武里—阿踰陀家族的泰人统治者接管该城；1283年的兰甘亨碑铭把它列为素可泰最南端的属邦，其上座部佛学还成为整个素可泰王国的典范。兰甘亨死后它恢复独立，1337年时已是半岛上最强大的泰人城邦，麾下还有若干小城称臣。1365年满者伯夷的宫廷诗已把它算作暹罗之地，1468年阿瑜陀耶又将其列入八大城市之一。它在阿瑜陀耶宗主权下保留了自己的王朝，纳黎萱时期成为一等行省，并曾于1629年和1688年两度反叛，1769年被郑信重新收服。阿瑜陀耶陷落后它曾短暂自立，随后在曼谷诸王治下降为普通行省，1821年和1831年还由它领兵征讨吉打。

en: The Duchy of Limbourg was an imperial estate of the Holy Roman Empire between the Meuse and Aachen, ruled from the cliff-top town of Limbourg on the Vesdre in present-day Wallonia. It grew from a county built up around 1020 by Frederick of Lower Lorraine of the House of Ardenne, who raised Limbourg Castle; Emperor Henry IV recognised the ducal title in 1101, and Barbarossa confirmed the style Duke of Limbourg in 1165. The dukes widened their reach through marriage, Waleran III acquiring Luxembourg in 1214, but when the line failed with the childless death of the heiress Irmgard in 1283 the War of the Limburg Succession broke out, and John I of Brabant's victory at the Battle of Worringen in 1288 brought the duchy under Brabant in personal union. In 1337 it was thus held by John III of Brabant, though it remained a separate imperial state. In 1404 it passed to the Valois dukes of Burgundy and in 1482 to the Habsburgs, becoming one of the Seventeen Provinces of the Burgundian Circle; after the Spanish and then Austrian periods of the Southern Netherlands, French Revolutionary troops dissolved the duchy in 1794 and merged it into the Ourthe department.
zh: 林堡公国是神圣罗马帝国的帝国邦国，地处默兹河与亚琛之间，以今瓦隆尼亚境内韦德尔河畔悬崖上的林堡镇为统治中心。它起源于1020年前后下洛林公爵弗里德里希（阿登家族成员）围绕林堡城堡经营起来的伯国；1101年皇帝亨利四世承认其公爵头衔，1165年皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨确认林堡公爵称号。公爵们借联姻扩张，瓦勒兰三世于1214年取得卢森堡；1283年女继承人伊尔姆加德无嗣而终、家族绝嗣，引发林堡继承战争，1288年布拉班特的约翰一世在沃林根战役获胜，林堡以君合形式归入布拉班特。因此1337年时它由布拉班特的约翰三世统治，但仍是独立的帝国邦国。1404年它传给瓦卢瓦家族的勃艮第公爵，1482年转入哈布斯堡家族，成为勃艮第行政圈十七省之一；历经南尼德兰的西班牙与奥地利统治时期后，法国革命军于1794年解散公国，将其并入乌尔特省。

en: Lái'ān was the Lai'an route, a military-civilian command in the hill country of western Guangxi, with its seat near present-day Tianyang and Baise. It began as the Song Lai'an military district; in 1276 its officers Li Weiping and Cen Congyi surrendered to the Yuan, and the district was raised to a route governing a cluster of departments and chief's offices, among them the Anlong chief's office. The native Cen clan held the route command by hereditary right, and in 1319 the commander Cen Shixing rose against the Yuan and seized the Tanghuo department. When the Ming took over, the old route was split into the Anlong office around present-day Longlin and the Sicheng department around present-day Lingyun, dissolving the Lai'an polity into a set of smaller native units.
zh: 来安即来安路军民总管府，是广西西部山区的军民建制，治所在今田阳区、百色市一带。其前身是宋朝的来安军，1276年知来安军李维屏、知来安军兼知冻州事岑从义降元，来安军升为来安路，统辖包括安隆长官司在内的一批州县和长官司，长官以岑氏世袭。1319年，来安路总管岑世兴起兵叛元，据有唐火州。明代取其地后，将来安路旧境拆分为安隆司（今隆林各族自治县）和泗城州（今凌云县），来安旧邦就此解体为若干较小的土司。

en: The Grand Duchy of Lithuania grew out of the Baltic lands of Aukštaitija, whose tribes were united under Mindaugas, crowned Catholic king in 1253 before the country reverted to paganism. From Vilnius, traditionally founded by Grand Duke Gediminas, who reigned from about 1316 to 1341 and gave his name to the Gediminid dynasty, the duchy expanded over former Kievan Rus' principalities until it reached from the Baltic Sea to the Black Sea. In 1337 Gediminas still ruled a pagan state under constant attack from the Teutonic Knights and the Livonian Order; his letters to the Hanseatic towns invited merchants and friars to settle, but baptism was repeatedly postponed. His sons Algirdas and Kęstutis continued the expansion, and in 1385 Algirdas's son Jogaila accepted the Union of Krewo and in 1386 married the Polish queen, converting Europe's last pagan state to Christianity. Under Vytautas the Great the Lithuanians crushed the Teutonic Knights at Grunwald in 1410. The Union of Lublin of 1569 merged the grand duchy with Poland into the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, though Lithuania kept its own laws, army and treasury. The Constitution of 3 May 1791 ended that separate status, and after the Kościuszko Uprising the partitions of 1795 divided Lithuania between Russia, Prussia and Austria.
zh: 立陶宛大公国起源于奥克什泰蒂亚的波罗的海诸部，各部在明道加斯治下统一，他于1253年加冕为天主教国王，此后国家又恢复了多神信仰。大公格迪米纳斯约在1316年至1341年在位，相传定都维尔纽斯，他创立的王朝也被称为格迪米纳斯王朝；大公国在其治下吞并了原基辅罗斯的诸多公国，疆域从波罗的海一直延伸到黑海。1337年的立陶宛仍是多神教国家，不断遭到条顿骑士团和利沃尼亚骑士团的进攻；格迪米纳斯曾致信汉萨诸城，邀请商人和修道士前来定居，受洗却一再推迟。他的儿子阿尔吉尔达斯与科斯图提斯继续扩张，1385年阿尔吉尔达斯之子雅盖沃接受克雷沃联合，1386年迎娶波兰女王，使这个欧洲最后的多神教国家皈依基督教。维陶塔斯大帝在位时，立陶宛于1410年在格伦瓦德击溃条顿骑士团。1569年的卢布林联合使大公国与波兰合并为波兰立陶宛联邦，但立陶宛保留了自己的法律、军队和国库。1791年的五三宪法取消了这一独立地位，科希丘什科起义后，1795年的瓜分使立陶宛被俄罗斯、普鲁士和奥地利三国分割。

en: Livonia is the state of the Livonian Order, the Baltic branch of the Teutonic Order. Its roots go back to 1202, when Bishop Albert of Riga, who had founded the city of Riga in 1201, created the Livonian Brothers of the Sword to conquer and convert the Livs, Latgalians, Estonians and other pagan peoples around the Gulf of Riga. After the Swordbrothers were crushed by Samogitians at Saule in 1236, their remnants were absorbed into the Teutonic Order in 1237 as an autonomous Livonian branch, which went on to subdue Courland and Semigallia. An eastward thrust ended in defeat on the ice of Lake Peipus at the hands of Alexander Nevsky in 1242. In 1337 the land master Everard von Monheim ruled from the castles of Livonia while the archbishop of Riga and several bishops shared the country; in 1343 the Estonian St. George's Night revolt was suppressed, and Denmark sold its Estonian duchy to the Order in 1346. Weakened after Grunwald, the Livonian masters joined the Livonian Confederation of prelates and towns in 1435. The Livonian War then proved fatal: the Muscovite victory at Ergeme in 1560 was followed in 1561 by the secularization of the Order under its last master, Gotthard Kettler, who founded the Duchy of Courland and Semigallia while Sweden, Denmark and Lithuania divided the remaining lands.
zh: 利沃尼亚是利沃尼亚骑士团的国家，即条顿骑士团的波罗的海分支。其前身可追溯到1202年：1201年创建里加城的里加主教阿尔伯特组建宝剑骑士团，以征服和归化里加湾周围的利夫人、拉特加尔人、爱沙尼亚人等异教民族。1236年宝剑骑士团在索莱被萨莫吉希亚人击溃，残部于1237年并入条顿骑士团，成为自治的利沃尼亚分支，随后又征服库尔兰和瑟米加利亚。它向东的扩张于1242年在楚德湖冰面上被亚历山大·涅夫斯基击败。1337年，地方长官埃弗拉德·冯·蒙海姆在利沃尼亚各城堡发号施令，里加大主教和几位主教则与他分治其地；1343年爱沙尼亚的圣乔治之夜起义被镇压，1346年丹麦把爱沙尼亚公国卖给骑士团。格林瓦尔德之战后骑士团日趋衰弱，1435年利沃尼亚长官加入由高级教士和城市组成的利沃尼亚联盟。利沃尼亚战争给了它致命一击：1560年俄军在埃尔盖梅取胜，末任长官戈特哈德·克特勒于1561年将骑士团世俗化，建立库尔兰和瑟米加利亚公国，其余土地则被瑞典、丹麦和立陶宛瓜分。

en: Lijiang is the Naxi chiefdom in the Hengduan Mountains of north-western Yunnan, grown rich on the tea-and-horse caravan roads between Yunnan, Tibet and India. The Naxi settled the Jinsha River valleys in the early medieval period and passed under Tibetan and then Nanzhao rule before their chieftain submitted to Khubilai Khan's army in 1253, when the Yuan confirmed the family as local pacification commissioners. In 1382 the chief Ajia Ade was among the first border rulers to submit to the Ming, and the Hongwu emperor gave him the Chinese name Mu De, founding the Mu dynasty of Lijiang magistrates. Mu armies served the Ming in the Yunnan and Luchuan campaigns and seized neighbouring lands, reaching their golden age under Mu Zeng in the early seventeenth century, when Lijiang raided the Gyalrong tribes and even invaded the Chakla chiefdom; Mu Zeng also sheltered the exiled tenth Karmapa and hosted the traveller Xu Xiake in 1639. Under Qing rule Mu Yi refused to join Wu Sangui's rebellion of 1673 and was imprisoned for it. In 1723 the Yongzheng emperor's bureaucratisation abolished the chiefdom, replacing the Mu with appointed Han magistrates, while the Naxi kept their Dongba religion and pictographic script.
zh: 丽江是纳西人在滇西北横断山中建立的土司政权，凭借连接云南、西藏和印度的茶马商道致富。纳西人在中古早期迁入金沙江峡谷，先后受吐蕃和南诏统治；1253年其首领向忽必烈的大军归降，元朝封这一家族为当地宣慰使。1382年，首领阿甲阿得率先归附明朝，洪武帝赐汉名木得，开创了世袭丽江知府的木氏土司。木氏军队随明军出征云南和麓川，又不断蚕食邻部土地，在17世纪初木增当政时达到鼎盛，兵锋直指嘉绒诸部，甚至攻入查克拉土司境内；木增还收留过流亡的第十世噶玛巴，并于1639年接待旅行家徐霞客。入清之后，木懿拒绝依附1673年起兵的吴三桂，因此被投入牢狱。1723年雍正帝推行改土归流，废除土司，改由朝廷委派的流官知府治理，而纳西人仍保有自己的东巴教和东巴象形文字。

en: Luliang is a broad basin on the upper Nanpan River east of Kunming, regarded as the homeland of the Cuan culture; the celebrated fifth-century Stele of Cuan Longyan was erected here. The Han established Tonglao County here in 109 BC, later renamed Tongle. After Nanzhao took the region in 748 it was called Kuilunong Chuan, and under the Dali kingdom the Luowen tribe dwelt here under Shicheng Commandery. With the Mongol arrival in 1253 the Luowen became a thousand-household unit, and in 1276 the area was organised as Luliang Subprefecture of Qujing Route, governing Fanghua and Hena counties. The Ming renamed it Liuliang Subprefecture in 1389, planted the Liuliang garrison in 1398, and soon folded the two counties into the subprefecture. The Qing abolished the garrison in 1669 and moved the subprefectural seat into the garrison town.
zh: 陆良是昆明以东、南盘江上游的宽阔坝子，被视为爨文化的发源地，5世纪的名碑《爨龙颜碑》即立于此地。公元前109年汉朝在此设同劳县，后改名同乐县。748年南诏取其地，称夔鹿弄川；大理国时落温部居住于此，隶属石城郡。1253年蒙古入滇，落温被编为千户，1276年改设陆梁州，隶曲靖路，领芳华、河纳二县。明代于1389年改名六凉州，1398年设置六凉卫，不久又将芳华、河纳二县省并入州。清代于1669年裁撤六凉卫，把州治迁到卫城。

en: Luoluosi was the Mongol name for the Yi country of southern Sichuan, the Anning River valley and Liangshan highlands centred on Jianchang, the modern city of Xichang. Nanzhao organised the region as Jianchang Prefecture in the ninth century, and the Dali kingdom raised its Jianchang Commandery to a prefecture in its turn. When the Mongols pacified the area they divided it in 1275 into five chief commands and twenty-three departments, over which they placed the Luoluosi Pacification Commission, taking its name from the Luoluo tribes of the region. With its seat at Jianchang, the commission supervised the five routes of Jianchang, Dechang, Huichuan, Dingchang and Deping, covering roughly the present Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture; Mongol nobles held the senior posts while local chiefs served as their deputies. In 1382 the Ming replaced the structure with Jianchang Prefecture and Jianchang Guard, which became the seat of the Sichuan Regional Military Command, and in 1728 the Qing reorganised the country as Ningyuan Prefecture.
zh: 罗罗斯是元朝对川西南彝族地区的称呼，以安宁河谷和凉山山地为主体，中心在建昌，即今四川西昌。9世纪南诏在此设建昌府，大理国时期又把建昌郡升为建昌府。蒙古平定此地后，于1275年将全境析为五个总管府、二十三州，并在其上设罗罗斯宣慰司兼管军民万户府，司名取自当地的罗罗部落。宣慰司治设在建昌路，统辖建昌、德昌、会川、定昌、德平五路的军民政务，辖境约当今凉山彝族自治州；宣慰使由蒙古贵族出任，其下官职则任用当地少数民族首领。1382年明朝将其改置为建昌府和建昌卫，建昌成为四川行都指挥使司的治所；1728年清朝又把这一地区改建为宁远府。

en: The Lalu are the Hulawen Jurchens, a Wild Jurchen group named after the Hulan river (Manchu hvlan, chimney), which rises in the Lesser Khingan mountains and crosses the Songnen plain to join the Songhua east of Harbin. The Wozhe forest peoples rose twice against the Yuan in 1343 and 1346, angered by gyrfalcon tribute demands.
zh: 拉卢即忽剌温女真，属野人女真，因呼兰河（满语意为烟囱）得名；呼兰河发源于小兴安岭，斜贯松嫩平原，在哈尔滨以东注入松花江。14世纪40年代，这一带的兀者森林部落因不堪海东青贡奉之扰，于1343年和1346年两次起兵反元。

en: Lho Mon, the southern Mon land or Monyul of the old Tibetan chronicles, is the chain of Himalayan valleys centred on Paro and Punakha that later became Bhutan. Its earliest named inhabitants were the Monpa mountain peoples, whose nature-worshipping shamans were gradually overlaid by Buddhism: the Tibetan king Songtsän Gampo founded temples at Kyichu near Paro and at Bumthang in the seventh century, and Padmasambhava preached there in 810, planting the Nyingmapa order. After the Tibetan Empire's collapse the valleys split into small kingdoms ruled by local kings, Bumthang foremost among them. From the twelfth century the Drukpa Kagyu school spread from one dzong fortress to the next, eclipsing the older Lhapa and Nyingmapa sects, so that in 1337 the land was still a patchwork of monastic estates and rival lords. Unity came only in 1616, when the Drukpa lama Ngawang Namgyal, the Zhabdrung, fled Gelug pressure in Tibet, defeated repeated Tibetan invasions, built a network of dzong and promulgated the Tsa Yig law code to create the theocratic state of Drukyul; after his death factional civil wars troubled it for two centuries.
zh: 珞门古称“门域”，藏文编年史意为南方的门地，是以帕罗、普那卡为中心的喜马拉雅山谷地带，也就是后来的不丹。当地最早见于记载的居民是门巴山民，他们崇拜自然的萨满信仰逐渐被佛教覆盖：7世纪时吐蕃赞普松赞干布在帕罗附近的吉曲和布姆唐修建寺院，810年莲花生到此传法，播下宁玛派的种子。吐蕃帝国崩溃后，各河谷分裂为由小王统治的小邦，其中以布姆唐最为强盛。12世纪起，竺巴噶举派以一座座宗堡为据点传播，逐渐压倒更古老的拉巴噶举和宁玛各派，因此到1337年，这里仍是寺院领地与割据贵族拼合而成的世界。统一迟至1616年才到来：竺巴噶举派喇嘛夏仲·阿旺朗杰为躲避西藏格鲁派的压力南逃入山，数次击败入侵的藏军，修筑宗堡网络并颁布《法令》，建立起神权国家竹域；他死后，派系内战又困扰了这个国家两百年。

en: The Kingdom of Lan Na was a Tai Yuan state in the northern Thai highlands, ruled from Chiang Mai. It grew out of the older mueang of Ngoenyang at Chiang Saen, whose king Mangrai founded Chiang Rai in 1262, conquered the Mon kingdom of Hariphunchai at Lamphun in 1281, and laid out Chiang Mai as his new capital in 1296. After Mangrai's death around 1311 the kingdom passed through succession disputes; in 1337 it was held by his great-great-grandson Phayu, who returned the court to Chiang Mai, fortified the city and built Wat Phra Singh. Under Kue Na the Sinhalese sect of Theravada Buddhism took root and the stupa on Doi Suthep was founded in 1386. Lan Na reached its height under Tilokaraj, who ruled from 1441 to 1487, annexed Phayao in 1456, fought a long war with Ayutthaya over the upper Chao Phraya, and held a Buddhist council to recompile the Tipitaka near Chiang Mai in 1477. Dynastic strife then weakened it, and in 1558 the Burmese king Bayinnaung took Chiang Mai and made Lan Na a vassal. It broke away in 1596, briefly acknowledged Siamese suzerainty under Naresuan in 1602, and came under Burmese-backed rulers again after 1614. A revolt in 1727 brought decades of independence before the Konbaung dynasty retook Chiang Mai in 1763. In 1775 Kawila of Lampang, with Siamese aid, drove out the Burmese, and Lan Na became a Siamese vassal, later divided into the five principalities of Chiang Mai, Lampang, Nan, Lamphun and Phrae.
zh: 兰纳是泰国北部高原上的傣阮人政权，以清迈为统治中心，由清盛一带更古老的恩央王国发展而来。恩央国王孟莱于1262年兴建清莱，1281年征服以今南奔为中心的孟人王国哈利奔猜，又在1296年营建清迈并定为国都。孟莱约在1311年去世后，王国内陷入继统纷争；1337年在位的是他的玄孙帕育，帕育把宫廷迁回清迈，加固城防并修建了帕辛寺。库纳在位时，上座部佛教的僧伽罗派在兰纳扎根，1386年又在素贴山起建佛塔。兰纳在1441至1487年在位的蒂洛卡拉治下达到鼎盛：1456年吞并帕尧，与阿瑜陀耶为争夺昭披耶河上游长期交战，并于1477年在清迈附近召集佛教结集，重新编纂三藏。此后王室内斗使国势转衰，1558年缅甸国王勃印曩攻占清迈，兰纳沦为属邦。它在1596年脱离缅甸，1602年一度向暹王纳黎萱称臣，1614年后又落回缅甸扶立的统治者手中。1727年的起义换来了数十年独立，1763年贡榜王朝再度攻陷清迈。1775年，南邦的卡威拉在暹罗援助下逐出缅人，兰纳从此成为暹罗属邦，后来被分为清迈、南邦、难府、南奔和帕府五个邦国。

en: Liang was the appanage of the Mongol Princes of Liang, the Borjigin viceroys through whom the Yuan dynasty governed its southwestern province of Yunnan from Kunming. Mongol rule there began in 1253, when Kublai, then still a prince, overran the Dali Kingdom, and Yunnan became one of the ten provinces of Kublai's empire, with Sayyid Ajjal Shams al-Din Omar appointed its governor in 1273. The Princes of Liang traced their line to Khökhechi, a son of Kublai, and presided over a hierarchy of native tusi chieftains, including the surviving Duan rulers of Dali. When the Ming drove the Yuan from China proper in 1368, the Prince of Liang Basalawarmi kept Yunnan loyal to the Northern Yuan, executing the Ming envoy Wang Wei in 1374. In 1381 the Hongwu Emperor sent Fu Youde, Mu Ying and Lan Yu with a reported 300,000 troops; Basalawarmi's army was overwhelmed, and he drowned his wife and killed himself on January 6, 1382. His family was exiled to Tamna, the island later known as Jeju, and Ming forces went on to subdue the last Duan holdouts at Dali by 1383.
zh: 梁是元朝镇守云南的蒙古宗王梁王的藩国，以昆明为统治中心，梁王以孛儿只斤氏出任元朝在西南的最高统治者。蒙古对云南的统治始于1253年，当时还是宗王的忽必烈攻灭大理国；云南后来成为忽必烈帝国十个行省之一，1273年赛典赤·赡思丁被任命为行省平章政事。梁王一支出自忽必烈之子忽哥赤，统辖着层层土著土司，包括大理段氏的残余势力。1368年明朝把元朝逐出中原后，梁王把匝剌瓦尔密仍效忠北元，并在1374年处死了明使王祎。1381年，洪武帝派傅友德、沐英、蓝玉统兵三十万大举入滇，梁王的军队被击溃，他先溺死妻子，随后于1382年1月6日自尽。其家族被流放耽罗，即后来的济州岛；明军又于1383年平定了大理段氏最后的抵抗。

en: Landak, in full the Ismahayana kingdom of Landak, was a Hindu state in the interior of western Borneo, holding the valley of the Landak River, a tributary of the Kapuas, in what is now the Landak Regency of West Kalimantan. Local chronicles derive its ruling house from a noble of Singhasari in Java, said to have been left behind by Kertanegara's Pamalayu expedition and to have sailed up the Kapuas to found a court at Ningrat Batur around 1292, taking the title Ratu Sang Nata Pulang Pali. The Javanese poem Negarakretagama of 1365 names Landa among the outer states of the Majapahit world. In 1337 the kingdom was still in its Hindu phase at Ningrat Batur, drawing wealth from the gold and diamonds washed out of its rivers. Islam was adopted from 1472 under Raden Abdul Kahar, after which the court moved to Mungguk Ayu, then to Bandong in 1703 and to Ngabang in 1768. Its rulers kept marriage ties with Sambas, Mempawah and Sanggau, and in the late eighteenth century Landak disputed its borders with the newly founded sultanate of Pontianak.
zh: 万那全称伊斯摩诃耶那·万那王国，是婆罗洲西部内陆的印度教政权，领有卡普阿斯河支流万那河流域，即今天印度尼西亚西加里曼丹省万那县一带。据当地编年史记载，其统治家族出自爪哇信诃沙里的一位贵族，相传是克尔塔纳加拉发动帕马莱尤远征后滞留的人员，他沿卡普阿斯河上溯，约于1292年在宁格拉特·巴图尔建立宫廷，自称拉图·桑·纳塔·普朗·帕利，开创伊斯摩诃耶那王朝。1365年的爪哇史诗《爪哇史颂》把“兰达”列为满者伯夷世界的外围邦国之一。1337年时王国仍处在以宁格拉特·巴图尔为都的印度教阶段，靠河中产的黄金和钻石致富。1472年起，拉登·阿卜杜勒·卡哈尔在位时改宗伊斯兰教，此后宫廷先后迁至蒙古·阿尤、1703年迁至班东、1768年迁至雅邦。万那诸王与三发、曼帕瓦、桑高等邦国联姻，18世纪末又与新建立的坤甸苏丹国发生边界争端。

en: The County of Leiningen was an immediate lordship of the Holy Roman Empire in the Palatinate, ruled from Altleiningen Castle, built around 1100 by the ancient noble House of Leiningen. The first count known to history was Emich II, who died before 1138. The first line of counts died out around 1220, and the lands passed through an heiress to Frederick of Saarbrücken, who took the Leiningen name and arms; himself a Minnesinger whose song entered the Codex Manesse, he built Hardenburg Castle before 1212. After 1316 his descendants divided the inheritance into the counties of Leiningen-Dagsburg and Leiningen-Hardenburg. In 1337 the Dagsburg line was headed by Frederick VI, and the later count Frederick VIII married Yolanda of Jülich, granddaughter of Count Gerhard V of Jülich. The Hardenburg line endured through the Middle Ages: in 1803 it was raised to the Principality of Leiningen, only to be mediatized in 1806.
zh: 莱宁根伯国是神圣罗马帝国的一块帝国直辖领地，位于普法尔茨，统治根基是莱宁根家族约在1100年修建的阿尔特莱宁根城堡。最早可考的伯爵是1138年前去世的埃米希二世；原系男嗣约在1220年断绝，领地经女继承人传给萨尔布吕肯的弗里德里希，他改用莱宁根的姓氏与纹章，本人还是《马内塞手稿》收录的恋歌诗人，并在1212年前兴建哈登堡城堡。1316年以后，后裔把领地分为莱宁根-达格斯堡与莱宁根-哈登堡两个伯国。1337年在位的是达格斯堡支的弗里德里希六世；后来的弗里德里希八世娶了于利希伯爵格哈德五世的孙女约兰达。哈登堡支延续整个中世纪，1803年受封为莱宁根侯国，1806年遭邦君兼并而沦为陪臣。

en: Lanao was the lake-country of central Mindanao, a ring of Maranao and Iranun settlements around Lake Lanao whose pre-Islamic life found its voice in the Darangen, a sung epic of seventeen cycles and more than seventy thousand lines handed down orally before the fourteenth century. The Chinese chronicle Zhufan Zhi of 1225 already knew the islands beyond Zamboanga as a separate country. Islam came with the missionary Sharif Kabungsuwan, whose son Sharif Makaalang became the first native Maranao sultan, and for a time Lanao rotated leadership with the Sultanate of Maguindanao. When Datu Kudarat seized the Maguindanao throne in 1616 against that custom, the lords of Bayabao, Masiu, Unayan and Balo-i met at Taraka and Sawir and seceded as the Four States of Lanao, still fighting alongside Maguindanao against Spain. In 1639 and 1640 expeditions sent by Governor Corcuera built a garrison on the lake, but the Maranaos stormed it and drove the Spaniards out, after which no Spanish force returned to the lake country for more than two hundred and fifty years.
zh: 拉瑙是棉兰老中部的湖区之国，马拉瑙人与伊琅文人的定居点环拉瑙湖分布。伊斯兰化以前，当地生活凝结在《达兰根》史诗之中：这部吟唱史诗分十七个循环、七万多行，在14世纪以前已靠口传流传。1225年的中国史籍《诸蕃志》也已把三宝颜以东的岛屿视为一个独立国度。伊斯兰教随传教士谢里夫·卡邦苏万传入，他的儿子谢里夫·马卡朗成为第一位本土马拉瑙苏丹，拉瑙一度与马京达瑙苏丹国轮流推戴共主。1616年达图·库达拉特违背这一惯例夺取马京达瑙王位，巴亚包、马休、乌纳延和巴洛伊四邦的首领在塔拉卡和萨维尔集会，宣布独立，组成拉瑙四邦联盟，但仍与马京达瑙并肩对西班牙作战。1639至1640年，总督科奎拉派出的远征队在湖畔建立要塞，马拉瑙人奋起攻战将西班牙人逐出，此后两百五十多年间再无西班牙军队进入湖区。

en: The Isles were the Norse-Gaelic maritime lordship of the Hebrides and Scotland's western seaboard, whose rulers bore the Gaelic title Rí Innse Gall, King of the Isles, and kept their seat at Finlaggan on Islay. The lordship went back to Somerled, who built the Kingdom of the Isles in the twelfth century; his Clan Donald descendants, the MacDonalds, commanded fleets of galleys called birlinns and were nominal vassals of Norway, Ireland or Scotland while ruling in practice as independent kings. In 1336 John of Islay, chief of Clan Donald, styled himself Dominus Insularum, Lord of the Isles. Edward Balliol courted him with grants of Kintyre, Knapdale, Skye and Lewis, but John gave no real help to the Balliol cause, and David II confirmed his possessions in 1343. Through his marriage to Amie mac Ruari he inherited the lordship of Garmoran in 1346, giving him the whole Hebrides except Skye and the coast from Morvern to Loch Hourn; in 1350 he married Margaret Stewart, daughter of the future Robert II, with Knapdale and Kintyre as dowry. He submitted to David II at Inverness in 1369, died at Ardtornish in 1386 and was buried on Iona, whose abbey he controlled and where he also founded an Augustinian priory on Oronsay. His successors fought the crown at Harlaw in 1411 and treated as sovereigns with England, until John MacDonald II's English pact of 1462 led James IV to forfeit the lordship in 1493.
zh: 群岛是赫布里底群岛与苏格兰西海岸的诺斯-盖尔人海上帝国，统治者的盖尔语头衔为“群岛之王”，驻地在艾莱岛的芬拉根。该政权可追溯到12世纪建立群岛王国的萨默莱德；其后人唐纳德家族（麦克唐纳氏）拥有被称为“伯林”的桨帆船队，名义上向挪威、爱尔兰或苏格兰称臣，实则像独立国王一样行事。1336年，唐纳德家族首领艾莱的约翰自称“群岛领主”。爱德华·巴里奥以金泰尔、纳普代尔、斯凯和刘易斯等地的封赐拉拢他，约翰却并未真正出力；大卫二世于1343年确认了他的领地。1346年，他凭借与阿米·麦克鲁阿里的婚姻继承加莫兰领地，从而领有除斯凯以外的整个赫布里底群岛，以及从莫文到洛赫尔恩的西海岸；1350年他又娶后来的罗伯特二世之女玛格丽特·斯图尔特，以纳普代尔和金泰尔为嫁妆。1369年他在因弗内斯向大卫二世臣服，1386年在阿德托尼什去世，葬于艾奥纳岛；他掌控着岛上的修道院，还在奥龙赛岛建立了一座奥古斯丁会小修院。他的继承人1411年在哈洛与苏格兰王权交战，并以主权者身份同英格兰订约；1462年约翰·麦克唐纳二世与英格兰结盟败露，詹姆斯四世遂于1493年没收了群岛领主权。

en: Loloda was a small thirteenth-century kingdom on the north-west coast of Halmahera in the North Moluccas, ruling from Loloda over islands later called North and South Loloda. Its ruler held the old title kolano and later sangaji, as Loloda never joined the Moti Alliance and remained a subordinate of Ternate and Tidore until the Dutch made it a district.
zh: 洛洛达是北摩鹿加哈马黑拉岛西北沿海的小王国，传统上始于13世纪，以洛洛达为中心统治后来称北洛洛达和南洛洛达的群岛。其君主使用古老的科拉诺称号，后改称桑贾吉；洛洛达从未加入莫蒂联盟，始终臣属特尔纳特和蒂多雷，直到荷兰人将其改为辖区。

en: The County of Loon was a fief of the Holy Roman Empire covering roughly the territory of the present-day Belgian province of Limburg. It took its name from its first seat at Loon, present-day Borgloon, although the counts later moved their court to Kuringen, now part of Hasselt. The first reliably recorded count, Giselbert, ruled in the eleventh century, and from about 1190 the counts held their lands as vassals of the Prince-Bishop of Liège. When Count Louis IV died without a male heir in 1336, the county passed, with Liège's consent, to Theodoric of Heinsberg, whose father had married Louis's sister, so that in 1337 he ruled Loon together with Heinsberg and the county of Chiny. This arrangement did not last: in 1362 Prince-Bishop Engelbert III of the Marck occupied Loon and in 1366 annexed it outright to the Prince-Bishopric of Liège. Loon kept its identity as one of Liège's three quarters until French revolutionary troops dissolved the bishopric in 1795, when its lands became part of the département of Meuse-Inférieure, and in 1815 they passed to the new province of Limburg in the United Kingdom of the Netherlands.
zh: 洛恩伯国是神圣罗马帝国的封邑，疆域大致相当于今比利时林堡省一带。它得名于伯爵最初的驻地洛恩，即今博尔赫隆，后来伯爵把宫廷迁到库林根，也就是今哈瑟尔特的一部分。11世纪时，第一位有可靠记载的伯爵吉塞尔贝特在位；约1190年起，洛恩伯爵作为列日采邑主教的封臣领有此地。1336年伯爵路易四世去世且没有男性继承人，经列日方面同意，伯国传给海因斯贝格的狄奥多里克——他的父亲娶了路易四世的妹妹，因此1337年时他同时领有洛恩、海因斯贝格和希尼伯国。这一安排未能持久：1362年采邑主教恩格尔贝特三世·冯·德马克出兵占领洛恩，并于1366年将其正式并入列日主教区。此后洛恩作为列日三大辖区之一保留了自身建制，直到1795年法国革命军解散主教区，其土地被划入下默兹省；1815年它转入尼德兰联合王国新设的林堡省。

en: The Duchy of Lorraine grew out of Upper Lorraine, the southern half created when the old stem duchy of Lotharingia was split in 959; as Lower Lorraine disintegrated, the upper duchy, with its capital at Nancy, became known simply as Lorraine and remained a state of the Holy Roman Empire. In 1337 its duke was Rudolph the Valiant, who had inherited as a child in 1328; that same year he went to war with Henry IV of Bar over refused homage until Philip VI of France mediated, and he later fought in the Hundred Years' War and the Reconquista before falling at the Battle of Crécy in 1346. The duchy was repeatedly coveted by Burgundy, and Charles the Bold was defeated and killed besieging Nancy in 1477, after which the House of Lorraine ruled securely. In 1737 Lorraine was granted to the exiled Polish king Stanisław Leszczyński for life, and on his death in 1766 it was annexed by France and reorganized as the province of Lorraine and Barrois.
zh: 洛林公国的前身是上洛林：959年古老的洛泰尔尼亚部族公国被一分为二，南部即上洛林；随着下洛林分崩离析，这个以南锡为首府的南部公国便径称洛林，是神圣罗马帝国的一个邦国。1337年在位的是“勇士”拉乌尔，他于1328年幼年继位；同年他因亨利四世拒绝行封臣臣服之礼而出兵巴尔，直到法兰西国王腓力六世出面调停。拉乌尔后来转战百年战争和伊比利亚的收复失地运动，1346年在克雷西战役中阵亡。洛林一直为勃艮第所觊觎，1477年大胆查理围攻南锡时兵败身死，洛林家族此后稳固地统治公国。1737年，洛林被封给流亡的波兰国王斯坦尼斯瓦夫·莱什琴斯基终身享有；1766年他去世后，洛林并入法兰西，被改组为洛林—巴尔鲁瓦行省。

en: Liping is a Kam settlement in the hills of southeastern Guizhou, where the borders of Hunan and Guangxi meet. Under the Tang it belonged to Longbiao County and was known as the Wunao stockade, where native chieftain rule first took root. The Yuan set up the Guzhou Bawandong military and civilian chiefdom here in 1283, and in 1322 replaced it with the Liping native long commandery, held under the Tian family of Sizhou. After Ming armies put down the Kam risings of 1385, the chiefdom was converted into the Wukai Guard, a garrison worked by military farmers. In 1413 the Ming dissolved Sizhou and created Liping Prefecture with its seat at the Liping stockade, placing thirteen Kam chieftaincies under the town, which passed from Huguang to Guizhou Province in 1603. The great Miao uprising of 1735 to 1736 swept the region and reached Liping.
zh: 黎平是贵州东南、毗邻湖南与广西的侗族山居聚落，唐代为龙标县属地，时称五脑寨，土司统治由此发端。元朝于1283年在此设古州八万军民总管府，1322年废总管府，改置黎平长官司，隶属于思州田氏。1385年明军平定思州诸洞侗族反抗后，废长官司，改设五开卫，以军屯驻守。1413年明朝废思州宣慰司，在黎平寨设立黎平府，下辖十三个侗族长官司，黎平由此成为这一地区的行政中心，并于1603年由湖广划归贵州。1735—1736年，古州一带爆发的苗民大起义席卷山区，也波及黎平。

en: Lippe began as a small lordship on the river of the same name, first attested in 1123 under Lord Bernard I, with most of its land held on lease from the bishopric of Paderborn after 1173. Bernard II founded Lippstadt in 1185, the first city foundation of the High Middle Ages in Westphalia, and his heirs added Lemgo, Horn, Blomberg and Detmold, giving the house a string of towns across the forests east of the Rhine. Under Simon I, who ruled from 1275 to 1344 and was lord of Lippe in 1337, acquisitions from the County of Schwalenberg between 1332 and 1358 carried the territory to its greatest extent, northward as far as the Weser. Simon's death in 1344 brought a partition and a long feud with the counts of Tecklenburg over Rheda, settled only in 1401, while Lippstadt became a jointly ruled lordship shared with the County of Mark and later, from 1666, with Brandenburg-Prussia.
