Lippe gained imperial immediacy by 1413 and entered the Lower Rhenish-Westphalian Circle in 1512; it was raised to an imperial county in 1528. The Reformation reached it in 1538 with Lutheranism, and Count Simon VI's turn to Calvinism in 1605 caused a lasting quarrel with the Lutheran town of Lemgo, settled by the Röhrentruper Recess of 1617. Devastated like the rest of Westphalia in the Thirty Years' War, Lippe survived under its Detmold line and was promoted to a principality in 1789.
zh: 利珀发端于利珀河畔的一个小领地，1123年在领主贝尔纳一世治下首次见于记载，1173年后其大部分土地以封租形式取自帕德博恩主教区。贝尔纳二世于1185年建立利普施塔特，这是威斯特伐利亚中世纪盛期的第一座建城；他的继承人又陆续建立莱姆戈、霍恩、布隆贝格和德特莫尔德，使这个家族在莱茵河以东的林区拥有一串城镇。西蒙一世于1275至1344年在位，1337年正是他统治利珀之时；1332至1358年间，利珀从施瓦伦贝格伯国取得大片土地，把领地向北扩张到威悉河畔，达到最大疆域。1344年西蒙去世后领地被瓜分，又与泰克伦堡伯爵为雷达长期私战，直到1401年才了结；利普施塔特则成为与马克伯国共治的领地，1666年起改由勃兰登堡-普鲁士参与共治。利珀最迟于1413年获得帝国直辖地位，1512年加入下莱茵-威斯特伐利亚行政区，1528年升为帝国伯国。宗教改革时期它于1538年接纳路德宗，1605年西蒙六世改宗加尔文宗，与坚持路德宗的莱姆戈城长期争执，最终以1617年的《勒伦特鲁普协议》收场。三十年战争中利珀与威斯特伐利亚各地一同遭到重创，之后由德特莫尔德主支延续，1789年升为侯国。

en: Larantuka was a Lamaholot kingdom at the eastern end of Flores in the Lesser Sunda Islands, whose rajas in time ruled eastern Flores and the neighbouring islands of Solor, Adonara and Lembata. Royal genealogy traces the line to a man from Timor and a mythical woman of the Ile Mandiri volcano, and the fourteenth-century Javanese poem Negarakertagama already locates tributary lands called Galiyao and Solot in these waters, on the sandalwood route between Bali and Timor. The Makassarese of Gowa seized Larantuka in 1541 to control that trade, but the port's future belonged to the Portuguese, who abandoned nearby Solor for Larantuka before 1600. After the Dutch took Solor in 1613 and Malacca in 1641, Portuguese and Dominican refugees swelled the town and formed the mixed Catholic community of the Larantuqueiros, also called Topasses. Its raja Ola Adobala, ninth in the traditional line, was baptized a Catholic, traditionally in 1650, and swore vassalage to the king of Portugal in exchange for the title Dom; the rajas then ruled as Catholic monarchs through the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries under Dominican influence, their port kept largely closed to rival traders while Malay served as the language of commerce.
zh: 拉兰图卡是小巽他群岛弗洛勒斯岛东端的拉马霍洛特人王国，其拉者后来统治弗洛勒斯东部以及邻近的索洛、阿多纳拉和伦巴塔诸岛。王室世系把先祖追溯到一名帝汶男子与伊莱曼迪里火山的神话女子；14世纪的爪哇史诗《爪哇史颂》已在巴厘至帝汶的檀香贸易航线上，提到名为加利尧和索洛特的朝贡之地。1541年，戈瓦的望加锡人为控制贸易夺取了拉兰图卡，但这座港口的未来属于葡萄牙人：他们在1600年以前放弃邻近的索洛，转居拉兰图卡。1613年荷兰人夺取索洛、1641年攻占马六甲后，葡萄牙人和多明我会难民涌入此城，形成混血的天主教社群拉兰图凯罗人，又称托帕塞人。世系中第九位拉者奥拉·阿多巴莱受洗入天主教，传统说法系于1650年，他向葡萄牙国王宣誓效忠并获唐的称号；此后拉者们在多明我会影响下以天主教君主身份统治了整个17、18世纪，港口对竞争商人基本封闭，而以马来语作为商贸语言。

en: Lausanne grew from the Roman lakeside settlement of Lousanna, whose inhabitants withdrew to the fortified hill above in the fourth century. Its bishopric was even older: the see of Windisch, whose first bishop attended the Burgundian synod of Epaone in 517, moved to Avenches and then, around the year 600, to Lausanne. From 888 to 1032 the town belonged to the Kingdom of Upper Burgundy, and in the eleventh century its bishops made it the centre of their secular rule; Bishop Hugo, a son of King Rudolph III, proclaimed the Peace of God there in 1037. The twelfth and thirteenth centuries were an age of prosperity, crowned in 1275 when the cathedral was consecrated in the presence of Pope Gregory X and King Rudolf I of Germany. The bishops shared power uneasily with the counts of Savoy until 1536, when Bernese troops conquered the town, imposed the Reformation and stripped the cathedral of its Catholic fittings, ending the prince-bishopric as a state. Under Bernese rule Lausanne became, after 1685, a refuge for French Huguenot pastors.
zh: 洛桑起源于湖畔的罗马定居点洛桑纳，4世纪时居民退守到上方易守难攻的山丘。当地教区的历史更久：温迪施教区的首任主教曾出席517年的埃帕翁主教会议，教区先迁至阿旺什，约600年前后再迁洛桑。888年至1032年该城属于上勃艮第王国，11世纪起主教把它经营成世俗统治的中心；主教雨果是国王鲁道夫三世之子，于1037年在此宣布“上帝的和平”。12至13世纪城市繁荣，1275年大教堂在教宗格列高利十世和德意志国王鲁道夫一世亲临下祝圣，为这段鼎盛期画上标志。主教们与萨伏依伯爵长期分享权力、龃龉不断，直到1536年伯尔尼军队攻占该城，推行宗教改革，拆去大教堂的天主教陈设，主教侯国就此亡国。伯尔尼统治时期，洛桑在1685年后成为法国胡格诺派牧师的避难地。

en:
Larestan is the arid belt of southern Fars between Kerman and the Persian Gulf, a country of bare mountains, rocky hills and sandy valleys whose people are the Achomi, also called Lari or Khodmooni, a Persian-speaking group whose language descends from the Middle Persian dialects of pre-Islamic Fars and who have mostly remained Sunni. In the Middle Ages the region was ruled by the local Miladian dynasty, founded by Gorgin Milad, who claimed descent from the Kayanid hero Kay Khosrow; its chiefs held Lar and the hot lowland tract of Garmsirat and kept their small realm apart from the politics of the rest of Persia. In the thirteenth century Lar briefly became a busy emporium on the caravan road from Hormuz, and under the Miladians it remained a major staging post on the route to the Gulf through the sixteenth century, with a wealthy merchant and silk-growing population, including a noted Jewish community attested from 1523.

The dynasty's independence ended in 1602, when a Safavid army under Allahverdi Khan invaded and annexed Larestan. In the following decades many Larestani families migrated across the Gulf to Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait and the ports that became the United Arab Emirates.
zh:
拉雷斯坦是法尔斯南部、克尔曼与波斯湾之间的干旱地带，遍布荒山、岩丘和沙谷；居民是阿乔姆人，又称拉尔人或霍德穆尼人，属波斯语族群，语言承自伊斯兰时代以前法尔斯的中古波斯方言，且大多保持逊尼派信仰。中世纪统治这一地区的是本土的米拉迪安王朝，开国者戈尔金·米拉德自称凯扬王朝英雄凯霍斯鲁的后裔；其首领据有拉尔和炎热的低地加尔姆西拉特，让这个小邦长期置身波斯主流政局之外。13世纪拉尔一度成为霍尔木兹商道上繁盛的商业中心，米拉迪安王朝治下的整个16世纪，它始终是通往波斯湾路上的重要驿站，城中富商和养蚕业者云集，1523年的记载已提到这里有一个知名的犹太人社群。

王朝的独立在1602年终结，萨非王朝的阿拉维尔迪汗率军入侵并吞并了拉雷斯坦。此后数十年间，许多拉尔家庭渡海迁往卡塔尔、巴林、科威特以及后来组成阿拉伯联合酋长国的诸港口。

en: Litang was a high-altitude Khampa chiefdom on the open grasslands of the Shaluli Mountains, in present-day southwestern Sichuan, its town standing at some 4,000 metres among the highest in the Tibetan world. The Yuan brought it under administration in 1272 with a district office and, in 1288, a revenue commissariat; the Ming appointed local rulers as pacification commissioners and later as a Thousand-Household office. Around the turn of the seventeenth century it passed to Güshi Khan's Khoshut Mongols, whose stewards ruled until 1719, when the local chiefs submitted their registers to the Qing and Litang became a Sichuan tusi, confirmed in 1729 as the principal and vice pacification commissions. Its great monastery, founded as a Bön temple, was converted to the Gelug order by the Third Dalai Lama in 1580, and in 1708 Litang gave birth to the Seventh Dalai Lama, Kelzang Gyatso.
zh: 理塘是沙鲁里山开阔草原上的康巴土司政权，地在今四川省西南部，镇城海拔约4000米，是藏地地势最高的城镇之一。元朝于1272年设李唐州，1288年又置钱粮总管府；明代封当地首领为里塘宣抚司，后改参卜郎千户所。17世纪前后理塘转入和硕特蒙古固始汗之手，由其营官统治；1719年当地土司向清军呈交户籍纳粮内附，理塘成为四川管辖的土司，1729年正式置里塘正、副宣抚司，隶属打箭炉厅。境内的理塘寺本是苯教寺院，1580年由三世达赖喇嘛索南嘉措改宗格鲁派；1708年，七世达赖喇嘛格桑嘉措就出生在理塘。

en: Lantu was a small Sui tusi holding in the hill country south of Duyun, on the territory of present-day Sandu County, the Sui heartland. Its chiefs kept office through the Ming and early Qing as dependants of the Duyun native administration, until the Yongzheng reforms of 1734 turned the Lantu lands into the Sanjiaotun assistant magistrate's district under Dushan Subprefecture.
zh: 烂土是都匀以南山区的一个水族小土司，辖地在今三都水族自治县境内，正是水族的聚居腹地。其土官经明代至清初世袭不绝，隶属都匀一带的土司体系；1734年雍正朝改土归流，以烂土司地设置三脚屯州同，划归独山州管辖。

en: Lübeck stands on the river Trave near the Baltic, on the site of Liubice, a stronghold of the Slavic Obotrites. In 1143 Count Adolf II of Holstein founded a German town there, which Henry the Lion rebuilt after a fire in 1159 and enriched by moving the local bishopric from Oldenburg; Emperor Frederick Barbarossa later confirmed its privileges. In 1226 Emperor Frederick II made it an imperial free city, and because it commanded the short overland link between the Baltic and the North Sea it became the cradle and de facto capital of the Hanseatic League. Hanseatic diets met in its town hall, its merchants led the league's wars against Denmark, and the Peace of Stralsund in 1370 marked the high point of its power; the town law granted here was copied by roughly a hundred Baltic cities. The Reformation was introduced in the 1530s, and Lübeck's failed intervention in the Count's Feud of 1534 to 1536 was its last bid to dominate Baltic trade. As Atlantic commerce eclipsed the Hansa and the Thirty Years' War disrupted its networks, the last Hanseatic diet met here in 1669, though the city kept its free status. Napoleon's forces occupied it in 1806 and annexed it to France in 1811, but the Congress of Vienna restored Lübeck as a sovereign free city in 1815.
zh: 吕贝克濒临波罗的海、坐落于特拉维河畔，其前身是斯拉夫人奥博特里特人的要塞柳比采。1143年，荷尔斯泰因伯爵阿道夫二世在此建立德意志城镇；1159年狮子亨利在一场火灾后重建该城，并把主教区从奥尔登堡迁来以提升其地位，皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨后来确认了它的特权。1226年，皇帝腓特烈二世将其立为帝国自由城市；由于扼守波罗的海与北海之间最短的陆上通道，它成为汉萨同盟的摇篮和事实上的首府。汉萨议会常在其市政厅召开，其商人主导同盟对丹麦的战争，1370年的《施特拉尔松德和约》标志着它权势的顶峰；这里颁行的吕贝克法被约百座波罗的海城市仿效。16世纪30年代宗教改革传入，吕贝克在1534至1536年伯爵战争中干预失败，这是它称霸波罗的海贸易的最后尝试。随着大西洋贸易使汉萨相形见绌、三十年战争又打乱了同盟网络，1669年最后一届汉萨议会在此召开，不过城市仍保有自由地位。1806年拿破仑的军队占领吕贝克，1811年将其并入法国；1815年维也纳会议恢复了它的主权自由城市身份。

en: Lucca, once the seat of the margraves of Tuscany, bought out its feudal obligations to Welf VI in 1160 and became a free commune answerable only to the emperor. Silk weaving and banking made it rich, while its citizens were drawn into the Guelph and Ghibelline wars. In 1314 Uguccione della Faggiuola made himself lord, and after his fall the Ghibelline Castruccio Castracani of the Antelminelli ruled from 1316, defeating Florence at Altopascio in 1325 and carrying Lucca to the height of its power. His death in 1328 opened a chaotic decade in which the city was repeatedly sold: by 1335 it belonged to Mastino II della Scala of Verona, under whose lordship Lucca stood in 1337, and after a Florentine siege it passed to Pisa. Emperor Charles IV restored its freedom in 1369, and the reborn republic prospered on the silk trade until Paolo Guinigi's signoria of 1400 to 1430 ended amid another Florentine siege. Lucca then settled into a closed oligarchy, reformed in 1628; the republican conspirator Francesco Burlamacchi was executed in 1548, yet the word Libertas flew on its banners until French troops entered in 1799. In 1805 Napoleon merged Lucca into the Principality of Lucca and Piombino under his sister Elisa, and the Congress of Vienna in 1815 reconstituted it as the Duchy of Lucca for the Bourbon-Parma family.
zh: 卢卡曾是托斯卡纳藩侯的驻地，1160年它向韦尔夫六世赎清封建义务，成为只对皇帝负责的自由公社。丝织业和银行业使它富庶，市民也被卷入圭尔夫与吉伯林战争。1314年乌古乔内·德拉·法焦拉自立为领主，他倒台后，安特尔米内利家族的吉伯林派首领卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼于1316年起执政，1325年在阿尔托帕肖战役中击败佛罗伦萨，把卢卡推向权势顶峰。1328年他死后城市陷入十年混乱、屡次被转卖：1335年它归维罗纳的马斯蒂诺二世·德拉·斯卡拉所有，1337年卢卡正处在他的宗主权之下；佛罗伦萨围攻之后它又落入比萨之手。1369年皇帝查理四世恢复其自由，重建的共和国靠丝绸贸易再度繁荣，直到1400至1430年保罗·圭尼吉的领主统治在又一次佛罗伦萨围攻中告终。此后卢卡转为封闭寡头政体，1628年再度改制；共和派密谋者弗朗切斯科·布拉尔马基于1548年被处死，但“自由”字样一直飘扬在它的旗帜上，直至1799年法军入城。1805年拿破仑把卢卡并入卢卡与皮翁比诺亲王国，交给妹妹埃莉萨统治；1815年维也纳会议将其重建为卢卡公国，封给波旁-帕尔马家族。

en: The Principality of Lüneburg was the northern division of the Welf Duchy of Brunswick-Lüneburg, covering the Lüneburg Heath and the Wendland in Lower Saxony. In 1235 Emperor Frederick II enfeoffed Otto the Child, nephew of Henry the Lion, with the newly created Duchy of Brunswick-Lüneburg, and in 1269 Otto's sons split it, Lüneburg falling to John. In 1337 it was ruled jointly by the brothers Otto III and William II of the Old House of Lüneburg, whose seat was the wealthy Hanseatic salt town of Lüneburg. When William died without sons in 1369 the Lüneburg War of Succession broke out against the Saxe-Wittenberg dukes; the town of Lüneburg destroyed the ducal castle on the Kalkberg in 1371, forcing the princes to move their residence to Celle, and the Welfs only secured their inheritance at the Battle of Winsen in 1388. Duke Ernest the Confessor introduced the Lutheran Reformation, signing the Augsburg Confession in 1530, and the Lutheran Church Order of 1564 completed it. The New House of Lüneburg, founded by Christian Louis in 1648, ended in 1705, when the principality was absorbed by the Electorate of Brunswick-Lüneburg, the later Electorate of Hanover.
zh: 吕讷堡侯国是韦尔夫家族不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公国的北部支系领地，据有下萨克森的吕讷堡灌木林和文德兰。1235年，皇帝腓特烈二世把新设立的不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公国封给狮子亨利的侄子孩童奥托；1269年奥托的诸子分家，吕讷堡归于约翰。1337年，吕讷堡旧家族的奥托三世与威廉二世兄弟共同治国，治所是富庶的汉萨盐业城市吕讷堡。1369年威廉无嗣而终，引发了对抗萨克森-维滕贝格诸公爵的吕讷堡继承战争；吕讷堡城于1371年拆毁公爵在卡尔克贝格的城堡，迫使诸侯迁居策勒，韦尔夫家族直到1388年温森战役才保住继承权。忏悔者恩斯特公爵引入路德宗改革，于1530年签署《奥格斯堡信纲》，1564年的路德宗教会章程最终完成了改宗。1648年由克里斯蒂安·路易开创的吕讷堡新家族于1705年绝嗣，侯国并入不伦瑞克-吕讷堡选侯国，即后来的汉诺威选侯国。

en: The Lupaca were one of the principal Aymara kingdoms that took shape around Lake Titicaca after the Tiwanaku state collapsed in the eleventh century. Their seven towns, among them Chucuito, Pomata and Juli, dotted the southwestern shore of the lake in what is now Peru's Puno region; the pre-Inca kings lived at Cutimbo, while Chucuito became the capital of the Inca province. Lupaca society was split into upper and lower moieties, each with its own leader, and Spanish visitors would call the kingdom extraordinarily wealthy, its riches resting on vast llama herds, lakeside farming and long-distance trade. Before the Incas arrived, the Lupaca fought their rivals the Colla for mastery of the Collao: the Inca Viracocha backed their curaca Curi, who defeated the Colla at Paucarcolla and sealed an alliance at Chucuito. Pachacuti nevertheless incorporated the Lupaca into the empire, and Tupac Yupanqui crushed a joint Lupaca and Colla revolt after 1471. An Inca census counted twenty thousand households, including Uru and mitma families. In 1538 the Lupaca again warred on the Colla and were defeated at the Desaguadero River by Hernando Pizarro, yet they remained rich enough in 1567 to impress the Spanish inspector Garci Diez de San Miguel.
zh: 卢皮哈基人是11世纪蒂亚瓦纳科国家崩溃后，在的的喀喀湖周围形成的主要艾马拉王国之一。其七座城镇——包括丘奎托、波马塔和胡利——分布在今秘鲁普诺大区的湖西南岸；印卡时代以前的诸王居住在库廷博，丘奎托则成为印卡行省的首府。卢皮哈基社会分为上、下两个半族，各有首领；西班牙来访者称这个王国异常富庶，财富来自庞大的骆马群、湖畔农业和长途贸易。印卡人到来之前，卢皮哈基与对手库尧争夺科利亚奥的霸权：印卡王维拉科查支持其首领库里，库里在保卡科拉击败库尧人，并在丘奎托缔结盟约。尽管如此，帕查库特克仍将卢皮哈基并入帝国，1471年后图帕克·尤潘基又镇压了它与库尧的联合叛乱。一次印卡人口调查记录了两万户，其中包括乌鲁人和米特玛人。1538年卢皮哈基再度与库尧交战，在德萨瓜德罗河畔被埃尔南多·皮萨罗击败；但直到1567年，它的富庶仍令西班牙巡查官加西·迭斯·德·圣米格尔惊叹。

en:
Laur was one of the petty kingdoms of the Sylhet region, covering in the seventh century the modern Sunamganj District and parts of Habiganj and Mymensingh. The country had earlier belonged to Jaintia within the old Kamarupa kingdom, and when Raja Guhak divided Jaintia among his three sons around 630, his youngest son Ladduk received the western plains that became Laur. In 640 Keshab Misra, a Brahman from Kannauj, migrated there and founded its Hindu ruling line; in the late thirteenth century the little kingdom repeatedly weathered attacks from Gour under King Govinda.

Laur's independence ended in the Mughal age. Ramnath's son Durbar Singh converted to Islam as Durbar Khan, and when his brother Gobind Singh in turn accepted the faith at Delhi, taking the name Habib Khan, the Nawab of Bengal restored Laur to him in 1566 only as a feudal mahal of the Sylhet Sarkar. Early in the eighteenth century the zamindar Abid Reza founded the sprawling new settlement of Baniachong, and after the Khasi burnt Laur in 1744 much of the population followed him there; under British rule Laur survived merely as a pargana, though a Khasi rising of 1787 swept through its estates before the rebels withdrew into the hills.
zh:
劳尔是锡尔赫特地区的小王国之一，7世纪时疆域相当于今苏纳姆甘杰县以及霍比甘杰和迈门辛的部分地区。此地原属古迦摩缕波境内的贾因蒂亚，约630年国王古哈克把贾因蒂亚分给三个儿子，幼子拉杜科得到西部平原，这便是劳尔的由来。640年，来自曲女城的婆罗门凯沙布·米斯拉迁居此地，建立了印度教统治世系；13世纪后期，这个小国屡次顶住高尔国王戈文达的进攻。

劳尔的独立终结于莫卧儿时代。拉姆纳特之子杜尔巴尔·辛格改宗伊斯兰教，改名杜尔巴尔汗；其弟戈宾德·辛格后来也在德里入教，改名哈比卜汗，孟加拉纳瓦布便于1566年把劳尔作为锡尔赫特萨尔卡尔治下的封建税区重新封给他。18世纪初，包税地主阿比德·礼萨另建了占地广阔的新聚落巴尼亚昌；1744年卡西人焚毁劳尔后，许多居民随他迁往那里。英国统治时期，劳尔仅作为一个帕尔加纳税区存在，1787年卡西人起义曾席卷其地产，随后退回山中。

en: Luwu was a Bugis-led kingdom on the Gulf of Bone, in the northern part of southern Celebes, its court at Malangke. Around 1300 Bugis settlers from the Cenrana valley moved to its coast to trade with the Pamona, Wotu and other peoples of the foothills, building a multi-ethnic coalition held together by commerce and by the authority of its ruler, the Datu; its founding myth told of a heavenly-descended being called Simpurusia. Its wealth came from iron: ore carried down from Lake Matano was smelted at Malangke into weapons and tools and exported, together with dammar, rattan and ebony, and the island itself was known as the iron island. By the mid-fourteenth century Luwu was the feared overlord of much of the peninsula, and the Majapahit poem Desawarnana of about 1365 names it among the three chief powers of Celebes. Its earliest identifiable king, Bataraguru, made peace with Bone in the fifteenth century, and Dewaraja, ruling around 1493 to 1526, campaigned against Wajo and Sidenreng, but in the sixteenth century Luwu was overtaken by the southern agrarian kingdoms. On 4 February 1605 its ruler La Patiwareq became the first great king of southern Celebes to accept Islam, and after a civil war the court abandoned Malangke for Palopo around 1620. Several sultanahs later held the throne, though by the 1830s European visitors found Palopo a decayed town of some three hundred houses.
zh: 鲁乌是波尼湾北岸、苏拉威西南部北部的布吉人主导的王国，宫廷设在玛琅客。约1300年，来自森拉纳河谷的布吉人迁居这里的海岸，与山麓的帕莫纳、沃图等族群贸易，靠商业和统治者达图的权威结成多元族群联盟；其开国神话讲述天神后裔辛普鲁西亚降临的故事。国家的财富来自铁：马塔诺湖的矿石运到玛琅客冶炼成兵器和农具，与达玛树脂、藤条、乌木一同出口，苏拉威西岛也因此被称为铁岛。到14世纪中叶，鲁乌已成为令半岛大部畏惧的宗主，约1365年满者伯夷的史诗《爪哇史颂》把它列为苏拉威西三大强权之一。可考的最早国王巴塔拉古鲁在15世纪与波尼议和，1493至1526年前后在位的德瓦拉贾曾进攻瓦乔和西登伦，但16世纪鲁乌被南部的农耕王国超过。1605年2月4日，国王拉·帕蒂瓦雷克成为苏拉威西南部第一位接受伊斯兰教的大国君主，称苏丹；约1620年内战后，宫廷放弃玛琅客，西迁帕洛波。此后数位女王曾临朝听政，而到19世纪30年代，欧洲旅人看到的帕洛波已是一座仅有约三百户人家的衰败城镇。

en: The County of Luxembourg was a state of the Holy Roman Empire in the Ardennes, taking shape after Siegfried, Count of the Ardennes, bought the Lucilinburhuc rock above the Alzette in 963 and built the castle from which his descendants took their comital title. The counts lost their Limburg inheritance to Brabant at the Battle of Worringen in 1288, but Count Henry VII healed the feud by marrying Margaret of Brabant, was elected King of the Romans in 1308 and crowned emperor in 1312, carrying the House of Luxembourg to the summit of imperial politics. His son John, count from 1313, won the crown of Bohemia in 1310 and moved the dynasty's seat to Prague; blind from a Lithuanian crusade in 1336, he ruled Luxembourg in 1337 as one of the seven prince-electors and fell commanding the French vanguard at Crécy in 1346. The Emperor Charles IV raised the county, together with Arlon, Durbuy, Laroche and Vianden, to the Duchy of Luxembourg in 1353 for his half-brother Wenceslaus. When the male line ended with the Emperor Sigismund in 1437, the duchy passed to Philip the Good of Burgundy in 1443, and with Mary of Burgundy's marriage to Maximilian of Austria in 1477 to the Habsburgs, who enrolled it among the Seventeen Provinces by the Pragmatic Sanction of 1549. Its ever-growing fortress became famed as the Gibraltar of the North.
zh: 卢森堡伯国是神圣罗马帝国在阿登山区的一个邦国。963年，阿登伯爵西格弗里德购得阿尔泽特河畔的卢西林堡岩地并修筑城堡，他的后代便以卢森堡为伯爵名号。1288年沃林根战役中，伯爵们败给布拉班特，失去了林堡的继承权；但伯爵亨利七世通过迎娶布拉班特的玛格丽特平息了仇怨，又于1308年当选罗马人的国王、1312年加冕为皇帝，把卢森堡家族推上帝国政治的顶峰。他的儿子约翰自1313年起为伯爵，1310年夺得波希米亚王位，把家族权力中心迁往布拉格；他在1336年征讨立陶宛的十字军途中双目失明，1337年以七大选帝侯之一的身份统治卢森堡，1346年在克雷西战役中指挥法军前锋时阵亡。1353年，皇帝查理四世把卢森堡连同阿尔隆、迪尔比、拉罗什和菲安登等地升格为卢森堡公国，封给异母弟文策尔。1437年皇帝西吉斯蒙德去世，家族男系断绝，公国于1443年转入勃艮第的好人腓力之手，1477年又随勃艮第的玛丽与奥地利的马克西米利安联姻而归哈布斯堡家族，1549年的《国事诏书》把它列入十七省之列。卢森堡不断加固的要塞后来赢得了“北方直布罗陀”之称。

en: Limbuwan, called Yakthung Laaje or the land of the Limbu-speaking people, covers the eastern Himalayan hills between the Arun and Teesta rivers, in present-day eastern Nepal. It was never a single monarchy but a league of ten Limbu kingdoms, each ruled from a hill fort by a king bearing the title Hang. In the ninth century the overlord Uba Hang, and later Sirijonga Hang of Yangwarok, reunited the quarrelling chiefs; Sirijonga built forts at Phedap and Chainpur and gave the Limbus a shared Limbu script. After the country lost its eastern marches between Kangchenjunga and the Teesta to the Namgyal kings of Sikkim, it fell apart in the early fifteenth century, and princes from Kamrup founded the lowland kingdom of Morang, whose ruler Pungla Ing adopted Hinduism and took a Hindu raja name. His descendant Bijay Narayan Raya founded the town of Bijaypur in 1584, which became the seat of Morang and the chief town of the region. In 1609 the Sen raja Lohang Sen captured Morang and his line ruled it for seven generations, until the Limbu minister Buddhi Karna Raya took the throne in 1769. The Limbuwan-Gorkha War of 1771 to 1774 ended with a collective treaty: the ten Limbu rulers submitted to Prithvi Narayan Shah and Limbuwan was incorporated into the kingdom of Nepal.
zh: 林布旺在林布语中称“雅克通·拉杰”，意为林布语居民之地，涵盖阿润河与蒂斯塔河之间的喜马拉雅山东段山地，在今尼泊尔东部。它从来不是统一的君主国，而是十个林布小王国的联合体，每个王国都由称号“杭”的国王据山堡统治。9世纪，宗主乌巴·杭以及后来扬瓦罗克的西里琼加·杭先后压服相互争斗的诸首领；西里琼加在费达普和琴布尔修筑堡垒，并为林布人统一了林布文字。林布旺把干城章嘉峰与蒂斯塔河之间的东部边地丢给锡金南嘉王朝的国王后，于15世纪初陷入分裂，来自迦摩缕波的王公建立了低地王国莫朗；其君主蓬格拉·英改宗印度教，改用印度教式的拉贾名号。他的后裔维贾伊·纳拉扬·拉亚于1584年兴建维贾亚普尔城，该城后来成为莫朗的都城和整个地区的首邑。1609年，森王朝的洛杭·森攻占莫朗，其家族统治了七代，直到林布出身的大臣布迪·卡尔纳·拉亚于1769年登上王位。1771至1774年的林布旺—廓尔喀战争以集体条约告终：十位林布君主向普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿臣服，林布旺并入尼泊尔王国。

en: Luoxiong is the mountainous country at the meeting point of Yunnan, Guizhou and Guangxi, on the upper Nanpan, a gateway between the three provinces known as the Lock of Yunnan and Guizhou. Under the Dali kingdom its people were the Luojiu, one of the thirty-seven eastern tribes whose chiefs swore an alliance with the Duan court at Shicheng in 971. The Mongols organised the area as Luoxiong Subprefecture, which under the Ming became one of the four subprefectures of Qujing Prefecture and was renamed Luoping Subprefecture.
zh: 罗雄地处云南、贵州、广西三省交界的山区，位于南盘江上游，旧有‘滇黔锁钥’之称。大理国时，当地的罗鸠部是滇东三十七部之一，971年三十七部酋长在石城与段氏政权会盟立碑。蒙古入滇后，这一带被编为罗雄州；明代它成为曲靖府下辖的四州之一，改称罗平州。

en: The Liangzhai tag covers the stockaded Zhuang country around Bazhai in present-day Maguan, southeastern Yunnan, which under the Yuan was the Yinijia tribal unit under Lin'an Route. The Ming organized the same district as the Bazhai Chief's Office in 1414, directly under the Yunnan military commission, until the Qing replaced it with an ordinary township in 1662.
zh: 良寨对应的是云南东南、今马关县八寨一带的壮族寨堡地区，元代属临安路下辖的矣尼迦部。1414年，明朝在同一地区设立八寨长官司，直属云南都司；1662年清朝将其改设永平里，土司世袭就此终结。

en: Luozuo was a small Zhuang native subprefecture created under the Yuan in 1276 in the hill country of present-day Funing in southeastern Yunnan, grouped with Fuzhou and Anning under the Guangnan West Route commission. In 1383 the early Ming folded Luozuo and Anning into Fuzhou, ending its separate tusi line.
zh: 罗佐是1276年元朝在云南东南、今富宁县山区设置的壮族小土州，与富州、安宁州同属广南西路宣抚司。1383年，明初将罗佐州与安宁州一并并入富州，这一土司建制就此撤销。

en: Ma'bar was the Muslim name for the Tamil coast, and the sultanate centred on Madurai grew out of the Delhi Sultanate's southernmost province. In 1335 its governor Jalaluddin Ahsan Khan, a north Indian from Kaithal, declared independence as Muhammad bin Tughluq's empire began to disintegrate; Tughluq marched against him in 1337 but fell ill at Bidar and had to turn back. The new kingdom, ruled by a Hindustani-speaking Muslim elite, held Madurai, Tiruchirapalli and parts of South Arcot, and in 1343 its sultan Ghiyasuddin Damghani captured and killed the Hoysala king Veera Ballala III. The Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta, who married a daughter of the founding sultan, left a grim account of its wars with the Hindu population. Plagued by coups, Ma'bar saw eight rulers in forty-three years, and in 1378 the last sultan was killed at Madurai by Kumara Kampana, whose father Bukka Raya ruled Vijayanagara; the sultanate was annexed and later passed to the Madurai Nayakas.
zh: 马巴尔是穆斯林对泰米尔海岸的称呼，以马杜赖为中心的这个苏丹国源自德里苏丹国最南端的行省。1335年，随着穆罕默德·图格鲁克的帝国走向瓦解，该行省总督、出身北印度凯塔尔的贾拉勒丁·阿赫桑汗宣布独立；图格鲁克于1337年发兵征讨，却在比达尔染病，只得退兵。新王国由讲印度斯坦语的穆斯林精英统治，据有马杜赖、蒂鲁吉拉帕利和南阿尔科特部分地区；1343年，苏丹吉亚斯丁·达姆加尼俘获并处死了曷萨拉国王维拉·巴拉拉三世。摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰曾娶开国苏丹之女，他在游记里留下了马巴尔与印度教徒交战的残酷记载。由于政变不断，马巴尔四十三年间换了八位苏丹；1378年末代苏丹在马杜赖被毗奢耶那伽罗君主布卡·拉亚之子库马拉·坎帕纳击杀，苏丹国被吞并，后来归入马杜赖纳亚克诸将的统治。

en: The March was the great Mortimer lordship of the Welsh border, anchored by the castles of Wigmore and Ludlow. Wigmore was raised around 1070 by William FitzOsbern, Earl of Hereford, and granted in 1075 to Ralph de Mortimer, whose family built a cross-border barony stretching from Herefordshire into Wales. Mortimer power peaked under Roger Mortimer, who gained Ludlow and Irish estates by marriage, led the barons against Edward II, and as Queen Isabella's lover ruled England after the king's deposition in 1327, becoming Earl of March in 1328. Edward III seized him at Nottingham and had him executed in 1330, and the lordship remained forfeit until his grandson Roger recovered it in 1342. The family later recovered so far that in the 1380s the young Roger Mortimer was proclaimed heir presumptive to Richard II; when the male line failed in 1424, the estates passed to the House of York through Anne Mortimer, feeding the Yorkist claim in the Wars of the Roses. The lordship's separate jurisdiction ended with the Laws in Wales Acts of 1535 to 1542.
zh: 边区是莫蒂默家族在威尔士边境的大领主领，以威格莫尔和勒德洛两座城堡为支柱。威格莫尔约1070年由赫里福德伯爵威廉·菲茨奥斯本兴建，1075年封给拉尔夫·德·莫蒂默，其家族由此建立起一个从赫里福德郡伸入威尔士的跨境男爵领。莫蒂默家族的权势在罗杰·莫蒂默时达到顶峰：他通过婚姻取得勒德洛和爱尔兰地产，率领贵族对抗爱德华二世，并在1327年国王被废后以王后伊莎贝拉情人的身份执掌英格兰大政，1328年受封马奇伯爵。1330年爱德华三世在诺丁汉将他擒获处决，领地被没收，直到1342年其孙罗杰才收回。莫蒂默家族后来声势复振，14世纪80年代年幼的罗杰·莫蒂默被宣布为理查二世的推定继承人；1424年男嗣断绝后，地产经安妮·莫蒂默转入约克家族，为玫瑰战争中的约克派王位主张提供了依据。1535至1542年的《威尔士法案》结束了该领主领的独立司法地位。

en: Magdeburg, on the Elbe, was first recorded in 805 and became the favoured city of Otto the Great, who gave it to his queen Edith in 929 and founded a Benedictine monastery there in 937. To secure and christianize the Slavic lands east of the Elbe, Otto had an archbishopric established at Magdeburg in 967, with the new sees of Brandenburg, Havelberg, Merseburg, Zeitz and Meissen as its suffragans. Under Archbishop Wichmann the chapter's temporalities won imperial immediacy in 1180, turning Magdeburg into a prince-archbishopric of the Empire; the present cathedral was begun in 1208 and consecrated in 1263. In 1325 citizens murdered Archbishop Burchard III, drawing the imperial ban on the city, and the dispute was only settled under Otto of Hesse, archbishop from 1327, to whom the town swore homage in 1333. Magdeburg joined the Reformation early and became a leading Protestant city, which in 1631 was stormed and sacked by Tilly's army in the Thirty Years' War. The Peace of Westphalia in 1648 promised the see to Brandenburg, and on the death of its last administrator in 1680 the prince-archbishopric was secularized as the Duchy of Magdeburg under the Hohenzollerns.
zh: 马格德堡位于易北河畔，805年首见记载，是奥托大帝最钟爱的城市：929年他把它赐给王后伊迪丝作为嫁妆，937年又在此建立本笃会修道院。为了守卫易北河以东的斯拉夫人土地并向其传教，奥托于967年在马格德堡设立大主教区，下辖勃兰登堡、哈弗尔贝格、梅泽堡、蔡茨和迈森等新主教区。在大主教维希曼治下，教区领地于1180年取得帝国直辖地位，马格德堡由此成为神圣罗马帝国的亲王大主教区；现存的大教堂1208年动工、1263年祝圣。1325年市民杀害大主教布尔夏德三世，城市因此被褫夺法律保护，直到1327年就任的黑森的奥托收场，市民于1333年向他宣誓效忠。马格德堡很早就皈依宗教改革，成为新教重镇，1631年三十年战争中被蒂利的军队攻陷并洗劫。1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》把该教区的继承权许给勃兰登堡；1680年末任管理者去世后，亲王大主教区被世俗化为霍亨索伦家族治下的马格德堡公国。

en: The Mahiyan are the Jurchen group of the Mayan river, whose Manchu name refers to its elbow-like bends; it rises in the Zhangguangcai mountains and winds through Shangzhi, Yanshou and Fangzheng to join the right bank of the Songhua. They were among the Wild Jurchens brought under Later Jin rule in Nurhaci's campaigns of 1596 to 1625.
zh: 马希安是蚂蜒河畔的女真群体，蚂蜒河又称蚂蚁河，满语意为肘，因干流弯曲如肘得名；它发源于张广才岭，流经尚志、延寿、方正，在方正县注入松花江右岸。他们属于野人女真，在1596年至1625年努尔哈赤的征讨中被纳入后金版图。

en: The Archbishopric of Mainz grew from the Roman city of Mogontiacum, whose see Saint Boniface took over in 747 and which became an archdiocese in 781; its incumbent was Primate of Germany and, as archchancellor of the Empire, ranked first among the prince-electors, a precedence fixed in the Golden Bull of 1356. His lands were scattered: the city of Mainz and stretches of the Rhine and Main around Aschaffenburg, together with the Eichsfeld and Erfurt far to the east. In 1337 the see was held by Henry III of Virneburg, whose election in 1328 was disputed by Baldwin of Luxembourg until 1336 and who backed Emperor Louis IV until Pope Clement VI deposed him in 1346. The city of Mainz itself enjoyed the status of a free city from 1244 until the Diocesan Feud of 1461 to 1462, when Archbishop Adolf of Nassau stormed it and reined in its liberties. Mainz won lasting fame as the home of Johannes Gutenberg, whose printing press produced the 42-line Bible around 1455, and its university opened in 1477. The electorate remained Catholic through the Reformation and was dissolved in the secularization of 1803, its territories divided among Prussia, Hesse and the Nassau princes, while Dalberg retained Aschaffenburg.
zh: 美因茨大主教区源于罗马城市莫贡提亚库姆，747年圣波尼法爵接任该主教座，781年升格为大主教区；其大主教身兼德意志首席主教和帝国大首相，在选侯中位列第一，这一优先权在1356年的《金玺诏书》中确定下来。它的领地互不相连：除美因茨城和阿沙芬堡一带的莱茵河、美因河土地外，还包括远方的艾希斯费尔德和埃尔福特。1337年在任的是亨利三世·冯·菲尔讷堡，他1328年当选，与卢森堡的巴尔杜因争执到1336年才获普遍承认；他支持皇帝路易四世，直到1346年被教皇克莱门特六世罢免。美因茨城本身1244至1462年间享有自由城市地位，1461至1462年的主教区纷争中，大主教阿道夫·冯·拿骚攻陷城市，收回了它的自由。美因茨还因约翰内斯·古腾堡闻名于世，他的印刷所约在1455年印出四十二行圣经；美因茨大学则于1477年创办。宗教改革时期选侯区坚持天主教，1803年在世俗化中解散，领土被普鲁士、黑森和拿骚诸侯瓜分，达尔贝格只保住阿沙芬堡。

en: Majapahit was a Hindu-Buddhist thalassocratic empire based at Trowulan in eastern Java, whose power rested on its war fleets and a network of tributary states across the archipelago. It was founded in 1293 by Raden Wijaya, who first used a Mongol expedition sent by Kublai Khan to overthrow the usurper Jayakatwang of Kediri and then turned on the Yuan troops and drove them from Java, taking the regnal name Kertarajasa. Early reigns were shaken by revolts, and it was the young officer Gajah Mada who saved King Jayanegara during the Kuti rebellion of 1319. In 1336 Queen Tribhuwana made him mahapatih, or prime minister, and he took the Palapa oath to bring the whole archipelago under Majapahit rule; his campaigns conquered Bali in 1343 and extended Majapahit power from Sumatra to the Moluccas. Under Tribhuwana's son Hayam Wuruk, who reigned from 1350 to 1389, the empire reached its peak, and the court poem Nagarakretagama of 1365 claimed ninety-eight tributaries. Succession wars after Hayam Wuruk's death, above all the Regreg civil war of 1405 to 1406, loosened the hold on the vassals, while the rise of Malacca and the Demak sultanate narrowed the kingdom to its Javanese heartland. Demak overran Trowulan in 1527, and the surviving court, priests and artisans fled east to Bali.
zh: 满者伯夷是以爪哇岛东部多乌兰为都的印度教—佛教海洋帝国，凭借战舰队和遍布群岛的朝贡网络称雄。1293年，拉登·韦查耶先利用忽必烈派来的蒙古远征军推翻谏义里的篡位者查耶卡旺，随即反戈将元军逐出爪哇，自己以克塔拉亚萨为号建国。开国初期叛乱不断，年轻军官加查·马达在1319年的库提叛乱中救驾有功；1336年，女王特里布瓦纳任命他为宰相，他立下帕拉帕誓言，誓将整个群岛纳入满者伯夷版图。其大军于1343年征服巴厘，把势力从苏门答腊扩张到马鲁古。特里布瓦纳之子哈奄·武禄于1350至1389年在位，帝国臻于鼎盛，1365年的宫廷史诗《爪哇史颂》宣称其领有98个朝贡国。哈奄·武禄死后继承纷争不断，尤以1405至1406年的雷格雷格内战为重，诸附庸纷纷失控；满剌加和淡目苏丹国相继崛起，王国版图收缩到爪哇腹地。1527年淡目攻陷多乌兰，残存的王室、祭司和工匠东逃巴厘。

en: Makuria was the medieval Nubian kingdom that ruled the Nile valley from its capital at Dongola, founded around 500 on the lands left by the collapse of Kush. It converted to Christianity in the mid-sixth century and annexed its northern neighbour Nobatia early in the seventh century. An Arab invasion of 652 failed to take Dongola, and the resulting Baqt treaty secured mostly peaceful relations with Egypt until the thirteenth century. The ninth to eleventh centuries were Makuria's zenith: the Throne Hall and the great cruciform church rose at Dongola, Old Nubian flourished as a written language, and the kingdom kept close dynastic ties with Alodia to the south while extending its power into Kordofan. Mamluk Egypt turned hostile after 1260: a punitive army sacked Dongola in 1276 and reduced Makuria to a tributary. In 1316 the Mamluks installed its first Muslim king, after which Christian and Muslim rulers alternated amid Bedouin pressure and the plague. A civil war of 1365 cost the kingdom Dongola itself, and its rulers withdrew to Gebel Adda and Qasr Ibrim. The last recorded king, Joel, appears around 1463, and Makuria vanished in the late fifteenth century; by 1523 Dongola belonged to the Funj sultanate of Sennar, while the Ottomans occupied Lower Nubia in the 1560s.
zh: 马库里亚是中世纪的努比亚王国，以约500年在库施崩溃后的故地上兴建的栋古拉为都，统治尼罗河谷。它于6世纪中叶皈依基督教，7世纪初吞并北邻诺巴。652年阿拉伯军队入侵却未能攻下栋古拉，双方随后签订《巴克特条约》，使马库里亚与埃及大体维持和平直到13世纪。9至11世纪是马库里亚的鼎盛期：栋古拉建起王座大厅和大型十字形教堂，古努比亚语成为发达的书面语，它与南方的阿勒底亚保持密切的王朝联系，势力还伸入科尔多凡。1260年后马穆鲁克埃及转为敌对：1276年远征军洗劫栋古拉，马库里亚沦为纳贡附庸。1316年马穆鲁克扶立了第一位穆斯林国王，此后基督徒与穆斯林君主交替在位，同时承受贝都因人的压力和瘟疫的打击。1365年的内战使王国连栋古拉也告失守，统治者退守杰贝勒阿达和盖斯尔伊卜里姆。最后一位有记载的国王约耳在1463年前后仍见诸文献，马库里亚于15世纪末消亡；到1523年栋古拉已属以森纳尔为都的丰吉苏丹国，奥斯曼人则在1560年代占领下努比亚。

en: Mali began as a small Mandinka kingdom in the upper Niger valley around the trading town of Niani, and rose to empire as Ghana, or Wagadu, broke apart. About 1235 Sundiata Keita united the Mandinka chiefs, overthrew Soumaoro Kanté of Sosso at the battle of Kirina and gave the new state its charter, the Kouroukan Fouga; his Keita successors ruled with the title mansa. Later generals brought the goldfields of Bambuk and the merchant cities of Timbuktu and Djenné under Niani's control, so that Mali taxed the gold, salt and slave caravans crossing the Sahel and became the largest power in West Africa. After a freedman general, Sakura, seized the throne in 1285, the Keita line returned under Mansa Gao, and from about 1312 Mansa Musa presided over the golden age; his pilgrimage to Mecca of 1324 to 1326, paid for with Wangara gold, carried Niani's fame from Cairo to the Maghreb. Musa died about 1337, the opening year of the game, and his son Maghan I was soon set aside by Suleyman, whose reign the traveller Ibn Battuta described after visiting in 1352. From 1507 Diarra, the Great Fulo, Yatenga and Songhai peeled away Mali's provinces; Songhai armies sacked the capital in 1544, and a last bid for recovery ended in defeat at Djenné in 1599. The Keitas then withdrew to Kangaba as local chiefs, and the empire had ceased to exist by 1610.
zh: 马里本是尼日尔河上游、商镇尼亚尼附近的一个曼丁戈小王国，在加纳（又称瓦加杜）瓦解之际崛起。约1235年，松迪亚塔·凯塔联合曼丁戈各部，在基里纳战役推翻苏苏王国的苏曼古鲁·坎特，并以《库鲁坎·富加》作为新国家的宪章，他的凯塔家族继承者此后以曼萨为号进行统治。后来的几代将领把邦布金矿和廷巴克图、杰内等商业名城纳入尼亚尼治下，马里向穿越萨赫勒的黄金、食盐和奴隶商队征税，成为西非最大的强权。1285年，奴隶出身的将领萨库拉夺取王位，其后凯塔一脉在曼萨·高治下恢复；约1312年起，曼萨·穆萨开启了帝国的黄金时代，1324至1326年他靠万加拉黄金资助的麦加朝觐，使尼亚尼之名远播开罗与马格里布。穆萨约在1337年、也就是游戏开局之年去世，其子马甘一世不久被苏莱曼取代，旅行家伊本·白图泰于1352年到访，记下了苏莱曼朝的景象。1507年起，迪亚拉、大富洛、亚滕加和桑海相继蚕食马里的行省，桑海军队于1544年洗劫都城，马里最后一次复兴尝试在1599年杰内之败后告终。凯塔家族随后退回康加巴，沦为地方酋长，帝国到1610年已不复存在。

en: Egypt entered this period as the seat of the Ayyubid sultanate founded by Saladin in 1171, whose reliance on imported slave-soldiers gave the mamluk regiments their opening: in 1250 they overthrew the Ayyubid heir and set up their own sultanate in Cairo. The Bahri line of Turkish mamluks ruled until 1382, turning Egypt into the centre of an empire spanning the Levant, the Hejaz and Nubia and making Cairo one of the richest cities of the medieval Mediterranean, its wealth drawn from Indian Ocean trade passing through its ports and from the iqta fiscal system. In 1382 the emir Barquq founded the Circassian Burji line; later sultans such as Barsbay, who reduced Cyprus to vassalage in 1426, and Qaitbay long propped up the state through trade monopolies and building, but plague, Bedouin unrest and inflation eroded its strength. The Ottomans defeated the last sultan, al-Ghuri, in 1516 and took Cairo in 1517, yet Mamluk houses soon regained influence inside the Ottoman province, which kept a large measure of self-rule. Napoleon's French army occupied Egypt from 1798 to 1801, and in 1805 the Albanian officer Muhammad Ali seized power, built a new army and state, and by the war of 1831 to 1833 against the sultan had made Egypt a nearly independent power ruling Syria as well.
zh: 这一时代开始时，埃及是萨拉丁于1171年建立的阿尤布苏丹国的中心；阿尤布王朝倚重输入的奴隶士兵，马穆鲁克军团趁机坐大，于1250年推翻阿尤布继承人，在开罗自建苏丹国。突厥裔马穆鲁克的伯海里系统治到1382年，把埃及变成一个横跨黎凡特、汉志和努比亚的帝国中心，开罗也成为中世纪地中海最富庶的城市之一，其财富来自过境港口的印度洋贸易和伊克塔财税制度。1382年，埃米尔巴尔库克开创切尔克斯人的布尔吉系；此后的苏丹们，如1426年迫使塞浦路斯称臣的巴尔西拜和长期靠贸易垄断与营建支撑局面的盖特拜，虽各有建树，却挡不住瘟疫、贝都因动乱和通货膨胀对国力的侵蚀。奥斯曼人于1516年击败末代苏丹古里，1517年攻占开罗；但马穆鲁克世家很快在这个奥斯曼行省里重获权势，使埃及保有很大的自治空间。1798至1801年拿破仑的法军占领埃及，1805年阿尔巴尼亚裔军官穆罕默德·阿里夺权，编练新军、改造国家，并在1831至1833年对苏丹的战争中把埃及建成一个近乎独立、且领有叙利亚的强权。

en: Mantua is a walled city-state on the Mincio in Lombardy. After the death of Countess Matilda of Canossa in 1115 it became a free commune, and in 1273 Pinamonte Bonacolsi made himself captain of the people, founding a signoria that lasted until 1328, when Ludovico Gonzaga overthrew the last Bonacolsi and took power. In 1337 the Gonzaga still ruled as captains of the people; Ludovico II secured the family's hold after 1369. In 1433 Gianfrancesco Gonzaga paid 120,000 florins to Emperor Sigismund for the title of marquis, and Pope Pius II held the Council of Mantua there in 1459 to preach a crusade. Emperor Charles V made Federico II the first duke in 1530, and the Gonzaga inherited Montferrat by marriage the next year. Their court became one of the most brilliant in Italy: Giulio Romano built Palazzo Te, and Claudio Monteverdi staged L'Orfeo there in 1607. The direct line died out in 1627, the War of the Mantuan Succession ended with the imperial sack of the city in 1630, and when the last Gonzaga died in 1708 Mantua passed to the Habsburgs while Montferrat went to the House of Savoy.
zh: 曼托瓦是伦巴第明乔河畔的筑城城邦。1115年卡诺莎女伯爵玛蒂尔达去世后，它成为自由市镇；1273年皮纳蒙特·博纳科尔西自立为市民官，建立领主统治，直到1328年卢多维科一世·贡扎加推翻末代博纳科尔西夺取政权。1337年贡扎加家族仍以市民官身份执政，卢多维科二世在1369年后巩固了家族权位。1433年吉安弗朗切斯科一世·贡扎加向皇帝西吉斯蒙德支付12万弗罗林，换得侯爵头衔；1459年教宗庇护二世在曼托瓦召开会议，号召组织十字军。1530年皇帝查理五世封费德里科二世为首任公爵，次年贡扎加家族又通过婚姻继承了蒙费拉托。曼托瓦宫廷成为意大利最辉煌的宫廷之一：朱利奥·罗马诺修建了特宫，克劳迪奥·蒙特威尔第于1607年在此首演《奥菲欧》。家族直系于1627年绝嗣，曼托瓦继承战争以1630年帝国军队洗劫城市告终；1708年末代贡扎加去世后，曼托瓦并入哈布斯堡，蒙费拉托则归萨伏依家族。

en: Maryul, later known as Ladakh, was the westernmost of the Tibetan kingdoms born from the collapse of the Tibetan Empire, with its capital at Shey in the upper Indus valley. Around 930 the eldest son of Kyide Nyimagon founded it, ruling from the Zoji La pass on the Kashmir border to Demchok in the southeast, with Rudok among its eastern lands. As the senior branch it claimed suzerainty over Guge and Purang, and around 1100 King Lhachen Utpala brought a weakened Guge under his control. The first dynasty weathered Kashmiri raids until 1460, when Lhachen Bhagan seized the throne and founded the Namgyal dynasty, under which the name Ladakh gradually replaced Maryul. Sengge Namgyal, who reigned from 1616 to 1642, built Leh Palace and the Hemis and Hanle monasteries, and Ladakh annexed Guge in the 1630s. The resulting Tibet-Ladakh-Mughal War ended in 1684 with the Treaty of Tingmosgang, which left Guge, Purang and Rudok to Tibet. The Namgyal line survived into the 1830s, when the Dogra general Zorawar Singh invaded from Jammu in 1834 and reduced Ladakh to a tributary.
zh: 麻域即后来的拉达克，是吐蕃帝国解体后诞生的诸西藏王国中位置最西的一个，以上印度河谷的谢伊为都。约930年，吉德尼玛衮的长子建政，疆域西起克什米尔边境的佐吉拉山口，东南抵典角，东部还领有日土等地。作为长支，麻域对古格、布让保有宗主权；约1100年，国王乌特巴拉迫使衰落的古格臣服。第一个王朝在克什米尔的侵袭中延续到1460年，巴干夺取王位，建立南嘉王朝，“拉达克”之名此后逐渐取代麻域。1616—1642年在位的僧格南嘉兴建列城王宫以及黑密斯、汉涅等寺，并于17世纪30年代吞并古格。随后的西藏—拉达克—莫卧儿战争以1684年的《廷莫斯冈条约》收场，古格、布让和日土被划归西藏。南嘉王统延续到19世纪30年代：1834年道格拉名将左拉瓦尔·辛格自查谟入侵，拉达克沦为附庸。

en: Tollohcan was a Matlatzinca city-state in the Toluca Valley, called Matlatzinco in Nahuatl, a highland basin west of the Valley of Mexico shared by Matlatzinca, Otomi, Mazahua and Nahua speakers. The Matlatzinca had emerged as a people distinct from the southern Otomi by the twelfth century, and Teotenango and later Calixtlahuaca grew into the valley's dominant capitals, while Tollocan itself long remained a secondary town overshadowed by Calixtlahuaca. Its people were governed by a theocratic nobility whose high lords confirmed the rulers of the local towns, and the valley's quarrels drew in both the Tepanecs of Azcapotzalco and the Purépecha empire to the west. In the later 1470s the Aztec tlatoani Axayacatl overran the valley, destroyed Calixtlahuaca and made Tollocan the seat of the imperial province through which the region paid tribute in maize, mantles and warrior costumes. Many Matlatzinca were then displaced or resettled and Nahuatl-speaking colonists were brought in, beginning the decline of their language.
zh: 托洛坎是托卢卡谷地的一座马特拉钦卡人城邦；该谷地在纳瓦特尔语中称马特拉钦科，是墨西哥谷地以西的高原盆地，马特拉钦卡、奥托米、马萨瓦和纳瓦等族群都在此居住。到12世纪，马特拉钦卡人已从南部奥托米人中分化为独立族群，特奥滕南戈及后来的卡利斯特拉瓦卡先后成长为谷地的首要都城，而托洛坎本身长期是屈居卡利斯特拉瓦卡之下的次要城镇。当地人由神权贵族中的几位大领主统治，各城统治者选出后须经他们确认；谷地的纷争还把阿斯卡波察尔科的特帕内克人和西方的普雷佩查帝国牵扯进来。15世纪70年代后期，阿兹特克特拉托阿尼阿哈雅卡特尔横扫谷地，摧毁卡利斯特拉瓦卡，把托洛坎设为帝国行省治所，全区通过它进献玉米、披风和战士装束。此后大量马特拉钦卡人被迁走或重新安置，帝国又移入讲纳瓦特尔语的殖民者，马特拉钦卡语由此走向衰落。

en: Mau Ganj, remembered as the Mau Raj, was a small Sengar Rajput kingdom in the fertile country that later formed the heart of Bagelkhand. The Sengars migrated from Jalaun in the eleventh century and raised a chain of mud forts, garhis, at Mau, Mangawan and Bicchrahta, holding their ground against the Kalachuri rajas to the south. Their independence ended in the fourteenth century, when the expanding Baghelas defeated them in the battle of Mau, stormed their fort and folded the little kingdom into Bagelkhand. Before the fall a junior Sengar prince had already withdrawn to the wooded country nearby, where the prince's son Chattradhari Singh built the fortress of Nai Garhi, meaning new fortress; its elephant gate was raised by Chattradhari's son Hathi Raj Singh, and the Sengar thakurs of Nai Garhi kept their small sovereign estate long after the old Mau Raj had gone, and were still fighting British sepoys near Itar in 1813.
zh: 毛甘吉古称毛拉杰，是后来成为巴格尔坎德核心的富庶土地上的森加拉杰普特小王国。森加尔人于11世纪从贾劳恩迁来，在毛甘杰、曼加万和比奇赫拉塔修筑一连串称作加尔希的土堡，抵住了南方迦罗朱利诸拉贾的进攻。他们的独立在14世纪终结：扩张中的婆稽罗人在毛战役中击败森加尔人，攻陷其堡垒，把这个小王国并入巴格尔坎德。城破之前，一位森加尔幼支王子已退入附近林地，王子之子查特拉达里·辛格在那里修建了意为新堡的奈加尔希堡，象门则由查特拉达里之子哈蒂·拉杰·辛格建成；在旧毛拉杰灭亡之后很久，奈加尔希的森加尔特库尔们仍守着小小的自主领地，1813年还在伊塔尔附近与英国士兵交战。

en: Mombasa is a Swahili port on an island of the Kenyan coast, its deep Kilindini harbor making it a prize for every power in the western Indian Ocean. Founded around 900, it was already prosperous when the geographer al-Idrisi named it in 1151, and Ibn Battuta, stopping there in 1331, found devout Shafi'i Muslims worshipping in well-built wooden mosques; the stone Mnara mosque rose about 1300, and the city belonged to the Kilwa Sultanate from the early fourteenth century. Vasco da Gama met a hostile reception in 1498, and Portuguese fleets sacked the town in 1500 and again under Francisco de Almeida in 1505; Mombasa broke from Kilwa in 1502 and was destroyed once more by Nuno da Cunha in 1528. An Ottoman force under Ali Bey seized it in 1585, but the Portuguese retook it in 1589 and built Fort Jesus in 1593. In 1631 the local ruler Dom Jeronimo massacred the garrison, though Portuguese rule returned a year later, and in 1698 the Omanis stormed Fort Jesus. Mazrui governors made Mombasa effectively independent from 1746; a short British protectorate from 1824 to 1826 gave way to renewed Omani rule, and in 1837 Said bin Sultan of Muscat annexed the city to his Zanzibar dominions.
zh: 蒙巴萨是肯尼亚沿海一座岛屿上的斯瓦希里港口，其深水港基林迪尼使它成为西印度洋每个强权觊觎的目标。该城约建于900年，1151年地理学家伊德里西已提到它；1331年伊本·白图泰在此停留一夜，看到虔信的沙斐仪派穆斯林在建造精良的木制清真寺中礼拜，石制的姆纳拉清真寺约建于1300年。14世纪初起，蒙巴萨隶属基卢瓦苏丹国。1498年瓦斯科·达伽马在此受到冷遇，葡萄牙舰队于1500年洗劫该城，1505年弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达再度出兵；蒙巴萨于1502年脱离基卢瓦，1528年又被努诺·达·库尼亚摧毁。1585年，阿里贝伊率领的奥斯曼军队夺取该城，但葡萄牙人于1589年再次攻占，并在1593年建成耶稣堡。1631年，当地统治者唐·热罗尼莫屠杀驻军，不过葡萄牙人一年后恢复了直接统治。1698年，阿曼人攻陷耶稣堡；1746年起，马兹鲁伊家族的总督使蒙巴萨实质独立。1824年至1826年的短暂英国保护国之后，阿曼恢复统治，1837年马斯喀特的赛义德·本·苏丹将该城并入他的桑给巴尔领地。

en: Manabondro is a coastal settlement in the Manambondro country of southeastern Madagascar, the homeland later known as that of the Temanambondro branch of the Antaisaka people. The Antaisaka descend from Sakalava royals of the Zarabehava line who crossed from the western kingdom of Menabe to the east coast between 1620 and 1650. Their leader Andriamandresy, a prince exiled after a succession quarrel, led his warriors and slaves to Nosipandra, modern Vangaindrano, by the 1650s. From there they built a kingdom that by the early eighteenth century ranked among the four largest in Madagascar, reaching its greatest extent under King Lengoabo. Succession disputes often weakened it, and from 1820 the Merina armies from the central highlands overran the Antaisaka country, carrying many of its people off as slaves.
zh: 马纳邦德罗是马达加斯加东南沿海马纳邦德罗地区的滨海定居点，这片土地后来是安泰萨卡人特马纳邦德罗支系的故土。安泰萨卡人源自萨卡拉瓦人的扎拉贝哈瓦王室支系：1620至1650年间，他们从西部的梅纳贝王国东渡海岸，首领安德里亚曼德雷西是一位因继承权之争被放逐的王子，率战士和奴隶于17世纪50年代抵达诺西潘德拉，即今天的万加因德拉努。他们在此建立的王国到18世纪初已跻身马达加斯加四大王国之列，并在伦戈阿博王治下扩张到最大版图。继承纷争常常削弱国力，1820年起，来自中部高原的伊梅里纳军队攻陷安泰萨卡地区，许多人被掳为奴。

en: Mbata was a Bantu kingdom whose court stood at Mbanza Mbata, in the Kwango River country east of the later heartland of Kongo. Its rulers belonged to the Nsaku lineage, and in 1337 the chief was Lau Nsaku. According to Kongo tradition, the marriage of Nimi a Nzima of Mpemba Kasi to Lukeni Lua Sange, daughter of the Mbata chief, joined the two peoples, and their son Lukeni lua Nimi became the first Mwene Kongo when the Kingdom of Kongo took shape around 1375. Mbata entered the new kingdom as a kingdom within a kingdom: its own ruler was inherited through the matrilineal line rather than appointed from the capital, Mbata princes traditionally conducted Kongo's diplomacy, and its army helped subdue the southern plateau realm of Mwene Kabunga. After Kongo adopted Catholicism in the 1490s, Mbata was restyled the Duchy of Bambata, and its Nsaku chiefs kept their privileged rank under the Manikongo for centuries.
zh: 姆巴塔是一个班图人王国，王庭设在姆班扎姆巴塔，位于后来刚果核心地带以东的宽果河流域。统治者出自恩萨库世系，1337年在位的酋长是劳·恩萨库。按照刚果的传统说法，姆佩姆巴卡锡的尼米·阿·恩津加娶姆巴塔酋长之女卢凯尼·卢阿·桑格为妻，两族由此合流；他们的儿子卢凯尼·卢阿·尼米在约1375年刚果王国形成时成为第一位马尼刚果。姆巴塔以“国中之国”的地位加入：它的统治者按母系世袭，不由首都任命，姆巴塔的王子世代掌管刚果的外交，其军队还协助征服了南部高原的姆韦内·卡本加。15世纪90年代刚果皈依天主教后，姆巴塔改称班巴塔公国，恩萨库家族的酋长们在马尼刚果治下长期保持着特权地位。

en: The County of Bregenz lay at the eastern end of Lake Constance around the town of Bregenz, guarding the routes into the Vorarlberg Alps. It is first recorded in 1043 as the seat of the Udalriching counts, whose last male heir, Count Rudolf, died in 1160; his daughter Elisabeth married the Palatine Count Hugo II of Tübingen, and their grandson Hugo I of Montfort carried Bregenz into the House of Montfort. From about 1170 the Montfort-Bregenz branch ruled the old county, and in 1337 its last count, Hugo, held the town shortly before the branch became extinct in 1338. The inheritance passed to the Montfort-Tettnang line, which from 1354 ruled as Montfort-Tettnang-Bregenz and produced the Minnesänger and statesman Hugo von Montfort, born in 1357. The heiress Elisabeth of Hochberg sold the elder half of the lordship to the Habsburg Duke Sigismund in 1451, and King Ferdinand I bought the remaining half in 1523. Bregenz then formed part of Further Austria, keeping its standing as an imperial county until the dissolution of the Empire in 1806.
zh: 布雷根茨伯国位于博登湖东端、布雷根茨镇一带，扼守进入福拉尔贝格山区的通道。它最早于1043年见诸记载，是乌达尔里希家族伯爵的治所；末代男嗣鲁道夫伯爵于1160年去世，其女伊丽莎白嫁给蒂宾根行宫伯爵胡戈二世，他们的孙子蒙特福特的胡戈一世把布雷根茨带入蒙特福特家族。约1170年起，蒙特福特-布雷根茨支系统治旧伯国；1337年，末代伯爵胡戈据有该镇，支系不久便于1338年绝嗣。遗产转入蒙特福特-泰特南一支，该支自1354年起以蒙特福特-泰特南-布雷根茨之名统治，并出了1357年出生的恋歌诗人与政治家胡戈·冯·蒙特福特。女继承人霍赫贝格的伊丽莎白于1451年把领地的大半卖给哈布斯堡公爵西吉斯蒙德，国王斐迪南一世又于1523年买下剩余的一半。布雷根茨此后成为前奥地利的一部分，直到1806年神圣罗马帝国解体都保持着帝国伯国的地位。

en: Michuachapanco is the Huastec polity centred on Pánuco, on the lower reaches of the river of the same name on the Gulf coast; in the Huastec tongue Pánuco means the pass, after the river crossing there. The town was the seat of a confederation of Huastec tribes and was ruled by a lord bearing the title Cuextecatl. Around 1450 the Huastecs were defeated by the armies of Moctezuma I and thereafter paid tribute to the Aztecs while keeping their local rulers. An expedition under Francisco de Garay was thrown back by local warriors at the lagoons of Chila and Tamós in 1521, but Hernán Cortés marched from Coyoacán in 1522 and took the region, founding Villa de Santiesteban del Puerto at Pánuco that December, only the second town council in the Americas and later capital of the colonial Province of Pánuco.
zh: 米却阿潘科是以帕努科为中心的瓦斯特克政权，位于墨西哥湾沿岸帕努科河下游；在瓦斯特克语中，帕努科意为渡口，得名于当地的过河处。该城是瓦斯特克诸部落联盟的驻地，统治者拥有奎斯特卡特尔的头衔。约1450年，瓦斯特克人被蒙特祖马一世的军队击败，此后向阿兹特克纳贡，但保留了本地首领。1521年，弗朗西斯科·德·加雷的远征队在奇拉和塔莫斯湖区被当地武士击退；1522年埃尔南·科尔特斯从科约阿坎出兵夺取该地，于12月在帕努科建立圣埃斯特万德尔普埃尔托镇，这是美洲大陆上第二个市政议会，后来成为殖民时期帕努科省的省会。

en: The Muchi, better known as the Muping tusi (Tibetan Mu-phyi), were a hereditary Gyalrong chieftaincy and one of the eighteen Gyalrong chiefdoms, holding the mountain country west of Yazhou in what is now Baoxing County, Sichuan. In 1410 its chief Nange submitted to the Ming and was appointed Dongbu Hanhu pacification commissioner. Under Keluo Jiancan, who succeeded in 1438, Muping grew powerful enough to invade the neighboring Tsakho chiefdom in 1449, but it declined after his death in 1455 and lost the lands it had seized. It submitted to the Qing in 1662, and Muping troops led the Qing assault on the rebel stronghold at Dartsedo during the Changcejilie rising of 1700; afterwards the ruling family intermarried with the Mingzheng tusi and often held both chiefdoms at once. The chieftain Jiancan Nangkha, invested in 1745, fought in the Jinchuan campaigns and received the Baturu honor in 1772. In 1833 the Yutong branch was recognized as a separate tusi.
zh: 木赤即穆坪（又作木坪，藏语穆丕）土司，是明朝至清朝的世袭嘉绒人土司，为嘉绒十八土司之一，辖境在今四川雅安宝兴县一带的雅州西山之中。1410年酋长南葛归附明朝，被授予董卜韩胡宣慰使司职。1438年克罗俄坚粲继位，势力强盛，于1449年大举入侵邻境杂谷土司；他在1455年去世后穆坪转衰，所占土地被杂谷夺回。1662年穆坪归附清朝，仍授原职；1700年打箭炉发生昌侧集烈之乱，穆坪兵随清军先行攻入西炉，此后其家族与明正土司联姻，常由一人兼领两司。1745年继任的坚参囊康率土兵参加大小金川之役，于1772年获赐巴图鲁勇号。1833年，占据鱼通的支系被清廷认定为独立的鱼通土司。

en: This is the Gaelic kingdom of Desmond, or South Munster, ruled from the Killarney lakes by the MacCarthy Mór, the Great MacCarthy and head of the whole MacCarthy kindred. It was born in 1118, when the Treaty of Glanmire split old Munster into Desmond and Thomond and Tadhg Mac Carthaigh became Desmond's first king; the dynasty traced itself to Carthach, an Eóganacht king who died in 1045, and his grandsons took Mac Carthaigh as their surname. The kingdom covered Cork and Kerry, with the O'Sullivans and O'Donovans among its subject clans, and the MacCarthys branched into the Duhallow, Muskerry and Carbery lines. After the Norman invasion the eastern half fell to the FitzGerald earls of Desmond, but the west stayed a semi-independent Gaelic realm, saved by Fínghin Mac Carthaigh's victory over the Geraldines at the Battle of Callann in 1261. In 1337 the king was Cormac MacCarthy Mor, who reigned until 1359; his younger son Dermot became the first Lord of Muskerry, and the dynasty founded Muckross Abbey, Kilcrea Friary and, in 1446, Blarney Castle. The kings kept their independence through the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries until the Nine Years' War, when the kingdom was dissolved in 1596 and Desmond was absorbed into the Kingdom of Ireland.
zh: 这是盖尔人的德斯蒙德王国，即南芒斯特，以基拉尼湖区为中心，统治者是麦卡锡·莫尔，意为“大麦卡锡”，也是整个麦卡锡家族的宗主。王国诞生于1118年：《格兰迈尔条约》把古芒斯特分为德斯蒙德与托蒙德，泰格·麦卡锡成为德斯蒙德第一代国王；该王朝可追溯到1045年去世的尤甘纳赫特国王卡萨赫，他的孙子们以麦卡锡为姓。王国领有科克和克里，臣属氏族包括奥沙利文和奥多诺万，麦卡锡家族后来分出杜哈洛、马斯克里和卡伯里三支。诺曼入侵后，东半部落入德斯蒙德的菲茨杰拉德伯爵之手，西部却作为半独立的盖尔王国存续下来——1261年，芬因·麦卡锡在卡兰战役击败杰拉尔丁家族，保住了独立。1337年在位的是科马克·麦卡锡·莫尔，他一直统治到1359年；幼子德莫特成为第一代马斯克里领主，王朝还修建了马克罗斯修道院、基尔克雷小修院，并于1446年建成布拉尼城堡。15至16世纪，历代国王维持独立，直到16世纪90年代的九年战争：王国于1596年被解散，德斯蒙德并入爱尔兰王国。

en: The Emirate of Medina was a sharifate centred on the Islamic holy city of Medina in the Hejaz, ruled by the Banu Muhanna, Husaynid Alids who claimed descent from Muhammad through Ali and his son Husayn. As Abbasid power collapsed, Ubayd Allah ibn Tahir seized control of the city around 940, and his dynasty held it on and off until the sixteenth century. The sharifs were Twelver Shi'ites and, because the two holy cities depended on Egyptian grain, usually recognised the suzerainty of Egypt's rulers, from the Fatimids to the Ayyubids and Mamluks. They repeatedly clashed with the larger Sharifate of Mecca, briefly occupying Mecca itself in 1271 and 1288. From the 1280s Cairo tightened its grip, and by the fourteenth century the Mamluk sultans appointed and deposed the emirs at will; Wudayy ibn Jammaz, a son of the long-reigning Jammaz ibn Shihah, ruled in 1336–1343. In the fifteenth century Medina was subordinated to the Sharif of Mecca as vice-sultan of the Hejaz, and an annual Mamluk garrison was stationed in the city.
zh: 麦地那酋长国是以汉志圣城麦地那为中心的埃米尔国，由穆罕纳家族统治；该家族属侯赛因系阿里德圣裔，自称通过阿里及其子侯赛因传承自穆罕默德。阿拔斯王朝瓦解之际，欧拜杜拉·伊本·塔希尔于940年前后夺取麦地那，其家族断断续续统治到16世纪。历任沙里夫信奉十二伊玛目派什叶派，而由于两座圣城依赖埃及运来的粮食，他们通常承认埃及统治者的宗主权，从法蒂玛王朝、阿尤布王朝到马穆鲁克王朝无不如此。他们与更强大的麦加酋长国屡次冲突，曾在1271年和1288年短暂占领麦加。13世纪80年代起，开罗方面加强控制，到14世纪马穆鲁克苏丹已可随意任免埃米尔；长期在位的贾马兹·伊本·希哈之子伍代·伊本·贾马兹于1336至1343年当政。15世纪，麦地那被置于麦加沙里夫（汉志副苏丹）之下，城内每年驻扎一支马穆鲁克守军。

en: The Sultanate of Mogadishu was a wealthy Muslim city-state on the Banaadir coast of southern Somalia, ruled from the thirteenth century by the Fakhr al-Din dynasty and already held within the Ajuran sphere as a client state in 1337. When Ibn Battuta visited in 1331 he found an exceedingly large city at the height of its prosperity, governed by the Somali sultan Abu Bakr ibn Shaikh Umar, who spoke both Somali and Arabic and kept a full court of wazirs, commanders and eunuchs. Mogadishu dominated the regional gold trade, minted its own coinage and wove the fine toob benadir cloth exported to Egypt and Syria, while its merchants sailed to Arabia, India and China; it sent envoys to the Ming court and in the early fifteenth century Zheng He's treasure fleets called at the city. Multi-storeyed stone houses and mosques with cylindrical minarets impressed Vasco da Gama when he passed the coast, and in 1542 a Portuguese bombardment forced the sultan to sign a peace treaty. Around 1600 the Muzaffar dynasty took over as Ajuran clients, and late in the seventeenth century the Abgaal overthrew them and folded Mogadishu into the new Hiraab Imamate.
zh: 摩加迪沙苏丹国是索马里南部巴纳迪尔海岸上富庶的穆斯林城邦，13世纪起由法赫尔丁王朝统治，到1337年时已作为附庸被纳入阿朱兰的势力范围。伊本·白图泰1331年到访时，见到的是一座正值鼎盛、极为宏大的城市，统治者是索马里苏丹阿布·贝克尔·伊本·谢赫·欧麦尔，他兼通索马里语和阿拉伯语，朝中有维齐尔、将领和宦官组成的完整班底。摩加迪沙主宰着地区黄金贸易，自铸钱币，织造远销埃及和叙利亚的精美“图布·巴纳迪尔”布匹，商人的帆樯远及阿拉伯、印度和中国；它曾向明朝遣使，15世纪初郑和的宝船队也到访过这座城市。瓦斯科·达伽马路过时，对这里多层石屋和带圆柱形宣礼塔的清真寺印象深刻；1542年葡萄牙人的炮击迫使苏丹签订和约。1600年前后，穆扎法尔王朝作为阿朱兰的代理人接管政权，17世纪末阿卜加尔人将其推翻，把摩加迪沙并入新建的希拉卜伊玛目国。

en: The Viscounty of Marsan was a small Gascon lordship on the Douze and Midou rivers, whose historic capital was Mont-de-Marsan. It appeared in the late tenth century, when the Duchy of Gascony was breaking into a patchwork of viscounties, and its first viscounts kept their seat at the castle of Roquefort. In the twelfth century Viscount Peter of Marsan, who died in 1163 and had married the countess of Bigorre, built the old castle that grew into Mont-de-Marsan, which then became the viscounty's political centre. Through a chain of heiresses Marsan passed to the houses of Comminges, Matha and Moncade, and when Margaret of Moncade married Roger-Bernard III of Foix in 1252 it was joined to Béarn in the Foix-Béarn inheritance. In 1337 its viscount was therefore Gaston II of Foix-Béarn, and Marsan afterwards followed the fortunes of the counts of Foix, the kings of Navarre and finally the House of Bourbon.
zh: 马桑子爵领是杜兹河与米杜河流域的加斯科涅小领地，历史首府为蒙德马桑。它出现于10世纪末加斯科涅公国裂分为众多子爵领之时，早期子爵以罗克福城堡为治所。12世纪的子爵皮埃尔·德·马桑于1163年去世，他娶了比戈尔女伯爵，并修建了后来发展为蒙德马桑的旧堡，蒙德马桑由此成为子爵领的政治中心。经过一连串女继承人的婚姻，马桑先后转入科曼日、马塔和蒙卡德家族；1252年蒙卡德的玛格丽特嫁给富瓦伯爵罗歇-贝尔纳三世，马桑便随贝阿恩一起并入富瓦-贝阿恩的遗产。因此1337年的子爵是富瓦-贝阿恩的加斯东二世，此后马桑的命运便随富瓦伯爵、纳瓦拉国王，最终随波旁家族一同起落。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Minden was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire on the middle Weser in Westphalia. Charlemagne founded the diocese in 803 after the conquest of the Saxons, and it became a prince-bishopric in 1180 when the Duchy of Saxony was broken up. In 1337 the see was held by Louis of Brunswick-Lüneburg, a Welf who ruled the small territory from the cathedral city of Minden. The Reformation took hold in the sixteenth century under the influence of the neighbouring Welf duchies, and during the Thirty Years' War Swedish troops occupied the land and ended episcopal rule. The Peace of Westphalia in 1648 secularized Minden and granted it to Brandenburg as the Principality of Minden. From 1719 Prussia administered it together with Ravensberg as Minden-Ravensberg; in 1807 it passed to the Kingdom of Westphalia, and after 1814 it returned to Prussia within the Province of Westphalia.
zh: 明登采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国位于威斯特伐利亚、威悉河中游的教会邦国。查理曼在征服萨克森人后于803年设立主教区，1180年萨克森公国被拆解时，它升为采邑主教区。1337年主持教区的是韦尔夫家族的不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的路易，他以主教座堂城市明登为中心统治这片小领地。16世纪，在邻近韦尔夫诸公国的影响下，宗教改革在这里扎根；三十年战争期间，瑞典军队占领此地，终结了主教统治。1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》将明登世俗化，作为明登侯国封给勃兰登堡。1719年起，普鲁士把它与拉芬斯堡合并为明登-拉芬斯堡管理；1807年它并入威斯特伐利亚王国，1814年后重归普鲁士，划入威斯特伐利亚省。

en: The County of Manderscheid was the Eifel lordship of the House of Manderscheid, whose estates around Schleiden were held in 1337 by Count William IV. The family became the most powerful noble house in the Eifel during the fifteenth century, when Dietrich III inherited Schleiden and Blankenheim and was raised to the rank of imperial count by the emperor in 1457. On Dietrich's death in 1498 his sons divided the inheritance, settled as early as 1488, into the lines of Manderscheid-Blankenheim-Gerolstein, Manderscheid-Kail and Manderscheid-Schleiden, each seated at its own castle. Schleiden itself had grown up as the centre of a lordship within the Duchy of Luxembourg and passed with the duchy to Burgundy in the 1440s and later to the Habsburgs. The Eifel counties suffered plague, feuds and witch-hunts, with roughly 260 people executed for witchcraft there between 1528 and 1641. The Kail line died out in 1762, and when the Blankenheim line's male heirs failed in 1780 its last countess carried the lands to the Bohemian counts of Sternberg, who styled themselves Sternberg-Manderscheid. French revolutionary troops occupied the Eifel in 1794 and abolished the county and its feudal dues.
zh: 曼德沙伊德伯国是曼德沙伊德家族在艾费尔山区的领地，1337年由威廉四世伯爵统治，产业以施莱登为中心。15世纪该家族成为艾费尔最有权势的贵族世家：迪特里希三世继承了施莱登和布兰肯海姆，并于1457年被皇帝擢升为帝国伯爵。迪特里希于1498年去世后，儿子们依据早在1488年定下的安排瓜分遗产，形成曼德沙伊德—布兰肯海姆—盖罗尔施泰因、曼德沙伊德—凯尔和曼德沙伊德—施莱登三支，各据自家城堡。施莱登本身原为卢森堡公国境内一块领地的中心，15世纪40年代随公国转入勃艮第之手，后来又归属哈布斯堡家族。艾费尔诸伯国饱受瘟疫、家族仇杀和猎巫之苦，1528至1641年间约有260人以巫术罪名被处死。凯尔一支于1762年绝嗣；布兰肯海姆一支的男系于1780年断绝，末代女伯爵把领地带给波希米亚的施特恩贝格伯爵家族，后者改称施特恩贝格—曼德沙伊德。1794年法国革命军占领艾费尔，废除了伯国及其封建赋税。

en: Madya-as was the traditional kedatuan, or datu-led confederacy, of Panay in the Visayas, remembered above all in the Maragtas traditions recorded by Pedro Monteclaro from older Hiligaynon and Kinaray-a oral accounts. The legends tell of ten datus from Borneo, led by Datu Puti, who fled the oppressive Rajah Makatunaw and landed on Panay; they bought the coastal plains from Marikudo, chief of the native Ati, in a bargain sealed with a golden salakot and other gifts. The eldest, Datu Sumakwel, convened a council of datus at Malandog, issued the Maragtas Code and divided the island into three districts, while other datus settled at Aklan and Irong-Irong, the future Iloilo. The dating of these events to around 1212 is doubted by historians, and the confederacy's existence rests on oral tradition rather than contemporary documents. Its settlements endured into the Spanish period and grew into the centers of the later provinces of Iloilo, Capiz and Antique.
zh: 马迪亚斯是米沙鄢班乃岛传说中的达图联盟（当地称克达图安），主要见于佩德罗·蒙特克拉罗根据更古老的希利盖农与基纳拉亚口传整理的《马拉格塔斯》。传说称，达图·普蒂率领十名来自婆罗洲的达图为逃避拉惹·马卡图瑙的暴政渡海北上，在班乃登陆，用一顶金盔和其他礼物向原住民阿提人的首领马里库多换得沿海平原。最年长的达图·苏马克韦尔在马兰多格召集达图会议，颁布《马拉格塔斯法典》，并把全岛划为三个辖区；另一些达图则在阿克兰和后来成为伊洛伊洛的伊龙伊龙定居。传说把这些事件系于1212年前后，但历史学家对此存疑，联盟的存在也只有口传而无同时代文献佐证。这些定居点延续到西班牙殖民时期，后来发展为伊洛伊洛、卡皮斯和安蒂克三省的中心。

en: Mecca was the seat of the Sharifate, the emirate held by the Hasanid descendants of the Prophet's clan, who governed the holy city and guarded the annual pilgrimage. Its fourteenth-century rulers belonged to the line of Qatada ibn Idris, the sharif who had seized the emirate around the turn of the thirteenth century, and by the reign of Abu Numayy I, from 1250 to 1301, the sharifs ruled in the shadow of the Mamluk sultans of Cairo, whose names entered the Friday sermon and whose armies installed and deposed emirs with the yearly hajj caravan. In 1337 the emir was Rumaythah ibn Abi Numayy, called Asad al-Din, who had held the office on and off since 1301 and openly favored Zaydi Shi'ism; the Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad confirmed him as sole emir that same year. He died in 1346 and was succeeded by his son Ajlan, whose descendants kept the Sharifate until, in 1517, the last Mamluk sultan fell and the sharif acknowledged the Ottoman caliph while retaining wide local autonomy.
zh: 麦加是麦加谢里夫政权的所在地，这一埃米尔之位由先知宗族的哈桑后裔世袭，负责治理圣城、护卫每年的朝觐。14世纪的当政者出自卡塔达·伊本·伊德里斯一系，他在13世纪初夺取埃米尔之位；到阿布·努麦伊一世在位时（1250—1301年），谢里夫们已在开罗马穆鲁克苏丹的阴影下统治，周五聚礼要念诵苏丹之名，马穆鲁克军队也随年度朝觐商队而来，数次废立埃米尔。1337年在位的是鲁迈塞·伊本·阿布·努麦伊，称号阿萨德丁，他自1301年起几度执掌该职，并公开支持栽德派什叶派；就在1337年，马穆鲁克苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德确认他为唯一埃米尔。他于1346年去世，其子阿吉兰继位，后裔世代保有谢里夫之位；1517年末代马穆鲁克苏丹覆灭后，麦加谢里夫承认奥斯曼哈里发的宗主权，同时保留了很大的地方自治权。

en: Medri Bahri, also called Mereb Melash, was the Christian highland country north of the Mereb River, covering the Hamasien and Seraye plateaus above the Red Sea coast, with its seat at Debarwa. These highlands had been heartland of the old Aksumite kingdom and its port of Adulis; after Aksum's decline they were settled by Beja and Agaw migrants before Tigrinya-speaking communities became dominant, and from the twelfth century local governors ruled the coastal approaches. Under Emperor Zara Yaqob in the mid-fifteenth century the governor, titled Bahr Negash, was set over Hamasien, Seraye, Shiré and Bur, drawing wealth from the gold, ivory and slave trade that ran down to the ports of Massawa and Hirgigo. The sixteenth century turned the office into a frontier command: in 1541 the Bahr Negash Yeshaq guided the Portuguese musketeers who helped break the Adalite invasion, but Ottoman forces seized Massawa in 1557 and briefly occupied Debarwa, and Yeshaq himself, after rebelling against Emperor Minas with Turkish backing, was killed at the Battle of Addi Qarro in 1578. By the seventeenth century hereditary families such as the Hab Sellus ruled the province, which fragmented among rival highland houses during the Zemene Mesafint.
zh: 梅德里巴赫里又称梅雷布·梅拉什，是马雷布河以北的基督教高原之国，涵盖红海沿岸上方的哈马森和塞拉埃台地，治所在德巴尔瓦。这片高原曾是古老阿克苏姆王国及其港口阿杜利斯的腹地；阿克苏姆衰落后，贝扎人和阿高乌移民相继迁入，最终说提格利尼亚语的族群成为主体，12世纪起由地方长官统辖沿海通道。15世纪中期，扎拉·雅各布皇帝将头衔为巴赫里·纳加什的长官设为哈马森、塞拉埃、希雷和布尔的主宰，靠流向马萨瓦、希尔吉戈两港的黄金、象牙和奴隶贸易积聚财富。16世纪，这个职位变成了边防统帅：1541年，巴赫里·纳加什叶沙克为协助击退阿达尔入侵的葡萄牙火枪手引路，但奥斯曼军队于1557年夺取马萨瓦并一度占领德巴尔瓦；叶沙克后来借土耳其支持反叛皇帝米纳斯，于1578年战死在阿迪卡罗战役。17世纪时，哈布·塞卢斯等世袭家族统治该省，到王子时代，它在高原诸家族的争斗中陷入分裂。

en: The Margraviate of Meissen grew from a fortress that Henry the Fowler built in 929 on a rock above the Elbe, during his campaigns against the Slavic Glomacze. After the break-up of Gero's vast march around 968, Meissen became the seat of its own margrave and of a new bishopric, charged with securing the Elbe frontier among the Sorbs and other Polabian Slavs, who were gradually Germanized over the following centuries. In 1089 Emperor Henry IV enfeoffed the Wettin count Henry of Eilenburg with the march, and Meissen became the dynasty's stronghold. Silver found near Freiberg around 1168 drew miners and wealth into the Ore Mountain foothills, funding the Wettin margraves from Conrad the Great and Otto the Rich onward. The victory at Lucka in 1307 over King Henry VII of Luxembourg left the margraviate effectively independent. In 1337 it was held by Margrave Frederick II the Serious, whose house also ruled Thuringia. In 1423 Frederick IV received the heirless Duchy of Saxe-Wittenberg and with it the Saxon electoral dignity. The 1485 Treaty of Leipzig split the Wettin lands between the Ernestine and Albertine lines; after 1547 the Albertines, who kept Meissen, folded the old march into the Electorate of Saxony while retaining the margravial title.
zh: 迈森藩侯国源于929年捕鸟者亨利在易北河畔岩石上修建的要塞，当时他正在征讨斯拉夫格洛马切人。约968年格罗的庞大藩侯国解体后，迈森成为独立藩侯的驻地，同时设立了新的主教区，负责在索布人等易北河斯拉夫人中守卫易北河边境；此后几个世纪里，这些斯拉夫人逐渐被德意志化。1089年，皇帝亨利四世把藩侯国封给韦廷家族的艾伦堡伯爵亨利，迈森从此成为该家族的根基。1168年前后，弗赖贝格附近发现银矿，把矿工和财富吸引到厄尔士山麓，从康拉德大帝和“富翁”奥托起为韦廷藩侯们提供了财源。1307年，藩侯国在卢卡战役中击败卢森堡的亨利七世，取得事实上的独立。1337年在位的是藩侯腓特烈二世（严肃者），他的家族同时统治着图林根。1423年，腓特烈四世获得绝嗣的萨克森—维滕贝格公国，并随之取得萨克森选侯地位。1485年的《莱比锡条约》把韦廷领地分给恩斯特和阿尔布雷希特两支；1547年后，保有迈森的阿尔布雷希特支系把旧藩侯国并入萨克森选侯国，同时保留藩侯头衔。

en: Memmingen lies on the Iller in Upper Swabia, on the site of the Roman settlement of Cassiliacum; an Alemannic village followed in the fifth century and a Frankish royal palace in the seventh. The medieval town of Mammingin was refounded in 1158 by the Welf duke Welf VI and became an imperial city in 1286, growing rich on the salt road that linked the Danube lands with Lindau. It embraced the Reformation under the preacher Christoph Schappeler, and in 1525 the peasants gathering there issued the Twelve Articles, the first printed declaration of peasant rights in Europe, of which 25,000 copies circulated within two months. During the Thirty Years' War Wallenstein made the town his headquarters in 1630 just before his dismissal, Swedish troops garrisoned it from 1632, and an imperial siege forced its surrender in 1647. In the reorganization of 1802 Memmingen lost its imperial immediacy and was assigned to Bavaria.
zh: 梅明根位于上施瓦本的伊勒河畔，城址是罗马人的卡西利亚库姆定居点；5世纪这里出现阿勒曼尼人的村落，7世纪又建有法兰克人的王宫。中世纪的马明金城于1158年由韦尔夫公爵韦尔夫六世重建，1286年成为帝国城市，依靠连接多瑙河流域与林道的盐路贸易致富。宗教改革时期，城市在传教士克里斯托夫·沙佩勒影响下皈依新教；1525年聚集于此的农民发布《十二条款》，这是欧洲第一份印刷流传的农民权利宣言，两个月内印行两万五千份。三十年战争中，华伦斯坦于1630年被解职前夕正驻节该城；1632年起瑞典军队在此驻防，1647年帝国军队围城，城市被迫投降。1802年的格局重组中，梅明根失去帝国直辖地位，被划归巴伐利亚。

en: The Menteşeids were the earliest of the Oghuz Turk frontier beyliks that arose as the Seljuk sultanate of Rûm collapsed. Founded in the late thirteenth century by Menteşe Bey and ruled from Milas, the ancient Mylasa, its lands covered ancient Caria, the later Muğla region with its three Aegean peninsulas, including Muğla, Balat, Çine, Tavas and the port of Mağrı. As the first seafaring Anatolian beylik it was called a power of the Sea Turks: Mesut Bey briefly seized part of Rhodes in 1300, a joint Menteşeid and Genoese fleet attacked the Hospitallers there in 1311, and under Orhan Bey, the reigning ruler in 1337, its galleys extorted tribute from Negroponte and Venetian islands. The same fleets traded grain, horses and alum with Venetian Crete and freely mixed commerce with piracy, and the beylik's coastal forests supplied timber for a renowned shipbuilding tradition. Menteşe sat out the Christian leagues and Smyrna crusades that broke its Aydınid neighbours, profiting from the Aegean trade they lost. A great earthquake in 1389 weakened it; it submitted to Bayezid I in 1390, was restored by Timur after 1402 under İlyas Bey, accepted Ottoman overlordship in 1414 and was fully annexed in 1426. Its seamen remained famous, supplying roughly two fifths of the fleet that besieged Constantinople in 1453, and its stone mosques at Milas and Balat pioneered building techniques later adopted by Ottoman architecture.
zh: 门泰谢（门泰谢奥卢）是罗姆塞尔柱苏丹国崩溃之际涌现的乌古斯突厥边境贝伊国中最早的一个。它于13世纪末由门泰谢贝伊建立，以古城米拉萨、即米拉斯为都，疆域涵盖古卡里亚地区，也就是后来的穆拉地区及其三个爱琴海半岛，包括穆拉、巴拉特、奇内、塔瓦斯和港口马格勒。作为安纳托利亚第一个面向海洋的贝伊国，它被称为海上突厥人之雄：梅苏德贝伊曾于1300年短暂攻占罗得岛部分地区，1311年门泰谢与热那亚联合舰队进攻岛上的医院骑士团；1337年在位的奥尔汗贝伊时期，其桨帆船向内格罗蓬特和威尼斯各岛勒索贡赋。这支舰队既把粮食、马匹和明矾销往威尼斯治下的克里特，又肆无忌惮地兼营海盗勾当，沿海森林的木材则造就了它发达的造船传统。当基督徒联盟和士麦那十字军击垮邻邦艾登贝伊国时，门泰谢基本置身事外，反而接手了对方失去的爱琴海贸易。1389年的大地震使其元气大伤；它于1390年臣服巴耶济德一世，1402年后由帖木儿归还给伊利亚斯贝伊，1414年承认奥斯曼宗主权，1426年被彻底吞并。其水手声名不坠，1453年围攻君士坦丁堡的奥斯曼舰队中约有五分之二来自门泰谢；米拉斯和巴拉特的石造清真寺所采用的营造技艺，后来也被奥斯曼建筑吸收。

en: Metztitlan, place of the moon in Nahuatl and Nzi'batha in Otomi, was the capital of an independent Otomi kingdom in the rugged canyon country of present-day Hidalgo, ringed by mountains around its lake. Alongside Tlaxcala and Huexotzinco it was one of the few central Mexican states the Aztec Empire never managed to conquer: Mexica armies campaigned repeatedly in its valley, but the difficult terrain and the region's modest tribute led the emperors to decide that the effort was not worthwhile. Its people worshipped the moon goddess Zana and kept a calendar close to the Mexica one but with day names of their own. When Hernan Cortes marched against Tenochtitlan, Metztitlan joined the Spanish alliance, and Augustinian friars founded a monastery there in 1538, rebuilt on higher ground as the great church of the Santos Reyes in 1557. Indigenous uprisings shook the town twice in 1811, early in Mexico's independence wars.
zh: 梅茨蒂特兰在纳瓦特尔语中意为月亮之地，奥托米语称恩齐巴塔，是今伊达尔戈州崎岖峡谷地带一个独立奥托米王国的都城，群山环抱着城下的湖泊。它与特拉斯卡拉、韦霍钦戈一样，是阿兹特克帝国始终未能征服的少数墨西哥中部政权之一：墨西加军队多次攻入其山谷，但地形艰险、当地贡赋有限，帝国的统治者最终认为得不偿失。当地人崇拜月亮女神扎娜，使用与墨西加历相近、却自有一套日名的历法。埃尔南·科尔特斯进军特诺奇蒂特兰时，梅茨蒂特兰加入了西班牙同盟；1538年奥斯定会修士在此建立修道院，1557年又在高处重建为宏伟的三王教堂。1811年墨西哥独立战争初期，当地土著两度起义，震动了这座城镇。

en: The Kingdom of Mewar was the Guhila Rajput state of southern Rajputana, sheltered by the Aravalli hills and centred from the eighth century on the fortress of Chittor. Its early rulers, traced in tradition to Bappa Rawal, alternated between independence and vassalage to the Pratiharas, Paramaras and Chauhans before emerging as a sovereign power in the tenth century. The first royal line ended when Alauddin Khalji stormed Chittor in 1303 and the Guhila defenders died fighting while their women performed jauhar. In 1326 Hammir Singh, head of the Sisodia branch of the clan from the village of Sisoda, retook Chittor, defeated a Tughlaq army at Singoli and founded the Sisodia dynasty that ruled Mewar thereafter. The fifteenth and early sixteenth centuries were its golden age: Rana Kumbha, reigning from 1433, ringed the country with forts including Kumbhalgarh, and Rana Sanga carried Mewar's arms across northern India until Babur defeated him at Khanwa in 1527. Akbar captured Chittor in 1568, after which Udai Singh II moved the court to his new lake city of Udaipur; his son Maharana Pratap fought the Mughals at Haldighati in 1576 and later recovered much of the country by guerrilla war, though Amar Singh I eventually accepted Mughal overlordship under Jahangir. As Mughal power crumbled, the later ranas regained their freedom in the Rajput wars of 1708 to 1710, only to fall under Maratha tribute exactions. In 1818 Bhim Singh accepted British protection, and Mewar entered the British period as Udaipur State.
zh: 梅瓦尔王国是拉杰普塔纳南部的古希拉族拉杰普特政权，依托阿拉瓦利山地的屏障，自8世纪起以吉多尔堡为中心。传说其早期君主可追溯到巴帕·拉瓦尔，王国在独立与臣服于波罗提诃罗、帕拉马拉和乔汉诸王朝之间几度反复，10世纪成为主权政权。1303年阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉攻陷吉多尔，古希拉守军战死、女眷投火自焚，王室主支就此断绝。1326年，出身西索达村的家族分支首领哈米尔·辛格收复吉多尔，在辛戈利击败图格鲁克军队，开创了此后统治梅瓦尔的西索迪亚王朝。15世纪至16世纪初是梅瓦尔的黄金时代：1433年即位的拉纳·昆巴在全境修筑了包括昆巴加尔堡在内的堡垒群，拉纳·桑加则把兵锋推向北印度各地，直到1527年在坎瓦被巴布尔击败。1568年阿克巴攻占吉多尔，乌代·辛格二世把朝廷迁往新建的湖畔之城乌代布尔；其子摩诃拉那·普拉塔普于1576年在哈米尔加蒂迎战莫卧儿大军，此后又以游击战收复大片国土，但阿马尔·辛格一世最终还是在贾汉吉尔时期接受了莫卧儿宗主权。莫卧儿势力衰落后，历代拉纳在1708至1710年的拉杰普特战争中重获自由，却又陷入马拉塔人的贡赋盘剥。1818年，比姆·辛格接受英国保护，梅瓦尔以乌代布尔土邦之名进入英属时期。

en: Montferrat is a march of the Holy Roman Empire in the hills of southern Piedmont, ruled from Casale. It was created about 967 when Emperor Otto I enfeoffed Aleramo with the western Ligurian march, and the Aleramici held it for more than three centuries. Marquess William V married a half-sister of the German king in 1133, and Boniface I led the Fourth Crusade in 1202 and founded the Kingdom of Thessalonica, though that Greek realm soon slipped from his family's grasp. Later marquesses fought long wars against the communes of Asti and Alessandria and led a renewed Lombard League against Angevin expansion. When the last Aleramici margrave died in 1305, the march passed to Theodore I Palaiologos, a son of the Byzantine emperor, whose line ruled in 1337 and for two centuries more. The Palaiologan margraves saw their lands shrink under pressure from Milan and Savoy, and when their line ended in 1533 Charles V briefly occupied the country before granting it to Federico II Gonzaga of Mantua in 1536. In 1574 it was raised to the Duchy of Montferrat, and after the Gonzaga died out in 1708 it fell to the House of Savoy.
zh: 蒙费拉托是神圣罗马帝国在皮埃蒙特南部丘陵间的侯国，以卡萨莱蒙费拉托为统治中心。约967年皇帝奥托一世把西利古里亚边区封给亚勒拉莫，亚勒拉米契家族此后统治该地三个多世纪。侯爵古列尔莫五世于1133年娶德意志国王的同母异父姐妹为妻；波尼法乔一世在1202年率领第四次十字军，并建立塞萨洛尼基王国，但这个希腊领地很快脱离家族掌握。此后的侯爵们与阿斯蒂、亚历山德里亚等市镇长期交战，并领导重建的伦巴第同盟抵抗安茹家族扩张。1305年末代亚勒拉米契侯爵去世，侯国传给拜占庭皇帝之子提奥多罗一世·巴列奥略；1337年在位的正是这一支，它还将延续两百年。巴列奥略诸侯爵在米兰和萨伏依的挤压下疆土日蹙，1533年家族绝嗣后，查理五世一度占领此地，又在1536年把它封给曼托瓦的费德里科二世·贡扎加。1574年蒙费拉托升格为公国，1708年贡扎加家族绝嗣后归入萨伏依家族。

en: The County of Mansfeld, centred on the mining country around Eisleben in the Saxon Hassegau, took its name from Mansfeld Castle. In 1069 Emperor Henry IV enfeoffed the loyal House of Mansfeld with the county; its progenitor Hoyer the Great served as field marshal to Henry V and fell fighting the Saxon rebels at the Battle of Welfesholz in 1115. The counts held fiefs under both the archbishopric of Magdeburg and the bishopric of Halberstadt. When the first male line died out in 1229, the heiress married a lord of Querfurt, whose descendants kept the Mansfeld title. Eisleben itself, first documented in 997 and chartered as a town in 1180, grew rich on the copper and silver mines of the Harz foothills, whose miners gave the town its fourteenth-century Neustadt. In the fifteenth century the house split into the Vorderort, Mittelort and Hinterort branches, and in 1512 the county gained a seat in the Upper Saxon Circle as an immediate imperial estate. This was the homeland of the Reformation: Martin Luther was born at Eisleben in 1483 and died there in 1546, and the Mittelort and Hinterort counts backed him, signing the Augsburg Confession in 1530 and joining the Schmalkaldic League, though the Vorderort line stayed Catholic. Crippled by debt, the counts lost their imperial immediacy in 1579 and were mediatised between Saxony and Magdeburg; the last branch died out in 1780, and the Congress of Vienna assigned Eisleben to Prussia in 1815.
zh: 曼斯费尔德伯国以萨克森哈瑟高地区艾斯莱本周围的矿业地带为中心，得名于曼斯费尔德城堡。1069年，皇帝亨利四世把这片伯国封给效忠他的曼斯费尔德家族；其先祖“伟人”霍耶曾任亨利五世的元帅，1115年在韦尔费斯霍尔茨战役中与萨克森叛军作战时阵亡。伯爵们在马格德堡大主教区和哈尔伯施塔特主教区之下都领有封邑。1229年第一条男系绝嗣，女继承人嫁给奎尔富特家族的一位领主，其后代沿用了曼斯费尔德的伯爵头衔。艾斯莱本最早见于997年的记载，1180年获建城权，靠哈茨山麓的铜银矿藏致富，14世纪又为矿工营建了新城。15世纪，该家族分为前堡、中堡、后堡三支，1512年伯国作为直属帝国的领地在上萨克森行政圈获得席位。这里也是宗教改革的故土：马丁·路德1483年生于艾斯莱本并于1546年逝于此，中堡和后堡两支伯爵支持他，于1530年签署《奥格斯堡信纲》并加入施马尔卡尔登同盟，只有前堡一支仍奉天主教。由于债务缠身，伯爵们于1579年失去帝国直辖地位，被萨克森和马格德堡瓜分代管；最后一支于1780年绝嗣，1815年维也纳会议把艾斯莱本划归普鲁士。

en: The County of Feldkirch was a small lordship of the Holy Roman Empire in the Vorarlberg, where the river Ill leaves the Alps for the Alpine Rhine plain. The town below Schattenburg Castle was laid out by Count Hugo I of Montfort and is first called a city in a document of 1218; the castle itself was built around 1260 under Rudolf II of Montfort and became the seat of the Montfort-Feldkirch counts. In 1345 Emperor Louis the Bavarian besieged the Schattenburg without success. The last count, Rudolf, inherited a heavily indebted lordship and in 1375 sold the town and county to Duke Leopold III of Habsburg, whose bailiffs took up residence in 1379; the citizens used the change of overlord to wring out a great charter of liberties in 1376. During the Appenzell Wars Feldkirch joined the Swiss-style League above the Lake in 1405, and the Schattenburg endured an eighteen-week siege in 1405 and 1406 before it was stormed and burned, then rebuilt two years later; the league itself was defeated by a Habsburg army near Bregenz in 1408. Swedish troops occupied the town without a fight in 1647, the Jesuits opened a college there in 1649, and a battle was fought outside its walls during the coalition wars in 1799.
zh: 费尔德基希伯国是神圣罗马帝国在福拉尔贝格的一块小领地，地处伊尔河出山进入阿尔卑斯莱茵河平原的要冲。沙滕城堡脚下的城镇由蒙特福特伯爵胡戈一世规划，1218年的文书首次称其为城市；城堡本身约1260年在鲁道夫二世·冯·蒙特福特主持下建成，成为蒙特福特-费尔德基希伯爵的治所。1345年，皇帝巴伐利亚人路易围攻沙滕城堡不克。末代伯爵鲁道夫接手的是债务缠身的领地，遂于1375年把城市和伯国卖给哈布斯堡公爵利奥波德三世，后者的监护官于1379年入驻；市民则趁易主之机在1376年争取到一份大自由特许状。阿彭策尔战争期间，费尔德基希于1405年加入仿效瑞士邦联组建的湖上游同盟，沙滕城堡在1405至1406年坚守十八周后被攻陷焚毁，两年后重建；同盟本身则于1408年在布雷根茨附近被哈布斯堡军队击败。1647年瑞典军队兵不血刃占领该城，1649年耶稣会在此开办学院，1799年反法同盟战争期间城外又爆发了一场战役。

en: Wenduling is the name recorded in the Yuan annals Nanhai Zhi of 1304 for a polity on Mindanao that had become a vassal of Pon-i, as Brunei was then known. Most scholars identify it with the animist settlements of the Cotabato valley, the predecessors of Maguindanao, although some have located the name on Mindoro instead. Hindu-Buddhist Brunei held it until a Majapahit invasion weakened Brunei, whereupon Wenduling broke away. In the sixteenth century Sharif Kabungsuwan of Johor brought Islam up the Mindanao rivers, married into local chiefly families and founded the Sultanate of Maguindanao with its seat at Cotabato; the brothers Tabunaway and Mamalu parted between the new faith and the old mountain ways, sealing a lasting pact between the Maguindanaon and the Teduray. Under Sultan Muhammad Kudarat in the seventeenth century the sultanate fought the Spanish-Moro Wars, took Sarangani in 1625 and allied with Ternate, while Lanao seceded from its rule. It ceded Palawan to Spain in 1705 and kept the Spaniards confined to the coasts of Mindanao.
zh: 文都灵是1304年元代史籍《南海志》所记载的棉兰老政权，当时它已沦为渤泥（即文莱）的属邦。多数学者把它比定为哥打巴托谷地信奉泛灵信仰的定居点，即马京达瑙的前身，但也有研究认为该名称指的是民都洛。印度教与佛教色彩的文莱一度统治此地，直到满者伯夷的入侵削弱了文莱，文都灵才趁机独立。16世纪，来自柔佛的谢里夫·卡邦苏万沿棉兰老各河传播伊斯兰教，与当地首领家族联姻，并在哥打巴托建立马京达瑙苏丹国；塔布纳韦与马马卢兄弟分别皈依新教和退守山林坚守旧俗，由此缔结了马京达瑙人与特杜莱人之间持久的和平之约。17世纪苏丹穆罕默德·库达拉特在位时，苏丹国投身西班牙—摩洛战争，1625年夺取萨兰加尼并与特尔纳特结盟，而拉瑙则在这一时期脱离其统治。1705年它把巴拉望割让给西班牙，但始终使西班牙人被牵制在棉兰老沿海。

en: Mangyül Gungthang, also called Lower Ngari, was a Tibetan kingdom in the Kyirong valley on the Nepal border, guarding the trans-Himalayan trade routes from its walled capital at Dzongka. Its kings descended from the old Yarlung royal line: Sakyapa-backed forces from Gungthang defeated Purang and Yatse in 1252 and 1253, and around 1265 Bumdegon founded the formal kingdom as one of the thirteen myriarchies of Yuan-era Tibet, receiving direct Mongol recognition and dominating western Tibet for a time. Gold finds and the mountain caravan trade made Dzongka prosperous. In the fifteenth century the princess Chökyi Drönma, daughter of King Tri Lhawang Gyaltsen, became the first Samding Dorje Phagmo, Tibet's highest female reincarnation. Gungthang repelled a Rinpungpa invasion in 1555, but after centuries under changing Central Tibetan overlords it was destroyed by the King of Tsang in 1620.
zh: 芒隅贡塘一称下阿里，是吉隆河谷、尼泊尔边境上的西藏王国，以城堡宗葛为都，扼守喜马拉雅南北的商路。其王统出自古老的雅砻王室后裔：13世纪50年代，贡塘的军队在萨迦派支持下击败布让与亚泽；约1265年，崩德衮正式建国，成为元代西藏十三万户之一，获得蒙古的直接承认，一度称雄阿里。西部黄金的发现与山地商队贸易使宗葛富庶。15世纪，国王赤拉旺坚赞之女、贡塘公主曲吉卓美成为西藏地位最高的女转世活佛，即第一代桑顶·多吉帕姆。1555年贡塘击退仁蚌巴的入侵，但在历经西藏中部各势力的宗主权更迭后，最终于1620年被藏巴汗攻灭。

en: Möng Ku denotes the cluster of small Tai Nüa chiefdoms in the hills between the Weiyuan and Zhenkang valleys, whose settlements included Kainan, Zheledian and Mengtong, the Tai name of Wandian. The Yuan brought Kainan under the Weichu route in 1262 and made it a prefecture in 1275, then reorganised it into Jingdong Prefecture in 1331. Under the Ming the country was parcelled into native offices: the Zheledian Chief's Office was created in 1403 under the Tai officer Dao Tan, and Wandian, called Mengtong in Tai, became a native prefecture in 1407. The Qing wound most of them down during the gaitu guiliu reforms, turning Zheledian into Enle County in 1727, while the Wandian chieftains kept their hereditary title until the twentieth century.
zh: 勐沽指威远与镇康之间山地里的一组傣那人小酋邦，聚落包括开南、者乐甸以及湾甸的傣语名勐统。1262年元朝将开南并入威楚万户，1275年立为开南州，1331年又改设景东府。明代把这一带划为多个土司衙门：1403年设者乐甸长官司，授傣族土官刀谈；1407年将傣语称勐统的湾甸长官司升为湾甸御夷州。清代改土归流时多数土司被裁撤，者乐甸于1727年改置恩乐县，而湾甸勐统土司的世袭头衔一直延续到20世纪。

en: Möng Ngüm, the Tai chiefdom known in Chinese records as Menglian and in Shan as Möng Lem, held the hills of the Salween's eastern tributaries where Menglian, Lancang and Ximeng now stand. The Yuan created it a tusi in 1289 as the Mulian Circuit, its saophas ruling from the old valley seat that survives as the town of Nayun. In 1348 it was swallowed by the rising power of Möng Mao, and under the early Ming it passed first to the Luchuan commission and then, after 1402, to the Mengding prefecture. In 1406 the Ming set up the Menglian chieftaincy, whose lands took in the old Mulian Circuit and the Yinshaluo country, together with territory granted by the Cheli tusi as a marriage portion. The office was suspended in the mid-sixteenth century and restored in 1585 under the name Menglian; the chiefs submitted to the Qing in 1662 and were raised to pacification commissioners in 1709. Counted among the Nine Shan States, Möng Lem long paid tribute to both China and the Burmese kingdoms.
zh: 勐恩是汉文史料中的孟连、掸语称勐连的台语酋邦，据有萨尔温江以东支流的山区，辖境相当今孟连、澜沧、西盟一带。元朝于1289年设木连路，以当地召法为土司，治所在娜允古镇。1348年它被崛起的麓川吞并，明初先后隶属麓川平缅宣慰司，1402年后改归孟定府。1406年明朝设置孟琏长官司，辖地除元代木连路外，还包括银沙罗甸故地，并因与车里土司联姻而得到一片陪嫁土地。该长官司在嘉靖年间一度被废，1585年恢复，改称猛脸；1662年首领归附清朝，仍置长官司，1709年升格为孟连宣抚司。作为九掸邦之一，勐连长期同时向中国和缅甸诸王国纳贡。
