en: Möng Mit, better known by its Burmese name Momeik, was a northern Shan state in the hills east of Bhamo, comprising the Mongmit and Kodaung, or Mabein, tracts. Shan tradition derives it from an ancient kingdom of Gandhalarattha and dates the present state to around 1238. In 1413 it became a dependency of Hsenwi, granted as a reward for Hsenwi's help to the Ming in campaigns against Lan Na and Ava, but in 1450 the dowager Nang Han Lung rebelled, sent her own ruby tribute to China from 1465, and won Ming recognition of independence in 1484, at the price of ceding the ruby lands of Mogok to the Burmese crown. Möng Mit fought in the Shan coalitions that tried to prop up Prome against the Toungoo, being defeated by Bayinnaung in 1542 and by Tabinshwehti in 1544; a bell inscription records Bayinnaung's conquest of Möng Mit and Hsipaw on 25 January 1557. The crown tightened its grip in 1597, when the saopha was forced to exchange Mogok and Kyatpyin for Tagaung and the ruby tract was annexed outright.
zh: 孟弥以缅甸语名称莫梅克（中文史籍多作孟密）更为人知，是八莫以东山地的北掸邦国，领有孟密和戈当（即马宾）一带。据掸人传说，其源头可溯至古老的犍陀罗国，现存的邦国约建于1238年。1413年，它成为兴威的属地，这是兴威协助明朝征讨兰纳和阿瓦所得的封赏；但1450年主母囊汉隆 起兵反叛，自1465年起单独向中国进贡红宝石，终在1484年获得明朝承认独立，代价是把红宝石产地抹谷割让给缅甸王室。孟弥曾参加各掸邦援助卑谬、对抗东吁的联军，1542年败于勃印曩，1544年再败于德彬瑞蒂；一口大钟的铭文记载，勃印曩于1557年1月25日攻灭孟弥和昔卜。1597年缅甸王室进一步收紧控制，诏法被迫以抹谷和杰宾交换太公，红宝石产区就此被正式吞并。

en: Möng Hsa was a Tai Nüa polity of the Mengding basin in western Yunnan, centred on the lands that are now Gengma. Its Tai rulers had moved south from Mong Mao in the fourteenth century and settled among the Wa peoples of the surrounding hills. Under the Yuan the area was organised as the Mengding route, and in 1382 the Ming set up the Mengding Native Prefecture, first held by a chieftain of the Dao family. During the Luchuan campaigns of the 1440s the old ruling line fled, and the Ming granted Mengding to Han Ge, a Hsenwi officer who had served in the fighting, beginning the long rule of the Han family. In the late Ming period the chieftains also submitted to the Burmese kings, but the Qing later reconfirmed their hereditary office under Yongchang Prefecture.
zh: 勐沙是滇西蒙定坝的傣那人政权，核心区域在今耿马一带。其傣族统治者在14世纪从勐卯南迁而来，与周围山地的佤人杂处。元朝在此设孟定路，1382年明朝置孟定御夷府，最初由刀姓土司执掌。15世纪40年代三征麓川时旧土司逃散，明朝把孟定封给从征有功的木邦土目罕葛，罕氏由此开始世袭统治。明末孟定土司一度臣服于缅甸国王，清代又重新承认其世袭地位，划归永昌府管辖。

en: Melahuacan was the head town of a small pre-conquest province on the southern coast of what is now Jalisco, whose people had come from Sayula. It headed a cluster of villages including Tenzitlán, Xirosto, Pampochin, Amborí, La Silla, Cuxmalán and Carrion. Francisco Cortés de San Buenaventura conquered the province in 1525, and in 1533 the captain Juan Fernández de Híjar, sent by Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán, founded the Spanish town of Villa Purificación in the same valley, around which the old communities were later gathered.
zh: 梅拉瓦坎是今哈利斯科南部海岸一个征服前小省的首镇，居民来自萨尤拉。它统领滕齐特兰、希罗斯托、潘波钦、安博里、拉西亚、库克斯马兰和卡里翁等村庄。1525年，弗朗西斯科·科尔特斯·德·圣布埃纳文图拉征服该省；1533年，受努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼派遣的队长胡安·费尔南德斯·德·伊哈尔在同一谷地建立西班牙城镇普里菲卡西翁，旧有各村后来被归并到它周围。

en: Möng Hkeng was a small Tai Nüa Shan chiefdom in the Yongchang frontier hills of western Yunnan, around present-day Zhenkang on the border facing Burma's Kokang district. Such Chinese Shan chiefdoms gained room to themselves after the Mongols overthrew Dali in 1253, and were later enrolled as tusi, becoming the Yuan Zhenkang military administration and the Ming-Qing Zhenkang native prefecture.
zh: 勐亨是云南西部永昌边地山区的傣那掸人小邦，地当今镇康、与缅甸果敢相望的边境一带。1253年蒙古攻灭大理后，这类汉地掸邦小邦获得一定自主，后来又被纳入土司体系，先后成为元代镇康路和明清镇康土州。

en: Mahilaka was a Swahili Muslim trading town on the north-western coast of Madagascar, in Ampasindava Bay near the island of Nosy Be. It was founded by the Antalaotra, Swahili-speaking migrants from the East African coast who intermarried with local Malagasy from around the year 1000, and it flourished from about 1000 to 1500 as one of the island's first urban settlements. Excavations have uncovered a walled town of about sixty hectares with stone houses and mosques, and a central stone building of nearly four hectares that may have been a ruler's palace, together with traces of ironworking, glassmaking, mining and pottery in local styles. Its merchants linked northern Madagascar to the Indian Ocean trade of the Comoros and the Swahili coast. The town was abandoned in the 1400s, its role passing to Vohemar, and some scholars link the rise of the kingdom of Guingemaro to slaves who escaped from Mahilaka.
zh: 马希拉卡是马达加斯加西北海岸安帕辛达瓦湾、邻近贝岛的一座斯瓦希里穆斯林贸易城镇。安塔拉特拉人——约1000年前后从东非海岸迁来、与当地马达加斯加人通婚的斯瓦希里语移民——建立了它，约1000年至1500年间它作为岛上最早的城市聚落之一繁荣一时。考古发掘出一座约六十公顷的城墙城镇，内有石屋和清真寺，还有一座近四公顷的中心石构建筑，可能是统治者的宫殿；铁器加工、玻璃制造、采矿的痕迹和本地风格的陶器也有出土。当地商人把马达加斯加北部同科摩罗和斯瓦希里海岸的印度洋贸易连在一起。该城于1400年代被废弃，港口地位由武希马里纳接续，有学者认为根杰马罗王国的兴起与从马希拉卡逃出的奴隶有关。

en: Möng Hten was the native chiefdom of the Shunning hills in western Yunnan, centered on Shunning, the modern Fengqing, and holding the valleys of Baotong and Youdian. It entered the imperial record in 1327, when its ruler submitted to the Yuan and the Shunning native prefecture was created, with Baotong subprefecture and Qingdian county added the following year. The Ming reduced it to a subprefecture in 1382 and restored it as a prefecture in 1384, leaving the native chiefs in place until 1598, when the Wanli court replaced them with circulating officials. In 1770 the Qing turned the old seat into Shunning County.
zh: 勐甸是云南西部顺宁山区的土著酋邦，以顺宁（今凤庆）为中心，领有宝通、右甸等河谷。它最早见于史籍是在1327年：其首领归附元朝，元廷设置顺宁土府，次年又增置宝通州和庆甸县。1382年明朝把它降为顺宁州，1384年复升为府，土官世袭之制一直维持到1598年，万历朝廷在此改土归流、改派流官治理。1770年，清朝又在旧府治设置顺宁县。

en: Miahuatlan, whose Nahuatl name means place of corn tassels and which the Zapotecs called Pelopenitza, was a Zapotec city-state in the southern mountains beyond the Oaxaca valleys. It grew rich as a regional market centre, trading local cochineal dye, soaproot amole and cotton mantas for the salt, cotton and slaves brought from more distant lands, and it fought repeated wars with its neighbours Coatlan and Ozolotepec. In the early sixteenth century the Aztec Empire conquered it under Moctezuma II and made it a provincial capital with a Mexica governor, extracting tribute of jewels and gold dust. After the Spanish conquest of Oaxaca in 1521 Miahuatlan remained an indigenous tribute town, its people now paying honey, gold dust, mantas and turkeys to the new authorities.
zh: 米亚瓦特兰在纳瓦特尔语中意为玉米穗之地，萨波特克语称佩洛佩尼察，是瓦哈卡谷地以南山地的萨波特克人城邦。它是区域性的商贸中心，市场上除本地的胭脂虫染料、皂用阿莫勒和棉毯外，还有远方运来的盐、棉花和奴隶，并与邻邦科阿特兰、奥索洛特佩克屡次交战。16世纪初，阿兹特克帝国在蒙特苏马二世在位时将其征服，把它设为行省首府，派驻墨西加总督，征收珠宝和金砂贡赋。1521年瓦哈卡被西班牙征服后，米亚瓦特兰仍是原住民贡赋城镇，居民改以蜂蜜、金砂、棉毯和火鸡向新统治者纳贡。

en: Mahu was the country of the Mahu tribe, a Yi people of the lower Jinsha River in southern Sichuan. The Tang held the area as a cluster of loose-reign prefectures under the collective name Mahu, and the Yuan organized it as the Mahu Route under the Xunan pacification office. In the winter of 1371 the Yuan route commander An Ji sent his son An Ren to tender submission to the Ming, who created Mahu Prefecture and confirmed the An clan as hereditary native prefects, ruling Pingshan County and four tribal chief's offices, among them Muchuan. The An family grew notorious for extortion and lawless violence: An Ao charged his subjects silver by the head, taking some ten thousand taels a year, ravished commoners' wives, kept sorcerer monks who killed by black magic, and plotted the murder of the Pingyi chief Wang Taiqing. In 1495 the native prefect An Ao was arrested and put to death for his crimes; the next year the court carried out gaitu guiliu and replaced him with an appointed official, making Mahu one of the earliest reforms of its kind in Sichuan. The prefecture itself was abolished in 1727 under the Qing, its lands divided among the districts of present-day southern Sichuan.
zh: 马湖是彝族马湖部的居地，位于四川南部的金沙江下游一带。唐代在这里设四个羁縻州，总称马湖部；元朝置马湖路，隶属叙南宣抚司。1371年冬，马湖路总管安济派儿子安仁向明朝归附，明廷设马湖府，以安氏世袭土知府，下辖屏山县和泥溪、平夷、蛮夷、沐川四个长官司。安氏在任上横征暴敛、暴虐不法：土知府安鳌按人口摊派银两，每年收入白银万两，又奸淫土民妇女、豢养妖僧以邪术害人，甚至图谋杀害平夷长官司长官王太庆。1495年安鳌被巡按御史逮治处死，次年朝廷即改土归流，以流官知府取代安氏，是四川最早推行改流的地区之一。1727年清朝裁撤马湖府，其地分入今四川南部的屏山、马边、沐川、雷波等州县。

en: The Michen are the Jurchen group of the lower Nen river plain, centered on the settlement of Yilaha in present-day Nenjiang. Under the Yuan the scattered Shuidada and Jurchen population of these plains was governed through the Shuidada circuit of Liaoyang province, and in 1346 they joined the Wozhe rising against the dynasty's gyrfalcon tribute demands.
zh: 密陈是嫩江下游平原的女真群体，以今嫩江市境内的伊拉哈聚落为中心。元朝时，这一带散居的水达达和女真人归辽阳行省水达达路管辖；1346年，他们参加了兀者野人因不堪海东青索贡而发动的反元起事。

en: The County of Maine, whose historic capital was Le Mans, took its name from the Aulerci Cenomani, the Gallic tribe of the region; in Carolingian times the ducatus Cenomannicus was a march stretching towards the Seine. Sandwiched between Anjou and Normandy, the county was long fought over by both: William the Conqueror seized Le Mans in 1063, and Count Elias I held out until 1110, when his daughter Eremburga married Fulk V of Anjou. Through her, Maine passed to Geoffrey Plantagenet in 1126 and then to Henry II of England in 1151, sharing the fortunes of the Angevin Empire until Philip II of France conquered it in 1204. Louis IX granted it in 1246 to his brother Charles of Anjou, and the marriage of Margaret of Anjou to Charles of Valois in 1290 carried it into the Valois family; when Philip VI inherited the crown in 1328 it entered the royal domain, and in 1332 it was given in appanage to his son John, the future John II, who held it in 1337. The count of Maine became a peer of France in 1331. After the English victory at Verneuil in 1424 the county was occupied and John of Lancaster took the title of duke; the English kept Le Mans until 1448. In 1481 Charles IV of Anjou bequeathed Maine to Louis XI, and it returned permanently to the crown.
zh: 曼恩伯国的历史首府是勒芒，其名来自当地高卢部落奥勒尔克·塞诺曼尼人；加洛林时代的塞诺曼尼亚边区是一块一直延伸到塞纳河的侯爵领地。曼恩夹在安茹与诺曼底之间，长期被两方争夺：征服者威廉于1063年夺取勒芒，埃利亚斯一世苦撑到1110年，其女埃伦布尔加嫁给安茹的富尔克五世。伯国由此在1126年传给若弗鲁瓦·金雀花，1151年又归英格兰的亨利二世，随安茹帝国的命运沉浮，直到1204年被法兰西国王腓力二世征服。1246年，路易九世把它封给弟弟安茹的查理；1290年安茹的玛格丽特嫁给瓦卢瓦的查理，曼恩随之进入瓦卢瓦家族。1328年腓力六世继承王位后它并入王室领地，1332年又作为亲王封地赐给儿子约翰，即后来的约翰二世，1337年时正由他领有。1331年，曼恩伯爵成为法兰西贵族院成员。1424年英军在韦尔讷伊获胜后占领曼恩，兰开斯特的约翰受封公爵；英格兰人占据勒芒直到1448年。1481年，安茹的查理四世把曼恩遗赠给路易十一，伯国从此永久收归王室。

en: The Mihrabanids were the third indigenous Muslim dynasty of Sistan, the arid Helmand-delta country also called Nimruz and famed in the Shahnameh as the homeland of the hero Rostam. They ruled it from 1236 until the mid-sixteenth century. Taking power in the wake of the Mongol conquest, their maliks, based at Shahr-i Sistan near Zaranj, acknowledged the Ilkhans as overlords from 1256 while enjoying wide autonomy; they conquered Quhistan by 1289 and fought intermittent wars with the Kartids of Herat. The Ilkhanate's collapse left the dynasty independent for nearly half a century, and in 1337 the malik was Qutb al-Din Muhammad, who reigned from 1330 to 1346. That independence ended when Timur invaded Sistan in 1383 and devastated the province, after which the Mihrabanids served as Timurid vassals and passed to the Shaybanids in the early sixteenth century. The last malik, Sultan Mahmud, submitted to the Safavids in the 1530s and handed over Sistan, ending three centuries of dynastic rule, while the Sunni population resented the Shi'i practices introduced under Safavid suzerainty.
zh: 米赫拉班王朝是锡斯坦的第三个本土穆斯林王朝。锡斯坦又称尼姆鲁兹，地处赫尔曼德河三角洲的干旱之地，在《列王纪》中被传颂为英雄鲁斯塔姆的故乡。王朝自1236年起统治该地区，直至16世纪中叶。蒙古征服后，历代马利克以扎兰季附近的沙赫里锡斯坦为都，1256年起奉伊儿汗为宗主但享有很大自治权；他们于1289年征服库希斯坦，并与赫拉特的卡尔提德王朝时战时和。伊儿汗国瓦解后，王朝独立了近半个世纪，1337年在位的马利克是库特布丁·穆罕默德（1330至1346年在位）。1383年帖木儿入侵锡斯坦并大肆蹂躏，独立告终，此后米赫拉班王朝沦为帖木儿附庸，16世纪初又转归昔班尼王朝。末代马利克苏丹·马哈茂德于16世纪30年代臣服萨法维王朝、交出锡斯坦，延续三百年的王朝统治就此结束，当地逊尼派民众对宗主权下引入的什叶派礼仪颇为不满。

en: Mitic was a small señorío of the Tecuexe, a Chichimeca people of the Los Altos highlands in what is now Mexico, counted among the independent chiefdoms that the migrating Mexica once raided together with Acatic and Xalostotitlan. It shared the fate of its neighbours in the Spanish conquest of 1530 and the Mixtón War of 1541.
zh: 米蒂克是特库埃克人的一个小邦，该奇奇梅克族群生活在今墨西哥的阿尔托斯高原，曾是特库埃克独立酋邦之一，迁徙中的墨西加人曾把它与阿卡蒂克、沙洛斯托蒂特兰一并攻掠。1530年西班牙征服和1541年米斯特翁战争中，它与邻邦同遭覆灭。

en: Yucu Dzaa, called Tututepec in Nahuatl, both names meaning Hill of the Bird, was a Mixtec city in the lower Rio Verde valley on the Pacific coast of Oaxaca. Mixtec codices record that Eight Deer Jaguar Claw led migrants from the highlands to the coast and founded the city in 1083, then conquered dozens of neighbouring towns, taking tribute in cacao, feathers and jaguar pelts. A Toltec embassy under Four Jaguar allied with him in 1097 and helped him take Tilantongo the following year. By the Late Postclassic it had grown into the largest city in Oaxaca, its political influence covering more than 25,000 square kilometres, while subject rulers were watched by governors sent from the capital. Its northward expansion was later checked by the Aztecs: the Aztecs backed the border town of Coatlan while Yucu Dzaa sent aid to Yanhuitlan. After the fall of the Aztec Empire, Pedro de Alvarado marched on the coast and captured the city in March 1522, taking its ruler Coaxintecuhtli, who died in Spanish captivity.
zh: 玉库扎在纳瓦特尔语中称图图特佩克，两个名字都意为“鸟山”，是瓦哈卡太平洋沿岸里奥贝尔德河下游的纽萨维城邦。据纽萨维手抄本记载，鹿八日虎爪于1083年率高地移民来到沿海建城，随后征服数十座邻近城镇，收取可可、羽毛和美洲豹皮等贡物。1097年，虎四日率领的托尔特克使团与他结盟，并于次年助他攻下蒂兰通戈。到后古典期，玉库扎已成为瓦哈卡最大的城市，势力范围超过2.5万平方公里，被征服的统治者由都城派去的官员监视。它向北的扩张后来被阿兹特克人遏制：阿兹特克支持边境城镇夸特兰，玉库扎则出兵援助扬惠特兰。阿兹特克帝国陷落后，佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多进军沿海，于1522年3月攻占该城，俘获其君主科阿辛特库特利，后者最终死于西班牙人的囚禁中。

en: Mayurbhanj was the largest of the Orissa hill states, a forested mountain country on the border of Orissa and Bengal whose people included the Santal, Munda, Ho and Kisan. Its rulers belonged to the Bhanja dynasty, heirs of the ancient Khijjinga mandala lineage, whose peacock emblem recalled a legend that their ancestors sprang from a peafowl's eyes. The present dynasty was traditionally founded in the twelfth century by Adi Bhanja, whose brother Jyoti Bhanja established the neighbouring Keonjhar line; the Bhanjas ruled as feudatories of the Eastern Ganga kings of Orissa. From the fifteenth century the capital stood at Baripada, where the royal palace was built in 1804. In the eighteenth century Mayurbhanj passed under Maratha supremacy and paid an annual tribute of six thousand rupees, and in 1829 it became a British protectorate, keeping its own Bhanja raja.
zh: 马尤布汉杰是奥里萨各山地土邦中最大的一个，地处奥里萨与孟加拉交界的山林地带，居民包括桑塔尔人、蒙达人、霍人和基桑人。统治这里的班贾王朝源出古代 基金伽曼荼罗的世系，其孔雀徽章源自祖先由孔雀眼中诞生的传说。一般认为该王朝由12世纪的阿迪·班贾开创，他的弟弟乔蒂·班贾另建了邻近的盖翁切尔支系；班贾诸王作为奥里萨东恒伽国王的附庸进行统治。15世纪起都城设在巴里帕达，王宫于1804年建于该城。18世纪马尤布汉杰转入马拉塔宗主权之下，每年纳贡六千卢比；1829年它成为英国的保护国，但仍保留自己的班贾罗阇。

en: Möng Kawng, better known by its Burmese name Mogaung, was one of the larger petty Shan principalities, lying apart from the main Shan states in what is now Kachin State. Tai chronicles credit its founding to the saopha Sam Long Hpa, who built his capital on the Nam Kawng, or Mogaung, river, and ruled a country said to stretch from Hkamti Long to Shwebo and into the lands of the Nagas and Mishmis, initially as a tributary of Möng Mao. It enters Chinese records in 1295 as Mengguang, where the Yuan dynasty set up a tribal command, and the Ming later listed it as a pacification superintendency under Yunnan. When Möng Mao was broken in the Luchuan–Pingmian campaigns of 1436 to 1449, its fugitive ruler Si Jifa found refuge at Möng Kawng. Ava captured the state in 1477, China occupied it from 1479 to 1483 and again briefly in 1495, and after the Toungoo era it passed increasingly under Burmese control. Burma held it from 1651 to 1742 and again from 1771 to 1775, before finally annexing Möng Kawng in 1796 and replacing its sawbwas with centrally appointed wuns.
zh: 孟拱以缅甸语名称莫冈更为人所知，是较大的掸人小邦之一，远离掸邦腹地，位于今克钦邦境内。据傣文编年史记载，其创立者是诏法三隆帕，他在南拱河（今莫冈河）畔建都，统治范围据说北起坎底、南至瑞波，还深入那加人和米什米人的土地，起初是孟卯的属邦。中国史籍中它于1295年以“蒙光”之名出现，元朝在当地设立土司，明代则将其列为云南辖下的宣慰司。1436至1449年麓川平缅之役后孟卯覆灭，其逃亡首领思机法曾到孟拱避难。阿瓦于1477年攻占该邦，明朝又在1479至1483年及1495年两度短暂占据；东吁时代之后，它日益受制于缅甸。缅甸先后在1651至1742年、1771至1775年占领孟拱，最终于1796年将其吞并，以中央任命的温取代了当地诏法。

en: Mekongga was a kingdom of the Tolaki-Mekongga branch of the Tolaki people on the southeast peninsula of Sulawesi, in the lands around the Mekongga Mountains that make up the present-day Kolaka area. Its domain was also called Wonua Sorume, the Land of Orchids, and the name Mekongga derives from the Tolaki word kongga, eagle: local tradition tells of the first ruler, Sangia Larumbalangi, who slew a giant eagle named Kongga Owose and became king in the 1200s. The royal seat stood first at Bende and was later moved to Wundulako, and the kings ruled with the title Bokeo. One of them, Bokeo Ladumaa, sent aid to the Kedatuan of Luwu in its war against Suppa and was rewarded by Luwu's ruler Datu Alimuddin with a red-and-white banner bearing the Islamic confession of faith, after which he was known as Sangia Nibandera, the king who holds the flag. The small neighboring polity of Watumendonga was later absorbed into the kingdom.
zh: 梅孔加是苏拉威西东南半岛、梅孔加山脉一带（今科拉卡地区）托拉基人支系托拉基—梅孔加人的王国。其国土又称“兰花之地”沃努阿·索鲁梅；“梅孔加”之名来自托拉基语 kongga（鹰）：当地传说初代统治者桑吉亚·拉伦巴兰吉杀死巨鹰孔加·奥沃塞后于1200年代（13世纪）称王。王都最初在本德，后迁至温杜拉科，君主使用“博凯奥”称号。其中一位君主博凯奥·拉杜马曾出兵协助卢武王国对抗苏帕，卢武统治者达图·阿里穆丁赐他一面写有清真言的红白旗帜，他因此得名“持旗之王”桑吉亚·尼班德拉。邻近的小邦瓦图门东加后来也并入了梅孔加。

en: Mecklenburg grew out of the lands of the Obotrites, the Wendish confederation settled between the Elbe and the Baltic. Its ruling house traced its descent to the Obotrite prince Niklot, whose son Pribislav submitted to Henry the Lion of Saxony in the twelfth century and was enfeoffed with Mecklenburg as a Christian prince. German and Flemish settlers then flowed in under the Ostsiedlung, founding or expanding the trading towns of Wismar, Rostock and Neubrandenburg, which later joined the Hanseatic League. In 1337 the lordship was held by Albert II of the House of Mecklenburg, who had succeeded his father Henry II in 1329 and ruled from Wismar. His marriage to Euphemia, heiress of the Swedish royal house, drew him into Scandinavian politics, and his younger son Albert became King of Sweden in 1364. Emperor Charles IV raised Mecklenburg to a duchy in 1348, and Albert bought the County of Schwerin in 1368. Henry IV reunited all the Mecklenburg lands in 1471; the duchy turned Protestant in 1549, was repeatedly partitioned into Mecklenburg-Schwerin and Mecklenburg-Strelitz, and both lines were raised to grand duchies in 1815.
zh: 梅克伦堡源自奥博特里特人的土地，这是一支活动于易北河与波罗的海之间的文德人部落联盟。统治家族自称出自奥博特里特王公尼克洛特，其子普里比斯拉夫在12世纪向萨克森的狮子亨利称臣，作为基督教王公受封梅克伦堡。随后在东向殖民运动中，德意志和佛兰德斯移民大量涌入，建立或扩建了维斯马、罗斯托克、新勃兰登堡等商业城镇，它们后来都加入了汉萨同盟。1337年，梅克伦堡家族的阿尔布雷希特二世领有此地，他于1329年继承父亲亨利二世，驻跸维斯马。他与瑞典王室继承人欧菲米亚的婚姻把他卷入斯堪的纳维亚政局，次子阿尔布雷希特于1364年成为瑞典国王。1348年皇帝查理四世将梅克伦堡升格为公国，阿尔布雷希特又在1368年买下什未林伯国。1471年亨利四世重新统一全部梅克伦堡领地；公国于1549年改宗新教，后来多次被分割为梅克伦堡-什未林和梅克伦堡-施特雷利茨，两支均于1815年升格为大公国。

en: Möng Köng, rendered Maingkaing in Burmese and meaning “lac town” in Shan, was a small Tai chiefdom on the upper Chindwin, around the village of Maingkaing in Homalin Township. It belonged to the scattered group of outlying Shan principalities north of the main Shan states, alongside Hsawnghsup and Hkamti Long.
zh: 孟昆的缅语转写为 孟更，掸语意为“紫胶城”，是钦敦江上游霍马林镇区孟更村一带的小型傣语酋邦，与双肃、坎底等同属掸邦腹地以北那群分散的偏远掸人小邦。

en:
Makran is the arid coastal strip of southern Baluchistan on the Gulf of Oman, running from Sonmiani Bay past the ports of Tiz, Pasni and Gwadar toward Bāšgerd. In antiquity it was the Achaemenid satrapy of Maka, perhaps the Sumerian land of Magan; Seleucus ceded it to Chandragupta Maurya in 304 BCE, and Shapur I listed Makuran among the provinces of the Sasanian Empire in 262 CE. Buddhist and Hindu Rajas of the Sewa and Chach lines still held parts of it when the Arabs conquered the coast in 643 and 644, after the Battle of Makran made it the easternmost frontier of the caliphate. The Ma'danid dynasty ruled there from the tenth to the eleventh century, followed by local Baloch tribal chiefs, and a Buyid army took the port of Tiz in 971.

By the fourteenth century the coast was held by Baloch rulers of the Hot, or Kalmati, line. The most famous of them, Sultan Hammal Jiand, destroyed a Portuguese raiding fleet in 1549 and defended Pasni and Gwadar until a Portuguese campaign of 1581 captured him; he died in captivity and the coastal towns were sacked. In the seventeenth century the Gichki nawabs, descended from a Rajput migrant who had converted to Islam, took power and kept Makran as a loose tribal principality, while Gwadar eventually passed under Omani rule.
zh:
莫克兰是俾路支斯坦南部濒临阿曼湾的干旱海岸地带，从松米亚尼湾经提兹、伯斯尼、瓜达尔等港口一直延伸到巴什格尔德一带。古代这里是阿契美尼德王朝的马卡行省，可能就是苏美尔文献中的马干；公元前304年塞琉古将它割让给旃陀罗笈多·孔雀，262年沙普尔一世的铭文又把莫库兰列为萨珊帝国的行省之一。7世纪阿拉伯人征服这里时，部分地区仍由信奉佛教和印度教的塞瓦、查查王朝王公统治；643至644年的莫克兰战役后，它成为哈里发帝国最东的边地。10至11世纪马丹尼德王朝在此立国，此后由当地俾路支部落首领割据，971年白益王朝的军队攻占了港口提兹。

到14世纪，海岸掌握在霍特（又称卡尔马提）一支的俾路支统治者手中。其中最著名的苏丹哈马尔·吉安德于1549年歼灭一支葡萄牙劫掠舰队，长期坚守伯斯尼和瓜达尔，直到1581年葡萄牙人的远征将他俘虏；他最终死于囚中，沿海城镇也遭洗劫。17世纪，改宗伊斯兰教的拉杰普特移民后裔吉奇基纳瓦布家族掌权，把莫克兰维持为一个松散的部落邦国，而瓜达尔后来落入阿曼之手。

en: The Merkewan were a Kurdish tribal chiefdom centered on Oshnaviyeh, medieval Ushnu south of Lake Urmia. Long Hadhabani Kurdish pasture and held by the Iva'iya clan in the thirteenth century, the district was ruled by Merkewan chiefs as Jalayirid vassals in 1337 and later joined the Mukriyan principality.
zh: 梅尔克万人是以奥什纳维耶（中世纪称乌什努）为中心的库尔德部落酋长政权，地当乌尔米耶湖以南。这里长期是哈兹巴尼库尔德人的牧场，13世纪由伊瓦亚氏族据有；1337年梅尔克万首领作为札剌亦儿王朝的附庸统治该地，后来并入穆克里扬埃米尔国。

en: Kangleipak was the Meitei kingdom in the Imphal valley on the frontier between India and Burma, known to later neighbors as Manipur. Meitei tradition traces the Ningthouja dynasty to King Pakhangba in the first century, with Kangla as its royal seat, and tells how the rulers of Imphal absorbed the surrounding clan principalities of the Khuman, Luwang and Moirang. Under King Loiyumba in the early twelfth century the kingdom received its first written code, the Loiyumba Sinyen. In 1337 the throne belonged to Telheipa, whose reign the royal chronicle, the Cheitharol Kumbaba, fills with campaigns against the hill and valley clans. During the reign of King Kiyamba, from 1467 to 1507, Brahmins settled at the court and a sacred stone brought from the Shan kingdom of Pong was worshipped as Vishnu, opening the way for Meitei Vaishnavism. King Pamheiba, called Gharib Niwaz, ruled from 1709 to 1748, renamed the realm Manipur, and in 1729 had the old Sanamahi scriptures burned as he imposed Hinduism on his people. Burmese armies then held the kingdom from 1819 to 1826, the Seven Years Devastation, while from 1824 it was a protectorate of the British East India Company.
zh: 刚莱博是印度与缅甸之间英帕尔河谷中的梅泰人王国，后来的邻邦称之为曼尼普尔。梅泰传统把宁托贾王朝追溯到1世纪的帕康巴王，以康拉为王都，并讲述英帕尔的统治者如何兼并库曼、鲁旺、莫伊朗等周围氏族邦国。12世纪初，洛伊雍巴王颁布了王国第一部成文法典《洛伊雍巴辛延》。1337年在位的是特尔黑帕，王室编年史《切塔罗尔·昆巴巴》记载他在位期间连年对山地与河谷诸氏族用兵。1467至1507年基亚姆巴王在位时，婆罗门开始定居宫廷，一块从掸人蓬国带来的圣石被当作毗湿奴崇拜，梅泰人的毗湿奴信仰由此发端。帕姆海巴王（又称加里布·尼瓦兹，1709—1748年在位）将国名改为曼尼普尔，并于1729年下令焚毁萨那玛依教的古老圣典，强迫臣民改宗印度教。此后缅甸军队在1819至1826年占领王国，史称七年浩劫；自1824年起，它又是英国东印度公司的保护国。

en: Mile takes its name from the Mile tribe, a branch of the Xiemotu Yi whose chief called Mile settled the basins of Guodian, Badian and Bulong after Nanzhao conquered the western Cuan lands in the eighth century. Under early Mongol rule the tribe was first placed under the Luomeng Ten-Thousand-Household and then merged with the Shizong tribe into a thousand-household, until in 1290 it was organised as Mile Department under Guangxi Route. The Ming kept Mile Department under Guangxi Prefecture from 1382. In 1389 rebels led by Zhemanyiqing killed the native prefect Pu De before government troops captured and executed them, and under the Zhengde reign the Shibazhai chiefs A Si and A Wu rose in turn until the grand coordinator He Mengchun pacified them. A walled department seat was built at Badian in 1490 and brick-faced in 1572. In 1631 Pu Mingsheng's rebels from Ami captured the department; the Shibazhai guard thousand-household was merged into it in 1668, and in 1770, when Guangxi Prefecture was reduced to an independent department, Mile was itself downgraded to a county.
zh: 弥勒得名于弥勒部：它是些莫徒蛮的一支，其首领弥勒率部占据郭甸、巴甸、部笼等地而居，部名由此而来。8世纪南诏征服西爨后，弥勒部归入南诏。元初该部先隶属落蒙万户府，又与师宗部合并为千户所，1290年改置弥勒州，隶广西路。明代自1382年起沿置弥勒州，隶广西府；1389年土贼者满矣情作乱，杀死土官知府普得，旋即被官军捕诛；正德年间十八寨夷酋阿寺、阿勿又反，被云南巡抚何孟春讨平。1490年州同梁伋在八甸修筑土城，1572年包砌砖石。1631年阿迷普名声的叛军攻陷弥勒州；1668年十八寨守御千户所被裁并入州。1770年广西府降为广西直隶州，弥勒州也随之降为弥勒县。

en: Malong is a highland basin between Kunming and Qujing, on the old road leading into central Yunnan. The Han set up Tonglai County here in 109 BC, and under Nanzhao the area was known as Qu'e Chuan. In the later Dali period its people were organised as the Nagou, one of the thirty-seven tribes of eastern Yunnan under Shicheng Commandery. After the Mongol conquest the Nagou became a thousand-household formation under the Moma command, and in 1276 it was made Malong Subprefecture of Qujing Route, with Tongquan County attached. The county was merged back into the subprefecture in 1382, when the Ming reorganised the region under Qujing Prefecture. From 1432 to 1476 Malong was briefly transferred to Rende Prefecture, then returned to Qujing, under which it remained a subprefecture throughout the Qing.
zh: 马龙是昆明与曲靖之间的高原盆地，扼守进入滇中的古道。公元前109年汉朝在此设铜濑县，南诏时称曲轭川。大理国后期，当地部众称纳垢部，是石城郡下辖的滇东三十七部之一。蒙古征服后，纳垢被编为磨弥万户府治下的千户所，1276年改置马龙州，领通泉县，隶属曲靖路。1382年明朝整顿滇东建制，通泉县并入马龙州，改属曲靖府。1432年至1476年间，马龙州曾短暂改隶仁德府，之后复归曲靖府，清代仍为其下辖的州。

en: Mühlhausen, on the Unstrut in the Thuringian Basin, was first mentioned in 967, when Emperor Otto II granted the estate to his wife Theophanu. Its imperial palace hosted German kings down to the eleventh century, and in 1198 the homage of the newly elected Philip of Swabia was held there. By the mid-thirteenth century Mühlhausen had become a free imperial city ruling over nineteen surrounding villages, and it joined the Hanseatic League in 1286; textiles and woad brought it a late-medieval heyday in which it ranked among the largest cities of Germany. In 1349 its Jewish community was destroyed in the Black Death persecutions. The Reformation turned violent here: after the preaching of Heinrich Pfeiffer and Thomas Müntzer, the council was overthrown during the Peasants' War of 1525, and once the rising was crushed Müntzer was beheaded outside the walls and the city fined forty thousand guilders. Mühlhausen clung to Catholicism until the Reformation was imposed by force in 1542. The Thirty Years' War began its long decline, and in 1803 mediatisation assigned the city to Prussia, with an interlude in the Kingdom of Westphalia from 1807 to 1815.
zh: 米尔豪森位于图林根盆地的翁施特鲁特河畔，最早见于967年的记载，当时皇帝奥托二世把这片领地赐给妻子狄奥凡诺。城里的皇宫在11世纪以前一直接待德意志国王，1198年新当选的施瓦本的菲利普便是在此接受效忠。13世纪中叶，米尔豪森成为帝国自由城市，管辖周围十九个村庄，并于1286年加入汉萨同盟；纺织品和菘蓝贸易带来了中世纪晚期的鼎盛，使它跻身德意志最大城市之列。1349年，当地犹太社区在黑死病排犹浪潮中被毁。宗教改革在这里走向暴力：海因里希·普法伊弗和托马斯·闵采尔相继布道后，市议会在1525年的农民战争中被推翻；起义被镇压后，闵采尔在城外被斩首，城市被罚四万盾。米尔豪森一度坚持天主教，直到1542年宗教改革被强制推行。三十年战争开启了它漫长的衰落，1803年采邑调解将它划归普鲁士，1807至1815年间又改属威斯特伐利亚王国。

en: Malindi was a Swahili port on the Kenyan coast, northeast of Mombasa, whose kingdom took shape around the ninth century. Its first town, founded about 850, was destroyed around 1000, and the present site recovered and prospered from the thirteenth century on; the geographer Abu al-Fida left the earliest written mention of it. Rivaling Mombasa for mastery of this stretch of coast, it grew rich exporting ivory, rhinoceros horn, coconuts and rice across the Indian Ocean, and in 1414 the fleet of the Chinese admiral Zheng He called there, carrying a Malindian envoy and a giraffe back to the Ming court. In 1498 Vasco da Gama received a warm welcome from its sultan, hired a pilot for the voyage to India and set up the stone padrão still called the Vasco da Gama Pillar. Malindi became Portugal's closest East African ally: a factory opened there in 1502, and its forces joined the assaults on Kilwa and Mombasa in 1505. As those rivals fell, Malindi flourished as the center of Portuguese activity until 1593, when the Portuguese and the sheikh's court moved to Mombasa. The old town then withered, and by the 1820s an Admiralty survey found only the pillar standing above the ruins.
zh: 马林迪是肯尼亚沿海的斯瓦希里港口，位于蒙巴萨东北，其王国约在9世纪成形。最早的城镇建于850年前后，约1000年被毁，现址从13世纪起恢复并繁荣起来；地理学家阿布·菲达留下了关于它的最早文字记载。它与蒙巴萨争夺这段海岸的主导权，靠向印度洋各地出口象牙、犀角、椰子和稻米致富。1414年，中国航海家郑和的船队到访此城，马林迪统治者的使者带着一只长颈鹿随船队前往明朝宫廷。1498年，瓦斯科·达伽马受到苏丹热情接待，在此雇请前往印度的领航员，并立下后人称为‘瓦斯科·达伽马石柱’的标柱。马林迪成为葡萄牙在东非最亲密的盟友：1502年葡萄牙在此设立商馆，1505年它还出兵参与攻打基卢瓦和蒙巴萨。随着两个对手陷落，马林迪作为葡萄牙活动中心兴盛起来，直到1593年葡萄牙人和谢赫的宫廷迁往蒙巴萨。旧城随后凋敝，到19世纪20年代，英国海军部的测量发现废墟之上只剩那根石柱。

en: Molokaʻi is the fifth largest of the eight main Hawaiian Islands, lying southeast of Oʻahu across the Kaʻiwi Channel and north of Lānaʻi. Polynesian voyagers settled it in the thirteenth century, and its people lived under the kapu system, ruled by a high chief, the aliʻi nui, whose line claimed descent from the sky father Wākea. The island never matched its neighbours in power and its royal traditions are fragmentary; its influence rested on marriage ties and the fame of its priests, the kahuna, while the kings of Oʻahu more than once held hegemony over it. From the late seventeenth century Molokaʻi was repeatedly struck by the rulers of Maui and Oʻahu, Kahekili II among them, and it had passed fully under Maui before the age of European contact. Captain James Cook sighted it in 1778 and George Dixon made the first recorded landing in 1786. In 1795 Kamehameha I's victory at the Battle of Nuʻuanu brought Molokaʻi, together with the other Maui-held islands, into his new Kingdom of Hawaiʻi.
zh: 莫洛卡伊是夏威夷八大岛中的第五大岛，隔凯维海峡位于瓦胡东南、拉奈以北。波利尼西亚航海者在13世纪定居于此，岛民在卡普禁忌制度下生活，由号称天神瓦凯亚后裔的最高酋长阿利伊努伊统治。莫洛卡伊实力不及邻岛，王室传世史迹零散，其影响主要靠联姻和祭司卡胡纳的名望维系，瓦胡诸王还曾多次对它建立宗主权。17世纪末起，莫洛卡伊屡遭毛伊和瓦胡的统治者攻伐，卡赫基利二世便是其中之一；到欧洲人接触的时代之前，它已完全并入毛伊。1778年库克船长望见该岛，1786年乔治·迪克森首次有记录地登岛。1795年卡美哈梅哈一世在努阿努山谷之战获胜，莫洛卡伊随毛伊属下各岛一起并入新生的夏威夷王国。

en: The Kingdom of Mallorca was founded on the Balearic Islands, which James I of Aragon conquered from the Almohad Caliphate and separated from his other realms in 1276 for his younger son James II. The new kingdom also held the mainland counties of Roussillon and Cerdanya and the city of Montpellier, but from 1279 its king was a vassal of Aragon under the Treaty of Perpignan. Alfonso III of Aragon occupied the islands in 1286, until the Treaty of Anagni returned them to James II. His son Sancho, reigning from 1324, named the Aragonese kings as his heirs in 1325, and the trade war with Genoa from 1329 to 1336 deepened the kingdom's financial troubles. In 1337 the crown belonged to James III, who lost the Balearics to Peter IV of Aragon in 1343 and Roussillon and Cerdanya in 1344; his attempt at reconquest ended with his death at the Battle of Llucmajor in 1349. Mallorca then stayed in personal union with the Crown of Aragon until the Nueva Planta decrees dissolved it in 1715.
zh: 马略卡王国建立在巴利阿里群岛之上：阿拉贡的海梅一世从阿尔摩哈德哈里发国手中征服这些岛屿，并于1276年将其从自己的其他领地中分封给幼子海梅二世。这个新王国还领有大陆上的鲁西永、塞尔达尼亚两伯国和蒙彼利埃城，但根据1279年的《佩皮尼昂条约》，马略卡国王须向阿拉贡称臣。1286年阿拉贡的阿方索三世占领群岛，直到《阿纳尼条约》才把岛屿归还海梅二世。其子桑乔1324年即位，1325年指定阿拉贡国王为继承人，1329至1336年与热那亚的贸易战又加深了财政困境。1337年在位的是海梅三世，他于1343年被阿拉贡的佩德罗四世夺去巴利阿里，1344年又丢了鲁西永和塞尔达尼亚；1349年他试图复国，在柳克马约尔战役中兵败身亡。此后马略卡与阿拉贡联合王国保持君合关系，直到1715年《新基本法令》将其废止。

en: Mong Lem, called Menglian in Chinese, was a Tai Nüa state in the hills of southwestern Yunnan, ruled by saopha princes from the town of Mùlián. The Yuan dynasty set it up as a tusi, or native chieftaincy, in 1289, and it was counted among the Koshanpye, the Nine Shan States of the Chinese borderlands. In 1348 it was swallowed by the neighboring power of Möng Mao, known to the Chinese as Luchuan, and remained under its shadow through the early Ming. The Ming re-established the territory as the Menglian Chief's Office in 1406, covering the old Yuan circuit of Mulian and lands east of the Salween. After a mid-sixteenth-century abolition it was restored in 1585, submitted to the Qing in 1662, and was raised to the rank of Xuanfu Si, or Pacification Commission, in 1709. For much of its history it sent tribute to both the Chinese court and the kings of Burma.
zh: 孟连，汉文作孟琏，是云南西南山区的一个傣那人邦国，由诏法家族以木连为治所进行统治。元朝于1289年将其设为土司，它也是汉文记载中“九掸邦”之一。1348年，它被邻邦勐卯（汉文称麓川）吞并，在明代初年一直处于麓川势力的影响之下。1406年，明朝重新设立孟琏长官司，辖境包括元代的木连路和萨尔温江以东的部分土地。该司在16世纪中期一度被废，1585年恢复；1662年归附清朝，1709年升格为孟连宣抚司。在历史上的大部分时间里，它同时向中国朝廷和缅甸国王两边进贡，在两大势力之间维持着自身的诏法世系。

en: Malinalco was a Matlatzinca town in the warm hills south of the Toluca Valley, its Nahuatl name drawn from the malinalli grass and associated with the goddess Malinalxochitl. The Matlatzinca counted it among their ceremonial centres alongside Calixtlahuaca, and it was later held by a Culhua ruling group under the lord Cuauhtepexpetlatzin. In 1476 the Aztec tlatoani Axayacatl conquered the Matlatzinca lands and Malinalco passed under the rule of Tenochtitlan. Between about 1486 and 1490 his successor Ahuitzotl had stonemasons brought from Tenochtitlan carve a sanctuary for the Eagle and Jaguar warriors directly into the rock of the Hill of the Idols, the building called Cuauhcalli; the work, raised largely with forced labour, was still unfinished when the Spaniards reached the valley. After the night of Sorrows in 1520 the town rose in revolt, and Andrés de Tapia was sent to subdue it together with the people of Ocuilan.
zh: 马利纳尔科是托卢卡谷地以南温暖丘陵中的马特拉钦卡人城镇，纳瓦特尔语名字来自马利纳尔利草，并与女神马利纳尔索奇特尔有关。马特拉钦卡人把它与卡利斯特拉瓦卡并列为祭祀中心之一，后来又由首领夸乌特佩什佩特拉丁率领的库尔瓦人集团统治。1476年，阿兹特克特拉托阿尼阿哈雅卡特尔征服马特拉钦卡人的土地，马利纳尔科改归特诺奇蒂特兰统治。约1486至1490年间，继位的阿维索特尔从特诺奇蒂特兰调来石匠，在偶像山的岩壁上直接开凿鹰战士与豹战士的圣所“鹰之屋”，工程大量使用强制劳役；西班牙人抵达谷地时它仍未完工。1520年“悲痛之夜”后，马利纳尔科起兵反抗，安德烈斯·德·塔皮亚奉命联合奥奎兰人将其镇压。

en: Milan is the great Lombard city on the northern Italian plain. A self-governing commune in the twelfth century, it led the Lombard League against Emperor Frederick I, and in 1277 Archbishop Ottone Visconti defeated the rival Della Torre at Desio, opening Visconti rule. In 1337 the city was held by Azzo Visconti, who had bought the title of imperial vicar and pushed its dominion into Piedmont; his successor Gian Galeazzo Visconti united the scattered family lands by a coup in 1385 and was made Duke of Milan by King Wenceslaus in 1395, ruling twenty-six towns from the Adda to the Ticino. When Filippo Maria Visconti died without a male heir in 1447 the city proclaimed the Golden Ambrosian Republic, but the condottiere Francesco Sforza, husband of Visconti's daughter Bianca Maria, took power in 1450 and founded the Sforza dynasty, recognized by the Peace of Lodi in 1454. Ludovico Sforza's invitation to Charles VIII of France helped open the Italian Wars in 1494; Louis XII conquered Milan in 1499, and after decades of French, Swiss and imperial interventions the last Sforza, Francesco II, died heirless in 1535. The duchy then passed to Habsburg Spain, and in 1707 to Austria, whose reforms developed the Lombard silk industry. Napoleon's campaign of 1796 ended the duchy, which the Treaty of Campo Formio merged into the Cisalpine Republic in 1797.
zh: 米兰是意大利北部平原上的伦巴第大城。12世纪它是自治市镇，曾领导伦巴第同盟对抗皇帝腓特烈一世；1277年大主教奥托内·维斯孔蒂在德西奥击败宿敌德拉·托雷家族，开启维斯孔蒂家族的统治。1337年掌权的是阿佐·维斯孔蒂，他购得帝国代理人头衔，把领地扩张到皮埃蒙特；后继者吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂于1385年通过政变统一家族分散的领地，1395年被国王瓦茨拉夫封为米兰公爵，统治着阿达河到提契诺河之间的26座城镇。1447年菲利波·马里亚·维斯孔蒂无男嗣而终，市民宣布成立金色安布罗修共和国，但雇佣兵首领弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎——维斯孔蒂之女比安卡·玛丽亚的丈夫——于1450年夺权，建立斯福尔扎王朝，并在1454年的《洛迪和约》中得到承认。卢多维科·斯福尔扎引法国国王查理八世入意大利，促成1494年意大利战争爆发；路易十二于1499年征服米兰，经过法国、瑞士和帝国势力数十年的拉锯，末代斯福尔扎弗朗切斯科二世于1535年无嗣而终。公国随后归入西班牙哈布斯堡，1707年转归奥地利，奥地利的改革推动了伦巴第丝绸业。拿破仑1796年的进军终结了公国，1797年的《坎波福尔米奥条约》将其并入奇萨尔皮尼共和国。

en: Malacato was the land of the Malacatos, one of the Palta chiefdoms of the Loja highlands in southern Ecuador. Their settlements climbed the flanks of the Sabanilla knot, on the route by which Palta groups had migrated out of the Amazon, and spread through the upper Catamayo valley and the valley they called Piscobamba, around the modern towns of Vilcabamba, Malacatos and Palanda, next to the country of the Bracamoros. Like the other Palta peoples they were maize farmers ruled by local curacas within a loose confederation whose meeting place was the Cuxibamba valley. They took part in the fierce resistance to the conquests of Tupac Inca Yupanqui, who ruled as Sapa Inca from 1471 to 1493; after the Inca victory the old organization was dismantled, Spanish rule later completed its breakup, and the Palta language survived only in a handful of recorded words.
zh: 马拉卡托是马拉卡托人的土地，为厄瓜多尔南部洛哈高地的帕勒塔酋长邦之一。他们的村落分布在萨瓦尼利亚山结两侧，即帕勒塔诸族迁出亚马孙所走的通道，并延伸到卡塔马约河上游和他们称作皮斯科班巴的河谷，即今比尔卡班巴、马拉卡托斯和帕兰达一带，与布拉卡莫罗斯人的土地相邻。和其他帕勒塔族群一样，他们种植玉米，由本地酋长库拉卡统领，加入以库西班巴河谷为会盟地的松散联盟。他们激烈抵抗过图帕克·印卡·尤潘基的征服，这位萨帕·印卡1471年至1493年在位；印加获胜后旧有组织被拆散，随后的西班牙统治最终使酋长邦瓦解，帕勒塔语只留下零星记录的词语。

en: Möng Mao, called Luchuan in Chinese records, was a Tai state centered on the Nam Mao, or Ruili, river basin on the present border of Yunnan and Myanmar, which flourished from the fourteenth to the fifteenth century. Under Si Kefa, who built the walled and moated capital of Selan around 1335, its power reached from Assam, conquered by his brother Hkun Sam Long, across the Tai states of upper Burma; raids from 1359 onward shattered the Burmese kingdoms of Sagaing and Pinya, which both fell in 1364 and opened the way for the rise of Ava. Si Kefa died in 1369. When Ming armies entered Yunnan in 1382, the ruler Si Lunfa submitted and accepted a tusi commission, but his attacks on defecting chiefdoms brought Ming expeditions that defeated him at Dingbian in 1388 and forced his surrender. In 1397 he was deposed in the Dao Ganmeng rebellion and restored only with Ming help. After his death the Ming split Möng Mao into five separate chieftaincies. Si Renfa's attempts to rebuild the old realm after 1437 drew down the Luchuan-Pingmian campaigns of 1436 to 1449, in which the Si family was defeated and retreated to Möng Yang, leaving a balkanized Shan frontier on which the Toungoo Empire later rose.
zh: 勐卯在汉文史料中称麓川，是以瑞丽江盆地为中心的傣族掸人国家，疆域在今天云南与缅甸交界一带，兴盛于14至15世纪。思可法约在1335年修建了城墙高、壕沟深的都城色兰；他在位时，其弟混三朗西征阿萨姆，势力横扫上缅甸诸掸邦。1359年起勐卯连年出兵，缅甸的实皆和彬牙两王国于1364年俱告覆灭，为阿瓦王国的兴起铺平了道路。思可法于1369年去世。1382年明军进入云南，君主思伦发归降并接受土司封号，但他转而攻打倒向明朝的属部，招致明军征讨，1388年在定边战败投降。1397年刀干孟之乱将他废黜，他借明朝援兵才得以复位。他死后，明朝把勐卯拆分为五个土司。1437年以后思任发试图重建旧疆，引来1436—1449年的麓川之役，思氏战败后退守孟养，掸邦边地就此群雄并立，日后东吁王朝得以乘势崛起。

en: The Mam are a Maya people of the western Guatemalan highlands, around the Sierra de los Cuchumatanes and the modern city of Huehuetenango, with related communities on the Soconusco coast of Chiapas; Quetzaltenango, or Xela, was originally a Mam town. Their Postclassic kingdom had its capital at Zaculeu, known in Mam as Chinabajul, a fortified plateau city above the Selegua River whose name means white earth. Settled from the Early Classic around the third century and shaped by Teotihuacán influence, it grew into the main Mam stronghold. The expanding K'iche' kingdom conquered it in the Postclassic: tradition places this in the fifteenth century, though radiocarbon work suggests as early as the twelfth. K'iche' king Q'uq'umatz died fighting the northern Mam before his son K'iq'ab completed their subjection, and Nija'ib' nobles then ruled the city from within. In 1525 Gonzalo de Alvarado y Contreras besieged Zaculeu for months, until its last king Kayb'il B'alam, starved out, surrendered to the Spanish.
zh: 玛姆人是危地马拉西部高地的玛雅民族，聚居于库丘马塔内斯山脉一带和今韦韦特南戈城附近，在恰帕斯的索科努斯科沿海也有亲缘社群；克萨尔特南戈（又名赫拉）最初就是玛姆人的城镇。他们后古典期王国的都城是萨库莱乌，玛姆语称奇纳巴胡尔，城名意为“白土”，是塞莱瓜河畔一座设防的高原城。该城约自3世纪的古典早期即有人居，建筑受特奥蒂瓦坎影响，后来成为玛姆人的主要堡垒。扩张中的基切王国在后古典期征服了它：传统说法定于15世纪，放射性碳定年则可能早至12世纪。基切国王库库马茨在与北方玛姆人作战时阵亡，其子基卡布最终完成征服，尼哈伊布氏族的贵族随后入驻统治。1525年，贡萨洛·德·阿尔瓦拉多·伊·孔特雷拉斯围攻萨库莱乌数月，末代国王凯比尔·巴拉姆因粮尽而降。

en: Maynila was a fortified Tagalog bayan on the southern bank of the Pasig River, on the site of the later Intramuros district of Manila, facing the separate polity of Tondo across the delta. Oral tradition dates its founding as a Muslim settlement to the 1250s, and Muslim burials near the Pasig show that Islam had reached the area by the late twelfth century. Its paramount rulers bore the Malay title of raja and kept close marriage ties with the Sultanate of Brunei, notably Rajah Salalila and his son Rajah Matanda. With Tondo it shared a duopoly over the Chinese trade in the archipelago: Chinese junks unloaded at Tondo while Maynila's fleets retailed the goods to other islands. By 1570 it was ruled jointly by the elderly Rajah Matanda and the younger Rajah Sulayman. That May Martin de Goiti stormed the settlement and burned its wooden palisade in the Battle of Maynila, and in June 1571 Miguel López de Legazpi proclaimed the Spanish city of Manila on its ruins, ending Maynila as an independent polity.
zh: 马尼拉是帕西格河南岸设防的他加禄城邦，位于后来马尼拉市王城区一带，与三角洲对岸独立的汤都隔河相望。口传传统称它在13世纪50年代作为穆斯林定居点建立，帕西格河附近的穆斯林墓葬也表明伊斯兰教在12世纪末已传入此地。它的最高统治者使用马来称号“拉惹”，并与文莱苏丹国保持密切的联姻关系，著名的有拉惹·萨拉利拉及其子拉惹·马坦达。马尼拉与汤都垄断了群岛内的中国贸易：中国商船在汤都卸货，再由马尼拉的船队转销各岛。1570年，它由年老的拉惹·马坦达和较年轻的拉惹·苏莱曼共同统治。同年5月，马丁·德·戈伊蒂在马尼拉之战中攻占并焚毁了它的木栅城寨；1571年6月，米格尔·洛佩斯·德·黎牙实比在其废墟上宣布建立西班牙人的马尼拉城，马尼拉作为独立政权的历史就此终结。

en: Mondovì is a hill town of southern Piedmont, the center of the Monregalese district. It was founded in 1198, when survivors of the destroyed village of Bredolo and peasants from the neighboring valleys gathered on Monte Regale to form an independent commune. The bishop of Asti and the marquis of Ceva stormed it in 1200 and destroyed it in 1231, but the commune rebuilt itself, and in 1260 it was occupied by Charles I of Anjou, king of Naples. It returned to the bishops of Asti in 1274, bought back its freedom in 1290 under the proud name Mons Regalis, or Royal Mount, and in 1305 fell to the Angevins again, so that in 1337 it was held in King Robert of Naples' name. Its lords then changed rapidly: the Visconti, the marquesses of Montferrat and the Acaja branch of Savoy followed one another until the House of Savoy kept it from 1418. By the sixteenth century Mondovì was the largest city in Piedmont; the first Piedmontese printing press opened there in 1472 and the region's first university in 1560. French occupation from 1537 ended with the treaty of 1559, and Duke Emmanuel Philibert restored the town to Savoy in 1560.
zh: 蒙多维是皮埃蒙特南部的山城，为蒙雷加莱塞地区的中心。1198年，被毁村庄布雷多洛的幸存者与邻近山谷的农民聚集在雷加莱山，组成独立市镇。1200年阿斯蒂主教和切瓦侯爵攻破此城，1231年又将其摧毁，但市镇得以重建；1260年它被那不勒斯国王安茹的查理一世占领，1274年重归阿斯蒂主教，1290年以“雷亚利斯山”即“国王山”的骄人名号赎买回自治权，1305年再度落入安茹家族之手，因此1337年它以那不勒斯国王罗伯特的名义受领。此后领主更迭频繁：维斯孔蒂家族、蒙费拉托侯爵和萨伏依的阿卡亚支系相继入主，1418年起由萨伏依家族稳定领有。到16世纪，蒙多维已是皮埃蒙特最大的城市；1472年皮埃蒙特第一家印刷所在此开设，1560年当地又建起全区第一所大学。1537年起的法国占领随1559年的条约结束，埃马努埃莱·菲利贝托公爵于1560年将该城归还萨伏依。

en: Möng Nai, also called Mone and bearing the ritual name Saturambha, was a Shan state of the eastern Southern Shan States, ruled from the town of Möng Nai. Its origins are disputed: Shan histories say Sam Long Hpa of Möng Kawng conquered it in 1223 and installed a branch of the old Möng Mi line as tributary rulers of Möng Mao, while Northern Thai chronicles claim it was founded in 1318 by 坤库阿, a son of King Mangrai, and thereafter owed allegiance to Lan Na. In the sixteenth century Möng Nai joined the confederation of Shan states that rallied after the fall of Ava, and its saopha marched with Möng Yang, Hsipaw and the others against the Toungoo dynasty until Bayinnaung overran the Shan country in 1556 and 1557. In later centuries the state controlled the subordinate chiefdoms of Kengtawng and Kenghkam in the adjoining valleys, and its rulers came to bear the Burmese title myoza rather than the higher rank of saopha.
zh: 孟乃又称孟尼，礼仪性国名为萨图朗巴，是南掸邦东部的一个掸人邦国，以孟乃城为治所。其起源说法不一：掸文史籍称孟拱的 三隆帕于1223年征服此地，安排旧孟弥支系的一支作为麓川的附庸统治者；而泰北编年史则称它由芒莱王之子 坤库阿 建于1318年，此后向兰纳称臣。16世纪时，孟乃加入阿瓦陷落后各掸邦组成的联盟，其诏法与孟养、昔卜等邦联手对抗东吁王朝，直到勃印曩在1556至1557年横扫掸地。后来的几个世纪里，该邦还控制着邻近谷地中的 肯通和肯坎 两个附属酋邦，其统治者也改用缅甸的“谬沙”头衔，等级低于更高一等的诏法，反映出该邦在缅甸朝贡体系中的位次。

en: Manjung is the later name for the Dindings coast of Perak, the stretch of the western Malay Peninsula running from the Dinding River to the estuary of the Klang. Its northern shores were part of the old Hindu Malay kingdom of Gangga Negara, while the port of Klang commanded a river mouth leading into the tin-rich interior. A bronze Klang Bell, dated to the centuries around the turn of the era, shows how early this coast joined the bay's trade networks, and in 1365 the Javanese poem Nagarakretagama counted Kelang among the tributary lands claimed by Majapahit. In the fifteenth century the whole coast passed under the Malacca Sultanate, whose famous bendahara Tun Perak began his career at Klang. After Malacca fell to the Portuguese in 1511 the ports acknowledged Johor, until Bugis settlers built the Sultanate of Selangor around them in the eighteenth century.
zh: 曼绒是霹雳天定海岸后来的名字，指马来半岛西部从天定河延伸到巴生河口的一带海岸。它的北部海岸本是印度教马来古国刚迦的一部分，而巴生港控制着通往产锡内陆的河口要冲。当地出土的巴生铜钟年代约在纪元前后，说明这片海岸很早便卷入了海湾贸易网；1365年的爪哇史诗《爪哇史颂》把巴生列为满者伯夷声称的朝贡地之一。15世纪，整条海岸归入马六甲苏丹国，著名的盘诃罗敦霹雳早年便在巴生任职。1511年马六甲被葡萄牙人攻陷后，这些港口转而臣服柔佛，到18世纪，布吉斯人在它们周围建立了雪兰莪苏丹国。

en: Mangalai, or Mangalai Suyah, meaning the sun-facing land, was a small kingdom of the Tarim oases with its capital at Aksu, reaching from Kucha in the east toward Issyk-Kul in the north; Marco Polo mentioned the cities of the region. Its ruler Babdagan submitted to Genghis Khan between 1224 and 1227, and Chagatai later granted the territory to the Dughlat lord Urtubu, so that through the later thirteenth and early fourteenth centuries it formed part of the Chagatai Khanate. As khanal power waned, the Dughlat amirs of Mangalai became king-makers: in 1347 Amir Bulaji raised Tughlugh Timur to the khanship of the new Moghulistan. Aksu then passed back and forth between the Moghul khans and Dughlat princes, who also held Kashgar, Yarkand and Khotan, until Sultan Said Khan's victory of 1514 folded the oases into the Yarkent Khanate, itself overrun by the Dzungars in 1680.
zh: 曼尕赖一称曼尕赖·苏雅，意为向阳之地，是塔里木盆地绿洲上以阿克苏为都的小国，疆域东起库车，北抵伊塞克湖一带，马可·波罗曾记述过这一地区的城市。其王巴布达干于1224—1227年间归降成吉思汗，后来察合台把这片领地封给杜格拉特贵族乌尔图布，整个13世纪至14世纪初，曼尕赖都是察合台汗国的一部分。汗权衰落后，曼尕赖的杜格拉特异密成为拥立者：1347年，异密布拉吉扶立秃忽鲁帖木儿为新的蒙兀儿斯坦之汗。阿克苏此后在蒙兀儿诸汗与杜格拉特王公之间反复转手，后者还据有喀什噶尔、叶尔羌与和阗；1514年赛德汗取胜，把各绿洲并入叶尔羌汗国，叶尔羌汗国又于1680年被准噶尔攻灭。

en: Mann is the heart of the old Norse-Gaelic Kingdom of the Isles, the Sudreyjar of the Viking sagas, which linked the Isle of Man with the Hebrides under the distant overlordship of Norway. From 1079 the Crovan dynasty of Godred Crovan ruled it, established the open-air parliament of Tynwald and kept its seat at Peel Castle on St Patrick's Isle; the Diocese of Sodor and Man was created in 1154. After the failure of a Manx revolt at Ronaldsway in 1275, Norwegian rights had already been ceded to Scotland by the Treaty of Perth of 1266, but Mann became a shuttlecock of the Scottish Wars: Edward I took it in 1290, Robert the Bruce stormed Castle Rushen in 1313, and the island changed hands several times before Edward III granted it to his companion William Montagu, who ruled as King of Mann and was made Earl of Salisbury in 1337. English rule became definitive in 1346, and in 1399 the lordship passed to the English Crown, which in 1405 entrusted it to the Stanley family, later Earls of Derby, as Lords of Mann. The Atholl dukes who inherited the lordship finally sold their sovereign rights back to the Crown under the Act of Revestment of 1765, while Tynwald continued to govern the island's internal affairs.
zh: 马恩是古老诺斯-盖尔“群岛王国”的核心，即维京萨迦中的苏德里群岛，把马恩岛与赫布里底群岛连在一起，遥奉挪威为宗主。1079年起，戈德雷德·克罗万的克罗万王朝统治此地，设立了露天议会廷瓦尔德，王庭设在圣帕特里克岛上的皮尔城堡；1154年又建立了索多尔暨马恩教区。1266年的《珀斯条约》已把挪威的宗主权让给苏格兰，1275年马恩人在罗纳斯韦起义失败后统治才稳固，但马恩随即成了苏格兰战争中的反复易手之地：爱德华一世于1290年取岛，罗伯特·布鲁斯于1313年攻陷拉申城堡，此后又几经转手，最终爱德华三世把它赐给亲信威廉·蒙塔古，他以“马恩国王”的身份统治，并于1337年受封索尔兹伯里伯爵。英格兰的控制在1346年定型，1399年领主权归于英格兰王室，1405年王室又把它托付给斯坦利家族（后为德比伯爵）世代担任马恩领主。继承该领主之位的阿索尔公爵最终在1765年《权力归还法令》中把统治权卖回王室，而廷瓦尔德则继续治理岛上的内部事务。

en: The Melanau, who call themselves A-Likou, the river people, are among the oldest settled peoples of the Sarawak coast, living in riverside villages along the lower Rajang and its neighbours, from Igan and Mukah to Tutong. Chinese records of the thirteenth century already place Igan, Tutong and Bintulu within the trading realm of Po-ni, and the Nagarakretagama of 1365 names Malano among the vassals of Majapahit, calling it the foremost land of the Tanjungpura region. Melanau oral tradition and the Brunei epic Syair Awang Semaun remember the chiefs Basiung and Tugau, who ruled from Igan over the Tutong lands; around 1400 the rising Brunei kingdom of Awang Alak Betatar marched on Igan and brought the Melanau river settlements under its sway. In 1609 Melanau chiefs joined Kalka and Saribas in revolting from Brunei to Sambas, though Brunei reasserted its control about 1730. The Melanau traded sago and jungle produce, and their ancient carved burial poles, the jerunei, still recall their early riverine culture.
zh: 梅拉瑙人自称阿利口，意为河上人，是砂拉越海岸最古老的定居族群之一，在下拉让河及邻近河流的伊甘、沐胶至都东一带傍水而居。13世纪的中国文献已把伊甘、都东和民都鲁列入渤泥的贸易范围；1365年的《爪哇史颂》把马拉诺列为满者伯夷的属国，称其为丹戎布拉地区最重要的地方。梅拉瑙口述传统与文莱史诗《阿旺·司马温传》都记得首领巴雄和图高，他们以伊甘为中心统治都东诸地；约1400年，阿旺·阿拉克·贝塔塔尔新兴的文莱王国进军伊甘，把梅拉瑙诸河聚落纳入治下。1609年，梅拉瑙首领联合卡尔卡和沙里巴斯脱离文莱、转投三发，文莱约在1730年重新确立统治。梅拉瑙人以西米和林产贸易为生，其古老的雕刻葬柱哲鲁奈是早期河居文化的见证。

en: Minzhou was a border prefecture on the middle Tao River in southern Gansu, around present-day Minxian, a land of Qiang and Di herders that the Qin had incorporated by the seventh century BC and where the western end of the Qin Great Wall once stood. The Western Wei created Minzhou in 544, naming it after the Min Mountains. Tibetan armies took it in 761, and it returned to Chinese rule only with Wang Shao's Xihe campaigns of 1073. Under the Yuan it served as the seat of the Tuosima, or Do-smad, route governing the Amdo country. In 1378 the Ming converted it into the Minzhou Guard, raised to a military-civilian commission in 1382, with native commanders such as the hereditary Wang clan keeping order among its Tibetan tribes; the department was briefly restored in 1545 and then merged back into the guard in 1561. The Qing made it a civilian department again in 1730, and in that form it governed the Tao River border country to the end of the imperial period.
zh: 岷州是甘肃南部洮河中游的边州，在今岷县一带，本是羌、狄牧民的居地，公元前7世纪已被秦国纳入版图，秦长城的西端就曾设在这里。544年西魏因境内岷山置岷州。761年吐蕃攻占岷州，直到1073年王韶发动熙河之役才重归中原王朝。元代岷州是管辖安多地区的脱思麻路治所。1378年明朝改置岷州卫，1382年升为军民指挥使司，汪家奴等世袭土官在卫中任职，管束藏族部落；1545年一度置州，1561年又废州恢复军民指挥使司。1730年清廷再改岷州，以民政体系管辖洮河边地，直至清末。

en: The Principality of Mologa was a small appanage on the Mologa River, a Volga tributary in the Yaroslavl lands. It was created in 1321, when after the death of Prince David of Yaroslavl his sons divided their inheritance: the elder, Vasily, kept Yaroslavl, while Mikhail Davidovich took the lands along the Mologa and upper Volga and settled at the town of Mologa. In 1337 Mikhail still ruled, holding his principality in loose subordination to Yaroslavl. An international barter fair grew up at nearby Kholopy Gorodok, and in 1362 Mikhail rode with Dmitry of Moscow to the Golden Horde, a mark of standing among the Rus' princes. His son Fyodor fought on the right wing at Kulikovo in 1380 and joined Dmitry Donskoy's campaigns against Tver and Novgorod. After Fyodor's death in 1408 the appanage split into three lines, the Prozorovsky, Sitsky and Mologa princes, whose descendants entered Muscovite service, and Ivan III annexed the principality in 1471. Mologa itself later became a flourishing Volga trading town with a fortress and a great fair relocated there in the late fifteenth century.
zh: 莫洛加公国是莫洛加河畔的小封邑，莫洛加河是雅罗斯拉夫尔地界内注入伏尔加河的支流。它形成于1321年：雅罗斯拉夫尔王公达维德死后诸子瓜分遗产，长子瓦西里保有雅罗斯拉夫尔，米哈伊尔·达维多维奇取得莫洛加河与伏尔加上游一带的土地，驻节于莫洛加城。1337年米哈伊尔仍在位，对雅罗斯拉夫尔保持松散的臣属关系。附近的霍洛皮戈罗多克兴起了国际易货集市；1362年米哈伊尔随莫斯科的德米特里同赴金帐汗国觐见，这在当时是罗斯王公地位的象征。其子费奥多尔参加了1380年库里科沃战役，位列俄军右翼，还随德米特里·顿斯科伊征伐特维尔和诺夫哥罗德。1408年费奥多尔死后，封邑分裂为普罗佐罗夫斯基、西茨基和莫洛加三支，后裔纷纷转入莫斯科服役，1471年伊凡三世兼并该公国。莫洛加城后来成为伏尔加河上繁荣的商业城镇，筑有要塞，15世纪末又有大型集市迁入。

en: Momboares was the Portuguese name for the Seven Kingdoms of Kongo dia Nlaza, a loose confederation of Bantu polities that had lain east of the young Kingdom of Kongo since at least the thirteenth century. Its chief district stood on the Kwale River, and its lands ran east to the Kwango, north to the Pool Malebo and west to the Inkisi, taking in smaller kingdoms such as Nsundi and Mpangu. In 1337 these lands were still independent of Kongo. The region was already a major centre of textile weaving: the Jesuit Mateus Cardoso, writing in the seventeenth century, described its cloth production and recorded exports of around a hundred thousand metres of raphia cloth a year to Luanda. Kongo expanded eastward through its province of Mbata and absorbed the Seven Kingdoms during the sixteenth century, after which their rulers appeared among the titles of the Manikongo, including those of King Álvaro II in 1583.
zh: 蒙博阿勒是葡萄牙人对“刚果·迪亚·恩拉扎七王国”的称呼，那是一个由班图人小邦组成的松散联盟，至少从13世纪起就位于年轻的刚果王国以东。其中心地区在夸莱河畔，疆域东抵宽果河、北达马莱博湖、西至因基西河，包括恩松迪、姆潘古等小王国。1337年时，这些土地仍独立于刚果之外。当地已是重要的纺织中心：17世纪著述的耶稣会士马特乌斯·卡多佐描述了这里的布匹生产，并记录了每年仅向罗安达就出口约十万米拉菲草布的盛况。刚果经姆巴塔省向东扩张，于16世纪吞并了七王国，此后其君主的名号被列入马尼刚果的头衔之中，1583年阿尔瓦罗二世的头衔里就有它们。

en: The County of Montfort, centred on the fortress of Montfort-l'Amaury west of Paris, began around 996 when King Robert the Pious had a castle raised there to shield the royal domain from the counts of Blois. Guillaume de Hainaut built it and his son Amaury I founded the adjoining town, which took the name Montfort-l'Amaury, and became its first seigneur. The house of Montfort made the place famous: Simon IV de Montfort led the Albigensian Crusade until his death at Toulouse in 1218, while his younger son Simon, earl of Leicester, died at Evesham in 1265 leading the English baronial revolt. By the early fourteenth century the county had passed to Yolande of Dreux, whose marriage to Arthur II of Brittany in 1294 tied it to the Breton ducal house; her son John of Montfort, count from 1322, held it in 1337. His claim to Brittany after 1341 opened the War of the Breton Succession, and the French crown judged Montfort-l'Amaury forfeit and seized it. John died in 1345, but his son John IV won Brittany in 1364. English troops destroyed the castle during the Hundred Years' War, and the county finally returned to the French crown when Brittany was united to France under Francis I.
zh: 蒙福尔伯国以巴黎以西的蒙福尔拉莫里要塞为中心，始于996年前后：虔诚者罗贝尔二世下令在此筑城，以保护王室领地、抵御布卢瓦伯爵。城堡由埃诺的纪尧姆修建，其子阿莫里一世在旁建立城镇，得名蒙福尔拉莫里，并成为首任领主。蒙福尔家族由此闻名：西蒙四世·德·孟福尔率领阿尔比十字军，1218年死于图卢兹；其幼子莱斯特伯爵西蒙则在英格兰领导贵族叛乱，1265年战死于伊夫舍姆。14世纪初，伯国转入德勒的约兰德之手，她于1294年嫁给布列塔尼公爵阿蒂尔二世，使伯国与布列塔尼公爵家族连在一起；她的儿子让·德·蒙福尔于1322年继承伯国，1337年时正由他领有。1341年后他对布列塔尼提出继承权，引发布列塔尼继承战争，法兰西王室判决没收蒙福尔拉莫里。让于1345年去世，其子让四世于1364年夺得布列塔尼。百年战争期间英格兰军队摧毁了这座城堡；等到布列塔尼在弗朗索瓦一世时并入法兰西，伯国也最终收归王室。

en: Moro was a small kingdom of the northern Moluccas, covering Morotai island and the adjacent north Halmahera coast, whose Galela-speaking people had little regional influence and fell within Ternate's sphere from the fifteenth century. A Portuguese Jesuit mission there was expelled in 1571, and seventeenth-century Ternate repeatedly deported its Christian villagers to Malayu on Ternate.
zh: 摩洛是北摩鹿加的小王国，地跨摩罗泰岛和邻近的哈马黑拉岛北部海岸，居民说加莱拉语，在地区内影响有限，15世纪起处于特尔纳特的势力范围。葡萄牙耶稣会曾在此传教，1571年被驱逐；17世纪特尔纳特又屡次将其基督徒村民迁往特尔纳特岛的马拉尤。

en: The Morocco of 1337 was the Marinid Sultanate, ruled from Fez by the Banu Marin, a Zenata Berber tribe that had drifted west from the Zab region in present-day eastern Algeria. Once mercenaries of the Almohads, they rebelled after the Almohad collapse at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212, took Fez in 1248 and the caravan city of Sijilmasa in 1255, and sealed their conquest by capturing Marrakesh in 1269. Abu Yusuf Yaqub made Fez his capital, founding Fes Jdid in 1276 and patronising the first Moroccan madrasas, and intervened across the Strait of Gibraltar to support the Nasrid emirs of Granada. At the apogee of the dynasty, Sultan Abu al-Hasan Ali conquered the Zayyanid kingdom of Tlemcen in 1337 and routed the Hafsids in 1347, briefly uniting most of the Maghreb. His defeat by a Castilian-Portuguese coalition at the Río Salado in 1340 and the loss of Algeciras in 1344 ended the Andalusian adventure, and he was deposed by his son Abu Inan in 1348. After Abu Inan's murder in 1358 the sultanate fragmented among viziers and rebellious tribes; the Portuguese seized Ceuta in 1415, and the Wattasid regents became the real power. A Fez revolt in 1465 killed the last Marinid sultan, Abd al-Haqq II, opening the way to direct Wattasid rule.
zh: 1337年的摩洛哥是马林苏丹国，由马林部落以非斯为都城统治。马林人是泽纳塔柏柏尔人的一支，从今阿尔及利亚东部的扎布地区向西迁徙而来。他们本是穆瓦希德王朝的佣兵，1212年穆瓦希德人在拉斯纳瓦斯德托洛萨战败后便起兵反叛，1248年夺取非斯，1255年拿下商道名城锡吉勒马萨，1269年攻占马拉喀什，完成了征服。阿布·优素福·叶尔孤白以非斯为都，1276年兴建新非斯城，赞助了摩洛哥最早的一批宗教学校，并渡海支援格拉纳达的纳斯里德埃米尔。王朝鼎盛时期，苏丹阿布·哈桑·阿里于1337年攻灭特莱姆森的宰扬王朝，1347年又击溃哈夫斯王朝，一度统一了马格里布大部。但1340年他在里奥萨拉多被卡斯蒂利亚与葡萄牙联军击败，1344年丢失阿尔赫西拉斯，安达卢西亚远征就此终结，他本人也于1348年被儿子阿布·伊南废黜。1358年阿布·伊南遇刺后，苏丹国在维齐尔专权和部落叛乱中走向分裂：1415年葡萄牙人攻占休达，瓦塔斯家族以摄政身份掌握实权。1465年非斯爆发起义，末代苏丹阿卜杜勒·哈克二世被杀，马林王朝告终，瓦塔斯王朝随之正式登场。

en: The Grand Principality of Moscow grew from a small appanage on the Moskva River, in a town first mentioned in 1147 and granted in 1263 to Daniel, youngest son of Alexander Nevsky. Its princes rose by serving the khans of the Golden Horde: Ivan I Kalita, ruling from 1325, collected the Tatar tribute from the other Rus' princes, grew rich, and kept the grand princely title of Vladimir in his line, while the metropolitan of the Russian Church moved his see from Vladimir to Moscow. Dmitry Donskoy defeated a Horde army at Kulikovo in 1380 and united the thrones of Vladimir and Moscow. After the long civil war of Vasily II's reign, Ivan III absorbed the rival Rus' states, annexing Novgorod in 1478 and throwing off Tatar overlordship in 1480; he styled himself sovereign of all Russia and rebuilt the Kremlin with Italian architects. Vasily III completed the gathering of the Russian lands, and in 1547 Ivan IV was crowned the first Russian tsar, turning the principality into the Tsardom of Russia.
zh: 莫斯科大公国的前身是莫斯科河畔的一个小封邑，莫斯科城最早见于1147年的记载，1263年被封给亚历山大·涅夫斯基的幼子丹尼尔。莫斯科的王公靠为金帐汗国的汗效力而崛起：1325年即位的伊凡一世·卡利塔替汗向罗斯诸公国征收贡赋，由此致富，并为家族保住了弗拉基米尔大公之位，罗斯教会的都主教也把驻节地从弗拉基米尔迁到莫斯科。德米特里·顿斯科伊于1380年在库利科沃击败金帐汗国的军队，并把弗拉基米尔与莫斯科的公位合二为一。经过瓦西里二世在位时的长期内战后，伊凡三世兼并了与之竞争的罗斯诸国，1478年吞并诺夫哥罗德，1480年摆脱了鞑靼人的宗主权；他自称全罗斯君主，还聘请意大利建筑师重建克里姆林宫。瓦西里三世完成了罗斯土地的聚合，1547年伊凡四世加冕为第一位俄国沙皇，大公国就此演变为俄罗斯沙皇国。

en: Mouzon was a small lordship on the Meuse in the Ardennes, on the border between the kingdom of France and the Holy Roman Empire. Its walled castrum belonged to the archbishops of Reims, for whom it served as a second residence until the twelfth century and as a meeting place for rulers: King Robert II of France met Emperor Henry II there in 1023, Pope Calixtus II negotiated with Henry V in 1119, and Philip Augustus received Frederick Barbarossa at Mouzon in 1187. Archbishop Adalbéron of Reims had re-founded its Benedictine abbey in 971, and a town charter of 1182 encouraged its growth as a river crossing. The surrounding lands, including Sedan, held of the lordship of Mouzon, were attached to the French crown by treaty in 1379. By the Treaty of Saint-Maur of 1465 the lordship passed to Duke John II of Lorraine, and in the sixteenth century it was absorbed into the Principality of Sedan.
zh: 穆宗是阿登地区默兹河畔的小领地，地处法兰西王国与神圣罗马帝国的边界。它的设防城堡属于兰斯大主教，12世纪以前是大主教的第二驻地，也是君主会晤之地：1023年法兰西国王罗贝尔二世在此会见皇帝亨利二世，1119年教皇加里斯都二世在此与亨利五世谈判，1187年腓力·奥古斯都又在此接待腓特烈·巴巴罗萨。971年，兰斯大主教阿达尔贝隆重建了当地的本笃会修道院，1182年的城市特许状推动这座渡口城镇发展。包括色当在内、从属于穆宗领的周围土地于1379年依条约并入法兰西王室。1465年《圣莫尔条约》将该领地划给洛林公爵让二世，16世纪它又被并入色当亲王国。

en: Moray, on the southern shore of the Moray Firth, began as a Gaelic province whose mormaers behaved as kings, sometimes independent of the Scottish kingdom of Alba to the south; the most famous of them was Macbeth, who held Moray before seizing the Scottish throne in 1040. The line ended when David I defeated Óengus of Moray at the Battle of Stracathro in 1130 and absorbed the province into Scotland, planting burghs and castles and establishing the bishopric whose cathedral rose at Elgin. During the Wars of Independence Moray was a loyal recruiting ground for Robert the Bruce, who in 1312 recreated it as a feudal earldom for his nephew Thomas Randolph, later regent of Scotland. In 1337 the earl was Thomas's son John Randolph, joint regent for the exiled David II, but he fell at the Battle of Neville's Cross in 1346 without an heir. In 1372 the earldom was split, the coastal districts going to John Dunbar while the uplands fell to Alexander Stewart, the Wolf of Badenoch, whose men burned Elgin and its cathedral in 1390. From the 1430s the Lords of the Isles overran much of the region until the crown reasserted itself, and in 1452 the Gordons of Huntly became its chief lords; the earldom's last creation, in 1562, went to James Stewart, the Regent Moray, illegitimate half-brother of Mary, Queen of Scots.
zh: 默里位于马里湾南岸，最初是一个盖尔人的省份，其莫勒玛（即盖尔语的伯爵）行事形同君王，对南方的苏格兰阿尔巴王国时附时叛；其中最著名的是麦克白，他在1040年夺取苏格兰王位之前正是默里的统治者。1130年，戴维一世在斯特拉卡思罗战役击败默里的昂古斯，终结了这一传承，把该省并入苏格兰，兴建自治市镇与城堡，并设立主教区，主教座堂后来建在埃尔金。独立战争期间，默里是罗伯特·布鲁斯忠诚的兵源地，布鲁斯于1312年将其重建为封建伯爵领，封给外甥托马斯·伦道夫，后者后来出任苏格兰摄政。1337年的伯爵是托马斯之子约翰·伦道夫，他与同僚共同为流亡中的戴维二世摄政，却于1346年在内维尔十字之战阵亡且无嗣。1372年伯爵领被拆分：沿海地区封给约翰·邓巴，山地则归“巴德诺赫之狼”亚历山大·斯图亚特，他的手下于1390年焚毁了埃尔金城及其大教堂。15世纪30年代起，群岛领主一度占据该省大部，直到王室重新立威；1452年亨特利的戈登家族成为当地首屈一指的领主。伯爵领最后一次册封是在1562年，受封者是苏格兰女王玛丽的异母弟、摄政马里伯爵詹姆斯·斯图亚特。

en: The Island of Mozambique is a small coral island off the northern Mozambique coast, home to a Swahili Muslim town founded no later than the fourteenth century, whose first settlers according to tradition came from Kilwa. By the fifteenth century its rulers were linked by kinship to those of Angoche and Quelimane, and when Vasco da Gama called there the island was ruled by the sultan Mussa Bin Bique, from whom the name Mozambique derives. The Portuguese seized the island in 1507, built a naval base and the Fort of São Sebastião, and made it the capital of their East African possessions and a missionary centre, trading in gold, spices and slaves. It repelled Dutch assaults in 1607 and 1608 under Estêvão de Ataíde and remained Portugal's chief staging post on the voyage to India for more than two centuries.
zh: 莫桑比克岛是莫桑比克北部近海的一座小岛，岛上的斯瓦希里穆斯林城镇至迟建于14世纪，据传统说法最早的居民来自基尔瓦。到15世纪，当地统治者已与安戈谢和克利马内的统治者联姻结盟；达伽马到访时，岛上的苏丹是穆萨·本·比克，莫桑比克一名即由他而来。葡萄牙人于1507年夺取该岛，修建海军基地和圣塞巴斯蒂昂堡，把它作为葡属东非领地的首府和传教中心，经营黄金、香料和奴隶贸易。1607年和1608年，该岛在埃斯特旺·德·阿塔伊德指挥下击退荷兰人的进攻，此后两个多世纪里一直是葡萄牙人远航印度途中最主要的中继站。

en: Maguela covers the Kongo-speaking chiefdoms around Wembo, Wandu and Masinga on the plateau east of Mbanza Kongo, small kingdoms absorbed by the expanding Kingdom of Kongo in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries. Wandu later became a Kinlaza province whose queen Violante invaded Kongo in 1764, briefly deposing King Álvaro XI.
zh: 马圭拉指姆班扎刚果以东高原上温布、万杜、马辛加一带的刚果语酋邦群，这些小邦在15至16世纪被扩张中的刚果王国吞并为行省。万杜后为金拉扎家族的行省，其女王维奥兰特于1764年攻入刚果，一度废黜国王阿尔瓦罗十一世。

en: Mamprugu is the kingdom of the Mamprusi people in the savanna of what is now north-eastern Ghana, reaching into northern Togo and Burkina Faso. It was founded in the 1200s by Naa Gbewaa, whose shrine at Pusiga remains the dynasty's ancestral home; Mamprusi tradition calls Gbewaa the common ancestor of the rulers of Dagbon and Nanumba as well, and makes his daughter Yennenga the grandmother of the founder of the Mossi kingdoms. As the eldest branch of the Mole-Dagbani cluster of peoples, Mamprugu long held ceremonial primacy in the region, and even the Moro-Naba of the Mossi is symbolically enskinned by its king, the Nayiri. The kingdom was governed through hereditary skins held by direct male descendants of the founding line, with Gambaga and later Nalerigu as its chief seats. Through Dyula merchants the Mamprusi began converting to Islam in the 1600s, though the older worship of the sky god Naa-wuni remained widespread.
zh: 曼普鲁古是曼普鲁西人的王国，位于今加纳东北部的稀树草原，势力延伸到多哥北部和布基纳法索。它约在13世纪由纳阿·格贝瓦建立，他在普西加的神龛一直是这个王朝的祖庭；曼普鲁西传说称格贝瓦同时是达格邦和纳农巴统治者的共同祖先，他的女儿耶能加则是莫西王国开国者的祖母。作为莫莱-达格巴尼族群中最年长的支系，曼普鲁古长期在该地区保有礼仪上的首席地位，就连莫西人的莫罗-纳巴也要由其国王纳伊里象征性地授予王位。王国通过世袭的“皮位”治理，只有创始血脉的男性直系后裔可以承袭，主要王庭先后设在甘巴加和后来的纳莱里古。17世纪，受迪尤拉商人影响，曼普鲁西人开始改宗伊斯兰教，但对天神纳乌尼的古老崇拜仍然广泛流传。

en: The prince-bishopric of Merseburg had its seat on the Saale, where Henry the Fowler had built a royal palace around 919. Emperor Otto I founded the diocese in 967, alongside those of Meissen and Zeitz, as a suffragan of Magdeburg, intended to Christianise the pagan Sorbs beyond the Saale and bind the Slavic marches to the empire; the first bishop was the Bavarian missionary Boso. The see was briefly suppressed and then re-established by Henry II in 1004, and under Bishop Thietmar, the chronicler, the great cathedral was begun and consecrated in 1021. Merseburg's bishops backed Pope Gregory VII in the Investiture Controversy, but from the thirteenth century the small state was increasingly overshadowed by the Wettin margraves of Meissen, who by the 1485 Treaty of Leipzig secured its protectorate. In 1337 the bishop was Gebhard of Schraplau, a lord of the Querfurt country. The Reformation ended the old see: Bishop Adolph II of Anhalt was expelled by his subjects during the Peasants' War of 1525, Saxon administrators took over, and in 1565 Merseburg was incorporated into the Electorate of Saxony. A Wettin cadet line held the title of duke of Saxe-Merseburg from 1652 to 1738, and at the Congress of Vienna in 1815 most of the former bishopric's lands passed to Prussia.
zh: 梅泽堡主教区邦位于萨勒河畔，捕鸟者亨利约在919年在此修建了王宫。967年，皇帝奥托一世在设立迈森和蔡茨教区的同时设立梅泽堡教区，作为马格德堡的下属教区，意在使萨勒河以东信奉异教的索布人皈依，并把斯拉夫人的边地与帝国联结起来，首任主教是巴伐利亚传教士博索。教区曾一度被撤销，1004年由亨利二世重建；在编年史家蒂特马尔主教任内，宏伟的大教堂动工并于1021年祝圣。叙任权斗争中，梅泽堡主教们支持教皇格列高利七世，但从13世纪起，这个小国日益受到迈森韦廷藩侯的压制，后者通过1485年的《莱比锡条约》取得了对它的保护权。1337年在任的是施拉普劳的格布哈德，出身奎尔富特一带的领主家族。宗教改革终结了古老的主教区：安哈尔特的阿道夫二世主教在1525年农民战争中被治下民众驱逐，萨克森派来的管理者接掌权力，1565年梅泽堡正式并入萨克森选侯国。1652至1738年，韦廷家族的一支旁系拥有萨克森-梅泽堡公爵头衔；1815年维也纳会议上，旧主教区的大部分土地划归普鲁士。

en: The County of La Marche, whose main town was Guéret on the north-western edge of the Massif Central, took its name from its role as a march, the border district between the Duchy of Aquitaine and the Frankish royal lands, when it first appeared as a fief around the middle of the tenth century. Its first count was Boson, a vassal of Duke William III of Aquitaine, and in the twelfth century the county passed to the House of Lusignan. When Count Guy died childless in 1308, King Philip IV seized it, and in 1314 it became the appanage of his son Charles the Fair, who as King Charles IV exchanged it in 1327 with Louis of Bourbon for the County of Clermont. La Marche then followed the Bourbon line, was held by the Armagnacs from 1435 to 1477 before reverting to the Bourbons, and was finally absorbed into the royal domain by Francis I in 1527.
zh: 拉马什伯国的主城是中央高原西北缘的盖雷，其名得自它的边区身份：10世纪中叶它首次作为封地出现时，是阿基坦公国与法兰克王室领地之间的边境马克，首任伯爵是阿基坦公爵威廉三世的封臣博松。12世纪伯国转入吕西尼昂家族手中。1308年伯爵居伊无嗣而终，腓力四世没收伯国，并于1314年把它封给儿子美男子查理，即后来的查理四世；1327年，即位后的查理四世用它与波旁的路易交换克莱蒙伯国。此后拉马什随波旁家族传承，1435—1477年由阿马尼亚克家族掌握，之后复归波旁，最终于1527年被弗朗索瓦一世并入王室领地。

en: Muren was the Hūrga Jurchen community of the Muren Bira, the Manchu name of the Muling River, which rises on the Heilongjiang–Jilin border and runs north past Muling and Jixi, its chief seat, to enter the Ussuri near Hulin. In the early fifteenth century the Ming planted the Mulu River Guard in this part of the Ussuri basin under the Nurgan commission, and the eunuch Yishiha's network stationed units along the Muling together with the Songari, Ussuri, Khor and Nen. The local chiefs kept their guard titles as hereditary tributaries until the Jianzhou campaigns of 1596 to 1625, when Nurhaci's rising state brought the Ussuri tribes under its banners.
zh: 穆伦是穆伦河（满语称穆伦毕拉，即穆棱河）流域的虎尔哈女真人聚落，以鸡西为首邑。穆棱河发源于黑龙江与吉林边界，北流经穆棱、鸡西，在虎林附近注入乌苏里江。15世纪初，明朝在乌苏里江流域这一带设穆噜河卫，隶属奴儿干都司；太监亦失哈的羁縻体系沿穆棱河与松花江、乌苏里江、霍尔河、嫩江一线部署卫所。当地酋长以卫所官职世袭朝贡，直到1596—1625年建州女真连年用兵，努尔哈赤的政权才把乌苏里江诸部收入旗下。

en: The Al Murrah are a camel-nomad Arab tribe whose annual circuits crossed the Rub' al-Khali, the Empty Quarter, between their original home of Najran and the oases of al-Hasa on the Gulf. They claim pre-Islamic descent from the Yam, themselves a branch of the Hamdan, and unlike the Ismaili Yam of Najran the Murrah follow Sunni Islam; in later centuries their seven clans were also found in Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and along the Gulf shore. Life in the great desert made them its true masters: pasturing their camels from the wells of Yabrin, the southernmost habitable oasis on the Najd edge of the sands, they ranged along routes that had carried Oman caravans since the third millennium before the common era. In the 1700s the Murrah backed the Wahhabi cause, and when Abd al-Aziz ibn Saud, who reigned from 1765 to 1803, was driven from power, he found refuge in their oases; the tribesmen recognized him as emir, took the Wahhabi banner into their own black standard, and fought beside him, an alliance later sealed by marriages with the Al Saud.
zh: 穆拉是放养骆驼的阿拉伯游牧部落，每年在鲁卜哈利（空旷之地）大沙漠往返迁徙，路线从祖居地奈季兰一直延伸到海湾沿岸的哈萨绿洲。他们自称伊斯兰兴起之前便已存在，源出哈姆丹人的分支亚姆部；与奈季兰信奉伊斯玛仪派的亚姆人不同，穆拉人信奉逊尼派，后来其七个氏族也见于卡塔尔、科威特、巴林和海湾沿岸。大漠生活使他们堪称这片沙海真正的主人：他们以内志沙漠边缘最南端的可居绿洲耶卜林的水井为基地游牧，所走的路线自公元前第三个千年起便是阿曼商队的通道。18世纪，穆拉支持瓦哈比事业；1765年至1803年在位的阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·本·沙特失势时，曾在穆拉的绿洲避难，部众承认他为埃米尔，把瓦哈比旗帜纳入自己的黑色战旗并随他作战，这一同盟后来又通过与沙特家族的联姻得到巩固。

en: The Principality of Murom, on the lower Oka, grew out of one of the oldest towns of the eastern Slavic world. Murom began as a Finnic trading settlement of the Muroma people in the ninth century and by the eleventh century was an appanage held by Gleb, son of Vladimir the Great. In 1127 it became the senior seat of the Murom-Ryazan principality under Yaroslav Sviatoslavich, and after his death in 1129 his sons divided the land, with Ryazan eventually breaking away entirely after 1212. Murom remained a loyal ally of the grand princes of Vladimir on the exposed southeastern frontier, and was devastated in the Mongol invasion of 1237 to 1238 and again in Tatar raids of 1283 and 1293. It recovered briefly under Prince Yury Yaroslavich after 1345, but Moscow increasingly controlled its throne: in 1355 Ivan II secured a Horde patent for his own candidate, Fyodor Glebovich, and Murom troops fought under Dmitry of Moscow at the disastrous battle on the Pyana in 1377. In 1392 Vasily I obtained a patent from Khan Tokhtamysh that annexed Murom, together with Nizhny Novgorod and Gorodets, to the Grand Principality of Moscow.
zh: 穆罗姆公国位于奥卡河下游，起源于东斯拉夫世界最古老的城镇之一。穆罗姆本是9世纪穆罗马芬兰部落的贸易定居点，11世纪时成为弗拉基米尔大帝之子格列布的封邑。1127年它成为雅罗斯拉夫·斯维亚托斯拉维奇治下穆罗姆-梁赞公国的长支驻地；1129年雅罗斯拉夫死后诸子瓜分领地，梁赞最终在1212年后完全独立出去。穆罗姆留在暴露的东南边境上，始终是弗拉基米尔大公的忠实盟友，在1237至1238年蒙古入侵以及1283、1293年的鞑靼袭击中屡遭蹂躏。1345年后它在尤里·雅罗斯拉维奇治下短暂复兴，但莫斯科日益操控其公位：1355年伊凡二世借助金帐汗国的册封敕令扶持自己的候选人费奥多尔·格列博维奇上位，1377年穆罗姆军队又在德米特里麾下参加了惨败的皮亚纳河战役。1392年瓦西里一世从脱脱迷失汗处取得册封敕令，将穆罗姆连同下诺夫哥罗德和戈罗杰茨一并并入莫斯科大公国。

en: Moronene was the realm of the Moronene people, one of the four large indigenous peoples of Southeast Sulawesi alongside the Tolaki, Buton and Muna, and held to be the earliest inhabitants of the peninsula's eastern coast. Their language belongs to the Bungku-Tolaki branch of the Celebic group, and their historic lands covered the mainland area that is now Bombana Regency, together with the nearby island of Kabaena. Their rulers bore the title Mokole and governed from Taubonto, whose name in the Moronene language means the year of rotting, from a legend of a rice goddess whose visit brought such a huge harvest that the grain rotted in the fields; the country was remembered as the Land of the Rice Goddess. The Moronene kingdom is said to have covered nearly 3,400 square kilometres before it was defeated by the expanding Tolaki kingdom of Konawe in the 1700s, and the Mokole domains, including the autonomous rulers on Kabaena, subsequently came under the oversight of the Sultanate of Buton.
zh: 莫罗内内是莫罗内内人的政权。莫罗内内人与托拉基人、布敦人、穆纳人并称东南苏拉威西四大族群，被认为是该半岛东海岸最早的居民。他们的语言属西里伯斯语群的朋古—托拉基语支，历史疆域包括今朋巴纳县一带的大陆地区和邻近的卡巴那岛。统治者称“莫科莱”（Mokole），以陶邦托为中心；“陶邦托”在莫罗内内语中意为“腐烂之年”，源于稻神降临、稻米丰收到烂在田里的传说，这片土地也被传为“稻神女神之乡”。莫罗内内王国据说疆域近3400平方公里，但在1700年代（18世纪）被扩张中的托拉基人哥那威王国击败，包括卡巴那岛上自治首领在内的各莫科莱领地，此后都转归布敦苏丹国节制。

en: Kutai Martapura, also known to historians as Kutai Martadipura, was a Hindu kingdom on the upper Mahakam River in eastern Borneo, centred on Muara Kaman. It is the oldest known state in the Indonesian archipelago: seven stone sacrificial posts, or yupa, carved in Pallava script with Sanskrit verses, were found there and date to the late fourth or early fifth century. The inscriptions name the local chieftain Kudungga, his son Asvavarman, the first ruler to bear a Sanskrit name, and his grandson Mulavarman, who rewarded brahmins with thousands of cattle and gifts of gold and widened his realm through conquest and ritual. After this early dynasty the kingdom's story is only faintly recorded, though the Nagarakretagama of 1365 still mentions the region. In 1635, after seven days and nights of fighting, Kutai Kartanegara stormed Muara Kaman, killed King Dermasatia, and annexed the old kingdom.
zh: 古泰‑摩多补罗（史家又称古泰马尔塔迪普拉）是东婆罗洲马哈坎河上游的印度教王国，以穆阿拉卡曼为中心，是印度尼西亚群岛已知最早的国家。当地发现的七根牺牲柱（尤帕）刻有帕拉瓦文书写的梵文颂诗，年代可追溯到4世纪末或5世纪初。铭文提到三位统治者：本土首领库东加、他的儿子——第一个使用梵文名字的国王阿斯瓦瓦尔曼，以及孙子穆拉瓦尔曼；穆拉瓦尔曼以数以千计的牛和黄金布施婆罗门，并通过征战和仪式扩大了疆土。早期王朝之后，这个王国的历史记载稀少，1365年的《爪哇史颂》仍提到这一地区。1635年，经过七天七夜的激战，古泰‑卡塔内加拉攻陷穆阿拉卡曼，国王德尔马萨蒂亚战死，古国被吞并。

en: The County of Moers was a small territory on the left bank of the Lower Rhine, comprising the town of Moers and, as an exclave, Krefeld. A lord of Moers is first mentioned in 1160, and the family began as vassals of the archbishops of Cologne; Count Dietrich I is documented ruling from 1226, and his successor fought at the Battle of Worringen in 1288, afterwards accepting Cleves as feudal overlord. In 1337 the county was held by Count Dietrich of Moers. Its standing grew under the later counts: they won Rhine toll rights in 1371, a minting licence in 1373, and in 1399 Count Frederick III inherited the separate County of Saarwerden, while his younger son Dietrich of Moers became archbishop of Cologne in 1414. Charles the Bold of Burgundy overran Moers in 1473, and the comital line was eventually succeeded, through marriage disputes, by the houses of Wied, Saarwerden and Neuenahr. When the native dynasty died out in 1578 the county was contested between Orange-Nassau and Cleves, passing to the Orange princes in 1600 and, on their extinction in 1702, to Prussia, which raised it to a principality in 1705. Its separate legal existence ended with the French annexation of the left bank in 1797 and 1801, and in 1815 the Congress of Vienna assigned it to Prussia.
zh: 默尔斯伯国是下莱茵左岸的小领地，领有默尔斯城以及作为飞地的克雷费尔德。默尔斯领主最早见于1160年的记载，该家族起初是科隆大主教的封臣；伯爵狄奥多里克一世于1226年已有统治记录，其继任者参加了1288年的沃林根战役，战后承认克莱沃为封君。1337年在位的是默尔斯伯爵狄奥多里克。伯国的地位在后来几位伯爵治下上升：1371年取得莱茵河征税权，1373年取得铸币许可；1399年伯爵弗里德里希三世继承了不相连的萨尔韦登伯国，他的幼子狄奥多里克·冯·默尔斯于1414年当选科隆大主教。1473年勃艮第的大胆查理攻占默尔斯，伯爵家族后来因继承纠纷先后由维德、萨尔韦登和诺伊恩阿尔家族接续。1578年本土王朝绝嗣，奥兰治-拿骚与克莱沃争夺伯国；1600年它落入奥兰治亲王之手，1702年奥兰治家族绝嗣后转归普鲁士，1705年被升为侯国。随着1797至1801年法国吞并莱茵左岸，它的独立法统终结；1815年维也纳会议将其划归普鲁士。

en: The County of Mortain was a choice Norman fief in the south-west of the duchy, on the edge of the Cotentin, centred on the rocky hill town of Mortain above the River Cance and usually kept for the duke's own kin. Founded around 1027 for Robert, a likely illegitimate son of Duke Richard I, it was granted in about 1049 by Duke William to his half-brother Robert of Mortain, who after 1066 also became earl of Cornwall; that Robert's son William rebelled against Henry I and lost the county after his capture at Tinchebray in 1106. It then passed to Stephen of Blois, who held it until he took the English throne in 1135, was resumed by Henry II, and was given by Richard I to his brother John in 1189. With the French conquest of Normandy in 1204 the county came to the French crown, which granted it through the houses of Dammartin, Boulogne and even the Portuguese king Afonso III. From 1328 it belonged to Joan II of Navarre, daughter of Louis X, who ruled it together with her husband Philip of Évreux and held it in 1337 until her death in the Black Death of 1349. Mortain was disputed through the Hundred Years' War, claimed by English magnates including the duke of Bedford and Edmund Beaufort while French grants went to Peter of Évreux and Jean de Dunois; in 1449 it passed to Charles of Le Maine and in 1481 to the royal domain.
zh: 莫尔坦伯国是诺曼底公国西南端、科唐坦边缘的一块优渥封土，以康斯河畔山岩上的莫尔坦城为中心，通常只封给公爵的近亲。它约于1027年为理查一世公爵可能的私生子罗贝尔设立，1049年前后威廉公爵把它封给同母异父弟弟莫尔坦的罗贝尔，此人1066年后还受封康沃尔伯爵；其子威廉反叛亨利一世，1106年在坦什布赖被俘后失去伯国。它随后转入布卢瓦的斯蒂芬之手，斯蒂芬1135年登上英格兰王位前一直领有此地，伯国后被亨利二世收回，1189年理查一世又把它封给弟弟约翰。1204年法兰西征服诺曼底后，伯国归于法兰西王室，先后封给达马尔坦家族、布洛涅家族，乃至葡萄牙国王阿方索三世。1328年起，它属于路易十世之女纳瓦拉的胡安娜二世，她与丈夫埃夫勒的菲利普共同统治，1337年时正领有莫尔坦，直到1349年死于黑死病。百年战争中莫尔坦几经易手，贝德福德公爵、埃德蒙·博尚等英格兰重臣与埃夫勒的皮埃尔、让·德·迪努瓦等法兰西受封者争相主张权利；1449年它落入勒芒的查理之手，1481年并入王室领地。

en: Merv, the great oasis on the Murghab river in southeastern Khorasan, was one of the chief cities of the Silk Road, where the routes from Persia to Bukhara and from Herat to Khwarezm crossed. Settled since the third millennium BC, it became the Achaemenid satrapal centre of Margiana, then the Umayyad capital of Khorasan and, in the early ninth century, the seat of the caliph al-Ma'mun. Under the Great Seljuks it was an imperial capital and perhaps the largest city on earth, famed for its libraries and observatories, where Omar Khayyam once worked. In 1221 Tolui Khan's Mongols sacked it and, on contemporary reports, slaughtered some seven hundred thousand people; though rebuilt, it never recovered. It passed to the Il-Khanids and suffered repeated Chagatai raids, and in the early fourteenth century it was held by the Kartids of Herat, under whom it even hosted an Eastern Church archbishopric. By 1380 Merv belonged to Timur's empire. The Uzbeks took it in 1505 until Shah Ismail I expelled them five years later, and it changed hands between Khiva, Bukhara and the Safavids, who appointed Qajar governors from 1608. After Nader Shah's death it became an independent Qajar principality, until the Bukharan amir Shah Murad killed its ruler in 1785 and razed the city in 1788 and 1789, breaking its dams and deporting its people.
zh: 木鹿是呼罗珊东南部穆尔加布河畔的大绿洲，也是丝绸之路上的首要城市之一，波斯通往布哈拉、赫拉特通往花剌子模的商路在此交汇。这里自公元前3000年便有定居，后来成为阿契美尼德王朝马尔吉亚纳行省的中心，又做过倭马亚王朝呼罗珊省的首府，9世纪初还是哈里发马蒙的驻跸之地。塞尔柱帝国时期它是帝国都城，可能是当时世界上最大的城市，以藏书楼和天文台闻名，奥马尔·海亚姆曾在此工作。1221年拖雷麾下的蒙古人洗劫该城，据当时记载屠杀约七十万人；木鹿虽获重建，却再未恢复元气。它先归伊儿汗国，又屡遭察合台汗国劫掠，14世纪初由赫拉特的卡尔提德王朝占据，其间甚至设有东方教会的大主教区。到1380年，木鹿已并入帖木儿帝国。1505年乌兹别克人攻占该城，五年后被沙阿·伊斯玛仪一世赶走；此后它在希瓦、布哈拉和萨法维王朝之间几度易手，萨法维人自1608年起任命卡扎尔人为总督。纳迪尔沙阿死后，木鹿成为独立的卡扎尔公国，直到布哈拉埃米尔沙阿·穆拉德于1785年杀死其统治者，并在1788至1789年间夷平城市、掘毁水坝、迁走居民。

en: The Kingdom of Marwar was the Rathore Rajput state of western Rajputana, founded in 1243 at Pali by Rao Siha, a migrant leader whose clan traced its descent from the Gahadavala kings of Kannauj. For more than a century the Rathores remained a small embattled chiefdom around Pali and Khed, fighting neighbouring Bhatis, Guhilas and Muslim governors, and nine of the first fifteen rulers died in battle. Rao Chunda, who took power in 1384, received the fortress of Mandore as a dowry from its Pratihara lords in 1395, made it his capital and pushed his frontier to Nagaur and Ajmer. His grandson Rao Jodha recovered Mandore after years of exile and in 1459 built the hill fort of Mehrangarh, around which grew his new capital, Jodhpur; one of Jodha's sons, Bika, carved out the neighbouring kingdom of Bikaner. Under Maldeo Rathore, who reigned from 1532, Marwar became the strongest power in Rajputana, seizing Nagaur, Ajmer and Jalore while resisting both Sher Shah Suri and the Mughals. Akbar annexed the kingdom in 1581, though two years later Udai Singh was restored as a Mughal vassal. When Jaswant Singh died in 1678, Aurangzeb withheld the throne from his posthumous son Ajit Singh; the Rathore leader Durgadas waged a thirty-one-year struggle that restored Ajit Singh and freed Marwar. In 1818 Man Singh accepted a subsidiary alliance with the British East India Company, and Marwar, usually called Jodhpur State thereafter, continued as a princely state under British overlordship.
zh: 马尔瓦尔王国是拉杰普塔纳西部的拉托尔族拉杰普特政权，1243年由拉奥·西哈在巴利建立，拉托尔人自称源出卡瑙杰的加哈达瓦拉王朝诸王。此后一个多世纪里，拉托尔人只是据守巴利、凯德一带的弱小首领政权，与邻近的巴蒂人、古希拉人和穆斯林总督连年交战，最初的十五位君主中有九位战死沙场。1384年继位的拉奥·琼达于1395年通过联姻从波罗提诃罗领主手中得到曼多尔堡，将其定为都城，并把边界推进到纳高尔和阿杰梅尔。其孙拉奥·乔达在多年流亡后收复曼多尔，1459年兴建梅兰加尔堡，堡下发展出新都城焦特布尔；乔达之子比卡还在旁侧另建了比卡内尔王国。1532年即位的马尔德奥·拉托尔治下，马尔瓦尔成为拉杰普塔纳最强的势力，夺取纳高尔、阿杰梅尔和贾洛尔，同时抵御舍尔沙·苏利与莫卧儿人。阿克巴于1581年吞并王国，但两年后乌代·辛格以莫卧儿附庸身份复位。1678年贾斯万特·辛格去世，奥朗则布拒绝让其遗腹子阿吉特·辛格继位，拉托尔首领杜尔加达斯坚持斗争三十一年，最终迎回阿吉特·辛格，使马尔瓦尔摆脱莫卧儿控制。1818年，曼·辛格与英国东印度公司签订附属同盟条约，此后马尔瓦尔通常改称焦特布尔土邦，作为英国宗主权下的土邦延续下去。

en: Mosbach lies in the Odenwald at the meeting of the Neckar and the Elz, and grew up around a Benedictine abbey first recorded in the ninth century.
