In 1241 it was granted the rights of an imperial free city, but in 1362 it passed to the Electorate of the Palatinate, the bond the town kept for most of its later history. On the partition of the Palatine lands after King Rupert's death in 1410, Mosbach became the seat of the small principality of Palatinate-Mosbach under Count Palatine Otto I; Otto later added Palatinate-Neumarkt by inheritance and purchase, ruling the combined state as Palatinate-Mosbach-Neumarkt. When Otto II died without heirs in 1499 the principality was dissolved and the town reverted to the Electoral Palatinate as the centre of an administrative district. In the reorganization of Germany after 1806, Mosbach was assigned to the Grand Duchy of Baden.
zh: 莫斯巴赫地处奥登林山区、内卡河与埃尔茨河交汇处，围绕一座9世纪已有记载的本笃会修道院发展起来。1241年它获得帝国自由城市的权利，1362年并入普法尔茨选侯国，此后大部分时间都保持这一隶属关系。1410年国王鲁普雷希特去世后普法尔茨领地分家，莫斯巴赫成为小邦普法尔茨-莫斯巴赫的治所，统治者是行宫伯爵奥托一世；奥托后来又通过继承和购买取得普法尔茨-诺伊马克特，合并为普法尔茨-莫斯巴赫-诺伊马克特。1499年奥托二世无嗣而终，小邦被撤销，城市重归普法尔茨选侯国，成为一个行政区的中心。1806年德意志格局重组后，莫斯巴赫被划归巴登大公国。

en: Musuniri was the country of the Musunuri Nayakas, Telugu warrior chiefs who rose from the ruins of the Kakatiya kingdom after the Delhi Sultanate sacked Warangal in 1323. Its founder Prolaya Nayaka established himself around 1330 at Rekapalle near Bhadrachalam, claiming Kakatiya heritage, and his successor Kapaya Nayaka seized Warangal from the Delhi governor Malik Maqbul in 1336, bringing much of eastern Telangana under his rule and taking the Persianised title of Sultan of the Andhra country. Kapaya's long wars with the newly founded Bahmani Sultanate cost him forts including Golconda, and in 1361 he surrendered the turquoise throne of Warangal to Mohammed Shah I under a treaty. In 1368 the Recherla Nayakas killed him in battle at Bhimavaram and replaced him as the leading power of Telangana, ending Musunuri rule.
zh: 穆苏尼里是穆苏努里·纳亚卡人的国家，这群泰卢固武士首领崛起于1323年德里苏丹国攻陷瓦朗加尔、卡卡提亚王国覆灭之后。开国者普罗拉亚·纳亚卡约于1330年在巴德拉查兰附近的雷卡帕勒立足，自称继承卡卡提亚统绪；继任者卡帕亚·纳亚卡于1336年从德里总督马利克·马克布尔手中夺取瓦朗加尔，据有特伦甘纳东部大片土地，并采用波斯式头衔‘安得拉之苏丹’。卡帕亚与新兴的巴赫曼尼苏丹国连年交战，陆续丢掉戈尔孔达等要塞，1361年又依约把瓦朗加尔的绿松石王座献给穆罕默德沙一世。1368年，隶契罗·纳亚卡人在比姆瓦拉姆之战将他击杀，取代他成为特伦甘纳的首要强权，穆苏努里家族的统治就此终结。

en: The County of Mesocco was the Alpine lordship of the Sax-Misox line of the house of Sax, a family originally known as de Sacco, whose estates straddled the Alps from St. Gallen to Ticino. In 1168 the Hohenstaufen rewarded their support with a fief over the Misox valley, and around Mesocco Castle, first documented in 1219, the family built up rule over the whole Val Mesolcina and its string of castles. After a family partition in 1248 the southern lands became the separate Sax-Misox branch, which reached the height of its power in the fourteenth century, its influence crossing the San Bernardino Pass. Baron Albert von Sax-Misox was a founder of the Grey League in 1395, but his murder in 1406 began the family's decline. In 1480 Mesocco and Soazza joined the Grey League of their own will, and in the same year the last baron sold the castle and demesne to the Milanese general Giacomo Trivulzio; in 1526 the Three Leagues ordered the castle abandoned and moved the valley's administration to Roveredo.
zh: 梅索科伯国是萨克斯家族萨克斯‑米索克斯支系在阿尔卑斯山区的领地。该家族原名德·萨科，地产横跨阿尔卑斯山，从圣加仑一直延伸到提契诺。1168年，霍亨斯陶芬王朝为酬谢其支持，把米索克斯河谷封给他们；家族以1219年首次见于文献的梅索科城堡为中心，逐步统治了整个梅索尔奇纳河谷及河谷中的一连串城堡。1248年家族分家，南部领地成为独立的萨克斯‑米索克斯支系，并在14世纪达到权势顶峰，势力越过圣贝纳迪诺山口。男爵阿尔伯特·冯·萨克斯‑米索克斯是1395年灰联盟的创建者之一，但他在1406年遇刺，家族由此走向衰落。1480年，梅索科和索阿扎自愿加入灰联盟，同年末代男爵把城堡和领地卖给米兰将领贾科莫·特里武尔齐奥；1526年，三联盟下令废弃这座城堡，把河谷的行政中心迁到罗韦雷多。

en: The Malaspina are a noble house of Longobard origin, descended from the Obertenghi marquesses of Luni; Alberto Malaspina, who died in 1140, was the first to bear the name, which means bad thorn. Marquess Obizzo I first served Emperor Frederick Barbarossa and then turned against him at Legnano in 1176, fighting with the Lombard League, and the Peace of Constance confirmed his fiefs in Lunigiana and the Apennines. In 1221 the house split into the Spino Secco and Spino Fiorito branches, whose many heirs partitioned the lands into a network of small marquisates; Dante, whom the family sheltered during his exile, praised them in the Purgatory of the Divine Comedy. In 1337 the Spino Fiorito held castles across the Lunigiana, and Spinetta Malaspina, called the Great, acquired the feud of Fosdinovo in 1340; his kinsman Galeotto made its marquisate autonomous in 1367. The Fosdinovo line was recognized as hereditary imperial vicar in 1529 and won the right to strike its own coin in 1666. A kinsman, Antonio Alberico, gained Massa in 1441 and his son added Carrara, lands that passed through Ricciarda Malaspina's marriage to the Cybo-Malaspina dukes. The last sovereign marquis of Fosdinovo renounced his fiefs under the Napoleonic edict of 1797.
zh: 马拉斯皮纳是伦巴第人血统的贵族世家，出自卢尼的奥贝尔滕吉侯爵谱系；1140年去世的阿尔贝托·马拉斯皮纳是第一个使用该姓的人，姓氏意为“恶棘”。侯爵奥比佐一世先效力于皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨，1176年又在莱尼亚诺倒戈加入伦巴第同盟，《康斯坦茨和约》确认了他在卢尼贾纳和亚平宁山区的封地。1221年家族分裂为“枯棘”和“繁花棘”两支，众多继承人把领地分割成一张小侯国网络；但丁流亡时曾受这个家族庇护，并在《神曲·炼狱篇》中称赞他们。1337年繁花棘支在卢尼贾纳据有多座城堡，号称“大帝”的斯皮内塔·马拉斯皮纳于1340年取得福斯迪诺沃封地，他的亲属加莱奥托于1367年使该侯国获得自治。福斯迪诺沃一系在1529年被承认为世袭帝国代理人，1666年又取得铸币权。族人安东尼奥·阿尔贝里科于1441年获得马萨，其子又取得卡拉拉，这些领地经里恰尔达·马拉斯皮纳的婚姻传给奇博-马拉斯皮纳诸公爵。末代福斯迪诺沃主权侯爵在1797年拿破仑的敕令下放弃了封地。

en: Mstislavl is a hill town east of Smolensk, first recorded in the Hypatian Chronicle in 1156 and originally an appanage of the Principality of Smolensk; by 1180 it had become the seat of its own princes, the Mstislavsky line, who gave the small principality its name. In 1377 the townspeople submitted of their own accord to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, whose first local duke was Karigaila, a brother of Jogaila, and the Mstislavsky princes later entered Lithuanian and then Muscovite service. Within the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth the town became capital of the Mścisław Voivodeship, with its own sejmik and court, and received Magdeburg rights from King Władysław IV in 1634. Russian troops stormed and sacked it in 1654 during the war of 1654 to 1667, and Polish-Lithuanian forces under Stefan Czarniecki retook the ruined town in 1661. In 1772 the First Partition assigned Mstislavl to the Russian Empire.
zh: 姆斯季斯拉夫尔是斯摩棱斯克以东的山城，1156年在《伊帕季耶夫编年史》中首次出现，原是斯摩棱斯克公国的封邑，到1180年已成为姆斯季斯拉夫斯基家族王公的驻地，这个小公国也因该家族得名。1377年，城镇居民自愿归附立陶宛大公国，立陶宛派来的首任王公是雅盖沃的兄弟卡里盖拉，姆斯季斯拉夫斯基家族的王公后来先后效力于立陶宛和莫斯科。在波兰立陶宛联邦内，该城成为姆斯季斯拉夫尔省的省会，设有自己的地方议会和法庭，并于1634年获瓦迪斯瓦夫四世国王授予马格德堡权利。1654年至1667年战争期间，俄军于1654年攻破并洗劫了此城，1661年斯特凡·恰尔涅茨基率领的波兰立陶宛军队收复了这座废墟。1772年第一次瓜分中，姆斯季斯拉夫尔被划归俄罗斯帝国。

en: Macerata is a hill town of the Marche, standing between the Chienti and Potenza rivers. Its people were descended from the inhabitants of Helvia Recina, a Roman town destroyed in the barbarian invasions, who rebuilt on the neighboring heights; the new settlement was organized as a self-governing commune in August 1138. A university was founded there in 1290, making it one of the oldest seats of learning in Europe, and in 1320 Pope John XXII moved the bishop's see to Macerata, tying the town firmly to the Papal States and drawing in population and trade. In the sixteenth century it gained bastioned walls and civic buildings such as the Loggia dei Mercanti of 1504, while the Accademia dei Catenati, founded in 1574, made it a small center of humanist letters. When revolutionary French armies entered the Marche, Macerata joined the anti-French risings of 1799, and French troops stormed and looted the town in July of that year; it remained a provincial city of the restored Papal States thereafter.
zh: 马切拉塔是马尔凯的山城，坐落在基恩蒂河与波坦察河之间。它的居民是罗马城镇赫尔维亚·雷奇纳的遗民——旧城在蛮族入侵中被毁，人们在邻近高地上重建家园，新聚落在1138年8月组建为自治市镇。1290年当地创办大学，是欧洲最古老的学府之一；1320年教宗约翰二十二世把主教座堂迁至马切拉塔，使这座城市牢牢归入教皇国，也带来了人口与贸易。16世纪它修筑起棱堡城墙，并建起1504年的商人凉廊等公共建筑；1574年成立的卡滕纳蒂学院又使它成为一个小型人文主义学术中心。法国革命军进入马尔凯后，马切拉塔参加了1799年的抗法起义，法军于当年7月攻破并劫掠了这座城市，此后它仍是复辟教皇国治下的一座省城。

en: The County of Montbéliard, known in German as Mömpelgard, was an immediate county of the Holy Roman Empire seated at Montbéliard in the Jura foothills, in present-day Franche-Comté. Emperor Henry III created it in 1042 out of the County of Burgundy, and the lords of Montfaucon acquired it by marriage in 1162. In 1282 Count Theodoric III made his great-granddaughter Guillemette of Neufchâtel and her husband Reginald of Burgundy, of the House of Chalon, his heirs. In 1337 the count was Othenin, called the Mad, who was mentally incapable and lived secluded under the guardianship of his uncle Hugh of Chalon. When Othenin died childless in 1338, Emperor Louis IV invested Henry I of Montfaucon, husband of Othenin's sister Agnes, with the county; Henry faced a civic revolt at Montbéliard in 1340. The last Montfaucon male, Henry II, fell fighting the Ottomans at Nicopolis in 1396, and in 1407 the heiress Henriette married Eberhard IV of Württemberg. From 1444 Montbéliard belonged to the House of Württemberg, which raised it to a princely county in 1495 and ruled it through junior branches, with a separate line ruling from 1617 until 1723. French troops occupied it in 1793 during the Revolutionary Wars, and Württemberg renounced its rights in 1796.
zh: 蒙贝利亚尔伯国（德语称默姆佩尔加德）是神圣罗马帝国的直属伯国，治所在今法国弗朗什-孔泰境内、汝拉山麓的蒙贝利亚尔。1042年，皇帝亨利三世从勃艮第伯国划出土地建立该伯国，1162年蒙福孔家族通过联姻取得统治权。1282年，伯爵狄奥多里克三世立曾孙女讷夫沙泰勒的吉耶梅特与其夫、沙隆家族的勃艮第的雷诺为继承人。1337年在位的是绰号“疯子”的奥瑟南，他因精神疾病无法理政，在叔父沙隆的于格监护下深居简出。1338年奥瑟南无嗣而终，皇帝路易四世将伯国封给娶了其妹阿涅丝的蒙福孔的亨利一世；1340年亨利曾面对蒙贝利亚尔市民的叛乱。蒙福孔家族最后一位男嗣亨利二世于1396年在尼科波利斯对奥斯曼人的战役中阵亡，1407年女继承人亨利埃特嫁给符腾堡的埃伯哈德四世。1444年起蒙贝利亚尔归属符腾堡家族，1495年升为诸侯伯国，由其支系统治，1617年至1723年间更由独立的支系掌权。大革命战争中的1793年，法军占领蒙贝利亚尔，符腾堡于1796年放弃其权利。

en: Möng Ting, the Mengding of Chinese records, was a small Tai chiefdom on the Nam Ting River in the southwestern Yunnan hills, where modern Mengding in Gengma County looks across into the Shan highland around Hsenwi. Its Golden Teeth chiefs submitted to the Yuan in 1287 with twenty-five thousand people, and the court created Mengding Circuit in 1289, raising it in 1294 to a military-civilian administration under the chief Aru, who was granted a tiger tally. In 1348 the circuit was swallowed by the rising Shan power of Möng Mao, whose ruler Si Lunfa posted his officer Han Nuan to govern it, and Tai families from Möng Mao settled in the valley. Ming armies reorganized it as the Mengding native prefecture in 1382 under hereditary Dao chieftains. During the Luchuan campaigns of the 1430s and 1440s the chief fled in the fighting, and the Ming commander Wang Ji enfeoffed Han Ge, a Hsenwi officer who had served with merit, with Mengding, after which the ruling house bore the surname Han. In the late Ming it once acknowledged Burmese overlordship, and the Qing confirmed the same hereditary line.
zh: 勐汀即汉文史料中的孟定，是滇西南山区南汀河畔的一个傣族小邦，其地在今耿马傣族佤族自治县孟定镇，与兴威一带的掸邦高原相望。1287年，金齿地区的孟定甸官俺嫂等率两万五千人归附元朝；元廷于1289年设立孟定路，1294年又升为孟定路军民总管府，任命归附官阿鲁为总管、佩虎符。1348年，孟定路被崛起的麓川吞并，思伦发派召鲁汉媛治理孟定，勐卯的傣族也随之迁入谷地。1382年明军平定云南，将其改置为孟定御夷府，由刀姓土司世袭。15世纪30至40年代麓川之役中，孟定土司因战乱逃走，明将王骥把孟定封给从征有功的木邦土目罕葛，统治家族自此改为罕姓。明末它曾一度臣服缅甸，清朝又延续旧制，承认该家族的世袭地位。

en: Maintirano is a Sakalava coastal settlement in the Melaky region of western Madagascar. In the 1300s this shore lay within the Indian Ocean trading network of the Muslim Swahili Antalaotra, whose dhows linked the island's western ports with the Comoros and the East African coast.
zh: 迈因蒂拉努是马达加斯加西部梅拉基地区的萨卡拉瓦人沿海聚落。1300年代，这一带海岸处于穆斯林斯瓦希里族群安塔拉特拉人的印度洋贸易网络之内，他们的独桅帆船把岛西港口同科摩罗和东非海岸相连。

en: Mataranga was the coastal principality of an Albanian noble family holding the plain between Durrës and Vlorë, around the lagoons of Karavasta and the later town of Kavajë. The Matranga were initially vassals of the Angevin kings of Albania, passed briefly under Byzantine rule when the empire retook the region between 1284 and 1288, and accepted Angevin overlordship again in 1304 after Philip of Taranto recovered Durrës. A Ragusan document of 1297 already records them clashing with Ragusan merchants near Karavasta, and in 1319 Paul Mataranga joined Philip of Taranto's coalition of Albanian lords against the Serbian king Stefan Milutin. The Serbian advance nonetheless absorbed their territory before 1343. After Stefan Dušan's empire collapsed, Blasius Mataranga revived the principality between the Shkumbin and Seman rivers from 1358 to 1367 with the rank of sebastokrator, his grain lands closely watched by the merchants of Dubrovnik. Kinsmen meanwhile served in Constantinople, where Nicholas Matarangos sat among the empire's four supreme judges during the civil war of 1341 to 1347. After the Ottoman conquest many Matranga emigrated to the Arbëresh settlements of southern Italy, while those who remained saw their name altered to Matranxhi.
zh: 马特兰加是一个阿尔巴尼亚贵族家族的滨海小邦，领有都拉斯与发罗拉之间的平原，包括卡拉瓦斯塔潟湖一带和后来的卡瓦亚地区。马特兰加家族最初是安茹阿尔巴尼亚诸王的附庸，1284至1288年拜占庭收复该地区时一度臣属君士坦丁堡，1304年塔兰托的腓力夺回都拉斯后又重新接受安茹宗主权。1297年的一份拉古萨文书已记载他们在卡拉瓦斯塔附近与拉古萨商人发生冲突；1319年，保罗·马特兰加加入塔兰托的腓力组织的阿尔巴尼亚领主联盟，对抗塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·米卢丁。然而塞尔维亚的推进仍在1343年前吞并了他们的领地。斯特凡·杜尚的帝国崩溃后，布拉西乌斯·马特兰加于1358至1367年复兴了什昆宾河与塞曼河之间的小邦，自称至尊者；他盛产粮食的土地一直受到杜布罗夫尼克商人的密切关注。与此同时，家族也有人在君士坦丁堡任职，尼古拉斯·马特兰戈在1341至1347年内战期间位列帝国四大最高法官之一。奥斯曼征服后，许多马特兰加家族成员移居意大利南部的阿尔伯雷什人聚居区，留下的人则把姓氏改成了马特兰吉。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Metz was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire, distinct from the diocese of Metz and from the city of Metz itself, which became a free imperial city in 1189. After the Treaty of Meerssen of 870 the bishops held large lands in former Lotharingia and fought the dukes of Lorraine for their independence, absorbing the lands of the old counts of Metz. Civic unrest in 1234 drove the bishops from their capital to a residence at Vic-sur-Seille. In 1337 the ruler was Aymar Adhémar de Monteil de La Garde, a nobleman from the Dauphiné who had been bishop since 1327. He clashed with Duke Raoul of Lorraine, fought beside King Philip VI of France at Crécy in 1346, invaded the Barrois and burned the fortress of Château-Salins, though his wars forced him to mortgage towns such as Sarrebourg. Emperor Charles IV confirmed the bishopric's imperial immediacy in 1357. From 1484 the see was held by princes of the House of Lorraine, whose ties to France opened the way to annexation. Under the Treaty of Chambord of 1552, King Henry II of France occupied Metz together with Toul and Verdun, the so-called Three Bishoprics; the Empire recognized the loss only in the Peace of Westphalia of 1648.
zh: 梅斯采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国的一个教会邦国，其疆域既不同于梅斯教区，也不同于1189年成为帝国自由城市的梅斯城本身。870年《梅尔森条约》后，主教们在旧洛塔林吉亚境内拥有大片领地，并为争取独立而与洛林公爵争斗，逐步吞并了旧梅斯伯爵的土地。1234年的市民骚乱迫使主教离开首府，迁居维克-苏塞耶。1337年在位的是艾马尔·阿代马尔·德蒙泰伊·德拉加尔格，他出身多菲内的贵族家庭，自1327年起担任主教。他与洛林公爵拉乌尔冲突不断，1346年随法国国王腓力六世征战克雷西，还入侵巴鲁瓦并焚毁沙托萨兰要塞；不过连年战事迫使他抵押萨尔堡等城镇。1357年，皇帝查理四世确认了主教区的帝国直辖地位。1484年起，主教之位由洛林家族的王公把持，他们与法国的联系为兼并打开了大门。根据1552年的《尚博尔条约》，法国国王亨利二世出兵占领梅斯以及图勒、凡尔登，即所谓三主教区；帝国直到1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》才承认这一损失。

en: Muang Sua was the Lao principality on the upper Mekong whose city later became known as Luang Prabang. In 698 the Tai prince Khun Lo, son of the legendary Khun Borom, took the town and founded a dynasty that ruled it for most of the next century; Nanzhao occupied it from 709, and after the Nanzhao withdrawal the ruler Chanthaphanit made the place known by the Tai name Xieng Dong Xieng Thong. It later became the kingdom of Sri Sattanak, where Mahayana Buddhism overshadowed the older Theravada tradition, and briefly accepted Khmer suzerainty under Jayavarman VII from 1185 to 1191. After the Mongols destroyed Dali in 1253, the middle Mekong fell under their influence: in 1271 Panya Lang founded a new dynasty of panya rulers, and his son Panya Khamphong, the ruler in 1337, seized power with Mongol backing in 1286 and took the throne on his father's death in 1316. Ramkhamhaeng of Sukhothai also won the principality's allegiance, and Muang Phuan became its vassal by 1312. Dynastic feuds then sent the young prince Fa Ngum into exile at Angkor; he returned in 1349 with a ten-thousand-strong Khmer army, reunited the Lao principalities in a six-year campaign, and in June 1354 was crowned at Vientiane as king of Lan Xang, with Muang Sua as its royal capital.
zh: 孟挝是湄公河上游的佬人政权，其城邑即后来的琅勃拉邦。698年，传说人物坤博隆之子、泰人王子坤洛夺取该城，建立王朝，在此后近一个世纪里世代统治；709年南诏进占，南诏势力撤走后，统治者占塔帕尼将此地改以泰名香通香东相称。它后来成为斯里沙达纳王国，汉传佛教的影响盖过了更早的上座部传统，并在1185年至1191年间短暂臣服于阇耶跋摩七世治下的高棉。1253年蒙古灭大理后，湄公河中游落入其影响：1271年披耶朗开创披耶王朝，1337年在位的披耶坎蓬于1286年在蒙古支持下发动政变，又在1316年父王死后正式继位。素可泰的兰甘亨也赢得了孟挝的归附，孟潘到1312年已成为它的附庸。随后的王族内讧使年轻王子法昂流亡吴哥；1349年他率一万高棉大军返乡，经过六年征战统一佬人诸邦，1354年6月在万象加冕为澜沧国王，孟挝则成为澜沧的王都。

en: The Muhiya are the Jurchen group of the Suifen river estuary, whose main settlement was Yongmingcheng on the site of present-day Vladivostok. The coast had belonged to the Balhae kingdom's Shuaibin circuit and then to the Liao and Jin, under which it formed the Xupin circuit, and in the early thirteenth century several cities of the Jurchen Eastern Xia stood here. The Mongols overran the region in 1233, destroyed its cities, and under the Yuan the surviving town was called Yongmingcheng. The Ming placed the area under the Nurgan commission, setting up the Muyanghe guard, and the eunuch Yishiha visited it on his far-eastern expeditions. In 1635 Later Jin forces under Wu Bahai campaigned through the southern coast and subjugated its remaining Wild Jurchen communities.
zh: 穆希亚是绥芬河口一带的女真群体，其主要聚落永明城就在今海参崴所在地。这片海岸先后隶属渤海国率宾府、辽朝率宾府和金朝恤品路，13世纪初，女真东夏国的数座城池都建在这里。1233年蒙古军队攻占该地，摧毁全部城市，元代残存的城称永明城，地区从此衰败、人口锐减。明朝将其纳入奴儿干都指挥使司，设立木阳河卫，宦官亦失哈远航奴儿干时曾到过此地。1635年，吴巴海率领后金军横扫滨海地区南部，征服了当地残存的野人女真部落。

en: Maui is one of the four principal Hawaiian Islands, and its high chief, the ali'i nui, also ruled the smaller island of Lanai. The first recorded ruler was Paumakua, but for many generations his successors controlled only the larger western half of Maui while the chiefs of Hana kept the east independent. The island's weakness was exposed early in the fourteenth century when Kalaunuiohua of Hawai'i invaded and carried off its chief Kamaluohua as a captive. Unity came only around the turn of the sixteenth century under Pi'ilani, the first chief to rule the whole island; his long reign was peaceful, and he began a paved highway encircling Maui, wide enough for eight men to walk abreast, which his son Kiha-a-Pi'ilani completed. In 1783 the high chief Kahekili II conquered O'ahu and built a cross-island empire, but a succession war between his son Kalanikupule and his brother Kaeokulani tore Maui apart, and in 1795 the island fell to Kamehameha and became part of the Kingdom of Hawai'i.
zh: 毛伊是夏威夷四大主岛之一，其最高酋长（阿里伊努伊）还统治着较小的拉奈岛。有记载的第一代统治者是保马库阿，但此后许多代继承人只能控制毛伊较大的西半部，东部的哈纳酋长始终保持独立。14世纪初，夏威夷岛的卡劳努伊奥华入侵毛伊，俘走其酋长卡马卢奥华，暴露出该岛的虚弱。直到16世纪前后，皮伊拉尼才成为统治全岛的第一位酋长；他在位长久而大体太平，并动工修建一条环绕毛伊的铺路大道，宽可容八人并行，后由其子基哈·皮伊拉尼完工。1783年，最高酋长卡赫基利二世征服瓦胡，建立跨岛霸业；但他的儿子卡拉尼库普莱与弟弟卡埃奥库拉尼之间的继承战争撕裂了毛伊，1795年该岛落入卡美哈梅哈之手，成为夏威夷王国的一部分。

en: Mulhouse, first recorded in 803 as Mulinhuson, was a town of the Sundgau in southern Alsace whose seal already bore a mill wheel by the 1260s. It became a free imperial city in 1275 and joined the Alsatian Decapole of ten imperial cities when the league was formed in 1354. In 1512 the city received a Julius banner from Pope Julius II for its part in the papal campaign in Lombardy, and in 1515 it left the Decapole to become an associate of the Swiss Confederation, a tie that spared it the French annexation of the rest of Alsace in 1648. Mulhouse adopted the Reformation in 1529 after the Zwinglian model and remained the only Reformed city in an increasingly Lutheran Alsace, governing itself as the city republic of Mülhausen. A customs blockade and revolutionary unrest ended its independence: on 28 January 1798 its citizens voted to join the French Republic, and the Treaty of Mulhouse sealed the union.
zh: 米卢斯最早于803年以“穆林胡松”之名见于记载，本是南阿尔萨斯孙戈地区的城镇，到13世纪60年代，其城印上已刻有磨坊水轮。它于1275年成为自由帝国城市，1354年加入由十座帝国城市组成的阿尔萨斯十城联盟。1512年，因参与教皇在伦巴第的战事，教皇尤利乌斯二世授予它一面尤利乌斯旗；1515年，它退出十城联盟，转而成为瑞士邦联的结盟城市，这层关系使它在1648年阿尔萨斯其余地区被法国吞并时幸免于难。1529年，米卢斯按茨温利的模式推行宗教改革，成为日益路德宗化的阿尔萨斯境内唯一的归正宗城市，以米尔豪森城市共和国之名自治。关税封锁和革命动荡终结了它的独立：1798年1月28日，市民投票加入法兰西共和国，《米卢斯条约》确认了这次合并。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Münster was one of the largest ecclesiastical states of the Holy Roman Empire, stretching across the Münsterland from the lower Rhine to the upper Ems. Charlemagne founded the diocese around 795 as a suffragan of Cologne, entrusting it to the Frisian missionary Ludger, whose monastery, the monasterium, gave the city its name. The bishops were recognized as princes of the Empire in 1220 and enlarged their territory by buying the Countship of Vechta in 1252 and later adding Cloppenburg and Ahaus. In 1337 the see was held by Louis II of Hesse, whose lands reached as far north as Meppen and Aschendorf. Lutheran ideas spread rapidly after 1524, and in 1534 radical Anabaptists seized the city and set up a communal regime until the bishop's troops stormed it in June 1535. The Counter-Reformation was enforced from 1585 by Ernest of Bavaria with the help of the Jesuits, and in 1648 the Spanish-Dutch treaty ending the Thirty Years' War was signed in Münster. Bishop Christoph Bernhard von Galen later subdued the restive city after a long siege and fought both Sweden and the Dutch Republic. Secularized in 1803, the bishopric was partitioned, and in 1815 the south went to Prussia while most of the north passed to Hanover and Oldenburg.
zh: 明斯特采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国最大的教会邦国之一，疆域横跨明斯特兰，从下莱茵一直延伸到埃姆斯河上游。查理曼约于795年设立该主教区，隶属科隆教省，交给弗里斯兰传教士卢德格尔主持，他建立的修道院（monasterium）后来成为城市名称的由来。1220年主教被承认为帝国诸侯，1252年购入费希塔伯国，后来又取得克洛彭堡和阿豪斯，领地不断扩大。1337年在任的是黑森的路易二世，其领地北抵梅彭和阿申多夫。1524年后路德宗思想迅速传播，1534年激进的再洗礼派夺取城市，建立公社式政权，直到1535年6月主教军队破城。1585年起，巴伐利亚的恩斯特在耶稣会协助下强力推行反宗教改革；1648年结束三十年战争的西班牙与荷兰和约在明斯特签署。后来主教克里斯托夫·伯恩哈德·冯·加伦经长期围攻降服了桀骜的城市，并先后对瑞典和荷兰共和国开战。1803年主教区被世俗化并瓜分，1815年南部归普鲁士，北部大部分划归汉诺威和奥尔登堡。

en: Murbach was a Benedictine princely abbey in a southern Alsatian valley at the foot of the Vosges, founded in 727 by Count Eberhard of Alsace and organised under the Benedictine Rule by Saint Pirmin. Richly endowed and exempt from all but pope and emperor, it drew Charlemagne himself to take the secular title of abbot in 792, and by about 850 its library of some three hundred and forty works made it an intellectual centre of the Upper Rhine; centuries later Poggio Bracciolini found Lucretius's De rerum natura there in 1417 and Beatus Rhenanus unearthed Velleius Paterculus in 1515. Its estates reached about three hundred and fifty localities and included Lucerne, whose sale with the Unterwalden lands to King Rudolf I in 1291 helped provoke the founding of the Swiss Confederation. Under Abbot Hugh of Rothenburg the abbey won imperial immediacy in 1228, becoming a prince-abbacy whose territorial politics in 1337 still pitted it against the bishops of Basel and the counts of Habsburg. Its influence waned from the fourteenth century, though it kept princely status; the Peace of Westphalia in 1648 reserved it to the Empire, but Louis XIV's Chambers of Reunion brought it under French control in 1680. Around 1759 the canons moved to Guebwiller and turned the house into a noble chapter, and in 1789 peasants looted the old abbey and the Revolution dissolved it.
zh: 米尔巴克是上阿尔萨斯孚日山脚下一处山谷里的本笃会亲王修道院，727年由阿尔萨斯伯爵埃伯哈德创建，圣皮尔明按本笃会会规加以整顿。它受封丰厚，除教皇和皇帝外不受任何人管辖，连查理曼都在792年以世俗身份兼任其修道院长；约850年时，它藏有约三百四十部著作的图书馆使它成为上莱茵的知识中心——许多世纪后，波焦·布拉乔利尼于1417年在此找到卢克莱修的《物性论》，贝阿图斯·雷纳努斯又于1515年发掘出维莱伊乌斯·帕特尔库鲁斯的著作。它的产业遍及约三百五十个地方，还包括卢塞恩；1291年修道院把卢塞恩和翁特瓦尔登的地产卖给国王鲁道夫一世，此事直接推动了瑞士邦联的诞生。在罗滕堡的于格院长任内，修道院于1228年获得帝国直辖地位，成为亲王修道院，1337年时它的领地经营仍在与巴塞尔主教和哈布斯堡伯爵角力。14世纪起其影响渐衰，但保住了亲王地位；1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》把它保留给帝国，路易十四的合并署却在1680年使它落入法国实际控制。约1759年，修士们迁往盖布维莱尔，把修道院改组成贵族骑士参事会；1789年农民洗劫了老修道院，法国大革命随即将其解散。

en: The Mus were a Kurdish tribal polity seated at Muş, chief town of the Taron region in the Armenian Highlands. After the Seljuk conquest of 1071 the district passed through Ayyubid, Ilkhanid and Kara Koyunlu rule, and the small Kurdish emirates of the area held their lands as vassals of the Principality of Bitlis.
zh: 穆什是一个以穆什城为中心的库尔德部落政权，穆什是亚美尼亚高地塔隆地区的首要城镇。1071年塞尔柱人征服之后，这一地区历经阿尤布王朝、伊儿汗国和黑羊王朝统治，当地的小型库尔德埃米尔国则以比特利斯公国附庸的身份保有领地。

en: The Mutayr are a large Sunni Bedouin tribe of central Arabia, counted among the so-called noble Arab tribes and traditionally living as camel-herding nomads. Their original homeland was the highland country of the northern Hejaz between the holy cities of Mecca and Medina. During the 1600s they began a great eastward migration into the Najd, pushing older Bedouin tribes such as the Harb and the Anazzah before them, and through the 1700s they fought a long series of wars with the Anazzah over the pasturelands of central Arabia, eventually forcing that confederation north toward the Syrian desert. They also developed a lasting rivalry with the Utaybah, who were moving into the same country from the Hejaz. In time the Mutayr became the dominant nomadic tribe of al-Qasem, the disputed northern gateway of the Najd, while their tribal lands stretched from the Hejaz across central Arabia to Kuwait and southern Iraq, where their branches remained a conspicuous Sunni Arab presence in the desert fringes of a mostly Shia region.
zh: 穆塔伊尔是阿拉伯半岛中部的大型逊尼派贝都因部落，被视为阿拉伯贵胄部落之一，传统上以游牧养驼为生。其祖居地是汉志北部、麦加与麦地那两圣城之间的高地。17世纪，他们开始大规模向东迁入内志，把哈尔卜、阿纳扎等老牌贝都因部落逼向北迁；整个18世纪，穆塔伊尔又为争夺阿拉伯中部的牧场与阿纳扎连番交战，最终迫使这一联盟向叙利亚沙漠方向北撤。他们与同样从汉志迁入这一地区的乌泰巴也结下长期对抗。此后穆塔伊尔成为盖西姆地区占主导地位的游牧部落，而盖西姆正是内志北方的争夺要冲；其部落领地从汉志横跨阿拉伯中部，一直延伸到科威特和伊拉克南部，其支系在伊拉克南部的沙漠边缘形成引人注目的逊尼派阿拉伯人聚落。

en: Moravia, the land east of Bohemia around the upper March river, was the heartland of the ninth-century Great Moravian realm before the Hungarian conquest of 907. King Otto I of Germany granted it to the Bohemian dukes after the Battle of Lechfeld in 955, and although the Polish king Bolesław the Brave held it from 999 to 1019, it returned to the Přemyslid dynasty and was tied to the Bohemian crown. In 1182 Emperor Frederick Barbarossa merged the appanage principalities of Brno, Olomouc and Znojmo into the Margraviate of Moravia. In 1337 its margrave was young Charles of Luxembourg, son of King John of Bohemia and the future Emperor Charles IV, who ruled the province from Olomouc as a Bohemian fief. Later the margraviate gave the empire an antiking when Margrave Jobst was elected King of the Romans in 1410. Moravia suffered heavily in the Hussite wars, was occupied by the Hungarian king Matthias Corvinus in 1469 and pawned to him by the Peace of Olomouc in 1479, and passed with Bohemia to the Habsburgs in 1526. Ottoman and Tatar raids harried it until the early eighteenth century, the capital moved from Olomouc to Brno in 1641 during the Thirty Years' War, and in 1804 Moravia became a crown land of the Austrian Empire.
zh: 摩拉维亚位于波希米亚以东、摩拉瓦河上游一带，9世纪时曾是大摩拉维亚国的核心，907年被匈牙利人征服。955年莱希费尔德战役后，德意志国王奥托一世把它封给波希米亚公爵；波兰国王“勇敢者”博莱斯瓦夫虽曾在999—1019年间占有此地，它最终还是回到普热米斯尔王朝手中，与波希米亚王冠绑定。1182年，皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨把布尔诺、奥洛莫乌茨和兹诺伊莫三个支系藩国合并为摩拉维亚藩侯国。1337年的藩侯是年轻的卢森堡的查理，即波希米亚国王约翰之子、后来的皇帝查理四世，他以波希米亚封臣的身份驻在奥洛莫乌茨统治此地。此后，藩侯约布斯特于1410年当选罗马人的国王，使这个藩侯国一度与帝位近在咫尺。摩拉维亚在胡斯战争中惨遭兵燹，1469年被匈牙利国王马加什·科尔温占领，1479年的《奥洛莫乌茨和约》又把它的统治权抵押给匈牙利，1526年随波希米亚一同转入哈布斯堡家族。奥斯曼与鞑靼人的袭扰一直持续到18世纪初，1641年三十年战争期间首府从奥洛莫乌茨迁往布尔诺，1804年摩拉维亚成为奥地利帝国的王冠领地。

en: Möng Wo was a Tai Lü polity of the Weiyuan River valley in southern Yunnan, the basin that is now Jinggu. Under the Dali kingdom the area belonged to the Weichu commandery, and after its rulers submitted to the Mongols in 1262, the Yuan established Weiyuan Prefecture in 1275 together with neighbouring Kainan. The Ming kept it as a native prefecture under hereditary Tai chieftains of the Dao family. In 1724 the Qing court, charging the chieftain Dao Guanghuan with harbouring rebels, exiled his family to Jiangxi, abolished the native prefecture and replaced it with the Weiyuan Subprefecture under Pu'er, one of the gaitu guiliu reforms that brought the Tai valleys of Yunnan under direct official rule.
zh: 勐沃是滇南威远江流域的傣仂人政权，其地即今天的景谷坝子。大理国时这里属威楚郡，1262年当地统治者归降蒙古，元朝于1275年与相邻的开南州一并设立威远州，隶属威楚路。明代仍以刀姓傣族土司世袭治理。1724年，清廷以土司刀光焕藏匿罪人为由，将其全家流放江西，裁撤威远土州，改设隶属普洱府的威远厅，这是改土归流的一环，滇南傣族坝子由此逐渐纳入流官直接管辖。

en: Mexticacán, whose Nahuatl name means place of the temple of moon worship, was a small cacicazgo in the Los Altos highlands of what is now Jalisco. Its first settlers were Tecuexe farmers who built their villages beneath mountain strongholds against Chichimeca raiders and fired earthenware by night, earning the name men who work in the moonlight; from the seventh century onward Caxcan migrants entering the region fought them for more than a hundred years. The chiefdom outlasted these wars only to fall in the Nueva Galicia conquest, when Cristóbal de Oñate, a captain of Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán, took the town on Christmas Day 1531.
zh: 梅什蒂卡坎在纳瓦特尔语中意为拜月神殿之地，是今哈利斯科州阿尔托斯高地的一个小酋长国。最早的居民是特奎谢农人，他们把村落建在山下的要塞附近，抵御奇奇梅克人的袭扰，并在夜间烧制陶器，因而被称为月光下劳作的人；从7世纪起，迁入该地区的卡克斯坎移民与他们交战了一百多年。这个酋邦熬过了这些战争，却在新加利西亚征服中覆灭：1531年圣诞节，努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼麾下的将领克里斯托瓦尔·德·奥尼亚特攻占了该镇。

en: Möng Yang, also called Mohnyin, was a Shan state centered on the modern town of Mohnyin in present-day Kachin State. It first appears in Chinese records in 1295 as Yunyuan, when the Yuan dynasty set up a tribal command there, and it long formed part of the neighbouring power of Möng Mao before winning independence in 1399. The Ming dynasty recognized it first as a prefecture and then, in 1404, as a pacification commission, while from 1406 the Burmese kingdom of Ava also claimed overlordship and posted its own prince to rule it. From the 1470s Möng Yang grew into the most aggressive of the Shan states, raiding Ava, Bhamo and Kale, and in 1527 its ruler Sawlon conquered Ava itself and placed his son Thohanbwa on its throne. Sawlon was murdered by his own ministers in 1532, and the loose confederation of Shan states that followed him could not withstand the rising Toungoo dynasty: Bayinnaung took Ava in 1555 and overran Möng Yang in 1557. Thereafter the state kept its native sawbwa dynasty under Burmese suzerainty until, under King Alaungpaya or by the end of the eighteenth century, it was placed under centrally appointed Burmese governors.
zh: 孟养又称莫宁，是一个掸人邦国，以今克钦邦的莫宁城为中心。中国史籍中它最早以“云远”之名出现于1295年，元朝在当地设立土司，此后长期隶属邻近的麓川势力，直到1399年才脱离独立。明朝先将其划为府，又于1404年改设宣慰司；与此同时，缅甸的阿瓦王国自1406年起也宣称对它的宗主权，并派自己的王子前往治理。15世纪70年代起，孟养成为各掸邦中最具扩张性的一个，不断袭扰阿瓦、八莫和格礼，1527年其首领思伦更攻灭阿瓦，把儿子多汉发扶上阿瓦王位。思伦于1532年被自己的大臣所杀，此后松散的掸邦联盟抵挡不住崛起的东吁王朝：勃印曩于1555年攻取阿瓦，1557年荡平孟养。此后该邦在缅甸宗主权下保留本土诏法王朝，直到雍籍牙王在位时或18世纪末，改由缅甸中央任命的官员治理。

en: Ma-i was a medieval trading polity of the Philippines, the first of the archipelago's states to appear in foreign records, named in the Song History as early as 971 and described in the Zhu Fan Zhi of 1225; scholars locate it either on Mindoro, whose old name was Mait, or at Bay on Laguna de Bay in the Tagalog lowlands. Its people lived in large villages of over a thousand households on the two banks of a stream, and Chinese merchants bartered porcelain, iron pots, lead and glass beads for kapok cotton, beeswax, tortoiseshell, betel nuts and patterned cloth, dealing honestly through an official plaza where rulers expected gifts of white parasols. The Daoyi Zhilue of 1349 praised its fertile fields and recorded metal religious images in the wilds, hints of Buddhist influence. Ma-i never sent tribute to China, living by trade alone, and in the fourteenth century the Nanhai zhi reports Brunei invading and briefly administering it; Chinese records fall silent after 1349, though Mindoro was later raided by Brunei in 1498 and conquered by the Spanish under Legazpi in 1570 and 1571.
zh: 麻逸是菲律宾中世纪的贸易政权，也是第一个见于外国记载的菲律宾古国：早在971年《宋史》中已有其名，1225年的《诸蕃志》更有详细描述；学者对其位置有两说，或在民都洛岛（古名迈特），或在他加禄低地内湖湾畔的巴伊。当地居民在溪流两岸聚居成上千户的大村落，中国商人以瓷器、铁锅、铅和彩色玻璃珠交换木棉、蜂蜡、龟甲、槟榔和花布，交易在官方广场进行，君主以接受白伞为礼，而麻逸商人守信履约。1349年的《岛夷志略》称赞其田地肥沃，并记载荒野中有金属神像，暗示佛教影响。麻逸从未向中国朝贡，专靠贸易立国；14世纪的《南海志》记载汶莱曾入侵并短暂统治该地。1349年以后中国史籍不再提及麻逸，民都洛后来又在1498年遭汶莱袭击，并于1570至1571年被莱加斯皮率领的西班牙人征服。

en: The Mayonmarka were a highland people of the Ayacucho region in the south-central Peruvian Andes. Their country lay around La Mar and Chungui near Andahuaylas, east of the Pocras, and they are known from Spanish colonial accounts of the ethnic groups living in the Huamanga highlands before the Inca conquest.
zh: 马永马尔卡人是秘鲁中南部安第斯山区阿亚库乔一带的高地族群，聚居在安达韦拉斯附近的拉马尔和琼吉，与西面的波克拉人相邻。西班牙殖民文献在记述印加征服前瓦曼加高原的诸族群时提到了他们。

en: Mayo was the heartland of the Mac William Íochtar, or Lower Mac William, the Mayo Burkes, a fully Gaelicised branch of the Hiberno-Norman de Burgh family. Their lands covered much of northern Connacht, and their chief ruled like a regional king, receiving the White Rod at his inauguration. The lordship was born from the Burke Civil War of the 1330s: after William Donn de Burgh, Earl of Ulster, was assassinated in 1333, the de Burgh inheritance in Connacht split between the Mac William Uachtar, or Clanricarde, Burkes in the south and the Mac William Íochtar in the north. Its first chief was Edmond Albanach de Burgh, who had spent part of his youth as a hostage in Scotland and by his death in 1375 was the strongest lord west of the Shannon. From his seat at Castlebar his line dominated Connacht politics for more than three hundred years, often at war with its Clanricarde cousins, and later branches of the family supplied the Earls of Mayo.
zh: 梅奥是下麦克威廉（又称梅奥伯克）的核心领地，这一支系是爱尔兰诺曼裔德·伯格家族完全盖尔化的分支。其领地覆盖康诺特北部的大部分地区，首领即位时接受白杖，实际行使着地区国王的权力。该领地诞生于14世纪30年代的伯克内战：1333年阿尔斯特伯爵威廉·唐·德·伯格遇刺后，德·伯格家族在康诺特的遗产分裂为南部的上麦克威廉（即克兰里卡德）伯克与北部的下麦克威廉。首任首领是埃德蒙·阿尔巴纳赫·德·伯格，他少年时曾在苏格兰充当人质，到1375年去世时已是香农河以西最强大的领主。他的家族以卡斯尔巴为根基，在其后三百多年里主导着康诺特的政局，并时常与克兰里卡德的同宗交战；家族的后支还衍生出梅奥伯爵一系。

en: The Mzab is a stony valley of the northern Sahara, some six hundred kilometres south of Algiers, whose oases are held by the Mozabites, a branch of the Zenata Berbers who follow the Ibadi school of Islam. Ibadi power in the Maghreb began with the Rustamid dynasty founded in 767, and after the Fatimids overthrew the Rustamids and seized Tahert early in the tenth century, Ibadi refugees first withdrew to Ouargla and then, from 1012, settled the Mzab valley, building five fortified oasis towns between the eleventh and fourteenth centuries, of which El Atteuf is the oldest and Ghardaïa the leading city. Ghardaïa heads a loose confederation governed by a council of religious scholars, the Majlis Ammi Said, which also represented Ouargla, and the towns grew rich on caravan trade and on merchant networks stretching across the Maghreb. In the sixteenth century the Mozabites recognized the nominal authority of the Ottomans of Algiers, paying tribute while keeping their own Ibadi institutions.
zh: 姆扎卜是撒哈拉沙漠北部的石质河谷，位于阿尔及尔以南约六百公里，绿洲的主人是姆扎卜人，即信奉伊巴德派伊斯兰教的泽纳塔柏柏尔人支系。伊巴德派在马格里布的政权始于767年建立的罗斯图姆王朝；10世纪初法蒂玛王朝推翻罗斯图姆人、攻占塔赫特后，伊巴德派难民先退往瓦尔格拉，又从1012年起迁入姆扎卜河谷，在11至14世纪间建起五座设防绿洲城镇，其中阿特夫最为古老，盖尔达耶则是首邑。盖尔达耶领导着一个松散联盟，由宗教学者组成的‘阿米·赛义德会议’治理，瓦尔格拉也由该会议代表；各城镇凭借商队贸易和遍布马格里布的商人网络致富。16世纪，姆扎卜人承认阿尔及尔奥斯曼政权的名义权威并向其纳贡，同时保留了自己的伊巴德派制度。

en: The Muzaffarids were a Sunni Muslim dynasty of Arab descent, long settled and thoroughly Persianized, who built a kingdom on the ruins of the Ilkhanate. Under the Il-Khans, Sharaf al-Din Muzaffar governed Maibud near Yazd, and his son Mubariz al-Din Muhammad seized Yazd itself around 1319; in 1337, as the Ilkhanate disintegrated, he ruled the city as an effectively independent prince. He conquered Kerman in 1340, took Bam soon afterwards, and in 1353 overthrew the rival Injuids, capturing Shiraz and Isfahan and making Shiraz his capital; he even occupied Tabriz briefly before the Jalayirids forced him back. In 1358 his son Shah Shoja blinded and imprisoned him, and he died in captivity in 1363. Shah Shoja's long reign made Shiraz a centre of Persian letters, where the poet Hafez worked, while the dynasty enlarged the Jameh Mosque of Yazd. Feuding between Shah Shoja's sons after his death in 1384 drew in Timur: Isfahan was sacked in 1387, and in 1393 Timur defeated and beheaded Shah Mansur at the battle of Shiraz and had the remaining Muzaffarid princes executed, ending the dynasty and absorbing its lands into his own empire.
zh: 穆扎法尔王朝是一个具有阿拉伯血统、但早已定居并完全波斯化的逊尼派穆斯林王朝，在伊儿汗国的废墟上建立起自己的王国。伊儿汗国治下，沙拉夫丁·穆扎法尔曾任亚兹德附近迈布德的总督，其子穆巴里兹丁·穆罕默德约于1319年夺取亚兹德；1337年伊儿汗国瓦解之际，他已是这座城市事实上独立的君主。1340年他征服克尔曼，不久又攻占巴姆，1353年攻灭与之争雄的因朱王朝，拿下设拉子和伊斯法罕，并定都设拉子；他还一度进占大不里士，终被札剌亦儿人逼退。1358年，其子沙阿·舒贾将他刺瞎囚禁，他于1363年死于狱中。沙阿·舒贾在位时间很长，使设拉子成为波斯文学中心，诗人哈菲兹便在其宫廷中创作；王朝还扩建了亚兹德聚礼清真寺。1384年沙阿·舒贾死后，诸子内讧，引来帖木儿入侵：1387年伊斯法罕遭屠城，1393年帖木儿在设拉子战役中击败并斩首沙阿·曼苏尔，又处死其余穆扎法尔王公，王朝灭亡，其领土并入帖木儿帝国。

en: The Mazenjani were a Kurdish tribal polity whose chief held the citadel city of Erbil on the Erbil plain in the first half of the fourteenth century, when the surrounding Jazira region lay within the sphere of the Mongol Sutayid dynasty.
zh: 马赞贾尼是一个库尔德部落政权，其首领在14世纪上半叶据有埃尔比勒平原上以城堡闻名的埃尔比勒城，当时周边的杰济拉地区处在蒙古苏塔耶王朝的势力范围内。

en: Muzaka was the lordship of an Orthodox Albanian noble family in the Myzeqe lowlands of southern Albania, between the Devoll and Vjosë rivers. The family is first heard of around 1090 in the history of Anna Komnene, and by the late thirteenth century its chiefs, bearing Byzantine titles such as sebastokrator, played the Angevin and imperial courts off against each other. Andrea I Muzaka ruled from about 1280 to 1319 and was followed by Andrea II, who received the title of despot from Constantinople in 1335, then switched to the Angevin camp in 1336 as a vassal of the Prince of Taranto, matching his position as a Catholic-king's Albanian client. Around 1340 he defeated a Serbian army on Mount Pelister, though Stefan Dušan overran the family's lands between 1343 and 1345; after Dušan's death they re-emerged and even seized Kastoria in northern Greece following the Battle of Marica in 1371. Andrea II died in 1372, and his son Teodor fell fighting the Ottomans at Kosovo in 1389. The Ottoman annexation of Vlorë and Berat in 1415 to 1417 ended the family's rule; in 1444 Theodor Corona Musachi joined Skanderbeg's revolt, while other kinsmen converted to Islam and entered Ottoman service, and many exiles ended their line in Italy.
zh: 穆扎卡是阿尔巴尼亚南部米泽切低地上一个信奉东正教的阿尔巴尼亚贵族家族的领地，地处德沃尔河与维约萨河之间。该家族最早见于1090年前后安娜·科穆宁娜的史著；到13世纪末，其族长顶着“至尊者”之类的拜占庭头衔，在安茹宫廷与君士坦丁堡之间周旋。安德鲁一世·穆扎卡约于1280至1319年在位，继位的安德鲁二世于1335年从拜占庭获得专制公称号，1336年又转投安茹阵营，成为塔兰托亲王的附庸。约1340年，他在佩利斯特山击败一支塞尔维亚军队，但斯特凡·杜尚仍在1343至1345年间吞并了家族领地；杜尚死后穆扎卡家族重新崛起，1371年马里查之战后甚至夺取了希腊北部的卡斯托里亚。安德鲁二世于1372年去世，其子狄奥多尔在1389年的科索沃之战中迎战奥斯曼人阵亡。1415至1417年奥斯曼吞并发罗拉与培拉特，家族统治告终；1444年狄奥多尔·科罗纳·穆扎基加入斯坎德培的起义，另一些族人则改宗伊斯兰教、出仕奥斯曼，许多流亡者最终在意大利终老。

en: Tabaristan is the mountainous Caspian province later called Mazandaran, ruled from the seventh century by the Bavandids, an Iranian dynasty claiming descent from the Sasanian kings. Surviving first as Zoroastrian highland princes who resisted the Arab conquest, they converted to Islam in the ninth century and ruled as ispahbads, or kings of Tabaristan, in three successive lines: the Kayusiyya, the Ispahbadhiyya with their capital at Sari, and the Kinakhwariyya, who returned after the Mongol invasions of 1237 as vassals of the Ilkhans. In 1337 the throne at Amol belonged to Hasan II, the last mainline Bavandid king; in 1349 his execution of a powerful noble provoked a revolt, and his brother-in-law Kiya Afrasiyab had him murdered and seized the kingdom. Afrasiyab's Shia dynasty fell in 1359 to the sayyid Mir-i Buzurg, founder of the Marashi line, and Mazandaran was finally drawn into the Safavid empire when Shah Ismail conquered it in 1504.
zh: 塔巴里斯坦是里海南岸多山的省份，后称马赞达兰，自7世纪起由巴文德王朝统治，这个伊朗王朝自称出自萨珊王室。他们起初作为抵抗阿拉伯征服的祆教山地王公存续，9世纪改宗伊斯兰，以伊斯帕巴德，即统帅，或塔巴里斯坦王的头衔分三支统治：卡乌西亚支、以萨里为都的伊斯帕赫巴德亚支，以及1237年蒙古入侵后作为伊利汗附庸复国的基纳赫瓦里亚支。1337年，阿莫勒的王位属于巴文德末代正统君主哈桑二世；1349年他处死一名强藩引发贵族叛乱，姻兄基亚·阿弗拉西亚布乘机将他谋害并篡夺了王国。阿弗拉西亚布的什叶派王朝又于1359年被圣裔米尔·布祖尔格推翻，后者建立马拉什王朝；1504年，伊斯玛仪一世征服马赞达兰，最终把它纳入萨非帝国。

en: Misantla was a Totonac town in the Sierra de Chiconquiaco of northern Veracruz, set in the valley of the river that still bears its name; in the Totonac language the name means the place of the deer. The region was originally Totonac, but in the late twelfth century it was overrun by Chichimec followers of Mizantecuhtli, lord of Huejotla, which left a Nahua minority alongside the Totonac majority. In 1486 Aztec armies made Misantla the seat of a strategic frontier province, and its people carried tribute of liquidambar resin all the way to Tenochtitlan. When the Spanish arrived its tlatoani was Macuilcuauhhuitzli, and its market dealt in maize, cotton, fruit, fish and game ranging from jaguars to parrots. After the conquest Franciscan friars gathered the dispersed population into a new mission town, which in 1564 was moved to the meeting of the Palchán and Misantla rivers and named Santa María de la Asunción Misantla, though the native population fell sharply under colonial rule.
zh: 米桑特拉是韦拉克鲁斯北部奇孔基亚科山区的托托纳克城镇，坐落于同名河流的河谷中；在托托纳克语里，其名字意为“鹿之地”。这一地区本是托托纳克人的土地，但12世纪末被韦霍特拉领主米萨特库特利率领的奇奇梅克人攻占，因此到16世纪时，当地除托托纳克主体居民外还形成了一支纳瓦人少数群体。1486年，阿兹特克军队将米桑特拉改为一个战略边疆省份的治所，当地人须把枫香树脂作为贡物一路运往特诺奇蒂特兰。西班牙人到来时，这里的城主是马奎尔夸维特兹利，城中大市交易玉米、棉花、水果、鱼鲜以及从美洲豹到鹦鹉的各类野味。征服之后，方济各会修士把分散人口集中为传教城镇，并于1564年迁至帕尔昌河与米桑特拉河交汇处，定名圣玛丽亚·德·拉·亚松森·米桑特拉，但原住民人口在殖民统治下急剧减少。

en: Nagar was a Burusho principality in the Nagar valley of what is now Gilgit-Baltistan in Pakistan, its mountain-girt capital standing on the south bank of the river opposite Hunza. Tradition holds that Hunza and Nagar originally formed one state, ruled by a branch of the Shahreis, the pre-Islamic ruling family of Gilgit, until the Thum Mayroo Khan divided it between his twin sons: Ghirkis took the northern bank, which became Hunza, and Moghlot the southern, from whom the ruling Mir family of Nagar claimed descent. The separate principality took shape in the fourteenth century, and Mayroo Khan is remembered as its first Muslim Thum. Its people were Burusho and Shina, speaking an older form of Burushaski, while the valley's steep terrain sheltered it from outside conquest. In 1337 and for centuries afterwards Nagar remained an autonomous mountain kingdom under Mirs of the Moghlot line.
zh: 那迦罗是布鲁绍人在那噶尔河谷建立的山邦，位于今巴基斯坦吉尔吉特-巴尔蒂斯坦，群山环抱的都城坐落在河南岸，与罕萨隔河相望。相传罕萨与那迦罗本是一个国家，由吉尔吉特前伊斯兰时代的统治者沙赫雷斯家族的一支统治；后来图姆迈鲁汗把国土分给双胞胎儿子：吉尔基斯得到河北岸，发展为罕萨，莫格洛特得到河南岸，那迦罗的弥尔家族便自称出自莫格洛特一脉。这个独立邦国在14世纪成形，传统上把迈鲁汗视为第一位信奉伊斯兰教的图姆。居民有布鲁绍人和希纳人，使用一种较古老的布鲁沙斯基语，河谷陡峻的地形替它挡住了外敌。1337年及其后数百年间，那迦罗始终是莫格洛特一脉弥尔统治下的自治山地王国。

en: Nalaji was a Haixi Jurchen polity of the Ougen valley, the country registered under the Ming as the Ouhanhe Guard. Its commanders, including Gusen Sangguu, were Nara clansmen kin to the rulers of Ula and traced their line to Nacibulu, founder of the Hulun polity on the Songhua in 1406.
zh: 纳拉吉是欧根河流域的海西女真政权，其地明代设为呕罕河卫。卫中都督固森桑古鲁等首领属那拉氏，与乌拉国主同族，世系可上溯至1406年在松花江畔创立扈伦国的纳齐布禄。

en: The County of Namur was a lordship of the Holy Roman Empire at the confluence of the Sambre and the Meuse in present-day Wallonia, with its capital at the fortified town of Namur. It grew out of the early medieval pagus of Lomme: a count of Namur is named as early as 919 and the title became normal under Albert I around 990. In 1190 Emperor Henry VI raised it to a margraviate, and after a period under the Courtenay family, Baldwin of Courtenay, the dispossessed Latin Emperor of Constantinople, sold his rights in 1263 to Guy of Dampierre, Count of Flanders, to fund an attempt to recover his capital. In 1297 Guy enfeoffed Namur as an appanage to his son John, whose Dampierre descendants ruled the small county; in 1337 it was held by Philip III of this line. The last of them, John III, sold Namur to Philip the Good of Burgundy in 1430, and it became one of the Seventeen Provinces of the Burgundian Netherlands. Under Habsburg rule Namur became a Catholic stronghold against Calvinism and gained a bishopric in 1559; after the Spanish and Austrian Netherlands periods, French armies conquered it in 1795 and made it the department of Sambre-et-Meuse.
zh: 那慕尔伯国是神圣罗马帝国的领地，位于今瓦隆尼亚桑布尔河与默兹河交汇处，以设防城镇那慕尔为治所。它由中世纪早期的洛姆伯爵区发展而来：919年已有那慕尔伯爵之名，约990年阿尔贝一世时期伯爵称号成为定制。1190年皇帝亨利六世将其升格为藩侯国；历经库尔特纳伊家族统治时期，曾出任君士坦丁堡拉丁皇帝却遭废黜的博杜安为筹措收复都城的军费，于1263年把自己的权利卖给佛兰德斯伯爵当皮埃尔的居伊。1297年，居伊将那慕尔作为封禄授予儿子让，当皮埃尔家族的后裔世代统治这个小邦，1337年在位的是该支系的菲利普三世。末代伯爵让三世于1430年把那慕尔卖给勃艮第的好人菲利普，它由此成为勃艮第尼德兰十七省之一。哈布斯堡统治时期，那慕尔成为对抗加尔文宗的天主教堡垒，1559年设立主教区；历经西属、奥属尼德兰阶段后，法军于1795年征服此地，将其划为桑布尔-默兹省。

en: The Kingdom of Naples covers the Italian peninsula south of the Papal States. The Normans first united these lands with Sicily under Roger II, crowned king in 1130; after the Hohenstaufen interlude the pope enfeoffed Charles of Anjou in 1266, and the Sicilian Vespers of 1282 drove the Angevin court from Palermo to the mainland capital of Naples. In 1337 the throne belonged to Robert the Wise, who had ruled since 1309 and also held Provence. His death in 1343 opened a long succession crisis: his granddaughter Joanna I was murdered by Charles III in 1382, and rival Angevin lines fought on until Queen Joanna II adopted Alfonso V of Aragon, who conquered the kingdom in 1442. Charles VIII of France seized Naples in 1494, but Gonzalo de Córdoba's Spanish armies secured it for Aragon by 1504, confirmed by the Treaty of Cateau-Cambrésis in 1559. Under the Spanish viceroys, heavy taxation to fund Madrid's wars provoked the great revolt of 1647, when the people of Naples proclaimed a short-lived republic. The Treaty of Rastatt gave the kingdom to Austria in 1714; a Spanish Bourbon army conquered it in 1734 and installed Charles of Bourbon, whose son Ferdinand IV ruled from 1759. French invasions set up the Parthenopean Republic in 1799 and the Napoleonic kings Joseph Bonaparte and Joachim Murat from 1806, until Murat's defeat at Tolentino in 1815 restored Ferdinand, who merged Naples with Sicily into the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies in 1816.
zh: 那不勒斯王国统辖教皇国以南的意大利半岛，疆域从坎帕尼亚延伸到阿布鲁齐和普利亚。诺曼人首先在鲁杰罗二世治下把这些土地与西西里统一起来，他于1130年加冕称王；经过霍亨斯陶芬家族的过渡，教宗于1266年把王国封给安茹的查理，1282年的西西里晚祷起义把安茹朝廷从巴勒莫赶到大陆上的那不勒斯城。1337年在位的是自1309年起统治、同时领有普罗旺斯的贤王罗伯特；他1343年去世后陷入长期继承危机：孙女乔万娜一世于1382年被查理三世杀害，安茹家族两支争位不休，直到女王乔万娜二世收阿方索五世为继承人，后者于1442年征服王国。1494年法国国王查理八世趁意大利战争开端攻占那不勒斯，但贡萨洛·德·科尔多瓦率领的西班牙军队到1504年已替阿拉贡稳固占领，1559年的《卡托-康布雷齐条约》确认了西班牙的统治。西班牙总督治下，为马德里历次战争征收的重税激起1647年的大起义，那不勒斯市民宣布成立一个短命的共和国。1714年的《拉斯塔特条约》把王国划给奥地利；1734年一支西班牙波旁军队征服此地，拥立后来的西班牙国王查理三世，其子费迪南多四世自1759年起在位。法国入侵先后催生了1799年的帕特诺珀共和国和1806年起约瑟夫·波拿巴、若阿尚·缪拉的拿破仑式王国；1815年缪拉在托伦蒂诺战败，费迪南多复位，并于1816年把那不勒斯与西西里合并为两西西里王国。

en: Navarre began as the Kingdom of Pamplona, the Basque-speaking polity whose ruler Íñigo Arista was proclaimed around 824 in the Pyrenean buffer lands between the Carolingian Empire and the Emirate of Córdoba. Under Sancho III, who died in 1035, it reached its greatest extent, but his will split the inheritance among his sons. In 1199 and 1200 Alfonso VIII of Castile overran the western lands of Álava, Biscay and Gipuzkoa, leaving Navarre a small mountain kingdom, and in 1234 the crown passed to the French House of Champagne. Joan I's marriage to Philip IV in 1284 opened a long period of French rule, which ended in 1328, when Joan II and her husband Philip III took over a Navarre again governed from within. Dynastic strife in the fifteenth century gave Ferdinand II of Aragon his opening: Castilian armies conquered Pamplona in 1512, and the southern kingdom was annexed to the Crown of Castile in 1515. The surviving Lower Navarre passed with Henry III to the French throne as Henry IV in 1589, and was merged into France in 1620.
zh: 纳瓦拉的前身是潘普洛纳王国，这个讲巴斯克语的政权位于加洛林帝国与科尔多瓦埃米尔国之间的比利牛斯缓冲地带，约824年伊尼戈·阿里斯塔被推举为统治者。1035年去世的桑乔三世在位时王国疆域达到顶峰，但他的遗嘱把遗产分给诸子。1199至1200年，卡斯蒂利亚的阿方索八世吞并了西部的阿拉瓦、比斯开和吉普斯夸，纳瓦拉沦为狭小的山地王国；1234年王位转入法国的香槟家族。胡安娜一世于1284年嫁给腓力四世，开启了长期的法国统治，直到1328年胡安娜二世与丈夫腓力三世接手，纳瓦拉才重新由本土治理。15世纪的王朝纷争让阿拉贡的费尔南多二世有机可乘：卡斯蒂利亚军队于1512年攻占潘普洛纳，南部王国于1515年并入卡斯蒂利亚王冠。残存的下纳瓦拉随亨利三世于1589年以亨利四世之名登上法国王位，并于1620年并入法国。

en: Naxos was the centre of the Duchy of the Archipelago, a Venetian maritime state in the Cyclades founded after the Fourth Crusade. In 1207 the Venetian noble Marco Sanudo, nephew of Doge Enrico Dandolo, borrowed eight galleys from the Arsenal, landed on Naxos and, after a siege of the fortress of Apalyros, mastered the island by 1210; he then conquered Paros, Melos and the rest of the Cyclades and ruled them as duke, dividing Naxos into fifty-six fiefs for his followers. The Greek islanders mostly remained Orthodox under their Catholic, often absentee lords, and the duchy was held successively as a vassal of the Latin emperors, the princes of Achaea from 1248 and the Angevin kings of Naples from 1278. In the late thirteenth century a Byzantine recovery under Licario stripped Marco II Sanudo of all but Naxos and Paros, though the lost islands returned by 1310, and the Catalan Company raided the duchy in 1317. In 1337 the duke was Nicholas Sanudo of the founding dynasty. The Crispo family seized power in 1383, and as piracy spread the duchy placed itself under Venice in 1418. Ottoman fleets made it a tributary in 1537, Sultan Selim II deposed the last Crispo duke in 1566 and conferred the islands on Joseph Nasi, and the duchy was annexed outright in 1579.
zh: 纳克索斯是群岛公国的中心，这个威尼斯人的海洋国家是第四次十字军东征后在基克拉泽斯群岛建立的。1207年，威尼斯贵族、总督恩里科·丹多洛的外甥马尔科·萨努多从兵工厂借来八艘桨帆船登陆纳克索斯，围攻阿帕利罗斯要塞，于1210年控制全岛；随后他征服帕罗斯、米洛斯及基克拉泽斯其余岛屿，自立为公爵，并把纳克索斯分成五十六个封邑分给部下。岛上的希腊居民在天主教领主（往往不在岛上）治下大多仍信东正教；公国先后作为拉丁帝国皇帝、1248年起亚该亚亲王和1278年起那不勒斯安茹国王的附庸。13世纪末，拜占庭在将领利卡里奥斯率领下反攻，马尔科二世·萨努多手中一度只剩纳克索斯和帕罗斯，但失地到1310年已全部收复；1317年加泰罗尼亚佣兵团又洗劫了公国。1337年在位的是开国家族的尼古拉斯·萨努多。1383年克里斯科家族夺权，随着海盗活动猖獗，公国于1418年接受威尼斯庇护。1537年奥斯曼舰队迫使它纳贡称臣，1566年苏丹塞利姆二世废黜末代克里斯科公爵，把群岛封给约瑟夫·纳西，1579年公国被正式吞并。

en: Nubhor, the Western Hor, was a confederation of Tibetanised Mongol pastoral tribes on the upper Salween grasslands, around the present-day Biru, Sog, Tengchen and Riwoche districts of northern Tibet; the names Hor and Sog both carry the meaning Mongol in Tibetan. The tribes grazed the high country between Chamdo and the Nagchu plateau under the loose overlordship of Lhasa. Under the Qing they were registered as the Thirty-nine Hor Tribes: in 1731 they counted 4,889 households, each tribe headed by a Thousand-Household or Hundred-Household chief holding a War Ministry licence, and by the late eighteenth century a single supreme Thousand-Household chief stood over thirteen hundred-household chiefs and fifty-three headmen. A Mongol-affairs secretary under the Lhasa amban collected their horse tribute and judged their disputes.
zh: 西霍尔意为西部霍尔，是藏化蒙古游牧部落组成的联合体，牧地在怒江上游草原，即今西藏北部比如、索县、丁青、类乌齐一带；霍尔与索克在藏语中都带有蒙古之意。诸部在昌都与那曲高原之间的高地放牧，臣属于拉萨。清代他们被编为霍尔三十九族，1731年共有4889户，各部设千户、百户或百长，由兵部颁给执照；到18世纪末，三十九族设总千户一人，下辖十三名百户、五十三名百长。驻藏大臣属下的夷情章京专管其马赋与刑名，形成清朝管辖藏北牧部的定制。

en: The Kingdom of Nangchen was a Tibetan tusi polity on the Yushu grasslands, in present-day southern Qinghai, whose ruling family bore the clan name Dri, one of the six great clans of ancient Tibet, and took the title Nangchen, meaning inner minister, from an ancestor who held that office under the old Tibetan Empire. After the empire's collapse, the forty-seventh clan leader Wa Alu made himself king of the Nangchen district and in 1175 submitted to the Southern Song, which recognised him as the first tusi. When the Mongol general Godan Khan invaded in 1239, his successor Ayowa submitted, and the Yuan confirmed the clan's rule over its six tribes. Devotees of the Kagyu school, the Nangchen kings were attacked early in the Qing period by the Bön ruler of Beri, but in 1639 Güshi Khan of the Khoshut helped them defeat the invaders. Until 1726 they paid tribute to Lhasa; the Yongzheng emperor, dividing the Tibetan regions between separate administrations, then placed them under the Xining amban as the Thousand-Household chief governing Nangchen, Chengduo and Yushu.
zh: 囊谦是玉树草原上的藏族土司政权，地在今青海省南部；统治家族姓智，是藏族古代六大姓氏之一，因祖先曾任吐蕃内大相，遂以藏语意为内大相的囊谦为家族名号。吐蕃王朝崩溃后，第四十七代首领者哇阿路割据囊谦一带自立为王，于1175年内附南宋，受封为第一代囊谦土司。1239年蒙古将领阔端入侵，继任者阿约哇归附，元朝承认该家族对所辖六部落的统治。囊谦王室信奉噶举派，清朝初年遭到信奉苯教的白利土司进攻，1639年和硕特汗国的固始汗出兵助其击退来敌。此后囊谦一直向拉萨朝贡，直到1726年雍正帝推行藏区分治，将其划归西宁办事大臣管辖，封作统辖囊谦、称多、玉树三地的囊谦千户。

en: Nandan was a Zhuang tusi in the mountains of northern Guangxi, centred on the valley that is still Nandan County in Hechi. The Tang had kept the area as a loose-reign prefecture, and in 974 the Zhuang chief Mo Hongyan submitted to the Northern Song, which recognised him as prefect of Nandan Prefecture and granted him an official seal. His descendants of the Mo clan held the office in unbroken succession; when Mo Shiren sent tribute in 1080 the court issued him a new Nandan Prefecture seal. Under the Yuan the prefecture became an appeasement commission, grouped with Qingyuan, and in 1395 the Ming stationed a military guard at Nandan alongside the native administration. Mo chiefs continued to rule their Zhuang subjects through the Ming and Qing, making Nandan one of the longest-lived native chieftaincies of the Guangxi uplands.
zh: 南丹是广西北部山区的壮族土司，中心在今河池市南丹县一带的谷地。唐代这里是羁縻州地，北宋开宝七年（974年），壮族土酋莫洪曣归附宋朝，被任命为南丹州刺史并获赐刺史印。莫氏子孙世代相袭，元丰三年（1080年）莫世忍入朝进贡，朝廷另赐新的“南丹州印”。元代南丹州改设安抚司，与庆远合为一体；明洪武二十八年（1395年）又在南丹设置卫所，与土官衙门并存。莫氏首领在明、清两代继续治理境内壮族部民，南丹也因此成为广西山地延续最久的土司之一。

en: The Triarchy of Negroponte was the Latin state on the island of Euboea, off the eastern coast of Greece, created after the Fourth Crusade. In 1205 the island was divided among three Veronese barons of the dalle Carceri circle, who formed three thirds ruled from Oreos in the north, Karystos in the south and Chalkis, the walled capital also called Negroponte. Ravano dalle Carceri made himself sole lord in 1209 and placed the island under Venetian protection, while also acknowledging the Latin Empire. The War of the Euboeote Succession of 1255 to 1262 pitted the triarchs and Venice against Prince William II of Villehardouin of Achaea, and later the Byzantine renegade Licario overran most of the island before the Latins, led by Boniface of Verona, drove the Byzantines out by 1296. The Catalan Company took Karystos in 1317 and Venice bought it in 1365. In 1337 the Lombard triarch Peter dalle Carceri ruled in Chalkis within the Venetian orbit. When the last triarchs died in 1383 and 1390 their lands passed to Venice, which ran the island as a regular colony until Sultan Mehmed II stormed Chalkis on 12 July 1470 and brought all of Euboea under Ottoman rule.
zh: 内格罗蓬特三主国是第四次十字军东征后在希腊东岸外海埃维亚岛上建立的拉丁政权。1205年，岛屿被分给达莱·卡尔切里圈子里的三位维罗纳男爵，形成三个三分之一领地，分别以北部的奥雷奥斯、南部的卡里斯托斯和筑有城墙的首府哈尔基斯（又名内格罗蓬特）为治所。拉瓦诺·达莱·卡尔切里于1209年成为唯一领主，把岛屿置于威尼斯保护之下，同时向拉丁帝国称臣。1255至1262年的埃维亚继承战争中，三位领主联合威尼斯对抗亚该亚亲王威廉二世·德·维尔阿杜安；此后拜占庭叛将利卡里奥一度攻占岛上大部分地区，拉丁人在维罗纳的博尼法乔率领下于1296年前把拜占庭人逐走。1317年加泰罗尼亚佣兵团夺取卡里斯托斯，威尼斯又于1365年将其买下。1337年，伦巴第领主彼得·达莱·卡尔切里在威尼斯势力范围内统治哈尔基斯。末代几位领主于1383年和1390年相继去世后，领地并入威尼斯，埃维亚成为威尼斯的常规殖民地；1470年7月12日苏丹穆罕默德二世攻陷哈尔基斯，全岛落入奥斯曼之手。

en: Nellenburg was a county, later landgraviate, in the Hegau country between the Swabian Alb and Lake Constance, centred on the castle of Nellenburg above the town of Stockach. Its first comital line, descended from the Eberhardinger counts of the Zürichgau, held the castle from the middle of the tenth century; Count Eberhard founded the abbey of Allerheiligen at Schaffhausen in 1049, and the line died out in the male line around 1105. The lordship passed first to the lords of Bürglen and around 1170 to the counts of Veringen, whose Nellenburg branch united it with the county of Hegau before 1256 and was enfeoffed as landgrave by King Rudolf of Habsburg after the fall of the Staufer. The counts founded Stockach in the thirteenth century and secured its town privileges in 1283. When the comital line died out in 1422 the landgraviate passed to the lords of Tengen, who sold it to the Habsburgs in 1465. It then belonged to Further Austria until 1805, with Stockach as the seat of its high court; the town survived a siege by the Three Leagues during the Swabian War of 1499, before passing to Württemberg in 1805 and to Baden in 1810.
zh: 内伦堡是施瓦本阿尔布与博登湖之间黑高地区的伯国，后升为领地伯爵领，以施托卡赫镇上方的内伦堡为中心。其第一个伯爵世家出自苏黎世高的埃伯哈丁格家族，10世纪中叶起据有该堡；埃伯哈德伯爵于1049年在沙夫豪森创立诸圣修道院，该支约于1105年男系绝嗣。领地先转入比格伦领主之手，约1170年归费林根伯爵；其支系在1256年前把它与黑高伯国合并，并在施陶芬家族倒台后受哈布斯堡的鲁道夫国王册封为领地伯爵。伯爵们13世纪建立施托卡赫，并于1283年为其取得城市权。1422年伯爵世系断绝，领地伯爵领传给滕根领主，后者于1465年卖给哈布斯堡家族。此后直到1805年它一直属于前奥地利，施托卡赫是其高等法院驻地；1499年施瓦本战争中，该城顶住了三盟联军的围攻，1805年转归符腾堡，1810年并入巴登。

en: Nemer was a Haixi Jurchen group of the lower Nen basin, named after the Nemor river, called Nemer Bira in Manchu, a name meaning tender in Manchu and autumn in Mongolian. The river flows west from the Hailun highlands into the Nen, through country shared by forest Jurchen and Mongol herdsmen.
zh: 内梅尔是嫩江下游一带的海西女真群体，得名于讷谟尔河，满语称讷默尔必拉；河名在满语中意为嫩，在蒙古语中意为秋。该河自海伦一带山地西流注入嫩江，两岸是森林女真与蒙古牧人交错活动之地。

en: Neopatria, the Catalan Duchy of Neopatras, covered southern Thessaly around the old Greek capital of Neopatras, modern Ypati, whose Doukas rulers Westerners had mistakenly styled dukes of Neopatras because they read their family name as a title. When the Thessalian ruler John II Doukas died heirless in 1318, the Almogavars of the Catalan Company, already masters of the Duchy of Athens to the south, marched north under Alfonso Fadrique and took Neopatras in 1319; by 1325 they held Zetounion, the modern Lamia, and a string of other fortresses, and organised the conquest into a duchy of five captaincies under the Crown of Sicily. The infant Manfred, son of King Frederick III of Sicily, was named duke, while a vicar-general and the elected marshal of the Company exercised real power, and the twin duchies of Athens and Neopatras were henceforth ruled together. The Serbian emperor Stefan Dušan overran most of the Thessalian lands in 1348, leaving only the district around Neopatras in Catalan hands, and the rise of the Navarrese Company and the Florentine Nerio Acciaioli then squeezed the Catalans until Acciaioli took Athens in 1388 and Neopatras itself in 1390. The Ottomans swept through the Spercheios valley and captured the town only a few years later, in 1393 or 1394.
zh: 新帕特里亚即加泰罗尼亚人的新帕特拉斯公国，领有色萨利南部、以希腊旧城新帕特拉斯（今伊帕蒂）为中心的地区；当地的杜卡斯家族统治者被西方人误称为“新帕特拉斯公爵”，因为他们把家族名当成了爵位。1318年色萨利统治者约翰二世·杜卡斯无嗣而亡，已控制南方雅典公国的加泰罗尼亚佣兵团“阿尔莫加维尔”在阿方索·法德里克率领下北上，1319年夺取新帕特拉斯，到1325年又攻占了泽图尼翁（今拉米亚）等一系列要塞，并把新征服土地组成一个下设五个队长区的公国，归属西西里王权。襁褓中的曼弗雷德——西西里国王腓特烈三世之子——被立为公爵，实权则由总督查和佣兵团选出的统帅掌握，雅典与新帕特拉斯两个公国从此联合治理。1348年，塞尔维亚皇帝斯特凡·杜尚席卷了色萨利的大部分领地，加泰罗尼亚人只剩新帕特拉斯周边地区；此后纳瓦拉佣兵团和佛罗伦萨冒险家内里·阿恰约利步步紧逼，阿恰约利于1388年拿下雅典，1390年又攻占新帕特拉斯。仅数年后的1393或1394年，奥斯曼人攻入斯佩尔赫奥斯河谷，夺取了这座城镇。

en: The County of Neuchâtel, on the lake of the same name between the Jura and the Swiss plateau, began with a new castle, novum castellum in Latin, recorded on its hill in 1011 under King Rudolph III of Burgundy. When Rudolph died without heirs in 1032 the land passed to the Empire, and in 1034 Emperor Conrad II enfeoffed Ulrich of Fenis, first of the House of Neuchâtel, as count; the grant was confirmed by Henry III in 1046. The counts built a network of alliances with the growing Swiss Confederation, contracting unions with Fribourg in 1290, Bern in 1308 and Solothurn in 1369. When the native line died with Countess Elisabeth in 1395, Neuchâtel passed to south German lords, first the counts of Freiburg and, after a succession dispute in 1457, the margraves of Hachberg-Sausenberg. In 1504 the heiress Jeanne married Louis d'Orléans, Duke of Longueville, bringing the county under a French princely house; during the Italian Wars the Swiss cantons occupied it as a common bailiwick from 1512 to 1529, and its subjects adopted the Reformation in the 1530s. Raised to a principality in the seventeenth century, Neuchâtel passed on the death of Marie de Nemours in 1707 to the Hohenzollern kings of Prussia, who ruled it in personal union while its Swiss alliances remained in force.
zh: 纳沙泰尔伯国地处侏罗山与瑞士高原之间的纳沙泰尔湖畔，起源于1011年勃艮第国王鲁道夫三世时期在山丘上修建的“新城堡”，拉丁语作novum castellum，纳沙泰尔一名即由此而来。1032年鲁道夫无嗣而终，土地并入帝国；1034年皇帝康拉德二世将它封给纳沙泰尔家族的始祖费尼的乌尔里希，建立伯国，1046年由亨利三世确认。历代伯爵与日益壮大的瑞士邦联结盟，1290年联合弗里堡、1308年联合伯尔尼、1369年联合索洛图恩。1395年女伯爵伊丽莎白去世，本家族绝嗣，伯国转入南德诸侯之手，先属弗赖堡伯爵，1457年继承纠纷后归哈赫贝格-绍森贝格藩侯。1504年女继承人让娜嫁给隆格维尔公爵路易·德·奥尔良，伯国落入法国宗室之手；意大利战争期间，瑞士诸州于1512年至1529年把它作为共同管领占领，其臣民则在16世纪30年代接受宗教改革。17世纪它升格为亲王国，1707年玛丽·德·内穆尔去世后传给霍亨索伦家族的普鲁士国王，以共主邦联的方式统治，同时维持与瑞士的同盟。

en: The County of Nevers, centred on the Loire town of Nevers, took shape around the beginning of the tenth century and covered the country later known as the Nivernais. It was long held with the neighbouring County of Auxerre and was closely tied to the dukes of Burgundy, numbering Duke Henry I among its lords. In the fourteenth century it passed to the Dampierre counts of Flanders through marriage: Louis I, count of Flanders, Nevers and Rethel, ruled it from 1322 but was driven from Flanders by the revolt of Jacob van Artevelde in 1339 and fell at the Battle of Crécy in 1346. His granddaughter Margaret III brought the county to the Valois duke Philip the Bold of Burgundy, whose younger son Philip II founded a separate line of counts of Nevers. A cadet branch of the dukes of Cleves followed, and in 1539 the county was raised to a duchy. In 1565 Louis Gonzaga acquired it by marriage to Henriette of Cleves, and the last Gonzaga duke later sold Nivernais to Cardinal Mazarin, whose family kept the title until the Revolution.
zh: 讷韦尔伯国以卢瓦尔河畔的讷韦尔城为中心，约在10世纪初形成，辖地即后来的尼韦奈地区。它长期与相邻的欧塞尔伯国合并统治，并与勃艮第公爵关系密切，公爵亨利一世也曾是它的领主。14世纪，讷韦尔随婚姻转入佛兰德的当皮埃尔家族手中：身兼佛兰德、讷韦尔和勒泰勒伯爵的路易一世自1322年起统治，1339年被雅各布·范阿特维尔德领导的起义逐出佛兰德，1346年战死于克雷西战役。他的孙女玛格丽特三世把伯国带给瓦卢瓦家族的勃艮第公爵大胆的腓力，其幼子腓力二世另立讷韦尔伯爵支系，此后又由克莱沃公爵的一支旁支承袭。1539年，讷韦尔伯国升为公国；1565年，路易·贡扎加因娶克莱沃的亨丽埃特而得到它，末代贡扎加公爵后来把尼韦奈卖给枢机主教马萨林，马萨林家族保有公爵头衔直到法国大革命。

en: Neyen is the Jurchen tribe named after the Neyen river on the upper Songhua, one of the three Changbai Mountain tribes grouped with the Jianzhou Jurchens under Ming frontier rule. In 1593 its men joined the Jusheri in the Yehe-led coalition of nine tribes against Nurhaci and, after the defeat at the Battle of Gure, raided a Jianzhou border hold with Yehe troops. The Neyen leaders Sowen and Sekeshi then gathered the people of seven villages into the fortified mountain camp of Fotuohe. Nurhaci sent three of his chief captains, Eidu, Gagai and Anfiyanggū, with a thousand men; after a three-month siege the camp fell and the two leaders were killed. With that the Neyen were absorbed into Nurhaci's realm and in time enrolled among the Eight Banners.
zh: 讷殷是因松花江上游的讷殷河而得名的女真部落，为长白山三部之一，在明朝的边务体系中与建州女真同列。1593年，讷殷兵与朱舍里一起加入叶赫牵头的九部联军攻打努尔哈赤，古勒山之战战败后，又引叶赫兵袭取建州东部的洞寨。部首领搜稳、塞克什随即收拢七寨部众，据守佛多和山寨。努尔哈赤命额亦都、噶盖、安费扬古三大臣领兵千人围攻，三个月后山寨告破，二人被杀。讷殷就此被并入努尔哈赤的版图，后来也被编入八旗。

en: The Negüderi, also called the Qara'unas, were Mongol garrison troops who made their home in the Afghan highlands. Mongol tamna soldiers had been posted near the Indian frontier from 1238 to watch the Delhi Sultanate, and the community took shape in 1262, when Jochid troops of the Golden Horde, fleeing the quarrel between Berke and Hülegü, poured into Afghanistan and were led on raids by the general Neguder, from whom they took their name. They wintered around Ghazni and summered in Ghur and Garchistan, raiding into India; Marco Polo found them a mixed people, Mongol soldiers joined by Turkish and Indian women. In the fourteenth century they were counted among the military groups of the Chagatai Khanate, and their emirs Qazaghan and his son Abdullah became the real masters of the western khanate until a Barlas and Suldus revolt in 1359. Timur himself served with the Qara'unas under Qazaghan's grandson Husayn before turning on him and taking Transoxiana in 1370; the Negüderi were fully subdued in the 1380s and then formed a large part of Timur's armies. According to Babur, their descendants still spoke Mongolian in the mountains around Ghazni at the end of the fifteenth century.
zh: 捏兀迭里人又称喀劳纳人，是在阿富汗高地安家的蒙古戍军。早在1238年，蒙古探马赤军就被派驻印度边境监视德里苏丹国；1262年，金帐汗国的术赤系军队因别儿哥与旭烈兀反目而大量涌入阿富汗，在将领捏古答儿率领四处袭掠，捏兀迭里之名即由他而来。他们在加兹尼一带过冬，在古尔和加尔奇斯坦度夏，并频频南下劫掠印度；马可·波罗发现他们已是混血族群，蒙古士兵与突厥、印度妇女通婚。14世纪时，他们被视为察合台汗国的军事集团之一，其埃米尔喀扎甘及其子阿卜杜拉成为西汗国的实际主人，直到1359年巴鲁剌思和速勒都思贵族起兵反抗。帖木儿本人曾在喀扎甘之孙侯赛因麾下与喀劳纳人并肩作战，随后倒戈，于1370年夺取河中地区；捏兀迭里人在14世纪80年代被彻底征服，之后构成帖木儿大军的重要部分。据巴布尔记载，直到15世纪末，他们的后裔在加兹尼周围的山区仍说蒙古语。

en: Ngali denotes a small Sumbawan, or Samawa, chiefdom on western Sumbawa, centred near present Sumbawa Besar and the nearby Pulau Ngali. In the fourteenth century this coast was a Majapahit dependency keeping Hindu and animist traditions, until its local chiefdoms merged into the Sumbawa Sultanate from 1648 as Islam spread.
zh: 恩加利指称松巴哇岛西部的一个松巴哇（萨马瓦）小邦，中心在今松巴哇大镇与附近的恩加利岛一带。14世纪时这里是满者伯夷的附庸，保留印度教和万物有灵传统；17世纪伊斯兰教传入，当地小邦于1648年并入松巴哇苏丹国。

en: Ningzhou was a native department in central-eastern Yunnan, in the country between present-day Jiangchuan and Huaning, where the Ningbu Yi had long lived. The Tang court briefly maintained Li Prefecture here before Nanzhao overran the land in the mid-eighth century; the native name was Langkuang, meaning a dry dragon. The Xiemotu people of the Buxiong tribe once held it, until the Cuan chief A Ji ceded Langkuang to Dou Gui, chief of the Ning, from whom the country took its later name of Ning tribe. In 1254 the Ning chief Puti submitted to the Mongols and ruled from his walled town Xishalong as a ten-thousand-household chief. The administration became successively the Ningbu Ten-Thousand-Household and Ninghai Prefecture, and then, under the Zhiyuan reign, Ningzhou under Lin'an Route, governing the counties of Tonghai, Xi'e and Xisha. Xisha County, founded in 1276 around the old Xishalong town, was attached to Ningzhou in 1289 and merged back into it in 1322. The Ming and Qing retained the department under Lin'an Prefecture.
zh: 宁州是滇中以东的土州，在今江川、华宁一带，宁部蛮世代居住于此。唐朝曾短暂在此设置黎州，到8世纪中期其地被南诏攻占；当地夷语称浪旷，意为旱龙。步雄部的些莫徒人曾占据此地，后来爨蛮首领阿几把浪旷割让给宁部首领豆圭，这里遂称宁部。1254年宁部首领普提归附蒙古，在自己修筑的西沙笼城中坐镇，受任为万户；此后先后改置宁部万户、宁海府，至元年间又改为宁州，隶临安路，领通海、嶍峨、西沙三县。西沙县1276年立于旧西沙笼城，1289年划归宁州，1322年并入州中。明代和清代都保留了宁州的建制，仍然隶属于临安府。

en: Nordhausen, at the southern foot of the Harz, was first recorded in 927 in a charter of King Henry the Fowler, who built a royal castle on the Zorge river. Long an imperial estate, it was granted to a nuns' chapter by Frederick Barbarossa in 1158, but returned to the crown under Frederick II in 1220 and emerged as a free imperial city with its own mayor and council, adopting the municipal law of Mühlhausen. During the fourteenth century the burghers had to fend off the extortions of the neighbouring Counts of Hohnstein, and in 1306 Nordhausen joined Erfurt and Mühlhausen in an alliance of Thuringian cities, entering the Hanseatic League with them in 1430. It was one of the first cities to accept the Protestant Reformation in 1523, when Thomas Müntzer stayed within its walls, though the cathedral chapter remained Catholic under Habsburg protection. The Thirty Years' War broke the city's medieval prosperity, and in 1802 Prussian troops occupied Nordhausen and the mediatisation ended its centuries-old status as a free city; from 1807 it belonged to the Kingdom of Westphalia.
zh: 诺德豪森坐落在哈茨山南麓，最早见于927年捕鸟者亨利国王的一份特许状，亨利还在佐尔格河畔修建了王家城堡。它本是皇室领地，1158年被腓特烈·巴巴罗萨赐给一座修女院，1220年又在腓特烈二世治下归还皇室，随后发展为拥有市长和市议会的帝国自由城市，并采用米尔豪森的城市法。14世纪，市民不得不应付邻邦霍恩施泰因伯爵的勒索；1306年，诺德豪森与爱尔福特、米尔豪森结成图林根城市同盟，并于1430年随二者加入汉萨同盟。1523年，托马斯·闵采尔曾在此停留，诺德豪森成为最早接受宗教改革的城市之一，只有主教座堂圣职团在哈布斯堡庇护下仍奉天主教。三十年战争终结了这座城市中世纪的繁荣；1802年普鲁士军队占领诺德豪森，采邑调解废除了它延续数百年的自由城市地位，1807年起它并入威斯特伐利亚王国。

en: The County of Nidda was a small state of the Holy Roman Empire on the northern edge of the Wetterau, centred on the town of Nidda and built from fiefs of Fulda Abbey. The abbey grouped its scattered Wetterau estates into the Bingenheim jurisdiction in 1064, soon called the County of Nidda, and enfeoffed its advocacy to the lords of Malsburg, who first styled themselves Counts of Nidda in 1104. After backing the losing side in a feud against the Archbishop of Mainz in 1155 they lost their northern Hessian lands, and when Count Berthold II died childless in 1206 the county passed to his nephew Louis I of Ziegenhain. A junior line ruled Nidda separately from 1259 until Engelbert I died without sons in 1329; his daughter Lukardis had married John I of Ziegenhain, whom Emperor Louis IV invested with Nidda in 1323, and from 1333 the two counties were united, John I being the count ruling in 1337. His feud with Fulda Abbey ended in an imperial ban and a mediated peace in 1331, and financial trouble later forced him to sell a quarter of Nidda to Mainz in 1344. Nidda became an immediate county in 1420, and when John II of Ziegenhain died childless in 1450 it passed, with Ziegenhain, to the Landgraviate of Hesse, going to Hesse-Marburg in 1567 and Hesse-Darmstadt in 1604.
zh: 尼达伯国是神圣罗马帝国的一个小邦，地处韦特劳北缘，以尼达镇为中心，由富尔达修道院的采邑拼凑而成。修道院于1064年把分散在韦特劳的产业合并为宾根海姆辖区，不久便被称作尼达伯国，并将护院之职封给马尔斯堡领主；该家族于1104年首次自称尼达伯爵。1155年，他们在一场反对美因茨大主教的仇杀中站错了队，丧失了黑森北部的领地；1206年贝托尔德二世伯爵无嗣而终，伯国由其外甥齐根海恩的路德维希一世继承。1259年起，一支旁系单独统治尼达，直到1329年恩格尔贝特一世无男嗣而亡；他的女儿卢卡尔迪斯嫁给了齐根海恩的约翰一世，皇帝路德维希四世早在1323年就把尼达封给约翰，1333年两个伯国正式合二为一，约翰一世正是1337年在位的伯爵。他与富尔达修道院的仇杀以帝国禁令和1331年的调停和约收场，财政困窘又迫使他在1344年把尼达四分之一的产业卖给美因茨。尼达于1420年成为直属帝国的伯国；1450年齐根海恩的约翰二世无嗣去世，尼达与齐根海恩一同归入黑森领地伯国，1567年划归黑森‑马尔堡，1604年转属黑森‑达姆施塔特。

en: Nienburg was the eastern portion of the Hoya inheritance on the middle Weser, centred on the town of Nienburg, the largest town of the Middle Weser region. The place, first recorded in 1025 as Negenborg, grew up around a ford of the Weser, and in 1215 Count Henry I of Hoya made it the residence of his line. In 1337 it was held by John II of Hoya, whose partition of the county with his brother Gerhard III in 1345 created the separate Nienburg branch. When the elder Hoya branch died out in 1497 the two parts were reunited under Count Jobst I, who ruled from Nienburg, and in 1582 the reunited county passed to the Welf dukes of Brunswick-Lüneburg.
zh: 宁堡是霍亚家族遗产在威悉河中游的东部部分，以威悉河中游地区最大的城镇宁堡为中心。该地1025年首见于记载，称内根堡，因威悉河上的一处渡口而兴起，1215年霍亚伯爵海因里希一世将其定为家族支系的驻地。1337年时它由霍亚的约翰二世统治，1345年约翰与其兄格哈德三世瓜分伯国，形成独立的宁堡支系。1497年霍亚长支绝嗣，两部分在约布斯特一世治下重新统一，他从宁堡进行统治；1582年，重新统一的伯国转入韦尔夫家族的不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵之手。

en: Ānlóng was a Zhuang native chief's office in the Nanpan river hills on the Guizhou-Guangxi border, the country around present-day Ceheng and Longlin. Under the Yuan it belonged to the Lai'an route, whose lists name the Anlong chief's office among its subordinate native posts under the local Cen clan. As the Ming reorganized the borderlands, an Anlong defense battalion was created in 1381, and in 1652 the Southern Ming Yongli emperor, fleeing the Qing, made Anlong his temporary capital and raised it to a prefecture; Qing troops took the place in 1658 and gave it a new name. The old chief's office country was thus recast over the centuries as guards, departments and counties under direct provincial rule.
zh: 安龙是南盘江山区、贵州与广西交界一带的僮人长官司，辖境当今册亨、隆林等地。元代其地属来安路，来安路所属土职中即列有安隆长官司，由岑氏土官统领。1381年，明朝在这一带设安隆守御千户所，重整边地建制；1652年，南明永历帝为避清军移跸安龙，以此为陪都，并升置安龙府，1658年清军攻克后改名安笼。昔日的长官司地由此逐渐被改编为卫、所、州、县，纳入流官直接治理的体制。

en: Nalou was a native chief's office of the Yi peoples on the middle Red River, south of Lin'an in what is now southern Jianshui and Mengzi. Under the Yuan its headmen held a thousand-household commission in the Hani route, and after a short-lived Ming prefecture called Hani was abolished, the Nalou Chadian Chief's Office was set up in 1384 under Lin'an Prefecture. The office became hereditary in the Pu family of Yi chieftains, who ruled their valley villages through the Ming and Qing. In 1817 the rising led by Gao Luoyi, who had been proclaimed king of the Hani, swept through the region and defeated the Nalou chief Pu Cheng'en before Qing troops suppressed it.
zh: 纳楼是红河流域中段的彝人长官司，位于临安府以南，约当今建水、蒙自南部。元朝时其首领受任和泥路的纳楼千户；明初短期设置和泥府，1384年废府，纳楼千户所改置为纳楼茶甸长官司，隶属临安府。长官由彝族普氏家族世袭，历明、清两朝治理河谷村寨。1817年，高罗衣自称窝泥王起事，义军横扫这一带，击败纳楼土司普承恩，后来才被清军镇压下去。

en: Naumburg was the seat of the prince-bishopric of Naumburg-Zeitz, one of the three missionary dioceses Emperor Otto I planted east of the Saale. Authorised at the Ravenna synod of 967 and founded at Zeitz in 968 together with Merseburg and Meissen, it was a suffragan of the archbishopric of Magdeburg. After the Polish king Mieszko II raided the frontier in 1028, the see was moved the next year to the safer Naumburg, a castle town on the Via Regia trade road, with papal approval. The bishops' temporal lands, the Hochstift, formed a small imperial state, while the town itself, chartered in 1144, prospered from its trade fairs, first recorded in 1278. In 1337 the bishop was Withego I of Ostrau. The Reformation broke the old diocese: Nicolaus von Amsdorf was installed as a Lutheran bishop in 1542, Julius von Pflug died in 1564 as its last Catholic bishop, and the Naumburg Diet of 1561 adopted the Augsburg Confession before the secularised lands passed to the dukes of Saxony. The rise of Leipzig and the Thirty Years' War then dimmed the town's trading fortunes. From 1657 the district belonged to the Saxe-Zeitz cadet line, and after its extinction in 1718 it reverted to the Dresden court; the Congress of Vienna assigned Naumburg to Prussia in 1815.
zh: 瑙姆堡是瑙姆堡-蔡茨主教区邦的治所，该主教区是皇帝奥托一世在萨勒河以东设立的三个传教教区之一。967年拉文纳宗教会议批准设立，968年与梅泽堡、迈森同时在蔡茨建区，隶属马格德堡大主教区。1028年波兰国王梅什科二世袭扰边境后，教座于次年经教皇批准迁至更安全的瑙姆堡——这座位于皇帝大道商路上的城堡城镇。主教的世俗领地“主教邦”是一个小小的帝国邦国，而瑙姆堡本身在1144年获得建城权，靠1278年即有记载的集市贸易兴盛起来。1337年在任的主教是奥斯特劳的维特戈一世。宗教改革瓦解了旧教区：1542年尼库劳斯·冯·阿姆斯多夫被立为路德宗主教，尤利乌斯·冯·普弗卢格于1564年作为最后一任天主教主教去世，1561年的瑙姆堡议会接受《奥格斯堡信纲》，世俗化的土地随后转入萨克森公爵之手。莱比锡的崛起和三十年战争又使城镇的贸易盛况黯淡。1657年起该地区归属萨克森-蔡茨旁支，1718年该支绝嗣后复归德累斯顿宫廷；1815年维也纳会议把瑙姆堡划归普鲁士。

en: The Duchy of Niemodlin, German Falkenberg, was an Upper Silesian Piast duchy centered on Niemodlin, a settlement first recorded in 1224 and granted town privileges in 1283. Originally part of the Duchy of Opole, it became the seat of its own duke in 1313, when Bolesław the Elder, the eldest son of Bolko I of Opole, inherited Niemodlin and Wieluń and acted as regent for his younger brothers until 1323. His Luxembourg alignment brought war with King Władysław I the Elbow-high of Poland, who took Wieluń in 1326, and on 18 February 1327 Bolesław paid homage to John of Bohemia at Opava with the other Silesian dukes; in 1336 he was allowed to purchase the town of Prudnik. He died around 1365 and was followed by his sons, the last of whom, Henry of Niemodlin, ruled alone from 1369, chartered Głogówek in 1373 and died childless in 1382. King Wenceslaus IV seized the vacated fief, but a 1383 settlement gave Niemodlin itself to the sons of Bolko III of Strzelce, while Głogówek and Prudnik went to Władysław of Opole. The duchy remained with the Opole Piasts until their line died out in 1532, after which the estate passed through Hohenzollern and other noble hands, and the town was annexed by Prussia in 1742.
zh: 涅莫德林公国（德语称法尔肯贝格）是上西里西亚皮雅斯特家族的公国，以涅莫德林为中心；该地1224年首见记载，1283年获得城市特权。它原属奥波莱公国，1313年奥波莱的博尔科一世去世后成为独立公国的治所：长子博莱斯拉夫（“长者”）继承涅莫德林和维伦，并在1323年前代年幼的诸弟摄政。他亲近波希米亚的卢森堡家族，因而与波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫一世（“矮子”）开战，维伦于1326年被波方夺去。1327年2月18日，博莱斯拉夫与其他西里西亚公爵一道在奥帕瓦向波希米亚国王约翰行臣服礼；1336年他获准买下普鲁德尼克城。他约于1365年去世，诸子相继统治，幼子涅莫德林的亨里克1369年起独自执政，1373年授予格沃古韦克特许状，1382年无嗣而终。波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫四世一度没收这块空置采邑，但1383年的裁断把涅莫德林本体判给斯切尔采的博尔科三世诸子，格沃古韦克和普鲁德尼克则归奥波莱的瓦迪斯瓦夫。公国此后一直属奥波莱皮雅斯特支系，1532年该世系断绝，产业经霍亨索伦等家族之手，城镇本身于1742年被普鲁士吞并。

en: The Duchy of Namysłów was a small Silesian Piast principality centered on the town of Namysłów on the Widawa River, which was destroyed in the first Mongol invasion of 1241 and refounded in 1249 by Duke Bolesław II the Bald. The town belonged to the Duchy of Wrocław until 1294 and then to Głogów, and in the 1312 partition of Henry III of Głogów's lands it briefly became the seat of its own duchy. The Peace of Kraków of 1323 transferred Namysłów, Byczyna and Kluczbork to Bolesław III the Generous of Legnica, and it was attached to his Duchy of Brzeg until 1338, when Casimir I of Cieszyn held it for a time as dowry for his daughter Anna, who married Wenceslaus I of Legnica. In 1342 Bolesław sold his rights to Namysłów to King Casimir III the Great of Poland, whose residence the local castle became. The Treaty of Namysłów was signed in the town in 1348, with Casimir III renouncing his claims to Silesia in favour of Charles IV of Bohemia, and from 1358 the town belonged to the Bohemian Crown. It beat off a Hussite siege in 1428 and, alone with Wrocław among Silesian towns, refused homage to Ladislaus the Posthumous in 1453. It passed to Hungary in 1469, back to the Bohemian Jagiellons in 1490 and to the Habsburgs in 1526, was sacked by the Swedes in the Thirty Years' War, and went to Prussia under the 1742 Treaty of Breslau.
zh: 纳梅斯武夫公国是西里西亚皮雅斯特家族的小公国，以维达瓦河畔的纳梅斯武夫城为中心。该城在1241年第一次蒙古入侵中被毁，1249年由公爵博莱斯拉夫二世（“秃头”）重建。它先属弗罗茨瓦夫公国至1294年，其后归格沃古夫；1312年格沃古夫的亨利三世遗产分封时，它一度成为独立公国的治所。1323年《克拉科夫和约》将纳梅斯武夫、贝奇纳和克卢奇堡划归莱格尼察的博莱斯拉夫三世（“慷慨者”），1338年之前附属于他的布热格公国；其间切申公爵卡齐米尔一世曾把它作为女儿安娜（1338年嫁给莱格尼察的瓦茨瓦夫一世）嫁妆的一部分暂时管有。1342年，博莱斯拉夫把对纳梅斯武夫的权利卖给波兰国王卡齐米日三世（“大帝”），当地城堡一度成为他的驻跸之地。1348年，《纳梅斯武夫条约》在此签订，卡齐米日三世向波希米亚的查理四世放弃对西里西亚的权利要求；1358年起该城归入波希米亚王冠。1428年它击退胡斯派围攻，1453年又与弗罗茨瓦夫一起成为仅有的拒绝向“遗腹子”拉斯洛行臣服礼的西里西亚城市。1469年它转属匈牙利，1490年回归波希米亚的雅盖隆王朝，1526年归哈布斯堡家族；三十年战争中被瑞典军队洗劫，1742年依《弗罗茨瓦夫条约》转归普鲁士。

en: Nuu Ndiyi, the Place of the Dead, is the Mixtec name for the city the Aztecs called Mictlan and later ages know as Mitla; the Zapotecs themselves called it Lyobaa, the Place of Rest. It lies at the upper end of the Tlacolula valley, one of the Central Valleys of Oaxaca, and was settled from the early Classic period, growing from a fortified village into the chief religious centre of the Zapotec world as Monte Alban lost its power. Around the year 1000 Mixtec rulers took control of the city, which then reached its greatest size between 750 and 1521 as a mixed Zapotec and Mixtec polity. It was built as a gateway between the living and the dead: rulers and high priests were buried in its cruciform tombs, hoping to become cloud people who interceded for the living, and the supreme priest, the Uija-tao, had his seat here. Its walls are covered in intricate mosaic fretwork of small polished stones fitted without mortar, a decoration found nowhere else in Mesoamerica. The city was still a functioning sanctuary when the Spanish reached it in the 1520s; in 1553 Archbishop Albuquerque ordered its temples dismantled and a church raised on the great northern platform.
zh: 纽恩迪伊意为“亡者之地”，是这座城市的纽萨维语名字；阿兹特克人称它米克特兰，后世通称米特拉，萨波特克人自己则叫它廖巴，意为“安息之地”。它坐落在瓦哈卡中央谷地之一的特拉科卢拉谷地顶端，古典期早期即有人居住，从一座设防村落发展为蒙特阿尔班衰落后萨波特克世界最重要的宗教中心。约1000年，纽萨维君主取得该城控制权，此后它在750年至1521年间达到鼎盛，成为萨波特克与纽萨维混合政权。城市被建造成连通生死两界的门户：统治者和大祭司葬在十字形墓穴中，期望化作护佑生者的“云人”，最高祭司乌伊哈-塔奥也驻跸于此。墙面铺满精雕细琢的马赛克回纹，由无数打磨过的小石块无灰浆嵌合而成，这种装饰在美索美洲独一无二。16世纪20年代西班牙人抵达时，它仍是运作中的圣地；1553年，阿尔武尔克尔克大主教下令拆毁神庙，在北部的大台基上建起教堂。

en: Annan was a native chieftaincy in south-eastern Yunnan, in the country around Mengzi on the road toward Dai Viet. It grew out of the Mongol-era Annan Route Escort Army Thousand-Household, set up in 1276 from the old Shezi Thousand-Household at Laozhai to guard the frontier near Jiaozhi. In the same year the Muze Thousand-Household nearby became Mengzi County, after the local Abo Yi tribe submitted to the Mongol general Uriangkhadai in 1256 and rose again in 1257. When Ming armies reached Lin'an in 1382 the escort-army officer Na You surrendered and was made deputy chief of a new Annan Chief's Office, while the Lu clan, descended from the Abo leader Lu Azhi, held Mengzi as hereditary native magistrates. The Lu line died out in 1523 and Mengzi passed to circulating officials. In the late Ming the Annan office became the base of the strongman Sha Dingzhou, whose rebellion of 1645 to 1648 convulsed Yunnan until the Daxi army of Sun Kewang crushed it and put him to death in 1648.
zh: 安南是滇南蒙自一带、扼守通往交趾道路的土司。它的前身是1276年由老寨舍资千户改设的安南道防送军千户，职责是护卫临近交趾的边境；同在1276年，元朝罢废目则千户，改置蒙自县，隶临安路，而目则千户源于1256年归附蒙古大将兀良合台、次年又反叛被平的阿僰蛮部落。1382年明军进抵临安，防送军土官那由归降，被授为新设安南长官司的副长官；阿僰蛮首领禄阿只的后裔禄氏则世袭蒙自土知县。1523年土知县禄仁去世无嗣，禄氏世绝，蒙自改由流官治理。明末，安南长官司成为豪强沙定洲的根基，他在1645至1648年间发动叛乱震动云南，最终被孙可望的大西军击溃，沙定洲本人于1648年被处死。

en: The Norwegian kingdom took shape in the Viking Age, when the fjord and coastal districts were united under Harald Fairhair around 900, and Christianity was imposed in the eleventh century by kings such as Olaf II, killed at Stiklestad in 1030 and later venerated as Norway's patron saint; Nidaros became an archbishopric in 1153. Norwegian seafarers had meanwhile settled the Faroes, Iceland, Greenland, Orkney and Shetland, all tied to the Norwegian crown. After a century of civil wars ended in 1240, the Black Death of 1349 halved the population and weakened the monarchy, while the Hanseatic League turned Bergen into its northern trading staple. In 1319 Magnus Eriksson inherited Norway together with Sweden, and from 1380 Norway was ruled in union with Denmark, entering the Kalmar Union in 1397. When Sweden broke away in 1523, Norway remained the junior partner of Denmark-Norway: the Lutheran Reformation was imposed in 1537 and absolute monarchy followed in 1661. Wars with Sweden cost it Jämtland and Härjedalen in 1645 and Bohuslän in 1658.
