After Denmark's defeat in the Napoleonic Wars the Treaty of Kiel in 1814 transferred Norway to Sweden; the Norwegians answered with the constitution of Eidsvoll and kept their laws and parliament under the new personal union.
zh: 挪威王国成型于维京时代：约900年前后，峡湾与沿海诸地区在金发哈拉尔治下统一；11世纪，奥拉夫二世等国王推行基督教，他于1030年在斯蒂克莱斯塔战死，后被尊为挪威的主保圣人，1153年尼达罗斯升格为大主教区。与此同时，挪威航海者已定居法罗群岛、冰岛、格陵兰、奥克尼和设得兰，这些地方都臣属于挪威王冠。一个世纪的内战于1240年结束后，1349年的黑死病使人口减半、王权削弱，汉萨同盟则把卑尔根经营成它在北方的贸易据点。1319年马格努斯·埃里克松同时继承挪威与瑞典，1380年起挪威又与丹麦联合，并于1397年加入卡尔马联盟。1523年瑞典脱离后，挪威成为丹麦—挪威联合中较弱的一方：1537年路德宗改革被强行推行，1661年又确立专制君主制。与瑞典的战争使它在1645年失去耶姆特兰和海里耶达伦，1658年失去布胡斯兰。丹麦在拿破仑战争中失败后，1814年《基尔条约》把挪威割让给瑞典；挪威人以埃兹沃尔宪法作答，在新的共主邦联下保留了自己的法律和议会。

en: Known as Lord Novgorod the Great, this was the largest of the East Slavic city-states, stretching from the Gulf of Finland to the Urals. Tradition places the invitation of the Varangian prince Rurik at Novgorod in 862, the legendary starting point of the Rurikid dynasty, and the city long stood at the head of the river trade between the Baltic and Byzantium. In 1136 the citizens drove out their prince and made the veche, or popular assembly, supreme: it elected and dismissed princes, the posadnik chief magistrate, the tysyatsky militia commander and even the archbishop, while boyar families and merchant guilds held the real power. Its wealth came from furs, beeswax and the Hanseatic kontor on the riverfront, and its armed river traders, the ushkuyniki, carried Novgorod's commerce and forts east to the Urals. Prince Alexander Nevsky saved the city from Swedish and Teutonic attacks at the Neva in 1240 and on the ice of Lake Peipus in 1242, though like other Rus' lands it paid tribute to the Mongol khans. From the fourteenth century the grand princes of Moscow collected that tribute and steadily tightened their grip. Ivan III defeated Novgorod at the Shelon in 1471 and in 1478 abolished the veche, carried off its assembly bell and annexed the republic. Ivan the Terrible sacked the city in 1570, a Swedish occupation from 1611 to 1617 deepened its decline, and the founding of St Petersburg in 1703 turned the Baltic trade away from its old river routes.
zh: 这个正式称号为“大诺夫哥罗德君主”的城邦是东斯拉夫诸城邦中疆域最大的一个，版图从芬兰湾一直延伸到乌拉尔山。相传862年瓦良格王公留里克正是在诺夫哥罗德受邀入主，成为留里克王朝的传奇起点，这座城市也长期扼守着波罗的海与拜占庭之间的河上商路。1136年市民驱逐了自己的王公，把民众大会“维彻”推上最高权力位置：维彻有权迎立和废黜王公，选举波萨德尼克首席长官、千人长民兵统领乃至大主教，而实权掌握在波雅尔家族和商人行会手中。它的财富来自毛皮、蜂蜡和设在河畔的汉萨商馆，被称为“乌什库伊尼基”的武装河上商队还把贸易和据点向东推进到乌拉尔山。王公亚历山大·涅夫斯基于1240年在涅瓦河畔、1242年在楚德湖冰面先后击退瑞典人和条顿骑士团，保住了城市，但它和其他罗斯城邦一样要向蒙古汗纳贡。从14世纪起，莫斯科大公们代征贡赋，控制日紧。伊凡三世于1471年在舍隆河击败诺夫哥罗德，1478年又废除维彻、运走维彻钟，将共和国吞并。1570年伊凡雷帝洗劫全城，1611—1617年的瑞典占领进一步加剧了它的衰落，1703年圣彼得堡的兴建更使波罗的海贸易绕开了它古老的河道。

en: The tusi holding around Qijiang, south of Chongqing, was the land of the Nanping Liao, called the Nanping barbarians in Tang times and the Bandun in earlier centuries. Their Zhu-clan king, titled King of Jianli, submitted to the Tang court, which placed his land under Yuzhou. In Song times they were the Yuzhou barbarians; after the three clans led by Li Guangji were subdued, the Northern Song set up the Nanping military prefecture in 1070. Under the Yuan it was run as the Nanping Qijiang chief's office, a long-standing tusi of the southern Sichuan hills. In 1363 Ming Yuzhen of Xia merged it with Nanchuan County into Qijiang County, which the Ming took over in 1371 and ruled from Chongqing.
zh: 綦江一带的土司辖地位于重庆以南，居民是南平僚，唐代称南平蛮，更早称板楯七姓蛮。其王姓朱，号剑荔王，归附唐朝后，唐朝将其地隶属于渝州。宋代他们被称为渝州蛮；李光吉等三族被平定后，北宋于1070年在当地设置南平军。元代这里以南平綦江长官司治理，是川南山地老牌土司之一。1363年，大夏政权君主明玉珍把该长官司与南川县合并，设立綦江县；1371年綦江县归入明朝，由重庆府管辖。

en: The Kingdom of Naqis was one of the six Beja polities recorded by the Arab historian al-Yaqubi in the ninth century, occupying the Red Sea hills between Aswan and Massawa. Its chief town was called Hajar, and its wealth rested on the gold and emerald mines of the eastern desert, where Muslim Arab miners worked beside the local Beja from the 800s to the 1200s; the fortified mining works at Derahib grew up in this same belt of hills. As in the other Beja kingdoms, mining and the trade in captives drawn from the interior underpinned its economy. Like its neighbours, Naqis was eventually absorbed into the Balaw kingdom of the later Middle Ages.
zh: 纳吉斯王国是阿拉伯史学家雅库比在9世纪记载的六个贝贾政权之一，据有阿斯旺与马萨瓦之间的红海山地。它的主城名叫哈杰尔，财富来自东部沙漠的黄金和祖母绿矿藏；从800年代到1200年代，穆斯林阿拉伯矿工与当地贝贾人一同在此采挖，德拉海布的设防采矿工程就兴起于这片山地。与其他贝贾王国一样，采矿业和来自内陆的奴隶贸易支撑着它的经济。纳吉斯最终和邻邦一道，在中世纪后期被并入巴劳王国。

en: Narbonne, on the Mediterranean coast of Languedoc, was founded as the Roman colony of Narbo Martius in 118 BC and became capital of the province of Gallia Narbonensis, where the Via Domitia met the road to the Atlantic. After the Roman collapse it served the Visigoths as capital of their kingdom of Septimania, and from the eighth century it was the seat of the Carolingian viscounts of Narbonne, vassals in name of the counts of Toulouse who in practice governed themselves and grew rich on port trade. The viscountess Ermengarde, who reigned from 1134 to 1192, kept one of the courts where troubadour poetry and the ideals of courtly love flourished. In 1192 Peter of Lara, sprung from a Castilian noble house, displaced Ermengarde and founded the Lara line; in 1337 the viscounty was held by Amalric III of that family. From the fourteenth century the silting and change of course of the river Aude slowly strangled the harbour. The last Lara successors, the Tinières, sold the viscounty to Gaston IV of Foix in 1447, and in 1507 Narbonne entered the French royal domain.
zh: 纳博讷位于朗格多克的地中海沿岸，公元前118年罗马人在此建立纳博马蒂乌斯殖民地，后来成为那旁高卢行省的首府，罗马大道多米提亚大道在此与通往大西洋的道路交汇。罗马帝国崩溃后，它成为西哥特人塞蒂马尼亚王国的都城；8世纪起，这里是加洛林王朝纳博讷子爵的治所，名义上臣属图卢兹伯爵，实则高度自治，并凭借港口贸易致富。1134至1192年在位的女子爵埃尔芒加德广开宫廷，是游吟诗人诗歌与典雅爱情观念兴盛的中心之一。1192年，出身卡斯蒂利亚名门的皮埃尔·德·拉腊取代埃尔芒加德，建立拉腊家族的统治；1337年在位的正是该家族的阿马尔里克三世。14世纪以后，奥德河淤积改道，港口逐渐衰微。拉腊家族的后继者蒂尼耶尔家族于1447年把子伯国卖给富瓦伯爵加斯顿四世，1507年纳博讷并入法兰西王室领地。

en: Nri was a priestly state of the Igbo people in the lower Niger region, ruled by a divine king called the Eze Nri. Its founder Eri was remembered as a sky being sent by the creator Chukwu to bring order to the Anambra valley, and oral tradition dates his coming to 1043, with the first Eze Nri, Ìfikuánim, reigning around 1225; royal burials unearthed in the region go back to the 800s. Nri grew without armies: travelling converts called mbùríchi won neighbouring towns over by ritual oath, and at its height in the late 1500s its religious authority reached roughly a quarter of Igboland, including settlements on the west bank of the Niger. Its soil was sanctuary, and after the tenth Eze Nri any slave who entered it was counted free. The bronzes cast at Igbo-Ukwu, intricate pieces decorated with insects, birds and elephant heads, form the oldest known bronze tradition in Nigeria. From the 1700s the rise of Benin and the Igala kingdom and the pressure of the Atlantic slave trade eroded Nri's authority, though its priestly hierarchy long outlasted its political power.
zh: 恩里是伊博人在尼日尔河下游建立的神权国家，由号称埃泽·恩里的神王统治。始祖埃里被铭记为造物主丘库派来为阿南布拉河谷带来秩序的天上之人，口传传统把他的到来定在1043年，第一位埃泽·恩里伊菲库阿尼姆约在1225年在位；当地出土的王室墓葬可追溯至9世纪。恩里不靠军队扩张：名为姆布里奇的游方传道者通过仪式誓约争取邻镇归附，到16世纪末鼎盛时，它的宗教权威遍及约四分之一的伊博兰，远及尼日尔河西岸的聚落。它的土地是避难所，从第十位埃泽·恩里时起，任何奴隶踏足此地即获自由。伊博乌库铸造的青铜器饰有昆虫、禽鸟和象首，工艺精细，是尼日利亚已知最古老的青铜传统。18世纪起，贝宁与伊加拉王国的崛起和大西洋奴隶贸易的冲击削弱了恩里的权威，但它的祭司等级在政治权力衰落后仍延续了很久。

en: Novogrudok is a fortified town in Black Ruthenia, founded by East Slavic settlers on earlier Baltic lands and first mentioned under 1044 in the Rus' chronicles; the Hypatian Codex calls it Novogorodok, the new little town, in 1252. In the thirteenth century it was ruled by Vaišvilkas, son of King Mindaugas, and it later became one of the core towns of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, hosting an episcopal see of the Metropolitanate of Lithuania. From 1329 the appanage principality belonged to Karijotas, a son of Gediminas, then to his son Fyodor from 1358 and to Kaributas from 1386. In 1392 it entered the grand-ducal demesne and a stone castle was built there. Novogrudok received Magdeburg rights in 1511 and from 1507 to 1795 served as capital of the Nowogródek Voivodeship, where sessions of the Lithuanian Tribunal were also held.
zh: 新格鲁多克是黑鲁塞尼亚的一座设防城镇，由东斯拉夫人在更早的波罗的人土地上建立，在1044年的罗斯编年史中首次被提及；1252年的《伊帕季耶夫编年史》称其为诺沃哥罗多克，意为“小小的新城”。13世纪时，统治这里的是国王明道加斯之子瓦伊什维尔卡斯，后来它成为立陶宛大公国的核心城镇之一，设有立陶宛都主教区的主教座。1329年起，这个封邑公国归格季米纳斯之子卡里约塔斯所有，1358年传给他的儿子费奥多尔，1386年起归卡里布塔斯。1392年它成为大公直领地，并修建了石砌城堡。新格鲁多克于1511年获得马格德堡权利，1507年至1795年间是新格鲁多克省的省会，立陶宛法庭也曾在此开庭。

en: The Duchy of Normandy grew from the Treaty of Saint-Clair-sur-Epte of 911, in which the West Frankish king Charles the Simple granted lands around the lower Seine to the Viking leader Rollo; his followers, the Northmen or Normans, gave the duchy its name and made Rouen its capital. Duke William conquered England in 1066, and for more than a century the dukes of Normandy were usually also kings of England. Philip II of France declared the duchy forfeit in 1202 and conquered it from John Lackland in 1204, the Channel Islands alone remaining English; the Treaty of Paris of 1259 secured the English renunciation of mainland Normandy, which entered the royal domain. The Norman Charter of 1315 guarded the province's customs and its exchequer against royal encroachment, and in 1337 its duke was John, eldest son of Philip VI and the future King John II. During the Hundred Years' War Henry V overran the duchy, taking Caen in 1417 and starving Rouen into surrender in January 1419. Charles VII won it back as the war turned: Rouen opened its gates in October 1449 and the Battle of Formigny in April 1450 destroyed the last English field army in Normandy. The duchy was briefly regranted as an appanage under the League of the Public Weal in 1465, then permanently reunited to the royal domain after 1469.
zh: 诺曼底公国源于911年的《圣克莱尔-叙尔-埃普特条约》：西法兰克国王糊涂查理把塞纳河下游一带封给维京首领罗洛，他的部属被称为北方人，即诺曼人，公国由此得名，并以鲁昂为都。1066年公爵威廉征服英格兰，此后一个多世纪里，诺曼底公爵往往同时身兼英格兰国王。1202年法兰西国王腓力二世宣布没收公国，1204年从无地王约翰手中将其征服，只有海峡群岛仍归英格兰；1259年的《巴黎条约》确认英王放弃大陆上的诺曼底，公国并入王室领地。1315年的《诺曼底宪章》保护本省的习惯法和财政署不受王权侵夺；1337年的公爵是腓力六世的长子约翰，即日后的约翰二世。百年战争中，亨利五世席卷诺曼底，1417年攻下卡昂，又在1419年1月迫使围困中的鲁昂投降。随着战局逆转，查理七世逐步收复失地：鲁昂于1449年10月开城，1450年4月的福尔米尼战役歼灭了英格兰在诺曼底最后的野战军。1465年公国曾因公益同盟之逼被再度封给宗室，1469年以后便永久并回王室领地。

en: Noro took its name from the Noro Bira, the Manchu name of the Naoli River, called the Nuolei under the Ming and the Noro in the Qing Jilin gazetteer; the name describes its wandering, shifting bed. The Noro flows through the country around present Shuangyashan to join the Ussuri as one of its larger left-bank tributaries, and its Hūrga Jurchen villagers lived by fishing and hunting in the marshes. Like the other Ussuri tribes their chiefs held nominal Ming guard titles under the Nurgan commission, and the river country was overrun in Nurhaci's eastern campaigns between 1596 and 1625, after which its people were gradually enrolled among the Manchu banners.
zh: 诺罗得名于诺罗河，满语称诺罗毕拉，明代称诺雷河，清代《吉林通志》作诺罗河，河名取其河床游荡不定之意。诺罗河流经今双鸭山一带，是乌苏里江左岸较大的支流之一，河畔的虎尔哈女真人以在湿地渔猎为生。与乌苏里江其他部落一样，其酋长在奴儿干都司体系下领有名义上的明朝卫所官职；1596—1625年努尔哈赤东征，诺罗一带被征服，部众后来渐被编入满洲八旗。

en: Nurpur was a hill kingdom in the Himalayan foothills between the Ravi and Beas rivers, guarding the route from the Punjab plains up to the Kangra valley. It was founded around 1064 by Jhetpal, a prince of the Tanwar dynasty of Delhi, who seized the fort of Pathankot; his clan took the name Pathania from that town, and the state was at first called Dhameri. For centuries its rajas held the gateway to Kangra, alternately resisting and submitting to the Muslim rulers of the plains. Nurpur reached its height under Raja Basu Dev between 1580 and 1613, who built a great fort there, but Mughal pressure drove out his son Suraj Mal in 1618. In 1620 Raja Jagat Singh renamed Dhameri as Nurpur to honour the emperor Jahangir and his wife Nur Jahan, and the state became a Mughal feudatory, rebelling during the Taragarh war of 1640 to 1642. It broke free in 1739 amid Nader Shah's invasion and weathered the campaigns of Ahmad Shah Durrani, until Ranjit Singh of the Sikhs annexed it in 1815.
zh: 努尔布尔是喜马拉雅山麓的山间王国，地处拉维河与比亚斯河之间，扼守从旁遮普平原通往冈格拉山谷的要道。约1064年，德里坦瓦尔王朝的王子杰特帕尔夺取帕坦科特要塞，建立此国；他的家族以该城得名帕塔尼亚，国家最初则称达梅里。数百年来，当地罗阇把守着进入冈格拉的门户，对平原上的穆斯林统治者时战时降。1580年至1613年巴苏·代夫在位时努尔布尔达到鼎盛，他在当地修建了宏伟的堡垒，但1618年莫卧儿的压力迫使他的儿子苏拉吉·马尔出走。1620年，贾格特·辛格将达梅里改名为努尔布尔，以向皇帝贾汉吉尔及其王后努尔·贾汉示好，国家成为莫卧儿附庸，并在1640年至1642年的塔拉加尔战争中起兵反抗。1739年纳迪尔沙入侵期间它脱离莫卧儿独立，又挺过了艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的历次征伐，最终于1815年被锡克人的兰季德·辛格吞并。

en: Narsinghpur was a small Garhjat chiefdom on the north bank of the Mahanadi in eastern Orissa, hemmed in by forested hills and the neighbouring states of Hindol and Baramba. Local tradition remembered two Khond war chiefs, Narsingh and Poro, who first carved out the tract in the thirteenth century and gave it Narsingh's name; they were in turn overcome by the chieftain Dharma Singh, from whom the later ruling family claimed descent. The dynasty entered the Orissan political order as feudatories of the Gajapati rajas of Puri, from whom its chiefs received the hereditary title Harichandan Mahapatra. It remained a quiet hill tributary with no recorded firmans from the Mughal or Maratha periods, its first dated ruler, Mandardhar Harichandan Mahapatra, being recorded from 1671.
zh: 讷尔辛格布尔是奥里萨东部默哈讷迪河北岸的迦尔贾德小首领邦，四周为山林和欣多尔、巴兰巴等邻邦所环抱。当地传说13世纪有两名孔德人武首领纳尔辛格与波罗率先开辟此地，邦名便取自纳尔辛格；后来首领达尔马·辛格征服了他们，后世统治家族即自称是他的后裔。该王朝作为普里加贾帕蒂诸王的附庸进入奥里萨政治体系，其首领从普里王那里领得世袭头衔“哈里钱丹·莫哈帕特拉”。在莫卧儿和马拉塔时期都没有关于它的诏书档案传世，始终是一个安静的山间纳贡小邦；已知最早有确切纪年的统治者曼达尔达尔·哈里钱丹·莫哈帕特拉于1671年在位。

en: Nassau-Hadamar was the westernmost share of the Ottonian, northern line of the House of Nassau. In the partition of 1303 the brothers Henry, Emicho and John split their father Otto's lands north of the Lahn, and Emicho I received Hadamar with Driedorf and the Esterau, at first residing at Driedorf. In 1320 he bought the model farm of Eberbach Abbey at Hadamar, turned it into a water castle and moved his court there; Emperor Louis IV granted town rights to Hadamar and Ems in 1324, and in 1332 the Counts of Diez renounced their rights over the town. Emicho died in 1334 and was followed by his son John, the count ruling in 1337, who bought the lordship of Ellar in 1337 but later sank into debt and pledged much of his land. With John's sons the elder line failed: after Henry's death in 1368 the incapable Emicho III was confined to Arnstein Abbey, and a long succession feud ended in 1405 with Hadamar divided between Nassau-Dillenburg and Katzenelnbogen; in 1557 the whole inheritance came to Nassau-Dillenburg. A younger Nassau-Hadamar line created in 1607 under John Louis was raised to princely rank in 1652 but died out in 1711, after which Hadamar reverted to the other Nassau houses and eventually joined the Duchy of Nassau in 1806.
zh: 拿骚‑哈达马尔是拿骚家族奥托系（北支）最西边的分地。1303年，亨利、埃米希和约翰三兄弟瓜分父亲奥托在兰河以北的领地，埃米希一世分得哈达马尔以及德里多夫和埃斯特劳，最初驻跸德里多夫。1320年，他买下埃伯巴赫修道院在哈达马尔的庄园，将其改建成水上城堡并把宫廷迁此；1324年皇帝路德维希四世授予哈达马尔和埃姆斯城市权，1332年迪茨伯爵放弃了对这座城镇的权利。埃米希于1334年去世，其子约翰继位，也就是1337年在位的伯爵；他在1337年购得埃拉尔领主地，后来却债台高筑，抵押了大片土地。随着约翰的儿子们相继离世，老支系走向终结：1368年亨利死后，被视为无力执政的埃米希三世被送进阿恩施泰因修道院；漫长的继承纠纷最终在1405年以哈达马尔由拿骚‑迪伦堡与卡岑埃尔恩博根瓜分收场，1557年全部遗产归拿骚‑迪伦堡。1607年在约翰·路德维希治下形成的新支系于1652年晋升诸侯，1711年绝嗣，哈达马尔随即回归拿骚其他支系，最终于1806年并入拿骚公国。

en: Nassau-Idstein was a Walramian Nassau territory in the Taunus, built around the lordships of Idstein and Wiesbaden. Idstein Castle, first recorded in 1102, was an imperial fief granted by the Archbishops of Mainz to the Laurenburg ancestors of the House of Nassau, and Idstein passed to the Walramian line in the Nassau partition of 1255. Count Adolf of Nassau, the future king, won town rights for Idstein from King Rudolf of Habsburg in 1287, and his son Gerlach I kept his residence at Wiesbaden, where in 1337 he still held the undivided Walramian lands. After Gerlach's abdication the partition of 1355 created a separate Nassau-Wiesbaden-Idstein line under Adolph I, who built Adolfseck Castle; several of its members became Archbishops of Mainz, and the Reformation was introduced around 1542. This older line died out in 1605 and its lands fell to Nassau-Weilburg. A younger line founded in 1629 joined the Swedes in the Thirty Years' War, was driven out in 1635 and restored by the Peace of Westphalia in 1648; its count George August Samuel was raised to prince in 1688 and built Biebrich Palace near Wiesbaden. When that line died in 1721, Idstein passed through Nassau-Usingen into the Duchy of Nassau of 1806.
zh: 拿骚‑伊德施泰因是拿骚家族瓦尔拉姆系在陶努斯山区的领地，核心是伊德施泰因和威斯巴登两块领主地。伊德施泰因城堡首见于1102年的记载，本是帝国采邑，由美因茨大主教封给拿骚家族的先祖劳伦堡家族；1255年拿骚分家时，伊德施泰因划归瓦尔拉姆系。后来成为国王的拿骚伯爵阿道夫于1287年从哈布斯堡的鲁道夫国王那里为伊德施泰因争取到城市权；他的儿子格拉赫一世常驻威斯巴登，1337年时仍领有尚未分割的瓦尔拉姆系全部土地。格拉赫退位后，1355年的分家产生了由阿道夫一世统领的拿骚‑威斯巴登‑伊德施泰因支系，他修建了阿道夫塞克城堡；该支系多人出任美因茨大主教，约在1542年引入宗教改革。老支系于1605年绝嗣，土地并入拿骚‑魏尔堡。1629年形成的新支系在三十年战争中依附瑞典，1635年被驱逐，1648年依《威斯特伐利亚和约》恢复领地；伯爵格奥尔格·奥古斯特·萨穆埃尔于1688年晋升诸侯，并在威斯巴登附近修建比布里希宫。该支系1721年绝嗣后，伊德施泰因经拿骚‑乌辛根之手并入1806年成立的拿骚公国。

en: The Principality of Novosil was one of the upper Oka principalities, lying along the Zusha, the Upa and the upper Don in country once held by the Vyatichi tribe, which kept its independence from Kiev until the twelfth century. The appanage emerged from the Glukhov principality, itself split from Chernihiv in the 1290s: Semyon Mikhailovich, son of Prince Mikhail of Chernihiv, held Glukhov and Novosil, and his son Alexander Semyonovich, the first Novosil prince, was executed in the Golden Horde in 1326 at the order of Khan Uzbek. The princes ruled by Horde patents and balanced between the Horde, Moscow and Lithuania; after Tatar raids ruined Novosil in 1375 the seat moved to Odoyev; in 1376 the Horde prince Arapsha ravaged the land again, and in 1380 Jogaila's army burned its towns while marching to join Mamai. In 1408, after the stand on the Ugra, the principality accepted Lithuanian suzerainty while keeping wide autonomy, and in 1422 its prince Yuri routed Khan Khudaydat near Odoyev with Vytautas's help. Around 1432 it split into the Belyov, Vorotynsk and Odoyev principalities; all their princes entered Moscow's service, confirmed to Ivan III in 1503.
zh: 诺沃西利公国是奥卡河上游诸公国之一，地处祖沙河、乌帕河与顿河上游一带，这里曾是维亚季奇部落的土地，他们直到12世纪仍保持着对基辅的独立。该封邑从格卢霍夫公国分出，而格卢霍夫本身于13世纪90年代从切尔尼戈夫分立：切尔尼戈夫王公米哈伊尔之子谢苗·米哈伊洛维奇领有格卢霍夫和诺沃西利，其子亚历山大·谢苗诺维奇是首任诺沃西利王公，1326年在金帐汗国被月即别汗下令处死。历代王公凭汗敕统治，在金帐汗国、莫斯科和立陶宛之间周旋；1375年鞑靼人的劫掠毁掉诺沃西利后，都城迁到奥多耶夫；1376年金帐汗国的阿剌卜沙再度洗劫这片土地，1380年雅盖沃的军队在前往与马迈会合的途中焚毁诸城。1408年乌格拉河对峙后，公国接受立陶宛宗主权，但保留很大自治权；1422年王公尤里在维陶塔斯援助下于奥多耶夫附近击溃胡代达特汗。约1432年，它分裂为别廖夫、沃罗滕斯克和奥多耶夫三个公国，诸王公最终都转入莫斯科麾下，1503年正式归伊凡三世统辖。

en: Nan Sarunai was a tribal state of the Ma'anyan people, a Dayak group of the Barito River basin in what is now South Kalimantan. Ma'anyan seafarers had once sailed as far as Madagascar, where their language helped shape Malagasy, but sedimentation in the Barito delta gradually pushed their settlements inland. Around 1309 the communities along the Tabalong River, near present-day Amuntai, formed a proto-state remembered in Ma'anyan wadian chants and later in the Hikayat Banjar; its name may refer to the sarunai, a ceremonial flute. In the mid-fourteenth century Nan Sarunai was overrun by an expedition of the Majapahit empire under Mpu Nala, and the country appears in the Negarakertagama of 1365 as Tanjung Negara. From its ruins arose the Hindu kingdom of Negara Dipa, predecessor of Negara Daha and eventually the Banjar Sultanate.
zh: 楠沙鲁奈是马安亚人的部族国家，马安亚人是今南加里曼丹巴里托河流域达雅克人的一支。马安亚航海者曾远航至马达加斯加，他们的语言参与塑造了马达加斯加语，但巴里托三角洲的淤积逐渐把定居点推向内陆。约1309年，塔巴隆河沿岸、今阿蒙泰一带的诸社群形成一个早期国家，其名可能来自仪式上吹奏的笛子沙鲁奈；这段历史保存在马安亚人的瓦迪安吟唱和后来的《马辰编年史》中。14世纪中叶，楠沙鲁奈被满者伯夷将领穆普·纳拉率领的远征军攻灭，1365年的《爪哇史颂》把这一地区称作丹戎尼加拉。在它的废墟上兴起了印度教王国尼贾拉·蒂帕，后者又被尼贾拉·达哈取代，最终演变为班贾尔苏丹国。

en: Nassau-Siegen was the chief share of the Ottonian, northern line of the House of Nassau, covering the Siegerland around the upper Sieg with the towns of Siegen and Dillenburg. Siegen, first recorded in 1079, was founded as a town in 1224 under joint ownership of Nassau and the Archbishopric of Cologne and only passed fully to Nassau in 1381. In the brothers' partition of 1303 Count Henry I, the ruler of 1337, received Siegen, Haiger, Ginsburg Castle and the Westerwald lordship; in 1298 his cousin King Adolf had pledged him the Ratzenscheid silver mines, the basis of the Nassau mining rights, and in 1328 he inherited Dillenburg, after which the line called itself Nassau-Dillenburg. A separate Nassau-Siegen re-emerged from the partition of 1606. John VII built the Lower Castle and in 1616 a knightly academy for Calvinist officers, while his son John VIII returned to Catholicism in 1612; from 1626 the little country was split into Catholic and Protestant halves, reunited only when both lines had died out by 1743 and the emperor awarded Siegen to the Prince of Orange. After the Prince of Orange refused to join the Confederation of the Rhine, Napoleon gave the Siegerland to the Grand Duchy of Berg in 1806; it was ceded to Prussia in 1815.
zh: 拿骚‑锡根是拿骚家族奥托系（北支）最主要的分地，涵盖锡格河上游以锡根和迪伦堡两城为中心的锡格兰地区。锡根首见于1079年的记载，1224年建城时由拿骚与科隆大主教共同领有，直到1381年才完全归入拿骚。1303年兄弟分家，1337年在位的亨利一世伯爵分得锡根、海格、金斯堡城堡和韦斯特林山领主地；1298年，他的表亲国王阿道夫把拉岑沙伊德银矿抵押给他，奠定了拿骚家族矿业权的基础；1328年他又继承迪伦堡，此后该支系改称拿骚‑迪伦堡。独立的拿骚‑锡根在1606年的分家中再次出现。约翰七世修建了下城堡，并于1616年创办为加尔文宗培养军官的骑士学院；他的儿子约翰八世则在1612年改宗天主教。1626年起，这个小国分裂为天主教和新教两半，直到两支分别于1743年前绝嗣，皇帝将锡根封给奥兰治亲王，才重新统一。奥兰治亲王拒绝加入莱茵邦联后，拿破仑于1806年把锡格兰划归贝格大公国；1815年，该地被割让给普鲁士。

en: Nsundi was a small Kongo kingdom whose capital lay on the Inkisi River, around the present village of Mbanza Nsundi in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Originally one of the states of the Seven Kingdoms of Kongo dia Nlaza, it ruled a string of lesser sub-provinces until the expanding Kingdom of Kongo conquered it, probably in the first half of the fifteenth century. Kongo's kings then treated Nsundi as a royal province, often granting it to the heir apparent: Mvemba a Nzinga, son of King Nzinga a Nkuwu, held it before his own accession as Afonso I in 1507. Its governor was appointed for a limited term, often three years, and under Álvaro II in the late sixteenth century Nsundi was restyled a duchy. The duke Manuel Jordão made and unmade kings between 1624 and 1628, until Ambrósio I deposed him. In the civil wars that followed the Battle of Mbwila of 1665, the dukes of the Kimpanzu branch made Nsundi virtually independent, and the ducal line had withered away by the 1830s.
zh: 恩苏迪是一个刚果语小王国，都城在因基西河上，即今刚果（金）姆班扎恩松迪村一带。它原是刚果迪亚恩拉扎七王国联盟的成员之一，治下还有若干小邦，直到不断扩张的刚果王国在15世纪上半叶将其征服。此后刚果国王把恩苏迪视为王室行省，常封给王储：恩津加·恩库武之子姆文巴·恩津加在1507年继位为阿方索一世之前，就曾受封于此。行省长官由国王限期任命，任期通常为三年；16世纪末阿尔瓦罗二世仿照欧洲贵族制度，把恩苏迪改封为公国。公爵曼努埃尔·若尔当在1624年至1628年间一度能废立国王，最终被安布罗西奥一世罢免。1665年姆布维拉战役后的内战中，金潘祖支系的公爵们使恩苏迪取得了事实上的独立，到19世纪30年代，这一公爵世系已然凋零。

en: Nassau-Weilburg was the southern, Walramian share of the County of Nassau, the state built by the lords of Laurenburg around their castle above the Lahn from the twelfth century, whose comital title was recognised in 1159. When the sons of Count Henry II divided Nassau in 1255, Walram II kept the lands south of the Lahn, including Weilburg, Idstein and Wiesbaden; his son Adolf was elected King of the Romans in 1292 and fell at Göllheim in 1298. Adolf's son Gerlach I, who in 1337 still ruled the whole Walramian inheritance from Wiesbaden, abdicated in 1344, and the partition of 1355 gave Weilburg to his son John I, founder of the Nassau-Weilburg line. The county was repeatedly split among kinsmen, with Saarbrücken and Wiesbaden branches of its own, until Count Louis II reunited the Walramian lands in 1605, only to divide them again after 1627. The Weilburg line was raised to princely status in 1688. In 1806, under French pressure, Nassau-Weilburg merged with Nassau-Usingen into the Duchy of Nassau, and the Weilburg prince Frederick William became its joint ruler.
zh: 拿骚‑魏尔堡是拿骚伯国南部的瓦尔拉姆系领地。拿骚伯国由劳伦堡领主家族自12世纪起围绕兰河畔的城堡建立，其伯爵头衔于1159年获得正式承认。1255年亨利二世伯爵的儿子们瓜分拿骚，瓦尔拉姆二世分得兰河以南的土地，包括魏尔堡、伊德施泰因和威斯巴登；他的儿子阿道夫于1292年当选罗马人的国王，1298年战死在格尔海姆。阿道夫之子格拉赫一世在1337年仍从威斯巴登统治整个瓦尔拉姆系领地，他于1344年退位；1355年的分家把魏尔堡分给其子约翰一世，开创了拿骚‑魏尔堡支系。伯国此后一再在亲族间分割，派生出萨尔布吕肯、威斯巴登等支系，直到路德维希二世伯爵于1605年重新统一瓦尔拉姆系领地，却在1627年后再度分裂。魏尔堡支系于1688年晋升诸侯。1806年，在法国的压力下，拿骚‑魏尔堡与拿骚‑乌辛根合并为拿骚公国，魏尔堡亲王弗里德里希·威廉成为共同统治者。

en: Canta was the highland lordship of the Canta people in the upper Chillón valley, northeast of Lima, whose name in their Cauqui language meant a lasso for taking vicuñas. Their chief settlement, Cantamarca, was raised on a pyramidal hill from about 1100 as the residence of their principal curaca, its circular stone compounds half hidden among the hillside vegetation. Downriver the Canta kept up a long feud with the Colli over the waters of the Chillón, although the two peoples also traded and shared irrigation works. The armies of Tupac Inca Yupanqui conquered the valley around 1450 and made Cantamarca an administrative centre, grouping the people into eight ayllus. After the Spanish entered the valley in 1535, the native communities were relocated into the new town of Canta on 8 December 1544, and a chapel was raised on the old sanctuary hill.
zh: 坎塔是坎塔人的高原领主邦，位于利马东北方的奇永河上游；在他们的考基语里，坎塔意为捕捉骆马用的套索。其主要聚落坎塔马尔卡约1100年起建在一座金字塔形山丘上，是坎塔人大酋长的居所，圆形石屋半掩在山坡植被之间。沿河谷而下，坎塔人与科利人为奇永河河水长期争斗，但双方也保持贸易并共用灌溉工程。1450年前后，图帕克·印卡·尤潘基的大军征服河谷，把坎塔马尔卡改为行政中心，将居民编为八个艾柳。1535年西班牙人进入河谷后，原住民社区于1544年12月8日被强行迁入新建的坎塔城，古老的圣丘上则盖起了小教堂。

en: Mahajanga is a seaport on the north-western coast of Madagascar, at the mouth of the Betsiboka River on Bombetoka Bay. Its shores belonged to the trading world of the Antalaotra, Muslim Swahili-speakers whose city-states had dotted northern Madagascar since the tenth century and drawn merchants from East Africa, Arabia and India. Around 1690 the Sakalava prince Andriamandisoarivo founded the Kingdom of Boina in the region, and early in the eighteenth century his successors made Mahajanga their commercial capital after conquering the Antalaotra port of Mazalagem Nova. An English captain visiting in 1764 found a cosmopolitan town built in the Indian fashion, with stone houses, mosques and Muslim merchants from Surat, Anjouan, Mozambique and the Comoros, and an Indian trading community of some two hundred people had formed there by the 1780s. After 1832 the kingdom was occupied by the forces of Imerina, bringing Boina's independence to an end.
zh: 马哈赞加是马达加斯加西北海岸的海港，位于邦贝托卡湾的贝齐博卡河口。这一带海湾原属安塔拉特拉人的贸易世界——这些说斯瓦希里语的穆斯林自10世纪起在马达加斯加北部建起众多城邦，吸引东非、阿拉伯和印度商人。约1690年，萨卡拉瓦王公安德里亚曼迪索阿里武在此建立博伊纳王国；18世纪初，他的继承者征服安塔拉特拉港口马扎拉任诺瓦后，把马哈赞加作为商业都城。1764年一位英国船长到访时，看到的是一座按印度风格建造的国际化城镇，石屋与清真寺林立，来自苏拉特、昂儒昂、莫桑比克和科摩罗的穆斯林商人云集；到1780年代，这里已形成约两百人的印度商人社群。1832年后，博伊纳被伊默里纳的军队占领，独立走向终结。

en: Nupe is the country of the Nupe people in the fertile basin between the Niger and Kaduna rivers in central Nigeria, where related villages had farmed and traded for centuries before a central kingdom took shape. Tradition gives the unification to Tsoede, also called Edegi, a leader of Igala origin who conquered the neighbouring tribes in the 1400s and took the title Etsu, king, making himself the first ruler of a Nupe kingdom remembered as a cavalry power on the middle Niger. For generations the Nupe kept their own gods and river cults and traded with the Yoruba states to the south, exchanging crafts and river produce across a cultural frontier marked by both commerce and war. Islam entered only late: Etsu Jibiri became the first Muslim ruler around 1770, and the kingdom reached its greatest strength under Etsu Ma'azu before his death in 1818. The Fulani jihad then exploited the succession wars that followed, and by 1835 the old Nupe kingdom had been reorganized as a Fulani-led emirate, later seated at Bida.
zh: 努佩是努佩人的国度，位于尼日利亚中部尼日尔河与卡杜纳河之间的肥沃盆地；在中央王国形成之前，彼此有亲缘关系的村落已在此农耕贸易了数百年。传说将统一归功于出身伊加拉的首领措埃德（又名埃代吉），他在15世纪征服邻近各部，采用“埃楚”（国王）称号，成为努佩王国的第一位统治者；这个王国在中尼日尔地区以骑兵见长。很长时间里，努佩人信奉自己的神祇与河流崇拜，并与南方的约鲁巴诸邦贸易，在一条既有通商也有战争的文化边界上交换手工制品和河产。伊斯兰教来得很晚：埃楚·吉比里约在1770年成为第一位穆斯林统治者，王国在埃楚·马阿祖治下达到极盛，直到他于1818年去世。随后富拉尼圣战利用继位战争介入，到1835年，旧努佩王国被改组为富拉尼人主导的埃米尔国，王庭后来设在比达。

en: Nuremberg grew up around an imperial castle on the Pegnitz, first documented in 1050. King Conrad III set up the Burgraviate of Nuremberg there, but Emperor Frederick II's Great Charter of Freedom of 1219 gave the town imperial immediacy, its own mint and customs, and power slipped from the burgraves to a municipal council. Standing on the route between Italy and northern Europe, Nuremberg became one of the richest trading cities of the Holy Roman Empire; the Golden Bull of 1356 required every newly elected German king to hold his first diet there, and from 1424 the Imperial Regalia were kept in the city. The age of Dürer, the print shop of Anton Koberger and the Nuremberg Chronicle of 1493 made it a centre of the German Renaissance. The city accepted the Reformation in 1525 and hosted the Religious Peace of 1532. In the Thirty Years' War Wallenstein besieged it in 1632 and its population nearly halved; the city never fully recovered, and in 1806 it was absorbed into the Kingdom of Bavaria.
zh: 纽伦堡环绕佩格尼茨河畔的一座皇家城堡发展起来，最早见于1050年的记载。康拉德三世曾在此设立纽伦堡城堡伯领，但皇帝腓特烈二世1219年颁布的《大自由特许状》赋予城市帝国直辖地位、独立铸币权和关税权，权力随之从城堡伯爵手中转入市议会。地处意大利与北欧之间的商路要冲，纽伦堡成为神圣罗马帝国最富庶的贸易城市之一；1356年的《金玺诏书》规定每位新当选的德意志国王必须在此召开首次帝国议会，1424年起帝国圣器也长期收藏于此。丢勒的时代、安东·科贝格尔的印刷所与1493年的《纽伦堡编年史》，使它成为德意志文艺复兴的中心。1525年城市接受宗教改革，1532年《纽伦堡宗教和约》在此签订。三十年战争中，华伦斯坦于1632年围城，城市人口几乎减半，此后再未完全恢复，1806年被并入巴伐利亚王国。

en: The Principality of Novgorod-Seversk was a Rurikovich appanage in the basin of the middle Desna and the Seim, with its capital at Novhorod-Siverskyi and chief towns at Kursk, Putivl, Rylsk and Trubchevsk. It was created at the Council of Liubech in 1097 within the Principality of Chernihiv, and from 1164 it passed to a separate Olgovichi line. Its most famous prince, Igor Svyatoslavich, ruled from 1180 to 1198 and led the disastrous 1185 campaign against the Cumans that became the subject of The Tale of Igor's Campaign; his sons briefly held Halych between 1206 and 1212. After the Mongol invasions the principality came under the princes of Bryansk and then of Lithuania. Under Lithuanian rule it passed through the hands of the Gediminid princes Dmitry-Koribut and Švitrigaila, until in 1454 Casimir IV granted it to the fugitive Muscovite prince Ivan Shemyakin. His son Vasily went over to Ivan III, and the truce of 1503 confirmed Novgorod-Seversk as Muscovite. The last appanage prince, Vasily Shemyakin, was arrested and died in prison in 1523, when the principality was abolished.
zh: 诺夫霍罗德-西韦尔斯基公国是留里克王朝的封邑，位于杰斯纳河中游与谢伊姆河流域，以诺夫霍罗德-西韦尔斯基为都，主要城市还有库尔斯克、普季夫利、雷利斯克和特鲁布切夫斯克。它在1097年的柳别奇大会上设立，最初隶属于切尔尼戈夫公国，1164年起由奥利戈维奇家族的单独一支统治。最著名的王公伊戈尔·斯维亚托斯拉维奇于1180—1198年在位，他1185年征伐波洛伏齐人惨败，成为《伊戈尔远征记》的题材；他的儿子们还曾在1206—1212年短暂据有加利奇。蒙古入侵后，公国先后落入布良斯克王公和立陶宛之手。立陶宛统治时期，它几经格迪米纳斯王族的德米特里-科里布特和斯维特里盖拉之手，1454年卡齐米日四世把它封给从莫斯科逃来的伊凡·舍米亚金。其子瓦西里转投伊凡三世，1503年的停战协定确认诺夫霍罗德-西韦尔斯基归属莫斯科。末代封邑王公瓦西里·舍米亚金被捕，1523年死于狱中，公国随即被撤销。

en: Naugard, present-day Nowogard, grew from a fortified Slavic settlement on the Oder Lagoon whose name meant new stronghold in the Pomeranian tongue. It first appears in the records in 1268, when Duke Barnim I of Pomerania enfeoffed the stronghold and its lands to the Bishopric of Cammin, whose bishops built a castle there. From 1274 the estate was administered by Otto von Eberstein, whose family, a Lower Saxon comital line, held Naugard as vassals of the Cammin bishops for centuries. The town received German municipal law in 1309, and in the first half of the fourteenth century it was ringed with new walls around an oblong market square, where the town hall and St Mary's Church went up. When the last Eberstein died in 1663, Naugard passed to Ernst Bogislaw von Croÿ, and in 1684 to the electors of Brandenburg.
zh: 瑙加德（今诺沃加德）起源于奥得河潟湖畔一座设防的斯拉夫聚落，其名字在波美拉尼亚语中意为“新城堡”。它最早见于1268年的记载，当时波美拉尼亚公爵巴尔宁一世把这座要塞及其周围土地封给卡明主教区，主教们在此修建了城堡。1274年起，这份产业由奥托·冯·埃伯施泰因管理，其家族出身下萨克森伯爵支系，作为卡明主教的封臣世代领有瑙加德。1309年该镇获得德意志城市法，14世纪上半叶又绕着长方形集市广场筑起新城墙，广场上建起了市政厅和圣马利亚教堂。1663年末代埃伯施泰因去世后，瑙加德传给恩斯特·波吉斯瓦夫·冯·克罗伊，1684年又转归勃兰登堡选帝侯。

en: Niuwu was a small highland chiefdom of the Hani villages south of Yuanjiang, in the country the Ming called the Hani lands. Early Ming practice granted hereditary native offices to Hani headmen who opened new hill fields, and in 1433 the headmen Ren Zhe and Tuo Bi travelled to Beijing to offer tribute and request regular titles. The Xuande emperor accordingly created the Niuwu Chief's Office under Lin'an Prefecture, naming Ren Zhe chief and Tuo Bi his deputy over the Niuwu and Wulong villages.
zh: 钮兀是元江以南山地的哈尼人小酋邦，辖下钮兀、五隆等寨位于明代所称的和泥之地。明初鼓励垦荒，对率众开辟山田的哈尼首领授予世袭土职。1433年，首领任者、陀比等人到北京朝贡，以辖地偏远、族众众多为由请求授予官职，明宣宗批准设立隶属临安府的钮兀长官司，以任者为长官、陀比为副长官，统领当地寨众。

en: Nyarong, known to the Qing as Zhandui, was a remote agricultural valley on the middle Yalong River in eastern Kham, corresponding to present-day Xinlong County in Sichuan. Its steep, narrow gorge kept it outside the main Tibetan trade routes, and for most of its history it was divided among competing tribes rather than ruled by one prince. Tradition traces its chiefly line to 1253, when the monk Sherap Gyeltsen is said to have knotted an iron club before Kublai Khan and received a seal as chief of the valley, earning the family the name Iron Knot. The Qing organised the area into tusi, creating the Upper and Lower Nyarong commissions in 1728 and the Middle commission in 1745; when the Lower chief Bangön defied the court, the Nyarong campaign of 1746 ended with his flight and a nominal Qing victory, though the isolated valley remained effectively in local hands.
zh: 娘绒清代称瞻对，又名梁茹，是康区东部雅砻江中游的偏僻农业河谷，大体相当于今四川省新龙县。峡谷陡窄，远离藏地主要商路，历史上大多时候由互相争雄的部落分治，而非一统于某位君长。当地首领的世系相传始于1253年：僧人喜饶坚赞在忽必烈面前把铁棍打成结，受封文书和印信，成为娘绒之长，家族也得名铁结。清朝在当地推行土司制度，1728年设上瞻对长官司与下瞻对安抚司，1745年又设中瞻对长官司；下瞻对土司班滚抗命，引发1746年的瞻对之战，最终班滚诈死逃走，清军名义上告捷，而闭塞的河谷实则仍由当地头人掌控。

en: Boeny is the name of the trading settlements around Boina Bay on the northwest coast of Madagascar, the heart of the island's Antalaotra merchant communities. From the tenth and eleventh centuries Arab and Swahili sailors sailing down the East African coast founded Muslim trading posts on this shore, and Antalaotra migrants from the Swahili colonies came to control the Indian Ocean trade of Madagascar's northwest, drawing merchants from East Africa, Arabia and even South and East Asia; by the late fifteenth century the Arab geographer Ibn Majid could list at least a dozen northern ports. Around 1690 the Sakalava prince Andriamandisoarivo built on this coast the kingdom of Boina, also called Iboina or Boeny, served by the port of Mahajanga, where an English captain in 1764 found stone houses, mosques and Muslim traders from Surat, Anjouan, Mozambique and the Comoro Islands. Sakalava rulers allowed the Muslims freedom of worship in exchange for control of trade, until the kingdom was occupied by Imerina after 1832.
zh: 布埃尼是马达加斯加西北海岸布埃纳湾一带贸易定居点的名称，也是岛上安塔劳特拉商人社群的中心。10至11世纪起，沿东非海岸南下的阿拉伯和斯瓦希里水手在这一带建立穆斯林商站，来自斯瓦希里诸殖民地的安塔劳特拉移民逐渐掌控了马达加斯加西北部的印度洋贸易，吸引东非、阿拉伯乃至南亚和东亚的商人；到15世纪末，阿拉伯地理学家伊本·马吉德已能数出北方至少十余个港口。约1690年，萨卡拉瓦王子安德里亚曼迪索阿里沃在这一带建立布埃纳王国，又称伊博伊纳或布埃尼，以马哈赞加为港口；1764年一位英国船长在城中看到石屋、清真寺和来自苏拉特、昂儒昂、莫桑比克与科摩罗群岛的穆斯林商人。萨卡拉瓦诸王允许穆斯林自由信教，以此换取贸易管控权，直到1832年以后王国被伊梅里纳占领。

en: The Duchy of Nysa, German Neisse, was the only ecclesiastical principality among the Silesian duchies alongside Siewierz, ruled by the bishops of Wrocław from their capital at Nysa on the Nysa Kłodzka river, a town probably founded in the tenth century and granted rights around 1223 by Bishop Lawrence. In 1198 Jarosław of Opole, son of Bolesław I the Tall, received the Nysa lands on becoming bishop of Wrocław, and in 1290 Duke Henry IV Probus granted the bishops autonomous privileges there, giving the duchy its legal basis; Bishop Henry of Wierzbna was the first to call himself Duke of Nysa. The Mongols sacked the town in 1241, and under the 1335 Treaty of Trentschin the principality passed under Bohemian suzerainty. Its bishop in 1337 was Nanker, formerly bishop of Kraków and founder of the Gothic Wawel Cathedral, who in that very year excommunicated King John of Bohemia and died at Nysa in 1341. Bishop Przecław of Pogorzeli swore fealty in 1342, helped negotiate the 1348 Treaty of Namysłów and enlarged the state by buying Grodków in 1344. Nysa beat off the Hussites in 1424 and fought the Battle of Nysa in 1428, became a Polish printing centre in the sixteenth century, and was three times besieged in the Thirty Years' War. Prussian troops took it in 1741, and the 1742 Treaty of Breslau split the duchy between Prussia and Austrian Bohemia; the Prussian part was secularized in 1810.
zh: 尼萨公国（德语称奈瑟）是西里西亚诸公国中除谢维日之外唯一的教会公国，由弗罗茨瓦夫主教以尼斯河畔的尼萨城为都进行统治。该城大概建于10世纪，约1223年由主教劳伦斯授予城市权。1198年，博莱斯拉夫一世（“高个子”）之子奥波莱的雅罗斯瓦夫出任弗罗茨瓦夫主教时获得尼萨一带的土地；1290年公爵亨利四世（普罗布斯）授予主教们在当地的自治特权，奠定公国的法律基础，主教亨里克·维日布纳是第一个自称尼萨公爵的人。1241年蒙古人洗劫了该城；根据1335年的《特伦钦条约》，公国转入波希米亚宗主权之下。1337年在任的主教是南克尔，他曾任克拉科夫主教，主持兴建了哥特式的瓦维尔主教座堂，并在这一年绝罚波希米亚国王约翰，1341年在尼萨去世。继任主教波戈热利的普热茨瓦夫1342年宣誓效忠，参与议定1348年的《纳梅斯武夫条约》，又在1344年买下格罗德库夫，扩大了领地。1424年尼萨击退胡斯派，1428年发生尼萨战役；16世纪它成为波兰语印刷中心，三十年战争中三次被围。1741年普鲁士军队攻占该城，1742年的《弗罗茨瓦夫条约》把公国一分为二，北归普鲁士、南属奥地利治下的波希米亚；普鲁士部分于1810年被世俗化。

en: Ningyuan Prefecture was a border native prefecture in the upper Black River valley, in country that now belongs to Vietnam's Lai Chau province. The Yuan created it in 1323, with its seat near modern Lai Chau, and placed it under Yunnan; the Ming transferred it to Lin'an Prefecture in 1382. When the Ming withdrew from Jiaozhi, the territory passed to Annam in 1427 and remained under Vietnamese rule for more than a century. In 1540 Mạc Đăng Dung, ruler of the Mạc dynasty, returned part of the old prefecture to China, and in 1586 the Ming re-established Ningyuan Prefecture, only to abolish it again in 1620.
zh: 宁远州是黑水河上游的边境土州，辖地今属越南莱州省。1323年元朝置州，治所在今莱州一带，隶属云南行省；1382年明朝将其改隶临安府。明军撤出交趾后，其地于1427年归入安南，受越南统治一百余年。1540年，莫朝君主莫登庸把原宁远州的一部分归还明朝，重新并入云南；1586年明朝复置宁远州，1620年又再度废州。

en: Nizhny Novgorod, at the confluence of the Oka and the Volga, was founded in 1221 by Grand Prince Yuri II of Vladimir as a wooden frontier fortress and was the easternmost Russian settlement for a century and a half. In 1264 it passed to the princes of Vladimir-Suzdal, and after its ruling line died out in 1320 the town escheated to the grand prince of Vladimir, which is why in 1337 it was held by Ivan I Kalita of Moscow. In 1341 Konstantin of Suzdal secured Nizhny Novgorod and Gorodets, and in 1350 he moved his seat there from Suzdal and took the title of grand prince, creating the Grand Principality of Nizhny Novgorod-Suzdal, Moscow's chief rival in the mid-fourteenth century. His son Dmitry even occupied the grand-princely throne of Vladimir from 1360 to 1362 and married his daughter to Dmitry Donskoy. The principality founded Kurmysh on the Sura in 1372 but was crushed by the Golden Horde on the Pyana River in 1377, and in 1392 Moscow annexed it, completing the absorption by the mid-fifteenth century. In 1612 the city was the base from which Kuzma Minin and Prince Dmitry Pozharsky raised the militia that liberated Moscow from the Poles.
zh: 下诺夫哥罗德位于奥卡河与伏尔加河交汇处，1221年由弗拉基米尔大公尤里二世修建为木制边防要塞，在一个半世纪里都是罗斯最东端的定居点。1264年它归入弗拉基米尔-苏兹达尔王公治下；1320年当地王公世系断绝，城镇作为绝封领地收归弗拉基米尔大公，这正是1337年它由莫斯科的伊凡一世·卡利塔持有的原因。1341年苏兹达尔的康斯坦丁取得下诺夫哥罗德和戈罗杰茨，1350年又把治所从苏兹达尔迁到这里并自称大公，建立下诺夫哥罗德-苏兹达尔大公国，即14世纪中叶莫斯科的主要竞争者；其子德米特里甚至在1360至1362年登上弗拉基米尔大公之位，并把女儿嫁给德米特里·顿斯科伊。1372年公国在苏拉河畔建立库尔梅什，1377年却在皮亚纳河战役中被金帐汗国击溃；1392年莫斯科兼并该公国，到15世纪中叶完成全部吞并。1612年，库兹马·米宁和德米特里·波扎尔斯基正是以这座城市为基地组建民军，从波兰人手中解放了莫斯科。

en: Nanzan, called Sannan before the eighteenth century, was the southern of the three Sanzan kingdoms of Okinawa, founded around 1314 when the lord of Ōzato withdrew from Tamagusuku's following and entrenched himself at Ōzato Castle on the island's southern bluffs. Small and poor, it lived chiefly by sea trade, its castle's inlet and dock serving junks from China and Southeast Asia. It gained Ming tributary status after Chūzan in 1372, though each mission was limited to one ship; Ofusato, its first known lord, presented himself at the Ming court in 1388 and died while in Korea in 1398. His brother Yafuso then seized power, and King Taromai won Chinese investiture in 1415. Court feuds kept Nanzan weak, and in 1429 Shō Hashi of Chūzan annexed it, completing the unification of Okinawa.
zh: 南山在18世纪以前称山南，是冲绳三山时代三个王国中位置最南的一个，约1314年大里首领脱离玉城，在岛屿南部崖壁上的大里城立寨建国。南山国小民贫，主要依靠海上贸易，大里城的海湾和码头停泊着来自中国和东南亚的商船。1372年中山入贡明朝后，南山也获得朝贡地位，但每次贡使仅限一艘船；已知的初代首领承察度于1388年亲赴明朝宫廷，1398年出使途中死于朝鲜。其弟屋富祖随后夺权，国王他鲁每于1415年获得明朝册封。宫廷内讧使南山始终孱弱，1429年中山的尚巴志将其吞并，完成了冲绳的统一。

en: Oʻahu is the third largest of the Hawaiian Islands, formed of two volcanic mountain ranges with a broad plain between them. Polynesian settlers arrived around the tenth to twelfth century, and in the fifteenth century the island was unified under a single high chief, the aliʻi nui. The first great ruler was Maʻilikūkahi, a lawgiver who founded a dynasty that lasted 304 years; later kings such as Kualiʻi made war on their neighbours and more than once held hegemony over Molokaʻi, while Oʻahu produced the first queen regnant recorded in the islands. In January 1778 Oʻahu was the first Hawaiian island sighted by Captain James Cook, though he landed on Kauaʻi instead, and Charles Clerke first brought a European ship into Waimea Bay the following year. In 1783 Kahekili II of Maui conquered Oʻahu and set his son Kalanikūpule over it as a puppet king. Kalanikūpule was overthrown in 1795, when Kamehameha I broke his army at the Battle of Nuʻuanu and added Oʻahu to the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi.
zh: 瓦胡是夏威夷第三大岛，由两条火山山脉和夹在中间的广阔平原构成。波利尼西亚定居者约在10至12世纪抵达，15世纪全岛统一在一位最高酋长阿利伊努伊之下。第一位伟大的统治者是立法者马伊利库卡希，他开创的王朝延续了304年；此后库阿利伊等好战君王频频对外用兵，不止一次取得对莫洛卡伊的宗主权，瓦胡还出了夏威夷诸岛有记载的第一位女王。1778年1月，瓦胡是库克船长望见的第一个夏威夷岛屿，不过他实际登岸的是考爱；次年查尔斯·克拉克率欧洲船只首次驶入威美亚湾。1783年毛伊国王卡赫基利二世征服瓦胡，立其子卡拉尼库普莱为傀儡王。1795年卡美哈梅哈一世在努阿努山谷之战击溃其军队，卡拉尼库普莱被推翻，瓦胡并入夏威夷王国。

en: Oapan was one of the Coixca towns of the multiethnic Coixcatlalpan country in northern Guerrero, in the present-day municipality of Tepecoacuilco, where Nahuatl-speaking Coixca communities were interspersed with Tlapanec and Chontal villages. Like the other Coixca settlements it held out against Aztec expansion for a long time before accepting the rule of Tenochtitlan.
zh: 奥阿潘是格雷罗北部多族杂处的科伊什卡特尔潘地区的科伊克斯卡城镇之一，其地在今特佩科阿奎尔科境内；讲纳瓦特尔语的科伊克斯卡聚落在那里与特拉帕内克、琼塔尔人的村落交错分布。与其他科伊克斯卡聚落一样，它曾长期抵抗阿兹特克扩张，最终才接受特诺奇蒂特兰的统治。

en: Obwalden is the upper valley of Unterwalden, south of Lake Lucerne around the town of Sarnen, with the Engelberg valley as an exclave. Alemannic settlers moved in around 700, and after Emperor Conrad II's campaign of 1032 to 1033 the land belonged to the Holy Roman Empire and was enfeoffed to the counts of Lenzburg. As part of Unterwalden it joined Schwyz and Uri in the Eternal Alliance of 1291, and in 1309 Emperor Henry VII granted the valleys imperial immediacy. Its men fought at Morgarten in 1315, guarding the Brünig Pass, and renewed the alliance at Brunnen. During the fourteenth century the valley communities built their own government around the open-air assembly, which in 1382 excluded the Hunwil noble family from office; Obwalden then fought at Sempach in 1386 and joined Uri in seizing the Leventina in 1403, only to lose the southern conquests after the defeat at Arbedo in 1422. In 1481 its hermit Niklaus von der Flüe mediated the Stans compromise that kept the confederation together and admitted Fribourg and Solothurn. Obwalden rejected the Reformation, sent troops over the Brünig in 1528 and stood with the Catholic cantons through the Kappel wars. In 1798 it became the district of Sarnen in the Helvetic canton of Waldstätten, and the Act of Mediation of 1803 re-established it as the half-canton of Obwalden.
zh: 上瓦尔登是翁特瓦尔登的上游谷地，位于卢塞恩湖以南、萨尔嫩城一带，恩格尔贝格谷地是它的飞地。约700年阿勒曼尼人迁入，1032—1033年皇帝康拉德二世远征后，此地归入神圣罗马帝国，被封给伦茨堡伯爵。作为翁特瓦尔登的一部分，它在1291年与施维茨、乌利结成永久同盟；1309年皇帝亨利七世授予诸谷地帝国直辖地位。1315年它的乡民在莫尔加滕作战、守卫布吕尼格山口，随后在布伦嫩续签盟约。14世纪，谷地诸社区围绕露天议会建立起自己的政府，1382年露天议会禁止洪维尔贵族家族担任官职；上瓦尔登后来参加了1386年的森帕赫之战，1403年与乌利联手夺取莱文蒂纳，但1422年在阿尔贝多战败后丧失了南方征服地。1481年，当地隐士尼克劳斯·冯·德·弗吕促成施坦斯妥协，使同盟免于破裂，弗里堡和索洛图恩由此入盟。上瓦尔登拒绝宗教改革，1528年派兵越过布吕尼格山口，并在卡佩尔战争中始终站在天主教诸州一边。1798年它成为海尔维第森林州的萨尔嫩区，1803年《调解法令》重新确立它为上瓦尔登半州。

en: The Duchy of Oleśnica, known in German as Oels, was a Silesian duchy with its capital at Oleśnica in Lower Silesia. The lands first belonged to the Duchy of Głogów before becoming a separate duchy in 1313 for Bolesław, a son of Duke Henry III of Głogów; from 1321 it was ruled by his brother Konrad I, the Piast duke still holding power in 1337. To shield himself from rival Piast claims and from the Polish king Władysław I, Konrad swore allegiance to King John of Bohemia in 1329, and Oleśnica remained a Bohemian fief. His successors enlarged it by buying up neighbouring estates and acquiring Koźle in 1355, although the Hussites overran the country during the Hussite Wars in 1432. The local Piast line ended with Duke Konrad X in 1492, and after a short dispute the duchy passed in 1495 to the Poděbrad dukes of Münsterberg. When that family died out in 1647 the Habsburg emperor enfeoffed Silvius Nimrod of Württemberg, whose house kept Oleśnica until Prussia conquered it with the rest of Silesia in 1742. In 1792 it passed to the Welf dukes of Brunswick-Lüneburg.
zh: 奥莱希尼察公国（德语称厄尔斯）是西里西亚诸公国之一，都于下西里西亚的奥莱希尼察。这片土地原属格沃古夫公国，1313年格沃古夫公爵亨里克三世之子博莱斯瓦夫受封，成为独立公国；1321年起由其弟康拉德一世统治，他正是1337年在位的皮亚斯特公爵。为抵御皮亚斯特同族的争夺和波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫一世的压力，康拉德于1329年向波希米亚国王约翰宣誓效忠，奥莱希尼察此后一直是波希米亚的封邑。他的继承者们不断收购邻近地产，又在1355年取得科伊兹莱，扩大了疆域；但在1432年的胡斯战争中，胡斯派军队曾席卷此地。当地皮亚斯特支系于1492年随着公爵康拉德十世去世而终结，经过短暂争执，公国于1495年转入波杰布拉德家族的明斯特贝格公爵手中。该家族1647年绝嗣后，哈布斯堡皇帝把公国封给符腾堡的西尔维乌斯·尼姆罗德，符腾堡家族一直保有它，直到1742年普鲁士随整个西里西亚将其征服。1792年它转归不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的韦尔夫公爵。

en: The County of Oettingen was the Swabian estate of the House of Oettingen, a noble family related to the Hohenstaufen and first documented as counts in 1147, with lands around the imperial city of Nördlingen. From the twelfth to the fourteenth century the Oettingens built up the largest secular territory in eastern Swabia, and in 1337 it was ruled by Count Louis VI. The county began to split into branches with the partition of 1410: the main Oettingen-Oettingen line turned Protestant and was raised to princes in 1674 but died out in 1731, while the Catholic Oettingen-Wallerstein and Oettingen-Spielberg lines inherited its lands and became princely houses in 1774 and 1734. In the mediatisation of 1806 the county passed to Bavaria, and part of it was ceded to Württemberg in 1810.
zh: 厄廷根伯国是厄廷根家族的施瓦本领地。该贵族世家与霍亨斯陶芬家族有亲缘，1147年首次以伯爵身份见于记载，领地围绕帝国城市内德林根展开。12至14世纪，厄廷根家族积累起东施瓦本最大的世俗领地，1337年在位的是路易六世伯爵。1410年伯国首次分家：主支厄廷根-厄廷根皈依新教，于1674年升为亲王，但1731年绝嗣；信奉天主教的厄廷根-瓦勒施泰因和厄廷根-施皮尔贝格两支继承其地，分别于1774年和1734年成为亲王家族。1806年的陪臣化浪潮中，伯国并入巴伐利亚，1810年其一部分被割让给符腾堡。

en: Offenburg stands at the mouth of the Kinzig valley where it opens into the Upper Rhine plain, a position that earned it the name gateway to the Black Forest. Roman remains have been found on its territory, and the town itself is first documented in 1148 under the rule of the Zähringer; by 1240 it was a free imperial city, though it was more than once pledged away by the crown. Emperor Frederick II made use of the Kinzig valley silver mines and had silver denars struck at the Offenburg imperial mint, until King Albert closed the mint in 1300. The town was ringed by three walls with numerous towers, and from 1500 it sat in the Swabian Imperial Circle. It briefly accepted the Reformation after 1525 but returned to Catholicism after 1530, and between 1586 and 1631 it held witch trials that put 104 people on trial and executed 89. The wars of Louis XIV brought ruin: French troops occupied it in 1688, and on 9 September 1689 they burned the town to the ground, sparing only the Capuchin monastery and two houses. Rebuilt after the disaster, Offenburg kept its imperial status until the Reichsdeputationshauptschluss of 1803 assigned it to the Grand Duchy of Baden.
zh: 奥芬堡位于金齐希河谷通往上莱茵平原的出口，这一位置为它赢得“黑林山门户”之称。其境内发现有罗马时代遗迹，城市本身则在1148年策林根家族统治时期首见记载；1240年它已成为帝国自由市，但后来又被王室多次抵押。皇帝腓特烈二世利用金齐希河谷的银矿，在奥芬堡的帝国造币厂铸造银迪纳厄斯，1300年国王阿尔布雷希特关闭了这家造币厂。城市由三道城墙环绕，墙上塔楼林立，1500年起被划入施瓦本帝国行政区。1525年后它一度接受宗教改革，1530年后又回归天主教；1586至1631年间这里滥施猎巫审判，104人受审、89人被处死。路易十四的战争给它带来灭顶之灾：1688年法军占领该城，1689年9月9日又纵火将全城夷为平地，仅嘉布遣会修道院和两栋房屋幸免。灾后重建的奥芬堡保住了帝国城市地位，直到1803年的《帝国代表重要决议》把它划归巴登大公国。

en: The Ögedei were the descendants of Ögedei Khan, Genghis Khan's third son and the Mongol Empire's second great khan, whose appanage lay on the upper Irtysh and around the Emil River. After the Toluid seizure of the great khanate in 1251, the house was overshadowed until Kaidu, a grandson of Ögedei, built a powerful steppe state from the 1260s, dominated the Chagatai Khanate, briefly occupied Karakorum and waged decades of war against Kublai and his Yuan successors before his death in 1301. His heir Chapar submitted to the Yuan in 1310, and the Ögedei lands were partitioned between the Yuan and the Chagataids. Ögedeid princes kept small appanages on the Irtysh as Yuan vassals, while other members of the house later sat as puppet khans in the Chagatai realm and the Northern Yuan. In 1337 the horde on the Irtysh was held by Temurchi of the Borjigin clan.
zh: 窝阔台人是成吉思汗第三子、蒙古帝国第二任大汗窝阔台的后裔，其封地在额尔齐斯河上游与叶密立河一带。1251年拖雷系夺取大汗之位后，该家族一度失势，直到窝阔台之孙海都在13世纪60年代建起强大的草原政权，控制察合台汗国，一度攻占哈拉和林，与忽必烈及其元朝继承者鏖战数十年，直至1301年死去。他的继承人察八儿于1310年向元朝投降，窝阔台的领地被元朝与察合台汗国瓜分。窝阔台系诸王仍在额尔齐斯河一带保留小块封地，作为元朝的附庸；家族另一些成员后来则在察合台汗国和北元充当傀儡汗王。1337年，额尔齐斯河上的这支游牧部落由孛儿只斤氏的塔哈察儿统领。

en: Ouargla is one of the oldest oasis towns of the Algerian Sahara, built on what was once the largest palm grove in the country. Its Berber inhabitants, the Banu Wargla, a Zenata people, adopted Ibadi Islam in the eighth century under the Rustamid imams, and when the Fatimids destroyed the Rustamid capital of Tahert in 909, Ibadi refugees founded Sedrata nearby, a wealthy caravan city whose ruins lie just south of the modern town. Sedrata was itself destroyed in the thirteenth century and Ouargla then became the chief centre of the region, usually independent under local dynasties but at times acknowledging the Hafsids of Tunis and the Arab emirs of Biskra. Ibn Khaldun called it the gate of the desert, the obligatory passage for merchants travelling from the M'zab to the Sudan, and medieval writers spoke of a land of Ouargla dotted with a hundred villages. As the gold roads shifted and Touggourt drew the caravans away, Ouargla declined, and in 1552 Salah Raïs of Algiers made it pay tribute; it was afterwards attached to the Beylik of Constantine, with the Friday prayer pronounced in the name of the Ottoman caliph.
zh: 瓦尔格拉是阿尔及利亚撒哈拉最古老的绿洲城镇之一，建在曾为全国最大椰枣林的绿洲之上。它的柏柏尔居民巴努瓦尔格拉人属泽纳塔族群，8世纪在罗斯图姆伊玛目治下皈依伊巴德派伊斯兰教；909年法蒂玛王朝摧毁罗斯图姆都城塔赫特后，伊巴德派难民在附近建起富庶的商队城塞德拉塔，遗址就在今城以南。塞德拉塔本身于13世纪被毁，瓦尔格拉从此成为地区首邑，通常由本地王朝独立统治，但有时也承认突尼斯哈夫斯王朝和比斯克拉阿拉伯埃米尔的权威。伊本·赫勒敦称它为‘沙漠门户’，是姆扎卜商人携货前往苏丹地区的必经之地，中世纪作家笔下的‘瓦尔格兰之地’村落以百计。后来黄金商路改道、图古尔特吸走商队，瓦尔格拉走向衰落；1552年阿尔及尔的萨拉赫·赖斯迫其纳贡，此后它被并入君士坦丁贝伊里克，周五的呼图白以奥斯曼哈里发的名义诵读。

en: Ohkwee Ówîngeh is a Tewa pueblo of the Tanoan-speaking Pueblo peoples, standing on the Rio Grande in present-day northern New Mexico. It was founded around 1200, during the Pueblo III period, by Tewa groups whose traditions trace a migration from valleys farther north. In 1598 the expedition of Juan de Oñate was received at the pueblo, which he renamed San Juan de los Caballeros and made the first Spanish capital of New Mexico; the seat of government moved to Santa Fe in 1610. A Tewa religious leader born here, Po'pay, was among the pueblo elders flogged and imprisoned in 1675, and in 1680 he organized the Pueblo Revolt that drove the Spanish out of New Mexico for twelve years. Diego de Vargas reconquered the Rio Grande pueblos in 1692, after which San Juan Pueblo lived under Spanish and later Mexican rule.
zh: 奥奎‑奥温格是说塔诺语族特瓦语的普韦布洛人的一座村镇，位于今新墨西哥州北部的里奥格兰德河畔。它约建于1200年的普韦布洛第三时期，建村的特瓦群体口传自己来自更北边的河谷。1598年，胡安·德·奥尼亚特的远征队在此受到接待，他把这座村镇改名为圣胡安·德·洛斯·卡瓦列罗斯，定为新墨西哥的第一个西班牙首府；1610年治所迁往圣菲。出生于此的特瓦宗教领袖波·依是1675年遭鞭笞监禁的普韦布洛长老之一，1680年他组织普韦布洛起义，把西班牙人逐出新墨西哥达十二年之久。1692年迭戈·德·巴尔加斯重新征服里奥格兰德诸普韦布洛，此后圣胡安普韦布洛先后处于西班牙和墨西哥的统治之下。

en: Oriel is the anglicised form of Airgíalla, once a confederation of nine small kingdoms across central Ulster, said in legend to have been founded by the Three Collas after they wrested the country from the Ulaid. From the eighth century the confederation fell under the domination of the Cenél nEógain and the O'Neills, and it reached its medieval height in the twelfth century under King Donnchad Ua Cerbaill. The Anglo-Norman invasion stripped away its eastern lands in Louth, leaving a reduced kingdom in what is now County Monaghan, ruled from 1243 by the MacMahons. Wedged between the expanding Tudor state and the O'Neills of Tyrone, Rossa Boy MacMahon surrendered the lordship to the crown in 1585, when it was shired as County Monaghan and divided into five baronies. The MacMahons joined the Irish rebellion of 1641, and after its defeat their lands passed to Protestant settlers.
zh: 奥里尔是 Airgíalla 的英语化名称，它曾是横跨阿尔斯特中部、由九个小王国组成的部族联盟，传说由“三科拉”从乌拉德人手中夺地后建立。8世纪起，联盟逐步受制于康尼尔·欧文和奥尼尔家族，12世纪在唐查德·乌阿·塞拜尔王治下达到中世纪鼎盛。盎格鲁-诺曼入侵削去了它在劳斯的东部疆土，残存的王国退守今莫纳亨郡一带，1243年起由麦克马洪（Mac Mathghamhna，意为“熊之子”）家族统治。由于夹在扩张中的都铎政权与蒂龙奥尼尔家族之间，罗萨·博伊·麦克马洪于1585年向王室交土再封，领地被划为莫纳亨郡，分成五个男爵区。1641年麦克马洪家族参加爱尔兰起事，失败后土地尽归新教定居者。

en: Oke-Ila, fully Oke-Ila Orangun, is an ancient Igbomina-Yoruba city-state in north-eastern Yorubaland and the sister kingdom of Ila Orangun. Both grew out of the old kingdom of Ila Yara, founded according to legend by Fagbamila, called Orangun, a son of Oduduwa. In the late 1400s a quarrel between the brother-princes Apakiimo and Arutu Oluokun split the kingdom: Arutu's followers moved away to found Ila-Magbon and later Ila Orangun, while Apakiimo, the legitimate Orangun, led his own faction east to a settlement named Igbohun, the site of the present-day town of Oke-Ila. A segment of the neighbouring Isedo royalty joined the migration and took the title of Obala, ranking next to the Orangun and acting as regent during interregnums. Ringed by quartzite ridges and gorges, the kingdom kept its Igbomina dialect and its distinctive Elewe ancestor-masquerade tradition, and both it and Ila retain the Orangun royal title to the present day.
zh: 奥凯伊拉全称为奥凯伊拉奥朗甘，是约鲁巴兰东北部古老的伊博米纳约鲁巴城邦，与伊拉奥朗贡为姊妹王国。两者都源自古伊拉雅拉王国——相传该国由奥杜杜瓦之子法格巴米拉（人称奥兰甘）建立。15世纪末，阿帕基莫与阿鲁图·奥卢奥昆两位王子相争，王国分裂：阿鲁图一派出走，先建伊拉马格邦，后发展为伊拉奥朗贡；正统奥兰甘阿帕基莫则率本支东迁至名为伊格博洪的定居点，即今天奥凯伊拉镇的所在地。邻近伊塞多王族的一支也随同迁徙，获封“奥巴拉”头衔，地位仅次于奥兰甘，并在王位空悬时担任摄政。王国四周环绕着石英岩山脊与峡谷，保留着伊博米纳方言和独特的埃莱韦祖先假面舞传统；它与伊拉两国此后都沿用奥兰甘王号。

en: The County of Oldenburg was a territory of the Holy Roman Empire on the lower Weser and Hunte, centred on the town of Oldenburg, first mentioned in 1108 as Aldenburg at a ford of the Hunte. Its counts traced their line to the Saxon leader Widukind and held Delmenhorst and Elsfleth around a modest core overshadowed by the Hanseatic city of Bremen; in the thirteenth century they seized large Frisian lands to the north in a series of wars. The family's fortunes changed in 1448, when Count Christian was elected King of Denmark and soon also of Norway and Sweden, leaving Oldenburg to his brothers; in 1460 it passed to Gerhard and became independent of the Danish crown. Count Anton I introduced the Reformation and dissolved the monasteries, reuniting Delmenhorst in 1547, and Anton Günther, who ruled from 1603, kept his lands out of the Thirty Years' War by armed neutrality and secured the right to levy tolls on the Weser. When he died without heirs in 1667 the main line became extinct and Oldenburg was administered from Copenhagen until the Treaty of Tsarskoye Selo in 1773, when it passed to the Holstein-Gottorp branch; in 1774 it was raised to a duchy.
zh: 奥尔登堡伯国是神圣罗马帝国在威悉河下游与洪特河一带的邦国，以奥尔登堡镇为中心；该镇1108年首见记载，称阿尔登堡，位于洪特河的一处渡口。奥尔登堡伯爵自称世系可上溯萨克森领袖维杜金德，领有代尔门霍斯特和埃尔斯弗莱特，核心领地不大，长期处在汉萨城市不来梅的阴影之下；13世纪，他们通过一系列战争夺取了北方大片弗里斯兰土地。1448年家族命运改变：伯爵克里斯蒂安当选丹麦国王，不久又成为挪威和瑞典国王，把奥尔登堡留给诸弟治理；1460年领地传给格哈德，脱离丹麦王冠独立。安东一世伯爵推行宗教改革、解散修道院，并于1547年重新合并代尔门霍斯特。1603年继位的安东·京特尔以武装中立使领地免于三十年战争的破坏，还取得威悉河征税权。1667年他无嗣而终，主支绝嗣，奥尔登堡改由哥本哈根管理；1773年依据《沙皇村条约》转入荷尔斯泰因-戈托普支系之手，1774年升格为公国。

en: Oman in 1337 was the kingdom of the Nabhanids, hereditary kings of the Azdi Arab Banu Nabhan, who had taken power in 1154 when the Seljuk Turks were expelled from the country. From their fortified capitals at Nizwa and Bahla they ruled the interior while the elected Ibadi imams were reduced to a largely symbolic role, and they grew rich on the overland frankincense trade that ran from Sohar through the Yabrin oasis toward Bahrain, Baghdad and Damascus. The coast often slipped from their grasp to the Kingdom of Hormuz, with which the Nabhanid kings maintained a working accord. From the fifteenth century the Ibadi imamate regained strength: the imam Muhammad ibn Ismail deposed the Nabhanid ruler Suleiman bin Mudhafar around 1500, and in 1507 the Portuguese seized Muscat and spread along the coast. The Nabhanids held out in Bahla until 1624, when Nasir bin Murshid of the Ya'Aruba founded a new imamate and ended the dynasty's rule.
zh: 1337年的阿曼是纳卜汉王朝的王国。纳卜汉人属艾兹德阿拉伯人的巴努·纳卜汉部落，1154年塞尔柱突厥人被逐出阿曼后掌权。他们以奈兹瓦和巴赫莱等设防都城统治内陆，使选举产生的伊巴德派伊玛目沦为象征性角色，并靠陆上乳香贸易致富，商队从苏哈尔出发，经叶卜林绿洲运往巴林、巴格达和大马士革。沿海地带常落入霍尔木兹王国之手，纳卜汉国王便与其维持协作。15世纪起伊巴德伊玛目势力复兴：1500年前后，伊玛目穆罕默德·伊本·伊斯梅尔废黜纳卜汉君主苏莱曼·本·穆扎法尔；1507年葡萄牙人攻占马斯喀特并沿海岸扩张。纳卜汉人退守巴赫莱，直到1624年雅鲁巴家族的纳西尔·本·穆尔希德建立新伊玛目政权，王朝统治告终。

en: Ometepec, called Yucuvui in Mixtec and meaning “at the two hills” in both Mixtec and Nahuatl, was a town of the Amuzgo people in the Yacuyagua mountains of the Costa Chica, where the coasts of Guerrero and Oaxaca meet. The older Amuzgo dominion, whose capital was Xochistlahuaca, was subjugated by the Mixtecs around 1100 and for some three centuries paid tribute in cotton, cloth, feathers, hides, gold, maize and chillies as part of the Mixtec province of Ayacastla. The Aztecs conquered Ayacastla in 1457 but never held it directly or completely; Amuzgo revolts in 1494 and again between 1504 and 1507 had to be put down by force, and Ometepec was made the seat of an Aztec strategic province covering Azoyú, San Luis Acatlán, Igualapa and Xochistlahuaca, whose cotton, gold and cacao flowed to Tenochtitlan. The townsfolk spoke Amuzgo alongside the now-vanished Ayacastec tongue. Pedro de Alvarado subjugated the region for Spain in 1522, and war, disease and forced labour so shattered its people that colonial writers counted the Amuzgos among the handful of native ethnicities to survive the collapse; in 1818 the old province's capital was moved from Igualapa to Ometepec.
zh: 奥梅特佩克在米斯特克语中称尤库武伊，其米斯特克语和纳瓦特尔语名字的意思都是“两山之间”，是科斯塔奇卡亚库亚瓜山区的阿穆斯戈人城镇，地处格雷罗与瓦哈卡海岸交界。更古老的阿穆斯戈领地以索奇斯特拉瓦卡为都，约1100年被米斯特克人征服，此后约三百年间作为米斯特克阿亚卡斯特拉省的一部分，缴纳棉花、布匹、羽毛、兽皮、黄金、玉米和辣椒。阿兹特克人于1457年征服阿亚卡斯特拉，但始终未能直接、完全地控制这里；阿穆斯戈人在1494年以及1504至1507年间的起义都被武力镇压，奥梅特佩克则被设为阿兹特克战略省的治所，辖有阿索尤、圣路易斯阿卡特兰、伊瓜拉帕和索奇斯特拉瓦卡，当地的棉花、黄金和可可源源不断运往特诺奇蒂特兰。居民除阿穆斯戈语外还讲现已消亡的阿亚卡斯特克语。1522年，佩德罗·德阿尔瓦拉多为西班牙征服了该地区，战争、疾病和苦役使人口锐减，殖民时代的作者把阿穆斯戈人列为大崩溃中幸存下来的少数原住民族群之一；1818年，旧省的首府从伊瓜拉帕迁至奥梅特佩克。

en: The Ondo Kingdom is a forest Yoruba state in the country south-east of Ife, with its capital at Ode Ondo. Its founder was the princess Pupupu, driven out of Ile-Ife in about the early 1500s because she had borne twins, then seen as an ill omen; she led her followers south to Ile-Oluji and her line went on to rule Ondo, where she is remembered as its first Osemawe, the title still borne by its kings. Her son Airo later took power in a palace coup, built the royal palace and organised the state around four ruling houses, from each of which an Osemawe was chosen in turn. Unusually for the region, Ondo governed through strong chiefs' councils, including a women's council that sat alongside the men's, with six leading high chiefs under the king. It kept its independence through the age of Oyo's dominance, but in the nineteenth century the Atlantic slave trade and the upheavals of the Yoruba wars brought repeated coups, wars and three changes of capital.
zh: 翁多王国是伊费东南森林地带的约鲁巴政权，首都为奥德翁多。开国者是公主普普普：约在16世纪初，她因生下双胞胎（当时被视为凶兆）而被逐出伊莱-伊费，遂率部众南下抵达伊莱奥卢吉，她的后裔后来统治翁多，她本人被尊为第一代“奥塞马韦”——翁多国王世代沿用的王号。她的儿子艾罗后来通过宫廷政变掌权，修建王宫，并把国家围绕四个王族重新编组，奥塞马韦便由四族轮流选出。翁多的治理在当地颇不寻常：它依靠强势的酋长会议，甚至设有与男性会议并立的女性会议，国王之下有六位首席大酋长。它在奥约称霸的年代里始终保持独立，但到19世纪，大西洋奴隶贸易和约鲁巴战乱的冲击带来了接连不断的政变、战争，首都也三度迁移。

en: The Onondowa'ga, or Great Hill People, are the Seneca, the westernmost of the five founding nations of the Haudenosaunee and thus Keepers of the Western Door. Their palisaded towns, among them Ganondagan with its hundred and fifty longhouses, lay between the Genesee River and Canandaigua Lake, south of Lake Ontario; by the seventeenth century they were the league's most populous nation, numbering perhaps four thousand. After entering the fur trade first with the Dutch and then the English, they led the confederacy in the long war against the Wendat, who surrendered in 1648, and went on to defeat the Neutrals in 1650, the Erie in 1653 and the Susquehannock in 1675, carrying Haudenosaunee power from Canada to the Ohio Country. In 1687 the French governor Denonville landed at Irondequoit Bay and destroyed Ganondagan and other towns, after which the Seneca anchored the league's alliance with England. Most Seneca fought for the crown in the American Revolution, and Sullivan's campaign of 1779 burned their villages and stores; the nation rebuilt on the Buffalo Creek, Tonawanda and Cattaraugus reservations confirmed by the treaties of Fort Stanwix in 1784, Canandaigua in 1794 and Big Tree in 1797. The Seneca prophet Handsome Lake, author of the Longhouse code, died at Onondaga in 1815, and in the early nineteenth century his followers kept the Longhouse religion alive on the reservations amid growing settler pressure.
zh: 奥农多瓦加意为“大山丘之人”，即塞内卡人，是霍迪诺肖尼五个创始族中位置最西的一族，因而号称“西门的守护者”。他们设有栅栏的村镇——包括拥有一百五十座长屋的加农达甘——分布在安大略湖以南、杰纳西河与卡南代瓜湖之间；到17世纪，他们已是联盟中人口最多的一族，约有四千人。塞内卡人先与荷兰人、后与英国人进行毛皮贸易，并率领联盟同温达特人长期作战，于1648年迫其投降，又在1650年击败中立族、1653年击败伊利人、1675年击败萨斯奎哈诺克人，把霍迪诺肖尼的势力从加拿大扩展到俄亥俄地区。1687年，法国总督德农维尔在伊隆德阔伊特湾登陆，摧毁加农达甘等城镇，此后塞内卡人成为联盟与英格兰同盟的支柱。美国独立战争中多数塞内卡人为英王而战，1779年沙利文远征焚毁了他们的村庄与存粮；全族在布法罗溪、托纳旺达和卡特劳格斯保留地重建家园，这些土地先后经1784年斯坦威克斯堡条约、1794年卡南代瓜条约和1797年大树条约确认。塞内卡先知“英俊湖”是长屋宗教法典的创立者，1815年在奥农达加去世；19世纪初，他的信徒们在移民日增的压力下，于各保留地维系着长屋信仰。

en: The Ononda'gega', or People of the Hills, are the Onondaga, the central nation of the five founding peoples of the Haudenosaunee. Their towns stood around the lake and valley that still bear their name in present-day central New York. As the Keepers of the Fire, they tended the confederacy's eternal flame, and the league's grand council met at Onondaga, making their capital the seat of Haudenosaunee government. Oral tradition makes them the last nation to accept the Great Peace: the chief Tadodaho was healed of his cruelty by the Great Peacemaker, Hiawatha and Jigonhsasee, an event dated by a remembered solar eclipse to around 1142, while radiocarbon evidence places Onondaga villages in the region from about 1200. Their nine clans, led by clan mothers, traced descent through the female line. Officially neutral at the start of the American Revolution, the Onondaga turned against the Americans after their main village was attacked in April 1779, and Sullivan's expedition then laid waste their country. Many followed Joseph Brant to British land on the Grand River, though those who remained had their homeland rights recognized in the Treaty of Canandaigua of 1794.
zh: 奥农达格加意为“山丘之人”，即奥农达人，是霍迪诺肖尼五个创始族中居于中央的一族。他们的村镇分布在今纽约州中部仍以其族名命名的湖泊与谷地一带。作为“火焰的守护者”，他们守护联盟的长明火，联盟大议会也在奥农达加召开，使其都城成为霍迪诺肖尼的政府所在地。口传传统称他们是最后接受“大和平”的一族：酋长塔多达霍的残暴被和平使者、海华沙和吉贡萨塞治愈，后人凭记忆中的日食把此事定在约1142年，而碳十四测年显示约1200年时当地已有奥农达加村落。他们有九个由氏族母主领导的氏族，世系按母系传承。美国独立战争爆发时奥农达人名义上保持中立，1779年4月其主村遭到美军攻击后转而反美，沙利文远征随即蹂躏了他们的家园。许多人随约瑟夫·布兰特前往英王授予的格兰德河土地，留下的人则在1794年的卡南代瓜条约中获得了对故土权利的承认。

en: The Oiniwars, also called the Sugauna dynasty, were a line of Maithil Brahmin kings who ruled the Mithila plain of northern Bihar from 1325 to 1526. The family's founder Nath Thakur served the last Karnat rajas and was granted the village of Oini, from which the clan took its name; his son Kameshwar Thakur, formerly chief priest at the Karnat court, inherited the throne when the Karnat kingdom collapsed in 1324, and he still reigned in 1337. In all twenty-one rulers followed, shifting their capital from town to town and patronising roads, forts, temples and tanks. Their court made Mithila a literary land: the poet Vidyapati, born around 1352, served seven kings and two queens and wrote the Kirtilata for King Kirtisimha, while gold coins of Sivasimha and silver coins of Bhairavasimha, struck around 1489, carried the rulers' names. The dynasty ended when its last king Laxminath Singh Deva was murdered by Nusrat Shah of Bengal; thirty years of fighting between rival clans followed before the Maithil Brahmins of Raj Darbhanga took over the region.
zh: 乌尼瓦尔王朝又称苏高纳王朝，是1325至1526年间统治比哈尔北部弥萨罗平原的迈蒂利婆罗门王系。家族始祖纳特·他俱罗曾效力于卡尔纳特末代诸王，受封奥伊尼村，部族便以此得名；其子卡梅什瓦尔·他俱罗本是卡尔纳特宫廷的首席祭司，1324年卡尔纳特王国崩溃后继承王位，1337年仍在位。其后共有二十一代统治者，都城屡迁，沿途资助道路、要塞、神庙和水池的修建。他们的宫廷使弥萨罗成为文翰之邦：约1352年出生的诗人维德亚帕蒂先后侍奉七位国王和两位王后，为基尔蒂辛哈王写下《基尔蒂拉塔》；湿婆辛哈的金币和约1489年铸造的拜罗沃辛哈银币上都镌有王名。王朝末年，末代国王拉克希米纳特·辛哈·提婆被孟加拉的努斯拉特沙阿杀害，此后诸部族混战三十年，最终由达尔彭加的迈蒂利婆罗门家族接掌该地区。

en: The Onyota'aka, the People of the Standing Stone, are better known as the Oneida, one of the five founding nations of the Haudenosaunee. Their homeland lay around Oneida Lake in central present-day New York, between the Mohawk to the east and the Onondaga to the west, where they farmed from the fourteenth century and lived in bark-covered longhouse towns. Their name comes from a legend in which the nation vanished from pursuers among the standing stones of a forest clearing. French raiders and the Dutch arms trade at New Amsterdam drew them into the fur-trade wars of the seventeenth century. When the American Revolution split the confederacy, the Oneida alone mostly sided with the rebels, partly through the work of the Presbyterian missionary Samuel Kirkland, who had lived among them since 1764: about fifty of their warriors fought at the Battle of Oriskany in 1777, and Polly Cooper carried maize to Washington's starving army at Valley Forge. Their chief Skenandoa kept the nation on the American side, but postwar land cessions, confirmed by the Fort Stanwix treaty of 1784 and the Canandaigua treaty of 1794, steadily reduced their territory, and in the 1820s and 1830s many Oneida migrated west to Wisconsin or joined communities in Ontario.
zh: 奥尼奥塔阿卡意为“立石之人”，更常见的称呼是奥奈达人，是霍迪诺肖尼五创始族之一。他们的家园在今纽约州中部的奥奈达湖一带，东接莫霍克人、西连奥农达人；他们从14世纪起务农，住在覆以树皮的长屋村镇里。其族名来自一则传说：敌人追入林间空地时，全族忽然消失在林立的石头之间，因而得名。17世纪，法国人的袭击和新阿姆斯特丹的荷兰武器贸易把他们卷入毛皮战争。美国独立战争使联盟分裂，唯独奥奈达人大多站在革命者一边，部分原因是1764年起便在他们中间生活的长老会传教士塞缪尔·柯克兰的影响：1777年约五十名奥奈达战士参加了奥里斯卡尼战役，波利·库珀还把玉米送到福吉谷，接济华盛顿缺粮的军队。酋长斯肯南多带领全族亲美，但战后的土地割让——经1784年斯坦威克斯堡条约和1794年卡南代瓜条约确认——使他们的领地不断缩小；19世纪20至30年代，许多奥奈达人西迁威斯康星，或加入安大略的同族社区。

en: The Duchy of Opole, with its capital at Opole in Upper Silesia, was one of the Silesian duchies of the Piast dynasty. It first appeared in 1172 for Duke Jarosław, but in 1202 it was merged with Racibórz into the united Upper Silesian Duchy of Opole and Racibórz. When that union was divided again in 1281, Opole re-emerged under its own Piast dukes, at the same time as the neighbouring duchies of Cieszyn and Bytom were carved from the old Racibórz lands. In 1327 its rulers paid homage to King John the Blind of Bohemia, so that in 1337 the duke, Bolko II, held Opole as a Bohemian fief. Repeated partitions shrank the duchy until the early sixteenth century, when Duke Jan II the Good reunited Opole with Racibórz in 1521. Jan died without heirs in 1532, the Opole Piast line became extinct, and the duchy reverted to the Bohemian Crown, which enfeoffed the Hohenzollern margrave George of Brandenburg-Ansbach. Between 1645 and 1666 it was held in fee by the Polish Vasas before returning to the Habsburgs, and in 1742 the Treaty of Berlin handed Opole to Prussia after the First Silesian War.
zh: 奥波莱公国是皮亚斯特王朝治下的西里西亚诸公国之一，都于上西里西亚的奥波莱。它最早出现于1172年，封给公爵雅罗斯瓦夫，1202年与拉齐布日合并为上西里西亚的奥波莱-拉齐布日联合公国。1281年联合公国再度分裂，奥波莱在本支皮亚斯特公爵治下重新独立，邻近的切申和比托姆公国也同时从旧拉齐布日领地中划出。1327年，它的统治者向波希米亚国王“盲人”约翰行臣服礼，因此1337年在位的博尔科二世是以波希米亚封臣的身份领有奥波莱。此后屡次分家使公国不断缩小，直到16世纪初，公爵扬二世“善人”于1521年重新统一奥波莱与拉齐布日。扬于1532年无嗣而终，奥波莱的皮亚斯特支系就此绝嗣，公国收归波希米亚王冠，随后被封给霍亨索伦家族的勃兰登堡-安斯巴赫藩侯格奥尔格。1645年至1666年间，它由波兰瓦萨王朝作为封邑持有，之后复归哈布斯堡；1742年第一次西里西亚战争后，《柏林条约》把奥波莱划归普鲁士。

en: The Duchy of Opava, known in German as Troppau, was unusual among the Silesian duchies in being ruled not by a Piast but by an illegitimate branch of the Bohemian Přemyslids. King Ottokar II of Bohemia carved the Opava lands from the Margraviate of Moravia before 1269 as an appanage for his natural son Nicholas I, so the territory had never belonged to the Polish Duchy of Silesia created in 1138. Redeemed by King John of Bohemia in 1311 and raised to a duchy in 1318, it was held from 1318 by Nicholas II, the Přemyslid duke ruling in 1337. By marrying Anna, sister of Leszek of Racibórz, Nicholas inherited the neighbouring Piast Duchy of Racibórz when Leszek died without heirs in 1336, and from 1337 he ruled Opava and Racibórz in personal union. His sons later separated the two, and repeated partitions shrank Opava until the Opava Přemyslids sold their shares to King George of Poděbrady in 1462. After Poděbrad, Hungarian and Cieszyn phases the Bohemian Crown reclaimed it, and in 1614 Emperor Matthias enfeoffed Karl I of Liechtenstein, whose house kept Troppau for the rest of its history. The Treaty of Breslau in 1742 split the duchy after the First Silesian War: Głubczyce and Hlučín went to Prussia, while Opava itself remained in Austrian Silesia.
zh: 奥帕瓦公国（德语称特罗保）在西里西亚诸公国中颇为特殊：统治者不是皮亚斯特家族，而是波希米亚普热米斯尔王朝的一支私生子后裔。1269年以前，波希米亚国王奥托卡二世把奥帕瓦地区从摩拉维亚藩侯国划出，封给私生子尼古拉斯一世，因此这片土地原本并不属于1138年的波兰西里西亚公国。1311年波希米亚国王约翰将其赎回，1318年升格为公国，封给尼古拉斯二世——他正是1337年在位的普热米斯尔公爵。尼古拉斯娶了拉齐布日公爵莱谢克的姐姐安娜，1336年莱谢克无嗣而终后，他继承了邻近的皮亚斯特公国拉齐布日，自1337年起以共主邦联的形式兼治奥帕瓦和拉齐布日。他的儿子们后来又把两地分开，屡次分家使奥帕瓦日益缩小，1462年奥帕瓦的普热米斯尔后裔把份额卖给波希米亚国王波杰布拉德的伊日。此后历经波杰布拉德家族、匈牙利和切申的统治，公国被波希米亚王冠收回；1614年皇帝马蒂亚斯把它封给列支敦士登的卡尔一世，列支敦士登家族此后一直领有特罗保。1742年第一次西里西亚战争后的《布雷斯劳条约》将公国瓜分：格鲁布奇采和赫卢钦划归普鲁士，奥帕瓦本土则留在奥地利西里西亚。

en: Orange was a small feudal state in Provence, north of Avignon on the east bank of the Rhône and ringed by the papal Comtat Venaissin. A county had existed there since Carolingian times and passed to the lords of Baux, who ruled it independently after the Kingdom of Burgundy broke up after 1033. In 1163 the Emperor Frederick Barbarossa raised the county to a sovereign principality within the Holy Roman Empire, and the princes of the House of Baux minted their own coin and kept their own court in the city. In 1337 the prince was Raymond IV des Baux, whose son Raymond V died in 1393 as the last male of his line; the Baux heiress Mary then carried Orange into the House of Chalon. The Emperor Charles IV had chartered a university at Orange in 1365, and in 1544 the principality passed by inheritance to the young William the Silent of Nassau, whose House of Orange made it a Huguenot stronghold in the Wars of Religion. Louis XIV's troops seized it in 1672 and again in 1682, and the Treaty of Utrecht of 1713 finally ceded the principality to France.
zh: 奥朗日是普罗旺斯境内的一个小封建邦国，地处阿维尼翁以北、罗讷河东岸，四周被教皇的沃奈桑伯爵领地环绕。当地的伯国早在加洛林时代便已存在，后来转入博家族的领主之手；1033年勃艮第王国解体后，博家族在此独立统治。1163年，皇帝红胡子腓特烈把伯国升格为神圣罗马帝国境内的主权亲王国，博家族的历代亲王在奥朗日城自铸钱币、自开朝廷。1337年在位的是雷蒙德四世·德·博，他的儿子雷蒙德五世于1393年去世，是家族最后一位男性继承人；博家族的女继承人玛丽随后把奥朗日带入沙隆家族。皇帝查理四世曾于1365年下诏在奥朗日兴办大学；1544年，亲王国经继承转入年轻的拿骚家族沉默者威廉之手，他的奥兰治家族在宗教战争中把这里变成胡格诺派的据点。路易十四的军队于1672年和1682年两度攻占奥朗日，1713年的《乌得勒支条约》最终把亲王国割让给法兰西。

en: Ormond was the principal lordship of the Butler family, Hiberno-Normans whose surname came from the hereditary office of Chief Butler, or cup-bearer, of Ireland, first held by Theobald Walter under Prince John around 1185. The earldom was created in 1328 for James Butler, whose lands took in most of Tipperary and Kilkenny, with Clonmel among his chief towns. The Butlers kept a tradition of crown service and English custom, and several earls were noted scholars. The fifth earl became Earl of Wiltshire in England in 1449 but was attainted in 1461; his brother John recovered Ormond in 1476. When the seventh earl died without heirs in 1515, a succession dispute allowed Henry VIII to grant the title to Thomas Boleyn, father of Anne Boleyn, in 1528, before the Butlers under Piers Butler were confirmed in it again in 1538. The family reached its peak under another James Butler, created Marquess of Ormonde in 1642 and Duke of Ormonde in 1660, who led the royalist cause in Ireland through the wars of the seventeenth century.
zh: 奥蒙德是巴特勒家族的核心领地。这一爱尔兰诺曼家族的姓氏源自世袭的爱尔兰首席司酒官之职，最早由西奥博尔德·沃尔特于1185年前后在约翰王子麾下担任。1328年，詹姆斯·巴特勒受封伯爵，其领地囊括蒂珀雷里和基尔肯尼的大部分地区，克朗梅尔是其主要城镇之一。巴特勒家族世代效力王室、恪守英格兰习俗，还出过几位以学问著称的伯爵。第五代伯爵于1449年在英格兰受封威尔特郡伯爵，但1461年被剥夺公权；其弟约翰于1476年恢复奥蒙德头衔。第七代伯爵1515年无嗣而终后，继承之争使亨利八世在1528年把头衔转封给安妮·博林之父托马斯·博林，直到1538年皮尔斯·巴特勒才重新确认了巴特勒家族的爵位。家族在另一位詹姆斯·巴特勒治下达到鼎盛：他于1642年受封奥蒙德侯爵、1660年受封奥蒙德公爵，在17世纪的战乱中统领爱尔兰的保王派事业。

en: Oreshek was a Novgorod border principality centered on a fortress on Orekhovy Island, where the Neva flows out of Lake Ladoga and commands the trade route from Novgorod to the Baltic. The wooden fort was raised in 1323 by Grand Prince Yury of Moscow on Novgorod's behalf, and the same year it hosted the peace treaty with Sweden that first fixed a border between the Orthodox and Catholic worlds. In 1333 the Novgorodians entrusted their north-western marches to the Lithuanian Gediminid prince Narimantas, whose son Alexander ruled the autonomous principality of Oreshek, so the Neva forts remained under Gediminid authority in 1337. King Magnus IV of Sweden stormed the fort in 1348 during his crusade, but Novgorod retook it in 1351 and Archbishop Vasily Kalika rebuilt it in stone the next year. For centuries afterward Oreshek remained a key stronghold disputed between Rus' and Sweden.
zh: 奥列舍克是诺夫哥罗德的边境封邑，核心是涅瓦河从拉多加湖流出处奥列霍维岛上的要塞，扼守诺夫哥罗德通往波罗的海的商路。木制要塞于1323年由莫斯科大公尤里代表诺夫哥罗德修建，同年这里还签署了与瑞典的和约，首次划定了东正教世界与天主教世界之间的边界。1333年诺夫哥罗德人把西北边地托付给立陶宛格迪米纳斯家族的王公纳里曼塔斯，他的儿子亚历山大统治自治的奥列舍克公国，因此1337年涅瓦河沿线的要塞仍处在格迪米纳斯家族掌控之下。1348年瑞典国王马格努斯四世在十字军行动中攻陷要塞，但诺夫哥罗德于1351年将其收复，大主教瓦西里·卡利卡次年又把它重建为石造要塞。此后数百年间，奥列舍克始终是罗斯与瑞典反复争夺的关键据点。

en:
Orissa, the old kingdom of Kalinga on the Bay of Bengal, was ruled in 1337 by the Eastern Ganga dynasty from their capital at Kataka, modern Cuttack. The Gangas had risen in the fifth century and moved their court to Kataka in 1135 under Anantavarman Chodaganga, who began the great Jagannath temple at Puri; his successors completed it and Narasimhadeva I built the Sun Temple at Konark after carrying the Ganga arms into Bengal in 1245, the first Orissan king to take the title Gajapati. In 1337 the throne belonged to Narasimha Deva III, whose rajas along the Andhra and Orissan coast held their lands as his feudatories. His son Bhanu Deva III had to buy off the invasion of Firuz Shah Tughlaq between 1353 and 1358, and the dynasty ended when the minister Kapilendra Deva usurped the crown in 1435 and founded the Suryavamsi Gajapati empire, which by 1457 stretched from the Ganga to Bidar and patronised the Odia poet Sarala Das.

Gajapati power faded under Prataparudra Deva, pressed by Bengal and by Krishnadevaraya of Vijayanagara, and coups between 1541 and 1559 ended with Mukunda Deva, whose kingdom fell to the Bengal sultan Sulaiman Khan Karrani and his general Kalapahad in 1568. Orissa then passed under Mughal governors until Maratha bargi raids from 1742 forced its cession to Raghoji I Bhonsle of Nagpur in 1751, and the British took Cuttack and the province in 1803 during the Second Anglo-Maratha War.
zh:
奥里萨古称羯陵伽，是孟加拉湾畔的王国，1337年由东恒伽王朝以卡塔克（今库塔克）为都进行统治。恒伽人5世纪兴起，阿南塔跋摩·朱达恒伽于1135年迁都卡塔克，并动工修建普里的贾格纳特大庙；后继诸王将其完成，那罗辛哈提婆一世还在1245年挥师攻入孟加拉后修建了科纳克太阳神庙，他也是首位采用伽阇波蒂称号的奥里萨国王。1337年在位的是那罗辛哈·提婆三世，安得拉与奥里萨沿海的罗阇们作为封臣为他守土。其子巴努·提婆三世在1353至1358年间被迫纳贡，才打发走菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克的入侵；1435年，大臣卡皮伦德拉·提婆篡位，建立苏利耶万希·伽阇波蒂帝国，到1457年疆域北起恒河、南抵比达尔，并庇护了奥里亚诗人娑罗罗·达斯，东恒伽王朝至此终结。

伽阇波蒂的国势在波罗多波鲁陀罗·提婆治下转衰，一面受孟加拉逼迫，一面遭毗奢耶那伽罗的克里希纳德瓦拉亚打击；1541至1559年间接连政变，最后上位的穆昆达·提婆在1568年被孟加拉苏丹苏莱曼汗·卡拉尼及其大将卡拉帕哈德攻灭。奥里萨随后由莫卧儿总督管辖，1742年起马拉塔骑兵（巴尔吉）连年劫掠，1751年被迫割让给那格浦尔的拉戈吉一世·邦斯勒；1803年第二次英国—马拉塔战争中，英军攻占库塔克，取得全省。

en: Orkney and Shetland, the Northern Isles of the Norse sagas, were Pictish lands until Viking settlers displaced them from the late eighth century. The earldom founded in the ninth century, its first jarls Sigurd the Mighty and Torf-Einarr, made the islands a base for fleets raiding Scotland and the Irish Sea, and from about 1100 the jarls did homage to Norway for Orkney while holding Caithness of the Scottish crown. Christianity came in 995 under King Olaf Tryggvason, and the murder of Earl Magnus Erlendsson in 1116 gave the islands their patron saint and the great Romanesque cathedral of St Magnus at Kirkwall. The old Norse line ended in 1231, and the Norwegian king conferred the jarldom on Gaelic lords from the Angus and Strathearn families, under whom the islanders kept their Norse Norn tongue. In 1290 the child Margaret, Maid of Norway, died here on her way to the Scottish throne, sparking the succession crisis behind the Wars of Independence. In 1337 the jarl was Malise, also Earl of Strathearn, who led a division of the Scottish army at Halidon Hill and kept his Norwegian title until his death around 1357; in 1379 the earldom passed to the Sinclairs. The end came through marriage diplomacy: in 1468 Christian I of Norway pledged the islands as security for his daughter's dowry to James III, and when the sum was never paid Orkney was annexed to Scotland in 1472, ending six centuries of Norse rule.
zh: 奥克尼与设得兰是维京萨迦中的北部群岛，本为皮克特人的土地，8世纪末起被维京定居者取而代之。9世纪形成的伯爵领以“强者”西居尔和“草皮”埃纳尔为首任雅尔，群岛成为舰队劫掠苏格兰与爱尔兰海的基地；约从1100年起，雅尔们就奥克尼向挪威称臣，同时又以苏格兰国王的名义持有凯斯内斯。995年，奥拉夫·特里格瓦松国王迫使群岛皈依基督教；1116年雅尔马格努斯·埃伦德松遇害，为群岛带来了主保圣人，也催生了柯克沃尔宏伟的罗马式圣马格努斯大教堂。古老的诺斯世系于1231年断绝，挪威国王把雅尔之位转封给安格斯和斯特拉森家族的盖尔贵族，岛民在他们治下仍说诺斯人的诺恩语。1290年，年幼的挪威少女玛格丽特在前往苏格兰继位途中病逝于此，引发了独立战争背后的继承危机。1337年的雅尔是马利兹，他兼领斯特拉森伯爵，曾在哈利顿山战役指挥苏格兰军的一个方阵，保留挪威封号直至约1357年去世；1379年伯爵领转入辛克莱家族。结局由一场婚姻外交写定：1468年，挪威国王克里斯蒂安一世把群岛作为女儿嫁给詹姆斯三世的嫁妆抵押，因抵押款始终未付，奥克尼于1472年被并入苏格兰，六百年的诺斯统治就此终结。

en: The Kingdom of Hormuz was founded in the eleventh century by Muhammad Diramku, an Arab chief from Oman, who built a port on the Persian mainland near modern Minab as a tributary of the Seljuk sultans of Kerman. Ruled by Diramku's descendants, it grew into one of the great emporia of the Indian Ocean, levying tolls on shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and controlling ports on both the Persian and Arabian shores. Around 1300, worn down by raids, its rulers abandoned the mainland and moved their capital to the island of Jarun, thereafter called Hormuz, where merchants accumulated legendary wealth. In 1337 the kingdom still dominated the sea routes linking Persia, India and Arabia, with tributary towns strung along the Fars and Makran coasts. The Portuguese stormed Hormuz in 1507 and made it a permanent client state in 1515, running Gulf shipping through their cartaz licensing system. Portuguese rule ended in 1622, when Shah Abbas of the Safavids, helped by the English East India Company, captured the island, and the trade of Hormuz shifted to the new mainland port of Bandar Abbas.
zh: 霍尔木兹王国于11世纪由来自阿曼的阿拉伯首领穆罕默德·迪拉姆库建立，他在今米纳布附近的波斯大陆沿海营建港口，作为克尔曼塞尔柱苏丹的附庸。迪拉姆库的后裔世代统治，使它成为印度洋上最大的商埠之一，向所有通过霍尔木兹海峡的船只征收通行税，并控制波斯与阿拉伯两侧海岸的港口。约1300年，因屡遭劫掠，统治者放弃大陆，把都城迁到贾伦岛，该岛此后称霍尔木兹岛，商人在此积聚了传说般的财富。1337年，王国仍掌控着连接波斯、印度和阿拉伯的海路，法尔斯和莫克兰沿岸的城镇向它纳贡。葡萄牙人于1507年攻破霍尔木兹，并在1515年把它变为永久附庸，通过特许状制度管理海湾航运。1622年，萨非王朝的阿拔斯沙阿在英国东印度公司协助下攻占该岛，葡萄牙统治结束，霍尔木兹的贸易随之转到大陆上的新港阿巴斯港。

en: The County of Ortenburg took its name from the castle of Hortenburc, first mentioned in 1091 on the slopes of Mt. Goldeck above the Drava valley in Carinthia, where Adalbert of Ortenburg had served the bishops of Freising as bailiff since 1072. When the rival Counts of Lurn died out in 1135 the Ortenburgs inherited their estates down the Drava to Villach, and in 1191 they founded a hospital, the Spittl, at the bridge over the Lieser river, around which grew Spittal an der Drau, their chief town. Two of the family, Herman and Ulrich, became bishops of Gurk, and Count Otto II took the cross on Emperor Henry VI's crusade in 1197. Around 1330 Count Meinhard absorbed the Sternberg estates between the Ossiach and Wörth lakes, and in the fourteenth century the family planted German colonists on its Gottschee lands in Lower Carniola, founding the town that is now Kočevje. Carefully balancing the Carinthian dukes and the Habsburgs, the Ortenburgs backed Rudolf of Habsburg in 1306 and had their immediate rights confirmed by the crown.
