The line ended with the childless Count Frederick III in 1418, whose lands passed to Hermann II of Cilli; when the Cilli themselves died out in 1456 the Habsburgs took Ortenburg, and in 1524 Archduke Ferdinand granted it to his treasurer Gabriel von Salamanca.
zh: 奥尔滕堡伯爵得名于1091年首见记载的霍滕堡城堡，它坐落在克恩滕德劳河谷上方的戈尔代克山坡；早在1072年，奥尔滕堡的阿达尔贝特就已作为弗赖辛主教的代理人在此管事。1135年敌对的卢恩伯爵绝嗣，奥尔滕堡家族继承了其沿德劳河直至菲拉赫的地产；1191年，他们在利泽尔河桥边修建了一所名为 Spittl 的济贫院，后来的首要城镇德劳河畔施皮塔尔即由此发展而来。家族中的赫尔曼和乌尔里希先后出任古尔克主教，奥托二世伯爵则在1197年随皇帝亨利六世参加十字军。约1330年，迈因哈德伯爵吞并了奥西阿赫湖与沃尔特湖之间的施特恩贝格地产；14世纪，家族又在下卡尼奥拉的戈切领地上安置德国殖民者，建立了即今科切维的城镇。奥尔滕堡家族在克恩滕公爵与哈布斯堡之间谨慎周旋，1306年支持哈布斯堡的鲁道夫，其直属地位也得到王室确认。1418年，末代伯爵弗雷德里克三世无嗣而终，领地传给采列的赫尔曼二世；1456年采列家族也绝嗣后，哈布斯堡接管奥尔滕堡，1524年斐迪南大公把它赐给了自己的司库加布里埃尔·冯·萨拉曼卡。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Osnabrück was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire in Westphalia, named after its cathedral city. Charlemagne erected the diocese in 772, making it the oldest see founded for the Christianization of the conquered Saxons; the bishops gained full temporal rule over their territory during the thirteenth century after long struggles with the Counts of Tecklenburg, who renounced their claims in 1236. In 1337 the bishop was Godfrey of Arnsberg, and the small state, which also held Bersenbrück, often had to defend itself against the neighbouring bishops of Minden and Münster. The Reformation split the population, and the Peace of Westphalia, negotiated in Osnabrück and Münster in 1648, left the city bi-confessional with Catholic and Protestant bishops alternating. The prince-bishopric was dissolved in the German Mediatisation of 1803 and given to the Electorate of Hanover; after passing through Prussian, Westphalian and French rule it returned to Hanover in 1814.
zh: 奥斯纳布吕克采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国在威斯特伐利亚的教会邦国，以其主教座堂城市得名。查理曼于772年设立该主教区，这是他为使被征服的萨克森人皈依基督教而建立的最古老教区；13世纪，主教们在与泰克伦堡伯爵长期争斗后取得领地的完整世俗统治权，伯爵于1236年放弃了各项权利要求。1337年在任的是阿恩斯贝格的戈弗雷，这个还领有贝尔森布吕克的小邦时常要抵御邻邦明登和明斯特主教的侵逼。宗教改革使居民分裂为两派，1648年在奥斯纳布吕克与明斯特谈判签订的《威斯特伐利亚和约》规定该城实行双信仰制，主教由天主教徒和新教徒轮流担任。1803年德意志采邑调解中，采邑主教区被解散并划归汉诺威选侯国；此后历经普鲁士、威斯特伐利亚和法国统治，于1814年重回汉诺威。

en: Ossory, in Irish Osraige, was a kingdom of Gaelic Ireland covering the valley of the River Nore, roughly the later County Kilkenny, western County Laois and the edge of Tipperary. Tradition traced its ruling Dal Birn dynasty to a first-century founder, and in 859 King Cerball mac Dunlainge won the kingdom formal independence from Munster. By the late tenth century the rulers had taken the surname Mac Giolla Phadraig, later anglicised as Fitzpatrick. The Norman invasion of 1169 broke the old kingdom: William Marshal built Kilkenny Castle and drove the Mac Giolla Phadraigs north, where they maintained themselves in the hill district of Upper Ossory around Cullohill. In 1337 the chief of the name still ruled this northern remnant as a Gaelic lordship while the Butler earls of Ormond administered Kilkenny, where the Statutes of Kilkenny were passed in 1367. Upper Ossory kept its independence until the reign of Henry VIII, when it was surrendered and regranted as an English barony.
zh: 奥索里，爱尔兰语称奥斯赖盖，是盖尔爱尔兰的王国，位于诺尔河流域，范围大致相当于后来的基尔肯尼郡、莱伊什郡西部和蒂珀雷里边缘。相传其统治家族达尔·比尔恩王朝的始祖可追溯到1世纪；859年，国王塞尔巴尔·麦克·邓林格使王国正式脱离芒斯特独立。到10世纪末，统治者采用麦克吉尔·帕特里克为姓，后来英化为菲茨帕特里克。1169年的诺曼入侵瓦解了旧王国：威廉·马歇尔修建基尔肯尼城堡，把麦克吉尔·帕特里克家族赶到北方，他们在卡洛希尔一带的上奥索里山区立足。1337年，该家族的酋长仍统治着北方这块残余领地，而巴特勒家族的奥蒙德伯爵管辖基尔肯尼，并于1367年在那里颁布《基尔肯尼法令》。上奥索里一直保持独立，直到亨利八世在位时才以“投降与再封”的方式被改为英格兰式男爵领。

en: The Duchy of Oświęcim, known in German as Auschwitz, lay on Lesser Polish lands east of the Biała River, in the foothills of the Beskids. The territory had belonged to the Duchy of Cieszyn when in 1315 it was split off as a separate duchy for Władysław, a younger son of Duke Mieszko I of Cieszyn. His heir Jan I the Scholastic, the Piast duke reigning in 1337, paid homage to King John of Bohemia in 1327, so Oświęcim entered the game's age as a Bohemian vassal even though its population and ties pointed towards Lesser Poland. Repeated partitions weakened it, and in 1445 the duchies of Zator and Toszek were carved out of its lands. The last duke, Jan IV, reversed the old Bohemian orientation by declaring himself a vassal of the Polish king Casimir IV Jagiellon in 1454, and having no sons he sold the whole duchy to the Polish Crown for three million Prague groschen in 1457. The Polish kings kept the ducal title, and the Sejm of 1564 formally incorporated Oświęcim into the Kraków Voivodeship as the Silesian County. In the First Partition of 1772 the lands passed to the Habsburg monarchy as part of Galicia.
zh: 奥斯威辛公国（德语称奥施维茨）位于比亚瓦河以东的小波兰土地上，地处贝斯基德山麓。这片领土原属切申公国，1315年被分出，单独立为切申公爵梅什科一世幼子瓦迪斯瓦夫的公国。他的继承人“学者”扬一世——即1337年在位的皮亚斯特公爵——于1327年向波希米亚国王约翰行臣服礼，因此尽管其居民和各种联系都朝向小波兰，奥斯威辛在游戏开局年代仍是波希米亚的附庸。不断分家削弱了它，1445年扎托尔和托谢克两个公国又从其领地中划出。末代公爵扬四世扭转了历来亲波希米亚的取向，于1454年宣布成为波兰国王卡齐米尔四世·雅盖隆的封臣；他没有儿子，遂在1457年以三百万布拉格格罗申的价钱把整个公国卖给波兰王冠。波兰国王保留了公爵头衔，1564年的议会正式把奥斯威辛并入克拉科夫省，编为西里西亚县。1772年第一次瓜分波兰时，这片土地作为加利西亚的一部分转归哈布斯堡君主国。

en: Otatitlan was a small river town on the lower Papaloapan, on the border between Veracruz and Oaxaca. Its Nahuatl name means place of the otates, the Mexican weeping bamboo, and was given by itinerant merchants when Aztec traders first reached the area. Before the Spanish conquest its people were Popoluca, and from pre-Hispanic times into the colonial period the settlement served as an indigenous trading post on the river routes of the Gulf lowlands. Jesuit missionaries later founded the mission of San Ignacio Otatitlan, and the town was formally refounded under Viceroy Diego Fernandez de Cordoba, Marquis of Guadalcazar, and dedicated to Saint Andrew, which is why colonial records often call it San Andres Otatitlan. It gained municipality status in 1831.
zh: 奥塔蒂特兰是帕帕洛阿潘河下游的一座河畔小镇，位于韦拉克鲁斯与瓦哈卡的交界地带。它的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“奥塔特竹之地”，奥塔特竹即墨西哥垂枝竹，名字是阿兹特克商人最初抵达此地时由这些行商所起。西班牙征服之前，这里的居民是波波卢卡人；从先西班牙时期到殖民时代，该聚落一直是海湾低地河运路线上的原住民商站。后来耶稣会传教士建立了圣伊格纳西奥·奥塔蒂特兰传道站，城镇又在总督迭戈·费尔南德斯·德·科尔多瓦（瓜达尔卡萨尔侯爵）任内正式重建并献给使徒圣安德烈，因此殖民文献常称它为圣安德烈斯·奥塔蒂特兰。1831年，它获得市镇地位。

en: The Otchigin horde descended from the appanage of Temüge, youngest brother of Genghis Khan, whose title otchigin marked him as guardian of the family hearth. At the coronation of 1206 he and his mother Hoelun received the largest share of lands and people allotted to any of the brothers; while the other princes campaigned far afield, Temüge ruled the Mongol heartland, his pastures running from the western foothills of the Greater Khingan south of the Hailar to the Khalkha river, and under Ögedei he pushed his power into Liaodong and beyond the Khingan. After Ögedei's death in 1241 he attempted to seize the throne, but the regent Töregene held him off, and when Güyük was elected in 1246 Temüge was tried and executed. His descendants kept the northeastern appanage: his great-great-grandson Nayan, a Nestorian Christian ruling wide Jurchen lands from his seat at Kwang-ning, rose against Kublai Khan in 1287 and was defeated and put to death, an episode recorded by Marco Polo. In 1337 the house still grazed around Taizhou in Songnen under Borjigin princes subject to the great khan, and after the Yuan collapse of 1368 its people were folded into the Ming Three Guards set up in 1389.
zh: 斡惕赤斤汗国源于成吉思汗幼弟铁木哥的投下封地，斡赤斤这一称号意为守护灶火的幼子。1206年蒙古建国时，他与母亲诃额仑分得诸弟中最多的土地和属民；其他王公远征时，铁木哥留守蒙古本土，牧地横跨大兴安岭西麓、海拉尔河以南直至哈拉哈河流域，窝阔台时期又把势力扩张到辽东和大兴安岭以东。1241年窝阔台死后，他企图夺取汗位，被摄政乃马真后阻止；1246年贵由在忽里勒台即位后，铁木哥被处死。他的后裔仍保有东北封地：玄孙乃颜是景教徒，以广宁为中心统治着广阔的女真之地，1287年起兵反叛忽必烈，兵败被杀，此事被马可·波罗记入行纪。1337年，该家族仍由孛儿只斤王公统领，在松嫩泰州一带游牧，臣属于大汗；1368年元朝灭亡后，其部众于1389年被编入明朝设立的兀良哈三卫。

en: Xaltocan was an Otomi city-state built on an island in the lake of the same name in the northern Valley of Mexico. Its people, the Xaltocameca, were counted among the Chichimec tribes, and their island position made the town easy to fortify and supported chinampa gardens that produced a grain surplus. Through much of the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries Xaltocan fought a long rivalry with the neighbouring Nahua city of Cuauhtitlan, in which it at first had the upper hand. Around 1395 Cuauhtitlan's ruler Xaltemoctzin called in Tezozomoc of Azcapotzalco and the Mexica of Tenochtitlan; the allies stormed Xaltocan and drove out its Otomi population, who fled to Metztitlan, Tlaxcala and the new settlement of Otumba. The island was then resettled by Nahuatl speakers, and after the fall of Azcapotzalco it became a tribute-paying subject city of the Aztec empire, sending woven blankets to Tenochtitlan. In 1521 the army of Hernán Cortés sacked and burned Xaltocan during the conquest of Mexico.
zh: 夏尔托坎是一座奥托米人的城邦，建在墨西哥谷地北部同名湖泊中的岛屿上。其居民夏尔托卡梅卡人被视为奇奇梅克诸部之一；岛屿地势既便于设防，也支撑起奇南帕园圃，出产的粮食还有盈余。13至14世纪的大部分时间里，夏尔托坎与邻近的纳瓦城邦库奥蒂特兰长期交战，起初还占据上风。约1395年，库奥蒂特兰君主沙特莫克钦请来阿斯卡波察尔科的特索索莫克和特诺奇蒂特兰的墨西加人助阵，联军攻陷夏尔托坎并驱逐奥托米居民，后者逃往梅斯蒂特兰、特拉斯卡拉和新建的奥通巴。此后该岛改由讲纳瓦特尔语的人居住；阿斯卡波察尔科倒台后，夏尔托坎成为阿兹特克帝国纳贡的臣属城邦，向特诺奇蒂特兰进献织毯。1521年，埃尔南·科尔特斯的军队在征服墨西哥期间洗劫并焚毁了夏尔托坎。

en: Wagadugu, better known by its French spelling Ouagadougou, is the principal Mossi kingdom on the upper Volta, whose ruler bears the title Mogho Naaba, King of All the World, and stands first among the Mossi kings. The town itself may have been planted about 1050 by Soninke Wangara traders from Ghana, and its name means home of the Wagu; Mossi horsemen moving north from Tenkodogo seized it in the fourteenth century, an acquisition credited in legend to Oubri, grandson of the founders' hero Ouédraogo and the traditional founder of the Ouagadougou dynasty. Under Komdimie, around 1170, the northern province of Yatenga broke away to form its own kingdom, while Wagadugu governed the rest through provincial governors called Dimas. The Mossi kept the rites of their ancestors and became the scourge of the Muslim empires to their north, raiding Walata and even Timbuktu in the fifteenth century; Askia Muhammad's holy war of 1497 defeated their armies but could not make them abandon their old religion. After Songhai fell to the Moroccans in 1591 Wagadugu was fully its own master, and in the eighteenth century it grew rich on regional trade and held off the jihad states of Massina and Sokoto, while the first mosque in the capital was built only in the early nineteenth century.
zh: 瓦加杜古（法语拼写作 Ouagadougou）是沃尔特河上游首要的莫西王国，君主号称莫戈·纳巴，意为“天下之王”，在莫西诸王中地位最高。这座城镇可能约在1050年由来自加纳的索宁克万加拉商人建立，城名意为“瓦古之人的家园”；14世纪，自滕科多戈北上的莫西骑兵夺取该地，传说将其归功于韦德拉奥果之孙乌布里，他也被视为瓦加杜古王朝的开创者。约1170年孔迪米耶在位时，北方的亚滕加省分裂出去另立王国，瓦加杜古则通过名为迪马的行省总督统治其余地区。莫西人恪守祖先祭祀，成为北方穆斯林帝国的祸患，15世纪劫掠瓦拉塔，甚至攻入廷巴克图；1497年阿斯基亚·穆罕默德的圣战虽击败其军队，却无法迫使他们放弃旧教。1591年桑海亡于摩洛哥后，瓦加杜古完全自主，18世纪靠区域贸易致富，并抵挡住马西纳和索科托等圣战国家，都城的第一座清真寺直到19世纪初才建成。

en: Owo lies at the southern edge of the Yoruba Hills, roughly halfway between Ile-Ife and Benin City. Its oral tradition traces the town to migrants from Ile-Ife, led by sons of the deity Oduduwa, and archaeology confirms close ties with Ife culture from an early date. Between 1400 and 1600 it was the capital of an independent Yoruba city-state whose king, the Olowo, built the sprawling Aghofen palace with around a hundred courtyards, each dedicated to a particular deity or public function. On the frontier with the powerful Edo kingdom of Benin, Owo preserved a large measure of independence although it sometimes paid tribute, and the two courts exchanged styles and craftsmen: Owo's ivory carvers were prized at Benin, and during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries Benin's rulers imported Owo carvings and recruited its artisans into the royal workshops. Owo thus developed a hybrid artistic tradition, blending Ife naturalism with Benin courtly motifs, and remained a self-governing Yoruba kingdom through the era of the Oyo empire's rise and decline.
zh: 奥沃位于约鲁巴丘陵南缘，大致处在伊费与贝宁城之间的中点。当地口传传统称，建城者是从伊费迁出、由神祇奥杜杜瓦之子率领的移民，考古发现也证实它很早就与伊费文化联系紧密。1400至1600年间，这里是一个独立约鲁巴城邦的首都，其国王称“奥洛沃”，修建了占地广阔、拥有约百处庭院的阿戈芬王宫，每处庭院各有专门的祭祀或公共功能。奥沃毗邻强大的贝宁埃多王国，虽有时不得不纳贡，但基本保持了独立；两国宫廷之间双向交流风格与工匠：奥沃的象牙雕刻在贝宁备受推崇，17至18世纪贝宁统治者大量进口奥沃雕刻品，并招募当地工匠进入王室作坊。奥沃因此形成融合伊费写实传统与贝宁宫廷纹样的混合艺术风格，并在奥约帝国兴衰的整个时期里始终是一个自治的约鲁巴王国。

en: Oxtlipan was a small Huastec, or Téenek, town of the inland Huasteca, in the mountain fringe between the Gulf lowlands and the Otomi stronghold of Metztitlan. Like the other fragmented Huastec city-states, it was drawn into the Aztec tributary empire during the fifteenth-century campaigns of Moctezuma I and Ahuitzotl while keeping its own local rulers.
zh: 奥斯特利潘是瓦斯特卡内陆的特内克人小镇，地处墨西哥湾低地与奥托米人重镇梅茨蒂特兰之间的山缘地带。与其他各自分立的瓦斯特克城邦一样，它在15世纪莫克特苏马一世和阿维索特尔的征战中被纳入阿兹特克纳贡体系，但仍保留本地首领。

en: Oyo grew into the largest of the Yoruba states from its capital at Oyo-Ile in the savanna north of the forest. Yoruba tradition places its founding around 1300 under Oranmiyan, a prince of Ife who became the first Alaafin, and remembers his son Shango, the warlike king later worshipped as the god of thunder. By the end of the 1300s Oyo was already a formidable inland power, but around 1535 the Nupe under Tsoede sacked the capital and drove the dynasty into exile in Borgu for eighty years. It returned rebuilt around cavalry and a stronger central government: Oba Ofinran recovered the lost lands, Eguguojo conquered nearly all of Yorubaland, and the court moved back to a restored Oyo-Ile, though an attempt to subdue Benin between 1578 and 1608 failed in the Ekiti hills. During the 1600s Oyo became a great cavalry empire living on tribute and trans-Saharan trade, raiding south from 1682 and waging repeated wars against Dahomey, which was finally forced to pay tribute in 1748. The Alaafin ruled through the Oyo Mesi council headed by the Bashorun, but dependence on the Atlantic slave trade and factional strife weakened the state: the general Afonja seceded with Ilorin in 1817 and joined the Sokoto jihad in 1823, Dahomey shook off tributary status the same year, and Ilorin forces destroyed Oyo-Ile in 1835, after which the court withdrew south to Ago d'Oyo.
zh: 奥约从森林以北草原上的都城奥约伊莱起步，成长为最大的约鲁巴人国家。按约鲁巴传说，它约在1300年由伊费王子奥兰米扬建立，他成为第一位阿拉芬（国王）；其子尚戈是勇武的君王，后来被尊为雷神。到14世纪末，奥约已是内陆强国，但1535年前后，措埃德率领的努佩人洗劫都城，迫使王朝流亡博尔古达八十年。复辟后的奥约以骑兵和更强的中央政府重建国家：奥巴·奥芬兰收复失地，埃古戈霍征服了几乎整个约鲁巴兰，王廷最终迁回重建的奥约伊莱；1578至1608年间征服贝宁的尝试则在埃基蒂山地受阻。17世纪，奥约成为靠朝贡和跨撒哈拉贸易支撑的骑兵帝国，1682年起不断南下袭掠，并与达荷美反复交战，终于在1748年迫使对方纳贡。阿拉芬通过以巴绍伦为首的奥约梅西议事会治国，但对大西洋奴隶贸易的依赖和党争削弱了国家：将领阿方贾于1817年据伊洛林独立，1823年投靠索科托圣战，达荷美也在同年摆脱藩属地位；1835年伊洛林军队摧毁奥约伊莱，王廷只得南迁至阿戈多约。

en: Ozuluama was a Huastec town on the flat coastal plain of the Huasteca Alta, beside the Tamiahua Lagoon in what is now northern Veracruz. Its name began as a Huastec phrase combining the words for jaguar and fig tree, meaning jaguar over a fig tree, and after the Aztec conquest it was translated into Nahuatl as ocelotl-amatl, the form that gradually shortened into Ozuluama. Like the other Huastec city-states it was defeated by the armies of Moctezuma I around 1450 and thereafter paid tribute while keeping its local rulers, and local tradition also credited the Texcocan poet-king Nezahualcoyotl with campaigning in these parts. When the Spanish overran the Huasteca between 1519 and the 1530s the town became a colonial settlement, its prehispanic past preserved in the nearby ruins of Cebadilla.
zh: 奥苏卢阿马是上瓦斯特卡沿海平原的瓦斯特克城镇，坐落于今韦拉克鲁斯北部的塔米亚瓦潟湖畔。其名字本是瓦斯特克语，由意为美洲豹和榕树的两个词组成，含义为“榕树上的美洲豹”；阿兹特克征服后被译作纳瓦特尔语的奥塞洛特尔-阿马特，后逐渐音变为奥苏卢阿马。与其他瓦斯特克城邦一样，它在1450年前后被莫克特苏马一世的军队击败，此后向阿兹特克纳贡但保留本地首领，当地传说还把这一带的征战归于特斯科科的诗人国王内萨瓦尔科约特尔。1519至1530年代西班牙人攻灭瓦斯特卡诸邦后，该城成为殖民聚落，其史前往事留存于附近的塞瓦迪亚遗址。

en: Oztoman, also recorded as Oztuma, was a Mexica frontier stronghold in the Cohuixca country of the Tierra Caliente, the rugged country between the Valley of Mexico and the Purépecha kingdom. Moctezuma I campaigned through the district between 1440 and 1469, subduing Oztuma together with Ixcateopan, Taxco and the neighbouring towns, and the Mexica then built a garrison of five forts to watch the Purépecha border and hold down the rebellious Chontal communities. For decades the forts faced the Purépecha garrison at Cutzamala across a war-ravaged frontier, until Purépecha warriors stormed them in 1520, an episode described in the sixteenth-century Relación de Oztuma.
zh: 奥斯托曼又记作奥斯图马，是阿兹特克人在特拉卡连特地区科维克斯卡地带的边防要塞，地处墨西哥谷与普雷佩查王国之间的崎岖山地。1440年至1469年间，蒙特祖马一世出兵这一地区，将奥斯托曼与伊斯卡特奥潘、塔斯科等邻近城镇一并征服；阿兹特克人随后修筑由五座堡垒组成的驻军要塞，既监视普雷佩查边境，也压制当地反叛的琼塔尔人。此后数十年间，堡垒与驻扎在库察马拉的普雷佩查守军隔饱受战火的边境对峙，1520年普雷佩查武士攻克五堡，此事见于16世纪的《奥斯图马记述》。

en: Ozumatzin, whose head town survives as San Pedro Ozumacin in the rainy Chinantla hills of northern Oaxaca, was a small polity of the Papaloapan basin whose people spoke a Chinantecan tongue. Local tradition remembered a wide Chinantec kingdom founded around 1100 by a king named Quiana, which later split into rival highland and lowland states. The Aztecs built a garrison and tribute centre at nearby Tuxtepec around 1455, launched a campaign against the Chinantla in 1479, and the emperor Ahuitzotl completed its conquest in 1488. The Chinantecs then turned against their overlords and joined Hernan Cortes in 1519, fighting with their unusually long lances, though they rose against Spanish rule around 1530.
zh: 奥苏马钦的首镇留存为今瓦哈卡州北部多雨的奇南特拉山区中的圣佩德罗·奥苏马辛，它是帕帕洛阿潘盆地一个讲奇南特克语的小邦。当地传说记得，约1100年一位名叫基亚纳的国王建立了幅员广阔的奇南特克王国，后来分裂为相互对抗的山地和低地诸邦。阿兹特克人约1455年在附近的图斯特佩克修建驻军和贡税中心，1479年发兵攻打奇南特拉，皇帝阿维索特尔于1488年完成征服。此后奇南特克人转而反对宗主，于1519年投奔埃尔南·科尔特斯，以格外修长的长矛作战，但约1530年又起兵反抗西班牙统治。

en: Padua is a Veneto city on the Bacchiglione, west of Venice, already a prosperous commune under elected consuls from 1138. Its university, founded in 1222, made it an early center of legal and humanist learning, and Giotto painted the frescoes of the Scrovegni Chapel there about 1305. In 1236 Emperor Frederick II imposed his vicar Ezzelino da Romano, whose tyranny lasted until the city drove him out in 1256; wars with Verona then opened the age of the signori. Jacopo da Carrara was elected lord in 1318, and after the della Scala of Verona seized the city in 1328 Padua was held as a Scaliger possession in 1337, ruled for Mastino della Scala. The Carraresi returned the same year and, except for two years of Visconti rule from 1388, governed until 1405, fighting Verona at the Battle of Castagnaro in 1387. Unable to stand against Milan and Venice together, Padua surrendered to the Venetian republic in 1405 and remained its subject, with only a brief imperial occupation during the War of the League of Cambrai in 1509. Under Venetian rule the university gained its botanical garden in 1545 and numbered Galileo among its teachers, while Elena Cornaro Piscopia became the first woman to take a university degree there in 1678. Venetian Padua ended with the republic's fall in 1797.
zh: 帕多瓦是威尼斯以西、巴奇廖内河畔的威尼托城市，早在1138年就已是由选举执政官治理的富庶市镇。1222年创办的大学使它成为法学与人文主义学术的早期中心，乔托约于1305年在此完成斯克罗威尼礼拜堂的壁画。1236年皇帝腓特烈二世安插代理人埃泽利诺·达·罗马诺，其暴政延续到1256年被市民驱逐；此后与维罗纳的战争拉开了僭主时代的序幕。雅各布·达·卡拉拉于1318年被推举为领主，1328年维罗纳的德拉·斯卡拉家族夺取城市，因此1337年帕多瓦作为斯卡拉家族的领地、由马斯蒂诺·德拉·斯卡拉委任的人统治。卡拉拉家族同年即返回，除1388年起两年的维斯孔蒂统治外一直执政到1405年，并在1387年的卡斯塔尼亚罗战役中与维罗纳交战。由于无力同时对抗米兰和威尼斯，帕多瓦于1405年投降威尼斯共和国，此后一直臣属于威尼斯，仅在1509年康布雷同盟战争中被帝国短暂占领。威尼斯统治时期，大学于1545年建起植物园，伽利略曾在此任教，埃莱娜·科尔纳罗·皮斯科皮亚于1678年成为世界上第一位获得大学学位的女性。威尼斯治下的帕多瓦随1797年共和国灭亡而告终。

en: Pahang occupies the broad river basin of the east coast of the Malay Peninsula, where Malayic settlements traded with Funan as early as the second century. A port at the Pahang river mouth served Indian and Chinese shipping in the third century, and the Book of Song records the Pohuang kingdom, usually identified with Pahang, sending embassies to the Liu Song court in 449 and 456 under a king named Sri Bhadravarman. It later passed into the Langkasuka-Kedah mandala, came under Srivijaya's hegemony by the eighth century, and after Srivijaya's decline became one of the twelve tributary cities of Ligor. In the fourteenth century Pahang was itself a rising Hindu-Buddhist power: its maharaja claimed overlordship over the southern peninsula including Temasek, the Javanese Nagarakretagama treated its name as shorthand for the whole peninsula, and Maharaja Tajau sent gold-leaf tribute to the Ming emperor in 1378. Malacca then absorbed it, and in the later fifteenth century its old ruling house ended with Dewa Sura, whose grandson was installed as Sultan Muhammad Shah, first ruler of the Old Pahang Sultanate at Pekan. The sultanate fought the Portuguese beside Johor after 1511, was raided by Aceh in 1615 and 1617, and in 1623 its sultan also took the Johor crown, joining the two realms.
zh: 彭亨位于马来半岛东岸广阔的河流盆地，早在2世纪，这里的马来人聚落便与扶南通商。3世纪时，彭亨河口的商港已接待印度与中国商船；《宋书》记载的婆皇国通常被比定为彭亨，其国王室利·跋陀罗跋摩曾于449年和456年遣使刘宋朝廷。此后它并入狼牙修—吉打曼荼罗，8世纪受三佛齐霸权控制，三佛齐衰落后又成为洛坤的十二属城之一。14世纪时，彭亨已是印度教—佛教的新兴强权：它的摩诃罗阇对包括淡马锡在内的半岛南端保有宗主权，爪哇的《爪哇史颂》甚至以彭亨之名泛指整个马来半岛，1378年彭亨摩诃罗阇还携金叶表文向明朝进贡。后来马六甲将其吞并，15世纪后期旧王族以德瓦·苏拉为末主，其外孙被立为苏丹穆罕默德·沙，成为以北根为都的旧彭亨苏丹国首任苏丹。1511年后，彭亨与柔佛联兵抗击葡萄牙人，1615和1617年两遭亚齐入侵，1623年其苏丹又兼领柔佛王位，两个王国由此合流。

en: The Palatinate of the Rhine, ruled from Heidelberg, was a scattered collection of lordships on both banks of the Upper Rhine, together with the Upper Palatinate on the Danube. The office of Count Palatine grew out of the royal representative of Lotharingia; after the last Ezzonid count died in 1085 it shrank into the hereditary County Palatine of the Rhine. In 1214 the Hohenstaufen emperor Frederick II enfeoffed the Wittelsbach duke Louis I of Bavaria, and the family kept the Palatinate for centuries afterwards. The division of 1294 gave the elder Wittelsbach line both the Rhenish and the Upper Palatinate, and the Treaty of Pavia in 1329 restored these lands to the nephews Rudolf and Rupert after their uncle the Emperor Louis IV had withheld them. The Golden Bull of 1356 made the Count Palatine one of the secular prince-electors, with the hereditary office of archsteward of the Empire, and Rupert I founded the University of Heidelberg in 1386. The Palatinate adopted Lutheranism in the 1530s and turned Calvinist under Frederick III from 1559, becoming a leading Protestant power; Frederick V's acceptance of the Bohemian crown in 1619 helped ignite the Thirty Years' War. French armies laid waste to Heidelberg and the countryside in 1689 and 1693, and after the Simmern line died out in 1685 the electorate passed to Catholic junior branches. In 1777 it was united with Bavaria under Charles Theodore, and in 1803 the Rhenish lands were annexed by Baden.
zh: 莱茵普法尔茨以海德堡为统治中心，由莱茵河上游两岸一系列分散领地，加上多瑙河畔的上普法尔茨共同组成。行宫伯爵一职源于洛塔林吉亚的国王代表；1085年末代埃措南伯爵死后，它收缩为世袭的莱茵行宫伯爵领。1214年霍亨斯陶芬皇帝腓特烈二世把它封给维特尔斯巴赫家族的巴伐利亚公爵路易一世，该家族在此后漫长岁月里一直保有普法尔茨。1294年的分家使维特尔斯巴赫长支同时得到莱茵普法尔茨和上普法尔茨；1329年的《帕维亚条约》把这些土地归还给被叔父皇帝路易四世扣留领地的侄子鲁道夫和鲁普雷希特。1356年的《金玺诏书》定行宫伯爵为世俗选帝侯之一，世袭帝国御前总管之职；1386年鲁普雷希特一世创办海德堡大学，即德国最古老的大学。普法尔茨在16世纪30年代改信路德宗，1559年起在腓特烈三世治下转为加尔文宗，成为新教重镇；1619年腓特烈五世接受波希米亚王位，成为三十年战争的导火索之一。1689年和1693年法军两度蹂躏海德堡和乡间；1685年锡门支系绝嗣后，选侯国转入天主教旁支之手，1777年在卡尔·特奥多尔治下与巴伐利亚合并，莱茵领地则于1803年被巴登吞并。

en: Pǔ'ān ruled the southwestern Guizhou plateau around present-day Panzhou. Its people were the Yushi tribe of the Cuan, who submitted to the Mongols in 1257 and were organized as a wanhu office; in 1276 it became the Pu'an route command, seated at the old Pu'an town east of present-day Panzhou and covering parts of present-day Pu'an, Xingren, Xingyi, Panzhou and Anlong in Guizhou and Fuyuan in Yunnan, briefly a pacification commission after 1279 and a route again from 1285, all under Yunnan province. The Ming converted it into Pu'an prefecture in 1383, then into the Pu'an pacification office in 1403 and the department of Pu'an in 1415, now directly under Guizhou. The department moved into the Pu'an Guard city in 1586 and was attached to Anshun prefecture in 1611; under the Qing it passed to Nanlong prefecture in 1727, became the independent Pu'an department in 1809, and was reorganized as the Pu'an sub-prefecture in 1811.
zh: 普安统辖今贵州盘州一带的黔西南高原，其地原为爨族于矢部。1257年于矢部归附蒙古，置为万户府；1276年改设普安路总管府，治今盘州市东旧普安镇，1279年一度改为普安宣抚司，1285年复改为路，均隶云南行省，辖地兼跨今贵州普安、兴仁、兴义、盘州、安龙及云南富源等地。明代1383年改置普安府，废后于1403年置普安安抚司，1415年改为普安州，直隶贵州布政司。1586年州治迁入普安卫城，1611年改属安顺府；清代1727年改隶南笼府，1809年升为普安直隶州，1811年改为普安厅。

en: The State of the Church is the band of central Italian lands ruled directly by the pope, stretching from Rome and the Patrimony of Saint Peter across Umbria, the Marche and Romagna. It was founded on the Donation of Pepin in 756, when the Frankish king handed the former Lombard lands around Rome to Pope Stephen II, and by 1300 it was effectively independent of emperor and king. From 1305, however, the popes resided at Avignon in Provence, an enclave which with the Comtat Venaissin was added to their domains; in 1337 Benedict XII ruled the church from there while Roman nobles, above all the Orsini and Colonna, fought over the empty city. The tribune Cola di Rienzo briefly seized power in Rome in 1347, and Cardinal Albornoz reconquered the restive papal cities in the 1350s, issuing a uniform law code in 1357. Gregory XI brought the court back to Rome in 1377, and the Western Schism divided the church the following year. Renaissance popes such as Alexander VI and Julius II enlarged the state by war and diplomacy, though the troops of Charles V sacked Rome in 1527; Ferrara was reclaimed in 1598, Urbino in 1631 and Castro in 1649, bringing the states to their greatest extent. Revolutionary France annexed Avignon in 1791 and proclaimed a Roman Republic in 1798, driving Pius VI into exile, and Napoleon absorbed Rome itself in 1809; the Congress of Vienna restored the Italian lands, though not Avignon, to Pius VII in 1815.
zh: 教会国是教宗直接统治的意大利中部领地，从罗马和圣彼得遗产横贯翁布里亚、马尔凯和罗马涅。它奠基于756年的丕平献土：法兰克国王把罗马周围原伦巴第人的土地交给教宗斯德望二世；到1300年，它已实际独立于皇帝和国王之外。然而从1305年起，教宗长驻普罗旺斯的阿维尼翁，阿维尼翁与沃奈桑伯爵领地也被并入教宗领地；1337年本笃十二世在那里治理教会，而罗马城内的贵族——尤其是奥尔西尼和科隆纳两大家族——正为争夺空虚的都城内斗。平民保民官科拉·迪·里恩佐于1347年一度在罗马夺权，阿尔沃诺斯枢机在14世纪50年代重新征服不服管束的教会城市，并于1357年颁布统一法典。格列高利十一世在1377年把教廷迁回罗马，次年西方教会大分裂爆发。亚历山大六世、儒略二世等文艺复兴教宗靠战争和外交扩张领地，尽管查理五世的军队在1527年洗劫了罗马；费拉拉于1598年、乌尔比诺于1631年、卡斯特罗于1649年相继被收回，教会国疆域达到极盛。革命法国于1791年吞并阿维尼翁，1798年宣布成立罗马共和国，迫使庇护六世流亡，拿破仑又在1809年吞并罗马本身；1815年维也纳会议把意大利境内的领地——但不包括阿维尼翁——归还庇护七世。

en: Parma is a city of the Po plain in Emilia, on the old Roman Via Aemilia. The Romans planted a colony there in 183 BC, and after Lombard and Frankish rule it became the seat of a county in 774. A commune emerged around 1140, its consuls already treating with Piacenza in 1149; as a Ghibelline city it withstood a siege by Emperor Frederick II in 1247 and 1248. Rival signori then followed one another: Rolando de' Rossi took power in 1328, the city submitted to John of Bohemia in 1331, and in 1341 it fell to the Visconti of Milan, whose rule was broken only briefly by the Terzi family between 1404 and 1409. The Battle of Fornovo in 1495 was fought on Parmesan soil during the Italian Wars, and French garrisons held the city from 1500 to 1521. After a period under the Papal States, Pope Paul III in 1545 created the Duchy of Parma and Piacenza for his son Pier Luigi Farnese. The Farnese ruled until 1731, when the line ended with Antonio Farnese; after a Spanish interlude the duchy passed in 1748 to the Bourbon-Parma branch, until Napoleonic France annexed it in 1801. The Congress of Vienna in 1815 assigned Parma to Marie Louise of Austria.
zh: 帕尔马是艾米利亚波河平原上的城市，地处古罗马艾米利亚大道沿线。罗马人于公元前183年在此设立殖民城，历经伦巴第人和法兰克人统治后，它在774年成为一个伯国的治所。1140年前后帕尔马形成公社，1149年其执政官已与皮亚琴察缔约；作为吉伯林派城市，它在1247—1248年顶住了皇帝腓特烈二世的围攻。此后各路领主轮番入主：罗朗多·德·罗西于1328年掌权，1331年城市向波希米亚国王约翰臣服，1341年又落入米兰的维斯孔蒂家族之手，仅在1404—1409年由泰尔齐家族短暂中断其统治。1495年的福尔诺沃战役就发生在帕尔马境内，意大利战争期间法军于1500—1521年占据该城。此后它一度归属教皇国，1545年教皇保罗三世把帕尔马和皮亚琴察从教皇国划出，为其子皮耶尔·路易吉·法尔内塞设立公国。法尔内塞家族统治到1731年末代公爵安东尼奥去世，经过一段西班牙插曲，公国于1748年转入波旁-帕尔马支系之手，1801年被拿破仑法国吞并。1815年的维也纳会议把帕尔马划归奥地利的玛丽·路易丝。

en: Patras was the greatest barony of the Principality of Achaea, on the north-western coast of the Peloponnese. Founded around 1209 as one of the twelve original secular baronies, with twenty-four knight's fiefs, it passed in the middle of the thirteenth century to the Latin Archbishop of Patras, who then held thirty-two fiefs and became the strongest vassal of the principality. Under Archbishop William Frangipani, from 1317 to 1337, the city kept close ties with Venice and acted almost independently of the prince of Achaea. When Frangipani died in 1337, the Angevin bailiff Bertrand of Les Baux besieged Patras to force it to obey, but Pope Benedict XII declared the city land of the Holy Roman Church and laid the principality under interdict; the regent Catherine of Valois gave way, and from then on the archbishop ruled Patras as an effectively independent ecclesiastical domain, still nominally holding his fiefs of Achaea. As Ottoman and Albanian raids grew, the archbishops sought Venetian protection, and Venice administered the barony from 1408 to 1413 and again briefly in 1418. In 1429 and 1430 Patras surrendered to the Byzantine Despotate of the Morea, ending its Latin rule.
zh: 帕特雷是亚该亚侯国最大的男爵领，位于伯罗奔尼撒半岛西北海岸。它约在1209年作为最初十二个世俗男爵领之一建立，下辖二十四个骑士封邑，13世纪中叶转入帕特雷拉丁礼大主教之手；大主教由此领有三十二个封邑，成为亲王国最强大的封臣。1317年至1337年大主教威廉·弗兰吉帕尼在位期间，该城与威尼斯关系密切，几乎不受亚该亚亲王节制。1337年弗兰吉帕尼去世，安茹王朝的代理官贝特朗·德·博率军围攻帕特雷，企图逼其就范；教皇本笃十二世宣布该城为“罗马神圣教会之地”，并对侯国处以绝罚，摄政瓦卢瓦的凯瑟琳被迫让步，此后大主教作为事实上独立的教会领地统治者治理帕特雷，只在名义上仍向亚该亚领有封邑。随着奥斯曼和阿尔巴尼亚袭扰加剧，大主教转而寻求威尼斯保护，威尼斯于1408年至1413年及1418年短暂代管该男爵领。1429年至1430年，帕特雷向拜占庭的摩里亚专制国投降，拉丁人统治结束。

en: Pavia, the Roman Ticinum on the lower Ticino near the Po, was one of the great royal seats of early medieval Italy. The Ostrogoths made it their capital from 540, and after the Lombards took the city in 572 it became the centre of their kingdom; from 774 it served as the capital of the Kingdom of Italy, where emperors were crowned with the Iron Crown in San Michele Maggiore down to the eleventh century. In the twelfth century Pavia became a self-governing commune, traditionally Ghibelline and the rival of Milan: Frederick Barbarossa held coronations there in 1155 and 1162, and its troops fought for Frederick II at Cortenuova in 1237. The commune kept its independence until 1359, when the Visconti of Milan took it after a hard siege. Galeazzo II moved his court to Pavia in 1365 and built the Visconti castle, the university was refounded in 1361, and Gian Galeazzo began the Certosa di Pavia in 1396. In 1525 the Battle of Pavia ended in the capture of King Francis I of France and opened a long Spanish occupation; the Austrians took the city in 1706 and held it until the French arrived in 1796.
zh: 帕维亚古称提契努姆，位于提契诺河下游、靠近波河，是中世纪早期意大利最重要的王都之一。东哥特人自540年起以它为都，572年伦巴第人攻占后它又成为伦巴第王国的中心；774年起它是意大利王国的都城，直到11世纪，历代皇帝都在圣米凯莱马焦雷教堂戴上铁王冠。12世纪帕维亚成为自治公社，一贯站在吉伯林派一边并与米兰为敌：腓特烈·巴巴罗萨曾于1155年和1162年在此加冕，其军队于1237年在科尔泰诺瓦为腓特烈二世作战。公社维持独立到1359年，才在一场苦战之后被米兰的维斯孔蒂家族征服。加莱亚佐二世于1365年把宫廷迁至帕维亚并修建维斯孔蒂城堡，大学于1361年重建，吉安·加莱亚佐于1396年动工兴建帕维亚切尔托萨修道院。1525年的帕维亚战役以法王弗朗索瓦一世被俘告终，开启了漫长的西班牙占领时期；奥地利人于1706年夺取该城，一直统治到1796年法军到来。

en: Pingchadong was one of the small Tujia cave chiefdoms in the middle Wuling mountains, on the lands of present-day Xiushan County in southeastern Chongqing. Its hereditary Yang chiefs traced their line to the Yang rulers of Bozhou; enfeoffed by the Sizhou chiefdom, they led their clansmen north into the Xiushan valleys, and after Sizhou's fall the office passed under the Youyang Pacification Commission, which from 1375 supervised Pingcha and three sister cave offices. The chiefdom survived into the Qing as the Pingchadong Longship Office. In 1735 the court's gaitu guiliu reforms converted it directly into Xiushan County, and in 1736 the area was folded into the new Youyang Independent Prefecture.
zh: 平茶洞是武陵山脉中段的土家族小型洞官司，其地在今重庆东南部的秀山土家族苗族自治县。世袭长官为杨氏，族源可追溯到播州杨氏；他们受思州土司分封，率族人北迁到秀山一带的河谷，思州灭亡后改属酉阳宣抚司，1375年起平茶与另外三个洞长官司同归酉阳管辖。入清以后它仍以平茶洞长官司传世。1735年朝廷推行改土归流，直接改平茶洞长官司为秀山县，1736年这片地区并入新置的酉阳直隶州。
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/秀山土家族苗族自治县

en: The Paka Jaqis, whose name the Spanish later wrote as Pacajes, were one of the twelve Aymara kingdoms of the Collao altiplano. In their own language the name means eagle men, and they emerged around 1100 from the collapse of the Tiwanaku state, settling the plains and river valleys around the Desaguadero River in present-day western Bolivia, with their capital at Axawiri, the modern Caquiaviri; Tiwanaku itself, Chuqiyapu and Viacha lay within their lands. Herders of llamas and alpacas and growers of potatoes and quinoa, they were judged less centrally organized than their Lupaca neighbours but kept alive the constant warfare of the Aymara chiefdoms. The Pacajes resisted Cusco longer than most: Inca armies met stubborn resistance there from the time of Mayta Capac through the reigns of Yahuar Huaca, Viracocha and Pachacuti, and they were only subdued under the tenth Inca, Tupac Yupanqui, late in the fifteenth century. Under Spanish rule their province became the Corregimiento de Pacajes in 1574, attached to La Paz.
zh: 帕卡贾基斯人——西班牙人后来把这个名字拼写为帕卡赫斯——是科利亚奥高原十二个艾马拉王国之一。其族名在本族语言中意为鹰人，约在1100年蒂亚瓦纳科国家崩溃后兴起，定居在今玻利维亚西部德萨瓜德罗河周围的平原与河谷，都城设在阿沙维里，即今天的卡基亚维里；蒂亚瓦纳科、丘基亚普和比亚查都在其境内。他们放牧骆马和羊驼，种植马铃薯和藜麦，组织程度不如邻邦卢帕卡，却维系着艾马拉诸酋长国之间连绵不断的战事。帕卡贾基斯人对库斯科的抵抗比多数政权都久：从迈塔·卡帕克时代起，历经亚瓦尔·瓦卡克、维拉科查和帕查库特克在位，印加军队始终遭遇顽强阻击，直到15世纪末第十代印卡图帕克·尤潘基时才将其征服。西班牙人统治后，其地于1574年成为隶属拉巴斯的帕卡赫斯印第安人督辖区。

en: Parinacocha took its name from the great shallow lake of the Ayacucho highlands, a name combining the Aymara word for flamingo with the Quechua word for lake; the waters lie west of the Sara Sara volcano at more than 3,200 metres. During the Inca conquests of the 1400s the chiefdom around the lake was absorbed into the empire and became a huamani, or province, counted among the twenty-eight provinces of Kuntisuyu, governed by a local curaca under an Inca apu and settled with colonists brought from other provinces. The ruined Inca village of Inkawasi stands on the lake's north-western shore.
zh: 帕里纳科查得名于阿亚库乔高原上的浅水大湖，湖名由艾马拉语的火烈鸟和克丘亚语的湖泊组合而成，湖面位于萨拉萨拉火山西侧，海拔超过3200米。15世纪印加扩张期间，湖畔的酋邦被并入帝国，成为一个瓦马尼，即行省，位列孔蒂苏尤的二十八个省之中，由当地酋长库拉卡在印加长官阿普的统辖下治理，境内还安置了从其他省迁来的移民。湖的西北岸留有印加时期的废弃村庄印卡瓦西遗址。

en: The Pocras, also recorded as Pacora or Pocora in colonial documents, were a Wari-derived people of the Ayacucho highlands in the south-central Peruvian Andes, centered on the site that became the Spanish city of Huamanga. Their Middle Horizon and Late Intermediate culture, dated from roughly 500 to 1000, produced distinctive pottery found at Conchopata and Akuchimay, and their language belonged to the Proto-Aymara family. Closely allied with the Hanan Chancas of Parkos, the Pocras at their height also settled the north-coast valleys of Jayanca and Pacora, and joined the Chanca, Wanka and Ankara attack on Cusco. In the fifteenth century the Inca ruler Pachacútec crushed the Pocra-Chanca army and, after a long and bloody resistance in which the Pocras and their Soras allies were starved into submission, annexed their lands into the provinces of Parkos and Guamanka. Some Pocra elites fled to the jungle at Lamas and Tarapoto, while a small Pocra polity under an administrator named Simi Auka survived into Spanish colonial times.
zh: 波克拉人在殖民文献中又作帕科拉或波科拉，是秘鲁中南部安第斯山区阿亚库乔高原的族群，属瓦里文化的一支，中心在后来成为西班牙城市瓦曼加的地方。其文化兴盛于约500年至1000年的中段视野期与晚中间期，在孔乔帕塔和阿库奇马伊留下了独具特色的陶器，所操语言属原始艾马拉语系。波克拉人与帕科斯的上昌卡人结成紧密同盟，鼎盛时还移居北岸的哈扬卡和帕科拉河谷，并参与了昌卡、万卡和安卡拉诸部对库斯科的进攻。15世纪，印加统治者帕查库特克击溃波克拉—昌卡联军；波克拉人与盟友索拉斯人经过长期而惨烈的抵抗，最终因断水断粮投降，故土被并入帕科斯和瓦曼卡两省。部分波克拉贵族逃往丛林中的拉马斯和塔拉波托，而一个由长官西米·奥卡管理的小波克拉政权一直存续到西班牙殖民时代。

en: Paderborn was an ecclesiastical principality in Westphalia whose diocese was founded in 799 by Pope Leo III. After the fall of the Duchy of Saxony in 1180 the see's overlordship passed to the Archbishops of Cologne, but the bishops steadily built up their own secular territory, recovering the diocesan bailiwick and holding it directly. In 1281 Bishop Otto of Rietberg received the regalia from King Rudolph of Habsburg, and the defeat of Cologne at the Battle of Worringen in 1288 left the bishops effectively sovereign within their Hochstift. In 1337 the ruler was Bernhard V of Lippe, who issued the first territorial constitution, the Privilegium Bernhardi, while conceding judicial freedom to the city of Paderborn itself. Later bishops were often foreigners in all but name: Dietrich of Moers ruled both Paderborn and Cologne and his feud with the city of Soest from 1444 to 1449 devastated the bishopric. The Reformation made deep inroads around it, yet the Jesuits called in 1580 and the University of Paderborn founded in 1614 re-established Catholic rule. The principality fell to Prussia in the mediatisation of 1802 and passed to the Kingdom of Westphalia from 1807 to 1813.
zh: 帕德博恩是威斯特伐利亚的教会邦国，其教区由教皇利奥三世于799年设立。1180年萨克森公国解体后，教区的宗主权转归科隆大主教，但历任主教逐步经营起自己的世俗领地，收回教区护院权并直接管理。1281年，主教里特贝格的奥托从哈布斯堡的鲁道夫国王手中领受皇权象征，1288年科隆在沃林根战役战败后，主教在自己的采邑内已形同君主。1337年在位的是利珀的伯恩哈德五世，他颁布了第一部领地宪法《伯恩哈德特权书》，同时承认帕德博恩城在司法上不受主教管辖。后来的主教往往遥领此地：默尔斯的迪特里希兼治帕德博恩与科隆，他在1444至1449年与索斯特城的世仇争斗使主教区惨遭破坏。宗教改革在周边地区深入传播，但1580年被召来的耶稣会士和1614年创立的帕德博恩大学重建了天主教统治。1802年采邑调解中该邦国并入普鲁士，1807至1813年改属威斯特伐利亚王国。

en: Píngdìng was the native Pingding Chief's Office in the mountain country of central Guizhou, around present-day Majiang. From 1494 it was one of the three chief's offices, with Leping and Maha, placed under the Ming department of Maha, and its hereditary chiefs kept their posts into the Qing.
zh: 平定即平定长官司，是贵州中部山区、今麻江县一带的土著土司。1494年明朝置麻哈州，平定司与乐坪、麻哈二司同为其下辖三长官司，长官世代承袭，延续至清代。

en: Prudnik, called Neustadt in German, is a small Silesian lordship on the Bohemian border, whose castle was founded in 1255 by Vok of Rosenberg on the orders of King Ottokar II of Bohemia to guard the trade road from Nysa to Opava. The town grew up under the Piast dukes of Opole, and in 1336 the Bohemian king John of Luxembourg allowed Bolesław the Elder, Piast duke of Niemodlin, to buy Prudnik and its surrounding villages for two thousand fines. Bolesław had done homage to John together with the other Silesian dukes at Opava in 1327, so the little lordship entered 1337 as a Bohemian fief held by a Piast. His descendants kept the area until the early fifteenth century, when it was combined with neighbouring Głogówek into the Duchy of Głogówek and Prudnik, which suffered heavily in the Hussite invasion of 1428. That duchy kept a separate identity until 1562, after which Prudnik shared the fate of Austrian Silesia and passed to Prussia in 1742.
zh: 普鲁德尼克（德语称诺伊施塔特）是波希米亚边境上的一个西里西亚小领地。1255年，罗森贝格的沃克奉波希米亚国王奥托卡二世之命在此修建城堡，扼守从尼斯到奥帕瓦的商道，城镇随后在奥波莱的皮亚斯特公爵治下发展起来。1336年，波希米亚国王卢森堡的约翰准许涅莫德林的皮亚斯特公爵博莱斯瓦夫“长者”以两千罚款的价钱买下普鲁德尼克及其周边村庄。博莱斯瓦夫已于1327年在奥帕瓦与其他西里西亚公爵一同向约翰行过臣服礼，因此这块小领地在1337年是以波希米亚封邑、皮亚斯特家族领有的身份出现的。他的后代保有该地直到15世纪初，随后它与邻近的格沃古韦克合并为格沃古韦克和普鲁德尼克公国，并在1428年胡斯派入侵中遭到严重破坏。该公国一直保持独立身份至1562年，此后普鲁德尼克随奥地利治下的西里西亚同命运，于1742年转归普鲁士。

en: Pǔdìng grew out of the Puli tribe around present-day Anshun in central Guizhou. The Mongols set up a wanhu office there in 1257 and converted it into the Puding prefecture under Yunnan province in 1278; in 1303 it became the Puding route, and in 1351 the Anshun and Xi'an departments and Puding county were carved from its lands. Its female chieftain Shi'er submitted to the Ming together with the Shuixi ruler Aicui in 1371, and the Puding native prefecture was confirmed in 1372, reorganized as a military-civilian prefecture in 1382, then dissolved in 1383 when Anshun became a department directly under Yunnan; Puding county was abolished in 1385 and Xi'an department merged into Anshun. After Guizhou province was created in 1413 the lands passed to Guizhou, Anshun was placed directly under it in 1438, was promoted to a military-civilian prefecture in 1602, and the county of Puding was restored in 1672 as its seat before the administration was renamed Anshun prefecture in 1687.
zh: 普定源于今贵州安顺一带的普里部。蒙古于1257年在其地设普定万户府，1278年改置普定府，1303年改为普定路，1351年又分置安顺州、习安州和普定县。1371年，普定女总管适尔与水西土司霭翠等率土归附明朝，1372年明廷置普定土府，1382年改置军民府，1383年府废，安顺州改为直隶云南的州，1385年废普定县，习安州并入安顺州。1413年贵州设布政使司，1438年安顺州直隶贵州，1602年升为安顺军民府，1672年复置普定县为府治，1687年改称安顺府。

en: The Kingdom of Cochin, formally Perumpadappu Swaroopam, arose in the early twelfth century in central Kerala after the collapse of the Later Chera kings, to whom it had been a feudatory. Its ruling house first held court at Kodungallur but moved its capital to Kochi in 1341 after a flood wrecked the old seat, and repeated attacks by the Zamorin of Kozhikode had shrunk the kingdom to its smallest extent by the late fifteenth century. In 1500 Raja Unni Goda Varma welcomed the Portuguese commander Cabral and made an alliance against the Zamorin; Fort Manuel was built and Cochin remained a Portuguese protectorate from 1503 to 1663, serving as Portugal's main Indian base after Goa. Saint Francis Xavier founded a mission there in 1530, and Vasco da Gama was buried at Cochin in 1524 before his remains were returned to Portugal in 1539. The Dutch East India Company took over as protector in 1663, followed by the British in 1795. Hyder Ali of Mysore made Cochin a tributary in 1766, and under the treaty of 1809 it became a princely state under British paramountcy.
zh: 科钦王国正式名称为佩鲁姆帕杜斯瓦鲁帕姆，12世纪初兴起于喀拉拉中部，此前是后期哲罗诸王的附庸，哲罗崩溃后获得独立。王室最初驻跸科敦加卢尔，1341年洪水摧毁旧都后迁都科钦；由于科泽科德扎莫林连番进攻，到15世纪末王国领土已缩至最小。1500年罗阇温尼·戈达·瓦尔马迎接葡萄牙统帅卡布拉尔，缔结针对扎莫林的同盟；曼努埃尔堡垒随后建成，1503至1663年间科钦是葡萄牙的保护国，也是葡萄牙在果阿之外最重要的印度据点。1530年圣方济各·沙勿略在此建立传教团，瓦斯科·达伽马于1524年下葬科钦，遗骨在1539年运回葡萄牙。1663年荷兰东印度公司接替葡萄牙成为保护者，1795年又换成英国人。1766年迈索尔的海德尔·阿里迫使科钦纳贡称臣，根据1809年的条约，它成为英国宗主权下的土邦。

en: Perugia, the Etruscan Perusia and one of the twelve cities of the Etruscan League, stands on a ridge in the Umbrian hills. In the ninth century it passed under the popes, but by the eleventh century its commune was running its own affairs, warring against Foligno, Assisi, Spoleto and Siena; Emperor Henry VI recognised its consular government in 1186. A Guelph city where several popes took refuge and five conclaves met between 1216 and 1305, it nonetheless rejected papal sovereignty and fought Pope Urban V in 1369, only to accept a papal legate the next year and expel him in 1375. Its university was founded in 1308. The condottiere Biordo Michelotti became its first lord in 1393, and Braccio da Montone ruled from 1416 until his death in 1424. The Baglioni family then held the city from 1438, their patronage drawing Raphael and Pinturicchio, until their bloody feuds ended in the Red Wedding of 1500. In 1540 Pope Paul III's troops sacked Perugia and built the Rocca Paolina, absorbing it into the Papal States, where it remained until French troops arrived in 1797 and set up the short-lived Tiberina Republic.
zh: 佩鲁贾古称佩鲁西亚，是伊特鲁里亚联盟十二城之一，雄踞翁布里亚丘陵的山脊上。9世纪它转入教皇治下，但到11世纪公社已自行管理政务，不断与福利尼奥、阿西西、斯波莱托和锡耶纳交战；皇帝亨利六世于1186年承认其执政官政府。作为圭尔夫派城市，多位教皇曾到此避难，1216—1305年间有五次教皇选举会议在此举行，但它始终拒绝教皇主权，1369年与教皇乌尔班五世开战，次年被迫接受教皇使节，又于1375年将其驱逐。佩鲁贾大学创办于1308年。佣兵队长比尔多·米凯洛蒂于1393年成为第一位城市领主，布拉乔·达·蒙托内则在1416—1424年间统治该城。此后巴廖尼家族自1438年起掌控佩鲁贾，其赞助吸引了拉斐尔和平图里基奥等艺术家，直到家族仇杀酿成1500年的红色婚礼惨案。1540年教皇保罗三世的军队洗劫城市，修建保利纳堡垒，把它并入教皇国；它一直留在教皇国内，直到1797年法军到来并建立短命的台伯里纳共和国。

en: Hanthawaddy, also called the Martaban or Pegu kingdom, was the Mon-speaking polity of lower Burma, with its first capital at Martaban. It arose from the collapse of the Pagan empire: the local chief Wareru seized Martaban in 1285, declared independence in 1287 with Sukhothai's backing, and by about 1296 had united the three Mon provinces of Bassein, Pegu and Martaban. The law code he commissioned, the Wareru Dhammathat, long outlived him. At first a loose federation and a nominal Sukhothai vassal, it became fully independent in 1330 when Binnya E Law, its ruler in 1337, repelled a Siamese invasion. Under Binnya U the court shifted to Pegu, which became the permanent capital. Razadarit, reigning from 1384 to 1421, unified the Mon provinces and held Ava at bay through the Forty Years' War of 1385 to 1424. The next century was Hanthawaddy's golden age: rulers such as Shin Sawbu and Dhammazedi drew wealth from Indian Ocean trade and made Pegu a centre of Theravada Buddhist reform linked to Sri Lanka. In 1538 and 1539 Tabinshwehti of Toungoo overran the delta and Pegu, taking Martaban in 1541; a Mon revival of 1550 was crushed by Bayinnaung in 1552. The Mon rose again in 1740, sacked Ava in 1752 and ended the Toungoo dynasty, but Alaungpaya of the new Konbaung dynasty destroyed Pegu in 1757, ending Mon rule in lower Burma.
zh: 汉达瓦底又称马达班王国或勃固王国，是下缅甸的孟人政权，最初定都马达班。它兴起于蒲甘帝国崩溃之际：地方首领伐丽流于1285年夺取马达班，1287年在素可泰支持下宣布独立，约1296年统一勃生、勃固和马达班三个孟人省份；他下令编纂的《伐丽流法典》流传久远。建国之初它只是松散的联盟，名义上臣属素可泰，1330年，1337年在位的频耶埃劳击退暹罗入侵，王国获得完全独立。频耶宇治下宫廷迁往勃固，勃固从此成为固定国都。1384至1421年在位的亚扎底律统一孟人诸省，在1385至1424年的四十年战争中挡住了阿瓦的攻势。此后一个世纪是汉达瓦底的黄金时代：信修浮、达摩悉提等君臣依靠印度洋贸易积聚财富，使勃固成为与锡兰相通的上座部佛教改革中心。1538至1539年，东吁的德彬瑞蒂攻占三角洲与勃固，1541年又陷马达班；1550年孟人的复国尝试在1552年被勃印曩镇压。1740年孟人再度起义，1752年攻陷阿瓦、灭亡东吁王朝，但新兴贡榜王朝的雍籍牙于1757年攻破勃固，孟人在下缅甸的统治就此终结。

en: Pemba, the Green Island of Arab geographers, is the northern major island of the Zanzibar Archipelago, separated from the Tanzanian mainland by the deep Pemba Channel. Bantu farmers from the Tanga coast had settled there by the seventh century, founding towns such as Tumbe, and on the long western peninsula of Ras Mkumbuu rose the stone city now identified, plausibly but not certainly, with Qanbalu, the Muslim trading port described by al-Masudi around 900. Its mosque was long the largest in sub-Saharan Africa, and the ruins span the ninth to the sixteenth century. By the mid-thirteenth century the geographer Yaqut al-Hamawi could report two independent sultans sharing the island, and in the fifteenth century Pemba numbered among the vassal island-states of Kilwa. Portuguese rule over the archipelago from about 1503 brought decline to the old towns, and Ras Mkumbuu was abandoned during the sixteenth century. After the Omani conquest of 1698 settlements revived, and from the late eighteenth century Pemba turned increasingly to plantation agriculture, exporting sugar and later cloves under its Zanzibari overlords.
zh: 奔巴在阿拉伯地理学家笔下称‘绿岛’，是桑给巴尔群岛两座主岛中偏北的一座，与坦桑尼亚大陆隔着幽深的奔巴海峡。7世纪时，来自坦噶海岸的班图农民已在此定居，建立了通贝等城镇；在西部狭长的姆昆比角半岛上，兴起了一座石城，今人很有把握但尚未完全确定地将它比定为马苏迪约在900年记述的穆斯林商港坎巴卢。城中的清真寺曾长期是撒哈拉以南非洲最大的同类建筑，遗址年代从9世纪延续到16世纪。到13世纪中叶，地理学家雅库特·哈马维已记载岛上有两位各自独立的苏丹分地而治；15世纪时，奔巴是基卢瓦的附庸岛国之一。约1503年起葡萄牙人统治整个群岛，旧城走向衰落，姆昆比角在16世纪被废弃。1698年阿曼征服之后，聚落重新兴旺，18世纪末起奔巴日益转向种植园农业，在桑给巴尔统治者治下出口蔗糖，后来又广种丁香。

en: The County of Périgord took its name from the Petrocorii, the Gaulish tribe that held the region against Roman conquest; its pagus became a fief of the Duchy of Aquitaine, centred on Périgueux and divided between the lands of Périgueux, Bergerac and Sarlat. From the tenth century its counts came from the house of Charroux, later called Talleyrand. In 1337 the count was Roger-Bernard, who had succeeded his brother in 1334 and ruled from Périgueux as a vassal of the French crown. Périgord became one of the chief battlegrounds of the Hundred Years' War, as English and French armies contested its towns and castles. The last Talleyrand counts, Archambaud V and Archambaud VI, were dispossessed by Charles VI in 1398 and 1399, and in 1400 the county was re-granted as a peerage to Louis I, Duke of Orléans. It passed through the houses of Châtillon and Albret to Henry of Bourbon, who inherited it in 1572 and became King Henry IV in 1589; with the death of his sister Catherine in 1604 it merged into the royal domain.
zh: 佩里戈尔伯国得名于高卢部族佩特罗科里人，该部族曾据守此地抵抗罗马征服；其故土后来成为阿基坦公国的封地，以佩里格为中心，分为佩里格、贝尔热拉克和萨尔拉三片区域。10世纪起，伯爵出自沙鲁家族，即后来的塔列朗家族。1337年在位的罗热—贝尔纳于1334年继兄长之位，以法兰西国王封臣的身份从佩里格统治伯国。百年战争期间，佩里戈尔是英法两军反复争夺城镇与城堡的主要战场之一。末代塔列朗伯爵阿尔尚博五世和阿尔尚博六世先后于1398年和1399年被查理六世剥夺领地；1400年，伯国被作为世卿领地改封给奥尔良公爵路易一世。此后它历经沙蒂永家族和阿尔布雷家族，1572年传给波旁的亨利——此人于1589年即位为国王亨利四世；1604年其妹卡特琳去世后，佩里戈尔并入王室领地。

en: Pesaro is an Adriatic port in the Marche, founded by the Romans as the colony of Pisaurum in 184 BC on the Via Flaminia. The Ostrogoth king Vitigis destroyed it in 539 during the Gothic War; rebuilt under Byzantine rule, it joined the Pentapolis of the Exarchate of Ravenna and later passed to the Papal States. During the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries the Malatesta of Rimini built up a lordship over the Romagna and the Marche, and Malatesta II Guastafamiglia became lord of Pesaro in 1326, ruling it together with Rimini. In 1445 the last Malatesta sold the city, and it passed to the Sforza, who held it until 1512; the wedding of Costanzo Sforza and Camilla d'Aragona was celebrated there in 1475. From 1513 the Della Rovere dukes of Urbino made Pesaro the capital of their duchy, surrounding it with new walls and filling it with palaces. When the Della Rovere line died out in 1631, the duchy reverted to the Papal States, under whose government Pesaro remained for the rest of this period.
zh: 佩萨罗是马尔凯地区的亚得里亚海港口，公元前184年罗马人沿弗拉米尼亚大道在此建立殖民城皮萨乌鲁姆。哥特战争期间，东哥特国王维蒂吉斯于539年摧毁该城；拜占庭统治时期它得到重建，加入拉文纳总督区的五城同盟，后来转入教皇国。14至15世纪，里米尼的马拉泰斯塔家族在罗马涅和马尔凯建立起领地，马拉泰斯塔二世·瓜斯塔法米利亚于1326年成为佩萨罗领主，并与里米尼合并统治。1445年末代马拉泰斯塔领主卖掉城市，佩萨罗转入斯福尔扎家族之手，一直统治到1512年；1475年，科斯坦佐·斯福尔扎与阿拉贡的卡米拉的婚礼在此举行。1513年起，乌尔比诺公爵德拉·罗韦雷家族把佩萨罗定为公国都城，为它修筑新城墙、广建宫殿。1631年德拉·罗韦雷家族绝嗣，公国回归教皇国，佩萨罗在此后整个时期都受教皇国管辖。

en: Píngbà was a native chieftain's seat in the Puli tribal lands of central Guizhou, present-day Pingba in Anshun. In the early Yuan it belonged to the Puding route, and under the Ming it was absorbed into the guard system as a military post ruling five battalions; the Qing later made it the county of Anping.
zh: 平坝是贵州中部普里部地上的土著土司治所，即今安顺市平坝区。元初其地属普定路，明代被纳入卫所体制，设统辖五个千户所的军事机构，清代改置为安平县。

en: Pugal is a desert fort-town in the arid Jangladesh country of northern Rajasthan, the dry belt between Jaisalmer and the Bhatner frontier. In the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries it was the seat of a small Bhati Rajput chiefdom, one of the Bhati holdings scattered across the western marches alongside Jaisalmer itself. Its best-documented ruler is Rao Kelana, also called Kelhana, a disinherited son of Rao Kehar of Jaisalmer, who secured the fort of Pugal in 1414 by marrying the Sodhi widow of its previous chief. From Pugal he raided as far as Bhatinda, Abohar and Dera Ghazi Khan, where he defeated the Baloch, and at his death in 1430 held nine forts; he also joined the coalition that surprised and killed Rao Chunda of Marwar at Nagaur. His sons kept Pugal for a generation, but later in the fifteenth century Rao Bika's Rathore conquest of Jangladesh absorbed the chiefdom into the new kingdom of Bikaner.
zh: 布格尔是拉贾斯坦北部干旱的禅伽罗德什地区的一座沙漠堡垒城镇，坐落在斋沙默尔与巴特尼尔边境之间的荒漠地带。14至15世纪，这里是巴蒂拉杰普特人的一个小首领政权，与斋沙默尔同属散布在西部边陲的巴蒂领地。其最可考的统治者是拉奥·凯拉纳，又名凯尔哈纳，他本是斋沙默尔君主凯哈尔之子，因私自娶妻被剥夺继承权，1414年通过迎娶布格尔前任首领的索迪遗孀取得布格尔堡。他以布格尔为据点四处出击，兵锋远至珀丁达、阿博赫尔和德拉加齐汗，在那里击败俾路支人，到1430年去世时已据有九座堡垒；他还加入了在纳高尔突袭并击杀马尔瓦尔君主拉奥·琼达的首领联盟。他的子孙据守布格尔一代人，到15世纪后期，拉奥·比卡率拉托尔人征服禅伽罗德什，这个小邦被并入新兴的比卡内尔王国。

en: Caboloan, also called Luyag na Caboloan or Binalatongan, was a pre-colonial Pangasinan polity on the Agno River delta in western Luzon, its chief town of Binalatongan being the largest settlement in the region, with more than two thousand houses. Its name means the place of the bolo bamboo, and it traded bamboo, beeswax and forest produce down the Agno to the coast in exchange for salt and Chinese goods. Its people worshipped the war god Apolaki alongside the anito spirits, kept female shamans and were feared as mangangayaw raiders performing tagam war dances. Local legend remembers a king named Ari Kasikis, though historians note that the name rests only on much later census records. Juan de Salcedo overran the Pangasinan coast in 1572, and after the Chinese pirate Limahong tried to found his own kingdom there in 1574 and 1575, the Spaniards pushed into the interior. Dominican missionaries established Binalatongan in 1587, and in 1611 the creation of the province of Pangasinan absorbed Caboloan outright. The district later rose in the revolts of Andres Malong in 1660 and Juan de la Cruz Palaris in 1762.
zh: 邦阿西楠又称卢亚格·那·卡博洛安或比纳拉托岸，是吕宋西部阿格诺河三角洲上的前殖民邦阿西楠政权，其首镇比纳拉托岸有两千多户人家，是当时该地区最大的定居点。其国名意为“博罗竹丛生之地”，居民沿阿格诺河把竹子、蜂蜡和山林物产运到海边，换取食盐和中国货物。他们信奉战神阿波拉基和阿尼托神灵，有女萨满，并以跳塔加姆战舞、从事猎头劫掠的曼加加尧武士闻名。当地传说有一位名叫阿里·卡西基斯的国王，但历史学家指出这个名字仅见于晚得多的人口普查记录。1572年胡安·德·萨尔塞多横扫邦阿西楠沿海；1574至1575年华人海盗林凤试图在此自立王国，西班牙人随即深入内陆。1587年多明我会传教士建立比纳拉托岸传教点，1611年邦阿西楠省设立，邦阿西楠政权被彻底并入。此地后来又爆发了1660年安德烈斯·马隆起义和1762年胡安·德·拉·克鲁斯·帕拉里斯起义。

en: Phayao, also called Phukamyao, was a Tai mueang of the upper Ing and Yom river basins in what is now northern Thailand, centred on the twin walled towns of Wiang Namtao and Wiang Phayao. According to the Phayao Chronicle it was refounded by Khun Chomtham, a younger son of the ruler of Ngoenyang, who restored the abandoned old city and reunited the surrounding chiefdoms. Its golden age came under Ngammueang, who took the throne in 1258 and was the first of its rulers attested outside the chronicles. He joined Mangrai of Ngoenyang and Ramkhamhaeng of Sukhothai in the Three Kings alliance, and in 1296 attended the founding of Mangrai's new capital at Chiang Mai, the heart of the emerging Lan Na kingdom. In 1263 Ngammueang also conquered Pua, capital of the neighbouring Nan polity, though Nan regained its freedom in 1320. The end came in 1338, when Khamfu of Chiang Saen and the Nan ruler Phaya Phanong sacked Phayao's two capitals and drove out King Khamlue; Khamfu then annexed the city to Lan Na, while the eastern towns along the upper Yom went to Nan.
zh: 帕尧又称普卡尧，是泰人的一个勐，位于今泰国北部的英河与永河上游流域，以威南陶与威帕尧两座双子城为中心。据《帕尧编年史》记载，恩央国王之子宗坦重修废城、统一周边各部，重建了这个邦国。1258年即位的昂孟开创了帕尧的黄金时代，他也是首位见诸编年史之外史料的帕尧君主。他与恩央的孟莱、素可泰的兰甘亨结成三王同盟，并于1296年出席孟莱新都清迈的奠基典礼，清迈正是新兴兰纳王国的核心。1263年，昂孟还攻占了邻邦难的都城磨，但难在1320年恢复独立。1338年帕尧走到尽头：清盛的坎富与难王帕亚帕农联手洗劫帕尧两城，赶走国王坎鲁；坎富随即将帕尧并入兰纳，永河上游的东部城镇则划归难国。

en: The Lordship of Piedmont, lying at the foot of the Alps around Turin and Pinerolo, was the Italian holding of the House of Savoy, governed by its Savoy-Achaia cadet branch. The region had come to the counts of Savoy in 1046, and Philip I of the branch also acquired the Principality of Achaea in Greece by marriage. In 1337 its lord was James of Savoy-Achaia, a vassal of his cousin the Count of Savoy. James backed the Angevins of Naples against the Marquess of Montferrat and, after the defeat at Gamenario in 1345, retook Chieri in 1347 with the army of Amadeus VI of Savoy. A later quarrel with the count saw him captured at Pinerolo and his lands confiscated, though they were restored in 1362, five years before his death. The last lord, Louis, founded the University of Turin in 1405 and died childless in 1418; the branch then became extinct and Piedmont reverted to the ducal line of Savoy, whose dukes moved their capital to Turin in 1563.
zh: 皮埃蒙特领地位于阿尔卑斯山脚下，以都灵和皮内罗洛为中心，是萨伏依家族在意大利一侧的领地，由其支系萨伏依-阿哈亚家族统治。这一地区于1046年归入萨伏依伯爵名下，支系的腓力一世还通过婚姻取得了希腊的亚该亚侯国。1337年在位的领主是詹姆斯·萨伏依-阿哈亚，他臣属于堂亲萨伏依伯爵。詹姆斯支持那不勒斯安茹家族对抗蒙费拉侯爵，在1345年加梅纳里奥之败后，于1347年借萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥六世的军队收复基耶里。后来他与伯爵反目，在皮内罗洛被俘、领地被没收，1362年才恢复领地，五年后去世。末代领主路德维科于1405年创办都灵大学，1418年无子而终，支系就此绝嗣，皮埃蒙特回归萨伏依公爵主支，公爵们后来在1563年把都城迁到都灵。

en: The Pinagua were a chiefdom of the Cusco valley, remembered mainly through the chronicles of the early Inca wars. Like the Ayarmaca, to whom they were closely bound, they took shape around the thirteenth century from the wreckage of the Wari culture; Spanish documents always name the two kingdoms together, and one chronicle calls the Pinagua half of the powerful Ayarmaca state. Their lands lay east and southeast of Cusco, around Quispicancha, Sailla and the Lucre lake, with their chief seat at the old Wari centre of Pikillaqta, a walled settlement occupied from about 550 and abandoned around 1100. When Inca Roca overthrew the Hurin Cusco dynasty around 1350, the Pinagua sinchi Huaman Tupac rose with the Muyna to recover their independence, but was defeated in the first battle and disappeared; Inca Roca later conquered Pinagua outright. They rebelled once more under Viracocha Inca, backed by Rondocancha and Casacancha, and were again crushed, after which their lands passed into the growing Inca state.
zh: 皮纳瓜是库斯科河谷的一个酋长国，主要因早期印卡战争的记载而被人记住。与关系密切的阿亚尔马卡一样，它约在13世纪从瓦里文化的废墟上形成；西班牙文献总是把这两个王国相提并论，一部编年史更称皮纳瓜人占了强大阿亚尔马卡政权的一半。其领地在库斯科以东和东南，环绕基斯皮坎查、萨伊利亚和卢克雷湖，治所设在古老的瓦里中心皮基拉克塔，这座有城墙的聚落约从550年起有人居住，1100年前后被废弃。约1350年印卡·罗卡推翻下库斯科王朝时，皮纳瓜首领瓦曼·图帕克与穆伊纳人一道起兵谋求独立，却一战即败、不知所终；印卡·罗卡随后彻底征服皮纳瓜。维拉科查·印卡在位时，他们在龙多坎查和卡萨坎查支持下再次反叛，又被镇压，领地从此并入日益壮大的印卡国家。

en: The Pinya kingdom ruled central Burma from its capital in the Kyaukse granary between 1313 and 1365, claiming to be the legal successor of the fallen Pagan empire. It grew out of the Myinsaing regency of three former Pagan commanders, and in 1313 the youngest of them, Thihathu, crowned himself king at a newly built city, Pinya, with the old Pagan queen Pwa Saw performing the ceremony. Division began almost at once: his eldest son Saw Yun took the northern province of Sagaing, winning autonomy in 1315 to 1317 and full independence in 1325. The rump state was then torn by the rivalry of Thihathu's sons Uzana I and Kyawswa I, while its southern vassals Toungoo and Prome were practically independent. Central authority briefly revived under Kyawswa I from 1344, but the Shan state of Maw raided the kingdom in 1358 to 1359 and again in 1362 to 1363, devastating the countryside and allowing Toungoo to break away. In 1364 Maw troops sacked both Pinya and Sagaing, and Thado Minbya of Sagaing seized the ruined capitals and founded the Ava kingdom in 1365.
zh: 彬牙王国于1313年至1365年间以粮仓皎施地区的彬牙城为都，统治缅甸中部，自称是覆灭的蒲甘王国的法理继承者。它由敏象王国的三位蒲甘旧将摄政演变而来：1313年，三兄弟中最年轻的底哈都在新建的彬牙城加冕称王，由蒲甘寡后菩娑亲自主持仪式。建国伊始分裂便随之而来：长子苏云占据北方的实皆省，于1315年至1317年间取得自治，并在1325年正式独立。残存的王国又陷入底哈都之子乌兹那与觉苏瓦一世的争斗，南方附庸东吁和卑谬则形同独立。1344年起觉苏瓦一世一度重振中央权威，但掸人政权麓川先后在1358年至1359年、1362年至1363年两度入寇，蹂躏乡野，东吁也趁机脱离。1364年麓川军队接连洗劫实皆和彬牙，实皆的德多明帕耶夺取两座残破都城，于1365年建立阿瓦王国。

en: The Republic of Pisa was one of the four great maritime republics of medieval Italy, its fleet dominating the Tyrrhenian Sea. Pisan ships helped take Sardinia from the Saracens in 1016, conquered Corsica in 1051 and 1052, and Pope Urban II recognised the city's supremacy over both islands in 1092 while raising its see to an archdiocese. Its consuls and council of elders were confirmed in their rights by Emperor Henry IV in 1077, and after the Pisans captured Amalfi in 1136 the city stood as an equal of Venice. A steadfast Ghibelline power, Pisa was granted wide trading privileges by Frederick Barbarossa and defeated Florence at Montecatini in 1315. Its long rivalry with Genoa ended in catastrophe at the naval Battle of Meloria in 1284, after which it renounced Corsica and sold its share of Sardinia in 1299; the Aragonese conquest of Sardinia from 1323 stripped away more of its empire. In 1399 the signore Gherardo Appiani sold the city to Gian Galeazzo Visconti, and in 1406 Florentine mercenaries occupied Pisa and annexed it to Florence. A council met there in 1409 to heal the Great Schism, and when Charles VIII of France entered Italy in 1494 the Pisans briefly restored a Second Pisan Republic before Florentine rule returned.
zh: 比萨共和国是中世纪意大利四大海上共和国之一，其舰队曾称雄第勒尼安海。比萨舰船于1016年协助从撒拉森人手中夺取撒丁岛，1051—1052年征服科西嘉岛；1092年教皇乌尔班二世承认比萨对两岛的宗主权，并把其主教座升格为总主教区。1077年皇帝亨利四世确认了执政官和长老会议的权利，1136年比萨攻占阿马尔菲后，地位已与威尼斯比肩。作为坚定的吉伯林派势力，比萨获腓特烈·巴巴罗萨授予广泛贸易特权，并于1315年在蒙特卡蒂尼击败佛罗伦萨。它与热那亚的长期争霸在1284年的梅洛里亚海战中以惨败告终，随后放弃科西嘉，又于1299年卖掉在撒丁岛的份额；1323年起阿拉贡人对撒丁岛的征服进一步剥蚀了它的海外领地。1399年领主盖拉尔多·阿皮亚尼把城市卖给吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂，1406年佛罗伦萨佣兵占领比萨并将其并入佛罗伦萨。1409年一次旨在结束天主教会大分裂的公会议在此召开；1494年法王查理八世入侵意大利时，比萨人曾短暂重建第二共和国，但佛罗伦萨的统治很快恢复。

en: Pudjananti is the game's name for an early Kaili polity on Donggala Bay in north-western Celebes, later divided among the small kingdoms of Palu, Banawa, Parigi and Moutong. In Kaili tradition this was the Tomanuru age, when villages were ruled by aristocratic madika said to descend from heavenly beings.
zh: 普占纳提是游戏对苏拉威西西北海岸栋加拉湾一带早期凯里人政权的称呼，其地后来分属帕卢、巴纳瓦、帕里吉、莫通等小王国。在凯里人的传统史述中，这属于托玛努鲁时代，村落由相传为天神后裔的贵族玛迪卡治理。

en: Passokkorang was a Mandarese kingdom that dominated the Mandar region of western Sulawesi by force of arms from at least the thirteenth century, its power centred on the lower Mandar River around the later site of Balanipa. In the mid-fifteenth century its king's arbitrary rule and his push for a coastal trade route drove the riverside villages of Napo, Samasundu, Mosso and Todang-todang to band together in the Appeq Banua Kayyang alliance. Unable to resist Passokkorang alone, the allies called in Gowa, which sent an elite commander, I Manyambungi; his troops broke Passokkorang's attacks, and in 1511 the victorious alliance re-founded itself as the kingdom of Balanipa with I Manyambungi as its first king. The Mandar lands later entered the seven-estuary Pitu Baqbana Binanga alliance and, like the other Mandarese states, adopted Islam in the early seventeenth century.
zh: 帕索科朗是西苏拉威西曼达地区的曼达里人王国，至迟从13世纪起便以武力称雄，势力中心在曼达河下游、后来巴拉尼帕所在的地方。15世纪中叶，其君主统治专横，又向海岸扩张以开辟海上商路，迫使纳波、萨马孙杜、莫索和托当托当等河畔村落结成阿佩克·巴努阿·卡扬联盟。联盟独力难支，向戈瓦求援，戈瓦派出精锐将领伊·曼扬邦吉；他率军击退帕索科朗的攻势，1511年获胜的联盟改组为巴拉尼帕王国，由伊·曼扬邦吉出任第一代国王。此后曼达地区加入由七个河口王国组成的联盟，并与其他曼达里邦国一样在17世纪初改宗伊斯兰教。

en: Pal Lahara was one of the Garhjat states, the small hill chiefdoms scattered through the forested highlands of inland Orissa, with its seat at the town of Pal Lahara. Tradition held that its founder Santosh Pal was chosen as ruler by the local Sabara tribe, and modern research likewise traces the ruling family to headmen of the Sabara clans; the cobra on the state emblem came from these tribal founding myths. Firm records begin only in 1778 with the death of chief Muni Pal, by which time Pal Lahara was a feudatory of the neighbouring Keonjhar state, its chiefs ruling as zamindars over a largely tribal population.
zh: 帕尔拉哈拉是迦尔贾德土邦之一——这类小山邦散布在奥里萨内陆林木茂密的高地上，治所就在帕尔拉哈拉城。相传其始祖桑托什·帕尔由当地萨巴拉部落推举为首领，后世考证也倾向于认为统治家族出自萨巴拉各部的头人；邦徽上的眼镜蛇便来自这些部落起源神话。可靠记载要到1778年首领穆尼·帕尔去世时才出现，彼时帕尔拉哈拉已是邻近克翁贾尔邦的附庸，其首领以柴明达尔身份统治着以部落民为主的人口。

en: Palembang, on the Musi River in southern Sumatra, was the capital of Srivijaya, the maritime empire that controlled trade through the Strait of Malacca from the seventh to the thirteenth century. The Kedukan Bukit inscription of 682 marks the kingdom's foundation, and when the Chinese pilgrim Yijing stayed there in 671 he found more than a thousand Buddhist monks; the port grew rich housing merchants who waited there for the monsoon winds. A Javanese attack from Mataram sacked the city in 990 before being repelled by 1006, and Chola raids further weakened Srivijaya, whose territories then broke into small kingdoms. By the fourteenth century Palembang had passed under Majapahit's overlordship, and the prince Parameswara fled the city after a Javanese attack, eventually founding Malacca. Pirates then held the estuary until Zheng He's treasure fleet destroyed Chen Zuyi's fleet there in 1407 and installed Shi Jinqing as ruler, Ming records calling the place Jiugang. After the fall of Demak the noble Geding Suro fled to Palembang and founded a new Muslim dynasty; the Dutch East India Company set up a post in 1619, secured a pepper monopoly in 1642 and burned the city in 1659, the year the Palembang Sultanate was proclaimed. Sultan Mahmud Badaruddin I built the Grand Mosque between 1738 and 1748, and after British and Dutch interventions the sultanate was abolished in 1825, when Palembang became the seat of a Dutch residency.
zh: 巴邻旁位于南苏门答腊的穆西河畔，是海上帝国室利佛逝的都城；7至13世纪间，室利佛逝控制着马六甲海峡的贸易。682年的哥杜干布吉铭文记载了这个王国的奠基，671年中国求法僧义净在此停留时，见到的佛教僧侣已逾千人；商人须在此等候季风换向，港口凭此聚敛财富。990年爪哇马打兰军队洗劫巴邻旁，入侵到1006年才被击退，朱罗人的袭击又进一步削弱室利佛逝，其领地随后分裂为众多小邦。14世纪时巴邻旁转入满者伯夷宗主权之下，王子拜里米苏拉在爪哇人的进攻下弃城出逃，后来建立马六甲。此后河口被海盗盘踞，直到1407年郑和的宝船舰队在此歼灭陈祖义的船队，任命施进卿为首领，明代载籍把此地称作旧港。淡目陷落后，贵族基·格德·英·苏罗逃到巴邻旁，建立新的穆斯林王朝；荷兰东印度公司1619年在此设商馆，1642年取得胡椒专卖权，1659年纵火焚城，同年巴邻旁苏丹国宣告成立。马哈茂德·巴达鲁丁一世于1738至1748年修建大清真寺；经过英国与荷兰的接连干涉，苏丹国于1825年被废除，巴邻旁成为荷兰驻扎官辖区的首府。

en: The Pale was the east-coast strip of Ireland where English law and English governance actually held, ruled from Dublin Castle in the name of the King of England, who bore the title Lord of Ireland. The English position began with the Anglo-Norman invasion of 1169 and Henry II's campaign of 1171; in 1177 Henry made his son John Lord of Ireland, and the Lordship of Ireland reached its greatest extent around 1300, when the Parliament of Ireland first met in 1297. The fourteenth century broke that power: the Bruce invasion of 1315 to 1318, the famine of those years, the Black Death and the Hundred Years' War left the crown without the means to control its own Anglo-Norman barons, who increasingly adopted Irish language, law and marriage alliances. The Statutes of Kilkenny of 1366 forbade exactly those Gaelic customs, but could not be enforced. By the mid-fifteenth century direct rule was confined to the four obedient shires of Dublin, Kildare, Meath and Louth, the strip from Dalkey to Dundalk; border trenches were dug from 1454, and the name English Pale, from the Latin palus for a stake, first appears in a statute of the Lord Deputy Poynings in 1494. The earls of Kildare ran the lordship as deputies from 1470 until the Silken Thomas revolt of 1534 to 1535 opened the way to the Tudor conquest, and in 1542 the lordship was reborn as the Kingdom of Ireland.
zh: 帕莱是爱尔兰东海岸上英格兰法律与统治真正生效的狭长地带，以都柏林城堡为中心，以英格兰国王的名义治理，国王本人兼领“爱尔兰领主”头衔。英格兰人的统治始于1169年的盎格鲁-诺曼入侵和1171年亨利二世的亲征；1177年亨利封其子约翰为爱尔兰领主，爱尔兰领地在1300年前后达到极盛，爱尔兰议会也于1297年首次召开。14世纪，这一权势崩解：1315至1318年的布鲁斯入侵、同期的饥荒、黑死病和百年战争，使王室无力约束自家的盎格鲁-诺曼男爵，后者纷纷改用爱尔兰语言、法律并与盖尔人联姻。1366年的《基尔肯尼法令》明令禁止这些盖尔化习俗，却无法推行。到15世纪中叶，王室直辖地区只剩都柏林、基尔代尔、米斯和劳斯这“四个忠顺郡”，即从多基到邓多克的狭长地带；1454年起边界开挖壕沟，而“英格兰帕莱”之名——源自拉丁文意为栅栏的“帕卢斯”——最早见于1494年副总督波伊宁斯召集的议会法令。1470年起，基尔代尔伯爵以副总督身份实际掌管领地，直到1534至1535年的“绸衣托马斯”叛乱为都铎征服打开道路；1542年，爱尔兰领地改组为爱尔兰王国。

en: The Duchy of Płock was one of the small Piast duchies carved out of Mazovia during the medieval fragmentation of Poland, with its capital at Płock on the Vistula, seat of a bishopric founded in 1075. When Duke Boleslaus II of Masovia died in 1313, his son Wenceslaus received Płock and ruled until 1336, followed by his own son Bolesław III, who died without heirs in 1351. The land then passed to Trojden I's son Siemowit III, who reunited most of Mazovia and in 1351 accepted the suzerainty of the Polish king. In the partition of 1381 Płock went to Siemowit IV, and after further divisions it was reorganized as the Płock Voivodeship in 1495. With the extinction of the Masovian Piasts in 1526, the whole of Mazovia, including Płock, was incorporated into the Kingdom of Poland.
zh: 普沃茨克公国是中世纪波兰分裂时期从马佐夫舍分割出来的皮亚斯特小公国之一，首府是维斯瓦河畔的普沃茨克，当地主教区设于1075年。1313年马佐夫舍公爵博莱斯瓦夫二世去世后，其子瓦茨拉夫分得普沃茨克，统治到1336年，之后由其子博莱斯瓦夫三世继位，后者于1351年无嗣而终。领地随后转入特罗伊登一世之子谢莫维特三世手中，他重新统一了马佐夫舍的大部分土地，并于1351年接受波兰国王的宗主权。1381年再次分封时，普沃茨克归谢莫维特四世所有；经过进一步分裂后，该地于1495年改组为普沃茨克省。1526年马佐夫舍皮亚斯特家族绝嗣，包括普沃茨克在内的整个马佐夫舍并入波兰王国。

en: Pulilu was a prehispanic Tagalog barangay on what is now Polillo off eastern Luzon, recorded in the Chinese gazetteer Zhu Fan Zhi of 1225 as a dependency of Sandao and of Ma-i on Mindoro. Its warlike people traded chiefly in rare red and blue corals taken from the sharp reefs around their islands.
zh: 普利禄是殖民以前的他加禄巴朗盖，位于今吕宋东岸外海的波利略，1225年的中国地志《诸蕃志》记载它臣属于三岛，并通过三岛归属民都洛的麻逸，当地民风强悍，以开采岛边锋利礁丛中的稀有红珊瑚与蓝琅玕为主要贸易。

en: Plauen was the lordship of the Vogts of Plauen, a family of imperial ministers named after their castle above the White Elster in the Vogtland, and an offshoot of the Vogts of Weida. Around 1100 the counts of Everstein had opened the surrounding Dobna Gau to German settlement, and in 1236 the lords first appear in documents as Vogts of Plauen; in 1278 Count Conrad of Everstein made over the town and the gau to his brother-in-law, Vogt Henry I. Henry's two sons split the house: the elder, Henry the Bohemian, kept Plauen, while Henry the Russian founded the younger line that became the House of Reuss of Greiz and Gera, and in 1306 the two lines formally divided the inheritance. In 1337 the Plauen line was headed by Henry III the Tall. Pressured by the margraves of Meissen and the kings of Bohemia, the house placed itself under Bohemian suzerainty in 1327. In the Vogtland War of 1354 to 1357 the vogts lost most of their lands to Emperor Charles IV and the Wettin margraves, and a partition of 1348 had already split the family into the houses of Mühltroff and Plauen. The elder Plauen line died out in 1572, when its estates fell to the Reuss, while the Vogtland itself kept the name of its one-time advocate-lords.
zh: 普劳恩是普劳恩福格特（即地方护法官）家族的领地，该家族出身帝国陪臣，是魏达福格特家族的支系，因在福格特兰白埃尔斯特河畔的城堡而得名。约1100年，埃弗施泰因伯爵在周围的多布瑙高推进德意志拓殖，1236年该家族首次以普劳恩福格特的名号见于文献；1278年，埃弗施泰因伯爵康拉德把城镇和整个高区移交给他的姻亲、福格特亨利一世。亨利一世的两个儿子分家：长子“波希米亚人”亨利二世保有普劳恩，次子“罗斯人”亨利开创了后来统治格赖茨和格拉的罗伊斯家族的先系，1306年两支正式分割遗产。1337年，普劳恩支系的家长是“高个子”亨利三世。在迈森藩侯和波希米亚国王的夹击下，该家族于1327年接受波希米亚的宗主权。1354年至1357年的福格特兰战争中，福格特们把大部分领地输给了皇帝查理四世和韦廷家族的藩侯，而1348年的分家已把家族拆成米尔特罗夫和普劳恩两支。长支于1572年绝嗣，产业落入罗伊斯家族之手；福格特兰这个地名则一直保留着昔日护法官领主的印记。

en: Palitana was a Gohil Rajput chiefdom beneath the Shatrunjaya hills in southern Saurashtra, in what is now Gujarat, its ruling line tracing back to Shahji, a son of the Gohil ancestor Sejakji who settled in the region around 1194. Above the town rose the sacred Shatrunjaya hill, where the first Jain tirthankara Adinatha was said to have meditated and where generations of Jain patrons carved more than nine hundred marble temples from the eleventh century onward, making the chiefdom guardian of one of Jainism's holiest pilgrimages. In 1337 a Gohil thakur of this branch still held the small fort and its surrounding villages. In 1656 the Mughal prince Murad Baksh, governing Gujarat for Shah Jahan, granted the town to the Jain banker Shantidas Jhaveri, and in 1730 the care of the temples passed to the Anandji Kalyanji Trust. As a Kathiawar principality Palitana paid tribute jointly to the Gaekwar of Baroda and the Nawab of Junagadh, and under British paramountcy its Gohil Thakur Sahib held a nine-gun salute.
zh: 巴利塔纳是戈希尔拉杰普特人的酋邦，坐落在今古吉拉特萨乌拉施特拉南部的沙特伦贾亚群山之下，统治家族自称是1194年前后迁入此地的戈希尔先祖塞贾吉之子沙吉的后裔。城镇背后矗立着神圣的沙特伦贾亚山，相传耆那教第一位祖师阿底那特曾在山上禅修；从11世纪起，历代耆那教施主在山上雕造了九百多座大理石神庙，使这个小邦成为耆那教最神圣的朝圣地之一。1337年时，该支系的一位戈希尔塔库尔仍据守着这座小堡和周围村庄。1656年，沙贾汗之子、出镇古吉拉特的穆拉德·巴克什把巴利塔纳封给耆那教银行家尚蒂达斯·贾韦里；1730年，神庙的管理权移交阿南德吉·卡尔扬吉信托会。作为卡提阿瓦的小邦，巴利塔纳同时向巴罗达的盖克瓦尔和朱纳格特的纳瓦布纳贡，在英国宗主权下，其戈希尔塔库尔享有九响礼炮的待遇。

en: Pembroke was one of the most powerful marcher lordships on the Welsh frontier. Arnulf of Montgomery raised the first castle there in 1093 during the Norman invasion of Wales, and his castellan Gerald de Windsor held it against a major Welsh siege. In 1138 King Stephen granted the lordship to Gilbert de Clare, whose son Richard, known as Strongbow, used Pembroke as the base for the Norman invasion of Ireland. In 1189 Richard I gave it to William Marshal together with the hand of Isabel de Clare; Marshal rebuilt the castle in stone and took the title Earl of Pembroke. From 1247 the de Valence family held it for seventy years, and Pembroke served as a military base during Edward I's conquest of Wales. The lordship passed to the Hastings family and reverted to the Crown in 1389, was granted to Jasper Tudor in 1452, and in 1457 saw the birth of the future Henry VII within its walls. Its southern hundreds were settled by Flemish and English colonists and became known as Little England beyond Wales, separated from the Welsh-speaking north by the old Landsker boundary.
zh: 彭布罗克是威尔士边境最有权势的边区领之一。1093年诺曼人入侵威尔士期间，蒙哥马利的阿努尔夫在此修建首座城堡，城主杰拉德·德·温莎据城抵御了威尔士人的大规模围攻。1138年，斯蒂芬王将这块领地授予吉尔伯特·德·克莱尔，其子人称“强弓”的理查以彭布罗克为基地远征爱尔兰。1189年，理查一世把它连同伊莎贝尔·德·克莱尔一起赐给威廉·马歇尔；马歇尔以石材重建城堡，并受封彭布罗克伯爵。1247年起瓦朗斯家族统治此地七十年，彭布罗克在爱德华一世征服威尔士时充当军事基地。领地后来转入黑斯廷斯家族，1389年收归王室，1452年封给贾斯珀·都铎，1457年未来的亨利七世出生在这座城堡中。其南部诸百户区由佛兰德斯和英格兰移民定居，被称为“威尔士之外的小英格兰”，与说威尔士语的北部以古老的兰斯克线相隔。

en: Pomesania takes its name from the Pomesanians, the westernmost clan of the pagan Old Prussians, who lived between the Vistula and the Elbląg rivers. During the Prussian Crusade the Teutonic Knights crossed the Vistula in 1231, founded Marienwerder, modern Kwidzyn, in 1233 and subdued the clan within a few years. In 1243 the papal legate William of Modena created the Bishopric of Pomesania as one of four dioceses set up in conquered Prussia. Its cathedral chapter sat in the fortified cathedral of Marienwerder, while the bishop's own residence was at Riesenburg. From the 1280s the canons were required to join the Teutonic Order, so the bishop's temporal lands never became a prince-bishopric and were administered as part of Teutonic Prussia. In 1454 the bishop and canons joined the Prussian Confederation in submitting to King Casimir IV of Poland, an arrangement confirmed by the Second Peace of Thorn in 1466. The Reformation brought Lutheran bishops from 1523, and in 1587 the diocese was secularized into Ducal Prussia.
zh: 波美萨尼亚得名于波美萨尼亚人——信奉异教的古普鲁士诸部族中位置最西的一支，居住在维斯瓦河与埃尔布隆格河之间。普鲁士十字军期间，条顿骑士团于1231年渡过维斯瓦河，1233年建立马林韦德（今克维曾），数年内便征服了该部族。1243年，教皇特使摩德纳的威廉设立波美萨尼亚主教区，作为在被征服普鲁士建立的四个教区之一；主教座堂参议会驻于马林韦德的设防大教堂，主教本人的宅邸则在里森堡。从13世纪80年代起，参事会成员被要求加入条顿骑士团，因此主教的世俗领地始终没有发展为采邑主教区，而是作为条顿普鲁士的一部分加以管理。1454年，主教与参议会加入普鲁士邦联，向波兰国王卡齐米日四世臣服，1466年的第二次托伦和约确认了这一安排。宗教改革后，1523年起主教改宗路德宗，1587年教区被世俗化，并入普鲁士公国。

en: Punia was the chieftaincy of the Punia or Poonia, a Jat clan settled in Jangladesh, the rough and dry country of northern Rajasthan, whose stronghold was Sidhmukh in what is now Churu district. From the tenth century onwards the Jat clans of this region, among them the Poonia, Godara, Saran, Asiagh, Beniwal and Sihag, held their lands under their own chiefs and customary law, while Bhati Rajputs dominated the country farther to the north and west. These small clan states kept their independence for centuries, but in the second half of the fifteenth century Rao Bika, a younger son of the Rathore ruler of Jodhpur, led his followers into Jangladesh, defeated the Jat clans and founded Bikaner State in 1465; the Punia chieftains then accepted Rathore suzerainty and their territory became part of the new kingdom around Bikaner.
zh: 普尼亚是同名氏族的酋长领地。该氏族属于贾特人，定居在拉贾斯坦北部干旱崎岖的禅伽罗德什，据点是今丘鲁县境内的悉陀目佉。从10世纪起，这一地区的贾特诸氏族——普尼亚、戈达拉、萨兰、阿西亚格、贝尼瓦尔和西哈格——在各自酋长和习惯法治理下保有土地，而北面和西面则由巴蒂拉杰普特人称雄。这些氏族小邦独立存续了数百年；15世纪下半叶，焦特布尔拉托尔统治者的幼子拉奥·比卡率众进入禅伽罗德什，击败贾特诸氏族，于1465年建立比卡内尔土邦，普尼亚酋长遂接受拉托尔宗主权，其领地并入这个以比卡内尔为中心的新王国。

en: Poonch is a small river valley west of the Kashmir plain, shut between the Pir Panjal range and the Jhelum. Kalhana's Rajatarangini calls it Paranotsa, and the Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang recorded it in the seventh century as Pun-nu-tso. Around 850 it emerged as a sovereign state under Raja Nar, and its raja Trilochanpal withstood Mahmud of Ghazni in 1020: the invader could not take the fort of Lohara and so failed to enter Kashmir. From 1475 the Kashmiri general Malik Tazi Bhat campaigned through the hills and made Poonch a tributary state of the Kashmir Sultanate, its local rulers keeping limited autonomy in return for tribute and troops. The Mughal conquest of Kashmir in 1586 transferred that overlordship to Delhi, and in 1819 Maharaja Ranjit Singh seized Poonch and granted it as a jagir to his Dogra minister Raja Dhyan Singh.
zh: 蓬奇是克什米尔平原以西的小河谷，夹在皮尔潘贾尔山脉与杰赫勒姆河之间。卡尔哈纳的《王河》称其为帕兰诺察，7世纪的中国求法僧玄奘也曾在行记中记录此地。约850年，它在罗阇纳尔治下成为独立政权；1020年，罗阇特里洛钦帕尔抵御伽色尼的马哈茂德，入侵者攻不下洛哈拉要塞，因而未能进入克什米尔。从1475年起，克什米尔将领马利克·塔齐·巴特转战山区，使蓬奇成为克什米尔苏丹国的附庸，当地统治者以贡赋和出兵换取有限自治。1586年莫卧儿征服克什米尔，宗主权随之转入德里手中；1819年，大君兰吉特·辛格夺取蓬奇，将它作为采邑封给多格拉出身的大臣迪扬·辛格。

en: Pannai, also written Panai or Pane, was a Buddhist kingdom that flourished from the eleventh to the fourteenth century in the valleys of the Panai and Barumun rivers on the east coast of North Sumatra, facing the Strait of Malacca. It was a small principality within the Srivijayan mandala and later a vassal of the Dharmasraya kingdom. The Tamil inscription of Tanjore records that Pannai was sacked around 1025 by Rajendra Chola I when the Chola navy raided Srivijaya's subject ports. Upstream at Padanglawas stand sixteen Vajrayana brick temples, including the well-preserved Bahal temple, which experts link to Pannai's rulers; a Sri Lankan-style bronze of Amitabha found at Pamutung shows their ties across the Indian Ocean. The Panai inscription suggests a Buddhist lesser king bearing the title haji, and Armenian trading accounts name Pane, together with Barus, as a source of high-quality camphor, while the hinterland also supplied forest produce, livestock and gold. After Singhasari's Pamalayu expedition drew Dharmasraya and its vassals into the Javanese orbit, a Majapahit naval campaign of 1339 secured Pannai, and the Nagarakretagama of 1365 still lists Pane among its Sumatran vassals, after which the kingdom disappears from the records.
zh: 潘奈又译巴奈，是11至14世纪兴盛于北苏门答腊东海岸巴奈河与巴鲁蒙河流域、面向马六甲海峡的佛教王国。它是室利佛逝圈中的小邦，后来又臣属于达摩室利耶王国。坦贾武尔的泰米尔铭文记载，约1025年朱罗海军远征室利佛逝属港时，拉金德拉·朱罗一世曾洗劫潘奈。上游的巴东拉瓦斯保存着十六座金刚乘砖寺，其中包括保存较好的巴哈尔寺，学者认为它们与潘奈统治者有关；在帕蒙通发现的斯里兰卡风格阿弥陀佛铜像，则显示其与印度洋对岸的联系。潘奈铭文表明当地由一位拥有“哈吉”称号的佛教小王统治；亚美尼亚商人的行记把巴奈与西海岸的巴鲁斯并列为优质樟脑的产地，腹地还出产林产品、牲畜和黄金。信诃沙里的帕马拉尤远征把达摩室利耶及其属邦拉入爪哇势力范围后，满者伯夷1339年的海上远征取得潘奈，1365年的《爪哇史颂》仍把巴奈列为其苏门答腊属国，此后这个王国便从记载中消失。

en: Pinsk stands in the Polesian marshes at the meeting of the Pina and Pripyat rivers, the chief town of a small principality first mentioned by Nestor the Chronicler in 1097. In the high Middle Ages it passed between the rulers of Kiev, Turov and Volhynia, was sacked during the Mongol invasion of 1240, and in 1241 inherited the Orthodox diocese transferred from Turov. Lithuanian dukes then took the town, which became a fief of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania by about 1320 and was governed by Gediminid princes, including Narimantas, the son of Gediminas. Its local princely line died out in 1521, after which Pinsk became a royal town and was granted in 1523 to Queen Bona Sforza, under whom it prospered; a Tatar raid was beaten off nearby in 1527 by Hetman Konstanty Ostrogski. It became a county seat in 1569 and received Magdeburg rights from King Stephen Báthory in 1581, though Cossack wars later in the century brought repeated sack and massacre.
zh: 平斯克位于波利西亚沼泽地带、皮纳河与普里皮亚季河交汇处，是一个小公国的首府，1097年由编年史作者涅斯托尔首次记载。中世纪盛期，它在基辅、图罗夫和沃伦的统治者之间几度易手，1240年在蒙古入侵中被洗劫，1241年又接管了从图罗夫迁来的东正教教区。此后立陶宛王公夺取该城，约1320年它成为立陶宛大公国的封邑，由格季米纳斯家族的王公统治，其中包括格季米纳斯之子纳里曼塔斯。1521年当地王公世系绝嗣，平斯克成为王家城市，1523年被赐给王后博娜·斯福尔扎，在她治下趋于繁荣；1527年一支鞑靼人来犯，在城郊被盖特曼康斯坦丁·奥斯特罗格斯基击败。1569年它成为县治，1581年斯特凡·巴托里国王授予其马格德堡权利，但17世纪后期的哥萨克战争使它屡遭劫掠和屠杀。

en: The Principality of Polotsk was an East Slavic state centred on the city of Polotsk on the Western Dvina, in the lands of the Krivichs and first mentioned in the Primary Chronicle in 862. Its Varangian prince Rogvolod was overthrown by Vladimir the Great of Kiev around 980, after which the principality passed to the Rurikid line of Vladimir's son Iziaslav. Under Bryachislav and his son Vseslav, who ruled from 1044 to 1101, Polotsk acted as a largely autonomous rival to Kiev, but after Vseslav's death it split into the smaller principalities of Minsk, Vitebsk and Drutsk. Hard pressed by German crusaders in Livonia and by the rising Lithuanians, Polotsk received Lithuanian princes from the mid-thirteenth century and was absorbed into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania early in the fourteenth. In 1337 its prince was Narimantas, a son of Gediminas, and the town later became the seat of the Polotsk Voivodeship from 1504.
zh: 波洛茨克公国是以东斯拉夫城市波洛茨克为中心的国家，该城位于西德维纳河畔、克里维奇人的土地上，在862年的《往年纪事》中首次被提及。10世纪80年代前后，基辅的弗拉基米尔大帝推翻了瓦良格王公罗格沃洛德，公国此后归入弗拉基米尔之子伊贾斯拉夫一系的留里克家族。在布里亚奇斯拉夫及其子弗谢斯拉夫（1044—1101年在位）治下，波洛茨克高度自治，长期与基辅分庭抗礼；弗谢斯拉夫死后，公国分裂为明斯克、维捷布斯克和德鲁茨克等小公国。在利沃尼亚的德意志十字军和崛起的立陶宛双重压力下，波洛茨克自13世纪中叶起由立陶宛王公统治，并在14世纪初并入立陶宛大公国。1337年统治这里的是格季米纳斯之子纳里曼塔斯；1504年，波洛茨克成为波洛茨克省的首府。

en: The Kingdom of Poland, ruled from Kraków, was reunited by Władysław Łokietek, crowned king in 1320 after nearly two centuries of fragmentation among rival Piast duchies. In 1337 the throne belonged to his son Casimir III, the last Piast king, whose long reign brought legal codification, new stone castles, expanded privileges for Jewish settlers, the founding of the University of Kraków in 1364, and the eastward annexation of Red Ruthenia. Casimir died without a male heir in 1370, and the crown passed to the Angevin kings of Hungary and then, through the 1385 Union of Krewo, to the Lithuanian grand duke Jogaila, baptized as Władysław II, founder of the Jagiellonian dynasty. The Polish-Lithuanian union defeated the Teutonic Order at Grunwald in 1410 and gained Royal Prussia in the Second Peace of Thorn of 1466. The Union of Lublin in 1569 fused the two states into the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, an elective monarchy whose Warsaw Confederation of 1573 guaranteed wide religious toleration. Later wars, including the Swedish Deluge of the 1650s, weakened the Commonwealth, and three partitions in 1772, 1793 and 1795 divided its lands among Russia, Prussia and Austria. Napoleon sponsored the Duchy of Warsaw in 1807, and after 1815 the Congress of Vienna turned the Polish core into Congress Poland, a kingdom in personal union with the Russian Empire.
