zh: 波兰王国以克拉科夫为统治中心，在皮亚斯特诸公国分裂近两个世纪后，由瓦迪斯瓦夫·沃凯泰克重新统一，并于1320年加冕为王。1337年在位的是其子卡齐米日三世，皮亚斯特王朝末代国王；他在位期间编纂法典、修筑石制城堡、扩大犹太定居者的特权、于1364年创办克拉科夫大学，并向东兼并了红鲁塞尼亚。卡齐米日1370年去世时没有男性继承人，王位先传给匈牙利安茹家族，又通过1385年的克雷沃联合传给立陶宛大公雅盖沃——他受洗后取名瓦迪斯瓦夫二世，开创雅盖隆王朝。波兰-立陶宛联盟于1410年在格伦瓦德击败条顿骑士团，并在1466年的第二次托伦和约中获得王家普鲁士。1569年的卢布林联合将两国合并为波兰立陶宛联邦，实行选举君主制，1573年的华沙联盟保证了广泛的宗教宽容。此后包括17世纪50年代瑞典大洪水之战在内的连年战争削弱了联邦，1772、1793和1795年的三次瓜分将其领土分给俄罗斯、普鲁士和奥地利。1807年拿破仑扶植了华沙公国，1815年维也纳会议后，波兰核心地区变为与俄罗斯帝国共主邦联的波兰王国（议会波兰）。

en: Powo, also called Poyul, was a quasi-independent kingdom in the forested gorges of southeastern Tibet, centered on Kanam in present-day Bomê County. Its Kanam Gyalpo rulers claimed descent from Drigum Tsenpo, one of the earliest Yarlung kings, whose son fled to the region in remote antiquity, and the kingdom took formal shape in the thirteenth century. Ringed by mountains and feared for its warrior population, Powo stayed largely outside the control of Lhasa and guarded the roads to the hidden land of Pemako, protecting pilgrims from the hill tribes to the south; at its height it held eighteen districts across Bomê, Mêdog and Nyingchi. In 1717 a Dzungar army burned the royal palace at Kanam and the court withdrew to Sowaka, after which the Kashag imposed dzong governors and corvée in the lower valleys. When the king died without an heir in 1821 local chiefs divided the land, and after a revolt in 1835 Qing troops confirmed a new Kanam Depa the following year.
zh: 波窝一称波域，是西藏东南部森林峡谷中的半独立王国，统治中心在今波密县的噶朗村。其君主称噶朗第巴，自称是雅砻早期赞普止贡赞普的后裔，相传止贡赞普之子恰墀曾逃奔博窝，后人便留在此地统治；13世纪，波窝形成正式王国。凭借群山阻隔和强悍的民风，波窝长期游离于拉萨政权的控制之外，并守护着通往隐秘圣地白马岗的道路，护卫朝圣者免受南方山地部落的侵扰；极盛时它领有波密、墨脱、林芝一带的十八个宗。1717年准噶尔军队焚毁噶朗府邸，王廷迁至索瓦卡，此后噶厦在下波窝设宗，征收赋税、摊派乌拉差役。1821年土王尼玛结布病死无嗣，属下土官各据一方；1835年扎布起兵劫掠，清廷于次年发兵剿灭，并封旺秋饶丹为新的噶朗第巴。

en: Portugal grew from a county of the Kingdom of León, first held by Vímara Peres in the late ninth century and later by the Burgundian knight Henry. His son Afonso Henriques won the Battle of São Mamede in 1128, took the royal title in 1139 and was recognised by León in the Treaty of Zamora of 1143 and by the pope in 1179. The Algarve was conquered in 1249 and Lisbon became the capital in 1255. The Castilian succession claim of 1383 was defeated at the Battle of Aljubarrota, placing John of Aviz on the throne and opening the House of Aviz, which sealed the long English alliance in the Treaty of Windsor of 1386. The capture of Ceuta in 1415 began the overseas empire: under Prince Henry the Navigator and his successors, Dias rounded the Cape of Good Hope in 1488, da Gama reached India in 1498, Cabral claimed Brazil in 1500, and Goa, Malacca and Macau followed. King Sebastian's death at Alcácer Quibir in 1578 led to the Spanish union of 1580, which lasted until the Braganza restoration under John IV in 1640 and the Restoration War ending in 1668.
zh: 葡萄牙的前身是莱昂王国的一个伯国，9世纪末由维马拉·佩雷斯首任，后来传到勃艮第骑士亨利手中。其子阿方索·恩里克斯在1128年圣马梅德战役获胜，1139年称王，1143年《萨莫拉条约》获莱昂承认，1179年又获教皇认可。1249年阿尔加维被征服，1255年里斯本成为首都。1383年卡斯蒂利亚人对王位的要求在阿尔茹巴罗塔战役中被击败，阿维斯的若昂登上王位，开创阿维斯王朝，并于1386年以《温莎条约》确立了与英格兰的长期同盟。1415年攻占休达开启了海外帝国：在航海家恩里克王子及其后继者推动下，迪亚士于1488年绕过好望角，达伽马于1498年抵达印度，卡布拉尔于1500年宣布占有巴西，随后果阿、马六甲和澳门相继落入葡萄牙之手。1578年国王塞巴斯蒂安在阿尔卡塞尔·基比尔阵亡，导致1580年与西班牙合并，直到1640年布拉干萨家族的若昂四世复国，复国战争一直打到1668年。

en: Powis was the marcher lordship that grew out of southern Powys, or Powys Wenwynwyn, one of the last native Welsh principalities. Its seat at Welshpool was unusual among Welsh castles in having been founded by a Welsh prince, Gruffydd ap Gwenwynwyn, an ally of Edward I; the principality itself was abolished by the Parliament of Shrewsbury in 1283, and Gruffydd's son Owen became the first English-style Lord of Powis. When Owen's male line failed, his heiress Hawys the Hardy married the Shropshire knight John Charlton in 1309, who built up Powis Castle and was summoned as Lord Charlton in 1313. Charlton joined the baronial revolt against the Despensers in 1321 but was pardoned, and in June 1337 Edward III made him Chief Justiciar of Ireland. His descendants held the lordship until 1421, when it passed through an heiress to the Grey family; late in the sixteenth century the Herberts bought Powis Castle and were created Earls of Powis in 1674. The Laws in Wales Acts of 1535 to 1542 folded the old lordship into the new county of Montgomeryshire.
zh: 波伊斯是由南波伊斯（又称波伊斯温温温）演化而来的边境领主领，后者是最后存续的本土威尔士小邦之一。它在威尔士浦的治所颇为特殊：这座城堡并非诺曼男爵所建，而是爱德华一世的盟友、威尔士亲王格鲁菲德·阿普·格温温温所筑；1283年什鲁斯伯里议会废除了该亲王国，格鲁菲德之子欧文成为第一代英格兰式的波伊斯勋爵。欧文男嗣断绝后，女继承人“刚毅者”哈维斯于1309年嫁给什罗普郡骑士约翰·查尔顿，查尔顿扩建波伊斯城堡，并于1313年被召集为查尔顿勋爵。他在1321年参加了反对勒德斯潘塞家族的贵族叛乱，但获赦免；1337年6月，爱德华三世任命他为爱尔兰首席司法官。其后裔一直领有该领主领到1421年，后经女继承人转入格雷家族；16世纪末赫伯特家族买下波伊斯城堡，并于1674年受封波伊斯伯爵。1535至1542年的《威尔士法案》把旧领主领并入新设的蒙哥马利郡。

en: Papantla was a Totonac town in the northern Veracruz lowlands, in the heart of the region called Totonacapan. It was founded around the year 1200 by Totonac groups, some displaced southward by Chichimec raiders and others drifting in from the fallen Classic city of El Tajín, and in the pre-Hispanic period it belonged to the league of Totonacapan towns then headed by Tuzapan. Its Nahuatl name means the place of the papanes, a kind of crow, and the surrounding forests were already famed for vanilla, which grows wild there, as well as for cacao, cotton and cedar. The armies of Moctezuma II conquered Papantla and attached it to the Aztec tributary province of Tochpan, to which it owed cloth, chili and maize. After the Spanish conquest it was refounded as Papantla de Santa María de la Asunción and became the administrative seat of the whole Totonacapan region, while vanilla gathered in its woods became one of New Spain's most prized exports to Europe.
zh: 帕潘特兰是韦拉克鲁斯北部低地的托托纳克城镇，地处托托纳卡潘地区的核心。它约于1200年由托托纳克各部建立：其中一些人是受奇奇梅克人袭扰而南迁至此，另一些则来自已经衰亡的古典期名城埃尔塔欣；在前西班牙时代，它属于当时以图萨潘为首的托托纳卡潘城镇联盟。其纳瓦特尔语名字意为“帕潘鸟（一种乌鸦）之地”，周围森林自古盛产天然香草，还出产可可、棉花和雪松。莫克特苏马二世的军队征服帕潘特兰后，将其并入阿兹特克帝国的托奇潘纳贡省，令其缴纳布匹、辣椒和玉米。西班牙征服后，此地以帕潘特拉·德·圣玛丽亚·德·拉·亚松森之名重建，成为西班牙人管辖整个托托纳卡潘地区的治所，当地出产的香草也成为新西班牙输往欧洲的珍贵货物之一。

en: Prato is a Tuscan town a few miles north of Florence, on the river Bisenzio. It grew from the tenth-century villages of Borgo al Cornio and Castrum Prati, united under the Alberti family, who held the imperial title of Counts of Prato and harnessed the river to drive fulling mills for the wool trade. After the troops of Matilde of Canossa besieged the town in 1107, the Alberti withdrew and Prato developed as a free commune, reaching some fifteen thousand inhabitants within two centuries on the strength of its textile industry and the pilgrimage cult of the Holy Belt relic, with new walls raised in the mid-twelfth and early fourteenth centuries. In 1313, to check the expansion of Florence, the commune placed itself under Robert of Anjou, King of Naples, whose lordship still held in 1337. On 23 February 1351 Queen Joanna I of Naples sold Prato to Florence for 17,500 gold florins, ending its separate political life. Under Florentine rule the merchant Francesco Datini built his palace there from 1383, and the Spanish sack of the town in 1512 helped force the Florentine Republic to restore the Medici.
zh: 普拉托是托斯卡纳的城镇，位于佛罗伦萨以北数英里的比森齐奥河畔。它由10世纪的博尔戈阿尔科尔尼奥和普拉托堡两个村落合并而成，统于阿尔贝蒂家族之下；该家族保有皇帝册封的普拉托伯爵头衔，并利用河水驱动缩绒机发展羊毛业。1107年卡诺莎的玛蒂尔达的军队围城后，阿尔贝蒂家族撤走，普拉托发展为自由公社，凭借纺织业和圣腰带圣物的朝圣崇拜，在两百年内人口达到约一万五千，并于12世纪中叶和14世纪初两度修筑新城墙。1313年，为抵御佛罗伦萨的扩张，公社主动归附那不勒斯国王安茹的罗伯特，1337年时仍在其统治之下。1351年2月23日，那不勒斯女王乔万娜一世以17500金弗罗林的价格把普拉托卖给佛罗伦萨，其独立政治生涯就此结束。并入佛罗伦萨后，商人弗朗切斯科·达蒂尼于1383年起在此修建宅邸；1512年西班牙军队洗劫该城，促使佛罗伦萨共和国恢复美第奇家族的统治。

en: The County of Perche was a wooded frontier land between Normandy and Maine, centred on the Huisne valley, where Bellême served as its historical capital alongside Mortagne-au-Perche and Nogent-le-Rotrou. Its lords were at first styled lords of Mortagne, and the rival houses of Talvas of Bellême and Rotrou of Nogent-le-Rotrou disputed the region until Rotrou III annexed Bellême in 1114 and took the title count of Perche in 1126. The Rotrou counts won fame on crusade, Rotrou IV dying at the siege of Acre in 1191 and Geoffrey III in 1202 before the Fourth Crusade could sail; the last of the line, William II, bishop of Châlons, died in 1226, and Perche reverted to the crown, which carved the county of Alençon out of its lands. In 1286 it was granted to Charles of Valois, and from 1325 his son Charles II held Perche and Alençon together, ruling them in 1337 before falling at Crécy in 1346. English partisans plundered the county and burned its castles and abbeys during the Hundred Years' War, until reconstruction began after 1449. The last Valois duke of Alençon died childless in 1525, after which Perche returned to the royal domain.
zh: 佩尔什伯国是诺曼底与曼恩之间一片森林密布的边地，以于讷河谷为中心，贝莱姆是它的历史首府，与莫尔塔涅欧佩尔什、诺让勒罗特鲁并称三大要镇。其领主最初称莫尔塔涅领主，贝莱姆的塔尔瓦家族与诺让勒罗特鲁的罗特鲁家族长期争夺此地，直到罗特鲁三世于1114年吞并贝莱姆，并在1126年采用佩尔什伯爵的称号。罗特鲁家族的伯爵在十字军中声名远播：罗特鲁四世1191年死于阿卡围城战，若弗鲁瓦三世1202年在第四次十字军出发前去世；末代领主沙隆主教纪尧姆二世于1226年死去，佩尔什重归王室，国王从其土地上划出了阿朗松伯国。1286年，佩尔什被封给瓦卢瓦的查理，1325年起其子查理二世兼领佩尔什与阿朗松，1337年时正由他统治，后于1346年战死克雷西。百年战争期间，英格兰盟军洗劫伯国，焚毁众多城堡和修道院，1449年后才开始重建。末代瓦卢瓦系阿朗松公爵于1525年无嗣而终，佩尔什此后收归王室领地。

en: The Principality of Pronsk was an appanage of the Principality of Ryazan, centered on the fortified town of Pronsk, which existed from the twelfth to the fifteenth century. It passed repeatedly between rival branches of the Ryazan line of the Rurik dynasty, and its princes often pursued their own diplomacy: in 1427 Prince Ivan Vladimirovich of Pronsk entered Lithuanian service. After long friction with Ryazan, the appanage was reabsorbed in 1483 during the regency of Anna of Ryazan, acting with the agreement of her brother Ivan III of Moscow. Early in the sixteenth century the surviving Pronsk princes transferred into Muscovite service, and their lands were absorbed into the centralized Russian state.
zh: 普龙斯克公国是梁赞公国的封邑，以要塞城镇普龙斯克为中心，存在于12至15世纪。它在留里克王朝梁赞支系的不同分支之间几经易手，其王公也常自行开展外交：1427年普龙斯克王公伊凡·弗拉基米罗维奇转入立陶宛服役。在与梁赞长期摩擦之后，1483年梁赞的安娜摄政期间，经其兄莫斯科的伊凡三世同意，该封邑被梁赞重新吞并。16世纪初，尚存的普龙斯克王公转入莫斯科服役，他们的领地也被并入集权的俄罗斯国家。

en: Perm, known in the chronicles as Great Perm, was the land of the Komi peoples along the upper Kama River, stretching from the Pechora to the western slopes of the Urals, with its chief market town at Cherdyn. The Novgorod chronicle first names the Kama Permians in 1324, and Novgorod long claimed their tribute of furs, though its hold was loose; Arab geographers and the Norse sagas of Bjarmaland had earlier heard of this wealthy forest land. In 1337 it was still ruled by local Komi princes who kept to their ancestral beliefs while juggling Novgorodian, Tatar and Muscovite pressure. Christianity first reached the related Vychegda Komi through Stephen of Perm, who created an alphabet for their language and became bishop at Ust-Vym in the 1380s, but Great Perm itself stayed pagan for another century, and Bishop Pitirim was killed by raiding Mansi in 1455. Moscow appointed its own prince at Cherdyn in 1451, took over Novgorod's claims in 1471 and fully absorbed the principality in 1505.
zh: 彼尔姆在史书中称大彼尔姆，是科米诸族在卡马河上游的土地，北起伯朝拉河，东抵乌拉尔山西坡，中心集镇是切尔登。诺夫哥罗德编年史于1324年首次提到卡马河流域的彼尔姆人，诺夫哥罗德长期向他们索取毛皮贡赋，但控制松散；更早的阿拉伯地理学者和讲述比亚尔马兰的北欧萨迦都曾听闻这片富庶的森林之地。1337年它仍由本地的科米王公统治，居民坚守祖传信仰，在诺夫哥罗德、鞑靼和莫斯科之间周旋。基督教最先传入亲缘相近的维切格达科米人：彼尔姆的斯捷潘为他们的语言创制文字，于14世纪80年代成为乌斯季维姆的主教，但大彼尔姆本地又过了一个世纪仍未皈依，1455年主教皮季里姆还在曼西人的袭掠中被杀。1451年莫斯科向切尔登派出自己的王公，1471年接管诺夫哥罗德的权利，1505年正式吞并这个公国。

en: The County of Provence is the Mediterranean fief between the Rhône, the Alps and the sea, with its court at Aix and its wealth in the port of Marseille. A land of Roman Provincia and then of the Burgundian kings, it became an imperial fief in 1032; Count William the Liberator drove out the Saracens of Fraxinetum at the Battle of Tourtour in 973. In 1112 the heiress Douce I married Ramon Berenguer III of Barcelona, opening a century and more of Catalan rule, when Marseille and Arles traded with Pisa and Genoa under their own consuls. In 1246 the last Catalan countess, Beatrice, married Charles of Anjou, brother of the French king, so that in 1337 Provence was held by Robert the Wise, Angevin king of Naples. His descendant Joanna I adopted the French prince Louis of Anjou in 1380, and her death two years later sparked the civil war of the Union of Aix, during which Nice and the eastern valleys submitted to Savoy in 1388. The second Angevin line ended with the art-loving Good King René, who died in 1480; his nephew Charles bequeathed the county to Louis XI of France in 1481, and the union with the French crown was declared definitive in 1486. Provence kept its own estates and privileges until the Revolution of 1790 divided it into departments.
zh: 普罗旺斯伯国是罗讷河、阿尔卑斯山与地中海之间的封建领地，朝廷驻于艾克斯，财富则集中在港口马赛。这里曾是罗马的行省之地，后来归勃艮第诸王，1032年成为帝国封地；973年“解放者”威廉伯爵在图尔图尔战役赶走了弗拉克西内图姆的撒拉森人。1112年女继承人杜丝一世嫁给巴塞罗那伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔三世，开启了一个多世纪的加泰罗尼亚统治，其间马赛和阿尔勒在各自执政官治下与比萨、热那亚通商。1246年末代加泰罗尼亚女伯爵贝阿特丽切嫁给法王胞弟安茹的查理，因此1337年领有普罗旺斯的是安茹家族的那不勒斯贤王罗伯特。他的后裔乔万娜一世于1380年收法国亲王路易·德·安茹为养子，两年后她去世，引发艾克斯联盟内战，尼斯和东部山谷趁乱于1388年归附萨伏依。第二个安茹支系终结于热爱艺术的贤王勒内，他于1480年去世；其侄查理在1481年把伯国遗赠给法王路易十一，1486年与法兰西王冠的合并被宣布为永久性质。普罗旺斯保留了自己的等级会议和特权，直到1790年大革命把它划分为若干省。

en: Mandore, the ancient Mandavyapura a few miles north of modern Jodhpur, was the seat of a Pratihara dynasty from the sixth century. The Pratiharas of Mandavyapura, who claimed descent from Lakshmana, brother of the epic hero Rama, ruled the surrounding Marwar country first from Mandore and later from Merta before their kingdom was absorbed into the imperial Pratihara empire of Kannauj in the ninth century. When that empire broke apart under Ghaznavid pressure, a surviving Pratihara branch retained Mandore as a small Rajput chiefdom through the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, hard pressed by the Delhi Sultanate. To win an ally against the Tughluqs, its raja married his daughter to the Rathore chief Rao Chunda and in 1395 gave the fortress of Mandore itself as her dowry, so that the Pratihara line was absorbed into the rising Rathore state. Mandore served as the Rathore capital until Rana Kumbha of Mewar seized it in 1438, and Rao Jodha did not recover it until 1453. Six years later he built the hill fort of Mehrangarh nearby and founded Jodhpur, leaving Mandore to become the royal cremation ground of the kings of Marwar.
zh: 曼多尔古称曼达维亚普拉，在今焦特布尔以北数英里，6世纪起便是波罗提诃罗王朝的治所。曼达维亚普拉的波罗提诃罗人自称是史诗英雄罗摩之弟罗奇曼纳的后裔，最初以曼多尔、后来以梅尔塔为都统治周围的马尔瓦尔地区，9世纪其王国并入卡瑙杰的波罗提诃罗帝国。帝国在伽色尼人的压力下瓦解后，波罗提诃罗的一支作为拉杰普特小首领政权据守曼多尔，熬过13至14世纪，始终承受着德里苏丹国的重压。为结交盟友对抗图格鲁克王朝，当地罗阇把女儿嫁给拉托尔首领拉奥·琼达，1395年更以曼多尔堡本身作为嫁妆，波罗提诃罗世系就此并入新兴的拉托尔政权。曼多尔随后成为拉托尔人的都城，1438年被梅瓦尔的拉纳·昆巴夺取，拉奥·乔达直到1453年才将其收复。六年后，他在附近修建梅兰加尔堡、兴建焦特布尔，曼多尔则成为马尔瓦尔历代君主的王家火葬地。

en: Pasai, also called Samudera Pasai, was a Muslim sultanate on the north coast of Sumatra, with its port near modern Lhokseumawe. It was founded in 1267 by Merah Silu, who converted to Islam and took the name Malik ul Salih; his Arabic-inscribed tomb, dated 1297, is among the earliest evidence of Islam in the Indonesian archipelago. Together with neighbouring Peureulak it was one of the first Muslim trading kingdoms of the region, and it grew rich after the collapse of Srivijaya drew Indian Ocean merchants to the Bay of Sumatra, its hinterland supplying gold, forest produce and, from the early fifteenth century, pepper. Marco Polo stopped there on his way home, and in 1345 Ibn Battuta stayed fifteen days as the sultan's guest, finding a pious Shafi'i ruler at what was then the easternmost land of Islam. By the end of the fourteenth century Pasai was a wealthy commercial centre, though Majapahit had sacked it mid-century and Malacca soon overtook it in trade. The Portuguese seized the port in 1521 and evacuated in 1524, whereupon Ali Mughayat Syah of Aceh annexed it to his new sultanate.
zh: 八昔又称苏木都剌·八昔，是苏门答腊北岸的穆斯林苏丹国，港口在今洛克司马威附近。它建于1267年，建立者梅拉·西鲁改宗伊斯兰教后改名马利克·萨利赫；其刻有阿拉伯文的墓碑纪年为1297年，是伊斯兰教传入印度尼西亚群岛最早的物证之一。它与邻近的勃拉克并称当地最早的两个穆斯林贸易王国，室利佛逝崩溃后，印度洋商人转向苏门答腊湾，八昔凭腹地出产的黄金、林产品以及15世纪初开始种植的胡椒致富。马可·波罗归国途中曾在此停留；1345年伊本·白图泰作为苏丹的客人住了十五天，见到一位虔诚的沙斐仪派统治者，这里当时是伊斯兰世界最东端的土地。到14世纪末八昔已是富庶的商业中心，但世纪中叶曾遭满者伯夷洗劫，贸易地位随后又被马六甲超过。1521年葡萄牙人攻占该港，1524年撤军，亚齐的阿里·穆哈亚特·沙随即将它并入新建的亚齐苏丹国。

en: Pskov, formally styled Lord Pskov, was a merchant city-state on the Velikaya River near the Livonian frontier, governing itself through a popular assembly, the veche. Long a self-ruling borough of Novgorod with its own dependent towns such as Izborsk, it won fame defending Rus' against the Livonian Order, above all under Prince Daumantas, whose victory at Rakvere in 1268 opened a long period of autonomy. In 1327 the city gave sanctuary to the exiled Prince Alexander Mikhailovich of Tver and made him its prince; he still ruled in 1337, when he left for the Golden Horde to seek his old throne. The Treaty of Bolotovo in 1348 ended Novgorod's rights over Pskov and confirmed its independence, and its Pskov Judicial Charter became one of the foundations of later Russian law. Hard pressed by the Teutonic and Livonian knights, the republic accepted Moscow's suzerainty from 1399 and was finally annexed by Vasily III in 1510.
zh: 普斯科夫正式称呼为“普斯科夫老爷”，是韦利卡亚河畔、邻近立窝尼亚边境的商业城邦，通过市民大会“韦切”实行自治。它长期是诺夫哥罗德治下享有自治权的城镇，还拥有伊兹博尔斯克等自己的附属城镇；在抵御立窝尼亚骑士团的战争中声望日隆，尤其是在道曼塔斯王公治下——1268年他在拉克韦雷取胜，开启了长期自治的局面。1327年普斯科夫收留流亡的特维尔王公亚历山大·米哈伊洛维奇并奉他为本城王公，1337年他仍在任，随后前往金帐汗国谋求恢复旧位。1348年的《博洛托沃条约》终结了诺夫哥罗德对普斯科夫的权利，确认了它的独立；《普斯科夫审判宪章》后来成为俄国法律的基石之一。在条顿与立窝尼亚骑士的压力下，共和国自1399年起接受莫斯科的宗主权，最终于1510年被瓦西里三世吞并。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Passau was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire seated at the meeting of the Danube, Inn and Ilz rivers, on the site of the Roman colony of Batavis. Saint Boniface erected the diocese in 739 with Bishop Vivilo as its first incumbent. In 999 Bishop Christian received from Emperor Otto III the rights of market, coinage, taxation and jurisdiction, after which the bishops ruled as princes of the Empire, though the title appears in writing only in 1193. The townspeople's rising of 1298 won them the Bernhardine Charter of 1299, yet Passau never became a free city and remained under its bishop. In 1320 Pope John XXII appointed Albert of Saxony, of the Askanier house, to the see, and he was still ruling in 1337. During the Reformation Bishop Ernest of Bavaria kept the Bavarian part Catholic while Lutheranism spread in the Austrian lands, and under Bishop Wolfgang von Salm the Peace of Passau was concluded there in 1552. A great fire of 1662 destroyed the old cathedral, and the present baroque one rose over the following decades. In 1803 the prince-bishopric was secularized and the city of Passau fell to Bavaria.
zh: 帕绍采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国的教会邦国，治所位于多瑙河、因河与伊尔茨河汇流处、罗马殖民地巴塔维斯的旧址上。教区由圣波尼法爵于739年建立，首任主教是维维洛。999年，主教克里斯蒂安从皇帝奥托三世手中取得市场、铸币、征税和司法权，此后主教便以帝国亲王身份统治，尽管这一头衔到1193年才见诸文书。1298年市民起义，换来1299年的《贝恩哈德特许状》，但帕绍始终没有成为自由市，仍受主教管辖。1320年，教宗约翰二十二世任命阿斯坎尼家族萨克森-维滕贝格的阿尔贝特为主教，1337年仍由他在任。宗教改革时期，主教巴伐利亚的恩斯特使巴伐利亚部分保持天主教，路德宗却在奥地利领地传播；1552年，主教沃尔夫冈·冯·萨尔姆任内在此缔结《帕绍条约》。1662年一场大火烧毁旧主教座堂，今天的巴洛克式教堂在随后几十年间建成。1803年采邑主教区被世俗化，帕绍城划归巴伐利亚。

en: Pistoia, the Roman Pistoria on the Via Cassia, was the place where the conspirator Catiline was killed in 62 BC; from the fifth century it was a bishopric, and under the Lombards it was a privileged royal city. Its great age began in 1177, when it proclaimed itself a free commune and ringed itself with walls and new churches. A Ghibelline town, it was conquered by Guelph Florence in 1254 and then torn by the feuds of Black and White Guelphs, so violent that Dante placed the Pistoian Vanni Fucci among the thieves of his Inferno. Early in the fourteenth century the former abbot Ormanno Tedici made himself lord of the city, but his nephew Filippo sold Pistoia to Castruccio Castracani of Lucca. Florentine rule returned and was made permanent in 1530, when the town was formally annexed by Florence. The local Rospigliosi family later gave the Church Pope Clement IX, and the diocesan synod held here in 1786 became a landmark of Catholic reform.
zh: 皮斯托亚即古罗马的皮斯托里亚，地处卡西亚大道旁，叛乱者喀提林于公元前62年在此附近被杀；5世纪起它成为主教座所在地，伦巴第时代又是享有特权的王城。它的鼎盛时代始于1177年，当时它宣布成为自由市镇，筑起城墙并新建多座教堂。作为吉伯林派城市，它在1254年被归尔夫派的佛罗伦萨征服，此后又被归尔夫派黑党与白党的仇杀撕裂，争斗之烈使但丁在《地狱篇》里把皮斯托亚人万尼·符契置于窃贼之中。14世纪初，还俗修道院长奥尔马诺·泰迪奇自立为城市之主，但他的侄子菲利波把皮斯托亚卖给了卢卡的卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼。佛罗伦萨的统治随后恢复，并于1530年正式吞并该城。当地的罗斯皮利奥西家族后来出了教皇克雷芒九世；1786年在此召开的教区会议也成为天主教改革的标志性事件。

en: Simmern, a small lordship in the Hunsrück on the old army road from Bingen to Trier, was first recorded in 1072 and passed from the counts of the Nahegau to the raugraves, who held it as a fief of the Archbishopric of Trier from between 1323 and 1330; in 1337 it was therefore a Trier vassal town. Emperor Louis the Bavarian granted it town rights in 1330, with Archbishop Baldwin's support, and the citizens fortified themselves behind a double wall. Before the fourteenth century ended Simmern had passed to the Wittelsbach counts palatine, and the partition of 1410 made it the residence of the Palatinate-Simmern line. Duke John II, ruling from 1509 to 1557, kept a humanist court, set up the town's first printshop and introduced the Reformation; his son Frederick III the Pious turned to Calvinism in 1563, and in 1559 the line inherited the Electoral Palatinate at Heidelberg. The Simmern inheritance later fed the Palatinate succession dispute, and French troops sacked and burned the town on 17 September 1689 during the Nine Years' War, leaving only the church of Saint Stephen and a few towers standing. Rebuilt as a modest Palatine administrative seat, Simmern was annexed by revolutionary France in the 1790s and assigned to Prussia at the Congress of Vienna in 1815.
zh: 锡门是洪斯吕克山区的一块小领地，地处宾根到特里尔的古道上，1072年首见记载，先属纳厄高伯爵，后转入劳伯爵家族之手；1323至1330年间，劳伯爵从特里尔大主教区受封锡门，因此1337年它是特里尔的附庸城镇。1330年，在大主教巴尔杜因支持下，皇帝巴伐利亚人路德维希授予它城市权，市民随后筑起双重城墙自卫。14世纪结束前，锡门转入维特尔斯巴赫家族的行宫伯爵之手，1410年的分封使它成为普法尔茨—锡门支系的驻地。1509至1557年在位的约翰二世公爵崇尚人文之学，开设镇上第一家印刷所并推行宗教改革；其子“虔信者”弗里德里希三世于1563年改宗加尔文派，1559年该支系又继承了海德堡的普法尔茨选侯之位。锡门的遗产后来引发普法尔茨继承争端，1689年9月17日法军在九年战争中洗劫并焚毁全城，只有圣斯蒂芬教堂和几座塔楼幸存。重建后的锡门只是一个普通的普法尔茨行政驻地，18世纪90年代被革命法国吞并，1815年维也纳会议把它划归普鲁士。

en: Phetchaburi, whose Sanskrit name means city of diamonds, sits at the northern neck of the Malay Peninsula between the Gulf of Thailand and the Tenasserim hills. In the Dvaravati period it was a seaport on the India–China trade route, until the town was abandoned around the eleventh century. It was refounded in the twelfth century as Phrip Phri by a prince of the Padumasuriyavamsa line who came south from the Sukhothai and Nakhon Thai region, and an inscription of about 1204 shows its ruler sending trade missions to China. The town then became a vassal of the rising kingdom of Sukhothai, and it lay on the overland route by which monks travelled between Sukhothai and Sri Lanka to bring back Theravada scriptures. In 1351 Phetchaburi was incorporated into the new kingdom of Ayutthaya, which kept it as a fortified frontier town on the road to the southern peninsula.
zh: 碧武里，其梵语名字意为钻石之城，坐落在马来半岛北段、泰国湾与丹那沙林山地之间。陀罗钵地时期，它是印度—中国商路上的一处海港，约在11世纪随陀罗钵地文明衰落而被废弃。12世纪，一位来自素可泰与那空泰地区、属帕杜玛苏里雅旺萨世系的王子南下重建该城，称披里披里；约1204年的一块碑铭显示，当地统治者曾向中国派遣贸易使团。此后该城沦为兴起中的素可泰王国的附庸，又地处素可泰与锡兰之间的陆上通道，僧侣沿这条路线往返，请回上座部佛教经典。1351年，碧武里被并入新生的阿瑜陀耶王国，后者把它经营为通往南部半岛要道上的设防边镇。

en: Pate was a Swahili sultanate on the largest island of the Lamu Archipelago, off the northern coast of what is now Kenya. The Pate Chronicle holds that the town was first settled by refugees from Oman and was re-founded in 1203 by the Nabhani family, Omani Arabs whose dynasty still ruled there in 1337 and claimed kinship with the Nabhani kings of Oman. Archaeological finds show the port already tied into Indian Ocean trade networks by the tenth century, and it rose to prominence in the fourteenth century, vying with nearby Lamu and Takwa for mastery of the archipelago. In 1587 a Portuguese expedition from Goa destroyed the neighboring island town of Faza for backing the privateer Mir Ali Bey. The eighteenth century was Pate's golden age: its merchants built plaster-decorated stone houses, its weavers and goldsmiths were famed along the coast, and the royal Yunga palace produced the Utendi wa Tambuka, one of the earliest surviving Swahili poems. Constant wars with its neighbors then wore the sultanate down, and its bid to subjugate Lamu ended in catastrophe at the Battle of Shela in 1813, when the army of Pate and its Mombasan Mazrui allies was almost annihilated.
zh: 帕泰是斯瓦希里人的苏丹国，位于今肯尼亚北部近海拉穆群岛的最大岛屿上。《帕泰编年史》称该城最早由阿曼难民定居，1203年由来自阿曼的阿拉伯纳巴哈尼家族重建；该家族的王朝到1337年仍在此统治，并自称与阿曼的纳巴哈尼诸王同源。考古发现表明，这座港口在10世纪已接入印度洋贸易网络，14世纪声名鹊起，与邻近的拉穆和塔克瓦争夺群岛的主导权。1587年，一支从果阿出发的葡萄牙远征军因附近岛城法扎支持海盗米尔·阿里贝伊而将其摧毁。18世纪是帕泰的黄金时代：商人建起灰泥装饰的石宅，织工和金匠闻名整个海岸，王室的永加宫殿还诞生了现存最早的斯瓦希里语诗歌之一《乌滕迪·瓦·坦布卡》。此后与邻邦连绵不断的战争耗尽了苏丹国的国力，它征服拉穆的企图在1813年的谢拉之战中惨败，帕泰与蒙巴萨马兹鲁伊盟友的军队几乎全军覆没。

en: The County of Pitigliano was a small lordship perched on a tufa cliff in southern Tuscany, on the edge of the Sienese Maremma. The site was settled in Etruscan times and is first mentioned in 1061; in the early thirteenth century it belonged to the Aldobrandeschi and became the capital of their county before passing to the Orsini in 1293. The Orsini were one of the great baronial families of Rome, leaders of the Guelph faction and kinsmen of Pope Nicholas III, and their Pitigliano line had been founded by Gentile Orsini in the mid-thirteenth century. In 1337 the county was held by Count Guido Orsini. Orsini rule brought a century and a half of intermittent wars with the neighbouring Republic of Siena, until a settlement of 1455 recognised Pitigliano as a county under Sienese sovereignty. The little state later followed Siena into the Grand Duchy of Tuscany, and in 1604 Count Giovanni Antonio Orsini ceded the fief to Grand Duke Ferdinando I de' Medici.
zh: 皮蒂利亚诺伯国是托斯卡纳南部、锡耶纳马雷马边缘一座凝灰岩悬崖上的小领地。此地在伊特鲁里亚时代已有居民，最早见于1061年的文献；13世纪初它属阿尔多布兰代斯基家族，并成为其伯国的都城，1293年转入奥尔西尼家族之手。奥尔西尼是罗马的大男爵家族之一，为圭尔夫派首领，与教宗尼古拉三世同族，其皮蒂利亚诺支系由真蒂莱·奥尔西尼于13世纪中叶开创。1337年统治伯国的是圭多·奥尔西尼伯爵。奥尔西尼家族的统治带来了与邻邦锡耶纳共和国长达一个半世纪、时断时续的战争，直到1455年双方达成协议，承认皮蒂利亚诺为伯国，但置于锡耶纳宗主权之下。这个小邦后来随锡耶纳并入托斯卡纳大公国，1604年乔瓦尼·安东尼奥·奥尔西尼伯爵把采邑让给了美第奇家族的大公费迪南多一世。

en: Puctlan was a small Nahua polity of the Papaloapan lowlands in central Veracruz, holding the nearby settlement of Nopiloa, whose ancient ceremonial centre belonged to the Classic Veracruz culture. By the fifteenth century the district had been conquered by the Aztecs, and its towns were paying tribute to the Mexica at the Spanish arrival.
zh: 普克特兰是韦拉克鲁斯中部帕帕洛阿潘低地的一个纳瓦小邦，领有附近的诺皮洛阿聚落，那里古老的祭祀中心属于古韦拉克鲁斯文化。到15世纪，这一地区已被阿兹特克征服，西班牙人到来时，当地各镇都在向墨西加纳贡。

en: Patna, with its early seat at Patnagarh, was the principal Chauhan Rajput kingdom of western Orissa, in the country watered by the Mahanadi and the Tel. In the early fourteenth century the tract lay under the loose suzerainty of the Eastern Ganga kings, whose administrator ruled through eight local Gauntia chiefs. Court chronicles such as the seventeenth-century Kosalananda Kavya trace the Chauhans to refugees of the Chauhan line of Garh Sambhar near Mainpuri, who fled south after their chief fell fighting Firuz Shah Tughlaq. In 1360 Ramai Deva, then twenty years old, overthrew the eight Gauntias with the backing of the common people and made himself raja, marrying a niece of the Ganga king Bhanu Deva III and building the Patneswari temple at Patnagarh. His descendants ruled for centuries, sending out cadet branches that founded the kingdoms of Sambalpur and Sonepur and the Khariar zamindari; in the eighteenth century the Patna rajas became tributaries of the Marathas of Nagpur before passing under British protection.
zh: 巴特那早期以帕特纳加尔为治所，是西奥里萨最主要的乔赫拉杰普特王国，地处默哈讷迪河与泰勒河之间。14世纪初，这一地区处在东恒伽诸王松散的宗主权下，由恒伽派驻的官员通过八名地方高恩提亚首领治理。17世纪的梵文宫廷史诗《侨萨罗喜歌》等文献把乔汉家族的来历追溯到迈恩布尔附近桑巴尔加尔的乔汉王族：其首领在与菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克作战阵亡后，余部南逃。1360年，年方二十的拉马伊·提婆在平民支持下推翻八名高恩提亚自立为王，又娶恒伽王巴努·提婆三世的侄女，并在帕特纳加尔修建帕特内斯瓦里神庙。他的后裔统治数百年，还分出支系建立了萨姆巴尔普尔、索内普尔等王国和哈里亚尔柴明达尔领地；18世纪，巴特那诸王成为那格浦尔马拉塔人的纳贡者，后来又转入英国保护之下。

en: Pantepec, whose Nahuatl name combines the words for banner and hill, was a small highland polity in the Sierra Norte of Puebla, its main town known as Kachikin in the local Totonac tongue. The hill country was first settled by Otomí villagers and then by Totonacs from El Tajín, with Tepehua communities alongside them. In 1120 the Toltec ruler Huemac made Xicotepec, its sister settlement, a señorío; Chichimec tribes held it for forty years until Metlaltoyuca retook it in 1162, and around 1325 the Acolhua leader Tlachotla conquered the district and attached it to his lordship. From 1432 the territory paid tribute, in bird feathers, to Texcoco, where Nezahualcóyotl installed Quetzalpatzin as its lord. Spaniards occupied it in 1533, and Augustinian friars founded the mission town of San José de Xicotepec two years later.
zh: 潘特佩克的纳瓦特尔语名字由“旗帜”和“山”两个词组成，是普埃布拉北部山区的一个高地小邦，其主要城镇在当地托托纳克语中叫作卡奇金。这片山地先有奥托米村民定居，后来又有从埃尔塔欣迁来的托托纳克人，特佩瓦人聚落也杂处其间。1120年，托尔特克首领韦马克把姊妹聚落希科特佩克变为领地；奇奇梅克诸部占据该地四十余年，直到1162年被梅特拉尔托尤卡夺回；约1325年，阿科卢阿首领特拉乔特拉征服该地区，将其并入自己的领地。1432年起，此地以鸟羽向特斯科科纳贡，内萨瓦尔科约特尔任命克察尔帕辛为其领主。1533年西班牙人占领该地，两年后奥古斯丁会修士建立了传教城镇圣何塞·德·希科特佩克。

en: Pingtouzheke was a Miao zhangguansi in the Wuluo hills of northeastern Guizhou, within the Yuan-era Sizhou chiefdom. In 1413 the Ming placed it under the new Wuluo Prefecture with three neighbouring offices; when that prefecture was abolished in 1438, it was transferred to Tongren Prefecture, its lands lying around present-day Wuluo in Songtao County.
zh: 平头著可是贵州东北部乌罗山区的苗族长官司，元代属思州土司地界。1413年明朝设置乌罗府，平头著可与乌罗、答意、治古共四个长官司归其管辖；1438年乌罗府废，平头著可改隶铜仁府，辖地当今松桃县乌罗镇一带。

en: Pua, also called Mueang Pua or the Nan state, was the Tai polity of the upper Nan River valley in present-day Nan province of northern Thailand. The Nan Chronicle traces it to the ruler Phukha, whose younger son Khun Fong founded Mueang Pua, also named Woranakhon, to rule the local Kao people while the elder son was sent to govern Luang Prabang. In 1263 the kingdom of Phayao, finding Pua ruled only by the queen mother Khamphin, stormed the city and ruled it for half a century; Khamphin's exiled son Phanong returned and was crowned Phaya Phanong in 1313, restoring independence. In 1338 his army joined Khamfu of Chiang Saen in sacking Phayao, though the allies quarrelled over the plunder, and Pua absorbed the eastern Phayao towns along the upper Yom. In 1368 the rulers shifted their capital south to the newly founded city of Nan. Closely linked to Sukhothai, which more than once restored its kings, Pua survived the fall of its old ally but was conquered by Tilokkaraj of Lan Na in 1449 after an artillery bombardment, becoming a Lan Na vassal and being fully annexed in 1461. Its salt wells at Bo Mang made the province one of Lan Na's most prized possessions.
zh: 磨又称勐磨或难国，是泰人在上难河流域建立的政权，位于今泰国北部难府一带。据《难编年史》记载，其始祖为普卡：幼子坤丰建勐磨（又名沃拉纳孔）统治当地的卡奥人，长子则被派去治理琅勃拉邦。1263年，帕尧王国趁磨由老王后坎芬主政之机攻陷此城，统治达半个世纪；坎芬流亡时生下的儿子帕农后来重返故土，于1313年加冕为帕亚帕农，恢复独立。1338年，他与清盛的坎富合兵洗劫帕尧，事后双方因分赃反目，磨吞并了帕尧在永河上游的东部城镇。1368年，统治者把都城南迁到新建的难城。磨与素可泰关系密切，素可泰曾多次出兵助其复位；老盟友灭亡后，磨仍艰难维持，最终在1449年遭兰纳的滴洛拉以火炮攻城而灭国，沦为兰纳附庸，1461年被彻底兼并。磨境内博芒的盐井也使这里成为兰纳最看重的领地之一。

en: Purang was a Himalayan kingdom centered on the walled town of Purang in western Tibet, in the valleys south of Mount Kailash. After the Tibetan Empire collapsed in the ninth century, the royal scion Kyide Nyimagon fled to Ngari and founded a kingdom around 925 that his sons divided into Maryul, Guge and Purang; Purang became a kingdom separate from Guge in 1072 and kept close ties with the Yatse polity in the hills to the south. In 1252 and 1253 the rising kingdom of Mangyul Gungthang, backed by the Sakyapa order, defeated Purang and Yatse, after which Purang accepted Mongol-Yuan overlordship. Towards the end of the fourteenth century the Purang-Yatse polity collapsed amid repeated changes of ruler and was absorbed by Guge. When Ladakh conquered Guge in 1630 Purang passed under Ladakhi rule, until a Ganden Podrang army retook Ngari in the 1680s and brought Purang under the administration of central Tibet.
zh: 布让是西藏西部、冈仁波齐峰以南山谷中的喜马拉雅小王国，以布让城为中心。9世纪吐蕃帝国崩溃后，王室后裔吉德尼玛衮逃往阿里，约在925年建立政权；他死后诸子把王国分为麻域、古格和布让三部，布让于1072年成为独立于古格的王国，并与南方山地亚泽政权关系密切。1252—1253年，在萨迦派支持下兴起的芒隅贡塘王国击败布让与亚泽，布让随后接受蒙古元朝的宗主权。14世纪末，布让—亚泽政权在反复易手中瓦解，被古格吞并。1630年拉达克征服古格，布让转归拉达克统治；17世纪80年代，甘丹颇章的军队收复阿里，布让纳入西藏地方政府的管辖。

en: Píngyuè was a Miao chieftaincy in the hills of central Guizhou, seated at the town of present-day Fuquan. In 1283 the Yuan court organized it as the Pingyue military and civilian chief's office, one of the native posts created after pacifying the Nine Streams and Eighteen Caves. The Ming reached it in 1381 and replaced native rule with guard posts: a defense battalion in 1381, the Pingyue Guard in 1383, and a military-civilian guard command in 1385. After the suppression of the Bozhou rebellion in 1600, the Pingyue military and civilian prefecture was set up in 1601 on former Bozhou lands, ruling two guards, one department and two chief's offices under the Guizhou provincial administration. In 1798 the Qing court abolished the prefecture and replaced it with the independent department of Pingyue.
zh: 平越是贵州中部山区的苗人土司，治所在今福泉市一带的城寨。1283年，元朝将其编为平越军民长官司，是平定九溪十八洞后设立的众多土职之一。1381年明军进入此地，朝廷逐步以卫所取代土官：当年设守御千户所，1383年置平越卫，1385年升为军民指挥使司。1600年播州杨应龙之乱平定后，1601年于卫城置平越军民府，隶贵州布政司，以播州宣慰司旧地益之，领二卫、一州、二长官司。1798年，清朝裁撤平越府，改置平越直隶州。

en: The Q'anjob'al are a Maya people of the Sierra de los Cuchumatanes in Huehuetenango, western Guatemala, whose highland towns include Jolom Konob, the present-day Santa Eulalia, Tz'uluma' or San Pedro Soloma, and Yich K'ox or Juan Ixcoy. Their own traditions relate a migration from the lowlands of Chiapas into the mountains, where sacred sites and archaeological remains show a long pre-Columbian settlement; they speak the Q'anjob'al language and lived in autonomous mountain communities with their own agricultural and ritual calendars. After Gonzalo de Alvarado took the Mam capital of Zaculeu in 1525, Spanish expeditions pushed into the Cuchumatanes, but the rugged highlands made submission gradual and many families withdrew into remoter valleys rather than accept colonial towns, tribute and missionary rule. Q'anjob'al speech and custom nevertheless survived the upheaval of the conquest centuries.
zh: 坎霍瓦尔人是玛雅人的一支，聚居于危地马拉西部韦韦特南戈省的库丘马塔内斯山脉，霍洛姆科诺布（今圣埃乌拉利亚）、察乌鲁马（圣佩德罗索洛马）和伊奇科什（胡安伊斯科伊）都是他们的山城。据本族口传，他们从恰帕斯低地迁入这片高地；境内的圣地与考古遗迹证明，早在欧洲人到来之前很久他们便定居于此。他们讲坎霍瓦尔语，以自治村社为单位生活，保有自己的农事与祭祀历法。1525年贡萨洛·德·阿尔瓦拉多攻占曼姆人的都城萨库莱乌后，西班牙远征军深入库丘马坦山区，但险峻地形令征服进程缓慢，许多家族退入更深的山谷，拒绝接受殖民集镇、贡赋和传教统治。历经征服年代的动荡，坎霍瓦尔的语言与习俗仍在群山中延续。

en: The Qasar horde was the ulus of Jochi Qasar, full brother of Genghis Khan, nicknamed Deft Qasar for his mastery of the bow. As a boy he and Temujin killed their half-brother Behter, and after the defeat at Khalakhaljid Sands in 1203 he gathered his followers in the forests and helped lure the Keraites to their destruction. Genghis allotted him pastures west of the Greater Khingan between the Ergune and Hailar rivers beneath Mount Külün, a smaller ulus than Temüge's, and later the house also received estates in Shandong and Jiangxi. Qasar's descendants kept their eastern identity: after the Yuan collapse they made up the Fuyu Guard of the Ming Three Guards of 1389 along the Nen and Onon, and in time became the Khorchin Mongols. Their Adai Khan challenged the Four Oirats until he was killed in 1438, and the tribe later fought beside Dayan Khan at Dalan Terqin in 1510. In 1624 the Khorchin became the first Mongol tribe to submit to Nurhaci and the rising Qing, whose emperors took Khorchin Borjigin brides, among them Empress Xiaozhuangwen.
zh: 合撒儿汗国是拙赤·合撒儿的兀鲁思。合撒儿是成吉思汗的同母弟，因善射被称为神箭合撒儿。少年时他与铁木真合力杀死异母弟别克帖儿；1203年合兰真沙陀之战败后，他率部众藏入森林，又协助诱歼克烈部。成吉思汗将大兴安岭以西、额尔古纳河与海拉尔河之间、库伦山一带的牧场封给他，其兀鲁思小于铁木哥的封地，后来该家族又在山东和江西得到食邑。合撒儿的后裔保持着东部蒙古的身份：元朝灭亡后，他们组成1389年明朝兀良哈三卫中的福余卫，游牧于嫩江与斡难河流域，后来发展为科尔沁部。其阿台汗曾与卫拉特四部抗衡，1438年被杀；该部后来又在1510年的达兰·特勤之战中追随达延汗。1624年，科尔沁成为第一个向努尔哈赤和崛起中的清朝归附的蒙古部落，清朝皇帝多娶科尔沁孛儿只斤氏女子为后妃，孝庄文皇后便是其中之一。

en: Qocho, also called Kara-Khoja or Gaochang, was the Uyghur kingdom of the Turpan oasis, founded in 843 by Uyghurs fleeing the Kirghiz destruction of their steppe khaganate. In 866 Pugu Jun took the title idiqut and ruled from a winter capital at Qocho and a summer capital at Beshbalik; the kingdom became a settled Buddhist state whose Bezeklik cave temples preserved its paintings and scriptures, and it paid homage in turn to the Liao dynasty and the Qara Khitai. In 1209 the idiqut Baurchuk Art Tekin killed the Qara Khitai overseer and submitted to Genghis Khan, after which Uyghur scribes and administrators became the bureaucratic backbone of the Mongol Empire. Qocho remained a Mongol vassal, aligned with the Yuan against the Chagatai khans, until Chagatai power reached the oases in the fourteenth century and the idiqut's court migrated east into Yuan territory. The last Buddhist Uyghurs of Qocho and Turpan were forcibly converted by the Chagatai khan Khizr Khoja, who campaigned there between 1389 and 1399.
zh: 高昌又称哈拉和卓，是吐鲁番绿洲上的回鹘王国，843年由躲避黠戛斯进攻、从崩溃的草原回鹘汗国逃来的部众建立。866年仆固俊称亦都护，冬都高昌、夏都别失八里；王国转为定居的佛教国家，柏孜克里克千佛洞保存了它的绘画与经卷，并先后向辽朝和西辽称臣。1209年，亦都护巴而术·阿而忒·的斤袭杀西辽监国，归降成吉思汗，回鹘书吏和行政人才此后成为蒙古帝国的官僚支柱。高昌作为蒙古附庸，长期联合元朝对抗察合台诸汗；14世纪察合台势力抵达绿洲后，亦都护朝廷东迁元朝境内。1389—1399年，察合台汗黑的儿火者进军此地，高昌与吐鲁番最后的佛教徒回鹘人被强迫改宗伊斯兰教。

en: Qiongshui was a small Kam tusi chiefdom in eastern Guizhou under the Tian clan of Sizhou. A Qiongshui county had been set up under the Song in 1107, and the Ming reorganized it as the Qiongshui zhangguansi; its seat lies in present-day Sansui County in Qiandongnan.
zh: 邛水是贵州东部的小型侗族土司，隶属思州田氏。其地宋代于1107年设置邛水县，明代改置邛水长官司，治所当今黔东南苗族侗族自治州三穗县一带。

en: Qahtan is the name borne by one of the great southern Arab tribal confederations, made up of three main tribes, the Sanhan, the Junb and the Rufaida, and spread across the highlands of Asir and the Yemeni borderlands, the Tihama coast and parts of the Najd, where its branches include both settled villagers and camel-nomads. Arab genealogists make the Qahtan the eponymous southern Arabs, the Qahtanites or Banu Qahtan, whom tradition counts as the original Arabs of Yemen and Hadhramaut, and the name itself has been read on ancient South Arabian inscriptions. The confederation traces its roots to the age of the Kingdom of Kinda and came to prominence under the Umayyad caliphs of 661 to 750, when the great blood feud between the southern Qahtanite or Yaman tribes and the northern Adnanite Qays broke out, a rivalry that flared in Arabian politics for centuries afterward. In later times a section of the Sanhan, the Jahadir, migrated into the Najd and for a while ranked among its powerful tribes before withdrawing again to the southern homelands around Tathlith.
zh: 盖哈坦是南方阿拉伯最庞大的部落联盟之一，由桑汉、朱恩布和鲁费达三大部落组成，分布在阿西尔高原、也门边境地带、帖哈麦沿海以及内志部分地区，其支系中既有定居村民，也有放牧骆驼的游牧民。阿拉伯谱系学家把盖哈坦视为南方阿拉伯人的代表，即盖哈坦人或巴尼·盖哈坦，传统上认为他们是也门和哈德拉毛的原住民阿拉伯人，“盖哈坦”一名还见于古代南阿拉伯铭文。该联盟的根源可追溯到肯德王国时代，在661年至750年的倭马亚哈里发时期崭露头角：当时南方盖哈坦（也门）诸部与北方阿德南人的盖斯诸部爆发大规模血仇，即盖斯—也门之争，在此后数百年的阿拉伯政治中反复点燃。后来桑汉人的一支贾哈德尔人迁入内志，一度跻身当地强部之列，最终又退回泰斯利特一带的南方故土。

en: Quiahuiztlan was a fortified Totonac city on the Gulf coast of central Veracruz, raised on the heights of the Cerro de los Metates near the later site of Villa Rica. Its Nahuatl name means the place where rain abounds. After the lowland Totonac cities, among them El Tajín, were abandoned in the Epiclassic period, their people withdrew to easily defended hilltops, and Quiahuiztlan was laid out with terraces, retaining walls and a ballcourt, serving at once as a town of as many as fifteen thousand people, a fortress and a walled cemetery. It was twice subjugated by invaders from the central highlands: first by the Toltecs around the year 800, and again by the Aztecs in the early fifteenth century, who imposed the cults of Tlaloc and Huitzilopochtli. In 1519 Hernán Cortés founded Villa Rica de la Vera Cruz on the shore below the city, and at Quiahuiztlan the Spanish sealed their alliance with some thirty Totonac towns, the pact that opened the way to the conquest of the Aztec Empire. The city was abandoned during the conquest and never resettled.
zh: 基亚维斯特兰是韦拉克鲁斯中部墨西哥湾沿岸的托托纳克人设防城市，建在梅塔特山（又称贝纳尔山）的高地上，邻近后来的比利亚里卡。其纳瓦特尔语名字意为“雨水丰沛之地”。史诗古典期，埃尔塔欣等低地托托纳克城市被废弃后，居民退守易守难攻的山顶；基亚维斯特兰以台地、护墙和球场布局，兼具城镇、要塞和有墙墓地三重功能，西班牙人到来时约有一万五千居民。它两度被来自中部高原的入侵者征服：第一次是约800年的托尔特克人，第二次是15世纪初的阿兹特克人，后者还强制推行特拉洛克与维齐洛波奇特利崇拜。1519年，埃尔南·科尔特斯在山下海滨建立比利亚里卡·德·拉·韦拉克鲁斯，并在基亚维斯特兰与约三十个托托纳克城镇缔结盟约，正是这一联盟为征服阿兹特克帝国打开了道路。该城在征服期间遭到废弃，此后再未恢复人烟。

en: Quiegoqui was a small Mixtec polity centred on Coatlan, in the forested Sierra Sur of Oaxaca on Tututepec's northern frontier. Coatlan was counted among the many towns reduced to tribute by Eight Deer Jaguar Claw, and in the fifteenth century it held out against Tututepec with Aztec military support.
zh: 基耶戈基是以夸特兰为中心的纽萨维小邦，地处瓦哈卡南部林木茂密的山区，位于图图特佩克的北部边境。夸特兰曾被列入鹿八日虎爪征服的纳贡城镇，15世纪时又靠着阿兹特克的军事支持抵御图图特佩克。

en: Qujing is a region in eastern Yunnan centred on the walled town of Nanning on the upper Nanpan River, where the roads from Sichuan and Guizhou enter the province; earlier writers called it the Key Between Yunnan and Guizhou. The Han first placed a county here in 109 BC, and after Zhuge Liang's southern campaign of 225 it became the seat of the Laixiang commandant and the political centre of the whole Nanzhong region. For more than five centuries it was the heartland of the Cuan clan, until Nanzhao overthrew them in 748; under the Dali kingdom the area was organised as Shicheng Commandery, ruling over a dozen local tribes including the Moma. The Mongols made it Qujing Route, and the Ming and Qing kept Qujing Prefecture with Nanning County as its seat. Ming armies entered Yunnan through Qujing in 1381, after which hereditary tribal chieftains, or tusi, governed the surrounding peoples alongside the prefectural officials.
zh: 曲靖在云南东部，以南盘江上游的南宁城为中心，是四川、贵州入滇的门户，旧有‘滇黔锁钥’之称。早在公元前109年，汉朝便在此设置味县；225年诸葛亮南征后，这里成为庲降都督的治所，是整个南中的政治中心。此后五百多年间，曲靖是爨氏家族的腹地，直到748年南诏攻灭爨氏；大理国时在此设石城郡，统领磨弥等十余个部落。元朝改设曲靖路，明、清两代沿置曲靖府，以南宁县为府治。1381年明军经曲靖攻入云南，此后当地的世袭酋长即土司，与流官知府一同治理周边各族。

en: Quauhquechollan, whose Nahuatl name means the place of eagles and spoonbills, was a Nahua altepetl in the Atlixco valley south of the great volcanoes, on the site of the modern town of Huaquechula in Puebla. The first settlement was founded around 1110 by Xicalanca and Chichimec groups and refounded by Nahua settlers about 1200. Caught between the rival powers of the central Mexican highlands, it saw heavy fighting between Tlaxcalteca and Mexica forces in the early sixteenth century, and a son of the Aztec ruler Moctezuma II was killed there in battle. The town lay on the Spanish line of march against Tenochtitlan and was granted in encomienda to Jorge de Alvarado in 1524. Quauhquechollan warriors then joined Alvarado's campaign of 1527 to 1529 into Guatemala, and their painters recorded the expedition on the Lienzo de Quauhquechollan, one of the earliest surviving maps of Guatemala and a rare Nahua pictorial account of conquest beyond Mexico.
zh: 夸乌克奇奥兰在纳瓦特尔语中意为鹰与玫瑰琵鹭之地，是火山带以南阿特利斯科谷地的纳瓦人城邦，即今普埃布拉州瓦克丘拉镇的前身。最早的聚落约于1110年由希卡兰卡人和奇奇梅克人建立，约1200年纳瓦移民又在此重新建城。由于夹在墨西哥高原诸强之间，16世纪初这里曾是特拉斯卡拉人与墨西加人激战的战场，阿兹特克君主蒙特苏马二世的一个儿子便战死于此。该城位于西班牙人进攻特诺奇蒂特兰的行军路线上，1524年被封给豪尔赫·德·阿尔瓦拉多作为委托监护地。夸乌克奇奥兰战士随后参加了阿尔瓦拉多1527至1529年远征危地马拉的战事，当地画师把这段经历绘成《夸乌克奇奥兰布画》，它是现存最早的危地马拉地图之一，也是少见的从纳瓦人视角记述墨西哥以外征服活动的图画文献。

en: Quelimane is a Swahili trading town on the Mozambique coast, set on the Rio dos Bons Sinais near the mouths of the Zambezi. Muslim merchants linked to the Kilwa Sultanate made it one of the oldest settlements of the region, and oral tradition numbers it among the coast towns founded by Kilwa refugees late in the fifteenth century. Vasco da Gama reached its river in 1498 on his first voyage to India, and a permanent Portuguese presence began in 1544. Under Portuguese oversight the port developed into a market of the Indian Ocean slave trade, drawing captives and ivory from the Zambezi hinterland, and in the 1760s the settlement was formally chartered as a Portuguese town, its commerce long reserved to Portuguese merchants alone.
zh: 克利马内是莫桑比克沿海的斯瓦希里贸易城镇，坐落在赞比西河口附近的良兆河畔。与基尔瓦苏丹国有关的穆斯林商人把它建成当地最古老的聚落之一，口述传统还把它列为15世纪末基尔瓦流亡者建立的沿海城镇之一。达伽马1498年首航印度时抵达这里的河口，葡萄牙人的永久驻点则始于1544年。在葡萄牙人监管下，这个港口发展为印度洋奴隶贸易的市场，从赞比西内陆掠取人口和象牙；1760年代，该聚落被正式特许为葡萄牙城镇，贸易长期只向葡萄牙商人开放。

en:
Qom lies on a low plain south of Tehran on the Qom River, a district in Sasanian times that had been a stronghold of the Anahita cult. Arab forces first raided it in 644 under Abu Musa al-Ashaari, and Ashaari Arab families from Kufa then settled among the local Persian villagers. The decisive event in its history was the death in 816 or 817 of Fatima Masumeh, sister of the eighth Imam Ali al-Rida, whose tomb was built up into a shrine from 869 and drew sayyids and Shia scholars to the town; the first Friday mosque rose on the site of a fire temple in 878, and by the tenth century, under Daylamite and then Buyid rule from 951, Qom was a Twelver Shia city with only a Sunni minority.

The Khwarezmshahs held it until the Mongols of Jebe and Sübedei destroyed it in 1224, and although it revived modestly under the Ilkhans, the Ilkhanid vizier Juvayni once sought asylum in the shrine, Timur sacked and massacred its people in the late fourteenth century. Under the Safavids Qom became by 1503 a leading center of Shia theology and pilgrimage; it was damaged again in the Afghan and Nader Shah wars, passed to the Qajars in 1793, and had Fath Ali Shah rebuild the shrine of Fatima Masumeh.
zh:
库姆位于德黑兰以南的低平原上，临库姆河，萨珊时代是一个以阿娜希塔崇拜为中心的小行政区。644年阿布·穆萨·阿沙里率阿拉伯军队首次袭取此地，随后来自库法的阿沙里阿拉伯家族在当地波斯村落间定居。816至817年，第八代伊玛目阿里·里达的妹妹法蒂玛·马苏梅在此去世，成为库姆历史的转折：她的陵墓自869年起被扩建为圣陵，吸引圣裔和什叶派学者云集；878年第一座聚礼清真寺在一座祆教神庙旧址上建成，到10世纪代莱米人、继而951年起白益王朝统治时，库姆已是十二伊玛目派的城市，逊尼派只占少数。

花剌子模沙赫统治此地，直到1224年哲别和速不台的蒙古军将其摧毁；伊儿汗国时期库姆略有恢复，维齐尔志费尼还曾到圣陵避难，但14世纪末帖木儿又洗劫城市、屠杀居民。萨非王朝时期，库姆到1503年已成为什叶派神学和朝圣的首要中心；阿富汗入侵和纳迪尔沙的战火再度破坏它，1793年库姆归入卡扎尔王朝，法特赫-阿里沙重修了法蒂玛·马苏梅圣陵。

en: The Kingdom of Qata, also called Qita'a, was one of the six Beja kingdoms recorded by the Arab historian al-Yaqubi in the ninth century. It held a stretch of the Red Sea coast around the gulf of Zula, near the ruins of the old Aksumite port of Adulis, and was later absorbed into the Balaw kingdom.
zh: 咖塔王国又称基塔阿，是阿拉伯史学家雅库比在9世纪记载的六个贝贾王国之一，据有祖拉湾一带的红海海岸，邻近阿克苏姆古港阿杜利斯的遗址，后来被并入巴劳王国。

en: Cuauhtemallan is a Nahuatl name meaning the place of many trees, which the Mexica and the Tlaxcalan and Cholultec auxiliaries of the Spanish gave first to the Kaqchikel highland capital of Iximche and then to the whole central valley and Pacific slope. Nahua-speaking Pipil enclaves dotted this country, above all Itzcuintlan, the present-day Escuintla, which late Postclassic sources describe as a notable Pipil town, and their settlements were interspersed with villages of Poqomam Maya. These Nahua communities were descendants of the migrants who left central Mexico during the Nahua diaspora of the tenth to twelfth centuries and lived by cacao, cotton and indigo farming and long-distance trade. When Pedro de Alvarado marched up the Pacific coastal plain in 1524 with his Tlaxcalan allies, the Nahuatl names they used fixed themselves on the map; after the highland kingdoms were defeated in turn and the Kaqchikel rebellion was put down in 1530, Cuauhtemallan became the Spanish province and city of Guatemala, from which the later republic takes its name.
zh: 奎特马兰是纳瓦特尔语，意为“多树之地”，墨西加人以及随西班牙人出征的特拉斯卡拉和乔卢拉附庸最初用它称呼卡克奇克尔人的山城伊希姆切，后来才泛指整个中部谷地与太平洋坡地。这片土地上散布着讲纳瓦语的皮皮尔人聚落，其中最著名的是伊茨昆特兰，即今埃斯昆特拉，晚期后古典期的文献称它为皮皮尔重镇；这些纳瓦聚落与波科马姆玛雅人的村落交错分布。他们是10至12世纪纳瓦人大迁徙中离开墨西哥中部的移民后裔，靠种植可可、棉花和靛蓝以及长途贸易为生。1524年佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多率特拉斯卡拉盟友沿太平洋海岸平原北上，他们口中的纳瓦特尔地名就此固定在地图上；随着高地诸王国相继败降、卡克奇克尔人的起义于1530年被镇压，奎特马兰变成西班牙治下的危地马拉省与危地马拉城，后来的共和国也由此得名。

en: Gera lies in the White Elster valley in the Vogtland, the bailiffs' land whose name comes from the imperial vogts appointed to rule it. First documented in 995, the Gera province was granted by Emperor Otto III to Quedlinburg Abbey in 999, and from 1209 the abbess entrusted its protectorship to the Vogts of Weida, ministeriales whose family, the future House of Reuss, would govern the Vogtland for centuries. Gera itself is first called a town in 1237 and was fortified in the thirteenth century, while the nearby lordship of Schleiz grew up around a castle of the same bailiff dynasty. The Quedlinburg abbess remained formal sovereign until 1358, when overlordship passed to the Wettin margraves, and Gera was nearly destroyed in the Saxon Fratricidal War of 1450. The Wettins imposed the Reformation there in 1533 against the vogts' wishes, but after the Schmalkaldic War of 1546 the territory passed nominally to the Bohemian Crown, leaving the Reuss lords, as the vogts' line was now called, effectively in charge. In 1673 the Reussians were raised to imperial counts with full sovereignty, and Gera became their residence; cloth-makers fleeing the Spanish Netherlands had already made it a textile town, and in 1806 Napoleon made Gera his headquarters on the eve of the Battle of Jena.
zh: 格拉地处福格特兰的白埃尔斯特河谷，“福格特兰”意为福格特（帝国摄政官）之地，得名于受命治理当地的摄政官。格拉最早见于995年的文献，999年皇帝奥托三世把格拉这片地方封给奎德林堡修道院；1209年起，女修院院长把保护权委托给魏达的福格特家族——这个出身侍臣的家族就是后来的罗伊斯家族，将统治福格特兰数百年。格拉在1237年首次被称为城镇，13世纪修筑城墙，附近的施莱茨领地也围绕同一摄政官家族的城堡发展起来。奎德林堡女院长一直是名义宗主，直到1358年宗主权转给韦廷藩侯；1450年格拉在萨克森兄弟阋墙战争中几乎被毁。1533年，韦廷家族不顾福格特们的意愿在格拉推行宗教改革，但1546年施马尔卡尔登战争后，领地名义上转归波希米亚王冠，此后被称为罗伊斯的福格特家族实际掌握了统治权。1673年，罗伊斯家族被升格为拥有完全主权的帝国伯爵，格拉成为其驻地；此前逃避西班牙属尼德兰动乱的织工已使它成为纺织城镇，1806年拿破仑又在耶拿战役前夕把大本营设在格拉。

en: The Qulla, or Colla, kingdom was the largest of the Aymara chiefdoms that filled the Collao plateau after Tiwanaku collapsed around 1000. From its capital at Hatunqulla, near modern Puno on the north-western shore of Lake Titicaca, it claimed some twenty thousand square kilometres divided into two moieties, Urco and Umasuyu, and forty-one local groups; archaeology shows a landscape of hilltop forts, or pukaras, rather than a tightly centralized monarchy. Aymara, Puquina and Uru communities all lived under Colla rule, and the kingdom kept Tiwanaku rites, including the feline cult of Choquechinchay and the chullpa tombs of Sillustani. Around 1400 the Colla went to war with their Lupaca rivals, but the Inca Viracocha secretly backed the Lupaca king Cari and the Colla army was beaten at Paucarcolla. Mid-century the Colla king Chuchi Capac faced Pachacuti, who defeated him and received the submission of the Colla lords at Hatunqulla; three later revolts were crushed by Amaru Yupanqui and Tupac Yupanqui, who also expelled Puquina and Uru groups from the Island of the Sun. The Incas named their whole south-eastern quarter Qullasuyu after the Colla, and in 1538 a Colla and Spanish alliance defeated the Lupaca at the Desaguadero.
zh: 库尧（又译科利亚）王国是1000年前后蒂亚瓦纳科崩溃后，科利亚奥高原上最大的艾马拉酋长国。其都城哈通库利亚位于的的喀喀湖西北岸、今普诺附近，宣称领有约两万平方公里的土地，分为乌尔科和乌马苏尤两个半部、四十一个地方群体；考古发现表明，其境内遍布山头堡垒普卡拉，并非高度集权的君主国。艾马拉、普基纳和乌鲁三个族群都在库尧治下生活，王国保留着蒂亚瓦纳科的礼仪，包括对猫科神乔克钦查伊的崇拜和锡卢斯塔尼的丘尔帕墓塔。约1400年，库尧与世仇卢皮哈基交战，但印卡王维拉科查暗中支持卢皮哈基国王卡里，库尧军队在保卡科拉战败。15世纪中期，库尧国王楚奇·卡帕克迎战帕查库特克，兵败后各地领主在哈通库利亚臣服；其后三次起义先后被阿马鲁·尤潘基和图帕克·尤潘基镇压，图帕克还把普基纳和乌鲁群体逐出太阳岛。印卡人把整个东南行政区命名为科利亚苏尤，名字即来自库尧；1538年，库尧与西班牙结盟，在德萨瓜德罗河击败卢皮哈基人。

en: The Qara'unas, also called the Negüderi, were Mongol garrison troops who settled in Afghanistan after moving out of Turkestan and Mongolia. From the 1230s they were stationed near the Indian frontier as tamachi soldiers, and in 1262 a large influx of Jochid troops fleeing the Ilkhanate under the general Negudar gave the group its lasting identity. They wintered around Ghazna and summered in Ghur and Garchistan, and Marco Polo described them as a mixed people of Mongol, Turk and Indian blood. After the Chagatai Khanate fractured in the 1340s, Qara'una emirs such as Qazaghan and his son Abdullah became the real masters of the western khanate, ruling through puppet khans. The Suldus and Barlas revolted in 1359, and after the Moghul invasions the Qara'una leader Husayn, grandson of Qazaghan, shared power with Timur until Timur overthrew and killed him at Balkh in 1370. Timur fully subjugated the group in the 1380s, and Qara'una horsemen thereafter made up a large part of his armies; according to Babur, some still spoke Mongolian in the mountains around Ghazni in the late fifteenth century.
zh: 哈剌兀纳思人又称捏古迭儿人，是从突厥斯坦和蒙古迁出、定居在阿富汗的蒙古戍军。13世纪30年代起，他们作为探马赤军驻扎在印度边境一带；1262年，金帐汗国将领捏古答儿率大批部众逃入阿富汗、脱离伊利汗国，奠定了这个群体的雏形。他们在哥疾宁一带过冬，在古耳和噶尔吉斯坦度夏，马可·波罗称他们是混杂了蒙古、突厥和印度血统的人群。14世纪40年代察合台汗国分裂后，哈剌兀纳思异密加兹罕及其子阿卜杜拉成为汗国西部的实际主宰，通过傀儡发号施令。1359年速勒都思和巴鲁剌思贵族起兵反抗，加上蒙兀儿人入侵，加兹罕之孙忽辛与帖木儿共掌河中，最终于1370年在巴尔赫被帖木儿推翻杀死。帖木儿在14世纪80年代完全征服该部，哈剌兀纳思骑兵此后构成其军队的重要部分；据巴布尔记载，直到15世纪末，哥疾宁山区仍有部分人说蒙古语。

en: Qingyuan was the chief administrative centre of the Zhuang lands along the Longjiang in northern Guangxi, with its seat at Yishan, the present-day Yizhou district of Hechi. In 1265 the Southern Song elevated Yizhou to Qingyuan Prefecture because it had been the princely estate of the future Emperor Duzong. Under the Yuan it became first an appeasement commission and then Qingyuan Route, reorganised in 1297 as the Qingyuan-Nandan military-civilian appeasement commission, which supervised the native chieftaincies of the surrounding valleys. The Ming restored it as a prefecture, and under the Qing its jurisdiction reached the present-day Nandan, Donglan, Fengshan, Tian'e and Xincheng counties, governing a network of Zhuang tusi beneath the prefectural city.
zh: 庆远是广西北部龙江流域壮族地区的行政中心，治所在宜山县，即今河池市宜州区。南宋咸淳元年（1265年），因宜州曾是宋度宗登基前的潜邸，升置庆远府。元代先设安抚司，后改庆远路，大德元年（1297年）又改为庆远南丹溪洞等处军民安抚司，统辖周围溪洞的土著首领。明代复置为府，清代辖境扩大到今南丹、东兰、凤山、天峨、忻城等县地，府城之下管辖着一批壮族土司。

en: The Republic of Ragusa was an aristocratic maritime republic centered on the walled city of Dubrovnik on the Dalmatian coast, governed by a patrician council and an elected rector and protected by Saint Blaise. The city grew from a seventh-century refuge of survivors from Roman Epidaurum and passed centuries under Byzantine, Norman and Venetian rule before the Fourth Crusade delivered it to Venice in 1205. As a Venetian tributary it kept much of its own government, and in 1333 it bought the Pelješac peninsula and Ston from Stefan Dušan of Serbia, securing the salt pans that became one of its chief revenues. In 1337 the rector Philip Belegno headed the city under Venetian overlordship. The Treaty of Zadar of 1358 transferred its homage to the Hungarian crown, leaving Ragusa effectively independent; it then added Primorje in 1399 and Konavle by 1426. From 1458 it paid tribute to the Ottoman sultan while ruling itself, and its merchants won tax exemptions and Black Sea access, carrying Balkan silver, salt and grain across the Mediterranean at the commercial height of the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries. New ocean trade routes and the great earthquake of 1667 sapped its wealth. Napoleon's armies occupied the city in 1806 and abolished the republic in 1808, and the Congress of Vienna in 1815 assigned its territory to Habsburg Austria.
zh: 拉古萨共和国是达尔马提亚沿岸以城墙城市杜布罗夫尼克为中心的贵族海洋共和国，由贵族议会和民选议长治理，奉圣布莱斯为主保圣人。这座城市源自7世纪罗马城市埃皮达鲁姆幸存者的避难所，先后经历拜占庭、诺曼和威尼斯的统治，1205年第四次十字军后被划归威尼斯。作为威尼斯的纳贡城邦，它保留了大部分自治政府，1333年又从塞尔维亚的斯特凡·杜尚手中购得佩列沙茨半岛和斯通，控制了后来成为其主要财源之一的盐田。1337年，议长菲利普·贝莱尼奥正是在威尼斯宗主权下主持市政。1358年的《扎达尔条约》把它的臣属关系转归匈牙利王冠，拉古萨由此获得实质独立，随后于1399年取得滨海区，1426年又取得科纳夫勒。从1458年起，它向奥斯曼苏丹纳贡却继续自治，商人获得免税特权和黑海通航权，在15至16世纪的商业鼎盛期把巴尔干的白银、食盐和粮食运往地中海各地。新远洋商路的开辟和1667年的大地震削弱了它的财富。拿破仑的军队于1806年占领该城，1808年废除共和国，1815年维也纳会议又把其领土划给哈布斯堡奥地利。

en: Rano was the southernmost of the seven true Hausa states, the Hausa Bakwai, lying in the farm country south of Kano in what is now northern Nigeria; its settlement reaches back to the 500s, making it one of the oldest towns of Hausaland. Hausa tradition names Zamna Kogi, a descendant of the hero Bayajidda, as its founder, and ranks Rano with Kano as a king of indigo, for its weavers and dyers supplied cloth across the Hausa markets. Three dynasties followed one another on its stool: the Kwararrafawa, the Habe and finally the Fulani. Its independence was short-lived: between 1349 and 1385 Yaji I of Kano conquered Rano and held it for two years, and although the town kept its own rulers afterward it never recovered its sovereignty, passing under Kano's shadow and, after the Fulani jihad of the early 1800s, into the Kano Emirate of the Sokoto Caliphate.
zh: 拉诺是豪萨七城邦（豪萨·巴克瓦伊）中位置最南的一个，位于今尼日利亚北部卡诺以南的农区；其聚落史可追溯到6世纪，是豪萨兰最古老的城镇之一。豪萨传说称英雄巴亚吉达的后裔扎姆纳·科吉是它的建立者，并把拉诺与卡诺同列为“靛蓝之王”，因为当地织工和染匠供应的布匹行销豪萨各市场。它的王位先后经历三个王朝：夸拉拉法瓦王朝、哈贝王朝和最后的富拉尼王朝。拉诺的独立并不长久：1349至1385年间，卡诺的亚吉一世攻克拉诺并占领两年，此后该城虽保留了自己的统治者，却再未恢复主权，始终处在卡诺的阴影之下；19世纪初富拉尼圣战之后，它被并入索科托哈里发国的卡诺埃米尔国。

en: Ravenna, a lagoon city of the Romagna, was the capital of the Western Roman Empire in its last century, then of Odoacer and of Theodoric's Ostrogothic kingdom after 493. Belisarius took it for Byzantium in 540, and it became the seat of the Exarchate of Italy until the Lombards captured it in 751; the Donation of Pepin in 756 handed the former exarchate to the papacy. Contested between empire and papacy in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, it passed in 1275 to Guido Novello da Polenta, who drove out the Traversari and founded a hereditary lordship under papal suzerainty. The exiled Florentine poet Dante found refuge there and died in the city in 1321. In 1337 the Da Polenta, in the person of Ostasio I, still ruled Ravenna. The last of the line, Ostasio III, was ousted by Venice in February 1441 under the Treaty of Cremona. Venetian rule lasted until 1509, when the War of the League of Cambrai returned Ravenna to the Papal States; the French sacked it after the Battle of Ravenna in 1512, and a brief Venetian reoccupation of 1527 was reversed in 1529. It remained a papal city until French forces annexed it in 1796, and it was restored to the papacy in 1814.
zh: 拉文纳是罗马涅的潟湖城市，在西罗马帝国最后一个世纪里是帝国首都，493年后又先后成为奥多亚克和狄奥多里克的东哥特王国的都城。540年贝利撒留为拜占庭夺取该城，它成为意大利总督区的治所，直到751年被伦巴第人攻占；756年的丕平献土把原总督区交给教皇。12至13世纪它在帝国与教皇之间几经易手，1275年圭多·诺韦洛·达·波伦塔驱逐特拉韦尔萨里家族，在教皇宗主权下建立起世袭领主治。流亡的佛罗伦萨诗人但丁在此避难，并于1321年在城中去世。1337年时，波伦塔家族的奥斯塔西奥一世仍统治着拉文纳。末代领主奥斯塔西奥三世于1441年2月被威尼斯根据《克雷莫纳条约》推翻。威尼斯的统治持续到1509年，康布雷同盟战争使拉文纳回归教皇国；1512年法军在拉文纳战役后洗劫该城，1527年威尼斯人短暂重新占领，又于1529年退出。此后它一直是教皇城市，1796年被法军吞并，1814年重归教皇。

en: The Duchy of Rawa was a Masovian Piast duchy centered on Rawa, east of Łęczyca. It was created in the partition of 1313, when the sons of Duke Boleslaus II divided Mazovia and Siemowit II, the Piast ruler shown in 1337, took Rawa. He died without heirs in 1345, and his lands were absorbed by his nephew Siemowit III, who reunited most of Mazovia and placed it under Polish suzerainty in 1351. When Masovia was divided again in 1381, Rawa fell to Siemowit IV together with Płock. The territory became the Rawa Voivodeship in 1495, and after the last Masovian Piast duke died in 1526 it passed, with the rest of Mazovia, directly to the Kingdom of Poland.
zh: 拉瓦公国是马佐夫舍皮亚斯特家族的公国，以文奇察以东的拉瓦为中心。1313年公爵博莱斯瓦夫二世的诸子瓜分马佐夫舍，1337年在任的皮亚斯特统治者谢莫维特二世分得拉瓦，公国由此建立。他于1345年无嗣而终，领地被侄子谢莫维特三世兼并；后者重新统一了马佐夫舍的大部分土地，并于1351年接受波兰的宗主权。1381年马佐夫舍再度分封，拉瓦与普沃茨克一同归谢莫维特四世所有。1495年该地改组为拉瓦省，1526年末代马佐夫舍皮亚斯特公爵去世后，它与马佐夫舍其余地区一起直接并入波兰王国。

en: The County of Rietberg was a tiny state of the Holy Roman Empire on the upper Ems in Westphalia, wedged between the prince-bishoprics of Paderborn and Münster. A castle on the site is recorded from the eleventh century and the place itself around 1100 as Rietbike, and from 1237 Rietberg ranked as an immediate imperial county. Small as it was, it kept its own laws, militia and coinage, striking its own money until the seventeenth century. In 1699 the heiress Maria Ernestine of East Frisia married Count Maximilian Ulrich von Kaunitz, carrying Rietberg to the Moravian Kaunitz family, who styled themselves Kaunitz-Rietberg and later rose to princely rank. The county survived until 1807, when it was mediatised to the Kingdom of Westphalia; after that kingdom collapsed in 1813, Rietberg passed to Prussia and was incorporated into the Province of Westphalia.
zh: 里特贝格伯国是神圣罗马帝国的一个小邦，位于威斯特伐利亚的埃姆斯河上游，夹在帕德博恩和明斯特两个采邑主教区之间。当地城堡在11世纪已有记载，居民点约在1100年以里特拜克之名首见文献；1237年起，里特贝格成为直属帝国的伯国。它幅员虽小，却保有自己的法律、民兵和铸币权，直到17世纪仍在铸造自己的钱币。1699年，女继承人东弗里斯兰的玛丽亚·埃内斯蒂娜与考尼茨伯爵马克西米利安·乌尔里希成婚，里特贝格随之转入摩拉维亚的考尼茨家族，该家族改称考尼茨‑里特贝格，后来晋升诸侯。伯国一直存续到1807年，被帝国直辖裁并给威斯特伐利亚王国；1813年该王国瓦解后，里特贝格归属普鲁士，并入威斯特伐利亚省。

en: The Duchy of Racibórz, with its capital at Racibórz in Upper Silesia, was formed in 1172 as the share of Mieszko I Tanglefoot when the Silesian inheritance was divided. Enlarged in 1177 with Bytom, Oświęcim, Pszczyna and neighbouring lands, it was joined to Opole in 1202 to form the united Duchy of Opole and Racibórz, until the family partition of 1281 recreated Racibórz as a separate Piast duchy around Pszczyna, Żory and Rybnik. Its duke Leszek paid homage to King John of Bohemia in 1327, making Racibórz a Bohemian fief. When Leszek died without heirs in 1336, John granted the duchy to his brother-in-law Nicholas II of Opava, who from 1337 ruled Racibórz and Opava together in personal union, the situation reflected in 1337. Separated again in 1377, Racibórz remained with the Opava Přemyslids until it was merged once more with Opole by Duke Jan II the Good in 1521. On Jan's death in 1532 the combined duchy reverted to the Bohemian, now Habsburg, Crown and was pledged to the Hohenzollerns of Brandenburg-Ansbach; the Polish Vasas held it in fee between 1645 and 1666, and the Treaty of Breslau assigned it to Prussia in 1742.
zh: 拉齐布日公国是上西里西亚的公国，都于拉齐布日，1172年西里西亚遗产分割时作为梅什科一世“缠足者”的份额而建立。1177年它得到比托姆、奥斯威辛、普什奇纳等邻近土地而扩大，1202年与奥波莱合并为奥波莱-拉齐布日联合公国，直到1281年家族分家，拉齐布日才作为独立的皮亚斯特公国重新出现，领有普什奇纳、若雷、雷布尼克一带。公爵莱谢克于1327年向波希米亚国王约翰行臣服礼，拉齐布日成为波希米亚封邑。1336年莱谢克无嗣而终，约翰把公国封给他的姻亲、奥帕瓦的尼古拉斯二世，后者自1337年起以共主邦联兼治拉齐布日与奥帕瓦，这正是1337年的局面。1377年两地再度分开，拉齐布日仍属奥帕瓦的普热米斯尔家族，直到1521年扬二世“善人”把它再次并入奥波莱。1532年扬去世后，联合公国收归已属哈布斯堡的波希米亚王冠，并被抵押给勃兰登堡-安斯巴赫的霍亨索伦家族；1645年至1666年间由波兰瓦萨王朝作为封邑持有，1742年《布雷斯劳条约》将其划归普鲁士。

en: The viscounty of Rochechouart was a Limousin lordship on the Grêne and Vayres rivers, whose castle keep still stands above the town. Its lords traced themselves to Foucher, viscount of Limoges in 876, a supporter of Charles the Bald, and to Aymeric I around 990, making their house one of the oldest noble families in France. Aymeric IV joined the First Crusade beside Godfrey of Bouillon, and Aymeric VI built the present castle around 1200. In 1337 the viscount was John I, who had fought in Flanders beside Philip VI; he charged at the Battle of Crécy in 1346 and was killed at Poitiers in 1356 defending John II. His successors kept the castle a centre of resistance to the English, one fighting alongside Bertrand du Guesclin and another beside Joan of Arc, while Viscount Foucaud advised Louis XI. The family later rebuilt the castle in the Renaissance style, and in the seventeenth century Françoise-Athénaïs de Rochechouart, Madame de Montespan, became the most powerful mistress of Louis XIV. During the Terror the viscountess was guillotined in Paris in 1794, though the line survived and a Rochechouart general governed Paris after 1814.
zh: 罗什舒阿尔子爵领是利穆赞的一处封邑，地处格雷讷河与韦尔河交汇处，城堡主楼矗立在城镇上方的高地上。领主家族自称源自876年出任利摩日子爵、辅佐秃头查理的富尔谢，以及约990年的艾梅里一世，是法兰西最古老的贵族世家之一。艾梅里四世曾随布永的戈弗雷参加第一次十字军东征，艾梅里六世则在1200年前后修建了现存的城堡。1337年在位的子爵让一世曾随腓力六世征战佛兰德斯，1346年冲锋于克雷西战场，1356年在普瓦捷为护卫约翰二世而战死。他的后继者把城堡作为抵抗英格兰人的据点：有人与贝特朗·杜·盖克兰并肩作战，也有人追随圣女贞德；子爵富尔科则是路易十一的顾问。后来家族以文艺复兴风格重修城堡，17世纪，家族之女弗朗索瓦丝-阿泰纳伊斯·德·罗什舒阿尔，即蒙特斯庞侯爵夫人，成为路易十四最有权势的宠妃。恐怖统治时期，子爵夫人于1794年在巴黎被送上断头台，但家族血脉延续下来，1814年后还有一位罗什舒阿尔将军出任巴黎总督。

en: Recherla was the country of the Recherla Nayakas, a Telugu warrior dynasty also called the Padmanayaka Velamas. In 1337 they were led by Singama Nayaka, a former commander of the Kakatiya king Prataparudra, from their base at Anumagallu. After Singama was killed while attacking Jallipalli fort around 1358, his sons Anapota and Maada Nayaka avenged him, then joined the Bahmani sultan against the Musunuri Nayakas: at Bhimavaram in 1368 they killed Kapaya Nayaka and made themselves masters of Telangana. Anapota built the fort of Rachakonda around 1360 and moved his capital there, while Maada held a second seat at Devarakonda. Long rivalry with the Reddy kings followed, and after switching from the Bahmani to the Vijayanagara alliance the Recherlas shared in the victory of Pangal in 1419. Bahmani armies took Rachakonda around 1435 and Devarakonda in 1475, extinguishing the kingdom, whose surviving chiefs entered Vijayanagara service.
zh: 隶契罗是隶契罗·纳亚卡人的国家，这个泰卢固武士王朝又称帕德马纳亚卡·韦拉马。1337年时，他们由曾在卡卡提亚国王普拉塔帕鲁德拉麾下任统兵官的辛伽玛·纳亚卡率领，据点在阿努马加卢。约1358年辛伽玛攻打贾利帕利要塞时被杀，其子阿纳波塔与马达·纳亚卡起兵复仇，随后联合巴赫曼尼苏丹对抗穆苏努里·纳亚卡人，于1368年在比姆瓦拉姆击杀卡帕亚·纳亚卡，成为特伦甘纳的主人。约1360年阿纳波塔修筑拉查孔达要塞并迁都于此，马达则以代瓦拉孔达为另一治所。他们与雷迪诸王长期争雄，在从巴赫曼尼阵营转投毗奢耶那伽罗后，于1419年分享了潘加尔之战的胜利。巴赫曼尼军队约在1435年攻陷拉查孔达，1475年又拿下代瓦拉孔达，王国就此灭亡，幸存的首领转投毗奢耶那伽罗效力。

en: Riedesel was the lordship of the Riedesels, an ancient Hessian knightly family first documented around 1226 and long settled as vassals of the Landgraves of Hesse, whose local Vögte they served at Kassel and Melsungen. Their rise began in 1428, when the lords of Eisenbach died out and the knight Hermann II, called the Golden Knight, took over their Fulda Abbey offices around Lauterbach; his son married the last lord's daughter, securing the castles of Eisenbach, Lauterbach, Ludwigseck and Stockhausen, and in 1432 Hermann gained the hereditary office of Marshal of Hesse. Blood feuds with Fulda Abbey over the old Eisenbach fiefs marked the 1460s, and Hermann IV introduced the Reformation in 1527; after Fulda seized Lauterbach in 1548 the family retook the town by force in 1552. As members of the Franconian Imperial Knighthood the Riedesels were raised to barons in 1680, and the treaty of 1684 with Fulda recognised them as independent lords of Lauterbach. Their small state lasted until 1806, when it was mediatised into the Grand Duchy of Hesse. The general Friedrich Adolph Riedesel, who led Brunswick troops in British service during the American war, was the most famous member of the house.
zh: 里德泽尔是里德泽尔骑士家族的领主地。这个古老的黑森骑士家族约在1226年首见文献，长期作为黑森领地伯爵的封臣，在卡塞尔和梅尔聪根担任地方护院。家族的崛起始于1428年：艾森巴赫领主绝嗣，号称“金骑士”的赫尔曼二世骑士接手了他们在劳特巴赫一带的富尔达修道院职务；他的儿子娶末代领主之女为妻，保住了艾森巴赫、劳特巴赫、路德维希塞克和斯托克豪森几座城堡，赫尔曼又于1432年获得黑森世袭元帅一职。15世纪60年代，围绕原艾森巴赫采邑，他们与富尔达修道院爆发流血仇杀；赫尔曼四世于1527年引入宗教改革。1548年富尔达偷袭占领劳特巴赫，家族于1552年以武力夺回。作为法兰克帝国骑士团的成员，里德泽尔家族于1680年晋升男爵，1684年与富尔达签订的条约承认他们为劳特巴赫的独立领主。这个小邦一直存续到1806年，被裁并进黑森大公国。家族最出名的成员是弗里德里希·阿道夫·里德泽尔将军，他曾在美国独立战争中率领为英国效力的不伦瑞克军队。

en: The Reddi kingdom grew out of the collapse of Kakatiya power in the Telugu country. When Delhi armies took Warangal and carried off the Kakatiya raja Pratapa Rudra in 1323, Tughluq rule over the coast proved too weak to hold, and local warrior lineages seized their chance. Prolaya Vema Reddy, whose family had been Kakatiya army commanders and village headmen, founded his own kingdom at Addanki around 1325. His successor Anavota Reddy moved the court to the hill fort of Kondavidu, and at its height the realm stretched from Cuttack in the north to Kanchi in the south, with a junior branch established at Rajahmundry in 1395. The Reddi kings were great builders and patrons: they repaired the temple of Srisailam, raised the Narasimha temple at Ahobilam, endowed Brahmin agraharas and fortified Kondapalli and Kondavidu against the Recherla Velamas and their Bahmani allies. The end came in the fifteenth century: Vijayanagara took Kondavidu in 1424, and the Gajapatis of Orissa conquered Rajahmundry around 1448, closing the hundred-year history of the Reddi kingdom.
zh: 罗底王国是在泰卢固地区卡卡提亚政权崩溃的乱局中崛起的。1323年德里军队攻陷瓦朗加尔、掳走卡卡提亚罗阇波罗陀波·鲁陀罗，图格鲁克王朝对沿海的统治无力维持，各地武士家族趁机而起。波罗罗耶·吠摩·罗底出身历任卡卡提亚军事统帅和村落首领的家族，约于1325年在阿登吉自建王国。继承者阿那伏多·罗底把朝廷迁往山城孔达维杜；极盛时疆域北起卡塔克、南至建志，1395年又在拉杰蒙德里分出一支旁系。罗底诸王大兴土木、广施护持：他们修葺斯里赛勒姆神庙，建成阿霍比勒的那罗辛哈神庙，向婆罗门广赐阿格拉哈拉封地，并修建孔达帕利和孔达维杜等堡垒，以抵御雷切尔拉的吠罗摩首领及其巴赫马尼盟友。15世纪王国走向终结：毗阇耶那伽罗于1424年夺取孔达维杜，奥里萨的伽阇波蒂又在约1448年征服拉杰蒙德里，罗底王国百年之运就此结束。

en: Regensburg stands on the northernmost bend of the Danube, on the site of Castra Regina, the Roman legionary fortress built around 179. From the early sixth century it was the seat of the Agilolfing dukes and served as the capital of Bavaria until the thirteenth century; Saint Boniface re-established its bishopric in 739, and after 843 Louis the German held court there. The Stone Bridge, finished around 1146, linked the trade routes of northern Europe with Venice and opened the city's golden age of merchant wealth. In 1245 Regensburg became a Free Imperial City, though it fell to the Duchy of Bavaria in 1486 before the emperor restored its independence ten years later. The Jewish community, one of the largest in southern Germany, was expelled in 1519, and the city adopted the Reformation in 1542. From 1663 until 1806 it hosted the Perpetual Diet, the permanent assembly of the Holy Roman Empire; in 1803 it passed to Carl von Dalberg's Principality of Regensburg and in 1810 to the Kingdom of Bavaria.
zh: 雷根斯堡位于多瑙河最北的河湾处，城址是约179年罗马军团修建的卡斯特拉-雷吉纳要塞。6世纪初起它是阿吉洛尔芬公爵的驻地，13世纪前一直是巴伐利亚的都城；739年圣波尼法爵重建了当地主教区，843年后日耳曼人路易在此设朝。约1146年落成的石桥把北欧商路与威尼斯连接起来，开启了这座城市商贸繁荣的黄金时代。1245年雷根斯堡成为帝国自由城市，1486年一度并入巴伐利亚公国，十年后皇帝又恢复了它的独立地位。1519年，南德最大的犹太社区之一被逐出该城；1542年城市接受宗教改革。1663年至1806年，神圣罗马帝国的常设议会——永久帝国议会在此召开；1803年它被并入卡尔·冯·达尔贝格的雷根斯堡侯国，1810年又转归巴伐利亚王国。

en: The County of Rethel was a small feudal lordship in the Ardennes, seated at the city of Rethel. The town originally belonged to the Abbey of Saint-Remi at Reims and was governed by its advocati, until one of them, Manasses I, established the comital House of Rethel. Count Hugh I, who ruled from 1065 to 1118, sent a son of his own to the Latin East: Baldwin of Rethel reigned in Jerusalem as King Baldwin II from 1118 until his death in 1131. When Hugh IV died in 1285 leaving only a daughter, Joan, the county passed by her marriage to Louis of Nevers of the Dampierre family, and their son Louis I held Rethel together with Flanders and Nevers in 1337, before he was killed at Crécy in 1346. Rethel thereafter shared the fortunes of the Burgundian and Nevers inheritances. It was raised to a peerage of France in 1481 and to a duchy in 1581, and in 1659 the last Gonzaga duke sold it to Cardinal Mazarin, after which it was known as the Duchy of Mazarin until the Revolution of 1789 abolished it.
zh: 勒泰勒伯国是阿登地区的一个小封建领地，治所在勒泰勒城。该城本属兰斯的圣雷米修道院，由其世俗代理人管理，后来代理人之一马纳塞斯一世开创了勒泰勒伯爵家族。1065至1118年在位的于格一世把一个儿子送到了拉丁东方：勒泰勒的鲍德温于1118年登上耶路撒冷王位，称鲍德温二世，统治到1131年去世。1285年于格四世去世，只留下女儿让娜，伯国随她的婚姻转入当皮埃尔家族的讷韦尔的路易之手；他们的儿子路易一世在1337年同时领有勒泰勒、佛兰德和讷韦尔，1346年战死于克雷西。此后勒泰勒随勃艮第与讷韦尔的继承关系几经转手，1481年被列为法兰西贵族爵位，1581年升为公国。1659年，末代贡扎加公爵把它卖给枢机主教马萨林，此后改称马萨林公国，直到1789年法国大革命将其废除。

en: Rongmei, in the mountains straddling present Hefeng and Wufeng in western Hubei, grew into the mightiest of the Tujia tusi. Its Tian clan, unrelated to the Tian rulers of Sizhou, first held office under the Yuan in 1310 and was confirmed as the Rongmei pacification commission under the Ming in 1371. Through fifteen generations and twenty-three chiefs the house expanded across eastern Enshi and into Changyang, Wufeng and the Hunan border, swallowing its four rival pacification offices and appointing twenty-seven local chiefs without imperial sanction; the Yongzheng emperor remarked that of all the tusi of Hubei and Sichuan, Rongmei was the richest and strongest. Its independence also made it the test case for gaitu guiliu: when the Qing moved to replace native rule in 1735, Rongmei alone took up arms, and its defeat emptied much of its Hefeng heartland. The old territory became Hefeng subprefecture under Yichang, ending four centuries of Tian rule.
zh: 容美位于鄂西山地，地跨今鹤峰、五峰一带，后来发展为最强大的土家族土司。其统治者田氏与思州田氏并无渊源，1310年已在元朝治下任职，1371年被明朝确认为容美宣抚司。田氏历十五代、二十三位土司，势力从恩施东部扩张到长阳、五峰和湖南边界，先后吞并属下四个安抚司，还不经朝廷册封自行分封了二十七个长官司；雍正帝曾评价，楚蜀各土司中唯有容美最为富强。它的坐大也使它成为改土归流的突破口：1735年清朝推行流官之治时，容美是唯一举兵反抗的土司，战败后鹤峰一带人口锐减。旧地被设为隶属宜昌府的鹤峰州，田氏四百年的统治就此结束。

en: Rongshan was one of the six zhangguansi held by the Bozhou chiefdom, in the hill country east of Bozhou's Zunyi heartland. When the Ming crushed the Bozhou rebellion in 1600 and replaced native rule with officials, Rongshan's lands were reorganized into Meitan County under the new Pingyue Prefecture.
zh: 容山是播州土司下辖的六个长官司之一，地处播州治所遵义以东的山区。1600年明朝平定播州之乱、推行改土归流后，容山故地被划为湄潭县，归新设置的平越府管辖。

en: The County of Rieneck was a small lordship of Lower Franconia in the Spessart hills, taking its name from the counts whose castle stood above the river Sinn and whose seats came to include Lohr am Main, their residence from 1295. The original comital family died out with Count Gerhard I in 1108, and through an heiress the lands passed to the counts of Loon, who took the Rieneck name and from 1168 kept their court at Burg Rieneck. In 1333 Emperor Louis IV granted the county town privileges in gratitude for its support during his struggle for the crown, yet in the same year the male comital line failed and the Bishopric of Würzburg laid claim to the lordship. Long feuds followed with the neighbouring sees of Würzburg and Mainz, which restated their claims after the deaths of Count Johann in 1366 and Count Ludwig XI in 1408. The Reformation was introduced in 1544, and when the last count, Philip III, died in 1559 the Archbishopric of Mainz took over the lordship and ruled it from Lohr. After passing through the Nostitz and Colloredo-Mansfeld families, Rieneck was mediatized in 1806 and finally awarded to the Kingdom of Bavaria by the Congress of Vienna in 1815.
zh: 里内克伯国是下法兰克尼亚施佩萨特山区的一个小领地，得名于其统治家族；伯爵们的城堡矗立在辛恩河畔，领地内的美因河畔洛尔从1295年起成为他们的驻地。原伯爵家族于1108年随格拉德一世去世而绝嗣，土地经女继承人转入洛翁伯爵家族，后者改用里内克之姓，1168年起以里内克城堡为治所。1333年，皇帝路易四世为酬谢该家族在争夺王位期间的支持，授予其城市特权；但也就在同一年，伯爵男系断绝，维尔茨堡主教区趁机对领地提出要求。此后它与邻近的维尔茨堡和美因茨两个主教区长期争执，1366年约翰伯爵和1408年路德维希十一世去世后，两区又各自重申其主张。1544年宗教改革传入；1559年末代伯爵菲利普三世去世，美因茨大主教区接管领地，从洛尔进行治理。里内克后经诺斯蒂茨家族与科洛雷多-曼斯费尔德家族之手，1806年被调解削权，最终在1815年维也纳会议上划归巴伐利亚王国。

en: Riga stands at the mouth of the Daugava river on the Baltic, on a sheltered harbour long used by Liv and Viking traders. In 1201 Bishop Albert of Livonia moved his see there and fortified the town, which quickly became the main German trading gateway on the eastern Baltic. Its merchants won self-government as early as 1221 and joined the Hanseatic League in 1282. The wealthy city then spent two centuries defending its autonomy against its nominal lord, the Archbishop of Riga, and the Livonian Order. Its long wars against the Order ended in defeat in 1330, when the knights built a castle inside the city, and Riga remained under heavy Order influence for generations. It embraced the Reformation in 1522, and after the collapse of the Livonian Order in 1561 it became a free imperial city of the Holy Roman Empire. The Treaty of Drohiczyn of 1581 placed it under the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden conquered it in 1621, and in 1710 Peter the Great's armies took it during the Great Northern War, a transfer confirmed by the Treaty of Nystad in 1721.
zh: 里加位于波罗的海道加瓦河河口，建在利夫人与维京商人长期使用的天然良港之上。1201年，利沃尼亚主教阿尔伯特将主教座迁至此地并修筑城池，这里很快成为德意志商人在波罗的海东岸的首要贸易门户；市民早在1221年便获得自治权，1282年加入汉萨同盟。此后两百年间，这座富庶城市不断对抗名义上的封君里加大主教和利沃尼亚骑士团，以维护自身自治。它与骑士团的长期战争以1330年的失败告终，骑士团在城内修建了城堡，里加此后几代人都处于骑士团的强力影响之下。1522年里加接受宗教改革；1561年利沃尼亚骑士团崩溃后，它成为神圣罗马帝国的自由帝国城市。1581年的德罗希琴条约将其划归波兰立陶宛联邦，1621年瑞典国王古斯塔夫二世将其征服，1710年大北方战争中它被彼得大帝的军队攻占，1721年的《尼斯塔德条约》确认了这一归属。

en: Rimini, the Roman colonia of Ariminum founded in 268 BC at the meeting of the Via Flaminia and the Via Aemilia, preserves the Arch of Augustus and the Ponte di Tiberio from its Roman age. In the factional struggles of the thirteenth century the Malatesta family rose to power: Malatesta da Verucchio became podestà in 1239 and made himself sole signore in 1295, and his descendants turned Rimini into the centre of a lordship spanning the Romagna and the Marche. In 1337 Malatesta II, also lord of Pesaro, ruled the city. Its most celebrated lord was Sigismondo Pandolfo Malatesta, a condottiero and poet who rebuilt the Tempio Malatestiano with Leon Battista Alberti and raised the Castel Sismondo, but wars with Pope Pius II reduced him to Rimini alone in 1463. In 1500 Pandolfo IV lost the city to Cesare Borgia; Venice held it from 1503 to 1509, after which Pope Julius II incorporated it into the Papal States. A last Malatesta attempt in 1527 and 1528 failed, ending the family's dominion. Rimini remained a papal legation until the Napoleonic army arrived in 1797, and in 1815 Joachim Murat issued his Rimini Proclamation there during the Neapolitan War.
zh: 里米尼古称阿里米努姆，是公元前268年罗马在弗拉米尼亚大道与艾米利亚大道交汇处建立的殖民城，城中仍留存罗马时代的奥古斯都拱门和提比略桥。在13世纪的党派纷争中，马拉泰斯塔家族崛起：马拉泰斯塔·达·韦鲁基奥于1239年成为行政长官，1295年自立为唯一领主，其后代把里米尼建成横跨罗马涅和马尔凯的领地中心。1337年时，统治该城的是身兼佩萨罗领主的马拉泰斯塔二世。最著名的领主是西吉斯蒙多·潘多尔福·马拉泰斯塔，这位佣兵队长兼诗人聘请莱昂·巴蒂斯塔·阿尔贝蒂重建了马拉泰斯塔神殿，并修建西斯蒙多城堡，但与教皇庇护二世的战争使他在1463年只剩下里米尼一城。1500年潘多尔福四世把城市丢给切萨雷·博尔贾；威尼斯于1503—1509年占据该城，随后教皇尤利乌斯二世将其并入教皇国。1527—1528年马拉泰斯塔家族最后一次复辟失败，家族统治永久终结。里米尼作为教皇使节辖区一直维持到1797年拿破仑军队到来，1815年若阿尚·缪拉在那不勒斯战争期间于此发表《里米尼宣言》。

en: Rajpipla, whose old capital Nandod was the ancient Nandipuri, was the chief town of the Lata country between the Mahi and the Narmada rivers. From the fifth to the eighth century Nandipuri had served as the seat of the Gurjaras of Lata, feudatories of the Maitrakas and Chalukyas; in later times a Bhil population gave the place its familiar name, remembering a chief who held court beneath a pipal tree. Around 1340 a Gohil Rajput line, kin to the Guhilas of Mewar, established itself at Rajpipla and built a principality in the wooded hills east of Bharuch. The rajas of Rajpipla kept their independence longer than most Gujarat chiefs: when the Delhi governors had reduced the rest of the province by the 1390s, Rajpipla and Junagadh alone still withheld tribute, and only in 1403 did Tatar Khan, the rebel sultan Muhammad Shah, march in and humble the chief of Nandod. The Gohils later weathered the sultans of Ahmedabad and submitted to Akbar, before Maratha Gaekwads occupied the state in 1815 and the British made it a protectorate in 1821.
zh: 拉杰毕普拉的旧都南多德古称南迪普里，是默希河与讷尔默达河之间拉塔地区的首邑。5至8世纪时，南迪普里是拉塔瞿折罗人的治所，他们世代作为梅特拉卡王朝和遮娄其王朝的附庸；后来当地比尔人给这里起了流传更广的名字，纪念一位在菩提树下听政的首领。约1340年，与梅瓦尔古希拉人同源的戈希拉拉杰普特支系在拉杰毕普拉立足，在巴鲁奇以东的山林中建立起一个小邦。拉杰毕普拉诸王保持独立的时间比古吉拉特多数首领都久：14世纪90年代德里派驻的总督已压服全省大部分地区，唯有拉杰毕普拉与朱纳格德拒不纳贡；直到1403年，自立为苏丹的塔塔尔汗（即穆罕默德沙）进军此地，才逼降南多德的首领。戈希尔人后来又熬过了艾哈迈达巴德诸苏丹并臣服于阿克巴，最终在1815年被马拉塔盖克瓦德人占领，1821年成为英国的保护邦。

en: Rajouri, the ancient Rajapuri named in Kalhana's twelfth-century Rajatarangini, is a hill kingdom in the Pir Panjal range west of the Kashmir valley. Its rajas came of the Jarral Rajput clan, the first of them, Prithvi Pal, holding the state from 1033 and guarding the mountain passes against the raids of Mahmud of Ghazni. In 1475 the Kashmiri general Malik Tazi Bhat conquered Rajouri together with Poonch and Bhimber for the Sultan of Kashmir; the Jarral rajas kept their throne as tributaries, supplying tribute and troops. When Akbar annexed Kashmir in 1586 the Mughals took the rajas under their own protection and granted them the title Mirza. The hill state held out against the first Sikh attacks of 1810 and 1812, but in 1813 Gulab Singh of Jammu defeated Raja Aghar Khan and attached Rajouri to the Sikh Empire of Ranjit Singh.
zh: 拉久里古称罗阇普里，见于卡尔哈纳12世纪的《王河》，是克什米尔谷地以西皮尔潘贾尔山脉中的山邦。其罗阇出自贾拉尔拉杰普特氏族，首位首领普里特维·帕尔于1033年起统治该邦，曾扼守山口抵御伽色尼的马哈茂德的袭掠。1475年，克什米尔将领马利克·塔齐·巴特为克什米尔苏丹征服拉久里，连同蓬奇和比姆贝尔一并拿下；贾拉尔罗阇作为附庸保留王位，承担贡赋与出兵义务。1586年阿克巴吞并克什米尔后，莫卧儿将这些罗阇置于自己庇护之下，并授予他们“米尔扎”称号。该山邦击退了1810年和1812年锡克人的头两次进攻，但1813年查谟的古拉布·辛格击败罗阇阿加尔汗，将拉久里并入兰吉特·辛格的锡克帝国。

en: The Rankali were a Kurdish tribal chiefdom holding the Kermanshah plain, with Bisotun and the Holeylan hills. Long Hasanwayhid and Annazid heartland, the country was sacked by the Mongols in 1257 and in 1337 was ruled by Rankali chiefs as Jalayirid vassals, before Kermanshah passed to the Kalhor.
zh: 兰卡利人是据有克尔曼沙阿平原的库尔德部落酋长政权，领有比索通和霍莱兰山地。这里长期是哈桑韦赫王朝与安纳兹王朝的核心地带，1257年遭蒙古人洗劫；1337年兰卡利首领作为札剌亦儿王朝的附庸统治该地，后来克尔曼沙阿落入卡尔霍尔人之手。

en: The Raksels are a Rajput clan of the Yaduvanshi, or Lunar, line who held the forested plateau of Palamu, south of Bihar, in the centuries before the Mughals. Their rajas built the old fort on the Auranga River, later left as ruins amid the Betla jungles. When Akbar's commander Man Singh marched into Palamu in 1574 the Raksels submitted, but after Akbar's death they drove out the Mughal garrison in 1605 and later refused the tribute demanded by the subedar of Patna, which brought three imperial expeditions in succession. Palamu itself was finally lost when the Chero chief Bhagwant Rai rebelled while his Raksel overlord, also named Man Singh, was away at a ceremony in Surguja; the raja never tried to return but withdrew east with his clan and founded the Raksel state of Surguja, with its capital at Ambikapur. As Surguja rajas the Raksels became overlords of the small states of Udaipur, Jashpur, Koriya and Changbhakar, and in 1818, after the Third Anglo-Maratha War, Surguja became a British protectorate.
