zh: 拉克塞尔人是属雅度月系的拉杰普特部族，在莫卧儿时代之前的数百年间据有比哈尔以南丛林密布的伯拉穆高原。其首领在奥兰加河畔修建了旧要塞，要塞后来只剩贝特拉丛林中的残垣。1574年阿克巴的将领曼·辛格进军伯拉穆，拉克塞尔人一度臣服，但阿克巴死后他们于1605年驱逐莫卧儿驻军，后来又拒绝巴特那省督索求的贡赋，招致莫卧儿接连三次征讨。伯拉穆最终失守：哲卢首领巴格万特·拉伊趁其宗主、同名的拉克塞尔首领曼·辛格前往苏尔古贾参加仪式之机起兵；这位首领没有反攻，而是率部东撤，建立了以安比卡布尔为都的苏尔古贾土邦。作为苏尔古贾王公，拉克塞尔人成为乌代布尔、杰什布尔、科里亚、昌格巴卡尔等小邦的宗主；1818年第三次英国—马拉塔战争后，苏尔古贾成为英国的保护土邦。

en: Rende was the country of the Rende tribe, one of the Wuman Yi tribes of the Dali Kingdom, in what is present-day Xundian in northeastern Yunnan. The Yuan organized it as Rende Prefecture, ruled through hereditary Yi headmen. In 1383 the Ming raised it to the Rende Military and Civilian Prefecture and soon renamed it the Xundian Military and Civilian Prefecture, confirming a local Yi woman, Sha Chen, as native prefect in 1384, and in 1390 a military garrison was planted inside her territory at Mumiguan. The chieftain line ended in the Chenghua reign of the 1470s, when the court carried out gaitu guiliu, replaced the tusi with appointed officials and made it Xundian Prefecture; the seat was moved below Mount Fengwu in 1528. In 1669 the Qing demoted it to Xundian Department under Qujing Prefecture, and the old name Rende survives only as the name of the central quarter of the present-day county town.
zh: 仁德在大理国时期是乌蛮彝族仁德部的居地，位于今云南东北部的寻甸一带。元朝置仁德府，由世袭的彝族首领治理当地彝民。1383年明朝升为仁德军民府，旋即改称寻甸军民府，并于1384年准当地彝族女土官沙琛袭任土知府；1390年朝廷又在其境内设置木密关守御千户所，驻军屯守。成化年间朝廷在此推行改土归流，废土官、派流官，定名寻甸府，1528年又将治所迁到凤梧山下。1669年清朝将其降为曲靖府属下的寻甸州，仁德这个旧名只保留在今寻甸县城中心的仁德街道中。

en: The Rong holding in the hills of southern Sichuan was the heartland of the Bo people, an ancient people of the upper Yangtze counted among the Hundred Pu, remembered for their hanging coffins hollowed from single logs and their bronze drums. Their Lingxiao stronghold on Bowang Mountain, the last south Chinese holdout against the Mongols, fell only in 1288. In 1285 the Yuan court organized the district as Rongzhou, administered through the Mahu circuit with its seat at present-day Xingwen. The Ming reduced Rongzhou to Rong County in 1371. War returned in 1573, when imperial armies besieged Lingxiao and neighbouring Gong County; the Bo were killed or assimilated and vanish from written records thereafter. Rong County was renamed Xingwen the next year, a name celebrating the return of civil order.
zh: 戎地位于川南山地，是僰人的核心居地。僰人是长江上游的古老民族，属百濮之一，以整木凿成的悬棺和铜鼓闻名。他们在博望山的凌霄城是华南抵抗蒙古人的最后据点，直到1288年才陷落。1285年，元朝将这一地区设为戎州，通过马湖路管辖，治所在今兴文县一带。1371年，明朝把戎州降为戎县。1573年战火再起，官军围攻凌霄城和邻近的珙县，僰人或被杀或被同化，此后从文字记载中消失。次年戎县改名兴文，取偃武修文之意。

en: Ranekouh takes its name from the Ranekouh district in the hills of eastern Gilan, between the Caspian shore and the Alborz range, with its seat at the nearby port of Langarud. In the fourteenth century this countryside formed part of Bia-pish, the eastern Gilani polity ruled from Lahijan by local Alid sayyids and later by the Kar-Kiya dynasty.
zh: 拉内库赫得名于吉兰东部、夹在里海海岸与厄尔布尔士山脉之间的拉内库赫山区，治所设在附近的港口兰加鲁德。14世纪时，这一带属比亚皮什的一部分，即由拉希詹的阿里德圣裔、后来的卡尔基亚王朝统治的东吉兰政权。

en: The Ranpur chiefdom was a small Jethwa Rajput domain in the Jhalavad region of Saurashtra, the reduced seat of one of the oldest ruling clans of the Kathiawar peninsula. The Jethwas entered Saurashtra from Sindh and Kutch around the ninth century, founded Morvi as their capital, and held much of western Kathiawar by the time of Mahmud of Ghazni. They lost Morvi to Qutb-ud-din Aibak in 1193 and later fixed their capital at Ghumli, which Rana Shiyaji restored as their seat in 1220. In 1309 Jam Unaji Jadeja of Sindh failed to take Ghumli, but in 1313 his son Bamaniyaji Jadeja sacked the city and drove out Rana Bhanji Jethwa, who moved his court to Ranpur. The Jethwas kept this much-reduced territory for generations, later shifting to Chhaya and then in 1685 to the port of Porbandar, where their rana line continued into the nineteenth century.
zh: 兰普尔是萨乌拉施特拉恰拉瓦尔地区的杰特瓦拉杰普特小邦，是卡提阿瓦半岛最古老统治家族之一退守后的据点。杰特瓦人约在9世纪从信德和卡奇进入萨乌拉施特拉，建莫尔维为都，到伽色尼的马哈茂德时代已据有卡提阿瓦西部大片土地。1193年莫尔维被库特布丁·艾伊拜克攻占，他们后来定都古姆利，拉纳·希亚吉于1220年再次以此为都。1309年信德的贾姆·乌纳吉·阇提奢攻打古姆利未果，但其子巴曼尼亚吉·阇提奢于1313年攻陷该城，赶走拉纳·班吉·杰特瓦，后者把宫廷迁到兰普尔。杰特瓦人守着这片大为缩小的领地延续多代，后来迁往查亚，又于1685年迁往港口博尔本德尔，其拉纳世系在那里一直延续到19世纪。

en: Ross was the highland province north of the Moray Firth, ruled from Dingwall by its mormaers, or earls, who also led Clan Ross. The province emerged from the old earldom of Moray in the mid-twelfth century, and in the 1220s Fearchar MacTaggart, son of the lay parson of Applecross, was made earl after crushing a rebellion for Alexander II; he founded Fearn Abbey and began the O'Beolan line of earls. Hugh, Earl of Ross, died fighting for David II at Halidon Hill in 1333, and his son William, a nephew of Robert the Bruce, returned from Norway to take up the earldom in 1336. In 1339 he helped take Perth from the English by diverting the town's defensive water channel and filling its ditch, but in 1346 he killed his own vassal Ronald MacRuari at Elcho priory and withdrew his men on the eve of Neville's Cross, contributing to David II's capture. He served as justiciar north of the Forth until 1355, joined the highland lords' tax revolt in 1366, and died in 1372, the last O'Beolan earl. David II had forced his daughter Euphemia to marry Walter Leslie, and the earldom then passed through the Leslies to the Stewart dukes of Albany. In 1411 Donald, Lord of the Isles, invaded Ross and fought the bloody Battle of Harlaw; under James I the lordship came to the MacDonald lords of the Isles, who forfeited it to the crown in 1476.
zh: 罗斯是马里湾以北的高地省份，以丁沃尔为中心，由其莫马尔（即伯爵）统治，伯爵同时也是罗斯氏族的首领。该省12世纪中叶从古老的马里伯爵领中分出；13世纪20年代，阿普尔克罗斯在俗牧师之子费尔查尔·麦克塔加特因替亚历山大二世平定叛乱而受封伯爵，他修建了费恩修道院，开创了奥贝兰家族的伯爵世系。1333年，罗斯伯爵休在哈利顿山为大卫二世作战时阵亡，其子威廉是罗伯特·布鲁斯的外甥，1336年从挪威返回承袭伯爵位。1339年，他协助从英格兰人手中夺取珀斯：引开护城河水、用浮木填平壕沟；但1346年他在内维尔十字之战前夕于埃尔科小修院杀死自己的附庸罗纳德·麦克鲁阿里，随后率军北撤，间接导致大卫二世兵败被俘。他担任福斯湾以北的司法官直到1355年，1366年又参加了高地领主抗税叛乱，1372年去世，是奥贝兰家族最后一位罗斯伯爵。大卫二世此前已迫使他的女儿尤菲米娅嫁给沃尔特·莱斯利，伯爵领随后经莱斯利家族转入斯图尔特家族的奥尔巴尼公爵一系。1411年，群岛领主唐纳德入侵罗斯，爆发惨烈的哈洛战役；詹姆斯一世时期，该领地落入群岛的麦克唐纳领主之手，最终于1476年被王室没收。

en: Rothenburg ob der Tauber takes its name from the red castle built above the Tauber around 1070 by the counts of Comburg-Rothenburg, whose line died out in 1116, when the lands passed to the Hohenstaufen. The town below the castle was founded in 1170, and in 1274 King Rudolf of Habsburg made it a free imperial city. Its rabbi Meir ben Baruch was one of the leading Jewish jurists of medieval Germany before the community was destroyed in the Rintfleisch pogrom of 1298. The Holy Blood pilgrimage and three annual fairs made Rothenburg one of the twenty largest cities of the Empire by the fourteenth century, though an earthquake shattered the old Staufer castle in 1356. The city joined the Peasants' War in 1525 and was punished by Margrave Casimir of Kulmbach, who restored the Catholic mass; the council firmly introduced the Reformation only in 1544. In 1631 Tilly's army stormed the town, plague followed in 1634, and Rothenburg never regained its old wealth. It passed to Bavaria in 1803.
zh: 陶伯河上游罗滕堡得名于约1070年孔堡-罗滕堡伯爵在陶伯河高处修建的红色城堡；该家族于1116年绝嗣，领地转入霍亨斯陶芬家族手中。山下的城市建于1170年，1274年哈布斯堡的鲁道夫国王将它立为自由帝国城市。当地的拉比梅厄·本·巴鲁赫是中世纪德意志最重要的犹太教法学家之一，而犹太社区在1298年的林特弗莱希屠杀中被毁。圣血朝圣和每年三次的集市使罗滕堡在14世纪跻身帝国二十大城市之列，不过1356年的一场地震摧毁了古老的霍亨斯陶芬城堡。1525年城市投身农民战争，库尔姆巴赫藩侯卡齐米日施以报复并恢复天主教弥撒；市议会直到1544年才正式引入宗教改革。1631年梯利的军队攻陷城市，1634年瘟疫接踵而至，罗滕堡再未恢复昔日的富庶，1803年划归巴伐利亚。

en: The County of Roucy was one of the seven lay peerages of the County of Champagne, covering a stretch of the Aisne valley north-west of Reims, whose counts also bore the title of count of Reims. The first castle was raised in 948, when King Louis IV gave the land to his ally Renaud of Roucy after the capture of Reims; Renaud was buried in the abbey of Saint-Remi, and his son Gislebert was the first to style himself count of Roucy. After the houses of Roucy and Montdidier failed in the male line, the heiress Eustachie of Roucy married Robert of Pierrepont in 1204, bringing the county to the Pierrepont family. In 1337 it was held by John V of Pierrepont, count from 1304, who had united Roucy with the county of Braine and who fell fighting for France at Crécy in 1346; his grandson John VI was killed at Agincourt in 1415. In 1370 Isabelle of Pierrepont sold Roucy to Louis of Anjou, but her uncle Simon won it back after a twenty-year suit before the Parlement of Paris. In 1415 the heiress Jeanne of Pierrepont carried the county by marriage to the Sarrebruck-Commercy family, and in 1525 it passed to the house of Roye, later to the La Rochefoucauld, keeping its peerage until the Revolution.
zh: 鲁西伯国是香槟伯国的七个世俗贵族领地之一，据有兰斯西北的一段埃纳河谷，其伯爵还兼任兰斯伯爵。948年，国王路易四世在夺取兰斯后把这片土地封给盟友雷诺·德·鲁西，第一座城堡由此修建；雷诺葬于圣雷米修道院，其子吉尔贝尔是第一个自称鲁西伯爵的人。鲁西家族和蒙迪迪耶家族的男嗣相继断绝后，女继承人厄斯塔谢·德·鲁西于1204年嫁给皮埃尔蓬的罗贝尔，伯国遂入皮埃尔蓬家族。1337年在位的是自1304年起任伯爵的皮埃尔蓬的约翰五世，他已把鲁西与布赖讷伯国合二为一，1346年在克雷西为法兰西战死；其孙约翰六世则于1415年殒命阿金库尔。1370年，皮埃尔蓬的伊莎贝尔把鲁西卖给安茹的路易，但她的叔父西蒙在巴黎高等法院打了二十年官司，终把伯国夺回。1415年，女继承人皮埃尔蓬的让娜经婚姻把伯国带入萨尔布吕肯-科梅尔西家族；1525年伯国转入鲁瓦家族，后归拉罗什富科家族，其贵族领地地位一直保持到大革命。

en: Barru, called Berru in Bugis, was a small Bugis kingdom on the Makassar Strait coast of South Sulawesi, its territory forming one of four small states in the present Barru area together with Tanete, Soppeng Riaja and Mallusetasi. Bugis Lontara tradition traces the kingdom to La Sarewo, who cleared forest for rice fields and was enthroned on a stone called Batu Allantireng beside the aju Berru tree that gave the realm its name. In 1337 the throne belonged to its second ruler, Petta Cakkeawo, and under the fourth king, Matinro ri Daun Lesang, the realm was split into an inland half, Berru Riaja, and a coastal half, Berru Rilau. Islam reached Barru from neighbouring Tanete, and in 1606 its twelfth ruler became the first of the line to adopt the faith. The dynasty survived the Makassar wars and kept its own line of rulers, which in 1836 passed to Tenripadang Sultan Aisyah, a princess of Gowa.
zh: 巴鲁在布吉语中称贝鲁，是南苏拉威西望加锡海峡沿岸的布吉人小王国，与塔内特、索彭里亚贾和马卢塞塔西并立，是巴鲁地区四个小邦之一。据布吉隆塔拉文献的传说，开国君主拉萨雷沃开垦丛林为稻田，在一块名为巴图阿兰蒂伦的巨石旁登位，巨石边的贝鲁树便成了国名的由来。1337年在位的是第二代君主佩塔·查凯奥；第四代君主马廷罗·里·道恩·莱桑在位时，王国被分为山居的贝鲁里亚贾和临海的贝鲁里劳两部分。伊斯兰教经邻邦塔内特传入，1606年第十二代君主成为家族中第一位穆斯林。这个王朝熬过了历次望加锡战争并维持着自己的君统，1836年王位传给出身戈瓦的公主滕里帕当·苏丹·艾莎。

en: Rasht is the chief city of the rainy Gilan lowlands near the Caspian coast, first mentioned in Umayyad records as early as 682 and listed as a district in the tenth-century geography Hudud al-'Alam. In the fourteenth century it was a market town of Bia-pas, the western half of Gilan ruled by the Sunni Eshaqvand dynasty from nearby Fuman, and it grew rich on the silk trade carried through the port of Bandar-e Anzali. In 1572 Jamshid Soltan moved the Bia-pas capital from Fuman to Rasht, which then became the seat of Gilan's governors after Shah Abbas I abolished the local dynasties in 1592. Cossack raiders under Stenka Razin sacked it in 1669, an earthquake levelled much of the city in 1714, and Russian troops held it from 1722 to 1732 during Peter the Great's Caspian campaign.
zh: 拉什特是里海沿岸多雨的吉兰低地的首要城市，早在682年的倭马亚文献中就有记载，10世纪的地理著作《世界境域志》已把它列为一个地区。14世纪时，它是吉兰西半部比亚帕斯的集镇，受定都附近富曼的逊尼派埃沙克万德王朝统治，并借安扎里港转运的生丝贸易致富。1572年，贾姆希德苏丹把比亚帕斯的都城从富曼迁到拉什特；1592年阿拔斯一世废除地方王朝后，它又成为吉兰总督的驻地。1669年，斯捷潘·拉辛率领的哥萨克袭掠了该城；1714年一场地震摧毁了大片城区；1722—1732年彼得大帝发动里海战役期间，俄军占领了拉什特。

en: The Principality of Rostov was a Rus' appanage principality centered on Rostov Veliky, on Lake Nero northeast of Moscow. One of the oldest towns of northeast Rus', Rostov was first recorded in 862 and had been the center of the Rostov-Suzdal land before Yuri Dolgorukiy moved his seat to Suzdal in 1125. In 1207 it became a separate principality for Konstantin, eldest son of Vsevolod the Big Nest of Vladimir, whose holdings also took in Beloozero, Uglich, Ustyug and Yaroslavl; after 1218 these lands were split among his sons. In 1238 the Mongols overran Rostov, and its prince Vasilko was captured and killed after the Battle of the Sit River. The city joined the anti-Tatar rising of 1262, yet its princes later kept unusually close ties with the Golden Horde. In 1328 the principality, and even the city itself, was divided between two princely lines, and one half had passed to Ivan I of Moscow by 1332. Moscow-backed princes took full control in the 1360s, in the days of Dmitry Donskoy, a Moscow governor sat in Rostov from 1433, and in 1474 Ivan III bought the remaining half from the last Rostov princes.
zh: 罗斯托夫公国是以莫斯科东北方涅罗湖畔的大罗斯托夫为中心的罗斯封邑公国。大罗斯托夫是东北罗斯最古老的城市之一，862年即见记载，曾是罗斯托夫-苏兹达尔领地的中心，1125年尤里·多尔戈鲁基把治所迁往苏兹达尔后，其政治地位开始下降。1207年，弗拉基米尔大公弗谢沃洛德（大窝）的长子康斯坦丁受封罗斯托夫，领地还包括别洛奥泽罗、乌格利奇、乌斯秋格和雅罗斯拉夫尔，罗斯托夫公国就此建立；1218年康斯坦丁死后，这些土地被他的儿子们瓜分。1238年蒙古人攻陷罗斯托夫，王公瓦西里科在锡季河战役后被俘遇害。1262年该城参加了反抗鞑靼人的起义，但此后罗斯托夫王公与金帐汗国保持着异乎寻常的密切关系。1328年，公国乃至罗斯托夫城本身被两支王族一分为二，其中一半到1332年已落入莫斯科的伊凡一世之手。14世纪60年代，在德米特里·顿斯科伊时代，得到莫斯科支持的王公完全掌权；1433年起罗斯托夫由莫斯科总督治理，1474年伊凡三世从末代罗斯托夫王公手中买下剩余的一半。

en: Ritzebüttel was a small lordship on the Lower Elbe near its mouth on the North Sea coast, in present-day Germany, held as a fief of the Dukes of Saxe-Lauenburg by the Lappe noble family. Around 1340 the Lappes built the brick residential tower that still forms the core of Ritzebüttel Castle, guarding the entrance to the Lower Elbe; the strongpoint also commanded a winter harbour and the sea lanes troubled by North Sea pirates. Disputes with the Hanseatic city of Hamburg led to a siege in 1393, and on 31 July 1394 the castle and its lands passed from the Lappes to Hamburg, which administered Ritzebüttel through its own bailiffs for the following centuries.
zh: 里策比特尔是北海沿岸、下易北河近入海口处的一处小领地，位于今德国境内，由拉佩贵族家族作为萨克森-劳恩堡公爵的封邑持有。约1340年，拉佩家族修建了砖砌居住塔楼，后来它一直是里策比特尔城堡的核心，扼守着下易北河的入口；这座要塞还控制着一处冬季港口和北海海盗出没的海路。与汉萨城市汉堡的争端引发了1393年的围攻，1394年7月31日，城堡及其领地从拉佩家族转入汉堡之手，此后数百年间汉堡均由自己的行政官治理里策比特尔。

en: The Ratnapura kingdom was the eastern branch of the Kalachuris, who also called themselves Haihaya, rulers of the old Chedi country. Around 1000 Kalinga-raja, a younger son of the Tripuri Kalachuri house, conquered Dakshina Kosala from the Somavamshi kings and fixed his capital at Tummana; his grandson Ratna-deva I founded the new city of Ratnapura, modern Ratanpur. Jajalla-deva I made the branch effectively independent and in 1114 invaded the Chindaka Naga lands and captured their king Somesvara, while Ratna-deva II formally threw off Tripuri rule and drove back an invasion by Anantavarman Chodaganga of the Eastern Gangas. The last well-attested early king, Pratapa-malla, ruled in the early thirteenth century, after which inscriptions fall silent until the reign of Vahara, known from records of 1494 and 1513, whom later rajas claimed as their ancestor. Ringed by steep hill ranges, the country was spared the Muslim invasions that swept northern India between the thirteenth and sixteenth centuries, and towards the end of the fourteenth century the house divided into Ratanpur and Raipur branches. The later rajas held out until 1740, when they accepted the suzerainty of the Maratha Bhonsles of Nagpur, who annexed the kingdom after the death of Mohan Singh about 1758.
zh: 拉特纳普勒王国是迦罗朱利人的东支，该家族自称诃伊诃耶，本是古老车底国的统治者。约1000年，特里普里迦罗朱利王室的幼子卡林伽拉杰从索马万什诸王手中征服南拘萨罗，定都图马纳；其孙拉特那·德瓦一世兴建新城拉特纳普拉，即今拉坦布尔。贾贾拉·德瓦一世使该支实际独立，并于1114年攻入钦达卡那伽人的土地，俘获其王索梅斯瓦拉；拉特那·德瓦二世则正式摆脱特里普里的宗主权，击退东恒伽王阿南塔瓦尔曼·乔达恒伽的入侵。早期最后一位有确凿记载的君主是13世纪初在位的普拉塔帕·马拉，此后碑铭长期空白，直到1494和1513年有铭文存世的瓦哈拉时期，后世拉贾都奉他为祖先。由于四周被陡峭山岭环绕，这片国土避开了13至16世纪席卷北印的穆斯林入侵；14世纪末，家族分裂为拉坦布尔和赖布尔两支。后期诸拉贾一直坚持到1740年，接受那格浦尔马拉塔邦斯勒家族的宗主权，后者又在莫汉·辛格约1758年去世后兼并了这个王国。

en: Ruppin was the lordship, later also styled a county, of the counts of Lindow-Ruppin, lying around Lake Ruppin in the Prignitz country of Brandenburg. The land had belonged to the Slavic Zamzizi tribe, whose island fort in the lake gave way to German rule after the Wendish Crusade of 1147 and to Flemish and Saxon settlement. Around 1214 Count Gebhard of Arnstein, a great-grandson of Albert the Bear, acquired the country between the Temnitz and Rhin rivers as a probably immediate fief, becoming the ancestor of the Lindow-Ruppin line. He built Castle Ruppin at Alt Ruppin and founded the trading settlement of Neuruppin, which received town rights in 1256, while his family endowed Cistercian and Dominican houses at Lindow and Neuruppin. From the late thirteenth century the lords called themselves counts, and in 1337 the ruler was Count Ulrich II, whose father Ulrich I had died in 1316 and who held the county until his own death in 1356. The lords steadily enlarged their territory, receiving Wusterhausen and Gransee as Brandenburg fiefs in 1349 and Neustadt in 1407, though the whole lordship had by then come under the overlordship of the margraves of Brandenburg. When Count Wichmann died without heirs in 1524, Elector Joachim I annexed Ruppin as a district of the Middle Mark; a kinsman's suit before the Imperial Chamber Court was dismissed in 1562.
zh: 鲁平是林多-鲁平伯爵家族的领地，13世纪末起也称作伯国，位于勃兰登堡普里格尼茨地区的鲁平湖一带。这里原是斯拉夫人扎姆齐齐部落的土地，他们在湖中小岛上建有堡寨；1147年文德十字军后，该地转入德意志统治，随后迎来佛兰德斯和萨克森移民。约1214年，大熊阿尔布雷希特的曾孙、阿恩施泰因伯爵格布哈特取得泰姆尼茨河与莱茵河之间的地区，受封一块很可能直属帝国的领地，成为林多-鲁平支系的始祖。他在旧鲁平修筑鲁平城堡，又兴建商业聚落新鲁平（1256年获得城市权），其家族还在林多和新鲁平捐建了西多会修女院与多明我会修道院。13世纪末起，领主们自称伯爵，1337年在位的是乌尔里希二世：其父乌尔里希一世卒于1316年，他本人统治到1356年去世。领地不断扩张，1349年武斯特豪森和格兰塞作为勃兰登堡封邑归入，1407年又得到诺伊施塔特，但此时整个领地已处于勃兰登堡藩侯的宗主权之下。1524年伯爵维希曼无嗣而终，选侯约阿希姆一世吞并鲁平，将其改为中马克的一个区；一位亲属向帝国宫廷法院提起的诉讼最终于1562年被驳回。

en: Rutul was the chief village of the Rutuls, a Northeast Caucasian people of the upper Samur river basin in southern Dagestan, whose ancestors had belonged to the tribal union of Caucasian Albania. Their villages formed a free society, the Rutul Magal, a federation of rural communities led by a hereditary bek who had to convene the popular assembly for important affairs. In 1536 the Rutuls attacked the Safavid stronghold of Akhty, and in 1542 they struck it again with the backing of the Quba Khanate; by the later sixteenth century, under the bek Gazibek, the federation corresponded on equal terms with the Ottoman sultan and the Safavid shah. In the seventeenth century it absorbed Tsakhur villages and ranked among the largest free societies of Dagestan, until the Russian Empire gained the region under the Treaty of Gulistan in 1813.
zh: 鲁图尔是鲁图尔人最主要的村镇。鲁图尔人是达吉斯坦南部萨穆尔河上游的东北高加索民族，先民曾臣属高加索阿尔巴尼亚的部落联盟。他们的村落组成自由公社鲁图尔马加尔，由世袭的伯克领导，遇有大事则须召集民众大会。1536年，鲁图尔人进攻萨法维王朝在南达吉斯坦的据点阿赫特，1542年又在库巴汗国支持下再度出击；16世纪后期伯克加齐别克当政时，这个联盟已能与奥斯曼苏丹和萨法维沙阿平等往来。17世纪，它兼并察胡尔人的村庄，跻身达吉斯坦最大的自由公社之列，直到1813年《古利斯坦条约》将该地区并入俄罗斯帝国。

en: Ravensburg lies at a ford of the Schussen on the old road between the Danube and Lake Constance. It grew up beneath a castle of the Welfs, who made it their ancestral seat in the eleventh century, and was first documented in 1088. On the extinction of the Hohenstaufen the town fell to the Empire, and in 1276 Emperor Rudolf I made it a Free Imperial City. Its merchant families, led by the Humpis, founded the Great Ravensburg Trading Society around 1380, which dealt in linen, paper, spices and Mediterranean wine through branches across Europe until its collapse in 1530. After the Reformation, Ravensburg became one of the four paritetic imperial cities, dividing all public offices equally between Catholics and Protestants, an arrangement confirmed by the Peace of Westphalia in 1648. The Thirty Years' War emptied and impoverished the town, and the mediatisation of 1803 assigned it to Bavaria; a territorial exchange gave it to Württemberg in 1810.
zh: 拉芬斯堡位于舒森河的一处渡口，扼守多瑙河与博登湖之间的古道。11世纪时，韦尔夫家族在镇旁山丘上修建城堡，并把这里作为祖传居所；城镇最早在1088年见于记载。霍亨斯陶芬家族绝嗣后，拉芬斯堡收归帝国，1276年皇帝鲁道夫一世将它立为帝国自由城市。以洪皮斯家族为首的商人世家约于1380年组建拉芬斯堡大贸易公司，经营亚麻、纸张、香料和地中海葡萄酒，分号遍及欧洲，直到1530年公司倒闭。宗教改革之后，拉芬斯堡成为四个实行两教平分制的帝国城市之一，一切公职由天主教徒和新教徒均分，这一安排在1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》中得到确认。三十年战争使人口锐减、城市凋敝；1803年陪臣化时它被划给巴伐利亚，1810年又经领土交换转归符腾堡。

en: The County of Ravensberg was an East Westphalian territory at the foot of the Teutoburg Forest, with Bielefeld as its chief town. Around 1100 the counts of Calvelage, previously seated near Vechta, acquired lands in the forest and built Ravensberg Castle; Count Otto I moved his seat there about 1140 and took the title count of Ravensberg. A partition in 1226 and the sale of the northern Emsland estates to the bishopric of Münster in 1252 confined the family to its East Westphalian lands, where Count Ludwig built Sparrenberg Castle above Bielefeld around 1250. The county then recovered steadily, recovering Vlotho and acquiring Limberg and, in 1334, Bünde. In 1337 it was ruled by Count Bernard, the last of his line, whose death in 1346 brought the county through his heiress Margaret to Gerhard of Jülich, from 1348 also count of Berg. Ravensberg was thereafter joined first with Berg, then with Jülich-Berg in 1437 and the United Duchies of Jülich-Cleves-Berg in 1521, and its people had turned entirely Lutheran by 1600. When that dynasty died out in 1609, the 1614 Treaty of Xanten assigned Ravensberg, Cleves and Mark to Brandenburg; from 1719 it was administered as Minden-Ravensberg, and Bielefeld grew rich on the linen trade. The county was absorbed into the Napoleonic Kingdom of Westphalia in 1807, returned to Prussia in 1813 and was dissolved into new Prussian districts in 1816.
zh: 拉芬斯贝格伯国是条顿堡林山脚下的东威斯特伐利亚领地，以比勒费尔德为首府。1100年前后，原本居住在费希塔一带的卡尔费拉格伯爵家族取得林区土地并修建拉芬斯贝格城堡；奥托一世约于1140年把治所迁到那里，改称拉芬斯贝格伯爵。1226年家族分家，1252年北方的埃姆斯兰领地被卖给明斯特主教区，家族势力遂收缩到东威斯特伐利亚；伯爵路德维希约于1250年在比勒费尔德上方修建施帕伦堡。此后伯国稳步恢复，重新取得弗洛托，又得到林贝格，并于1334年取得宾德。1337年在位的是伯爵贝尔纳德，他也是家族的最后一位男嗣，1346年去世后，伯国经由女继承人玛格丽特转给于利希家族的格哈德，后者1348年又成为贝格伯爵。拉芬斯贝格此后先与贝格联合，1437年并入于利希-贝格，1521年并入于利希-克莱沃-贝格联合公国；到1600年，当地居民已全部改宗路德宗。1609年该王朝绝嗣，1614年的《克桑滕条约》把拉芬斯贝格连同克莱沃、马克一起划归勃兰登堡；1719年起它与明登合组为明登-拉芬斯贝格行政区，比勒费尔德也靠亚麻贸易致富。1807年伯国被并入拿破仑的威斯特伐利亚王国，1813年回归普鲁士，1816年被拆分划入普鲁士新设的各县。

en: The Principality of Ryazan, later styled the Grand Principality of Ryazan, was the easternmost of the Russian principalities and kept its formal independence longer than any of them. It emerged by 1129 when the Murom-Ryazan land split from Chernigov under Yaroslav Sviatoslavich. Its first capital, Ryazan, was sacked and destroyed in the Mongol invasion of December 1237, the first Rus' city to fall to Batu Khan, and is remembered as Old Ryazan; the seat moved north to Pereyaslavl-Ryazansky, which later took the name Ryazan. In 1337 the throne belonged to Prince Ivan II Korotopol, who reigned from 1327 to 1342. In 1301 Prince Daniel of Moscow had already seized the city, and thereafter Ryazan balanced between Moscow, the Golden Horde and Lithuania: Prince Oleg II was defeated by the Muscovites at Skornishchevo in 1371 and stood aside at Kulikovo in 1380. Its long feud with its appanage of Pronsk ended when Ryazan annexed it in 1483. In 1520 Vasili III imprisoned the last Ryazan prince, Ivan Ivanovich, and in 1521 the principality was incorporated into Muscovy.
zh: 梁赞公国，后称梁赞大公国，是罗斯诸公国中位置最东、正式独立时间也最长的一个。它在1129年前后随穆罗姆-梁赞领地在雅罗斯拉夫·斯维亚托斯拉维奇治下脱离切尔尼戈夫而形成。最初的都城梁赞在1237年12月蒙古入侵时被洗劫摧毁，成为拔都汗攻陷的第一座罗斯城市，旧城后来被称为旧梁赞；都城北迁至佩列亚斯拉夫尔-梁赞斯基，该城后来沿用了梁赞之名。1337年在位的是伊凡二世·科罗托波尔，他于1327至1342年统治梁赞。早在1301年莫斯科王公丹尼尔就曾攻占该城，此后梁赞在莫斯科、金帐汗国和立陶宛之间周旋：奥列格二世于1371年在斯科尔尼谢沃被莫斯科人击败，1380年又在库里科沃战役中按兵不动。它与封邑普龙斯克的长期争斗以1483年兼并普龙斯克告终。1520年瓦西里三世囚禁末代梁赞王公伊凡·伊凡诺维奇，1521年公国并入莫斯科国。

en: The Principality of Rylsk was a small Rurikovich appanage of the Seim region, centered on Rylsk, a Siverian town first mentioned in the chronicles in 1152; its princely table appeared in the 1160s as an appanage of Novgorod-Seversk. Its first prince, Svyatoslav Olgovich, fought the Cumans in 1183 and was captured in the great defeat of 1185 told in The Tale of Igor's Campaign. The Mongols stormed the town around 1240 and killed two of its princes later in that decade; in the 1280s its prince Oleg was ruined together with his ally of Lipovichi after resisting a Horde tax collector, when Nogai's Tatars ravaged the Seim lands, after which both princes were killed in a feud among the princes. In the 1350s and 1360s Rylsk passed to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, in whose service its prince Fyodor Patrikeevich died at the battle of the Vorskla in 1399. In 1454 Casimir IV granted Rylsk together with Novgorod-Seversk to the fugitive Ivan Shemyakin; his son Vasily submitted to Ivan III in 1500, and in 1523 Vasily was arrested and the appanage abolished.
zh: 雷利斯克公国是谢伊姆河流域的留里克王朝小封邑，以雷利斯克为中心；这座谢韦里亚城镇最早在1152年见于编年史，12世纪60年代出现王公席位，是诺夫霍罗德-西韦尔斯基的封邑之一。首任王公斯维亚托斯拉夫·奥利戈维奇曾在1183年出征波洛伏齐人，并在1185年的惨败中被俘，《伊戈尔远征记》记述了这场战役。1240年前后蒙古人猛攻该城，那十年间又有两位雷利斯克王公被杀；13世纪80年代，王公奥列格因抗拒金帐汗国征税官，与利波维奇王公一同遭到那海的鞑靼军队洗劫，两人随后在诸王公的内讧中丧命。14世纪50至60年代，雷利斯克并入立陶宛大公国；1399年，为立陶宛效力的雷利斯克王公费奥多尔·帕特里克耶维奇战死在沃尔斯克拉河战役。1454年，卡齐米日四世把雷利斯克和诺夫霍罗德-西韦尔斯基一同封给流亡的伊凡·舍米亚金；其子瓦西里于1500年归顺伊凡三世，1523年瓦西里被捕，封邑被撤销。

en: Ratzeburg was a prince-bishopric of the Holy Roman Empire, seated on its island cathedral town between the lakes of westernmost Mecklenburg. A first diocese was carved out of the Oldenburg see around 1060 by Archbishop Adalbert of Bremen, but perished in the Obodrite rising of 1066, when the monk Ansverus was stoned to death. The see was re-founded in 1154 under Duke Henry the Lion, who installed the Premonstratensian Evermod as its bishop; Pope Hadrian IV confirmed the foundation in 1158, and the Romanesque cathedral was built from 1170. After the old comital line died out the bishops acquired the local advocacies, and from about 1230 they sat as imperial princes over the Hochstift, which joined the Lower Saxon Circle in 1500. In 1337 the see was held by Bishop Volrad von dem Dorne, who occupied it until his death in 1355. The Reformation ended the Catholic diocese: the chapter turned Protestant and the bishopric was secularised, being formally suppressed in 1554.
zh: 拉策堡是神圣罗马帝国的一个主教采邑，主教座堂所在的城镇坐落在梅克伦堡西端的湖泊之间、四面环水。最早的教区于1060年前后由不来梅大主教阿达尔贝特从奥尔登堡教区划出，但在1066年的奥博特里特人起义中覆灭，修士安斯韦鲁斯被乱石砸死。1154年，狮子亨利公爵重建教区，任命普雷蒙特雷修会的埃弗莫德为主教；教皇哈德良四世于1158年批准建区，罗马式主教座堂自1170年起兴建。旧伯爵家族绝嗣后，主教们取得了当地的代管权，约1230年起以帝国诸侯身份统治主教采邑，该采邑于1500年加入下萨克森行政圈。1337年在位的是福尔拉德·冯·德姆·多恩主教，他一直任职到1355年去世。宗教改革终结了这个天主教教区：圣职团改宗新教，主教区被世俗化，并于1554年正式撤销。

en: The Principality of Rzhev was a small Rus' appanage centered on the uppermost Volga town of Rzhev, whose fortress and trade route made it a bone of contention between Smolensk, Novgorod, Tver, Moscow and Lithuania. First chronicled in 1216, it had belonged to the Toropets branch of the Smolensk dynasty before passing, late in the thirteenth century, to the Fominsky princes. In 1314 its prince Fyodor Yuryevich served the Moscow prince Yuri Danilovich in Novgorod; the following year the grand prince Mikhail of Tver captured him near Torzhok and confiscated the appanage, after which Rzhev came under the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. The town changed hands repeatedly: Algirdas of Lithuania seized it in 1356, Moscow retook it in 1358 and again in 1368, and it passed back and forth until the time of Dmitry Donskoy. In the fifteenth century it was held in turn by Serpukhov princes, Dmitry Shemyaka and the princes of Tver, and in 1521 it was finally incorporated into Moscow when its ruling line died out.
zh: 勒热夫公国是以伏尔加河最上游城镇勒热夫为中心的罗斯小封邑。这座要塞扼守商路，长期是斯摩棱斯克、诺夫哥罗德、特维尔、莫斯科和立陶宛争夺的对象。它1216年首见编年史记载，原属斯摩棱斯克王朝的托罗佩茨支系，13世纪末转入福明斯克王公之手。1314年，王公费奥多尔·尤里耶维奇随莫斯科王公尤里·丹尼洛维奇出征诺夫哥罗德；次年特维尔大公米哈伊尔在托尔若克附近将他俘获并没收封邑，勒热夫此后归入立陶宛大公国。该城此后反复易手：立陶宛的阿尔吉尔达斯于1356年攻占它，莫斯科于1358年、1368年两度夺回，直到德米特里·顿斯科伊时代归属才逐渐稳定。15世纪，它又先后由谢尔普霍夫王公、德米特里·舍米亚卡和特维尔王公领有，1521年因统治支系绝嗣，最终并入莫斯科。

en: The County of Saarbrücken, on the Saar in Upper Lorraine, began around 1080, when King Henry IV enfeoffed Count Siegbert of the Saargau with the old Carolingian palace at Wadgassen and surrounding estates; in 1118 Siegbert's son Frederick first styled himself count of Saarbrücken. Barbarossa slighted the comital residence in 1168, and about 1183 a partition hived off the Palatinate lands as the County of Zweibrücken. The counts were loyal Hohenstaufen men: Simon III joined the Fifth Crusade, and when he left no son the county passed through his daughters, the second of whom, Mathilda, married Simon of Commercy in 1271, bringing in the Broyes-Commercy dynasty that ruled in 1337 under Count John I. A vassal of the dukes of Lorraine, John followed Emperor Henry VII to Italy and fought on the French side in the Hundred Years' War; Saarbrücken town received its privileges in 1322. John II was captured beside King John of France at Poitiers in 1356 and held in England until 1360, and with his death in 1381 the line failed. His daughter had married a count of Nassau-Weilburg, so Saarbrücken passed to the House of Nassau, under whom it was repeatedly divided until French troops occupied it in 1793 and annexed it to the Sarre department in 1797.
zh: 萨尔布吕肯伯国位于上洛林的萨尔河畔，始于1080年前后：国王亨利四世把瓦德加森的加洛林旧行宫及周边地产封给萨尔高伯爵西格贝特；1118年，西格贝特之子腓特烈首次自称萨尔布吕肯伯爵。1168年巴巴罗萨拆毁了伯爵的宅邸，约1183年的一次分家又把普法尔茨领地划出，另立茨魏布吕肯伯国。历代伯爵都是霍亨斯陶芬的忠仆：西蒙三世参加过第五次十字军，他没有儿子，伯国由女儿们继承；次女玛蒂尔德1271年嫁给科梅尔西的西蒙，带来了布罗瓦—科梅尔西王朝，1337年在位的约翰一世就出自这一家族。作为洛林公爵的附庸，约翰曾随皇帝亨利七世远征意大利，并在百年战争中站在法国一边作战；萨尔布吕肯城于1322年获得城市特权。约翰二世1356年在普瓦捷战役中和法王约翰二世一起被俘，关押在英格兰直到1360年；他1381年去世后家族男系断绝。由于其女儿嫁给了拿骚—魏尔堡伯爵，萨尔布吕肯转入拿骚家族，此后几经分合，1793年被法国军队占领，1797年并入萨尔省。

en: Sausenberg was a lordship in the far south-west of the Holy Roman Empire, in the Markgräflerland country between Freiburg and Basel, with its seat at Sausenburg Castle above Kandern. The land first belonged to the Benedictine abbey of St Blaise, until the counts of Hachberg bought it in 1232 and built the castle to guard it. In 1306 the Hachberg inheritance was divided and the ruling branch took the title of margraves of Hachberg-Sausenberg, a cadet line of the house of Baden and Zähringen. In 1316 the margraves inherited the nearby lordship of Rötteln and moved their residence there, leaving vogts to hold the Sausenberg, and in 1444 they added Badenweiler, the three lands forming the Markgräflerland. The last margrave, Philip, died without sons in 1503, and Sausenberg passed by inheritance to Christopher I of Baden. Its castle was destroyed by French troops in 1678 during the Franco-Dutch War.
zh: 绍森贝格是神圣罗马帝国西南端的一块领地，地处弗赖堡与巴塞尔之间的马克格雷夫勒兰，统治中心是坎德恩上方的绍森堡。这片土地原属圣布拉辛的本笃会修道院，1232年被哈赫贝格伯爵购得并建堡镇守。1306年哈赫贝格分家，统治支系称哈赫贝格-绍森贝格藩侯，是巴登及策林根家族的旁支。1316年藩侯家族继承邻近的勒特伦领地并迁居那里，留下地方代理官看守绍森贝格；1444年又取得巴登韦勒，三块领地合为马克格雷夫勒兰。末代藩侯菲利普于1503年去世且无子，绍森贝格随继承归于巴登藩侯克里斯托夫一世。绍森堡则在1678年法荷战争中被法军摧毁。

en: The Sagaing kingdom was a small Upper Burmese state that existed from 1315 to 1365, ruled by a junior branch of the Myinsaing dynasty from its capital on the Irrawaddy opposite later Ava. Its territory covered the Mu valley, one of the three great granaries of the Irrawaddy basin, and began as the northern province of Pinya. In 1315 the young prince Saw Yun, son of King Thihathu, left the Pinya court and fought his father to a standstill, winning autonomy by 1317; after Thihathu's death Sagaing formally seceded in 1325. Its survival for four decades owed much to Pinya's own divisions, while Sagaing's court was itself dominated by the chief minister Nanda Pakyan, who manipulated a series of weak kings from the mid-1330s to the 1350s. In the 1350s Princess Soe Min repaired relations with Pinya to face the rising Shan state of Maw. Sagaing took the brunt of the Maw invasions of 1356 to 1364, and in 1364 Maw troops sacked the city before going on to sack Pinya. Saw Yun's grandson Thado Minbya then seized both ruined capitals and in 1365 founded the Ava kingdom.
zh: 实皆王国是1315年至1365年间存在于上缅甸的一个小邦，由敏象王朝的旁支统治，都城位于伊洛瓦底江畔，与后来的阿瓦城隔河相望。其领土涵盖伊洛瓦底流域三大粮仓之一的穆河谷，最初是彬牙王国的北方省份。1315年，底哈都王之子、年轻的苏云王子离开彬牙宫廷，举兵与父王对抗，至1317年取得自治；底哈都死后，实皆于1325年正式独立。它能立国四十年，很大程度上靠的是彬牙自身的分裂，而实皆宫廷也由首相南达巴坚把持，1330年代中期至1350年代间连立数位弱主。1350年代，索敏公主修复了与彬牙的关系，两国共同对付崛起的掸人政权麓川。1356年至1364年麓川屡次入侵上缅甸，实皆首当其冲，1364年麓川军队洗劫实皆城，继而攻陷彬牙。苏云之孙德多明帕耶随即夺取两座残破都城，于1365年建立阿瓦王国。

en: The Marquisate of Saluzzo was a small Piedmontese state wedged between the Alps, the Po and the Stura di Demonte, on the lands Rome wrested from the Ligurian Vagienni around 125 BC. In the Carolingian age the hill town was a count's seat, and in 1142 Manfred I, son of Boniface del Vasto, became its first marquis on the partition of the mark of Susa. The del Vasto dynasty held Saluzzo from 1142 to 1548, repeatedly clashing with the expanding counts of Savoy, whose claims were bolstered by tributes imposed after Manfred II's death. The fifteenth century was its golden age: Ludovico I, ruling from 1416 to 1475, kept a neutral course and mediated between the Italian powers, while Ludovico II drove the Buco di Viso tunnel through Monte Viso to open a safe road to the Dauphiné and Provence. He withstood a Savoyard siege in 1486 with French help, yielded in 1487 and returned to power in 1490. Succession quarrels after his death weakened the state, and in 1548 France deposed the last marquis, Gabriele, and annexed Saluzzo. Savoyard troops occupied it in 1588 and the Treaty of Lyon in 1601 confirmed its transfer to the House of Savoy. Boccaccio set the tale of Griselda in the marquisate.
zh: 萨卢佐侯国是皮埃蒙特的小邦，夹在阿尔卑斯山、波河与斯图拉迪德蒙特河之间，其地约在公元前125年被罗马人从利古里亚人的瓦吉恩人手中夺占。加洛林时代这座山城是伯爵驻地，1142年博尼法乔·德尔·瓦斯托之子曼弗雷德一世在苏萨边区分封时成为第一代侯爵。德尔·瓦斯托王朝从1142年统治到1548年，不断与扩张中的萨伏依伯爵冲突；曼弗雷德二世死后其遗孀被迫缴纳的贡赋，更成为萨伏依家族宗主权要求的依据。15世纪是萨卢佐的黄金时代：卢多维科一世在1416—1475年间保持中立，在意大利诸强之间充当调停人；卢多维科二世则开凿穿过蒙维索山的维索隧道，打通了通往多菲内和普罗旺斯的安全商道。他在法国援助下于1486年顶住萨伏依的围攻，1487年屈服后流亡法国，1490年重新掌权。他死后的继承纷争削弱了国势，1548年法国废黜末代侯爵加布里埃莱并吞并萨卢佐。1588年萨伏依军队占领该地，1601年的《里昂条约》确认把它划归萨伏依家族。薄伽丘笔下格里塞尔达的故事就以这个侯国为背景。

en: The Samoan islands of Savaiʻi, Upolu and Tutuila were among the earliest homes of Polynesian culture: Lapita pottery shows settlers arrived around 1500 to 900 BCE, and the oldest chiefly title in Polynesia, the Tui Manuʻa of the eastern Manuʻa islands, headed a maritime confederacy whose trade and genealogical reach stretched toward Fiji, Tonga and Rarotonga. As that power waned, the rising Tuʻi Tonga Empire drew Savaiʻi, Upolu and Tutuila under its rule for some four centuries after about 950, while Manuʻa itself was left untouched as a sacred land. Tradition dates the Samoan revolt to about 1250, when the brothers Tuna, Fata and Savea drove out the Tuʻi Tonga Talakaifaiki; Savea took the new paramount title Malietoa, named from the fleeing king's praise, mālie toa, or brave warrior, and his order ruled western Samoa unchallenged for nearly three hundred years. The warrior queen Nafanua and her niece Salamasina then shaped the faʻamatai, the decentralized system of family and village chiefs that remained the backbone of Samoan society. The Dutchman Jacob Roggeveen sighted the islands in 1722 and Bougainville named them the Navigator Islands in 1768, but contact stayed thin until 1830, when the missionary John Williams landed and Malietoa Vainuʻupo opened Samoa to Christianity.
zh: 萨摩亚的萨瓦伊、乌波卢和图图伊拉诸岛是波利尼西亚文化最早的摇篮之一：拉皮塔陶器表明，定居者约在公元前1500至前900年就已抵达；波利尼西亚最古老的酋长头衔——东部马努阿群岛的图伊马努阿——统领着一个海上邦联，其贸易与血缘网络远及斐济、汤加和拉罗汤加。随着这一势力衰落，南方新兴的图伊汤加帝国在950年前后将萨瓦伊、乌波卢和图图伊拉纳入统治，前后约四百年，唯有马努阿因被视为圣地而未遭占领。传说约在1250年，图纳、法塔和萨韦亚三兄弟起义，赶走图伊汤加塔拉凯法伊基；萨韦亚采用新的最高头衔马列托亚，名字取自败退国王称赞他们“勇武善战”之语，他建立的秩序在西萨摩亚维系了近三百年无人挑战。此后，武士女王纳法努阿和她的侄女萨拉马西娜奠定了法阿马泰，即家族与村落酋长分权的制度，它一直是萨摩亚社会的主干。荷兰人罗赫芬于1722年望见群岛，布干维尔在1768年将其命名为航海家群岛，但外界接触始终不多；直到1830年传教士约翰·威廉斯登岛，马列托亚·瓦伊努乌波接纳基督教，萨摩亚的大门才真正打开。

en: The County of Sancerre was a small fief in Upper Berry, centred on a fortified hilltown above the Loire. In 1152 it was granted to Stephen, a younger son of the count of Champagne, whose descendants, a cadet branch of the House of Blois, ruled it as counts. Stephen gave the townsmen the Customs of Lorris in 1155, one of the most liberal town charters of the Capetian kingdom, and in 1190 he was among the first French lords to abolish serfdom on his lands. In 1337 the count was Louis II, born around 1305, who had succeeded his father John II in 1326 and confirmed the town's customs in 1327; he was killed fighting the English at the Battle of Crécy on 26 August 1346. His younger son Louis of Sancerre rose to become constable of France. The county twice repelled English assaults during the Hundred Years' War, endured an eight-month siege as a Huguenot stronghold in 1572 and 1573 during the Wars of Religion, and was sold in 1637 to Henry II of Bourbon, prince of Condé.
zh: 桑塞尔伯国是上贝里的小封地，以卢瓦尔河畔一座设防山城为中心。1152年，香槟伯爵的幼子艾蒂安受封于此，他的后裔作为布卢瓦家族的旁支世代承袭伯爵。艾蒂安于1155年向市民颁赐《洛里斯惯例》，这是卡佩王国最开明的城市特许状之一；1190年，他又成为法国最早在领地废除农奴制的领主之一。1337年在位的路易二世约生于1305年，1326年继承父亲让二世之位，并在1327年确认了城市惯例；1346年8月26日，他在克雷西战役中与英军作战时阵亡。他的幼子桑塞尔的路易后来官至法兰西统帅。百年战争中桑塞尔两次击退英军进攻；宗教战争期间，它作为胡格诺据点在1572—1573年坚守了八个月的围攻，1637年伯国被卖给孔代亲王亨利二世·德·波旁。

en: The Lordship of Salona was a Crusader state in central Greece, built around the fortress town of Salona, present-day Amfissa beneath Mount Parnassus. In 1205 Boniface of Montferrat, King of Thessalonica, appointed Thomas I d'Autremencourt as its first lord. After a brief occupation by the Despotate of Epirus around 1210 to 1212, Salona became a vassal of the Principality of Achaea and later of the Duchy of Athens. The last French lord, Thomas III, was killed at the Battle of the Cephissus in 1311, and after the Catalan Company's victory the fief passed in 1318 to Alfonso Fadrique, who took the title Count of Salona. In 1337 the count was still Alfonso Fadrique, ruling within the Catalan Duchy of Neopatras. Navarrese troops overran the county in 1380, and under the unpopular regency of Helena Asanina Kantakouzene the townsmen opened their gates to Sultan Bayezid I in 1394. The Despotate of the Morea held it briefly after 1402 and sold Salona to the Knights Hospitaller in 1404, but the Ottomans conquered it for good in 1410.
zh: 萨洛纳领地是希腊中部的十字军国家，以帕纳索斯山下的要塞城镇萨洛纳（今安菲萨）为中心。1205年，萨洛尼卡国王蒙费拉托的博尼法乔任命托马斯一世·德·奥特勒芒古为首任领主。1210至1212年前后遭伊庇鲁斯专制国短暂占领后，萨洛纳成为亚该亚侯国的附庸，后来又依附雅典公国。末代法国领主托马斯三世在1311年的凯菲索斯河战役中阵亡，加泰罗尼亚佣兵团获胜后，封邑于1318年转入阿方索·法德里克之手，他自称萨洛纳伯爵。1337年在任的仍是阿方索·法德里克，作为加泰罗尼亚人新帕特拉斯公国的封臣统治此地。1380年纳瓦拉军队攻占伯国；在不得人心的海伦娜·阿萨妮娜·坎塔库泽娜摄政期间，城镇居民于1394年向苏丹巴耶济德一世开城。1402年后它一度落入摩里亚专制国之手，1404年被卖给医院骑士团，最终于1410年被奥斯曼人永久征服。

en: The County of Savoy grew from the Alpine fiefs of Humbert the White-Handed, whom King Rudolph III of Burgundy raised to count in 1003. Humbert's son Otto married Adelaide, heiress of the March of Turin, in 1046, joining the Piedmontese lowlands to the mountain counties of Aosta, Maurienne and Chablais; the counts inherited Vaud in 1218, and Thomas I took Chambéry in 1220, which became their capital. Amadeus VII bought an outlet to the Mediterranean with the County of Nice in 1388, and in 1337 the county, ruled from Chambéry by Count Aymon, stood at the head of a cluster of Alpine vassals. His successor Amadeus VIII purchased Geneva in 1401 and was raised to duke by Emperor Sigismund in 1416. French pressure long overshadowed the duchy: Francis I's troops occupied it in 1536 and held Turin until the Peace of Cateau-Cambrésis in 1559, after which Emmanuel Philibert moved the capital to Turin in 1562 and built a standing army. The Treaty of Lyon added Saluzzo in 1601, and in 1706 Prince Eugene relieved the French siege of Turin during the War of the Spanish Succession. Victor Amadeus II received the Kingdom of Sicily in 1713 and exchanged it for Sardinia in 1720, creating the Kingdom of Sardinia ruled from Turin. Revolutionary France annexed Savoy in 1792, and the Congress of Vienna restored the dynasty's Alpine lands in 1814 and 1815.
zh: 萨伏依伯国源自白手翁贝托的阿尔卑斯封地，1003年勃艮第国王鲁道夫三世封他为伯爵。1046年翁贝托之子奥托与图林边区女继承人阿德莱德成婚，把皮埃蒙特低地与奥斯塔、莫里耶讷、沙布莱等山区伯国连为一体；1218年伯爵们继承了沃地区，1220年托马索一世夺取尚贝里，后来这里成为都城。1388年阿梅迪奥七世取得尼斯伯国，获得通向地中海的出口；1337年时，这个由伯爵海莫从尚贝里统治的伯国，正统辖着一群阿尔卑斯附庸。继任者阿梅迪奥八世于1401年买下日内瓦，1416年被皇帝西吉斯蒙德升格为公爵。法国的压力长期笼罩公国：1536年弗朗索瓦一世的军队占领萨伏依并据守都灵，直到1559年《卡托-康布雷西和约》才恢复独立；此后埃马努埃莱·菲利贝托于1562年把都城迁至都灵，并建立常备军。1601年《里昂条约》为它增添了萨卢佐，1706年西班牙王位继承战争期间，欧根亲王解了都灵之围。维托里奥·阿梅迪奥二世于1713年获得西西里王国，1720年以西西里换得撒丁岛，建立起以都灵为中心的撒丁王国。1792年革命法国吞并萨伏依，1814—1815年的维也纳会议恢复了该王朝的阿尔卑斯领地。

en: The County of Saarwerden was a mediate fief of the Holy Roman Empire in Lorraine, straddling the river Saar around its capital of Bockenheim. It was created in 1111 when the lord Friedrich, son of Godfrey I of Blieskastel, detached his lands from the Bishopric of Metz; Friedrich built his castle on the ruins of a Roman bath and, with his wife Gertrude, founded Wörschweiler Abbey in 1130. The house's most famous son was Frederick III of Saarwerden, Archbishop of Cologne from 1370 to 1414, who after the death of his childless brother Henry II in 1397 briefly governed the county before passing it to his stepbrother, the Count of Moers. When the Moers-Saarwerden line died out, Johann Ludwig of Nassau-Saarbrücken inherited the lands through his wife, Countess Katharina, in 1527. Count Adolf introduced the Reformation in 1556 and settled French-speaking Calvinist refugees in the so-called Seven Gallic Villages alongside the Lutheran German population. The county was seized by Lorraine during the Thirty Years' War and restored to Nassau by the Peace of Westphalia, after which the counts abandoned Bockenheim and built a new capital at Neu-Saarwerden. Once Lorraine itself was annexed by France in 1766, Saarwerden became an imperial enclave, until French revolutionary troops occupied it and it passed to France as the Sarrewerden district in 1793.
zh: 萨尔韦尔登伯国是神圣罗马帝国在洛林的一块非直属封邑，横跨萨尔河，以博肯海姆为治所。1111年，布利斯卡斯特尔的戈特弗里德一世之子领主腓特烈把自己的领地从梅斯主教区划出，伯国由此建立；腓特烈在一处罗马浴场废墟上修建城堡，并于1130年与妻子格特鲁德共同创办沃尔施韦勒修道院。家族最著名的成员是萨尔韦尔登的腓特烈三世，他在1370至1414年间担任科隆大主教；1397年他无嗣的弟弟亨利二世去世后，他曾短暂掌管伯国，随后把治理权交给同母异父的弟弟默尔斯伯爵。默尔斯-萨尔韦尔登支系绝嗣后，拿骚-萨尔布吕肯的约翰·路德维希于1527年凭借妻子卡塔琳娜女伯爵的权利继承了这些领地。1556年，阿道夫伯爵推行宗教改革，安置讲法语的加尔文宗难民，在信奉路德宗的德意志居民之外建立了所谓“七个高卢村庄”。三十年战争期间伯国被洛林占领，《威斯特伐利亚和约》又把它归还拿骚；此后伯爵们放弃博肯海姆，在新萨尔韦尔登营建新治所。1766年洛林本身被法国吞并后，萨尔韦尔登沦为帝国的飞地，最终被法国革命军队占领，于1793年作为萨尔韦尔登县区并入法国。

en: Sayollan, a Nahuatl name meaning the place where flies abound, was the polity centred on Sayula in the salt-lake country of southern Xalisco, in modern Jalisco. Together with Tapalpa it formed the señorío ruled by the cacique Cuantoma, who paid tribute to the king of Colima. When the Purépecha cazonci invaded in 1480 to seize the region's saltpeter workings, the long Saltpeter War began. Cuantoma fought as an ally of Colima, was defeated at Acatlán, but struck back to win a victory at Zacoalco with Xaliscan troops led by the Tepic lord Moz. He died in 1502, after which Sayula became a vassal lordship of the Purépecha Empire, and in 1519 it passed into the orbit of the Kingdom of Xalisco on the eve of the Spanish arrival.
zh: 萨约兰的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“苍蝇繁盛之地”，是以萨尤拉为中心的小邦，地处今哈利斯科州南部的盐湖地带。它与塔帕尔帕共同组成首领宽托马统治的领地，向科利马国王纳贡。1480年，普雷佩查的卡松奇为夺取当地的硝石矿而出兵，漫长的硝石战争就此爆发。宽托马作为科利马的盟友参战，在阿卡特兰战败，但又依靠特皮克首领莫斯率领的哈利斯科军队，在萨科阿尔科赢得一场胜利。他于1502年去世，萨尤拉随后沦为普雷佩查帝国的附庸领地，1519年又在西班牙人到来前夕转入哈利斯科王国的势力范围。

en: Santubong was a trading kingdom at the mouth of the Sarawak River on the north-west Borneo coast, beneath the mountain that still bears its name. Excavations show a busy port from the seventh to the fourteenth century, where Chinese ceramics, Hindu images and some forty thousand tonnes of iron slag reveal workshops feeding the China trade. A local chronicle, the Hikayat Datuk Merpati, traces its rulers to Datuk Merpati, said to have come from Java, and his son Merpati Jepang. When Majapahit expanded into Borneo around 1350, Santubong's trade withered and the port was abandoned, its people moving inland to Gedong and the Sadong River; the Nagarakretagama of 1365 records the area as Sawaku. By 1530 Portuguese mapmakers knew the bay as Cerava, one of the five great ports of Borneo, as it passed under the widening sway of Brunei.
zh: 山都望是婆罗洲西北海岸砂拉越河口的贸易王国，背倚同名山峰。考古发掘显示，7至14世纪这里是繁忙港口，出土的中国瓷器、印度教造像和约四万吨铁渣，表明当地有服务对华贸易的手工业。地方编年史《拿督·梅尔帕蒂传》把其统治者追溯到据说来自爪哇的拿督·梅尔帕蒂及其子梅尔帕蒂·日邦。约1350年满者伯夷势力进入婆罗洲后，山都望的贸易衰落、港口废弃，居民迁往内陆的格东和沙东河一带；1365年的《爪哇史颂》把这一地区记作沙瓦库。到1530年，葡萄牙制图师已把这个海湾称作塞拉瓦，列为婆罗洲五大港之一，其时它正落入日益扩张的文莱势力范围。

en: The Balliol regime was the Scottish kingship claimed by Edward Balliol, son of John Balliol, who had ruled as King of Scots from 1292 until he abdicated under English pressure in 1296. The family came from Bailleul in Picardy and held Barnard Castle in northern England. After Robert the Bruce took the crown in 1306 and died in 1329, leaving the child David II on the throne, Edward Balliol invaded in 1332 together with the Disinherited, nobles whose Scottish lands had been forfeited. He defeated the regent at Dupplin Moor on 11 August 1332 and was crowned at Scone on 24 September, but was driven out after a surprise attack at Annan. Restored with the open help of Edward III, he took Berwick after Halidon Hill in 1333, and by the Treaty of Newcastle in 1334 ceded Lothian to England and did homage to Edward III. The defeat of his lieutenant Strathbogie at Culblean in November 1335 broke his cause, and by 1338 he held little beyond English-garrisoned strongholds; in 1337 his court still sat at Perth. After David II was captured at Neville's Cross in 1346, Balliol returned and kept part of Galloway until 1355. In January 1356 he surrendered his claim to Edward III in return for a pension of two thousand pounds a year, and died childless in 1364, the last of his line.
zh: 巴利奥尔政权是爱德华·巴里奥所主张的苏格兰王权。爱德华是约翰·巴里奥之子，后者于1292年被推举为苏格兰国王，1296年在英格兰压力下退位。巴利奥尔家族来自皮卡第的巴约勒，在英格兰北方领有巴纳德城堡。罗伯特·布鲁斯于1306年夺取王位，1329年去世后由幼子大卫二世继位；1332年，爱德华·巴里奥联合被没收苏格兰领地的‘被剥夺者’贵族入侵，8月11日在杜普林沼地击败摄政，9月24日在斯昆加冕，却在安嫩遭突袭后被逐。他在爱德华三世公开支持下复位，1333年哈利顿山之战后取得贝里克，又依1334年的《纽卡斯尔条约》割让洛锡安并向爱德华三世称臣。1335年11月，他的部将斯特拉斯博吉在科尔布伦战败，巴里奥的事业由此瓦解，到1338年只剩英格兰驻军把守的据点；1337年时他的朝廷仍设在珀斯。1346年大卫二世在内维尔十字之战被俘后，巴里奥重返苏格兰，占据加洛韦的一部分直到1355年。1356年1月，他以每年两千英镑年金为代价，把王位主张让给爱德华三世，1364年无嗣而终，家族直系就此断绝。

en: Selimbau was a Hindu river kingdom on the upper Kapuas in what is now Kapuas Hulu Regency of West Kalimantan, its town standing about two kilometres from the later district centre of the same name. Local tradition remembers it first as the kingdom of Pelembang, founded by Sri Paduka Maharaja Bindu Mahkota, and calls it the oldest Hindu kingdom in West Kalimantan, with a fully ranked court and a line of twenty-five rulers descending from its founder's queen, Ratu Sri Batara. In 1337 it was one of several Hindu principalities strung along the upper Kapuas, among them the neighbouring kingdom of Silat. Its rulers eventually converted to Islam, and in 1823 Selimbau contracted its first treaty with the Dutch, by which time its war parties had carried its power from the upper Silat to the headwaters of the Kapuas and north towards the Sarawak border.
zh: 塞林包是卡普阿斯河上游的印度教河域王国，位于今天印度尼西亚西加里曼丹省上卡普阿斯县境内，其王城距后来的同名县城约两公里。当地传说它最初称珀莱邦王国，由斯里·帕杜卡·摩诃罗阇·宾杜·马科塔建立，被视为西加里曼丹最古老的印度教王国，朝仪等级完备，自王后拉图·斯里·巴塔拉以下传了二十五代统治者。1337年时，它是卡普阿斯河上游一连串印度教小邦之一，邻邦中有锡拉特王国。塞林包的统治者最终改宗伊斯兰教，并于1823年与荷兰人订立第一份条约；此时其武力已从锡拉特河上游扩张到卡普阿斯河源头，北抵砂拉越边界一带。

en: The Subay are an Adnanite Arab tribe of the Najd, belonging to the Hawazin and Mudar line and tracing their descent to the Banu Amir ibn Sa'sa'a, the great tribal grouping that dominated central Arabia in the medieval period. Long accustomed to both desert and town life, the tribe has a nomadic section whose original grazing grounds were the country around Ranyah and Kurmah on the Najd-Asir border, and who later roamed the central Najd around Riyadh alongside their kinsmen the Suhool, with one group pushing north to found the town of Rumah; its settled clans have lived in the towns of central Arabia for centuries and make up a large share of their traditional population. In the 1600s a Subay dynasty, the Al Sulaim, ruled the trading town of Unaizah in al-Qasem. The tribe also marched with the Al Saud: after the Ottoman invasion of 1818 it pressed into the weakening Bani Khalid's desert lands, and in 1830 Subay and Saudi forces fought the battle that brought Bani Khalid rule in al-Hasa to an end.
zh: 苏拜是内志的阿德南系阿拉伯部落，属哈瓦津与穆达尔支脉，血统上溯到巴努·阿米尔·本·萨阿萨，即中世纪称雄阿拉伯中部的庞大部落群。他们久已习惯沙漠与城镇两种生活：游牧支系最初的牧地在内志与阿西尔交界的拉尼亚和库尔迈一带，后来与亲族苏胡尔人一起游牧于利雅得周围的内志腹地，其中一支更向北开拓，建立了鲁迈镇；定居支系则数百年来散居阿拉伯中部各城镇，在当地传统定居人口中占很大比例。17世纪，苏拜出身的阿勒·苏莱姆王朝统治着盖西姆的商贸名城欧奈宰。苏拜还随沙特家族征战：1818年奥斯曼入侵后，他们乘巴尼·哈立德衰落之机进入其沙漠领地；1830年，苏拜与沙特的联军在决战中终结了巴尼·哈立德在哈萨的统治。

en: Sabzevār, an ancient city of western Khorasan whose Azarbarzin fire temple dates back to the first millennium BC, stood on the road between Nishapur and the Caspian gates. In 1337 it was held for the Il-Khanid claimant Togha Temür by a local ruler, 'Ala' al-Din Muhammad of the Farumadi family, whose harsh taxation provoked a revolt: a landowner named 'Abd al-Razzaq killed his tax official at Bashtin and in the summer of 1337 seized Sabzevār, founding the Sarbadar state. The Sarbadars, a blend of Shi'i dervishes and secular amirs, made the city their capital, fought the Jauni Kurban and the Kartids of Herat, and for decades balanced between Togha Temür and their own independence; their leader Yahya Karawi murdered Togha Temür in 1353. The long reign of 'Ali Mu'ayyad ended with submission to Timur in 1381, after which Sabzevār kept its local administration and supplied troops to the Timurid armies, though the Sarbadars slowly faded after Timur's death. Under the Safavids the province was lost to the Uzbeks and reconquered around 1600 together with Herat and Farah.
zh: 萨卜泽瓦尔是呼罗珊西部的古城，境内的阿扎尔巴尔津火庙可追溯到公元前1000年，城市坐落在内沙布尔通往里海山口的大道上。1337年，它由本地统治者法鲁马迪家族的阿劳丁·穆罕默德替伊儿汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿镇守；他的横征暴敛激起叛乱：地主阿卜杜勒·拉扎克在布什廷杀死税官，于1337年夏攻占萨卜泽瓦尔，建立萨尔巴达尔政权。萨尔巴达尔人由什叶派托钵僧和世俗埃米尔混合组成，以该城为都，与札兀尼·库尔班和赫拉特的卡尔提德王朝交战，数十年来在臣服脱合帖木儿与自立之间摇摆；其首领叶海亚·卡拉维于1353年袭杀脱合帖木儿。阿里·穆阿亚德的长期统治以1381年归顺帖木儿告终，此后萨卜泽瓦尔保留了本地行政机构，并为帖木儿的军队提供兵源，但萨尔巴达尔人在帖木儿死后逐渐式微。萨法维王朝时期，这一省份一度被乌兹别克人夺去，约1600年又与赫拉特、法拉一同被收复。

en: The County of Schauenburg, known after about 1485 as Schaumburg, was a state of the Holy Roman Empire on the Weser in present-day Lower Saxony, with its seat at Bückeburg. It took its name from Schauenburg Castle near Rinteln, whose lords first appear early in the twelfth century. In 1110 Duke Lothair of Saxony enfeoffed Adolf I with Holstein and Stormarn, including Hamburg, and the House of Schauenburg thereafter ruled both its Weser homeland and the Holstein counties through several partitioned lines. The lordship was raised to a county in 1295 and passed to the Holstein-Pinneberg line, which held it in 1337 under Count Adolf VII. Its counts founded the towns of Stadthagen and Rinteln and added the County of Sternberg in 1377. The Reformation was introduced in 1559, Count Ernst moved the residence from Stadthagen to Bückeburg, and in 1619 the county was raised to a principality. When Otto V died childless in 1640 the house became extinct and the land was divided, chiefly between Hesse-Kassel and the counts of Lippe.
zh: 绍恩堡伯国（约1485年后改称绍姆堡）是神圣罗马帝国的邦国，位于今德国下萨克森州的威悉河畔，治所在比克堡。它得名于林特尔恩附近的绍恩堡城堡，城堡领主最早出现于12世纪初。1110年，萨克森公爵洛泰尔将荷尔斯泰因和施托尔曼（含汉堡）封给阿道夫一世，绍恩堡家族此后通过几条分家支脉，同时统治威悉河本土和荷尔斯泰因诸伯国。1295年领地升格为伯国，1337年时由荷尔斯泰因-平讷贝格支系的阿道夫七世统治。绍恩堡伯爵建立了施塔特哈根和林特尔恩两座城镇，1377年又取得施特恩贝格伯国。1559年伯国推行宗教改革，恩斯特伯爵将府邸从施塔特哈根迁至比克堡，1619年伯国升为侯国。1640年奥托五世无嗣而终，家族绝嗣，领地主要被黑森-卡塞尔与利珀伯爵瓜分。

en: The Duchy of Ścinawa was a Silesian Piast principality on the middle Oder, centered on the town of Ścinawa, which was first documented in 1202 and received town rights between 1248 and 1259 from Duke Konrad I of Głogów. After the partition of the Duchy of Głogów in 1273 it briefly stood on its own under Konrad II the Hunchback, then was reunited with Głogów in 1290. In 1317 John, a younger son of Duke Henry III, received Ścinawa, Góra and Lubin as his own duchy. In 1329 he paid homage to King John the Blind of Bohemia in Wrocław, and his lands became a Bohemian fief. Dogged by debts, John sold the duchy piecemeal: in 1337 his brothers bought the whole territory while leaving him life rule, half of Ścinawa went to Bolko II the Small of Świdnica in 1358, and after John's death around 1365 the rest passed to Henry V of Iron of Żagań and in 1397 to Konrad II the Gray of Oleśnica. The Świdnica half was annexed by Emperor Charles IV after 1368. In 1528 Ścinawa entered the united duchies of Wołów and Brzeg, it was devastated in the Thirty Years' War, and when the last Silesian Piast, George William, died in 1675 it reverted to the Habsburgs, passing to Prussia in 1742.
zh: 希齐纳瓦公国是奥得河中游的西里西亚皮雅斯特家族的公国，以希齐纳瓦城为中心。该城最早见于1202年的记载，1248至1259年间由格沃古夫公爵康拉德一世授予城市权。1273年格沃古夫公国分封后，它在康拉德二世（“驼背者”）治下一度自成一国，1290年又与格沃古夫合并。1317年，公爵亨利三世的幼子约翰分得希齐纳瓦、古拉和卢宾，建立自己的公国。1329年，他在弗罗茨瓦夫向波希米亚国王“盲人约翰”行臣服礼，领地成为波希米亚采邑。约翰债务缠身，将公国一块块出卖：1337年他的兄弟们买下全部领地、只留给他终身统治权；1358年半个希齐纳瓦卖给希维德尼察的博尔科二世（“小个子”）；约1365年约翰死后，其余部分归扎甘的亨利五世（“铁人”），1397年又转入奥莱希尼察的康拉德二世（“灰发者”）之手。卖给希维德尼察的那一半则在1368年后被皇帝查理四世吞并。1528年希齐纳瓦并入合并后的沃武夫与布热格公国，三十年战争中遭到重创；1675年西里西亚皮雅斯特家族的末代成员格奥尔格·威廉去世后，领地作为收回的采邑归于哈布斯堡家族，1742年转归普鲁士。

en: Saint-Claude grew up around Condat Abbey, founded in the 420s by the monks Romanus and Lupicinus in the Bienne valley of the Upper Jura. Its fourth abbot, Eugendus, rebuilt the house in stone and turned it into an ecclesiastical principality ruling the surrounding mountains, and the settlement was long known as Saint-Oyend after him. The abbey held directly of the Holy Roman Emperor, independent of the Counts of Burgundy, and by the late twelfth century it governed thirty-four priories and more than a hundred churches. Pilgrims came to venerate the intact body of Saint Claudius, its twelfth abbot, who had died around 699; from the thirteenth century his cult gave the place its present name of Saint-Claude. In 1337 the abbot still ruled this principality in Franche-Comté. A reform was carried out under Abbot Étienne de Fauquier after 1445, but later commendatory abbots turned the house into an aristocratic chapter, and its lands were finally secularised in 1742, when the bishopric of Saint-Claude was created.
zh: 圣克洛德围绕孔达修道院兴起。这座修道院于5世纪20年代由修士罗曼努斯和卢皮奇努斯在汝拉山区上游的比耶讷河谷创建，第四任院长欧根迪乌斯用石头重建修道院，并把它变成统治周围山区的教会诸侯国，聚居地也长期以他的名字称作圣奥扬。修道院直属于神圣罗马帝国皇帝，不受勃艮第伯爵管辖，到12世纪末已下辖34座小修院和一百多座教堂。朝圣者前来敬拜第十二任院长圣克洛德的完好遗体，他约卒于699年；从13世纪起，对他的崇拜使此地得到今天的名字圣克洛德。1337年，院长仍统治着这个位于弗朗什-孔泰的诸侯国。1445年以后，院长艾蒂安·德·福基埃推行改革，但后来的领薪院长把修院变成贵族修士团，其领地最终于1742年被世俗化，圣克洛德主教区也在同年设立。

en: The Kingdom of Scotland traces its birth to 843, when Kenneth MacAlpin united the Gaelic Scots of Dál Riata and the Picts into the realm called Alba, whose kings from the late eleventh century were buried at Dunfermline. David I in the twelfth century remodelled the crown on Norman lines with burghs, sheriffdoms and a royal coinage, while the Hebrides passed from Norway to Scotland under the Treaty of Perth of 1266. The kingdom's survival was tested when Edward I invaded in 1296: William Wallace led the resistance, Robert the Bruce won Bannockburn in 1314, and the Declaration of Arbroath of 1320 preceded English recognition of independence in 1328. In 1337 the child king David II is exiled in France while Edward Balliol and the Disinherited, backed by Edward III, press their claim; David returned to be captured at Neville's Cross in 1346 and ransomed only in 1357. On his death the throne passed in 1371 to his nephew Robert II, first of the Stewart kings, whose line took Orkney from Norway in 1472, lost Berwick in 1482 and lost James IV with the flower of the nobility at Flodden in 1513. The Calvinist Reformation of 1560 created the Presbyterian Kirk and engulfed Mary, Queen of Scots; her son James VI inherited the English throne in 1603, joining the two crowns, and the Scottish parliament voted itself out of existence in the Acts of Union of 1707, creating the Kingdom of Great Britain.
zh: 苏格兰王国的起点通常定在843年，这一年肯尼思·麦卡尔平把达尔里阿达的盖尔苏格兰人与皮克特人统一为阿尔巴王国；自11世纪末起，历代国王安葬于邓弗姆林。12世纪的戴维一世按诺曼模式改造王权，设立自治市镇、郡长辖区，发行最早的苏格兰钱币；1266年的《珀斯条约》又使赫布里底群岛从挪威转入苏格兰。1296年爱德华一世入侵，王国面临生死考验：威廉·华莱士以护国者身份领导抵抗，罗伯特·布鲁斯夺取王位并于1314年赢得班诺克本之战，1320年的《阿布罗斯宣言》之后，英格兰于1328年承认苏格兰独立。1337年，幼主戴维二世正流亡法国，爱德华·巴利奥尔与“被剥夺者”在爱德华三世支持下趁第二次独立战争争位；戴维回国后于1346年在内维尔十字之战被俘，直到1357年签订赎金条约才获释。1371年戴维去世，王位传给外甥罗伯特二世，即斯图亚特王朝初代君主；该王朝于1472年从挪威取得奥克尼，1482年把贝里克丢给英格兰，又在1513年遭遇弗洛登惨败，詹姆斯四世与大批贵族精锐战死。1560年的加尔文宗改革建立了长老会国教会，并把苏格兰女王玛丽卷入漩涡；她的儿子詹姆斯六世于1603年继承英格兰王位，两王冠合而为一，1707年苏格兰议会又通过《联合法令》自行解散，与英格兰组成大不列颠王国。

en: The Chiefdom of Shuidong, ruled by the Song clan, was one of the Four Great Native Chiefdoms of Guizhou together with Bozhou, Sizhou and Shuixi. In 975 the Song court recognized Song Jingyang as hereditary ruler after he seized Manzhou, around present-day Kaiyang, from the Yi people, and in 1303 the chiefdom submitted to the Yuan dynasty and entered the tusi system. The Ming confirmed Song rule in 1371; during the conquest of Yunnan the regent Liu Shuzhen kept the peace with neighbouring Shuixi and travelled to Nanjing to secure the recall of the abusive general Ma Ye in 1384. When Guizhou province was created in 1413, the Shuidong seat of Guizhou City, present-day Guiyang, became its capital. Shuidong chiefs held the title Guizhou Xuanwei tongzhi, junior to the Shuixi Xuanweishi, and rivalry between the two chiefdoms deepened after 1479. A Miao rising in 1513 drove out the chief Song Ran and began a long decline. Song Cheng'en refused to join his father-in-law Yang Yinglong's Bozhou rebellion but was imprisoned at Hailongtun. In 1623 Song Wanhua joined the She-An Rebellion and was captured and executed; after his son Song Siyin was put down in 1630, the Ming annexed Shuidong under direct bureaucratic rule.
zh: 水东土司由宋氏世袭，与播州、思州、水西并称贵州四大土司。975年，宋景阳从彝人手中夺取蛮州，约当今开阳一带，被宋朝确认为当地世袭统治者；1303年水东归附元朝，被纳入土司制度。明朝于1371年承认宋氏的统治；明军攻取云南期间，摄政刘淑贞与邻部水西安然相处，并亲赴南京，于1384年促使朝廷召回凌辱土官的将领马晔。1413年贵州设省，水东的治所贵州城，当今贵阳，被定为省会。水东首领世代担任贵州宣慰同知，位在水西宣慰使之下，1479年以后两家仇怨日深。1513年苗民起事，首领宋然败逃，水东由此走向衰落。宋承恩是播州杨应龙的女婿，却拒绝参与岳丈的叛乱，反被囚于海龙囤。1623年宋万化参加奢安之乱，兵败被俘处死；其子宋嗣殷继续抵抗，于1630年被平定，水东随即被明朝并入流官体系。

en: Sidenreng was a Bugis kingdom in the fertile rice plains west of the lakes of central South Sulawesi. Bugis Lontara chronicles date its founding to around 1300, shortly after the rise of Bone, and its people farmed wet rice on land watered by several rivers; the Portuguese explorer Manuel Pinto, visiting in the 1540s, found the country rich in rice and other crops. In the sixteenth century Sidenreng joined Suppa, Rappang, Sawitto and Alitta in the Ajatappareng confederation, whose rulers swore to be one house divided into five parts, and its chief Lapateddungi was counted among the founders. As Gowa expanded, Sidenreng chose submission over ruin and fought as its ally rather than resist. When the rulers of Gowa adopted Islam in 1605 and made war on the remaining Bugis states, Sidenreng, the last surviving Ajatappareng principality, was annexed in 1609, and its trade later passed under the Dutch East India Company's monopoly after the Makassar War of 1666 to 1669.
zh: 锡登伦是南苏拉威西中部湖群以西肥沃稻作平原上的布吉人王国。布吉人的隆塔拉编年史把它的建国时间系于1300年前后，仅略晚于波尼的兴起；境内河渠纵横，居民种植水稻，1540年代到访的葡萄牙探险家曼努埃尔·平托曾记下此地稻米和其他作物丰饶。16世纪，锡登伦与苏帕、拉庞、萨维托、阿利塔结成阿贾塔帕朗联盟，统治者立誓同为一屋、分为五部，其首领拉帕泰迪东被视为联盟缔造者之一。随着戈瓦扩张，锡登伦放弃抵抗，转而作为戈瓦的盟友出战。1605年戈瓦统治者改宗伊斯兰教并对其余布吉邦国开战，锡登伦作为阿贾塔帕朗仅存的邦国于1609年被吞并；1666至1669年的望加锡战争后，它的贸易又落入荷兰东印度公司的垄断之下。

en: The Duchy of Sieradz, centered on the town of Sieradz in central Poland, was created in 1263 when the Duchy of Łęczyca was divided among the Masovian line of the Piast dynasty. Its first notable duke was Leszek II the Black, who also held Kraków, and in 1299 Władysław Łokietek had to cede the land to King Wenceslaus II of Bohemia. After the Přemyslid dynasty died out in 1306, Sieradz returned to the Polish kingdom as a vassal duchy. In 1337 it was held by the Piast prince Przemysł of Inowrocław; when he died without heirs in 1339, Casimir III the Great incorporated the territory directly into the Lands of the Polish Crown, where it became the Sieradz Voivodeship and was thereafter known as Sieradz Land rather than a duchy.
zh: 谢拉兹公国以波兰中部的谢拉兹镇为中心，1263年皮亚斯特王朝马佐夫舍支系瓜分文奇察公国时产生。其早期著名公爵是同时领有克拉科夫的黑色者莱谢克二世；1299年瓦迪斯瓦夫·沃凯泰克被迫将此地割让给波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫二世。1306年普热米斯尔王朝绝嗣后，谢拉兹作为附庸公国重归波兰王国。1337年统治它的是皮亚斯特王公、伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫的普热梅斯乌；他于1339年无嗣而终后，卡齐米日三世将这片领地直接并入波兰王冠领地，改制为谢拉兹省，此后便以“谢拉兹之地”而非公国的名称存在。

en: The medieval Kingdom of Serbia was the creation of the Nemanjić dynasty. Grand Prince Stefan Nemanja united the Serbian lands from 1166, his son Stefan the First-Crowned took the royal title in 1217, and their youngest brother Sava secured an autocephalous Orthodox Church in 1219. The kings who followed expanded into Macedonia and the Adriatic coast; Stefan Dečanski shattered Bulgaria at Velbazhd in 1330, and in 1331 his son Stefan Dušan seized the throne, the ruler who held Prizren and the Kosovo heartland in 1337. Dušan's campaigns carried Serbia from the Danube to the Gulf of Corinth, and in 1346 he was crowned emperor of the Serbs and Greeks at Skopje and raised his archbishopric to a patriarchate; his law code of 1349 and 1354 crowned the empire's brief golden age. After his death in 1355 the realm fragmented under Uroš V, the nobility fell to the Ottomans at Marica in 1371, and Prince Lazar's stand at Kosovo in 1389 ended independent Serbia, which was annexed outright in 1459. After nearly four centuries of Ottoman rule, it returned to history in 1804, when the Slaughter of the Knezes provoked Karađorđe's First Uprising; after its collapse Miloš Obrenović led the Second Uprising of 1815, and the sultan recognized hereditary Serbian princes in 1830 and 1833, and a constitution followed in 1835.
zh: 中世纪塞尔维亚王国是内马尼奇王朝的缔造。大茹潘斯特凡·内马尼亚自1166年起统一塞尔维亚诸地，其子“首位加冕者”斯特凡于1217年取得王号，幼弟萨瓦则在1219年争取到东正教会的自治地位。此后诸王向马其顿和亚得里亚海沿岸扩张；斯特凡·德钱斯基于1330年在维尔巴日德击溃保加利亚，1331年其子斯特凡·杜尚废父夺位，正是1337年领有普里兹伦与科索沃核心地带的统治者。杜尚的征战使塞尔维亚疆域北起多瑙河、南抵科林斯湾，1346年他在斯科普里加冕为塞尔维亚人与希腊人的皇帝，并将大主教区升格为牧首区；1349和1354年颁布的《杜尚法典》标志着帝国短暂黄金时代的顶峰。他1355年去世后，帝国在乌罗什五世治下瓦解，贵族于1371年在马里查败于奥斯曼人，拉扎尔公爵1389年在科索沃的抵抗终告失败，塞尔维亚于1459年被彻底吞并。经过近四个世纪的奥斯曼统治，1804年“屠杀诸侯”事件激起卡拉乔尔杰领导的第一次起义；失败后米洛什·奥布雷诺维奇于1815年发动第二次起义，苏丹在1830和1833年承认塞尔维亚诸侯世袭，1835年又颁布了宪法。

en: Sofala was the southernmost of the great Swahili city-states, standing on a marshy estuary of the Mozambique coast. It grew up in the tenth century as a trading post founded by merchants from Mogadishu, who guarded its secret because the Buzi River led inland through Manica to the goldfields of Great Zimbabwe and the Mwenemutapa kingdom. In the 1180s Sultan Suleiman Hassan of Kilwa took the town, and its gold revenues financed Kilwa's commercial empire; yet Sofala kept its own patrician elite and paid tribute to the Mwenemutapa king, remaining the dominant port south of Kilwa. In 1489 the Portuguese scout Pêro da Covilhã reached it in disguise, and in 1502 the sheikh Isuf, unwilling to recognize the usurper Emir Ibrahim in Kilwa, signed a treaty with the arriving Portuguese ships. Pêro de Anaia built Fort São Caetano beside the town in 1505, but fever gutted the garrison and the harbor's shifting sandbanks made it unsafe for deep-draught ships. After the Portuguese seized Mozambique Island in 1507 they moved their base there, and as the old goldfields were exhausted Sofala sank into insignificance, its ruins eventually swallowed by the estuary.
zh: 索法拉是斯瓦希里大城邦中位置最南的一个，坐落在莫桑比克海岸一片多沼泽的河口。它在10世纪由摩加迪沙商人开辟为贸易站；摩加迪沙人长期对竞争对手保密，因为溯布济河而上，经马尼卡便可抵达大津巴布韦和莫诺莫塔帕王国的金矿区。12世纪80年代，基卢瓦苏丹苏莱曼·哈桑夺取该城，索法拉的黄金收入支撑了基卢瓦商业帝国的扩张；但索法拉保留了自己的贵族精英，并向莫诺莫塔帕国王纳贡，始终是基卢瓦以南最显赫的港口。1489年，葡萄牙密探佩罗·达·科维良乔装抵达此地；1502年，谢赫伊素福因不愿承认基卢瓦的篡位者埃米尔·易卜拉欣，与到来的葡萄牙船只签订条约。1505年，佩罗·德·阿纳亚在城旁修建圣卡埃塔诺堡，但热病使驻军大批死亡，港口游移的沙洲也让深吃水船只难以安全停靠。1507年葡萄牙人夺取莫桑比克岛后将基地北迁，加上旧金矿日渐枯竭，索法拉沦为无足轻重的小据点，城址最终被河口海水吞没。

en: Strasbourg, the Roman Argentoratum on the Ill near its confluence with the Rhine, was a frontier camp from 12 BC and the scene of the emperor Julian's victory over the Alemanni in 357. From 362 the city was ruled by its bishops, and in 842 Charles the Bald and Louis the German exchanged the bilingual Oaths of Strasbourg there. In 1262 the citizens defeated the bishop's army at the Battle of Hausbergen and made Strasbourg a Free Imperial City, governed by its council; a guild revolution in 1332 broke the patrician monopoly and gave the craft guilds the leading office of Ammeister, so that in 1337 it was one of the richest self-ruling cities of the empire, its great sandstone cathedral still rising above the rooftops. In 1349 a guild revolt preceded the burning alive of the city's two thousand Jews in the Black Death pogrom. Strasbourg later became a cradle of printing through Johannes Mentelin and Heinrich Eggestein, embraced the Reformation under Martin Bucer and Wolfgang Capito, founded its academy in 1538 and produced the world's first printed newspaper in 1605. Louis XIV's armies annexed the city without a siege in 1681, confirmed by the Treaty of Ryswick in 1697, and in 1792 Rouget de Lisle first sang the marching song that became La Marseillaise in its streets.
zh: 斯特拉斯堡位于伊尔河汇入莱茵河处附近，古罗马时称阿让托拉图姆，公元前12年起就是边防军营，357年皇帝尤利安在此击败阿勒曼尼人。362年起该城由主教统治，842年秃头查理和日耳曼人路易在此互换双语的《斯特拉斯堡誓言》。1262年市民在豪斯贝根战役中击败主教军队，使斯特拉斯堡成为帝国自由市，由市议会治理；1332年的行会革命打破了贵族世家的垄断，手工业行会取得了行业总管这一要职，因此1337年时它已是帝国最富庶的自治城市之一，宏大的砂岩大教堂仍在兴建之中。1349年，一场行会起事之后，该城两千名犹太人在黑死病迫害中被集体活活烧死。后来斯特拉斯堡凭借约翰内斯·门特林和海因里希·埃格施泰因成为印刷业摇篮，在马丁·布塞尔和沃尔夫冈·卡皮托推动下皈依宗教改革，1538年创办学院，1605年印出世界上第一份印刷报纸。1681年路易十四的军队未经围攻便吞并该城，1697年《赖斯韦克条约》予以确认；1792年，鲁日·德·李尔在它的街头首次唱起那首后来成为《马赛曲》的战歌。

en: Esfarāyen, in earlier centuries called Isfarāyīn, is a town at the gateway to the northern mountains of Khorasan, set back from the road between Bayhaq and Nishapur. Already a seat of religious learning, it produced the Shafi'i theologian Abu Ishaq al-Isfarayini, who taught Ash'ari doctrine in Nishapur at the turn of the eleventh century. With the break-up of the Ilkhanate the town, held by the local Qushji family, was drawn into the wars of the Khurasan princes: Shaykh 'Ali b. 'Ali Qushji, governor of Khurasan for the Il-Khanid claimant Togha Temür, was the strongest man in eastern Iran until July 1337, when he was captured and executed by Arghun Shah of the Jauni Kurban tribe, who sent his head to the Jalayirid Hasan Buzurg. Esfarāyen remained a prize of the wars between Astarabad, the Sarbadars and the Jauni Kurban, and in 1381 Timur sacked the town after Amir Vali refused to pay him homage, bringing it within the Timurid order of Khurasan.
zh: 埃斯法拉延旧称伊斯法拉因，是呼罗珊北部山口要冲的一座城镇，偏离拜海格通往内沙布尔的大路。这里早就是宗教学术中心，曾走出沙斐仪派神学家阿布·伊斯哈格·伊斯法拉伊尼，他在11世纪初于内沙布尔讲授艾什尔里派教义。伊儿汗国瓦解后，这座由本地库什吉家族把持的城镇卷入呼罗珊诸王公的混战：库什吉家的谢赫·阿里·本·阿里·库什吉是伊儿汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿帐下的呼罗珊长官，也是伊朗东部最有权势的人物，直到1337年7月被札兀尼·库尔班部落的阿儿浑沙擒杀，首级被送往札剌亦儿人哈桑·布祖尔格处。此后埃斯法拉延一直是阿斯塔拉巴德、萨尔巴达尔人和札兀尼·库尔班反复争夺的猎物；1381年，因阿米尔·瓦利拒绝向帖木儿称臣，帖木儿洗劫了该城，把它纳入帖木儿治下的呼罗珊秩序。

en: Sanghana was the name Arab geographers gave to the low-lying region around the mouth of the Senegal River, which may even have given the river its name. Around 800 it was counted among the states of the lower Senegal alongside Takrur and Silla, and by the Almoravid age its coastlands were held by the Godala, a Sanhaja Berber people who worked the salt deposits of Awlil and ran a coastal caravan route linking the river mouth to southern Morocco. Godala caravans carried Awlil salt along the north bank of the Senegal and traded with their neighbour Takrur. In the fourteenth century the country formed the westernmost march of the Mali Empire, whose mansa it served as a vassal.
zh: 桑哈纳是阿拉伯地理学家对塞内加尔河河口一带低洼地区的称呼，塞内加尔河的名字甚至可能就源于此。约800年，它与塔克鲁尔、锡拉并列为塞内加尔河下游的诸国之一；到穆拉比特时代，其沿海地带由戈达拉人占据。戈达拉人属桑哈贾柏柏尔人，开采奥利勒的盐层，经营着连接河口与摩洛哥南部的沿海商路，其商队沿塞内加尔河北岸贩运奥利勒食盐，与邻国塔克鲁尔贸易。14世纪时，此地是马里帝国最西端的边地，作为附庸为曼萨效力。

en: Sonargaon, the ancient Suvarnagrama or golden hamlet, was a river port on the old course of the Brahmaputra in eastern Bengal, whose hinterland archaeologists identify with the Sounagoura emporium recorded by Greco-Roman geographers. The Hindu Deva king Dasharathadeva moved his capital there from Bikrampur in the mid-thirteenth century, and from the 1270s the Sufi scholar Abu Tawwama made it a seat of Persian learning with his khanqah and madrasa. Early in the fourteenth century the Delhi sultanate's governor Shamsuddin Firoz Shah conquered central Bengal and opened a mint at Sonargaon; in 1337 the town was held for Delhi by the governor Bahram Khan. On his death in 1338 his armour-bearer Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah made himself independent sultan, conquered Chittagong in 1340, and fought the rival Bengali cities of Lakhnauti and Satgaon; the traveller Ibn Battuta visited his court. Sonargaon later served as a capital of the Bengal Sultanate under Ghiyasuddin Azam Shah and grew wealthy on muslin weaving. When the sultanate collapsed, Isa Khan led the Baro-Bhuyan confederacy of landlords from Sonargaon against the Mughals, until his son Musa Khan was defeated in 1610 and the town became a district of Mughal Bengal, overshadowed by the new capital at Dhaka.
zh: 索纳尔冈，古称苏瓦尔纳格拉马，意为金村，是孟加拉东部布拉马普特拉河故道上的河港；考古学者认为它的腹地就是希腊罗马地理学家记载的商港索纳古拉。13世纪中叶，印度教提婆王朝的达沙拉塔提婆王把都城从比克拉姆普尔迁到这里；从13世纪70年代起，苏菲学者阿布·塔瓦马在此设立道堂和经学院，使它成为波斯学术的中心。14世纪初，德里苏丹国的总督沙姆斯丁·菲罗兹沙征服孟加拉中部，在索纳尔冈开设造币厂；1337年，这座城由总督巴赫拉姆汗替德里镇守。1338年巴赫拉姆汗去世，他的持甲官法赫鲁丁·穆巴拉克沙自立为独立苏丹，1340年征服吉大港，并与拉克瑙蒂、萨特冈两个孟加拉城邦争雄，旅行家伊本·白图泰曾到访他的宫廷。后来索纳尔冈在吉亚斯丁·阿扎姆沙在位时成为孟加拉苏丹国的都城，靠薄纱织造致富。苏丹国瓦解后，伊萨·汗以索纳尔冈为据点，率领地主联盟“十二布伊扬”抵抗莫卧儿人，直到他的儿子穆萨汗于1610年战败，该城成为莫卧儿孟加拉的一个县，风头被新都达卡盖过。

en: Shangsi was a small Zhuang tusi subprefecture in the hills south of Nanning, at the northern foot of the Shiwandashan range in present-day Fangchenggang, Guangxi. Under the Yuan and early Ming it was attached to the Siming native prefecture; the Ming court briefly abolished it, restored the subprefecture under Siming in 1388, and transferred it to Nanning Prefecture in 1505.
zh: 上思是南宁以南、十万大山北麓的一个壮族小土州，辖地在今广西防城港境内，境内群山起伏，是思明黄氏土官下辖的寨堡之地。元及明初辖于思明路、思明府，明初一度废置，1388年复置仍属思明，1505年改隶南宁府。

en: Siguntur lies in the Minangkabau highlands of western Sumatra, on the upper Batanghari River at the old royal site of Dharmasraya, the capital of the Buddhist Malay kingdom of Bhumi Malayu, where the Mauli dynasty inherited much of Srivijaya's authority after the Chola raid of 1025. In 1275 King Kertanagara of Singhasari launched the Pamalayu expedition to the region, and in 1286 sent the Amoghapasa statue recorded in the Padang Roco inscription, which names King Tribhuwanaraja Mauli Warmadewa at Dharmasraya. His grandson Adityawarman, once a senior minister of Majapahit, returned to rule Malayapura from 1347 to 1375 as a tantric Buddhist king who controlled the highland gold trade and founded the Pagaruyung dynasty; his son Ananggawarman succeeded him. Local tradition at Siguntur traces a small kingdom there to 1250 and claims Mauli descent, counting Adityawarman among its rulers before the highland states passed under Pagaruyung's overlordship. The court later turned to Islam, its first Muslim ruler, Abdul Jalil Sutan Syah, reigning from 1575, while the old Siguntur dialect remained close to the Minangkabau of Payakumbuh.
zh: 西昆图尔位于西苏门答腊的米南加保高地，在巴唐哈里河上游的旧王都达摩室利耶一带；这里曾是佛教马来王国“马来之地”的都城，1025年朱罗人突袭之后，毛利王朝在此继承了室利佛逝的大部分权威。1275年，信诃沙里国王格尔达纳卡拉发动帕马拉尤远征，1286年又送来阿莫伽巴沙神像，此事见于巴东罗科铭文，铭文提到达摩室利耶国王特里布瓦纳拉贾·毛利·瓦马德瓦。他的外孙阿迪蒂亚瓦尔曼曾担任满者伯夷的重臣，1347至1375年回到马来普拉统治，作为密宗佛教国王掌控高地黄金贸易，并开创巴加鲁永王朝，其子阿南加瓦尔曼继位。西昆图尔当地传说把一个小王国的起源追溯到1250年，自称出自毛利世系，还把阿迪蒂亚瓦尔曼列为其统治者，后来高地各邦均归入巴加鲁永宗主权之下。宫廷此后改宗伊斯兰教，第一位穆斯林统治者阿卜杜勒·贾利勒·苏丹·沙于1575年即位，而当地古老的西昆图尔方言仍与帕亚孔布的米南加保语相近。

en: Sanggau was a Dayak river state on the lower Kapuas in western Borneo, its early Hindu polity centred on Mengkiang up the Sekayam tributary, said in local tradition to have been founded by the noblewoman Putri Daranante. In 1380 the Muslim preacher Abang Abdurrahman, a prince of Labai Lawai schooled in Banten, married the daughter of its Temenggung Raden Satry, succeeded him and took the title sultan, turning the old Hindu state into an Islamic one. His son-in-law Sultan Awaluddin founded a new town at Kantu on the main Kapuas shipping lane, moved the court there from Mengkiang and built the stone mosque; Sanggau became the gateway between the upriver states of Sekadau and Sintang and downstream ports such as Mempawah and Sambas. Around 1400 the expansion of Brunei under Awang Alak Betatar reached the Kapuas and brought Sanggau under Bruneian overlordship.
zh: 桑高是婆罗洲西部卡普阿斯河下游的达雅克河居国家，早期的印度教政权以塞卡扬支流上游的孟姜为中心，当地传说它由贵族女子普特里·达拉南特建立。1380年，曾在万丹求学、出身拉拜拉瓦伊的穆斯林传道者阿邦·阿卜杜勒拉赫曼娶了天猛公拉登·萨特里的女儿，继而继任并采用苏丹头衔，把这个印度教古国改为伊斯兰政权。他的女婿苏丹阿瓦卢丁在卡普阿斯主航道旁的坎图建立新城，把王庭从孟姜迁来，并修建了石造清真寺；桑高由此成为贸易枢纽，上游连通塞卡道、新当等邦，下游衔接孟加影、三发等港。约1400年，阿旺·阿拉克·贝塔塔尔治下的文莱扩张到卡普阿斯河流域，桑高被纳入文莱的宗主权之下。

en: Sangzhi was a Tujia native chieftaincy, or tusi, in the Wuling mountains of northwestern Huguang, on the lands of present-day Sangzhi County in northwestern Hunan. The Song court set up the Sangzhi Pacification Commission in the eleventh century during the reign of Emperor Renzong, naming it after its seat at Sangzhiping; the hereditary Xiang chiefs held the office through the Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties. The last chieftain, Xiang Guodong, waged bloody feuds with the neighboring Rongmei, Yongshun and Maogang chiefdoms. The Qing court confiscated his seal in 1726 and carried out gaitu guiliu in 1728, replacing native rule with ordinary provincial administration. Sangzhi County was established on the chieftaincy's territory in 1729, and Xiang was resettled in Henan.
zh: 桑植是湖广西北部武陵山区的土家族土司，其地在今湖南西北部的桑植县。11世纪宋仁宗推行土司制度时设桑植宣抚司，因司治位于桑植坪而得名，向氏土官世代承袭，历经元、明、清三代。末代宣慰使向国栋与容美、永顺、茅冈等土司连年仇杀，朝廷于1726年追缴其印信，1728年实行改土归流，1729年以其地置桑植县，向国栋被安置到河南。

en: The Shabankara were an Iranian tribal people of southeastern Fars, deported there from Isfahan and Syria by the Buyid ruler 'Adud al-Dawla in the tenth century and organized into several herder-warrior clans. Their Ramanid chiefs, known as the Fadlawayhids after their founder Fadluya, seized power in Fars in 1062 before being broken by the Seljuks, who executed Fadluya in 1071. After the Seljuk collapse the tribe restored its rule from its capital Ij, and under the Ilkhans governed the province of Shabankara centered on Darabjird; Hulegu destroyed Ij in 1260 and a revolt in 1312 was put down, yet the chiefs survived as local rulers. In 1337 the chief was Ardashir, who claimed descent from the Sasanian kings and kept a court combining strict Sunni orthodoxy with ancient Persian customs. His refusal to obey the Muzaffarids proved fatal: in 1355 Mubariz al-Din Muhammad sent his son Mahmud against him, defeated Ardashir and annexed the Shabankara lands, though remnants of tribal power may have lingered in the district until 1424.
zh: 沙班卡拉是法尔斯东南部的伊朗部落族群，10世纪被布韦希王朝君主阿杜德·道莱从伊斯法罕和叙利亚迁徙至此，分为若干游牧武士氏族。其拉马尼支首领、以开创者法德卢亚得名的法德勒瓦希德家族，于1062年夺取法尔斯政权，但随后被塞尔柱人击溃，法德卢亚于1071年被处死。塞尔柱帝国瓦解后，该部落以伊杰为都恢复统治，伊儿汗时期治理以达拉卜吉尔德为中心的沙班卡拉省；1260年旭烈兀摧毁伊杰，1312年的起义也遭镇压，但诸首领仍作为地方统治者存续。1337年在位的首领是阿尔达希尔，他自称萨珊诸王后裔，宫廷中严格的逊尼派正统信仰与古波斯习俗并存。他拒绝服从穆扎法尔王朝，终致灭亡：1355年穆巴里兹丁·穆罕默德派其子马哈茂德来攻，击败阿尔达希尔并吞并沙班卡拉领地，不过残余的部落势力可能在当地一直延续到1424年。

en: Shanglin was a Zhuang tusi in the upper Youjiang valley of north-western Guangxi, covering present-day Tianlin and Xilin counties. The Northern Song court created it as the Shanglin dong in 1053, after Di Qing's armies suppressed the rebellion of Nong Zhigao, and under the Yuan it was attached to the Lai'an Route of the Liangjiang circuit. In 1409 the Ming enfeoffed Cen Zicheng, a son of the Sicheng chief Cen Shanzhong, as hereditary head, and the dong was reorganised as the Shanglin Chief's Office, thereafter ruled by a branch of the Cen clan.
zh: 上林是广西西北部右江上游的壮族世袭土司，辖境在今田林县、西林县一带。北宋皇祐五年（1053年），朝廷在狄青平定侬智高起兵后废如赖县、设置上林峒，元代划归两江道来安路管辖。明永乐七年（1409年），泗城州土官岑善忠之子岑子成袭任长官，上林峒改为上林长官司，此后由岑氏一支世袭统治。

en: The Shilin are the Donghai Jurchen group of the settlement called Tulazi, which stood on Amur Bay facing the Suifen estuary. In the first month of 1617 Nurhaci sent the officer Muhalian with a thousand men to subdue the Donghai Hurha tribes, and Tulazi passed with the rest of the coast under Later Jin rule, completing the unification of the Donghai Jurchens.
zh: 施林是聚居于土拉子的东海女真群体，土拉子位于阿穆尔湾畔、与绥芬河口隔海相望。1617年正月，努尔哈赤派穆哈连率兵一千征讨东海虎尔哈各部，土拉子随整片地区归入后金版图，东海女真至此基本统一。

en: The Shammar were a great Qahtanite tribal confederation of northern Najd, descended from the Tayy, who had migrated north from Yemen in 115 and taken the twin mountains of Aja and Salma, later called Jabal Shammar, from the Banu Assad and Banu Tamim. For centuries they lived as camel-herders and horse-breeders around the wells of Ha'il, and the tribe's early fame rested on Hatim al-Ta'i, the sixth-century Christian chieftain whose generosity made him a hero of the Arabian Nights, and on his son Adi ibn Hatim, who embraced Islam. It was in the fourteenth century, as the old name of Tayy gave way to Shammar, that the confederation of the Abdah, Aslam and Sinjarah branches first appears under that name in written sources. Rivalry with the Anizah over the desert wells ran through these centuries, and in the seventeenth century a large section migrated north under the Al Jarba into Iraq as far as Mosul, while those who remained kept Ha'il as their seat.
zh: 舍迈尔是内志北部的盖哈坦部落大联盟，源出泰伊人。泰伊人于115年从也门北迁，从巴努·阿萨德和巴努·塔米姆手中夺取阿贾、塞尔马两座山，此山后来改称贾巴勒·舍迈尔。他们世代在哈伊勒的水井周围游牧，牧骆驼、养骏马；部落早年的声名来自6世纪的基督徒酋长哈提姆·塔伊，他的慷慨使他成为《一千零一夜》里的名人，其子阿迪·伊本·哈提姆后来皈依伊斯兰教。14世纪，泰伊的旧名逐渐为舍迈尔取代，由阿卜达、阿斯莱姆和辛贾拉三支组成的联盟首次以这个名字见诸文献。他们与阿尼扎人争夺沙漠水井的长期对抗贯穿数个世纪；17世纪，一大支舍迈尔人在贾尔巴家族率领下北迁伊拉克，远至摩苏尔，留在阿拉伯的人则继续以哈伊勒为中心。

en: The Sahib Ataids were a short-lived Turkmen beylik centered on Karahisar-ı Sâhib, modern Afyonkarahisar, founded by the sons of Fakhr al-Din Ali, known as Sâhib Ata, the grand vizier who dominated the Seljuk sultanate of Rûm after 1277. Restored to favour under the Ilkhanid overlords in 1275, he secured the Afyon region as a family domain for his sons Taceddin Hüseyin and Nusreddin Hasan. Both brothers fell in 1277 at the Battle of Değirmençayı fighting the Karamanid Mehmet Bey and his Seljuk pretender Jimri, after which Hasan's son Şemseddin Mehmed ruled until his own death in battle against the Germiyanids in 1287. His son Nusreddin Ahmed, the reigning bey in 1337, fled before the Ilkhanid governor Timurtash's campaign against the frontier princes, but Timurtash abandoned his siege of Karahisar and escaped to Egypt in 1327; Ahmed returned home and accepted Germiyanid suzerainty. When he died around 1341 the beylik was peacefully absorbed by the Germiyanids, ending a line descended from one of the last great Seljuk viziers, whose mosques and medreses still stand in Konya and Sivas.
zh: 萨希布—阿塔（萨希布阿塔奥卢）是以萨希布—卡拉希萨尔、即今阿菲永卡拉希萨尔为中心的短命突厥蛮贝伊国，建立者是1277年后权倾罗姆塞尔柱朝堂的大维齐尔法赫尔丁·阿里（人称萨希布·阿塔）的两个儿子。1275年他在伊利汗国宗主下重获宠信，为儿子塔杰丁·侯赛因和努斯雷丁·哈桑谋得阿菲永地区作为家族封地。1277年，兄弟二人在代伊尔门恰伊战役中迎战卡拉曼的穆罕默德贝伊及其拥立的塞尔柱僭位者吉姆里，双双战死；哈桑之子谢姆塞丁·穆罕默德继位，1287年在抵御格尔米扬的战斗中身亡。他的儿子努斯雷丁·艾哈迈德就是1337年在位的贝伊，曾为躲避伊利汗国总督帖木儿塔什征讨边境王公的兵锋而出逃；但帖木儿塔什于1327年解卡拉希萨尔之围、逃奔埃及，艾哈迈德得以归国并承认格尔米扬的宗主权。约1341年他去世后，贝伊国被格尔米扬平稳吞并，这个出自末代塞尔柱大维齐尔的家族就此落幕，而萨希布·阿塔在科尼亚和锡瓦斯修建的清真寺与经学院依然存世。

en: The Saharan were a Jat clan of the dry Jangladesh country, now northern Rajasthan, holding the tract around Churu under their own chiefs in the fourteenth century. When Rao Bika conquered Jangladesh in the fifteenth century, the clan accepted the suzerainty of Bikaner.
zh: 撒哈拉是贾特人的一支氏族，14世纪在今拉贾斯坦北部干燥的禅伽罗德什地区由本族首领割据，治所设在久鲁一带。15世纪拉奥·比卡征服禅伽罗德什后，该族接受了比卡内尔的宗主权。

en: Sondershausen was the Thuringian seat of a branch of the Counts of Hohnstein, a Harz noble house whose county took its name from Hohnstein Castle, first mentioned in 1130 and held by the Counts of Ilfeld from 1182. The Hohnsteins built up a compact territory between the Wipper and the Upper Harz, acquiring the County of Klettenberg, the advocacy of Walkenried Abbey and the County of Lohra, while a separate Sondershausen line branched off in 1289 and pushed south into Thuringia, with a further partition following in 1315. In 1337 the Sondershausen lands were ruled by Count Henry of Hohnstein. The line did not long outlast him: in 1356 the Hohnstein-Sondershausen branch died out in the male line and its inheritance passed to the Counts of Schwarzburg. The parent Hohnstein house survived in the Harz until the death of Count Ernst VII in 1593, when its remaining counties were divided among the Stolberg, Schwarzburg and Brunswick claimants.
zh: 松德斯豪森是霍恩施泰因伯爵家族一支在图林根的治所。霍恩施泰因伯国得名于1130年首见记载的霍恩施泰因城堡，1182年起由伊尔费尔德伯爵持有。霍恩施泰因家族在维珀河与上哈茨之间经营出一片完整领地，先后取得克莱滕贝格伯国、瓦尔肯里德修道院的护院权和洛拉伯国；1289年，松德斯豪森支系独立出来并向南深入图林根，1315年又经历一次分家。1337年统治松德斯豪森领地的是霍恩施泰因伯爵亨利。这一支在他身后不久便断绝：1356年霍恩施泰因-松德斯豪森支系男嗣绝嗣，遗产由施瓦茨堡伯爵继承。母家则在哈茨延续到1593年伯爵恩斯特七世去世，残存伯国被施托尔贝格、施瓦茨堡和不伦瑞克的继承人均分。

en:
The Kingdom of Sicily, ruled from Palermo, was founded on Christmas Day 1130, when the Norman count Roger II had himself crowned over the island his family had taken from its Muslim rulers. After the Norman and Hohenstaufen lines, including the emperor Frederick II, the French Angevins took the throne, and their harsh rule provoked the Sicilian Vespers of 1282. The islanders called in Peter III of Aragon, and the kingdom split: the Angevins kept the mainland half, later called the Kingdom of Naples, while the island became an Aragonese realm, confirmed to Frederick III by the Peace of Caltabellotta in 1302. Frederick strengthened the Sicilian parliament through the Constitutiones regales and was still reigning when 1337 opened, though he died that June and was succeeded by his son Peter II.
