The island crown stayed with an Aragonese cadet line until the Compromise of Caspe of 1412 attached Sicily permanently to the Crown of Aragon; Alfonso V reunited it with Naples in 1442. Under the united Spanish monarchy it became a viceroyalty, and its Jews were expelled under the edict of 1492, the last of them leaving by early 1493. After the War of the Spanish Succession it passed to the House of Savoy, which in 1720 exchanged it with Austria for Sardinia; a Bourbon line later ruled it from Naples, and in 1816 it was merged into the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies.
zh:
西西里王国以巴勒莫为都，1130年圣诞节，诺曼伯爵鲁杰罗二世加冕为王，建立了这个王国——他的家族此前从穆斯林统治者手中夺取了西西里岛。历经诺曼王朝和霍亨斯陶芬王朝（包括皇帝腓特烈二世）之后，法国安茹家族登上王位，其苛政激起1282年的西西里晚祷起义。岛民请来阿拉贡的佩德罗三世，王国就此分裂：安茹家族保住半岛部分，即后来的那不勒斯王国，海岛则成为阿拉贡支系统治的国度，1302年的《卡尔塔贝洛塔和约》正式确认腓特烈三世的王位。腓特烈通过《王室宪章》加强了西西里议会的权力，1337年开局时他仍在位，但于当年6月去世，由其子佩德罗二世继位。

海岛王位在阿拉贡支系中传承，直到1412年的《卡斯佩妥协方案》把西西里永久并入阿拉贡联合王国，1442年阿方索五世又将它与那不勒斯重新合并。在统一的西班牙君主制下，西西里成为总督辖区，岛上的犹太人则依1492年的驱逐敕令，在1492至1493年间被逐出。西班牙王位继承战争后，该岛转归萨伏依家族，1720年萨伏依又用它向奥地利换取撒丁岛；后来波旁家族的一支从那不勒斯统治西西里，1816年它被并入两西西里王国。

en: The Republic of Siena was a city-state of southern Tuscany, traditionally founded in 1125 when the commune deposed its ruling bishop; it declared full independence from episcopal control in 1167 and possessed a written constitution by 1179. Wealth came from banking and the wool trade, and its Ghibelline politics set it against the Guelph Florence. In 1260 the Sienese, backed by King Manfred of Sicily, crushed a larger Florentine army at the Battle of Montaperti. From 1287 the merchant government of the Nine, the Nove, presided over a golden age: the cathedral was completed, the Palazzo Pubblico rose on the Campo, and Ambrogio Lorenzetti painted his Allegory of Good Government there in 1338 and 1339, while the university traced its studium to 1240. In 1337 the Nine still ruled, but the Black Death of 1348 shattered the city's economy and the regime fell in 1355. After decades of factional strife, Pandolfo Petrucci made himself signore from 1487 until his death in 1512; the revived republic then fought Florence for eighteen months before surrendering on 21 April 1555, when Siena was absorbed into the Medici Duchy of Florence.
zh: 锡耶纳共和国是托斯卡纳南部的城邦，传统上以1125年公社废黜主教统治者为建国之始；1167年公社宣布完全脱离主教控制，1179年已有成文宪法。它的财富来自银行业和羊毛贸易，政治上属吉伯林派，与圭尔夫派的佛罗伦萨为敌。1260年，锡耶纳人在西西里国王曼弗雷德支持下，于蒙塔佩尔蒂战役击溃兵力更强的佛罗伦萨军队。1287年起，商人组成的“九人政权”开启了黄金时代：大教堂竣工，田野广场上建起市政宫，安布罗焦·洛伦泽蒂于1338年至1339年在宫内绘成《好政府的寓言》，大学的渊源也可追溯到1240年的学堂。1337年九人政权仍在执政，但1348年的黑死病重创城市经济，该政权于1355年倒台。数十年派系纷争之后，潘多尔福·佩特鲁奇在1487年至1512年去世前成为城市的实际领主；恢复后的共和国又与佛罗伦萨交战十八个月，最终于1555年4月21日投降，锡耶纳被并入美第奇家族的佛罗伦萨公国。

en: Siang was a trading kingdom on the west coast of South Sulawesi, its royal centre at Sengkae near a river mouth in what is now the Pangkajene and Islands Regency. It flourished from roughly the tenth century on forest and sea products and, later, wet rice, and its port drew merchants from across the archipelago after the fall of Malacca in 1511. Portuguese visitors found it at the height of its power: António de Paiva stayed there in 1542 and 1544, and Manuel Pinto estimated around 1545 that the capital held some forty thousand people, while local tradition and Portuguese accounts alike remembered Gowa and Talloq as once having been its vassals. Siang's primacy did not outlast the rise of Gowa and its better-sited port of Somba Opu. From the mid-sixteenth century its trade and influence drained away, and by the end of the century it had ceased to be heard of as an independent power, lingering only as a subject land under Gowa's hegemony.
zh: 锡昂是南苏拉威西西海岸的贸易王国，王都设在森卡埃，位于今庞卡杰内和群岛县境内一处河口附近。它约从10世纪起兴盛，靠林产、海产和后来的水田稻米致富，1511年马六甲沦陷后，其港口吸引了群岛各地的商人。葡萄牙访客见到的正是它的鼎盛期：安东尼奥·德·派瓦于1542年和1544年两度逗留，曼努埃尔·平托在1545年前后估计王都约有四万人口；当地传说和葡萄牙人的记述都记得，戈瓦和塔洛曾是它的附庸。锡昂的霸主地位没能熬过戈瓦的崛起，后者的松巴奥普港位置更为优越。从16世纪中叶起，它的贸易和影响不断流失，到该世纪末已不再作为独立政权见于记载，只作为戈瓦霸权下的臣属之地残存。

en: The Sirin are the Wozhe Jurchen group of the Shili, or Xilin, river valley on the forested Primorye coast; under the Yuan they were administered through the Shilin thousand-household office set up for Wozhe hunters. They rose against the Yuan in 1343 and again in 1346, when gyrfalcon tribute demands drove the Wozhe and Shuidada to revolt.
zh: 西林是活动在失里（又译细林）河流域、滨海森林地带的兀者女真群体，元朝曾在细林河设失邻千户所管辖他们。1343年辽阳兀者野人起兵反元，1346年因捕海东青的繁重摊派，兀者野人与水达达再次反元。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Sion was a church state of the Holy Roman Empire ruling the upper Rhône valley, the Valais, from the city of Sion. Its see, the oldest in Switzerland, was founded in Roman times at Octodurum, now Martigny; Saint Theodore founded the Abbey of Saint-Maurice, the oldest monastery north of the Alps, and in 589 the seat was moved to Sion. Around 999 the last king of Upper Burgundy granted the County of Valais to Bishop Hugo, uniting spiritual and temporal rule, and Tourbillon Castle became the bishops' residence. The peasant communities of Upper Valais, the Seven Tithings, rose against them in the Raron rebellion of 1415 to 1420, burned Tourbillon in 1417 and took civil jurisdiction by the Treaty of Naters in 1446. Valais joined the Swiss wars against Charles the Bold and drove the House of Savoy from the Lower Valais in 1475. Cardinal Matthaeus Schiner led the diocese into the papal alliance and fought at Marignano in 1516 before being driven out by his subjects. The Valais rejected the Reformation and helped the Catholic cantons win at Kappel in 1531, but in 1634 the bishop ceded temporal power to the Republic of the Seven Tithings. The French invasion of 1798 ended the old order; after the Rhodanic Republic and French annexation, the Valais joined Switzerland as a canton in 1814.
zh: 锡永采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国的教会邦国，以锡永城为中心统治罗讷河上游的瓦莱谷地。它的教区是瑞士最古老的教区，罗马时代设于奥克托杜鲁姆，即今马蒂尼；圣狄奥多勒创立了阿尔卑斯山以北最古老的圣莫里斯修道院，589年主教驻地迁至锡永。约999年，上勃艮第末代国王把瓦莱伯国封给主教雨果，教权与世俗权力合一，陶鲁比永城堡成为主教官邸。上瓦莱被称为七个十户区的农民社区起而反抗，在1415—1420年的拉龙起事期间于1417年焚毁陶鲁比永城堡，并通过1446年的《纳特斯条约》取得民事司法权。瓦莱参加瑞士人对大胆查理的战争，1475年把萨伏依家族赶出下瓦莱。枢机主教马特乌斯·席纳尔率教区投入教皇同盟，1516年亲自参加马里尼亚诺之战，不久被属民驱逐。瓦莱拒绝宗教改革，1531年协助天主教诸州赢得卡佩尔之战；但1634年主教把世俗权力让给十户区共和国。1798年法军入侵终结旧秩序，历经罗达尼亚共和国和法国兼并后，瓦莱于1814年作为一个州加入瑞士。

en: The Duchy of Siewierz was a small Silesian Piast principality centered on the town of Siewierz, first mentioned in 1125 and granted city rights in 1276. In 1177 Casimir II the Just of Poland gave Siewierz with the whole Duchy of Bytom to Mieszko IV Tanglefoot, and after the Mongols burned the town in 1241 it was rebuilt under the Bytom Piasts; in 1289 the army of Władysław I the Elbow-high defeated Henry IV Probus of Wrocław before its gates. As part of Bytom the duchy accepted Bohemian overlordship between 1327 and 1335, and in 1337 Duke Władysław of Bytom sold Siewierz and Czeladź to Casimir I of Cieszyn, who is therefore its ruler in this period. Bolko II the Small of Świdnica held it briefly in 1359 before it returned to the Cieszyn line. On 30 December 1443 the indebted Wenceslaus I of Cieszyn sold the duchy for six thousand Prague groschen to Zbigniew Oleśnicki, bishop of Kraków; the Kraków bishops then ruled Siewierz as an ecclesiastical principality with its own laws, treasury and army, one of only two such duchies in the region alongside Nysa. The Great Sejm incorporated it into the Polish Crown in 1790, Prussia took it in the Third Partition of 1795, and in 1807 Napoleon recreated the duchy for Marshal Jean Lannes before it passed to Russian-ruled Congress Poland in 1815.
zh: 谢维日公国是西里西亚皮雅斯特家族的小公国，以谢维日城为中心；该城1125年首见记载，1276年获得城市权。1177年，波兰的卡齐米日二世（“正义者”）把谢维日连同整个比托姆公国封给梅什科四世（“缠足者”）。1241年蒙古人焚毁该城，其后在比托姆皮雅斯特支系治下重建；1289年，瓦迪斯瓦夫一世（“矮子”）的军队在城门外击败弗罗茨瓦夫的亨利四世（普罗布斯）。作为比托姆的一部分，公国在1327至1335年间接受波希米亚宗主权；1337年，比托姆公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫把谢维日和切拉季卖给切申公爵卡齐米尔一世，这一时期的君主正是他。1359年希维德尼察的博尔科二世（“小个子”）曾短暂占有它，随后又回到切申支系手中。1443年12月30日，负债累累的切申公爵瓦茨瓦夫一世以六千布拉格格罗申的价格把公国卖给克拉科夫主教兹比格涅夫·奥莱希尼茨基；此后克拉科夫主教们把谢维日当作教会公国统治，自有法律、国库和军队，与尼萨并为当地仅有的两个教会公国。1790年大议会将其并入波兰王国，1795年第三次瓜分波兰时被普鲁士夺取，1807年拿破仑为让·拉纳元帅重建该公国，1815年它转入俄国统治的波兰会议王国。

en: The Scanian lands comprise the provinces of Scania, Halland and Blekinge, fertile Danish territories east of the Sound, whose provincial thing was one of the three assemblies that elected the kings of Denmark and whose Scanian Law, written down around 1200, is the oldest surviving Nordic provincial law. Lund, their capital, became the seat of an archbishop in 1104 and for centuries housed the primatial see of all Scandinavia. A revolt against royal taxation in the 1180s was put down by King Valdemar I and Absalon. In 1332 the impoverished Danish crown, having pledged these provinces to the counts of Holstein, let them pass to Magnus Eriksson of Sweden, so that in 1337 they are held as a Swedish fief by a Danish-speaking population. Valdemar IV Atterdag reconquered Scania in 1360, and it remained Danish for three centuries until the Treaty of Roskilde in 1658 ceded the Scanian provinces to Sweden. Danish attempts to win them back, including the Scanian War of 1675 to 1679, failed; Sweden then pressed assimilation through Swedish law and worship and founded the University of Lund in 1666.
zh: 斯堪尼亚之地由斯堪尼亚、哈兰和布莱金厄诸省组成，是厄勒海峡以东富庶的丹麦土地；其省议事会是选举丹麦国王的三大议事会之一，而约1200年成文的斯堪尼亚法是现存最古老的北欧地方法。首府隆德于1104年成为大主教驻地，数个世纪里是整个斯堪的纳维亚的首席主教区。1180年代当地因抗税爆发起义，被瓦尔德马一世和阿布萨隆镇压。1332年，穷困的丹麦王室已把这些省份抵押给荷尔斯泰因伯爵，任其转入瑞典的马格努斯·埃里克松之手，因此1337年它们是由瑞典领有、居民却说丹麦语的封地。瓦尔德马四世·阿道戴于1360年重新征服斯堪尼亚，此后三百年间它一直属于丹麦，直到1658年《罗斯基勒条约》把斯堪尼亚诸省割让给瑞典。丹麦收复失地的努力（包括1675至1679年的斯堪尼亚战争）均告失败；瑞典随后推行瑞典法律和礼拜以促进同化，并于1666年创办隆德大学。

en: Shaki is a walled city of the southern Caucasus foothills on the road between the Caspian and the Georgian lands, in the historical province of Shirvan. Settled since the late Bronze Age, it took its name from the Iranian Saka nomads who occupied the region in the seventh century BC and became one of the chief cities of Caucasian Albania, whose main temple stood there. The Arab conquest of 654 brought Islam, and as caliphal power waned the Armenian Smbatean princes ruled Shaki as the core of the principality of Hereti. After the Kiurikian kings and the Georgian conquest under David IV in 1117, it passed through the hands of the Azerbaijani atabegs, the Khwarazmians and the Mongols. In the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries it belonged to the Shirvanshahs, until the local Orlat clan seized power in the 1330s and ruled an independent Shaki after the collapse of the Ilkhanate. Timur stormed the city in 1392 and later carried its prince on campaign, and from 1444 a hereditary Muslim dynasty of Armenian origin governed until the Safavids ended its rule in 1551. Ottoman occupation twice interrupted Safavid government, and in 1743 Haji Chelebi founded the independent Shaki Khanate, whose silk wealth and the khan's palace built in 1762 made the city famous. The treaties of Kyurekchay in 1805 and Gulistan in 1813 delivered Shaki to Russia, and the khanate was abolished in 1819.
zh: 沙基是南高加索山麓的一座城邑，坐落在里海与格鲁吉亚之间的商路上，属历史上的希尔凡地区。早在青铜时代晚期便有人定居，城名来自公元前7世纪占据此地的伊朗语游牧民族萨卡人，后来成为高加索阿尔巴尼亚的主要城市之一，阿尔巴尼亚人的主神庙就设在这里。654年阿拉伯人征服后伊斯兰教传入；哈里发势力衰落时，亚美尼亚的斯姆巴特王公以沙基为核心建立赫列提公国。此后历经基乌里基王朝和1117年格鲁吉亚大卫四世的征服，又先后落入阿塞拜疆的阿塔伯克诸朝、花剌子模和蒙古人之手。13至14世纪它臣属于希尔万沙，14世纪30年代本地的奥拉特部族夺权，在伊儿汗国崩溃后统治着独立的沙基。1392年帖木儿攻破该城，后来又带其君主从征；1444年起，一个亚美尼亚血统的穆斯林世袭王朝统治此地，直到1551年被萨法维王朝终结。奥斯曼人曾两度打断萨法维的统治；1743年哈吉·切莱比建立独立的沙基汗国，丝绸之利与1762年修建的汗宫使这座城市闻名远近。1805年的《库雷克恰伊条约》和1813年的《古利斯坦条约》把沙基交给俄罗斯，汗国于1819年被废除。

en: Sikkim, the Drenjong or rice valley of Tibetan sources and Zhe Mengxiong in Qing records, is the small Himalayan kingdom between Nepal, Bhutan and Tibet. Its earliest known inhabitants were the Lepcha pastoralists of the southern slopes, with Limbu and Magar communities in the western hills; tradition holds that Padmasambhava crossed the land in the eighth century and blessed it. In the seventh century it formed part of the Tibetan Empire, and after the empire's ninth-century collapse its valleys lived as independent tribes whose monasteries still answered to Lhasa. The monarchy itself was founded only in 1642, when Phuntsog Namgyal, a Bhutia noble whose ancestor Khye Bumsa had come south from the Minyak country in Kham in the fourteenth century, was consecrated first Chogyal, or priest-king, by three lamas at Yuksom. His Namgyal dynasty ruled as a Tibetan protectorate, and in 1670 the capital moved from Yuksom to Rabdentse. Gorkha Nepal and Bhutan overran much of the country from the mid-eighteenth century; the Nepalese sack of Rabdentse in 1788 drew in a Qing army under Fukang'an, and after the Anglo-Nepalese War the 1817 Treaty of Titalia tied Sikkim to British India.
zh: 锡金在藏文文献中称“登疆”，意为稻米之谷，清代典籍则称哲孟雄，是夹在尼泊尔、不丹和西藏之间的喜马拉雅小邦。当地最早的居民是南坡的雷布查牧民，西林山地还分布着林布人和马加尔人；相传8世纪莲花生路过此地并为之加持。7世纪时它是吐蕃的一部分，吐蕃于9世纪崩溃后，各山谷成为独立部落，境内寺院仍隶属西藏各大寺。君主制迟至1642年才建立：菩提亚贵族蓬楚格·纳穆加尔的先祖凯尔布姆萨于14世纪从康区的明雅地方南迁，这一年他在域松被三位喇嘛拥立为第一代却嘉，即法王，开创纳穆加尔王朝，作为西藏的藩属立国。1670年，首都从域松迁往拉布登策。18世纪中叶起，廓尔喀尼泊尔和不丹大举入侵，1788年廓尔喀军攻陷拉布登策，引来福康安统率的清军；英尼战争之后，1817年的《蒂塔利亚条约》又把锡金与英属印度绑在了一起。

en: Suakin is a coral-built port on a sheltered inlet of the Red Sea coast of the Beja country. The geographer al-Hamdani already knew it as an ancient Beja settlement in the tenth century, and it grew into a major emporium after the nearby port of Badi was abandoned, its merchants linking India, the Hijaz and the African interior and carrying pilgrims to Mecca. In 1264 a Mamluk army from Qus drove out its ruler Ala al-Din al-Asba'ani, and the town formally submitted to the sultans of Cairo in 1317. When Ibn Battuta visited in 1332 he found it ruled by the sharif Zayd ibn Abi Numayy, son of a Meccan sharif, who had inherited local leadership through his Beja maternal kin. As Mamluk power waned the Hedareb took the town and made it their capital, and the destruction of rival Aydhab in 1426 left Suakin the foremost port of the north-east African coast. It was briefly held by the Adal sultanate and attacked by the Portuguese in 1513 and 1541. The Ottomans occupied it in the 1550s and made it the seat of the Habesh pashalik, though the Cape route had already begun its long decline, and by the early nineteenth century much of the old coral city lay in ruins.
zh: 萨瓦金是贝贾人之地红海海岸上一座用珊瑚石建造、踞于隐蔽海湾内的港口。地理学家哈姆达尼在10世纪就已知道它是一座古老的贝贾聚落；邻近的巴迪港废弃后，它成长为重要商埠，商人往来于印度、汉志与非洲内陆之间，并运送前往麦加的朝圣者。1264年，一支来自古斯的马穆鲁克军队赶走了它的统治者阿拉丁·阿斯巴尼；1317年，该城正式臣服于开罗的苏丹。伊本·白图泰1332年到访时，统治这里的是谢里夫扎伊德·伊本·阿比·努马伊，他是麦加谢里夫之子，通过贝贾人的母系亲属继承了当地权位。马穆鲁克势力衰落后，哈达里巴人夺取该城并立为都城；1426年竞争对手阿伊扎布被毁，萨瓦金遂成为东北非沿海首屈一指的港口。它曾短暂归属阿达尔苏丹国，并在1513年和1541年遭葡萄牙人进攻。1550年代奥斯曼人占领萨瓦金，将其设为哈贝什帕夏辖区的驻地，但绕好望角航路的开辟已开启它漫长的衰落，到19世纪初，这座珊瑚古城已有大半沦为废墟。

en: Suket was a Sen-ruled hill state in the Sutlej valley of the Punjab Hills, its rajas keeping their seat at Pangna. Tradition traces the line to Bira Sen, a son of the Sena dynasty of Bengal, and the rulers long warred with their neighbour Kullu, which Raja Bikram Sen at last forced to pay tribute; under Raja Madan Sen the smaller surrounding states also submitted, making his reign Suket's golden age. When the Mughals reached the hills in the days of Raja Udai Sen, Suket submitted and was left to itself on payment of tribute. In 1527 the dynasty's lands split when Ajbar Sen founded the separate state of Mandi, which grew into Suket's equal and neighbour. Suket kept its autonomy through the Gurkha incursions of 1803 to 1815 and the following Sikh supremacy, as Raja Bikram Sen II played the greater powers off against one another.
zh: 苏盖德是旁遮普山区萨特莱杰河谷中一个由森王朝统治的山邦，罗阇们以庞格纳为治所。按传统说法，王统可追溯到孟加拉犀那王朝王子维拉·森；历代罗阇长期与邻邦库鲁交战，最终比克拉姆·森迫使库鲁纳贡，到马丹·森时周围小邦也纷纷臣服，他的时代成为苏盖德的黄金时代。莫卧儿势力在乌代·森时进入山区，苏盖德称臣纳贡，内政得以照旧。1527年王统领地分裂，阿杰巴尔·森另建曼迪邦，后来发展成与苏盖德并立的邻邦。1803至1815年廓尔喀人入侵，随后锡克人势力笼罩山区，罗阇比克拉姆·森二世周旋于列强之间，使苏盖德保住了自治地位。

en: Starodub-on-the-Klyazma was the seat of one of the smallest Russian principalities, a town on the Klyazma River in the Opolye district, not far from modern Kovrov. Settlers named it after Starodub in Severia, and in 1238, during the Mongol invasion, Prince Ivan, the youngest son of Vsevolod III of Vladimir, made the town his seat. For more than a century his descendants, the Starodub branch of the Rurikids, held this tiny appanage between two expanding neighbours, Moscow and Nizhny Novgorod. In the 1370s Dmitry Donskoy annexed it, and the princely family moved into Muscovite service, giving rise to such boyar houses as the Gagarins, Khilkovs, Romodanovskys and Pozharskys. The old town was burned to the ground by a Polish raiding party under Lisowski in 1609 and was never rebuilt; the village of Klyazminsky Gorodok now marks its site.
zh: 克利亚济马河畔斯塔罗杜布是罗斯最小的公国之一的都城，这座城镇位于奥波利耶地区的克利亚济马河畔，离科夫罗夫不远。移民以故乡谢维里亚的斯塔罗杜布为它命名；1238年蒙古入侵期间，弗拉基米尔大公弗谢沃洛德三世的幼子伊凡以该城为治所。一个多世纪里，他的后裔——留里克王朝的斯塔罗杜布支系——在莫斯科和下诺夫哥罗德两个扩张中的强邻之间保有这块小小的封邑。14世纪70年代德米特里·顿斯科伊将其兼并，斯塔罗杜布家族转入莫斯科服役，衍生出加加林、希尔科夫、罗莫达诺夫斯基、波扎尔斯基等波雅尔家族。1609年旧城被利索夫斯基率领的波兰袭掠部队焚毁，再未重建，克利亚济明斯基戈罗多克村就坐落在其遗址上。

en: Silat was a small Dayak river polity on the upper Kapuas in what is now Kapuas Hulu Regency of West Kalimantan. Local tradition names it as a neighbour of the stronger kingdom of Selimbau, which came to dominate the upper-Kapuas chieftaincies in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.
zh: 锡拉特是卡普阿斯河上游的达雅克河域小邦，位于今天印度尼西亚西加里曼丹省上卡普阿斯县境内。地方传说把它记作较强的塞林包王国的邻邦，17至18世纪上卡普阿斯的小酋长邦相继受塞林包支配。

en: The Suldus were a Darligin Mongol tribe who in the twelfth century lived attached to the Tayichiud and helped Genghis Khan against them. Sorgan-Shira, one of the khan's nine early companions, was a Suldus, and his son Chilaun became one of the Four Stewards and a guards commander; Chilaun's descendants rose as the Chobanids, the family of the Ilkhanid commander Chupan, who in 1327 was named chief commander of all the Mongol khanates and whose line later ruled Iranian Azerbaijan. Suldus mingghans were among the eight thousand households given to Chagatai, and after the conquests they settled in Transoxiana and northern Afghanistan, around Balkh and the upper Oxus. When the Chagatai Khanate disintegrated, the Suldus amir Buyan joined Hajji Beg of the Barlas in revolting against Qara'una rule in 1359, overthrew Abdullah ibn Qazaghan and briefly set the pace in Transoxiana before Tughlugh Timur of Moghulistan executed him in 1362. Other Suldus groups moved west into Azerbaijan and Iran, while a branch survives among the Hazaras as the Dai Chopan.
zh: 速勒都思是迭儿列勤蒙古的一支，12世纪时依附泰赤乌部，后来在成吉思汗与泰赤乌的战争中倒戈相助。成吉思汗早年九位同伴之一的锁儿罕失剌就出自该部，其子赤老温是“四杰”之一、怯薛长官；赤老温的后裔发展为出班家族，伊利汗国名将出班于1327年被元朝册封为诸蒙古汗国的总指挥官，其后人还一度在伊朗阿塞拜疆建立政权。速勒都思千户是封给察合台的八千属民之一，西征后定居河中与阿富汗北部，游牧于巴尔赫和阿姆河上游一带。察合台汗国瓦解时，速勒都思异密巴颜联合巴鲁剌思的哈吉·伯克于1359年起事，推翻合扎罕之子阿卜杜拉，一度左右河中政局，最终于1362年被蒙兀儿斯坦的图黑鲁·帖木儿处死。另有支系西迁阿塞拜疆和伊朗，还有一支以“戴出班”之名留存于哈扎拉人之中。

en: The Sabuli were a Kurdish tribal chiefdom of the Mukriyan highlands, centered on Savojbolagh, the modern Mahabad, and holding Piranshahr. In 1337 their chiefs ruled the district as Jalayirid vassals, among the local Kurdish lordships that the Mukri principality later unified from the late fourteenth century onward.
zh: 萨布利人是穆克里扬山区的一个库尔德部落酋长政权，以萨沃季布拉格（即今马哈巴德）为中心，领有皮兰沙赫尔。1337年，其首领作为札剌亦儿王朝的附庸统治该地区；14世纪末以后，穆克里埃米尔国逐渐统一了这些本地库尔德领地。

en: The County of Salm in the Vosges, later called Upper Salm, was the mountain lordship of the House of Salm, a Lotharingian noble family whose ancestor Hermann of Salm had been elected anti-king against Henry IV in 1081. In 1163 the family's lands were split: the Ardennes estates became Lower Salm, while the Vosges estates around the castle of Salm near Schirmeck became Upper Salm. The counts served as advocates of Senones Abbey, and from 1205 Count Henry III rebuilt the castle of Salm as their seat, with Badonviller as their lowland residence. Hemmed in by the Prince-Bishopric of Strasbourg to the north and the Duchy of Lorraine to the south, the county was partitioned more than once: Salm-Blankenburg split off in 1246 and Salm-Badenweiler in 1431. In 1337 the county was ruled by Count Henry VI of the House of Salm. In 1475 half of Upper Salm passed by inheritance to the Wild- and Rhinegraves of Dhaun and Kyrburg, who took the title of counts of Salm and were raised to princely rank in 1623; the other half fell to the dukes of Lorraine in 1600. The surviving line formed the Principality of Salm-Salm in 1751, until French Revolutionary troops annexed the Vosges lands in 1793.
zh: 孚日山区的萨尔姆伯国后称上萨尔姆，是萨尔姆家族的山地领地。这个洛林贵族家族的先祖赫尔曼·冯·萨尔姆曾于1081年被推举为对立国王，与亨利四世分庭抗礼。1163年家族领地被一分为二：阿登的产业成为下萨尔姆，希尔梅克附近、围绕萨尔姆城堡的孚日产业成为上萨尔姆。历代伯爵兼任瑟农修道院的护院官，1205年起亨利三世伯爵重修萨尔姆城堡作为治所，并以巴东维莱为低地居所。伯国北邻斯特拉斯堡采邑主教区、南接洛林公国，疆域一再分割：1246年分出萨尔姆-布兰肯堡，1431年又分出萨尔姆-巴登韦勒。1337年在位的是萨尔姆家族的亨利六世伯爵。1475年，上萨尔姆的一半由道恩和基尔堡的荒野-莱茵伯爵继承，他们承袭萨尔姆伯爵头衔，并于1623年晋升诸侯；另一半则于1600年落入洛林公爵之手。存续的支系于1751年组成萨尔姆-萨尔姆侯国，其孚日领地最终在1793年被法国革命军吞并。

en: Carbury, in Irish Cairbre Drom Cliabh, was a Gaelic túath of Lower Connacht along the coast beneath Benbulbin, in what is now County Sligo, with the harbour town of Sligo as its seat. It took its name from the early king Cairbre mac Néill and was also called Cairbre na Catha, Carbury of the Battles; Saint Colmcille founded the monastery of Drumcliff there in 575. From the later twelfth century its lords were the Ó Conchobhair Sligigh, or O'Conor Sligo, a junior branch of the kings of Connacht descended from Brian Luighnech Ua Conchobhair, who was killed in 1181. As a frontier saor-túath it paid no tribute, and amid the Burke Civil War of the 1330s its chiefs extended their power across Lower Connacht; Maghnus Mac Cathail, the ruler in 1337, headed the line of lords of Sligo recorded for the next three centuries. In later times the O'Conors struggled to hold back the O'Donnells of Tyrconnell, and their independence ended with the collapse of the Gaelic order after the Nine Years' War in 1603.
zh: 卡伯里，爱尔兰语称凯尔布雷·德罗姆克利夫，是下康诺特的一个盖尔图阿特，位于本布尔本山麓的海岸，即今天的斯莱戈郡，以港口城镇斯莱戈为治所。其名取自早期国王凯尔布雷·麦克·尼尔，又称凯尔布雷·纳卡塔，意为“百战卡伯里”；575年，圣科伦基尔在此创立鼓崖修道院。12世纪后期起，这里的领主是奥康诺·斯莱戈家族，即康诺特诸王的旁支，始祖为1181年战死的布莱恩·卢伊格内赫·奥·康乔巴尔。作为边境的免贡图阿特，它无须纳贡；趁14世纪30年代伯克内战之机，其首领把势力扩张到整个下康诺特，1337年在位的马格努斯·麦克·卡瑟尔正是此后三百年间斯莱戈领主世系的一环。后来奥康诺家族苦苦抵挡蒂龙奈尔的奥唐奈家族，其独立地位最终在1603年九年战争结束、盖尔秩序崩溃时告终。

en: Selaparang, also called the Kingdom of Lombok, was the Sasak kingdom of Lombok island in the Lesser Sunda Islands, its court at Selaparang in the island's east. The fourteenth-century Javanese court poem Negarakertagama already described Lombok as split between two native realms, Lombok Mirah in the east and Sasak Adhi in the west, and tradition calls this early, Hindu-influenced phase Hindu Selaparang. Islam spread among the Sasak from the fifteenth century, and under Prabu Rangkesari the united kingdom reached its height: its navy repelled two invasions by the Balinese kingdom of Gelgel in 1616 and 1624, the court moved inland from the silting coastal bay to Selaparang, and its sway crossed the sea to western Sumbawa. Its fleets drove off Dutch East India Company attacks in 1667 and 1668 but lost western Sumbawa, and around 1692 it fell to a Karangasem expedition from Bali after the noble Arya Banjar Getas turned against his king. From 1740 the island was partitioned between Karangasem and its local allies, and Balinese lords ruled the old Selaparang lands thereafter.
zh: 沙拉巴朗又称龙目王国，是小巽他群岛龙目岛上的萨萨克人王国，王廷设在岛东部的沙拉巴朗。14世纪的爪哇宫廷史诗《爪哇史颂》已把龙目记为两个本土政权分治之岛，即东部的龙目米拉和西部的萨萨克阿迪；传统说法把这个受印度教影响的早期阶段称为印度教沙拉巴朗。15世纪起伊斯兰教在萨萨克人中传播，到普拉布·朗克萨里在位时，统一的王国进入鼎盛：其水师于1616年和1624年两次击退巴厘岛格尔格尔王国的入侵，王廷从淤塞的海湾内迁到沙拉巴朗，势力还跨海达到松巴哇西部。1667年和1668年，它的舰队击退了荷兰东印度公司的进攻，但失去了西松巴哇；约1692年，贵族阿里亚·班查尔·格塔斯叛主，引导巴厘的卡朗阿森远征军灭掉了王国。1740年起，龙目被卡朗阿森与其当地盟友瓜分，旧沙拉巴朗之地此后由巴厘贵族统治。

en: Solothurn, on the Aare at the foot of the Jura, grew from the Roman road station of Salodurum, first mentioned in 219 and fortified with a castrum in the fourth century. In the Early Middle Ages it passed from Lotharingia to the Second Kingdom of Burgundy, and in 1033, when Burgundy joined the Holy Roman Empire, it became an imperial town; Emperor Conrad II held court there in 1038 and crowned his son Henry III king of Burgundy. The dukes of Zähringen acquired it in 1127, and after their line died out in 1218 it became a free imperial city. A town council with its own seal is recorded from 1252, and Emperor Rudolf I confirmed its privileges in 1276 and 1280. The guilds won a share of power during the fourteenth century, and in 1344 the city secured the right to appoint its own Schultheiss, or mayor. An alliance with Bern in 1295 drew Solothurn into the Swiss Confederation; it fought the Habsburgs at Sempach in 1386, enlarged its territory through neighbouring acquisitions in the fifteenth century, and became a full member of the Confederation in 1481. From 1530 to 1792 the city housed the French embassy to the Swiss Confederation.
zh: 索洛图恩位于阿勒河畔、侏罗山脚下，前身是罗马道路驿站萨洛杜鲁姆，219年首见记载，4世纪修筑了军营城堡。中世纪早期它先后归属洛塔林吉亚和第二勃艮第王国；1033年勃艮第并入神圣罗马帝国后，它成为帝国城市，1038年皇帝康拉德二世在此驻跸，并为儿子亨利三世加冕为勃艮第国王。1127年它转入策林根公爵之手，1218年策林格家族绝嗣，它成为帝国自由城市。1252年已有市议会和自己的印章，1276年和1280年皇帝鲁道夫一世两度确认其特权。14世纪行会争取到参政权，1344年城市获得自行任命市长的权利。1295年与伯尔尼的结盟把索洛图恩带入瑞士邦联，1386年它在森帕赫战役中对哈布斯堡作战，15世纪通过兼并邻近土地扩大疆域，1481年成为邦联正式成员。1530年至1792年，法国驻瑞士邦联的大使馆设在该城。

en: The Duchy of Schleswig, also called South Jutland, covered the neck of the Jutland peninsula between the Eider river and the Danish heartland, with Flensburg, Schleswig and Haderslev as its chief towns. A Danish fief rather than a state of the Holy Roman Empire, it was home to Danes, North Frisians and Low German speakers, and had guarded the crossing between the North Sea and the Baltic since the days of the Viking trading town of Hedeby and the Danevirke wall. From the mid-thirteenth century the duchy was held by the line descended from King Abel of the Danish Estridsen dynasty. In 1326 the young Duke Valdemar V, born in 1314, was placed on the Danish throne as Valdemar III under the regency of his uncle Gerhard III of Holstein-Rendsburg, while the Constitutio Valdemariana laid down that Schleswig and Denmark could never be united under one ruler. He abdicated in 1329 and ruled his duchy again as a Danish vassal in 1337. When Valdemar died in 1364 and his son Henry in 1375, the Abel line ended; in 1386 the duchy was enfeoffed to the Schauenburg counts of Holstein-Rendsburg, and the assembly of Ribe in 1460 joined Schleswig and Holstein under Christian I of Denmark, never to be divided. Early modern partitions split the duchy between the Danish crown and the Gottorp dukes, whose share was absorbed by Denmark after the Great Northern War and the settlement of 1773.
zh: 石勒苏益格公国又称南日德兰，雄踞日德兰半岛的咽喉，北接丹麦本土，南抵艾德河，主要城市有弗伦斯堡、石勒苏益格和哈泽斯莱乌。它是丹麦的封臣领地，而非神圣罗马帝国的一部分，居民有丹麦人、北弗里斯兰人和讲低地德语的人群；早在维京时代，这里就凭海泽比商镇和丹麦边墙扼守着北海与波罗的海之间的通道。13世纪中叶起，公国由丹麦埃斯特里德王朝国王阿贝尔的后裔世袭。1326年，生于1314年的年轻公爵瓦尔德马五世被扶上丹麦王位，称瓦尔德马三世，由舅父荷尔斯泰因‑伦茨堡的格哈德三世摄政；同时颁布的《瓦尔德马宪章》规定石勒苏益格与丹麦永远不得由同一人统治。他于1329年退位，1337年时已重新以丹麦封臣的身份统治自己的公国。瓦尔德马1364年去世，其子亨利又于1375年身亡，阿贝尔一系就此断绝；1386年公国被封给荷尔斯泰因‑伦茨堡的绍恩堡伯爵，1460年的里伯会议把石勒苏益格与荷尔斯泰因一同交给丹麦国王克里斯蒂安一世，约定两地永不分割。近代的分封使公国由丹麦王室与戈托普公爵分治，后者的领地在大北方战争后及1773年的安排中被丹麦收并。

en: The Prince-Archbishopric of Salzburg was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire in the Salzach valley, ruled from the former Roman town of Iuvavum, now Salzburg. The archdiocese was founded by Saint Boniface in 739, and from the late thirteenth century its archbishops won imperial immediacy and independence from the Bavarian dukes. Archbishop Eberhard II of Regensberg was raised to a prince of the Empire in 1213 and founded the suffragan sees of Chiemsee, Seckau and Lavant. In 1337 the see was held by Frederick III of Leibnitz, who had been elected in 1315. When the Black Death reached Salzburg in 1347, the Jews were accused of poisoning the wells and bitterly persecuted. Leonard of Keutschach, archbishop from 1495, curbed the rebellious town councils, while his successor Matthäus Lang brought in Saxon miners whose Protestant books helped spark the peasant uprisings of the 1520s. Wolf Dietrich von Raitenau then gave Protestants the choice of conversion or exile and rebuilt the cathedral in lavish baroque style, and Paris von Lodron kept the little state neutral and prosperous through the Thirty Years' War. In 1731 Leopold Anton von Firmian expelled more than twenty thousand Protestants, most of whom settled in Prussia. The last prince-archbishop, Hieronymus von Colloredo, patron of Mozart, lost his secular power when the archbishopric was secularized in 1803; the territory passed to Austria in 1805 and to Bavaria in 1809 before the archdiocese was restored without temporal rule in 1818.
zh: 萨尔茨堡采邑大主教区是神圣罗马帝国在萨尔察赫河谷的教会邦国，统治中心是古罗马城镇尤瓦武姆的旧址，即后来的萨尔茨堡。总教区由圣波尼法爵于739年建立；13世纪末起，大主教逐步取得帝国直辖地位，摆脱了巴伐利亚公爵的控制。1213年，大主教雷根斯贝格的埃伯哈德二世受封帝国亲王，并创立了基姆湖、塞考和拉万特三个附属主教区。1337年在任的是1315年当选的弗里德里希三世·冯·莱布尼茨。1347年黑死病传入萨尔茨堡，犹太人被指控投毒，遭到残酷迫害。1495年就任的大主教克伊查赫的莱昂哈德制服了抗命的市议会；继任者马特乌斯·朗·冯·韦伦堡引入萨克森矿工，他们带来的新教书籍助长了16世纪20年代的农民起义。此后沃尔夫·迪特里希·冯·赖特瑙要求新教徒要么改宗要么流亡，并以华丽的巴洛克风格重建主教座堂；帕里斯·冯·洛德龙则使这个小邦在三十年战争中保持中立和繁荣。1731年，利奥波德·安东·冯·菲尔米安驱逐了两万多名新教徒，其中多数移居普鲁士。末任采邑大主教、莫扎特的庇护者希罗尼穆斯·冯·科洛雷多于1803年大主教区世俗化时失去世俗权力；领地1805年归奥地利、1809年归巴伐利亚，总教区于1818年恢复，已不再拥有世俗统治权。

en: The Samma domains were the rising power of fourteenth-century Sindh, built by the Samma, a Muslim Sindhi tribe whose chiefs took the title of jam, meaning sultan. They had long stood beside the Soomras as one of the two great landholding groups of the Indus valley, and in 1333 the traveller Ibn Battuta found them in open revolt under Jam Tamachi. They overthrew the Soomras soon after 1335, and when Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq of Delhi died on campaign in Sindh in 1351, Jam Unar made the dynasty fully independent; Firuz Shah Tughluq's expeditions of 1365 and 1367 reimposed tribute only briefly. Their early stronghold was the ancient Indus city of Sehwan, the old Sindomana stormed by Muhammad bin Qasim in 711, before the court settled at Samanagar, later Thatta. The sultanate reached its golden age under Jam Nizamuddin II, who reigned from 1461 to 1508, made Thatta a great textile market and endowed the Makli necropolis; his vizier Darya Khan defeated an Arghun invasion near Sibi. A succession war after his death opened the way for Shah Beg Arghun, who overthrew the last jam at the Battle of Fatehpur in 1519.
zh: 萨姆玛是14世纪信德兴起的强权，由穆斯林信德部落萨姆玛人建立，其首领采用意为苏丹的称号贾姆。他们与苏姆拉人长期并称印度河流域两大土地集团，1333年旅行家伊本·白图泰已见到他们在贾姆·塔马奇率领下公开反叛。1335年后不久他们推翻苏姆拉人，1351年德里苏丹穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克在征信德途中身亡，贾姆·乌纳尔遂使王朝完全独立；菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克1365和1367年的远征也只短暂恢复了贡赋。他们早期的重镇是印度河畔的古城塞赫万，即711年被穆罕默德·本·卡西姆攻陷的辛多马纳，后来宫廷定于萨马纳加尔，也就是后来的特达。贾姆·尼扎姆丁二世在位的1461至1508年是苏丹国的黄金时代，特达成为大型纺织品市场，马克利墓地也在此时营建；他的维齐尔达尔亚汗还在锡比附近击败了阿尔浑人的入侵。他死后爆发继承战争，沙阿·贝格·阿尔浑乘机于1519年在法塔赫布尔战役中推翻末代贾姆。

en: Sambas was an old Dayak state on the north-west coast of Borneo, on the Sambas River near the South China Sea. Local tradition traces it to the seventh-century kingdom of Sanujuh of the Bakati Dayak, and it is named among the tributary lands in the Nagarakretagama of 1365, where it appears as part of the Tanjungnegara province conquered for Majapahit by Gajah Mada; in the fourteenth century its rulers, titled Ratu, were vassals of Tanjungpura. Sitting on the shipping lane between China, Champa and Java, Sambas drew Chinese traders, with a permanent Chinese settlement from 1407. In the early sixteenth century it passed under the influence of Demak and later paid tribute to Banjar. The old Hindu dynasty ended in the seventeenth century, when the Brunei prince Tengah married into the local royal house and his son founded the Muslim Sultanate of Sambas in 1675.
zh: 三发是婆罗洲西北海岸、三发河沿岸的古老达雅克国家，濒临南海。当地传统把它追溯到7世纪巴卡提达雅克人的萨努朱王国；1365年的《爪哇史颂》把三发列为满者伯夷的加查·马达所征服的丹戎尼加拉省诸朝贡地之一，14世纪时，称拉图的三发统治者是丹戎布拉的附庸。三发地处中国、占城与爪哇之间的航线上，吸引了中国商人，1407年已有华人定居点。16世纪初它受淡目影响，后来向班贾尔纳贡。旧的印度教王朝在17世纪终结：文莱王子登加入赘当地王室，他的儿子于1675年创立了伊斯兰化的三发苏丹国。

en: Samland is the Sambia Peninsula on the Baltic coast, home of the Sambians, a pagan Old Prussian tribe whose amber trade made their land the richest and most densely populated part of Prussia. The Teutonic Knights subdued them only in 1254 and 1255, in a campaign joined by King Ottokar II of Bohemia, after whom the new fortress of Königsberg was named. The Diocese of Samland had already been created in 1243 by the papal legate William of Modena as one of four Prussian bishoprics. Its cathedral chapter was established at Königsberg in 1285, while the bishops kept their residence at Fischhausen until 1523. Like the other Prussian dioceses it was tightly bound to the Teutonic Order, and in 1454 its territory was briefly absorbed into Poland before the Thirteen Years' War returned it to the Order as a Polish fief. Bishop George of Polentz introduced the Reformation in 1523, and after the creation of secular Ducal Prussia in 1525 the Lutheran bishopric gradually faded: its last incumbent died in 1577 and the Catholic see was formally dissolved in 1821.
zh: 萨姆兰即波罗的海沿岸的桑比亚半岛，居民是信奉异教的古普鲁士部族萨姆比亚人；琥珀贸易使这里成为普鲁士最富庶、人口最稠密的地区。条顿骑士团直到1254至1255年才征服他们，波希米亚国王奥托卡二世也参加了这场战役，新建的柯尼斯堡要塞即以他命名。萨姆兰教区早在1243年便由教皇特使摩德纳的威廉设立，是普鲁士四个主教区之一；1285年主教座堂参议会设于柯尼斯堡，而主教们在1523年之前一直驻节菲施豪森。与普鲁士其他教区一样，它与条顿骑士团关系紧密，1454年其领地一度被并入波兰，十三年战争后又作为波兰采邑重归骑士团。1523年，主教格奥尔格·冯·波伦茨引入宗教改革；1525年世俗的普鲁士公国建立后，路德宗主教区逐渐消亡，最后一任主教于1577年去世，天主教教区则在1821年被正式撤销。

en: The Principality of Samtskhe, ruled from Akhaltsikhe, covered the mountainous south of Georgia, including Javakheti and the old lands of Tao-Klarjeti. Its lords of the House of Jaqeli submitted to the Mongols in 1238, but Sargis I Jaqeli seceded from the Georgian crown in 1266 and placed himself directly under the Ilkhans, ruling an independent principality from 1268. In 1334 King George V brought Samtskhe back under royal authority and made the Jaqeli title of atabeg hereditary, after which the state was called Samtskhe-Saatabago. Timur's armies sacked Akhaltsikhe during the campaigns of 1386 to 1403, and the Kara Koyunlu and Aq Qoyunlu Turkomans raided the land repeatedly through the fifteenth century. Qvarqvare II defeated King George VIII near Lake Paravani in 1465 and broke away from Georgia for good. As the Ottomans and Safavids closed in, King Bagrat III of Imereti captured Qvarqvare III at the Battle of Murjakheti in 1535 and annexed the principality, but an Ottoman victory at Sokhoista in 1545 reduced Samtskhe to vassalage. The Jaqelis adopted Islam after 1578 and ruled on as hereditary pashas of Akhaltsikhe until the Russian conquest of 1829.
zh: 萨姆茨赫公国以阿哈尔齐赫为统治中心，疆域覆盖格鲁吉亚南部山区，包括贾瓦赫季和古老的陶-克拉尔杰季地区。其统治者贾凯利家族于1238年臣服蒙古，但萨尔吉斯一世在1266年脱离格鲁吉亚王权、直接归附伊儿汗国，自1268年起成为独立公国。1334年，吉奥尔基五世重新确立对萨姆茨赫的宗主权，并把“阿塔贝格”头衔定为贾凯利家族世袭，该国此后被称为萨姆茨赫-萨塔巴戈。1386—1403年帖木儿大军接连来犯，阿哈尔齐赫遭到洗劫；整个15世纪，黑羊王朝与白羊王朝的土库曼人又频频入侵。1465年，克瓦克瓦雷二世在帕拉瓦尼湖附近击败格鲁吉亚国王吉奥尔基八世，彻底脱离格鲁吉亚。随着奥斯曼与萨法维东西夹击，伊梅列季国王巴格拉特三世于1535年在穆尔贾赫季战役中生擒克瓦克瓦雷三世并吞并公国，但奥斯曼军队1545年在索霍伊斯塔获胜，萨姆茨赫沦为其附庸。1578年后贾凯利家族改宗伊斯兰教，以阿哈尔齐赫世袭帕夏的身份继续统治，直到1829年被俄国征服。

en: Siming was a Zhuang tusi holding in the far south of Guangxi, centered on the Mingjiang valley at present-day Ningming on the border with Annam, with Pingxiang and Shangsi among its dependencies. A Siming prefecture existed there under the Tang and Song as a jimi office, its hereditary chiefs drawn from the Huang clan, the dominant Zhuang chiefly family of the Zuo River region. Under the Yuan it became Siming Route, administered through the Guangxi Liangjiang pacification office, and in 1369 the Ming reorganized it as Siming Prefecture. Its frontier position cost it territory: in 1426 the Xiping and Lu subprefectures were absorbed by Annam, the Vietnamese kingdom to the south. Shangsi was detached to Nanning Prefecture in 1505, and in 1588 the prefecture's own Siming Subprefecture was transferred to neighboring Taiping, followed by the Upper Shixi stockade in 1610. Under the Qing the remaining lands were divided into the Si and Ningming subprefectures, with Siming Subprefecture restored to the prefecture in 1727, and in 1731 the native people of the fifty-three stockades of the Ming River were placed under Ningming Subprefecture.
zh: 思明是广西极南边的壮族土司辖地，以明江流域、今宁明一带为中心，与安南接壤，凭祥、上思等地曾隶属其下。唐宋时期这里就设有羁縻性质的思明州，世袭土官出自左江壮族望族黄氏。元代升为思明路，由广西两江道宣慰司管辖；1369年明朝改设思明府。地处边境使它不断失地：1426年，西平州和禄州被南边的安南国吞并。1505年上思州改属南宁府，1588年府辖思明州划归邻近的太平府，上石西州也于1610年改隶太平府。清代余下辖地被分为思州和宁明州，思明州于1727年复归思明府管辖，1731年明江五十三寨的土民又划归宁明州管治。

en: Sanmalan was a precolonial state on the Zamboanga peninsula of Mindanao, standing on the ancestral lands of the Subanon people, with its capital probably at the site of present-day Zamboanga City. Chinese annals call it Sanmalan and record that its ruler Rajah Chulan sent the envoy Ali Bakti to the imperial court in 1011 with aromatics, ivory, glassware, refined sugar and rose-water, goods that point to trade links reaching Western Asia. By the time Zhao Rugua compiled the Zhufan Zhi in 1225, the same port, now named Shahuagong, had changed character: its people put to sea as raiders, bound their captives and sold them as slaves to Java. In the centuries before the Spanish arrival Sanmalan passed under the protection of the Sultanate of Sulu, and the Spaniards in turn took the semi-independent polity under their own protectorate.
zh: 三马兰是棉兰老岛三宝颜半岛上的前殖民政权，地处苏巴农人的祖居之地，都城可能就在今天三宝颜市一带。中国史籍称其为三麻蘭，记载其王朱兰罗阇于1011年派使臣阿里·巴克蒂入朝，贡品中有香料、象牙、玻璃器、白糖和玫瑰水，这些货物显示其贸易网络远及西亚。到1225年赵汝适编撰《诸蕃志》时，这个港口已改称沙华公，性质也为之一变：居民出海劫掠，把俘虏捆绑后卖到爪哇为奴。在西班牙人到来之前的几个世纪里，三马兰沦为苏禄苏丹国的保护国，西班牙人抵达后又把这个半独立政权置于自己的保护之下。

en: Shilimian corresponds to the Ming Shilimian Guard, established near present Hulin on the lower Ussuri in the early fifteenth century as one of the guards of the Nurgan commission, alongside the Yima River Guard upstream. The country had been counted as Sushen land in antiquity and was long the home of Tungusic fishing and hunting peoples, ancestors of the Hezhen. Its Hūrga chiefs held the guard as a hereditary tributary post, trading furs to the Ming while ruling their own river villages. With Nurhaci's campaigns against the Wild Jurchens from 1596 to 1625, Shilimian was absorbed into the rising Later Jin state, and its people were in time registered in the Manchu banners.
zh: 失里绵对应明代的失里绵卫。15世纪初，明朝在今虎林一带的乌苏里江下游设该卫，隶属奴儿干都司，与上游的亦麻河卫等共同扼守乌苏里江一线。其地上古属肃慎之地，长期是通古斯系渔猎民族的家园，即赫哲人的先民所居。虎尔哈酋长以卫职世袭朝贡，向明朝贸易毛皮，同时自治其河畔村寨。1596—1625年努尔哈赤征讨野人女真，失里绵被崛起的后金吞并，部众后来被编入满洲八旗。

en: The Principality of Smolensk commanded the upper Dnieper and the trade roads linking Novgorod and Polotsk with Kiev, in the old country of the Krivichs. It became an independent Rurikid principality in 1125 under Rostislav Mstislavich, whose Rostislavichi descendants took the title of grand prince and ruled from Smolensk with Bryansk, Vyazma and Mozhaysk as appanages, and gained their own bishop in 1136. The Mongol age brought raids by Mindaugas of Lithuania and dependence on the grand princes of Vladimir, and from about 1339 Smolensk was pulled between Lithuania, Moscow and the Golden Horde: Algirdas captured the city in 1356 and again in 1359, yet its army fought beside Moscow at Kulikovo in 1380. After Prince Sviatoslav Ivanovich fell against the Lithuanians at the Vikhra River in 1386, Lithuanian influence grew, and in 1404 Vytautas annexed Smolensk outright. Reorganized as the Smolensk Voivodeship in 1508, the city fell to Vasili III of Moscow in 1514, was seized by the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth in 1611 during the Time of Troubles, and was finally ceded to Russia by the Treaty of Andrusovo in 1667.
zh: 斯摩棱斯克公国扼守第聂伯河上游，控制着连接诺夫哥罗德、波洛茨克与基辅的商路，地处古代克里维奇人的故土。1125年，它在罗斯季斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇治下成为独立的留里克公国，其后代罗斯季斯拉夫家族自称大公，以斯摩棱斯克为本城，领有布良斯克、维亚济马和莫扎伊斯克等封邑，并于1136年设立了自己的主教。蒙古时代，立陶宛的明道加斯屡次来犯，公国又沦为弗拉基米尔大公们的附庸；约1339年起，斯摩棱斯克被立陶宛、莫斯科和金帐汗国三方拉扯：阿尔吉尔达斯于1356年、1359年两度攻占该城，但斯摩棱斯克军队仍在1380年与莫斯科并肩参加库里科沃之战。1386年王公斯维亚托斯拉夫·伊万诺维奇在维赫拉河之战中死于立陶宛人之手后，立陶宛影响日深，1404年维陶塔斯最终吞并斯摩棱斯克。1508年它被改组为斯摩棱斯克省，1514年城池落入莫斯科的瓦西里三世之手，1611年动荡时代中又被波兰立陶宛联邦夺取，最终依1667年的《安德鲁索沃条约》正式割让给俄罗斯。

en: Simsir, also written Simsim in the Persian Zafarnama chronicles, was a medieval kingdom of the Nakh peoples, the ancestors of the Chechens and Ingush, occupying the mountain gorges of present-day Chechnya and Ingushetia and reaching the edge of the Kumyk plain. Founded around the middle of the twelfth century, it was a feudal monarchy ruled by a prince called the eela above nobles, free commoners, serfs and captives, and in the fourteenth century its rulers became tributaries of the Golden Horde while long remaining Christian. Its best-known prince, Gayur-khan of the Sado-Orsoy clan, was so trusted by Khan Khidir that he served as his envoy to the Rus cities, and when the Horde collapsed into civil war he defeated the warlord Mamai in 1362 and made Simsir an independent kingdom. Gayur-khan then backed Tokhtamysh, whose Nakh vanguard fought Timur at the Battle of the Terek in 1395. Timur's revenge campaign of the same year destroyed Simsir, drove its people into the high mountains and ended the kingdom, installing Gayur-khan's son Makhama as a Muslim vassal before both princes perished in the ensuing revolts. The survivors gave up princely rule for the free clan councils of the teips, and their mountain country became the Durdzuketia and later Chechnya that faced the Russian advance of the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries.
zh: 西姆西尔在波斯《武功记》等编年史中又写作西姆西姆，是纳赫人的中世纪王国。纳赫人即车臣人和印古什人的先民，疆域据有今车臣和印古什的高山峡谷，并延伸到库梅克平原边缘。它约在12世纪中叶形成，是封建君主国，国君称埃拉，其下依次为贵族、自由民、农奴和战俘。14世纪时其君主向金帐汗国称臣纳贡，但长期仍信奉基督教。最著名的王公是萨多-奥尔索伊氏族的加尤尔汗，他深得汗希德尔信任，曾作为金帐使者出使罗斯诸城；金帐陷入内战后，他于1362年击败军阀马迈，使西姆西尔成为独立王国。加尤尔汗随后支持脱脱迷失，纳赫士兵作为前锋参加了1395年的捷列克河之战。同年帖木儿兴兵报复，攻灭西姆西尔，把居民逼入深山，又立加尤尔汗之子马哈马为改宗伊斯兰教的附庸，随后两位王公都在变乱中被杀。幸存者放弃王公统治，改行自由的氏族议事会（泰普）制度，他们的山国便是后来的杜尔祖克和车臣，并在18至19世纪迎来俄罗斯的进逼。

en: The Sambuvarayar were Tamil chieftains of the Vanniyar community who rose under the imperial Cholas. Their earliest chiefs held the Oyma Nadu country as feudatories, and Edirili Chola Sambhuvaraya served Rajadhiraja II and Kulothunga III in the late twelfth century, governing the northern half of Tondai Nadu from their hill capital of Padaividu. Their title Nalayiravan recalled the four thousand soldiers they kept for their overlords. As Chola, Pandya and Hoysala power crumbled in the early fourteenth century, the family turned its fief into an independent kingdom covering the country of Kanchipuram, Vellore and Gingee: Venrumankonda Sambuvaraya dated records in his own regnal year from 1322, and Rajanarayana Sambuvaraya, the ruler of 1337, did the same. He first allied with Harihara I of Vijayanagara against the Madurai Sultanate, but Vijayanagara's southward expansion left no room for a vassal kingdom, and he was later killed by Bukka Raya I, after which the Sambuvarayar lands were absorbed into the Vijayanagara Empire.
zh: 三补缚罗耶尔是瓦尼雅尔社群的泰米尔酋长，在朱罗帝国治下兴起。其早期酋长以附庸身份统治奥伊马纳德地区，12世纪末的伊迪里利·朱罗·三补缚罗耶曾臣事罗阇帝罗阇二世和俱罗通伽三世，以山城波多毗都为中心管辖通代纳德的北半部。他们的头衔“那莱伊罗梵”意为四千人，指其为宗主供养的四千士卒。14世纪初朱罗、潘地亚和曷萨拉的势力相继崩塌，这个家族把封地变成独立王国，疆域涵盖建志补罗、韦洛尔和京吉一带：温鲁曼孔达·三补缚罗耶自1322年起以自己的年号发布文书，1337年在位的罗阇那罗延·三补缚罗耶也同样行事。他起初与毗奢耶那伽罗的诃利诃罗一世结盟对抗马杜赖苏丹国，但毗奢耶那伽罗的南扩不容附庸王国并存，他后来被布卡·罗耶一世杀死，三补缚罗耶尔的土地随之并入毗奢耶那伽罗帝国。

en: Sancaha was a Haixi Jurchen polity seated at Boduna, where the Nen river meets the Songhua on the Songnen plain. Early Ming records organized the same ground as the Sanchahe Guard, named for the river junction; under the Qing a relay station was set up at Boduna and a brick city, called Xincheng, was built to its south.
zh: 三察哈是以伯都讷为中心的海西女真政权，地当松嫩平原上嫩江与松花江交汇处。明初同一地带曾设三岔河卫，以河口的三岔河得名；清代在此设伯都讷站，又在其南另建砖城，称新城。

en: The lower Indus kingdom that kept the name Sindh in 1337 was the last domain of the Soomra dynasty, a local Muslim house that had risen in the eleventh century amid the collapse of the old Habbarid emirate. The Soomras held lower Sindh from towns such as Muhammad Tur, with some of their rulers attached to Isma'ili Shia Islam; Arab writers called them Qarmatians, and letters survive between them and the Fatimid caliph al-Mustansir Billah. One of their kings, Shimuddin Chamisar, submitted to Sultan Iltutmish of Delhi and ruled on as a vassal, and a Soomra branch founded the desert fort of Umarkot, which the clan recovered from the Sodha Rajputs in 1330. Their rule ended soon after 1335, when the rebel Samma tribe overthrew them; the last Soomra fled to the protection of Muhammad bin Tughluq, whose attempt to restore him ended with the sultan's own death in Sindh in 1351. The lands then passed through Samma, Arghun and Tarkhan hands; the fugitive Mughal Humayun found shelter at Umarkot in 1542, where Akbar was born, and Mughal armies annexed lower Sindh between 1591 and 1593. Mughal rule gave way to the Kalhoras in 1701 and then to the Talpurs in 1783.
zh: 1337年仍以信德为名的印度河下游王国，是11世纪乘旧哈巴里埃米尔国崩溃而兴起的本地穆斯林王朝苏姆拉的最后领地。苏姆拉人以穆罕默德图尔等城镇为中心据有下信德，部分统治者信奉伊斯玛仪派，阿拉伯作者称他们为卡尔马特派，他们与法蒂玛哈里发穆斯坦绥尔之间仍有信函存世。其国王希姆丁·查米萨尔曾向德里苏丹伊勒杜迷失称臣，作为附庸继续统治；苏姆拉的一个分支还修建了沙漠要塞欧迈尔果德，并于1330年从索达拉杰普特人手中夺回该城。1335年后不久，起兵的萨姆玛部落推翻了他们，末代苏姆拉君主投奔穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克庇护，而后者助其复位的远征以1351年苏丹本人死于信德告终。此后这片土地先后落入萨姆玛、阿尔浑和塔尔汗之手；1542年流亡的莫卧儿皇帝胡马雍在欧迈尔果德得到庇护，阿克巴即出生于此，1591至1593年莫卧儿军队兼并下信德。1701年莫卧儿统治被卡尔霍拉王朝取代，1783年又转入塔尔普尔王朝之手。

en: Singapura was a Malay Hindu-Buddhist kingdom on the island of Temasek, at the southern tip of the Malay Peninsula. According to the Malay Annals, the Palembang prince Sang Nila Utama landed there in 1299, renamed the island Singapura, Sanskrit for lion city, and built his fortified capital on the hill above the Singapore River with the support of the Orang Laut sea people. Its harbour lay on the main route through the Strait of Malacca, and within a generation it had become a cosmopolitan port trading with the Malay Archipelago, India and Yuan China. The Chinese traveller Wang Dayuan, visiting in the 1330s, described a walled town of Ban Zu and a pirates' settlement at Long Ya Men where Chinese merchants lived alongside Malays. A Siamese siege by a fleet of seventy junks failed when Chinese ships appeared. The kings of Majapahit demanded its submission from 1350, and in 1398 a Javanese fleet sacked the fort after a courtier betrayed the gates. The last ruler, Parameswara, fled to the peninsula and founded the Malacca Sultanate around 1400, after which Temasek sank into obscurity for centuries.
zh: 新加坡是马来半岛南端淡马锡岛上的印度教—佛教马来人王国。据《马来纪年》记载，巨港王子桑·尼拉·乌他玛于1299年登岛，将岛名改为新加坡——梵语意为狮子城——并在罗越人支持下，于新加坡河旁的山丘上筑起坚固国都。它的港口扼守马六甲海峡要道，不出一代人便发展成国际性商埠，与马来群岛、印度和中国元朝通商。14世纪30年代到访的中国旅人汪大渊在《岛夷志略》中记述，岛上有筑城而居的班卒港和海盗盘踞的龙牙门，中国商人与当地人比邻而居。暹罗曾以七十艘帆船组成的舰队来攻，因中国船只抵达而解围。1350年起，满者伯夷要求其称臣，1398年爪哇舰队在叛臣开门献城后攻陷堡垒。末代君主拜里米苏拉逃到半岛，约于1400年建立马六甲苏丹国，淡马锡此后数百年间湮没无闻。

en: Songpan, the old Songzhou, is a high plateau garrison country at the eastern edge of the Tibetan plateau in northwestern Sichuan, where the Min and Fu rivers rise. The Tang founded Songzhou there in 618 as their frontier gate facing the Tibetan Empire, whose king Songtsen Gampo attacked through it before receiving Princess Wencheng in 641. Under the Song, three Pan prefectures were set up after Tibetan tribes submitted in 1104, and the Yuan brought the area into the Songpan-Weimao tribal pacification office after 1283. In 1379 the Ming built the Songzhou and Panzhou guards and merged them into the Songpan Guard, whose walled seat commanded the tea-for-horse trade routes linking Sichuan with Gansu, Qinghai and Tibet, while restive Tibetan tribes were largely left under friendly lamas and local chiefs. Qing garrison command followed, and in 1731 it became Songpan Subprefecture, raised to an independent subprefecture in 1760.
zh: 松潘即古松州，是四川西北、青藏高原东缘的高原军镇，岷江、涪江发源于此。618年唐朝在今进安镇置松州，作为面对吐蕃王国的边关，吐蕃赞普松赞干布曾由此叩关，随后于641年迎娶文成公主。宋代在1104年因吐蕃部落归附而置上、中、下三潘州；元代1283年以后将其纳入松潘叠宕威茂等处军民安抚司管辖。1379年明朝筑松州卫、潘州卫，后合并为松潘卫，卫城扼守四川与甘肃、青海、西藏之间的茶马商道，而桀骜的藏族部落大多交给亲明的喇嘛和当地头人治理。清代设松潘镇总兵驻守，1731年改置松潘厅，1760年升为松潘直隶厅。

en: Sentispac was a native kingdom of the Pacific coastal plain of Nayarit in western Mexico, whose jurisdiction reached the hill settlement of Ixcatán while the coastal town of Ayutuxpan paid it tribute; the ceremonial centre of Coamiles, with its stone-faced platforms and more than 150 carved glyphs, served the region's ritual life. Its Huichol and Cora neighbours traded and warred across the same river valleys, and the mountain kingdom of Xécora remained a threat on its inland flank. Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán's army crossed the territory in 1530 and subdued it in 1531, folding it into the province of Nueva Galicia. Long after the conquest the frontier stayed restless: in the early eighteenth century the Cora leader Tonati raided Sentispac itself, before his stronghold in the Sierra del Nayar fell in 1722.
zh: 森蒂斯帕克是墨西哥西部纳亚里特太平洋沿海平原的原住民王国，势力及于山区聚落伊克斯卡坦，沿海城镇阿尤图什潘则向它纳贡；科阿米莱斯仪式中心拥有石面台基和150多处石刻，服务于这一地区的宗教生活。它与维乔尔人、科拉人邻邦在相同的河谷间贸易交战，山区的谢科拉王国始终是其内陆方向的威胁。1530年，努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼的军队穿过其领土，1531年将它征服，并入新加利西亚省。征服之后边地仍不平静：18世纪初，科拉人首领托纳蒂一度劫掠森蒂斯帕克，他在纳亚尔山区的据点最终于1722年陷落。

en: The Sohri were the Kurdish tribal polity of the Sohran, later known as the Soran, whose mountain stronghold was Rawanduz above the Erbil plain. Rawanduz, whose name means fortress of the Rawand, had been founded in the tenth century by the Rawadid family, leaders of the Hadhbani Kurds. According to the Sharafnama, the Sohran took their name from the red rocks of their homeland, the Kurdish sohr rendering the Persian word for red, and the emirate probably took shape between the 1330s and the 1430s. The Sohran expanded after the battle of Chaldiran in 1514, seizing the country between Erbil and Kirkuk, but in 1535 the Ottoman sultan Suleiman ordered the killing of their Erbil ruler Izz al-Din Shir and gave the city to a Yazidi chief. The emirate was revived from Rawanduz in 1816 and fell to the Ottomans in 1836.
zh: 索赫里是索赫兰（后称索兰）库尔德人的部落政权，山寨设在埃尔比勒平原上方的拉万杜兹。拉万杜兹意为拉万人的堡垒，10世纪由哈兹班尼库尔德人的望族拉瓦德家族建城。据《谢拉夫纳玛》记载，索赫兰得名于家乡的红色岩石，库尔德语把波斯语的“红”读作 sohr；学者估计这个酋长国大约形成于1330年代至1430年代之间。1514年查尔迪兰战役后，索赫兰向外扩张，夺取了埃尔比勒与基尔库克之间的土地，但1535年奥斯曼苏丹苏莱曼下令处死其驻埃尔比勒的统治者伊兹丁·希尔，把该城交给一位雅兹迪首领。1816年酋长国以拉万杜兹为中心复兴，最终于1836年被奥斯曼人攻灭。

en: The Songhai began as a cluster of fishing, hunting and farming peoples, the Sorko, Gao and Do, along the great bend of the Niger, joined before the tenth century by horse-riding Songhai speakers; their chiefs made Gao a trading kingdom controlling traffic in gold, salt and ivory, ruled first by the shadowy Za kings remembered in the Tarikh al-Sudan. Around 1300 the expanding Mali Empire captured Gao, and for more than a century the Songhai kings ruled as Malian vassals; Ibn Battuta found the city rich and prosperous when he passed through in 1353. As Mali tore itself apart after the death of Mansa Suleyman in 1360, Gao slipped from its grasp and was fully independent by the 1390s. Sonni Ali, reigning from 1464, built the empire that bore the Songhai name, taking Timbuktu in 1468 and starving Djenné into surrender after a long siege, and his general Askia Muhammad seized the throne in 1493. As Askia the Great he centralised government, promoted Islamic learning at Timbuktu's Sankore Mosque and made his pilgrimage to Mecca with a train loaded with gold, until his sons deposed him in 1528. A later revival under Askia Daoud ended with his death in 1583, and in 1591 a Moroccan army armed with firearms destroyed the Songhai host at Tondibi, near Gao, and swept the empire away.
zh: 桑海人最初是尼日尔河大河湾一带索尔科、高、多等渔猎农耕族群的结合体，10世纪前被骑马的桑海语诸首领征服，逐渐融为一体；其首领把加奥建成经营黄金、食盐和象牙贸易的商业王国，最早的统治者是《塔里克·苏丹》中记载的面目模糊的扎王朝诸王。约1300年，扩张中的马里帝国攻陷加奥，此后一个多世纪里桑海诸王作为马里附庸统治，伊本·白图泰1353年路过时，见到的仍是一座富庶繁华的城市。1360年曼萨·苏莱曼去世后马里陷入内乱，加奥逐渐脱离其掌控，到14世纪90年代已完全独立。1464年即位的桑尼·阿里建立了以桑海为名的帝国，1468年夺取廷巴克图，又经长期围困迫使杰内投降；他的将领阿斯基亚·穆罕默德于1493年篡位，即阿斯基亚大帝。他加强中央集权，在廷巴克图的桑科雷清真寺扶持伊斯兰学术，还带着满载黄金的队伍赴麦加朝觐，最终于1528年被儿子们废黜。阿斯基亚·达乌德时期的中兴随着他1583年去世而终结，1591年，装备火器的摩洛哥军队在加奥附近的通迪比击溃桑海大军，帝国就此覆灭。

en: Lusatia, later called Lower Lusatia to distinguish it from Upper Lusatia to the south, is the flat heath and forest country along the Spree, settled by the West Slavic Lusici, the forebears of the Sorbs. In the 960s the Saxon margrave Gero subdued the Lusici for King Otto I, and after a period of Polish rule under Bolesław I the Brave, confirmed by the Treaty of Bautzen in 1018, the land was reconquered in 1031 and organized as the March of Lusatia. In 1136 it passed to Conrad the Great of the Wettin house, whose heirs held it until the Ascanians of Brandenburg bought it in 1303. The Ascanian extinction fragmented the march: its southern towns went to the Piast Duchy of Jawor in 1319, while the north passed in 1324 to the Wittelsbachs. In 1337 it was therefore held as a Brandenburg fief by Margrave Louis V the Brandenburger, eldest son of Emperor Louis IV, ruling from Cottbus over towns such as Guben, Lübben and Luckau. In 1367 the Wittelsbach elector Otto V sold his rights to Emperor Charles IV, who joined all of Lower Lusatia to the Bohemian Crown; it remained a Bohemian crown land under the Luxembourg, Jagiellon and Habsburg dynasties, turned Protestant in the Reformation, and was ceded to Saxony by the Peace of Prague in 1635. After the Napoleonic Wars the Congress of Vienna of 1815 assigned Lower Lusatia to Prussia.
zh: 卢萨蒂亚，后为与南部的上卢萨蒂亚相区别而称下卢萨蒂亚，是施普雷河畔平坦的荒原与林地，居民为西斯拉夫的卢西奇人，即索布人的先民。10世纪60年代，萨克森藩侯格罗为国王奥托一世征服卢西奇人；该地一度由波列斯瓦夫一世治下的波兰统治（1018年《包岑条约》予以确认），1031年被德意志重新夺回，组建为卢萨蒂亚边疆区。1136年它转入韦廷家族的康拉德大帝之手，其后人一直统治到1303年勃兰登堡的阿斯坎尼家族将其买下。阿斯坎尼家族绝嗣后边疆区四分五裂：1319年南部城镇归皮亚斯特家族的亚沃尔公国，北部则于1324年转入维特尔斯巴赫家族之手。因此1337年时，它作为勃兰登堡的封邑，由皇帝路易四世的长子、藩侯路易五世（绰号“勃兰登堡人”）领有，以科特布斯为治所，统辖古本、吕本、劳希等城镇。1367年，维特尔斯巴赫选侯奥托五世把权利卖给皇帝查理四世，查理四世将整个下卢萨蒂亚并入波希米亚王冠领地；此后它历经卢森堡、雅盖隆和哈布斯堡三个王朝，宗教改革时期改宗新教，1635年依《布拉格和约》割让给萨克森。拿破仑战争后，1815年的维也纳会议又把下卢萨蒂亚划归普鲁士。

en: Spremberg was a small lordship built around a walled town and castle on an island in the Spree in Lower Lusatia; its Sorbian name Grodk means little castle. Town and castle first appear in a charter of 3 August 1301, when Landgrave Dietrich the Younger of Thuringia sold them to Archbishop Burchard II of Magdeburg. The first recorded holders of the lordship were members of a junior Wettin line from Landsberg, who named themselves after their seat at Spremberg, and the county was still in Wettin hands in 1337. In 1349 it passed to the counts of Schwarzburg-Wachsenburg, from whom Emperor Charles IV bought the castle in 1360. Charles's son John of Görlitz pledged Spremberg to Otto of Kittlitz in 1395, and the Lower Lusatian governor Henry Reuss of Plauen bought the lordship in 1497. After further sales to the Kittlitz and Redern families, it fell to the Saxon dukes of Merseburg in 1680 and to Electoral Saxony in 1738, before passing to Prussia with the rest of Lower Lusatia in 1815.
zh: 施普伦贝格是下卢萨蒂亚的一处小领地，核心是施普雷河一座岛上的设防城镇与城堡；它的索布语名格罗德基意为小城堡。城镇和城堡首次见于1301年8月3日的一份契约：图林根领地伯爵“年轻者”迪特里希将它们卖给马格德堡大主教布尔夏德二世。该领地最早有记载的持有者是韦廷家族兰茨贝格支系的成员，他们以治所施普伦贝格为姓氏，1337年时领地仍在韦廷家族手中。1349年它转给施瓦茨堡-瓦克森堡伯爵，1360年皇帝查理四世又从该家族手中买下城堡。查理四世之子格尔利茨的约翰于1395年把施普伦贝格抵押给奥托·冯·基特利茨，1497年下卢萨蒂亚长官、普劳恩的海因里希·罗伊斯购得这块领地。此后它又几经转卖，先后属基特利茨和雷德尔恩家族，1680年落入萨克森-梅泽堡公爵之手，1738年归萨克森选侯国，最终在1815年随下卢萨蒂亚其余部分一起并入普鲁士。

en: Shiping is a basin town on the southern Yunnan road leading toward Lin'an. The place first appears in 752 as the Stone Flat settlement under Nanzhao's Tonghai Commandery, which the Dali kingdom reorganised as Xiushan Commandery. In 1270 the Mongols made it Shiping Department, attached at first to the Abo Ten-Thousand-Household and later to Lin'an Route. When Ming armies took Yunnan in 1382 the department was renamed and attached to Lin'an Prefecture, soon acquiring its present written name Shiping, under which the Qing kept it. In 1810 five neighbouring native chieftaincies, among them Wazha and Luokong, were placed under the department's jurisdiction. Long known as a town of scholars, Shiping produced more than a hundred metropolitan graduates during the Ming and Qing.
zh: 石屏是滇南通往临安道路上的坝子城邑。752年其地始称石坪邑，隶属于南诏通海郡，到大理国时又改属秀山郡。1270年元朝置石坪州，先隶秀山郡阿僰万户，后改属临安路。1382年明军攻取云南，该州先被改名为石平州，不久又定名石屏州，划归临安府管辖，清代也沿用这一建制。1810年，亏容、思陀、瓦渣、落恐、左能五个相邻土司的辖区划归石屏州管辖。石屏历来以文教兴盛闻名，明清两代一共出了上百名进士，素有文献名邦之称。

en: Suphanburi, in older sources Suphannabhum or Suvarnapura, was a Thai-speaking mueang on the Tha Chin river, west of the lower Chao Phraya plain. Its moated town grew from Dvaravati-period settlements, and local tradition makes it the heir of the abandoned port of U Thong, whose merchants moved upriver in the eleventh century; its region appears in Jayavarman VII's Preah Khan inscription of the late twelfth century as Suvarnapura, and Chinese records of 1200 and 1205 probably know it as Chen Li Fu. By the thirteenth century it was counted among the vassals of Sukhothai, and its kilns exported stoneware jars across the gulf. In the fourteenth century it was one of the four rival towns of the lower plain, and its lord Khun Luang Pha Ngua joined U Thong in founding the Ayutthaya Kingdom in 1351. Pha Ngua seized the Ayutthayan throne in 1370 as King Borommarachathirat I, founding the Suphannaphum dynasty; after his death in 1388 his line briefly lost the crown to the exile Ramesuan before Intharacha restored it in 1408, and the old principality was fully merged into Ayutthaya in 1438. As a frontier city it later faced repeated Burmese invasions, most famously the elephant duel at Nong Sarai in 1593, where Naresuan slew the Burmese crown prince and restored Siamese independence.
zh: 素攀武里在较古的文献中称素攀那蓬或素攀补罗，是他金河畔的泰人城邦，位于昭披耶河下游平原以西。它的环城城邑由陀罗钵地时期的聚落发展而来，按地方传统，它继承了11世纪废弃的商港乌通——乌通商人当时溯河迁居于此；12世纪末阇耶跋摩七世的圣剑寺碑铭把这一地区记作素攀补罗，1200和1205年中国史籍中的真里富很可能就是它。13世纪时它被列为素可泰的属邦，当地窑场烧制的粗陶大罐远销暹罗湾各地。14世纪，它是下游平原相互角逐的四大城邦之一，领主坤銮帕娘与乌通联手，于1351年共建阿瑜陀耶王国。1370年，帕娘夺取阿瑜陀耶王位，称波隆摩罗阇一世，开创素攀那蓬王朝；他1388年去世后，王统一度被退守罗涡的拉梅萱夺回，1408年因陀罗阇又恢复了该王朝的统治，旧邦则于1438年完全并入阿瑜陀耶。作为边境城市，它此后屡遭缅甸入侵，最著名的一役是1593年的农沙拉莱象战：纳黎萱在阵中斩杀缅甸王储，恢复了暹罗的独立。

en: The County of Sponheim was an immediate territory of the Holy Roman Empire, lying between the Rhine, the Moselle and the Nahe around the Hunsrück, where the counts of the Rhenish branch of the House of Sponheim are documented from the eleventh century. Around 1225, after Count Gottfried III died on the Fifth Crusade, his sons split the lands into the Upper County, ruled from Starkenburg, and the Lower County, ruled from Kreuznach. The two lines feuded constantly with the neighbouring Electorates of Mainz and Trier and dotted their hills with some twenty-one castles. In 1337 Kreuznach was held by Count John II of the Sponheim-Kreuznach line. The Kreuznach line died out in 1417 and the Starkenburg line in 1437, after which female-line heirs from Baden and the Palatinate ruled the county as a condominium. The Reformation reached Sponheim in 1557, and the Thirty Years' War brought heavy fighting; after the Napoleonic Wars most of the territory passed to Prussia, while the Birkenfeld lands went to Oldenburg.
zh: 施蓬海姆伯国是神圣罗马帝国的帝国直辖领地，地处莱茵河、摩泽尔河与纳厄河之间的洪斯吕克山区，施蓬海姆家族的莱茵支自11世纪起在此任伯爵。约1225年，伯爵戈特弗里德三世死于第五次十字军东征后，儿子们把领地分为以施塔肯堡为治所的上伯国和以克罗伊茨纳赫为治所的下伯国。两支长期与毗邻的美因茨和特里尔选侯国结仇交战，在山区修筑了约二十一座城堡。1337年，下伯国由施蓬海姆-克罗伊茨纳赫支的伯爵约翰二世统治。克罗伊茨纳赫支于1417年绝嗣，施塔肯堡支也于1437年男嗣断绝，此后由巴登和普法尔茨的女系继承人以共治方式领有。1557年宗教改革传入伯国，三十年战争期间这里战事惨烈；拿破仑战争结束后，大部分领土划归普鲁士，比肯费尔德一带则并入奥尔登堡。

en: Spira is the Prince-Bishopric of Speyer, an ecclesiastical state on the Upper Rhine whose bishops had held royal lands in the Speyergau since the seventh century. Emperor Henry IV granted them the whole county in 1086, and the Romanesque cathedral at Speyer, begun in 1030 and consecrated in 1061, was among the greatest churches of the Holy Roman Empire. As the city of Speyer freed itself from episcopal rule and became a Free Imperial City in 1294, the bishops governed a scattered territory of enclaves on both banks of the Rhine from residences outside the city; in 1337 the see was held by Bishop Gerhard von Ehrenberg. The episcopal residence moved to Udenheim, later called Philippsburg, in 1371 and to Bruchsal in 1723. French armies repeatedly seized Philippsburg and the left-bank lands during the Thirty Years' War and the wars of Louis XIV, and the bishopric was secularised in 1803, with its right-bank territories passing to Baden.
zh: 斯皮拉即施派尔主教区，是上莱茵的一个教会邦国。早在7世纪，施派尔主教就领有施派尔高的王室地产，1086年皇帝亨利四世把整个伯国封给主教区。1030年动工、1061年祝圣的施派尔罗马式大教堂，是神圣罗马帝国最宏伟的主教座堂之一。随着施派尔城逐渐摆脱主教统治、于1294年成为帝国自由城市，主教们只能在城外的府邸统治莱茵河两岸由多块飞地拼成的零散领地；1337年在任的是格哈德·冯·埃伦贝格主教。主教驻地先于1371年迁到乌登海姆，即后来的菲利普斯堡，1723年再迁布鲁赫萨尔。三十年战争和路易十四时代的战争中，法军多次攻占菲利普斯堡和左岸领地；1803年主教区被世俗化，右岸领土并入巴登。

en: Sora was the land of the Soras, a highland people of the Ayacucho region in the cold puna above the Pampas river, grouped into the two halves of Soras and Chalcos. They spoke Ayacucho Quechua, kept large llama and vicuña herds around the snow peak of Ccarhuarazo, their principal wak'a, and built their chief settlement at Hatun Soras. After the fall of the Wari state the Soras emerged as a warrior people, never subdued by the neighbouring Chanka with whom they were almost always at war; they instead sided with the Incas, and under Pachacuti, who ruled from 1438 to 1471, their territory was incorporated into the Tawantinsuyo. Hatun Soras then housed an aclla house with five hundred chosen women dedicated to the sun, and its curacas were present at Cajamarca in 1532 when Pizarro seized the Inca emperor; the town afterwards became the wealthy encomienda of Melchor Palomino, one of Pizarro's own companions.
zh: 索拉是索拉斯人的土地，这是一支高原民族，住在阿亚库乔地区潘帕斯河上游寒冷的普纳草原，分为索拉斯和查尔科斯两个部分。他们讲阿亚库乔克丘亚语，在圣山卡尔瓦拉索雪峰周围放牧大群羊驼和骆马，雪峰就是他们最重要的瓦卡；主城建于大索拉。瓦里国家衰落后，索拉斯人以善战著称，从未被邻近的昌卡人征服，双方几乎战事不断；他们反而与印加人结盟，在1438年至1471年在位的帕查库特克治下被并入塔万廷苏尤。大索拉随后设有甄选贞女馆，五百名入选女子专事奉祀太阳神；1532年皮萨罗在卡哈马卡擒获印加君主时，索拉斯人的酋长也在场，此后这座城镇成为皮萨罗同伴梅尔乔·帕洛米诺的富庶委托监护地。

en: The Sarbadars, whose name means head on the gallows, were an unusual Shi'i state of western Khurasan, centered on Sabzavar and born from the collapse of the Ilkhanate. It began in early 1337 as a revolt: 'Abd al-Razzaq, a local notable angered by the harsh taxation of Togha Temür's governor, killed an official at Bashtin, defeated the forces sent against him and seized Sabzavar in the summer of 1337, giving the government a republican rather than dynastic form. Power was shared uneasily between secular amirs and the Shi'i dervish order founded by Sheikh Khalifa and Hasan Juri, whose followers expected the return of the Twelfth Imam. The Sarbadars fought Togha Temür, his vassal tribes and the Kartids of Herat, losing the Battle of Zava in 1342 after Hasan Juri was killed, then murdering Togha Temür in his own camp in 1353 and removing the last serious claimant to the Ilkhanid throne. Frequent coups followed until the long reign of Khwaja 'Ali-yi Mu'ayyad, who made Shi'ism the state creed. Beset by rivals, he submitted to Timur at Nishapur in 1381; the Sarbadars kept their local administration and served Timur loyally, slowly fading from prominence after his death.
zh: 萨尔毕道朗，其名意为“绞架上的头颅”，是伊儿汗国崩溃之际诞生于西呼罗珊的特殊什叶派政权，以萨卜泽瓦尔为中心。它始于1337年初的一场起义：地方显贵阿卜杜勒-拉扎克不堪脱合帖木儿所派总督的苛税，在巴斯廷杀死一名官员，击退前来围剿的军队，并于1337年夏攻占萨卜泽瓦尔，建立起共和而非王朝式的政权。世俗埃米尔与谢赫哈利法、哈桑·朱里创立的什叶派德尔维希教团之间始终紧张地分享权力，教团信徒期待第十二代伊玛目归来。萨尔毕道朗人先后与脱合帖木儿、其附庸部族以及赫拉特的卡尔提德王朝交战：1342年哈桑·朱里被杀后在扎瓦战役中落败，1353年又潜入脱合帖木儿的营帐将其刺杀，除掉了伊儿汗位最后的有力争夺者。此后政变频繁，直到霍贾·阿里-伊·穆阿亚德长期执政，将什叶派立为国教。在群雄围攻下，他于1381年在内沙布尔向帖木儿臣服；萨尔毕道朗人保留了地方行政，忠实效命于帖木儿，在其死后逐渐湮没无闻。

en: Soroca stands on the Dniester at one of the river's few reliable fords, on the old road linking the Carpathian lands with the Black Sea steppe; its name is the East Slavic word for a magpie. The district was part of the Golden Horde's western pastures until Moldavia expanded to the Dniester in the later fourteenth century, and the town itself grew up around the fortress that Prince Ștefan the Great built in 1499 to guard the crossing. It was the northernmost link in a chain of Moldavian strongholds that ran down the Dniester through Hotin to Akkerman and along the Danube. Between 1543 and 1546 Petru Rareș replaced the wooden fort with a circular stone citadel of five evenly spaced bastions. Sobieski's Poles held it against the Ottomans during the Great Turkish War, it played a key part in Peter the Great's Prut campaign of 1711, and Russian troops sacked it during the war of 1735 to 1739. A Jewish community, first documented in 1653, made Soroca one of the older Jewish settlements in the region.
zh: 索罗卡位于德涅斯特河畔一处少有的常年可涉的渡口，扼守连接喀尔巴阡地区与黑海草原的古道；其名称来自东斯拉夫语的“喜鹊”一词。14世纪后期摩尔达维亚扩张至德涅斯特河之前，这一带曾是金帐汗国的西部牧场；城镇本身则围绕1499年什特凡大公为守卫渡口而建的要塞发展起来。它是摩尔达维亚要塞链最北端的一环，这条防线沿德涅斯特河经霍京南下至阿克曼，再沿多瑙河延伸。1543至1546年，佩特鲁·拉雷什把木堡改建为石砌圆形城堡，设有五座等距分布的棱堡。大土耳其战争期间，索别斯基率领的波兰军曾在此抵御奥斯曼人；1711年彼得大帝的普鲁特河战役中，它发挥了关键作用；1735至1739年的战争里，俄军洗劫了这座要塞。当地犹太社群最早见于1653年的记载，使索罗卡成为该地区较早的犹太人定居点之一。

en: Sarangarh was a small hill state in the Chhattisgarh country, ruled by a Raj Gond dynasty whose clan emblem was the turtle. Its rulers traced their origin to a Gond war band that, according to tradition, migrated from Bhandara in the first century and carved out a chiefdom in the forests east of the plains. Sarangarh began as a dependency of the Kalachuri kingdom of Ratanpur and later became one of the eighteen Garhjat feudatory states attached to Sambalpur, whose kings valued it for the troops it supplied in their campaigns. It remained a Gond tributary chiefdom until 1818, when it came under British protection.
zh: 萨兰加尔是切蒂斯格尔地区的小山邦，由拉杰贡德王朝统治，家族徽记是一只龟。其统治者把家世追溯到一支贡德武士队伍：相传他们于1世纪从班达拉迁出，在平原以东的丛林中开辟出这块领地。萨兰加尔起初是拉坦普尔卡拉楚里王国的附庸，后来成为附属于萨姆巴尔普尔的十八个迦尔贾德土邦之一，因能在战事中出兵助战而深受萨姆巴尔普尔诸王看重。它一直保持贡德附庸首领的地位，直到1818年接受英国保护。

en: Sarikol was a Pamir mountain kingdom centered on the stone fortress of Tashkurgan, a Turkic name meaning stone fortress, which Chinese writers called Shitoucheng. In Han times the same valley held the Kingdom of Puli, one of the western realms recorded in the Book of Han, and later it was known to Persian and Chinese travellers as Qiepantuo. The Buddhist pilgrim Song Yun passed through around 500, and Xuanzang came that way around 649 on his road from Badakhshan to Khotan. Caravan routes from Kashgar, Kargilik, Badakhshan and Wakhan converged on the capital, which controlled the road from the Oxus to the oases of southern Turkestan. Tang troops broke Qiepantuo in the Kaiyuan era of 713 to 741 and planted the Congling border garrison on the site; under the Song it first belonged to Khotan and was then swallowed by the Kara-Khanid Khanate. From the thirteenth century it passed in turn through the Mongol Empire, the Chagatai and Eastern Chagatai khanates and the Yarkent Khanate, before its final conquest by the Qing. The Yuan-period Tashkurgan Fort and the ruins of a fire temple beside it still marked the old royal center.
zh: 萨雷阔勒是帕米尔高原上的山间王国，中心在石头城塔什库尔干——突厥语中塔什库尔干意为石头城，汉文古籍称之为石头城。汉代时这条谷地是《汉书》所载西域诸国之一蒲犁国的所在，后来又以朅盘陀之名见于波斯和汉地旅行者的记载。约500年，僧人宋云途经此地；约649年，玄奘从巴达赫尚前往于阗时也路过这座都城。来自喀什噶尔、叶城、巴达赫尚和瓦罕的商路在此交汇，扼守着从乌浒水通往南疆绿洲的道路。713—741年的唐开元年间，唐军攻破朅盘陀，在当地设置葱岭守捉；宋代这里先属于阗，后被喀喇汗国吞并。13世纪起，它先后归入蒙古帝国、察合台汗国与东察合台汗国、叶尔羌汗国，最终被清朝征服。元代所建的塔什库尔干大石堡和堡旁的祆祠废墟，仍标示着旧日的王都。
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/塔什库尔干塔吉克自治县

en: Nahan was a Rajput hill kingdom in the southern Himalayas, in what is now the Sirmaur district of Himachal Pradesh, and the strongest of the Punjab Hill States, later better known as Sirmur State. A principality on the site was founded in 1095 by Soba Rawal, who ruled under the raja name Subans Prakash. After a flood of the Giri River destroyed the old capital of Sirmaur-Tal in 1195, a Bhati Rajput line from Jaisalmer seized the disordered country and ruled it thereafter. Raja Karm Prakash founded the city of Nahan in 1621 and made it his capital. His successors aided the Mughal campaigns of Shah Jahan and Aurangzeb against Garhwal and were rewarded with fresh lands, and in 1685 Mat Prakash gave refuge to the Sikh guru Gobind Singh and let him fortify Paonta. During the Gurkha wars the dynasty was briefly driven from its throne and returned under British protection, so that Nahan entered the British Indian order as Sirmur State.
zh: 那罕是喜马拉雅山南麓的拉杰普特山地王国，在今印度喜马偕尔邦锡尔穆尔县一带，是旁遮普山地土邦中最强的一个，后来多以锡尔穆尔土邦之名为人所知。1095年，索巴·拉瓦尔在此建立城邦，以拉贾·苏班斯·普拉卡什之名统治。1195年吉里河洪水冲毁旧都锡尔穆尔-塔尔，来自杰伊瑟尔梅尔的巴蒂氏族拉杰普特人趁乱征服该国，从此在此统治。1621年，拉贾·卡尔马·普拉卡什兴建那罕城并定为新都。其后诸王协助沙贾汗和奥朗则布对加瓦尔的莫卧儿战事，以此换取新领地；1685年，马特·普拉卡什收留锡克教第十代古鲁戈宾德·辛格，允许他在保恩塔筑垒。廓尔喀战争期间王朝一度被逐下王位，后在英国保护下复位，那罕遂以锡尔穆尔土邦的身份纳入英属印度体系。

en: The Saruhanids were a Turkmen beylik in the Gediz valley of western Anatolia, with its capital at Manisa and towns including Menemen, Akhisar, Gördes and Demirci. Its founder Saruhan Bey began as an emir in Seljuk and Germiyanid service and was sent against the Byzantine holdings of the region; he weathered the campaigns of the Catalan Company early in the fourteenth century and captured Manisa in 1313, making it his seat. During his long reign, which lasted until 1346 and was still running in 1337, the beylik became an Aegean naval power: allied with the Aydınids, it supported the capture of Smyrna, raided from the sea and joined Umur Bey's expeditions to Thrace, while Saruhan's eldest son died campaigning against the Bulgar warlord Momchil in 1345. His successors İlyas Bey and İshak Bey maintained the principality, and İshak's Great Mosque of Manisa, built in 1374 with its large central dome, later inspired Ottoman imperial mosques. After siding with the Karamanids against Bayezid I, the beylik was conquered in 1390; Timur restored it after 1402, but Mehmed I captured and killed the restored ruler Hızır Şah in 1410 and the last prince died in 1412, when the lands became the Ottoman Sanjak of Saruhan, later the training province where Ottoman princes were groomed for the throne.
zh: 萨鲁汗（萨鲁汗奥卢）是安纳托利亚西部盖迪兹河流域的突厥蛮贝伊国，以马尼萨为都，领有梅内门、阿克希萨尔、格尔代斯和代米尔吉等城镇。开国者萨鲁汗贝伊早年是塞尔柱和格尔米扬麾下的埃米尔，奉命攻打该地区的拜占庭据点；他顶住了14世纪初加泰罗尼亚佣兵团的攻势，于1313年攻克马尼萨并定都于此。在他持续到1346年、1337年仍在进行的漫长统治期间，贝伊国成长为爱琴海海上强国：它与艾登贝伊国结盟，协助夺取士麦那，频频从海上出击，并跟随乌穆尔贝伊远征色雷斯；1345年，萨鲁汗的长子在讨伐保加利亚军阀莫姆奇尔的战役中身亡。后继的伊利亚斯贝伊和伊沙克贝伊维系着侯国，伊沙克于1374年修建的马尼萨大清真寺以巨大的中央穹顶著称，后来启发了奥斯曼皇家清真寺的设计。该贝伊国因站在卡拉曼一边对抗巴耶济德一世，于1390年被征服；1402年后帖木儿将其恢复，但穆罕默德一世于1410年擒杀复位的赫泽尔沙阿，末代王公也于1412年死去，其地成为奥斯曼的萨鲁汗桑贾克，后来更是奥斯曼王子出镇历练、预备继位的封地。

en: The Kingdom of Shirvan was the eastern Caucasus realm of the Shirvanshahs, the kings of Shirvan, who ruled from Shamakhi and Baku between 861 and 1538. Its first ruling line, the Arab-born and later Persianized Yazidids, were known from the twelfth century as the Kasranids. Their court became a centre of Persian letters where the poets Khaqani and Nizami Ganjavi found patronage, and Akhsitan I moved the royal residence from Shamakhi to Baku around 1190. After a century under Mongol and Ilkhanid suzerainty, the collapse of the Ilkhanate in 1335 let Kayqubad I, the Kasranid ruler reigning in 1337, restore autonomy, though his successors had to acknowledge the Jalayirids. The Kasranid line ended when Hushang was murdered in 1382, and Ibrahim I of the Darbandid branch began a new line as Timur's vassal. The long reigns of Khalilullah I and Farrukh Yasar in the fifteenth century brought peace and the building of the Palace of the Shirvanshahs at Baku. Farrukh Yasar was defeated and killed by the Safavid leader Ismail I in 1500; the shahs survived as Safavid vassals until Shah Tahmasp I annexed Shirvan as a province in 1538.
zh: 希尔凡王国是高加索东部希尔凡沙赫的国度，历代国王于861—1538年间以沙马基和巴库为都。第一支统治家族出身阿拉伯、后来逐渐波斯化，12世纪起称科斯兰家族。他们的宫廷是波斯文学中心，诗人哈加尼和尼扎米·甘伽维都曾在此受庇护，阿赫西坦一世约在1190年把王宫从沙马基迁往巴库。在臣属蒙古与伊儿汗国一个世纪后，1335年伊儿汗国崩溃，1337年在位的科斯兰家族国王凯库巴德一世恢复了自治，但后继者仍不得不承认札剌亦儿王朝的宗主权。1382年胡尚格被杀，科斯兰王统断绝，德尔本德支系的易卜拉欣一世作为帖木儿的附庸开启新朝。15世纪哈利卢拉一世与法鲁赫·亚萨尔的长期统治带来和平，巴库的希尔凡沙赫宫殿即建于此时。1500年法鲁赫·亚萨尔被萨法维领袖伊斯玛仪一世击败身亡，希尔凡沙赫作为萨法维附庸延续到1538年，塔赫马斯普一世最终将希尔凡改为行省。

en: Ssangseong was a Yuan prefecture in northeastern Korea, set up at Hwaju in 1258 after Möngke Khan's campaigns against Goryeo. Attached to the Kaiyuan circuit of the Liaoyang province, it was governed hereditarily by the Cho family, Goryeo men who had submitted to the Mongols, and served together with the neighboring Dongnyeong Prefecture as a bridgehead of Yuan control over the northern Korean lands. In 1337 its superintendent was Cho Rim. As the Yuan weakened, King Gongmin of Goryeo made its recovery the core of his northern policy: in 1356 his general Yu In-u took the prefecture, while the local Mongol-appointed commander Yi Chach'un came over to Goryeo with his young son Yi Sŏnggye, the future founder of the Joseon dynasty. After nearly a century of Yuan rule, the territory reverted to Goryeo.
zh: 双城是元朝设在朝鲜半岛东北部的行政机构，1258年蒙哥汗征讨高丽后设于和州（今朝鲜咸镜南道金野郡一带），隶属于辽阳行省开元路，由归降蒙古的高丽人赵氏家族世袭管领，与邻近的东宁府同为元朝控制高丽北部的据点。1337年时任总管为赵琳。元朝衰落之际，高丽恭愍王把收复双城作为北伐的核心：1356年将领柳仁雨攻克总管府，元朝任命的当地千户李子春携年幼的儿子李成桂归降高丽，李成桂后来正是朝鲜王朝的开国君主。历经近百年的元朝统治后，这片土地重归高丽。

en: Străşineţ is the Romanian-style name of Storozhynets, the chief town of the wooded upper Siret valley where Moldavia meets Bukovina at the Carpathian foothills. The oldest centre in the district is Siret, where the Teutonic Knights raised a fortress between 1211 and 1225, only for the Mongols to destroy it in 1241. First documented in 1339, Siret became the first capital of the independent Principality of Moldavia after Bogdan I crossed the mountains: Franciscans opened a monastery there in 1340 and Prince Lațcu obtained a Latin bishopric in 1371, until Prince Petru moved the court to Suceava in 1388. Storozhynets itself began as a loggers' settlement and is first mentioned in 1448. Nearby Putna, founded by Ștefan the Great in 1466 after the taking of Kilia and consecrated in 1470, became the princely necropolis of Moldavia and holds the voivode's tomb; its church was rebuilt by Vasile Lupu between 1653 and 1662. In 1775 the whole upper Siret country passed with Bukovina to the Habsburg monarchy.
zh: 斯托罗日涅茨的罗马尼亚语写法为 Storojineț，是林木茂密的锡雷特河上游地区的首要城镇，这一带位于喀尔巴阡山麓，是摩尔达维亚与布科维纳的交界。区内最古老的中心是锡雷特：1211至1225年间条顿骑士团在此修建要塞，1241年被蒙古人摧毁。锡雷特最早见于1339年的文献，博格丹一世翻山建国后，它成为独立的摩尔达维亚公国的第一个首都：方济各会1340年在此开设修道院，1371年拉茨库大公又争取到一个天主教主教区，直到1388年佩特鲁大公把宫廷迁往苏恰瓦。斯托罗日涅茨本身起源于伐木者定居点，1448年才首见记载。附近的普特纳修道院由什特凡大公在夺取基利亚后于1466年兴建、1470年祝圣，后来成为摩尔达维亚的王室陵寝所在地，什特凡大公即葬于此；现存教堂是1653至1662年瓦西里·卢普重建的。1775年，整个锡雷特河上游地区随布科维纳并入哈布斯堡君主国。

en: The Principality of Slutsk, on the Sluch River in the old Dregovich lands, grew out of an appanage of Turov: the Rus' chronicle records the town as early as 1116, and around 1160 Volodimer Mstislavich became the first prince to reside there, giving the separate principality its beginning. It passed to the Turov line of the Rurikids and, like the other Turov lands, came under Galicia-Volhynia before joining the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in 1320. In 1395 Vytautas granted Slutsk to Vladimir Olgerdovich, whose Olelkovich descendants made it one of the political and cultural centres of the grand duchy; the town received Magdeburg rights in 1441 and kept its own princes longer than any other Lithuanian appanage before the family died out and the Radziwiłłs inherited it. From the seventeenth century its weavers were famous across the Commonwealth for the luxury kontusz sashes known as Slutsk belts. In 1778 it became a county seat of the Nowogródek Voivodeship, and in 1793 the Second Partition assigned it to Russia.
zh: 斯卢茨克公国地处斯卢奇河畔、古代德列戈维奇人的土地，原是图罗夫的封邑：罗斯编年史早在1116年就记载了这座城镇，约1160年弗拉基米尔·姆斯季斯拉维奇成为第一个驻跸于此的王公，独立的公国由此开端。它后来归留里克家族的图罗夫一系所有，与图罗夫的其他土地一样先臣属于加利奇—沃伦，1320年加入立陶宛大公国。1395年维陶塔斯把斯卢茨克封给弗拉基米尔·奥尔格多维奇，其后代奥列尔科维奇家族把这里经营成大公国的政治文化中心之一；城镇于1441年获得马格德堡权利，保留自家王公的时间比立陶宛其他任何封邑都久，直到该家族绝嗣，由拉济维乌家族继承。17世纪起，当地织工出产的豪华康图什绶带闻名整个联邦，被称为斯卢茨克绶带。1778年它成为新格鲁多克省的县治，1793年第二次瓜分中被划归俄罗斯。

en: The Duchy of Stettin was the westernmost of the Griffin-ruled partition duchies of Pomerania, with its capital at Stettin on the Oder, a town granted Magdeburg rights in 1243. The Pomeranian dukes, descendants of the Slavic prince Wartislaw I, had been Christianized through the missions of Otto of Bamberg and held their lands as fiefs of the Holy Roman Empire from 1227. Stettin first became a separate duchy in the partition of 1160, and after the reunification of 1264 it was created again in the partition of 1295, when Otto I of the Griffin dynasty took up residence there. In 1337 the long-reigning Otto I still ruled, caught between the claims of the Margraves of Brandenburg and the rival Pomeranian line of Wolgast; his son Barnim III succeeded him in 1344. The Stettin and Wolgast lines were reunited in 1478 under Duke Bogislaw X, whose duchy adopted the Reformation in 1534. When the last Griffin, Bogislaw XIV, died in 1637 during the Thirty Years' War, the dynasty ended; the Peace of Westphalia in 1648 divided Pomerania between Sweden and Brandenburg-Prussia, and Stettin itself passed to Prussia in 1720 after the Great Northern War.
zh: 斯德丁公国是格里芬家族统治的波美拉尼亚诸分藩公国中最西边的一个，以奥得河畔的斯德丁为都，这座城市于1243年获得马格德堡城市权。波美拉尼亚公爵是斯拉夫王公瓦季斯瓦夫一世的后裔，经班贝格的奥托传教皈依基督教，自1227年起以神圣罗马帝国封臣的身份保有领地。斯德丁在1160年的首次分封中成为独立公国，1264年公国重新统一后，又在1295年的分封中再度设立，由格里芬家族的奥托一世入主。1337年在位的仍是统治已久的奥托一世，他周旋于勃兰登堡藩侯的领主权要求与沃尔加斯特旁支之间，其子巴尼姆三世于1344年继位。1478年，斯德丁一系与沃尔加斯特一系在波吉斯瓦夫十世治下重新合并，公国于1534年接受宗教改革。1637年末代格里芬公爵波吉斯瓦夫十四世在三十年战争期间去世，家族绝嗣；1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》把波美拉尼亚分给瑞典与勃兰登堡—普鲁士，斯德丁本身则在大北方战争后的1720年并入普鲁士。

en: St. Gallen grew up around the hermitage of the Irish monk Gallus, who settled in the Steinach valley around 612, and the Benedictine abbey founded on the spot by Saint Othmar in 719. Under Carolingian patronage it became one of the foremost centres of learning in Europe, with a famous school and a library of manuscripts copied by its monks. Emperor Louis the Pious confirmed its imperial immediacy in 813, Louis the German granted immunity and free election of the abbot in 833, and in 1207 King Philip raised Abbot Ulrich von Sax to the rank of prince of the Empire, making St. Gallen a princely abbey with its own territory. The adjoining town steadily slipped from the abbot's grasp: the guilds mastered its council by about 1353, it bought its liberty from King Sigismund in 1415 and was fully free of the abbot in 1457. The abbot's Appenzell estates revolted from 1401 and defeated his allies at Stoss in 1405, while Abbot Ulrich Rösch bought the County of Toggenburg in 1468 and saw his new monastery at Rorschach destroyed by the townspeople in 1489. The town turned Protestant in 1524, leaving the abbey as a Catholic enclave allied to the Swiss Confederation; Swiss troops pillaged it during the Toggenburg War of 1712 and carried much of the library to Zürich and Bern. The baroque abbey church was built between 1755 and 1768, before the prince-abbot's secular power was suppressed in 1798 and the monastery dissolved in 1805.
zh: 圣加仑起源于爱尔兰修士加卢斯约612年在施泰纳赫河谷建立的隐修所，719年圣奥特马尔又在此创建本笃会修道院。在加洛林王朝庇护下，它成为欧洲首屈一指的学术中心之一，拥有著名的修院学校和修士手抄本图书馆。813年皇帝虔诚者路易确认其帝国直辖地位，833年日耳曼人路易授予豁免权和自由选举院长之权；1207年国王菲利普把院长乌尔里希·冯·萨克斯提升为帝国亲王，圣加仑由此成为拥有领地的亲王修道院。毗邻的城镇却逐渐脱离院长掌握：约1353年行会控制了市议会，1415年城市从国王西吉斯蒙德手中赎得自由，1457年彻底摆脱院长管辖。院长名下的阿彭策尔地产自1401年起兵反叛，1405年在施托斯击败院长的盟军；院长乌尔里希·勒施于1468年购得托根堡伯国，他在罗尔沙赫兴建的新修道院却于1489年被市民捣毁。1524年城市改宗新教，修道院成为与瑞士邦联结盟的天主教飞地；1712年托根堡战争中，瑞士军队洗劫修院，把大量藏书运往苏黎世和伯尔尼。巴洛克风格的修道院教堂建于1755至1768年间，随后院长的世俗权力于1798年被废除，修道院于1805年解散。

en: Saptagram, colloquially Satgaon, was a great river port on the Saraswati in southern Bengal, sometimes the capital of the region and now a site in the Hooghly district of West Bengal. Its name means seven villages, the original settlement having grown from Bansberia and six neighbouring villages. It rose from the ninth and tenth centuries as the older port of Tamralipta silted up, and was already a leading mart under the Pala and Sena kings; after the Muslim conquest it became an administrative centre, and the fourteenth to sixteenth centuries were its golden age. In 1337 it was held for Delhi by the governor Izz al-Din Yahya, whose officer Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah seized the city on his death in 1338 and used it as the base from which he united Bengal. In 1565 Maharaja Rudranarayan of Bhurshut took Saptagram from the Pathans, who won it back in 1592, but by then the Saraswati was silting and trade moved to Hooghly and later Calcutta, leaving the old port deserted.
zh: 萨普塔格拉姆俗称萨特冈，是南孟加拉萨拉斯瓦蒂河畔的大型河港，曾几度成为这一地区的都城，其故地在今西孟加拉邦胡格利县。城名意为七个村庄，最初由班斯贝里亚等七座村落发展而成。9至10世纪，随着更古老的港口耽摩栗底因淤塞衰落，它逐渐兴起，在波罗王朝和犀那王朝治下已是首屈一指的商埠；穆斯林征服后它又成为行政中心，14至16世纪是其黄金时代。1337年，德里派驻的总督伊兹丁·叶海亚镇守此地，1338年叶海亚死后，其部将沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯·沙夺取该城，并以它为基地统一了孟加拉。1565年，布尔舒特的摩诃罗阇鲁德拉纳拉扬从帕坦人手中夺得萨普塔格拉姆，帕坦人又于1592年将其收复；但此时萨拉斯瓦蒂河日渐淤塞，贸易转向胡格利、继而转向加尔各答，这座古港终遭废弃。

en: The County of Saint-Pol, centred on Saint-Pol-sur-Ternoise, covered the Ternois country between Artois and Picardy, a fief first held from the counts of Flanders after the break-up of the old pagus Teruanensis in the tenth century. From the mid-eleventh century its lords, also styled counts of Ternois, built a durable lordship: the Campdavaine counts Hugh II and Hugh IV went on the First, Third and Fourth Crusades, and when the line failed, Elisabeth of Campdavaine's marriage to Gaucher de Châtillon brought Saint-Pol to the house of Châtillon in 1205. Guy IV of Châtillon, Grand Butler of France, escaped the French rout at the Golden Spurs in 1302, and his son John ruled the county from 1317 to 1344, holding it in 1337 as a vassal of Artois. John's granddaughter Mathilde married Guy of Luxembourg-Ligny, so carrying Saint-Pol to the house of Luxembourg.
