Immunity grants in 772 and 898, followed by full rights over the city and district of Trier around 900, turned the archbishops into territorial lords holding lands along the Moselle from Trier to the Rhine at Koblenz.

The archbishop ruling in 1337 was Baldwin of Luxembourg, elected in 1307 at the age of twenty-two. Brother of Emperor Henry VII, he reformed the archiepiscopal administration, preserved its archives, built the Baldwin Bridge at Koblenz and for a time also administered Mainz, Worms and Speyer. A university was founded at Trier in 1473, and the Reichstag of 1512 settled the structure of the Imperial Circles there. The territory was badly scarred by the witch trials of 1581 to 1593 and by repeated French occupations from the Thirty Years' War onward; the destruction of 1688 and 1689 left the city without walls and only about two and a half thousand people. The electors had meanwhile moved their residence to Ehrenbreitstein near Koblenz. French Republican troops took Trier in 1794, the left-bank lands were annexed in 1801, and the surviving territory was secularized and granted to Nassau-Weilburg in 1803.
zh:
特里尔选侯国是特里尔大主教的教会领地，大主教是神圣罗马帝国三位教会选帝侯之一，并兼任勃艮第-阿尔勒王国的大首相。主教区的历史可追溯到罗马城市奥古斯塔·特雷维洛伦，查理曼时代升为大主教区，下辖梅斯、图勒和凡尔登三个主教区。772年和898年的免税豁免特权，加上900年前后取得特里尔城及周边地区的完整治权，使大主教成为割据一方的领土领主，领有沿摩泽尔河从特里尔到莱茵河畔科布伦茨的土地。

1337年在位的大主教是卢森堡的鲍德温，他于1307年年仅二十二岁时当选。作为皇帝亨利七世之弟，他改革了大主教区的行政、保存了教区档案，在科布伦茨修建鲍德温桥，并曾兼管美因茨、沃尔姆斯和施派尔三个主教区。1473年特里尔大学创立，1512年的帝国议会在当地确定了帝国行政圈的框架。1581至1593年的猎巫审判使领地深受创痛；自三十年战争起，法军又一再占领此地，1688至1689年的破坏使特里尔城墙尽毁，居民只剩约两千五百人。此时选帝侯早已把居所迁到科布伦茨附近的埃伦布赖特施泰因。1794年法兰西共和国军队攻占特里尔，1801年莱茵河左岸土地被法国吞并，残存领地于1803年被世俗化，划归拿骚-威尔堡。

en: The Shamkhalate of Tarki was the Kumyk state of the eastern North Caucasus, ruled from the old Caspian town of Tarki by a prince bearing the title shamkhal, who also styled himself Vali of Dagestan. Its strongholds included the mountain fastness of Gazi-Kumukh as well as Tarki, and at its height its vassals stretched from the Caspian shore to Kabarda and Balkaria. In the fifteenth century the shamkhal stood at the head of a loose alliance of Dagestani highland communities, and in the sixteenth his power peaked under Chopan-shamkhal, whose sister married Shah Tahmasp I of Iran and whose raids reached Shirvan and Georgia. Rivalry with Russia began with the building of the Terki fortress on the Terek in 1588, although the Kumyks destroyed a Russian army at the Battle of Karaman in 1605. The shamkhalate formally entered the Ottoman Empire in the 1580s, split into rival Kumyk fiefdoms in the early seventeenth century, and was briefly abolished after Peter the Great's Persian campaign before being restored in 1734. Its annexation by Russia was confirmed by the Treaty of Gulistan in 1813, and uprisings against Russian rule followed in 1823 and 1831.
zh: 塔尔基沙姆哈尔国是北高加索东部的库梅克人国家，由拥有“沙姆哈尔”头衔的王公统治，都城设在里海沿岸古城塔尔基，沙姆哈尔还自称达吉斯坦瓦利。它的据点除塔尔基外还有山中要塞加齐库穆赫，鼎盛时附庸从里海之滨一直延伸到卡巴尔达和巴尔卡里亚。15世纪，沙姆哈尔统领着达吉斯坦山区公社组成的松散联盟；16世纪乔潘沙姆哈尔在位时势力达到顶峰，其姐妹嫁给伊朗沙赫塔赫马斯普一世，兵锋远及希尔凡和格鲁吉亚。1588年俄国在捷列克河口修建捷尔基要塞，双方就此长期对抗，库梅克人在1605年的卡拉曼战役中歼灭一支俄军。1580年代沙姆哈尔国正式并入奥斯曼帝国，17世纪初分裂为相互争斗的库梅克领地，彼得大帝波斯远征后它一度被废，1734年又得以恢复。1813年的《古利斯坦条约》确认俄国对它的吞并，1823年和1831年当地先后爆发反俄起义。

en: The barony of Turn represents the Bernese Oberland estates of the Freiherren von Turn, one of the mightiest noble houses of the Valais. Probably descended from the La Tour-du-Pin barons of the Dauphiné, the family settled in the Valais in the twelfth century as vassals of St. Maurice Abbey; Wilhelm I built the Gestelnburg at Niedergesteln around 1170, and his brother Amadeus became bishop of Sitten. As guardians of Sion and its bishopric the von Turn controlled much of the Rhône valley in the thirteenth century, while the marriage of Johann I to Elisabeth of Wädenswil brought him Frutigen, Tellenburg, Felsenburg, Mülenen and the Lauterbrunnen valley, the lands held in 1337 by his son Peter III. The family's fortunes then crumbled: Peter made war on the pro-Savoyard bishop Guichard Tavelli, and in 1375 Anton von Turn had the bishop murdered; defeated and driven from the Valais, he saw the Gestelnburg destroyed in 1384 and sold the Lauterbrunnen estates to Interlaken Abbey in 1395 and Frutigen to the city of Bern in 1400. The line died out with Anton in 1405.
zh: 图恩男爵领代表的是图恩男爵（冯·图恩）家族在伯尔尼高地的产业，该家族是瓦莱最有权势的贵族世家之一。他们可能出身多菲内的拉图尔迪潘男爵家族，12世纪作为圣莫里斯修道院的封臣定居瓦莱；威廉一世约1170年在下格斯特尔恩修建格斯特尔恩堡，其兄弟阿马迪乌斯出任锡永主教。13世纪时，图恩家族作为锡永及其教区的守护者控制了罗讷河谷的大片土地；约翰一世娶韦德尼斯维尔的伊丽莎白为妻，得到弗鲁蒂根、泰伦堡、费尔森堡、米莱嫩和劳特布伦嫩山谷，正是1337年其子彼得三世在位时领有的这片土地。此后家族运势急转直下：彼得对亲萨伏依的主教吉沙尔·塔韦利开战，1375年安东·冯·图恩派人刺杀主教，兵败后被逐出瓦莱，格斯特尔恩堡于1384年被毁；他又在1395年把劳特布伦嫩产业卖给因特拉肯修道院，1400年把弗鲁蒂根卖给伯尔尼城。1405年安东去世，家族绝嗣。

en: Tripoli, the Tripoli-of-the-West of Arab geographers, is a Phoenician foundation called Oea that became the chief of the three cities of Roman Tripolitania, alongside Sabratha and Leptis Magna. The Arabs took it from the Byzantines in the 640s, and after Fatimid, Almohad and then Hafsid rule it passed in 1324 to the Banu Thabit, a Berber family of the Huwwara confederation whose amirs governed in the name of Tunis while running an effectively independent city-state grown rich on Mediterranean trade; Muhammad ibn Thabit, who held power from 1326, belonged to this house. The Genoese sacked and occupied Tripoli in 1354 and sold it to the Banu Makki of Gabès, but the exiled family made its fortune as merchants in Alexandria, chartered Christian ships and retook the city in 1369. Hafsid armies returned in strength at the end of the century, and Abu Faris Abd al-Aziz II ended the dynasty and restored direct rule in 1401. Spain conquered Tripoli in 1510 and handed it to the Knights of St John, until the Ottoman admiral Turgut Reis took it in 1551. Under the Ottomans it became a great Barbary corsair base, and from 1711 the Karamanli dynasty ruled it as a virtually independent pashalik, famed for its wars with the United States, until the sultan reimposed direct rule in 1835.
zh: 的黎波里在阿拉伯地理学家口中称‘西的黎波里’，最初是腓尼基人建立的奥亚城，后来成为罗马的黎波里塔尼亚三城之首，与萨布拉塔、大莱普提斯并列。7世纪40年代阿拉伯人从拜占庭手中夺取该城，历经法蒂玛、穆瓦希德和哈夫斯王朝统治后，1324年落入巴努萨比特家族之手；这是豪瓦拉联盟的柏柏尔人家族，其埃米尔以突尼斯名义治理，实际独立经营着一座靠地中海贸易致富的城邦，1326年起主政的穆罕默德·伊本·萨比特就出自该家族。1354年热那亚人洗劫并占领的黎波里，把它卖给加贝斯的巴努马基家族；流亡的萨比特家族在亚历山大经商致富，租用基督徒船只卷土重来，于1369年收复该城。14世纪末哈夫斯大军压境，阿布·法里斯·阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹二世于1401年终结该王朝，恢复直接统治。1510年西班牙征服的黎波里，随后将它交给圣约翰骑士团，1551年奥斯曼海军将领图尔古特·雷斯将其攻取。奥斯曼治下它成为柏柏尔海盗的重要基地，1711年起卡拉曼利王朝以近乎独立的帕夏领统治该地，并因与美国的战争闻名，直到1835年苏丹恢复直接统治。

en: The Principality of Tarusa was a minor Russian state centered on the town of Tarusa on the Oka River and one of the Upper Oka Principalities. It arose around 1246, when Yury Mikhailovich, a son of Prince Mikhail Vsevolodovich of Chernigov, received Tarusa as his appanage. His descendants, including the Obolensky and Volkonsky families, later divided it into smaller holdings such as Obolensk. From the 1350s the Tarusa princes leaned on Moscow in the rivalry between Lithuania and Ryazan, and in 1392 the principality was annexed by the Grand Principality of Moscow. Its princely lines then entered Muscovite service, and Tarusa itself was later counted among the fortified border towns that Ivan III bequeathed to his son Vasily in 1503.
zh: 塔鲁萨公国是以奥卡河畔塔鲁萨城为中心的罗斯小邦，属于上奥卡公国群之一。它约形成于1246年，切尔尼戈夫王公米哈伊尔·弗谢沃洛多维奇之子尤里·米哈伊洛维奇分得塔鲁萨作为世袭领地；他的后裔，包括奥博连斯基家族和沃尔孔斯基家族，后来又把它分割成奥博连斯克等更小的封邑。14世纪50年代起，塔鲁萨诸王公在立陶宛与梁赞的角力中倚重莫斯科，1392年公国被莫斯科大公国兼并。各支王公随后转入莫斯科服役，塔鲁萨本身也在1503年伊凡三世留给其子瓦西里的边境要塞城镇之列。

en: Tyrconnell, in Irish Tír Chonaill, the land of Conall, was the Gaelic kingdom of the Cenél Conaill, a Northern Uí Néill people descended from Conall Gulban, son of Niall of the Nine Hostages. Once part of the overkingdom of Ailech, it emerged as a separate kingdom in the twelfth century under the O'Donnell clan, whose power centred on Donegal Castle and the Franciscan Donegal Abbey in what is now County Donegal, with influence reaching into Sligo, Leitrim and Fermanagh. The O'Donnells spent much of their history at war with the rival O'Neills of Tyrone, defeating them at Knockavoe in 1522 and Farsetmore in 1567, and Manus O'Donnell took part in the crown's surrender and regrant settlement in 1541. In the Nine Years' War of 1593 to 1603 Red Hugh O'Donnell stood beside Hugh O'Neill until the defeat at Kinsale in 1601. His brother Rory was made Earl of Tyrconnell after the peace of 1603, but joined the Flight of the Earls in 1607, died in Rome in 1608, and his title was attainted in 1614; the kingdom was then planted under the Plantation of Ulster.
zh: 蒂康奈尔的爱尔兰语作 Tír Chonaill，意为“科纳尔之地”，是北尼尔支系康尼尔·康纳尔人的盖尔王国，他们自认是“九名人质”尼尔之子科纳尔·古尔班的后裔。这里原属阿莱赫大王权，12世纪分离为独立王国，由奥唐奈（Ó Domhnaill）家族统治，权力中心在今多尼戈尔郡的多尼戈尔城堡和方济各会多尼戈尔修道院，势力一度延伸到斯莱戈、利特里姆和弗马纳。奥唐奈家族的历史大半在与东邻蒂龙的奥尼尔家族交战，1522年在诺克沃、1567年在法塞特莫尔两度击败对方；马努斯·奥唐奈还于1541年参与了王室的“交土再封”。1593至1603年的九年战争中，“红休”奥唐奈与休·奥尼尔并肩作战，直到1601年金塞尔之役战败。其弟罗里在1603年议和后受封蒂康奈尔伯爵，却在1607年参与“伯爵出逃”，1608年客死罗马，爵位也于1614年被剥夺；王国随后在阿尔斯特殖民中被瓜分安置。

en: Tesechoacan was a river town on the stream of the same name, also called the Guaspaltepec river, a tributary of the Papaloapan in southern Veracruz. In pre-Hispanic times it was one of the subject towns of the senorio of Guaspaltepec, and so shared the fate of that rich and populous state: already under Mexica rule when the Spaniards came, it was conquered in 1522 during Gonzalo de Sandoval's campaign through the Papaloapan basin and then distributed in encomienda. In 1742 San Miguel Tesechoacan was still a self-governing republica de indios with its own governor and alcaldes, though its indigenous families had mostly withdrawn after quarrels with the mulato and black families settled there; the remaining community traded cotton for cochineal with Villa Alta in Oaxaca. It became a municipality in 1831.
zh: 特塞乔阿坎是同名河畔的城镇，这条河又称瓜斯帕尔特佩克河，是韦拉克鲁斯南部帕帕洛阿潘河的支流。先西班牙时期，它是瓜斯帕尔特佩克领主邦的属镇之一，因而与这个富庶稠密的邦国同命运：西班牙人到来时它已处在墨西加统治之下，1522年贡萨洛·德·桑多瓦尔征战帕帕洛阿潘盆地时将它征服，随后被分封进监护征赋制。1742年，圣米格尔·特塞乔阿坎仍是一个自治的印第安人共和国，设有自己的总督和市政官，但当地印第安人家族已因与定居于此的穆拉托人和黑人家庭冲突而大多迁出，留下的社群用棉花向瓦哈卡的比亚阿尔塔换取胭脂虫红。1831年，它成为市镇。

en: The Tsakho, or Zagunao tusi (Tibetan rGyal-kha), were a hereditary Gyalrong chieftaincy and one of the eighteen Gyalrong chiefdoms, holding the valleys of present-day Li, Mao and Heishui counties in Sichuan, with its seat at Zagunao. In 1407 its headman Apiao submitted to the Ming and was named pacification commissioner over the old Weizhou border forts. The rising Muping tusi invaded and partly occupied its lands in 1449, but Tsakho recovered its full territory by 1469. During the Ming-Qing transition the chieftains Sangjipeng and his son Liang'erji expanded steadily: by 1683 they had swallowed several smaller chiefdoms and, linked by marriage to the Jinchuan and Wori tusi, ruled a thousand-li stretch with over ten thousand households, making Tsakho the strongest of the Gyalrong chiefdoms. A wary Qing court split off the Somang tusi in 1721 and the Choktse and Tangpa tusi in 1748. In 1752 the chieftain Cangwang attacked those neighbors in open revolt, was captured and executed, and the court replaced native rule with military colonies, created Zagu Subprefecture, and set up the Songgang tusi to continue the lineage.
zh: 杂谷（又称杂谷脑，藏语嘉卡）土司是明朝至清朝的世袭嘉绒人土司，为嘉绒十八土司之一，辖今四川阿坝州理县、茂县、黑水县一带，治所在理县杂谷脑。1407年头人阿漂归附明朝，授安抚司，命其抚辑旧维州诸寨。1449年崛起的穆坪土司大举入侵，占据旧维州等地；后来杂谷于1469年恢复旧疆。明清交替之际，土司桑吉朋、良尔吉父子持续扩张，到1683年攻灭打喇、八棱碉等小土司，又与小金川、沃日、绰斯甲诸司联姻，辖地东西绵延一千里、有百姓一万余户，成为嘉绒最强的土司。清廷转而分而治之：1721年分置梭磨土司，1748年又分置卓克基、党坝二司。1752年土司苍旺攻打梭磨、卓克基，被四川总督策楞、提督岳钟琪擒杀，清廷随即改土归屯，设杂谷厅，另立松岗土司以承其世系。

en: Tenasserim, now called Tanintharyi, is the long coastal salient on the western side of the Malay Peninsula, where Mon-speaking ports such as Tavoy, Mergui and Tenasserim itself face the Andaman Sea. Chinese records of the first millennium knew the area as Tun Sun, and its southern marts were identified with the ancient emporium of Takkola, while the north belonged to the Mon kingdom of Thaton until King Anawrahta folded the coast into the Pagan Empire after 1057. When Bagan fell in 1287, Tenasserim passed to the Siamese kingdom of Sukhothai, whose vassal it remained in 1337, and then to Ayutthaya. The Siamese founded the walled port of Tenasserim in 1383, and together with Tavoy and Mergui it handled Ayutthaya's Indian Ocean trade. Bayinnaung of Toungoo conquered the coast in 1564, and although Ayutthaya retook the south by 1599, King Anaukpetlun recovered the northern half down to Tavoy in 1614. The Konbaung kings Alaungpaya and Hsinbyushin seized the whole coastline between 1760 and 1765, and the Treaty of Yandabo transferred it to the British in 1826.
zh: 丹那沙林，今称德林达依，是马来半岛西侧一条狭长的滨海地带，土瓦、丹老和丹那沙林等孟人港口面向安达曼海。公元第一个千年的中国史籍称这一带为顿逊，其南部商埠被比定为古港塔科拉，北部则在1057年以前属于孟人的直通王国；后来阿奴律陀王把整条海岸纳入蒲甘帝国。1287年蒲甘灭亡后，丹那沙林转入暹罗的素可泰王国之手，1337年时仍是它的藩属，之后又归阿瑜陀耶。暹罗人于1383年筑建了有城墙的丹那沙林港，它与土瓦、丹老一起承担阿瑜陀耶的印度洋贸易。1564年，东吁的勃印曩征服这条海岸；阿瑜陀耶虽在1599年以前收复南段，阿瑙白龙王又于1614年夺回直到土瓦的北半段。1760至1765年间，贡榜王朝的雍笈牙和辛标信夺取整条海岸线；1826年的《杨达波条约》又把它割让给英国。

en: Tuf Shur Tia, the Green Reed Place in Southern Tiwa, is the indigenous name of the pueblo the Spaniards called Sandía, after the watermelon-red glow of the neighbouring mountains at sunset; an older Tiwa name was Nafiat, the place where the wind blows dust. Its people had lived on this bend of the Rio Grande near present-day Albuquerque since the fourteenth century, when their country held more than twenty pueblos and numbered perhaps three thousand souls at first contact. Francisco Vázquez de Coronado's expedition reached it around 1540, and after 1610 Franciscans under Esteban de Perea built the mission of San Francisco, whose tribute demands and forced labour in church building and mines turned the pueblo against colonial rule. Tuf Shur Tia gave shelter to rebels from Zia and Jemez and joined the Pueblo Revolt of 1680 led by Popé; Governor Antonio de Otermín burned the already abandoned village, and its people took refuge among the Hopi. Four hundred and forty-one survivors came home and resettled in 1742, and in 1762 Governor Tomás Cachupín had the pueblo rebuilt as a buffer against Navajo and Apache raids, although a Comanche attack killed thirty of its people in 1775. The rebuilt community preserved its Southern Tiwa speech and kachina ceremonies through the rest of the colonial era.
zh: 图夫舒尔蒂亚是南蒂瓦语，意为“绿芦之地”，即西班牙人所称的桑迪亚普韦布洛——西班牙人见附近山峦在落日下呈西瓜红色，便以“西瓜”名之；它更古老的蒂瓦语名字叫纳法亚特，意为“风吹尘土之地”。蒂瓦人14世纪起便居住在格兰德河这道河湾，即今阿尔伯克基附近，当时这一带有二十多座普韦布洛，初次接触欧洲人时人口约有三千。1540年前后科罗纳多远征队抵达，1610年后埃斯特万·德·佩雷亚等方济各会修士建起圣弗朗西斯科传教站；贡赋勒索以及建教堂、下矿井的苦役，使这座普韦布洛与殖民当局为敌。图夫舒尔蒂亚曾收容齐亚和赫梅斯的反抗者，并参加了1680年波佩领导的普韦布洛起义；总督安东尼奥·奥特尔明放火焚毁这座已然撤空的村镇，居民逃往霍皮人处避难。1742年，四百四十一名幸存者返乡重新定居；1762年总督托马斯·卡丘平下令重建此镇，作为抵御纳瓦霍人和阿帕奇人袭扰的屏障，尽管1775年科曼奇人的一次袭击仍杀死了三十人。重建后的社区在殖民时代余下的岁月里保存了南蒂瓦语和克契奈仪式。

en: Teutila was a small Popoloca-speaking polity in the lower Papaloapan valley, in present-day northern Oaxaca, ruling the neighbouring towns of Ixcatlan and Oxitlan. The Popoloca were Oto-Manguean farming peoples of the hill country between Puebla, Oaxaca and Veracruz, whom Nahuatl speakers dismissed as speakers of a barbarous tongue. Mexica armies campaigned through the region from 1456, planting garrisons and tribute collectors, so that Teutila's lands were drawn into the Aztec tribute system. The expeditions of Hernan Cortes reached the area in 1521, and the following years brought encomiendas and the colonial tribute regime. The old towns correspond to present-day San Pedro Teutila and San Pedro Ixcatlan.
zh: 特乌蒂拉是帕帕洛阿潘河下游一个讲波波洛卡语的小邦，地处今瓦哈卡州北部，统辖邻近的伊斯卡特兰和奥希特兰两镇。波波洛卡人属于奥托-曼格语系，在普埃布拉、瓦哈卡和韦拉克鲁斯之间的山区务农，讲纳瓦特尔语的人曾把他们的语言当作蛮语。1456年起，墨西加军队攻入这一地区，设置驻军和贡税官吏，特乌蒂拉的土地于是被纳入阿兹特克的朝贡体系。1521年，埃尔南·科尔特斯的远征队到达此地，随后几年监护征赋制和殖民地贡税制度相继建立。这些古镇即今瓦哈卡州境内的圣佩德罗·特乌蒂拉和圣佩德罗·伊斯卡特兰。

en: Tamtoc, whose Huastec name means place of the water clouds, was a great Huastec city on the Tampaón River, part of the Pánuco river system in the heart of the Huasteca. Founded around 600 BC, it was rebuilt on a new plan between 600 and 900 and entered its greatest age from 900 onward, growing to some 210 hectares and ranking as the leading urban, military and commercial centre of the Huastec world. Its sculptors carved sandstone stelae and statues of rulers and priestesses from quarries in the Sierra de Tanchipa, and the prominence of women among its burials and figurines suggests they held high rank in the city. Around 1350 Tamtoc lost its regional hegemony and was abandoned, so that when Spanish forces overran the Huasteca after 1519 only its ruins remained on the Tamuín plain.
zh: 塔姆托克在瓦斯特克语中意为水云之地，是瓦斯特卡腹地坦帕翁河畔（帕努科水系）的一座瓦斯特克大城。它约建于公元前600年，600—900年间按新规划重建，900年以后进入鼎盛期，面积约210公顷，是瓦斯特克世界首屈一指的城市、军事和商业中心。工匠从坦奇帕山的采石场取来砂岩，雕成统治者和女祭司的石像与石碑；墓葬和陶俑中女性占突出地位，说明女性在城中地位很高。约1350年，塔姆托克失去地区霸权并遭废弃，因此当1519年以后西班牙军队征服瓦斯特卡时，塔穆因平原上只剩下它的废墟。

en: Trieste, the Roman Tergeste on the Gulf of Trieste, was a small Adriatic port whose medieval commune grew rich on maritime trade. In 788 it submitted to Charlemagne and was placed under a count-bishop subject to the Duke of Friuli. By the thirteenth century it had become a trade rival of the Republic of Venice, which occupied the city from 1283 to 1287 before it passed under the loose patronage of the Patriarchate of Aquileia. In 1337 Trieste still governed itself as a free commune under its consuls, though Venetian pressure never eased. A new Venetian war began in 1368 and the city was occupied until 1372; after the Peace of Turin of 1381 renounced Venetian claims, its leading citizens petitioned Duke Leopold III of Habsburg, signing their voluntary submission at Graz on 30 September 1382. Trieste kept broad autonomy under the Habsburgs but suffered Emperor Frederick III's sack of 1468 and 1469, remembered as the Destruction of Trieste, and a brief Venetian occupation during the War of the League of Cambrai in 1508. Its fortunes revived when Emperor Charles VI made it a free port in 1719, opening the prosperous eighteenth-century age of the city as Austria's main harbour.
zh: 的里雅斯特古称特尔格斯泰，位于的里雅斯特湾，是亚得里亚海畔的小港口，其中世纪公社靠海上贸易致富。788年它臣服于查理曼，被置于听命弗留利公爵的主教伯爵治下。到13世纪，它成为威尼斯共和国的贸易竞争者，威尼斯曾在1283年至1287年占领该城，此后它转而接受阿奎莱亚牧首的松散庇护。1337年，的里雅斯特仍由执政官以自由公社的形式自治，但威尼斯的压力从未减轻。1368年威尼斯再度开战，城市被占领至1372年；1381年《都灵和约》使威尼斯放弃对它的主权要求后，城中显贵向哈布斯堡公爵利奥波德三世请愿，于1382年9月30日在格拉茨签署自愿臣服协议。的里雅斯特在哈布斯堡治下保留了广泛自治权，但在1468年至1469年遭皇帝腓特烈三世洗劫，史称“的里雅斯特之毁”，1508年康布雷同盟战争期间又被威尼斯短暂占领。1719年皇帝查理六世将它辟为自由港，城市命运由此复兴，迎来了作为奥地利主要港口的繁荣18世纪。

en: Tortona, the Roman colony of Dertona founded around 123 BC, stood on the road from Genoa to Piacenza and was one of the chief military stations of the western Po valley. An early bishopric grew up within its walls, and bishops ruled the city until the ninth century. In 1090 Tortona became a free commune, and in 1133 its diocese was transferred from the archdiocese of Milan to the newly created archdiocese of Genoa. The commune took the Guelph side in the struggles of Lombardy, which cost it dear: the emperor Frederick Barbarossa captured it after a siege in 1155 and razed the city to the ground. Rebuilt, Tortona never fully escaped the ambitions of stronger neighbours, and from 1260 it passed under a succession of local lords and adventurers, among them the condottiere Facino Cane. In 1337 it still kept its communal institutions, but in 1347 the Visconti of Milan incorporated it decisively into the Duchy of Milan, under which it remained until 1735. In the War of the Polish Succession the King of Sardinia occupied Tortona, and the title Count of Tortona was added to those of the House of Savoy.
zh: 托尔托纳古称德尔托纳，约公元前123年建立为罗马殖民地，地处热那亚通往皮亚琴察的大道上，是波河平原西部最重要的军事据点之一。城中很早就设立了主教区，9世纪以前一直由主教统治。1090年，托尔托纳成为自由公社，1133年其教区从米兰总主教区划归新设立的热那亚总主教区。公社在伦巴第的纷争中站在圭尔夫派一边，也因此付出惨重代价：1155年皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨围攻后攻陷该城，将其夷为平地。重建后的托尔托纳始终无法摆脱强邻的觊觎，1260年起相继受制于一系列地方领主和冒险家，佣兵首领法奇诺·卡内便是其中之一。1337年它仍保留着公社制度，但1347年米兰的维斯孔蒂家族把它正式并入米兰公国，此后一直隶属米兰直到1735年。波兰王位继承战争期间，撒丁国王占领托尔托纳，“托尔托纳伯爵”也成为萨伏依家族的头衔之一。

en: Acolhuacan was the polity of the Acolhua people, whose capital was Tetzcoco, an altepetl on the eastern shore of Lake Texcoco founded in the twelfth century, probably by Chichimecs. Around 1337, with Tepanec help, the Acolhua drove the Chichimecs out of Tetzcoco and made it their capital in place of Coatlinchan, under the long reign of Quinatzin from 1298 to 1357. In 1418 Tezozomoc of Azcapotzalco dethroned the Tetzcocan ruler Ixtlilxochitl I, but his son Nezahualcoyotl allied with the Mexica and in 1428 defeated the Tepanec usurper Maxtla. Tetzcoco then joined Tenochtitlan and Tlacopan in the Triple Alliance, receiving two fifths of the tribute and ranking second only to Tenochtitlan. Nezahualcoyotl, poet, philosopher and builder, made his court a center of learning with a famed library, gardens and aqueducts. In 1520 Cortés occupied the city and killed its tlatoani Cacamatzin, and from Tetzcoco he launched the 1521 siege that destroyed Tenochtitlan.
zh: 阿科尔瓦坎是阿科尔瓦人的政权，都城特斯科科是特斯科科湖东岸的一座城邦，12世纪时大概由奇奇梅克人建立。约1337年，阿科尔瓦人在特帕内克人帮助下把奇奇梅克人逐出特斯科科，取科阿特林昌而代之，将其定为都城，当时在位的是1298至1357年长期统治的基纳钦。1418年，阿斯卡波察尔科的特索索莫克废黜了特斯科科君主伊斯特利尔索奇特尔一世，但王子内萨瓦尔科约特尔联合墨西加人，于1428年击败特帕内克篡位者马克斯特拉。特斯科科随即与特诺奇蒂特兰、特拉科潘结成三方同盟，分得五分之二的贡赋，地位仅次于特诺奇蒂特兰。身兼诗人、哲人和营造者的内萨瓦尔科约特尔把宫廷变成学术中心，建有著名的藏书馆、园林和引水渠。1520年科尔特斯占领该城并杀死君主卡卡马辛，随后以特斯科科为基地，在1521年发动围城战摧毁了特诺奇蒂特兰。

en: Tübingen was the seat of the counts palatine of Swabia, a dynasty first documented as counts of Nagoldgau and established at Hohentübingen Castle, which is mentioned as early as 1078, when Henry IV besieged it during the Investiture Controversy. From 1146 Count Hugo V styled himself count palatine, rewarded for his services to the first Staufer king, Conrad III; as the emperor's representative in the Duchy of Swabia he held judicial, customs and minting rights, and the Tübingen pfennig was struck from 1185. The family was a great founder of monasteries, among them Blaubeuren in 1085, Marchtal in 1171 and Bebenhausen in 1183, while a younger son's marriage to the heiress of Bregenz produced the Montfort branch. Repeated partitions and lavish piety gradually ruined the counts, and their lines at Horb, Böblingen and Asberg died out one by one. In 1311 Count Gottfried led the imperial army against the banned count of Württemberg, but debt still dogged the family, and in 1342 Emperor Louis the Bavarian ordered Gottfried to make restitution, forcing him to sell the town and castle of Tübingen to Count Ulrich III of Württemberg for 20,000 gold hellers. The remaining branches, Herrenberg and Tübingen-Lichteneck, survived as lesser lords until the seventeenth century.
zh: 蒂宾根是施瓦本行宫伯爵的治所，这个家族最初以纳戈尔德高伯爵的身份见于文献，盘踞在霍亨蒂宾根堡；该堡早在1078年就有记载，当时亨利四世在主教叙任权之争中围攻过它。1146年起，胡戈五世自称行宫伯爵，这是他效力于首位施陶芬国王康拉德三世所得的封赏；作为皇帝在施瓦本公国的代表，他拥有司法、关税和铸币权，蒂宾根芬尼银币从1185年开始铸造。该家族热衷于兴建修道院，1085年的布劳博伊伦、1171年的马尔赫塔尔和1183年的贝本豪森修道院都出自其手，家族幼子与布雷根茨女继承人的婚姻则衍生出蒙特福特支系。不断分家加上慷慨的宗教施舍使伯爵们日渐穷困，霍尔布、伯布林根和阿斯贝格各支相继绝嗣。1311年，戈特弗里德伯爵曾率帝国军队讨伐被剥夺法律保护的符腾堡伯爵，但债务仍如影随形；1342年，皇帝巴伐利亚人路易下令赔偿，戈特弗里德被迫以两万金赫勒的价格把蒂宾根城和城堡卖给符腾堡伯爵乌尔里希三世。余下的黑伦贝格与蒂宾根-利希特内克两支作为小领主又延续到17世纪。

en: Toul stands on the Moselle in Lorraine, on the site of Tullum Leucorum, the chief town of the Gallic Leuci. Its bishopric was founded in the middle of the fourth century as a suffragan of Trier, and the 550 Council of Toul showed its early standing. After the Treaty of Meerssen in 870 it belonged to East Francia, and from 925 it formed part of the Holy Roman Empire; in 1048 the bishop's lands became an imperial state while the city of Toul itself became a free imperial city. The see was one of the three Lotharingian bishoprics with Metz and Verdun, and under Bishop Gerhard I and his successors it became a centre of church reform: Bishop Brun of Toul, a cousin of Emperor Conrad II, was elected Pope Leo IX in 1049. The bishops fortified Liverdun from 1178 as their stronghold, but after disputed elections Pope Nicholas III appointed the Franciscan Konrad Probus in 1278, who surrendered the episcopal advocacy to the dukes of Lorraine; the city meanwhile emancipated itself and the bishops withdrew to Liverdun. In 1552 King Henry II of France occupied Toul together with Metz and Verdun under the Treaty of Chambord, and though Charles V failed to win Metz back, the Empire recognised the loss only in the Peace of Westphalia of 1648. The three bishoprics then formed a French province, and the old diocese was suppressed under the Concordat of 1802.
zh: 图勒位于洛林的摩泽尔河畔，所在之地古称图卢姆-勒乌科鲁姆，是高卢勒乌基人的主城。当地教区4世纪中叶创立，隶属特里尔教省，550年举行的图勒会议已显示出它的地位。870年《梅尔森条约》后它归属东法兰克，925年起成为神圣罗马帝国的一部分；1048年主教的领地成为帝国邦国，而图勒城本城成为帝国自由市。它与梅斯、凡尔登并称洛林三主教区，在格哈德一世主教及其继任者治下成为教会改革的中心：皇帝康拉德二世的堂亲、图勒主教布鲁恩于1049年当选教皇利奥九世。主教们从1178年起把利韦尔丹筑为据点，但1278年历数次选举纠纷后，教皇尼古拉三世任命方济各会修士康拉德·普罗布斯为主教，他把主教的护领权让给洛林公爵；城市也在此期间摆脱主教统治，主教们退居利韦尔丹。1552年，法国国王亨利二世依据《尚博尔条约》出兵占领图勒以及梅斯、凡尔登；查理五世收复梅斯失败，而帝国直到1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》才正式承认这一损失。三主教区随后组成法国的一个行省，古老的图勒教区则在1802年的《教务专约》中被撤销。

en: The Tunisia of 1337 was the Hafsid Sultanate, a Sunni dynasty of Berber descent ruling Ifriqiya, the eastern Maghreb covering present-day Tunisia, eastern Algeria and western Libya, from its capital at Tunis. Its founder Abu Zakariya Yahya had been appointed governor of the province by the Almohad caliph and declared himself independent in 1229; his successors assumed the caliphal title and made Tunis a haven for Andalusi refugees, a city of madrasas and the birthplace of the historian Ibn Khaldun. The dynasty split into a Tunis branch and a western branch ruling from Béjaïa and Constantine, until Abu Yahya Abu Bakr II, sultan from 1318 to 1346, reunited the realm. His death in 1346 opened a crisis in which the Marinid sultans of Morocco overran the country and briefly held Tunis. Unity returned under Abu al-Abbas Ahmad II in 1370, and the fifteenth century became the Hafsid apogee: Abu Faris Abd al-Aziz II annexed Tripoli in 1401 and Algiers in 1410, while Abu Amr Uthman made the Zayyanids and the Moroccan Wattasids acknowledge his suzerainty. Caught between Spain and the Ottomans in the sixteenth century, the Hafsids became Spanish tributaries after Charles V took Tunis in 1535; the Ottomans finally conquered the city in 1574 and carried off the last Hafsid caliph to Constantinople.
zh: 1337年的突尼斯是哈夫斯苏丹国，这个柏柏尔裔逊尼派王朝以突尼斯城为都，统治易弗里基叶，即涵盖今突尼斯、阿尔及利亚东部和利比亚西部的东马格里布。开国君主阿布·扎卡里亚·叶海亚本是穆瓦希德哈里发任命的行省总督，1229年宣布独立；他的后继者自称哈里发，把突尼斯城建成安达卢斯难民的庇护所和宗教学校林立的学术之城，史学家伊本·赫勒敦便出生于此。王朝后来分裂为突尼斯支系与以贝贾亚、君士坦丁为都的西部支系，直到1318至1346年在位的阿布·叶海亚·阿布·贝克尔二世重新统一全国。他1346年去世后局势陷入危机，摩洛哥的马林苏丹们乘虚入侵，一度占领突尼斯城。1370年阿布·阿拔斯·艾哈迈德二世恢复统一，15世纪成为哈夫斯王朝的鼎盛期：阿布·法里斯·阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹二世于1401年吞并的黎波里、1410年吞并阿尔及尔，阿布·阿慕尔·奥斯曼则迫使宰扬王朝和摩洛哥的瓦塔斯王朝承认其宗主权。16世纪，哈夫斯王朝夹在西班牙与奥斯曼之间，1535年查理五世夺取突尼斯城后沦为西班牙附庸；1574年奥斯曼人最终攻克该城，末代哈夫斯哈里发被押往君士坦丁堡。

en:
The Ottoman state began as one of the Turkmen beyliks that succeeded the Seljuk sultanate of Rum, founded around 1299 by Osman of the Kayı clan on the Byzantine frontier of northwestern Anatolia. His son Orhan captured Bursa in 1326 and made it the Ottoman capital, and within a generation Turkish rule had crossed into the Balkans. Murad I crushed the Serbs at Kosovo in 1389 and was killed on the field; Bayezid I defeated the crusaders at Nicopolis in 1396 but was taken prisoner by Timur at Ankara in 1402, opening an eleven-year civil war from which Mehmed I reunited the state. Mehmed II ended the Byzantine Empire by storming Constantinople in 1453, Selim I conquered the Mamluk lands including Egypt in 1517 and assumed the caliphate, and Suleiman, ruling from 1520 to 1566, took Belgrade, won at Mohács in 1526 and besieged Vienna in 1529.

The failed second siege of Vienna in 1683 and the Treaty of Karlowitz in 1699 opened an age of territorial retreat, confirmed against Russia by the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca in 1774. The Serbian revolution of 1804 and the Greek revolt of 1821 carried Balkan nationalism into the empire's European provinces, while the French seized Algiers in 1830. In 1826 Mahmud II destroyed the reactionary Janissary corps in the Auspicious Incident and began rebuilding the army on European lines, only to face the revolt of Muhammad Ali of Egypt, whose forces advanced as far as Kütahya in 1833.
zh:
奥斯曼国家起家于继承罗姆苏丹国的土库曼贝伊国之一，约1299年由卡耶氏族的奥斯曼在安纳托利亚西北部的拜占庭边境建立。他的儿子奥尔汗于1326年攻占布尔萨并定为都城，不到一代人的时间，突厥人的统治便进入巴尔干。穆拉德一世1389年在科索沃击溃塞尔维亚人并战死沙场；巴耶济德一世1396年在尼科波利斯击败十字军，却在1402年的安卡拉战役中被帖木儿俘虏，引发长达十一年的内战，最终由穆罕默德一世重新统一国家。穆罕默德二世于1453年攻陷君士坦丁堡，终结拜占庭帝国；塞利姆一世1517年征服包括埃及在内的马穆鲁克领地并承袭哈里发之位；1520至1566年在位的苏莱曼攻占贝尔格莱德，1526年赢得莫哈奇战役，1529年围攻维也纳。

1683年第二次维也纳围城失败，1699年的《卡尔洛维茨条约》开启领土收缩的时代，1774年的《库楚克—凯纳尔卡条约》又确认了对俄罗斯的失利。1804年的塞尔维亚革命和1821年的希腊起义把巴尔干民族主义带进帝国的欧洲行省，法国则于1830年夺取阿尔及尔。1826年马哈茂德二世在“吉祥事件”中剿灭守旧的禁卫军，开始按欧洲模式重建军队，却又面临埃及的穆罕默德·阿里叛乱，其军队在1833年推进到屈塔希亚。

en: Tototepec, bird hill in Nahuatl, was a Huastec, or Teenek, town in the Sierra de Tenango of the Huasteca highlands, in present-day northeastern Hidalgo. It fell with the rest of the Huasteca to Moctezuma I's Aztec armies around 1450, keeping local rule under tribute, and Augustinian friars built a mission church there after the Spanish conquest, completed in 1620.
zh: 托托特佩克在纳瓦特尔语中意为鸟山，是瓦斯特卡高地特南戈山脉中的一座瓦斯特克，即特内切，城镇，位于今伊达尔戈州东北部。约1450年，它与整个瓦斯特卡地区一同被蒙特苏马一世的阿兹特克军队征服，在纳贡条件下保留地方统治；西班牙征服后，奥斯定会修士在此修建传教教堂，于1620年竣工。

en: The Principality of Turov grew up in the lands of the Dregovich tribe around the town of Turov, said to have been founded by the Varangian prince Tur and first mentioned in 980, with Pinsk, Slutsk and Brest among its subject towns. Vladimir the Great made it a seat for his sons, and the Council of Liubech of 1097 turned Turov into a hereditary patrimony of its own Rurikid line. In 1162 Prince Yury Yaroslavich broke free of Kiev, but the principality soon fragmented, with Pinsk going its own way, and its men fought beside the Smolensk contingent at the Battle of the Kalka River in 1223. Early in the thirteenth century Turov fell under the sway of the Kingdom of Galicia-Volhynia, and its princes then turned to Lithuania; the principality joined the Grand Duchy of Lithuania peacefully early in the fourteenth century, though Turov itself remained under Rurikid princes. Its lands were later distributed among the Brest, Nowogródek and Minsk Voivodeships.
zh: 图罗夫公国兴起于德列戈维奇人的土地，以图罗夫城为中心；相传该城由瓦良格王公图尔建立，980年首次见于记载，平斯克、斯卢茨克和布列斯特都曾是它的属城。弗拉基米尔大帝曾把它封给儿子们，1097年的柳别奇会议使图罗夫成为留里克家族一支的世袭产业。1162年王公尤里·雅罗斯拉维奇脱离基辅独立，但公国很快四分五裂，平斯克另立门户；1223年，图罗夫军队还与斯摩棱斯克分队并肩参加了迦勒迦河之战。13世纪初，图罗夫沦为加利奇—沃伦王国的附庸，其王公转而投靠立陶宛，公国于14世纪初和平并入立陶宛大公国，而图罗夫本地仍由留里克家族的王公统治。它的土地后来被划入布列斯特、新格鲁多克和明斯克诸省。

en: Tozantlan, on the site of the present-day town of Tuzantla, was a pre-Columbian settlement in the eastern uplands of Michoacán. Its Nahuatl name means place where gophers abound, while the Purépecha called it Cusaro or Ocumo, a word meaning Otomi. Nahuas inhabited the area until the Purépecha Empire absorbed it in the expansion that began under Tariácuri around 1300, after which it lay on the empire's eastern march.
zh: 托赞特兰位于今图桑特拉镇一带，是米却肯东部山地的前哥伦布时期聚落。它的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“囊鼠众多之地”，普雷佩查人则称之为库萨罗或奥库莫，后一个词意为“奥托米”。纳瓦人曾居住于此，后来在约1300年塔里亚库里开启的普雷佩查扩张中被帝国吞并，成为其东部边陲的一部分。

en:
The Principality of Tver was a Rus' principality on the upper Volga, with its capital at Tver, whose rulers rivaled Moscow for leadership of the northeast Rus' lands in the fourteenth century. Carved out of the Pereyaslavl-Zalessky principality, it passed in 1246 to Yaroslav Yaroslavich, whose descendants ruled it until 1485. Refugees fleeing the Mongol raids swelled its population, and its river trade and the building of the Transfiguration Cathedral made it one of the wealthiest Rus' cities. Its prince Mikhail became grand prince of Vladimir in 1305, but the Golden Horde khan Özbeg favored Moscow: Mikhail was executed at the Horde in 1318, his son Dmitry in 1326, and Prince Aleksandr Mikhailovich and his son in 1339. The anti-Tatar uprising of 1327 ended with Tver burned and its people decimated, and the title of grand prince of Vladimir passed to Ivan I of Moscow.

Tver nevertheless kept the contest alive. Mikhail II was the last Tver prince to hold the grand princely patent, in 1371, and a Muscovite siege in 1375 forced him to recognize Dmitry Donskoy as his elder brother; Tver sent no troops to Kulikovo in 1380 and later leaned on Lithuania, allying with Vytautas in 1427. As Moscow gained the upper hand, Ivan III imposed unequal treaties, and when Mikhail III turned to Lithuania for help, Ivan's army conquered Tver in 1485 and annexed the principality, granting it to his son Ivan the Young.
zh:
特维尔公国是伏尔加河上游的罗斯公国，都城在特维尔，14世纪时曾与莫斯科争夺东北罗斯的领导权。它从佩列亚斯拉夫尔-扎列斯基公国分出，1246年归于雅罗斯拉夫·雅罗斯拉维奇，其后裔一直统治到1485年。蒙古劫掠带来的难民充实了它的人口，河运贸易和显圣容大教堂的兴建使它成为罗斯最富庶的城市之一。王公米哈伊尔于1305年成为弗拉基米尔大公，但金帐汗月即别转而支持莫斯科：米哈伊尔于1318年在金帐汗国被处死，其子德米特里于1326年遇害，王公亚历山大·米哈伊洛维奇父子又于1339年被处决。1327年的反鞑靼起义以特维尔被焚、人口锐减告终，弗拉基米尔大公的称号转入莫斯科的伊凡一世之手。

特维尔仍未放弃争夺。米哈伊尔·亚历山德罗维奇于1371年成为最后一位领有大公诰命的特维尔王公，1375年莫斯科军队围城，迫使他承认德米特里·顿斯科伊为兄长；1380年特维尔没有派兵参加库利科沃战役，此后转而依靠立陶宛，于1427年与维陶塔斯结盟。随着莫斯科占据上风，伊凡三世强迫它签订不平等条约；当米哈伊尔·鲍里索维奇向立陶宛求援时，伊凡三世的军队于1485年攻占特维尔，吞并公国，并把它封给儿子小伊凡。

en: Tavas was a small Turkmen beylik on the fertile Tavas plain in ancient Caria, around the fortress of Tabae, modern Kale-Tavas south of the Menderes river. It emerged after the Seljuk defeat at Köse Dağ in 1243 loosened Rum's hold on the interior, and its lords ruled first from the villages of Horasanlı and Hırka and then from Tavas itself. In the fourteenth century the beylik was held by İlyas Bey, the ruler in 1337, among a population noted for its devotion to the Mevlevi order, and its position wedged between the Germiyan, Aydın, Hamid and Menteşe beyliks made it a natural pawn of its stronger neighbours. When Denizli passed to the Germiyanids, Tavas was attached to the Menteşeids in 1365, and the whole region was absorbed into the Ottoman Empire under Murad II in 1424.
zh: 塔瓦斯是古卡里亚地区塔瓦斯平原上的一个突厥蛮小贝伊国，地当门德雷斯河以南的塔巴埃要塞，即今卡莱—塔瓦斯一带。1243年克谢山战败后，罗姆对内陆的控制松弛，塔瓦贝伊国就此兴起，其首领先后以霍拉萨勒村、赫尔卡村和塔瓦斯村为治所。14世纪时，贝伊国由1337年在位的伊利亚斯贝伊统治，当地居民以虔信梅夫拉维教团著称；它夹在格尔米扬、艾登、哈米特和门泰谢四个贝伊国之间，自然成为强邻摆布的棋子。代尼兹利落入格尔米扬之手后，塔瓦斯于1365年被并入门泰谢，整个地区又在1424年被穆拉德二世治下的奥斯曼帝国吞并。

en:
Twipra, anglicized as Tipperah, was the hill kingdom of the Tripuri people in what is now the state of Tripura in north-eastern India. Its court chronicle, the Rajmala, composed in Bengali under Dharma Manikya in the fifteenth century, claims for its kings descent from the Lunar Dynasty, and the royal cult of the fourteen Chaturdasa Devata deities, served by Chantai priests, long blended Hindu and tribal worship. In the eighth century the rulers moved their capital east along the Surma River to the country around Kailashahar.

Firm history begins in the early fifteenth century, when the Tripuri chief Maha Manikya founded the Manikya dynasty after a victory over Bengal; Ratna Manikya then established the capital at Rangamati on the Gomati River. Under Dhanya Manikya, reigning from 1463 to 1515, and Vijaya Manikya II, Twipra reached its greatest extent, stretching from the Garo Hills to the Bay of Bengal and holding sway over Sylhet, Cachar and the Chittagong Hill Tracts. Mughal pressure in the early seventeenth century cost the kingdom its plains, which became a Mughal client state, but the hill kings kept their independence, and in 1761 Twipra entered British protection as the self-governing state of Hill Tippera.
zh:
特里普拉（又译蒂佩拉）是特里普拉人在今印度东北部特里普拉邦建立的山地王国。15世纪达尔马·曼尼克亚在位时用孟加拉语编成的宫廷编年史《拉杰马拉》，声称诸王出自月种王朝；由昌泰祭司主持的十四神崇拜长期融合了印度教与部落信仰。8世纪时，统治者把都城沿苏尔马河东迁至凯拉萨哈尔一带。

可靠的历史始于15世纪初：特里普拉首领摩诃·曼尼克亚在对孟加拉的战争获胜后开创曼尼克亚王朝，其后拉特纳·曼尼克亚在戈马蒂河畔的兰加马蒂定都。在1463至1515年在位的达尼亚·曼尼克亚以及毗阇耶·曼尼克亚二世治下，特里普拉达到极盛，疆域北起加罗丘陵、南抵孟加拉湾，统有锡尔赫特、卡恰尔和吉大港山区。17世纪初，莫卧儿的压力使其丧失平原领地，那里成为莫卧儿的附庸国，但山地诸王保住了独立；1761年，特里普拉以自治的山地蒂佩拉之名接受英国保护。

en: Tixi was a small native longship office in the wooded hills of eastern Guizhou, among the stream valleys west of Tongren. Under the Yuan it was counted among the longship offices belonging to the great Sizhou Xuanwei Commission of the Tian clan. When the Ming dismantled Sizhou in 1413, Tixi was assigned, together with four sister offices, to the new Tongren Prefecture. Its mountain streams bore gold, and the Ming ran a gold-washing bureau at Taipingxi inside the chieftaincy's territory.
zh: 提溪是贵州东部山区的小型长官司，地处铜仁以西的溪洞之间。元代它是思州田氏宣慰司属下的长官司之一，1413年明朝拆分思州、思南两司后，提溪与省溪、大万山、乌罗、平头著可四司一起划归新置的铜仁府管辖。其境内溪涧产金，明代在太平溪设有金场局，淘采沙金。

en: Tuxpan, called Tochpan in Nahuatl, or place of rabbits, was a Huastec town on the Gulf coast of Mexico near the mouth of the river that now bears its name. Its coastal position made it a trading centre: a market held every twenty days drew merchants from the Valley of Mexico and Tulancingo, dealing in cedar wood, chicle, fish, shrimp and tortoises. Around 1450 the armies of Moctezuma I defeated the Huastecs, and Tochpan became the seat of an Aztec tributary province that also included Papantla, sending clothing, turquoise, jade and featherwork to Tenochtitlan. The town kept substantial local self-rule until the Spanish overran the Huasteca between 1519 and the 1530s, after which many of its people were shipped to the Caribbean as slaves.
zh: 图斯潘在纳瓦特尔语中称托奇潘，意为兔子之地，是墨西哥湾沿岸、今图斯潘河入海口附近的瓦斯特克城镇。凭借沿海位置，它成为贸易中心，每二十天一次的集市吸引来自墨西哥谷地和图兰辛戈的商人，交易雪松木、奇克莱树脂、鱼、虾和龟。约1450年，蒙特祖马一世的军队击败瓦斯特克人，托奇潘成为阿兹特克一个纳贡行省的治所，该行省还包括帕潘特拉，向特诺奇蒂特兰输送衣物、绿松石、玉石和羽毛制品。在1519年至16世纪30年代西班牙人征服瓦斯特卡之前，该镇保留了相当大的自治权；征服之后，许多居民被当作奴隶运往加勒比地区。

en: Tyrone, in Irish Tír Eoghain, the land of Eoghan, was the leading Gaelic kingdom of Ulster, homeland of the Cenél nEógain among the Northern Uí Néill. It began in the fifth century as a sub-kingdom of Ailech, initially based in Inishowen, and supplied thirteen high kings of Ireland between the sixth and tenth centuries. When Ailech split in the twelfth century, Tyrone fell first to the Mac Lochlainns and then to their kinsmen the O'Neills, who destroyed Mac Lochlainn power at the Battle of Caimeirge in 1241 and reigned as sovereign kings from Dungannon, with inauguration at Tullyhogue Fort. The Norman Earldom of Ulster checked them for a time, but its collapse in 1333 let the O'Neills overrun eastern Ulster and plant the Clandeboye branch, while the main line under Aodh Reamhar and his son Niall Mór, king from 1364, made Tyrone the strongest power in the north, balanced against the O'Donnells of Tyrconnell. In 1493 Henry VII addressed the O'Neill as chief of the Irish kings. The Tudor kings then drew the kingdom into their system: Conn Bacagh O'Neill was made Earl of Tyrone in 1542, Shane the Proud died in revolt in 1567, and Hugh O'Neill's Nine Years' War ended in surrender in 1603. His flight to the Continent with the other Ulster earls in 1607, the Flight of the Earls, was followed by the forfeiture of the title and the Plantation of Ulster.
zh: 蒂龙，爱尔兰语称蒂尔欧文，意为“欧文之地”，是阿尔斯特最强大的盖尔王国，也是北方尼尔后裔中欧文部族的故土。它5世纪时作为阿利奇的附庸小国兴起，最初以因尼肖温为根基，6至10世纪间出过十三位爱尔兰至高王。12世纪阿利奇分裂后，蒂龙先归麦克洛克林家族，后落入同宗的奥尼尔家族；奥尼尔氏于1241年在凯梅尔格战役摧毁麦克洛克林势力，以邓甘嫩为都、在塔利霍格堡举行即位礼，作为主权国王进行统治。诺曼人的阿尔斯特伯爵领曾一度压制他们，但1333年伯爵领崩溃，奥尼尔氏趁机东进，扶植出克兰迪博伊支系；主支在奥埃德·雷瓦尔及其子1364年继位的尼尔·莫尔率领下，成为北方最强势力，与泰尔康奈尔的奥唐纳家族分庭抗礼。1493年，亨利七世在书信中称奥尼尔为“爱尔兰诸王之首”。都铎诸王随后把这个王国纳入体制：康恩·巴卡·奥尼尔1542年受封蒂龙伯爵，“骄傲的”谢恩1567年兵败身死，休·奥尼尔的九年战争于1603年以投降告终。1607年他与阿尔斯特众伯爵逃往欧洲大陆，史称“伯爵出逃”，头衔随后被没收，阿尔斯特种植园随之展开。

en: The Kingdom of Taytay was a precolonial monarchy on the northern coast of Palawan, whose ruler was said to be attended wherever he went by ten scribes. In 1521 the surviving crew of Ferdinand Magellan, fleeing the Battle of Mactan, held the king of Taytay and his consort hostage to extort supplies before sailing on to the Moluccas, an episode recorded by the chronicler Antonio Pigafetta. Spanish rule came only in 1623, when the town was formally founded. The Augustinian Recollects built the stone fortress of Fuerza Santa Isabel de la Paragua between 1667 and 1738 to fend off raids by the war fleets of the Muslim polities of the south, and in 1818 Taytay became capital of the province of Calamianes, covering the whole of Palawan.
zh: 泰泰王国是巴拉望岛北部海岸的前殖民时代王国，据说君主无论走到哪里都有十名书吏随行。1521年，费迪南德·麦哲伦的残部在逃离麦克坦战役后，扣下泰泰国王及其王后勒索补给，随后才驶往摩鹿加群岛，随队编年史家安东尼奥·皮加费塔记录了此事。西班牙人的统治迟至1623年才到来，泰泰镇在这一年正式建立。奥斯定会重整派修士于1667年至1738年修筑石砌要塞圣伊莎贝尔堡，以抵御南方穆斯林政权战船的袭掠；1818年，泰泰成为辖有整个巴拉望岛的卡拉米安内斯省首府。

en: Tollantzinco, meaning the place behind the reeds in Nahuatl, stands in the fertile valley of present-day Tulancingo in Hidalgo, a crossroads whose great twenty-day market drew Otomi, Tepehua and Totonac traders from across the eastern highlands. A Toltec city had been founded there as early as 645 BCE and was abandoned with the fall of Tula, after which Chichimeca groups under the leader Xolotl refounded it around 1120 together with the surviving Toltec population. In 1324 the ruler Quinatzin made Tollantzinco the head of a province, but its wars with Texcoco ended in defeat, and early in the fifteenth century the Acolhua of Texcoco conquered the city; in 1431 Itzcoatl and Nezahualcoyotl reorganized it as an Aztec tributary center with an Acolhua garrison. During the Spanish war the local prince Ixtlilxochitl raised an army here to join Hernan Cortes against Tenochtitlan, and the valley passed under Spanish rule in 1525.
zh: 图拉钦科在纳瓦特尔语中意为芦苇后方之地，位于今伊达尔戈州肥沃的图兰辛戈谷地，是一处交通要冲：当地每二十天一次的大集市吸引着东部高地的奥托米、特佩瓦和托托纳克商人。早在公元前645年，托尔特克人便在此建城，图拉衰落后该城遭到废弃；约1120年，首领索洛特尔率领奇奇梅卡人与残存的托尔特克居民一起重建此城。1324年，统治者基纳钦把图拉钦科改组为一省之首，但它与特斯科科的战争以失败告终，15世纪初特斯科科的阿科瓦人征服了该城；1431年，伊兹科阿特尔与内萨瓦尔科约特尔又将其整顿为阿兹特克的朝贡中心，驻扎阿科瓦军队。西班牙人交战期间，当地王子伊斯特利尔索奇特尔在此起兵，加入埃尔南·科尔特斯一方攻打特诺奇蒂特兰，整个谷地于1525年归入西班牙统治。

en: The Tzeltal, who call themselves Winik Atel, the working men, are a Maya people of the central Chiapas highlands and close kin of the Tzotzil, from whose language theirs began to separate around 1200. Their ancestors entered Chiapas in the early centuries of the Common Era, and on the eve of the Spanish arrival their society was divided into nobles, commoners and slaves and split among as many as forty-five autonomous hill polities, speaking the highland Oxchuc and lowland Bachajonteco dialects. Spanish expeditions crossed the region in the early 1520s, and in 1527 Pedro de Portocarrero founded San Cristóbal de los Llanos, the first highland colonial town; within a year the Ocosingo valley and the upper Grijalva basin had submitted, and the province of Chiapa was organized in 1528. Crushing tribute and labour demands drove the Tzeltal to abandon their towns and take to the wilds, and encomiendas then bound them to Spanish estates. In the mid-sixteenth century Bartolomé de las Casas founded the mission town of Quechula on the royal road through their country.
zh: 策尔塔尔人自称维尼卡特尔，意为“劳作的人”，是恰帕斯中部高地的玛雅民族，与索西人是近亲，两种语言约在1200年前后分化。他们的祖先在公元最初几个世纪进入恰帕斯；西班牙人到来前夕，其社会分为贵族、平民和奴隶，分裂为多达45个自治的山头小邦，使用高地的奥什楚克方言和低地的巴哈洪特科方言。1520年代初，西班牙远征队穿过这一地区；1527年，佩德罗·德·波托卡雷罗建立了高地第一个殖民城镇圣克里斯托瓦尔·德·洛斯亚诺斯，不出一年，奥科辛戈谷地和格里哈尔瓦河上游便告臣服，恰帕省于1528年设立。沉重的贡赋与劳役逼得策尔塔尔人弃城逃入荒野，监护征赋制又把他们束缚在西班牙人的地产上。16世纪中叶，巴托洛梅·德·拉斯卡萨斯在穿越其土地的皇家大道上建立了传教城镇克丘拉。

en: Tziuhcoac, rendered Cicoaque in later Spanish documents, was a Huastec town in the hill country of the inland Huasteca, between Tuxpan and the Otomi stronghold of Metztitlan. The Huastec polities had paid tribute to the Aztec Empire since the campaigns of Moctezuma I around 1450, but they kept their own rulers and repeatedly rose in revolt. Ahuitzotl stormed Tziuhcoac in 1486 and carried off a great many captives, who were sacrificed at the rededication of the Great Temple of Tenochtitlan in 1487. After the Spanish conquest the town appears as Cicoaque among the Tuxpan estates granted to Hernán Cortés with his title of Marqués del Valle in 1529.
zh: 齐乌科阿克在后世西班牙文献中又拼作西科阿克，是瓦斯特卡内陆山区的瓦斯特克城镇，地处图斯潘与奥托米人重镇梅茨蒂特兰之间。自1450年前后莫克特苏马一世出征以来，瓦斯特克诸邦虽向阿兹特克帝国纳贡，却保留自己的首领并屡次起兵反抗。1486年，阿维索特尔攻陷齐乌科阿克，掳走大批俘虏，这些人在1487年特诺奇蒂特兰大神庙的落成献祭中被处死。西班牙征服后，该城又以西科阿克之名，列入1529年随瓦哈卡谷地侯爵头衔封授给埃尔南·科尔特斯的图斯潘属地清单。

en: Tzitacuaro, the nucleus of the later city of Zitácuaro, was a highland settlement in far eastern Michoacán, its name taken from the Mazahua language. Otomis and Mazahuas founded a village there perhaps as early as the twelfth century, and around the middle of the fourteenth century Mazahuas led by a chief named Yquingari conquered the region. By the Spanish arrival it stood on the frontier between the Purépecha kingdom and the Aztec Empire, and its people fought on the Aztec side in the failed defense of Tenochtitlan in 1521.
zh: 茨塔夸罗是后来锡塔夸罗城的雏形，位于米却肯最东部的高地，名字取自马萨瓦语。奥托米人和马萨瓦人可能早在12世纪便在此建村，约14世纪中叶，首领伊金加里率领马萨瓦人征服了这一地区。西班牙人到来时，它地处普雷佩查王国与阿兹特克帝国之间的边境，1521年当地居民还站在阿兹特克一方，参加了特诺奇蒂特兰失败的保卫战。

en: Teozacoalco, Chiyo Cahnu in Mixtec, meaning Great Altar, was a highland Mixtec city-state in the Nochixtlan valley of the Mixteca Alta. Its ruling dynasty, recorded in the pictorial Codex Bodley, made it one of the principal kingdoms of the highland Mixtecs, alongside Tilantongo, Chalcatongo, Tlaxiaco and Achiutla, and its fortunes were often joined to those of Tilantongo, with the two courts at times sharing a single king. The kingdom was overwhelmed by Aztec expansion under Moctezuma II, who reigned from 1502 to 1520: he conquered it and made it the seat of a tributary province that stretched southwest as far as Zenzontepec. An Aztec garrison was installed in the city, which supplied the soldiers with maize, beans, chia and cotton, while the province paid tribute in greenstone, feathers and woven mantas.
zh: 特奥萨科阿尔科的纽萨维语名为奇约卡努，意为“大祭坛”，是米斯特卡高地诺奇斯特兰谷地的高地纽萨维城邦。它的统治王朝载于图画手抄本《博德利手抄本》，使它与蒂兰通戈、查尔卡通戈、特拉希亚科和阿奇特拉并列，成为高地纽萨维人的主要王国之一，其国运也常与蒂兰通戈相连，两国王廷有时共奉一位君主。这个王国在1502—1520年在位的莫克特苏马二世治下被阿兹特克的扩张吞并：他征服此地后，将它设为一个纳贡省份的治所，辖区向西南延伸至森森特佩克。城中驻扎了阿兹特克守军，由当地供应玉米、豆类、奇亚籽和棉花，全省则以绿石、羽毛和织毯纳贡。

en: Tamazollan was the Nahuatl name for the polity centred on Tlamazolan, the place of toads, a settlement in the warm lowlands of southern Xalisco on the site of modern Tamazula in Jalisco. Its people were a mixture of the region's older village populations with Nahuatl-speaking settlers and Purépecha newcomers, and at the time of the Spanish arrival its lord Calizendo ruled scattered hamlets along the river rather than a single compact town. In 1521 Calizendo joined the rulers of Tuxpan and Zapotlán in an alliance with the Spaniards against Tzome, king of Colima; the district then became the Provinces of Ávalos, and Franciscan friars began its evangelization in 1524, founding a convent and hospital there by 1561.
zh: 塔马索兰是纳瓦特尔语地名，指以特拉马索兰（意为“蟾蜍之地”）为中心的小邦，坐落在哈利斯科南部温暖的低地，即后来墨西哥哈利斯科州塔马苏拉的所在地。其居民由当地古老村社人口与纳瓦特尔语移民、普雷佩查新来者混合而成；西班牙人到来时，首领卡利森多统治的是沿河散布的村落，而不是一座集中的城镇。1521年，卡利森多与图斯潘、萨波特兰的首领一同同西班牙人结盟，对抗科利马国王索梅；此后该地区成为阿瓦洛斯诸省，方济各会修士于1524年开始传教，并在1561年前建起了修道院与医院。

en: Tetzapotitlan was a Huastec town of the northern Veracruz Huasteca, its Nahuatl name meaning a place among the zapote trees; scholarship links the toponym to the prehispanic city now studied at Castillo de Teayo, which was once also called Tzapotlan. Axayacatl's armies overran the Aztec tributary province of Tochpan with its twelve head towns in 1480, and after Ahuitzotl pushed on to take the rebel town of Tziucohuac in 1486, he stationed a permanent Mexica garrison at Tetzapotitlan in 1488 to keep the conquered Huastec polities under control. The town thus became one of the anchor garrisons securing the Aztec Empire's north-eastern frontier.
zh: 特察波蒂特兰是韦拉克鲁斯北部瓦斯特卡地区的瓦斯特克城镇，纳瓦特尔语名字意为“萨波特果树之地”；学界将这一地名与今特阿约城堡遗址所研究的史前古城联系起来，该城旧名察波特兰。1480年，阿克萨亚卡特尔的大军攻占阿兹特克的托奇潘纳贡省及其十二座首镇；1486年阿维索特尔进一步攻克反叛的齐乌科阿克后，于1488年在特察波蒂特兰常驻墨西加戍军，以压制被征服的瓦斯特克诸邦，该城由此成为镇守阿兹特克帝国东北边疆的据点之一。

en: The Tz'utujil are a Maya people of the southern shore of Lake Atitlán in the Sololá highlands of Guatemala, whose name comes from the title of one of their two paramount lords. Their ancestors claimed to have come from Tollan, the old Toltec capital, and they built their capital Chiaa, close to the water, on the fortified hill of Chuitinamit above the later town of Santiago Atitlán, where the supreme lord, the Ahtz'iquinahay, and his nobles ran cacao plantations along the lake. In the fifteenth century the K'iche' king K'iq'ab used military force to stop their expansion, and they remained under the K'iche' shadow until the Spanish came. In 1524 Pedro de Alvarado, marching with Kaqchikel allies, routed them in a battle near Panajachel and seized control of the lake. Franciscan friars soon moved the capital down from the hill to Santiago Atitlán and built a monastery there, while introduced diseases and mine labour cut the population from 72,000 in 1520 to about 5,600 by 1550.
zh: 楚图希尔人是危地马拉索洛拉高地阿蒂特兰湖南岸的玛雅民族，其族名来自两位至高首领之一的头衔。他们自称祖先来自古代托尔特克人的都城图兰，并在后来的圣地亚哥阿蒂特兰上方、设防的楚伊蒂纳米特山丘上建立都城奇亚，意为“近水之地”；至高首领阿奇基纳哈伊和贵族们在湖畔经营可可种植园。15世纪，基切国王基卡布以武力阻止他们向外扩张，楚图希尔人自此处在基切人的阴影之下，直到西班牙人到来。1524年，佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多在卡克奇克尔盟友协助下，于帕纳哈切尔附近的战斗中将其击溃，夺取了湖泊的控制权。方济各会修士很快把都城从山丘迁至圣地亚哥阿蒂特兰并修建修道院；外来疾病和矿场劳役使人口从1520年的7.2万锐减到1550年的约5600人。

en: Tzapotzingo was one of the small señoríos of the coastal plain of Nayarit in western Mexico, in the country of the Huichol peoples. The region was swept through by Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán's expedition from 1529 and folded into the Spanish province of Nueva Galicia, whose encomiendas drove the native communities to revolt. In 1540 Pentécatl, lord of Tzapotzingo, attended the ceremony in the Huasamota valley that heralded the great uprising known as the Mixtón War; he and his neighbours joined the Caxcanes against the Spaniards until viceroy Antonio de Mendoza crushed the rebellion in 1542.
zh: 察波钦戈是墨西哥西部纳亚里特沿海平原上的小酋邦之一，地处维乔尔人活动的地域。1529年起，努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼的远征军横扫这一地区，将其并入西班牙的新加利西亚省，监护制下的奴役迫使当地原住民起而反抗。1540年，察波钦戈的首领彭特卡特尔参加了在瓦萨莫塔谷地举行的仪式，那场仪式宣告了米斯通战争大起义的开始；他率部与卡克斯坎人联手抗击西班牙人，直到1542年总督安东尼奥·德·门多萨将起义镇压。

en: Cuauhteopan, recorded in colonial codices as Quiauhteopan, was a Nahua town in the mountains of eastern Guerrero southwest of Olinalá, on the edge of Mixtec country. Its conquest was claimed both by Moctezuma I of Tenochtitlan and by Nezahualcóyotl of Texcoco, and the town was finally subdued during the Guerrero campaign of 1458. Under Aztec rule it became the seat of one of the small tribute provinces grouped on folio 10v of the Matrícula de Tributos, which every six months delivered eighty copper axes and forty copper bells to the imperial treasury.
zh: 夸乌特奥潘在殖民抄本中记作基尧特奥潘，是格雷罗州东部山区、奥利纳拉西南方的纳瓦人城镇，地处米斯特克地区边缘。特诺奇蒂特兰的蒙特祖马一世和特斯科科的内萨瓦尔科约特尔都声称征服了它，该城最终在1458年的格雷罗战事中被平定。阿兹特克统治时期，它成为《贡税册》第10页背面几个小型贡税省之一的治所，每六个月向帝国府库缴纳八十把铜斧和四十只铜铃。

en: Uaymil, also called Bakhalal, was one of the sixteen Maya kuchkabals that took shape after the wars which destroyed Mayapan between 1441 and 1461. It covered the swampy Caribbean lowlands of what is now southern Quintana Roo, from the Ekab frontier in the north to the Chactemal border in the south, and took in the whole of Bacalar Lagoon; its name is said to mean the opossum, and although large, the province was sparsely peopled because so much of it was marsh. Its chief town, Bakhalal on the lagoon, was a canoe port linked to the traders of Sian Ka'an and Chetumal Bay. In 1531 Alonso de Ávila, acting for Francisco de Montejo, became the first Spaniard to cross the province, marching from Cochuah through the settlements of Chablé and Mazanahua. The southern districts held out until the Pacheco entrada, which in 1544 incorporated the whole coast from Bacalar to Chetumal into Spanish Yucatán.
zh: 瓦伊米尔又名巴卡拉尔，是1441—1461年毁灭玛雅潘的战争后形成的十六个玛雅城邦之一。它占据今金塔纳罗奥南部多沼泽的加勒比低地，北接埃卡布，南邻查克特埃马尔，整个巴卡拉尔湖都在其境内；据说其名意为“负鼠”。该邦幅员虽广，却因沼泽遍布而人烟稀少。湖畔重镇巴卡拉尔是独木舟贸易港口，与锡安卡安和切图马尔湾的商人相通。1531年，阿隆索·德·阿维拉奉弗朗西斯科·德·蒙特霍之命，从科丘阿出发，经查布莱和马萨纳瓦等聚落横穿该邦，成为第一个进入此地的西班牙人。南部地区一直坚持到帕切科征伐，1544年从巴卡拉尔到切图马尔的整个海岸被并入西班牙治下的尤卡坦。

en: Überlingen lies on the northern shore of Lake Constance in Swabia, on the site first recorded in 770 as Iburinga; an earlier settlement called Gunzoburg had been the seat of the Alemannic duke Gunzo in the seventh century. Under the Hohenstaufen it prospered on the lake trade, and by the end of the fourteenth century it held the status of a free imperial city, governed through its guilds and council. In 1525, during the German Peasants' War, its troops helped Georg Truchsess von Waldburg relieve Radolfzell, and the emperor later granted it extended market rights. The city stayed Catholic and withstood the storms of the Thirty Years' War: Swedish and Saxon armies besieged it in 1632 and again in 1634, but failed to take it, a deliverance still commemorated by the annual Sweden Procession; French troops occupied it in 1643 before Franz von Mercy's imperial army retook it the next year. The Reichsdeputationshauptschluss of 1803 ended its self-government and assigned the city to the Grand Duchy of Baden.
zh: 于伯林根位于施瓦本的博登湖北岸，770年首见记载，时称伊布林加；更早的641年前后，这里的贡佐堡是阿勒曼尼公爵贡佐的驻地。霍亨施陶芬时期，它凭湖上贸易兴盛，到14世纪末已取得帝国自由市地位，由行会和市议会治理。1525年德意志农民战争期间，它出兵协助格奥尔格·特鲁赫泽斯·冯·瓦尔德堡解拉多尔夫采尔之围，后来皇帝又扩大了它的市场特权。该城坚守天主教，在三十年战争中顶住了围攻：瑞典和萨克森军队于1632年和1634年两度围城均告失败，此后每年举行瑞典人游行以纪念这次解围；1643年法军一度占领，次年弗朗茨·冯·默西的帝国军队将其收复。1803年的《帝国代表重要决议》终结了它的自治，把它划归巴登大公国。

en: The Duchy of Upper Bavaria, ruled from Munich, was created by the first Wittelsbach partition of 1255, which assigned it to Duke Louis II. In 1337 it was held by his son Louis IV, called the Bavarian, who had ruled since 1294 and been elected King of the Romans in 1314 in a contested double election; he settled the claim by defeating his Habsburg rival Frederick the Fair at the Battle of Mühldorf in 1322 and was crowned Holy Roman Emperor in Rome in 1328, in open defiance of Pope John XXII, who excommunicated him. From Munich he also held Brandenburg and the Electoral Palatinate, and when the last Lower Bavarian duke died childless in 1340 he inherited that duchy too, reuniting all of Bavaria. Louis's death in 1347 left the inheritance to his many sons, who split it afresh in 1349; the partition of 1392 then carved the duchies of Bavaria-Munich and Bavaria-Ingolstadt out of the old Upper Bavarian lands. The rival Wittelsbach lines contended for Munich and the Alpine borderlands until the whole of Bavaria was reunited in 1505.
zh: 上巴伐利亚公国以慕尼黑为治所，产生于1255年维特尔斯巴赫家族的第一次分邦，归路易二世统辖。1337年在位的是其子路易四世，人称巴伐利亚人路易；他自1294年起执政，1314年在有争议的双重选举中当选罗马人的国王，1322年在米尔多夫战役中击败哈布斯堡家族的对手美男子腓特烈，奠定胜局，又于1328年在罗马加冕为神圣罗马皇帝，公然与将他绝罚的教皇约翰二十二世对抗。他以慕尼黑为中心还领有勃兰登堡和莱茵普法尔茨；1340年末代下巴伐利亚公爵无嗣而亡，他又继承该公国，重新统一整个巴伐利亚。1347年路易去世后，众多儿子于1349年再度瓜分遗产；1392年的分邦又在旧上巴伐利亚土地上划出巴伐利亚-慕尼黑和巴伐利亚-因戈尔施塔特两个公国。维特尔斯巴赫的对立支系为争夺慕尼黑和阿尔卑斯边境争斗不休，直到1505年整个巴伐利亚才重新统一。

en: Hohenlohe is the county of the House of Hohenlohe, whose ancestor Conrad, Lord of Weikersheim, appears in documents in 1153. The family took its name from Hohlach Castle, first styling itself von Hohenloch in 1178, and built its lands between the Kocher, Jagst and Tauber rivers, the plateau later called the Hohenlohe Plain, with seats at Weikersheim, Brauneck and Öhringen. Two of its sons, Heinrich and Gottfried, rose to be Grand Masters of the Teutonic Order in the thirteenth century, and in 1230 the house split into the Hohenlohe and Brauneck lines. During the Interregnum its knights fought for the Bishop of Würzburg at the Battle of Kitzingen and won the town of Uffenheim. In 1337 the lordship was held by Count Louis of Hohenlohe, though Uffenheim itself was sold to the Hohenzollerns of Ansbach in 1378; the Brauneck line died out in 1390 and its lands followed in 1448. Emperor Frederick III raised the surviving lordship to an imperial county in 1450. The Reformation was introduced after 1551, when the family divided into the Lutheran Neuenstein and Waldenburg branches, the latter returning to Catholicism in 1667. Both lines gained princely rank in the eighteenth century, and in 1806 their principalities were mediatized to Bavaria and Württemberg.
zh: 霍恩洛厄是霍恩洛厄家族的伯国，其先祖、魏克斯海姆领主康拉德最早见于1153年的文献。家族得名于霍拉赫城堡，1178年首次以“冯·霍恩洛厄”为姓，在科赫尔河、雅格斯特河与陶伯河之间的台地——日后所称的霍恩洛厄平原——上经营领地，驻地在魏克斯海姆、布劳内克和厄林根。13世纪家族中海因里希和戈特弗里德先后出任条顿骑士团大团长；1230年家族分为霍恩洛厄与布劳内克两支。大空位时期，家族骑士在基青根战役中为维尔茨堡主教作战，赢得乌芬海姆镇。1337年领主权由路易·冯·霍恩洛厄执掌，而乌芬海姆本镇于1378年被卖给安斯巴赫的霍亨索伦家族；布劳内克支于1390年绝嗣，其领地也在1448年易主。1450年皇帝腓特烈三世将尚存的领主领地升格为帝国伯国。1551年后宗教改革传入，家族分裂为信奉路德宗的诺恩施泰因支与瓦尔登堡支，后者于1667年重归天主教。两支在18世纪相继取得诸侯等级，1806年其侯国被分别并入巴伐利亚和符腾堡。

en: The Ughanids represent the autonomous non-Muslim Mongol tribes that grazed the uplands around Sirjan in the Kerman province, known to Persian sources as the Avgani and Jormai. The Il-Khan Abaqa, who reigned from 1265 to 1282, granted these tribes autonomy in their Kerman pastures, and in 1337 they still kept their old Mongol ways and Tengrist beliefs amid the Muslim Persian population around them. After the Muzaffarid Mubariz al-Din Muhammad conquered Kerman in 1340, he bound the tribal chieftains to his new dynasty by marriage: his son Shah Shoja wed the daughter of one of their chiefs, and the tribes remained important Muzaffarid allies in the region's wars.
zh: 乌格罕对应在克尔曼省锡尔詹一带高地游牧的自治非穆斯林蒙古部落，波斯史料称之为阿夫加尼部与焦尔马伊部。1265至1282年在位的伊儿汗阿八哈授予这些部落对克尔曼牧场的自治权；1337年时，在周围穆斯林波斯人的环绕中，他们仍保持着蒙古旧俗和腾格里信仰。1340年穆扎法尔王朝的穆巴里兹丁·穆罕默德征服克尔曼后，通过联姻把这些部落酋长绑定在新王朝上：他的儿子沙阿·舒贾娶了其中一位酋长的女儿，这些部落也在此后的地区战争中始终是穆扎法尔王朝的重要盟友。

en: Uglich is a Volga town first recorded in 1148 as Ugliche Pole, its name referring to the sharp bend the river makes nearby. From 1218 it was the seat of its own small Rurikid principality, but in 1328 its princes sold their rights to Ivan I Kalita of Moscow, so that in 1337 the town was already a Muscovite appanage and a frontier stronghold, repeatedly burned in raids by Lithuanians, Tatars and the men of Tver. In 1462 Ivan III granted it to his brother Andrey Bolshoy, under whom the town gained its first stone buildings, including the red-brick prince's palace completed in 1481. Later the town passed to Yury, brother of Ivan the Terrible, and its craftsmen built the wooden fortress shipped down the Volga for the siege of Kazan in 1552. Uglich is most famous for the death of the young Tsarevich Dmitry in 1591, which extinguished the old Rurikid line and helped trigger the Time of Troubles.
zh: 乌格利奇是伏尔加河畔的城镇，最早以“乌格利奇原野”之名见于1148年的记载，城名得自附近伏尔加河的急转弯。1218年起这里是一个独立的留里克小公国的驻地，但1328年当地王公把权利卖给了莫斯科的伊凡一世·卡利塔，因此1337年时它已是莫斯科的封邑和边境要塞，曾多次在立陶宛人、鞑靼人和特维尔军队的袭扰中被焚。1462年伊凡三世把它封给弟弟安德烈·博利绍伊，乌格利奇的第一批石造建筑由此出现，包括1481年完工的红砖王公宫。后来此地归伊凡雷帝的弟弟尤里所有，当地工匠为1552年的喀山之役建造了沿伏尔加河运往前线的木制要塞。乌格利奇最著名的事件是1591年幼储君德米特里在此身亡，古老的留里克血脉就此断绝，并成为混乱时期的导火索之一。

en: Ungwana, known in older records as Hoja, was a walled Swahili trading town near the mouth of the Tana River, on the bay that still bears its name on the northern Kenyan coast. Founded around the middle of the tenth century, it grew behind a stone circuit wall into an eighteen-hectare city of mosques, a market square and coral-stone houses, one of them large enough to have served as a ruler's palace, and it has been suggested as the capital of the little-known kingdom of Ozi. Its wells supplied the town with fresh water, and imported Chinese and Islamic pottery found in its ruins shows trade across the Indian Ocean, while local wares recovered inland point to exchanges with hinterland communities. A Portuguese fleet sacked Ungwana in 1505 during its campaign along the Swahili Coast. The town never fully recovered and was abandoned in the early seventeenth century.
zh: 翁瓜纳在较早的记载中称霍贾，是一座有城墙的斯瓦希里贸易城镇，位于肯尼亚北部海岸塔纳河河口附近，濒临同名的翁瓜纳湾。它约建于10世纪中叶，在石砌城墙内发展为一座占地18公顷的城市，内有清真寺、市场和珊瑚石住宅，其中一座规模宏大，可能是统治者的宫殿；还有学者认为它就是少有人知的奥济王国的都城。城中水井提供淡水，废墟里出土的中国和伊斯兰陶器表明它参与了印度洋贸易，而在内陆发现的本地陶器则说明它与腹地社群也有往来。1505年，一支葡萄牙舰队在斯瓦希里海岸的征战中洗劫了翁瓜纳。该城再未完全恢复，于17世纪初被废弃。

en: The Ujjainiyas are a Rajput clan of the Bhojpur country, holding the lower Ganga lands around Buxar and Arrah. An offshoot of the Parmar Rajputs, their bardic tradition, recorded in the Tawarikh-i-Ujjainiya, traces them to the Paramara kings of Ujjain in Malwa and the celebrated ruler Bhoja. In the fourteenth century, under Hunkar Singh, they entered western Bihar and fought a long war with the Chero chiefs who then ruled the region; the Cheros were driven south into Palamu after battles said to have cost them more than twenty thousand men. The Ujjainiyas next clashed for over a century with the Jaunpur Sultanate, whose first sultan Malik Sarwar harassed Brahmins at their devotions until the chief Raja Harraj was forced back into guerrilla war in the forests. Gajpati Sahi, placed on the Bhojpur throne with Sher Shah Suri's help in 1534, fought at Surajgarha and Chausa and received Rohtas as his reward. Narayan Mal made his peace with the Mughals in 1607, taking a mansab rank, and routed a Chero and Munda army near Buxar; but a later family feud gave the Mughals their opening, and Bhojpur was sacked and brought under direct imperial rule in 1699. In 1709 Horil Singh founded the new house of Dumraon, which survived into British times as a zamindari.
zh: 乌贾伊尼亚人是博杰普尔地区的拉杰普特部族，占据伯格萨尔、阿拉一带的恒河下游土地。他们是帕马尔拉杰普特的支系，其吟游传统记于《乌贾伊尼亚史》中，自称源自马尔瓦乌贾因的帕拉马拉诸王，可追溯到名王波阇。14世纪，他们在洪卡尔·辛格率领下进入比哈尔西部，与当时统治当地的哲卢首领长期交战；据说哲卢人战死逾两万，最终被逐往南方的伯拉穆。此后乌贾伊尼亚人又与江布尔苏丹国交锋百余年：初代苏丹马利克·萨尔瓦尔骚扰祈祷中的婆罗门，首领哈拉杰先胜后败，退入丛林打起游击战。1534年，加杰帕蒂·萨希在舍尔沙·苏尔帮助下登上博杰普尔之位，参加苏拉杰加尔哈和乔萨之战，受封罗赫达斯。1607年，纳拉扬·马尔与莫卧儿廷议和，接受曼萨布品级，并在伯格萨尔附近击溃哲卢与蒙达联军；但后来的家族内讧给了莫卧儿人可乘之机，博杰普尔于1699年遭洗劫，被纳入帝国直接统治。1709年，霍里尔·辛格另建杜姆拉翁政权，在英国统治时期以柴明达尔领地存续。

en: Ulm stands on the upper Danube below the Swabian Jura, first mentioned in 854 when Louis the German held court at the royal palace of Hulma. Emperor Frederick Barbarossa made it an imperial city in 1181, and from a stopping place of the peripatetic royal court it grew into a centre of trade and crafts on the routes to Italy. The Great Swear Letter of 1397, a settlement between the patricians and the guilds, gave the city an early constitution, and in 1377 the citizens began the vast Ulm Minster at their own expense. The fifteenth and sixteenth centuries were its golden age, built on the export of fine textiles and marked by sculptors such as Hans Multscher and Jörg Syrlin the Elder; the city adopted the Reformation in 1530. The shift of trade routes and the Thirty Years' War began a long decline, and in the War of the Spanish Succession French and Bavarian troops occupied it in turn. Ulm lost its imperial status to Bavaria in 1803, and in 1805 Napoleon surrounded General Mack's Austrian army there in the Battle of Ulm; in 1810 the city passed to the Kingdom of Württemberg.
zh: 乌尔姆位于施瓦本汝拉山下的多瑙河上游，最早见于854年的记载，当时日耳曼人路易正在名为“胡尔马”的王宫驻跸。1181年皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨将它立为帝国城市，它也从流动王廷的巡幸驻地，成长为通往意大利商路上的工商业重镇。1397年城市贵族与行会达成的《大宣誓书》赋予它一部早期宪法，1377年市民又自费动工兴建宏伟的乌尔姆大教堂。15至16世纪是乌尔姆的黄金时代，优质纺织品外销各地，汉斯·穆尔舍、老约尔格·叙尔林等雕刻家活跃于此；1530年城市接受宗教改革。商路转移和三十年战争开启了长期的衰落，西班牙王位继承战争中法国与巴伐利亚军队又轮番占领。1803年乌尔姆失去帝国直辖地位，划归巴伐利亚；1805年拿破仑在此以乌尔姆战役包围马克将军的奥军；1810年城市转属符腾堡王国。

en: The Earldom of Ulster was the foremost Anglo-Norman lordship in northern Ireland, with its seat at Carrickfergus Castle on the Antrim coast. The Norman knight John de Courcy invaded the Gaelic kingdom of Ulaid in 1177 and was made earl palatine by Henry II in 1181; his conquests covered most of the present counties of Antrim and Down. In 1263 the earldom passed to Walter de Burgh, and under his family it became a wealthy, largely peaceful province, linked by marriage to the Bruces and the greatest English houses. Edward Bruce of Scotland sacked much of the earldom and besieged Carrickfergus in 1315, a blow from which it never fully recovered. The young William Donn de Burgh, third earl, was murdered by his own men in 1333, leaving his thirteen-month-old daughter Elizabeth as sole heir; her claim later passed to the English crown through her marriage to Lionel of Antwerp, son of Edward III. The title reverted to the Crown in 1461, by which time the once great earldom had shrunk to a few coastal enclaves around Carrickfergus and County Down.
zh: 阿尔斯特伯爵领是爱尔兰北部最重要的盎格鲁—诺曼领地，治所设在安特里姆海岸的卡里克弗格斯城堡。诺曼骑士约翰·德·库西于1177年入侵盖尔人的乌拉德王国，1181年被亨利二世封为宫伯，其征服地大致相当于今天的安特里姆郡和唐郡。1263年伯爵领转入沃尔特·德·伯格之手，在其家族治下成为富庶而大体安定的省份，并通过联姻与布鲁斯家族及英格兰的名门相连。1315年，苏格兰的爱德华·布鲁斯蹂躏了伯爵领大部并围攻卡里克弗格斯，伯爵领自此一蹶不振。1333年，年轻的第三代伯爵威廉·唐·德·伯格被部下杀害，只留下十三个月大的女儿伊丽莎白作为唯一继承人；她后来嫁给爱德华三世之子安特卫普的莱昂内尔，继承权随之转入英格兰王室。1461年伯爵头衔收归王室，此时昔日强大的伯爵领已萎缩为卡里克弗格斯和唐郡周边的几处沿海飞地。

en: Umasuyus, the water quarter, was the eastern shore of the Lake Titicaca basin in the Aymara-speaking Qullaw, taking its name from the Aymara word uma, water, in contrast to Urcosuyu, the fire quarter on the western shore. After Tiwanaku collapsed around 1000 its lands broke into a string of rival lordships, among them Azángaro, Asillo, Ayaviri, Moho, Conima and Pacasa, whose capital was Achacachi; between 1300 and 1450 their wars drove each group to shelter in hilltop forts called pukaras. Like the other lake kingdoms the Umasuyu lords held discontinuous colonies in the warmer Pacific and Amazon valleys, a vertical archipelago of settlements. The Inca emperor Pachacuti opened the Collao campaign in the mid-fifteenth century, defeating the Colla Capac at Ayaviri and Pucara, and after fresh revolts Túpac Yupanqui subdued the remaining independent Umasuyu chiefdoms and placed the eastern lake shore under an administration centered on La Paz.
zh: 乌马苏尤斯意为水区，是艾马拉语区科利亚奥境内的的喀喀湖流域东岸，名称来自艾马拉语的水，与湖西岸的火区乌尔科苏尤相对。1000年前后蒂亚瓦纳科崩溃后，这一带分裂为一连串相互争战的酋长国，包括阿桑加罗、阿西约、阿亚维里、莫霍、科尼马和以阿查卡奇为都的帕卡萨；1300年至1450年间战事不断，各部纷纷退守名为普卡拉的山顶堡垒。与其他湖畔王国一样，乌马苏尤的首领们在太平洋沿岸和亚马孙一侧的温暖河谷保有互不相连的殖民地，形成垂直群岛式的定居体系。15世纪中叶，印加皇帝帕查库特克发动科利亚奥战役，在阿亚维里和普卡拉击败科利亚卡帕克；此后又发生多次反叛，图帕克·尤潘基最终征服了其余保持独立的乌马苏尤酋长国，把湖东岸交给以拉巴斯为中心的机构管辖。

en: Owill, in Irish Umhaill, was a small Gaelic seafaring lordship wrapped around Clew Bay in western Connacht, covering the baronies of Burrishoole and Murrisk in what is now County Mayo. By the twelfth century its rulers were the Uí Máille, or O'Malleys, who kept a line of shore castles, lived by trading and fishing, and charged black rent even to English fishermen working their coasts. Long an autonomous kingdom under the high king of Connacht, Umhaill later became a vassal territory of the Mac William Íochtar Burkes. Its last and most famous ruler was Gráinne Ní Mháille, better known as Grace O'Malley, the pirate queen, who inherited the chiefship about the middle of the sixteenth century and commanded both the clan's lands and its fleet. In 1576 she accepted the crown's surrender and regrant terms, and in 1593 she sailed to Greenwich to petition Elizabeth I in person for the release of her captured sons and brother. On her death about 1603 the lordship passed to her son Tibbot na Long, and the old Gaelic order of Umhaill faded under the Tudor conquest.
zh: 奥维尔，爱尔兰语称乌维尔，是环绕康诺特西部克鲁湾的一个小型盖尔航海领地，辖有今天梅奥郡境内的伯里舒尔和马里斯克两个男爵区。12世纪时，其统治者已是奥马利家族（爱尔兰语称伊·马利）；他们沿海岸修筑一连串城堡，以贸易和渔业为生，甚至向在自家海域作业的英格兰渔民收取黑租。乌维尔长期是臣属于康诺特至高王的自治小邦，后来成为下麦克威廉伯克家族的附庸。它最后也是最著名的统治者是格蕾丝·奥马利（爱尔兰语名格拉涅·尼·马利），人称海盗女王，她在16世纪中叶继承首领之位，同时统辖家族的土地与船队。1576年她接受王室“投降再封”的条件，1593年又亲赴格林尼治向伊丽莎白一世请愿，要求释放被俘的儿子和弟弟。约1603年她去世后，领地传给儿子蒂博特·“纳朗”，乌维尔古老的盖尔秩序也在都铎征服中走向终结。

en: Urbino was a lordship of the Montefeltro family in the Marche of central Italy, set on its fortified hill town between the Adriatic coast and the Apennines. A branch of the counts of Carpegna, the Montefeltro became imperial vicars of Urbino under Frederick Barbarossa and counts in 1226 under Frederick II, leading the Ghibelline party of the Marche against their Guelph rivals, the Malatesta of Rimini. In 1337 its lord was Nolfo da Montefeltro, called Siginolfo, who had recovered the town after the murder of his father Federico I and a period of papal control. In 1443 Pope Eugene IV raised the county into a duchy; under Federico III, duke from 1474, Urbino became one of the most brilliant courts of the Renaissance, famed for its Ducal Palace, its library and patrons of artists from Piero della Francesca to the young Raphael, while Baldassare Castiglione later set The Book of the Courtier there. Cesare Borgia briefly seized the state in 1502 and 1503, and with the death of Guidobaldo in 1508 the Montefeltro line ended and the duchy passed to the della Rovere, who moved the capital to Pesaro in 1523. When the last della Rovere duke died without an heir in 1631, Urbino was annexed by the Papal States.
zh: 乌尔比诺是蒙泰费尔特罗家族在意大利中部马尔凯地区建立的领地，以亚得里亚海岸与亚平宁山脉之间设防的山城为核心。蒙泰费尔特罗家族出身卡尔佩尼亚伯爵家族的支系，在腓特烈·巴巴罗萨时期成为乌尔比诺的帝国代理官，1226年又被腓特烈二世封为伯爵，是马尔凯吉伯林派的首领，长期与里米尼的圭尔夫派马拉泰斯塔家族相争。1337年在位的是领主诺尔福·达·蒙泰费尔特罗（又称西吉努尔夫），他在父亲费德里科一世遇刺、领地一度被教皇国控制后重新夺回了这座城市。1443年，教皇尤金四世将伯国升为公国；1474年成为公爵的费德里科三世治下，乌尔比诺成为文艺复兴时期最辉煌的宫廷之一，以公爵宫、藏书室和对皮耶罗·德拉·弗朗切斯卡、年轻的拉斐尔等艺术家的赞助闻名，卡斯蒂廖内后来也把《廷臣论》的场景设在这里。切萨雷·博尔贾曾于1502年至1503年短暂夺取公国；1508年圭多巴尔多去世后蒙泰费尔特罗家族绝嗣，公国转入德拉·罗韦雷家族手中，并于1523年将首都迁往佩萨罗。1631年末代德拉·罗韦雷公爵无嗣而终，乌尔比诺被教皇国吞并。

en: The Urin Chanka were the lower half of the Chanka people, settled around Andahuaylas in the Apurímac highlands, where their capital Huaman Karpa, the house of the falcon, stood by Lake Anori on the Pampas River near the sanctuary of Sondor. Founded according to tradition by Ancovilca, they were above all farming folk, growing Andean crops in several altitude zones and herding llamas and alpacas, and the mummy of the early leader Uscovilca was long venerated at Huaman Karpa. Unlike their Hanan kinsmen, the Urin Chanka did not march on Cusco but submitted peacefully to the Incas after the Battle of Yawarpampa in 1438, keeping their local lords under imperial governors. They were later drawn into the Inca civil war on the side of Huáscar, and after the Spanish invasion served the short-lived Cusco government of Túpac Hualpa.
zh: 乌林·昌卡是昌卡人的下半部，定居在阿普里马克高原的安达韦拉斯一带，都城瓦曼卡尔帕意为隼之屋，坐落在潘帕斯河畔的阿诺里湖畔，邻近松多尔圣地。相传他们由安科维尔卡建立，以农耕为本，在不同海拔地带种植安第斯作物，放牧大羊驼和羊驼，早期首领乌斯科维卡的木乃伊长期在瓦曼卡尔帕受供奉。与哈南亲族不同，乌林·昌卡没有进军库斯科，而是在1438年亚瓦尔潘帕战役后和平归顺印加，在帝国总督之下保留了本地首领。他们后来被卷入印加内战，支持瓦斯卡尔，西班牙入侵后又为图帕克·瓦尔帕短命的库斯科政权效力。

en: Uri is the valley of the Reuss between Lake Lucerne and the St Gotthard Pass, with its seat at Altdorf; the legendary William Tell and the Rütli meadow both belong to its tradition. Settled by Alemanni from the seventh century, the valley was granted to Zürich's Fraumünster Abbey by Louis the German in 853 and passed briefly to the Habsburgs in 1218. The opening of the St Gotthard Pass in 1230 brought transit wealth, and King Henry VII granted Uri imperial immediacy in 1231, confirmed by Rudolf of Habsburg in 1274; its bull's-head seal was already in use in 1243. Together with Schwyz and Unterwalden it formed the Eternal Alliance of 1291, fought at Morgarten in 1315 and helped defeat the Habsburgs at Sempach in 1386. To command the Gotthard road it annexed the Urseren valley in 1410 and, with Obwalden, seized the Leventina from Milan in 1403; the confederates took Bellinzona in 1500 and Lugano in 1512 until Marignano checked expansion in 1515. Uri rejected the Reformation and stayed Catholic, allying with Austria in 1529 before the Catholic victory at Kappel in 1531. Plague and harvest failure kept it poor. In 1798 it was merged into the Helvetic canton of Waldstätten and lost the Leventina, until the Act of Mediation restored it in 1803.
zh: 乌利是卢塞恩湖与圣哥达山口之间罗伊斯河上的山谷州，治所在阿尔特多夫；传说中的威廉·退尔和吕特利草地都属于它的传统。7世纪起阿勒曼尼人在此定居，853年日耳曼人路易把该谷地赐给苏黎世的弗劳明斯特修道院，1218年它一度转入哈布斯堡之手。1230年圣哥达山口开通带来过境贸易之利，1231年国王亨利七世授予乌利帝国直辖地位，1274年哈布斯堡的鲁道夫又予以确认；刻有牛头的印章在1243年已在使用。它与施维茨、翁特瓦尔登结成1291年永久同盟，参加了1315年的莫尔加滕之战，并在1386年的森帕赫之战中协助击败哈布斯堡。为控制圣哥达通道，它于1410年兼并乌尔塞伦谷地，1403年又与上瓦尔登联手从米兰夺取莱文蒂纳；同盟军队1500年拿下贝林佐纳，1512年拿下卢加诺，1515年的马里尼亚诺之战终结了扩张。乌利拒绝宗教改革，坚持天主教，1529年与奥地利结盟，随后在1531年的卡佩尔之战中迎来天主教一方的胜利。瘟疫和歉收使它长期贫困。1798年它被并入海尔维第共和国的森林州并失去莱文蒂纳，1803年《调解法令》恢复了它的地位。

en: The Ussuri polity gathered the Hurka Jurchen bands living along the Ussuri and its right-bank tributaries, with its seat at Alchan on the river of that name, a tributary of the Bikin in present-day Primorsky Krai. Hunter-fishers of the densely forested country east of the Songhua, they were counted by Ming officials among the Wild Jurchens. After 1403 the Yongle Emperor's officers enrolled these riverine tribes in a string of guards under the Nurgan Regional Military Commission, founded on the lower Amur in 1409 and abandoned in 1435. Qing records later classed the Ussuri groups with the Hurka and Warka of the Donghai Jurchens, and Nurhaci's Jianzhou campaigns between 1596 and 1625 brought most of them under Later Jin rule, while some clans stayed outside the banners and became the Udege and Nanai peoples.
zh: 乌苏里政权统辖乌苏里江及其右岸支流一带的虎尔哈女真部落，治所阿尔钦位于同名河畔，这条河是今俄罗斯滨海边疆区比金河的右岸支流。这些山林渔猎部落位于松花江以东的密林地带，被明朝官员归入野人女真。1403年以后，永乐帝的使者把沿河各部落编入一连串卫所，隶属1409年设于黑龙江下游、1435年撤销的奴儿干都指挥使司。清代文献后来把乌苏里各部分入东海女真的虎尔哈与瓦尔喀；1596—1625年间努尔哈赤的建州用兵使大部分部落臣服于后金，也有一些氏族未被编入八旗，发展为乌德盖人与那乃人。

en: The Otaibah are one of the largest Arab tribes of the peninsula, concentrated in the Najd and the Hejaz and tracing their descent to the pre-Islamic Hawazin of the Qays Aylan group, the northern Adnanite stock that also produced the Quraysh. When most Hawazin clans dispersed to the Levant, Iraq, Egypt and beyond in the early Islamic centuries, those who remained in the Hejaz and Najd coalesced under the descendants of Otaibah ibn Guzayah, from whom the tribe takes its name. Their earliest dated appearance in the records is violent: in 1470 the Sharif of Mecca, Muhammad ibn Barakat, attacked them in the eastern Ta'if, the highland country that remains their heartland. During the 1700s they overtook the Mutayr and the Qahtan to become the largest tribe of central Najd, and in the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries both the Sharifs of Mecca and the Saudi and Rashidi dynasties courted their camelry in the long struggle for the interior. In 1816, after the Egyptians broke the first Wahhabi state, Ibrahim Pasha won the Otaibah and several Anazzah clans to his campaign against Abdullah bin Saud.
zh: 乌泰巴是阿拉伯半岛最大的部落之一，主要聚居于内志和汉志，血统上溯到伊斯兰兴起前盖斯·艾兰族群中的哈瓦津部，与古莱什同属北方阿德南人一脉。伊斯兰早期，哈瓦津各氏族大多流散到黎凡特、伊拉克、埃及等地，留在汉志和内志的人则集结在乌泰巴·本·古扎亚的后裔周围，部落由此得名。史书中他们最早的确切登场充满硝烟：1470年，麦加谢里夫穆罕默德·本·巴拉卡特在塔伊夫东部进攻乌泰巴，而这片高地正是他们世代居住的核心地带。18世纪，他们取代穆塔伊尔和盖哈坦，成为内志中部最大的部落；18世纪末至19世纪初，麦加谢里夫家族以及沙特、拉希德两个王朝在争夺半岛内陆的长期较量中，都争相拉拢乌泰巴的骆驼骑兵。1816年埃及军队击灭第一个瓦哈比国家后，易卜拉欣帕夏争取到乌泰巴和数个阿纳扎氏族加入讨伐阿卜杜拉·本·沙特的战事。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Utrecht was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire governing the northern Low Countries. Its roots go back to 695, when Saint Willibrord was consecrated bishop of the Frisians and settled at Utrecht with Frankish support. In 1024 the bishops were raised to princes of the empire, and their secular lands, the Sticht, were divided into the Nedersticht around Utrecht and the larger Oversticht covering present-day Overijssel, Drenthe and part of Groningen. After the Concordat of Worms in 1122 the cathedral chapters elected the bishop, which gave the neighbouring counts of Holland and Guelders constant leverage over the see. Episcopal authority was weak on the ground: the Drenthers annihilated a bishop's army at the Battle of Ane in 1227, killing Bishop Otto of Lippe, while Floris V of Holland annexed the lands around Amsterdam around 1270 and the city of Groningen drifted out of the bishop's control. In 1337 the see was held by Jan van Diest, a Brabantine imposed by Holland and Guelders and consecrated by Pope John XXII at Avignon; his debts allowed the two counties to dictate a partition treaty in 1331, thwarted only by local resistance. Burgundy claimed protection over the bishopric in 1439, and in 1528 the last prince-bishop, Henry of Bavaria, surrendered his temporal power to Emperor Charles V, who divided the lands into the lordships of Utrecht and Overijssel and the county of Drenthe.
zh: 乌得勒支采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国统治低地北部的教会邦国。它的源头可追溯到695年，圣威利布罗德被祝圣为弗里斯兰人的主教，并在法兰克人支持下驻节乌得勒支。1024年主教们被擢升为帝国诸侯，其世俗领地称为施蒂希特，分为以乌得勒支为中心的下辖区，以及覆盖今上艾瑟尔、德伦特和格罗宁根一部分的广大上辖区。1122年《沃尔姆斯宗教协定》后，主教由座堂议会选举，邻近的荷兰伯爵和海尔德公爵因此长期能左右主教人选。主教在地方上的权威相当薄弱：1227年德伦特人在阿内之战中歼灭主教军队，主教利珀的奥托阵亡；荷兰伯爵弗洛里斯五世约在1270年吞并了阿姆斯特丹一带，格罗宁根城也逐渐脱离控制。1337年在位的约翰·范·迪斯特出身布拉班特贵族，由荷兰和海尔德扶植、教皇约翰二十二世在阿维尼翁亲自祝圣；他债台高筑，两国得以在1331年操纵签订瓜分主教区的条约，全靠当地民众抵抗才保住独立。1439年勃艮第取得主教区保护权；1528年末代采邑主教巴伐利亚的亨利把世俗权力交给皇帝查理五世，旧地被划为乌得勒支领地、上艾瑟尔领地和德伦特伯国。

en: The Land of Valkenburg was a lordship of the Holy Roman Empire lying east of the Maas around Maastricht, in the south of the present-day Dutch province of Limburg. It grew up around Oud-Valkenburg, first named in an imperial charter of 1041, and around 1075 Thibald of Voeren built the hill castle above the Geul that became the seat of its lords; through marriage the lordship passed in 1118 to the related house of Heinsberg. Hemmed in by ambitious neighbours, Valkenburg warred repeatedly with Jülich, Guelders, Liège and Brabant, and its castle was besieged after the Battle of Worringen in 1288. In 1337 it was held by Dirk IV of the Valkenburg-Heinsberg line, whose kinsman Dietrich of Heinsberg ruled the neighbouring county of Loon. The male line ended with Lord Jan in 1352 and a succession dispute followed; the creditor Reinhard of Schönforst sold the lordship to the Duke of Jülich in 1355, who raised it to a county in 1357 and sold it on in 1364 to Wenceslaus of Luxembourg, Duke of Brabant. Valkenburg then became one of Brabant's three Lands of Overmaas, governed through a bailiff called the drossard. During the Eighty Years' War it changed hands several times, and the Partage Treaty of 1661 split it between Spain and the Dutch Republic; after 1713 the Spanish portion passed to the Austrian Habsburgs, and in 1795 revolutionary France united both halves in the département of Meuse-Inférieure, ending the county's separate existence.
zh: 法尔肯堡领地是神圣罗马帝国的封邑，位于马斯河以东、马斯特里赫特一带，今荷兰林堡省南部。它围绕奥德法尔肯堡发展起来，1041年一份皇帝诏书中首次提到该地；约1075年富伦的蒂博在赫尔河畔的高地上修建城堡，成为历代领主的驻地，1118年领地通过联姻转入同族的海因斯贝格家族。由于强邻环伺，法尔肯堡反复同于利希、海尔德、列日和布拉班特交战，1288年沃林根战役后城堡还遭到围攻。1337年在位的是法尔肯堡—海因斯贝格家族的迪尔克四世，他的亲族、海因斯贝格的狄奥多里克同时统治着邻近的洛恩伯国。1352年领主扬去世，男系断绝，继承纠纷随之而起；债权人申福斯特的赖因哈德于1355年把领地卖给于利希公爵，后者1357年将其升格为伯国，又在1364年转卖给布拉班特公爵、卢森堡的文策尔。法尔肯堡从此成为布拉班特的马斯河外三领地之一，由称为德罗萨特的管家代行治理。八十年战争期间它数度易手，1661年的分割条约把它分给西班牙和尼德兰联省共和国；1713年后原属西班牙的部分转归奥地利哈布斯堡统治，1795年革命法国把南北两部分并入下默兹省，伯国的单独建制就此终结。

en: The Principality of Vitebsk was a Ruthenian appanage centred on the river port of Vitebsk, whose trade ran down the Western Dvina to Riga. It was created in 1101, when the sons of Vseslav of Polotsk divided his lands and Vitebsk fell to Sviatoslav Vseslavich. In 1129 the prince of Kiev, Mstislav, captured the Polotsk dynasty and sent them into exile in Constantinople, but Sviatoslav's son Vasilko returned in 1132 to reclaim his town, and his line kept Vitebsk through long contests with Smolensk and Polotsk. Its last prince, Jaroslav Vasilkovich, died without male heirs in 1320, and his daughter Maria's marriage to the Lithuanian grand duke Algirdas carried Vitebsk into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, where Algirdas ruled it in person. The appanage kept its own administration until 1393, and in 1508 its lands, together with Orsha, Drutsk and Mogilev, formed the Vitebsk Voivodeship.
zh: 维捷布斯克公国是以河港维捷布斯克为中心的鲁塞尼亚封邑，贸易沿西德维纳河直通里加。1101年波洛茨克王公弗谢斯拉夫的诸子瓜分父土，维捷布斯克归斯维亚托斯拉夫·弗谢斯拉维奇，公国由此建立。1129年基辅王公姆斯季斯拉夫俘获波洛茨克王朝全家，流放至君士坦丁堡，但斯维亚托斯拉夫之子瓦西里科于1132年返回夺回本城，其家族在同斯摩棱斯克和波洛茨克的长期争夺中保有维捷布斯克。末代王公雅罗斯拉夫·瓦西里科维奇于1320年去世，没有男嗣，他的女儿玛丽亚嫁给立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯，维捷布斯克随之并入立陶宛大公国，由阿尔吉尔达斯亲自统治。该封邑保留自己的行政机构直到1393年，1508年其土地连同奥尔沙、德鲁茨克和莫吉廖夫组成维捷布斯克省。

en: Vadakkumkur, meaning the northern regency, was a Hindu principality in the Kerala backwaters whose rajas kept their court at Karikkode. It took shape around 1102, when the old region of Vempolinad split in two after the collapse of the Chera Kulasekhara kingdom: the southern half became Thekkumkur and the northern half Vadakkumkur, which entered the orbit of Cochin as its vassal. In 1600 it defeated and absorbed the neighbouring chiefdom of Keezhmalainadu. After the Portuguese established themselves at Cochin, quarrels over the pepper trade led to war, and the Vadakkumkur raja was killed fighting Cochin and its Portuguese allies; his dynasty afterwards divided into the Mattathil and Kadanadu branches. In 1750 Marthanda Varma of Travancore overran the principality, his commander Ramayyan destroyed Karikkode, and Vadakkumkur was incorporated into Travancore.
zh: 瓦达库姆库尔意为“北方摄政之邦”，是喀拉拉回水地带的印度教小邦，罗阇们以卡里科德为宫廷所在地。1102年前后，切拉·库拉谢卡拉王国解体后，旧地温波利纳德一分为二：南半成为特库姆库尔，北半成为瓦达库姆库尔，后者作为科钦的附庸进入其势力范围。1600年，它攻灭并吞并了邻近的基兹马拉纳德酋长国。葡萄牙人在科钦立足后，双方因胡椒贸易争执开战，瓦达库姆库尔罗阇在与科钦及其葡萄牙盟友的作战中阵亡，其家族此后分为马塔蒂尔和卡达纳德两支。1750年，特拉凡哥尔的玛尔坦达·瓦尔马攻入该邦，将领拉马扬摧毁卡里科德，瓦达库姆库尔被并入特拉凡哥尔。

en: The County of Vendôme was a fief on the Loir river in north-central France, north of Blois, formed from the old Frankish pagus vindocinensis, a subdivision of the Carnutes. Its first known counts were the Bouchardides, beginning with Bouchard the Venerable, a close follower of Hugh Capet who held Paris and Corbeil and balanced between the rival counts of Blois and Anjou; Angevin influence then dominated until the early thirteenth century, when the county passed to the House of Montoire. In 1337 its count was Bouchard VI of Montoire, who also held Castres, had sold his minting rights to King Philip V in 1320 and fixed his border with Blois by treaty in 1329. He died in 1354 and was succeeded by his son John VI, and when the last Montoire heiress Catherine married John of Bourbon-La Marche, the county passed to a junior branch of the Bourbons in 1372.
