Raised to a duchy-peerage in 1515, Vendôme entered the royal domain in 1589 when its duke came to the throne as King Henry IV of France.
zh: 旺多姆伯国是法兰西北部卢瓦河畔、布卢瓦以北的封地，由法兰克时期卡尔努特人的行政区“旺多辛”发展而来。已知最早的伯爵出自布沙尔家族，始祖“可敬者”布沙尔一世是于格·卡佩的亲信，领有巴黎和科尔贝，在布卢瓦伯爵与安茹伯爵之间周旋；此后安茹势力长期主导伯国，直到13世纪初蒙图瓦尔家族接管。1337年在位的是蒙图瓦尔家族的布沙尔六世，他兼领卡斯特尔，1320年把铸币权卖给腓力五世，又在1329年以条约划定与布卢瓦的边界。他于1354年去世，其子让六世继位；蒙图瓦尔家族最后的女继承人卡特琳嫁给波旁-拉马什的让，伯国遂于1372年转入波旁家族的一支。1515年旺多姆被升为公爵兼贵族领地，1589年其公爵以亨利四世的身份登上法国王位，旺多姆随之并入王室领地。

en: Verdun, the Roman Virodunum on the Meuse in Lorraine, was the seat of a bishopric founded in the fourth century within the province of Trier. The Merovingian King Childebert II endowed Bishop Agericus with estates along the Moselle, and after a fire destroyed the old archives Bishop Dadon commissioned the Chronicle of the Bishops of Verdun from the monk Bertharius around 900. Under the Ottonian emperors the see rose to secular power: Bishop Haimont began a new cathedral in 990, and in 997 Emperor Otto III granted him and his successors the title of Count, so that by the year 1000 the bishopric, roughly three thousand square kilometres, nearly coincided with the County of Verdun. The count's rights were at first exercised by life-counts of the Ardennes family, whose quarrels with the bishops long troubled the principality. French influence grew steadily: after the marriage of Philip IV to Joan of Navarre, and from 1331 onward the king of France rather than the emperor controlled episcopal appointments. Plague and warfare depopulated the diocese in the fourteenth century, and between 1457 and 1548 no bishop resided there at all. French troops built a citadel in the town early in the seventeenth century over the bishop's protests, and in 1552 Henry II annexed Verdun with Toul and Metz, an acquisition the Empire recognised in the Peace of Westphalia of 1648. The bishopric then formed part of the French province of the Three Bishoprics until it was secularised during the Revolution.
zh: 凡尔登位于洛林的默兹河畔，罗马时代称维罗杜努姆，4世纪起设有教区，隶属特里尔教省。墨洛温国王希尔德贝尔特二世曾把摩泽尔河沿岸的地产赐给阿格里库斯主教；后来一场大火烧毁旧档案，达东主教约在900年命修士贝尔塔里乌斯编写《凡尔登主教编年史》。在奥托诸帝治下，教区取得世俗权力：海蒙主教于990年动工兴建新主教座堂，997年皇帝奥托三世授予他及其继任者伯爵头衔，因此到1000年前后，这个约3000平方公里的主教区几乎与凡尔登伯国重合。伯爵之权起初由阿登家族的终身伯爵行使，他们与主教长期争斗，搅扰着这个小国。法国的影响不断加深：腓力四世娶纳瓦拉女王胡安娜一世之后，尤其从1331年起，主教人选改由法国国王而非皇帝掌控。14世纪的瘟疫和战争使教区人口锐减，1457至1548年间更是没有一位主教驻跸于此。17世纪初，法军不顾主教抗议在城内修筑堡垒；1552年亨利二世把凡尔登连同图勒、梅斯一并吞并，帝国在1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》中予以承认。此后主教区成为法国三主教区行省的一部分，直到法国大革命期间被世俗化。

en: Vayots Dzor, meaning the valley of sorrows in Armenian, was a mountainous canton of the historic province of Syunik along the upper Arpa River. In the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries it was held by the Orbelian princes of Syunik and their Proshian vassals, who studded the valley with monasteries and fortresses: Noravank was raised in the thirteenth century, Proshaberd guarded its eastern approaches, and Orbelian's caravanserai of 1332 served merchants on the Silk Road. Its greatest renown came from the University of Gladzor, founded around 1280 by Nerses of Mush and patronised by both noble houses; with around 350 students and its own academic degrees, it taught theology, philosophy and the art of illuminated manuscripts until its closure in 1340. Timur's invasion of 1385 broke Orbelian power in Syunik, and through the fifteenth to seventeenth centuries the valley was repeatedly fought over by Turkmen and Iranian armies. Under Persian rule it became part of the Nakhichevan Khanate and was known as Daralagyaz, until the Treaty of Turkmenchay transferred it to Russia in 1828.
zh: 瓦约茨佐尔在亚美尼亚语中意为“悲叹之谷”，是历史上休尼克省的一个山区州，位于阿尔帕河上游。13至14世纪，它由休尼克的奥尔贝利扬王公及其封臣普罗什扬家族统治，山谷中遍布修道院与要塞：13世纪修建的诺拉旺克修道院、扼守东口的普罗沙贝尔德要塞，以及1332年建成、服务丝绸之路商队的奥尔贝利扬商队驿站。它最负盛名的是格拉佐尔大学：约1280年由穆什的涅尔谢斯创办，受到两大家族庇护，曾有约350名学生并自行授予学位，讲授神学、哲学和泥金手抄本技艺，1340年关闭。1385年帖木儿入侵摧毁了奥尔贝利扬家族在休尼克的权势；15至17世纪，山谷屡遭土库曼和伊朗军队争夺。波斯统治时期它并入纳希切万汗国，改称达拉拉格亚兹，直到1828年的《土库曼恰伊条约》把它割让给俄国。

en: The County of Veldenz, a Hunsrück and Moselle principality with a vote in the Imperial Diet, originated in 1112 when its first counts separated from the wildgraves of Kyrburg. That first line ended with Count Gerlach V in 1260; his daughter Agnes inherited, and through her marriage to Heinrich of Geroldseck the county passed to the Veldenz-Geroldseck house, which still ruled from Thallichtenberg in 1337. When Count Frederick III died without a male heir, his daughter Anna brought Veldenz in 1444 to Stephen, Count Palatine of Simmern-Zweibrücken, and so into the Wittelsbach orbit. By the Marburg Contract of 1543 Count Wolfgang of Zweibrücken granted Veldenz to his uncle Rupert, whose son George John married Anna Maria, daughter of Gustav I Vasa of Sweden, in 1563. The line of these counts palatine ended in 1694 with Leopold Ludwig of Lützelstein, who died without legitimate children; the much-war-ravaged county reverted to the Zweibrücken branch, held for a time by Charles XI of Sweden, and passed to the Electoral Palatinate in 1733. French rule from 1801 swept away the old county, and in 1815 the Congress of Vienna split its lands between Prussia and Bavaria.
zh: 费尔登茨伯国地处洪斯吕克山与摩泽尔河一带，在帝国议会拥有席位，起源于1112年，其初代伯爵从基尔堡的荒野伯爵家族中分立。第一系于1260年随格拉赫五世去世而终结，其女阿格尼丝继承家业，通过与杰拉尔德塞克的海因里希联姻，伯国转入费尔登茨—杰拉尔德塞克家族之手；1337年该家族仍以塔尔利希滕贝格为统治中心。伯爵弗里德里希三世没有男嗣，其女安娜于1444年把费尔登茨带给锡门—茨韦布吕肯行宫伯爵斯特凡，伯国由此落入维特尔斯巴赫家族势力范围。依据1543年的《马尔堡契约》，茨韦布吕肯伯爵沃尔夫冈把费尔登茨封给叔父鲁普雷希特；鲁普雷希特之子格奥尔格·约翰于1563年娶瑞典国王古斯塔夫一世·瓦萨之女安娜·玛丽亚为妻。这一支行宫伯爵传至1694年，吕策尔施泰因的利奥波德·路德维希死时没有合法子嗣，历经战火残破的伯国复归茨韦布吕肯支系，一度由瑞典国王卡尔十一世兼领，1733年又转入普法尔茨选侯国。1801年起法国的统治取消了旧伯国，1815年维也纳会议把其土地分划给普鲁士和巴伐利亚。

en: The Most Serene Republic of Venice was a maritime republic built on the islands of the Venetian Lagoon, traditionally founded in 697 and ruled by an elected doge from the Rialto. Between the ninth and eleventh centuries its fleets won control of the Adriatic, and the conquest of Dalmatia in 1109 gave the doge the title of Doge of Venice, Dalmatia and Croatia. Enrico Dandolo led its fleet on the Fourth Crusade, which sacked Constantinople in 1204, making Venice fully independent and bringing it Crete, the Cyclades and a chain of eastern trading ports. Rivalry with Genoa led to the War of Chioggia, after which the Treaty of Turin of 1381 left Venice free to expand on the mainland; it took Padua in 1405 and built up the Domini di Terraferma. In 1337 the doge was Francesco Dandolo, and the gold ducat minted from 1284 was already the standard coin of Mediterranean commerce. The League of Cambrai defeated Venice at Agnadello in 1509, and long Ottoman wars then stripped away its eastern empire: Cyprus fell in 1570 despite the victory at Lepanto in 1571, the War of Candia cost it Crete, and the Morea won in 1684 was lost again by the Treaty of Passarowitz in 1718. In 1797 Napoleon occupied the lagoon, Doge Ludovico Manin abdicated, and the Treaty of Campo Formio divided the thousand-year-old republic between France and Austria.
zh: 威尼斯共和国，全称“最尊贵的威尼斯共和国”，是建立在威尼斯潟湖群岛上的海洋共和国，传统上认为建于697年，由里亚尔托选出的总督统治。9至11世纪，其舰队取得亚得里亚海的制海权；1109年征服达尔马提亚热带，总督获得“威尼斯、达尔马提亚与克罗地亚总督”的头衔。恩里科·丹多洛率舰队参加第四次十字军东征，于1204年洗劫君士坦丁堡，使威尼斯完全独立，并获得克里特、基克拉泽斯群岛和一连串东方商港。与热那亚的争霸引发基奥贾战争，战后1381年的《都灵和约》使威尼斯得以转向大陆扩张，1405年取得帕多瓦，建立“大陆领土”。1337年在位的总督是弗朗切斯科·丹多洛，1284年起铸造的金杜卡特已是地中海贸易的标准货币。1509年康布雷同盟在阿尼亚代洛战役中击败威尼斯，此后对奥斯曼帝国的长期战争逐步剥去它的东方领地：1571年勒班陀海战取胜仍挡不住塞浦路斯于1570年陷落，干地亚战争使它失去克里特，1684年夺得的摩里亚又在1718年的《帕萨罗维茨和约》中丧失。1797年拿破仑占领潟湖，总督卢多维科·马宁退位，《坎波福尔米奥和约》将这个千年共和国瓜分给法国和奥地利。

en: Verona was the signoria of the della Scala family, the Scaligeri, who ruled the city and much of the Veneto mainland from 1262, when Mastino I della Scala made himself capitano del popolo and turned the commune's office into a family inheritance. Its greatest prince was Cangrande I, lord from 1308, a warrior and patron of Dante, Petrarch and Giotto who added Vicenza, Padua in 1328 and Treviso in 1329 to his domains. In 1337 the ruler was his nephew Mastino II, the richest prince in Italy of his generation, who had taken Brescia in 1332 and bought Parma in 1335 and Lucca in 1339. His power frightened the rest of the peninsula: Venice, Florence, the Visconti, the Este and the Gonzaga formed a league against him, and after a three-year war the Scaliger state was reduced to Verona and Vicenza. Later rulers were marked by tyranny and fratricide, and in 1387 Gian Galeazzo Visconti of Milan drove out Antonio della Scala, ending Scaliger rule. A brief restoration in 1404 ended with the lord's death ten days later, and in 1405 Verona passed to the Republic of Venice.
zh: 维罗纳是德拉·斯卡拉家族（斯卡拉家族）的领地。1262年，马斯蒂诺一世·德拉·斯卡拉自立为“人民队长”，把公社官职变成家族世袭，此后该家族统治维罗纳及威尼托大陆的大片土地长达一个多世纪。家族最杰出的君主是1308年继位的坎格兰德一世，他是能征善战的君主，也是但丁、彼特拉克和乔托的庇护人，先后把维琴察、1328年取得的帕多瓦和1329年取得的特雷维索纳入版图。1337年在位的是他的侄子马斯蒂诺二世，当时意大利最富有的君主：他1332年攻下布雷西亚，又于1335年买下帕尔马、1339年买下卢卡。他的强盛令半岛各国恐惧，威尼斯、佛罗伦萨、维斯孔蒂、埃斯特和贡扎加结成反斯卡拉同盟，经过三年战争，斯卡拉家族的领地被削弱到只剩维罗纳和维琴察。此后的统治者残暴且骨肉相残，1387年米兰的吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂赶走安东尼奥·德拉·斯卡拉，斯卡拉家族的统治告终。1404年的短暂复辟也在复辟者十天后死去时结束，1405年维罗纳并入威尼斯共和国。

en:
The Vijayanagara Empire was founded in 1336 by the brothers Harihara I and Bukka Raya I of the Sangama dynasty, in the power vacuum left when Delhi Sultanate armies overran the Deccan kingdoms of Kampili, Warangal and the Hoysalas. Its capital on the Tungabhadra, whose name means City of Victory and whose ruins survive at Hampi, became the heart of Hindu resistance to the northern sultanates; later tradition credits the sage Vidyaranya with guiding the founders. Harihara I consolidated the lands south of the river, and under Bukka Raya I the court moved into the fortified city while his son Kumara Kampana destroyed the Madurai sultanate around 1371 and brought the Tamil country under Vijayanagari rule.

Power later passed from the Sangamas to the Saluva, Tuluva and Aravidu dynasties. The Tuluva king Krishnadevaraya, ruling from 1509 to 1529, brought the empire to its peak, defeating the Deccan sultans and the Gajapatis of Orissa and drawing tribute from most of southern India; his reign adorned the land with temple cities and drew Portuguese horse traders to its markets. In 1565 the combined Deccan sultanates destroyed the imperial army at Talikota, killed the regent Rama Raya and sacked the capital. The Aravidu rulers lingered on at Penukonda, Chandragiri and Vellore until the last vestige of the empire disappeared in 1646.
zh:
毗奢耶那伽罗帝国由桑迦摩王朝的哈里哈拉一世与布卡·拉亚一世兄弟于1336年建立。当时德里苏丹国的军队接连攻灭坎皮利、瓦朗加尔和曷萨拉等德干王国，造成权力真空，兄弟二人便在栋格珀德拉河畔建国。都城之名意为“胜利之城”，遗址留存于今亨比，成为印度教世界抵御北方苏丹国的核心；后世传说将建国归于毗迪亚兰雅仙人的指引。哈里哈拉一世整合了大河以南的土地，布卡·拉亚一世时朝廷迁入设防的新都，其子库马拉·坎帕纳约于1371年攻灭马杜赖苏丹国，把泰米尔地区纳入版图。

此后政权先后转入萨卢瓦、图卢瓦和阿拉维杜三个王朝。图卢瓦王朝的克里希纳德瓦拉亚于1509至1529年在位，把帝国推向鼎盛：他连败德干诸苏丹与奥里萨的伽贾帕提王朝，使南印度大部称臣纳贡；他的时代广建神庙城市，葡萄牙马匹商人也云集其市场。1565年，德干诸苏丹联军在塔利科塔歼灭帝国大军，杀死摄政罗摩·拉亚并洗劫都城。阿拉维杜君主退守佩努孔达、钱德拉吉里和韦洛尔，残余政权一直延续到1646年。

en: Valluvanad, or the Arangottu Swaroopam, was a medieval chiefdom of north-central Kerala, ruled from Angadipuram by the Vellattiri rajas, who bore the title Valluvakonathiri. It was already one of the leading chiefdoms under the Chera kings: its lord Rayiran Chathan witnessed the Jewish Copper Plates around 1000, and the Valluvanad Six Hundred militia protected markets far beyond its borders. When the Chera kingdom dissolved in the early twelfth century Valluvanad became independent and inherited the sacred duty of guarding the Mamankam festival at Tirunavaya. The rising Zamorins of Kozhikode then seized Ponnani, Tirunavaya, Malappuram and Manjeri, took over the Mamankam rite and executed the Vellattiri's minister; generations of Chaver suicide warriors were sent to challenge the Zamorin at the festival in a blood feud that lasted for centuries. Mysorean armies overran the country later in the eighteenth century, and in 1793 the British East India Company deposed the raja, turned Valluvanad into the Walluvanad taluk and settled a pension on the royal house.
zh: 瓦卢瓦纳德又称阿兰戈图斯瓦鲁帕姆，是喀拉拉中北部的中世纪酋长国，以安加迪普兰为治所，统治者称韦拉蒂里罗阇，头衔为瓦卢瓦科纳蒂里。早在哲罗诸王时代它就是首屈一指的大酋长国之一：其首领拉伊兰·查坦在约1000年的犹太铜盘上列名见证，瓦卢瓦纳德的六百人民兵还在境外保护市集。12世纪初哲罗王国解体后，瓦卢瓦纳德获得独立，并继承了在蒂鲁纳瓦亚马曼卡姆节上担任护法的圣职。随后崛起的科泽科德扎莫林夺取蓬纳尼、蒂鲁纳瓦亚、马拉普兰和曼杰里，篡走马曼卡姆仪式的主持权，并处死韦拉蒂里的大臣；一代又一代的查维尔死士被派往节庆现场刺杀扎莫林，这场血仇延续了数百年。18世纪后期迈索尔军队攻占该国，1793年英国东印度公司废黜罗阇，把瓦卢瓦纳德改为瓦卢瓦纳德县，并向王室发放年金。

en: The County of Valentinois covered the lower Rhône lands around Valence, the Roman Valentia, usually together with the neighbouring Diois around Die. As a fief of the Holy Roman Empire it passed in the twelfth century to the house of Poitiers-Valentinois, named after a local castle and unrelated to the city of Poitiers; from 1280 its lords also bore the title Count of Diois. In 1337 the count was Aymar V, a vassal of the Dauphin of Viennois, Humbert II, with whom he settled a long homage dispute at Chabeuil in 1338. His successors served the French-backed Dauphiné: Aymar VI was its governor from 1349 and rector of the Comtat Venaissin. When the last male heir, Louis II, died in 1419, his testament made the Dauphin Charles, son of Charles VI, his successor, and Valentinois was absorbed into the Dauphiné and the royal domain. In 1498 Louis XII revived the title as a duchy for Cesare Borgia, and as Duke of Valentinois it later passed to the princes of Monaco.
zh: 瓦朗蒂努瓦伯国据有罗讷河下游、瓦朗斯（罗马时代的瓦伦蒂亚）周围的土地，通常与邻近的迪城一带的迪瓦合并统治。作为神圣罗马帝国的封地，它在12世纪转入普瓦捷—瓦朗蒂努瓦家族手中；该家族得名于当地一座城堡，与西部的普瓦捷城并无关系，1280年起其领主还兼任迪瓦伯爵。1337年在位的艾马尔五世是维埃纳多菲内藩王的封臣，1338年他在沙伯伊与藩王安贝尔二世了结了一场旷日持久的臣服之争。他的继任者转而效力于法兰西支持下的多菲内：艾马尔六世于1349年出任多菲内总督，还担任过沃奈桑伯爵领地的摄政。末代男嗣路易二世于1419年去世，遗嘱指定查理六世之子、王太子查理为继承人，瓦朗蒂努瓦随之并入多菲内和王室领地。1498年，路易十二把这个头衔重立为公国，封给切萨雷·波吉亚；瓦朗蒂努瓦公爵之号后来又归摩纳哥亲王所有。

en: The Grand Principality of Vladimir, also called Vladimir-Suzdal, was the leading power of northeast Rus'. It grew out of the Rostov-Suzdal lands: Yury Dolgoruky moved his seat to Suzdal in 1125 and founded or fortified towns including Moscow, first mentioned in 1147, and Yuryev-Polsky. His son Andrey Bogolyubsky transferred the capital to Vladimir and sacked Kiev in 1169, drawing power away from the old Dnieper centre, while Vsevolod the Big Nest made the grand prince overlord of the other Rus' princes, including Novgorod. The Mongol invasion of 1237 to 1238 devastated the land and killed Grand Prince Yury II, after which the princes held their title as nominees of the khan. By 1300 the grand principality had split into more than a dozen appanages, and Moscow and Tver fought over its throne. From 1331 the prince of Moscow held the grand principality almost continuously, so that in 1337 the grand prince was Ivan I Kalita of Moscow, and in 1389 the two titles were united for good.
zh: 弗拉基米尔大公国又称弗拉基米尔-苏兹达尔大公国，是东北罗斯的头号强权。它起源于罗斯托夫-苏兹达尔之地：尤里·多尔戈鲁基于1125年把驻节地迁到苏兹达尔，并兴建或加固了一批城镇，包括最早见于1147年记载的莫斯科和尤里耶夫-波利斯基。他的儿子安德烈·博戈柳布斯基把都城迁到弗拉基米尔，又于1169年洗劫基辅，使权力中心从第聂伯河旧地北移；“大窝”弗谢沃洛德三世则让弗拉基米尔大公成为包括诺夫哥罗德在内的罗斯诸王公的宗主。1237—1238年的蒙古入侵蹂躏了这片土地，大公尤里二世战死，此后大公之位须由汗册封。到1300年前后，大公国已分裂成十余个封邑，莫斯科与特维尔为争夺大公之位长期角力。1331年起莫斯科王公几乎一直兼任弗拉基米尔大公，因此1337年在位的大公正是莫斯科的伊凡一世·卡利塔，1389年两个权位正式合二为一。

en: Volterra is a walled hill town in the Tuscan interior, the Etruscan Velathri, one of the twelve cities of the Etruscan League, and later the Roman municipium of Volaterrae. A bishopric from the fifth century, it was ruled by its bishops from the ninth and tenth centuries until the murder of the despotic Bishop Galgano Pannocchieschi at the doors of the cathedral in 1170 opened the way to a free commune; the Palazzo dei Priori, begun in 1208, became the seat of its government, and the bishops lost their temporal power by 1239. Around 1300 the city was torn by Guelph and Ghibelline feuds between the Belforti and the Allegretti families, who dominated the commune in the 1330s. In 1340 the Allegretti were driven out and Ottaviano Belforti made himself signore; his son Bocchino was beheaded in 1361 after trying to sell the city to Pisa, and Volterra fell under Florentine control. A revolt led by Giusto Landini briefly restored independence in 1429 before he was murdered, and in 1472, during the war over the newly discovered alum mines, Florentine troops under Federico da Montefeltro sacked the town. Volterra then followed the Medici and the Grand Duchy of Tuscany.
zh: 沃尔泰拉是托斯卡纳内陆一座有城墙的山城，古称维拉特里，是伊特鲁里亚联盟十二城之一，后来成为罗马的沃拉特雷自治市。它从5世纪起就是主教驻地，9至10世纪起由主教统治；1170年，专横的主教加尔加诺·潘诺基耶斯基在大教堂门口被杀，为自由公社开辟了道路，1208年动工的市政长官宫成为政府所在地，到1239年主教已丧失世俗权力。1300年前后，城市陷入圭尔夫派与吉伯林派的仇杀，分别由贝尔福尔蒂家族和阿莱格雷蒂家族领导，后者在14世纪30年代左右把持公社。1340年阿莱格雷蒂家族被驱逐，奥塔维亚诺·贝尔福尔蒂自立为领主；其子博基诺因企图把城市卖给比萨，于1361年被斩首，沃尔泰拉随即落入佛罗伦萨控制。1429年，朱斯托·兰迪尼领导的起义一度恢复独立，但他很快遇害；1472年，在围绕新发现的明矾矿爆发的战争中，费德里科·达·蒙泰费尔特罗率领的佛罗伦萨军队洗劫了这座城市。此后沃尔泰拉随美第奇家族并入托斯卡纳大公国。

en: Vunda was a small Kongo kingdom within the confederation of Mpemba, which from the thirteenth century held the country between the Loze River and the Congo, and it was substantial enough to rule lesser units of its own, among them Mpangala. As the Kingdom of Kongo arose in the fourteenth century, Mpemba was absorbed into it, and the lord of Vunda, bearing the title Ne Vunda, became one of the great officers of the Kongo court. The most famous holder of the title, Antonio Emanuele Ne Vunda, was sent to Europe by King Álvaro II in 1604 as ambassador to the papacy. Travelling by way of Brazil and Spain, he reached Rome only on 3 January 1608 and died of illness two days later, the first African ambassador ever received by the Holy See; he was buried in the basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore, where a coloured marble bust of him by Francesco Caporale was erected.
zh: 温达是姆彭巴邦联境内的一个刚果语小王国；姆彭巴邦联自13世纪起据有洛泽河至刚果河之间的土地，而温达国力不弱，还统辖着姆潘加拉等更小的单元。14世纪刚果王国兴起后，姆彭巴被并入刚果，温达的领主带着内温达的头衔，成为刚果王廷的重臣之一。最著名的一任内温达是安东尼奥·埃马努埃莱·内温达，他于1604年受国王阿尔瓦罗二世派遣，作为使节出使罗马教廷。他经巴西和西班牙辗转前行，直到1608年1月3日才抵达罗马，两天后即病逝；他是教廷接待的第一位非洲使节，葬于圣母大殿，殿内立有弗朗切斯科·卡波拉莱为他制作的彩色大理石胸像。

en: Venad was a medieval principality at the south-western tip of India, between the Western Ghats and the Arabian Sea, ruled from the spice port of Kollam, or Quilon. It began as a chiefly territory under the Chera kings and became an independent state under the Kulasekhara dynasty in the early twelfth century. As Chera power faded it passed under Pandya suzerainty, and when the Pandyas collapsed in the early fourteenth century its ruler Ravi Varma Kulasekhara carried Venad arms into the Tamil country. Kollam had been a great Indian Ocean emporium since the ninth century, known to Marco Polo and to Arab and Chinese merchants, whose trade gave the Venad rulers their wealth and their own coinage. In the sixteenth century the rajas acknowledged Vijayanagara overlordship, and in the seventeenth they paid tribute to the Nayaks of Madurai while the realm split into collateral branches such as Trippappoor and Elayadathu. The English East India Company opened a factory at Vizhinjam in 1664 and built Fort Anjengo in 1695. Under Marthanda Varma, who reigned from 1729 to 1758, Venad was remade into the centralised kingdom of Travancore.
zh: 吠那住是印度西南端的中世纪小邦，位于西高止山与阿拉伯海之间，以香料港奎隆为统治中心。它最初是哲罗诸王治下的酋长领地，12世纪初在库拉谢卡拉王朝治下成为独立政权。哲罗衰落后它转受潘地亚的宗主权约束；14世纪初潘地亚崩溃时，君主拉维·瓦尔马·库拉谢卡拉曾挥师攻入泰米尔地区。奎隆自9世纪起就是印度洋大商港，马可·波罗以及阿拉伯、中国商人都曾到访，香料贸易为吠那住统治者带来财富和自铸钱币的权力。16世纪罗阇们承认毗奢耶那伽罗的霸权，17世纪又向马杜赖的纳亚克纳贡，国土则分裂为特里帕普尔、伊罗耶达都等旁支。英国东印度公司于1664年在维津贾姆设立商馆，1695年建成安金戈堡垒。1729至1758年在位的马尔坦达·瓦尔马把吠那住改造为中央集权的特拉凡哥尔王国。

en: The viscounty of Ventadour was a small Limousin lordship in the Corrèze hills, ruled from the eleventh-century Château de Ventadour, with its political centres at Égletons and Ussel. Its court won lasting fame in the twelfth century, when the viscount Eble III patronised the troubadour Bernart de Ventadorn, possibly the son of a baker at the castle, who became the most influential poet-composer of the troubadour age before following Eleanor of Aquitaine to the English court. In 1337 the viscounty was still held by the House of Ventadour as a vassal of the French crown. It was raised to a county in 1350 and to a duchy-peerage in 1578. The native line ended in 1472, when the heiress married Louis de Lévis; the lands and title later passed through the Rohan family to the princes of Condé, while the old castle was sold and dismantled after the French Revolution.
zh: 旺塔杜尔子爵领是利穆赞科雷兹山区的小封邑，以11世纪建成的旺塔杜尔城堡为统治中心，政务中心在埃格勒通和于塞勒。12世纪时它的宫廷声名远播：子爵埃布尔三世庇护了游吟诗人贝尔纳·德·旺塔杜尔——此人可能是城堡里一个面包师的儿子，后来成为游吟诗人时代最有影响的诗人兼作曲家，最终随阿基坦的埃莉诺前往英格兰宫廷。1337年，子爵领仍由旺塔杜尔家族以法兰西王室封臣的身份领有。它于1350年升为伯爵领，1578年升为公爵兼法兰西贵族院成员。1472年本土家族绝嗣，女继承人嫁给路易·德·莱维斯；领地和头衔后来经罗昂家族传到孔代亲王手中，而古老的城堡在法国大革命后被出售拆毁。

en: Vohemar is a Swahili trading port on the northeast coast of Madagascar, likely founded around the thirteenth century. Its Islamized Rasikajy merchants mixed with the local Antankarana people and buried their dead in a necropolis outside the town whose soapstone vessels, Chinese porcelain and beads record a busy Indian Ocean trade. After the older port of Mahilaka was abandoned, Vohemar became one of the island's leading commercial towns in the fifteenth century. The Arab navigator Ibn Majid knew it as Bimaruh, and Portuguese sailors called it Bemaro from 1514; in 1526 it was named Reis Bimar after its sultan Bimar, and Diogo de Couto in 1557 described Bimaro as a haven where navigators of many origins put in. The name Vohémar only came into general use in the seventeenth century.
zh: 武海马尔是马达加斯加东北海岸的斯瓦希里贸易港，大约在13世纪建城。信奉伊斯兰教的拉西卡吉商人与当地的安坦卡拉纳人融合，他们在城外墓地留下的皂石器皿、中国瓷器和珠子，见证了繁忙的印度洋贸易。更早的港口马哈伊拉卡被废弃后，武海马尔在15世纪成为岛上主要的商业城镇之一。阿拉伯航海家伊本·马吉德称它为比马鲁，1514年起葡萄牙水手称之为贝马罗；1526年它以苏丹比马尔之名得名赖斯·比马尔，1557年迪奥戈·德·科托又把比马罗描述成各地航海者停靠的港湾。武海马尔这一名称到17世纪才通行。

en: Volhynia, the country around Volodymyr and Lutsk in the western borderlands of Kievan Rus, was already organized as a Rus' principality in the late tenth century. In 1170 Roman Mstislavich inherited Volhynia, and in 1199 he added Halych to his domains, founding the united Kingdom of Galicia-Volhynia, or Ruthenia. Its princes became tributaries of the Mongol Golden Horde after the invasion of 1239 to 1241, while keeping their own Rurikid dynasty. In 1337 Volhynia was ruled, together with Halych, by Yuri II Boleslav, a Piast prince from Masovia; after he was poisoned by his boyars in 1340, the Galicia-Volhynia Wars ended the united kingdom, and between 1352 and 1366 Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania divided Volhynia between them. The Lithuanian share became a formal province of the Grand Duchy in 1452, and after the Union of Lublin in 1569 all of Volhynia was reorganized as the Volhynian Voivodeship of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. In the Third Partition of 1795 it passed to the Russian Empire as the Volhynian Governorate.
zh: 沃里尼亚位于基辅罗斯西部边陲，领有沃洛德米尔和卢茨克一带，早在10世纪末就已是一个罗斯公国。1170年罗曼·姆斯季斯拉维奇继承沃里尼亚，1199年又取得哈利奇，建立统一的加利西亚-沃里尼亚王国（鲁塞尼亚）。1239年至1241年蒙古入侵后，王公们成为金帐汗国的附庸，但仍保留自己的留里克王朝。1337年，沃里尼亚与哈利奇一同由来自马佐夫舍的皮亚斯特王公尤里二世·博莱斯瓦夫统治；1340年他被波雅尔毒杀后，加利西亚-沃里尼亚战争终结了统一王国，1352年至1366年间，波兰与立陶宛大公国瓜分了沃里尼亚。立陶宛所得部分于1452年正式成为大公国的一个省；1569年卢布林联合后，整个沃里尼亚改组为波兰立陶宛联邦的沃里尼亚省。1795年第三次瓜分中，它作为沃里尼亚省并入俄罗斯帝国。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Verden was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire in Lower Saxony, ruled from the town of Verden on the Aller. Its diocese was founded around 800 as a suffragan of the archbishopric of Mainz, and when the old Duchy of Saxony was broken up in 1180 the bishop's lands around the middle Aller became a territory of imperial immediacy, with Tammo as its first prince-bishop. In 1195 Bishop Rudolph I built the castle of Rotenburg on the Wümme, which later became the episcopal residence. The bishops were elected by the cathedral chapter, and several also held the neighbouring Archbishopric of Bremen in personal union. Lutheran teaching spread from 1558 and a Protestant church ordinance was enacted in 1568 under Administrator Eberhard von Holle; during the Thirty Years' War the Edict of Restitution briefly restored the Catholic Francis of Wartenberg between 1630 and 1634. The Peace of Westphalia dissolved the see in 1648, and its lands became the Swedish-ruled Principality of Verden, governed together with Bremen until that principality was dissolved in 1712.
zh: 费尔登主教侯国是神圣罗马帝国在下萨克森的教会邦国，以阿勒尔河畔的费尔登镇为统治中心。其教区约于800年设立，隶属美因茨大主教区；1180年旧萨克森公国被肢解时，主教在中阿勒尔一带的领地成为直辖帝国的邦国，塔莫为首任主教诸侯。1195年，主教鲁道夫一世在维默河畔修建罗滕堡城堡，后来成为主教驻地。主教由大教堂参事会选举产生，有数位主教还以君合关系兼任邻近的不来梅大主教。1558年起路德宗传播开来，1568年行政官埃伯哈德·冯·霍勒颁布新教教会规程；三十年战争期间，依据《归还敕令》，天主教徒弗朗茨·威廉·冯·瓦滕贝格于1630至1634年短暂恢复主教之位。1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》废除主教区，其领地成为瑞典统治的费尔登侯国，与不来梅合并治理，该侯国于1712年终结。

en: Vientiane, whose Lao name means the walled city of sandalwood, began as Chantaburi, one of the Mon city-states that dotted the middle Mekong from the eighth century and received Theravada Buddhism through Sri Lankan missionaries. By the twelfth century it lay in the Khmer orbit: a Vietnamese inscription records that in 1135 Văn Đan, the inscription's name for Vientiane, raided the Vietnamese province of Nghe An as a vassal of Zhenla, and in 1171 its ruler Phraya Chanthaburi invaded the Tai kingdom of Ngoenyang, only to be defeated. In 1354 Fa Ngum incorporated the city into his new Lan Xang kingdom, and in 1563 King Setthathirath moved Lan Xang's capital there to escape Burmese pressure, building the great stupa Pha That Luang three years later. When Lan Xang split in 1707, Vientiane became the seat of its own kingdom; it accepted Burmese suzerainty from 1765 to 1779 and then passed under Siamese overlordship, the city being sacked in 1779 and the Emerald Buddha carried away. King Anouvong's rebellion of 1826 to 1827 ended in catastrophe: Siamese armies burned Vientiane to the ground, deported its people and extinguished the kingdom, leaving the site in ruins until French colonial rule.
zh: 万象的佬语意为檀木城墙之城，其前身是8世纪起散布在湄公河中游的孟人城邦之一占塔武里，斯里兰卡僧侣把上座部佛教传到了这里。到12世纪它已进入高棉势力范围：一方越南碑铭记载，1135年碑中称作文单的万象作为真腊附庸入侵越南义安省；1171年，其君主帕亚占塔武里又进攻泰人的恩央王国，结果兵败。1354年法昂将该城纳入新建的澜沧王国，1563年塞塔提腊王为躲避缅甸兵锋把澜沧首都迁此，并于三年后修建大塔銮。1707年澜沧分裂，万象成为独立王国的都城；1765年至1779年它臣服缅甸，其后又受暹罗宗主权支配，1779年城被攻破，玉佛被掳走。1826年至1827年阿努冯王起兵反暹，酿成惨祸：暹罗军队将万象夷为平地、迁走全部人口，王国就此灭亡，城址直到法国殖民时期才得以重建。

en: The Barony of Vaud was the great Savoyard appanage between lakes Geneva and Neuchâtel, covering roughly the modern Swiss canton of Vaud. The counts of Savoy had first gained a foothold at Moudon in 1207, and Peter of Savoy, called the Little Charlemagne, brought most of the pays de Vaud under his rule after 1234; in 1286 the territory was formally settled on his descendants as a fief held of the Count of Savoy. The barony was administered from Morges through ten castellanies including Nyon and Yverdon, and its fertile lakeside lands yielded more revenue than the neighbouring County of Geneva. In 1337 the baron was Louis II, a veteran of campaigns in Italy and the Hundred Years' War who had represented the Savoyards at the coronation of Edward II of England in 1308 and who became regent of the County of Savoy in 1343. After his death the barony passed to his daughter Catherine, and in 1359 the Count of Savoy bought it back, ending its semi-independent existence. The territory remained Savoyard until the canton of Bern overran it during the Protestant Reformation in 1536.
zh: 沃男爵国是萨伏依家族最大的封邑，位于日内瓦湖与纳沙泰尔湖之间，地域约当今天的瑞士沃州。萨伏依伯爵于1207年率先在穆东取得立足点，绰号“小查理曼”的萨伏依的彼得在1234年以后把沃地区的大部分纳入治下，1286年这片领地正式封给其后代，作为向萨伏依伯爵效忠的采邑。男爵国以莫尔日为行政中心，下辖尼永、伊韦尔东等十个城堡辖区，肥沃的湖滨土地收入比邻近日内瓦伯国还要丰厚。1337年在位的男爵是路易二世，他曾在意大利和百年战争的战场上征战，1308年代表萨伏依人出席英王爱德华二世的加冕礼，1343年出任萨伏依伯国摄政。他死后男爵国传给女儿凯瑟琳，1359年萨伏依伯爵将其购回，这个半独立政权就此终结。此后该地一直属萨伏依，直到1536年宗教改革期间被伯尔尼州攻占。

en: Vungu, also written Bungu, was a Kongo-speaking kingdom of the Mayombe forest coast, in the region between the present-day Republic of the Congo and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In the thirteenth century it stood at the head of a coastal confederation with Ngoyo and Kakongo, west of the Congo River, and Kongo court tradition remembered it as the original home of the Kongo dynasty: its rulers were said to have crossed the Congo and imposed their authority on Mpemba Kasi, the marriage of Nimi a Nzima of Vungu with the heiress of Mbata around 1390 giving birth to the Kingdom of Kongo. Vungu itself long remained a separate realm, first named in a surviving document in a letter of King Afonso I of Kongo in 1535, and the Jesuit Mateus Cardoso recorded its founding role in the royal traditions in 1624. In the 1620s the Jaga, driven out of Kongo, moved north with the backing of Loango and occupied Vungu.
zh: 温古又译本古，是刚果河以西马永贝森林沿海的刚果语王国，地在今天的刚果（布）与刚果（金）之间。13世纪时，它统领着与恩戈约、卡刚果组成的沿海邦联；刚果宫廷传统把它视为刚果王朝的发源地：据说温古的统治者渡过刚果河，把势力扩展到姆彭巴·卡锡，约1390年温古的尼米·阿·恩齐马与姆巴塔的女继承人联姻，由此诞生刚果王国。温古本身长期保持独立政权，现存文献中最早的记载见于刚果国王阿方索一世1535年的一封信，耶稣会士马特乌斯·卡多索又在1624年把它的开国角色写入王室传说。17世纪20年代，被逐出刚果的贾加人在卢安果支持下北迁，占领了温古。

en: The Principality of Vyazma was a Rus' appanage of the Smolensk land, centered on the fortified town of Vyazma on the river of the same name, halfway between Smolensk and Mozhaysk. The town first appears in the chronicles in 1230, and in 1239 it became a separate principality for Andrey Vladimirovich Dolgoruky, a son of the grand prince of Kiev; his descendants, a junior branch of the Smolensk Rurikids, held it for the rest of the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries and grew prosperous on trade with Narva. In 1300 its prince Andrey Mikhailovich defeated the Smolensk princes Roman and Aleksandr near Dorogobuzh. As Lithuanian power pressed eastward, Vyazma was absorbed into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in 1403, though its princes kept their appanage for a time, and in 1494 a Muscovite army under Daniil Shchenya took the town and the peace treaty confirmed it as a possession of Moscow, where the Vyazemsky princes entered service.
zh: 维亚济马公国是斯摩棱斯克领地分出的罗斯封邑，中心在同名河畔的要塞城镇维亚济马，地处斯摩棱斯克与莫扎伊斯克之间。该城1230年首见编年史，1239年成为基辅大公之子安德烈·弗拉基米罗维奇（长手）的独立公国；他的后裔是斯摩棱斯克留里克王朝的幼支，在13世纪后期和14世纪领有此地，并靠与纳尔瓦的贸易致富。1300年，维亚济马公安德烈·米哈伊洛维奇在多罗戈布日附近击败斯摩棱斯克王公罗曼和亚历山大。随着立陶宛势力东进，维亚济马于1403年被并入立陶宛大公国，不过当地王公一度保留封邑权利；1494年，丹尼尔·谢尼亚率领莫斯科军队攻占该城，和约确认它归属莫斯科，维亚泽姆斯基王公们随后入朝供职。

en: Vyatka was a remote commonwealth of Russian settlers in the basin of the Vyatka River, beyond the Volga in the forests toward the Urals. Novgorodian and Vladimir-Suzdal colonists moved in among the native Permian and Udmurt population from the twelfth century, their chief town being Khlynov, later called Vyatka and then Kirov. Cut off by forests and rivers, the settlers ran their own affairs through a popular assembly and only intermittently acknowledged outside overlords. Their river pirates, the ushkuyniki, were famed and feared: in 1374 a Vyatka band raided the Golden Horde capital of Sarai. Around 1383 Nizhny Novgorod made the land its dependency, and Tatar expeditions soon imposed tribute as well. In 1402 Vasily I of Moscow granted Vyatka to his brother Yury, but it kept backing Moscow's enemies in the civil wars and raided both Tatar and Russian lands, sacking Sarai again in 1471. Ivan III ended its stubborn autonomy by force in 1489, deporting its notables and absorbing the republic into Muscovy.
zh: 维亚特卡是维亚特卡河流域的偏远移民共同体，位于伏尔加河以东、通往乌拉尔山的森林地带。12世纪起，诺夫哥罗德和弗拉基米尔-苏兹达尔的移民迁入本地彼尔姆人和乌德穆尔特人中间，他们的中心城镇是赫雷诺夫，后来先后改称维亚特卡和基洛夫。由于被森林与河流隔绝，移民通过市民大会管理自己的事务，对外界的宗主只是时断时续地承认。他们的河盗“乌什库伊尼克”令人生畏：1374年一支维亚特卡队伍就曾袭掠金帐汗国的都城萨莱。约1383年下诺夫哥罗德把这片土地收为附庸，鞑靼人的远征军很快也来征收贡赋。1402年莫斯科的瓦西里一世把维亚特卡封给弟弟尤里，但它在内战中屡次支持莫斯科的敌人，还同时劫掠鞑靼和罗斯的土地，1471年再度洗劫萨莱。1489年伊凡三世以武力终结了它顽强的自治，流放当地显贵，把这个共和国并入莫斯科。

en: Wallachia was the Romanian Orthodox principality between the Southern Carpathians and the Lower Danube, divided into Muntenia and Oltenia and called by its own people the Romanian Land. It grew from the union of smaller Romanian polities in the thirteenth century, and tradition credits the legendary Radu Negru with leading settlers across the Carpathians in 1290. Its first documented prince, Basarab I, ruled lands on both sides of the Olt from Câmpulung and, after refusing tribute to King Charles I of Hungary, destroyed the Hungarian army at the Battle of Posada in 1330, founding an independent principality under the House of Basarab, which still held it in 1337. Mircea the Elder defeated the Ottomans at Rovine in 1395 and briefly held Dobruja, but in 1417 Wallachia accepted Ottoman suzerainty, which Vlad the Impaler repeatedly challenged until his defeat at the Night Attack of Târgoviște in 1462. Michael the Brave briefly united Wallachia, Transylvania and Moldavia in 1600. Phanariot princes imposed from Istanbul ruled after 1715 until the 1821 rising of Tudor Vladimirescu, and the Treaty of Adrianople of 1829 then placed the principality under Russian supervision and restored its Danube ports.
zh: 瓦拉几亚是南喀尔巴阡山与多瑙河下游之间的罗马尼亚人东正教公国，分为蒙特尼亚和奥尔特尼亚两部分，罗马尼亚人自称为罗马尼亚之地。它由13世纪若干较小的罗马尼亚政权合并而成，传说中黑拉杜于1290年率部翻越南喀尔巴阡山前来建邦。有记载的第一位君主巴萨拉布一世以肯普隆格为府，领有奥尔特河两岸；他拒绝向匈牙利国王查理一世纳贡，1330年在波萨达战役歼灭匈牙利军队，建立起巴萨拉布家族统治的独立公国，1337年这个家族仍执掌政权。老者米尔恰一世1395年在罗维内击败奥斯曼人，一度据有多布罗加，但瓦拉几亚于1417年接受奥斯曼宗主权；穿刺公弗拉德三世一再起兵反抗，直到1462年特尔戈维什泰夜袭失败。1600年，勇敢的米哈伊曾短暂统一瓦拉几亚、特兰西瓦尼亚和摩尔达维亚。1715年起，伊斯坦布尔派来的法纳尔王公把持君位，直到1821年图多尔·弗拉迪米雷斯库起义才告终结；1829年的《阿德里安堡条约》使公国接受俄国监督，并收回多瑙河港口。

en: Warsangali denotes the Somali Muslim polity of the Maakhir coast, the Gulf of Aden shore beneath the Cal-Madow mountains where the Warsangali clan herded camels, grew dates and harvested frankincense around ports such as Las Khorey and Maydh. In the fourteenth century these lands were ruled by competing militarized garaads, or lords, each with his own following and forts, and in 1337 the coast lay within the tributary sphere of the Ifat Sultanate; Maakhir garaads later sent large contingents, many from Maydh, to the sixteenth-century holy wars of the imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi. The scattered lordships were welded into a single hereditary state only in 1613, when Garaad Abdulle Mahmud I of the Dar al-Sanjali dynasty, the House of Warsangali, made Durduri his capital. The sultanate grew rich on the frankincense and gum trade of the Gulf of Aden, controlled nine fortified ports and built its own trading ships at Las Khorey, which became the seat of the court. In 1764 the rulers exchanged the old title of garaad for sultan, and through the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries Las Khorey's towers and harbour made it one of the busiest towns on the northern Somali coast.
zh: 瓦桑加利指的是马赫海岸的索马里穆斯林政权——在卡尔马多山脉脚下的亚丁湾沿岸，瓦桑加利部族围绕拉斯霍雷、梅德等港口放牧骆驼、种植椰枣、采集乳香。14世纪时，这片土地由彼此竞争的军事化“加拉德”（首领）分别统治，各有部众和堡垒；1337年，该海岸处在伊法特苏丹国的朝贡势力圈内。后来在16世纪伊玛目艾哈迈德·加齐的圣战中，马赫的加拉德们还派出大量军队参战，其中不少兵员来自梅德。这些分散的领主权直到1613年才被整合为一个世袭国家：达尔·桑贾利王朝（瓦桑加利家族）的加拉德阿卜杜勒·马哈茂德一世以杜尔杜里为都。苏丹国靠亚丁湾的乳香和树胶贸易致富，控制九座设防港口，并在拉斯霍雷自行建造商船，那里后来成为宫廷所在地。1764年，统治者把旧称“加拉德”改为“苏丹”；整个18世纪至19世纪初，拉斯霍雷的塔楼与港湾使它成为索马里北部海岸最繁忙的城镇之一。

en: The Prince-Bishopric of Würzburg was the greatest ecclesiastical principality of Franconia, straddling the Main around its cathedral city. Boniface founded the diocese in 741 with Saint Burchard as its first bishop, and in the tenth and eleventh centuries the bishops absorbed the surrounding counties until the Golden Privilege granted by Emperor Frederick I in 1168 raised their church lands to duchy rank; from the fifteenth century the bishops also styled themselves Dukes in Franconia, ruling from the Marienberg fortress. In 1337 the see was held by Otto II von Wolfskeel, a member of a Franconian ministerialis family, who had become bishop in 1333. The bishopric's later history was violent: in the Peasants' War of 1525 over ten thousand rebels and citizens died in its territory, and Bishop Julius Echter von Mespelbrunn led the Counter-Reformation from 1573, founding the University of Würzburg in 1582 while witch trials gathered pace and peaked in the 1620s. As a member of the Catholic League it was ravaged in the Thirty Years' War and in 1633 was briefly erected as a Duchy of Franconia for Bernard of Saxe-Weimar. Secularized to Bavaria in 1803, it became the Grand Duchy of Würzburg under Napoleonic patronage in 1806 and returned to Bavaria in 1814.
zh: 维尔茨堡采邑主教区是法兰克尼亚最大的教会邦国，跨美因河两岸，以主教座堂所在的维尔茨堡为中心。741年波尼法修创立教区，圣布尔卡德为首任主教；10至11世纪间，主教们吞并了周边各伯国，1168年皇帝腓特烈一世颁布《黄金自由状》，将教会领地提升到公国等级，15世纪起主教们又自封法兰克尼亚公爵，从马林贝格要塞发号施令。1337年在任的是奥托二世·冯·沃尔夫斯基尔，出身法兰克尼亚家臣家族，1333年成为主教。主教区后来的历史充满暴力：1525年农民战争中，其境内有一万多名起义者和市民丧生；1573年起主教尤利乌斯·埃希特·冯·梅斯佩尔布伦推行反宗教改革，1582年创办维尔茨堡大学，与此同时猎巫审判愈演愈烈，在17世纪20年代达到顶峰。作为天主教联盟成员，它在三十年战争中惨遭蹂躏，1633年还被短暂立为萨克森-魏玛的伯恩哈德名下的法兰克尼亚公国。它于1803年被世俗化并划归巴伐利亚，1806年在拿破仑庇护下成为维尔茨堡大公国，1814年重新并入巴伐利亚。

en: Waldberg represents the County of Waldburg in Upper Swabia, the estate of the House of Waldburg, whose twelfth-century castle crowns a hill above the town of Waldburg. The family rose as stewards, or Truchsesse, of the Hohenstaufen: Eberhard von Tanne-Waldburg served Emperor Frederick II and even guarded the imperial regalia at Waldburg from 1220 to 1225. In the fourteenth century the lords held a scatter of Swabian castles and lordships such as Alttrauchburg, and the house later split into many comital lines, among them Waldburg-Zeil, Waldburg-Wolfegg and Waldburg-Wurzach. Raised to imperial counts in 1628, the Waldburgs played a conspicuous part in the wars of the early modern empire: Georg Truchsess von Waldburg, captain of the Swabian League, crushed the peasant armies at Böblingen in 1525, while Gebhard Truchsess von Waldburg, as Elector of Cologne, touched off the Cologne War in 1583 by marrying and embracing Protestantism. The family's lines kept their estates and titles through the mediatisation of 1806.
zh: 瓦尔德贝格对应上施瓦本的瓦尔德堡伯国，是瓦尔德堡家族的领地；家族12世纪的城堡雄踞在瓦尔德堡镇的山丘之上。该家族以担任霍亨斯陶芬家族的宫廷总管，即德意志所称的特鲁赫泽斯而起家：埃伯哈德·冯·塔讷-瓦尔德堡侍奉皇帝腓特烈二世，1220至1225年甚至在瓦尔德堡保管帝国皇权信物。14世纪时，领主们在施瓦本拥有阿尔特劳赫堡等一批分散的城堡和领地，后来家族分成瓦尔德堡-蔡尔、瓦尔德堡-沃尔夫埃格、瓦尔德堡-武尔察赫等众多伯爵支系。1628年瓦尔德堡家族升为帝国伯爵，并在近代早期帝国的战争中频频露面：施瓦本同盟军队统帅格奥尔格·特鲁赫泽斯·冯·瓦尔德堡于1525年在伯布林根击溃农民军；格布哈特·特鲁赫泽斯·冯·瓦尔德堡身为科隆选侯，因结婚并皈依新教而在1583年引发科隆战争。各支系在1806年的陪臣化中保住了产业和头衔。

en: The County of Waldeck grew from a small lordship in the north Hessian highlands around Waldeck Castle above the Eder river, first attested in 1120. Its rulers were a branch of the counts of Schwalenberg: in 1180 Volkwin II of Schwalenberg married the heiress of Waldeck, took the castle's name and built up a compact territory administered from the town of Korbach. Originally a fief of the archbishopric of Mainz, Waldeck gained imperial immediacy in the fourteenth century and was recognized as an imperial fief in 1379. In 1337 it was ruled by Count Henry IV, who reigned from 1305 to 1344. After the death of Henry VI in 1397 the family split into the Landau and Waldeck lines, whose debts later pushed them into the overlordship of the landgraves of Hesse. The house divided again in 1486 into the Wildungen and Eisenberg branches, which both adopted Lutheranism in 1526 and 1529; reunited in 1692, the family had inherited the distant County of Pyrmont in 1626 and moved its residence to Arolsen in 1655. Waldeck was raised to a principality in 1712, outlived the Holy Roman Empire itself, and joined the German Confederation in 1815.
zh: 瓦尔代克伯国起源于黑森北部高地的一个小领地，核心是埃德尔河畔1120年首次见于记载的瓦尔代克城堡。统治者是施瓦伦贝格伯爵的支系：1180年，施瓦伦贝格的福尔克温二世娶瓦尔代克女继承人为妻，以城堡为氏，并以科尔巴赫镇为行政中心，逐步整合出一块紧凑的领地。瓦尔代克原是美因茨大主教区的封地，14世纪取得帝国直辖地位，1379年被承认为帝国封地。1337年的统治者是亨利四世伯爵，1305至1344年在位。1397年亨利六世去世后，家族分裂为兰道和瓦尔代克两支，债务后来迫使他们接受黑森领地伯爵的宗主权。1486年家族再度分裂为维尔东根和艾森贝格两支，二者分别于1526年和1529年改宗路德宗；家族于1692年重新统一，此前已在1626年继承远方的皮尔蒙特伯国，并于1655年把驻地迁往阿罗尔森。1712年瓦尔代克升格为亲王国，它的寿命甚至超过神圣罗马帝国本身，1815年加入德意志邦联。

en: Wuding was the country of the Luowu, a Wuman Yi tribe already organized as a tribal division under the Dali Kingdom in the twelfth century. After the Mongol conquest of Dali the Yuan set up the Luowu tribal command in 1257 and the Wuding Route in 1276, ruling its Yi population through hereditary chieftains under the tusi system, with its seat at Hequ. The Ming converted it into the Wuding Military and Civilian Prefecture in 1382 and kept local Yi headmen as hereditary prefects. Repeated succession conflicts among the ruling clans gave the court a pretext for reform: the seat moved to Shizishan in 1569, and in 1607 the native prefect was replaced by an appointed official and the territory became the regular prefecture of Wuding. During the collapse of Ming rule the tusi Wu Bikui rebelled in 1645, taking Dayao, Dingyuan and Yao'an and alarming the whole of Yunnan before Ming troops defeated and captured him that September. In 1770 the Qing reduced Wuding to an independent department under the provincial government.
zh: 武定是彝族罗婺部的居地，早在12世纪的大理国时期就以部落建制存在。蒙古攻灭大理后，元朝于1257年立罗婺万户府，1276年改设武定路，治所设在和曲，通过世袭的彝族首领按土司制度治理当地彝民，辖境相当于今武定、禄劝、元谋一带。1382年明朝改设武定军民府，以当地彝族土官世袭知府。土官家族接连发生承袭纷争，朝廷借机推行改革：1569年将治所迁往狮子山，1607年废土知府、改派流官，成为正式的武定府。明朝末年天下大乱，武定土司吾必奎于1645年起兵反叛，连下大姚、定远、姚安，全滇震动，当年九月即被明军击败俘获。1770年清朝将武定府降为隶属省府的直隶州。

en: Weißenburg stands on the Franconian Jura south of Nuremberg, on the site of Biriciana, a Roman frontier fort whose surviving baths mark the edge of the old town. The name first appears in a charter of 867, and under the Franks the place served as a royal residence, linked by legend to Charlemagne and his unfinished Fossa Carolina canal. In 1296 it won the status of a Free Imperial City, answerable to the emperor alone, and for five centuries it governed itself as one of the small imperial cities of Franconia, its council meeting in the Gothic town hall completed in 1476. At the Reformation it followed the example of Nuremberg and joined the Protestant side, and it suffered heavily in the wars of religion that followed before its ancient rights were restored in the final peace settlement. Like the other free cities, Weißenburg lost its independence in the mediatization of 1802 and passed to the Kingdom of Bavaria in 1806.
zh: 魏森堡位于纽伦堡以南的弗兰肯汝拉山区，城建在罗马边境要塞比里基亚纳的旧址上，残存的罗马浴场仍横亘在老城边缘。其名最早见于867年的一份特许状；法兰克时代这里是王室驻地，传说与查理曼及其未完工的卡罗莱纳运河有关。1296年，它取得帝国自由城市地位，只对皇帝负责，此后五个世纪里作为法兰克尼亚的小城之一自治，市议会在1476年落成的哥特式市政厅议事。宗教改革时它效法纽伦堡加入新教阵营，在随后的宗教战争中损失惨重，其古老权利直到最终和约签订才得以恢复。与其他自由城市一样，魏森堡在1802年的世俗化调解中失去独立，1806年并入巴伐利亚王国。

en: Weji takes its name from the Tungusic word weji, meaning forest, long used in Chinese records for the forest Tungusic peoples of the lower Songhua and Amur. Under the Yuan they belonged, together with the Gilimi, to the Water Tatar circuit, and late-Yuan annals note Weji uprisings in 1343, 1346 and 1347. After the Ming founding, chiefs Xiyangha and Suoshiha led their people south into the Hulan river basin, where they became known as the Hulun, whom the Ming called the Haixi Jurchens and enrolled in the Wuzhe Guard; groups that stayed behind on the Amur were counted among the Wild Jurchens, whose Woji tribe was subdued by Nurhaci's Jianzhou in campaigns between 1596 and 1625. This polity had its seat at Hailun on the Tongken river, inside the Hulan basin resettled by those migrants.
zh: 窝集得名于通古斯语中意为森林的 weji，长期是汉文史料对松花江、黑龙江下游森林通古斯人的统称。元代他们与吉里迷同属水达达路，元末的1343年、1346年、1347年都有吾者野人反叛的记载。明朝建立后，首领西阳哈、锁失哈率部南下呼兰河流域，被周边民族称为扈伦，明朝称之为海西女真，并在永乐年间编入兀者卫；留居黑龙江中下游的群体则被称为兀狄哈，归入野人女真，其窝集部在1596—1625年的连年征讨中被努尔哈赤的建州女真征服。该政权的都城海伦位于通肯河畔，正处在南迁兀者人经营的呼兰河流域。

en: The Weken were a Jurchen group of the Woken River valley, a right-bank tributary of the Songhua that joins the main river at Yilan, the Ilan Tumen district where the Yuan posted its lower-Songhua myriarchies. The river's name derives from the Jurchen and Manchu word wehe, meaning stone. In 1337 the Woken clans lived under Yuan overlordship like their neighbours around Yilan. In 1408 the Ming established the Ouhanhe Guard over the Woken basin east of Yilan, giving its chieftains hereditary guard titles through the Nurgan system under which the region's Jurchens sent tribute to Beijing.
zh: 倭肯是活动在倭肯河流域的女真部落，倭肯河是松花江右岸支流，在依兰县城东侧汇入松花江，而依兰正是元朝设置松花江下游诸万户府的三姓之地。河名来自女真语和满语的 wehe，意为石头。1337年，倭肯各氏族与依兰附近的邻部一样臣属于元朝。1408年，明朝在依兰以东的倭肯河流域设立呕罕河卫，授予当地首领世袭卫职，使其经由奴儿干卫所体系向北京朝贡。

en: The County of Werdenberg was a Swabian state of the Holy Roman Empire on either side of the Alpine Rhine, centred on Werdenberg Castle above the modern Swiss town of Grabs and also holding Bludenz and the Montafon, Schellenberg and Lustenau. The counts descended from Count Hugo II of Tübingen, who had married the heiress of the last count of Bregenz; their lands were split from the County of Montfort in 1230 and divided again in 1260 into the Werdenberg and Sargans lines. In 1337 the county was held by Albert I of Werdenberg-Heiligenberg, who had served as imperial bailiff around Lake Constance and over Uri, Schwyz and Unterwalden, and whose feud with the counts of Montfort-Feldkirch let the Habsburgs gain a foothold in the Vorarlberg. His grandsons split the inheritance between 1377 and 1387 into the Werdenberg, Rheineck, Bludenz and Heiligenberg branches. The Vaduz branch died out in 1406 and its lands passed to the barons of Brandis. The Werdenberg feud with the von Zimmern family helped provoke the formation of the Swabian League in 1488, while the county itself was pledged in 1402, bought by Lucerne in 1485, and finally sold to the canton of Glarus in 1517, under whose rule it remained until it joined the canton of St. Gallen in 1803.
zh: 韦尔登贝格伯国是神圣罗马帝国的施瓦本邦国，地跨阿尔卑斯莱茵河两岸，以今瑞士格拉布斯镇上方的韦尔登贝格城堡为中心，还领有布鲁登茨、蒙塔丰、谢伦贝格和卢斯特瑙。伯爵家族出自蒂宾根伯爵胡戈二世，他娶了末代布雷根茨伯爵的女继承人；家族领地于1230年从蒙特福特伯国分出，1260年又分成韦尔登贝格和萨尔甘斯两支。1337年统治伯国的是韦尔登贝格-海利根贝格的阿尔布雷希特一世，他曾任博登湖一带以及乌里、施维茨、翁特瓦尔登的帝国监护官，他与蒙特福特-费尔德基希伯爵的纷争让哈布斯堡家族得以在福拉尔贝格立足。他的孙子们在1377至1387年间把遗产分为韦尔登贝格、莱茵埃克、布鲁登茨和海利根贝格四支。瓦杜兹一支于1406年绝嗣，领地落入布兰迪斯男爵之手。与齐默恩家族的韦尔登贝格世仇促成了1488年施瓦本同盟的建立；伯国本身则于1402年被抵押，1485年由卢塞恩购得，最终在1517年卖给格拉鲁斯州，受其管辖直到1803年并入圣加仑州。

en: The County of Wernigerode grew up at the northern foot of the Harz around Wernigerode Castle, first recorded in 1213, where a line of comital rulers appears from 1121. As Eastphalian magnates they held broad estates stretching from the Oker river to the Grosses Bruch lowland and long rivalled the counts of Regenstein. Threatened by the Welf dukes of Brunswick, they surrendered imperial immediacy in 1268 and became vassals of the Ascanian margraves of Brandenburg, and from 1381 of the archbishops of Magdeburg. In 1337 the county was held by Conrad IV, who ruled from 1325 to 1370 and in 1343 added former Regenstein lands held as fiefs of the bishop of Halberstadt. The native comital line ended with Henry IV in 1429, when the inheritance passed, by an arrangement of 1417, to his Stolberg cousins. The counts of Stolberg then ruled Wernigerode in personal union for two centuries; the Stolberg-Wernigerode line took up residence in the restored castle in 1710, and the county was finally incorporated into the Prussian Province of Saxony in 1815.
zh: 韦尼格罗德伯国兴起于哈茨山北麓，核心是1213年首次见于记载的韦尼格罗德城堡，当地的伯爵世系从1121年起出现。作为东法伦地区的大贵族，他们的地产从奥克河一直延伸到大布鲁赫低地，长期与雷根施泰因伯爵家族争雄。由于受到韦尔夫家族不伦瑞克公爵的威胁，他们在1268年放弃帝国直辖地位，成为阿斯坎尼家族勃兰登堡藩侯的附庸，1381年起又改臣马格德堡大主教。1337年统治伯国的是康拉德四世，他于1325至1370年在位，并在1343年取得原属雷根施泰因的土地，作为哈尔伯施塔特主教的封邑。本地伯爵世系随亨利四世在1429年去世而断绝，依照1417年的安排，遗产传给施托尔贝格的堂亲。此后施托尔贝格伯爵以共主邦联形式统治韦尼格罗德两百年；1710年施托尔贝格‑韦尼格罗德支系迁入重修的城堡，伯国最终于1815年并入普鲁士萨克森省。

en: Wehali was a traditional kingdom on the southern coast of central Timor, centered on the village of Laran in the fertile Belu plain, whose South Tetun-speaking people followed a matrilineal order. Among the many small Timorese realms it held ritual seniority: its paramount, the Maromak Oan or 'son of God', kept an executive regent titled Liurai at his side. Timorese oral tradition called Wehali the first land to emerge from the waters, and when Antonio Pigafetta of the Magellan expedition visited Timor in 1522, Wewiku-Wehali was already the island's leading power; seventeenth-century accounts called its ruler an emperor to whom all the island's kings paid tribute. It kept friendly ties with the Muslim kingdom of Makassar until devastating Portuguese attacks in 1642 and 1665 curbed its power and drew it into the Portuguese sphere. After the Battle of Penfui in 1749 it tilted toward the Dutch East India Company, and in 1756 the Liurai signed a treaty with the Dutch envoy Paravicini claiming overlordship over dozens of Timorese kingdoms, after which Wehali vacillated between the two colonial powers.
zh: 韦哈勒是帝汶岛中南部沿海的传统王国，以肥沃的贝鲁平原上的拉兰村为中心，居民属南德顿语区，实行母系制度。在帝汶众多小邦中，韦哈勒居于礼仪上的宗主地位：最高君主称马罗马克·奥安，意为“神之子”，身边有称柳赖的执政摄政辅佐。帝汶口传传统称韦哈勒是从洪水中最先露出的土地；1522年麦哲伦船队的皮加费塔抵达帝汶时，韦威库—韦哈勒已是岛上首屈一指的强权，17世纪的记载称其君主为皇帝，全岛诸王都向他纳贡。它与穆斯林的望加锡王国保持友好往来，直到1642年和1665年葡萄牙人的两次毁灭性进攻削弱了它的力量，将其纳入葡萄牙势力范围。1749年彭富伊战役后，韦哈勒转向荷兰东印度公司，1756年柳赖与荷兰使者帕拉维奇尼签约，宣称对数十个帝汶小邦拥有宗主权，此后便在两个殖民强国之间摇摆。

en: The County of Wied was a Holy Roman Empire territory in the Westerwald, named after the river Wied where it enters the Rhine and held from its beginnings as a fief of the Count Palatine. Its first lord, Metfried, appears as Meffridus de Widhe in a charter of 1129, and his son Arnold of Wied became archbishop of Cologne and chancellor of King Conrad III. The first comital line died out with Count Lothar in 1244, and the county passed through his heiress Theodora to the Isenburg family, who ruled as counts of Isenburg-Wied for the next two centuries; the other half of the inheritance had gone to the lords of Eppstein and was sold to the counts of Virneburg in 1306. In 1462 the Isenburg-Wied line likewise failed, and Wied passed to the Runkel family, whose head Frederick IV founded the third and last comital house. The county was later split into Wied-Neuwied, whose residence town of Neuwied was founded in 1653 and became a famous refuge for persecuted religious minorities, and Wied-Runkel. Raised to a principality in 1784, Wied was mediatized to the Duchy of Nassau in 1806 and passed to Prussia in 1815.
zh: 维德伯国是神圣罗马帝国在韦斯特林山的领地，因维德河注入莱茵河处而得名，自始即为莱茵行宫伯爵的采邑。其首位领主梅特弗里德于1129年的一份文书中以“德·维德”之名出现，他的儿子维德的阿诺尔德后来官至科隆大主教兼国王康拉德三世的首相。第一个伯爵世家随洛塔尔伯爵于1244年绝嗣，伯国经女继承人特奥多拉转入伊森堡家族，此后两百年由伊森堡-维德伯爵统治；遗产的另一半则归埃普施泰因领主，1306年卖给菲尔讷堡伯爵。1462年伊森堡-维德一系也绝嗣，维德转入龙克尔家族，其家主腓特烈四世开创了第三个也是最后一个伯爵世家。伯国后来分裂为维德-新维德与维德-龙克尔：前者的居城新维德建于1653年，以收容受迫害的宗教少数派闻名。维德于1784年升格为侯国，1806年被并入拿骚公国，1815年转属普鲁士。

en: Waldsassen was the domain of Waldsassen Abbey, the first Cistercian monastery in Bavaria, founded on the River Wondreb near Tirschenreuth by the monk Gerwich of Wolmundstein and built between 1128 and 1132, with its first abbot elected in 1133. Richly endowed, it became one of the foremost Cistercian houses of the empire and founded daughter monasteries at Osek and Senftenberg in Bohemia and at Walderbach near Regensburg. In 1147 King Conrad III granted it imperial immediacy, so that the abbot ruled the abbey's Stiftland lands, including Tirschenreuth, as a prince of the Holy Roman Empire. From the middle of the fourteenth century wars, famines, heavy taxation and Hussite raids brought repeated setbacks. The monastery was burned in the Bavarian War of 1504 and again during the Peasants' War of 1525, and in 1543 it lost its imperial immediacy to the Electorate of the Palatinate, whose authorities expelled the monks. Restored to the Cistercians in 1669 after the Thirty Years' War, it was rebuilt in Baroque splendour, famous for its library completed in 1726, but never recovered its old political rights. The Reichsdeputationshauptschluss of 1803 dissolved the abbey and assigned its lands to Bavaria.
zh: 瓦尔德萨森是瓦尔德萨森修道院的领地。这座修道院是巴伐利亚第一座西多会修道院，由修士沃尔蒙德施泰因的格维希在蒂申罗伊特附近的翁德雷布河畔创建，1128至1132年间建成，1133年选出首任院长。它捐赠丰厚，成为帝国最显赫的西多会修道院之一，并在波希米亚的奥塞克、森夫滕贝格和雷根斯堡附近的瓦尔德巴赫建立了子修道院。1147年国王康拉德三世授予它帝国直辖地位，院长自此作为神圣罗马帝国的诸侯，统治包括蒂申罗伊特在内的施蒂夫特兰领地。14世纪中叶起，战争、饥荒、重税和胡斯派袭扰使它屡遭挫折。修道院在1504年巴伐利亚战争中被焚，1525年农民战争中再遭破坏；1543年它丧失帝国直辖地位，领地落入普法尔茨选侯国之手，修士也被驱逐。三十年战争后，修道院于1669年归还西多会，并按巴洛克风格华丽重建，以1726年落成的图书馆闻名，但再未恢复旧日的政治权利。1803年的《帝国代表重要决议》解散了修道院，将其领地划归巴伐利亚。

en: Wales is the last stronghold of the Britons, the Celtic inhabitants of Roman Britain who were driven west of Offa's Dyke by the Anglo-Saxon conquest. Out of the early kingdoms of Gwynedd, Powys and Deheubarth came rulers such as Rhodri the Great and Hywel Dda, and later Llywelyn the Great, while Norman adventurers carved marcher lordships out of the southern and eastern lowlands. Llywelyn ap Gruffudd, the last native Prince of Wales, was recognised by the Treaty of Montgomery in 1267, but his conflict with Edward I ended in ruin: Llywelyn was killed in 1282, his brother Dafydd was executed in 1283, and the Edwardian castles of Caernarfon, Conwy and Harlech anchored the conquest. The Statute of Rhuddlan of 1284 imposed English administration, and in 1301 Edward bestowed the title Prince of Wales on his heir, a custom ever since. In 1337 the principality and the marcher lordships together cover the country under the English crown, held by Edward III himself. Native risings under Madog ap Llywelyn in 1294 and Owain Glyndwr from 1400 shook but never broke English rule, though Glyndwr held a Welsh parliament at Machynlleth and vanished uncaptured. In 1485 Henry Tudor, descended from Welsh princes, landed here and marched to victory at Bosworth, and under Henry VIII the Laws in Wales Acts of 1535 and 1542 fully incorporated Wales into the kingdom of England.
zh: 威尔士是不列颠人的最后据点：这些罗马不列颠时代的凯尔特居民在盎格鲁-撒克逊人的征服中被驱赶到奥法堤以西。圭内斯、波伊斯和德赫巴思等早期王国先后出过罗德里大王、海韦尔·法达以及“大帝”卢埃林等统治者，而诺曼冒险家则在南部和东部低地开辟出一个个边区领。最后一位本土威尔士亲王卢埃林·阿普·格鲁菲德的地位在1267年的《蒙哥马利条约》中获得承认，但他与爱德华一世的冲突以毁灭告终：卢埃林于1282年被杀，其弟达菲德于1283年被处死，卡那封、康维和哈莱克等爱德华式城堡镇住了征服成果。1284年的《里兹兰法令》推行英格兰式行政，1301年爱德华又把威尔士亲王头衔封给继承人，此后相沿成例。1337年，威尔士公国与各地边区领共同构成英格兰王冠治下的国土，由爱德华三世本人领有。1294年马多格·阿普·卢埃林的起义和1400年起欧文·格兰道尔的大起义都曾撼动却未能推翻英格兰统治；格兰道尔在马汉莱斯召开过威尔士议会，最终下落不明、未被擒获。1485年，兼有威尔士诸王血统的亨利·都铎在此登陆，进军博斯沃思并取胜登基；亨利八世时期，1535和1542年的《威尔士法案》在法律上将威尔士完全并入英格兰王国。

en: Weimar grew up in the Ilm valley around a count's castle, and the County of Weimar is first mentioned in 949 as one of the leading lordships of early medieval Thuringia. Around 1062 Count Otto united it with his County of Orlamünde on the Saale, creating the County of Weimar-Orlamünde. When that first dynasty died out in 1112, an inheritance dispute ended with the lands passing to the Ascanian Siegfried of Ballenstedt, and in 1140 to Albert the Bear; a younger Ascanian line then took the comital title. Under Hermann II in the early thirteenth century the county briefly flourished and expanded into the Orla hills, but a later partition and heavy debt weakened it against the rising Wettin margraves. In 1337 the Weimar line was headed by Count Otto VI, whose kinsmen sold Orlamünde to the Wettins in 1344. The Thuringian Counts' War of 1342 to 1346 ended in the Treaty of Dresden, by which Weimar became a Wettin fief and lost its imperial immediacy; the last Ascanian side branches disappeared by 1486. After the 1485 Treaty of Leipzig Weimar belonged to the Ernestine Wettins, and from the Wittenberg Capitulation of 1547 it was their residence and the capital of Saxe-Weimar. The Reformation made the town a Protestant centre, and in the late eighteenth century Duke Charles August drew Goethe and Schiller to his court, making Weimar the home of Weimar Classicism.
zh: 魏玛在伊尔姆河谷一座伯爵城堡周围发展起来，魏玛伯国最早于949年被提及，是中世纪早期图林根最主要的领主邦国之一。约1062年，奥托伯爵把它与自己在萨勒河畔的奥拉明德伯国合并，组成魏玛-奥拉明德伯国。1112年第一个王朝绝嗣，经过继承纠纷，领地落入阿斯坎尼家族的巴伦施泰特的齐格弗里德之手，1140年又归大熊阿尔贝，此后由阿斯坎尼的一支幼系承袭伯爵头衔。13世纪初赫尔曼二世治下伯国一度兴盛，势力扩展到奥拉山区，但后来的分家与沉重债务削弱了它，难以抗衡崛起的韦廷藩侯。1337年魏玛支系的首领是奥托六世伯爵，他的亲族于1344年把奥拉明德卖给了韦廷家族。1342至1346年的图林根伯爵战争以《德累斯顿条约》告终，魏玛据此成为韦廷的封邑，丧失帝国直辖地位；阿斯坎尼最后的旁支到1486年也告绝嗣。1485年《莱比锡条约》后，魏玛归属韦廷恩斯特系，1547年维滕贝格投降后成为该支的驻地和萨克森-魏玛的首府。宗教改革使这座城镇成为新教中心，18世纪末，公爵卡尔·奥古斯特把歌德和席勒罗致到宫廷，魏玛由此成为魏玛古典主义的故乡。

en: The name Weimao groups the Qiang, or Rma, chieftaincies of the upper Min River valley around Weizhou and Maozhou, in what is now Wenchuan and Mao counties of Sichuan, with its center at Wenshan. The Yuan first organized the hill country in 1283 under the Songpan-Diedang-Weimao tribal pacification office, while Maozhou, seated at Wenshan, administered the Qiang fort-villages of the gorges. After the Ming conquest of Sichuan in 1371, Maozhou was placed under Chengdu and local headmen were confirmed as hereditary tusi, including the Wenchuan chief's office set up in 1374 and the Wasi pacification commission, whose stone watchtower villages kept the old white-stone cult. Han settlement spread through the Maozhou valleys in the fifteenth century, and the frontier wars of the 1580s tightened imperial control upriver. In 1728 the Qing raised Maozhou to an independent department overseeing six native offices, among them the Wasi tusi at Wenchuan.
zh: 威茂是对岷江上游威州、茂州一带尔玛（羌）人土司领地的统称，在今四川汶川、茂县地区，中心在汶山。这一带山寨最早由元朝招抚：1283年元廷设松潘叠宕威茂等处军民安抚司，以治所设在汶山的茂州统领峡谷中的羌人寨堡。1371年明军平定四川后，茂州划归成都府，当地头人被确认为世袭土司，如1374年设置的汶川长官司和辖地在汶川的瓦寺安抚使司，其石碉村寨保留着古老的白石崇拜。15世纪汉人移民不断进入茂州河谷，16世纪80年代的边战又加强了朝廷对岷江上游的控制。1728年清廷升茂州为直隶州，下辖瓦寺宣慰司等六个土司分理羌民。

en: Wanga is the kingdom of the Abawanga, a Luhya people of western Kenya, whose Nabongo rulers kept their court at Mumias near the Nzoia river. Their traditions trace the people through Buganda, where their ancestors served the Kabaka for generations before moving west into the Nyanza country, and the dynasty itself was founded in the sixteenth century by Nabongo Wanga, who gave the kingdom its name and made Mumias his capital. After his death a succession quarrel between his sons Wabala and Murono ended in assassination and battle, and the defeated Murono founded a rival centre across the Nzoia at Matungu around 1679. Nabongo Netya, ruling from about 1760, fought the Teso and Bukusu and bargained Maasai military aid against cattle and grazing land, while Nabongo Osundwa made peace with the Maasai and made Mumias the administrative heart of the realm. A new succession dispute in 1814 split the country when Kweyu seceded to Eshimuli and set up the Wanga Mukulu confederacy.
zh: 万加是肯尼亚西部卢希亚人一支阿巴万加人的王国，其统治者称纳邦戈，宫廷设在恩佐亚河畔的穆米亚斯。据他们的传说，先民曾寄居布干达，世代臣事卡巴卡，随后西迁进入尼安扎一带；王朝本身由纳邦戈·万加于16世纪开创，国名即得自他本人，并以穆米亚斯为都。万加死后，儿子瓦巴拉与穆罗诺争夺继承权，以暗杀和兵戎相见，败走的穆罗诺约于1679年在恩佐亚河对岸的马通古另立中心。约1760年起在位的纳邦戈·内特亚同泰索人与布库苏人交战，并用牲畜和牧场换取马赛人的军事援助；纳邦戈·奥孙达则与马赛人讲和，把穆米亚斯经营成王国的行政中枢。1814年又起继承之争，奎尤率众退守埃希穆利，另建上万加联盟，国家再度分裂。

en: Wumeng takes its name from the Wumeng tribe of the Wuman Yi, who held these mountains where Yunnan, Sichuan and Guizhou meet under the Nanzhao and Dali kingdoms; Yi tradition still regards the region, present-day Zhaotong, as its ancestral homeland. The Yuan created the Wumeng Route in 1278, and after the Ming conquest of 1382 it became Wumeng Prefecture, entrusted to hereditary Yi chieftains but placed under the administration of Sichuan. Garrisons guarded the old five-foot road into Yunnan while the native Lu clan kept its power in the hills. In 1726 the governor-general Ortai launched the gaitu guiliu campaign here: the Lu chieftains surrendered at first, but in 1728 Lu Wanfu gathered the tribes of Wumeng, Dongchuan, Zhenxiong and the Liangshan and rose in revolt, killing the garrison commander Liu Qiyuan, before three-province armies crushed the rising with great bloodshed. Wumeng passed to Yunnan in 1727, received appointed officials and the new counties of En'an and Yongshan in 1728, and in 1731 was renamed Zhaotong, meaning enlightened and open communication, so that the name Wumeng disappeared from the map.
zh: 乌蒙得名于乌蛮彝族的乌蒙部，南诏、大理时期这支彝人就盘踞在云南、四川、贵州交界的群山之中；直到今天，彝族仍把今昭通一带视为祖居之地。1278年元朝置乌蒙路，1382年明军平定乌蒙后改设乌蒙府，交由彝族首领世袭治理，行政上却隶属四川。明清驻军把守入滇的五尺古道，禄氏土官则在山中保有实权。1726年，云贵川总督鄂尔泰在此推行改土归流，禄氏首领一度受抚；1728年禄万福集结乌蒙、东川、镇雄和凉山的彝部数万人起兵反叛，杀死总兵刘起元，鄂尔泰调集云南、贵州、四川三省大军围剿，屠戮极惨，叛乱才告平息。1727年乌蒙府改隶云南，1728年派任流官、置恩安与永善等县，1731年取昭明宣通之意改名昭通府，乌蒙之名从此从地图上消失。

en: Wuntho, called Wying Hsö in Shan, was a Shan state in Upper Burma, lying midway between the Ayeyarwady and Chindwin rivers. Its Shan name means city of the tiger, and local chronicles trace a line of saopha rulers back to the sixth century, though British colonial officials doubted it was ever as independent as the larger Shan states to the east. In 1337 the saopha Hso Ngam Möng Hpa succeeded his brother and ruled from the town of Wuntho. The state was drawn into the wars of the Burmese lowlands: in 1555 its governor, a nephew of the saopha of Möng Yang, was posted to Taze to resist Bayinnaung's conquest of Upper Burma. Wuntho kept its own line of saophas under Burmese overlordship into the nineteenth century.
zh: 文多，掸语称威英瑟，是上缅甸的一个掸邦，地处伊洛瓦底江与钦敦江之间。其掸语名字意为虎城，当地编年史把诏法世系追溯到6世纪，但英国殖民官员认为它从未像东边那些较大的掸邦那样真正独立。1337年，诏法索甘孟继承兄长之位，在文多城统治。该邦后来被卷入缅甸低地的战事：1555年，它的统治者——勐养诏法的外甥——被派驻德榭，抵御勃印曩对上缅甸的征服。此后文多在缅甸的宗主权下保留自己的诏法世系，一直延续到19世纪。

en: Wolgast was the western duchy of the Griffin rulers of Pomerania, created in 1295 when the dynasty split its lands between the Wolgast and Stettin lines under Duke Bogislaw IV. Its territories fronted the Baltic from the Peene estuary to the island of Rügen, taking in the Hanseatic port of Stralsund; Rügen itself, the old kingdom of the Rani, fell to the Wolgast dukes after the Rügen War of Succession ended in 1328. In 1337 the duchy was held by the brothers Bogislaw V, Barnim IV and Wartislaw V, who had ruled jointly since the death of their father Wartislaw IV in 1326. Bogislaw married Elisabeth, daughter of King Casimir III of Poland, in 1343, and their daughter Elisabeth became the wife of Emperor Charles IV in 1363. The brothers' quarrels led to the partition treaty of 1368, which spun off Pomerania-Stolp, Pomerania-Neustettin and the Barth lands, while Bogislaw's grandson through his second marriage was Eric of Pomerania, king of the Kalmar Union. The Wolgast duchy was merged back into a reunited Duchy of Pomerania under Bogislaw X in 1478.
zh: 沃尔加斯特是波美拉尼亚格里芬家族治下的西部公国，1295年该家族在波吉斯瓦夫公爵主持下把领地分为沃尔加斯特和斯德丁两支，沃尔加斯特公国由此建立。其领土濒临波罗的海，北起佩讷河口、南至吕根岛，辖有汉萨港口施特拉尔松德；吕根本是拉尼人的故地，在1328年吕根继承战争结束后落入沃尔加斯特公爵之手。1337年，波吉斯瓦夫五世、巴尔宁四世和瓦季斯瓦夫五世兄弟共治公国，他们自1326年父亲瓦季斯瓦夫四世去世后便联合执政。波吉斯瓦夫于1343年娶波兰国王卡齐米日三世之女伊丽莎白为妻，他们的女儿伊丽莎白在1363年嫁给皇帝查理四世。兄弟间的争执导致1368年签订分割条约，分出波美拉尼亚-斯武普斯克、波美拉尼亚-新斯德丁和巴尔特等地；波吉斯瓦夫第二次婚姻的孙子则是卡尔马联盟国王波美拉尼亚的埃里克。1478年，沃尔加斯特公国在波吉斯瓦夫十世治下重新并入统一的波美拉尼亚公国。

en: The Duchy of Wrocław, German Breslau, was the leading Lower Silesian Piast duchy, centered on the wealthy Oder crossing of Wrocław, which had been the main residence of the Silesian dukes since the line of Bolesław I the Tall took shape in the 1172 partition. In the division of 1311 Henry VI the Good received Wrocław as his share, and hard pressed by his brother Bolesław III of Brzeg he signed a treaty there on 6 April 1327 with King John of Bohemia: the duchy stayed independent for his lifetime but would pass to the Bohemian crown on his death. When Henry died without a son on 24 November 1335, Wrocław was accordingly incorporated into the Crown of Bohemia, and from 1337 King John himself ruled it as a direct fief, with the ecclesiastical Duchy of Nysa held beneath it. In 1348 Charles IV formally attached the Silesian duchies to the Lands of the Bohemian Crown, and Wrocław, which joined the Hanseatic League by 1387, became the foremost city of Silesia. The Reformation reached it in 1518, the Habsburgs inherited the Bohemian crown in 1526, and it endured occupation and plague in the Thirty Years' War. Prussia seized the city in the War of the Austrian Succession and received it under the 1742 Treaty of Breslau; under Prussian rule its fortifications were demolished in the Napoleonic Wars and its university was refounded in 1811.
zh: 弗罗茨瓦夫公国（德语称布雷斯劳）是下西里西亚首屈一指的皮雅斯特公国，以奥得河畔富庶的弗罗茨瓦夫城为中心；自1172年分封形成博莱斯拉夫一世（“高个子”）一支以来，该城便是西里西亚公爵的主要驻地。1311年分封时，亨里克六世（“善人”）分得弗罗茨瓦夫；在其弟布热格的博莱斯拉夫三世逼迫下，他于1327年4月6日在当地与波希米亚国王约翰签约：公国在他生前保持独立，死后转归波希米亚王冠。1335年11月24日亨里克无嗣而终，弗罗茨瓦夫依约并入波希米亚王冠，1337年起由国王约翰本人作为直属采邑亲自统治，教会性质的尼萨公国则是其附庸。1348年，查理四世正式把西里西亚诸公国纳入波希米亚王冠领地；弗罗茨瓦夫在1387年前加入汉萨同盟，成为西里西亚首屈一指的城市。宗教改革于1518年传到这里，1526年哈布斯堡家族继承波希米亚王冠，三十年战争中该城又遭占领和瘟疫。奥地利王位继承战争期间普鲁士夺取此城，1742年依《弗罗茨瓦夫条约》正式获得；普鲁士统治时期，城防工事在拿破仑战争中被拆除，当地大学于1811年重组重建。

en: Wairagarh is a Gond chiefdom of upper Vidarbha, centred on the fort of Vairagad at the meeting of the Khobragadhi and Satnalas rivers, a site famed for diamond mines that the Ain-i-Akbari later recorded. The fort had first been the seat of the Mana dynasty, whose kings Kurumpruhoda and Gahilu fortified Wairagarh, Garbori and Manikgarh from the seventh century until the Gond leader Kol Bhil overthrew them after long warfare. Gond chiefs then held Wairagarh together with Garbori and Rajgad, and around 1422 Ahmad Shah Bahmani raided the town, leaving the graves of the soldiers fallen in the fighting. In time the country was drawn into the Gond kingdom of Chanda, whose rulers built Chandrapur and Ballarpur and developed irrigation and a regular revenue system, until the Maratha leader Raghoji I Bhonsle conquered Chanda in 1751 and ended Gond rule over the region.
zh: 韦拉加尔是上维达尔巴的贡德人首领邦，以霍布拉加迪河与萨特纳拉斯河交汇处的韦拉加尔要塞为中心，当地盛产钻石，后来的《阿克巴则例》也曾记载其矿。这座要塞最早是马纳王朝的治所：7世纪起，库伦普鲁霍达、加希卢等马纳国王相继修筑了韦拉加尔、加尔博里和马尼加尔等堡垒，直到贡德首领科尔·比尔经多年征战将其推翻。此后贡德首领连同加尔博里、拉杰加尔一并据有韦拉加尔；约1422年，巴赫曼尼苏丹艾哈迈德沙劫掠此地，战殁士兵的坟墓留存当地。后来该地被纳入贡德人的钱达王国，钱达诸王修建了昌德拉布尔和巴拉尔布尔，发展灌溉与固定税制，直到1751年马拉塔首领拉戈吉一世·邦斯勒征服钱达，贡德人在这一地区的统治才告结束。

en:
Worms was a Rhine city of great antiquity and the seat of a bishopric documented as early as 614. Charlemagne kept a palace there, and Bishop Burchard, author of an influential collection of church law, gave the see its early eleventh-century reputation. In 1074 King Henry IV granted the citizens far-reaching privileges, and Worms developed into a Free Imperial City while its bishops withdrew to Ladenburg and kept jurisdiction only over the cathedral precinct. The city's Jews suffered in the Rhineland massacres of the People's Crusade in 1096, when Count Emich's followers killed between eight hundred and a thousand people.

Worms became a favored stage of imperial politics: the Concordat of Worms of 1122 closed the Investiture Controversy between emperor and papacy, the diet of 1495 launched the Imperial Reform, and the diet of 1521 produced the Edict of Worms condemning Martin Luther; the city's presses soon printed Luther's German Bible and, by 1526, William Tyndale's English New Testament. Louis XIV's troops sacked Worms in 1689 during the Nine Years' War, and the Treaty of Worms in 1743 linked Britain, Austria and Sardinia. French Revolutionary troops occupied the city in 1792, the bishopric was secularized in 1801, and the Congress of Vienna assigned Worms to the Grand Duchy of Hesse in 1815.
zh:
沃尔姆斯是莱茵河畔一座古老的城市，当地主教区早在614年已有记载。查理曼在此设有行宫，主教布尔夏德撰有影响深远的教会法汇编，使该主教区在11世纪初声名远扬。1074年，国王亨利四世授予市民广泛特权，沃尔姆斯逐渐发展为帝国自由城市，主教们则退居拉登堡，只保留对大教堂辖区的管辖权。1096年平民十字军期间的莱茵兰大屠杀中，埃米希伯爵的追随者在城内杀害了八百到一千名犹太人。

沃尔姆斯后来成为帝国政治的重要舞台：1122年的《沃尔姆斯宗教协定》结束了皇帝与教皇之间的主教叙任权之争，1495年的帝国议会启动了帝国改革，1521年的帝国议会颁布《沃尔姆斯敕令》，宣判马丁·路德为异端；当地印刷商很快印出路德的德文圣经，并在1526年前印出威廉·廷代尔的英文《新约》。1689年九年战争期间，路易十四的军队洗劫了沃尔姆斯；1743年的《沃尔姆斯条约》使英国、奥地利和撒丁王国结盟。1792年法兰西革命军队占领该城，1801年主教区被世俗化，1815年维也纳会议将沃尔姆斯划归黑森大公国。

en: Waren was the seat of the Werle-Waren branch of the Wendish lordship of Werle, held by a junior line of the Obotrite House of Mecklenburg. The branch split off from Werle-Güstrow in 1337, the year the old lord John II the Bald died, and its lands lay on the Mecklenburg lake plateau around Waren and Malchin, on the shores of the Müritz. John's youngest son Bernard II ruled Werle-Waren from the partition of 1347 until his death in 1382, and added Werle-Goldberg to his holdings in 1374. He was followed by his son John VI and then by the brothers Nicholas V, who died in 1408, and Christopher, who died in 1425. With Christopher's death without heirs the Waren line ended and its lands reverted to Werle-Güstrow, and in 1436 the whole lordship of Werle escheated to the Duchy of Mecklenburg.
zh: 瓦伦是文德人韦尔莱领地瓦伦支系的驻地，统治者是奥博特里特人梅克伦堡家族的一支旁系。1337年，老领主秃头约翰二世去世，瓦伦支系在这一年从韦尔莱-居斯特罗分出，领地位于梅克伦堡湖区的瓦伦和马尔欣一带、米里茨湖畔。约翰的幼子伯恩哈德二世自1347年分家起统治韦尔莱-瓦伦，直到1382年去世，并于1374年兼并了韦尔莱-戈德堡。继他之后的是其子约翰六世，再后是兄弟尼古拉斯五世（1408年卒）和克里斯托弗（1425年卒）。克里斯托弗无嗣而终后瓦伦支系断绝，领地复归韦尔莱-居斯特罗；1436年整个韦尔莱领地都收归梅克伦堡公国。

en: Wusa was the high country of the Wusa branch of the Yi, on the Guizhou plateau west of the Wumeng mountains, covering the lands around present-day Weining and Hezhang. The Yuan organized it as the Wusa Route under the joint Wusa-Wumeng pacification command, and in 1381 the Ming created Wusa Prefecture, appointing the Yi chieftain Shibu as native prefect; a military guard followed in 1382. In 1383 the prefecture was placed under the administration of Sichuan and in 1384 raised to a military-civilian prefecture, while in 1414 its guard was placed under the Guizhou military command, native rule and garrison government standing side by side. For nearly three centuries the hereditary An clan of native prefects ruled from its mountain seat while military farms held the road into Yunnan. In 1664 the Wusa prefect An Chongsheng joined the great Shuixi rising of An Kun, together with the Manai chieftain Long Jizhao, against the Qing and the prince Wu Sangui. The revolt was defeated in 1665, and in 1666 the court abolished the tusi and replaced Wusa with Weining Department, its new name meaning awe and peace, under Guizhou administration.
zh: 乌撒是彝族乌撒支系的高地之邦，位于乌蒙山以西的贵州高原，辖地相当于今威宁、赫章一带。元朝置乌撒路，归乌撒乌蒙宣慰司统辖；1381年明朝设乌撒府，授彝族首领实卜为土知府，治所就在乌撒，1382年又置乌撒卫，1383年乌撒府改隶四川布政司，1384年升为乌撒军民府，而乌撒卫在1414年改属贵州都司，土流并立、犬牙相制。近三百年间，安氏土知府在山城中世袭统治，卫所屯军则扼守入滇要道。1664年，乌撒土司安重圣联合水西土司安坤、马乃土司龙吉兆起兵反抗清朝与平西王吴三桂；1665年叛乱被平定，1666年朝廷废除土司，改乌撒府为威宁州，取威镇安宁之意，划归贵州管辖。
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/威宁彝族回族苗族自治县

en: The County of Wittgenstein was a small lordship in the wooded Sauerland, held by an imperial comital family named after Wittgenstein Castle above the upper Lahn. Count Werner I first styled himself after the castle in 1174, and when the house divided in 1238 Siegfried I took the Wittgenstein lands, with the town of Laasphe growing up beneath the castle. In 1337 the county was still ruled by the descendants of Werner, but the line died out in the male line in 1359: the heiress Adelheid had married Count Salentin of Sayn-Homburg in 1345, and their heirs combined the two lands as the County of Sayn-Wittgenstein. The territory was repeatedly split between a northern part around Berleburg and a southern part around Laasphe, and in 1607 it was partitioned into the Sayn-Wittgenstein-Berleburg, Sayn-Wittgenstein-Sayn and Sayn-Wittgenstein-Wittgenstein counties. The Berleburg line was raised to a principality in 1792, mediatised to the Grand Duchy of Hesse in 1806, and annexed by Prussia in 1816.
zh: 维特根斯坦伯国是绍尔兰林区的一个小领地，统治家族是以上拉恩河畔的维特根斯坦城堡得名的帝国伯爵家族。1174年，伯爵维尔纳一世率先以该城堡自称；1238年家族分家，西格弗里德一世分得维特根斯坦领地，拉斯费镇在城堡脚下兴起。1337年统治伯国的仍是维尔纳的后裔，但该家族男嗣于1359年断绝：女继承人阿德尔海德已于1345年嫁给塞恩-洪堡伯爵萨伦廷，他们的继承人把两块领地合并为塞恩-维特根斯坦伯国。此后领地多次在以贝勒堡为中心的北部和以拉斯费为中心的南部之间划分，1607年正式分封为塞恩-维特根斯坦-贝勒堡、塞恩-维特根斯坦-塞恩和塞恩-维特根斯坦-维特根斯坦三个伯国。贝勒堡一系于1792年升为侯国，1806年被并入黑森大公国，1816年为普鲁士所吞并。

en:
Wetzlar was a Free Imperial City on the river Lahn in the Wetterau, grown up around a collegiate church founded under the Conradines in the early tenth century. Emperor Frederick I Barbarossa set up an imperial bailiwick there and in 1180 placed its citizens on the same footing as those of Frankfurt; the imperial castle of Kalsmunt housed a mint, and the town throve on ironworking, wool weaving and the trade road crossing the Lahn. Around the middle of the fourteenth century, when it held perhaps six thousand inhabitants, Wetzlar stood at the height of its medieval prosperity.

Long feuds with the counts of Solms, who sought to make it their own, drove the city into debt; in 1387 it fell under forced administration and joined the Swabian League of Towns. By the end of the Thirty Years' War its population had shrunk to about fifteen hundred. Its fame came late: in 1689 the Empire's supreme court, the Reichskammergericht, was moved from war-ravaged Speyer to Wetzlar, making the small town one of the Holy Roman Empire's judicial capitals alongside Vienna and Regensburg. Johann Wolfgang von Goethe served there as a legal trainee in 1772 and set The Sorrows of Young Werther in the town. The city lost its imperial freedom to Karl von Dalberg in 1803, the court was dissolved with the Empire in 1806, and the Congress of Vienna assigned Wetzlar to Prussia in 1815.
zh:
韦茨拉尔是韦特劳地区兰河畔的一座帝国自由城市，围绕10世纪初康拉丁家族建立的修道院教堂发展起来。皇帝腓特烈一世·巴巴罗萨在此设立帝国辖区，并于1180年赋予其市民与法兰克福市民同等的地位；帝国的卡尔斯蒙特城堡设有铸币厂，城镇凭借冶铁、毛纺和横跨兰河的商路繁荣起来。14世纪中叶，韦茨拉尔约有六千居民，正处于中世纪繁荣的顶点。

与企图吞并它的索尔姆斯伯爵家族长期争斗，使城市债台高筑；1387年它被迫接受强制管理，并加入士瓦本城市同盟。到三十年战争结束时，其人口已萎缩到约一千五百。它的盛名来得很晚：1689年，帝国最高法院帝国枢密法院从遭战火蹂躏的施派尔迁至韦茨拉尔，使这座小城与维也纳、雷根斯堡并列为神圣罗马帝国的司法之都。1772年，约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德在此任法律实习生，并把《少年维特之烦恼》的故事安排在这座城镇。1803年，韦茨拉尔的帝国自由地位被卡尔·冯·达尔贝格剥夺，1806年法院随帝国一同解散，1815年维也纳会议将它划归普鲁士。

en: Muna, also called Wuna, was the kingdom of the Muna people on Muna Island off the southeast coast of Sulawesi. Local tradition dates its foundation to around 1210, when eight earlier villages bound themselves into a single polity with its capital at Kotano Wuna, and names La Eli, titled Bheteno ne Tombula, as its first king, a ruler legend marries to a sister of the La Galigo hero Sawerigading. Later kings ruled with the title Sugi, and the fifth of them, Sugi Manuru, who reigned from 1501 to 1517, is remembered as a great reformer. His son Lakilaponto fortified the capital before crossing to Buton in 1520, where as La Kilaponto he converted to Islam and ruled as Sultan Murhum, the first sultan of Buton; Muna itself became a Muslim kingdom under his successors and took its place as one of the Four Barata, the guardian kingdoms that supported and defended the Sultanate of Buton alongside Tiworo, Kalisusu and Kaledupa. In the late 1700s a succession dispute over marriage custom grew into a civil war: with help from Buton and Tiworo the rebel princess Wa Ode Kadingke overthrew King La Ode Sumaeli, who was executed by the royal council, and her young son La Ode Saete was placed on the throne under a regent.
zh: 穆纳（又称武纳）是穆纳人的王国，位于苏拉威西东南近海的穆纳岛。当地传说把建国时间定在约1210年：早先的八个村庄结成一个政权，定都科塔诺武纳，并拥立拉·埃利（称号 Bheteno ne Tombula）为初代国王，传说他娶了史诗《拉加利戈》英雄萨韦里加丁的姐妹。此后的君主使用“苏吉”称号，第五位苏吉·马努鲁（1501—1517年在位）被视为大有作为的改革者。他的儿子拉基拉蓬托修筑了环绕王都的堡垒，又于1520年前往布敦，在那里以拉·基拉蓬托之名皈依伊斯兰教，成为布敦第一代苏丹穆尔胡姆；穆纳本身也在后继君主治下成为伊斯兰王国，并位列“四大巴拉塔”之一，与蒂沃罗、卡利苏苏、卡莱杜帕共同辅佐和拱卫布敦苏丹国。1700年代末，一场围绕婚姻习俗的争端演变为内战：叛乱公主瓦·奥德·卡丁克在布敦和蒂沃罗援助下推翻国王拉·奥德·苏迈利，国王被王室会议处死，她年幼的儿子拉·奥德·萨埃特在摄政辅佐下登上王位。

en: The County of Württemberg, with its capital at Stuttgart, grew from a Swabian lordship first recorded in 1081, whose lords were raised to counts in the twelfth century. After the fall of the Hohenstaufen in 1250 the counts expanded across the old Duchy of Swabia, and Stuttgart entered their domains through marriage in 1251. In 1337 the county was ruled by Count Ulrich III. Through betrothal and inheritance it acquired the County of Montbéliard in 1397, but the Treaty of Nürtingen of 1442 split Württemberg into Stuttgart and Urach lines; the Treaties of Münsingen (1482) and Esslingen (1492) reunited it under Eberhard V, who was raised to duke at the Diet of Worms in 1495. Duke Ulrich was driven out by the Swabian League in 1519 and the duchy was sold to Emperor Charles V, but he was restored in 1534 with Hessian help and introduced the Protestant Reformation. Hard hit by the wars of the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, Württemberg was nevertheless made an electorate in 1803 and a kingdom in 1806.
zh: 符腾堡伯国以斯图加特为中心，起家于1081年首次见于记载的施瓦本贵族领地，其领主在12世纪升为伯爵。1250年霍亨斯陶芬家族倒台后，伯爵们在旧施瓦本公国的土地上扩张，斯图加特也于1251年因联姻并入领地。1337年在位的是乌尔里希三世伯爵。1397年，符腾堡通过婚约和继承取得蒙贝利亚尔伯国；1442年的《尼尔廷根条约》把符腾堡分为斯图加特和乌拉赫两支，1482年与1492年的《明辛根条约》和《埃斯林根条约》又在埃伯哈德五世治下重新统一，他于1495年在沃尔姆斯帝国议会上被擢升为公爵。公爵乌尔里希于1519年被施瓦本同盟驱逐，公国被卖给皇帝查理五世；1534年他在黑森帮助下复位，并引入新教改革。尽管在17、18世纪的战争中屡遭兵燹，符腾堡仍于1803年升为选侯国，1806年成为王国。

en: Wuyewu was a Jurchen polity whose seat, Girin Ula, stood on the middle Songhua at the site of present-day Jilin City. The surrounding country became the homeland of the Ula clan, one of the Four Hulun of the Haixi Jurchens, which held out against Nurhaci until he incorporated Ula into his confederation in 1613.
zh: 兀也吾是以吉林乌拉为治所的女真政权，城址位于松花江中流，即今吉林市一带。这一地区后来成为海西女真扈伦四部之一乌拉部的故土；乌拉部与努尔哈赤相抗，最终于1613年被并入他的联盟。

en: Wuzhai was a Miao tusi in the Wuling mountains, centred on Zhen'gan, the site of present-day Fenghuang in western Hunan, and within the fourteenth-century reach of the Sizhou chiefdom. Under the Ming it was the Wuzhai zhangguansi under the Baojing pacification commission, until the Qing replaced it with circulating officials in 1704.
zh: 五寨是武陵山区的苗族土司，治所镇筸即今湖南西部的凤凰县城，14世纪时处在思州土司的势力范围之内。明代为五寨长官司，隶属保靖宣慰使司，至1704年被清朝改土归流，改派流官治理。

en: Xalisco, whose Nahuatl name means place over the sandy ground, was a Nahua señorío, or tlatonazgo, on the Pacific slope of western Mexico, centred on the town of Xalisco on the slopes of Cerro del Coatépec above the Matatipac valley in what is now Nayarit. Its rulers, recorded as early as Xiuhcohuatl around 618, governed a mixed population of Pinome Nahuas together with Coras, Huicholes and other peoples; unlike most Mesoamerican states, women as well as men could hold power. Its farmers worked terraced fields of maize, beans, squash and cotton, and its merchants traded with central Mexico, while the kingdom bordered Aztatlán and Chiametla to the north. The last ruler, Pupualtzin, reigned from 1516 until the campaigns of Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán overran western Mexico and the kingdom was extinguished in 1532, its lands folded into the new Spanish province of Nueva Galicia.
zh: 哈利斯科在纳瓦特尔语中意为沙地上的地方，是墨西哥西部太平洋坡地的纳瓦人酋邦，中心为哈利斯科镇，坐落在今纳亚里特州马塔蒂帕克谷地之上的科阿特佩克山坡。早在约618年，休科瓦特尔便是见载的统治者；治下人口以皮诺梅纳瓦人为主，还有科拉人、维乔尔人等；与多数美索美洲政权不同，女性和男性同样可以掌权。农民在梯田上种植玉米、菜豆、南瓜和棉花，商人与墨西哥中部贸易，北邻阿兹塔特兰和查梅特兰两王国。末代统治者普普阿尔钦于1516年即位；努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼的西征席卷墨西哥西部，王国于1532年灭亡，土地被并入西班牙新设的新加利西亚省。

en: Xalapan was the Nahuatl name, meaning spring in the sand, for the polity centred on Xalapa, beneath the Macuiltepetl volcano in the Veracruz highlands on the road from the Gulf coast to the Mexican plateau. Totonacs first settled the hill, and in the fourteenth century four peoples dwelt there in separate villages: Totonacs at Xalitic, Toltecs at Tecuanapan and Teochichimecs at Tlalnecapan. Around 1313 these villages fused into the single town of Xallapan. In the second half of the fifteenth century the Aztec emperor Moctezuma Ilhuicamina invaded and incorporated the district into his empire, and in 1519 Hernán Cortés passed through on his march to Tenochtitlan. Franciscan friars completed their convent there in 1555; the town grew as a market for local medicinal plants and was formally declared a town by Charles IV in 1791.
zh: 哈拉潘是纳瓦特尔语地名，意为“沙中的泉水”，指以哈拉帕为中心的小邦，坐落在韦拉克鲁斯高地、马奎尔特佩特火山脚下，扼守着从墨西哥湾沿岸通往墨西哥高原的道路。托托纳克人最早在这座山丘定居，14世纪时有四个族群分村而居：托托纳克人住在哈利蒂克，托尔特克人住在特夸纳潘，特奥奇奇梅卡人住在特拉尔内卡潘。约1313年，这些村落合并为一座名叫哈拉潘的城镇。15世纪下半叶，阿兹特克皇帝蒙特苏马·伊尔维卡米纳入侵此地，将其并入帝国；1519年，埃尔南·科尔特斯在进军特诺奇蒂特兰途中经过这里。方济各会修士于1555年建成修道院；此后该镇作为当地药用植物的贸易集市逐渐兴盛，并于1791年被卡洛斯四世正式册封为城镇。

en: Xincheng was a Zhuang native county on the middle Hongshui River in central Guangxi, covering present-day Xincheng County in Laibin. A county had existed there since the Tang, and under the Ming it became a native county entrusted to a hereditary chieftain of the Mo clan, one of the tusi supervised by Qingyuan Prefecture. In 1582 the eighth Mo chief, Mo Zhenwei, built his yamen at the foot of Cuiping Mountain, its halls, ancestral shrines and family mansions arranged along a central axis; it remained the seat of Mo chiefs governing their Zhuang subjects through the rest of the Ming and the whole Qing period.
zh: 忻城是广西中部红水河中游的壮族土县，辖境在今来宾市忻城县一带。唐代已置忻城县，明代改为土县，由莫氏首领世袭知县，是庆远府统辖的土司之一。万历十年（1582年），第八代土官莫镇威在翠屏山北麓修建土司衙署，大堂、祠堂和官族府第沿中轴线排布，在明末和整个清代一直是莫氏治理境内壮族部民的统治中枢。

en: Xochimilco, meaning flower field in Nahuatl, was a Nahua altepetl on the southern shore of the lake of the same name in the Valley of Mexico, whose Xochimilca farmers were credited with perfecting the chinampa system of floating gardens that made the shallow lakes extraordinarily productive. Tradition dates the city to 919, and in its heyday it dominated the neighboring lakeside towns of Mixquic, Tlahuac and Culhuacan and raided as far as the lands that became Morelos. From 1335 to 1347 it was ruled by a woman, the tlatoani Tlazocihualpilli, and in 1352 the ruler Caxtoltzin moved the town from the mainland onto the island of Tlilan. In 1376 an attack by Tenochtitlan was beaten off only with help from Azcapotzalco, to which Xochimilco then had to pay tribute, but in 1430 the Mexica under Itzcoatl conquered the city outright and linked it to Tenochtitlan with a great causeway. Xochimilco's canoemen and farmers then served the Aztec Empire in its campaigns toward Cuauhnahuac, Metztitlan and Oaxaca, and Ahuitzotl later granted the city limited autonomy in exchange for tribute; its chinampa produce fed the island capital until Spanish times and long afterward.
zh: 霍奇米尔科在纳瓦特尔语中意为花田，是墨西哥谷地南部同名湖岸上的一个纳瓦人阿尔特佩特尔；当地的霍奇米尔科农民以完善奇南帕浮动园地农业而闻名，这种技术使浅水湖区产出极高。传统说法将建城时间定在919年，鼎盛时期它控制着米斯基克、特拉瓦克、库尔瓦坎等邻近湖镇，兵锋远达后来的莫雷洛斯一带。1335年至1347年，这里由一位女性特拉托阿尼特拉索西瓦皮尔皮利统治；1352年，统治者卡克斯托尔钦把城址从大陆迁到特利兰岛上。1376年特诺奇蒂特兰来攻，霍奇米尔科靠阿斯卡波特萨尔科援救才得以解围，此后却不得不向后者纳贡；1430年，伊兹科阿特尔麾下的墨西加人最终征服该城，并修建一条长堤把它与特诺奇蒂特兰相连。此后霍奇米尔科的舟师和农夫随阿兹特克帝国出征夸乌纳瓦克、梅茨蒂特兰和瓦哈卡，阿维索特尔后来以纳贡为条件授予该城有限自治；直到西班牙人到来之后很久，它的奇南帕农产品仍供应着这座湖都。

en: Xochiapan was centred on Xochiapa, a Nahuatl name meaning place of flowers, a Zapotec town in the hot Papaloapan lowlands of southern Veracruz.
