In prehispanic times it was a subject town of the neighbouring state of Guaspaltepec, possibly within the Aztec tributary sphere, until Sandoval's campaigns of the early 1520s brought the basin under Spanish rule.
zh: 霍奇阿潘以索奇亚帕为中心，索奇亚帕的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“鲜花之地”，是今韦拉克鲁斯州南部炎热的帕帕洛阿潘低地上的萨波特克人城镇。前西班牙时代，它是邻近古国瓜斯帕特佩克的属镇之一，后者可能已处于阿兹特克的贡赋体系之内；16世纪20年代初，桑多瓦尔的征战使帕帕洛阿潘诸镇归入西班牙统治。

en: Xochitepec, the flowery hill in Nahuatl, was a Tecuexe community in the Valles region of western Jalisco, standing on two islands in a lagoon that has since been drained; the Spaniards later renamed the settlement Magdalena. At contact it belonged to the senorio of Etzatlan and was ruled by the cacique Goaxicar. Francisco Cortes de San Buenaventura received its submission in 1524, and Cristobal de Onate entered it for Nuno de Guzman in 1530; Franciscans founded the convent of the Purisima Concepcion nearby in 1534. Goaxicar rose against the newcomers in 1538 and was put down, then joined the Mixton War of 1541 alongside the peoples of Tequila, Ameca and Ahualulco. After a storm wrecked the island villages, the survivors moved to the shore, where the church of Santa Maria Magdalena gave the town its later name.
zh: 霍奇特佩克在纳瓦特尔语中意为“花之山”，是哈利斯科西部巴列斯地区的一个特库埃克人聚落，坐落于一座后来干涸的潟湖中的两座岛上，西班牙人后来把它改名为马格达莱纳。接触之初，它隶属埃察特兰领地，由酋长戈阿奇卡尔统治。1524年弗朗西斯科·科尔特斯·德·圣布埃纳文图拉接受其归降，1530年克里斯托瓦尔·德·奥尼亚特代表努尼奥·德·古斯曼进入此地；1534年方济各会在附近建起至圣受孕修道院。戈阿奇卡尔于1538年举兵反抗、被镇压后，又在1541年的米斯特顿战争中联合特基拉、阿梅卡和阿瓦卢尔科等地的原住民再战。一场风暴摧毁岛上村落后，幸存者迁往湖岸，当地的圣玛利亚·马格达莱纳教堂后来成了城镇新名字的来源。

en: Xicochimalco, a Nahuatl name meaning the nest of the bumblebee, was a fortified hill town on the wooded slopes of the Cofre de Perote in central Veracruz, the place now called Xico. Totonac villagers had lived there since the ninth century BCE, and in 1454 a large body of Mexica settlers arrived from the famine-stricken plateau, leaving remains on the Yoctipac hill. The town grew into a strong subject lordship of Moctezuma: Hernán Cortés, who passed through in 1519, described in his second letter a steep stronghold entered only by a stairway pass, ringed by villages able to field five or six thousand warriors. Epidemics after the conquest emptied much of the district, and a painted land lienzo of 1600 records how its surviving people were regrouped into colonial congregations.
zh: 希科奇马尔科的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“熊蜂之巢”，是韦拉克鲁斯中部科弗雷德佩罗特山林间的一座设防山城，即后来的希科。早在公元前9世纪，托托纳克村民便已在此居住；1454年，大批墨西卡人为躲避高原旱涝引发的饥荒迁来，在约克蒂帕克山上留下了遗迹。该城后来成为蒙特苏马麾下一处坚固的附庸领地：1519年途经此地的埃尔南·科尔特斯在《第二次奏陈信》中描写道，这是一座只有一条石阶通道可入的险峻要塞，周围村落能出动五六千名战士。征服后的疫病使该地区人口大量损失，1600年的一幅彩绘土地图记录了幸存居民被并入殖民集居村的过程。

en: Xiuhtlan was the small polity centred on Xihutla, the native name of the Banderas valley on the coast of what is now Jalisco, explained in the Relación de Compostela of 1584 as the place where grass grows. Its valley had held settled villages since about 300 BC and was occupied in turn by Aztatlán peoples and, in the Late Postclassic, by the Banderas culture. In March 1525 Francisco Cortés de San Buenaventura reached the village of Tintoque, where more than twenty thousand armed Indians bearing feather banners faced him before submitting; the banners gave the valley its Spanish name of Banderas.
zh: 修特兰是以希乌特拉为中心的小邦，希乌特拉是今哈利斯科沿岸班德拉斯谷地的土著名称，1584年的《孔波斯特拉纪事》解释它意为长草之地。谷地内约公元前300年就已有定居村落，此后先有阿兹塔特兰人迁入，后古典期晚期又为班德拉斯文化人群所居。1525年3月，弗朗西斯科·科尔特斯·德·圣布埃纳文图拉抵达廷托克村，两万多名手持羽毛小旗的武装土著列阵相对，最终不战而降；这些旗帜使谷地得到西班牙名班德拉斯，意为旗帜。

en: Xilotepec, hill of the tender corn in Nahuatl, was the capital of a large Otomi senorio on the northern rim of the Valley of Mexico, whose subject towns stretched from present-day Estado de Mexico into southern Queretaro and Hidalgo, including Huichapan, Nopala and Zimapan. Farming Otomi made up most of its population alongside Chichimeca groups, and in 1337 it was still an independent mountain power guarding the routes toward the Chichimeca north. Tenochtitlan first conquered it in 1379 under Acamapichtli, but its people fought their way back to autonomy; Axayacatl invaded again and Ahuitzotl finally completed the Mexica conquest in 1487, ruling the Queretaro country through Xilotepec as a bulwark against the northern nomads. During the Spanish invasion the lord of Xilotepec and his kinsman Conin sided with Hernan Cortes, and in 1531 Conin, baptized Hernando de Tapia, led the founding of the Spanish city of Santiago de Queretaro.
zh: 希洛特佩克在纳瓦特尔语中意为嫩玉米之山，是墨西哥谷地北缘一个强大奥托米酋长国的都城，其属镇从今墨西哥州一带一直延伸到克雷塔罗州南部和伊达尔戈州，包括维查潘、诺帕拉和锡马潘等地。务农的奥托米人是其主要居民，另有奇奇梅卡族群杂处；1337年时它仍是一个独立的山地强权，扼守着通往北方奇奇梅卡草原的道路。特诺奇蒂特兰曾在1379年由阿卡马皮奇特利首次征服它，但当地人奋战恢复了自治；阿萨亚卡特尔再度入侵，阿维索特尔最终于1487年完成墨西加征服，把克雷塔罗一带作为抵御北方游牧民的屏障，经由希洛特佩克管辖。西班牙入侵时，希洛特佩克之主与他的族人科宁倒向埃尔南·科尔特斯；1531年，受洗后改名埃尔南多·德·塔皮亚的科宁主持建立了西班牙城市圣地亚哥-德克雷塔罗。

en: Tutul-Xiu was the chiefdom of the Xiu lineage, whose capital after the thirteenth century was the ancient city of Maní in central Yucatán. The Xiu were the first masters of Mayapan, dominating the league's capital from about 1180 to 1280, before the rival Cocom and their Canul mercenaries took power around 1300 and drove many Xiu out of the city around 1400. In 1441 Ah Xiu Xupan led the revolt that slaughtered the Cocom household and destroyed Mayapan; when Yucatán fragmented into eighteen petty kingdoms, the Xiu made Maní their capital and became the strongest power in the west. Maní had long been the peninsula's main pilgrimage center of Kukulcán, home of the annual chic kaban festival until 1341. At the Spanish invasion the Xiu chose alliance rather than war: their ambassadors were massacred by Nachi Cocom at Otzmal in 1536, and Xiu troops fought beside Francisco de Montejo at the fall of T'ho in 1542. The price of submission came in 1562, when Friar Diego de Landa held his auto-da-fé at Maní and burned the Maya hieroglyphic books kept there.
zh: 图图尔休是休族的城邦，13世纪以后以尤卡坦中部古城马尼为都。休人是玛雅潘最早的主人，约1180—1280年间主宰这座联盟都城，后来敌对的科科姆家族凭借卡努尔雇佣兵在1300年前后夺权，又于1400年左右把大批休人逐出城外。1441年，阿·休·舒潘率众起事，屠灭科科姆全族并摧毁玛雅潘；尤卡坦碎成十八个小邦后，休人以马尼为都，成为西部最强的势力。马尼早先是半岛上库库尔坎信仰的主要朝圣中心，一年一度的奇克卡班节一直持续到1341年。西班牙人入侵时，休人选择结盟而非开战：1536年他们的使节在奥斯马尔被纳奇·科科姆屠杀，1542年休族军队又与弗朗西斯科·德·蒙特霍并肩攻下特奥。臣服的代价在1562年到来——修士迭戈·德·兰达在马尼举行宗教审判仪式，焚毁了收藏于此的玛雅象形文字手抄本。

en: Xianlong is the native country of the Bacui, a Luoluo Yi tribe of the Anning River valley in southern Sichuan, in the hill country of present-day Miyi on the border of Dechang. The Bacui comprised three sub-tribes, the Shawapuzong, Wujinizu and Wanuolongchangpu, whom the Yuan administration combined into a single department in 1278. Under the Ming the territory was attached to Dechang Prefecture in 1382, and its chief Puxi travelled to court in 1391 to present horses and local goods. The department was reorganised as a chief's office in 1399, restored to department status after the Jingnan war, and then fixed as the Weilong Chief's Office in 1404. Hereditary native chiefs continued to rule it under the Qing, when it formed part of Xichang County in Ningyuan Prefecture.
zh: 仙龙是巴翠部的故土，巴翠部是川西南安宁河谷的罗罗（彝族）部落，地在今米易与德昌交界一带，下辖沙娲普宗、乌鸡泥祖、娲诺龙菖蒲三个小部。1278年元朝把三部合并，立为威龙州。1382年明朝将其划归德昌府，1391年知州普习还曾入朝进贡马匹和地方物产。1399年威龙州改置为长官司，靖难之役后一度恢复州制，1404年再改为威龙长官司。清代其地属四川宁远府西昌县，世袭土官仍以威龙州长官司的名号统治。

en: Xllang was the kingdom of the Sican or Lambayeque people, who from about 750 held the La Leche and Lambayeque river valleys of Peru's north coast as heirs to the older Moche culture. The Middle Sican centuries of 900 to 1100 saw its florescence at Batán Grande, whose rulers were buried in gold-rich tombs with their retinues; Sican smiths mastered tumbaga alloys, the ceremonial tumi knife and vast irrigation canals, and traded Spondylus shells and emeralds from Ecuador and Colombia. Foundation legends collected by the chronicler Cabello Valboa tell of Naylamp, who landed from a fleet of balsa rafts carrying a green-stone idol named Yampallec and founded a dynasty of twelve kings at Chot. After El Niño floods and droughts weakened the late kingdom, the Chimú ruler Chimú Cápac overran it around 1375 and carried its goldsmiths south; with Chimor it passed to the Inca around 1470.
zh: 什扬是西坎人，又称兰巴耶克人的王国，他们约从750年起占据今秘鲁北部沿海的拉莱切河与兰巴耶克河流域，是更早的莫切文化的继承者。900至1100年的中西坎时期是它的鼎盛阶段，中心在巴坦格兰，统治者带着丰厚金器和随从入葬；西坎工匠精通铜金合金、典礼用的图米刀和庞大的灌溉渠网，并用海菊蛤贝壳、祖母绿同厄瓜多尔和哥伦比亚贸易。编年史家卡韦略·巴尔沃亚记录的开国传说讲到，纳扬普率巴尔萨木筏船队登陆，携来一尊名为扬帕列克的绿石神像，在乔特建立了传位十二王的王朝。厄尔尼诺带来的洪水与旱灾削弱了晚期王国，约1375年奇穆君主奇穆·卡帕克将其征服，把金匠掳往南方；约1470年它又随奇穆一同并入印加。

en: Xalostotitlan was an independent señorío of the Los Altos highlands, ruled by families of mixed Tecuexe and Caxcan stock, who had made the towns of Teocaltitlan, Temacapulin and Atonayalco their tributaries. From 1164 onwards its warriors withstood the raids of the migrating Mexica, who lingered at nearby Teocaltiche for some forty years before moving on toward the Valley of Mexico. In August 1530 the captain Pedro Almíndez Chirino, marching under Nuño de Guzmán, accepted the submission of its local chiefs, but the town rose again in 1541 as one of the first to join Tenamaxtli's Mixtón rebellion: its people burned the missionary chapel and withdrew to the hills above Nochistlan. After the defeat the viceroy Antonio de Mendoza spared the survivors, and in 1544 the friar Miguel de Bolonia refounded the town as Jalostotitlan.
zh: 沙洛斯托蒂特兰是阿尔托斯高原上的一个独立小邦，统治者出自特库埃克与卡什坎混血的家族，并征服了特奥卡尔蒂特兰、特马卡普林和阿托纳亚尔科等城镇，令它们纳贡。从1164年起，当地武士多次抵挡住迁徙中墨西加人的进攻；墨西加人在附近的特奥卡尔蒂切停留了约四十年，才继续向墨西哥谷地进发。1530年8月，奉努尼奥·德·古斯曼之命进军的佩德罗·阿尔门德斯·奇里诺接受了当地酋长的归降，但1541年此地再度举事，是最早响应特尼亚马孙特尔、投身米斯特翁叛乱的城镇之一：居民烧毁传教士的小教堂，退入诺奇斯特兰上方的山中。叛乱失败后，总督安东尼奥·德·门多萨赦免了幸存者；1544年，修士米格尔·德·博洛尼亚在原址重建城镇，命名为哈洛斯托蒂特兰。

en: Xianning was a Miao chieftaincy seated at Weiqing, west of Guiyang in present-day Qingzhen, Guizhou. The Ming court brought the area under direct military rule by creating the Weiqing Guard in 1390, part of the Guizhou regional military commission.
zh: 咸宁是以威清为治所的苗人土司，位于今贵州清镇市、贵阳以西。1390年明朝置威清卫，隶贵州都司，将这一地区纳入卫所军事体制。

en: Xinlong, centred on Huangping, was the Bozhou chiefdom's Huangping domain: the Yuan created Huangping Prefecture there in 1291, the Ming made it the Huangping anfusi in 1374, and the Xinglong Guard was later stationed at the same walled town, giving the office its name. In 1601 it became Huangping Zhou under Pingyue Prefecture.
zh: 兴隆土司以黄平为治所，实为播州属下的黄平之地：元朝于1291年设置黄平府，明朝1374年改置黄平安抚司，后来又在同城派驻兴隆卫，兴隆之名即由此而来。1601年改置黄平州，隶属平越府。

en: Xochipillan, the Caxcan name for the kingdom later called Juchipila, was the largest of the Caxcan city-states that grew up in the mountain valleys of what is now southern Zacatecas. Caxcan settlers began arriving in the tenth century, founding many small altepetl, and by the fifteenth century Xochipillan had absorbed its rivals and stretched from Mecatabasco in the north to Moyahua in the south, bordering the Zacatecos, the Tecuexe and the fellow Caxcan kingdoms of Nochistlan and Tlaltenango; its markets made it the commercial power of the region. Nuño de Guzmán's Tlaxcaltec army broke its defences in 1530 after overrunning Nochistlan, and its last ruler, Xiutecutli, was again defeated in the Mixtón War of 1541 by the viceroy Antonio de Mendoza. The towns lay in ruins and the survivors had fled to the sierra, until the Franciscans Antonio de Segovia and Miguel de Bolonia interceded and, on 20 January 1542, gathered some six thousand Caxcanes to refound the town as Juchipila.
zh: 索奇皮尔兰是卡什坎人对这个王国的称呼，后来它被称为胡奇皮拉，也是在今萨卡特卡斯州南部山谷中兴起的诸卡什坎城邦里最大的一个。卡什坎人从10世纪起迁入此地，建立了许多小型阿尔特佩特利；到15世纪，索奇皮尔兰吞并诸邻，疆域北起梅卡塔巴斯科、南抵莫亚瓦，与萨卡特科人、特库埃克人以及同属卡什坎的诺奇斯特兰、特拉尔特南戈两王国接壤，其集市之盛使它成为该地区的商业强权。1530年，努尼奥·德·古斯曼麾下的特拉斯卡拉军队在攻陷诺奇斯特兰后击破了它的防线；末代君主休特库特利又在1541年的米斯特翁战争中被总督安东尼奥·德·门多萨击败。城镇沦为废墟，幸存者逃入深山，直到方济各会修士安东尼奥·德·塞戈维亚和米格尔·德·博洛尼亚出面求情，于1542年1月20日聚集约六千名卡什坎幸存者，重建城镇并命名为胡奇皮拉。

en: The Ch'ol are a Maya people of the northern Chiapas highlands and the Gulf-facing lowlands beyond them, who call their language Lak ty'añ, or our speech, in its Tilá, Tumbalá and Sabanilla branches. Their country embraces the valley of the Usumacinta and the ruins of Lakamha, the great Classic city-state better known as Palenque, whose kings K'uk' Bahlam and Pakal the Great raised its temples between the fifth and eighth centuries before the city was abandoned to the jungle. In the sixteenth century the Ch'ol held out in the forests until Spanish campaigns from 1554 onward broke the communities of the Lacandon jungle, and the reducciones of the later 1550s resettled them at Palenque, Tilá and Tumbalá. They were then put to work on encomiendas, until royal cédulas later granted them the lands their families had farmed for generations.
zh: 乔尔人是居住在恰帕斯北部高地及其面向墨西哥湾低地的玛雅民族，他们把自己的语言称作拉克蒂扬，意为“我们的话”，下分蒂拉、通巴拉和萨瓦尼利亚三支。他们的土地涵盖乌苏马辛塔河流域，以及拉坎姆哈的废墟，也就是古典期的伟大城邦帕伦克；5至8世纪间，库克·巴拉姆和巴加尔大帝等国王在此修建神庙，后来城市被遗弃，湮没于丛林。16世纪，乔尔人在森林中坚守，直到1554年起西班牙人的攻势击破拉坎东丛林中的社群，1550年代后期的集合安置把他们迁往帕伦克、蒂拉和通巴拉。他们随后被迫在监护征赋制下劳作，后来王室颁发敕令，将其家族世代耕种的土地授予他们。

en: Xisanyang was a Kam native chieftaincy in the steep Duliu River hills of southeastern Guizhou, its seat at Dingshang in the Xishan valley of present-day Congjiang County. Under the Mongol Yuan the country was recorded as the Xishan great dong and governed through the Tian family of Sizhou. The Ming set up the Xishan Yangdong native long commandery in 1407 and attached it to Liping Prefecture in 1414, together with the neighbouring Fulu-Yongcong commandery. It survived the conversion of its neighbour into Yongcong County in 1441 and kept its hereditary chiefs until the Qing abolished the commandery in 1693. Further down the river, Xiajiang became the seat of a Qing sub-prefecture in 1771.
zh: 西山阳是贵州东南都柳江深山里的侗族土司，治所在今从江县西山镇顶洞村。元代这里称西山大洞，由思州田氏统辖。1407年，明朝设置西山阳洞长官司，1414年与相邻的福禄永从司一同划归黎平府。1441年福禄永从改置永从县时，西山阳洞司保留下来，世袭土司一直延续到1693年才被清朝裁废。其地沿河而下的下江，后来在1771年置下江厅，成为清朝治理这片山区的据点。

en: Yahualican was a Tecuexe chiefdom in the Altos highlands of northeastern Jalisco, its Nahuatl name usually read as house of fog. Around 1165 its people fought bloody battles to keep Aztec armies out of their valley and held their ground. On the eve of the Spanish arrival the chiefdom was governed by a woman, a cacica praised in early colonial accounts for her skill in ruling; when Cristóbal de Oñate, Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán's captain, reached Yahualican in April 1530 its people came out peacefully with gifts of fruit and game, and the town submitted without a siege. It became an encomienda within the new province of Nueva Galicia, and a parish church was raised there from 1542. The rugged pass above the town was later remembered as the spot where Pedro de Alvarado took the fall in 1541 that led to his death during the Mixtón War.
zh: 亚瓦利坎是哈利斯科东北部阿尔托斯高地的特奎谢人酋邦，其纳瓦特尔语名字通常被解释为雾之屋。约1165年，当地人与试图夺取亚瓦利坎的阿兹特克军队血战，最终守住了谷地。西班牙人到来前夕，执掌酋邦的是一位女性首领，早期殖民记载称赞她善于治国；1530年4月，努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼的将领克里斯托瓦尔·德·奥尼亚特抵达亚瓦利坎，居民带着水果和猎物和平出迎，城镇未经围攻便归降。它随后成为新加利西亚省监护制下的封邑，1542年起在当地修建教区教堂。镇外险峻的隘口后来也载入米斯通战争的史册：1541年，佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多在此坠马，最终伤重身亡。

en: The Yam, or Banu Yam, are a Qahtanite Arab tribe of the Banu Hamdan, native to the highland oasis of Najran on the Yemeni frontier and already named in the ancient South Arabian Musnad inscriptions, where their line runs back through Hamdan and Kahlan to the Sabaeans. In Islamic times they were known as the Yam al-Qura, the Yam of the villages, though the Empty Quarter at their door also gave them one of the largest bedouin sections of the southwest, and two great eastern tribes, the Sunni Al Murrah and Ajman, are Yam offshoots. The Najran Yam themselves follow the Sulaymani branch of Ismaili Shia Islam. The Sulaymani community took shape in 1592, and from 1677 its da'is, drawn from the Makrami family and seated at Badr in Najran, ruled the oasis with Yam backing; their power peaked under Isma'il ibn Hibat Allah from 1747 to 1770, who defeated the Wahhabis in the Najd and even invaded Hadhramawt. Yam raiders themselves pushed north as far as Dhruma near Riyadh in 1775, spreading alarm through the first Saudi state before its later counter-expansion.
zh: 亚姆（巴努·亚姆）是属巴努·哈姆丹的盖哈坦系阿拉伯部落，世居也门边境的高地绿洲奈季兰，古代南阿拉伯的穆斯奈德铭文里已有其名，谱系经哈姆丹、凯赫兰一直上溯到赛伯伊人。伊斯兰时代他们被称为“村落之亚姆”，但家门口就是空旷之地大沙漠，这使他们同时拥有西南阿拉伯最庞大的贝都因支系之一；东部两大逊尼派部落穆拉和阿治曼都是从亚姆分出的支系。奈季兰的亚姆本支则信奉伊斯玛仪什叶派的苏莱曼尼支派。该派形成于1592年；自1677年起，出自迈克拉米家族的传教道长驻奈季兰的巴德尔，在亚姆支持下统治这片绿洲，其势力在1747年至1770年伊斯玛仪·本·希卜图拉在位时达到顶峰——他在内志击败瓦哈比势力，甚至发兵攻入哈德拉毛。1775年，亚姆劫掠者更向北深入到利雅得附近的德鲁迈，令第一个沙特国家举国震动。

en: Yao'an was a Bai native prefecture around Yaozhou in central Yunnan, the basin of modern Yao'an and Dayao. The Tang founded Yaozhou there in 621 and made it the seat of a protectorate governing thirteen loose-rein prefectures, a gateway to the peoples of the southwest. Its hereditary Gao chiefs traced their line to Gao Taixiang, the Dali chancellor executed for resisting the Mongol invasion of 1253; Kublai, admiring his loyalty, enfeoffed his sons at Yao'an, and under the Tianli reign Yaozhou was raised to the Yao'an route under the Gao family. The Ming converted it into Yao'an Prefecture in 1382 and a military-civil prefecture in 1394. The twenty-fourth chief, Gao Wengying, was one of Yunnan's leading Confucian scholars, but in 1729 his grandson Gao Houde was exiled on charges of misconduct and the chiefdom underwent gaitu guiliu after twenty-six generations; the prefecture itself was dissolved in 1770 and attached to Chuxiong.
zh: 姚安是以姚州为中心的白族土府，辖地约当今云南姚安、大姚一带的坝子。621年唐朝在此置姚州，并设姚州都督府统领十三个羁縻州，是沟通西南诸族的要冲。世袭高氏土司是大理国丞相高泰祥的后裔：1253年高泰祥因抵抗蒙古入侵战败被杀，忽必烈赞赏其忠义，封他的儿子高均锦、高均常任姚安同知，姚安土司由此开端；天历年间姚州又升为姚安路，由高氏出任总管。1382年明朝改设姚安府，1394年升为姚安军民府，领姚州和大姚县。第24代土司高奣映是清初云南著名的儒家学者；1729年，其孙高厚德因不法之罪被流放江南，传了26世的姚安土司就此改土归流，姚安府本身也在1770年裁撤，并入楚雄府。

en: Yap is a cluster of four small islands in the western Caroline Islands of Micronesia, joined by coral reefs and mangrove. Around 950 the village of Gatcheper in the Gagil chiefdom built a maritime trade and tribute network, the sawei, that stretched more than 1,300 kilometres east over Ulithi, Woleai and other atolls as far as the western Chuuk group; canoe fleets of the subject islands gathered at Ulithi to carry tribute to Yap. Yapese society was ordered by a ranked caste system of at least seven tiers, and its sailors were among the most celebrated navigators in the Pacific, steering by the stars and ocean swells without compass. They also sailed to Palau to quarry the great limestone disks called rai, the island's stone money, and rafted them home. The first recorded European sighting came with the Spanish expedition of Álvaro de Saavedra in 1528, followed by Ruy López de Villalobos in 1543. A Jesuit mission under Juan Antonio Cantova was destroyed in 1731, after which Spain left the Carolines alone until 1787, so Yap's chiefdoms kept their old order and the tribute network still functioned into the early nineteenth century.
zh: 雅浦是密克罗尼西亚西部加罗林群岛中的一组小岛，由雅浦、加吉尔、马普和鲁蒙四块陆地组成，彼此以珊瑚礁和红树林相连。约950年，加吉尔酋邦的加切佩尔村建立起名为萨韦的海上贸易与朝贡网络，向东绵延1300多公里，涵盖乌利西、沃莱艾等环礁，一直延伸到丘克西部岛群；附庸各岛的独木舟队在乌利西集结，把贡品运往雅浦。雅浦社会实行至少分为七层的等级种姓制度，当地水手则是太平洋上最负盛名的航海者之一，不靠罗盘，仅凭星象和涌浪定向。他们还远航帕劳开采石灰岩巨盘拉伊，即雅浦石币，再用木筏渡海运回。欧洲人最早有记录地看到雅浦是1528年西班牙人萨阿韦德拉的探险队，1543年比亚洛沃斯的船队继之而来。1731年坎托瓦率领的耶稣会传教团被消灭，西班牙此后直到1787年都不再插手加罗林群岛，雅浦诸酋邦的旧秩序和朝贡网络因此一直维系到19世纪初。

en: The Principality of Yaroslavl was a Rus' principality centered on the city of Yaroslavl, on the upper Volga. It took shape in 1218, when the sons of Konstantin Vsevolodovich of Vladimir-Suzdal divided their father's lands and Vsevolod Konstantinovich received the Yaroslavl territory. In 1238 the Mongols sacked the city and killed its prince at the Battle of the Sit River, bringing the principality under the overlordship of the Golden Horde; an uprising against Tatar tribute collectors followed in 1262. Its later prince Fyodor Rostislavich married a daughter of the Horde ruler Mengu-Timur. In 1332 Ivan I of Moscow, acting on the khan's orders, burned Yaroslavl and forced its prince Vasily Davidovich to marry his daughter, drawing the principality into Moscow's orbit. During the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries it fragmented into appanages, and in 1463 the last prince, Aleksandr Bryukhaty, surrendered the succession to Ivan III of Moscow; the annexation was formalized by 1471.
zh: 雅罗斯拉夫尔公国是以伏尔加河上游的雅罗斯拉夫尔城为中心的罗斯公国。1218年，弗拉基米尔-苏兹达尔的康斯坦丁·弗谢沃洛多维奇去世，诸子瓜分领地，弗谢沃洛德·康斯坦丁诺维奇分得雅罗斯拉夫尔一带，公国由此形成。1238年蒙古人洗劫该城，并在锡季河战役中杀死其王公，公国从此受金帐汗国统治；1262年当地又爆发反抗鞑靼包税人的起义。后来的王公费奥多尔·罗斯季斯拉维奇娶了金帐汗忙哥帖木儿的女儿。1332年，莫斯科的伊凡一世奉可汗之命焚毁雅罗斯拉夫尔，强迫王公瓦西里·达维多维奇娶自己的女儿，把公国纳入莫斯科的轨道。14至15世纪，公国分裂为多个封邑；1463年末代王公亚历山大·布鲁哈蒂把继承权交给莫斯科的伊凡三世，吞并于1471年正式完成。

en: The Bani Yas are a large Arab tribal confederation of Najdi origin, descended with the Awamir from Yas ibn Amir ibn Sa'sa'a of the old Banu Amir stock, who carried their herds east into the Gulf country. By around 1700 the leading clan, the Al Bu Falah, had gathered the confederation's clans in the Liwa oasis on the edge of the desert, the country still marked by their island of Sir Bani Yas and the waters around Marawah. The Bani Yas grew into a coalition of about twenty tribes stretching from the Abu Dhabi coast to Dubai and Khor al-Udaid, combining date-growing in the oases with pearling and coastal trade. In 1793 the Al Bu Falah moved to the island of Abu Dhabi after fresh water was found there, and in 1795 they founded the town that became the seat of their emirate, later fortified by the Qasr al-Hosn. In 1822 a related section, the Al Bu Falasah, forebears of the Al Maktoum, took over the trading port of Dubai and set up their own emirate, while in 1835 Bani Yas tribesmen planted a settlement at Khor al-Udaid on the Qatar coast.
zh: 巴尼·亚斯是源自内志的大型阿拉伯部落联盟，与阿瓦米尔人同出古老的巴努·阿米尔谱系，先祖为亚斯·本·阿米尔·本·萨阿萨，后来赶着畜群东迁海湾地区。约1700年，为首的阿勒·布·法拉赫氏族率领联盟各氏族定居于沙漠边缘的利瓦绿洲——锡尔·巴尼·亚斯岛和马拉瓦附近海域，正是他们传统活动范围的标志。巴尼·亚斯后来发展为约二十个部落组成的联盟，地盘从阿布扎比沿海延伸到迪拜和豪尔乌代德，绿洲里种植椰枣，海上则采珠和经商。1793年，阿勒·布·法拉赫人因发现淡水而迁至阿布扎比岛，1795年在岛上建城，此城后来成为其酋长国的都城，并建有豪森堡巩固防务。1822年，同族支系阿勒·布·法拉萨人，即阿勒·马克图姆家族的先祖，夺取贸易港迪拜，建立自己的酋长国；1835年，巴尼·亚斯人又在卡塔尔海岸的豪尔乌代德开辟定居点。

en: Yatenga was the northernmost and most warlike of the Mossi kingdoms, covering the dry country beyond the upper Volta where its cavalry could operate at will. Its ruling line looked back to Rawa, a son of the Mossi founding hero Ouédraogo, who had moved north to Zandana; the province broke away from the Ouagadougou dynasty during the fourteenth century, absorbed the neighbouring state of Zondoma and made its kings, titled naaba, independent rivals of the Mogho Naaba. In 1400 the emperor Bonga raided Masina in the collapsing Mali Empire, and in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries Yatenga reached its peak under Naaba Yadega and his successors, twice seizing Timbuktu and fighting constant wars with Songhai; Sonni Ali died while campaigning against the Mossi, and in 1498 Askia Muhammad inflicted on Yatenga the heaviest defeat in its history. The kingdom kept its ancestral rites and long rejected Islam. After a mid-eighteenth-century collapse of royal authority, Naaba Kango returned from exile in 1757 with Bambana mercenaries carrying the first flintlocks seen in the country, won the civil war, curbed the regional chiefs and founded a new capital at Ouahigouya in 1780. Even the jihad armies of Massina and Sokoto failed to subdue it, though Yatenga's own succession wars had left it weakened by the early nineteenth century.
zh: 亚滕加是莫西诸王国中地处最北、最好战的一个，据有沃尔特河上游以北的干旱地带，骑兵在此纵横自如。其统治世系可追溯到莫西开国英雄韦德拉奥果之子拉瓦，他北上建立赞达纳；14世纪，该行省脱离瓦加杜古王朝，吞并邻国宗多马，使号为纳巴的诸王成为莫戈·纳巴之外的独立对手。1400年，皇帝邦加趁马里帝国瓦解劫掠马西纳；15至16世纪，亚滕加在纳巴·亚德加及其后继者治下达到鼎盛，曾两度攻占廷巴克图，与桑海连年交战，桑尼·阿里正是在征讨莫西人的战役中死去，1498年阿斯基亚·穆罕默德又给予亚滕加其史上最沉重的打击。该王国长期恪守祖先祭祀、拒绝伊斯兰教。18世纪中期王权崩坏后，纳巴·坎戈于1757年带着配备燧发枪的班巴纳雇佣军从塞古流亡归来，这是该国首次出现火器；他赢得内战、压制地方酋长，并于1780年兴建新都瓦希古亚。此后即便马西纳和索科托的圣战大军也未能征服它，但连绵的继承战争已使亚滕加在19世纪初元气大伤。

en: Yautepec, whose Nahuatl name means hill of black corn, was a Zapotec town in the hill country beyond the eastern end of the Oaxaca valleys, near Tlacolula. Its people spoke a distinct Zapotec tongue now called Yautepec Zapotec, and like the other Zapotec communities of the region it passed under Spanish rule with the conquest of Oaxaca in 1521.
zh: 尧特佩克在纳瓦特尔语中意为黑玉米山，是瓦哈卡谷地东端外侧、靠近特拉科卢拉的山城，居民为萨波特克人，所说的独特萨波特克语今称尧特佩克萨波特克语。与该地区其他萨波特克社群一样，1521年瓦哈卡被征服后，它也被置于西班牙统治之下。

en: Yucu Satuta, also written Yucu Chatuta and called Zacatepec or Grassy Hill in Nahuatl, was a Mixtec city-state of the Costa Chica, near the Guerrero frontier, whose people included Mixtecs, Tacuates and Amuzgos. Mixtec tradition records its foundation in 1120, when Four Wind-Fire Serpent of Tututepec installed his son Eleven Tiger as its first ruler, but in later centuries it held itself independent of both Tututepec and the Aztec Empire. Its cacique ruled without check, receiving mantles, jewels and green stones in tribute and taking several wives, though only the child of the first wife could succeed him. Priests of the two stone idols Yahatujyuty and Nahanuhuconu were chosen for merit, served fifteen to twenty years and kept strict fasts before feasts. The cacique ruling at the Spanish arrival was Yyachihuyzu, whose name means Lord Wind Jaguar.
zh: 玉库萨图塔又拼作尤库查图塔，纳瓦特尔语称萨卡特佩克，意为“草山”，是科斯塔奇卡沿海、临近格雷罗边界的纽萨维城邦，居民包括纽萨维人、塔库阿特人和阿穆斯戈人。据纽萨维传说，它建于1120年，图图特佩克的四风·火蛇君把自己的儿子十一虎君封到此地为首任统治者；但在后来的几个世纪里，它同时保持着对图图特佩克和阿兹特克帝国的独立。它的卡西克君主大权独揽，收取织毯、珠宝和绿石为贡，可以娶多位妻子，但只有正妻之子能继位。侍奉两尊石像神祇亚哈图朱蒂和纳尼亚乌科努的祭司凭才干选任，任职十五至二十年，节庆前须严格斋戒。西班牙人到来时在位的卡西克是亚亚奇惠祖，名字意为“风虎之主”。

en: The Yadavarayas were Telugu chieftains who held the hill country around Chandragiri and Tirupati in southern Rayalaseema, ruling from Narayanavanam. Like several South Indian dynasties they sprang from pastoral Kuruba cowherd groups and claimed Yadava, or Moon lineage, Kshatriya standing. Around the year 1000 Immadi Narasimha Yadavaraya built the fort at Chandragiri, and the family long patronised the nearby temple of Tirumala, whose walls preserve records of their gifts alongside those of the Pallavas, Cholas and Pandyas. In the early fourteenth century a Yadavaraya of Chandragiri joined Hoysala Ballala and the Sambuvarayar of Padaividu in a coalition that Kakatiya Prataparudra defeated. The chiefs kept endowing temples through the fourteenth century, but in 1367 Chandragiri passed to the Vijayanagara Empire, where Yadavaraya lords such as Sriranganatha, known from an inscription at Egmore, continued as local feudatories.
zh: 亚达瓦拉亚是泰卢固酋长家族，占据南拉亚拉西马的昌德拉吉里和蒂鲁帕蒂一带山地，以纳拉耶纳瓦纳姆为统治中心。与南印度若干王朝一样，他们源出牧牛的库鲁巴游牧族群，自称耶陀婆即月族刹帝利。约1000年时，伊马迪·那罗辛哈·亚达瓦拉亚修建了昌德拉吉里堡；这个家族长期护持附近的蒂鲁马拉神庙，庙墙上仍留有他们与帕拉瓦、朱罗、潘地亚等王朝并列的布施题记。14世纪初，昌德拉吉里的亚达瓦拉亚与曷萨拉的巴拉拉、波多毗都的三补缚罗耶尔结盟，结果被卡卡提亚的波罗陀波鲁陀罗击败。其首领在14世纪仍不断向神庙布施，但1367年昌德拉吉里并入毗奢耶那伽罗帝国，埃格莫尔题记所见的室利兰伽那陀等亚达瓦拉亚首领此后作为地方附庸延续下来。

en: Yodzocahi was a small Mixtec city-state in the Coixtlahuaca valley of the northern Mixteca Alta, its name sharing the Yodzo element in Yodzocoo, the Mixtec name of Coixtlahuaca. It belonged to the Chocho and Mixtec world of Coixtlahuaca, which the Aztecs under Moctezuma I made a tributary province in the mid-fifteenth century and whose envoys submitted to the Spaniards in 1520.
zh: 约佐卡伊是北部上米斯特卡科伊斯特拉瓦卡谷地的小米斯特克人城邦，名字中的约佐成分也见于科伊斯特拉瓦卡的米斯特克语名约佐科。它属于乔乔人与米斯特克人杂处的科伊斯特拉瓦卡世界；15世纪中期，阿兹特克君主蒙特苏马一世把这一带变为纳贡省份，1520年当地使者向西班牙人投降。

en: The Yemen of 1337 was the Sunni kingdom of the Rasulids, a dynasty of likely Oghuz Turkic origin whose forebears served as Ayyubid mercenary officers. It took power when the last Ayyubid prince left Zabid in 1229, and its first sultan, al-Mansur Umar, won recognition from the Abbasid caliph in 1235. From Zabid and Taiz the sultans ruled the Tihamah lowland and the southern highlands against the Zaydi imams of the northern mountains, who retook Sanaa in 1324. The reigning sultan in 1337, al-Mujahid Ali, was seized by the Egyptian Mamluks during a pilgrimage to Mecca in 1350 and held in Egypt for a year. These were Yemen's great commercial centuries: Aden and Zabid carried the Red Sea trade with India and China, and a Chinese treasure fleet visited the court in 1419. Weakened by plague and tribal revolt, the Rasulids fell to the Tahirid clan in 1454; the Mamluks overran that realm in 1517, and in 1538 the Ottoman commander Hadim Suleiman Pasha took Aden and made Zabid the seat of the Yemen Eyalet. The Zaydi Qasimid imams expelled the Ottomans from the highlands by the mid-seventeenth century, and their imamate grew rich on coffee exported from Mokha until Europeans broke the monopoly in the early eighteenth century and the Qasimi state fragmented.
zh: 1337年的也门是拉苏勒王朝的逊尼派王国。该王朝很可能源于乌古斯突厥，先祖曾在阿尤布军中充任雇佣军军官；1229年末任阿尤布王公离开宰比德后他们接管政权，初代苏丹曼苏尔·奥马尔于1235年获得阿拔斯哈里发的册封。苏丹们以宰比德和塔伊兹为都，统治帖哈麦低地与南部高原，与北部山区的栽德派伊玛目长期对抗，后者于1324年夺回萨那。1337年在位的穆贾希德·阿里曾在1350年赴麦加朝觐时被埃及马穆鲁克人扣押，在埃及囚禁一年。这一时期也是也门的商业黄金时代：亚丁和宰比德经营通往印度与中国的红海贸易，1419年还有中国宝船队到访王宫。瘟疫和部落起义削弱了拉苏勒王朝，它于1454年被塔希尔家族取代；1517年马穆鲁克又攻灭塔希尔王朝，1538年奥斯曼将领哈德姆·苏莱曼帕夏攻占亚丁，并把宰比德设为也门省的首府。后来栽德派的卡西姆伊玛目们在17世纪中叶把奥斯曼人逐出高原，建立的伊玛目国靠穆哈港出口的咖啡致富，直到18世纪初欧洲人打破咖啡垄断，卡西姆政权也随之分裂。

en: Yongshun was the mightiest Tujia native chieftaincy, or tusi, in the Wuling mountains of northwestern Huguang, on the lands of present-day Yongshun County in Hunan. Under the Tang the area was Xizhou and under the Song Yongshun Prefecture; the hereditary Peng chiefs ruled from Laosicheng, to which Peng Fushichong moved the seat in 1135 from Fushijun in Lingxi. In 1349 Peng Wanqian inherited the Yuan pacification commission, and in 1351 reorganized it as the Yongshun Military-Civil Pacification Commission, raised himself to pacification commissioner and brought the Baojing chiefdom under his authority. Under the Ming it became the Yongshun Xuanwei Commission, one of the ranking tusi of the southwest. In 1555 the chieftain Peng Yinan led three thousand native troops east against the wokou pirates and won the great victory at Wangjiangjing, taking more than nineteen hundred heads. Late in the Ming the Peng moved their seat north to Kesha, calling the new seat the New Seat City and leaving Laosicheng as the old capital. The Qing gaitu guiliu reforms ended the chiefdom in 1728; Yongshun County was set up in 1729, and the last chieftain Peng Zhaohuai was resettled in 1729 at Ji'an in Jiangxi, his ancestral home.
zh: 永顺是湖广西北武陵山区最强大的土家族土司，辖地在今湖南永顺县一带，由彭氏世袭。唐代其地为溪州，宋代称永顺州；1135年土官彭福石宠把治所迁到灵溪福石郡，即后来的老司城。1349年彭万潜袭任元朝安抚使，1351年改置永顺等处军民安抚司、自升宣抚司，并把保靖州改为保靖安抚司，收为下属。明代永顺成为宣慰使司，是西南品级最高的土司之一；1555年宣慰使彭翼南率三千土兵东征倭寇，在王江泾大捷，斩倭一千九百余级。明代后期彭氏把治所北迁颗砂，称新司城，旧城遂名老司城。1728年清朝改土归流，土司统治结束，1729年置永顺县，末代宣慰使彭肇槐被安置回祖籍江西吉安。

en: Yimahu was a Jurchen polity centered on Itu, on the Yitong River of central Jilin, a tributary that winds north to join the Songhua system. In the early fifteenth century the Ming enrolled chiefs of this area into the guard network of the Nurgan commission, and its people were later counted among Nurhaci's Eight Banners.
zh: 亦马忽是以伊通河畔的伊通为中心的女真政权；伊通河在今吉林省中部，北流汇入松花江水系。15世纪初，明朝将这一带的首领编入奴儿干都司的卫所体系，其部众后来被努尔哈赤纳入八旗。

en: Yanjing, the salt wells, was the polity of the Mosha, forebears of the Nashi, in the high basin that is now Yanyuan in south-western Sichuan. The Han set up Dingzuo county there in 111 BC, and the Tang maintained Kunming county until the Tibetan empire and then Nanzhao took the basin, which Nanzhao called Xiangcheng and the Dali kingdom later Hetoudian. Under the Yuan a salt-well thousand-household office was created in 1277, replaced by Runyan Prefecture in 1280 and, in 1290, by Boxing Prefecture seated at Runyan. The Ming turned the country into a military colony, establishing the Yanjing Guard in 1393 and the Mala Chief's Office south of it in 1407. Qing rule brought civilian administration: in 1728 the guard became Yanyuan County under Ningyuan Prefecture, while the surrounding hills remained in the hands of native offices such as the Zuosuo thousand-household chieftains.
zh: 盐井因盐井得名，是摩沙人——纳西人的先民——在今川西南盐源盆地的政权。公元前111年西汉在此设定筰县，唐代置昆明县，唐末盆地先后为吐蕃和南诏所据，南诏改称香城郡，大理时又名贺头甸。1277年元朝设盐井千户，1280年改闰盐州，1290年立柏兴府，府治就在闰盐。明代将其改为军屯建制，1393年置盐井卫，1407年又在卫南设马剌长官司。清代恢复文官治理，1728年改盐井卫为盐源县，隶属宁远府，但周围山地仍由左所土千户等土司分别管辖。

en: The Chiefdom of Yongning was a hereditary Mosuo tusi in the mountains where Yunnan, Sichuan and Tibet meet, its seat lying northwest of present-day Ninglang County beside Lugu Lake. Its people, the Mosuo, are a Naxi-speaking group whose chiefs claimed an ancestor, Niyuewu, who had settled the valley in the first century. The chiefdom was successively subject to Nanzhao and the Dali kingdom until 1253, when its ruler He Zi submitted to Kublai Khan's invading Mongols; the Yuan set up Yongning Prefecture in 1279, and the chiefly house later claimed Mongol descent. In 1381 the chief Budu Geji travelled to the Ming court to see the Hongwu Emperor, and from 1406 his heirs held the hereditary title of prefect. The enfeoffment of Muli to a lama in 1648 and the Kangxi Emperor's grant of the Zuosuo and Qiansuo lands to a relative of the chief in 1710 greatly reduced its lands, though the Qing confirmed the A family in its prefectural title after the submission of 1659.
zh: 永宁土司是摩梭人的世袭土司，地处云南、四川、西藏三省交会的山区，治所在今宁蒗彝族自治县西北，邻近泸沽湖。摩梭人属纳西语族群，土司家族相传其祖先泥月乌于1世纪来到永宁。这里先后臣属南诏与大理国，1253年土司和字向攻入大理的忽必烈归降；元朝于1279年设永宁州，此后的阿姓土司自称是蒙古人后裔。1381年，土司卜都各吉赴明廷朝见洪武帝，1406年起其子孙世袭永宁知府。1648年木里被封给一位藏传佛教喇嘛，1710年康熙帝又将左所、前所之地封给土司的亲戚，永宁辖境大为缩小；而1659年归顺清朝后，阿氏家族的知府世袭职位仍获保留。

en: Yanhe was a small Tujia longship office, or zhangguansi, on the Wu River in northeastern Guizhou, seated on the lands of present-day Yanhe Tujia Autonomous County. It began as the Yanhe Youxi office, a native fief inside the domain of the Tian chiefs of Sizhou, and under the Yuan it was counted among the longship offices of the Sizhou Xuanwei Commission. When the Ming broke up the Sizhou and Sinan chiefdoms in 1413, Yanhe Youxi was placed under the new Sinan Prefecture as one of its three native offices, ruled by a principal chief of the Zhang clan with a deputy of the Ran clan. Nominally a prefectural tusi, it in practice fell under the sway of the neighboring Youyang chiefdom and followed its fortunes until the Qing gaitu guiliu reforms reached Youyang in 1735.
zh: 沿河是贵州东北部乌江边的土家族小型长官司，其地在今沿河土家族自治县，最初称沿河祐溪长官司，是思州田氏领地内分封的土职，元代列为思州宣慰司属下的长官司之一。1413年明朝废思州、思南两宣慰司后，沿河祐溪改隶新置的思南府，是该府三个长官司之一，由正长官张氏和副长官冉氏世袭。它名义上是思南府属土司，实际长期受邻近的酉阳土司控制，随酉阳的盛衰浮沉，直到1735年酉阳土司在改土归流中被废。

en: Yuanjiang was a native-ruled prefecture on the upper Red River in southern Yunnan, centred on the valley that is now the Yuanjiang autonomous county. The Yuan first set up a prefecture there in 1265 among the Luopan tribes and made it the Yuanjiang route in 1288; the Ming re-established Yuanjiang Prefecture in 1382, governing Fenghua and Gongshun through the hereditary Na family of native chieftains. From their seat at Fenghua the Na chiefs extended their power south towards Pu'er and the Tai country of Cheli. The last of them, Na Song, welcomed the fleeing Yongli emperor in 1656 and raised Yuanjiang against the Qing. In 1659 Wu Sangui's army stormed the city, and Na Song, refusing to surrender, burned himself together with his family on the north gate. The Qing then placed Yuanjiang under circulating officials, and in 1770 it became an independent department.
zh: 元江是滇南红河水系上游的土府，核心在今元江自治县一带的坝子。1265年元朝先在罗盘部地设立元江府，1288年改设元江路；1382年明朝重设元江府，通过世袭的那氏土司管理奉化、恭顺二州。那氏以奉化州为治所，势力向南推进到普洱和车里的傣人地区。末代土知府那嵩于1656年迎入流亡的永历帝，举元江抗清。1659年吴三桂大军攻城，那嵩拒绝投降，城破后携全家在北门城楼自焚而死。清廷随后将元江改由流官治理，1770年又降为元江直隶州。

en: Yunlian was a small Yi-speaking frontier polity in the hills where southern Sichuan meets Yunnan. The Tang held it as the loose-reign prefectures of Jun and Lian, which the Yuan merged into the Junlian tribal department in 1278; in 1371 the Ming converted it into Junlian County under appointed officials.
zh: 筠连是四川盆地南缘、川滇交界处山地的彝族小邦。唐代在此设筠州、连州两个羁縻州，元朝于1278年将二州合并为筠连州，1371年明朝改置筠连县、派任流官治理。

en: The Yongning Zhuang chieftaincy took its name from the department of Yongning, created early in the Yuan from the lands of Dahan in the Guanling hills of southwestern Guizhou, with its seat north of present-day Yongning town. A department without subordinate counties, it belonged first to Puding prefecture and then to the Puding route, and was abolished in the late Yuan. The Ming restored it in 1383 under the Puding native prefecture, with territory equal to present-day Guanling county. From 1392 it was attached to the Puding Guard, its seat for a time lodged in the guard city at present-day Anshun, and in 1532 its seat moved to the Guansuoling battalion; in 1576 it moved again into the Annan Guard city at present-day Qinglong, the Xincheng area shown as its home, and in 1583 it passed to Anshun prefecture. During the Tianqi reign of 1621 to 1627 it made a final move to Chacheng, where it remained a native department through the early Qing.
zh: 永宁僮因永宁州得名。元朝初年以打罕部地置永宁州，治所在今关岭布依族苗族自治县西南永宁镇北，不辖县，先隶普定府，后随府改属普定路，至正年间废置。1383年明朝复置永宁州，属普定土府，辖境相当今关岭布依族苗族自治县；1392年改属普定卫，治所一度侨寄卫城（今安顺市），1532年迁治关索岭千户所，1576年移驻安南卫城（今晴隆县，即治所新城一带），1583年改属安顺府。1621年至1627年的天启年间再迁治查城，此后永宁作为土州一直延续至清初。

en: Yohualtepec, also written Yoaltepec and Ihualtepec, was a Mixtec hill town of the Mixteca Baja in northwestern Oaxaca; the village survives as San Juan Ihualtepec, called Yucunicana in Mixtec, 'hill of the brave dead', and its district took in the neighbouring centres of Huajuapan and Silacayoapam. The dry valleys of the Mixteca Baja, whose people knew themselves as the Ñuu Savi or 'people of the rain', had held settled towns since about 400 BCE and were divided among rival city-states using their own ñuiñe script, while Silacayoapam owed allegiance to the multi-ethnic state of Coixtlahuaca. Aztec armies overran the Mixtec country in the 1450s and defeated its rulers in 1458, after which the towns around Yohualtepec paid tribute through imperial provinces. The Mixtecs submitted to the expedition of Francisco de Orozco in 1521, Augustinian friars followed, and the Spanish gathered the hill villages into new towns, refounding Huajuapan in 1561. During the independence war, royalist forces besieged Huajuapan for 111 days until Valerio Trujano relieved it with José María Morelos in 1812.
zh: 约瓦尔特佩克又拼作约阿尔特佩克或伊瓦尔特佩克，是瓦哈卡西北部米斯特卡低地的米斯特克山城，故地即今圣胡安伊瓦尔特佩克，米斯特克语称尤库尼卡纳，意为“勇士亡魂之山”，其辖区包括邻近的瓦华潘和西拉卡约阿潘两个中心。米斯特卡低地气候干热，居民自称纽萨维，意为“雨之民”；这一带公元前400年左右已有城镇，林立的城邦使用特有的纽伊涅文字，西拉卡约阿潘当时臣属多族群的科伊斯特拉瓦卡邦。15世纪50年代，阿兹特克军队攻入米斯特克地区，1458年击败诸邦君长，此后约瓦尔特佩克周围的城镇通过帝国的贡税省输贡。1521年，米斯特克人向弗朗西斯科·德·奥罗斯科的远征军投降，奥斯定会修士随后而至；西班牙人把山间村落集中为新城，瓦华潘于1561年重新建城。独立战争期间，保王军围攻瓦华潘达111天，1812年巴莱里奥·特鲁哈诺在何塞·玛丽亚·莫雷洛斯的支援下解围。

en: The Yoko t'aanob, better known as the Chontal Maya or Putún, are a Maya people of the swampy Gulf coast of Tabasco; their own name means speakers of Yoko ochoco, their native tongue. Their lowland homeland was also the cradle of the Olmecs, and by the Terminal Classic their canoe-borne merchants dominated the river and coastal trade routes of the Maya lowlands. In the early sixteenth century they were organized into six provinces, among them Copilco, Potonchán, Xicalango and Zahuatan, growing cacao and hosting merchants from rival powers on neutral ground. Juan de Grijalva met hostility off their coast in 1518, and the following year Hernán Cortés landed at Potonchán, where the chief Tabscoob supplied him with the woman later known as La Malinche; these chiefs became the first native vassals of New Spain. Colonial resettlement emptied most of the old towns, and only Nacajuca, where a church was built in 1614, survived as an urban center.
zh: 约科坦人更常见的称呼是琼塔尔玛雅人或普顿人，是塔巴斯科沼泽化墨西哥湾沿岸的玛雅民族，其自称意为母语约科奥乔科语的使用者。这片低地家园也曾是奥尔梅克文明的摇篮；到古典期末期，他们驾独木舟经商的商人掌控了玛雅低地的河流与沿海商路。16世纪初，他们分为六个省，包括库皮尔科、波通昌、希卡兰戈和萨瓦坦，种植可可，并在中立之地接待来自敌对强权的商人。1518年，胡安·德·格里哈尔瓦在他们的海岸遭到敌视；次年埃尔南·科尔特斯在波通昌登陆，酋长塔布斯库布将后来被称为拉·马林切的女子献给他，这些酋长也成为新西班牙最早的土著附庸。殖民时期的重新安置使多数旧城凋零，只有1614年建起教堂的纳卡胡卡作为城市中心留存下来。

en: Yoose was a Jurchen polity seated at Nogule in the wooded country between the Suifen and Ussuri river basins, near the Sikhote-Alin fringe. It belonged to the loosely connected Wild Jurchen clans, who lived by hunting, fishing and pig farming and kept only intermittent tribute ties with the Ming court.
zh: 约瑟是以诺古勒为治所的女真政权，地处绥芬河与乌苏里江流域之间、锡霍特山脉边缘的林海。它属于联系松散的野人女真诸部，以渔猎和养猪为生，与明朝只维持断断续续的朝贡关系。

en: Yopitzinco was the Nahuatl name for the country of the Yopi, a branch of the Tlapanec or Me'phaa people, who held the rugged mountains of the Costa Chica east of present-day Acapulco, with their principal town at Tlapan. Their old ceremonial centre of Tehuacalco, occupied from about 400 to 1100, was built around hills worshipped as guardians of water and seed. The Yopi were formidable warriors and Yopitzinco remained an independent enclave ringed by Aztec territory: the Mexica never conquered it, yet invited Yopi embassies to the coronations of rulers in Tenochtitlan and loaded them with gifts. They were skilled goldsmiths and jewellers and worshipped the flayed god Xipe Totec, whose cult may have passed from Yopitzinco to Tenochtitlan. Spanish forces reached the region in the early 1520s, and after a rebellion was crushed the surviving Yopi were decimated by European diseases and scattered among neighbouring settlements.
zh: 约皮钦科是阿兹特克人对约皮人地区的称呼；约皮人是特拉帕内克人（自称梅法阿人）的一支，据有今阿卡普尔科以东科斯塔奇卡的崎岖山地，主城在特拉潘。他们古老的祭祀中心特瓦卡尔科约在400年至1100年间使用，围绕被视为水源与种子守护者的群山而建。约皮人是强悍的战士，约皮钦科始终是阿兹特克领土环绕中的独立飞地：墨西加人始终未能征服它，却会邀请约皮使节前往特诺奇蒂特兰参加君主加冕礼，并厚赠礼物。他们擅长金器和宝石工艺，崇拜剥皮之神希佩托特克，该信仰可能正是由约皮钦科传入特诺奇蒂特兰。16世纪20年代初，西班牙军队进入这一地区；一次起义被镇压后，幸存的约皮人又因欧洲传来的疫病大量死亡，余众被打散到周边聚落。

en: Yaran was a Jurchen polity of the coastal hills east of the Ussuri, taking its name from the Yaran Bira, the river now called the Partizanskaya that rises in the Sikhote-Alin and reaches the Sea of Japan at Nakhodka Bay. Its hunting and fishing clans belonged to the disparate groups the Ming knew as the Wild Jurchens.
zh: 雅兰是乌苏里江以东海滨丘陵地带的女真政权，得名于雅兰河，即发源于锡霍特山脉、在纳霍德卡湾注入日本海的今帕尔季赞斯卡亚河。其渔猎部众属于明朝所称野人女真中分散的一支。

en: Yuryev-Polsky is a small appanage of the Vladimir-Suzdal lands on the upper Koloksha River. Its walled town was founded in 1152 by Yury Dolgoruky and named for St. George, his patron saint, with the suffix Polsky, meaning in the fields, to distinguish it from the older Yuryev fortress in Estonia. On Vsevolod the Big Nest's death in 1212 it passed to his son Svyatoslav, who designed its white-stone Cathedral of St. George, built between 1230 and 1234 and regarded as the last great pre-Mongol church of Rus'. Rival princes fought the Battle of Lipitsa nearby in 1216, and the Mongols sacked the town in 1238. It remained a minor Rurikid appanage, ruled in 1337 by Prince Yaroslav Ivanovich, until Moscow bought up the local princely rights and incorporated it around 1340.
zh: 尤里耶夫-波利斯基是弗拉基米尔-苏兹达尔地区科洛克沙河上游的小封邑。它的筑城城镇由尤里·多尔戈鲁基建于1152年，城名取自他的主保圣人圣乔治，后缀“波利斯基”意为“在田野间”，用以区别爱沙尼亚境内更古老的尤里耶夫要塞。1212年“大窝”弗谢沃洛德三世去世后，城镇传给其子斯维亚托斯拉夫，后者亲自设计了1230—1234年建造的白石圣乔治大教堂，它被视为蒙古入侵前罗斯最后一座伟大的石造教堂。1216年罗斯诸王公在附近展开利皮察战役，1238年蒙古人洗劫了这座城镇。此后它一直是留里克家族的小封邑，1337年在位的是雅罗斯拉夫·伊万诺维奇王公，约1340年莫斯科买下当地王公的权利，将其吞并。

en: Yongshun was a Zhuang chief's office in the Qingyuan prefecture of northern Guangxi, its lands lying around present-day Yizhou in Hechi. The Ming created it in 1492 by carving territory out of Yizhou and installed two hereditary native officers: a senior chief of the Deng clan with his seat south-west of Yishan, and a junior chief of the Peng clan to the north-east. Both branches answered to the Qingyuan prefect and governed the local Zhuang villages through the Ming and Qing.
zh: 永顺僮是广西北部庆远府境内的壮族长官司，地在今河池市宜州区一带。明弘治五年（1492年）从宜州分地设置，授两名世袭土官：正长官为邓氏，衙署在宜山西南；副长官为彭氏，衙署在宜山东北。正、副两司都隶属于庆远府，在明、清两代治理当地的壮族村寨。

en: The Yasa'uri took their name from Yasa'ur, a Chagatai prince and great-great-grandson of Chagatai Khan. After campaigning against the Ilkhanate in 1314, he fell out with his own khan, defected to Ilkhan Öljeitü and was granted the pastures of Badghis, but in 1319 he revolted against the new Ilkhan Abu Sa'id, raiding Mazandaran and besieging Herat before the Chagatai khan Kebek hunted him down and killed him in 1320. His personal troops held together and became the Yasa'uri, a tribal grouping whose lands in central Transoxiana bordered those of the Barlas; the Mu'izz al-Ansab claims Timur's own mother was related to them. During the Moghul invasion of 1360 their chief Hajji Mahmudshah raided the Barlas with a Moghul army, and when Hajji Beg Barlas and Bayazid Jalayir counter-attacked, the young Timur sided with the Yasa'uri before the Barlas and Jalayir finally defeated them, clearing the way for Timur's own rise within the Chagatai ulus.
zh: 札撒兀里之名得自察合台宗王也孙·札撒兀儿——他是察合台汗的玄孙。1314年随军攻打伊利汗国后，他与本国大汗反目，投奔伊利汗完者都并受封巴德吉斯牧场；1319年他又起兵反叛新伊利汗不赛因，侵扰马赞德兰、围攻赫拉特，最终于1320年被察合台汗怯别追杀。他的私属部众不散，逐渐形成札撒兀里部，游牧于河中腹地，牧地与巴鲁剌思相接；《穆伊兹·安萨卜》称帖木儿的母亲就出自该部。1360年蒙兀儿人入侵时，其首领哈吉·马合木沙随蒙兀儿军劫掠巴鲁剌思领地，哈吉·伯克·巴鲁剌思与巴耶济德·札剌伊尔联手反击，年轻的帖木儿一度站在札撒兀里一边，最终巴鲁剌思与札剌伊尔联军将其击败，这也为帖木儿随后在察合台兀鲁思的崛起铺平了道路。

en: Youyang was a Tujia native chieftaincy in the Wuling mountains of eastern Sichuan, on the lands of present-day Youyang County in southeastern Chongqing, ruled by the hereditary Ran clan. Under the late Yuan the Ran held the marshal's office of the Youyang Border Stream-Cave Military-Civil Commission. In 1372 the chieftain Ran Rubiao sent his brother to court with tribute and was made prefect of the new Youyang Prefecture, and in 1375 the Ming reorganized it as the Youyang Pacification Commission, placing four longship offices, Pingcha, Yimei, Matu and Shiye, under its authority. Ran chiefs repeatedly led native troops on Ming campaigns: in 1600 Ran Yuelong routed the Bozhou rebels at the Sangmu Pass with the first merit on the Nanchuan route, and in 1618 he marched four thousand men to Liaodong against the rising Later Jin, where his brother and more than a thousand of his soldiers fell in the fighting. In 1621 he was raised to Xuanwei Commissioner, the senior rank of the native pacification offices. The chiefdom ended in 1735, when the Qing gaitu guiliu reforms replaced it with the regular Youyang Independent Prefecture.
zh: 酉阳是川东武陵山区的土家族土司，其地在今重庆东南部的酉阳土家族苗族自治县，由冉氏世袭。元末冉氏任酉阳沿边溪洞军民宣慰司都元帅府元帅；1372年首领冉如彪派弟弟入朝进贡，被明太祖授为酉阳知州，1375年改置酉阳宣抚司，下辖平茶、邑梅、麻兔、石耶四洞长官司。明代冉氏多次率土兵从征：1600年冉跃龙在平定播州之役中直取桑木关、大败播州兵，位列南川路战功第一；1618年他又率四千土兵驰援辽东对抗后金，其弟冉见龙及千余名土兵先后战死。1621年冉跃龙升任宣慰使。1735年清朝改土归流，土司被废，其地改设酉阳直隶州。
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/酉阳土家族苗族自治县

en: Yizuo was a small highland county in eastern Yunnan, lying in the area of present-day Fuyuan County east of Qujing. Under the Ming it was, together with Nanning, one of the two counties of Qujing Prefecture; in Qing prefectural rolls its place had been taken by the newly established Pingyi County.
zh: 亦佐是云南东部的山区小县，辖地在今曲靖市富源县一带。明代它与南宁县同为曲靖府下辖的两县之一；清代曲靖府的属县名单中，其位置已由新设的平彝县取代。

en: The Zab is the belt of oases on the desert edge of eastern Algeria, centred on Biskra, the so-called door of the desert, where the routes from the Mediterranean coast turn south towards Touggourt and the Sahara. After the Hilalian Arab invasions of the eleventh century the Dhouaouda tribe, descended from the Banu Riyah, set up an emirate at Biskra in 1179, and in the following century the Banu Muzni family made themselves emirs there, extending their authority over the Oued Righ, the Aurès, the Hodna and even Ouargla with the sanction of the sultans of Béjaïa. The Banu Muzni balanced between the Hafsids of Tunis, the Zianids of Tlemcen and the Marinids of Fez: they allied with Tlemcen to shake off Hafsid tutelage, submitted again in 1329, and afterwards gave only nominal obedience, so that the Hafsids had to besiege Biskra repeatedly to extract tribute. The historian Ibn Khaldun visited the town and devoted a chapter to its Muzni emirs. In 1401 a Hafsid army defeated the Zab before Biskra and captured the emir Ahmed ibn Yusuf, ending the emirate, and in 1541 the chiefs of Biskra accepted Ottoman overlordship under the Pact of Barbarossa and took the title Shaykh al-Arab.
zh: 扎卜是阿尔及利亚东部沙漠边缘的绿洲地带，以有‘沙漠门户’之称的比斯克拉为中心，地中海沿岸南下图古尔特和撒哈拉的商路就在这里转入沙漠。11世纪希拉尔阿拉伯人入侵后，巴努里亚赫人的后裔达瓦乌达部落在1179年以比斯克拉为都建立酋长国；13世纪时，巴努穆兹尼家族成为这里的埃米尔，并经贝贾亚苏丹准许，把势力扩展到韦德里格、奥雷斯、霍德纳乃至瓦尔格拉。穆兹尼家族在突尼斯哈夫斯王朝、特莱姆森扎扬王朝和非斯马林王朝之间周旋：他们曾联合特莱姆森摆脱哈夫斯监护，1329年重新称臣，此后只给名义上的服从，哈夫斯人不得不一再围攻比斯克拉才能索到贡赋。历史学家伊本·赫勒敦曾到访该城，并为穆兹尼埃米尔们写了专章。1401年，哈夫斯军队在比斯克拉城下击败扎卜军队，俘虏埃米尔艾哈迈德·伊本·优素福，酋长国灭亡；1541年，比斯克拉的酋长们根据‘巴巴罗萨协议’接受奥斯曼宗主权，并取得‘阿拉伯谢赫’的头衔。

en: The Duchy of Żagań was a Silesian principality of the Holy Roman Empire, centred on the town of Żagań in Lower Silesia and ruled by a branch of the Polish Piast dynasty. It was created in 1274 from the western lands of the Duchy of Głogów, whose youngest heir Przemko founded an Augustinian monastery at his new residence, and after a spell of reunion it re-emerged as a separate duchy in 1321 under Henry IV the Faithful. In 1329 Henry and most of his Piast kinsmen were forced to accept the overlordship of John of Luxembourg, King of Bohemia, so that in 1337 Żagań was a Bohemian fief on the western edge of Silesia. Henry failed in his attempts to recover the neighbouring Duchy of Głogów, which the Bohemian crown absorbed in 1331, and on his death in 1342 he was buried in the Augustinian church at Żagań. His descendants kept the duchy until 1472, when Jan II the Mad, last of the line, sold it to Albert III the Bold of Saxony with the consent of King Matthias Corvinus. Under the Wettin dukes it turned Protestant in 1539, and in 1549 it passed to the Bohemian Habsburg crown, which in 1627 granted it to the imperial general Wallenstein and afterwards to the Lobkowicz family. Frederick the Great of Prussia conquered Żagań in the First Silesian War, and the Treaty of Breslau of 1742 assigned it to Prussia.
zh: 扎甘公国是神圣罗马帝国的西里西亚邦国，以下西里西亚的扎甘城为中心，由波兰皮亚斯特王朝的一支统治。它于1274年从格沃古夫公国的西部领地分出，最早的领主普热姆科在新驻地修建了奥古斯丁修道院；经过一段重新合并的时期后，1321年它在忠贞者亨里克四世治下再次成为独立公国。1329年，亨里克和大多数皮亚斯特亲族被迫接受波希米亚国王卢森堡的约翰的宗主权，因此1337年时扎甘是波希米亚的封邑，地处西里西亚西缘。亨里克试图夺回邻邦格沃古夫公国未果，该公国于1331年被波希米亚王室吞并；他于1342年去世，葬在扎甘的奥古斯丁会教堂。他的后裔保有公国直到1472年，末代领主疯子扬二世经国王马加什·科尔温同意，把它卖给萨克森的勇者阿尔布雷希特三世。韦廷家族治下它于1539年改宗新教，1549年转入波希米亚哈布斯堡王室之手，1627年被赐给帝国统帅华伦斯坦，之后又归洛布科维茨家族。普鲁士的腓特烈二世在第一次西里西亚战争中攻占扎甘，1742年的《布雷斯劳条约》把它划归普鲁士。

en: Zamfara was a Hausa kingdom of the fertile river valleys in what is now northwestern Nigeria, whose people, the Zamfarawa, traced themselves to Maguzawa hunting clans and kept a ritual cousinship with the people of Kano. It grew out of the chiefdoms of Dutsi, Togai and Kiyawa: after seven years without a ruler the clans made Dakka their first Sarkin Zamfara, and tradition remembers the early chiefs as giants buried under great earthen mounds at Dutsi. The later kings moved north to the Gagare River and built Birnin Zamfara, an eleven-mile walled capital with fifty gates; tradition places this under King Bakurukuru around 1300. Its name is said to honour Fara, a lost Gobir princess rescued by local hunters, and means the men of Fara. Long a tributary of Kebbi, Zamfara rebelled around 1715 under King Babba and his son Yakubu, allied with Gobir and Agadez, routed the Kebbawa at Tsamiya Maibaura and captured their king Muhammadu dan Giwa, becoming a first-rate regional power. The alliance with Gobir turned fatal: Sarkin Gobir Babari, who reigned from 1742 to 1770, attacked his former friends, and Birnin Zamfara was stormed about 1756. The last king, Mairoki, was hunted down at the hill fortress of Kiawa by Bawa Jan Gwarzo, and in the early 1800s the Fulani jihad absorbed the ruined kingdom into the Sokoto Caliphate.
zh: 扎姆法拉是位于今尼日利亚西北部肥沃河谷地带的豪萨王国，其居民扎姆法拉瓦人自称源自马古扎瓦狩猎氏族，并与卡诺人保持着仪式性的表亲关系。它由杜齐、托加伊和基阿瓦等小邦发展而来：各氏族在七年无主之后推举达卡为第一代萨尔金·扎姆法拉，传说早期酋长都是巨人，葬在杜齐的巨大土冢之下。后来的诸王北迁到加加雷河畔，建起城墙长11英里、设有五十座城门的都城比尔宁扎姆法拉；相传此事发生在1300年前后的巴库鲁库鲁国王时代。据说国名是为纪念迷路后被当地猎人救下的戈比尔公主法拉，意为“法拉的人”。扎姆法拉长期向凯比称臣，约1715年国王巴巴与儿子雅库布联合戈比尔和阿加德兹起兵，在察米亚·迈巴乌拉击溃凯比军队，俘获其王穆罕默杜·丹·吉瓦，一跃成为地区头等强国。但与戈比尔的同盟最终致命：1742至1770年在位的戈比尔萨尔基巴巴里反戈攻打旧日盟友，比尔宁扎姆法拉约在1756年陷落。末代国王迈罗基在基阿瓦山寨被巴瓦·詹·瓜尔佐追杀灭国；19世纪初，富拉尼圣战把这个残破的王国并入索科托哈里发国。

en: Kilwa was a Swahili sultanate centered on the coral island of Kilwa Kisiwani, off the coast of what is now southern Tanzania. Local chronicle makes it a foundation of the tenth century by Ali ibn al-Hassan Shirazi, a Persian prince of Shiraz who is said to have bought the island from its Bantu inhabitants for as much colored cloth as could ring its shore. Around 1178 Sultan Suleiman Hassan seized the southern port of Sofala from Mogadishu, giving Kilwa command of the gold and ivory trade flowing out of Great Zimbabwe in the interior. From the late thirteenth century the Mahdali dynasty, of Yemeni Arab origin, ruled the city and built the Husuni Kubwa palace and enlarged the Great Mosque; when Ibn Battuta visited in 1331 he praised Kilwa as one of the finest cities in the world. At its fifteenth-century height its overlordship ran from Malindi and Lamu in the north to Sofala and Inhambane in the south, taking in Mombasa, Pemba, Zanzibar and Mafia, although the vassal cities kept their own merchant elites. Court coups weakened the sultanate before Vasco da Gama extorted tribute in 1502, and in 1505 Francisco de Almeida sacked the city and erected Fort Santiago. The Portuguese withdrew in 1512; Kilwa recovered only partly, and in 1784 it fell to the Omani rulers of Zanzibar.
zh: 基卢瓦是斯瓦希里人的苏丹国，以今坦桑尼亚南部近海的珊瑚岛基卢瓦基斯瓦尼为中心。据当地编年史记载，它于10世纪由设拉子的波斯王公阿里·伊本·哈桑·设拉子建立，传说他用足以环绕海岸的彩色布匹从班图居民手中买下了这座岛。约1178年，苏丹苏莱曼·哈桑从摩加迪沙手中夺取南方港口索法拉，使基卢瓦掌握了内陆大津巴布韦输出的黄金与象牙贸易。13世纪末起，源自阿拉伯也门的马赫达利王朝统治该城，修建了胡苏尼库布瓦宫，并扩建了大清真寺；1331年伊本·白图泰来访时，盛赞基卢瓦是世界上最美的城市之一。15世纪鼎盛时，其宗主权北起马林迪和拉穆，南至索法拉与伊尼扬巴内，蒙巴萨、奔巴、桑给巴尔和马菲亚岛都在其势力范围内，但各附庸城市保留了自己的商人精英。宫廷政变削弱了苏丹国，1502年瓦斯科·达伽马向它强索贡赋，1505年弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达洗劫该城并修建圣地亚哥堡。葡萄牙人于1512年撤离，基卢瓦只恢复了部分繁荣，1784年落入桑给巴尔的阿曼统治者之手。

en: Zaachila, called Teotzapotlan by the Aztecs, was the last capital of the Zapotecs, rising in the central valleys of Oaxaca after the older city of Monte Alban lost its primacy in the Postclassic period. Founded around the fourteenth century and named after its ruler Zaachila Yoo, it grew into a powerful kingdom whose subjects included Mitla and Tlacolula, while it fought repeated wars with the Mixtec states of Tututepec and Tlaxiaco; Mixtec influence at court ran so deep that the royal tombs inside its palace were built in Mixtec style. In the fifteenth century Aztec armies pushed into Oaxaca, and King Cosijoeza, who had fortified the mountain city of Guiengola, fought two invasions by the Aztec ruler Ahuitzotl in the 1490s before making peace and marrying Ahuitzotl's daughter. Their son Cosijopii, the last sovereign, allied with Pedro de Alvarado against the Mixtecs, was baptized as Juan Cortes Sicasibi and moved his court to Guiengola; his sister Donaji was taken hostage and killed in the Mixtec wars and was remembered as the last Zapotec princess.
zh: 扎奇拉（阿兹特克人称之为特奥察波特兰）是萨波特克人的末代都城。后古典时代，随着古城蒙特阿尔万丧失中心地位，它在瓦哈卡中央谷地崛起，约14世纪建城，名字得自君主扎奇拉·尤。扎奇拉发展成强大王国，米特拉、特拉科卢拉等地都臣属于它，同时它与米斯特克人的图图特佩克和特拉希亚科两邦连年交战；米斯特克影响深入宫廷，宫殿中的王陵甚至采用米斯特克风格。15世纪阿兹特克军队攻入瓦哈卡，君主科西霍埃萨固守山城吉恩戈拉，在15世纪90年代两度抵御阿兹特克君主阿维措特尔的入侵，最终议和并迎娶阿维措特尔之女。他们的儿子科西霍皮是末代君主，与佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多结盟对抗米斯特克人，受洗取名胡安·科尔特斯·西卡西比，并把宫廷迁往吉恩戈拉；他的妹妹多纳希在米斯特克战争中被掳杀，被后世铭记为末代萨波特克公主。

en: Chunsua stands for the northern Muisca chiefdoms of the Colombian Andes, whose paramount lord, the hoa or zaque, ruled from Hunza, on the site of later Tunja; the priestly chiefdom of Sugamuxi at Sogamoso and the hardy chiefdom of Tundama at Duitama were his close allies. In 1490 the hoa Michuá and the southern zipa Saguamanchica both fell at the Battle of Chocontá, and the long reign of Quemuenchatocha began amid endemic war with the southern Muisca, until a truce brokered by the iraca of Sugamuxi held on the eve of the Spanish arrival. Quemuenchatocha tried to buy off Gonzalo Jiménez de Quesada with gold and emeralds, but in August 1537 the Spaniards seized Hunza and captured him; he died in exile at Ramiriquí in 1538. His nephew Aquiminzaque, the last hoa, rebelled and was publicly beheaded at Tunja in 1540, and the Spanish town of Tunja rose over the site of Hunza.
zh: 琼苏阿代表哥伦比亚安第斯山区的北穆伊斯卡诸酋长邦，其最高首领称奥阿，又称扎克，坐镇温萨，也就是后来通哈的所在地；索加莫索的祭司邦苏加穆希和杜伊塔马的强悍酋长邦通达马是他的紧密盟友。1490年，奥阿米楚阿与南方的锡帕萨瓜曼奇卡双双战死于乔孔塔战役，克穆恩查托查随后即位，在与南穆伊斯卡的长期战争中统治多年，直到西班牙人到来前夕，苏加穆希的伊拉卡出面斡旋达成的休战仍然有效。克穆恩查托查试图用黄金和祖母绿收买贡萨洛·希门尼斯·德·克萨达，但1537年8月西班牙人攻占温萨并将他俘虏，他于1538年死于流放地里米里基。他的外甥阿基明萨克是末代奥阿，起兵反抗后于1540年在通哈被公开斩首，西班牙人的通哈城就建在温萨的故地之上。

en: Zacatlan was a mountain polity of the Sierra Norte de Puebla whose Nahuatl name joins zacatl, grass, and tlan, place, meaning the land of abundant pasture. Its high valley received its first permanent settlement in the sixth to eighth centuries, when the Zacateca people fled the Teochichimeca and founded Otlatlan, and it stood on a trade route linking the world of Teotihuacan with the Gulf of Mexico. Around 1170 the Chichimeca ruler Xolotl conquered the region, and in 1181 his grandson Toxtequihuatzin inherited Zacatlan; in Toltec times it had belonged to the lordship of Tulancingo, but after the Toltec collapse it ruled itself as an independent province. In the fifteenth century the Colhua lords of Texcoco incorporated it into the Aztec Empire, and much of the Sierra Norte became known as the province of Zacatlan, whose Nahuatl-speaking towns fought repeated wars with Tlaxcala. Spanish expeditions reached the area in 1519 and 1520, and a Franciscan convent was raised in the town under the viceroyalty. During the independence war the insurgent Francisco Osorno seized Zacatlan in 1811 and made it his base, and in 1824 it became a department of the new state of Puebla.
zh: 萨卡特兰是普埃布拉北部山区的一个山地政权，其名来自纳瓦特尔语的“萨卡特”（草）和“特兰”（地方），意为牧草丰茂之地。6至8世纪，萨卡特卡人为躲避特奥奇奇梅卡人进入这处高海拔山谷，建立了最早的永久定居点奥特拉特兰；此地还处在连接特奥蒂瓦坎世界与墨西哥湾的商路上。约1170年，奇奇梅克首领索洛特尔征服该地区，1181年其孙托斯特基瓦辛继承萨卡特兰。托尔特克强盛时这里隶属图兰辛戈领地，托尔特克衰落后萨卡特兰成为独立省份。15世纪，特斯科科的科尔瓦贵族将它并入阿兹特克帝国，普埃布拉北部山区的大部被称作萨卡特兰省，境内讲纳瓦特尔语的城邦与特拉斯卡拉反复交战。1519至1520年西班牙探险队抵达此地，殖民时期镇上建起一座方济各会修道院。独立战争中，起义者弗朗西斯科·奥索尔诺于1811年占领萨卡特兰并以此为基地；1824年它成为新成立的普埃布拉州的一个行政区。

en: In the fourteenth century a Zebari chiefdom held Qaladiza in the Garmian hills under Jalayirid overlordship. The tribe's historic homeland lay along the Great Zab in Bahdinan, where Evliya Celebi recorded its autonomous Zibari district, and the Barzan valley was also once Zebari land.
zh: 14世纪时，一个泽巴里酋长政权在札剌亦儿王朝宗主权下据有加尔米安山区的卡拉迪扎。该部落的历史家园在更北面巴赫迪南境内的大扎布河沿岸，埃夫利亚·切莱比曾记载其自治的兹巴里行政区，巴尔赞山谷也曾是泽巴里人的土地。

en: Zacatollan, later known to the Spanish as Zacatula, was a coastal town on the Costa Grande of what is now western Guerrero, where Tolimec and Chumbia were spoken and a non-standard Nahuatl served as lingua franca. The Purépecha Empire counted the Chumbios of this district among its subject groups.
zh: 萨卡图拉即后来西班牙人所称的萨卡图拉，是今格雷罗州西部科斯塔格兰德的沿海城镇，当地通行托利梅克语和琼比亚语，并以一种不规范的纳瓦特尔语作为通用语；普雷佩查帝国把这一带的琼比亚人算作臣属族群。

en: Zacazonapan was a small Nahuatl-speaking community in the Temascaltepec country, on the forested frontier between the Mexican highlands and Tarascan Michoacán. The region, earlier home to Matlatzinca and Otomi farmers, was conquered by Mexica armies under Axayácatl in 1475 and 1476 and garrisoned against the Purépecha.
zh: 萨卡索纳潘是特马斯卡尔特佩克地区一个说纳瓦特尔语的小聚落，地处墨西哥高原与塔拉斯科米却肯之间的林缘地带。这一带早先住着马特拉钦卡人和奥托米农人，1475—1476年被阿沙亚卡特尔的墨西加军队征服，并驻军抵御普雷佩查人。

en: The County of Zeeland was a Holy Roman Empire county of islands and tidal flats in the Scheldt and Meuse delta, with its seat at Middelburg; Zeelandic Flanders on the opposite bank belonged to Flanders and lay outside it. In 1012 Emperor Henry II enfeoffed the Count of Flanders with Zeeland, and for two centuries Holland and Flanders fought over it until the counts of Holland reconquered it and ruled it in personal union from 1256. The Treaty of Paris of 1323 confirmed the count of Holland as Count of Zeeland, so in 1337 it was held by William of Avesnes as a fief of Holland. Philip the Good of Burgundy annexed it in 1432, and after 1482 it passed with the rest of the Burgundian inheritance to the Habsburgs as one of the Seventeen Provinces. In the Eighty Years' War Zeeland joined the revolt against Spain, and from 1581 it was one of the seven provinces of the Dutch Republic until the Batavian Revolution abolished the county in 1795.
zh: 泽兰伯国是神圣罗马帝国位于斯海尔德河与默兹河三角洲的岛屿和滩涂之地，治所在米德尔堡；对岸的泽兰佛兰德当时属于佛兰德，并不在其境内。1012年，皇帝亨利二世将泽兰封给佛兰德伯爵，此后荷兰与佛兰德争夺了两个世纪，最终荷兰伯爵重新征服此地，并从1256年起以共主方式统治。1323年的《巴黎条约》确认荷兰伯爵兼任泽兰伯爵，因此1337年它由阿韦讷家族的威廉作为荷兰的封邑持有。1432年勃艮第公爵好人腓力吞并泽兰，1482年后它随勃艮第遗产一并归哈布斯堡家族，成为十七省之一。八十年战争中泽兰加入反西班牙的起义，1581年起成为尼德兰七联省共和国的七省之一，直到1795年巴达维亚革命废除伯国。

en: Vohipeno is a settlement on the Matitana river near the southeast coast of Madagascar, in the coastal country of Imoro that was the homeland of the Zafiraminia. The Zafiraminia, whose name means descendants of Ramini, were Muslim seafarers who reached Madagascar around the thirteenth century, at least a century before the better-known Antemoro. Their leaders claimed descent from lines that moved from Mecca to Mangalore and then across the ocean, though many scholars trace them instead to Sumatra, Ramini being a medieval name for that island. Their overseas knowledge gave them high standing among local Malagasy communities, together with the exclusive right to perform the sombili ritual sacrifice to the ancestors. Around 1490 fresh Muslim migrants, the Antemoro, began settling the same coast, and the long rivalry between the two groups ended in the sixteenth century when an Antemoro kingdom supplanted Zafiraminia power.
zh: 武希佩努是马达加斯加东南海岸马蒂塔纳河畔的定居点，地处伊莫罗沿海地带，即扎菲拉米尼亚人的故土。扎菲拉米尼亚意为拉米尼的后裔，是约13世纪抵达马达加斯加的穆斯林航海者，比更为人知的安泰莫罗人至少早一个世纪。他们的首领自称先祖从麦加迁至门格洛尔，再渡海而来；但许多学者认为他们其实来自苏门答腊，因为拉米尼正是中世纪对该岛的称呼。他们带来的海外知识使其在当地马尔加什社群中地位崇高，并独享向祖先举行松比利祭祀的特权。约1490年，新的穆斯林移民安泰莫罗人开始在同一海岸定居，两个群体长期相争，到16世纪以安泰莫罗王国取代扎菲拉米尼亚人的权势告终。

en: Zagha, the medieval Arabic name for the delta town of Dia, is a sultanate on the Diaka channel at the western edge of the Inner Niger Delta, ruled by a sultan who held the land as a vassal of the Mansa of Mali. It is one of the oldest settled places in West Africa: the mound of Dia-Shoma was occupied from the 800s BCE, and the three linked settlements of Dia reached their height around the 900s, a river-trade crossroads passed in turn between the empires of Ghana, Mali and Songhai. Bozo and Somono fishermen were its first inhabitants, later joined by Marka Soninke rice-growers and merchants and by Fulani herders. Diakhanke tradition honours Dia as the town of the saintly marabout Suware, and fourteenth-century Arab travel accounts, including that of Ibn Battuta, attest its reputation as a Muslim centre. In later times the Diawara family, ruling under the name Traore and keeping to the old rites, held the town until the Fulani jihad of 1818, when Seku Amadu displaced them and installed clerical rulers.
zh: 扎加是中世纪阿拉伯文献对三角洲城镇迪亚的称呼，这个苏丹国位于内陆三角洲西缘的迪亚卡水道畔，由一位苏丹作为马里曼萨的附庸统治。它是西非最古老的人居地之一：迪亚肖马土丘在公元前9世纪已有居民，迪亚三处相连的聚落在10世纪前后臻于鼎盛，是河上贸易的枢纽，先后处在加纳、马里和桑海诸帝国的势力范围内。博佐和索莫诺渔民是最早的居民，后来又有马尔卡（索宁克）稻农、商人以及富拉尼牧民迁入。迪亚汉克人的传统把迪亚尊为圣徒式马拉布特苏瓦雷的城镇，14世纪的阿拉伯行纪（包括伊本·白图泰的记载）也印证了它作为伊斯兰学术中心的声望。后来迪亚瓦拉家族以特拉奥雷为姓统治此城，固守旧有仪礼，直到1818年富拉尼圣战中谢赫·阿马杜将其取代，改立僧侣首领。

en: Zhonglu was a Tujia tusi holding in the Qing River valley of western Hubei, its seat at present-day Zhonglu in Lichuan, where the Ming stationed native offices under the Shizhou guard. Like the other tusi of western Hubei, it was absorbed into the regular provincial administration in 1735, when the Qing replaced native rule with the Shinan prefecture.
zh: 忠路是鄂西清江流域的土家族土司，治所在今利川市忠路镇一带，明代归施州卫体系下的各级土司机构管辖。它和鄂西其他土司一样，在1735年清朝改土归流时被纳入流官体系，其地划入新设的施南府。
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/恩施土家族苗族自治州

en: The Zi'b are an Adnanite Arab tribe of the great Banu Sulaym, tracing their descent from Zi'b ibn Malik, a scion of Sulaym ibn Mansur of the Qays. In early Islamic times their grazing grounds lay in the Hejaz between Mecca and Medina, around al-Suwariqiyya and al-Ghuraba and along the edge of the Rabadha reserve, the same country later centred on Ma'din Bani Sulaym. Together with the Banu Lam they dominated the high Najd steppe as far as the Empty Quarter until around 1400, when the Lam migrated north to Iraq and Syria. A bitter war with the Sharif of Mecca then broke the Zi'b: most of the tribe drifted east to the Gulf coast, while other clans took refuge in the Hauran, Jordan and Palestine, and their old Hejazi wells passed to other peoples.
zh: 齐卜是阿德南系阿拉伯部落，属巴努·苏莱姆大部落，谱系可上溯至盖斯部苏莱姆·伊本·曼苏尔的后裔齐卜·伊本·马利克。伊斯兰时代早期，他们的牧场位于麦加与麦地那之间的汉志，围绕苏瓦里吉耶、古拉巴以及拉巴扎保护区边缘活动，正是后来以苏莱姆矿镇为中心的那片地方。他们与巴努·拉姆联手，称雄于高内志草原，势力远达鲁卜哈利沙漠，直到1400年前后拉姆人北迁伊拉克和叙利亚。随后与麦加沙里夫的一场惨烈战争击垮了齐卜：大部分族人向东流落海湾沿岸，另一些氏族避往豪兰、约旦和巴勒斯坦，他们在汉志的古老水井则落入他人之手。

en: The Duchy of Ziębice, known in German as Münsterberg, was a Silesian Piast duchy centered on the hill town of Ziębice and covering roughly the later Ząbkowice region. Bolko I the Strict of Świdnica inherited the towns of Ziębice and Ząbkowice Śląskie in 1290 and completed the ducal castle there around 1300; after his sons divided the inheritance, the youngest, Bolko II of Ziębice, received the lands in 1321 and was the first to style himself Duke of Ziębice. A long quarrel with the bishop of Wrocław brought interdicts and excommunication down on his duchy, and after Charles IV of Bohemia besieged Ząbkowice, Bolko recognized Bohemian suzerainty in the Treaty of Straubing of 1336. He died in 1341 and was buried at Henryków Abbey. His son Nicholas the Small ruled until 1358, and the local Piast line ended when Duke Jan was killed fighting the Hussites at the Battle of Altwilmsdorf in 1428. The duchy then escheated to the Bohemian crown, passing through pledged lords to George of Poděbrady in 1456 and to his Poděbrady successors; it reverted to the crown in 1569, was granted to the Auersperg princes in 1654, and came under Prussia with the rest of Silesia in 1742.
zh: 津比采公国（德语称明斯特贝格）是西里西亚皮雅斯特家族的公国，以山城津比采为中心，疆域大致相当于后来的宗布科维采地区。1290年，希维德尼察的博尔科一世（“严厉者”）继承了津比采和希隆斯克地区宗布科维采两城，并于1300年前后在当地建成公爵城堡。他的儿子们瓜分遗产时，幼子津比采的博尔科二世于1321年分得这些土地，第一个自称津比采公爵。他与弗罗茨瓦夫主教长期争执，公国数次遭禁罚、公爵本人被革出教会；波希米亚的查理四世围攻宗布科维采后，博尔科在1336年的《施特劳宾条约》中承认波希米亚的宗主权。他于1341年去世，葬在亨利库夫修道院。其子尼古拉（“小个子”）统治到1358年；1428年，公爵约翰在阿尔特维尔姆斯多夫战役中与胡斯派作战身亡，当地的皮雅斯特世系就此断绝。公国随后收归波希米亚王冠，几经质押转手，1456年归波杰布拉德的伊日及其后裔；1569年又收回王室，1654年封给奥尔斯佩格亲王，1742年随西里西亚大部并入普鲁士。

en: The County of Ziegenhain was a Hessian lordship of the Holy Roman Empire, taking its name from the castle built by Count Gottfried I, whose family had styled themselves Counts of Ziegenhain since 1144. Growing out of the hereditary advocacy of Fulda Abbey, together with allodial lands and fiefs held from Mainz, Fulda and Hersfeld, the county came to fill the gap between the Burgwald and Knüll hills, almost severing Lower from Upper Hesse. In 1205 the Ziegenhains also inherited the County of Nidda in the Wetterau, and a younger son, Burkart, rose to be Archbishop of Salzburg in 1247. The two counties were split between branches and reunited in 1330, when Count John I, the ruler in 1337, married the Nidda heiress Lukardis; in 1344 he sold the old Fulda advocacy back to the abbey while retaining the hereditary office of its marshal. The last count, John II the Strong, died without male heirs in 1450, and a long inheritance dispute between Hesse and the House of Hohenlohe ended in 1495 with the county passing to the Landgraves of Hesse.
zh: 齐根海恩伯国是神圣罗马帝国在黑森的领地，得名于戈特弗里德一世伯爵所建的城堡，其家族自1144年起自称齐根海恩伯爵。伯国以世袭的富尔达修道院护院权为根基，加上自主地以及从美因茨、富尔达和黑斯费尔德持有的封邑，逐渐占据了堡林山与克尼尔山之间的要冲，几乎把下黑森与上黑森隔断。1205年，齐根海恩家族又继承了韦特劳地区的尼达伯国；家族幼子布尔卡特于1247年升任萨尔茨堡大主教。两个伯国曾在支系间分治，1330年重新合并：1337年在位的约翰一世伯爵娶了尼达女继承人卢卡迪斯；1344年，他把古老的富尔达护院权卖回给修道院，只保留世袭的修道院元帅一职。末代伯爵“强者”约翰二世于1450年无男嗣而终，黑森与霍恩洛厄家族展开长期继承之争，1495年伯国最终归于黑森方伯。

en: Zinapecuaro, the place of obsidian or place of healing in the Purépecha language, lies in the hills northeast of Lake Cuitzeo in present-day Michoacan, and the obsidian quarries of its Ucareo valley were among the largest in pre-Hispanic Mesoamerica, supplying Tula and Xochicalco in the Classic period and traded as far as Chichen Itza. In the Postclassic era the district, whose frontier population included Otomi and Matlatzinca farmers, was absorbed into the Purépecha Empire of the cazonci Hirepan and his successors, who built a temple there to the mother goddess Cuerauaperi. It was still a subject frontier town when the Spanish conquistador Luis Montanez founded a settlement on the spot around 1530, and the insurgent forces of Miguel Hidalgo occupied it during the independence rising of 1810.
zh: 锡纳佩夸罗在普雷佩查语中意为黑曜石之地或治愈之地，位于今米却肯州奎采奥湖东北的丘陵地带；其乌卡雷奥谷地的黑曜石矿是史前美索美洲规模最大的矿源之一，古典时期供应图拉和霍奇卡尔科，商路远达奇琴伊察。后古典时期，这一带的边民中包括奥托米和马特拉钦卡农人，被卡松奇伊雷潘及其继承者的普雷佩查帝国吞并，统治者还在当地为母神奎拉瓦佩里修建神庙。西班牙征服者路易斯·蒙塔涅斯约于1530年在此建镇时，它仍是帝国的边境属镇；1810年独立起义期间，米格尔·伊达尔戈的起义军曾占领此地。

en: Muyquyta was the chief seat of the zipa, ruler of the southern Muisca confederation on the Bogotá savanna of the Colombian Andes. Called Muyquytá in the Muisca tongue and standing on the site of present-day Funza near the settlement of Bacatá, it headed a loose network of matrilineal chiefdoms whose rulers were succeeded by a sister's son; the zipa's gold offerings on sacred Lake Guatavita are thought to have inspired the legend of El Dorado. In 1514 Tisquesusa became zipa and fought repeated wars with the northern Muisca of Hunza. When Gonzalo Jiménez de Quesada climbed into the highlands in 1537, Tisquesusa abandoned the capital and was killed near Facatativá. His brother Sagipa, the last zipa, joined the Spanish against the Panche and won the Battle of Tocarema in 1538, but was then tortured for gold and died at Bosa in 1539. His lands became the core of the Spanish New Kingdom of Granada.
zh: 穆伊奎塔是锡帕的首府，锡帕是哥伦比亚安第斯山区波哥大平原上南穆伊斯卡联盟的统治者。它在穆伊斯卡语中称穆伊奎塔，位于今丰萨一带、邻近巴卡塔聚落，统辖着一个按母系组成的松散酋长邦网络，统治者由姐妹之子继承；锡帕在圣湖瓜塔维塔献上金器的仪式，被认为是黄金国传说的由来。1514年蒂斯克苏萨成为锡帕，与温萨的北穆伊斯卡连年交战。1537年贡萨洛·希门尼斯·德·克萨达攻入高原，蒂斯克苏萨弃都而走，在法卡塔蒂瓦附近被杀。他的弟弟萨希帕是末代锡帕，与西班牙人联手在1538年的托卡雷马战役中击败潘切人，随后却因索要黄金遭受酷刑，于1539年在博萨死去。他的土地成为西班牙新格拉纳达王国的核心。

en: Zhonglindong was a Kam native chieftaincy in the Qingshui River hills, its seat at Zhongling in present-day Jinping County, Guizhou. Under the Mongol Yuan the area was ruled through the Tian family of Sizhou, and the Ming re-established the Zhonglin Yandong native long commandery in 1403. It was one of the seven Kam commanderies grouped under Xinhua Prefecture when that prefecture was created in the Yongle reign, and in 1434, after Xinhua was abolished, it passed to Liping Prefecture. Nearby Tonggu, the garrison town of the district, was fortified as the Tonggu Guard in 1397 and re-established in 1405, before the Qing turned it into Jinping County in 1727.
zh: 中林峒是清水江山区的一个侗族土司，治所在今贵州省锦屏县钟灵一带。元代时这一地区由思州田氏代为统辖，1403年明朝重新设置中林验洞蛮夷长官司。永乐年间朝廷设立新化府，它是府下管辖的七个侗族长官司之一；1434年新化府被废除后，辖地改隶黎平府。其地附近的铜鼓是山区的驻军要镇，1397年筑为铜鼓卫，1405年又重新设置，1727年清朝将铜鼓卫改置为锦屏县。

en: The Kingdom of Kozhikode, on the Malabar coast of southwestern India, was ruled by the Samoothiri, known to Europeans as the Zamorin. Its dynasty originated at Nediyiruppu inland, where Eradi chiefs governed Eranad under the Chera kings; after a long struggle they seized the marshy port of Kozhikode from the ruler of Polanadu and moved their capital there. By the fourteenth century Kozhikode was the leading spice port of the Kerala coast, crowded with Arab and Chinese merchants, and the traveller Ibn Battuta recorded the Zamorin's title in 1342. Vasco da Gama landed nearby in 1498, opening the direct sea route from Europe, while the Zamorin's Muslim admirals, the Kunjali Marakkars, fought the Portuguese for the pepper trade through the sixteenth century. The Dutch displaced the Portuguese in the seventeenth century and were themselves displaced by the British. When Hyder Ali of Mysore overran Malabar in 1766 the reigning Zamorin burned himself in his palace rather than submit; after the Third Mysore War the Treaty of Seringapatam of 1792 handed Malabar to the British East India Company, reducing the Zamorin to a pensioned landlord.
zh: 科泽科德王国位于印度西南的马拉巴尔海岸，统治者称萨穆特里，欧洲人通称扎莫林。该王朝发源于内陆的内迪伊鲁普，埃拉迪酋长们曾在哲罗诸王治下管辖埃拉纳德；经过长期争夺，他们从波拉纳德首领手中夺取了沼泽地带的港口科泽科德，并迁都于此。到14世纪，科泽科德已是喀拉拉海岸首屈一指的香料港，阿拉伯和中国商人云集，旅行家伊本·白图泰于1342年记下了扎莫林的称号。1498年瓦斯科·达伽马在附近登陆，打通了欧洲直通南亚的航路；扎莫林麾下的穆斯林海军将领昆贾利·马拉卡尔家族在整个16世纪与葡萄牙人争夺胡椒贸易。17世纪荷兰人取代葡萄牙人，随后又被英国人排挤。1766年迈索尔的海德尔·阿里攻陷马拉巴尔，在位的扎莫林焚宫自尽，不肯臣服；第三次英迈战争后，1792年的《塞林伽巴丹条约》把马拉巴尔交给英国东印度公司，扎莫林沦为领取年金的地主。

en:
The Kingdom of Great Zimbabwe was a Shona state on the high plateau of what is now Zimbabwe, ruled from the stone city of Great Zimbabwe, whose name means houses of stone in the Karanga tongue. The site had been occupied by proto-Karanga farmers since about the year 1000, and from the thirteenth century its kings raised massive dry-stone walls without mortar; around 1300 it supplanted Mapungubwe as the leading trading power of the southern African interior. At its apogee the capital held some ten thousand people around the Hill Complex and the Great Enclosure, the royal residence, and the kingdom comprised more than a hundred and fifty tributary chiefdoms, each with its own lesser zimbabwe. Its sacred king, the mambo, drew wealth from cattle and from gold carried down the Save and Runde rivers to Swahili ports such as Sofala, whence Persian pottery and Chinese celadon found their way back to the capital.

From the early fifteenth century the gold trade shifted north toward the Zambezi, and a royal prince, Nyatsimba Mutota, led part of the population away to found the Mutapa Empire. Power passed to the Mutapa state in the north and to the Kingdom of Butua at Khami in the west; Great Zimbabwe itself remained inhabited, and Mutapa kings still kept wives and rituals there in the sixteenth century, before the city was finally abandoned in the seventeenth century. Portuguese traders heard reports of its stone edifices from Swahili merchants in the early sixteenth century.
zh:
大津巴布韦王国是位于今津巴布韦高原上的绍纳人国家，定都于石城大津巴布韦，其名在卡兰加语中意为“石屋”。约1000年起，原始卡兰加农人已在此定居，13世纪起历代国王不用灰浆垒起宏大的干石城墙；约1300年，它取代马蓬古布韦，成为南部非洲内陆首屈一指的贸易强国。鼎盛时期，都城围绕山丘建筑群和王宫所在的大围场聚居约一万人，王国由一百五十多个纳贡酋长国组成，各有自己的小“津巴布韦”石城。神圣国王称曼博，财富来自畜牧，以及沿萨韦河和伦德河运往索法拉等斯瓦希里港口的黄金，波斯陶器和中国青瓷也循此路回流都城。

15世纪初起，黄金贸易北移至赞比西河一线，王室宗亲尼亚钦巴·穆托塔率部众北迁，另建穆塔帕帝国。权力随后落入北方的穆塔帕和西方以卡米为都的布图阿王国之手；大津巴布韦仍有人居住，16世纪穆塔帕君主还在城中安置妃嫔、举行仪式，直到17世纪这座城市终遭废弃。16世纪初，葡萄牙商人就从斯瓦希里商人那里听说了它的石造殿堂。

en: Zanskar was a remote Buddhist kingdom in the high Himalayan valleys southwest of Ladakh, centered on Zangla and Padum. When Kyide Nyimagon's kingdom was divided around 930, his youngest son Detsukgon inherited Zanskar together with Lahul and Spiti. Two related royal houses arose there in the tenth and eleventh centuries, when the monasteries of Karsha and Phugtal were founded, and until the fifteenth century Zanskar remained a largely independent kingdom ruled by two to four related families. In the early seventeenth century Sengge Namgyal of Ladakh conquered it and folded it into his expanding realm, whose fate Zanskar then shared, remaining inside Ladakh after the Treaty of Tingmosgang in 1684. In 1822 a coalition of Kulu, Lahaul and Kinnaur raided the valleys and destroyed its royal palace.
zh: 桑迦是拉达克西南方向喜马拉雅高山河谷中的偏远佛教王国，以藏拉和巴敦一带为中心。约930年吉德尼玛衮的王国分裂时，幼子德祖衮继承了桑迦以及拉胡尔、斯皮提。10至11世纪，这里兴起两个彼此联姻的王室，卡尔夏寺和普克塔尔寺也于此时建成；直到15世纪，桑迦仍是由两到四个同族家族共治、基本独立的王国。17世纪初，拉达克的僧格南嘉征服桑迦，把它并入扩张中的拉达克，桑迦从此与拉达克同命运，1684年《廷莫斯冈条约》后仍留在拉达克境内。1822年，库鲁、拉胡尔和金瑙尔的联军攻入河谷，摧毁了桑迦的王宫。

en: Zhen'an was a Zhuang native prefecture in the karst uplands of westernmost Guangxi, hard against the Annam frontier and covering the present-day Debao, Jingxi and Napo counties. The Yuan raised the old Zhen'an Prefecture to a route in 1292, with its seat at present-day Napo, and in 1369 the Ming reconstituted it as Zhen'an Prefecture, moving the seat east to present-day Debao. Its subordinate Guishun department, first created under the Tang and re-established in 1363, was placed back under Zhen'an in 1496. Under the early Qing Zhen'an remained a native prefecture; a regular assistant prefect was stationed there in 1663, and in 1729 the gaitu guiliu reform turned it into an ordinary prefecture, with Tianbao County installed as its seat in 1738.
zh: 镇安是广西最西端喀斯特山区的壮族土府，紧邻安南国界，辖境在今德保、靖西、那坡一带。元代至元二十九年（1292年）升镇安州为路，治所在今那坡县；明洪武二年（1369年）改路为镇安府，府治东移到今德保县。下辖的归顺州唐代始置、1363年复置，弘治九年（1496年）重新划归镇安府。清初仍为土府，康熙二年（1663年）朝廷派驻流官通判，雍正七年（1729年）改土归流、升为正式的府，乾隆三年（1738年）又置天保县作为府治。

en: Zhenxiong began as the country of the Mangbu tribe, a Wuman Yi people of the steep borderlands where Yunnan, Sichuan and Guizhou meet, ruled from their stronghold at Mangbu under the Nanzhao and Dali kingdoms. The Yuan created the Mangbu Route in 1285, and the Ming made it Mangbu Prefecture under Sichuan, governed by the hereditary Long clan of the Yi. A succession feud destroyed the peace: after the recognized heir Long Shou was lured to his death by his half-brother Long Zheng and the official seal was seized in 1525, Ming forces intervened and in 1526 carried out gaitu guiliu, renaming the territory the Zhenxiong Military and Civilian Prefecture and moving the seat south; it became the regular prefecture of Zhenxiong in 1609. Native resistance smouldered on in the hills. The Qing transferred Zhenxiong from Sichuan to Yunnan in 1727, and when its tribes joined the great Wumeng rising of 1728 led by Lu Wanfu the revolt was crushed and Zhenxiong was reduced to a department under Zhaotong Prefecture, the old chieftain order at last replaced by appointed officials.
zh: 镇雄的前身是芒部，一支乌蛮彝人的部族之邦，盘踞在云南、四川、贵州交界的崇山峻岭中，南诏、大理时期以芒部为据点进行统治。1285年元朝置芒部路，明朝改设芒部府，隶属四川，由彝族陇氏世袭土知府。一场承袭仇杀打破了平静：1525年，合法继承人陇寿被庶弟陇政诱杀，官印也被夺走，明军随即介入，于1526年推行改土归流，改芒部府为镇雄军民府，并将治所南移；1609年定名镇雄府。彝民的抵抗在山中延续未息。1727年清朝将镇雄由四川改隶云南，1728年镇雄彝部又参加乌蒙禄万福的大起义，事败之后镇雄被降为昭通府属下的镇雄州，旧有的土司秩序终被流官取代。

en: Zhenzhou lies in the northern Guizhou mountains on the upper Furong River, where Sui and other hill peoples meet the Sichuan basin. In the early Song it belonged to Zhenzhou and Luoyuan County; under the Yuan it became the Zhenzhou Sining chief's office under the Zunyi administration. In 1363 Ming Yuzhen, who ruled Sichuan as the Xia state, changed the character of its name from Zhen to Zhen, and the Ming confirmed it in 1384 as the Zhenzhou chief's office, a dependency of the Yang clan of Bozhou, northern Guizhou's great tusi house. When the Bozhou rebellion of Yang Yinglong was crushed in 1600, the office was replaced in 1601 by the regular prefecture of Zhen'an, and in 1724 it was renamed Zheng'an to avoid the personal name of the Yongzheng emperor.
zh: 真州地处贵州北部山地、芙蓉江上游，是水族等山地民族与四川盆地相接的地方。宋初它属珍州乐源县，元代设珍州思宁长官司，归遵义方面的机构管辖。1363年割据四川的大夏君主明玉珍将珍州改名为真州，明朝又于1384年确认为真州长官司，作为黔北最大土司播州杨氏的辖地。1600年杨应龙的播州之乱被平定后，朝廷于1601年改土归流，以真州长官司地置真安州；1724年为避雍正帝名讳，真安州改名为正安州。

en: Tzompanco, the Coixca town whose Nahuatl name refers to the tzompantli skull rack, stood in the Sierra Madre del Sur of Guerrero; the Spanish mining town that later occupied its district is Zumpango del Río. The Coixcas were Nahuatl-speaking highlanders whose city-states were drawn into the Aztec Triple Alliance under Ahuitzotl, and Tzompanco became the seat of a strategic province covering Tixtla, Mochitlán and Huitziltepec, paying tribute in gold dust and war captives. Its traders carried maize, chilies, honey and turkeys to the Pacific coast in exchange for cacao, while its ruler, styled a general, led campaigns against the Yope people to the south. Silver lodes discovered in 1531 by Francisco de Hoyos and Juan Jaramillo launched colonial mining, which used Indian slave labour until the practice was banned in 1550; the mines were largely abandoned by 1582.
zh: 聪潘科是科伊克斯卡人的城镇，纳瓦特尔语名字源自献祭用的骷髅架，城址在格雷罗州的南马德雷山脉，后来占据这一地区的西班牙矿业城镇即今松潘戈德尔里奥。科伊克斯卡人是说纳瓦语的高地居民，其城邦在阿维特索特尔时代被并入阿兹特克三方同盟，聪潘科成为一个战略省的治所，下辖蒂斯特拉、莫奇特兰和维西尔特佩克，以金粉和战俘纳贡。商人把玉米、辣椒、蜂蜜和火鸡运往太平洋海岸换回可可；统治者被称为“将军”，主要率军向南征讨约佩人。1531年，弗朗西斯科·德·奥约斯和胡安·哈拉米略发现银脉，殖民矿业由此兴起，役使印第安奴隶直到1550年禁令出台；到1582年这些矿场大多已废弃。

en: The Zirqan were a Kurdish principality of the Zirki tribe whose rulers traced their line to the sheikh Hassan Zerraki. In 1335 Zeyd, a descendant of Hassan, captured Boğat castle near Silvan, the ancient Mayyafariqin north of Mardin, and founded the principality, which came to comprise the Ataq, Tercil, Gürdükan and Mihrani districts. Its greatest days came under the Aq Qoyunlu, when it held Mardin, Diyarbakır and Bitlis; the Aq Qoyunlu ruler Uzun Hasan married a daughter of its emir Omer and granted Bitlis to the dynasty. Safavid armies overran most of its lands in 1507, but after the Ottoman victory at Chaldiran in 1514 the Zirqan emirs were confirmed as autonomous frontier lords under Selim I, and the Ahmet Bey Mosque survives from their fifteenth-century building. Gürdükan passed to Bitlis in 1709, and after the emirs declared independence in 1830 an Ottoman army defeated them in 1835 and exiled the family to Edirne, ending the principality.
zh: 齐尔坎是齐尔基部落的库尔德公国，统治者把世系追溯到谢赫·哈桑·兹拉基。1335年，哈桑的后裔扎伊德攻占马尔丁以北、古称玛亚法里钦的锡尔万附近的博阿特城堡，建立公国，版图后来包括阿塔克、泰尔吉勒、居尔迪坎和米拉尼四个地区。它在白羊王朝时期达到鼎盛，领有马尔丁、迪亚巴克尔和比特利斯；白羊君主乌尊·哈桑娶了埃米尔奥马尔的女儿，并把比特利斯封给该家族。1507年萨法维军队攻占其大部分领地，但1514年查尔迪兰战役奥斯曼获胜后，塞利姆一世承认齐尔坎埃米尔为自治的边疆领主，艾哈迈德贝伊清真寺就是其15世纪建筑的遗存。1709年居尔迪坎并入比特利斯；1830年埃米尔们宣布独立，1835年被奥斯曼军队击败，家族被流放至埃迪尔内，公国就此灭亡。
