From 1636 the emperors made Gondar their permanent capital, giving its name to a period of castles and church art, before the eighteenth century brought the Zemene Mesafint, an age of rival regional lords that reduced the Solomonic emperors to figureheads.
zh: 阿姆哈拉人是埃塞俄比亚中部和北部高原上说阿姆哈拉语的东正教徒，历史故土包括塔纳湖周边的贝特阿姆哈拉、贡德尔、戈贾姆、拉斯塔和绍阿等地。他们是阿克苏姆后裔的基督教家庭向南迁入高原、同化当地库希特语族阿高人后形成的；阿姆哈拉语属南埃塞俄比亚闪米特语，作为宫廷和行政用语沿用了七百多年。阿姆哈拉之名最早见于12世纪的记载，1270年叶库诺·阿姆拉克推翻扎格维王朝、建立所罗门皇朝后，他们成为帝国的统治民族。1337年在位的是武功赫赫的阿姆达·塞约恩一世，他以流动的高原营帐为都，把基督教政权的势力扩展到东部低地的穆斯林诸邦；后继者于1456年在德布雷伯尔汉建起第一座固定都城。1529至1543年，阿达尔苏丹国的艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐率军入侵，重创基督教高原，最终加拉德沃斯皇帝在葡萄牙援助下取胜并重建国家。1636年起，皇帝们以贡德尔为固定都城，开启了以城堡和教堂艺术闻名的贡德尔时期；到18世纪，国家进入“王子时代”，地方豪强并起，所罗门皇帝沦为傀儡。

en: The Ç'amkoe are San foragers who speak ǂʼAmkoe, a Kxʼa language of south-eastern Botswana with three dialects, Nǃaqriaxe, ǂHoan and Sasi. Classed with the ǃKung Juu languages, it joins Taa and Gǀui at the core of the Kalahari Basin sprachbund. Most communities have shifted to neighbouring tongues such as Gǀui, Kgalagadi and Tswana.
zh: 阿姆科伊人是讲阿姆科伊语的桑人狩猎采集者，该语言属科语系，通行于博茨瓦纳东南部，分为恩库阿里亚赫、霍安、萨西三种方言。它与孔人的朱语合属科语系，并和塔语、格维语构成卡拉哈里盆地语言联盟的核心。多数社群已转用邻近的格维语、卡拉加迪语和茨瓦纳语。

en: The Amuzgos are an Oto-Manguean people of the Yacuyagua mountains on the Guerrero-Oaxaca border, around the towns of Xochistlahuaca, Tlacoachistlahuaca and Ometepec, whose speech belongs to the Mixtec branch and whose own names for themselves include Tzjon Noan, people of the thread. They once held a wider stretch of the Costa Chica down to the Pacific, but Mixtec expansion drove them into the highlands: around 1100 their capital Xochistlahuaca was subjugated, and for three centuries they paid tribute in cotton, cloth, feathers and gold as part of the Mixtec province of Ayacastla. The Aztecs took Ayacastla in 1457 but never mastered the Amuzgo country, and revolts in 1494 and 1504 to 1507 had to be put down by force. Pedro de Alvarado's men conquered the region in 1522; war, disease and overwork cut the people of Xochistlahuaca from some 20,000 to 200 by 1582, and the survivors retreated deeper into the Sierra Madre del Sur, where their backstrap-loom textiles and language survived the colonial centuries.
zh: 阿穆斯戈人是格雷罗州与瓦哈卡州交界亚库亚瓜山区的奥托-曼格族群，聚居于索奇斯特拉瓦卡、特拉科阿契斯特拉瓦卡和奥梅特佩克等城镇；其语言属米斯特克语支，自称之一为特宗诺安，意为织线之民。他们曾据有从小海岸直到太平洋的更广阔地带，米斯特克人的扩张把他们逼进高地：约1100年，首府索奇斯特拉瓦卡被征服，此后三百年间他们作为米斯特克人阿亚卡斯特拉省的一部分，以棉花、布匹、羽毛和黄金纳贡。阿兹特克人于1457年夺取阿亚卡斯特拉，却始终未能真正控制阿穆斯戈山区，1494年和1504至1507年的起义都靠武力才镇压下去。1522年，佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多的军队征服此地；战乱、疫病和劳役使索奇斯特拉瓦卡的人口从约两万人锐减到1582年的两百人，幸存者进一步退入南马德雷山脉深处，其腰带织机纺织传统和语言则延续过整个殖民时代。

en: The Anambé are a Tupi-Guarani people of the lower Tocantins, living in the river delta and the Cairari River country of Pará, where they kept to forest villages before sustained contact with Brazilian settlers began in the nineteenth century.
zh: 阿南贝人是托坎廷斯河下游的图皮-瓜拉尼族群，住在帕拉州的河口三角洲和凯拉里河流域，在19世纪与巴西定居者建立持续接触之前，一直以林中村落居民的身份生活。

en: The Anauls were a Yukaghir tribal group who lived along the upper Anadyr River in the far northeast of Siberia and spoke the Chuvan, or coastal, variant of Yukaghir. Unlike the nomadic reindeer groups, they were settled river fishermen and hunters; their name derives from a Chukchi word meaning the people living on the Enmyvaam. They had a reputation as the most warlike of the Yukaghir clans, yet their settled camps made them an easy target for Russian fur collectors. Fighting began in 1649 when Semyon Dezhnev's detachment reached the Anadyr, and in 1650 the chief Kogyunya's men killed nine Russian traders before Dezhnev stormed their fortified camp. Rivalry with neighboring groups, epidemics and Tsarist tribute policy scattered and reduced the Anauls, and they disappeared as a distinct people in the colonial period.
zh: 阿瑙尔斯人是尤卡吉尔人的一个部落群体，住在西伯利亚极东北部的阿纳德尔河上游，说尤卡吉尔语的丘万（沿海）变体。与游牧的养鹿群体不同，他们是定居河畔的渔猎部落，族名出自楚科奇语，意为“住在恩米瓦阿姆河上的人”。他们在尤卡吉尔各部中以好战著称，但定居的营地反而使他们容易成为俄国毛皮税征收者的目标。1649年谢苗·杰日尼奥夫的队伍抵达阿纳德尔，双方开战；1650年酋长科古尼亚的部下杀死九名俄国商人，杰日尼奥夫随即强攻其堡寨。此后部族仇杀、疫病和沙皇的贡赋政策使阿瑙尔斯人不断流散衰减，最终在殖民时代作为独立群体消亡。

en: The Anccara, also written Angaraes or Ankaras, were the Quechua-speaking people of the cold highlands around modern Huancavelica, in the central Peruvian sierra, whose señorío took shape in the Late Intermediate Period across the present provinces of Angaraes, Huancavelica and Acobamba. Their earliest farming and herding ancestors had occupied these mountains long before, and the region was later drawn into the Wari cultural sphere; as an independent nation the Anccara kept up both alliances and border wars with the Yauyos, Wanka, Andamarca and other neighbouring peoples. Together with the Chanca and the Pokra they joined the Chanca confederation that marched on Cusco and was shattered by the young Pachacuti, and in the 1460s Inca armies under Pachacuti brought the Anccara lands directly into the Tawantinsuyu, building administrative centers along the royal road and deporting part of the population as mitimaes while planting loyal colonies in their place. After the Spanish conquest their territory was attached from the 1540s to the repartimiento of Huamanga, and the discovery of the great Huancavelica mercury mines transformed the region: the town of Lircay was founded in 1572 as a mining and reduction center, and in 1612 the old Anccara corregimiento was divided between Castrovirreyna and Huancavelica.
zh: 安加赖人又译安加赖斯或安卡拉人，是秘鲁中部山区今万卡韦利卡一带寒冷高原上讲克丘亚语的族群；在晚中间期，他们的领主政权成型，疆域涵盖今天的安加赖斯、万卡韦利卡和阿科班巴诸省。最早在这片山地务农放牧的先民年代久远，后来该地区又被纳入瓦里文化圈；作为独立民族，安加赖人与亚维尤、万卡、安达马卡等邻族时战时和。他们与昌卡人、波克拉人共同加入昌卡联盟，进军库斯科，却被年轻的帕查库特克击溃；15世纪60年代，帕查库特克的印加军队直接吞并安加赖土地，在皇家大道沿线修建行政中心，把一部分居民作为米蒂马伊人迁走，同时迁入效忠印加的殖民群体。西班牙征服后，他们的土地从16世纪40年代起划归瓦曼加委托监护区；万卡韦利卡大汞矿的发现改变了整个地区，1572年利尔凯建城，成为矿业和归化中心，1612年旧安加赖督辖区又被拆分给卡斯特罗维雷纳和万卡韦利卡。

en:
The Hisatsinom, the Hopi word for ancient people, is the name the Pueblo descendants give to the farming culture archaeologists call the Ancestral Puebloans (also the Anasazi or the Basketmaker-Pueblo culture), centered on the Colorado Plateau in the Four Corners country where Utah, Arizona, New Mexico and Colorado meet. Their tradition took shape around the twelfth century BCE, and from about 700 to 1130 steady rainfall supported a tenfold rise in population. In Chaco Canyon they raised fifteen great houses of dressed sandstone, some with 700 rooms and great kivas aligned to the cycles of the sun and moon, while Mesa Verde preserves their cliff dwellings built under canyon overhangs. Maize, beans and squash, watered by check dams and terraces, fed towns joined by hundreds of miles of engineered roads.

A fifty-year drought beginning in 1130 emptied Chaco Canyon, and in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries renewed droughts, eroded soils and pressure from incoming Numic and Athabaskan groups drove the villagers out of the Four Corners, many first retreating to fortified mesa tops. By the fourteenth century the great houses and cliff dwellings stood abandoned. The people did not disappear: they migrated south and east into the Pueblo villages of the Rio Grande and Arizona, among them the Hopi, who still remember the builders as the Hisatsinom.
zh:
“希萨齐农”是霍皮语“古人”的意思，是普韦布洛后裔对考古学所称古代普韦布洛人（又称阿那萨吉文化、篮手—普韦布洛文化）的称呼，其核心区在犹他、亚利桑那、新墨西哥和科罗拉多四州交界的四角落地区，以科罗拉多高原为中心。这一传统约形成于公元前12世纪；700年至1130年间，稳定的降雨使人口增长了约十倍。他们在查科峡谷用修整过的砂岩建起十五座大屋，有的含七百个房间，还有按日月运行方位排列的大基瓦；梅萨维德则留存着他们修在悬崖凹壁下的崖居。依靠谷坊和梯田灌溉的玉米、豆类与南瓜，供养着由数百英里道路相连的城镇。

1130年开始的一场持续五十年的大旱使查科峡谷沦为空谷；12至13世纪，连年干旱、土壤退化，加上努米克语和阿萨巴斯卡语族群迁入的压力，把村民逼出四角落地区，许多人先退守设防的台地顶端，再向南、向东迁徙。到14世纪，大屋和崖居已全部荒废。但这些人并未消失：他们融入里奥格兰德河和亚利桑那的普韦布洛村落，霍皮人便是其中之一，在霍皮语里把这些建造者称作希萨齐农。

en: The Andalusi are the Arabic-speaking Muslims of southern Iberia and the heirs of the civilization of al-Andalus, born of the Muslim conquest of 711. Out of Arab and Berber settlers and the mass of local Iberian converts, the Muladíes, a single Andalusi identity speaking Andalusi Arabic had emerged by the 1200s, sharing its cities with Mozarabic Christians and Jews. Their world had known the Umayyad caliphate of Córdoba, whose tenth-century scholars led Europe in astronomy, medicine and philosophy, the rival taifa kingdoms that followed its fall in 1031, and the rule of the Almoravids and the Almohads. As Christian kingdoms pressed south in the thirteenth century, the Nasrid emir Ibn al-Ahmar founded in 1238 the Emirate of Granada, the last Muslim state on the peninsula, which paid tribute to Castile and adorned its capital with the palaces of the Alhambra. In 1337 it still held Granada, Málaga and Almería, but the city of Granada fell to the Catholic Monarchs in 1492. Castile outlawed Islam in 1502; the forced converts, the Moriscos, rose in the Alpujarras in 1568 and were crushed and dispersed, and between 1609 and 1614 the crown expelled them by the tens of thousands, most finding refuge in Morocco and the Ottoman lands.
zh: 安达卢斯人是伊比利亚南部讲阿拉伯语的穆斯林，是711年穆斯林征服后诞生的安达卢斯文明的继承者。阿拉伯和柏柏尔定居者与大批本地改宗的穆拉迪人长期融合，到13世纪形成了统一的安达卢斯认同，使用安达卢斯阿拉伯语，与莫扎拉布基督徒和犹太人共居城市。他们的世界经历过倭马亚家族的科尔多瓦哈里发国——10世纪时其学者在天文、医学和哲学领域领先欧洲——1031年哈里发国瓦解后群雄并立的泰法诸国，以及穆拉比特王朝和穆瓦希德王朝的统治。13世纪基督教诸王国南下，纳扎里王朝的埃米尔伊本·艾哈迈尔于1238年建立格拉纳达王国，这是半岛上最后的穆斯林政权，向卡斯蒂利亚称臣纳贡，并用阿尔罕布拉宫的宫殿装点都城。1337年，它仍据有格拉纳达、马拉加和阿尔梅里亚，但1492年格拉纳达城落入天主教双王之手。1502年卡斯蒂利亚取缔伊斯兰教；被迫改宗者称摩里斯科人，1568年在阿尔普哈拉斯起义，遭镇压后被打散迁居；1609至1614年，王室又将数以万计的摩里斯科人驱逐出境，多数人避难于摩洛哥和奥斯曼帝国。

en: The Andamanese are the Negrito hunter-gatherers of the Andaman Islands in the Bay of Bengal, divided into the Great Andamanese and Jarawa of the main archipelago, the Onge of Little Andaman and the Sentinelese of North Sentinel Island, each speaking mutually unintelligible languages. They settled the islands at the end of the last ice age, more than twenty thousand years ago, and lived in near-total isolation, meeting outsiders with arrows; the Chola king Rajendra I nevertheless seized the chain as a naval base against Srivijaya, and the Thanjavur inscription of 1050 names it Ma-Nakkavaram. Zhao Rugua's Zhu Fan Zhi described the islands in 1225, and Marco Polo's travels of 1294 repeated sailors' tales of dog-headed cannibals there, so in 1337 the Andamanese remained a people known to the wider world only through rumour. That seclusion ended in 1789, when the Bengal Presidency built a penal settlement at Port Blair; disease cut deep into the islanders, the post was abandoned in 1796, and in 1824 its harbour served the British fleet in the First Anglo-Burmese War.
zh: 安达曼人是孟加拉湾安达曼群岛的尼格利陀狩猎采集者，分为主群岛上的大安达曼人和加洛瓦人、小安达曼岛的翁格人，以及北森蒂纳尔岛的森蒂纳尔人，各说互不相通的语言。他们在上一个冰河时代末期、两万多年前便定居群岛，此后几乎与外界完全隔绝，以箭矢迎接外来者；尽管如此，朱罗国王拉金德拉一世仍夺取这条岛链作为进攻室利佛逝的海军基地，1050年的坦贾武尔碑铭将其记为“大纳卡瓦拉姆”。1225年赵汝适的《诸蕃志》描述过这些岛屿，1294年马可·波罗的行记又转述了海员有关狗头食人族的传说，因此在1337年，安达曼人仍是一个外界只凭传闻知晓的民族。这种封闭状态在1789年终结：英属孟加拉管辖区在布莱尔港建立流放地，疾病使岛民人口锐减，该据点于1796年放弃，1824年其港湾又为第一次英缅战争中的英国舰队充当集结地。

en: The Andaquí, also called Aguanunga or Churuba, are an indigenous people of the forested eastern foothills of the Colombian Andes, settled in the upper Caquetá basin, the Fragua valley in Cauca and the Suaza valley of southwestern Huila. They were among the Upper Magdalena nations drawn into the great rising of 1536 led by the cacica Gaitana against the Spanish, though conquistador texts first name them only in the late sixteenth century. In 1637 they and the Pijao attacked the conquistador Francisco Dias, an incident entered in the town records of Timaná. Their resistance ran on into the next century: the 1721 rebellion united the Andakí, Tama and Mocoa peoples of the Putumayo and Caquetá against the colonial advance. Their language, recorded in a word list compiled in 1788, was later classed as Chibchan by linguists following Paul Rivet, though other scholars treat it as an isolate.
zh: 安达基人又称阿瓜农加人或丘鲁巴人，是哥伦比亚安第斯山脉东麓林区的原住民，聚居于卡克塔河上游、考卡省的弗拉瓜谷地和乌伊拉省西南部的苏阿萨谷地。1536年女酋长盖塔娜领导反抗西班牙人的大起义时，马格达莱纳河上游诸部纷纷响应，安达基人也在其中，但征服者的文书直到16世纪末才首次提到他们的名字。1637年，他们与皮豪人联手袭击征服者弗朗西斯科·迪亚斯，此事被记入蒂马纳的市政档案。他们的抵抗延续到下一个世纪：1721年的起义把普图马约和卡克塔的安达基、塔马、莫科阿诸部联合起来，共同抗击殖民扩张。他们的语言在1788年编纂的一份词汇表中留有记录，后世语言学家承袭保罗·里韦的观点将其归入奇布查语系，但也有学者认为它是一门孤立语言。

en: The Anejom are the people of Aneityum, the southernmost inhabited island of Vanuatu, whose language of the same name is the island's only indigenous tongue, a Southern Vanuatu branch of the Oceanic group most closely related to the languages of Tanna. Aneityum was settled around 874 BC by voyagers from Tanna, who first kept to coastal hillsides and later moved into the valleys as land and population pressed. Traditionally the island was ruled by chiefs called natimarid over many chiefdoms, or neclau; oral history tells of two original chiefdoms splitting into seven, divided again into fifty or sixty districts. The first European ship, the sandalwood brig Alpha, arrived in 1830, and the trade and epidemics that followed sharply reduced the Aneityumese population.
zh: 阿内霍姆人是瓦努阿图最南端有人居住的岛屿阿内蒂乌姆岛的居民，他们同名的语言是岛上唯一的本土语言，属大洋洲语族南瓦努阿图语支，与塔纳岛诸语言关系最近。阿内蒂乌姆岛约在公元前874年由来自塔纳岛的航海者定居，他们最初居住在沿海坡地，后因土地和人口压力迁入谷地。传统上岛上由称纳蒂马里德的酋长统治众多名为内克劳的酋邦；口传史称最初的两个酋邦分裂为七个，再分成五六十个区域。1830年，第一艘欧洲船，即做檀香木生意的双桅帆船阿尔法号抵达，随后的贸易和疫病使阿内蒂乌姆人口锐减。

en: Angevin is the traditional langue d'oïl of Anjou in western France, spoken from the Loire valley around Angers and Saumur into the neighbouring county of Maine, where it shares the country with the closely related Mayennois speech. Together with Sarthois and southern Norman it forms the eastern Armorican group of the langues d'oïl, and in the ninth and tenth centuries it helped shape the Gallo language beyond the Breton march. Its land was the Roman civitas of the Andecavi, descended from the Gaulish Andes, and Angers remained its capital through the Frankish county and the later duchy. The counts of the tenth and eleventh centuries, the Fulks, built Anjou into a major principality, and Count Geoffrey Plantagenet's marriage to the Empress Matilda carried the Angevin inheritance to the English throne; Angevin words even entered English through the Anglo-Norman of the Plantagenet court. Despite this dynastic glamour the dialect produced little written literature, for Anjou was drawn into the French royal domain early in the thirteenth century and Parisian Francien became the language of letters. In 1360 the county became the Duchy of Anjou, an appanage of royal princes until its final absorption into the crown lands in 1482, and it remained a province until 1790, when it became the core of the department of Maine-et-Loire.
zh: 安茹语是法国西部安茹的传统奥依语，通行于昂热和索米尔一带的卢瓦尔河谷，并延伸到相邻的曼恩伯国，在那里与亲缘很近的马耶讷语并存。它与萨尔特语、南诺曼语共同构成奥依语的东阿莫里卡语组，并在9至10世纪影响了布列塔尼边地之外的加洛语。这片土地原是高卢安德斯人的罗马城邦安德卡维，昂热在法兰克伯国和后来的公国时期一直是其首府。10至11世纪的伯爵们——富尔克家族——把安茹经营成大诸侯领地，若弗鲁瓦·金雀花伯爵与玛蒂尔达皇后的婚姻使安茹的继承权登上英格兰王位；一些安茹词汇也借金雀花宫廷的盎格鲁-诺曼语进入英语。尽管王朝显赫，该方言却没有多少书面文学，因为安茹在13世纪初就并入法国王室领地，巴黎的法兰西语成为书面语言。1360年伯国升为安茹公国，作为王室亲王的封邑直到1482年最终并入王田，之后作为行省延续到1790年，成为曼恩-卢瓦尔省的核心。

en: The Anggamudi, also written Angkamuthi, are an Aboriginal people of the western Cape York Peninsula in Queensland, whose country lay north of Port Musgrave around Duyfken Point, Mapoon and the Ducie River mouth. Their speech was the Angkamuthi dialect of Uradhi, a Paman language of the Pama-Nyungan family, and Dutch explorers skirmished with local people nearby in 1623.
zh: 安加穆迪人是昆士兰约克角半岛西部的原住民，领地位于马斯格雷夫港以北、杜伊夫肯角、马普恩和杜西河河口一带。他们的语言是乌拉迪语的安加穆迪方言，属帕马-牛雅语系的帕马语组；1623年荷兰探险者曾在附近与当地人发生冲突。

en: The Anglo-Irish are the English-descended settler community of Ireland, whose roots lie in the Anglo-Norman invasion of 1169–1171 and the Lordship of Ireland created for Henry II’s son John in 1177. Colonists held the eastern and southern ports of Dublin, Wexford and Waterford and carved out feudal earldoms, while many families Gaelicised so thoroughly that medieval commentators called them more Irish than the Irish themselves. Edward Bruce’s Scottish invasion of 1315–1318, famine and the Black Death of the 1340s shrank the colony, and the Statutes of Kilkenny of 1366 vainly forbade settlers from using the Irish language and Irish customs; by the fifteenth century English rule scarcely reached beyond the Pale around Dublin. The Tudor plantations and the Cromwellian conquest of the seventeenth century remade the community into a largely Anglican landowning class, the Protestant Ascendancy, whose ascendancy was anchored by the Act of Union of 1801.
zh: 盎格鲁-爱尔兰人是爱尔兰岛上英格兰裔定居者群体，其源头是1169年至1171年的盎格鲁-诺曼人入侵，以及1177年为亨利二世之子约翰设立的爱尔兰领地。殖民者占据都柏林、韦克斯福德、沃特福德等东部和南部港口，建立起封建伯爵领地；许多家族却彻底盖尔化，以至于中世纪的评论者称他们比爱尔兰人还要爱尔兰。1315年至1318年爱德华·布鲁斯的苏格兰入侵、饥荒和14世纪40年代的黑死病使殖民地萎缩，1366年的《基尔肯尼法令》禁止定居者使用爱尔兰语、遵从爱尔兰习俗，却收效甚微；到15世纪，英格兰的实际统治几乎只剩都柏林周围的“佩尔”地区。都铎王朝的种植园运动和17世纪克伦威尔的征服，把这个群体重塑为以圣公会信徒为主的地主阶层，即“新教优势”阶层，其统治地位又由1801年的《联合法令》固定下来。

en: The Angoram are a Papuan people of the lower Sepik River in East Sepik Province. Their language, also called Pondo and known to its own speakers as Kanda, stands as its own branch of the Lower Sepik family, and the speech of Maramba village counts as one of its dialects.
zh: 安戈拉姆人是东塞皮克省塞皮克河下游的巴布亚族群。他们的语言又称庞多语，使用者自己称之为坎达语，在下塞皮克语族中自成一支，马兰巴村的话是它的一种方言。

en: The Angrians are the people of Angria, called Engern in German, the country along the middle Weser around Minden that was one of the four subdivisions of Old Saxony, lying between Westphalia and Eastphalia. Their name descends from the Angrivarii, a Germanic tribe described by Tacitus that joined Arminius' alliance against Rome at the Teutoburg Forest in the year 9. Absorbed into the Saxon tribal confederation, they faced Charlemagne in the Saxon Wars, their commanders making a separate peace near Bückeburg in 775, and Minden became a bishop's see in 803, anchoring the region's Christianization. When Emperor Frederick I deposed Henry the Lion in 1180 and split the Saxon duchy under the Gelnhausen Charter, Angria passed to Bernhard of Anhalt, after which its old name fell out of use. In the thirteenth century the middle Weser lands formed the core of the County of Hoya, inherited in 1582 by the House of Brunswick-Lüneburg, and the old Angrian country lived on as a Low German-speaking region divided among the bishoprics, counties and duchies of the Holy Roman Empire. In 1815 the Kingdom of Prussia revived the title Duke of Angria among its royal styles.
zh: 安格里亚人是安格里亚（德语称恩格恩）地区的居民，这一地区位于威悉河中游、以明登为中心，是古萨克森四大分区之一，地处威斯特伐利亚与伊斯特伐利亚之间。他们的名字源出安格里瓦里人——塔西佗已记载过的日耳曼部落，曾在公元9年参加阿米尼乌斯的联盟，在条顿堡森林与罗马人作战。该部落后来并入萨克森部落联盟，在萨克森战争中与查理大帝为敌，其首领于775年在比克堡附近单独议和；803年明登设立主教区，成为本地基督教化的支点。1180年皇帝腓特烈一世废黜狮子亨利，凭《格尔恩豪森特许状》分割萨克森公国，安格里亚封给安哈尔特的伯恩哈德，旧地名此后逐渐废弃。13世纪时，威悉河中游的土地构成霍亚伯国的核心，1582年由不伦瑞克-吕讷堡家族继承，古安格里亚之地则作为讲低地德语的地区，继续分裂为神圣罗马帝国治下的众多主教区、伯国和公国。1815年，普鲁士王国在其王号中恢复了安格里亚公爵的旧称。

en: The Anguthimri are an Aboriginal people of the western Cape York Peninsula in Queensland, whose country ran from the Mission River mouth north to the Pennefather River and west to Duyfken Point near Weipa. They spoke a Paman language of the Pama-Nyungan family, in related dialects used by the Tjungundji and Yupungathi; Dutch explorers landed at that river in 1623.
zh: 安古西姆里人是昆士兰约克角半岛西部的原住民，其领地自米申河口向北延伸至彭尼法瑟河，西抵杜伊夫肯角，邻近韦帕。他们使用帕马-牛雅语系下帕马语组的一种语言，琼贡吉人和尤庞加蒂人等邻近群体也使用其亲属方言；1623年荷兰探险者曾在彭尼法瑟河登陆。

en: The Antaifasy, whose name means people of the sands, are a fishing and farming Malagasy people of the south-eastern coast around Farafangana, in a historic homeland called Ifasy between the Antaimoro country to the north and Isaka to the south. Their uncertain early history is dominated by a long feud: from the 1680s they clashed with the neighbouring Antaimoro in skirmishes that ran on through the eighteenth century without a decisive victory, and after a period of Antaimoro overlordship an Antaifasy king named Maseba freed them again. In the eighteenth century they grew wealthy on coastal commerce, and King Ifara monopolized trade with European ships until he controlled all traffic on the Manampatra river. Their society remained split into three clans, the Randroy, Andrianseranana and Marofela, each under its own king and bound by strict moral codes. In 1827 the armies of the Kingdom of Imerina invaded and reduced the Antaifasy to vassals; resistance continued in the forests and they were never wholly subdued, though many were carried off to Antananarivo as slaves or conscripted into forced labour. Like the Antaisaka, they did not bury their dead in the earth but laid the bodies in kibory funeral houses hidden in remote sacred forest.
zh: 安泰法西人族名意为“沙民”，是马尔加什人的一支，以渔耕为生，住在东南沿海法拉凡加纳一带；他们的传统家园叫伊法西，北邻安泰莫罗之地，南接伊萨卡。他们的早期历史已不可考，主线是一场长期世仇：从17世纪80年代起，他们与邻近的安泰莫罗人冲突不断，小规模战斗贯穿整个18世纪，谁也无法彻底取胜；在被安泰莫罗人统治一段时期后，安泰法西国王马塞巴重新赢得独立。18世纪，他们靠沿海贸易致富，国王伊法拉垄断了与欧洲商船的交易，进而控制马南帕特拉河上的一切航运。社会始终分为兰德罗伊、安德里安塞拉纳纳和马鲁费拉三个氏族，各有国王，并受严苛的道德规范约束。1827年，伊默里纳王国的军队入侵，将安泰法西人降为附庸；他们在丛林中坚持抵抗，始终未被完全征服，但仍有许多人被掳为奴隶带往塔那那利佛，或被强征服苦役。与安泰萨卡人一样，他们不把死者埋入土中，而是将遗体安放在偏远圣林深处的基博里墓屋里。

en: The Antaisaka, or Antesaka, are a Malagasy people of the south-eastern coast south of Farafangana, bearing the name of Isaka, an old inland province. Their kings came of the Zarabehava, a royal Sakalava line that crossed from the west coast between 1620 and 1650 to settle at Nosipandra, now Vangaindrano. Oral history names the founder Andriamandresy, born Repila in a village near Mahabo in Menabe: passed over for the succession after a violent quarrel in which he wounded his uncle, he was exiled and led his warriors and slaves eastward to build a new kingdom. By the early 1700s the Antaisaka realm ranked among the four largest kingdoms in Madagascar. Succession remained murderous, and King Ratongalaza secured his throne only by killing or exiling every brother; his grandson Lengoabo, the foremost king of the eighteenth century, pushed the frontiers to their greatest extent. From 1820 the armies of the Kingdom of Imerina invaded the coast, killing captured men and carrying off women and children as slaves, and the old kingdom lost its independence piece by piece. The Antaisaka grew rice, bananas and coffee and fished the shore, and their life was governed by strict marriage taboos: twins were held to be fady, and corpses were dried for two or three years before being carried through a special door of the house to the kibory burial house hidden in a sacred men-only forest.
zh: 安泰萨卡人（又称特萨卡人）是马尔加什人的一支，住在东南海岸法拉凡加纳以南，族名取自古老的内陆省份伊萨卡。他们的国王出自扎拉贝哈瓦谱系，这是一支萨卡拉瓦王族，于1620至1650年间从西海岸渡海东来，定居在今万加因德拉努的努西潘德拉。口传史称始祖为安德里曼德雷西，原名雷皮拉，生于梅纳贝马哈布附近的村落；他在继承权之争中失势，又在激烈冲突中伤了舅父，因而被放逐，便带着战士和奴隶东去另建王国。到18世纪初，安泰萨卡已是马达加斯加四大王国之一。王位继承始终充满血腥：拉通加拉扎国王靠杀掉或放逐所有兄弟才坐稳王位；他的孙子伦戈阿布是18世纪最杰出的国王，把疆域扩张到极限。1820年起，伊默里纳王国的军队入侵海岸，俘获的男子多被处死，妇女儿童则被掳为奴隶，旧王国一步步丧失独立。安泰萨卡人种植水稻、香蕉和咖啡，兼营近海渔业，生活受严苛的婚姻禁忌约束：双胞胎被视为不祥之物；死者遗体要风干两三年，再从房屋的专用门抬出，送往藏在男子专属圣林中的集体墓屋。

en: The Antambahoaka are a small Malagasy people of the south-eastern coast around Mananjary, whose founding village of Masindrano grew into that town. They share their origins with the Antaimoro, who trace themselves to an Arab migrant called Raminia, said to have come from Mecca between the 900s and the 1100s; in the 1400s an Antaimoro leader named Ravalarivo broke away to found Masindrano, and from his later title Ratiambahoaka, beloved of his people, the community took its name. Their later history went largely unrecorded, and they remained a tight cluster of villages under local mpanjaka kings, each ruling through lohatrano heads of extended families over a society split into nobles, commoners and slaves. The noble clans kept the sorabe art of writing Malagasy in Arabic script. The great event of Antambahoaka life was the Sambatra, held every seven years in a Friday year: all boys born since the previous festival were circumcised together and received as sons of Raminia into their paternal clans, amid warlike processions that marched to the mouth of the Mananjary river in memory of their ancestor's exodus. They venerated their ancestors in the large tranobe meeting houses, kept strict fady taboos and retained Islamic traces such as refusing pork to their chiefs.
zh: 安坦巴华卡人是马达加斯加东南沿海、马南扎里一带的小族群，他们最早的村落马辛德拉诺后来发展为马南扎里城。他们与安泰莫罗人同源，后者自称是阿拉伯移民拉米尼亚的后裔，相传拉米尼亚于10至12世纪从麦加迁来；15世纪，安泰莫罗首领拉瓦拉里武分出自立，建立马辛德拉诺，他后来的称号“拉蒂安巴胡阿卡”（意为受族人爱戴者）演化成了安坦巴华卡这个族名。此后他们的历史鲜有记载，一直是一群联系紧密的村落，由各地的小国王统治，国王通过各大家族的族长施政，社会分为贵族、平民和奴隶。贵族氏族掌握着用阿拉伯字母拼写马尔加什语的苏拉贝文书技艺。安坦巴华卡人生活中的头等大事是每隔七年在“星期五之年”举行的桑巴特拉节：节间为过去七年出生的所有男孩集体施行割礼，承认他们作为拉米尼亚子孙加入父系氏族，同时举行威武的游行，长行军至马南扎里河口，纪念先祖的迁徙。他们在宽大的公共议事屋里敬奉祖先，恪守种种禁忌，还保留着首领禁食猪肉等伊斯兰遗俗。

en: The Antankarana hold the northern tip of Madagascar around the bay of Antsiranana, and their name means the people of the tsingy, after the jagged limestone crags and caves of the Ankarana massif that became their refuge and their sacred ground. They began as the Zafin'i'fotsy, a branch of the Sakalava royal line that lost a succession quarrel with the Zafin'i'mena in the sixteenth century and migrated beyond the northern edge of Sakalava power. Their first king, Kozobe, ruled from 1614 and divided his lands among five sons, but late in the century Sakalava armies under Andriamandisoarivo, founder of the Kingdom of Iboina, overran most of the country. Andriantsirotso then founded the Antankarana kingdom in 1692, led his people into the Ankarana rocks and, with soldiers lent by his kinsman Raholo of Maroantsetra, drove the Sakalava back after three years; he set up an administration and gave the united northern communities their name. A long line of kings followed at Ambilobe, from Lamboeny to Tsialana I, but as the Kingdom of Imerina expanded in the early nineteenth century Merina tax posts and governors reduced Tsialana to vassalage. His son Tsimiaro I rose against the Merina in 1835 and fought on until 1837, when reprisals drove him and his people into the Ankarana caves. The Antankarana lived by fishing and herding, honoured ancestor spirits in tromba ceremonies and kept fady taboos that protected the wildlife of their rocky land.
zh: 安坦卡拉纳人住在马达加斯加最北端、安齐拉纳纳湾一带，族名意为“石林之人”，取自安卡拉纳山地嶙峋的石灰岩峰丛与洞穴；那里既是他们的避难所，也是圣地。他们本是萨卡拉瓦王族的一支，称扎菲尼富齐，16世纪在继承权之争中败给扎菲尼梅纳，便迁到萨卡拉瓦势力北界之外。第一代国王科佐贝1614年即位，把国土分给五个儿子；但17世纪末，伊博伊纳王国的创建者安德里阿曼迪苏阿里沃率萨卡拉瓦大军攻陷了大部分国土。1692年，安德里安齐罗措建立安坦卡拉纳王国，率众退入安卡拉纳石林，又靠亲戚马鲁安采特拉首领拉胡卢借出的军队，三年后击退萨卡拉瓦人；他设立行政机构，并为联合起来的北方各部取了安坦卡拉纳之名。此后兰博埃尼、齐阿拉纳一世等国王在安比卢贝一脉相传。19世纪初伊默里纳王国扩张，梅里纳人的税站和长官相继进入，齐阿拉纳被迫沦为附庸。其子齐米亚罗一世于1835年起兵反抗，坚持到1837年，梅里纳人的报复把他和族人逼进了安卡拉纳的岩洞。安坦卡拉纳人以渔牧为生，通过通灵仪式敬奉祖灵，并用种种禁忌保护石林之地的野生动物。

en: The Antanosy, whose name means people of the island, are a Malagasy people of the arid Anosy region in the south-eastern corner of Madagascar, around the harbour of Fort Dauphin. Ironworking reached their valleys in the thirteenth century together with Indian Ocean trade, and Chinese celadon circulated there until the fifteenth, when the Efaho valley was divided among fortified, stratified chiefdoms that grew irrigated rice and exported cattle. Tradition brings the Zafiraminia clan into Anosy in the fourteenth century, and by the mid-seventeenth century they ruled the valley from Fanjahira: in 1613 the Portuguese landing at Manafiafy were met by King Andriantsiambany and five hundred warriors, and French governors at Fort Dauphin between 1643 and 1674 burned hundreds of villages and carried off thousands of slaves and tens of thousands of cattle before the garrison was evacuated in 1674 after a rising killed more than half its men. The Antanosy then traded on under their own chiefs until the nineteenth century. Jean Rene, son of a French settler and an Antanosy mother, became governor of Toamasina and in 1817 swore a blood oath with Radama I of Imerina; in 1825 a Merina army under Ramananolona took Fort Dauphin and ended Antanosy independence, and Queen Ranavalona I soon had the conqueror himself murdered and replaced.
zh: 安塔诺西人族名意为“岛民”，是马尔加什人的一支，住在马达加斯加东南角干旱的阿诺西地区，以多凡堡港为中心。13世纪，冶铁术随印度洋贸易传入他们的山谷，中国青瓷在此流通至15世纪；当时埃法霍河谷已分成若干设防且等级分明的酋邦，种植灌溉水稻并出口牛只。相传扎菲拉米尼亚氏族于14世纪迁入阿诺西，到17世纪中叶已在凡贾希拉建都统治河谷：1613年葡萄牙人在马纳菲亚菲登陆时，出面迎接的是安德里安粲巴尼国王和五百名武士；1643至1674年间，多凡堡的法国历任总督焚毁数百座村庄，掠走数千奴隶和数以万计的牛只，1674年当地起义杀死过半守军，要塞随后被撤空。此后安塔诺西人在各自酋长治下继续贸易，直到19世纪。法国定居者与安塔诺西女子所生的让·勒内出任图阿马西纳长官，1817年与伊默里纳的拉达马一世歃血为盟；1825年，拉马纳努卢纳率领梅里纳军队攻占多凡堡，安塔诺西人的独立终结，而腊纳瓦洛娜一世很快又派人杀死这位征服者，另立长官。

en: The Anuak are a Luo Nilotic people of the Upper Nile, living in the riverine lowlands of the Baro, Gilo and Akobo rivers, in the Gambela country of western Ethiopia and across the border in South Sudan. Their traditions trace a common origin with the Shilluk and other Luo peoples in the Gezira, between the Blue and White Niles; between the 1100s and the 1400s their ancestors moved south and east under environmental pressure and local warfare, into the lowlands where they subsequently made their home. Unlike the cattle-focused peoples around them, the Anuak combined sorghum cultivation on the riverbanks with herding, fishing and hunting, and their self-contained villages were governed by headmen whom the villagers could depose. Their traditional religion centred on a supreme spirit, Jwøk, and on holy trees standing in certain villages.
zh: 阿努亚克人是上尼罗河地区的卢奥支系尼罗特人，散居在巴罗河、吉洛河和阿科博河沿岸的低地，即埃塞俄比亚西部的甘贝拉地区及边境另一侧的南苏丹。他们的传说把自己与希卢克人等卢奥诸族的共同发源地追溯到青尼罗河与白尼罗河之间的杰济拉；12至15世纪，先民因环境压力和局部冲突向南、向东迁徙，进入此后世代居住的低地。与周围以牧牛为生的族群不同，阿努亚克人在河畔种植高粱，同时兼营畜牧、渔猎；他们自成一体的村庄由可被村民废黜的头人主持。传统信仰以至高神乔克和部分村庄里的圣树为核心。

en: The Aondironon were one of the Iroquoian-speaking tribes named within the Neutral Confederacy, or Attawandaron, of southwestern Ontario, the western neighbours of the Wendat. Their confederacy was broken up by Haudenosaunee attacks in 1651, and the surviving Aondironon were absorbed into other Iroquoian nations.
zh: 阿昂迪罗农人是今安大略省西南部中立联盟（阿塔万达龙）名下的一支易洛魁语部族，也是温达特人的西邻。1651年，易洛魁联盟的进攻瓦解了中立联盟，幸存的阿昂迪罗农人被并入其他易洛魁语民族。

en: The Aónikenk, or Southern Tehuelche, are the people of the open steppe of eastern Patagonia, from the Chubut River south to the Strait of Magellan; their autonym means people of the south, and their Tshoneka language belongs to the Chonan family shared with the Teushen and the Selk'nam. Before horses they were foot nomads, moving in bands of fifty to a hundred between winter lowlands and summer plateaus on the seasonal trails of guanaco herds, hunting with bows and bolas; the ancient rock paintings of the Cueva de las Manos are attributed to their remote ancestors. Ferdinand Magellan's expedition wintered among them at San Julian Bay in 1520, and Antonio Pigafetta's tales of their stature made the Patagonian giants a European legend. Horses, known to them from about 1570, turned them into mounted nomads who ranged far north and south on trade networks, living above all on guanaco and rhea. From the eighteenth century Mapuche influence, the Araucanization, spread ponchos, alliances and the Mapuche language across the steppe; early nineteenth-century Aónikenk bands fought the Pehuenche and followed chiefs such as the female leader Maria la Grande.
zh: 奥尼肯克人即南支特维尔切人，栖居在东巴塔哥尼亚的开阔草原上，范围从丘布特河向南直到麦哲伦海峡；他们的自称意为南方之人，所说的聪内卡语属乔南语系，与特乌申语和塞尔克南语同系。在获得马匹之前，他们是徒步游群，以五十至一百人为一队，随着原驼群季节性迁徙，冬天在低地、夏天上高原，用弓箭和流星锤狩猎；平图拉斯河手洞的古老岩画就出自他们远古祖先之手。1520年斐迪南·麦哲伦的探险队在圣胡利安湾过冬时与他们相处，随队的安东尼奥·皮加费塔记述了他们的高大身材，巴塔哥尼亚巨人的传说由此风靡欧洲。约1570年起接触到的马匹把他们变成骑马游群，凭借四通八达的贸易网络纵横南北，主食转为原驼和美洲鸵鸟。从18世纪起，马普切人的影响即阿劳卡化把篷乔、联盟和马普切语带上草原；19世纪初的奥尼肯克群体曾与佩文切人交战，并拥戴过大玛丽亚这样的女性酋长。

en: The Apalachee were a Muskogean-speaking people of the Florida Panhandle, settled between the Aucilla and Ochlockonee rivers around Apalachee Bay. Their Fort Walton culture, a regional heir of Mississippian mound-building, was organized into stratified chiefdoms with temple mounds; its greatest town stood at Lake Jackson with more than two hundred houses, and the capital of Anhaica lay near present-day Tallahassee. Pánfilo de Narváez entered their land in 1528, and Hernando de Soto wintered at Anhaica in 1539 and 1540 against stubborn resistance, their arrows said to pierce two layers of chain mail. From about 1600 Franciscan missions drew many Apalachee into Catholicism, and San Luis de Talimali became the western capital of Spanish Florida in 1656; a revolt in 1647 was followed by forced labor on Spanish ranches and growing slave raids out of Carolina. In 1704 Colonel James Moore and about a thousand Creek allies destroyed the missions in the Apalachee massacre, carrying off or enslaving more than two thousand people, and the province was abandoned. Survivors scattered to Carolina, Pensacola, Mobile and the Red River, some later joining the Lower Creeks and the Seminoles, and the Apalachee language died out by the end of the eighteenth century.
zh: 阿巴拉契人是佛罗里达狭长地带操马斯科吉语族语言的族群，聚居于阿巴拉契湾附近的奥西拉河与奥克洛科尼河之间。他们的沃尔顿文化是密西西比台庙文化的地方后继，社会为分级的酋长国，以神庙土丘为中心；最大的城镇在杰克逊湖，有两百多座房屋，都城安海卡则在今塔拉哈西附近。1528年潘菲洛·德·纳尔瓦埃斯进入他们的土地，1539至1540年埃尔南多·德·索托又在安海卡过冬，遭到顽强抵抗，据说他们的箭能穿透两层锁子甲。约1600年起，方济各会传教站使许多阿巴拉契人皈依天主教，圣路易斯·德·塔利马利于1656年成为西属佛罗里达的西部首府；1647年的起义失败后，阿巴拉契人被迫在西班牙人的牧场劳役，来自卡罗来纳的奴隶掳掠也日益猖獗。1704年，詹姆斯·穆尔上校率约一千名克里克盟军在阿巴拉契大屠杀中摧毁各传教站，掳走或奴役两千多人，整个省份就此废弃。幸存者流散到卡罗来纳、彭萨科拉、莫比尔和雷德河一带，部分人后来加入下克里克人和塞米诺尔人，阿巴拉契语也在18世纪末消亡。

en: The Apiaka are a Tupi-Guarani people of northern Mato Grosso, whose language belongs to the Tupi-Guarani branch and took in elements of the Tupi-based Lingua Geral trade jargon. Their name is said to derive from a Tupi word for man, though their own leaders trace it to a wasp that travels far to avenge an attack with a painful sting, fitting a people famed as warriors. They were heavily agricultural, farming large communal fields of manioc, maize, beans, peanuts and cotton, and lived in riverside villages built around a single large thatched communal house with cotton hammocks and bark canoes. The earliest written records date from 1791, with a possible European encounter as early as 1747, and in 1812 one settlement alone held about five hundred people, half of them fighting men. After each harvest the Apiaka launched war expeditions of two or three hundred warriors against neighbors such as the Nambicuara, Parintintin and Tapanyuna, fighting to avenge old quarrels rather than for plunder, and ceremonially ate captured enemies. A chief marked his rank with a white shell collar, feather diadem and a belt strung with human teeth.
zh: 阿皮亚卡人是马托格罗索北部的图皮-瓜拉尼族群，其语言属图皮-瓜拉尼语支，并吸收了以图皮语为基础的贸易混合语“通用语”的成分。据说族名来自图皮语中表示“人”的词，但他们的首领认为族名源自一种黄蜂：遭到攻击后会长途追击，用剧痛的蜇刺报仇——这正符合这个以勇武闻名的族群。他们农业发达，集体耕作大型园圃，种植木薯、玉米、豆类、花生和棉花，村落临河而建，核心是一座巨大的茅草公共长屋，屋内挂着棉布吊床，出行使用树皮独木舟。现存最早的文字记载始于1791年，而他们与欧洲人相遇可能早至1747年；1812年时，仅一处村落就有约五百人，其中一半是战士。每次收获之后，阿皮亚卡人会出动两三百名战士，攻打南比夸拉、帕林廷廷和塔帕纽纳等邻族，征战不为劫掠，而为旧怨复仇，并仪式性地吞食俘虏。酋长以白色贝壳项圈、羽毛冠和串着人牙的腰带彰显身份。

en: The Apma are an Oceanic-speaking Melanesian people of the mountainous centre of Pentecost island in Vanuatu, whose speech, also called Abma or Central Raga, stands between the North Vanuatu and Central Vanuatu language groups. They live in garden villages where taro is the staple and pigs serve both as wealth and as ceremonial payment in marriage and compensation. Society is ordered by grade-taking, the climb in rank through the ritual slaughter of valued pigs, and Pentecost's famous land diving belongs to the same complex: each year men hurl themselves from wooden towers twenty to thirty metres high with vines tied to their ankles, an offering meant to secure the yam harvest and to mark entry into manhood. Spanish ships first sighted Pentecost in April 1606; Louis Antoine de Bougainville reached it on the day of Pentecost in 1768 and gave the island its name, and James Cook followed in 1774.
zh: 阿普玛人是瓦努阿图彭特科斯特岛中部山区的美拉尼西亚人，操大洋洲语；他们的语言又称阿布玛语或中拉加语，介于北瓦努阿图语群与中瓦努阿图语群之间。他们居住在耕作园圃的村落里，以芋头为主食，猪既是财富，也是婚嫁聘礼和赔偿仪式上的支付手段。社会等级靠“晋阶”维系，即通过仪式性宰杀贵重的猪来提升身份；彭特科斯特岛著名的陆地跳跃便属于同一仪典体系：每年都有男子脚踝缠上藤蔓，从二三十米高的木塔纵身跃下，以此祈求山药丰收并标志成年。1606年4月，西班牙船只首次望见彭特科斯特岛；1768年路易·安托万·德·布干维尔在圣灵降临节当天抵达并以此为岛命名，詹姆斯·库克又于1774年到访。

en: The Tapirapé, who call themselves Apyãwa, are a Tupi-Guarani people of the lower Araguaia river, holding the forests and savannah edges around Bananal Island where the states of Tocantins and Mato Grosso now meet. Their traditions and language point to descent from the Tupinambá of the Brazilian coast, bands of whom are thought to have fled inland after the European arrival of the 1500s and settled in this stretch of forest. They lived by slash-and-burn horticulture, hunting and fishing: each large loghouse, home to four or five families linked through the mother's line, kept its own garden, while the oval village was built around the takana, a men's house shared by six Bird Societies named after bird species, which organized collective hunts and garden clearings and danced masked when their spirits came to visit. Shamans worked themselves into tobacco trances to heal and to bless the hunt, and an annual ceremony of gift-giving, sealed with draughts of manioc beer, redistributed wealth between households. Settled deep in the interior and protected by distance, the Tapirapé had no sustained dealings with colonial society through the whole of this period.
zh: 塔皮拉佩人自称阿皮亚瓦，是阿拉瓜亚河下游使用图皮-瓜拉尼语族语言的族群，占据班纳纳尔岛周边、地当今托坎廷斯州与马托格罗索州交界处的森林与稀树草原边缘。他们的语言和传统表明，其祖先是巴西沿海的图皮南巴人；一般认为，16世纪欧洲人到来后，部分图皮南巴人逃入内陆，在这片林地定居下来。他们以刀耕火种的园艺、狩猎和捕鱼为生：每座大型长屋住有四五户按母系相联的家庭，各有自己的园地；村庄呈椭圆形，中央是男子会所塔卡纳，六个以鸟类命名的鸟社共用这一会所，负责组织集体狩猎和开荒，并在神灵降临时戴上面具起舞。萨满靠烟草进入出神状态，为人治病、为狩猎祈福；每年还有赠礼仪式，人们痛饮木薯酒，借此在各户之间重新分配财物。由于深居内陆、路途遥远，在这整个时期里塔皮拉佩人始终未与殖民社会发生持续往来。

en: The Aragonese are the people of the middle Ebro and its Pyrenean headwaters, heirs of the county of Jaca that became a kingdom on the death of Sancho III of Navarre in 1035, when Ramiro I received Aragon as his share. Driving south through Muslim territory in the Reconquista, his successors moved the capital from Jaca to Huesca in 1096 and to Zaragoza in 1118, and by 1285 the Ebro valley up to the kingdom's southern frontier had been won. The marriage of Queen Petronilla with the count of Barcelona Ramon Berenguer IV in 1150 created the Crown of Aragon, under which Aragonese ships and soldiers built a Mediterranean empire of Valencia, Majorca, Sicily, Naples and Sardinia, while the Navarro-Aragonese Romance speech of the Ebro was carried into the reconquered lowlands and produced, in the late 1300s, the Greek translations of the Hospitaller grand master Juan Fernández de Heredia. The Castilian Ferdinand of Antequera took the Aragonese throne in 1412, and after the union with Castile in 1479 Castilian steadily displaced Aragonese, which retreated to the Pyrenean valleys; the Nueva Planta decrees of 1707 abolished the kingdom's autonomous Corts and banned Aragonese from the schools.
zh: 阿拉贡人生活在埃布罗河中游及其比利牛斯山源头一带，其前身是哈卡伯爵领。1035年纳瓦拉的桑乔三世去世，拉米罗一世分得阿拉贡，阿拉贡由此成为王国。此后阿拉贡在收复失地运动中向南推进，都城于1096年从哈卡迁至韦斯卡，1118年再迁至萨拉戈萨；到1285年，埃布罗河谷直到王国南部疆界的土地均已收复。1150年，女王佩特罗尼利亚与巴塞罗那伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世联姻，建立阿拉贡联合王国；阿拉贡的船只和军队随后缔造了囊括瓦伦西亚、马略卡、西西里、那不勒斯和撒丁的地中海霸业。埃布罗流域的纳瓦拉-阿拉贡罗曼语也随收复的土地向南传播，14世纪末医院骑士团大团长胡安·费尔南德斯·德·埃雷迪亚把多部希腊著作译成阿拉贡语，开中世纪欧洲之先。1412年，卡斯蒂利亚的安特克拉的费尔南多登上阿拉贡王位；1479年与卡斯蒂利亚联合后，卡斯蒂利亚语逐渐取代阿拉贡语，后者退入比利牛斯山谷。1707年的《新基本法令》废除了阿拉贡的自治议会，并禁止学校使用阿拉贡语。

en: The Arandai are a Papuan people of the southern shore of the Bird's Head Peninsula along the Berau Gulf, occupying the Aranday, Kamundan and Weriagar districts of Bintuni Regency. Their speech forms a three-member dialect cluster of Kemberano, Dombano and Kokoda, belonging to the South Bird's Head branch of the Trans-New Guinea family.
zh: 阿兰代人是鸟头半岛南岸贝劳湾沿岸的巴布亚族群，居于宾图尼县的阿兰代、卡蒙丹和韦里亚加尔三区。他们的话属跨新几内亚语系南鸟头语支，由肯贝拉诺、东巴诺和科科达三种近亲方言组成一个方言群。

en: The Arawak of the Guianas, who call themselves Lokono, are the mainland branch of one of the most widely spread language families of the Americas. Arawakan tongues probably formed in the Orinoco valley and then spread along the great rivers and coasts of northern South America, carrying a village agriculture based on manioc, maize and sweet potatoes, skilled pottery, raised fields and far-flung trade networks. The Lokono settled the shorelands between the Orinoco delta and the Amazon, the coasts later known as Guayana, while related Arawakan peoples reached the Caribbean and became the Taíno whom Columbus met in 1492. Unlike the islanders, the mainland Arawak kept the Spanish at arms' length throughout the sixteenth century. When Dutch and English traders arrived in the seventeenth century, founding posts such as Essequibo in 1616 and Berbice in 1627, the Lokono built a profitable exchange of cassava, fish, timber and canoes, at first allying with Spain against their old rivals the Kalina, or Caribs. Their riverside villages and manioc-bread economy thus became part of the colonial Guianas, where Lokono communities kept their language and ancestral customs under Dutch, and later British, rule.
zh: 圭亚那的阿拉瓦克人自称洛科诺人，是美洲分布最广的语系之一在大陆上的支系。阿拉瓦克诸语言大概形成于奥里诺科河谷，随后沿南美北部的大河与海岸传播，带来了以木薯、玉米和甘薯为基础的村落农业、精湛的制陶术、台田和范围广阔的贸易网络。洛科诺人定居在奥里诺科三角洲到亚马逊河之间的滨海地带，即后来被称为圭亚那的沿海地区；亲缘的阿拉瓦克群体则进入加勒比海，成为哥伦布1492年遇到的泰诺人。与岛上的亲属不同，大陆阿拉瓦克人在整个16世纪都让西班牙人无法近身。17世纪荷兰和英国商人到来，于1616年建立埃塞奎博、1627年建立伯比斯等商站，洛科诺人以木薯、鱼、木材和独木舟开展有利可图的交换，并一度与西班牙结盟，对抗世仇卡利纳人（即加勒比人）。他们的河畔村落和木薯面包经济由此融入殖民时代的圭亚那，洛科诺社群在荷兰及后来英国的统治下保留了自己的语言和祖传习俗。

en: The Arendaronon, or Arendaenronnon, “people of the lying rock,” were the Rock nation of the Wendat Confederacy in southern Ontario, joining the older Bear and Cord alliance around 1590. Their chief village was Cahiague, near the shore of Lake Simcoe, which grew into the largest settlement in Wendake and may have held as many as four thousand people at the time of French contact. Like the other Wendat, they were sedentary farmers of maize, beans and squash, living in bark-covered longhouses behind timber palisades and trading furs with Algonquian neighbours and the French. When the Dutch-armed Haudenosaunee overran Wendake in 1648 and 1649, the Arendaronon shared the general ruin: survivors were absorbed into Haudenosaunee communities, fled to the French on the St. Lawrence, or joined the Tionontati in the fusion that produced the Wyandot.
zh: 阿伦达罗农人意为“卧岩之人”，是今安大略省南部温达特联盟中的岩族，约在1590年加入此前已结成同盟的熊族与绳族。他们的主要村寨卡希亚格坐落于锡姆科湖畔，后来发展为温达克最大的定居点，在与法国人接触时人口可能多达四千。和其他温达特人一样，他们是定居农耕者，种植玉米、菜豆和南瓜，住在木栅栏内的树皮长屋中，并与邻近的阿尔冈昆人及法国人进行毛皮贸易。1648年至1649年，得到荷兰火器的易洛魁联盟攻陷温达克，阿伦达罗农人随之溃散：幸存者或被并入易洛魁人的社群，或逃往圣劳伦斯河畔的法国人那里，也有人加入提奥农塔特人，共同融合成怀安多特人。

en: The Armenians are the indigenous people of the Armenian Highlands around Mount Ararat and Lake Van, whose ancient kingdom under Tigran the Great once stretched from the Caucasus to the Levant. Their Arsacid kings made Armenia the first state to adopt Christianity, around 301, and Mesrop Mashtots gave the language its own alphabet in 405, opening a golden age of religious and historical writing. After the Arab, Seljuk and Mongol upheavals the Bagratid kingdom revived Armenian statehood from 885, but its fall in 1045 and the Seljuk advance of 1064 drove a great migration into Cilicia, where the Rubenid princes built a new Armenian state from about 1080; crowned a kingdom in 1198, it allied with the Crusaders and the Mongols, grew rich on the trade of its port Ayas, and finally fell to the Mamluks in 1375. Thereafter the homeland passed under Turkmen confederations and then between the Ottoman and Safavid empires, whose treaties of Amasya in 1555 and Zuhab in 1639 split the Armenian lands for centuries. Organized as their own millet in the Ottoman Empire from 1461, and led in Persia by the merchants Shah Abbas I resettled at New Julfa near Isfahan from 1604, Armenians built trading colonies from Tbilisi and Istanbul to India and Venice. The Russo-Persian War ended with the Treaty of Turkmenchay in 1828, when the eastern provinces around Yerevan and Sevan passed from Iran to the Russian Empire.
zh: 亚美尼亚人是阿拉拉特山与凡湖一带亚美尼亚高原的原住民，公元前1世纪提格兰大帝在位时，其王国版图从高加索一直延伸到黎凡特。阿尔沙克王朝的国王约于301年使亚美尼亚成为世界上第一个以基督教为国教的国家，405年梅斯罗普·马什托茨又为亚美尼亚语创制专属字母，开启了宗教与历史写作的黄金时代。历经阿拉伯人、塞尔柱人和蒙古人的冲击，巴格拉提德王朝于885年重建亚美尼亚国家，但1045年王国灭亡、1064年塞尔柱人推进，迫使大批亚美尼亚人迁往奇里乞亚；鲁本家族的王公约从1080年起在那里建立新的亚美尼亚政权，1198年加冕为王国，与十字军和蒙古人结盟，凭港口阿亚斯的贸易致富，最终于1375年亡于马穆鲁克。此后故地先后落入土库曼联盟之手，继而在奥斯曼与萨法波斯两大帝国之间易手，1555年的《阿马西亚和约》和1639年的《祖哈布条约》将亚美尼亚土地分割了数百年之久。1461年起，亚美尼亚人在奥斯曼帝国被单列为一个米利特；在波斯，阿拔斯一世于1604年把他们迁居到伊斯法罕附近的新朱尔法，亚美尼亚人的商团从第比利斯、伊斯坦布尔一直延伸到印度和威尼斯。俄波战争以1828年的《土库曼恰伊条约》告终，埃里温与塞凡湖周边的东部省份由伊朗并入俄罗斯帝国。

en: The Aromanians are an Eastern Romance people of the southern Balkans, often called Vlachs in medieval and Ottoman sources. Their Aromanian language descends, like Romanian, from the Vulgar Latin of Romanized Paleo-Balkan peoples and retains a largely Romance vocabulary beneath Greek, Slavic and Turkish loanwords. They traditionally kept flocks in the mountains of what is now northern Greece, Albania, North Macedonia and south-western Bulgaria, moving seasonally between highland pastures and lowland markets, and their caravan traders carried wool, leather and wax across the peninsula. They first appear in eleventh-century Byzantine writings, which place Vlach shepherds in Thessaly; later sources name districts such as Great Vlachia near Meteora and an Upper Vlachia in Epirus. Under the Ottomans they were Orthodox Christians within the Rum millet, and many urban families were Hellenized while growing wealthy on commerce. Their mountain city of Moscopole, in present-day south-eastern Albania, became in the eighteenth century a commercial and scholarly centre with the first printing press in the Ottoman Balkans outside Constantinople, until raids in 1769 and its destruction by Ali Pasha of Ioannina in 1788 scattered its people and fed the wider Aromanian diaspora.
zh: 阿罗马尼亚人是巴尔干南部的东罗曼语民族，在中世纪和奥斯曼文献中常被称为弗拉赫人。他们的阿罗马尼亚语与罗马尼亚语一样，源自古巴尔干罗马化居民所说的通俗拉丁语，尽管借入了大量希腊语、斯拉夫语和土耳其语词汇，核心词汇仍以罗曼语为主。他们传统上在今希腊北部、阿尔巴尼亚、北马其顿和保加利亚西南部的山区放牧，随季节在高山牧场与低地集市之间迁徙，商队则把羊毛、皮革和蜂蜡运到半岛各地。11世纪的拜占庭著作首次记载了色萨利的弗拉赫牧人，后来的文献又提到迈泰奥拉附近的“大弗拉希亚”和伊庇鲁斯的“上弗拉希亚”等地区。奥斯曼统治时期，他们作为东正教徒被归入鲁姆米利特，许多城市家庭在经商致富的同时被希腊化。他们在今阿尔巴尼亚东南部的山城莫斯科普尔，于18世纪发展为商业与学术中心，拥有君士坦丁堡之外奥斯曼巴尔干的第一家印刷所；但1769年的劫掠和1788年约阿尼纳的阿里帕夏将其摧毁，居民流散，汇入更大的阿罗马尼亚人离散群体。

en: The Arop are the people of four small islands in the Siassi chain, in the Vitiaz Strait between New Guinea's Huon Peninsula and New Britain. They speak Arop-Lokep, an Oceanic language of the Austronesian family, rather than a Papuan language.
zh: 阿罗普人居住在维蒂亚兹海峡西亚西群岛的四座小岛上，海峡位于新几内亚休恩半岛与新不列颠岛之间。他们使用阿罗普-洛凯普语，这是南岛语系的一种大洋洲语言，而非巴布亚语言。

en: The Arosi are a Melanesian people of western Makira, formerly called San Cristobal, the easternmost large island of the Solomon Islands, living chiefly west of the Wango River and speaking Arosi, a Southeast Solomonic language. A Spanish expedition under Álvaro de Mendaña made the first recorded European landfall on the island in 1568 and noted only a handful of Arosi words.
zh: 阿罗西人是美拉尼西亚族群，居住在所罗门群岛最东边的大岛马基拉岛（旧称圣克里斯托瓦尔岛）西部，主要聚居于万戈河以西，操东南所罗门语支的阿罗西语。1568年，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚率领的西班牙探险队首次有记载地登上该岛，当时只记下了寥寥几个阿罗西语词汇。

en: Arpitan, traditionally known to philologists as Franco-Provençal, is a Gallo-Romance language standing apart from both the langues d'oïl of northern France and the Occitan of the south. It is the speech of the Western Alps and their approaches: the Lyonnais around Lyon, the Viennois and Dauphiné along the Rhône, the Bresse and the southern Jura, the Duchy of Savoy about Chambéry, and beyond the mountains the Romand lands of western Switzerland and the Aosta Valley of Italy, with a small medieval colony of its speakers surviving in Apulia. Its deep dialectal fragmentation, into Savoyard, Lyonnais, Bressan, Dauphinois and many other local patois, reflects a history of mountain valleys and divided rule: the French crown held Lyon and the Dauphiné, the House of Savoy built its rising state around Chambéry, the Swiss confederates governed the Romand cities, and the Franche-Comté passed under Spanish sovereignty. The language first appears in manuscripts of the twelfth century, in a country once occupied by the Celtic Allobroges and Helvetii and later by the Burgundians. An edict of 1539, confirmed by the Savoyard parliament in 1540, installed French as the language of law and the courts, and the spread of French administration and schooling afterwards steadily reduced Arpitan to the domestic speech of isolated villages.
zh: 阿尔皮坦语在语言学界传统上称为法兰克-普罗旺斯语，是一种高卢-罗曼语，既不同于法国北部的奥依语，也不同于南方的奥克语，自成一支。它通行于阿尔卑斯山西段及其周边：里昂所在的里昂奈、罗讷河畔的维埃努瓦和多菲内、布雷斯和汝拉南部、以尚贝里为中心的萨伏依公国，以及山那边的瑞士西部罗曼地区和意大利的奥斯塔山谷，在普利亚还有一小块中世纪移民留下的语言飞地。它的方言极度分化，分为萨伏依话、里昂话、布雷斯话、多菲内话等众多乡土话，反映出山谷阻隔、政权分治的历史：法国王室领有里昂和多菲内，萨伏依家族以尚贝里为中心经营崛起的国家，瑞士邦联统治着罗曼诸城，弗朗什-孔泰则曾处于西班牙宗主权之下。该语言最早见于12世纪的手抄本，其地古时为凯尔特人的阿洛布罗基人、赫尔维蒂人所居，后来又落入勃艮第人之手。1539年的一项敕令——1540年经萨伏依议会确认——把法语确立为法律和法庭用语，此后随着法国行政和学校教育的扩张，阿尔皮坦语逐渐萎缩为偏僻村庄里的家用语言。

en: The Aru are the indigenous islanders of the Aru archipelago in southeast Maluku, a chain of some ninety-five low-lying islands, including Wokam, Kobroor and Trangan, set in the Arafura Sea south of New Guinea; they are of mixed Austronesian and Papuan descent and speak a cluster of Central Malayo-Polynesian languages. Their egalitarian society was built on lineage clans grouped into two ritual alliances, Ursia and Urlima, and the islands were long tied into regional trade networks with the Banda Islands, visited regularly by Bugis and Makasarese traders. Islam took root in the west in the mid-seventeenth century, brought by Makasarese seafarers. Portuguese and Spanish navigators sighted Aru from the 1520s, and in 1623 the Dutch East India Company contracted its west-coast villages, drawing the islands into a trade in pearls, birds of paradise, trepang, sago, turtle-shell and slaves; a Dutch post and fort rose on Wokam in 1659. Resentment of VOC monopolies fed into the great Maluku rebellion of the Tidore prince Nuku: in 1787 the Muslims of Ujir killed the Dutch garrison and made Nuku's brother Jou Mangofa their king, until troops from Banda crushed the rising in 1791. Dutch influence was only reasserted in 1824, when fresh agreements were signed with local chiefs.
zh: 阿鲁人是马鲁古东南部阿鲁群岛的原住民。群岛由约95个低平岛屿组成，沃坎、科布罗尔和特兰甘等大岛横亘在新几内亚以南的阿拉弗拉海上，居民兼有南岛与巴布亚血统，讲一组中马来—波利尼西亚语言。他们的社会崇尚平等，以血缘氏族为基础，分属乌尔西亚和乌利马两个仪式联盟；群岛很早就纳入了与班达群岛相连的区域贸易网，布吉人和望加锡商人常来常往。17世纪中叶，在望加锡海员传播下，伊斯兰教在群岛西部扎根。葡萄牙和西班牙航海家在16世纪20年代先后望见阿鲁群岛；1623年荷兰东印度公司与西海岸村庄签约，把群岛拖入珍珠、极乐鸟、海参、西谷、玳瑁和奴隶的贸易，并于1659年在沃坎设立商站、修筑小堡。对公司垄断的不满汇入蒂多雷王子努库席卷马鲁古的大起义：1787年乌吉尔岛的穆斯林消灭荷兰驻军，拥立努库之弟乔·曼戈法为王，起义直到1791年才被班达来的军队镇压。荷兰的影响到1824年才重新确立，当年他们与本地首领订立了一批新约。

en: The Aruá are a Tupian-speaking Indigenous people of the southern Amazon in Brazil, established along the Guaporé River in southern Rondônia, where they hold the Rio Branco and Rio Guaporé indigenous lands. Their speech forms its own language within the Mondé branch of the Tupian family.
zh: 阿鲁阿人是巴西南部亚马孙地区操图皮语的原住民，定居在隆多尼亚州南部瓜波雷河一带，领有里奥布兰科和里奥瓜波雷原住民地。他们的语言在图皮语系的蒙代语支中自成一支。

en: The Aruamu, also known as the Mikarew, are a Papuan people of the lower Ramu River in Madang Province, centred on Mikarew village in the Yawar area. Their language belongs to the Ramu family, a group of some thirty closely related languages spread across the Sepik-Ramu basin of northern Papua New Guinea.
zh: 阿鲁阿穆人又称米卡鲁人，是马当省拉穆河下游的巴布亚族群，以亚瓦尔地区的米卡鲁村为中心。他们的语言属拉穆语族；该语族包含约三十种亲属语言，分布在巴布亚新几内亚北部的塞皮克-拉穆盆地。

en: The Ashalaho, also known as the Mountain Crow, were the largest of the four historic bands of the Crow, whose own name for themselves is Apsáalooke. Their name means 'Many Lodges', and they were also called Awaxaawaxammilaxpáake, 'Mountain People', and Ashkúale, 'the Center Camp'. Tradition holds that they split from the Awatixa Hidatsa and were the first Crow group to travel west: their leader No Intestines followed a vision and led his band on a long migration in search of sacred tobacco before settling on the upper Yellowstone River. They made their home in the Rocky Mountain foothills along the Wyoming-Montana border, around the Big Horn and Absaroka ranges, while the Black Hills marked the eastern edge of their hunting grounds. Like the other Crow bands they had left the Hidatsa earth-lodge villages on the Upper Missouri in the late seventeenth century, became mounted bison hunters after horses reached the northern Plains around 1730, and through the eighteenth century dominated the Yellowstone valley while resisting pressure from the Lakota and Cheyenne.
zh: 阿沙拉霍人又称山地克劳人，是克劳人（自称阿普萨卢克）四个历史群体中最大的一支。其名意为‘多屋之人’，另有‘山地人’和‘中央营地’之称。相传他们从希达察人的阿瓦蒂克萨分支分出，是最早西迁的克劳群体：首领‘无肠’受异象指引，率部长途迁徙寻找圣烟草，最终定居黄石河上游。他们活动于今怀俄明与蒙大拿交界的落基山山麓，以大角山和阿布萨罗卡岭为中心，黑山是其猎场的东缘。与其他克劳群体一样，他们在17世纪末离开密苏里河上游的希达察土屋村落，约1730年马匹传入北部平原后转为骑马猎牛，18世纪间称雄黄石河流域，并抵御拉科塔人和夏延人的进逼。

en: The Ashenika are an Arawak-speaking people of Peru's central jungle, close kin of the Asháninka with whom they share the Selva Central; their communities lie mainly in the Ucayali and Pasco departments, including the open grassland plateau of the Gran Pajonal. Their language, Ashéninka, belongs to the Campa branch of the Arawak family and forms one end of the Ashéninka-Asháninka dialect continuum once lumped together under the outside name Campa. Before the colonial period they kept trade networks with the peoples of the highlands. Franciscan friars first entered their territory in 1635, baptising villagers and introducing iron tools that transformed their farming, but missionary interference and epidemics provoked repeated revolts. The great uprising led by Juan Santos Atahualpa in 1742 drove the friars from the Gran Pajonal and restored the Ashenika's control over their own lands for generations.
zh: 阿舍尼卡人是秘鲁中部雨林的阿拉瓦克语族群，与阿沙宁卡人关系密切，同在中央雨林区活动，社区主要分布在乌卡亚利和帕斯科大区，包括开阔的格兰帕霍纳尔草甸高原。他们的阿舍尼卡语属阿拉瓦克语系坎帕语支，与阿沙宁卡语构成一条方言连续体，过去外人把它们统称为坎帕语。殖民时代之前，他们已与山区民族保持贸易网络。1635年，方济各会修士首次进入其地界，为村民施洗并传入铁器，改变了他们的农耕方式；但传教士的干预和疫病引发了反复起义。1742年胡安·桑托斯·阿塔瓦尔帕领导的大起义将修士逐出格兰帕霍纳尔，使阿舍尼卡人在以后好几代人里重新掌握了自己的土地。

en: The Ashkenazim are the Jewish diaspora community that took shape in medieval Germany and northern France; rabbis of the time applied the biblical name Ashkenaz to Germany, and it came to cover the Jews of both lands. Their communities consolidated from the tenth century in the Rhineland cities of Speyer, Worms and Mainz and in French towns such as Troyes, settled by migrants from Italy and the Mediterranean east, and it was in Troyes that the commentator Rashi laid the foundations of Ashkenazi religious learning in the eleventh century. The First Crusade brought the Rhineland massacres of 1096, and crusader and Black Death pogroms of the twelfth to fourteenth centuries drove a steady eastward migration, encouraged by rulers such as Casimir III of Poland. By the sixteenth century most Ashkenazim lived in the Kingdom of Poland and its eastern neighbours. Their vernacular was Yiddish, a Middle High German tongue written in Hebrew letters, and they followed the German synagogue rite. In the eighteenth century Hasidism arose among them in Poland-Lithuania while the Haskalah, or Jewish Enlightenment, spread from Germany, after which emancipation and then nineteenth-century pogroms sent large numbers westward and overseas.
zh: 阿什肯纳兹犹太人是在中世纪德意志和法兰西北部形成的流散犹太社群：当时的拉比把《圣经》中的亚述基纳兹一名用于德意志，后来便兼指法德两地的犹太人。10世纪起，他们的社群在莱茵兰的施派尔、沃尔姆斯、美因茨以及特鲁瓦等法兰西城镇定型，定居者多来自意大利和地中海东部；11世纪，释经家拉什正是在特鲁瓦奠定了阿什肯纳兹经学的基础。第一次十字军东征引发1096年的莱茵兰屠杀，12至14世纪十字军时期和黑死病期间的历次屠犹又迫使他们持续东迁，波兰国王卡齐米日三世等统治者的招揽更推动了这一潮流。到16世纪，多数阿什肯纳兹犹太人已住在波兰王国及其东邻诸国。他们的日常语言是意第绪语，即一种用希伯来字母拼写的中古高地德语，会堂礼拜则沿用德意志仪轨。18世纪，哈西德派在波兰立陶宛兴起，而哈斯卡拉（犹太启蒙运动）从德意志传播开来；此后的解放浪潮和19世纪的俄境屠犹，又促使大批犹太人西迁并远渡重洋。

en: The Ashshipite, 'the Black Lodges', are better known as the River Crow, in their own speech the Binnéessiippeele, 'those who live amongst the river banks'. They were one of the four historic bands of the Crow, or Apsáalooke, a Siouan-speaking Plains people related to the Hidatsa. Tradition holds that they split from the Hidatsa proper after a quarrel over a bison stomach, which earned the whole Crow nation the Hidatsa nickname 'those who pout over tripe'. Leaving the Hidatsa earth-lodge villages of the Upper Missouri in the late seventeenth century, they made their homes along the Yellowstone and Musselshell rivers and in the valleys of the Big Horn, Powder and Wind, a region later called the Powder River Country, sometimes wandering as far north as the Milk River. After horses spread among the northern Plains tribes around 1730 they became mounted bison hunters, and through the eighteenth century they shared in the Crow dominance of the Yellowstone country while warring against the westward-moving Lakota and Cheyenne.
zh: 阿什希皮特人意为‘黑屋之人’，更通行的称呼是河畔克劳人，自称宾内西佩莱，意为‘居于河岸者’。他们是克劳人（自称阿普萨卢克）四个历史群体之一，与希达察人同源。相传他们因一具野牛肚的争执与希达察本部分道扬镳，希达察人因此把全体克劳人戏称为‘为牛肚怄气的人’。17世纪末，他们离开密苏里河上游希达察人的土屋村落，沿黄石河、马瑟尔谢尔河以及大角河、粉河、温德河的河谷而居，这一带后来被称为粉河地区，有时还北游至米尔克河。约1730年马匹传入北部平原后，他们转为骑马猎牛；整个18世纪，他们与其他克劳群体一同称雄黄石河流域，并不断与西迁的拉科塔人和夏延人交战。

en: Asinikawithini, the Asinikaw Īthiniwak or Rocky Cree, are a Cree people of the boreal forest east and west of the lower Nelson River, in what is now northern Manitoba and Saskatchewan. Their name means people of the rocky land, and they once spoke a distinctive r-dialect of Cree before shifting toward the Woodland Cree th-dialect. They lived by hunting caribou and moose, fishing, and snaring snowshoe hares, moving between birch-bark wigwams in the southern woods and caribou-hide lodges farther north. After the Hudson's Bay Company opened posts on the bay from 1670 onward, the Rocky Cree became middlemen between the coastal traders and inland nations, and guns acquired through that trade let them push west and north alongside other Cree groups during the eighteenth century. Their bands are the forerunners of later Cree nations centered on Nelson House, Cross Lake, Lac La Ronge and the Churchill River.
zh: 阿西尼卡维西尼人自称 Asinikaw Īthiniwak，又称岩石克里人，是居住在纳尔逊河下游东西两侧北方森林中的克里人支系，其地今属加拿大马尼托巴省北部和萨斯喀彻温省。他们的名字意为“岩石之地的人”，原本使用克里语中独特的 r 方言，后来逐渐改用林地克里人的 th 方言。他们以猎捕驯鹿和驼鹿、捕鱼、套捕白靴兔为生，南部林地住桦皮棚屋，更北的地方则住驯鹿皮锥形帐篷。1670年哈德逊湾公司在哈得逊湾设立商站后，岩石克里人成为海湾商人和内陆部族之间的中间人，并借由贸易获得火枪，在18世纪与其他克里人支系一起向西、向北扩张。他们的各个群体，正是后来以纳尔逊豪斯、克罗斯莱克、拉龙日湖和丘吉尔河为中心的诸克里族的前身。

en: The Asmat are a cluster of related peoples on the mangrove and tidal-swamp coast of southwestern New Guinea, along the Arafura Sea in present-day South Papua, Indonesia. The name covers about twelve sub-groups united by closely related Asmat-family languages, part of the Trans–New Guinea phylum, and by a shared warrior culture. They live on sago starch, fish, crustaceans and forest game, building stilted houses over flooded ground and tall tree houses inland. Veneration of ancestors lies at the heart of their life: carved bisj poles honour the dead, while headhunting raids and boys' initiation rituals long bound villages together in cycles of revenge. Outside contact came late. In 1770 Captain James Cook's Endeavour met a party of Asmat warriors on the shore and withdrew, and in 1826 the Dutch explorer Kolff likewise retreated from a hostile reception; the Dutch, who had claimed western New Guinea in 1793, did not penetrate the region until the early twentieth century.
zh: 阿斯马特人是新几内亚岛西南岸、阿拉弗拉海沿岸红树林与潮汐沼泽地带的一组相近族群，地处今印度尼西亚南巴布亚省。阿斯马特是约十二个支系的统称，各支系说泛新几内亚语系下彼此相近的阿斯马特语族语言，并共享勇武的战士文化。他们以西谷椰淀粉、鱼、甲壳类和林猎为食，在易涝的土地上建造高脚屋，内陆则搭建高耸的树屋。祖先崇拜是其生活的核心：雕刻的比斯柱用以敬奉死者，猎首袭击和男子成丁仪式则使村落长期处在复仇循环之中。外界接触来得很晚：1770年詹姆斯·库克船长的奋进号在岸边遇到一队阿斯马特战士后撤离，1826年荷兰探险者科尔夫也在敌意的迎接下退走；荷兰人虽于1793年宣称占有新几内亚西部，直到20世纪初才真正深入这一地区。

en: The Astrakhani are the Tatar Muslims of the lower Volga, the people of the delta where the great river empties into the Caspian Sea. Their country was the heartland of the Golden Horde, whose capital Sarai stood nearby, and when the Horde collapsed they became the population of its rump state, the Khanate of Astrakhan, founded in the 1460s by Mahmud bin Küchük, a descendant of Genghis Khan's grandson Jochi. Ruled from the walled town of Xacitarxan, the khanate lived on the transit trade between Muscovy, Kazan, Crimea and Central Asia and on the busiest slave market on the Volga; its commoners were called the qara xalıq and its khans ranked above sultans, begs and morzalar. Crimea briefly occupied Astrakhan in 1523 and again in 1549, and Moscow's envoys arrived from 1532. After the fall of Kazan, Russian armies descended the Volga: Khan Yamghurchi fled in 1554, and in 1556 the tsar's troops occupied Astrakhan and destroyed its slave market. The town was rebuilt twelve kilometres downstream at its present site in 1558, and an Ottoman attempt to retake it failed in 1569. From the seventeenth century the Astrakhani increasingly mingled with incoming Volga Tatars and with the neighbouring Nogai herders.
zh: 阿斯特拉罕人是伏尔加河下游的鞑靼穆斯林，居住在大河注入里海的三角洲地带。这里曾是金帐汗国的心脏地带，汗国都城撒莱就在附近；金帐汗国崩溃后，他们成为其残余政权阿斯特拉罕汗国的臣民。汗国由成吉思汗之孙术赤的后裔马哈茂德·本·库楚克于15世纪60年代建立，以设防城市哈只塔儿罕为都，靠莫斯科、喀山、克里米亚与中亚之间的转口贸易，以及伏尔加河上最繁忙的奴隶市场为生；平民称“哈拉哈勒克”，社会等级自汗以下依次为苏丹、伯克和米尔扎。克里米亚曾于1523年和1549年两度短暂占领阿斯特拉罕，莫斯科的使节则从1532年起到来。喀山陷落后，俄军沿伏尔加河而下：汗王雅姆古尔赤于1554年出逃，1556年沙皇军队占领阿斯特拉罕并摧毁奴隶市场。1558年城市向下游迁移12公里，在今址重建；1569年奥斯曼人试图夺回该城，未能成功。17世纪起，阿斯特拉罕人越来越多地与迁入的伏尔加鞑靼人以及邻近的诺盖游牧民相互融合。

en: The Atacame were a coastal people of the rainy Pacific lowlands of what is now Esmeraldas Province in Ecuador, whose chief settlement of Atacames, on the river of the same name, was the largest town of the shore when Bartolomé Ruiz reconnoitred it in 1526. They shared their culture and their isolated Atacame tongue, also called Esmeraldeño, with the neighbouring Esmeraldas groups. Unlike the highland peoples they were never subdued by the Incas and met the Spaniards as independent villagers. Francisco Pizarro passed along their coast in 1531, and in 1560 Juan de Olmos founded the Spanish town of Atacames on the native site; a first chapel followed in 1577, and an epidemic of 1589 emptied many villages. The colonial era brought sharp depopulation, and by 1740 the town held only about twenty-four families, while the Atacame language, heavily influenced by neighbouring Barbacoan tongues yet unrelated to them, steadily gave way to Spanish.
zh: 阿塔卡梅人是太平洋沿岸多雨低地的居民，地在今厄瓜多尔埃斯梅拉达斯省；其主要聚落阿塔卡梅斯坐落于同名河畔，1526年巴托洛梅·鲁伊斯勘察时，它是这一带海岸最大的村镇。他们与邻近的埃斯梅拉尔达人同文同种，使用孤立的阿塔卡梅语（又称埃斯梅拉尔达语）。与高原各族不同，他们从未被印加征服，西班牙人初到时仍是独立村民。1531年弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗经过这段海岸，1560年胡安·德·奥尔莫斯在土著聚落原址建立西班牙式城镇阿塔卡梅斯，1577年建起第一座小教堂，1589年的一场疫病使许多村落荒废。殖民时代人口锐减，到1740年全镇只剩约二十四户；阿塔卡梅语虽深受邻族巴巴科安诸语影响却与之并无亲缘，此时也不断让位于西班牙语。

en:
The Ishak, better known to outsiders as the Atakapa, are an Indigenous people of the Gulf coast of what is now Louisiana and Texas, speaking a language isolate of the same name. Ishak means the people in their own tongue; Atakapa is a Choctaw or Mobilian label meaning eater of human flesh, after their ritual treatment of enemies. Bands such as the Akokisa, Bidai, Calcasieu and Vermilion occupied six river basins from the Trinity in Texas to the Vermilion in Louisiana, wintering inland in pole-and-thatch villages and moving to the coast in summer. They fished from dugout canoes, speared flounder by torchlight, hunted alligator and deer, and traded dried fish, shark teeth and salt from the Avery Island dome with the Caddo and Chitimacha.

Survivors of the failed Narváez expedition, including Álvar Núñez Cabeza de Vaca, washed up among them in 1528. La Salle's French colony of 1685 drew Spanish and French expeditions into their country; in 1760 French buyers acquired the Vermilion lands, whose band was soon broken by the rival Opelousa, and in 1771 the female leader Quitachoulabenak headed some 500 people near modern Lafayette. After the Louisiana Purchase of 1803 epidemics and land loss thinned the villages sharply, and in 1805 the Indian agent John Sibley counted only about fifty fighting men among the Louisiana bands.
zh:
伊沙克人在外界记载中通常称阿塔卡帕人，是聚居在今美国路易斯安那和得克萨斯墨西哥湾沿岸的原住民，所说的阿塔卡帕语是一门孤立语。“伊沙克”在本族语中意为“人民”；“阿塔卡帕”则是乔克托语或莫比尔行话对他们的称呼，意为“食人肉者”，源自他们处置敌人的仪式。阿科基萨、比戴、卡尔克苏、弗米利恩等支派分布在从得克萨斯特里尼蒂河到路易斯安那弗米利恩河之间的六个河流流域，冬天在内地住木柱茅草屋村落，夏天迁往海岸。他们乘独木舟捕鱼，举火把叉捕比目鱼，猎捕短吻鳄和鹿，并把鱼干、鲨鱼牙和埃弗里岛盐丘出产的盐卖给卡多人和奇蒂马查人。

1528年，纳瓦埃斯远征队的幸存者，包括阿尔瓦·努涅斯·卡韦萨·德·巴卡，漂流到他们中间。1685年拉萨尔建立的法国殖民地把法国和西班牙探险队引到这里；1760年法国收购者买下弗米利恩一带的土地，该支派不久被敌对的奥佩卢萨人击散；1771年，女首领基塔丘拉贝纳克在今拉斐特附近统领约五百人。1803年路易斯安那购地后，疫病和土地流失使村落急剧凋敝，1805年印第安事务官约翰·西布利统计，路易斯安那各支派的战士仅剩约五十人。

en: The Ataronchronon, whose name means “people of the bog,” were the fifth group counted within the Wendat Confederacy of southern Ontario, living in the marshy country on the southeastern fringe of Georgian Bay. French observers were unsure whether they held full nation status, and they may have been no more than a division of the dominant Attignawantan, or Bear nation. They shared the settled Iroquoian life of the other Wendat: palisaded towns of bark longhouses, matrilineal clans, and fields of maize, beans and squash worked by women. When the Dutch-armed Haudenosaunee destroyed Wendake in the Beaver Wars of 1648 and 1649, the Ataronchronon dispersed with the Bear people, their survivors absorbed into Haudenosaunee communities, the French-protected Wendat settlement near Quebec, or the Wyandot coalescence around the Tionontati.
zh: 阿塔龙克罗农人的名字意为“沼泽之人”，是今安大略省南部温达特联盟所辖的第五个群体，居住在乔治亚湾东南边缘的沼泽地带。法国观察者无法确定他们是否拥有完整的民族地位，认为他们可能只是势力最大的阿蒂格纳万坦（熊族）的一个分支。他们和其他温达特人一样过着易洛魁式的定居生活：住在树皮长屋组成的栅栏城镇中，行母系氏族制，由妇女耕作玉米、菜豆和南瓜。1648年至1649年海狸战争中，得到荷兰火器的易洛魁联盟摧毁温达克，阿塔龙克罗农人与熊族一同离散，幸存者或被并入易洛魁社群，或加入魁北克附近受法国保护的温达特定居点，或随提奥农塔特人融合进怀安多特人之中。

en: The Atavillos, also written Atauillo or Atabillo, were a highland people of the Lima region whose territory covered the country of the modern Canta and Huaral provinces, with communities also recorded on the Bombon plateau near Cerro de Pasco and around Jauja. They were one of the many chiefdoms of the central Andes overrun by the Inca general Capac Yupanqui during the northern campaigns of the emperor Pachacutec, and their land entered the empire as the Chinchaysuyu province of Atawillu. Francisco Pizarro's men entered their valleys in 1533 and 1534, and the people were later grouped into the reduction of San Agustin, whose lands Viceroy Toledo formally recognized in 1570. Pizarro himself was sometimes styled the Marquis of the Atavillos, though the crown never granted that title.
zh: 阿塔维约斯人又拼作阿陶约或阿塔比约，是利马大区的高原族群，领地相当于今坎塔省和瓦拉尔省一带，在帕斯科山附近的邦邦高原和豪哈周边也有他们的聚落。他们是安第斯中部众多酋长国之一，在印加君主帕查库特克的北方征战中被印加将领卡帕克·尤潘基的大军席卷，故土作为阿塔维尤省并入印加帝国的钦查苏尤。1533和1534年，弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗的部下先后进入他们的山谷，后来他们被编入圣阿古斯丁归化村，其土地于1570年得到托莱多总督的正式承认。皮萨罗本人曾被戏称为“阿塔维约斯人的侯爵”，不过王室从未授予过这一头衔。

en: The Atchakangouen, also recorded as Atchatchakangouen and called the Greater Miami or Crane Band after their leading clan, were the largest of the bands that made up the Miami, an Algonquian-speaking people of the Great Lakes. Their principal village was Kekionga, at the meeting of the Saint Joseph, Saint Marys and Maumee rivers on the site of present-day Fort Wayne, Indiana, which served as the capital of the Miami confederacy; the French built a trading post and fort there in 1704. Displaced west to Wisconsin during the Beaver Wars, the band retook its Indiana and Ohio homelands around the turn of the eighteenth century with French firearms and support. The war chief Little Turtle, who led the Western Confederacy to St. Clair's Defeat in 1791 and accepted peace after Fallen Timbers and the Treaty of Greenville in 1794 and 1795, belonged to this division. By the early nineteenth century the name Miami had come to mean the Atchakangouen above all, and pressure from American settlement and debt-driven treaties steadily stripped the band of its lands around Kekionga.
zh: 阿查坎古恩人又拼作阿查查坎古恩，以其首领氏族得名鹤部，也称大迈阿密，是五大湖阿尔冈昆语民族迈阿密诸队伍中最大的一支。他们的主村基基翁加位于今印第安纳州韦恩堡所在地、圣约瑟夫河、圣玛丽斯河与莫米河交汇处，是迈阿密联盟的首府；法国人于1704年在此设立商馆和要塞。海狸战争期间他们西逃至威斯康星，18世纪初靠法国火器和支持夺回印第安纳与俄亥俄故土。军事首领小海龟就出自这一分支，他率西部联盟在1791年取得圣克莱尔惨败之战，又在1794年福伦廷伯斯战役失利、1795年签订《格林维尔条约》后接受和平。到19世纪初，迈阿密一名已主要用来指阿查坎古恩人，而美国定居者的进逼和以债务相逼的条约逐渐剥夺了该分支在基基翁加周围的土地。

en: The Atikamekw, who call themselves Nehirowisiw, meaning people in balance with nature, are an Algonquian-speaking nation of the boreal forest north of the Saint Lawrence River. Their homeland Nitaskinan, our land, covers the upper Saint-Maurice River valley in present-day Quebec, where their bands gathered in summer at places such as Wemotaci and dispersed into smaller winter camps, living in dome-shaped bark lodges called piskokan. They hunted, fished and trapped, and their women also raised corn and boiled maple sap into syrup. French documents first name them early in the seventeenth century as the Atikamegouékhi, five or six hundred strong and counted among the more considerable nations of the north, and they soon traded furs for French metal goods. A peaceful people, they shared the country with the Innu to the east, the Cree to the north and the Algonquin to the south, but rivalry over the beaver trade drew them into war with the Mohawk. A smallpox epidemic of about 1670 to 1680 devastated their bands, and Mohawk raids killed many of the survivors; early in the eighteenth century a people the French called Tête-de-Boule reappeared in the same forests, likely a regrouping of Atikamekw remnants with other nomadic families.
zh: 阿提卡梅克人自称“内希罗维西乌”，意为与自然保持平衡的人，是圣劳伦斯河以北北方针叶林中操阿尔冈昆语的族群。他们的家园“尼塔斯基南”意为“我们的土地”，位于今魁北克的圣莫里斯河上游谷地；群队夏天在韦莫塔西等地聚会，冬天则分散成较小的营地，住在名为“皮斯科坎”的圆顶树皮棚屋里。他们打猎、捕鱼、设陷阱，妇女还种植玉米，把枫树干汁熬成糖浆。法国文献在17世纪初首次以“阿提卡梅古埃基”之名记载他们，当时有五六百人，被列为北方较有分量的民族之一；他们很快就用毛皮交换法国金属器具。这是一个性情平和的民族，与东面的伊努人、北面的克里人和南面的阿尔冈金人共享这片土地，但海狸贸易的争夺把他们拖入与莫霍克人的战争。约1670至1680年的一场天花瘟疫重创其群队，莫霍克人的袭击又杀死许多幸存者；18世纪初，一支被法国人称为“圆头人”的族群重新出现在同一片森林中，很可能是阿提卡梅克残余与其他游猎家族重新组合而成。

en: The Atikum, also called Huamuê or Uamué, are an Indigenous people of the Serra do Umã in the Pernambuco sertão, near Carnaubeira da Penha, where colonial records knew them as the Umãs. Documents of 1801 show the Umãs being settled, together with other tribes, in an official aldeia in these hills; they remained there until 1819, when repeated conflicts drove them out, and in 1825 they dispersed across the backlands, part of the group taking refuge in the Serra Negra. Their own tradition calls Umã the father of Atikum, founder of the Olho d'Água do Padre village, and the community also absorbed fugitive Black slaves who sought shelter in the mountains. Their old language, sometimes speculated to belong to the Kariri family but too scantily recorded to classify, survives only in scattered words such as toê for fire, kept alive in the Toré chants they learned from their Tuxá neighbors; otherwise the Atikum speak Portuguese.
zh: 阿蒂库姆人（又称瓦穆埃人或乌穆埃人）是伯南布哥干旱腹地乌蒙山的原住民，住在卡瑙贝拉-达佩尼亚附近，殖民文献称他们为乌芒人。1801年的档案显示，乌芒人与其他部落一起被安置在山里的官设村落；他们在那里待到1819年，接连不断的冲突迫使他们离开，1825年各群体散入腹地，一部分人到内格拉山避难。他们自己的传说把乌芒称为阿蒂库姆之父、奥柳达瓜杜帕德雷村的创建者；社群还吸收了逃入山中避难的黑奴。他们的旧语言有人猜测属卡里里语族，但记录太少、无法分类，只在托雷仪式的唱词中留下表示火等含义的零星词汇，而托雷舞是他们从邻族图沙人那里学来的；除此之外，阿蒂库姆人使用葡萄牙语。

en: The Atka are the Aleut, or Unangax̂, people of the central Aleutians, whose principal home is Atka Island — Atx̂ax̂ in their own speech — the largest of the Andreanof Islands, together with the neighbouring islands of the group. Their speech is the Atkan dialect of Unangam Tunuu, the Aleut language, distinct from the eastern Unalaska dialect and from the now-extinct Attuan of the far western chain. Like other Aleuts they were maritime hunters and fishers, taking sea lions, seals and whales from skin kayaks among the treeless, wind-swept volcanic islands. The Russian navigator Andreyan Tolstykh became the first European to explore the Andreanof Islands in 1761, opening the group to the Siberian fur trade, and Atka subsequently became a station of the Russian-American Company. In the 1820s the Company resettled numbers of Atkan families on the Commander Islands and the Pribilofs to hunt fur seals, and the Atkan dialect thereby also took root on Bering Island, far to the west.
zh: 阿特卡人是阿留申群岛中部的阿留申人（乌南甘人）分支，主要家园是阿特卡岛——他们自称“阿特哈阿特”——安德烈亚诺夫群岛中最大的岛屿，以及群岛中的邻近岛屿。他们讲阿留申语乌南甘话的阿特卡方言，既不同于东部的乌纳拉斯卡方言，也不同于群岛最西端已经消亡的阿图方言。和其他阿留申人一样，他们是海洋猎人和渔民，在树木不生、狂风呼啸的火山群岛间乘坐皮艇捕猎海狮、海豹和鲸鱼。俄国航海家安德烈扬·托尔斯泰于1761年成为第一个勘探安德烈亚诺夫群岛的欧洲人，为西伯利亚毛皮贸易打开了这一海域，阿特卡后来成为俄美公司的一个站点。19世纪20年代，俄美公司把大批阿特卡家庭迁到科曼多尔群岛和普里比洛夫群岛捕猎海狗，阿特卡方言也由此在遥远西方的白令岛上扎下根来。

en: The Atoni, also called Atoin Meto or Dawan, are the dominant Austronesian-speaking people of West Timor, also settled in the Oecussi enclave, whose Uab Meto language accompanies a culture built on circular stone-fenced villages and the gendered symbolism of the Ume Atoni house. Anthropologists count them among Timor's oldest inhabitants, and their highlands drew foreign merchants for centuries through the sandalwood trade. Their most prestigious principality was Sonbai, whose lords claimed descent from a brother of the Liurai of Wehali, the ritual centre of central Timor. Sonbai appears in colonial records in 1649 as a Portuguese ally, but switched to the Dutch East India Company in 1655; defeats by the Portuguese Topasses in 1657 and 1658 split it into Lesser Sonbai, which withdrew to Dutch Kupang as one of five loyal allied principalities, and inland Greater Sonbai, governed in practice by the Kono family. Greater Sonbai defected to the Dutch in 1749, broke away again in 1782 and kept an autonomous highland realm over Fatuleu, Mollo and Miomaffo.
zh: 阿托尼人又称阿托因·梅托人或达万人，是西帝汶的主体南岛语族群，在欧库西飞地也有分布，操瓦布梅托语；他们的文化以石墙环绕的环状村落和讲究男女阴阳象征的乌梅·阿托尼民居为特色。人类学家把他们视为帝汶最古老的居民之一，其高地因檀香木贸易数百年来吸引着外国商人。阿托尼人最负盛名的政权是松拜，其君主自称是帝汶中部礼仪中心韦哈莱的利乌莱之弟的后裔。1649年的松拜已见于殖民记载，本为葡萄牙盟邦，1655年转与荷兰东印度公司缔约；1657至1658年被葡萄牙托帕塞人击败后，松拜分裂为两部分：小松拜撤往荷兰治下的古邦，成为五个忠实盟邦之一，内陆的大松拜则由科诺家族实际执政。大松拜于1749年转投荷兰，1782年再度脱离，在法图勒乌、莫洛和米奥马福一带维持着高地自治政权。

en: The Atrakwaye are the Akhrakouaeronon, a little-known people thought to be a Susquehannock subtribe. Their chief town, shown as Quadroque on John Smith's map of 1608, stood on the Susquehanna below its West Branch in Northumberland County, Pennsylvania, and the group is otherwise known only from the Jesuit Relations.
zh: 阿特拉夸耶人即阿特拉克瓦埃罗农人，是一支记载很少的族群，一般认为属于萨斯奎哈诺克人的分支。他们的主要城镇在约翰·史密斯1608年的地图上标作夸德罗克，位于萨斯奎哈纳西支汇口以下的今宾夕法尼亚州诺森伯兰县境内；除此之外，该族群只在《耶稣会报告》中被简短提及。

en: The Attignawantan, or Attinniaoenten, “people of the bear,” were the leading nation of the Wendat Confederacy of southern Ontario. With the Cord people they formed the first Wendat alliance in the mid-fifteenth century, the nucleus around which the full confederacy later grew. Their country lay at the heart of Wendake between Georgian Bay and Lake Simcoe, and the village of Ossossane, where more than six hundred Wenro refugees were welcomed in 1639, served as the confederacy’s capital in the Jesuit period; the smaller Ataronchronon group may itself have been a division of the Bear nation. Dutch-armed Haudenosaunee forces destroyed Wendake in 1648 and 1649 during the Beaver Wars. It was chiefly Attignawantan survivors who took refuge with the Tionontati, and their union, later joined by Wenro and Neutral refugees, formed the Wyandot people who settled at Michilimackinac in 1671 and near Detroit in 1701.
zh: 阿蒂格纳万坦人（Attinniaoenten）意为“熊之人”，是今安大略省南部温达特联盟中居于主导地位的民族。15世纪中叶，他们与绳族结成温达特人的第一个同盟，成为日后整个联盟的核心。其领地位于乔治亚湾与锡姆科湖之间的温达克腹地；在耶稣会传教士活跃的年代，奥索萨内村是联盟的首府，1639年有六百多名温罗难民在此受到接纳，而规模较小的阿塔龙克罗农群体可能本就是熊族的一个分支。1648年至1649年海狸战争期间，得到荷兰火器的易洛魁联盟摧毁了温达克。投奔提奥农塔特人的幸存者主要就是阿蒂格纳万坦人，二者融合，又陆续吸收温罗人和中立人难民，形成了怀安多特人，于1671年定居米基利马基诺，1701年迁至底特律附近。

en: The Attigneenongnahac, whose Wendat name Hatingeennonniahak means “makers of cords for nets,” were the Cord nation and one of the founding peoples of the Wendat Confederacy of southern Ontario. In the mid-fifteenth century they allied with the Bear nation, creating the nucleus to which the Rock nation attached itself around 1590 and the Deer nation around 1610. They shared the Wendat homeland of Wendake, between Lake Simcoe and Georgian Bay: a country of twenty or more palisaded longhouse towns whose matrilineal families farmed the Three Sisters and traded maize and tobacco with the neighbouring Tionontati and Neutral. European epidemics reduced the confederacy from perhaps thirty thousand people to about nine thousand by 1640, and the Haudenosaunee conquest of Wendake in 1648 and 1649 scattered the Cord nation along with the rest; its survivors ended in Haudenosaunee villages, the Quebec settlement of Wendake, or the Wyandot fusion with the Tionontati.
zh: 阿蒂格尼农纳哈克人在温达特语中称 Hatingeennonniahak，意为“织网绳的人”，即绳族，是今安大略省南部温达特联盟的奠基民族之一。15世纪中叶，他们与熊族结盟，构成联盟的核心；岩族约于1590年、鹿族约于1610年先后加入。他们生活在锡姆科湖与乔治亚湾之间的故土温达克，那里分布着二十多座围有木栅栏的长屋城镇，母系大家庭种植“三姐妹”作物，并与邻近的提奥农塔特人和中立人交易玉米和烟草。欧洲人带来的疫病使联盟人口从可能的三万人降到1640年的约九千人；1648年至1649年易洛魁联盟征服温达克，绳族与其他民族一同离散，幸存者或进入易洛魁人的村寨，或前往魁北克的温达克定居点，或随提奥农塔特人融合为怀安多特人。

en: The Attu are the westernmost of the Aleut, or Unangax̂, people, occupying Attu Island — Atan in their own speech — and the other Near Islands at the end of the Aleutian chain, closest of all to the Kamchatka peninsula. Archaeological sites suggest a pre-contact population of between two and five thousand on Attu alone. Like the rest of the Unangax̂ they were maritime people, hunting sea otters, seals and whales from skin kayaks and fishing the stormy Bering and North Pacific waters, and their speech formed the distinct Attuan, or Western Aleut, dialect of Unangam Tunuu. Their position nearest Asia made them the first Aleuts to meet the Russian fur trade: the explorer Aleksei Chirikov sighted and named the island in 1742, and promyshlenniki hunters then wintered on Attu for years at a time to take sea-otter pelts, clashing repeatedly with the islanders. Tribute demands, violence and introduced disease cut deeply into the Attu population during the Russian period, while the Russian-American Company also drew survivors into its far-flung hunting and resettlement network.
zh: 阿图人是阿留申人（乌南甘人）中最靠西的一支，居住在阿留申群岛链尽头的阿图岛（他们自称阿坦）及尼尔群岛其他岛屿，是所有阿留申人中离堪察加半岛最近的。考古遗址显示，仅阿图岛在接触外来者之前就有两千到五千居民。和其他乌南甘人一样，他们是海洋民族，乘坐皮艇捕猎海獭、海豹和鲸鱼，在白令海与北太平洋的风暴海域捕鱼，他们的话构成阿留申语乌南甘话中独特的阿图（西阿留申）方言。由于地处最靠近亚洲的位置，他们成为最早接触俄国毛皮贸易的阿留申人：探险家阿列克谢·奇里科夫于1742年望见并命名了该岛，随后俄国毛皮猎人连年在阿图越冬猎取海獭皮，并与岛民屡次冲突。在俄国人统治时期，贡赋勒索、暴力和传入的疾病使阿图人口大幅减少，俄美公司还把幸存者纳入其横跨大洋的狩猎与迁徙安置网络。

en: The Aukštaitians, or Highland Lithuanians, take their name from Aukštaitija, the upland country of the upper Nemunas basin in north-eastern Lithuania and the adjoining lands of present-day Belarus. Until the thirteenth century their territory corresponded to the early Duchy of Lithuania, probably centred on Kernavė, and the Teutonic Chronicon terrae Prussiae of about 1326 calls it Austechia; Grand Duke Gediminas was styled King of the Aukštaitians in German documents. From the late thirteenth century these lands formed the Duchies of Vilnius and Trakai, the core of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania later known as Lithuania proper. Alongside the Samogitians they were one of the two main branches from which the Lithuanian nation consolidated, and their Aukštaitian dialect became the basis of the modern standard Lithuanian language. They remained pagan until the Christianization of Lithuania in 1387, and their nobles later shared the fate of the Grand Duchy within the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth until the partitions of the late eighteenth century.
zh: 奥克什泰特人即“高地立陶宛人”，得名于奥克什泰蒂亚——立陶宛东北部涅穆纳斯河上游的高地，并延伸到今白俄罗斯境内。13世纪以前，他们的土地相当于早期的立陶宛公国，中心很可能在克尔纳韦；条顿方面约1326年写成的《普鲁士地志》称其为奥斯特基亚，德语文书则把格迪米纳斯大公称为奥克什泰特人的国王。13世纪末起，这片土地分为维尔纽斯公国和特拉凯公国，构成立陶宛大公国的核心，后来被称为“正统立陶宛”。他们与萨莫吉蒂亚人是凝聚成立陶宛民族的两大支系，其奥克什泰特方言成为标准立陶宛语的基础。他们在1387年立陶宛基督教化之前一直信奉异教，其贵族后来随立陶宛大公国一同并入波兰立陶宛联邦，直到18世纪末的瓜分。

en: The Auvergnat are the people of the volcanic highlands of the Massif Central, around Clermont, Brioude, Saint-Flour and Le Puy, whose speech is the northernmost major dialect of Occitan, the Romance language of southern France. Their country was the land of the Arverni, one of the richest and strongest tribes of Gaul, whose king Vercingetorix defeated Julius Caesar at Gergovia in 52 BC before the final Roman victory at Alesia; the Roman town of Augustonemetum grew into modern Clermont. In the feudal age the counts of Auvergne ruled from the mountains until Philip Augustus attached most of the county to the royal domain, after which it passed through appanages to the dukes of Berry and Bourbon, whose confiscation by Francis I in 1527 and the inheritance of the last fief by Catherine de' Medici bound the province firmly to the crown. Auvergne nourished Occitan poetry itself, giving the troubadours Peire d'Alvernhe, Castelloza and Pons de Capduelh, and local official documents were written in Auvergnat from about 1340, peaking between 1380 and 1480 before French conquered administration and the upper classes, leaving the dialect to the rural communities of shepherds and cheesemakers.
zh: 奥弗涅人生活在中央高原的火山高地，以克莱蒙、布里乌德、圣弗卢尔和勒皮为中心，方言奥弗涅语是法国南部罗曼语奥克语最靠北的一大方言。这里古时是高卢最富强的部落之一阿维尔尼人的地盘，其首领维钦托利于公元前52年在热尔戈维击败尤利乌斯·凯撒，最终却在阿莱西亚之战中兵败被擒；罗马人建立的奥古斯托内梅图姆城后来发展为克莱蒙。封建时代奥弗涅伯爵割据山中，直到腓力·奥古斯都把伯国大部并入王室领地，此后又经贝里公爵、波旁公爵等封君转手；1527年弗朗索瓦一世没收波旁领地，加上卡特琳·德·美第奇继承最后一块封邑，奥弗涅遂彻底纳入王权体系。奥弗涅还滋养了奥克语诗歌，特罗巴多诗人佩尔·德阿尔韦涅、卡斯泰洛扎和蓬·德卡普杜埃都出自此地；约1340年起当地公文开始用奥弗涅方言书写，1380至1480年间达到高峰，此后法语占据行政与上层社会，方言便留给了牧人和奶酪匠们的乡村世界。

en: The Ava, more widely known as the Guaraní, are a constellation of Tupi-Guarani-speaking peoples whose homelands stretch from the Paraguay and Paraná basins into the Andean foothills of eastern Bolivia, where the warlike Chiriguano branch long held off both the Inca and the Spanish. They call themselves Abá or Ava, meaning people. Before contact they were sedentary farmers living in large communal maloca houses, growing manioc and maize, and may have numbered some 400,000 across their range.
