zh: 科塔加蓬指的是巴科塔人，这是一群讲班图语的族群，生活在加蓬东北部马科库一带奥果韦-伊温多河流域的密林中，以及边界另一侧的刚果邻近地区；该地区名为沙凯的村落便属于他们的支系之一，与正宗科塔、马洪圭、沙马耶和丹博莫等支系并列。他们自己的传说讲述先民从北方人口稠密之地南迁，据说其族名就来自迁徙渡河时众人像捆成一包那样聚集在河岸的经历。他们讲伊科塔语，这是一种方言众多的班图语言，在父系氏族村落中农耕狩猎，并有秘传的割礼和寡妇净化仪式。巴科塔人最负盛名的是姆布卢-恩古卢圣物守护者雕像：风格化的木质面孔覆以闪亮的铜片和铜条，安放在盛放氏族重要祖先遗骨的篮子之上，生者借此与死者沟通，祈求护佑与兴旺；铜在当地稀有珍贵，本身就象征财富与灵力。碳十四测年把现存的马洪圭风格作品断在1600年前后，说明名为布韦特的祖先崇拜及其雕刻传统在17世纪已完全成熟，并在18世纪至19世纪初的森林村落中持续繁荣。

en: The Kowoj were a Late Postclassic Maya group and polity of the Petén lakes in northern Guatemala, active from about 1250 until the Spanish conquest. Their own traditions traced them to Mayapan in Yucatán, whose collapse in the fifteenth century sent them migrating south into Petén, where they settled the cities of Zacpetén on Lake Salpetén, Ixlu between the Salpetén and Petén Itzá lakes, and Topoxte on the Yaxha lagoon. Kin to the Itza but their political rivals, the Kowoj marked their towns with a distinctive C-shaped plaza temple assemblage inherited from Mayapan; in 1696 a Kowoj attack on the Itza capital Nojpetén burned nine of its temples. Earlier, in 1518, Juan de Grijalva's expedition clashed with Kowoj fighters at Chakán Putum on the Gulf coast and killed their chief Moch Couoh. Together with the Itza, the Kowoj held out against the Spanish until 1697, when the fall of Nojpetén brought the last independent Maya polities of Mesoamerica to an end.
zh: 科沃伊人是后古典期末期（约1250年起）危地马拉北部佩滕湖区的玛雅族群兼政权。按他们自己的传说，其先祖来自尤卡坦的玛雅潘，该城在15世纪崩解后，他们南迁佩滕，先后在萨尔佩滕湖畔的萨克佩滕、萨尔佩滕湖与佩滕伊察湖之间的伊斯卢以及雅克萨潟湖畔的托波斯特建城。科沃伊人与伊察人同源却长期为敌，他们用承袭自玛雅潘的独特C形广场神庙群标识自己的城镇；1696年科沃伊人攻打伊察都城塔亚萨尔，焚毁了城中九座神庙。更早的1518年，胡安·德·格里哈尔瓦的远征队曾在墨西哥湾沿岸的查坎普图姆与科沃伊武士交战，击杀其首领莫奇·科沃。科沃伊人与伊察人一同抵抗西班牙人至1697年，随着塔亚萨尔陷落，中美洲最后一批独立的玛雅政权告终。

en: Koyoongkawi is the speakers' own name for Konkow, the Northwestern Maidu language of the Sacramento Valley edge: koyoo means meadow, so the word denotes the speech of the meadow tribe. Its bands held the lower Yuba and Feather River country, one of the most thickly peopled parts of aboriginal California, where hundreds of small independent villages rather than large tribes shared similar customs and lived on acorn meal and the Yuba salmon runs. Their villages included Yupu or Yubu, whose name was later given to the Yuba River, and the Mechoopda, whose main settlement stood near present-day Chico; early records distinguish as many as nine local dialects, among them Otaki, Eskeni, Pulga and Mikchopdo, though only four were still spoken by the turn of the nineteenth century. Like other Maiduan peoples they had no chiefs beyond the leaders of their Kuksu dance societies, and their valley homes put them closer than the mountain bands to Spanish and Mexican travel routes. In 1833 the malaria epidemic that swept the Sacramento Valley struck these river villages hardest, opening the way for the foreign settlement that followed soon after.
zh: 科永卡维是萨克拉门托谷地边缘的康考语（即西北迈杜语）使用者对本族语言的自称：koyoo 意为“草甸”，整个词即“草甸部落之语”。他们的群体据有尤巴河与费瑟河下游一带，那是原住民加利福尼亚人口最稠密的地区之一：这里没有大部落，而是数百个独立的小村落，习俗相近，以橡子粉和尤巴河的鲑鱼洄游为生。其村落包括尤普（又称尤布）村——尤巴河后来便得名于此——以及主营地在今奇科附近的米乔普达人。早期记录区分出多达九种地方方言，如奥塔基、埃斯克尼、普尔加和米乔普多，但到19世纪初只剩四种仍在使用。和其他迈杜族群一样，他们除库克苏舞社的首领外没有酋长；谷地的住地也使他们比山地群体更接近西班牙和墨西哥人的往来路线。1833年，席卷萨克拉门托谷地的疟疾对这些河畔村落打击最重，为随后的外来定居者打开了通道。

en: The Koyukon, who call themselves Denaa and their language Denaakk'e, are an Alaska Native Athabaskan people of the interior, with villages strung along the Yukon and Koyukuk rivers. Archaeological evidence traces their occupation of the region back at least a thousand years, on cultural roots reaching millennia earlier. As hunters and trappers they followed a seasonal round of salmon fishing, caribou and moose hunting and fur taking, moving between small riverbank camps and trading furs to coastal Iñupiat and Yupik, through whom Russian goods and tobacco reached them before any European arrived. The first Russians ascended the Yukon as far as Nulato in the 1830s, finding that a smallpox epidemic had already devastated the village; introduced diseases would cut deep into the Koyukon population in the years that followed.
zh: 科育空人自称迪纳人，称自己的语言为迪纳阿克语，是内陆的阿拉斯加阿萨巴斯卡族群，村落散布在育空河与科尤库克河沿岸。考古证据显示，他们在这一地区至少已生活了一千年，文化根源更可上溯至数千年前。作为猎人和陷阱捕兽者，他们按季节轮替捕鲑鱼、猎驯鹿和驼鹿、取毛皮，在河畔小营地间迁徙，并把毛皮卖给沿海的伊努皮亚特人和尤皮克人，俄国人的货物和烟草也经由此路先于欧洲人到来。1830年代，首批俄国人沿育空河上溯至努拉托，发现一场天花已经重创了村庄；在此后的岁月里，外来疫病使科育空人口锐减。

en: The Kpelle, called the Guerze in Guinea, are a Mande-speaking people of central Liberia and the adjoining forest belt of Guinea, and they make up the largest ethnic group in Liberia. In a country of heavy rainfall and broken ground they farm rice as their staple crop, and their towns were traditionally governed by paramount chiefs and town chiefs who kept order, settled disputes and acted as mediators with outside powers. Their traditions place their ancestors in the Sudanian belt in the sixteenth century, from where they moved westward in the 1500s as the Mali Empire crumbled into tribal wars, clearing forest land for their settlements. In later centuries they traded rice and forest produce with Muslim Vai and Mandinka merchants on the routes to the coast.
zh: 克佩勒人在几内亚被称为格尔泽人，是说曼德语族语言的民族，居住在利比里亚中部和毗邻的几内亚森林地带，是利比里亚最大的族群。他们在多雨崎岖的土地上以种植水稻为生，城镇传统上由最高酋长和城镇酋长治理，负责维持秩序、裁断纠纷并与外部政权交涉。按其口述传统，他们的祖先16世纪时居住在苏丹地带，因马里帝国瓦解后的部落混战向西迁徙，开垦林地定居。此后几个世纪里，他们在通往海岸的商路上与穆斯林瓦伊人和曼丁哥商人交易大米和林产品。

en: The Kren, known to the Portuguese as Aimoré or Botocudo, from the botoque wooden plugs worn in their lips and ears, are a Macro-Jê people of eastern Brazil, whose heartland was the Espírito Santo coast and the headwaters of the Doce and Belmonte rivers on the Espinhaço slopes. Their own name Krenak means heads or sons of the land, and their language belongs to the Jê family, kept alive chiefly by the Krenak themselves. They met the Portuguese almost at once: in 1532 a Botocudo chief was carried to the court of Henry VIII, and a fort raised at Espírito Santo in 1535 was meant to guard against them. Slave-raiding provoked the long Aimoré War from 1555 onward. Colonists gradually drove them west over the Serra dos Aimorés into Minas Gerais, where diamond strikes at the end of the eighteenth century brought fresh conflict; the frontier wars of 1790 to 1820, fought with deliberate smallpox contagion and poisoned food, nearly destroyed the eastern Botocudo groups and left the Krenak as their principal survivors.
zh: 克雷纳克人被葡萄牙人称为艾莫雷人或博托库多人，博托库多一名来自他们戴在唇上和耳垂上的木塞。他们是巴西东部的大热语系族群，核心地带在圣埃斯皮里图沿海以及埃斯皮尼亚苏山坡上的多西河和贝尔蒙蒂河源头。他们的自称克雷纳克意为“土地之首”或“土地之子”，所说的语言属热语族，主要靠克雷纳克人自身保存下来。他们几乎一开始就与葡萄牙人相遇：1532年一名博托库多酋长被带到亨利八世的宫廷，1535年葡萄牙人在圣埃斯皮里图修筑堡垒，目的就是防备他们。掳人为奴的劫掠引发了1555年起漫长的艾莫雷战争。殖民者逐渐把他们向西赶过艾莫雷山脉，逼入米纳斯吉拉斯；18世纪末那里发现钻石，带来新的冲突，1790至1820年的边疆战争中，殖民者甚至故意传播天花、投放毒物，东部的博托库多各群体几近覆灭，克雷纳克人成为他们主要的遗裔。

en: The Ktunaxa, also called Kutenai or Kootenay, are an Indigenous people of the northern Columbia Plateau whose bands live along the Kootenay River in southeastern British Columbia, northern Idaho and western Montana, split into Upper and Lower groups; the easternmost band, the Ksanka, meaning people of the standing arrow, ranged into Montana. Their Kutenai language is a language isolate, unrelated to any neighbouring tongue. One account of their origins holds that they began on the prairies and were pushed across the Rockies by the Blackfoot; each year parties crossed the mountains to hunt bison, and rivalry with the Blackfoot over hunting grounds often turned violent, while smallpox further thinned the Plains bands. Plateau villages lived on salmon, game and roots, travelling in distinctive sturgeon-nosed bark canoes of a type shared with the Sinixt. In the eighteenth century a Lower Kootenay prophet, Shining Shirt, foretold the coming of black-robed missionaries, and by the 1830s Christian elements reached the Ktunaxa through Iroquois voyageurs in the Hudson's Bay Company trade. The North West Company built Kootanae House among them in 1807, but abandoned it in 1812 under hostility from the Peigan.
zh: 库特内人又称库特奈人，是哥伦比亚高原北部的原住民，各支系沿库特内河而居，分布在不列颠哥伦比亚省东南部、爱达荷州北部和蒙大拿州西部，分为上、下两支；最东边的一支称克桑卡人，意为“立箭之民”，活动范围深入蒙大拿。他们的库特内语是一门孤立语言，与任何邻族语言都没有亲缘关系。关于其起源，一种说法认为他们原住草原，被黑脚人赶过了落基山脉；此后每年仍有队伍翻山捕猎野牛，围绕猎场与黑脚人的冲突常演变为武力相向，天花又使草原上的支系人口大减。高原上的村落以鲑鱼、野味和根茎为生，出行使用独特的鲟鱼鼻树皮独木舟，邻近的锡尼斯特人也使用这种船。18世纪，下库特内的先知“闪光之衫”预言黑袍传教士即将到来；到19世纪30年代，基督教元素已随哈德逊湾公司贸易体系中的易洛魁向导传入库特内人中间。西北公司于1807年在他们那里建起库特内贸易站，但在佩甘人的敌对压力下于1812年将其放弃。

en: The Kuba, also called Bakuba or Bushongo, are a cluster of about nineteen Bantu-speaking peoples in the heart of the Congo basin, between the Sankuru, Lulua and Kasai rivers. Their ancestors are said to have migrated from the north in the sixteenth century, settling among earlier villagers and Twa foragers. Around 1625 the outsider leader Shyaam a-Mbul united the rival chiefdoms into the Kuba Kingdom, modeling its court and rituals on what he had seen among the Pende and Kongo. The kingdom was ruled by a king, the nyim, drawn from the Bushoong clan, who governed through a council representing each subject group and a system of merit-based titles. Maize, cassava, beans and tobacco from the Americas brought new wealth, and Kuba nobles patronized a famous artistic tradition of embroidered raffia cloth, geometric helmet masks and carved ndop royal figures. During the eighteenth century the nyims extended their power southward along the Kasai, and the kingdom entered the nineteenth century rich, densely populated and comparatively untouched by the Atlantic slave trade.
zh: 库巴人又称巴库巴人或布尚人，是生活在刚果盆地中心、散库鲁河、卢卢阿河与开赛河之间约十九个班图语族群的统称。据说他们的祖先在16世纪从北方迁来，与更早的村民和特瓦族狩猎采集者混居。约1625年，外来首领希亚姆·安布尔统一了彼此竞争的诸酋长国，建立库巴王国，其宫廷和礼仪参照了他在潘德和刚果见到的制度。王国由布尚氏族出身的国王“尼伊姆”统治，通过代表各臣属族群的议事会和一套凭功绩授予头衔的体系治理。美洲传来的玉米、木薯、豆类和烟草带来了新财富，库巴贵族资助了著名的刺绣酒椰布、几何纹头盔面具和恩多普国王雕像等艺术传统。18世纪，历任尼伊姆沿开赛河向南扩张，进入19世纪时，王国富庶、人口稠密，且因地处内陆而较少受到大西洋奴隶贸易的冲击。

en: The Kuchun-deka are the Kuccuntikka, the Buffalo Eaters of the Eastern Shoshone, also called the Plains Shoshone and later the Wind River Shoshone. Their country lay along the upper Green and Wind rivers of western Wyoming, from the Wind River and Bighorn basins south-west toward Bear Lake and Great Salt Lake, and they kept the largest horse herds of any Shoshone band. Mounted early, they pushed far north on to the plains of Montana and Alberta until the Blackfoot, armed through the Hudson's Bay trade, drove them back; the surveyor David Thompson found most of that northern territory lost by 1787. Their kinsmen the Comanche had already split off for the southern plains in the late seventeenth or early eighteenth century. Around the Wind River Range they fought the Crow over prime bison ground, and from the 1820s their camps anchored the Rocky Mountain fur trade's summer rendezvous.
zh: 库春德卡人即库春蒂卡人，是东肖肖尼人的“食野牛者”支群，又称平原肖肖尼人，也就是后来的温德河肖肖尼人。他们的家园在怀俄明西部的格林河上游与温德河一带，从温德河盆地、大角盆地向西南延伸到贝尔湖和大盐湖，拥有所有肖肖尼支群中最大的马群。他们很早就掌握骑术，向北远抵蒙大拿和阿尔伯塔的平原，直到黑脚人通过哈得孙湾贸易获得火器后将其逐退；测量员戴维·汤普森在1787年记述，北方的故土大多已经丧失。他们的近亲科曼奇人则已于17世纪末或18世纪初分离，南迁到大平原南部。在温德河岭一带，他们为争夺优良的野牛猎场与克罗人交战；从19世纪20年代起，他们的营地还成为落基山毛皮贸易夏季集会的依托之地。

en: The Kuhtsutuuka, whose name means Bison Eaters and was written Kotsoteka in Spanish documents, were a Shoshone-speaking division whose ancestors lived as foot-borne hunter-gatherers in the Wyoming mountains before horses reached the plains. They were probably among the first of the Shoshonean groups to break away: during the sixteenth century the proto-Comanche crossed the Rocky Mountains, and after the Pueblo Revolt of 1680 put Spanish horses within reach they became mounted bison hunters on the southern plains, where New Mexico Spaniards called them the Eastern Comanche, or Cuchanec Orientales. In the late 1770s their war leader Cuerno Verde, who had inherited his father's green-tinted horned headdress after the older man was killed raiding New Mexico in 1768, led a series of deep raids on Spanish settlements. Governor Juan Bautista de Anza marched against him with Ute, Apache and Pueblo auxiliaries and killed him in a running battle in Colorado in September 1779. Through the early nineteenth century the Kotsoteka remained one of the strongest Comanche divisions, until the Cheyenne and Arapaho advance of the 1830s severed their last links with the Shoshone of Wyoming.
zh: 库楚图卡人名字意为食野牛者，西班牙文献写作科措特卡。他们的先祖在马匹传入平原之前，是怀俄明山区讲肖肖尼语的徒步狩猎采集者，而且很可能是最早分离出去的肖肖尼群体之一：16世纪，原科曼奇人越过落基山脉；1680年普韦布洛起义后西班牙马群流入，他们变成南部平原上骑马猎野牛的人，新墨西哥的西班牙人称之为东科曼奇人。18世纪70年代末，战将绿角继承了父亲那顶染绿的角饰头饰——其父1768年袭击新墨西哥时被西班牙人击杀——并率部深入劫掠西班牙定居点。总督安萨联合犹他人、阿帕奇人和普韦布洛人出兵征讨，于1779年9月在科罗拉多的连续追击战中将他杀死。19世纪初，库楚图卡人仍是科曼奇人最强的分支之一，直到1830年代夏延人和阿拉帕霍人推进，切断了他们与怀俄明肖肖尼人的最后联系。

en: The Kuiba were a little-documented Indigenous people of the western Venezuelan interior around Aricagua, on the margin between the Andean foothills and the llanos. Their language is known only from colonial and later ethnographic name lists, which group it speculatively with the extinct Jirajaran tongues of Lara and Falcón; no grammar or texts survive to confirm the link.
zh: 奎巴人是委内瑞拉内陆西部阿里卡瓜一带、安第斯山麓与平原交界地带的原住民，记载稀少。他们的语言只散见于殖民时代及后世的民族志名录，学者推测它与拉腊和法尔孔一带已消亡的希拉哈拉诸语同类，但没有语法或文本存世，这一归属无法证实。

en: The Kuikuro are a Cariban-speaking people of the upper Xingu River in Mato Grosso, one of the interconnected Upper Xingu tribes whose members also include the Kalapalo, Nahukuá and Matipu, whose tongues are mutually close southern Cariban dialects. They are regarded as the descendants of the builders of the archaeological towns now called Kuhikugu, whose palisaded villages, plazas, bridges and radial roads housed perhaps ten thousand people by around 1400, the kind of large settled society the game places along the headwaters of the Xingu. These settlements were abandoned around four hundred years ago, probably after epidemics introduced through European contact shattered the old network. Surviving Kuikuro communities kept the village-otomo way of life, combining fishing, manioc farming and ritual exchange with their Xingu neighbors under shared regional customs. Their cosmology centers on the sun Giti and moon Alukuma as creators and on the Itseke spirits of water and forest, dealt with by initiated shamans who diagnose illness and misfortune. Portuguese slave-raiding bandeirantes entered their oral memory long before any peaceful European visit, leaving disease and disruption in their wake.
zh: 库伊库罗人是马托格罗索州兴古河上游使用加勒比语族语言的族群，属于彼此联系紧密的上兴古诸部之一，与卡拉帕洛、纳库阿、马蒂普等部的方言同属南加勒比语支、彼此接近。他们被认为是考古遗址库希库古城建造者的后裔：那些设有木栅、广场、桥梁和放射状道路的村镇，在1400年前后可能容纳了上万人，正是游戏安排在兴古河源一带的大型定居社会。这批聚落在约四百年前被废弃，原因很可能是欧洲人接触带来的疫病摧毁了旧有网络。幸存的库伊库罗群体保留了“奥托莫”村落生活方式，以捕鱼、木薯种植和与兴古邻族的礼仪交换为生，遵循共通的区域习俗。他们的宇宙观以太阳神吉蒂和月神阿卢库马为创世者，并崇信居于水中与林间的伊采凯精灵，只有经过入会仪式的萨满能与之沟通、诊断疾病与灾祸。早在欧洲人和平到来之前，葡萄牙猎奴远征队就已进入他们的口述记忆，所到之处留下疫病与破坏。

en: The Kukakma are the Cocama, who call themselves Kukama, a Tupi-Guarani people of the upper Amazon floodplain; the Spaniards knew them together with their kin as Omaguas or Cambeba. They held the island-dotted channels and banks of the lower Huallaga, Ucayali and Marañón, where they farmed terra preta soils and orchards, fished, and were acknowledged as the finest canoemen on the great river, carrying trade between its peoples. The name Cambeba refers to their custom of flattening children's foreheads with boards as a mark of distinction. Their Cocama language is closely related to Omagua and travelled with them upriver from Brazil; by the sixteenth century they had reached the Ucayali. They first allied with the Spanish missions, but rose against them in 1662 and were crushed in 1666; epidemics and forced recruitment into Spanish armies then thinned their villages.
zh: 库卡克马人即科卡马人（自称库卡马），是上亚马孙河漫滩的图皮-瓜拉尼语族群，西班牙人把他们与同族统称为奥马瓜人，亦称坎贝瓦人。他们据有瓦亚加河下游、乌卡亚利河和马拉尼翁河上沙洲罗布的河道与河岸，在亚马孙黑土和果园中耕作、捕鱼，并被公认为大河上最出色的船夫，在各民族间转运货物。坎贝瓦一名得自他们用木板压平幼儿前额的习俗，以此作为身份标志。他们的科卡马语与奥马瓜语近亲，随族人从巴西溯河而上，到16世纪已进抵乌卡亚利河。他们起初与西班牙传教站结盟，却于1662年起义，1666年被镇压；此后疫病流行，加上被强征入西班牙军队，村落人口大为减少。

en: The Kukatj, also rendered Kukatji or Gugadj, are an Aboriginal people of the southern Cape York Peninsula in Queensland, whose traditional lands lie around Normanton on the lower Gulf of Carpentaria. Their Kukatj language belonged to the Paman branch of the Pama-Nyungan family and has since become extinct.
zh: 库卡特吉人又拼作库卡吉或古加吉，是昆士兰州约克角半岛南部的原住民，传统领地位于卡奔塔利亚湾下游的诺曼顿一带。他们的库卡特吉语属帕马—牛雅语系的帕曼语支，该语言已经消亡。

en: The Kukra were a Misumalpan-speaking people of the Ulua branch of the Sumu family, whose home was the coast around present-day Kukra Hill and the Kukra River in southern Nicaragua, south of the Ulwa settlements. Their tongue is counted among the Sumo dialects, alongside Panamahka and Tawahka. In the second half of the seventeenth century Kukra communities began mixing with Africans brought to the coast as slaves, but their independence ended with the rise of the Miskito: allied with English privateers, Miskito war parties subjugated them, and English influence over the shore lasted until Britain recognized Spanish sovereignty over Mosquitia in 1796. By the end of the eighteenth century the Kukra had been absorbed into the dominant Miskito, leaving only place names such as Kukra Hill, Kukra River and Kukra Point to mark their former territory.
zh: 库克拉人是苏莫语族乌尔瓦支系的一支米苏马尔潘语族群，故地在尼加拉瓜南部加勒比沿海、今库克拉希尔和库克拉河一带，位于乌尔瓦人聚落以南。他们的语言与帕纳马卡语、塔瓦卡语同属苏莫语的方言。17世纪下半叶，库克拉社群开始与被贩运到海岸的非洲人混血；但他们的独立随着米斯基托人的崛起而终结：与英国私掠者结盟的米斯基托武装征服了他们，英国对这片海岸的影响一直持续到1796年英国承认西班牙对莫斯基蒂亚的主权。到18世纪末，库克拉人已被占主导地位的米斯基托人同化，只有库克拉希尔、库克拉河、库克拉角等地名还标示着他们昔日的领地。

en: The Kuku-Yalanjin are an Aboriginal Australian rainforest people of Far North Queensland, whose traditional territory of some two thousand two hundred square miles covered the headwaters of the Palmer River, running east from Palmerville to Mount Lukin and across the southern and western slopes of the Dividing Range as far as the upper Mitchell River. They had made the rainforest their home for at least four thousand years, living at high population density in semi-permanent bark huts called gunyahs and ordering the year into five seasons. Their staple carbohydrate was the toxic seed of the cycad Cycas media, soaked to leach out the poison before cooking, supplemented by two kinds of yam, bitter walnuts, candlenuts and the Kuranda quandong. Their traditional language was Guugu Yalandji, and they are closely related to the Wulpura people of the Mount Windsor rainforest plateau.
zh: 库库‑亚兰吉人是昆士兰远北地区的热带雨林原住民，传统领地约两千二百平方英里，覆盖帕尔默河上游，东起帕默维尔、西至卢金山，横跨大分水岭的南坡与西坡，一直延伸到米切尔河上游。他们在雨林中至少生活了四千年，人口密度较高，住在半永久性的树皮棚屋“古尼亚”里，并把一年划分为五个季节。他们的主食是有毒的媒质苏铁种子，须先用水浸出毒素再烹煮，此外还食用两种山药、苦核桃、石栗和库兰达昆东果。他们的传统语言是古古‑亚兰吉语，与栖息在温莎山雨林台地上的乌尔普拉人亲缘密切。

en: The Kumalu are the people of the Kumalu area in the inland ranges of Morobe Province, New Guinea. Their speech forms the Dambi–Kumalu end of the Mumeng dialect chain, an Austronesian linkage of the South Huon Gulf group whose varieties share only partial mutual intelligibility.
zh: 库马鲁人住在新几内亚莫罗贝省内陆山区的库马鲁一带，所说的方言构成穆孟方言链的丹比-库马鲁一端。穆孟方言链属南岛语系南休恩湾语群，链内各方言只能部分互通。

en: The Kumandins, who call themselves Kumandy, are a Turkic people of the northern Altai foothills, living along the Biya and lower Katun rivers and speaking a Northern Altai language. Ethnographers treat them as a federation of seok clans of mixed descent: Kipchak-Cuman steppe herders, taiga hunters, Nenets reindeer breeders and fishing groups, and the name Kumandin has been linked to the Cumans whose confederation, from the late ninth century to the Mongol conquests of the 1230s, reached from the Altai toward the Danube. By the seventeenth century the Kumandins lived on the Charysh near its junction with the Ob, and when the Russians demanded the yasak fur tribute they withdrew deeper into the Altai rather than pay. They were first and foremost taiga hunters, adding cedar-nut gathering in the nineteenth century, and dwelt in polygonal log and bark yurts. Over the imperial period most were baptized into Russian Orthodoxy, which coexisted with the older shamanic cults.
zh: 库曼丁人自称“库曼杜”，是阿尔泰山北麓的突厥语民族，居住在比亚河和卡通河下游一带，讲一种北阿尔泰语。民族学家认为他们是由多个“塞奥克”氏族组成的联盟，族源混杂：既有钦察库曼系的草原牧民，也有泰加林猎人、涅涅茨养鹿人和渔猎群体；其族名被认为与库曼人有关——库曼联盟从9世纪末到13世纪30年代蒙古西征时，势力范围从阿尔泰一直延伸到多瑙河。17世纪时，库曼丁人住在恰雷什河临近鄂毕河汇流处一带，俄国人向他们征收毛皮税“亚萨克”，他们不愿缴纳，便向阿尔泰山区深处退避。他们本以泰加林狩猎为首要生计，19世纪又增加了采集雪松籽，住多边形木架树皮屋。在帝国时期，多数人受洗皈依俄罗斯东正教，与更古老的萨满信仰并存。

en: The Kumaoni are the people of Kumaon, a Himalayan hill country in present-day Uttarakhand, with kindred communities across the border in western Nepal; they speak Kumaoni, an Indo-Aryan language that was once the official tongue of the Kumaon kingdom and survives in temple stone and copper-plate inscriptions. Around the seventh century Vasu Dev of the Katyuri dynasty united the local principalities into the kingdom of Kurmanchal, ruling from Kartikeyapura, modern Baijnath; Katyuri kings patronised Shaivism and built the temples of Jageshwar and Katarmal. After the Katyuris collapsed in the eleventh century the hills fragmented for three centuries until the Chand dynasty reunified them in the mid-fifteenth century, moving the capital to Champawat and then, in 1563, to Almora. From the reign of Rudra Chand the Chands acknowledged Mughal suzerainty and sent tribute to Delhi. Weakened during the eighteenth century, Kumaon was conquered by the expanding Kingdom of Nepal in 1791 and passed to the British East India Company after the Anglo-Nepalese war of 1814 to 1816.
zh: 库马翁人是库马翁地区的居民，那里是喜马拉雅山区，在今天的北阿坎德邦境内，同族群体还分布在尼泊尔西部边境一带；他们讲的库马翁语属印度—雅利安语支，曾是库马翁王国的官方语言，今天仍可见于寺院石碑和铜板铭文。约7世纪，卡图里王朝的瓦苏·德夫统一各地小邦，建立库尔马查尔王国，定都卡尔蒂凯亚普拉，即今天的拜杰纳特；卡图里诸王崇奉湿婆派，修建了杰格什瓦尔和卡塔尔马尔的神庙。11世纪卡图里王朝崩溃后，山地分裂了三百年，15世纪中叶昌德王朝重新统一，先后定都占帕瓦特，又于1563年迁都阿尔莫拉。从鲁德拉·昌德在位时起，昌德诸王承认莫卧儿宗主权，向德里进贡。18世纪王国衰弱，1791年被扩张中的尼泊尔王国征服，又在1814至1816年的英尼战争后转入英国东印度公司之手。

en: The Kumeyaay, called Diegueños by the Spanish and Kumiai south of the later border, are a Yuman-speaking people of the Pacific coast between present-day San Diego and Ensenada, reaching east as far as the Colorado River. Their name means people of the west, and they comprise the northern 'Iipai, the southern Tiipai and the desert Kamia, divided into autonomous patrilineal bands under hereditary chiefs, the Kwaapaay. Juan Rodríguez Cabrillo sighted their coast in 1542 and Sebastián Vizcaíno named San Diego during his voyage of 1602, but colonization began only in 1769, when the Portolá expedition built a presidio and the Mission San Diego de Alcalá on the site of the Kumeyaay village of Cosoy. Abuse by soldiers and friars drove the Tiipai villages to revolt: they burned the mission and killed the priest Luis Jayme, though the Spanish rebuilt and tightened their hold. After Mexican independence in 1821 the coastal lands were seized for ranchos, and fighting flared in 1826, when Kumeyaay and Quechan warriors destroyed Fort Romualdo Pacheco after troops had killed dozens of their people at Santa Ysabel. In 1835 some Kumeyaay were settled in the new pueblo of San Pasqual, while other bands raided Rancho Tecate in 1836 and Rancho Jamul in 1837, confining the Mexicans of San Diego behind their town walls.
zh: 库梅亚伊人是讲尤曼语的太平洋海岸族群，西班牙人叫他们迪格尼奥人，在后来的边界以南则称库米艾人；其领地北起今圣迭戈、南至恩塞纳达，向东一直延伸到科罗拉多河。他们的名字意为“西方之人”，内部分为北方的伊派、南方的蒂派和沙漠中的卡米亚三支，由若干父系自治游群组成，首领称“夸帕艾”，世袭继承。1542年胡安·罗德里格斯·卡布里略望见他们的海岸，1602年塞瓦斯蒂安·维斯凯诺在航行中为圣迭戈命名，但殖民要到1769年才真正开始：波尔托拉远征队在库梅亚伊村落科索伊的原址上修筑了要塞和圣迭戈·德·阿尔卡拉传教站。士兵和修士的虐待逼得蒂派诸村起兵反抗，他们焚毁传教站，杀死神父路易斯·海梅；西班牙人后来重建传教站并加强了控制。1821年墨西哥独立后，沿海土地被没收充作大牧场；1826年战事再起，军队在圣伊莎贝尔杀死数十名库梅亚伊人之后，库梅亚伊与夸特桑战士联手摧毁了罗穆阿尔多·帕切科堡。1835年，一部分库梅亚伊人被安置到新建的圣帕斯夸尔村；另一些游群则在1836年袭掠特卡特牧场、1837年袭掠哈穆尔牧场，把圣迭戈的墨西哥人困在城垣之内。

en: The Kumyks are the largest Turkic people of the North Caucasus, settled on the Caspian coastal plain and the banks of the Terek in a land called Kumykia. Their identity grew from the Turkic-speaking population of the Khazar era, reinforced by Kipchak and Cuman migrants, and their final ethnogenesis stretched from the twelfth to the seventeenth centuries. Their chief polity was the Shamkhalate of Tarki, already noted by Timurid historians in the fourteenth century, alongside smaller Kumyk states such as the Endirey principality and the Utamish sultanate. Wedged between Russia, the Ottoman Empire and Persia, the Kumyks balanced all three: Shamkhal Chopan became an Ottoman vassal in the late sixteenth century and joined the Ottoman-Persian war of 1578 to 1590. Russian armies first stormed Tarki in 1560 and conquered the allied Tumen Khanate in 1588, but the campaigns of 1594 and 1604 to 1605 ended in disaster, and the Kumyk victory at Karaman in 1605 under Sultan-Mahmud of Endirey halted Russian advance for more than a century. Surkhay-Shamkhal III routed the Russians at Germenchik in 1650 and destroyed their Sunzha fortress in 1653. Peter the Great's Persian campaign of 1722 to 1723 broke the balance: Endirey and Utamish resisted fiercely, and in 1725 Russian troops burned Tarki and over six thousand households. Through these wars Kumyk, written in the Arabic script, served as the lingua franca of the whole North Caucasus from Dagestan to Kabarda.
zh: 库梅克人是北高加索最大的突厥语民族，定居在里海沿岸平原和捷列克河畔，他们的土地称库梅基亚。其认同形成于可萨时代讲突厥语的人口，又经钦察人和库曼人迁入而加强，最终的民族形成过程从12世纪延续到17世纪。他们最主要的政权是塔尔基沙姆哈尔国，14世纪的帖木儿史家已有记载，此外还有恩迪列伊公国、乌塔米什苏丹国等较小的库梅克政权。夹在俄国、奥斯曼帝国和波斯之间，库梅克人周旋于三方之间：沙姆哈尔乔潘于16世纪末成为奥斯曼附庸，并参加1578—1590年的奥斯曼—波斯战争。俄军1560年首次攻陷塔尔基，1588年征服与之结盟的图门汗国；但1594年和1604—1605年的远征均以惨败告终，1605年恩迪列伊的苏丹·马哈茂德率联军在卡拉曼取胜，使俄国的扩张停滞了一百多年。1650年，苏尔海·沙姆哈尔三世在格尔缅奇克击溃俄军，又于1653年捣毁俄国人在孙扎河上的堡垒。1722—1723年彼得大帝的波斯战争打破了均势：恩迪列伊和乌塔米什拼死抵抗，1725年俄军焚毁塔尔基及六千余户人家。在连绵战火中，以阿拉伯字母书写的库梅克语始终是从达吉斯坦到卡巴尔达整个北高加索的通用语。

en: The Kunama are an ethnic group of the plains between the Gash and Setit rivers, in the Gash-Barka region of western Eritrea and adjoining northern Ethiopia, whose Kunama language belongs to the Nilo-Saharan family and whose closest kin are the Nara. The earliest written notice is that of the Arab writer Ya'qubi around 872, who places the “Cunama” on the eastern borders of the Christian kingdom of Alodia. The tenth-century geographer Ibn Hawqal located them in the Barka valley, fighting with bows, poisoned arrows and spears but no shields, worshipping a god called Anna and governed by a council of elders. Their society is matrilineal, with kinship and membership traced through the mother, and they lived by hoe farming and cattle herding. During these centuries the Kunama were repeatedly the target of slave raiding from their Abyssinian neighbours; in 1692 the Ethiopian emperor Iyasu I led an expedition against them in the Mareb valley, sacking their towns and carrying off captives.
zh: 库纳马人是生活在加什河与塞蒂特河之间平原的族群，聚居于厄立特里亚西部的加什-巴尔卡地区及相邻的埃塞俄比亚北部，所操库纳马语属尼罗-撒哈拉语系，与纳拉人关系最近。最早的文字记载出自阿拉伯著作家雅库比，约在872年，他把“库纳马”部落置于基督教王国阿洛迪亚的东境。10世纪的地理学家伊本·豪盖勒记载他们住在巴尔卡河谷，以弓、毒箭和长矛作战而不用盾牌，信奉名叫安娜的神，由长老议事会治理。其社会按母系计算亲属与成员身份，以锄耕和牧牛为生。这几百年间，库纳马人不断遭到阿比西尼亚邻邦的猎奴袭击；1692年，埃塞俄比亚皇帝伊亚苏一世远征马雷卜河谷的库纳马人，洗劫村镇并掳走人口。

en: The Kunda, or Akunda, are a Bantu people whose own traditions place their origin in the Luba country of the upper Congo basin. Led by a migration hero named Mambwe, they drifted south with other groups leaving the Luba and Lunda sphere, and by the 1700s had settled in the middle Luangwa valley, a land they call Malambo, in what is now eastern Zambia. They live by farming and hunting in villages ruled by hereditary chiefs of the Mambwe title, six of whom recognize a single senior chief, and they preserve the memory of the migration and of legendary hunts in their annual Malaila ceremony. Their language, Chikunda, is a Bantu tongue closely related to Bisa and Nsenga, the speech of neighboring peoples who shared the same movement out of the Luba heartland.
zh: 昆达人（自称阿昆达人）是班图人的一支，他们自己的起源传说把故乡放在刚果盆地上游的卢巴地区。在迁徙英雄曼布韦率领下，他们与其他离开卢巴、隆达势力范围的群体一同南下，到18世纪已定居在卢安瓜河中游河谷，他们称之为马拉姆博，即今天赞比亚东部一带。他们以农耕和狩猎为生，村落由世袭的“曼布韦”头衔酋长统治，六位酋长共尊一位大酋长；每年举行的马莱拉仪式保存着对大迁徙和传奇狩猎的记忆。他们的语言奇昆达语属班图语，与比萨语和恩森加语关系密切，后两者的使用者也同样是从卢巴核心区迁出的邻近族群。

en: The Qkung are the ǃKung, also written ǃXun or Ju, both words meaning people, one of the best-known San nations. Their country runs along the western edge of the Kalahari, through Ovamboland in northern Namibia and southern Angola and into northern Botswana, where the Juǀʼhoansi are their largest group. They lived in small, fluid bands of hunter-gatherers, following game and wild plant foods around seasonal waterholes, and kept no chiefs or headmen: even an acknowledged leader only divided the kill and stood no higher than the elders. Bands bound themselves to one another through arranged marriages, and a new couple went to live with the wife's family. Their Ju language belongs to the Kxʼa family and makes heavy use of click consonants. As the Bantu expansion reached the region by about the year 1000, cattle-keeping Ovambo and other Bantu peoples settled the better-watered fringes of the desert, and ǃKung bands traded, intermarried and sometimes served them while keeping their own foraging life in the sandveld.
zh: 孔人是最知名的桑人支系之一，其族名“孔”，又作“讯”或“朱”，在他们的语言里都意为“人”。他们的家园沿卡拉哈里沙漠西缘延伸，穿过纳米比亚北部与安哥拉南部的奥万博兰，直达博茨瓦纳北部，其中人数最多的群体是 朱霍安西人。他们以流动小群狩猎采集为生，随猎物和野生植物围绕季节性水洼迁徙；群内没有酋长或头人，公认的领袖也只负责分配猎物，地位并不高于长者。各群体通过包办婚姻彼此结盟，新婚夫妇随女方家庭居住。他们的朱语属卡语系，大量使用吸气音。到公元1000年前后，班图扩张抵达这一地区，养牛的奥万博等班图民族在沙漠边缘水源较好的地带定居，孔人小群与他们贸易、通婚，有时还为其服役，同时在沙原上保留着自己的狩猎采集生活。

en: The Kungarakany, also spelt Kungarakan or Gunerakan, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Northern Territory, called the Paperbark People by European settlers for the paperbark forests of their country. Norman Tindale estimated their tribal lands at about 5,200 square kilometres, taking in the country north-east of Mount Litchfield, the middle reaches of the Reynolds River and the headwaters of the Adelaide River, with their north-eastern boundary near Rum Jungle and Batchelor, and extending toward the Finniss River and Berry Springs. Their language, of which Mukngirru was probably a dialect, belonged to the Daly family; with the Warai and Maranunggu they were joint traditional owners of parts of this country.
zh: 昆加拉卡尼人又拼作昆加拉坎或古内拉坎，是澳大利亚北领地的原住民，欧洲移民因他们家乡遍布白千层林而称之为“白千层人”。诺曼·廷代尔估计其部落领地约5200平方公里，包括利奇菲尔德山以东北、雷诺兹河中游与阿德莱德河河源一带，东北边界靠近拉姆章格尔和巴彻勒，并延伸至芬尼斯河与贝里斯普林斯。他们的语言属于戴利语系，穆克恩格鲁可能是其方言；在这片土地的部分区域，他们与瓦赖人、马拉农古人同为传统所有者。

en: The Kunjeni are the Kunjen-speaking peoples of the south-western Cape York Peninsula of Queensland, whose lands lay around the Alice and Crosbie Rivers and, further west, the Mitchell River and the Gulf Country, with the Yir-Yoront to their north-west. Their speech, also called Uw, is a Paman language of the Pama-Nyungan family, closely related to Kuuk Thaayorre; its dialects, Uw Oykangand and Uw Olkola among them, share up to ninety-seven per cent of their core vocabulary, and well over nine-tenths of its words begin with a vowel. It kept a separate respect register for speaking to in-laws such as a mother-in-law, replacing ordinary nouns and verbs while leaving grammatical words untouched, and the name Oykangand means language of the people from the lagoons.
zh: 昆真人是昆士兰约克角半岛西南部说昆真语诸族的统称，领地在爱丽丝河与克罗斯比河一带，向西远至米切尔河和海湾地区，西北邻伊尔—约龙特人。他们的语言又称乌乌语，属帕马—牛雅语系帕曼语支，与库库—塔约尔语关系密切；其方言包括乌乌·奥伊坎甘德语和乌乌·奥尔科拉语等，核心词汇重合率高达百分之九十七，且九成以上的词以元音开头。该语还保留一套专门对姻亲（如岳母）使用的敬语语体，替换普通名词和动词、语法词则保持不变；奥伊坎甘德一名的意思是‘潟湖人的语言’。

en: The Kuot are the only Papuan-speaking people of New Ireland, a long, narrow island in the Bismarck Archipelago: their language, also called Panaras, is an isolate with no proven relatives, spoken in about ten villages of the northern districts, where earlier populations held out as Austronesian languages spread around them. Even so, Kuot left its mark on those neighbours, and several New Ireland languages are thought to have adopted sound changes through contact with it. The Dutch sailors Jacob Le Maire and Willem Schouten made the first recorded European landing on the island in 1616, and from 1799 onwards whaling ships called regularly for water and provisions, sometimes taking islanders on as crew.
zh: 库奥特人是新爱尔兰岛上唯一操巴布亚语言的族群，该岛是俾斯麦群岛中一座狭长的大岛；他们的语言又称帕纳拉斯语，是一种尚未找到亲属语言的孤立语言，通行于岛北约十个村落。当南岛语族在四周扩散时，这些早期居民的后裔在北方坚守住了自己的语言，反过来还影响了邻语，新爱尔兰岛上好几种南岛语言的音变软化，都被认为是与库奥特语接触的结果。1616年，荷兰水手雅各布·勒梅尔和威廉·斯豪滕首次有记载地登上该岛；从1799年起，捕鲸船定期前来补充淡水和给养，有时还招募岛民充当船员。

en: The Bakairi, who call themselves Kurâ, meaning our people, are a Cariban-speaking people of northern Mato Grosso in Brazil, living along the headwaters of the Arinos and Teles Pires rivers in the cerrado south of the Amazon rainforest. Their earliest remembered home was the forest on the lower Teles Pires, a branch of the Tapajós, until internal quarrels and warfare with the Kayabí drove them south in three separate groups. The western group reached the upper Arinos and was the first to meet Portuguese miners and slaving expeditions in the early 1700s, afterwards working in mineral extraction. The central group settled the headwaters of the Teles Pires and only encountered settlers in the early 1800s, when they took up cattle raising and farming. The largest, eastern group moved to the upper Xingu, lost touch with the other two, and remained unknown to Europeans beyond the frontier.
zh: 巴凯里人自称库拉，意为“我们的人”，是巴西马托格罗索州北部的加勒比语族群，分布在亚马逊雨林以南稀树草原上的阿里努斯河与特利斯皮里斯河上游一带。他们记忆中最早的家园在塔帕若斯河支流特利斯皮里斯河下游的雨林里，内部纷争和与卡亚比人的交战迫使他们分三支南迁。西支到达阿里努斯河上游，18世纪初最早与葡萄牙采矿者和猎奴队接触，此后从事采矿劳作。中支在特利斯皮里斯河源头定居，直到19世纪初才遇到殖民者，转而经营牧牛和农耕。人数最多的东支迁往欣古河上游，与另外两支失去联系，在欧洲人的势力范围之外不为人知。

en: The Kurds are an Iranic people native to the mountains of Kurdistan, the arc from the upper Tigris and Diyarbakır through the Zagros toward Fars, speaking the Northwestern Iranian Kurdish languages. A name resembling Kurd appears in classical sources such as the land of Corduene noted by Xenophon, but under the Sasanians and early caliphs the word chiefly meant Iranian nomads, hardening into an ethnic name only between the tenth and twelfth centuries, when Arabic geographers wrote of Bilad al-Akrad and the Seljuk era coined the term Kurdistan. The Islamic Middle Ages saw Kurdish principalities such as the Marwanids of Diyarbakır and the Hasanwayhids of the Zagros, and above all the Ayyubid dynasty founded by Saladin, who retook Jerusalem from the Crusaders at Hattin in 1187; the Mongol invasions of the fourteenth century ended Ayyubid rule and drove many tribes toward Syria and Egypt. In 1337 the Kurdish emirates lay among the Ilkhanate's successor states. The Safavids brought the eastern Kurds under their rule from 1501, but defeat at Chaldiran in 1514 split Kurdistan between the Safavids and Ottomans for three centuries, with local chiefs installed as hereditary governors. Safavid shahs deported restive tribes to Khorasan after the fall of Dimdim under Abbas I, and in the eighteenth century the Kurdish ruler Karim Khan Zand held the Iranian throne before the Qajars inherited his domains.
zh: 库尔德人是伊朗语族民族，世居库尔德斯坦的山地与高原，其地从底格里斯河上游和迪亚巴克尔沿扎格罗斯山脉延伸至法尔斯边缘，使用西北伊朗语支的库尔德语。类似库尔德的名称早见于色诺芬所记的科杜内等古典文献，但在萨珊王朝和早期哈里发时代，该词主要泛指伊朗游牧民；直到10至12世纪，随着阿拉伯地理书的记载和塞尔柱时代出现库尔德斯坦一名，它才固定为族称。伊斯兰中世纪涌现出一系列库尔德王公政权，包括迪亚巴克尔的马尔万王朝和扎格罗斯山区的哈桑韦赫王朝。库尔德人建立的最强政权是萨拉丁开创的阿尤布王朝：他于1187年在哈丁之役从十字军手中收复耶路撒冷，14世纪蒙古人的入侵终结了阿尤布统治，也迫使许多库尔德部落迁往叙利亚和埃及。1337年前后，各库尔德埃米尔国正处在伊儿汗国后继政权之下。1501年起萨法维王朝将东部库尔德人纳入统治，但1514年败于奥斯曼的查尔迪兰之战，使库尔德斯坦在此后三百年间分属两大帝国；本地酋长被册封为世袭长官。萨法维沙阿则将不安分的部落迁往呼罗珊，阿拔斯一世时期迪姆迪姆陷落后迁徙规模尤大；18世纪的库尔德首领卡里姆汗·赞德更一度登上伊朗王位，其疆土最终由卡扎尔王朝继承。

en:
The Kurnai, also written Gunai or Gunaikurnai, are the Aboriginal nation of most of Gippsland and the southern slopes of the Victorian Alps in south-eastern Australia, a country of inlets, forests and snow-gum high plains. Five major clans made up the nation: the Brataualung, Braiakalung, Brabiralung, Krauatungalung and Tatungalung, each speaking its own closely related dialect. Their founding story tells of Borun the pelican, who came down from the north-western mountains carrying a canoe on his head and found within it Tuk the musk duck, who became his wife and the mother of the Kurnai. Caves near Buchan were the domain of the mulla-mullung magic-workers, and Cloggs Cave has yielded ritual hearths and fat-smeared casuarina sticks showing continuous ceremony across more than twenty thousand years of occupation.

Their relations with neighbours were often warlike: Kurnai raiders once wiped out a Boonwurrung clan near Wilsons Promontory, and the Kulin, Bidawal and Jaitmathang peoples held the borders to the west, east and north. The first Europeans known to cross their country were survivors of the Sydney Cove, wrecked in 1797, who straggled along the Ninety Mile Beach on their desperate walk toward Sydney; sealing boats soon followed along the coast, but the Gippsland interior remained untouched by squatters until the very end of the 1830s, leaving the Kurnai clans in full possession of their lands through most of the game's period.
zh:
库尔奈人又拼作古奈或古奈库尔奈，是澳大利亚东南部吉普斯兰大部与维多利亚阿尔卑斯山南坡的原住民族群，家园遍布海湾、森林和高山雪桉平原。整个民族由布劳塔隆、布拉亚卡隆、布拉比隆、克劳阿塔隆和塔通加隆五大氏族组成，各说关系密切的方言。他们的始祖传说讲，鹈鹕博伦头顶独木舟从西北大山走来，却发现舟中藏着麝鸭图克，图克后来成为他的妻子、库尔奈人的始祖母。巴肯一带的洞穴是穆拉穆隆法师的领域，克洛格斯洞中出土的仪式火塘和涂过油脂的木麻黄枝条表明，两万多年来祭祀传统从未中断。

他们与邻族往往兵戎相见：库尔奈袭击者曾在威尔逊岬附近消灭一个布伍伦氏族，库林人、比达瓦尔人和杰特马唐人则分别扼守西、东、北三面边界。已知最早穿过他们土地的欧洲人是1797年失事的“悉尼湾号”幸存者，他们沿九十英里海滩艰难跋涉，试图走到悉尼；海豹船很快随之出没海岸，但吉普斯兰内陆直到19世纪30年代末仍无牧场主进入，在本时期的大部分时间里，库尔奈各氏族仍完整保有自己的土地。

en: The Kurrama are an Aboriginal people of the Pilbara region of Western Australia, whose traditional lands centred on the high plateau of the Hamersley Range, country they share in native-title arrangements with the neighbouring Pinikura. Their language, also spelled Kurama or Gurrama, belongs to the Ngayarta group of the Pama-Nyungan family and is nearly identical in vocabulary and grammar with Yindjibarndi, though Kurrama speakers regard it as a distinct tongue; the Yindjibarndi call them the Jawunmara.
zh: 库拉玛人是西澳大利亚皮尔巴拉地区的原住民，传统领地以哈默斯利岭的高原为中心，并在原生地权安排中与邻族皮尼库拉人共同管理这片土地。他们的语言又拼作库拉马或古拉马，属于帕马‑牛雅语系的恩亚尔塔语群，词汇和语法与因吉巴兰迪语几乎相同，但库拉玛人仍视其为独立语言；因吉巴兰迪人则称他们为贾温马拉人。

en: The Kurtjari are the Kunggara, also called the Gilbert River tribe, an Aboriginal people of the southern Cape York Peninsula in Queensland. They spoke Gurdjar, an extinct Paman language of the Pama-Nyungan family with two dialects, Gunggara and Rip.
zh: 库特贾人即昆加拉人，又称吉尔伯特河部落，是昆士兰州约克角半岛南部的原住民。他们使用古贾语，这是帕马—牛雅语系帕曼语支的语言，下分昆加拉、里普两种方言，该语言现已消亡。

en: The Kurukh, known to their Munda neighbours as Oraon and as Dhangad in Maharashtra, are a Dravidian tribal people of the Chota Nagpur Plateau, concentrated in what is now Jharkhand with adjoining settlements in Odisha, Chhattisgarh and West Bengal. Their mother tongue, Kurukh, belongs to the northern Dravidian branch alongside Malto and the distant Brahui, and many communities have also adopted the local Sadri and Odia tongues. Kurukh traditions trace their ancestors to the Konkan coast and Coorg in southern India, and the people are said to have reached Chota Nagpur by around 100 CE; another oral account recorded in the nineteenth century describes them holding Rohtasgarh until driven out under the Mughal emperor Akbar, when they withdrew into the plateau forests. Long settled as forest farmers around Ranchi and Palamau, the Kurukh joined the Kol uprising of 1832 against the East India Company and local tax lords.
zh: 库鲁克人是焦达讷格布尔高原的达罗毗荼语部落族群，邻族蒙达人称他们为奥拉翁，在马哈拉施特拉一带又称丹加德；其主体聚居于今贾坎德，并散布到邻近的奥里萨、切蒂斯格尔和西孟加拉等地。他们的母语库鲁克语属于北达罗毗荼语支，与马尔托语以及远在俾路支斯坦的布拉灰语同支，不少群体也兼用当地的萨德里语和奥里亚语。库鲁克人的口传史把祖先追溯到印度南部的孔卡尼海岸和库尔格，据说约在公元100年已抵达焦达讷格布尔；19世纪记录的另一则口述称，他们曾据有罗赫达斯格尔，直到莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴时代被穆斯林逐出，退入高原丛林。他们长期在兰契和帕拉毛一带以林耕为生，并于1832年参加了反抗东印度公司和地方包税地主的科尔起义。

en: The Kusiutta are the Goshute, the westernmost of the Western Shoshone, whose desert country ran from Great Salt Lake west to Nevada's Steptoe Range and south to Simpson Springs. They call themselves Newe, the people, or Kutsipiuti, people of the dry earth, and neighbouring Numic groups used the name Kusiutta from which the game takes its title. Their families were concentrated in the Deep Creek, Simpson Springs, Skull Valley and Tooele areas, gathering only two or three times a year for pine-nut harvests, communal pronghorn hunts and winter villages under a village headman. Women harvested nearly a hundred wild seeds and roots while men took rabbits, lizards and insects and, when luck allowed, deer and bighorn sheep. Through the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries Ute and Navajo raiders carried them off as slaves, and the Goshute remained largely on foot long after their neighbours had horses. The first written account of them was left by the trapper Jedediah Smith, who crossed their lands on his way to Bear Lake in 1827.
zh: 库西乌塔人即高休特人，是西肖肖尼人中最靠西的一支，其沙漠家园东起大盐湖，西抵内华达的斯特普托岭，南达辛普森泉。他们自称“内韦”，意为“人”，又称“库齐皮乌蒂”，意为“旱地之人”；邻近的努米克族群则称他们为库西乌塔，游戏名即由此而来。其家族集中在深溪、辛普森泉、骷髅谷和图埃勒等地，一年只聚会两三次，分别为采松籽、集体围猎叉角羚和在首领主持下过冬。妇女采集近百种野生种籽和根茎，男子捕猎兔子、蜥蜴、昆虫，运气好时也猎鹿和大角羊。整个18世纪到19世纪，尤特人和纳瓦霍人不断来袭，把他们掳为奴隶；当邻族纷纷有马之后，高休特人仍长期徒步行走。关于他们最早的文字记载出自猎人杰迪代亚·史密斯，他在1827年前往贝尔湖途中穿过了这片土地。

en: The Kuskokwagmiut — “the people of the Kuskokwim,” or Kusquqvak in Yup'ik — are the Central Alaskan Yup'ik inhabitants of the broad lower Kuskokwim River and the shores of Kuskokwim Bay on the Bering Sea, while Athabaskan peoples hold the middle and upper river. Their villages, among them Mamterilleq — whose people were called the Mamterillermiut, the Smokehouse People — Quinhagak, Eek, Kwigillingok and Kalskag, lived above all on the river's salmon and whitefish runs, supplemented by seal and beluga hunting on the bay and fur trapping inland, with the qasgiq men's house at the centre of ceremonial and everyday life. Yup'ik groups had spread up the coastal rivers from the Bering shoreline by about the fourteenth century. Russian seamen first recorded the river's name in 1826, and in 1832 the Russian-American Company founded Kolmakov Redoubt on the Kuskokwim as a fur post, binding the Kuskokwagmiut into the Russian trade network that ran from the Bering coast to Nushagak and Kodiak.
zh: 库斯科夸格缪特人意为“库斯科奎姆之人”，库斯科奎姆在尤皮克语中称“库斯夸克瓦克”，他们是宽阔的库斯科奎姆河下游及白令海库斯科奎姆湾沿岸的中阿拉斯加尤皮克居民，而河流中游和上游则是阿萨巴斯卡群体的地盘。他们的村落包括曼特列勒克（其居民称曼特列勒缪特，意为“熏鱼房之人”）、奎纳加克、伊克、奎吉林戈克和卡尔斯卡格，生计首先靠河里的鲑鱼和白鱼鱼汛，辅以海湾的海豹与白鲸捕猎和内地的毛皮诱捕，男子会所“卡斯基格”则是仪式与日常生活的中心。约14世纪时，尤皮克群体已从白令海岸向各条沿海河流上游扩展。俄国水手于1826年首次记录下这条河的名字，1832年俄美公司在库斯科奎姆河上建立科尔马科夫棱堡作为毛皮商站，把库斯科夸格缪特人纳入了从白令海岸通往努沙加克和科迪亚克的俄国贸易网络。

en: The Kusu, plural Bakusu, are a Bantu people of the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, settled chiefly in the Kibombo and Kailo territories of Maniema along the Lomami River, with further communities in North Kivu, Ituri and around Kongolo in Tanganyika, where they are known as the Benya Lubunda and Benya Samba. They arose as a branch of the Tetela and belong with them to the Anamongo cluster. During the 1800s Arab-Swahili caravans opened the Lomami country to long-distance trade, and the Tetela groups who adopted Swahili-Muslim dress, customs and Islam came to be distinguished as Kusu. Their sculpture borrows from the wider region: chiefly stools recall those of the Luba, power figures those of the Songye, and ancestor figures those of the Hemba, while Kusu women fashion the pottery and baskets of everyday use.
zh: 库苏人（复数称巴库苏）是刚果民主共和国东部的班图族群，主要定居在马涅马省洛马米河沿岸的基邦博和凯洛两个领地，在北基伍、伊图里以及坦噶尼喀的孔戈洛一带也有社群，后两处自称贝尼亚·卢本达和贝尼亚·桑巴。他们是特特拉人的分支，与特特拉人同属阿纳蒙戈群。19世纪，阿拉伯—斯瓦希里商队把洛马米地区拉入长途贸易，接受了斯瓦希里穆斯林服饰、习俗与伊斯兰教的特特拉群体逐渐被称为库苏人。他们的雕刻融汇周边诸族之长：酋长凳凳式近卢巴人，灵力雕像似松耶人，祖先像则如海姆巴人；陶器和篮筐等日常器用由库苏妇女制作。

en: The Kutai are the Malayic people of the Mahakam River basin in East Kalimantan, heirs to one of Borneo's oldest political traditions. Their name comes from the ancient Hindu kingdom of Kutai Martapura, whose yupa stone pillars were raised near Muara Kaman in the fourth century under King Mulawarman, making it the earliest known Indianised state in the Indonesian archipelago. Downriver at Kutai Lama a new court, Kutai Kartanegara, was founded around 1300 by Aji Batara Agung Dewa Sakti, its rulers taking Hindu-Javanese titles through contact with Majapahit. The Kutai themselves descend from Dayak clans of the Mahakam who underwent Malayisation and conversion to Islam, brought in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries by Minangkabau clerics, and the court officially became Muslim in 1575. In 1635 Kutai Kartanegara conquered and absorbed the old kingdom of Martapura, forging a single Kutai identity and pushing unconverted Dayak groups into the interior. The capital moved upriver to Jembayan in 1732 and to Tenggarong in 1782, from where the sultans controlled the Mahakam's forest and delta trade. Their language, Kutainese, is a Malayic tongue once written in the Jawi script, with Tenggarong and Kota Bangun varieties.
zh: 古泰人是东加里曼丹马哈坎河流域的马来语支族群，继承了婆罗洲最古老的政治传统之一。他们的名字来自古印度教王国古泰马尔塔普拉：4世纪时，穆拉瓦尔曼王在穆阿拉卡曼一带立下尤帕石柱，这是印度尼西亚群岛已知最早的印度化政权。1300年前后，阿吉·巴塔拉·阿贡·德瓦·萨克蒂在河口的古泰拉马建立新朝廷古泰卡塔尼加拉，统治者因与满者伯夷交往而采用印度教—爪哇式头衔。古泰人本身源自马哈坎流域的达雅诸部，后来经历马来化并改宗伊斯兰教，信仰在16至17世纪由米南加保教士传入，朝廷于1575年正式成为穆斯林政权。1635年，古泰卡塔尼加拉攻灭并吞并古国马尔塔普拉，塑造出统一的古泰认同，不愿改宗的达雅群体则退入内陆。王都于1732年迁至占巴延，1782年再迁登加龙，苏丹由此控制马哈坎河的林产品与河口贸易。他们的语言古泰语属马来语支，曾用爪夷文书写，分为登加龙和哥打邦温两种变体。

en: The Kuthanti are the Gkuthaarn people, also recorded as Kutanda or Kareldi, an Aboriginal group of the southern Cape York Peninsula in Queensland whose country lay around Normanton on the Gulf of Carpentaria, alongside the Kukatj. Their Gkuthaarn language was a Paman tongue of the Pama-Nyungan family, now extinct.
zh: 库坦特人即古塔恩人，文献中也记作库坦达或卡雷尔迪，是昆士兰州约克角半岛南部的原住民群体，领地位于卡奔塔利亚湾的诺曼顿一带，与库卡特吉人为邻。他们的古塔恩语是帕马—牛雅语系帕曼语支的语言，现已消亡。

en: The Kuuku-Yau, more properly the Pakadji, are an Aboriginal people of the north-eastern Cape York Peninsula in Queensland, whose country lay on the Coral Sea coast around Lloyd Bay and the Lockhart River, north of the Umpila. Their speech belongs to the Umpila dialect group of the North Cape York Paman languages, and the coastal name Kuuku Ya'u, given them by southern neighbours, combines words for speech and this way. Like other Kawadji or sandbeach peoples they lived from the resources of the sea, splitting the year between the dry kawali season, when they moved inland for yams, bush honey and spear wood, and the monsoon season spent on the coast; they also used a rapid one-handed sign language. Captain Cook charted their coast in 1770, though permanent outside settlement came only after the period.
zh: 库库尧人（本名帕卡吉人）是昆士兰约克角半岛东北部的原住民，家园位于珊瑚海畔劳埃德湾与洛克哈特河一带，在乌姆皮拉人以北。他们的语言属北约克角帕马语组的乌姆皮拉方言群；“库库尧”是南方邻人对他们的称呼，由“话语”和“这边”两个词构成，大意是“这样说话的人”。和其他“沙滩人”一样，他们以海洋出产为生：一年分为两季，东南信风带来的干季里转入内陆，采集山药、野蜜并获取制矛木材，西北季风季则留守海岸；他们还使用一套动作迅捷的单手手语。1770年库克船长测绘了这段海岸，但永久的外来定居点直到本时期结束后才出现。

en: The Kuy, whose name means person or human being in their own Katuic Mon-Khmer tongue, are regarded as one of the indigenous peoples of the southern Khorat Plateau, the Dangrek Mountains and the middle Mekong, across present-day Thailand, Laos and Cambodia. In 1337 their villages already dotted the Khmer-influenced plateau around Phimai, Buriram and Khukhan. Kuy tradition and the inscriptions of Preah Vihear associate them especially with elephants: the Kuy Ajiang of the Surin forests caught and trained wild elephants along the Dangrek range as early as the Chenla kingdoms of the 600s and 700s, and later supplied the courts of Angkor and Siam. The Siamese of Ayutthaya, founded in 1351, called these upland tribute-paying villagers Suay, an administrative label rather than a tribal name. Most Kuy combined swidden farming with animist spirit cults, while those absorbed into Thai and Lao kingdoms gradually took up Theravada Buddhism.
zh: 归人在自己的戈都语支孟高棉语言里以“归”自称，意为“人”，被视为呵叻高原南部、扁担山脉和湄公河中游一带的原住民之一，分布在今天的泰国、老挝和柬埔寨。1337年时，他们的村落已散布在受高棉影响的披迈、武里南、库坎一带高原上。归人的传统以及柏威夏寺的碑铭都把他们与大象紧紧联系在一起：素林森林里的“象归”早在六七世纪的真腊王国时期就沿着扁担山脉捕捉和驯化野象，后来又向吴哥和暹罗的宫廷供应大象。1351年建立的阿瑜陀耶王朝把这些纳贡的山地村民称为“苏哀”，这是一个行政标签而非族名。多数归人一边刀耕火种，一边信奉万物有灵的神灵崇拜，被纳入泰人、佬人政权的部分则逐渐改奉上座部佛教。

en: The Kuyu, also called Koyo, are a Bantu people living along the Kuyu River in the borderlands of Gabon and the Republic of the Congo. They are divided into two clans marked by separate ancestor cults, the serpent on the east bank and the panther on the west, whose initiation rites feature the spinning kebe-kebe dance and carved éouya crests.
zh: 库尤人又称科约人，是生活在库尤河沿岸的班图族群，地处加蓬与刚果（布）交界一带。他们分为两个氏族，各有不同的祖先崇拜：河东奉蛇，河西奉豹；其成年仪式上有旋转的“凯贝凯贝”舞和雕刻的“埃乌亚”头饰。

en: The Kvens are a Balto-Finnic people of the far north, whose Kven language is a Finnic tongue closely related to Finnish and to Meänkieli across the Torne Valley. The Old English Orosius of the ninth century calls them Cwenas, and the Icelandic sagas speak of the kvenir dwelling in Kvenland east of the Scandinavian mountains, around the northern end of the Gulf of Bothnia. Dano-Norwegian tax censuses first register Quæn settlers in the 1520s, and a map by Olaus Magnus in 1539 marks a Kven settlement between Tromsø and Lofoten. From the early eighteenth century larger waves crossed into Norway, driven by the devastation of the Great Northern War of 1700 to 1721, failed harvests and a growing rural population; farmers and fishermen from the Torne Valley, northern Ostrobothnia and Kainuu cleared land along the fjords of Troms and Finnmark, combining agriculture with salmon fishing. The Danish crown welcomed them as bulwarks against Swedish and Russian claims, and a delegation led by Knut Olsen Kven swore loyalty in Copenhagen and won royal backing for settlement at Alta. By the early nineteenth century Kven farming and fishing communities were established along the fjords of northern Norway.
zh: 克文人是远北地区的波罗的芬兰人，使用与芬兰语及托尔讷河谷的梅安基利语相近的芬兰语支语言克文语。9世纪的古英语文献称他们为克韦纳人，冰岛萨迦则提到住在斯堪的纳维亚山脉以东克文兰的克文人，其地约在波的尼亚湾北端一带。丹麦-挪威的税册在1520年代首次登记到名为奎恩的定居者，奥劳斯·马格努斯1539年的地图也在特罗姆瑟与罗弗敦之间标出一处克文定居点。18世纪初出现更大规模的迁挪威浪潮：1700至1721年大北方战争的破坏、歉收和乡村人口增长，推动托尔讷河谷、北博滕北部和凯努的农民与渔民渡海北上，在特罗姆斯和芬马克的峡湾沿岸开垦土地，兼营农耕与鲑鱼捕捞。丹麦王室欢迎他们前来，以抵御瑞典和俄国的领土主张；克努特·奥尔森·克文率领的使团在哥本哈根宣誓效忠，为阿尔塔的定居点争得王室支持。到19世纪初，克文人的农耕渔业社群已在挪威北部各峡湾扎根。

en: The Kwaio are an Oceanic-speaking people of the rugged interior of central Malaita in the Solomon Islands, whose oral tradition holds that the ancestral founders first cleared the forest twelve to twenty centuries ago; the old clearings, marked by shrines, still define the lands of the clans descended from those founders. Kwaio families lived in tiny hamlets set close together, farming taro in rotating swiddens alongside yams and plantains, and their religion centred on the power of ancestors, whose rules of taboo, called abu, were enforced through sacrifice, with the ancestral spirit La'aka held in particular awe. Spanish explorers sighted Malaita in 1568, but the Kwaio valleys long remained beyond European reach, and the Kwaio kept to their rites more stubbornly than their coastal neighbours.
zh: 夸约人是所罗门群岛马莱塔岛中部崎岖内陆操大洋洲语族语言的族群；按其口传传统，始祖在约十二至二十个世纪前首次开垦森林，那些以神龛标记的古老垦地此后一直界定着各父系氏族的土地。夸约人家族住在彼此相近的小村落里，以轮歇方式种植芋头，兼种山药和芭蕉；宗教以祖先灵力为中心，称阿布的禁忌规则须靠献祭弥补，名为拉阿卡的祖灵尤其令人敬畏。1568年西班牙探险者望见了马莱塔岛，但夸约人的山谷长期处在欧洲人势力之外，夸约人也比沿海邻族更顽强地守着自己的仪式。

en: The Kwakiutl, whose own name Kwakwaka'wakw means the Kwak'wala-speaking peoples, are a Wakashan nation of the northern end of Vancouver Island, the Discovery Islands and the inlets of the neighbouring British Columbia mainland. Kwakiutl properly names only the Kwagu'ł community of Fort Rupert, but the anthropologist Franz Boas made it the label for all the Kwak'wala-speaking nations, each governed by a head chief above hereditary clan chiefs in a society divided between nobles, commoners and slaves. Their fishing and barter economy reached the Tsimshian, Tlingit, Nuu-chah-nulth and Coast Salish in wide trade networks. They built cedar plank houses up to thirty metres long with crest totem poles at the door, carved transformation masks and towering poles, wove Chilkat blankets and hammered named copper plates whose value was counted in wool blankets. Rank was proven not by keeping wealth but by giving it away at the potlatch, where rival chiefs bid against each other for coppers, and the four-day Klasila festival of song and dance opened the winter ceremonial season. Their oral histories tell of ancestors who arrived as Thunderbirds, orcas and grizzlies before taking human form. Captain George Vancouver made the first recorded European contact in 1792.
zh: 夸扣特尔人自称夸夸卡瓦库，意为“讲夸克瓦拉语的人”，是瓦卡什语民族，分布在温哥华岛北端、发现群岛以及邻近的不列颠哥伦比亚大陆海岸峡湾一带。严格说来，“夸扣特尔”本指鲁珀特堡的夸古尔特一个群体，但人类学家弗朗茨·博厄斯用它统称所有讲夸克瓦拉语的部族；各部族由大酋长统领，其下是世袭的氏族酋长，社会分为贵族、平民和奴隶三个等级。他们以渔业和物物交换为生，贸易网络远及钦西安人、特林吉特人、努查努阿特人和海岸萨利什人。他们建造长达三十米的雪松木板房，门口竖立绘有家徽的图腾柱，雕刻变形面具和高大图腾柱，编织奇尔卡特毛毯，还打造取了名字的铜片——铜片的价值以毛毯来折算。地位不靠囤积财富、而靠在夸富宴上散财来证明：宴上敌对酋长竞相出价争购铜片；历时四天、载歌载舞的克拉西拉节则拉开冬季仪典季节的序幕。他们的口传历史说，祖先以雷鸟、虎鲸和灰熊的形态降临，之后才化为人形。1792年，乔治·温哥华船长与他们进行了有记载的第一次欧洲人接触。

en: The Kwaraae are an Oceanic-speaking people spread across the western, central and eastern parts of Malaita in the Solomon Islands, whose speech is the most widely used indigenous language of the archipelago. Malaita was settled by Austronesian seafarers between five thousand and thirty-five hundred years ago, and Kwaraae oral tradition tells of a founding ancestor, some twenty generations back, who first landed on Guadalcanal and then followed a magical staff to the middle of Malaita, where he laid down the people's customs before his descendants spread out to the coastal lowlands. The Spanish expedition of Álvaro de Mendaña sighted Malaita in 1568, after which the Solomons vanished from European charts for two centuries, leaving the Kwaraae to their own clan and chiefly affairs.
zh: 夸拉埃人是分布在所罗门群岛马莱塔岛西部、中部和东部、操大洋洲语族语言的族群，其语言是该群岛使用最广的本土语言。马莱塔岛在五千至三千五百年前由南岛语系航海者定居；夸拉埃人的口传传统称，约二十代前有一位始祖先在瓜达尔卡纳尔登陆，随后跟随一根魔杖来到马莱塔岛中部，立下族人的习俗，他的后裔再四散到沿海低地。1568年阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚的西班牙探险队望见马莱塔岛，此后所罗门群岛在欧洲海图上消失了两百年，夸拉埃人得以照旧过着氏族与酋长治下的村落生活。

en: The Kwaza, also called Koaiá, are a people of the high rainforest in southern Rondônia, once settled along the São Pedro and Taboca rivers and the headwaters of the Pimenta Bueno. Semi-nomadic slash-and-burn cultivators, they lived, intermarried and feuded with the Aikanã, Kanoê and Tuparí, and their language is an isolate unrelated to any neighboring tongue.
zh: 夸扎人又称科阿亚，是朗多尼亚州南部高地雨林中的族群，曾散居在圣佩德罗河、塔博卡河沿岸和皮门塔布埃努河源头。他们是半游耕的刀耕火种农人，与艾卡纳人、卡诺埃人和图帕里人比邻而居，互通婚姻也时相攻伐；他们的夸扎语是与周边语言都没有亲属关系的孤立语言。

en: The Kwerba are a Papuan people of the interior behind Sarmi on the northern coast of Indonesian New Guinea, around the western slopes of the Foja Range, where they occupy villages including Aurime, Munukania and Wamariri. Their language is the namesake of the Kwerbic, or Greater Kwerba, family, whose closest linguistic relatives include the neighbouring Isirawa language.
zh: 奎尔巴人是印度尼西亚新几内亚岛北部海岸萨米后方内陆、福贾山脉西坡一带的巴布亚族群，村落包括奥里梅、穆努卡尼亚和瓦马里里等。他们的语言是奎尔比克语系，又称大奎尔巴语系，的命名语言，邻近的伊西拉瓦语是其亲缘最近的语言之一。

en: The Kwesten are a Papuan people of the Tor River coastal plain in Sarmi Regency on the northern shore of Indonesian New Guinea, living in the villages of Arare, Holmhaven, Mafenter and Omte. Their language belongs to the Orya–Tor family, a small Papuan family named after the Tor River and confined to this coast.
zh: 奎斯滕人是印度尼西亚新几内亚岛北岸萨米县托尔河沿海平原的巴布亚族群，聚居在阿拉雷、霍尔姆黑文、马芬特尔和奥姆特等村落。他们的语言属奥里亚—托尔语系，这是以托尔河命名、仅分布于这段海岸的小型巴布亚语系。

en: The Kwini, also spelt Gwini and often grouped with the neighbouring Yiiji under the name Yeidji, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the far north Kimberley in Western Australia, also known by the collective name Balanggarra. Norman Tindale understood Gwini as a directional word meaning ‘easterners’, used by inland peoples for the coastal groups around the Forrest River; together with the Miwa they are often called the Forrest River people. Their country ran from the shores of Cambridge Gulf up the Forrest River to the Milligan ranges, covering roughly 2,600 square kilometres. From the eighteenth century onwards they dealt with Makassan traders sailing to the Kimberley coast, whose landfalls began sometime between 1669 and 1763, and Kwini canoemen travelled out to islands such as Sir Graham Moore Island to gather and cure sea cucumber.
zh: 奎尼人（又作格维尼）常与相邻的伊吉人一起被称作耶吉人，是西澳大利亚州极北金伯利的澳大利亚原住民，也以巴兰加拉这一集体名称为人所知。诺曼·廷代尔认为，格维尼是内陆居民对沿海群体使用的方位词，意为‘东方人’，指福里斯特河一带的人；他们与米瓦人常被合称为福里斯特河人。其领地从剑桥湾沿岸沿福里斯特河延伸到米利根山脉，面积约2600平方公里。从18世纪起，他们与驶往金伯利海岸的望加锡客商往来——望加锡人在1669至1763年间开始到来——奎尼人的独木舟手还远航到格雷厄姆·穆尔爵士岛等岛屿采集、加工海参。

en: The Kwomtari are a Papuan people of the Senu River watershed in the Sepik border country of north-western Papua New Guinea. Their language gives its name to the small Kwomtari, or Senu River, language family, whose closest relative is the neighbouring Nai language; Kwomtari marks both subject and object on the verb and inflects verbs for mood rather than tense.
zh: 科姆塔里人是巴布亚新几内亚西北部塞皮克边境地带塞努河流域的巴布亚族群。他们的语言是小型的科姆塔里语系（又称塞努河语系）的命名语言，与邻近的奈语亲缘最近；科姆塔里语的动词同时标记主语和宾语，并按语气而非时态屈折。

en: The Kyrgyz are a Turkic, Kipchak-speaking people of the Tian Shan and Zhetysu, the grasslands around the Chu and Ili rivers, whose name is traditionally explained as the forty tribes that the epic hero Manas united against the Khitans. Their earliest known ancestors, the Yenisei Kyrgyz, appear in Chinese annals of the second and first centuries BC as the Gekun and Jiankun of the Yenisey valley. In 840 they overthrew the Uyghur Khaganate, and the center of their power shifted south to Jeti-su, the Seven Rivers, carrying them into the Tian Shan and Xinjiang, where they dominated for roughly two centuries before shrinking under Khitan and then Mongol pressure. In 1207 Jochi, eldest son of Genghis Khan, received their submission without a battle, and they remained Mongol vassals until the later fourteenth century; the History of Yuan, compiled in 1370, already recorded their founding myth of forty steppe mothers. A Kyrgyz khanate took shape in the fifteenth century, but from 1685 the Dzungar Oirats ruled them until the Qing defeat of the Dzungars in 1757, after which the returning tribes were enrolled under Qing titles, their chiefs known in Qing documents as the Bulute. Long fire-venerators who burned their dead, as the tenth-century Hudud al-'Alam observed, the Kyrgyz turned to Sunni Islam only from the mid-seventeenth century through Sufi missionaries, while keeping shamanic customs alive.
zh: 吉尔吉斯人是天山和七河地区（楚河、伊犁河一带草原）的突厥语民族，操钦察语支语言；其族名通常解释为四十个部落，史诗《玛纳斯》讲述的正是四十部团结抗击契丹的故事。可考的先祖叶尼塞吉尔吉斯人在公元前2至前1世纪的中国史籍中称鬲昆、坚昆，居于叶尼塞河流域。840年，他们攻灭回鹘汗国，统治中心南移七河，势力进入天山和新疆，称雄约两百年，随后在契丹和蒙古的挤压下收缩。1207年，成吉思汗长子术赤兵不血刃地接受其归附，吉尔吉斯作为蒙古属部一直延续到14世纪后期；1370年成书的《元史》已记载其四十位草原母亲的起源神话。15世纪，吉尔吉斯汗国成形，但1685年起被准噶尔卫拉特人统治，直到1757年清朝平定准噶尔；此后返回故地的部落受清朝封授，清文书称其为布鲁特。10世纪的《世界境域志》还记载他们敬火、火葬死者；直到17世纪中叶，经苏菲派传教士努力，吉尔吉斯人才改宗逊尼派伊斯兰教，同时保留了若干萨满旧俗。

en: Kyūshū is the southernmost of Japan's main islands and the one nearest the Asian continent, which made it the historic gateway for continental ideas and foreign trade. Under the eighth-century Taihō Code it was organized as the Saikaidō, its nine provinces including Chikuzen, Chikugo, Hizen and Buzen, and administered from Dazaifu. In 1274 and again in 1281 the island bore the brunt of Kublai Khan's Mongol invasion fleets; the Kamakura shogunate's vassals fought the landings off, and typhoons scattered the enemy ships in storms remembered as the kamikaze, or divine wind. The first Portuguese navigators reached Tanegashima in 1543, introducing firearms, and the Jesuit Francis Xavier landed at Kagoshima in 1549; the Christian daimyō Ōmura Sumitada opened Nagasaki to Portuguese ships in 1571. After Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyūshū campaign of 1587 the rulers turned against the new faith, and the Shimabara Rebellion of 1637–1638 ended in massacre and brought on the seclusion policy. The Portuguese were expelled and the Dutch confined to Dejima, leaving Nagasaki as Japan's only official window abroad, and after the ban on Dutch books was lifted in 1720 it became the sole channel for the European learning called rangaku.
zh: 九州是日本主要岛屿中位置最南、离亚洲大陆最近的一个，自古以来就是大陆文化和对外贸易传入日本的门户。8世纪《大宝律令》将其划为西海道，下辖筑前、筑后、肥前、丰前等九国，以大宰府为统治中心。1274年和1281年，九州两度承受忽必烈的蒙古舰队来袭；镰仓幕府的武士击退登陆敌军，入侵船队又被台风摧毁，时人称之为神风。1543年，首批葡萄牙人漂流到种子岛，带来了火枪；1549年耶稣会士沙勿略在鹿儿岛登陆，基督教随之传入。1571年，信奉基督教的大名大村纯忠开放长崎港，供葡萄牙船只停泊。1587年丰臣秀吉平定九州后，统治者转而压制新教；1637—1638年的岛原之乱以血腥镇压告终，锁国政策由此确立。葡萄牙人被逐，荷兰人被限制在出岛上，长崎成为日本唯一的对外窗口；1720年荷兰书籍禁令解除后，这里又是兰学传入的唯一渠道。

en: The Ladakhi are a Tibetan-speaking people of the high Indus valley in the western Himalaya, centred on the towns of Leh, Shey and Basgo, with the Zanskar gorge and the pastoral Changtang on their margins. Around 900 Kyide Nyimagon, a prince of the shattered Tibetan royal line, founded a kingdom in western Tibet, and his son Lhachen Palgyigon received Ladakh, then called Maryul; this first West Tibetan dynasty ruled for five centuries and carried the second diffusion of Buddhism into the region. In 1460 King Bhagan overthrew the king of Leh and founded the Namgyal dynasty, which repelled Central Asian raiders and briefly pushed its borders toward Nepal. Sengge Namgyal in the early seventeenth century restored the monasteries and built Leh Palace and Hemis. The Tibet–Ladakh–Mughal war of 1679 to 1684 ended with the Treaty of Tingmosgang, fixing the kingdom's borders and obliging it to pay tribute to the Mughals. In 1834 the Dogra general Zorawar Singh invaded and annexed Ladakh to Jammu, ending Namgyal rule, while the dispossessed kings kept the estate of Stok. Ladakhi life rested on barley farming, trans-Himalayan trade and Buddhist monasticism, and a Shia Muslim community grew around Leh and Kargil from the seventeenth century.
zh: 拉达克人是喜马拉雅西部印度河上游河谷的藏语族群，以列城、谢伊和巴斯戈等城镇为中心，边缘是赞斯卡尔峡谷和游牧的羌塘。约900年，吐蕃王室后裔吉德·尼玛衮在西藏西部建立王国，其子拉钦·白吉贡分得古称“玛域”的拉达克；这个西吐蕃首个王朝统治了五百年，并把佛教后弘期的传播带入当地。1460年，国王巴甘推翻列城之王，建立南嘉王朝，击退中亚袭扰者，一度把边界推进到尼泊尔附近。17世纪初，僧格·南嘉修复寺院，修建了列城王宫和黑密寺。1679—1684年的西藏—拉达克—莫卧儿战争以《廷莫斯冈条约》收场，划定了王国边界，拉达克并须向莫卧儿人纳贡。1834年，多格拉将领佐拉瓦尔·辛格入侵，把拉达克并入查谟，南嘉王朝告终，被废的王室保留了斯托克庄园。拉达克人的生活依托青稞农耕、跨喜马拉雅贸易和佛教寺院制度，17世纪起列城和卡吉尔一带还形成了什叶派穆斯林社群。

en: The Ladins are a Romance mountain people of the Dolomites, holding the high valleys of Badia and Gherdëina in South Tyrol, Fassa in Trentino and Ampezzo and Livinallongo near Belluno. They descend from the Rhaetian population of the Alps, whose Vulgar Latin speech once formed, around the year 1000, an unbroken Rhaeto-Romance belt from the Swiss Alps to the Julian Alps; from the sixth century Bavarii pressing in from the north and Gallo-Italic speakers from the south split the belt and left the Ladins isolated in remote valleys, separated from the Romansh speakers of Switzerland and the Friulans. In 1337 their lands were divided among the County of Tyrol and the prince-bishoprics of Brixen and Trent, while Cadore to the south belonged to Venice, and Habsburg rule brought steady Germanization. Ladin survived as a chain of valley dialects with no written standard until the early nineteenth century, when the priest Micurà de Rü made the first attempt to fix it in writing.
zh: 拉定人是多洛米蒂山区的罗曼语山民，散居在南蒂罗尔的巴迪亚和加尔德纳山谷、特伦蒂诺的法萨山谷，以及贝卢诺附近的安佩佐和利维纳隆戈。他们是阿尔卑斯雷蒂安人的后裔：约1000年时，其通俗拉丁语方言曾构成一条从瑞士阿尔卑斯山延伸到尤利安山的完整雷托-罗曼语带；6世纪起，巴伐利亚人自北方、高卢-意大利语人群自南方不断渗入，将这条语言带冲散，使拉定人隔绝在偏远山谷中，与瑞士的罗曼什人和意大利东北的弗留利人分隔开来。1337年，他们的土地分属蒂罗尔伯国以及布里克森、特伦托两个亲王主教区，南方的卡多雷则归属威尼斯；哈布斯堡的统治带来了持续的德意志化。拉定语长期只是一串没有书面规范的山谷方言，直到19世纪初，神父米库拉·德·吕才首次尝试将它写成文字。

en: The Lahkota, better known as the Lakota or Teton Sioux, were the westernmost of the three great divisions of the Sioux nation, the Očhéthi Šakówiŋ or Seven Council Fires. Before the 1650s they lived east of the Red River on the woodland-prairie edge of southern Minnesota, hunting and gathering like their Dakota kin. Their winter counts recall horses among them by 1700, and as mounted bison hunters they began to dominate the prairies east of the Missouri by the 1720s. The tribe split into the Saône, who settled around Lake Traverse, and the Oglála-Brulé group of the James River valley; both had crossed the Missouri by about 1760. In 1776 they defeated the Cheyenne and made the Black Hills their home and spiritual center, and in 1804 their bands faced down the Lewis and Clark expedition on the river. By the 1820s they had allied with the Northern Cheyenne and Arapaho and were fighting the Mandan, Hidatsa and Arikara for control of the Upper Missouri. The Lakota comprised seven bands, the Brulé, Oglala, Sans Arc, Hunkpapa, Miniconjou, Sihasapa and Two Kettles.
zh: 拉科塔人又称蒂顿苏人，是苏族七议会之火（奥切蒂·沙科温）三大支系中最靠西的一支。17世纪50年代以前，他们住在雷德河以东、明尼苏达南部的林原交界地带，和达科他亲族一样以狩猎采集为生。他们的冬季计数记载，1700年前后马匹已传入；成为骑马猎牛者后，到18世纪20年代他们已称雄密苏里河以东的草原。拉科塔随后分为两支：索昂人定居特拉弗斯湖一带，奥格拉拉—布鲁莱人占据詹姆斯河谷，两路人马约在1760年前都渡过了密苏里河。1776年他们击败夏延人，把黑山变成自己的家园和信仰中心；1804年，拉科塔诸部在河上与刘易斯—克拉克探险队对峙。到19世纪20年代，他们已与北夏延人、北阿拉帕霍人结盟，为争夺密苏里河上游而与曼丹人、希达察人和阿里卡拉人交战。拉科塔共分七团：布鲁莱、奥格拉拉、桑斯阿克、亨克帕帕、米尼孔朱、西哈萨帕和双壶。

en: The Lahu are a Lolo-speaking Tibeto-Burman people of the steep mountains of southern Yunnan, centred on Lancang, Menglian and Shuangjiang along the Mekong, with related villages spreading into the Shan hills of Burma and the highlands of Laos, Vietnam and Thailand. They divide into branches named from the traditional colour of their dress, the Black Lahu or Lahu Na being the largest, followed by the Red, White and Yellow Lahu; descent is counted on both sides and married couples often live with the wife's family. Their tonal Loloish language served as a lingua franca between neighbouring hill peoples, and their oral lore centres on the long creation epic of Mupa Mipa. Traditionally polytheist, the Lahu adopted Buddhism from neighbouring Tai communities in the late 1600s, and the faith spread widely through their villages in the following century.
zh: 拉祜是说彝语支语言的藏缅语族民族，世居云南南部崇山峻岭，核心在澜沧江流域的澜沧、孟连、双江一带，同源村寨还延伸到缅甸掸邦高原以及老挝、越南、泰国的山地。他们按传统服色分为各支，人数最多的是称“拉祜纳”的黑拉祜，另有红拉祜、白拉祜和黄拉祜；世系按父母双系计算，婚后常从妻居。他们的语言声调丰富，曾是邻近山地民族之间的通用语，口头传统则以长篇创世史诗《牡帕密帕》为核心。拉祜本信多神，17世纪末从邻近的傣族社区接受佛教，此后一百年间佛教在各村寨广泛传播。

en: The Laks, who call themselves Lakru, are a Northeast Caucasian people of the arid interior of Dagestan, grouped around their ancient fortress capital Kumukh, high in the basin between the Avar and Dargin lands. Kumukh was already a highland political center in the sixth century, and from the eighth century its rulers bore the title of shamkhal; Arab armies built a mosque there in 777, though Christian communities are still reported in the eighth century. The shamkhals accepted Islam at the end of the thirteenth century, and in the fourteenth century Kumukh became the gazi-center of Gazi-Kumukh, the principal base from which Islam was carried across Dagestan in the following century, when the shamkhalate overshadowed its neighbors and absorbed the Avar Khanate. The Laks were the first Dagestani people to organize a full feudal order, of khans, noble beks, free uzden peasants and serfs, which coexisted with self-governing tukhum clan villages living by customary adat law. When the shamkhalate broke up in 1642 there emerged the Gazikumukh Khanate, whose rulers balanced between Safavid Persia, Ottoman Turkey and the advancing Russian Empire. With thin soil and no forests, the Laks lived mainly by transhumant sheep herding and specialized crafts: Kumukh was famed for jewelers and coppersmiths, while other villages produced saddlers, masons and even travelling acrobats.
zh: 拉克人自称拉克鲁，是达吉斯坦干旱内陆的东北高加索语族群，环居在古老的堡垒都城库穆赫周围，地处阿瓦尔人与达尔金人土地之间的高地盆地。库穆赫在6世纪已是高地政治中心，8世纪起其统治者拥有沙姆哈尔头衔；阿拉伯军队于777年在那里建起清真寺，但直到8世纪仍有基督教社群的记载。13世纪末沙姆哈尔们皈依伊斯兰教，14世纪库穆赫成为加济（圣战）中心加济库穆赫，是下一世纪向整个达吉斯坦传播伊斯兰教的主要据点，当时沙姆哈拉特势力凌驾邻邦之上，还吞并了阿瓦尔汗国。拉克人是达吉斯坦最早建立完整封建秩序的族群，社会分为汗、贵族贝克、自由农民乌兹坚和农奴，同时并存着依据阿达特习惯法自治的图胡姆氏族村。1642年沙姆哈拉特瓦解，加济库穆赫汗国代之而兴，其统治者在萨法维波斯、奥斯曼土耳其和步步进逼的俄罗斯帝国之间周旋。由于土地贫瘠、不生森林，拉克人主要靠转场牧羊和专门手艺为生：库穆赫以珠宝匠和铜匠闻名，其他村庄则出产鞍匠、石匠，甚至周游各地的杂技艺人。

en: The Xokleng, who call themselves Laklãnõ, are a Southern Jê people of southern Brazil, closely related to the Kaingang; archaeology suggests both peoples occupied the land that became Santa Catarina before the Guarani. Their territory ran from the Paraná plateau to the Atlantic coast and south to the Rio Grande do Sul, and also reached into Misiones in present-day Argentina. They lived in mobile bands of fifty to three hundred people, hunting and fishing and gathering the pine nuts of the araucaria: winters were spent on the plateau on stored nuts, and summers in the valleys, where huts stood in a semicircle around a plaza used for initiation and marriage rites. The people split into three segments, the Angying, the Ngrokòthi and the Laklanõ of the Itajaí valley. In the 1800s European colonization of the Itajaí valley swallowed their hunting grounds, and armed frontier raiders exterminated several subgroups, while the Laklanõ held out longest in the valley forests.
zh: 肖克伦人自称拉克拉诺，是巴西南部的南热语族群，与卡因冈人关系密切；考古证据显示，在瓜拉尼人到来之前，他们和卡因冈人就已居住在后来的圣卡塔琳娜州一带。其领地从巴拉那高原延伸到大西洋沿岸，南抵南里奥格兰德州，还包括今阿根廷米西奥内斯的部分地区。他们以五十至三百人的游动群体为生，狩猎、捕鱼、采集南洋松子：冬天在高原上靠储藏的松子过冬，夏天迁入谷地，茅屋围成半圆，中央是举行成年礼和婚礼的广场。全族分为三支：安吉英支、恩格罗科提支和据守伊塔雅伊河谷的拉克拉诺支。19世纪，欧洲殖民者开垦伊塔雅伊河谷，吞没了他们的猎场，边疆武装猎手剿灭了多个支系，拉克拉诺人则在河谷丛林中抵抗得最久。

en: The Lalagir were an Evenki, or Tungus, rod of the Olyokma and Nyukzha taiga south-west of Yakutsk, named in Russian surveys of the Evenki rods of the Olyokma basin. Like the rods of the neighbouring Amga country, they were nomadic elk hunters and reindeer herders brought under the fur tribute, or yasak, in the 1600s.
zh: 拉拉吉尔人（俄文调查中作拉雷加尔氏族）是雅库茨克西南奥廖克马河与纽克扎河泰加林的鄂温克（通古斯）氏族，族名保存在奥廖克马河流域的鄂温克氏族调查中。与邻近阿姆加河一带的同类氏族一样，他们是游猎的猎驼鹿人和驯鹿牧民，在17世纪哥萨克东进时被纳入毛皮贡赋牙萨克体系。

en: The Lamaholot, also called the Solorese, are an Austronesian people of eastern Flores and the neighbouring islands of Solor, Adonara and Lomblen, where they speak a cluster of Lamaholot dialects and trace descent through patrilineal origin groups. Coastal villages such as Lamakera and Lamalera built their livelihood on whale hunting, while others ran an intermediary trade in textiles across the Larantuka and Solor seas. From the 1500s their shores were contested by the Makassar Sultanate, Portugal and the Netherlands. Shortly before 1600 Portuguese traders settled at Larantuka, and after the Dutch took Solor in 1613 it became the Portuguese commercial centre of eastern Indonesia, fed by the sandalwood trade of Timor. Refugees from Portuguese Malacca in 1641 and Makassar in 1660 swelled the town and gave rise to the mixed Catholic Larantuqueiros, or Topasses, whose da Costa and de Hornay families long dominated the rajas of Larantuka and Adonara. Inland Lamaholot kept the older cult of Lera Wulan Tanah Ekan, the combined power of sun, moon and earth, alongside Catholicism and Islam.
zh: 拉马霍洛特人又称索洛人，是弗洛勒斯岛东部及邻近索洛岛、阿多纳拉岛和龙布伦岛上的南岛语族群，操多种拉马霍洛特方言，按父系氏族追溯血统。拉马克拉、拉马莱拉等沿海村落以捕鲸为生，另一些村落则在拉兰图卡与索洛一带的海域从事纺织品中转贸易。16世纪起，望加锡苏丹国、葡萄牙和荷兰相继争夺这片海岸。1600年前不久，葡萄牙商人定居拉兰图卡；1613年荷兰夺取索洛后，这里成为葡萄牙在印尼东部的商业中心，承接来自帝汶的檀香木贸易。1641年马六甲和1660年望加锡相继陷落后的难民涌入该城，促成了混血天主教徒拉兰图凯罗人，即托帕塞人的形成，其达科斯塔与德奥尔奈两大家族长期把持拉兰图卡和阿多纳拉的拉贾之位。内陆的拉马霍洛特人则在天主教和伊斯兰教之外，保留着对日月地合体之力莱拉·乌兰·塔纳·埃坎的古老信仰。

en: The Lamalama, then more often called the Bakanambia or Wanbara, are an Aboriginal people of the eastern base of the Cape York Peninsula in Queensland, whose country centred on the mangrove flats and river mouths of Princess Charlotte Bay, rich in dugong, barramundi and waterbirds. Their speech belonged to the Lamalamic group of Paman languages within the Pama-Nyungan family, together with the closely related tongues of neighbouring peoples such as the Umpithamu, recorded in older sources as Umbindhamu. The coast was little known to Europeans until a British naval survey under Lieutenant Charles Jeffreys named Princess Charlotte Bay in 1815; the upheavals that later fused the Lamalama with their neighbours into a single community came only after the period.
zh: 拉马拉曼人当时更多被称为巴卡南比亚人或万巴拉人，是昆士兰约克角半岛东麓的原住民，家园以夏洛特公主湾的红树林滩涂与河口为中心，那里盛产儒艮、尖吻鲈和水鸟。他们的语言属帕马-牛雅语系帕马语组下的拉马拉曼语支，与乌姆皮塔穆人等邻族的语言关系密切；乌姆皮塔穆在较早的文献里也拼作乌宾达穆。1815年，英国海军军官查尔斯·杰弗里斯测绘海岸时将这片海湾命名为夏洛特公主湾，在此之前欧洲人对这一带所知甚少；而拉马拉曼人与邻族在动荡中融合为一个共同体，则是本时期结束以后的事。

en: The Lamogai are an Austronesian-speaking people of West New Britain Province on the island of New Britain in the Bismarck Archipelago.
zh: 拉莫盖人是俾斯麦群岛新不列颠岛西新不列颠省的南岛语族群。

en: The Lampung are the indigenous Austronesian people of the southern tip of Sumatra, around Tulang Bawang River and the bay that now bears their name, with related communities also settled across the Sunda Strait on the Banten coast. Chinese annals record their country of Po-huang sending embassies as early as the fifth century, and from the late seventh century the coast came under the Buddhist Srivijaya empire, whose inscriptions of around 680 mark the southernmost limit of its power; Javanese Majapahit influence followed in later centuries. In 1337 the highlanders and river villagers were not politically unified but lived under small chiefdoms tracing descent from the legendary Sekala Brak kingdom, dividing in time into the aristocratic coastal Saibatin and the more egalitarian interior Pepadun custom groups. They spoke Lampung, a language of its own Lampungic branch with Api and Nyo dialects, and wove the famed ship-cloth textiles and tapis skirts. The pepper of their country then drew outside conquest: from the mid-sixteenth century the Banten Sultanate under Maulana Hasanuddin brought the southern and eastern coasts under its rule and monopolized the pepper trade by the seventeenth century, until the Dutch annexed the Lampung districts in 1752.
zh: 楠榜人是苏门答腊岛最南端的本土南岛语系民族，聚居于图朗巴旺河与今楠榜湾一带，另有亲缘社群越过巽他海峡定居在万丹沿海。中国史籍记载，早在5世纪，当地的婆皇国就曾多次遣使朝贡；7世纪末起，沿海被佛教帝国室利佛逝纳入版图，约680年的铭文标志着其势力所及的最南端，此后数个世纪又受到爪哇满者伯夷的影响。1337年时，高地与河谷居民并未形成统一政权，而是生活在众多小酋长邦之下，谱系均可追溯到传说中的塞卡拉布拉克王国，并逐渐分化为沿海贵族制的赛巴廷和内陆较平等的佩帕敦两大习俗群。他们使用独立的楠榜语支语言，分阿皮和纽两种方言，并织就著名的“船布”织物与塔皮斯裙。当地出产的胡椒后来招致外来征服：16世纪中期起，万丹苏丹国在毛拉纳·哈萨努丁治下征服南部和东部沿海，到17世纪完全垄断胡椒贸易，最终荷兰人于1752年吞并楠榜诸地区。

en: The Lamtuna are a nomadic Sanhaja Berber tribe of the western Sahara, whose pastures once ran from the Sous valley in southern Morocco to the Adrar and Tagant plateaus in what is now Mauritania. They founded the caravan city of Aoudaghost in the seventh century, and by the ninth century they dominated the Adrar and Hodh and led the loose Sanhaja confederation that controlled the western trans-Saharan trade between Sijilmasa and the Ghana Empire. When the confederation dissolved and Aoudaghost passed to Ghana, a Lamtuna chief tried to reunite the desert tribes about 1035, and in the 1050s the Lamtuna became the backbone of the Almoravid movement under Abdallah ibn Yasin: they took Sijilmasa in 1054 and Aoudaghost in 1055, while their chiefs Abu Bakr ibn Umar and Yusuf ibn Tashfin founded Marrakesh about 1070 and carried the empire into al-Andalus, winning the Battle of Sagrajas in 1086. The Lamtuna supplied the Almoravid ruling class and its provincial governors; the Banu Ghaniya, who held the Balearic Islands and Tripoli into the thirteenth century, were their kinsmen, and the Sahrawi Tajakant tribe also traces its descent from them.
zh: 兰图纳人是西撒哈拉的游牧桑哈贾柏柏尔部落，牧场一度从摩洛哥南部的苏斯河谷延伸到今毛里塔尼亚境内的阿德拉尔和塔甘特高原。他们在7世纪建立商队城市奥达戈斯特，到9世纪已控制阿德拉尔与霍德，领导松散的桑哈贾联盟，掌控西吉尔马萨与加纳帝国之间的西部跨撒哈拉贸易。联盟解体、奥达戈斯特落入加纳之手后，一位兰图纳酋长约在1035年试图重新统一沙漠诸部；11世纪50年代，兰图纳人成为阿卜杜拉·本·亚辛麾下穆拉比特运动的骨干：1054年攻取西吉尔马萨，1055年攻取奥达戈斯特，其酋长阿布-贝克尔·本·奥马尔和优素福·本·塔什芬约在1070年兴建马拉喀什，并把帝国带入安达卢斯，于1086年赢得萨拉卡战役。穆拉比特的统治阶层和各地总督多出自兰图纳；统治巴利阿里群岛和的黎波里至13世纪的巴努·加尼亚家族是他们的亲族，撒哈拉威人中的塔贾坎特部落也自称源出该部。

en: The Lamutk take their name from the Lamuts, the old Russian and Yakut name for the Even people: lamu meant the Okhotsk Sea in the Tungusic languages, so the Lamuts were the people of the seaboard. Closely related to the Evenki and speaking the Even language of the Tungusic family, they roamed east of the Lena from the Yana and Indigirka basins to the Okhotsk coast, having spread from the Baikal region in the first millennium and absorbed Yukaghir groups along the way. In the seventeenth century Russian records divide them into the Okhotsk reindeer Tungus, or Lamut proper, and the Tiugesir, Memel and Buiaksir clans, alongside sedentary fishing groups. Nomadic reindeer herders who used their animals mainly for transport, they also hunted, trapped and fished from conical skin tents. Cossack fur-tribute collection drew them into the Russian orbit from the 1600s, and by the nineteenth century most Lamuts were formally Orthodox Christians while retaining shamanic practices.
zh: 拉穆特克人的名字来自拉穆特人——这是俄罗斯人和雅库特人对鄂温人的旧称：在通古斯语里拉穆意为鄂霍次克海，拉穆特即海边之人。他们与鄂温克人同源，说通古斯语族的鄂温语，在勒拿河以东的亚纳河、因迪吉尔卡河流域直到鄂霍次克海岸游猎；其先民在公元第一个千年从贝加尔湖一带东迁，途中融合了部分尤卡吉尔人。17世纪的俄方记录把他们分为鄂霍次克驯鹿通古斯（即狭义的拉穆特）以及秋格西尔、梅梅尔、布亚克西尔等氏族，另有定居的捕鱼群体。他们是游牧的驯鹿牧民，驯鹿主要用作坐骑和驮运，同时在兽皮圆锥帐篷里从事狩猎、设陷阱和捕鱼。17世纪起，哥萨克征收毛皮贡赋使他们并入俄国势力范围；到19世纪，多数拉穆特人在名义上皈依东正教，却仍保留萨满教习俗。

en: Languedocien is the central dialect of Occitan, spoken across the broad southern sweep from the Mediterranean coast around Narbonne and Montpellier through the inland plateaus of Quercy and Rouergue to the country of Albi and Cahors. Because it stands midway between the other Occitan dialects it is often taken as the basis of a standard written Occitan, and the whole region owes its name to this speech, the langue d'oc. Its country was the Roman province of Gallia Narbonensis, later held by the Visigoths and briefly by the Emirate of Córdoba before Pepin the Short took Narbonne in 759 and tied the south to the Frankish kingdom. After the Carolingian collapse the land fragmented among the counts of Toulouse and the Trencavel viscounts, whose wealthy towns sheltered the Cathar believers; the Albigensian Crusade of 1208 to 1229 crushed Catharism and opened the Midi to the Capetian crown, which absorbed the Trencavel lands in 1224 and Toulouse itself in 1271, with Montpellier following in 1349. The Estates of Languedoc first met in 1346, and from 1542 the province was administered through the two generalities of Toulouse and Montpellier. In these same centuries French was steadily displacing Occitan as the language of administration and letters, a process completed in the villages only long after the Revolution, when in 1790 the province was partitioned into a ring of new departments.
zh: 朗格多克方言是奥克语的核心方言，分布范围广阔：从纳博讷和蒙彼利埃一带的地中海沿岸，经凯尔西和鲁埃格的内陆高原，一直到阿尔比和卡奥尔地区。由于它在各奥克语方言中处于居中位置，常被用作标准书面奥克语的基础，而整个地区也因这种语言——奥克语（langue d'oc）——而得名。这片土地曾是罗马的纳博讷高卢行省，先后由西哥特人和科尔多瓦埃米尔国短暂统治，759年矮子丕平攻占纳博讷，把南方并入法兰克王国。加洛林王朝瓦解后，土地分裂为图卢兹伯爵和特伦卡维尔子爵们的领地，他们富庶的城镇庇护了清洁派信徒；1208至1229年的阿尔比十字军镇压了清洁派，也为卡佩王室打开了南方的大门，王室于1224年吞并特伦卡维尔领地，1271年取得图卢兹，1349年又获得蒙彼利埃。朗格多克三级会议于1346年首次召开，1542年起该行省由图卢兹和蒙彼利埃两个财政区管辖。也就在这几个世纪里，法语不断取代奥克语成为行政和书面语言，这一过程直到大革命之后才在乡间完成；1790年，该行省被分割为一圈新设的省。

en: The Lao are a Tai people of the Kra-Dai family who speak Lao and follow Theravada Buddhism, kin to the Thai and to the Isan across the Mekong. Chinese Han-dynasty chronicles already mention their forebears as the Ai Lao, and Tai tribes drifted southwest from Yunnan and Guangxi between the seventh and thirteenth centuries, the flow quickening after the Mongol conquest of Yunnan of 1253 to 1256; they absorbed or displaced the indigenous Mon-Khmer villagers of the middle Mekong and settled around old chiefships such as Muang Sua, later Luang Prabang. In 1353 Fa Ngum united these mueang into the kingdom of Lan Xang, whose capital moved from Luang Prabang to Vientiane in 1560 and whose palladium was the Phra Bang Buddha. Burmese invasions weakened the crown, and in 1707 Lan Xang broke into the kingdoms of Luang Prabang, Vientiane and Champasak, with Muang Phuan also going its own way. Vientiane was a Burmese vassal from 1765 to 1779, when Siamese armies sacked it and carried off the Emerald Buddha, making it a Siamese vassal; the last Lao bid for power, Anouvong's rebellion of 1826 to 1827, ended with Vientiane burned and its people deported to the Khorat plateau, planting the Lao-speaking majority of what became Isan.
zh: 佬人属壮侗语系的泰语民族，操老挝语，信奉上座部佛教，与泰人和湄公河对岸的依善人同源。中国汉代史籍已把其先民称作哀牢；7至13世纪间，泰语部落从云南、广西陆续西南迁，1253—1256年蒙古征服云南后迁徙加速。他们融合或排挤了湄公河中游原有的孟-高棉村民，在孟苏瓦（后来的琅勃拉邦）等古老酋邦周围定居。1353年，法昂把这些勐统一为澜沧王国，1560年首都由琅勃拉邦迁往万象，护国佛为柏邦佛。缅甸的入侵削弱了王权，1707年澜沧分裂为琅勃拉邦、万象和占巴塞三个王国，孟潘也自立。万象在1765—1779年间为缅甸藩属，1779年暹罗军队破城，掳走玉佛，万象转为暹罗藩属。佬人最后一次争雄是1826—1827年的昭阿努之乱，结果万象被焚、人口被迁往柯叻高原，形成了后来依善地区以佬语人口为主的格局。

en: Old Xiang, or Lou-Shao, is the inland branch of the Xiang languages, spoken in the hills of central Hunan around Loudi, Xiangxiang and Shuangfeng, with Shaoyang, then known as Baoqing, on its western edge; the Shuangfeng dialect is taken as its representative. Like New Xiang it descends from the Southern Chu speech recorded by the Han lexicographer Yang Xiong, born of the fusion of Chu migrants with the native Ba, Nanman and Baiyue peoples. Sheltered by the mountains, these districts kept the voiced stops, fricatives and affricates of Middle Chinese, the three-way contrast that the flatter lowlands lost under the flood of Jiangxi settlers after the Ming founding in 1368. Most Lou-Shao dialects have also shed the entering tone. Through the Ming and Qing they remained the speech of Hunan's farming heartland, bordered by Southwestern Mandarin to the west and by the Miao and Tujia languages beyond the Yuan River.
zh: 老湘又称娄邵片，是湘语的内陆支系，通行于湖南中部娄底、湘乡、双峰一带的丘陵，西缘抵达当时称宝庆的邵阳，双峰话是其代表方言。与新湘一样，它源自汉代扬雄《方言》所记的南楚话，由楚地移民与土著巴人、南蛮、百越融合而成。由于群山阻隔，这一带保留了中古汉语浊塞音、浊擦音和浊塞擦音的三分格局，而东部低地在1368年明朝建立后的江西移民潮中失去了浊音；娄邵片多数方言的入声也已消失。明清两代，老湘始终是湖南农耕腹地的语言，西面与西南官话相邻，沅水之外还与苗语、土家语相接。
