en: The Larrakia, who originally called themselves the Gulumirrgin, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Northern Territory whose traditional lands of about 3,900 square kilometres centred on the harbour where Darwin now stands, taking in Southport, Bynoe Harbour and the Howard River, from the Finniss River and Fog Bay to Gunn Point near the Adelaide River mouth. Calling themselves the Saltwater People, they built their society around the sea and traded with the Tiwi, Wadjiginy and Djerimanga, sharing ceremonies and songlines and intermarrying with them. Their language belonged to the Darwin Region group. In their cosmology the sky being Mangarrara made all earthly things, while Nanganburra, who dwelt underground, fashioned the first man, Dowed, and judged the dead, sending the worthy to dwell among the stars.
zh: 拉拉基亚人原称古卢米尔金人，是澳大利亚北领地的原住民，传统领地约3900平方公里，以今达尔文所在的港湾为中心，包括绍斯波特、拜诺港和霍华德河，从芬尼斯河与福格湾一直到阿德莱德河口附近的冈角。他们自称“海水人”，社会围绕海洋而建，与蒂维人、瓦吉吉尼人和杰里芒加人贸易往来，共享仪式和歌路并互通婚姻。他们的语言属于达尔文地区语群。在其宇宙观中，天神曼加拉拉创造了地上万物，居于地下的南甘布拉则造出第一个人道德，并审判死者，使配得上的人升居群星之间。

en:
The Latje-Latje, or Latjilatji, are the river people of the Murray around Mildura in north-western Victoria, their name a reduplication of their word for no. Their language belongs to the Western Central Murray group within the Kulinic branch of the Pama-Nyungan family, closely related to Wadi Wadi and Madi Madi, and neighbouring tribes knew them by names such as Baluk-mernen, people of the sandhills, and Walkandwani. The Murray gave them a steady harvest of Murray cod, yabbies, shellfish, waterfowl and the eggs of turtles and birds, taken from bark canoes and weirs, while the river flats hosted gatherings of the wider Murray basin nations, who shared ceremony, trade and the kicking-and-catching ball game called marn grook.

As with the other riverine tribes, their first disaster arrived by water: the smallpox loosed by the British settlement at Port Jackson in 1788 spread down the Murray through the flood-season networks, and later epidemics left the old men pockmarked and whole camps depopulated before any settler appeared. In 1830 Charles Sturt rowed down the Murray on his voyage to the sea, passing the Latjilatji reaches and noting the dense weirs and smoke of camps along the banks, while the first stations were not taken up near Mildura until the middle of the nineteenth century, leaving the river people in control of their fishery through the rest of the period's early decades.
zh:
拉杰拉杰人又称拉吉拉吉人，是维多利亚州西北部米尔杜拉一带墨累河畔的河居民族，族名由他们语言中意为“不”的词重叠而成。他们的语言属帕马—牛雅语系库林语支的中西墨累语组，与瓦迪瓦迪语、马迪马迪语关系密切；邻族或以“巴卢克—梅嫩”（沙丘之人）、“瓦尔坎德瓦尼”等名字称呼他们。墨累河通过树皮独木舟和鱼梁，为他们稳定提供墨累鳕、淡水螯虾、贝类、水禽以及龟蛋和鸟蛋；河畔平地上还会聚起墨累盆地的众多部族，一起举行仪式、开展贸易，并玩一种又踢又接的球类游戏“马恩格鲁克”。

和其他河居部族一样，他们的第一场灾祸也是顺水而来：1788年英国在杰克逊港建立殖民地后放出的天花，借洪水季的交通网沿墨累河扩散，其后的几次疫病在移民到来之前就令长者满脸痘痕、整座营地人口凋零。1830年查尔斯·斯特特在出海航行中划舟顺墨累河而下，经过拉杰拉杰人的河段，记下了沿岸密布的鱼梁和营地炊烟；而米尔杜拉附近直到19世纪40年代中期才出现首批牧场，使河居民族在本时期最初的几十年里仍掌握着自己的渔场。

en: The Latvians are a Baltic people whose nation was forged from several pagan tribes: the Latgalians, the largest group with their principal seat at Jersika, the Selonians, the Semigallians and the Curonians, together with Finnic Livonians whose name the German conquerors gave to the whole country as Livland. The Livonian Crusade ended their independence: Bishop Albert founded Riga in 1201, the Brothers of the Sword subdued the Livonians by 1207 and the Latgalians by 1214, and after the Order's ruin at the Battle of Saule in 1236 it was reborn as the Livonian Order of the Teutonic state. The Curonians and Semigallians held out longest, the latter going down only in 1290, when many migrated to Lithuania. The land became Terra Mariana, the Livonian Confederation, whose Hanseatic city of Riga grew rich on the Daugava trade while a Baltic German nobility ruled over Latvian peasants. The Livonian War of 1558 to 1583 dissolved the Order's state: Courland became a duchy under Polish suzerainty, while Swedish Livonia emerged after 1629. The Great Northern War delivered Riga to Russia in 1710, confirmed by the Treaty of Nystad in 1721, and the partitions of Poland added Latgale and Courland by 1795. Lutheranism and the Herrnhut pietist movement fostered Latvian literary culture, and serfdom was abolished in Courland in 1819 and Livonia in 1820.
zh: 拉脱维亚人是波罗的民族，由数个异教部落融合而成：以叶尔西卡为主要中心、人数最多的拉特加尔人，以及塞洛尼亚人、塞米加利亚人、库罗尼亚人，还有芬兰语族的利夫人——德意志征服者正是用利夫之名称呼整片土地为立窝尼亚。立窝尼亚十字军终结了他们的独立：阿尔伯特主教于1201年建里加，佩剑兄弟会到1207年征服利夫人、1214年征服拉特加尔人；1236年该会在索莱战役惨败后，被条顿政权收编为立窝尼亚骑士团。库罗尼亚人和塞米加利亚人抵抗最久，后者直到1290年才被征服，许多人随即迁往立陶宛。这片土地成为“玛丽亚之地”立窝尼亚邦联，加入汉萨同盟的里加凭道加瓦河贸易致富，而波罗的德意志贵族统治着拉脱维亚农民。1558—1583年的立窝尼亚战争瓦解了骑士团国家：库尔兰成为波兰宗主权下的公国，1629年后又形成瑞典属立窝尼亚。大北方战争中，里加于1710年落入俄国之手，1721年《尼斯塔德条约》予以确认；瓜分波兰又在1795年前把拉特加尔和库尔兰并入俄国。路德宗与摩拉维亚虔敬派运动推动了拉脱维亚书面文化的发展，农奴制也先后于1819年在库尔兰、1820年在立窝尼亚被废除。

en: Lavongai is the native name of the people of New Hanover, a rugged volcanic island west of New Ireland in the Bismarck Archipelago of Papua New Guinea; they live by subsistence farming and fishing and speak Tungag, also called Lavongai, an Austronesian language whose dialects divide between the south coast and the northern and western villages.
zh: 拉翁盖人是新汉诺威岛本地居民的自称，该岛是巴布亚新几内亚俾斯麦群岛中新爱尔兰岛以西一座崎岖的火山岛；岛民以自给农业和渔业为生，操南岛语系的通加格语（又称拉翁盖语），方言大致分为南岸一支与北岸、西岸村落一支。

en: The Lawa are an Austroasiatic people of the Palaungic branch, whose language is close to the Wa and Blang, and they are regarded as the autochthonous inhabitants of the Chao Phraya and upper Ping valleys before the southward migration of the Tai. Between the fifth and tenth centuries Lawa communities lived in central Thailand alongside the Mon, including at Lavo, present-day Lopburi, while Chiang Mai was later built on the site of a fifth-century Lawa walled settlement. Northern Thai chronicles remember them as the founders of Haripunchai, modern Lamphun, and of the Ngoenyang chiefship. In the thirteenth century King Mangrai of Lanna took Kengtung from the Lawa and brought their northern towns under Tai rule, and in 1388 Lavo was absorbed into the rising Ayutthaya kingdom. The Lawa who kept to the hills of Chiang Mai and Mae Hong Son preserved village animism and a reputation as ironsmiths under the overlordship of Lanna and later Siam.
zh: 拉威人属南亚语系佤德昂语支，语言接近佤族和布朗族，被认为是泰人南下之前昭披耶河与滨河上游谷地的原住民。5至10世纪间，拉威人的聚落与孟人并存于泰国中部，包括罗涡（今华富里）；后来的清迈也是建在一处5世纪拉威人城墙聚落的遗址上。泰北编年史把南奔（哈利奔猜）和恩央城邦的建立也归于他们。13世纪，兰纳的孟莱王从拉威人手中夺取景栋，将其北方城镇纳入泰人统治；1388年，罗涡被崛起的大城王国吞并。退居清迈和湄宏顺山区的拉威人在兰纳及后来暹罗的宗主权下，保留了村落万物有灵信仰和铁匠的手艺名声。

en: The Laz are a Kartvelian people of the southeastern Black Sea coast, whose homeland runs from Trabzon and Rize in north-eastern Anatolia to the Adjara corner of Georgia. Their ancestors were the Colchian tribes of antiquity: by the third century the Lazi had united most of Colchis into the kingdom of Lazica, while the related Tzanni highlanders of Pontus kept their freedom until the generals of Justinian I subdued and Christianized them in the sixth century. After the Arab conquests the Trebizond country became their main center, and under the Empire of Trebizond, founded in 1204, Laz villagers made up much of the rural population while a semi-autonomous Lazia theme governed the eastern coast. The Ottomans took the region in 1547 and organized it as the Lazistan sanjak of Trabzon. During the seventeenth century most Laz converted from Orthodox Christianity to Sunni Islam while keeping their own Kartvelian tongue, and native derebey valley lords ruled with little interference from Istanbul until the reforms of Mahmud II crushed their revolt of 1832 to 1834. Laz society stayed organized around armed clans in the coastal valleys, famed for the horon dance and for shipbuilding and seamanship.
zh: 拉兹人是黑海东南岸的卡特维尔语族群，故乡从今土耳其东北部的特拉布宗、里泽延伸到格鲁吉亚的阿扎尔一带。其先民是古代科尔基斯诸部：3世纪时，拉兹人将科尔基斯大部统一为拉齐卡王国，而本都山地的同源部族察尼人直到6世纪才被查士丁尼一世的军队征服并皈依基督教。阿拉伯入侵后，特拉布宗一带成为他们的主要中心；1204年特拉布宗帝国建立后，拉兹村民构成其农村人口的主体，东部沿海则由半自治的拉齐亚军区管辖。1547年奥斯曼人征服该地区，设为特拉布宗下辖的拉齐斯坦桑贾克。17世纪间，多数拉兹人从东正教改宗逊尼派伊斯兰教，但保留了自己的卡特维尔语；本土的“谷地领主”德雷贝伊长期近乎独立，直到马哈茂德二世的改革镇压了他们1832至1834年的起义。拉兹社会以沿海谷地的武装氏族为基础，以霍龙舞以及造船和航海技艺闻名。

en: The Lega, also spelled Rega and calling themselves Warega, are a Bantu people of the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, holding the forested hills between Kivu and the Lomami and Ulindi rivers. They trace their origin to the country that is now Uganda, and in the 1500s began a long migration southward, fighting their way into their present lands as warriors who subdued the peoples already settled there and imposed their own customs. Lega villages had no kings: authority rested with clan and village heads and, above all, with the Bwami, a graded initiation society whose teaching joined proverbs, poetry, song and dance to the handling of sculpted objects. Bwami masks and figures, small and simply carved in wood or ivory, show the characteristic concave heart-shaped face with slit eyes; masks were rubbed with white clay at each use, while ivory pieces took on a russet or yellow patina. The Lega lived mainly by forest hunting and gathering, and because objects could be seen or owned only by the proper grades, art, knowledge and rank formed a single moral order.
zh: 莱加人又译雷加人，自称瓦雷加，是刚果民主共和国东部的班图族群，占据基伍与洛马米河、乌林迪河之间林木覆盖的丘陵。他们把发源地追溯到今乌干达一带，16世纪开始漫长的南迁，以能征善战之姿征服沿途居民，把自己的习俗推行到新占之地。莱加村落没有国王，权力握在氏族和村社首领手中，而居于社会核心的是布瓦米入会社：它分若干等级，逐级传授，把谚语、诗歌、歌唱、舞蹈与木雕器物的使用结合在一起。布瓦米的面具和人像用木或象牙雕成，形制小而简洁，典型特征是内凹的心形脸和细缝状的眼睛；面具每次使用都抹上白陶土，日久形成白色包浆，象牙器物则透出黄褐色光泽。莱加人传统上以森林狩猎和采集为生，器物只能由相应等级的人观看和持有，艺术、知识与等级因此构成同一套道德秩序。

en: The Leizhou are the Min-speaking Han Chinese of the Leizhou peninsula that reaches towards Hainan, occupying Haikang, Xuwen and Suixi under the old Leizhou prefecture and calling their speech Leizhou Min, or Li speech. Before the Han the peninsula was Luoyue country; in 111 BC, after the conquest of Nanyue, the Han set up Xuwen county over the whole peninsula, whose harbour became a departure port of the maritime silk route to Southeast Asia and India. Haikang was split off under the Sui in 589, and in 634 the Tang renamed the prefecture Leizhou. The Leizhou descend mainly from Min migrants from Zhangzhou and Putian who began arriving under the Tang; a great wave came at the fall of the Southern Song, when Putian militiamen fled the Mongol advance and settled the peninsula after 1279. Their dialect, first counted a branch of Southern Min and later grouped with Hainanese in the Qiong-Lei branch, took in local Yue and Li substrata, and the 1687 Haikang annals already described this eastern speech as much like the language of Zhangzhou and Chaozhou.
zh: 雷州人是伸向海南岛的雷州半岛上操闽语的汉族民系，聚居在旧雷州府的海康、徐闻、遂溪一带，母语为雷州话，又称黎话。汉代以前这里是骆越人的居地；公元前111年汉朝攻灭南越后置徐闻县，辖整个雷州半岛，徐闻港成为通往东南亚和南亚的海上丝绸之路始发港之一。589年隋朝析置海康县，634年唐朝改东合州为雷州。雷州人主要是唐代以来漳州、莆田闽地移民的后裔；南宋末年元军南下，莆田籍民兵在1279年崖山之战后大批逃到半岛定居，形成又一次移民高潮。他们的方言先被划为闽南语的一支，后来又与海南话合为琼雷片独立成区，吸收了本地越人、黎人的语言底层；1687年的《海康县志》已称这种东语与漳州、潮州话大类相通。

en: The Lenakel are an Oceanic-speaking people of the west-central coast of Tanna in southern Vanuatu, around the island's largest town, Lenakel, and the provincial centre of Isangel. Melanesian seafarers settled Tanna around 400 BC, and the glow of the active volcano Mount Yasur drew James Cook to the island in 1774, when he found thousands of villagers tending broad yam and sugar-cane plantations; whalers followed from 1804 and the sandalwood trader Peter Dillon called in 1825. Their language, known to its speakers as Netvaar, is a dialect chain of up to ten local forms, including Itonga and Ikyoo, and lies close to the Whitesands and North Tanna tongues. After Presbyterian missionaries adopted it as a church language in the nineteenth century, Lenakel became the most prestigious of the five languages of Tanna.
zh: 莱纳克尔人是瓦努阿图南部塔纳岛中西部沿海操大洋洲语族语言的族群，环居岛上最大的城镇莱纳克尔和省府伊桑格尔一带。美拉尼西亚航海者约在公元前400年定居塔纳岛；1774年，活火山亚苏尔山的火光把詹姆斯·库克引到该岛，他看到数千村民经营着大片山药和甘蔗种植园，1804年起捕鲸船接踵而至，檀香木商人彼得·狄龙也于1825年到访。他们的语言自称内特瓦尔语，是一条包含伊通加、伊基尤等多达十种地方话的方言链，与白沙语和北塔纳语十分接近。19世纪长老会传教士把它用作教会语言后，莱纳克尔语成为塔纳岛五种语言中声望最高的一种。

en: The Lenca are the indigenous people of southwestern Honduras and eastern El Salvador, speaking the isolated Lencan languages in dialects such as Potón and Chilanga. Their towns, among them the old trading city of Yarumela in the Comayagua Valley and the Quelepa site in El Salvador, were grouped into lordships such as Sulaco-Manianí, each ruled by a supreme lord and staffed by headmen whom clan mothers helped to choose. They farmed maize, yuca, cacao and cotton, paid tribute in honey and cotton cloaks, used a 365-day Mesoamerican calendar and learned Nahuat, Ch'orti' and other neighboring tongues for trade, sealing truces between lordships in the Guancasco ceremony. At the start of the sixteenth century they may have numbered over half a million. After the Spanish invasion the Lenca rose in 1537 under the war leader Lempira, who united rival subgroups on the fortified hill of Cerquín with some 30,000 men drawn from 200 towns. His death later that year broke the revolt, the Spanish town of Gracias a Dios was founded on the conquered ground, and the surviving Lenca were folded into the encomienda system.
zh: 伦卡人是洪都拉斯西南部和萨尔瓦多东部的原住民，讲孤立的伦卡语系语言，方言有波通、奇兰加等。他们的城镇——包括科马亚瓜谷地的古老商贸城市亚鲁梅拉和萨尔瓦多的克莱帕遗址——分属苏拉科-马尼亚尼等领地，各由一位最高首领统治，镇长的人选有氏族母亲参与决定。他们种植玉米、木薯、可可和棉花，以蜂蜜和棉斗篷纳贡，使用中美洲365天历法，并为经商学会纳瓦特语、乔尔蒂语等邻近语言，还以关卡斯科仪式缔结盟约、平息领地间的争端。16世纪初，伦卡人可能超过50万。西班牙入侵后，伦卡人于1537年在战将伦皮拉领导下起事，他在设防的塞尔金山上联合各个对立支系，集结了来自200个城镇约3万人的队伍。他在同年战死，起义随之失败，西班牙人在征服的土地上建立格拉西亚斯阿迪奥斯城，幸存的伦卡人被纳入委托监护制。

en: Asturleonese is the Ibero-Romance culture of the old Kingdom of León, covering the highlands of Asturias and the plains around León, Salamanca, Toro and Zamora, where its Leonese, Asturian, Cantabrian and Extremaduran varieties form one dialect continuum. Its speakers descend from the Astures, who resisted Augustus in the Cantabrian Wars before adopting the Latin of the garrisons; the city of León itself grew out of the camp of the Legio VII Gemina. In 910 the kings of Asturias moved their capital from Oviedo to León, creating the kingdom that bore the city's name and carried the Reconquista south beyond the Douro and the Sistema Central into Extremadura, where military orders settled the new frontier. The County of Castile broke away in 931 and Portugal in 1139, and from 1230 León was joined to Castile in a personal union under Ferdinand III, briefly challenged between 1296 and 1300; it nevertheless kept its own laws and assemblies as a constituent realm until 1833. Meanwhile Castilian steadily displaced Leonese from towns and documents, confining it to village speech across the Asturian mountains and the León countryside.
zh: 阿斯图尔-莱昂是旧莱昂王国的伊比利亚罗曼文化，范围涵盖阿斯图里亚斯高地以及莱昂、萨拉曼卡、托罗和萨莫拉一带的平原，其莱昂语、阿斯图里亚斯语、坎塔布里亚语和埃斯特雷马杜拉语诸变体构成一个方言连续体。他们的先民是阿斯图尔人，曾在坎塔布里亚战争中抵抗奥古斯都，后来接受了驻军的拉丁语；莱昂城本身就由第七双子军团的营地发展而来。910年阿斯图里亚斯诸王把首都从奥维耶多迁到莱昂，建立了以此城命名的王国，并将收复失地运动向南推进，越过杜罗河和中央山脉进入埃斯特雷马杜拉，由骑士团在新边疆定居。卡斯蒂利亚伯国于931年脱离，葡萄牙于1139年独立；1230年起莱昂在费尔南多三世治下与卡斯蒂利亚结成共主邦联，1296至1300年间一度出现争议，但它始终保留自己的法律和议会，作为组成王国延续到1833年。与此同时，卡斯蒂利亚语不断把莱昂语挤出城镇和文书，使它退居阿斯图里亚斯山区和莱昂乡间的村落口语。

en: The Lepai Ndé are the Lipan Apache, the easternmost of the Apache bands, whose name in their own Southern Athabaskan language means the light gray people. Their ancestors, encountered along the Canadian River by Coronado's expedition in 1541 and possibly including the Teya of the Texas Panhandle, once held a homeland stretching from the Southern Great Plains to the Gulf of Mexico. They had acquired Spanish horses by 1608 and became nomadic buffalo hunters and raiders; one of their branches, the Acho, joined the Taos and Picuris Pueblos in the great revolt of 1680 that drove the Spanish from New Mexico for twelve years. By 1700 Lipan bands were spread across southern Texas and into Coahuila, mixing seasonal farming of corn, beans and pumpkins with mounted hunting. They raided the new settlement of San Antonio from 1718, signed a notable peace with Spain there in 1749, and then saw their missions on the San Sabá River burned by Comanche and Wichita in 1757; defeat at the Battle of the Twin Villages in 1759 and a smallpox epidemic in 1764 left them exposed, and in 1767 the Spanish frontier adopted a policy of extermination against them.
zh: 勒派恩德人即利潘阿帕奇人，是阿帕奇诸支系中分布最东的一支，其南阿萨巴斯卡语自称意为“浅灰色之人”。他们的祖先在1541年于加拿大人河畔被科罗纳多远征队遇到，可能还融合了得克萨斯锅柄地区的特亚人，故土一度从南部大平原延伸到墨西哥湾。他们至迟在1608年已获得西班牙马匹，转型为骑马游猎、四处袭扰的野牛猎人；其中的阿乔支系参加了1680年陶斯和皮库里斯普韦布洛人的大起义，这场起义曾把西班牙人逐出新墨西哥十二年。到1700年，利潘诸群体已散布于得克萨斯南部直至科阿韦拉，过着种植玉米、豆类、南瓜与骑马狩猎相结合的季节性生活。1718年起他们劫掠新建的圣安东尼奥，1749年又在那里与西班牙签订了一份著名和约；然而1757年圣萨瓦河上的传教站被科曼切人和维希塔人焚毁，1759年他们在双村之战中战败，1764年的天花瘟疫又重创其人口，1767年西班牙边疆当局转而对他们采取剿灭政策。

en: The Lesser Polish are the West Slavic people of historical Lesser Poland, the hilly upper Vistula basin centered on Kraków, Sandomierz and Lublin. In the ninth and tenth centuries its southern part belonged to the Vistulan tribe and its north-eastern lands to the Lendians, until Mieszko I of Poland annexed the whole region in the late tenth century. From about 1040 Kraków served as the royal capital under Casimir I the Restorer. The fragmentation of 1138 split the province into the duchies of Kraków and Sandomierz, though unlike Silesia it was not subdivided further. Mongol raids in 1241, 1259 and 1287 burned its cities, and the assembled nobility of Małopolska perished at the Battle of Chmielnik in 1241. In 1320 Władysław I the Elbow-high was crowned in Wawel Cathedral, making the reunited province the heart of a kingdom that prospered under Casimir III the Great. Sixteenth-century grain exports down the Vistula enriched its cities, the Union of Lublin was concluded there in 1569, but the court's move to Warsaw in 1596 began its slow decline. During the partitions of 1772 and 1795 most of Lesser Poland passed to Austria as Galicia; the Kościuszko Uprising was proclaimed at Kraków in 1794, and after the Congress of Vienna in 1815 Kraków became a free city while the northern lands went to Russian-ruled Congress Poland, reached by the November Uprising in 1831. Its Lesser Polish dialect descends from Vistulan speech and, with Greater Polish, shaped standard literary Polish.
zh: 小波兰人是历史上小波兰地区的西斯拉夫人，聚居在以克拉科夫、桑多梅日和卢布林为中心、维斯瓦河上游的丘陵地带。9至10世纪，其南部属于维斯瓦人部落，东北部则是伦迪亚人的土地，10世纪末波兰的梅什科一世将整个地区兼并。约1040年起，克拉科夫在复兴者卡齐米日一世治下成为波兰都城。1138年波兰分裂，小波兰被分为克拉科夫公国和桑多梅日公国，但没有像西里西亚那样进一步碎分。1241、1259和1287年蒙古人三次入侵、焚毁城镇，1241年集结的小波兰贵族在赫梅利尼克战役中尽数战死。1320年瓦迪斯瓦夫一世（矮子）在瓦维尔大教堂加冕，重新统一的小波兰成为王国心脏，并在卡齐米日三世大帝治下走向繁荣。16世纪沿维斯瓦河外运的粮食使其城市富庶，1569年卢布林联合在此缔结，但1596年宫廷迁往华沙开启了它的缓慢衰落。1772和1795年的两次瓜分中，小波兰大部作为加利西亚归于奥地利；1794年柯斯丘什科起义在克拉科夫发动，1815年维也纳会议后克拉科夫成为自由市，北部土地则归入俄国治下的波兰会议王国，1831年十一月起义的战火蔓延至此。小波兰方言承自维斯瓦人的语言，与大波兰方言共同塑造了标准书面波兰语。

en: The Levantines, or Shamis, are the Arabic-speaking population of the eastern Mediterranean shore and its hinterland: the cities of Damascus and Aleppo, the Lebanese mountains around Baalbek and Sidon, and the Palestinian and Transjordan highlands. Their Levantine Arabic, self-styled Shami, grew from the long shift of Aramaic-speaking villagers into Arabic after the Muslim conquest of Syria in the seventh century and still keeps a marked Aramaic vocabulary. In 1337 the whole region belonged to the Cairo-based Mamluk sultanate, which ruled it through Damascus and Aleppo until the Ottomans defeated the Mamluks at Marj Dabiq in 1516. Istanbul then organized Syria into the eyalets of Damascus, Aleppo from 1534, Tripoli from 1579 and Sidon from 1660, while the Mount Lebanon emirate gained special autonomous status in 1667. Long a mosaic of Sunni and Shia Muslims, Druze, Alawites and Christians of several churches, the region lived from Mediterranean trade, textile crafts and the overland pilgrimage to Mecca until 1833, when the Convention of Kutahya handed all the Syrian provinces to Muhammad Ali of Egypt and opened a decade of Egyptian rule under his son Ibrahim Pasha.
zh: 黎凡特人又称沙姆人，是东地中海沿岸及其腹地讲阿拉伯语的居民，分布在大马士革、阿勒颇等城市，巴勒贝克、西顿周围的黎巴嫩山地，以及巴勒斯坦和外约旦高地。他们的黎凡特阿拉伯语自称沙姆语，源自7世纪穆斯林征服叙利亚后讲阿拉姆语村民漫长的语言转用，仍保留着大量阿拉姆语词汇。1337年整个地区隶属于以开罗为中心的马穆鲁克苏丹国，经由大马士革和阿勒颇统治，直到1516年奥斯曼人在马尔吉·达比克战役击败马穆鲁克。伊斯坦布尔随后把叙利亚划分为大马士革省、1534年分出的阿勒颇省、1579年分出的的黎波里省和1660年分出的西顿省，黎巴嫩山酋长国则于1667年获得特殊自治地位。这里长期是逊尼派、什叶派、德鲁兹、阿拉维各派与多个教会基督徒共处的拼图，靠地中海贸易、纺织手工业和通往麦加的陆上朝圣维系繁荣；1833年《屈塔希亚公约》把全部叙利亚省份交给埃及的穆罕默德·阿里，开启了其子易卜拉欣帕夏治下十年的埃及统治。

en: The Lewo are an Oceanic-speaking people of eastern Epi Island in central Vanuatu, settled in small, widely scattered villages. Their Austronesian language includes the Tasiko, Lemaroro and Maluba dialects and is closely related to the Lamen language of the same island, while many Lewo also speak neighbouring Bierebo.
zh: 莱沃人是瓦努阿图中部埃皮岛东部操大洋洲语族语言的族群，村落规模不大而分布分散。他们的南岛语系语言包括塔西科、莱马罗罗和马卢巴等方言，与同岛的拉门语关系密切；许多莱沃人也通晓邻近的比埃雷博语。

en: The Lezgins are a Northeast Caucasian people native to southern Dagestan and northern Azerbaijan, whose Lezgin language belongs to the Lezgic branch. Their mountain homeland runs from the eastern Greater Caucasus along the Samur River toward the Caspian, and their society was traditionally built on egalitarian village unions, called djamaat, made up of autonomous clans, or sykhyls, bound by an unwritten code of honour known as Lezgiwal. Greek and Roman authors knew their ancestors as the Legoi of Caucasian Albania, and Arab writers of the ninth and tenth centuries recorded a kingdom of Lakz whose people defended Shirvan against raiders from the north. Islam arrived in the eighth century but spread slowly, and many Lezgins kept older beliefs until the fifteenth. In the early sixteenth century the Safavids brought the region under Persian rule, briefly losing it to the Ottomans between 1578 and 1590 before Shah Abbas recovered it. In 1721 the Lezgin cleric Haji Davud sacked Shamakhi and set up a short-lived Shirvan Khanate under Ottoman protection; Nader Shah later restored Persian authority, and after his death in 1747 the Lezgins were divided between the Kuba and Derbent khanates and self-governing highland societies such as Akhtypara, Kure and Dokuzpara. The treaties of Gulistan in 1813 and Turkmenchay in 1828 transferred them to Russia, and in the decades that followed Lezgin clans rose in the Caucasian War, fighting under Imam Shamil against Russian rule.
zh: 列兹金人是世居达吉斯坦南部与阿塞拜疆北部的东北高加索民族，所说的列兹金语属列兹金语支。他们的山地家园沿萨穆尔河从大高加索山东段延伸至里海之滨，传统社会以平等的村落联盟“贾马特”为基础，由自治氏族“西希尔”组成，并受不成文的荣誉准则“列兹吉瓦尔”约束。古希腊、罗马作家把他们的先民称为高加索阿尔巴尼亚的莱戈伊人，9至10世纪的阿拉伯文献则记有拉克兹王国，其居民曾为保卫希尔万抵御北方来犯者。伊斯兰教8世纪即已传入，但传播缓慢，许多列兹金人直到15世纪仍保留古老信仰。16世纪初，萨法维王朝将这一地区纳入波斯治下，1578至1590年间一度被奥斯曼帝国夺取，后由阿拔斯沙收复。1721年，列兹金宗教学者哈吉·达乌德攻陷沙马基，在奥斯曼庇护下建立了短命的希尔万汗国；纳迪尔沙后来恢复了波斯的统治，1747年他死后，列兹金人分属库巴汗国、杰尔宾特汗国以及阿赫特帕拉、库雷、多库兹帕拉等自治高地社群。1813年的《古利斯坦条约》和1828年的《土库曼恰伊条约》将他们划归俄国，此后数十年间，列兹金诸氏族在高加索战争中起事，追随伊玛目沙米勒对抗俄国统治。

en: The Liáng culture belongs to the oases of the Hexi Corridor in present-day Gansu, a chain of farming towns from Lanzhou to Ganzhou and Shandan known in imperial times as Liangzhou. Han armies conquered the corridor in the 120s BCE and opened the Silk Road, and in the Sixteen Kingdoms era a succession of states named Liang ruled these oases between the steppe and the Tibetan plateau. In 1370 and 1372 the newly founded Ming dynasty seized the corridor from the Mongols and built Jiayu Pass at its western end; after the pass was closed in 1524 and the Great Wall was rebuilt through Gansu from 1539 to 1541, Liangzhou became a heavily garrisoned frontier. Qing forces took it from the short-lived Shun dynasty in 1645, and a Muslim revolt led by Milayin held Ganzhou and Suzhou against them until 1649. Soldier-farmers were settled in large numbers in the 1720s to guard against the Dzungars, and by the 1750s Hexi millet and wheat were shipped across the empire to relieve famines.
zh: 凉文化分布在今甘肃河西走廊的各片绿洲上，属于从兰州到甘州、山丹一连串农耕城镇的居民，这一带在古代统称凉州。公元前2世纪20年代，汉军攻占走廊、打通丝绸之路；十六国时期，一串以凉为名的政权先后立国于这片草原与高原之间的绿洲。1370至1372年，新生的明朝从蒙古人手中夺取河西，并在西端修建嘉峪关；1524年闭关之后，1539至1541年又沿甘肃重修长城，凉州由此成为重兵驻守的边疆。1645年，清军从短命的大顺政权手中接管此地；米喇印领导的回民起义据守甘州、肃州，直到1649年才被平定。18世纪20年代，大批军屯户迁入垦殖，以防准噶尔；到18世纪50年代，河西出产的粟和小麦已被调运帝国各地赈济饥荒。

en: The Liáodōng are the Chinese farming communities east of the Liao River and on the Liaodong Peninsula, the long-settled Han frontier between the Central Plain and the Manchurian forests. The state of Yan conquered the country from Gojoseon around 300 BC and planted the Liaodong Commandery at Xiangping, modern Liaoyang, which remained the region's chief city under the Han, when the Gongsun warlords ran an independent Liaodong state until Cao Wei overran it in 238. After the fourth century it passed through the Murong Yan kingdoms and Goguryeo, was reconquered by the Tang, and then ruled by Balhae, the Khitan Liao and the Jurchen Jin before the Mongols took it in 1206 and governed it through the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat; in 1337 its garrison towns and millet farms were therefore part of the Yuan frontier. The Ming recovered Liaodong in 1371 and built the Liaodong Wall from 1442, extending it in 1467 and 1468 against the Jianzhou Jurchens, yet the whole region fell to Nurhaci's Later Jin in the early seventeenth century, with Shenyang becoming the Manchu capital Shengjing in 1625. War emptied the old towns, and after 1653 the Qing resettled Liaodong with Shandong migrants behind the Willow Palisade, whose descendants gave the coast its Jiaoliao speech.
zh: 辽东人是辽河以东及辽东半岛上的汉族农耕居民，这片土地是中原与满洲森林之间开发已久的汉人边疆。约公元前300年，燕国从古朝鲜手中夺取此地，设立辽东郡，治所襄平即今天的辽阳；汉代这里仍是东北重镇，汉末公孙氏割据辽东，直到238年被曹魏攻灭。4世纪以后，辽东先后历经慕容氏诸燕和高句丽统治，唐朝收复后又归渤海、契丹辽和女真金管辖；1206年蒙古攻占其地，设辽阳行省管理。因此1337年时，这里的军镇和粟田属于元朝边疆。1371年明朝收复辽东，1442年起修筑辽东边墙，又于1467至1468年扩建，以防御建州女真；但17世纪初，整个辽东仍落入努尔哈赤的后金之手，沈阳于1625年成为满洲都城盛京。战乱使旧城人口凋零，1653年起清朝在柳条边内招徕山东移民重新垦殖，这些移民的后代也把胶辽口音带到了沿海各地。

en: The Libyans are the Arabic-speaking people of the North African coast between Egypt and Tunisia, divided between the eastern towns of Cyrenaica, Benghazi and Al-Bayda, and those of Tripolitania, Tripoli and Misrata. Their vernacular, Libyan or Sulaimitian Arabic, is a Maghrebi variety shaped above all by the Banu Sulaym and Banu Hilal, Bedouin tribes who left famine-stricken Egypt for the Maghreb in the mid-eleventh century; the Sulaym in particular spread across Cyrenaica and Tripolitania. Later migrants from reconquered al-Andalus, together with older Berber, Greek, Italian and Turkish layers, also left their mark on the dialect. Tripoli itself fell to Spanish conquerors in 1510 and was assigned to the Knights of St John in 1530, until the Ottoman commander Turgut Reis took it in the siege of 1551, after which it became a Barbary corsair stronghold. In 1711 the Janissary officer Ahmed Karamanli killed the Ottoman governor and founded a hereditary dynasty; his pashas grew rich on corsair tribute and by the mid-eighteenth century ruled as far as Cyrenaica and the Fezzan. Yusuf Karamanli's demands on American shipping brought the First Barbary War of 1801 to 1805, and in 1835, amid a dynastic civil war, an Ottoman army restored direct rule and ended the dynasty.
zh: 利比亚人是埃及与突尼斯之间北非海岸的阿拉伯语居民，分为东西两部分：东部人居于昔兰尼加的班加西、贝达等城，西部人居于的黎波里塔尼亚的的黎波里、米苏拉塔等城。他们的口语利比亚阿拉伯语又称苏莱姆阿拉伯语，属马格里布方言，主要由巴努·苏莱姆和巴努·希拉勒两支贝都因部落塑造：11世纪中叶，两部落为逃避埃及饥荒西迁马格里布，其中苏莱姆人遍布昔兰尼加和的黎波里塔尼亚。收复运动后离开安达卢西亚的移民，以及更古老的柏柏尔、希腊、意大利、土耳其语言层，也在方言中留下痕迹。的黎波里1510年被西班牙人攻占，1530年划归圣约翰骑士团，1551年奥斯曼统帅图尔古特·雷斯在围城战后夺取该城，这里从此成为巴巴里海盗的据点。1711年，近卫军军官艾哈迈德·卡拉曼利杀死奥斯曼总督，建立世袭王朝；历代帕夏靠海盗贡金致富，到18世纪中叶势力远达昔兰尼加和费赞。优素福·卡拉曼利向美国商船索贡引发了1801至1805年的第一次巴巴里战争；1835年，奥斯曼军队乘王朝内战恢复直接统治，卡拉曼利王朝告终。

en: The Licanantay, whose name means inhabitants of the territory in their own Kunza tongue, are better known as the Atacameño people of the Atacama Desert. Their villages, among them San Pedro de Atacama, Quitor, Toconao and Lasana, lined the oases of the Loa River and the Salar de Atacama, stretching from Copiapó to the Puna de Atacama and the Lípez highlands. Rooted in the San Pedro culture from about 500, they herded llamas, farmed irrigated terraces of maize, quinoa and potatoes, worked copper from Chuquicamata and defended their towns with stone pukara fortresses, while the volcano Licancabur was their sacred mountain. Tiwanaku influence reached them early, and in the early fifteenth century the Inca Túpac Yupanqui conquered them, imposing sun worship and mitma rule. Diego de Almagro's men appeared in 1536 and Spanish control was sealed by 1557. In the eighteenth century the Atacameño Tomás Paniri took part in the great Andean rebellions of Túpac Katari and Túpac Amaru II, while Kunza steadily gave way to Spanish.
zh: 利卡南泰人在自己的昆萨语中意为“这片土地上的居民”，更广为人知的称呼是阿塔卡马人。他们的村落——包括圣佩德罗-德阿塔卡马、基托尔、托科瑙和拉萨纳——沿洛阿河绿洲和阿塔卡马盐沼分布，范围从科皮亚波一直延伸到阿塔卡马普纳和利佩斯一带的高地。其文化可追溯到约500年的圣佩德罗文化：他们放牧羊驼，在灌溉梯田上种植玉米、藜麦和马铃薯，开采丘基卡马塔的铜矿，并用石砌的普卡拉堡垒保卫村镇，还把利坎卡武尔火山奉为圣山。他们早年受蒂亚瓦纳科文化影响，15世纪初被印加王图帕克·尤潘基征服，被迫接受太阳神崇拜和米特马埃制度。1536年阿尔马格罗的部下抵达此地，1557年西班牙正式确立统治。18世纪，阿塔卡马人托马斯·帕尼里参加了图帕克·卡塔里和图帕克·阿马鲁二世领导的安第斯大起义，昆萨语也在这一时期逐渐被西班牙语取代。

en: The Ligurians are the people of the narrow north-western Italian coast and its Apennine hinterland, the land of the ancient Ligures, herders and pirates whose emporium of Genoa traded with Etruscans and Greeks and who resisted Rome until the deportation of the Apuani in 180 BC; under Augustus the country became the ninth region of Roman Italy. The medieval Genoese turned to the sea, and by 1337 their city, la Superba, ruled a maritime republic whose galleys had crushed Pisa at Meloria in 1284 and whose factories stretched from Corsica, held from 1347 to 1768, to the Crimea and Chios. Two years after 1337 the republic gained its first elected doge, though real power rested with merchant oligarchs, who fought Venice for Mediterranean trade and, after losing most colonies, remade Genoa into a banking centre financing the Spanish empire. Their language is Ligurian, a Gallo-Italic tongue whose Genoese dialect, Zeneize, served as the republic's written koiné and has carried a literary tradition since the thirteenth century. Napoleon ended the republic in 1797 with the Ligurian Republic, annexed it to France in 1805, and in 1815 the Congress of Vienna gave Genoa to the Kingdom of Sardinia.
zh: 利古里亚人居住在意大利西北狭窄的沿海地带及其亚平宁腹地，这里是古代利古里亚人的土地：他们以牧养和海盗为生，其贸易据点热那亚与伊特鲁里亚人和希腊人通商；他们长期抵抗罗马，直到公元前180年阿普亚尼部被强行迁走，奥古斯都时代该地成为罗马意大利的第九区。中世纪的热那亚人转向海洋，到1337年，他们的城市“高傲者”热那亚已是一个海上共和国：其舰队在1284年的梅洛里亚海战中击垮比萨，商站从科西嘉（1347至1768年据有）一直延伸到克里米亚和希俄斯。1337年过后两年，共和国有了第一位选举产生的总督，但实权掌握在商业寡头手中；他们与威尼斯争夺地中海贸易，在丧失大部分殖民地后，又把热那亚改造为为西班牙帝国融资的银行业中心。他们的语言利古里亚语属于高卢-意大利语，其中的热那亚方言是共和国的书面通用语，文学传统可追溯至13世纪。1797年拿破仑以利古里亚共和国终结了热那亚共和国，1805年将其并入法国，1815年维也纳会议又把热那亚划归撒丁王国。

en: The Lillooet, who call themselves the St'at'imc, are an Interior Salish people of the Fraser Canyon and the surrounding mountains of southern British Columbia. Their language, St'at'imcets, belongs to the Interior Salish branch alongside the speech of the neighbouring Shuswap and Nlaka'pamux. Salmon fishing formed the backbone of their economy, supplemented by hunting bear, mountain sheep and caribou and by berry gathering, and the eleven Lillooet bands generally preferred trade over warfare. They built plank longhouses, insulated winter earthlodges and summer lodges covered in bark or reed mats, like the ancient settlement at Keatley Creek. Sharing much with Northwest Coast peoples, they held potlatches, kept clan names and raised totem poles in some communities, notably the Lil'wat of the Whistler valley, whose lands met those of the Coast Salish Squamish. A rare rupture was the brutal war with the Tsilhqot'in, whose raiders carried off women and children from every Lillooet band until a St'at'imc victory in Graveyard Valley broke their power. The fur trader Simon Fraser passed through the Fraser Canyon on his river journey of 1808.
zh: 利卢埃特人自称斯亚特姆克人，是不列颠哥伦比亚省南部弗雷泽峡谷及周围山区的内陆萨利什人。他们的语言斯亚特姆克茨语属内陆萨利什语支，与邻近的舒斯瓦普人和恩拉卡帕穆克人的语言同支。鲑鱼捕捞是他们的经济支柱，辅以猎取熊、岩羊和驯鹿以及采集浆果；利卢埃特人的十一个群体通常以贸易为先，少有战事。他们建造木板长屋、保暖的冬季土屋和覆以树皮或芦苇席的夏季棚屋，基特利溪的古代聚落就是这类村落。他们与西北海岸民族有许多共通之处，举办夸富宴、保有氏族名号，部分群体还竖立图腾柱，尤以惠斯勒河谷的利尔瓦特人为代表，其土地与海岸萨利什的斯阔米什人相接。少有的一次决裂是与齐尔科廷人的惨烈战争：对方的劫掠者从利卢埃特人的每个群体掳走妇女和儿童，直到利卢埃特人在墓地谷一战获胜，才挫其锋芒。毛皮商人西蒙·弗雷泽在1808年的沿河探险中曾穿过弗雷泽峡谷。

en: The Limbu, who call themselves Yakthung, are a Kirati Tibeto-Burman people indigenous to the eastern Nepalese hills, the country the game calls Limbuwan around Taplejung, Dhankuta and Vijayapur, with kindred communities in Sikkim and the Darjeeling hills. They were among the earliest inhabitants of this region and heirs of the ancient Kirat civilization once also dominant in the Kathmandu valley. Before the Gorkha conquest their country, Limbuwan, was a confederation of ten kingdoms whose chiefs bore the title of Subba or Hang, each with its own laws and communal kipat land tenure. In the 1770s Prithvi Narayan Shah annexed Limbuwan during the unification of Nepal, and the treaty of about 1774 promised the Limbu autonomy over their lands and customs, though centralization later eroded those guarantees. They speak Limbu, or Yakthungpan, written in the Sirijanga script first created in the ninth century and revived centuries later, and their traditional religion, Yuma Samyo, rests on the oral Mundhum lore of their phedangma priests rather than on written scripture.
zh: 林布人自称雅克通，是尼泊尔东部山区的基拉蒂系藏缅语原住民，居住在游戏所称的林布万地区，即塔普勒琼、丹库塔和维贾亚布尔一带，在锡金和大吉岭山区也有亲缘社群。他们是该地区最早的居民之一，承袭了也曾统治加德满都谷地的古代基拉蒂文明。廓尔喀征服之前，他们的国家林布万是十个王国组成的联盟，首领称苏巴或杭，各有自己的法律和基帕特公社土地制。18世纪70年代，普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿在统一尼泊尔的过程中兼并林布万，1774年前后的条约承诺保障林布人对土地和习俗的自治权，但后来的中央集权逐渐侵蚀了这些保证。林布人使用林布语（又称雅克通语），文字为9世纪创制、数百年后复兴的西里琼加文；其传统信仰尤玛教以佩当马祭司口传的《蒙杜姆》经典为根基，而非依靠成文经文。

en: The Limilngan, also called Minitja or Buneidja and recorded by Norman Tindale as the Puneitja, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the country east of Darwin, their neighbours being the Ngardok, Ngomburr, Uwinymil, Warray and Djerimanga. Tindale placed their roughly 2,300 square kilometres of territory on the western side of the South Alligator River along Coirwong Creek, around the lower Mary River between Mount Bundey and Point Stuart, country that later fell within Kakadu. Their extinct language shared its name with the people. In local Dreamtime lore the founding woman Imberombera walked south across the sea, landed at Malay Bay and, heavy with child, left spirit children and the languages of each land along her path; a Limilngan narrative tells of the old creator Wanyjuwanyjuwa journeying from Oenpelli toward Darwin with three mermaid sisters.
zh: 利米恩甘人又称米尼查或布内贾，诺曼·廷代尔记为普内查人，是达尔文以东地区的澳大利亚原住民，邻族有加尔多克人、贡布尔人、乌维尼米尔人、瓦赖人和杰里芒加人。廷代尔将其约2300平方公里的领地定在南阿利盖特河以西、夸尔旺溪一带，即班迪山与斯图尔特角之间的玛丽河下游，这片地方后来划入卡卡杜。他们已经消亡的语言与族名相同。当地梦幻时代传说中，始祖女因贝龙贝拉渡海南下，在马来湾登陆，身怀六甲沿途留下灵童并为每片土地定下语言；利米恩甘人自己的叙事则讲造物主老者万朱万朱瓦与三姐妹美人鱼从昂佩利向达尔文一路游历的故事。

en: Limousin is the north-westernmost dialect of Occitan, spoken across the old province of Limousin and the neighbouring county of La Marche, on the western edge of the Massif Central. Its name comes from the Lemovices, the Gaulish tribe whose Roman capital, Augustoritum, grew into the city of Limoges; excavations at Tintignac have recovered rare Celtic war trumpets, or carnyces, from one of their sanctuaries. Some of the very earliest texts in an Occitan-like vernacular, above all the poem Boecis written around the year 1000, are in an early Limousin form. Limoges, with its great Abbey of Saint-Martial, was a centre of medieval music and of the troubadour poetry that flourished in the Limousin castles, and the dukes of Aquitaine were invested there. The viscounts of Limoges and local lords such as those of Ventadour and Turenne ruled a country that passed with Aquitaine under English Plantagenet claims before the French crown retook it in the later Hundred Years' War. From the sixteenth century standard French made steady inroads, though Occitan long remained the everyday speech of the villages; in 1790 the province was broken into the departments of Haute-Vienne, Corrèze and Creuse.
zh: 利穆赞语是奥克语最靠西北的方言，通行于旧利穆赞行省和相邻的拉马什伯国，地处中央高原西缘。其名来自高卢部落莱莫维斯人，他们的罗马时代首府奥古斯托里图姆后来发展为利摩日；坦蒂尼亚克的考古发掘还从他们的圣所中出土了罕见的凯尔特战号“卡尼克斯”。最早一批接近奥克语的俗语文献，尤其是约公元1000年写成的长诗《博埃西斯》，用的就是早期利穆赞语形式。利摩日拥有宏伟的圣马夏尔修道院，是中世纪音乐和游吟诗人诗歌的中心，游吟诗歌在利穆赞的城堡中盛极一时，阿基坦公爵也在此受封。利摩日子爵以及旺塔杜尔、蒂雷讷等地的领主统治着这片土地，它随阿基坦一并落入英格兰金雀花王朝的势力范围，百年战争后期才被法国王室收复。从16世纪起标准法语不断渗透，但奥克语长期仍是乡村的日常用语；1790年该行省被划分为上维埃纳、科雷兹和克勒兹三省。

en: The Lio, who call themselves Ata Li'o, are an Austronesian people of central Flores, settled around the Kelimutu region and the western edge of Sikka in the Lesser Sunda chain. They speak Li'o, a Central Flores language close to Ende, and have long been strongly influenced and partly absorbed by their Ende neighbours.
zh: 廖人自称阿塔·廖，是弗洛勒斯岛中部的南岛语族群，聚居在克利穆图一带及锡卡地区西缘。他们操中弗洛勒斯语支的廖语，与恩德语相近，长期受邻近的恩德人影响，并有一部分被其同化。

en: The Lisu are a Tibeto-Burman highland people whose history is carried in long genealogical songs. They trace their origin to the eastern edge of the Tibetan plateau, where their ancestors lived around modern Xichang before drifting south into the gorges of north-western Yunnan; Chinese records of the 700s already call them the Lisu clans of the Wuman, and the name appears in Fan Chuo's Manshu of about 862. In the eighth century their forebears were ruled by the Wudeng, Lianglin and Fengba tribes, and from the 1100s they passed under the Lijiang military command of the Yuan and then the Mu native chieftains of the Ming, for whom Lisu warriors fought in the Luchuan campaigns of 1438–1449, a service remembered in the Knife-Pole festival. In the mid-1500s, fleeing war and the exactions of the Mu tusi, a great host under the headman Kuomubi crossed the Mekong and the Biluo snow range into the Nujiang valley, the first of the migrations that spread Lisu clans through the Salween country and beyond. From the mid-1700s groups from Yinjiang crossed into Burma and settled around Momeik and Mogok. Divided into more than fifty-eight named clans, the Lisu share much of their culture with the Yi, hunting and farming the steep mountain slopes.
zh: 傈僳是藏缅语族的高山民族，历史靠长篇叙事歌代代传唱。他们的发源地在青藏高原东缘，先民居住在今西昌一带，后来南迁入云南西北部的峡谷；8世纪的汉文记载已称他们为乌蛮中的“栗粟两姓蛮”，樊绰约在862年写成的《蛮书》也记下了这个族称。8世纪时，其先民受勿邓、两林、丰巴三大乌蛮部落统辖；12世纪以后，先后隶属于元朝的丽江路军民总管府和明代丽江木氏土知府。1438至1449年麓川之役中，傈僳将士为明朝作战，这段事迹后来凝结为刀杆节。16世纪中叶，为逃避战乱和木土司的压榨，大批傈僳人在头人括木必率领下渡过澜沧江、翻越碧罗雪山进入怒江谷地，这是一系列迁徙的开端，此后傈僳各氏族逐渐散布到萨尔温江流域及更远的地方。18世纪中叶，盈江一带的傈僳人又迁入缅甸，定居莫梅、抹谷等地。傈僳分为五十八个有名号的氏族，文化与彝族多有相通，在陡峭山坡上狩猎耕种。

en: The Livs are a Finnic fishing and trading people who gave Livonia its name. They called themselves rāndalist, coast dwellers, and held the shores of the Gulf of Riga and the lower Daugava, the river that carried the Baltic trade into Rus, with another group on the northern coast of Courland. Their lands before the German coming were divided among the Daugava Livonians, Turaida, Idumeja, Metsepole and other chiefdoms, and the Turaida chieftain Caupo was among the first native rulers drawn into the crusader orbit. Missionary work began in the 1180s under Bishop Meinhard; when the Livs resisted, Berthold of Hanover was killed in 1198, and Albert of Buxhövden founded Riga at the mouth of the Daugava in 1201. The Brothers of the Sword, formed in 1202, subdued and baptised them by 1208, and Liv levies then fought the Order's wars as infantry. The crusade depopulated the Daugava valley, and from about 1220 Latvian tribes moved into the vacuum, cutting the inland Livs off from those of Courland; the inland communities were gradually absorbed into the Latvians, while the Courland coast kept its Finnic speech. After the Livonian War the country passed through Polish and Swedish rule to Russia in 1710, under a German landed nobility, and the surviving Livs lived on as fishermen in the coastal villages of Courland.
zh: 利夫人是芬兰语族的渔贸民族，立窝尼亚之名即来自他们。他们自称“兰达利斯特”，意为海滨居民，占据里加湾沿岸和道加瓦河下游——这条河把波罗的海贸易引入罗斯，另有一支住在库尔兰北岸。德意志人到来之前，他们的土地分为道加瓦利夫、图雷达伊、伊杜梅亚、梅采波莱等酋长领地，图雷达伊首领考波是最早被卷入十字军体系的本地统治者之一。传教活动始于12世纪80年代的迈因哈德主教；利夫人起而反抗，汉诺威的贝特霍尔德于1198年被杀，布克斯赫夫登的阿尔伯特则于1201年在道加瓦河口建立里加。1202年成立的佩剑兄弟会到1208年征服并为他们施洗，利夫民壮此后充当步卒为骑士团作战。十字军使道加瓦河谷人口凋零，约1220年起拉脱维亚诸部迁入空地，把内陆利夫人与库尔兰的同族人隔开；内陆各群体逐渐被拉脱维亚人同化，只有库尔兰海岸保留了芬兰语。立窝尼亚战争后，这片土地先后历经波兰、瑞典统治，于1710年归俄国，由德意志贵族地主把持，幸存的利夫人则以渔民身份生活在库尔兰的滨海渔村。

en: The Lom, often called Bosha by their neighbours, are a Romani people of the South Caucasus whose ancestors left northwestern India and, after centuries of migration through the Iranian plateau, reached the Armenian Highland in the eleventh and twelfth centuries. Their own language, Lomavren, keeps an Indo-Aryan vocabulary on an Armenian grammar and was increasingly reserved for private speech as most Lom adopted Armenian. Traditionally itinerant, they lived as sievemakers, blacksmiths and small craftsmen, while the women traded, told fortunes and begged, moving with their donkeys between towns. Ottoman tax records and Armenian chronicles place them in Kars, Erzurum and other western Armenian cities, and by the 1720s a Bosha quarter existed in Yerevan. Christian Lom lived under Georgian and Armenian princes around Akhaltsikhe and Akhalkalaki, whereas those who remained in the Ottoman eastern provinces of Ardahan, Kars and Artvin turned to Islam during the nineteenth century. After the Russo-Turkish war of 1828 to 1829, Archbishop Karapet led a group from Erzurum into Russian territory, resettling them at Akhalkalaki, Akhaltsikhe and Alexandropol; by the late nineteenth century the Lom were mostly semi-sedentary, working the same crafts in fixed quarters of Caucasian towns.
zh: 洛姆人是外高加索的罗姆人支系，邻族多称他们为博沙人。他们的祖先离开印度西北部，经伊朗高原迁徙数百年，于11至12世纪抵达亚美尼亚高原。他们本族的洛马夫伦语保留了印度雅利安词汇，却采用亚美尼亚语语法；随着多数洛姆人改用亚美尼亚语，这种语言逐渐只在私下场合使用。洛姆人传统上游居四方，男子以制筛、打铁和小手艺为生，妇女从事商贩、占卜和乞讨，赶着毛驴在城镇间流动。奥斯曼税册和亚美尼亚编年史记载他们住在卡尔斯、埃尔祖鲁姆等西亚美尼亚城市，到18世纪20年代，埃里温已形成博沙人街区。信奉基督教的洛姆人生活在阿哈尔齐赫、阿哈尔卡拉基一带的格鲁吉亚和亚美尼亚王公治下；留在奥斯曼东部阿尔达汉、卡尔斯、阿尔特温诸省的洛姆人则在19世纪改宗伊斯兰教。1828至1829年俄土战争后，卡拉佩特大主教率领一批人从埃尔祖鲁姆迁入俄国境内，被安置在阿哈尔卡拉基、阿哈尔齐赫和亚历山德罗波尔；到19世纪末，洛姆人大多已半定居，在高加索城镇的固定街区里操持旧日手艺。

en: The Lombards are the people of the fertile Po plain of northern Italy, whose region takes its name from the Germanic Longobards who invaded in 568 and made Pavia the capital of their kingdom until Charlemagne deposed their last king Desiderius in 774; the native Gallo-Roman population absorbed the newcomers and kept their name. In 1337 their cities of Milan, Pavia, Cremona, Brescia and Novara were rich manufacturing and banking communes, already dominated in Milan by the Visconti lords. Earlier, the cities had formed the Lombard League and defeated the emperor Frederick I at Legnano in 1176. Their speech is Lombard, a Gallo-Italic language built on a Celtic and Latin base with a Lombardic Germanic layer, long used in local administration until literary Tuscan displaced it in the fifteenth century, when the Sforza dukes of Milan drew Florentine scholars including Leonardo da Vinci to their court. The Duchy of Milan passed to the Spanish Habsburgs after the Battle of Pavia in 1525, suffered the great plague of 1628 to 1630, and came under Austria in 1706; Napoleon made Milan the capital of his Cisalpine Republic and Kingdom of Italy, before the Congress of Vienna in 1815 merged the region into the Austrian Kingdom of Lombardy-Venetia.
zh: 伦巴第人是意大利北部富庶波河平原的居民，地区得名于568年入侵的日耳曼伦哥巴人；他们以帕维亚为王国都城，直到774年查理曼废黜末代国王德西德里乌斯。当地的高卢-罗马居民同化了这些征服者，却保留了他们的名字。1337年，米兰、帕维亚、克雷莫纳、布雷西亚、诺瓦拉等城市已是富庶的制造业和银行业公社，米兰则已由维斯孔蒂家族的领主把持。更早之前，这些城市曾组成伦巴第同盟，于1176年在莱尼亚诺击败皇帝腓特烈一世。他们的语言伦巴第语属于高卢-意大利语，以凯尔特语和拉丁语为基础，又覆有一层伦哥巴日耳曼语成分；它长期用于地方行政，到15世纪被文学托斯卡纳语取代，当时米兰的斯福尔扎公爵把包括莱昂纳多·达·芬奇在内的佛罗伦萨学者延揽到宫廷。1525年帕维亚战役后，米兰公国转入西班牙哈布斯堡家族手中，1628至1630年又遭大瘟疫侵袭，1706年归属奥地利；拿破仑曾以米兰为其奇萨尔皮尼共和国和意大利王国的首都，1815年维也纳会议则把该地区并入奥地利治下的伦巴第-威尼托王国。

en: The Lorrain are the Romance people of Lorraine, the Moselle and Meuse country around Nancy, Metz and Verdun, whose Oïl vernacular took shape beside the Germanic Lorraine Franconian spoken in the northern third of the region and borrowed freely from it; in the high Vosges valleys it kept archaic sounds, while the Welche dialect marks its eastern edge in Alsace and Gaumais extends it into Belgian Gaume. The country descends from Lotharingia, the middle Carolingian kingdom named after Emperor Lothair, and after the stem duchy split in 959 its southern half became the Duchy of Upper Lorraine, later simply Lorraine, with its capital at Nancy. Ruled by the House of Lorraine from 1473, it was the battlefield where Charles the Bold of Burgundy met defeat and death in 1477. The Three Bishoprics of Metz, Toul and Verdun were ceded to France by the Treaty of Chambord in 1552, and French armies occupied the duchy repeatedly during the Thirty Years' War and after. In 1737 it passed to the exiled Polish king Stanislaw Leszczynski on the understanding that France would inherit it, and on his death in 1766 Lorraine was finally annexed and reorganized as a French province.
zh: 洛林人是洛林地区讲罗曼语的居民，分布在南锡、梅斯和凡尔登一带的摩泽尔河与默兹河流域；他们的洛林语属奥依语，与地区北部三分之一通行的日耳曼洛林法兰克语相邻，大量吸收后者的成分。在孚日高山谷地它保留了古塞擦音，东端在阿尔萨斯形成韦尔什方言，还以戈梅方言之名延伸到比利时的戈姆地区。洛林的前身是加洛林王朝的中间王国洛塔林吉亚，得名于皇帝洛泰尔；959年大公国分裂后，南半成为上洛林公国，后径称洛林公国，首府南锡。1473年起由洛林家族统治，1477年勃艮第公爵大胆查理正是在南锡战役中兵败身死。1552年《尚博尔条约》把梅斯、图勒和凡尔登三个主教区割让给法国，三十年战争及其后法军又多次占领公国。1737年，公国交给流亡的波兰国王斯坦尼斯瓦夫·莱什琴斯基，并约定死后归法国继承；1766年他去世，洛林终被兼并，改建为法国行省。

en: The Low Franconians are the speakers of the Dutch dialect continuum, from Flemish and Brabantine in the south to Hollandic, Zeelandic and the Limburgish and Kleverlandish speeches of the Lower Rhine, generally regarded as the most direct descendants of the language of the Salian Franks. From the ninth century the counts of Flanders built one of Europe's richest principalities on the North Sea coast, and the cloth towns of Ghent, Bruges and Ypres turned English wool into the luxury textiles of a huge trade network; in 1302 Flemish militias crushed French chivalry at the Battle of the Golden Spurs near Kortrijk. Burgundy inherited Flanders in 1384 and gathered the seventeen provinces of the Low Countries, including Brabant, Holland, Zeeland and Guelders, into the Burgundian Netherlands, which passed to the Habsburgs with Mary of Burgundy in 1477. The Reformation and resistance to Spanish taxation then ignited the Eighty Years' War of 1568 to 1648: the Union of Utrecht of 1579 and the Act of Abjuration of 1581 produced the Calvinist Dutch Republic of 1588, whose seafaring merchants built the VOC empire and presided over the seventeenth-century Golden Age of Rembrandt and Vermeer, while the southern provinces stayed with Catholic Habsburg Spain and later Austria. French revolutionary armies overran both halves in 1794 to 1795, and after Waterloo the United Kingdom of the Netherlands briefly reunited them in 1815, until the Belgian Revolution of 1830 split the kingdom again.
zh: 低地法兰克人讲荷兰语方言连续体，从南部的佛兰芒语、布拉班特语，到荷兰语、泽兰语，以及下莱茵的林堡语和克莱弗兰语；这些方言被公认为萨利克法兰克人语言最直接的后裔。9世纪起，佛兰德斯伯爵在北海沿岸建立了欧洲最富庶的政权之一，根特、布鲁日和伊珀尔等呢绒城把英国羊毛织成畅销各地的高档织物；1302年佛兰德斯民兵在科特赖克附近的金马刺战役中击溃法国骑士。1384年勃艮第继承佛兰德斯，把布拉班特、荷兰、泽兰、海尔德等低地十七省整合为勃艮第尼德兰，1477年随勃艮第的玛丽转入哈布斯堡之手。宗教改革和对西班牙赋税的反抗引发了1568至1648年的八十年战争：1579年乌得勒支同盟、1581年誓绝法案催生了1588年的加尔文宗尼德兰联省共和国，其航海商人建立东印度公司贸易帝国，开创了伦勃朗和维米尔所处的17世纪黄金时代；南部各省则留在天主教的西班牙、其后奥地利的哈布斯堡治下。1794至1795年法国革命军席卷南北，滑铁卢后的1815年尼德兰联合王国一度将双方重新统一，直到1830年比利时革命使王国再度分裂。

en: Lower Egyptians are the Arabic-speaking people of the Nile Delta, the fertile country between Cairo and the Mediterranean that medieval Arab writers called Miṣr as-Suflā. Their vernacular, Egyptian Arabic, or Masri, took shape in Fustat, the first Islamic capital, on the site of modern Cairo, and carries a large Coptic substrate inherited from the Egyptians who adopted Arabic after the conquest of 641; Coptic-Arabic bilingualism in the delta lasted more than three centuries. Cairo itself was founded by the Fatimids in 969 and remained the seat of power under the Ayyubids and the Mamluks, who ruled Egypt from the mid-thirteenth century until the Ottoman conquest of 1517. Under Ottoman rule Egypt became a province largely run by Mamluk beys, while the delta kept its rich farmlands, and Alexandria and Damietta remained its Mediterranean ports. French troops occupied Cairo from 1798 to 1801, and after their withdrawal Muhammad Ali Pasha seized power in 1805, making the delta the heartland of a quasi-independent Egyptian state.
zh: 下埃及人是尼罗河三角洲的阿拉伯语居民。三角洲是开罗与地中海之间的肥沃土地，中世纪阿拉伯作家称之为米斯尔·苏夫拉。他们的口语埃及阿拉伯语又称马斯里语，成形于今开罗境内的第一座伊斯兰都城富斯塔特，带有浓厚的科普特语底层：641年阿拉伯征服后，当地埃及人逐渐改说阿拉伯语，三角洲的科普特—阿拉伯双语状态持续了三个多世纪。开罗本身由法蒂玛王朝建于969年，阿尤布王朝和马穆鲁克王朝相继在此掌权，马穆鲁克从13世纪中叶统治埃及，直到1517年被奥斯曼帝国征服。奥斯曼统治下，埃及成为主要由马穆鲁克贝伊经营的省份，三角洲凭借肥沃农田保持富庶，亚历山大和杜姆亚特则是地中海港口。1798至1801年法国军队占领开罗，法军撤走后，穆罕默德·阿里帕夏于1805年夺取政权，三角洲成为这个半独立埃及政权的心脏地带。

en: The Lower Saxons are the Low German-speaking people of the north-west German plain, the marsh and heath country along the lower Elbe and Weser around Hamburg, Stade and Oldenburg, and the heirs of the Old Saxons who settled there from the Migration Period. Charlemagne conquered them in the Saxon Wars of 772 to 804 and folded their land into his empire, after which it formed the stem duchy of Saxony, whose duke Henry the Fowler became German king in 919. Ruled first by the Billungs and then the Welfs, the old duchy was broken when Emperor Frederick I deposed Henry the Lion in 1180, and in 1235 the Welf Otto the Child received the new Duchy of Brunswick-Lüneburg, from which the region's later Welf states descended. Their West Low German speech, descending from Old Saxon, served in its Middle Low German form as the trading language of the Hanseatic League and was carried from harbours such as Hamburg and Bremen. From the late thirteenth century these former Saxon lands were called Lower Saxony, and in 1500 they were organized into the Lower Saxon Circle of the Empire. The region adopted the Protestant Reformation in the sixteenth century, and in the eighteenth century the Welf Electorate of Hanover inherited the British crown, a personal union that ended in 1837; after the Napoleonic Wars the Congress of Vienna of 1815 recast the country into the Kingdom of Hanover, the Grand Duchy of Oldenburg and the free cities of Hamburg and Bremen.
zh: 下萨克森人是德国西北部平原——汉堡、施塔德、奥尔登堡一带易北河与威悉河下游的沼泽和荒原——讲低地德语的居民，是民族大迁徙时代定居于此的古撒克逊人的后裔。查理大帝在772至804年的萨克森战争中征服他们，将其土地并入帝国，后来这里形成萨克森部落公国，公爵捕鸟者亨利于919年登上德意志王位。此地先后由比隆家族和韦尔夫家族统治；1180年皇帝腓特烈一世废黜狮子亨利，旧公国瓦解，1235年韦尔夫家族的孩童奥托受封新的不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公国，本地区后来的韦尔夫邦国都由它分出。他们的西低地德语源自古撒克逊语，其中古低地德语形态又是汉萨同盟的贸易通用语，经汉堡、不来梅等港口传播。13世纪末起，这些旧萨克森土地被称为下萨克森，1500年组建为帝国的下萨克森行政圈。该地区于16世纪接受新教改革；18世纪，韦尔夫家族的汉诺威选侯国继承英国王位，这一君合关系延续到1837年；拿破仑战争后，1815年维也纳会议把这片土地重组为汉诺威王国、奥尔登堡大公国以及汉堡和不来梅自由市。

en: The Lozi, or Barotse, are a Bantu people of the upper Zambezi, whose name means people of the plain after the vast Barotse floodplain they call Bulozi in what is now western Zambia. They are a composite of many tribes, with a Luyana core joined by the Kwanda, Bafwe, Bayeyi, Mbukushu and others under a single monarchy. The Lozi kingdom took shape in the seventeenth century under a paramount king titled the Litunga, keeper of the earth, and society became strongly hierarchical, with royal clans and titled indunas governing the floodplain villages. Life follows the Zambezi flood cycle: each wet season the court and villages move from the plain to higher ground in the Kuomboka migration, still the people's greatest ceremony. Their Silozi language already carried Sotho contacts before about 1830, when the Sotho-speaking Makololo under Sebetwane invaded from the south and conquered Barotseland, imposing a new ruling clique on the old kingdom.
zh: 洛齐人又称巴罗策人，是赞比西河上游的班图族群；“洛齐”意为平原之人，得名于他们称为布洛齐的巴罗策大泛滥平原，位于今赞比亚西部。他们是多个部落融合而成的民族，以卢亚纳人为核心，陆续并入宽达、巴夫韦、巴耶伊、姆库舒等部，共尊一个王权。洛齐王国于17世纪形成，最高国王称“利通加”，意为大地的守护者；社会等级分明，由王族氏族和有封号的贵族“因杜纳”治理平原上的村庄。生活随赞比西河的汛期轮转：每到雨季，宫廷和村落从平原迁往高地，即“昆博卡”迁徙，是洛齐人最隆重的年度大典。他们的西洛齐语早有索托语影响的痕迹；约1830年，讲索托语的马科洛洛人在塞贝塔内率领下自南方入侵，征服巴罗策兰，在旧王国之上建立了新的统治集团。

en: The Luba, or Baluba, are a Bantu people of the Upemba Depression and the surrounding savanna in Katanga, in the southern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Iron-working farmers had settled its lakes and marshes by the 400s, building dams and dikes for fishing and cultivation and trading dried fish, salt, copper and iron along routes that reached both the Atlantic and Indian Ocean worlds; by the 900s fishing, farming and metalwork sustained a stratified society. Around 1500 these communities coalesced into the Kingdom of Luba. Its oral tradition remembers the tyrant Nkongolo, whose capital was Mwibele, and the hunter Mbidi Kiluwe from the east, whose son Kalala Ilunga overthrew Nkongolo and became the ancestor from whom every sacred king, the Mulopwe, claimed descent; a court of nobles and the Mbudye men of memory sustained the state, and this model of government was borrowed by the neighboring Lunda. From 1700 the empire expanded through tribute rather than direct conquest, campaigning against the Songye in the 1700s and planting client fire kingdoms on its frontiers, the first of them founded before 1810 between the Lukuga and Luvua rivers.
zh: 卢巴人又称巴卢巴人，是刚果民主共和国南部加丹加乌彭巴洼地及周围草原的班图族群。早在5世纪，冶铁农人已在当地的湖沼间定居，他们修筑堤坝发展渔业和耕作，把鱼干、盐、铜器和铁器沿商路外销，商网远及大西洋和印度洋两个贸易圈；到10世纪，渔、农、金属加工并举的经济已支撑起一个分层社会。1500年前后，这些社群合并为卢巴王国。口传中，暴君恩孔戈洛以姆维贝莱为都，来自东方的猎人姆比迪·基卢韦之子卡拉拉·伊隆加推翻了他，此后每位神圣国王穆洛普韦都自称是卡拉拉·伊隆加的后裔；贵族会议和负责记诵历史的姆布迪秘社维系着国家运转，这套统治模式后来被邻邦隆达借用。1700年起，王国以索贡而非直接征服的方式扩张，18世纪曾出兵松耶人，并在边疆建立臣属的“火王国”，其中最早的一个于1810年之前立国于卢库加河与卢武阿河之间。

en: The Lucayo, or Lucayans, were the Indigenous people of the Bahamas and the Turks and Caicos Islands. Their own name, Lukku-Cairi, means people of the islands, and their word cairi for island lives on in the Spanish cayo and the English cay. They were a branch of the Taíno who began crossing from Hispaniola and Cuba in dugout canoes between about 500 and 800, spreading through the whole archipelago over the next eight centuries until they numbered perhaps forty thousand, living in linear coastal villages under matrilineal custom and farming cassava while drawing most of their protein from the reefs and shallows. In October 1492 they became the very first Americans encountered by Columbus when he landed at Guanahani, which he renamed San Salvador. Contact proved catastrophic: Spanish raiders seized the islanders for slaves and carried them off to the colonies, and by 1520 the Lucayo had been entirely emptied out of the Bahamas, one of the swiftest and most complete erasures of a people in the early colonial Caribbean.
zh: 卢卡约人是巴哈马群岛及特克斯和凯科斯群岛的原住民。他们的自称 Lukku-Cairi 意为“群岛之人”，其中表示“岛屿”的 cairi 一词演变为西班牙语的 cayo 和英语的 cay（礁岩）。他们是泰诺人的一支，约在500年至800年间乘独木舟从伊斯帕尼奥拉和古巴渡海而来，在此后八个世纪里散布整个群岛，人口一度达到约四万，沿岛岸建起线状分布的村落，按母系传统生活，种植木薯，同时从礁滩和浅海获取大部分肉食。1492年10月，哥伦布在瓜纳哈尼岛（他改名为圣萨尔瓦多）登陆，卢卡约人由此成为他遇到的第一批美洲人。接触带来了灭顶之灾：西班牙掠奴者把岛民成批掳往各殖民地充作奴隶，到1520年，巴哈马的卢卡约人已被彻底清空，这是早期殖民加勒比地区最迅速、最彻底的族群消亡之一。

en: The Luchazi, who speak the language of the same name, are the principal people of the Ngangela cluster of Bantu communities in eastern Angola, concentrated around Muié and the Moxico lands east of the Bié Plateau. Their speech forms a dialect continuum with Nyemba, Mbunda and Ngonzela, and Ngangela itself was a label coined in the 1700s by Ovimbundu traders and missionaries for the tribes of east-central Angola; each community kept its own language and social identity, with no overarching polity uniting them. They lived by subsistence cultivation, the rearing of small animals and gathering wild honey and fruit. Known to the Portuguese from the 1600s, they were drawn into the commerce of the Luanda and Benguela bridgeheads, first as victims of the slave trade through African middlemen and later as suppliers of wax, honey and ivory carried to Benguela by Ovimbundu caravans.
zh: 卢查齐人操同名语言，是安哥拉东部恩甘盖拉班图社群群中最主要的一支，聚居于比耶高原以东的穆耶及莫希科一带。他们的语言与尼恩巴、姆本达、恩贡泽拉等方言连成一体；“恩甘盖拉”本身是18世纪奥文本杜商人和传教士对安哥拉中东部诸部落造出的统称，各社群保有自己的语言和社会身份，并不存在统合各部的政权。他们以自给农业、饲养小家畜和采集野蜜、野果为生。葡萄牙人从17世纪起知道这些族群，他们先经非洲中间人之手被卷入罗安达和本格拉据点的商业网络，不少人沦为奴隶，后来又向奥文本杜商队供应蜡、蜂蜜和象牙，由后者运往本格拉。

en: The Lugbara are a Central Sudanic people of the West Nile country, living on both sides of the Albert Nile in northwestern Uganda around Arua and the adjoining Orientale Province of the Congo, with a few communities in southern Sudan. They speak Lugbara ti, a Moru-Madi language so close to Madi that some scholars treat it as a Madi dialect; its chief forms are the Ayivu, Maracha, Terego, Vurra and Aringa speech. In Madi oral tradition the Lugbara, whom the Madi call Lugbari, were the branch of the migrating Moru-Madi cluster that broke off in search of food before the Madi settled by the Nile, part of the southward movements that scholars place between roughly 1400 and 1700. Lugbara lands had no kings or kingdoms: chiefs headed autonomous chiefdoms, villages allied with their neighbors for defense, and every able-bodied man was liable to take up arms. Originally animists, they were settled farmers growing millet and sorghum and breeding guineafowl.
zh: 卢格巴拉人是西尼罗河地区的中苏丹语族群，散居在艾伯特尼罗河两岸，即乌干达西北部的阿鲁阿一带和毗邻的刚果东方省，另有少数人住在苏丹南部。他们说卢格巴拉语，属莫鲁-马迪语，与马迪语极为接近，有学者甚至将其视为马迪语的方言，主要方言有阿伊武、马拉查、特雷戈、武拉和阿林加五种。在马迪人的口述传统中，卢格巴拉人（马迪人称之为卢格巴里）是莫鲁-马迪群体南迁途中为寻找食物而分出去的一支，后来马迪人在尼罗河畔定居；学者把这波南迁大致定在1400至1700年间。卢格巴拉人的土地上没有国王和王国，只有酋长领导的自治酋邦，村落之间结盟自卫，凡健壮男子都有操兵器守村的义务。他们原本信奉万物有灵，以种植小米、高粱和饲养珍珠鸡为生。

en: The Luhya, or Abaluhya, are a cluster of more than twenty closely related Bantu peoples, among them the Bukusu, Maragoli, Wanga, Tachoni and Samia, living in the well-watered Lake Victoria basin of western Kenya around Mount Elgon, the Nzoia River and Kakamega, with kindred groups across the border in Uganda and Tanzania. Bantu-speaking communities ancestral to them were settled on the slopes of Elgon and along the middle Nzoia by around 1000. They combined shifting cultivation of sorghum, finger millet, cowpeas and bananas with cattle keeping, hunting and well-developed iron working, exchanging their produce through networks that reached the lake and eventually the coast. Most Luhya communities lived in decentralised clan polities ruled by councils of elders and ritual specialists; the exception was the Wanga, whose Nabongo kings built a centralised tributary court at Mumias and dealt with the neighbouring Luo, Nandi and Maasai. Around 1800 Maasai and Kalenjin raiders and expanding Luo groups pressed on their lands, sharpening competition between the clan strongholds.
zh: 卢希亚人（自称阿巴卢希亚）是二十多个亲缘班图族群的总称，包括布库苏、马拉戈利、旺加、塔乔尼和萨米亚等支，聚居在肯尼亚西部水源丰沛的维多利亚湖盆地，环绕埃尔贡山、恩佐亚河与卡卡梅加一带，同族群体还分布在乌干达和坦桑尼亚境内。约1000年时，他们的班图先民已定居埃尔贡山坡和恩佐亚河中游。他们兼营高粱、穇子、豇豆和香蕉的轮垦、牧牛、狩猎以及发达的冶铁制陶，产品经贸易网络远达湖畔，并最终通到沿海。多数卢希亚社群是分权的氏族政体，由长老议事会和仪式专家主持；唯独旺加人在纳邦戈国王治下于穆米亚斯建立了集权的纳贡朝廷，与邻近的卢奥人、南迪人和马赛人往来。1800年前后，马赛人和卡伦金人的袭扰以及卢奥群体的扩张逼近他们的土地，使各氏族据点之间的竞争更趋激烈。

en: The Lule were an indigenous people of the Gran Chaco, first encountered in what is now Salta Province of Argentina and the adjoining borderlands of Bolivia and Paraguay. Divided into bands such as the Esistiné, Tokistiné and Oristiné, they lived mainly by hunting and gathering, though they also planted maize, potatoes and quinoa, and the sedentary villages west of Salta kept llama herds under strong Andean influence. Pressed by the Wichí, many drifted south into Tucumán and Santiago del Estero. Their language, Lule, forms a small family with Vilela. From 1670 the Jesuits gathered them into the mission of San José de Lules, and after the 1708 Chaco campaign of Governor Esteban de Urízar, four hundred Lules were settled at San Juan Bautista de Balbuena, moved in 1715 to San Esteban de Miraflores on the Salado River. The mission was sacked in the rising of 1728, rebuilt in 1752, and after the Jesuit expulsion of 1768 it passed to the Franciscans before being abandoned early in the nineteenth century.
zh: 卢莱人是大查科地区的原住民，最早见于今阿根廷萨尔塔省及玻利维亚、巴拉圭毗邻地带。他们分成埃西斯蒂内、托基斯蒂内、奥里斯蒂内等支派，以狩猎采集为主，也种植玉米、马铃薯和藜麦；萨尔塔以西的定居民众受到强烈的安第斯文化影响，饲养羊驼。在维奇人的压力下，许多人向南迁入图库曼和圣地亚哥-德尔埃斯特罗。他们的卢莱语与比莱拉语共同构成一个小语系。1670年起，耶稣会把他们集中到圣何塞-德卢莱传教区；1708年图库曼省长埃斯特万·德·乌里萨尔发动查科征讨后，四百名卢莱人被安置在圣胡安·包蒂斯塔·德·巴尔武埃纳，1715年又迁至萨拉多河畔的圣埃斯特万·德·米拉弗洛雷斯。该传教区在1728年的起义中被毁，1752年重建；1768年耶稣会被驱逐后转交方济各会，到19世纪初最终废弃。

en: The Lhaq'temish, better known as the Lummi and called 'people of the sea', are a Coast Salish people of the straits and islands south of the Fraser delta in present-day Washington State, speaking a North Straits Salish dialect closely related to those of Vancouver Island. Their seasonal villages and reef-net fishing stations stood on the San Juan, Orcas, Lummi and Fidalgo islands, and they traded camas bulbs and dried berries along the coast; their population around 1780 has been estimated at roughly one thousand. From the 1770s smallpox and raids by musket-armed northern tribes drove them from the islands to the lower Nooksack River on the mainland, where they built stockaded villages and absorbed the local Hulwhaluq and Skalakhan groups. The long cycle of coastal raiding ended in 1821, an event later remembered in Lummi canoe gatherings.
zh: 卢米人自称拉赫特米什，意为‘海民’，是沿海萨利什人的一支，活动在今华盛顿州弗雷泽三角洲以南的海峡与群岛，所说的北海峡萨利什方言与温哥华岛诸部的方言相近。他们的季节性村落和礁网渔场设在圣胡安、奥卡斯、卢米和菲达尔戈等岛屿，并以卡马夏球茎和干果在沿海贸易；据估计1780年前后人口约有一千。1770年代起，天花和北方持火枪部落的劫掠把他们从群岛逼到大陆上的努克萨克河下游，在那里筑起栅栏村落，并同化了当地的赫尔瓦卢克和斯卡拉坎两支居民。沿海部落间漫长的劫掠循环于1821年终结，后来卢米人的独木舟集会一直纪念此事。

en: The Chorote, who also call themselves Yofuasha or Lumnana, are a Gran Chaco people of the Pilcomayo River in the borderlands of present-day Argentina, Paraguay and Bolivia. Chorote itself is an outside name, probably given by the Chiriguano Guaraní, and the people divide into riverine and forest groups, the latter including the Manjui. Their speech forms the Chorote branch of the Mataguayan family. Until the later 1600s they held the right bank of the middle Bermejo, when colonial punitive expeditions drove them north to the Pilcomayo. Semi-nomadic hunter-gatherers who also fished and grew maize, cassava and squash, they lived in exogamous extended-family bands under leaders who ruled by consensus, traded fish, shell ornaments and textiles with the Nivaclé and Wichí, and kept a spring carob festival of renewal.
zh: 乔罗特人也自称约夫阿沙或卢姆纳纳，是皮科马约河一带的大查科族群，分布在今阿根廷、巴拉圭和玻利维亚三国交界地区。乔罗特本是外来称呼，可能出自奇里瓜诺瓜拉尼人；他们内部分为河畔支与林地支，后者包括曼胡伊人。他们的语言构成马塔瓜约语族下的乔罗特语支。17世纪下半叶以前，他们还居住在贝尔梅霍河中游右岸，殖民时期的讨伐远征把他们向北赶到皮科马约河。他们是半游牧的狩猎采集者，也从事渔捞，种植玉米、木薯和南瓜，生活在实行外婚制的扩大家庭支群里，首领靠共识和慷慨服众；他们与尼瓦克莱人、韦奇人交换鱼、贝饰和织物，并在春季举行象征更新的角豆节。

en: The Lunda, or Balunda, are a Bantu people whose heartland lies along the Kalanyi River in Katanga, in the south of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, spreading west into eastern Angola and south into Zambia. In the 1600s they built the Kingdom of Lunda under the paramount title Mwata Yamvo, ruling from the royal capital of Musumba, enclosed by a moat and earthen walls. Tradition traces the ruling house to the marriage of the Luba prince Tshibinda Ilunga with the Lunda princess Lueji A'Nkonde, while the first historically attested king, Nawej, reigned from about 1695. By 1680 the kingdom covered some 150,000 square kilometres, campaigns in the 1720s carried its power beyond the Kasai River, and the chief Mwata Kazembe founded an eastern Lunda state in the Luapula valley. It became a commonwealth of autonomous chiefdoms bound by tribute, whose fishermen and farmers sold ivory and slaves to Portuguese and Swahili merchants. By the early 1800s the gun-armed Chokwe were already pressing on its western lands, foreshadowing the empire's collapse.
zh: 隆达人又称巴隆达人，是班图族群，故土在今刚果民主共和国南部加丹加的卡拉尼河沿岸，后向西扩展到安哥拉东部，向南进入赞比亚。17世纪，他们以姆瓦塔·扬沃为最高君主称号建立隆达王国，王都穆松巴外有壕沟和土墙环绕。口传将王室追溯到卢巴王子奇宾达·伊隆加与隆达公主卢埃吉·恩孔代的联姻，而第一位有可靠史实佐证的国王纳韦吉约于1695年即位。到1680年，王国版图已约达15万平方公里；18世纪20年代的远征把势力推进到开赛河以西，首领姆瓦塔·卡曾贝则在卢阿普拉河谷建立了东隆达国家。隆达由此成为由多个自治酋长国以纳贡联结的联盟，渔农并作的国人把象牙和奴隶卖给葡萄牙和斯瓦希里商人。到19世纪初，手持火器的绍奎人已经进逼其西部边境，预示了帝国的衰落。

en: The Luo are a family of Western Nilotic peoples, including the Shilluk and Anuak of South Sudan, the Acholi, Alur and Padhola of Uganda, and the Joluo of western Kenya and northern Tanzania, who speak related Luo languages and trace their origins to the Bahr el Ghazal region of South Sudan. From the early centuries of the second millennium their southern branches drifted south through Uganda, a journey preserved in many clan genealogies; in the mid-fifteenth century the chief Nyikango led one branch north along the Nile to found the Shilluk kingdom. The groups entering Kenya came in several waves, the first, the Joka Jok, settling at Ramogi Hill near Lake Victoria around 1490 to 1517, with the Jok'Owiny and Jok'Omolo following between 1598 and 1625. They mixed with, absorbed or displaced older Bantu and Southern Nilotic communities, building stone-walled homesteads such as Thimlich Ohinga. Cattle herders, cultivators and fishermen, the Luo lived in decentralised clans and villages under elders and hereditary ruoth chiefs, and by the seventeenth century their lands ringed the northern and eastern shores of Lake Victoria.
zh: 卢奥人是西尼罗河语诸族的统称，包括南苏丹的希卢克人和阿努阿克人，乌干达的阿乔利人、阿卢尔人和帕多拉人，以及肯尼亚西部和坦桑尼亚北部的乔卢奥人；他们操亲属语言，共同起源于南苏丹的加扎勒河流域。从第二个千年的最初几个世纪起，南支卢奥人取道乌干达陆续南迁，许多氏族谱系都保留了这段历程；15世纪中叶，酋长尼坎戈率一支北迁尼罗河畔，建立希卢克王国。进入肯尼亚的支系分数波而来：最早的乔克—乔克人约在1490—1517年定居维多利亚湖附近的拉莫吉山，乔克—奥温人、乔克—奥莫洛人随后在1598—1625年抵达。他们与更早定居的班图人和南尼罗河语族群通婚、融合或将其排挤，并修建了蒂姆利赫—奥欣加一类的石墙聚落。卢奥人牧牛、耕种兼渔猎，社会以氏族和村庄为单位，由长老和世袭的鲁奥特酋长松散治理；到17世纪，他们的土地已环绕维多利亚湖的北岸与东岸。

en: The Lurs are the Iranian tribal people of the Zagros, spread from Lorestan into Khuzestan and the Bakhtiari mountains, and speak Luri, a Western Iranian language lying between Persian and Kurdish. They formed from Iranian newcomers blending with older inhabitants of the region, including the Kassites and Gutians, and some scholars argue the ancient Elamites were their proto-Lur forebears. The name Lur began as a geographical term for the land between Khuzestan and Isfahan and only became an ethnic label in the tenth and eleventh centuries; the geographer Hamdallah Mustawfi already described their distinctive tongue in the fourteenth century. From 1115 the Hazaraspid atabegs ruled Greater Lorestan from Idaj, holding the Zagros roads through the Saljuq and Ilkhanid eras, and Yusuf Shah II added Shushtar and even Basra in the first half of the fourteenth century, until Timur's son Shahrukh overthrew the last Hazaraspid in 1424. The tribes kept their semi-nomadic ways and adopted Shia Islam under the Safavids; around 1800 a mojtahed had to be brought from Karbala to teach the highland tribes orthodox practice.
zh: 卢尔人是扎格罗斯山区的伊朗语部落族群，分布从洛雷斯坦延伸到胡齐斯坦和巴赫蒂亚里山地，讲介于波斯语与库尔德语之间的西伊朗语卢尔语。他们由迁入的伊朗部落与当地更早的居民融合而成，后者包括卡西特人和古提人，一些学者还认为古代埃兰人就是原卢尔人的祖先。“卢尔”最初是胡齐斯坦与伊斯法罕之间一片地区的名字，10至11世纪才成为族称；14世纪的地理学家哈姆杜拉·穆斯图菲已记述过他们独特的语言。1115年起，哈扎拉斯普王朝的阿塔巴克们以伊达季为中心统治大洛雷斯坦，在塞尔柱和伊利汗时代扼守扎格罗斯的商路，优素福沙二世在14世纪上半叶攻取舒什塔尔，甚至一度拿下巴士拉，直到1424年帖木儿之子沙鲁赫推翻末代君主。各部落始终保持半游牧的生活方式，并在萨法维王朝时期改宗什叶派；1800年前后，当局还不得不从卡尔巴拉请来一位穆智台希德，向山地部落传授正统教义。

en: Lushootseed, once called Puget Sound Salish, is the Central Coast Salish dialect continuum spoken around the inland waters of Puget Sound, from the country of the Skagit and Snohomish in the north to the Duwamish, Puyallup and Nisqually in the south, perhaps by as many as 12,000 people at its peak. The Lushootseed-speaking peoples lived in permanent winter villages of cedar-plank longhouses, moving to seasonal camps for salmon fishing, berry gathering and root digging, and villages were linked by marriage, trade and the potlatch, in which hosts gave away wealth to establish rank. European diseases reached the sound in the 1770s, decades before sustained contact, which began when George Vancouver surveyed Puget Sound and claimed it for Britain in 1792. Maritime fur traders followed, Hudson's Bay Company men entered the sound in 1824 and built Fort Nisqually, its first European post, in 1833, and meanwhile northern raiders such as the Kwakwaka'wakw swept through Lushootseed villages carrying off slaves. The combined shocks of disease, trade and raiding had already transformed their world before American settlers arrived.
zh: 卢舒特西德语旧称皮吉特萨利什语，是中部海岸萨利什语的一条方言连续体，通行于皮吉特湾内水一带，北起斯卡吉特人和斯诺霍米什人的地方，南到迪瓦米什人、普亚卢普人和尼斯夸利人，鼎盛时使用者可能多达12000人。讲卢舒特西德语的诸族住在雪松木板长屋组成的固定冬村里，按季节外出捕鲑鱼、采浆果、挖块根；村落之间靠婚姻、贸易和散财宴联结，主人在散财宴上分发财物以确立地位。欧洲人的疫病在18世纪70年代就传到湾内，比持续接触早了几十年；1792年，乔治·温哥华测绘皮吉特湾并代表英国提出主权要求，持续接触由此开始。海上毛皮商人接踵而至，哈德逊湾公司的人员于1824年进入湾内，并在1833年建起欧洲人在这里的第一个据点尼斯夸利堡；与此同时，夸扣特尔人等北方袭击者横扫卢舒特西德人的村落掳人为奴，疫病、贸易和劫掠的叠加冲击，在美国定居者到来之前就已经改变了他们的世界。

en: The Luthighi are the Lotiga, also called the Okara, an Aboriginal Australian people of the northern Cape York Peninsula in Queensland. They spoke Luthigh, a Paman language of the North Cape York group that forms a single tongue with Mpalitjanh and differed only marginally from the speech of their Unjadi neighbours.
zh: 卢西格人又称洛蒂加人或奥卡拉人，是昆士兰约克角半岛北部的澳大利亚原住民。他们说的卢西格语属北约克角帕曼语群，与姆帕利詹语实为同一种语言，与邻族温贾迪人的语言也只有细微差别。

en: The Luvale, called Lwena or Luena in Angola, are a Bantu people of the upper Zambezi, spread over southeastern Angola and northwestern Zambia and closely related to the Lunda, Chokwe and Luchazi. Their oral tradition remembers a migration from the country north of Lake Tanganyika through the Congo basin, under leaders sprung from the dynasty of Konde Mateti; the chieftainess Lueji, who married the Luba hunter Tshibinda Ilunga and became queen of the Lunda, was of that line, and her brothers broke away to found their own tribes. Around 1747 Chinyama cha Mukwamayi established the Kakenge chieftainship near the Lumbala stream in Angola. In the 1700s the Luvale were the first Upper Zambezi people to welcome Ovimbundu caravans, exchanging slaves raided from neighbouring tribes for guns, cloth and jewellery, and they also levied tolls on passing traders. The commerce reached its height in the 1830s, when their raiding expansion brought repeated wars with the southern Lunda chiefships.
zh: 卢瓦勒人在安哥拉又称卢埃纳人，是赞比西河上游的班图族群，分布在安哥拉东南部和赞比亚西北部，与隆达人、绍奎人和卢查齐人关系密切。根据口传，他们的祖先从坦噶尼喀湖以北的故土出发，经刚果盆地南迁，王族出自孔德·马泰蒂一系；嫁给卢巴猎人奇宾达·伊隆加、后来成为隆达女王的卢埃吉就出自这一系，她的兄弟们则分裂出去自建部落。1747年前后，奇尼亚马·查·姆夸马伊在安哥拉的隆巴拉溪附近建立卡肯吉酋长国。18世纪，卢瓦勒人是赞比西河上游最早接纳奥文本杜商队的族群，用从邻邦掳来的奴隶交换火器、布匹和珠宝，还向过路商人征收通行费。这一贸易在19世纪30年代达到顶峰，他们为寻找掳掠对象而不断扩张，与南部的隆达诸酋长国屡次交战。

en: The Lwalwa, also called Balwalwa or Lwalu, are a Bantu people of central Africa settled in the Luiza territory of the Kasai region in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with related communities across the border in Angola. They speak Lwalu, also known as Khongo, a Bantu language placed in the Luban group, and occupy the southern edge of the Lulua country, beside the Mbagani, Kete and Salampasu. During the 1700s the expansion of the Luba empire scattered small Luban-speaking farming and hunting groups through these Kasai borderlands, which remained a country of stateless village communities rather than kingdoms. The Lwalwa are best known as carvers. Their wooden masks have elongated faces, angular noses, protruding mouths and half-closed rectangular eyes; a hole drilled between mouth and nose lets a cord fasten the mask to the dancer's face. These masks and their carved figurines are kept for initiation and other ceremonial dances.
zh: 卢瓦鲁人又称巴卢瓦鲁人或卢阿卢人，是中非的班图族群，定居在刚果民主共和国开赛地区的路易萨领地，在安哥拉境内也有亲缘社群。他们使用卢阿卢语，又名孔戈语，属班图语中的卢巴语支，居住在卢卢阿地区南缘，与姆巴加尼人、凯特人和萨兰帕苏人为邻。18世纪卢巴帝国扩张，把使用卢巴语支语言的小型农耕、狩猎群体驱散到开赛河边缘地带，这里因此始终只有没有王权的村社，没有产生王国。卢瓦鲁人以雕刻闻名：他们的木雕面具脸型修长、鼻子棱角分明、嘴巴前凸、双眼呈半闭的长方形，嘴鼻之间钻有小孔，可用绳索系在舞者脸上；这类面具与雕刻人像一起用于入会仪式和其他仪式舞蹈。

en: The Ma'anyan, or Dayak Ma'anyan, are an Eastern Barito Dayak people of central and southern Borneo, living along the upper Barito river and in the Tabalong and Balangan districts to the east of the Ngaju lands. Their language is the closest relative of Malagasy, the language of Madagascar: between roughly 50 and 500 AD, Ma'anyan-related people were carried across the Indian Ocean as labourers and slaves on Malay and Javanese trading ships, carrying their Southeast Barito speech to the island. Before the twelfth century the Ma'anyan had built their own realm, Nansarunai, in southern Kalimantan. Ma'anyan oral histories remember two invasions from Majapahit, called Nansarunai Usak Jawa, the destruction of Nansarunai by the Javanese; the kingdom had fallen by 1389, and its people scattered up the Barito into several sub-groups, some of which later fell under the influence of the Muslim Banjar sultanate. In later centuries they kept to rice agriculture and their elaborate funeral rites, led by shamans who also tended the sick.
zh: 马安亚人又称达雅马安亚人，是婆罗洲中南部的东巴里托达雅族群，居住在巴里托河上游以及雅朱人以东的塔巴隆、巴兰甘一带。他们的语言与马达加斯加岛的马尔加什语亲缘最近：约在50—500年间，与马安亚人同源的人群作为劳工和奴隶搭乘马来人和爪哇人的商船横渡印度洋，把东南巴里托语带到了马达加斯加。12世纪以前，马安亚人曾在南加里曼丹建立自己的王国南萨鲁奈。马安亚口述史保留了满者伯夷的两次入侵，称之为“爪哇人毁灭南萨鲁奈”；到1389年王国已然覆灭，族人沿巴里托河上游四散，分成若干支派，其中一些后来受到穆斯林班查尔苏丹国的影响。此后几个世纪里，他们以稻作农业和繁复的丧葬仪式为生活重心，仪式由兼治疾病的萨满主持。

en: The Maasai are an Eastern Nilotic, Maa-speaking people of the Great Rift Valley in what is now southern Kenya and northern Tanzania, and the southernmost of the Nilotic speakers, whose ancestors drifted south from the region of South Sudan; their Maa tongue is closest to the Lotuko languages. Semi-nomadic cattle pastoralists organised in some twenty local sections, or iloshon, among them the Samburu, Ilchamus, Laikipiak and Parakuyo, they built a warrior society armed with spear, shield and throwing club, and took from neighbouring Cushitic peoples the age-set system, circumcision and much vocabulary. As they spread through the Rift Valley they absorbed Southern Cushitic hunter-gatherer groups such as the Aasax, El Molo and Yaaku, and displaced older settled communities. From the late eighteenth century they competed for pasture with the related Kwavi, or Loikop; the long drought that began about 1800 peaked in the 1830s, bringing the Kenyan famine of 1836 and opening the Mutai, and around 1830 the long Iloikop wars between Maasai and Kwavi began.
zh: 马赛人是东非大裂谷一带的东尼罗河语族群，操马赛语，分布在今天肯尼亚南部和坦桑尼亚北部，是分布最靠南的尼罗语民族；先祖自南苏丹一带南徙，马赛语与南苏丹的洛图科语最接近。他们是半游牧的牧牛人，分成约二十个称为伊洛雄的地方分支，包括桑布鲁人、伊尔查穆斯人、莱基皮亚克人、帕拉库约人等，以长矛、盾牌和投掷短棍武装，形成战士社会，并从邻近的库希特人那里接受了年龄组制度、割礼和大量词汇。他们在裂谷地带扩张时，同化了阿萨克斯人、埃尔莫洛人、亚阿库人等南库希特渔猎族群，也排挤了更早定居的社群。18世纪末起，他们与亲缘的夸维人（洛伊科普人）争夺草场；约1800年开始的长期干旱在19世纪30年代达到顶峰，造成1836年肯尼亚大饥荒，开启了穆泰时期，约1830年，马赛人与夸维人之间漫长的伊洛伊科普战争爆发。

en: The Ma'ya are the coastal people of the Raja Ampat archipelago off the Bird's Head Peninsula of New Guinea, living on Waigeo, Salawati, Batanta and Misool in villages strung along the bays; on Waigeo they divide into the Kawe, Wauyai and Laganyan sub-groups. Their language, Ma'ya, belongs to the South Halmahera–West New Guinea branch of Austronesian and sits on the boundary with Papuan languages, with distinct dialects on each island. Ma'ya tradition places their origin in Kabui Bay on northern Waigeo and tells of seven sacred eggs, four of which hatched into the kings who ruled the Four Kings islands of Waigeo, Salawati, Sailolof and Misool. Islam reached the archipelago in the fifteenth century through contacts with Bacan, and after the sixteenth century the Ma'ya lands were tied to the Tidore Sultanate, whose four vassal rajas governed them. The Portuguese navigator Jorge de Menezes had already landed on Waigeo in 1526, and with the Dutch rise in the Moluccas the islands were drawn into the colonial sphere as Tidore's dependencies.
zh: 马亚人是新几内亚鸟头半岛外海拉贾安帕特群岛的沿海居民，村落沿湾散布于卫吉、萨拉瓦蒂、巴丹塔和米苏尔四岛；在卫吉岛上，他们分为卡韦、瓦乌亚伊和拉甘扬三个支系。其语言马亚语属南岛语系南哈马黑拉—西新几内亚语支，正处在与巴布亚语言的交界地带，各岛方言差异明显。马亚人的传说把祖源地放在卫吉岛北部的卡布伊湾，讲述七枚神蛋中有四枚孵出统治“四王群岛”——卫吉、萨拉瓦蒂、赛洛洛弗和米苏尔——的君王。15世纪，伊斯兰教经与巴占的接触传入群岛；16世纪以后，马亚之地与蒂多雷苏丹国紧密相连，由蒂多雷的四个附庸拉贾治理。葡萄牙航海家豪尔赫·德·梅内塞斯早在1526年即已登抵卫吉岛，随着荷兰在摩鹿加崛起，群岛又作为蒂多雷的属地被卷入殖民体系。

en: The Maba, also called the Bargo or the Wadai people, are Sunni Muslim farmers and pastoralists of the Wadai mountains in eastern Chad, with clans also settled across the border in Sudan; their language, Maba or Bura Mabang, became the state language of the Wadai Sultanate. From the fifteenth century their country was ruled by the Tunjur kingdom, but in 1635 the Maba clans answered the call of Abd al-Karim, overthrew the Tunjur king Daud and founded the Kolak dynasty, seating their capital at Ouara and making Islam the state religion even though most commoners kept older beliefs. For much of the seventeenth century Wadai paid tribute to Darfur until the kolak Ya'qub Arus withheld it and beat off Darfur's invasion, and his son Joda pushed the frontier southwards. After 1804 Sultan Muhammad Sabun turned Wadai into a caravan power: in 1805 he conquered and tributized Bagirmi, and a new route north to Benghazi opened about 1810, bringing coinage, chain mail and firearms. Instability followed Sabun's death around 1815, with six sultans rising and falling through the 1820s and 1830s as neighbouring Darfur pressed its claim to oversee the succession.
zh: 马巴人又称巴尔戈人或瓦达伊人，是乍得东部瓦达伊山区的逊尼派穆斯林农耕与游牧族群，部分氏族也定居在苏丹境内；他们的语言马巴语（本地称布拉马班语）成为瓦达伊苏丹国的官方语言。15世纪起，他们的家园受通朱尔王国统治，但1635年马巴诸氏族响应阿卜杜勒·卡里姆的号召，推翻通朱尔国王达乌德，建立科拉克王朝，定都瓦拉，并将伊斯兰教定为国教，而多数平民仍保留旧有信仰。17世纪的大部分时间里，瓦达伊向达尔富尔纳贡，直到科拉克叶尔孤卜·阿鲁斯拒缴贡赋并击退达尔富尔的入侵，其子乔达又把疆界向南推进。1804年后，苏丹穆罕默德·萨本把瓦达伊打造成商路强国：1805年征服巴吉尔米并迫其纳贡，1810年前后又开通了北上班加西的新商路，随之引入铸币、锁子甲和火器。萨本约在1815年去世，此后局势动荡，1820至1830年代间有六位苏丹轮番上台，邻国达尔富尔则趁机干预王位继承。

en: The Maba are the principal people of the southeastern peninsula of Halmahera, settled around Buli Bay and the coastal districts of Maba, Gane and Weda, with their center at the town also called Maba Sangaji. They speak Maba, known locally as Bicoli, an Austronesian language of the South Halmahera branch whose many local dialects carry a strong Ternate lexical legacy; the related Gane tongue is spoken along the southern coast. Farmers and sailors, they raised rice and spices in forest clearings and traded the produce of their coasts with the Moluccan sultanates. The sultans of Tidore ruled most of southern Halmahera through local chiefs bearing the title sangaji, and in the 1780s the Maba joined the south-east Halmaherans who backed Prince Nuku of Tidore in his long rebellion against Dutch rule.
zh: 马巴人是哈马黑拉岛东南半岛的主要居民，聚居于布利湾沿岸及马巴、加内、韦达等沿海地区，中心在又称马巴·桑阿吉的马巴镇。他们操马巴语，当地称比科利语，属南岛语系南哈马黑拉语支，方言众多，词汇深受特尔纳特语影响；南海岸的近亲族群则使用加内语。马巴人以务农和航海为生，在林地里开垦旱田种植水稻和香料，再把沿海物产运往马鲁古各苏丹国贸易。历史上，蒂多雷苏丹通过名为桑阿吉的地方酋长统治哈马黑拉南部的大部分地区；18世纪80年代，马巴人与哈马黑拉东南部各族一道，支持蒂多雷的努库亲王发动长期的反荷起义。

en: The Manche Ch'ol were a Ch'olan-speaking Maya people of the rainforests and river valleys between southern Peten, Lake Izabal and the coast of southern Belize, and they took their name from Manche, their largest village. They are regarded as descendants of the Classic Maya population of the southeastern lowlands, the builders of cities such as Quirigua and Nim Li Punit, who after the ninth-century collapse reorganized into small chiefdoms without a single king. Their towns, among them Nito, Paliac, Campin and Tzoite, grew cacao, annatto and vanilla rather than much maize, and their canoes linked them into a trade network running from the Itza capital of Nojpeten to the Spanish mission towns of Verapaz; the warlike Itza controlled the supply of salt and kept the Manche Ch'ol in a client relationship. Hernan Cortes crossed their thinly peopled territory in 1525, and coastal villages were soon granted in encomienda, but the inland settlements long stayed independent. From the early seventeenth century Dominican friars gathered them into mission towns, until Itza raids and epidemic disease broke the settlements up. Franciscans then called for conquest, and in the late seventeenth century the Manche Ch'ol were forcibly relocated to the Guatemalan highlands; by 1770 the people had effectively disappeared, the few survivors merging into the Qeqchi communities.
zh: 曼切乔尔人是说乔尔语的玛雅民族，生活在佩滕南部、伊萨瓦尔湖与伯利兹南部海岸之间的雨林和河谷地带，族名取自其最大的村庄曼切。学界认为他们是东南低地古典玛雅人的后裔，即基里瓜、尼姆利普尼特等城的建造者的后代；9世纪城市崩溃后，这些人重组为没有共主的小型酋邦。他们的村镇包括尼托、帕利亚克、坎平和措伊特，种植可可、胭脂树和香荚兰，玉米反而种得不多；独木舟把他们接入一张贸易网络，北起伊察人的都城诺赫佩滕，南到韦拉帕斯的西班牙传教镇；好战的伊察人垄断了食盐供应，使曼切乔尔人长期处于附庸地位。1525年，埃尔南·科尔特斯穿过他们人烟稀少的土地，沿海村庄很快被封为监护领地，但内陆聚落长期保持独立。17世纪初起，多明我会修士把他们集中到传教镇，伊察人的袭击和疫病又将这些聚落打散。此后方济各会修士主张武力征服，17世纪末曼切乔尔人被强行迁往危地马拉高地；到1770年，这支民族实际上已经消亡，少数幸存者融入了凯克奇人的社群。

en: The Macorix were one of the non-Taíno peoples of Hispaniola when Columbus reached the island in 1492, sharing it with the Taíno and the Ciguayo. Their name was a Taíno exonym meaning unfriendly people, and Spanish writers counted their tongue as one of the island's three distinct languages, divided into Upper Macoris on the north-central and south-eastern coasts and Lower Macoris in the north-west around Monte Cristi and Santiago. They seem to have been semi-sedentary fishermen and foragers whose presence predated the agricultural Taíno chiefdoms that came to dominate most of Hispaniola, and early observers found them much like their Ciguayo neighbours. Already in decline when the Spanish arrived, the Macorix language was moribund at the conquest and extinct by the end of the sixteenth century, as the people were absorbed into the encomienda system and the mixed colonial population.
zh: 马科里斯人是1492年哥伦布抵达时伊斯帕尼奥拉岛上非泰诺的族群之一，与泰诺人、西瓜约人同居一岛。他们的名字是泰诺语给的他称，意为“不友好的人”；西班牙人把马科里斯语列为岛上三种不同语言之一，又分为上马科里斯和下马科里斯两支：前者分布在中北部海岸及东南沿海，后者在西北的蒙特克里斯蒂和圣地亚哥一带。他们似乎是半定居的渔猎族群，其出现早于后来统治岛上大部分地区的泰诺农耕酋邦，早期观察者认为他们与邻近的西瓜约人十分相似。西班牙人到来时马科里斯语已在衰退，征服之后更是沦为死语，到16世纪末便告消亡，马科里斯人也被纳入监护征赋制，融入混血的殖民地人口之中。
