en: The Qúzhōu culture occupies the western end of the Jinqu basin, where the Changshan, Jiangshan and Wuxi rivers join to form the Qu River, gathering the streams of the borderlands of Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Anhui and Fujian, a region traditionally called the thoroughfare of four provinces. In the Spring and Autumn period this was the land of Gumie, whose seat stood at present-day Longyou; the Qin set up Taimo County there in 222 BC, and in 621 the Tang established Quzhou Prefecture, whose prefectural city was renamed Xi'an County in the ninth century. Guarding the Xianxia Pass route, its roads carried traffic between the Zhejiang coast, Fujian and Jiangxi. During the Southern Song flight of the 1120s, the Duke Yansheng Kong Duanyou brought the southern branch of Confucius's descendants to Quzhou, whose Kong family temple stands beside the one at Qufu as the only two of their kind. Under the Yuan it became Quzhou Route, renamed Longyou Prefecture in 1359 and Quzhou Prefecture in 1366. The Longyou merchant band, already visible under the Southern Song, reached its height in the mid-Ming as one of the empire's ten great merchant bands, dealing in paper, books and jewels under the Wanli-era saying that Longyou men were everywhere; it declined under the Qing. The local speech belongs to the Chu-Qu division of Southern Wu.
zh: 衢州文化地处金衢盆地西端，常山港、江山港、乌溪江在城边汇成衢江，接纳浙、赣、皖、闽四省边缘的溪流，历来素有四省通衢之称。春秋时期这里是姑蔑国之地，治所就在今龙游；公元前222年秦设太末县，621年唐代置衢州，9世纪咸通年间州治所在改名西安县。仙霞岭山路由此连通沿海与福建、江西。12世纪20年代宋室南渡，衍圣公孔端友随宋高宗南下，把孔子后裔的南宗安顿在衢州，孔氏南宗家庙与曲阜家庙并称全国两座孔氏家庙。元代这里为衢州路，1359年改龙游府，1366年又改衢州府。龙游商帮南宋时已初见端倪，明代中叶臻于极盛，龙游商人经营纸业、书业和珠宝，跻身全国十大商帮，万历年间有遍地龙游的民谚，入清以后才逐渐衰落。当地方言属南部吴语处衢片。

en: The Rabha are a Tibeto-Burman people of the Lower Assam plains, centred on Goalpara and the neighbouring Dooars, with smaller communities in the Garo Hills and southern Bhutan. They are divided into several named groups, including the Rongdani, Maituri and Kocha, and their society was historically matrilineal, tracing descent through women. Traditional life rested on rice farming, shifting hill cultivation, forest gathering and weaving. Their language belongs to the Bodo-Koch branch of Tibeto-Burman and is close to Garo; each Rabha group traditionally spoke its own dialect, while the speech of the Kocha group stands closer to Koch than to the other Rabha varieties.
zh: 拉巴人是藏缅语族群，居住在阿萨姆下游平原，以戈阿尔帕拉和邻近的杜阿尔斯为中心，在加罗丘陵和不丹南部也有较小的社群。他们分为若干有名号的支系，包括龙达尼、迈图里和科恰；传统社会行母系制，世系依女性计算。传统生计依靠稻作、山区轮垦、山林采集和纺织。拉巴语属于藏缅语族博多—库奇语支，与加罗语相近；各支系传统上讲自己的方言，而科恰支系的话比起其他拉巴方言更接近库奇语。

en: The Rakhine, or Arakanese, are a Theravada Buddhist Tibeto-Burman people of the narrow coastal plain west of the Arakan Mountains, whose language descends from Old Burmese but whose history faces the Bay of Bengal and the Indian Ocean trade rather than the Irrawaddy valley. Their chronicles carry the line of ancient Arakanese kingdoms Dhanyawadi, Waithali and the Lemro cities, and in 1337 the long-reigning King Min Hti ruled the Launggyet dynasty from his capital near the Kaladan river. Ava invaded and occupied northern Arakan from 1406, and the exiled king Min Saw Mon returned in 1429 with troops lent by the Bengal sultan to found Mrauk U, which remained a Bengali vassal until 1437. Mrauk U grew into the greatest Arakanese kingdom: Min Bin, who built the Shitthaung temple, repelled a Toungoo invasion in 1545 to 1547 and made Chittagong a tributary around 1542, and Min Razagyi joined Portuguese freebooters to sack Pegu in 1599. Ruling a mixed Buddhist and Muslim population, the Arakanese kings employed Muslim-style titles and fleets of Portuguese and Afghan sailors until the Mughals retook Chittagong in 1666. In 1785 the Konbaung king Bodawpaya overran Mrauk U and annexed Arakan to Burma, sending tens of thousands of Rakhine refugees into the Chittagong region by the end of the century.
zh: 若开人又称阿拉干人，是若开山脉以西狭长沿海平原上信仰上座部佛教的藏缅语民族，其语言源自古缅甸语，但历史朝向孟加拉湾和印度洋贸易，而非伊洛瓦底江流域。他们的史书记载了丹那瓦底、维沙利和莱姆罗诸城等古老阿拉干王国的世系；1337年时，在位的是统治隆耶王朝、在位极长的明梯王，王都位于加拉丹河附近。1406年起阿瓦入侵并占据阿拉干北部，流亡的明苏蒙于1429年借孟加拉苏丹的军队归国，建立谬乌王国，直到1437年仍为孟加拉附庸。谬乌后来发展为最强大的阿拉干国家：建造八万神殿的明宾王在1545至1547年击退东吁入侵，并于1542年前后使吉大港称臣；1599年，明耶娑基联合葡萄牙雇佣兵攻陷勃固。阿拉干诸王统治着佛教徒与穆斯林混居的人口，采用穆斯林式头衔，拥有葡萄牙和阿富汗水手组成的舰队，直到1666年莫卧儿帝国夺回吉大港。1785年，贡榜王朝的波道帕耶攻灭谬乌、吞并阿拉干，到该世纪末已有数万若开难民流入吉大港地区。

en: The Rama are a Chibchan-speaking people of Nicaragua's Caribbean coast, formed from several Indigenous communities who held the lagoons and river mouths between Bluefields and the San Juan at the time of European contact. While Spanish power settled over Pacific Nicaragua, this shore remained beyond its reach, and in the seventeenth century English privateers of the Providence Island Company built an alliance with the Miskito, arming them for raids on Spanish settlements and on weaker Indigenous groups. A written account of 1699 already describes a Miskito kingdom strung along the coast, and in the late seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries Miskito war parties raided as far south as Costa Rica, carrying off captives for the slave trade and reducing neighbours such as the Rama to clients. The British made this overlordship formal with a treaty of friendship and alliance in 1740, creating the protectorate known as the Mosquito Coast. Rama oral tradition holds that in the eighteenth century the Miskito gave them the island of Rama Cay in Bluefields Lagoon in return for help against the Naso, or Teribe, of Costa Rica. Retreating to that island and to scattered river villages, the Rama kept alive their self-sufficient life of subsistence farming, fishing and skilled navigation, their dugout dories earning them the name of the best boatmen on the coast.
zh: 拉马人是尼加拉瓜加勒比海岸使用奇布查语的民族，由欧洲人接触时代据有布卢菲尔兹至圣胡安河之间潟湖与河口的若干原住民社群融合而成。当西班牙势力统治尼加拉瓜太平洋岸时，这一带海岸仍在其掌控之外；17世纪，普罗维登斯岛公司的英国私掠船长与米斯基托人结盟，向他们提供武器，唆使其劫掠西班牙定居点和较弱的原住民群体。1699年的一份文字记录已描述了沿海岸散布的米斯基托王国，17世纪末至18世纪初，米斯基托战队南下远达哥斯达黎加，掳走人口卖为奴隶，把拉马等邻族降为附庸。1740年，英国以友好同盟条约正式确认这种宗主权，建立了名为莫斯基托海岸的保护地。拉马人的口述传统称，18世纪米斯基托人把布卢菲尔兹潟湖中的拉马礁岛赠给他们，以酬谢他们协助攻打哥斯达黎加的纳索人（即特里贝人）。拉马人退居该岛和分散的河畔村落，维持着自给农业、捕鱼和精良航海的生活方式，他们制造的独木舟使其赢得了海岸最佳船工的名声。

en: The Rao are a river people of the middle Ramu country in western Madang Province, Papua New Guinea. Their language, recorded as Annaberg in the older German colonial literature, belongs to the Ramu family of northern New Guinea.
zh: 拉奥人是巴布亚新几内亚马当省西部拉穆河中游地带的河畔族群。他们的语言在德属殖民时期的旧文献中记作阿纳贝格语，属于新几内亚北部的拉穆语系。

en: The Rapa Nui are the indigenous Polynesian people of Easter Island, the easternmost outpost of Polynesia, more than a thousand kilometres from the nearest inhabited island. Their ancestors, led in tradition by the chief Hotu Matuʻa, settled the isolated volcanic island between roughly 300 and 1200, and developed one of the Pacific's most distinctive cultures. Between about 1250 and 1500 they carved nearly nine hundred giant stone figures, the moai, as the living faces of deified ancestors, setting them on stone platforms called ahu, some crowned with red stone pukao, and later devised the rongorongo glyphs, a script still undeciphered. Competition between clans also fed the birdman cult of the god Makemake, whose annual egg contest at Orongo chose a sacred ruler for the year. The first European to arrive was the Dutchman Jacob Roggeveen on Easter Sunday, 5 April 1722; a Spanish expedition under Felipe González de Ahedo claimed the island in 1770, and James Cook and the comte de Lapérouse visited in 1774 and 1786. Rivalry between the island's clans was remembered in legends of the war between the Hanau Epe and the Hanau Momoko.
zh: 拉帕努伊人是复活节岛的波利尼西亚原住民，而复活节岛是波利尼西亚最东端的前哨，距最近的有人居住岛屿上千公里。传说中，他们的祖先在首领霍图·马图阿率领下，约于300年至1200年间定居这座孤悬海上的火山岛，发展出太平洋上最具特色的文化之一。约1250年至1500年间，他们雕凿了近九百尊巨型石像“摩艾”，视为神化祖先的活面孔，立在称作“阿胡”的石台上，有些还头戴红色岩石雕成的“普卡奥”；后来又创造了后人仍无法释读的“朗戈朗戈”象形符号。氏族之间的竞争还催生了信奉马克马克神的鸟人崇拜，每年在奥龙戈举行的取鸟蛋竞赛会选出任期一年的神圣统治者。最早到来的欧洲人是荷兰人雅各布·罗赫芬，他于1722年4月5日复活节那天登岛；费利佩·冈萨雷斯·德·阿埃多率领的西班牙探险队1770年宣布该岛归西班牙所有，詹姆斯·库克和拉彼鲁兹伯爵又分别于1774年和1786年造访。岛上诸氏族的对抗，则留存在长耳人与短耳人交战的传说中。

en: The Rappahannock are an Algonquian-speaking people of the Virginia tidewater and a peripheral member of the Powhatan Confederacy, dominant in the valley of the river that bears their name, where they kept thirteen villages with their capital at Topahanocke. English explorers met their chief on the James in May 1607, only weeks after the founding of Jamestown, and John Smith was brought to their capital later that year to be checked against memories of earlier raiders; in 1608 Smith mediated a feud between them and the Moraughticund. Colonial retaliation for the 1622 Indian massacre struck them in 1623, but they stayed out of the Second Anglo-Powhatan War of 1644 to 1645. Planter settlement along their river in the 1650s forced a retreat: chiefs deeded land to the colony in 1651, a boundary was imposed in 1662, and by 1669 the survivors, perhaps a hundred people, had withdrawn to the Mattaponi headwaters. They briefly joined Cockacoeske's revived Powhatan Confederacy in 1677, and in 1684, reduced to seventy souls, Virginia ordered them merged with the Portobago for protection against Seneca raiders; the later Rappahannock community descends from this fusion with the Portobago, Morattico and Doeg.
zh: 拉帕汉诺克人是弗吉尼亚潮水区的阿尔冈昆语民族，波瓦坦联盟的边缘成员，在以他们命名的拉帕汉诺克河流域居于主导地位，沿河拥有十三座村庄，首府在托帕哈诺克。1607年5月，即詹姆斯敦建立仅数周后，英国探险家就在詹姆斯河见到了他们的酋长；同年晚些时候约翰·史密斯被带到其首府，以核对他是否是早年袭击者的同族；1608年史密斯还调解了他们与莫劳蒂昆德人的世仇。1622年印第安人大屠杀后，殖民者于1623年发动报复，拉帕汉诺克人受到打击，但他们没有卷入1644至1645年的第二次英波瓦坦战争。17世纪50年代种植园主沿河定居，迫使他们后退：酋长们于1651年向殖民地出让土地，1662年边界被强行划定，到1669年幸存者约百人已退至马塔波尼河源头。1677年他们短暂加入科卡科伊斯克重建的波瓦坦联盟；1684年全族只剩七十人时，弗吉尼亚当局为防范塞内卡人袭扰，下令他们与波尔托巴戈人合并。后来的拉帕汉诺克社群正是这一融合的后裔，融合对象还包括莫拉蒂科人和多格人。

en: The Raramuri, whom the Spanish named Tarahumara, are the Uto-Aztecan people of the Sierra Madre Occidental in Chihuahua, holders of the ravine country around the Copper Canyon. Probably descended from the Mogollon culture, they once held most of Chihuahua but withdrew into the high sierras when Spaniards opened mines on their land in the early seventeenth century. The Jesuit Juan Fonte founded the San Pablo Balleza mission before the Tepehuan revolt of 1616 killed him and seven fellow missionaries, and the Parral silver strike of 1631 drew in more settlers and slavers. The Raramuri rose in 1648 and destroyed the San Francisco de Borja mission; afterwards the lowland bands accepted baptism while the highland bands kept fighting under leaders such as Teporaca, who was executed in 1690, and the wars of 1696 to 1698 ended in defeat. The Jesuit expulsion of 1767 handed their failing missions to the Franciscans. Long isolated in their canyons, the Raramuri kept their language and their famed tradition of endurance running across hundreds of kilometres of mountain trails.
zh: 拉拉穆里人被西班牙人称为塔拉乌马拉人，是奇瓦瓦州西马德雷山脉、铜峡谷一带沟壑之地的主人，属犹他—阿兹特克语系族群。他们可能是莫戈永文化的后裔，曾占据奇瓦瓦的大部分土地，17世纪初西班牙人在其土地上开矿后，便退入高山峡谷。耶稣会士胡安·丰特建立了圣巴勃罗·巴列萨传教站，却在1616年的特佩万人起义中与七名同会传教士一同被杀；1631年帕拉尔银矿的发现又引来更多移民和奴隶贩子。1648年拉拉穆里人起兵，摧毁圣弗朗西斯科·德博尔哈传教站；此后低地诸支接受洗礼，高地诸支则在特波拉卡等首领率领下继续战斗，特波拉卡于1690年被处死，1696至1698年的战争也以失败告终。1767年耶稣会被驱逐，衰败的传教站转给方济各会。凭借峡谷中长期的隔绝，拉拉穆里人保住了自己的语言，以及沿山道长跑数百公里的著名传统。

en: The Rawa are a mountain people of the Finisterre Range in northern Papua New Guinea, split into two groups, the Rawa and the Karo, living on opposite sides of the range. Their two dialects belong to the Finisterre branch of the Trans-New Guinea language family.
zh: 拉瓦人是巴布亚新几内亚北部菲尼斯蒂尔山脉的山地族群，分为拉瓦和卡罗两支，分别住在山脉两侧。他们的两种方言同属跨新几内亚语系的菲尼斯蒂尔语支。

en: The Refaluwasch, or Carolinians, are a Micronesian people whose home is the low atolls of the central and western Carolines, among them Puluwat, Pulusuk and Woleai, and who speak Carolinian, a Chuukic Micronesian language. Their name means people of the deep sea, and they were among the Pacific's most accomplished navigators, sailing inter-island sea-lanes from memory in large outrigger canoes and paying periodic tribute to Yap under the old sawei network. Their society was matrilineal, with men's meeting houses and a living built on fishing, taro and breadfruit. They had traded with Guam since ancient times, but the Spanish-Chamorro wars cut the link until the navigator Luito reopened it in 1778 and Carolinian canoes returned to Talofofo Bay for iron in 1788. After typhoons wrecked the atolls of Elato and Satawal, chiefs Aghurubw of Satawal and Nguschul of Elato led some nine hundred people in a hundred and twenty canoes to the depopulated island of Saipan in 1815, founding the village of Arabwal under Spanish permission; further groups from Lamotrek and other atolls joined them. By 1837 the Refaluwasch lived between their old Carolinian atolls and new Marianas settlements, still voyaging the sea roads between them.
zh: 雷法卢瓦什人即加罗林人，是密克罗尼西亚族群，故乡在加罗林群岛中、西部的低矮环礁，包括普鲁瓦特、普鲁苏克和沃莱艾等，使用密克罗尼西亚语族楚克语支的加罗林语。他们的自称意为“深海之人”，是太平洋最出色的航海者之一，凭记忆中的海上航路驾驶大型舷外浮杆独木舟远航，并在古老的萨韦体系下定期向雅浦纳贡。社会按母系组织，设有男子会馆，以捕鱼、种芋和面包果为生。他们早在上古时代就与关岛贸易，但西班牙—查莫罗战争打断了往来，直到航海者卢伊托于1778年重新打通航路，1788年加罗林独木舟又到塔洛福福湾换取铁器。埃拉托和萨塔瓦尔环礁遭台风摧毁后，萨塔瓦尔酋长阿古鲁布与埃拉托酋长恩古舒尔在1815年率约九百人、乘一百二十艘独木舟迁往人烟稀少的塞班岛，经西班牙人许可建立阿拉伯瓦尔村，拉莫特雷克等环礁的人群随后也来投奔。到1837年，雷法卢瓦什人同时生活在旧日的加罗林环礁和马里亚纳新定居点之间，仍航行在连接两地的海路上。

en: The Rejang are an Austronesian people of the cool Barisan highlands of southwestern Sumatra, chiefly in the upper Musi and Ketahun river basins of Bengkulu. Linguistic evidence suggests their ancestors crossed from Borneo, where their closest linguistic kin are the Bukar Sadong of Sarawak, and made their way up the Musi to settle the interior in several waves. In 1337 they lived in small upland hamlets of ten to fifteen houses, divided among five dialect groups each led by its own chief, with noble kutei families ruling through a customary-law system and reckoning descent through the male line. Their old religion peopled the forests and volcanoes with gods and goddesses, venerated the rice goddess Nyang Serai and treated the tiger as an ancestral spirit not to be harmed. The Rejang language forms its own branch of Malayo-Polynesian, split into five dialects of which the highland Rawas is considered the oldest, while Malay served for dealings with outsiders. Islam first reached them in the sixteenth century through Banten, Minangkabau and Acehnese traders and missionaries, and spread only gradually; the highlanders blended it with older customary law and ancestor-centered rites such as lighting coconut-husk torches for returning spirits at Eid.
zh: 拉让人是苏门答腊西南部巴里桑高地凉爽山区的南岛语系民族，主要聚居于明古鲁上游的穆西河与克塔洪河流域。语言学证据显示，其先民从婆罗洲渡海而来——与他们语言最接近的是砂拉越的布卡沙东人——分若干批次溯穆西河而上，定居内陆。1337年时，他们居住在只有十来户人家的高地小村，分成五个方言群体，各有首领；贵族“库泰”家族依习惯法体系进行统治，世系按父系计算。他们的古老信仰认为森林和火山中遍布男女神祇，崇拜稻神“娘丝莱”，并把老虎视为不可伤害的祖先化身。拉让语在马来–波利尼西亚语族中自成一支，下分五种方言，其中高地的拉瓦斯方言被认为最古老，与外界交往则使用马来语。伊斯兰教最早在16世纪经万丹、米南加保和亚齐的商人与传教士传入，传播过程十分缓慢；高地居民将其与古老习惯法和祖先仪式相融合，例如在开斋节点燃椰壳火把，为归来的祖先之灵照路。

en: The Rembarrnga, also spelt Rembarunga and recorded in older sources as Maiadi or Maieli, are an Aboriginal people of central Arnhem Land in the Northern Territory, in the country toward the Roper River. Their language is a non-Pama-Nyungan tongue of the Gunwinyguan family, divided into the Galduyh, Gikkik and Mappurn dialects, and its neighbours include Dalabon, Burarra, Ngalakan and Ngandi as well as the Kunwinjku and Kune dialects of Bininj Kunwok. Ceremony lay at the heart of their material culture: dancers carried sculpted animal figures built from a paperbark or grass core bound with bark-fibre string, and by moving with them took on the identity of the Ancestor being represented. The fibre figures known as djawurn-djawurn, made in the same manner but in human form, were left at abandoned campsites with a raised arm pointing the way the group had travelled.
zh: 伦巴恩加人又拼作伦巴伦加，旧籍中也记作马亚迪或马伊利，是北领地阿纳姆地中部、靠近罗珀河一带的原住民。他们的语言是非帕马-牛雅语，属贡温古语系，下分加尔杜伊赫、吉基克和马普恩三种方言，四邻的语言有达拉本语、布拉拉语、恩加拉坎语、恩甘迪语，以及比宁库沃克语的贡温朱方言和库内方言。仪式在他们的物质文化中居于核心：舞者手捧纤维编扎的动物塑像，塑像以白千层树皮或草为芯，用树皮纤维绳缠成，舞者随塑像起舞，便化身为所表现的祖先生灵。同类工艺制成的人形塑像“贾温-贾温”会留在废弃的营地，举起的手臂为后来者指明朝队伍离去的方向。

en: The Rendille are a Cushitic-speaking nomadic people of the Kaisut Desert and Mount Marsabit in northern Kenya, between the lands of the Gabra, Borana and Samburu. They trace their origins to Cushitic pastoralists who moved south from the Horn of Africa, living mainly from camels, sheep and goats and following the traditional worship of Waaq.
zh: 朗迪耶人是操库希特语的游牧民族，住在肯尼亚北部的凯苏特沙漠和马萨比特山一带，与加布拉人、博拉纳人和桑布鲁人为邻。他们的先民是从非洲之角南徙的库希特牧民，主要以骆驼、绵羊和山羊为生，信奉传统的瓦克神。

en: The Rhine Alemannic people speak the Low Alemannic dialects of Upper German along the Upper Rhine plain, from the Alsatian cities of Strasbourg, Colmar and Saverne across the river to the Baden Ortenau around Offenburg. Their speech, the Alsatian of the French side, is the Alemannic variety closest to Swabian and sits below the High Alemannic of the Swiss plateau. Their forebears were the Alemanni who overran the Roman Agri Decumates by 260 and made the Rhine valley their country until the Franks under Clovis defeated them in 496; their customary law was codified in the Lex Alamannorum around 720, and after the Treaty of Verdun of 843 the land belonged to the East Frankish realm. In the high Middle Ages Strasbourg and Colmar flourished as free imperial cities on the Rhine trade route, while Mulhouse tied itself to the Swiss Confederacy from 1466. The Reformation won many Alsatian towns, and even after the Edict of Fontainebleau of 1685 abolished Protestant privileges elsewhere in France, Alsatian Protestants kept their worship. Southern Alsace passed to France at the Peace of Westphalia in 1648 and the remainder, including Strasbourg, later in the same century, Mulhouse following only in 1798; the Alemannic vernacular nevertheless remained the everyday speech of town and countryside under French rule.
zh: 莱茵阿勒曼尼人讲高地德语中的低地阿勒曼尼方言，分布在上莱茵平原：从阿尔萨斯的斯特拉斯堡、科尔马和萨韦尔讷，越河到奥芬堡一带的巴登奥尔特瑙。他们的话在法国一侧称为阿尔萨斯语，是与施瓦本语最接近的阿勒曼尼变体，地势上低于瑞士高原的高地阿勒曼尼。其先民是260年攻占罗马十营领地的阿勒曼尼人，他们以莱茵河谷为家园，直到496年被克洛维率领的法兰克人击败；约720年，他们的习惯法被整理为《阿勒曼尼法典》，843年《凡尔登条约》后这片土地归属东法兰克王国。中世纪盛期，斯特拉斯堡和科尔马作为莱茵商路上的自由帝国城市繁荣一时，米卢斯则从1466年起与瑞士邦联结盟。宗教改革赢得了许多阿尔萨斯城市，即使1685年《枫丹白露敕令》在法国其他地区取消新教徒的特权，阿尔萨斯的新教徒仍得以保留自己的礼拜。1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》把南阿尔萨斯割给法国，包括斯特拉斯堡在内的其余地区也在同一世纪稍后并入，米卢斯迟至1798年才加入法国；尽管如此，阿勒曼尼口语在法国统治下仍是城镇居民和村民的日常语言。

en: The Rhine Franconians speak the West Central German dialect chain between the Sankt Goar line and the Speyer line, covering Rhenish Hesse, the Palatinate, the Kraichgau and Nassau, with Palatine German and Hessian among its best-known varieties. Its northern anchor is Mainz, the Roman Mogontiacum where Saint Boniface took the see in 747 and which became an archdiocese in 781; its archbishop-elector was Primate of Germany and archchancellor of the Holy Roman Empire, first among the empire's princes, and in 1455 Johannes Gutenberg printed his famous Bible there with movable type. The region also staged the Reformation's great scenes: Martin Luther defended his teaching at the Diet of Worms in 1521, and the Protestation at Speyer in 1529 gave the Protestant movement its name. South of Mainz the Electoral Palatinate, held by the Wittelsbachs from 1214 and ruled from Heidelberg, became a Calvinist stronghold whose Heidelberg Catechism of 1563 spread across Europe; its elector Frederick V accepted the Bohemian crown in 1619 and, as the Winter King, helped ignite the Thirty Years' War, and Louis XIV's troops ravaged the country again in the Nine Years' War of 1688 to 1697. War and poverty then drove thousands of Palatines to emigrate, above all to Pennsylvania, where their Palatine German survives as Pennsylvania Dutch among the Amish and Mennonites. The Napoleonic mediatisation of 1803 secularised Mainz and dissolved the Palatinate, and the Congress of Vienna in 1815 assigned the left bank to Bavaria as the Rhenish Palatinate and Mainz to Hesse.
zh: 莱茵法兰克人讲圣戈阿尔线与施派尔线之间的西中部德语方言链，涵盖莱茵黑森、普法尔茨、克拉赫高和拿骚，普法尔茨语和黑森语是其中最知名的分支。其北方重镇美因茨即罗马旧城莫贡提亚库姆，747年圣博尼法斯在此就任教座，781年升为总主教区；其总主教选侯身兼德意志首席主教和神圣罗马帝国大首相，位列帝国诸王公之首，1455年约翰内斯·古腾堡正是在这里用活字印出著名的圣经。宗教改革的大戏也在此地登场：1521年马丁·路德在沃尔姆斯帝国议会为自己的主张辩护，1529年的施派尔抗议则赋予新教运动“抗议者”之名。美因茨以南的莱茵普法尔茨选侯国自1214年起属维特尔斯巴赫家族，以海德堡为都，后来成为加尔文宗重镇，1563年的《海德堡教理问答》传遍欧洲；选帝侯腓特烈五世1619年接受波希米亚王位，作为“冬王”点燃了三十年战争，1688至1697年路易十四的军队又在大同盟战争中蹂躏此地。战火与贫困随后迫使成千上万普法尔茨人外迁，尤其前往宾夕法尼亚，他们的普法尔茨德语以宾夕法尼亚德语的形式保存在阿米什和门诺派社群中。1803年拿破仑主导的并吞世俗化了美因茨、解散了普法尔茨；1815年维也纳会议把莱茵左岸作为莱茵普法尔茨划给巴伐利亚，美因茨则归黑森。

en: The Riantana are a Papuan people of Kolepom Island off southern New Guinea, speaking the language also called Kimaam. Together with Kimaghama it makes up the Central Kolopom branch of the Trans–New Guinea family, one of the native tongues of the island's scattered swamp villages.
zh: 里安塔纳人是新几内亚岛南方科洛庞岛上的巴布亚族群，所说的语言又称基马马语。它与基马马语共同组成泛新几内亚语系的中科洛庞语支，是岛上分散的沼泽村落的本土语言之一。

en: The Rikbaktsa are a Macro-Ge-speaking people of the rainforest of northwestern Mato Grosso, and their self-name, built from words for person and human being plus a plural suffix, means the human beings. Neighboring Brazilians called them Canoeiros, the Canoe People, for their skill on the rivers, or Wooden Ears, after the wooden plugs that stretched their earlobes. Their traditional country covered a vast stretch of the Juruena River basin, from the Papagaio River in the south to the Augusto Falls on the upper Tapajos and between the Aripuana and Arinos rivers. Scientific and commercial expeditions had passed along those waterways since the 1600s without entering their forests, so the Rikbaktsa kept their autonomous, decentralized life untouched: slash-and-burn gardens of maize, manioc, yams, beans and cotton beside hunting, fishing and gathering. Boys passed into manhood through nose- and ear-piercing rites at the green maize and forest-clearing ceremonies, and their faith teaches reincarnation, with the virtuous returning as people or night monkeys, which they therefore never hunt.
zh: 里巴克察人是马托格罗索西北部雨林中的大热语支族群，其自称由表示“人”的词加复数后缀构成，意为“真正的人”。周边的巴西人因他们擅长行船而称之为“独木舟人”，又因他们用木塞撑大耳垂而称他们“木耳人”。他们的传统领地横跨茹鲁埃纳河流域的大片土地，南起帕帕加尤河，北至上塔帕若斯河的奥古斯托瀑布，介于阿里普阿南河与阿里诺斯河之间。自17世纪起，科学和商业探险队只沿这些水路经过，从未深入他们的森林，里巴克察人因此保持着自治而分散的生活：在刀耕火种的园圃里种植玉米、木薯、山药、豆类和棉花，同时狩猎、捕鱼、采集。男孩要在青玉米节和开荒节上经过穿鼻、穿耳仪式才算成年；他们相信轮回，认为有德之人会转生为人或夜猴，所以夜猴是他们从不猎取的动物。

en: The Ripuarian Franconians are the people of the Cologne Bay in the Rhineland, whose West Central German dialects form the Ripuarian group of the Central Franconian family. Their name goes back to the Ripuarian Franks, who from the 4th century settled around the former Roman city of Cologne; Ripuarian fighters served in the Roman army of Aetius against Attila at the Catalaunian Plains in 451, and the 7th-century law code Lex Ripuaria governed the country around Cologne, Bonn, Zülpich, Jülich and Neuss. The dialect area runs south of the Benrath line from Düsseldorf and Cologne to Aachen, and also crosses into eastern Belgium and the Dutch province of Limburg. Its most famous variety is Kölsch, the speech of Cologne, while Aachen and Bonn keep their own Öcher Platt and Bönnsch; more than a hundred local forms are separated by the bundle of isoglosses known as the Rhenish fan. Shaped by Latin, Low German, Dutch and French influence, Ripuarian remained the everyday speech of townspeople and villagers across the Rhineland, whose free imperial cities such as Cologne and Aachen grew rich on trade and church politics within the Holy Roman Empire.
zh: 里普阿尔法兰克人是莱茵兰科隆湾一带的居民，他们的西中部德语方言构成中部法兰克语族下的里普阿尔语组。其名源自4世纪起定居于罗马旧城科隆周围的里普阿尔法兰克人；451年，里普阿尔战士曾在埃提乌斯的罗马军中于卡塔劳努姆平原迎战阿提拉，7世纪的《里普阿尔法典》管辖的正是科隆、波恩、曲尔皮希、于利希和诺伊斯一带。方言区位于本拉特线以南，从杜塞尔多夫、科隆延伸至亚琛，并越境进入比利时东部和荷兰林堡省。最著名的变体是科隆的科尔施语，亚琛和波恩也各有奥赫普拉特和本施方言；上百种地方话之间由一组被称为“莱茵扇”的同言线隔开。受拉丁语、低地德语、荷兰语和法语影响的里普阿尔方言，始终是莱茵兰城镇居民和村民的日常语言，而科隆、亚琛等自由帝国城市也在神圣罗马帝国内凭借贸易和教会政治日益富庶。

en: The Rma, known in Chinese as the Qiang, are a Qiangic-speaking people of the high mountains on the eastern edge of the Tibetan plateau in northwestern Sichuan, above all the upper Min River valley around Maozhou, Wenchuan and Songpan, and their language has no traditional script. Peoples called Qiang appear in Chinese sources as early as the Shang oracle bones of the second millennium BC, when the Di-Qiang pastoralists of the western frontier were noted for cremating their dead. Over the centuries many of these groups were sinicized or merged into other Tibeto-Burman peoples, and by the Ming dynasty the name had narrowed to the non-Han villagers of the upper Min and Beichuan area from whom the Rma trace their descent. Chinese settlement at Maozhou from the fifteenth century and the frontier wars of the 1580s bound them closely to the Ming order. Rma society kept a shamanic, polytheistic religion centered on sky and mountain gods, white stones and spirit towers, with the sheep as its leading totem, and an epic tradition of the ancient battle against the Go people, after which the victors took the name Rma.
zh: 尔玛人在汉文中称羌，是聚居在四川西北部青藏高原东缘高山地带、尤以茂州、汶川、松潘一带岷江上游为中心的羌语支民族，本族语言没有传统文字。早在公元前第二个千年的商代甲骨文中，就有关于羌人的记载，当时西北边外的氐羌游牧部落以火葬闻名。千百年间，这些部众很多被汉化或融入其他藏缅语民族，到明代，羌这个名称已缩小为对岷江上游和北川一带非汉村民的称呼，今天的尔玛人正是他们的后裔。15世纪起汉人迁入茂州，16世纪80年代的边地战事又把他们与明朝秩序紧紧绑在一起。尔玛社会保留着萨满式的多神信仰，以天神、山神、白石和神塔为崇拜对象，以羊为主要图腾，并流传着羌戈大战的史诗：相传战胜戈人之后，胜利者便以尔玛为自称。

en: The Romagnol are the people of Romagna, the southeastern corner of northern Italy around Ravenna, Forlì, Cesena, Rimini and Imola, with kindred speakers also in San Marino and the Marche around Pesaro and Urbino. Roman colonies such as Ariminum were planted there from 268 BC along the Via Aemilia, and Ravenna became the capital of the Western Roman Empire in 402 and later the seat of the Byzantine exarch, until the Lombards overthrew the exarchate in 751. Their vernacular is Romagnol, a Gallo-Italic language forming one branch of the Emilian-Romagnol continuum; Dante already discussed the speech of Romagna in De vulgari eloquentia, and its first printed literary text, the Sonetto romagnolo by Bernardino Catti of Ravenna, appeared in 1502. In 1278 King Rudolf I ceded the region to the Papal States, but real power rested with local dynasties such as the Ordelaffi of Forlì and the Malatesta of Rimini. Cesare Borgia briefly built a Duchy of Romagna around 1500 before Pope Julius II reclaimed it, and the Peace of Cateau-Cambrésis of 1559 divided the land among the papacy, the Este and the Farnese.
zh: 罗马涅人是意大利北部罗马涅地区的居民，聚居于拉韦纳、弗利、切塞纳、里米尼和伊莫拉一带，圣马力诺以及马尔凯的佩萨罗、乌尔比诺附近也有相近方言的人口。公元前268年起，罗马人沿艾米利亚大道在此设立阿里米努姆等殖民地；拉韦纳于402年成为西罗马帝国首都，后来又是拜占庭总督的驻地，直到751年伦巴第人推翻总督区。他们的俗语罗马涅方言属于高卢-意大利语支，与艾米利亚语构成同一方言连续体的两支；但丁在《论俗语》中已讨论过罗马涅的语言，其最早的印刷文学作品是拉韦纳人贝尔纳迪诺·卡蒂1502年问世的《罗马涅十四行诗》。1278年鲁道夫一世将该地区割让给教皇国，但实权长期落在弗利的奥尔德拉菲家族和里米尼的马拉泰斯塔家族等地方王朝手中。1500年前后切萨雷·博尔贾一度建立罗马涅公国，不久教皇尤利乌斯二世将其收回；1559年的《卡托-康布雷西和约》又把这片土地分属教皇、埃斯特家族和法尔内塞家族。

en: The Latin culture represents the ancient Latins of Latium, the lower Tiber region around Rome, and the Roman people they became. According to tradition Rome was founded in 753 BC and the Roman Republic in 509 BC; originally only the Latin inhabitants of the city were Romans, but citizenship was extended to the other Italic peoples after the Social War and, by Caracalla's edict of 212, to every free inhabitant of the empire. Their Latin language, an Italic tongue of the Indo-European family, spread with the legions and colonies from the Italian peninsula across Europe, North Africa and the Near East, producing the literary Classical Latin of Cicero and Virgil alongside the everyday Vulgar Latin of soldiers, merchants and settlers. The Western Empire collapsed in the fifth century, but between the sixth and ninth centuries regional Vulgar Latin evolved into the Romance languages, including Italian, French, Spanish and Portuguese, while written Medieval Latin remained the common language of the Catholic liturgy, law, diplomacy and scholarship throughout Western Europe. In 1337 it was still the language of the Church, of universities and of almost all formal writing, and the citizens of Rome themselves continued to be called Romans long after the ancient empire had passed away.
zh: 拉丁文化代表的是古代拉丁姆地区、即罗马周边台伯河下游的拉丁人，以及由他们发展而来的罗马人。按照传统说法，罗马建于公元前753年，罗马共和国建于公元前509年；起初只有城里的拉丁居民才算罗马人，但经过同盟者战争，公民权扩大到意大利其他各族，到212年卡拉卡拉的敕令又把公民权授予帝国境内每一个自由民。他们的拉丁语属于印欧语系意大利语族，随着军团和殖民地从意大利半岛传遍欧洲、北非和近东，既产生了西塞罗、维吉尔所用的古典拉丁语文学语言，也存在于士兵、商人和移民日常所说的通俗拉丁语中。西罗马帝国在5世纪崩溃，但6至9世纪间，各地通俗拉丁语演化为意大利语、法语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语等罗曼语，而书面的中世纪拉丁语在整个西欧始终是天主教礼仪、法律、外交和学术的通用语言。1337年时，拉丁语仍是教会、大学和几乎一切正式写作的语言；而罗马城的居民自身，在古罗马帝国消亡之后很久也依然被称为罗马人。

en: The Romani are an Indo-Aryan people whose language and genetic heritage trace them to northwestern India, where their name may descend from the Doma, a caste of musicians and dancers. Migrating west in waves from about the year 1000 through Persia, Armenia and the Byzantine Empire, they were recorded in Constantinople in 1068 and had reached the Balkans and Crete by the fourteenth century. The Irish friar Symon Semeonis described Romani migrants at Candia in 1322, and around 1360 Corfu held a fief worked mainly by Romani serfs. As the Ottomans overran the Byzantine Balkans, many Romani settled in the towns of Thrace and Macedonia, while others moved on to western Europe, where reception hardened into expulsion edicts from 1416 and enslavement in Wallachia and Moldavia, whose first recorded Romani slave sale dates to 1385. Persecution ran into the eighteenth century, from the Dutch heathen hunts to the Spanish round-up of 1749, though individual Romani rose high, as when Ștefan Răzvan became prince of Moldavia in 1595. Their language, Romani, kept its Indo-Aryan core while absorbing Persian, Armenian, Greek, Slavic and Turkish words.
zh: 罗姆人是印度-雅利安族群，语言和遗传证据都表明他们起源于印度西北部，其名称可能源自古时从事乐舞的多姆种姓。他们约从1000年起分批西迁，经波斯、亚美尼亚进入拜占庭帝国；1068年君士坦丁堡的文献已提到他们，到14世纪其足迹已遍及巴尔干和克里特。1322年，爱尔兰修士西蒙·塞梅奥尼斯在干地亚记述了罗姆移民；约1360年，科孚岛出现了一个主要由罗姆农奴耕作的采邑。奥斯曼人征服拜占庭治下的巴尔干后，许多罗姆人在色雷斯和马其顿的城镇定居，另一些人继续前往西欧，迎接他们的却是1416年起接连不断的驱逐令，以及瓦拉几亚和摩尔达维亚的奴役，1385年当地已有罗姆奴隶交易的记录。迫害延续到18世纪，尼德兰有“异教徒狩猎”，西班牙则在1749年发动大搜捕；但也有罗姆人跻身高位，斯特凡·勒兹万于1595年成为摩尔达维亚大公。罗姆语保留了印度-雅利安语的核心，同时吸收了波斯语、亚美尼亚语、希腊语、斯拉夫语和土耳其语词汇。

en: The Romansh are the Romance people of the high Alpine valleys of Raetia, in and around the Grisons canton with its chief town Chur, their speech once reaching further into Vorarlberg and the southern Tyrol before Alemannic and Bavarian dialects pushed it back. Rome organised the land as the province of Raetia in 15 BC, and the Vulgar Latin of soldiers and settlers displaced the old Raetic and Celtic tongues by the fifth century, leaving the archaic Gallo-Romance language now called Romansh, whose earliest written fragments date from the tenth or eleventh century. In the Middle Ages the region was ruled by the prince-bishops of Chur until local communes formed the League of God's House in 1367, the Grey League in 1395 and the League of the Ten Jurisdictions in 1436; these united as the Three Leagues in 1471, allied with the Swiss Confederacy and helped defeat the Habsburgs at Calven in 1499. The leagues became a free state under the federal charter of 1524, the bishop lost his last jurisdiction in 1526, and the Reformation and the Bündner Wirren civil conflicts of 1618 to 1639 split the valleys between Catholic and Protestant communities, each preserving its own Romansh dialect.
zh: 罗曼什人是雷蒂亚高山谷地中的罗曼语族群，以库尔为首府的格劳宾登一带为家园；他们的语言一度远及福拉尔贝格和南蒂罗尔，后被阿勒曼尼和巴伐利亚方言逼退。罗马于公元前15年在此设立雷蒂亚行省，到5世纪时，驻军与移民的通俗拉丁语取代了古老的雷蒂亚语和凯尔特语，形成了今天称为罗曼什语的古老高卢-罗曼语言，其最早的文字残片可追溯至10或11世纪。中世纪时该地区由库尔的主教诸侯统治，后来地方公社于1367年结成上帝之家同盟，1395年结成灰色同盟，1436年结成十辖区同盟；三者于1471年联合为三同盟，与瑞士邦联结盟，并在1499年的卡尔文之战中协助击败哈布斯堡。三同盟凭1524年的联邦宪章成为自由邦，主教的最后管辖权于1526年被废除；宗教改革以及1618至1639年的格劳宾登动乱又使各谷地分裂为天主教和新教社群，各自保留了本地的罗曼什方言。

en: The Romaniotes are the Greek-speaking Jews of the Eastern Roman Empire, from whose name for that empire, Rhomania, their own is derived, and they count as the oldest Jewish community in Europe. A Greek inscription from Oropos of about 300 to 250 BCE already names a Jew, and the synagogue on Delos of the second century BCE is the oldest known in the diaspora; the Romaniotes of Ioannina preserve a tradition that their ancestors arrived after the destruction of the Second Temple in 70 CE. They developed their own Romaniote rite and a Greek dialect laced with Hebrew called Yevanic, and their devotional poems, the piyyutim, later entered the Ashkenazi festival prayer books through Italy. In the twelfth century Benjamin of Tudela found their greatest settlement at Thebes, with some two thousand Jews working in dyeing, weaving, silk and silver, and communities stretching from Corinth and Chalcis to Corfu, Crete and Cyprus. The first Romaniote synagogue passed under Ottoman rule at Bursa in 1324, and after the fall of Constantinople in 1453 Mehmed II forcibly concentrated most of the empire's Romaniotes in his new capital, where they formed a tenth of the population and long supplied the chief rabbis. The Sephardic exiles of 1492, speaking Ladino and swelling Thessaloniki, gradually absorbed the older communities in ritual and language, though distinct Romaniote congregations survived, notably at Ioannina and Chalcis, under Ottoman rule marked by such restrictions as Murad III's bans on fine houses and slaves.
zh: 罗曼尼奥特人是东罗马帝国境内说希腊语的犹太人，其名称得自东罗马帝国的自称罗马尼亚，被视为欧洲最古老的犹太社群。约公元前300至前250年奥罗波斯的一方希腊文铭文已提到一名犹太人，公元前2世纪提洛岛上的会堂则是已知流散地最古老的会堂；约阿尼纳的罗曼尼奥特人还保留着先祖于70年第二圣殿被毁后抵达的传说。他们发展出自己的罗曼尼奥特仪轨，以及一种混入大量希伯来语的希腊方言耶瓦尼语，其礼仪诗后来经意大利进入阿什肯纳兹人的节日祈祷书。12世纪图德拉的本雅明发现他们最大的定居点在底比斯，约有两千犹太人从事染布、织造、丝作和银器行当，社群则从科林斯、哈尔基斯一直延伸到科孚、克里特和塞浦路斯。1324年，布尔萨的罗曼尼奥特会堂最先被纳入奥斯曼治下；1453年君士坦丁堡陷落后，穆罕默德二世把帝国境内大部分罗曼尼奥特人强迁到新都，他们占到全城人口的十分之一，并长期出任各地首席拉比。1492年后说拉迪诺语的塞法迪流亡者涌入、壮大了塞萨洛尼基，在仪轨和语言上逐渐同化了这些古老社群，但在穆拉德三世禁止华宅和蓄奴等限制之下，约阿尼纳和哈尔基斯等地仍保有独立的罗曼尼奥特会堂。

en: The Romblomanon people are the Visayan-speaking indigenous inhabitants of the Romblon island group, lying between Luzon and Panay. They share the province with speakers of Asi and Onhan, but their own Romblomanon language, close to Hiligaynon, prevails on Romblon and Sibuyan islands, and most also speak Hiligaynon through trade with nearby Capiz and Aklan. The islands were first settled by Negritos from Panay and Mangyans from Mindoro, and ancient wooden coffins kept in the caves of Banton attest to a developed pre-colonial culture. Spanish explorers reached Romblon in 1569, and the islands were governed from Arevalo in Panay until 1716, when they passed to the province of Capiz. Under Spanish friars the islanders became mostly Roman Catholic.
zh: 朗布隆人是朗布隆群岛上说米沙鄢语的原住民，该群岛位于吕宋与班乃之间。他们与说阿西语和翁汉语的居民共居一省，但本族的朗布隆语与希利盖农语相近，通行于朗布隆岛和锡布延岛；因与邻近的卡皮斯和阿克兰贸易，多数人也会说希利盖农语。这些岛屿最早的居民是来自班乃的尼格利陀人和来自民都洛的芒扬人，班顿岛洞穴中保存的古代木棺证明这里在殖民时代之前已有发达的文化。西班牙探险者于1569年抵达朗布隆，群岛先由班乃的阿雷瓦洛管辖，1716年改归卡皮斯省。在西班牙修道士影响下，岛民大多皈依罗马天主教。

en: The Roon are an Austronesian-speaking people of Roon Island, the largest island off the northern tip of the Wandammen Peninsula, which reaches into southern Cenderawasih Bay from the Bird's Neck of New Guinea. They live in six villages on the island and speak Roon, a Cenderawasih Bay Austronesian language known only from short word lists.
zh: 隆人是南岛语族岛民，聚居隆岛——该岛是万达门半岛北端外岛群中最大的一座，半岛从新几内亚的鸟颈地峡伸入极乐鸟湾南部。他们分居岛上六村，使用的隆语属南岛语系极乐鸟湾语支，仅有简短词表传世。

en: The Rotenese are the Austronesian people of Rote Island, a dry savanna island southwest of Timor, with communities also on neighbouring Ndao and other islets and in West Timor. Their own traditions trace them to migrants from Seram in Maluku who reached Rote between the late 1200s and the 1500s, in the Majapahit era, when the first Rotenese rulers are mentioned; they also planted settlements on Timor, farming with slash-and-burn fields and irrigation. Rotenese, a Southwest Malayo-Polynesian language, splits into many dialects, among them Termanu, Dengka, Ringgou and Lole. Their old faith centred on the creator Lamatuan, symbolised by a three-branched pillar, and the horned ti'i langga straw hat remains the mark of Rotenese identity.
zh: 罗地人是罗地岛上的南岛语族群；罗地岛位于帝汶西南，气候干燥、遍布热带草原，罗地人在邻近的恩道等小岛和西帝汶也有聚居点。他们自称源自马鲁古的斯兰岛，于13世纪末至16世纪的满者伯夷时代迁来，罗地统治者的最早记载也出现在这一时期；他们还在帝汶建立定居点，以刀耕火种和灌溉农业为生。罗地语属西南马来—波利尼西亚语支，分为特尔马努、登卡、林古、洛莱等多种方言。他们的传统信仰以创世神拉马图安为中心，以三杈神柱为象征；顶部带角状凸起的蒂伊朗加草帽，则是罗地人身份的标志。

en: The Rotokas are the people of central Bougainville Island in eastern Papua New Guinea, speaking a North Bougainville Papuan language split into Central, Aita and Pipipaia dialects. Its Central dialect has one of the world's smallest sound systems, with only six consonants and no distinct nasals.
zh: 罗托卡斯人居住在巴布亚新几内亚东部布干维尔岛的中部，使用属北布干维尔语族的巴布亚语言罗托卡斯语，下分中部、艾塔和皮皮帕亚方言。其中中部方言拥有世界上最小的音系之一，只有六个辅音，没有独立的鼻音。

en: The Roviana are an Oceanic people of the New Georgia group in the Solomon Islands, dwelling on the barrier islands and shores around the Roviana and Vonavona lagoons. Their Northwest Solomonic language was once a widespread trade tongue and later the lingua franca of church work across the western Solomons. Central New Georgia is the cradle of Roviana culture, where a great complex of megalithic shrines was built from the thirteenth century. Between the fifteenth and seventeenth centuries the people moved to smaller offshore islands centred on Nusa Roviana, which grew into a regional seat of power through trade and headhunting raids launched in large war canoes. From the sixteenth century speakers of neighbouring Kazukuru merged into the Roviana and adopted their speech. In August 1789 John Shortland, sailing home in command of First Fleet vessels, gave the main island its name, New Georgia.
zh: 罗维阿纳人是所罗门群岛新乔治亚群岛上说大洋洲语的族群，散居在罗维阿纳潟湖与沃纳沃纳潟湖一带的障壁岛和沿岸地带。他们的语言属西北所罗门语支，曾是广泛通行的贸易语言，后来又成为所罗门群岛西部教会活动的通用语。新乔治亚岛中部是罗维阿纳文化的摇篮，13世纪起当地兴建了庞大的巨石神坛建筑群。15至17世纪间，罗维阿纳人迁往以努萨罗维阿纳为中心的近海岛礁，凭借贸易和乘坐大战独木舟发动的猎头远征，使那里成为区域权力中心。从16世纪起，邻近卡祖库鲁语的使用者逐渐并入罗维阿纳人，改用了他们的语言。1789年8月，约翰·肖特兰率领第一舰队的船只返航英国途中经过此地，将主岛命名为新乔治亚岛。

en: The Rukwa are the Bantu communities of southwestern Tanzania and northern Malawi whose related languages make up Guthrie's Zone M, among them Fipa, Nyakyusa, Safwa, Wanda, Pimbwe and Bungu. On the largely treeless Ufipa Plateau overlooking Lake Tanganyika, the Fipa built a stratified society of iron-smelting clans: the old Milansi dynasty of smiths exchanged its iron for woven cloth before an immigrant Twa clan made itself the ruling aristocracy, and by the early nineteenth century the chiefdom of Nkansi ran a court with a prime minister, a queen mother holding her own estate and elected village headmen, giving the plateau sharply defined borders and a real state of its own. At Ivuna, on the salt flats southeast of Lake Rukwa, Iron Age pottery marks salt workings that had traded their produce from before 1200 into the fifteenth century. East of the plateau, in the wet mountains at the northern end of Lake Malawi, lived the Nyakyusa, whose Ngonde, Kukwe and Selya dialects spread across the border into the Karonga district of Malawi.
zh: 鲁夸人是对坦桑尼亚西南部和马拉维北部一批班图社群的统称，他们关系相近的语言构成格思里分区的M区，主要有菲帕语、尼亚库萨语、萨夫瓦语、旺达语、平布韦语和本古语。在俯瞰坦噶尼喀湖、几乎没有树木的乌菲帕高原上，菲帕人建立了由冶铁氏族组成的等级社会：古老的米兰齐铁匠王朝用铁器交换织布，后来一个迁入的特瓦氏族成为统治贵族；到19世纪初，坎西酋长国的宫廷已设有首相、拥有独立地产的王太后和民选村长，使高原有了清晰的边界和名副其实的国家。鲁夸湖东南的伊武纳盐滩出土了铁器时代陶器，那里的盐场从1200年以前一直生产到15世纪。高原以东、马拉维湖北端湿润的山区住着尼亚库萨人，他们的恩贡德、库克韦和塞利亚方言越过边界，传到马拉维的卡龙加县。

en: The Rumu, also recorded as Kairi or Dumu, are a people of the forested river country between the Turama and Kikori rivers in the Gulf Province of southern New Guinea. Their speech is a strongly divergent member of the Turama–Kikorian family of Papuan languages, set apart from the Omati and Ikobi tongues of its neighbours.
zh: 卢穆人又被记作凯里人或杜穆人，住在新几内亚南部海湾省图拉马河与基科里河之间森林密布的河川地带。他们的卢穆语是图拉马-基科里语族中分歧极大的成员，与邻近的奥马蒂语和伊科比语明显有别。

en: The Runga are a Muslim people of the borderlands where Chad, Sudan and the Central African Republic meet, in the dry country between the Salamat, Aouk and Kara rivers. They form a composite society split by tongue into Arabic-speaking Runga and the Runga-Aiki who speak the Aiki language, usually with Arabic as a second language, yet the two halves share a single culture. Their country was organized as the Sultanate of Dar Runga, which by the reign of the Wadai ruler Muhammad Sabun, between 1804 and 1815, had been brought under Wadai's sway as a tributary state; it also served Darfur as a favoured hunting ground for slaves. The Runga homeland remained a prize of the Wadai-Darfur rivalry until the warlord Rabih az-Zubayr overran it at the end of the nineteenth century.
zh: 龙加人是生活在乍得、苏丹与中非共和国交界地带的穆斯林族群，分布在萨拉马特河、奥克河与卡拉河之间的干旱地区。他们是一个复合社会，按语言分为讲乍得阿拉伯语的龙加人和讲艾基语（通常兼通阿拉伯语）的龙加—艾基人，两部分却共有同一种文化。他们的家园曾组成达尔龙加苏丹国；在瓦达伊君主穆罕默德·萨本在位的1804至1815年间，它沦为瓦达伊的附庸国，同时也是达尔富尔偏美的猎奴之地。在此后瓦达伊与达尔富尔的争霸中，龙加人的家园一直是双方争夺的猎物，直到19世纪末被军阀拉巴赫·祖拜尔攻灭。

en: The Rusyns are the East Slavic highlanders of the Eastern Carpathians, the valleys around Uzhhorod and Mukachevo that in 1337 belonged to the Kingdom of Hungary. They grew from several waves of Slavic settlers between the eighth and seventeenth centuries, among them White Croats and Rus' migrants from Galicia and Podolia joined by Vlach shepherds, and are divided into highland groups such as the Boykos, Hutsuls and Lemkos. Until the eleventh century their mountains were a thinly held no-man's-land between Kievan Rus' and Hungary, and the Mongol army of Batu Khan swept through the Veretski Pass in 1241, burning villages and emptying the valleys. In 1396 the exiled Lithuanian prince Theodor Koriatovich made Mukachevo his seat, built up its castle and founded an Orthodox monastery, drawing a fresh Ruthenian migration from Podolia. Under Hungarian rule much of the population later entered the Greek Catholic Church while keeping its Eastern rite and Rusyn speech, and by the time of the Partitions of Poland in 1772 the Carpathian lands were under the Habsburg monarchy.
zh: 卢森尼亚人是东喀尔巴阡山的东斯拉夫山民，聚居在乌日霍罗德和穆卡切沃一带的山谷里，1337年时属匈牙利王国。他们来自8世纪至17世纪间数批斯拉夫移民，包括白克罗地亚人、从加利西亚和波多利亚迁入的罗斯人，以及瓦拉几亚牧人，又分成博伊科人、胡楚尔人、莱姆科人等山地支系。直到11世纪，这片山区仍是基辅罗斯与匈牙利之间人烟稀少的两不管地带；1241年拔都的蒙古军经韦列茨基山口涌入，焚毁村庄、使山谷人口一空。1396年，流亡的立陶宛王公费奥多尔·科里亚托维奇以穆卡切沃为据点，修筑城堡、建立东正教修道院，并引来波多利亚的鲁塞尼亚人再度迁入。匈牙利统治时期，许多居民后来加入希腊礼天主教会，同时保留东方礼仪和卢森尼亚语；1772年波兰第一次瓜分时，喀尔巴阡诸地已处在哈布斯堡君主国治下。

en: The Rutara peoples, who call themselves the Banyakitara, are a cluster of closely related Bantu communities of the African Great Lakes region; they include the Banyoro, Batooro, Banyankore and Bahaya, and their dialects are mutually intelligible. Their Proto-Rutara ancestors kept cattle in the Kagera grasslands near Bukoba from about the year 500, learning pastoralism from neighboring Cushitic and Eastern Sudanic peoples. After 1200 a northern branch expanded northwest into the grasslands of western Uganda, absorbing older Central Sudanic populations and opening the era remembered in oral tradition as the age of the Batembuzi and Bachwezi; the great earthworks at Bigo bya Mugenyi and the brine salt gardens of Kibiro belong to this early Kitara world. From it arose the Kingdom of Bunyoro, where the Babiito dynasty took power in the late sixteenth century and made Bunyoro the leading power of the western lakes for two centuries. Its dominance faded in the late eighteenth century, when Buganda seized Kooki and Buddu, and in the 1830s Tooro broke away, taking the profitable salt works with it.
zh: 鲁塔拉人自称巴尼亚基塔拉，是非洲大湖地区一群关系密切的班图族群的统称，包括巴尼奥罗人、巴托罗人、巴尼扬科莱人和巴哈亚人，各方言彼此可以互通。他们的原始鲁塔拉先民约在公元500年起在布科巴附近的卡盖拉草原牧牛，从邻近的库希特人和东苏丹人那里学会了游牧生计。1200年以后，北支向西北扩张，进入乌干达西部草原，同化了当地更古老的中苏丹人，开启了口传传统中巴特姆布齐与巴赫韦齐相继称雄的时代；穆盖尼的比戈大型土筑遗址和基比罗的咸泉盐田都属于这个早期基塔拉世界。布尼奥罗王国由此兴起，巴比托王朝于16世纪末掌权，在此后两个世纪里使布尼奥罗成为西部湖区的头等强国。它的霸权在18世纪末衰落，布干达夺走了科基和布杜，19世纪30年代托罗又分立出去，并带走了利润丰厚的盐场。

en: The Ruthenians are the East Slavic heirs of Kievan Rus' in the Dnieper basin and the western Rus' lands, the people whom Latin documents called Rutheni to distinguish them from the Muscovites further north. After the Mongol sack of Kyiv in 1240, these principalities gravitated to the rising Grand Duchy of Lithuania, whose victory at the Blue Waters in 1362 brought Kyiv and the steppe border under Vilnius; the Lithuanian chanceries ran in their written tongue, Ruthenian, known to its speakers as ruska mova or the simple speech, set beside Church Slavonic in the liturgy. The Union of Lublin of 1569 transferred the Ruthenian lands of Ukraine to the Polish Crown, opening an age of Polish nobility, enserfment and Catholic pressure that produced the Union of Brest in 1596, when part of the Orthodox hierarchy entered communion with Rome as the Greek Catholic Church. Orthodox resistance found its centre at the Kyiv Caves Monastery and the Mohyla Academy, founded in 1632, while runaway townsmen and peasants swelled the Cossack host of the Dnieper steppe. The great Cossack uprising of 1648 under Bohdan Khmelnytsky and the Pereyaslav agreement of 1654 drew Muscovy into Ruthenian affairs, and through the following partitions the old Ruthenian vernaculars matured into the Ukrainian and Belarusian languages.
zh: 鲁塞尼亚人是基辅罗斯在第聂伯河流域及西部罗斯土地上的东斯拉夫继承者，拉丁文献称他们为鲁塞尼人，以区别于更北面的莫斯科人。1240年蒙古攻陷基辅之后，这些公国纷纷投向兴起的立陶宛大公国；1362年蓝水之战后，基辅与草原边地归入维尔纽斯治下，立陶宛的官署长期使用他们的书面语——鲁塞尼亚语，自称“罗斯语”或“朴素语”，礼拜中则并行使用教会斯拉夫语。1569年卢布林联合把乌克兰的鲁塞尼亚土地划给波兰王室，随之而来的是波兰贵族、农奴化和天主教压力，并促成1596年的布列斯特联合：一部分东正教会与罗马共融，成为希腊礼天主教会。东正教的抵抗以基辅洞窟修道院和1632年创办的莫希拉学院为中心，而逃亡的市民与农民不断壮大第聂伯草原上的哥萨克队伍。1648年波格丹·赫梅利尼茨基领导的哥萨克大起义，以及1654年的佩列亚斯拉夫协议，把莫斯科势力引入鲁塞尼亚事务；在随后的历次瓜分中，古老的鲁塞尼亚各方言逐渐发展为乌克兰语和白俄罗斯语。

en: The Ruvu are a cluster of Bantu peoples of central and coastal Tanzania whose languages form the Ruvu group of Guthrie's Zone G, sixty to seventy percent alike in vocabulary: the Gogo and Sagara of the dry Dodoma plains, the Kaguru, Luguru, Kutu and Vidunda of the Eastern Arc mountains, and the Zaramo, Kwere and Doe nearer the sea. Most were matrilineal, and the Luguru alone counted more than fifty exogamous clans in the Uluguru Mountains, where rainmakers such as the famous Kingalu drew clients from across the region without any chief ever standing above the local lineages. Through Ugogo and Ukaguru ran the principal caravan route linking Lake Tanganyika with the Indian Ocean, traveled from the eighteenth century onward; Gogo chiefs levied tolls on the Nyamwezi ivory caravans and kept Nyamwezi advisors at their courts. On the coast the Zaramo took shape in the early 1800s, when the hinterland warrior Pazi drove off Kamba raiders attacking the merchant Shomvi clan and then settled among them as their ruler.
zh: 鲁伏人是坦桑尼亚中部与沿海一带班图各族的统称，其语言构成格思里G区下的鲁伏语组，词汇相似度达六成至七成，包括干旱的多多马平原上的戈戈人和萨加拉人，东部弧形山脉里的卡古鲁人、卢古鲁人、库图人和维敦达人，以及更靠近海边的扎拉莫人、奎雷人和多埃人。他们大多按母系继嗣，仅乌卢古鲁山里的卢古鲁人就有五十多个外婚制氏族；那里以金加卢为代表的祈雨师声名远播，客户遍布各地，却始终没有高于地方世系的首领。连接坦噶尼喀湖与印度洋的主要商路穿过乌戈戈和乌卡古鲁，18世纪起商旅络绎于途，戈戈酋长向尼扬韦齐人的象牙商队征收通行税，宫廷里还养着尼扬韦齐顾问。沿海的扎拉莫人形成于19世纪初：内地武士帕齐击退了攻打经商的肖姆维氏族的坎巴劫掠者，随后定居在他们中间，成为其统治者。

en: The Banyarwanda are the Bantu people of the mountainous country around Lake Muhazi, united by the Kinyarwanda language and traditionally divided not into separate peoples but into three social categories: the farming Hutu, the cattle-keeping Tutsi and the small remnant of hunter-gatherer Twa, whose clans, the ubwoko, cut across all three. Bantu farmers had cleared these hills by about the year 1000, and waves of pastoral Tutsi entered from the north between the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries. From the fourteenth or fifteenth century the clans coalesced into kingdoms, one of which, the small chiefdom of Gasabo beside Lake Muhazi, grew into the Kingdom of Rwanda under its Nyiginya dynasty. Around 1600 an invasion by the Banyoro drove its kings westward, but Ruganzu Ndori rebuilt the state from Nyanza, and in the seventeenth century his successors subdued the outlying Hutu communities. Conquered populations were absorbed as Banyarwanda, and the realm became one of the most centralized monarchies of the African Great Lakes, its mwami ruling through appointed chiefs rather than hereditary lineages.
zh: 巴尼亚卢旺达人是穆哈齐湖周围山国的班图人，以卢旺达语为纽带，传统上并不分成不同民族，而是分为务农的胡图人、牧牛的图西人和残存的少量狩猎采集者特瓦人三个社会类别，氏族（乌布科）的成员横跨三类。约公元1000年，班图农民已在此间丘陵开垦，15至16世纪又有一批批图西牧人从北方迁入。14或15世纪起，诸氏族合并为若干王国，其中穆哈齐湖畔的加萨博小酋长国在尼吉尼亚王朝治下发展为卢旺达王国。约1600年，巴尼奥罗人的入侵把国王赶到西方，但鲁甘祖·恩多里从尼安扎重建国家，17世纪其继承者又征服了外围的胡图社群。被征服者被吸纳为巴尼亚卢旺达人，这个国度也成为非洲大湖地区最集权的君主国之一，姆瓦米（国王）通过任命的酋长而非世袭世系实行统治。

en: The Ryazanians are the East Slavic people of the middle Oka, the south-eastern frontier of Rus' where forest meets steppe. Their land emerged from the Murom-Ryazan inheritance that split from Chernigov by 1129, a network of fortress towns on the border with the nomadic world. This exposed position made them the first Rus' principality to face the Mongol storm: in December 1237 Batu's armies sacked and annihilated the capital, Old Ryazan, killing most of its princely house, and the seat was moved north to Pereyaslavl-Ryazansky, the later city of Ryazan. Rebuilding under the Golden Horde, the Ryazan princes balanced between Sarai, Moscow and the steppe: Prince Oleg Ivanovich stood aside from Kulikovo in 1380 as an ally of Mamai, while the long feud with the junior principality of Pronsk ended only with its annexation in 1483. On Ryazan soil the grand princes of Moscow planted the Tatar vassal khanate of Kasimov in 1452, and the towns of Tula guarded the new fortified line against Crimean raids. The last principality to keep its formal independence, Ryazan was finally absorbed by Vasily III in 1521 when its last prince fled to Lithuania. Its speech belonged to the southern Russian dialect belt, marked by akanye and the soft steppe frontier's long contact with Turkic neighbours.
zh: 梁赞人是奥卡河中游的东斯拉夫人，这里是罗斯东南边陲、森林与草原相接之地。他们的土地出自穆罗姆—梁赞遗产，1129年从切尔尼戈夫分立，由一系列面向游牧世界的边城组成。正因地处前沿，梁赞成为第一个撞上蒙古风暴的罗斯公国：1237年12月拔都的大军攻陷并屠灭都城旧梁赞，王公家族几乎死绝，都城北迁至佩列亚斯拉夫尔—梁赞斯基，即后来的梁赞城。在金帐汗国治下重建后，梁赞王公在萨莱、莫斯科与草原之间周旋：1380年库利科沃之战时，奥列格·伊万诺维奇作为马迈的盟友按兵不动；与小邦普龙斯克的长期争斗则直到1483年将其吞并才告结束。1452年，莫斯科大公在梁赞土地上安置了鞑靼附庸卡西姆汗国，图拉等城则构成抵御克里米亚鞑靼人袭扰的新防线。梁赞是最后一个保持形式独立的罗斯公国，1521年末代王公逃奔立陶宛，公国终被瓦西里三世并入。梁赞方言属于南俄罗斯方言带，以“阿坎耶”弱读为特征，也带着长期与突厥邻人接触留下的草原印记。

en: The Ryukyuans are the Japonic-speaking people of the Ryukyu Islands, the chain stretching from Kyushu toward Taiwan, who call themselves Uchinaanchu on Okinawa and speak a group of languages distinct from Japanese. Rice cultivation reached the islands only in the twelfth century, and society kept strong matriarchal elements, with priestesses called noro tending an indigenous ancestor cult. In the fourteenth century Okinawa was divided among the three principalities of Hokuzan, Chūzan and Nanzan, centered on Nakijin, Urasoe and Ōzato; Chūzan opened tributary relations with Ming China in 1372 and received Chinese settler families from Fujian. Its king Shō Hashi conquered Hokuzan in 1416 and Nanzan in 1429, founding the Ryukyu Kingdom at Shuri with the port of Naha, and the crown later absorbed Amami Ōshima and the Sakishima Islands. Under Shō Shin, who reigned from 1478 to 1526, the kingdom prospered as a maritime trader linking China, Japan and Southeast Asia. In 1609 the Satsuma Domain of Kyushu invaded and carried off the king; the Amami Islands were annexed and Ryukyu survived as a dual vassal, paying tribute to Qing China while answering to Satsuma, a position it still held in the early nineteenth century.
zh: 琉球人是琉球群岛（从九州延伸向台湾的岛链）上说日本语系语言的族群，在冲绳自称冲绳人，所说的琉球语与日语不同。水稻种植12世纪才传入群岛，社会保留浓厚的母系色彩，由称“祝女”的女祭司主持本土的祖先信仰。14世纪，冲绳分裂为北山、中山、南山三个政权，分别以来自今归仁、浦添和大里的据点为中心；中山于1372年与明朝建立朝贡关系，并接纳来自福建的汉人移民家族。中山王尚巴志于1416年攻灭北山、1429年攻灭南山，建立以首里为都、那霸为港的琉球王国，后来又吞并奄美大岛和先岛群岛。1478至1526年尚真王在位时，琉球凭借连接中国、日本与东南亚的海上贸易臻于鼎盛。1609年九州的萨摩藩入侵并掳走国王，奄美群岛被割占；琉球此后以双重臣属的地位存续，一边向清朝朝贡，一边听命于萨摩，直到19世纪初仍是如此。

en: The Saa, or Sa'a, are an Oceanic-speaking people of the southern Solomon Islands, living on Small Malaita off the southern tip of Malaita and on nearby Ulawa. Their language, also called Apae'aa or South Malaita, belongs to the Austronesian family.
zh: 萨阿人是所罗门群岛南部操大洋洲语族语言的族群，居住在马莱塔岛南端外的南马莱塔岛，又称小马莱塔岛，以及附近的乌拉瓦岛。他们的语言又称阿帕埃阿语或南马莱塔语，属南岛语系。

en: The Saanich, whose name means 'the emerging people', are a Central Coast Salish people of the southern tip of Vancouver Island, the Saanich Peninsula and the neighbouring Gulf and San Juan Islands, whose traditional reach extended along the adjacent mainland. They were divided into five independent house groups, each with its own winter villages and fishing grounds, and spoke a North Straits Salish dialect. Their ranked society distinguished nobles, commoners and slaves, and stone burial cairns were raised around present-day Victoria between about 500 and 1000. Spanish explorers anchored at Esquimalt Harbour in 1790 and named it Puerto de Cordova, and British ships followed in 1792. From around 1800 musket-armed raiders from the northern coast pressed hard on Saanich villages, pushing the local Salish groups toward shared defensive alliances.
zh: 萨尼奇人是中部沿海萨利什人的一支，族名意为‘新兴之民’，分布在温哥华岛南端、萨尼奇半岛以及邻近的海湾群岛和圣胡安群岛，传统活动范围还及于附近的大陆沿岸。他们分为五个独立的聚居家族，各有冬村和渔场，所说的是北海峡萨利什语的一种方言。社会等级分明，分为贵族、平民和奴隶；约500年至1000年间，今维多利亚一带留下了大量石冢墓葬。1790年西班牙探险船驶入埃斯奎莫尔特港，将其命名为科尔多瓦港，1792年英国船队也来到这里。1800年前后，来自北方海岸、持有火枪的劫掠者频频袭击萨尼奇村落，迫使当地萨利什各部走向共同防御的联盟。

en: The Sach'a-p-qulla, better known as the Chachapoyas or “Warriors of the Clouds,” were an Andean people of the misty eastern slopes of the northern Peruvian Andes, their heartland the Utcubamba valley in present-day Amazonas. Their culture took shape around AD 800 in cloud forest won by terracing, and its hallmark is the mountaintop citadel of Kuélap, with more than four hundred stone buildings behind walls eighteen metres high, together with the cliff tombs of Revash and the painted settlement of Gran Pajatén. The Inca Túpac Yupanqui conquered them around 1475 after fighting that began at Pías, but they rebelled again under Huayna Cápac, killing his governors; the revolt ended only when a delegation of women, led by a former concubine of Túpac Yupanqui, begged for peace. The Incas then scattered thousands of Chachapoyas as mitma settlers, some of whom built parts of Choquequirao near Cusco. In the Inca civil war they backed Huáscar and suffered Atahualpa's revenge, so many welcomed Francisco Pizarro; the local lord Huaman of Quchapampa pledged allegiance after the capture of Atahualpa at Cajamarca. Spanish troops occupied the city of Chachapoyas in 1547, ending their independence, and disease and resettlement cut the region's population by some ninety percent within two centuries.
zh: 查查波亚人又称“云端战士”，是秘鲁北部安第斯山脉东坡云雾林中的安第斯族群，核心地区在今亚马孙大区的乌特库班巴河谷。他们的文化约在公元800年形成，靠开垦梯田向云林要地；最鲜明的标志是山顶城堡库埃拉普，十八米高的石墙内有四百多座石砌建筑，此外还有雷瓦什的崖墓和格兰帕哈滕的彩绘聚落。印加君主图帕克·尤潘基约在1475年征服他们，战事始于皮亚斯；但他们在瓦伊纳·卡帕克时期再度起义，杀死印加总督，直到一群妇女在图帕克·尤潘基的一位旧妃率领下请求宽恕，叛乱才告平息。此后印加人把数以千计的查查波亚人作为米特马克移民分散各地，其中一些人参与修建了库斯科附近的乔克基劳。印加内战中，他们支持瓦斯卡尔，遭到阿塔瓦尔帕报复，因此许多人欢迎弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗；阿塔瓦尔帕在卡哈马卡被俘后，当地首领瓦曼率先归顺。1547年西班牙军队占领查查波亚城，他们的独立告终；疾病和强制迁徙使该地区人口在两百年内减少约九成。

en: The Sahaptin are not one tribe but a constellation of Plateau peoples speaking dialects of one Sahaptin language, among them the Umatilla, Tenino, Walla Walla, Klickitat, Palus and Wanapum, whose villages lined the Columbia River from the Cascades Rapids eastward and the Snake, Yakima, Deschutes, Walla Walla and Umatilla tributaries in what is now Oregon and Washington. Sahaptin itself is a Plateau Penutian tongue, and the name was given them by Salishan neighbours; the Umatilla, for instance, call themselves Imatalamłáma after their village at the mouth of the Umatilla River. They had no clans, and their headmen were elected and guided by councils rather than ruling over centralized bands. Semisettled hunter-gatherers, they took salmon and deer, pit-roasted camas bulbs and baked kouse root into cakes, wintering in long semisubterranean lodges framed with poles and sheathed in rush mats that could hold a hundred people, and raising buffalo-skin tipis on seasonal expeditions. Lewis and Clark passed through their villages in 1805, and the epidemics that followed contact cut their numbers steeply during the first half of the nineteenth century.
zh: 萨哈普廷人不是一个部落，而是高原上一群说萨哈普廷语各方言的族群，包括乌马蒂拉人、特尼诺人、沃拉沃拉人、克利基塔特人、帕卢斯人和瓦纳普姆人等，村社沿哥伦比亚河喀斯喀特急流以东的河段，以及斯内克河、亚基马河、德舒特河、沃拉沃拉河和乌马蒂拉河等支流分布，地在今俄勒冈与华盛顿州。萨哈普廷语属高原佩努蒂语系，“萨哈普廷”这个名字是邻近萨利什语族群对他们的称呼；例如乌马蒂拉人就按自己在乌马蒂拉河口的村社自称伊马塔拉姆拉马人。他们没有氏族，头人由选举产生，靠议事会辅佐，并不存在集权的支派首领。作为半定居的狩猎采集者，他们捕鲑鱼、猎鹿，在坑灶里烤卡马夏百合的球茎，把考斯根烤成饼储存；冬天住进木骨芦席的长形半地穴大屋，一屋可容百人，季节性远行时则支起水牛皮帐篷。1805年，刘易斯与克拉克一行经过他们的村落；接触之后随之而来的传染病在19世纪上半叶使人口锐减。

en: The Sahnish, better known to their neighbours as the Arikara or Ree, are a Caddoan-speaking Plains people who call themselves Sáhniš; their better-known name may mean horns, elk people or corn eaters. Linguists place their split from the Skidi Pawnee around the fifteenth century, after which they built fortified earth-lodge villages along the Missouri River in present-day South Dakota. In 1743 two sons of the French explorer La Vérendrye visited one such village near modern Pierre. They farmed corn and hunted buffalo and were once estimated at thirty thousand people, but the smallpox epidemic of 1780 to 1782 cut their thirty-two Missouri villages to two and left them open to Sioux raids. The weakened Sahnish drifted north to live near the Mandan and Hidatsa; the Lewis and Clark Expedition met them in 1804, and their 1823 clash with Ashley's trappers and Colonel Leavenworth's troops became the first United States Indian war west of the Missouri, ending in a peace treaty in 1825.
zh: 萨尼什人在邻族口中更常见的名字是阿里卡拉人或里人，自称萨尼什，是大平原上说卡多语的族群；阿里卡拉一名可能意为角、麋人或食玉米者。语言学家认为他们约在15世纪从斯基迪波尼人中分出，此后在今天南达科他州的密苏里河畔建起设防的土屋村落。1743年，法国探险家拉韦朗德里的两个儿子到访了今皮埃尔附近的一座村落。他们种植玉米、猎捕野牛，人口一度估计有三万，但1780至1782年的天花瘟疫使密苏里河畔的三十二座村落只剩两座，也令他们门户洞开，遭苏人袭扰。衰弱的萨尼什人逐渐北迁，靠近曼丹人和希达察人而居；刘易斯与克拉克远征队于1804年与他们接触，1823年他们与阿什利的毛皮猎队及利文沃思上校的部队冲突，成为密苏里河以西第一场美国印第安战争，并以1825年的和约收场。

en: The Sahtú, also called the North Slavey and once known to Europeans as the Hare or Hareskin Indians, are a Dene people of the Northern Athabaskan language family, which belongs to the wider Na-Dene grouping. They take their name from Sahtú, the Great Bear Lake in the Northwest Territories of present-day Canada, where their communities of Délı̨nę, Colville Lake, Fort Good Hope, Norman Wells and Tulita stand. They comprise the Hare Dene around Colville Lake and Fort Good Hope, the Bear Lake Dene of Délı̨nę and the Mountain Dene of Tulita, and call themselves Ɂehdzo Got’ı̨ne, the Trap People. As a subarctic people they lived by hunting caribou and moose, fishing the lakes and rivers, and trapping, moving seasonally between hunting grounds. Their first sustained contact with outsiders came through the fur trade: Alexander Mackenzie descended the river later named after him in 1789, and Fort Good Hope was founded as a trading post in 1805, drawing the Sahtú into the networks of the North West Company and later the Hudson's Bay Company.
zh: 萨赫图人又称北斯拉维人，欧洲人过去称他们为黑尔人或兔皮印第安人，是北阿萨巴斯卡语族的德内族群，而阿萨巴斯卡语族属于更大的纳-德内语系。他们的名字得自萨赫图，即今加拿大西北领地的大熊湖，社区有代林、科尔维尔湖、好望堡、诺曼韦尔斯和图利塔。萨赫图人分为科尔维尔湖与好望堡一带的黑尔德内、代林的大熊湖德内和图利塔的山地德内，自称“埃佐戈廷内”，意为“设陷阱的人”。作为亚寒带族群，他们以猎捕驯鹿和驼鹿、在河湖捕鱼和诱捕猎物为生，随季节在猎场之间迁徙。他们与外来者持续接触始于毛皮贸易：亚历山大·麦肯齐于1789年顺后来以他命名的大河而下，好望堡于1805年建为贸易站，萨赫图人由此被卷入西北公司以及后来哈德逊湾公司的贸易网络。

en: Saigoku, the western country, is the old name for the western Japanese lands, used in contrast to the eastern country of Tōgoku. Its earliest recorded appearance, in the Nihon Shoki of 676, meant the Saikaidō provinces of Kyushu, and under the Kamakura shogunate it broadened to cover the court-ruled districts around Kyoto as well. The core of these western lands is the Kinai, the provinces of Yamato, Yamashiro, Kawachi, Settsu and Izumi, which form the historical heart of Japan. Nara held the first permanent capital from 710, when Buddhism and state temples such as Tōdai-ji took root, and in 794 the court moved to Heian-kyō, the later Kyoto, which remained the imperial seat for more than a thousand years and produced The Tale of Genji, the Noh and Kabuki stages of Kyoto and the Bunraku puppets of Osaka. In 1496 the fortified Ishiyama Hongan-ji temple rose at Osaka; Oda Nobunaga crushed it after a ten-year siege begun in 1570, and Toyotomi Hideyoshi built Osaka Castle on the site in 1583. After the Tokugawa victory in the Siege of Osaka of 1614–1615, Osaka became the merchant capital of the shogunate, and its Dōjima Rice Exchange of 1697 pioneered the world's first futures trade.
zh: 西国是日本对西部诸地的旧称，与“东国”相对；最早见于676年的《日本书纪》，当时指九州的西海道各国，镰仓幕府时期范围扩大，把京都周围朝廷治下的地区也包括在内。西国的核心是畿内，即大和国、山城国、河内国、摄津国和和泉国，也是日本历史的心脏地带。710年起，奈良成为日本第一个永久性都城，佛教和东大寺等国立寺院在此扎根；794年朝廷迁都平安京，即后来的京都，在此后一千多年里一直是天皇所在，《源氏物语》以及京都的能、歌舞伎和大阪的文乐木偶戏都诞生于这一地区。1496年，设防森严的石山本愿寺在大阪兴起；织田信长从1570年起围攻十年将其摧毁，丰臣秀吉于1583年在原址修筑大阪城。1614—1615年大阪之阵后德川氏确立胜局，大阪成为幕府治下的商人之都，1697年设立的堂岛米会所开创了世界上最早的期货交易。

en: Saintongeais is a langue d'oïl of the Poitevin–Saintongeais group, spoken along the Atlantic coast of western France in the old provinces of Saintonge, Aunis and Angoumois, from Saintes and Saint-Jean-d'Angély inland to Angoulême and Cognac. Its country takes its name from the Santones, the Gaulish people whose town of Saintes became the first capital of Roman Aquitaine, and the speech still carries a substrate left by the Limousin Occitan once used there. In the later Middle Ages Saintonge was a marchland between the Capetian kings and the Plantagenet dukes of Aquitaine; its lords wavered between Paris and Anglo-Aquitaine until Charles VII's armies secured the province for France in 1451. The port towns and vineyards along the Charente, home of the wine that became cognac, also made the region a nursery of seafarers: Samuel de Champlain, born near Saintes in 1574, went on to found Quebec, and settlers from Saintonge carried their speech to Acadia, where it shaped Acadian and later Cajun French. The area was likewise one of the strongholds of the Huguenots in south-western France. The province was dissolved in 1790 into the department of Charente-Inférieure, later Charente-Maritime, while Saintongeais lived on mainly as a rural patois.
zh: 圣通日语是奥依语普瓦图-圣通日语支的语言，通行于法国西部大西洋沿岸的旧行省圣通日、欧尼斯和昂古穆瓦，从桑特、圣让当热利一直延伸到内陆的昂古莱姆和干邑。这片土地得名于高卢部落桑托内斯人，他们的城镇桑特曾是罗马阿基坦行省的第一个首府；当地语言中还保留着早先通行于此的利穆赞奥克语留下的底层成分。中世纪后期，圣通日是卡佩王室与金雀花阿基坦公爵之间的边地，领主们在巴黎和英属阿基坦之间摇摆，直到1451年查理七世的军队将该省并入法国。夏朗德河畔的港口和葡萄园出产后来造就干邑的葡萄酒，也使这里成为航海家的摇篮：1574年生于桑特附近的塞缪尔·德·尚普兰后来建立了魁北克，圣通日移民还把家乡话带到阿卡迪亚，影响了阿卡迪亚法语乃至后来的卡真法语。这里也是法国西南部胡格诺派的重镇之一。1790年该行省被撤销，并入下夏朗德省（后改名滨海夏朗德省），圣通日语则主要作为乡间土话留存下来。

en: The Sakalava are the dominant people of Madagascar's long western plain, spread along the coast from Toliara in the south to the Sambirano River and Nosy Be in the north, and formed from the mingling of Austronesian seafarers who had reached the island by the ninth century with later Bantu farmers. Their first kingdoms took shape around the 1650s, when the Maroserana princes of Fiherenana, possibly heirs of the older Zafiraminia clans, built their power on the slave trade, exchanging captives raided from the Comoros and neighbouring Malagasy peoples for Arab guns. After 1610 Andriandahifotsy pushed his rule north across the Mangoky River, and his sons carried it to the site of Mahajanga; the chiefdom of Menabe, centred on Morondava, became the leading power of western Madagascar. At its height between 1730 and 1760, under King Andrianinevenarivo, the Sakalava realm covered nearly half the island, extracted tribute from weaker neighbours such as the Mahafaly and held a monopoly of the slave trade through Mahajanga, while its rulers adopted Sunni Islam in the 1700s to secure the support of Oman and Zanzibar. The kingdom then split into the northern Boina and southern Menabe states, and the wars of the Merina king Radama I broke its power in the 1820s, though neither Menabe nor Boina was ever fully annexed from Antananarivo. Sakalava life centred on great zebu herds and on the royal ancestor cult, served by dady priests and the Tromba spirit ceremonies that define Sakalava identity.
zh: 萨卡拉瓦人是马达加斯加西部狭长平原上的主体民族，沿海岸分布，南起图利亚拉，北至桑比拉诺河和贝岛，由9世纪已抵达该岛的南岛语航海者与后来的班图农民融合而成。他们最早的王国约形成于17世纪50年代：菲赫雷纳纳的马鲁塞拉纳王公可能是更古老的扎菲拉米尼亚氏族的后裔，靠奴隶贸易起家，用从科摩罗和邻近马尔加什族群掳来的人口交换阿拉伯人的枪支。1610年后，安德里安达希富齐把统治向北推过曼戈基河，他的儿子们进一步扩张到马哈赞加一带；以穆龙达瓦为中心的梅纳贝酋邦遂成为马达加斯加西部的首要强权。1730至1760年安德里亚尼韦纳里武国王在位时，萨卡拉瓦疆域达到顶峰，几乎覆盖全岛一半，迫使马哈法利等较弱的邻邦纳贡，并通过马哈赞加港垄断奴隶贸易；18世纪时，其统治者还改宗逊尼派伊斯兰教，以换取阿曼和桑给巴尔的支持。此后王国分裂为北部的博伊纳和南部的梅纳贝两个国家；19世纪20年代，梅里纳国王拉达马一世的战争摧毁了萨卡拉瓦的霸权，但梅纳贝和博伊纳始终未被塔那那利佛完全吞并。萨卡拉瓦人的生活以庞大的瘤牛群和王室祖先崇拜为中心，达迪祭司主持的特龙巴通灵仪式更是其身份认同的核心标志。

en: The Sakao are an Oceanic-speaking Melanesian people of the northeastern horn of Espiritu Santo in Vanuatu, settled around the anchorages of Port-Olry in the north and Hog Harbour in the south, the two villages giving their names to the dialects of the Sakao tongue. Outsiders named them after the small offshore islet of Sakao, which the people themselves call Ladhi. Although their language is a close cousin of the neighbouring Tolomako, it has undergone such drastic sound change, probably within the last thousand years, that the two peoples can no longer understand one another. Sakao country lay near the route of the first European visitors: Pedro Fernandes de Queirós made the first recorded European landing on Santo in 1606, and Louis Antoine de Bougainville and James Cook returned in 1768 and 1774.
zh: 萨卡奥人是瓦努阿图圣埃斯皮里图岛东北角的美拉尼西亚人，聚居于北部的奥尔里港和南部的霍格港两处锚地，萨卡奥语的两种方言便以这两个村落得名。外来者以近海的萨卡奥小岛称呼他们，而他们自己把该岛称作拉齐。萨卡奥语虽与邻近的托洛马科语是近亲，但可能在最近一千年内经历了剧烈的语音演变，两族已经无法互通。萨卡奥人的家园临近最早一批欧洲访客的航线：1606年佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯首次有记载地登上圣埃斯皮里图岛，布干维尔和库克又于1768年和1774年重访该岛。

en: The Sakha, known to their Russian and Tungusic neighbours as the Yakuts, are a Turkic people of the middle and lower Lena River in northern Siberia, whose language belongs to the northern branch of Siberian Turkic and is closest to Dolgan. Their ancestors were pastoralist tribes of the Baikal and upper Yenisei region, linked by scholars to the Kurykan Tiele and to Khakas groups, who were pushed north by Buryat and Mongol expansion from the twelfth century and settled along the Lena, blending with the indigenous Tungusic and Paleo-Siberian hunters already living there. In the harsh taiga they became horse and cattle breeders, famed for the hardy Yakutian horse and Yakutian cattle, and were organized into clans led by chiefs such as Tygyn Darkhan. In the 1620s Muscovite Cossacks reached the Lena, built Yakutsk and imposed the yasak fur tribute; Sakha revolts between 1634 and 1642 were crushed, and smallpox and war cut the population by an estimated seventy percent by the 1680s. By the 1820s nearly all Sakha were formally Russian Orthodox, though they kept many Tengri customs, and the region had become a major source of furs and later gold for the Russian Empire.
zh: 萨哈人被俄罗斯和通古斯邻族称为雅库特人，是北西伯利亚勒拿河中下游的突厥语民族，其语言属西伯利亚突厥语北支，与多尔干语最接近。他们的先民是贝加尔湖和叶尼塞河上游一带的游牧部落，学界将其与铁勒骨利干部及哈卡斯群体联系起来；12世纪起因布里亚特和蒙古扩张被迫北迁，沿勒拿河定居，并与当地原有的通古斯、古西伯利亚狩猎族群融合。在严酷的泰加林环境中，他们以养马和养牛为生，以耐寒的雅库特马和雅库特牛闻名，社会按氏族组织，由特根·达尔汗之类的首领统领。17世纪20年代，莫斯科的哥萨克进抵勒拿河，修建雅库茨克并征收毛皮税“亚萨克”；1634至1642年间的萨哈起义遭到镇压，加上天花和战乱，到17世纪80年代人口估计减少了七成。到19世纪20年代，萨哈人几乎都在名义上皈依了俄罗斯东正教，但仍保留大量腾格里信仰习俗，该地区也成为俄罗斯帝国重要的毛皮、后来又是黄金产地。

en: The Adyan are the Even, or Lamut, reindeer clans of the lower Lena and the Olenyok country, the tundra between the two rivers in present-day northwestern Sakha Republic. Seventeenth-century Russian records call them the Olenyok Tungus of the Adyan, or Edyan, tribe, and between 1639 and 1664 the fort clerks recorded their running feuds with the Vanyady, ancestors of the Nganasans, to the west. They lived as nomadic reindeer herders, hunting wild reindeer and fishing along the Arctic rivers, and the Even speech of their descendants is classed as the Sakkyryr dialect, named after the Sakkyryr River. With the rest of the Evens they came under Russian fur-tribute rule in the seventeenth century and were counted as Orthodox by the nineteenth.
zh: 萨克雷尔人是下勒拿河与奥列尼奥克河之间苔原上的鄂温（拉穆特）养鹿氏族，在今萨哈共和国西北部。17世纪的俄国文献把他们记作阿德扬部落的奥列尼奥克通古斯人；1639至1664年间，堡寨文书多次记录他们与西邻瓦尼亚德人（恩加纳桑人的先民）发生冲突。他们以游牧驯鹿为生，在北极各河沿岸猎取野鹿、捕鱼，其后人的鄂温语被划为萨克雷尔方言，得名于萨克雷尔河。和其他鄂温人一样，他们在17世纪被纳入俄国的毛皮税体系，到19世纪已被算作正教徒。

en: The Salar are a Turkic Muslim people whose villages line the Yellow River in Xunhua and Hualong in Qinghai and the neighbouring Jishishan hills of Gansu, the Ming-era Jishi prefecture. Their tradition traces them to the Salur tribe of the Oghuz Turks, who in the thirteenth century trekked east from the Samarkand region under the brothers Qaraman and Aqman, carrying a Quran on a white camel, and settled there. Over the centuries they mixed with Tibetan, Hui, Han and Mongol neighbours, and clan lore remembers Tibetan women as their first wives, leaving many Salars bilingual in Amdo Tibetan. They farm wheat, buckwheat and fruit in a patriarchal village society, follow Sunni Islam of the Hanafi school, speak the Oghuz Salar language and write in Chinese. In 1370 their chief Han Bao submitted to the Ming, which made him hereditary centurion under the Hezhou guard and let the Salar clans keep broad self-rule; the upper clans took the surname Han and the lower ones Ma. In the 1670s the Kashgarian Sufi Afaq Khoja introduced Sufi orders, and in the eighteenth century Ma Laichi's Khufiyya and Ma Mingxin's Jahriyya fought for Salar followers. Their rivalry became the Jahriyya revolt of 1781, led by Su Sishisan: Qing forces under Agui crushed the rebels after a three-month siege near Lanzhou, killing perhaps two in five Salars and exiling survivors to the Ili valley.
zh: 撒拉人是信奉伊斯兰教的突厥语民族，村落沿青海循化、化隆一带的黄河分布，并延伸到相邻的甘肃积石山，即明代的积石州一带。撒拉人的口述传统将祖先追溯到乌古斯突厥的撒鲁尔部：13世纪，嘎勒莽、阿赫莽兄弟率领族人牵着白骆驼、驮着古兰经自撒马尔罕一带东迁，在积石州落脚。此后数百年间，他们与藏族、回族、汉族和蒙古族杂处通婚，族谱称最早的妻子是藏族女子，不少撒拉人因而兼通安多藏语。他们以父系村寨社会务农为生，种植小麦、荞麦与瓜果，信奉哈乃斐派的逊尼派伊斯兰教，口说乌古斯语支的撒拉语，书写则通用汉文。1370年首领韩宝归附明朝，被授为河州卫积石千户所的世袭百户，撒拉各姓由此获得广泛的自治权，上部诸族取韩姓、下部诸族取马姓。17世纪70年代，喀什噶尔的苏菲大师阿帕克霍加将苏菲派传入；18世纪马来迟的虎夫耶与马明心的哲合忍耶两派在撒拉人中争夺信徒，最终酿成1781年苏四十三领导的哲合忍耶起义。阿桂率领的清军在兰州附近围城三月将起义镇压，约四成撒拉人死于战乱，幸存者被流放伊犁河谷。

en: The Saleesh, better known as the Bitterroot Salish or Flathead and calling themselves Selish, are an Interior Salish people of present-day western Montana, whose language gave the entire Salishan family its name. Their early homeland lay east of the continental divide, but in the 1700s pressure from westward-moving Plains nations, above all the Blackfeet, together with smallpox, drove them into the Bitterroot Valley. There they kept a seasonal round, crossing the divide once or twice a year to hunt buffalo on the plains and building alliances with plateau tribes to their west. The expedition of Lewis and Clark met them in the valley in 1805, and by the 1830s Iroquois trappers schooled by Jesuits had settled among them; their accounts moved the Saleesh to send delegations to St. Louis in 1831, 1835 and 1837 asking for priests to be sent to their country.
zh: 萨利希人自称塞利什，更常被称为比特鲁特萨利什人或弗拉特黑德人，是内陆萨利什人的一支，住在今蒙大拿州西部，他们的语言正是整个萨利什语系的得名来源。他们的早期家园在大陆分水岭以东，18世纪时，向西扩张的平原部族（主要是黑脚人）施加的压力加上天花，把他们逼入比特鲁特谷。他们在那里按季节迁徙，每年一两次越过分水岭到平原猎牛，并与西边的高原部落结盟自保。1805年，刘易斯与克拉克的探险队在谷中与他们相遇；1830年代，受过耶稣会教育的易洛魁猎户已在他们中间定居，后者的讲述促使萨利希人于1831年、1835年和1837年数次派人前往圣路易斯，请求派遣神父到他们的土地。

en: The Salinan are an Indigenous people of the Central Coast of California, whose ancestral lands covered the southern Salinas Valley and the Santa Lucia Range. They were divided into the Antoniano of the lower valley, the Miguelino of the upper Salinas River and the coastal Playano, living as hunter-gatherers in small, loosely organized bands and relying on acorns, fish, shellfish and game. Their own name for themselves means People of the Oaks, while Salinan was given to them by the Spanish from the Salinas River. Their language was a linguistic isolate, sometimes tentatively grouped with the Hokan family. The Spanish built the missions of San Antonio de Padua in 1771 and San Miguel Arcángel in 1797 in their territory, around which most Salinan came to live, and their numbers fell steeply under the mission system and the epidemics that accompanied it.
zh: 萨利南人是加利福尼亚中部海岸的原住民，祖居地包括萨利纳斯河谷南部和圣卢西亚山脉。他们分为住在河谷下游的安东尼奥人、萨利纳斯河上游的米格尔人以及沿海的普拉亚诺人，以小型松散的游群从事采集狩猎，主食橡子、鱼类、贝类和猎物。他们的自称意为“橡树之人”，“萨利南”则是西班牙人依萨利纳斯河给他们起的名字。萨利南语是一门孤立语言，也有人尝试把它归入霍坎语系。西班牙人于1771年和1797年先后在他们的土地上建立圣安东尼奥和圣米格尔两座传教站，多数萨利南人后来围绕传教站生活，人口在传教制度和伴随而来的疫病中急剧下降。

en: The Saluan are an Austronesian people of the mountainous interior of Banggai Regency in eastern Central Sulawesi, descended from the Loinang, or mountain people, of the highlands and grouped into the Lingketeng, Loinang and Obo dialect subgroups; their Celebic Saluan language and the tooth-filing rite marking adulthood are central to their tradition.
zh: 萨卢安人是中苏拉威西东部邦盖县山区的南岛语族群，源自高地上被称为“洛伊南”（意为山里人）的居民，下分林格滕、洛伊南和奥博三个方言支系；属西里伯斯语支的萨卢安语和标志成年的锉齿仪式是其传统的重要部分。

en: The Sama, more widely known by the exonym Bajau, are a cluster of Austronesian seaborne peoples of maritime Southeast Asia, dwelling in houseboats such as the lepa and vinta across the Sulu Archipelago, the coasts of Borneo and Sulawesi and the islands of eastern Indonesia. They live from fishing and trade, and their later spread was closely tied to commerce in sea cucumber. The Magellan expedition's chronicler Antonio Pigafetta first described boat-dwelling Sama in 1521 off the Zamboanga Peninsula, and Dutch records note them in Sulawesi from 1675. Some northern Sulu groups, notably the Banguingui, took part in the sea raids and slave trade of the colonial era, serving as crews under Iranun commanders who answered to the Tausug datus of the Sultanate of Sulu, with raids reaching as far as the Moluccas. A Sama settlement at Bajoe in Sulawesi stood under the Bugis Sultanate of Bone and was caught up in the Bone Wars of 1824 and 1825, after which most of its people resettled elsewhere on the island. Their Sinama languages are commonly written in the Jawi script, and their beliefs range from Sunni Islam to folk Islam and older sea-spirit worship.
zh: 巴瑶人自称萨马人，是东南亚海岛地区一组以船为家的南岛语族群体，乘莱帕船、文塔船等木船活动于苏禄群岛、婆罗洲与苏拉威西沿海及印尼东部诸岛，以捕鱼和贸易为生，其后来的扩散与海参贸易密切相关。1521年，麦哲伦探险队的记述者皮加费塔在三宝颜半岛外海首次记载了栖身船上的巴瑶人；荷兰文献则从1675年起记录他们出现在苏拉威西。殖民时代，苏禄北部的部分群体（尤以班吉英人为代表）卷入海上劫掠和奴隶贸易，在伊拉农指挥官麾下充当船员，而后者听命于苏禄苏丹国的陶苏格酋长，劫掠范围远达马鲁古群岛。苏拉威西的巴瑶港有一处巴瑶人聚落，臣属布吉人的波尼苏丹国，被卷入1824至1825年的波尼战争，战后多数人迁往岛内其他地方。他们的萨马语常用爪夷文书写，信仰则从逊尼派伊斯兰教、民间伊斯兰到更古老的海神崇拜不一而足。

en: The Samaritans are an ethnoreligious community of Samaria in central Palestine, descended from the population of the ancient northern Kingdom of Israel; their identity crystallized under Persian and Hellenistic rule. They recognize only their own Torah and hold Mount Gerizim above Nablus, not Jerusalem, as God's chosen sanctuary, where their temple stood from the fifth century BCE until the Hasmonean king John Hyrcanus destroyed it around 110 BCE. Revolts against Byzantium in 484 and under Julianus ben Sabar in 529 were drowned in blood by Emperors Zeno and Justinian, leaving the once numerous people a small minority. Under Islamic rule they lived as dhimmis taxed by the jizya, but ninth-century Abbasid persecutions emptied their villages and concentrated the survivors in Nablus, and from the eleventh century Arabic replaced Aramaic as their speech. The Franks of the First Crusade massacred their coastal communities, and in 1137 a Damascene raid on Nablus carried off five hundred captives. Benjamin of Tudela found only about nineteen hundred Samaritans in the twelfth century; Ottoman repression further shrank them, and by the end of the eighteenth century roughly two hundred remained, clustered in Nablus and living by trade and clerking.
zh: 撒玛利亚人是巴勒斯坦中部撒玛利亚地区的族群，源自古以色列北国的遗民，其群体认同在波斯与希腊化统治时期成形。他们只承认本派的《托拉》，坚信纳布卢斯旁的基利心山而非耶路撒冷才是上帝选定的圣所；他们的圣殿自公元前5世纪立于该山，约公元前110年被哈斯蒙尼王朝的约翰·海尔卡努斯拆毁。484年以及529年尤利亚努斯·本·萨巴尔领导的反拜占庭起义先后被芝诺和查士丁尼皇帝血腥镇压，这个曾人口众多的民族沦为少数群体。伊斯兰统治下，他们作为缴纳吉兹亚税的迪米民生活，但9世纪阿拔斯王朝的迫害使乡村聚落荒废，幸存者聚居于纳布卢斯；11世纪起，阿拉伯语取代阿拉米语成为他们的语言。第一次十字军东征时，法兰克人屠杀了他们的沿海社群，1137年大马士革军队袭击纳布卢斯，掳走五百人。12世纪图德拉的便雅悯统计时，撒玛利亚人只剩约一千九百人；奥斯曼时期的压迫使人口进一步萎缩，到18世纪末仅余约两百人，聚居在纳布卢斯，靠经商和文书为生。

en: The Sambal are the original Austronesian inhabitants of Zambales, the mountainous western coast of Luzon, with related communities at Bolinao and Anda in Pangasinan; their Sambalic languages, split into Sambali, Botolan and Bolinao, belong to the same Central Luzon family as Kapampangan. They once lived farther south until Tagalog migration pushed them north, where they in turn displaced the Aeta foragers. Early Spanish accounts describe a warlike, headhunting society of small villages of ten to thirty families, skilled with poison arrows, short spears and the large rectangular kalasag shield, whose warriors took heads with the bararao dagger; the Boxer Codex pictures these trophies, while their own faith centered on the creator Malayari, served by shamans called bayoc. During the first century of Spanish rule the Sambal were gathered into reduccion towns and gradually Christianized, notably around Fort Paynauen at present-day Botolan, though they kept a name for ferocity: in 1660 the Zambales chieftain Pedro Gumapos led six thousand men in Andres Malong's war, sacking Vigan before he was captured and hanged, and Sambal raiders once seized the young Diego Silang, who was later ransomed to a Recollect missionary. They shipped timber to Manila by native boats, but Moro pirate raids on that trade kept Zambales poor through the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, as Spanish geographical dictionaries of the period record.
zh: 三描礼人是吕宋西部多山海岸三描礼士省的原始南岛语系居民，在邦阿西楠的博利瑙和安还有亲缘社群；他们的三描礼诸语言分为桑巴利、博托兰和博利瑙三种，与邦板牙语同属中吕宋语族。他们原本住在更南边，被他加禄人的移民浪潮推向北方，又在当地排挤了阿埃塔狩猎采集者。早期西班牙文献记载了一个骁勇的猎头社会：村落只有十到三十户，善用毒箭、短矛和长方形大盾“卡拉萨格”，战士用“巴拉劳”匕首割取敌人首级，《博克塞图册》就描绘了这种首级战利品；他们本土信仰的核心是造物主马拉亚里，由称“巴约克”的萨满侍奉。西班牙统治的头一百年里，三描礼人被并入集村城镇并逐渐基督教化，博托兰的派纳文堡一带尤为集中，但他们凶悍之名不减：1660年，三描礼酋长佩德罗·古马波斯率六千人加入安德烈斯·马隆的战争，洗劫维甘后被俘并被绞死；三描礼游猎者还曾俘虏幼年的迭戈·西朗，后来他被一位重整奥斯定会传教士赎走。他们用本地船只把木材运往马尼拉，但莫罗海盗不断劫掠这项贸易，使三描礼在18世纪和19世纪初一直贫困，当时的西班牙地理辞典对此就有记载。

en: The Samogitians, whose name means the Lowlanders, are the western branch of the Lithuanians, formed in the lowlands of central and western Lithuania as early as the fifth and sixth centuries. Closely related to the Semigallians and Curonians, they absorbed the southern remnants of those neighbouring tribes between the thirteenth and sixteenth centuries, and their Samogitian speech remains the most distinct dialect of Lithuanian. For two hundred years they stood on the front line against the crusading orders: they destroyed the Brothers of the Sword at the Battle of Saule in 1236 and crushed the combined Teutonic and Livonian armies at Durbe in 1260. Repeatedly ceded to the Order in treaties and repeatedly won back, Samogitia was surrendered by Vytautas in 1398 under the Treaty of Salynas, but its people rose in 1401 and again in 1409, and Samogitian regiments fought at the decisive Battle of Grunwald in 1410. They were the last people in Europe to accept Christianity, baptised only in 1413, and the Treaty of Melno in 1422 finally settled their border with the Order. Organised as the autonomous Duchy of Samogitia within the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, whose nobility long kept using Lithuanian, they passed to Russia with the partitions of the late eighteenth century.
zh: 萨莫吉蒂亚人意即“低地居民”，是立陶宛人的西支，早在5—6世纪就形成于立陶宛中西部的低地。他们与塞米加利亚人、库罗尼亚人关系密切，13—16世纪间吸收了这两个邻族的南部余部，其萨莫吉蒂亚话仍是立陶宛语中差异最大的方言。两百多年里，他们始终处在对抗十字军骑士团的最前线：1236年在索莱战役歼灭佩剑兄弟会，1260年又在杜尔贝击溃条顿与立窝尼亚联军。萨莫吉蒂亚曾多次在条约中被割让给骑士团、又多次被夺回；1398年维陶塔斯依《萨利纳斯条约》将其割让，但当地人于1401年和1409年两度起义，萨莫吉蒂亚部队还参加了1410年决定性的格伦瓦德战役。他们是欧洲最后接受基督教的族群，迟至1413年才受洗，1422年的《梅尔诺条约》最终划定了他们与骑士团的边界。此后萨莫吉蒂亚作为立陶宛大公国内自治的萨莫吉蒂亚公国存在，其贵族长期坚持使用立陶宛语；18世纪末随联邦瓜分转入俄国统治。

en: The Sanavirones, also called Salavinones, were an Indigenous people of central Argentina whose ancestors split from the Tonokote around the Salavina district of Santiago del Estero. In the fifteenth century, under pressure of growing numbers and prolonged drought, they spread southwest into the Sierras of Córdoba, taking land from the Comechingones; their territory ran from the Salado River in the north to the Suquía River and the Mar Chiquita lagoon in the south, and as far west as the Sumampa hills. They farmed with Andean techniques, supplemented them with hunting and fishing, and lived in large communal huts of branches and grass, each housing several families. Potters made both grey-black and engraved wares, and men fought with the macana, a heavy wooden club. Though never conquered by the Inca, they took in many Quechua words after 1480 through captives held among them. The first Spaniards to meet them, in the sixteenth century, called them Yugitas; mixing with settlers began early, and by the eighteenth century the Sanavirones had ceased to exist as a separate people. Their language, once used as a common tongue in colonial administration, survives only in six or seven recorded words.
zh: 萨纳维龙人又称萨拉维农人，是阿根廷中部的原住民，其先民在圣地亚哥-德尔埃斯特罗的萨拉维纳一带从托诺科特人中分化出来。15世纪时，因人口增长和长期干旱的压力，他们向西南扩张到科尔多瓦山脉，夺取了科梅钦贡人的土地；其领地北起萨拉多河，南至苏基亚河和小海潟湖，西达苏潘帕丘陵。他们采用安第斯式农耕技术，兼事狩猎和渔捞，住在树枝和茅草搭成的大型公共棚屋里，每座棚屋容纳数个家庭。陶工生产灰黑陶和刻纹陶两类陶器，男子作战使用沉重的木棒“马卡纳”。他们虽从未被印加征服，却在1480年后通过族中收容的俘虏吸收了大量克丘亚语词汇。16世纪最早接触他们的西班牙人称之为胡吉塔人；他们与殖民者的混血开始得很早，到18世纪已不再作为独立民族存在。他们的语言在殖民时代曾充当通用语，却只留下六七个有记录的词。
