The same contact era brought smallpox, measles and other new diseases, to which Oregon coastal peoples had no acquired immunity and which carried off between three-quarters and nine-tenths of many of their populations.
zh: 图图特尼人是俄勒冈州西南部讲阿萨巴斯卡语的一群原住民，是罗格河下游诸部中最主要的一支，同群的还有上科基尔人和沙斯塔科斯塔人。他们的村庄散布在太平洋沿岸罗格河及其支流一带，北起科基尔河，南至切特科河，包括图图顿、纳尔图内、米科诺顿、夸塔米等分支。他们的罗格河下游语言又称图图特尼语，属于纳-德内语系的俄勒冈阿萨巴斯卡语支，每个分支各有自己的方言。18世纪末，英国、西班牙和美国的船只开始勘探这段海岸；1792年春，图图特尼村民见到了乔治·温哥华船长的探险队，商人随后接踵而至，收购海獭皮。同一接触时代也带来了天花、麻疹等新疫病，俄勒冈沿岸各族对此毫无免疫力，许多群体因此损失了四分之三乃至九成的人口。

en: The Tuvaluans are the Polynesian people of nine low coral atolls and reef islands strung across the western Pacific, of which eight were inhabited in pre-contact times, giving Tuvalu its name of eight standing together. Their ancestors spread out from Samoa, with some islands such as Nanumea recalling founders from Tonga, and the atolls served as a stepping stone for Polynesian voyagers settling the outliers of Melanesia and Micronesia; canoes kept up regular traffic with Samoa and Tonga, whose Tuʻi Tonga empire drew Tuvalu into its sphere in the thirteenth century. Their creation story tells of the Eel and the Flounder, who shaped the flat atolls and the coconut palms. The first European to sight the islands was Álvaro de Mendaña, who passed Nui on 16 January 1568 and charted it as Isla de Jesús, and he sailed past Niulakita in 1595. Commodore Byron followed in 1765, naming the atolls the Lagoon Islands, and the Spaniard Francisco Mourelle charted Nanumea in 1781. After Arent de Peyster named Funafuti Ellice's Island in 1819, the whole group became known to Europeans as the Ellice Islands, while American whalers began calling from 1821.
zh: 图瓦卢人是散居在西太平洋九座低矮珊瑚环礁和礁岛上的波利尼西亚人，其中八座在欧洲人到来之前已有人居住，图瓦卢之名即意为八岛并立。他们的祖先主要从萨摩亚扩散而来，纳努梅阿等岛则传说始祖来自汤加；这些环礁还是波利尼西亚航海者迁居美拉尼西亚和密克罗尼西亚飞地的跳板，独木舟与萨摩亚、汤加往来不绝，13世纪时图瓦卢被纳入图伊汤加帝国的势力范围。他们的创世神话讲述鳗鱼与比目鱼造出平坦环礁和椰子树的故事。最早望见群岛的欧洲人是阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚，他于1568年1月16日经过努伊，将其标为耶稣岛，1595年又航经纽拉基塔。拜伦准将1765年继至，把环礁命名为潟湖群岛，西班牙人弗朗西斯科·莫雷列1781年测绘了纳努梅阿。1819年，阿伦特·德派斯特把富纳富提命名为埃利斯岛，此后整个岛群被欧洲人称作埃利斯群岛，美国捕鲸船则从1821年起开始来访。

en: The Tuvans are a Siberian Turkic people of the upper Yenisei and the Sayan Mountains, in the land that takes its name from them, Tuva. Chinese chronicles trace their ancestors to the Dingling and the Dubo of the eastern Sayan, counted among the wooden-horse Turkic tribes; the Göktürks, the Uyghur Khaganate and, after 840, the Yenisei Kyrgyz in turn ruled their pastures. In 1207 Jochi's Mongol armies brought them under Mongol suzerainty, and they were later reckoned among the Uriankhai peoples. In 1538 Dayan Khan crushed a Uriankhai revolt and dissolved their tumen, after which the Tuvan clans fell mostly to the northern Khalkha; for much of the seventeenth century they obeyed the Khalkha Altan Khan, whose camp received the first Russian envoys in 1615. As the Dzungar wars swept the region, Tuva passed under Dzungar and then Qing rule, administered as Tannu Uriankhai while Russian stockades advanced from the north. Traditionally semi-nomadic herders of reindeer, sheep and yaks living in yurts and birch-bark tents, the Tuvans kept their Turkic speech and shamanic rites, and in the eighteenth century adopted Tibetan Buddhism through Mongol contact without abandoning the old ways.
zh: 图瓦人是叶尼塞河上游、萨彦岭一带的西伯利亚突厥语民族，所居之地因他们得名图瓦。中国史籍把他们的先民上溯到丁零和东萨彦岭的都波，将其列入“木马突厥”部落；突厥汗国、回鹘汗国先后统治其牧场，840年以后又落入叶尼塞黠戛斯之手。1207年，术赤率领的蒙古大军确立了对图瓦的宗主权，后来图瓦人被归入兀良哈诸部。1538年达延汗镇压兀良哈反叛并解散其万户，图瓦诸部大多归附北喀尔喀；17世纪的大部分时间里，他们臣服于喀尔喀阿勒坦汗，1615年首批俄国使节正是在其营地受到接待。随着准噶尔战争席卷此地，图瓦先归准噶尔、后入清朝版图，被编为唐努乌梁海，而俄国的寨堡也从北方步步逼近。图瓦人传统上是放养驯鹿、绵羊和牦牛的半游牧民，住毡帐和桦树皮帐篷，保留着突厥语和萨满仪式；18世纪时，他们在蒙古人影响下改奉藏传佛教，但旧有的信仰并未消失。

en: The Great Lakes Twa, plural Batwa, are a pygmy hunter-gatherer people and the oldest surviving population of the African Great Lakes, scattered across Rwanda, Burundi, Uganda and the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. For centuries they lived as semi-nomadic forest hunter-gatherers in small, strongly egalitarian bands that stored no surplus, and unlike most other pygmy peoples they also made pottery for their farming neighbors. From at least the 1300s they came under the domination of agricultural peoples: Bantu-speaking Hutu are held to have entered the region between the 1000s and 1300s and subjugated the local Twa, and in the 1400s pastoral Tutsi overlords in turn built up the three-order society of the Rwanda kingdom. The Twa nevertheless kept a distinct place at court: they served the Tutsi kings as entertainers and executioners, some held the title of sub-chief, one clan was ennobled, and their knowledge of forest plants and their supposed shamanic power made them figures both admired and feared. They speak the Bantu languages of their neighbors, among them Rwanda and Rundi.
zh: 大湖地区特瓦人（复数称巴特瓦）是俾格米狩猎采集族群，也是非洲大湖地区现存最古老的居民，散居在卢旺达、布隆迪、乌干达和刚果民主共和国东部。多少个世纪里，他们以半游牧的森林狩猎采集为生，结成高度平等、不积余粮的小群；与其他俾格米人不同，他们还为邻近的农耕村民制陶。至少从14世纪起，特瓦人陆续被农耕民族支配：一般认为说班图语的胡图人在11至14世纪进入这一地区，征服了当地特瓦人；15世纪，从事游牧的图西霸主又建立起卢旺达王国三级社会的秩序。但特瓦人在宫廷中保有独特位置：他们为图西国王充当艺人、行刑人，有些人还出任副酋长，其中一个氏族受封贵族；他们对森林植物的知识和被信以为真的萨满神力，也使他们既受钦佩又令人生畏。他们使用邻族的班图语言，其中包括卢旺达语和隆迪语。

en: The Twana are a group of nine related Coast Salish peoples — among them the Skokomish, Quilcene, Duckabush and Dosewallips — living along the forested shores of Hood Canal in western Puget Sound, whose Central Coast Salish language is a close relative of Lushootseed. Like other Coast Salish they spent the winters in permanent plank-house villages with sweat houses and potlatch houses and dispersed to summer camps for the salmon runs, harvesting cedar, camas, wapato, shellfish and game. Rank was displayed through the potlatch, where sponsors gave away blankets, dentalia, canoes and even slaves, and shamans cured illness by recovering lost souls. Maritime fur traders seeking sea otter pelts made the first European contact around 1788, and the sea otter had been nearly hunted out by 1792, after which Hood Canal saw almost no outsiders for roughly thirty years. The epidemics that swept the Puget Sound region in those decades nevertheless reached the Twana as well, thinning their villages before the treaty period began.
zh: 特瓦纳是九个彼此亲缘的海岸萨利什族群的合称，包括斯科科米什人、奎尔森人、达卡布什人、多西瓦利普斯人等，住在皮吉特湾西部林木茂密的胡德运河沿岸；他们的语言属于中部海岸萨利什语，与卢舒特西德语近亲。和其他海岸萨利什人一样，他们冬天住在有蒸汽屋和散财宴屋的固定木板房村落里，夏天则分散到营地赶鲑鱼汛，取用雪松、卡马夏、慈姑、贝类和猎物。地位通过散财宴展示，主办人在宴会上分发毛毯、角贝、独木舟甚至奴隶，萨满则通过找回失落的灵魂来治病。约1788年，搜寻海獭皮的海上毛皮商人首次与他们接触，到1792年海獭已近乎被捕绝，此后约三十年间胡德运河几乎再无外人到来。但那些年里席卷皮吉特湾地区的疫病同样波及特瓦纳人，在条约时代开始之前就削弱了他们的村落。

en: The Txapakura are the Chapacuran-speaking peoples of the Guaporé and Mamoré basins on the Brazil-Bolivia border, whose principal surviving groups are the Wariʼ, whose name means we, people, the Oro Win, Torá and Moré. They were semi-nomadic riverside villagers who moved every few years, grew maize in swiddens on terra preta soils and built a separate men's house.
zh: 查帕库拉人是巴西与玻利维亚边境瓜波雷河、马莫雷河流域使用查帕库拉语族诸语言的族群总称，现存主要支系有瓦里人（其族名意为我们、人）、奥罗温人、托拉人和莫雷人。他们是半游牧的河畔村民，每隔数年便迁居一次，在黑土上用游耕方式种植玉米，并在村中另建男子屋。

en: The Tzeltal, who call themselves Winik Atel, are a Maya people of the Chiapas highlands in southern Mexico. Their Tzeltal speech forms, together with Tzotzil, the Tzeltalan branch of the Mayan language family, and the two languages began to diverge around 1200. They descend from the builders of the Classic Maya cities, and after the lowland kingdoms collapsed their pre-Hispanic society was stratified into nobles, commoners and slaves and divided among as many as forty-five autonomous political units. Spanish soldiers and missionaries reached Chiapas between 1524 and 1545, and through most of the colonial era Tzeltal villages were forced to supply labour for mines, mills and haciendas. The people lived by maize farming and textile work in self-governing communities, blending Catholic rites with native beliefs and shamanic healing. In 1824 Chiapas separated from Guatemala and joined the new Mexican republic, while highland families kept their language and customary authorities.
zh: 维尼卡特尔人（学界通称泽套人）是墨西哥南部恰帕斯高地的玛雅民族。他们所说的泽套语与索西语共同构成玛雅语系的采尔塔尔语支，两种语言约在1200年前后分化。他们是古典期玛雅诸城建造者的后裔，低地王国衰落后，其前殖民社会分为贵族、平民和奴隶，政治上分裂为多达四十五个自治单位。1524至1545年间，西班牙军队和传教士进入恰帕斯，整个殖民时代的大部分时间里，泽套人的村落都被迫为矿山、作坊和大庄园提供劳役。他们在自治村务农种玉米、纺织为生，将天主教仪式与本土信仰和萨满医术糅合在一起。1824年恰帕斯脱离危地马拉，加入新生的墨西哥共和国，高地家族则保留了自己的语言和传统权威。

en: The Sotz'leb, better known as the Tzotzil, are a Maya people of the central Chiapas highlands, whose principal towns include Zinacantán and Chamula. Their name derives from sotz', the bat, and they call their language Bats'i k'op, the true language. Together with the Tzeltal, their ancestors entered Chiapas between 100 BCE and 300 CE, and their speech descends from the proto-Ch'ol used at the late Classic cities of Palenque and Yaxchilán. On the eve of the conquest their society of nobles, commoners and slaves formed at least seven small polities under hilltop ajaw rulers, exporting quetzal feathers and amber to Aztec Tenochtitlán and trading salt from the wells of Ixtapa. In 1522 the lord of Zinacantán submitted to the Spaniards and helped Luis Marín subdue neighboring tribes, while Chamula resisted and was abandoned; disease, forced resettlement and encomienda vassalage greatly reduced their numbers. Colonial labour exactions provoked revolts in 1528 and 1712, and in 1824 their highlands passed with Chiapas from Guatemala to Mexico.
zh: 索茨莱布人（通称索西人）是墨西哥恰帕斯州中部高地的玛雅民族，主要城镇有锡纳坎坦和查穆拉。其族名来自本族语言中“蝙蝠”一词，他们又把自己的语言称为“真正的语言”。他们与泽套人的先民在公元前100年至公元300年间进入恰帕斯，语言源自古典期晚期帕伦克和亚克斯奇兰一带使用的原始乔尔语。征服前夕，其社会由贵族、平民和奴隶构成，分成至少七个由山顶城邦首领统辖的小政权，向阿兹特克人的特诺奇蒂特兰出口格查尔鸟羽和琥珀，并贩运伊斯塔帕盐井出产的食盐。1522年锡纳坎坦领主向西班牙人归顺，并协助路易斯·马林征服邻族，查穆拉人则奋起抵抗后弃城而去；疫病、强制迁徙和监护征赋制下的封臣地位使人口大减。殖民时代的劳役压榨引发了1528年和1712年的起义，1824年他们所在的高地随恰帕斯从危地马拉划归墨西哥。

en: The Tz'utujil are a Maya people of the Guatemalan highlands, holding the southern shore of Lake Atitlán in Sololá and cacao-growing lowlands in Suchitepéquez. According to the Popol Vuh their ancestors came from the mythic city of Tollan around the dawn of the thirteenth century, and they built their capital Chiaa on the fortified hill of Chuitinamit above the lake, ruled by a lord bearing the title Ahtz'iquinahay. In the fifteenth century the K'iche' king K'iq'ab crushed their attempts to expand westward and reduced them to the K'iche' sphere. When Pedro de Alvarado invaded in 1523 with Kaqchikel allies, Tz'utujil warriors under Tepepul had already fought beside the K'iche' captain Tecún Umán; Alvarado defeated them near Panajachel in 1524 and the Ahtz'iquinahay, baptized Pedro, submitted and founded the new town of Santiago Atitlán. Franciscans moved the people down from the old hill capital and set up cofradías from 1533, while introduced diseases and gold mining cut the population from some 72,000 in 1520 to little more than 5,000 by 1550.
zh: 楚图希尔人是危地马拉高地的玛雅族群，据有索洛拉省阿蒂特兰湖南岸以及苏奇特佩克斯省种植可可的低地。据《波波尔·乌》记载，其先民约在13世纪初从神话之城图兰迁来，在湖畔险要的楚伊蒂纳米特山上建起都城奇亚，统治者号称“鸟屋之主”阿齐基纳哈伊。15世纪，基切国王基亚布以武力粉碎了他们向西扩张的企图，将其纳入基切的势力范围。1523年佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多联合卡克奇克尔人入侵时，楚图希尔武士已在特佩普尔率领下随基切将领特昆·乌曼作过战；1524年阿尔瓦拉多在帕纳哈切尔附近击败他们，受洗取名佩德罗的阿齐基纳哈伊臣服，另建新城圣地亚哥阿蒂特兰。方济各会修士把居民从山上的旧都迁下，自1533年起设立兄弟会组织；与此同时，传入的疫病和淘金劳役使人口从1520年约七万二千锐减到1550年的五千出头。

en: Uakambalelté is the name the Vilela people gave themselves, meaning those who speak Waqha, their native language, which was divided into the Chinipi, Sinipi and Ocol dialects. Their culture stood between those of the Andes, the Pampas and Cuyo, and by the fifteenth century they ranged over the north of Tucumán and Santiago del Estero and the east of Salta. They were nomadic hunters and gatherers who took peccary, carob pods and wild honey. The Spanish conquest of Tucumán pushed them east into the Gran Chaco, where they lived in a number of subgroups. During the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries the horse-riding Guaycuru peoples expanded across the Chaco and drove them still farther east toward the Paraná River. The Jesuits, whose missions among them included San José de las Petacas founded in 1735 and two further foundations of 1763, worked in their lands until the expulsion of the order in 1767 and 1768.
zh: 瓦坎巴莱尔特是比莱拉人的自称，意为“说瓦卡语的人”；他们的母语瓦卡语分为奇尼皮、西尼皮和奥科尔三种方言。其文化介于安第斯、潘帕斯和库约三种类型之间，到15世纪时，他们活动在图库曼和圣地亚哥-德尔埃斯特罗以北以及萨尔塔东部一带。瓦坎巴莱尔特人是游牧的狩猎采集者，猎取西貒，采集角豆荚和野蜂蜜。西班牙人征服图库曼后，他们向东退入大查科，分成若干支系生活。17至18世纪，学会骑马的瓜伊库鲁诸部在查科扩张，又把他们进一步向东逼向巴拉那河。耶稣会在他们的土地上建立了多处传教区，包括1735年建立的圣何塞-德拉什佩塔卡斯以及1763年建立的另外两处，直到1767至1768年耶稣会被驱逐为止。

en: The Goragir were an Evenki band of the Uchami, a left tributary of the Lower Tunguska, whose camps around Nidym and Tutonchany later lay in the Ilimpiyskiy district. They were nomadic reindeer herders and sable hunters of the far northern taiga, counted as Tungus tribute payers after Cossacks reached the Yenisei in the early seventeenth century.
zh: 乌恰米人是乌恰米河流域的鄂温克游猎群，在尼德姆、图图恩恰内一带的营地后来属于伊利姆皮耶区；乌恰米河是下通古斯河的左支流。他们是极北林区的驯鹿牧民和紫貂猎手，17世纪初哥萨克抵达叶尼塞河后，被列为缴纳毛皮贡的通古斯部落之一。

en: The Udege are a Tungusic forest people of the Sikhote-Alin mountains and the right-bank tributaries of the Ussuri and Amur, whose self-name means “people of the forest”. Chinese dynasties knew them under a succession of names: Jin records called them the Wudigai, the “wild people” of the far northeast, Ming writers counted them among the Wild Jurchen under the name Wudiha, and Qing documents called them the Kiyakara, or sable-catching people. They had no script and lived in clans led by elected elders, the men hunting elk and sable while the band also fished and gathered ginseng; their animism centred on kinship with the bear and the Ussuri tiger, on shamans and on air burial. In 1343 the Wozhe wild people of the Liaoyang region rose against the Yuan, and in 1346 they rebelled again together with the Shui Dada when officials pressed them for gyrfalcons. In the early 1600s Nurhaci campaigned against the Woji forest bands and brought them into the nascent Qing order, under which they tendered a sable tribute every two years in exchange for court gifts. Russian explorers at first treated them as one people with the Oroch.
zh: 乌德盖是锡霍特山脉和乌苏里江、黑龙江右岸支流一带的通古斯语森林民族，自称意为“林中人”。中国历代文献对他们有一连串称呼：金代称兀的改，视为东北极边的“野人”；明代把他们归入野人女真，称兀狄哈；清代文献则称恰喀拉，又叫捕貂鼠人。他们没有文字，以氏族为单位游猎，由推举的长老统领，男子猎马鹿和紫貂，群体兼事捕鱼和采参，信仰萨满教与万物有灵，崇拜熊和乌苏里虎，并实行风葬。1343年，辽阳的兀者野人起兵反元；1346年又因官府强索海东青，兀者野人与水达达再度反叛。17世纪初，努尔哈赤征讨窝集人，把这些森林部落纳入兴起中的清朝秩序，此后他们每两年向朝廷贡貂，换取朝廷的回赐。俄国探险家起初把他们与奥罗奇人视为同一群体，很久以后才将两者区分开来。

en: The Udmurts are a Permian people of the Uralic family, the autochthonous forest dwellers of the middle Kama and Vyatka basins, whose name odo-mort means meadow people and whom Russian sources long called Votyaks. Their line runs from the Iron Age Ananyino culture through the Pyanobor and Azelino cultures; pressed first by the Mari and then by Slavic settlers on the Vyatka, they gradually withdrew to the river's left bank in the early second millennium. Their southern kin, the ary of the Arsk land, paid tribute to the Volga Bulgars and later served the governors of the Golden Horde, while the northern vatka groups neighboured Khlynov, core of the fourteenth-century Vyatka veche republic. Moscow's annexation of Vyatka in 1489 brought the northern Udmurts under its rule, and after the fall of Kazan in 1552, when tsarist troops harried the Arsk country for ten days, the southern Udmurts were enrolled as yasak tribute-payers; by 1600 their settlement area had taken its later shape, the Cheptsa valley being opened together with the Besermyan. Clan-organised, they lived as semi-nomadic hunters and riverside farmers, served by a pagan priesthood of the sky god Inmar and hearth spirit Voršud in sacred groves, and their national epic is the Dorvyzhy. Under the Vyatka governorate from 1796, they kept their grove rites even after Orthodox feast days entered their calendar; a European survey of the Russian empire had already devoted a chapter to them as the Wotyak in 1776.
zh: 乌德穆尔特人是乌拉尔语系彼尔姆语支的民族，世居卡马河与维亚特卡河中游的林地，族名“乌德穆尔特”意为“草地之人”，俄罗斯文献旧称沃佳克人。他们的谱系从铁器时代的阿南因诺文化，经皮亚诺博尔文化、阿泽利诺文化延续而来；先受到马里人排挤，后来斯拉夫人又进入维亚特卡河流域，遂在第二个千年初期逐渐退居维亚特卡河左岸。南部的乌德穆尔特人即阿尔斯克之地的“阿尔人”，向伏尔加保加尔人纳贡，后来又为金帐汗国的总督效力；北部的瓦特卡群体则与赫雷诺夫为邻，后者是14世纪维亚特卡韦切共和国的核心。1489年莫斯科吞并维亚特卡，北部乌德穆尔特人随之入俄；1552年喀山陷落、沙皇军队蹂躏阿尔斯克地方十日之后，南部乌德穆尔特人被登记为缴纳牙萨克的贡民。到1600年前后，他们的分布区已大致定型，切普察河谷是与贝谢尔曼人共同开发的。乌德穆尔特人以氏族为组织，过着半游猎与河畔农耕生活，异教祭司在圣林中侍奉天神因马尔和家灶守护神沃尔舒德，他们的民族史诗是《多尔维日》。1796年起全境隶属维亚特卡省，东正教节庆进入他们的历法之后，圣林仪式仍得以保留；早在1776年，一部介绍俄罗斯帝国各民族的欧洲著作就以沃佳克之名为他们单列一章。

en: The Ughele are an Oceanic-speaking people of Rendova, a volcanic island in the New Georgia group of the Solomon Islands, occupying its northern tip. Their language, also called Ugele, has no internal dialect divisions and is one of the Oceanic tongues of the western Solomons.
zh: 乌格勒人是所罗门群岛新乔治亚群岛的火山岛伦多瓦岛北部上说大洋洲语的族群。他们的语言又称乌盖莱语，内部没有方言分化，是所罗门群岛西部的大洋洲语言之一。

en: The Uitoto, also called Witoto or Murui-Muinane, are an Amazonian people whose original homeland lay in the middle Caquetá River basin and the rainforest stretching toward the Putumayo, in territory now divided between Colombia and Peru. They were once a constellation of more than thirty tribes and around a hundred villages, grouped into the western Murui, the eastern Muinane, who were largely absorbed into the Murui, and the Meneca of the Putumayo. Society followed the father's line, and several families shared a single communal longhouse, the maloca, each with its own sector and hammocks. Men gathered in the maloca to take mambe, a powder of coca leaf and yarumo ash, while great maguare drums carried messages between settlements for kilometers through the forest. Their language belongs to the Bora-Huitoto family. Their first fleeting contacts with Europeans came in the early 1600s, and outside intrusion remained sporadic through the rest of the colonial period.
zh: 乌伊托托人又称维托托人或穆鲁伊-穆伊纳内人，是亚马孙地区的原住民，故地在卡克塔河中游流域及向普图马约河延伸的雨林，今分属哥伦比亚和秘鲁两国。他们曾是由三十多个部落、上百个村落组成的族群联合体，主要分为西部的穆鲁伊人、东部多被穆鲁伊人吸纳的穆伊纳内人，以及普图马约河畔的梅内卡人。社会按父系血缘组织，数个家庭共居在名为马洛卡的公社长屋中，各家拥有自己的区域和吊床。男子聚在长屋里吸用曼贝，即古柯叶与亚鲁莫木灰磨成的粉末；巨大的马瓜雷鼓能在森林中把信息传到数公里外的村落之间。他们的语言属于博拉-维托托语系。17世纪初，他们与欧洲人有了最初的短暂接触，而在整个殖民时代余下的时间里，外界的渗入始终时断时续。

en: The Arara, who call themselves Ukarãgmã, “people of the red macaw”, are a Cariban-speaking people of the Brazilian interior, holding the forests along the Iriri river near where it joins the Xingu, in what is now the state of Pará. They lived as nomadic hunter-gatherers, moving through the forest in small bands but gathering in large communal houses built of wood and palm thatch; they hunted and fished and planted manioc, sweet potatoes, bananas and pineapples in forest clearings. Feared as warriors who kept war trophies, they also intermarried freely with neighbouring tribes, and for rituals they painted their bodies with bold black designs drawn from genipapo fruit. As Portuguese settlement spread along the lower Amazon in the 1600s and 1700s, they remained upriver beyond colonial reach, keeping their autonomy in the forest.
zh: 阿拉拉人自称乌卡朗芒，意为“红金刚鹦鹉之民”，是巴西内陆使用加勒比语族语言的族群，居住在今帕拉州境内伊里里河汇入欣古河一带的森林中。他们以游猎采集为生，小群体在林中迁徙，聚会时则住进木柱与棕榈叶搭成的大型公共屋舍；人们狩猎捕鱼，还在林间空地种植木薯、甘薯、香蕉和菠萝。阿拉拉人以善战和保存战利品闻名，也常与邻近部落通婚；举行仪式时，他们用吉尼帕波果汁制成的黑色颜料在身上绘出浓烈的图案。17至18世纪，葡萄牙人的定居点沿亚马逊下游扩展，阿拉拉人仍居于上游林地，处在殖民势力范围之外，保持着自身的自主。

en: The Ulch, who call themselves nani, are a fishing people of the lower Amur valley, settled in small villages on the river's right bank where the annual salmon runs set the rhythm of the year; their Ulch language belongs to the Nanai branch of Tungusic, and Chinese accounts classed them as the Hezhen group that did not shave the front of the head. Their ancestry reaches back to the ancient coastal population of Northeast Asia, and their economy rested on salmon, dried in strips for winter, supplemented by sable hunting and by catching seals and sea lions. They wintered in solid log-frame houses and moved into bark-covered summer huts when the fishing season began. Russian explorers first recorded the Ulch in the 1600s, after which their sable furs entered the Russian fur trade.
zh: 乌尔奇人自称“那尼”，是黑龙江下游以捕鱼为生的定居民族，村落散布在干流右岸，每年鲑鱼洄游的节律决定了他们一年的生计；乌尔奇语属通古斯语系南通古斯语族的赫哲语支，汉文记载把他们视作赫哲的一支，即不剃发的黑斤。他们的先民可追溯到东北亚沿海古老的土著人群，经济以鲑鱼为主，捕来的鱼切成条风干储存，兼猎紫貂、捕海豹和海狮。冬天他们住木构架的固定住房，渔季来临时搬进树皮覆盖的棚屋。俄国人在17世纪首次记载到乌尔奇人，此后他们的紫貂皮也进入了俄国的毛皮贸易。

en: The Ulwa are the southernmost of the Misumalpan-speaking peoples grouped under the name Mayangna, or Sumu, living along the rivers of eastern Nicaragua, above all around the Río Grande de Matagalpa. The name ulwa first appears in a Spanish document of 1586, recorded in half a dozen spellings including ulba and wulwa. When the English reached the Mosquito Coast in the 1630s, the Ulwa and their Mayangna kin were divided among several sub-tribes holding much of the coast and its interior. Firearms traded to the Miskito then turned the balance of power: Miskito raiding parties carried off Ulwa captives for sale in Jamaica and forced a retreat upriver, while coastal survivors paid tribute to the Miskito king crowned by the English in 1660. Through the eighteenth century the Ulwa kept to remote river basins, living by shifting cultivation, hunting and fishing, as their own language came under growing pressure from Miskito.
zh: 乌尔瓦人是归入马扬格纳（又称苏莫）名下的米苏马尔潘语各族中位置最南的一支，住在尼加拉瓜东部的河流沿岸，以马塔加尔帕大河一带为中心。乌尔瓦一名最早见于1586年的西班牙文献，当时有乌尔巴、武尔瓦等五六种拼法。17世纪30年代英国人到达莫斯基托海岸时，乌尔瓦人与马扬格纳亲族分成若干部落，占据着海岸和内陆的大片土地。流入米斯基托人手中的火枪改变了力量对比：米斯基托袭掠队掳走乌尔瓦人贩卖到牙买加，迫使他们向河流上游退避，留在沿海的人则要向1660年由英国人加冕的米斯基托国王纳贡。整个18世纪，乌尔瓦人退守偏远的河流流域，以轮耕、狩猎和渔捞为生，他们的语言也日益受到米斯基托语的挤压。

en: The Umboi are the people of Umboi, a volcanic island of the Siassi Group lying between New Guinea's Huon Peninsula and New Britain across the Vitiaz and Dampier straits. Their language, Kovai, is a Papuan tongue spoken mostly within the island's large caldera, although the island's villages also use several Austronesian languages.
zh: 翁博伊人居住在翁博伊岛上；该岛是西亚西群岛中的一座火山岛，隔维蒂亚兹海峡和丹皮尔海峡与新几内亚的休恩半岛及新不列颠岛相望。他们使用的科瓦伊语是一种巴布亚语言，主要通行于岛上巨大的破火山口内，不过岛上村落也使用几种南岛语系语言。

en: The Umiida, also written Umida or Umede, were an Aboriginal Australian people of the Kimberley region of north Western Australia, living on the coast and islands north of the Warrwa around the Meda River. They spoke a western dialect of Worrorra, one of the Worrorran languages. A nomadic rafter people, they harvested the maritime resources of the many islands off their shore in company with the neighbouring Djaui and Unggarranggu, tribes with whom they kept amicable relations, sailing rafts built from mangrove timber. The first European ship to reach their coastal waters was the Cygnet, when William Dampier explored the adjoining King Sound in 1688.
zh: 乌米达人（又作乌梅德）是西澳大利亚州北部金伯利地区的澳大利亚原住民，住在梅达河一带、瓦尔瓦人以北的海岸与岛屿上。他们讲沃罗拉语的一种西部方言，属沃罗拉语系。乌米达人是逐岛而居的游牧筏民，与相邻的焦维人和翁加兰吉人交好，结伴乘坐红树林木材造的木筏，在沿海众多岛屿上获取海产。第一艘驶入他们近海的欧洲船只是‘西格尼特号’，1688年威廉·丹皮尔乘它考察了毗邻的金湾。

en: The Umpila are an Aboriginal people of the north-eastern Cape York Peninsula in Queensland, whose traditional country ran along the Coral Sea coast from Temple Bay south towards Princess Charlotte Bay and inland as far as Coen. They call themselves Umpila pama malngkanichi, people of the sand beach, and belong to the Kawadji family of coastal peoples, living by fishing, reef gathering and seasonal inland foraging. Their speech is a North Cape York Paman language, split into several dialects and accompanied by a developed sign language. Their society was divided into two exogamous patrilineal moieties, kaapay and kuyan, the same two categories being used to classify plants and animals, and strict avoidance rules governed speech with certain in-laws. Captain Cook charted their coast in 1770; the uprooting of the Umpila to the Lockhart River settlement came only in the twentieth century.
zh: 乌姆皮拉人是昆士兰约克角半岛东北部的原住民，传统领地沿珊瑚海海岸展开，北起坦普尔湾，南至夏洛特公主湾附近，向西深入到科恩一带。他们自称“乌姆皮拉沙滩人”，属沿海“沙滩人”文化群体，以捕鱼、礁盘采集和按季转往内陆觅食为生。他们的语言属北约克角帕马语组，分为数种方言，还配有一套发达的手语。社会分为两个外婚制父系半偶族，连动植物也用这两个范畴分类；与某些姻亲说话则有严格的回避规矩。1770年库克船长测绘了这段海岸；乌姆皮拉人被强行迁往洛克哈特河定居点，则是20世纪的事了。

en: The Unalachtigo were the southernmost and least-recorded division of the Lenape, or Delaware Indians. Their name, a Munsee word often glossed as “people who live down by the water,” was applied to the Unami-speaking bands of west-central and southern New Jersey and the adjacent Lehigh Valley of Pennsylvania, whose villages included the Sankhikan on the Delaware and the Kechemeche of the Cape May peninsula between the Atlantic and Delaware Bay. Linguists debate whether their speech was a distinct dialect or simply northern Unami, and the Moravian missionaries grouped them with the so-called Forks Indians around Easton. Their coastal life leaned heavily on the rivers, bays and ocean: men netted fish and dug clams, hunted deer in the pine woods with fire drives, and traded beaver and otter pelts and shell wampum, while women raised maize, beans and squash in the Lenape manner and families lived in wigwam villages sometimes palisaded against attack. Contact around 1600 was peaceful at first, but disease, land pressure and absorption into colonial settlements shrank the communities fast; the Kechemeche ceased to exist as a separate people by 1735. The survivors shared the general Lenape fate of the Walking Purchase of 1737 and the Treaty of Easton of 1758, some ending up at New Jersey’s Brotherton reservation before the westward removals through Pennsylvania and Ohio ultimately carried Lenape families to Oklahoma and Ontario.
zh: 乌纳拉奇戈人是莱纳佩人（特拉华人）三支中位置最南、记载最少的一支。其名称来自蒙西语，常被解释为“临水而居的人”，用来指新泽西西中部和南部以及邻近的宾州利哈伊河谷一带说乌纳米语的各群体，村落包括特拉华河畔的桑希坎和大西洋与特拉华湾之间开普梅半岛上的凯克梅切。语言学家一直争论他们的话是独立方言还是只是北乌纳米方言，摩拉维亚传教士则把他们与伊斯顿附近所谓“福克斯印第安人”归为一类。滨海生活使他们高度依赖河流、海湾和海洋：男子撒网捕鱼、挖蛤，在松林里用火围猎鹿，交易河狸皮、水獭皮和贝珠；妇女按莱纳佩传统种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，全家住在围有栅栏的棚屋村落里。1600年前后与欧洲人初次接触时还算和平，但疫病、土地压力和被殖民社群同化使这些群体迅速萎缩，到1735年凯克梅切人已不再作为独立群体存在。幸存者经历了全体莱纳佩人共同的命运：1737年的“步行购地”和1758年的《伊斯顿条约》，一部分人被安置到新泽西的布拉泽敦保留地，随后又经宾州、俄亥俄西迁，最终有莱纳佩家庭被带到俄克拉荷马和安大略。

en: The Unangax̂ — the Unangan of the eastern dialects, commonly called Aleuts — are the Indigenous people of the Aleutian island chain, and this grouping covers the Fox Island communities centred on Unalaska, where human occupation reaches back roughly nine thousand years. In 1759 the islands of Unalaska and Amaknak alone held twenty-four settlements with more than a thousand inhabitants. Their life was organized around the sea: they hunted seals, sea lions and whales from the covered kayaks called iqyax, fished the cold coastal waters, and wintered in semi-subterranean houses known as ulax. The Russian fur trader Stepan Glotov reached Unalaska in 1759, and harsh tribute demands provoked an uprising between 1763 and 1766 in which the Aleuts destroyed four Russian ships; a permanent Russian post nevertheless opened in 1774 and later passed to the Russian-American Company. The Orthodox priest Ivan Veniaminov, later Saint Innocent of Alaska, built the Church of the Holy Ascension in 1825 and devised the first writing system for Unangam Tunuu, the Aleut language, while epidemic disease in the later 1830s sharply reduced the population of the island.
zh: 乌南甘人即东部方言的乌南甘人，通称阿留申人，是阿留申群岛链的原住民，这一文化涵盖以乌纳拉斯卡为中心的福克斯群岛诸社区，人类在当地的居住史可追溯至约九千年前。1759年，仅乌纳拉斯卡岛和阿马克纳克岛上就有二十四个定居点、一千多名居民。他们的生活围绕海洋展开：乘坐称为“伊基亚克斯”的覆盖式皮艇捕猎海豹、海狮和鲸鱼，在寒冷的近海水域捕鱼，冬天住在半地穴式的“乌拉克斯”房屋里。俄国毛皮商人斯捷潘·格洛托夫于1759年抵达乌纳拉斯卡，沉重的贡赋激起了1763至1766年的起义，阿留申人摧毁了四艘俄国船；但俄国人仍于1774年开设常设商站，后来并入俄美公司。东正教神父伊凡·韦尼阿米诺夫（后来的阿拉斯加圣英诺森）于1825年建起圣升天教堂，并为阿留申语乌南甘话创制了第一套文字；19世纪30年代后期的瘟疫则使岛上人口锐减。

en: The Unaligmiut, or Unalirmiut, are the Central Alaskan Yup'ik people of Norton Sound, whose villages included Unalakleet and St. Michael on the south shore and Elim and Golovin on the north, and who spoke the Unaliq subdialect of Yup'ik. Their country was a meeting ground of Yup'ik, Iñupiaq and interior Athabaskan peoples, for Unalakleet, at the end of the portage route linking the sound with the Yukon River, had long been a major trade fair between coast and interior. In 1833 the Russian-American Company founded Redoubt St. Michael as a post for trade with the local Yup'ik, and later in the 1830s it added another post at Unalakleet, drawing the Unaligmiut into the Russian fur trade.
zh: 乌纳利格缪特人（又作乌纳利尔缪特人）是诺顿湾一带的中阿拉斯加尤皮克人，村庄包括南岸的尤纳拉克利特和圣迈克尔，以及北岸的埃利姆与戈洛文，使用尤皮克语的乌纳利克次方言。他们的家园是尤皮克人、因纽皮亚特人与内陆阿萨巴斯卡人交汇之地：尤纳拉克利特位于连接诺顿湾与育空河的搬运路线一端，早就是沿海与内陆之间重要的贸易集市。1833年，俄美公司建立圣迈克尔堡，作为与当地尤皮克人贸易的据点；19世纪30年代后期又在尤纳拉克利特增设贸易站，把乌纳利格缪特人卷入了俄国的毛皮贸易。

en: The Unami were the southern and largest of the three main divisions of the Lenape, or Delaware Indians, occupying the lower Delaware valley: the southern two-thirds of New Jersey, southeastern Pennsylvania around the future sites of Philadelphia and the Lehigh, and the northern part of Delaware, where their villages included Shackamaxon on the Delaware and Assunpink on the Raritan. Like all Lenape they were organized into matrilineal Wolf, Turtle and Turkey clans under village sachems advised by elder councils, lived in dispersed longhouse settlements, and grew the Three Sisters of maize, beans and squash while fishing the rivers and bays and making wampum from coastal shells. Dutch and Swedish traders reached them in the seventeenth century, and in 1682 William Penn made his famous treaty of friendship with the Lenape at Shackamaxon. Penn’s heirs abandoned that spirit: the fraudulent Walking Purchase of 1737 seized a huge tract and drove the river Lenape from their homeland, and the Treaty of Easton in 1758 pushed them west into the Ohio Country. There they settled around Coshocton and in Moravian mission towns such as Gnadenhutten, where Pennsylvania militia massacred nearly a hundred Christian Lenape in 1782 during the Revolution. Subsequent treaties carried the Unami bands through Indiana and Missouri to Kansas and finally Oklahoma, where the Delaware Nation and Delaware Tribe of Indians carry on their heritage, while a related community settled at Moraviantown in Ontario in 1792.
zh: 乌纳米人是莱纳佩人（又称特拉华人）三大分支中偏南、人数最多的一支，占据特拉华河下游地区：新泽西的南三分之二、宾州东南部今费城和利哈伊一带，以及特拉华州北部，村落包括特拉华河畔的沙卡马克森和拉里坦河畔的阿松平克。和全体莱纳佩人一样，他们按母系分为狼、龟、火鸡三大氏族，由村长和长老议事会治理，住分散的长屋村落，种植玉米、豆类、南瓜“三姐妹”，在河湾捕鱼，并用海贝制作贝珠。17世纪荷兰和瑞典商人先后来到这里，1682年威廉·佩恩在沙卡马克森与莱纳佩人缔结了著名的友好条约。但佩恩的继承人背弃了这种精神：1737年欺诈性的“步行购地”强占大片土地，把河畔的莱纳佩人赶出家园；1758年的《伊斯顿条约》又迫使他们西迁进入俄亥俄地区。他们在那里定居于科肖克顿一带以及格纳登胡滕等摩拉维亚传教镇，独立战争期间的1782年，宾州民兵在格纳登胡滕屠杀了近百名信奉基督教的莱纳佩人。此后的一系列条约把乌纳米各支经印第安纳、密苏里迁到堪萨斯，最终到达俄克拉荷马，今特拉华族和特拉华印第安部落延续着他们的传统；另有一支亲缘社群于1792年在安大略的摩拉维亚镇定居。

en: The Unggarranggu, also recorded as Unggarangi or Ongkarango, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Kimberley region of Western Australia. Together with the Yawijibaya they are the traditional owners of the Buccaneer Archipelago off the port of Derby, the two groups being known together as the Mayala. Although based on the mainland coast, they were a seafaring people on close terms with the maritime Umiida, sailing rafts lashed from mangrove wood out to islands such as Wilima off the mouth of the Meda River, close to Warrwa country. Their language belonged to the Worrorran family. The first European vessel in the neighbouring waters was the Cygnet, in which William Dampier explored King Sound in 1688.
zh: 翁加兰吉人（又记作翁加兰戈）是西澳大利亚州金伯利地区的澳大利亚原住民。他们与亚维吉巴亚人同为德比港外巴卡尼尔群岛的传统主人，两个群体合称马亚拉。他们虽以大陆海岸为根基，却擅长航海，与以海为生的乌米达人关系密切，会乘坐用红树林木材扎成的木筏，远航到梅达河口外、靠近瓦尔瓦人领地的威利马岛等地。他们的语言属于沃罗拉语系。最早驶入附近水域的欧洲船只是‘西格尼特号’，1688年威廉·丹皮尔乘它考察了金湾。

en: The Uni are the Kakataibo, better known in older records as Cashibo or Carapache, a Panoan forest people of the Peruvian Amazon who call themselves Uni. They live back from the Ucayali on the Aguaytía, San Alejandro, Shamboyacu and Sungaroyacu rivers and along tributaries of the Pachitea, having been pushed away from the main river banks, it seems, by warlike Shipibo and Conibo neighbours; their Kakataibo language belongs to the Western Panoan family. Split into the Cashiñon, Kakataibo and Ruño groups, they kept fiercely to themselves, raiding neighbouring peoples for women and blocking navigation of the Aguaytía. They joined the rebellion of Juan Santos Atahualpa in 1744 and helped destroy the missions, and when friars approached again in 1757 they killed one and chased the rest away, preserving their isolation until the end of the century and long after.
zh: 乌尼人即卡卡塔伊博人，旧文献多称卡希博人或卡拉帕切人，是秘鲁亚马孙地区的帕诺语林居民族，自称乌尼。他们远离乌卡亚利河干流，住在阿瓜伊蒂亚河、圣亚历杭德罗河、尚博亚库河、松加罗亚库河及帕奇特亚河支流一带，大概是被好战的希皮博人和科尼博人挤出了大河岸边；其卡卡塔伊博语属西帕诺语族。他们分为卡希尼翁、卡卡塔伊博和鲁尼奥三个支系，长期紧闭门户，常袭击邻族掳掠妇女，并封锁阿瓜伊蒂亚河的航道。1744年，他们加入胡安·桑托斯·阿塔瓦尔帕的起义，参与捣毁传教站；1757年修士再度前来时，他们杀死一人、逐走其余众人，从而把孤立状态保持到18世纪末乃至更久。

en: Upper Egyptians, or Sa'idis, are the people of the narrow Nile valley south of the delta, the region called in Arabic Ṣaʿīd Miṣr and studded with old river towns such as Asyut, Akhmim and Qena. Under Islamic rule the valley formed a province separate from Lower Egypt, administered from Fustat through deputies of the governor of Egypt. Its speech is Sa'idi Arabic, a group of related Upper Egyptian varieties of Egyptian Arabic, and Arabicization proceeded more slowly here than in the delta: Coptic long remained a living language in the valley and was still spoken by peasant women in the seventeenth century. In the eleventh century Hilalian pastoralists drifted west from the Sa'id into Libya and as far as Tunis. Under Mamluk and then Ottoman rule the remote valley served as a refuge and power base for rival Mamluk beys, as when Abu-l-Dhahab occupied Asyut in 1772 and the duumvirs Ibrahim and Murad Bey retreated there in 1786 ahead of an Ottoman army.
zh: 上埃及人或称赛义迪人，生活在三角洲以南狭窄的尼罗河谷地。这一地区阿拉伯语称萨伊德·米斯尔，沿河分布着艾斯尤特、艾赫米姆、基纳等古城。伊斯兰统治时期，河谷是与下埃及分立的省份，由埃及总督派驻副手从富斯塔特遥控管理。他们讲赛义迪阿拉伯语，即埃及阿拉伯语的一组上埃及方言；这里的阿拉伯化比三角洲缓慢，科普特语在河谷长期作为活语言存在，直到17世纪仍有农妇使用。11世纪，希拉勒游牧民从萨伊德向西迁徙，进入利比亚，远至突尼斯。马穆鲁克及后来的奥斯曼统治时期，偏远的河谷是失势马穆鲁克贝伊的退路和权力基地：1772年阿布·扎哈布攻占艾斯尤特，1786年易卜拉欣贝伊与穆拉德贝伊又在奥斯曼大军压境时退避于此。

en: The Upper Palatine people inhabit the wooded hill country east of Franconia, around Amberg, Neumarkt, Weissenburg and the Upper Palatine Forest, where the Northern Bavarian dialects of Upper German are spoken. In the High Middle Ages this was the Bavarian March of the Nordgau, colonized from the Agilolfing duchy along the Naab river against the Slavs and Bohemians, and it kept a frontier character of abbey lands, castles and small lordships such as Leuchtenberg. From the middle of the 1200s the Wittelsbachs held most of the region as part of the County Palatine of the Rhine, until the Treaty of Pavia of 1329 split their inheritance: the western lands on the Rhine became the Lower Palatinate, while the eastern territory centred on Amberg took the name Upper Palatinate. The Elector Palatine Frederick V's failed bid for the Bohemian crown in 1619 and 1620 cost him these lands, which the Emperor granted to the Duke of Bavaria together with the electoral title; the Peace of Westphalia in 1648 restored the Lower Palatinate to Frederick's heirs but left the Upper Palatinate with Bavaria, where it remained. The free imperial city of Regensburg was added only in 1806, and in 1837 King Ludwig I of Bavaria revived the old name by renaming the Regen district the Upper Palatinate. Through these political changes the Northern Bavarian speech of its towns and mining villages remained distinct from the Franconian dialects to the west.
zh: 上普法尔茨人居住在法兰克以东、安贝格、诺伊马克特、魏森堡和上普法尔茨森林周围的丘陵林地里，讲高地德语中的北巴伐利亚方言。中世纪盛期，这里是巴伐利亚的诺德高边区，由阿吉洛尔芬公国沿纳布河向斯拉夫人和波希米亚方向殖民开发，长期保持着修道院领地、城堡和洛伊希滕贝格这类小邦林立的边疆面貌。13世纪中叶起，维特尔斯巴赫家族把这片土地的大部分作为莱茵普法尔茨伯国的一部分统治，直到1329年《帕维亚条约》分割其遗产：莱茵河畔的西部领地成为下普法尔茨，以安贝格为中心的东部领地则得名上普法尔茨。1619至1620年，普法尔茨选帝侯腓特烈五世争夺波希米亚王冠失败，丢掉了这些土地；皇帝把它们连同选帝侯头衔一并授予巴伐利亚公爵。1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》把下普法尔茨归还腓特烈的继承人，上普法尔茨却留在巴伐利亚手中，从此再未离开。自由帝国城市雷根斯堡迟至1806年才并入，1837年巴伐利亚国王路德维希一世将雷根县改回旧名上普法尔茨。历经这些政治变迁，当地城镇和矿业村落的北巴伐利亚口音始终与西边的法兰克方言判然有别。

en: The Uru are an ancient lacustrine people of the Collao plateau, scattered across the lakes and rivers of what is now Bolivia and Peru, from Lake Titicaca and the Desaguadero to Lakes Poopó and Coipasa, with enclaves reaching towards the Pacific-facing valleys. Calling themselves men of the water, they believed they owned the lake; the name uru was given to them by their Aymara neighbours. They lived by fishing and bird hunting, built movable floating islands and reed boats from totora reeds, and also kept fields and llama herds beyond the reed beds. Their main groups were the Iruito, Murato and Chipaya, the last by the Salar de Coipasa. Older than both Aymara and Quechua polities, they were subdued by the Inca Empire, which taxed them and often reduced them to servitude. Under Inca and later Spanish pressure most groups abandoned the Uru tongue for Aymara by the early sixteenth century; only the Chipaya language survived. From 1722 the Uru of Lake Poopó waged a long legal and territorial struggle against neighbouring Aymara communities.
zh: 乌鲁人是科利亚奥高原古老的水上族群，散布在今玻利维亚和秘鲁的湖泊河流之间，从的的喀喀湖、德萨瓜德罗河到波波湖和科伊帕萨湖，还有一些飞地延伸到太平洋坡向的河谷。他们自称“水之人”，相信自己拥有湖泊，“乌鲁”本是艾马拉邻居对他们的称呼。他们以捕鱼和猎鸟为生，用托托拉芦苇建造可移动的浮岛和芦苇船，也在苇荡之外耕种田地、放牧羊驼。主要支派有伊鲁伊托、穆拉托和奇帕亚，后者居住在科伊帕萨盐沼旁。乌鲁人的历史比艾马拉和克丘亚政权都更古老，后来被印加帝国征服，承担赋税，还常被降为奴仆。在印加及后来西班牙的压力下，多数支派到16世纪初已放弃乌鲁语改用艾马拉语，只有奇帕亚语留存下来。从1722年起，波波湖的乌鲁人为捍卫土地，与邻近的艾马拉社群展开了长期的法律和领地之争。

en: Ü-Tsang is the cultural heartland of Tibet and the foremost of its three great regions, with Amdo to the northeast and Kham to the east. It unites Ü, the country of Lhasa and the Yarlung valley, with Tsang around Shigatse and Gyantse, covering the Yarlung Tsangpo basin between the Himalayas and the Changtang. The Yarlung kings ruled these valleys from about 127 BCE and built the Tibetan Empire of the seventh to ninth centuries, whose court made Buddhism the faith of the land. After the empire's collapse the region entered an era of fragmentation, and from the thirteenth century the Sakya lamas governed it as clients of the Mongol Yuan emperors, their abbot Phagpa serving as imperial preceptor. In 1337 Sakya power was already fading, and in 1354 the Phagmodrupa dynasty seized the region, followed in Tsang by the Rinpungpa and Tsangpa rulers. Mongol arms again decided its fate when Güshi Khan defeated the Tsang king and in 1642 made the fifth Dalai Lama head of the Ganden Phodrang government, which raised the Potala Palace in Lhasa. Qing armies entered in 1720, beginning nearly two centuries of imperial supervision over the Dalai Lama's government, while the speech of Lhasa became the standard Tibetan tongue across these lands.
zh: 卫藏是西藏三大区域中最核心的一个，与东北的安多、东方的康区并列，由拉萨和雅砻河谷所在的卫，与日喀则、江孜所在的藏合并而成，占据喜马拉雅山与羌塘之间的雅鲁藏布江流域。雅砻部落的赞普约自公元前127年起统治这些谷地，并在7至9世纪建成强盛的吐蕃帝国，使佛教成为雪域之教。帝国崩溃后卫藏陷入分裂，13世纪起，萨迦派法王作为蒙古元朝皇帝的代理人执掌藏政，萨迦班智达之侄八思巴还出任元朝帝师。1337年时萨迦的权势已近尾声，1354年帕木竹巴王朝取而代之，此后藏地又先后出现仁蚌巴和藏巴汗政权。蒙古和硕特部的固始汗攻灭藏巴汗后，于1642年拥立五世达赖喇嘛建立甘丹颇章政权，布达拉宫随后在拉萨落成；1720年清军入藏，开始了对达赖政府近两百年的监护，拉萨方言也由此成为整个藏地的通用藏语标准。

en: The Uutaalnganu, also called the Night Island Kawadji or sandbeach people, are an Aboriginal group of the north-eastern Cape York Peninsula in Queensland, whose home was Night Island and the coastal strip facing it, between Oxford Bay and Princess Charlotte Bay. They spoke Yankonyu, a dialect of the Umpila cluster within the North Cape York Paman languages, and were closely linked by marriage to the mainland Barungguan clans. Though few in number, they were skilful seafarers who built double-outrigger wooden canoes for long voyages to outlying reefs, where they hunted dugong and turtles and gathered the eggs of turtles and sea birds. Captain Cook charted these waters in 1770, but the Night Island people remained beyond direct colonial reach until long after the period closed.
zh: 乌塔恩加努人又称夜岛“沙滩人”，是昆士兰约克角半岛东北部的原住民群体，家园在夜岛及其对面的海岸地带，介于牛津湾与夏洛特公主湾之间。他们使用扬科纽语，即北约克角帕马语组中乌姆皮拉方言群的一种方言，并与大陆的巴伦关氏族长期通婚。他们人数不多，却是出色的航海者，会制造双舷外支架木舟，远航到外海礁盘，捕猎儒艮和海龟，捡拾海龟蛋与海鸟蛋。1770年库克船长测绘了这片海域，但直到本时期结束很久以后，夜岛居民仍未受到殖民势力的直接控制。

en: The U'wa, long known to outsiders as the Tunebo, are a Chibchan-speaking people of the cloud forests and paramo highlands of northeastern Colombia, centred on the Sierra Nevada del Cocuy in the eastern Andes, where their ancestral lands embrace the headwaters of the Orinoco and once extended across the frontier into Venezuela. Their own name means 'the people', and neighbouring peoples call them 'the people who speak well'; their tongue, Uw Cuwa or Tunebo, forms part of the Magdalenic branch of the Chibchan family together with the language of the Muisca. In early times they may have numbered as many as 20,000, organised into matrilineal clans, traditionally eight, whose territories ringed the Cocuy massif. Clans moved seasonally between highland and lowland zones, farming as well as hunting, fishing and gathering, and they traded forest goods such as pineapples to the Muisca of the neighbouring high plateau, exchanging surpluses by barter at ceremonial sites marked by standing stones. Werjaya elders and kareka healers led each clan, and because the U'wa had no writing, their myths and customs were passed on chiefly through song. When Spanish expeditions began entering the eastern Andes in the 1530s, the rugged remoteness of the Cocuy kept large parts of their homeland closed to outsiders and helped the clans preserve their language and ritual life.
zh: 乌瓦人长期被外界称为图内博人，是说奇布查语的族群，居住在哥伦比亚东北部的云雾林与高寒荒原，以安第斯山脉东麓的科奎雪山为中心；他们的祖地涵盖奥里诺科河源头，一度还延伸到今委内瑞拉境内。乌瓦在本族语中意为“人”，邻族称他们为“善于言辞的人”；他们的语言乌瓦语又称图内博语，与穆伊斯卡人的语言同属奇布查语系的马格达莱纳语支。早期乌瓦人可能多达两万，按母系氏族组织，传统上分为八个氏族，各氏族的领地环绕科奎山地分布。氏族随季节在高低海拔间迁徙，既务农，也狩猎、捕鱼和采集，还把菠萝等林地产物贩运给邻近高原上的穆伊斯卡人，并在立有石柱的仪式场所通过物物交换互通有无。每个氏族由称为韦尔哈亚的长老和称为卡雷卡的医者主持事务；乌瓦人没有文字，神话与习俗主要靠歌谣传承。16世纪30年代西班牙远征队开始进入安第斯山东麓时，科奎山区偏远险峻，大片祖地仍与外界隔绝，使各氏族得以保存自己的语言和仪式。

en: The Uyghurs are the settled Turkic people of the Tarim and Turpan oases, heirs to a name first borne by the Uyghur Khaganate that ruled Mongolia from 744 to 840. When the Kirghiz overthrew that empire, one branch fled to the Turpan basin and built the Kingdom of Qocho, with its seats at Gaochang and Beshbalik; these Uyghurs turned from Manichaeism to Buddhism, kept the Old Uyghur script, and served the Mongol Empire as scribes and administrators after submitting in 1209. Meanwhile the western oases had passed to the Muslim Karakhanids, who took Buddhist Khotan in the early eleventh century, so that in 1337 the country around Turpan, Karasahr and Kurla was still largely Buddhist while Kashgar and the west had long been Islamic. The Chagatai khanate's split in the 1340s made these lands part of Moghulistan; Tughluq Temür's conversion opened the spread of Islam, and by the early sixteenth century even Turpan was largely Muslim, as the old name Uyghur faded from use and oasis dwellers called themselves simply Turki. From the seventeenth century the rival Sufi Khoja factions dominated the basin until the Dzungars, and then the Qing conquest of 1759, brought the oases under imperial rule; the Ush rising of 1765 showed how heavy that rule could be, and for generations identity stayed tied to individual towns such as Turpan and Kashgar rather than to any single national name.
zh: 维吾尔人是塔里木与吐鲁番各绿洲的定居突厥民族，其族名最早属于744至840年称雄蒙古高原的回鹘汗国。汗国被黠戛斯攻灭后，一支回鹘人西迁吐鲁番盆地，建立高昌回鹘王国，以高昌和别失八里为都；他们由摩尼教改奉佛教、沿用回鹘文，并在1209年归附蒙古帝国，长期出任帝国的书吏与文官。与此同时，西部绿洲已落入穆斯林的喀喇汗国之手，佛教古国于阗在11世纪初被其攻灭，因此1337年时，吐鲁番、喀喇沙尔、库尔勒一带仍以佛教为主，而喀什噶尔等西部绿洲早已伊斯兰化。14世纪40年代察合台汗国分裂，这里成为蒙兀儿斯坦的一部分；秃黑鲁·帖木儿汗改宗伊斯兰教，开启全境的伊斯兰化，到16世纪初连吐鲁番也基本成为穆斯林地区，回鹘旧名逐渐湮没，绿洲居民只称自己为突厥人。17世纪起，苏菲派的和卓各派把持盆地政局，随后准噶尔人、继而1759年的清朝征服相继把各绿洲纳入统治，1765年的乌什起义更显示出这种统治的严酷；此后很长时间里，人们的身份认同仍系于单个绿洲，而非一个统一的族名。

en: The Uzbeks began as the Kipchak-speaking nomads of the eastern Golden Horde, roaming the Desht-i Kipchaq steppe and the Zhetysu pastures along the Chu River. Central Asian writers called the whole nomadic population of the Jochid ulus by this name, which spread after Khan Ozbeg converted the Golden Horde to Islam in the early fourteenth century. In 1337 these tribes pastured their herds across what is now central and eastern Kazakhstan, organized in clan groups later counted as the ninety-two Uzbek tribes, with little to distinguish them from the other Tatar nomads of the Horde. Early in the fifteenth century Abu'l-Khayr Khan united them into the Uzbek Khanate north of the Timurid realm, raiding Khwarazm and taking Urganj in 1431; when his confederation collapsed after his death, the dissident clans broke away to become the Kazakhs, while his grandson Muhammad Shaybani led the loyal tribes south. Shaybani's invasion of Transoxiana began in 1501, Samarkand fell in 1505 and Herat in 1507, founding the Khanate of Bukhara. The conquerors, once Kipchak speakers, gradually adopted the Karluk Chagatai tongue of the settled towns and merged with their inhabitants, forging the Uzbek people of Bukhara, Khiva and, from the early eighteenth century, Kokand.
zh: 乌兹别克人最初是金帐汗国东部说钦察语的游牧民，游走于钦察草原和楚河沿岸的七河牧场。中亚作家把术赤兀鲁思的全体游牧人口都称作乌兹别克；14世纪初乌兹别克汗使金帐汗国改宗伊斯兰教后，这个名称流传开来。1337年，这些部落在今哈萨克斯坦中部和东部放牧，按氏族组织，后来被归为九十二个乌兹别克部落，与汗国其他鞑靼游牧民几乎没有分别。15世纪初，阿布海尔汗把他们统一为帖木儿王朝以北的乌兹别克汗国，1431年攻入花剌子模、占领乌尔根奇；他死后联盟瓦解，出走的氏族形成哈萨克人，其孙穆罕默德·昔班尼则率忠于他的部落南下。昔班尼于1501年大举入侵河中，1505年攻下撒马尔罕、1507年攻下赫拉特，建立布哈拉汗国。这些原本说钦察语的征服者逐渐改用城镇定居者的葛逻禄语支察合台语，与当地居民融合，形成布哈拉、希瓦以及18世纪初浩罕的乌兹别克民族。

en: The Vadul-Alais are the tundra Yukaghirs of the East Siberian seaboard. Vadul, meaning the strong or mighty ones, is the old self-name of the Tundra Yukaghirs, who also called themselves Detkil. The Alais, or Alazei, were the tribe of the Alazeya River basin between the Indigirka and the Kolyma; at the time of Russian contact they numbered about five hundred and eighty people in eight clans, some wandering on foot as hunters and others herding reindeer, led by the princes Nevgocha and Mundita. They spoke the tundra variant of Yukaghir and held in their folklore that they descended from the hero Idilvey, who could outrun a wild reindeer and leap across rivers. A Cossack fort had been built on the Alazeya by 1649, when Yukaghir hostages escaped and killed its men; the rising was crushed and the clans were made to pay fur tribute. Tribute, warfare and epidemics drove the tribe into decline, and the present-day Tundra Yukaghirs are chiefly of Alais descent.
zh: 瓦杜尔‑阿莱斯人是东西伯利亚沿海苔原上的尤卡吉尔人。“瓦杜尔”意为强壮有力者，是苔原尤卡吉尔人古老的自称，他们也自称杰特基尔人。阿莱斯人（又称阿拉泽伊人）游牧于因迪吉尔卡河与科雷马河之间的阿拉泽亚河流域；俄国人到来时，他们约有580人，分八个氏族，一部分徒步游猎，一部分放牧驯鹿，首领是涅夫戈恰和蒙季塔。他们说尤卡吉尔语的苔原变体，民间传说称自己是英雄伊迪尔韦的后代，据说他跑得比野鹿还快，还能一跃跨过河流。到1649年，哥萨克已在阿拉泽亚河上建起堡寨，这一年被扣作人质的尤卡吉尔人逃脱并杀死守军，起义随即被镇压，各氏族被迫缴纳毛皮贡赋。贡赋、战争和疫病使部落走向衰落，现存的苔原尤卡吉尔人大多有阿莱斯人的血统。

en: The Vaghua are an Austronesian-speaking people of Choiseul, known to its inhabitants as Lauru, the largest island of Choiseul Province in the Solomon Islands. Their language, also called Tavula, is closely related to neighbouring Varisi. The island was first recorded by Europeans in April 1568, when the brigantine Santiago of Álvaro de Mendaña's Spanish expedition, commanded by Pedro Ortega Valencia with Hernán Gallego as pilot, charted it as San Marcos. The French explorer Louis Antoine de Bougainville gave the island its present name in 1768, in honour of the French foreign minister, the duc de Choiseul.
zh: 瓦格瓦人是所罗门群岛舒瓦瑟尔省最大岛屿舒瓦瑟尔岛（当地称劳鲁）上说南岛语的族群。他们的语言又称塔武拉语，与邻近的瓦里西语关系密切。1568年4月，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚率领的西班牙探险队所辖双桅船“圣地亚哥号”在佩德罗·奥尔特加·巴伦西亚指挥、埃尔南·加列戈领航下首次记录下这座岛屿，将其标为圣马科斯岛。1768年，法国探险家路易·安托万·德·布干维尔以法国外交大臣舒瓦瑟尔公爵的名字为该岛命名，舒瓦瑟尔岛由此得名。

en: The Valpei are an Oceanic-speaking Melanesian people of the northern tip of Espiritu Santo, the largest island of Vanuatu, where their closely related Valpei and Hukua varieties are remembered together under the name Valpei-Hukua. Like other Ni-Vanuatu, they trace their ancestry to the Austronesian Lapita navigators who settled the archipelago roughly three thousand years ago and whose speech fragmented into the more than thirty languages of Santo alone. In May 1606 the Spanish expedition of Pedro Fernandes de Queirós anchored in Big Bay on the island's northern coast, the first recorded European landing in Vanuatu, and clashed with local villagers before sailing away. No other Europeans returned to Santo until Louis Antoine de Bougainville in 1768 and James Cook in 1774, who gave the archipelago the name New Hebrides.
zh: 瓦尔佩人是瓦努阿图最大岛屿圣埃斯皮里图岛最北端的美拉尼西亚人，操大洋洲语，其关系密切的瓦尔佩话与胡库阿话常被合称为瓦尔佩-胡库阿。与其他瓦努阿图人一样，他们的祖先可追溯到约三千年前定居这片群岛的南岛语系拉皮塔文化航海者；这些人的语言不断分化，仅圣埃斯皮里图岛就形成了三十多种语言。1606年5月，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯率领的西班牙探险队停泊在该岛北海岸的大湾，这是欧洲人有记载首次登陆瓦努阿图，途中还与当地村民发生冲突，随后驶离。此后直到1768年路易·安托万·德·布干维尔、1774年詹姆斯·库克先后到来，欧洲人才重返该岛；库克将这片群岛命名为新赫布里底群岛。

en: The Vangunu are an Oceanic people of Vangunu, a volcanic island at the southern end of the New Georgia group in the Solomon Islands, most of its coast ringed by the waters of Marovo Lagoon. Their language is closely related to Marovo, spoken on the same island's northern shore, and most Vangunu speakers command both tongues. The islanders live from subsistence gardens and fishing. Vangunu was among the islands charted in 1568 by the brigantine built for Álvaro de Mendaña's Spanish settlement on Santa Isabel, whose cruises under Pedro Ortega Valencia and Hernando Enríquez first mapped the central Solomons for Europeans.
zh: 万古努人是所罗门群岛新乔治亚群岛南端火山岛万古努岛上说大洋洲语的族群，岛屿大部分海岸被马罗沃潟湖的水域环绕。他们的语言与岛北部通行的马罗沃语关系密切，多数万古努语使用者两种语言都会说。岛民以园圃自给农业和捕鱼为生。1568年，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚在圣伊莎贝尔岛的西班牙定居点建造的双桅船出航测绘，万古努岛正是佩德罗·奥尔特加·巴伦西亚和埃尔南多·恩里克斯等人标定的岛屿之一，欧洲人由此首次绘出所罗门群岛中部的海图。

en: The Vargagaits are an Evenki clan band of the taiga east of the Yenisei, around the Yeruda, Teya and Chirimba rivers in what is now the Severo-Yeniseysky district of Krasnoyarsk Krai. They were nomadic reindeer herders and hunters whose clans fell under Cossack yasak collection when Russian power reached the Yenisei taiga in the 1600s.
zh: 瓦尔加盖茨人是叶尼塞河以东泰加林的鄂温克氏族游群，活动在今克拉斯诺亚尔斯克边疆区北叶尼塞区的叶鲁达河、捷亚河和奇林巴河一带。他们以游牧养鹿和狩猎为生，17世纪俄国势力到达叶尼塞泰加林后，其氏族被纳入哥萨克的雅萨克征收体系。

en: The Vazimba are remembered in Malagasy oral tradition as the first inhabitants of Madagascar, Austronesian settlers who reached the island from the Indonesian archipelago between roughly 350 BCE and 500 CE. They cleared the highland forests by slash-and-burn farming, growing bananas, tubers and ginger, and tradition holds that they knew neither metallurgy nor rice cultivation. By the eighth century they had absorbed or displaced still earlier settlers and called themselves tompontany, masters of the soil; their highland villages and kingdoms were often ruled by queens. Tradition divides them into the Vazimba of the water, the soil and the limestone tsingy, with the largest group settled around the Betsiriry valley in the central highlands. From the fourteenth century the expanding Merina kingdoms pressed on their lands, and the rulers Andriamanelo, Ralambo and Andrianjaka drove them out of the highlands between the sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries. The last independent Vazimba communities were destroyed or absorbed into Merina society, while some of their descendants may survive among the Mikea and Vezo of the west and south.
zh: 瓦赞巴人在马尔加什口传传统中被视为马达加斯加岛最早的居民，是约公元前350年至公元500年间从印度尼西亚群岛渡海而来的南岛语系定居者。他们用刀耕火种开辟高地森林，种植香蕉、块茎和姜；按传统说法，他们既不懂冶金，也不会种稻。到8世纪，他们已同化或驱逐了更早的定居者，自称“土地之主”；他们在高地的村落和王国常由女王统治。传统将其分为水居、土居和石林三支，人数最多的一支聚居在中部高地的贝齐里里河谷。14世纪起，不断扩张的梅里纳诸王国进逼其土地，16世纪至17世纪初，安德里亚马内洛、拉兰博和安德里安贾卡等君主把他们逐出高地。最后的独立瓦赞巴社群或被消灭，或并入梅里纳社会，也有一部分后裔可能融入了西部和南部的米凯亚人与斐索人。

en: The Vedda, who call themselves Wanniyalaeto, are the indigenous forest people of Sri Lanka and probably its oldest inhabitants, predating the Indo-Aryan settlers from whom the Sinhalese descend. Their name comes from a Tamil word meaning hunter, and place names across the Ratnapura district long preserved the memory of their former range. In the interior they hold to their old ways around Bintenne and Dambana, while the Anuradhapura Veddas of the dry north and the Coast Veddas between Batticaloa and Trincomalee have drawn closer to their Sinhalese and Tamil neighbours. Their own tongue, built on a language isolate of unknown origin and reshaped through contact with Sinhala into a stable creole by the 1200s, is kept for hunting calls and religious chants, as most Vedda had come to speak Sinhala; their traditional religion is polytheistic, overlaid among the interior groups by Buddhism. Through the centuries assimilation steadily narrowed the communities preserving the old life.
zh: 维达人自称万尼亚莱托，是斯里兰卡的土著森林居民，也很可能是岛上最古老的居民，早于后来僧伽罗人所源出的印度—雅利安定居者。族名来自泰米尔语，意思是猎人；拉特纳普勒地区的许多地名保留着他们昔日活动范围的痕迹。内陆的维达人在宾特纳和丹巴纳一带守着古老生活方式，北部干旱区有阿努拉德普勒维达人，拜蒂克洛与亭可马里之间的东海岸则有海岸维达人，后两者已与邻近的僧伽罗人、泰米尔人日益接近。他们本族语言的底层是系属不明的孤立语言，在与僧伽罗语接触中演变，到13世纪已形成稳定的克里奥尔语；后来多数维达人改说僧伽罗语，本族语只在狩猎呼号和宗教吟唱中保留，传统信仰为多神教，内陆群体又在其上叠加了佛教。数百年来，同化不断压缩着保留古老生活方式的社群。

en: The Venda, or Vhavenda, are a Bantu people of the mountainous country along the Limpopo, on either side of the present-day border between South Africa and Zimbabwe. Their roots reach back to the Kingdom of Mapungubwe, whose hilltop capital flourished between about 1220 and 1300 as a center of gold, copper and iron working, cotton spinning and long-distance trade before it was abandoned as the climate dried and power shifted north to Great Zimbabwe. The Venda themselves formed from the Vhangona, the earlier inhabitants of the Soutpansberg, and later Karanga-Rozvi clans moving in from Zimbabwe; their language took shape from around 1400 through contact with Sotho-Tswana and Kalanga neighbors. In the Soutpansberg they built the royal kraal of Dzata under the legendary chief Thoho-ya-Ndou, and the stone settlements of Thulamela and Dzata carried on the Mapungubwe tradition of hilltop towns in the Limpopo valley.
zh: 文达人又称瓦文达人，是林波波河沿岸山区的班图人，生活在今南非与津巴布韦边界两侧一带。他们的渊源可追溯到马蓬古布韦王国：其山顶都城约在1220—1300年间兴盛，是金、铜、铁器加工、棉纺和长途贸易的中心，后来因气候干旱而被废弃，权力北移至大津巴布韦。文达人由索特潘斯山区较早的居民万戈纳人，与后来从津巴布韦迁入的卡兰加-罗兹维诸氏族融合而成；他们的语言约从1400年起，在与索托-茨瓦纳人和卡兰加人的接触中定型。在索特潘斯山区，他们在传说中的酋长托霍亚恩杜率领下建立了王家村寨扎塔，而图拉梅拉和扎塔等石建聚落延续了马蓬古布韦在林波波河谷营建山城的传统。

en: The Venetian culture belongs to the people of the Veneto, in north-eastern Italy, centred on the lagoon city of Venice and the mainland towns of Padua, Verona, Vicenza and Treviso. Their language, Venetian, grew from the Vulgar Latin of the region and is first attested in writing in the thirteenth century; linguists still debate whether it belongs to the Gallo-Italic branch or forms its own Dalmatian Romance group. In 1337 Venice was the dominant maritime republic of the Adriatic, ruled by its elected doge and the Great Council, whose merchants and fleets linked Europe with the Byzantine and Islamic eastern Mediterranean. After the hard-fought War of Chioggia against Genoa, the republic conquered its mainland empire, bringing Treviso, Padua, Verona and Vicenza under Venetian rule by the early fifteenth century. Venetian served as a lingua franca of Mediterranean trade and produced its own theatre, from Ruzante's peasant comedies to Carlo Goldoni and Carlo Gozzi in the eighteenth century, even as Tuscan became the language of formal writing and administration. The League of Cambrai defeated Venice at Agnadello in 1509, and long Ottoman wars cost it Cyprus, Crete and its Aegean possessions. In 1797 Napoleon abolished the republic and handed the Veneto to Austria by the Treaty of Campo Formio; after a decade under the Napoleonic Kingdom of Italy, the region returned to Habsburg rule in 1815 as part of Lombardy-Venetia.
zh: 威尼斯文化属于意大利东北部威尼托地区的居民，以潟湖之城威尼斯以及帕多瓦、维罗纳、维琴察、特雷维索等内陆城市为中心。他们的威尼斯语由当地通俗拉丁语演变而来，13世纪始见书面记载；语言学家对它应归入高卢-意大利语支，还是自成一支的达尔马提亚罗曼语仍有争论。1337年，威尼斯是亚得里亚海首屈一指的海上共和国，由民选总督和大议会统治，商人和船队把欧洲与拜占庭及伊斯兰的东地中海世界连在一起。在与热那亚苦战的基奥贾战争之后，共和国开始征服陆上领地，到15世纪初已把特雷维索、帕多瓦、维罗纳和维琴察纳入治下。威尼斯语曾是地中海贸易的通用语，还孕育了自己的戏剧文学，从鲁赞特的农民喜剧到18世纪卡洛·戈尔多尼和卡洛·戈齐的作品；与此同时，托斯卡纳语逐渐成为正式书面语和行政用语。1509年，康布雷同盟在阿尼亚代洛战役中击败威尼斯；此后与奥斯曼帝国的长期战争又使它失去塞浦路斯、克里特和爱琴海领地。1797年拿破仑灭亡共和国，根据《坎波福尔米奥条约》把威尼托割让给奥地利；在拿破仑的意大利王国统治十年后，该地区于1815年作为伦巴第-威尼托的一部分重归哈布斯堡王朝。

en: The Vepsians are a Baltic Finnic people whose homeland is the lake country between Lake Ladoga, Lake Onega and Lake Beloye, around Beloozero and Tikhvin, speaking Vepsian, a Finnic tongue close to Karelian and Finnish. They took shape as a separate people in the second half of the first millennium AD, and the Gothic writer Jordanes may already name them in the sixth century; Arab geographers called them the Wisu, while the Russian Primary Chronicle knows them as the ves, the first inhabitants of Beloozero, who paid tribute to the Varangians in 859. Farming, fur hunting and river trade on the Volga route between Ladoga and the east sustained this early medieval people, whose burial mounds of the tenth to thirteenth centuries mark the woods and waterways of the region. From the twelfth century their history followed Novgorod, whose Obonezhskaya pyatina included most Vepsian lands; groups that crossed the Svir merged into the Karelians, and after Moscow annexed Novgorod in 1478 the rest became state peasants on the Russian frontier, gradually assimilated by Slavic settlers. In the early eighteenth century northern Vepsians were assigned to the Olonets ironworks and others to the Lodeynoye Pole shipyard, and the ethnographer Sjögren only re-established their identity in 1824, tracing them back to the ves of the chronicles.
zh: 韦普斯人是波罗的芬兰人的一支，故乡在拉多加湖、奥涅加湖与别洛耶湖之间的湖区，即白湖、季赫温一带，使用与卡累利阿语和芬兰语相近的芬兰语支语言韦普斯语。他们在公元1千纪后半叶形成独立族群，哥特作家约尔达尼斯在6世纪的记载可能已提到他们；阿拉伯地理学家称他们为维苏人，而罗斯《往年纪事》称之为维斯人，说白湖的最早居民就是他们，859年他们曾向瓦良格人纳贡。农耕、毛皮捕猎和伏尔加商路拉多加至东方段上的河运贸易养育了这个中世纪早期民族，10至13世纪的墓葬群散布在当地的森林水道之间。12世纪起他们的历史与诺夫哥罗德连在一起，其大部分土地划入诺夫哥罗德的奥博涅日斯卡亚皮亚特纳；越过斯维里河的支系融入卡累利阿人，1478年莫斯科兼并诺夫哥罗德后，其余人成为俄国边疆的国有农民，在斯拉夫移民的渗透下逐渐被同化。18世纪初，北部韦普斯人被划归奥洛涅茨冶金厂做工，另一些人被派往洛杰伊诺耶波列造船厂；直到1824年，民族学家舍格伦才重新厘清他们的身份，把他们与编年史中的维斯人对应起来。

en: The Vezo are the fishing people of Madagascar's western and southwestern coast, living along the shore between Toliara and Morondava; their name means those who live from the sea. They speak a Malagasy dialect of Malayo-Polynesian origin and define themselves by a maritime way of life rather than descent, sailing pirogues and trading fish with inland neighbours such as Masikoro.
zh: 威祖人是马达加斯加西部和西南沿海的渔民，分布在图利亚拉与穆龙达瓦之间的海岸，族名意为靠海为生的人。他们讲源于马来-波利尼西亚语系的马尔加什语方言，以海上生计而非血统界定身份，驾驶独木舟出海捕鱼，并用渔获与马希科洛人等内陆邻居交易。

en: The Vietnamese, or Kinh, are the main Vietic people of the Red River Delta, whose bronze-casting Đông Sơn ancestors, the Lạc Việt, formed the Văn Lang chiefdom under the legendary Hùng kings. A millennium of Chinese rule began with the Han conquest of 111 BCE and deeply shaped Vietnamese civilization: Confucian learning, Mahayana Buddhism, Chinese-style administration and a large Sinitic vocabulary entered local life, though the vernacular Vietic tongue survived. Ngô Quyền restored independence by defeating a Chinese fleet on the Bạch Đằng River in 938, and Đinh Bộ Lĩnh founded the kingdom of Đại Việt in 968, with its capital at Thăng Long under the Lý and Trần dynasties; the Trần had already repelled three Mongol invasions by 1337. Ming China reconquered the country in 1407 but was driven out by Lê Lợi in 1427, and the restored Lê dynasty under Lê Thánh Tông crushed Champa in 1471. From the sixteenth century the country split between the Trịnh lords of the north and the Nguyễn lords of the south, who pushed the Vietnamese settlement frontier steadily down the coast in the Nam Tiến, while Catholic missionaries arrived and Alexandre de Rhodes printed the romanized quốc ngữ script in 1651. The Tây Sơn uprising reunited the country briefly before the Nguyễn founder Gia Long established the imperial dynasty at Huế in 1802.
zh: 越南人又称京人，是红河三角洲的主体越族语民族，其擅长青铜铸造的东山文化先民——骆越人，在传说中的雄王治下组成了文郎部落联盟。从公元前111年汉朝征服开始的千年北属深刻塑造了越南文明：儒家学问、大乘佛教、中式官制和大量汉语词汇进入当地生活，而本土的越语始终存续。938年，吴权在白藤江击败中国舰队，恢复独立；968年丁部领建立大越国，李朝和陈朝时以升龙为都，到1337年陈朝已三次击退蒙古入侵。1407年明朝重新征服越南，但1427年被黎利逐出；复国的黎朝在黎圣宗治下于1471年攻灭占婆。16世纪起，国家分裂为北方的郑氏与南方的阮氏两大势力，阮氏推动越南人沿海南下“南进”；与此同时天主教传教士到来，亚历山大·德·罗德于1651年印行了拉丁化的国语字。西山起义曾短暂统一全国，最终阮朝建立者嘉隆于1802年在顺化开创皇朝。

en: The Vili are a Bantu people and a branch of the Kongo, settled on the Atlantic coast from southwestern Gabon to Cabinda, around the ports of Loango and the Kouilou estuary. With the Yombe, Lumbu, Vungu and Punu they formed the ethnic core of the Kingdom of Loango, which broke away from the Kingdom of Kongo in the sixteenth century; tradition names King Njimbe as its founder, and Dutch and English travellers around 1600 described its capital at Bwali. At its height in the seventeenth century Loango reached from Cape Sainte Catherine almost to the mouth of the Congo, exporting copper and cloth, while the Vili, organised in matrilineal clans, became its dominant political group and expressed their spirituality through carved nkisi nail fetishes. Vili brokers then dominated the growing trade with European ships, first in ivory and copper and later in slaves, which enriched a small elite but unbalanced society, while epidemics of smallpox and sleeping sickness cut the population sharply. After the death of King Buatu in 1787 the succession faltered and the old kingdom fragmented into rival chiefdoms.
zh: 维利人是班图人的一支、刚果人的分支，聚居在从加蓬西南部到卡宾达的大西洋沿岸，以罗安果和奎卢河口一带的港口为中心。他们与永贝人、伦布人、丰古人、普努人共同构成罗安果王国的族群核心；该王国于16世纪脱离刚果王国独立，传说中由恩吉姆贝建立，1600年前后荷兰和英国旅行者已记述过其首都布瓦利。17世纪是罗安果的鼎盛期，疆域从圣凯瑟琳角几乎延伸到刚果河口，输出铜和布匹，按母系氏族组织的维利人成为王国的主导政治集团，并以被称为“恩基西”的钉子神像雕刻表达信仰。此后维利中间商把持了与欧洲商船日益扩大的贸易，先是象牙和铜，后来转为奴隶，少数精英致富而社会结构失衡，天花和昏睡病的流行又使人口锐减。1787年布阿图国王去世后继承混乱，旧王国分裂为彼此竞争的酋长领地。

en: The Vitimske are the Evenki, or Tungus, bands of the Vitim Plateau, the basin of the upper Vitim and its tributaries the Tsipa, Muya and Kuanda, in present-day northeastern Buryatia and Zabaykalsky Krai. They spoke Vitim group Evenki dialects of the Northern Tungusic branch and lived as nomadic taiga hunters who kept small herds of domestic reindeer for riding and transport and pitched conical birch-bark tents. Russian Cossacks first entered their country in 1639, when Maksim Perfilyev sailed up the Vitim to the mouth of the Tsipa; forts such as Barguzin soon imposed the fur tribute, or yasak, on the local clans and took hostages to ensure payment. Tribute demands and the spread of Russian settlement gradually pushed Vitim hunting groups deeper into the eastern taiga over the following two centuries.
zh: 维季姆人是活动在维季姆高原的鄂温克（通古斯）游猎群体，家园在维季姆河上游及其支流齐帕河、穆亚河和宽达河流域，位于今布里亚特东北部与外贝加尔边疆区境内。他们说鄂温克语北通古斯语支的维季姆方言，在泰加林中过游猎生活，饲养少量驯鹿用于骑乘和运输，住桦树皮搭成的锥形帐篷。1639年，哥萨克马克西姆·佩尔菲利耶夫沿维季姆河上溯至齐帕河口，俄国人首次进入这一地区；不久巴尔古津堡便向当地氏族征收毛皮税，并扣押人质以保证完税。在此后两个世纪里，赋税压力和俄国移民的扩张，迫使维季姆游猎群体不断向东部泰加林深处迁移。

en: The Alpine culture speaks the eastern, mountain branch of Vivaro-Alpine, one of the northern dialects of Occitan, traditionally called gavot in the high country from Gap and Sisteron to Briançon and the upper Durance. In older books it is named Alpine Provençal or Dauphinois, for its valleys made up the High Dauphiné, the land once crossed by the Roman road over the Mont Genèvre past Brigantium, the later Briançon, in the former kingdom of King Cottius. From the 1040s these mountains belonged to the counts of Albon, the dauphins of Viennois, whose dolphin emblem gave the Dauphiné its name. Mountain self-government flourished here: the charter granted to Briançon in 1244 was enlarged in 1343 into the Republic of the Escartons, a league of five valleys that elected its own consul, taxed itself and kept its privileges under every French king down to 1789. In 1349 the indebted last dauphin, Humbert II, sold the Dauphiné to the future Charles V of France, and from then on the French king's eldest son bore the title of Dauphin. The Treaty of Utrecht in 1713 shifted the transalpine valleys of the Briançonnais to the House of Savoy in exchange for Barcelonnette, while Briançon itself, fortified by Vauban, withstood a three-month Allied siege in 1815. French gradually displaced the gavot speech from administration and trade, though it long remained the language of the shepherds and mountain villages.
zh: 阿尔卑斯文化使用的是维瓦赖-阿尔卑斯语的东部山地方支，后者属于奥克语的北部方言群，在加普、锡斯特龙到布里扬松和迪朗斯河上游的山国里传统上称为“加沃话”。旧著作中它被称作阿尔卑斯普罗旺斯语或多菲内语，因为这些山谷构成了上多菲内：古罗马道路曾经热内夫尔山穿过此地，经过科蒂乌斯王国境内的布里甘提乌姆，也就是后来的布里扬松。从11世纪40年代起，这片山区归属阿尔邦伯爵——维埃努瓦的多菲内藩侯，其纹章上的海豚图案正是“多菲内”一名的由来。山地自治在这里十分兴盛：1244年授予布里扬松的特许状于1343年扩充为埃斯卡顿共和国，由五个山谷结盟而成，自选执政官、自行征税，其特权历经每位法国国王确认，一直维持到1789年。1349年，负债累累的末代多菲内藩侯安贝尔二世把多菲内卖给未来的法王查理五世，此后法国王太子便享有“多菲内”的头衔。1713年的《乌得勒支条约》把布里扬松地区的山外山谷划给萨伏依家族，以交换巴瑟洛内特；由沃邦加固的布里扬松城本身则在1815年顶住了反法同盟三个月的围攻。法语逐渐在行政和贸易中取代了加沃话，但它长期仍是牧羊人和山乡村庄的语言。

en: The Volhynians were the East Slavic people of Volhynia, the wooded country between the Western Bug and the Pripyat that now straddles Ukraine, Poland and Belarus. The Primary Chronicle places the Dulebes, Buzhans and Volhynians tribes there, and in 988 Vladimir the Great founded Volodymyr, which became the capital of the Rurikid Principality of Volhynia. In 1199 Prince Roman the Great joined Volhynia with Halych to form the Kingdom of Galicia-Volhynia, a power that survived Mongol raids and succession wars until its collapse around 1340. Poland and Lithuania then divided the region between 1352 and 1366, and after the Union of Lublin in 1569 it became the Volhynian Voivodeship of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, drawing Polish nobles and Jewish settlers while Orthodox and Uniate communities lived side by side. At the First Partition of 1772 the Belz district passed to Austria, and the Third Partition of 1795 handed the rest to the Russian Empire, which dissolved the local Uniate Church and made the country a Russian governorate.
zh: 沃里尼亚人是沃里尼亚的东斯拉夫人，那是西布格河与普里皮亚季河之间的林泽地带，地跨今乌克兰、波兰和白俄罗斯。《古史纪年》记载当地有杜列比人、布然人和沃里尼亚人等部落；988年弗拉基米尔大帝兴建沃洛德米尔城，后来成为留里克王朝沃里尼亚公国的都城。1199年罗曼大公将沃里尼亚与哈利奇合并，组成加利西亚-沃里尼亚王国，这个政权挺过了蒙古入侵和继承战争，约1340年瓦解。1352—1366年间，波兰与立陶宛瓜分了该地区；1569年卢布林联合后，它成为波兰立陶宛联邦的沃里尼亚省，波兰贵族和犹太移民陆续迁入，东正教徒与合并派信徒比邻而居。1772年第一次瓜分时，贝尔兹一带划归奥地利，1795年第三次瓜分后其余部分归入俄罗斯帝国，当地的合并派教会被取缔，土地改为俄国的一个省。

en: The Votians are a Finnic people of Ingria, the land between the Gulf of Finland and Lake Peipus, and are considered its oldest known inhabitants, probably descended from Iron Age farmers of northeastern Estonia and western Ingria. Medieval Russian chronicles call them the Voď and group them with other Finnic neighbours under the name Chudes, while the Kylfings of Viking Age sources may have been their ancestors. In 1069 they joined a raid on Novgorod with the prince of Polotsk, but they later became part of the Novgorod Republic, whose Vodskaya administrative division took its name from them, and in 1149 they marched with Novgorod against the Tavastians of Finland. When Moscow absorbed Novgorod in the 1470s, many Votians were deported, and from 1534 Orthodox missionaries sent by Archbishop Macarius destroyed their pagan shrines and gradually converted them. Sweden ruled Ingria for most of the seventeenth century, and Lutheran pressure, Orthodox migration and the arrival of Finnish settlers reshaped the region; the Votians kept their Orthodox faith and their Finnic Votic tongue, often also speaking Ingrian and Russian. Their villages around Koporye and the Soikino peninsula remained the heart of Votia in the following centuries.
zh: 瓦佳人是英格里亚——芬兰湾与楚德湖之间的土地——的芬兰语支民族，被视为当地已知最古老的居民，先民可能是爱沙尼亚东北部和英格里亚西部的铁器时代农人。中世纪罗斯编年史称他们为沃德人，并把他们与邻近的芬兰语支族群统称丘德人；维京时代文献中的库尔芬人或许就是他们的先民。1069年，他们随波洛茨克王公参与了对诺夫哥罗德的袭击，后来却并入诺夫哥罗德共和国，共和国的沃季行政区即因他们得名；1149年他们又随诺夫哥罗德出征芬兰的塔瓦斯蒂亚人。15世纪70年代莫斯科吞并诺夫哥罗德后，大批瓦佳人被驱逐，1534年起诺夫哥罗德大主教马卡里派遣的东正教传教士捣毁他们的异教神龛，逐步使其改宗。17世纪的大部分时间里英格里亚归瑞典统治，路德宗的压力、东正教徒的迁徙和芬兰移民的到来重塑了这一地区；瓦佳人保留了东正教信仰和芬兰语支的瓦佳语，往往还兼说英格里亚语和俄语。此后几个世纪里，科波里耶与索伊基诺半岛一带的村庄始终是瓦佳兰的核心。

en: The Wa are an Austroasiatic people of the rugged country between the Mekong and the Salween, the hills called the Wa States that span the border of Yunnan and the Shan country of Burma, where their villages cluster around Kengtung and Menglian. Chinese records trace them to a branch of the ancient Hundred Pu, naming them in turn the Puzi Man under the Tang, the Pu Man under the Song and the Gula under the Ming; their own autonyms Wa, Ba Raog and A Wa all mean mountain people. They farmed rice, beans and poppies on the slopes, kept buffalo for sacrifice, and honoured the spirits of the land through wooden drums and ritual offerings, with head-taking once practised to fertilise the rice fields. The Wa of Kengtung were displaced around 1229 and later defeated by King Mangrai of Lan Na, after which many fell under Shan rule; Wa living close to the Dai took up Theravada Buddhism, while the remote hill villages kept their old animist rites. Their Palaungic language had no traditional script, and literate Wa wrote in Chinese or Shan characters.
zh: 佤是南亚语系民族，聚居在湄公河与萨尔温江之间的崎岖山地，即地跨云南与缅甸掸邦的阿佤山区，村寨多在景栋、孟连一带。汉文记载把他们追溯为古“百濮”的一支，唐代称“濮子蛮”，宋代称“濮蛮”，明代称“古剌”；他们的自称“佤”“巴饶克”“阿佤”都有“住在山上的人”之意。佤人在坡地种植水稻、豆类和罂粟，养水牛用于祭祀，通过木鼓和献祭崇拜山川神灵，曾以猎人头祈求稻田丰收。1229年前后，景栋的佤人被逐，后来又败于兰纳的孟莱王，许多人自此沦为掸族诏法的属民；与傣族邻近的佤人接受了南传上座部佛教，深山村寨则保留旧有的万物有灵仪式。他们的佤德昂语支语言本无文字，识字者多用汉字或掸文书写。

en: The Waanyi, also spelt Wanyi or Wanji, are an Aboriginal people of the well-watered limestone and sandstone country south of the Gulf of Carpentaria, straddling the border of the Northern Territory and Queensland and including parts of the Gregory River. Norman Tindale estimated their territory at about 25,000 square kilometres, from the upper Nicholson River and Spring and Lawn Hill creeks east to the Barkly River and Bannockburn, west to Old Benmara and south-west to Mount Morgan. They lay south of the Gunindiri and Garrwa, west of the Injilarija and Nguburinji and east of the Wambaya and Wakaya. Their language forms the southern branch of the Garrwan family, distinct from the surrounding Barkly and Mirndi tongues, and older records preserve the variants Waangyee, Wanee, Wanyee and Wonyee.
zh: 瓦安伊人又拼作瓦尼或万吉，是卡奔塔利亚湾以南水源充沛的石灰岩与砂岩地区的原住民，地跨北领地与昆士兰边界，格雷戈里河的一部分也在其地域内。诺曼·廷代尔估计其领地约2.5万平方公里，东起尼科尔森河上游及斯普林溪、朗希尔溪，向东延伸至巴克利河与班诺克本，西抵旧本马拉，西南达摩根山。他们位于古宁迪里人和加拉瓦人以南、因吉拉贾人和恩古布林吉人以西、万巴亚人和瓦卡亚人以东。他们的语言属加拉万语系的南支，与周围的巴克利诸语和米尔恩迪诸语不同；旧籍还保存了瓦安吉、瓦尼、万尼、沃尼等异拼。

en: The Waashiw, better known as the Washoe, are the ancient people of Lake Tahoe on the California-Nevada border, their autonym meaning people from here. They have occupied the eastern Sierra and the adjoining Great Basin for at least six thousand years, and theirs is the only Great Basin language that is not Numic, a surviving isolate sometimes assigned to the Hokan family, which suggests they held the country before the arrival of the Numic tribes. Their land ran from Honey Lake in the north to the West Walker River and Sonora Pass in the south, and from the Sierra crest to the Pine Nut Mountains, taking in the Carson and Truckee Rivers. Four regional bands, the northern Welmelti, the Powalu of the east, the southern Hungalelti and the small western Tanalelti, followed a strict seasonal round: summer fishing for whitefish at Tahoe, autumn gathering pine nuts in the eastern hills, winter in sheltered valley camps where stores of dried fish and game saw them through the lean months. The Kings Beach culture that arose around the lake about 500 marks their early archaeological tradition. Spanish explorers may have met them in the early nineteenth century, but no European presence disturbed their round before 1837.
zh: 瓦肖人是加利福尼亚与内华达边界塔霍湖畔的古老居民，其自称意为“本地人”。他们在内华达山脉东麓及相邻的大盆地已居住至少六千年；瓦肖语是大盆地唯一不属于努米克语支的语言，作为幸存的孤立语言有时被暂归霍坎语系，说明在努米克诸族到来之前他们便已据有此地。其疆域北起哈尼湖，南至西沃克河与索诺拉山口，西起内华达山脊，东抵皮农山，卡森河与特拉基河皆在其中。四个区域群体——北方的韦尔梅尔蒂、东方的波瓦卢、南方的洪加莱尔蒂和人数不多的西方塔纳莱尔蒂——遵循严格的季节轮转：夏天在塔霍湖捕白鱼，秋天到东山采松子，冬天躲进避风的谷地营地，靠鱼干和猎获熬过青黄不接的月份。约500年在湖畔兴起的金斯滩文化，便是他们早期的考古传统。19世纪初或许有西班牙探险者与他们相遇，但直到1837年，还没有任何欧洲人的势力扰动他们的轮转。

en: The Waccamaw were a Siouan people of the Carolina coast, whose villages lined the Waccamaw and Pee Dee rivers of North and South Carolina. Their name, recorded as Guacaya by the kidnapped interpreter Francisco de Chicora in the 1520s, is of unknown meaning, and their own language went unrecorded, though it is thought to have belonged to the Catawban family, like the related Woccon speech of which John Lawson published a vocabulary in 1709. Farming towns had stood in their country since the Mississippian period. Disease and settlement cut their numbers sharply: the Carolina census of 1715 counted only 610 Waccamaw, and after they joined the Yamasee War of 1715 against the colonists a brief conflict in 1720 left sixty more of them dead or captured. In 1755, pressed by Cherokee and Natchez raids, the surviving Waccamaw together with the Cheraw and Pedee accepted the South Carolina governor's arrangement and were adopted into the Catawba nation of King Hagler.
zh: 沃卡莫人是卡罗来纳沿海的苏语民族，村落分布在南北卡罗来纳的沃卡莫河与皮迪河沿岸。16世纪20年代，被西班牙人掳走的翻译奇科拉的弗朗西斯科把其族名记为瓜卡亚，含义已不可考；他们的语言没有留下记录，一般认为属于卡托巴语族，与近亲沃孔语同类，约翰·劳森曾在1709年公布过一份沃孔语词汇表。早在密西西比文化时期，他们的土地上就已有农耕城镇。疫病和殖民扩张使人口锐减：1715年卡罗来纳人口普查只统计到610名沃卡莫人；他们加入1715年的亚马西战争对抗殖民者，1720年的一场短暂冲突又使六十余人被杀或被俘。1755年，在切罗基人和纳奇兹人的袭扰下，残存的沃卡莫人与切罗人、皮迪人一起接受南卡罗来纳总督的安排，被黑格勒王的卡托巴人收养。

en: The Wahgochtatta are the Otoe under the name they took after splitting from the Missouria; both peoples, together with the Iowa and Ho-Chunk, once formed a single Chiwere-speaking nation around the Great Lakes. That nation moved southwest before European contact, parting from the Ho-Chunk near Green Bay, and Jacques Marquette found the Otoe on the upper Des Moines River in 1673. At the mouth of the Iowa River the Iowa stayed behind while the Otoe and Missouria went on to the Missouri, and after a quarrel between their chiefs the Otoe pushed upstream, calling themselves Waghtochtatta while whites knew them as Otoe. Around 1760 they occupied earth-lodge villages on the Platte River, where in 1804 the Lewis and Clark Expedition held its first council with a Plains tribe, at the place later called Council Bluff. Mounted buffalo hunters who also grew maize, beans and squash in elm-bark and earth lodges, they made their first land cession to the United States in 1830, and further treaties of 1833 and 1836 stripped away most of their Missouri and Iowa country.
zh: 瓦戈奇塔塔人是奥托人与纽阿奇人分道后使用的自称；他们与纽阿奇人、巴荷杰人、霍查克人原本是五大湖一带一个说奇维雷语的共同体。欧洲人到来之前，该群体向西南迁徙，在格林贝附近与霍查克人分开；1673年，雅克·马凯特在得梅因河上游发现了奥托人。在艾奥瓦河河口，巴荷杰人留下，奥托人与纽阿奇人继续前进到密苏里河；两群酋长发生争执后，奥托人溯河而上，改称瓦戈奇塔塔，白人则称他们为奥托人。约1760年，他们在普拉特河一带居住土屋村落，1804年刘易斯与克拉克远征队在此与他们举行了同平原部落的第一次议事会，该地后来得名康瑟尔布拉夫斯。他们骑马猎捕野牛，也在树皮屋和土屋里种植玉米、豆类和南瓜；1830年他们首次向美国割地，1833和1836年又签订条约，交出在密苏里和艾奥瓦的大部分土地。

en: The Wagiman are an Aboriginal people of the Northern Territory, whose traditional country stretched for hundreds of square kilometres from the Stuart Highway through the well-watered Mid-Daly Basin and across the Daly River, around Pine Creek. Their neighbours included the Waray to the north, the Kunwinjku and Jawoyn to the east, the Wardaman and Jaminjung to the south and the Murrinh-Patha and Malak-Malak to the west. Their language, once loosely grouped with the Gunwinyguan tongues of Arnhem Land but reclassified as an isolate, is noted by linguists for its complex verbal morphology and a rare part of speech called the coverb, and was said to sound rougher than the euphonious Marrithiyel speech of the country downstream.
zh: 瓦吉曼人是澳大利亚北领地的原住民，传统地域从斯图尔特公路一带延伸，穿过水源充足的中戴利盆地，跨过戴利河，方圆达数百平方公里，以派恩克里克一带为中心。他们的四邻包括北面的瓦雷人、东面的贡温古人和贾沃因人、南面的瓦达曼人和贾明荣人，以及西面的马林-帕塔人和马拉克-马拉克人。他们的语言曾被粗略归入阿纳姆地的贡温古语群，后改定为孤立语言；语言学家注意到它有复杂的动词形态和一种罕见的词类“副动词”，据说其语音比下游马里蒂耶尔人圆润悦耳的话听起来更生硬。

en: The Wahpekhute, also rendered Wahpekute, are one of the four bands of the Eastern Dakota, the Santee of the Sioux Seven Council Fires, and their name means Leaf Archers, or Shooters Among the Trees. Unlike the other bands their name carries no word for village, for they were the most nomadic of the Santee, and together with the Mdewakanton they formed the alliance's Upper Council. Before the seventeenth century they hunted and gathered wild rice around Lake Superior and in the Wisconsin woods, but long wars with the musket-armed Ojibwe drove them southwest, and by the late eighteenth century they had settled in the Big Woods of southern Minnesota, along the Cannon and Straight rivers. There they entered the fur trade: Alexander Faribault built a post among them in 1826, and in 1834 the band moved its village to his station. War with the Sauk and Meskwaki cost some hundred and seventy Wahpekhute lives between 1815 and 1825 and killed their head chief Shakeska, or White Nails, in 1822; his son Tasagi succeeded him as game grew scarce and dependence on the traders deepened.
zh: 瓦佩库特人（又译瓦佩库特，意为“树叶弓箭手”或“树丛中的射手”）是东达科他四族之一，属苏族“七议团”中的桑蒂人。与其他族群不同，他们的族名里没有“村落”一词，因为他们是桑蒂人中最逐猎物而居的一支，并与布德韦坎通万人共同组成联盟的上议事会。17世纪以前，他们在苏必利尔湖周边和威斯康星林地狩猎、采集野稻，但与持有火枪的奥吉布瓦人的长期战争把他们逼向西南；到18世纪末，他们已定居在明尼苏达南部的大森林，沿坎农河与斯特雷特河而居。他们在那里卷入毛皮贸易：亚历山大·法里博于1826年在他们中间设立贸易站，1834年族群把村落迁到该站附近。1815至1825年间，与索克人和梅斯克瓦基人的战争使约一百七十名瓦佩库特人丧生，酋长沙克斯卡（意为白钉）于1822年战死，其子塔萨吉继任；此时猎物日渐稀少，他们对贸易商的依赖也日益加深。

en: The Whapetunwan, or Wahpeton, are one of the four Eastern Dakota bands of the Santee within the Sioux Seven Council Fires, and their name means Leaf Village, the village of those who dwell among the leaves. They were the constant allies of the Sisseton, with whom they shared villages and councils and who were later grouped with them as the Upper Sioux. In the seventeenth century they lived in the forests southwest of Lake Superior, gathering wild rice, spearing fish from canoes and hunting woodland game, until the musket-armed Ojibwe and the long Dakota-Ojibwe War drove them toward the prairies of southern Minnesota. In April 1806 their chiefs joined those of the Sisseton and Mdewakanton, five hundred warriors in all, in a council with the American officer Zebulon Pike at the mouth of the Minnesota River, opening the era of United States treaty-making with the eastern Dakota.
zh: 瓦佩图万人（即瓦佩顿人）是东达科他四族之一，属苏族“七议团”中的桑蒂人，族名意为“树叶村”，即居于树叶之间者的村落。他们始终与锡西屯万人结盟，村落与议事会都合在一起，后来二者被统称为上苏族。17世纪时，他们住在苏必利尔湖西南的森林里，采集野稻、乘独木舟叉鱼、猎捕林中之物，直到手持火枪的奥吉布瓦人和漫长的达科他—奥吉布瓦战争把他们赶向明尼苏达南部的草原。1806年4月，他们的酋长与锡西屯万、布德韦坎通万的酋长汇合，共五百名战士，在明尼苏达河河口会见美国军官泽布伦·派克，开启了美国与东达科他缔约的时代。

en: The Waima are a coastal people of Central Province in southeastern New Guinea, settled around Yule Island and the Kairuku coast northwest of Port Moresby. Their speech, with its three close dialects of Waima, Roro and Paitana, is an Oceanic Austronesian language of the West Central Papuan Tip group rather than a Papuan language.
zh: 瓦伊玛人是新几内亚东南部中央省的沿海族群，聚居在莫尔兹比港西北方的尤尔岛和凯鲁库海岸一带。他们的语言含瓦伊玛、罗罗、派塔纳三个极近的方言，属南岛语系大洋洲语族中西巴布亚尖端语支，并不是巴布亚语。

en: The Waiwai are a Carib-speaking forest people of the remote headwaters between the Essequibo in Guyana and the Mapuera in northern Brazil, formed from the fusion of several small Carib groups. Hunters and slash-and-burn farmers famous for their dogs and their hammock weaving, they stayed beyond colonial observation until an explorer reached their villages in 1837.
zh: 怀怀人是加勒比语森林族群，生活在圭亚那埃塞奎博河与巴西北部马普埃拉河之间偏远的河源地带，由数个小型加勒比群体融合而成。他们从事狩猎和刀耕火种农业，以良犬和吊床编织闻名；直到1837年才有探险者抵达他们的村落，此前始终处于殖民视野之外。

en: The Wajuru, also recorded as Ajuru or Wayurú, are a Tupian people of north-western Rondônia near the Bolivian border, whose Wayoró language belongs to the Tupari branch. They were formerly divided into three subgroups, the Stone people, the Agouti people and the Forest people, each with a speech variety, in the forests between the Guaporé headwaters and the frontier.
zh: 瓦朱鲁人又记作阿朱鲁人或瓦尤鲁人，是朗多尼亚州西北部、靠近玻利维亚边境的图皮语族群，所用瓦约罗语属图帕里语支。他们原分三支：岩石人、刺鼠人和森林人，各有自己的语言变体，散居在瓜波雷河源头与边境之间的丛林中。

en: The Wakaya, also recorded as Wagaja or Wogaia, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Northern Territory, whose traditional territory of some 39,000 square kilometres lay north-east and east of Tennant Creek, bordered by the Alyawarre to the east and south-east, the Kaytetye to the south and the Warlpiri to the west. They gathered purslane seeds and threshed them inside stone circles to draw out their oily nutrients. Their language, Wagaya, belonged to the Warluwarric (Ngarna) subgroup of the Pama-Nyungan family and had eastern and western dialects; frontier violence later drove many Wakaya from their country together with the Alyawarre.
zh: 瓦卡亚人（又记为瓦加贾、沃加亚等）是北领地的澳大利亚原住民，约3.9万平方公里的传统领地位于滕南特克里克东北和以东，东与东南邻阿利亚瓦尔人，南邻凯蒂切人，西邻瓦尔皮里人。他们采集马齿苋籽，在石圈中脱粒，取其含油的养分。他们的瓦加雅语属帕马‑牛雅语系的瓦尔卢瓦里克（纳尔纳）语支，分东、西两种方言；后来的边疆暴力迫使许多瓦卡亚人与阿利亚瓦尔人一起逃离故土。

en: The Wallachians are the Romanian-speaking Vlachs of the plain between the southern Carpathians and the Danube, the heartland from which the Principality of Wallachia grew. Local Vlach voivodes such as Litovoi are documented in the thirteenth century, and Basarab I threw off Hungarian overlordship by crushing Charles I's army at the Battle of Posada in 1330, founding the House of Basarab and ruling from Câmpulung and Târgoviște. Mircea the Elder fought the Ottomans at Rovine in 1394 and briefly held the Danube delta and Dobruja, while Vlad III the Impaler's defiance of Mehmed II, culminating in the night attack at Târgoviște in 1462, made him a legend both at home and in Saxon pamphlets abroad. From the 1520s the principality became an Ottoman tributary, trading autonomy for internal self-rule, though Michael the Brave broke with the Porte in 1593 and in 1600 briefly united Wallachia, Transylvania and Moldavia.
