After his death his follower Abd al-Mu'min took power in 1130, overthrew the Almoravids and captured Marrakesh in 1147, founding the caliphal line; by 1159 the Almohads held the whole Maghreb, and by about 1172 they ruled Muslim Iberia from Seville. Their court patronized thinkers such as Ibn Rushd and Ibn Arabi and raised monuments including the Giralda of Seville. Defeat at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212 broke their power in Spain, where Cordoba fell in 1236 and Seville in 1248, while the Marinids advanced in the Maghreb. Reduced to Marrakesh, the last caliph Idris al-Wathiq was killed when the Marinids stormed the city in 1269, ending the dynasty.
zh: 穆瓦希德王朝又称穆米宁王朝，是定都马拉喀什的柏柏尔人哈里发政权。它源于马斯穆达柏柏尔人伊本·图马特的传教：他约在1121年被追随者奉为马赫迪，在阿特拉斯山区的廷梅尔建立据点，斥责穆拉比特王朝不敬神。他死后，弟子阿卜杜勒·慕敏于1130年掌权，推翻穆拉比特王朝并在1147年攻占马拉喀什，开创哈里发世系；到1159年穆瓦希德人已控制整个马格里布，约1172年又以塞维利亚为中心统治穆斯林伊比利亚。其朝廷庇护了伊本·鲁世德、伊本·阿拉比等学者，留下塞维利亚吉拉达塔等建筑。1212年拉斯纳瓦斯·德·托洛萨之战的惨败动摇了他们在西班牙的统治，科尔多瓦于1236年、塞维利亚于1248年相继失守，马林王朝则在马格里布步步紧逼。末代哈里发伊德里斯·瓦西格被压缩在马拉喀什，1269年马林王朝破城时被杀，王朝就此终结。

en: The House of Alsace, also called the House of Châtenois, was a branch of the Ardennes family whose power centred on Metz and the Moselle valley. In 1048 Emperor Henry III granted the Duchy of Upper Lorraine first to Adalbert of Metz and then to his brother Gerard, and Gerard's descendants kept the duchy until the death of Duke Charles II in 1431. A younger son of the ducal house, Thierry of Alsace, won the County of Flanders in 1128; a veteran of four eastern campaigns and the Second Crusade, he died in 1168 and was buried at Watten. His sons Philip of Alsace and Matthew, the latter marrying the Countess of Boulogne, extended the family's power to the North Sea coast, while his daughter Margaret's marriage carried Flanders to the counts of Hainaut in 1194. The Lorraine cadet branch of Vaudémont recovered the duchy in 1473 and ruled until 1737, and another offshoot, the House of Guise, became a leading force in the French Wars of Religion. The last duke, Francis of Lorraine, married Maria Theresa of Austria in 1736, founding the House of Habsburg-Lorraine, which supplied the Holy Roman emperors until 1806.
zh: 阿尔萨斯家族又名沙特努瓦家族，是阿登家族的支系，势力以梅斯和摩泽尔河谷为中心。1048年，皇帝亨利三世把上洛林公国先封给梅斯的阿达尔贝特，又转封其弟热拉尔，热拉尔的后代一直保有公国，直到1431年查理二世公爵去世。家族幼支的阿尔萨斯的蒂埃里于1128年取得佛兰德斯伯国；他四次东征、参加第二次十字军东征，是经验丰富的十字军将领，1168年去世后葬于瓦坦修道院。他的儿子阿尔萨斯的腓力和马修——后者娶了布洛涅女伯爵——把家族势力延伸到北海沿岸，而他的女儿玛格丽特的婚姻在1194年把佛兰德斯带入埃诺伯爵一系。洛林的沃代蒙旁支于1473年收复公国并统治到1737年，另一支吉斯家族则在法国宗教战争中领导天主教阵营。末代公爵洛林的弗朗茨于1736年迎娶奥地利的玛丽亚·特蕾西亚，开创哈布斯堡-洛林家族，该家族世代出任神圣罗马帝国皇帝，直到1806年帝国解体。

en: The lords of Altenburg were a Thuringian ministerialis family holding the imperial burgraviate of Altenburg in the Pleissnerland, the Reichsgut around Altenburg, Chemnitz and Zwickau that Emperor Frederick II had pledged to the Wettin margraves of Meissen in 1243. Burgrave Dietrich II died in 1303 and was succeeded by his son Albrecht IV, who died without male heirs in 1329. Another son, Dietrich von Altenburg, had entered the Teutonic Order in 1307: he served as Komtur of Ragnit and Balga, became Grand Marshal in 1331 and led the Order's war against Poland, and was elected its nineteenth Grand Master in 1335. As grand master he rebuilt the order's castles, completed the Chapel of Saint Anne and the first permanent bridge over the Nogat at Marienburg, and began the Marienburg's Church of the Virgin Mary. He died at Thorn in October 1341 while negotiating with Poland and was the first grand master buried in the Chapel of Saint Anne, the last of his family line.
zh: 阿尔滕堡领主是图林根的侍臣家族，世袭普莱斯纳兰的帝国城堡伯爵；普莱斯纳兰是环绕阿尔滕堡、开姆尼茨和茨维考的帝国直辖领地，皇帝腓特烈二世已于1243年把它抵押给迈森的韦廷藩侯。城堡伯爵迪特里希二世卒于1303年，其子阿尔布雷希特四世继位，1329年无男性子嗣而亡。另一个儿子迪特里希·冯·阿尔滕堡已于1307年加入条顿骑士团：他历任拉格尼特和巴尔加的地方长官，1331年升任大元帅，指挥骑士团对波兰的战争，1335年当选第十九任大团长。任内他大修骑士团城堡，在马林堡建成圣安娜礼拜堂和诺加特河上第一座固定桥梁，并动工修建马林堡的圣母教堂。1341年10月，他在与波兰谈判期间病逝于托伦，成为第一位葬入圣安娜礼拜堂的大团长，也是其家族的最后一人。

en: The Andō were a warrior house of northern Japan, written with the characters for Andō 安藤 in their earlier Tsugaru years, who claimed descent from the Heian rebel Abe no Sadatō. From the early Kamakura period an Andō head was stationed in the Tsugaru region to handle Ezo affairs, and by the late thirteenth century the clan served the Hōjō regents as Ezo deputies, overseeing trade and dealings with the Ainu across holdings that stretched from Akita District in Dewa to the Shimokita Peninsula. A family feud and an armed Ezo uprising known as the War of the Andō weakened the house at the end of the Kamakura period, and it split into the Hiyama (Shimokuni) and Minato branches; the Minato house, based at Akita, was enrolled among the shogun's Kyoto retainers under the Muromachi regime. In the sixteenth century Andō Chikasue reunited the two branches and took the surname Akita, from Akita Port and the hereditary title Akita jō-no-suke. His son Sanesue won a succession quarrel, the Minato disturbance, in 1587 but had his lands cut back by Toyotomi Hideyoshi to fifty thousand koku, and under the Tokugawa the house was moved to Miharu in Mutsu, where it remained a tozama daimyō family through the Edo period.
zh: 安东氏是日本北部的武家豪族，早年在津轻时代多写作安藤氏，自称是平安时代叛将安倍贞任的后裔。镰仓初期，安东家首领被安置在津轻地方负责虾夷事务；13世纪末，他们作为北条得宗的御内人出任虾夷沙汰代官，统辖与阿伊努人的贸易和交涉，所领西起出羽国秋田郡、东至下北半岛。镰仓末期，家族内讧叠加虾夷武装起义（安藤氏之乱）使家业中衰，一族分裂为檜山的下国家与秋田的凑家，其中凑家在室町时代被编入京都御扶持众。16世纪，安东爱季合并两家，并以凑家世代自称的秋田城介官职改姓秋田；其子实季在1587年的继承纷争凑骚动中胜出，封地却被丰臣秀吉大幅削减，仅留出羽凑五万石。德川幕府时期，秋田家被转封陆奥三春，作为外样大名延续于整个江户时代。

en: The Anenokōji were a Kyoto court-noble house of the Fujiwara Hokke, taking their name from the Anenokōji avenue in the capital where the tenth-century courtier Fujiwara no Naritoki, of the Koichijō line, built his residence. A cadet branch made its fortune away from the court: under the Kenmu restoration of the 1330s Anenokōji Ietsuna was appointed governor of the remote mountain province of Hida, and his descendants kept the governorship for generations before splitting into the Kojima, Furukawa and Mukai houses, each claiming the title. The Hida disturbance of 1411 brought a shogunate army under Kyōgoku Takakazu against them, yet the Furukawa head Mototsuna reached the court rank of sangi in 1480 and provisional middle councillor in 1504. In the Sengoku age the local Miki family of the Takayama basin absorbed the clan and assumed its name in 1560, ruling Hida as daimyō until Toyotomi Hideyoshi's general Kanamori Nagachika overran the province in 1585. A separate, senior kuge line of the Kan'in branch, founded by Kinnobu, a son of the great minister Sanjō Sanefusa, had died out in the early Muromachi period and was revived in 1613 by Ano Saneaki's son Kinkage; ranked among the Urin houses with two hundred koku, it made the study of court precedent its hereditary calling, and in 1760 an imperial order joined its genealogy to the older line.
zh: 姊小路家是藤原北家的京都公家，得名于京都的姊小路——10世纪的廷臣藤原济时属小一条流，在这条街上营建宅邸，子孙遂以姊小路为姓。家族的一支在宫廷之外发迹：14世纪30年代建武新政时，姊小路家纲被任命为偏远山国飞驒国的国司，其后代世代承袭这一职务，后来分裂为小岛、古川、向三家，各自声称拥有国司头衔。1411年飞驒之乱爆发，室町幕府派京极高数率军讨伐；尽管如此，古川家的基纲仍于1480年升任参议，1504年更晋为权中纳言。战国时代，高山盆地的地方豪族三木氏同化并接管了这个家族，于1560年改用姊小路之姓，以大名身份统治飞驒，直到1585年丰臣秀吉的部将金森长近攻灭该国。另有闲院流的嫡流公家一支，由左大臣三条实房之子公宣开创，属羽林家格，在室町初期一度断绝，1613年由阿野实显之子公景再兴，领地两百石，以研究有职故实即朝廷典章为家业；1760年朝廷奉天皇之命，把这一支的系谱与古老的小一条流系谱合并为同一家。

en: The Capetian House of Anjou, also called the House of Anjou-Sicily, was a cadet branch of the French royal Capetians, founded by Charles of Anjou, youngest son of Louis VIII. Enfeoffed with Anjou and Maine in 1246, he married the heiress of Provence and, with papal backing, defeated the Hohenstaufen king Manfred at Benevento in 1266 to take the Kingdom of Sicily, confirming the conquest at Tagliacozzo in 1268. The Treaty of Viterbo in 1267 opened his way into the Balkans, and in 1272 he proclaimed himself King of Albania around Durazzo. The Sicilian Vespers of 1282 drove him from the island of Sicily to the mainland kingdom of Naples. A younger line secured Hungary: Charles Robert was crowned there in 1301, and his son Louis the Great inherited Poland in 1370. In 1337 Robert the Wise ruled at Naples while Charles I reigned in Hungary. Later decades were scarred by the murder of Andrew of Hungary in 1345 and the wars between Queen Joanna I and the Hungarian kings. The Durazzo branch produced Charles III, king of both Naples and Hungary, then Ladislaus and Joanna II, whose death in 1435 ended the senior line. Naples passed first to Rene of the Valois-Anjou branch and then, in 1442, to Alfonso V of Aragon.
zh: 安茹-西西里王朝是法国卡佩王室的支系，由路易八世的幼子安茹的查理一世创立。他于1246年受封安茹和曼恩，又娶普罗旺斯女继承人而得到普罗旺斯；在教宗支持下，他于1266年在贝内文托击败霍亨斯陶芬家族的曼弗雷迪，夺取西西里王国，并在1268年的塔利亚科佐之战后巩固了征服。1267年的《维泰博条约》为他打开了通往巴尔干的道路，1272年他在都拉佐一带自立为阿尔巴尼亚国王。1282年的西西里晚祷使他被逐出西西里本岛，退居大陆上的那不勒斯王国。家族的一支在匈牙利立足：卡洛·罗贝托于1301年加冕为匈牙利国王卡罗伊一世，其子拉约什一世又在1370年继承波兰王位。1337年，智者罗贝托在那不勒斯在位，卡罗伊一世则统治匈牙利。此后的岁月因1345年匈牙利的安德烈遇害、女王乔万娜一世与匈牙利诸王的战争而动荡。都拉佐支系先后出了同时身兼那不勒斯与匈牙利国王的卡洛三世，以及拉迪斯劳和乔万娜二世；乔万娜二世于1435年去世，安茹长支就此断绝。那不勒斯先由瓦卢瓦-安茹支系的勒内继承，最终在1442年落入阿拉贡国王阿方索五世之手。

en: The Ano were a court-noble house of Kyoto, a junior branch of the Shigenoi family within the Northern Fujiwara Kan'in line, ranked among the urin houses. Their founder was Fujiwara no Kinsuke, fourth son of Fujiwara no Narichika and adopted son of Shigenoi Sanekuni; he married the heiress of Ano Zenjō, lord of the Ano manor in Suruga and a son of Minamoto no Yoshitomo and full brother of Yoshitsune, and the manor's name became his family name. His son Sanenao took rank as a kugyō in 1249. The house rose through the imperial bedchamber: the fifth head served Emperor Go-Daigo, and his sister Renshi became the emperor's consort and mother of Emperor Go-Murakami, binding the Ano to the Southern Court through the Nanboku-chō split, when one of their heads even reached the Inner Minister's post. After the courts reunited in 1392 the family kept a middle-rank place among Kyoto's kugyō, until successive early deaths left it without an heir, and the line lapsed for about half a century. The sixteenth head Saneaki, a grandson of the last lord, revived the house and in 1612 reached Provisional Major Counselor of Junior Second Rank, its Edo-period ceiling; on a stipend of 478 koku it passed the period with court music and ceremonial lore as its hereditary arts.
zh: 阿野家是京都的公家，属藤原北家闲院流滋野井家的庶流，家格为羽林家。始祖藤原公佐是藤原成亲的第四子、滋野井实国的养子，他娶了骏河国阿野庄领主阿野全成（源义朝之子、义经的同母兄）的女儿为妻，妻方继承的阿野庄后来成为家名的由来。其子实直于1249年叙任公卿。阿野家靠后宫因缘发迹：第五代当主出仕后醍醐天皇，妹妹廉子入侍天皇并生下后村上天皇，阿野家因此在南北朝分裂时代世代效忠南朝，当主甚至官至内大臣。1392年南北朝合一后，他们回到京都朝廷，保持着中等公家的地位，战国时却因当主接连早逝、无嗣而家门中断约半世纪。第十六代实显以末代当主之孙的身份复兴家名，于1612年叙任公卿、升至正二位权大纳言，这也是江户时代阿野家的极官；其家禄478石，以神乐与有职故实为家业。

en: The degli Antelminelli were a Ghibelline noble family of Lucca, swept into the faction wars of medieval Tuscany. Their greatest figure was Castruccio Castracani, exiled with his family by the Black Guelphs in 1300. He made his name as a condottiero in Flanders, Lombardy and then Tuscany under the Pisan lord Uguccione della Faggiuola, fighting at the capture of Lucca in 1314 and the victory of Montecatini in 1315. After Uguccione turned on him, a Lucchese revolt freed him, and in 1316 he was elected lifelong consul of Lucca in place of the Quartigiani. Made imperial vicar by Frederick of Austria in 1320, he later served Emperor Louis the Bavarian, crushed the Florentines at Altopascio in 1325 and was named duke of Lucca, Pistoia, Volterra and Luni, taking Pisa as well in 1327. His death in 1328 ruined his young heirs, and amid the Guelph comeback the family lost its grip on Lucca, though it survived in the city. In 1596 its members were tried for treason over dealings with Tuscany; Alessandro Antelminelli escaped to London, where he lived as Amerigo Salvetti and served as Tuscan envoy.
zh: 德利·安泰尔米内利是卢卡的吉伯林派贵族世家，卷入了中世纪托斯卡纳的党派战争。家族最杰出的人物是卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼，他于1300年随家人被黑党圭尔夫派放逐，此后在佛兰德、伦巴第当雇佣军队长，又投到比萨领主乌古乔内·德拉·法焦拉麾下，参加了1314年攻占卢卡和1315年蒙特卡蒂尼大捷。乌古乔内后来对他反目相害，卢卡民众起事才使他获释；1316年，他取代夸尔蒂贾尼家族当选卢卡终身执政官。1320年他被奥地利的腓特烈任命为帝国代理人，后来又效力于皇帝巴伐利亚的路德维希，1325年在阿尔托帕肖大败佛罗伦萨人，受封为卢卡、皮斯托亚、沃尔泰拉和卢尼公爵，1327年又拿下比萨。他于1328年去世，年幼的继承人随即失势，趁圭尔夫派反攻之机，家族丧失了对卢卡的控制，但仍在城中存续。1596年，家族成员因与托斯卡纳往来被控叛国，亚历山德罗·安泰尔米内利逃往伦敦，化名阿梅里戈·萨尔韦蒂，后来出任托斯卡纳驻英使节。

en: The Apokaukos family is attested in Byzantine service from the tenth to the fifteenth century. Its earliest known member was Basil Apokaukos, strategos of the Peloponnese around 990, and around 1200 John Apokaukos served as Metropolitan of Naupaktos. The family's greatest figure was Alexios Apokaukos, who came from a humble Bithynian background but rose through the fiscal bureaucracy to become imperial chamberlain in 1321 and megas doux, commander of the navy, under Andronikos III in 1341. Once the protégé of John Kantakouzenos, he switched to the regency faction of the Empress Anna of Savoy and Patriarch John XIV Kalekas when the civil war of 1341 began, and became urban prefect of Constantinople while his sons John and Manuel were made governors of Thessalonica and Adrianople. In June 1345 he was lynched by political prisoners while inspecting a new prison, and the family's influence collapsed with the regency's cause. A George Apokaukos was still recorded as archon at Constantinople in 1403, and after the city fell to the Ottomans in 1453 Demetrios Kyritzes Apokaukos entered the service of Sultan Mehmed II.
zh: 阿波卡夫科斯家族有记载的拜占庭仕途从10世纪延续到15世纪。已知最早的成员是约990年任伯罗奔尼撒将军的瓦西里·阿波卡夫科斯，约1200年前后约翰·阿波卡夫科斯出任纳夫帕克托斯都主教。家族最显赫的人物是阿历克塞·阿波卡夫科斯，他出身比提尼亚寒门，却从财税官僚一路升迁，1321年任宫内大臣，1341年在安德洛尼卡三世治下成为海军大都督。他本是约翰·坎塔库齐诺斯的门生，1341年内战爆发时却转投萨伏依的安娜皇后与牧首约翰十四世·卡莱卡斯的摄政阵营，出任君士坦丁堡市长，他的儿子约翰和曼努埃尔则分别担任塞萨洛尼基和阿德里安堡总督。1345年6月，他在视察一座新监狱时被政治犯私刑处死，家族势力也随摄政阵营的失势骤然衰落。1403年仍有一位乔治·阿波卡夫科斯在君士坦丁堡任执政官；1453年城市落入奥斯曼之手后，季米特里奥斯·基里齐斯·阿波卡夫科斯转投苏丹穆罕默德二世麾下。

en: This branch of the Roman Orsini family built its fortunes on the Ionian Islands and in Epirus. Matthew Orsini succeeded the Sicilian admiral Margaritus of Brindisi around 1195 as count of Cephalonia and Zakynthos, holding the islands as a vassal successively of Venice, the papacy and the Principality of Achaea. His descendant Richard Orsini was followed by John I, who married an Epirote princess and gained Leukas as her dowry. The family then crossed to the mainland: in 1318 Nicholas Orsini murdered his uncle Thomas Komnenos Doukas, seized southern Epirus around Arta, adopted Orthodoxy and received the Byzantine title of despot, until his brother John II killed him in 1323. John II lost Cephalonia to his Angevin overlord John of Gravina in 1324 but ruled Epirus until his death, probably by poison, in 1335. His young son Nikephoros II inherited amid a regency, and in 1337 and 1338 Emperor Andronikos III overran Epirus and ended its independence. Nikephoros briefly recovered his inheritance between 1356 and 1359, when he fell fighting the Albanians at the Battle of Achelous. The island county had meanwhile passed to the Angevins and, in 1357, to the Tocco family.
zh: 这支罗马奥尔西尼家族的支系在伊奥尼亚群岛和伊庇鲁斯起家。1195年前后，马泰奥·奥尔西尼继西西里海军将领布林迪西的马加里托之后成为凯法利尼亚和扎金索斯伯爵，先后臣属于威尼斯、教宗和亚该亚公国。传到后人里卡尔多，再到乔瓦尼一世时，他娶了伊庇鲁斯公主，以嫁妆得到莱夫卡达岛。此后家族渡海登上大陆：1318年，尼科洛·奥尔西尼杀死舅父托马斯·科穆宁·杜卡斯，夺取阿尔塔一带的南伊庇鲁斯，皈依东正教并接受拜占庭的专制公封号，最终于1323年被弟弟乔瓦尼二世所杀。乔瓦尼二世于1324年被宗主安茹家族的格拉维纳的乔瓦尼夺去凯法利尼亚，但仍统治伊庇鲁斯，直到1335年疑似被毒杀。他年幼的儿子尼基弗鲁斯二世在摄政中继位，1337至1338年，皇帝安德洛尼卡三世攻灭伊庇鲁斯的独立地位。尼基弗鲁斯曾在1356至1359年短暂恢复祖业，最终于1359年在阿刻罗俄斯河之战中与阿尔巴尼亚人作战时阵亡。而群岛伯国此前已转入安茹家族之手，并于1357年改归托科家族。

en: The Arghunids were the family of the Mongol amirs Arghun Aqa, his son Nawrūz and his grandson Arghun Shah, who led the Ja'un-i Qurban, a Mongol military tribe settled in Khorasan. After the Ilkhanate collapsed in 1335, Arghun Shah became the chief supporter and commander-in-chief of the Ilkhanid claimant Togha Temür, ruling from Nishapur over Tus, Mashhad and the Atak frontier. In 1337 he purged his rival Ali Qushji and crushed the Jalayirid-backed governor Muhammad Mulai, but the Sarbadars seized Nishapur in 1340 and forced him back to Tus. Arghun Shah died in 1345 or 1346; his son Muhammad Beg abandoned Togha Temür and allied with the Sarbadars. The tribe later submitted to Timur around 1381 and joined the failed revolt of Hajji Beg at Tus in 1389.
zh: 阿儿浑家族是蒙古异密阿儿浑·阿合、其子捏兀鲁思及其孙阿儿浑沙的家族，阿儿浑沙统领着驻牧于呼罗珊的蒙古军事部落乔尼·库尔班。1335年伊利汗国瓦解后，阿儿浑沙成为汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿的主要支持者和军队统帅，以内沙布尔为中心统治图斯、马什哈德和阿塔克边境地带。1337年，他诛杀政敌阿里·库什吉，又击败了札剌亦儿人扶植的长官穆罕默德·穆莱；但萨尔巴达尔人于1340年夺取内沙布尔，把他逼回图斯。阿儿浑沙死于1345或1346年，其子穆罕默德·别吉背弃脱合帖木儿，转而与萨尔巴达尔人结盟。该部落后来于约1381年臣服帖木儿，并在1389年参与了哈吉·别吉在图斯发动的失败叛乱。

en: The Arianiti were a noble Albanian family whose lands covered the Shkumbin valley and the old Via Egnatia road in central Albania, reaching east to the Ohrid lake and Bitola. A David Arianites already served the Byzantine emperor Basil II as strategos of Thessalonica and then of Skopje in the campaigns of 1001 to 1018, while the first securely attested medieval member, the sebastos Alexius Arianiti, swore allegiance to Charles I of Naples for the Kingdom of Albania in 1274. From the fourteenth century they also used the surname Komneni to bolster their noble standing. Their greatest figure was Gjergj Arianiti, whose father Komnen held the Sopot fortress; from 1430 Gjergj won a series of victories over Ottoman armies, and his kin joined the League of Lezhe in 1444. The family left the league in 1450, but Skanderbeg bound them to his cause by marrying Gjergj's daughter Donika in 1451, while another daughter, Angelina, married the Serbian despot Stefan Brankovic and was later venerated as a saint. Gjergj's kinsman Moisi Golemi fought at Skanderbeg's side. As the Ottomans closed in, some Arianiti converted to Islam and entered Ottoman service, while the sons of Gjergj's Italian marriage withdrew to Italy; the male line died out in the mid-sixteenth century.
zh: 阿里亚尼蒂是阿尔巴尼亚的贵族世家，领地覆盖阿尔巴尼亚中部的什昆宾河谷与古老的埃格纳提亚大道，向东延伸至奥赫里德湖和比托拉一带。早在1001至1018年的战事中，就有一位大卫·阿里亚尼蒂在拜占庭皇帝瓦西里二世麾下历任塞萨洛尼基和斯科普里将军；而中世纪第一位确凿可考的成员、至尊者阿历克塞·阿里亚尼蒂于1274年向那不勒斯的查理一世宣誓效忠，承认其阿尔巴尼亚王国。14世纪起，他们还兼用科穆宁这一姓氏以抬高门第。家族最杰出的人物是乔治·阿里亚尼蒂，他的父亲科穆宁据守索波特要塞；从1430年起，乔治多次击败奥斯曼军队，他的族人于1444年加入莱什联盟。1450年家族退出联盟，但斯坎德培在1451年娶乔治之女多妮卡为妻，以此维系双方同盟；另一个女儿安格琳娜嫁给塞尔维亚专制公斯特凡·布兰科维奇，后来被尊为圣徒。乔治的族人莫伊西·戈莱米则随斯坎德培征战。随着奥斯曼人步步紧逼，一部分阿里亚尼蒂家族成员改宗伊斯兰教、进入奥斯曼军政体系，而乔治与意大利妻子所生的儿子们则退往意大利；男系于16世纪中叶断绝。

en: The Arima of Hizen were a warrior house that arose in the Arima estate of Takaki district in Hizen province on Kyushu. Their own tradition derives them from Fujiwara no Sumitomo of Iyo, but they were more probably descendants of the Taira stewards of the Fujitsu estate. During the Kenpō era of the early thirteenth century Arima Tsunezumi received the jitō office of the Arima estate and took its name, and the family built its power in southern Takaki, serving in turn the Kikuchi and the Shōni in the Nanboku-chō wars. In the Sengoku period the lord Kenzumi, granted a character of his name by Shogun Ashikaga Yoshiharu, called himself Haruzumi and came to rule six districts of Hizen. His grandson Harunobu became one of the best-known Christian daimyo, baptised Protasio and later called John: in 1582 he joined Ōtomo Sōrin and Ōmura Sumitada in sending the Tenshō embassy to Europe, and he allied with the Shimazu to check the Ryūzōji before submitting to Toyotomi Hideyoshi in 1587 and keeping forty thousand koku around Hinoe Castle. Harunobu sided with the east at Sekigahara and kept his lands, but was exiled and executed in the Okamoto Daihachi affair of 1612; his son Naozumi inherited the domain, which was moved in 1619 to Nobeoka in Hyūga, in 1691 to Itoigawa in Echigo and in 1695 to Maruoka in Echizen, where the Arima ruled as daimyo for the rest of the Edo period.
zh: 肥前有马氏是兴起于九州肥前国高来郡有马庄的武家。其家传自称是伊予藤原纯友的后裔，实际更可能是藤津庄庄司平氏一族的后人。13世纪初建保年间，有马经澄受任有马庄地头，遂以有马为姓，在高来郡南部扩张势力，南北朝时期先后从属菊池氏和少贰氏。战国时代，当主贤纯获将军足利义晴赐字，改名晴纯，一度支配肥前六个郡。其孙有马晴信是著名的吉利支丹大名，教名普罗塔西奥，后改为若昂；1582年他与大友宗麟、大村纯忠共同派出天正遣欧使节，又联合岛津氏抵御龙造寺氏的南进，1587年向丰臣秀吉称臣，保住高来郡四万石领地，居于日野江城。关原之战中有马晴信加入东军，封地得到安堵，却在1612年的冈本大八事件中被幕府流放并处死；其子直纯继承遗领，1619年转封日向延冈藩，1691年移封越后丝鱼川，1695年又移封越前丸冈，有马氏此后以丸冈藩主的身份延续到江户末年。

en: The counts of Armagnac were a Gascon comital house seated at Auch, between the Adour and the Garonne. The county was carved out of Fezensac in 960, and after the Treaty of Meaux in 1229 it was the strongest fief in Gascony, its rulers ranking with the counts of Foix and the lords of Albret as the great southern magnates. Count John I, who ruled from 1319 to 1373, enlarged the patrimony through marriage and purchase, adding the counties of Rodez and Carlat and several viscounties. Ceded to England with Aquitaine by the Treaty of Brétigny in 1360, Armagnac found the Black Prince's taxes unbearable and in 1369 its count placed himself under Charles V of France. Bernard VII, who died in 1418, married his daughter to the Duke of Orléans and led the royal party against the Burgundians, and the whole faction came to be called the Armagnacs; the civil war lasted until 1435, and his veteran followers later fought as mercenaries in the Armagnac War in Switzerland in 1444. Count John V resisted Louis XI and was killed at the siege of Lectoure in 1473, and with the last count's death in 1497 the house lost its lands, which Henry IV joined to the royal domain in 1607.
zh: 阿马尼亚克伯爵是加斯科涅的伯爵世家，驻于阿杜尔河与加龙河之间的欧什。伯国于960年从费藏萨克分出，1229年《莫城条约》后成为加斯科涅最强大的封邑，其统治者与富瓦伯爵、阿尔布雷领主并称南方三大诸侯。1319至1373年在位的让一世通过联姻和购买扩充家产，并入罗德兹、卡尔拉两个伯国和数个子爵领。1360年《布雷蒂尼条约》把阿马尼亚克随阿基坦割让给英格兰，黑太子的重税令人难以忍受，伯爵遂于1369年转投法兰西的查理五世。1418年去世的贝尔纳七世把女儿嫁给奥尔良公爵，率领王党对抗勃艮第派，整个王党也因此被称为“阿马尼亚克派”；这场内战一直打到1435年，他麾下的老兵后来以雇佣兵身份参加了1444年入侵瑞士的“阿马尼亚克战争”。让五世伯爵对抗路易十一，1473年在勒克图尔围城战中被杀；1497年末代伯爵死后家族失去领地，亨利四世于1607年把阿马尼亚克并入王室领地。

en: The Counts of Arnsberg grew out of the Counts of Werl, who moved their seat from Werl to a new castle above the Ruhr at Arnsberg around 1080 and once claimed lands reaching as far as the North Sea. When the old Werl line died out in the twelfth century, the county passed through the heiress Jutta to Godfrey I of the House of Cuyk. Hemmed in by the County of Mark and the Archdiocese of Cologne, his successors lost Rietberg to a kinsman in 1237 and concentrated on clearing forests and founding towns inside their Sauerland heartland. In 1337 the county was ruled by Count William, followed by his son Godfrey IV, while a younger son of the house, Godfrey of Arnsberg, served as Bishop of Osnabrück from 1321 to 1349 and later as Archbishop of Bremen. As Godfrey IV remained childless, he sold the county to the Archdiocese of Cologne in 1368; its lands became the core of the Cologne Duchy of Westphalia, and the Arnsberg eagle entered Westphalia's arms.
zh: 阿恩斯贝格伯爵家族源自韦尔尔伯爵，后者在1080年前后把驻地从韦尔尔迁到鲁尔河畔阿恩斯贝格的新城堡，其祖辈的势力一度远达北海。12世纪韦尔尔老系断绝后，伯国经女继承人尤塔转入屈克家族的戈特弗里德一世手中。在马克伯国和科隆大主教区的夹逼下，后继者于1237年把里特贝格割给宗亲，转而专注于在绍尔兰腹地垦荒建城。1337年在位的是威廉伯爵，之后由其子戈特弗里德四世继位；家族幼子戈特弗里德·冯·阿恩斯贝格则在1321—1349年任奥斯纳布吕克主教，后来还当上不来梅大主教。戈特弗里德四世无嗣，于1368年把伯国卖给科隆大主教区，其领地成为科隆治下威斯特伐利亚公国的核心，阿恩斯贝格之鹰也被收入威斯特伐利亚的纹章。

en: The Capetian House of Artois began in 1237, when Louis VIII of France gave the County of Artois, reclaimed from Flanders after the Battle of Bouvines, as an appanage to his younger son Robert, born in 1216. Robert I refused an imperial crown offered by Pope Gregory IX in 1240 and died ten years later charging into the streets of Mansurah during the Seventh Crusade. His son Robert II, born after his father's death, ruled for half a century until he was killed at the Battle of the Golden Spurs in 1302. The succession then passed to his daughter Mahaut against the claim of her nephew Robert III, who in 1331 was convicted of forging his father's will and exiled in 1332. Robert took refuge at the court of Edward III of England, where his accounts of the French court and his urging of Edward's claim to the French throne helped bring on the Hundred Years' War; Philip VI cited Edward's protection of Robert when he confiscated Guyenne in 1337. Robert commanded the Anglo-Flemish army at Saint-Omer in 1340 and died of wounds after the retreat from Vannes in 1342. His sons held counties such as Eu, while Artois itself passed through Mahaut's heiresses to the dukes of Burgundy in 1384 and, after centuries in the Spanish Netherlands, was ceded to France by the Treaty of the Pyrenees in 1659.
zh: 卡佩系的阿图瓦家族始于1237年：法兰西国王路易八世把布汶战役后从佛兰德斯收回的阿图瓦伯国作为封禄，赐给生于1216年的幼子罗贝尔。罗贝尔一世曾在1240年谢绝教皇格列高利九世奉上的皇帝冠冕，十年后在第七次十字军东征中冲入曼苏拉街巷战死。他的遗腹子罗贝尔二世统治了半个世纪，最终于1302年在金马刺战役中阵亡。爵位随后传给其女马奥，她的侄子罗贝尔三世主张继承权失败，又在1331年因伪造父亲遗嘱获罪，于1332年被流放。罗贝尔逃到英格兰国王爱德华三世的宫廷，他对法兰西宫廷的情报和对爱德华争夺法国王位的怂恿，成为百年战争的诱因之一；腓力六世1337年没收吉耶讷时，给出的理由正是爱德华收留罗贝尔。罗贝尔1340年在圣奥梅尔指挥英荷联军，1342年从瓦讷撤退后因伤死去。他的儿子们保有厄等伯国，而阿图瓦本土经马奥的女继承人于1384年转入勃艮第公爵之手，在西属尼德兰辖下度过数百年后，依1659年的《比利牛斯条约》割让给法兰西。

en: The Artuqids were a Turkoman dynasty of the Oghuz Döger tribe, named after Artuk Bey, a Seljuk general who governed Jerusalem from 1086 until his death in 1091. Expelled from Jerusalem by the Fatimids in 1098, his sons Sökmen and Ilghazi carved out principalities in Upper Mesopotamia and northern Syria, ruling from Hasankeyf, Harput, Mardin and at times Aleppo. Ilghazi crushed the Principality of Antioch at the Battle of Ager Sanguinis in 1119, and for much of the twelfth century the Artuqid beys were among the leading Muslim rivals of the Crusader states, while also patronising architecture and the arts in their walled cities. The Hasankeyf and Harput lines fell to the Ayyubids and the Seljuks of Rum in the thirteenth century, but the Mardin branch endured as a vassal in turn of the Ayyubids, the Ilkhanids, to whom Qara Arslan submitted after the Mongol conquest, and later the Timurids and the Qara Qoyunlu. In 1337 the Mardin ruler was as-Salih Mahmud, who reigned from 1312 to 1364. The line ended when the Qara Qoyunlu seized Mardin in 1409 and deposed the last Artuqid bey, Ahmad.
zh: 阿图克王朝是出自乌古斯突厥德格尔部的土库曼王朝，得名于阿尔图克贝伊——他原是塞尔柱将领，1086年起出任耶路撒冷总督，1091年去世。他的儿子索克曼和伊尔加齐1098年被法蒂玛王朝逐出耶路撒冷后，在上美索不达米亚和叙利亚北部建立割据政权，先后以哈桑凯伊夫、哈尔普特、马尔丁为都，并一度统治阿勒颇。伊尔加齐于1119年在萨尔马达之战（血田战役）中大破安条克公国；整个12世纪，阿图克诸贝伊都是十字军国家最主要的穆斯林对手之一，同时在其城墙环绕的城市里大兴建筑、庇护艺文。哈桑凯伊夫和哈尔普特两支于13世纪先后被阿尤布王朝和罗姆塞尔柱人攻灭，唯有马尔丁支系存续下来，相继臣服于阿尤布王朝、伊儿汗国（卡拉·阿尔斯兰在蒙古征服后向旭烈兀称臣）、帖木儿王朝和黑羊王朝。1337年在位的是1312年至1364年统治马尔丁的萨利赫·马哈茂德。1409年黑羊王朝攻占马尔丁，废黜末代贝伊艾哈迈德，王朝遂告终结。

en: The Aryacakravarti dynasty ruled the Jaffna Kingdom on the Jaffna Peninsula in northern Sri Lanka from the thirteenth to the seventeenth century. The family first appears in the records between 1277 and 1283 as a military leader in the service of the Pandyan Empire, who raided western Sri Lanka and carried off the Buddha's tooth relic from the Sinhalese capital of Yapahuwa; inscriptions in Tamil Nadu dated between 1272 and 1305 connect the line with the Ramanathapuram coast, while its court chronicles claimed descent from Tamil Brahmins of the Rameswaram temple. Jaffna became a Pandyan feudatory in 1258 and gained independence early in the fourteenth century, when Malik Kafur overthrew the Pandyas of Madurai, and for a time the dynasty was the strongest power on the island. Around 1450 the Kotte kingdom under Parakramabahu VI conquered Jaffna, which only recovered its freedom in 1467. After the Portuguese reached Sri Lanka in 1505 the kings alternated between war and treaties; the last ruler, Cankili II, was defeated in 1617 and the kingdom was annexed in 1619, ending the dynasty.
zh: 阿梨耶遮迦罗跋帝王朝在13至17世纪统治斯里兰卡北部贾夫纳半岛上的贾夫纳王国。该家族最早见于1277—1283年的记载，当时一位同名将领在潘地亚帝国军中效力，劫掠斯里兰卡西部，并从僧伽罗人的都城亚帕胡瓦夺走佛牙舍利；1272—1305年间泰米尔纳德的铭文把这一家族与拉默纳特布勒姆沿海联系起来，其宫廷编年史则自称出身于拉梅斯沃勒姆神庙的泰米尔婆罗门。贾夫纳于1258年成为潘地亚的附庸，14世纪初马利克·卡富尔推翻马杜赖的潘地亚统治者后获得独立，一度成为全岛最强的政权。约1450年，科提王国在波罗迦罗摩巴忽六世治下攻占贾夫纳，直到1467年当地才恢复独立。1505年葡萄牙人来到该岛后，诸王在交战与订约之间周旋；末代君主桑吉利二世于1617年战败，王国在1619年被吞并，王朝告终。

en: The Asakura were a samurai clan whose home was Asakura in Yabu district of Tajima Province, where in the late Heian period Kusakabe Munetaka, of a family claiming imperial descent, first took the Asakura name. A branch entered Echizen in the Nanboku-chō wars when Asakura Hirokage and his son Takakage took service with the Shiba, the province's shugo; after changing sides during the Jōji Incident they kept their new holdings and rose to become one of the Shiba's three deputy-governor houses alongside the Kai and Oda. In the Ōnin War the seventh head Asakura Toshikage, who lived from 1428 to 1481, switched from the western to the eastern camp in 1471, overcame the rival Kai family, united Echizen and built Ichijōdani Castle; his seventeen-article house code made him the first Sengoku daimyō of the line. The Asakura then ruled Echizen steadily and campaigned into Wakasa, Kaga, Ōmi and Mino. The eleventh head Yoshikage sheltered the fugitive shōgun Ashikaga Yoshiaki but refused to march on Kyoto, and his wars with Oda Nobunaga alongside the Azai ended in defeat at Anegawa in 1570 and the burning of Ichijōdani in 1573, when Yoshikage killed himself. A later kinsman, Asakura Nobumasa, held Kakegawa Domain from 1625 until he was disgraced and dispossessed in 1632, while another branch served the Tokugawa as hatamoto.
zh: 朝仓氏本是但马国养父郡朝仓地方的武家，平安末期，自称皇室后裔的日下部宗高定居于此，始称朝仓氏，其本贯在今天的兵库县养父市一带。南北朝时代，支流的朝仓广景、高景父子出仕越前守护斯波氏，在贞治之变中倒向幕府一方，所领得到安堵，从此在越前扎根，与甲斐氏、织田氏并列为斯波家的三守护代。第七代当主朝仓孝景生于1428年、卒于1481年，他在应仁之乱中于1471年由西军转投东军，击败争权的甲斐氏，平定越前，修筑一乘谷城，并颁布分国法《朝仓敏景十七条》，成为朝仓家的初代战国大名。此后朝仓氏稳定统治越前，还屡次出兵若狭、加贺、近江和美浓。第十一代当主义景收留了流亡的将军足利义昭，却不肯奉其上洛，又与浅井长政结盟对抗织田信长，最终在1570年姊川之战中战败，1573年一乘谷城被焚毁、义景自尽，战国大名朝仓氏就此灭亡。族人朝仓宣正1625年受封远江国挂川藩，1632年因事获罪被改易，另有一支以江户幕府旗本身份存续。

en: The Asayama were a warrior house based at the Asayama estate in Kandori district in Izumo Province, who traced an ancient lineage back to the early Heian period and claimed descent from the Otomo kin group, later bearing the court-granted surname Katsube. A Kamakura-period head already appears in documents from the shogunal prince Hisaaki and the regent Hojo Sadatoki, and Katsube Masatsuna helped fund the rebuilding of Izumo Taisha in 1242 and was appointed a guards officer, emon-no-jo, for it. Asayama Kagetsura served Ashikaga Takauji in the Nanboku-cho wars and was rewarded with stewardships in Hoki and Izumo, and his son Yoshikage received further Izumo estates from Shogun Ashikaga Yoshiakira after kinsmen died in the fighting. Through the Muromachi age the house combined court guard titles with Izumo landholding, until Asayama Toshitsuna became a retainer of Amago Tsunehisa in the early sixteenth century. With its home district wasted by the Sengoku wars, Oda Nobunaga in the 1580s settled the family on new land in Yamashiro Province near Kyoto; in 1601 Asayama Yukitsuna became a northern guard of Emperor Go-Yozei, and from 1612 the house served the Kujo court nobility as hereditary stewards.
zh: 朝山氏是以出云国神门郡朝山乡为据点的武家，谱系可追溯到平安时代早期，自称出自大伴氏一族，后来受赐胜部姓。镰仓时代，其当主已见于将军久明亲王和执权北条贞时的奉书；1242年，胜部昌纲为出云大社的营造出资，被任命为右卫门尉。南北朝时，朝山景连出仕足利尊氏，凭战功受封伯耆、出云两国的地头职；其子义景在族人战死后，又从将军足利义诠处得到出云国内的多处领地。整个室町时代，该家既带朝廷武官头衔，又在出云保有领地，到16世纪初，朝山利纲成为尼子经久的家臣。由于故乡在战国兵乱中荒废，织田信长于16世纪80年代将其一家安置到京都附近的山城国；1601年，朝山幸纲成为后阳成天皇的北面武士，1612年起，朝山家世代担任公卿九条家的家司。

en: The Asen dynasty founded and ruled the Second Bulgarian Empire from Tarnovo between 1185 and 1280. The brothers Peter and Ivan Asen I led the revolt against Byzantine taxation in 1185 and restored an independent Bulgarian state. Ivan Asen was murdered by the boyar Ivanko in 1196 and Peter in 1197, leaving their youngest brother Kaloyan on the throne. A papal legate crowned Kaloyan king at Tarnovo in 1204, and in 1205 he captured the Latin emperor Baldwin I at the Battle of Adrianople before his own death in 1207. After the weak reign of Boril, Ivan Asen II returned in 1218, blinded his rival, and brought Bulgaria to its height: his victory over Theodore Komnenos Doukas at Klokotnitsa in 1230 opened Macedonia and Thrace to his rule, and in 1235 the Bulgarian patriarchate was restored. His death in 1241 began a long decline, and in 1280 Ivan Asen III fled the revolt of Ivaylo for Constantinople, where he had already married Irene Palaiologina, daughter of Michael VIII. Their descendants became a leading Byzantine noble house: Andronikos Asen governed the Morea from 1316, and Irene Asanina sat as empress beside John VI Kantakouzenos from 1347, while other branches carried the Asen name to Theodoro, Moldavia, Naples and Aragon.
zh: 阿森王朝在1185至1280年间以特尔诺沃为都，建立并统治着第二保加利亚帝国。1185年，彼得和伊凡·阿森一世兄弟领导了反抗拜占庭加税的起义，重建独立的保加利亚国家。伊凡·阿森于1196年被贵族伊万科杀害，彼得也在1197年遇刺，幼弟卡洛扬遂登位。1204年，教皇使节在特尔诺沃为卡洛扬加冕为王；1205年，他在阿德里安堡战役中生擒拉丁皇帝鲍德温一世，本人则于1207年死去。经过博里尔的软弱统治后，伊凡·阿森二世于1218年回国，刺瞎对手夺取王位，把保加利亚推向鼎盛：1230年他在克洛科特尼察击败塞奥多雷·科穆宁·杜卡斯，马其顿和色雷斯尽入其版图，1235年保加利亚牧首区也得以恢复。他1241年去世后国势长期衰落，1280年伊凡·阿森三世为躲避伊瓦伊洛起义逃往君士坦丁堡——他此前已娶米哈伊尔八世之女伊琳娜·巴列奥略。他们的后代成为拜占庭的一流望族：安德洛尼卡·阿森于1316年起治理摩里亚，伊琳娜·阿萨尼娜则在1347年成为约翰六世·坎塔库齐诺斯的皇后，另有支系把阿森之名带到狄奥多罗、摩尔达维亚、那不勒斯和阿拉贡。

en: The Ashikaga were a branch of the Minamoto, the Seiwa Genji, who took their name from their manor at Ashikaga in Shimotsuke Province, present-day Tochigi, where Minamoto no Yoshiyasu settled in the 1100s; his son Yoshikane married a daughter of Hojo Tokimasa and became a leading vassal of the Kamakura shogunate. When the main Minamoto line died out, the Ashikaga claimed its headship. In 1333 the clan head Ashikaga Takauji helped Emperor Go-Daigo destroy the Hojo regime, but by 1336 he had turned against the Kenmu Restoration, set up a Northern Court in Kyoto and taken the title of shogun, opening the decades of the Northern and Southern Courts war that ended in 1392 when the Southern Court submitted to the third shogun Yoshimitsu. Yoshimitsu built the Flower Palace in Kyoto's Muromachi district, giving the shogunate its other name, and presided over flourishing Zen culture and licensed trade with Ming China. The clan spawned great branch houses including the Hosokawa, Imagawa, Hatakeyama, Kira and Shiba, while a rival Kamakura branch, the Kanto kubo, was crushed in 1439. The Onin War of 1467 shattered shogunal authority and opened the Sengoku age; in 1573 Oda Nobunaga drove out the last shogun Yoshiaki and ended Ashikaga rule.
zh: 足利氏出自源氏支流清和源氏，因12世纪源义康定居下野国足利庄而得姓；其子义兼迎娶北条时政之女，成为镰仓幕府的有力御家人。源氏嫡流断绝后，足利氏便以源氏首领自居。1333年，当主足利尊氏协助后醍醐天皇推翻北条政权，但到1336年便背弃建武新政，在京都另立北朝并就任征夷大将军，开启了持续数十年的南北朝动乱，直至1392年南朝向第三代将军义满投降。义满在京都室町街营建花之御所，室町幕府由此得名，其治下禅宗文化兴盛，与明朝的勘合贸易繁荣。足利氏分出细川、今川、畠山、吉良、斯波等名门支流，而盘踞镰仓的关东公方一系则在1439年被攻灭。1467年应仁之乱摧毁了幕府权威，揭开战国时代；1573年织田信长驱逐末代将军义昭，足利氏的统治告终。

en: The Ashina were a Taira-descended warrior house sprung from the Miura clan of Sagami, taking their name from Ashina in Miura district, the land around present-day Yokosuka where their castle stood. Two lines emerged: the Sagami Ashina, one of whom served as shugo of Hōki in the mid-Kamakura age, and the Aizu Ashina, founded when Miura Yoshiaki's seventh son Sawara Yoshitsura received Aizu for his part in the Ōshū campaign of 1189; the name Ashina was first taken by his grandson Mitsumori, and the Muromachi heads styled themselves shugo of Aizu from their Kurokawa seat. The clan peaked under Ashina Moriuji, the great Sengoku lord of the northern Kantō, but his death in 1580 opened a succession crisis: his adopted heir Moritaka was murdered by a retainer in 1584, the infant Kameōmaru died two years later, and the house finally adopted Ashina Yoshihiro, a son of the Satake lord Yoshishige. In 1589 Date Masamune crushed Yoshihiro at the Battle of Suriagehara and overran Aizu. Yoshihiro fled to Hitachi, was later settled as a Satake retainer at Kakunodate in Dewa with sixteen thousand koku, and his line ended with the child Sentsurumaru; a retainer branch, the Hariu, revived the Ashina surname under the Sendai Date lord Tsunamura in 1676.
zh: 芦名氏是出自相模国三浦氏的平氏流武家，得名于三浦郡的芦名，即今神奈川县横须贺市一带，芦名城即建于此。家族分为两支：相模芦名氏在镰仓中期曾有人出任伯耆守护；会津芦名氏则源于1189年的奥州合战，三浦义明的第七子佐原义连因功受封会津，到其孙辈光盛时始称芦名，室町时代的当主以黑川为本据，自称会津守护。战国时代，当主芦名盛氏时家族达到鼎盛，成为北关东的一大势力；但盛氏1580年去世后继嗣危机接踵而来：养子盛隆1584年被近臣刺杀，幼主龟若丸两年后夭折，最后迎立佐竹义重之子芦名义广。1589年，伊达政宗在摺上原之战中大破义广、吞并会津，芦名氏就此没落。义广逃往常陆，后来作为佐竹家臣被安置在出羽国角馆城，领一万六千石；其嫡流随幼主千鹤丸夭折而断绝，唯有家臣针生氏一支于1676年奉仙台藩主伊达纲村之命恢复芦名旧姓。

en: The Asil are named after Khajeh Asil al-Din, one of the independent emirs who ruled Qom in the fourteenth century after the collapse of the Ilkhanate; his tomb in the city's Green Dome Garden is dated 1359 and stands beside that of Khajeh Ali Safi of the same ruling house, dated 1389. The game presents the family as Qom's dynasty.
zh: 阿西尔家族得名于火者阿西尔丁，他是伊儿汗国崩溃后14世纪割据库姆的独立异密之一；其位于库姆绿穹顶花园的陵墓建于1359年，旁边是同一家族的火者阿里·萨菲之墓（1389年）。游戏将该家族处理为库姆的本地王朝。

en: The Ascanians, also called the House of Anhalt, began as the Counts of Ballenstedt in the eastern Harz, first documented with Esico of Ballenstedt in 1036; their double name comes from Aschersleben, Latinized as Ascania, and from Anhalt Castle. Count Otto the Rich briefly held the Duchy of Saxony in 1112, but the house's great figure was his son Albert the Bear, Duke of Saxony from 1138 to 1142 and first Margrave of Brandenburg from 1150, who led German colonization into the former Slavic Nordmark. After Henry the Lion's fall, the Gelnhausen charter of 1180 gave Albert's son Bernhard the eastern remnant of Saxony. The division of 1212 separated Saxony from the Anhalt estates, and that of 1296 split Saxony into Wittenberg and Lauenburg lines. The Wittenberg dukes gained the hereditary electoral dignity in the Golden Bull of 1356, but their line died out in 1422 and Electoral Saxony passed to the Wettins; the Brandenburg line had already ended with Henry the Child in 1320, when Emperor Louis IV granted the mark to his own son. The Lauenburg line lasted until 1689 and then fell to the Welfs. The Anhalt lands, first divided among princely lines in 1252, proliferated into small principalities such as Bernburg, Köthen, Zerbst and Dessau, whose rulers took ducal rank in 1806 and 1807. In 1337 Ascanian electors, dukes and princes still held a wide scatter of lands from the Elbe to the Harz.
zh: 阿斯坎尼家族又称安哈尔特家族，最初是哈茨山东部的巴伦施泰特伯爵世家，其先祖埃西科在1036年已有文献可考；家族的两个名称分别来自阿舍斯莱本（拉丁化为阿斯坎尼亚）和安哈尔特城堡。“富人”奥托曾于1112年短暂领有萨克森公国，而家族最显赫的人物是其子“熊”阿尔布雷希特：他1138至1142年任萨克森公爵，1150年成为首任勃兰登堡藩侯，推动德意志人向昔日斯拉夫人的北方马克殖民。狮子亨利倒台后，1180年的盖尔恩豪森诏书把萨克森公国的东部残余封给阿尔布雷希特之子伯恩哈德。1212年的分家把萨克森公国与安哈尔特祖产分开，1296年萨克森又分为维滕堡和劳恩堡两支。维滕堡公爵凭1356年的金玺诏书获得世袭选帝侯地位，但该支于1422年绝嗣，选帝侯萨克森落入韦廷家族之手；勃兰登堡支系更早，1320年便因“孩童”亨利之死断绝，皇帝路德维希四世把藩侯领地封给了亲生儿子。劳恩堡支系延续到1689年，随后转入韦尔夫家族。安哈尔特祖产从1252年起一再分封，繁衍出贝恩堡、克滕、采尔布斯特、德绍等小邦，其统治者在1806和1807年晋升公爵。1337年，阿斯坎尼家族的选帝侯、公爵和诸侯们仍在易北河到哈茨山之间领有众多封地。

en: The Aso were a warrior and shrine family of Higo Province in central Kyushu, hereditarily holding the office of high priest of Aso Shrine. They traced their line to the ancient Aso provincial governors and, beyond them, to Takeiwatatsumi no Mikoto, a grandson of the legendary Emperor Jimmu. The first historically verifiable head, Korenobu, had built a warrior band around the Aso valley by the early twelfth century, and after the Kamakura shogunate was founded the family became closely tied to the Hojo regents, moving its seat south to the Hama residence in Yabe. Alongside the Kikuchi and Sagara it ranked among the great local lords of Higo. In the wars of the Nanboku-cho period the Aso fought for the Southern Court: Koretoki joined the 1333 attack on the Rokuhara deputies and the clan was defeated with the Kikuchi at Tatara-hama in 1336, after which rival Southern and Northern Court high-priest lines kept the house divided for generations. It was reunified only in 1484, and the sixteenth century brought fresh internal strife, briefly mitigated by alliances with the Otomo and Sagara. When the Shimazu overran Higo in 1585 the Aso domain collapsed and the infant head Koremitsu fled into the mountains; Toyotomi Hideyoshi later restored the family only as shrine priests, and under the Tokugawa it survived as a shrine house, becoming barons after the Meiji Restoration.
zh: 阿苏氏是九州中部肥后国的武家兼社家，世代担任阿苏神社大宫司。其家系自称上承古代的阿苏国造，更远可追溯到传说中神武天皇之孙健磐龙命。首位可考证的当主惟宣在12世纪初已在阿苏一带结成武士团；镰仓幕府建立后，阿苏家与北条执权关系密切，并把据点南迁至矢部乡的滨之馆，与菊池氏、相良氏并称肥后三大豪族。南北朝战乱中阿苏氏效忠南朝：惟时参加了1333年攻打六波罗探题的行动，1336年又随菊池氏在多多良滨战败，此后家族分裂为南朝、北朝两派大宫司，内争持续数代，直到1484年才重新统一。16世纪阿苏氏再度陷入内乱，靠与大友氏、相良氏结盟勉强维持。1585年岛津军攻入肥后，阿苏领国崩溃，年幼的当主惟光逃入深山；丰臣秀吉后来只恢复其神社宫司地位，江户时代阿苏氏以社家身份存续，明治维新后位列男爵。

en: The Asonuma were a branch of the Fujiwara-descended Ashikaga house of Shimotsuke Province, founded by Hirotsuna, fourth son of Ashikaga Aritsuna, who took his name from the Asonuma estate in Aso district, near present-day Sano, where the game locates the clan. During the Genpei War they parted from their Ashikaga kinsmen, who backed the Taira, and followed Minamoto no Yoritomo alongside the Yamakami and Ogo; Hirotsuna fought for Oyama Tomomasa and became a Kamakura gokenin. His service in the Oshu campaign of 1189 won him the stewardship of the Tono estate in distant Hei district of Mutsu, which his younger son Chikatsuna inherited, building Yokota Castle on Gomadō hill as its centre. The Shimotsuke main line kept its seat at Asonuma Castle and eventually sank into the retainer band of the Sano clan in the Sengoku period. The Tono branch flourished on its own: in 1334 its head Tomotsuna had his holdings confirmed by the Southern Court general Kitabatake Akiie, and in the late sixteenth century Hirosato of Tono made the family an independent local lord at its height, but for failing to appear at Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign of 1590 he was reduced to vassal status under the Nanbu. In 1600, while his heir Hironaga was away with the Nanbu against the Uesugi in the Sekigahara campaign, kinsmen left in charge revolted and drove him out, extinguishing the Tono main line, while a third branch settled in Aki Province lived on as retainers of the Mori and later of Choshu.
zh: 阿曾沼氏是下野国藤姓足利氏的分流，始祖为足利有纲的四男阿曾沼四郎广纲，他领有下野安苏郡的阿曾沼（今佐野市浅沼町一带）并以此为苗字，游戏也把本据放在下野。源平合战时，本家足利氏站在平家一方，阿曾沼氏却与同族山上氏、大胡氏一起追随源赖朝，广纲助阵小山朝政，成为镰仓御家人。1189年奥州合战的军功使他受封陆奥闭伊郡远野保的地头职，由次子亲纲继承，亲纲在护摩堂山修筑横田城作为统治中心。留在下野的嫡流以阿曾沼城为据点，战国时代沦为佐野氏的家臣。远野分流则自成一方势力：1334年当主朝纲的远野保所有权得到南朝将领北畠显家的安堵，16世纪后期广乡时达到鼎盛，却因1590年未参加丰臣秀吉的小田原征伐，被从独立大名降为南部氏家臣。1600年关原之战期间，广长随南部氏出征上杉，留守一族趁机叛乱，远野嫡流就此断绝；另有迁往安芸国的分流，后来投身毛利氏，江户时代作为长州藩士存续。

en: The Aspenäs family was a high noble house of Östergötland, named by later historians after its seat at Aspenäs in Malexander parish and documented from the thirteenth century. Its earliest known ancestor Filip married Cecilia Knutsdotter of the House of Bjelbo, daughter of the Swedish jarl Knut Birgersson, which gave the family royal blood through the female line. Filip's sons Johan and Birger Filipsson joined the third Folkung uprising of 1278 to 1280 against King Magnus Ladulås and were beheaded at the Great Square in Stockholm in 1280 after its defeat. Later generations served as knights, lawspeakers and members of the council of the realm, and the line ended with Erik Laurensson, who was buried in 1445.
zh: 阿斯彭奈斯家族是东约特兰的高级贵族世家，后世史家以其在马莱克桑德教区的阿斯彭奈斯庄园为它命名，可考历史始于13世纪。已知始祖菲利普娶瑞典雅尔克努特·比耶松之女、比耶尔博家族的塞西莉亚·克努茨多塔为妻，家族由此通过母系获得王室血统。菲利普之子约翰·菲利普松和比耶尔·菲利普松参加了1278—1280年反对国王马格努斯·拉杜洛斯的第三次福尔孔叛乱，失败后于1280年在斯德哥尔摩大广场被斩首。其后裔历任骑士、法律发言人和国政会议成员，家族最终随着1445年下葬的埃里克·劳伦松而绝嗣。

en: The House of Astarac was a feudal lineage of Gascony descended from the old dukes of Gascony. Around 920 Duke Garcia II divided his lands among his sons, and the youngest, Arnold, called Nonnat, received the newly created county of Astarac, a hilly country between Armagnac, Comminges and Bigorre. Its counts joined the Crusade to the Holy Land as early as 1099 and later leaned toward the Cathar cause in the thirteenth century, but the county never matched the power of its neighbour Armagnac, and the family married only within the lesser Gascon nobility. The bastide of Mirande was founded in 1280 and became the county's capital in 1297. In 1337 the line still ruled its small state from Mirande, styling itself count by the grace of God until 1442. The dynasty lasted into the sixteenth century: Count John IV died in 1511 leaving only daughters, and the county passed through his heiress Marthe to her husband Gaston III of Foix-Candale. The Foix-Candale later carried it into the Nogaret de La Valette family, whose head was the duke of Epernon, before the crown sold it to the Roquelaure family. A younger branch, the lords of Montlezun and Pardiac, survived until 1677.
zh: 阿斯塔拉克家族是加斯科涅的封建世系，出自古老的加斯科涅公爵家族。约920年，加斯科涅公爵加西亚二世把土地分给诸子，幼子阿诺德（人称“非降生者”）得到新设立的阿斯塔拉克伯国——那是一片夹在阿马尼亚克、科曼日和比戈尔之间的丘陵地带。其伯爵早在1099年就参加了前往圣地的十字军，13世纪又倾向清洁派，但该伯国始终未能比肩邻国阿马尼亚克，家族联姻也只限于加斯科涅的小贵族。1280年建立的米朗德新城于1297年成为伯国首府。1337年，该家族仍以米朗德为中心统治这个小邦，并直到1442年都自称“蒙神恩的伯爵”。王朝延续到16世纪：伯爵让四世于1511年去世，只留下女儿，伯国经女继承人玛尔特转给其丈夫富瓦-康达尔的加斯东三世。富瓦-康达尔家族后来把它带入诺加雷·德·拉瓦莱特家族（即埃佩尔农公爵一族），最后王室将其卖给罗克洛尔家族。旁支蒙特勒赞-帕尔迪亚克一支一直延续到1677年。

en: The Audleys were a marcher family named after Audley in Staffordshire, where their ancestor Adam de Alditheley held land in the twelfth century. Henry de Audley, who died in 1246, served as sheriff of Shropshire and Staffordshire, founded the Cistercian abbey at Hulton in 1223 and made Heleigh Castle the family seat while commanding royal castles on the Welsh border. His descendants acquired the Pembrokeshire lordship of Kemes by marriage, and Nicholas Audley of Heleigh was summoned to Parliament as the first Baron Audley in 1313. His son James, born in 1312 or 1313, held Heleigh together with Kemes and Barnstaple, and married a daughter of Roger Mortimer, Earl of March; he died in 1386. When his son Nicholas, the third baron, died without issue in 1391, the title fell into abeyance, and in 1408 it passed to the Tuchet family, who later held it as Earls of Castlehaven. A younger branch rose with Hugh Audley of Stratton Audley, created Earl of Gloucester in 1337, but that earldom died with him in 1347 and his heiress married into the Staffords.
zh: 奥德利家族是边境领主世家，得名于斯塔福德郡的奥德利，其先祖亚当·德·阿尔迪瑟利12世纪时在当地持有领地。1246年去世的亨利·德·奥德利曾任什罗普郡和斯塔福德郡治安官，1223年创立西多会的霍尔顿修道院，并把黑利城堡作为家族主宅，同时统辖威尔士边境的多座王家城堡。他的后代通过联姻取得了彭布罗克郡的凯梅斯领地，黑利的尼古拉斯·奥德利于1313年被召入议会，成为第一代奥德利男爵。其子詹姆斯生于1312或1313年，兼领黑利、凯梅斯和巴恩斯特普尔，娶马奇伯爵罗杰·莫蒂默之女为妻，1386年去世。他的儿子、第三代男爵尼古拉斯于1391年无嗣而终，爵位进入搁置状态，1408年转入塔切特家族，该家族后来以卡斯尔黑文伯爵身份持有此爵。旁支的斯特拉顿奥德利的休·奥德利于1337年受封格洛斯特伯爵，但该伯爵爵号随他1347年去世而废止，其女继承人嫁入斯塔福德家族。

en: The family of the counts of Auvergne emerged in the later tenth century as Carolingian authority in Aquitaine faded, holding the hill country around Clermont and Riom as a hereditary county from about 980. Around 1155 Count William VIII the Old seized most of the county from his nephew William VII, a coup that split off the dauphinate of Auvergne as a separate lordship. The main line kept the county, and in the thirteenth century Robert V also inherited the county of Boulogne on the Channel. In 1332 the inheritance fell to Joan I, a child countess, who in 1350 became the second wife of King John II of France and thus queen consort. On her death in 1360 Auvergne and Boulogne passed briefly to her son Philip of Rouvres, duke of Burgundy, then to her uncle John I and his descendants John II and Joan II. The last of the line, Mary I, died in 1437; her son Bertrand V of La Tour took the county as the first count of the House of La Tour d'Auvergne, while the duchy of Auvergne had gone to the Bourbons in 1434. When the La Tour line failed in 1531 the county passed to Catherine de' Medici and afterwards to the French royal domain.
zh: 奥弗涅伯爵家族兴起于10世纪后期，当时加洛林王朝在阿基坦的权威衰落，约980年起，该家族世袭领有克莱蒙和里永一带的丘陵伯国。约1155年，伯爵纪尧姆八世（“老者”）从侄子纪尧姆七世手中夺走伯国大部，这次政变使奥弗涅多菲内分立为单独的领地。主支保住了伯爵之位，13世纪时罗贝尔五世还继承了海峡沿岸的布洛涅伯国。1332年，领地传给年幼的女伯爵让娜一世，她于1350年成为法王让二世的第二任妻子，即法国王后。1360年她去世后，奥弗涅和布洛涅先由其子、勃艮第公爵菲利普·德·鲁夫尔短暂继承，随后转到她的叔父让一世及其后代让二世、让娜二世手中。家族最后一位传人玛丽一世于1437年去世，她的儿子拉图尔的贝特朗五世以拉图尔·德·奥弗涅家族开国伯爵的身份接管伯国，而奥弗涅公爵领地已于1434年归入波旁家族。拉图尔一系于1531年绝嗣，伯国传给卡特琳·德·美第奇，后来并入法国王室领地。

en: The House of Avesnes took its name from Avesnes-sur-Helpe in northern France and rose through the inheritance of Hainaut. In 1212 Bouchard d'Avesnes married Margaret II, countess of Flanders and Hainaut; the disputed validity of that marriage pitted his children against the Dampierre offspring of her second marriage in the long War of the Flanders and Hainaut Succession. The arbitration of King Louis IX in 1246 gave Flanders to the Dampierres and Hainaut to the Avesnes, and John I of Avesnes made good his claim by victory at West-Capelle in 1253, keeping Valenciennes as his chief seat. By the early fourteenth century the family also held Holland and Zeeland. In 1337 William II succeeded his father as count of Hainaut, Holland and Zeeland; his sister Philippa was queen of Edward III of England, and he fought on the English side in France, taking part in the siege of Cambrai in 1339, granting Rotterdam its city rights in 1340 and capturing Utrecht in 1345. Later that year he was killed fighting the Frisians at the Battle of Warns, leaving no children. His sister Margaret, wife of the Emperor Louis IV of Wittelsbach, inherited the three counties, and the Avesnes line came to an end.
zh: 阿韦讷家族得名于法国北部的埃尔普河畔阿韦讷，靠继承埃诺伯国崛起。1212年，布沙尔·德阿韦讷娶了佛兰德斯与埃诺女伯爵玛格丽特二世；这段婚姻的效力长期有争议，使他的子女与玛格丽特第二次婚姻所生的当皮埃尔子女陷入漫长的佛兰德斯-埃诺继承战争。1246年法王路易九世仲裁，把佛兰德斯判给当皮埃尔家族、埃诺判给阿韦讷家族；1253年阿韦讷的约翰一世在西卡佩勒之战中获胜，巩固了权利，并以瓦朗谢讷为主要驻地。到14世纪初，家族还领有荷兰和泽兰。1337年，威廉二世继承父位成为埃诺、荷兰和泽兰伯爵；他的姐姐菲莉帕是英王爱德华三世的王后，他本人站在英格兰一方在法国作战，1339年参加康布雷围城战，1340年授予鹿特丹城市权，1345年攻占乌得勒支。同年晚些时候，他在瓦恩斯战役中与弗里斯兰人作战时阵亡，没有留下子女。他的姐姐、皇帝路易四世（维特尔斯巴赫家族）的妻子玛格丽特继承了三个伯国，阿韦讷家族的世系就此终结。

en: The Ayarmaca were a powerful highland chiefdom that emerged from the ruins of the Wari culture around the thirteenth century in the country north and northwest of Cusco, with Pisac, Ollantaytambo, Chinchero and Calca among its eighteen towns; together with the neighboring Pinagua they formed a confederated lordship that the small Inca polity of Cusco feared. The early Incas Sinchi Roca and Lloque Yupanqui fought long wars against them, and the death of the Ayarmaca warlord Tocay Capac in battle gave Cusco breathing room, though some Ayarmaca ayllus preferred alliance to war. The confederacy recovered and later sealed a marriage alliance with Capac Yupanqui, while another warlord, Tokay Qhapaq, carried off the child who would rule as Yawar Waqaq, whose name recalls the tears of blood he wept in captivity. The Ayarmacas joined the revolts against Viracocha Inca and later sided with the Chanka against Cusco; their final rebellion in the 1460s was crushed by Pachacuti, who incorporated their lands into the Inca Empire.
zh: 阿亚尔马卡是13世纪前后从瓦里文化废墟上兴起的强大山地酋邦，据有库斯科以北和西北的乡野，皮萨克、奥兰泰坦博、钦切罗和卡尔卡等十八座城镇都在其境内；它与邻近的皮纳瓜结成联盟式领主政权，令库斯科弱小的印卡城邦深感畏惧。早期印卡君主辛奇·罗卡和略克·尤潘基长期同它交战，阿亚尔马卡战将托卡伊·卡帕克战死之后，库斯科才获得喘息之机，但也有一些阿亚尔马卡氏族选择与印卡结盟。该联盟后来恢复元气，与卡帕克·尤潘基联姻修好；另一位战将托凯·卡帕克曾劫走后来成为君主的亚瓦尔·瓦卡克，后者的名字正源于他被掳时泣血的传说。阿亚尔马卡人后来参加了反抗维拉科查·印卡的叛乱，又在昌卡来犯时站在库斯科的敌人一边；15世纪60年代他们最后一次起义被帕查库特克镇压，土地被并入印加帝国。

en: The Ayasho were the royal house of the Hunza valley, known in Burushaski as Ayeshé, meaning heavenly or heaven-born, a name that reflects the Burusho tradition that their rulers' authority came from the sky. Burushaski-speaking and later Nizari Ismaili in faith, they took the title Thum, later Mir, and traced their line to the legendary Persian prince Azar Jamshid; tradition holds that Shah Khan, called Ayasho I, founded the house in 874 after the earlier Girkis dynasty, and that the family kept marriage ties with the rulers of Wakhan and Badakhshan. Hunza remained an independent mountain principality for more than nine centuries under the Ayasho, its seat at Baltit above the valley capital. In the sixteenth century Ayasho II married Shah Khatun, a princess of Skardu, and artisans sent by her father rebuilt Baltit Fort in its present Tibetan-influenced form.
zh: 阿亚朔家族是罕萨河谷的王室，布鲁夏斯基语称 Ayeshé，意为“天上的”或“天生者”，反映了布鲁绍人认为其统治权来自上天的传统。该家族以布鲁夏斯基语为母语，后来信奉尼扎尔伊斯玛仪派，君主称图姆（后称米尔），并把世系追溯到传说中的波斯王子阿扎尔·贾姆希德。相传沙阿汗（阿亚朔一世）在更早的吉尔基斯王朝之后于874年创立该家族，并与瓦罕和巴达赫尚的统治者保持联姻。在阿亚朔家族治下，罕萨作为山地小邦独立了九百多年，王庭设在河谷都城上方的巴尔蒂特。16世纪，阿亚朔二世迎娶斯卡都的公主沙阿·哈通，女方之父派来工匠，将巴尔蒂特堡重建成带有藏式风格的样貌。

en: The Aydinids were a Turkoman dynasty whose beylik on the Aegean coast of Anatolia grew out of the collapse of Seljuk power and began as a vassal of the Germiyanids. Aydin's son Mehmed Bey seized Ephesus in 1304 and made himself independent emir around 1308, ruling from Ayasuluk, while the long siege of Smyrna ended in 1329 under his son Umur, who turned the city into a base for fleets that raided the Aegean islands, Negroponte and the Greek mainland. Umur became a famous sea ghazi and an ally of the Byzantine emperor John VI Kantakouzenos in the civil war of 1341 to 1347, lending him ships and soldiers. His piracy provoked the Smyrniote crusades: a Latin coalition took Smyrna in 1348 and Umur was killed in the fighting. The beylik survived under his brother Khidr and then Isa, but lost Smyrna to the crusaders and was absorbed by the Ottomans in 1390. Timur's victory at Ankara in 1402 briefly restored the dynasty, yet the last bey, Junayd, was defeated and put to death by Sultan Murad II in 1426, after which the Aydinid lands remained Ottoman.
zh: 艾登王朝是安纳托利亚爱琴海沿岸的土库曼贝伊国，兴起于塞尔柱权力瓦解之际，最初臣属于盖尔米扬王朝。艾登之子穆罕默德贝伊于1304年攻占以弗所，约1308年自立为埃米尔，以阿亚苏鲁克为都；他的儿子乌穆尔于1329年结束对士麦那的长期围攻，并把该城建成海军基地，舰队四处劫掠爱琴海岛屿、内格罗蓬特和希腊本土。乌穆尔由此成为著名的海上加齐，并在1341至1347年的拜占庭内战中结盟皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯，为其提供船只和士兵。他的海盗行径招致士麦那十字军：拉丁联军于1348年攻克士麦那，乌穆尔战死。贝伊国在其弟希德尔和后来的伊萨手中延续，但士麦那长期被十字军占据，1390年艾登被奥斯曼帝国吞并。1402年帖木儿在安卡拉获胜后王朝一度复国，但末代贝伊朱奈德于1426年被苏丹穆拉德二世击败并处死，艾登之地从此并入奥斯曼版图。

en: The Ayyubids were a Sunni dynasty of Kurdish origin founded by Saladin, who abolished the Fatimid Caliphate in 1171 and built a sultanate stretching from Egypt across Syria to Upper Mesopotamia, overwhelming the Crusader states after his victory at Hattin in 1187. After Saladin's death in 1193 the realm fragmented among his kin, and the Egyptian sultanate was seized by the Mamluks in 1250, with the last Syrian principalities falling to the Mongols in 1260. One branch outlived all the others: in 1232 Saladin's family had received Hasankeyf on the Tigris, whose meliks ruled an emirate they called the last remnant of the Ayyubid state. They weathered the Mongol storm as Ilkhanid vassals and in the early fourteenth century saw their city prosper again, with madrasas, caravanserais and a great bridge over the Tigris. In 1337 the reigning melik was al-Adil Shahab ad-Din, who ruled from 1328 to 1349. Later the emirate submitted to Timur, was occupied by the Aq Qoyunlu under Uzun Hasan and briefly by the Safavids, and was finally dissolved by the Ottomans in 1524, nearly three centuries after the fall of Ayyubid Egypt.
zh: 阿尤布王朝是库尔德出身的逊尼派王朝，由萨拉丁创立：他于1171年废除法蒂玛哈里发国，建立起一个从埃及经叙利亚延伸到上美索不达米亚的苏丹国，并在1187年哈丁战役获胜后横扫十字军国家。萨拉丁1193年去世后，王国被宗亲瓜分，埃及苏丹国于1250年被马穆鲁克夺取，叙利亚的残余领地也在1260年亡于蒙古人。但有一支后裔存续最久：1232年萨拉丁家族受封底格里斯河畔的哈桑凯伊夫，那里的梅利克（王）们统治着一个自视为阿尤布国家最后孑遗的埃米尔国。他们作为伊儿汗国藩属度过蒙古征服的风暴，14世纪初城市再度繁荣，兴建了众多经学院、商队驿站和横跨底格里斯河的大桥。1337年在位的是1328至1349年执政的阿迪勒·谢哈卜丁。此后埃米尔国先后臣服帖木儿、被乌尊·哈桑的白羊王朝占领、又一度落入萨法维王朝之手，最终于1524年被奥斯曼帝国解散，距阿尤布埃及灭亡已近三百年。

en: The Bachwezi, or Chwezi, are remembered in the oral traditions of the Great Lakes peoples as the second and greatest dynasty of the legendary Empire of Kitara, in the grasslands west of Lake Victoria in present-day Uganda. Tradition traces the line to the hunter Isimbwa and the founder Karubumbi, with capitals first at Mubende and then at Bigo bya Mugenyi, whose ten kilometers of ditches and banks on the Katonga River have been dated by archaeologists to roughly 1300 to 1500. The Bachwezi were said to be master blacksmiths and cattle lords; their best-remembered kings are Ndahura, who vanished on a southern campaign, and Wamara, the last of the line. Under Wamara the dynasty lost the loyalty of its people and, according to the legends, abandoned Kitara, making way for the Luo-speaking Babiito clan who founded Bunyoro. Historians treat the Bachwezi as a local Bantu aristocracy rather than foreign conquerors, and the Rutara peoples still venerate them as ancestor spirits, while Bunyoro, Buganda and the neighboring kingdoms long claimed their legacy to legitimize their own rule.
zh: 巴契韦齐又译契韦齐，在大湖地区诸族的口传传统中被铭记为传说中的基塔拉帝国第二朝、也是最显赫的王朝，地在今乌干达维多利亚湖以西的草原地带。传说其世系可上溯到猎人伊辛布瓦和开创者卡鲁邦比，都城先在穆本德，后迁比戈比亚穆根尼；后者位于卡通加河畔，绵延十公里的壕沟与土墙经考古测定约建于1300至1500年间。相传巴契韦齐人精于冶铁、役使牛群，最著名的国王是在南征中神秘失踪的恩达乌拉，以及末代君王瓦马拉。瓦马拉在位时丧失人心，传说中巴契韦齐最终弃基塔拉而去，取而代之的是讲卢奥语的巴比托氏族，后者建立了布尼奥罗。史学界认为巴契韦齐是本地班图贵族，而非外来征服者；鲁塔拉诸族将其当作祖灵敬奉，布尼奥罗、布干达等周边王国也长期自称继承其遗产，以此论证自身统治的合法性。

en: The margraves of Baden were the surviving Swabian line of the House of Zähringen. When the Zähringer Berthold failed to hold the duchy of Swabia, he was compensated with Carinthia and the march of Verona, and his grandson Herman II, enfeoffed with immediate territory around 1098, built Hohenbaden castle above the thermal springs of Baden and took the title margrave of Baden in 1112. Loyal servants of the Hohenstaufen in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, the margraves spread their lands from the Breisgau north to the Murg and across the Rhine into Alsace; Herman V founded the towns of Stuttgart, Durlach, Ettlingen and Pforzheim and moved his residence to Pforzheim in 1219, while his son Herman VI and grandson Frederick I pressed an unsuccessful claim to the duchies of Austria and Styria. Repeated partitions created the Baden-Baden, Baden-Hochberg and Baden-Sausenberg lines until Bernard I reunited the inheritance in 1391 and the acquisition of Lahr and Mahlberg in 1442 linked its northern and southern halves. The Reformation split the house into Catholic Baden-Baden and Protestant Baden-Durlach, formally divided in 1535, and the Thirty Years' War and the wars of Louis XIV ravaged both; Louis William, the Turkish Louis, won fame commanding imperial armies against the Ottomans and France. In 1771 Charles Frederick of Baden-Durlach inherited Baden-Baden and reunited all the Baden lands, becoming prince-elector in 1803 and grand duke in 1806.
zh: 巴登藩侯家族是策林根家族留在施瓦本的支系。策林根的贝托尔德未能保住施瓦本公爵之位，改获克恩滕和维罗纳边伯领地作为补偿；其孙赫尔曼二世约在1098年受封直辖领地，在巴登温泉上方修建霍亨巴登城堡，并于1112年采用巴登藩侯头衔。12至13世纪，历代藩侯作为霍亨斯陶芬的忠仆，把领地从布赖斯高向北扩至穆尔河，西渡莱茵河伸入阿尔萨斯；赫尔曼五世创建了斯图加特、杜拉赫、埃特林根和普福尔茨海姆等城镇，1219年又把居所迁往普福尔茨海姆；他的儿子赫尔曼六世和孙子弗里德里希一世曾主张奥地利和施蒂利亚公爵之位，但未能成功。家族一再分家，形成巴登-巴登、巴登-霍赫贝格和巴登-绍森贝格三支，直到伯恩哈德一世于1391年重新统一遗产，1442年取得拉尔和马尔贝格，把领地南北两段连成一体。宗教改革使家族分裂为信奉天主教的巴登-巴登和信奉新教的巴登-杜拉赫，1535年正式分治，三十年战争和路易十四的战争又使两支饱受蹂躏；绰号土耳其人路易的路德维希·威廉统率帝国军队对抗奥斯曼与法国，战功卓著。1771年，巴登-杜拉赫的卡尔·弗里德里希继承巴登-巴登，再度统合全部巴登领地，并于1803年成为选侯，1806年成为大公。

en: The Baduspanids were a local Iranian dynasty that ruled the mountain district of Ruyan, later called Rustamdar, in Tabaristan on the southern Caspian coast. They traced Sasanian blood through Gil Gavbara, a great-grandson of King Jamasp: in 665 his son Baduspan I was enfeoffed with Ruyan, founding a line that held the region for 933 years, the longest of any Iranian dynasty. While the lowlands passed to Arab governors after the Dabuyid fall in 760, the Baduspanids kept their highland autonomy as tributary princes, and their title of ustandar eventually gave Rustamdar its name. They weathered a Bavandid occupation between 1190 and 1209 and, in the fourteenth century, ruled from Kojur under Jalal al-Dawla Iskandar, who was on the throne in 1337. The Mar'ashis overran Rustamdar in 1381 and held it until Timur's conquest of Mazandaran in 1393; Kayumarth I, reduced to the castle of Nur in 1399, restored the realm in 1405. On his death in 1453 the kingdom split into the Kojur and Nur branches, which ruled separately until the Safavid shah Abbas the Great deposed both during the 1590s, extinguishing the dynasty in 1598.
zh: 巴杜斯潘王朝是塔巴里斯坦的地方伊朗人王朝，统治里海南岸的鲁彦山区，即后来的鲁斯塔姆达尔。他们通过萨珊国王贾马斯普的曾孙吉尔·伽夫巴拉追溯萨珊血统：665年，吉尔·伽夫巴拉之子巴杜斯潘一世受封鲁彦，开创的家族统治此地长达933年，是伊朗延续最久的王朝。760年达布依王朝灭亡后，低地落入阿拉伯总督之手，巴杜斯潘家族却以纳贡王公的身份保住了山区自治，他们“乌斯坦达尔”的称号后来还演变成鲁斯塔姆达尔这个地名。他们挺过了1190至1209年巴万德王朝的占领，14世纪时以科朱尔为都，1337年在位的是贾拉勒·道莱·伊斯坎达尔。1381年马拉什人攻占鲁斯塔姆达尔并统治到1393年帖木儿征服马赞达兰；卡尤马尔斯一世一度在1399年被削地至努尔城堡，1405年恢复故国。他1453年死后，王国分裂为科朱尔和努尔两支，各自为政，直到16世纪90年代萨法维沙阿拔斯大帝将两支先后废黜，王朝于1598年灭亡。

en: The Baghelas are a Rajput clan of Solanki, or Chalukya, stock, whose name survives in Baghelkhand, the country east of Bundelkhand. They trace their line to Vyaghra Dev, a kinsman of the Vaghela rulers of Gujarat, who moved into northern India around the middle of the thirteenth century and took the fort of Marpha near Kalinjar; his son Karan Deo married a Kalachuri princess of Mandla and received the fort of Bandhogarh as her dowry, which became their capital. A later chief, Sohag Deo, founded the town of Sohagpur, and the clan enlarged its holdings for two centuries without drawing the notice of the Delhi sultans. In 1498 and 1499 Sikandar Lodi failed to storm Bandhogarh. Veer Singh Deo, ruling from 1500 to 1540, rode with Rana Sanga against Babur at Khanwa in 1527, and the mid-sixteenth-century court of Ramchandra Singh kept the poet and musician Tansen and the wit Birbal before they joined Akbar. After an eight-month siege Akbar's forces took and dismantled Bandhogarh in 1597, and in 1618 Vikramaditya Deo founded Rewa and moved the capital there. Sacked by Panna in 1731 and hard pressed by the Marathas, Rewa accepted British protection by treaty in 1812.
zh: 婆稽罗是出身索兰基（即遮娄其）世系的拉杰普特氏族，本德尔肯德以东的巴格尔坎德地区便因他们得名。其世系可追溯到维亚格拉·迪奥：他是古吉拉特瓦盖拉王朝统治者的同族，约13世纪中叶北上，夺取卡林贾尔附近的马尔法要塞；其子卡兰·迪奥娶曼德拉的卡拉丘里公主为妻，得到班达迦要塞作为嫁妆，班达迦从此成为都城。后来的首领索哈格·迪奥建立索哈格布尔城，此后两百年间氏族不断扩张领地，没有引起德里苏丹的注意。1498至1499年，西坎达尔·洛迪围攻班达迦不克。1500至1540年在位的维尔·辛格·迪奥曾于1527年随拉纳·桑伽在汗瓦迎战巴布尔；16世纪中期罗摩旃陀罗·辛格的宫廷聚集了乐师坦森和智者比尔巴尔，二人后来投奔阿克巴。1597年，阿克巴的军队经过八个月围攻攻占并拆毁班达迦；1618年维克拉马迪亚·迪奥建立雷瓦城并迁都于此。1731年雷瓦遭潘纳洗劫，又受马拉塔人重压，最终于1812年订约接受英国保护。

en:
The Bagrationi were the royal dynasty of Georgia from the early Middle Ages until the Russian conquest, and one of the oldest Christian ruling houses in Europe. Most scholars derive them from the Armenian Bagratuni family. The Georgian branch gained the Principality of Iberia in the late eighth century: Ashot I became its presiding prince in 813, Adarnase restored the Georgian kingship in 888, and Bagrat III united the Georgian lands into one kingdom early in the eleventh century. Under David IV the Builder, who retook Tbilisi from the Muslims in 1122, and Queen Tamar the Great (1184–1213), Georgia became the leading power of the Christian East, its empire reaching from the North Caucasus into northern Iran.

The Khwarezmian raid of 1225 and the Mongol invasion of 1236 ended that golden age, though George V the Brilliant, reigning in 1337, briefly restored the kingdom's strength. Timur's eight campaigns between 1386 and 1403 and the pressure of the Kara Koyunlu and Ak Koyunlu shattered its unity, and by 1491 the Bagrationi ruled three rival kingdoms, Kartli, Kakheti and Imereti, under Ottoman and Safavid suzerainty, with several kings converting to Islam. Erekle II reunited Kartli and Kakheti in 1762 and placed himself under Russian protection by the Treaty of Georgievsk of 1783, but Russia stood aside when the Qajar shah Agha Mohammad Khan sacked Tbilisi in 1795. Tsar Alexander I deposed the dynasty and annexed Kartli-Kakheti in 1801, and Imereti followed in 1810, when Solomon II was driven into exile.
zh:
巴格拉季奥尼王朝是中世纪早期至俄国征服期间统治格鲁吉亚的王室，也是欧洲最古老的基督教统治家族之一，多数学者认为它出自亚美尼亚的巴格拉提德家族。格鲁吉亚支系于8世纪末取得伊比利亚公国：阿绍特一世在813年成为其首席王公，阿达尔纳塞于888年恢复格鲁吉亚王权，巴格拉特三世则在11世纪初将格鲁吉亚诸地统一为一个王国。在1122年从穆斯林手中收复第比利斯的建国者大卫四世，以及塔马尔女王（1184—1213年在位）治下，格鲁吉亚成为基督教东方的头等强国，疆域从北高加索一直延伸到伊朗北部。

1225年花剌子模人的袭击和1236年蒙古人的入侵终结了这个黄金时代，不过1337年在位的吉奥尔基五世（勇敢者）曾短暂重振国力。帖木儿在1386至1403年间的八次远征，加上黑羊王朝与白羊王朝的挤压，摧毁了国家的统一；到1491年，巴格拉季奥尼家族只能在奥斯曼与萨法维波斯的宗主权下分治卡特利、卡赫蒂和伊梅雷蒂三个敌对王国，不少君主还改宗伊斯兰教。伊拉克略二世于1762年重新统一卡特利和卡赫蒂，并通过1783年的《格奥尔吉耶夫斯克条约》接受俄国保护；但1795年卡扎尔王朝的阿迦·穆罕默德汗洗劫第比利斯时，俄国并未出手。1801年沙皇亚历山大一世废黜该王朝、吞并卡特利—卡赫蒂，1810年伊梅雷蒂也遭吞并，所罗门二世被迫流亡。

en: The Bahriyya, or Bahri Mamluks, were the first Mamluk dynasty to rule Egypt and Syria from Cairo, holding power from 1250 to 1382. They were mostly Kipchak Turks bought as slave soldiers and manumitted; their name, meaning ‘of the river’, came from their barracks on Roda Island in the Nile, built by the Ayyubid sultan as-Salih Ayyub. In 1250 they murdered his heir Turanshah and seized the sultanate, and in 1260 Qutuz and Baybars shattered the Mongols at Ain Jalut, saving Egypt from the Ilkhanate. Bayars, who took the throne after Qutuz's assassination, installed a puppet Abbasid caliph in Cairo in 1261 and took Antioch in 1268; Sultan Qalawun recaptured Tripoli in 1289 and his son Khalil took Acre, the last Crusader city, in 1291. The Qalawunid line dominated the next century, above all al-Nasir Muhammad, sultan at the 1337 start, whose long reign ended in 1341. The Black Death of 1349 and rapid succession crises weakened the regime, and in 1382 the Circassian emir Barquq deposed the last Bahri sultan, Hajji II, establishing the Burji Mamluk order after his return to power in 1390.
zh: 伯海里王朝又称伯海里马穆鲁克，是第一个以开罗为都、统治埃及和叙利亚的马穆鲁克王朝，掌权时间为1250至1382年。其成员多为钦察突厥人，以奴隶兵身份被购入后获释；“伯海里”意为“河上的”，得名于他们驻扎的尼罗河罗达岛军营，该营由阿尤布苏丹萨利赫·阿尤布所建。1250年他们刺杀萨利赫的继承人突兰沙，夺取苏丹之位；1260年古突兹与拜巴尔在阿音札鲁特之战击溃蒙古军，使埃及免于伊利汗国的征服。拜巴尔在古突兹遇刺后继位，1261年在开罗扶立阿拔斯傀儡哈里发，1268年夺取安条克；苏丹嘉拉温1289年收复的黎波里，其子哈利勒1291年攻克十字军最后一座城市阿卡。嘉拉温一支在此后一个世纪占据主导，其中最显赫的是1337年开局时在位的纳西尔·穆罕默德，他的长期统治于1341年结束。1349年的黑死病和接连不断的继承危机削弱了政权，1382年切尔克斯埃米尔巴尔库克废黜末代伯海里苏丹哈吉二世，并在1390年重新掌权后确立布尔吉马穆鲁克的统治。

en: The rulers known in Balinese tradition as the dynasty of Bali were the native Hindu-Buddhist kings of the island, whose line is traced to Sri Kesari Warmadewa and the Belanjong pillar of 914. By the early fourteenth century their court stood at Bedulu, where Sri Astasura Ratna Bumi Banten, the last independent Balinese king, reigned from about 1332 until the Majapahit invasion of 1342 to 1343: troops under Gajah Mada and Arya Damar took Bedulu after seven months of fighting and ended native rule. Majapahit then installed its own vassal dynasty, the Kepakisan, whose first king Sri Aji Kresna Kepakisan was crowned at Samprangan in 1352. In the late fourteenth or fifteenth century the court moved east to Gelgel, which under Dalem Baturenggong in the sixteenth century drew Lombok, western Sumbawa and Blambangan into its orbit. After 1651 Gelgel fragmented, and a new seat at Klungkung founded in 1686 presided over the nine rival Balinese kingdoms that survived into later centuries.
zh: 巴厘王朝是巴厘本土印度教—佛教诸王的统称，其世系可追溯到914年立贝兰琼石柱的斯里·克萨里·瓦尔马德瓦。14世纪初，王廷设在贝杜卢，末代独立国王斯里·阿斯塔苏拉·拉特那·布米·班滕约于1332年即位；1342—1343年满者伯夷大将加查·马达与阿里亚·达玛尔率军来攻，历经七个月战事攻陷贝杜卢，本土王统告终。满者伯夷随后扶植附庸的克帕基桑王朝，初代国王斯里·阿吉·克雷斯纳·克帕基桑于1352年在桑普拉岸登基。14世纪末至15世纪，王廷东迁至格尔格尔，16世纪达伦·巴图伦贡在位时国力鼎盛，龙目、西松巴哇和爪哇东端的布兰邦甘皆入其势力范围。1651年后格尔格尔走向分裂，1686年新建的克隆孔王廷统辖着九个相互争战的巴厘小王国，其格局一直延续到近代。

en: The Balliols, originally de Bailleul, came from the village of Bailleul in Picardy and were granted English estates under William Rufus. They held Barnard Castle in Durham, and John, fifth Baron Balliol, founded Balliol College in Oxford. His marriage to Dervorguilla of Galloway, a descendant of David, Earl of Huntingdon, gave the family its claim to the Scottish crown. When the Dunkeld line failed with the death of Margaret, Maid of Norway, their son John Balliol was chosen King of Scots in 1292 under the arbitration of Edward I of England. His defiance in signing the Auld Alliance with France brought an English invasion; he abdicated in 1296, was held in the Tower of London and died in French exile in 1314, mocked as Toom Tabard, the empty coat. His son Edward Balliol took up the claim with the disinherited lords, winning at Dupplin Moor and being crowned at Scone in 1332. Backed by Edward III, he won Halidon Hill in 1333 and ceded Lothian by the Treaty of Newcastle, but defeat at Culblean in 1335 broke his cause. A last rising in Galloway after Neville's Cross in 1346 came to nothing, and in 1356 he surrendered his claim for an English pension. He died childless in 1364 and the direct line became extinct.
zh: 巴利奥尔家族原名德·巴约勒，出自皮卡第的巴约勒村，在威廉·鲁弗斯时代获赐英格兰领地，世代领有达勒姆的巴纳德城堡；第五代巴利奥尔男爵约翰还创办了牛津大学巴利奥尔学院。他娶加洛韦的德沃尔吉拉为妻，后者是亨廷登伯爵大卫的后裔，家族由此取得苏格兰王位的继承权。邓凯尔德王朝随挪威少女玛格丽特之死而断绝后，他们的儿子约翰·巴利奥尔于1292年在英格兰国王爱德华一世的仲裁下被立为苏格兰国王。他转而与法国缔结老同盟，招致英军入侵，1296年被迫退位，囚禁于伦敦塔，后流亡法国，1314年去世，被讥讽为“空外套”图姆·塔巴德。其子爱德华·巴利奥尔联合被剥夺领地的贵族重提王位主张，1332年在达普林沼泽获胜并于斯昆加冕。他在爱德华三世支持下于1333年赢得哈利顿山之战，又依《纽卡斯尔条约》割让洛锡安，但1335年卡尔布林之败使其事业瓦解。1346年内维尔十字战役后他在加洛韦作最后一次起事，仍归失败，1356年以换取英格兰年金为条件放弃王位主张。他于1364年无嗣而终，直系就此绝嗣。

en: Bantaeng was a small kingdom on the south coast of the southern peninsula of Sulawesi. In 1254 seven local rulers, each bearing the title Kare, merged their domains into one kingdom under Mula Tau, titled To Toa; after the palace moved from Onto to Karatuang its rulers took the title Karaeng. Under the name Bantayan it appears in the Javanese court poem Negarakertagama of 1364 among the lands claimed by Majapahit. Its rice fields and harbor made it a trading port where local rice was exchanged for Chinese ceramics, and it kept marriage ties with the Bugis kingdom of Bone. It later joined the empire of Gowa peacefully, adopted Islam after Gowa did, and in 1666 a Dutch fleet under Cornelis Speelman burned the boats gathered in its harbor during the Makassar War.
zh: 班塔恩是苏拉威西南半岛南岸的一个小王国。1254年，七位各称“卡雷”的地方统治者把领地合并为一个王国，尊称号为“多多阿”的穆拉·陶为首领；王宫从翁托迁至卡拉图昂后，君主改称为“卡朗”。1364年的爪哇宫廷史诗《爪哇史颂》以“班塔延”之名把它列入满者伯夷声称拥有的土地。当地稻田与海港使它成为贸易口岸，以稻米交换中国瓷器，并与布吉斯人的波尼王国保持联姻。它后来和平并入戈瓦的势力范围，在戈瓦之后皈依伊斯兰教；1666年望加锡战争期间，科尔内利斯·斯皮尔曼率领的荷兰舰队烧毁了聚集在其港口的船只。

en: The Baranzi stand for the lineage of Bukuku and his daughter Nyinamwiru in the oral traditions of Kitara, the legendary Chwezi state of the Great Lakes region. Bukuku, born a commoner of the Iru order, was deputy to Isaza, last king of the earlier Tembuzi dynasty, and proclaimed himself ruler after Isaza was carried off into the underworld. The county chiefs refused to follow a common-born king and rebelled, and Bukuku was eventually killed in a quarrel over cattle by his grandson Karubumbi, also called Ndahura, who then founded the Chwezi dynasty. Nyinamwiru, Bukuku's daughter, is remembered as the mother of Ndahura, the first Chwezi king, and Baranzi is also the name of one of the oldest clans of Bunyoro and Buluuli. The game places the family at Bigo bya Mugenyi on the Katonga River, whose ditch-and-bank earthworks have been dated to roughly 1300 to 1500 and are linked in local tradition with the age of the Chwezi.
zh: 巴兰齐代表的是大湖地区传说中的基塔拉（奇韦齐国家）口述传统里布库库与其女尼纳姆维鲁一系。布库库出身伊鲁阶层平民，本是滕布齐王朝末代国王伊萨扎的副手，伊萨扎被带入冥界后自立为王，但各地酋长不肯臣服于平民出身的君主，纷纷反叛；布库库最终在一场争牛纠纷中被外孙卡鲁班比（又名恩达胡拉）所杀，后者随后开创奇韦齐王朝。布库库之女尼纳姆维鲁被认为是奇韦齐初代国王恩达胡拉的生母，而巴兰齐本身也是布尼奥罗和布鲁利最古老的氏族之一。游戏将这一家族放在卡通加河畔的比戈比亚穆根尼，当地的壕沟土垒遗址测定约建于1300年至1500年间，在本地传统中与奇韦齐时代联系在一起。

en: The House of Barcelona was descended from Wilfred the Hairy, count of Barcelona from 878, whose Bellonid heirs built the County of Barcelona into the leading power of the Catalan counties and for a time held Provence as well. The decisive step came in 1137, when Count Ramon Berenguer IV married Petronilla, heiress of the Kingdom of Aragon: their son Alfonso II was the first king of the united Crown of Aragon from 1162. Under James the Conqueror the house took Mallorca in 1229 and Valencia in 1238, and a cadet kingdom of Mallorca survived until Peter IV reunited it in the 1340s. The Sicilian Vespers of 1282 carried Peter III to the throne of Sicily, where a younger branch ruled until 1409, while the family's Occitan claims in Provence had already passed to the Angevins in 1246. In 1337 Peter IV the Ceremonious ruled the Crown of Aragon, a Mediterranean power whose fleets and the Catalan Company also brought the Duchy of Athens under its cadets. The main line ended with Martin the Humanist in 1410; after an interregnum the Compromise of Caspe of 1412 gave the crown to Ferdinand of Antequera of the Castilian House of Trastámara, though the old Urgell branch of the family contested the settlement.
zh: 巴塞罗那家族是878年就任巴塞罗那伯爵的“多毛者”威尔弗雷德的后裔，其贝略尼德继承人把巴塞罗那伯国经营成加泰罗尼亚诸伯国中的首强，还曾一度领有普罗旺斯。决定性的一步发生在1137年：伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世娶阿拉贡王国王位女继承人佩特罗尼拉，他们的儿子阿方索二世于1162年成为统一的阿拉贡联合王国的第一位国王。在“征服者”海梅一世治下，家族于1229年夺取马略卡、1238年夺取巴伦西亚，分封出的马略卡王国延续到14世纪40年代才由佩德罗四世重新合并。1282年的西西里晚祷使佩德罗三世登上西西里王位，幼支在当地统治到1409年，而家族在奥克西塔尼亚的普罗旺斯领地已于1246年落入安茹家族之手。1337年在位的是“礼仪者”佩德罗四世，阿拉贡已是地中海强国，其舰队和加泰罗尼亚佣兵团还让雅典公国归其支系统治。1410年“人文主义者”马丁去世，主支断绝；经过一段空位期，1412年的卡斯佩妥协把王位交给卡斯蒂利亚特拉斯塔马拉家族的安特克拉的费尔南多，家族旧支乌尔赫尔伯爵则起兵反对这一安排。

en: The Bardi were a noble and banking family of Florence, whose noble rank was documented as early as 1164, when Emperor Frederick Barbarossa enfeoffed Count Alberto with the county of Vernio near the Mugello. From 1215 they took the Guelph side in Florence's faction wars: Gualterotto de' Bardi joined the Fifth Crusade and became bishop of Acre, and Bardi kinsmen fought at Montaperti in 1260 and Campaldino in 1289, the latter alongside Dante. Their true power rested on the Compagnia dei Bardi, whose bills of exchange made them one of Europe's chief bankers by the 1320s, with branches from London and Bruges to Paris, Avignon, Constantinople and Jerusalem. In 1338 the house was at its height, but it had lent Edward III of England some 900,000 gold florins for the Hundred Years' War, and his default in 1345, together with that of the Peruzzi, brought the bank down. The family survived as merchants and patrons of the Franciscans, whose Bardi Chapel in Santa Croce was frescoed by Giotto. Around 1415 Contessina de' Bardi married Cosimo de' Medici, and when Cosimo took power in 1434 he restored the Bardi to Florentine public life.
zh: 巴尔迪家族是佛罗伦萨的贵族兼银行世家，其贵族身份最早可考于1164年——皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨将穆杰洛附近的韦尔尼奥伯国封给阿尔贝托伯爵。1215年起，他们在佛罗伦萨党争中站在圭尔夫派一边：瓜尔泰罗托·德·巴尔迪参加第五次十字军东征，后来成为阿卡主教；族中子弟先后参加1260年的蒙塔佩尔蒂之战和1289年的坎帕尔迪诺之战，后者还是与但丁并肩作战。家族真正的权势来自巴尔迪银行公司，凭借汇票业务，到14世纪20年代它已成为欧洲首屈一指的银行之一，分号从伦敦、布鲁日一直开到巴黎、阿维尼翁、君士坦丁堡和耶路撒冷。1338年前后家族正值鼎盛，却为百年战争借给英格兰国王爱德华三世约九十万金弗罗林；1345年爱德华三世违约赖账，佩鲁齐银行同时倒闭，巴尔迪银行也随之破产。此后家族转为商人和方济各会的赞助人，圣十字教堂中的巴尔迪礼拜堂即由乔托绘制壁画。1415年前后，孔泰西娜·德·巴尔迪嫁给科西莫·德·美第奇；1434年科西莫掌权后，恢复了巴尔迪家族在佛罗伦萨的公共地位。

en: Barru, called Berru in the Bugis language, was a small kingdom on the west coast of South Sulawesi, in the area that now forms Barru Regency. Its line begins with La Sarewo, who according to its royal chronicle cleared the sago-palm forest of La Rumpia for rice fields and was installed as first king on the stone of Batu Allantireng; the kingdom took its name from the aju berru tree beside that stone. His successor Petta Cakkeawo ruled from 1336, and under the fourth king, Matinro ri Daun Lesang, the realm was split into an inland half, Berru Riaja, and a coastal half, Berru Rilau. Islam reached Barru through its neighbor Tanete: the twelfth king, Mattinro ri Dua Jenna, became its first Muslim ruler after 1606, and the teaching center at Pancana drew scholars and helped spread the faith to the smaller kingdoms nearby.
zh: 巴鲁在布吉斯语中称“贝鲁”，是南苏拉威西海岸的一个小王国，疆域大致在今巴鲁县一带。据王室编年史记载，王统始于拉·萨雷沃：他开垦拉·伦皮亚的西谷椰林为稻田，并在阿兰蒂伦石上被拥立为首任国王，国名取自石旁的贝鲁树。继任者佩塔·查克阿沃于1336年即位；第四代国王马廷罗·里·道恩·莱桑在位时，王国被分为内陆的贝鲁·里亚贾和沿海的贝鲁·里劳两部分。伊斯兰教经邻国塔内特传入：1606年后，第十二代国王马廷罗·里·杜阿·珍纳成为首位穆斯林君主，潘查纳的教学中心吸引学者前来，并推动该信仰传播到周围的小邦。

en: The House of Basarab was the ruling dynasty that founded the Principality of Wallachia north of the Danube, taking its name from its first prince, Basarab I. Of disputed Vlach or Cuman origin and son of a local lord called Thocomerius, Basarab is first documented in 1324 as a voivode holding Wallachia as a vassal of Charles I of Hungary. He broke with the Hungarian crown in 1325, seized the Banate of Severin and, after fighting alongside Bulgaria at Velbazhd in July 1330, faced a Hungarian invasion: in the Battle of Posada of 9–12 November 1330 his archers ambushed the royal army in a Carpathian pass and nearly destroyed it, securing Wallachia's independence. Basarab ruled from Câmpulung and Curtea de Argeș until 1351–1352, married his daughter Theodora to the future Bulgarian tsar Ivan Alexander, and was followed by his son Nicholas Alexander and his grandson Vladislav I. The throne was elective among the family's male members, and after the death of Alexandru I Aldea in 1436 the dynasty split into the rival Dănești and Drăculești branches, the latter producing Vlad II Dracul and Vlad III the Impaler. Basarab's descendants ruled Wallachia for at least two centuries after Posada, and the region of Bessarabia preserves the dynasty's name.
zh: 巴萨拉布王朝是在多瑙河北岸建立瓦拉几亚亲王国的统治家族，得名于首任亲王巴萨拉布一世。巴萨拉布的族源在瓦拉几亚人与库曼人之间存在争议，父亲是名叫托科梅里乌斯的地方首领；1324年的一份特许状首次提到他，当时他作为匈牙利国王查理一世的封臣，以沃伊沃德身份统治瓦拉几亚。1325年他叛离匈牙利王室，夺取塞维林巴纳特；1330年7月随保加利亚参加维尔巴日德战役之后，匈牙利大军于同年入侵，11月9日至12日的波萨达战役中，他的弓箭手在喀尔巴阡山隘口伏击王室军队，几乎将其全歼，瓦拉几亚由此赢得独立。巴萨拉布以肯普隆格和阿尔杰什河畔库尔泰亚为都，统治到1351—1352年；他把女儿狄奥多拉嫁给后来的保加利亚沙皇伊凡·亚历山大，死后由儿子尼古拉·亚历山大、孙子弗拉迪斯拉夫一世相继继位。家族男嗣均可经波雅尔会议选举登位；1436年亚历山德鲁一世·阿尔代亚死后，王朝分裂为对立的达内什特与德勒库莱什特两支，后者出了弗拉德二世·德拉库尔和穿刺公弗拉德三世。巴萨拉布的后裔在波萨达之战后又统治瓦拉几亚至少两个世纪，比萨拉比亚地区的名称便来自这个王朝。

en: The House of des Baux was one of the richest and most powerful feudal lineages of medieval Provence, named after the cliff fortress of Les Baux in the Alpilles above Arles, where Pons the Younger built the first castle in the tenth century; bau means cliff in the local Occitan tongue. Its lords claimed descent from Balthazar, one of the three Biblical Magi, and bore a silver sixteen-pointed star with the motto “Au hasard, Balthazar”. In the twelfth century they fought the Baussenque Wars against the counts of Barcelona, claiming Provence through a female heir, but were defeated. The house then split into three branches: the elder line kept Les Baux and took lands in southern Italy; the Berre branch settled in the Angevin kingdom of Naples, where the Italianized del Balzo held the principality of Taranto and the duchy of Andria and the title of titular emperor of Constantinople; the youngest branch inherited Orange, raised to a principality in 1163. In 1337 all three branches flourished around Provence, Orange and Naples. Marie des Baux, last of the Orange line, carried that principality to the House of Chalon-Arlay by marriage in 1386 and died in 1417. The elder line ended with Alix des Baux in 1427, when the barony was annexed to the county of Provence, and the Italian branch died out with Antoinette des Baux in 1538.
zh: 德斯·博家族是中世纪普罗旺斯最富有、最有权势的封建世系之一，得名于阿尔勒附近阿尔皮耶山脉悬崖上的莱博；10世纪时，小庞斯在那里修建了第一座城堡，而“博”在当地方言奥克语中就是悬崖的意思。家族领主自称是圣经三王之一巴尔塔扎尔的后裔，纹章为一枚银色十六角星，铭言是“随命吧，巴尔塔扎尔”。12世纪，他们通过女性继承人主张普罗旺斯继承权，与巴塞罗那伯爵们打了几场“博桑克战争”，最终落败。此后家族分成三支：长支保有莱博，并在意大利南部取得领地；贝尔支定居于安茹家族统治的那不勒斯王国，意大利化的德尔巴尔佐家族在那里领有塔兰托亲王国和安德里亚公国，还拥有君士坦丁堡挂名皇帝的头衔；幼支通过联姻继承了奥兰治，该地于1163年升格为亲王国。1337年，三支都在普罗旺斯、奥兰治和那不勒斯一带兴盛。奥兰治支最后一位传人玛丽·德斯·博于1386年随婚姻把奥兰治亲王国带入沙隆-阿尔莱家族，并于1417年去世。长支随阿丽克斯·德斯·博于1427年死去而终结，博男爵领被并入普罗旺斯伯国；意大利支则随安托瓦内特·德斯·博于1538年去世而绝嗣。

en: The Bavandids were an Iranian dynasty that ruled the mountains of Tabaristan, modern Mazandaran along the southern Caspian shore, from 651 to 1349, one of the longest-lived lines in Iranian history. They claimed descent from Bav, a supposed grandson of the Sasanian prince Kawus, son of Kavad I, who was said to have fled the Arab conquest, and their kings styled themselves ispahbadh and kept Sasanian-style coronation rites described by the local historian Ibn Isfandiyar. Their rule fell into three branches: the Kayusiyya of 665–1006, overthrown by the Ziyarid Qabus; the Ispahbadhiyya of 1073–1210, who ruled from Sari as vassals of the Seljuqs and then the Khwarezmshahs and counted Shah Ghazi Rustam, the victor over the Ismailis in the twelfth century, until the murder of Rustam V in 1210; and the Kinakhwariyya, restored in 1237 after the Mongol invasions, who governed as Ilkhanid vassals. In 1337 the throne at Amol belonged to Hasan II, the last mainline king: in 1349 he was killed by Kiya Afrasiyab, head of a Bavandid cadet branch, who seized the realm and brought the dynasty's seven centuries of rule to an end.
zh: 巴万德王朝是伊朗人的王朝，651至1349年间统治里海南岸塔巴里斯坦（今马赞达兰）的山区，是伊朗历史上延续最久的统治家族之一。他们自称出自巴甫——据说他是萨珊皇帝喀瓦德一世之子卡乌斯的孙子，在阿拉伯征服时逃到此地；其君主号称“伊斯帕巴德”，保留着地方史家伊本·伊斯凡迪亚尔所记载的萨珊式加冕礼。王朝分为三支：665至1006年的卡宇斯亚支，被齐亚尔王朝的卡布斯推翻；1073至1210年的伊斯帕巴德支，以萨里为都，先后做塞尔柱人和花剌子模沙的附庸，12世纪曾出了击败伊斯玛仪派的名王沙·加齐·鲁斯塔姆，1210年末代王鲁斯塔姆五世遇刺；第三支基纳赫瓦里亚于蒙古入侵后的1237年复国，作为伊儿汗国的藩属治国。1337年坐在阿莫勒王座上的是末代嫡系君主哈桑二世：1349年他被巴万德旁支首领基亚·阿弗拉西亚布所杀，后者篡夺了国家，王朝长达七百年的统治就此终结。

en: The Beaumonts of this line were a branch of the House of Brienne, descended from John of Brienne, King of Jerusalem and Latin Emperor of Constantinople. In France they held the viscounty of Beaumont in Maine, with seats at Beaumont-sur-Sarthe, Sainte-Suzanne, Le Lude and La Fleche, and later married into the viscounts of Ventadour. The English branch began when Louis of Brienne married Agnes de Beaumont, heiress of the viscounty; their younger son Henry de Beaumont entered Edward I's service in 1297 and fought from Falkirk to Halidon Hill. Summoned as the first Baron Beaumont in 1309, he married Alice Comyn, heiress of Buchan, and became Earl of Buchan jure uxoris. As one of the Disinherited, he was the chief organizer of Edward Balliol's bid for the Scottish crown, planning the 1332 invasion that won Dupplin Moor and attending Balliol's coronation at Scone. His brother Lewis de Beaumont was Bishop of Durham from 1317 until 1333. Henry's children married into the greatest houses: Katherine wed David Strathbogie, titular Earl of Atholl, and Isabel married Henry of Grosmont, Duke of Lancaster.
