Henry died on Edward III's Flemish campaign in 1340; his son John never pressed the lost Buchan claim, while the French line kept the Beaumont viscounty in Maine.
zh: 这一支博蒙家族出自布列讷家族，始祖可溯至耶路撒冷国王、君士坦丁堡拉丁皇帝布列讷的约翰。在法国，他们世袭曼恩的博蒙子爵领，驻地包括博蒙叙萨尔特、圣苏珊、勒吕德和拉弗莱什，后来还与旺塔杜尔子爵家族联姻。英格兰支系始于布列讷的路易娶博蒙子爵领女继承人阿涅丝·德·博蒙；他们的幼子亨利·德博蒙特于1297年投入爱德华一世麾下，从福尔柯克一直打到哈利顿山。1309年他成为第一代博蒙男爵，又娶巴肯女继承人艾丽斯·科明，凭妻权受封巴肯伯爵。作为“被剥夺者”贵族的一员，他是爱德华·巴利奥尔争夺苏格兰王位的主要策划者，组织了1332年赢得达普林沼泽之战的入侵，并出席巴利奥尔在斯昆的加冕礼。他的兄弟路易·德·博蒙于1317年至1333年任达勒姆主教。亨利的子女都嫁入名门：凯瑟琳嫁给名义上的阿索尔伯爵大卫·斯特拉斯博吉，伊莎贝尔嫁给兰开斯特公爵格罗斯蒙特的亨利。1340年亨利于爱德华三世的佛兰德战事中去世，其子约翰再未坚持已失去的巴肯伯爵主张，法国支系则继续保有曼恩的博蒙子爵领。

en: The Beccaria were a noble house of Pavia, documented among the city's consular aristocracy as early as the twelfth century and leaders of its Ghibelline faction. Murro Beccaria, captain of the people, died in 1259; his grandson Manfredo became the family's first effective lord of Pavia, until the rival Guelph Langosco drove him out around 1300, a reverse undone when Matteo Visconti restored him in 1315. The jurist Beccario Beccaria served as podesta of cities from Monza to Milan between 1322 and 1341. Musso Beccaria recovered the signoria and died in 1341; his son Castellino, styled a prince of the city, kept a veiled lordship that left Pavia's communal institutions formally intact and sealed marriage ties with the Gonzaga and the marquises of Monferrato. In 1357 the family was expelled in a rising led by the friar Iacopo Bussolari, and after the Visconti siege of 1359 they returned as clients of Galeazzo II. A bid to regain power after Gian Galeazzo Visconti's death in 1402 failed when Filippo Maria Visconti executed Lancillotto and Castellino Beccaria in 1415 and 1418. The house then lived by its fiefs, law professorships and condottieri service; its most famous later son was the Enlightenment jurist Cesare Beccaria.
zh: 贝卡里亚是帕维亚的贵族世家，早在12世纪便名列该市的执政官贵族之中，并成为帕维亚吉伯林派的首领。家族的穆罗曾任人民领袖，1259年去世；其孙曼弗雷多成为家族中第一个实际统治帕维亚的人，约1300年被对立的圭尔夫派兰戈斯科家族赶走，1315年马泰奥·维斯孔蒂出兵又使他复位。法学家贝卡里奥·贝卡里亚在1322至1341年间历任蒙扎、米兰等多城的最高行政官。穆索·贝卡里亚重新取得领主之位，1341年去世；其子卡斯泰利诺被称为城市的“亲王”，实行一种保留公社机构外壳的隐性统治，并与贡扎加家族和蒙费拉托侯爵联姻结盟。1357年，修士亚科波·布索拉里领导起事，将家族逐出帕维亚；1359年维斯孔蒂军队围城得手后，贝卡里亚家族作为加莱亚佐二世的附庸重返城市。1402年吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂死后，家族试图夺回权力，菲利波·马里亚·维斯孔蒂遂于1415年和1418年处死兰奇洛托和卡斯泰利诺·贝卡里亚。此后家族靠封地、法学教职和雇佣军生涯立足，其最著名的后裔是启蒙时代的法学家切萨雷·贝卡里亚。

en: The Belegno, sometimes spelled Bellegno, were a Venetian patrician family counted among the old houses of the lagoon. Tradition held that they came originally from Bergamo and settled at Rialto in very early times, where they built the church of San Bartolomeo, first dedicated to Saint Demetrius; some traced their descent from the doge family of the Selvo. They were confirmed in the patriciate at the lockout of the Great Council in 1297, with a collateral branch admitted in 1311. The family's best-remembered figure was Filippo Belegno, a ducal councillor who, during the Tiepolo conspiracy of 1310, persuaded Bajamonte Tiepolo to lay down his arms at the last moment. Later Giusto Antonio Belegno commanded the Venetian armada at the Battle of Ragusa in 1617, an unsuccessful fight after which he was relieved of his command. The house died out around 1698, or perhaps in the middle of the eighteenth century with Paolo Antonio Belegno, procurator of Saint Mark.
zh: 贝莱尼奥家族（亦拼作贝莱格诺）是威尼斯的贵族世家，位列潟湖的“旧家”门第。相传他们发源于贝加莫，很早便迁居里亚尔托，并在当地修建了圣巴尔多禄茂教堂，该堂最初供奉的是圣德米特里；还有说法认为他们出身于总督塞尔沃家族。1297年大议会封闭时，家族被确认保有贵族资格，一支旁系则于1311年获准入籍。家族最留名史册的人物是公爵顾问菲利波·贝莱尼奥：1310年蒂耶波洛阴谋期间，他在最后关头说服巴亚蒙特·蒂耶波洛放下武器。后来，朱斯托·安东尼奥·贝莱尼奥于1617年统率威尼斯舰队参加拉古萨海战，战事失利后被解除指挥权。家族约于1698年绝嗣，也有说法认为延续到18世纪中叶，末代传人是圣马可检察官保罗·安东尼奥·贝莱尼奥。

en: The Belforti, sometimes called Belfredotti, were an old noble family of the Volterra region in Tuscany, perhaps named after the castle of Belforte near Radicondoli. They first rose as vassals and bankers of the bishops of Volterra, whose temporal rights had been confirmed by Emperor Frederick Barbarossa in 1164: Belforte di Buonafidanza lent the bishop large sums in 1214, and the family repeatedly took the bishop's side against the communal podesta, earning exile and restoration by papal legates. Turning Guelph, they gained the upper hand in the city's faction strife; in 1286 they helped expel the Ghibelline bishop Ranieri Ubertini, and in 1289 they fought with Florence at Campaldino. Ranieri Belforti himself became bishop in 1301 and used his nineteen-year tenure to advance his kin, above all his brother Ottaviano, who seized the signoria of Volterra in 1340. Ottaviano's sons Roberto and Bocchino succeeded him, while another son, Filippo, held the bishopric from 1348 to 1358, the height of the family's power. The end came in 1361, when Bocchino tried to sell the city to Pisa: the Volterrans rose, imprisoned him and beheaded him in the Piazza dei Priori on 10 October, after which the Belforti were banished and never recovered their old standing.
zh: 贝尔福蒂家族（又称贝尔弗雷多蒂）是托斯卡纳沃尔泰拉一带的古老贵族，其姓氏可能来自拉迪孔多利附近的贝尔福泰城堡。他们最初作为沃尔泰拉主教的封臣和债主发迹：主教的世俗权力在1164年得到皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨确认，1214年贝尔福泰·迪·博纳菲丹扎曾向主教放出大额贷款；家族还多次站在主教一边对抗公社的最高行政官，因而几度被逐，又靠教宗特使调停回城。转入圭尔夫派后，他们在城市党争中占了上风：1286年参与赶走吉伯林派主教拉涅利·乌贝尔蒂尼，1289年又随佛罗伦萨出战坎帕尔迪诺。拉涅利·贝尔福蒂本人于1301年出任主教，在十九年任期内大力提拔亲族，尤其是弟弟奥塔维亚诺——后者于1340年夺取沃尔泰拉的领主之位。奥塔维亚诺的儿子罗伯托和博基诺相继继任，另一子菲利波则在1348至1358年间担任主教，家族势力达到顶峰。1361年大难临头：博基诺企图把城市卖给比萨，沃尔泰拉民众起事将他囚禁，并于10月10日在普廖里广场斩首，贝尔福蒂家族随后被放逐，再也未能恢复昔日地位。

en: The Berlaer lords, properly Berthout van Berlaer, were a branch of the Berthout family, a wealthy noble house of Mechelen which held many lordships in the Duchy of Brabant, including Grimbergen and Berlaar near Antwerp, their original seat. In 1314 Jan II Berthout van Berlaer received the lordship of Helmond in fief from the Duke of Brabant, together with Keerbergen, and in 1325 he began the stone keep that grew into Helmond Castle, replacing the older moated house. His son Lodewijk III and grandson Walraven succeeded him as lords of Helmond and Keerbergen, while Walraven's son Jan III ruled from 1361 to 1425; the family was buried at Binderen Abbey and supplied knights and councillors to the Brabantine court. The Berlaer branch held Helmond until 1433, when the lordship passed to the Cortenbach family, while the Berlaar line near Antwerp survived until 1505.
zh: 贝拉尔领主的全称是贝尔特豪特·范·贝拉尔，是梅赫伦显贵贝尔特豪特家族的支系；该家族在布拉班特公国内领有大批领地，包括赫林贝亨和安特卫普附近的祖宅贝尔拉尔。1314年，扬二世·贝尔特豪特·范·贝拉尔从布拉班特公爵手中受封海尔蒙德领地，同时领有基尔贝亨；1325年他动工修建石砌主楼，后来发展为海尔蒙德城堡，取代了旧有的宅邸。其子路德维克三世、其孙瓦尔拉芬相继担任海尔蒙德和基尔贝亨领主，瓦尔拉芬之子扬三世的统治从1361年延续到1425年；族人葬于宾德伦修道院，并在布拉班特公爵宫廷出任骑士和顾问。贝拉尔支系统治海尔蒙德至1433年，领地随后转入科滕巴赫家族，安特卫普附近的贝尔拉尔本支则延续到1505年。

en: The Bhanjas are one of Odisha's oldest chiefly lines, emerging before the Gupta period in the Khinjali and Khijjinga mandalas of central and northern Odisha, first as feudatories of the Bhauma-Kara kings, whose throne two Bhanja princesses, Vakula Mahadevi and Dharma Mahadevi, themselves occupied in the tenth century. The Khinjali branch was centred on Dhritipura, modern Boudh, and after the Eastern Gangas displaced the Somavamshis the Bhanjas continued as their local vassals. In the fourteenth century a childless Brahmin chieftain of Baudh adopted a Bhanja nephew of the raja of Keonjhar, who ruled as Ananga Deva and founded the Baudh line; in 1498 the Daspalla appanage of a younger son broke away from Baudh. Other branches held Mayurbhanj, Keonjhar and Ghumusar, where the poet-king Upendra Bhanja made his court a centre of Odia letters. The Bhanja states became feudatories in turn of the Eastern Gangas and the Gajapati Empire before passing under British paramountcy; the Ghumusar line was annexed in 1835 after the Ghumusar rebellion of 1835–36, while Mayurbhanj and Keonjhar survived as princely states.
zh: 班吉家族是奥里萨最古老的首领世系之一，早在笈多帝国称霸之前便兴起于奥里萨中部和北部的钦贾利、基钦加等曼达罗，最初做鲍摩-卡拉诸王的附庸，10世纪还有瓦库拉·摩诃提毗和达尔摩·摩诃提毗两位班吉公主登上鲍摩-卡拉王位。钦贾利一支以陀里提普拉（今包特）为中心；东恒伽取代索马万希后，班吉人继续担任当地附庸。14世纪，包特一位无嗣的婆罗门首领收养了凯翁贾尔罗阇的班吉族外甥，后者取名阿南伽·提婆，开创包特世系；1498年，幼支的达斯帕拉封地从包特独立。此外还有马尤尔班杰、凯翁贾尔、古穆萨尔等分支，古穆萨尔的诗人国王乌彭德拉·班贾曾使宫廷成为奥里亚文学的中心。班吉诸邦先后臣属于东恒伽与加贾帕蒂帝国，后来在英国宗主权下保有领地；古穆萨尔在1835—1836年起义后于1835年被英国吞并，马尤尔班杰和凯翁贾尔则作为土邦延续下来。

en: The Bhatis are a Yaduvanshi Rajput clan whose traditions place their origin at Mathura, from which their early ancestor Rao Bhati led them westward after losing their homeland. They settled first at Bhatner in the Lakhi Jungle, then spread through Punjab and the Thar desert, ruling a chain of forts from Tanot and Lodhruva to Pugal and Deravar and clashing with the Ghaznavids and Ghurids. In 1156 Rawal Jaisal moved his capital from Lodhruva to a new desert stronghold, Jaisalmer, which became the clan's lasting kingdom. Around 1299 Alauddin Khalji of Delhi besieged Jaisalmer after a Bhati raid on his treasure caravan; the women perished in the rite of jauhar and the warriors fell fighting, though surviving Bhatis later retook the fort. In 1398 Rai Dul Chand of Bhatner put up one of the stiffest resistances of Timur's Indian campaign before his fort was sacked. The Bhatis later came to terms with the Mughals: Rawal Lunakaran fought Humayun in 1541 and then gave a daughter in marriage to Akbar, and Mughal oversight lasted until 1762. In 1818 the Maharawal Mulraj accepted a British subsidiary alliance, preserving the Jaisalmer throne under protection.
zh: 婆提是亚达瓦世系的拉杰普特氏族，传说其发源地在马图拉；先祖拉奥·婆提在失去故土后率族人西迁，先在拉基丛林的巴特内尔落脚，随后散布到旁遮普和塔尔沙漠，统治着从塔诺特、洛德鲁瓦到普加尔、德拉沃尔的一连串要塞，并长期与伽色尼、古尔势力交锋。1156年，拉瓦尔·贾萨尔把都城从洛德鲁瓦迁往新建的沙漠重镇杰伊瑟尔梅尔，这里成为该氏族长久的王国。约1299年，因婆提人劫掠财宝商队，德里的阿拉乌德丁·卡尔吉围攻杰伊瑟尔梅尔；围城末期妇女行乔哈尔礼自焚，武士全部战死，但幸存的婆提人后来又收复要塞。1398年，巴特内尔的拉伊·杜尔·昌德对帖木儿的征印大军进行了最顽强的抵抗之一，最终要塞仍遭洗劫。婆提人后来与莫卧儿人妥协：1541年拉瓦尔·卢纳卡兰迎战胡马雍，随后又把女儿嫁给阿克巴，莫卧儿对要塞的控制一直持续到1762年。1818年，摩诃拉瓦尔·穆尔拉吉接受英国的辅助同盟，杰伊瑟尔梅尔王位在英国保护下得以保留。

en: The Bhattis, also called Bhatis, are a Rajput clan of the Lunar lineage who claim the Yadava descent of their ancestor Rao Bhati, a king remembered from the third century. Driven out of Mathura, the clan drifted west into the Lakhi Jungle of the Ghaggar valley, where Bhupat, son of Rao Bhati, raised the fort of Bhatner in 295, the fortress that gave the surrounding country its name of Bhattiana. While one branch of the clan pushed on through the desert to Tanot and eventually Jaisalmer, the Bhatner Bhattis held the old fort on the Delhi-Multan road, guarding one of the historic invasion routes into India. Their finest hour came in 1398, when Timur's army poured south from the Punjab and the Bhatti rai Dul Chand gave the invader his hardest resistance in India, Rajput and Muslim tribesmen fighting side by side until the fort was stormed, sacked and burned; Timur himself recorded Bhatner as one of the strongest places he had seen. The clan rebuilt its power afterwards and shared the fort with the Johiya and Chayal tribes until 1527, when Rao Jet Singh of Bikaner seized it. The Rathores of Bikaner took the fortress once more in 1805 and renamed it Hanumangarh, ending more than fifteen centuries of Bhatti association with the place, though Bhatti chiefs and villages remained spread across the Punjab and Sindh countryside.
zh: 婆帝人（又译巴蒂）是属月亮世系的拉杰普特部族，自称雅达瓦后裔，始祖为传说中的3世纪君王拉奥·巴蒂。该族被逐出马图拉后向西辗转，进入加加尔河谷的拉基丛林；295年，拉奥·巴蒂之子布帕特在此修筑巴蒂尔堡，周围地区也因这座堡垒得名巴蒂亚纳。族中一支继续穿越沙漠迁往塔诺特，最终落脚杰伊瑟尔梅尔；留守的婆帝人则据守德里至木尔坦古道上的旧堡，扼守印度历史上的外敌入侵通道之一。他们最壮烈的时刻是1398年：帖木儿大军自旁遮普南下，婆帝罗阇杜尔·昌德给出了入侵者在印度遭遇的最顽强抵抗，拉杰普特与穆斯林部众并肩死守，最终堡垒仍被攻陷、洗劫并焚毁，帖木儿本人也在回忆录中称巴蒂尔是他所见最坚固的要塞之一。此后该族重振势力，与乔提耶、查亚尔诸部共守堡垒，直到1527年比卡内尔的拉杰特·辛格将其夺取。1805年比卡内尔的拉托尔人再度攻占该堡，改名哈努曼加尔，终结了婆帝人与此地逾十五个世纪的渊源，不过婆帝首领与村落仍遍布旁遮普和信德乡间。

en: The Bissetts were a Norman family brought to Scotland in the train of King William the Lion after his release in 1174, where they rose in Moray until Walter Byset, lord of Aboyne, murdered the young Earl of Atholl after a tournament at Haddington in 1242, set fire to the house to hide the deed, and fled with his nephew John to Ireland. In Ulster the family made itself lord of the Glens of Antrim, the narrow coastal glens facing Scottish Kintyre, whose seat was at Glenarm, and became one of the most Gaelicised of the Anglo-Norman lineages; its chiefs adopted the Irish style Mac Eoin Bissett, meaning descendant of John Byset. They held Rathlin Island as well, and in 1306 sheltered Robert the Bruce over the winter at Rathlin Castle after his defeats in Scotland, for which the English dispossessed them of the island. Late in the fourteenth century Margery Byset married John Mór MacDonnell of the Scottish Isles, and the MacDonnells built their claim to the seven lordships of the Glens on that marriage, turning them in time into the MacDonnell lordship of Antrim.
zh: 比塞特家族是诺曼人出身，1174年后随获释归国的苏格兰国王威廉一世北上，在马里郡起家。1242年，阿博因领主沃尔特·比塞在哈丁顿的比武大会上杀死年轻的阿索尔伯爵，事后纵火灭迹，与侄子约翰逃往爱尔兰。在阿尔斯特，这一家族成为安特里姆峡谷的领主，那是一片与苏格兰金泰尔半岛隔海相望的狭长海岸谷地，治所在格勒纳姆；他们也是盎格鲁—诺曼家族中盖尔化最深的一支，族长改用盖尔式称谓，意为“约翰·比塞特之后”。他们还据有拉斯林岛，1306年罗伯特·布鲁斯在苏格兰连遭败绩后，曾在岛上的拉斯林城堡避冬，比塞特家族因此被英格兰人剥夺了该岛。14世纪末，玛杰里·比塞嫁给苏格兰群岛的约翰·莫尔·麦克唐奈，麦克唐奈家族正是凭这段婚姻宣称对峡谷七块领地的权利，后来在此建立了安特里姆的麦克唐奈领地。

en: The House of Bjelbo took its name from its oldest manor at Bjälbo in Östergötland and for generations supplied Sweden's jarls and bishops of Linköping; Folke the Fat became the first known Swedish jarl around 1100, and the family held the office until it was abolished in 1266. Its rise to the throne came through Birger Jarl, whose son Valdemar was elected king in 1250 when Eric XI died without an heir, though Valdemar was deposed by his own brother Magnus Ladulås in 1275. The house then ruled Sweden until 1364, when Magnus Eriksson was driven out by Albert of Mecklenburg, and through Magnus it also held Norway from 1319 to 1387. Olaf, king of both Denmark and Norway, was its last reigning monarch when he died in 1387, and the last male of the line followed within a few years. Its blood survived through daughters: Euphemia of Sweden was an ancestress of the later Oldenburg kings, while Gustav Vasa descended from an illegitimate branch.
zh: 比耶尔博家族得名于其在东约特兰最古老的庄园比耶尔博，世代出任瑞典的雅尔和林雪平主教；约1100年，胖子福尔克成为已知最早的瑞典雅尔，该家族一直把持此职，直到1266年雅尔头衔被废除。家族凭借摄政伯爵比尔耶尔登上王位：1250年国王埃里克十一世无嗣而终，比尔耶尔之子瓦尔德玛被推举为国王，但他在1275年被弟弟马格努斯·拉杜洛斯废黜。此后该家族统治瑞典直至1364年，马格努斯·埃里克松被梅克伦堡的阿尔伯特赶走；凭借马格努斯的血统，家族又在1319—1387年统治挪威。身兼丹麦与挪威国王的奥拉夫四世于1387年去世，是家族最后一位在位君主，家族最后的男嗣也在数年后死去。其血脉通过女系延续：瑞典的尤菲米娅是后来奥尔登堡诸王的先祖，古斯塔夫·瓦萨则出自其一个庶支。

en: The House of Blois, whose lords were so often named Theobald that historians call them the Theobaldians, grew from Theobald the Elder, viscount of Tours and then of Blois in the early tenth century. His descendants stacked up the counties of Blois, Chartres and Chateaudun, and from the eleventh century added Troyes, Meaux and Reims, the core of Champagne, while Odo II's claims stretched as far as the kingdom of Arles. The family gave England a king when Stephen of Blois, grandson of William the Conqueror on his mother's side, seized the English crown in 1135 and held it until 1154. Count Theobald IV of Champagne inherited Navarre in 1234 as King Theobald I, and the Blois-Navarre line ruled there until Queen Joan I died in 1305, when Navarre and Champagne passed to her husband Philip IV of France and the Capetians. The Blois-Chartres branch had already died out in 1249, leaving Blois itself to the Chatillon family. By 1337 the only surviving branch was the counts of Sancerre, founded in the twelfth century, whose hilltop county twice repelled English attacks during the Hundred Years' War even though the Black Prince wasted the country around it. This last line ended with Countess Margaret of Sancerre in 1419, and the whole House of Blois was extinct.
zh: 布卢瓦家族的成员常取名蒂博，因此史家也称其为“蒂博家族”；其源头是10世纪初先后担任图尔和布卢瓦子爵的老蒂博。他的后代陆续取得布卢瓦、沙特尔和沙托丹等伯国，11世纪起又加上特鲁瓦、莫城和兰斯——也就是香槟伯国的核心，厄德二世的继承权主张甚至远及阿尔勒王国。家族还为英格兰贡献过一位国王：布卢瓦的艾蒂安（母系为征服者威廉之孙）于1135年夺得英格兰王位，统治到1154年。香槟伯爵蒂博四世于1234年以国王蒂博一世的身份继承纳瓦拉，布卢瓦-纳瓦拉支系统治那里直到1305年女王让娜一世去世，纳瓦拉和香槟随她的丈夫法王腓力四世转入卡佩家族。布卢瓦-沙特尔支系早在1249年就已绝嗣，布卢瓦本地改属沙蒂永家族。到1337年，唯一存续的是12世纪建立的桑塞尔伯爵支系；百年战争中，这座山顶伯国两次击退英格兰进攻，尽管黑太子把周围乡村蹂躏一空。这最后一支随桑塞尔女伯爵玛格丽特于1419年去世而终结，整个布卢瓦家族就此绝嗣。

en: The Boccanegra were a leading noble family of the Republic of Genoa, champions of the Ghibelline and popular party against the old mercantile patriciate. Guglielmo Boccanegra became captain of the people and virtual ruler of the republic in 1257, and in 1260 he commissioned the Palazzo San Giorgio, the future seat of Genoese government. His nephew Simone Boccanegra was elected the republic's first doge for life on 23 December 1339. He excluded the ancient aristocracy from office and extended Genoese control along both Rivieras, but conspiracies forced him to resign in 1345. After Genoa's defeat at Alghero in 1353 the city submitted to Giovanni Visconti of Milan; when an anti-Visconti rising broke out in 1356 Simone returned, rallied the commoners at San Siro and was restored as doge. He received the surrender of the Corsican rebels in 1358, but died suddenly after a banquet in March 1363, widely believed poisoned, and his regime was at once replaced by that of Gabriele Adorno. Other kinsmen made careers at sea: Egidio Boccanegra led the Genoese fleet at Sluys and served Castile as admiral, winning off Algeciras in 1344, while his son Ambrosio commanded the Castilian fleet at La Rochelle in 1372.
zh: 博卡内格拉是热那亚共和国的名门世家，作为吉伯林派和平民党的领袖，与老牌商业贵族分庭抗礼。古列尔莫·博卡内格拉于1257年出任人民领袖，成为共和国的实际统治者，1260年又主持修建圣乔治宫，这里后来成为热那亚政权的所在地。他的侄子西蒙·博卡内格拉于1339年12月23日当选共和国首任终身总督。他把旧贵族逐出政府，并把热那亚的控制力沿东西两段里维埃拉延伸，但阴谋叛乱不断，迫使他于1345年辞职。1353年热那亚在阿尔盖罗战败后，城市臣服于米兰的乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂；1356年反维斯孔蒂起义爆发，西蒙返回热那亚，在圣西罗教堂号召平民支持，官复原职。1358年他接受科西嘉叛乱者投降，但1363年3月在一次宴会后暴毙，外界普遍认为他是被毒杀，其政权随即被加布里埃莱·阿多尔诺取代。家族其他成员则在海上建功：埃吉迪奥·博卡内格拉曾率热那亚舰队参加斯勒伊斯海战，又出任卡斯蒂利亚海军上将，1344年在阿尔赫西拉斯外海取胜；其子安布罗焦于1372年指挥卡斯蒂利亚舰队参加拉罗谢尔海战。

en: The Bohtan were the ruling family of the Kurdish principality of the same name, centered on Jazirat ibn Umar, modern Cizre, on the Tigris in the northern Jazira. The Sharafnama traces the dynasty, known as the Azizan, to the Bokhti tribal chief Sulaiman Khalid and his son Abdulaziz, from whom all the later emirs descended; in the fourteenth century the family still followed Yezidism before converting to Sunni Islam. In 1336 or 1337 the Bohtan seized Cizre with the help of the Ayyubid emir of Hisn Kayfa, who married a daughter to the emir Izz al-Din in the hope of controlling the town, but the Bohtan kept their independence and repelled a Hisn Kayfa attack in 1385. The eighth ruler, Izz al-Din Abdal, submitted to Timur at Mardin in 1394. At its height the emirate stretched from Diyarbakır to Van and from Zakho to Sinjar, and after the Ottoman victory at Çaldiran in 1514 it was recognized as a hereditary Kurdish principality, counting among the longest-lived of the region.
zh: 博赫丹家族是同名库尔德酋长国的统治家族，政权以杰济拉北部底格里斯河畔的贾齐拉特·伊本·奥马尔（今吉兹雷）为中心。《谢里夫纳马》把这个称做阿齐赞的王朝追溯到博赫提部落首领苏莱曼·哈立德及其子阿卜杜勒阿齐兹，历代埃米尔皆出其裔；14世纪时该家族仍信奉雅兹迪教，后来才改宗逊尼派伊斯兰教。1336至1337年间，博赫丹人借哈桑凯夫阿尤布埃米尔之力夺取吉兹雷，后者把女儿嫁给埃米尔伊兹丁，企图借此控制该城，但博赫丹保持了独立，并在1385年击退哈桑凯夫的来攻。第八代统治者伊兹丁·阿卜达勒于1394年在马尔丁向帖木儿称臣。极盛时酋长国疆域从迪亚巴克尔延伸到凡城，从扎霍延伸到辛贾尔；1514年恰尔德兰战役奥斯曼获胜后，它被承认为世袭的库尔德酋长国，是当地延续最久的政权之一。

en: The de Bohun were a Norman family founded by Humphrey with the Beard, who held the manor of Bohon on the Cotentin Peninsula and settled in England after the Conquest. Henry de Bohun became the first Earl of Hereford and hereditary Constable of England in 1199, and from his stronghold at Pleshey Castle the family went on to hold the earldoms of Hereford and Essex with broad lands in the Welsh Marches, taking the swan as its heraldic badge. Generation after generation was named Humphrey. The fourth earl, born about 1276, was one of the Ordainers who curbed Edward II and married Elizabeth of Rhuddlan in 1302, a daughter of Edward I; he was killed leading the rebel charge at Boroughbridge in 1322. His daughter Eleanor married James Butler, first Earl of Ormonde, while his son William was created Earl of Northampton under Edward III. The last male heir, the seventh earl Humphrey, joined the sack of Alexandria in 1365 and died in 1373 leaving only daughters, so the titles fell into abeyance and the estates were carried by Eleanor to Thomas of Woodstock, Duke of Gloucester, and by Mary to Henry Bolingbroke, the future Henry IV.
zh: 博洪家族是诺曼人家族，始祖为留有胡须的汉弗莱，在科唐坦半岛领有博洪庄园，诺曼征服后定居英格兰。亨利·德·博洪于1199年成为第一代赫里福德伯爵和世袭英格兰统帅；家族以普莱西城堡为据点，先后领有赫里福德与埃塞克斯伯爵衔，在威尔士边疆拥有大片领地，并以天鹅为纹章徽记，历代继承人多取名汉弗莱。约1276年出生的第四代伯爵是约束爱德华二世的贵族改革派成员，1302年娶爱德华一世之女里兹兰的伊丽莎白为妻，1322年在巴勒布里奇率叛军冲锋时战死。他的女儿埃莉诺嫁给第一代奥蒙德伯爵詹姆斯·巴特勒，儿子威廉则被爱德华三世封为北安普顿伯爵。末代男嗣、第七代伯爵汉弗莱曾参加1365年洗劫亚历山大港之役，1373年去世时只留下女儿，伯爵爵位搁置待决，遗产由两个女儿带走：埃莉诺嫁与格洛斯特公爵伍德斯托克的托马斯，玛丽则嫁与后来的亨利四世亨利·博林布鲁克。

en: The Bolaang dynasty ruled the Mongondow people of northern Celebes, in what is now North Sulawesi. Mongondow tradition holds that in the thirteenth century the local chiefs, or bogani, met in a bakid assembly and united their clans into a maritime polity called Bolaang, meaning sea, choosing Mokodoludut of Molantud as their first paramount chief, or punu; the king lists place his long reign from 1280 to 1376 over Dumoga and Manado. His successors moved the court between the Mongondow plateau and coastal settlements such as Bolaang and Belang, and Spanish and Portuguese sailors knew the realm as the kingdom of Boulan. After a power vacuum in the late sixteenth century, when King Mokodompit withdrew to Siau Island, the chief Tadohe restored the state, and his son Datu Loloda Mokoagow, on succeeding in 1670, took the title datu and built the Kingdom of Bola'ang into a power stretching from the Mongondow plateau to Manado. A Dutch-backed border agreement with the Minahasan federation in 1694 stripped away the eastern lands, and in the eighteenth century contracts with the Dutch East India Company shrank the realm further, after which it was called Bolaang Mongondow.
zh: 博朗王朝统治今印度尼西亚北苏拉威西的蒙贡杜人。蒙贡杜传统称，13世纪时各地部落首领博加尼举行巴基德大会，把各氏族联合为名为博朗的海上政权——博朗意为海——并推举莫兰图部的莫科多卢杜特为首任最高首领普努；王表把他的漫长统治系于1280—1376年，领有杜莫加和万鸦老。其后继者在蒙贡杜高原与博朗、伯朗等沿海据点之间迁徙王廷，西班牙和葡萄牙水手称其为布兰王国。16世纪末国王莫科多姆皮特退居锡奥岛，国内出现权力真空，首领塔多赫重振国政；其子达图·洛洛达·莫科阿戈于1670年继位后改用达图头衔，把博朗王国建成横跨蒙贡杜高原至万鸦老的强权。1694年，在荷兰支持下，米纳哈萨部落联盟与其划界，博朗丧失东部疆土；18世纪又因与荷兰东印度公司的一系列条约不断萎缩，此后改称博朗-蒙贡杜。

en: The Bolkiah are the royal house of Brunei, the Malay sultanate on the northern coast of Borneo. Tradition traces the line to Awang Alak Betatar, the local ruler who embraced Islam and became the first sultan, Muhammad Shah, in the later fourteenth century, together with his brother Awang Semaun; Chinese envoys already recorded a Sultan Muhammad Shah ruling a Brunei that paid tribute to Majapahit. The dynasty took its name from its most celebrated ruler, Sultan Bolkiah, who reigned from 1485 to 1524 and presided over Brunei's golden age. He brought in Javanese blacksmiths to cast cannon, and Brunei's sway then ran over the coasts of Borneo and reached the Sulu Archipelago and Manila, whose rajahs married into the house. Brunei remained a major maritime power through the sixteenth century, visited by Pigafetta's surviving Magellan expedition in 1521. From the later seventeenth century succession quarrels among the nobles, the rise of Sulu and widespread piracy eroded the sultanate into a loose cluster of riverine territories, and by the 1830s open revolt had broken out in the Bau region.
zh: 博尔基亚家族是婆罗洲北岸马来苏丹国文莱的王室。按传统说法，其世系可追溯到14世纪后期皈依伊斯兰教、成为首任苏丹穆罕默德·沙的本地统治者阿旺·阿拉克·贝塔塔尔，以及他的兄弟阿旺·塞马温；中国使臣的记载中已出现一位向满者伯夷纳贡的文莱苏丹穆罕默德·沙。王朝得名于最负盛名的苏丹博尔基亚（1485—1524年在位），他统治时期是文莱的黄金时代：他引入爪哇工匠铸造火炮，文莱势力遍及婆罗洲沿海，并远及苏禄群岛和马尼拉，马尼拉的拉惹们纷纷与王室联姻。整个16世纪文莱都是海上强国，1521年麦哲伦船队的幸存者皮加费塔曾到访此地。17世纪后期起，贵族间的王位纷争、苏禄的崛起和海盗活动使苏丹国逐渐瓦解为松散的河川领地集合，到19世纪30年代，巴乌地区还爆发了公开叛乱。

en: Bone was the leading Bugis kingdom of the southern peninsula of Sulawesi, centered on Watampone. Its tradition credits ManurungngE Rimatajang with founding the line around 1330, and its rulers bore the title Arumpone. From a few settlements around Watampone it grew under early fifteenth-century rulers such as La Umasa, and in the early sixteenth century it fought Luwu for the mouth of the Cenrana River, an east-coast trade outlet. In 1582 it joined Wajo and Soppeng in the Tellumpocco'e alliance, the Three Summits, to check the rising power of Gowa and Tallo, but a Gowa invasion of 1611 forced Bone to accept Islam. Its greatest ruler was Arung Palakka, La Tenritatta, who allied with the Dutch admiral Cornelis Speelman; the fall of Makassar in 1669 made Bone the overlord of South Sulawesi. It kept that standing until the British interlude of 1814 and the Dutch return in 1816, after which the Dutch tried to reduce it to a vassal, meeting armed resistance in the war of 1824.
zh: 波尼是苏拉威西南半岛首屈一指的布吉人王国，以瓦坦波尼为中心。相传曼努隆格·里马塔姜于1330年前后开创王统，君主称号为“阿伦波内”。15世纪初，在拉·乌马萨等君主治下，它从瓦坦波尼周围的几处聚落发展壮大；16世纪初，它为争夺东海岸贸易出口琴拉纳河口与卢武交战。1582年，波尼与瓦佐、索彭结成“三峰”同盟，以遏制戈瓦和塔洛的崛起，但1611年戈瓦入侵，迫使波尼接受伊斯兰教。它最伟大的君主是阿隆·帕拉卡（拉·滕里塔塔），他与荷兰海军将领科尔内利斯·斯皮尔曼结盟；1669年望加锡陷落后，波尼成为南苏拉威西的宗主。这一地位一直维持到1814年英国短暂接管和1816年荷兰卷土重来，此后荷兰企图将它降为附庸，在1824年的战争中遭到波尼的武力抵抗。

en: The Borcke, also spelled Bork or Borke, were an old Pomeranian noble family of Wendish origin, sometimes called the Borkonen in historiography. Their presumed ancestor Bork was a Wendish noble killed between 1170 and 1187 in the wars of Duke Bogislaw I of Pomerania against Brandenburg; his grandson Borko II served as burgrave of Kolberg until 1255 and appears in a charter of Duke Barnim I in 1271 as lord of Lobis. At the end of the thirteenth century the personal name Borko hardened into a family name, first so used by Nikolaus Borko in 1297. Their Farther Pomeranian estates around Labes, Regenwalde, Strahmel and Wangerin formed a compact lordship officially known as the Borcke Circle until 1817, where the family exercised full jurisdiction. Heinrich Borcke, called the black knight, added Falkenberg in the Neumark in 1479 and bought Pansin Castle from the Order of Saint John in 1493. For generations the Borcke refused to do homage to the Griffin dukes for their ancestral lands, holding out until 1567. Sidonia von Borcke was beheaded at Stettin in 1620 after a witch trial, and Adrian Bernhard von Borcke became a Prussian field marshal and minister under Frederick William I, receiving a comital patent in 1740.
zh: 博尔克家族（亦拼作博克或博尔克）是波美拉尼亚的古老贵族，出身文德人，史学著作中有时称其为博尔科嫩家族。传说中的先祖博克是文德贵族，在1170至1187年间波美拉尼亚公爵博吉斯瓦夫一世对勃兰登堡的战争中战死；其孙博尔科二世至1255年一直担任科尔贝格城堡伯爵，并在1271年公爵巴尔宁一世的特许状中以洛比斯领主的身份出现。13世纪末，人名博尔科固定为家族姓氏，1297年尼古拉·博尔科首次这样使用。他们在远波美拉尼亚围绕拉贝斯、雷根瓦尔德、施特拉梅尔和旺格林的领地连成一片完整的辖区，1817年以前官方名称就叫博尔克区，家族在区内行使全部司法权。绰号“黑骑士”的海因里希·博尔克于1479年取得新马克的法尔肯贝格，1493年又从圣约翰骑士团手中买下潘辛城堡。好几代人里，博尔克家族都拒绝为祖传土地向格里芬公爵行臣服礼，一直坚持到1567年。西多妮娅·冯·博尔克于1620年在斯德丁遭女巫审判后被斩首；阿德里安·伯恩哈德·冯·博尔克则在腓特烈·威廉一世麾下官至普鲁士陆军元帅兼大臣，并于1740年获封伯爵。

en: The Borjigin were the imperial clan of the Mongols, tracing descent from Bodonchar Munkhag, youngest son of the legendary Alan Gua; his descendant Khabul Khan built the Khamag Mongol confederation about 1131, and Khabul's great-grandson Temüjin united the steppe tribes and was enthroned as Genghis Khan in 1206. Genghis and his sons built the largest continuous land empire in history, and after 1259 his Borjigid heirs divided it among appanage lines: the great khans and then Kublai's Yuan dynasty in China, Jochi's Golden Horde on the Volga, the Chagatai khanate in Central Asia, and the Ögedei and Ilkhanid lines. In 1368 the Ming drove the last Yuan emperor Toghon Temür beyond the Great Wall, but the house continued as the Northern Yuan on the Mongolian plateau. Oirat strongmen briefly usurped the khanate in the 1450s, before Dayan Khan restored Borjigid supremacy between 1480 and 1517 and parcelled the steppe among his sons, from whom the Khalkha khans and the Altan khans of Tumed descended. Borjigid princes also ruled Kazan and the Crimea until the Russian conquests of the sixteenth and eighteenth centuries, while Babur, founder of the Mughal Empire in India, claimed Chinggisid blood through his mother. The senior khagan line ended with Ligden Khan, who died fighting the rising Qing in 1634, and the Khalkha Borjigid khanates submitted to the Qing in 1691.
zh: 孛儿只斤是蒙古的帝裔氏族，传说可追溯至阿兰豁阿感天光所生的幼子孛端察儿；其后人合不勒汗约在1131年聚合蒙古诸部，建立起松散的部族联盟，合不勒的曾孙铁木真统一草原诸部，于1206年即大汗位，称成吉思汗。成吉思汗及其子孙建立了史上疆域最辽阔的陆上帝国，1259年以后，孛儿只斤的后裔按支系瓜分帝国：忽必烈一系的大汗及后来的元朝统治中国，术赤的金帐汗国据有伏尔加河流域，另有中亚的察合台汗国、窝阔台系和伊儿汗国。1368年明朝将末代元帝妥懽帖睦尔逐过长城，但该家族在蒙古高原以北元延续。15世纪50年代卫拉特权臣也先一度篡夺汗位，达延汗随即在1480—1517年间恢复孛儿只斤的霸权，并把草原分封给诸子，喀尔喀诸汗与土默特的俺答汗皆出其后。孛儿只斤王公还统治着喀山和克里米亚，直到16至18世纪被俄罗斯相继征服；印度莫卧儿帝国的建立者巴布尔也通过母系自称拥有成吉思汗血统。大汗嫡系至1634年林丹汗对抗新兴的清朝败死而告终，喀尔喀的孛儿只斤诸汗国则于1691年归附清朝。

en: The House of Bourbon is a cadet branch of the Capetian kings of France. It began in 1272 when Robert, count of Clermont, youngest son of Saint Louis IX, married Beatrice, heiress of the lordship of Bourbon in central France. Their son Louis I, born in 1279, was made the first duke of Bourbon and a peer of France in 1327, and in 1337 he was one of the leading princes of the realm. His descendants served the Valois crown: Peter I fell at Poitiers in 1356, Louis II added Forez by marriage, and John I was captured at Agincourt in 1415 and died a prisoner in England. The senior ducal line ended in 1527 when Duke Charles III, the rebellious constable of France, was killed at the sack of Rome. The junior Vendome branch then became the senior line, and when the Valois died out in 1589 its head inherited the crown as Henry IV. His line ruled France until Louis XVI was overthrown in the French Revolution and executed in 1793; restored in 1815, the Bourbons were finally driven out by the July Revolution of 1830, after which the Orléans cadet branch ruled under King Louis-Philippe. Meanwhile a Bourbon grandson of Louis XIV became Philip V of Spain in 1700, and the Treaty of Utrecht of 1713 separated the Spanish and French crowns; Spanish Bourbons also took Naples and Sicily from 1734 and Parma from 1748, founding courts that lasted into the nineteenth century.
zh: 波旁家族是法兰西卡佩诸王的支系，始于1272年：圣路易九世的幼子、克莱蒙伯爵罗贝尔娶了法兰西中部波旁领地的女继承人贝亚特丽丝。他们的儿子路易一世生于1279年，1327年成为第一代波旁公爵和法兰西重臣，1337年时已是王国首屈一指的大诸侯之一。其后代为瓦卢瓦王朝效力：皮埃尔一世于1356年战死于普瓦捷，路易二世通过联姻取得福雷，让一世在1415年的阿金库尔战役中被俘，最终囚死于英格兰。公爵长支于1527年终结——叛逆的法兰西统帅夏尔三世在罗马之劫中被杀。旁支旺代姆一支随即成为长支，1589年瓦卢瓦王朝绝嗣，其族长以亨利四世的身份继承王位。这一系统治法国直到路易十六在法国大革命中被推翻并于1793年被处死；1815年波旁复辟，最终在1830年七月革命中被赶下台，此后奥尔良旁支在路易-菲利普治下继续统治。与此同时，路易十四的一个波旁孙辈于1700年成为西班牙国王腓力五世，1713年的《乌得勒支条约》规定西、法两顶王冠永不合并；西班牙波旁家族又从1734年起取得那不勒斯和西西里，1748年起取得帕尔马，建立的宫廷一直延续到19世纪。

en: Bowontehu was a kingdom around Manado Bay on the northern tip of Sulawesi, recorded as the predecessor of the Kingdom of Manado and dated from about 1500 to 1670. Its successor realm held the islands of Bunaken and Lembeh and the neighboring coast, hosted Portuguese and Spanish traders, and converted to Catholicism in the seventeenth century.
zh: 博翁特胡是苏拉威西北端万鸦老湾一带的王国，史料记载它是万鸦老王国的前身，约存在于1500年至1670年。后继的万鸦老王国领有布纳肯、伦贝等岛屿和附近海岸，接待葡萄牙与西班牙商人，并于17世纪皈依天主教。

en: The Brancaleoni were a noble family of the Marche, in the upper valley of the Metauro, who held the lordship of Massa Trabaria and the county of Mercatello sul Metauro, together with Sant'Angelo in Vado and Castel Durante, later called Urbania. Bartolomeo Brancaleoni, lord of Massa Trabaria, married Giovanna Alidosi, daughter of the lord of Imola, and on his death in 1424 his daughters Gentile and Piera inherited his domains, while effective power passed to Guidantonio da Montefeltro, Count of Urbino, as papal vicar. After Piera died, Gentile became sole heiress and in 1437 married Guidantonio's son Federico da Montefeltro, who took possession of the Brancaleoni lands by right of his wife. Pope Eugene IV confirmed him as vicar and count in 1443, and when Federico became Duke of Urbino in 1444 the Brancaleoni castles, about eighteen in all, were merged into the Duchy of Urbino. Gentile, duchess consort of Urbino, died without surviving children in 1457, and the family's independent rule came to an end.
zh: 布兰卡莱奥尼家族是马尔凯地区梅陶罗河上游的贵族，领有马萨特腊巴里亚领地和梅陶罗河畔梅尔卡泰洛伯国，以及圣安杰洛-因瓦多和后来改称乌尔巴尼亚的杜兰堡。家主巴尔托洛梅奥娶伊莫拉领主之女乔万娜·阿利多西为妻，1424年他去世后，女儿真蒂莱和皮耶拉继承领地，实际权力则落入以教皇代理人身份执政的乌尔比诺伯爵圭达托尼奥·达·蒙泰费尔特罗之手。皮耶拉死后，真蒂莱成为唯一继承人，1437年嫁给圭达托尼奥之子费德里科·达·蒙泰费尔特罗，后者凭妻权接管布兰卡莱奥尼的土地。1443年教皇尤金四世任命他为代理人并封伯爵；1444年费德里科成为乌尔比诺公爵，布兰卡莱奥尼家族约十八座城堡并入乌尔比诺公国。真蒂莱作为乌尔比诺公爵夫人于1457年去世，未留下存活子嗣，家族的独立统治就此终结。

en: The Bruces were a Lowland Scottish house of Norman origin, taking their name from Brix in Normandy; Robert de Brus came to England in 1106 as a companion of David I and received the lordship of Annandale in Scotland. The marriage of the fourth lord to Isobel of Huntingdon, niece of William the Lion, gave the family a claim to the crown, and the fifth lord was a leading claimant in the Great Cause of 1290, though Edward I of England awarded the throne to John Balliol. Robert the Bruce revived the claim: after killing his rival John Comyn he was crowned king in 1306, defeated Edward II at Bannockburn in 1314, and saw Scottish independence recognised in the Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton of 1328, dying the next year at his favoured Dunfermline. His brother Edward Bruce had briefly been high king of Ireland before falling in battle in 1318. Robert's son David II inherited as a child, was driven into French exile after Halidon Hill in 1333, and spent eleven years captive in England after his defeat at Neville's Cross in 1346. When David died childless in 1371, the last male of the house, the crown passed through Robert's daughter Marjorie to the Stewarts under Robert II.
zh: 布鲁斯家族是出身诺曼的苏格兰低地贵族，姓氏源自诺曼底的布里克瑟；1106年，罗伯特·德·布鲁斯作为大卫一世的伙伴来到英格兰，后受封苏格兰的安南代尔领地。第四代领主娶狮子王威廉的侄女亨廷顿的伊莎贝尔为妻，家族由此获得王位继承权；第五代领主在1290年的大业之争中是主要争位者，但英格兰国王爱德华一世把王位判给了约翰·巴里奥。罗伯特·布鲁斯重启争夺：他杀死政敌约翰·科明后于1306年加冕为王，1314年在班诺克本击败爱德华二世，并在1328年的《爱丁堡—北安普顿条约》中赢得苏格兰独立的承认，次年在他钟爱的邓弗姆林去世。其弟爱德华·布鲁斯曾短暂成为爱尔兰至高王，1318年战死。罗伯特之子大卫二世幼年继位，1333年哈利顿山战败后流亡法国，1346年又在内维尔十字兵败，被英格兰囚禁十一年。1371年大卫无嗣而终，家族男嗣断绝，王位经罗伯特之女玛乔丽传给罗伯特二世开创的斯图亚特家族。

en: This is the royal line of the kabakas, the kings of Buganda, known in Ganda tradition as the Kintu or Abalasangeye dynasty. Its founder was Kato Kintu, who in the late 1200s united the clans around the north-western shore of Lake Victoria and set up his capital at Nnono; his sons included Gguluddene, Wakayima and Chwa, who succeeded him as Chwa I. Chwa's son Kalemeera was driven into Bunyoro, and Kalemeera's son Kimera, born there at Kibulala, returned to reign as the third kabaka, a link that fed Bunyoro claims of influence over the young kingdom. From a small ritual polity in Busiro, Buganda survived a Bunyoro invasion in the 1500s and then expanded steadily as Bunyoro-Kitara declined: during the 1600s and 1700s it conquered Buddu, parts of Busoga and Karagwe, and made Kooki a tributary. Appointed military chiefs in the conquered lands bound the state together, and by the early 1800s the kabaka ruled the strongest and most centralised kingdom of the Great Lakes, served by fleets of war canoes on Lake Victoria; the Ganda king list counts thirty-six kabakas in an unbroken line.
zh: 这是布干达国王“卡巴卡”的王统，在干达传统中称为金图王朝（阿巴拉桑杰王朝）。开创者卡托·金图于13世纪末统一了维多利亚湖西北岸的各个氏族，建都诺诺；他的儿子包括古卢代内、瓦卡伊马和继位为恰瓦一世的恰瓦。恰瓦之子卡莱梅拉被逐入布尼奥罗，卡莱梅拉之子基梅拉出生于当地的基布拉拉，后来回国成为第三代卡巴卡，这段渊源也成了布尼奥罗声称对年轻的布干达拥有影响力的依据。布干达从布西罗的小型仪式政权起家，16世纪击退布尼奥罗的入侵，随后趁布尼奥罗-基塔拉衰落持续扩张：17至18世纪间征服了布杜、布索加和卡拉圭的部分地区，并使科基成为属国。被征服土地上由任命的军事首领治理，国家因此日益整合；到19世纪初，卡巴卡已是大湖地区最强大、集权程度最高的统治者，在维多利亚湖上拥有战船队，而干达王表记载了一脉相承的三十六代卡巴卡。

en: The Bulduqani were a Kurdish dynasty, of Zaza speech, who ruled the Principality of Eğil north of Diyarbakır for some eight centuries. The line was founded by Pir Mansur, a Sufi leader who came from the Hakkâri region and took Eğil around 1049 with the backing of the local Mirdesan tribe; his grandson Pir Bedir was killed in the Seljuk siege of 1087, and the posthumously born Emir Bulduk, from whom the dynasty took its name, was raised by the tribe. Under Emir Muhammed the emirate expanded from Eğil to Palu and Elazığ in the north, Çermik in the west and Karaca Dağ in the south. In the fifteenth century the Bulduqani married into the Aq Qoyunlu, as Dawlatshah's daughter wed Uzun Hasan, even though Dawlatshah's son Isa fought against him at the Battle on the Tigris in 1457. The Safavids later seized the principality and lost it to the Ottoman sultan Selim I, under whom Eğil became a self-governing Kurdish emirate, exempt from the ordinary timar fief system.
zh: 布尔杜卡尼是操扎扎其语的库尔德王朝，在迪亚巴克尔以北的埃伊尔酋长国统治了约八百年。家族始祖皮儿·曼苏尔是来自哈卡里地区的苏菲首领，约1049年借当地米尔迪桑部落之力取得埃伊尔；其孙皮儿·贝迪尔在1087年塞尔柱人的围攻中被杀，遗腹子埃米尔·布尔杜克由部落抚养成人，王朝之名即由他而来。埃米尔穆罕默德在位时，酋长国以埃伊尔为中心向北扩张到帕卢和埃拉泽，西至切尔米克，南抵卡拉贾山。15世纪时布尔杜卡尼家族与白羊王朝联姻，道拉特沙之女嫁给乌尊·哈桑，而道拉特沙之子伊萨却在1457年底格里斯河战役中与乌尊·哈桑为敌。此后酋长国一度被萨法维波斯夺取，又落入奥斯曼苏丹塞利姆一世之手，埃伊尔由此成为自治的库尔德埃米尔国，享有不纳入普通蒂玛封地制度的特权。

en: The Bundelas are a Rajput clan that gave its name to Bundelkhand in central India. Their traditions trace their rise to 1288, when Sohanpal, a dispossessed chief of Mahoni, joined the Panwar leader Panpal to defeat Naga, the Khangar ruler of Kurar, and seize the fort of Garh Kundar, the clan's first stronghold. In 1531 Rudra Pratap Singh, who had ruled from Garh Kundar since 1501, founded Orchha on the Betwa River and moved his capital there. Orchha became the parent Bundela kingdom: Madhukar Shah submitted to the Mughal emperor Akbar and ceded lands in 1577 and 1588, while Vir Singh Deo, a vassal of Jahangir, brought the state to its zenith between 1605 and 1627, building the Jahangir Mahal. Cadet branches founded Datia in 1626 and Panna in 1657. The Panna raja Chhatrasal, reigning from 1675 to 1731, led a long revolt against Mughal rule and on his death divided his kingdom, leaving one third to the Maratha Peshwa Baji Rao; Ajaigarh, Bijawar and Charkhari then split from Panna. Orchha itself escaped full Maratha subjugation and concluded a treaty of alliance with the British in 1812.
zh: 班德拉是拉杰普特氏族，中印度的本德尔肯德地区便因他们而得名。据其传说，1288年被剥夺领地的马霍尼首领索汉帕尔联合潘瓦尔首领潘帕尔，击败昆达尔的坎加尔统治者纳加，夺取加尔昆达尔要塞，这里成为该氏族最早的据点。1531年，自1501年起以加尔昆达尔为治所的鲁德拉·普拉塔普·辛格在贝德瓦河畔建立奥拉奇哈，并迁都于此。奥拉奇哈成为班德拉诸邦的母邦：马杜卡尔·沙阿向莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴臣服，于1577和1588年割让土地；维尔·辛格·迪奥作为贾汉吉尔的封臣，在1605至1627年间把国家推向鼎盛，修建了贾汉吉尔宫。支系先后于1626年分出达蒂亚、1657年分出潘纳。潘纳君主查特拉萨尔（1675—1731年在位）长期起兵反抗莫卧儿统治，临终时瓜分王国，把三分之一领地留给马拉塔佩什瓦巴吉拉奥；阿杰伊加尔、比贾瓦尔和查尔卡里随后从潘纳分立。奥拉奇哈本身未被马拉塔人彻底征服，并于1812年与英国结盟订约。

en: The Burghersh family were English soldiers and royal servants raised to the peerage when Robert de Burghersh was summoned to Parliament as Baron Burghersh in 1303. As constable of Dover Castle and warden of the Cinque Ports he guarded the main crossing to France, an office his sons inherited. One son, Henry Burghersh, became Bishop of Lincoln and joined Queen Isabella's invasion of 1326 that overthrew Edward II. The title was recreated in 1330 for another son, Bartholomew the elder, who held Dover and the Cinque Ports for Edward III, served as admiral and diplomat, and died in 1355. His son Bartholomew the younger fought at Crécy in 1346 and the siege of Calais in 1347, was among the first Knights of the Garter in 1348, and distinguished himself at Poitiers in 1356 before dying in 1369. After passing through the Despenser and Beauchamp families the barony fell into abeyance in 1449, and a new creation in 1624 carried it to the Earls of Westmorland.
zh: 伯格斯家族是英格兰的军人与王室仆从家族，罗伯特·德·伯格斯于1303年被召入议会、受封伯格斯男爵，家族由此跻身贵族。他担任多佛尔城堡总管和五港同盟长官，扼守通往法国的主要渡口，这两个职务后来由他的儿子们继承。其子亨利·伯格斯官至林肯主教，参与了伊莎贝拉王后1326年推翻爱德华二世的入侵行动。1330年，男爵头衔为另一个儿子老巴塞洛缪重新创设，他为爱德华三世镇守多佛尔和五港，出任海军统帅与外交官，于1355年去世。他的儿子小巴塞洛缪参加了1346年的克雷西战役和1347年的加来围城战，1348年成为首批嘉德骑士之一，又在1356年的普瓦捷战役中立功，1369年去世。男爵头衔后经勒德斯潘塞和比彻姆家族传承，于1449年进入搁置状态；1624年的新册封把它转入威斯特摩兰伯爵一系。

en: The Castilian House of Burgundy was a cadet line of the Anscarid House of Ivrea, founded when Raymond of Burgundy came to the court of Alfonso VI around 1087 and married his heiress Urraca, receiving Galicia as his appanage. Their son Alfonso VII inherited León and Castile in 1126, but his death in 1157 split the realms between his sons; they were permanently reunited by Ferdinand III, who added Córdoba in 1236 and Seville in 1248 to the reconquered south. Ferdinand's marriage to Joan, heiress of Ponthieu and Aumale, also planted a junior line in northern France as counts of Aumale, while another daughter of the house, Blanche of Castile, became queen of France and mother of Louis IX. Alfonso X the Wise, king from 1252, compiled the Siete Partidas law code but left a disputed succession between the la Cerda line and Sancho IV. In 1337 the reigning king was Alfonso XI, who routed the Marinids at the Río Salado in 1340 and took Algeciras in 1344. His son Peter I, called the Cruel, was overthrown and killed at Montiel in 1369 during the Castilian Civil War by his illegitimate half-brother, who took the crown as Henry II and founded the Trastámara line, itself sprung from this same Burgundian stock.
zh: 卡斯蒂利亚勃艮第王朝是伊夫雷亚王朝（安斯卡里德家族）的支系：勃艮第的雷蒙约在1087年来到阿方索六世的宫廷，娶其女继承人乌拉卡，并受封加利西亚。他们的儿子阿方索七世于1126年继承莱昂和卡斯蒂利亚，但1157年他去世后王国分给两个儿子；直到费尔南多三世时才重新统一，他还在再征服运动中于1236年取得科尔多瓦、1248年取得塞维利亚。费尔南多娶蓬蒂厄和欧玛勒的女继承人让娜，使一支幼支在法国北部世袭欧玛勒伯爵；家族的另一位公主卡斯蒂利亚的布兰卡则成为法国王后，即路易九世之母。1252年继位的“智者”阿方索十世主持编纂《七章法典》，却在拉塞尔达支系与桑乔四世之间留下继承争端。1337年在位的是阿方索十一世，他于1340年在萨拉多河大败马林王朝，1344年攻占阿尔赫西拉斯。其子“暴君”佩德罗一世在1369年的卡斯蒂利亚内战中被私生子兄长推翻，在蒙铁尔遇害，后者即位为恩里克二世，开创特拉斯塔马拉王朝——而这一支同样源自勃艮第血脉。

en: This House of Burgundy was a cadet branch of the Capetian kings, founded when Robert I, younger son of King Robert II the Pious, received the Duchy of Burgundy from his brother Henry I in 1032 and ruled it from Dijon. Its dukes took the cross with the crusades and planted branches across the west: a younger grandson of Robert I, Henry, became count of Portugal in 1093, and his son Afonso Henriques founded the Portuguese kingdom in 1139, a Burgundian line that ruled in Lisbon until 1383; another son inherited the Dauphine of Viennois through his mother, while the lords of Montagu and, by marriage, the counties of Nevers, Auxerre and Tonnerre also came from the house. Its daughters married into the greatest courts, including two queens of France. In 1337 the reigning duke was Odo IV, who through his wife Joan III held the Free County of Burgundy and Artois from 1330 and loyally commanded Philip VI's armies in the opening wars with England, fighting at Cassel in 1328 and Saint-Omer in 1340. His grandson Philip of Rouvres gathered Burgundy, Artois, the Free County, Auvergne and Boulogne into one hand, but died childless in 1361, probably of plague. The duchy then reverted to the French crown, and in 1363 King John II gave it to his own son Philip the Bold, opening the Valois House of Burgundy.
zh: 这个勃艮第家族是卡佩诸王的支系：国王“虔诚者”罗贝尔二世的幼子罗贝尔一世于1032年从兄长亨利一世手中受封勃艮第公国，以第戎为中心统治。历代公爵随十字军东征，并把支系播撒到西方各地：罗贝尔一世的一个幼孙亨利在1093年成为葡萄牙伯爵，其子阿方索·恩里克斯于1139年建立葡萄牙王国，这条勃艮第世系在里斯本统治到1383年；另一个儿子通过母亲继承了维埃努瓦多菲内，蒙塔居领主以及靠联姻取得的讷韦尔、欧塞尔和托内尔等伯国也出自该家族。家族的女儿嫁入各国宫廷，其中两人成为法国王后。1337年在位的公爵是厄德四世，他通过妻子让娜三世从1330年起领有勃艮第自由伯国和阿图瓦，并在英法战争初期忠心为腓力六世统兵，参加了1328年的卡塞尔之战和1340年的圣奥梅尔之战。其孙菲利普·德·鲁夫尔一度集勃艮第、阿图瓦、自由伯国、奥弗涅和布洛涅于一身，却在1361年无子而亡（很可能死于瘟疫）。公国随即收归法国王室，1363年国王让二世把它封给亲子“勇敢者”菲利普，开启了瓦卢瓦-勃艮第支系。

en: The Portuguese House of Burgundy was founded by Henry of Burgundy, a Capetian cadet who joined the Reconquista and in 1096 received the County of Portugal from Alfonso VI of León together with the hand of his daughter Teresa. Their son Afonso Henriques defeated his mother's party at São Mamede in 1128 and was proclaimed king after the Battle of Ourique in 1139, with papal recognition of the independent kingdom following in 1179. His successors pushed the reconquest south: Afonso III completed it by taking the Algarve in 1249 and styling himself King of Portugal and the Algarve, while Afonso II summoned the first Cortes and Denis I, reigning from 1279 to 1325, made Portuguese the language of the law courts, founded the university that settled at Coimbra and fixed the Castilian frontier in the Treaty of Alcañices of 1297. Dynastic marriages carried the house abroad, as when the infante Ferdinand became Count of Flanders and princesses wed the kings of Denmark and Aragon. In 1337 Afonso IV ruled at Lisbon and later sent his host to fight alongside Castile at the Río Salado in 1340. The house ended when Ferdinand I died in 1383 leaving his heiress Beatrice, wife of John I of Castile: the resulting interregnum and fear of Castilian annexation ended at the Battle of Aljubarrota in 1385, which placed the illegitimate Aviz line of John I on the throne.
zh: 葡萄牙勃艮第王朝由勃艮第的亨利开创，他是卡佩王室的支系成员，参加伊比利亚再征服运动，于1096年从莱昂国王阿方索六世手中受封葡萄牙伯爵，并娶其女特蕾莎。他们的儿子阿方索·恩里克斯于1128年在圣马梅德战役击败母亲一党，1139年奥里基战役后自立为王，教宗于1179年承认这个独立王国。后继诸王继续向南推进再征服：阿方索三世于1249年夺取阿尔加维，完成大业，自称葡萄牙与阿尔加维国王；阿方索二世召开第一次科尔特斯议会；1279至1325年在位的迪尼什一世确立葡萄牙语为法庭语言，创办后来落户科英布拉的大学，并在1297年的《阿尔卡尼塞斯条约》中划定与卡斯蒂利亚的边界。联姻把家族血脉带到欧洲各地，如王子费尔南多成为佛兰德斯伯爵，公主们则分别嫁入丹麦和阿拉贡王室。1337年在位的是阿方索四世，他后来在1340年派军与卡斯蒂利亚并肩作战于萨拉多河。王朝的终结始于1383年费尔南多一世去世，只留下嫁给卡斯蒂利亚国王胡安一世的女继承人比阿特丽丝；随之而来的空位期和被卡斯蒂利亚吞并的危机，最终在1385年的阿尔茹巴罗塔战役中了结，私生子出身的若昂一世率阿维什支系登上王位。

en: The Butlers are a Hiberno-Norman noble family descended from Theobald Walter, who served Prince John as Chief Butler of Ireland, the hereditary cup-bearer, around 1185; the family name comes from that office, and their arms bore three cups. Theobald was granted lands in eastern Munster, and in 1328 his descendant James Butler was created Earl of Ormond, with the earldom covering County Kilkenny and much of Tipperary, where the family held Clonmel and built Kilkenny Castle into their principal seat. For centuries the earls were pillars of English rule in Ireland, though several also won reputations as scholars. The fifth earl, a Lancastrian made Earl of Wiltshire in 1449, was attainted and executed after the Yorkist victory at Towton in 1461; the title was restored to his brother in 1476. In 1528 Piers Butler was pressured into surrendering the earldom to Thomas Boleyn, father of Anne Boleyn, but recovered it in 1538. The family reached its peak under James Butler, first Duke of Ormonde (1610-1688), who led the royalist cause through the Irish Confederate Wars and served twice as Lord Lieutenant of Ireland. His grandson, the second duke, was attainted as a Jacobite in 1715 and died in exile, after which the main line dwindled while junior branches kept many of the titles.
zh: 巴特勒家族是定居爱尔兰的诺曼贵族世家，始祖西奥博尔德·沃尔特约在1185年出任爱尔兰首席侍酒（Butler，即世袭掌酒官），侍奉约翰王子，家族姓氏便来自这一职务，其纹章上也绘有三只酒杯。西奥博尔德受封芒斯特东部的土地，1328年其后裔詹姆斯·巴特勒被封为奥蒙德伯爵，伯爵领涵盖基尔肯尼郡和蒂珀雷里的大部分地区，家族在那里领有克朗梅尔，并把基尔肯尼城堡经营成主要宅邸。数百年间，历代伯爵都是英格兰统治爱尔兰的支柱，其中几位还以博学著称。第五代伯爵是兰开斯特派，1449年受封威尔特伯爵，1461年约克派在陶顿取胜后被定罪处决；伯爵领于1476年还封给他的弟弟。1528年，皮尔斯·巴特勒被迫把伯爵头衔让给安妮·博林之父托马斯·博林，1538年又予恢复。家族在第一代奥蒙德公爵詹姆斯·巴特勒（1610—1688）时达到鼎盛：他在爱尔兰联盟战争期间领导保王派，并两度出任爱尔兰总督。其孙第二代公爵因参与詹姆斯党活动于1715年被定罪，流亡异乡，主支由此衰落，但各旁支仍保有大量头衔。

en: The Buzen Nagano were local lords of Buzen province in northern Kyushu, whose castle stood at Nagano in Kiku district. Family records name their founder as Taira no Yasumori, sixth son of Taira no Tokimori, a cousin of Taira no Kiyomori, who came down as governor of Buzen in 1157, built a castle at Nagano and took its name; thirteen generations of the house, of Kanmu Heishi blood, ruled the district for nearly four hundred and thirty years. In the Sengoku period the clan was swept into the wars between the Ōtomo and the Mōri for northern Kyushu and driven from its ancestral lands to Umagatake Castle on the border of Miyako and Nakatsu districts. After the Ōtomo collapse at the battle of Mimi-gawa in 1578 it joined Akizuki Tanezane and Takahashi Mototane in asserting independence, but when Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyushu campaign opened it submitted early to the army of Kuroda Yoshitaka, and Hideyoshi himself lodged at Umagatake in 1587. With Buzen granted to the Kuroda, the Nagano scattered as retainers of Kobayakawa Takakage, Tachibana Muneshige and Katō Kiyomasa; some branches ended in the Osaka campaigns, while others survived as mountain ascetics of Hiko-san or sake brewers in Kokura.
zh: 丰前长野氏是九州北部丰前国的国人领主，本据在企救郡长野城。据其家传，始祖是平清盛的堂兄弟平时盛的第六子平康盛，他于1157年以丰前国司身份下向当地，在长野筑城并以地名为姓；这支出自桓武平氏的家族在此统治近四百三十年，传了十三代。战国时代，长野氏被卷入大友氏与毛利氏争夺北九州的战乱，被迫离开本领，移往京都郡与仲津郡交界的马岳城。1578年大友氏在耳川之战惨败后，长野氏与秋月种实、高桥元种联手自立；但丰臣秀吉发起九州征伐时，它很快归降黑田孝高的大军，秀吉本人还于1587年驻跸马岳城。丰前被封给黑田氏后，长野氏一族四散，分别成为小早川隆景、立花宗茂和加藤清正的家臣，有的支族在大坂之阵中覆灭，也有人逃入英彦山成为修验者，或在小仓以酿酒为业。

en: The de' Cabanni were a courtier family of the Angevin Kingdom of Naples, founded by Raimondo de' Cabanni, a black African slave boy sold to the provost of the royal kitchens of the same name. The provost freed and baptized him, gave him his name and made him his heir; Raimondo then rose at the court of King Robert, marrying Philippa of Catania, governess of the royal children, in 1305. He was knighted, served as chamberlain to the Duke of Calabria and ended his career as seneschal of the royal hospice, the highest office of the household, accumulating fiefs such as Minervino and Mottola. When he died in 1334 he was buried with royal honours in Santa Chiara, the Angevin mausoleum. His sons Carlo and Perrotto became chamberlains, while Roberto became count of Eboli and grand seneschal of the realm. The family's fall was as swift as its rise: in 1345 Roberto, his mother Philippa and his niece Sancia were accused of murdering Andrew, Duke of Calabria, husband of Queen Joanna I. They were arrested and tortured; Philippa died in prison and Roberto was executed, though Raimondello, Carlo's son, was declared innocent in 1346. Giovanni Boccaccio made their sudden ruin the subject of the last chapter of his Fates of Illustrious Men.
zh: 德·卡巴尼家族是安茹王朝那不勒斯王国的廷臣家族，创始人拉伊蒙多原是一名黑人奴隶少年，被卖给同名的王室厨房总管。总管释放并为他施洗，让他承袭自己的名字和职位。拉伊蒙多在罗贝托国王的宫廷中发迹，1305年娶王室子女的女傅、卡塔尼亚的菲利帕为妻，后受封骑士，出任卡拉布里亚公爵的侍从长，最终升任王室总管府的最高职掌宫廷内侍长，并取得米内尔维诺、莫托拉等封地。1334年他去世时，以王室规格葬入安茹诸王的陵寝圣基亚拉教堂。他的儿子卡洛和佩罗托都做过侍从长，而罗贝托受封埃博利伯爵、任王国大内侍长。然而家族败亡与发迹同样迅速：1345年，罗贝托、其母菲利帕和侄女桑恰被控谋杀那不勒斯女王乔万娜一世的丈夫、卡拉布里亚公爵安德烈亚，三人被捕受刑，菲利帕死于狱中，罗贝托被处决，只有卡洛之子拉伊蒙代洛于1346年获判无罪。薄伽丘把这个家族的骤然倾覆写进了《名人的命运》最后一章。

en: The Gaetani, or Caetani, were a baronial family of the Papal States who traced their origin to the city of Gaeta. They first rose to prominence when two of their number became pope, Gelasius II in 1118 and Boniface VIII in 1294; Boniface enriched his kinsmen with the fiefs of Sermoneta and Bassiano, while his brother was made count of Caserta by the Angevin king of Naples. The Aquila branch took shape in 1297 when Giordano Roffredo Caetani married Giovanna dell'Aquila, heiress of the counts of Fondi, adding that county to the family's lands; his grandson later acquired Piedimonte and Gioia. The branch's most powerful figure was Onorato I Caetani, count of Fondi from 1348, Great Constable of Naples and senator of Rome, who backed the Avignon antipopes Clement VII and Benedict XIII during the Western Schism and was excommunicated for it; he died in 1400 after a failed assault on Rome. Feuds with the Colonna troubled the Roman Campagna for generations, and in 1500 Pope Alexander VI confiscated the Caetani fiefs for his daughter Lucrezia Borgia, though the family later recovered them.
zh: 加埃塔尼（又译卡埃塔尼）家族是教皇国的男爵世家，族源可追溯到加埃塔城。家族先后有两人当选教皇——1118年的格拉修二世和1294年的博义八世——从此显赫：博义八世把塞尔莫内塔、巴萨诺等封邑赏给族人，他的兄弟还被那不勒斯安茹国王封为卡塞塔伯爵。阿奎拉支系形成于1297年，焦尔达诺·罗弗雷多·加埃塔尼娶丰迪伯爵的女继承人乔万娜·德拉奎拉为妻，丰迪伯国随之并入家族产业，其孙又取得皮耶迪蒙特和焦亚。这一支最有权势的人物是奥诺拉托一世·加埃塔尼，他自1348年起任丰迪伯爵，还担任那不勒斯大统帅和罗马元老；西方教会大分裂期间他支持阿维尼翁的对立教宗克雷芒七世和本笃十三世，因此被绝罚，1400年在攻打罗马失败后不久死去。加埃塔尼家族与科隆纳家族的世仇搅动罗马坎帕尼亚数代之久；1500年教皇亚历山大六世没收其封邑赐给女儿卢克雷齐娅·博尔贾，但家族后来又收回了这些土地。

en: The Campbells, the greatest of the Highland clans, built their power in Argyll around Loch Awe. The name first appears in a charter of 1263, and an early marriage to the heiress of the O'Duines brought the lordship of Loch Awe, so the clan was first known as Clan O'Duine. Its chief Cailean Mór, Colin Campbell, was killed by the MacDougalls at the Red Ford in 1296, and every later chief has borne the Gaelic style MacCailean Mór. His son Sir Neil Campbell backed Robert the Bruce, fought at Bannockburn in 1314 and married the king's sister Mary, and the rewards of that loyalty made the family dominant in Argyll. Created Lord Campbell in 1445 and Earl of Argyll in 1457, the Campbells stepped into the vacuum left by the fall of the Lords of the Isles in 1493, beginning a long and bitter rivalry with the MacDonalds. The second earl died at Flodden in 1513. In the civil wars the eighth earl, made Marquess of Argyll in 1641, led the Covenanters until his defeat by Montrose at Inverlochy in 1645, and he was executed after the Restoration in 1661; his son, the ninth earl, was beheaded in 1685 after Argyll's Rising. Campbell soldiers led the Glencoe massacre of the MacDonalds in 1692, and the family was raised to Dukes of Argyll in 1701. Steadfast Hanoverians, the Campbells fought at Sheriffmuir in 1715, helped form the Black Watch in 1725 and stood on the government side at Culloden in 1746.
zh: 坎贝尔家族是高地最强大的氏族，势力围绕阿盖尔的洛赫奥湖建立。坎贝尔一名最早见于1263年的特许状；家族早年通过与奥杜因家族的女继承人联姻取得洛赫奥领主权，因此最初称奥杜因氏族。族长卡兰·莫尔，即科林·坎贝尔，于1296年在雷德渡口被麦克杜格尔家族所杀，此后历任族长都沿用盖尔称号麦卡兰·莫尔。其子尼尔·坎贝尔爵士追随罗伯特·布鲁斯，参加1314年的班诺克本战役并娶国王之妹玛丽为妻，这份忠诚换来的封赏使家族称雄阿盖尔。1445年受封坎贝尔勋爵，1457年受封阿盖尔伯爵；1493年群岛领主势力覆灭后，坎贝尔家族填补了权力真空，也开启了与麦克唐纳家族漫长而激烈的世仇。第二代伯爵1513年战死弗洛登。内战时期，1641年受封阿盖尔侯爵的第八代伯爵领导誓约派，1645年在因弗洛奇被蒙特罗斯击败，复辟后于1661年被处死；其子第九代伯爵也在1685年阿盖尔起事失败后被斩首。1692年，坎贝尔士兵主导了对麦克唐纳家族的格伦科屠杀；1701年家族晋封阿盖尔公爵。坎贝尔家族始终效忠汉诺威王室，1715年战于谢里夫缪尔，1725年参与组建黑卫士部队，1746年又站在政府一方参加卡洛登战役。

en: The Candarids were an Oghuz Turkish dynasty of the Kayı branch who ruled the Black Sea coast region the ancients called Paphlagonia, with their capitals at Kastamonu and the port of Sinop, from 1291 to 1461. The founder, Şemseddin Yaman Candar, was a senior commander of the Seljuk sultan Mesud II, who granted him Eflani after he rescued the sultan from Mongol captivity; his son Süleyman then conquered Kastamonu and added Safranbolu and Sinop, ruling as a vassal of the Ilkhanate until the death of Abu Sa'id in 1335. In 1337 Süleyman still reigned, though his sons Ibrahim and Ali were already rivals for the succession. Later beys fought Kadı Burhan al-Din of Sivas and the rising Ottomans: Bayezid I took Kastamonu in 1391, and after Timur's victory at Ankara in 1402 the dynasty recovered its lands under İsfendiyar Bey, from whom it is also called the Isfendiyar line. The Candarids navigated the Ottoman Interregnum and Murad II's reign as semi-independent vassals, until Mehmed the Conqueror captured Sinop in 1461 and annexed the beylik, the last of its rulers entering Ottoman service as provincial governors.
zh: 詹达尔王朝是出自乌古斯突厥卡伊部的王朝，1291至1461年间统治古称帕夫拉戈尼亚的黑海沿岸地区，先后以卡斯塔莫努和港口城市锡诺普为都。开国君主沙姆塞丁·亚曼·詹达尔本是塞尔柱苏丹梅苏德二世麾下大将，因将苏丹从蒙古人的囚禁中救出而受封埃夫拉尼；其子苏莱曼继而征服卡斯塔莫努，吞并萨夫兰博卢和锡诺普，并作为伊儿汗国藩属统治，直到1335年不赛因去世。1337年苏莱曼仍在位，不过他的儿子易卜拉欣和阿里已在争夺继承权。此后历代贝伊先后与锡瓦斯的卡迪·布尔汉丁和崛起的奥斯曼人交战：巴耶济德一世于1391年攻占卡斯塔莫努，1402年帖木儿安卡拉大捷后，王朝在伊斯凡迪亚尔贝伊治下复国，因此该朝也被称为伊斯凡迪亚尔王朝。詹达尔人在奥斯曼大空位期和穆拉德二世时代以半独立藩属的身份周旋，直到征服者穆罕默德于1461年攻陷锡诺普、吞并贝伊国，末代统治者转入奥斯曼麾下出任地方总督。

en: The Kavanaghs (Irish Caomhánach) are the senior surviving line of the Uí Ceinnselaig, the Gaelic dynasty that supplied the medieval kings of Leinster. Their surname was first taken by Domhnall Caomhánach, eldest son of Diarmait Mac Murchada, the king of Leinster who was deposed in 1167 and called in English help under Strongbow, opening the Anglo-Norman invasion of Ireland. Fostered at the monastery of St Caomhán in Wexford, Domhnall bore the nickname Caomhánach, meaning of Caomhán, and himself ruled as king of Leinster from 1171 to 1175. While the English crown held the coastal towns around Dublin, his descendants kept an independent Gaelic lordship in the Leinster interior and went on styling themselves kings of Leinster. Art mac Art MacMurrough-Kavanagh, who lived from 1357 to 1417, was the most formidable of these later kings, and Cahir Mac Art Kavanagh, who died in 1554, remained a major Leinster magnate on the eve of the Tudor conquest.
zh: 卡瓦纳家族（爱尔兰语 Caomhánach）是乌伊·琴塞拉伊格王朝留存的主支，这个盖尔王朝曾产生中世纪的伦斯特诸王。家族姓氏始于多姆纳尔·卡瓦纳，他是伦斯特国王迪尔梅德·麦克穆尔查达的长子；迪尔梅德于1167年被废后向以‘强弓’理查·德·克莱尔为首的英格兰势力求援，由此开启了盎格鲁-诺曼人对爱尔兰的入侵。多姆纳尔自幼在韦克斯福德的圣卡万修道院寄养，因而得到绰号‘卡瓦纳’，意为‘属于卡万的’，他本人于1171—1175年出任伦斯特国王。英格兰王室控制都柏林一带的沿海城镇后，他的后裔仍在伦斯特内地保有独立的盖尔领地，并继续自称伦斯特国王。其中最强势的是1357—1417年在世的阿尔特·麦克阿尔特·麦克穆罗-卡瓦纳；1554年去世的卡希尔·麦克阿尔特·卡瓦纳，则是都铎征服前夕伦斯特的重要豪强。

en: The direct House of Capet ruled France from Paris for 341 years. Its founder Hugh Capet, a great lord of the Ile-de-France, was elected king in 987 after the death of the last Carolingian, Louis V, and secured the crown for his son by having him crowned in his own lifetime, turning election into heredity. Early Capetian kings held little beyond the Ile-de-France and the Orleanais, but Philip II Augustus, reigning from 1180, broke the Plantagenet grip on western France, triumphed at Bouvines in 1214 and vastly enlarged the royal domain. Louis IX, later Saint Louis, built the machinery of royal justice and died on crusade at Tunis in 1270, while Philip IV the Fair quarrelled with Pope Boniface VIII, summoned the Estates-General in 1302 and suppressed the Knights Templar. His three sons Louis X, Philip V and Charles IV each died without a male heir, the infant John I living only days in 1316; when Charles IV died in 1328 the lawyers invoked the Salic law to bar his nephew Edward III of England, whose claim came through a woman, and gave the crown to the Valois cousin Philip VI, opening the Hundred Years' War. In 1337 the surviving Capets were women such as Joan II, queen of Navarre, and Isabella, mother of Edward III. The blood of Hugh Capet nevertheless carried on through cadet branches including Valois, Anjou, Bourbon, Burgundy and Courtenay, the last of which supplied Latin emperors at Constantinople.
zh: 卡佩直系王朝以巴黎为中心统治法国长达341年。其创立者于格·卡佩本是法兰西岛的大贵族，987年末代加洛林国王路易五世死后被推举为王，他又在生前就让儿子加冕，把选举制变成世袭制。早期卡佩国王实际只控制法兰西岛和奥尔良一带，但从1180年在位的腓力二世·奥古斯都开始，王室打破了金雀花家族对法国西部的控制，1214年在布汶获胜，王室领地大幅扩张。后来被封圣的路易九世建立起王室司法体系，1270年在十字军征途中死于突尼斯；“美男子”腓力四世则与教宗博义八世相争，1302年首次召开三级会议，并镇压了圣殿骑士团。他的三个儿子路易十世、腓力五世和查理四世都没有留下男嗣——婴儿国王让一世1316年只活了几天；1328年查理四世去世后，法学家援引萨利克法，排除了经女性一脉主张王位的外甥英王爱德华三世，把王冠交给瓦卢瓦堂亲腓力六世，百年战争由此开端。1337年在世的卡佩成员都是女性，如纳瓦拉女王让娜二世和爱德华三世之母伊莎贝拉。但于格·卡佩的血脉通过瓦卢瓦、安茹、波旁、勃艮第和库特奈等支系延续，其中库特奈支还出过君士坦丁堡的拉丁皇帝。

en: The dalle Carceri were a noble family of Verona whose members served as podestà of Verona and Mantua in the twelfth century before following the Fourth Crusade to Greece. In 1205 the island of Euboea, called Negroponte by the Venetians, was granted to three Veronese barons, Ravano and Giberto dalle Carceri and Pecoraro da Mercanuovo, who split it into three triarchies based at Oreos, Karystos and Chalkis. By 1209 Ravano had made himself sole lord and placed the island under Venetian protection; after his death in 1216 his widow, sons and nephews partitioned the triarchies among themselves, and the family supplied most of Negroponte's rulers for the next two centuries. The death of the hexarch Carintana dalle Carceri in 1255 sparked the War of the Euboeote Succession against William of Villehardouin of Achaea. In Italy the family's fortunes collapsed when they were found guilty of the murder of Mastino I della Scala in 1277 and banished from Verona. In Greece their line continued: Pietro was triarch and baron of Arcadia, Giovanni ruled Negroponte from 1340 to 1359, and Niccolò III was Duke of the Archipelago as well as lord of the island until his death in 1383. As the last triarch he left his territories to Venice, which ruled Euboea until the Ottoman conquest of Chalkis by Mehmed II in 1470.
zh: 达莱·卡尔切里家族是维罗纳的贵族，12世纪时族中多人出任维罗纳和曼托瓦的执政官，随后随第四次十字军东征前往希腊。1205年，被威尼斯人称作内格罗蓬特的埃维亚岛被封给拉瓦诺·达莱·卡尔切里、吉贝托·达莱·卡尔切里和佩科拉罗·达·梅尔卡诺沃三位维罗纳男爵，他们把岛屿划分为以奥雷奥斯、卡里斯托斯和哈尔基斯为中心的三个三头领地。到1209年，拉瓦诺已成为全岛之主，并把岛屿置于威尼斯的保护之下；1216年他死后，遗孀、子侄们瓜分了三头领地，此后近两个世纪里内格罗蓬特的统治者大多出自这个家族。1255年，六分领主卡林塔娜·达莱·卡尔切里之死引发了对抗亚该亚的纪尧姆·德·维勒阿杜安的埃维亚继承战争。在意大利本土，家族因1277年谋杀马斯蒂诺一世·德拉·斯卡拉被判有罪、逐出维罗纳而失势。希腊一支则延续下去：彼得罗任三头领主兼阿卡迪亚男爵，乔万尼于1340至1359年统治内格罗蓬特，尼古拉三世更身兼群岛公爵和岛屿领主，直至1383年去世。作为末代三头领主，他把领地留给威尼斯；威尼斯统治埃维亚直到1470年穆罕默德二世攻陷哈尔基斯。

en: The da Carrara, or Carraresi, were a noble family of Lombard origin from Carrara Santo Stefano near Padua, where one Luitolfo founded the abbey of Carrara in 1027. Loyal to the emperors and enriched by estates in the Paduan countryside, they rose with the commune: Jacopo I, called the Great, made himself lord of Padua in 1318. After the city fell to the Scaligeri of Verona, Marsilio da Carrara ousted the della Scala in 1338 and restored the family's rule, followed by Ubertino and Jacopo II. Under Francesco il Vecchio the Carraresi reached their height, taking Verona, Vicenza, Treviso, Feltre and Belluno and controlling much of the Veneto. Francesco was a noted patron of letters, close to Petrarch, who spent his retirement at the Carrara fief of Arquà and left him a Virgin painted by Giotto. In 1388 a coalition of Milan and Venice forced Francesco il Vecchio to abdicate, and he died a Visconti prisoner at Monza in 1393. His son Francesco Novello recovered Padua for a time, but the Venetians annexed the city in 1405, and in 1406 Francesco Novello and his sons were strangled in a Venetian prison; only Bishop Stefano escaped to Rome, where he died in 1448, and the elder line of the house became extinct.
zh: 卡拉拉家族（又称卡拉雷西）源出伦巴第人，祖居帕多瓦附近的圣斯德望卡拉拉，族人卢伊托尔福于1027年在那里创办卡拉拉修道院。家族世代效忠皇帝，凭帕多瓦乡间的大量地产致富，并随公社崛起：号称“大帝”的雅各布一世于1318年自立为帕多瓦领主。城市一度被维罗纳的斯卡拉家族占据，马尔西利奥·达·卡拉拉于1338年将其驱逐，恢复家族统治，其后由乌贝蒂诺和雅各布二世相继执政。老弗朗切斯科在位时家族达到鼎盛，攻取维罗纳、维琴察、特雷维索、费尔特雷和贝卢诺，控制了威尼托的大部分地区。他还是著名的文学赞助人，与彼特拉克交厚；彼特拉克晚年退隐于卡拉拉家族的封地阿尔夸，还把一幅乔托所绘的圣母像遗赠给他。1388年，米兰与威尼斯联手迫使老弗朗切斯科退位，他于1393年作为维斯孔蒂家族的囚徒死于蒙扎。其子小弗朗切斯科一度收复帕多瓦，但威尼斯人于1405年吞并该城；1406年，小弗朗切斯科和诸子在威尼斯狱中被缢死，只有主教斯德望逃到罗马，1448年死于当地，家族长支就此绝嗣。

en: The del Carretto were an old noble house of Liguria and Piedmont, descended through the Aleramici from Boniface del Vasto, whose son Henry, called il Guercio, held the march of Savona in the twelfth century and served the emperor Frederick Barbarossa, acting as imperial envoy at the Peace of Constance. In the wars of the communes the family lost sovereignty over Savona itself but entrenched itself in the marquisate of Finale, whose seat was Finalborgo, and from there fought on the imperial Ghibelline side against the Republic of Genoa and the Lombard League. Henry's sons Otto and Henry divided the inheritance around 1185, and their descendants multiplied into many branches holding fiefs along the western Ligurian Riviera and in lower Piedmont, some as vassals of Genoa, others of Asti or the dukes of Savoy. Otto del Carretto became podestà of Genoa and patronized the troubadours. Later members included Ilaria del Carretto, wife of Paolo Guinigi of Lucca, whose tomb was carved by Jacopo della Quercia, and Fabrizio del Carretto, who became Grand Master of the Knights Hospitaller in 1513. The marquisate of Finale kept its direct imperial status until 1602, when it passed to Philip III of Spain, and the family's independent power in Liguria came to an end.
zh: 德尔·卡雷托家族是利古里亚和皮埃蒙特的古老贵族，属阿莱拉米奇一系，先祖可追溯到博尼法乔·德尔·瓦斯托；其子绰号“斜眼”的恩里科于12世纪领有萨沃纳边区，效力于皇帝腓特烈一世（红胡子），并在《康斯坦茨和约》谈判中担任帝国使节。公社战争中，家族失去了对萨沃纳城本身的主权，却在以菲纳尔博尔戈为治所的菲纳莱侯爵国站稳脚跟，并由此站在皇帝党（吉伯林派）一边，同热那亚共和国和伦巴第同盟作战。1185年前后，恩里科的两个儿子奥托内和恩里科瓜分家业，后裔繁衍出众多支系，在利古里亚西海岸和下皮埃蒙特广有封邑，有的向热那亚称臣，有的依附阿斯蒂或萨伏依公爵。奥托内·德尔·卡雷托曾出任热那亚执政官并资助行吟诗人。后世名媛有伊拉莉亚·德尔·卡雷托，她嫁给卢卡的保罗·圭尼吉，其陵墓由雅各布·德拉·奎尔恰雕刻；法布里齐奥·德尔·卡雷托则于1513年当选医院骑士团大团长。菲纳莱侯爵国一直保有帝国直辖地位，直到1602年并入西班牙国王腓力三世的版图，家族在利古里亚的独立权势就此终结。

en: The Casali were a Tuscan noble family attested from 1217 in the mountains around Cortona, where their castles of Casale, Castel Giudeo and Castel Gherardo guarded the roads between the upper Tiber valley and the Valdichiana. After serving the communes of Cortona, Arezzo and Pisa, Guglielmino Casali became podestà of Arezzo in 1307 and later imperial vicar in Cortona. In 1325 Ranieri II Casali made himself lord of Cortona and Pierle, founding a signoria that lasted more than eighty years; his son Bartolomeo, who succeeded in 1351, was confirmed as imperial vicar by the Emperor Charles IV in 1355. The family also persuaded Pope John XXII to raise Cortona to a bishopric in 1325 and built the Palazzo Casali, later the seat of the town's Etruscan academy. The lordship ended in violence: in 1407 Aloigi Battista Casali murdered his uncle Francesco, who had governed since 1400, and two years later was overthrown and forced to surrender Cortona to King Ladislaus of Naples, who passed the town to Florence. Part of the family then settled in Bologna, where they entered the senatorial patriciate and later produced diplomats in papal and English service, notably Gregorio Casali, Henry VIII's ambassador at the Holy See.
zh: 卡萨利家族是托斯卡纳的贵族，1217年已见载于科尔托纳周围山区，其卡萨莱、朱代奥堡和盖拉尔多堡扼守着台伯河上游与瓦尔迪基亚纳之间的通路。在为科尔托纳、阿雷佐和比萨等公社效力之后，古列尔米诺·卡萨利于1307年出任阿雷佐执政官，后来又任科尔托纳的帝国代理人。1325年，拉涅利二世·卡萨利自立为科尔托纳和皮耶尔莱的领主，开创了延续八十余年的领主政权；1351年继位的其子巴尔托洛梅奥于1355年被皇帝查理四世确认为帝国代理人。1325年，家族还促成教皇约翰二十二世把科尔托纳升为主教区，并修建了卡萨利宫，这里后来成为当地伊特鲁里亚学院的馆址。领主政权最终在暴力中收场：1407年，阿洛伊吉·巴蒂斯塔·卡萨利谋杀了自1400年起执政的叔父弗朗切斯科，两年后自己也被推翻，被迫把科尔托纳交给那不勒斯国王拉迪斯劳，后者又将该城转手佛罗伦萨。家族一部分人随后定居博洛尼亚，跻身元老贵族阶层，后世还出了不少为教廷和英格兰效力的外交家，其中最著名的是亨利八世派驻教廷的大使格雷戈里奥·卡萨利。

en: The Castelbarco were the most powerful noble house of the medieval Prince-Bishopric of Trent, taking their name from Castel Barco near Chiusole and first recorded in the twelfth century as vassals of the bishops of Trent. Briano Castelbarco seized the castles of Avio and Lizzana and settled the family in the Vallagarina, and his son Azzone rebuilt Avio as a great residence and allied himself with Ezzelino III da Romano after the Emperor Frederick II suspended the bishopric in 1236. Guglielmo da Castelbarco, lord from 1265, took Castellano, Beseno and Castel Pietra, began the basilica of Sant'Anastasia in Verona, hosted Dante Alighieri and in 1310 held Bergamo for the Emperor Henry VII; he died without direct heirs in 1320 and his lands were split among his nephews. At its height in the mid-fourteenth century the family's domain stretched from the Vallagarina to the gates of Verona and Vicenza and west to Lake Garda. Hemmed in by Venice and the Habsburgs, the house then declined: in 1411 Azzone of Avio bequeathed his fiefs to the Venetian Republic, which destroyed the castles of Lizzana, Albano and Nomesino in 1441. After the battle of Agnadello in 1509 the valley passed under Austrian rule, and only the Gresta branch survived, eventually moving to Milan in the late seventeenth century.
zh: 卡斯泰尔巴科家族是中世纪特伦托主教区最有权势的贵族，得名于基乌索莱附近的巴尔科堡，12世纪时作为特伦托主教的封臣首见记载。布里亚诺·卡斯泰尔巴科夺取阿维奥堡和利扎纳堡，把家族安顿在瓦拉加里纳；其子阿佐内把阿维奥改建成宏大的居所，并在1236年皇帝腓特烈二世暂时取缔主教区后与埃泽利诺三世·达·罗马诺结盟。1265年继位的古列尔莫·达·卡斯泰尔巴科先后拿下卡斯特拉诺、贝塞诺和彼得拉堡，在维罗纳发起修建圣阿纳斯塔西娅教堂，还曾款待但丁·阿利吉耶里，1310年替皇帝亨利七世镇守贝加莫；他于1320年无直系继承人而终，领地由诸侄瓜分。14世纪中叶鼎盛时，家族疆域从瓦拉加里纳一直延伸到维罗纳和维琴察城下，西抵加尔达湖。此后家族在威尼斯与哈布斯堡之间勉力周旋、日渐衰落：1411年，阿维奥的阿佐内把封地遗赠给威尼斯共和国，威尼斯又于1441年拆毁利扎纳、阿尔巴诺和诺梅西诺诸堡。1509年阿尼亚代洛战役后，瓦拉加里纳转入奥地利统治，只有格雷斯塔支系幸存，最终于17世纪末迁往米兰。

en: The Castracani degli Antelminelli, better known as the Antelminelli, were a Ghibelline noble family of Lucca. In 1300 the ruling Black Guelphs exiled them with the rest of their faction, and the young Castruccio Castracani, orphaned at nineteen, made his name as a condottiero in Flanders, with the Visconti in Lombardy and, from 1313, under Uguccione della Faggiuola of Pisa. He helped take Lucca in 1314 and win the battle of Montecatini in 1315, and after an uprising freed him from Uguccione's prison he was elected lifelong lord of Lucca on 12 June 1316. Named imperial vicar in 1320 by Frederick of Austria, he later served the Emperor Louis the Bavarian, crushed the Florentines at Altopascio in 1325 and was made duke of Lucca, Pistoia, Volterra and Luni; in 1327 he took Pisa and became its imperial vicar, but died suddenly in 1328 at the height of his power. With his death the Guelphs triumphed and the family's dominance collapsed, its young children scattered among the courts of northern Italy. The Antelminelli lingered on in Lucca until 1596, when most of them were imprisoned or executed on a charge of conspiring with the Grand Duchy of Tuscany; only Alessandro Antelminelli escaped to London, where he lived under the name Amerigo Salvetti as Tuscany's agent. Niccolò Machiavelli later made Castruccio the subject of a celebrated biography.
zh: 卡斯特拉卡尼·德利·安泰尔米内利家族（常简称安泰尔米内利）是卢卡的吉伯林派贵族。1300年，执政的黑圭尔夫派把他们连同同党一并放逐；年轻的卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼十九岁成为孤儿，先后在佛兰德、伦巴第的维斯孔蒂麾下和1313年起比萨的乌古乔内·德拉·法焦拉帐下充当雇佣军队长，以此成名。他参与了1314年攻取卢卡和1315年蒙特卡蒂尼之战的胜利，后在一次起义中被人从乌古乔内的监狱救出，于1316年6月12日被选为卢卡终身领主。1320年奥地利的腓特烈任命他为帝国代理人，后来他转投皇帝巴伐利亚的路易，1325年在阿尔托帕肖大败佛罗伦萨人，受封卢卡、皮斯托亚、沃尔泰拉和卢尼公爵；1327年他攻占比萨并任当地帝国代理人，却在权势鼎盛的1328年暴卒。他死后圭尔夫派得势，家族霸业倾覆，年幼的子女散居意大利北部各宫廷。安泰尔米内利家族在卢卡余脉延续到1596年，当年多数族人因被控与托斯卡纳大公国密谋而被捕或处死，只有亚历山德罗·安泰尔米内利逃到伦敦，化名阿梅里戈·萨尔韦蒂充任托斯卡纳的驻英代表。尼科洛·马基雅维利后来为卡斯特鲁乔写过一部著名的传记。

en: The House of Castro was a great Castilian noble lineage, probably named after Castrojeriz in Burgos, whose first clearly attested member was the early twelfth-century count Fernando García de Hita, a vassal of Queen Urraca. Under Gutierre Fernández the family rivaled the House of Lara for influence at the court of Alfonso VIII. When the senior line failed, a cadet branch settled in Galicia, where it became the most powerful of the Galician nobility, seated at Monforte de Lemos and holding the counties of Lemos, Trastámara and Sarria. Pedro Fernández de Castro, called the Warrior, lord of Monforte de Lemos in the early fourteenth century, fathered Fernán Ruiz de Castro, praised as all the loyalty of Spain, and Inés de Castro, born in 1320, whose love affair with the future Peter I of Portugal ended when Afonso IV had her killed at Coimbra in 1355; Peter later had her remains crowned as queen. From 1456 the county of Lemos became a hereditary title in the family, raised to the first rank of grandees in 1520, and the seventeenth-century Great Count of Lemos and his uncle Cardinal Rodrigo de Castro Osorio were its most illustrious sons. Dying out for lack of heirs, the house saw Lemos pass to the House of Alba.
zh: 卡斯特罗家族是卡斯蒂利亚的大贵族世系，名称可能来自布尔戈斯的卡斯特罗赫里斯；可考的最早成员是12世纪初的伯爵费尔南多·加西亚·德·伊塔，他是女王乌拉卡的封臣。在古铁雷·费尔南德斯时代，该家族与拉腊家族在阿方索八世的宫廷中争权。长支绝嗣后，一支旁系定居加利西亚，成为当地最有权势的贵族，以蒙福特-德莱莫斯为据点，领有莱莫斯、特拉斯塔马拉和萨里亚诸伯国。14世纪初的蒙福特-德莱莫斯领主佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·卡斯特罗（绰号“战士”）生有被誉为“西班牙全部忠诚”的费尔南·鲁伊斯·德·卡斯特罗，以及1320年出生的伊内斯·德·卡斯特罗：她与后来的葡萄牙国王佩德罗一世相恋，却在1355年被阿方索四世下令杀害于科英布拉，佩德罗继位后又将她的遗骸加冕为王后。1456年起，莱莫斯伯爵成为该家族的世袭头衔，1520年位列第一等大公；17世纪的“伟大的莱莫斯伯爵”及其叔父枢机主教罗德里戈·德·卡斯特罗·奥索里奥是家族最显赫的人物。家族最终因无嗣而衰，莱莫斯伯国转入阿尔瓦家族之手。

en: The Counts of Celje, German Cilli, were the most powerful late medieval noble dynasty of present-day Slovenia. They began as the lords of Sanneck castle in Lower Styria, first recorded around 1130, and became Habsburg vassals in 1308. Frederick of Sanneck inherited the rich Heunburg estates in 1322 and the Celje lands in 1333, and in 1341 Emperor Louis IV raised him to the rank of imperial count, taking the title Cilli from Celje Castle. The family then built a web of more than twenty castles across Styria, Carinthia, Carniola and the Hungarian lands in Croatia. Count Ulrich I campaigned in Dalmatia with Louis I of Hungary in 1354, and his son William married Anna, daughter of Casimir III of Poland. Their fortune rose further at the 1396 Battle of Nicopolis, where Hermann II saved King Sigismund's life; Hermann received wide Croatian estates, and his daughter Barbara married Sigismund in 1405 and became Holy Roman Empress. In 1436 the counts were elevated to princes of the Empire, which drew them into war with the Habsburgs until an inheritance treaty in 1443. Ulrich II, regent of Hungary through his ward Ladislaus the Posthumous, succeeded John Hunyadi as captain general in 1456 but was murdered in Belgrade that November by Hunyadi's son. With Ulrich the male line died out, and the Habsburgs inherited all the Celje domains.
zh: 采利斯基家族（德语称采列伯爵）是今斯洛文尼亚境内中世纪晚期最有权势的贵族王朝。他们原是下施蒂里亚绍内克堡的领主，约1130年首见记载，1308年成为哈布斯堡附庸。绍内克的腓特烈于1322年继承富饶的霍因堡遗产，1333年又取得采列领地；1341年，皇帝路易四世将他升为帝国伯爵，头衔采列即得自采列城堡。此后家族通过联姻在施蒂里亚、克恩滕、卡尼奥拉以及匈牙利治下的克罗地亚构筑起二十多座城堡的领地网络。乌尔里希一世伯爵曾于1354年随匈牙利国王路易一世远征达尔马提亚，他的儿子威廉娶了波兰国王卡齐米日三世之女安娜。1396年尼科波利斯战役中，赫尔曼二世救了国王西吉斯蒙德一命，家族运势更盛：赫尔曼获封克罗地亚大片地产，女儿芭芭拉于1405年嫁给西吉斯蒙德，后来成为神圣罗马帝国皇后。1436年，采列伯爵受封帝国亲王，因此与哈布斯堡开战，直到1443年签订继承条约。乌尔里希二世借受监护人“遗腹子”拉迪斯劳斯之手成为匈牙利摄政，1456年继匈雅提·亚诺什出任大将军，却在同年11月于贝尔格莱德被匈雅提之子派人刺杀。乌尔里希一死，男系断绝，采列的全部领地依约落入哈布斯堡之手。

en: The Celsi were a patrician family of Venice, traditionally said to have come from Ravenna, whose name first appears in the documents in 1122. Paolo Celsi took part in the election of the doge Orio Mastropiero in 1178, and Pietro Celsi commanded galleys in Enrico Dandolo's reconquest of Zara in 1202, while Nicolò Celsi served as Procurator of Saint Mark from 1268. The house usually played only a modest part in Venetian public life, so the election of Lorenzo Celsi as doge in 1361, after he had led Venetian fleets against Genoa, came as a surprise. As doge he crushed the revolt of Saint Titus in Crete, whose leaders had tried to set up an independent state, and he died in office in 1365. Later Celsi mostly held colonial and provincial posts, though three brothers of the house fought in the campaign that ended at the Battle of Lepanto in 1571. The family line died out with Francesco Maria Celsi in 1789.
zh: 切尔西家族是威尼斯的贵族世家，传统上认为来自拉文纳，其名字最早见于1122年的文献。保罗·切尔西参与了1178年总督奥里奥·马斯特罗皮耶罗的选举，彼得罗·切尔西于1202年在恩里科·丹多洛收复扎拉的战事中指挥桨帆船舰队，尼科洛·切尔西从1268年起担任圣马可行政长官。该家族在公共事务中向来角色有限，因此洛伦佐·切尔西在率舰队与热那亚作战之后于1361年当选总督，出乎许多人意料。任内他镇压了克里特岛首领试图建立独立政权的圣提多起义，并于1365年卒于任上。此后切尔西家族成员多出任殖民地和外省职务，不过家族的三兄弟参加了1571年勒班陀海战前的战事。1789年，随着弗朗切斯科·马里亚·切尔西去世，家族绝嗣。

en: The House of la Cerda was the senior cadet line of the Castilian House of Burgundy, springing from Infante Ferdinand de la Cerda, eldest son of Alfonso X the Wise, nicknamed for the tuft of hair, a cerda or bristle, he carried on his chest. Ferdinand died before his father in 1275, leaving a young son, Alfonso de la Cerda, whom Alfonso X named his heir ahead of his second son Sancho. Sancho revolted and took the crown as Sancho IV, and after years of civil war the arbitration of Torrellas in 1304 finally barred Alfonso, called the Disinherited, and his descendants from the Castilian throne. Driven into exile, the family prospered in France: Luis de la Cerda, count of Talmont and admiral of France, was granted the Canary Islands as Prince of Fortuna by the pope in 1344, while his kinsman Charles de la Cerda, known as Charles of Spain, became the favourite of John II, commanded the Castilian galleys at Winchelsea in 1350 and was made Constable of France and Count of Angoulême, only to be murdered at L'Aigle in 1354 by men of Charles II of Navarre. In Castile the lineage remained among the foremost nobility; its heiress Isabel de la Cerda married the first Count of Medinaceli, and through her the house became the stem of the Dukes of Medinaceli, one of Spain's grandest aristocratic houses.
zh: 德·拉·塞尔达家族是卡斯蒂利亚勃艮第王室的长支旁系，始祖为“智者”阿方索十世的长子费尔南多·德·拉·塞尔达——他因胸口生来有一撮硬毛（西班牙语“塞尔达”意为鬃毛）而得此绰号。费尔南多于1275年先于父王去世，留下幼子阿方索·德·拉·塞尔达；阿方索十世欲立这个孙子为储，次子桑治遂起兵篡位，即桑治四世。经过多年内战，1304年的托雷利亚斯仲裁最终剥夺了被称为“被剥夺者”的阿方索及其后裔的卡斯蒂利亚王位继承权。家族成员流亡法国后反而飞黄腾达：塔尔蒙伯爵、法国海军上将路易斯·德·拉·塞尔达于1344年被教宗封为加那利群岛的“福尔图纳亲王”；其同族夏尔·德·拉·塞尔达（人称“西班牙的夏尔”）成为约翰二世的宠臣，1350年在温奇尔西指挥卡斯蒂利亚桨船队，后任法国统帅兼昂古莱姆伯爵，却在1354年于莱格尔被纳瓦拉国王夏尔二世的部下刺杀。留在卡斯蒂利亚的支系仍位列一等贵族，女继承人伊莎贝尔·德·拉·塞尔达嫁给首任梅迪纳塞利伯爵，家族由此成为梅迪纳塞利公爵的源头，后者是西班牙最显赫的贵族门第之一。

en: The Ceva were a branch of the Aleramici, the Frankish-descended marquises of Piedmont and Liguria, and took their name from the town of Ceva at the foot of the Apennines. When the lands of Bonifacio del Vasto were divided among his sons, Ceva passed to Anselmo, whose son Guglielmo is the first marquis clearly attested in the documents. Guglielmo I pursued an expansionist policy between the rival communes of Alba and Asti, but after his death the marquisate was split into shares held jointly by his many sons, which weakened it and led to frequent changes of allegiance. In 1257 the commune of Alba forced the marquises under its hegemony, and in 1260 they transferred their homage to Charles I of Anjou. From 1295 they were repeatedly vassals of Asti, and for two centuries the marquisate passed back and forth between the Visconti, the House of Orléans and the dukes of Savoy, who sometimes kept Ceva descendants on as governors. In 1531 the Emperor Charles V assigned the marquisate definitively to the Duchy of Savoy.
zh: 切瓦家族是阿莱拉米奇家族的支系，后者是源出法兰克人、统治皮埃蒙特和利古里亚的侯爵世家；切瓦一支得名于亚平宁山麓的切瓦城。博尼法乔·德尔瓦斯托的领地被诸子分割时，切瓦分给了安塞尔莫，其子古列尔莫是文献中第一位可考的侯爵。古列尔莫一世在阿尔巴和阿斯蒂两个敌对城邦之间推行扩张政策，但他死后侯国被众多儿子分成份额共同掌管，国势削弱，盟属也频繁改换。1257年，阿尔巴城邦迫使切瓦诸侯接受其霸权，1260年他们转而向安茹的查理一世效忠。从1295年起，他们屡次沦为阿斯蒂的附庸，此后两百年间侯国在维斯孔蒂家族、奥尔良家族和萨伏依公爵之间反复易手，萨伏依有时仍留用切瓦后裔担任总督。1531年，皇帝查理五世将切瓦侯国最终划归萨伏依公国。

en: The House of Chalon was a Burgundian noble family and a cadet branch of the Ivrea line of the counts of Burgundy. It took its name from Chalon-sur-Saone, inherited by its founder John the Old through his mother Beatrice of Chalon. Born around 1190, John was count of Auxonne and Chalon, and in 1237 he exchanged those lands with Duke Hugh IV of Burgundy for the lordship of Salins in the Free County, whose salt works made his fortune; he ringed his new domains with castles and kept his court at Nozeroy. Of his sixteen children, the eldest Hugh married the heiress Adelaide of Merania and became count palatine of Burgundy, a second son founded the Chalon-Auxerre line that held the counties of Auxerre and Tonnerre, and a younger son from his third marriage began the Chalon-Arlay branch at Arlay. Other children carried the house into Montbeliard and the bishoprics of Liege and Besancon. In 1337 its branches therefore stretched on both sides of the border between France and the Empire, from the Jura and Vaud to Auxerre and Montbeliard. The Arlay lords proved the most enduring: when John III of Chalon-Arlay married Mary des Baux in 1386 the principality of Orange came to the house, and his descendant Rene of Chalon, the last male of the line, left Orange on his death in 1544 to his cousin William of Nassau, the future William the Silent, thus begetting the House of Orange-Nassau.
zh: 沙隆家族是勃艮第的贵族世家，为勃艮第伯爵伊夫雷亚世系的支系，得名于创始人“长者”让经母亲贝亚特丽丝·德·沙隆继承的索恩河畔沙隆。让约生于1190年，身兼欧索讷和沙隆伯爵，1237年他把这些土地与勃艮第公爵于格四世交换，取得自由伯国境内的萨兰领地——当地的盐矿为他带来巨额财富；他在新领地周围广建城堡，常驻诺兹鲁瓦。他有十六个子女：长子于格娶梅拉尼亚女继承人阿代拉伊德，成为勃艮第行宫伯爵；次子开创沙隆-欧塞尔支系，领有欧塞尔和托内尔伯国；第三次婚姻所生的幼子则在阿尔莱建立沙隆-阿尔莱支系。其他子女还把家族带入蒙贝利亚尔以及列日和贝桑松主教区。因此到1337年，家族各支已横跨法兰西与帝国边境，从汝拉、沃到欧塞尔和蒙贝利亚尔都有领地。其中阿尔莱领主一脉延续最久：1386年沙隆-阿尔莱的让三世娶玛丽·德斯·博，奥兰治亲王国随之归入家族；其后代、家族最后一位男嗣勒内·德·沙隆于1544年去世时把奥兰治留给表亲拿骚的威廉（即后来的“沉默者”威廉），奥兰治-拿骚家族由此发端。

en: The Champa dynasty denotes the restored line of Varman kings who ruled from Vijaya after the Khmer occupation of 1190 to 1220. When the Khmers evacuated in 1220, Prince Angsaraja of Turai-vijaya was crowned at Vijaya in 1226 as Jaya Paramesvaravarman II, and spent his reign rebuilding irrigation works, lingas and the temple of Po Nagar. Indravarman V, who seized power in 1257, faced the Yuan Mongol invasion of 1282: he and his son Harijit withdrew into the mountains and wore down General Sogetu's army until the Mongols withdrew in 1285. Harijit reigned as Jaya Simhavarman III from 1288, and in 1306 married the Vietnamese princess Huyền Trân, ceding two northern districts to Dai Viet as the bride price. His son Jaya Simhavarman IV tried to win them back from 1307 but was defeated in 1312 and died a prisoner in Annam, after which the Tran dynasty installed a puppet governor and the old Sanskrit epigraphy of Champa fell silent. A later member of the line, Maha Sawa, claimed the throne in 1342 on the death of his brother-in-law Che Anan and ruled until 1360, while the dispossessed heir Jamo fled to the Tran court for help.
zh: 占婆王朝指的是1190至1220年高棉占领结束后，在毗阇耶复国的跋摩王统。1220年高棉人撤离，都来毗阇耶的王子安萨拉阇于1226年在毗阇耶加冕，称阇耶波罗密首罗跋摩二世，在位期间修复水利、林伽神像和波那加神庙。1257年夺位的因陀罗跋摩五世遭遇元朝入侵：1282年，他与王子诃里吉特退入山区，以游击战消耗唆都的大军，直到1285年蒙古人退兵。诃里吉特后来即位，即1288年起在位的阇耶僧伽跋摩三世（制旻）；1306年他迎娶越南玄珍公主，以割让北部两个州为聘礼。他的儿子阇耶僧伽跋摩四世（制至）1307年起试图收复失地，1312年兵败被俘，死于安南国中；陈朝随后扶植傀儡长官统治，占婆的梵文碑铭传统也就此中断。该世系后来的成员茶和布底于1342年趁姐夫制阿难去世夺取王位，统治到1360年；被剥夺继承权的王子亚莫则逃往陈朝求援。

en: The house of Champaner takes its name from the fortified town of that name in eastern Gujarat, which local tradition traces to a Bhil raja called Champa and, in another telling, to the eighth-century Chavda king Vanraj, who named it after his general Champa. By the fourteenth century the principality was held by Khichi Chauhan Rajputs from the great cliff-fort of Pavagadh above the town. The kingdom stretched between Dahod and Godhra in the Rewa Kantha hills, and its awkward position between the Gujarat and Malwa sultanates shaped all its later history: the rajas paid tribute to Ahmedabad while leaning on Malwa whenever Gujarat pressed them. In 1416 Raja Trimbakdas joined the Rajput confederacy that backed Malwa's Hoshang Shah against Ahmad Shah I, and in 1449 Rawal Gangadas was beaten in the field and driven into Pavagadh by Muhammad Shah II, saved only by a Malwa diversion. The end came under Mahmud Begada, who marched out in 1483 and pressed the siege of Pavagadh for twenty months; a relief attempt by Ghiyas Shah of Malwa failed, and the fort fell in November 1484.
