The last raja, Jai Singh, was captured and executed, his lands were annexed to Gujarat, and Mahmud rebuilt the town as Muhammadabad, his new capital. In 1535 the Mughal emperor Humayun stormed the same cliffs when he chased Bahadur Shah out of Gujarat.
zh: 昌帕内尔家族得名于古吉拉特东部的同名要塞城镇尚庞；当地传说把建城归于一位名叫占巴的比尔人罗阇，另一说则归于8世纪的查夫达国王万罗阇，他以部将占巴之名为城命名。到14世纪，该土邦已由基奇·乔诃那拉杰普特人据守，凭借城镇上方悬崖上的巴瓦加德堡御敌。王国在雷瓦坎塔丘陵地带上横跨达霍德与戈德拉之间，夹在古吉拉特和马尔瓦两苏丹国之间，这一尴尬处境决定了它后来的全部历史：罗阇们向艾哈迈达巴德纳贡，一旦古吉拉特攻来便依靠马尔瓦周旋。1416年罗阇特林巴卡斯加入拉杰普特同盟，支持马尔瓦的胡尚沙对抗艾哈迈德沙一世；1449年拉瓦尔·甘加达斯在野战中被穆罕默德沙二世击败、退入巴瓦加德堡，全靠马尔瓦出兵牵制才得以保全。终结在马哈茂德·贝加达手中：他于1483年出师，围攻巴瓦加德堡长达二十个月，马尔瓦吉亚斯沙的救援失败，堡垒终在1484年11月陷落。末代罗阇杰·辛格被俘处死，领地并入古吉拉特，马哈茂德把城镇重建为新都穆罕默达巴德。1535年莫卧儿皇帝胡马雍追击巴哈杜尔沙出古吉拉特时，也曾攀上这同一处悬崖攻占堡垒。

en: The Champlitte were a knightly house of Franche-Comté, descended from the counts of Champagne of the House of Blois. Their ancestor Odo I, born in 1123 to Count Hugh of Champagne but denied legitimacy, was raised by his Burgundian mother's kin and became lord of Champlitte, near Vesoul; his marriage to Sibylle de La Ferté also brought the family the viscountcy of Dijon. His sons joined the Fourth Crusade: Odo II died at the siege of Constantinople in 1204, while William of Champlitte conquered the Morea together with Geoffrey of Villehardouin and in 1205 founded the Principality of Achaea as its first Frankish prince. William died in Apulia in 1209 while returning to France, and his heirs failed to secure the succession, so Achaea passed to the Villehardouin. The family's Burgundian lordship of Champlitte was later inherited by a younger branch of the house of Vergy.
zh: 尚普利特家族是弗朗什-孔泰的骑士世家，为布卢瓦家族香槟伯爵一脉的幼支。始祖厄德一世生于1123年，是香槟伯爵于格之子却不被承认婚生地位，由勃艮第的母族抚养成人，成为沃苏勒附近尚普利特的领主；他与西比勒·德·拉费尔泰的婚姻又为家族带来第戎子爵之位。他的儿子们参加了第四次十字军东征：厄德二世于1204年死于君士坦丁堡围城战，威廉·德·尚普利特则与若弗鲁瓦·德·维尔阿杜安联手征服摩里亚，于1205年建立亚该亚公国并成为首任法兰克亲王。威廉于1209年在返回法国途中死于普利亚，继承人未能接掌权位，亚该亚转入维尔阿杜安家族之手。家族在勃艮第的尚普利特领地后来由韦尔吉家族的一支幼支继承。

en: The Chand dynasty rose in Kumaon after the collapse of the Katyuri kingdom. Tradition calls Som Chand its seventh-century founder, but inscriptions suggest the family held power only from around 1019, when a Rajput prince related to the rajas of Kannauj migrated to the hills amid the Ghaznavid invasions and set himself up at Champawat, calling his state Kurmanchal. From that mountain capital the Chands ruled Kumaon through the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, gradually rising from feudatories to kings; Ratan Chand, ruling from 1450 to 1488, settled five kindred Rajput clans in his lands to consolidate them. In 1563 Raja Kalyan Chand moved the capital to the new town of Almora, and his son Rudra Chand, ruling from 1565 to 1597, seized Sira, repeatedly invaded Garhwal and in 1587 travelled to Lahore to offer obedience to Akbar, who named him among the great landlords of India in the Akbarnama. His son Lakshmi Chand built the Bagnath temple at Bageshwar in 1602. In 1744 the Rohilla chief Ali Mohammed Khan stormed Almora and held it for seven months before being bought off, and troops under Dip Chand later fought beside the Rohillas at the Third Battle of Panipat in 1761. Weakened by internal strife, the kingdom lost its plains holdings, and in 1790 Gorkha armies of Nepal crossed the Kali River and drove out the last raja, Mahendra Chand. After twenty-four years of Gorkha rule, British forces captured Almora in April 1815, and the Treaty of Sugauli in 1816 incorporated Kumaon into British India.
zh: 卡秋里王国衰落后，昌德王朝在库马翁兴起。传统说法以7世纪的索姆·昌德为开国者，但铭文显示其家族实际掌权要晚到11世纪初，约1019年前后：一位与曲女城罗阇有亲缘的拉杰普特王子趁伽色尼入侵之乱避入山区，在金巴瓦特立足，定国名为俱尔门遮罗。13至14世纪，昌德诸王以这座山城为都，从封臣逐步成为独立君王；1450至1488年在位的拉坦·昌德还以封地安置五个同族拉杰普特氏族以巩固疆土。1563年罗阇卡尔扬·昌德把都城从金巴瓦特迁往新建的阿尔莫拉城；其子鲁陀罗·昌德于1565至1597年在位，夺取锡拉、屡次进攻加瓦尔，并于1587年前往拉合尔向莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴朝觐，《阿克巴本纪》称他为印度的大封建主之一。其后的拉克希米·昌德于1602年在巴盖什沃尔修建巴格纳特神庙。1744年罗希拉酋长阿里·穆罕默德汗攻陷阿尔莫拉，盘踞七个月后收受赎金退兵；后来迪普·昌德又率昌德军队随罗希拉人参加1761年的第三次帕尼帕特战役。在内争中削弱的王国丢掉了平原领地，1790年尼泊尔的廓尔喀军队渡过卡利河，赶走末代罗阇马亨德拉·昌德。经过二十四年廓尔喀统治，英军于1815年4月攻占阿尔莫拉，1816年的《苏高利条约》将库马翁并入英属印度。

en:
The Chanda dynasty was the Gond royal house of the kingdom of Chanda in the Wardha river country of present-day eastern Maharashtra. The Gonds under Kol Bhill first overthrew the older Mana rulers of Wairagarh, and Bhim Ballal Singh of the Atram clan then subdued the local chiefs and founded the Gond kingdom by 1320, ruling from Sirpur with the hill fortress of Manikgarh as his stronghold. Later kings adopted the title Shah in place of Singh, and Khandkya Ballal Shah, who reigned from 1472, built the fort of Ballarpur and founded the city of Chandrapur, which became the dynasty's capital.

The Chanda kings developed irrigation tanks and the first regular revenue system among the Gond states. Recorded as fully independent in the Ain-i-Akbari, they later became Mughal feudatories within the Berar Subah and rivals of the neighbouring Deogarh kingdom. Maratha power ended the line: Raghoji I Bhonsle of Nagpur forced a treaty in 1749 that took two-thirds of the revenue, and in 1751 he defeated the rebellious Nilkanth Shah and imprisoned him in Ballarpur Fort, bringing Gond rule at Chanda to an end.
zh:
钱达王朝是冈德人的王室，统治今马哈拉施特拉东部瓦尔达河流域的钱达王国。冈德人在科尔·比尔率领下先推翻了瓦伊拉加尔的马纳旧统治者，随后阿特拉姆氏族的比姆·巴拉尔·辛格征服各地小首领，于1320年前建立冈德王国，以西尔布尔为都、山城马尼加尔为要塞。后来的君主改用“沙阿”称号取代“辛格”，1472年即位的坎德克亚·巴拉尔·沙阿修建了巴拉尔布尔要塞，并创建钱德拉布尔城，该城后来成为王朝都城。

钱达诸王兴修蓄水池灌溉，建立了冈德诸国中第一套正规的税收制度。《阿克巴政典》记载它曾是完全独立的政权，后来成为莫卧儿贝拉尔省辖下的附庸，并与邻邦德奥加尔长期对立。马拉塔势力终结了这支王统：那格浦尔的拉戈吉一世·邦斯勒于1749年逼签条约，夺去三分之二的赋税；1751年他又击败起兵反抗的尼尔坎特·沙阿，将其囚禁于巴拉尔布尔堡，钱达的冈德统治就此告终。

en: The Chandel, also written Chandela, are a Rajput clan of the lunar lineage whose families ruled several kingdoms in northern India; its most celebrated branch were the Chandelas of Jejakabhukti, masters of Bundelkhand from the tenth to the thirteenth century. A younger line founded the hill state of Kahlur, later called Bilaspur: Raja Bir Chand established it around 697, and Raja Kahal Chand built Kahlur Fort around 900, after which the dynasty was also known as the Kahluria. Its rajas long kept their independence in the Punjab Himalaya, moving their capital to the new town of Bilaspur under Dip Chand (r. 1663-1665). Raja Bhim Chand defeated a Mughal army at the Battle of Nadaun and abdicated in 1692 to live as an ascetic, while his son Ajmer Chand made a string of neighbouring hill states tributary. In the eighteenth century Bilaspur became a patron of the Kangra painting style, and in 1815 Raja Mahan Chand placed the state under British protection as one of the Simla Hill States.
zh: 钱代尔（又译昌德拉）是月族世系的拉杰普特氏族，各支在北印度建立过多个王国，最显赫的一支是10至13世纪统治本德尔坎德的杰贾卡布克蒂昌德拉人。另有一支迁入山区，开创了后称比拉斯布尔的贾罗尔邦：罗阇比尔·昌德约于697年立国，罗阇卡哈尔·昌德约在900年修筑贾罗尔堡，王朝此后又称卡劳里亚。历代罗阇在旁遮普喜马拉雅山区长期保持独立，迪普·昌德（1663—1665年在位）将都城迁至新建的比拉斯布尔城。罗阇比姆·昌德在纳道恩战役中击败莫卧儿军队，1692年退位修行；其子阿杰梅尔·昌德迫使一连串邻近山邦纳贡称臣。18世纪时，比拉斯布尔成为冈格拉画派艺术家的赞助之地，1815年罗阇马汉·昌德将本邦置于英国保护之下，成为西姆拉山邦之一。

en: The Chandelas were a Rajput dynasty of the Chandel clan who ruled Jejakabhukti, the historic Bundelkhand of central India, from the early ninth to the fourteenth century. Founded by Nannuka around 831 as a small chiefdom centered on Khajuraho, the family began as feudatories of the Gurjara-Pratiharas of Kannauj before Yashovarman made it virtually independent and Dhanga raised it to sovereign power. Its kings warred in turn with the Paramaras of Malwa and the Kalachuris of Tripuri, and built the Hindu and Jain temples of Khajuraho together with the forts of Kalinjar, Ajaigarh and Mahoba. Raids by the Ghaznavids and Ghurids weakened the kingdom from the eleventh century; Prithviraj Chauhan sacked Mahoba around 1183, and in 1202 Qutb al-Din Aibak invaded and received the surrender of the last powerful king Paramardi. Reduced to minor chiefs, the later Chandelas lost ground to the rising Bundelas and Baghelas; Hammiravarman, ruling from about 1288 to 1311, no longer used the imperial title. A branch kept the fort of Kalinjar until its ruler fell fighting Sher Shah Suri in 1545.
zh: 旃提罗是昌德尔氏族的拉杰普特王朝，9世纪初至14世纪统治中印度的杰贾卡布克蒂，即历史上的本德尔肯德地区。王朝由南努卡约于831年建立，最初是以克久拉霍为中心的小首领邦，臣属卡瑙杰的瞿折罗-波罗提诃罗王朝；后来亚索瓦尔曼使其实际独立，丹加更把它提升为主权王国。历代国王先后与马尔瓦的帕拉马拉王朝、特里普里的卡拉丘里王朝交战，并修建了克久拉霍的印度教与耆那教神庙群，以及卡林贾尔、阿杰伊加尔和默霍巴等要塞。11世纪起，伽色尼和古尔势力的入侵不断削弱王国；约1183年普利色毗罗阇·乔汉洗劫默霍巴，1202年库特布丁·艾伊拜克大举来攻，末代强势君主帕马尔迪被迫投降。此后旃提罗人沦为小首领，在崛起的班德拉和婆稽罗家族面前节节失地；约1288至1311年在位的哈米拉瓦尔曼已不敢使用帝王头衔。其中一支据守卡林贾尔要塞，直到其首领在1545年与舍尔沙·苏尔作战时阵亡。

en: The Charltons were a Shropshire knightly family holding Charlton near Wellington, who rose through royal service and a Welsh inheritance. John Charlton, born in 1268, entered the royal household as a page under Edward I and became a knight and chamberlain to Edward II. In 1309 he married Hawys Gadarn, heiress of the marcher lordship of Powys, the former principality of Powys Wenwynwyn; through her he gained Welshpool and built Powis Castle between 1310 and 1315, and in 1313 he was summoned to Parliament as the first Baron Charlton, commonly called Lord of Powis. He governed border castles against Welsh rebels, joined the Earl of Lancaster's rising against the Despensers in 1321 and was pardoned the next year, and in 1326 arrested the Earl of Arundel for Queen Isabella. In 1337 Edward III made him Chief Justiciar of Ireland, while his brother Thomas, Bishop of Hereford, became Irish Lord Chancellor. John died in 1353 and was buried at Shrewsbury. His direct line held the barony until the fifth baron's death in 1421, when the title fell into abeyance.
zh: 查尔顿家族是什罗普郡的骑士家族，在惠灵顿附近的查尔顿持有领地，靠王室服役和一桩威尔士遗产联姻发迹。约翰·查尔顿生于1268年，在爱德华一世时以侍童身份进入王室，后来成为爱德华二世的骑士和宫廷总管。1309年他娶波伊斯边境领地的女继承人哈维斯·加达恩为妻，该领地即从前的波伊斯·温温温亲王国；凭借妻子他取得威尔士浦，并在1310至1315年间修建波伊斯城堡，1313年被召入议会，成为第一代查尔顿男爵，通常被称作波伊斯勋爵。他镇守边境城堡镇压威尔士叛乱，1321年参加兰开斯特伯爵反对勒德斯潘塞父子的起事，次年获赦；1326年又奉伊莎贝拉王后之命逮捕阿伦德尔伯爵。1337年爱德华三世任命他为爱尔兰最高司法官，他的兄弟、赫里福德主教托马斯则出任爱尔兰大法官。约翰于1353年去世，葬在什鲁斯伯里。他的直系后裔保有男爵爵位，直到1421年第五代男爵去世，爵位进入搁置状态。

en: The lords of Châteauvillain were a younger branch of the Champenois house of Broyes. Hugh III of Broyes built the castle of Châteauvillain, near Chaumont-en-Bassigny, in 1160 and favoured it as his residence; his younger son Simon, who died around 1260, inherited the lordship and took its name. The family also held Arc-en-Barrois, Baye and Pleurs. Jean I, called the Blind, a companion of Saint Louis on the Seventh Crusade, granted the town a charter of liberties in 1286 before abdicating his titles to his son. Simon II of Châteauvillain married Marie de Dampierre around 1285, founded the chartered village of Leffonds in the same year, and was summoned by Philip the Fair to Arras in 1303 for the war against the Flemish revolt. The lordship was later raised to a county: it was bought in 1620 by Nicolas de L'Hospital and in 1699 by Louis de Bourbon, comte de Toulouse, whose family held it as a duchy-peerage from 1703.
zh: 沙托维兰领主家族是香槟地区布鲁瓦家族的一支幼支。布鲁瓦的于格三世于1160年在肖蒙昂巴西尼附近修建沙托维兰城堡，并偏爱在此居住；他的幼子西蒙（约1260年去世）继承了这块领地并以地名为家族名。家族还领有阿尔克昂巴鲁瓦、拜和普勒尔。被称为“盲人”的让一世曾随圣路易参加第七次十字军东征，他在1286年向城镇居民颁发自由特许状，后来又把头衔让给儿子。西蒙二世约于1285年娶当皮埃尔的玛丽为妻，同年创建获得特许状的勒丰村，并在1303年被美男子腓力召到阿拉斯参加镇压佛兰德斯叛乱的战争。这块领地后来升为伯国，1620年由尼古拉·德·洛皮塔尔买下，1699年转入图卢兹伯爵路易·德·波旁之手，其家族自1703年起以公爵兼法兰西贵族的身份持有它。

en: The House of Châtillon was one of the great noble houses of medieval France, taking its name from Châtillon-sur-Marne in Champagne, where its ancestors held a castle of the counts of Champagne from the ninth century. It gave the Latin Church Pope Urban II, born Odo of Châtillon, who preached the First Crusade at Clermont in 1095, and Raynald of Châtillon, prince of Antioch and lord of Oultrejordain, executed by Saladin after the battle of Hattin in 1187. Gaucher de Châtillon served as seneschal of Burgundy and fought at Bouvines in 1214, while his great-grandson Gaucher V became constable of France under Philip the Fair and count of Porcien. Younger branches ruled Saint-Pol, Blois and Penthièvre: Charles of Blois-Châtillon claimed the duchy of Brittany jure uxoris and kindled the Breton War of Succession, falling at Auray in 1364, and Marie de Saint-Pol founded Pembroke College at Cambridge. The Saint-Pol branch ended in 1360, the Blois branch in 1397 and the Penthièvre branch in 1457; the county of Porcien was sold to the duke of Orléans in 1400.
zh: 沙蒂永家族是中世纪法兰西的名门之一，得名于香槟的马恩河畔沙蒂永，其先祖自9世纪起便在那里为香槟伯爵镇守城堡。家族出身的厄德·德·沙蒂永后来成为教宗乌尔班二世，于1095年在克莱芒宣讲第一次十字军东征；雷纳德·德·沙蒂永则当过安条克亲王和外约旦领主，1187年哈丁战役后被萨拉丁处死。戈谢·德·沙蒂永曾任勃艮第总管并参加1214年的布汶战役，他的曾孙戈谢五世在美男子腓力治下出任法兰西王室统帅，并受封波尔西安伯爵。家族的幼支先后统治圣波勒、布卢瓦和庞蒂耶夫尔：布卢瓦的夏尔凭妻权争夺布列塔尼公爵之位，引发布列塔尼继承战争，1364年战死于欧赖；圣波勒的玛丽则在剑桥创办了彭布罗克学院。圣波勒支系于1360年绝嗣，布卢瓦支系于1397年断绝，庞蒂耶夫尔支系延续到1457年；波尔西安伯国则于1400年卖给了奥尔良公爵。

en: The Chauhans, whose name is the vernacular form of the Sanskrit Chahamana, are one of the great Rajput clans and the heroes of the Agnivanshi legend, in which the first Chauhan sprang from the sacrificial fire on Mount Abu to defeat the demons. From the seventh century their main line, the Chahamanas of Shakambhari, held the Sambhar lake country and later Ajmer, ruling Rajasthan for some four hundred years and rivalling the Guhilas, Paramaras and Solankis. Cadet branches carved out their own kingdoms at Nadol, Jalor and Ranthambore. The clan's greatest king was Prithviraj III, whose romance with Sanyogita and wars with his neighbours filled the bardic epic Prithviraj Raso; in 1192 he was defeated and killed by Muhammad of Ghor at the Second Battle of Tarain, the turning point that opened northern India to Turkish rule, and Qutb al-Din Aibak's invasion of 1197 shattered the old kingdom. Chauhan power lived on in its branches: Hammiradeva of Ranthambore defied Alauddin Khalji until his fort fell in 1301, while the Songara line held Jalor and the Deoras founded Sirohi in 1311. Across the following centuries Chauhan houses ruled states from Bundi and Kota in Rajasthan to Patna and Sambalpur in Orissa and Chhattisgarh, leaving the clan one of the most widely spread of all Rajput lineages.
zh: 乔诃那一名源自梵语“查哈马纳”，是拉杰普特大族之一，也是火神世系传说的主角——相传其始祖从阿布山的祭火中降生，降服群魔。从7世纪起，其主支沙坎巴里·查哈马纳人占据桑巴尔湖地区，后又据有阿杰梅尔，在拉贾斯坦统治约四百年，与古希罗、帕拉马尔、索兰基诸强争雄。旁支则在纳多尔、贾洛尔和兰桑波尔各自建国。全族最伟大的君王是普里特维拉杰三世，他与桑约吉塔的爱情及与邻邦的征战成就了史诗《普里特维拉杰·拉索》；1192年他在第二次塔拉因战役中被古尔的穆罕默德击败身亡，此役成为北印度落入突厥人统治的转折点，顾特卜丁·艾伯克又于1197年入侵，粉碎了旧王国。乔诃那的势力在各分支中延续：兰桑波尔的哈米拉德瓦对抗阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉，直到1301年堡垒陷落；松加拉支系守住贾洛尔，德奥拉支系则于1311年建立锡罗希。此后数百年间，乔诃那诸家在拉贾斯坦的本迪、科塔以及奥里萨和恰蒂斯加尔的帕特纳、桑巴尔布尔等地立国，使该族成为支系分布最广的拉杰普特世系之一。

en: The Chauhans of Jalor were a Songara branch of the great Chauhan clan, descended from the Chahamanas of Nadol. Around 1160 Kirtipala, son of the Nadol king Alhana, received a grant of twelve villages and made his seat on Sonagiri hill, where the Jalore fort still stands; his line took its name Songara from that golden rock. At first feudatories of the Solanki kings of Gujarat, the Jalor Chauhans grew strong under Udayasimha in the early thirteenth century, when they took Nadol, Mandor and Barmer, forced the Solankis to treat with a Rajput confederacy and even made Iltumish of Delhi retreat from Marwar. The dynasty then passed through Chachigadeva and Samantasimha, who was rescued from a Delhi attack by the Vaghela king Saranagadeva. Its last great ruler was Kanhadadeva, whose defence of Jalore against Alauddin Khalji is celebrated in the Gujarati epic Kanhadade Prabandha: when the Delhi army invested the fort in 1311 the garrison crowned his son Viramadeva, who died within days, and Kanhadadeva himself fell fighting as the fort was stormed. A kinsman's line survived further south at Chandravati and Mount Abu, becoming the ruling house of Sirohi.
zh: 贾洛尔的乔诃那人是乔诃那大族的松加拉分支，源自纳多尔的查哈马纳家族。约1160年，纳多尔国王阿尔哈纳之子基尔蒂帕拉受封十二个村庄，在贾洛尔堡所在的索纳吉里山（意为金山）立寨，其支系便因这座金色山岩得名“松加拉”。他们起初是古吉拉特索兰基国王的附庸，13世纪初在乌达亚辛哈治下强盛起来，连克纳多尔、曼多尔和巴尔梅尔，既迫使索兰基人与拉杰普特同盟议和，还让德里的伊勒杜迷失从马尔瓦尔退兵。王朝此后历经查奇加提婆与萨曼塔辛哈，后者遭德里进攻时靠瓦盖拉国王萨拉纳德瓦相救才脱险。末代雄主是坎哈达提婆，他抗击阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉、死守贾洛尔的事迹被古吉拉特语史诗《坎哈达提婆传》广为传诵：1311年德里军队围城时，守军为其子维拉马提婆加冕，新王数日即亡，坎哈达提婆本人也在堡垒被攻破时战死。其亲属的支系在南方的钱德拉瓦蒂和阿布山延续下来，后来成为锡罗希的统治家族。

en: The Chauhans of Patna were the westernmost offshoot of the great Chauhan clan, the Rajput rulers of the Patna kingdom in the upper Mahanadi valley of Orissa, around modern Patnagarh and Balangir. Their own tradition, recorded in the seventeenth-century Sanskrit chronicle Kosalananda Kavyam, brings them from Garh Sambhar near Mainpuri, kin of Prithviraj Chauhan: when their raja Vishala Dev was killed in battle with a Muslim king, identified with Firuz Shah Tughlaq, his pregnant queen Jayanti Devi fled south and found shelter with a Brahmin family in the Patna country. Her son Ramai Deva grew up among the common people, and in 1360, aged twenty, he overthrew the eight local warlords who had divided the region as the Eastern Ganga empire crumbled, making himself raja of Patna. He married a niece of the Ganga king Bhanu Deva III, built the Patneswari and Kosaleswara temples, and gave the loosely held hill country a strong government. His descendants spread the line across western Orissa: Balarama Deva founded the cadet kingdom of Sambalpur, and further branches ruled Sonepur, Khariar and Jarasingha, so that Chauhan houses long dominated the country between the Mahanadi and the Tel.
zh: 帕特纳的乔诃那人是乔诃那大族最西边的支系，作为拉杰普特统治者领有奥里萨默哈讷迪河上游的帕特纳王国，其地在今帕特纳加尔与巴朗吉尔一带。据17世纪梵文编年史《俱萨罗喜诗》记载的家族传说，他们来自迈恩普里附近的加尔桑巴尔，与普里特维拉杰·乔汉同族：其罗阇毗沙拉·提婆在与穆斯林君王（被比定为菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克）的交战中被杀后，怀孕的王后贾扬蒂·提婆南逃，在帕特纳地区一个婆罗门家中避难。她的儿子拉迈·提婆在民间长大，1360年年方二十时，趁东恒伽帝国崩溃、八位地方豪强割据之际将其逐一推翻，自立为帕特纳罗阇。他娶恒伽国王巴努·提婆三世的侄女为妻，修建帕特斯瓦里神庙与俱萨罗湿婆罗神庙，为这片松散的丘陵之地建立起强有力的统治。他的后裔把家族支脉撒遍奥里萨西部：巴拉罗摩·提婆另建桑巴尔布尔支系王国，其余支系又统治索内布尔、卡里亚尔和贾拉辛哈，乔诃那诸家由此长期称雄于默哈讷迪河与特尔河之间。

en: The Chauvirey were seigneurs of the Terre de Chauvirey in the county of Burgundy, a fief near Vesoul grouping the villages of Chauvirey-le-Vieil and Chauvirey-le-Châtel. A member of the house built the castle of Chauvirey-le-Châtel in the thirteenth century, and the family's strongholds held out against a French attack in 1475.
zh: 肖维雷家族是勃艮第伯国境内肖维雷领地的领主，这块封地处在沃苏勒附近，领有旧肖维雷与沙泰勒肖维雷等村落。家族成员于13世纪修建了沙泰勒肖维雷城堡，1475年家族要塞还曾抵御法兰西军队的进攻。

en: The Chiaromonte, also spelled Chiaramonte, were a Sicilian noble family of French origin, descended from the Clermont lords of Picardy, who came to the island in the wake of the Norman count Roger I at the end of the eleventh century. During the Sicilian Vespers of 1282 they backed the party that offered the crown to Peter III of Aragon, and in 1296 Manfredi Chiaramonte was rewarded with the County of Modica in the Val di Noto, one of the largest fiefs in Sicily, and the office of Grand Seneschal. His marriage to Isabella Mosca united the counties of Modica and Ragusa, and around 1307 the family began its Palermo seat, the Palazzo Chiaramonte, which gave its name to a distinctive Sicilian Gothic style. Through the fourteenth century the house led the Latin noble faction against the Catalan party and supplied several vicars of the kingdom. Manfredi, count of Modica, was one of the four regents for Queen Maria and in 1391 joined the baronial oath of Castronovo against Martin of Aragon. His son Andrea continued the revolt but was beheaded outside the family palace at Palermo in 1392, and Modica passed to the Aragonese admiral Bernardo Cabrera. Stripped of its titles, the family survived only in minor branches whose male line died out in the eighteenth century.
zh: 基亚罗蒙特（又译基亚拉蒙特）家族是源出法国的西西里贵族世家，先祖为皮卡第的克莱蒙领主，11世纪末随诺曼伯爵鲁杰罗一世来到西西里。1282年西西里晚祷战争期间，他们支持将王位献给阿拉贡的佩德罗三世的一派；1296年曼弗雷迪·基亚罗蒙特受封诺托谷的莫迪卡伯国——西西里最大的封地之一，并出任王室大总管。他与伊莎贝拉·莫斯卡的婚姻使莫迪卡和拉古萨两个伯国合而为一，约1307年起家族在巴勒莫兴建宅邸基亚拉蒙特宫，这种独特的西西里哥特式建筑日后以该家族命名。整个14世纪，该家族率领拉丁贵族派系对抗加泰罗尼亚派，数人出任王国摄政。莫迪卡伯爵曼弗雷迪是女王玛丽亚的四位摄政之一，1391年参与诸侯在卡斯特罗诺沃的结盟宣誓，反对阿拉贡的马丁。其子安德烈亚继续叛乱，于1392年在巴勒莫的家族宅邸外被斩首，莫迪卡落入阿拉贡海军司令贝尔纳多·卡夫雷拉之手。家族被剥夺头衔后仅靠小支系延续，男系于18世纪断绝。

en: The Chiavelli were a Ghibelline noble family of the Marche, said to be of Norman origin, who returned to Italy from Germany with Ruggiero Chiavello in 1154, in the time of Frederick Barbarossa, and built their power at Fabriano. Long loyal to the Empire, they became lords of the city in 1378 and made its fortune: in 1349 Guido Napolitano had already developed the papermaking on which Fabriano's fame rested, and Pope Boniface IX made him apostolic vicar. Under their rule the city drew in merchants and artists, including the painter Gentile da Fabriano, while Alberghetto Chiavelli restored the medieval Sturinalto fountain and Tommaso issued a new, more modern statute in 1415. Their populist government pleased the artisans and the poor but alienated the wealthy merchants, whose resentment ended in a massacre on Ascension Day, 26 May 1435, when the men of the house were killed during a service in the cathedral of San Venanzio; Tommaso, his heir Battista and eight male grandchildren died. The women were spared but exiled, and Fabriano was absorbed into the Papal States.
zh: 基亚韦利家族是马尔凯的吉伯林派贵族，相传源出诺曼人，1154年腓特烈·巴巴罗萨时代随鲁杰罗·基亚韦洛从德意志返回意大利，在法布里亚诺建立势力。他们长期效忠神圣罗马帝国，1378年成为这座城市的领主，并成就了它的富庶：1349年圭多·纳波利塔诺发展了令法布里亚诺闻名的造纸业，教宗博义九世还任命他为宗座代理人。在他们治下，城市吸引了商人和艺术家，画家真蒂莱·达·法布里亚诺即在此时创作；阿尔贝盖托·基亚韦利修复了中世纪的斯图里纳尔多喷泉，托马索于1415年颁布了更近代化的新法令。其民粹式统治深受工匠和平民欢迎，却得罪了富商。1435年5月26日耶稣升天节，积怨爆发为屠杀：家族男丁在圣维南齐奥大教堂的礼拜中遇害，托马索、继承人巴蒂斯塔和八个男性孙辈身亡。女眷获免但被逐走，法布里亚诺并入教宗国。

en: The Chiba were a gōzoku, or local landed power, and samurai family of the Bōsō Peninsula, descended from the Kanmu branch of the Taira clan. In 1126 Taira no Tsuneshige moved his seat to Inohana in Shimōsa Province, the site of later Chiba Castle, and took the name Chiba. His son Tsunetane sheltered the fugitive Minamoto no Yoritomo after his defeat by the Taira and advised him to make Kamakura his base, becoming one of the founders of the Kamakura shogunate; Tsunetane's six sons, the Chiba Rokutō, carried the clan's influence across many provinces. Under the shogunate the Chiba head served as hereditary shugo governor of Shimōsa and also held the large Sōma manor. In the fourteenth century Emperor Go-Daigo recognized Chiba Sadatane as the leading daimyō of the Kantō region. The family survived the medieval wars as provincial lords of Shimōsa but was ultimately dispossessed by Toyotomi Hideyoshi's conquest of the Kantō in the 1590s.
zh: 千叶氏是房总半岛的豪族与武家，出自桓武天皇一脉的桓武平氏。1126年，平常兼把据点迁往下总国的亥鼻，即后来千叶城的所在地，并取“千叶”为苗字。其子千叶常胤在源赖朝被平氏击败逃亡时予以庇护，并建议他以镰仓为根据地，成为镰仓幕府的开国功臣之一；常胤的六个儿子并称“千叶六党”，把家族势力扩展到多国。幕府时代，千叶当主世袭下总国守护职，还领有广阔的相马庄。14世纪，后醍醐天皇认可千叶贞胤为关东武家的首领。此后千叶家以下总国领主的身份历经中世战乱，最终在16世纪90年代丰臣秀吉平定关东时被没收领地而衰落。

en: The Chichimecayotl were the Acolhua royal house of Tetzcoco, the city-state on the eastern shore of Lake Texcoco, whose rulers claimed descent from the Chichimec leader Xolotl and his heirs at Tenayuca. Quinatzin, the first known king of Tetzcoco, transferred the seat of Chichimec power there from Tenayuca, and around 1337 the Acolhua made the city their capital in place of Coatlinchan. His son Techotlalatzin, reigning from 1357 to 1409, adopted Nahuatl language and customs and built a small Acolhua domain, though within the orbit of the Tepanec tyrant Tezozomoc of Azcapotzalco, who overthrew the next king Ixtlilxochitl I in 1418. Ixtlilxochitl's son Nezahualcoyotl allied with the Mexica to defeat the Tepanecs in 1428 and made Tetzcoco a founding member of the Triple Alliance, entitled to two fifths of its tribute; a poet, engineer and patron of learning, he and his son Nezahualpilli made the city the intellectual center of the Aztec world. Spanish troops seized Tetzcoco in 1520 and used it as the base for the siege of Tenochtitlan, while the dynasty survived as colonial governors and landed nobles.
zh: 奇奇梅卡约特尔家族是特斯科科湖东岸城邦特斯科科的阿科尔瓦王室，其统治者自称奇奇梅卡首领索洛特尔的后裔，先世曾在特奈乌卡掌权。基纳特辛是已知的第一位特斯科科国王，他把奇奇梅卡人的权力中心从特奈乌卡迁到这里；约1337年，阿科尔瓦人又以该城取代夸特林昌成为都城。他的儿子特乔特拉拉特辛1357年至1409年在位，采用纳瓦特尔语言和习俗，建起一个以阿科尔瓦人为核心的小邦，却仍处在阿斯卡波察尔科的特帕内克霸主特索索莫克的势力圈内，后者于1418年推翻了下一任国王伊斯特利尔索奇特尔一世。伊斯特利尔索奇特尔之子内萨瓦尔科约特尔与墨西加人结盟，于1428年击败特帕内克人，使特斯科科成为三方联盟的创始成员，有权分得五分之二的贡赋；他兼具诗人、工程师和学术赞助人的身份，与儿子内萨瓦尔皮利一道把该城建成阿兹特克世界的文化中心。1520年西班牙军队占领特斯科科，并以此为基地围攻特诺奇蒂特兰，而该王朝则作为殖民时代的总督和地产贵族延续下来。

en: The Chobanids were descendants of a Mongol family of the Suldus clan who rose to power as commanders of the Ilkhanate. The amir Chupan served three ilkhans from Ghazan onward and married into the line of Hulagu, but his dominance angered the Ilkhan Abu Sa'id, who drove him out in 1327; Chupan fled to Herat, where the Kartids put him to death, and his sons were killed or scattered to the Golden Horde and the Mamluks. His daughter Baghdad Khatun nonetheless married Abu Sa'id and held wide influence until his death in 1335. As the Ilkhanate collapsed, Chupan's grandson Hasan Kucek reunited the family, defeated the Jalayirids in 1338 and built a realm around Tabriz, ruling through puppet ilkhans such as Suleiman Khan. His brother Malek Ashraf took control in 1344 but failed against Baghdad in 1347 and Fars in 1350; when a Golden Horde army sacked Tabriz in 1357 he was executed and his line extinguished, ending Chobanid power in Persia.
zh: 出班王朝（又译丘拜尼王朝）出自蒙古苏勒都思部，以伊尔汗国军事统帅的身份起家。异密出班自加赞汗起侍奉三任伊尔汗，并与旭烈兀家族联姻，但他的权势引起伊尔汗阿布·赛义德的猜忌，于1327年被逐，出逃赫拉特后被卡尔提德人处死，诸子或被杀，或逃奔金帐汗国和马穆鲁克。不过他的女儿巴格达·哈敦嫁给了阿布·赛义德，在1335年伊尔汗去世前一直手握大权。伊尔汗国瓦解后，出班之孙哈桑·库楚克重新聚拢家族，于1338年击败札剌亦儿王朝，以大不里士为中心建立政权，并通过苏莱曼汗等傀儡伊尔汗发号施令。其弟马立克·阿什拉夫于1344年掌权，但1347年争夺巴格達和1350年争夺法尔斯均告失败；1357年金帐汗国军队攻陷大不里士，他被处死，子嗣断绝，出班家族在波斯的统治就此终结。

en: The Chōsokabe were a kokujin, or local lord family, of the Nagaoka district in Tosa Province on Shikoku, counted among the seven warrior houses of Tosa and claiming descent from the immigrant Hata clan. Their first head Yoshitoshi settled at Okō in the twelfth century, and during the Nanboku-chō wars the eleventh head Nobuyoshi fought for the Ashikaga under the Tosa shugo Hosokawa Akiuji against Southern Court forces at Higashisakamoto on Hachimanyama, earning estates that laid the clan's foundations; through the Muromachi years the Chōsokabe served in turn the Hosokawa, Miyoshi and Ichijō. In 1508 the head Kanetsugu was killed by a coalition of neighboring lords, and his orphaned son was raised by Ichijō Husaie before returning in 1518 as Chōsokabe Kunichika to restore the house as its twentieth head. Kunichika's son Motochika, the twenty-first head, destroyed the Motoyama in 1562, made a puppet of the Ichijō in 1574 and crushed them at the Watarigawa in 1575 to unify Tosa; by 1585 he had conquered most of Shikoku, but Toyotomi Hideyoshi's invasion that year forced him to surrender all but Tosa. His heir Nobuchika fell in Kyūshū in 1587, and after Motochika's death in 1599 the next head Morichika joined the losing western army at Sekigahara in 1600 and was dispossessed; he was executed after the Siege of Osaka in 1615, ending the clan as a daimyō house.
zh: 长宗我部氏是四国土佐国长冈郡的国人领主，为土佐七雄之一，自称渡来人秦氏的后裔。初代能俊于12世纪进入土佐，在冈丰筑馆定居；南北朝动乱中，第十一代当主信能追随土佐守护细川显氏站在足利一方，在长冈郡八幡山东坂本与南朝势力作战，因功获封大片领地，奠定家业。室町时代，长宗我部氏先后侍奉细川氏、三好氏和一条氏。1508年，当主兼序在本山、山田等豪族的联合进攻中败死，遗孤千雄丸被一条房家收留，1518年以国亲之名回到冈丰城、复兴家名，是为第二十代当主。国亲之子元亲是第二十一代当主，1562年攻灭本山氏，1574年将一条氏傀儡化，1575年又在四万十川之战中击破一条兼定，统一土佐；到1585年他已征服大半个四国，却在同年丰臣秀吉的四国征伐中战败，被减封至土佐一国。1587年其嫡子信亲在九州户次川之战中战死；元亲1599年去世后，继任的盛亲在1600年关原之战中加入西军，遭到改易，又在1615年大坂之阵后被处死，长宗我部氏作为大名的历史就此终结。

en: The Chudasamas were the longest-lived Hindu dynasty of Saurashtra, ruling from their capitals at Vamanasthali (Vanthali) and, after Navaghana moved his seat, Junagadh, from the late ninth century to 1472. Bardic tradition calls the founder Chudachandra, son of a Samma chief of Sindh, and both chronicles and later inscriptions connect the family with the lunar Yadava line, though some writers give them Abhira origins. Early kings such as Graharipu and Khengara fought repeated wars with the Chaulukyas of Anahilavada, including Mularaja and Jayasimha Siddharaja; Navaghana rebuilt the old Uparkot fort at Junagadh, and the Navghan Kuvo well and Adi Kadi stepwell inside it are attributed to him. The first ruler known from inscriptions, Mandalika I, was on the throne when Alauddin Khalji's armies invaded Gujarat, and the dynasty afterwards held on as independent kings or vassals of the Delhi and Gujarat sultans. Its end came in 1472, when Mahmud Begada defeated Mandalika III, forced him to convert and annexed Junagadh, making the Chudasamas the last major Hindu dynasty of the peninsula.
zh: 珠多娑摩是萨乌拉施特拉存续最久的印度教王朝，先以瓦马纳斯塔利（万塔利）为都，纳瓦加纳迁都后以朱纳格尔为中心，统治自9世纪末延续至1472年。行吟传统称开创者为朱达旃陀罗，是信德一位萨马首领之子；铭文与晚近的《曼达利卡王传》把该家族与月族耶陀温世系相连，也有学者认为他们出自阿比拉人。格拉哈里普、肯伽罗等早期君主曾与阿纳希拉瓦达的遮娄其诸王（包括穆拉罗阇和阇耶辛诃·悉达罗阇）连年交战；纳瓦加纳重修朱纳格尔的乌帕尔科特古堡，堡内的纳万井和阿迪·卡迪阶梯井相传也由他修建。铭文可考的首位君主曼达利卡一世在位时，阿拉丁·卡尔吉的大军攻入古吉拉特；此后该王朝时而独立、时而称臣于德里和古吉拉特的苏丹。1472年，马哈茂德·贝加达击败末代君主曼达利卡三世，迫其改宗并吞并朱纳格尔，珠多娑摩遂成为半岛上最后一个重要的印度教王朝。

en: The Chūjō were one of the families of the Yokoyama party, itself part of the Musashi Seven Parties, the network of warrior bands rooted in Musashi Province. Their founder Chūjō Ienaga rode as a retainer of Minamoto no Yoshitomo in the twelfth-century wars, and the clan joined Minamoto no Yoritomo's rising of 1180 and helped build the Kamakura shogunate. When the Yokoyama main line was destroyed in the Wada conflict of 1213, the Chūjō endured: they sat on the shogunate's Council of State and long held the Constableship of Owari Province. Estates they also held in Mikawa brought them into the Ashikaga orbit, and in the Nanboku-chō wars they fought for the Northern Court, becoming shogunal guardsmen serving Shogun Ashikaga Yoshimitsu and others under the Muromachi regime and extending their interests into Dewa and Shinano, until they fell out of favour with Shogun Yoshinori. The Mikawa branch kept the name alive but fared badly in the Sengoku age: in 1493 Chūjō Hideaki was beaten by the Matsudaira at Idano, repeated Imagawa and Matsudaira attacks eroded their lands, and after Oda Nobunaga's victory at Okehazama in 1560 the family abandoned the province without a fight and the Mikawa Chūjō came to an end. The clan also gave its name to the Chūjō school of swordsmanship.
zh: 中条氏是武藏七党之一横山党的族人，世代扎根于武藏国。始祖中条家长在12世纪的战乱中作为源义朝的郎党出征，一族随后参加了1180年源赖朝的举兵，为镰仓幕府的创建立下功劳。1213年横山党嫡流横山氏在和田合战中覆灭，中条氏却幸存下来，出任幕府评定众，并长期担任尾张国守护。它在三河国也拥有领地，由此与足利氏结缘，南北朝时站在北朝一方，室町时代被编为将军直属的奉公众，出仕足利义满等人，势力延伸到出羽、信浓，直到第六代将军足利义教时遭其厌恶而失脚。三河中条氏在战国时代处境艰难：1493年中条秀章在井田野之战中败给松平亲忠，此后又屡遭今川义元与松平元康的侵攻，1560年织田信长在桶狭间获胜后进军三河，中条氏不战而散，三河中条氏就此灭亡。该族还以中条流剑术闻名于世。

en: The Clermont were the historic dauphins of Auvergne, a comital line that also held the worldly county of Clermont. Their house arose from the quarrel that split the county of Auvergne in the twelfth century: around 1147 William VIII the Old seized the inheritance of his nephew William VII the Young, and the settlement of 1155 left the dispossessed branch with only a reduced territory around Vodable. William VII had married Marquise d'Albon, daughter of the count of Viennois, whose byname Dauphin passed to their son; from Robert II's testament of 1281 the heads of the house styled themselves counts of Clermont and dauphins of Auvergne, and placed a dolphin on their arms. From the late twelfth century they resided at the castle of Vodable, where successive Roberts and Bérauds ruled through the fourteenth century. The blood line ended with Béraud III in 1426; his daughter Jeanne carried the dauphinate to the house of Bourbon, and in 1436 it passed to the Bourbon-Montpensier branch.
zh: 克莱蒙家族即史上的奥弗涅多芬世家，因领有世俗的克莱蒙伯国而得名。家族起源于12世纪奥弗涅伯国的分裂：约1147年，“老者”威廉八世篡夺了侄子“年轻人”威廉七世的继承权，1155年的分产只给被剥夺的一支留下沃达布勒周围一块缩小的领地。威廉七世娶了维埃努瓦伯爵之女阿尔邦的马基斯，伯爵的别名“多芬”传给了他们的儿子；从1281年罗贝尔二世的遗嘱起，家族首领自称克莱蒙伯爵兼奥弗涅多芬，并把海豚绘入纹章。自12世纪末起，他们以沃达布勒城堡为驻地，历代罗贝尔和贝罗在此统治了整个14世纪。血脉终于1426年去世的贝罗三世，其女让娜把多芬领地带入波旁家族，1436年它又归波旁-蒙庞西埃支系所有。

en: The Colhua were the ruling dynasty of Culhuacan, a Nahuatl city-state on Lake Xochimilco whose heirs claimed the mantle of the fallen Toltec capital Tollan and were said to be the first to bear the title tlatoani, or speaker. Long the most prestigious polity in the Valley of Mexico, Culhuacan subjugated towns such as Xochimilco and Cuitlahuac, and in 1299 its king Coxcoxtli joined the Tepanecs in driving the wandering Mexica from Chapultepec before settling them as vassals at Tizaapan. The marriage of Coxcoxtli's daughter Atotoztli to the Mexica leader Opochtli Iztahuatzin produced Acamapichtli, the first tlatoani of Tenochtitlan, so that every later Aztec emperor carried Colhua, and through it claimed Toltec, blood. Culhuacan's own independence ended in 1377, when Azcapotzalco subdued it with Mexica help, and after the fall of the Tepanecs in 1428 the Mexica ruler Itzcoatl took the title Ruler of the Culhua, leaving the old city a junior partner of the Triple Alliance.
zh: 科尔瓦家族是索奇米尔科湖畔纳瓦特尔城邦库尔瓦坎的统治王朝，其继承人自称承接了陷落的托尔特克都城图兰的衣钵，相传也是最早使用“特拉托阿尼”（发言人）头衔的统治者。库尔瓦坎曾是墨西哥谷地最有声望的政权，征服了索奇米尔科、奎特拉瓦克等城镇；1299年，国王科克斯科斯特利联合特帕内克人把漂泊的墨西加人赶出查普尔特佩克，又把他们安置在蒂萨潘的荒地上充作附庸。科克斯科斯特利之女阿托托斯特利嫁给墨西加首领奥波奇特利·伊斯塔瓦钦，生下的正是特诺奇蒂特兰首任特拉托阿尼阿卡马皮奇特利，因此后来的阿兹特克皇帝都流着科尔瓦人的血，并借此自托为托尔特克继承者。库尔瓦坎自身的独立于1377年终结，阿斯卡波察尔科借助墨西加军队将其征服；1428年特帕内克霸权倒台后，墨西加统治者伊茨科特尔取“科尔瓦人之主”头衔，这座古城沦为三方联盟中的次要伙伴。

en: The viscounts of Comborn were one of the oldest feudal dynasties of Bas-Limousin, in what is now the Corrèze, seated at the castle of Comborn near Orgnac alongside the viscounties of Turenne and Limoges. The first identified lord, Archambaud, held the title in 958, and his son Archambaud I, called the Butcher and later Rotten Leg, became viscount of Comborn in 962 and of Turenne around 976. The house then threw off powerful branches: an elder line took Turenne, a younger son received Ventadour in the eleventh century, and the marriage of Archambaud the Bearded to the heiress of Limoges carried that viscounty to his elder son. In the fourteenth century Guy de Comborn was bishop of Limoges and then of Noyon, while Guichard V, lord of Treignac and Chamberet, bought the viscounty in 1374 and died at Agincourt in 1415. His last heirs sold Comborn in 1508 and 1509, and it passed through a Comborn daughter to the viscounts of Pompadour.
zh: 孔博恩子爵家族是下利穆赞（今科雷兹省一带）最古老的封建世家之一，以奥尔尼亚克附近的孔博恩城堡为驻地，与蒂雷讷、利摩日的子爵领并称。可考的第一代领主阿尔尚博在958年已持有头衔，其子阿尔尚博一世绰号“屠夫”、后称“烂腿”，于962年成为孔博恩子爵，约976年又取得蒂雷讷子爵之位。家族此后分出几支强藩：长支得到蒂雷讷，幼子在11世纪受封旺塔杜，“大胡子”阿尔尚博娶利摩日子爵的女继承人后，利摩日子爵领又传给长子。14世纪时，居伊·德·孔博恩先后出任利摩日和努瓦永主教；特雷尼亚克与尚伯雷领主吉沙尔五世于1374年买下子爵领，1415年战死于阿金库尔。他的末代继承人在1508至1509年间卖掉孔博恩，领地经孔博恩家的女儿转入蓬巴杜子爵家族。

en: The lords of Commercy, a castle on the Meuse in the Barrois whose holders were first vassals of the bishops of Metz, rose from the seigneurial family of Broyes-Commercy. Around 1247 Simon of Commercy married Mathilde, who inherited the County of Saarbrücken in 1270, and their son Simon IV united both fiefs in 1274 as founder of the House of Saarbrücken-Commercy, count of Saarbrücken and lord of Commercy. His son John I, who died in 1342, settled the succession in 1326 by splitting the lands: the County of Saarbrücken with the lower castle of Commercy went to his grandson John II, while the upper castle passed to a younger son whose line kept the seigneurie of Commercy. A daughter, Mahaut, married Count Simon I of Salm in 1334. John II of Saarbrücken served the French crown and was captured alongside King John at the Battle of Poitiers in 1356, later becoming Grand Butler of France. When he died in 1381 leaving no son, his daughter Johanna and then her Nassau-Weilburg heirs carried Saarbrücken into the House of Nassau, which held it until the French conquest of 1795. The junior Commercy line survived through the lords of the upper castle and later supplied counts of Roucy, while the lower castle was sold to the house of Lorraine in 1444.
zh: 科梅尔西是默兹河畔、巴尔鲁瓦地区的城堡，其领主最初是梅斯主教的封臣，出自布鲁瓦-科梅尔西领主家族。约1247年，科梅尔西的西蒙娶了1270年继承萨尔布吕肯伯国的马蒂尔德，他们的儿子西蒙四世于1274年兼领两块封地，创立萨尔布吕肯-科梅尔西家族，身兼萨尔布吕肯伯爵与科梅尔西领主。西蒙四世之子约翰一世于1342年去世，此前在1326年安排了分家：萨尔布吕肯伯国连同科梅尔西下堡归孙子约翰二世，上堡则给幼子一支，由其世袭科梅尔西领主权；女儿马蒂尔德于1334年嫁给萨尔姆伯爵西蒙一世。萨尔布吕肯的约翰二世效力法国王室，1356年在普瓦捷战役中与法王约翰一同被俘，后来官至法国大司酒。他1381年去世时没有儿子，女儿约翰娜及其拿骚-威尔堡继承人把萨尔布吕肯带入拿骚家族，该伯国由拿骚各支系统治，直到1795年被法国征服。科梅尔西幼支凭上堡领主延续，后来还出了鲁西伯爵；下堡则于1444年卖给洛林家族。

en: The counts of Comminges ruled an ancient feudal county of Gascony on the northern slope of the Pyrenees, straddling the upper Garonne, which took shape in the tenth century. Long thought to descend from the counts of Aragon, the family is now traced by historians to the circle of the dukes of Vasconia, with an Aznar appearing among its earliest named ancestors. Bernard became the dynasty's favoured name: Bernard III held the county from before 1153, and Bernard IV, count from 1176 to 1225, married in turn the countess of Bigorre and Marie de Montpellier. Bernard VI ringed his lands with bastides, founding Lestelle in 1243 and a string of similar chartered towns down to 1282, and Bernard VIII, who died in 1336, also held the viscounty of Turenne. In 1337 the county belonged to his son Jean I, and then passed to the Pierre-Raymonds. The last hereditary ruler was Marguerite, who reigned from 1376 to 1443 and married successively into the houses of Armagnac and Foix; she bequeathed Comminges to the French crown, and after the death of her last husband Mathieu de Foix in 1453 it was incorporated into the royal domain in 1454, definitively in 1498. Younger branches, such as the viscounts of Couserans, carried the name onward.
zh: 科曼日伯爵家族统治着加斯科涅境内一个古老的封建伯国，地处比利牛斯山北坡、加龙河上游两岸，伯国在10世纪成形。长期以来人们认为该家族源自阿拉贡伯爵，晚近研究则把它追溯到瓦斯科尼亚公爵的随从圈，最早的有名始祖中就有一位叫阿斯纳。“贝尔纳”是家族最偏爱的名字：贝尔纳三世在1153年之前已执掌伯国，1176至1225年在位的贝尔纳四世先后娶比戈尔女伯爵和蒙彼利埃的玛丽为妻。贝尔纳六世在领地上广建巴斯蒂德设防新城，1243年建莱斯泰勒，之后到1282年又建起一连串同类特许城镇；1336年去世的贝尔纳八世还身兼蒂雷讷子爵。1337年，伯国归其子让一世所有，随后由两位皮埃尔-雷蒙相继统治。末代世袭统治者是1376至1443年在位的玛格丽特，她先后嫁入阿马尼亚克和富瓦家族，临终把科曼日遗赠给法兰西国王；她最后一任丈夫富瓦的马蒂厄于1453年去世后，伯国在1454年并入王室领地，1498年最终完成合并。库斯朗子爵等幼支则延续了科曼日的姓氏。

en: The Comyns, later spelled Cumming, were a family of Norman or Flemish origin who rose under David I of Scotland and became the most powerful noble house in thirteenth-century Scotland. William Comyn married the countess of Buchan, founding the Buchan earls, while his son Walter acquired the lordship of Badenoch, where castles such as Ruthven and Lochindorb commanded the Highland passes; the family also held Lochaber and the justiciarship of Scotia for decades. John the Black Comyn was one of the six guardians of the realm after 1286 and claimed the crown through descent from Donald III. His son John the Red Comyn led the Scots to victory at Roslin in 1303 but submitted to Edward I in 1304, and in 1306 Robert the Bruce killed him in the Greyfriars church at Dumfries. The Red Comyn's son died fighting for the English at Bannockburn in 1314, the Badenoch line was forfeited, and its heiresses carried claims into English families: Elizabeth Comyn married Richard Talbot and Alice Comyn married Henry de Beaumont. The surviving branches remained in the Highlands as Clan Cumming, with the Cummings of Altyre recognised as chiefs, feuding with the Macphersons and other clans around Badenoch and Strathspey.
zh: 科明家族，后来也拼写为卡明，源出诺曼或佛兰德人，在苏格兰国王大卫一世治下崛起，成为13世纪苏格兰最有权势的贵族世家。威廉·科明娶布坎女伯爵为妻，开创了布坎伯爵一支；其子沃尔特取得巴德诺赫领主之位，在那里修建的鲁斯文、洛钦多布等城堡扼守高地通道；家族还领有洛哈伯，并世代担任苏格兰司法官。黑科明约翰是1286年后的六位护国大臣之一，并凭唐纳德三世的血统主张王位。其子红科明约翰于1303年率军在罗斯林击败英军，但1304年向爱德华一世屈服；1306年，罗伯特·布鲁斯在邓弗里斯的方济各会教堂中将他杀害。红科明之子1314年在班诺克本为英格兰作战时阵亡，巴德诺赫一脉被剥夺爵位与领地，其女继承人把家族的权利带入英格兰家族：伊丽莎白·科明嫁给理查德·塔尔博特，爱丽丝·科明嫁给亨利·德·博蒙特。幸存的各支留在高地，演变为卡明氏族，以奥尔泰尔的卡明家族为族长，在巴德诺赫和斯特拉斯佩一带与麦克弗森等氏族长期仇杀。

en: The Contarini are one of the twelve founding, or apostolic, families of Venice, whose name is first documented in the city in 853; by family tradition they claimed descent from the Roman Aurelii Cottae. Rich and prolific, they produced eight doges and forty-four Procurators of Saint Mark, and held more seats in the Great Council than any other house from before the Serrata of 1297 until the fall of the republic in 1797. Domenico I Contarini sat as doge from 1043 and Jacopo Contarini from 1275, while Bertucci Contarini captained galleys in Enrico Dandolo's crusading fleet that took Zara in 1202 and Constantinople in 1204. Andrea Contarini, doge from 1367, was the hero of the War of Chioggia against Genoa: though in his seventies he took command of the fleet, liquidated his own fortune to fund the fight, and led the recapture of Chioggia. Later members served across the Venetian empire and beyond, among them Ambrogio Contarini, ambassador to the Persian ruler Uzun Hasan from 1473 to 1476, and Gasparo Contarini, diplomat and Bishop of Belluno, who died in 1542. A branch of the house settled in Sicily in 1394 and survives there.
zh: 孔塔里尼家族是威尼斯十二家创始贵族（即使徒家族）之一，其名字853年首见于威尼斯文献；家族传统自称是古罗马奥雷利·科塔家族的后裔。该家族人丁兴旺、财力雄厚，共出了八位总督和四十四位圣马可行政长官，从1297年大议会锁闭之前到1797年共和国灭亡，他们在大议会中的席位一直多于任何其他家族。多梅尼科一世·孔塔里尼于1043年出任总督，雅各布·孔塔里尼于1275年出任总督；贝尔图乔·孔塔里尼在恩里科·丹多洛的十字军舰队中担任舰长，先后参加1202年攻占扎拉和1204年攻占君士坦丁堡。1367年起任总督的安德烈亚·孔塔里尼是对热那亚的基奥贾战争中的英雄：他年逾七旬仍亲掌舰队，散尽家财充作军饷，并率军收复基奥贾。后世成员任职遍及威尼斯海外领地乃至更远，如1473—1476年出使波斯统治者乌尊·哈桑的安布罗乔·孔塔里尼，以及1542年去世的外交家、贝卢诺主教加斯帕罗·孔塔里尼。1394年还有一支迁居西西里，在当地落户传续。

en: The Cornaro, known in Venetian as the Corner, were one of the twelve tribunal families of Venice and sat among the founders of the Great Council in 1172, claiming descent from the Roman gens Cornelia. In the fourteenth century the house split into the Great House line and the Cornaro Piscopia, named after the fief of Piscopia in Cyprus granted to Federico Cornaro in 1363; its members also held Bodonitsa, Argos and Nauplia and the Aegean islands of Scarpanto and Kasos. Marco Cornaro was doge from 1365, and the family's eastern connections culminated in Caterina Cornaro, who married King James II of Cyprus in 1468 and ruled the island as queen from 1474 until she ceded it to Venice in 1489. The Cornaro remained prolific churchmen and patrons: one cardinal commissioned Bernini's Ecstasy of Saint Theresa in 1652, while Elena Cornaro Piscopia became the first woman to earn a doctorate in philosophy, at Padua in 1678. Three more Cornaro doges followed, the last of them Giovanni II, elected in 1709.
zh: 科尔纳罗家族（威尼斯语称科尔内尔）是威尼斯十二家裁判官家族之一，1172年即为大议会创始成员，自称源出古罗马的科尔内利乌斯氏族。14世纪，家族分为两支：大宅支和皮斯科皮亚支，后者得名于1363年封给费代里科·科尔纳罗的塞浦路斯皮斯科皮亚领地；家族成员还领有博多尼察、阿尔戈斯、纳夫普利翁以及爱琴海的卡尔帕索斯和卡索斯岛。马尔科·科尔纳罗于1365年出任总督，家族与东方的联系在卡特琳娜·科纳罗时达到顶峰：她1468年嫁给塞浦路斯国王雅克二世，1474年起以女王身份统治该岛，1489年将塞浦路斯割让给威尼斯。科尔纳罗家族还出了许多教士和艺术赞助人：一位枢机主教于1652年委托贝尼尼创作《圣特蕾莎的狂喜》，埃莱娜·科尔纳罗·皮斯科皮亚于1678年在帕多瓦成为第一位获得哲学博士学位的女性。此后又有三位家族成员出任总督，最后一位是1709年当选的乔瓦尼二世。

en: The da Correggio were a powerful noble house of Emilia, named after the castle of Correggio near Reggio, where a certain Frogerio is recorded as lord as early as 1009. Through the high Middle Ages they built up a cluster of fiefs between Parma and Reggio, serving as lords, podesta and capitani del popolo. The most ambitious of them, Giberto III, became lord of Parma in 1303 and briefly made himself master of Cremona and Guastalla; named imperial vicar of Reggio by the Emperor Henry VII, he then switched from the Ghibellines to the Guelphs, was driven out of Parma for good in 1316, and died at his castle of Castelnovo di Sotto in 1321. His sons retook Parma in 1341 but sold it to the Este in 1344, after which the house concentrated on Correggio itself. The Emperor Frederick III raised their signoria to a county in 1452, and it became a principality in 1616; because their arms happened to match those of the Habsburgs, they were sometimes called Correggio d'Austria. The line of rulers ended in 1635, when the Duchy of Modena seized the principality.
zh: 达·科雷焦家族是艾米利亚的显赫贵族，得名于雷焦附近的科雷焦城堡；早在1009年，文献就记载一个名叫弗罗杰里奥的人为该城堡的领主。整个中世纪盛期，他们在帕尔马和雷焦之间积累了大批封地，出任领主、最高行政官和人民长官。家族中最有野心的吉贝尔托三世于1303年成为帕尔马领主，还一度掌控克雷莫纳和瓜斯塔拉；他被皇帝亨利七世任命为雷焦的帝国代理人，随后却从吉伯林派转投圭尔夫派，1316年被永久逐出帕尔马，1321年死于卡斯泰尔诺沃迪索托的自家城堡。他的儿子们1341年重新夺取帕尔马，却在1344年把它卖给埃斯特家族，此后家族专注于科雷焦本土。皇帝腓特烈三世于1452年将其领地升为伯国，1616年又升为亲王国；由于家族纹章恰与哈布斯堡纹章相同，他们有时被称为奥地利的科雷焦。1635年，摩德纳公国吞并亲王国，该家族的统治告终。

en: The lords of Cossonay were one of the oldest seigneurial lineages of the Pays de Vaud, first recorded in 1096 when Ulrich of Cossonay made a donation to the abbey of Romainmôtier. From their castle at Cossonay, west of Lausanne, they held Prangins and Nyon from the late eleventh century and later L'Isle, Bercher and Surpierre. Humbert I founded the priory of Cossonay, and in the early thirteenth century Jean I extended the family lands to Bercher and ranked among the most powerful lords of Vaud; his sons split the inheritance between Cossonay and Prangins. The house long opposed the expansion of the counts of Savoy and only submitted gradually. Louis II, lord of Cossonay and Surpierre, could still count thirty-six vassals across the region, but the male line ended with Louis III and the female line with the heiress Jeanne, who in 1398 granted her town a charter of franchises. On her death in 1406 the succession was disputed, and in 1421 arbitration awarded the lordship to Amédée VIII of Savoy, whose house later raised it to a barony.
zh: 科索奈领主家族是沃地区最古老的封建世家之一，最早见于1096年的记载，当时科索奈的乌尔里希向罗曼莫捷修道院作了一次捐赠。家族以洛桑以西的科索奈城堡为根基，自11世纪末起领有普朗然和尼永，后来又得到利勒、贝尔谢和叙尔皮埃尔。安贝尔一世创建了科索奈小修道院；13世纪初，让一世把领地扩展到贝尔谢，跻身沃地区最有权势的领主之列，他的儿子们后来把祖产分作科索奈与普朗然两支。家族长期对抗萨伏依伯爵的扩张，只是逐步归附。科索奈兼叙尔皮埃尔领主路易二世仍拥有三十六名封臣，但男系随路易三世而绝，女系则止于女继承人让娜——她曾在1398年向城镇居民颁发自由特许状。1406年让娜去世后继承权发生争执，1421年的仲裁把领地判给萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥八世，萨伏依家族后来又将它升格为男爵领。

en: The sires de Coucy held the barony of Coucy-le-Château in Picardy, where the first castle had been raised by the archbishops of Reims in the early tenth century; the house probably descended through the female line from the counts of Vermandois. Entitled to call themselves barons, they preferred the rarer title of Sire, and in the thirteenth century they ranked among the most powerful sub-comital magnates in western Europe, weaving marriage ties with the royal houses of France, England, Scotland and Austria. Crusading ran in the family: Enguerrand II died on the Second Crusade in 1149, Raoul I was killed on the Third in 1191, and Raoul II died at el-Mansourah in 1250. Enguerrand III the Great, who died in 1242, built the enormous castle of Coucy that became the seat of the house. In 1337 the lordship belonged to Enguerrand VI. His son Enguerrand VII, the last of the line, married a daughter of Edward III of England, became earl of Bedford and count of Soissons, helped crush the Jacquerie in 1358, and died a captive at Bursa in 1397 after the disaster of Nicopolis in 1396. His daughter Marie sold Coucy to Louis I, duke of Orléans, in 1400, and it reached the French crown with Louis XII in 1498.
zh: 库西领主家族盘踞在皮卡第的库西城堡男爵领，当地最早的城堡由兰斯大主教于10世纪初修建；家族很可能经女系出自韦芒杜瓦伯爵。他们虽有资格称男爵，却偏爱更罕见的“西尔”（宗主）头衔，并在13世纪跻身西欧最有权势的次伯爵级大诸侯之列，与法兰西、英格兰、苏格兰和奥地利的王室都结有姻亲。家族素有十字军传统：昂盖朗二世1149年死于第二次十字军东征，拉乌尔一世1191年在第三次东征中丧命，拉乌尔二世1250年死于曼苏拉。1242年去世的“伟人”昂盖朗三世修建了规模宏大的库西城堡，作为家族的根基。1337年，领地归于昂盖朗六世。他的儿子昂盖朗七世是家族末代领主，娶英格兰国王爱德华三世之女，受封贝德福德伯爵和苏瓦松伯爵，1358年参与镇压扎克雷起义，1396年尼科波利斯惨败后被俘，1397年死于布尔萨的囚所。其女玛丽于1400年把库西卖给奥尔良公爵路易一世，1498年路易十二登基后，领地并入法兰西王室。

en: The house of Craon took its name from the castle of Craon in Haut-Anjou, in the modern Mayenne, and is documented from the eleventh century, when Robert of Nevers, a younger son of the count of Nevers, became its lord. Robert of Craon, a son of the next generation, joined the Knights Templar in the Holy Land and became their second grand master in 1136. Maurice II governed Anjou and Maine for Henry II Plantagenet, while later heads served the French crown as seneschals of Anjou, Touraine and Maine or of Gascony: Amaury III, who died in 1333, founded the Gascon bastide of Créon in 1312 and gave it his name. In the fourteenth century Jean III de Craon became bishop of Le Mans and then archbishop of Reims. The most notorious member was Pierre de Craon, called the Great, who embezzled funds meant for the Anjou expedition to Naples and later waylaid the constable Olivier de Clisson in a Paris street; the royal march on Brittany that followed ended in Charles VI's mental breakdown. Pierre's son Antoine was killed at Agincourt in 1415, and the house ended with Antoine de Domart, who died around 1480 after governing Burgundy for Louis XI; the Beauvau then inherited the Craon name and arms through marriage.
zh: 克朗家族以上安茹（今马耶讷省）的克朗城堡得名，11世纪已见记载，讷韦尔伯爵的幼子罗贝尔当时成为该地领主。下一代的罗贝尔·德·克朗前往圣地加入圣殿骑士团，1136年出任第二任大团长。莫里斯二世曾为金雀花王朝的亨利二世管辖安茹和曼恩，后来的家族首领则为法兰西国王充任安茹、图赖讷、曼恩或加斯科涅的总管：1333年去世的阿马里克三世于1312年在加斯科涅建立设防新城克雷翁，并以自己的姓氏为它命名。14世纪，让三世·德·克朗先后出任勒芒主教和兰斯大主教。家族中最声名狼藉的是“大皮埃尔”·德·克朗，他侵吞了安茹家族远征那不勒斯的军费，后来又在巴黎街头伏击王室统帅奥利维耶·德·克利松；随后王室进军布列塔尼，却以查理六世精神失常告终。皮埃尔之子安托万1415年战死于阿金库尔，家族最后一位代表安托万·德·多马尔约在1480年去世，他此前曾为路易十一治理勃艮第；博沃家族随后通过婚姻继承了克朗的姓氏和纹章。

en: The van Cuijk family, lords of the Land of Cuijk in northern Brabant between the Meuse and the Peel marshes, is documented from 1096 and long kept its small lordship independent between the stronger counties round about. After the destruction of Cuijk Castle around 1133 the lords moved their seat to Grave, which received town rights in 1233, though the lordship's diet and high court stayed at Cuijk. The house reached its height under Jan I, lord from 1254 to 1308, who also held Grave and Asten and married Jutta of Nassau; as an ally of Brabant he fought at the Battle of Worringen in 1288 against Guelders and Cologne, and in 1296 he led the noble conspiracy that ended in the murder of Count Floris V of Holland. A popular ruler, he opened thousands of hectares of common heath to the villagers and founded the hospital of Saint Catherine at Grave. His sons Jan II and Otto continued the line, but the lords of Cuijk came to an end around 1400.
zh: 范·克伊克家族是北布拉班特、默兹河与皮尔沼泽之间克伊克领地的领主，1096年已见记载，长期在周边强邦之间维持这块小领地的独立。约1133年克伊克城堡被毁后，领主把驻地迁往1233年获得城市权的赫拉弗，但领地议会和最高法院仍留在克伊克。家族在扬一世时达到鼎盛：他1254至1308年为领主，兼领赫拉弗和阿斯滕，娶拿骚的于塔为妻；作为布拉班特的盟友，他1288年在沃林根战役中与海尔德和科隆作战，1296年又主导贵族密谋，最终导致荷兰伯爵弗洛里斯五世被杀。他颇得民心，向村民开放数千公顷公有荒地，并在赫拉弗创办圣凯瑟琳济贫院。其子扬二世和奥托延续家系，但克伊克领主一脉约在1400年断绝。

en: The da Camino, or Caminesi, were a noble family of Lombard origin in the March of Treviso, probably descended from the Colalto. In the tenth century one Guido received the castle of Montanara from the German king Conrad I as a reward for saving his life, and his sons were granted lands between the Piave and Livenza by the bishop of Ceneda; the castle they built near Oderzo stood at Camino, which gave the family its name. Within a century they dominated the counties of Ceneda, Feltre and Belluno and the mountains of Cadore. Reduced to ordinary citizens by the commune of Treviso between 1183 and 1199, they returned as leaders of the local Guelphs against the Ghibelline da Romano, twice holding Treviso in the 1230s before being expelled by Alberico da Romano. Gherardo III da Camino made himself signore of Treviso in 1283 and ruled as a builder and patron of letters, numbering Dante Alighieri among his guests. His son Rizzardo inherited peacefully, but the occupation of Udine in 1309 and its defeat, followed by a switch to the Ghibelline side, brought rapid ruin: Guecellone was driven out of Treviso, and in 1335 the Republic of Venice absorbed all the family's lands. A lesser branch survived in the Venetian nobility until 1422; through a Cadore line the family also numbered the painter Titian among its descendants.
zh: 卡米诺家族（又称卡米内西）是特雷维索边区的伦巴第裔贵族，很可能出自科拉尔托家族。10世纪时，族人圭多因救助德意志国王康拉德一世而受封蒙塔纳拉城堡，他的儿子们又从切内达主教手中得到皮亚韦河与利文扎河之间的土地，并在奥德尔佐附近的卡米诺筑堡，家族由此得名。不到一个世纪，他们已统辖切内达、费尔特雷、贝卢诺诸伯国和卡多雷山区。1183至1199年间，他们曾被特雷维索公社降为普通市民，后来作为当地圭尔夫派的领袖卷土重来，与吉伯林派的达·罗马诺家族对抗，13世纪30年代两度占据特雷维索，终被阿尔贝里科·达·罗马诺驱逐。1283年，格拉尔多三世·达·卡米诺自立为特雷维索领主，治下大兴土木、礼遇文人，但丁·阿利吉耶里曾是他的座上宾。其子里扎尔多平稳继位，但1309年占领乌迪内后旋即战败，又转投吉伯林派，家运急转直下：圭切洛内被逐出特雷维索，1335年家族领地全部被威尼斯共和国吞并。一支旁系在威尼斯贵族中延续到1422年；经由卡多雷的一支，画家提香也是该家族的后裔。

en: The da Fogliano, also called Fogliani, were a Guelph noble family of Reggio nell'Emilia, where from the later twelfth century Guido I da Fogliano, who had married a sister of Pope Innocent IV Fieschi, and his descendants built up estates from the old lands of Matilda of Canossa. Niccolò da Fogliano became lord of Reggio and was named imperial vicar by the Emperor Louis the Bavarian in 1331. His son Guidoriccio, born around 1290, won lasting fame as a condottiero for Siena: he took Montemassi after a seven-month siege in 1328 and was painted in the saddle by Simone Martini in the great equestrian fresco of Siena's Palazzo Pubblico. Expelled by the Sienese in 1333, he and his brother Giberto seized Reggio from Azzo Manfredi, but the Gonzaga conquered the city in 1335 and the brothers took service in the Veneto, where Guidoriccio was podestà of Padua in 1337 and of Verona in 1348. Later kin included the condottiero Carlo da Fogliano, husband of Bernabò Visconti's daughter Isotta, while a Piacenza branch took the name Fogliani Sforza d'Aragona and died out in 1780.
zh: 达·福利亚诺家族又称福利亚尼，是雷焦艾米利亚的归尔夫派贵族。12世纪下半叶，娶了教皇英诺森四世（菲耶斯基家族）一个姐妹的圭多一世及其后人，在雷焦及周边省份逐步吞并卡诺莎的玛蒂尔达遗留的地产。尼科洛·达·福利亚诺成为雷焦领主，并于1331年被皇帝巴伐利亚人路德维希任命为帝国代理人。他约1290年出生的儿子圭多里乔作为为锡耶纳效力的雇佣骑兵队长名垂后世：1328年他经七个月围攻拿下蒙泰马西，西莫内·马尔蒂尼为他创作的巨型骑马肖像壁画就画在锡耶纳市政宫。1333年他被锡耶纳人驱逐，与兄弟吉尔贝托从阿佐·曼弗雷迪手中夺取雷焦，但贡扎加家族于1335年攻陷该城，兄弟二人转赴威尼托谋生，圭多里乔先后于1337年和1348年出任帕多瓦和维罗纳的最高行政官。家族后人中还有雇佣骑兵队长卡洛·达·福利亚诺，他娶了贝尔纳博·维斯孔蒂的女儿伊索塔；皮亚琴察支派改姓福利亚尼·斯福尔扎·达拉戈纳，于1780年绝嗣。

en: The Montefeltro were a branch of the Lombard lords of Carpegna who, around 1140, took the castle of San Leo in the region then called Montefeltro. Emperor Frederick Barbarossa made their ancestor Antonio imperial vicar of Urbino in 1155, and in 1226 Frederick II appointed the brothers Buonconte and Taddeo counts of Urbino. In the Guelph-Ghibelline wars the family led the imperial party in the Marche and Romagna against the Guelph Malatesta of Rimini. Federico I seized Spoleto, Assisi and Gubbio before being murdered in 1322, and after the campaigns of Cardinal Albornoz in 1355 the family's power was curbed by the papacy, though Antonio II restored its rule in Urbino in 1377. Guidantonio da Montefeltro, count from 1403, fought the mercenary captain Braccio da Montone and was made duke of Spoleto by the pope. His illegitimate son Federico III, succeeding in 1444, turned Urbino into one of the great cultural centres of the Renaissance through his library, his studiolo and his patronage of Piero della Francesca; Pope Sixtus IV made him Duke of Urbino in 1474. His son Guidobaldo I fled before Cesare Borgia in 1502 and, dying without male heirs in 1508, left the duchy to his adopted nephew Francesco Maria della Rovere. The Della Rovere held Urbino until 1631, when the duchy reverted to the Papal States.
zh: 蒙泰费尔特罗家族是伦巴第贵族卡尔佩尼亚领主的支系，约在1140年占据了当时称蒙泰费尔特罗地区的圣莱奥城堡。1155年，皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨任命其先祖安东尼奥为乌尔比诺的帝国代理人；1226年，皇帝腓特烈二世又封邦孔泰和塔代奥兄弟为乌尔比诺伯爵。圭尔夫派与吉伯林派混战期间，家族在马尔凯和罗马涅领导帝党，对抗里米尼的圭尔夫派马拉泰斯塔家族。费德里科一世一度夺占斯波莱托、阿西西和古比奥，最终于1322年遇刺；1355年枢机主教阿尔沃诺斯出兵后，家族势力受到教宗压制，但安东尼奥二世仍于1377年恢复了在乌尔比诺的统治。1403年继位的圭达托尼奥·达·蒙泰费尔特罗与佣兵首领布拉乔·达·蒙托内交战，并被教宗封为斯波莱托公爵。他的私生子费德里科三世于1444年继位，凭借藏书室、书房和对皮耶罗·德拉·弗兰切斯卡等人的资助，把乌尔比诺建成文艺复兴的重要文化中心；1474年教宗西克斯图斯四世封他为乌尔比诺公爵。其子圭多巴尔多一世于1502年为躲避切萨雷·博尔贾出逃，1508年去世时没有男嗣，将公国留给养子、外甥弗朗切斯科·马里亚·德拉·罗韦雷。德拉·罗韦雷家族统治乌尔比诺直到1631年，公国最终收归教宗国。

en: The da Varano were a Guelph noble house who ruled Camerino and a string of towns in the Marche from the thirteenth to the sixteenth century. First recorded with the Guelph captain Prontaguerra da Varano, the family rose under Gentile da Varano, who rebuilt Camerino after its destruction by Manfred of Sicily and the Ghibelline defeat at Benevento in 1266, and was made Count of the Roman Campagna by Pope Martin IV in 1282. His son Rodolfo and nephew Berardo served the papacy as commanders; Berardo became lord of Camerino in 1316 and Marquis of Ancona, reconquering Urbino, Fano and Osimo for the Church. The later da Varano combined signorial rule with condottiere careers: Rodolfo II fought for Cardinal Albornoz and for Florence against the Visconti, while Rodolfo III served King Ladislaus of Naples. Family feuds then weakened the house until Rodolfo IV retook Camerino in 1444. Its end came in 1502, when Cesare Borgia captured and killed Giulio Cesare da Varano with three of his sons; the surviving Giovanni Maria was created Duke of Camerino in 1515 but died without heirs in 1529, after which the duchy passed to the della Rovere dukes of Urbino.
zh: 瓦拉诺家族是信奉圭尔夫派的贵族世家，13至16世纪统治着卡梅里诺及马尔凯地区的一系列城镇。家族最早见于记载的是圭尔夫派首领普龙塔圭拉·达·瓦拉诺；真蒂莱·达·瓦拉诺时期家族崛起：西西里的曼弗雷德摧毁卡梅里诺后，他趁1266年吉伯林派在贝内文托战败之机重建城市，并于1282年被教宗马丁四世封为罗马坎帕尼亚伯爵。其子鲁道尔夫和侄贝拉尔多都以将领身份为教廷效力：贝拉尔多于1316年成为卡梅里诺领主、受封安科纳侯爵，为教会收复乌尔比诺、法诺和奥西莫。后来的瓦拉诺家族成员兼擅领主统治与佣兵生涯：鲁道尔夫二世为枢机主教阿尔沃诺斯和佛罗伦萨作战，对抗维斯孔蒂家族；鲁道尔夫三世则效力于那不勒斯国王拉迪斯劳。此后家族内讧削弱了势力，直到鲁道尔夫四世于1444年重新夺回卡梅里诺。1502年家族走向终结：切萨雷·博尔贾俘获并杀死朱利奥·切萨雷·达·瓦拉诺和他的三个儿子；幸存的乔瓦尼·马里亚于1515年被封为卡梅里诺公爵，但1529年无嗣而终，公国随后并入德拉·罗韦雷家族的乌尔比诺公国。

en: The Daihoji were a great warrior house of the Shonai plain in Dewa province, who claimed Fujiwara blood through the Muto clan, a line descending from the Chinjufu shogun Fujiwara no Hidesato and kin to the Shoni of Kyushu. Their ancestor Muto Ujihira entered the region as jito of the Oizumi estate in the early Kamakura period; the family was first called Oizumi and then Daihoji after its castle, ruling the estate as local deputy for the Hojo and later the Uesugi. In the late Muromachi period it reached a first heyday: in 1462 the lord Atsuuji received the title Dewa no kami from Shogun Ashikaga Yoshimasa and visited Kyoto the next year to present tribute, and in 1477 Masauji was granted a shogunal name character through the mediation of Asakura Takakage. The Sengoku lords also held the betto office of Mount Haguro, adding religious authority to their arms, and in 1513 they crushed the Sagochi, but restive kokujin and pressure from the Mogami brought decline and forced them into Uesugi vassalage in 1568. Yoshiuji then rebuilt the house by force, destroying the Tosasabayashi, uniting the three districts of Tagawa, Kushibiki and Akumi, and receiving the title yakata from Oda Nobunaga, until in 1583 his own retainers, the Tozenji brothers, murdered him at Mogami Yoshiaki's instigation. His adopted heir Yoshikatsu recovered Shonai at Jorigahara in 1588 and submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi, but was attainted in 1591 over the Fujishima rising; he ended as a Uesugi retainer and the Daihoji name died out.
zh: 大宝寺氏是出羽国庄内地方的豪族与战国大名，本姓藤原，出自镇守府将军藤原秀乡一脉的武藤氏，与九州的少贰氏同族。其先祖武藤氏平在镰仓初期以大泉庄地头的身份入部，家族先称大泉氏，后因居于庄园中心的大宝寺城而改名大宝寺氏，先后作为北条氏和上杉氏的在地代官治理此地。室町后期该族迎来全盛：1462年当主淳氏获将军足利义政授予出羽守之职，次年上洛谒见并进献贡礼；1477年政氏又经朝仓孝景中介获赐将军偏讳。进入战国，历代当主兼任羽黑山别当，以宗教权势扩张势力，1513年讨灭砂越氏，但国人反抗与最上氏的压力使其渐衰，1568年被迫臣从上杉氏。其后义氏以铁腕重整家势，攻灭土佐林氏，掌握田川、栉引、饱海三郡，还从织田信长处获“屋形”称号，却在1583年被暗通最上义光的家臣东禅寺兄弟杀害。养子义胜虽在1588年十五里原之战夺回庄内并臣服丰臣秀吉，终因1591年藤岛一揆的责任被改易，战国大名大宝寺氏就此断绝，义胜后来出仕上杉氏，大宝寺的家名也随之消亡。

en: The Daijō were the main line of the Hitachi Heishi, descendants of the Kanmu Heishi through Taira no Kunika, who dominated the provincial administration of medieval Hitachi. The house took its name from the office of Hitachi Daijō: in 1193, after the fall of Taki Yoshimoto, Minamoto no Yoritomo appointed Yoshida Sukemoto to the post and to the headship of the Hitachi Taira, with its seat first at Taki in Tsukuba District and later at Mito Castle. The Daijō never became shugo, resting their power on the provincial government and the rites of Kashima Shrine, which repeatedly set them against the Oda and Satake, who held the shugo title. In the Nanboku-chō war Daijō Takamoto first backed the Hōjō and then the Southern Court, helping Kusunoki Masaie defend Urizura Castle before it fell in 1336, and submitted to the Ashikaga in 1338, thereafter serving the Kamakura government. The house joined Uesugi Zenshū's rebellion of 1416, lost Mito Castle in 1419, and its head Mitsumoto was put to death by the Kamakura kubo in 1429. In the Sengoku century the Daijō leaned on Uesugi Kenshin against the Later Hōjō, but after they failed to join Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign of 1590, Satake Yoshishige, who had been granted Hitachi, overran Fuchū Castle and the last head Kiyomoto killed himself; the Satake slaughtered the allied Thirty-Three Houses of southern Hitachi at Ōta Castle the next year, extinguishing the clan.
zh: 大掾氏是中世常陆国的军事贵族，属坂东平氏中的桓武平氏国香流，也是常陆平氏的嫡流。家名来自常陆大掾这一国衙官职：1193年多气义干失势后，源赖朝任命吉田资干出任常陆大掾并统领常陆平氏，本据先在筑波郡多气，后来移至水户城。大掾氏从未担任守护，势力依托国衙与鹿岛神宫祭祀，因而与历任常陆守护小田氏、佐竹氏屡起冲突。南北朝纷争中，大掾高干先随北条时行，后改投南朝，协助楠木正家据守瓜连城，城于1336年陷落，他本人则在1338年投降足利氏，此后侍奉镰仓府。1416年上杉禅秀之乱中，大掾氏站在禅秀一方，1419年丢失水户城，当主满干于1429年被镰仓公方足利持氏杀害。战国时代，大掾氏联合上杉谦信对抗后北条氏；1590年丰臣秀吉发动小田原征伐时一族未从军，佐竹义重遂受封常陆，攻陷府中城，末代当主清干自尽，次年佐竹氏又将号称三十三馆的南方支族诱杀于太田城，大掾一族基本灭亡。

en: The dal Verme were a Veronese noble house, traced to a certain Vermis recorded near the Porta San Zeno in Verona in 1174. His descendants held communal offices there, and the jurist Nicola dal Verme kept the family's standing through the harsh rule of Ezzelino da Romano; Nicola's son Pietro was the father of Luchino, under whom the family turned to the trade of arms. Luchino dal Verme served the della Scala, the Visconti and Venice, counted Petrarch among his friends, and in 1364 crushed the Revolt of Saint Titus in Crete for the Venetians, earning Venetian nobility before dying near Constantinople in 1367. His son Jacopo became the chief Visconti commander, winning the battle of Alessandria against the French in 1391 and the battle of Casalecchio in 1402, and was enfeoffed at Bobbio in 1387; Jacopo's son Luigi held the counties of Bobbio, Sanguinetto and Voghera. The family's general Pietro dal Verme was murdered in 1485 amid the rise of Ludovico Sforza, who confiscated their fiefs, though later branches recovered them. The marquisate of Bobbio was created in 1516 and split between family lines in 1530; the Bobbio line died out in 1759, and the remaining feudal rights ended with the abolition of feudalism in 1806.
zh: 达尔·韦尔梅是维罗纳的贵族世家，始祖可追溯到1174年见于记载、住在维罗纳圣芝诺门附近的维尔米。其后人历任城邦官职，法学家尼古拉·达尔·韦尔梅在埃泽利诺·达·罗马诺的严酷统治下保全了家族地位；尼古拉之子彼得罗生卢基诺，家族从卢基诺这一代起转为戎马生涯。卢基诺·达尔·韦尔梅先后效力德拉·斯卡拉家族、维斯孔蒂家族和威尼斯，与诗人彼特拉克交好，1364年替威尼斯平定克里特岛的圣提多起义，因而获封威尼斯贵族，1367年在君士坦丁堡附近去世。其子雅各布成为维斯孔蒂的主将，1391年在亚历山德里亚会战击败法军，1402年又赢得卡萨莱基奥会战，并于1387年受封博比奥；雅各布之子路易吉领有博比奥、圣圭内托和沃盖拉诸伯国。家族将领彼得罗·达尔·韦尔梅于1485年在卢多维科·斯福尔扎夺权的乱局中遇刺，封地被没收，不过后来的各支又陆续收回。1516年博比奥侯爵领地设立，1530年在家族各支间分割；博比奥一支于1759年绝嗣，残余的封建权利则随1806年封建制废除而终结。

en: The von Dalwigk family belonged to the ancient nobility of Hesse and Waldeck and took its name from the village of Dalwigk southeast of Korbach, first mentioned in 1036 and abandoned after the Thirty Years' War. First documented with Rabodo de Dalewic in 1167, its members were ministeriales of Corvey Abbey and held Lichtenfels Castle in Dalwigksthal as its castle garrison, later serving as vassals of the counts of Waldeck, the landgraves of Hesse and the archbishops of Mainz. Two of the family, Dietrich and Reinhard von Dalwigk, served as abbots of Corvey between 1336 and 1369, and the knight Bernhard V fought in the Mainz and Hesse feuds around 1400. From Johann von Dalwigk zu Lichtenfels, marshal of Count Otto IV of Waldeck in 1470, descend the baronial lines of Dalwigk zu Lichtenfels and Dalwigk zu Schauenburg, both later raised to the rank of Freiherr.
zh: 达尔维格家族属于黑森与瓦尔德克的古老贵族，得名于科尔巴赫东南的达尔维格村；该村1036年即见记载，三十年战争后被毁弃。家族最早于1167年以拉博多·德·达勒维奇之名见载，世代为科尔费修道院的家臣，驻守达尔维格斯塔尔的利希滕费尔斯城堡，后来又成为瓦尔德克伯爵、黑森藩侯和美因茨大主教的封臣。1336至1369年间，迪特里希和莱因哈德·冯·达尔维格先后出任科尔费修道院院长；骑士贝尔纳五世则在1400年前后卷入美因茨与黑森的纷争。1470年担任瓦尔德克伯爵奥托四世元帅的约翰·冯·达尔维格·祖·利希滕费尔斯是利希滕费尔斯支的始祖，家族后来形成利希滕费尔斯和绍恩堡两个男爵支系。

en: The House of Dampierre was a noble family named after its lordship of Dampierre in Champagne, whose earliest known ancestor, Guy I of Dampierre, held the local castle in the twelfth century. Its rise came through marriage: William II of Dampierre wed Margaret II, Countess of Flanders. In the long succession war against the House of Avesnes, King Louis IX of France arbitrated in 1246 and awarded Flanders to Margaret's Dampierre children while Hainaut went to the Avesnes, and the Dampierre defeat at West-Capelle in 1253 forced them to accept that division. Guy of Dampierre ruled as Count of Flanders, a younger son opened the line that held the County of Namur, and Guy II's marriage to Mathilde of Bourbon founded the Bourbon-Dampierre branch. Marriage policy added Nevers in 1280 and Rethel in 1328, so that by 1337 the family held Flanders, Nevers, Rethel and Namur, while Blanche of Namur was queen of Norway and Sweden. The senior line ended with Countess Margaret III in 1405, when Flanders, Artois, Nevers and Franche-Comte passed to her son John the Fearless and became the core of the Valois-Burgundy dominions; the Namur line died out in 1429.
zh: 当皮埃尔家族是因香槟地区的当皮埃尔领地而得名的贵族世家，可考的最早成员居伊一世在12世纪已据有当地城堡。家族靠婚姻发迹：当皮埃尔的纪尧姆二世娶佛兰德斯女伯爵玛格丽特二世为妻。在与阿韦讷家族长期的继承战争中，法兰西国王路易九世于1246年仲裁，将佛兰德斯判归玛格丽特与当皮埃尔所生的诸子，埃诺则归阿韦讷家族；1253年西卡佩勒之战失利后，当皮埃尔家族被迫接受了这一划分。居伊·德·当皮埃尔后来成为佛兰德斯伯爵，他的幼子一支开创了统治那慕尔伯国的支系，居伊二世与波旁的玛蒂尔德联姻又衍生出波旁-当皮埃尔支系。凭借联姻策略，家族于1280年得到讷韦尔、1328年得到勒泰勒，到1337年已领有佛兰德斯、讷韦尔、勒泰勒和那慕尔，那慕尔的布朗什还身为挪威与瑞典王后。1405年女伯爵玛格丽特三世去世，长支断绝，佛兰德斯、阿图瓦、讷韦尔和弗朗什-孔泰传给她的儿子无畏者约翰，构成瓦卢瓦-勃艮第家族领地的核心；那慕尔支系则于1429年消亡。

en: The Dandolo were a patrician family of Venice, descended from a merchant named Domenico recorded around 1085, who rose to the front rank of Venetian politics in the twelfth century and produced four doges. The first and greatest was Enrico Dandolo, elected in 1192 when already old and blind: he diverted the Fourth Crusade first to the reconquest of Zara in 1202 and then to the sack of Constantinople in 1204, an event that laid the foundations of Venice's colonial empire, and he died in that city in 1205 and was buried in Hagia Sophia. His kinswoman Anna Dandolo married King Stefan the First-Crowned and became queen of Serbia in 1217. Giovanni Dandolo held the dogeship from 1280 and Francesco Dandolo from 1328; the last doge of the house was Andrea Dandolo, a former law professor at Padua who ruled from 1343 and wrote Latin chronicles of Venetian history before his death in 1354. Later Dandolo women served as dogaressas, among them Giovanna in 1457 and Zilia in 1556, and the house supplied the republic with admirals and diplomats throughout its history.
zh: 丹多洛家族是威尼斯的贵族世家，先祖为约1085年见载的商人多梅尼科，12世纪跃居威尼斯政坛前列，共出了四位总督。第一位也是最伟大的一位是恩里科·丹多洛，他1192年当选时已年老目盲，却引导第四次十字军先在1202年转攻扎拉，又于1204年洗劫君士坦丁堡，为威尼斯的殖民帝国奠定基础；他1205年死于君士坦丁堡，葬于圣索菲亚大教堂。他的族人安娜·丹多洛嫁给塞尔维亚国王“首位加冕者”斯特凡，1217年成为塞尔维亚王后。乔瓦尼·丹多洛1280年出任总督，弗朗切斯科·丹多洛1328年出任总督；家族最后一位总督是安德烈亚·丹多洛，他曾任帕多瓦大学法学教授，1343年上台，撰写了记载威尼斯历史的拉丁文编年史，1354年去世。后来家族还出了乔万娜（1457年）和齐莉娅（1556年）等总督夫人，并持续为共和国输送海军将领和外交官。

en: The D'Arcys were a family of Norman-origin name, established as Lincolnshire gentry with their seat at Knaith by the late thirteenth century. Their great figure was John D'Arcy, created Baron Darcy de Knayth in 1332, who became one of Edward III's most trusted councillors. He served three terms as chief governor, or justiciar, of Ireland between 1323 and 1344, and in 1324 presided at Kilkenny over the witchcraft trial of Alice Kyteler. In England he held the sheriffdoms of Nottingham, Lancaster and York, served the king as steward and chamberlain, fought the Scots and the French, and was present at the Battle of Crecy in 1346. His second wife Joan de Burgh was the widow of the earl of Kildare, and their daughter Elizabeth married James Butler, second earl of Ormonde, tying the family to the great Anglo-Irish lordships. When John died in 1347 his son inherited the barony, and later D'Arcys kept lands and influence within the English Pale around Dublin and Drogheda.
zh: 达西家族的姓氏源于诺曼人，13世纪末已是林肯郡的乡绅，宅邸在奈斯。家族最显赫的人物是约翰·达西，1332年受封德奈斯的达西男爵，是爱德华三世最信任的谋臣之一。1323至1344年间，他三度出任爱尔兰总督，即司法官；1324年他在基尔肯尼主持了爱丽丝·基特勒女巫案的审判。在英格兰，他先后担任诺丁汉、兰开斯特和约克郡长，又任国王的内廷总管和宫务大臣，征战苏格兰和法国，并参加了1346年的克雷西战役。他的续弦琼·德·伯格是基尔代尔伯爵的遗孀，两人的女儿伊丽莎白嫁给第二代奥蒙德伯爵詹姆斯·巴特勒，使家族与盎格鲁-爱尔兰大领地联姻。1347年约翰去世后，其子继承男爵爵位，后世达西家族在都柏林和德罗赫达一带的英属直辖区内保有土地与势力。

en: The Dasni, or Dasini, were the leading tribe of the Yazidi Kurds of the northern Mosul country, holding the mountains around Duhok, Sheikhan and Sinjar as far as the Great Zab, and for centuries Dasini served even as a general name for the Yazidis themselves. Fourteenth-century writers counted them a branch of the Bokhti Kurds, and they had once followed the Adawiyya order from which Yazidism grew, preserving a memory of revolt that went back to Mir Jafar Dasni's rising against the Abbasid caliph al-Mu'tasim in the 840s and an uprising against the Hamdanids in 906. Around the end of the thirteenth century their mountain principality, centered on Duhok beneath Mount Dasin, was reorganized under the name Sheikhan, though its rulers kept the epithet Dasini; in the fifteenth century it came under pressure from the Bahdinan emirate. After the Ottoman conquest of Iraq, Mir Hussein Beg Dasini entered Ottoman service, governing Mosul from 1534 and then Erbil, Bitlis and other sanjaks, while his sons held governorships across the region and carried the Dasini name into the late sixteenth century.
zh: 达斯尼（又作达西尼）是摩苏尔北部雅兹迪库尔德人的首要部落，据有杜胡克、谢赫汉和辛贾尔周围直至大扎卜河的山区；数百年来，达斯尼甚至被用作雅兹迪人的通称。14世纪的史家把他们算作博赫提库尔德人的一支，他们早先信奉后来演化为雅兹迪教的阿达维教团，其反抗传统可追溯到9世纪40年代米尔·贾法尔·达斯尼反对阿拔斯哈里发穆阿台绥姆的起义，以及906年反对哈姆丹王朝的起事。13世纪末，他们以达斯宁山下的杜胡克为中心的山地政权改组并改称谢赫汉酋长国，但统治者仍保留达斯尼称号；15世纪时它受到巴赫迪南酋长国的挤压。奥斯曼征服伊拉克后，米尔·侯赛因·贝格·达斯尼于1534年出掌摩苏尔桑贾克，其后又历任埃尔比勒、比特利斯等地的桑贾克贝伊，他的儿子们在各地担任长官，使达斯尼之名延续到16世纪后期。

en: The Date were a samurai house claiming descent from Fujiwara no Uona through the Isa family of Hitachi. Their founder Isa Tomomune served Minamoto no Yoritomo in the Genpei War and in his struggle against his brother Yoshitsune, and in 1189 received the Date district of Mutsu, from which the family took its name. In the Nanboku-chō wars of the 1330s the Date backed the Southern Court through the court general Kitabatake Akiie. They spent the Sengoku age guarding their independence in the far north, and reached their height under Date Masamune, who in 1589 destroyed the Ashina at the Battle of Suriagehara and seized Aizu, only to be trimmed by Toyotomi Hideyoshi after the Odawara campaign of 1590 to the three-hundred-thousand-koku fief of Yonezawa. Masamune then cast his lot with Tokugawa Ieyasu: in 1600 his troops, fighting beside the Mogami, routed Naoe Kanetsugu of the Uesugi, and the clan was rewarded with twelve districts and the six-hundred-and-twenty-thousand-koku Sendai Domain, where Masamune built Sendai Castle. Classed as tozama outsiders, the Date nonetheless ranked among the greatest Edo-period daimyō, though a succession struggle in the 1660s ended in bloodshed at Edo in 1671 as the Date Disturbance. A younger son, Date Hidemune, founded a separate hundred-thousand-koku branch at Uwajima in Shikoku.
zh: 伊达氏是自称藤原鱼名后裔的武士名门，出自常陆国的伊佐氏。始祖伊达朝宗在源平合战以及源赖朝与其弟义经的争斗中侍奉赖朝，1189年受封陆奥国伊达郡，家族遂以伊达为姓。14世纪30年代南北朝战乱时，伊达氏通过南朝武将北畠显家效忠南朝。整个战国时代，他们在日本东北竭力维系独立，到伊达政宗时达到鼎盛：1589年在摺上原之战中攻灭芦名氏、夺取会津；但1590年小田原征伐后被丰臣秀吉削封，只领有三十万石的米泽领地。政宗随后转投德川家康，1600年与最上氏协同作战，击溃上杉家的直江兼续，因此受封十二郡、六十二万石的仙台藩，并在仙台筑城。伊达氏虽被列为外样大名，却仍是江户时代最显赫的大名之一，只是17世纪60年代的继嗣之争在1671年于江户演变为流血的伊达骚动。政宗的庶子伊达秀宗另立门户，领有四国宇和岛十万石的分家。

en: The lords of Daun held Daun Castle in the Vulkaneifel, on the edge of the Eifel-Mosel uplands. An earlier free noble house of that name died out in 1163, whereupon its ministerialis Richardus de Duna took over the castle, the manor and the name of his former lords and founded the second Daun dynasty. In 1250 Wirich of Daun married Gudrun of Oberstein and gained a share of the Oberstein lordship in the Hunsrück, beginning the Daun-Oberstein line, which around 1320 built its own castle at Oberstein after quarrelling with the original lords. In 1340 Gilles of Daun received the lordship as a fief from King John of Bohemia of the House of Luxembourg, but in 1353 John's uncle, Archbishop Baldwin of Trier, captured the castle and forced the family into Trier overlordship; for centuries afterwards the lords of Daun held their many Eifel villages under the Elector of Trier. A later branch acquired Falkenstein in 1456 and became counts of Daun-Falkenstein in 1518, and in 1643 the whole house was raised to the rank of imperial count. From 1657 members entered Austrian service, producing field marshals such as Count Wilhelm Johann Anton and Wirich Philipp, who was made Prince of Teano in 1711.
zh: 道恩领主家族盘踞在艾费尔火山地区的道恩城堡，地处艾费尔与摩泽尔山地之间。更早的一支道恩自由贵族于1163年绝嗣，其家中侍臣里夏杜斯·德·杜纳接管了城堡、庄园和旧主的名号，开创了第二个道恩世家。1250年，道恩的维里希娶奥伯施泰因的古德龙为妻，分得洪斯吕克山区奥伯施泰因领地的一份，开创道恩-奥伯施泰因支系；该支与奥伯施泰因原领主发生争执后，约于1320年另建奥伯施泰因城堡。1340年，道恩的吉勒斯从卢森堡家族的波希米亚国王约翰手中领受封地，但1353年约翰的叔父、特里尔大主教巴尔杜温攻陷城堡，迫使家族臣服于特里尔；此后数百年间，道恩领主都在特里尔选侯的宗主权下统治艾费尔山区的众多村庄。家族的一支于1456年取得法尔肯施泰因，1518年成为道恩-法尔肯施泰因伯爵；1643年整个家族被擢升为帝国伯爵。1657年起家族成员进入奥地利服役，出了威廉·约翰·安东伯爵和1711年受封泰亚诺侯爵的维里希·菲利普等多位陆军元帅。

en: The counts of Bar came from the House of Montbeliard, itself a branch of the Ardennes family known in French as the maison de Scarpone. The county around Bar-le-Duc was inherited in 1033 by Sophia, daughter of the duke of Upper Lorraine, who ruled it together with her husband Count Louis of Montbeliard; their son Theodoric II founded the enduring comital line. The counts balanced between the Empire and France, and in 1301 the western part of the county, the Barrois mouvant, became a fief held of the French crown. In 1337 Edward I of Bar died and his son Henry IV succeeded, followed by the short reign of Edward II. Count Robert, ruling from 1352, was raised to duke and peer of France in 1354; he died in 1411, and his successor Edward III fell at Agincourt in 1415. The last male duke, Cardinal Louis, died in 1431, leaving Bar to his great-nephew Rene of Anjou, husband of the duchess of Lorraine. From Rene's death in 1480 Bar remained united with Lorraine, and a testament of 1506 bound the two duchies together permanently. In 1738 the Treaty of Vienna gave Bar to the exiled Polish king Stanislaw Leszczynski, and on his death in 1766 it reverted to the French crown.
zh: 巴尔伯爵出自蒙贝利亚尔家族，而后者是阿登家族（法语称斯卡尔波内家族）的支系。1033年，上洛林公爵之女索菲继承了以巴勒迪克为中心的伯国，她与丈夫蒙贝利亚尔伯爵路易共同统治，其子蒂博二世开创了绵延的伯爵世系。历代伯爵在帝国与法兰西之间周旋，1301年，伯国西部的“属法巴尔鲁瓦”成为向法兰西王冠宣誓的封土。1337年，巴尔伯爵爱德华一世去世，其子亨利四世继位，之后是爱德华二世的短暂统治。1352年起在位的罗贝尔于1354年升格为公爵并成为法兰西重臣，他于1411年去世，继任者爱德华三世于1415年战死于阿金库尔。最后一位男嗣公爵、枢机主教路易死于1431年，巴尔传给其侄孙、洛林女公爵之夫安茹的勒内。1480年勒内死后，巴尔与洛林合并，1506年的遗嘱更规定两个公国永不分离。1738年的《维也纳条约》把巴尔交给流亡的波兰国王斯坦尼斯瓦夫·莱什琴斯基，1766年他去世后，巴尔正式并入法兰西王冠领地。

en: The counts of Brienne held Brienne-le-Chateau in Champagne from the tenth century, as vassals of the counts of Champagne. Count Erard II died on the Third Crusade in 1191, leaving sons who carried the house far beyond its small county. His younger son John, born around 1170, ruled Brienne as regent for his nephew and in 1210 married the heiress of the Kingdom of Jerusalem, ruling there as king and leading the Fifth Crusade against Damietta; after giving his daughter Isabella II in marriage to the Emperor Frederick II he lost the kingdom, and in 1229 was elected Latin emperor of Constantinople, ruling that shrunken crusader state until his death in 1237. The elder line meanwhile built a second fortune in southern Italy, holding Lecce and Conversano in the Angevin kingdom of Naples. Hugh of Brienne married into the ruling family of the Duchy of Athens, and his son Walter V became duke of Athens in 1308, only to be defeated and killed by the Catalan Company at the Battle of Halmyros in 1311. Walter VI, count in 1337 and later constable of France, spent years trying in vain to reconquer Athens, and fell fighting the English at Poitiers in 1356. On the death of his sister Isabella in 1360 the county passed to the Enghien family, and afterwards to the Luxembourgs of Saint-Pol; the duchy of Brienne, created in 1587, expired with its last duke in 1608.
zh: 布里耶纳伯爵家族自10世纪起就领有香槟的布里耶纳堡，是香槟伯爵的封臣。伯爵埃拉尔二世在1191年的第三次十字军中死于圣地，他的几个儿子把家族的事业远远带出了这座小伯国。幼子约翰约生于1170年，先替侄子摄政布里耶纳，1210年娶耶路撒冷王国女继承人并就任国王，还率领第五次十字军进攻杜姆亚特；后来他把女儿伊莎贝拉二世嫁给皇帝腓特烈二世，因此丢掉了耶路撒冷王位，1229年又被选为君士坦丁堡拉丁皇帝，统治这个日益萎缩的十字军国家直到1237年去世。长支则在意大利南部另辟基业，在安茹家族的那不勒斯王国领有莱切和孔韦尔萨诺。于格·布里耶纳娶了雅典公国统治家族的女子，其子沃尔特五世于1308年成为雅典公爵，却在1311年的阿尔米罗斯之战中被加泰罗尼亚佣兵团击败身亡。1337年在位的沃尔特六世后来官至法兰西统帅，多年试图收复雅典都徒劳无功，最终于1356年在普瓦捷与英格兰人作战时阵亡。1360年其妹伊莎贝拉去世后，伯国转给昂吉安家族，后来又归圣波勒的卢森堡家族；1587年设立的布里耶纳公爵头衔在1608年末代公爵死后废止。

en: The de Burghs were an Anglo-Norman house that crossed to Ireland with the invasion and became one of the greatest lordly lines in the island. Their founder William de Burgh, born about 1160 and brother of Hubert de Burgh, regent of England, married a daughter of the king of Thomond and won a lordship in Connacht through campaigns in Munster and the west. His son Richard Mór became Lord of Connacht, and his grandchildren rose to be Earls of Ulster, holding castles such as Carrickfergus. A daughter of the house, Elizabeth de Burgh, married Robert the Bruce, while the infant heiress of the Brown Earl William Donn married Lionel of Antwerp, son of Edward III. When the Brown Earl was murdered by his own knights in June 1333, after starving his cousin Walter Liath to death the year before, his Irish inheritance collapsed into the Burke Civil War of 1333 to 1338, from which three Gaelicised clans emerged: the Clanricarde Burkes of Galway, the Mayo Burkes of north Connacht, and the Clanwilliam line of Castleconnell, whose founder drowned in Lough Mask in 1338. These branches dominated Connacht for three centuries. In 1543 Ulick Burke was made Earl of Clanricarde, while the Mayo line later became Viscounts and Earls of Mayo. The ninth Earl of Clanricarde fought for James II and was captured at Aughrim in 1691, and in the eighteenth century the Galway line exchanged the surname Burke for the older de Burgh.
zh: 伯格家族是随诺曼入侵进入爱尔兰的盎格鲁—诺曼名门，后来成为岛上最显赫的领主世系之一。开山始祖威廉·德·伯格约生于1160年，其兄是英格兰摄政休伯特·德·伯格；他娶了索蒙德国王之女，凭在芒斯特和爱尔兰西部的战功受封康诺特领地。其子理查德·莫尔成为康诺特领主，孙辈又晋为阿尔斯特伯爵，坐拥卡里克弗格斯等城堡。家族的伊丽莎白·德·伯格嫁给罗伯特·布鲁斯，棕伯爵威廉·唐年幼的女继承人则嫁给爱德华三世之子安特卫普的莱昂内尔。棕伯爵前一年将表亲沃尔特·利亚饿死，1333年6月自己也被手下骑士谋杀，他在爱尔兰的遗产随即陷入1333至1338年的伯格内战，战后形成三个盖尔化支系：戈尔韦的克兰里卡德·伯克、北康诺特的梅奥·伯克，以及卡斯尔康奈尔的克兰威廉支系，其始祖1338年溺死于马斯克湖。此后三百年间，这些支系左右着康诺特的政局。1543年尤利克·伯克受封克兰里卡德伯爵，梅奥支系后来成为梅奥子爵和伯爵。第九代克兰里卡德伯爵为詹姆斯二世作战，1691年在奥赫里姆被俘；18世纪，戈尔韦一支又把姓氏伯克改回更古老的德·伯格。

en: The House of Evreux was a cadet branch of the Capetian kings of France, founded by Louis, Count of Evreux, a younger son of King Philip III and Marie of Brabant. The family rose to royalty when Louis's son Philip married Joan II, daughter of King Louis X: in 1328, as the Capetian main line died out, the couple inherited the Kingdom of Navarre, ending its forty-four-year personal union with France, while keeping the County of Evreux and other French fiefs. In 1337 Philip III and Joan II ruled jointly, and Philip led Navarrese troops for his Valois cousin Philip VI in the opening campaigns of the Hundred Years' War at Cambrai and Tournai. He died in 1343 during the crusader siege of Algeciras in Granada, and Joan reigned alone until 1349, when their son Charles II, called the Bad, succeeded. His line produced Charles III and Blanche I; with Blanche's death in 1441 the Evreux dynasty came to an end and Navarre passed to the House of Trastamara through her husband. Other daughters became queens of France and England, including Joan of Navarre, wife of Henry IV.
zh: 埃夫勒家族是法兰西卡佩王室的支系，始祖路易是国王腓力三世与布拉班特的玛丽所生的幼子，受封埃夫勒伯爵。家族的王权来自路易之子腓力与国王路易十世之女胡安娜二世的婚姻：1328年卡佩长支绝嗣，夫妻俩继承纳瓦拉王国，结束了纳瓦拉与法兰西长达四十四年的共主邦联，同时仍保有埃夫勒伯国等法兰西封地。1337年，腓力三世与胡安娜二世共同在位，百年战争初期，腓力还率领纳瓦拉军队跟随瓦卢瓦堂兄腓力六世征战康布雷和图尔奈。1343年，他在格拉纳达的十字军围城战阿尔赫西拉斯之围中病死，胡安娜独自统治到1349年，由儿子“恶人”查理二世继位。这一支后来又出了查理三世和布兰卡一世；1441年布兰卡去世，埃夫勒王朝终结，纳瓦拉经她的丈夫转入特拉斯塔马拉家族之手。家族的其他女儿还曾成为法兰西和英格兰王后，其中就有嫁给亨利四世的纳瓦拉的胡安娜。

en:
The House of Rochechouart, named after its castle in the Limousin, is counted among the oldest noble families in France. It traces itself to Foucher, a follower of Charles the Bald who was made viscount of Limoges in 876; in 980 Aimery de Limoges received the lands of Rochechouart as the dowry of Eve, daughter of the count of Angoulême, and became the first viscount of Rochechouart. Late in the thirteenth century Aimery XI granted the town a charter of enfranchisement, with four elected consuls and no taille, which remained in force until 1789.

The viscounts stayed loyal to the French crown through the Hundred Years' War: Viscount Jean fought at Crécy in 1346, saw his town sacked by the English, and was killed at Poitiers in 1356 while shielding King John II; his son Louis escaped English captivity to fight beside Bertrand du Guesclin. A later Rochechouart, Geoffroy, campaigned with Joan of Arc, and Foucaud took part in the victory of Castillon in 1453. The Mortemart branch rose at court under Louis XIII, and in 1663 Gabriel de Rochechouart became Duke of Mortemart and a peer of France; his daughter Françoise-Athénaïs, Madame de Montespan, was the mistress of Louis XIV from 1667 to 1680. The Revolution cost several members their heads on the scaffold in 1794, but the family returned under the Restoration, and in 1830 Charles X called Casimir de Rochechouart to be his chief minister only days before the July Revolution ended the monarchy.
zh:
罗什舒阿尔家族以其在利穆赞的城堡得名，被视为法国最古老的贵族世家之一。其始祖可追溯到秃头查理的追随者富歇尔，他于876年受封利摩日子爵；980年，利摩日的艾默里迎娶昂古莱姆伯爵之女夏娃，以罗什舒阿尔领地为嫁妆，成为第一代罗什舒阿尔子爵。13世纪末，艾默里十一世向城镇居民颁布解放特许状，设四名选举产生的执政官并免除塔耶税，该特许状一直施行到1789年。
