百年战争中，历代子爵始终效忠法兰西王权：子爵让参加了1346年的克雷西会战，领地城镇遭英军洗劫，1356年又在普瓦捷会战中为掩护国王约翰二世而战死；其子路易从英俘中逃脱后，投到贝特朗·杜·盖克兰麾下作战。后人若弗鲁瓦曾随贞德征战，富尔科则参加了1453年的卡斯蒂永大捷。莫特马尔一支在路易十三时兴起，加布里埃尔·德·罗什舒阿尔于1663年成为莫特马尔公爵和法国贵族院议员；其女弗朗索瓦丝—阿泰纳伊斯即蒙特斯潘夫人，1667年至1680年是路易十四的宠妃。法国大革命期间，家族数人在1794年被送上断头台，但波旁复辟后家族重返高位；1830年，查理十世任命卡西米尔·德·罗什舒阿尔为首相，然而几天之后七月革命便推翻了君主制。

en: The lords of Ventadour took their name from the castle of Ventadour in the Limousin, the present-day Corrèze. The viscounty was formed around 1060 when the viscounty of Comborn was divided in favour of Ebles I, son of the viscount of Comborn, and a long line of viscounts bearing the name Ebles followed. The family's early fame belongs to Occitan poetry: Ebles II, called the Singer, was himself a troubadour, and the young Bernart de Ventadorn, the most celebrated poet-composer of the troubadour age, learned his art at the castle under Eble III before following Eleanor of Aquitaine to the Plantagenet court. In 1350 the viscounty was raised to a county, and Count Jacques de Ventadour was killed fighting the English at Verneuil in 1424. The original line ended with Blanche de Ventadour, whose marriage to Louis de Lévis in 1472 carried the county into the Lévis family, henceforth called de Lévis-Ventadour. Their descendants had the county raised to a duchy and peerage, and in the eighteenth century the title passed, again by marriage, to the House of Rohan-Soubise.
zh: 旺塔杜尔家族得名于利穆赞地区（今科雷兹省）的旺塔杜尔城堡。约1060年，孔博恩子爵领被一分为二，孔博恩子爵之子厄布尔一世得到其中东部，建立旺塔杜尔子爵领，此后历代子爵多取名厄布尔。家族早年的声名与奥克语诗歌相连：绰号“歌手”的厄布尔二世本人就是特罗巴多诗人，而特罗巴多黄金时代最负盛名的诗人兼作曲家贝尔纳·德·旺塔杜恩，正是在厄布尔三世的城堡里学艺，后来追随阿基坦的埃莉诺前往金雀花宫廷。1350年，子爵领被升格为伯国；伯爵雅克·德·旺塔杜尔于1424年在韦尔讷伊战役中与英军作战时阵亡。嫡系随着布朗什·德·旺塔杜尔而终结：她于1472年嫁给路易·德·莱维，伯国随之转入莱维家族，改称莱维-旺塔杜尔。其后代又使伯国升格为公爵领和法兰西贵族爵位，18世纪该头衔再经联姻转入罗昂-苏比斯家族。

en: The del Vasto were the principal branch of the Aleramici, the Frankish dynasty installed in Piedmont and western Liguria by the tenth-century Ottonian grants, taking their name from the devastated borderlands between the Tanaro and the Orba. Their defining figure was Boniface del Vasto, margrave of Savona from 1084, whose sons fanned out across northern Italy: Manfred I founded the marquisate of Saluzzo, Anselm began the margraves of Ceva, and Henry's line became the del Carretto, while the Lancia branch later gave Bianca Lancia, wife of the Emperor Frederick II. Boniface also raised his niece Adelaide del Vasto, who married first Roger I of Sicily and then King Baldwin I of Jerusalem, tying the house to the Norman kingdoms of the Mediterranean. The Saluzzo line, the most enduring, ruled its Alpine marquisate for five centuries: it was overshadowed by the rising House of Savoy, reached its height under the mediator Ludovico I in the fifteenth century, and under Ludovico II opened the Buco di Viso, the first Alpine road tunnel, before dynastic quarrels drew in France, which deposed the last marquis Gabriele and annexed Saluzzo in 1548.
zh: 德尔·瓦斯托家族是法兰克阿莱拉米奇王朝的主要支系；阿莱拉米奇人10世纪凭奥托王朝的封赐立足皮埃蒙特和西利古里亚，家族之名来自塔纳罗河与奥尔巴河之间遭兵燹荒废的边地。家族的关键人物是1084年起任萨沃纳藩侯的博尼法乔·德尔·瓦斯托，他的儿子们遍布北意大利：曼弗雷迪一世开创萨卢佐侯国，安塞尔莫是切瓦藩侯的始祖，亨利一支后来成为德尔·卡雷托家族，而兰恰支系出了神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈二世的妻子比安卡·兰恰。博尼法乔还抚养了侄女阿德莱德·德尔·瓦斯托，她先嫁西西里的罗杰一世，再嫁耶路撒冷国王鲍德温一世，使家族与地中海的诺曼诸王国联姻。最持久的萨卢佐一脉在阿尔卑斯山麓的侯国统治了五个世纪：它长期受崛起的萨伏依家族压制，15世纪在善于调停的卢多维科一世治下达到鼎盛；卢多维科二世时期开凿了第一条阿尔卑斯公路隧道“维索洞”，但家族继承纠纷引法国入局，1548年末代藩侯加布里埃莱被废，萨卢佐被法国吞并。

en: The della Faggiola were a minor noble family of the Massa Trabaria, the Apennine border country between Romagna, Tuscany and the Marche, where they held the castle of Casteldelci near Rimini. Their place in history belongs almost entirely to Uguccione della Faggiola, born around 1250, a Ghibelline soldier who served as podestà of Arezzo and imperial vicar in Genoa for Henry VII before being called to Pisa in 1313. He made himself lord of Pisa, sacked Lucca in 1314 with his protégé Castruccio Castracani, and on 29 August 1315 crushed the Florentine Guelphs and their Angevin allies at Montecatini, the worst Guelph defeat since 1260. Driven out of Pisa and Lucca by revolts in 1316, he took service with Cangrande della Scala as podestà of Vicenza and died of malaria on 1 November 1319 during the siege of Padua, leaving his kin to continue as local feudatories in the Rimini Apennines.
zh: 德拉·法焦拉家族是马萨特拉巴里亚的小贵族，那里是罗马涅、托斯卡纳和马尔凯之间的亚平宁边境地带，家族在里米尼附近的卡斯泰尔泰尔奇拥有城堡。它在历史上的地位几乎全靠约1250年出生的乌古乔内·德拉·法焦拉：这位吉伯林派军人曾任阿雷佐的最高行政官，并在热那亚为皇帝亨利七世担任帝国代理人，1313年被请往比萨。他成为比萨的实际领主，1314年在门生卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼协助下洗劫卢卡，又于1315年8月29日在蒙特卡蒂尼击溃佛罗伦萨归尔夫派及其安茹盟友，这是归尔夫派自1260年以来最惨重的失败。1316年比萨和卢卡相继起义将他赶走，他投奔坎格兰德·德拉·斯卡拉，出任维琴察最高行政官，1319年11月1日在围攻帕多瓦期间死于疟疾，其族人则继续在里米尼一带的亚平宁山区做地方封建主。

en: The della Rocca were one of the five great Cinarchesi noble clans of southern Corsica, holding the lordship of Rocca in the island's mountainous south after Genoa replaced Pisa as Corsica's ruler at the end of the thirteenth century. Guglielmo della Rocca was named vicar of the Genoese governor for the southern half of the island in 1340, but in 1353 he rebelled against the Republic and declared for the Crown of Aragon, whose kings claimed Corsica; he was defeated and died in 1354. His son Arrigo, held hostage in Genoa as a pledge of loyalty, escaped in 1356 and fled to Catalonia during the anti-feudal revolt of 1357, entering Aragonese service. In February 1372 he landed in the Gulf of Valinco with Aragonese troops, overran most of the island and was elected count of Corsica at the assembly of Biguglia in 1373, ruling as the leader of the aristocratic party under Aragonese suzerainty. He outfaced the Genoese maona of Corsica for more than a decade, was driven into Aragon in 1392, returned with an army in 1394 and crushed another Genoese invasion at Biguglia in 1397, before dying of plague at Frasso in June 1401.
zh: 德拉·罗卡氏是科西嘉南部奇纳尔凯西五大贵族氏族之一，13世纪末热那亚取代比萨成为科西嘉的统治者之后，他们在岛屿南部山区据有罗卡领地。古列尔莫·德拉·罗卡于1340年被任命为热那亚总督治下南半岛的代官，但他在1353年举兵反叛共和国，转而向对科西嘉提出主权要求的阿拉贡王室称臣，结果兵败，于1354年死去。他的儿子阿里戈曾作为效忠人质被扣在热那亚，1356年逃脱，又在1357年的反封建暴动中逃往加泰罗尼亚，转而为阿拉贡国王服役。1372年2月，他率阿拉贡军队在瓦林科湾登陆，席卷岛上大部地区，并于1373年在比古利亚集会上被推举为科西嘉伯爵，以阿拉贡宗主权下贵族派领袖的身份统治全岛。他与热那亚的科西嘉马奥纳公司周旋了十余年，1392年被逐往阿拉贡，1394年又带兵返回，1397年在比古利亚粉碎热那亚的再次入侵，最终于1401年6月在弗拉索死于瘟疫。

en: The della Torre, known in Latin as the Torriani, were a Milanese noble house who led the Guelph faction in Lombardy and held the lordship of Milan before the Visconti. Taking their name from a tower house in the Porta Nuova district of Milan, they were enfeoffed with the county of Valsassina and supplied podestà to cities across northern Italy from the early thirteenth century. Pagano della Torre became captain of the people of Milan in 1240, and his nephew Martino turned the office into a family signoria from 1256. The house's supremacy ended in 1277, when Napoleone della Torre was defeated and captured by Archbishop Ottone Visconti at the Battle of Desio and died in prison, though Corrado Mosca della Torre briefly restored Torriani rule in Milan between 1302 and 1307. Driven from Lombardy, the family found a new base in Friuli: Raimondo della Torre was Patriarch of Aquileia from 1273 and waged war on Venice, and three more della Torre followed him in that patriarchate. Other branches entered imperial service in Austria and Bohemia as the counts von Thurn und Valsassina, the most famous being Heinrich Matthias von Thurn, a leader of the Bohemian revolt that opened the Thirty Years' War in 1618.
zh: 德拉·托雷家族（拉丁文献中称托里亚尼）是米兰贵族世家，在伦巴第统领圭尔夫派，并先于维斯孔蒂家族掌握米兰领主权。家族得名于米兰新门区的一座塔楼，受封瓦尔萨西纳伯国，13世纪初起家族成员在北意大利多座城市出任市政长官。帕加诺·德拉·托雷于1240年成为米兰人民首领，其侄马尔蒂诺从1256年起把这一职位变成家族世袭僭主统治。1277年家族霸权终结：纳波莱奥内·德拉·托雷在代西奥战役中被大主教奥托内·维斯孔蒂击败俘虏，死于狱中；不过科拉多·莫斯卡·德拉·托雷曾在1302至1307年短暂恢复家族在米兰的统治。被逐出伦巴第后，家族在弗留利找到新根基：拉伊蒙多·德拉·托雷自1273年起任阿奎莱亚宗主教并对威尼斯开战，此后又有三位家族成员出任该宗主教。另一些支系进入奥地利和波希米亚，为神圣罗马帝国皇帝效力，受封图恩-瓦尔萨西纳伯爵；其中最著名的是海因里希·马蒂亚斯·冯·图恩，他是1618年引爆三十年战争的波希米亚起义领袖之一。

en: The Deramku were the Arab royal house of the Kingdom of Hormuz, named after Muhammad Diramku, also called Deramkub or the dirham minter, who emigrated from Oman to the Iranian coast in the eleventh century and founded the kingdom as a dependency of the Seljuk rulers of Kerman. His descendants, at first tributary to the Salghurids of Fars and afterwards to the Ilkhanate, built Hormuz into the leading emporium of the Persian Gulf, controlling both shores and Omani ports such as Qalhat and levying tolls on traffic through the strait. Under Emir Rukn al-Din Mahmud Qalhati (r. 1249-1286) the kingdom tilted its power towards Bahrain and Oman, and around 1300, as raids made the mainland capital near Minab unsafe, the fifteenth king Mir Bahrudin Ayaz moved the court to the island of Jerun, the later Hormuz island, where Hurmuzi merchants had just cast off Persian overlordship. The island city became a by-word for wealth and luxury until Afonso de Albuquerque seized it for Portugal in 1515; the Deramku kings then ruled as Portuguese clients until Shah Abbas the Great, with English help, conquered Hormuz in 1622.
zh: 德拉姆库家族是霍尔木兹王国的阿拉伯王室，得名于穆罕默德·迪拉姆库，又称迪拉姆库布（意为“迪拉姆铸造者”）。他在11世纪从阿曼迁居伊朗沿海，作为克尔曼塞尔柱统治者的附庸建立了王国。他的后裔先后向法尔斯的萨尔古尔王朝和伊利汗国称臣纳贡，却把霍尔木兹经营成波斯湾首屈一指的商贸中心，控制海湾两岸和盖勒哈特等阿曼港口，并对通行海峡的商船征税。埃米尔鲁肯丁·马哈茂德·卡拉提在位期间（1249—1286年），王国把势力转向巴林和阿曼；约1300年，由于米纳布附近的大陆都城屡遭劫掠、不再安全，第十五代国王米尔·巴哈丁·阿亚兹把朝廷迁往杰鲁恩岛，即后来的霍尔木兹岛，而霍尔木兹商人恰在此时摆脱了波斯宗主权。这座岛城成为财富与奢华的代名词，直到1515年阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克为葡萄牙夺取该岛；德拉姆库诸王此后作为葡萄牙附庸统治，1622年阿拔斯大帝在英国人协助下攻占霍尔木兹，王朝终结。

en: The le Despensers were an English baronial family whose landed wealth in the East Midlands went back to Hugh le Despenser, High Sheriff of Berkshire, who died in 1238. His son, the first Baron le Despenser, died beside Simon de Montfort at the Battle of Evesham in 1265. The family reached its height under Edward II: Hugh the Elder was made Earl of Winchester in 1322, while his son Hugh the Younger married Eleanor de Clare, inherited Glamorgan, and became the king's chief favourite and chamberlain. Their greed and monopoly of power drove Queen Isabella and Roger Mortimer's rebellion of 1326; the elder Hugh was hanged at Bristol and the younger hanged, drawn and quartered at Hereford, and their titles were forfeit. The line nonetheless recovered: the younger Hugh's son was summoned to Parliament as Baron le Despenser in 1338, his grandson Edward became a Knight of the Garter, and Edward's son Thomas was made Earl of Gloucester before being executed in 1400. Another grandson, Henry le Despenser, ruled as the fighting Bishop of Norwich until 1406.
zh: 勒德斯潘塞家族是英格兰的男爵世家，其在英格兰中部的地产可追溯到1238年去世的伯克郡高级治安官休·勒德斯潘塞。他的儿子、第一代勒德斯潘塞男爵于1265年在伊夫舍姆战役中与西蒙·德·孟福尔一同战死。家族在爱德华二世治下达到鼎盛：老休于1322年受封温切斯特伯爵，其子小休娶埃莉诺·德·克莱尔为妻，继承格拉摩根，成为国王的首席宠臣和王室总管。他们的贪婪与专权引发了伊莎贝拉王后和罗杰·莫蒂默1326年的叛乱；老休在布里斯托尔被绞死，小休在赫里福德被处绞刑、车裂并分尸，家族头衔被剥夺。但家族很快恢复：小休的儿子于1338年被召入议会成为勒德斯潘塞男爵，其孙爱德华受封嘉德骑士，爱德华之子托马斯受封格洛斯特伯爵，后于1400年被处决。另一个孙子亨利·勒德斯潘塞则以好战的诺里奇主教身份当权，直到1406年去世。

en: The House of Este was a noble family of Frankish origin, probably a branch of the Obertenghi, whose name came from the castle of Este near Padua built by Albert Azzo II in the eleventh century. His sons split the house: the elder Welf line became dukes of Bavaria and Brunswick, produced the Emperor Otto IV and, through the Hanoverians, the British kings, while the younger line founded by Fulco I made its fortune in Italy. Obizzo II was made lord of Ferrara in 1264 and added Modena in 1288 and Reggio in 1289; in 1332 the family became hereditary papal vicars of Ferrara, the position it held in 1337. Under Niccolò III the court hosted the council of 1438 later called the Council of Florence, and Borso d'Este was raised to duke of Modena and Reggio in 1452 and duke of Ferrara in 1471. Ercole I and Alfonso I, husband of Lucrezia Borgia, made Ferrara a center of music and letters, patronising Josquin des Prez and Ariosto, while Isabella and Beatrice d'Este married into the Gonzaga and Sforza. The legitimate line ended with Alfonso II in 1597, and Pope Clement VIII seized Ferrara in 1598; a cadet branch kept Modena and Reggio until the French deposed Ercole III in 1796, the male line dying out in 1803 and the inheritance passing to the Austrian House of Austria-Este.
zh: 埃斯特家族是起源于法兰克的贵族世家，一般认为是奥贝尔滕吉家族的支系，其名称来自阿尔贝托·阿佐二世于11世纪在帕多瓦附近修建的埃斯特城堡。他的儿子们将家族分为两支：长支韦尔夫一支先后成为巴伐利亚和不伦瑞克的公爵，出过神圣罗马帝国皇帝奥托四世，并经汉诺威一支成为英国国王；幼支由富尔科一世开创，在意大利发迹。奥比佐二世于1264年成为费拉拉领主，又在1288年和1289年相继取得摩德纳和雷焦；1332年家族成为费拉拉的世袭教皇代理人，这也是它在1337年时的地位。尼科洛三世治下，费拉拉宫廷在1438年承办了后来称佛罗伦萨公会议的宗教会议；博尔索·德斯特于1452年被封为摩德纳和雷焦公爵，1471年又受封费拉拉公爵。埃尔科莱一世与卢克雷齐娅·博尔贾的丈夫阿方索一世把费拉拉建成音乐与文学中心，庇护过若斯坎·德普雷和阿里奥斯托，伊莎贝拉和贝亚特丽切·德斯特则分别嫁入贡扎加与斯福尔扎家族。嫡系随阿方索二世于1597年绝嗣，教皇克雷芒八世于1598年夺取费拉拉；旁支继续统治摩德纳和雷焦，直到1796年法国人废黜埃尔科莱三世。男系于1803年断绝，遗产转入奥地利的奥地利-埃斯特家族。

en: The di Murta took their name from the village of Murta in the Polcevera valley, now part of Genoa, where they were a family of affluent commoners linked by marriage to the patrician Usodimare. Its only doge was Giovanni di Murta, a banker by trade, who was elected on 25 December 1345 after the resignation of Simone Boccanegra, becoming the second doge in the republic's history. He checked the Grimaldi faction at home and sent the fleet of Simone Vignoso to relieve Chios from the siege of Jani Beg, khan of the Golden Horde, and to retake Phocaea with its alum mines in 1346; unable to pay the captains, he vested the island's revenues in them, creating the Maona of Chios and Phocaea. He charged his son Tommaso di Murta with the reconquest of Corsica, where only Bonifacio still flew the Genoese flag, and the campaign broke the island's feudal anarchy. His dogate saw the Black Death reach Genoa from Kaffa in 1347, and Giovanni himself died of the plague on 6 January 1350, remembered as a peacemaker and a lover of the common good.
zh: 迪·穆尔塔家族得名于波尔切韦拉河谷的穆尔塔村（今属热那亚），是富裕的平民家族，并通过婚姻与贵族乌索迪马雷家族联姻。家族唯一的总督是银行家出身的乔瓦尼·迪·穆尔塔：1345年12月25日西蒙尼·波卡涅拉辞职后，他当选为热那亚共和国历史上第二任总督。任内他在内政上遏制格里马尔迪派，又派海军将领西蒙尼·维尼奥索的舰队驰援被金帐汗国可汗札尼别围攻的希俄斯，并于1346年收复福西亚及其明矾矿；由于无力支付船主们的巨额酬金，他把希俄斯的税收授予这些投资人，由此组成希俄斯与福西亚马奥纳。他还命其子托马索·迪·穆尔塔率军收复科西嘉——当时岛上只剩博尼法乔仍挂热那亚旗帜——这次征战结束了岛上的封建混乱。他执政期间，黑死病于1347年从卡法传入热那亚，乔瓦尼本人也在1350年1月6日染疫病故，身后被视为平息纷争、热心公益的政治家。

en: The da Pagana were a Genoese mercantile family named after San Michele di Pagana, a village of Rapallo on the Levante Riviera near Lavagna. They belonged to the Ghibelline, popular faction of the Republic of Genoa. The best-documented member is Federico da Pagana, born in Genoa in 1315, whose father Nicolò had helped fortify the Genoese Black Sea colony of Caffa in Crimea. A merchant turned statesman, Federico was among the electors of the first doge Simone Boccanegra in 1339, served as ambassador to several Italian courts including the Visconti, and went as special envoy to the Emperor Charles IV in Vienna. On 7 April 1383 he was acclaimed doge after Nicolò Guarco was driven from office, but Leonardo Montaldo had the election annulled the very same day and took his place, making Federico the shortest-reigned doge in Genoese history. He then returned to trade and died in Genoa in 1406.
zh: 达·帕加纳家族是热那亚的商人世家，族名来自东里维埃拉拉帕洛境内、邻近拉瓦尼亚的村庄圣米凯莱-迪帕加纳，在热那亚共和国中属于吉伯林派的平民势力。记载最详的成员是1315年生于热那亚的费德里科·达·帕加纳，他的父亲尼科洛曾参与加固热那亚在黑海克里米亚的殖民地卡法。费德里科由商入仕，1339年参与选举首任总督西蒙·波卡涅拉，后出任驻维斯孔蒂等意大利宫廷的使节，还曾作为专使前往维也纳觐见皇帝查理四世。1383年4月7日，尼科洛·瓜尔科被赶下台后，他被推举为总督，但莱昂纳多·蒙塔尔多当天就宣布选举无效并取而代之，使他成为热那亚在位最短的总督。此后他重操经商旧业，1406年死于热那亚。

en: The lords of Diepholz were a noble house of the Middle Weser, seated at a castle east of the Dümmer lake. Cono and William of Diepholz appear in Osnabrück charters in 1160, and the nobleman Gottschalk of Diepholz is said to have followed Henry the Lion into English exile after 1182. Back in Saxony the family enlarged its allodial lands north and south during the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, until the marshes, the Bishopric of Minden and the County of Hoya checked further growth. The house married into the wider Westphalian nobility; Rudolf II of Diepholz, who died in 1303, wed Maria, daughter of King Waldemar of Sweden. In 1337 the lords Conrad and Rudolf still held the small territory around their castle. It became an imperial fief in 1512, adopted the Reformation in 1528 and took the title of count in 1530. The last count, Frederick II, died in 1585, and Diepholz fell to the Dukes of Brunswick-Lüneburg, apart from the Auburg district taken by Hesse.
zh: 迪普霍尔茨家族是中威悉地区的贵族世家，驻在迪默湖以东的城堡。1160年，康诺和威廉·冯·迪普霍尔茨已出现在奥斯纳布吕克的文书中；领主戈特沙尔克据说在1182年后随狮子亨利流亡英格兰。返回萨克森后，家族在13、14世纪向南北两面扩张自有地，直到被沼泽、明登主教区和霍亚伯国挡住去路。家族主要与威斯特伐利亚周边贵族联姻，1303年去世的鲁道夫二世娶了瑞典国王瓦尔德马尔之女玛丽亚。1337年时，康拉德和鲁道夫等领主仍据守着城堡周围的小片领地。该地1512年成为帝国采邑，1528年改宗新教，1530年家族取得伯爵头衔。末代伯爵弗里德里希二世于1585年去世，迪普霍尔茨随之落入不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵之手，只有奥堡辖区被黑森取走。

en: The counts of Diez were a medieval comital house in the middle Lahn valley, first documented in 1073 when Count Embricho and his brother sold estates near Badenheim to the Saint Victor chapter at Mainz. Probably installed as office counts by the Salian kings, they made Diez Castle their seat and ruled a territory stretching along the Lahn below Weilburg, into the Westerwald and the fertile Goldener Grund, which contemporaries called the Golden County. Their power peaked under the Staufer: Henry II of Diez, who died in 1189, inherited rich Wetterau lands through a Nurings heiress and accompanied Frederick Barbarossa on his Italian campaigns, while his son Gerhard II sat on the regency council for the young Henry VII and founded the family abbey at Salz before 1255. Decline set in when the Weilnau cadet branch split off and in 1302 formed its own county, later moving to Birstein, while the Diez line pledged more and more rights to Nassau, Trier and Katzenelnbogen. Count Gottfried, born in 1303, was ruled incapable of governing and placed under the guardianship of Emich of Nassau-Hadamar from 1317 to 1332; his son Gerhard VI died feuding against the city of Limburg in 1343. When the last count, Gerhard VII, died in 1388, the county passed through his daughter Jutta to her husband Adolf of Nassau-Dillenburg, and was later partitioned between Nassau, Eppstein and the archbishopric of Trier.
zh: 迪茨伯爵家族是中世纪拉恩河中游的伯爵世家，1073年首次见于文献，当时恩姆布里希伯爵及其兄弟将巴登海姆附近的地产卖给美因茨的圣维克多修会。他们很可能是萨利安国王任命的职务伯爵，以迪茨城堡为驻地，领地沿拉恩河延伸到威尔堡以下，北入韦斯特林山，东抵肥沃的金色谷地，当时人称之为金色伯国。家族权势在霍亨斯陶芬时期达到顶峰：1189年去世的迪茨伯爵亨利二世通过娶尼灵斯家族的女继承人继承了韦特劳的大片土地，并随腓特烈一世（巴巴罗萨）远征意大利；其子格哈德二世加入幼王亨利七世的摄政会议，并在1255年前创建了家族修道院萨尔茨修道院。衰落始于维尔瑙支系分出，并于1302年自成伯国、后来迁居比尔施泰因；迪茨本支则不断把权益抵押给拿骚、特里尔和卡岑埃尔恩博根。1303年出生的戈特弗里德伯爵被判定无执政能力，1317至1332年由拿骚-哈达马尔的埃米希监护；其子格哈德六世于1343年在与林堡城的仇杀中丧命。1388年末代伯爵格哈德七世去世，伯国经其女尤塔传给女婿拿骚-迪伦堡伯爵阿道夫，此后在拿骚、埃普施泰因和特里尔大主教区之间分割。

en: The Dilmaçids were a small Turkoman beylik centered on Bitlis in the Armenian Highlands, born from the Turkic settlement of eastern Anatolia after the Seljuk victory at Manzikert in 1071. The ghazi warrior Dilmaç oğlu Mehmet received Bitlis as an iqta grant from the Great Seljuks in 1085, and after his death in 1104 his son Togan Arslan made the principality independent. Togan Arslan joined the Artuqid bey Ilghazi against the Crusaders and fought at the Battle of Ager Sanguinis in 1119, where Roger of Salerno was killed, and he and his successors also warred with Georgia, the Danishmends and rival Turkic beyliks to hold Bitlis. Too small to stand alone, the dynasty then passed through the suzerainty of the Ayyubids, the Khwarazmshahs, the Ilkhanids and Timur, and its rulers are only sparsely recorded in the fourteenth century. Around the 1410s the Aq Qoyunlu Turkomans overran Bitlis and brought the Dilmaçid line to an end.
zh: 迪尔马克王朝是以亚美尼亚高地比特利斯为中心的小型土库曼贝伊国，源于1071年曼齐刻尔特战役后突厥人对东安纳托利亚的拓殖。加齐战士迪尔马克之子穆罕默德于1085年从大塞尔柱王朝手中获得比特利斯作为伊克塔封地，1104年他去世后，其子托甘·阿尔斯兰使贝伊国获得独立。托甘·阿尔斯兰曾联合阿尔图格贝伊伊尔加齐对抗十字军，参加了1119年的萨尔马达之战（血田战役），萨莱诺的罗杰即战死于此役；他和后继者还为保住比特利斯，同格鲁吉亚、达尼什孟德王朝及其他突厥贝伊国连年交战。由于国小势孤，王朝此后相继臣服于阿尤布王朝、花剌子模沙王朝、伊儿汗国和帖木儿，14世纪的统治者记载寥寥。约15世纪10年代，白羊王朝的土库曼人攻占比特利斯，迪尔马克一脉就此终结。

en: The Doi were a cadet branch of the Kōno clan, the great provincial family of Iyo Province on Shikoku, descended like the main line from the ancient Ochi house. They held the Minami-Doi lands in Ishii village of Kume district, and in 1321 Doi Michimasu was entrusted with the maritime defence of Iyo by the Rokuhara tandai in Kyoto. When the Genkō War broke out he was among the first warriors anywhere to declare for Emperor Go-Daigo: in the leap second month of 1333 he rose together with the Tokunō and Kutsuna families, stormed the Iyo shugo's Fuchū Castle, and routed the Nagato tandai Hōjō Tokinao at Ishiihama and again at Hoshioka, his following swelling to more than six thousand horsemen. Under the Kenmu government he was made governor of Bitchū and displayed his archery before the emperor. In the Nanboku-chō wars he followed Nitta Yoshisada on the Southern Court side, fought at the Battle of Minatogawa in 1336, and was killed that autumn in the snowy mountain passes of Echizen when Shiba Takatsune surprised the retreating imperial army.
zh: 土居氏是四国伊予国豪族河野氏的旁流，与宗家同出古老的越智氏，本据在久米郡石井乡的南土居。1321年，土居通增受京都六波罗探题委托，负责伊予的海上警备。元弘之乱爆发后，他是全国最早表态支持后醍醐天皇的武将之一：1333年闰二月，他与得能、忽那等同族举兵，攻克伊予守护的府中城，又在石井浜和星冈接连击败长门探题北条时直，麾下一度聚集六千余骑。建武政权成立后，他受任备中守，还曾在天皇御前表演骑射。南北朝战乱中，他追随新田义贞加入南朝，参加了1336年的凑川之战；同年秋随军北上越前，在荒乳山道遭斯波高经趁雪夜突袭，与一族一同战死。

en: The Dolfin, also italianised as Delfino, were one of the twelve apostolic families of Venice and counted among its oldest houses, traditionally sharing a single origin with the Gradenigo in the tribune families that fled Aquileia for Torcello in 452; the name is documented from 997. Before the Serrata of 1297 they were already among the richest and most powerful lineages of the republic, supplying Procurators of Saint Mark, generals, bishops and ambassadors generation after generation. Their only doge was Giovanni Dolfin, elected in 1356 while he was defending Treviso against a Hungarian army: he broke through the siege to reach Venice and take office. His reign saw Venice's defeat at Nervesa and the Treaty of Zadar of 1358, by which the republic lost Dalmatia, Zara and Split to King Louis I of Hungary, though it kept naval supremacy in the Adriatic. In later centuries the house won renown chiefly as patrons of the arts, employing Titian, Bellini and Tiepolo, building with the architect Sansovino and hosting the composer Vivaldi.
zh: 多尔芬（又译德尔菲诺）家族是威尼斯十二使徒家族之一，也是最古老的世家之一，传统上与格拉代尼戈家族同出一源，先祖是452年为躲避匈人从阿奎莱亚逃到托尔切洛的裁判官家族；其姓氏997年即见文献。早在1297年大议会锁闭之前，他们已是共和国最富有的望族之一，历代出任圣马可行政长官、将领、主教和大使。家族唯一一位总督是乔瓦尼·多尔芬，1356年他正在被匈牙利军队围攻的特雷维索防守时当选，竟突破包围赶回威尼斯就职。任内威尼斯在内尔韦萨战败，1358年签订《扎拉条约》，将达尔马提亚、扎拉和斯普利特割让给匈牙利国王拉约什一世，但保住了亚得里亚海的海上优势。此后几个世纪，该家族主要以艺术赞助闻名，曾提挈提香、贝利尼和提埃波罗，延请建筑师圣索维诺营造宅邸，并接待过作曲家维瓦尔第。

en: The Donboli are a Kurdish tribe, later Turkic-speaking, whose ruling family built one of the longest-lived Kurdish principalities of the age. Sharaf Khan Bidlisi derives them from the Bohtan country, where they were known as the Donbol-e Bokht, and they were originally Yazidis before their chiefs converted to Islam. In the Ilkhanid period Emir Ibrahim Donboli, who died in 1320, stood well with Ilkhan Ghazan; his successors Cemşid and Behlül fought and then made peace with the Mongols, and Behlül died in Hakkâri in 1359. A branch under Isa Beg held Sokmanabad before the rise of the Aq Qoyunlu, whose service Shaikh Ahmad Beg entered, winning Hakkâri and the castle of Bay. Under the Safavids, Shah Tahmasp I joined Sokmanabad to Khoy and enfeoffed Haji Beg with the merged district, but after Haji Beg's murder in 1548 the tribe was bloodily subdued and fled into Ottoman territory, only returning to Safavid allegiance in the early seventeenth century, when Khoy was restored to them. They then ruled the Khoy Khanate as hereditary khans, reaching their greatest power in the later eighteenth century before the Qajar prince Abbas Mirza abolished the khanate in 1799.
zh: 东博利是一支后来改操突厥语的库尔德部落，其统治家族建立了当时延续最久的库尔德政权之一。谢里夫汗·比德利西认为他们源自博赫丹地区，旧称“博赫特的东博利”；他们本信奉雅兹迪教，后来首领们改宗伊斯兰教。伊儿汗时期，东博利埃米尔易卜拉欣（1320年卒）与伊儿汗合赞交好，后继的杰姆希德和贝赫卢勒先与蒙古人作战而后议和，贝赫卢勒于1359年死于哈卡里。伊萨贝格一支在白羊王朝兴起前领有索克马纳巴德，其后人谢赫·艾哈迈德贝格出仕白羊王朝，取得哈卡里和巴伊城堡。萨法维王朝的塔赫玛斯普一世把索克马纳巴德并入霍伊，封哈吉贝格为合并后的长官；1548年哈吉贝格遇刺后，部落遭血腥镇压并逃入奥斯曼境内，17世纪初才重新归附萨法维，霍伊也在1620年代归还。此后他们以世袭汗位统治霍伊汗国，18世纪后期势力达到顶峰，最终于1799年被卡扎尔王子阿巴斯·米尔札废除。

en: The Doria, first recorded as the de Auria, or sons of Auria, with two members named in 1110, were one of the oldest and richest noble houses of Genoa, possibly descended from the Arduinici counts of Auriate in Piedmont. From fiefs in the western Riviera at Dolceacqua, Oneglia and Portofino and large estates in Sardinia, they rose to command the republic itself, first as captains of the people and later as doges. Oberto Doria led Genoa to its decisive naval victory over Pisa at La Meloria in 1284, and his brother Lamba Doria crushed the Venetian fleet at Curzola in 1298, while Tedisio Doria financed the Vivaldi brothers' Atlantic voyage of 1291. Brancaleone Doria ruled the Sardinian Giudicato of Arborea and came close to conquering the whole island, and Ottone Doria died leading the Genoese crossbowmen at the Battle of Crecy in 1346. The house reached its peak with Andrea Doria, born in 1466, admiral of the Emperor Charles V, who refounded the Genoese republic in 1528 and was made Prince of Melfi in 1531. After his death in 1560 his adopted heir's line kept the titles, and several later Doria sat as doges of Genoa down to the seventeenth century.
zh: 多里亚家族最早以“德奥里亚”（奥里亚之子）之名见载，1110年已有两位成员留名，是热那亚最古老、最富有的贵族世家之一，可能源出皮埃蒙特奥里亚泰的阿尔杜伊尼奇伯爵家族。他们以利古里亚西部里维埃拉的多切阿夸、奥内利亚、菲诺港以及撒丁岛的大片领地为根基，逐步掌握共和国大权，先任人民首领，后任总督。奥贝托·多里亚率热那亚舰队在1284年的梅洛里亚海战中决定性击败比萨，其弟兰巴·多里亚又于1298年在科尔丘拉海战击溃威尼斯舰队；泰迪西奥·多里亚资助了1291年维瓦尔第兄弟的大西洋远航。布兰卡莱奥内·多里亚统治撒丁岛的阿尔博雷亚法官国，一度几乎征服全岛；奥托内·多里亚则在1346年的克雷西战役中率领热那亚弩手作战身亡。家族的巅峰人物是1466年出生的安德烈亚·多里亚，他身为皇帝查理五世的海军司令，于1528年重建热那亚共和国，1531年受封梅尔菲亲王。他1560年去世后，养子一系承袭头衔，17世纪仍有多位多里亚家族成员出任热那亚总督。

en: The Douglases take their name from Douglas in Lanarkshire, from Gaelic words meaning black stream, with a William, Lord of Douglas first recorded in 1179; a Flemish origin through Theobald the Fleming has also been suggested. William Douglas le Hardi (c. 1243-1298) joined William Wallace and died a prisoner in the Tower of London, but it was his son Sir James Douglas, called the Good or the Black Douglas (c. 1286-1330), who made the house famous as Robert the Bruce's most feared lieutenant; after Bruce's death he carried the king's heart on crusade and was killed fighting in Spain. In 1358 the family became Earls of Douglas, and Archibald the Grim built up a great Border power; the fourth earl led a Scottish army to France and was made Duke of Touraine before falling at Verneuil in 1424. Their overmighty strength brought the Black Douglases down: the sixth earl and his brother were murdered at the Black Dinner of 1440, James II stabbed the eighth earl at Stirling in 1452, and the ninth earl's rebellion was crushed at Arkinholm in 1455. The Red Douglases, earls of Angus, inherited their leading role and supplied regents and queens' consorts to later Stewart kings, while branches of the house became Dukes of Hamilton and Queensberry and even counts of Sweden.
zh: 道格拉斯家族得名于拉纳克郡的道格拉斯，其名在盖尔语中意为“黑色的溪流”；1179年已有威廉·道格拉斯领主的记载，也有说法认为家族源自佛兰德斯人西奥博尔德。“硬汉”威廉·道格拉斯（约1243—1298）追随威廉·华莱士，最终死于伦敦塔；而使家族扬名的是其子“好人”詹姆斯·道格拉斯，又称“黑道格拉斯”（约1286—1330），他是罗伯特一世麾下最令敌人胆寒的将领，罗伯特死后携其心脏参加十字军，1330年在西班牙战死。1358年家族受封道格拉斯伯爵，“冷酷者”阿奇博尔德建立起强大的边境势力；第四代伯爵率军赴法，受封图赖讷公爵，1424年战死于韦尔讷伊。过盛的权势给“黑道格拉斯”主支招来灭顶之灾：1440年第六代伯爵兄弟在“黑色晚宴”上被杀，1452年詹姆斯二世在斯特灵亲手刺死第八代伯爵，1455年第九代伯爵的叛乱又在阿金霍姆被平定。作为旁支的“红道格拉斯”安格斯伯爵们接过了家族的显赫地位，在后来的斯图亚特诸王时代出任摄政、联姻王室，其余支脉还成为汉密尔顿公爵、昆斯伯里公爵，乃至瑞典的伯爵。

en: The House of Dreux was a cadet branch of the Capetian kings of France, founded when Robert I, a younger son of King Louis VI, received the County of Dreux as his appanage. As counts of Dreux the family long remained only minor nobles, but its fortunes changed in 1212, when Peter of Dreux married Alix, heiress of the Duchy of Brittany, and ruled it as duke; the French court recognised Brittany as a lay peerage and duchy in 1297. In 1337 John III held the Breton duchy while the senior Dreux comital line, which became extinct in 1345, still kept its county. John III's death in 1341 opened the War of the Breton Succession: Joan of Pentievre and her husband Charles of Blois, backed by Philip VI of France, fought John of Montfort, backed by Edward III of England. John of Montfort died during the siege of Quimper in 1345, Charles of Blois fell at the Battle of Auray in 1364, and the Treaty of Guerande settled the duchy on the Montfort line. When its last male duke, Francis II, died, Brittany passed to his daughter Anne, who married two successive kings of France.
zh: 德勒家族是法兰西卡佩王室的支系，由国王路易六世的幼子罗贝尔一世受封德勒伯国而开创。作为德勒伯爵，家族长期只是小贵族；转机出现在1212年，德勒的皮埃尔娶布列塔尼公国女继承人阿莉克斯为妻并成为公爵，法兰西宫廷又在1297年正式承认布列塔尼为公爵领和世俗贵族封地。1337年，约翰三世统治着布列塔尼公国，将于1345年绝嗣的德勒长支则仍保有伯国。1341年约翰三世去世，引发布列塔尼继承战争：庞蒂耶夫尔的让娜与丈夫布卢瓦的夏尔得到法兰西国王腓力六世支持，对抗英格兰国王爱德华三世撑腰的蒙福尔的约翰。蒙福尔的约翰于1345年在围攻坎佩尔期间病死，布卢瓦的夏尔于1364年在欧赖战役中阵亡，《盖朗德条约》最终把公国确定给蒙福尔支系。该支系最后一位男性公爵弗朗索瓦二世死后，布列塔尼传给女儿安妮，她后来先后嫁给两位法兰西国王。

en: The Duan were the Bai ruling house of Dali in what is now Yunnan. Their founder Duan Siping overthrew the short-lived Great Yining kingdom and established the Dali Kingdom at Yangjumie in 937, and his descendants ruled for more than three centuries; after a Gao clan usurpation in 1094 to 1096, the restored Later Dali kings largely left secular power to their Gao chief ministers and devoted themselves to Buddhism. In 1253 Kublai Khan's army crossed the Jinsha River and destroyed Dali; the last king Duan Xingzhi surrendered and was enfeoffed as Maharaja, and from then on the family served the Mongols and the Yuan as hereditary administrators, or zongguan, of the Dali region, governing from their old capital while imperial princes and provincial officers held Kunming. The ninth administrator Duan Guang, who took office in 1333, fought the Mongol Prince of Liang over their border and in 1343 defeated him at Mount Kunmi, after which the two sides fixed the Luona Pass as their boundary, the Duan ruling the south and the Liang prince the north. His brother Duan Gong saved the prince from the Red Turban invasion of 1363 and recovered Kunming, only to be lured to his death at the Tongji Bridge in 1365, where his wife Princess Agai killed herself in grief. When the Ming conquered Yunnan in 1382 the last Duan chiefs asked to keep Dali as an autonomous tributary and were refused; the clan was scattered across China by the Hongwu Emperor.
zh: 段氏是今云南一带白族的统治家族。始祖段思平推翻短命的大义宁国，于937年在阳苴咩城建立大理国，子孙世代为王三百余年；1094—1096年高氏一度篡位，还政后的后理国王多崇信佛教，世俗大权常落在高家宰相手中。1253年忽必烈大军渡过金沙江攻灭大理，末代国王段兴智出降后受封摩诃罗嵯（大王），段氏从此以世袭大理总管的身份为蒙古和元朝治理大理故土，仍居旧都，而蒙古梁王与行省官员坐镇昆明。第九代总管段光于1333年袭职，因辖界之争与蒙古梁王兵戎相见，1343年在昆弥山击败梁军，双方约以罗那关为界，段氏治南、梁王治北。其弟段功在1363年红巾军明玉珍入滇时出兵勤王、收复昆明，梁王却疑其怀有吞并全滇的野心，于1365年在通济桥将他诱杀，下嫁段功的阿盖公主也殉情而死。1382年明军平定云南，末代总管段明、段世请求保留自治被拒，段氏族人被明太祖分散安置到内地各处。

en: The Lords of Dubá were a lineage of the Ronovci, one of the oldest noble families of Bohemia, whose ancestors can be traced to Smil Světlík of Tuhaň around 1192 and whose power base lay in northern Bohemia around Česká Lípa. Taking their name from their seat at Dubá, they spread into the Boleslav region around Turnov and built or held castles such as Houska, where Hynáček of Dubá is recorded in 1316; Hynek of Dubá served as burgrave of Prague. The house produced several cadet branches, above all the Berka of Dubá, founded by Hynek Berka of Dubá between 1249 and 1306, alongside the Škopek, Adršpach and Červenohorský lines. The Berkas became one of the richest families in the kingdom, with estates in northern and eastern Bohemia, Moravia and Kladsko, and counted Zbyněk Berka of Dubá, archbishop of Prague from 1592 to 1606, among their members. They were raised to imperial counts in 1637, but after the defeat of the Bohemian estates at the White Mountain in 1620 the line died out in the Czech lands early in the eighteenth century, its exiled descendants continuing in Saxony and Sweden.
zh: 杜贝领主是波希米亚最古老的贵族世家之一罗诺夫家族的支系，其先祖可追溯到约1192年的图哈尼的斯米尔·斯韦特利克，势力范围在北波希米亚的捷克利帕一带。他们以驻地杜贝为姓，势力扩展到图尔诺夫所在的博莱斯拉夫地区，修建或据有豪斯卡等城堡——1316年的文献中已出现杜贝的希纳切克“德·豪斯卡”的记载，杜贝的希内克还当过布拉格城堡长官。家族分出若干旁支，最重要的是1249—1306年间由希内克·贝尔卡·德·杜贝创立的杜贝·贝尔卡支，此外还有什科佩克、阿德尔什帕赫和切尔韦诺霍尔斯基等支。贝尔卡支成为王国最富有的家族之一，领地遍及北波希米亚、东波希米亚、摩拉维亚和克拉德斯科，成员包括1592—1606年任布拉格大主教的兹比涅克·贝尔卡·德·杜贝。1637年他们被升为帝国伯爵，但1620年白山战役波希米亚等级派失败后，该支系于18世纪初在捷克本土绝嗣，流亡的后裔在萨克森和瑞典延续下来。

en: The Dulkadirids were a Turkoman dynasty drawn from the Oghuz Bayat, Afshar and Begdili clans, whose beylik became one of the strongest in southeastern Anatolia. Their chieftain Zayn al-Din Qaraja occupied the pastures between Elbistan and Maraş, took Elbistan itself in 1337, and was recognised as na'ib, or deputy governor, by the Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad, having fought alongside the Mamluks against Cilician Armenia. From these twin capitals the dynasty expanded until its lords held Maraş, Kayseri, Malatya and Antep, with influence reaching toward Kırşehir and Mosul. Sandwiched between the Mamluk sultanate and the rising Ottoman Empire, the Dulkadirids turned marriage into statecraft and became linked to the Ottoman house by several royal weddings, while playing the two empires off against each other. The balancing act ended under Selim I: after the Battle of Turnadağ in 1515 the Ottomans overran the beylik and reduced it to a sanjak, the last vestiges of its autonomy disappearing by 1522.
zh: 杜尔卡迪尔王朝是由乌古斯突厥的巴亚特、阿夫沙尔和贝格迪利等部落组成的土库曼王朝，其贝伊国后来成为安纳托利亚东南部最强盛的政权之一。首领扎因丁·卡拉贾占据埃尔比斯坦与马拉什之间的牧场，于1337年攻下埃尔比斯坦，并因随马穆鲁克人征讨奇里乞亚亚美尼亚而被马穆鲁克苏丹纳绥尔·穆罕默德承认为纳伊卜（副总督）。王朝以这两座城市为双核不断扩张，领主们先后统治马拉什、开塞利、马拉蒂亚和安泰普，势力远达克尔谢希尔与摩苏尔一带。由于夹在马穆鲁克苏丹国和崛起的奥斯曼帝国之间，杜尔卡迪尔人以联姻为政略，数次与奥斯曼王室通婚，同时在两大帝国之间周旋。这种平衡最终在塞利姆一世时代终结：1515年图尔纳达山战役后，奥斯曼人攻灭贝伊国并将其改为桑贾克，残余自治权到1522年也不复存在。

en: The Dunbars were the comital family of south-eastern Scotland, holding an earldom known interchangeably as Dunbar, Lothian or March. They descended from Gospatric, Earl of Northumbria, who after the Norman Conquest lost his English earldom and settled at Dunbar under the Scottish king; his son Gospatric II was the first to style himself earl. In 1291 the eighth earl, Patrick, was among the competitors for the Scottish crown. His son Patrick, the ninth earl, was a leading magnate under Robert the Bruce and David II: he surrendered Berwick after Halidon Hill in 1333, briefly served the English, then returned to the Scottish side. In 1338 his wife Agnes Randolph, called Black Agnes, defended Dunbar Castle for five months against the Earl of Salisbury until the English abandoned the siege. The family's power ended with George, eleventh Earl of March, whose titles and estates were declared forfeit by the Scottish parliament in 1435; he died in obscurity in England, while a younger branch continued as the lords and later earls of Home from 1473.
zh: 邓巴家族是苏格兰东南部的伯爵世家，其伯爵领地先后被称作邓巴、洛锡安或马奇。家族源自诺森布里亚伯爵戈斯帕特里克，他在诺曼征服后失去英格兰的伯爵领地，投奔苏格兰国王并定居邓巴；其子戈斯帕特里克二世率先以伯爵自称。1291年，第八代伯爵帕特里克是苏格兰王位的竞争者之一。他的儿子第九代伯爵帕特里克是罗伯特·布鲁斯和大卫二世治下的重要权贵：1333年哈利顿山战败后他献出贝里克、短暂效力英格兰，随后又回到苏格兰一方。1338年，他的妻子阿格尼丝·伦道夫（人称“黑阿格尼丝”）据守邓巴城堡，抵抗索尔兹伯里伯爵的围攻达五个月，直至英军撤围。家族权势终结于第十一代马奇伯爵乔治：1435年苏格兰议会宣布剥夺他的头衔和地产，他在英格兰默默无闻地死去；不过家族的一支幼支作为霍姆领主、后来的霍姆伯爵从1473年延续下去。

en: The lords of Ehrenberg were a family of the lower nobility seated from 1193 at Ehrenberg Castle above Heinsheim on the Neckar near Heilbronn, followers of the Hohenstaufen and vassals of the bishopric of Worms. The line died out in 1647, and its castles and villages passed to Worms and, in 1803, to Hesse.
zh: 埃伦贝格领主是一个下层贵族家族，至迟从1193年起驻跸海尔布隆附近内卡河畔海因斯海姆上方的埃伦贝格城堡，是霍恩施陶芬家族的追随者和沃尔姆斯主教区的封臣。该家族于1647年绝嗣，城堡与村落转归沃尔姆斯，1803年又落入黑森之手。

en: The Eiso dynasty was the ruling house of Chūzan in central Okinawa, named after its semi-legendary founder Eiso, said to have reigned from 1260 to 1299 from Urasoe. Later Ryukyu histories credit him with restoring prosperity to a famine-stricken island before taking the throne, building Okinawa's first Buddhist temple at Gokuraku-ji, extending rule over Amami Ōshima and rejecting the suzerainty of the Yuan; his mausoleum at Urasoe yōdore still holds late thirteenth-century sarcophagi, though modern historians treat him as a local lord of the Urasoe area rather than master of all Okinawa. His line passed through four more heirs, but under his great-grandson Tamagusuku, who succeeded in 1314, the territorial lords defected: the lord of Nakijin founded Hokuzan in the north and the aji of Ōzato founded Nanzan in the south, leaving Tamagusuku only the central kingdom of Chūzan. His son Seii came to the throne as a child in 1337, and the misrule of his mother's regency cost the house its support; when Seii died in 1349 the anji set his heir aside and raised the Urasoe lord Satto to the throne, ending the Eiso line.
zh: 英祖王朝是冲绳中山地区的统治家族，以半传说的始祖英祖得名，相传他于1260—1299年以浦添为中心统治。后世琉球史书称他先以摄政身份令遭饥荒的冲绳重归富庶，随后即位，任内建成岛上第一座佛寺极乐寺、将奄美大岛纳入统治并拒绝元朝的宗主权，其陵墓浦添极乐陵中仍存有13世纪末的石棺；后世学者多认为他只是浦添一带的地方领主，并非全岛之主。他的世系又传了四代，到曾孙玉城于1314年继位时，各地按司纷纷背离：今归仁领主在北方自立北山，大里按司在南方建立南山，玉城只保有中部的中山。其子西威于1337年幼年即位，母后摄政时政令昏乱、大失人心；1349年西威病逝，众按司废黜世子，拥立浦添按司察度为王，英祖王朝就此终结。

en: The Ema clan claimed descent from the Kanmu Heishi line of Taira no Tsunemori. Its genealogy holds that Tsunemori's son Terutsune was raised by Hojo Tokimasa in Izu and took the name Ema Koshiro from Ema manor in Tagata district of Izu, the district that gave the clan its name, before entering Hojo service. The family later moved east to Takahara in Yoshiki district of Hida, where it grew into one of the province's leading kokujin houses. In the Muromachi period it kept ties with the Ise family, stewards of the shogunal mandokoro, and fought on the Eastern army's side in the Onin War. During the Sengoku period Ema Tokitsune built a domain in northern Hida and repeatedly clashed with the Anegakoji and Miki clans. As Hida became a flank of the Kawanakajima wars, the Ema split between the Takeda and Uesugi camps: Tokimori leaned on Takeda Shingen, while the Miki and Terumori sided with the Uesugi; in 1564 Tokimori overwhelmed the Miki and Terumori with Takeda help, and Terumori then submitted to the Takeda too. After Uesugi Kenshin's Hida campaign of 1576 Terumori submitted to him as well, and later went over to Oda Nobunaga. In 1578 Terumori murdered Tokimori in a succession quarrel, and after Nobunaga's death in 1582 he was killed fighting the Anegakoji at the battle of Yokamachi, which brought the Ema as an independent power to an end; a remnant under Tokimasa took refuge with the Kanamori but was destroyed in a later revolt.
zh: 江马氏自称出自桓武平氏平经盛一脉。据其谱系，经盛的妾生子辉经由伊豆的北条时政抚养，以伊豆国田方郡江马庄的地名为苗字，称江马小四郎，并出仕北条氏——这正是游戏把其据点放在伊豆田方的由来。江马氏后来迁往飞驒国吉城郡高原乡，逐渐成长为当地有力的国人众。室町时代，该族与执掌幕府政所的伊势氏关系密切，应仁之乱时加入东军作战。进入战国，江马时经在飞驒北部构筑势力，与国司姊小路家、三木氏屡次交锋。飞驒的纷争与川中岛之战互为表里：江马时盛依附甲斐武田氏，1564年借武田之力压倒从属上杉方的三木氏与江马辉盛，辉盛随后也臣服武田；1576年上杉谦信讨伐飞驒，辉盛又降于上杉，之后再转投织田信长。1578年，辉盛在继承争执中杀死时盛；1582年本能寺之变后，他在八日町之战中与姊小路氏交战时战死，江马氏作为独立势力事实上灭亡。余党时政投奔金森氏，后来因叛乱被诛。

en: The Enghien were a noble family of Hainaut, named after their lordship of Enghien in Wallonia, whose fortunes were transformed by the Brienne inheritance. Walter III of Enghien married Isabella of Brienne, sister of Walter VI of Brienne, the titular Duke of Athens who died in 1356, and their sons divided his claims. Sohier, lord of Enghien from 1346, became Count of Brienne and titular Duke of Athens, but was captured and beheaded by Albert of Bavaria in 1364; his brother Walter held Brienne as a soldier of the count of Flanders, sacked Geraardsbergen in 1381 and then fell in an ambush near Ghent. Another brother, Guy, took the Greek lordship of Argos and Nauplia in 1356, ruled there as a vassal of the Principality of Achaea and in 1370–1371 led a failed invasion of the Catalan Duchy of Athens. His daughter Maria, the last Enghien ruler in Greece, married the Venetian Pietro Cornaro and sold Argos and Nauplia to Venice in 1388; she died childless in Venice in 1393, after which the Byzantines seized Argos and the Venetians made good their hold on Nauplia.
zh: 昂吉安家族是埃诺的贵族世家，得名于其在瓦隆尼亚的昂吉安领地，家族命运因继承布里耶讷遗产而改变。沃尔特三世·德·昂吉安娶布里耶讷的伊莎贝拉为妻——伊莎贝拉是名义上的雅典公爵布里耶讷的沃尔特六世之妹，沃尔特六世于1356年死后，诸子瓜分了他的各项权利。索耶1346年起为昂吉安领主，又成为布里耶讷伯爵和名义雅典公爵，却在1364年被巴伐利亚的阿尔布雷希特俘获斩首；其弟沃尔特作为佛兰德斯伯爵麾下的军人领有布里耶讷，1381年洗劫赫拉尔兹贝亨，随后在根特附近的伏击中被杀。另一个弟弟居伊于1356年接掌希腊的阿尔戈斯与瑙普利亚领地，作为亚该亚公国的封臣在当地统治，并于1370—1371年领兵进攻加泰罗尼亚人的雅典公国，失败而回。居伊之女玛丽亚是家族在希腊的最后一位统治者，她嫁给威尼斯人彼得罗·科尔纳罗，1388年把阿尔戈斯与瑙普利亚卖给威尼斯共和国，1393年无嗣而终于威尼斯；此后拜占庭人夺取阿尔戈斯，威尼斯人则牢牢控制了瑙普利亚。

en: The Enríquez de Castilla were a noble house of royal blood, a cadet line of the Castilian House of Burgundy. Its founder was Fadrique Alfonso de Castilla, born in Seville in 1334 as the natural son of Alfonso XI and his favourite Eleanor de Guzmán, and twin brother of the future Henry II of Trastámara, after whom the patronymic Enríquez, meaning son of Enrique, was taken. Fadrique was made Master of the Order of Santiago while still a boy and Lord of Haro, but after his half-brother Peter I seized power he was caught in the Trastámara civil wars and was killed on the king's orders in 1358. His son Alonso Enríquez restored the family's fortunes and became Admiral of Castile, an office the Enríquez held for almost two hundred years, together with lordships including Medina de Rioseco, Peñafiel and Tarifa. In 1520 Charles V numbered them among the first Grandees of Spain, and the Duchy of Medina de Rioseco became their principal title. The house reached the threshold of a throne when Juana Enríquez married John II of Aragon: their son, born in 1452, was Ferdinand the Catholic, husband of Isabella of Castile and architect, with her, of the united Spanish monarchy.
zh: 恩里克斯·德·卡斯蒂利亚是带有王室血统的贵族世家，为卡斯蒂利亚勃艮第王朝的旁支。始祖法德里克·阿方索·德·卡斯蒂利亚1334年生于塞维利亚，是阿方索十一世与宠妃埃莉诺·德·古斯曼的私生子，与后来的特拉斯塔马拉国王恩里克二世是孪生兄弟；“恩里克斯”这一姓氏即意为“恩里克之子”，取自恩里克二世。法德里克少年时便出任圣地亚哥骑士团团长，受封阿罗领主，但在异母兄佩德罗一世掌权后卷入特拉斯塔马拉内战，于1358年被国王下令处死。他的儿子阿隆索·恩里克斯重振家业，出任卡斯蒂利亚海军上将——此后该家族把持海军上将之职近两百年，还领有梅迪纳-德里奥塞科、佩尼亚菲耶尔、塔里法等领地。1520年，卡洛斯五世将其列为首批西班牙大公之一，梅迪纳-德里奥塞科公爵成为家族的首要头衔。家族还一度接近王座：胡安娜·恩里克斯嫁给阿拉贡国王胡安二世，两人于1452年生下的儿子正是“天主教徒”费尔南多——他与卡斯蒂利亚的伊莎贝拉联姻，夫妇二人共同缔造了统一的西班牙王权。

en: The En'ya were the main line of the Izumo Genji, an offshoot of the Sasaki house of the Uda Genji, and took their name from the Enya estate in Izumo Province, whose shugo, or constable, office they held generation after generation from the mid-Kamakura period. Their founder was Enya Yoriyasu. At the end of the Kamakura age the head of the house, Enya Takasada, sided with Emperor Go-Daigo in the Genko War of 1331 to 1333 and helped bring down the Kamakura shogunate, but in 1341 Ashikaga Tadayoshi, the strongman of the new Muromachi shogunate, accused him of treason and Takasada killed himself; most of the clan were executed or surrendered to the Yamana. A cadet line survived: Sasaki Doho served as deputy constable of Izumo and fought under Yamana Ujikiyo against the Southern Court general Kusunoki Masanori at the Battle of Hirao in 1382. Revived early in the fifteenth century as a hokoshu house of the Muromachi shogunate, the later En'ya grew strong enough to contend with the Amago, the deputy constables of Izumo, until the Amago destroyed them in the first half of the sixteenth century.
zh: 盐冶氏是出云源氏的嫡流，而后者出自宇多源氏佐佐木氏的支流，家族以出云国盐冶乡为苗字，自镰仓时代中期起世代担任出云国守护。始祖为盐冶赖泰。镰仓末期，当主盐冶高贞在1331至1333年的元弘之乱中投奔后醍醐天皇，参与推翻镰仓幕府；但1341年，室町幕府的实权人物足利直义怀疑他谋反，高贞被迫自尽，一族大多被诛杀或归降山名氏。唯有庶流存续：佐佐木道彭出任出云守护代，1382年在平尾合战中隶属山名氏清麾下，与南朝大将楠木正仪交战。15世纪初，盐冶家作为室町幕府的奉公众得以复兴，此后势力壮大，一度与出云守护代尼子氏相争，最终在16世纪上半叶被尼子氏攻灭。

en: The lords of Eppstein were an imperial free noble house, descended from the lords of Hainhausen in the Rodgau, who are documented from 1108 and who took their new name after acquiring Eppstein Castle in the Vordertaunus between 1183 and 1190. From this base in the Rhine-Main country they rose to be one of the most powerful families of the high Middle Ages: between 1200 and 1305 they supplied four archbishops of Mainz, Siegfried II, Siegfried III, Werner and Gerhard II, with Siegfried III leading the anti-Staufer party in the empire. Through purchase, marriage and enfeoffment the secular lords gathered rights from the Middle Rhine to the Vogelsberg, including shares of the counties of Wied and Diez and the lordships of Breuberg, Trimberg and Falkenstein. The early thirteenth-century split between an elder and a younger line turned against them when the elder branch died out in 1269, opening a ten-year feud from which the counts of Katzenelnbogen carried off much Eppstein land. In 1433 the brothers Gottfried VII and Eberhard II divided the inheritance into Eppstein-Munzenberg and Eppstein-Konigstein, and King Maximilian I granted the Konigstein line the comital title in 1505. A planned reunion of the branches came to nothing, and with the death of the last lord in 1535 the house became extinct, its territories passing mainly to the landgraves of Hesse and the archbishopric of Mainz.
zh: 埃普施泰因领主家族是帝国自由贵族，源自罗德高的海恩豪森领主家族（1108年始见文献），1183至1190年间取得前陶努斯山区的埃普施泰因城堡后改用现名。以此为基地，家族在莱茵-美因地区崛起为中世纪盛期最有权势的世家之一：1200至1305年间出了齐格弗里德二世、齐格弗里德三世、维尔纳和格哈德二世四位美因茨大主教，其中齐格弗里德三世是帝国境内反霍亨斯陶芬派的领袖。世俗支则通过购买、联姻和受封，把从中莱茵到福格尔斯贝格山的各项权利收入囊中，包括维德伯国、迪茨伯国以及布罗伊贝格、特林贝格和法尔肯施泰因等领地的份额。13世纪初家族分为长幼两支，长支于1269年绝嗣，引发长达十年的纷争，卡岑埃尔恩博根伯爵乘机攫取了大量埃普施泰因领地。1433年，戈特弗里德七世与埃伯哈德二世兄弟将遗产分为埃普施泰因-明岑贝格和埃普施泰因-柯尼希施泰因两支，1505年国王马克西米利安一世授予柯尼希施泰因支伯爵头衔。两支重新合并的计划落空，1535年末代领主去世，家族绝嗣，领地主要落入黑森藩侯和美因茨大主教区之手。

en: The lords and later counts of Erbach were a Rhenish Franconian noble house of ministerial origin, seated at Erbach in the Odenwald. A certain Eberhard I of Erbach first appears in documents in 1148, and the family long served as advocates of Lorsch Abbey before the Wittelsbach counts palatine made them their hereditary cup-bearers around 1226, after which they styled themselves the Schenken of Erbach. In the thirteenth century the house split into the Erbach and Reichenberg lines, while its water castle at Erbach is first mentioned around 1303. The family gained a seat among the imperial estates in 1422 and was raised to the rank of imperial count in 1532, in reward for Count Eberhard's service against the peasants in the Palatine Peasants' War. The counts introduced the Reformation into their lands in 1544, and in 1717 the house divided into the Erbach-Fürstenau, Erbach-Erbach and Erbach-Schönberg branches. Under the Confederation of the Rhine in 1806 the county was mediatized, most of it passing to the Grand Duchy of Hesse and the remainder to Bavaria, though two branches kept their castles in the Odenwald.
zh: 埃尔巴赫家族是莱茵法兰克尼亚的古老贵族，出身侍臣阶层，以奥登林山的埃尔巴赫为驻地。家族的埃伯哈德一世最早于1148年见于文献，起初担任洛尔施修道院的福格特；约1226年，维特尔斯巴赫家族的莱茵行宫伯爵将他们立为世袭掌酒官，此后便自称埃尔巴赫的申肯。13世纪家族分出埃尔巴赫与赖兴贝格两支，其埃尔巴赫水堡约在1303年首次见于记载。1422年埃尔巴赫领主取得帝国等级席位，1532年又因埃伯哈德伯爵在普法尔茨农民战争中镇压农民的功劳而被擢升为帝国伯爵。1544年伯爵们在领地内推行宗教改革，1717年家族分为埃尔巴赫-菲尔斯滕瑙、埃尔巴赫-埃尔巴赫和埃尔巴赫-申贝格三支。1806年莱茵邦联成立后，伯国被调解，大部分并入黑森大公国，其余划归巴伐利亚，但有两支仍保留了在奥登林山的城堡。

en: The Eretnids were a short-lived but powerful sultanate that straddled central and eastern Anatolia from Sivas to Kayseri between 1335 and 1381, rising from the wreckage of the Ilkhanate. Its founder Eretna was an officer of Uyghur origin who served the Mongol governor Timurtash and became viceroy of Anatolia himself; after an unexpected victory over rival Mongol warlords at the Battle of Karanbük in 1343 he declared independence and took the title of sultan. His just and prosperous rule earned him the nickname Köse Peygamber, the beardless prophet. In 1337, however, he still governed as an Ilkhanid, then Jalayirid, vassal. His son Muhammad I was deposed and restored in a feud with his brother Jafar, and saw the borders shrink as the Dulkadirids, Karamanids and Ottomans encroached, until his emirs murdered him at Kayseri in 1365. The child sultans Ala al-Din Ali and Muhammad II Chelebi were dominated by their vizier Kadı Burhan al-Din; Ali died of plague on campaign in 1380, and within a year Burhan al-Din deposed the seven-year-old Muhammad II and seized the throne, extinguishing the Eretnid line and replacing its state with his own.
zh: 埃雷特纳王朝是1335至1381年间横跨安纳托利亚中东部、以锡瓦斯和开塞利为核心的短命而强盛的苏丹国，兴于伊儿汗国崩溃的废墟之上。开国者埃雷特纳为畏兀儿出身的将领，曾在蒙古总督帖木儿塔什麾下效力，后来本人出任安纳托利亚副王；1343年他在卡兰比克战役意外击败争夺伊儿汗国遗产的蒙古军阀后宣布独立，自称苏丹。他治下公正而繁荣，赢得了“无须先知”（柯塞·佩甘贝尔）的绰号。不过在1337年，他仍以伊儿汗国及后来札剌亦儿王朝藩属的身份执政。其子穆罕默德一世在与兄弟贾法尔的争斗中一度被废又复位，眼睁睁看着杜尔卡迪尔、卡拉曼和奥斯曼等势力蚕食疆土，最终于1365年在开塞利被埃米尔们弑杀。年幼的阿拉丁·阿里和穆罕默德二世·切莱比两任苏丹皆受维齐尔卡迪·布尔汉丁挟制：阿里于1380年在远征途中染鼠疫身亡，不到一年布尔汉丁便废黜七岁的穆罕默德二世自立，埃雷特纳一脉就此断绝，其国家也被布尔汉丁的政权取代。

en: The House of Estridsen supplied the kings of Denmark from 1047 to 1412 and also gave three rulers to Sweden and one to Norway. It takes its name from Estrid Svendsdatter, daughter of Sweyn Forkbeard and sister of Cnut the Great, whose marriage to the Danish earl Ulf Jarl founded the line, which contemporaries sometimes called the Ulfinger after him. Their son Sweyn Estridsson, born around 1019, won the Danish throne in 1047 and fathered more than twenty children, including five future kings, among them Saint Canute. For the next three centuries his descendants kept the Danish crown, and the family coat of arms became the coat of arms of Denmark. In 1337 the house had ruled Denmark for nearly three hundred years, and its fortunes soon revived under Valdemar IV. His youngest daughter Margaret I, born in 1353, made herself queen regnant of Denmark, Norway and Sweden and founded the Kalmar Union, which joined the Scandinavian crowns for more than a century. On her death in 1412 the line ended, the crown passing to her grandnephew Eric of Pomerania, while every later Danish monarch remained a cognatic descendant of the house.
zh: 埃斯特丽德王朝在1047—1412年间为丹麦提供历代国王，还曾有三人统治瑞典、一人统治挪威。王朝得名于八字胡斯文之女、克努特大帝之妹埃斯特丽德·斯文斯达特，她嫁给丹麦伯爵乌尔夫而开枝散叶，家族因此也被称作‘乌尔夫家族’。他们的儿子斯文·埃斯特里德森约生于1019年，1047年登上丹麦王位，身后留下二十多个子女，其中五人后来称王，圣克努特便是其一。此后近三百年间，丹麦王冠一直在他的后裔手中传承，家族纹章也演变为丹麦的国徽。1337年时这个家族已统治丹麦近三百年，不久瓦尔德马四世重振王权；他的幼女玛格丽特一世生于1353年，后来成为统治丹麦、挪威和瑞典的女王，并缔造卡尔马联盟，把斯堪的纳维亚诸王冠合为一体达一个多世纪。1412年玛格丽特去世，王统断绝，王位传给她的侄孙波美拉尼亚的埃里克；此后丹麦历代君主都是该家族的后裔，只是不再循男系相承。

en: The free lords and counts of Everstein, sometimes also written Eberstein, took their name from the castles on the Grosser and Kleiner Everstein in the Weser hills near Holzminden, first using it in 1116. As kinsmen and followers of the Hohenstaufen, they built their allodial lands between Hoexter, Holzminden and Hameln into a small lordship lying on the border of four dioceses, and around 1100 they also led the colonization of the Slavic Dobnagau around Plauen in the Vogtland, a holding they finally surrendered to the Vogts of Plauen in 1328. Around 1200 the house split into the Ohsen, Holzminden and other branches, but the fall of the Hohenstaufen exposed it to the ambitions of the Welfs: in 1284 the dukes of Brunswick forced the sale of Everstein Castle, Polle became the family seat, and around 1335 the lords had to surrender Ohsen on the Weser. Marriage still carried the name into princely houses, for in 1322 Adelaide of Everstein-Polle married Ernest I of Brunswick-Grubenhagen and became the mother of his heirs. The end came under Count Hermann VII: after the Everstein succession feud of 1403 to 1408, the county and Polle Castle passed to the dukes of Brunswick-Lueneburg, and Hermann, the last male of the line, died in exile. A Pomeranian branch at Naugard, established in 1274, outlived the parent house until 1663.
zh: 埃弗施泰因的自由领主与伯爵（亦拼作埃伯施泰因）得名于霍尔茨明登附近威悉山地中大、小埃弗施泰因山上的城堡，1116年开始以此为号。作为霍亨斯陶芬家族的亲族和追随者，他们把赫克斯特、霍尔茨明登与哈默尔恩之间的自主地产经营成一个横跨四个教区边界的小领地；约1100年，他们还主导了对福格特兰普劳恩一带斯拉夫人多布纳高的拓殖，这片领地最终于1328年让给普劳恩福格特。约1200年家族分为奥克森、霍尔茨明登等支，但霍亨斯陶芬家族倒台后，韦尔夫家族的压力接踵而至：1284年不伦瑞克公爵强迫他们出售埃弗施泰因城堡，波勒城堡成为新的治所，约1335年又被迫交出威悉河畔的奥克森。不过联姻仍把这个姓氏带进诸侯之家：1322年，埃弗施泰因-波勒的阿德莱德嫁给不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根公爵恩斯特一世，成为其继承人的母亲。家族在赫尔曼七世伯爵时走向终结：经过1403至1408年的埃弗施泰因继承纷争，伯国连同波勒城堡落入不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵之手，末代男嗣赫尔曼死于流放。1274年在波美拉尼亚建立的诺加德支系则比本家延续得更久，直到1663年才断绝。

en: The Fadlawayhids were the ruling family of the Shabankara, an Iranian tribal confederation, commonly described as Kurdish, that held the mountains of eastern Fars from its capital at Ij. The Shabankara had been deported there from Isfahan and Syria by the Buyid ruler Adud al-Dawla in the tenth century, and claimed descent from the Sasanian king Ardashir I. The dynasty took its name from Fadluya, also called Fadlawayh, chief of the Ramani clan: he rose in the Buyid army, overthrew the last Buyid ruler of Fars in 1062, and made himself master of the province before submitting to the Seljuks under Alp Arslan. Repeated revolts ended with his capture and death in Seljuk captivity, yet the family survived as local rulers under Seljuk atabegs and then the Ilkhans. Hulagu destroyed Ij and killed their chief in 1260, and another rising against the Ilkhans failed in 1312. The last chief, Ardashir, refused obedience to the Muzaffarids; Mubariz al-Din sent his son against him in 1355, overran the Shabankara country and ended the dynasty's rule, though traces of local Shabankara power may have lingered until 1424.
zh: 法德勒瓦希德王朝是沙班卡拉人的统治家族。沙班卡拉是一个通常被视为库尔德人的伊朗部落联盟，以伊杰为都，据有法尔斯东部山区。他们在10世纪被白益王朝君主阿杜德·道莱从伊斯法罕和叙利亚迁徙至此，自称是萨珊国王阿尔达希尔一世的后裔。王朝得名于拉马尼氏族首领法德卢叶（又名法德勒瓦希德）：他在白益军队中起家，1062年推翻白益王朝在法尔斯的末代统治者，成为该省之主，随后向阿尔普·阿尔斯兰的塞尔柱人称臣。他屡次反叛，最终被俘、死于塞尔柱人的囚禁之中，但家族仍作为地方统治者存续下来，先后依附塞尔柱的阿塔伯格和后来的伊儿汗国。1260年旭烈兀摧毁伊杰并杀死其首领，1312年反抗伊儿汗的起义又告失败。末代首领阿尔达希尔拒绝臣服莫扎法尔王朝，穆巴里兹丁于1355年派儿子发兵征讨，攻灭沙班卡拉政权，终结了该王朝的统治；不过沙班卡拉人的地方势力残余可能一直延续到1424年。

en: The Frederick or Fadrique family was a Catalan noble house founded by Alfonso Fadrique, the illegitimate eldest son of Frederick II of Sicily. Sent to Greece in 1317 as vicar general of the Catalan Duchy of Athens, he married Marulla, daughter of Boniface of Verona, invaded Thessaly after 1318, took Neopatras and the lordship of Salona, and ruled as its first count until his death in 1338. His sons divided his fiefs: Peter inherited the County of Salona, James held Siderokastron, William became lord of Livadeia, Boniface lord of Aegina and Karystos, and John lord of Salamis. James's son Louis Fadrique reunited much of the inheritance, served as vicar general of the twin duchies of Athens and Neopatras from 1375 to 1381, and married the Byzantine princess Helena Kantakouzene. When Louis died in 1382 his daughter Maria inherited Salona under her mother's regency, but in 1394 the town opened its gates to Sultan Bayezid I, ending the family's rule; Salona passed briefly to the Despotate of the Morea and the Knights Hospitaller before the final Ottoman conquest of 1410.
zh: 弗雷德里克家族（史料作法德里克）是加泰罗尼亚贵族世家，开创者阿方索·法德里克是西西里国王腓特烈二世的私生子长子。他于1317年被派往希腊，出任加泰罗尼亚人雅典公国的总代理人，1318年后娶维罗纳的博尼法斯之女马鲁拉为妻，进军色萨利，夺取新帕特雷和萨洛纳领地，并以首任萨洛纳伯爵的身份统治到1338年去世。他的儿子们瓜分了封地：彼得继承萨洛纳伯国，詹姆斯据有西德罗卡斯特龙，威廉成为利瓦迪亚领主，博尼法斯领有埃伊纳和卡里斯托斯，约翰领有萨拉米斯。詹姆斯之子路易·法德里克重新聚拢了大部分遗产，于1375至1381年出任雅典与新帕特雷双联公国的总代理人，并娶拜占庭公主海伦娜·坎塔库泽娜为妻。路易于1382年去世后，女儿玛丽亚在母亲摄政下继承萨洛纳，但1394年该城向苏丹巴耶济德一世开城，家族统治就此终结；萨洛纳又短暂归属摩里亚专制国和医院骑士团，最终于1410年被奥斯曼人彻底征服。

en: The Falier were one of the oldest patrician houses of Venice, counted by the fourteenth century among the twelve apostolic noble families; tradition traced them back to the tribunician families that moved from Eraclea to the Rialto in the early ninth century, and a member named Orso Faletro is recorded as a witness in an act of 912. The house gave Venice three doges: Vitale Faliero from 1084 to 1096, Ordelafo Faliero from 1102 to 1117, and Marino Faliero, elected on 11 September 1354 when already about eighty years old after a career in the Council of Ten and as bailo of Negroponte. Within seven months he led a plot to overthrow the republic and make himself prince; the conspiracy was betrayed, and he was beheaded on 17 April 1355, his place among the doges' portraits in the Great Council hall marked only by a black shroud. Other Faliers served as bishop of Castello, patriarch of Grado and Latin patriarch of Constantinople, and branches of the family settled in Venetian Crete under the Greek surname Phalieros.
zh: 法列罗家族是威尼斯最古老的贵族世家之一，到14世纪已位列十二家所谓使徒贵族；相传其先祖属于9世纪初从埃拉克莱亚迁往里亚尔托的护民官家族，912年的一份文书中已有名叫奥尔索·法莱特罗的成员出面作证。该家族出过三位威尼斯总督：1084至1096年在任的维塔莱·法列罗、1102至1117年在任的奥尔代拉福·法列罗，以及马里诺·法列罗。马里诺历任十人团成员和内格罗蓬特长官，1354年9月11日当选总督时已年约八旬；不到七个月，他便策划推翻共和、自立为君，阴谋败露后于1355年4月17日被斩首，大议事厅总督肖像序列中他的位置只留下一幅黑布。此外还有家族成员出任卡斯泰洛主教、格拉多牧首和君士坦丁堡拉丁牧首；家族的一些支系在威尼斯属克里特定居，改用希腊姓氏法列罗斯。

en: The Falkensteins were an imperial ministerial dynasty named after Falkenstein Castle on the Donnersberg in the Palatinate, first recorded with Sigbold of Falkenstein in 1135. His son Hunfried served Emperor Frederick Barbarossa as imperial steward, and when the first line died out its lands and office passed through marriage to the lords of Bolanden. Early in the thirteenth century Philipp IV of Bolanden, treasurer of the Empire and keeper of the imperial regalia at Trifels Castle, founded the Bolanden-Falkenstein branch and took the name Philipp I of Falkenstein. In 1255 he married Isengard, heiress of the counts of Hagen-Munzenberg, and in 1258 inherited their estates, which brought him the land-vogtei of the Wetterau and the imperial forest vogtei of Dreieich, shifting the family's centre of gravity to the Taunus, where they built Neufalkenstein Castle at Konigstein and also held Offenbach am Main, which they pledged to Frankfurt in 1372. A younger line received the comital title in 1398, and Werner III of Falkenstein ruled as archbishop of Trier from 1388 until 1418. When the Hessian Falkensteins died out in the male line in 1418, their Palatinate and Rhenish Hesse lands passed through the last count's sister to the counts of Virneburg; the lordship was sold to the Daun-Oberstein family in 1456 and raised to a county by Emperor Maximilian I in 1518.
zh: 法尔肯施泰因家族是帝国直属家臣世家，得名于普法尔茨唐纳山上的法尔肯施泰因城堡，1135年西格博尔德·冯·法尔肯施泰因首次见于记载。其子洪弗里德任皇帝腓特烈一世（巴巴罗萨）的帝国膳务官；长支绝嗣后，领地与职务经联姻转入博兰登领主家族。13世纪初，掌管帝国财库并在特里费尔斯城堡看守帝国珍宝的博兰登的菲利普四世创立博兰登-法尔肯施泰因支，改称菲利普一世·冯·法尔肯施泰因。1255年他娶哈根-明岑贝格伯爵的女继承人伊森加德为妻，1258年继承其家族产业，由此取得韦特劳的地方辖区官职权和德赖艾希森林的帝国林务官职权，家族重心随之移到陶努斯山区，在柯尼希施泰因修建新法尔肯施泰因城堡，并领有美因河畔奥芬巴赫——该城于1372年被他们抵押给法兰克福。家族的一支于1398年获伯爵头衔，维尔纳三世则于1388至1418年任特里尔大主教。1418年黑森的法尔肯施泰因男系绝嗣，普法尔茨北部和莱茵黑森的领地经末代伯爵之姐转入菲尔讷堡伯爵之手；1456年领地被卖给道恩-奥伯施泰因家族，1518年皇帝马克西米利安一世将其升为伯国。

en: The Fārūmādī were a notable family of Sabzevar in western Khorasan, named after the nearby town of Fārūmād; already under the Ilkhans, Khwaja Taher Faryumadi and his son were wealthy patrons of the poet Pur-Baha Jami. Their best-known member, 'Ala' al-Din Muhammad Faryumadi, governed Sabzevar, Juvain and part of Nishapur for the Ilkhanid claimant Togha Temür and served as his vizier. His harsh taxation drove the local landowner 'Abd al-Razzaq to revolt in 1337, the rising that gave birth to the Sarbadar state. 'Ala' al-Din remained Togha Temür's vizier and fought the Sarbadars until he was killed in the khan's defeat near the Atrek river on 29 July 1342, a battle in which the lord of Kuhistan and the khan's own brother also fell.
zh: 法鲁马迪家族是西呼罗珊萨卜泽瓦尔的名门，得名于附近的法鲁马德；早在伊利汗国时期，长老塔希尔·法鲁马迪父子就是诗人普尔·巴哈·贾米的富有施主。家族中最知名的阿拉丁·穆罕默德·法鲁马迪为伊利汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿镇守萨卜泽瓦尔、朱温及内沙布尔的一部分，并出任维齐尔。他的苛税迫使当地地主阿卜杜勒·拉扎克于1337年起兵，这场起义造就了萨尔巴达尔政权。阿拉丁继续担任脱合帖木儿的维齐尔并与萨尔巴达尔人作战，最终在1342年7月29日阿特拉克河畔的惨败中阵亡，同战而死的还有库希斯坦领主和汗的亲弟。

en: The Fieschi were an ancient noble house of the Genoese hinterland, invested as counts of Lavagna by the Emperor Henry II in 1010 and established at San Salvatore di Cogorno in the Ligurian Levant, where they kept a semi-independent lordship against the Republic of Genoa. As leading Guelphs and merchants they built fiefs and business interests in Piedmont, Lombardy, Umbria and the Kingdom of Naples, and their feud with the Doria family shaped Genoese politics for centuries. The house reached the summit of the Church when Sinibaldo Fieschi was elected Pope Innocent IV in 1243; he fled to France in 1244 before the Emperor Frederick II and returned to Rome only in 1250, dying in 1254. His nephew Ottobuono became Pope Adrian V in 1276, one of three popes of that year, and the family is reckoned to have supplied seventy-two cardinals, along with the Latin patriarch Opizzo of Antioch and the mystic Catherine of Genoa, who died in 1510. Their long contest with Genoa ended in the Fieschi conspiracy of 2 January 1547, when Count Giovanni Luigi Fieschi tried to seize the dogate from Andrea Doria and drowned in the arsenal during the attempt; the failure broke the family's power, though a cadet line continued as the Fieschi Ravaschieri princes of Belmonte.
zh: 菲耶斯基家族是热那亚内陆的古老贵族世家，1010年被皇帝亨利二世册封为拉瓦尼亚伯爵，立足利古里亚东部里维埃拉的圣萨尔瓦托雷·迪科戈尔诺，在那里保有一块对热那亚共和国半独立的领地。作为归尔夫派领袖和商人，他们在皮埃蒙特、伦巴第、翁布里亚和那不勒斯王国广置封地与商业利益，与多里亚家族的世仇左右了热那亚数百年的政局。家族在教会达到顶峰：西尼巴尔多·菲耶斯基于1243年当选教皇英诺森四世，1244年为躲避皇帝腓特烈二世逃往法国，直到1250年才返回罗马，1254年去世；他的侄子奥托博诺于1276年成为教皇阿德里安五世，是当年三位教皇之一。据统计该家族共出了七十二位枢机，还有安条克拉丁牧首奥皮佐，以及1510年去世的神秘主义者热那亚的圣凯瑟琳。家族与热那亚的长期较量终结于1547年1月2日的菲耶斯基阴谋：伯爵乔瓦尼·路易吉·菲耶斯基企图从安德烈亚·多里亚手中夺取总督之位，却在行动中溺死于军火库；事败后家族势力一蹶不振，只有旁支以贝尔蒙特亲王菲耶斯基·拉瓦斯基耶里的名号延续下去。

en: This FitzAlan line held the manor of Bedale in Richmondshire, Yorkshire, and claimed descent from Conan II, Duke of Brittany and Earl of Richmond. Its head, Sir Bryan FitzAlan, was a Yorkshire landowner with estates also at Askham Bryan and Killerby, where he received a licence to crenellate in 1291. In the same year Edward I named him one of the Guardians of Scotland during the succession dispute over the Scottish crown, and from 1295 he was summoned to parliament as Lord FitzAlan; in 1301 he sealed the Barons' Letter to the Pope. His sons by his first wife all died young, and by his second marriage to Maud de Balliol, sister of King John Balliol of Scotland, he left only daughters. When Bryan died in 1306 the male line became extinct: Agnes, born in 1298, married Sir Gilbert Stapleton and became the grandmother of Sir Miles Stapleton of Bedale, a knight founder of the Order of the Garter in 1348, while Katherine married Sir John de Grey, first Baron Grey of Rotherfield. Bedale and its lands passed through these two heiresses to the Stapleton and Grey families.
zh: 这一支菲查伦家族世居约克郡里士满郡的比代尔庄园，自称是布列塔尼公爵兼里士满伯爵柯南二世的后裔。家主布莱恩·菲查伦爵士是约克郡地主，还领有阿斯克姆布莱恩和基勒比，1291年获准在基勒比修建雉堞。同年，爱德华一世在苏格兰王位继承争端期间任命他为苏格兰监护官之一；1295年起他以菲查伦勋爵之名受召出席议会，1301年又在致教皇的男爵联名信上盖印。他与元配所生的儿子全部早夭，继室是苏格兰国王约翰·巴利奥尔之妹莫德·德·巴利奥尔，只留下女儿。1306年布莱恩去世，男系就此断绝：1298年出生的阿格尼丝嫁给吉尔伯特·斯特普尔顿爵士，是1348年嘉德骑士团创始骑士迈尔斯·斯特普尔顿的祖母；凯瑟琳则嫁给第一代罗瑟菲尔德格雷男爵约翰·德·格雷。比代尔的领地经这两位女继承人转入斯特普尔顿和格雷两家。

en: The FitzAlans were an Anglo-Norman house descended from Alan fitz Flaad, a Breton knight who came to England with Henry I; the family shares its paternal ancestry with the royal Stuarts, whose ancestor Walter fitz Alan was the younger brother of the FitzAlan William, lord of Oswestry. As Marcher lords the FitzAlans held Oswestry and Clun on the Welsh border, and a marriage to the d'Aubigny heiress brought them Arundel Castle in Sussex and the Earldom of Arundel in 1267. Edmund FitzAlan, the ninth earl, stood by Edward II and the Despensers and was executed in 1326, but his son Richard recovered the title in 1331. One of the richest men in England, Richard served as Admiral of the West, fought at Sluys in 1340 and was one of the three principal commanders at Crécy in 1346, while also ruling north Wales as justiciar. His younger son Thomas Arundel became Archbishop of Canterbury. The next earl, another Richard, joined the Lords Appellant against Richard II and was beheaded in 1397; the family was restored under Henry IV in 1400. Henry FitzAlan, the twelfth earl and last of the male line, died in 1580, and Arundel passed through his daughter Mary to the Howard dukes of Norfolk.
zh: 菲查伦家族是盎格鲁-诺曼名门，始祖为随亨利一世来到英格兰的布列塔尼骑士艾伦·菲茨弗拉阿德，与后来的斯图亚特王室同宗——斯图亚特先祖沃尔特·菲查伦之兄、奥斯沃斯特里领主威廉就是菲查伦家的人。作为威尔士边境的边疆贵族，菲查伦家族领有奥斯沃斯特里和克伦；通过与多比尼家族女继承人联姻，他们于1267年取得萨塞克斯的阿伦德尔城堡和阿伦德尔伯爵爵位。第九代伯爵埃德蒙效忠爱德华二世和德斯潘塞父子，1326年被处决，其子理查德于1331年恢复爵位。理查德是英格兰最富有的贵族之一，曾任西海海军上将，1340年参加斯鲁伊斯海战，1346年作为三名主将之一出战克雷西，并以北威尔士司法官的身份治理北威尔士。他的幼子托马斯·阿伦德尔后来官至坎特伯雷大主教。下代伯爵理查德加入诉追派贵族反对理查二世，1397年被斩首；1400年亨利四世在位时家族恢复爵位。第十二代伯爵亨利·菲查伦是家族最后一名男性继承人，1580年去世，阿伦德尔经其女玛丽转入霍华德家族的诺福克公爵一系。

en: The FitzGeralds, known in Ireland as the Geraldines, descend from Gerald de Windsor, a Norman castellan of Pembroke, and Nest ferch Rhys, a princess of the Welsh House of Dinefwr. Their son Maurice FitzGerald crossed to Ireland with the Anglo-Norman invasion of 1169 and helped take Wexford, Waterford and Dublin, founding one of the greatest Hiberno-Norman dynasties. The family split into two great branches: the Kildare line, created earls of Kildare in 1316 and based at Maynooth, and the Desmond line in Munster, later earls of Desmond. Both grew so deeply Gaelicised that contemporaries called them more Irish than the Irish themselves, and Gerald, third earl of Desmond, composed verse in Irish. Their power troubled the crown: Silken Thomas of Kildare rose in 1534 and was executed in 1537, while the Desmond Rebellions of 1569 to 1583 ended with the killing of the fourteenth earl, the forfeiture of Munster's greatest estate and the Plantation of Munster. The Kildare branch survived the upheaval, was restored to its earldom, and in 1766 became dukes of Leinster, the premier peers of Ireland.
zh: 菲茨杰拉德家族在爱尔兰被称为杰拉尔丁人，始祖是彭布罗克的诺曼城堡司令杰拉德·德·温莎与威尔士迪内弗尔王室公主内斯特·费奇·里斯。他们的儿子莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德参加了1169年盎格鲁-诺曼人对爱尔兰的入侵，参与攻占韦克斯福德、沃特福德和都柏林，由此开创了最显赫的海伯诺-诺曼王朝之一。家族分成两大支：1316年受封的基尔代尔伯爵支，以梅努斯为大本营；以及芒斯特的戴斯蒙德支，后为戴斯蒙德伯爵。两支都深度盖尔化，时人称其“比爱尔兰人还爱尔兰人”，第三代戴斯蒙德伯爵杰拉德还能用爱尔兰语写诗。他们的权势令王室不安：基尔代尔的“丝绸托马斯”1534年起兵，1537年被处决；1569至1583年的戴斯蒙德叛乱以第十四代伯爵被杀告终，芒斯特最大的地产被没收，随后开启了芒斯特种植园。基尔代尔一支熬过动荡、恢复伯爵爵位，并于1766年晋为伦斯特公爵，位列爱尔兰贵族之首。

en: The Gilpatricks, in Gaelic Mac Giolla Phádraig or son of the devotee of Saint Patrick, were the hereditary kings of Osraige, the kingdom of Ossory spanning what became County Kilkenny and the western part of Laois. They sprang from the old Dál Birn royal line and took their surname from Gilla Patráic mac Donnchada, who ruled Ossory from 976 to 996; his son Donnchad, king from 1003, also held the kingship of Leinster and was the first to bear the family name. The Norman invasion after 1169 broke the kingdom, and William Marshal partitioned most of it among his followers, but the northern district of Upper Ossory survived as an independent Gaelic lordship under the Gilpatricks, sometimes styled kings of the Slieve Blooms, with seats such as Cullahill Castle. In 1537 Brian Mac Giolla Phádraig surrendered to Henry VIII under the policy of surrender and regrant, adopted the anglicized surname Fitzpatrick and was created Baron Upper Ossory in 1541. His descendants held the barony until the seventh baron was attainted for his Jacobite loyalty in 1691; other branches then rose as Barons Gowran and Earls of Upper Ossory in the eighteenth century.
zh: 吉尔帕特里克家族，盖尔语作麦克·吉拉·法德里格，意为圣帕特里克信徒之子，是奥斯里格（即奥索里王国）的世袭王族，领地涵盖后来的基尔肯尼郡和利什郡西部。他们出自古老的达尔·伯恩王室，姓氏取自976至996年在位的奥索里国王吉拉·帕特里克·麦克·敦查达；其子敦查德1003年继位后还一度领有伦斯特王位，是第一个使用该姓氏的人。1169年以后的诺曼入侵瓦解了这个王国，威廉·马歇尔把大部分土地分封给部下，但北部的上奥索里作为独立的盖尔人领地保留下来，仍由吉尔帕特里克家族统治，族长有时被称为斯利维布鲁姆山之王，卡洛希尔城堡便是其据点之一。1537年，布赖恩·麦克·吉拉·法德里格按投降与再封政策归顺亨利八世，改用英语化的菲茨帕特里克为姓，并于1541年受封上奥索里男爵。其后代世袭男爵，直到第七代男爵因效忠詹姆斯党于1691年被剥夺爵位；其他支系则在18世纪相继成为高伦男爵和上奥索里伯爵。

en: The counts of Foix took their name from the castle of Foix in the northern Pyrenees, first held as a county by Roger of Foix around the middle of the eleventh century out of the old lands of the counts of Carcassonne. Roger II joined the First Crusade in 1095, and Raymond Roger fought at the capture of Acre in 1190 before being drawn into the Albigensian Crusade on the Cathar side; several early counts were patrons and composers of troubadour verse. From 1278 the counts were also co-princes of Andorra, and in 1290 Roger Bernard III inherited Bearn and Nebouzan through his wife, daughter of the viscount of Bearn, which made the family one of the greatest nobles of southern France and opened a long feud with the counts of Armagnac. In 1337 Gaston II ruled from the richer Bearn rather than Foix itself; his son Gaston III, called Phoebus, became the most famous of the line, defending the Gascon frontier, defeating the Armagnacs in 1362, holding a brilliant court at Orthez and writing the hunting treatise Livre de chasse. He died without legitimate sons in 1391, and the county passed through the Foix-Grailly branch, whose Francis Phoebus became king of Navarre in 1479. His sister Catherine carried the inheritance to the House of Albret and ultimately to Henry of Navarre, who as Henry IV of France united Foix to the royal domain in 1607.
zh: 富瓦伯爵得名于比利牛斯山北麓的富瓦城堡，11世纪中叶，罗热·德·富瓦从卡尔卡松伯爵的旧领地中分得富瓦，成为首任伯爵。罗热二世参加了1095年开始的第一次十字军东征，雷蒙·罗热则在1190年攻占阿卡时立功，后来又卷入阿尔比十字军、站在清洁派一边；早期几位伯爵还资助并亲自创作游吟诗人诗歌。自1278年起，富瓦伯爵同时是安道尔的共治亲王；1290年，罗热-贝尔纳三世凭借妻子——贝阿恩子爵之女——继承了贝阿恩和内布藏，家族一跃成为法兰西南部最有权势的贵族之一，也由此与阿马尼亚克伯爵结下长期世仇。1337年在位的加斯东二世留居更富庶的贝阿恩而非富瓦本地；他的儿子加斯东三世绰号“腓比斯”，是家族中最负盛名的一位，曾镇守加斯科涅边境、1362年击败阿马尼亚克人，在奥尔泰兹维持着辉煌的宫廷，并著有狩猎专著《狩猎之书》。他于1391年去世，没有嫡子，伯国转入富瓦-格拉伊支系；该支的弗朗索瓦·腓比斯于1479年成为纳瓦拉国王，其妹卡特琳又把继承权带入阿尔布雷家族，最终传到纳瓦拉的亨利手中——他作为法兰西国王亨利四世，于1607年将富瓦并入王室领地。

en: The Forzaté were one of the foremost noble houses of Padua, a branch of the Transalgardi who originally held the castle of Montemerlo on behalf of the city's bishop before turning to communal politics. Their most celebrated early member was the Benedictine monk Giordano Forzaté, born in 1158, whose peacemaking and monastic reforms earned him the title father of Padua; he backed Azzo VII d'Este against Ezzelino III da Romano, was arrested when Ezzelino took Padua in 1237, and died in Venetian exile on 7 August 1248, his cult being approved by Pope Clement XIII in 1767. In the fourteenth century the family rose through service to the Carraresi lords: Marzio's son Alvise Forzaté commanded castles in the Valsugana and led troops against Venice in the war of 1372 to 1373. After the peace he joined a plot to murder Francesco da Carrara and replace him with Marsilio da Carrara; betrayed by Pietro Salomoni, he was arrested on 17 January 1374 and beheaded with his nephew Philip on 24 January in front of the Palazzo della Ragione. A surviving son, Aledusio, was rehabilitated by Francesco Novello da Carrara in 1392, and later kin included the bishop Giovanni Battista Forzaté.
zh: 福尔扎泰家族是帕多瓦最显赫的贵族世家之一，属特兰萨尔加迪人的支系，最初替本城主教掌管蒙泰梅尔洛城堡，后来转而投身公社政治。家族早期最著名的成员是1158年出生的本笃会修士焦尔达诺·福尔扎泰，他因调停争端和推行修院改革赢得帕多瓦之父的称号；他支持阿佐七世·德斯特对抗埃泽利诺三世·达·罗马诺，1237年埃泽利诺占领帕多瓦后被捕，1248年8月7日死于威尼斯流亡地，教皇克雷芒十三世于1767年批准对他的崇拜。14世纪，家族凭借效力卡拉拉僭主而崛起：马尔齐奥之子阿尔维塞·福尔扎泰曾统辖瓦尔苏加纳的城堡，并在1372至1373年的战争中率兵对抗威尼斯。议和之后，他参与密谋，企图刺杀弗朗切斯科·达·卡拉拉、以马尔西利奥·达·卡拉拉取而代之；因彼得罗·萨洛莫尼出卖，他于1374年1月17日被捕，1月24日与侄子菲利普一起在法理宫前被斩首。幸存的儿子阿莱杜西奥于1392年被小弗朗切斯科·达·卡拉拉恢复名誉，家族后人中还有主教乔瓦尼·巴蒂斯塔·福尔扎泰。

en: The Fregoso, also called Campofregoso, were a Genoese noble house of merchants from Val Polcevera, active in the city's politics from the thirteenth century, when Rolando Fregoso held the castles of Voltaggio, Gavi and Porto Venere. They became the most prolific dogal dynasty in Genoese history: thirteen Fregoso became doge, beginning with Domenico di Campofregoso, who deposed Gabriele Adorno on 13 August 1370 and held the longest consecutive dogeship of the republic, dying in 1390. Family members also ruled Sarzana and scattered fiefs of the Ligurian Apennines, while Pomellina Fregoso married the lord of Monaco. The most famous was Paolo di Campofregoso, archbishop of Genoa from 1453 and a cardinal, who seized the dogeship three times from 1462 amid violent feuds with his own kin. Ottaviano Fregoso, raised at the humanist court of Urbino and portrayed in Castiglione's The Book of the Courtier, was the last Fregoso doge; captured by the Spaniards, he died in the prison of Ischia in 1524. In Andrea Doria's reform of 1528 the house was merged into the alberghi of De Fornari and De Ferrari, and although it revived its name in 1576, it never regained political importance.
zh: 弗雷戈索家族又称坎波弗雷戈索，是出身瓦尔波尔切维拉的热那亚商人贵族，13世纪起活跃于城市政坛，当时的罗兰多·弗雷戈索曾掌管沃尔塔焦、加维和韦内雷港等城堡。他们后来成为热那亚历史上出产总督最多的王朝：共有十三位家族成员出任总督，第一位是多梅尼科·迪·坎波弗雷戈索，他于1370年8月13日推翻加布里埃莱·阿多尔诺，其任期是共和国历史上最长的连续总督任期，本人于1390年去世。家族成员还统治过萨尔扎纳和利古里亚亚平宁山区的若干封地，波梅利娜·弗雷戈索则嫁给了摩纳哥领主。最著名的成员是保罗·迪·坎波弗雷戈索：他自1453年起任热那亚大主教并位至枢机，从1462年起在同族人的激烈内讧中三次夺得总督之位。奥塔维亚诺·弗雷戈索在乌尔比诺的人文主义宫廷长大，被写进卡斯蒂廖内的《廷臣论》，是最后一位弗雷戈索总督；他被西班牙人俘虏，1524年死于伊斯基亚的监狱。1528年安德烈亚·多里亚改革时，家族被并入德福尔纳里和德费拉里两个阿尔贝戈；1576年虽恢复本姓，却再未取得任何政治地位。

en: The counts of Freiburg were a branch of the counts of Urach who inherited the Zähringen lands in the Breisgau when the Zähringen dukes died out in 1218. Count Egino V of Urach, whose mother Agnes was a Zähringen, styled himself count of Freiburg from about 1230 and ruled the city and the surrounding Black Forest country. Under his son Conrad I the inheritance was divided with the princely house of Fürstenberg before 1245, and a younger son, Henry, received the southern lordship of Badenweiler in 1272; that line failed by 1303 and its lands passed through marriage to the counts of Straßberg before returning in 1385. The counts' hold on Freiburg itself was always contested, and in 1368 the city council ransomed the town from their rule, after which it became a Habsburg territorial city in the Austrian Forelands. Reduced to their estates around Neuenstein castle at Badenweiler, the counts lingered until the last of them, John, bequeathed Badenweiler in 1444 to his Hachberg-Sausenberg nephews, whose union of Rötteln, Sausenberg and Badenweiler created the Markgräflerland.
zh: 弗赖堡伯爵家族是乌拉赫伯爵的支系：1218年策林根公爵绝嗣后，他们继承了策林根家族在布赖斯高的领地。乌拉赫伯爵埃吉诺五世的母亲阿格尼丝出身策林根家族，他约从1230年起自称弗赖堡伯爵，统治这座城市及周围的黑林山地带。其子康拉德一世在位时，家族在1245年前与菲尔斯滕贝格诸侯家族分家；1272年幼子亨利获得南部的巴登韦勒领地，该支于1303年前后绝嗣，土地经联姻转入施特拉斯贝格伯爵之手，1385年才又收回。伯爵们对弗赖堡城本身的统治始终不稳，1368年市议会出钱赎身，摆脱伯爵统治，城市从此成为哈布斯堡在前奥地利的直辖城市。伯爵家族只剩下巴登韦勒的诺因施泰因城堡一带产业，勉强维持；末代伯爵约翰于1444年把巴登韦勒遗赠给外甥哈赫贝格-绍森贝格家族的兄弟，后者将勒特恩、绍森贝格和巴登韦勒合并，形成马克格雷夫勒兰。

en: The Gabras were a Byzantine aristocratic family from Chaldia, the mountainous north-eastern corner of Anatolia around Trebizond. A Constantine Gabras is first heard of in the revolt of Bardas Skleros of 976, and the family's greatest early figure was Theodore Gabras, who recaptured Trebizond from the Turks in 1075 and ruled the theme of Chaldia as a virtually autonomous governor from 1081 until his death in battle in 1098; he was later venerated as a saint. Another Constantine Gabras held Chaldia as a quasi-independent prince from about 1126 until Emperor John II Komnenos subdued him in 1140. Some Gabrades later entered Seljuk service, while the fourteenth-century scholar Michael Gabras and his brother John held administrative posts in Constantinople. Better known in this period is the family's Crimean branch, which ruled the Principality of Theodoro, also called Gothia, from its cliff capital of Mangup. A prince Demetrios is attested at the Battle of Blue Waters around 1362, and a prince Basil probably reigned before Stephen, who emigrated to Moscow with his son Gregory in 1391 or 1402; the Russian Khovrin and Golovin families claimed descent from them. The Theodoro Gabrades balanced vassalage to the Golden Horde with constant rivalry against the Genoese colonies on the coast, until the Ottomans stormed Mangup and extinguished the principality in 1475.
zh: 加夫拉斯是拜占庭的贵族世家，出自安纳托利亚东北角、特拉布宗周围的山区哈尔迪亚。976年，一位君士坦丁·加夫拉斯首次见于巴尔达斯·斯克莱鲁的叛乱记载；家族早期最显赫的人物是塞奥多雷·加夫拉斯，他于1075年从突厥人手中收复特拉布宗，1081年起以近乎自立的总督身份统治哈尔迪亚军区，直至1098年战死，后来被尊为圣徒。另一位君士坦丁·加夫拉斯约从1126年起以半独立王公身份统治哈尔迪亚，1140年被皇帝约翰二世·科穆宁平定。此后一些加夫拉斯家族成员转投塞尔柱人效力，而14世纪的学者米海尔·加夫拉斯和他的兄弟约翰则在君士坦丁堡担任行政官职。这一时期更出名的是家族的克里米亚支系：他们以悬崖上的曼古普为都，统治又称哥提亚的狄奥多罗公国。约1362年，一位季米特里奥斯王公见于蓝水之战的记载；在斯捷潘之前可能还有一位瓦西里王公在位，斯捷潘则于1391年或1402年携子格里高利移居莫斯科，俄罗斯的霍夫林和戈洛温家族都自称是他们的后裔。狄奥多罗的加夫拉斯家族一面臣服于金帐汗国，一面与沿海的热那亚殖民地长期争衡，最终奥斯曼人于1475年攻陷曼古普，公国灭亡。

en: The Gabrielli were an old feudal noble house of Gubbio in Umbria, first documented in the tenth century, when a Cante Gabrielli received castles in central Italy from Pope Stephen VII; the castle of Luceoli was renamed Cantiano after him. The family combined warfare with church careers: Girolamo Gabrielli led a hundred knights on the First Crusade, while the hermit Forte, who died in 1040, Bishop Rodolfo of Gubbio and the Franciscan tertiary Castora, who died in 1391, were all beatified or canonised. The most famous member was Cante Gabrielli, commander in chief of the Guelph League in central Italy and podestà of Florence, who condemned Dante Alighieri to exile; Dante repaid him in the Divine Comedy by naming the furious devil Rubicante in the barratry bolgia after him. The Gabrielli ruled their native town as Giovanni Gabrielli held the lordship from 1350 to 1354 and Gabriello Gabrielli was both lord and bishop from 1381 to 1384; after losing Gubbio, the self-styled duke Cecciolo failed to reconquer it. Branches then served other Italian courts and the papacy, which made cardinals of Gabriele de' Gabrielli in 1505 and Giulio Gabrielli the Younger, Cardinal Secretary of State from 1808 to 1814, while the counts of Baccaresca settled in the French Comtat Venaissin.
zh: 加布里埃利家族是翁布里亚古城古比奥的封建贵族，最早见于10世纪的文献，当时一位名叫坎特·加布里埃利的人从教皇司提反七世手中获赐意大利中部的若干城堡，卢切奥利城堡还以他的名字改名为坎蒂亚诺。这个家族戎马与教会生涯并行：吉罗拉莫·加布里埃利率一百名骑士参加第一次十字军东征；1040年去世的隐修士福尔特、古比奥主教罗多尔福和1391年去世的方济各第三会修士卡斯托拉，都受宣福或封圣。最著名的成员是坎特·加布里埃利，他曾任意大利中部归尔夫联盟统帅和佛罗伦萨最高行政官，正是他判处但丁·阿利吉耶里流放；但丁在《神曲》的卖官鬻狱之沟里，用他的谐音给狂暴恶魔取名鲁比坎特作为报复。家族还曾统治故乡：乔瓦尼·加布里埃利于1350至1354年任古比奥领主，加布里埃洛·加布里埃利则在1381至1384年身兼领主与主教。失去古比奥后，自称公爵的切乔洛试图反攻却未能成功。此后各支派转而效力于意大利各宫廷和教廷，加布里埃莱·德·加布里埃利于1505年成为枢机，小朱利奥·加布里埃利在1808至1814年出任枢机国务卿，巴卡雷斯卡伯爵一支则定居法国的沃奈桑伯爵领地。

en: The Gambacorta or Gambacorti were a merchant noble family of Pisa, traced to the thirteenth-century trader Buonaccorso, called Coscio, who moved from the Pisan countryside into the city and built a fortune trading with Naples and Sardinia and buying estates in the Valdera. They led the Bergolini faction, the party favouring alliance with Florence: Andrea Gambacorta became captain of the masnade and head of the Pisan government after the Bergolini victory of 1347, and his nephew Francesco succeeded him in 1354, only to be deposed and killed in 1355 when the Emperor Charles IV's visit revived the anti-Florentine party. Pietro Gambacorta brought the family back to power in 1369, but in 1392 a conspiracy by Jacopo d'Appiano, allied to Gian Galeazzo Visconti, drove them out and Pietro was executed with his sons. After Florence conquered Pisa in 1406 the Gambacorta received the lordship of Bagno di Romagna, held until 1453, when Gherardo moved the family to Naples and entered the Neapolitan patriciate, accumulating fiefs from Celenza to the principality of Macchia; that branch died out in 1703. A Dominican daughter, Chiara Gambacorti, was beatified in 1830, and a Sicilian branch still numbered a senator of Palermo in 1771.
zh: 甘巴科尔塔家族（又作甘巴科尔蒂）是比萨的商人贵族，始祖可追溯到13世纪的商人布翁阿科尔索（人称科肖）：他从比萨乡间迁入城内，靠与那不勒斯和撒丁岛经商致富，并在瓦尔德拉广置田产。家族领导着主张与佛罗伦萨结盟的贝尔戈利尼派：安德烈亚·甘巴科尔塔在1347年贝尔戈利尼派获胜后成为佣兵队长和比萨政府首脑，侄子弗朗切斯科于1354年继任，却在1355年皇帝查理四世到访使反佛罗伦萨派重振时被废黜杀害。彼得罗·甘巴科尔塔于1369年率家族重新执政，但1392年雅各布·达皮亚诺勾结詹·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂发动阴谋，家族再度被逐，彼得罗与几个儿子一起被处决。1406年佛罗伦萨征服比萨后，甘巴科尔塔家族受封罗马涅巴尼奥领地，一直保有到1453年；此后盖拉尔多举家迁往那不勒斯，跻身那不勒斯贵族，从切伦扎领主权到马基亚亲王国累积了大批封地，该支派于1703年绝嗣。家族的多明我会女儿基亚拉·甘巴科尔蒂于1830年受宣福，西西里支派到1771年还有一位成员出任巴勒莫元老院议员。

en: The Garaad were the ruling house of the Muslim kingdom of Hadiya in the Ethiopian highlands south of Shewa, whose sovereigns bore the title Garad. Local tradition traces the dynasty to descendants of Abadir, emir of Harar, who intermarried with the local Sidama people, and Hadiya is already named in the thirteenth-century Kebra Nagast. Early in the fourteenth century its king, Garad Amano, refused tribute to Emperor Amda Seyon I, who invaded and reduced Hadiya to a tributary linked with the Muslim principalities of Ifat and Zeila. During the reign of Zara Yaqob (1434-1468), Garad Mahiko, son of Garad Mehmad, likewise defied the crown and was deposed in favor of his uncle Bamo, then killed while fleeing to Adal; the Hadiya princess Eleni was married into the imperial court, and Adal's defeat at Gomit in 1445 tightened Ethiopian overlordship. In the 1520s the Portuguese priest Francisco Álvares found Hadiya peaceful and tributary, and in the 1530s its Muslims joined the conquests of Ahmad Gragn. Garad Aze's revolt was crushed under Emperor Sarsa Dengel, but early in the seventeenth century Garad Sidi Mohammed defeated the troops of Susenyos I, and the Czech traveller Remedius Prutky could still describe an independent Hadiya in 1751.
zh: 加拉德王朝是穆斯林政权哈迪亚王国的统治家族，哈迪亚位于绍阿以南的埃塞俄比亚高原，其君主以“加拉德”为号。当地传说称该王朝出自哈勒尔埃米尔阿巴迪尔的后裔，他们与当地锡达马人通婚；13世纪的《众王荣耀》已经提到哈迪亚。14世纪初，国王加拉德·阿莫诺拒绝向埃塞俄比亚皇帝阿姆达·塞翁一世纳贡，皇帝发兵入侵，把哈迪亚降为附庸，与伊法特、泽拉等穆斯林政权同处一个体系。泽拉·雅各布皇帝在位期间（1434—1468年），加拉德·梅哈马德之子加拉德·马希科再度抗命，被废后改立其叔父巴莫，他逃往阿达尔途中被杀；哈迪亚公主埃莱尼嫁入皇室，1445年阿达尔在戈米特战败，埃塞俄比亚的宗主权进一步加强。16世纪20年代，葡萄牙神父弗朗西斯科·阿尔瓦雷斯见到的哈迪亚和平安定、照章纳贡；16世纪30年代，当地穆斯林加入了艾哈迈德·格拉格的征战。加拉德·阿泽的叛乱在萨尔萨·登格尔皇帝时期被镇压，但17世纪初加拉德·西迪·穆罕默德击败了苏塞尼奥斯一世的军队，到1751年捷克旅行家普鲁特基仍把哈迪亚记作一个独立王国。

en: The House of Garen was the hereditary ruling dynasty of the Ajuran Sultanate in southern Somalia.
