It grew out of the Garen Kingdom, which held parts of the Somali lands east of the Ogaden in the thirteenth century, and as Somali groups moved south the line developed into an Islamic monarchy whose rulers took the title imam and claimed baraka descending from the saint Balad. From the late 1300s the Garen imams dominated the Banaadir interior for some three centuries, holding seasonal palaces at Mareeg, Qelafo and Merca and ruling over client sultans and emirs. Their empire monopolized the Jubba and Shebelle rivers through dykes, dams and stone wells, earning Ajuran the name of a hydraulic empire, while its armies checked the Oromo in the west and burned Portuguese raiders at Barawa. Heavy taxation sparked revolts at the end of the seventeenth century: the Abgaal took Mogadishu and set up the Hiraab Imamate, and the general Ibrahim Adeer founded the Gobroon dynasty, so that by the early 1700s Garen rule had vanished from Banaadir.
zh: 加伦家族是索马里南部阿朱兰苏丹国的世袭统治王朝。它源自13世纪的加伦王国，当时该国控制着欧加登以东的部分索马里人土地；随着索马里诸部南迁，这一世系演变为伊斯兰君主制，统治者称伊玛目，并宣称拥有源自圣徒巴拉德的“巴拉卡”神恩。14世纪末起，加伦伊玛目们在贝纳迪尔内陆称雄约三百年，在马雷格、凯拉福和梅尔卡设有季节性宫殿，统御众多附庸苏丹和埃米尔。帝国凭堤坝、水闸和石井垄断朱巴河与谢贝利河，阿朱兰因而被称为水利帝国；其军队西拒奥罗莫人，又在巴拉韦击退葡萄牙劫掠者。17世纪末，重税激起一连串叛乱：阿布加尔人夺取摩加迪沙，建立希拉卜伊玛目国；将领易卜拉欣·阿迪尔开创戈布伦王朝。到18世纪初，加伦的统治已在贝纳迪尔销声匿迹。

en: The Gediminids were the ruling dynasty of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania from the fourteenth to the sixteenth century, named after Grand Duke Gediminas, whose family tree was later traced back to the otherwise shadowy duke Skalmantas. Gediminas, ruling from about 1316 to 1341, made Vilnius his permanent capital, absorbed a string of Ruthenian principalities including Kiev, and pushed the grand duchy's borders from the Baltic toward the Black Sea while remaining pagan at his death. His sons Algirdas and Kęstutis and their descendants divided the inheritance, and in 1386 Algirdas' son Jogaila accepted baptism and the Polish crown through the Union of Krewo, founding the Jagiellonian cadet branch. Under Vytautas the Great the dynasty's armies shared in the victory over the Teutonic Knights at Grunwald in 1410, while Jagiellonian kings later wore the crowns of Poland, Hungary and Bohemia; the line ended with Sigismund II Augustus in 1572, three years after the Union of Lublin in 1569 joined Lithuania and Poland into one commonwealth. Other Gediminid branches stayed Orthodox and were Ruthenized, with houses such as the Galitzines and Trubetskoys entering the service of Muscovy, while the Polonized Czartoryskis remained magnates of Poland.
zh: 格迪米纳斯王朝是14至16世纪统治立陶宛大公国的王朝，得名于大公格迪米纳斯，后世把其家世追溯到面目模糊的公爵斯卡尔曼塔斯。格迪米纳斯约1316年至1341年在位，将维尔纽斯定为永久都城，吞并了包括基辅在内的一系列鲁塞尼亚公国，把大公国的疆界从波罗的海推进到黑海附近，去世时仍信奉异教。他的儿子阿尔吉尔达斯、科斯图提斯及其后代分割了家业；1386年，阿尔吉尔达斯之子雅盖沃通过《克雷沃联合》接受洗礼并登上波兰王位，开创了支系雅盖隆王朝。在维陶塔斯大帝治下，该王朝的军队于1410年在格伦瓦德战役中合力击败条顿骑士团；此后雅盖隆系君主还先后戴上波兰、匈牙利和波希米亚的王冠。1569年《卢布林联合》把立陶宛与波兰合并为一个共和国，三年后的1572年，末代男嗣齐格蒙特二世·奥古斯特去世，主支断绝。其余支系仍奉东正教并被鲁塞尼亚化，戈利岑、特鲁别茨科伊等家族转投莫斯科公国，而波兰化的恰尔托雷斯基家族则长期位列波兰权贵。

en: The counts of Geneva, called the Géroldiens after their mid-eleventh-century ancestor Gérold, were one of the great comital houses of the old Kingdom of Burgundy, holding lands around Lake Geneva, the Annecy basin and the Chamonix valley. In 1034 Count Gérold resisted the absorption of Burgundy by the Emperor Conrad II, who nevertheless had himself crowned at Geneva. Rivalry with the bishops of Geneva ended in the treaty of Seyssel of 1124, under which Count Aymon I gave up his temporal claims over the city itself and kept only the castle of Bourg-de-Four; from 1219 the family's capital was Annecy. Hemmed in by the rising House of Savoy, the counts nonetheless cut a figure in regional politics, and a younger branch, the lords of Gex, took its name from Amadeus of Gex. The house's last spectacular role came through Robert of Geneva, who was elected pope by the French cardinals in 1378 as the Avignon antipope Clement VII and inherited the county from his brother in 1392. On his death in 1394 the male line was extinct, and in 1401 his heirs sold the county to Amadeus VIII of Savoy, after which it served as an appanage for younger Savoyard princes.
zh: 日内瓦伯爵家族（因11世纪中叶的始祖热罗尔而被一些系谱学者称为热罗尔家族）是旧勃艮第王国的大伯爵世家之一，领地分布在日内瓦湖、阿讷西湖盆地和沙莫尼山谷一带。1034年，伯爵热罗尔曾抵制皇帝康拉德二世吞并勃艮第，但皇帝仍在日内瓦加冕。家族与日内瓦主教的争斗以1124年的《塞塞尔条约》告终：伯爵艾蒙一世放弃对日内瓦城本身的世俗权力，只保留布尔格德富尔城堡；从1219年起，家族的首府设在阿讷西。尽管被崛起的萨伏依家族步步挤压，日内瓦伯爵们仍在地区政治中占有一席之地，其幼支还形成了以热克斯的阿梅迪奥得名的热克斯领主家族。家族最后一段显赫经历与罗贝尔·德·日内瓦有关：他于1378年被法国籍枢机选为对立教宗克莱孟七世，驻跸阿维尼翁，又在1392年继承兄长的伯爵之位。他于1394年去世后男系断绝，1401年其继承人把伯国卖给萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥八世，此后该伯国成为萨伏依幼支亲王的封地。

en: The Germiyanids were a Turkoman dynasty that ruled western Anatolia from Kütahya from around 1300 to 1429 and for much of that time overshadowed the tiny Ottoman frontier principality beside them. The Germiyan tribe is first heard of in the twelfth century fighting the Crusaders and Georgia, and it was settled near Malatya before Mongol pressure pushed it west; when the Sultanate of Rum dissolved, Yakub I, who reigned from 1300 to 1340, made the beylik sovereign and warred with both the Byzantines and the rising Ottomans. In 1337 it was Yakub I who still ruled from Kütahya, his court already a centre of learning where Persian works were translated into Turkish. His successors Mehmed and Süleyman faced the Karamanids on one side and the Ottomans on the other, and Süleyman married his daughter Devletşah Hatun to the future Bayezid I with a dowry that surrendered much of the realm, including Kütahya. Yakub II was imprisoned by Bayezid in 1390 but fled to Timur and was restored after the Battle of Ankara in 1402, losing and recovering Kütahya once more to the Karamanids. Having no sons, Yakub II bequeathed the beylik to Murad II on his death in 1429, and Germiyan passed peacefully into the Ottoman Empire.
zh: 盖尔米扬王朝是约1300至1429年间以屈塔希亚为都、统治西安纳托利亚的土库曼王朝，在很长时间里令身旁弱小的奥斯曼边境侯国相形见绌。盖尔米扬部最早见于12世纪，曾与十字军和格鲁吉亚作战，先是游牧于马拉蒂亚一带，后在蒙古压力下西迁；罗姆苏丹国瓦解时，1300至1340年在位的雅库布一世使贝伊国获得独立，并同时与拜占庭和崛起中的奥斯曼人交战。1337年仍是雅库布一世坐镇屈塔希亚，他的宫廷已是学术中心，不少波斯语作品在此被译成土耳其语。后继的穆罕默德和苏莱曼两面受敌，一边是卡拉曼王朝，一边是奥斯曼人；苏莱曼将女儿德夫莱特莎哈顿嫁给后来的巴耶济德一世，嫁妆竟包括都城屈塔希亚在内的大半国土。雅库布二世于1390年被巴耶济德囚禁，后逃奔帖木儿，1402年安卡拉战役后复国，其间屈塔希亚还曾一度失陷于卡拉曼人又再度收回。雅库布二世没有子嗣，1429年去世时以遗嘱将贝伊国赠予穆拉德二世，盖尔米扬遂和平并入奥斯曼帝国。

en:
The Gerulfings, also called the House of Holland, were the first comital dynasty of the County of Holland and Zeeland, then known as West Frisia. They took their name from Gerulf the Elder, who died after 839 and was said to descend from Radbod, the Frisian king of the early eighth century. Gerolf, count in Frisia, was the father or foster-father of Dirk I, who in 922 received the lands around Egmond from Emperor Charles the Fat, an act regarded as the foundation of the County of Holland. The counts built Egmond Abbey and turned the coastal marshes into a territorial power, while bastard branches such as the Van Brederode and Van Teylingen spread their influence through the Low Countries.

The main line ended with Count John I, the fifteen-year-old son of the murdered Floris V, who died childless at Haarlem in 1299, after which Holland passed to the House of Avesnes of Hainaut. A younger branch survived longer in the County of Bentheim, inherited through Sophia of Rheineck, wife of Count Dirk VI; after a partition in 1277 into Bentheim-Bentheim and Bentheim-Tecklenburg, this branch lasted until 1421, when Bentheim passed through a collateral female line.
zh:
赫吕尔夫家族又称荷兰家族，是荷兰伯国与泽兰伯国（当时称西弗里斯兰）的第一个伯爵王朝。家族得名于839年后去世的老格鲁尔夫，传说他是8世纪初弗里斯兰国王拉德博德的后裔。弗里斯兰伯爵格鲁尔夫是德克一世的生父或养父；922年，德克一世从皇帝胖子查理手中受封埃赫蒙德一带的土地，此事被视为荷兰伯国的开端。历代伯爵兴建埃赫蒙德修道院，把沿海沼泽经营成一方强权，范布雷德罗德、范泰林根等庶支也在低地开枝散叶。

主支终结于伯爵约翰一世：他是遇刺的弗洛里斯五世之子，1299年十五岁时在哈勒姆无嗣而亡，荷兰随后转入埃诺的阿韦讷家族手中。更小的支系则在本特海姆伯国延续得更久——这块领地由伯爵德克六世之妻赖讷克的索菲娅继承而来；1277年该支分裂为本特海姆-本特海姆与本特海姆-泰克伦堡两支，直到1421年绝嗣，本特海姆才经旁系女继承人转手。

en: The della Gherardesca were a noble family of the Republic of Pisa, of Lombard origin, whose lineage is documented from the eleventh century. As leaders of the Ghibelline party in Pisa they held the county of Donoratico and carried on a long rivalry with the Guelph Visconti, an enmity that Emperor Frederick II failed to settle in 1237. From the 1250s the family built up interests in Pisan Sardinia: after the partition of the giudicato of Cagliari in 1258 it took the mining-rich south-west, where Count Ugolino della Gherardesca founded the town of Villa di Chiesa, present-day Iglesias, around 1272. Ugolino, as podestà of Pisa, withdrew his squadron at the naval battle of Meloria against Genoa in 1284, a flight later read as treachery. He became the strongest man in the city until Archbishop Ruggieri degli Ubaldini seized him in 1288 and had him starved to death with two sons and two grandsons in the tower of the Muda in March 1289, an episode Dante made famous in the Inferno. The house never recovered its hold on Pisa, but branches endured as landholders in Volterra and Florence; Emilia della Gherardesca married the lord of Mantua and died as its duchess in 1349, and later sons of the family became bishops and archbishops in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries.
zh: 德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡家族是比萨共和国的贵族世家，源自伦巴第人，谱系可追溯至11世纪。作为比萨吉伯林派的首领，他们领有多诺拉蒂科伯爵领，并与圭尔夫派的维斯孔蒂家族长期敌对，皇帝腓特烈二世曾于1237年出面调解却未能成功。13世纪50年代起，该家族在比萨治下的撒丁岛经营势力：1258年参与瓜分卡利亚里王国，得到矿藏丰富的西南部，乌戈利诺·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡伯爵约于1272年在那里建立基耶萨镇，即今天的伊格莱西亚斯。乌戈利诺身为比萨执政官，在1284年对热那亚的梅洛里亚海战中率部撤退，这一逃走后来被视为叛变。他一度成为全城最有权势的人，直到1288年被比萨大主教鲁吉耶里·德利·乌巴尔迪尼逮捕，1289年3月与两个儿子、两个孙子一起被关在穆达塔楼中活活饿死，但丁在《地狱篇》中写过这一幕。此后该家族未能恢复对比萨的掌控，但支系作为地主在沃尔泰拉和佛罗伦萨延续；埃米莉亚·德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡嫁给曼托瓦领主，1349年去世时身为曼托瓦公爵夫人，其后人在16、17世纪还出过主教和大主教。

en: The Ghisi were a Venetian noble family, said to originate in Padua or Aquileia, who rose as Latin lords in the Aegean after the Fourth Crusade. In 1207 Andrea Ghisi took part in Marco Sanudo's conquest of the Cyclades and became lord of Tinos and Mykonos, holding them directly of the Latin Empire, while his brother Geremia ruled Skopelos, Skiathos and Skyros and seized Andros around 1239; the Republic of Venice condemned the brothers for that occupation in 1243 and exiled Andrea before reconciling with him in 1253. A sister, Agnese, married Othon de Cicon, lord of Karystos on Euboea, tying the house to the Negroponte frontier. Later generations combined their island lordship with fiefs on the Greek mainland: George I Ghisi held the barony of Chalandritsa in the Principality of Achaea and fell fighting the Catalan Company at the battle of the Cephissus in 1311. His son Bartholomew II became a triarch of Negroponte and Grand Constable of Achaea; he was captured by the Byzantines in 1320 and held prisoner in Constantinople until 1325, and died in 1341. George II joined the Smyrniote crusade of 1343 and probably died in its fighting. The island line continued through Bartholomew III and George III, the last Ghisi lord of Tinos, Mykonos and Negroponte, who died around 1390.
zh: 吉西家族是威尼斯贵族世家，据说源自帕多瓦或阿奎莱亚，在第四次十字军东征后作为拉丁人领主崛起于爱琴海。1207年，安德烈亚·吉西参加马尔科·萨努多征服基克拉泽斯群岛的远征，成为蒂诺斯岛和米科诺斯岛的领主，直接臣属于拉丁帝国；其弟杰雷米亚则领有斯科派洛斯、斯基亚索斯和斯基罗斯三岛，并于1239年前后夺取安德罗斯岛，威尼斯共和国为此在1243年判罪两兄弟、流放安德烈亚，直到1253年才与他和解。姊妹阿涅塞嫁给埃维亚岛卡里斯托斯的领主奥托·德·西孔，使家族与内格罗蓬特边境联姻。此后几代人把海岛领地与希腊大陆的封邑结合起来：乔治一世·吉西在亚该亚公国领有卡兰德里察男爵领，1311年在凯菲索斯河战役中迎战加泰罗尼亚佣兵团时阵亡。其子巴尔托洛梅奥二世成为内格罗蓬特的三执政官之一兼亚该亚大统帅，1320年被拜占庭人俘虏、关押在君士坦丁堡，1325年才获释，1341年去世。乔治二世参加1343年的士麦那十字军，很可能死于战事。海岛一系经巴尔托洛梅奥三世传到乔治三世——最后一位领有蒂诺斯、米科诺斯和内格罗蓬特的吉西家族成员，他于1390年前后去世。

en: The Girkis were the earlier royal line of Hunza, remembered in Burusho tradition as the dynasty that preceded the Ayasho. One account, recorded by the nineteenth-century British officer John Biddulph, makes Girkis and Moghlot the twin sons of Mayroo Khan, the first Muslim thum of Nagar, by a daughter of the Trakhan raja of Gilgit; because the brothers were hostile from birth, their father divided his state, giving Girkis the northern bank of the river, which became Hunza, and Moghlot the southern bank, which became Nagar. The Hunza royal chronicle instead calls the founder Sahib Khan, surnamed Girkis, a great-grandson of the legendary Persian prince Azar Jamshid, and dates the succeeding Ayasho house to 874. Later British writers linked the title Girkis with the Kirghiz nomads of the Pamir steppes who had displaced the older Dardic population of the valley.
zh: 吉尔基斯是罕萨更早的王世，在布鲁绍传说中是阿亚朔王朝之前的统治家族。19世纪英国军官约翰·比杜尔夫记录的说法称，吉尔基斯与莫格洛特是讷格尔首位穆斯林图姆迈鲁汗与吉尔吉特特剌汗拉杰之女所生的双胞胎；兄弟二人自幼敌对，父亲便将国家一分为二，吉尔基斯得到河北岸，即后来的罕萨，莫格洛特得到河南岸，即后来的讷格尔。罕萨王室的编年则称开创者为萨希卜汗，别号吉尔基斯，是传说中波斯王子阿扎尔·贾姆希德的曾孙，而继起的阿亚朔家族按传说始于874年。后来的英国学者还把吉尔基斯这个称号与帕米尔草原上取代了河谷古老达尔德居民的柯尔克孜游牧民联系起来。

en: The Glabas were a small Byzantine aristocratic family whose standing came almost entirely from Michael Doukas Glabas Tarchaneiotes, born around 1235. A career soldier under Michael VIII and Andronikos II, he campaigned against Bulgaria from the 1260s and in 1279 captured Tarnovo to install the exile Ivan Asen III on the Bulgarian throne. He later fought the Serbs in Macedonia, recovered Dyrrhachion, Kruja and Kanina from the Angevins of Naples between 1284 and 1291, and served as governor of the western provinces with his seat at Thessalonica, rising to the rank of protostrator, effectively commander-in-chief. He and his wife Maria were generous church patrons, restoring the Pammakaristos Church in Constantinople, where he was buried around 1305 to 1308. Their daughters married into the Branas and Angelos houses, and one line became maternal ancestors of the emperor John VI Kantakouzenos. A later kinsman, Isidore Glabas, born in 1341, served as metropolitan of Thessalonica from 1380 and negotiated with the Ottomans after they took the city in 1387, dying in 1396.
zh: 格拉瓦斯是拜占庭的一个小贵族家族，其地位几乎全靠约1235年出生的米海尔·杜卡斯·格拉瓦斯·塔尔哈内奥蒂斯一人奠定。他在米哈伊尔八世和安德洛尼卡二世麾下为将，13世纪60年代起出征保加利亚，1279年攻克特尔诺沃，把流亡的伊凡·阿森三世扶上保加利亚王位。此后他在马其顿对抗塞尔维亚人，1284至1291年间从那不勒斯安茹家族手中收复都拉齐翁、克鲁亚和卡尼纳，又出任西部行省总督、坐镇塞萨洛尼基，最终升为首席马夫，实际执掌全军统帅之职。他与妻子玛丽亚热心赞助教会，重修了君士坦丁堡的帕玛卡里斯托斯教堂，约1305至1308年间去世后即葬于该处。他们的女儿嫁入布拉纳斯和安格洛斯家族，其中一支后来成为皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库齐诺斯的外祖父母。较晚的族人伊西多尔·格拉瓦斯生于1341年，1380年起任塞萨洛尼基都主教，1387年城市陷落后曾与奥斯曼人谈判，1396年去世。

en: The House of Gonzaga was an Italian princely family that ruled Mantua from 1328 to 1708, first as captains-general, then margraves and finally dukes. Already a dominant clan in the city from the twelfth century, they overthrew their former allies the Bonacolsi in 1328, when Ludovico I Gonzaga, helped by the Scaliger lords of Verona, made himself capitano del popolo and imperial vicar under Emperor Louis IV. A younger son, Feltrino, founded the cadet line of Novellara, which survived until 1728. In 1433 Gianfrancesco I obtained the title of Marquis of Mantua from Emperor Sigismund, and Federico II became its first duke in 1530; the house also acquired the marquisate of Montferrat by marriage in 1531. Cadet branches ruled Nevers in France, Guastalla until 1746 and Sabbioneta, and the inheritance of Mantua and Montferrat by the Gonzaga-Nevers line triggered the War of the Mantuan Succession. Two daughters of the house, both named Eleonora, married emperors Ferdinand II and Ferdinand III, while Marie Louise Gonzaga was Queen of Poland from 1645 to 1667, and the family also produced Saint Aloysius Gonzaga. The Gonzaga were lavish patrons of art and learning: the collections of Isabella d'Este made their Mantuan court a magnet for Renaissance artists and musicians, until the main line died out and Gonzaga rule in Mantua ended in 1708.
zh: 贡扎加家族是意大利的诸侯世家，1328年至1708年统治曼托瓦，身份先后为平民官、侯爵和公爵。该家族12世纪起已是曼托瓦的望族，1328年在维罗纳斯卡拉家族的坎格兰德一世援助下推翻旧盟友博纳科尔西家族，卢多维科一世·贡扎加自立为平民官，并被神圣罗马帝国皇帝路易四世任命为帝国代理人。幼子费尔特里诺开创诺韦拉拉旁支，一直延续到1728年。1433年詹弗朗切斯科一世从皇帝西吉斯蒙德手中获得曼托瓦侯爵头衔，费代里科二世于1530年成为首任曼托瓦公爵，家族又在1531年通过联姻取得蒙费拉托侯爵领。各旁支分别统治法国的讷韦尔、延续至1746年的瓜斯塔拉以及萨比奥内塔；贡扎加-讷韦尔一系继承曼托瓦和蒙费拉托还引发了曼托瓦爵位继承战争。家族的两位女儿都叫埃莱奥诺拉，分别嫁给皇帝斐迪南二世和斐迪南三世；玛丽亚·路易莎·贡扎加于1645年至1667年出任波兰王后，家族还出了圣人圣路易吉·贡扎加。贡扎加家族也是慷慨的艺术与学术赞助人：伊莎贝拉·埃斯特的收藏使曼托瓦宫廷汇聚了文艺复兴时期的一流艺术家与音乐家，直到主系绝嗣、家族于1708年结束在曼托瓦的统治。

en: The Görz dynasty, known as the Meinhardiner after its forebear Count Meinhard I, took its name from Gorizia Castle, where its members served as advocates, or Vogts, of the Patriarchate of Aquileia and were first called counts of Gorizia in 1117. Probably descended from the Bavarian Siegharding family, they rose under the Hohenstaufen and from 1253 also ruled the County of Tyrol. In 1271 their lands were divided: the senior Gorizia-Tyrol line kept Tyrol while the Albertine line held Gorizia, the Puster Valley and offices in Carinthia. Both fought beside Rudolf of Habsburg against Ottokar II of Bohemia at Marchfeld in 1278, and in 1286 the senior line received the Duchy of Carinthia and the March of Carniola. Henry of Gorizia-Tyrol even wore the Bohemian crown in 1306 and again from 1307 to 1310 by marriage to the Přemyslid heiress Anne. The Tyrol branch died out with his daughter Margaret in 1369, its lands passing to the Habsburgs. The Albertine counts lost most of their wider territories after 1335 and withdrew to the original County of Gorizia; when the last count, Leonhard, died heirless in 1500, Maximilian I of Habsburg inherited the rest.
zh: 格尔茨家族又称迈因哈德家族，得名于始祖迈因哈德一世伯爵，姓氏则来自戈里齐亚城堡：家族成员在那里担任阿奎莱亚牧首区的护法官，1117年首次被称为戈里齐亚伯爵。他们可能源出巴伐利亚的西哈丁家族，在霍亨斯陶芬家族治下崛起，1253年起又领有蒂罗尔伯国。1271年家族领地一分为二：戈里齐亚-蒂罗尔长支保有蒂罗尔，阿尔伯特支则分得戈里齐亚、普斯特河谷以及在克恩滕的职位。两支都在1278年的马希费尔德战役中随哈布斯堡的鲁道夫对抗波希米亚的奥托卡二世；1286年长支受封克恩滕公国和卡尼奥拉边区。戈里齐亚-蒂罗尔的亨利还因娶普热米斯尔家族的女继承人安妮，于1306年及1307—1310年两度戴上波希米亚王冠。1369年亨利之女玛格丽特去世，蒂罗尔支系断绝，领地落入哈布斯堡家族之手。阿尔伯特支在1335年后陆续丧失大部分外围领地，退缩回最初的戈里齐亚伯国；1500年末代伯爵莱昂哈德无嗣而终，剩余领地由哈布斯堡的马克西米利安一世继承。

en: The Gotō were a widespread warrior lineage who claimed descent from Fujiwara no Toshihito, a chinjufu shōgun of the Northern House of the Fujiwara. According to the Sonpi Bunmyaku, his fifth-generation descendant Norimura, a resident of Sakado in Kawachi Province, styled himself Gotō no uchi by combining his offices of Higo no kami and udoneri with his Fujiwara surname, and his descendants adopted Gotō as their family name. After Motokiyo of the Hidesato-line Satō family entered the house as an adopted heir, its heads took Moto as their shared generational character. Branches spread across the country: the Mimasaka Gotō, settled in the province of that name, were counted kin of the Harima Gotō, whose most famous son was Gotō Mototsugu, the hard-fighting commander killed at Dōmyōji in the Osaka Summer Campaign of 1615. Another great branch, the Takeo Gotō of Hizen, began when Gotō Akiaki was made jitō of Tsukasaki after the Earlier Nine Years' War; its head Ujiaki fought the Mongol invaders in 1281, and in the Sengoku age Takaaki, an adopted son from the Ōmura house, attached the family to Ryūzōji Takanobu and then to the Nabeshima, under whom the Takeo Gotō became chief retainers of Saga Domain and were granted the Nabeshima surname in 1699.
zh: 后藤氏是分布很广的武士家族，自称出自藤原北家鱼名流的镇守府将军藤原利仁。据《尊卑分脉》记载，利仁五世孙、河内国坂户居民则村把自己的官职肥后守、内舍人与本姓藤原合起来，自称“后藤内”，子孙遂以后藤为姓。后来秀乡流佐藤氏的基清入继为养子，此后当主便以“基”为通字。后藤氏支流遍布日本，扎根美作国的一支称美作后藤氏，与播磨后藤氏同族；播磨一支最有名的人物是后藤基次（又兵卫），这位猛将在1615年大阪夏之阵的道明寺之战中战死。另一大支流是肥前的武雄后藤氏：前九年之役后，后藤章明被任命为肥前塚崎地头，其子孙在武雄落地生根，1281年当主后藤氏明曾与元军作战；战国时代的后藤贵明本是大村氏之子，入继后带领家族依附龙造寺隆信，其后又臣事取代龙造寺氏的锅岛氏，江户时代成为佐贺藩家老，并于1699年获准使用锅岛姓氏。

en: The Gradenigo were one of the oldest and most powerful houses of the Venetian patriciate, traditionally counted among the twelve apostolic families present at the birth of the duchy. Legend traced their ancestors to Ravenna or Transylvania, by way of Aquileia and the founding of Grado, from which their name was said to derive, and they are documented in Venetian politics from the second half of the ninth century. The house gave the Republic three doges. Pietro Gradenigo, doge from 1289, carried through the Serrata del Maggior Consiglio of 1297, which confined membership of the Great Council to a closed noble caste; when he died in 1311 Venice lay under papal interdict and he was buried in an unmarked grave on Murano. Earlier, Marco Gradenigo had served as bailo of Negroponte and podestà of Constantinople, holding that post when the Byzantines retook the city in 1261, and he later fought in the Venetian naval victory at Trapani in 1266. Bartolomeo Gradenigo, a wealthy merchant and former podestà of Ragusa, was doge from 1339 to 1342, and Giovanni Gradenigo was elected in 1355 after the execution of Marino Faliero and made peace with Genoa. A branch settled in Crete joined the island revolt of 1363 to 1366, while later Gradenigo served as Duke of Crete and rose to be patriarchs of Aquileia and Venice in the seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries.
zh: 格拉代尼戈家族是威尼斯贵族中最古老、最有权势的世家之一，传统上被列为共和国初创时的十二使徒家族之一。传说其先祖经阿奎莱亚参与建立格拉多，源头或在拉文纳或在特兰西瓦尼亚，姓氏也被认为得自格拉多；该家族自9世纪下半叶已见载于威尼斯政治史，先后出了三位总督。彼得罗·格拉代尼戈1289年出任总督，于1297年推动大议会封闭法案，把大议会议席限定在封闭的贵族阶层内部；他1311年去世时威尼斯正受教廷绝罚，只得葬在穆拉诺的无名墓中。更早的马尔科·格拉代尼戈曾任内格罗蓬特长官和君士坦丁堡执政官，1261年拜占庭人收复君士坦丁堡时他正在任上，后来又参加1266年威尼斯获胜的特拉帕尼海战。富商出身、曾任拉古萨执政官的巴尔托洛梅奥·格拉代尼戈于1339年至1342年出任总督；乔瓦尼·格拉代尼戈在马里诺·法列罗被处决后的1355年当选，并与热那亚媾和。定居克里特的支系参加了1363年至1366年的克里特叛乱，家族后人还担任过克里特公爵，并在17世纪至18世纪初出任阿奎莱亚和威尼斯的宗主教。

en: The lords of Grandson were a great noble house of the Vaud, named after their castle of Grandson on the Lake of Neuchâtel; a certain Adalbert is already styled prince of Grandson Castle in a charter of 1049. From their castles of Grandson, Champvent, La Sarraz and Montricher they commanded the Jura passes between the Vaud and the Franche-Comté, and around 1130 they founded the Abbey of Lac de Joux, which became their burial place. The family's European fame came under Edward I of England: Otto I de Grandson, son of Lord Peter I, was the king's closest friend and a leading Savoyard knight in his wars, while his brother William was created Baron Grandison in England in 1299 and two other brothers, Gerard and Henry, sat successively as bishops of Verdun. Having no children, Otto I made his nephew Peter II his heir; Peter's marriage to Blanche of Savoy-Vaud in 1303 tied the house to the counts of Savoy. Peter's grandson Oton III, who died in 1397, was a soldier and poet whose fame for chivalry spread through Europe, and another kinsman, John, fell on the crusade of Nicopolis in 1396. The senior Vaud line died out in the later fourteenth century and the Franche-Comté branch of Grandson-Pesmes in the early sixteenth, when the princes of Savoy confiscated the family's remaining lands.
zh: 格朗松领主是沃地区的大贵族世家，得名于他们在纳沙泰尔湖畔的格朗松城堡；早在1049年的一份特许状里，一位名叫阿达尔贝尔特的人就已被称为格朗松城堡的主人。家族凭借格朗松、尚旺、拉萨拉和蒙特里谢等城堡，控制着沃地区与弗朗什-孔泰之间的汝拉山口，并在约1130年创建茹湖修道院，那里后来成为家族墓地。家族的全欧声誉来自英王爱德华一世时代：领主彼得一世之子奥托一世是爱德华一世最亲密的朋友，也是其战争中最重要的萨伏依骑士之一；其弟威廉于1299年在英格兰受封格兰迪森男爵，另外两个兄弟热拉尔和亨利先后出任凡尔登主教。奥托一世没有子女，立外甥彼得二世为继承人，彼得二世于1303年娶萨伏依-沃的布朗什，使家族与萨伏依伯爵联姻。彼得的孙子奥东三世于1397年去世，是骑士精神和诗名传遍欧洲的军人诗人；另一位族人约翰则在1396年的尼科波利斯十字军之战中阵亡。沃地区的长支于14世纪末断绝，弗朗什-孔泰的格朗松-佩姆支系也在16世纪初消亡，家族剩余领地被萨伏依公爵没收。

en: The Greys of Rotherfield traced their Oxfordshire estate to the Norman knight Anchetil de Greye, who is recorded in the Domesday Book of 1086 as lord of Rotherfield. Their principal seat was Greys Court at Rotherfield Greys, and they later held the feudal baronies of Shabbinton in Buckinghamshire and Bedale in Yorkshire, the latter through the marriage of Sir John de Grey to Katherine FitzAlan, co-heiress of Bryan FitzAlan, Lord FitzAlan. The same John de Grey, born in 1300, was a soldier in the Scottish and French wars of Edward III and a courtier who became Lord Steward of the royal household. Summoned to parliament from 1338, he took his seat as the first Baron Grey of Rotherfield and in 1348 was among the founding knights of the Order of the Garter. His son and grandson succeeded as second and third barons, but when the fourth baron died without issue in 1388 the barony fell dormant, while the Rotherfield lands passed through heiresses to other houses.
zh: 罗瑟菲尔德的格雷家族在牛津郡的产业可追溯到诺曼骑士安克蒂尔·德·格雷——1086年的《末日审判书》已记载他为罗瑟菲尔德的领主。家族主宅是罗瑟菲尔德格雷的格雷庄园，后来又领有白金汉郡沙宾顿和约克郡比代尔两处封建男爵领，其中比代尔来自约翰·德·格雷与菲查伦勋爵布莱恩之女、共同继承人凯瑟琳·菲查伦的婚姻。这位生于1300年的约翰·德·格雷是爱德华三世朝苏格兰和法兰西战争中的军人，也是宫廷重臣，官至王室总管。他从1338年起受召出席议会，成为第一代罗瑟菲尔德格雷男爵，并于1348年位列嘉德骑士团创始骑士。其子其孙先后袭封第二、第三代男爵；1388年第四代男爵无嗣而终，男爵爵位就此搁置，罗瑟菲尔德的地产则经女继承人转入其他家族。

en: The House of Grimaldi descends from Grimaldo Canella, a twelfth-century consul of Genoa whose given name became the family surname, and from his son Oberto, who built up its maritime trading fortune. With the Fieschi, Doria and Spinola, the Grimaldi were one of the four dominant clans of the Republic of Genoa and led its Guelph faction, a stance that brought repeated exile, during which they took to piracy and held fiefs along the Ligurian and Provençal coasts. On the night of 8 January 1297 Francesco Grimaldi, called il Malizia, seized the Genoese citadel on the Rock of Monaco by entering it disguised as a Franciscan friar; the two armed monks supporting the Monegasque arms recall the trick. His cousin Rainier I, lord of Cagnes, held the rock until 1301 and was made Admiral of France after the battle of Zierikzee in 1304. The family bought definitive rights over Monaco from the crown of Aragon in 1419 and turned the outpost into a lasting lordship, adding Menton in 1346 and, under Spanish patronage, the Marquisate of Campagna in 1532. Honoré II took the title of sovereign prince in 1612 and later placed the house under French protection, receiving the Duchy of Valentinois. When the male line died with Antonio I in 1731, his daughter Louise Hippolyte's husband, Jacques de Matignon, adopted the Grimaldi name and arms so that the dynasty could continue.
zh: 格里马尔迪家族源自12世纪的热那亚执政官格里马尔多·卡内拉，他的名字后来成了家族姓氏；其子奥贝托靠海上贸易积累起家族财富。格里马尔迪与菲耶斯基、多里亚、斯皮诺拉并称热那亚共和国四大家族，并领导城里的圭尔夫派，也因此屡次遭流放，流亡期间一度以海盗为业，并在利古里亚和普罗旺斯沿海领有封邑。1297年1月8日夜，绰号“狡猾者”的弗朗索瓦·格里马尔迪乔装成方济各会修士，夺取了热那亚设在摩纳哥巨岩上的城堡；摩纳哥国徽上两名持剑修士的扶盾形象，记的就是这一计谋。其堂弟、卡涅领主拉尼埃里一世占据巨岩至1301年，并在1304年的济里克泽海战后受任法国海军统帅。1419年，家族从阿拉贡王室手中买下摩纳哥的永久权利，把这个据点经营成稳固的领地，1346年又取得芒通，1532年在西班牙庇护下获得坎帕尼亚侯爵领。奥诺雷二世于1612年改称世袭亲王，后来率家族接受法国庇护，并受封瓦伦蒂努瓦公爵。1731年男系随安东尼奥一世去世而断绝，其女婿雅克·德·马提翁改用格里马尔迪的姓氏与纹章，使王朝得以延续。

en: The counts of Gruyere were one of the foremost noble houses of western Switzerland from the eleventh to the sixteenth century, ruling a compact county in the upper Sarine valley of the present-day canton of Fribourg, a land of forests and clearings running from Gsteig to Broc. A Count Wilerius and his family appear as benefactors of Rougemont Priory in a charter of 1115, and two kinsmen took part in the First Crusade; the name Gruyere first appears in 1144, when William II is styled comes de Grueria, while Gruyeres Castle is attested from 1244. The house founded Rougemont Priory in 1104, Haut-Cret Abbey in 1134, Humilimont Abbey in 1136 and the Part-Dieu charterhouse in 1307. Count Rodolphe III did homage to Savoy in 1236 and placed the county under Savoyard suzerainty in 1244, a bond that lasted until 1536; Rodolphe IV added the lordships of Palezieux in 1381, Oron in 1388 and Aubonne and Coppet in 1393, and received a minting right from King Wenceslas in 1396. The last count, Michel, crushed by debt, fled to Burgundy, and in 1554 his Swiss allies declared him bankrupt and Fribourg and Bern divided the County of Gruyere between them.
zh: 格吕耶尔伯爵家族是11至16世纪瑞士西部最重要的贵族世家之一，统治着萨讷河上游河谷（在今弗里堡州境内）一块紧凑的伯国，那是一片从格施泰格延伸到布罗克、遍布森林与新开垦地的山区。1115年的一份文书显示，维莱里乌斯伯爵一家是鲁日蒙修道院的捐赠人，家族还有两名亲属参加第一次十字军东征；格吕耶尔之名首见于1144年，纪尧姆二世当时被称为格吕耶尔伯爵，格吕耶尔城堡则1244年已有记载。家族先后创立鲁日蒙修道院（1104年）、欧克雷修道院（1134年）、于米利蒙修道院（1136年）和帕尔迪厄加尔都西会院（1307年）。鲁道夫三世伯爵于1236年向萨伏依伯爵行臣服礼，1244年把伯国置于萨伏依宗主权之下，这一关系一直延续到1536年；鲁道夫四世又于1381年取得帕勒济厄、1388年取得奥龙、1393年取得欧博讷与科佩等领地，并于1396年从文策尔国王手中获得铸币权。末代伯爵米歇尔债台高筑，逃往勃艮第；1554年他的瑞士盟友宣布其破产，弗里堡与伯尔尼随即瓜分了格吕耶尔伯国。

en: The Griffins, or House of Pomerania, were a West Slavic dynasty named after the griffin on their ducal seal, first attested for Casimir II in 1194. Their first historical ruler was Wartislaw I, who died around 1135 and built a duchy along the southern Baltic coast from the Oder Lagoon to the Peene; his people were converted by the missionary Otto of Bamberg in 1124 and 1128. The dukes were successively vassals of Poland, Saxony, the Empire from 1181 and Denmark from 1185 until 1227, when they settled under the Empire. The duchy was split in 1295 into Pomerania-Wolgast and Pomerania-Stettin, and in 1337 several Griffin dukes ruled these parts jointly, while daughters of the house married into Saxe-Lauenburg and the Silesian duchy of Ścinawa; the family also absorbed the Schlawe and Stolp lands in 1317 and the Principality of Rügen in 1325. Its most famous son was Eric of Pomerania, who became king of Denmark, Norway and Sweden and head of the Kalmar Union in 1397, while Elizabeth of Pomerania married the Emperor Charles IV. Bogislaw X reunited the duchy in 1478, and the nobility adopted Protestantism at the Treptow diet of 1534. The last duke, Bogislaw XIV, died without heirs in 1637 during the Thirty Years' War, after which Sweden and Brandenburg-Prussia divided Pomerania; the last Griffin of all, Anna von Croy, died in 1660.
zh: 格里芬家族又称波美拉尼亚家族，是西斯拉夫王朝，得名于公爵纹章上的狮鹫——这一图案最早见于1194年卡齐米日二世的印章。家族第一位可考的统治者是约1135年去世的瓦季斯瓦夫一世，他在波罗的海南岸建立起从奥得河潟湖到佩讷河的公国；1124年和1128年，传教士班贝格的奥托使其臣民皈依基督教。公爵们先后臣属于波兰、萨克森，1181年起臣属神圣罗马帝国，1185—1227年又受丹麦控制，此后固定为帝国封臣。1295年公国分裂为波美拉尼亚-沃尔加斯特和波美拉尼亚-斯德丁两支，1337年数位格里芬公爵共同统治这些分地，家族的公主则嫁入萨克森-劳恩堡和西里西亚的希齐纳瓦公国；家族还在1317年并入斯瓦夫诺和斯武普斯克地区，1325年继承吕根亲王国。最著名的成员是波美拉尼亚的埃里克，他于1397年成为丹麦、挪威、瑞典三国国王和卡尔马联盟的共主；波美拉尼亚的伊丽莎白则嫁给了皇帝查理四世。博吉斯瓦夫十世于1478年重新统一公国，1534年的特雷普托等级会议正式定新教为国教。末代公爵博吉斯瓦夫十四世在三十年战争中的1637年无嗣而终，波美拉尼亚随后被瑞典和勃兰登堡-普鲁士瓜分；家族最后一位成员安娜·冯·克罗伊于1660年去世。

en: The Guarco were a Ghibelline noble family of the Republic of Genoa, probably originating at Gavi in the Oltregiogo and settled from the twelfth century in the upper Polcevera valley at Cesino, where watermills and ironworks made them one of the richest houses of the city. Their only member to reach the dogeship was Nicolò Guarco, born around 1325 as the son of a merchant. After embassies to France in 1351 and Portugal in 1371 and a term as governor of Chiavari, the popolani leaders made him the seventh doge on 17 June 1378. He led Genoa through the War of Chioggia against Venice: Genoese and allied troops took the island of Chioggia in the Venetian lagoon in August 1379, but the garrison was forced to surrender there in June 1380. The defeat weakened his rule, and on 6 April 1383 Antoniotto Adorno drove him from office. He fled to Finale, was handed back to the Genoese in 1384, and died a prisoner in the castle of Lerici around 1385.
zh: 瓜尔科家族是热那亚共和国的吉伯林派贵族，可能起源于奥尔特雷焦戈的加维，12世纪起定居波尔切韦拉河谷上游的切西诺，靠水磨坊和炼铁业成为热那亚最富有的世家之一。家族中唯一登上总督之位的是商人之子尼科洛·瓜尔科，约1325年出生。他曾于1351年出使法国、1371年出使葡萄牙，并出任基亚瓦里总督；1378年6月17日，平民派领袖拥立他为第七任总督。他领导热那亚进行对威尼斯的基奥贾战争：1379年8月，热那亚联军攻占威尼斯潟湖中的基奥贾岛，但岛上驻军于1380年6月被迫投降。战败动摇了他的统治，1383年4月6日安东尼奥托·阿多尔诺将他赶下总督宝座。他先逃到菲纳莱，1384年被交还给热那亚人，约1385年作为囚徒死于莱里奇城堡。

en: The Guhila name in Saurashtra belongs to the Gohils, a Suryavanshi Rajput dynasty whose genealogists and modern scholars alike trace them to the Guhilas of Mewar. Driven from their small state of Khera on the Luni river by the Rathores, the chief Sejakji migrated into Saurashtra around the turn of the thirteenth century and took service with the Chudasama rajas of Junagadh, receiving a grant of twelve villages around Sejakpur; his sons Shahji and Saranji founded the lines that later ruled Palitana and Lathi. Ranoji, who ruled from 1254 to 1309, founded Ranpur and seized Vala, and his son Mokhadaji (1309-1347) conquered Umrala and Ghogha, made himself master of Piram island in the Gulf of Cambay and lived by piracy until Muhammad bin Tughluq invaded and killed him in 1347. Restored soon afterwards, the family built up a cluster of chiefdoms along the eastern Saurashtra coast, the country afterwards called Gohilwad, moving its main seat by stages to Sihor and finally to Bhavnagar, founded in 1723.
zh: 萨乌拉施特拉的古希拉一支即戈希尔人，属日族拉杰普特王朝，其谱系学者和后世史家都把他们追溯到梅瓦尔的古希拉王朝。他们在卢尼河畔的小邦凯拉被拉托尔人所迫，首领塞贾吉约在13世纪之交迁入萨乌拉施特拉，投效朱纳格尔的珠多娑摩诸王，受封塞贾克布尔一带的十二个村庄；他的儿子沙吉和萨兰吉开创了后来统治帕利塔纳和拉提的支系。1254至1309年在位的拉诺吉建立兰布尔并夺取瓦拉；其子莫克达吉（1309—1347年）征服乌姆拉拉和戈加，占据坎贝湾中的皮拉姆岛，以海盗为业，1347年被穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克发兵攻杀。家族不久后恢复势力，在萨乌拉施特拉东岸形成一批土邦，这片地方后来称戈希尔瓦德；主都几经迁移，先至西霍尔，最终定于1723年新建的巴夫纳加尔。

en: The House of Guzmán was one of the grandest noble dynasties of Castile. It took its name from the village of Guzmán in Burgos, where the Castilian nobleman Rodrigo Muñoz de Guzmán held lands in the mid twelfth century, and its men served the crown through the Reconquest: one fell at Alarcos in 1195 and another fought at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212, while Mayor Guillén de Guzmán became a mistress of Alfonso X. The family's legend was made by Alonso Pérez de Guzmán, called Guzmán the Good, who in 1296 defended Tarifa for Sancho IV against rebels and Marinid besiegers and, when his captive son was threatened with death before the walls, threw down his own dagger rather than surrender the town. From this stock came Eleanor de Guzmán, born in 1310, the favourite of Alfonso XI and mother of Henry II of Trastámara; after the king's death she was imprisoned and executed at Talavera in 1351, and her sons' feud with Peter I opened the Trastámara civil war. Later branches carried the greatest titles in Spain: the senior line became Dukes of Medina Sidonia, while others were Count-Dukes of Olivares, Marquesses of Toral and, from 1625, Dukes of Medina de las Torres with grandee rank. The senior inheritance finally passed through a female heir to the Álvarez de Toledo family in 1779.
zh: 古斯曼家族是卡斯蒂利亚最显赫的贵族世系之一，得名于布尔戈斯的古斯曼村——12世纪中叶，贵族罗德里戈·穆尼奥斯·德·古斯曼在那里领有封地。家族成员随王权投身再征服运动：有人战死于1195年的阿拉尔科斯之战，有人参加了1212年的拉斯纳瓦斯-德托洛萨之战，马约尔·吉列恩·德·古斯曼还成为阿方索十世的情妇。家族传奇由“好人古斯曼”阿隆索·佩雷斯·德·古斯曼写就：1296年他为桑治四世镇守塔里法，抵御叛军和马林王朝的围攻，当敌人以杀死他被俘的儿子相逼时，他竟把自己的匕首扔下城头，宁失亲子也不献城。家族后人中有1310年出生的莱昂诺尔·德·古斯曼，她是阿方索十一世的宠妃、特拉斯塔马拉王朝开国君主恩里克二世的生母；国王死后她于1351年被囚禁并处死在塔拉韦拉，她的儿子们与佩德罗一世的仇怨引发了特拉斯塔马拉内战。家族的各支系后来拥有西班牙最顶尖的头衔：长支成为梅迪纳-西多尼亚公爵，其他支系出过奥利瓦雷斯伯爵-公爵、托拉尔侯爵，以及1625年起领有大公身份的梅迪纳-德拉斯托雷斯公爵。长支的爵位最终在1779年经女嗣转入阿尔瓦雷斯·德·托莱多家族。

en: The Habsburgs take their name from Habsburg Castle, built in the 1020s by Radbot of Klettgau in the Aargau; his grandson Otto II first styled himself count of Habsburg, and the name appears in documents from 1108. Long attached to the Staufer emperors, they rose when Count Rudolf was elected King of the Romans in 1273. His victory over Ottokar II of Bohemia at Marchfeld in 1278 and the Georgenberg Pact of 1286 won his sons Austria and Styria, and Vienna became the seat of the new House of Austria. After Rudolf's death in 1291 and Albert I's murder in 1308 the house lost the imperial crown for a time, but its domains grew regardless: Carinthia and Carniola in 1335, Tyrol in 1369 and Trieste in 1382. From 1440 the imperial title was in practice hereditary in the family. The double wedding of 1515 brought Bohemia and Hungary to Ferdinand I in 1526, while Charles V, elected emperor in 1519, ruled Spain, the Indies, the Low Countries and Austria together. Charles V's abdication in 1556 split the house into Spanish and Austrian branches; the Spanish line ended with Charles II in 1700 and passed to the Bourbons, and the Austrian male line ended with Charles VI in 1740. Maria Theresa's marriage to Francis Stephen of Lorraine created the House of Habsburg-Lorraine, which under Francis I took the title of Emperor of Austria in 1804 and saw the Holy Roman Empire dissolved in 1806.
zh: 哈布斯堡家族得名于哈布斯堡城堡：11世纪20年代，克莱特高的拉德博特在阿尔高修建了这座城堡，其孙奥托二世最先自称哈布斯堡伯爵，1108年起这个姓氏出现在家族文书中。他们长期忠实地追随施陶芬皇帝，1273年伯爵鲁道夫当选罗马人的国王，家族就此登上王位。1278年他在马希费尔德击败波希米亚的奥托卡二世，又借1286年的《格奥尔根贝格协定》为儿子们取得奥地利和施蒂里亚两个公国，维也纳从此成为家族驻地，家族也被称为奥地利王室。1291年鲁道夫去世、1308年阿尔布雷希特一世遇刺后，家族一度失去帝号，领地却仍在扩张：1335年得到克恩滕和卡尼奥拉，1369年得到蒂罗尔，1382年得到的里雅斯特。从1440年起，皇帝头衔实际上由家族世袭。1515年的双重联姻使斐迪南一世于1526年获得波希米亚和匈牙利；1519年当选皇帝的查理五世同时统治西班牙、西印度、尼德兰和奥地利。1556年查理五世退位，家族分为西班牙和奥地利两支：西班牙支随查理二世于1700年断绝，经西班牙王位继承战争归于波旁家族；奥地利男系则于1740年随查理六世终结。玛丽亚·特蕾西亚嫁给洛林的弗朗茨·斯特凡，由此产生哈布斯堡-洛林家族；弗朗茨一世于1804年自称奥地利皇帝，神圣罗马帝国又于1806年解体。

en: The Hacıemiroğulları, also called the Bayramoğulları and known to Byzantine Greeks as the emirate of Chalybia, were a small Turkoman beylik of the Chepni tribe on the Black Sea coast of Canik, in the countryside around modern Ordu. When Mongol civil war convulsed Anatolia in 1335 and 1336 the first bey, Bayram, threw off Eretnid overlordship; in 1337 his tiny realm was therefore freshly independent, its capital at a fortress near Mesudiye. Bayram and his fellow beys besieged Trebizond in 1348 without success, and his son Hacıemir, after whom the dynasty is named, long fought the Empire of Trebizond, then sealed peace by marrying the emperor's daughter Theodora in 1358. Backed by an alliance with Kadı Burhan al-Din of Sivas, Hacıemir seized the coastal city of Ordu in 1380 and moved his capital there. A civil war between Hacıemir and his son Süleyman weakened the beylik, though Süleyman took Giresun in 1397; after Burhan al-Din's death the dynasty accepted Ottoman suzerainty, enjoyed a brief second independence in the wake of Timur's victory at Ankara in 1402, and was finally annexed by the Ottomans in 1427.
zh: 哈吉埃米罗格鲁王朝又称巴伊拉姆奥格鲁，拜占庭希腊人称之为哈吕比亚埃米尔国，是黑海沿岸贾尼克地区（今奥尔杜一带）切普尼部落土库曼人建立的小型贝伊国。1335至1336年蒙古内战撼动安纳托利亚之际，初代贝伊巴伊拉姆摆脱埃雷特纳的宗主权自立；因此在1337年，这个以梅苏迪耶附近一座要塞为都的小国刚刚独立。1348年巴伊拉姆与诸贝伊联军围攻特拉布宗未果；其子哈吉埃米尔（王朝即由他得名）长期与特拉布宗帝国交战，后于1358年迎娶皇帝之女塞奥多拉以示和解。凭借与锡瓦斯强人卡迪·布尔汉丁的同盟，哈吉埃米尔于1380年攻占滨海城市奥尔杜并迁都于此。哈吉埃米尔与儿子苏莱曼之间的内战削弱了贝伊国，不过苏莱曼仍在1397年拿下吉雷松；布尔汉丁死后，王朝接受奥斯曼宗主权，1402年帖木儿安卡拉获胜后曾短暂再度独立，最终于1427年被奥斯曼帝国吞并。

en: The Hadhur recall the Hadhabani, a great Kurdish tribal confederation of the tenth and eleventh centuries whose pastures and strongholds ran from Mosul and Erbil through Shahrazur to Azerbaijan and the Caucasian foothills. Arab geographers record them clashing with the Hamdanids of Mosul as early as 906, after which thousands of Hadhbani families were settled in the northern Mosul country, and their chiefs held fortresses such as Urmia and Barkari in rivalry with the Rawwadids. The confederation had several branches: the Hakamiyya in Erbil and Shahrazur, the Rawadiyya in Azerbaijan, the Mihraniyya in Hakkari and the Banu Maran south of Mosul, and from these clans came the ruling houses of the Shaddadids, the Rawwadids and, most famously, the Ayyubids, Saladin's own family being of Hadhbani Rawadiyya stock. As the Seljuk and Mongol waves broke over the Jazira the independent Hadhbani principalities were absorbed, though the tribal name and its clans lived on in the Shahrazur hills, which at the end of the Mongol era passed to the Ardalan.
zh: 哈杜尔之名可追溯到哈兹巴尼，这是10至11世纪一个强大的库尔德部落联盟，牧场与据点从摩苏尔、埃尔比勒经谢赫雷祖尔一直延伸到阿塞拜疆和高加索山麓。阿拉伯地理学家记载，他们早在906年就与摩苏尔的哈姆丹王朝冲突，战后数千户哈兹巴尼人被安置在摩苏尔北部；其首领占据乌尔米耶、巴里卡里等要塞，与拉瓦德王朝争雄。联盟分为数支：居埃尔比勒和谢赫雷祖尔的哈卡米耶、居阿塞拜疆的拉瓦迪耶、居哈卡里的米拉尼耶，以及摩苏尔以南的巴努马兰；沙达德、拉瓦德乃至最著名的阿尤布王朝都出自这些支系，萨拉丁本人的家族即属哈兹巴尼的拉瓦迪耶。随着塞尔柱和蒙古的浪潮席卷杰济拉，独立的哈兹巴尼政权先后被吞并，但部落名号与族支仍留存于谢赫雷祖尔山区，该地在蒙古时代末期转入阿尔达兰之手。

en: The Hafsids were a Sunni Muslim dynasty of Berber origin that ruled Ifriqiya, modern Tunisia with eastern Algeria and western Libya, from Tunis between 1229 and 1574. Their ancestor Abu Hafs, a chief of the Masmuda Berbers and companion of the Almohad founder Ibn Tumart, gave the house its name; his descendants governed Ifriqiya as Almohad governors until Abu Zakariya Yahya broke away in 1229 and founded an independent sultanate. Under al-Mustansir, who reigned until 1277, Tunis became a secure capital that welcomed Andalusi refugees; Ibn Khaldun was born there and the first madrasas of the Maghreb were built under Hafsid patronage. The dynasty later split between Tunis and the western cities of Béjaïa and Constantine, and mid-fourteenth-century Marinid invasions and plague were followed by a strong recovery: Abu al-Abbas Ahmad II reunited the realm in 1370, Abu Faris Abd al-Aziz II annexed Tripoli in 1401 and Algiers in 1410 and made the Zayyanids and Marinids his vassals, and the long reign of Abu 'Amr 'Uthman in 1435–1488 briefly brought the whole Maghreb under Hafsid suzerainty. Caught between Spain and the Ottoman corsairs in the sixteenth century, the Hafsids became Spanish tributaries after Charles V took Tunis in 1535; the Ottomans finally conquered the city in 1574 and carried off the last caliph Muhammad VI to Constantinople, where he was executed.
zh: 哈夫斯王朝是柏柏尔血统的逊尼派穆斯林王朝，1229—1574年以突尼斯为都，统治伊弗里基叶，即今突尼斯以及阿尔及利亚东部和利比亚西部。家族始祖阿布·哈夫斯是马斯穆达柏柏尔人的首领、穆瓦希德运动创始人伊本·图马尔特的亲信，王朝也因他得名；他的后裔作为穆瓦希德总督治理伊弗里基叶，直到阿布·扎卡里亚·叶海亚于1229年脱离独立，建立苏丹国。到1277年去世的穆斯坦绥尔在位时，突尼斯已成为稳固的都城，接纳了大批安达卢西亚难民，伊本·赫勒敦便出生于此，马格里布最早的伊斯兰学校也在哈夫斯王室资助下建成。王朝后来分裂为突尼斯与西部的贝贾亚、君士坦丁两支，14世纪中期又遭马林人入侵和瘟疫打击，随后强势复兴：阿布·阿拔斯·艾哈迈德二世1370年重新统一全国，阿布·法里斯·阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹二世1401年吞并的黎波里、1410年兼并阿尔及尔，并使宰扬人和马林人称臣；阿布·阿慕尔·奥斯曼1435—1488年的漫长统治期间，整个马格里布一度都承认哈夫斯的宗主权。16世纪王朝夹在西班牙与奥斯曼海盗之间，1535年查理五世攻占突尼斯后沦为西班牙附庸；1574年奥斯曼人最终攻克突尼斯，末代哈里发穆罕默德六世被押往君士坦丁堡处死。

en: The Haihayas of Ratnapura were a branch of the Kalachuri dynasty, which claimed descent from the ancient Haihaya kings of the Lunar line. Around the year 1000 Kalingaraja, a prince of the Tripuri Kalachuri royal house, conquered Dakshina Kosala from the Somavamshis and founded the Ratnapura kingdom, first ruling from Tummana; his grandson Ratnadeva I built the capital of Ratnapura, modern Ratanpur in Chhattisgarh. The branch long served the parent dynasty at Tripuri as feudatories before Jajalladeva I made it effectively independent around 1100, and Ratnadeva II formally threw off Tripuri's overlordship and repulsed the Eastern Ganga king Anantavarman Chodaganga. After Pratapamalla, who ruled in the early thirteenth century, the line becomes obscure, and by the late fourteenth century the family had split into Ratanpur and Raipur branches. King Vahara, attested by inscriptions of 1494 and 1513 and remembered as Bahar Sahai, fought the Afghans on his frontier. Sheltered by forested hills, the kingdom escaped the Muslim conquests of northern India; its later rajas kept an unbroken court until 1740, when the Marathas of Nagpur imposed their suzerainty, and in 1758 the death of the last raja Mohan Singh brought annexation.
zh: 拉特纳普拉的诃伊诃耶人是卡拉丘里王朝的支系，自称源出月亮世系的古代诃伊诃耶诸王。约1000年，特里普里卡拉丘里王室的卡林加拉贾从索马万希王朝手中夺取南拘萨罗，建立拉特纳普拉王国，最初定都图马纳；其孙拉特那提婆一世兴建都城拉特纳普拉，即今恰蒂斯加尔的拉坦普尔。该支系长期作为特里普里本朝的封臣，约1100年贾贾拉提婆一世使其实际独立，拉特那提婆二世则正式摆脱宗主，并击退东恒伽国王阿南塔跋摩·朱达恒伽。13世纪初在位的波罗塔帕摩罗之后，世系变得模糊，到14世纪末家族分裂为拉坦普尔和赖布尔两支。瓦哈拉王有1494和1513年的铭文存世，被后人记作巴哈尔·萨海，曾在边境与阿富汗人作战。凭借山林屏障，王国避开了北印度的穆斯林征服；后世拉贾维持着绵延不断的宫廷，直到1740年那格浦尔的马拉塔人强迫其臣服，1758年末代拉贾莫汉·辛格去世，国家遂被吞并。

en: The Hakkari were a great Kurdish tribal house, known to medieval Arab writers as al-Hakkariyya, who grazed their flocks in the mountains between the Great Zab and Lake Urmia from at least the tenth century and gave their name to the emirate centered on Çölemerik, also called Julamerk. Their chief Abu'l-Hayja al-Hakkari submitted to Imad al-Din Zengi in 1133, and the tribal Hakkariyya regiment, several thousand strong, became one of the two dominant Kurdish corps in Saladin's Ayyubid army, fighting at the siege of Acre in 1191. The hereditary emirate of Hakkâri is documented from the 1380s under Izz al-Din Shir, who kept his mountain throne by switching allegiance between the Timurids and the Qara Qoyunlu until his death in 1423; after Qara Iskander destroyed his heirs, a descendant called Asad al-Din Zarin Cang returned from Egypt and rebuilt the principality, his line taking the name Shambo. Izz al-Din Shir II was put to death by the Aq Qoyunlu sultan Yaqub in 1491. Perched on the Ottoman-Safavid frontier, later emirs played the two empires off against each other, though repeated family wars split the emirate into rival fiefs between the sixteenth and eighteenth centuries.
zh: 哈卡里是库尔德大部落家族，阿拉伯中世纪文献称之为哈卡里亚，至迟10世纪起就在大扎卜河与乌尔米耶湖之间的山地游牧，其名也被用来称呼以彻莱梅里克（又名朱拉梅尔克）为中心的埃米尔国。首领阿布勒·海贾·哈卡里于1133年向伊马德丁·赞吉称臣，族人组成数千人的哈卡里军团，与哈兹巴尼军团并为萨拉丁阿尤布军队中最主要的库尔德武装，参加了1191年的阿卡围城战。世袭的哈卡里埃米尔国在1380年代已见记载，建立者伊兹丁·希尔在帖木儿系与黑羊王朝之间反复改换门庭，维系山地王权至1423年去世；黑羊的伊斯坎达尔诛戮其继承人后，后裔阿萨德丁·扎林昌从埃及返回重建政权，其家族改称尚博王朝。伊兹丁·希尔二世于1491年被白羊苏丹雅各布处死。地处奥斯曼与萨法维两强边界，后世埃米尔得以在两强之间周旋，但连绵的家族内战使埃米尔国在16至18世纪分裂为彼此独立的领地。

en: The counts of Hals took their name from Burg Hals, a castle on a loop of the Ilz near its confluence with the Danube at Passau, now a district of the city. The first ancestor on record is the noble Rotbert, called of Polsenz, who appears in Passau cathedral documents in 1112 and is credited with building the castle around 1100. Around 1160 Albert of Kamm inherited the lordship through his marriage to Liukarde of Hals, and his descendants, the lords of Kamm, became the counts of Hals. In 1280 King Rudolf I of Habsburg invested Albert of Hals with the rank of imperial count, after which the family pushed its territory from Osterhofen and Aidenbach north to the Bohemian border and secured the lucrative Goldener Steig trade route; it also absorbed the county of Leonberg am Inn and, in 1338, Baumgarten. The line died out in 1375, and an inheritance dispute between Landgrave John of Leuchtenberg and Count Henry IV of Ortenburg ended with the former receiving the fief. Hals itself was raised to a town in 1376 and granted minting rights in 1377, though the county was later heavily pledged; what remained passed to the Aichberg family in 1485 and was sold to the Wittelsbach dukes of Bavaria in 1517.
zh: 哈尔斯伯爵得名于伊尔茨河河湾上的哈尔斯城堡，城堡临近伊尔茨河在帕绍汇入多瑙河之处，其地后来成为帕绍城的哈尔斯区。可考的始祖是出身波尔森茨的贵族罗特贝特，1112年已见于帕绍主教座堂的文书，一般认为他在1100年前后修建了这座城堡。约1160年，卡姆的阿尔伯特因与哈尔斯的柳克德联姻而继承了领地，他的后裔即卡姆领主家族，后来成为哈尔斯伯爵。1280年，哈布斯堡的鲁道夫一世授予阿尔伯特帝国伯爵衔，家族随即把领地从奥斯特霍芬、艾登巴赫向北拓展到波希米亚边境，并控制了利润丰厚的“黄金小道”商路；此后又兼并因河河畔莱昂贝格伯国，1338年再得鲍姆加滕。1375年该支绝嗣，洛伊希滕贝格藩侯约翰与奥尔滕堡伯爵亨利四世之间爆发继承之争，最终由前者受封。哈尔斯于1376年升格为城市，1377年获得铸币权，但伯国后来被大量抵押，残余部分于1485年归艾希贝格家族，1517年卖给巴伐利亚的维特尔斯巴赫公爵。

en: The Hamar Gale were the royal Gerad line of the Warsangali Darod Somalis of the Maakhir coast in northern Somalia, a region of frankincense-growing mountains and ports such as Haylan and Las Khorey. The line is traced to Gerad Abdullahi Dhidhin, founder of the Warsangali polity, whose son Gerad Hassan inherited the leadership in 1311. Hassan earned the nickname Hamar Gale, meaning the Mogadishu settler, after leaving the northern clan lands for the Benadir coast near Mogadishu; when he died in 1328 the leadership passed to Gerad Ibrahim, the member of the house living in 1337. The Garaads of Maakhir kept their local authority through the following centuries and sent fighting men to the campaigns of Ahmad Gragn in the sixteenth century. In 1613 a descendant, Garaad Abdulle Mahmud I, united the coastal factions into a centralized Warsangali state with its capital at Durduri, dominating the frankincense and date trade of the Gulf of Aden. His house bore the title Garaad until 1764, when the ruler adopted the style of Sultan while the older title remained in local use.
zh: 哈马尔·加莱家族是北索马里马希尔沿海瓦桑加利达鲁德索马里人的王室杰拉德世系，当地山区出产乳香，拥有海兰、拉斯科雷等港口。该世系可追溯到瓦桑加利政权的建立者杰拉德·阿卜杜拉希·迪丁，其子杰拉德·哈桑于1311年继位。哈桑因离开北方氏族故地、迁居摩加迪沙一带的贝纳迪尔沿海而得绰号“哈马尔·加莱”，意为“摩加迪沙的定居者”；他于1328年去世，首领之位传给杰拉德·易卜拉欣，即这一家族在1337年在世的成员。马希尔的加拉德们在此后几个世纪保持着地方权力，并在16世纪派部众参加艾哈迈德·格拉格的征战。1613年，其后人加拉德·阿卜杜勒·马哈茂德一世把沿海各派系联合成集权的瓦桑加利国家，定都杜尔杜里，控制了亚丁湾的乳香和椰枣贸易。其家族一直保有“加拉德”称号，直到1764年统治者改用苏丹尊号，而旧称在民间仍然沿用。

en: The Hamidids were a Turkic beylik that arose in southwestern Anatolia as the Sultanate of Rum dissolved, holding the lake district around Eğirdir, Isparta and Uluborlu. The dynasty looked back to Hamid and his son Ilyas, Seljuk frontier lords, and the actual founder was Dündar Bey, also called Felek al-Din, who made the family independent early in the fourteenth century. In 1321 his brother Yunus Bey carved out the neighbouring Beylik of Teke on the Mediterranean coast with its capital at Antalya, so that the same Hamidid house ruled two principalities, Hamid and Teke. In 1337 both branches governed their valleys and ports as independent ghazi lords. As Ottoman power grew, the Hamidids were persuaded to sell Akşehir and Beyşehir to Murad I, and Bayezid I extinguished the beylik altogether in 1391, turning its heartland into the Ottoman Sanjak of Hamid. Teke was taken in the same year but restored by Timur after his victory at Ankara in 1402, until the Ottomans re-annexed it for good in 1423.
zh: 哈米德王朝是罗姆苏丹国瓦解时兴起于安纳托利亚西南部的突厥贝伊国，领有埃伊尔迪尔、厄斯帕尔塔和乌卢博尔卢一带的湖区。该朝先世为塞尔柱边境领主哈米德及其子伊利亚斯，真正的开国者是敦达尔贝伊（又称费莱克丁），他在14世纪初使家族获得独立。1321年，他的兄弟尤努斯贝伊分出自立，在地中海岸建立以安塔利亚为都的特克贝伊国，于是同一个哈米德家族同时统治哈米德和特克两个政权。1337年，两支都还以独立加齐领主的身份治理着各自的山谷与港口。随着奥斯曼势力壮大，哈米德人被说服将阿克谢希尔和贝伊谢希尔卖给穆拉德一世，巴耶济德一世更于1391年彻底攻灭贝伊国，其核心领地被改为奥斯曼的哈米德桑贾克。特克也于同年被吞并，但帖木儿1402年安卡拉大捷后将其恢复，直到1423年奥斯曼人再度永久兼并特克。

en: The Hanan Qusqu, or Upper Cusco, was the second Inca royal dynasty, drawn from the upper half of the city's dual moiety system. Around 1350 its leader Inca Roca overthrew the ruling Hurin Qusqu branch and became the first Cusco lord to call himself Inca, leaving the Hurin with religious office while the Hanan monopolized secular and military power. Inca Roca and his successors Yawar Waqaq and Viracocha Inca enlarged the small kingdom around Cusco and held off the warlike Chanka. The dynasty's greatest figure was Pachacuti, who as Cusi Yupanqui saved Cusco from the Chanka invasion of 1438 and then built the Tawantinsuyu, the Inca Empire; his son Topa Inca Yupanqui and grandson Huayna Capac extended its rule from Quito to central Chile. Huayna Capac's death in a smallpox epidemic around 1527 brought a civil war between his sons Huascar and Atahualpa, and the Spanish under Pizarro seized the moment to capture and execute Atahualpa in 1533. A Hanan prince held out in the Vilcabamba retreat until 1572, when Tupac Amaru I was executed in Cusco.
zh: 哈南·库斯科在克丘亚语中意为上库斯科，是印卡的第二个王族，出自库斯科城二元氏族体系中的上支。约1350年，其首领印卡·罗卡推翻执政的乌林·库斯科一支，成为第一位自称印卡的库斯科君主，让乌林支专掌宗教事务，哈南支则独揽世俗与军政大权。印卡·罗卡及其后继者亚瓦尔·瓦卡克、维拉科查·印卡不断扩张库斯科周边的小王国，并抵挡住好战的昌卡人。王朝最伟大的人物是帕查库特克：他原名库西·尤潘基，在1438年昌卡入侵时拯救库斯科，随后建立起印加帝国塔万廷苏尤；其子图帕克·印卡·尤潘基和其孙瓦伊纳·卡帕克把帝国疆域从基多一直推进到智利中部。约1527年瓦伊纳·卡帕克死于天花瘟疫，他的两个儿子瓦斯卡尔与阿塔瓦尔帕爆发内战，皮萨罗率领的西班牙人趁机而入，于1533年擒杀阿塔瓦尔帕。哈南支的一位王子退守比尔卡班巴，坚持到1572年图帕克·阿马鲁一世在库斯科被处死。

en: The lords and later counts of Hanau were a Wetterau noble house whose lordship was enlarged in 1255 by the inheritance of part of the rich Hagen-Munzenberg estate. Under Ulrich I, ruling from 1281 to about 1306, the family gained a sixth share of the Munzenberg inheritance, including Babenhausen, through his mother, and widened its lands in the upper Kinzig valley while serving the kings of the Romans in campaigns as far afield as Bohemia; he also secured town rights for several of his settlements. In 1429 Emperor Sigismund raised the lordship, lying between the Taunus, Spessart and Odenwald, to the County of Hanau. A partition of 1458 created the Munzenberg and Babenhausen lines, and when the latter inherited the Alsatian lordship of Lichtenberg in 1473, the two immediate counties of Hanau-Munzenberg and Hanau-Lichtenberg took shape. In 1612 the Reformed Munzenberg county passed to the Lutheran Lichtenberg line. Count Friedrich Casimir, after the devastation of the Thirty Years' War, founded Germany's first faience factory but nearly bankrupted the county by leasing Guiana in the failed Hanau Indies venture, and was placed under imperial guardianship in 1670. The house died out in 1736, whereupon Hanau-Munzenberg fell to Hesse-Kassel and Hanau-Lichtenberg to Hesse-Darmstadt.
zh: 哈瑙的领主及后来的伯爵家族是韦特劳地区的贵族世家，1255年因继承富庶的哈根-明岑贝格领地的一部分而版图大增。乌尔里希一世在1281年至约1306年间执政，他通过母亲取得明岑贝格遗产的六分之一，包括巴本豪森，并在随罗马人之王出征远至波希米亚的战事中扩张了在上金齐希河谷的领地，还为治下数个聚落争取到市镇权。1429年，皇帝西吉斯蒙德将这片介于陶努斯山、施佩萨尔特山和奥登林山之间的领地升为哈瑙伯国。1458年家族分裂为明岑贝格和巴本豪森两支，后者于1473年继承阿尔萨斯的利希滕贝格领地，由此形成哈瑙-明岑贝格和哈瑙-利希滕贝格两个帝国直辖伯国。1612年，信奉归正宗的明岑贝格伯国转入信奉路德宗的利希滕贝格支之手。三十年战争使领地残破，弗里德里希·卡西米尔伯爵战后创办了德国第一家彩陶工厂，却因租下圭亚那、搞出失败的哈瑙印度计划而险些令伯国破产，1670年被皇帝置于监护之下。1736年家族绝嗣，哈瑙-明岑贝格并入黑森-卡塞尔，哈瑙-利希滕贝格并入黑森-达姆施塔特。

en: Haniji, also read Haneji, was the local warlord who founded the kingdom of Hokuzan in northern Okinawa during the Sanzan period. Ryukyu tradition holds that he overthrew the aji of Nakijin and seized his title, then in 1322 renounced the overlordship of Chūzan and styled himself King of Hokuzan, ruling the northern part of Okinawa with nearby islands and the southern Amami group from Nakijin Castle; one tradition makes him a grandson of the Wakugawa aji, a son of King Eiso of Chūzan. His name may derive from Haneji, a northern settlement now part of Nago. He first appears in Ming Chinese records in 1383, when he sent a tributary mission after the Ming court ordered the three warring Okinawan kings to make peace, and five missions went under his name before his last contact in 1390. On his death around 1395 his son Min succeeded him; because the reign covers nearly seventy years, some scholars suspect the name covers several same-named rulers. The realm his house founded, the poorest of the three Sanzan kingdoms, ended in 1416 when Shō Hashi of Chūzan stormed Nakijin and the last king killed himself.
zh: 怕尼芝（又读羽地）是三山时代在冲绳本岛北部建立北山王国的地方豪酋。据琉球本土记载，他攻灭今归仁按司并夺取其称号，于1322年宣布脱离中山的统辖，自称北山王，从今归仁城统治冲绳本岛北部、附近岛屿及奄美群岛南部；一说他是中山英祖王次子涌川按司之孙。其名字可能得名于冲绳北部的羽地（今名护市一带）。1383年明朝遣使调停三山争斗，他随即向明朝派出首个朝贡使团，至1390年最后一次见于记载为止，以其名义共派出五次朝贡。约1395年他去世，子珉继位；因其名义上的统治延续近七十年，有学者认为怕尼芝实为数代同名君主的合称。他所开创的北山是三国中最贫瘠的一国，1416年中山的尚巴志攻破今归仁城，末代国王自杀，北山灭亡。

en: The Hanyang Han were a Goryeo aristocratic clan of Hanyang, present-day Seoul. They branched from the Cheongju Han: their founder Han Won-seo, a sixth-generation descendant of Cheongju founder Han Ran, passed the civil examination under King Chungnyeol (r. 1274—1308), rose to high office and was enfeoffed as Prince of Hanyang, after which his descendants made Hanyang their clan seat.
zh: 汉阳韩氏是以汉阳（今首尔）为本贯的高丽贵族氏族，自清州韩氏分出。其始祖韩元諝是清州韩氏始祖韩兰的六世孙，在忠烈王（1274—1308年在位）时科举及第，历任高官并受封汉阳府院君，后人遂以汉阳为本贯、奉韩元諝为始祖。

en: The Harichandan Mohapatras were the ruling family of Narsinghpur, a small Garjat chiefdom in the Mahanadi valley of central Odisha. Local legend traces the chiefdom to two Khond chiefs of the thirteenth century, Narsingh and Poro, who were subdued by a chieftain called Dharma Singh, and the family's title Harichandan Mahapatra was conferred by its overlord the Gajapati raja of Puri. No records of the chiefdom survive from the Mughal or Maratha periods; its documented line of rulers begins with Mandardhar Harichandan Mahapatra in 1671 and runs unbroken through the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries.
zh: 哈里钱丹·莫哈帕特拉家族是讷尔辛格布尔的统治家族，其领地是奥里萨中部默哈讷迪河谷的一个迦贾德小酋邦。当地传说该酋邦源于13世纪的两位孔德人首领纳尔辛格与波罗，后被首领达尔马·辛格征服；家族的哈里钱丹·莫哈帕特拉头衔，则是宗主普里的加贾帕蒂罗阇授予的。莫卧儿与马拉塔时期均无文书传世，可考的首领世系从1671年的曼达尔达尔开始，此后一脉相承，贯穿18世纪至19世纪初。

en: The Hasan-Jalalyan were an Armenian princely house that ruled the mountain principality of Khachen, in historical Artsakh, from 1214. Their founder Hasan-Jalal Dawla inherited his father's lands in 1214 and, through marriage, added the kingdom of Dizak-Balk, styling himself King of Artsakh and Balk; the family claimed descent from the ancient Aranshahik princes and the Siunik and Bagratuni royal lines. Hasan-Jalal founded Gandzasar monastery, built between 1216 and 1238 and consecrated in 1240, which became the seat of the Catholicosate of Albania and the family's burial church. After the Mongol conquest he was twice arrested by the Ilkhans and executed at Qazvin around 1262 on the orders of Arghun Khan, yet his son Atabek was confirmed in Khachen and ruled until 1306. His descendants took the surname Hasan-Jalalyan and kept their autonomy under successive Seljuk, Mongol and Persian overlords. In the late sixteenth century cadet branches set up the melikdoms of Jraberd, Khachen and Gulistan, which with Varanda and Dizak formed the Five Melikdoms of Karabakh. The meliks fought both Ottoman and Persian armies in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries and turned to Russia; the Catholicos Yesayi Hasan-Jalalyan, who died in 1728, sought aid from Peter the Great. The last melik of Khachen, Allahverdi II, died in 1813, after the Russian Empire took the region in 1805.
zh: 哈桑‑贾拉良家族是亚美尼亚王公世家，自1214年起统治位于历史上阿尔察赫地区的山地公国哈琴。始祖哈桑‑贾拉勒·道莱于1214年继承父祖领地，又通过联姻取得迪扎克‑巴尔克王国，自称阿尔察赫与巴尔克之王；家族自称源出古代的阿兰沙希克王公以及休尼克、巴格拉图尼王统。哈桑‑贾拉勒主持修建了甘扎萨尔修道院，工程始于1216年、1238年完工，1240年祝圣，后来成为阿尔巴尼亚卡托利科斯座驻地和家族墓地。蒙古征服后，他两次被伊儿汗国逮捕，约1262年奉阿鲁浑汗之命在加兹温被处死，其子阿塔贝克仍被确认统治哈琴，在位至1306年。后代以始祖之名加“扬”字后缀为姓，称哈桑‑贾拉良，在塞尔柱、蒙古和波斯历代宗主下保持自治。16世纪末，家族旁支建立了吉拉贝尔德、哈琴和古利斯坦三个梅利克领，与瓦兰达、迪扎克合称卡拉巴赫五梅利克领。17至18世纪，这些梅利克同时抗击奥斯曼与波斯军队，并向俄国求援；1728年去世的卡托利科斯叶萨伊·哈桑‑贾拉良曾与彼得大帝谈判。哈琴末代梅利克阿拉韦尔迪二世于1813年去世，此前俄罗斯帝国已在1805年吞并该地区。

en: The Hastings were an English baronial house seated at Abergavenny on the Welsh march. Henry de Hastings was summoned as Lord Hastings by Simon de Montfort in 1263, and his son John, born in 1262, inherited the vast Abergavenny estates in 1273 and was recognized as Baron Hastings in 1290, the same year he put forward a claim to the crown of Scotland. John's grandson Laurence, born in 1319 and a great-grandson of William de Valence, Earl of Pembroke, was created Earl of Pembroke in 1339 and married a daughter of Roger Mortimer, Earl of March, before dying at Abergavenny in 1348. His son John, the second earl, served Edward III in Aquitaine but was captured by the Castilian fleet at the Battle of La Rochelle in 1372; he died in 1375 just after his ransom was paid. The last earl, another John, inherited as an infant and was killed in a joust at Woodstock in 1389 at the age of seventeen, leaving no children. With him the earldom of Pembroke became extinct, while the older Barony of Hastings passed to a cousin's line.
zh: 黑斯廷斯家族是英格兰的男爵世家，坐落在威尔士边境的阿伯加文尼。亨利·德·黑斯廷斯于1263年被西蒙·德·孟福尔召为黑斯廷斯勋爵；他的儿子约翰生于1262年，1273年继承了阿伯加文尼的大片地产，1290年被确认为黑斯廷斯男爵，同年还提出过对苏格兰王位的主张。约翰的孙子劳伦斯生于1319年，作为彭布罗克伯爵威廉·德·瓦朗斯的曾外孙，于1339年受封彭布罗克伯爵，并娶马奇伯爵罗杰·莫蒂默之女为妻，1348年在阿伯加文尼去世。其子、第二代伯爵约翰在阿基坦为爱德华三世作战，1372年在拉罗谢尔海战中被卡斯蒂利亚舰队俘虏，1375年赎金付清后不久即病死。末代伯爵也叫约翰，幼年袭爵，1389年在伍德斯托克的比武大会上被对手的长矛刺中身亡，年仅十七岁，没有子嗣。他死后彭布罗克伯爵爵号废止，更早的黑斯廷斯男爵则转入堂亲一系。

en: The Hata were the leading house of the Upper Matsuura party, a federation of seafaring warriors on the Matsuura coast of Hizen province in northern Kyushu. They traced their line to the Saga Genji through the Watanabe: Matsuura Mochi, second son of Matsuura Hisa and great-grandson of Watanabe no Tsuna, settled at Hata and took its name in 1102, and the clan grew strong around Kishidake Castle. At its height it crossed to Iki Island and its lords styled themselves governors of Iki. In the Sengoku period a succession quarrel after the death of Hata Sakō drew in the Arima, the Ryūzōji and the Hirado Matsuura, and the seventeenth head, Hata Chikashi, a son of Arima Yoshisada adopted as heir by his maternal grandfather Hata Sakō, only won his seat with Ryūzōji backing between 1564 and 1569; he then submitted to Ryūzōji Takanobu and, after Takanobu fell at Okitanawate in 1584, drifted toward the Shimazu. Chikashi submitted early to Toyotomi Hideyoshi in the Kyushu campaign of 1587 and even received the Toyotomi surname in 1588, but during the Korean campaign he defied the orders of Nabeshima Naoshige; in 1593 Hideyoshi confiscated the Hata lands and exiled him to Tsukuba in Hitachi, where he died and the house came to an end.
zh: 波多氏是九州北部肥前国松浦地区上松浦党中最大的一族，属于以水军著称的松浦党。其谱系可追溯到嵯峨源氏的渡边纲：渡边纲曾孙松浦久的次子松浦持移居波多，于1102年改称波多持，此后以岸岳城为本据发展壮大，极盛时还进兵壹岐岛，当主自称壹岐守护。战国时代，当主波多盛死后爆发御家骚动，有马氏、龙造寺氏和同属松浦党的平户松浦氏纷纷插手；第十七代当主波多亲是有马义贞之子，过继给外祖父波多盛为嗣，在1564至1569年的继承之争中靠龙造寺氏的支援才夺回岸岳城，随后臣服于龙造寺隆信。1584年隆信在冲田畷之战战死后，波多亲又倒向岛津氏。1587年九州征伐时他早早谒见丰臣秀吉，1588年还获赐丰臣姓，但在文禄之役中违抗锅岛直茂的军令，1593年被秀吉没收领地、流放常陆国筑波，最终客死当地，波多氏就此灭亡。

en: The Hatakeyama began as a Taira house of Musashi Province, named for the Hatakeyama estate in Nambuki district, but the line of Hatakeyama Shigetada was destroyed by the Hojo in the purge of 1205. Hojo Tokimasa then had Ashikaga Yoshizumi, a son of the Ashikaga house of the Seiwa Genji, marry Shigetada's widow and revive the name, so the later Hatakeyama were Minamoto in descent. They fought for the Ashikaga shogunate through the Nanboku-cho wars and were rewarded with hereditary constableships over Yamashiro, Kii, Kawachi, Etchu and Noto, becoming one of the three kanrei, or deputy shogun, houses of the Muromachi regime. Around 1450 the family split over the succession between Hatakeyama Masanaga and Hatakeyama Yoshinari, whose feud was one of the sparks of the Onin War from 1467 and cost the clan the kanrei office to the Hosokawa. In the Sengoku age its branches went separate ways: the Kawachi line remained strong enough to be a leading opponent of Oda Nobunaga, the Noto line at Nanao Castle collapsed through internal strife in the 1570s, and the Mutsu line of Nihonmatsu, reduced to Ashina vassals, was largely destroyed by Date Masamune after the Battle of Hitotoribashi in 1586.
zh: 畠山氏原是桓武平氏的一支，以武藏国男衾郡畠山乡为苗字，但畠山重忠一脉在1205年遭北条氏讨伐而断绝。北条时政随后安排清和源氏足利家的足利义纯迎娶重忠的遗孀、继承其领地并复兴畠山之名，因此后来的畠山氏在血统上属于源氏。南北朝时期，他们为足利幕府作战，世代受封山城、纪伊、河内、越中、能登五国守护，成为室町幕府三管领家之一。1450年前后，畠山政长与畠山义就围绕家督继承分裂，两家的争斗成为1467年爆发的应仁之乱的导火索之一，管领一职也被细川氏夺去。进入战国时代，畠山各支各自沉浮：河内畠山仍保有实力，是织田信长在畿内的主要对手之一；能登畠山以七尾城为居城，在16世纪70年代因内乱失势；陆奥的二本松畠山先沦为芦名氏家臣，又在1586年的人取桥之战后被伊达政宗基本攻灭。

en: The Hatta were a warrior house of Hatta in Niihari District, Hitachi Province, now part of Chikusei in Ibaraki, springing from the Utsunomiya clan of Shimotsuke. Its most famous head, Hatta Tomoie, joined Minamoto no Yoritomo when he raised arms in 1180, defeated Shida Yoshihiro at the Battle of Nogimiya in 1183, and was appointed shugo of Hitachi in 1185; in the Ōshū campaign of 1189 he and Chiba Tsunetane commanded the Tōkaidō army. In 1193 Tomoie engineered the fall of his rival Taki Yoshimoto and added the former Daijō lands of Tsukuba and Niihari to his holdings, and after Yoritomo's death in 1199 he sat among the thirteen councillors of the Kamakura shogunate. Tomoie built Oda Castle in Tsukuba, and his son Tomoshige took the surname Oda, under which the main line is better known; the house lost the Hitachi shugo title and part of its lands after backing the Miura in the Hōji Conflict of 1247. In the Nanboku-chō war the Oda fought for the Southern Court, and under the Muromachi regime they were ranked among the eight great houses of the Kantō. Pressed by the Satake and the Later Hōjō, they lost Oda Castle in 1569, submitted to the Satake in 1583, and were dispossessed after missing Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign of 1590.
zh: 八田氏是常陆国新治郡八田（今茨城县筑西市）的武家，出自下野的宇都宫氏。当主八田知家于1180年源赖朝举兵时投身麾下，1183年在野木宮合战中击败志田义广，1185年出任常陆守护；1189年奥州合战时，他与千叶常胤同任东海道军大将。1193年，知家用计扳倒对手多气义干，将筑波、新治等地的旧大掾氏领地收入囊中；1199年赖朝死后，他又位列镰仓幕府的十三人合议制。知家修筑了筑波郡的小田城，其子知重改以小田为姓，此后嫡流便以小田氏知名；1247年宝治合战后，小田氏因站在三浦泰村一方而被剥夺守护职和部分领地。南北朝时代，小田氏作为南朝一方作战，室町时代被镰仓府列为关东八屋形之一。战国时代，他们在佐竹氏与后北条氏的挤压下日渐衰落，1569年居城小田城被佐竹氏攻陷，1583年彻底臣服，1590年又因未参加小田原征伐而被没收领地。

en: The Hazaraspids were a Kurdish Sunni dynasty that ruled the Zagros highlands of southwestern Iran, chiefly Greater Luristan, from 1115 to 1424, with their capital at Idaj. Their ancestor Fadlawi had migrated from Syria through Adharbayjan to Luristan in the early eleventh century; the founder Abu Tahir ibn Muhammad, himself of Shabankara stock, began as a commander of the Salghurids of Fars and governor of Kuhgiluya before making himself independent and taking the title of atabeg. The dynasty is named not after him but after his son Malik Hazarasp, whose Persian name means thousand horses; Malik Hazarasp aided the Khwarezmshah Jalal al-Din against the Mongols. As Ilkhanid vassals the family enlarged its domains: Yusuf Shah I added Khuzestan and Golpayegan with Abaqa's confirmation, while Yusuf Shah II seized Shushtar, Hoveizeh and even Basra in the 1330s. Afrasiab I was executed by Ghazan in 1296, and in the later fourteenth century the Muzaffarids briefly occupied Idaj. The end came in 1424, when the Timurid Shahrukh overthrew the last atabeg, Ghiyath al-Din, and annexed Greater Luristan.
zh: 哈扎拉斯普王朝是库尔德人的逊尼派王朝，1115至1424年间统治伊朗西南部的扎格罗斯山区，核心是大卢尔斯坦，都城在伊达吉。其先祖法德拉维于11世纪初从叙利亚经阿塞拜疆迁徙到卢尔斯坦；开国君主阿布·塔希尔·本·穆罕默德本身有沙班卡拉人血统，原是法尔斯萨尔古尔王朝的将领、库赫吉卢耶总督，后来自立并采用阿塔伯格称号。王朝不以他命名，而得名于其子马利克·哈扎拉斯普——这个波斯语名字意为“千马”；哈扎拉斯普曾协助花剌子模沙札兰丁抵抗蒙古人。作为伊儿汗国的藩属，家族不断扩张：优素福沙一世经阿八哈认可，取得胡齐斯坦和戈勒派甘；优素福沙二世则在14世纪30年代攻占舒什塔尔、霍韦伊泽乃至巴士拉。阿弗拉西亚布一世于1296年被合赞处死，14世纪后期莫扎法尔王朝还曾短暂占领伊达吉。1424年末代阿塔伯格吉亚斯丁被帖木儿王朝的沙哈鲁推翻，大卢尔斯坦遭吞并，王朝告终。

en: The Hei were a samurai house of Mutsu Province, holding the Hei district on the rugged Pacific coast of what the game calls Rikuchu, around present-day Miyako in Iwate. Their tradition called them Hei Genji, claiming the warrior Minamoto no Tametomo as ancestor through a son who was adopted by Sasaki Takatsuna and given Hei and Kesen districts after the Oshu war of 1189, whereupon Yorimoto moved from Kesen to Hei in the 1190s and took the district's name; modern scholars consider the family more likely a branch of the Sasaki that settled locally. As Kamakura gokenin they ruled the district as stewards, and early in the fourteenth century an inheritance dispute between Mitsuyori and his kinsman was settled in Kamakura by the regent Hojo Takatoki himself. In 1333 Chikamitsu, Mitsuyori's son, joined the Southern Court army of Kitabatake Akiie, fighting at Teshimagawara and Aonogahara before the defeat at Ishizu. The main line later built Takasari Castle and took the name Takasari, heading a local league known as the thirteen Takasari houses and breeding the prized Takasari horses celebrated even in Kyoto. Pressed through the fifteenth century by the expanding Nanbu clan, the family submitted and sank to the rank of local lords, and when Toyotomi Hideyoshi confirmed the Nanbu holdings of seven districts in 1590 the Takasari became Nanbu retainers, serving the Morioka Domain into the Edo period.
zh: 闭伊氏是陆奥国的武家，盘踞在游戏所称陆中、今岩手县宫古市一带的太平洋沿岸闭伊郡，自称“闭伊源氏”。其家传称始祖是源为朝之子、佐佐木高纲的养子，1189年奥州合战后受封闭伊、气仙两郡，赖基在12世纪90年代从气仙移住闭伊并以郡名为苗字；后世学者多认为他们更可能是奥州合战后来此土着的佐佐木一族。镰仓时代闭伊氏以御家人身份担任地头治理当地，14世纪初光赖与族人的遗产争端甚至由执权北条高时亲自在镰仓裁决。1333年，光赖之子亲光投奔南朝的北畠显家，参加了丰岛河原、青野原等战役，最终在石津之战败走。其嫡流后来修筑田锁城并改称田锁氏，统率“田锁十三家”的地方联盟，所产田锁马以骏足闻名，连京都都有口碑。15世纪在南部氏的持续攻势下，田锁氏臣服降格为国人领主；1590年丰臣秀吉确认南部氏领有七郡后，田锁一族成为南部家臣，江户时代以盛冈藩士身份存续。

en: The Heib, or Banu Hayb, were an Arab Bedouin tribal line of Barqa, as medieval Cyrenaica in eastern Libya was called. They belonged to the Banu Sulaym confederation, which moved west from Egypt in the great Hilalian migration of the eleventh century and occupied a region left half empty by earlier wars; their two main branches were the Shammakh and the Labid, whom Ibn Khaldun described as rich and numerous, while the chieftaincy over all the Hayb groups rested with the Banu Izzaz, known as the Izza. In the fourteenth century they were the dominant tribesmen of Barqa under loose Mamluk suzerainty. Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad launched expeditions against them between 1319 and 1325 to enforce payment of the zakat on flocks and harvests, and a commander named Fayid led the Barqa Arabs on the sultan's behalf until his death in 1346. Later the chieftaincy passed to Arif ibn Amr and then to his son Amr, whom the Egyptian encyclopedist al-Qalqashandi still found holding Barqa early in the fifteenth century.
zh: 海卜部又称巴努·海卜，是巴尔卡（中世纪对利比亚东部昔兰尼加的称呼）的阿拉伯贝都因酋长治系。他们隶属于巴努·苏莱姆联盟，11世纪随希拉尔大迁徙从埃及西来，占据了因连年战乱而人口稀少的巴尔卡；其下分舍马赫、莱比德两大支，伊本·赫勒敦称其人多财广，而海卜各部的酋长权掌握在别称“伊扎”的巴努·伊扎兹家族手中。14世纪，他们是巴尔卡占主导地位的部族，仅在名义上臣服马穆鲁克。纳西尔·穆罕默德苏丹于1319至1325年间多次派兵远征，强迫他们缴纳牲畜和庄稼的天课；名叫法伊德的首领代表苏丹统辖巴尔卡阿拉伯人，直到1346年去世。此后酋长权先后传给阿里夫·伊本·阿姆鲁及其子阿姆鲁，埃及百科学者盖勒盖山迪在15世纪初仍记载阿姆鲁执掌巴尔卡。

en: The lords of Heinsberg sprang from the House of Wassenberg: in 1082 Goswin, brother of the first count of Guelders, was invested with the lordship around Heinsberg west of the Rhine. Its most famous son was Philip of Heinsberg, Archbishop of Cologne from 1167 to 1191 and archchancellor of Italy, who became Duke of Westphalia in 1180, built the great Cologne city wall and died on Emperor Henry VI's siege of Naples. After the male Wassenberg line failed, the heiress Alix married a younger son of the count of Cleves in 1168, and her daughter Agnes carried Heinsberg to the Sponheim family, whose Sponheim-Heinsberg line ruled through the thirteenth century. Theodoric of Heinsberg, son of Godfrey II, inherited the counties of Loon and Chiny in the Ardennes in 1336 through his mother and held them against the claims of the prince-bishopric of Liege; his marriage to Kunigunde of the Mark tied the house to its powerful Westphalian neighbours. His only son died on the Prussian Crusade in 1342, and when Theodoric himself died in 1361, the disputed Loon and Chiny inheritance sparked the War of the Loon Succession, while Heinsberg itself later passed to the dukes of Juelich.
zh: 海因斯贝格领主出自瓦森贝格家族：1082年，首任海尔德伯爵之弟戈斯温受封莱茵河以西、以海因斯贝格为中心的领地。家族最著名的成员是海因斯贝格的菲利普，他1167至1191年任科隆大主教兼意大利大总理，1180年成为威斯特伐利亚公爵，主持修建了宏伟的科隆城墙，最后在皇帝亨利六世围攻那不勒斯时染病身亡。瓦森贝格男嗣断绝后，女继承人阿莉克斯于1168年嫁给克莱沃伯爵的幼子，其女阿格妮丝又把海因斯贝格带给施蓬海姆家族，施蓬海姆—海因斯贝格一支由此在13世纪领有该地。戈特弗里德二世之子迪特里希于1336年通过母亲继承阿登地区的隆和希尼两个伯国，并顶住列日主教区的索取；他娶马克的库尼贡德为妻，与威斯特伐利亚的强邻联姻。他唯一的儿子1342年死于普鲁士十字军，迪特里希本人1361年去世后，隆与希尼的继承争端引发隆继承战争，海因斯贝格本地后来则转入于利希公爵之手。

en: The counts of Henneberg were a Franconian comital dynasty, probably descended from the Popponid Babenberg family, who built a county between the Thuringian Forest and the Main as old Frankish county structures collapsed in the late eleventh century. Their ancestral seat was the Henneburg, first associated with the burgrave Godebold II of Wurzburg in 1096; the family had held the burgraviate of Wurzburg, with military command over the city and its high court, since about 1057, though a long contest with the bishops of Wurzburg cost them those rights by 1354. Godebold II shifted the centre of power eastward and founded the Premonstratensian monastery of Vessra in 1131, which became the dynasty's burial church. Repeated partitions followed, above all the great division of 1274 into the Hartenberg, Aschach-Romhild and Schleusingen lines; in 1310 Berthold VII of Henneberg-Schleusingen was raised to princely count, an imperial prince who at various times administered Bohemia and guarded the young Wittelsbach heir. The county's chief towns were Schmalkalden, Coburg and Suhl, whose mines and arms manufacture made it the economic heart, while the family also produced the minnesinger Otto von Botenlauben and Berthold of Henneberg, elector-archbishop of Mainz from 1484. The Reformation was introduced in 1542, and when the last princely count, Georg Ernst, died in 1583 the male line became extinct; by an earlier inheritance treaty the lands passed to the Saxon Wettin dynasty, Ernestine and Albertine lines sharing them twelvefold.
zh: 亨讷贝格伯爵是法兰克尼亚的伯爵世家，很可能出自波波尼德系的巴本贝格家族。11世纪末旧法兰克尼亚伯爵体制瓦解之际，他们在图林根林山与美因河之间建立起自己的伯国。家族祖堡为亨讷堡，1096年首次与维尔茨堡城堡伯爵戈德博尔德二世联系在一起；约从1057年起，该家族就世袭维尔茨堡城堡伯爵之职，掌握城市军权和高等法庭，后在与维尔茨堡主教的长期较量中于1354年丢掉这些权利。戈德博尔德二世把统治重心东移，并于1131年创立普雷蒙特雷修会的费斯拉修道院，它后来成为家族墓地。此后家族屡经分家，最重要的是1274年大分裂，形成哈滕贝格、阿沙赫‑勒姆希尔德和施洛伊辛根三支；1310年，亨讷贝格‑施洛伊辛根的贝希托尔德七世被擢升为尊贵伯爵、帝国诸侯，他曾数度代管波希米亚并监护年幼的维特尔斯巴赫继承人。伯国的主要城市是施马尔卡尔登、科堡和苏尔，苏尔的矿业与兵器制造是经济支柱；家族还走出了宫廷抒情诗人奥托·冯·博滕劳本，以及1484年起任美因茨选侯大主教的贝希托尔德·冯·亨讷贝格。1542年伯国引入宗教改革；1583年末代尊贵伯爵格奥尔格·恩斯特去世，男系绝嗣，根据早先的继承条约，领地转入萨克森韦廷家族，由恩斯特和阿尔布雷希特两支按十二份瓜分。

en: The House of Hesse descends from the dukes of Brabant of the Reginar family. In 1241 Sophie of Thuringia, daughter of Landgrave Louis IV and Saint Elizabeth of Hungary, married Duke Henry II of Brabant; when the Ludovingian landgraves died out in 1247, Sophie fought the War of the Thuringian Succession and kept the Hessian lands, the old Hessengau of the Chatti, for her son Henry the Child, who became the first Landgrave of Hesse in 1264 and was raised to princely rank by King Adolf in 1292. In 1337 the landgraviate was ruled by Henry II the Iron from Cassel; his daughter Adelaide married King Casimir III of Poland, one of many dynastic matches that carried Hesse's name across the Empire and beyond. The landgraviate was briefly split between Upper and Lower Hesse and reunited by William II in 1500. It reached its greatest weight under Philip I the Magnanimous, who adopted Protestantism at the Homberg synod of 1526 and led the Schmalkaldic League of Protestant princes against Emperor Charles V. On Philip's death in 1567 his four sons divided Hesse into Kassel, Marburg, Rheinfels and Darmstadt; the Kassel line became imperial electors in 1803 and the Darmstadt line grand dukes in 1806.
zh: 黑森家族男系出自雷吉纳尔家族的布拉班特公爵一脉。1241年，图林根领地伯爵路易四世与匈牙利的圣伊丽莎白之女索菲嫁给布拉班特公爵亨利二世；1247年卢多维格家族男系断绝后，索菲在图林根继承战争中力争，为儿子孩童亨利保住了黑森土地——古称卡蒂人的黑森高。亨利于1264年成为首任黑森领地伯爵，1292年被国王阿道夫升为帝国诸侯。1337年，领地伯爵是驻于卡塞勒的亨利二世“铁人”，他的女儿阿德莱德嫁给波兰国王卡齐米日三世，这类联姻把黑森的名号带到帝国各地乃至更远。领地曾一度分为上黑森和下黑森，1500年由威廉二世重新统一。家族在“慷慨者”菲利普一世治下达到鼎盛：他在1526年的霍姆贝格会议上皈依新教，并领导新教诸侯的施马尔卡尔登联盟对抗皇帝查理五世。1567年菲利普去世后，四个儿子把黑森分为卡塞尔、马尔堡、莱茵费尔斯和达姆施塔特四支；卡塞尔一支于1803年成为帝国选侯，达姆施塔特一支则在1806年成为大公。

en: The Hethumids, also called the House of Lampron after their castle in the Taurus Mountains, were the Armenian dynasty that ruled the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia from 1226 to 1341. As barons of Lampron the family had long rivalled the Rubenid kings, until Hethum I married Queen Isabella, daughter of Leo I, and inherited the crown. Hethum submitted to the Mongol Empire and travelled in person to the court of the Great Khan, forging an Armeno-Mongol alliance against the Mamluks of Egypt; the partnership brought decades of campaigning, including the devastating Mamluk victory at Mari in 1266. Under Hethum and his successors Cilician Armenia reached its height, its port of Ayas linking Mediterranean and East Asian trade while its nobility drew close to the Crusader states and Western feudal culture. From the early fourteenth century the kingdom shrank under repeated Mamluk invasions, and the abdications and murders around Hethum II exposed bitter court factionalism. Leo IV, the last Hethumid king, was killed in 1341, after which the crown passed to Lusignan cousins from Cyprus; the remnant kingdom finally fell to the Mamluks in 1375.
zh: 海屯米扬王朝又称兰普龙家族，得名于其在托罗斯山脉中的城堡兰普龙，是1226年至1341年间统治奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王国的亚美尼亚王朝。该家族本为兰普龙的男爵，长期与鲁本王朝的诸王分庭抗礼，直到海屯一世娶鲁本王朝莱翁一世之女伊莎贝拉女王为妻，于1226年继承王位。海屯一世向蒙古帝国称臣，并亲赴大汗朝廷，建立起亚美尼亚与蒙古的同盟，共同对抗埃及的马穆鲁克；这场同盟带来数十年征战，包括1266年马穆鲁克在马里战役中取得的毁灭性胜利。在海屯一世及其后继者治下，奇里乞亚亚美尼亚达到鼎盛，港口阿亚斯成为地中海与东亚贸易的枢纽，贵族阶层也与十字军国家和西欧封建文化日益亲近。14世纪初起，王国在马穆鲁克的反复入侵下不断萎缩，海屯二世几度退位又最终遇害，更暴露了宫廷内讧的惨烈。末代海屯米扬君主莱翁四世于1341年被杀，王位转入来自塞浦路斯的吕西尼昂家族旁支；残存的王国最终于1375年被马穆鲁克攻灭。

en: The Hienuki were a local warrior clan of northern Japan who held Hienuki district in Mutsu province, on the Kitakami river in what is now Iwate Prefecture. Their founder was said to have served Minamoto no Yoritomo and received the district after the Oshu campaign of 1189, though the clan first appears in documents only in the 1330s. In the Nanboku-cho wars it first backed the Southern Court, then sided with the Shiba, the Northern Court's tandai of Oshu, and in 1340 and 1341 suffered ruinous attacks by Nanbu Masanaga. Its long feud with the Nanbu continued: in the Waga disturbance of 1435 and 1436 its castles fell and it accepted Nanbu overlordship, while under the Muromachi order it served the Osaki, the Oshu tandai, below houses such as the Date and Kasai. In 1555 the lord Terutoki visited Kyoto, presented gold to Shogun Ashikaga Yoshiteru and received the character ‘teru’ for his name, yet the Hienuki stayed mere district-level kokujin lords, weakened by a run of adopted heirs from neighboring houses. The last lord, Hirotada, missed Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign of 1590 and lost his lands in the Oshu settlement; he joined the Waga-Hienuki rising of 1591, fled after its defeat and died, and his descendants later served the Date of Sendai as samurai.
zh: 稗贯氏是日本东北的地方武士豪族，领有陆奥国稗贯郡，辖地在今日本岩手县境内的北上川流域。相传其始祖追随源赖朝，在1189年奥州合战后受封稗贯郡；直到14世纪30年代的镰仓末期，该族才首次见于存世文书。南北朝战乱中稗贯氏先从南朝，北畠显家死后转投北朝派出的奥州探题斯波氏，1340至1341年连遭南朝方南部政长攻击，受到毁灭性打击而衰落。它与南部氏的争斗长期延续：1435至1436年的和贺大乱中，稗贯的城池被南部大军攻陷，只得臣服南部；在室町秩序下，它作为奥州探题大崎家的属下，地位排在伊达、葛西、南部等家之后。1555年当主辉时上洛，向将军足利义辉献金并获赐“辉”字，但稗贯氏始终只是控制一郡的国人领主，未能成长为战国大名，且当主多由葛西、斯波、和贺等家的养子继承，反引外力介入。末代当主广忠未参加1590年丰臣秀吉的小田原征伐，在奥州仕置中被没收领地；他又在1591年参与和贺·稗贯一揆，败逃后死去，后裔相传在江户时代以仙台藩藩士的身份存续。

en: The Hindu dynasty takes its name from Shaykh 'Ali Hindu, a follower of the Ilkhanid claimant Togha Temür, who appointed him governor of Astarabad on the Caspian coast. When Togha Temür was murdered by the Sarbadars in 1353 and Astarabad was annexed, 'Ali Hindu's son Amir Vali took refuge with the neighboring Jauni Kurban tribe and then used Mazandaran as a base from which to recover the city in 1356. He ruled Astarabad and parts of Mazandaran until 1366 and again from about 1374 to 1384, waging repeated wars against the Sarbadars and the Jalayirids and declaring for Shi'ism to win local support. His independent rule ended only with the arrival of Timur, who took Astarabad in 1384.
zh: 欣杜家族得名于谢赫·阿里·欣杜，他是伊利汗国汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿的部将，被任命为里海沿岸阿斯塔拉巴德的长官。1353年脱合帖木儿被萨尔巴达尔人杀害、阿斯塔拉巴德遭吞并后，阿里·欣杜之子阿米尔·瓦利先投奔邻近的乔尼·库尔班部落，随后以马赞达兰为基地，于1356年夺回阿斯塔拉巴德。他统治阿斯塔拉巴德和马赞达兰的部分地区至1366年，又在约1374年至1384年间当政，其间屡次与萨尔巴达尔人和札剌亦儿人交战，并宣布皈依什叶派以争取当地支持。1384年帖木儿攻陷阿斯塔拉巴德，他的独立统治才告结束。

en: The Aki Hiraga claimed descent from the great regent Fujiwara no Yoshifusa of the Northern House. Their founder Matsuba Sukemune fought for Minamoto no Yoritomo in the Gempei War and was rewarded with lands in Dewa, Aki, Kazusa and Etchū; his son Koreyasu moved to Hiraka district in Dewa and took Hiraga, another reading of Hiraka, as the family name. Around 1274 the house moved west against the Mongol threat, settled on its Takaya estate in southern Aki and built Misonou Castle, becoming one of the province's kokujin lords. In 1508 Hiraga Hiroyasu marched to Kyoto with Ōuchi Yoshioki and the other Aki warriors and fought at Funaokayama. The Sengoku age caught the house between the Ōuchi and the Amago: the heir Okisada defected to the Amago and was crushed in 1540 when Mōri Motonari, on Ōuchi Yoshitaka's orders, stormed Kashirazaki Castle; in 1551, after Sue Takafusa killed Yoshitaka, Motonari sided with Sue, destroyed the Ōuchi loyalist Hiraga Takayasu at Kashirazaki, and installed Shinkurō, renamed Hiraga Hirosuke, as head. Hirosuke bound the family to the Mōri, receiving his generational character from them and becoming sworn brother to Kobayakawa Takakage, and the holding grew to some eighteen thousand koku. After the Mōri were transferred to Suō and Nagato in 1600, the Hiraga followed with their fief cut to four thousand koku, and the line continued as modest retainers of the Chōshū domain.
zh: 安艺平贺氏自称是摄政藤原良房的后裔，属藤原北家良房流。始祖松叶资宗在源平合战中追随源赖朝屡立战功，受封出羽、安艺、上总、越中等地领地；其子惟泰移居出羽国平鹿郡，便以地名“平鹿”（另读平贺）为姓氏。1274年前后，为防备元军来袭，一族西迁到自家领地安艺国南部的高屋保，修筑御薗宇城，成为安艺国人之一。1508年，平贺弘保随大内义兴与其他安艺武将一同上洛，在船冈山之战等处作战。战国时代，平贺氏夹在大内氏与尼子氏之间：嫡子兴贞倒向尼子，1540年毛利元就奉大内义隆之命攻破头崎城，兴贞兵败出家；1551年陶隆房在大宁寺之变中弑杀义隆，毛利元就又攻灭大内方的平贺隆保，拥立忠於毛利的新九郎继位，即平贺广相。广相受赐毛利家通字“广”，与小早川隆景结为义兄弟，平贺氏在保持国人自治的同时日渐从属毛利氏，领地一度增至一万八千石。1600年关原之战后毛利氏被减封至防长二国，平贺氏随行迁移，领地大幅削减为四千石，此后作为长州藩的下级藩士延续家名。

en: The Hishikari were a kokujin warrior family of Hishikari District in northern Ōsumi, the area that is now Isa in Kagoshima Prefecture, taking their name from the valley they ruled. During the Muromachi period they seized Ōguchi Castle, a fortress founded in the twelfth century on the road between Satsuma, Ōsumi and Hyūga, and from there resisted the expansion of the Shimazu alongside their neighbours the Sagara and Gamō. In the Tenbun era their head Hishikari Takaaki joined Kedōin Yoshishige and Gamō Norikiyo in revolt against Shimazu Takahisa; the coalition besieged Kajiki Castle in 1554 but was routed when Takahisa's sons stormed Iwatsurugi Castle. Fighting dragged on for fifteen years, until in 1569 the Hishikari were beaten at the Battle of Togamire and Ōguchi became a Shimazu outer stronghold, ending the house's independence with Takaaki as its last ruling head.
zh: 菱刈氏是大隅国北部菱刈郡（今鹿儿岛县伊佐市一带）的国人武家，以所领的谷地为姓。室町时代他们夺取了12世纪修筑、扼守萨摩、大隅、日向三国通道的大口城，联合邻近的相良氏、蒲生氏对抗岛津氏的扩张。天文年间，当主菱刈隆秋与祁答院良重、蒲生范清一同举兵反叛岛津贵久，联军于1554年围攻加治木城，却因贵久诸子攻陷岩剑城而溃败。战事又持续了十余年，到1569年菱刈氏在户神尾之战中被岛津军击败，大口城沦为岛津氏的外城，隆秋成为最后一位统治该谷地的当主，菱刈氏就此失去独立地位。

en: The counts of Hohenberg were a Swabian comital house whose seat was Oberhohenberg Castle on the Swabian Jura. They split from the counts of Zollern, the ancestors of the Hohenzollerns, around the middle of the twelfth century, with Burkhard II, who died about 1154, as their founder; a Burkhard of Zollern-Hohenberg first appears as a witness in a charter of Emperor Frederick Barbarossa in 1170. Marriages and inheritances carried the house north to Haigerloch, Nagold and Horb on the Neckar, largely at the expense of the counts palatine of Tübingen, and in 1260 the county was divided between a Rottenburg main line and a Nagold-Wildberg line. The family's greatest match was Gertrude of Hohenberg, who around 1245 married Count Rudolf of Habsburg and, as Queen Anna, stood beside him after his election as German king in 1273. Her brother Albert II was Rudolf's councillor and land-vogt of Lower Swabia, founded the town of Rottenburg about 1280, and was also a Minnesinger recorded in the Manesse manuscript before he fell in battle in 1298. Repeated partitions then drove the counts into debt: shares were sold to Württemberg and the Rhenish Palatinate from 1363, and in 1381 Rudolf III sold the whole county to Duke Leopold III of Austria.
