He died in 1389, and the last sideline ended with Count Sigmund in 1486, though the county existed in law until 1806.
zh: 霍恩贝格伯爵是施瓦本的伯爵世家，驻地在施瓦本汝拉山上的上霍恩贝格城堡。他们约在12世纪中叶从索伦伯爵（霍亨索伦家族的先祖）分出，始祖是约1154年去世的布克哈德二世；1170年，一位索伦-霍恩贝格的布克哈德首次作为见证人出现在皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的特许状中。借助联姻和继承，家族向北扩展到海格洛赫、纳戈尔德和内卡河畔霍尔布，扩张主要蚕食了图宾根行宫伯爵的领地；1260年，伯国分为罗滕堡主支和纳戈尔德-维尔德贝格支。家族最显赫的联姻是霍恩贝格的格特鲁德：她约在1245年嫁给哈布斯堡伯爵鲁道夫，1273年鲁道夫当选德意志国王后，她以安娜王后的名号相伴左右。她的兄弟阿尔布雷希特二世是鲁道夫的顾问、下施瓦本的地方长官，约1280年创建罗滕堡城，同时还是《马内塞手稿》中留有作品的爱情诗人，最终于1298年战死。此后一再分家使伯爵们债台高筑：1363年起，各份领地陆续卖给符腾堡和莱茵行宫伯爵；1381年，鲁道夫三世把整个伯国卖给奥地利公爵利奥波德三世。他于1389年去世，最后的旁支也在1486年随伯爵西格蒙德而绝，不过伯国在名义上一直存续到1806年。

en: The House of Hohenlohe traces its first documented ancestor to Conrad of Weikersheim, recorded in 1153, who held an escort right on the Tauber trade route; the name itself comes from Hohlach Castle, first adopted by the family in 1178. From Weikersheim and Brauneck the lords built a compact lordship on the Hohenlohe Plateau between the Kocher, Jagst and Tauber rivers in Franconia, and two of their number, Heinrich and Gottfried von Hohenlohe, became grand masters of the Teutonic Order. In 1230 the house divided into the Hohenlohe and Brauneck lines, though the Brauneck line died out in 1390 and the Uffenheim-Speckfeld branch in 1412. Emperor Frederick III raised Kraft V and his brother to imperial counts in 1450, after which the Weikersheim line repeatedly subdivided; from 1551 the Neuenstein and Waldenburg branches dominated, the first turning Lutheran and the second remaining Catholic. The Waldenburg line gained princely rank in 1744 and the Neuenstein-Oehringen line in 1764, with their territories becoming principalities. In 1806 the Confederation of the Rhine mediatized the Hohenlohe lands to Bavaria and Wuerttemberg, while the family kept its estates and several branches, including the Oehringen line, survived.
zh: 霍恩洛厄家族可考的始祖是1153年见载的魏克斯海姆领主康拉德，他掌握陶伯尔河商道的护送权；家族之名则来自霍拉赫城堡，1178年起被族人采用。领主们以魏克斯海姆和布劳内克为据点，在法兰克尼亚科赫尔河、雅格斯特河与陶伯尔河之间的霍恩洛厄高原经营出一片紧凑领地，海因里希和戈特弗里德·冯·霍恩洛厄两人还先后出任条顿骑士团大团长。1230年家族分为霍恩洛厄与布劳内克两支，后者于1390年绝嗣，乌芬海姆—施佩克费尔德支也在1412年断绝。1450年皇帝腓特烈三世将克拉夫特五世兄弟升为帝国伯爵，此后魏克斯海姆一系又多次分家；1551年起，诺因施泰因和瓦尔登堡两支成为主干，前者改宗路德宗，后者保持天主教。瓦尔登堡支于1744年、诺因施泰因—厄林根支于1764年取得诸侯头衔，领地相继升格为亲王国。1806年莱茵邦联将霍恩洛厄领地分别并入巴伐利亚和符腾堡，家族保留了产业，包括厄林根支在内的多个支系延续下来。

en: The Hohenstaufen, also called the Staufer, were a Swabian noble family named after their castle on the conical Staufen hill near Göppingen. Frederick of Büren's son Frederick I was enfeoffed with the Duchy of Swabia by Emperor Henry IV in 1079 and married the emperor's daughter Agnes. In 1138 Conrad III became the first Hohenstaufen king of the Romans. Frederick I Barbarossa, crowned emperor in 1155, carried the Holy Roman Empire to its greatest medieval extent and died on crusade in 1190; his son Henry VI, emperor from 1191, inherited the Kingdom of Sicily through his wife Constance in 1194. Frederick II, crowned emperor in 1220, ruled mainly from Sicily and waged a long struggle with the papacy. After his death in 1250 the house collapsed: Manfred was killed at Benevento in 1266 by Charles of Anjou, and the young Conradin was beheaded at Naples after the Battle of Tagliacozzo in 1268, ending the direct line. The last captive member, Manfred's son Henry, died at Castel dell'Ovo in 1318, so by 1337 the dynasty was extinct, although many later ruling houses descended from it through female lines.
zh: 霍恩施陶芬家族又称施陶芬家族，是施瓦本的贵族世家，得名于格平根附近锥形的施陶芬山上的家族城堡。比伦的腓特烈之子腓特烈一世于1079年被皇帝亨利四世封为施瓦本公爵，并娶皇帝之女阿格尼丝为妻。1138年，康拉德三世成为家族第一位罗马人的国王。绰号“红胡子”的腓特烈一世于1155年加冕为皇帝，使神圣罗马帝国的疆域在中世纪达到极盛，1190年在十字军途中死去；其子亨利六世1191年称帝，并于1194年凭借妻子科斯坦察继承西西里王国。腓特烈二世1220年加冕为帝，长期在西西里执政，与教宗争斗多年。他1250年死后家族迅速败落：曼弗雷迪于1266年在贝内文托被安茹的查理一世击杀，年轻的康拉丁在1268年塔利亚科佐之战后被斩首于那不勒斯，直系就此断绝。家族最后的男嗣、曼弗雷迪之子恩里科于1318年在蛋堡的囚禁中死去，因此到1337年王朝已经不复存在，但后来的许多统治家族都通过女系出自该家族。

en: The Hohenzollern of the Swabian line were counts in the Swabian Jura, taking their name from their castle of Zollern near Hechingen. Their first documented ancestor, Burkhard I of Zollern, was killed in a feud in 1061, and his likely grandson Frederick I appears early in the twelfth century as a powerful Swabian count. When the family lands were divided at the end of that century, the younger son's line took the Burgraviate of Nuremberg and grew into the Franconian branch, while the elder line kept Zollern and remained the Catholic Swabian branch. A son of Frederick I secured the County of Hohenberg in the twelfth century, which the family held until 1486. Repeated partitions narrowed the line's means, and in 1576 its lands split into Hohenzollern-Hechingen, Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen and Hohenzollern-Haigerloch; the counts were raised to princely rank in 1623, and Haigerloch was absorbed by Sigmaringen in 1767. In 1337 the line still ruled its small Swabian county from the Zollern hills, where Frederick IX, who died in 1379, became the first of the family to call himself Count of Hohenzollern.
zh: 霍亨索伦家族的施瓦本支系是施瓦本汝拉山区的伯爵世家，得名于黑兴根附近的索伦城堡。家族第一位有确切记载的先祖布克哈德于1061年在一场仇杀中丧命，他可能的孙子腓特烈一世在12世纪初已是有权势的施瓦本伯爵。12世纪末分家时，幼支取得纽伦堡城堡伯爵领地，发展为法兰克尼亚支系；长支则保有索伦，成为始终信奉天主教的施瓦本支系。腓特烈一世的一个儿子在12世纪取得霍恩贝格伯国，该领地一直保留到1486年。一再分家使支系国力日衰，1576年领地分为霍亨索伦-黑兴根、霍亨索伦-锡格马林根和霍亨索伦-海格洛赫三块；1623年家族由伯爵晋升为帝国诸侯，海格洛赫则于1767年并入锡格马林根。1337年，这一支仍在索伦山区统治着小小的施瓦本伯国，1379年去世的腓特烈九世是家族中第一个自称霍亨索伦伯爵的人。

en: The Franconian Hohenzollern, or Nuremberg line, descend from a younger son of the Swabian counts of Zollern who acquired the Burgraviate of Nuremberg around 1192 by marrying its Raabs heiress; the branch's effective founder was Conrad I, Burgrave of Nuremberg, born in 1186. The city of Nuremberg won its independence in 1219, so the burgraves built their power on the castle and the surrounding lands, adding Ansbach in 1331 and Kulmbach in 1340. Their Franconian territory was split into Ansbach and Kulmbach, later Bayreuth, in 1398. In 1411 Burgrave Frederick VI was made governor of troubled Brandenburg; at the Council of Constance in 1415 King Sigismund enfeoffed him as Elector and Margrave Frederick I, and he bought the margraviate outright in 1417. Ten years later his line sold its Nuremberg rights to the imperial city. The family turned Protestant in the sixteenth century, and in 1525 Albert of the Ansbach line, last Grand Master of the Teutonic Knights, secularized its state as the Duchy of Prussia. Brandenburg and Prussia were joined in personal union in 1618 and became the Kingdom of Prussia in 1701. In 1337 the branch still held the Nuremberg burgraviate, a rising comital house of the empire.
zh: 霍亨索伦的法兰克尼亚支系又称纽伦堡支系，出自施瓦本索伦伯爵家族的幼支：1192年前后，家族通过与拉布斯家族的女继承人联姻取得纽伦堡城堡伯爵领地，支系实际始祖是生于1186年的首任城堡伯爵康拉德一世。纽伦堡城于1219年赢得独立，城堡伯爵们便以城堡和周围领地为根基扩张，1331年取得安斯巴赫，1340年取得库尔姆巴赫。1398年，法兰克尼亚领地分为安斯巴赫与库尔姆巴赫（即后来的拜罗伊特）两支。1411年，城堡伯爵腓特烈六世受命治理动荡的勃兰登堡；1415年国王西吉斯蒙德在康斯坦茨会议上封他为藩侯兼选帝侯（称腓特烈一世），他又在1417年彻底买下这片藩侯领地，十年后其支系把在纽伦堡的权利卖给了这座帝国城市。家族在16世纪改宗新教；1525年，出身安斯巴赫支系的条顿骑士团末代大团长阿尔布雷希特将骑士团国家世俗化，建立普鲁士公国。1618年勃兰登堡与普鲁士结成共主邦联，1701年普鲁士王国建立。1337年，该支仍领有纽伦堡城堡伯爵领地，是帝国境内蒸蒸日上的伯爵家族。

en: The counts of Hohnstein, often spelled Honstein in their own day, were a noble house of the southern Harz, first documented in 1154 as the lords of Ilfeld in a charter of Henry the Lion for Volkenroda Abbey. Count Elger of Hohnstein appears as a witness to an imperial diploma in 1182, and the county grew up around Hohnstein Castle above Neustadt in the Harz. By the middle of the fourteenth century the Hohnsteins were counted the leading comital family of the southern Harz, ahead of the counts of Schwarzburg and Stolberg. The house split into three lines from 1315: the Sondershausen line died out in 1356 and passed to Schwarzburg, while the remaining branches divided in 1373 into Kelbra-Heringen and Lohra-Klettenberg. The flail war of 1412 wrecked part of their domain and forced sales to the counts of Stolberg, beginning the family's decline. The Lohra-Klettenberg line nevertheless added the counties of Scharzfeld and Lauterberg in the sixteenth century and in 1521 issued the first mining charter at Sankt Andreasberg. With the death of Count Ernst VII in 1593 the ruling house became extinct; rival claims by Schwarzburg and Stolberg were settled only after long suits, and under the Peace of Westphalia in 1648 the former Hohnstein lands, as part of the secularised bishopric of Halberstadt, fell to the Elector of Brandenburg.
zh: 霍恩施泰因伯爵家族（当时常拼作 Honstein）是哈茨山南麓的贵族世家，1154年首次见于文献，时为伊尔费尔德领主，载于狮子亨利为福尔肯罗达修道院颁发的特许状中。1182年，霍恩施泰因伯爵埃尔格作为见证人出现在皇帝的诏书上；伯国围绕哈茨山区诺伊施塔特上方的霍恩施泰因城堡发展起来。到14世纪中叶，霍恩施泰因家族被视为南哈茨首屈一指的伯爵世家，地位在施瓦茨堡和施托尔贝格伯爵之上。家族自1315年起分裂为三支：松德斯豪森支于1356年绝嗣，领地由施瓦茨堡继承；其余两支于1373年分为凯尔布拉-黑林根支和洛拉-克莱滕贝格支。1412年的链枷战争摧毁了部分领地，家族被迫向施托尔贝格伯爵出售土地，由此走向衰落。尽管如此，洛拉-克莱滕贝格支仍在16世纪取得沙茨费尔德和劳特贝格两个伯国，并于1521年在圣安德烈亚斯贝格颁布了首部矿业特许状。1593年恩斯特七世伯爵去世，当权的家族支系绝嗣；施瓦茨堡与施托尔贝格的继承争夺经长期诉讼才了结，1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》将原霍恩施泰因领地作为还俗的哈尔伯施塔特主教区的一部分划归勃兰登堡选帝侯。

en: The Honma took their name from Honma in Echi village, Aiko district of Sagami, and traced their descent to the Ebina line of the Yokoyama party, one of the seven warrior bands of Musashi. In the early Kamakura period Honma no Yoshihisa crossed to Sado Island as shugodai, deputy to the Osaragi Hojo who held the island's shugo post, and made Sawada Castle his seat; his descendants ruled Sado from the thirteenth century into the Sengoku period and split into several branches, the Sawada, Kawarada and Hamochi houses. In 1509 the Honma sheltered the Echigo shugodai Nagao Tamekage and the shugo Uesugi Sadazane after their defeat by Uesugi Akisada, and in 1510 the Hamochi and Sawada houses landed troops in Echigo at Teradomari and killed Akisada at the battle of Nagamorihara, earning estates in Echigo from Tamekage. During the Sengoku wars the Kawarada and Hamochi branches overshadowed the main Sawada house and fought one another repeatedly while the senior Sawada house declined. The quarrel settled for a time under Nagao Kagetora, later Uesugi Kenshin, and after Uesugi Kenshin's death in 1578 the feuding revived, and the Honma leaned toward the Ashina of Aizu and Mogami Yoshiaki of Dewa against Kenshin's heir Uesugi Kagekatsu. In 1589 Kagekatsu, with Toyotomi Hideyoshi's leave, invaded Sado and overthrew the clan; some Honma who had sided with the Uesugi followed them to Echigo, Aizu and Yonezawa.
zh: 本间氏的苗字来源于相模国爱甲郡依知乡的本间，谱系上出自武藏七党之一横山党的海老名氏流。镰仓初期，本间能久作为佐渡守护大佛氏（北条氏支流）的守护代渡海进入佐渡，以杂太城为本据扩张势力，其子孙从13世纪起统治佐渡，一直延续到战国时代，并分出杂太、河原田、羽茂等多家分家。1509年，越后守护代长尾为景被关东管领上杉显定击败，本间氏收留了为景和守护上杉定实；1510年，羽茂、杂太两家又派出援军从寺泊登陆越后，在长森原之战中迫使显定败死，凭战功从为景处获封越后领地。进入战国，河原田家和羽茂家势力坐大，纷争不断，惣领杂太家反而没落。上杉谦信（长尾景虎）时代两家争斗一度平息，1578年谦信死后再度激化；后来本间氏又与会津芦名氏、出羽最上义光联手，对谦信的继承者上杉景胜采取反旗姿态。1589年，得到丰臣秀吉许可的景胜攻入佐渡讨伐本间氏，本间氏灭亡；其中早先与抵抗的同族决裂、投靠上杉方的一支，则随上杉家先后迁往越后、会津和米泽。

en: The Honnavara rulers were the local lords of the trading port of Honnavar on the Kanara coast, where the traveller Ibn Battuta met its Muslim sultan Jamaluddin in 1342. The port later passed to the Saluva kings of nearby Gerusoppa and then to the Portuguese, who built a fortress there in the sixteenth century.
zh: 霍纳沃尔家族是卡纳拉海岸贸易港口霍纳瓦尔的地方统治者，1342年旅行家伊本·白图泰在此见到其穆斯林苏丹贾马鲁丁。该港后来归入邻近盖鲁索佩的萨卢瓦诸王，继而落入葡萄牙人之手，后者于16世纪在此修建了要塞。

en: The lords of Horne took their name from the village of Horn in Limburg, not from the North Holland town of Hoorn; an Engelbert of Horne appears in twelfth-century charters and is regarded as the family's ancestor, while a kinship with the counts of Loon is suspected but unproven. From William I, who married the heiress of Altena in 1230, the family built up a cluster of lordships straddling the Meuse, adding Altena, Wessem and Kortessem to Horn itself. Gerard I, lord from around 1300, held Horne, Altena, Perwijs and Herlaar, and his son William IV added Gaasbeek by marriage; their thirteenth-century castle at Horn was the family seat, later joined by Nijenborgh castle at Weert. In 1450 Emperor Frederick III raised the lordship to the imperial county of Horn, but the senior line died out with the fourth count in 1540 and the title passed by adoption to the Montmorency family. Philip of Montmorency, count of Horn, was beheaded at Brussels in 1568 together with Lamoral of Egmond, after which the county was seized and handed to the bishop of Liège. A younger line, the princes of Hornes in the Spanish Netherlands, survived until 1826.
zh: 霍恩领主家族得名于林堡的霍恩村，而不是北荷兰的霍伦城。12世纪的契约中已出现一位霍恩的恩格尔贝特，被视为家族始祖；后人推测他们与洛恩伯爵有亲缘，但始终没有证实。自威廉一世于1230年娶阿尔特纳女继承人起，家族在默兹河两岸积累起一连串领地，在霍恩之外又取得阿尔特纳、韦瑟姆和科特瑟姆。约1300年袭位的格拉拉尔一世领有霍恩、阿尔特纳、佩韦斯和赫拉拉尔，其子威廉四世又凭婚姻获得哈斯贝克；他们在霍恩的13世纪城堡是本家城堡，后来又在韦尔特修建了奈延堡。1450年，皇帝腓特烈三世将霍恩领地升格为帝国伯国，但长支在1540年随第四代伯爵而绝嗣，爵位经收养转入蒙莫朗西家族。霍恩伯爵菲利普·德·蒙莫朗西于1568年在布鲁塞尔与拉莫拉尔·范·埃格蒙特一同被斩首，伯国随即被没收并交给列日主教。家族的幼支、西属尼德兰的霍恩亲王一支则延续到1826年。

en: The Hosokawa are a samurai clan of Seiwa Genji stock, branching from the Ashikaga family: Ashikaga Yoshisue, whose estate lay in Mikawa Province, was the first to bear the name. In the wars of the early fourteenth century Hosokawa Yoriharu and Akiuji backed Ashikaga Takauji, and under the new Muromachi shogunate the clan became one of the three houses, alongside the Shiba and Hatakeyama, that supplied the office of Kanrei, the shogun's deputy. Yoriyuki, holding that post from the 1360s, did much to entrench shogunal rule, while Hosokawa kinsmen were appointed Constables of provinces from Shikoku to the Kinai, including Awa, Tosa, Sanuki, Settsu and Yamashiro. In 1467 the rivalry between Kanrei Hosokawa Katsumoto and his father-in-law Yamana Sozen over the shogunal succession ignited the Onin War, which opened the Sengoku age. Katsumoto's son Masamoto for a time held the capital, but his assassination in 1507 split the clan into feuding branches, and the main line was driven from Kyoto when Oda Nobunaga seized the city. A junior branch led by Hosokawa Fujitaka and his son Tadaoki went on to serve Nobunaga, Hideyoshi and Tokugawa Ieyasu; after siding with Ieyasu at Sekigahara in 1600 they were enfeoffed at Kumamoto in Higo Province with 540,000 koku. The Kumamoto lords ranked among the wealthiest Edo daimyo: the third lord Tadatoshi employed the swordsman Miyamoto Musashi, and Lord Shigekata's reforms and his domain school of 1755 repaired the domain's later finances.
zh: 细川氏是清和源氏足利氏的支流，因始祖足利义季的领地位于三河国细川而取此姓。14世纪初的战乱中，细川赖春、显氏等人追随足利尊氏，室町幕府建立后，细川家与斯波、畠山两家并列为世袭管领的三大家族。赖之于14世纪60年代出任管领，为巩固幕政建树甚多；一族成员还陆续被任命为阿波、土佐、赞岐、摄津、山城等国守护，势力从四国延伸到畿内。1467年，管领细川胜元与岳父山名持丰（宗全）因将军继承问题对立，引爆应仁之乱，京都化为焦土，战国时代由此开端。胜元之子政元一度独揽京都大权，却在1507年遇刺，细川家随即分裂内讧，宗家最终在织田信长入京时被逐出京都。以细川藤孝（幽斋）、忠兴父子为首的旁支转而先后侍奉织田、丰臣与德川；1600年关原之战中他们站在德川家康一方，战后受封肥后国熊本藩五十四万石。熊本藩主跻身江户最富有的大名之列，第三代藩主忠利的家臣中就有剑豪宫本武藏；第六代藩主重贤推行改革，并于1755年创设藩校时习馆，扭转了藩财的颓势。

en: The Hot, also written Hoth, are a Baloch tribe descending from Hoth Khan, one of the four sons of Jalal Khan, who led the Baloch migration from Persia into Makran and founded the first Baloch confederacy in the twelfth century. The game presents the tribe's chiefs as the ruling house of Kharan in the Makran interior.
zh: 霍特（又译霍斯）是俾路支部落，始祖为贾拉尔·汗之子霍特·汗；贾拉尔·汗于12世纪率领诸部从波斯迁入莫克兰，建立第一个俾路支联盟，四个儿子分衍出几大部落。游戏将该部首领处理为莫克兰内陆哈兰的统治家族。

en: The Hojo were the de facto rulers of Japan from 1203 to 1333 as hereditary regents, or shikken, of the Kamakura shogunate. Said to descend from a Taira branch settled in Izu, the family rose through Hojo Tokimasa (1138—1215), whose daughter Masako married Minamoto no Yoritomo; after Yoritomo's death Tokimasa made himself regent to the child shoguns, and both the shoguns and the Kyoto court were reduced to figureheads. The second regent Yoshitoki crushed Emperor Go-Toba's rising in the Jokyu War of 1221, while Yasutoki set up a council of state in 1225 and issued Japan's first samurai law code, the Goseibai Shikimoku, in 1232. The regency's finest hour came when its defenses weathered the two Mongol invasions of 1274 and 1281, both broken by typhoons hailed as kamikaze, yet the unrewarded costs of defense alienated the vassal warriors. Emperor Go-Daigo's revolts of 1324 and 1331 opened the regime's collapse: in 1333 Ashikaga Takauji defected and Nitta Yoshisada stormed Kamakura, where some 870 Hojo, led by the last regent Takatoki, killed themselves at the Tosho-ji temple. Takatoki's son Tokiyuki briefly retook Kamakura in the Nakasendai rising of 1335, then served the Southern Court until he was captured and beheaded in 1353; the Later Hojo of Odawara who rose in the 1400s were a separate, unrelated family.
zh: 北条氏在1203年至1333年间以镰仓幕府世袭执权的身份实际统治日本。该族据称出自定居伊豆的一支平氏，其崛起靠的是北条时政（1138—1215）：他的女儿政子嫁给源赖朝，赖朝死后时政成为幼龄将军的执权，并使该职位世袭，将军与京都朝廷一同沦为傀儡。第二代执权义时在1221年承久之乱中击败后鸟羽上皇的倒幕军队；泰时则于1225年设立评定众集体议政，并在1232年颁布日本第一部武家法典《御成败式目》。执权政治最辉煌的时刻是扛住了1274年和1281年两次蒙古来袭，两场台风被视为“神风”而令入侵舰队覆灭，但无功可赏的沉重防务开销反而加深了御家人武士的离心。后醍醐天皇1324年和1331年的倒幕行动开启了政权的崩溃：1333年足利尊氏倒戈，新田义贞攻陷镰仓，末代执权高时为首的约870名北条族人在东胜寺集体自尽。高时之子时行在1335年的中先代之乱中一度夺回镰仓，兵败后归顺南朝继续作战，最终于1353年被俘斩首；15世纪崛起的小田原后北条氏则是与此并无血缘的另一家族。

en: The counts of Hoya were a north German comital family seated at the town of Hoya on the middle Weser, between Bremen and Nienburg. The first documented count, Henry, appears in 1202 as a vassal of Archbishop Hartwig II of Bremen, and his descendants steadily bought up the Weser estates of the rival Hodenberg family until 1313; the acquisition of Nienburg in 1215 also opened a long quarrel with the bishops of Minden. In 1345 the brothers Gerhard III and John II divided the county between a Hoya and a Nienburg line. The family tried in 1450, during the Münster Diocesan Feud, to install Erich of Hoya as bishop of Münster but failed. The elder Hoya line died out in 1497 and the lands were reunited under Count Jobst I at Nienburg. Pressure from the Welf dukes of Brunswick-Lüneburg grew regardless: they occupied the county in 1512 and the counts had to accept them as liege lords. When Count Otto VIII died without sons in 1582, Hoya was partitioned among the Calenberg and Lüneburg lines of Brunswick-Lüneburg and Hesse-Kassel, and the dynasty came to an end.
zh: 霍亚伯爵家族是北德意志的伯爵世家，驻于威悉河中游、不来梅与尼恩堡之间的霍亚镇。家族第一位见于记载的伯爵亨利在1202年以不来梅大主教哈特维希二世封臣的身份出现，其后人逐步买下敌对的霍登贝格家族在威悉河畔的地产，这一过程持续到1313年；1215年取得尼恩堡还引发了与明登主教的长期冲突。1345年，格哈德三世与约翰二世兄弟分家，形成霍亚与尼恩堡两支。1450年明斯特主教区纷争期间，家族试图把族人埃里希推上明斯特主教之位，但未能成功。霍亚长支于1497年绝嗣，领地在尼恩堡的约布斯特一世治下重新统一。然而韦尔夫家族的不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵压力日增，1512年出兵占领伯国，霍亚伯爵被迫承认其为宗主。1582年伯爵奥托八世无子而终，霍亚被不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的卡伦贝格支、吕讷堡支以及黑森-卡塞尔瓜分，家族就此终结。

en: The Hoysalas rose from the misty Malnad hills of Karnataka as hill chiefs who, under kings such as Nripa Kama and Vinayaditya around the year 1000, served the Western Chalukyas as feudatories. Their name comes from the Kannada legend of Sala, who struck down a tiger to save his Jain guru, the cry hoy sala giving the dynasty its name and the fight its royal emblem. Vishnuvardhana, reigning from about 1108 to 1152, broke Chalukya tutelage and crushed the Cholas at Talakad in 1116, taking the title Conqueror of Talakad and making first Belur and then Dvarasamudra, modern Halebidu, his capital. In the thirteenth century the Hoysalas overshadowed both the Cholas and the Pandyas, set up a provincial capital at Kannanur Kuppam near Srirangam and drew tribute from the Tamil country under kings like Vira Someshwara, whom the southern courts called Mamadi, or uncle. The fourteenth century brought the Delhi Sultans: Malik Kafur sacked Dvarasamudra in 1311 and the armies of Muhammad bin Tughluq sacked it again in 1327, yet Veera Ballala III kept the last great Hindu kingdom of the Deccan fighting for nearly thirty years from Tiruvannamalai until he was killed at the Battle of Madurai in 1343. His lands then passed to Harihara I and merged into the new Vijayanagara Empire. The Hoysalas left a lasting legacy in their star-shaped soapstone temples at Belur, Halebidu and Somanathapura and in the Kannada and Sanskrit literature patronised by their court.
zh: 曷萨拉人起家于卡纳塔克多雨的马尔纳德山区，约在1000年前后，尼利波·伽摩、毗那耶迭多一带的首领作为西遮娄其王朝的封臣据有一方。其族名源自卡纳达传说：青年萨拉为救耆那教上师搏杀猛虎，呼喊的“霍伊·萨拉”遂成族名，人虎相搏也成为王室纹章。毗湿奴伐弹那约1108至1152年在位，他摆脱遮娄其控制，于1116年在塔莱卡德击溃朱罗人，赢得“塔莱卡德征服者”的称号，并先后以贝卢尔和德瓦拉萨穆德拉（即赫莱比杜）为都。13世纪曷萨拉凌驾于朱罗与潘地亚之上，在斯里兰甘附近的坎纳努尔库帕姆设立行都，维拉·索梅什瓦拉等国王向泰米尔地区收取贡赋，南方诸廷尊称他为“玛马迪”，意为舅父。14世纪德里苏丹国的兵锋南下：马利克·卡富尔于1311年洗劫德瓦拉萨穆德拉，穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克的军队又于1327年再度破城，但维拉·巴拉拉三世以蒂鲁万纳马莱为据点，使德干这个最后的印度教大国又苦撑了近三十年，最终于1343年在马杜赖战役中战死。他的领地随后并入诃里诃罗一世的版图，融入新生的毗奢耶那伽罗帝国。曷萨拉留下了贝卢尔、赫莱比杜和索门纳特普尔那些星形台基的滑石神庙，以及宫廷赞助下繁荣的卡纳达语与梵语文学，影响深远。

en: The Hsenwi dynasty was the saopha ruling house of Hsenwi, called Theinni by the Burmese and Mubang in Chinese records, the largest of the Shan states west of the Salween. Tai Yai chronicles derive the line from two brothers, Khun Lung and Khun Lai, who are said to have come down from heaven in the sixth century and been hailed as kings at Hsenwi; the predecessor polity of Sivirattha was traditionally founded before 650. The state entered Chinese records under the Yuan as the Mubang military district and under the Ming as a native pacification office, while its saophas balanced tributary ties between Ava and the Chinese frontier commands. In the early seventeenth century the Toungoo kings of Burma absorbed Hsenwi during the Ming-Burmese wars. During the Sino-Burmese war of 1765-1769 the Qing general Ming Rui seized Hsenwi in 1767 and made it his main supply base before marching on Ava.
zh: 兴威王朝是掸邦大邦兴威的诏法世家；兴威缅语称兴尼，中国史籍作木邦，位于萨尔温江以西，是萨尔温江西岸最大的掸族政权。掸族纪年把王室世系追溯到6世纪从天而降的两兄弟坤龙和坤莱，传说他们在兴威被当地人拥为王；其前身西维拉塔相传在650年以前已经立国。元代木邦内附，设木邦路军民总管府，明代改置木邦宣慰司，而历代诏法在阿瓦与中国边境政权之间权衡称臣。17世纪初的明缅战争中，缅甸东吁王朝吞并木邦。1765—1769年清缅战争期间，清将明瑞于1767年攻占兴威，以此为主要粮草基地，再向阿瓦进军。

en: The Hso, known in Chinese records as the Si family, were the ruling house of Möng Mao, the great Tai Shan state of the Nam Mao or Ruili river valley on the present Yunnan-Myanmar frontier; its rulers carried the Shan prefix Hso, written by the Chinese as the surname Si. The house was built by Hso Hkan Hpa, called Si Kefa (1294-1369), who seized power about 1335 and welded neighbouring Tai states including Hsenwi and Möng Mit into a regional power. Four Yuan expeditions sent against him between 1342 and 1348 failed, and in 1355 he accepted the Yuan title of Pingmian Pacification Commissioner; his armies pushed west to extract tribute from Assam and in 1364 sacked the Burmese kingdoms of Sagaing and Pinya, clearing the way for the rise of Ava. His successors kept Möng Mao independent through the early Ming: Si Lunfa was invested by the Ming after 1382 but repeatedly went to war with them, and after his death the court partitioned the kingdom into five tusi. A later ruler, Si Renfa, tried to rebuild the old domains from 1413, provoking the Luchuan-Pingmian campaigns of 1436 to 1449, in which the house was defeated and driven back to Möng Yang.
zh: 思氏是傣族掸人国家勐卯（汉籍称麓川）的统治家族，立国于今滇缅边境的瑞丽江（南卯河）河谷，历代君主名字中的掸语冠称在汉文里记作姓思。家族的缔造者思翰法（汉名思可法，1294—1369）约于1335年夺取麓川政权，征服木邦、孟密等邻近傣邦，将勐卯建成一方强权。元朝在1342—1348年间四次征讨均告失败，他于1355年接受元朝平缅宣慰使的头衔；其军队向西迫使阿洪姆王国称臣纳贡，又于1364年攻灭缅甸的实皆与彬牙两国，为后来阿瓦王国的兴起腾出了空间。他的子孙在明初继续保持独立：思伦发于1382年后受明朝册封，却屡启战端，他死后明朝将勐卯拆分为五个土司。后继的思任发自1413年起试图恢复旧疆，引发1436—1449年的麓川之役，思氏最终战败，退往孟养。

en: The Hurin Qusqu, or Lower Cusco, was the first royal dynasty of the Kingdom of Cusco and the senior half of the Inca diarchy, ruling the small city-state in the Cusco valley from its temple-palace of Inticancha. Its five rulers were Manco Capac, the legendary founder who led his ten ayllus into the valley around the start of the thirteenth century, followed by Sinchi Roca, Lloque Yupanqui, Mayta Capac and Capac Yupanqui. Over little more than a century they subdued or expelled the neighboring Huallas, Alcahuisas and other peoples, terraced the valley, and fought repeated wars with the powerful Ayarmaca confederacy. After Capac Yupanqui died around 1350, allegedly poisoned by his Ayarmaca wife, the rival Hanan Qusqu branch seized power under Inca Roca and killed the Hurin heir Quispe Yupanqui. The two halves then came to terms: the Hanan held secular and military rule as Sapa Inca, while the Hurin kept Inticancha, the royal treasures and the chief religious offices, including perhaps that of Willaq Umu.
zh: 乌林·库斯科在克丘亚语中意为下库斯科，是库斯科王国的第一个王族，也是印卡双头体制中的长支，以恩蒂坎查神庙宫苑为中心统治着库斯科河谷里的小城邦。它共有五位统治者：13世纪初率十氏族入据河谷的传奇始祖曼科·卡帕克，以及此后的辛奇·罗卡、略克·尤潘基、迈塔·卡帕克和卡帕克·尤潘基。百余年间，他们征服或驱逐了邻族瓦亚人、阿尔卡维萨人等，修筑梯田，并与强大的阿亚尔马卡联盟连年交战。约1350年卡帕克·尤潘基去世，据说他被出身阿亚尔马卡的妻子毒杀，敌对的哈南·库斯科一支随即在印卡·罗卡率领下夺取政权，处死乌林支的继承人基斯佩·尤潘基。两支后来达成妥协：哈南支以萨帕·印卡之尊执掌世俗与军政，乌林支则保留恩蒂坎查、王室财宝以及包括维利亚克·乌穆在内的主要宗教职位。

en: The House of Ibelin was a noble family of the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem, named after the castle of Ibelin, built by King Fulk in 1141 near the Arab town of Yibna and entrusted to the family's founder, Barisan. A knight who became constable of Jaffa and married the heiress of Ramla, Barisan was granted the castle for his loyalty during the revolt of Hugh of Jaffa in 1134. His youngest son Balian married the dowager queen Maria Comnena and held Nablus, but the family's mainland lordships, including Ibelin itself, were lost to Saladin in 1187. Balian's descendants then rose to the front rank of the crusader nobility: John, the Old Lord of Beirut, led opposition to Emperor Frederick II, and another John, count of Jaffa and Ascalon, served as regent of Jerusalem and compiled the Assizes of the High Court, the foremost legal text of the kingdom. As the mainland kingdom crumbled, the Ibelins settled in Cyprus, where for two centuries they married into the ruling Lusignan dynasty and filled the highest offices. With the fall of the Lusignan kingdom of Cyprus in the late fifteenth century the family lost its lands and vanished, its male line extinct.
zh: 德·伊贝林家族是十字军耶路撒冷王国的贵族世家，得名于伊贝林城堡——1141年国王富尔克在阿拉伯城镇伊布纳附近修建该堡，并把它托付给家族始祖巴里森。巴里森本是骑士，曾任雅法统帅，又娶拉姆拉女继承人；1134年雅法的于格叛乱时他效忠国王，因而受封这座城堡。他的幼子贝里昂娶太后玛利亚·科穆宁娜为妻，领有纳布卢斯，但包括伊贝林在内的大陆领地在1187年全部落入萨拉丁之手。贝里昂的后裔后来跻身十字军贵族的最高层：贝鲁特老领主约翰带头抵制皇帝腓特烈二世，另一位身兼雅法和阿斯卡隆伯爵的约翰曾任耶路撒冷摄政，并编纂了王国最重要的法律文献《耶路撒冷法令》。随着大陆王国节节失守，伊贝林家族迁居塞浦路斯，两百多年间与统治当地的吕西尼昂王朝联姻、出任要职。15世纪末吕西尼昂的塞浦路斯王国灭亡后，家族失去土地并销声匿迹，男系就此断绝。

en: The Ii were a Tōtōmi warrior house who claimed Fujiwara Hokke descent and held the Iinoya manor in that province for some five hundred years. A warrior called Ii Hachirō appears following Minamoto no Yoshitomo in the Hōgen War narrative, and the Azuma Kagami lists the Ii among the substantial gokenin of the Kamakura shogunate. In the Nanboku-chō wars the head Ii Yukinao, holding the title Ii no Suke, embraced the Southern Court: he welcomed the imperial prince Muneyoshi to Iinoya Castle and fought the Northern generals Kō no Moroyasu and Niki Yoshinaga until the family seat at Mitsutake fell in 1340, after which the house submitted to the Imagawa, shugo of Suruga. Imagawa service ended in blood when Ii Naomori fell at the Battle of Okehazama in 1560 and his heir Naochika was murdered by Imagawa Ujizane; the daughter Naotora then held the chieftaincy through the clan's years of collapse. Her adopted heir Ii Naomasa fled to Tokugawa Ieyasu in 1575, became one of his Four Heavenly Kings, received Minowa with a hundred and twenty thousand koku in 1590 and Sawayama with a hundred and eighty thousand after Sekigahara. His son built Hikone Castle in 1604, and the Ii rose to three hundred thousand koku as the premier fudai daimyō house, repeatedly filling the office of tairō throughout the Edo period.
zh: 井伊氏是远江国的武家，自称藤原北家后裔，在远江井伊谷庄园统治了约五百年。《保元物语》中已有追随源义朝的武士井八郎登场，《吾妻镜》也把井伊氏列为镰仓幕府的有力御家人。南北朝动乱时，当主井伊行直官称井伊介，投身南朝：他把皇族宗良亲王迎入井伊谷城加以保护，并与北朝的高师泰、仁木义长等连年交战，直到1340年本城三岳城陷落，家族才归降骏河守护今川氏。侍奉今川氏的结局颇为惨烈：井伊直盛1560年随今川义元战死于桶狭间，继嗣的直亲又被今川氏真诛杀；直盛之女直虎在一族凋零的远州错乱中接掌家督，苦苦支撑。她的养子井伊直政于1575年投奔德川家康，后来成为德川四天王之一，1590年受封上野箕轮十二万石，关原之战后又得到近江佐和山十八万石。直政之子于1604年修筑彦根城，井伊家最终升至三十万石，位居谱代大名之首，整个江户时代多次出任大老。

en: The Ijuin of Satsuma were the most numerous branch family of the Shimazu, claiming descent from the Ki lineage in its genealogies but historically founded when Toshitada, a son of the Shimazu house, received the stewardship of Ijuin in Hioki district; his son Hisakane was the first to use the Ijuin name. In the Nanboku-cho wars the fifth head Tadakuni first followed the Shimazu main house on the Northern Court side, then defected to the Southern Court and gathered the Shibuya clans such as the Iriki-in, together with the Hishikari, to fight the main family, which long recorded the Ijuin as rebels. The sixth head, Hisauji, repaired the bond by rejecting the overtures of the Kyushu deputy Imagawa Ryoshun and helping defeat him, restoring the family's influence, yet the revolts of Yorihisa and the blood feud pursued by Hirohisa, who killed Machida Takahisa at his own Ichiuji castle, brought a Shimazu siege and exile to Higo. A junior line then rose as hereditary chief retainers: Tadaakira, Tadakura and Tadamune served generation after generation as senior councillors, and Tadamune became the leading councillor of Shimazu Yoshihisa, campaigning across Kyushu. After the Shimazu submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi, Tadamune won an eighty-thousand-koku fief at Miyakonojo in Hyuga, but his power alarmed Shimazu Tadatsune, who had him killed; his son Tadazane rose at Miyakonojo in the Sho-nai revolt of 1599 and was likewise destroyed with his family. Other Ijuin lines continued as Satsuma samurai and produced several titled noblemen after the Meiji Restoration.
zh: 萨摩伊集院氏是岛津氏支流中人数最盛的一族，系图自称纪姓，实际始于岛津一族的俊忠获得萨摩日置郡伊集院地头职，其子久兼最早以伊集院为苗字。南北朝时期，第五代忠国起初随岛津宗家投靠北朝，后倒向南朝，纠合入来院氏等涩谷一族及菱刈氏与宗家连年交战，长期被岛津文书记作贼徒。到第六代久氏时，他拒绝九州探题今川了俊的拉拢、协助宗家击破今川军，伊集院氏重新获得发言权；但此后赖久之乱、以及熙久在一宇治城诱杀町田高久的仇杀事件，招致宗家围攻，熙久亡命肥后，本家一度没落。其庶流则以家臣身份崛起：忠朗、忠仓、忠栋三代连任家老，忠栋更成为岛津义久的笔头家老，转战九州各地。岛津降伏丰臣秀吉后，忠栋受封日向都之城八万石，却因权重遭岛津忠恒忌惮而被诛杀；其子忠真据都城起兵，即1599年的庄内之乱，和解后仍被忠恒灭族。其余伊集院支流继续以萨摩藩士身份存续，明治维新后有数家位列华族。

en: The Ikeda were a warrior clan of the Kawabe region in Settsu, whose ancestors served as estate stewards of the Ikeda estates in Settsu and Mino; around the Genpei War Minamoto no Yasumasa, brother of Minamoto no Yorimasa of the Seiwa Genji, married into the family, and the clan thereafter claimed descent from Minamoto no Yorimitsu. The Settsu line held Ikeda Castle and survived as prominent local lords by changing suzerains with the times, serving the Settsu Genji, Kusunoki, Ashikaga, Hosokawa, Miyoshi and finally the Oda, until the head Ikeda Tomomasa was swallowed by Araki Murashige's coup in the 1570s and his line ended as Tokugawa hatamoto. The clan's glory came from the Mino branch: Ikeda Tsuneoki, Oda Nobunaga's milk brother, won fiefs reaching 130,000 koku at Ōgaki in 1583 but fell with his eldest son at the Battle of Nagakute in 1584. His son Terumasa married a daughter of Tokugawa Ieyasu, fought on the Tokugawa side at Sekigahara in 1600 and was enfeoffed at Himeji with 520,000 koku, building Himeji Castle; his heirs became lords of Okayama, while a junior branch ruled Tottori in Inaba and Hōki, both houses lasting as daimyō into the nineteenth century.
zh: 池田氏是以摄津国川边一带为根基的武家，其先祖在摄津和美浓担任池田庄的庄官；源平合战前后，清和源氏源赖政之弟源泰政入赘池田家，此后一族自称源赖光后裔。摄津池田氏以池田城为居城，从平安到战国时代先后投靠摄津源氏、楠木氏、足利氏、细川氏、三好氏和织田氏，始终是摄津的有力国人，直到16世纪70年代当主池田知正被荒木村重以下克上夺去势力，江户时仅以旗本存续。真正让池田家扬名的是美浓一脉：池田恒兴是织田信长的乳兄弟，凭战功在1583年领有美浓大垣13万石，却在1584年小牧·长久手之战中与长子元助一同战死。其次子辉政迎娶德川家康之女督姬，1600年关原之战从属德川方，因功受封播磨姬路52万石并修筑姬路城；辉政的子孙后来移封冈山，另有分家领有因幡、伯耆的鸟取藩，两家皆作为大名延续至19世纪。

en: The Ilyas Shahi were the first independent Sunni Muslim dynasty of the Bengal Sultanate, founded by Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah, whose ancestors came from Sistan and held estates in Bengal from 1227. Ilyas Shah began as an officer under Izz al-Din Yahya, governor of Satgaon, the district where the house is found in 1337; when Yahya died in 1338 he seized Satgaon and declared himself independent of Delhi, and by 1342 he had conquered the rival Muslim states of Lakhnauti and Sonargaon, uniting Bengal into a single sultanate. His son Sikandar Shah (r. 1358-1390) raised the great Adina Masjid at Pandua in 1368, and Ghiyasuddin Azam Shah fostered trade and embassies with Ming China. The first line ended in 1414 when the Hindu landowner Raja Ganesha seized power, but in 1436 Nasiruddin Mahmud Shah, a descendant of Ilyas Shah, restored the dynasty, which then ruled from Gaur until 1487, when Sultan Jalaluddin Fatih Shah was murdered by his Habshi guard commander Shahzada Barbak and the house gave way to a succession of Abyssinian rulers.
zh: 伊利亚斯·沙希王朝是孟加拉苏丹国第一个独立的逊尼派穆斯林王朝，创立者为沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯·沙阿，其祖先来自锡斯坦，1227年起在孟加拉保有封地。伊利亚斯·沙阿早年在萨特冈总督伊兹丁·叶海亚麾下效力，萨特冈正是该家族在1337年所在的地区；1338年叶海亚去世后，他夺取萨特冈并宣布脱离德里独立，到1342年又征服拉克瑙提和索纳尔冈两个对立的穆斯林政权，把孟加拉统一为一个苏丹国。其子锡坎达尔·沙阿在位期间（1358—1390年）于1368年在潘杜阿修建了宏伟的阿迪纳清真寺，吉亚斯丁·阿扎姆·沙阿则鼓励贸易，并与中国明朝通使。第一王世系于1414年被印度教徒地主罗阇·伽内什夺权而中断，1436年伊利亚斯·沙阿的后裔纳西尔丁·马哈茂德·沙阿复辟，王朝以高尔为都延续到1487年，末代苏丹贾拉鲁丁·法提赫·沙阿被哈比什卫队指挥官沙赫扎达·巴尔巴克杀害，家族随后让位于一连串阿比西尼亚统治者。

en: The Imagawa were a prestigious branch of the Ashikaga family, themselves of Seiwa Genji stock. In the thirteenth century Kuniuji, a son of Kira Nagauji, received the Imagawa manor in Hazu District of Mikawa and took its name, and the house stood so high among Ashikaga kinsmen that a saying held that if the shogunal line failed the Kira would succeed, and if the Kira failed, the Imagawa. Fighting for Ashikaga Takauji in the Nanboku-chō wars, Norikuni was made Constable of Suruga and Totomi, and his descendants kept Suruga as their hereditary seat. His son Sadayo, better known as Ryoshun, was appointed Kyushu Deputy on the recommendation of the shogunal deputy Hosokawa Yoriyuki, to subdue the island for the shogunate and was also an admired linked-verse poet, though his growing power later drew Shogun Yoshimitsu's suspicion and cost him his offices. In the Sengoku decades Ujichika, secured in his inheritance by his uncle Ise Moritoki, the future Hojo Soun, conquered Totomi and issued the Imagawa Kana Mokuroku, one of the earliest warrior house laws. His son Yoshimoto won the succession in the Hanakura feud of 1536, built the triple alliance of the Takeda, Hojo and Imagawa, and ruled Suruga, Totomi and Mikawa as the greatest lord of the Tokaido, until his surprise defeat and death at Okehazama against Oda Nobunaga in 1560. Under his heir Ujizane the domain collapsed within a decade, partitioned by the Takeda and Tokugawa; later Imagawa served the Tokugawa shoguns as ceremonial masters.
zh: 今川氏是清和源氏足利一门的名门。13世纪，吉良长氏之子国氏受封三河国幡豆郡今川庄，便以今川为姓；其家格之高，甚至有“将军家绝嗣则吉良继之，吉良绝嗣则今川继之”的说法。南北朝战乱中，今川范国追随足利尊氏，被任命为骏河、远江两国守护，其嫡流从此世袭骏河守护。范国之子贞世（法号了俊）受管领细川赖之推举出任九州探题，平定了南朝势力强盛的九州，同时也是著名的连歌师；但他声势过大，后来招致足利义满的猜忌而被罢免。战国时代，氏亲在舅父伊势盛时（即后来的北条早云）扶助下赢得家督之争，攻占远江，并颁布分国法《今川假名目录》，完成向战国大名的转型。1536年花仓之乱后义元继位，他与武田、后北条结成甲相骏三国同盟，领有骏河、远江、三河三国，成为东海道最强大的大名，却在1560年的桶狭间之战中遭织田信长奇袭败死。继承人氏真治下，领国不出十年便被武田与德川瓜分蚕食；今川一族后来转而侍奉德川幕府，担任执掌礼仪的高家。

en: The İnanç family, known in Turkish as the İnançoğulları and also as the Beylik of Lâdik after Laodicea on the Lycus, ruled a small Turkmen principality around Denizli in south-western Anatolia from 1261 to 1368. Its founder Mehmed Bey, a frontier chief of Turkmen clans fleeing the Mongol advance, rebelled against the Seljuk sultan of Rûm in 1261 and placed himself under the Ilkhan Hulagu, only to be captured and killed the following year. His son-in-law Ali Bey then attached the beylik to the Seljuks, but was imprisoned after backing the failed Cimri revolt of 1277, whereupon Lâdik fell under the control of the Sahib Ata family. Around 1310 the Germiyanid ruler Yakup I seized Lâdik and restored Ali's son İnanç Bey, from whom the dynasty takes its name. His successors Murad Arslan and Ishak Bey kept up a much-reduced principality until the Germiyanids annexed it outright in 1368.
zh: 亦难赤家族在土耳其语中称亦难赤奥乌拉勒，又称拉迪克贝伊国，名字源自吕卡努斯河畔的老底嘉，1261年至1368年间在安纳托利亚西南部的代尼兹利一带统治一个小型土库曼公国。开国者穆罕默德贝伊是躲避蒙古兵锋西迁的土库曼部落边疆首领，1261年起兵反抗鲁姆塞尔柱苏丹，转而依附伊儿汗旭烈兀，次年即被擒杀。其女婿阿里贝伊继位后重新归附塞尔柱人，却因支持1277年失败的吉姆里事变而下狱，拉迪克从此落入沙希布·阿塔家族之手。约1310年，格尔米扬君主雅各布一世夺取拉迪克，扶立阿里贝伊之子亦难赤贝伊复位，家族也由他得名；其后的穆拉德·阿尔斯兰和伊沙克贝伊勉强维持着版图大缩的公国，最终于1368年被格尔米扬彻底吞并。

en: The Inawashiro were a warrior house of the Aizu basin in Mutsu province, seated at Inawashiro on the lake of the same name in Yama district. They sprang from the Sawara branch of the Miura clan: around the mid-thirteenth century Sawara Tsunetsura, elder brother of the Ashina founder Mitsumori, made Inawashiro his home and took the place as his family name, so the house stood as a junior but strongly independent offshoot of the Ashina. Through the Muromachi and Sengoku ages it repeatedly warred with its Ashina overlords, and when the lord Tsunemoto died without an heir the family had to adopt Morikiyo from the Ashina house. His son Morikuni, after retiring and then seizing the headship back, opened secret talks with Date Masamune and defected to him as the Ashina crumbled, fighting in the decisive Battle of Suriagehara in 1589, while his own disinherited son Moritane stayed loyal to the Ashina. After Masamune's reshuffle of fiefs following the Odawara campaign, the Inawashiro entered Date service and remained Sendai retainers under the Tokugawa.
zh: 猪苗代氏是以陆奥国耶麻郡猪苗代（同名湖畔，会津盆地一带）为本贯的武家，出自桓武平氏三浦氏的佐原分流，是芦名氏的支流。13世纪中叶，佐原盛连长子、芦名氏之祖光盛的兄长经连定居猪苗代并以地名为苗字，因此该族虽为芦名分家，独立倾向却很强，从室町到战国屡次与本家交战。当主经元无嗣，只得从芦名氏迎立盛清为养子。盛清之子盛国隐居后又夺回家督，他暗中联络伊达政宗，眼见芦名氏衰落便彻底倒向政宗，在1589年决定性的摺上原之战中效力；而被废嫡的儿子盛胤反而站在芦名一方。小田原征伐后政宗调整封地图，猪苗代氏的领地也被更换，此后他们出仕伊达氏，在江户时代作为仙台藩士存续。

en: The Indravarman line gathers the last Varman kings of Angkor, the final Khmer rulers named in the temple inscriptions. It begins with Indravarman II, the Buddhist son of Jayavarman VII, who ruled until 1243 and saw Champa break away while the new Sukhothai Kingdom seized western provinces. Jayavarman VIII, who reigned from 1243 to 1295, turned back to Shaivism, defaced Buddhist images and converted the Bayon into a temple of Shiva; in 1283 he bought peace from a Mongol invasion by paying tribute. His son-in-law Indravarman III seized the throne in 1295, made Theravada Buddhism the state religion, and received the Chinese envoy Zhou Daguan at Angkor between 1296 and 1297, whose report records a country devastated by recent Siamese wars. Indrajayavarman then ruled from 1308 to 1327, and Jayavarman IX, a Shivaite like his father, from 1327 to 1336. With Jayavarman IX the Sanskrit inscriptions fall silent: he is the last Angkor king documented on the monuments, and the later Cambodian chronicles take up the story with a new, legendary line.
zh: 因陀罗跋摩一系汇集了吴哥最后的几位跋摩王，也就是寺庙碑铭中能见到的末代高棉王统。首位是阇耶跋摩七世的佛教徒儿子因陀罗跋摩二世，他在位至1243年，任内占婆脱离，新兴的素可泰王国夺取了西部省份。1243至1295年在位的阇耶跋摩八世改宗湿婆派，毁坏佛像，把巴戎寺改成湿婆神庙；1283年蒙古大军压境，他以纳贡换取和平。1295年，他的女婿因陀罗跋摩三世夺取王位，将上座部佛教定为国教；1296至1297年，中国使臣周达观在吴哥受到他接见，其记载描述了这个刚遭暹罗战争重创的国家。此后因陀罗阇耶跋摩于1308至1327年在位，与其父一样信奉湿婆的阇耶跋摩九世于1327至1336年在位。阇耶跋摩九世之后，梵文碑铭就此沉寂——他是碑铭所载的最后一位吴哥国王，再往后的史事只能由柬埔寨王家编年史中一条新的传说王统接续。

en: The Injuids were an Iranian dynasty that ruled Fars from Shiraz and, at their height, Isfahan in the fourteenth century. Their name came from the injü, the Mongol term for the royal estates: in 1304 the Ilkhan Öljeitü entrusted Sharaf al-Din Mahmud Shah, who claimed descent from the eleventh-century Herat mystic Abd-Allah Ansari, with the administration of the crown lands in Fars. The family grew into virtual governors of the province, and after the death of the Ilkhan Abu Sa'id in 1335 it made itself independent amid the breakup of the Ilkhanate. Sharaf al-Din's sons fought one another for Shiraz until Jamal al-Din Abu Ishaq seized the city in 1343. His long rivalry with the Muzaffarids of Yazd ended in disaster: their ruler Mubariz al-Din Muhammad took Shiraz in 1353 and captured Isfahan in 1357, when Abu Ishaq was executed and the Injuid lands passed to the Muzaffarids, who held them until Timur's conquest forty years later. In Shiraz the dynasty commissioned the Khuda Khane, the Qur'an repository inside the Atigh Jame' Mosque, in 1351.
zh: 因朱王朝是14世纪以设拉子为中心统治法尔斯、鼎盛时还领有伊斯法罕的伊朗人王朝。其名来自蒙古语对王室地产的称呼“因朱”：1304年，伊儿汗完者都把法尔斯王室领地的管理权交给谢拉夫丁·马哈茂德沙，此人自称是11世纪赫拉特神秘主义者阿卜杜拉·安萨里的后裔。该家族逐渐成为法尔斯的实际统治者，1335年伊儿汗不赛因死后，伊儿汗国解体，因朱家遂自立。马哈茂德沙诸子为争夺设拉子互相攻杀，最终贾马勒丁·阿布·伊沙克于1343年夺取该城。他与亚兹德的莫扎法尔王朝长期争霸，结局悲惨：莫扎法尔君主穆巴里兹丁·穆罕默德于1353年攻占设拉子，1357年又拿下伊斯法罕，阿布·伊沙克被处死，因朱领地全部落入莫扎法尔王朝之手，直到约四十年后帖木儿征服此地。1351年，该王朝还在设拉子的阿蒂克聚礼清真寺内修建了存放《古兰经》的胡达哈内经阁。

en: The Isa were a warrior family of Isa District in Hitachi Province, now around Chikusei in Ibaraki, and the kin from whom the Date clan sprang. In 1189 the four sons of the local lord Hitachi Nensei followed Minamoto no Yoritomo on his Ōshū campaign, and the eldest, Isa no Tamemune, won distinction at the Battle of Ishinazaka. Their father was rewarded with the Date and Shinobu districts in Mutsu and took the name Date, while Tamemune kept the old estate in Hitachi and called himself Isa. Tamemune is said to have drowned fighting for the Kamakura shogunate in the Uji River during the Jōkyū War of 1221. When the war of the Northern and Southern Courts began, the Isa sided with the Southern Court: Isa Yukisuke followed Kitabatake Akiie and then held Isa Castle in alliance with the Oda, Seki and Taihō garrisons until it fell in 1343, after which the house lost its lands and disappeared as a power, as the Date lost their foothold in Hitachi, though families bearing the name later served the Yūki of Shimōsa.
zh: 伊佐氏是居住在常陆国伊佐郡（今茨城县筑西市一带）的武家，也是伊达氏的同族本源。1189年，当地领主常陆念西的四个儿子跟随源赖朝参加奥州合战，长子伊佐为宗在石那坂之战中立下战功。念西因此受封陆奥的伊达郡与信夫郡，自称伊达氏，而为宗留在本领伊佐郡，称伊佐氏。1221年承久之乱中，为宗随北条泰时讨伐后鸟羽上皇一方，相传在宇治川溺亡。南北朝对立开始后，伊佐行资投奔南朝，追随北畠显家，并与小田城、关城、大宝城互为犄角据守伊佐城；1343年城池陷落，伊佐氏就此没落，伊达氏也失去了在常陆的势力。到战国时代，下总结城氏的家臣中仍可见伊佐姓之人。

en: The Ise were a bureaucratic samurai house who claimed descent from the Kanmu Taira line of Ise, though one theory traces their earlier ancestors to the Nakatomi-affiliated Ise district lords rooted in Suzuka district of Ise Province. At the end of the Kamakura period the head Taira no Toshitsugu took the name Ise after his appointment as governor of Ise, and by 1330 Ise Munetsugu was already serving the Ashikaga as deputy governor of Kazusa. In 1379 Ise Sadatsugu was made shitsuji, or chief administrator, of the Muromachi shogunate's Mandokoro, an office his descendants inherited while using the character sada in their names. Ise Sadachika raised the eighth shōgun Ashikaga Yoshimasa and dominated shogunal politics until his fall in the Bunshō coup of 1466, and his recall during the Ōnin War drove Ashikaga Yoshimi into the western camp and helped prolong the fighting. Later heads served the shrinking shogunate under the Miyoshi, until Ise Sadataka was killed in Kyoto in 1562 and Ise Sadaoki, a yoriki under Akechi Mitsuhide, died at Yamazaki in 1582 after joining the Honnō-ji attack on Oda Nobutada. A branch, the Bitchū Ise, produced Ise Moritoki, better known as Hōjō Sōun, founder of the Later Hōjō. In the Edo period the main line served as hatamoto and became the authoritative house of the Ise school of warrior etiquette under Ise Sadatake.
zh: 伊势氏是执掌实务的武家，自称出自桓武平氏的伊势平氏一脉，另有研究认为其先祖是以伊势国铃鹿郡为根基的中臣朝臣伊势国造一族。镰仓末期，当主平俊继受任伊势守后始称伊势氏，至迟在1330年，伊势宗继已以足利氏上总国守护代的身份见诸记载。1379年，伊势贞继出任室町幕府政所执事，此后该职由其家族世袭，子孙通字为‘贞’。伊势贞亲曾担任第八代将军足利义政的养育方，作为侧近左右幕政，1466年在文正之变中失脚，应仁之乱爆发后又被召回，他的复职直接导致足利义视出奔西军、战乱长期化。此后伊势氏在不断收缩的幕府中继续任职，1562年伊势贞孝在京都船冈山战死；伊势贞兴成为明智光秀的与力，参与1582年本能寺之变、攻杀织田信忠，最终在山崎之战中败死。其庶流备中伊势氏出了伊势盛时，即后来的北条早云，为后北条氏之祖。江户时代，宗家以旗本身份侍奉德川幕府，并由伊势贞丈集其大成，成为武家伊势礼法与有职故实的权威之家。

en: The lords of Isenburg took their name from the castle of Isenburg in the Westerwald, built around 1100 by the brothers Rembold and Gerlach on the Sayn and Iserbach. As one of the old free noble families of the Middle Rhine, the house split in 1137 into the Isenburg and Limburg-Covern lines, and thereafter into many branches, among them Braunsberg, Grenzau, Kleberg and Wied. Around 1300 Ludwig of Isenburg married the heiress of Buedingen in the Wetterau, and by 1376 his descendants had made good that inheritance, shifting the family's centre of gravity to Upper Isenburg; they became imperial counts in 1442 and also held the burgraviate of Gelnhausen. The Lower Isenburg lines along the Rhine died out one by one, the Grenzau branch last in 1664, while in Hesse the Buedingen line subdivided into Birstein, Offenbach, Waechtersbach and Meerholz. In 1744 the Birstein line was raised to princely rank, and in 1806 the Confederation of the Rhine united all the Isenburg lands into a single Principality of Isenburg with its residences at Offenbach and Birstein. The principality was mediatized after 1815 and divided between Hesse-Darmstadt and Hesse-Kassel in 1816.
zh: 伊森堡家族得名于韦斯特瓦尔德的伊森堡城堡，约1100年由伦博尔德与格拉赫兄弟在赛恩河和伊瑟巴赫河畔修建。作为中莱茵古老的自由贵族世家，家族于1137年分为伊森堡与林堡—科芬两支，此后又衍生布劳恩斯贝格、格伦藻、克莱贝格、维德等众多支系。约1300年，伊森堡的路德维希娶韦特劳地区比丁根的女继承人为妻，到1376年其后代完全取得这份遗产，家族重心随之转到上伊森堡；1442年他们成为帝国伯爵，还兼任盖尔恩豪森的城堡伯爵。莱茵河畔的下伊森堡各支相继绝嗣，最后的格伦藻支于1664年断绝；黑森境内的比丁根支则分出比尔施泰因、奥芬巴赫、韦希特斯巴赫和梅尔霍尔茨等系。1744年比尔施泰因支升为诸侯，1806年莱茵邦联将伊森堡诸系领地合并为统一的伊森堡亲王国，驻跸奥芬巴赫和比尔施泰因。1815年后亲王国被陪臣化，1816年由黑森—达姆施塔特和黑森—卡塞尔瓜分。

en: The Ishidō, also written with the characters for stone hall, were a junior branch of the Ashikaga family of Shimotsuke. Their founder Yorishige, a grandson of Ashikaga Yasuuji who was adopted as Yasuuji's own son, took the name Ishidō in the mid-thirteenth century, probably from an estate named for a stone monument. The clan's brief prominence came in the Nanboku-chō wars. Yorishige's son Yoshifusa, already Constable of Suruga and Izu, was named supreme commander of Ōshū in 1337 to secure the far north for the new Ashikaga shogunate. Recalled in 1345, he quarrelled with Shogun Takauji and withdrew to Kamakura to serve Takauji's brother Tadayoshi, becoming Constable of Izu and Kai; in the Kannō Disturbance he and his son Yorifusa fought on Tadayoshi's side, and Yorifusa afterwards held out with the Southern Court and Ashikaga Tadafuyu until he surrendered to Ashikaga Yoshiakira in 1364 and took holy vows. Another son, Yoshimoto, styled himself Ōshū Kanrei and briefly seized the provincial capital of Taga in 1354 before Shiba Iekane drove him out, and the family's fortunes declined. A later kinsman still appears in shogunal service during the Ōei War of 1399, after which the Ishidō vanish from the records, the only Ashikaga kinsmen to leave no trace in Muromachi sources.
zh: 石塔氏（亦写作石堂氏）是下野足利氏的旁支。始祖赖茂是足利泰氏之孙，被泰氏收为养子，13世纪中叶以“石塔”为姓，其地名大概取自当地的石造纪念物。该族短暂的活跃期在南北朝战乱：赖茂之子义房原任骏河、伊豆两国守护，1337年被任命为奥州总大将，替新生的足利幕府镇抚北方；1345年他被解任上洛，与将军尊氏不和，便前往镰仓投奔尊氏之弟直义，又出任伊豆、甲斐守护。观应之乱中，义房与次子赖房加入直义一方，乱后赖房继续依附南朝和足利直冬抵抗，直到1364年才向足利义诠投降并出家。三子义基则自1354年起自称奥州管领，一度攻占国府多贺城，很快被斯波家兼夺回，家运由此走低。1399年应永之乱时，族中仍有人担任将军义满的马回护卫，但此后石塔氏便从史料中消失——在足利一门诸家中，唯独它在室町幕府的记录里再无踪迹可寻。

en: The Mutsu Ishikawa, so called to distinguish them from other Ishikawa houses, were a Seiwa Genji clan of the Yamato Genji line, founded when Minamoto no Arimitsu, who took command after his father Yorito fell at Kuriyagawa in the Earlier Nine Years' War of the 1050s and 1060s, was rewarded in 1063 with Ishikawa district, carved out of Shirakawa in southern Mutsu; he built Miashi castle and took the place name as his own. The clan married into the Oshu Fujiwara of Hiraizumi, though one branch backed the Fujiwara against Minamoto no Yoritomo in 1189 and paid with its lord's life, and under the Kamakura shogunate its men appear among the Hojo regents' own housemen. In 1333 an Ishikawa lord joined Nitta Yoshisada at Inamuragasaki to overthrow the shogunate, and through the Muromachi age the house navigated the rival courts and Kamakura kubo politics of Oshu, fighting in the Yuki war of 1440. Long independent lords of a single district, they were drawn into the Date orbit in the Sengoku age: in 1563 Harumitsu adopted a son of Date Harumune, the future Akimitsu. In 1590 Akimitsu dared not join Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign for fear of Date Masamune, and the Oshu settlement attainted him and gave his lands to Gamo Ujisato; his old retainer Mizoi Yoshinobu burned the castle and took his own life. The Ishikawa then entered Date service, were enfeoffed at Kakuda with twelve thousand koku in 1598 and rose to head the Date ichimon houses, their holding growing to twenty-one thousand koku under the Tokugawa.
zh: 陆奥石川氏为与其他石川氏区分而得名，属清和源氏中的大和源氏一脉。11世纪50至60年代的前九年之役中，源有光随父赖远出征陆奥，赖远战死后由他统军，1063年以军功受封从白河郡分出的石川郡，筑三芦城居住并以地名为苗字，是为该族之始。他们与平泉的奥州藤原氏通婚，但1189年奥州合战时有族人站在藤原一方对抗源赖朝，当主因此被杀；镰仓时代其族人还以执权北条氏御内人的身份活动。1333年，石川义光加入新田义贞的稻村崎之战，参与推翻幕府，室町时期又在奥州各公方与探题之间周旋，1440年还参加了结城合战。作为长期自立的一郡之主，该族在战国被卷入伊达氏的轨道：1563年晴光迎伊达晴宗之子昭光为养子并让出家督。1590年昭光因畏惧伊达政宗而未参阵小田原，奥州仕置中被改易，领地划给蒲生氏乡；老臣沟井义信力主向丰臣秀吉表明忠心不成，独自焚城自尽。石川氏此后出仕伊达，1598年受封伊具郡角田一万二千石，位列伊达家一门首席，江户时代知行增至二万一千石。

en: The Isshiki were a warrior house of the Seiwa-Genji and a branch of the Ashikaga clan. Their founder Isshiki Kōshin, a son of Ashikaga Yasuuji, took the family name from Isshiki in the Kira manor of Mikawa Province, in present-day Aichi Prefecture, where the clan held its domain from the late thirteenth century. As housemen of the Kamakura shogunate they served in the east, and in 1336 Isshiki Yoriyuki followed Ashikaga Takauji on his campaign to Kyushu, falling the next year at the Battle of Inuzukahara against the Southern Court armies of the Kikuchi and Aso. Under the Muromachi shogunate the Isshiki became the foremost of the four shiki houses eligible to head the Samurai-dokoro, and inherited the military governorships of Wakasa, Mikawa and Tango provinces. They survived into the Sengoku period as daimyō of Tango, but the invasions of Hosokawa Fujitaka and his son Tadaoki in the 1570s and early 1580s overran the province and ended the main line's rule.
zh: 一色氏是出自清和源氏的武士家族，属于足利氏一门。始祖一色公深为足利泰氏之子，以三河国吉良庄的一色（今爱知县西尾市一带）为本贯并取此苗字，13世纪末起在当地建有领地。一色家作为御家人侍奉镰仓幕府，1336年一色赖行跟随足利尊氏转战九州，翌年在犬冢原之战中与菊池、阿苏等南朝方军队作战时战死。室町幕府时期，一色家位列“四职”笔头，获得出任侍所长官的资格，并世袭若狭、三河、丹后等国的守护职。进入战国时代后，他们以丹后大名的身份存续，但在16世纪70至80年代细川藤孝、忠兴父子的侵攻下，丹后被吞并，一色家嫡系的统治就此终结。

en: The Itō were a branch of the Kudō clan, itself of the Southern House of the Fujiwara, who took their name from the Itō Manor in Tagata district of Izu Province, their home from the late Heian period. In the 1170s the family was caught in the quarrel that produced the Soga brothers' revenge: Kudō Suketsune's men killed Kawazu Sukeyasu in 1176, and Suketsune, whom Minamoto no Yoritomo had confirmed in the Itō Manor, was himself cut down by the Soga brothers in 1193. Another head, Itō Sukechika, had guarded Yoritomo during his Izu exile but fell out with him when Yoritomo took up with his daughter Yae, and opposed his rising of 1180, and after capture he took his own life. Suketsune's son Suketoki received a steward post in distant Hyūga, and in 1335 Itō Sukemochi moved there at Ashikaga Takauji's command, founding the Hyūga Itō, who fought for the Northern Court and then spent centuries contesting the province with the Shimazu. The eleventh head Yoshisuke held forty-eight castles around Sadowara at his peak, but defeat by Shimazu Yoshihiro at Kizaki in 1572 and a Shimazu invasion in 1577 drove the clan out. His son Suketaka entered Toyotomi Hideyoshi's service, guided the Kyūshū campaign of 1587 and recovered the family lands, which became the 50,000-koku Obi Domain; the Itō ruled Obi, confirmed by the Tokugawa after Sekigahara, through the Edo period, while a cadet branch held Okada Domain in Bitchū from 1615.
zh: 伊东氏是藤原南家工藤氏的支族，平安末期起以伊豆国田方郡的伊东庄（在今天的静冈县伊东市）为本贯，遂以伊东为姓，通字为‘祐’。12世纪70年代，一族卷入曾我兄弟仇讨的前因：工藤祐经派人于1176年射杀河津祐泰，祐经虽被源赖朝安堵了伊东庄，却在1193年被祐泰的遗孤曾我兄弟讨杀。当主伊东祐亲曾负责监视流放伊豆的源赖朝，却因赖朝与其女八重姬私通而交恶，1180年赖朝举兵后祐亲兵败被俘，自尽而亡。祐经之子伊东祐时获任遥远的日向国地头，1335年，伊东祐持奉足利尊氏之命南下日向，是为日向伊东氏之祖；他们站在北朝一方作战，此后数百年与守护岛津氏反复抗争。第十一代当主义佑以佐土原城为中心坐拥四十八座支城，达到鼎盛，却在1572年木崎原之战中被岛津义弘击败，1577年全族被逐出日向。义祐之子祐兵辗转投入丰臣秀吉麾下，在1587年九州平定中担任向导，得以收复旧领，建立五万石的饫肥藩；关原之战后其领地得到德川家安堵，伊东氏统治饫肥直至幕末，另有庶流于1615年领有备中国冈田藩。

en: Ah Itzá, the people of Itzá, denotes the royal lineage of the Itza Maya, whose kings all bore the name or title Kan Ekʼ, meaning serpent star. The Itza traced descent from the Chanes of the Chontal region and migrated through Bacalar into northern Yucatán in the tenth century, when they were associated with the great city of Chichen Itza; the Kan Ekʼ name itself is recorded much earlier, on an eighth-century stela at Yaxchilan and on Seibal monuments of 849. Driven from Mayapan by the rival Xiu Maya around 1441 to 1446, the Itza withdrew south to Lake Petén Itzá and built their island capital Nojpetén, divided into four lineage quarters. There the Aj Kan Ekʼ ruled an independent kingdom while the rest of Maya lands fell to the Spanish: Hernán Cortés crossed the lake and met the Kan Ekʼ in 1525, and Franciscan missions were expelled in the early seventeenth century. The line ended only in 1697, when Spanish forces stormed Nojpetén and carried the last Kan Ekʼ prisoner to Guatemala.
zh: 阿·伊察意为“伊察人”，指伊察玛雅的王室世系；历代国王都使用“卡内克”这一名号，意为“蛇星”。伊察人自称是琼塔尔地区查内斯人的后裔，10世纪经巴卡拉尔迁入尤卡坦北部，与名城奇琴伊察关系密切；而“卡内克”之名出现得更早，8世纪亚克斯奇兰的石碑和849年塞瓦尔的碑铭中已有记载。约1441至1446年，伊察人被敌对的休人逐出玛雅潘，南撤至佩滕伊察湖，在岛上建起都城诺赫佩滕，城邑按血缘分为四个区。阿赫·卡内克在此维持着独立王国，而玛雅其余土地相继落入西班牙人之手：1525年科尔特斯渡过湖泊会见卡内克，17世纪初方济各会的传教活动又被驱逐。直到1697年，西班牙军队攻陷诺赫佩滕，末代卡内克被押往危地马拉，这一王统才告终结。

en: The Jadejas are a Rajput clan of Kutch and Saurashtra in Gujarat, descended from the Samma pastoral people of Sindh. Written sources place their emergence in the fourteenth century, when Hindu branches of the Sammas, whose chiefs bore the title Jam, settled in Kutch rather than accept Islam; marriages with Sodha Rajput women and the adoption of Rajput customs later secured their Rajput standing. By the middle of the fourteenth century Jadeja chiefs held lands across Kutch. The clan's fortunes rose under Khengarji I, whose sister married Sultan Mahmud Begada of Gujarat: the sultan raised him to the title Rao and granted him Morvi in 1538, and in 1540 Khengarji founded the state of Kutch, binding twelve related Jadeja chieftain families to him. Other Jadeja branches came to rule Nawanagar, Rajkot, Gondal and Dhrol, while the Kutch line remained on its throne into the nineteenth century.
zh: 阇提奢是古吉拉特卡奇和萨乌拉施特拉一带的拉杰普特氏族，源自信德的萨姆玛游牧族群。有文字可考的记载把该氏族的出现定在14世纪：当时萨姆玛人的一支印度教分支不愿改宗伊斯兰教，迁居卡奇，其首领沿用贾姆头衔；他们通过与索达拉杰普特家族联姻、仿效拉杰普特习俗，逐渐取得拉杰普特身份。到14世纪中叶，阇提奢首领已在卡奇广占领地。16世纪，肯加吉一世之妹嫁给古吉拉特苏丹马哈茂德·贝加达，苏丹于1538年封他为拉奥并赐地莫尔维；1540年肯加吉建立卡奇邦，把十二个与他同族的阇提奢首领家族团结在麾下。阇提奢的其他支系后来统治纳瓦纳加尔、拉杰果德、贡达尔和德罗尔，卡奇一脉的王位则延续到19世纪。

en: The Jadon, or Jadaun, are a Rajput clan of the Lunar lineage, claiming the Yaduvanshi descent that traces them to the god Krishna. Tradition holds that the clan once ruled at Mathura, the Krishna country, before Muslim pressure pushed it west into Rajasthan. A Jadon raja, Vijay Pal, came from Mathura and built the fort of Bayana in 1040, and his successor Timan Pal, ruling from 1093 to 1159, broadened the chiefship over the country from Alwar and Bharatpur to Gwalior and Agra. In 1348 Raja Arjun Pal Dev founded a new capital at Kalyanpuri, the later Karauli, which became the permanent seat of the clan. Fortune turned under the sultans of Malwa: Mahmud Khalji stormed Karauli in 1454, and the rajas withdrew to the small stronghold of Untagarh and ruled a shrunken domain until Raja Gopaldas recovered the ancestral capital with the favour of the Mughal emperor Akbar. Thereafter the Jadons served the Mughals as local chiefs and in 1817 entered a subsidiary alliance with the East India Company, continuing as the princes of Karauli through the early nineteenth century.
zh: 阇豆那（又译贾东）是属月亮世系的拉杰普特部族，自称雅杜万什后裔，可追溯到神祇黑天。相传该族曾统治黑天故里马图拉，后在穆斯林势力压力下西迁拉贾斯坦。阇豆那罗阇维杰·帕尔从马图拉出走，于1040年修筑巴亚纳堡；继任者蒂曼·帕尔（1093—1159年在位）把酋长政权扩张到从阿尔瓦尔、珀勒德布尔到瓜廖尔、阿格拉的广大地区。1348年罗阇阿周那·帕尔·德夫在格扬普里建立新都，即后来的格劳利，此地从此成为该族的固定根基。时运在马尔瓦苏丹治下逆转：马哈茂德·卡尔吉于1454年攻陷格劳利，罗阇们退守温塔加尔小堡，统治着大为缩小的领地，直到罗阇戈帕尔达斯借莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴的恩宠收复旧都。此后阇豆那人以地方首领身份效力莫卧儿，又于1817年与英国东印度公司签订附属同盟，在19世纪初继续以格劳利王公的身份存续。

en: The Jalayirids were a dynasty of the Mongol Jalayir tribe, originally from the Onon River in Mongolia, whose ancestors came west with Hulagu's armies and by the fourteenth century had become largely Turkicized. As the Ilkhanate disintegrated after the death of Abu Sa'id in 1335, the emir Hasan Buzurg made himself master of Baghdad and the old Ilkhanid lands of Iraq and western Iran, ruling at first through puppet Chinggisid khans before taking open power. Under his son Shaykh Uways, who reigned from 1356 to 1374 and held both Baghdad and Tabriz, the sultanate reached its peak, controlling Iraq, Azerbaijan and parts of Iran, while its court became a noted centre of Persianate letters and book painting that shaped later Persian art. After Uways the dynasty weakened amid succession disputes, and from the 1380s it was battered first by Timur's campaigns and then by the rising Qara Qoyunlu. A short-lived restoration in southern Iraq and Khuzistan after Timur's death in 1405 could not save it, and the Qara Qoyunlu extinguished the last Jalayirid rulers in 1432.
zh: 札剌亦儿王朝出自蒙古鄂嫩河流域的札剌亦儿部，其先祖随旭烈兀的大军西来，到14世纪时已高度突厥化。1335年伊儿汗不赛因死后伊儿汗国瓦解，埃米尔哈桑·布祖格占据巴格达以及伊儿汗国在伊拉克和伊朗西部的旧地，先以成吉思汗后裔的傀儡汗为号，继而公开掌权。其子谢赫·乌韦斯在位期间（1356—1374）同时据有巴格达和大不里士，王朝达到鼎盛，版图覆盖伊拉克、阿塞拜疆和伊朗部分地区，宫廷也成为波斯文学与细密画的著名中心，深刻影响了后来的波斯艺术。乌韦斯死后，王朝在继承纷争中日趋衰弱，14世纪80年代起先遭帖木儿征伐重创，又受到崛起的黑羊王朝不断打击。1405年帖木儿死后，札剌亦儿人曾在伊拉克南部和胡齐斯坦短暂复国，却终究无力回天，末代势力于1432年被黑羊王朝攻灭。

en: The Jaqeli were an old Georgian princely house, an offshoot of the Chorchaneli, whose name comes from their castle of Jaqi on the Jaqis-tsqali river and whose estates lay around Akhaltsikhe. The line that ruled Samtskhe began with Ivane-Qvarqvare, enfeoffed by Queen Tamar, and under Sargis I the province seceded from Georgia in 1266 and placed itself directly under the Mongol Ilkhanate; Sargis had saved Hulagu's life in battle against the Golden Horde. The family seat was at Sapara, and Beka Jaqeli's daughter Natela married King Demetrius II of Georgia and raised the future King George V at the Jaqeli court. In 1334 George V brought Samtskhe back under the crown and granted the Jaqelis the hereditary title of atabeg, so their state became known as Samtskhe-Saatabago. The principality survived Timur's invasions between 1386 and 1403 and repeated Turkmen sacks of Akhaltsikhe, and Qvarqvare II defeated King George VIII near Lake Paravani in 1465 and broke away from Georgia for good. In 1535 King Bagrat III of Imereti captured Qvarqvare III at Murjakheti and annexed the principality, but after the Ottoman victory at Sokhoista in 1545 Samtskhe became an Ottoman vassal. From 1578 the Jaqeli atabegs converted to Islam and ruled as hereditary pashas of Akhaltsikhe, in the Childir eyalet, until the Russian conquest of 1829; a cadet branch entered Russian service as the Atabekov-Kvabliansky.
zh: 亚克力是古老的格鲁吉亚王公世家，出自乔尔恰内利家族，族名得自贾基斯茨卡利河畔的贾基城堡，领地在阿哈尔齐赫一带。统治萨姆茨赫的支系始于受塔玛尔女王封赐的伊万涅‑克瓦尔克瓦雷；萨尔吉斯一世在位时，该省于1266年脱离格鲁吉亚，直接臣属于蒙古伊儿汗国——萨尔吉斯曾在与金帐汗国的战斗中救过旭烈兀的性命。家族驻地在萨帕拉，贝卡·亚克力之女娜特拉嫁给格鲁吉亚国王德米特里二世，并在亚克力宫廷抚养了后来的格奥尔基五世。1334年，格奥尔基五世重新将萨姆茨赫纳入王权，并授予亚克力家族世袭阿塔贝格头衔，其政权从此称萨姆茨赫‑萨阿塔巴戈。公国挺过了1386至1403年帖木儿的多次入侵和土库曼人对阿哈尔齐赫的反复洗劫；1465年，克瓦尔克瓦雷二世在帕拉瓦尼湖附近击败格奥尔基八世，彻底脱离格鲁吉亚。1535年，伊梅列季国王巴格拉特三世在穆尔贾赫季俘获克瓦尔克瓦雷三世并吞并公国，但1545年奥斯曼在索霍伊斯塔获胜后，萨姆茨赫沦为奥斯曼附庸。1578年起，亚克力阿塔贝格们改宗伊斯兰教，以阿哈尔齐赫世袭帕夏的身份统治切尔德尔省，直至1829年俄罗斯征服；其一支旁系则以阿塔别科夫‑克瓦布良斯基之姓入仕俄国。

en: The Jarral are a Rajput clan of the Pir Panjal hills, later counted among the Muslim Rajputs, who trace descent from the Tomar (Tanwar) Rajputs of the lunar lineage. Their rajas ruled Rajouri, the ancient Rajapuri named in Kalhana's Rajatarangini. The first of them, Prithvi Pal, held the Pir Panjal passes against Mahmud of Ghazni's raid of 1021, and his line ruled the principality from 1033. In 1475 the campaigns of the Kashmiri general Malik Tazi Bhat reduced Rajouri to a tributary of the Kashmir Sultanate, though its local rajas kept limited autonomy. Under Mughal rule the Jarral rulers came to terms with the empire and received the title Mirza. They long resisted Sikh expansion, but in 1813 Gulab Singh of Jammu captured Rajouri for Ranjit Singh by defeating Raja Aghar Khan, ending Jarral rule.
zh: 贾拉尔人是皮尔潘贾尔山区的拉杰普特氏族，后世归入穆斯林拉杰普特之列，自称源出月族世系的托马尔（坦瓦尔）拉杰普特。他们的罗阇统治着拉久里，即古称拉贾普里、见于卡尔哈纳《罗阇塔兰吉尼》的那座山城。最早的首领普里特维·帕尔曾在1021年扼守皮尔潘贾尔山口，抵御加兹尼的马哈茂德的进犯，其家族自1033年起统治这个小邦。1475年，克什米尔将领马利克·塔齐·巴特的征讨使拉久里沦为克什米尔苏丹国的附庸，但本地罗阇仍保留有限的自治权。莫卧儿时期，贾拉尔统治者与帝国达成和议，获封“米尔扎”称号。他们长期抵抗锡克人的扩张，1813年查谟的古拉卜·辛格击败罗阇阿加尔汗，为兰吉特·辛格的锡克帝国夺取拉久里，贾拉尔家族的统治至此终结。

en: The Jarwanids were an Arab dynasty of the Bani Malik clan that ruled the oases of eastern Arabia, al-Qatif and al-Ahsa, in the fourteenth and early fifteenth centuries. Their founder Jarwan ibn Nasir al-Maliki, based at al-Qatif, drove out the forces of the Muntafiq chief Saʿid ibn Mughamis from Basra and overthrew the Usfurids around 1383, establishing an emirate over the old Bahrain region. Contemporary writers such as Ibn Battuta and Ibn Hajar called them extreme Rafida, and a fifteenth-century Egyptian scholar dismissed them as remnants of the Qarmatians; modern debate variously makes them Ismaʿilis or Twelver Shiʿites, though it was Twelver scholars who filled the judgeships and the office of market inspector under their rule, and prayers were said in the mosques according to the Shiʿite formula. The Jarwanid emirate lasted until the early fifteenth century, dated 1392 to 1417 in Arabic sources, when the Banu Uqayl Bedouin clan of the Jabrids deposed and killed its last ruler in al-Qatif and by 1440 had taken over al-Ahsa, Qatif and the Bahrain islands.
zh: 贾尔万王朝是巴尼·马利克部族的阿拉伯人王朝，14世纪至15世纪初统治阿拉伯半岛东部的卡提夫与哈萨绿洲。其奠基人是以卡提夫为据点的贾尔万·伊本·纳西尔·马利基，他击退了来自巴士拉的蒙塔菲格部首领赛义德·伊本·穆加米斯的军队，约1383年推翻乌斯富尔王朝，在旧巴林地区建立埃米尔国。伊本·白图泰、伊本·哈吉尔等当时的学者称他们为极端的拉斐达派，15世纪一位埃及学者则把他们斥为卡尔马特派余孽；今人对其属伊斯玛仪派还是十二伊玛目派仍有争论，但在其治下担任法官和市场督察的都是十二伊玛目派学者，清真寺也按什叶派仪轨礼拜。阿拉伯文史料将该埃米尔国的存续时间系于1392年至1417年，其后巴努·欧盖勒部落的贝都因人贾布里德王朝在卡提夫废黜并杀死末代统治者，到1440年已夺取哈萨、卡提夫和巴林群岛。

en: The Jethwa are the oldest Rajput ruling clan of the Saurashtra peninsula, and likely heirs of the Saindhavas, the eighth-century naval kings of Ghumli who styled themselves masters of the western sea; their own bardic genealogy instead traces the clan to Jethi-dhwaja of the line of Hanuman, whose image they bore on their arms. Entering the peninsula from Sindh and Kutch, they founded Morvi around 900 and at the time of Mahmud of Ghazni controlled much of western and northern Kathiawar, the country called Jyeshthukadesh. Sangaji defeated the Vaghela chief Virdhavala near Morvi in 1125 and took the title rana, which the house kept thereafter. Driven out of Morvi by Qutb-ud-din Aibak in 1193, the Jethwas withdrew to the Barda hills and made Ghumli their capital, where they built the twelfth-century Navlakha sun temple and the great Vikia stepwell. In 1313 Rana Bhanji, after whom the town of Bhanvad is named, lost Ghumli and moved the seat to Ranpur; later capitals included Chhaya and finally Porbandar, from 1685.
zh: 杰特瓦是萨乌拉施特拉半岛最古老的拉杰普特统治部族，很可能是8世纪海上王朝赛恩达瓦（都于贡姆利，自称西海之主）的后继；而该族自己的世系歌把祖先追溯到哈奴曼一脉的杰提德瓦贾，其纹章也以哈奴曼为记。他们从信德和卡奇进入半岛，约900年建立莫尔维，在加兹尼的马哈茂德时代控制着卡提阿瓦西部和北部的大片土地，古称杰耶什图卡德什。1125年，桑加吉在莫尔维附近击败瓦盖拉首领维尔达拉，取得拉纳头衔，此后该家族世代沿用。1193年，库特卜丁·艾巴克攻陷莫尔维，杰特瓦人退入巴尔达丘陵，以贡姆利为都，在那里修建了12世纪的纳夫拉卡太阳神庙和宏大的维基阶梯井。1313年，拉纳·班吉兵败失去贡姆利，迁都兰布尔；班瓦德城即以他的名字命名。此后都址又经查亚等地，最终于1685年迁至波尔班达尔。

en: The Jhala are a Chandravanshi Rajput clan, also called Makwana after their old dynasty at Karenti in Sindh. In 1090 Harpal Makwana led the clan from Sindh into northern Gujarat and founded the kingdom of Jhalawad, the tract in northern Saurashtra that still bears their name. The early Jhala rajas served the Chaulukya kings as great provincial governors: Durjansalji fought for the young Mularaja at Kasahrada against Muhammad of Ghor, and Santaldev founded a new capital at Santalpur in 1304. Ranmalsinhji I, ruling from 1392, was captured by the Rathores of Barmer and freed by his son Shatrusaldev, who moved the seat to Mandal and three times rebelled against Ahmed Shah I of the Gujarat Sultanate. In 1486 Mahmud Begada sacked the Jhala fort of Kuva, the disaster remembered as Kuva-no-Ker, and the capital was moved to Halvad two years later. A Jhala prince, Ajajji, died fighting for Mewar at Khanwa against Babur in 1527, and in 1742 Rai Singh II built the new capital of Dhrangadhra, from which the state took its later name. Junior Jhala branches also ruled the nearby states of Limbdi, Wankaner and Wadhwan.
zh: 阇诃罗是月系拉杰普特部族，又称马克瓦纳，得名于他们在信德卡伦蒂的旧王朝。1090年，哈尔帕尔·马克瓦纳率部从信德迁入古吉拉特北部，建立阇诃罗伐德王国，萨乌拉施特拉北部那片以其命名的土地即由此而来。早期阇诃罗王公作为大省总督效力于遮娄其王朝：杜尔阇那萨罗吉曾在卡萨赫拉达代年幼的穆拉罗阇迎战古尔的穆罕默德；桑塔尔提婆于1304年另建都城桑塔尔布尔。1392年起在位的兰马尔辛吉一世被巴尔梅尔的拉托尔人俘虏，其子沙特鲁萨尔提婆将他救出，又把王庭迁至曼达尔，并曾三次起兵反抗古吉拉特苏丹国的艾哈迈德沙阿一世。1486年，马哈茂德·贝加达攻陷阇诃罗要塞库瓦，这场惨剧被称为库瓦之难；两年后都城迁至哈尔瓦德。1527年，阇诃罗王子阿贾吉随梅瓦尔一方战死于对抗巴布尔的坎瓦战役；1742年，拉伊·辛格二世兴建新都德兰加达，土邦后来即以该城为名。阇诃罗的旁支还统治着附近的林布迪、万卡内尔和瓦德万等小邦。

en: The Hanyang Zhao, usually romanised from Korean as the Hanyang Jo clan (한양 조씨, 漢陽趙氏), took their clan seat at Hanyang, present-day Seoul, which Goryeo knew as Namgyeong. Their founder Jo Ji-su was a local lord of Yongjin in Deokwon-bu on the north-eastern coast who held a mid-ranking post at the Goryeo court. In 1258 his son Jo Hwi mutinied, killed the north-eastern commander Sin Jip-pyeong and surrendered the lands beyond Hwaju to the Mongols; the Yuan made him first superintendent of the new Ssangseong Prefecture, an office held in turn by Hwi, his son Yanggi, his grandson Rim and his great-grandson Sosaeng over four generations. In 1356, when King Gongmin broke with the Yuan, Yanggi's son Jo Don, Sosaeng's own uncle, turned against the commandery and helped General Yu In-u storm it, restoring the territory north of Cheolnyeong to Goryeo. Don then rose to the highest Goryeo rank of Samjungdaegwang, and kinsmen such as Jo In-ok became founding merit subjects of Joseon after 1392; the clan's most famous later son was the reformist scholar Jo Gwang-jo (1482—1519).
zh: 汉阳赵氏（한양 조씨）是以汉阳（今首尔，高丽时称南京）为本贯的氏族。始祖赵之寿出身东北沿海德源府龙津县的土著士族，在高丽朝中任佥议中书事。1258年，其子赵晖起兵攻杀东北面兵马使慎执平等人，以和州以北之地投降蒙古，被元朝任命为新设双城总管府的首任总管，此后赵晖、赵良琪、赵琳、赵小生祖孙四代相继出任总管。1356年恭愍王决意摆脱元朝，赵良琪之子、赵小生的叔父赵暾倒戈，配合东北面兵马使柳仁雨攻破双城，高丽由此收复铁岭以北的旧疆。赵暾后来官居高丽最高品阶三重大匡，族人赵仁沃等更在1392年朝鲜开国时成为开国功臣；该氏族后世最著名的人物是16世纪的改革派儒臣赵光祖（1482—1519）。

en: The lords of Joinville were a feudal family of Champagne who held the castle and lordship of Joinville from the eleventh century and served as hereditary seneschals of the counts of Champagne. Their most famous member was John of Joinville, born in 1224, the son of Simon of Joinville. He joined Louis IX on the Seventh Crusade in 1244, was captured with the king at the Battle of Al Mansurah in 1250 and helped negotiate the ransom, then spent four years at the king's side in the Holy Land as his close counsellor. He refused to follow Louis on the Tunis crusade of 1270, and his judgment was borne out when the king died outside Tunis. At the papal inquest into the king's sanctity he testified in 1282, and at the request of Queen Jeanne of Navarre he wrote his Life of Saint Louis, completed in 1309, one of the most vivid memoirs of the medieval French court. John died in 1317 at the age of ninety-three. The family continued to rule Joinville until 1365 and became extinct in the following century.
zh: 茹安维尔家族是香槟的封建贵族，自11世纪起便据有茹安维尔城堡和领地，并世袭香槟伯爵的宫廷总管一职。家族最有名的成员是生于1224年的让·德·茹安维尔，西蒙·德·茹安维尔之子。1244年他随路易九世参加第七次十字军东征，1250年在曼苏拉战役中与国王一同被俘，还参与了赎金谈判，此后四年他作为亲信谋臣随侍国王身边，留在圣地。1270年他拒绝参加突尼斯十字军，而国王后来果然病死在突尼斯城下，印证了他的判断。1282年他在教宗主持的圣德调查中出庭作证；应纳瓦拉王后让娜之请，他撰写了《圣路易传》，于1309年成书，是中世纪法兰西宫廷最生动的回忆录之一。让于1317年去世，享年九十三岁。家族对茹安维尔的统治延续到1365年，最终于15世纪绝嗣。

en: The Joyces, Gaelic Seoighe, were a Hiberno-Norman family that put down Gaelic roots in the far west of Connacht. Their surname comes from the Old French Josse, itself drawn from Judoc, a Breton royal saint of the seventh century. One of the first recorded in Ireland was Thomas Joy, who founded a small lordship in northern Iar Connacht, holding the barony of Ross between the Cong river and Killary Harbour on the borders of Galway and Mayo. The family became completely Gaelicised, ruling its followers like an Irish chiefly line over the old Partraige country around Lough Mask and Lough Corrib, which became known as Joyce Country. A kinsman branch settled in Galway town and joined its fourteen merchant tribes, the Tribes of Galway: Henry Joyce served as mayor in 1542, and tradition credits the goldsmith Richard Joyce, around 1700, with designing the Claddagh ring.
zh: 乔伊斯家族，盖尔语作肖伊，是在康诺特极西之地深深盖尔化的诺曼—爱尔兰家族。其姓氏源自古法语若斯，而该词又可追溯到7世纪布列塔尼的王族圣人朱多克。最早见于爱尔兰记载的成员之一是托马斯·乔伊，他在西康诺特北部建起一块小领地，据有戈尔韦与梅奥交界处、孔格河与基拉里港之间的罗斯男爵区。家族后来彻底盖尔化，像爱尔兰酋长家族一样统治部众，辖地涵盖马斯克湖与科里布湖周边古老的帕特雷地区，这片地方后来被称为乔伊斯地区。另有一支亲族定居戈尔韦城，跻身该城十四大商人部族“戈尔韦诸部族”之列：亨利·乔伊斯于1542年出任市长；据传统说法，金匠理查德·乔伊丝在1700年前后设计了克拉达戒指。

en: The lords of Jülich began as counts in the Jülich gau west of the Rhine, first documented with Gerhard I in 1003; Gerhard III styled himself Count of Jülich from 1081, and the family built its lordship around the town of Jülich on the Rur. Count William IV, ruling from 1219, enlarged the county and granted Jülich its town charter in 1234, opening a long rivalry with the archbishops of Cologne in which Count Walram fought alongside Brabant at the Battle of Worringen in 1288 and Gerhard V's younger son Walram became Archbishop of Cologne in 1332. Emperor Charles IV raised Count William V to duke in 1356, and Duke William II defeated Brabant at Baesweiler in 1371 before the house inherited Guelders in 1393. When Reinald IV died without heirs in 1423, Jülich passed to the younger Jülich-Berg branch and was united with Berg and Ravensberg; the last male Jülich duke, William IV, died in 1511, and his daughter Maria carried the lands to the House of La Marck of Cleves, forming the United Duchies of Jülich-Cleves-Berg in 1521. The succession crisis of 1609 ended with the Treaty of Xanten in 1614, which assigned Jülich to the Palatinate-Neuburg line of the Wittelsbachs, until Revolutionary France annexed it in 1794 and the Congress of Vienna gave it to Prussia in 1815.
zh: 于利希家族起家于莱茵河以西的于利希高，1003年格哈德一世首次见载，格哈德三世自1081年起自称于利希伯爵，在鲁尔河畔的于利希城周围经营领地。1219年继位的威廉四世大力扩张，1234年授予于利希城市权，并与科隆大主教长期对抗：瓦尔拉姆伯爵1288年在沃林根战役中站在布拉班特一边，格哈德五世的幼子瓦尔拉姆则于1332年当选科隆大主教。1356年皇帝查理四世升威廉五世为公爵，威廉二世1371年在巴斯韦勒击败布拉班特，家族又于1393年继承海尔德。1423年赖因哈德四世无嗣而终，于利希转入幼支于利希—贝格系，与贝格和拉文斯贝格合并；末代男嗣公爵威廉四世1511年去世，其女玛丽亚把领地带给克莱沃的拉马克家族，1521年组成于利希—克莱沃—贝格联合公国。1609年的继承危机引发于利希继承战争，1614年《克桑滕条约》把于利希判给维特尔斯巴赫家族的普法尔茨—诺伊堡支；1794年法兰西革命政府吞并该地，1815年维也纳会议又将它划归普鲁士。

en: The Kachhwahas are a Rajput clan of the Dhundhar country in northeastern Rajputana, where they ruled the Kingdom of Amber and later Jaipur. They claim Solar-line descent from Kusha, son of Rama. Their ancestors are said to have ruled at Gwalior before the clan moved into Rajputana: in the eleventh century Dulha Rai, possibly a survivor of the Kachchhapaghata house of Narwar, received Dausa from the Chauhans, defeated the Meenas and Bargujars, and carved out the Dhundhar kingdom, while his successor Kakil seized the fort of Amber. For centuries a small power, Amber paid tribute to Mewar in the fifteenth century. Its rise began under Raja Bharmal, who met the emperor Akbar at Sanganer in 1562 and gave him his daughter in marriage, becoming a Mughal vassal; Bharmal's son Bhagwant Das and grandson Man Singh I became Akbar's foremost Rajput generals, with Man Singh governing Bihar and Bengal. Mirza Raja Jai Singh I, honoured by Shah Jahan in 1639, commanded in the Deccan and extracted the Treaty of Purandar from Shivaji in 1665. Sawai Jai Singh II reasserted independence in 1708, founded the planned city of Jaipur in 1727 and built the Jantar Mantar observatories. After his death in 1743 succession wars and Maratha tribute drained the state, until a treaty of 1818 placed Jaipur under a British subsidiary alliance.
zh: 卡奇瓦哈是拉杰普塔纳东北部敦达尔地区的拉杰普特氏族，统治着安泊尔王国及其后的斋普尔。他们自称是罗摩之子俱舍的后裔，属太阳世系。据说其祖先曾在瓜廖尔立国，后来氏族迁入拉杰普塔纳：11世纪，可能出身纳尔瓦尔卡奇帕加塔家族遗脉的杜尔哈·拉伊从乔汉人手中得到道萨，击败米纳人和巴尔古贾尔人，开创敦达尔王国；继任者卡基尔又夺取安泊尔要塞。安泊尔数百年间只是小邦，15世纪还曾向梅瓦尔纳贡。它的崛起始于拉贾巴尔马尔：1562年他在桑加内尔觐见皇帝阿克巴，把女儿嫁给阿克巴，成为莫卧儿附庸；其子巴格万特·达斯和其孙曼·辛格一世成为阿克巴麾下最重要的拉杰普特将领，曼·辛格曾治理比哈尔和孟加拉。1639年受沙贾汗赐号米尔扎·拉贾的贾伊·辛格一世长期在德干统兵，于1665年迫使希瓦吉签订《普兰达尔条约》。萨瓦伊·贾伊·辛格二世于1708年重振独立，1727年兴建规划城市斋普尔，并建造詹塔曼塔天文台。1743年他死后，继承内战和马拉塔贡赋耗尽国力，最终1818年的条约把斋普尔纳入英国的辅助同盟体系。

en:
The Kadambas were an ancient royal family of Karnataka who ruled the northern Deccan and the Konkan from Banavasi. Founded around 345 by Mayurasharma after he defeated the Pallavas of Kanchi, the kingdom reached its peak under Kakusthavarma and was the first native dynasty to use Kannada in administration. From the mid-sixth century the Kadambas continued as feudatories of the Chalukyas and then the Rashtrakutas, splitting into the lesser branches of Goa, Halasi and Hangal.

The Goa branch was set up in 960 by Shashthadeva, a Chalukya feudatory who took Chandrapur from the Shilaharas and ruled first from Chandor and then from the wealthy port of Gopakapattana, whose merchants traded with Zanzibar, Bengal, Gujarat and Sri Lanka. The Kadambas of Goa built many Shiva temples and ran their courts in Sanskrit and Kannada. In the 1320s Khalji general Malik Kafur sacked Gopakapattana, and the line came to an end around 1345, as the Bahmani Sultanate rose in the Deccan.
zh:
卡达姆巴人是卡纳塔克的古老王族，从巴南巴西出发统治北德干和康坎一带。约345年，马尤拉沙尔马击败建志的帕拉瓦人后建国，在卡库斯塔瓦尔马时期达到鼎盛，也是第一个在行政中使用卡纳达语的本地王朝。6世纪中叶以后，卡达姆巴人作为遮娄其及后来罗湿陀罗拘陀的附庸延续下来，分裂成果阿、哈拉西和杭加尔几个支系。

果阿支系由沙斯塔提婆于960年建立，他作为遮娄其的封臣从希拉哈拉人手中夺取昌德拉普尔，先后以昌多尔和富庶港口戈帕卡帕塔纳为都，当地商人与桑给巴尔、孟加拉、古吉拉特和斯里兰卡贸易。果阿的卡达姆巴人修建了大量湿婆神庙，宫廷使用梵语和卡纳达语。14世纪20年代，卡尔吉的将领马利克·卡富尔洗劫戈帕卡帕塔纳，这支王统约于1345年终结，此时德干的巴赫曼尼苏丹国正在兴起。

en: The Sanuki Kagawa claimed Kanmu Heishi descent and looked back to the famed warrior Kamakura Kagemasa as their ancestor; an earlier branch of the family took its name from Kagawa village in Kōza district of Sagami, the area of modern Chigasaki. After the Nanboku-chō wars the house attached itself to the Hosokawa, and its men entered Sanuki Province together with the Yasutomi after winning distinction at the battle of Shiramine. From then on the Kagawa held the shugodai office of Sanuki generation after generation, fought prominently in the Ōnin War, and came to be counted among the so-called Four Heavenly Kings of the Hosokawa. By the Sengoku age they controlled much of western Sanuki from their Mitoyo lands. The last great head Yukikage steered a delicate course between the Mōri, Oda Nobunaga and Chōsokabe Motochika, even taking Nobunaga's generational character to rename himself Nobukage and adopting Motochika's second son Chikakazu as his heir to secure the domain. The maneuvering ended in 1585, when Toyotomi Hideyoshi's conquest of Shikoku cost the Kagawa their fief and the house was attainted.
zh: 赞岐香川氏自称桓武平氏后裔，以镰仓时代的名将镰仓权五郎景政为祖先；其早年一支定居相模国高座郡香川村（今茅崎市一带），便以地名为姓。南北朝战乱后，香川氏追随细川氏，在白峰合战中立功，与安富氏一同进入赞岐国，此后世代担任赞岐守护代。应仁之乱中香川氏表现活跃，被列为“细川四天王”之一；到战国时代，他们以三丰一带为根基，控制了赞岐西部的大半领地。末代当主香川之景在毛利氏、织田信长、长宗我部元亲等强权之间周旋，他接受信长偏讳改名信景，又迎立元亲次子亲和为养子，竭力保全家业。但这些运作终究徒劳：1585年丰臣秀吉发动四国征伐，香川氏遭到改易，就此失去大名身份。

en: The Kaimana dynasty is the royal house of the Kingdom of Sran, later called the Kingdom of Kaimana, on the Bomberai Peninsula of western New Guinea. Oral tradition places its foundation in 1309, when the chief Imaga united the villages and tribes of the Pattimunin lands in the Kumawa mountains through visits and marriage alliances and took the title Rat Sran Nati Pattimuni, meaning king of Sran. His son Basir Onin moved the court to Borombouw on Adi Island to profit from trade, and the later king Woran grew so powerful that Javanese tradition remembers a visit by Gajah Mada and lists Sran among the tributaries of Majapahit in the Negarakertagama. Around 1498 the Tidore Sultanate subdued the kingdom during its Hongi expeditions, and it paid tribute in slaves, spices and birds of paradise; the royal family converted to Islam in the 1500s. In 1808 Nduvin, the Rat Sran IV, moved the capital from Adi Island to E'man, the site of modern Kaimana, and in 1828 the Dutch built Fort Du Bus nearby at Lobo, drawing the kingdom into the Netherlands-Tidore sphere.
zh: 凯马纳王朝是新几内亚岛西部邦贝赖半岛上斯兰王国（后称凯马纳王国）的王室。据口述传统，酋长伊马加于1309年立国，通过巡访和联姻统一了库马瓦山区帕蒂穆宁之地的村落与部落，并采用王号“斯兰之王帕蒂穆尼”。他的儿子巴西尔·奥宁把王庭迁到阿迪岛上的博龙布，以经营贸易；后来的国王沃兰势力强盛，以至于爪哇传说称加查·马达曾亲临其宫，《爪哇史颂》也把斯兰列为满者伯夷的朝贡国之一。约1498年，蒂多雷苏丹国在洪吉远征中征服该国，斯兰须以奴隶、香料和极乐鸟纳贡；王室于16世纪改宗伊斯兰教。1808年，第四任斯兰王恩杜温把都城从阿迪岛迁到埃曼，即今天的凯马纳；1828年荷兰人在附近的洛博修建迪比斯要塞，将这个王国纳入荷兰与蒂多雷的势力范围。

en: The Kajiki were a warrior house of Ōsumi Province in southern Kyushu, named for the Kajiki valley in what is now Aira in Kagoshima Prefecture. Their founder was Fujiwara no Tsunehira, third son of the regent Fujiwara no Yoritada, who in the late tenth century married the daughter of the local magnate Ōkura Yoshinaga, settled on his wife's lands and took the place name as his family name. As Kamakura gokenin the clan reached its height helping to repel the Mongol invasions of Japan. During the Nanboku-chō wars it split into rival factions backing Ashikaga Takauji and Ashikaga Tadayoshi, and under the Muromachi shogunate it served the Shimazu, shugo lords of Ōsumi. The family later adopted Mitsuhisa, a third son of Shimazu Suehisa, but that heir's own son Hisahira rebelled and in 1495 raided Chōsa, held by the Shimazu vassal Kawakami; Shimazu Tadamasa stormed Kajiki Castle the next year, and the Kajiki were removed to Ata in Satsuma, ending their rule of their home valley.
zh: 加治木氏是九州南部大隅国的武家，得名于今鹿儿岛县姶良市一带的加治木谷地。始祖藤原经平是关白藤原赖忠的第三子，10世纪后期入赘当地豪族大藏良长家，在妻方的领地定居，便以地名为家名。镰仓时代加治木氏以御家人身份参加抵御元寇的战斗，家门达到鼎盛。南北朝战乱中一族分裂，分别追随足利尊氏与足利直义；室町时代沦为大隅守护岛津氏的麾下。后来加治木家迎岛津季久第三子满久为养子，满久之子久平却举兵反叛，于1495年袭击岛津家臣川上氏所在的帖佐，岛津忠昌次年发兵攻破加治木城，加治木氏被移往萨摩的阿多，从此失去了世代居住的谷地。

en:
The Kakatiyas were a Telugu dynasty that ruled the eastern Deccan from the twelfth to the fourteenth century, with their capital at Orugallu, modern Warangal. Long feudatories of the Rashtrakutas and Western Chalukyas, they claimed sovereignty under Rudradeva in 1163, and Ganapati Deva later extended their power over the Godavari and Krishna deltas. His daughter Rudrama Devi, one of India's few queen regnants, ruled from 1262 and repelled the Yadavas of Devagiri; Marco Polo praised her government. The Kakatiyas opened tank irrigation across the uplands, granted the nayaka warrior title regardless of birth, and built the Thousand Pillar Temple and the forts of Warangal and Golconda.

Delhi's invasions ended the main line: Alauddin Khalji's attack of 1303 failed, but the siege of Warangal in 1310 forced Prataparudra II to pay tribute, and in 1323 Ulugh Khan conquered the kingdom. A branch survived in the forests to the east, where Annamadeva, said to be a brother of Prataparudra, founded the state of Bastar around 1324 under the goddess Danteshwari. His line ruled from Bastar and later Jagdalpur, splitting off the kingdom of Kanker in the fifteenth century and keeping its independence until the Maratha advances of the eighteenth century.
zh:
卡卡提亚人是12至14世纪统治东德干的泰卢固王朝，都城在奥鲁加卢，即今瓦朗加尔。他们长期作为罗湿陀罗拘陀和西遮娄其的附庸，1163年在鲁陀罗提婆治下称王，后来加纳帕蒂·德瓦把势力扩展到戈达瓦里河与克里希纳河三角洲。他的女儿鲁德拉玛·德维是印度少有的女王，1262年起执政并击退德瓦吉里的雅达瓦人，马可·波罗曾称赞她的治理。卡卡提亚人在高地广修蓄水池灌溉，不论出身都可授予“纳亚卡”武士头衔，并留下千柱神庙、瓦朗加尔堡和戈尔孔达堡等建筑。

德里的入侵终结了主支王统：阿劳丁·卡尔吉1303年的进攻失败，但1310年瓦朗加尔围城战后，普拉塔帕鲁陀罗二世被迫纳贡，1323年乌鲁格汗最终攻灭该王国。一支后裔在东部森林中存续：相传为普拉塔帕鲁陀罗之弟的安纳马提婆约于1324年在丹特什瓦里女神的护佑下建立巴斯塔邦。他的后裔先后以巴斯塔和贾格达尔普尔为都，15世纪又分出坎凯尔王国，并保持独立直到18世纪马拉塔人东进。

en: The Kampili, called the Basnaga kingdom in some Muslim chronicles, were a short-lived Hindu ruling house of the early fourteenth century, holding the Tungabhadra valley around Ballari in what is now north-eastern Karnataka. Its founder Singeya Nayaka III was a commander of the Hoysalas who declared independence around 1280, when a Delhi Sultanate army was destroyed in the Deccan by the Seuna Yadavas of Devagiri. His son Kampilideva succeeded him in 1300 and kept the new kingdom alive in the teeth of repeated northern invasions, ruling from the stronghold that later gave its name to the Kampili region. The end came in 1327, when Muhammad bin Tughluq sent a large army under Malik Zada against him; Kampilideva fell in the fighting and the court women performed jauhar, the mass self-immolation of a besieged garrison, rather than surrender. The victors stuffed the dead king's body with straw and sent his head to Delhi as a trophy. Kampili rule lasted barely two generations, but its ruins became the seedbed of the Vijayanagara Empire: the brothers Harihara and Bukka, who had served Kampilideva, were carried off to Delhi after the conquest and returned to the south to found Vijayanagara in 1336.
zh: 剑毕离王朝在部分穆斯林编年史中被称作巴斯纳伽王国，是14世纪初一个短命的印度教政权，据有今印度境内卡纳塔克东北部巴拉里一带的通加巴德拉河谷。开国者辛吉亚·纳亚卡三世本是曷萨拉的将领，约在1280年趁德瓦吉里的亚达瓦王朝歼灭一支德里苏丹国军队之机宣布独立。其子坎皮利提婆于1300年继位，在北方一波波入侵中苦苦支撑这个新王国，以后来得名坎皮利地区的要塞为统治中心。1327年末路降临：穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克派马利克·扎达率大军来攻，坎皮利提婆战死，宫廷妇女举行“乔哈尔”——被围者集体自焚殉城——而不肯投降。胜利者把国王遗体填上稻草，将首级送往德里献捷。剑毕离的统治仅历两代，但其废墟却成了毗奢耶那伽罗帝国的温床：曾侍奉坎皮利提婆的诃里诃罗与布卡兄弟在城破后被掳往德里，后来重返南方，于1336年建立毗奢耶那伽罗。

en: The Kaneko were a warrior house of Kanmu Heishi descent, an offshoot of the Murayama party of the seven warrior bands of Musashi. Their ancestor Taira no Yoritō held Murayama in Tama district, and his grandson Ienori settled at Kaneko in Iruma district and took the place as his family name. Ienori's son Ietada won distinction in the Hōgen and Heiji wars of the twelfth century and was appointed jitō of Nii in Iyo on Shikoku.
