In the Kenchō era of the mid-thirteenth century his great-grandson Hiroie moved to Nii, named his holding Kaneko and built Kaneko Castle, founding the Iyo Kaneko line. During the Nanboku-chō wars the district was contested between the Kōno of Iyo and the Hosokawa of Sanuki, and the Kaneko eventually became Hosokawa vassals. In the Sengoku period they served the Ishikawa as their leading warriors, and Kaneko Motoie became the effective ruler of the district and an ally of Chōsokabe Motochika. When Toyotomi Hideyoshi invaded Shikoku in 1585, the Mōri army of Kobayakawa Takakage landed at Nii; Motoie met them in the Tenshō campaign and fell at the battle of Nonoichigahara, and Kaneko Castle was taken, ending some three hundred and thirty years of Kaneko rule in Nii.
zh: 金子氏是出自桓武平氏的武家，为武藏七党之一村山党的支族。先祖平赖任领有多摩郡村山，其孙家范移居入间郡金子，便以金子为姓。家范之子家忠在12世纪的保元之乱、平治之乱中建功，被任命为四国伊予国新居等地的地头。13世纪中叶建长年间，家忠的曾孙广家迁居新居郡，将领地命名为金子，修筑金子城，开创伊予金子氏。南北朝时期，新居一带是伊予河野氏与赞岐细川氏争夺的激战之地，金子氏最终成为细川氏的属下。战国时代，金子氏作为重臣辅佐统治新居、宇摩的石川氏，当主金子元宅成为当地事实上的支配者，并与长宗我部元亲结盟。1585年丰臣秀吉发动四国征伐，小早川隆景率领的毛利军渡海在新居登陆，元宅在天正之阵中迎战，战死于野野市原之战，金子城随后陷落，金子氏在新居郡约三百三十年的统治就此终结。

en: The Kangleipak dynasty is the Meitei royal house of ancient Kangleipak, the valley kingdom around Imphal that became modern Manipur. Meitei tradition traces the line, later called the Ningthouja, to King Nongda Lairen Pakhangba, enthroned at Kangla in the first century, and to the long absorption of the surrounding clan principalities of Luwang, Moirang, Khuman and others. Its kings patronised the indigenous Sanamahi religion, and King Loiyumba, around the turn of the twelfth century, issued the Loiyumpa Silyel, one of the earliest written law codes in the region. After centuries of hill-and-valley warfare, Khagemba (r. 1597-1654) drove back invasions from the north and west, introduced coinage and settled captured Chinese artisans at Kangla to build bridges and gates. The greatest transformation came under Pamheiba, better known as Gharib Niwaz (r. 1709-1748), who enlarged the kingdom and made Hinduism the court faith. Burmese conquests opened the Seven Years Devastation of 1819-1826, which ended only with the Treaty of Yandaboo and the restoration of King Gambhir Singh under British protection.
zh: 刚莱博王朝是古刚莱博的梅泰王室，统治以英帕尔河谷为中心、即后来曼尼普尔的山地王国。梅泰传统把该王统（后称宁托贾王朝）追溯到1世纪在康拉登基的国王农达·莱伦·帕汗巴，历代君王陆续吞并鲁旺、莫伊朗、库曼等周边部族小邦。王室尊奉本土的萨纳马希信仰；12世纪之交的国王洛伊雍巴颁布《洛伊雍巴法典》，是当地最早的成文法典之一。经过数百年的山地河谷争战，卡根巴（1597—1654年在位）击退北方和西方的来犯，推行铸币，并把俘获的中国工匠安置在康拉修桥筑城。最大的转变发生在帕姆赫巴（号称加里布·尼瓦兹，1709—1748年在位）时期，他扩张版图，并把印度教立为宫廷信仰。1819—1826年缅甸的征服带来七年浩劫，直到《杨达波条约》签订，甘比尔·辛格在英国保护下复国，乱局才告结束。

en: The Kantakouzenos were one of the richest landowning families of the later Byzantine Empire. Probably originating in Asia Minor, they are first heard of campaigning against the Cumans in 1094, and under the Komnenian emperors the sebastos John Kantakouzenos served Manuel I as a general until he was killed at Myriokephalon in 1176. By the Fourth Crusade they held vast estates in the Peloponnese. Michael Kantakouzenos became the first Byzantine governor of the Morea in 1308, and his son John rose as megas domestikos and regent after the death of Andronikos III in 1341. Denied power by the regency of the Empress Anna of Savoy and Alexios Apokaukos, John fought the civil war of 1341 to 1347 and entered Constantinople as Emperor John VI. He married his daughter Helena to John V and made his son Matthew co-emperor in 1353, but a second civil war ended with John VI's abdication into a monastery in 1354 and Matthew's surrender in 1357. The family kept the Morea: Manuel Kantakouzenos ruled it as despot from 1349 to 1380, followed by Matthew and briefly his son Demetrios, until Theodore I Palaiologos took over in 1383. Other children linked the house to the rulers of Epirus and the Ottomans, for Theodora married the bey Orhan I, and a later Irene married the Serbian despot Djuradj Brankovic while Helena became wife of the last Trebizond emperor David.
zh: 坎塔库齐诺斯家族是拜占庭帝国晚期最大的地主世家之一。他们可能起源于小亚细亚，1094年首次见于征讨库曼人的战事；科穆宁朝时期，至尊者约翰·坎塔库齐诺斯在曼努埃尔一世麾下为将，1176年战死于米里奥凯法隆。到第四次十字军时，家族已在伯罗奔尼撒拥有大片地产。1308年，米海尔·坎塔库齐诺斯出任摩里亚首任拜占庭总督；他的儿子约翰官至大统帅，并在1341年安德洛尼卡三世去世后成为摄政。由于萨伏依的安娜皇后与阿历克塞·阿波卡夫科斯的摄政集团排挤，约翰发动1341至1347年的内战，最终以皇帝约翰六世的身份进入君士坦丁堡。他把女儿海伦娜嫁给约翰五世，又于1353年立儿子马修为共治皇帝，但第二次内战以1354年约翰六世退位入修院、1357年马修投降告终。家族仍保有摩里亚：曼努埃尔·坎塔库齐诺斯从1349年到1380年任专制公，随后由马修、再由其子季米特里奥斯短暂继任，1383年塞奥多雷一世·巴列奥略接管该地。家族的其他子女还把这一门第与伊庇鲁斯统治者和奥斯曼人联系起来——塞奥多拉嫁给了奥斯曼贝伊奥尔汗一世，后来的伊琳娜嫁给塞尔维亚专制公久拉吉·布兰科维奇，海伦娜则成为特拉布宗末代皇帝大卫的妻子。

en: The Karamanids, in Turkish the Karamanoğulları, were the strongest and longest-lived of the Anatolian beyliks, founded in the mid-thirteenth century by the Turkmen chief Karaman Bey, whose Afşar or Salur clansmen had fled the Mongol advance from Arran to the Taurus Mountains. From their first centre at Ermenek they seized Larende, later renamed Karaman in their honour, and in 1277 Mehmed Bey briefly captured the Seljuk capital Konya and enthroned the pretender Jimri, before he was defeated and executed. As the Sultanate of Rûm collapsed the family made Konya its capital, controlling the roads from central Anatolia to the Mediterranean and ports such as Alanya, where it traded directly with Cyprus and Venice; Mehmed Bey also famously proclaimed Turkish the language of state, a landmark in the rise of written Turkish in Anatolia. From the mid-fourteenth century the Karamanids were the Ottomans' principal Anatolian rivals, allying with the Mamluks and European powers to hold the balance. Bayezid I reduced them to vassalage after the Battle of Akçay in 1398, but Timur restored their lands after defeating the Ottomans at Ankara in 1402. Renewed Ottoman campaigns under Mehmed II and bitter succession quarrels then broke the dynasty, and Bayezid II completed the annexation of its territory in 1487. Its mosques and madrasas in Konya and Karaman carried on Seljuk architectural traditions.
zh: 卡拉曼王朝在土耳其语中称卡拉曼奥乌拉勒，是安纳托利亚诸贝伊国中最强大也最长寿的一个。13世纪中叶，土库曼首领卡拉曼贝伊率领因躲避蒙古兵锋而从阿兰西迁的阿夫沙尔（一说撒鲁尔）部众落脚托罗斯山脉，建立政权。他们最初以埃尔梅内克为中心，随后夺取拉兰达（后改名卡拉曼以纪念该家族）；1277年穆罕默德贝伊一度攻占塞尔柱首都科尼亚，拥立僭称者吉姆里，最终却兵败被俘处死。鲁姆苏丹国崩溃后，家族以科尼亚为都，控制了从中安纳托利亚通往地中海的商路和阿拉尼亚等港口，与塞浦路斯和威尼斯直接通商；穆罕默德贝伊还明令以土耳其语为国家官方语言，成为安纳托利亚书面土耳其语兴起的里程碑。14世纪中叶起，卡拉曼人成为奥斯曼在安纳托利亚最主要的对手，多次联合马穆鲁克和欧洲势力以求自保。1398年巴耶济德一世在阿克恰伊战役后将其降为附庸，但1402年帖木儿在安卡拉战役击败奥斯曼后又归还了其领地。此后穆罕默德二世的连年征伐加上家族内部的继承纷争，最终使王朝瓦解，1487年巴耶济德二世完成了对卡拉曼领地的吞并。其在科尼亚和卡拉曼修建的清真寺与经院延续了塞尔柱建筑的传统。

en: The Karasids, in Turkish the Karesioğulları, were a Turkoman dynasty that in the early fourteenth century ruled Mysia, the country around Balıkesir facing the Dardanelles. Its eponymous founder Karasi Bey, son of Kalam Shah, built an independent emirate as Seljuk power faded, and on his death around 1328 the realm was divided between his sons Demir Khan and Yakhshi Khan. Demir built a fleet that raided Cyzicus and the Thracian shore and forced the Byzantine emperor Andronikos III to accept a truce in 1328; Ibn Battuta, who visited the court in 1333, left a sour portrait of him. Later rulers such as Ajlan Bey were drawn into Byzantine civil wars, and the dynasty's end is obscured by conflicting legends: after Ajlan's death his son Dursun took refuge with the Ottoman sultan Orhan and guided the Ottoman takeover of the Karasid lands around 1345, making Karasi the first Anatolian beylik to be absorbed. The conquest gave the Ottomans a ready fleet of experienced Aegean sailors and a frontage on the Dardanelles, opening the road into Rumelia.
zh: 卡雷西奥乌拉勒家族（即卡拉斯王朝）是14世纪初统治密细亚的土库曼王朝，领有巴勒克埃西尔一带，隔海与达达尼尔海峡相望。开国者卡拉西贝伊是卡拉姆沙赫之子，趁塞尔柱势力衰落建立起独立的埃米尔国，约1328年他去世后，国土由其子德米尔汗和叶赫什汗瓜分。德米尔建立舰队，劫掠基齐库斯和色雷斯海岸，迫使拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡三世于1328年接受停战；1333年到访其宫廷的伊本·白图泰，对他留下了刻薄的记载。后来的阿吉兰贝伊等统治者卷入拜占庭内战，而王朝的结局在彼此矛盾的传说中已难详考：阿吉兰死后，其子杜尔孙投奔奥斯曼苏丹奥尔汗，并引导奥斯曼军队在约1345年接管卡拉斯领地，使它成为第一个被奥斯曼吞并的安纳托利亚贝伊国。这次吞并让奥斯曼获得现成的舰队和熟悉爱琴海的水手，还取得达达尼尔海峡的出海口，为进军鲁米利亚打开了道路。

en: The Kart, or Kartid, dynasty was a Sunni Muslim family of Tajik origin, related to the Ghurids, that ruled most of Khorasan from Herat between the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries. Its founder Shams-uddin Muhammad, who traced his line to the Shansabani clan of Ghur and claimed Seljuk blood, established the family's power in 1245 as a vassal of the Mongols, and the Karts governed Herat under the Ilkhans; Shams-uddin was poisoned at the court of Abaqa in 1278, and Fakhr-uddin shattered an Ilkhanid army sent against Herat in 1306 before the city submitted to Öljeitü. When the Ilkhanate fragmented after 1335, Mu'izz-uddin Husayn built an independent principality, crushing the Sarbadars at the Battle of Zava in 1342, campaigning against the Chagatai Mongols and even taking the young Timur into his service; he dropped his tribute and ruled as sultan from 1349. Herat was sacked by the Chagatai amir Qazaghan around 1358, but the dynasty survived until Timur's first Persian campaign: Herat fell in 1381, its last ruler Ghiyas-uddin Pir Ali was executed after a revolt in 1383, and the remaining Karts were massacred at a banquet by Timur's son Miran Shah in 1396.
zh: 卡特王朝（一译卡尔提德王朝）是与古尔王朝有亲缘关系的塔吉克人逊尼派家族，13至14世纪以赫拉特为都统治呼罗珊大部。开国君主沙姆斯丁·穆罕默德出身古尔的尚萨巴尼氏族，自称有塞尔柱血统，1245年作为蒙古附庸奠定家族权势，卡特家族此后在伊儿汗国治下治理赫拉特：沙姆斯丁于1278年在阿八哈宫廷被毒杀，法赫尔丁则于1306年歼灭了一支来攻赫拉特的伊儿汗军队，其后该城仍向完者都臣服。1335年伊儿汗国瓦解后，穆仪兹丁·侯赛因建立起独立公国，1342年在扎瓦战役击溃萨尔巴达尔人，又多次远征察合台蒙古人，还曾收留年轻的帖木儿为其效力；他于1349年停止纳贡，以苏丹身份自立。约1358年赫拉特遭察合台异密加兹罕洗劫，但王朝延续了下来，直到帖木儿第一次波斯远征：1381年赫拉特陷落，末代君主吉亚斯丁·皮尔·阿里在1383年的一次叛乱后被处死，残余的卡特家族成员也于1396年在一场宴会上被帖木儿之子米兰沙尽数诛杀。

en: The Kartawi took their name from the Kartaw Kurds, called Kartawaye in Syriac sources, a Kurdish tribal group of the hill country west of Lake Van. By 585 the Church of the East had a diocese of Beth Tabyathe and the Kartawaye for them, and the monk David served as their bishop around 686 to 698.
zh: 卡尔塔维之名来自卡尔陶库尔德人，叙利亚语文献称其为卡尔塔瓦叶人，是活动在凡湖以西山区的一支库尔德部落。585年东方教会已为他们设立贝特·塔比亚特与卡尔塔瓦叶教区，修士大卫在686—698年前后曾任该部落的主教。

en: The Kasai were a warrior house of the Chichibu Taira line, founded by Kasai Kiyoshige, third son of Toshima Kiyomoto, whose family held the Kasai shrine-estate in Shimōsa, the country around present-day Katsushika in eastern Musashi. Kiyoshige and his father joined Minamoto no Yoritomo's rising against the Taira in 1180 and became his direct vassals; after the campaign that destroyed the Northern Fujiwara of Hiraizumi in 1189, Kiyoshige was made governor-general of Ōshū and granted wide lands in Mutsu, where he built his seat at Hiyoriyama in Ishinomaki. The clan later moved its headquarters to Teraike in Tome district and, after splitting into rival Ishinomaki and Teraike branches, re-emerged during the Nanboku-chō wars as one of the great regional lords of the Ōu region. In the Sengoku age the Kasai ruled several districts of central Mutsu, from the Sanriku coast into what is now southern Iwate, but the seventeenth head, Kasai Harunobu, failed to join Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign of 1590 and was attainted; with his death in 1597 the house ceased to be daimyō, though a surviving line later served the Tokugawa as hereditary sewer cleaners of Edo Castle.
zh: 葛西氏是出自秩父平氏的武家，始祖葛西清重为丰岛清元的第三子，家族本据下总国的葛西御厨，即后来武藏东部今葛饰一带的伊势神宫庄园。清重父子于1180年投奔源赖朝举兵讨伐平氏，成为镰仓的御家人；1189年攻灭平泉的奥州藤原氏后，清重出任奥州总奉行，在陆奥国获得大片封地，并在石卷的日和山筑城为本据。其后家族把本据迁往登米郡寺池，一度分裂为石卷系与寺池系两支相互争斗，又在南北朝动乱中重新崛起，成为奥羽地方的有力国人领主。战国时代，葛西氏统治陆奥中部数郡，势力从三陆海岸延伸到今岩手县南部；但第十七代当主葛西晴信未参加丰臣秀吉1590年的小田原征伐，被追究改易，1597年晴信死后，葛西氏作为大名彻底灭亡，仅存的一支后来以世袭清扫江户城下水道的身份侍奉德川家。

en: The Kasranids were the Persianized senior line of the Shirvanshahs, the rulers of Shirvan on the western shore of the Caspian. They grew out of the Arab Yazidid family, which had held the region since Haytham ibn Khalid took the ancient title of Shirvanshah in 861; the new name came from Kasra, linked to the legendary king Kai Khosrow, as the dynasty abandoned Arab naming customs to cast itself as heir to the Sasanian and Kayanian kings. From their capital at Shamakhy they married into the Bagrationi of Georgia, absorbed the neighboring Emirate of Derbent, and survived as vassals or tributaries of the Seljuqs, the Ilkhanate, the Chupanids and finally the Jalayirids. Their court was one of the great centers of Persian poetry, home to Nizami Ganjavi and Khaqani, and after the earthquake of 1192 Akhsitan I moved the capital to Baku, whose walls and towers were raised under these kings. The line ended with Hushang: raised as a hostage at the Jalayirid court, he ruled from 1372 until his own subjects killed him in 1382, when the crown passed to his cousin Ibrahim I of the Darbandid branch.
zh: 科斯兰王朝是希尔万沙王朝波斯化后的正统支系，统治里海西岸的希尔凡地区。它源出阿拉伯人的叶齐德家族——该家族自861年海萨姆·本·哈立德采用希尔万沙这一古老称号起便割据此地；新名号中的“科斯拉”与传说中的国王凯霍斯鲁相关，王朝借此放弃阿拉伯式命名传统，以萨珊王朝和凯扬王朝的继承者自居。他们以沙马基为都，与格鲁吉亚的巴格拉季奥尼家族联姻，吞并邻邦杰尔宾特埃米尔国，并先后作为塞尔柱、伊儿汗国、楚邦王朝和最后的札剌亦儿王朝的附庸或纳贡国存续下来。其宫廷是波斯诗歌的一大中心，内扎米·甘贾维和哈卡尼都曾在此效力；1192年大地震后，阿赫西坦一世把都城迁往巴库，巴库的城墙与塔楼也多建于这些君主治下。末代君主胡尚格自幼在札剌亦儿宫廷充当人质，1372年继位，1382年被自己的臣民所杀，王位转入其堂兄易卜拉欣一世的杰尔宾特支系之手。

en: The Katoch are a Rajput clan whose name means those within the fort, from the kot or fortress of Nagarkot, better known as Kangra. Their main branch ruled Kangra State, the ancient Trigarta of the Mahabharata, between the Ravi, Beas and Sutlej rivers, and claimed lunar-dynasty descent, suffixing Chand to their names; junior branches such as the Guleria and Jaswal founded neighbouring hill states. In 1333 Raja Prithvi Chand withstood the invading army of Muhammad bin Tughlaq, and Akbar's forces besieged Kangra for ten years without taking it, until Jahangir captured the fort in 1610 and reduced the rajas to Mughal vassals. Raja Ghamand Chand recovered the fort after 1751, and his grandson Sansar Chand (r. 1775-1823) made Kangra supreme among the hill states and a patron of the arts. Hard pressed by a Gurkha-backed revolt in 1805, he called in Ranjit Singh; the Sikh maharaja expelled the Gurkhas but kept the fort and the valley's best lands, leaving the Katoch rajas only the villages around it.
zh: 卡托奇是拉杰普特氏族，其名字意为“堡垒中人”，源自讷格尔果德——即冈格拉堡的kot（堡垒）。主支统治着拉维河、比亚斯河与萨特莱杰河之间的冈格拉邦，也就是《摩诃婆罗多》中的古特里加尔塔，并自称月族后裔，名字都冠以“昌德”；古莱里亚、贾斯瓦尔等支系则另建了邻近的山地小邦。1333年，罗阇普里特维·昌德击退了穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克的入侵大军；阿克巴的军队围攻冈格拉堡十年仍未能破城，直到1610年贾汉吉尔才拿下堡垒，将当地罗阇降为莫卧儿附庸。1751年即位的罗阇格曼德·昌德收复了堡垒，其孙桑萨尔·昌德（1775—1823年在位）使冈格拉称霸于众山邦，并成为艺术赞助中心。1805年，在廓尔喀支持的叛乱逼迫下，他向兰吉特·辛格求援；这位锡克大君赶走廓尔喀人，却留下了堡垒和河谷最肥沃的土地，卡托奇的罗阇只剩堡垒周围的村庄。

en: The Kawano were a warrior clan of Iyo Province on Shikoku, who claimed descent from the ancient Ochi clan and made Yuzuki Castle their seat from the Muromachi period. From the twenty-second head, Michikiyo, onward they used the character michi in every generation's name. In the late Heian period they served Taira no Kiyomori, but during the Genpei War Michinobu Kawano joined Minamoto no Yoritomo and fought the Taira in western Japan. The clan backed the retired emperor Go-Toba in the Jōkyū War of 1221 and was punished for it, yet recovered when Michiari Kawano won fame as a naval commander against the Mongol invasions. In 1337 the head, Michimori, had remained loyal to the Kamakura shogunate during its final wars and was sidelined under the new Kenmu regime; he then attached himself to Ashikaga Takauji and became shugo of Iyo. His successor Michitomo was killed fighting the invading Hosokawa, and the clan only made peace with them in 1386 through Ashikaga Yoshimitsu's mediation. Plagued by succession feuds and restive local lords, the Kawano never became true Sengoku daimyō, leaning on the Murakami navy and the Mōri for support. In 1585, during Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Shikoku campaign, Michinao Kawano surrendered after Kobayakawa Takakage persuaded him, and when he died without an heir in 1587 the clan's rule ended after fifty-seven generations.
zh: 河野氏是四国伊予国的武士家族，自称出自古代的越智氏，室町时代以后以汤筑城为居城，自第二十二代当主河野通清起，历代名字都用“通”字。平安末期他们臣属于平清盛，源平合战时河野通信投奔源赖朝，在西国与平氏作战。1221年承久之乱中河野氏站在后鸟羽上皇一方，事后受到处分而衰落，后来河野通有在元寇之战中以水军勇将成名，家族才重振。1337年的当主河野通盛在镰仓幕府末期的战乱中始终忠于幕府，建武政权成立后遭到冷遇，随后追随足利尊氏，被任为伊予守护。继任的河野通朝在抵御细川氏入侵时战死，直到1386年经足利义满调停，河野氏才与细川氏和解。此后家族屡受继承内讧和国人叛乱困扰，未能成长为真正的战国大名，军事上依赖村上水军和毛利氏的支援。1585年丰臣秀吉发动四国征伐，河野通直经小早川隆景劝说后投降，1587年他在竹原无嗣而终，历经五十七代的河野氏统治就此终结。

en: The Kawanobe were a warrior house of northern Hitachi, holding land from Naka District into Kuji District around their Noguchi Castle in Kawanobe-gō, now part of Hitachi-ōmiya. They claimed Fujiwara descent through the line of Fujiwara no Hidesato, the general who put down Taira no Masakado, as a branch of the Naka clan, and counted the Edo and Kawai houses among their kin. Their ancestor Michinao is said to have built Noguchi Castle around 1090, and the family name began four generations later, when Naka no Sukeaki, second son of Naka no Michiyasu, made Kawanobe his seat. In 1335 Kawanobe Sukeshige and his son Jirō took arms for the Southern Court, defeated the Hitachi shugo Satake Sadayoshi at Mikanohara, and followed Kitabatake Akiie to Kyoto to fight Ashikaga Takauji; tradition says Emperor Go-Daigo granted them the chrysanthemum crest, which they modified into a sixteen-petal chrysanthemum with the character for one. In 1336 they were crushed at Dokushōhō together with the Naka, and most of the kindred killed themselves, though a line survived and later submitted to the Satake, whose retainers they remained through the Sengoku age. When the Satake were transferred to Akita after Sekigahara, the last Kawanobe head stayed behind and lived as a rōnin in Kuji District.
zh: 川野边氏是常陆北部的武家豪族，势力从今常陆大宫市一带的那珂郡延伸到久慈郡，本城为川野边乡的野口城。他们本姓藤原，自称是平定平将门的镇守府将军藤原秀乡的后裔，属那珂氏的一支，与江户氏、川井氏等同族。其先祖藤原通直相传于1090年前后修筑野口城，四代之后，那珂通泰的次子那珂资明以川野边为据点，始称川野边氏。1335年，川野边资镇与儿子次郎举兵加入南朝，在瓮之原击败北朝方的常陆守护佐竹贞义，又随北畠显家上洛，与足利尊氏作战；相传后醍醐天皇将菊花纹赐予他们，川野边氏不敢原样使用，改成十六菊加“一”字作家纹。1336年，他们与那珂氏一同在独松峰被北朝军击败，一族大多自尽，仅有少数人逃得性命；其后人后来归降佐竹氏，整个战国时代均为佐竹家臣。关原之战后佐竹氏被转封出羽秋田，末代川野边当主没有随行，留在久慈郡做了浪人。

en: The Kedah dynasty rules one of the oldest polities on the Malay Peninsula, a straits-facing state whose heartland was the Bujang Valley. A settled trading government existed there as early as the eighth century BCE, and ancient Kedah Tua grew into a Hindu-Buddhist port where Indian, Persian and Arab merchants called, for centuries within the orbit of Srivijaya. The ruling house's own memory is preserved in the Kedah Annals, which trace the kings to the legendary hero Merong Mahawangsa and tell how the raja Phra Ong Mahawangsa embraced Islam and became Sultan Mudzaffar Shah, traditionally dated to 1136, though modern scholars place the conversion closer to the fifteenth century, when Kedah sought the protection and royal band of Malacca. In 1337 the throne was held by the sixth sultan, Ibrahim Shah, who reigned from 1321 to 1373 and had moved his capital to Kota Seputih in 1323. Through the following centuries the dynasty kept its sultanate alive by balancing stronger neighbors, paying tribute at various times to Malacca, Ayutthaya and Siam. Siamese armies overran Kedah in 1821 and drove its sultan into exile, and although a prince briefly retook Alor Setar in 1831, Siamese rule was not shaken off for years afterward.
zh: 吉打王朝统治着马来半岛最古老的政权之一，这个面向海峡的国家以布央谷为核心。早在公元前8世纪，当地就已有建制化的贸易政权，古老的吉打陀后来发展为印度教—佛教商港，印度、波斯和阿拉伯商人纷至沓来，此后数百年间长期处于室利佛逝的势力范围。王室自身的记忆保存在《吉打纪年》中：书中把历代君王追溯到传奇英雄梅隆·摩诃旺萨，并讲述国王帕·翁·摩诃旺萨皈依伊斯兰教、改名穆扎法尔沙的故事，传统上系于1136年；但后世学者多认为伊斯兰化更可能发生在15世纪，即吉打寻求马六甲庇护、请求赐予王权仪仗的时期。1337年在位的是第六任苏丹易卜拉欣沙（1321—1373年在位），他已于1323年迁都哥打昔布迪。此后几个世纪里，王朝在马六甲、阿瑜陀耶和暹罗等强邻之间周旋纳贡，维系苏丹国于不坠。1821年暹罗大军攻陷吉打，苏丹流亡；1831年虽有王子一度收复亚罗士打，但暹罗统治在此后多年间仍未被推翻。

en: The Keita dynasty ruled the Mandinka kingdom and later the Mali Empire from Niani on the upper Niger, from the eleventh century into the early seventeenth. A Muslim line, its mansas claimed descent from Bilal ibn Rabah, the Prophet Muhammad's muezzin. The first historically documented ruler was Sundiata Keita, who united the Mandinka peoples, defeated Soumaoro Kante of Sosso at Kirina around 1235 and gave the federation the Kouroukan Fouga constitution; from his reign Keita became the ruling clan's name. His great-nephew Mansa Musa, who reigned from about 1312, made Mali famous across the Islamic world with his pilgrimage to Mecca of 1324 to 1326, whose gold spending upset prices in Egypt. In 1337 the throne passed to Maghan I and then to his uncle Suleyman, under whom Ibn Battuta visited the court in 1352. From the early sixteenth century neighboring powers peeled away Mali's provinces, a defeat outside Djenne in 1599 broke its power, and after the empire's collapse around 1610 the Keitas withdrew to Kangaba as provincial chiefs.
zh: 凯塔王朝自11世纪至17世纪初，以尼日尔河上游的尼亚尼为中心，统治曼丁戈人的王国及后来的马里帝国。这是一个穆斯林世系，历代曼萨自称是先知穆罕默德的宣礼员比拉勒·伊本·拉巴赫的后裔。第一位有确切文献记载的统治者是松迪亚塔·凯塔：他联合曼丁戈各部，约在1235年的基里纳战役中击败苏苏王国的苏曼古鲁·坎特，并以《库鲁坎·富加》作为联邦的根本大法，凯塔也从他在位时成为统治家族的族名。他的侄孙曼萨·穆萨约1312年即位，1324至1326年赴麦加朝觐，沿途挥霍黄金以致扰乱了埃及的物价，使马里闻名于整个伊斯兰世界。1337年王位先后传给马汉一世及其叔苏莱曼，伊本·白图泰于1352年在苏莱曼在位时访问其宫廷。16世纪初起，周边强国不断蚕食马里的行省，1599年杰内城外的惨败摧毁了它的实力；1610年前后帝国瓦解，凯塔家族退回康加巴，沦为地方酋长。

en: The Kengtung dynasty was the saopha house of Kengtung, also called Chiang Tung or Menggen, the great eastern Shan state between the Salween and the Mekong. The line was founded around 1243 by the Tai prince Mang Kun; later tradition presents him and his kinsman Mang Kyin as governors sent by King Mangrai, and Chinese records likewise call the Kengtung rulers sons or delegates of Mang Lai. Before the Tai arrival the country had been Wa land, known in chronicle tradition as Khemarattha. Its saophas, seated in the valley town of Kengtung, generally sent tribute of ritual gold flowers to the Burmese kings rather than to their closer Thai and Chinese neighbours, and in 1405 the Ming enrolled the state as a native tusi office under the name Menggen. The house kept its autonomy through the wars of the sixteenth to eighteenth centuries: in 1760 rival Qing and Burmese claims over Kengtung helped bring on war between the Qianlong emperor and King Hsinbyushin, and after a decade under Chiang Mai from 1802 the dynasty was restored in 1814 with Burmese aid.
zh: 景栋王朝是萨尔温江与湄公河之间的掸族大邦景栋（傣艮语称孟艮，明代中国置孟艮府）的诏法世家。约1243年，泰族王子芒昆建立这一王统；后世传说他与族人芒京都是芒莱王派来的镇守官，中国史籍也把景栋统治者称为芒莱之子或其使者。在泰人到来之前，当地居民以佤族为主，纪年传说称其古国为凯玛拉塔。历代诏法以山谷中的景栋城为都，通常不向更近的泰人诸邦和中国称臣，而是向缅甸诸王进献金花为礼；1405年明朝将其封为土司，置孟艮府。该家族在16至18世纪的战乱中维持自治：1760年清朝与缅甸国王辛标信因景栋的归属矛盾兵戎相见，1802年景栋一度被清迈吞并，1814年又在缅甸帮助下恢复旧王朝。

en: Bahram Khan, also called Tatar Khan, was a military commander of the Delhi Sultanate and the only holder of this short-lived governor's house. Tradition holds that he was born in the camp of the sultan of Khorasan near Multan and adopted as an infant by Sultan Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq. He served as governor of Satgaon from 1324 and was appointed governor of Sonargaon in East Bengal in 1328, and the legal compendium Fatwa-i-Tatarkhani was compiled at his initiative. On his death in 1337 his armour-bearer Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah seized Sonargaon and declared himself its independent sultan, so the governorship never passed to Bahram Khan's heirs.
zh: 巴赫拉姆汗又名塔塔尔汗，是德里苏丹国的将领，也是这个短命总督家族仅有的掌权者。相传他出生于呼罗珊苏丹在木尔坦附近的军营，尚在襁褓中便被苏丹吉亚斯丁·图格鲁克收养。他自1324年起担任萨特冈总督，1328年又被任命为东孟加拉索纳尔冈总督，法学汇编《塔塔尔汗教法意见》即在他主持下编成。1337年他去世后，军械官法赫尔丁·穆巴拉克沙夺取索纳尔冈，自立为独立苏丹，总督之位因此没有传给巴赫拉姆汗的后人。

en: Qadar Khan, born Pindar Khilji and also called Bedar Khilji, was a Khalji noble who served Nasiruddin Ibrahim Shah, the tributary ruler of Lakhnauti installed by Delhi after the Tughlaq conquest of Bengal in 1324, and was in time appointed governor of the Lakhnauti province at Gaur by Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq. When Bahram Khan of Sonargaon died in 1337 and his armour-bearer Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah declared independence, Qadar Khan led a large army against the rebel, defeated him in the field and occupied Sonargaon. His soldiers then quarrelled over the plunder, and Fakhruddin lured them into an ambush in which Qadar Khan was captured and executed. The war minister he left behind at Lakhnauti, Alauddin Ali Shah, killed the deputy governor and made himself ruler of the city in 1339.
zh: 卡达尔汗本名平达尔·卡尔吉，又作贝达尔·卡尔吉，原是卡尔吉贵族，侍奉1324年图格鲁克王朝征服孟加拉后德里所立的拉克瑙提附庸君主纳西尔丁·易卜拉欣沙，后来被苏丹穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克任命为驻高达的拉克瑙提省总督。1337年索纳尔冈的巴赫拉姆汗去世，其军械官法赫尔丁·穆巴拉克沙宣布独立，卡达尔汗率大军讨伐，在野战中击败叛军并占领索纳尔冈。随后他的士兵为争夺战利品内讧，法赫尔丁诱使他们中伏，卡达尔汗被俘处死。他留在拉克瑙提的军政官阿拉丁·阿里沙杀死副总督，于1339年自立为该城之主。

en: The Kherla dynasty took its name from its hill fortress of Kherla in the Satpura range, seat of the earliest kingdom of Gondwana and one of its four ancient Gond realms. An earlier Rajput line held the fort, whose ruler Jaitpal is credited with building the fortress; he was succeeded by Narsingh Rai, the first Gond king of Kherla and the first ruler said to have unified the Gond. By 1398 Narsingh Rai's power reached west to the hills north of Berar, including the fortress of Gawilghur, and he once raided as far as Mahur. Defeated by Firuz Shah of the Bahmani Sultanate, he submitted at Ellichpur, gave his daughter in marriage and ruled on as a Bahmani vassal raised to the rank of amir. That alliance drew the hostility of Hoshang Shah of Malwa, whose repeated campaigns ended in 1433 with Narsingh Rai slain in battle and Kherla, together with Betul, incorporated into the Malwa Sultanate.
zh: 克尔拉王朝得名于萨德布尔山脉中依山而建的凯尔拉堡，这里是冈瓦纳最早的王国，也是冈瓦纳四大冈德古国之一。更早的拉杰普特世系曾据有此堡，其罗阇贾特帕尔被视为堡垒的修建者；继他而立的纳尔辛格·拉伊是凯尔拉第一位冈德人国王，也被认为是最早统一冈德人的君主。到1398年，纳尔辛格·拉伊的势力向西抵达贝拉尔以北的山地，包括加维尔加尔堡，还曾远征至马胡尔。他被巴赫曼尼苏丹国的菲鲁兹沙击败，在埃利奇布尔投降，嫁女和亲，以受封埃米尔的巴赫曼尼附庸身份继续统治。这层盟约招来马尔瓦的霍尚沙连年进攻，1433年纳尔辛格·拉伊战死，凯尔拉连同贝图尔被并入马尔瓦苏丹国。

en: The Khön are a Tibetan noble clan seated at Sakya in Tsang, whose members have supplied the hereditary head, the Sakya Trizin, of the Sakya school of Tibetan Buddhism. Clansmen already held office under the kings of the old Tibetan Empire, and in 1073 Khön Könchok Gyalpo founded Sakya Monastery, the seat around which the school grew. Under the Mongol Yuan dynasty the clan rose to govern Tibet: Drogön Chögyal Phagpa, tutor of Kublai Khan, was named imperial preceptor, and his kinsmen kept the office, ruling through Sakya-appointed administrators. Zangpo Pal, who died in 1323, was the last strong head; his sons, among them Namkha Lekpa, split the inheritance in 1323 and 1324 into the four Zhitog, Lhakang, Rinchengang and Ducho branches, weakening Sakya. In 1354 Tai Situ Changchub Gyaltsen of Phagmodrupa overthrew the Sakya administration and ended the clan's political power, though the Khön retained their monastic leadership and later gave rise to the Ngor and Tshar sub-schools.
zh: 孔氏是世居后藏萨迦的吐蕃贵族家族，藏传佛教萨迦派的历代座主萨迦法王均出自该家族。早在吐蕃帝国时期，孔氏族人已在朝中任职；1073年，孔·贡却杰布创建萨迦寺，成为萨迦派的根基。蒙古元朝时期，家族权势达到顶峰：八思巴出任忽必烈汗的帝师，此后帝师一职多由孔氏成员担任，西藏政务由萨迦任命的本钦掌管。1323年，最后一位强势座主桑波贝去世，他的儿子们于1323至1324年间分成细脱、拉康、仁钦岗和都却四个拉章，南喀勒巴即为其中之一，萨迦的势力由此衰弱。1354年，帕木竹巴的绛曲坚赞推翻萨迦政权，结束了孔氏在西藏的世俗统治；不过家族仍保有萨迦派座主之位，后来又衍生出俄尔、察尔等支派。

en: The Khorshidi were a Lur dynasty of the Salburi clan who ruled Little Lorestan from the fortress of Khorramabad between about 1184 and 1597. Their founder Shoja al-Din Khorshid, from whom the family took its name, inherited the lands of the Turkic lord Husamuddin Shuhli and made himself independent of the caliphal governors. Later princes also styled themselves Abbasi and claimed descent from Abbas ibn Ali. As atabegs they weathered the Mongol Ilkhanate, whose khans confirmed and deposed their chiefs, but Timur's invasion of 1386 devastated the province: the fortress of Khorramabad was razed and the ruler Izz al-Din was deported to Turkestan before being released. The family recovered after Timur's death, and Shah Rostam backed Ismail I when the Safavids rose to power. Caught between the Safavids and the Ottomans, the last Khorshidi chief Shahverdi twice rebelled against Shah Abbas I, who had him killed at Changuleh in 1597 and partitioned Little Lorestan, though a collateral line continued to govern it as Safavid governors.
zh: 霍什迪王朝是出自萨尔布里氏族的卢尔人王朝，约1184年至1597年间以霍拉马巴德城堡为中心统治小卢尔斯坦。始祖舒贾丁·胡尔希德（王朝得名于他）接掌了突厥领主侯萨姆丁·舒赫利的领地，摆脱哈里发所派总督而独立。后来的王公还自称阿拔西，声称是阿拔斯·伊本·阿里的后裔。他们以阿塔贝格身份撑过了蒙古伊儿汗国时期，诸汗可以废立其首领；但1386年帖木儿入侵使此地惨遭兵燹，霍拉马巴德城堡被夷平，首领伊兹丁被流放突厥斯坦，后来才获释。帖木儿死后家族复兴，沙阿·罗斯塔姆在萨法维王朝兴起时支持伊斯玛仪一世。末代首领沙韦尔迪夹在萨法维与奥斯曼之间，两次反叛阿拔斯一世，于1597年在昌古莱被杀，小卢尔斯坦遭分割，但其旁支仍以萨法维总督的身份继续治理此地。

en: The Kun Lo dynasty is the royal house of the Lao principality of Muang Sua, on the site of later Luang Prabang, tracing its line to Khun Lo, the legendary eldest son of Khun Borom and first Lao king, who was said to have seized Muang Sua from its indigenous inhabitants and died in 780. By the fourteenth century the line was represented by Phraya Khamphong, ruler of Muang Sua; his son Phi Fa was driven into exile for an indiscretion with one of the king's wives, at the Khmer court of Angkor, where Phi Fa's son Fa Ngum was born around 1316 and raised, and at sixteen he married a Khmer princess. With ten thousand troops supplied by the Khmer king, Fa Ngum returned up the Mekong, conquered the Lao mueangs and in 1353 founded the kingdom of Lan Xang Hom Khao, the Land of a Million Elephants and the White Parasol, with its capital at Xieng Dong Xieng Thong, later renamed Luang Prabang. He made Theravada Buddhism the state faith and installed the Phra Bang image as the kingdom's palladium. Driven out by his nobles in 1372, he was succeeded by his son Samsenethai, who secured Ming recognition in 1402; the house ruled Lan Xang until the kingdom was partitioned into Luang Prabang, Vientiane and Champasak in 1707.
zh: 坤洛王朝是老挝城邦勐苏瓦（在今琅勃拉邦一带）的王室，世系上溯至传奇君主坤洛——坤布伦的长子、传说中的第一位老挝王，相传他从当地原住民手中夺取勐苏瓦，于780年去世。14世纪时，在位的是勐苏瓦君主披耶坎蓬；其子陶披法因与父王妃嫔有染被逐，出逃高棉吴哥宫廷，陶披法之子法昂约于1316年在流亡中出生并在高棉长大。法昂娶高棉公主，凭高棉国王拨给的一万兵马沿湄公河北返，征服诸老挝城邦，于1353年建立澜沧洪考王国，意为百万大象与白伞之地，定都川东川通，后改名琅勃拉邦；他又把上座部佛教立为国教，以帕邦佛为护国之宝。1372年法昂被贵族驱逐，其子桑森泰继位，并于1402年得到明朝册封；该家族统治澜沧直至1707年王国分裂为琅勃拉邦、万象和占巴塞三国。

en: Ah Kʼicheʼ means a lord of the Kʼicheʼ, the Maya people of the Guatemalan highlands whose ruling dynasty governed from a succession of fortified capitals. Around 1200, Mexicanized invaders from the Gulf coast, called the Kʼicheʼ forefathers and bringing the worship of the sky god Tohil, conquered the highland valley and first settled at Jakawitz. They then moved to Pismachi, where the rulers Kʼoqaib and Kʼonache built a great ritual centre; the king bore the title ajpop, man of the mat, and power was shared among the noble houses of Kaweq, Nijaib, Saqik and Ajaw Kʼicheʼ. Around 1400 Kʼotuja's son Qʼuqʼumatz founded a new capital at nearby Qʼumarkaj, and under his son Kʼiqʼab the kingdom subdued the Tzʼutujil, Kaqchikel and Mam and stretched from the Motagua River to Chiapas. A noble rebellion in 1470 drove the Kaqchikel away to found Iximche, and Kʼiqʼab's death in 1475 began a long decline. After accepting Aztec overlordship in 1510, the Kʼicheʼ fell to Pedro de Alvarado in 1524: the war leader Tecún Umán died at Xelajú, the captured lords were burned alive and Qʼumarkaj was razed, its history preserved in the Popol Vuh.
zh: 阿基切意为“基切人的首领”。基切人是危地马拉高地的玛雅族群，其统治王朝接连以数座要塞城市为都。约1200年，一批来自墨西哥湾沿岸、深受墨西哥文化影响的入侵者——基切文献所称的“基切先祖”，带着天神托希尔信仰攻入高地山谷，先在哈卡维茨定居，随后迁往皮斯马奇；统治者科凯布和科纳切在此建起大型祭祀中心。国王号称“阿赫波普”，意为“席上之主”，权力由卡韦克、尼哈伊布、萨基克和阿赫基切几大贵族家族共享。约1400年，科图哈之子库库马茨在附近另建新都库马尔卡赫；到他儿子基卡布在位时，王国征服了特苏图希尔、卡克奇克尔和玛姆诸族，疆域从莫塔瓜河一直延伸到恰帕斯。1470年贵族叛乱，卡克奇克尔人出走并建立伊希姆切；1475年基卡布死后，国势长期衰落。1510年基切人接受阿兹特克宗主权，1524年又败于佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多：军事首领特昆·乌曼战死在谢拉胡，被俘的贵族被活活烧死，库马尔卡赫被夷为平地，他们的历史则保存在《波波尔·乌》之中。

en: The Kii, also called the Buzen-Utsunomiya, were a cadet branch of the Utsunomiya clan of Shimotsuke who became great landowners in Kii village of Buzen, in what is now Fukuoka. The line began when Nakahara Munehusa, second son of the Utsunomiya ancestor Fujiwara no Sōen, took up an estate steward post there in the Kamakura period. Under Utsunomiya Nobufusa, appointed shugo of Buzen, the clan built Kiidani Castle and reached its height, placing cadet houses across the province; his grandson Utsunomiya Nobukage was named by Minamoto no Yoritomo to the shogunate's council of state and as one of the four Kyūshū magistrates, overseeing the warriors of the island. From the seventh head, Fuyutsuna, in the Nanboku-chō wars the house declined, and in the Sengoku period it survived first as a client of the Ōuchi and, after their fall in 1557, of the Ōtomo. When the Shimazu advanced, Shigefusa Kii defected to them, but after Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyūshū campaign of 1587 he submitted and was ordered transferred to Iyo. Refusing to leave his ancestral lands, he held the mountain fastness of Kiidani against the Kuroda father and son, Yoshitaka and Nagamasa, defeating Nagamasa at Iwamaruyama before a starvation siege forced peace with his thirteen-year-old daughter Tsuruhime given as hostage. In 1588 Nagamasa lured Shigefusa to Nakatsu Castle and murdered him at a banquet; his heir Asafusa was killed and Tsuruhime was crucified with thirteen ladies-in-waiting by the Yamakuni river, ending the Kii as lords, though former retainers rose once more in 1600 behind Ōtomo Yoshimune of the western army and were defeated at Ishigakihara.
zh: 城井氏又称丰前宇都宫氏，是下野国名门宇都宫氏的分流，中世纪为丰前国仲津郡城井乡（在今天的福冈县境内）的大领主。镰仓时代，宇都宫始祖藤原宗圆的次子中原宗房以地头身份赴任城井乡，是为家族之始；宇都宫信房被任为丰前守护时修筑城井谷城，家族达到鼎盛，向丰前各郡分派庶流，其孙宇都宫信景还被源赖朝任命为幕府评定众和九州四奉行之一，统辖九州武士。南北朝时代第七代当主城井冬纲以后，家族迅速衰落，进入战国后先依附周防的大内氏，1557年大内氏灭亡后又改仕丰后的大友氏。岛津氏北上时，城井镇房倒向岛津，1587年丰臣秀吉九州征伐后又被迫归顺，并被命令转封伊予；镇房拒绝离开本领，据守天险城井谷城，与入主中津的黑田孝高、黑田长政父子对抗，在岩丸山之战中利用地形重创长政的军队，最后因兵粮攻才以十三岁的女儿鹤姬为人质议和。1588年，长政把镇房诱至中津城，在酒宴上将其谋杀，嫡子朝房同时遇害，鹤姬也被处磔刑、连同十三名侍女死于山国川河畔，城井氏作为大名的历史就此终结。1600年关原之战时，城井旧臣随西军的大友义统再起，又在石垣原之战中被孝高击败。

en: The Kikkawa were a samurai clan tracing descent from the Southern House of the Fujiwara through the Irie and Kudō families. In the late Heian period they settled at Kikkawa in the Irie estate of Suruga Province, from which they took their name, and they submitted to Minamoto no Yoritomo in the early years of the Kamakura shogunate. Service against Kajiwara Kagetoki in 1200 brought the Fukui estate in Harima, and after the Jōkyū War of 1221 the clan was made steward of the Ōasa estate in Aki, where the main line settled in 1313 and threw off branches in Iwami, Harima and Suruga. Through the Nanboku-chō and Muromachi years the Kikkawa acted as independent local lords of Aki, serving in turn the Ōuchi and the Amago. In 1550 the reigning head Kikkawa Okitsune was destroyed through a plot by Mōri Motonari, who placed his second son Motoharu into the family as its heir; together with the Kobayakawa, the Kikkawa became one of the Two Rivers upholding Mōri power, and Motoharu, who lived from 1530 to 1586, led troops in Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyūshū campaign. His son Hiroie, head from 1587, fought at the siege of Ulsan and issued a house code of 188 clauses; under the Tokugawa the Kikkawa ruled Iwakuni Domain in Suō Province down to the nineteenth century.
zh: 吉川氏是日本武家，自称出自藤原南家，经入江氏、工藤氏一脉相传。平安末期，其一族定居于骏河国入江庄的吉川，遂以吉川为姓，并在镰仓幕府初期臣从源赖朝。1200年追讨梶原景时立功，获封播磨国福井庄；1221年承久之乱后又被补任为安艺国大朝庄的地头，宗家于1313年正式土着于安艺，并分出石见、播磨、骏河等庶流。南北朝至室町时代，吉川氏以不隶属于守护的安艺国众身份活动，战国时先后从属于大内氏和尼子氏。1550年，当主吉川兴经在毛利元就的谋划下遇害，元就次子元春入继吉川家；此后吉川氏与小早川氏并称‘毛利两川’，共同辅佐毛利宗家。元春生于1530年、卒于1586年，曾作为丰臣秀吉的部将参加九州征伐；其子广家1587年继任家督，在朝鲜之役的蔚山之战中立功，并制定了多达188条的家法。江户时代，吉川氏作为周防国岩国藩主家延续至幕末。

en: The Kikuchi were one of the great warrior houses of Kyushu, ruling the Kikuchi district of Higo Province, in present-day Kumamoto Prefecture, from the late eleventh century. Their founder Noritaka, an official of the Dazaifu government who claimed Fujiwara descent, retired there in 1071 and built the castle town from which the family took its name. The house early made its name in border wars: its men helped repel the Toi raiders of 1019, and Kikuchi Takefusa became a celebrated hero fighting the Mongol landings of 1274 and 1281. In the Genpei War the sixth head Takanao backed Minamoto no Yoritomo and was executed after Dan-no-ura in 1185. Loyalty to the throne became the family's hallmark: in 1333 Taketoki attacked the Hōjō at Hakata on Emperor Go-Daigo's secret orders, only to be betrayed by the Ōtomo and Shōni and beheaded, and his sons Takeshige and Takemitsu carried on the Southern Court cause in Kyushu, losing at Tatarahama in 1336 but crushing the Shōni army at the Battle of Ōboharu on the Chikugo River in 1359. Hard pressed by the shogunate general Imagawa Sadayo, the house afterwards declined, and its Sengoku succession crises ended when the Ōtomo of Bungo absorbed Higo and Ōtomo Sōrin destroyed the last Kikuchi lord in 1554.
zh: 菊池氏是九州的大武士家族之一，11世纪末起领有肥后国菊池郡（今熊本县一带）。家祖则隆原为大宰府官吏，自称藤原氏后裔，1071年退隐当地并修筑城下町，遂以地名为苗字。菊池家早年以边境武功闻名：族人参与击退1019年的刀伊入寇，菊池武房更在1274年和1281年两次抵御蒙古登陆的战斗中成为名将。源平合战时，第六代家督隆直支持源赖朝，1185年坛之浦之战后被处死。忠于皇室成为这个家族的标志：1333年，武时奉后醍醐天皇密旨袭击博多的北条氏，却因大友、少贰的背叛而被捕斩首；其子武重、武光继续在九州为南朝奋战，1336年在多多良滨战败，1359年又在筑后川畔的大保原之战大破少贰军。在幕府将领今川贞世的压力下，菊池家此后渐衰；战国时代继嗣纷争不断，最终肥后被丰后的大友氏吞并，大友宗麟于1554年攻灭末代菊池家督，终结了这个名门。

en: The Kimotsuki were a warrior house of Osumi Province in southern Kyushu, descended from the ancient Tomo lineage. In the Heian period Tomo no Kaneyuki went down to Satsuma as a provincial official, and his descendants took office in Kimotsuki district of Osumi; Kanetoshi, head of the family around the twelfth century, adopted the district's name as his surname. During the Nanboku-cho wars the Kimotsuki fought for the Southern Court, and in the following centuries they served the Shimazu as local lords of eastern Osumi. The Sengoku period turned them into the Shimazu's most stubborn rival: allied by marriage and treaty with the Ito of Hyuga, the sixteenth head Kanetsugu defeated the Shimazu at Takeharayama, killing Takahisa's brother Tadamasa, and seized Shibushi, briefly gaining the upper hand, until a Shimazu counter-offensive drove him to suicide in 1566. His successor Kanesuke tried to continue the struggle but was deposed in 1573 by his own pro-Shimazu retainers and his stepmother Onan, Shimazu Takahisa's elder sister, and the head installed in his place, Kanemori, submitted to the Shimazu in 1574; in 1581 the family's lands were confiscated and the Kimotsuki ceased to be daimyo, continuing as Satsuma retainers. Kanemori died fighting at Sekigahara in 1600, while a junior line held the 5,500-koku Kiire fief through the Edo period and produced the celebrated reformer Komatsu Tatewaki.
zh: 肝付氏是九州南部大隅国的武家，本姓伴氏。平安时代，伴兼行出任萨摩掾赴任九州，其后代在大隅国肝属郡担任弁济使，到兼俊一代取郡名为苗字，称肝付氏。南北朝时期肝付氏追随南朝作战，之后作为大隅东部的国人臣服于岛津氏。战国时代，肝付氏成为岛津氏最强硬的对手：他们与日向伊东氏结盟，第十六代当主兼续是一代名将，在竹原山之战讨杀岛津贵久之弟忠将，又夺取志布志郡，一度压制岛津，直到1566年在岛津反攻中被迫自尽。后继的兼亮试图继续抗争，却于1573年被家中亲岛津派家臣和义母御南（岛津贵久之姐）联手废黜；被拥立的兼护于1574年向岛津称臣，1581年领地被没收，肝付氏大名之家灭亡，仅以岛津家臣身份存续。兼护于1600年关原之战中战死，其庶流在江户时代领有喜入五千五百石，幕末名臣小松带刀（清廉）即出自该支流。

en: The Kira were a cadet branch of the Ashikaga house, itself part of the Seiwa Genji line of the Minamoto clan descended from Emperor Seiwa. In the Kamakura period a son of Ashikaga Yoshiuji took the name Kira from the Kira estate in Mikawa Province, where the family served as land stewards, and a younger son founded the separate Oshu, later Musashi, Kira line. Kira Sadayoshi backed Ashikaga Takauji's strike against the Kamakura shogunate's Rokuhara deputies in 1333, and his son Mitsuyoshi held office in the Muromachi shogunate, where the Mikawa Kira ranked first among the Ashikaga Gosanke, the three houses treated as next in standing to the shogun himself. During the Nanboku-cho wars the Mikawa line split into the Saijo and Tojo branches. The Saijo joined the Mikawa Ikko-ikki rising and were destroyed in the Sengoku upheavals, while the Tojo and the Oshu Kira survived on small fiefs and entered the Edo period as hatamoto; Kira Yoshinaka, head of the family, was the shogunate official whose attack by the Ako ronin in 1703 became the story of Chushingura, and the surviving Kira houses kept their hatamoto standing into the nineteenth century.
zh: 吉良氏是足利氏的分家，而足利氏出自源氏的清和源氏一脉，祖先是清和天皇。镰仓时代，足利义氏之子以三河国吉良庄为苗字，其家族在当地担任地头；其弟另立奥州吉良家，即后来的武藏吉良家。吉良贞义支持足利尊氏，在1333年攻灭镰仓幕府的六波罗探题，其子满义在室町幕府任职。三河吉良位列足利御三家之首，地位仅次于将军，南北朝时期又分为西条与东条两支。西条吉良参加三河一向一揆，在战国动乱中灭亡；东条吉良与奥州吉良则凭狭小领地存续，进入江户时代后成为旗本。1703年，当主吉良义央遭到赤穗浪人袭击，即后世《忠臣藏》故事的原型；幸存的吉良各家以旗本身分延续至19世纪。

en: The rajas of Kishtwar ruled the upper Chenab valley in the Punjab Hills, their fortress-town already known to the twelfth-century chronicler Kalhana as Kashthavata in the Rajatarangini; its ruler Uttamaraja joined the hill chiefs who visited the court of the Kashmir raja Kalsa (r. 1063-1089). The long line of local Hindu rajas entered a new age in the seventeenth century, when the Iraqi Sufi Farid-ud-Din Baghdadi settled in Kishtwar around 1664 and propagated Islam. Under his influence Raja Kirat Singh accepted the faith and took the Muslim name Tegh Muhammad Singh, opening the Muslim phase of the dynasty. Its independence ended in 1821, when Gulab Singh of Jammu annexed Kishtwar for the Sikh Empire and carried its raja off to Lahore, where he died in prison.
zh: 吉什德瓦尔的罗阇统治着旁遮普山丘的杰纳布河上游谷地。这座堡垒城镇在12世纪史学家卡尔哈纳的《罗阇塔兰吉尼》中已以“卡什塔瓦塔”之名出现，其君主乌塔马拉贾曾与众山地首领一同入朝，觐见克什米尔罗阇卡尔萨（1063—1089年在位）。这个悠久的本土印度教罗阇世系在17世纪进入新阶段：伊拉克苏菲法里德丁·巴格达迪约于1664年定居吉什德瓦尔并传播伊斯兰教，罗阇基拉特·辛格在其影响下改宗，取穆斯林名泰格·穆罕默德·辛格，王朝由此进入穆斯林统治时期。1821年，查谟的古拉卜·辛格为锡克帝国吞并吉什德瓦尔，将这位罗阇押往拉合尔，后者最终死于狱中，家族的独立统治告终。

en: The Kitabatake were a house of court nobles and warriors descended from the Murakami Genji, through a branch of the Nakanoin lineage, who took their name from an estate in northern Kyoto where the courtier Masaie settled. Long close to the Daikakuji line of emperors, they rose to prominence at the end of the Kamakura period through Kitabatake Chikafusa, a pillar of Emperor Go-Daigo's Kenmu Restoration. After the restoration collapsed and the Southern Court withdrew to Yoshino, Chikafusa became its chief military and political mind and wrote the Jinno Shotoki, a history arguing the legitimacy of the Southern imperial line. His son Akiie, appointed to lead the court's forces in the far north, repeatedly marched armies out of Mutsu against the Ashikaga until he was killed in battle in 1338. A branch of the family established itself in Ise Province, where the Kitabatake ruled the south as provincial governors and transformed themselves into Sengoku daimyo; under Harutomo and his son Tomonori their power stretched across southern Ise into Shima, Iga, Yamato and Kii. The rise of Oda Nobunaga ended the house: his invasion of 1569 forced the family to adopt Nobunaga's son Nobukatsu as heir, and in 1576 the retired lord Tomonori and much of the clan were assassinated in the Mitsuse Incident, extinguishing the Ise Kitabatake.
zh: 北畠家（北畠氏）出身村上源氏中院家的庶流，因先祖雅家迁居京都北部的北畠而得名，是兼具公家与武家身份的世家。它与大觉寺统的天皇关系密切，镰仓末期凭借北畠亲房崭露头角：亲房是后醍醐天皇建武新政的支柱，新政瓦解、南朝退守吉野后，他又成为南朝的军事与政治核心，并写下论证南朝正统的《神皇正统记》。其长子北畠显家受命统领奥州兵马，屡次自陆奥南下讨伐足利氏，最终于1338年战死。此后一族的支系进入伊势国，以南伊势为根据地担任国司，逐渐演变为战国大名；在晴具、具教两代治下，势力遍及南伊势并延伸至志摩、伊贺、大和与纪伊。织田信长的崛起终结了这个家族：1569年信长入侵伊势，迫使北畠家收其次子信雄为养子，1576年隐居的具教及大批族人在三濑之变中遭暗杀，伊势北畠氏就此灭亡。

en: The first comital house of Cleves sprang from the same Lower Rhine nobility as the Wassenbergs: around 1020 Emperor Henry II enfeoffed the brothers Gerhard and Rutger Flamens, and while Gerhard founded the Guelders line, Rutger's descendants became the counts of Cleves, first styling themselves after Kleve Castle in 1092. Their seat was the Schwanenburg, or Swan Castle, at Cleves, and in later legend the family traced its origin to a swan knight akin to Lohengrin. The county grew around the lands between Cleves and Kalkar, with the counts founding the collegiate churches of Wissel and Bedburg, and in 1283 Cleves joined the War of the Limburg Succession against Cologne, gaining Zevenaar from Guelders in 1355. The thirteenth and fourteenth centuries were dominated by counts named Dietrich and Otto, whose daughters and sisters married into the neighbouring houses of the Marck and Waldeck. When Count John died without a male heir in 1368, the county passed to his nephew Adolf III of the Marck, and from 1391 Cleves and the Marck were ruled in personal union by the House of La Marck, whose head was raised to Duke of Cleves by King Sigismund in 1417.
zh: 第一代克莱沃伯爵世家与瓦森贝格家族同出下莱茵贵族：约1020年，皇帝亨利二世把领地封给格拉尔德·弗拉门斯与鲁特格尔·弗拉门斯兄弟，格拉尔德开创了海尔德兰一系，鲁特格尔的后裔则成为克莱沃伯爵，并于1092年首次以克莱沃城堡为号。他们的治所是克莱沃的天鹅堡，后世传说还把家族祖先附会为类似罗恩格林的天鹅骑士。伯国以克莱沃与卡尔卡尔之间的土地为核心扩张，伯爵们建立了维瑟尔和贝德堡修士会；1283年，克莱沃参加林堡继承战争对抗科隆，1355年又从海尔德兰取得泽芬纳尔。13至14世纪的伯爵多取名迪特里希和奥托，他们的女儿、姐妹纷纷嫁入邻邦马克与瓦尔德克家族。1368年伯爵约翰无男嗣而终，伯国传给外甥马克的阿道夫三世；1391年起克莱沃与马克由拉马克家族联合统治，其家主于1417年被国王西吉斯蒙德擢升为克莱沃公爵。

en: The Kobayakawa traced their name to Kobayakawa gō in Ashigara district of Sagami Province, where local lords of that name appear as early as the Nara period. The warrior house known in later centuries was founded early in the Kamakura period by Kobayakawa Tohira, a son of the Taira commander Dohi Sanehira, who claimed Kanmu Heishi descent; the family soon gained the jitō office of the Numata manor in Aki Province and grew into a leading Chūgoku kokujin house. Under the third head Shigehira, his sons split the family into the Numata and Takehara branches. The clan's great age came when Mōri Motonari placed his third son Takakage into the Numata headship: together with the Kikkawa, heirs to another Motonari son, the two houses were known as the Two Rivers of the Mōri, and Takakage became a trusted counselor of Toyotomi Hideyoshi and one of the Five Elders, receiving Chikuzen after the Kyūshū campaign of 1587. He died in 1597, and the headship passed to Hideaki, Hideyoshi's nephew. At Sekigahara in 1600 Hideaki's sudden switch to the Tokugawa side helped decide the battle, but he died heirless in 1602 and the house was attainted. A cadet line of the Mōri revived the Kobayakawa name as barons in the Meiji nobility.
zh: 小早川氏的名字源于相模国足柄郡的小早川乡，早在奈良时代，当地就有以小早川为姓的豪族活动。后世知名的武家小早川氏由平安末期武将土肥实平之子远平在镰仓初期开创，自称桓武平氏后裔；其家很快获得安艺国沼田庄的地头职，从此在中国地方发展成有力国人。第三代当主茂平的两个儿子又分出沼田小早川氏和竹原小早川氏两支。小早川氏的鼎盛期始于战国：毛利元就把三男隆景送入沼田家继承家督，隆景与继承吉川氏的兄长并称“毛利两川”，他本人深受丰臣秀吉信任，位列五大老，1587年九州征伐后受封筑前国。隆景于1597年去世，家督由秀吉的外甥秀秋继承。1600年关原之战中，小早川秀秋突然倒戈东军，一举决定了战局，但他在1602年便无嗣而终，小早川家遭到除封。直到明治时代，毛利公爵家的一个分家才再兴小早川家名，位列男爵。

en: The Komnenos Asen family sprang from the highest Bulgarian nobility. John Komnenos Asen was a son of Sratsimir, despot of Kran, and Keratsa Petritsa, herself a descendant of the Asen tsars, and a brother of Tsar Ivan Alexander of Bulgaria and Helena, wife of the Serbian ruler Stephen Dušan. Around 1345, after Dušan's conquest of southern Albania, John was granted the title of despot and put in charge of Valona, Kanina and Berat. He adopted the Byzantine surname Komnenos, signed his charters in Greek and married Anna Palaiologina, widow of the Epirote ruler John II Orsini. After Dušan died in 1355 he ruled the Principality of Valona as an effectively independent lord, holding citizenship of both Venice and Ragusa and growing rich on Adriatic trade, until he died of the plague in 1363. His likely son Alexander succeeded him and ruled until about 1371; after Alexander's death Valona and Kanina passed to Balsha II through marriage, ending the family's rule.
zh: 科穆宁·阿森家族出身于保加利亚最高层贵族。约翰·科穆宁·阿森是克兰专制公斯拉齐米尔与阿森王朝后裔克拉察·佩特里察之子，也是保加利亚沙皇伊凡·亚历山大和塞尔维亚统治者斯特凡·杜尚之妻海伦娜的兄弟。约1345年杜尚征服阿尔巴尼亚南部后，约翰获封专制公，受命管辖发罗拉、卡尼纳和培拉特。他改用拜占庭姓氏科穆宁，以希腊语签署文书，并娶伊庇鲁斯统治者约翰二世·奥尔西尼的遗孀安娜·巴列奥略为妻。1355年杜尚死后，他作为事实上独立的领主统治发罗拉公国，同时拥有威尼斯和拉古萨的公民身份，靠亚得里亚海贸易致富，直至1363年死于瘟疫。继位者可能是他的儿子亚历山大，统治到约1371年；亚历山大死后，发罗拉和卡尼纳随婚姻转入巴尔沙二世之手，该家族的统治就此终结。

en: The Komnenos were a Byzantine Greek military aristocracy, traditionally traced to the village of Komne in Thrace; their first known member, Manuel Erotikos Komnenos, built up estates at Kastamon in Paphlagonia. Isaac I Komnenos seized the throne in 1057 but abdicated two years later, and the family's great age began when his nephew Alexios I became emperor in 1081, in the aftermath of the disaster at Manzikert. Alexios, his son John II and his grandson Manuel I, who reigned until 1180, rebuilt the empire's power and fought Normans, Pechenegs and Turks, though Manuel's defeat at Myriokephalon in 1176 checked the recovery. The ruthless Andronikos I, emperor from 1183, was killed in 1185 and the Angeloi took Constantinople, while a separate Komnenian regime on Cyprus under Isaac Komnenos fell to Richard I of England in 1191. Weeks before the Fourth Crusade sacked Constantinople in 1204, Alexios and David Komnenos, grandsons of Andronikos I, founded the Empire of Trebizond on the Black Sea with Georgian help. Its rulers styled themselves the Grand Komnenoi and outlasted every other Byzantine successor state: in 1337 the throne belonged to Basil Megas Komnenos, who had ruled since 1332, and the empire only fell to Mehmed II after a month-long siege in 1461. The last emperor, David Komnenos, and his family were executed by the Ottomans in 1463.
zh: 科穆宁家族是拜占庭希腊人的军事贵族世家，传统上溯源于色雷斯的科姆内村；已知最早的成员曼努埃尔·厄洛提科斯·科穆宁在帕夫拉戈尼亚的卡斯塔莫农积累了大批地产。伊萨克一世·科穆宁于1057年夺取皇位，两年后即退位；家族的辉煌时代始于他的侄子阿历克塞一世在1081年登基，时值曼齐刻尔特惨败之后。阿历克塞、其子约翰二世和统治到1180年的孙子曼努埃尔一世重振帝国，先后抗击诺曼人、佩切涅格人和突厥人，不过1176年曼努埃尔在密列奥塞法隆的失利遏制了复兴势头。1183年登位的安德洛尼卡一世行事酷烈，1185年被杀，安格洛斯家族入主君士坦丁堡；伊萨克·科穆宁在塞浦路斯建立的割据政权也于1191年被英格兰的理查一世攻灭。1204年第四次十字军洗劫君士坦丁堡前夕，安德洛尼卡一世的两个孙子阿历克塞和大卫·科穆宁在格鲁吉亚帮助下于黑海之滨建立特拉布宗帝国。其君主自称“大科穆宁”，国祚比任何拜占庭继承国都长：1337年在位的是1332年登基的瓦西里·大科穆宁，而帝国直到1461年才在持续一个月的围攻后被穆罕默德二世攻灭。末代皇帝大卫·科穆宁及其家人于1463年被奥斯曼人处死。

en: The Koto were a local warrior magnate house of Nagato Province, whose original surname was Mononobe and whose genealogy claimed the seventh-century magnate Mononobe no Moriya as ancestor; the early head Taketada settled at Tanai in the eastern part of Asa district, from which the family expanded. In the Genpei War they first fought for the Taira at Ichinotani and then changed sides, earning lordship of the Koto district for their part in the Battle of Dannoura. On the shogunate's orders they also campaigned beside the Ouchi against the Mongol landings of 1274 and 1281. Koto Takezane broke with the Hojo deputy in the Genko War and was rewarded in 1334 with the constableship of Nagato, which his son Takemura and two more heads held in turn, Takemura receiving lands in Kiku district of Buzen Province. The Kannō Disturbance split the house between the Northern and Southern courts, and the Ouchi, who had taken the Southern side, overran Nagato: in 1358 Yoshitake abandoned his base at Shimofuri Castle and lost Chofu, and although Kikuchi Takemitsu's aid let him make a truce with the Ouchi and briefly return to Shimofuri, the Koto then vanish from the records, which is taken as the end of the house. In 1362 Ouchi Hiroyo was formally named constable of Nagato, and only the cadet Akiyoshi branch kept the name alive as retainers.
zh: 厚东氏是长门国的在地豪族，本姓物部，系谱自称祖先是7世纪的大连物部守屋；早期当主武忠在厚狭郡东部的棚井筑馆定居，家族由此扩张。源平合战时，他们起初作为平氏一方参加一之谷之战，后来倒向源氏，凭坛之浦之战的军功成为厚东郡的领主。1274年和1281年的元军来袭中，厚东氏又奉镰仓幕府之命与大内氏一同出阵。元弘之乱时，厚东武实背离长门探题北条时直，1334年受封长门守护，其子武村又拜领丰前国企救郡的领地，连同他共四代人连任长门守护。观应之扰乱使厚东一家在北朝与南朝之间分裂，站队南朝的大内氏大举进攻长门：1358年，厚东义武放弃据点霜降城，随后又丢失长府，虽靠菊池武光的援救一度议和复位，此后却再无音讯，被视为厚东氏灭亡的时期。1362年，大内弘世正式就任长门守护，只有庶流秋吉氏作为家臣延续了厚东的血脉。

en: The Kotromanić were the ruling dynasty of medieval Bosnia. Their first reliably attested member, Prijezda I, was a Hungarian vassal who became Ban of Bosnia around 1250, holding little beyond the valley of the river Bosna. The family's fortunes rose under Stephen II, who defeated the Dalmatian Šubić family in 1322 and doubled Bosnia's territory from the Sava to the Adriatic coast; his daughter Elizabeth married King Louis I of Hungary in 1353. Stephen's nephew Tvrtko I succeeded in 1353, conquered lands from the crumbling Serbian Empire in 1373 and had himself crowned king of Bosnia and Serbia in 1377, claiming the legacy of the extinct Nemanjić dynasty; between 1385 and 1390 he also seized much of Dalmatia and Croatia and repelled the first Ottoman raids. After Tvrtko's death in 1391 the realm weakened under his successors. The last sovereign, Stephen Tomašević, briefly ruled as Despot of Serbia in 1459 and as King of Bosnia from 1461 until the Ottoman conquest of 1463 ended both his reign and the dynasty's rule.
zh: 科特罗马尼奇王朝是中世纪波斯尼亚的统治家族。第一位可确考的成员普里耶兹达一世是匈牙利的附庸，约1250年成为波斯尼亚巴恩，当时其势力几乎不出博斯纳河流域。家族在斯特凡二世治下发迹：他于1322年击败达尔马提亚的舒比奇家族，把波斯尼亚领土扩大一倍，疆域从萨瓦河一直延伸到亚得里亚海；他的女儿伊丽莎白于1353年嫁给匈牙利国王拉约什一世。斯特凡的侄子特维科一世于1353年继位，1373年从瓦解中的塞尔维亚帝国夺取土地，1377年加冕为波斯尼亚兼塞尔维亚国王，宣称继承已绝嗣的内马尼奇王朝遗产；1385年至1390年间他又攻占达尔马提亚和克罗地亚的大片土地，并击退了奥斯曼人的最初几次袭击。1391年特维科死后，国家在后继者手中走向衰弱。末代君主斯特凡·托马舍维奇曾于1459年短暂出任塞尔维亚专制公，1461年起任波斯尼亚国王，1463年奥斯曼征服终结了他的统治，也终结了该王朝的政权。

en: The Kō were a samurai clan based in the Ashikaga estate of Shimotsuke Province, who claimed descent from the ancient Takashina lineage and had served the Ashikaga family as hereditary stewards since the Kamakura period. Their heyday came under Kō no Moronao, steward to Ashikaga Takauji: he sat on the Kenmu government's board of claims as Takauji's deputy, and after the Muromachi shogunate was founded he and his brother Moroyasu filled its highest offices while their armies killed Kitabatake Akiie and Kusunoki Masatsura and pressed the Southern Court in Yoshino to the edge of destruction. Moronao's arrogance then pitted him against Takauji's brother Tadayoshi, sparking the Kannō Disturbance of 1350. He briefly forced Tadayoshi from power, but Tadayoshi made common cause with the Southern Court and routed him at Uchidehama in Settsu; after surrendering, Moronao and Moroyasu were cut down with most of the clan by men of Uesugi Yoshinori at the Mukō River while being escorted north, and the Kanto leader Morofuyu was also driven to suicide. Survivors who had sided with Tadayoshi kept the name alive: Moroari briefly held the post of Kanto Kanrei and Morohide served as Constable of Yamashiro and Sado, the last of the clan to reach such rank. Thereafter the Kō served the Kamakura and Koga Kubō and, into the Sengoku years, as shogunal guardsmen, one of their number dying beside Ashikaga Yoshiteru in 1565.
zh: 高氏是以在下野国足利庄为据点的武家，自称源自古老的高阶氏，自镰仓时代起便世代担任足利氏的执事，总管其家政。它的鼎盛在高师直一代：师直作为足利尊氏的执事，在建武新政中以尊氏代理的身份位列杂诉决断所；室町幕府建立后，他与弟弟师泰及一族的师冬等人占据要职，军事上讨杀北畠显家、楠木正行，攻入吉野，把南朝逼到崩溃边缘。但师直日益骄横，与尊氏之弟足利直义对立，酿成1350年的观应之乱。他一度迫使直义失势，直义却转投南朝反攻，在摄津打出滨将其击溃；师直、师泰投降后在押送途中于武库川被上杉能宪的部下杀害，一族大半同时覆灭，坐镇关东的师冬也兵败自尽。站在直义一方的幸存者延续了家名：师有曾短期出任关东管领，师英则历任山城、佐渡守护，这也是高氏最后一次跻身守护之列。此后高氏子孙转而侍奉镰仓公方、古河公方，到室町末期还以将军亲卫队奉公众的身份活动，其中高师宣于1565年随足利义辉在永禄之变中战死。

en: The Kosaka, also written with the characters for Takasaka, were a Shinano warrior house of the Shigeno clan, descended from Sadayuki, a fifth son of the Nezu family, one of the three great Shigeno houses; their name came from Kosaka in Saku district, present-day Saku City. The first head Munekiyo is thought to have become a newly appointed jito in northern Shinano with lands confiscated after the Jokyu War of 1221, and the family built its strength running private ranches in the mountains south of the Zenkoji plain, acquiring its seat at Makinoshima around 1260. In 1336 the sixth head Shinkaku raised the Southern Court banner at Maki Castle in the wake of the Nakasendai disturbance, acting alongside remnants of the Hojo; the rising was put down by the Murakami and Takana clans, though the castle itself held. Kosaka bands later served in the Oto War of 1400 and the Yuki campaign of 1440. During the Takeda conquest of Shinano the head Munishige first followed Murakami Yoshikiyo and then submitted to Takeda Shingen, who in 1556 moved him to Matsushiro; but in 1561 Munishige was executed at Kaizu Castle on suspicion of dealing with the Uesugi, ending the direct line. Kasuga Toratsuna, who had married a Kosaka daughter, inherited the family name and is better known as Kosaka Masanobu, the celebrated Takeda general and keeper of Kaizu. Cadet lines survived as retainers of the Uesugi at Yonezawa and of the Hoshina at Takato.
zh: 香坂氏又写作高坂氏，是信浓国的武家，属于滋野一族，祖先是滋野三家之一禰津氏当主禰津宗直的第五子贞行，苗字取自佐久郡的香坂（今佐久市香坂）。初代宗清被认为是1221年承久之乱后，凭滋野一党追随执权北条方的战功，获封北信浓没收地的新补地头之一；香坂氏在善光寺平南部的山间经营私牧积蓄实力，约1260年得到牧之岛作为根据地。1336年，六代当主香坂心觉趁中先代之乱的余波，在牧城竖起南朝旗帜举兵，与北条残党相呼应，虽被村上信贞、高梨经赖等北朝方镇压，牧城却始终未被攻破。此后香坂一族还参加了1400年的大塔合战和1440年的结城合战。武田氏侵攻信浓时，当主香坂宗重起初从属村上义清，最终臣服于武田信玄，1556年奉命移封埴科郡英多庄（今松代）；但1561年，宗重因被怀疑私通上杉氏，在海津城被诛，香坂嫡流断绝。娶了香坂氏之女的春日虎纲继承其名迹，即后世熟知的武田名将、海津城代高坂昌信（高坂弹正忠）。其支流则作为上杉氏家臣在米泽、保科氏家臣在高远延续到江户时代。

en: The Kōzai of Sanuki claimed descent from the Northern House of the Fujiwara through the Sanuki Fujiwara. In the Gempei War their forebear Fujiwara no Sukemitsu fought at the battles of Mizushima in 1183 and Yashima in 1185, the latter in the camp of Minamoto no Yoshitsune, and Yoritomo confirmed his holdings in Aya district. After the Jōkyū War of 1221 his kinsman Nii Sukemura, rewarded for his service with twelve villages in Kagawa district and four in Aya, built Shōga Castle on Mount Shōga and took the new surname Kōzai. The house grew into the greatest kokujin power of eastern Sanuki, and in Muromachi times served the Keichō branch of the Hosokawa, the kanrei house: in the Ōnin War its head Motosuke fought as a retainer of Hosokawa Katsumoto and was counted, with the Kagawa, Yasutomi and Nara, among the Four Heavenly Kings of the Hosokawa. The family then split into an upper line that held office in Kyoto and Yamashiro, and a lower line that kept the Sanuki lands; the upper line's Motonaga took part in the murder of Hosokawa Masamoto in 1507 and was soon killed in the infighting that followed. In the Sengoku age the lower line under Motosada wielded the Shiwaku island fleet, dominated the Bisan Strait and even traded with Korea in 1531, the height of the house, before being drawn under Miyoshi and then Chōsokabe overlordship; the last head Yoshikiyo surrendered to the Chōsokabe in 1582 and fought on their side against Hideyoshi's Shikoku invasion of 1585, after which he lost his fief and ended his days on a pension from Sengoku Hidehisa and Ikoma Chikamasa, the new lords of Sanuki.
zh: 赞岐香西氏自称出自藤原北家的赞岐藤原氏。源平合战时，祖先藤原资光在1183年水岛之战和1185年屋岛之战中加入源义经阵营立功，源赖朝下感状安堵其阿野郡领地。1221年承久之乱后，同族的新居资村因战功获封香川郡十二乡与阿野郡四乡，在胜贺山修筑胜贺城，并改姓香西。此后香西氏发展为赞岐东部最有势力的国人，室町时代出仕管领细川京兆家，当主香西元资在应仁之乱中作为细川胜元的内众活跃，与香川、安富、奈良三家并称“细川四天王”。后来一族分为在京都、山城任职的上香西氏和留守赞岐本领的下香西氏：上香西的香西元长参与了1507年暗杀细川政元的永正错乱，旋即在内讧中被讨杀。下香西氏在香西元定时代拥有塩饱水军、称雄备赞濑户，1531年还派船赴朝鲜贸易，达到鼎盛；此后先后被纳入三好氏、长宗我部氏的伞下。末代当主香西佳清于1582年降于长宗我部氏，1585年又在丰臣秀吉的四国征伐中战败下野，靠仙石秀久、生驹亲正给的扶持度过余生。

en: The Kubadids, in Turkish the Kubadoğulları or Altunbaşoğulları, were a small Turkmen emirate of the Canik group on Anatolia's Black Sea coast, with their capital at Lâdik and lands around Samsun and Kavak. Their founder Tâceddin Altunbaş was a son of the Seljuk sultan Mesud II of Rûm, and the Ilkhan granted him Amasya and the surrounding country after his father's death in 1308; from about 1318 he ruled independently from Lâdik, making the Kubadids a last offshoot of the Seljuk royal house. His son Keykubad, the dynasty's only member alive in 1337, kept the Ladik seat while becoming a vassal of the stronger Kutluşah rulers of Amasya, and Keykubad's son Ali was the first to bear the name Kubadoğlu. The family's long feud with the neighbouring Taceddinoğulları centred on control of Samsun, which Ali and his son Cüneyd held together with Bafra at the beylik's greatest extent. Bayezid I annexed Samsun in 1398 but left the Kubadids as Ottoman vassals, and Timur's victory at Ankara in 1402 allowed them a brief restoration; Ottoman reconquest under Mehmed I followed, Cüneyd was killed, and after a final attempt by Hüseyin Bey in 1422 the emirate disappeared, its surviving line said to have migrated to the Caucasus.
zh: 库巴德家族在土耳其语中称库巴德奥乌拉勒，又名阿尔通巴什奥乌拉勒，是安纳托利亚黑海沿岸卡尼克诸贝伊国中的一个小型土库曼埃米尔国，以拉迪克为都，领有萨姆松和卡瓦克一带。开国者塔吉丁·阿尔通巴什是鲁姆塞尔柱苏丹梅苏德二世之子，1308年其父死后由伊儿汗把阿马西亚及周边地区封给他；约1318年起他在拉迪克独立施政，使库巴德成为塞尔柱王室最后的支脉。他的儿子凯库巴德（即1337年家族唯一在世的成员）坐守拉迪克，同时向更强的阿马西亚库特卢沙赫统治者称臣，凯库巴德之子阿里则是第一个冠以库巴德奥卢名号的人。家族与邻邦塔吉丁奥乌拉勒长期相争，核心是争夺萨姆松，阿里及其子居内伊德在位时势力一度扩及萨姆松和巴夫拉，达到极盛。1398年巴耶济德一世吞并萨姆松，但保留库巴德家族为奥斯曼附庸；1402年帖木儿在安卡拉获胜后他们一度复国，随后穆罕默德一世重新征服该地区，居内伊德被杀，1422年侯赛因贝伊最后一次夺回萨姆松的尝试也告失败，埃米尔国就此终结，据说幸存的族人迁徙到了高加索。

en: The Kudō were a clan of the Fujiwara southern house, whose name began in the mid-ninth century when Fujiwara no Tamenori, holding the court office of Mokunosuke, or assistant in the woodworkers' bureau, was styled Kudō Taifu. His grandson Korekage became governor of Suruga, founding the Suruga Kudō around whose seat in Abe district the clan was centered, while other branches spread into Izu and Kai. The Izu Kudō threw off a swarm of local houses — Itō, Kanō, Kawazu and Sameshima among them — and the Itō later migrated to Hyūga in the Nanboku-chō period and grew into Sengoku daimyō; other Kudō lines took the names Irie, Hara and Nikaidō, and the Ii of Tōtōmi later claimed Kudō blood. The clan's early fame was violent: Kudō Suketsune's murder of Kawazu Sukeyasu provoked the revenge of the Soga brothers, one of the best-known vendettas of the early shogunate, while Kudō Shigemitsu became ancestor of the Kanō family whose painter descendants founded the Kanō school. In the Sengoku age a Kai branch served the Takeda; Sukenaga Kudō was adopted into the Naitō name as Naitō Masahide, ranked among Takeda Shingen's twenty-four generals, and fell at Nagashino in 1575, after which surviving Kudō entered Tokugawa service when the Takeda were destroyed in 1582.
zh: 工藤氏是出自藤原南家的氏族。9世纪中期，藤原为宪担任木工助，被称为工藤大夫，家名由此而来；其孙维景出任骏河守，开创了以骏河安倍一带为本据的骏河工藤，另有支族迁往伊豆和甲斐。伊豆工藤分出大量以地名为姓的家族，如伊藤、狩野、河津、鲛岛等，其中伊藤氏在南北朝时代移居日向，后来发展为战国大名；入江、原、二阶堂等氏也出自工藤，远江的井伊氏还自称是其后裔。工藤家早年的声名带着血腥味：工藤祐经杀害河津祐泰，引出曾我兄弟复仇事件，成为镰仓初期最著名的仇讨之一；工藤茂光则是狩野氏之祖，其后人开创了日本画的狩野派。战国时代，甲斐的一支工藤出仕武田氏，工藤祐长继承内藤家名、改名内藤昌秀，位列武田信玄的二十四将之一，1575年战死于长篠；1582年武田氏灭亡后，幸存的工藤族人转而侍奉德川氏。

en: The Kurani were the leading family of the Guran, also called Goran, a Kurdish tribe of the Kermanshah country whose main seats were Dartang, around Rijab on the Zohab plain where Qasr-e Shirin stands, and Darneh in the Zimkan valley. Vladimir Minorsky suggested their ancestors came from the Caspian provinces and migrated to the Zagros under the Sasanians, and saw a possible early reference in the Guranii mentioned by Strabo. Medieval Muslim sources knew them as the Juraqan, and in 1014 the Guran killed their former ally Badr ibn Hasanwayh. Around 1343 the geographer al-Umari called them powerful and bellicose, made up of soldiers and peasants, and placed them at Rawst, led by an amir named Muhammad, and at Dartang, the earliest definite link between the tribe and its later homeland. In his chronicle of 1596 Sharaf Khan Bidlisi counted the Guran among the four main branches of the Kurds, with the Kurmanj, Lur and Kalhur, noting that most then lived under Kalhur and Ardalan rule. After the Ottoman sultan Murad IV gave Zohab to the Bajilan, the Guran recovered the leadership only in the early nineteenth century under the chiefs of Qaleh Zanjir.
zh: 库拉尼家族是库尔德古兰部落（一译戈兰）的首领家族。古兰部落活动在克尔曼沙阿一带，主要据点是佐哈布平原上里贾布附近的达尔坦格（即今席林堡所在地）以及齐姆坎河谷的达尔内。学者米诺尔斯基认为，其先民来自里海沿岸诸省，可能在萨珊王朝时期迁入扎格罗斯山区，斯特拉波笔下的古拉尼伊人或即其前身。中世纪穆斯林文献称他们为朱拉坎人，1014年古兰人杀死了昔日的盟友巴德尔·本·哈桑韦赫。约1343年，地理学家欧麦里记载古兰人“强悍好战”，由士兵和农民组成，分别居住在首领穆罕默德治下的拉乌斯特和达尔坦格，这是该部落与后世故乡最早的明确联系。1596年，沙拉夫汗·比特利西在其史书中把古兰人与库尔曼吉人、卢尔人、卡尔胡人并列为库尔德人的四大支派，并称当时多数古兰人臣属于卡尔胡尔和阿尔达兰。奥斯曼苏丹穆拉德四世把佐哈布封给巴吉兰人后，古兰人直到19世纪初才在加勒津吉尔首领的带领下重新取得主导地位。

en: The Kusunoki were a warrior clan of Kawachi Province in the southern Kinai region, who claimed descent from the ancient Tachibana lineage, although their exact origins remain uncertain. They enter history with Kusunoki Masashige, who answered Emperor Go-Daigo's call against the Kamakura shogunate in the Genko War of 1331, holding the mountain fortresses of Akasaka and Chihaya against far larger shogunate armies. After the shogunate fell he served the Kenmu Restoration, but when Ashikaga Takauji turned against the court, Masashige was defeated and met his death at the Battle of Minatogawa in 1336, becoming the most celebrated loyalist of the Southern Court. His sons Masatsura and Masatoki and his brother Masasue likewise died fighting the Ashikaga, while another son, Masanori, survived the clan's reverses and more than once mediated between the two rival courts. The family's fortunes sank with the Southern Court, yet the memory of Masashige's loyalty spread through the military chronicle Taiheiki, and in the Sengoku period a self-styled descendant, Kusunoki Masatora, obtained the court's removal of the traitor label from his name.
zh: 楠木氏是以畿内南部河内国为根据地的武家豪族，自称出自古老的橘氏，确切谱系则众说纷纭。它在史料中崭露头角是在1331年的元弘之乱：楠木正成响应后醍醐天皇讨伐镰仓幕府的号召，凭借赤坂、千早等山城以少抗多。幕府灭亡后他出仕建武新政，足利尊氏背叛朝廷后，正成于1336年的凑川之战兵败自尽，成为南朝最著名的忠臣楷模。他的儿子正行、正时和弟弟正季也先后在与足利氏的作战中战死，唯有儿子正仪在家族屡遭挫败后幸存，并多次在两朝之间斡旋议和。楠木氏的势力随南朝衰落而沉寂，但借助军记物语《太平记》的流传，正成的忠名日益高涨；到战国时代，自称其后代的楠木正虎奔走于朝廷，最终为正成洗去了朝敌的污名。

en: Kutai Kartanegara was the coastal rival and eventual heir of old Martapura, founded around 1300 at Kutai Lama near the mouth of the Mahakam river in eastern Borneo. Its first ruler, Aji Batara Agung Dewa Sakti, and his successor Aji Batara Agung Paduka Nira bore Hindu-Javanese titles that show close cultural contact with Majapahit, and court legend traced Paduka Nira to the river princess Putri Karang Melenu, remembered in the Erau coronation festival. For two and a half centuries the kingdom grew wealthy on the Mahakam river trade, until Islam, brought by the missionary Tuan Tunggang Parangan, became the official faith in 1575 under Raja Aji Mahkota. In 1635 its ruler Pangeran Sinum Panji Mendapa sent troops upriver, killed the Martapura maharaja Dermasatia after seven days of fighting, and united the two Kutai realms as Kutai Kartanegara ing Martapura. The court later moved its capital to Jembayan in 1732 and to Tenggarong in 1782, by which time Dutch traders and warships had become a growing presence on the Borneo coast.
zh: 古泰-卡塔内加拉是古老摩多补罗的沿海竞争者，也是其最终继承者，约1300年建于婆罗洲东部马哈坎河河口附近的古泰拉玛。初代君主阿吉·巴塔拉·阿贡·德瓦·萨克蒂与继任者阿吉·巴塔拉·阿贡·帕杜卡·尼拉使用印度教—爪哇式头衔，显示出与满者伯夷密切的文化接触；宫廷传说把帕杜卡·尼拉的身世追溯到河神公主普特里·卡朗·梅莱努，这一故事保存在埃劳登基庆典的传统中。此后两个半世纪，王国靠马哈坎河贸易致富；16世纪，传教士端·东冈·帕朗安带来伊斯兰教，1575年罗阇·阿吉·马科塔在位时定伊斯兰教为国教。1635年，君主潘格兰·西努姆·潘吉·门达帕发兵溯河而上，激战七天后杀死摩多补罗的摩诃罗阇德尔马萨蒂亚，将两个古泰政权合并为古泰-卡塔内加拉·因·摩多补罗。王廷后来于1732年迁都真巴扬，1782年再迁登加龙，此时荷兰商船与战舰已在婆罗洲海岸日益活跃。

en: The Martapura kings, better known to historians as the dynasty of Kutai Martadipura, ruled the oldest Hindu kingdom attested in the Indonesian archipelago from their capital at Muara Kaman on the upper Mahakam river in eastern Borneo. Seven Sanskrit yupa, or sacrificial posts, carved in Pallava script at Bukit Brubus preserve its early line: the local founder Kudungga, his son Asvavarman, the first to bear an Indianised name, and his grandson Mulavarman, who around 400 styled himself lord of kings and recorded lavish gifts of gold and thousands of cattle to brahmin priests, the earliest firm evidence of Indian statecraft in the Malay world. After Mulavarman the sources fall silent for many centuries, and the inland kingdom is known in this later age chiefly as the older neighbour of the coastal state of Kutai Kartanegara, founded at Kutai Lama around 1300. In 1635 Kartanegara attacked upriver and, after seven days of fighting, killed Maharaja Dermasatia and annexed Muara Kaman, merging the two realms under the name Kutai Kartanegara ing Martapura.
zh: 摩多补罗诸王，史家多称古泰·摩罗迪补罗王朝，在婆罗洲东部马哈坎河上游的穆阿拉卡曼建都，统治着印度尼西亚群岛可考的最古老印度教王国。武吉布鲁布斯出土的七根帕拉瓦文梵语尤帕祭柱保存了早期世系：本土开国之君贡东加、首个使用印度化名字的儿子阿湿瓦瓦尔曼，以及其孙穆拉瓦尔曼；后者约在400年自称王中之王，碑文记载他向婆罗门祭司慷慨施舍黄金和数以千计的牛，这是马来世界有明确印度式政权的最早证据。穆拉瓦尔曼之后史料沉寂了许多世纪，人们只知道这个内陆王国是1300年前后在古泰拉玛兴起的沿海国家古泰-卡塔内加拉的西邻。1635年，卡塔内加拉溯河来攻，激战七天后杀死摩诃罗阇德尔马萨蒂亚，吞并穆阿拉卡曼，合并后以“古泰-卡塔内加拉·因·摩多补罗”为国号。

en: The Kutsuna were a seafaring warrior house of Iyo Province on Shikoku whose power lay on the water rather than the land. From the Heian through the Muromachi period they dominated the Kutsuna archipelago in the Seto Inland Sea, between the Aki and Iyo channels, with their base on Kutsuna-jima, now called Nakajima; the islands under their control were known as the seven Kutsuna islands. As a naval family they served the Kamakura shogunate, and in the Jōkyū War of 1221 Kutsuna Kunishige defeated and killed the imperial-side leader Tokunō Michitoshi at the Battle of Mount Takanawa. In 1331 Kutsuna Shigekiyo answered Emperor Go-Daigo's call and campaigned across Iyo against the Utsunomiya, then followed Nitta Yoshisada against the Ashikaga as far as Ōi Castle in Shinano, only to change sides in 1336 and serve Ashikaga Takauji in Kyoto, Iyo and Aki. He was eventually shouldered aside by his own brother Yoshinori, who had stayed loyal to the Southern Court, after which the family faded from the main stage of politics.
zh: 忽那氏是四国伊予国的水军武士家族，势力在海上而非陆地。从平安时代到室町时代，他们称雄于濑户内海安艺滩与伊予滩之间的忽那诸岛，以最大的忽那岛（今中岛）为本据，受其控制的岛群被称为“忽那七岛”。作为水军，他们侍奉镰仓幕府：1221年承久之乱中，忽那国重在高绳山之战击败并斩杀朝廷方的得能通俊。1331年，忽那重清响应后醍醐天皇举兵，在伊予各地讨伐宇都宫氏，随后追随新田义贞与足利军作战，远守信浓大井城；1336年他转投足利尊氏，在京都、伊予、安艺等地为北朝效力。但他的弟弟义范始终忠于南朝，最终压过了他的声势，忽那氏也随之淡出政治舞台的中心。

en: The Kyōgoku were a branch of the Sasaki clan and traced their line to the Uda Genji, the Minamoto descendants of Emperor Uda; their name came from the Kyōgoku quarter of Kyoto where the family had lived in the Heian period. The line was founded by Sasaki Ujinobu in the thirteenth century. Its most famous head, Sasaki Takauji (1306–1373), better known by his monastic name Dōyō, abandoned the Hōjō regency to support Ashikaga Takauji against the Kenmu Restoration of 1333, became shugo governor of six provinces, and was also a noted renga poet whose verses entered the imperial anthology Tsukubashū. Before the Ōnin War of 1467 to 1477 the Kyōgoku held the shugo posts of Ōmi, Hida, Izumo and Oki, but their power collapsed in the succession wars of the late fifteenth century. Under the Tokugawa the house recovered and was classed as a tozama daimyō family, ruling domains that included Marugame and Tadotsu in Sanuki, Toyooka in Tajima and Mineyama in Tango, while one branch served the shogunate as kōke, masters of court ceremony.
zh: 京极氏是佐佐木氏的一支，谱系可追溯至宇多天皇一脉的宇多源氏；其苗字取自平安时代家族在京都的居所京极。这一支由13世纪的佐佐木氏信开创。最著名的当主是1306至1373年在世、法名道誉的佐佐木高氏，他背弃北条执权幕府，转投足利尊氏推翻1333年的建武新政，身兼六国守护，同时又是知名的连歌师，有八十一首作品收入敕撰连歌集《菟玖波集》。1467至1477年应仁之乱以前，京极家世袭近江、飞驒、出云、隐岐四国守护，但在15世纪后期的继承混战中势力瓦解。德川时代家族复兴，被列为外样大名，先后领有赞岐的丸龟藩与多度津藩、但马的丰冈藩以及丹后的峰山藩，另有一支担任主持朝廷典礼的高家，效力于江户幕府。

en: The Lackfi were one of the foremost noble houses of the fourteenth-century Kingdom of Hungary, named after Lack of the Hermán kindred, Count of the Székelys from 1328, whose sons and grandsons monopolized high office under the Angevin kings. From their Transylvanian seats around Mediaș they supplied repeated Voivodes of Transylvania and Counts of the Székelys: Andrew Lackfi, who took his father's countship in 1343, led the Székelys across the Carpathians and on 2 February 1345 crushed a large Tatar army of the Golden Horde, served as Viceroy of Naples in 1350–1352 and ruled Transylvania as voivode until his death in 1359. His kinsmen Stephen I and Stephen II added the banships of Croatia, Slavonia, Dalmatia and Bulgaria, while Stephen II also became Palatine of Hungary and lord of Zadar. The house reached the Wallachian court through Maria Lackfi, first wife of Prince Nicholas Alexander and mother of Vladislav I Vlaicu. Its power ended under King Sigismund: Stephen II was killed with his followers at the Bloody Sabor of Križevci in 1397, after which the surviving branch retired to its Croatian estates.
zh: 拉克菲是14世纪匈牙利王国最显赫的贵族世家之一，得名于赫尔曼氏族的拉克——他自1328年起任塞凯伊人伯爵，其子嗣在安茹诸王治下垄断了高官职位。家族以梅迪亚什一带的特兰西瓦尼亚领地为根基，多次出任特兰西瓦尼亚沃伊沃德和塞凯伊人伯爵：安德鲁·拉克菲1343年承袭父职，率塞凯伊人越过喀尔巴阡山，于1345年2月2日重创金帐汗国的鞑靼大军，1350—1352年出任那不勒斯副王，1359年去世前一直担任特兰西瓦尼亚沃伊沃德。同族的斯蒂芬一世与斯蒂芬二世又相继出任克罗地亚、斯拉沃尼亚、达尔马提亚和保加利亚的班，斯蒂芬二世还做过匈牙利摄政和扎达尔领主。家族还通过联姻进入瓦拉几亚宫廷：玛丽亚·拉克菲是亲王尼古拉·亚历山大的第一任妻子，也是弗拉迪斯拉夫一世·弗拉伊库的生母。家族权势在国王西吉斯蒙德治下终结：1397年斯蒂芬二世及其追随者在克里热夫齐血腥议会上被杀，幸存的支系退入自家在克罗地亚的庄园。

en: The House of Lancaster was a cadet branch of the Plantagenets, begun in 1267 when Henry III of England created the Earldom of Lancaster for his second son Edmund Crouchback, who had already inherited the attainted lands of Simon de Montfort. Edmund's son Thomas married the heiress of the Earl of Lincoln and became the most powerful baron in England, only to be executed in 1322 for rebelling against his cousin Edward II; Thomas's brother Henry and nephew Henry of Grosmont then served Edward III, the latter becoming the first Duke of Lancaster. When Grosmont died without a male heir in 1361, his daughter Blanche brought the inheritance to her husband John of Gaunt, Edward III's third son. Their son Henry Bolingbroke seized the crown in 1399 as Henry IV, and the house gave England three kings: Henry IV, Henry V and the ill-fated Henry VI. The male line ended in 1471, when Henry VI's son Edward died at Tewkesbury and Henry himself was murdered in the Tower of London during the Wars of the Roses. The Lancastrian claim then passed through the Beaufort line to Henry Tudor, founder of the Tudor dynasty.
zh: 兰开斯特家族是金雀花家族的旁支，始于1267年——英格兰国王亨利三世为次子埃德蒙·克罗奇贝克设立兰开斯特伯爵领，此前埃德蒙已接手被剥夺公权的西蒙·德·孟福尔的地产。埃德蒙之子托马斯娶林肯伯爵的女继承人，成为英格兰最有权势的男爵，却因反叛表兄爱德华二世于1322年被处死；其弟亨利和侄孙格罗斯蒙特的亨利转而效忠爱德华三世，后者受封第一代兰开斯特公爵。1361年格罗斯蒙特的亨利无子而终，女儿布朗什把家产带给丈夫——爱德华三世的第三子冈特的约翰。他们的儿子亨利·博林布鲁克于1399年夺取王位，即亨利四世；这个家族为英格兰贡献了亨利四世、亨利五世和命运多舛的亨利六世。1471年玫瑰战争期间，亨利六世之子爱德华战死蒂克斯伯里，亨利六世本人在伦敦塔遇害，男嗣就此断绝。兰开斯特的王位主张随后经博福特一系传到亨利·都铎手中，即都铎王朝的开创者。

en: The Lancia, later also spelled Lanza, were a noble house with lands in Piedmont and Sicily, traced to Manfred I Lancia, margrave of Busca, an Aleramici dynast first recorded around 1160 whose surname was said to come from the office of lancifer, or spear-bearer, held under Emperor Frederick Barbarossa. The family's fortunes came to rest on the Hohenstaufen: Bianca Lancia, raised at the family seat of Brolo in Sicily, was the mistress and possibly deathbed wife of Emperor Frederick II and the mother of King Manfred of Sicily. Her uncle Manfred II served Frederick as imperial vicar across Piedmont and Lombardy, governing Alessandria and fighting the Guelph communes until he changed sides in 1252. Other kinsmen staffed King Manfred's regime: Giordano Lancia, marshal of Sicily, led the Ghibelline cavalry at the victory of Montaperti in 1260, but after Manfred's defeat and death at Benevento in 1266 he was captured by Charles of Anjou, mutilated and beheaded at Brolo in 1267. The Angevin conquest broke the house's power, although the Sicilian line kept the barony of Longi and rose again from the fifteenth century under Blasco Lanza, whose heirs became princes of Trabia in 1601 and dukes of Brolo.
zh: 兰恰家族（后来也拼作兰扎）是在皮埃蒙特和西西里都领有土地的贵族世家，可追溯到布斯卡侯爵曼弗雷德一世·兰恰。他出身阿勒拉米契家族，1160年前后已有记载，据说姓氏得自其在皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨麾下担任的持矛官一职。家族的命运后来系于霍亨斯陶芬王朝：在西西里家族祖宅布罗洛城堡长大的比安卡·兰恰，是皇帝腓特烈二世的情妇，也可能是他临终前的妻子，并生下西西里国王曼弗雷迪。她的叔父曼弗雷德二世作为帝国代理人替腓特烈二世镇守皮埃蒙特和伦巴第，治理亚历山德里亚、连年征讨圭尔夫派城市，直到1252年改换阵营。其他族人则在曼弗雷迪朝中任要职：西西里元帅焦尔达诺·兰恰在1260年的蒙塔佩尔蒂战役中率领吉伯林派骑兵取胜，但1266年曼弗雷迪在贝内文托战败身亡后，他被安茹的查理俘虏，遭酷刑残肢并于1267年在布罗洛斩首。安茹王朝的征服摧毁了家族的权势，不过西西里一系保住了隆吉男爵领，15世纪起在布拉斯科·兰扎手中复兴，其后人于1601年成为特拉比亚亲王，并受封布罗洛公爵。

en: The Lords of Landštejn, in Czech Landštejnové, were one of the five chief branches of the great Vítkovci clan of southern Bohemia. Originally seated at Třeboň, they took their name from Landštejn Castle, first recorded in 1231 and acquired by Sezema of Landštejn in the later thirteenth century. The warriors Ojíř of Svinna and his son Vítek of Landštejn rose at the turn of the fourteenth century; Vítek held the office of supreme chamberlain and helped drive Henry of Carinthia from Prague in 1309. His son Vilém, after a rebellion in 1318, made his peace with King John of Bohemia, served as captain of Moravia and as burgrave of Prague from 1351 to 1356, and became a trusted councillor of Charles IV. The family's many castles included Třeboň, Nová Bystřice and Nové Hrady, although Landštejn itself was sold to Konrád Krajíř of Krajka in 1381. One line settled in Moravia, where it built Nový Světlov; Mikuláš Svitáček of Landštejn became royal marshal in the later fifteenth century. The house became extinct in 1612 with the death of Vilém, captain of Prague's New Town.
zh: 兰德施泰因领主（捷克语称兰德施泰因诺维）是波希米亚南部维特科维奇大家族五大支系之一。他们原居特热邦，后来得名于兰德施泰因城堡；该城堡最早见于1231年的记载，13世纪后期由谢泽马·德·兰德施泰因取得。13、14世纪之交，战将奥伊尔·泽·斯温及其子维特克·德·兰德施泰因崛起，维特克曾任最高内侍，并在1309年参与把克恩滕的亨利逐出布拉格。其子威廉在1318年叛乱后与波希米亚国王约翰和解，出任摩拉维亚长官，1351—1356年任布拉格城堡长官，成为查理四世信赖的顾问。家族城堡众多，包括特热邦、新比斯特日采和新赫拉迪，不过兰德施泰因本堡于1381年卖给了克拉伊卡的康拉德·克拉伊日。一支后人定居摩拉维亚，在那里修建了新斯韦特洛夫城堡；15世纪后期，兰德施泰因的米库拉什·斯维塔切克官至王室元帅。1612年，任布拉格新城长官的威廉去世，家族绝嗣。

en: The Lappe were a knightly family of Land Hadeln on the Lower Elbe, formally vassals of the Dukes of Saxe-Lauenburg, who had colonized the marshy region. They are documented from 1315 to 1419. In 1324 Duke Eric I of Saxe-Lauenburg pledged the judicial rights of the parishes of Wolde and Groden to Wolderich Lappe for two hundred marks, giving the family a steady income and a leading position in Hadeln. By 1370 at the latest their seat was the tower of Ritzebüttel, guarding the mouth of the Elbe, where their duties included keeping the river clear of pirates for the merchants of Hamburg. The relationship with Hamburg soured: the city stormed the Ritzebüttel tower in 1393, and in 1394 Wolder and Alverich Lappe were forced to sell both the tower and their allodial lands to Hamburg. After 1419 the family can no longer be traced with certainty.
zh: 拉佩家族是下易北河哈德尔恩地区的骑士世家，在名义上臣属于殖民这片沼泽地的萨克森-劳恩堡公爵，文献可考的时间为1315—1419年。1324年，萨克森-劳恩堡公爵埃里希一世以200马克的代价，把沃尔德和格罗登两个教区的司法权抵押给沃尔德里希·拉佩，使家族获得稳定收入，在哈德尔恩身居要职。至迟在1370年，他们的驻地是镇守易北河口的里策比特尔塔楼，职责之一是为汉堡商人肃清河上海盗。后来家族与汉堡反目：汉堡于1393年强攻里策比特尔塔楼，1394年沃尔德和阿尔弗利希·拉佩被迫把塔楼连同自有地一并卖给汉堡。1419年以后，这个家族便再无可靠的踪迹可考。

en: The House of Lara took its name from Lara de los Infantes in Burgos, where the nobleman Gonzalo Núñez is first documented around 1100, and grew into one of the most powerful magnate lineages of medieval Castile, its arms a silver field charged with black cauldrons. In the twelfth century Pedro González de Lara backed Queen Urraca against Alfonso I of Aragon, while the brothers Manrique, Álvar and Nuño Pérez de Lara disputed the regency during the minority of Alfonso VIII; a later Álvaro Núñez de Lara served as regent for Henry I. The family's appetite for opposition was constant: Nuño González de Lara led a noble league against Alfonso X in 1270, Juan Núñez I, lord of Albarracín, had to flee to France after resisting Sancho IV, and Juan Núñez III headed repeated rebellions against Alfonso XI. A younger son, Pedro Manrique de Lara, inherited the viscounty of Narbonne beyond the Pyrenees after 1192, founding a Languedoc branch that ruled there under viscounts such as Aimery III and placed Lara kin at Foix and in Aragon. Back in Castile the family backed Henry of Trastámara, was dispossessed by Peter I, and recovered its lands under Henry II. The senior line died out in the male line in the mid fourteenth century, its inheritance passing through daughters, while the Manrique de Lara cadet branch endured: it produced the Dukes of Nájera and Marquesses of Aguilar de Campoo, grandees of Spain, and the fifteenth-century poets Diego Gómez Manrique and Jorge Manrique.
zh: 拉腊家族得名于布尔戈斯的拉腊-德洛斯因凡特斯，贵族贡萨洛·努涅斯约于1100年首次见于记载，此后成长为中世纪卡斯蒂利亚最有权势的大贵族世系之一，族徽为银底黑色大锅。12世纪时，佩德罗·冈萨雷斯·德·拉腊支持乌拉卡女王对抗阿拉贡的阿方索一世；曼里克、阿尔瓦尔和努尼奥·佩雷斯·德·拉腊兄弟在阿方索八世未成年期间争夺摄政权，后来的阿尔瓦罗·努涅斯·德·拉腊则在恩里克一世时任摄政。家族的反叛传统一以贯之：努尼奥·冈萨雷斯·德·拉腊于1270年率领贵族联盟对抗阿方索十世，阿尔瓦拉辛领主胡安·努涅斯一世因反对桑治四世而亡命法国，胡安·努涅斯三世又多次起兵反对阿方索十一世。家族幼子佩德罗·曼里克·德·拉腊在1192年后继承了比利牛斯山以北的纳博讷子爵领，开创了朗格多克支系，在埃梅里三世等子爵治下统治当地，并把拉腊的亲族带到富瓦和阿拉贡。留在卡斯蒂利亚的家族支持特拉斯塔马拉的恩里克，被佩德罗一世抄没家产，又在恩里克二世继位后光复。长支男系于14世纪中叶断绝，遗产经女儿传承；曼里克·德·拉腊旁支则延续下来，出了纳赫拉公爵、阿吉拉尔-德坎波奥侯爵等西班牙大公，以及15世纪的诗人迭戈·戈麦斯·曼里克和豪尔赫·曼里克。

en: The Launggyet dynasty ruled the last Arakanese kingdom of the Le-Mro period, seated at Launggyet in the Kaladan valley of northern Arakan from its foundation in 1251 until its fall to Ava in 1406. It succeeded the old Vesali kingdom and grew rich as a trade link between Bengal and Southeast Asia, exporting rice, ivory and lacquer. Its greatest king was Min Hti, placed on the throne as a child around 1279 after the usurper who had murdered his father Min Bilu was killed; Arakanese chronicles credit him with a reign of nearly a century, the longest reputed reign on record. His armies repelled Shan raids from 1294 onward, campaigned against the Talaings at Sandoway, the Burmese at Pagan and Pegu, and the northern Thet, and after Pinya raided Ramree in 1327 and Shans struck up the Lemro in 1334, he crossed the Arakan Mountains to sack Thayet and founded the staging town of Ann in 1335. Min Hti died around 1374 without a legitimate heir and the kingdom drifted until 1404, when his great-grandson Narameikhla took power; Ava's crown prince Minye Kyawswa seized Launggyet in 1406 and drove him into twenty-four years of exile in Bengal. Returning with Bengali troops in 1430, Narameikhla founded Mrauk-U, where Min Hti's line continued as the Arakanese royal house.
zh: 隆邑王朝是阿拉干莱茂时期最后一个阿拉干人王国，1251年立国，都城在北阿拉干加拉丹河谷的隆邑，1406年为阿瓦所灭。它继承古老的维沙利王国，凭借连接孟加拉与东南亚的贸易而兴盛，出口稻米、象牙和漆器。王朝最著名的国王是敏蒂：弑杀其父敏比卢的僭主被大臣诛灭后，他约于1279年幼年登基，阿拉干纪年称他在位近百年，是史上相传在位最久的君主。他的军队自1294年起多次击退掸人来犯，又征讨山多威的得楞人、蒲甘与勃固的缅人以及北方的帖人；1327年彬牙劫掠兰里岛、1334年掸人沿莱茂河进攻之后，他率军翻过阿拉干山脉洗劫德耶谬，并于1335年兴建驿站城镇安城。敏蒂约于1374年去世，没有嫡子，王国随之动荡；1404年他的曾孙那罗弥迦罗（敏绍蒙）即位，阿瓦王储明耶觉苏瓦于1406年攻陷隆邑，迫使他流亡孟加拉二十四年。1430年他借孟加拉兵复国，建立妙乌城，敏蒂的血脉遂在妙乌王室延续。
