en: The House of Laval was a powerful baronial family of Maine, named after the town and castle of Laval, where a baron named Guy I is recorded early in the eleventh century. Its lords long stood among the greatest nobles of both Maine and neighboring Brittany, and by tradition every head of the house took the name Guy. When the direct line died out in 1211 with Guy VI, his sister Edme had married Matthieu II de Montmorency under a contract requiring her eldest son to keep the Laval name and arms, and so the Montmorency-Laval branch succeeded. In 1337 that branch still ruled from Laval and held wide lands in Brittany; it ended with Guy XII in 1412, when the heiress Anne carried the inheritance to the Montfort family by a similar marriage contract. The Montfort-Laval line lasted until 1547 and a later Rieux-Laval branch until Guy XX was killed fighting in Hungary in 1605, after which the Laval possessions passed to the House of La Tremoille. Its most famous son remains Gilles de Rais, born Gilles de Montmorency-Laval, a companion-in-arms of Joan of Arc executed in 1440.
zh: 拉瓦勒家族是曼恩地区势力雄厚的男爵世家，得名于拉瓦勒镇和城堡，11世纪初已有名叫居伊一世的男爵见载。其领主长期跻身曼恩及邻近布列塔尼最显赫的贵族之列，而且依照传统，家族族长一律取名“居伊”。1211年直系随居伊六世去世而断绝，他的姐妹埃德姆此前嫁给马蒂厄二世·德·蒙莫朗西，婚约规定长子须沿用拉瓦勒的姓氏和纹章，蒙莫朗西-拉瓦勒支系由此继统。1337年该支仍以拉瓦勒为中心统治，并在布列塔尼领有大片土地；1412年居伊十二世死后支系终结，女继承人安妮凭类似的婚约把家产带入蒙福尔家族。蒙福尔-拉瓦勒支系延续到1547年，后来的里约-拉瓦勒支系则在1605年居伊二十世战死于匈牙利后告终，拉瓦勒的产业转入拉特雷穆瓦耶家族。家族最出名的人物是吉尔·德·雷，全名吉尔·德·蒙莫朗西-拉瓦勒，他曾是圣女贞德的战友，于1440年被处死。

en: The Lazarević were a short-lived Serbian royal house that ruled Moravian Serbia and the Serbian Despotate. Its founder Lazar Hrebeljanović was the son of Pribac, a logothete at the court of Emperor Stephen Dušan; around 1353 he married Milica of the collateral Nemanjić line and, as the Nemanjić dynasty died out, built up a principality in central Serbia from 1371. In 1389 Lazar led a Balkan coalition against Sultan Murad I at the Battle of Kosovo, where both commanders were killed. His son Stefan Lazarević, known as the Tall, ruled first as an Ottoman vassal and then, after receiving the despot's title from Byzantium in 1402, as an independent lord; allied with Hungary, he gained Belgrade and Golubac, became a founding member of the Order of the Dragon, issued the Code of Mines in 1412 to develop the great silver mines at Novo Brdo, and won fame as a poet and patron of scholars. Childless, he named his nephew George Branković heir and died in 1427, whereupon the dynasty was succeeded by the Branković.
zh: 拉扎列维奇王朝是一个国祚不长的塞尔维亚王室，统治过摩拉维亚塞尔维亚和塞尔维亚专制公国。开创者拉扎尔·赫雷别利亚诺维奇是斯特凡·杜尚皇帝朝中御书房长官普里巴茨之子，约1353年娶内马尼奇旁支的米莉察为妻；内马尼奇王朝绝嗣后，他从1371年起在塞尔维亚中部建立起自己的公国。1389年，拉扎尔率巴尔干联军在科索沃战役中迎战苏丹穆拉德一世，两位主帅都战死阵中。其子斯特凡·拉扎列维奇（人称高个子）起初作为奥斯曼附庸统治，1402年从拜占庭获得专制公头衔后成为独立领主；他与匈牙利结盟，取得贝尔格莱德和戈卢巴茨，是龙骑士团的创始成员之一，1412年颁布《矿业法典》以开发新布尔多的大银矿，同时以诗人和学者庇护人闻名。他没有子嗣，指定外甥久拉德·布兰科维奇为继承人，于1427年去世，王朝随之由布兰科维奇家族接续。

en: The le Poers, later more commonly called Power, are an Anglo-Norman family whose progenitor came to Ireland with Strongbow and received wide lands in County Waterford around 1172; Sir Roger le Puher was granted the Curraghmore estate by Henry II in 1177, and it remained the family seat for more than five hundred years. Settled in the Decies and the Pale, the le Poers became pillars of the Anglo-Irish colony. Arnold le Poer, Seneschal of Kilkenny, helped defeat Edward Bruce's invasion but was ruined by the Kilkenny witchcraft trials of 1324: his defence of his kinswoman Alice Kyteler led to charges of heresy, and he died a prisoner in Dublin Castle in 1328. His probable younger son Robert le Poer (died c. 1346) nevertheless rose to be Lord High Treasurer of Ireland and Chief Baron of the Exchequer, while Nicholas le Poer of Kilmeadan was summoned to the Irish parliament in the 1370s. In 1535 Sir Richard le Poer was created Baron La Poer, and in 1673 the head of the house became Viscount Decies and Earl of Tyrone. The male line failed in 1704, and the heiress Catherine married Sir Marcus Beresford; their Beresford descendants, who kept the name de la Poer, became Marquesses of Waterford in 1789 and still hold Curraghmore.
zh: 勒普尔家族（后来更常写作 Power，即鲍尔）是盎格鲁-诺曼世家，先祖随斯特朗博入侵爱尔兰，约1172年受封沃特福德郡的大片土地；罗杰·勒普尔爵士又于1177年从亨利二世手中得到库拉格莫尔庄园，此地作为家族宅邸长达五百多年。家族定居于迪西和英格兰佩尔地区，成为盎格鲁-爱尔兰殖民社会的支柱。基尔肯尼总管阿诺德·勒普尔曾参与击退爱德华·布鲁斯的入侵，却在1324年的基尔肯尼女巫审判中身败名裂：他因庇护亲族爱丽丝·基特勒而被控异端，1328年死于都柏林城堡的囚所。但他可能的幼子罗伯特·勒普尔（约1346年去世）仍官运亨通，出任爱尔兰财政大臣和财税法庭首席男爵；基尔米丹的尼古拉斯·勒普尔则在14世纪70年代多次被召入爱尔兰议会。1535年，理查德·勒普尔爵士受封拉普尔男爵；1673年，家族首领又成为迪西子爵和蒂龙伯爵。1704年男嗣断绝，女继承人凯瑟琳嫁给马库斯·贝雷斯福德爵士，其贝雷斯福德后裔保留了 de la Poer 的名字，1789年受封沃特福德侯爵，库拉格莫尔庄园也由该支后人继续保有。

en: The Lehet, also written Leet, d'Alet or Delet, were a ricohombre, or magnate, lineage of the Kingdom of Navarre, seated around Pamplona. Its first well-documented member, Corberan de Lehet, left Navarre to join the Catalan Grand Company of Roger de Flor: he reached Constantinople in 1303 as the company's seneschal, commanded its infantry in the campaigns against the Ottoman Turks in Anatolia, and was killed by an arrow at the battle of Tira in 1304 after taking off his helmet during the pursuit. His kinsman Juan Corbarán de Lehet, born in the last third of the thirteenth century, became alférez, the royal standard-bearer of Navarre, and one of the kingdom's leading ricoshombres. When the death of Charles the Fair in 1328 ended the personal union with France and opened a succession crisis, the Navarrese Cortes named him one of the regents who governed for eleven months from February 1329 until Queen Joan II and King Philip III took power. He died in 1355, after a career spanning the reigns in which the Evreux dynasty established itself in Navarre.
zh: 莱埃特家族（文献中又拼作 Leet、d'Alet、Dalet、Delet）是纳瓦拉王国的“里科翁布雷”大贵族世系，聚居在潘普洛纳一带。可考的第一位名人科尔贝兰·德·莱埃特离开纳瓦拉，加入罗赫尔·德·弗洛尔的加泰罗尼亚大佣兵团：1303年他以佣兵团总管的身份抵达君士坦丁堡，在安纳托利亚对抗奥斯曼土耳其人的战役中指挥步兵，1304年在蒂拉之战的追击中因摘下头盔被流矢射中身亡。他的亲族胡安·科尔巴兰·德·莱埃特生于13世纪后期，后来出任纳瓦拉王室掌旗官，是王国最有权势的大贵族之一。1328年美男子夏尔去世，纳瓦拉与法国的共主联邦终结、王位继承出现危机，纳瓦拉议会任命他为摄政之一，自1329年2月起执政十一个月，直到女王胡安娜二世和国王费利佩三世继位。他于1355年去世，一生亲历了埃夫勒王朝在纳瓦拉站稳脚跟的年代。

en: The counts of Leiningen took their name from Leiningen Castle in the Palatinate Forest, the region still known as the Leiningerland. Count Emich II is the first securely documented member, appearing as a witness in 1128, and around 1204 the family held the land advocacy of the Speyergau and the advocacy of Limburg Abbey. When the old line died out in the male branch between 1212 and 1214, the inheritance passed through Liutgard of Leiningen to her son by Count Simon II of Saarbrücken, who took the Leiningen name and arms as Frederick II and founded the younger Saarbrücken-Leiningen house. His son Frederick III added the County of Dagsburg in the Vosges in 1241, while a younger son, Emich IV, founded the town of Landau and the short-lived Landeck branch. In 1317 the grandsons of Frederick III divided the house into Leiningen-Dagsburg and Leiningen-Hardenburg; the Dagsburg branch died out in 1467, its lands passing through an heiress to the counts of Westerburg, who then called themselves Leiningen-Westerburg. The counts introduced the Reformation in 1569 and shared in the spoils of the extinct Zweibrücken-Bitsch line in 1570. The Hardenburg branch, its residence moved from the ruined Hardenburg to Dürkheim, was raised to princely rank in 1779, and after losing its Rhenish lands to France it was compensated in 1803 with the Amorbach abbey estates and mediatized to Baden in 1806.
zh: 莱宁根伯爵得名于普法尔茨森林中的莱宁根城堡，城堡所在的地区名为莱宁根兰。家族第一位可确考的成员是埃米希二世，他于1128年作为见证人出现在文献中；约1204年，家族领有施派尔高的地方行政权和林堡修道院的福格特权。1212至1214年间老支男系断绝，遗产经莱宁根的柳特加德传给她与萨尔布吕肯伯爵西蒙二世所生的儿子；后者以弗里德里希二世之名采用莱宁根的名号与纹章，开创了较年轻的萨尔布吕肯-莱宁根世系。他的儿子弗里德里希三世于1241年取得孚日山区的达格斯堡伯国，幼子埃米希四世则建立了兰道城和短命的兰德克支系。1317年，弗里德里希三世的孙辈把家族分为莱宁根-达格斯堡与莱宁根-哈登堡两支；达格斯堡支于1467年绝嗣，领地经女继承人转入韦斯特堡伯爵之手，后者从此改称莱宁根-韦斯特堡。1569年伯爵们推行宗教改革，1570年又分得绝嗣的茨魏布吕肯-比奇支系的部分领地。哈登堡支把居所从被毁的哈登堡迁到迪克姆，于1779年被擢升为帝国侯爵；莱茵河西岸领地被法国夺取后，他们于1803年获阿莫尔巴赫修道院地产作为补偿，1806年被调解并入巴登。

en: The landgraves of Leuchtenberg were an influential noble dynasty of the Upper Palatinate, documented from the twelfth to the seventeenth century and ruling the largest secular non-Wittelsbach territory in Bavaria. The first ancestor, Gebhard I, appears in a charter of 1146; his son Gebhard II accompanied Emperor Frederick Barbarossa to Italy and was raised to the rank of count in 1158, and in 1196 Diepold I inherited the title of landgrave. Ulrich I, who ruled from 1293 to 1334, recovered earlier losses, acquired the castle of Pfreimd, which became the dynasty's residence after Burg Leuchtenberg was abandoned in 1322, and fought at the Battle of Muhldorf in 1322 at the side of Emperor Louis the Bavarian; his daughter Kunigunde entered German legend as the White Lady. Under Ulrich's sons the landgraviate was partitioned: Johann I obtained town rights for Grafenau and, together with his brother Ulrich II, inherited the county of Hals near Passau in 1375. Leopold of Leuchtenberg distinguished himself against the Hussites and saved Karlstein Castle for Emperor Sigismund, and in the fifteenth century the family won the rank of imperial princes with a seat in the Imperial Diet. The male line ended with Maximilian Adam in 1646, after which the landgraviate passed to the Wittelsbachs and, in 1705, to the Bavarian electors.
zh: 洛伊希滕贝格藩侯是上普法尔茨显赫的中世纪贵族世家，12至17世纪间有文献可考，其藩侯领是巴伐利亚境内最大的非维特尔斯巴赫、非教会世俗领地。始祖格布哈德一世见于1146年的文书；其子格布哈德二世随皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨远征意大利，1158年被擢升为伯爵，1196年迪波德一世又承袭藩侯头衔。1293至1334年在位的乌尔里希一世收复了此前流失的产业，取得普弗赖姆德堡——该堡在1322年洛伊希滕贝格堡弃用后成为家族驻地；他还于1322年在米尔多夫战役中随皇帝巴伐利亚的路德维希作战，其女儿库妮贡德后来成为德国传说中“白衣女士”的原型。乌尔里希的儿子们瓜分了藩侯领：约翰一世为格拉芬瑙争取到城市法，又与其弟乌尔里希二世在1375年继承了帕绍附近的哈尔斯伯国。利奥波德·冯·洛伊希滕贝格在抗击胡斯派时战功卓著，曾为皇帝西吉斯蒙德保住卡尔施泰因堡；15世纪家族晋升帝国诸侯，在帝国议会中拥有席位。男系于1646年随马克西米利安·亚当去世而终结，藩侯领随之归维特尔斯巴赫家族所有，1705年又转入巴伐利亚选侯手中。

en: Lhachen, meaning great deity, was the title borne by the kings of the first dynasty of Maryul, the Tibetan kingdom that later became known as Ladakh. After the collapse of the Tibetan Empire, Kyide Nyimagon fled to western Tibet and built a kingdom stretching from the Mayum La to the Zoji La; around 930 his eldest son, Lhachen Palgyigon, inherited the western portion and founded Maryul, with his capital at Shey. The kingdom ran from the Kashmir border in the west to Demchok and Rudok in the east. The Lhachen kings, whose history is recorded in the Ladakh Chronicles, ruled from Shey for more than five centuries. In 1460 the warlike prince Bhagan allied with the people of Leh, dethroned King Lodrö Chokden and his brothers, and took the surname Namgyal, founding a new dynasty that went on to rule Ladakh for nearly four centuries.
zh: “拉钦”意为大神，是玛域第一代王朝历代国王的王号；玛域即后来的拉达克。吐蕃帝国崩溃后，吉德尼玛衮逃往西藏西部，建立起东起马攸木山口、西至佐吉山口的王国；约930年，长子拉钦·贝吉贡分得西部疆土，以谢伊为都建立玛域，其疆域西起克什米尔边境，东抵德穆绰克和日土。拉钦诸王的事迹载于《拉达克王统记》，他们在谢伊统治了五百余年。1460年，好战的王子巴甘联合列城民众，废黜国王洛卓确丹及其兄弟，改姓南嘉，建立了此后统治拉达克近四百年的南嘉王朝。

en: The lords of Lichtenberg were a knightly house of Lower Alsace named after Lichtenberg Castle, whose first securely documented member, Rudolf of Lichtenberg, appears as a canon of Strasbourg in 1203. Through purchase, fief and pledge they built a scattered but powerful lordship around Strasbourg and Hagenau and spread onto the right bank of the Rhine, holding fiefs of the Empire, the bishoprics of Strasbourg, Metz, Speyer and Mainz, Murbach Abbey, Lorraine and the Palatinate, and controlling tolls and Rhine ferries on the Italy-to-Flanders road. They secured town rights for settlements such as Buchsweiler in 1291 and Lichtenberg itself in 1305, and organised their lands into administrative districts. Around 1330 the inheritance was really divided between an elder line under John II and a younger line under Louis III. When the last male lord, James of Lichtenberg, died in 1480, the inheritance fell to his two nieces: Anna, married to Count Philip I the Elder of Hanau-Babenhausen, founded the County of Hanau-Lichtenberg, while Elisabeth married Simon Wecker of Zweibruecken-Bitsch, and when that line died out in 1570 its half passed to Hanau-Lichtenberg as well.
zh: 利希滕贝格领主家族是下阿尔萨斯的骑士世家，以利希滕贝格城堡为姓；家族第一位确凿可考的成员鲁道夫于1203年以斯特拉斯堡法政牧师的身份出现。通过购买、受封和质押，他们在斯特拉斯堡与阿格诺一带经营出一块分散却强盛的领地，并扩展到莱茵河右岸；其封地来自帝国、斯特拉斯堡、梅斯、施派尔和美因茨等主教区、米尔巴克修道院、洛林以及普法尔茨，家族还控制着意大利通往佛兰德斯大道上的关税和莱茵河渡口。他们为布克斯维莱尔（1291年）、利希滕贝格本身（1305年）等定居点争取到城市权，并把领地编成若干行政区。约1330年，家族遗产在约翰二世统领的长支与路易三世统领的幼支之间正式分割。1480年末代男性领主雅各布去世，遗产传给两个侄女：安娜嫁给哈瑙-巴本豪森伯爵菲利普一世（长者），由此形成哈瑙-利希滕贝格伯国；伊丽莎白嫁给茨魏布吕肯-比奇的西蒙·韦克，该支系于1570年绝嗣后，其半数遗产也归入哈瑙-利希滕贝格。

en: The House of Limburg grew from the counts of Limburg, a lordship in the Ardennes whose first rulers were a younger line of the House of Ardenne-Luxembourg and who held the ducal title of Lower Lotharingia before styling themselves dukes of Limburg. Two marriages transformed the family's fortunes: in 1214 Waleran III married Ermesinde, heiress of Luxembourg, opening a younger branch that became the House of Luxembourg and later gave the Empire Henry VII and Charles IV; and around 1218 the marriage of Henry IV to Irmgard, heiress of Berg, carried the County of Berg to their son Adolf VII. The original duchy did not remain in the family for long: when Duchess Ermengarde died without issue in 1283, the War of the Limburg Succession ended at Worringen in 1288, where John I of Brabant defeated the coalition of Guelders and Luxembourg and annexed Limburg. The Berg line therefore became the senior surviving branch, ruling from Düsseldorf through Counts Adolf VIII, William I and, from 1308, Adolf IX. A kinswoman, Margaret of Berg-Windeck, married Otto IV of Ravensberg in 1313, placing family members in that county as well. When Adolf IX died childless in 1348, Berg passed through Margaret's daughter to the counts of Jülich, and the male line of the House of Limburg came to an end.
zh: 林堡家族源于阿登山区的林堡伯爵，最早的统治者是阿登-卢森堡家族的幼支，曾领有下洛林公爵头衔，后改称林堡公爵。两次联姻改变了家族命运：1214年瓦尔拉姆三世娶卢森堡女继承人埃尔梅辛德，由此分出的幼支即卢森堡家族，后来为神圣罗马帝国贡献了亨利七世和查理四世两位皇帝；约1218年，亨利四世娶贝格女继承人伊尔姆加德，贝格伯国遂传给他们的儿子阿道夫七世。但祖传的林堡公国未能久守：1283年女公爵埃尔梅加德无嗣而终，引发林堡继承战争，1288年布拉班特的约翰一世在沃林根击败海尔德与卢森堡联军，吞并林堡。贝格支系由此成为仅存的长支，以杜塞尔多夫为治所，先后由阿道夫八世、威廉一世和1308年继位的阿道夫九世统治。家族女性成员贝格-温德克的玛格丽特于1313年嫁给拉芬斯贝格伯爵奥托四世，使家族在该伯国也有支脉。1348年阿道夫九世无嗣而终，贝格经玛格丽特的女儿传给于利希伯爵，林堡家族的男系就此断绝。

en: The counts of Lindow-Ruppin were an imperial free noble house and a cadet line of the counts of Arnstein, whose ancestors had built Arnstein Castle near Aschersleben around 1130. Around 1214 Count Gebhard of Arnstein, a great-grandson of Albert the Bear, acquired the lordship of Ruppin, a former stronghold of the Slavic Zamzizi tribe on the Ruppin See, and became the progenitor of the new line; its double name combined Ruppin with the Anhalt lordship of Lindau. Gebhard rebuilt the old fort as Alt Ruppin, founded the new trading settlement of Neuruppin nearby and endowed the Cistercian nunnery of Lindow, while his son Gunther I granted Neuruppin its town charter in 1256. In the fourteenth century the house gathered in Rheinsberg, Wusterhausen in 1317 and Gransee in 1319, though it gradually accepted the overlordship of the margraves of Brandenburg, and Burchard II of the family served as bishop of Havelberg from 1348 to 1370. Ruppin was listed among the estates of the Upper Saxon Circle in 1512. When Count Wichmann died without male heirs in 1524, the line became extinct and Elector Joachim I of Brandenburg absorbed the lordship as the district of Ruppin, rejecting the relatives' claims before the Imperial Chamber Court in 1562.
zh: 林多‑鲁平伯爵家族是帝国自由贵族，出自阿恩施泰因伯爵的支系，其先祖约于1130年在阿舍斯莱本附近修建了阿恩施泰因城堡。1214年前后，大熊阿尔布雷希特的曾孙、阿恩施泰因伯爵格布哈特取得鲁平领地——鲁平本是斯拉夫扎姆齐齐部落在鲁平湖畔的据点——他由此成为新支系的始祖；家族的双姓把鲁平与安哈尔特的林道领地连在一起。格布哈特将旧堡扩建为旧鲁平，在附近兴建商业聚落新鲁平，并捐资修建林多西多会女修院；其子金特一世于1256年授予新鲁平市镇特许状。14世纪，家族又取得莱茵斯贝格、1317年取得武斯特豪森、1319年取得格兰塞，但逐渐接受勃兰登堡藩侯的宗主权；家族成员布尔夏德二世于1348至1370年任哈弗尔贝格主教。1512年，鲁平被列入上萨克森行政圈的领地名册。1524年维希曼伯爵无男嗣而终，家族绝嗣，勃兰登堡选帝侯约阿希姆一世将该领地收编为鲁平区，并于1562年在帝国宫廷法院驳回了其亲属的继承诉求。

en: The House of Lippe took its name from the Lippe river in Westphalia, where Bernard I first appears as Bernardus de Lippe in a charter of 1123. In 1173 the family was enfeoffed by the Bishop of Paderborn with the lands around Lemgo and Detmold. Bernard II founded Lippstadt in 1185, the first high-medieval planned town in Westphalia, acquired Rheda in 1190 and founded Lemgo; later generations added Horn, Blomberg and Detmold, while younger sons were provided with church careers, including the see of Paderborn. The lordship reached its greatest extent under Simon I, who ruled from 1275 to 1344 and bought into the County of Schwalenberg, pushing the frontier to the Weser. After his death the lands were partitioned, and the long feud over Rheda ended with that town passing to Tecklenburg and Lippstadt becoming a condominium with the County of Mark. Simon V was raised to imperial count in 1528 and introduced the Reformation. In 1613 the house split into the Detmold, Brake and Alverdissen lines, the last giving birth to the Schaumburg-Lippe branch in 1643; the Detmold line was elevated to princes of the Empire in 1789.
zh: 利珀家族得名于威斯特伐利亚的利珀河，1123年伯恩哈德一世以“Bernhardus de Lippe”之名首次出现在文书中。1173年，家族从帕德博恩主教手中受封莱姆戈和代特莫尔德一带的土地。伯恩哈德二世于1185年建立利普施塔特，这是威斯特伐利亚第一座中世纪盛期规划城市；他又在1190年取得雷达、建立莱姆戈，后人再添霍恩、布隆贝格和代特莫尔德等城，幼子们则走教会路线，有人出任帕德博恩主教。领地在西蒙一世（1275—1344年在位）时达到极盛，他购入施瓦伦贝格伯国的大片土地，把边界推到威悉河。他死后诸子分地，围绕雷达的长期争执以该城归泰克伦堡、利普施塔特变成与马克伯国共管的领地告终。西蒙五世于1528年升为帝国伯爵并推行宗教改革。1613年家族分裂为代特莫尔德、布拉克和阿尔弗迪森三支，后者又在1643年衍生出绍姆堡-利珀支系；代特莫尔德一支则在1789年升为帝国诸侯。

en: The lords of L'Isle-Jourdain were a Gascon vassal family of the counts of Toulouse, holding a lordship on the Save river west of Toulouse that grew by purchase and conquest from the early eleventh century. The line is traced from Odon Raymond around 1000, and generations of its lords bore the name Jourdain: Jourdain III married Esclarmonde of Foix at the end of the twelfth century, and Bernard IV Jourdain, who ruled from about 1303 to 1340, took a daughter of the counts of Foix as his wife, tying the house to the greatest families of the south. In 1337 the family still held the ancestral lordship, which was raised to a county in 1340 under Bertrand I. The comital line ran through John Jourdain I and Bertrand II to Jourdain VI, the last count; ruined and without heirs, he sold the county in 1404 to the lord of Clermont, later duke of Bourbon, who resold it in 1421 to John IV, count of Armagnac. With that sale the house of L'Isle-Jourdain came to an end.
zh: 利勒茹尔丹家族是加斯科涅的贵族，作为图卢兹伯爵的封臣，据守图卢兹以西萨沃河上的领地；自11世纪初起，这块领地通过购买和征战不断扩大。世系可追溯到约1000年时的奥东·雷蒙，此后历代领主多取名“茹尔丹”：12世纪末，茹尔丹三世娶富瓦的埃斯克拉蒙德为妻；约1303年至1340年在位的贝尔纳四世·茹尔丹也娶了富瓦伯爵之女，与南方最显赫的家族联姻。1337年家族仍保有祖传领地，1340年贝尔特朗一世在位时，领地被升为伯国。伯爵之位后经让·茹尔丹一世、贝尔特朗二世传到末代伯爵茹尔丹六世；他家财耗尽又无子嗣，于1404年把伯国卖给后来成为波旁公爵的克莱蒙领主，后者又在1421年转售给阿马尼亚克伯爵让四世。利勒茹尔丹家族也就此终结。

en: The lords of Lobdeburg originated with the lords of Auhausen in the Nördlinger Ries in Swabia, one of whom, Hartmann of Auhausen, moved east in the early twelfth century and built a new seat at Lobdeburg above Lobeda near Jena. On the Slavic frontier east of the Saale they raised an imperial-immediate lordship between the Saale and the White Elster, reaching as far as Triptis by 1300, and founded or chartered the towns of Jena, Kahla, Schleiz, Lobenstein and Elsterberg together with the Leuchtenburg and the monastery of Roda. Between 1173 and 1254 the house supplied one Bishop of Speyer and two Bishops of Würzburg. It later split into the Arnshaugk, Burgau, Elsterberg and Leuchtenburg lines; the widow Elisabeth of Arnshaugk, born around 1262, married Margrave Albert II of Meissen, carrying that branch's lands into the Wettin family. In the fourteenth century the Lobdeburgs lost their imperial immediacy to the Margraves of Meissen and Landgraves of Thuringia, sold castle after castle, chiefly to the Counts of Schwarzburg, and their name-bearing line died out in the middle of the fifteenth century.
zh: 洛德堡领主家族出自施瓦本讷德林根里斯盆地的奥豪森领主，其中哈特曼·冯·奥豪森在12世纪初东迁，在耶拿附近洛贝达上方的洛德堡建立新驻地。在萨勒河以东的斯拉夫边境上，他们在萨勒河与白埃尔斯特河之间建起一块直属于帝国的领地，到1300年已扩展至特里普蒂斯一带，并建立或特许了耶拿、卡拉、施莱茨、洛本施泰因、埃尔斯特贝格等城镇，还修建了洛伊希滕堡和罗达修道院。1173—1254年间，家族出了一位施派尔主教和两位维尔茨堡主教。家族后来分裂为阿恩斯豪格克、布高、埃尔斯特贝格和洛伊希滕堡诸支；约1262年出生的阿恩斯豪格克遗孀伊丽莎白嫁给迈森藩侯阿尔布雷希特二世，把该支的土地带入韦廷家族。14世纪，洛德堡家族丧失帝国直辖地位，受制于迈森藩侯和图林根领地伯爵，城堡被陆续变卖，主要落入施瓦茨堡伯爵之手，袭名男系于15世纪中叶断绝。

en: Loughlin represents the Irish Mac Lochlainn, also Ó Lochlainn, a leading kindred of the Cenél nEógain in the Northern Uí Néill, named from Lochlann mac Máelsechnaill, king of Inishowen, who died in 1023. From their peninsula homeland between Lough Foyle and Lough Swilly they rose to dominate the north: Domnall Ua Lochlainn held the high kingship of Ireland for twenty years until his death in 1121, and his grandson Muirchertach Mac Lochlainn was again high king until 1166. After Muirchertach's death the kindred's supremacy crumbled. In 1235 Domnall Mac Lochlainn seized the kingship of Tír nEógain, but the family was crushed by Brian Ua Néill and the king of Tír Conaill at the battle of Caimeirge in 1241, which destroyed its leadership and left the O'Neills supreme. The survivors lost Inishowen to the rising Ua Dochartaigh, or O'Doherty, kindred and continued only as a minor sept; as late as 1601 two Mac Lochlainn chieftains are still recorded holding small castles in their old homeland around Buncrana.
zh: 洛克林对应爱尔兰的麦克洛克林，又作奥洛克林，是北尼尔后裔中欧文一系的重要氏族，得名于1023年去世的伊尼什欧文国王洛克兰·麦克梅尔谢奈尔。他们以福伊尔湖与斯威利湖之间的半岛故土为根基，一度称雄爱尔兰北部：多姆纳尔·乌阿·洛克林担任爱尔兰高王长达二十年，直到1121年去世；其孙穆尔切塔赫·麦克洛克林在1166年之前同样位居高王。穆尔切塔赫死后，氏族的霸权迅速瓦解。1235年多姆纳尔·麦克洛克林夺下蒂尔欧文王位，但1241年在卡梅尔格战役中被布莱恩·奥尼尔和蒂尔康诺尔国王联军击溃，首领层几乎被一扫而空，奥尼尔家族从此独大。幸存者把伊尼什欧文故土丢给了崛起的奥多尔蒂氏族，只能作为小支系延续；迟至1601年，仍有两名麦克洛克林酋长在班克拉纳一带的旧领地上保有小型城堡的记载。

en: The Lohara dynasty took its name from the hill fortress of Loharkot in the Pir Panjal range, whose chiefs, of the Khasa tribe, first entered Kashmir's politics when Didda, daughter of the Lohara chief Simharja, married King Kshemgupta and ruled Kashmir herself as regent and then queen from 980 to 1003. On her death her nephew Samgramaraja took the throne and founded the Lohara line, whose early history is told in Kalhana's Rajatarangini; he repelled the attacks of Mahmud of Ghazni and backed the Hindu Shahis of Gandhara. The centuries that followed were marked by court corruption and endless revolts of the damara landowners, interrupted only by the long reign of Jayasimha (1128-1155), called the last great Hindu ruler of Kashmir, who restored peace and rebuilt destroyed temples. After a string of weak successors the throne passed to Simhadeva in 1286 and then to his brother Suhadeva, whose heavy taxation made him hated; a Ladakhi prince, Rinchan, overthrew him in 1320, converted to Islam as Sadr-ud-Din and founded the Kashmir Sultanate. The last remnants of Lohara power ended when Shah Mir seized the throne in 1339.
zh: 卢诃罗王朝得名于比尔本贾尔岭上的山城洛哈尔科特，其首领出自哈萨部落。洛哈尔首领辛诃罗阇之女迪达嫁给克什米尔国王克塞姆笈多，自980年起以摄政和女王身份统治克什米尔直至1003年；她死后，外甥桑格拉摩罗阇继位，开创卢诃罗王朝，其早期历史载于卡尔哈纳的《王河》。桑格拉摩罗阇击退了加兹尼的马哈茂德的多次进攻，并支援犍陀罗的印度教沙希王朝。此后数百年间朝纲腐败，封建领主达马拉叛乱不断，只有阇耶辛诃（1128—1155年在位）的长期治世带来喘息，他被称为克什米尔最后一位伟大的印度教君主，恢复了和平并重建被毁的神庙。经过一连串软弱君主，王位1286年传给辛诃提婆，又落到其弟苏诃提婆手中，后者税役繁重，尽失人心。1320年，拉达克王子林钦推翻苏诃提婆，改宗伊斯兰教、改名萨德尔丁，开创克什米尔苏丹国；1339年沙阿·米尔夺取王位，卢诃罗残余势力彻底终结。

en: Luanuʻu was an early Aliʻi nui, or high chief, of the islands of Kauaʻi and Niʻihau. He is listed among Kauaʻi's independent rulers between the chief Kamahano and Kukona, who reigned from 1350 to 1380 and defeated the invading Hawaiʻi island chief Kalaunuiohua.
zh: 卢亚努乌是考艾岛及邻近尼豪岛的早期高级酋长“阿利伊努伊”之一，在考艾独立统治者列表中排在酋长卡马哈诺与库科纳之间；库科纳于1350—1380年在位，曾击败来犯的夏威夷岛酋长卡劳努伊奥胡阿。

en: The House of Luna was one of the eight greatest noble lineages of the Kingdom of Aragon, its roots traced back to Navarre and its name to the town of Luna in Zaragoza, taken from the Muslims in 1092 under King Sancho I. A semi-legendary early ancestor, Bacalla de Luna, is said to have held the new fortress there, and the lordship of Luna became hereditary in 1343. The Lunas were a fighting house: they served at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212, died defending Peter II at Muret, and in 1348 backed Peter IV against the rebellious Union at the battle of Épila. That victory made Lope de Luna, ninth lord of Luna, the first Count of Luna in 1348, and the family's standing was crowned when María de Luna married King Martin I of Aragon. Its most famous son was Pedro Martínez de Luna, a learned canon lawyer made cardinal in 1375, who during the Western Schism was elected the Avignon pope Benedict XIII and held out against all attempts to depose him until his death at Peñíscola in 1423. A later kinsman, Álvaro de Luna, became Constable of Castile and the all-powerful favourite of John II before his execution in 1453, while other branches kept the Aragonese titles alive through the fifteenth century and beyond.
zh: 卢纳家族是阿拉贡王国最显赫的八大贵族世系之一，源头可追溯至纳瓦拉，得名于萨拉戈萨省的卢纳镇——1092年桑治一世在位时，该镇从穆斯林手中收复。半传说中的先祖巴卡利亚·德·卢纳据说镇守了新建的城堡，卢纳领地于1343年成为世袭领地。卢纳家族以善战著称：1212年参加拉斯纳瓦斯-德托洛萨之战，在米雷为保卫佩德罗二世而战死，1348年又在埃皮拉之战中支持佩德罗四世、平定贵族联盟叛乱。凭借这场胜利，第九代卢纳领主洛佩·德·卢纳于1348年成为首任卢纳伯爵；玛丽亚·德·卢纳嫁给阿拉贡国王马丁一世，更使家族地位登峰造极。家族最有名的人物是佩德罗·马丁内斯·德·卢纳，他是博学的教会法学家，1375年升任枢机主教，西方教会大分裂期间当选阿维尼翁教宗，称本笃十三世；他顶住了一切逼其退位的努力，直到1423年在佩尼伊斯科拉去世。后来的亲族阿尔瓦罗·德·卢纳出任卡斯蒂利亚统帅，是胡安二世权倾朝野的宠臣，最终于1453年被处决；其他支系则在整个15世纪及以后延续着阿拉贡的爵位。

en: The House of Lusignan began as petty lords of the castle of Lusignan in Poitou, where the family is traced to the early tenth century and where legend made the water-sprite Melusine its foundress. In France its lords became counts of La Marche, and Hugh X's marriage to Isabella of Angouleme, widow of King John of England, added the County of Angouleme in 1220; that French line ended when Philip IV annexed La Marche in 1314. A younger branch had meanwhile risen in the Latin East: Guy of Lusignan wore the crown of Jerusalem, and in 1192, after the Third Crusade, the family established itself on Cyprus, which its kings ruled from Nicosia for nearly three centuries, also holding the mainland ports of Antalya and Corycus for parts of the fourteenth century. In 1337 a Lusignan still reigned over a prosperous Cyprus enriched by the trade of Famagusta. Through marriage the house inherited the Armenian kingdom of Cilicia in the mid-fourteenth century, only to lose it to the Mamluks in 1375. The Mamluks made Cyprus itself a tributary state in 1426 after capturing King Janus, and when the last queen, Catherine Cornaro, was forced to sell the island to Venice in 1489, the Lusignan royal line came to an end.
zh: 吕西尼昂家族原是普瓦图的吕西尼昂城堡小领主，世系可追溯到10世纪初，传说还把水精灵梅露辛奉为家族始祖。在法兰西，家族成员成为拉马什伯爵，于格十世又娶英格兰国王约翰的遗孀昂古莱姆的伊莎贝拉，于1220年添得昂古莱姆伯国；这支法兰西支系最终随1314年腓力四世吞并拉马什而告终。与此同时，一支幼系在拉丁东方崛起：居伊·德·吕西尼昂曾戴上耶路撒冷王冠，1192年第三次十字军东征后，家族在塞浦路斯立足，诸王以尼科西亚为中心统治该岛近三百年，14世纪还一度据有大陆上的安塔利亚和科里库斯两港。1337年，吕西尼昂国王仍统治着因法马古斯塔贸易而富庶的塞浦路斯。14世纪中叶，家族又通过联姻继承了亚美尼亚的奇里乞亚王国，却在1375年被马穆鲁克人攻灭。1426年马穆鲁克俘虏国王雅努斯后，塞浦路斯本身也沦为纳贡国；末代女王卡特琳娜·科尔纳罗被迫于1489年把岛屿卖给威尼斯，吕西尼昂王统就此终结。

en: The House of Luxembourg descended from the dukes of Limburg-Arlon, who had held Lower Lorraine in the eleventh century; in 1247 Henry V inherited the County of Luxembourg through his mother Ermesinde, heir of the older Ardennes counts. Henry VII, count from 1288 after his father fell at Worringen, was elected king of the Romans in 1308 with the backing of his brother Baldwin, archbishop of Trier, and was crowned emperor at Rome in 1312 before dying on campaign in Italy in 1313. His son John the Blind married the Přemyslid heiress Elisabeth of Bohemia in 1310, bringing the family the Bohemian crown and vassalizing the Piast dukes of Silesia between 1327 and 1335. John's son Charles IV took the imperial throne in 1346, issued the Golden Bull of 1356 that fixed the empire's electoral constitution, and added Brabant, Limburg, Lusatia and, in 1373, Brandenburg. His son Wenceslaus was deposed by the electors in 1400 in favour of the Wittelsbach Rupert, but Wenceslaus' brother Sigismund recovered the throne, ended the Western Schism in 1417 and was crowned emperor in 1433. At Sigismund's death without male heirs in 1437 the senior line ended; his daughter Elisabeth carried the inheritance to her Habsburg husband Albert V of Austria, and the county itself fell to the Habsburgs in 1443. The last known male of the house, George of Luxembourg, died in 1457.
zh: 卢森堡家族出自11世纪领有下洛林的林堡-阿尔隆公爵世家；1247年，亨利五世凭借母亲埃尔梅辛德（阿登老系伯爵的女继承人）的身份继承卢森堡伯国。1288年父亲在沃林根战役阵亡后，亨利七世成为伯爵，他在兄弟特里尔大主教巴尔杜因的支持下于1308年当选罗马人的国王，1312年在罗马加冕为皇帝，1313年在意大利征战期间去世。他的儿子盲人约翰于1310年迎娶普舍美斯王朝的女继承人波希米亚的伊丽莎白，为家族取得波希米亚王位，并在1327至1335年间使西里西亚的皮雅斯特公爵纷纷臣服。约翰之子查理四世于1346年登上帝位，1356年颁布确立帝国选举宪政的金玺诏书，又为家族取得布拉班特、林堡、卢萨蒂亚，并于1373年取得勃兰登堡。查理之子文策尔于1400年被选帝侯废黜，帝位落入维特尔斯巴赫家族的鲁普雷希特之手；但文策尔之弟西吉斯蒙德重夺帝位，1417年促成西方教会大分裂结束，1433年加冕为帝。西吉斯蒙德1437年无子而终，长支断绝，其女伊丽莎白把庞大遗产带给丈夫、哈布斯堡家族的奥地利公爵阿尔布雷希特五世，卢森堡伯国本身也于1443年落入哈布斯堡之手。家族已知的最后一名男性格奥尔格于1457年去世。

en: The Ma'bar dynasty ruled the short-lived Madurai Sultanate from the city of Madurai in Tamil country. Its founder Jalaluddin Ahsan Khan, a Muslim noble of northern origin, governed the province of Ma'bar for the Delhi Sultanate until the crises of Muhammad bin Tughluq's reign allowed him to declare independence around 1335. The sultanate held Madurai, Tiruchirapalli and parts of the southern Carnatic, and eight sultans followed one another in just forty-three years amid frequent coups and assassinations. Ghiyasuddin Damghani captured and killed the Hoysala king Veera Ballala III in 1343, and the Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta, who married a daughter of Jalaluddin, left a grim account of the court's cruelty toward its Hindu subjects. Constant war with the Hoysalas and the rising Vijayanagara Empire wore the sultanate down, and in 1378 Kumara Kampana's Vijayanagara army stormed Madurai and killed the last sultan, Alauddin Sikandar Shah, ending the dynasty and bringing the far south under Vijayanagara rule.
zh: 马巴尔王朝是定都泰米尔地区马杜赖的短命苏丹国——马杜赖苏丹国的统治家族。开创者贾拉勒丁·阿赫桑汗是出身北印度的穆斯林贵族，原代德里苏丹国镇守马巴尔省，趁穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克统治危机于1335年前后宣布独立。苏丹国领有马杜赖、蒂鲁吉拉伯利及南卡纳蒂克部分地区，四十三年间历经八位苏丹，宫廷政变与刺杀层出不穷。吉亚斯丁·达姆哈尼于1343年俘获并处死曷萨拉国王维拉·巴拉拉三世；摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰曾迎娶贾拉勒丁之女，他在游记中严厉记述了该朝廷对印度教臣民的残暴。与曷萨拉及崛起的毗奢耶那伽罗帝国的连年征战耗尽了国力，1378年毗奢耶那伽罗将领库马拉·坎帕纳攻陷马杜赖，杀死末代苏丹阿拉乌丁·西坎达尔沙，王朝灭亡，南印度就此纳入毗奢耶那伽罗版图。

en: The MacCarthys (Irish Mac Cárthaigh) were a leading Gaelic Irish dynasty of Munster whose chiefs ruled the kingdom of Desmond across much of what is now Cork and Kerry. They descend from Carthach, a king of the Eóganacht Chaisil who died in 1045; his grandsons adopted Mac Carthaigh as a surname after their father Muireadhach died in 1092. After the treaty of Glanmire of 1118 split Munster into Desmond and Thomond, Tadhg Mac Carthaigh became the first king of Desmond. Four great septs grew up under him: the MacCarthy Mór of south Kerry, the Duhallow branch of north-west Cork, the MacCarthy Reagh of Carbery, and the Muskerry MacCarthys, whose Blarney Castle was rebuilt in 1446. Fineen MacCarthy defeated the Geraldines in 1261, and the septs kept resisting Norman and English encroachment for centuries. The kingdom of Desmond was dissolved in 1596, and the Muskerry branch lost its titles after backing James II in the Williamite War, when it was attainted in 1691.
zh: 卡西家族（爱尔兰语 Mac Cárthaigh）是芒斯特的盖尔爱尔兰名门，其首领统治着以今科克和凯里一带为核心的德斯蒙德王国。家族源自1045年去世的埃奥加纳赫特·卡希尔支国王卡萨克；1092年他的儿子穆里达死后，孙子们正式以 Mac Carthaigh 为姓。1118年《格兰米尔条约》把芒斯特分为德斯蒙德与托蒙德，卡西家的泰格成为第一位德斯蒙德国王。家族后来形成四大支：南凯里的大卡西、西北科克的杜哈洛支、卡伯里的里亚支，以及以布拉尼城堡为据点的马斯克里支，现存的布拉尼城堡于1446年重建。1261年菲尼恩·卡西击败杰拉尔丁家族，此后各支长期抵抗诺曼人与英格兰人的进逼。德斯蒙德王国于1596年被废除；马斯克里支因在威廉王战争中支持詹姆斯二世，于1691年被褫夺爵位。

en: The Domhnaills, known in English as the MacDonalds of Clan Donald, are a Norse-Gaelic kindred of the Hebrides descended from Somerled, the self-styled King of the Hebrides who was killed at the Battle of Renfrew in 1164; the clan takes its name from his grandson Dòmhnall Mac Raghnuill, who died about 1250. As Norse vassals they passed to the Scottish crown after the Battle of Largs in 1263 and the Treaty of Perth, and Aonghus Óg of Islay fought for Robert the Bruce at Bannockburn in 1314. His grandson Donald of Islay, Lord of the Isles, claimed the Earldom of Ross through marriage and fought the bloody Battle of Harlaw against the crown's regent in 1411; the MacDonalds held Ross from 1437 until John of Islay surrendered the earldom in 1475. James IV forfeited the Lordship of the Isles altogether in 1493, and the risings of Domhnall Dubh to restore it had all failed by 1545, leaving the clan split into branches such as Sleat, Clanranald, Glengarry and Glencoe, each holding directly of the crown. MacDonald swordsmen rose in the Jacobite causes of 1715 and 1745, and the Glencoe MacDonalds had been massacred in their beds in 1692.
zh: 多纳尔家族即英语所称的麦克唐纳，属唐纳德氏族，是赫布里底群岛的诺斯—盖尔宗亲，先祖可追溯到自称赫布里底国王、1164年战死于伦弗鲁战役的萨默莱德；氏族得名于其孙、约1250年去世的多姆纳尔·麦克·拉格努伊尔。他们本是挪威国王的封臣，1263年拉格斯战役和《珀斯条约》后转归苏格兰王室；艾莱的安格斯·奥格曾在1314年的班诺克本战役中为罗伯特·布鲁斯效力。其孙艾莱的唐纳德身兼群岛之王，凭婚姻主张罗斯伯爵的继承权，1411年与王室摄政在惨烈的哈洛战役交锋；麦克唐纳家族自1437年起兼领罗斯，直到1475年艾莱的约翰交出伯爵头衔。1493年詹姆斯四世彻底没收群岛之王的领地，多姆纳尔·杜夫图谋复辟的历次起事到1545年全部失败，氏族随之分裂为斯利特、克兰拉纳德、格伦加里、格伦科等支系，各自直接向王室领取特许状。1692年格伦科支系在睡梦中惨遭屠杀，麦克唐纳人又在1715年和1745年的詹姆斯党起事中追随斯图亚特王朝。

en: The Leods are the MacLeods, Scottish Gaelic Clann Mhic Leòid, “sons of Leòd”, a Norse-Gaelic clan of the Inner Hebrides. Tradition makes Leòd, who lived in the thirteenth century, a younger son of Olaf the Black, king of Mann, and says he held Harris and part of Skye and married the heiress of the Norse steward of Dunvegan; he died about 1280 and was buried on Iona. His sons Tormod and Torquil founded the two great branches, Sìol Tormoid of Harris and Dunvegan and Sìol Torcaill of Lewis, while Dunvegan Castle on Skye became the chief seat. The MacLeods first appear in a royal charter of about 1343, fought for the Lord of the Isles at Harlaw in 1411, and lost their chief William Dubh at the Battle of Bloody Bay in 1481. Their long feud with the MacDonalds of Sleat ended in defeat at Coire Na Creiche on Skye in 1601, and early in the seventeenth century the Mackenzies seized Lewis from the Torcall branch. Five hundred MacLeods fought as royalists at the Battle of Worcester in 1651; the clan rose in the Jacobite cause in 1715, though in 1745 the Dunvegan chief backed the government while the MacLeods of Raasay fought at Culloden.
zh: 利奥德家族即麦克劳德氏族，盖尔语 Clann Mhic Leòid 意为“利奥德之子”，是内赫布里底群岛的诺斯—盖尔氏族。按家族传说，13世纪的利奥德是马恩岛国王黑脸奥拉夫的幼子，领有哈里斯岛和斯凯岛的一部分，又娶了邓韦根的诺斯总管之女；他约于1280年去世，葬在艾奥纳岛。他的两个儿子托莫德和托基尔开创了两大支系：一支据有哈里斯和邓韦根，一支据有刘易斯岛，斯凯岛上的邓韦根城堡则是全族的主城。麦克劳德人最早见于约1343年的王室特许状，1411年随群岛之王征战哈洛，1481年族长威廉·杜夫在血湾战役中阵亡。他们与斯利特麦克唐纳家族的世仇以1601年斯凯岛科雷纳克雷克之战的失败告终，17世纪初刘易斯岛又被麦肯齐家族从托基尔支系手中夺走。1651年有五百名麦克劳德人作为王党参加伍斯特战役；全族参与了1715年的詹姆斯党起事，而1745年邓韦根族长转而支持政府，拉塞岛的支系却在卡洛登为詹姆斯王子作战。

en: The MacMahons of Oriel (Irish Mac Mathghamhna, meaning son of the bear) were a Gaelic Irish chiefly family who ruled the kingdom of Airgíalla, anglicised as Oriel, a territory centred on what is now County Monaghan. A sept of Clann Nadsluaigh claiming descent from the Three Collas, they took their surname from Niall Mac Mathghamhna, himself descended from Mathgamna, lord of Fernmaige in the barony of Farney. They held the kingship of Oriel from 1243, so that in 1337 their chief still ruled this south Ulster kingdom. Caught between the expanding Tudor crown and the O'Neills of Tír Eoghain, Rossa Buidhe MacMahon surrendered and regranted his lands in 1590, when Oriel became County Monaghan, divided among five baronial families. The MacMahons joined the Irish rebellion of 1641 under Colla MacMahon; Hugh Oge MacMahon, betrayed after the Dublin Castle plot, escaped the Tower of London in 1644 but was recaptured and beheaded, after which the family's Monaghan lands passed to Protestant settlers.
zh: 奥里尔的马洪家族（爱尔兰语 Mac Mathghamhna，意为‘熊之子’）是盖尔爱尔兰首领家族，统治着以今莫纳亨郡为中心的奥里尔王国（爱尔兰语 Airgíalla）。他们属于克兰纳德尔斯卢伊支，自称世系可追溯到三科拉，姓氏得自尼尔·马洪，其先祖是法尼境内费尔马伊格的领主马加纳。马洪家自1243年起掌握奥里尔王权，1337年时其首领仍是阿尔斯特南部这个王国的统治者。在都铎政权扩张与蒂龙·奥尼尔家族的夹攻之下，罗萨·布伊德·马洪于1590年向英王投降并重新受封，奥里尔改为莫纳亨郡，分给五个男爵家族。1641年马洪家族在科拉·马洪率领下参加爱尔兰起义；休·奥格·马洪因都柏林城堡密谋败露被捕，1644年逃出伦敦塔后又被抓获并处决，家族在莫纳亨的土地随后落入新教定居者之手。

en: The Hugos are the Mackays, Clann Mhic Aoidh or “sons of Aoidh (Hugh)”, a Highland clan with roots in the old Kingdom of Moray that settled the far north-west of Scotland. Their Strathnaver lordship covered the parishes of Farr, Tongue, Durness and Eddrachillis in Sutherland, and clan tradition traces them to Malcolm MacHeth, Earl of Ross, who died about 1168, with Iye Mackay, born about 1210, as their first named chief. They fought for Robert the Bruce at Bannockburn in 1314, and the murder of chief Iye Mackay at Dingwall Castle in 1370 opened a long feud with the Sutherlands; rival clans were also met at the Battle of Tuiteam Tarbhach in 1403 and at Dingwall in 1411. Chief Iye Roy Mackay fell at Flodden in 1513. In 1626 Donald Mackay led three thousand clansmen to the Thirty Years' War and became the first Lord Reay, and the Mackays later served Charles I in the civil wars. The Hanoverian tradition held: General Hugh Mackay was beaten at Killiecrankie in 1689 and killed at Steenkerque in 1692, and the clan fought the Jacobites in 1715 and again in 1746, when it captured the Earl of Cromartie after the fight at Littleferry. In 1829 the Reay estate was sold to the Countess of Sutherland and the Highland clearances emptied much of Strathnaver.
zh: 雨果家族即麦凯氏族，盖尔语 Clann Mhic Aoidh 意为“艾，即休之子”，其根脉可溯至古老的马里王国，后来扎根苏格兰最西北端。他们的斯特拉斯纳弗领地涵盖萨瑟兰的法尔、汤格、德内斯和埃德拉希尔斯诸教区；按氏族传统，其先祖是约1168年去世的罗斯伯爵马尔科姆·麦克赫斯，约1210年出生的艾·麦凯则是第一位有名可考的族长。麦凯人1314年在班诺克本为罗伯特·布鲁斯作战，1370年族长艾·麦凯在丁沃尔城堡遇害，从此与萨瑟兰家族结下长期世仇；他们还在1403年的图蒂姆塔瓦之战和1411年的丁沃尔之战中与各路对手交锋。1513年，族长艾·罗伊·麦凯战死弗洛登。1626年，唐纳德·麦凯率三千族人赴三十年战争作战，后来成为第一代雷伊勋爵；内战中麦凯人又为查理一世效力。他们一贯支持汉诺威王室：休·麦凯将军1689年在基利克兰基战败，1692年死于斯滕凯克之战；1715年和1746年两度与詹姆斯党作战，并在1746年利特尔费里之战后生擒克罗默蒂伯爵。1829年，雷伊地产被卖给萨瑟兰女伯爵，随后的高地清洗使斯特拉斯纳弗大片土地人去地空。

en: The Anguses, known in Irish as Mac Aonghusa, “son of Angus”, and later anglicised as Magennis, were a Gaelic kindred of eastern Ulster. From the twelfth century they were chiefs of Iveagh in what is now County Down, based at Rathfriland and inaugurated on Knock Iveagh; Aedh Mor Magennis witnessed the charter of Newry Abbey in 1153. They allied with the Norman Earldom of Ulster until its collapse after 1333, then, by the fifteenth century, pushed the bounds of Iveagh east to Dundrum on the Irish Sea. Two Magennis chiefs were knighted by Henry VIII at Greenwich in 1542 under the policy of surrender and regrant, yet Art Roe Magennis joined Hugh O'Neill in the Nine Years' War and saw Lord Deputy Mountjoy ravage Iveagh before he submitted. Between 1607 and 1610 the Crown broke Iveagh into fifteen freeholds, and although Art Roe was created Lord Iveagh in 1623, the family's estates steadily passed to English speculators, until by 1700 the old lordship was shared between the Magennises, the McCartans and newly settled planters.
zh: 安格斯家族的盖尔语名为 Mac Aonghusa，意为“安格斯之子”，后英语化为马格尼斯，是阿尔斯特东部的盖尔宗亲。12世纪起他们成为今唐郡一带艾维格的首领，驻于拉斯弗赖兰，在诺克艾维格举行酋长继位仪式；1153年，艾德·莫尔·马格尼斯还在纽里修道院的特许状上联署作证。他们曾与诺曼人的阿尔斯特伯国结盟，1333年伯国崩溃后，于15世纪把艾维格的东界推进到爱尔兰海边的邓德拉姆。1542年，两位马格尼斯首领在格林尼治被亨利八世封为骑士，作为“投降与再封”政策的一部分；但阿尔特·罗伊·马格尼斯后来在九年战争中加入休·奥尼尔一方，眼看爱尔兰总督蒙乔伊把艾维格蹂躏殆尽才被迫投降。1607至1610年，王室把艾维格拆成十五块自由保有地，阿尔特·罗伊虽于1623年受封艾维格勋爵，家族地产仍不断落入英格兰投机者之手，到1700年前后，旧领地已由马格尼斯、麦卡坦两族和新来的种植园殖民者瓜分。

en: The Maguires, Gaelic Mac Uidhir or son of Odhar, were the ruling sept of Fermanagh in the lakelands of southern Ulster. They supplanted the older O'Devine chiefs around 1264, and Donn Carrach Maguire, who died in 1302, was the first of the line to rule the whole county, later called Maguire's Country. Chiefs were inaugurated on the summit of Cuilcagh or at Sciath Gabhra, the later Lisnaskea, and held Enniskillen Castle on Lough Erne, from which a large fleet policed the lough. As Lords of Fermanagh the Maguires kept their independence through the later Middle Ages, allied by marriage and war with the O'Neills and O'Donnells of Ulster. In the Nine Years' War of 1594 to 1603 Hugh Maguire joined the Irish rebels, while his kinsman Connor Roe backed the English crown. The submission that followed opened the way to the Plantation of Ulster of 1609, which confiscated most of the county. Bryan Maguire was made Baron Maguire of Enniskillen in 1627, but his sons rose in the Confederate wars of the 1640s: the second baron was executed in 1645 and Rory Maguire was killed in 1648. Later Maguires served the Stuart cause, and Roger Maguire sat in James II's Patriot Parliament of 1689.
zh: 马圭尔家族，盖尔语作麦克·伊尔，意为奥达尔之子，是阿尔斯特南部湖区弗马纳的统治氏族。他们约在1264年取代了更早的奥德文家族，卒于1302年的唐·卡拉赫·马圭尔是该世系中第一个统治整个郡的人，这块地方后来被称为马圭尔之地。族长在库尔卡山顶或希亚·加乌拉（即后来的利斯纳斯基）就职，坐镇厄恩湖畔的恩尼斯基林城堡，以一支庞大的船队巡弋湖面。作为弗马纳领主，马圭尔家族在整个中世纪后期保持独立，与阿尔斯特的奥尼尔、奥唐纳等家族或联姻或交战。1594至1603年的九年战争中，休·马圭尔加入爱尔兰叛军，他的族人康纳·罗则支持英格兰王室。随后的降服为1609年阿尔斯特殖民铺平道路，该郡大部分土地被没收。1627年布赖恩·马圭尔受封恩尼斯基林的马圭尔男爵，但他的儿子们在17世纪40年代的爱尔兰联盟战争中起兵：第二代男爵于1645年被处死，罗里·马圭尔于1648年战死。此后的马圭尔家族继续为斯图亚特王室效力，罗杰·马圭尔还出席了1689年詹姆斯二世的爱国者议会。

en: The Mahdali were the Arab sultans of Kilwa, the island trading city off the Swahili Coast in present-day Tanzania. Of Yemeni origin, their founder al-Hasan bin Talut seized power from the older Shirazi line at the end of the thirteenth century and took over Kilwa's grip on the gold trade from Sofala. The dynasty's golden age came under his grandson al-Hasan ibn Sulaiman, called Abu al-Mawahib, who reigned from 1310 to 1333: he minted Kilwa's only known gold coins, reconquered Mafia Island and began the great Husuni Kubwa palace and warehouse, while Ibn Battuta visited the city in 1331 and praised the sultan's generosity to strangers. In the fifteenth century the Mahdali sultanate claimed overlordship from Mozambique to Lamu, including Mombasa, Pemba and Zanzibar, as a loose confederation of merchant cities. The arrival of the Portuguese ended it: Vasco da Gama extorted tribute in 1502, and in 1505 Francisco de Almeida stormed and sacked Kilwa, installing a puppet sultan. The rival port cities broke away, trade fled elsewhere and the city was largely abandoned, carrying the Mahdali line down with it.
zh: 马赫达利王朝是基卢瓦的阿拉伯苏丹世系。基卢瓦是今坦桑尼亚近海斯瓦希里海岸的岛上商埠，马赫达利家族出身也门，始祖哈桑·本·塔卢特于13世纪末从老牌设拉子世系手中夺权，接管了基卢瓦对索法拉黄金贸易的控制。王朝的黄金时代在其孙哈桑·伊本·苏莱曼（人称“馈赠之父”）1310至1333年在位时：他铸造了基卢瓦迄今仅见的金币，重新征服马菲亚岛，并动工兴建宏伟的胡苏尼·库布瓦宫殿与货栈；伊本·白图泰1331年到访该城，盛赞这位苏丹对外来客慷慨好施。15世纪，马赫达利苏丹国以松散的商业城邦联盟形式，号令所及从莫桑比克直到拉穆，包括蒙巴萨、奔巴和桑给巴尔。葡萄牙人的到来终结了这一切：瓦斯科·达伽马1502年强索贡赋，弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达1505年攻陷并洗劫基卢瓦，扶立傀儡苏丹。诸港城邦纷纷独立，商路他移，城市大半废弃，马赫达利世系也随之没落。

en: The Maki are the royal line of the Tanade, one of the oldest Darod Somali clans, whose kingdom lay around the ancient port of Alula in northeastern Somalia. Clan tradition names Aw Maki as its first king, followed by Dirir and Hobanle, and dates the kingdom's collapse to 1775.
zh: 马基是塔纳代人的王世系。塔纳代是达鲁德索马里人最古老的支系之一，王国位于索马里东北部，以古老港口阿卢拉为中心；氏族口传以阿乌·马基为第一代王，迪里尔、霍班莱继之，并称王国于1775年瓦解。

en: The Banu Makki were a leading Muslim family of Gabes in Ifriqiya who turned a Hafsid governorship into a dynastic lordship lasting from 1282 to 1394. As Hafsid power weakened, they secured the appointment of their own kinsmen as governors and built a domain stretching from Gabes to Tripoli and the Jabal Nafusa. In 1355 they bought Tripoli itself from the Genoese, who had just seized it from the Banu Thabit, and by the middle of the fourteenth century they also held Sfax, ruling an effectively independent state along the Gulf of Gabes. Their autonomy ended under the Hafsid sultan Abu al-Abbas Ahmad II, who reigned from 1371 to 1394 and progressively reimposed direct Tunisian rule over the coast; the Banu Makki lost Gabes and disappeared from history when their lands were reabsorbed in 1394.
zh: 马基家族是伊夫里奇亚加贝斯的穆斯林望族，把哈夫斯王朝的总督职位经营成世袭统治，自1282年掌权至1394年。随着哈夫斯王权衰弱，他们安排同族出任总督，版图从加贝斯一直延伸到的黎波里和奈富塞山。1355年，他们从刚夺取的黎波里的热那亚人手中买下该城——此前的统治者是萨比特家族；到14世纪中叶，他们又据有斯法克斯，在加贝斯湾一带建立起事实上独立的政权。他们的独立终结于哈夫斯苏丹阿布·阿拔斯·艾哈迈德二世，此人1371至1394年在位，逐步在沿海恢复突尼斯的直接统治；1394年马基家族失去加贝斯，领地被重新吞并，家族也从历史记载中消失。

en: The House of Malaspina was a marquessal house of Lombard origin and Obertenghi stock, whose ancestor Oberto I became count of Luni in 945 and marquis of the Genoese march in 951. Alberto Malaspina, who died in 1140, was the first to bear the surname, meaning bad thorn in Italian, and his son Obizzo I played both sides in the wars of Emperor Frederick Barbarossa, fighting him, serving him and finally joining the Lombard League at the battle of Legnano in 1176. In 1221 the inheritance was split into the Spino Secco, or dried thorn, and Spino Fiorito, or bloomed thorn, branches, dividing the Lunigiana along the Magra river; repeated equal partition then shattered their lands into a mosaic of small marquisates. The family's courtesy to exiles won lasting fame: Moroello and Franceschino Malaspina sheltered Dante during his banishment, and he praised the house in the eighth canto of Purgatory, while Franceschino's talks with the bishop of Luni produced the peace of Castelnuovo in 1306. Spinetta Malaspina the Great bought the feud of Fosdinovo in 1340, and his descendants made its marquisate autonomous in 1355 and ruled it as imperial vicars until the last marquis renounced his feudal rights under Napoleonic rule in 1797. A related line took Massa in 1441 and added Carrara soon after, and through Ricciarda Malaspina's marriage to Lorenzo Cybò it became the Cybo-Malaspina dukes of Massa and Carrara.
zh: 马拉斯皮纳家族是伦巴第人出身的侯爵世家，属奥贝尔滕吉谱系，先祖奥贝托一世于945年成为卢尼伯爵，951年出任热那亚边区侯爵。1140年去世的阿尔贝托·马拉斯皮纳是第一个使用该姓氏的人，姓氏在意大利语中意为“恶刺”；其子奥比佐一世在皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的战争中几度改换立场，先与皇帝为敌、继而效力，最终在1176年的莱尼亚诺战役中加入伦巴第同盟。1221年，家产被分为“枯枝”与“繁花”两支，沿马格拉河瓜分卢尼贾纳；此后诸子均分的继承制又把领地碎化成众多小侯爵领。家族对流亡者的慷慨赢得了长久名声：莫罗埃洛和弗兰切斯基诺·马拉斯皮纳曾收留被放逐的但丁，但丁在《炼狱篇》第八章中盛赞该家族，弗兰切斯基诺与卢尼主教的谈判则促成1306年的卡斯泰尔诺沃和约。斯皮内塔·马拉斯皮纳（“大帝”）于1340年买下福斯迪诺沃封邑，其后人于1355年使该侯爵领自治，并以帝国代理人身份统治，直到末代侯爵在1797年拿破仑统治下放弃封建权利。另一支于1441年取得马萨、不久又取得卡拉拉，经里恰尔达·马拉斯皮纳嫁给洛伦佐·奇博，演变为统治马萨和卡拉拉公国的奇博-马拉斯皮纳家族。

en: The House of Malatesta was an Italian dynasty that ruled Rimini from 1295 to 1500 and held a string of cities across Romagna and the Marche. Its progenitor, Rodolfo of Carpegna, was nicknamed mala testa, or bad head, for his fierceness, and the family settled in Rimini in the twelfth century before Malatesta I rose to be its podestà in 1239. His son Malatesta da Verucchio turned Guelph after the emperor's defeat near Parma in 1248 and made himself sole lord of the city by expelling the rival Parcitadi in 1295. The house soon entered literature: in 1285 the hunchback Giovanni Malatesta murdered his wife Francesca da Polenta and his brother Paolo on finding them together, a scene Dante placed in the Inferno. Through the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries Malatesta lords and condottieri held Pesaro, Fano, Cesena and Cervia, while Malatesta Novello built the Malatestiana Library at Cesena between 1447 and 1452. Their most celebrated son, Sigismondo Pandolfo Malatesta, fought the papacy and Federico da Montefeltro and raised the Tempio Malatestiano at Rimini from 1450, but lost nearly all his lands and kept Rimini only with Venetian support. Cesare Borgia expelled his grandson Pandolfo in 1500, and after a last failed restoration the city passed to the Papal States in 1528; later branches lived on as condottieri until the middle of the eighteenth century.
zh: 马拉泰斯塔家族是意大利的诸侯世家，1295年至1500年统治里米尼，并在罗马涅和马尔凯一带据有一连串城市。始祖卡尔佩尼亚的鲁道夫因凶悍得绰号“恶头”，家族12世纪定居里米尼，马拉泰斯塔一世于1239年出任该城执政官。其子马拉泰斯塔·达·韦鲁基奥在1248年皇帝于帕尔马附近战败后转投圭尔夫派，并于1295年驱逐政敌帕尔奇塔迪家族，成为里米尼唯一的统治者。这个家族很快进入文学：1285年，驼背的乔瓦尼·马拉泰斯塔撞见妻子弗兰切斯卡·达·波伦塔与弟弟保罗私通，将二人杀死，但丁把这一幕写进了《地狱篇》。14、15世纪，马拉泰斯塔家族的领主和佣兵头领先后据有佩萨罗、法诺、切塞纳和切尔维亚；马拉泰斯塔·诺韦洛于1447年至1452年在切塞纳修建马拉泰斯塔图书馆。家族最著名的成员西吉斯蒙多·潘多尔福·马拉泰斯塔同时与教廷和费代里科·达·蒙特费尔特罗为敌，从1450年起在里米尼兴建马拉泰斯塔神庙，却几乎丢掉全部领地，只靠威尼斯支持才保住里米尼。1500年，切萨雷·博尔贾驱逐了他的孙子潘多尔福；最后一次复辟失败后，里米尼于1528年并入教皇国。其余支系此后继续以佣兵为业，直到18世纪中叶相继绝嗣。

en: The Malla dynasty ruled Nepal Mandala, the Kathmandu Valley and its surrounding hills, from 1201, when Arimalla first took the Sanskrit title Malla, meaning wrestler, until 1769. Presiding over the urban Newar civilisation, the kings made Nepal Bhasa their court language and grew rich on the India-Tibet trade; in 1260 a party of eighty artisans was sent to Tibet, among them Araniko, who went on to build the white stupa at Miaoying Temple for Kublai Khan's Yuan court. In 1337 Jayari Malla ruled a valley still shared by competing towns, and refugees from Mithila flooded in after Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq sacked the Tirhut kingdom in 1324. Jayasthiti Malla reunited the whole valley between 1382 and 1395 and issued its first comprehensive law code, organising society around a caste order, and the long reign of Yaksha Malla from about 1428 to 1482 marked the height of united Malla power. After his death the valley split into the three rival kingdoms of Kathmandu, Bhaktapur and Patan, whose related kings outdid one another in pagoda temples, palaces and tank building on their Durbar Squares; Pratap Malla of Kathmandu, reigning from 1641 to 1674, built Hanuman Dhoka and Rani Pokhari and patronised the living goddess Kumari. The three courts exhausted themselves in rivalry until Prithvi Narayan Shah of Gorkha took the valley in 1768 and 1769 after the Battle of Kirtipur, ending Malla rule with the fall of its last three kings, Jaya Prakash, Tej Narsingh and Ranajit Malla.
zh: 末罗·尼波罗王朝自1201年起统治尼波罗曼荼罗，即以加德满都谷地为中心的地区，开国的阿里·末罗首先采用意为“角力士”的梵文王号“末罗”，王朝延续至1769年。诸王治下尼瓦尔城市文明繁荣，尼瓦尔语为宫廷语言，国家凭印度—西藏商路致富；1260年谷地曾派出八十名工匠入藏，其中的阿尼哥后来北上元朝，为忽必烈主持修建了北京妙应寺白塔。1337年在位的贾亚里·末罗所统治的谷地仍由数座互相竞争的城镇分据；1324年吉亚斯·丁·图格鲁克攻破提尔胡特王国后，大批弥提拉难民涌入谷地。贾亚斯提提·末罗于1382至1395年重新统一整个谷地，颁布首部系统法典，按种姓整饬社会秩序；亚克沙·末罗约1428至1482年的长期统治则是统一末罗政权的鼎盛期。他死后谷地分裂为加德满都、巴克塔普尔和帕坦三个互争雄长的王国，同源的诸王在各自的杜巴广场竞相修建金顶宝塔、宫殿与水池，1641至1674年在位的加德满都国王普拉塔普·末罗修建了哈努曼多卡宫和拉尼博卡里水池，并尊崇库玛丽活女神。三雄内耗耗尽国力，廓尔喀国王普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿经基尔蒂普尔战役，于1768至1769年攻占谷地，末代三王贾亚·普拉卡什、特杰·纳尔辛格与拉纳吉特相继败亡，末罗统治告终。

en: The Malla kings of Mallabhum, also called the Bagdi Rajas, ruled the forests of the Rarh region in what is now Bankura district of West Bengal from the seventh century, when the founder Adi Malla established a small chiefdom around 694 and died in 710. A later ruler, Jagat Malla, moved the capital to Bishnupur, which remained the dynasty's seat for almost a thousand years; the forty-sixth king, Chandra Malla, was reigning there around 1500. The dynasty's golden age came under Bir Hambir, the forty-ninth king, who ruled from 1565 to 1620: he fought beside the Mughal general Man Singh against the Afghan rulers of Orissa, acknowledged Mughal suzerainty by paying tribute, and after hearing the Bhagavata from the saint Srinivasa converted to Vaishnavism, making Bishnupur a centre of Vishnu worship and adding Dev to the royal titles. His successors Raghunath Singha Dev and Bir Singha Dev built the terracotta temples for which Bishnupur is still known, while royal patronage also produced the Bishnupur Gharana of Hindustani music and a local school of painting. As Mughal power waned the kingdom was wasted by Maratha raids, and in 1760 Bishnupur was ceded to the British East India Company with the rest of the Burdwan chakla; the rajas were reduced to zamindars, the famine of 1770 depopulated much of the land, and Madhav Singha Dev led the Chuar and Paik rebellion against the Company between 1788 and 1809.
zh: 末罗浮摩的马拉诸王又称巴格迪罗阇，自7世纪起统治拉尔赫地区的丛林地带，其地在今印度境内：开国者阿迪·马拉约在694年建立小型酋长国，710年去世。后来的贾加特·马拉把都城迁至毗湿奴普尔，此地在此后近千年间一直是王朝的王都；第46代国王钱德拉·马拉约于1500年前后在位。王朝的黄金时代在第49代国王比尔·汉比尔治下，他于1565至1620年在位，曾随莫卧儿将领曼·辛格征讨奥里萨的阿富汗政权，以纳贡承认莫卧儿宗主权；后来他听圣人斯里尼瓦萨宣讲《薄伽梵往世书》后皈依毗湿奴派，使毗湿奴普尔成为毗湿奴信仰中心，并在王号中加上“提婆”。其后继者拉古纳特·辛哈·提婆与比尔·辛哈·提婆兴建了闻名于世的赤陶神庙，王室的赞助还催生了印度斯坦音乐的毗湿奴普尔乐派和本地画派。莫卧儿势力衰落之后，王国遭马拉塔人劫掠凋敝，1760年毗湿奴普尔随布尔德万查克拉一并割让给英国东印度公司，诸王被降为柴明达尔；1770年的大饥荒使大量人口死亡，马达夫·辛哈·提婆又在1788至1809年间领导丘阿尔人与派克制服者反抗东印度公司。

en: The Manfredi were a patrician house of Faenza in Romagna, numbered among the city's consuls as early as 1050, who turned their local standing into a signoria during the fourteenth century. Francesco I Manfredi, son of a Guelph leader, became capitano del popolo in 1313 and made himself absolute lord of Faenza and Imola in 1319, although papal reconquests repeatedly interrupted the family's rule. The condottiere Astorre I reconquered Faenza from the Este in 1377 with help from the Ordelaffi of Forlì, ran his own mercenary band, the Company of the Star, and defeated Azzo d'Este at the battle of Portomaggiore in 1395; after the Papacy retook the city in 1404 he was condemned and executed in Faenza's main square in 1405. Restored in 1410, the dynasty held Faenza for another century and Imola from 1439 to 1473, combining lordship with condottiere careers: Galeotto Manfredi commanded the Florentine army in 1483 and was murdered by his wife Francesca Bentivoglio in 1488. Her three-year-old son Astorre III inherited, only to be deposed when Cesare Borgia captured Faenza in April 1501; he was held in the Castel Sant'Angelo and murdered in Rome in 1502, his body thrown into the Tiber, and after a brief restoration under Astorre IV in 1503 the city passed permanently to the Papal States.
zh: 曼弗雷迪家族是罗马涅法恩扎的贵族世家，早在1050年就已名列该市执政官，14世纪时把地方声望转化为世袭领主权。圭尔夫派领袖之子弗朗切斯科一世·曼弗雷迪于1313年出任平民官，1319年成为法恩扎和伊莫拉的专制领主，不过教皇国的几度收复多次打断家族统治。佣兵头领阿斯托雷一世于1377年在弗利的奥尔代拉菲家族帮助下从埃斯特家族手中夺回法恩扎，自组“星辰佣兵团”，并在1395年的波尔托马焦雷战役中击败阿佐·德埃斯特；1404年教皇国重新占领法恩扎后，他被判刑并于1405年在法恩扎广场处决。1410年家族复辟，又统治法恩扎近一个世纪，并于1439年至1473年领有伊莫拉，领主权与佣兵生涯并行：加莱奥托·曼弗雷迪1483年统率佛罗伦萨军队，1488年被妻子弗兰切斯卡·本蒂沃利奥杀害。她三岁的儿子阿斯托雷三世继位，却在1501年4月切萨雷·博尔贾攻陷法恩扎后被废黜；他被关押在圣天使城堡，1502年在罗马遇害，尸体被抛入台伯河。1503年阿斯托雷四世短暂复辟后，法恩扎永久并入教皇国。

en: The Mangrai dynasty was the royal house of Lan Na, the northern Thai kingdom centered on Chiang Mai. Its founder Mangrai, born around 1238, was the twenty-fifth king of the old mueang of Ngoenyang at Chiang Saen. He founded Chiang Rai in 1262, conquered the Mon kingdom of Hariphunchai in 1281, and in 1296 laid out Chiang Mai, the new city, as the capital of the unified Lan Na kingdom, drawing tribute from across northern Thailand, the Shan states and Sipsongpanna. After his death in 1311 succession disputes brought six kings in eleven years, until his grandson Kham Fu restored stability; in 1337 the throne belonged to Phayu, who re-fortified Chiang Mai and built Wat Phra Singh. Under Kue Na later in the fourteenth century Theravada Buddhism flourished and the Doi Suthep stupa was founded. By the fifteenth century Lan Na could fight Ayutthaya on equal terms, but mid-sixteenth-century succession struggles weakened it: Ayutthaya forced tributary status in 1546, and in 1558 Bayinnaung's Burmese armies conquered Chiang Mai. The house then ruled as Burmese vassals, with intervals of independence, until Kawila of Lampang, with Siamese help, drove out the Burmese in 1775 and Lan Na passed under Siamese suzerainty.
zh: 孟莱王朝是以清迈为中心的泰北王国兰纳的王室。开创者孟莱约生于1238年，本是清盛恩央城的第二十五代君主。他于1262年兴建清莱，1281年攻灭孟人的哈里奔猜王国，1296年又营建新城清迈作为统一的兰纳王国之都，势力所及涵盖泰北、掸邦和西双版纳等地，各地纷纷纳贡。1311年孟莱死后继承混乱，十一年间换了六位君主，直到他的孙子一辈恢复稳定；1337年在位的是帕育，他重修清迈城防，并修建了帕辛寺。14世纪后期的桂纳王时期，上座部佛教兴盛，素贴山佛塔也在此时奠基。15世纪的兰纳已能与阿瑜陀耶分庭抗礼，但16世纪中期的继承纷争使其转衰：1546年被迫向阿瑜陀耶称臣，1558年更被勃印曩的缅甸大军征服，清迈陷落。此后孟莱家族作为缅甸附庸继续统治，间或独立，直到1775年南邦的卡维拉在暹罗协助下驱逐缅甸人，兰纳转归暹罗宗主权之下。

en: The Manikandans were the royal house of Thekkumkur, a kingdom in southern Kerala between the Meenachil and Pamba rivers, whose rulers all bore Manikandan as part of their regnal name. The state took shape in 1103, when the old chiefdom of Vempolinad split into Thekkumkur and Vadakkumkur after the decline of the Chera kingdom, and its first capitals were Vennimala and Manikandapuram, where Iravi Manikandan Varman built the Krishna temple in 1152. Early in the fifteenth century the court moved to Changanassery and later added a fortress-capital at Kottayam, while kings such as Rama Varman Manikandan are named in the Malayalam poem Unnuneeli Sandesam. The line ended with Aditya Varma Manikandan: after he took sides against the expanding Travancore of Marthanda Varma, Ramayyan Dalawa's troops stormed Changanassery in 1749 and Thekkumkur was annexed to Travancore in 1753.
zh: 摩尼建多家族是喀拉拉南部特库姆库尔王国的王室，该王国位于米纳奇尔河与潘巴河之间，历代君主的王号中都带有摩尼建多一名。1103年，旧领地温波利纳德在哲罗王国衰落后分裂为特库姆库尔和瓦达库姆库尔，特库姆库尔由此立国，早期都城为文尼马拉和摩尼建多普兰，伊拉维·摩尼建多·瓦尔马于1152年在那里修建了黑天神庙。15世纪初宫廷迁往昌加纳切里，后来又在科塔亚姆增设设防都城；罗摩·瓦尔马·摩尼建多等君主见于马拉雅拉姆语长诗《温努尼利信使》。王朝末代君主阿底提耶·瓦尔马·摩尼建多与扩张中的特拉凡哥尔为敌，1749年马坦达·瓦尔马的将领拉马扬·达拉瓦率军攻陷昌加纳切里，特库姆库尔于1753年被并入特拉凡哥尔。

en: The House of Mansfeld was a comital dynasty of the Holy Roman Empire, named after the town of Mansfeld and seated at Eisleben in the Saxon Hassegau. Emperor Henry IV made its lords counts there after the Saxon revolt of 1069. Their progenitor Hoyer I served Emperor Henry V as field marshal and fell at the Battle of Welfesholz in 1115. When Count Burchard died without sons in 1229, a lord of Querfurt married his heiress Sophia and took the Mansfeld title, so that in 1337 the family still held the County of Mansfeld with fiefs under the archbishopric of Magdeburg and the bishopric of Halberstadt. In the fifteenth century it split into the Vorderort, Mittelort and Hinterort branches, and in 1512 the county joined the Upper Saxon Circle. The Reformation divided the branches: the Vorderort stayed Catholic while the others backed Luther, and Count Albert VII of Hinterort signed the Augsburg Confession in 1530 and was banned after the Battle of Mühlberg in 1547. Crippled by debt, the counts lost their estates and imperial immediacy in 1579, mediatized between Saxony and Magdeburg. Ernst von Mansfeld led Protestant armies early in the Thirty Years' War, while Peter Ernst I governed the Spanish Netherlands for the Spanish Habsburgs. The Mittelort and Hinterort lines died out in 1602 and 1666, and the last Vorderort male, Josef Wenzel, Prince of Fondi, died in 1780; his heiress married a Colloredo, whose house took the name Colloredo-Mansfeld.
zh: 曼斯费尔德家族是神圣罗马帝国的伯爵世家，得名于曼斯费尔德镇，祖居萨克森哈塞高的艾斯莱本。1069年萨克森叛乱后，皇帝亨利四世将其首领封为当地伯爵。家族始祖霍耶一世曾任皇帝亨利五世的陆军元帅，1115年在韦尔费斯霍尔茨之战中阵亡。1229年伯爵布尔夏德无子而终，奎尔富特家族的一名领主娶其女继承人索菲亚并承袭曼斯费尔德头衔，因此1337年家族仍领有曼斯费尔德伯国，在马格德堡大主教区和哈尔伯施塔特主教区下辖有封地。15世纪家族分裂为福尔德奥特、米特尔奥特和欣特奥特三支，1512年伯国加入上萨克森行政圈。宗教改革使各支分裂：福尔德奥特支仍奉天主教，其余各支支持路德；欣特奥特支的阿尔布雷希特七世伯爵于1530年签署《奥格斯堡信纲》，1547年米尔贝格之战后被褫夺公权。由于债务沉重，伯爵们于1579年丧失领地和帝国直辖地位，被萨克森与马格德堡瓜分管辖。恩斯特·冯·曼斯费尔德在三十年战争初期统率新教军队，彼得·恩斯特一世则为西班牙哈布斯堡家族治理西属尼德兰。米特尔奥特与欣特奥特两支分别于1602年和1666年绝嗣，福尔德奥特支最后一名男丁、丰迪亲王约瑟夫·文策尔于1780年去世，其女继承人嫁入科洛雷多家族，该家族改姓科洛雷多-曼斯费尔德。

en: The Manuel de Villena were a noble house of royal Castilian blood, descended from Infante Manuel of Castile, a son of Ferdinand III, and one of the lineages that grew directly from the Castilian royal trunk. Its towering figure was Don Juan Manuel, born in the castle of Escalona on 5 May 1282 and raised at the court of his cousin Sancho IV. From his father he inherited the vast lordship of Villena on the Murcian frontier, together with Peñafiel, and the kings of Aragon later granted him the titles of Duke and Prince of Villena; he was among the richest men in Castile, wealthy enough to strike his own coinage. His feud with Alfonso XI, whose young queen was Juan Manuel's daughter Constanza, kept the kingdom in intermittent revolt through the 1320s and 1330s, allied at times with Aragon and Granada, until reconciliation in 1340, when he fought beside the king at Río Salado and the siege of Algeciras. He is better remembered as the greatest prose writer of medieval Castile, above all for the frame-tale collection Count Lucanor, finished around 1335. His daughter Juana Manuel married Henry of Trastámara and became queen of Castile as the wife of Henry II, while another daughter, Constanza, married Peter I of Portugal. The house kept its titles and military employments for centuries after the prince's death in 1348.
zh: 曼努埃尔·德·比列纳家族是带有卡斯蒂利亚王室血统的贵族世家，始祖为费尔南多三世之子曼努埃尔亲王，是直接从卡斯蒂利亚王室主干分出的世系之一。家族的核心人物是堂胡安·曼努埃尔，1282年5月5日生于埃斯卡洛纳城堡，在表兄桑治四世的宫廷中长大。他从父亲那里继承了穆尔西亚边境上广袤的比列纳领地和佩尼亚菲耶尔，阿拉贡国王后来又授予他比列纳公爵和亲王的头衔；他是卡斯蒂利亚最富有的人之一，甚至像国王一样自铸钱币。他与阿方索十一世长期对立——年轻的王后正是他的女儿康斯坦萨——在14世纪20至30年代间断断续续地发动叛乱，一度与阿拉贡和格拉纳达结盟，直到1340年双方和解，他随国王参加了萨拉多河之战和阿尔赫西拉斯之围。他更以中世纪卡斯蒂利亚最伟大的散文作家闻名，代表作是约1335年成书的框架故事集《卢卡诺尔伯爵》。他的女儿胡安娜·曼努埃尔嫁给特拉斯塔马拉的恩里克，后来成为恩里克二世的卡斯蒂利亚王后；另一个女儿康斯坦萨则嫁给葡萄牙国王佩德罗一世。1348年这位亲王去世后，家族仍在数百年间保有爵位和军职。

en: The Marinids were a Berber dynasty of the Zenata confederation, descended from the Banu Marin, a nomadic tribe originally from the Zab around Biskra that drifted into eastern Morocco and pastured between Sijilmasa and Figuig. Their leader Abd al-Haqq I made the family a power early in the thirteenth century, and after the Almohad collapse following Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212 they waged a long war against their former masters, taking Fez and finally capturing Marrakesh in 1269. Abu Yusuf Yaqub founded New Fez in 1276 and intervened repeatedly in Spain to support the Emirate of Granada, but the Iberian adventure ended with defeat at the Río Salado in 1340 and the loss of Algeciras to Castile in 1344. At their zenith under Abu al-Hasan, the Marinids conquered Tlemcen in 1337 and overran the Hafsid lands as far as Tripoli in 1347, uniting most of the Maghreb for a few years. After Abu Inan was strangled by his own vizier in 1358 the sultans became puppets of their ministers; Marrakesh broke away in 1359, Castile sacked Tetouan in 1399 and Portugal seized Ceuta in 1415. The related Wattasid house held the regency from 1420, and when the last sultan Abd al-Haqq II was murdered in the Fez revolt of 1465, Marinid rule gave way to the Wattasids. Their Fez was a golden age of Maliki learning, studded with new madrasas.
zh: 马林王朝是柏柏尔人泽纳塔联盟的一支，源出贝尼马林游牧部落——他们原本在比斯克拉附近的扎布地区游牧，后逐步西迁进入摩洛哥东部，在锡吉勒马萨与菲吉格之间逐水草而居。13世纪初，首领阿卜杜勒·哈克一世使家族崛起；1212年穆瓦希德王朝在拉斯纳瓦斯德托洛萨战役惨败后，马林人对旧主连年用兵，攻取非斯，最终于1269年拿下马拉喀什。阿布·优素福·叶尔孤白1276年兴建新非斯，并多次渡海支援伊比利亚的格拉纳达酋长国，但这场海外冒险以1340年里奥萨拉多战役惨败、1344年阿尔赫西拉斯落入卡斯蒂利亚之手告终。在阿布·哈桑治下王朝达到极盛：1337年征服特莱姆森，1347年又席卷哈夫斯人的土地，兵锋远及的黎波里，一度统一马格里布大部。1358年阿布·伊南被自己的维齐尔缢杀后，苏丹沦为权臣傀儡：马拉喀什1359年脱离，1399年卡斯蒂利亚洗劫得土安，1415年葡萄牙夺取休达。同族的瓦塔斯家族自1420年起把持摄政，1465年末代苏丹阿卜杜勒·哈克二世在非斯暴动中被杀，马林王朝告终，瓦塔斯王朝取而代之。马林治下的非斯是马立克派学术的黄金时代，城中建起了一座座新的伊斯兰学校。

en: The House of La Marck, or von der Mark, began as a cadet line of the counts of Berg at Altena in Westphalia. Around 1198 Count Frederick of Berg-Altena built Mark Castle on the Ruhr, and his son Adolf I, first documented as count de La Marck in 1202, founded Hamm in 1226 and made the County of Mark the family's seat. Originally ministeriales of the archbishops of Cologne, the counts broke free by fighting for Brabant at the Battle of Worringen in 1288 and became the leading lords of southern Westphalia, while younger sons ruled the prince-bishoprics of Liege, Muenster and Osnabrueck and even the see of Cologne. In 1368 Adolf III inherited Cleves and in 1394 united it with the Mark; under John III the Peaceful the house combined Juelich, Cleves, Berg, Mark and Ravensberg into the United Duchies in 1521, and his daughter Anne of Cleves married Henry VIII of England. When the last duke died in 1609, the Treaty of Xanten of 1614 assigned the Mark to Brandenburg. A collateral branch held the duchy of Bouillon and the principality of Sedan, while the last male count died in 1773 and the title passed to the House of Arenberg.
zh: 德马克家族又称拉马克家族，原为威斯特伐利亚阿尔特纳的贝格伯爵幼支。约1198年，贝格—阿尔特纳的腓特烈伯爵在鲁尔河畔修建马克城堡；其子阿道夫一世1202年首次以马克伯爵之名见载，1226年兴建哈姆城，并以马克伯国为家族基业。家族本是科隆大主教的家臣，1288年在沃林根战役中协助布拉班特获胜后摆脱科隆控制，成为南威斯特伐利亚的头等领主，幼子们则先后出掌列日、明斯特、奥斯纳布吕克主教区乃至科隆大主教之位。1368年阿道夫三世继承克莱沃，1394年将其与马克合并；1521年和平者约翰三世治下，家族把于利希、克莱沃、贝格、马克和拉文斯贝格合为联合公国，他的女儿克莱沃的安娜后来嫁给英格兰国王亨利八世。1609年末代公爵去世，依1614年《克桑滕条约》，马克划归勃兰登堡。家族旁支领有布永公国和色当亲王国，末代男嗣伯爵1773年去世，头衔转入阿伦贝格家族。

en: The Mashiko were a warrior house of Haga District in Shimotsuke, seated at Mashiko with Saimyōji Castle and holdings of some six hundred chō, and leaders of the Ki-tō, one of the two great warrior bands in the service of the Utsunomiya, shugo of Shimotsuke. They claimed Ki clan descent from the ancient minister Takenouchi no Sukune. Their founder Mashiko Masataka was a son of Ki no Sadataka, and under the third head Masashige they marched in Utsunomiya Tomotsuna's twenty-thousand-strong army during the Ōshū campaign of 1189, earning one of the Minamoto white banners that Yoritomo granted to the Ki-tō and Haga bands. In the Nanboku-chō war they followed the Utsunomiya on the Northern Court side, fighting in the Kyoto region, where Mashiko Kensuke fell at Tō-ji, and in 1339 Southern Court troops briefly seized their castles. During the Sengoku centuries the house acted as an independent lord: Mashiko Katsumune, who seized the headship in 1546, opened his own ties with Takeda Shingen and received the character shin from Shingen's name for his heir, yet the clan also raided Takeda Katsuyori's camp in 1578. Open revolt against the Utsunomiya in the 1580s ended in the defeat and death of Mashiko Iemune, and after the 1590 settlement of Shimotsuke the survivors are thought to have taken the surname Kataoka; other Mashiko followed the Satake to Akita in 1602.
zh: 益子氏是下野国芳贺郡的武家，以益子邑为据点，领有约六百町土地，居城为西明寺城，并统领下野两大武士团之一的纪党，世代担任下野守护宇都宫氏的重臣。他们本姓纪氏，自称是古代大臣武内宿祢的后裔，始祖益子正隆为纪贞隆之子。第三代益子正重时，一族随宇都宫朝纲率两万大军参加1189年的奥州合战，与芳贺氏的清党各获源赖朝赐予的一面源氏白旗，纪清两党由此成为宇都宫氏麾下的两大武力支柱。南北朝时代，益子氏随主家站在北朝一边，转战京都周边，益子显助战死于东寺；1339年，南朝军还一度攻陷他们的西明寺城等城池。进入战国，益子氏以独立领主自居：1546年益子胜宗攻灭宗家夺取家督，又自行结交甲斐的武田信玄，为嫡子拜领“信”字；但1578年武田胜赖入侵上野时，他们又随北关东诸将夜袭武田营地。16世纪80年代，益子氏公开反叛宇都宫国纲，最终当主益子家宗兵败身亡；1590年下野领地重新划分后，幸存者据说改用片冈姓氏，另有一族随佐竹氏于1602年迁往秋田。

en: The Masuda were a warrior house of Iwami Province on the Sea of Japan coast, in present-day Shimane Prefecture, who held their castle town of Masuda from the twelfth century to 1600. They traced their line to Fujiwara Kunikane, appointed governor of Iwami in the late Heian period, and took their name when the fourth head, Kanetaka, moved the family seat to the port of Masuda and sided with the Minamoto in the Gempei War, fighting under Minamoto no Yoshitsune at Ichi-no-Tani in 1184 and Dan-no-ura in 1185. By the early Kamakura years the family ruled roughly a third of Iwami. In the Muromachi age the fifteenth head, Kanetsu, campaigned in the Ōnin War of 1467 and entertained the painter Sesshū Tōyō, who painted his portrait in gratitude. Long allied with the Ōuchi and hard pressed by the Amago, the Masuda eventually submitted to the rising Mōri: Motoyoshi, the twentieth head, received a character of his name from Mōri Motonari and held lands stretching from Nagato to Izumo and into Kyushu, profiting also from overseas trade. On the Toyotomi side at Sekigahara in 1600 though absent from the battle, they kept their lands under Tokugawa Ieyasu but chose to follow the dispossessed Mōri into exile at Susa in Nagato, ending four centuries of rule in Masuda.
zh: 益田氏是日本海沿岸石见国（今岛根县）的武士家族，从12世纪到1600年一直以益田的城下町为据点。其先祖可追溯到平安末期出任石见守的藤原国兼；第四代家督兼高把本据迁到港口要冲益田并以此为苗字，源平合战时投奔源氏，在源义经麾下参加了1184年的一之谷之战和1185年的坛之浦之战。镰仓初期，益田家已领有石见约三分之一的土地。室町时代，第十五代兼尧参加了1467年开启的应仁之乱，还曾接待画僧雪舟等杨，雪舟为答谢其款待而画下《益田兼尧像》。益田家长期与大内氏结盟，在尼子氏的压力下最终臣服于崛起的毛利氏：第二十代元祥获毛利元就赐予偏讳“元”字，领地从长门延伸到出云并及于九州部分地区，还通过海外贸易获利。1600年关原之战时他们名义上从属丰臣方但未出兵，德川家康虽准许其保留领地，益田家却选择随被改易的毛利氏迁往长门须佐，结束了在益田四百年的统治。

en: The Mataranga were an Albanian noble family that held the coastland between Durrës and Vlorë. They first appear in a Ragusan document of 1297, and in the early fourteenth century they shifted between Angevin and Byzantine overlordship, accepting Philip of Taranto as suzerain when he retook Durrës in 1304; one of them, Nicholas Matarangos, rose to one of the four general judges of the Byzantine court and took part in the civil war of 1341 to 1347. Paul Mataranga joined an Albanian coalition against King Stephen Milutin of Serbia in 1319, but the family's lands were swallowed by the expanding Serbian Empire before 1343. After the death of Stephen Dušan in 1355, Blasius Mataranga built the short-lived Principality of Mataranga between the Shkumbin and Seman rivers, ruling from 1358 to 1367 with the Byzantine title of sevastokrator under the suzerainty of Simeon Uroš and exporting grain to Ragusa. In 1367 his principality was partitioned between the Thopia and Muzaka families, ending the house's independent rule; a daughter of the house, Euphemia, had married Andrea II Muzaka.
zh: 马特兰加家族是阿尔巴尼亚贵族世家，据有都拉斯与发罗拉之间的沿海地带。它最早见于1297年的拉古萨文书，14世纪初在安茹王朝与拜占庭之间辗转称臣：1304年塔兰托的菲利普夺回都拉斯时，他们接受其宗主权；家族成员尼古拉斯·马塔兰戈斯还升任拜占庭朝廷的四名大法官之一，参与了1341年至1347年的内战。1319年，保罗·马特兰加加入阿尔巴尼亚联盟对抗塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·米卢廷，但家族领地在1343年前被扩张中的塞尔维亚帝国吞并。1355年斯特凡·杜尚死后，布拉修斯·马特兰加在什昆宾河与塞曼河之间建立了短命的马特兰加公国，1358年至1367年间以西美昂·乌罗什附庸的身份持有拜占庭“至尊者”头衔，并向拉古萨出口粮食。1367年，公国被托皮亚和穆扎卡两大家族瓜分，该家族的独立统治就此结束；家族女子尤菲米娅此前已嫁给安德烈二世·穆扎卡。

en: The House of Mathrafal, also called the Lleision or House of Powys, took its name from Mathrafal Castle near Welshpool, the seat of the kings of Powys from the ninth century. The family rose in 1063, when Harold and Tostig Godwinson installed Bleddyn ap Cynfyn, half-brother of Gruffudd ap Llywelyn, as a ruler in north Wales. Driven out of Gwynedd, the house was rebuilt by Maredudd ap Bleddyn, who restored the Kingdom of Powys, and reached its height under Madog ap Maredudd, a patron of the Church who steered between the Empress Matilda and Henry II of England. After Madog's death in 1160 Powys split into the principalities of Powys Fadog and Powys Wenwynwyn, and Mathrafal Castle itself was destroyed by Llywelyn the Great in 1213. Uniquely among the Welsh royal houses, Mathrafal survived the Edwardian conquest largely intact, exchanging its royal claims for the English lordship of Powys at the Parliament of Shrewsbury in 1283. Under Edward II the heiress Hawys Gadarn was married to the English courtier John Charlton, carrying the southern lordship to an English line. The northern branch lived on to produce Owain Glyndŵr, who led the great Welsh Revolt against Henry IV in the opening years of the fifteenth century.
zh: 马斯拉法尔家族又称莱申家族或波伊斯家族，得名于威尔士浦附近的马斯拉法尔城堡——自9世纪起那里就是波伊斯诸王的驻地。1063年，哈罗德·戈德温森与托斯蒂格·戈德温森兄弟拥立格鲁菲兹·阿普·卢埃林的异母兄弟布莱丁·阿普·坎芬在北威尔士执政，家族由此崛起。被逐出圭内斯后，马雷杜德·阿普·布莱丁重建家族、恢复波伊斯王国；到马多格·阿普·马雷杜德时势力达到顶峰，他护持教会，在玛蒂尔达皇后与英格兰的亨利二世之间周旋。1160年马多格死后，波伊斯分裂为波伊斯·法多格和波伊斯·温温温两个亲王国，马斯拉法尔城堡本身也于1213年被卢埃林大帝摧毁。在威尔士诸王室中，唯独马斯拉法尔家族大体完整地熬过了爱德华一世的征服，于1283年的什鲁斯伯里议会上以王权主张换取英格兰式的波伊斯勋爵领地。爱德华二世在位时，女继承人哈维斯·加达尔恩被嫁给英格兰廷臣约翰·查尔顿，南部领地随之转入英格兰支系。北方支系则延续下来，诞生了欧文·格兰道尔——他在15世纪初领导了反抗亨利四世的威尔士大起义。

en: The Matsuda of Sagami originated in the Ashigara district as a leading house of the Hatano kinship group, heirs of Fujiwara no Hidesato. In the twelfth century their elder Aritsune's father fought Minamoto no Yoritomo at the Battle of Ishibashiyama in 1180 and held out in Matsuda Castle before being forced to his death; Aritsune was pardoned and granted the Matsuda estate, from which the family took its name. Many Matsuda joined Wada Yoshimori's rising in 1213, and in 1333 the clan took the field with Nitta Yoshisada against the Hojo at Bubaigawara, later standing by the Southern Court when Ashikaga Takauji's armies overran the Ashigara castles. One branch had already moved to Bizen Province, where it ruled the western districts until Ukita Naoie destroyed it in 1568. The Sagami main line backed Ise Moritoki, the future Hojo Soun, when he seized Odawara Castle in 1495, and became one of the seven veteran houses and chief karo councillors of the Later Hojo; Matsuda Norihide, the tenth head, was the clan's foremost councillor during the Odawara campaign of 1590. After the Hojo fall the Matsuda entered Maeda service in Kaga at four thousand koku, while a cadet line became Tokugawa hatamoto.
zh: 相模松田氏发迹于足柄地方，是波多野氏一族的惣领家，祖先为藤原秀乡。12世纪时，有常之父在1180年的石桥山之战中与源赖朝为敌，固守松田城后被迫自尽；有常获得赦免并受封松田乡，遂以松田为苗字。1213年，不少松田族人参加了和田义盛的举兵；1333年，全族随新田义贞在分倍河原与北条氏作战，后来足利尊氏大军攻陷足柄诸城时，松田氏又站在南朝一方。其一支早已迁往备前国，在备前西部割据，最终于1568年被宇喜多直家攻灭。相模宗家则在1495年支持伊势盛时（即后来的北条早云）夺取小田原城，此后成为后北条氏御由绪家七家之一、世代担任家老；第十代当主松田宪秀在1590年小田原征伐时是北条家的首席重臣。北条氏灭亡后，松田氏以四千石俸禄出仕加贺前田家，其庶流则成为德川家的旗本。

en: The Mauli were the Buddhist dynasty that ruled the Malay kingdom of Bhumi Malayu, better known by its later capital Dharmasraya, along the Batanghari river in what is now Jambi and West Sumatra. Emerging after the Chola raid of 1025 broke Srivijayan and Sailendra power, the Mauli inherited much of the old Srivijayan sphere in Sumatra and the Malay Peninsula. Their earliest known inscription, set up at Grahi in 1183, names King Trailokyaraja Maulibhusana Warmadewa, while the Padang Roco inscription of 1286 records Maharaja Tribhuwanaraja at Dharmasraya. The Pamalayu expedition sent from Singhasari made the kingdom a Javanese ally, and two of its princesses, Dara Jingga and Dara Petak, were carried to Java: Dara Petak married Raden Wijaya, founder of Majapahit, and bore its second king Jayanegara. Dara Jingga's son Adityawarman, after serving Majapahit as a senior minister, returned to Sumatra and from about 1347 ruled an inland kingdom at Pagaruyung until his last known inscription in 1375, controlling the gold trade of central Sumatra. His son Ananggawarman succeeded him, and this late Mauli realm is regarded as the seed of the later Minangkabau kingdom.
zh: 茂利王朝是崇信佛教的王朝，统治以巴唐哈里河流域为中心的马来王国，其后期都城达摩室利耶的名字更为人熟知，疆域在今印度尼西亚的占碑和西苏门答腊一带。1025年注辇入侵摧毁了室利佛逝与夏连特拉王朝的势力，茂利王朝随后兴起，接掌了室利佛逝在苏门答腊和马来半岛的大部分势力范围。已知最早的相关碑铭是1183年立于格拉希的碑文，其中提到国王特莱洛基亚拉贾·毛利布沙纳·瓦马德瓦；1286年的巴东罗科碑文则记载了达摩室利耶的摩诃罗阇特里布瓦纳拉贾。信诃沙里发动的帕玛拉尤远征使该国成为爪哇的盟邦，两位公主达拉·京加和达拉·佩塔克被带往爪哇：达拉·佩塔克嫁给了满者伯夷的建立者拉登·韦查耶，生下第二代国王阇耶纳加拉。达拉·京加之子阿蒂亚瓦曼曾在满者伯夷任重臣，后来回到苏门答腊，约1347年起在帕加鲁永建立内陆王国，控制中苏门答腊的黄金贸易，存世碑文最晚至1375年。其子阿南加瓦尔曼继位，这个晚期茂利政权被视为后来米南加保王国的雏形。

en: The Mauvoisin were a feudal family of the French royal domain, rooted around Rosny-sur-Seine on the Normandy border, where the first known lord, Raoul Mauvoisin, held Rosny and the viscounty of Mantes and died after 1074; his raids into the Evreux district helped provoke William the Conqueror's campaign of 1087, which ended with the destruction of Mantes. As vassals of the Capetian kings the family made its name in arms: Guy II served Louis VI against Henry I of England, Pierre fought for Philip Augustus at the Battle of Bouvines and was rewarded with the lordship of Nonancourt, Robert II helped Simon de Montfort take Marmande in the Albigensian Crusade of 1212, and Guy IV followed Louis IX to Taillebourg and to the disaster of Al Mansurah in 1250. Its prelates included Samson, archbishop of Reims from 1140 to 1161, and William, bishop first of Glasgow and then of Saint Andrews. In 1337 the Mauvoisin still held their castles between the Seine and the Norman frontier, but the line grew thin and the house became extinct in 1458.
zh: 莫瓦桑家族是法兰西王室领地内的封建贵族，根基在诺曼底边境的塞纳河畔罗尼一带；可考的首位领主拉乌尔·莫瓦桑据有罗尼和芒特子爵领，卒于1074年之后，他对埃夫勒地区的袭扰还引来了征服者威廉1087年的征伐，战事以芒特被毁告终。作为卡佩诸王的封臣，家族以武功立身：居伊二世追随路易六世对抗英格兰国王亨利一世；皮埃尔在布汶战役中为腓力·奥古斯特作战，受赏诺南库尔领地；罗贝尔二世在1212年的阿尔比十字军里助西蒙·德·蒙福尔攻克马尔芒德；居伊四世则随路易九世征战塔耶堡，并在1250年亲历曼苏拉之败。家族还出过数位高级教士，包括1140年至1161年任兰斯大主教的桑松，以及先后出任格拉斯哥主教和圣安德鲁斯主教的纪尧姆。1337年，莫瓦桑家族仍保有塞纳河与诺曼底边境之间的城堡，但人丁日衰，最终于1458年绝嗣。

en: The Māweke dynasty takes its name from a chief of the highest rank who, according to Hawaiian chants, sailed to Oʻahu from Tahiti in the 1000s. Already famed as a kahuna priest and master of magic, Māweke erected a temple to the god Kanaloa on Oʻahu and through his sons Mulielealiʻi and Keaunui became the ancestor of the island's ruling line. Keaunui's daughter Nuʻakea became a high chiefess of Molokaʻi, tying the family to that island, while Mulielealiʻi's son Kumuhonua was the first known king of Oʻahu. The dynasty kept the high chieftainship for generations: around 1290 the descendant Nāwele reconquered Oʻahu from a rival cousin and was followed by his son Lakona, but after the death of the later chief Haka the family was displaced by the House of Maʻilikūkahi. Oʻahu itself was conquered by Kahekili II of Maui in 1783 and then by Kamehameha I after the Battle of Nuʻuanu in 1795.
zh: 马韦凯王朝得名于一位最高等级的酋长。据夏威夷口诵歌谣，他在11世纪从塔希提渡海来到瓦胡。马韦凯本就以祭司“卡胡纳”和精通法术闻名，到瓦胡后为神卡纳洛阿修建了神庙；他的儿子穆列莱阿里伊和凯奥努伊后来成为瓦胡统治世系的祖先。凯奥努伊之女努阿凯亚成为莫洛凯的高级女酋长，使这个家族与莫洛凯联结起来；穆列莱阿里伊之子库穆霍努阿则是已知最早的瓦胡国王。该家族世代保有高级酋长之位：约1290年，后裔纳韦莱从堂亲手中重新征服瓦胡，其子拉科纳继位；但在后来的酋长哈卡死后，家族被马伊利库卡希家族取代。瓦胡岛于1783年被毛伊的卡赫基利二世征服，1795年努阿努之战后又落入卡美哈梅哈一世之手。

en: The Mazenjani were a Kurdish leading family of Erbil in the Ilkhanid period. After the Mongol siege of 1258 and the fall of the citadel in 1259, they chose to serve the new order: their chief Mubariz al-Din Kak received a payza, the Mongol decree tablet, authorizing him to collect taxes at Erbil and Aqra, and Ghazan Khan confirmed the vassal standing of such Kurdish houses through documents of safe conduct written in the Uyghur script. The family thus kept its local position while Mongol rule lasted.
zh: 马赞贾尼家族是伊儿汗国时期埃尔比勒的库尔德望族。1258年蒙古军围攻埃尔比勒、城堡于1259年陷落后，他们转而效力新政权：首领穆巴里兹丁·卡克获得蒙古牌符敕令，获准在埃尔比勒和阿克拉征税，合赞汗又以回鹘文书写的安全文书确认这类库尔德家族的臣属地位。马赞贾尼家族借此在蒙古统治时期保住了在当地的地位。

en: The House of Mecklenburg, also called the Niklotings, descends from the Polabian Slavs of the Baltic coast rather than from a German comital family. Niklot, prince of the Obotrite confederacy from about 1131, held Schwerin and the Wendish lands against the Saxons for nearly thirty years during the Wendish Crusade, until a combined campaign of Duke Henry the Lion of Saxony and King Valdemar the Great of Denmark killed him at his Werle stronghold in 1160. His son Pribislav revolted in 1163 and was beaten at Verchen in 1164, but in 1167 Henry the Lion restored him as the first Prince of Mecklenburg, now a Christian Saxon vassal; Pribislav founded Doberan Abbey in 1171 and endowed the bishopric of Schwerin. Under his descendants the Obotrite nobility was gradually Germanized. The Werle appanage split off in 1235 and lasted until 1436, while the main line was raised to ducal rank in 1347 and soon divided into Mecklenburg-Stargard from 1348 and Mecklenburg-Schwerin from 1352. Duke Albert of the house wore the Swedish crown from 1364 to 1389. Later partitions created Mecklenburg-Güstrow in 1621 and, in 1701, the Mecklenburg-Schwerin and Mecklenburg-Strelitz duchies. In 1337 the Niklotings still ruled their coastal principality around Wismar as princes of the empire.
zh: 梅克伦堡家族又称尼克洛特家族，出自波罗的海沿岸的波拉布斯拉夫人，而非德意志伯爵世家。尼克洛特约从1131年起担任奥博特利特联盟的王公，领有什未林和文德人的土地，在文德十字军期间对抗萨克森人近三十年，最终于1160年在萨克森公爵狮子亨利与丹麦国王瓦尔德马大帝的联合进攻中战死于韦尔勒据点。他的儿子普里比斯拉夫于1163年起兵反抗，1164年在费尔兴战败，但狮子亨利在1167年恢复了他的地位，立他为第一代梅克伦堡藩侯，成为皈依基督教的萨克森封臣；普里比斯拉夫于1171年修建多贝兰修道院，并资助设立什未林主教区。在他的后裔治下，奥博特利特贵族逐渐德意志化。1235年韦尔勒封地分出，一直存续到1436年；主支于1347年晋升公爵，很快又在1348年和1352年先后分出梅克伦堡-斯塔加德与梅克伦堡-什未林两支。家族的阿尔布雷希特于1364至1389年间头戴瑞典王冠。后来的分封又产生了1621年的梅克伦堡-居斯特罗，以及1701年定型的梅克伦堡-什未林和梅克伦堡-施特雷利茨两个公国。1337年，尼克洛特家族仍以帝国藩侯的身份统治着维斯马一带的滨海领地。

en: The Medici came from the Mugello countryside north of Florence and are first recorded in a document of 1230. They grew rich in the wool trade before Giovanni di Bicci de' Medici founded the Medici Bank in 1397, which became the largest bank in Europe and the foundation of the family's power. Cosimo de' Medici, called the Elder, made himself the effective ruler of the Florentine Republic in 1434, and his grandson Lorenzo the Magnificent led the city at the height of the Renaissance, patronising Botticelli, Michelangelo and many others. The Pazzi conspiracy of 1478 failed to overthrow the family but killed Lorenzo's brother Giuliano; the Medici were driven out of Florence in 1494 after the invasion of Charles VIII of France, and returned only in 1512. Two Medici became popes in this period, Leo X in 1513 and Clement VII in 1523, and in 1532 Alessandro de' Medici took the hereditary title Duke of Florence. After Alessandro's assassination in 1537 the junior branch under Cosimo I took over; Cosimo became Grand Duke of Tuscany in 1569. The family supplied two more popes, Pius IV and Leo XI, and two queens of France, Catherine and Marie de' Medici. Its grand dukes ruled Tuscany until 1737, when the death of Gian Gastone de' Medici ended the line and the grand duchy passed to the Habsburg-Lorraine.
zh: 美第奇家族出身佛罗伦萨以北的穆杰洛乡村，最早见于1230年的一份文书。他们靠羊毛贸易致富，随后乔瓦尼·迪·比奇·德·美第奇于1397年创办美第奇银行，这家银行后来成为欧洲最大的银行，也是家族权势的根基。“长者”科西莫·德·美第奇于1434年成为佛罗伦萨共和国的实际统治者，其孙“豪华者”洛伦佐在文艺复兴鼎盛时期主政这座城市，资助了波提切利、米开朗琪罗等众多艺术家。1478年的帕齐阴谋未能推翻家族，却杀死了洛伦佐之弟朱利亚诺；1494年法国国王查理八世入侵后，美第奇家族被逐出佛罗伦萨，直到1512年才重返。这一时期家族出了两位教宗：1513年当选的利奥十世和1523年当选的克雷芒七世；1532年，亚历山德罗·德·美第奇取得世袭的佛罗伦萨公爵头衔。1537年亚历山德罗遇刺后，科西莫一世领导的旁支接掌权力，科西莫于1569年成为托斯卡纳大公。家族还出过庇护四世、利奥十一世两位教宗，以及卡特琳、玛丽两位法国王后。历任大公统治托斯卡纳直到1737年，吉安·加斯托内·德·美第奇去世后家族绝嗣，大公国转入哈布斯堡-洛林家族之手。

en: The Medrano were a high-noble lineage of the Kingdom of Navarre, their surname of Basque origin meaning growth or prosperity, with houses established around Estella and Pamplona and later branches in Aragon and Castile. They were already among the kingdom's ricoshombres, the magnates who held castles and rents of the crown and advised its kings, in the early thirteenth century, when a Martín López de Medrano is named among the great nobles serving at the battle of Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212.
