Their finest hour came in the succession crisis of 1328, when the death of Charles the Fair severed Navarre's personal union with France: the Navarrese Cortes chose the ricohombre Juan Martínez de Medrano, called the Elder, together with Juan Corbarán de Lehet, as regents to govern until Joan II and her husband Philip of Évreux took the crown. Through later centuries the family kept its place in Navarrese administration and arms, one branch serving as royal standard-bearers and lords of Azpa and neighbouring towns, and in 1793 a Vélaz de Medrano was created Marquis of Fontellas near Tudela. Other branches spread into Castile, where the name was borne by scholars, poets and royal councillors in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries.
zh: 梅德拉诺家族是纳瓦拉王国的高级贵族世系，其姓氏源出巴斯克语，意为“生长、兴旺”，宅邸主要分布在埃斯特利亚和潘普洛纳一带，后来也有支系迁入阿拉贡和卡斯蒂利亚。早在13世纪初，他们便位列纳瓦拉的“里科翁布雷”大贵族——这些大贵族领有王室的城堡和租税，并担任国王的顾问；1212年拉斯纳瓦斯-德托洛萨之战时，一位名叫马丁·洛佩斯·德·梅德拉诺的大贵族便在参战名将之列。家族最风光的时刻是1328年的王位继承危机：美男子夏尔去世，纳瓦拉与法国的共主联邦终结，纳瓦拉议会推举“长者”胡安·马丁内斯·德·梅德拉诺与胡安·科尔巴兰·德·莱埃特同为摄政，主持国政直到胡安娜二世与丈夫埃夫勒的费利佩继位。此后数百年间，家族始终在纳瓦拉的行政和军界占有一席之地，一支世代担任王室掌旗官，领有阿斯帕及附近城镇，1793年又有一位贝拉斯·德·梅德拉诺被封为图德拉附近的丰特利亚斯侯爵。另一些支系迁入卡斯蒂利亚，在16、17世纪出过学者、诗人和王室顾问。

en: Medri Bahri, meaning Land of the Sea and also called Mereb Melash, was the semi-autonomous Christian highland realm north of the Mereb River in what is now Eritrea, comprising Hamasien and Seraye with its seat at Debarwa; its governors bore the title Bahr Negash, or king of the sea. The region had been Aksumite heartland, and local governors ruled there from at least the twelfth century, until Emperor Zara Yaqob in the mid-fifteenth century extended the Bahr Negash's authority over Hamasien, Seraye, Shire and Bur. The office drew its wealth from the caravan routes carrying gold, ivory and slaves down to the Red Sea ports of Massawa and Hirgigo. During the Ethiopian-Adal war the Bahr Negash Za-Wangel was killed in the south and Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi's overran the highlands in 1535, while in 1541 the Bahr Negash Yeshaq helped bring the Portuguese expedition to the emperor's aid. Ottoman troops under Ozdemir Pasha seized Massawa and Debarwa in 1557, and the coast was lost to the empire; Yeshaq, grown powerful on imported firearms, twice rebelled with Ottoman backing and was killed at the Battle of Addi Qarro in 1578. From the mid-seventeenth century the governorship became hereditary under the Hab Sellus family, confirmed by Emperor Fasilides around 1663, whose rival Sa'azzaga and Hazzega branches disputed the highlands through the Zemene Mesafint era.
zh: 梅德里巴赫里意为“海之地”，又称梅雷布·梅拉什，是今厄立特里亚境内、梅雷布河以北的基督教半自治高地政权，辖哈马西恩和塞拉耶，治所在德巴尔瓦，其统治者拥有“巴赫里·尼加什”（海王）头衔。此地原是阿克苏姆帝国的核心地带，至迟12世纪起便由本地总督治理；15世纪中叶，皇帝扎拉·雅各布把巴赫里·尼加什的权力扩展到哈马西恩、塞拉耶、希雷和布尔。该职位的财富来自把黄金、象牙和奴隶运往红海港口马萨瓦与希尔吉戈的商路。埃塞俄比亚—阿达尔战争中，巴赫里·尼加什扎-万格尔在南方战死，艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐的军队于1535年席卷高地；1541年，巴赫里·尼加什伊沙克协助引来葡萄牙援军。1557年，厄兹代米尔帕夏率奥斯曼军队攻占马萨瓦和德巴尔瓦，海岸从此脱离帝国；伊沙克凭借输入的火枪势力日盛，两度勾结奥斯曼人叛乱，1578年在阿迪卡罗战役中被杀。17世纪中叶起，总督之位在哈布·塞卢斯家族手中世袭，约1663年得到皇帝法西利德斯确认；其萨阿扎加与哈泽加两个支派在“王侯时代”里反复争夺高地。

en: The Meenas are a tribal people of northern and western India who claim descent from the Matsya, the fish incarnation of Vishnu, and once ruled a string of chiefdoms in the country that became Rajasthan. By the thirteenth century their chieftains held the Hadoti hills, where the town of Bundi takes its name from the Meena leader Bunda Meena. Their rule was broken by expanding Rajput clans: Rao Dewa of the Hada Chauhans took Bundi in 1342 and made it the seat of his Hadoti kingdom, the Kachhwahas seized Dhundhar, and Meena holdings also passed into the later states of Kota, Jhalawar, Karauli and Jalore. Driven into the forests and hills, the dispossessed Meenas kept up a long armed struggle against the new Rajput states, notably Amber, which eventually made peace with them through a conditional treaty.
zh: 迷那人是印度北部和西部的部落民族，自称是毗湿奴鱼化身摩蹉的后裔，曾在后来形成拉贾斯坦的土地上建立一连串酋长领地。13世纪时，他们的酋长据有哈多蒂山区，本迪城的名字就来自迷那首领本达·迷那。扩张中的拉杰普特诸氏族终结了他们的统治：哈达·乔汉人的拉奥·德瓦于1342年夺取本迪，将其作为哈多蒂王国的都城；卡奇瓦哈人占领了敦达尔，迷那名下的科塔、贾拉瓦尔、卡劳利和贾洛尔等地也相继易手。被逐入山林的迷那人长期武装抵抗新兴的拉杰普特诸邦，其中以安贝尔所受困扰最甚，最终以附条件的议和收场。

en: Mekongga was a kingdom of the Tolaki people in what is now the Kolaka region on the southeastern arm of Sulawesi. Its name comes from kongga, meaning eagle in the Tolaki language; local legend traces it to a giant eagle killed by Sangia Larumbalangi, the first leader, who united seven hill settlements and took the royal title Bokeo. The court first sat at Bende and later moved to Wundulako, in a land also called Wonua Sorume, the land of orchids. Mekongga kept close ties with the older polity of Luwu, whose merchants helped it build an earthen fort in 1676 against coastal raiders. It kept its traditional beliefs until 1699, when the eighth ruler, Bokeo Laduma, made Islam the religion of the kingdom with teachers sent from Luwu; he became known as Sangia Nibandera, the king who holds the flag, after a banner given him by Luwu's ruler for service in the war against Suppa.
zh: 梅孔加是托拉基人在苏拉威西东南半岛今科拉卡一带建立的王国。其名来自托拉基语中的“孔加”，意为鹰；当地传说称，首位首领桑吉亚·拉伦巴兰吉杀死一只巨鹰，王国因此得名，他还统一了七处山地聚落，并采用“博凯奥”作为君主称号。王宫先设在本德，后迁至温杜拉科，这片土地又称“沃努阿·索鲁梅”，即兰花之地。梅孔加与更古老的卢武关系密切，1676年卢武商人协助它修筑土堡，抵御海上劫掠者。它长期保持传统信仰，直到1699年第八位君主博凯奥·拉杜马在卢武派来的导师帮助下立伊斯兰教为国教；他因在对苏帕的战争中效力而获卢武统治者赐旗，此后被称为“持旗之王”桑吉亚·尼班德拉。

en: The Mello were a knightly family of northern France, first recorded in the later eleventh century as holders of the fief of Mello in the Oise country. Early in the twelfth century Aubri I de Mello married Aelis, heiress of the county of Dammartin, and his branch took the Dammartin name, rising in time to hold not only Dammartin but also the counties of Boulogne, Aumale, Mortain and Ponthieu. Renaud de Dammartin, count of Boulogne, joined the imperial coalition against Philip Augustus and was captured at the Battle of Bouvines in 1214, ending his life in royal captivity. Two daughters of the house became queens: Mathilde de Dammartin married Afonso III of Portugal, while Jeanne de Dammartin, countess of Ponthieu, married Ferdinand III of Castile. The Mello line proper stayed closer to the crown: Dreux IV de Mello was made Constable of France after the crusade of 1191 and received Loches and Chatillon-sur-Indre in 1204, and his son Dreux V, baron of Mayenne, died on crusade in Cyprus in 1249. By the fourteenth century only a handful of the name survived, and the male line died out soon afterwards.
zh: 梅洛家族是法兰西北部的骑士世家，最早在11世纪下半叶以梅洛（瓦兹一带）领主的身份见于记载。12世纪初，奥布里一世·德·梅洛娶达马尔坦伯国女继承人阿埃莉斯，这一支便改姓达马尔坦，后来不仅领有达马尔坦，还相继取得布洛涅、欧马勒、莫尔坦和蓬蒂厄等伯国。布洛涅伯爵勒诺·德·达马尔坦加入反对腓力·奥古斯都的帝国联军，1214年在布汶战役中被俘，在王室牢狱里度过余生。家族的两位女儿成为王后：玛蒂尔德·德·达马尔坦嫁给葡萄牙国王阿方索三世；蓬蒂厄女伯爵让娜·德·达马尔坦嫁给卡斯蒂利亚国王费尔南多三世。梅洛本支则更贴近王权：德雷厄四世·德·梅洛在1191年随十字军东征后被任命为法兰西统帅，1204年受封洛什和安德尔河畔沙蒂永；其子德雷厄五世是马耶讷男爵，1249年随路易九世东征时死于塞浦路斯。到14世纪，沿用梅洛之名的族人已寥寥无几，男系不久后断绝。

en: The Menteşe dynasty, in Turkish the Menteşeoğulları, founded the earliest of the Anatolian beyliks in the rugged country of ancient Caria in south-western Anatolia, with Milas as its capital. Named after the Turkmen chief Menteşe Bey, who established the line in the late thirteenth century, it was the first beylik to take to the sea, earning its sailors the name Sea Turks. Under Mesut Bey its fleets briefly seized parts of Rhodes in 1300, and in 1311 a combined Menteşe and Genoese fleet attacked the Hospitallers there; Orhan Bey later levied tribute from Negroponte and the Venetian islands of the Aegean. Alongside piracy the beylik ran a busy trade with Venetian Crete, exporting grain, horses and alum through the port of Mağrı, and it profited from the Christian leagues and Smyrna crusades that battered its Aydınid rivals while leaving Menteşe untouched. Weakened by the great earthquake of 1389, it submitted to Bayezid I in 1390, was restored by Timur after 1402 under İlyas Bey, accepted Ottoman overlordship in 1414 and was fully annexed in 1426. Its shipyards and seamen remained prized, supplying roughly two fifths of the fleet that besieged Constantinople in 1453, while its domed stone mosques at Milas and Balat pioneered building techniques later absorbed into Ottoman architecture.
zh: 门泰谢家族在土耳其语中称门泰谢奥乌拉勒，在安纳托利亚西南部古称卡利亚的崎岖之地建立了最早的安纳托利亚贝伊国，以米拉斯为都。该家族得名于13世纪末开创基业的土库曼首领门泰谢贝伊，也是第一个走向海洋的贝伊国，其水手赢得了“海上突厥人”的称号。梅苏特贝伊在位时，舰队于1300年一度攻占罗得岛部分地区；1311年门泰谢又与热那亚组成联合舰队，进攻岛上的医院骑士团；后来的奥尔汗贝伊则向内格罗蓬特和爱琴海的威尼斯岛屿征收贡赋。除了海盗活动，贝伊国还通过马格勒港与威尼斯治下的克里特繁忙贸易，出口谷物、马匹和明矾；当基督教同盟和士麦那十字军东征重创邻邦艾登王朝时，门泰谢基本置身事外，反而独享贸易之利。1389年的大地震使其元气大伤，1390年它向巴耶济德一世臣服，1402年后帖木儿把土地归还给伊利亚斯贝伊，1414年其承认奥斯曼宗主权，1426年被彻底吞并。但它的船厂和水手仍备受倚重，1453年围攻君士坦丁堡的奥斯曼舰队中约有五分之二来自门泰谢；其在米拉斯和巴拉特修建的穹顶石构清真寺所开创的建筑技艺，后来也被奥斯曼建筑吸收。

en: The Migita were a cadet branch of the Ōuchi, the local official house of Suō Province whose Tatara ancestors claimed Baekje royal descent. At the end of the Heian period Morinaga, younger brother of Ōuchi Morifusa, was enfeoffed at Migita in Saba district and founded a separate house; in the late Kamakura period its head Hirotoshi was the first to call himself Migita. A branch of this family would later settle at Sue village and become the Sue clan. During the Nanboku-chō wars Migita Hironao followed Ōuchi Yoshihiro and was appointed shugodai of Iwami, and through the Muromachi age the house supplied district deputies in Iwami and officers at the Shimonoseki strait. The Sengoku upheavals that destroyed the Ōuchi also remade the Migita: after Sue Harukata's coup of 1551 (the Taineiji incident) and his death at Itsukushima in 1555, the last Ōuchi lord was driven to suicide in the Mōri conquest of Suō and Nagato, and Migita Takakage surrendered to Mōri Motonari before Yamaguchi fell. He adopted Motonari's seventh son Amano Motomasa as his heir, and the line continued as the Migita-Mōri, a kinsman house of the Chōshū daimyō, while his own son Yasumasa took the name Misato and served the Mōri as a modest retainer.
zh: 右田氏是周防在庁官人大内氏的庶流，大内家的祖先多々良氏自称出自百济王族。平安末期，大内盛房之弟盛长受封佐波郡右田，另立一家；镰仓时代后期的当主弘俊最早以右田为姓。后来从右田氏中又分出一族，移居陶村后称陶氏，即发动大宁寺之变的陶晴贤一族。南北朝时代，右田弘直追随大内义弘，被任命为石见守护代；室町时代，右田氏还出任石见国的郡代和赤间关一带的官职。战国的动乱也重塑了右田氏：1551年陶晴贤发动政变、1555年又在严岛之战中败死，最后的大内当主在毛利氏的防长经略中自尽，右田隆量在山口陷落前向毛利元就投降，成为其家臣。他迎立元就七男天野元政为养子继承右田家，其后代作为毛利一门“右田毛利家”存续；隆量的亲生儿子康政则改姓御乡，以毛利家下级家臣的身份传续家名。

en: The Mihrabanids were a Persian Muslim dynasty, the third indigenous Muslim line to rule Sistan, also called Nimruz, after the Saffarids and the Nasrids. They held the province from 1236 to the mid-sixteenth century, governing from Shahr-i Sistan near Zaranj with the title of malik. The first malik, Shams al-Din Ali ibn Mas'ud, took power in the wake of the Mongol conquest, and after Hulagu founded the Ilkhanate in 1256 the family ruled as largely autonomous vassals, intermittently warring with the Kartids of Herat and conquering the upland region of Quhistan by 1289. The collapse of the Ilkhanate left the Mihrabanids independent for nearly half a century, until Timur invaded Sistan in 1383 and devastated the province; the maliks then served the Timurids and, after their fall in the early sixteenth century, the Shaybanids. The last malik, Sultan Mahmud, acknowledged Safavid suzerainty and introduced Shia practices such as the Shia call to prayer among a mostly Sunni population, before the family handed over Sistan and brought its three centuries of rule to an end around the 1540s.
zh: 米赫拉班王朝是波斯人的穆斯林王朝，也是继萨法尔王朝和纳西尔王朝之后第三个土生土长统治锡斯坦（又称尼姆鲁兹）的穆斯林家族。他们自1236年起统治该省，直到16世纪中叶，以扎兰季附近的锡斯坦城为都，君主称马利克。首任马利克沙姆斯丁·阿里·本·马苏德在蒙古征服之后掌权，1256年旭烈兀建立伊儿汗国后，该家族作为高度自治的藩臣治理地方，不时与赫拉特的卡尔提德王朝交战，并于1289年征服山地库希斯坦。伊儿汗国崩溃后，米赫拉班人独立了近半个世纪，1383年帖木儿入侵锡斯坦、大肆破坏，独立告终；此后马利克们先后臣服帖木儿王朝，以及16世纪初取而代之的昔班尼王朝。末代马利克苏丹·马哈茂德承认萨法维王朝的宗主权，在以逊尼派为主的民众中推行什叶派唤礼等做法，随后交出锡斯坦的统治权，家族约在16世纪40年代结束了长达三百年的统治。

en: The Minami were a cadet house of the Kō family, whose original surname was Takashina. Their founder Yorimoto, a son of Kō Shigeuji in the Kamakura period, established the branch at the Maruki estate in the Ashikaga manor of Shimotsuke Province, and the house hereditarily headed the Mandokoro, the administrative office of the Ashikaga clan's household. Its best-known head was Minami Munetsugu, grandson of Yorimoto and a cousin once removed of Kō no Moronao, the first steward of the Muromachi shogunate. Munetsugu accompanied Ashikaga Takauji east during the Nakasendai rebellion of 1335 and served the new shogunate as head of the Samuraidokoro and as constable of Mikawa and, from about 1347, Bitchu. In the Kannō Disturbance of 1349 to 1352 he took Takauji and Moronao's side against Ashikaga Tadayoshi; after Moronao's murder he became one of the surviving elders of the Kō kin and a right-hand man to Takauji, issuing documents in the steward's own authority. He founded the Zen temple Seigen-ji in Ashikaga in 1357 and died in 1371.
zh: 南氏是高氏的庶流，本姓高阶。镰仓时代，高重氏之子赖基分家自立，住在下野国足利庄丸木乡，成为南氏之祖；该家世代担任足利氏家政机构政所的笔头奉行。最知名的当主是赖基之孙南宗继，他与室町幕府初代执事高师直是又从兄弟。1335年中先代之乱时，宗继随足利尊氏前往东国，此后出仕室町幕府，历任侍所头人、三河守护，并于1347年前后出任备中守护。在1349至1352年的观应之扰乱中，他站在尊氏、师直一边，与足利直义为敌；师直被杀后，他成为高一族幸存的长老之一、尊氏的左膀右臂，甚至以执事的职权发布施行状。1357年，他在足利开建禅寺清源寺，于1371年去世。

en: The Mitoya were an Izumo kokujin house who claimed Seiwa Genji blood through the Shinano line of the Ina and Suwabe families. After Suwabe Sukenaga fought for the shogunate in the Jōkyū War of 1221 he was made steward of Mitoya township in Iishi District, and his descendants settled there and took its name. Around 1332 the head Sukeshige built Tamatsukuri Castle in Yu manor, and in 1337 he led men for Ashikaga Takauji in the Hokuriku campaign, serving at the siege of Kanegasaki and holding off Kitabatake Akiie in Mino. When the Yamana became Izumo shugo in 1341 the Mitoya entered their service, but in the Meitoku War of 1391 they obeyed the shogunate and turned against them, afterwards passing to the Kyōgoku and then falling under the shadow of their shugo-dai, the Amago. They joined the 1484 order to chastise Amago Tsunehisa yet submitted once he retook power, and Hisasuke fought in the disastrous siege of Yoshida-Kōriyama in 1540. After wavering between the Ōuchi and Amago, the Mitoya surrendered to Mōri Motonari together with the Misawa; their castle became a Mōri supply base that beat off Amago assaults in 1562 and 1563, and they served under Kobayakawa Takakage at the final attack on Gassan-Toda in 1565 and the fall of Kōzuki in 1578. In 1586 Mōri Terumoto exiled Hisasuke to seize the strategic fief; he left Mitoya in 1588 to retire in Kyoto, refused Tokugawa Ieyasu's offer of a post worth 8,000 koku, and ended his days in Kyoto's Yokkaichi quarter. His son Takasuke served the Mōri and then the Hosokawa, fought in the defence of Tanabe Castle in Tango during the Sekigahara campaign of 1600, and later entered the Kishū Tokugawa service with 3,000 koku; Takasuke's son Sukeaki reverted to the old Suwabe surname, bringing the Mitoya name to an end.
zh: 三刀屋氏是出云国的国人豪族，自称清和源氏满快流信浓源氏伊那氏、诹访部一族的后裔。1221年承久之乱中，诹访部助长为幕府方立功，被补任为出云国饭石郡三刀屋乡的地头，子孙就此入居出云，以地名三刀屋为苗字。1332年前后，当主诹访部扶重在汤庄修筑玉造城；1337年他从属足利尊氏在北陆方面作战，参加了金崎城攻略，并在美浓牵制北畠显家。1341年山名氏就任出云守护后，三刀屋氏归入其麾下，1391年明德之乱时又听命幕府转而讨伐山名氏，此后改仕新守护京极氏，并日渐受到守护代尼子氏的强烈影响。1484年他们参与了幕府追讨尼子经久的行动，但经久以谋略再起后便归服尼子氏；1540年，久扶作为尼子方武将参加吉田郡山城之战，惨败而逃。之后三刀屋氏在大内氏与尼子氏之间反复，最终与三泽氏一同归降毛利元就：1562年毛利攻进出云时，地处山阴与山阳要冲的三刀屋城成为毛利军兵站据点，先后在1562年、1563年击退尼子军的围攻，1565年又随小早川隆景参与攻打尼子本城月山富田城，1578年亲历上月城之战、目睹尼子氏的最后结局。1586年，毛利辉元为把要地三刀屋据为己有而将久扶流放；久扶1588年隐居京都，还拒绝了德川家康八千石的出仕邀请，终老于京都四日市。其子孝扶先后效力毛利氏、细川氏，1600年关原之战中参加丹后田边城笼城，后以三千石出仕纪州德川家；孝扶之子扶明恢复本姓诹访部，三刀屋的苗字就此终结。

en: The Miura were one of the eight Taira clans of the Kanto, the Bando Hachi Heishi, named for the Miura peninsula of Sagami, the land around modern Yokosuka that they ruled from the eleventh century. Tametsugu and his son Yoshitsugu, who styled himself Miura no suke, built the clan into leading provincial officials of eastern Sagami and Awa, and Yoshiaki answered Minamoto no Yoritomo's call to arms in 1180 only to die defending Kinugasa castle after the defeat at Ishibashiyama. His son Yoshizumi became one of Yoritomo's senior councillors and a member of the thirteen-man regency council, and the Miura stood at the height of Kamakura politics, kin and rivals to the Hojo regents; their kinsman Wada Yoshimori headed the Samurai-dokoro until his own fall in 1213. When Yasumura's power threatened to overshadow the Hojo, the regent Tokiyori crushed them in the Hoji war of 1247 and the main line perished. A compliant side branch, the Sawara, was allowed to revive the name as Hojo housemen, and this Sagami Miura line grew into a Sengoku daimyo house until Hojo Soun stormed Arai castle in 1516 and the lords Yoshiatsu and Yoshimoto killed themselves. Other Miura branches had long since spread across Japan, notably the Sawara offshoots in Oshu such as the Ashina and Inawashiro, while an Edo branch under Miura Masatsugu became daimyo and was settled at Katsuyama in Mimasaka in 1764.
zh: 三浦氏是坂东八平氏之一，本姓平，11世纪起以相模国三浦半岛（在今日本神奈川县境内）为根据地，又称三浦党。为继、义继两代打下基业，义继自称三浦介，成为相模东部与安房的有力在厅官人；1180年义明响应源赖朝举兵，却在石桥山战败后据守衣笠城战死。其子义澄成为赖朝的宿老、十三人合议制成员，三浦氏由此跻身镰仓幕府权力核心，与执权北条氏既是姻亲又是对手，同族和田义盛更曾任侍所别当，直至1213年和田合战败亡。泰村、光村兄弟权势逼近北条，执权北条时赖遂于1247年宝治合战中将其消灭，嫡流覆灭。事后早已被北条拉拢的旁流佐原氏盛时获准再兴三浦家，以御内人身份存续，这一支即战国大名相模三浦氏；1516年北条早云攻陷新井城，当主义同、义元父子自尽，相模三浦氏灭亡。三浦的分支早已遍布日本，奥州的芦名、猪苗代等氏都出自佐原分流；江户时代另有三浦正次一支位列大名，1764年定封美作胜山藩。

en: The Mixcoatl house takes its name from Iztac Mixcoatl, whom Mexica migration lore calls the father of Tenoch, the chief who led the Mexica, or Aztecs, at the end of their long wanderings from Aztlán. Elected by the council of elders, Tenoch guided his people to an island in Lake Texcoco, where they founded Tenochtitlan, named in his honour, in 1325; his followers were first called the Tenochca and later the Mexica, and scholars still debate whether he was a historical leader or a mythologized founder. He died between 1350 and 1375, after which the elders chose Acamapichtli, a youth of Culhua descent through his mother Atotoztli, as the first tlatoani (the Codex Aubin dates his reign to 1376-1395), beginning a royal line that at first made Tenochtitlan tributary to the Tepanec city of Azcapotzalco. In 1428 that line, under Itzcoatl, joined Texcoco and Tlacopan in the Triple Alliance that overthrew Azcapotzalco and built the Aztec empire expanded by Moctezuma I and Ahuitzotl. Its last independent ruler, Cuauhtémoc, fell with the city to Hernán Cortés in 1521.
zh: 米西克亚特尔家族得名于伊斯特阿克·米西克亚特尔，在墨西加人的迁徙传说中，他是特诺奇的父亲；特诺奇是墨西加人（即阿兹特克人）从阿兹特兰漫长迁徙末期的首领，由长老议事会选出。他率领族人来到特斯科科湖中的一座岛屿，于1325年建立了以他命名的特诺奇蒂特兰，其部众最初称特诺奇卡人，后来才叫墨西加人；学界对他究竟是真实首领还是被神化的始祖仍有争论。他于1350至1375年间去世，长老们随后选出经母亲阿托托斯特利而带有库尔瓦血统的阿卡马皮奇特利为首任特拉托阿尼（《奥宾手抄本》记其在位为1376—1395年），开创的王室世系起初让特诺奇蒂特兰臣服于特帕内克人的阿斯卡波特萨尔科。1428年，这一世系的伊茨科阿特尔联合特斯科科和特拉科潘组成三方联盟，推翻阿斯卡波特萨尔科，并经蒙特祖马一世、阿维特索特尔扩张为阿兹特克帝国。末代独立统治者夸乌特莫克最终在1521年随城市一同落入埃尔南·科尔特斯之手。

en: The Miya were kokujin, local warrior lords, of Bingo Province in western Honshū, traditionally held to descend from the Ononomiya branch of the northern Fujiwara, whose members settled there as priestly families of the Kibitsu Shrine. In the Nanboku-chō wars Miya Kanenobu fought for Ashikaga Takauji and drove Ashikaga Tadafuyu out of Bingo, for which he was made shugo, or military governor, of neighboring Bitchū Province by 1364 and held it until at least 1365. His kinsman Miya Morishige took the opposite side, joining Tadafuyu against Iwamatsu Yorisuke, the shogunate's own governor of Bingo. Kanenobu's and Morishige's descendants, known together as the two Miya houses, both entered the Muromachi shogun's direct vassal corps, the hōkōshū, and kept the clan united through the years of the Ōnin War. In the Sengoku age the Miya served the Amago of Izumo; their main line died out in 1541, and around 1548 an attack by the Ōuchi brought about their downfall, though branch houses such as the Arichi and Kushiro later served the Mōri and the Chōshū domain.
zh: 宫氏是中世纪日本备后国的国人，即地方武士领主，通说认为其出自藤原北家小野宫流，后裔土着于备后，世代担任吉备津神社的社家。南北朝动乱中，宫兼信追随足利尊氏转战，击退攻入备后的足利直冬，因功于1364年以前被任命为邻藩备中国的守护，至少在任至1365年；同族的宫盛重则站在足利直冬一方，与室町幕府任命的备后守护岩松赖宥交战。兼信与盛重的两支后裔并称‘两宫’，都被编入幕府的奉公众，应仁之乱后仍通过协作维持一族团结。进入战国，宫氏从属于出云的尼子氏，宗家于1541年绝嗣，约1548年又遭大内氏进攻而没落，仅有有地氏、久代氏等庶流后来侍奉毛利氏，江户时代为长州藩家臣。

en: The Bingo Miyoshi, distinct from the more famous Miyoshi house of Awa, claimed Fujiwara descent through Fujiwara no Kanenori, a son of the courtier Fujiwara no Yukinari. In the twelfth century Kanenori moved from Ōmi to Miyoshi gō in Bingo, and his son Kanemune styled himself Miyashi Taifu and became the first head of the family, which built Hiebiwayama Castle and grew into a local kokujin power. At the fall of the Kamakura shogunate the Miyoshi sided with Emperor Go-Daigo and then with Ashikaga Tadafuyu; as his cause faded they drifted between the great western overlords, the Yamana, Ōuchi and Amago in turn. Their Sengoku head Munetaka fought for the Amago against Mōri Motonari at the siege of Yoshida Kōriyama in 1540, then switched to the Ōuchi, and in 1544 an Amago attack on his lands was beaten off with Mōri help. In 1553 Munetaka and his son Takasuke submitted to Motonari while keeping much of their autonomy, and a daughter of the house became Motonari's concubine. Thereafter the Miyoshi served the Mōri in campaigns across the Chūgoku region, but after the Sekigahara campaign of 1600 their head Hirotaka refused to follow the Mōri into their reduced Chōshū fief, became a rōnin in Kyoto and was eventually taken into the Hiroshima domain of the Asano, while a cadet line served the Chōfu branch of the Mōri.
zh: 备后三吉氏与名声更大的阿波三好氏同名而异家，自称是公卿藤原行成之子藤原兼范的后裔。12世纪时，兼范从近江移居备后国三吉乡，其子兼宗自称三吉大夫，成为三吉氏初代当主，一族修筑比叡尾山城，成长为当地国人势力。镰仓幕府灭亡之际，三吉氏拥护后醍醐天皇，其后又追随足利直冬；直冬失势后，他们辗转依附山名氏、大内氏、尼子氏等西国强权。战国当主三吉致高在1540年吉田郡山城之战中先站在尼子一方与毛利元就作战，后来转投大内，1544年尼子氏来攻时又靠毛利援军将其击退。1553年，致高与儿子隆亮在保留相当自治权的情况下从属毛利元就，族中还有女子成为元就的侧室。此后三吉氏作为毛利家臣转战中国各地，屡立战功。但1600年关原之战后，当主三吉广高不愿随毛利氏移封防长，上洛沦为浪人，后来被广岛藩主浅野氏起用；另一支则再度出仕毛利家的长府藩。

en: The Mizawa of Izumo traced their line to Shinano Genji forebears, either the Kiso clan of Minamoto no Yoshinaka or the Iijima family. In the Jōkyū War of 1221 Iijima Tamemitsu won merit and was appointed steward of Mizawa manor in Izumo. Around 1302 his descendant Tamenaga moved there by way of Inaba, grew wealthy mining iron sand and working the mountain tatara furnaces, and in 1305 built Mizawa Castle on Mount Kamokura in Nita District, overlooking the Shimane peninsula, after which the family took the Mizawa name. Under the Muromachi shogunate they served first the Yamana shugo; the head Tametada fell fighting for Yamana Mitsuyuki in the Meitoku War of 1391, and later they transferred to the Kyōgoku. In the Sengoku age they long resisted the Amago: Tamekuni was defeated by Amago Tsunehisa in 1488, and after the Mizawa joined a revolt against the Amago in 1531 Tsunehisa attacked Fujigase Castle again; a later head Tameyuki died fighting at Yoshida-Kōriyama in 1540. When Mōri Motonari invaded Izumo in 1561 the Mizawa submitted together with the Akana and Mitoya, and Tamekiyo then held firm for the Mōri against the Amago restoration armies. In 1589 Tamekiyo's son Tametora was confined by Mōri Terumoto but later released with a ten-thousand-koku fief in Nagato; he served at the Odawara campaign and in Korea, guarded Akamagaseki in 1600, and the house survived the Edo period as senior retainers of the Chōfu domain.
zh: 出云三泽氏出自信浓源氏，谱系或溯至木曾义仲的木曾一脉，或溯至饭岛氏。1221年承久之乱中，饭岛为光立有战功，被补任为出云国三泽庄的新补地头。1302年前后，其后人三泽为长经因幡鹿野往来当地，靠开采优质砂铁、经营野踏鞴制铁和开垦山野积蓄实力，于1305年在仁多郡内可远眺岛根半岛的要冲鸭仓山修筑要害山三泽城，并从信浓迁来此地，正式改苗字为三泽，这便是出云三泽氏之始。室町时代他们先从属出云守护山名氏，1391年当主三泽为忠随山名满幸参加明德之乱而战死；后来又改仕新守护京极氏，成长为出云有力国人。战国时代，三泽氏与夺取京极领地的尼子氏长期对抗：1488年三泽为国败于尼子经久，1531年藤濑城再遭攻击，当主三泽为幸则在1540年吉田郡山城之战中命丧青山土取场。1561年毛利元就大举进攻出云，三泽氏与赤穴氏、三刀屋氏一同归降，此后为清始终追随毛利，协助击退尼子再兴军。1589年，为清之子为虎遭毛利辉元设计幽禁，后获释并领有长门厚狭郡古帐一万石；他参加了小田原征伐和文禄庆长之役，1600年奉命守备赤间关，三泽氏作为长府藩家老延续到了江户时代。

en: The Mogami were a cadet branch of the Shiba, themselves kin of the Ashikaga and of Seiwa Genji blood, and held by heredity the post of Ushū tandai, or governor of Dewa. The founder was Shiba Kaneyori, son of the Ōshū governor Shiba Iekane, who entered the Mogami district of Dewa in the 1350s, built Yamagata Castle and took the name Mogami from his new lands; in 1368 he swept the Southern Court forces from the district at the battle of Urushikawa. His successors planted cadet houses across the Mogami and Murayama districts, but these grew independent, and a defeat by Date Tanemune at Hasedō in 1514 opened the door to Date meddling, until the adult Yoshimori retook Hasedō and made the Mogami true Sengoku daimyō. His daughter Yoshihime married Date Terumune and became the mother of Date Masamune. Under Yoshimori's son Yoshiaki the house reached its height: he crushed the rival Tendō, Shiratori and Sagae, submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi at Odawara in 1590 with holdings of 240,000 koku, and in 1600 held Hasedō Castle for a month against the invading Uesugi Kagekatsu while the Sekigahara campaign was decided. Rewarded with roughly 570,000 koku, Yoshiaki became one of the greatest daimyō of the northeast, but after his death in 1614 succession feuds undid the house: it was attainted in 1622 and its descendants sank to a 5,000-koku hatamoto line of kōtai-yoriai rank in Ōmi that lasted until the Meiji period.
zh: 最上氏是斯波氏的分家，而斯波氏与足利氏同族、出自清和源氏；最上家世袭羽州探题，即出羽的管治者。初代斯波兼赖是奥州管领斯波家兼之子，14世纪50年代进入出羽国最上郡，修筑山形城，并以领地为姓改称最上；1368年他在漆川之战中肃清了郡内的南朝势力。其后继者把诸子分派到最上、村山两郡各地，但这些庶族逐渐独立，1514年当主又在长谷堂败给伊达稙宗，引来伊达氏的干涉，直到成年后的最上义守夺回长谷堂，最上才成为真正的战国大名。义守之女义姬嫁给伊达辉宗，是伊达政宗的生母。到义守之子最上义光一代，家族达到鼎盛：他攻灭天童、白鸟、寒河江等敌对势力，1590年在小田原归顺丰臣秀吉，领有二十四万石；1600年关原之战时，他在长谷堂城顶住上杉景胜一个月的围攻，战后受封约五十七万石，成为东北屈指可数的大大名。但义光1614年去世后继承纷争不断，家族于1622年被改易，子孙被减封为近江五千石的旗本，作为交代寄合一直延续到明治维新。

en: The Moghlot are the ruling house of Nagar, the Burusho valley-state on the southern bank of the Hunza river, and take their name from the twin brother of Girkis, eponym of Hunza's older royal line. Burusho tradition recorded by John Biddulph makes Moghlot and Girkis sons of Mayroo Khan, the first Muslim thum of Nagar, by a daughter of the Trakhan raja of Gilgit; their father divided his lands between them, and the Moghlot kept the southern bank, which became the principality of Nagar. Nagar emerged as an autonomous state in the 1300s and was ruled by this family under the title thum, later mir. Its people held to Twelver Shi'ism even while neighbouring Hunza was pressed toward Sunnism, and the Moghlot line survived the wars that followed the fall of Trakhan Gilgit around 1810.
zh: 莫格洛特家族是讷格尔的统治世家。讷格尔是罕萨河南岸的布鲁绍人河谷邦国，家族得名于罕萨更早王世同名始祖吉尔基斯的孪生兄弟。约翰·比杜尔夫记录的布鲁绍传说称，莫格洛特与吉尔基斯是讷格尔首位穆斯林图姆迈鲁汗与吉尔吉特特剌汗拉杰之女所生的双胞胎；父亲将土地分给二人，莫格洛特一支保有河南岸，即后来的讷格尔土邦。讷格尔在14世纪成为自治小邦，该家族以图姆（后称米尔）之号世代统治。居民信奉十二伊玛目派什叶派，即便邻近的罕萨后来被迫转向逊尼派也未改变；特剌汗治下的吉尔吉特约于1810年衰落后，莫格洛特一支又在随之而来的混战中存续下来。

en: The Mulucci were a Guelph family of Macerata in the Marche who held the city's signoria from about 1321 to the mid-fourteenth century before the Da Varano of Camerino overshadowed them. One member, the Franciscan Pietro Mulucci, was bishop of Senigallia from 1323 until his death in 1347.
zh: 穆卢奇是马尔凯马切拉塔的圭尔夫派家族，约1321年起领有该城的领主政权，14世纪中叶后被卡梅里诺的达·瓦拉诺家族盖过；其成员方济各会修士彼得罗·穆卢奇于1323年至1347年去世前任塞尼加利亚主教。

en: The Momonoi were a cadet branch of the Ashikaga house and so traced their descent to the Seiwa Genji. In 1225 Ashikaga Yoshikane's son Yoshisuke was appointed steward of Momonoi Manor in the Gunma district of Kōzuke Province, and Yoshisuke's son Yoshitane took Momonoi as his family name; an older local line of Mononobe descent that had ruled the manor earlier had already fallen in the Jōkyū War of 1221. Settled as Kamakura gokenin, the clan split into two lines, whose members fought on both sides at the fall of the shogunate in 1333: Momonoi Naotsune and his brother Nobunobu marched with Ashikaga Takauji against the Rokuhara deputies, while a kinsman joined Nitta Yoshisada's assault on Kamakura. During the Nanboku-chō wars the family itself divided between the Northern and Southern courts. Naotsune, a famed fierce general who became shugo of Etchū Province, sided with Ashikaga Tadayoshi in the Kannō Disturbance of 1350 to 1352 and remained an enemy of Takauji thereafter, so his line gradually declined. Other Momonoi served the Muromachi shoguns as guardsmen, with one branch hereditarily leading the second guard company until 1522, and a grandson of Naotsune founded the house that created the kōwakamai dance drama; the priest Nichiryū, another descendant, founded Honnō-ji, the temple of the 1582 incident.
zh: 桃井氏是足利氏的庶流，因此也属清和源氏。1225年，足利义兼之子桃井义助出任上野国群马郡桃井乡的庄司，义助之子义胤遂以桃井为苗字；更早统治该乡的物部系桃井氏已在1221年的承久之乱中没落。作为镰仓御家人定居桃井庄的家族后来分为两支，在1333年镰仓幕府灭亡之际各奔其主：桃井直常、直信兄弟随足利尊氏攻打六波罗探题，同族的尚义则加入新田义贞的镰仓攻城军。南北朝动乱中，桃井一族又分属北朝与南朝。以骁将闻名、官至越中国守护的桃井直常在1350至1352年的观应之扰乱中追随足利直义，此后始终与尊氏为敌，其支流因此逐渐衰落。另有桃井族人在室町幕府担任奉公众番众，一支世袭二番众番头直至1522年；直常之孙直诠是幸若舞创始之家的祖先，族人日隆则开创了因1582年本能寺之变而闻名的本能寺。

en: The Montagus, also written Montacute and Latinised de Monte Acuto meaning from the sharp mountain, were founded in Somerset after the Norman Conquest of 1066 by the warrior Drogo de Montagud and built up wide estates across the West Country. Summoned to parliament as barons from 1299, the family reached the front rank under William Montagu (1301-1344), the closest companion of Edward III: he was a leader of the coup that seized Roger Mortimer in 1330, campaigned repeatedly in Scotland, received the Isle of Man, where he was styled king, and in 1337 was created Earl of Salisbury. Captured by the French in 1340, he died of wounds from a tournament four years later. His successors sold the Isle of Man in 1392, while John, the third earl, was executed in 1400 for his part in the Epiphany Rising against Henry IV. Thomas Montagu, fourth earl (1388-1428), became one of England's foremost commanders in France and died of wounds at the siege of Orleans; his daughter Alice married Richard Neville, who took the Salisbury earldom, and their son was Warwick the Kingmaker, so the old male line ended in the Neville inheritance. A Northamptonshire family, the Montagus of Boughton, claimed the name and arms and rose under the Tudors and Stuarts to become Earls of Sandwich in 1660, Dukes of Montagu in 1705 and Dukes of Manchester in 1719.
zh: 蒙塔古家族又拼作 Montacute，拉丁化写法 de Monte Acuto 意为“来自尖山”。1066年诺曼征服后，武士德罗戈·德·蒙塔古在萨默塞特开创家业，家族随后在英格兰西南各郡积累了大片地产。1299年起家族首领受召入议会成为男爵，而使家族跻身一流贵族的是威廉·蒙塔古（1301—1344）：他是爱德华三世最亲密的伙伴，1330年参与发动抓捕罗杰·莫蒂默的政变，多次在苏格兰征战，受封马恩岛并被称为该岛国王，1337年又受封索尔兹伯里伯爵。1340年他被法军俘虏，四年后死于比武受伤。其后继者于1392年卖掉马恩岛；第三代伯爵约翰因参与1400年反对亨利四世的主显节起事被处死。第四代伯爵托马斯（1388—1428）是英军在法国最出色的将领之一，在奥尔良围城战中伤重而亡；其女艾丽斯嫁给理查德·内维尔，索尔兹伯里伯爵头衔随之转入内维尔家族，他们的儿子就是“拥立国王者”沃里克，古老的男系也就此并入内维尔的继承体系。后来北安普敦郡的鲍顿蒙塔古家族承袭了这一姓氏和纹章，在都铎和斯图亚特朝相继崛起，1660年受封三明治伯爵，1705年受封蒙塔古公爵，1719年又受封曼彻斯特公爵。

en: The Montaldo were a Genoese noble family whose origins are placed in the Oltregiogo around Gavi. Paolo Montaldo, a judge close to the first doge Simone Boccanegra, raised the family's standing, but its most prominent figure was his son Leonardo, born in 1319 in the Polcevera valley. Leonardo served Genoa as consul at Caffa in the Crimea in 1351, as ambassador to Castile, as imperial count palatine under Charles IV and as podesta of Pera near Constantinople, while two failed attempts to seize power in 1365 and 1366 sent him into exile until 1371. He led the Genoese delegation at the Peace of Turin that ended the War of Chioggia with Venice, and in April 1383 he was elected doge after the fall of Domenico Fregoso. As doge he freed King James I of Cyprus in exchange for Genoese control of Famagusta and won popularity with fiscal reforms, but he died of plague in June 1384 after little more than a year in office. His son Antonio Montaldo later became doge in 1392.
zh: 蒙塔尔多是热那亚的贵族家族，祖籍一般认为在热那亚后方奥尔特雷焦戈的加维一带。保罗·蒙塔尔多是与首任总督西蒙尼·波卡涅拉关系密切的法官，提升了家族地位；而家族最显赫的人物是他1319年生于波尔切韦拉河谷的儿子莱奥纳尔多。莱奥纳尔多曾于1351年出任热那亚在克里米亚卡法的领事，还担任过驻卡斯蒂利亚使节、皇帝查理四世册封的宫廷伯爵，以及君士坦丁堡附近佩拉的行政长官；1365年和1366年两次夺权失败后他被迫流亡，直到1371年才获召回。他率领热那亚代表团参加结束基奥贾战争的都灵和谈，并在1383年4月多梅尼科·弗雷戈索倒台后当选总督。任内他释放塞浦路斯国王詹姆斯一世，换取热那亚对法马古斯塔的控制，又以财税改革赢得民心，但执政仅一年多便在1384年6月死于鼠疫。他的儿子安东尼奥·蒙塔尔多后来于1392年出任总督。

en: The Da Monteverde were a noble family of Fermo in the Marche, descended from the lords of Brunforte, who held the fiefs of Monterone, Castelporcino and Valdigrano around the city. Its earliest documented head, Fidesmido da Monteverde, was podesta of Fermo around the middle of the thirteenth century. The family's fortunes rose with the Ghibelline leader Mercenario da Monteverde, born around 1275, who took up arms in 1318, raiding the towns of the Macerata district, and in 1323 defeated the Guelphs of Berardo da Varano, lord of Camerino, at the battle of Osimo. In 1331 he seized Fermo itself by a coup and ruled it as signore for ten years, defying the repeated summons of Pope Benedict XII to submit to the Church; in 1340 conspirators ambushed and killed him while he was riding outside the city, and chroniclers remembered him as a wicked tyrant and enemy of the Church. His kinsmen, including the condottieri Boccalario and Rinaldo da Monteverde, could not sustain the signoria, and the family died out in 1380, its claims passing through the heiress Vannetta.
zh: 达·蒙泰韦尔德是马尔凯地区费尔莫的贵族家族，出身布伦福尔特领主，领有城市周边的蒙特罗内、卡斯特尔波尔奇诺和瓦尔迪格拉诺等封地。家族最早可考的家主菲德斯米多·达·蒙泰韦尔德在13世纪中叶曾任费尔莫行政长官。家族的崛起依靠吉伯林派首领梅尔切纳里奥·达·蒙泰韦尔德：他约生于1275年，1318年起兵攻掠马切拉塔一带的城镇，1323年在奥西莫战役中击败卡梅里诺领主贝拉尔多·达·瓦拉诺率领的圭尔夫派军队。1331年，他发动政变夺取费尔莫，以领主身份统治十年，多次拒绝教宗本笃十二世要求他臣服教会的命令；1340年，密谋者趁他出城骑马时伏击并杀死了他，编年史家把他记作邪恶的僭主和教会之敌。他的族人、佣兵首领博卡拉里奥和里纳尔多·达·蒙泰韦尔德等人未能维持领主政权，家族于1380年绝嗣，权利经女继承人万内塔转归他人。

en: The House of Montfaucon was a noble family of the Franche-Comte, named after its castle of Montfaucon on a rocky height east of Besancon, whose lords are recorded from the middle of the eleventh century as vassals of the counts of Burgundy. In 1123 and 1124 they founded the Cistercian abbey of Lucelle, and the marriage of Richard II to Sophie of Montbeliard allowed his son Amadeus II to inherit the county of Montbeliard in 1163. Amadeus, who died in 1195, also carried the house into the Vaud country, buying half the lordship of Orbe from Emperor Frederick Barbarossa in 1168, and the family later held Echallens and Montagny as well. After 1227 the Montbeliard and Montfaucon inheritances were split between two brothers, and when the Montbeliard line failed, Henry I of the younger branch recovered the county in 1339 by marrying Agnes, heiress of Reginald of Burgundy. Henry's son Stephen, count from 1367, was the last male of the house: his son Henry II was killed at the Battle of Nicopolis in 1396, and when Stephen died in 1397 the lands were divided among three granddaughters. Henriette, who took Montbeliard, married Count Eberhard IV of Wurttemberg in 1407, carrying the county into the Wurttemberg-Montbeliard line.
zh: 蒙福孔家族是弗朗什-孔泰的贵族世家，得名于贝桑松以东岩石高地上的蒙福孔城堡；11世纪中叶，其领主作为勃艮第伯爵的封臣首次见于记载。1123至1124年，家族创立了熙笃会的吕塞勒修道院；理查二世娶蒙贝利亚尔的索菲为妻，其子阿梅代二世遂于1163年继承蒙贝利亚尔伯国。卒于1195年的阿梅代还把家族势力带入沃地区，于1168年从皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨手中购得奥尔布领地的一半，家族后来又领有埃沙朗和蒙塔尼。1227年以后，蒙贝利亚尔与蒙福孔两份遗产由兄弟两支分承；蒙贝利亚尔支系绝嗣后，幼支的亨利于1339年凭借与勃艮第的雷诺之女、女继承人阿涅丝的婚姻收回伯国。亨利之子艾蒂安自1367年起担任伯爵，是家族最后一位男嗣：他的儿子亨利二世在1396年的尼科波利斯战役中阵亡，1397年艾蒂安去世后，领地由三个孙女瓜分。继承蒙贝利亚尔的亨利埃特于1407年嫁给符腾堡伯爵埃伯哈德四世，伯国由此转入符腾堡-蒙贝利亚尔支系之手。

en: The Montfort-Bregenz were the Bregenz branch of the counts of Montfort, a Swabian dynasty sprung from the counts palatine of Tübingen. When Hugo II of Tübingen died in 1182 he had inherited the former county of Bregenz through his wife Elizabeth of Bregenz, and from about 1170 a younger line ruled it as counts of Montfort-Bregenz, seated on the eastern shore of Lake Constance. This first Bregenz line died out in 1338, whereupon the lands were carried on through the Montfort-Tettnang branch, which from 1354 took the name Montfort-Tettnang-Bregenz and in 1379 split into an elder and a younger lordship. Its most famous son was Hugo of Montfort, a Minnesang poet and statesman born in 1357, who through his wife inherited the Styrian counts of Pfannberg's estates in 1362 and moved his residence to Pfannberg Castle in 1401, founding a Styrian branch. Elizabeth of Hochberg, heiress of Count William VII, sold the elder part of the Bregenz territory to the Habsburgs in 1451, and the rest of the county followed in 1523. The Styrian line, later called Montfort-Bregenz-Peggau, inherited the Tettnang lands in 1574 and survived until the whole Montfort house became extinct with Count Anton IV in 1787.
zh: 蒙特福特‑布雷根茨家族是蒙特福特伯爵家族的布雷根茨支系。蒙特福特家族是施瓦本贵族，源出图宾根行宫伯爵：图宾根的雨果二世在1182年去世前，已通过妻子布雷根茨的伊丽莎白继承了旧布雷根茨伯国；约从1170年起，一条幼支以蒙特福特‑布雷根茨伯爵的身份统治博登湖东岸。这一最早的布雷根茨支于1338年绝嗣，领地改由蒙特福特‑泰特南支接续，该支从1354年起称蒙特福特‑泰特南‑布雷根茨，1379年又分成年长与年幼两支领地。这一家最著名的人物是1357年出生的雨果·冯·蒙特福特，他既是宫廷抒情诗人又是政治家，1362年通过妻子继承了施蒂里亚的普凡贝格伯爵产业，1401年迁居普凡贝格堡，开创施蒂里亚支系。威廉七世的女继承人霍赫贝格的伊丽莎白于1451年把布雷根茨领地的年长部分卖给哈布斯堡，剩余部分也在1523年售出。其施蒂里亚支后称蒙特福特‑布雷根茨‑佩高，1574年继承泰特南领地，一直延续到1787年安东四世伯爵去世、整个蒙特福特家族绝嗣为止。

en: The House of Montfort-l'Amaury was a noble house of the Ile-de-France, a cadet branch of the counts of Hainaut. Hugh Capet enfeoffed Guillaume de Montfort with a small lordship, and the castle his heirs raised there was named Montfort-l'Amaury after its builder Amaury I. Simon I's marriage to Agnes of Evreux brought the county of Evreux into the family, and his daughter Bertrade was carried off and married by King Philip I while already wed to Fulk IV of Anjou. Simon III married the heiress Amicia of Leicester and opened the family's English career. His son Simon IV, earl of Leicester, led the Albigensian Crusade from 1209, became count of Toulouse and was killed at its siege in 1218; his son Amaury ceded those claims to Louis VIII in 1224. The younger Simon, sixth earl of Leicester, married Eleanor, daughter of King John, led the baronial revolt against Henry III, captured the king at Lewes in 1264, and was killed at Evesham in 1265, after which the family was exiled and Montfort-l'Amaury passed to the House of Dreux. The name survived through Yolande de Montfort, wed to Duke Arthur II of Brittany in 1292: their John of Montfort won the Breton succession war at Auray in 1364, and his line ruled Brittany as dukes until the male line ended with Francis II in 1488.
zh: 蒙福尔拉莫里家族是法兰西岛的贵族世家，为埃诺伯爵家族的幼支。于格·卡佩将一处小领地封给纪尧姆·德·蒙福尔，其后人在领地上修建城堡，并以建造者阿莫里一世之名命名为蒙福尔拉莫里。西蒙一世与埃夫勒的阿涅丝结婚，埃夫勒伯国由此并入家族；他的女儿贝尔特拉德已嫁给安茹的富尔克四世，却被国王腓力一世夺走并娶为王后。西蒙三世娶莱斯特女继承人阿米西娅，为家族打开了英格兰的门路。他的儿子西蒙四世是莱斯特伯爵，1209年起统领阿尔比十字军，成为图卢兹伯爵，1218年在图卢兹围城战中被杀；其子阿莫里于1224年把这些权益让给路易八世。小西蒙是第六代莱斯特伯爵，娶约翰王之女埃莉诺为妻，领导反对亨利三世的贵族叛乱，1264年在刘易斯战役中生擒国王，1265年在伊夫舍姆战役中兵败被杀，家族随后被逐，蒙福尔拉莫里也落入德勒家族之手。家族之名靠约兰德·德·蒙福尔延续：她于1292年嫁给布列塔尼公爵阿尔蒂尔二世，其子让·德·蒙福尔在1364年的欧赖战役中赢得布列塔尼继承战争，这一支遂以公爵身份统治布列塔尼，男系至1488年弗朗索瓦二世去世而终结。

en: The Montfort-Feldkirch were the Feldkirch branch of the counts of Montfort, a Swabian high-noble dynasty itself descended from the counts palatine of Tübingen. Hugo II of Tübingen, who died in 1182, inherited the lands of the old counts of Bregenz through his wife Elizabeth, including Bregenz, Montfort and Sigmaringen; his younger son Hugo III styled himself Hugo of Montfort from about 1200 and founded the town of Feldkirch, building the Schattenburg castle on the hill above it. The Schattenburg became the centre of the Montfort-Feldkirch lordship, joined by the newer Burg Neu-Montfort around 1311. The counts gave their town a generous city law modelled on that of Lindau, so that medieval Feldkirch outgrew Bregenz in population and wealth, while several kinsmen held powerful church offices, among them Abbot William of Saint Gall and Bishop Rudolf III of Constance. A feud involving Count Rudolf III of Montfort-Feldkirch began the line's decline and opened the door to Habsburg influence in Vorarlberg, and in 1375 Burgrave Rudolf IV sold the Feldkirch lordship to Duke Leopold III of Austria; by 1390 the territory had passed entirely to the Habsburgs.
zh: 蒙特福特‑费尔德基希家族是蒙特福特伯爵家族的费尔德基希支系。蒙特福特家族是施瓦本的高级贵族，本为图宾根行宫伯爵的旁支：1182年去世的图宾根的雨果二世通过妻子伊丽莎白继承了老牌布雷根茨伯爵的领地，包括布雷根茨、蒙特福特和锡格马林根；其幼子雨果三世约从1200年起自称蒙特福特的雨果，他修建了俯瞰全城的沙滕堡，并创建了费尔德基希城。沙滕堡成为蒙特福特‑费尔德基希领地的中心，约1311年又兴建了新蒙特福特堡。伯爵们以林道法为蓝本，给予城市宽和的城市法，使中世纪的费尔德基希在人口和富庶程度上超过布雷根茨；家族中还有多位成员出任要职，如圣加伦修道院院长威廉和康斯坦茨主教鲁道夫三世。后来一场牵涉蒙特福特‑费尔德基希伯爵鲁道夫三世的私战开启了家族的衰落，也让哈布斯堡势力得以进入福拉尔贝格。1375年，城堡伯爵鲁道夫四世把费尔德基希领地卖给奥地利公爵利奥波德三世，到1390年这片领土已完全归于哈布斯堡。

en: The House of Montoire, also known after its lands as the house of Langeais or Vendome, was a noble family of the Loire valley whose first known ancestor Hubert held the castle of Langeais as a vassal of Fulk Nerra of Anjou around the year 1000. In about 1073 Hamelin II married Helvise, heiress of the lordship of Montoire on the Loir, and his descendants took their name from it. The family's rise came through another marriage: Pierre II de Montoire wed Agnes, daughter of Count Bouchard IV of Vendome, and their son John inherited the county from his uncle around 1218, ruling as Count John IV and joining the lordship of Montoire permanently to Vendome. For the next two centuries his line gave the Vendomois its counts, until the house ended in 1412 with Countess Catherine of Vendome. Catherine had married John I of Bourbon-La Marche, so the Vendome inheritance passed to the Bourbon-Vendome branch; the county was raised to a duchy-peerage in 1515, and Catherine was an ancestor of Henry IV, who held that duchy before taking the French throne in 1589.
zh: 蒙图瓦尔家族也按其封地被称为朗热家族或旺多姆家族，是卢瓦尔河谷的贵族世家；可考的始祖于贝尔在公元1000年前后以安茹的富尔克·内拉封臣的身份镇守朗热城堡。约1073年，阿姆兰二世娶卢瓦河畔蒙图瓦尔领地的女继承人埃尔薇丝，后代便以蒙图瓦尔为姓。家族的崛起同样靠婚姻：皮埃尔二世·德·蒙图瓦尔娶旺多姆伯爵布沙尔四世之女阿涅丝，他们的儿子让在1218年前后从舅父那里继承伯国，称让四世伯爵，蒙图瓦尔领地从此与旺多姆伯国合为一体。此后两百年间，这一支世代担任旺多姆伯爵，直到1412年末代女伯爵卡特琳去世而家族断绝。卡特琳嫁给波旁-拉马什的让一世，旺多姆的遗产随之转入波旁-旺多姆支系；该伯国于1515年升格为公爵领，卡特琳也是亨利四世的祖先，后者在1589年登上法兰西王位之前便领有这个公爵领。

en: The Mōri were a samurai clan of Ōe descent whose founder Mōri Suemitsu (1202–1247), fourth son of the Kamakura statesman Ōe no Hiromoto, took the name from his Mōri estate in Aikō district of Sagami Province. After the Jōkyū War of 1221 Suemitsu was made steward of an estate in Aki, but in 1247 he joined the Miura against the Hōjō in the Hōji War, was defeated and killed himself, and only his son Tsunemitsu's line survived, splitting into Echigo and Aki branches. The Aki line, confirmed in the Yoshida estate, kept its distance from the Kenmu Restoration of 1333 and then attached itself to Ashikaga Takauji; Mōri Motoharu campaigned under the Kyūshū commander Imagawa Sadayo before going down to Aki to rule from Yoshida-Kōriyama Castle. For generations the Mōri were local lords squeezed between the Ōuchi and the Amago, until Mōri Motonari, who lived from 1497 to 1571, turned them into Sengoku daimyō: he placed his sons into the Kikkawa and Kobayakawa houses to form the Two Rivers system, destroyed Sue Harukata at the Battle of Itsukushima in 1555 and overthrew the Amago in 1566, ruling ten provinces of the Chūgoku region. His grandson Terumoto submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi with over a million koku, but as nominal head of the western army at Sekigahara in 1600 he lost the eastern provinces and was reduced to Nagato and Suō, the future Chōshū Domain, ruled from Hagi.
zh: 毛利氏本姓大江，始祖毛利季光（1202—1247）是镰仓幕府重臣大江广元的第四子，因继承相模国爱甲郡的毛利庄而以毛利为姓，世代为幕府御家人。1221年承久之乱后，季光被补任为安艺国一处庄园的地头；1247年他与三浦泰村结盟反抗北条时赖，在宝治合战中兵败自尽，一族大多覆灭，唯有身在越后的儿子经光一脉存续，此后分为越后与安艺两支。安艺毛利氏领有吉田庄，1333年元弘之乱时当主时亲对建武新政保持距离，一度被没收领地，南北朝时转而追随足利尊氏；其曾孙元春在九州探题今川贞世麾下征讨征西府，随后南下安艺，以吉田郡山城为居城治理吉田庄。室町以降，毛利氏作为安艺国人长期受大内氏、尼子氏两大势力挤压，直到毛利元就（1497—1571）当政才跃升为战国大名：他将次子元春、三子隆景分别送入吉川氏与小早川氏，建立‘毛利两川’体制，1555年在严岛之战击破陶晴贤，1566年攻灭尼子氏，领有中国地方十国。其孙辉元后来臣从丰臣秀吉，总石高超过一百一十万石；1600年关原之战中他名义上总领西军，战败后被削去东部领地，仅余长门、周防两国，移居萩城，即江户时代的长州藩。

en: The Morosini were one of the oldest patrician houses of Venice, said to have settled in the lagoon before the tenth century, when they crushed their rivals the Caloprini. They gave the Republic four doges, twenty-six procurators of Saint Mark and many generals and admirals. Doge Domenico Morosini, elected in 1148, led Venice's expansion into the Adriatic against the Dalmatian corsairs and the cities of Istria. On the Fourth Crusade the family supplied Domenico and Sebastiano Morosini among the crusader captains, while the monk Tommaso Morosini became the first Latin Patriarch of Constantinople in 1204. Later doges were Marino Morosini from 1249 and Michele Morosini in 1382. Through marriage the family reached beyond Venice: Tomasina Morosini became queen of Hungary and mother of King Andrew III, while Constanza Morosini married into the Serbian royal house. Antonio Morosini chronicled the city's affairs in the early fifteenth century in the Morosini Codex. After a quieter period the family rose again with Francesco Morosini, captain-general in the Morean War against the Ottomans, who conquered the Peloponnese and was elected doge in 1688, the first doge since Enrico Dandolo to lead a great fleet in person.
zh: 莫罗西尼家族是威尼斯最古老的贵族世家之一，据说在10世纪以前已定居潟湖，并在10世纪末压垮对手卡洛普里尼家族。家族为共和国贡献了四位总督、二十六位圣马可检察官以及大批将领和海军统帅。1148年当选的总督多梅尼科·莫罗西尼领导威尼斯在亚得里亚海扩张，征讨达尔马提亚海盗和伊斯特拉诸城。第四次十字军东征时，家族的多梅尼科和塞巴斯蒂亚诺·莫罗西尼担任十字军将领，修士托马索·莫罗西尼则于1204年成为君士坦丁堡首任拉丁宗主教。此后出任总督的还有1249年就任的马里诺·莫罗西尼和1382年就任的米凯莱·莫罗西尼。通过联姻，家族的影响越出威尼斯：托马西娜·莫罗西尼成为匈牙利王后，是国王安德拉什三世的母亲；孔斯坦察·莫罗西尼则嫁入塞尔维亚王室。安东尼奥·莫罗西尼在15世纪初以《莫罗西尼抄本》记录了威尼斯的大事。经历一段相对沉寂的时期后，家族因弗朗切斯科·莫罗西尼再度崛起：他在对抗奥斯曼人的摩里亚战争中任海军统帅，征服伯罗奔尼撒，并于1688年当选总督，是恩里科·丹多洛之后首位亲率大舰队出征的在任总督。

en: The lords of Moers, first documented as the noblemen Elger and Theodoric de Murse in 1186, began as vassals of the Archbishops of Cologne on the Lower Rhine. Theodoric I, attested from 1226, is the first securely known ruling count of the small county around Moers Castle, which also held Krefeld as an exclave. Theodoric II fought on the Cologne side at the Battle of Worringen in 1288, and in 1361 the family secured a declaration from Cleves that Moers was not a Cleves fief, though the overlordship dispute long outlived him. The house reached its highest standing through the church: a younger son, Theodoric of Moers, was Archbishop of Cologne from 1414 to 1463, while his brothers Henry and Walram each became Bishop of Münster. The comital line died out in 1578. The county was disputed between Orange-Nassau and Cleves, occupied by Maurice of Orange in 1601, and passed to Brandenburg-Prussia in 1702, which raised it to a principality in 1705.
zh: 莫尔斯家族是下莱茵地区的小邦统治者，1186年以贵族埃尔格和迪特里希·德·穆尔塞的名字首次见于文献，起初是科隆大主教的封臣。1226年起有记载的迪特里希一世是第一位可确考的在位伯爵，领地以默尔斯城堡为中心，还辖有飞地克雷费尔德。迪特里希二世在1288年的沃林根战役中站在科隆一方作战；1361年家族取得克莱沃的声明，确认默尔斯并非克莱沃的采邑，但宗主权之争在他身后仍持续很久。家族的最高地位来自教会：幼子迪特里希·冯·莫尔斯在1414—1463年任科隆大主教，他的兄弟亨利希和瓦拉姆先后出任明斯特主教。伯爵男系于1578年断绝，伯国由奥兰治-拿骚与克莱沃争夺，1601年被拿骚的莫里斯占领，1702年并入勃兰登堡-普鲁士，1705年被升格为侯国。

en: The Mortimers were a Norman family, named after Mortemer in Normandy, who settled in England after the Conquest and rose as marcher lords based at Wigmore Castle in Herefordshire. Their chief stronghold became Ludlow after Roger Mortimer, the future first Earl of March, married the heiress Joan de Geneville in 1301, bringing him wide lands in the Welsh Marches and Ireland and the lord lieutenancy of Ireland in 1316. This same Roger led the marcher revolt known as the Despenser War against Edward II in 1322, escaped from the Tower of London to France, and returned with Queen Isabella, whose lover he became; together they deposed Edward II in 1327 and ruled England for three years. Created Earl of March in 1328, he was overthrown by the young Edward III and hanged at Tyburn in 1330, leaving the house attainted and its heir underage in 1337. The earldom was later restored to his grandson, and through marriage into Lionel of Antwerp's line the Mortimers became heirs presumptive to Richard II; when their claim passed to the House of York, it was pressed in the Wars of the Roses and vindicated when Edward IV, who bore the title Earl of March, won the throne at Towton in 1461. The direct Mortimer line had ended with the death of the fifth earl in 1425.
zh: 莫蒂默家族是诺曼人家族，得名于诺曼底的莫尔蒂默，诺曼征服后定居英格兰，以赫里福德郡的威格莫尔城堡为根基，崛起为威尔士边疆贵族。后来受封第一代马奇伯爵的罗杰·莫蒂默于1301年迎娶女继承人琼·德·热纳维尔，得到拉德洛这座家族首要城堡以及威尔士边疆和爱尔兰的大片领地，并于1316年出任爱尔兰总督。1322年，正是这位罗杰率领边疆贵族发动反对爱德华二世的德斯潘塞战争，兵败后被关进伦敦塔，又越狱逃往法国，与王后法兰西的伊莎贝拉结盟并成为她的情人；两人1327年废黜爱德华二世，实际统治英格兰三年。罗杰1328年受封马奇伯爵，1330年被年轻的爱德华三世推翻，绞死于泰伯恩，因此1337年开局时家族被剥夺爵位、继承人年幼，正处于低谷。伯爵爵位后来由其孙恢复；通过与安特卫普的莱昂内尔一系联姻，莫蒂默家族成为理查二世的推定继承人。他们的继承权转入约克家族后，在玫瑰战争中成为争位依据，1461年身兼马奇伯爵的爱德华四世在陶顿战役获胜、登上王位。莫蒂默嫡系则在1425年第五代伯爵死后断绝。

en: The House of Mowbray was an Anglo-Norman noble house taking its name from Montbray in Normandy, whose English lands passed through Nigel d'Aubigny to his son Roger, the first Roger de Mowbray. The family fought in the greatest baronial crises of the thirteenth century: one Roger was captured with King Stephen at Lincoln in 1141, and a later William was among the twenty-five barons set over the enforcement of Magna Carta in 1215. Roger de Mowbray was summoned to parliament as the first Lord Mowbray under Edward I, and his son John, warden of the Scottish March, joined the earl of Lancaster's revolt, was taken at Boroughbridge and hanged at York in 1322; his marriage to a Braose heiress had already brought the house Gower in Glamorgan and Bramber in Sussex. His son John, the third baron, was held in the Tower of London as a boy until 1327, then served Edward III in Brittany and at Neville's Cross, and died of the plague in 1361. A later marriage to the Segrave heiress, granddaughter of Edward I's son Thomas of Brotherton, brought the earldom of Nottingham and the earl marshalship, and in 1397 Richard II made Thomas Mowbray the first Duke of Norfolk. The direct line ended with the child Anne de Mowbray in 1481, and the Norfolk inheritance and title passed to the Howard family.
zh: 莫布雷家族是盎格鲁-诺曼贵族世家，得名于诺曼底的蒙布雷，其英格兰领地经奈杰尔·多比尼传给其子罗杰——即第一代罗杰·德·莫布雷。这个家族参与了13世纪历次重大男爵危机：一位罗杰曾在1141年林肯之战中与斯蒂芬国王一同被俘，后来的威廉则是1215年负责监督《大宪章》执行的二十五名男爵之一。罗杰·德·莫布雷受爱德华一世召入议会，成为第一代莫布雷男爵；其子约翰曾任苏格兰边疆长官，后加入兰开斯特伯爵的叛乱，1322年在巴勒布里奇被俘，绞死于约克。约翰与布劳斯家族女继承人的婚姻已为家族带来格拉摩根的高尔和萨塞克斯的布兰伯领地。他的儿子、第三代男爵约翰幼年被囚于伦敦塔，1327年才获释，后来随爱德华三世征战布列塔尼并参加内维尔十字之战，1361年染鼠疫而死。再往后，家族与塞格雷夫女继承人——爱德华一世之子布罗瑟顿的托马斯的孙女——联姻，得到诺丁汉伯爵衔与军务伯爵之职；1397年，理查二世封托马斯·莫布雷为第一代诺福克公爵。嫡系随年幼的安妮·德·莫布雷于1481年夭亡而断绝，诺福克的遗产与爵位转入霍华德家族。

en: The Muhannids, or Banu Muhanna, were the Husaynid sharifian dynasty that ruled the holy city of Medina on and off from about 940 into the sixteenth century. As descendants of Muhammad through Ali and his son Husayn they professed Twelver Shiʿism, and their line began when Ubayd Allah ibn Tahir seized power in the city as Abbasid authority crumbled. Like their Hasanid rivals in Mecca, the sharifs of Medina generally accepted the overlordship of the rulers of Egypt, first the Ikhshidids and Fatimids and later the Ayyubids; the emir Qasim ibn Muhanna, a confidant of Saladin, even held Mecca for three days in 1176. The long reign of Shihah ibn Hashim from 1226 to 1250 was peaceful and close to Ayyubid Egypt, while his son Jammaz briefly occupied Mecca in 1271 and 1288. From 1283 the Mamluks tightened their grip, installing a Sunni imam in the Prophet's Mosque, and during the fourteenth century Cairo claimed the right to appoint Medina's emir outright; Wudayy ibn Jammaz, the head of a rival branch, ruled the city from 1336 to 1343, and the family was temporarily expelled between 1350 and 1357. In the fifteenth century Medina was subordinated to the Sharif of Mecca as vice-sultan of the Hejaz, and after the Ottoman conquest of Egypt in 1517 the old emirate was absorbed into the Ottoman administration of the holy cities.
zh: 穆罕尼德家族又称巴努·穆罕纳，是侯赛因系圣裔谢里夫王朝，约940年至16世纪断断续续统治圣城麦地那。他们是穆罕默德经阿里及其子侯赛因传下的后裔，信奉十二伊玛目派什叶派；阿拔斯政权瓦解时，欧拜杜拉·伊本·塔希尔夺取麦地那政权，开创此家族。与麦加的哈桑系对手一样，麦地那谢里夫通常接受埃及统治者的宗主权，先后臣属伊赫什德王朝、法蒂玛王朝和阿尤布王朝；埃米尔卡西姆·伊本·穆罕纳是萨拉丁的亲信，1176年还曾占据麦加三天。1226年至1250年希哈·伊本·哈希姆在位长久、治下太平，与阿尤布埃及关系密切；其子贾马兹又于1271年和1288年短暂攻占麦加。1283年起马穆鲁克加强控制，在先知寺设立逊尼派伊玛目，14世纪开罗更直接取得麦地那埃米尔的任命权；支系首领伍代伊·伊本·贾马兹于1336年至1343年统治该城，整个家族则在1350年至1357年间一度被逐。15世纪，麦地那被置于麦加谢里夫（汉志副苏丹）之下；1517年奥斯曼征服埃及后，这个旧埃米尔国被并入两圣城的奥斯曼行政体系。

en: The Muirs, also spelled Mure, were a knightly family of Ayrshire in southwest Scotland; their surname comes from the Scots word more, meaning moor or fen. David de More witnessed a charter of Alexander II in the first half of the thirteenth century, and the family held Polkelly near Kilmarnock before Sir Gilchrist Mure helped secure Rowallan Castle through his service at the Battle of Largs in 1263. Sir Adam Mure of Rowallan was the father of Elizabeth Mure, the only member of the house represented in 1337. She formed a secular union with Robert Stewart, High Steward of Scotland and the future Robert II, around 1336; after a papal dispensation they remarried in 1349. She died before 1355, but her sons included Robert III and Robert Stewart, Duke of Albany, and doubts over the validity of her marriage fed later succession disputes. The Muirs went on holding Rowallan for centuries.
zh: 缪尔家族（又拼穆尔）是苏格兰西南部艾尔郡的骑士家族，姓氏源自苏格兰语more，意为荒原或沼泽。13世纪上半叶，大卫·德·莫尔曾为亚历山大二世的特许状作证；家族早先领有基尔马诺克附近的波尔凯利，后来吉尔克里斯特·缪尔爵士在1263年的拉格斯战役中立功，取得罗阿伦城堡。罗阿伦的亚当·缪尔爵士之女伊丽莎白·缪尔是这个家族在1337年唯一在册的成员。约1336年，她与苏格兰王室大管家、后来的罗伯特二世罗伯特·斯图尔特结合；在取得教皇特许后，两人于1349年重新举行婚礼。她在1355年前去世，所生诸子包括罗伯特三世和奥尔巴尼公爵罗伯特·斯图尔特，而她婚姻效力的争议后来引发了继承纠纷。缪尔家族此后保有罗阿伦达数百年之久。

en: The Muknes were a Koli chiefly house, the rulers of the hill state of Jawhar in the northern Konkan, in the wooded country between Nasik and the coast. Their founder Jayabha Mukne, a Koli polygar also remembered as Paupera, seized the Jawhar fort in 1306 and built a chiefship on the strength of the Koli clans of the Western Ghats. His son Dulbar Rao expanded the patrimony to twenty-two forts covering much of the Nasik and Thana country, and in 1343 his rule was recognised by Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq of Delhi, who conferred on him the name Nem Shah and the hereditary title of Raja, an event the state commemorated with its own calendar era. A later raja, Deobar Rao, was captured fighting the Bahmani sultan Ahmad Shah at Bidar, converted to Islam as Muhammad Shah and married the sultan's daughter; on his death the Hindu nobles rejected his Muslim son and restored a Hindu cadet line. The little state kept its independence through the age of the Deccan sultanates, but the Marathas proved too strong: Raja Vikram Shah joined Shivaji in the sack of Surat in 1664, yet Maratha armies occupied Jawhar in 1742, 1758 and 1761, each time restoring the Muknes only against fresh cessions of land and tribute, until by 1782 the raja held only a small landlocked hill territory. Reduced to a minor chiefship, the house entered the nineteenth century as one of many small Maratha-period principalities soon to pass under British paramountcy.
zh: 穆克内家族是科利人的酋长世家，统治着北孔卡尼的山地土邦贾瓦尔，据有纳西克与海岸之间西高止山的林地区域。始祖贾亚巴·穆克内（又称保佩拉）是科利人的小首领，于1306年夺取贾瓦尔堡，凭西高止山的科利诸部建立起酋长政权。其子杜尔巴尔·拉奥把祖业扩展到22座堡垒，覆盖纳西克与塔纳大部；1343年德里苏丹穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克承认其统治，赐名内姆沙并授予世袭罗阇称号，土邦还为此创立了自己的纪年。后来的罗阇德奥巴尔·拉奥在比达尔与巴赫曼尼苏丹艾哈迈德沙作战时被俘，改宗伊斯兰教、改名穆罕默德沙并娶苏丹之女；他死后印度教贵族拒绝承认其穆斯林儿子，改立印度教旁支后裔。这个小邦在德干苏丹国时代保持了独立，却不敌马拉塔人：罗阇维克拉姆沙曾随希瓦吉参与1664年洗劫苏拉特，但马拉塔军队仍于1742、1758和1761年三度占领贾瓦尔，每次都以割地加贡为条件才归还穆克内家，到1782年罗阇只剩一块内陆山地小领地。沦为小酋长政权的穆克内家就这样步入19世纪，成为马拉塔时代众多小邦之一，不久便归入英国的宗主权之下。

en: The Mulai were the lords of Kuhistan, the rugged mountain country of southern Khorasan whose chief city was Qaen. On the collapse of the Ilkhanate in 1335, 'Abd-Allah b. Mulai joined the princes of eastern Iran in accepting Togha Temür as Ilkhan, and in 1337 he and Arghun Shah withdrew their troops from the ill-fated western campaign at Bistam. A kinsman, Muhammad-i Mulai, was appointed governor of Khurasan by the Jalayirid Hasan Buzurg, but Togha Temür and Arghun Shah defeated and executed him later that year. 'Abd-Allah remained Togha Temür's ally in the wars against the Sarbadars until he was killed, together with the vizier Faryumadi, in the khan's defeat of 29 July 1342.
zh: 穆莱家族是库希斯坦的领主，库希斯坦即南呼罗珊的山地区域，以加延为首府。1335年伊利汗国瓦解时，阿卜杜拉·本·穆莱与东伊朗诸王公一同拥立脱合帖木儿为伊利汗；1337年，他又和阿儿浑沙一起在比斯塔姆撤离了那场注定失败的西征。他的族人穆罕默德·穆莱被札剌亦儿人哈桑·布祖格任命为呼罗珊长官，但同年就被脱合帖木儿和阿儿浑沙击败并处死。阿卜杜拉始终是脱合帖木儿对抗萨尔巴达尔人的盟友，直到1342年7月29日在汗廷的那场惨败中与维齐尔法鲁马迪一同阵亡。

en: The Munakata were an ancient maritime clan of Chikuzen in northern Kyūshū, also recorded as Munakata no Kimi, who ruled the Munakata district and the waters of the Genkai Sea while serving as hereditary priests of Munakata Taisha, shrine of the three Munakata goddesses. After the Taika reform of 645 the clan headed the shrine's sacred district and held the Onga district office as well; in 979 the court created the post of daiguji, or chief priest, for its heads. Maritime wealth brought marriage ties with Chinese merchants of Hakata, and under the Kamakura shogunate the Munakata were gokenin who fought the Mongol invasion of 1281 and were rewarded with an estate in Hizen. In 1333 they helped overthrow the Chinzei deputy, and from 1336 they backed Ashikaga Takauji, fighting at Tatara-hama and holding first the jitō post and later the shugo post of Iki; in 1375 they campaigned against the Kikuchi in Higo on Ashikaga Yoshimitsu's order, besieging Yatsushiro Castle. Through the fifteenth century they balanced between the Ōuchi and the Shōni, leaning toward the Ōuchi. Caught in the sixteenth-century wars of the Sue, Mōri and Ōtomo, the clan lost its last head Munakata Ujisada to disease in 1587 without an heir, and Toyotomi Hideyoshi confiscated its lands during the Kyūshū campaign.
zh: 宗像氏又作宗形氏、胸形君，是九州北部筑前国的古老海洋豪族，世代奉祀宗像大社的宗像三女神，同时统治宗像地方及玄界滩一带的广阔海域。645年大化改新后，宗像氏兼任神郡大领与宗像大社神主，并担任远贺郡等郡司；979年朝廷正式设置大宫司职，由其家族世袭。凭借海上贸易之利，宗像氏与博多的中国商人世代联姻，镰仓时代成为幕府御家人，1281年弘安之役中抗击元军，获封肥前国神埼庄。1333年其参与攻灭镇西探题，1336年又投效足利尊氏，在多多良滨之战中力战，此后一贯效忠北朝，先后兼任壹岐的地头与守护；1375年还奉足利义满之命进攻肥后的菊池氏、围攻八代城。15世纪，宗像氏被夹在大内氏与少贰氏之间，靠拢大内氏保住家名。16世纪它又被陶氏、毛利氏与大友氏的争战裹挟，1587年末代当主宗像氏贞病死，嗣子盐寿丸夭折，家门断绝，丰臣秀吉在九州平定中对其予以改易、没收领地。

en: The Senn von Münsingen were a knightly ministerial family of the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, holding allodial and feudal lands in the Aare basin around Münsingen, between Thun and Bern, and later around the castles of Buchegg and Balmegg on the Bern-Solothurn border. The knight Johannes von Münsingen was the first to use the surname Senn, in 1241; as vassals of the counts of Kyburg and the prince-bishop of Basel, the family married into the houses of Buchegg, Bechburg and Neuchâtel. Many sons entered the church: Johann, born around 1308, was elected Bishop of Basel in 1335 and sat on the council he opened to the city's craftsmen in 1337, while other members became provosts of Moutier-Grandval and commanders of the Teutonic Order at Köniz. In the Aare basin wars the family backed its overlords against Bern and Solothurn, whose troops repeatedly sacked its castles. Emperor Charles IV made Burkhard a baron in 1360, but the house could not keep its rank, and around 1410 the last heir, Elisabeth, sold the lordships of Münsingen, Buchegg and Diessenberg to Bern, Solothurn and Thun.
zh: 森·冯·明辛根是13至14世纪的骑士侍从家族，在阿勒河流域拥有自主地和封地，核心在图恩与伯尔尼之间的明辛根，后来又在伯尔尼与索洛图恩交界的布赫埃格、巴尔梅格城堡附近立足。1241年，骑士约翰内斯·冯·明辛根最先使用“森”这一家姓；作为基堡伯爵和巴塞尔采邑主教的封臣，家族与布赫埃格、贝希堡、纳沙泰尔等家族联姻。许多成员投身教会：约1308年出生的约翰于1335年当选巴塞尔主教，1337年准许行会工匠进入市议会，还有成员出任穆捷-格朗瓦勒的修道长和条顿骑士团克尼茨辖区长官。在阿勒河流域的争夺中，家族站在领主一边对抗伯尔尼和索洛图恩，城堡屡遭两城军队拆毁。1360年皇帝查理四世封布克哈德为男爵，但家族终究保不住地位；约1410年，末代继承人伊丽莎白把明辛根、布赫埃格和迪森贝格三块领地分别卖给伯尔尼、索洛图恩和图恩，家族随之消亡。

en: The Murrays descend from Freskin, a twelfth-century Flemish knight to whom David I of Scotland granted lands in Moray and West Lothian; his descendants took the Norman-style surname de Moravia, meaning of Moray, which became Murray in Lowland Scots. The senior branch, the Morays of Bothwell, built Bothwell Castle in Lanarkshire into one of Scotland's greatest strongholds. Andrew Moray, the family's most famous son, led the rising of 1297 alongside William Wallace and was mortally wounded after the victory at Stirling Bridge. His posthumous son, Sir Andrew Murray (1298-1338), inherited Bothwell, married Christina Bruce, sister of Robert the Bruce, and twice served as Guardian of Scotland during the Second War of Independence, harrying Edward Balliol and the English until his death in 1338. When the fifth lord died of plague in 1360 Bothwell passed to the Douglases, and the chiefship later moved to the Murrays of Tullibardine, who were created Earls of Tullibardine in 1606 and Earls of Atholl in 1626. Raised to Marquess in 1676 and Duke of Atholl in 1703, the family largely backed the Stuart cause in the Jacobite risings of the eighteenth century.
zh: 默里家族的先祖是12世纪的佛兰德斯骑士弗雷斯金，苏格兰国王大卫一世把马里和西洛锡安的土地封给他；其后裔取诺曼式姓氏 de Moravia，意为“马里的”，在苏格兰低地语中演变为 Murray（默里）。主支博思韦尔的默里家族在拉纳克郡修建的博思韦尔城堡，是苏格兰最坚固的要塞之一。家族最著名的人物安德鲁·默里于1297年与威廉·华莱士共同举兵，在斯特灵桥大捷后伤重而亡。他的遗腹子安德鲁·默里爵士（1298—1338）继承博思韦尔，娶罗伯特一世之妹克里斯蒂娜·布鲁斯为妻，并在第二次苏格兰独立战争期间两度出任苏格兰摄政，持续打击爱德华·巴利奥尔和英格兰势力，直至1338年去世。1360年第五代领主死于瘟疫，博思韦尔转入道格拉斯家族之手，族长之位后来由图利巴丁的默里一支继承：该支于1606年受封图利巴丁伯爵，1626年成为阿索尔伯爵，1676年升侯爵，1703年又升阿索尔公爵，并在18世纪的詹姆斯党起事中长期支持斯图亚特王室。

en: The Muş were the Kurdish lords of the town of Muş in the Taron plain, a small fourteenth-century emirate within the orbit of the Bitlis princes under Kara Koyunlu overlordship. Timur took the town without a battle in 1387, and it later passed to the Aq Qoyunlu, the Safavids and the Ottomans.
zh: 穆什家族是塔隆平原穆什城的库尔德统治者，14世纪时是比特利斯王公势力范围内的一个小埃米尔国，与比特利斯同受黑羊王朝羁縻。1387年帖木儿兵不血刃地拿下该城，此后穆什又相继转入白羊王朝、萨非王朝和奥斯曼帝国之手。

en: The Mushana Rajput dynasty, whose clan name was Chamial, ruled the Himalayan state of Chamba in an almost unbroken line from the sixth century. Claiming solar-lineage descent from Ayodhya, its founder Maru settled at Bharmour around 550; Meru Varman defeated the raja of Kullu and kept that rival under Chamba's sway for six generations, while Mushan Varman, legend says named for the mice that guarded him as an abandoned baby, married the daughter of the raja of Suket and rose to power. Around 920 Sahila Varman moved the capital from Bharmour to the new town of Champavati, later called Chamba and said to be named for his daughter, from which the Mushana rajas reigned for the rest of the dynasty's history. Vijaya Varman enlarged the state in the late twelfth century, Ganesa Varman (r. 1512-1559) built the fortress of Ganeshgarh, and his son Pratap Singh Varman seized Guler in his wars with Kangra. Sheltered by its mountains, Chamba largely escaped direct conquest, accepting no more than nominal Mughal suzerainty under Jahangir.
zh: 穆沙纳拉杰普特王朝（氏族名为昌米亚尔）自6世纪起以几乎未曾中断的世系统治喜马拉雅山地邦昌巴。该家族自称日族后裔、源出阿约提亚，始祖马鲁约于550年定居巴尔毛尔；梅鲁·瓦尔曼击败库鲁罗阇，使这个对手连续六代屈从昌巴。穆尚·瓦尔曼迎娶苏凯特罗阇之女而得势，传说他幼年被弃于洞穴、由鼠群守护，因此得名。约920年，萨希拉·瓦尔曼将都城从巴尔毛尔迁至新城昌帕瓦蒂，即后来的昌巴，据说城名得自他的女儿，穆沙纳的罗阇们此后一直在此临朝。维贾亚·瓦尔曼在12世纪末拓土开疆，加内萨·瓦尔曼（1512—1559年在位）修建加内什加尔堡，其子普拉塔普·辛格·瓦尔曼在与冈格拉的战争中夺取古莱尔。凭借群山屏障，昌巴大体免于被外敌直接征服，在贾汉吉尔时期仅名义上承认莫卧儿的宗主权。

en:
The Musunuri Nayakas were Telugu warrior chiefs who rose from obscurity in the lower Godavari country after the fall of the Kakatiya kingdom of Warangal to the Delhi Sultanate. Around 1330 Musunuri Prolaya Nayaka established himself at Rekapalle, near Bhadrachalam, claiming the Kakatiya heritage. His successor Kapaya Nayaka seized Warangal from the Delhi governor Malik Maqbul in 1336 and led the Andhra chieftains in expelling Sultanate rule from eastern Telangana, taking the Persianised title Sultan of the Andhra country.

His power was soon worn down by the new Bahmani Sultanate: he lost fort after fort, including Golconda, and in 1361 surrendered the turquoise throne of Warangal to Mohammed Shah I under a treaty. In 1368 the rival Recherla Nayakas killed him in battle at Bhimavaram, and the Musunuri chiefship broke up as its allied Nayakas returned to their own towns.
zh:
穆苏努里·纳亚卡是泰卢固武将首领家族，在瓦朗加尔的卡卡提亚王国亡于德里苏丹国之后，于戈达瓦里河下游一带悄然崛起。约1330年，穆苏努里·普罗拉亚·纳亚卡立足巴德拉查拉姆附近的雷卡帕勒，自称继承卡卡提亚的法统。继任者卡帕亚·纳亚卡于1336年从德里总督马利克·马克布勒手中夺取瓦朗加尔，率领安得拉诸首领把苏丹国势力赶出特伦甘纳东部，并采用波斯化的称号“安得拉之国的苏丹”。

新兴的巴赫曼尼苏丹国很快削弱了他的力量：他接连失去包括戈尔孔达在内的多座要塞，1361年又依条约把瓦朗加尔的绿松石王座献给穆罕默德·沙一世。1368年，敌对的隶契罗·纳亚卡家族在比马拉姆战役中将他击杀，穆苏努里的首领之邦随之瓦解，结盟的纳亚卡们各回本城。

en: The Muzaffarids were a Persianized dynasty of Arab descent whose ancestors fled the Mongol invasion of Khorasan for Yazd, where they served the Ilkhans as governors of Maibud. Its founder, Mubariz al-Din Muhammad, overthrew the atabeg of Yazd around 1319, seized Kirman from its Mongol governor in 1340, and destroyed the rival Injuids to take Shiraz in 1353, making his the strongest power in central Iran; he even occupied Tabriz briefly before the Jalayirids forced him back. His son Shah Shoja, who blinded and deposed him in 1358, ruled until 1384 and made Shiraz a center of Arabic and Persian letters, where the poet Hafez flourished; the family also enlarged the Jameh Mosque of Yazd, completing its tiled dome in 1375. Fraternal wars between Shah Shoja's sons then weakened the realm. When Timur invaded, Isfahan was sacked in 1387 and Shah Mansur was defeated and beheaded at the Battle of Shiraz in 1393; the remaining Muzaffarid princes were executed at Qumisha soon after, ending the dynasty.
zh: 穆扎法尔王朝是一个已深度波斯化的阿拉伯裔家族，其祖先在蒙古入侵呼罗珊时逃到亚兹德，世代为伊尔汗国担任迈布德总督。开创者穆巴里兹丁·穆罕默德约于1319年推翻亚兹德的阿塔伯克，1340年从蒙古总督手中夺取克尔曼，又在1353年攻灭敌对的因朱王朝、拿下设拉子，成为伊朗中部最强的势力，甚至一度占领大不里士，后被札剌亦儿王朝逼退。他的儿子沙阿·舒贾于1358年将他废黜并刺瞎，统治至1384年，在设拉子倡导阿拉伯语和波斯语文学，诗人哈菲兹即活跃于这一时期；家族还扩建亚兹德聚礼清真寺，于1375年完成瓷砖穹顶。此后诸子兄弟相争，国势衰弱。帖木儿入侵后，伊斯法罕于1387年遭屠城，沙阿·曼苏尔在1393年的设拉子之战中战败被斩首，其余穆扎法尔王公不久在库米沙被处死，王朝就此灭亡。

en: The Muzaka were an Albanian noble house that ruled the Myzeqe lowlands of southern Albania, between the Devoll and Vjosë rivers. A member of the family is already recorded around 1090 as a commander in the service of the Byzantine emperor Alexios I Komnenos. From the late thirteenth century Andrea I and then Andrea II headed the house, steering between Byzantium and the Angevins of Naples; Andrea II received the title of despot in 1335, became a vassal of the Prince of Taranto the next year and defeated a Serbian army near Mount Pelister around 1340. Stefan Dušan's Serbian Empire nevertheless overran their lands between 1343 and 1345, though the family recovered them after his death in 1355 and later took the fortress of Berat. After the Battle of Savra in 1385 the Muzaka submitted to the Ottomans, until Theodor Corona Musachi joined Skanderbeg's revolt in 1444. When the Ottomans overran Albania later in the fifteenth century, many of the family took refuge in Italy, where the last notable exile died at Naples in 1600; those who remained lost their feudal rights and some converted to Islam.
zh: 穆扎卡伊特家族是阿尔巴尼亚贵族世家，统治阿尔巴尼亚南部穆泽切低地、德沃尔河与维约萨河之间的地带。早在约1090年，就有一名家族成员作为拜占庭皇帝阿莱克修斯一世·科穆宁麾下的统兵官见诸记载。13世纪末起，安德烈一世、安德烈二世相继为家族首领，在拜占庭与那不勒斯安茹王朝之间周旋：安德烈二世于1335年获封专制公，次年成为塔兰托亲王的附庸，约1340年在佩利斯特山附近击败一支塞尔维亚军队。尽管如此，斯特凡·杜尚的塞尔维亚帝国仍在1343年至1345年间攻占其领地，不过杜尚1355年死后家族又收复故土，后来还夺取了培拉特要塞。1385年萨夫拉战役后，穆扎卡伊特家族臣服于奥斯曼人，直到1444年特奥多尔·科罗纳·穆扎基加入斯坎德培的起义。15世纪后期奥斯曼人征服阿尔巴尼亚后，家族许多人避难意大利，最后一位知名流亡者于1600年死于那不勒斯；留在本土的成员丧失了封建特权，其中一些人改宗伊斯兰教。

en: The Banu Muzni were the ruling family of the Zab Emirate, a desert-edge state centered on Biskra in eastern Algeria. In the thirteenth century they displaced the Banu Romman at Biskra, imposed their authority on the Bedouin tribes of the region, and with leave from the sultan of Bejaia extended their rule over the Oued Righ, the Aures, the Hodna, Ouargla and Tuggurt, reaching as far as Tozeur. Early in the fourteenth century they tried to throw off Hafsid overlordship by allying with the Zianids of Tlemcen, but had to resubmit to Tunis in 1329; the allegiance stayed purely nominal, and Hafsid armies repeatedly besieged Biskra to force its governor to pay tribute. When the Marinids swept into the central Maghreb in the mid-fourteenth century the Muzni briefly acknowledged their sovereignty before returning to the Hafsid orbit. Ibn Khaldun devoted a chapter to the Banu Muzni as emirs of Biskra, and the emirate finally fell to a Hafsid reconquest in 1402.
zh: 穆兹尼家族是扎布酋长国的统治家族，这个沙漠边缘政权以阿尔及利亚东部的比斯克拉为中心。13世纪，他们在比斯克拉取代巴努·鲁曼人，压服当地贝都因诸部，又经贝贾亚苏丹许可，把统治扩展到里格河谷、奥雷斯、霍德纳、瓦尔格拉和图古尔特，势力远达托泽尔。14世纪初，他们联合特莱姆森的扎扬王朝试图摆脱哈夫斯宗主权，但1329年被迫重新臣服突尼斯；这种臣服仅存名义，哈夫斯军队因此多次围攻比斯克拉，逼迫其总督缴纳贡赋。14世纪中叶马林王朝攻入马格里布中部时，穆兹尼人一度承认马林宗主权，随后又回到哈夫斯势力范围。伊本·赫勒敦曾专门写下一章，记述这些比斯克拉埃米尔的兴衰；1402年，酋长国终被哈夫斯王朝重新征服。

en: The Myinsaing dynasty takes its name from the Kyaukse valley town where three brothers, Athinkhaya, Yazathingyan and Thihathu, rose as commanders of the late Pagan kingdom. After the Mongol invasions shattered Pagan power in 1287, the brothers became the real rulers of central Burma, overthrew King Kyawswa in 1297, and drove off a second Mongol invasion in 1300-1301; the Mongols quit northern Burma altogether in 1303. Thihathu, the youngest brother, crowned himself king and in 1313 founded a new capital at Pinya, claiming Pagan's legacy, while the chronicles treat Sagaing, built up by his son Saw Yun, as a junior branch of the same house. Pinya was weakened by the rivalry of Uzana I and Kyawswa I and by Sagaing's formal secession in 1325. Kyawswa I's reign of 1344-1350 briefly restored central authority, but raids by the Shan state of Maw sacked both Sagaing and Pinya in 1364. Thado Minbya, a great-grandson of Thihathu, seized the two ruined capitals and founded the Ava kingdom in 1365.
zh: 敏象王朝得名于皎施地区的敏象城，出自蒲甘王国末年的三位将领兄弟——阿散哥也、阿剌者僧加蓝和底哈都。1287年元军入侵瓦解蒲甘之后，兄弟三人成为中缅甸的实际统治者，1297年废黜国王憍苴，又在1300—1301年击退元朝的第二次征讨，元军最终于1303年全部退出缅甸。幼弟底哈都自立为王，1313年迁都彬牙、建立彬牙王国，宣称继承蒲甘法统；缅甸编年史把其子苏云经营的实皆视为同一家族的幼支。彬牙长期受乌兹那与觉苏瓦一世争位、以及1325年实皆正式独立的拖累，觉苏瓦一世在位期间（1344—1350年）一度恢复中央权威，但掸族麓川政权的入侵在1364年接连洗劫实皆和彬牙。底哈都的曾孙德多明帕耶攻取两座残破都城，于1365年建立阿瓦王国。

en: The Nabahani were the ruling dynasty of the Swahili island sultanate of Pate in the Lamu Archipelago. According to the Pate Chronicle, the family arrived in 1203 and 1204, when the Arab chief Sulaymān ibn Sulaymān al-Nabahānī married the daughter of the last native Batawiyyūn king and took the throne; the Chronicle goes on to recount thirty-two Nabahani sovereigns, and the family claimed descent from the Nabhani kings of Oman. Under their rule Pate grew into one of the leading trading cities of the East African coast, prominent from the 1300s and long rivalling nearby Lamu and Mombasa. Fortune had turned by the eighteenth century as Pate declined and its sultans took up residence in Lamu. Around 1812 a succession dispute after the death of Sultan Fumo Madi drew in the Mazrui of Mombasa, and the allied Pate and Mombasa army was crushed by Lamu at the Battle of Shela, after which the coast fell under the domination of Oman.
zh: 纳巴哈尼家族是拉穆群岛斯瓦希里城邦帕泰苏丹国的统治王朝。据《帕泰编年史》记载，该家族于1203—1204年到来：阿拉伯首领苏莱曼·本·苏莱曼·纳巴哈尼娶了本地末代巴塔维温国王之女并夺取王位；该书随后记载了三十二位纳巴哈尼君主，这个家族还自称源自阿曼的纳卜汉诸王。在他们治下，帕泰成长为东非海岸首屈一指的贸易城市之一，14世纪起声名显赫，长期与邻近的拉穆、蒙巴萨争雄。到18世纪，帕泰国势衰落，苏丹们迁居拉穆。1812年前后，苏丹富莫·马迪死后的继承之争引来蒙巴萨的马兹鲁伊家族插手，帕泰与蒙巴萨联军在谢拉之战中被拉穆击溃，此后东非海岸落入阿曼的支配之下。

en: The Nabhanids, or Banu Nabhan, were an Arab royal house of Azdi origin that ruled Oman as hereditary kings from 1154 to 1624. Their leader Muhammad al-Fallah rose as the Seljuk garrisons withdrew from Oman and had made himself master of the interior by 1154, ruling from the fortified oases of Nizwa, Bahla and later Maqniyat. As muluk, or kings, the Nabhanids reduced the elected Ibadi imams to a largely symbolic religious office, and Omani chronicles record no imam at all between 1153 and 1406. Their wealth rested on the overland frankincense trade running from Dhofar through Sohar and the Yabrin oasis toward Bahrain, Baghdad and Damascus, and at Bahla they raised the great mud-brick fort complex built between the twelfth and fifteenth centuries. While the Nabhanids managed the interior, they came to terms with the Kingdom of Hormuz, which held much of the coast, and their envoys and rulers travelled as far as Ethiopia, Zanzibar and the Lamu archipelago. From the fifteenth century the Ibadi imamate regained strength: the imam Muhammad ibn Ismail removed King Sulayman ibn Mudhafar early in the sixteenth century, and after the Portuguese seized Muscat in 1507 and overran the coastal towns, the dynasty was left with only the Bahla region. In 1624 Nasir ibn Murshid of the Yaʿrubid dynasty took control of Oman, ending Nabhani kingship.
zh: 纳卜汉王朝又称巴努·纳卜汉，是出身艾兹德部落的阿拉伯王室，1154年至1624年以世袭国王身份统治阿曼。其首领穆罕默德·法拉赫趁塞尔柱驻军撤出阿曼之机崛起，1154年已控制内陆，以奈兹瓦、巴赫莱及后来的迈克尼亚特等设防绿洲为都。纳卜汉君主以国王自居，把经选举产生的伊巴德派伊玛目降为近乎象征性的宗教职位，阿曼史籍在1153年至1406年间甚至没有任何伊玛目的记载。他们的财富依托陆上乳香贸易：商路从佐法尔经苏哈尔和亚卜林绿洲通往巴林、巴格达和大马士革；他们还在巴赫莱修建了12世纪至15世纪陆续建成的巨型土坯堡垒群。纳卜汉家族经营内陆，与控制大片海岸的霍尔木兹王国妥协，其使节和君主的足迹远至埃塞俄比亚、桑给巴尔和拉穆群岛。15世纪起伊巴德派伊玛目国重新壮大，伊玛目穆罕默德·伊本·伊斯玛仪于16世纪初废黜国王苏莱曼·伊本·穆扎法尔；1507年葡萄牙人攻占马斯喀特并席卷沿海城镇后，王朝只剩巴赫莱一隅。1624年，雅鲁卜王朝的纳西尔·伊本·穆尔希德接管阿曼，纳卜汉王统告终。

en:
The Naga dynasty of Kalahandi were the Nagavamsi rulers of the forested hill country of western Odisha, holding court at Junagarh, also called Kalahandinagara. Naga chiefs had ruled parts of the region since the eleventh century, when the Chindaka Nagas carved out the Chakrakota Mandala over Kalahandi and neighbouring Koraput; in the twelfth century their realm became the Kamala Mandala, a feudatory province of the Eastern Ganga kings of Orissa. Court tradition claims the Kalahandi line began when Raghunath Sai, a prince of the Naga house of Chota Nagpur, married the daughter of the last Ganga governor and took the throne, though historians place the change of dynasty in the fifteenth century, as Ganga power weakened.

The Naga kings were crowned with the participation of the Khond tribe, whose chief seated the new raja on his lap, and they claimed eighteen hill forts under the tutelary goddess Manikeswari. After the fourteenth century they transferred their allegiance to the Suryavamsi Gajapatis and ruled independently from 1568. In 1788 the Marathas of Nagpur intervened and reduced Kalahandi to a tributary state, confirming Raja Purushottama Deo on its throne.
zh:
卡拉汉迪的那加王朝是奥里萨西部山林地带的那加万希统治者，宫廷设在朱纳加尔，又称卡拉汉迪那加拉。早在11世纪，钦达卡·那加人就在卡拉汉迪和邻近的科拉普特一带建立查克拉科塔曼达拉，那加首领开始统治这片地区；12世纪时其领地改称卡马拉曼达拉，成为奥里萨东恒伽诸王的一个附庸行省。宫廷传统称，乔塔那格浦尔那加家族的王子拉古纳特·赛娶了末代恒伽总督之女并夺取王位，开创卡拉汉迪王统，但史家认为这次易代实际发生在15世纪恒伽势力衰微之时。

那加诸王的加冕要有孔德部落参与，由部落首领把新罗阇抱在膝上完成仪式，他们在保护女神马尼凯什瓦里的护佑下号称领有十八座山塞。14世纪以后他们转而归附苏利耶万希·伽阇波提王朝，并于1568年起独立统治。1788年，那格浦尔的马拉塔人介入，使卡拉汉迪沦为纳贡之国，同时承认普鲁绍塔马·德奥为当地罗阇。

en: The Nagai of Dewa were a leading Kamakura-period gokenin house founded by Tokihiro, second son of Oe no Hiromoto, the great administrator of the Kamakura shogunate. Tokihiro took his family name from the Nagai manor in northwestern Okitama district of Dewa Province, the region where the game places the clan, and after his elder brother Chikahiro was ruined for supporting the retired emperor in the Jokyu War of 1221, the Nagai inherited the standing of the main Oe lineage. They attached themselves to the Hojo regents, sat on the council of state and held the shugo posts of Bingo and Tango by hereditary tenure; in the Hoji War of 1247 Yasuhide fought for the Hojo against the Miura, and used his influence to save the surviving Mori kinsmen and secure their stewardships, a service the later Mori daimyo remembered. The family built Yonezawa Castle and served generation after generation as stewards of the Nagai manor, until the whole Okitama region came to be called the Nagai district. When the shogunate collapsed in 1333, Hirohide and his nephew Takafuyu abandoned the Hojo for Emperor Go-Daigo and then attached themselves to Ashikaga Takauji, whose steward Hirohide became in 1335. Their long absence in Kyoto and Kamakura, however, let the neighbouring Date grow stronger on the ground: Date Muneto invaded Okitama in 1380 and made Takahata Castle his foothold, and in 1385 Date Masamune seized the Nagai manor, reducing the clan to a minor local house.
zh: 出羽长井氏是镰仓时代显赫的御家人之家，始祖为镰仓幕府政所别当大江广元的次男时广，他以出羽国置赐郡西北部的长井庄为苗字，游戏也把本据放在这一地区。1221年承久之乱中，时广之兄亲广因站在后鸟羽上皇一方而没落，长井氏遂继承大江氏惣领的地位。他们靠拢北条执权，历任评定众，并世代担任备后、丹后两国守护；1247年宝治合战时，泰秀站在北条一方攻打三浦氏，又出力保全了战败的亲族毛利氏的地头职，后来的毛利大名一直感念这份恩义。长井氏修筑米泽城，世代出任长井庄地头，置赐一带甚至被称作长井郡。1333年镰仓幕府灭亡，广秀与侄子举冬见北条大势已去，转投后醍醐天皇，随后又接近足利尊氏，广秀于1335年出任足利氏执事。但家族长期身在京都、镰仓，邻接的伊达氏却在领地内坐大：1380年伊达宗远侵入置赐、占据高畠城，1385年伊达政宗终于横领长井庄，长井氏由此衰微为地方小族。

en: The Nagano, more fully the Nagano Kudō, were a family of local lords who dominated central Ise Province from the Kamakura period. Originally calling themselves Kudō, they took the Nagano name from their lands and long used the character fuji in the personal names of their heads. During the Nanboku-chō wars they joined the Northern Court against the Kitabatake, the Southern Court governors advancing into Ise, and a Nagano warrior appears in the fourteenth-century chronicle Baishōron. In 1429 the head Mitsufuji fought for the shogunate at the Battle of Iwatagawa, where Kitabatake Mitsumasa was killed, and the clan was rewarded with Ichishi District. In the Ōnin War that began in 1467 the Nagano served in the western army. Later they were squeezed between the resurgent Kitabatake and the Rokkaku of Ōmi, and in 1558 the fifteenth head Fujisada submitted to Kitabatake Tomonori and adopted his second son Tomofusa as heir. When Oda Nobunaga overran Ise, the family was forced to adopt Nobunaga's brother Nobukane; after the Mise Incident of 1576, in which Nagano men helped murder Kitabatake Tomonori, Nobukane reverted to the Oda name, ending the Nagano as local rulers. He was dispossessed by Toyotomi Hideyoshi in 1594 and the clan's followers scattered.
zh: 长野氏全称长野工藤氏，是自镰仓时代起称霸伊势国中部的国人领主。其家族本姓工藤，后以领地称长野氏，为与其他长野氏区别而称长野工藤氏，历代当主名字中多带“藤”字。南北朝时代，南朝方国司北畠氏进入伊势，长野氏加入北朝方与之争夺伊势霸权，14世纪的史书《梅松论》中也出现了长野工藤氏族人的名号。1429年，当主长野满藤站在幕府一方参加岩田川之战，迫使北畠满雅败死，家族因功获封一志郡。1467年爆发的应仁之乱中，长野氏从属山名宗全的西军。进入战国时代，家族在重新崛起的北畠氏与近江六角氏的挤压下日衰，1558年第十五代当主长野藤定向北畠具教屈服，收其次子具藤为养子继承家督。织田信长攻入伊势后，长野氏被迫收信长之弟信包为养子；1576年三濑之变中，长野氏族人参与刺杀北畠具教，此后信包恢复织田姓氏，长野氏作为国人领主的历史终结。1594年信包被丰臣秀吉改易，长野一族就此离散。

en: The Naganuma were a warrior house of Shimotsuke province and one of the eight yakata houses of the Kanto, tracing Fujiwara descent through the Oyama clan from the Chinjufu shogun Fujiwara no Hidesato. Their founder was Munemasa, second son of Oyama Masamitsu, who followed Minamoto no Yoritomo and was enfeoffed at Naganuma in Haga district, in what is now Tochigi Prefecture, from which the family took its name; his brothers carried on the Oyama and founded the Yuki. Munemasa won distinction in the Jokyu war of 1221 and was made shugo of Awaji, and in the Kamakura age the house also held the shugo post of Awa. The Nanboku-cho wars split it: the heir Hidetada, unable to hold the home estate, withdrew to its lands in Mutsu, creating Mutsu and Shimotsuke branches. Yoshihide of the Mutsu line entered the service of the Kamakura kubo Ashikaga Ujimitsu and in 1399 recovered the old Naganuma estate, the same year the Naganuma were named among the eight Kanto yakata. A succession quarrel then pulled the house into the Eikyo and Yuki wars of the 1430s and 1440s, and during the Kyotoku war after 1454 the main line was destroyed or driven out when southern Shimotsuke fell under the Koga kubo. A surviving branch served the Koga kubo, moved to Minagawa and took that name; Minagawa Hiroteru became an early Edo daimyo, though his house soon died out without an heir.
zh: 长沼氏是下野国的武家，为关东八屋形之一，本姓藤原，经小山氏一脉追溯至镇守府将军藤原秀乡。其祖宗政是追随源赖朝的小山政光次男，受封下野国芳贺郡长沼（在今日本栃木县境内）并以地名为苗字；其兄长继承小山氏，弟弟则成为结城氏之祖。宗政在1221年承久之乱中立功，受任淡路守护，镰仓时代长沼氏还担任过阿波守护。南北朝战乱令该族分裂：嫡流秀直难以维持本领长沼庄，退往位于陆奥国的长江庄，由此分出陆奥长沼氏与下野长沼氏。陆奥一脉的义秀出仕镰仓公方足利氏满，1399年获认领主本领长沼庄、排挤掉下野分支，同年长沼氏被列入关东八屋形。此后的家督之争把家族卷入15世纪30至40年代的永享之乱与结城合战；1454年以后的享德之乱中，下野南部被古河公方控制，长沼嫡流据说灭亡或被放逐。幸存的一支出仕古河公方，移住皆川庄并改称皆川氏，皆川广照在江户初年位列大名，但其家在孙辈便因无嗣而断绝。

en: The Nakajima of Owari claimed descent from the Saga Genji line of Minamoto no Toru, the twelfth son of Emperor Saga. In 1221, after the Jokyu War, the family settled in Nakajima village of Nakajima district in Owari, the area of present-day Ichinomiya in Aichi Prefecture, and took the place name as its own; the first to style himself Nakajima was Saemon-no-jo Nobunaga, said to be Toru's descendant in the thirteenth generation, and his heirs held Nakajima Castle and also used the title Nakajima Kurando. Through the Muromachi period the family remained local lords of the district, but from the middle of the Sengoku age it was squeezed by the rising Shiba and Oda houses and lost its standing, eventually entering the service of Toyotomi Hideyoshi. Its best-known member, Nakajima Ujitane, became one of the seven hand-group captains of the Toyotomi house with a stipend of over twenty thousand koku; he fought in Ishida Mitsunari's army at Sekigahara in 1600 and again at the Osaka summer campaign of 1615, where he led two thousand men as a mobile force and took his own life as the castle fell. His descendants returned to the land in Kawachi and became prominent wealthy farmers there, and the bakumatsu shogunal officer Nakajima Saburosuke also claimed him as an ancestor.
zh: 尾张中岛氏自称是嵯峨天皇第十二子源融的后裔，属嵯峨源氏。1221年承久之乱后，该族土着于尾张国中岛郡中岛村（今爱知县一宫市），以地名中岛为苗字；源融的第十三代子孙首先自称中岛左卫门尉宣长，其后代居守中岛城，历代还以中岛藏人为号。整个室町时代，中岛氏都是当地的领主，但进入战国中期后，在斯波氏、织田氏等新兴势力的挤压下逐渐衰落，最终出仕丰臣秀吉。族中最有名的是中岛氏种，他成为丰臣家大坂七手组的组头之一，禄高两万余石；1600年关原之战时他在石田三成阵中参战，1615年大坂夏之阵又率两千兵力作为游军奋战，城破前夕自尽。其子孙在河内国归农，成为当地豪农，幕末的幕臣中岛三郎助也自称是氏种的后裔。
