en: Nan Sarunai was the tribal kingdom of the Ma'anyan, a Dayak people of the Barito basin in what is now South Kalimantan, and is remembered in Ma'anyan wadian chants and the Hikayat Banjar as the earliest polity of the Banjar region. Its people, once seafarers with ancient links to the Malagasy of Madagascar, had settled inland along the Tabalong river, around Amuntai and Tanjung. Early leaders named Datu Sialing and Damung Gamiluk Langit were followed by Raden Japutra Layar, who from 1309 built a more centralised state with Javanese-style titles; his successors Raden Neno and Raden Anyan ruled in turn. The end came when Majapahit, under Hayam Wuruk, invaded between 1355 and 1362 and destroyed the kingdom; the victors set up the tributary state of Negara Dipa on its ruins, the predecessor in turn of Negara Daha and the Muslim Banjar Sultanate. Because its story survives mainly in oral tradition, Nan Sarunai's earliest history is hard to date, though archaeology near Amuntai points to very old settlement in the area.
zh: 楠沙鲁奈是今南加里曼丹巴里托河流域达雅克支系马安延人的部落王国，在马安延人的瓦迪安歌谣和《班贾尔故事集》中被视为班贾尔地区最早的政权。马安延人本是善于航海的民族，与马达加斯加的马尔加什人有远古渊源，后来在巴里托河支流塔巴隆河沿岸的阿蒙泰、丹戎一带定居内陆。早期首领达图·西亚灵与达蒙·加米鲁·朗吉之后，拉登·贾普特拉·拉亚尔于1309年建立起更集权的国家，采用爪哇式头衔，其后由拉登·内诺、拉登·安延相继在位。1355—1362年，哈奄·武禄治下的满者伯夷大举入侵并攻灭楠沙鲁奈，胜利者在其废墟上建立附庸国内加拉·迪帕，后来又演变为内加拉·达哈和伊斯兰化的班贾尔苏丹国。由于史事主要靠口传保存，楠沙鲁奈的早期年代难以确考，但阿蒙泰附近的考古发现显示当地定居史十分久远。

en: The Nanbu were a Tōhoku samurai clan claiming Seiwa Genji descent from Kai Province, where they were kin to the Takeda; their name came from their estates at Nanbu in Kai. The founder, Mitsuyuki, joined Minamoto no Yoritomo at the Battle of Ishibashiyama and after the conquest of the Hiraizumi Fujiwara in 1189 was granted the vast Nukanobu district in far northeastern Mutsu, where his six sons held the fortified horse ranches numbered Ichinohe through Kunohe and grew rich supplying warhorses. During the Nanboku-chō wars Motoyuki Nanbu accompanied the Southern Court general Kitabatake Akiie north, built Ne Castle and thereby moved the clan's seat from Kai to Mutsu, while a rival branch served the Northern Court; the two made peace in 1393. By the time of the twenty-fourth head, Harumasa, the Nanbu controlled seven districts of northern Mutsu, but power remained scattered among competing branches. Their vassals the Ōura exploited this: Ōura Tamenobu rebelled in 1572, seized Tsugaru and was confirmed there by Toyotomi Hideyoshi in 1590, taking the name Tsugaru and remaining their hereditary rivals. Nanbu Nobunao meanwhile pledged to Hideyoshi at Odawara in 1590, was recognized as clan chieftain, crushed the Kunohe rebellion and in 1592 moved his seat to Morioka and built its castle. The Nanbu joined the eastern army at Sekigahara and ruled Morioka Domain, rated at 100,000 koku, through the Edo period, with cadet domains at Hachinohe and Shichinohe. The old grudge with the Tsugaru flared again in 1821, when a Morioka retainer plotted to ambush the Tsugaru lord in the Sōma Daisaku incident.
zh: 南部氏是东北地方的武士家族，自称出自甲斐国的清和源氏，与武田氏同族，家名来自其在甲斐南部的本领。始祖南部光行曾在石桥山之战投奔源赖朝，1189年攻灭平泉藤原氏后受封陆奥极东的广大糠部郡；他的六个儿子分守从一户到九户的坚固牧马城寨，靠供应战马积累财富。南北朝战乱中，南部师行随南朝大将北畠显家北上，修筑根城作为朝廷据点，家族本据就此由甲斐移到陆奥，而另一支南部则效力于北朝，两支直到1393年才和解。到第二十四代当主南部晴政时，南部氏领有陆奥北部七郡，但权力分散在互相竞争的分家手中。家臣大浦氏趁虚而入：大浦为信于1572年起兵，夺取津轻地方，1590年得到丰臣秀吉承认，改姓津轻，从此成为南部累世的仇敌。与此同时，南部信直于1590年在小田原归顺秀吉，被承认为一族总领，平定九户政实之乱，1592年把本据迁到盛冈并修筑盛冈城。关原之战中南部加入东军，江户时代领有表高十万石的盛冈藩，另立八户、七户两个支藩；与津轻的旧怨又在1821年的相马大作事件中再度爆发。

en: The Narayan rulers were the middle royal line of the Kamata kingdom, the state born when Raja Sandhya moved his capital west from Kamarupanagara to Kamatapur after 1257. The line began when the minister Pratapdhvaj usurped the throne; on his death his cousin Dharma Narayan seized power, until Pratapdhvaj's son Durlabh Narayan forced a partition that left him Kamatapur with Kamrup, Goalpara, Jalpaiguri and Koch Bihar. Durlabh Narayan kept a literary court, patronising the poets Hema Saraswati and Harivara Vipra, whose works, including Hema's Prahlada Charita, count among the earliest written Assamese poems. His successor Indra Narayan was weakened by the invasion of Sikandar Shah of Bengal between 1357 and 1390, after which a local Baro-Bhuyan chieftain, Arimatta, usurped the kingdom, ending this line.
zh: 纳拉扬诸王是迦摩多王国的中间一脉；迦摩多源于1257年之后罗阇桑迪亚把都城从迦摩缕波那揭罗西迁到迦摩多城。这一脉始于大臣普拉塔普德瓦杰篡位，他死后堂弟达尔马·纳拉扬夺权，普拉塔普德瓦杰之子杜尔拉布·纳拉扬起兵相争，最终达成分割：杜尔拉布·纳拉扬保有迦摩多城以及迦摩缕波、戈阿尔帕拉、杰尔拜古里和库奇比哈尔。他的宫廷崇尚文治，庇护诗人赫马·萨拉斯瓦蒂和哈里瓦拉·维普拉；赫马的《普拉拉德传》等作品是已知最早的阿萨姆语诗篇之一。继位的因陀罗·纳拉扬在1357年至1390年间遭孟加拉苏丹锡坎达尔沙入侵而衰弱，随后当地巴罗—布延首领阿里马塔篡位，这一脉终结。

en: The Naservand were a local Gilaki clan who ruled Lahijan and the eastern Gilan region of Bia-pish before the rise of the Kar-Kiya sayyids. Their name points to a link, real or claimed, with the Zaydi imam Nasir al-Din al-Atrush, who died in 917 and brought Zaydi Shi'ism to Bia-pish; the family grew out of the Kutam clans of the Ranikuh district. A Jamal al-Din Shluk Naservand held Lahijan under the Ilkhan Hulagu, and under Öljaitü the house split into two branches, with Nupasha Naservand ruling Lahijan. Nupasha's resistance to the Ilkhanid Gilan campaign of 1306 failed, but he submitted and kept his lands as a tributary; after the Mongols sacked the town it was rebuilt around 1328. The Naservand still held Lahijan in 1337, until the Zaydi sayyid Ali Kiya conquered Bia-pish from 1367 and founded the Kar-Kiya dynasty. The last Naservand resistance was broken by 1390, when Sayyid Hadi Kiya became master of the whole region.
zh: 纳塞尔万德是吉兰本地的吉拉克氏族，在卡尔基亚赛义德家族兴起之前统治拉希詹和吉兰东部的比亚皮什。其族名与917年去世的栽德派伊玛目纳绥尔丁·阿特鲁什有真实或自称的渊源——正是他把栽德派什叶教带到比亚皮什；该家族出自拉尼库赫地区的库塔姆诸氏族。伊儿汗旭烈兀时代，贾马勒丁·什卢克·纳塞尔万德已在拉希詹执政；完者都时代家族分为两支，努帕沙·纳塞尔万德领有拉希詹。1306年他抵抗伊儿汗国的吉兰之役失败，随后称臣纳贡、保住领地；城镇遭蒙古人洗劫后，约于1328年重建。1337年纳塞尔万德仍据有拉希詹，直到栽德派赛义德·阿里·基亚自1367年起征服比亚皮什、建立卡尔基亚王朝。1390年赛义德·哈迪·基亚成为整个地区的主人，纳塞尔万德最后的抵抗也告失败。

en: The Nasrids, in Arabic Banu Nasr or Banu al-Ahmar, were the last Muslim dynasty to rule in the Iberian Peninsula. They claimed descent from the Arab Banu Khazraj tribe and rose from the military leadership of Ibn Hud's Andalusi forces: Muhammad I Ibn al-Ahmar, born at Arjona, made himself emir in 1232, entered Granada in 1238 and founded the Emirate of Granada as a tributary state of Castile, ruling over Granada, Almería and Málaga. For two and a half centuries the dynasty balanced between the Castilian crown and the Marinids of Fez, paying tribute while playing its neighbours against one another. In 1337 the throne belonged to Yusuf I, who in 1340 joined the Marinid invasion broken at the battle of Río Salado and saw Algeciras fall to Alfonso XI. The fourteenth century, above all the long second reign of Muhammad V, was Granada's golden age: the city became a refuge of Islamic learning and craftsmanship, and the Alhambra palace complex, begun under the first sultans, was raised into its enduring form. From the early fifteenth century dynastic coups multiplied, weakening the emirate just as Castile and Aragon united under the Catholic Monarchs. The decade-long Granada War ended when the last sultan, Muhammad XII, called Boabdil, surrendered the city in January 1492, closing more than seven centuries of Muslim rule in al-Andalus.
zh: 奈斯尔家族（阿拉伯语称巴努·奈斯尔或巴努·艾哈迈尔）是伊比利亚半岛最后一个穆斯林统治王朝，自称源自阿拉伯的哈兹拉吉部落。家族崛起于安达卢斯首领伊本·胡德的军中：出生在阿尔霍纳的穆罕默德一世·伊本·艾哈迈尔于1232年自立为埃米尔，1238年入主格拉纳达，建立了向卡斯蒂利亚纳贡称臣的格拉纳达埃米尔国，领有格拉纳达、阿尔梅里亚和马拉加。此后两个半世纪里，王朝在卡斯蒂利亚王权与非斯的马林王朝之间走钢丝，一面纳贡，一面让邻邦互相牵制。1337年在位的是优素福一世，他在1340年联合马林王朝入侵，却在萨拉多河之战中被击溃，阿尔赫西拉斯也落入阿方索十一世之手。14世纪是格拉纳达的黄金时代，尤其是穆罕默德五世漫长的第二次在位期间：整座城市成为伊斯兰学术和工艺的庇护所，从初代苏丹动工的阿尔罕布拉宫也在此时建成今日的规模。15世纪初起，宫廷政变层出不穷，埃米尔国日渐衰弱，而卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡恰在天主教双王治下联合起来。长达十年的格拉纳达战争最终以末代苏丹穆罕默德十二世（博阿夫迪尔）于1492年1月献城告终，安达卢斯七百余年的穆斯林统治就此落幕。

en: The House of Nassau took its name from Nassau Castle on the Lahn, after the lordship of Laurenburg, held by the founder Count Dudo around 1100, was moved there in 1159. As Franconia fragmented after the fall of the Hohenstaufen, the lords of Nassau emerged as imperial counts answerable only to the emperor. Count Henry the Rich, who died in 1251, left two sons whose partition of 1255 created the dynasty's two great lines: the elder Walramian branch around Wiesbaden and Idstein, and the younger Ottonian branch around Siegen and Dillenburg. Repeated subdivisions later scattered the family over Nassau-Hadamar, Nassau-Weilburg and many other tiny counties. The Walramian line produced Adolf of Nassau, elected King of the Romans in 1292 and killed in battle at Göllheim in 1298. The Ottonian line grew far greater in the west: in 1544 William the Silent inherited the principality of Orange and led the Dutch revolt against Spain, and his descendants served as hereditary stadtholders of the Dutch Republic, with William III of Orange mounting the English and Scottish thrones in 1689. In 1815 the Orange-Nassau line gained the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, while the Walramian branch united the ancestral lands into the Duchy of Nassau with its capital at Wiesbaden.
zh: 拿骚家族得名于兰河畔的拿骚城堡：创始人杜多伯爵在1100年前后领有劳伦堡领地，1159年家族统治中心迁至拿骚堡。霍亨斯陶芬王朝覆灭后弗兰肯瓦解，拿骚领主崛起为只对皇帝负责的帝国伯爵。1251年去世的“富人”亨利伯爵留下两个儿子，他们于1255年分家，形成家族的两大支系：以威斯巴登和伊德施泰因为中心的长支瓦尔拉姆系，以及以锡根和迪伦堡为中心的幼支奥托系。此后领地一再分割，家族散布在拿骚-哈达马尔、拿骚-威尔堡等众多小伯国中。瓦尔拉姆系出了1292年当选罗马人的国王、1298年在格尔海姆战死的拿骚的阿道夫。奥托系则在西方成就更大：1544年“沉默者”威廉继承奥兰治亲王之位，领导荷兰反抗西班牙的起义，其后代世袭荷兰共和国执政，奥兰治的威廉三世更于1689年登上英格兰和苏格兰王位。1815年，奥兰治-拿骚系获得尼德兰王国和卢森堡大公国，瓦尔拉姆系则把祖传领地合并为以威斯巴登为首都的拿骚公国。

en: The Nasu were a warrior clan of Nasu District in northeastern Shimotsuke, who claimed descent from the Hokke, or northern house, of the Fujiwara and were earlier known as the Sudō before taking the name Nasu. They are most famous for Nasu no Yoichi, the archer in Minamoto no Yoshitsune's army who, at the Battle of Yashima in 1185, shot from the shore a fan set up on a Taira ship, an exploit told in the Heike Monogatari. After the Kamakura shogunate was founded the Nasu became gokenin, and in the Muromachi period they reached their height, ranking with the Yūki and Satake as one of the eight great houses of the Kantō. Early in the fifteenth century the clan split into Upper and Lower Nasu houses, which leaned on the Muromachi shogunate and the Kamakura kubo, later the Koga kubo, respectively during their long rivalry; in 1514 the Upper house fell to internal strife and Nasu Sukefusa of the Lower house reunited the clan, only to spend the following decades fighting the Utsunomiya and Satake. In 1590 the Nasu arrived late for Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign and lost their lands, though a plea by the retainer Ōtawara Harukiyo secured the heir five thousand koku. They joined the eastern army at Sekigahara and became daimyō of Nasu Domain under the Tokugawa and were later moved to Karasuyama; the Karasuyama disturbance, a succession quarrel over an adopted heir, brought attainder in 1687, after which the house continued only as a 1,000-koku kōtai-yoriai family.
zh: 那须氏是以下野国那须郡为本贯的武家，自称藤原北家后裔，早先称须藤氏，后来才改姓那须。一族最知名的人物是那须与一：1185年屋岛之战中，他在源义经军中从岸上一箭射落平氏战船上竖起的扇子，这段事迹载于《平家物语》。镰仓幕府成立后，那须氏成为御家人；室町时代达到鼎盛，与结城氏、佐竹氏并称关东八屋形。15世纪初，一族分裂为上那须氏与下那须氏，两家分别倚仗室町幕府和镰仓公方（后来的古河公方）长期争战。1514年上那须氏在内讧中灭亡，下那须的那须资房重新统一一族，此后却陷入与宇都宫氏、佐竹氏的连年对抗。1590年，那须氏在丰臣秀吉的小田原征伐中迟参，领地被没收，经家臣大田原晴清谢罪，才为继承人争取到五千石，勉强免于改易。关原之战中他们加入东军，江户时代成为那须藩大名，后来转封乌山藩；1687年因养子引发的御家骚动乌山骚动被改易，此后仅以一千石的交代寄合身份延续家名。

en: The Nasurid were the local ruling family of Murzuk, an oasis town of the Fezzan south of Tripoli on the Saharan caravan routes. Around 1300 the region was held by Arab Banu Sulaym tribes, and after a Moroccan tribal takeover in 1310 Murzuk became the seat of a small desert sultanate.
zh: 纳苏尔家族是费赞绿洲城镇迈尔祖格的地方统治家族，该镇坐落在的黎波里以南的撒哈拉商路上。1300年前后，费赞由阿拉伯巴努·苏莱姆诸部控制；1310年一支摩洛哥部落夺据迈尔祖格，以此为都建立沙漠小苏丹国。

en: The Nawa were a provincial warrior family of Hōki Province in western Honshu, whose power rested on the Nawa manor along the Sea of Japan coast. Their best-known member, Nawa Nagatoshi, answered Emperor Go-Daigo's call against the Kamakura shogunate in 1333: when the exiled emperor escaped from the Oki Islands, Nagatoshi sheltered him and raised troops in his support at Mount Senjō, and was rewarded with the governorship of Hōki after the shogunate fell. He remained a Southern Court loyalist in the wars that followed, and in August 1336 he was killed leading an attack on the Tō-ji temple in Kyoto, where Ashikaga Takauji had installed the rival Emperor Kōmyō. After Nagatoshi's death his descendants lost their Hōki footing and drifted west to Higo Province in Kyushu, settling first in Yatsushiro district and later in Uto, where in the Edo period they served the Tachibana lords of the Yanagawa domain as retainers.
zh: 名和氏是本州西部伯耆国的地方武士豪族，势力根基在日本海沿岸的名和庄。家族最知名的人物名和长年于1333年响应后醍醐天皇讨伐镰仓幕府的号召：天皇从隐岐岛逃出后，他在船上山迎驾并举兵勤王，幕府灭亡后受封伯耆守。此后他始终忠于南朝，1336年8月在京都率军攻打足利尊氏拥立光明天皇的东寺时战死。长年死后，其后人失去在伯耆的根基，辗转西迁至九州的肥后国，先落脚八代郡，后移往宇土郡；江户时代他们作为家臣侍奉柳川藩的立花氏。

en: The Ndiaye, or Njaay, dynasty was the ruling house of Jolof, founded in Wolof and Serer oral tradition by the legendary Ndiadiane Ndiaye. The epic makes him a man of Futa Toro who, after his mother remarried, wandered down the Senegal River to Waalo, where the village elders, the lamanes, chose him as their ruler for the fairness of his judgements. After sixteen years in Waalo he is said to have united, mostly by consent, the Wolof-speaking lands between the Senegal and Gambia rivers into the Jolof Empire, an early vassal of Mali that emerged as an independent power in the second half of the fourteenth century. Historians generally place his floruit around 1300, and the Rao archaeological site near his legendary first capital dates to between 1300 and 1350. Ndiadiane was succeeded by his son Sare Ndiadiane, and his descendants, bearing the title buurba, kept the Jolof throne until the empire's collapse after the battle of Danki in 1549, when the vassal states broke away and Jolof lived on as a smaller kingdom under the same dynasty.
zh: 恩迪亚耶（又译恩贾伊）王朝是乔洛夫的统治家族，据沃洛夫和谢列尔人的口传传统，由传奇人物恩贾贾恩·恩迪亚耶创立。史诗称他出身富塔托罗，在母亲再婚后沿塞内加尔河辗转来到瓦洛，当地的长老“拉曼”们因他断事公正而推举他为首领。据说他在瓦洛统治十六年后，以和平会盟为主，把塞内加尔河与冈比亚河之间讲沃洛夫语的各邦统一为乔洛夫帝国；该帝国早年是马里的附庸，14世纪下半叶成为独立强权。后世学者一般把他的活跃年代定在1300年前后，传说中他首个都城附近的拉奥遗址的考古年代为1300年至1350年。恩贾贾恩之后由其子萨尔·恩迪亚耶继位，他的后代以“布尔巴”为号保有乔洛夫王位，直到1549年丹基战役后帝国解体——各附庸邦纷纷独立，乔洛夫降为一个较小的王国，但仍由同一家族统治。

en: The Nemanjić were the foremost royal house of medieval Serbia, producing twelve monarchs between 1166 and 1371. Its founder, Stefan Nemanja, ruled as Grand Prince of Raška from 1166, expanded the state and fought Byzantium, then abdicated in 1196 to end his life as the monk Simeon on Mount Athos, where he and his son Saint Sava restored the Hilandar monastery. Sava secured an autocephalous Serbian Orthodox Church in 1219 and issued the Nomocanon, Serbia's first written law code, while Nemanja's son Stefan was crowned the first king of Serbia in 1217. Later rulers such as Stephen Milutin and Stephen Dečanski, victor over Bulgaria at Velbazhd in 1330, kept enlarging the realm. The peak came under Stephen Dušan, who was crowned Emperor of the Serbs and Greeks in 1346, raised the Serbian Church to a patriarchate and issued Dušan's Code, making Serbia the strongest power in the Balkans. Dušan died in 1355, and when his son Uroš the Weak died childless in 1371 the empire broke into rival lordships; the last Nemanjić prince, John Uroš of Thessaly, died around 1423, and the family's blood survived only through female lines.
zh: 内马尼奇王朝是中世纪塞尔维亚最显赫的王室，在1166年至1371年间出了十二位君主。开创者斯特凡·尼曼雅自1166年起任拉什卡大茹潘，扩张国力、与拜占庭交战，1196年退位，以修士西梅翁之名在阿索斯山终老，并在那里与儿子圣萨瓦一同重修希兰达尔修道院。萨瓦于1219年促成塞尔维亚东正教会自主，还颁布了塞尔维亚第一部成文法典《教会法汇编》；尼曼雅之子斯特凡则于1217年加冕为第一代塞尔维亚国王。此后的斯特凡·米卢廷、以及1330年在维尔巴日德击败保加利亚的斯特凡·德昌斯基等君主继续扩张疆土。王朝在斯特凡·杜尚治下达到顶峰：他于1346年加冕为塞尔维亚人与希腊人的皇帝，将塞尔维亚教会提升为牧首区，并颁布《杜尚法典》，使塞尔维亚成为巴尔干最强的国家。杜尚死于1355年，其子“弱者”乌罗什于1371年无嗣而终，帝国随即分裂为相互争战的贵族领地；内马尼奇家族最后一位王公、色萨利的约翰·乌罗什约于1423年去世，家族血脉只通过女性后裔延续下去。

en: The Neu-Kyburg, also called Kyburg-Burgdorf or Habsburg-Neukyburg, were a Swiss comital house that flourished from about 1273 to 1417 with its main estates in the Oberaargau. When the male line of the old counts of Kyburg died out in 1264, Count Rudolf of Habsburg, whose mother Heilwig was a Kyburg princess, took guardianship of the underage heiress Anna. In 1273 Anna married Eberhard I of Habsburg-Laufenburg, a cousin of the by then King Rudolf, and part of the old Kyburg inheritance became the new county of Neu-Kyburg, centred on Burgdorf, Wangen an der Aare, Landshut and Thun. The family soon went its own way: with the Habsburg-Laufenburg line it was implicated in the murder of King Albert I in 1308, and from 1313 its counts held the Habsburg fief of the Landgraviate of Burgundy. Caught between the rising city of Bern, the Swiss Confederation, Savoy and Austria, the Neu-Kyburg were chronically short of money and steadily sold or pledged rights and towns; Eberhard II even murdered his brother Hartmann II at Thun to seize the inheritance. Count Rudolf II's failed raid on Solothurn in 1382 sparked the Burgdorf War of 1383 to 1384, after which Bern bought Thun and Burgdorf, the dynasty's chief towns. The last lordships passed to Bern and Solothurn early in the fifteenth century, and the house became extinct on the death of the debt-ridden Count Berchtold at Bern in 1417.
zh: 新基堡伯爵家族又称基堡‑布格多夫或哈布斯堡‑新基堡，是1273年至1417年间活跃的瑞士贵族世家，主要产业在上阿尔高。旧基堡伯爵男系于1264年绝嗣后，母亲出自基堡家族的哈布斯堡伯爵鲁道夫（即后来的国王鲁道夫一世）成为年幼女继承人安娜的监护人。1273年，安娜嫁给国王的堂亲、哈布斯堡‑劳芬堡的埃伯哈德一世，旧基堡遗产的一部分由此组建成新的新基堡伯国，统治中心在布格多夫、阿尔河畔旺根、兰茨胡特和图恩。家族很快自行其是：它与哈布斯堡‑劳芬堡支系都卷入了1308年刺杀国王阿尔伯特一世的阴谋；从1313年起，伯爵们还以哈布斯堡封臣的身份领有勃艮第藩侯领。新基堡家族夹在崛起的伯尔尼城、瑞士邦联、萨伏依和奥地利之间，长期财政拮据，只能不断出售或抵押权利与城镇，埃伯哈德二世甚至在图恩亲下手刃兄长哈特曼二世以夺遗产。1382年伯爵鲁道夫二世袭击索洛图恩失败，引发1383至1384年的布格多夫战争，战后伯尔尼买下了图恩和布格多夫这两座家族首邑。15世纪初，剩余领地也先后落入伯尔尼和索洛图恩之手；1417年，负债累累的贝希托尔德伯爵在伯尔尼去世，家族绝嗣。

en: The House of Neuchâtel was the comital dynasty that ruled the county of the same name on the lake shore in present-day western Switzerland from the twelfth century to 1395. It probably sprang from the lords of Fenis: around 1034 the Emperor Conrad II enfeoffed Ulrich I of Fenis with the Neuchâtel lands, centred on the novum castellum, the new castle above the town that gave the dynasty its name. Its sons founded several lines, including the counts of Nidau, Strassberg and Aarberg and the lords of Valangin. In April 1214 Ulrich III and his nephew Berthold granted the town of Neuchâtel its charter of franchises, modelled on the customs of Besançon, and after the Zähringen dukes died out in 1218 the county became immediately subject to the Empire. The counts entered alliances with Fribourg in 1290 and Bern in 1308, tying their small state to the growing Swiss Confederation. Count Rudolf IV ruled from 1288 to 1343 and was followed by his son Louis I, who died in 1373. The last of the line, Countess Elisabeth, died childless in 1395 and bequeathed the county to her nephew Conrad IV of Freiburg, ending the native dynasty's rule.
zh: 纳沙泰尔家族是12世纪至1395年间统治今瑞士西部同名伯国的伯爵王朝，很可能出自费尼领主家族：约1034年，皇帝康拉德二世把纳沙泰尔一带封给费尼的乌尔里希一世，其统治中心是俯瞰城镇的“新城堡”，家族也由此得名。家族子弟开创了尼道伯爵、施特拉斯堡伯爵、阿尔贝格伯爵和瓦朗然领主等多个支系。1214年4月，乌尔里希三世与侄子贝托尔德仿效贝桑松习惯法，向纳沙泰尔城颁布特许状；1218年策林根公爵绝嗣后，伯国改为直属于帝国。伯爵们先后于1290年与弗里堡、1308年与伯尔尼结盟，把这个小邦与日益壮大的瑞士邦联联系在一起。鲁道夫四世伯爵在位时间为1288至1343年，其子路易一世继立，1373年去世。末代伯爵伊莎贝拉无嗣而终，1395年在遗嘱中把伯国传给外甥弗赖堡的康拉德四世，本土家族的统治至此结束。

en: The Nevilles are rare survivors of the native Anglo-Saxon aristocracy: their male line, the FitzMaldreds, kept their lands in County Durham after the Norman Conquest, and the marriage of Robert FitzMaldred to the heiress Isabel de Neville brought her Norman surname and estates such as Brancepeth and Middleham, with Raby Castle in Durham as the family seat. Ralph Neville was summoned to parliament as Baron Neville de Raby in 1295, beginning a house that rivalled the Percys for power in northern England. His son Ralph (c. 1291-1367), Warden of the Marches from 1334, crushed a Scottish invasion at the Battle of Neville's Cross outside Durham in 1346 and captured King David II. In 1397 the family was raised to the earldom of Westmorland; the first earl's children included Cecily Neville, mother of Edward IV and Richard III, and Richard, Earl of Salisbury, whose son Richard Neville became Earl of Warwick, the Kingmaker, until his death at Barnet in 1471. The Nevilles were central to the Wars of the Roses, though their northern dominance waned under the Tudors. When Charles Neville, sixth Earl of Westmorland, led the failed Rising of the Northern Earls in 1569 in favour of Mary, Queen of Scots, he was attainted and died exiled in 1601, extinguishing the senior line; the Bergavenny branch carried the name onward and the Westmorland earldom was later recreated for their Fane descendants.
zh: 内维尔家族是本土盎格鲁-撒克逊贵族中罕见的幸存者：其男系菲茨马尔德雷德一支在诺曼征服后仍保有达勒姆郡的土地，罗伯特·菲茨马尔德雷德娶了女继承人伊莎贝尔·德·内维尔，遂改用她的诺曼姓氏，并得到布兰斯佩思、米德勒姆等地产，以达勒姆的拉比城堡为家族宅邸。1295年，拉尔夫·内维尔受召入议会，成为拉比的内维尔男爵，这个家族从此与珀西家族并称英格兰北部两大强权。其子拉尔夫（约1291—1367）自1334年起任边境镇守长官，1346年在达勒姆城外的内维尔十字战役击溃苏格兰入侵军，并俘获苏格兰国王大卫二世。1397年家族晋封威斯特摩兰伯爵；第一代伯爵的子女包括爱德华四世与理查三世之母塞西莉·内维尔，以及索尔兹伯里伯爵理查德，后者之子理查德·内维尔即沃里克伯爵、绰号“拥立国王者”，1471年战死于巴尼特。内维尔家族深度卷入玫瑰战争，但在都铎王朝治下北方权势渐衰。第六代威斯特摩兰伯爵查尔斯于1569年发动拥戴苏格兰女王玛丽的“北方伯爵起事”，失败后被定罪，1601年死于流亡，主支就此断绝；伯加文尼旁支延续了家族姓氏，威斯特摩兰伯爵头衔后来则由其费恩后裔重新受封。

en: The Niiro were a cadet house of the Shimazu in Hyūga Province. The line began when Tokihisa, fourth son of Tadamune, the fourth head of the main Shimazu house, was made steward of the Niiro estate in Koyu district and took up Takajō Castle, calling himself Niiro after the holding. His successors held a string of castles in southern Hyūga, including Matsuo and Shibushi, and were posted at Obi to guard against the Itō clan, but feuds with neighboring Shimazu branches and local lords cost them Shibushi and drove the main line into exile at Sadowara. A cadet branch fared far better: Niiro Tadamoto, born in 1526, became one of the most celebrated generals of Shimazu Takahisa and Yoshihisa, fighting in the conquest of Kyūshū, including the victory of Okita Nawate in 1584, and standing beside Shimazu Yoshihiro at Sekigahara in 1600. Under the Satsuma domain of the Edo period, the Niiro houses continued as ranked retainers, some holding senior posts such as karō.
zh: 新纳氏是岛津氏在日向国的分家。初代新纳时久本是岛津宗家第四代当主忠宗的第四子，被任为日向儿汤郡新纳院的地头，入主高城，便以领地为姓，称新纳氏。其后人据有松尾城、志布志城等日向南部诸城，还曾被移封饫肥以防备伊东氏，但因与岛津其他分家及周边豪族争斗而丢失志布志，嫡流一度亡命佐土原。庶流则显赫得多：新纳忠元生于1526年，是岛津贵久、义久两代麾下名将，参加了平定九州的诸多战役，包括1584年的冲田畷大捷，1600年又随岛津义弘出征关原。进入江户时代，新纳各家作为萨摩藩的有格藩士延续下来，其中有人还担任家老等要职。

en: The Nikaido were a bureaucratic warrior house of the Kamakura and Muromachi shogunates, of Fujiwara descent through the Kudo clan of the Fujiwara southern house. Their founder Kudo Yukimasa served Minamoto no Yoritomo as a civil official and, from his Kamakura mansion beside the two-story hall of Eifuku-ji built in 1192, took the name Nikaido. His son Yukimitsu became shitsuji, chief administrator of the shogunate's Mandokoro, and the house made the post its own; through marriage it became the maternal grandfather's house of the seventh regent Hojo Masamura, reaching its zenith in the mid-thirteenth century. The clan split into the Shinano and Oki lines, which staffed the highest secretariats of the Kamakura, Kenmu and Muromachi regimes and spawned branches across Japan, though several were purged in the Shimotsuki incident of 1285 and the Kenmu purges after 1333. In Kyoto the Muromachi Nikaido held the Mandokoro shitsuji office into the sixteenth century, while the most famous martial branch began around 1444, when Tameuji moved from Kamakura to Sukagawa in southern Mutsu, destroyed the deputy who defied him, took Sukagawa Castle and made himself a Sengoku daimyo. The Sukagawa Nikaido were drawn into the Date civil war of 1542 and long pressed by the Ashina; their last castle fell to Date Masamune in 1589, after the dowager Anan no Kata, Masamune's aunt, had refused every summons to surrender. Another branch, settled in Satsuma after the Shimotsuki incident, became retainers of the Shimazu.
zh: 二阶堂氏是镰仓、室町幕府的官僚武家，本姓藤原，出自藤原南家工藤氏。其祖工藤行政以文官身份侍奉源赖朝，1192年因其镰仓宅邸紧邻建有两层佛堂的永福寺而以“二阶堂”为苗字。其子行光出任镰仓幕府政所执事，此后该职几乎由二阶堂氏世袭；通过联姻，它还成为第七代执权北条政村的外祖父家，在13世纪中叶权势达到顶峰。一族分成信浓流与隐岐流，在镰仓、建武、室町三个政权的核心文书机构任职，庶流遍布日本，但也有多个分支在1285年霜月骚动和1333年后的建武整肃中被清洗。在京都，室町的二阶堂氏担任政所执事直至16世纪；而最著名的武家分支始于1444年前后：为氏从镰仓南下陆奥须贺川，讨灭不从的代官、入主须贺川城，成为战国大名。须贺川二阶堂氏被卷入1542年伊达天文之乱，又长期受芦名氏压迫；1589年须贺川城被伊达政宗攻陷，此前当主遗孀、政宗的伯母阿南之方屡次拒绝投降。另有一支在霜月骚动后定居萨摩，成为岛津氏的家臣。

en: The Nikruzi take their name from the Ilkhanid emir Nikruz, whose sons Sultanshah and Qutb al-Din Jahanshah, styled of Kerman, served in the wars over the collapsing Ilkhanate; Sultanshah defected from Arpa Ke'un at the Battle of Jaghatu in 1336 to the Oirat kingmaker Ali Padshah, and the game places the house at Kerman.
zh: 尼克鲁齐家族得名于伊儿汗国异密尼克鲁兹，他的儿子苏丹沙与号称“克尔曼人”的库特卜丁·贾汉沙在伊儿汗国崩溃时的混战中领兵：1336年苏丹沙在贾加图之战中背弃阿尔巴汗，转投卫拉特权臣阿里·帕迪沙，游戏将该家族置于克尔曼。

en: The Nimi line was the ruling house of Vungu, also called Bungu, a kingdom in the Mayombe forest north of the Congo River, in the borderlands of the modern Republic of the Congo and Democratic Republic of the Congo. In the thirteenth century Vungu led a confederation that also included Ngoyo and Kakongo, and Kongo court tradition remembered it as the homeland from which the first kings of Kongo came. Nimi a Nzima ruled the domain of Mpemba Kasi, and his son Lukeni lua Nimi, born around 1380, crossed the Congo River, displaced the local chief Mwene Kabunga and founded Mbanza Kongo, taking the title Ntinu and becoming the first king of the Kingdom of Kongo. Vungu itself first appears in writing in a letter of the Kongo king Afonso I in 1535, and in the 1620s it was occupied by the Jaga after they were driven out of Kongo and allied with Loango.
zh: 尼米家族是温古（又译本古）的统治王朝，温古是刚果河以北马永贝森林中的王国，地处今刚果共和国与刚果民主共和国交界一带。13世纪时，温古统领着一个还包括恩戈约和卡孔戈的联盟，刚果宫廷传统把它视为刚果开国诸王的故乡。尼米·阿·恩齐马统治着姆潘巴·卡西领地，他的儿子卢凯尼·卢阿·尼米约生于1380年，后来渡过刚果河，逐走当地首领姆韦内·卡本加，建立姆班扎刚果，自称“恩蒂努”，成为刚果王国的第一代国王。温古本身最早见于1535年刚果国王阿方索一世的一封信；17世纪20年代，雅加人被逐出刚果后与卢安戈结盟，占领了温古。

en: The Nitsuki, also read Niki, were a Seiwa Genji family of the Ashikaga line: in the Kamakura period Sanekuni, a great-grandson of Ashikaga Yoshiyasu, settled at Nitsuki in Nukata District of Mikawa Province and called himself Nitsuki Taro, while his younger brother Yoshisue took the neighbouring Hosokawa estate and founded the Hosokawa clan. Both became hereditary retainers of the Ashikaga main line, and the Nitsuki's chance came when Ashikaga Takauji built his shogunate. The brothers Yoriaki and Yoshinaga fought across the country for him, heading the Samurai Dokoro and collecting provincial constableships: Yoriaki succeeded the disgraced Ko no Moronao as Takauji's steward from 1351 until the shogun's death in 1358, and between them the brothers at one time governed as many as nine provinces, including Tamba, Musashi, Ise, Iga and Mikawa. Their eminence was short-lived. Yoshinaga's high-handed rule set him against fellow generals such as Hosokawa Kiyouji and Hatakeyama Kunikiyo, and after his fall the provinces slipped away, the last, Tajima, passing to the Yamana in 1372. Under Ashikaga Yoshimitsu the family still held Ise and Izumi, but the Onin War of 1467 to 1477 split it into Tamba, Ise and Iga branches fighting on opposite sides, and it never recovered. The Iga branch was eventually driven out by the province's warrior league, the Iga Sokoku Ikki, while lesser lines survived into the Edo period as retainers of the Tokugawa and the Mori.
zh: 仁木氏是清和源氏足利流的武家：镰仓时代，足利义康的曾孙实国迁居三河国额田郡仁木乡，自称仁木太郎；其弟义季领有相邻的细川乡，成为细川氏之祖。两家同为足利嫡流的谱代被官，仁木氏的发迹则在足利尊氏创立室町幕府之际。赖章、义长兄弟为尊氏转战各地，出任侍所头人并兼任多国守护：1351年赖章接替失势的高师直担任尊氏的执事，直到1358年尊氏去世；兄弟俩最盛时同时领有丹波、武藏、伊势、伊贺、三河等九国守护之职。不过荣华短暂，义长因专横与细川清氏、畠山国清等将领对立而失势，领国接连丧失，1372年最后一国但马也落入山名氏之手。足利义满时代仁木家还保有伊势、和泉守护之职，但1467至1477年的应仁之乱使其分裂为丹波、伊势、伊贺三家，甚至各投一方，家势就此一蹶不振。伊贺仁木氏最终被当地的国人联合体伊贺惣国一揆驱逐，其余旁系则在江户时代以德川家、毛利家家臣的身份延续下去。

en: The Nitta were a Seiwa Genji house of Kozuke Province, present-day Gunma, taking their name from the Nitta manor held by their ancestor Minamoto no Yoshishige (1135—1202); Yoshishige was the elder brother of Minamoto no Yoshiyasu, ancestor of the rival Ashikaga, and backed Minamoto no Yoritomo at the Battle of Ishibashiyama in 1180. Because the family sat out much of the Genpei War, it held only provincial weight under the Kamakura shogunate. Its great moment came under Nitta Yoshisada (1301—1338), who answered Emperor Go-Daigo's call against the Hojo: in June 1333 he marched on Kamakura and stormed it, driving the last Hojo regent Takatoki to suicide and ending the Kamakura shogunate. During the Kenmu Restoration he became the Ashikaga brothers' chief rival, but defeat at the Minatogawa in 1336 forced him into the Hokuriku with two imperial princes; the siege of Kanegasaki in 1337 cost the lives of his son Yoshiaki and the princes, and Yoshisada himself fell at Kuromaru in 1338, traditionally cutting his own throat when trapped under his dead horse. His remaining sons, including Yoshioki, fought on for the Southern Court alongside the Date, and although the Ashikaga destroyed the main Nitta line, the Tokugawa shoguns later claimed Nitta ancestry through a branch that had settled at Tokugawa, a genealogy most historians doubt.
zh: 新田氏是上野国（今群马）的清和源氏家族，以祖先源义重（1135—1202）所领的新田庄为姓；义重是宿敌足利氏祖先源义康之兄，1180年曾在石桥山之战中支持源赖朝。由于该族在源平合战中大多置身事外，镰仓幕府时期仅为地方豪族。其鼎盛时刻属于新田义贞（1301—1338）：他响应后醍醐天皇讨伐北条的号召，于1333年6月进军镰仓并破城，迫使末代执权北条高时自杀，镰仓幕府就此灭亡。建武新政期间，他成为足利兄弟的主要对手，但1336年凑川之战兵败后，携两位亲王退守北陆；1337年金崎城陷落，其子义显与两位亲王丧生，义贞本人也于1338年在黑丸之战中阵亡，相传他被死马压身时自行了断。余下诸子（如义兴）联合伊达氏继续为南朝奋战；嫡系虽被足利氏翦除，后来的德川将军却自称出自定居德川之地的新田支流，这一世系多被史家视为附会。

en: The Nogarola were an aristocratic family of Verona, named for their estates at Nogarole Rocca, who served the ruling Scaliger dynasty as soldiers and diplomats. Its most prominent fourteenth-century member was Bailardino Nogarola, born around 1270, who was knighted in 1295 alongside the sons of Alberto I della Scala and became a trusted councillor of Cangrande I. He held the podesta's office in Mantua, Vicenza, Treviso and Padua, went as Scaliger ambassador to Emperor Henry VII in Milan in 1311, stood beside Cangrande when Padua was taken in 1328, and arranged the succession of Mastino II and Alberto II at Cangrande's death in 1329, before dying in 1340. In the fifteenth century the family turned to letters rather than arms: Leonardo Nogarola and his wife Bianca Borromeo gave their daughters a full humanist education, and Isotta Nogarola, born in 1418, became the first major female humanist of the Renaissance, famed for her Latin dialogue on the sin of Adam and Eve, while her aunt Angela Nogarola was a noted Latin poet and Ludovico Nogarola later won fame as a humanist man of letters.
zh: 诺加罗拉是维罗纳的贵族家族，得名于其在诺加罗莱罗卡的地产，世代以武将和外交官身份侍奉执政的斯卡利杰（德拉·斯卡拉）家族。家族在14世纪最显赫的成员是约1270年出生的拜拉尔迪诺·诺加罗拉：他于1295年与阿尔贝托一世·德拉·斯卡拉的儿子们一同受封骑士，成为坎格兰德一世信赖的谋臣，曾出任曼托瓦、维琴察、特雷维索和帕多瓦的行政长官，1311年作为斯卡利杰使节赴米兰觐见皇帝亨利七世，1328年坎格兰德夺取帕多时随侍在侧，又在1329年坎格兰德去世时安排马斯蒂诺二世与阿尔贝托二世继位，最终于1340年去世。15世纪，家族由武功转向文事：莱奥纳尔多·诺加罗拉与妻子比安卡·博罗梅奥让女儿们接受完整的人文主义教育，1418年出生的伊索塔·诺加罗拉因此成为文艺复兴时期第一位重要的女性人文主义者，以论述亚当与夏娃之罪的拉丁语对话闻名；她的姑母安杰拉·诺加罗拉是知名拉丁语诗人，后来的卢多维科·诺加罗拉也以人文学者著称。

en: The House of Noyers was a feudal dynasty of the Duchy of Burgundy, named after its stronghold of Noyers on the Serein near Tonnerre. A lord Miles of Noyers first appears as a witness to a charter of Duke Hugh I of Burgundy in 1077, and the family grew into one of the region's greater lordships, taking the viguerie of Chablis in 1151 and receiving homage for some eighty fiefs in 1224 while itself owing vassalage to no one. Two sons of the house reached high church office: Guy I was archbishop of Sens from 1176 and Hugh bishop of Auxerre from 1183. Its most famous member was Miles de Noyers, called the Great, born about 1271: he fought at Courtrai in 1302, was made Marshal of France in 1303, saved the royal oriflamme at Mons-en-Pevele in 1304, and served four kings as head of the treasury and president of the chamber of accounts, buying the county of Joigny for his son in 1338 and dying in 1350. The lordship had accepted the Burgundian duke's suzerainty back in 1295, and after the last male heir died in 1369 and his sister Jeanne in 1394, the scattered rights were sold to Duchess Margaret of Bavaria in 1419 and 1421.
zh: 努瓦耶家族是勃艮第公国的封建世家，得名于托内尔附近塞兰河畔的据点努瓦耶。1077年，一位名叫米隆·德·努瓦耶的领主首次在勃艮第公爵于格一世的特许状上以见证人身份出现；家族后来发展为当地最有权势的领主之一，1151年取得沙布利的地方司法权，1224年接受约八十个小封地的效忠，而自身不向任何人承担封臣义务。家族中有两人位登教会高位：居伊一世于1176年出任桑斯大主教，于格则于1183年任欧塞尔主教。最著名的成员是约1271年出生、人称“大人物”的米隆·德·努瓦耶：他参加1302年的科特赖克战役，1303年被任命为法兰西元帅，1304年在蒙斯昂佩韦勒战役中护住了法兰西王旗金焰旗；他历事四任国王，掌管财政、主掌审计院，1338年为儿子购得茹瓦尼伯国，1350年去世。早在1295年，努瓦耶领地已承认勃艮第公爵的宗主权；最后一位男嗣于1369年去世、其姐让娜于1394年死后，被瓜分的领有权在1419至1421年间卖给了公爵夫人巴伐利亚的玛格丽特。

en: The Nsaku were the ruling line of Mbata, a Bantu kingdom east of Mpemba Kasi along the Kwango River, whose founding ancestor is remembered as Nsaku Ne Vunda. Around 1375 its chief Nsaku-Lau gave his daughter Lukeni Lua Sange in marriage to Nimi a Nzima of Mpemba Kasi; their son Lukeni lua Nimi became the first king of Kongo, and Mbata's army was decisive in the conquest of the plateau kingdom of Mwene Kabunga. Mbata thereby entered the Kingdom of Kongo as a kingdom within the kingdom: its ruler was not appointed by the Manikongo but succeeded by matrilineal descent from Lukeni Lua Sange, and Mbata princes traditionally led Kongo's diplomacy with neighboring states. After the Kongo court adopted Catholicism and Portuguese customs, Mbata was styled the Duchy of Bambata and kept its privileged standing under the crown of Mbanza Kongo.
zh: 恩萨库家族是姆巴塔的统治世系。姆巴塔是姆潘巴·卡西以东、宽果河沿岸的班图人王国，始祖传说为恩萨库·内·温达。约1375年，酋长恩萨库·劳把女儿卢凯尼·卢阿·桑格嫁给姆潘巴·卡西的尼米·阿·恩齐马；两人的儿子卢凯尼·卢阿·尼米后来成为刚果的第一代国王，而姆巴塔的军队在征服高原王国姆韦内·卡本加时起了决定性作用。姆巴塔由此以“国中之国”的地位加入刚果王国：其君主不由马尼刚果任命，而是按母系由卢凯尼·卢阿·桑格的后裔继承，姆巴塔的王公还按惯例主持刚果与邻国的外交。刚果宫廷接受天主教和葡萄牙习俗后，姆巴塔被称为班巴塔公国，在姆班扎刚果的王权之下保持着特权地位。

en: Bolan is the game's rendering of Ó Beólláin, the Gaelic family that supplied the medieval earls, or mormaers, of Ross. Tradition made them hereditary keepers of the old monastery of Applecross, and their first great figure was Fearchar mac an t-Sagairt, meaning son of the priest and anglicised as Farquhar MacTaggart. In 1215 he crushed a revolt in Moray and Ross for the young Alexander II and presented the rebel leaders' heads to the king, and in the 1220s he was rewarded with the mormaerdom of Ross, binding this remote northern province to the Scottish crown. His descendants ruled from Dingwall and Tain: Uilleam, or William, the second earl, supported the crown in the early independence wars, and Hugh, called Hugh Beolan in English records, was slain fighting for David II at the Battle of Halidon Hill in 1333. The last male earl, another William, died in 1372, leaving a daughter, Euphemia, whose marriage to Walter Leslie carried the earldom into the Leslie family; after further disputes Ross passed to the MacDonald lords of the Isles in the fifteenth century.
zh: 博兰是游戏对盖尔家族 Ó Beólláin（又拼奥贝兰、博兰）的转写，这个家族正是中世纪罗斯的莫尔马尔，即伯爵世系。相传他们世代掌管古老的阿普尔克罗斯修道院；家族第一位大人物是费查尔·麦克因塔加特，名字意为“神父之子”，英语作法夸尔·麦克塔加特。1215年，他替年轻的亚历山大二世平定了马里和罗斯的叛乱，把叛军首领的首级献给国王，13世纪20年代受封罗斯莫尔马尔，使这个偏远的北方省份归入苏格兰王权的轨道。其后代以丁沃尔和泰恩为中心进行统治：第二代伯爵乌莱亚姆，即威廉，在独立战争初期支持王室；英语文献中写作休·博兰的休伯爵1333年在哈利顿山战役中为大卫二世战死。最后一代男嗣威廉伯爵1372年去世，留下女儿尤菲米娅，她嫁给沃尔特·莱斯利，伯爵领随之转入莱斯利家族；此后几经争夺，罗斯在15世纪落入麦克唐纳家族的群岛领主之手。

en: The O'Briens, Irish Ó Briain, descend from Brian Boru of the Dál gCais, the Munster king who broke the Uí Néill hold on the high kingship, ruled all Ireland from 1002 and was killed winning the Battle of Clontarf against the Norsemen of Dublin and their Leinster allies in 1014. His kin took the name Ua Briain, supplied two further high kings and ruled Munster until the Treaty of Glanmire in 1118 split the province and left them the kingship of Thomond in what is now County Clare. The Norman invasion drove them beyond the Shannon, and in 1276 the Crown granted Thomond to Thomas de Clare; the de Clare bid ended in the defeat of the Battle of Dysert O'Dea in 1318, after which Thomond stayed independent for another two centuries. Succession ran by tanistry, the family electing its ablest royal kinsman, which fed long internal feuds. The last king, Murrough O'Brien, surrendered to Henry VIII and in 1543 was created Earl of Thomond and Baron Inchiquin; a later branch, the Viscounts Clare, followed James II into exile and was attainted in 1691, and the earldom itself was forfeited in 1741.
zh: 布莱恩家族的盖尔语名为 Ó Briain，英语化姓奥布莱恩，祖先是达尔盖斯部族的布赖恩·博鲁。他打破尼尔家族对爱尔兰最高王位的垄断，1002年成为全爱尔兰的至高王，1014年在克隆塔夫战役中击败都柏林诺斯人及其伦斯特盟军，本人却战死阵中。他的后裔以乌·布莱恩为姓，又出过两位至高王，并统治芒斯特；1118年的《格兰米尔条约》瓜分芒斯特后，他们只剩今克莱尔郡一带的托蒙德国王头衔。诺曼入侵把他们逼过香农河，1276年王室又把托蒙德封给托马斯·德·克莱尔，但德·克莱尔家族的征服在1318年迪瑟特奥代战役的惨败中终结，托蒙德由此再独立了两百年。其继承采用坦尼斯特制，由家族在王室近亲中推选最能干者，长期引发内部仇杀。末代国王默罗·奥布莱恩向亨利八世投降，1543年受封托蒙德伯爵兼英奇昆男爵；旁支克莱尔子爵家族后来随詹姆斯二世流亡，1691年被剥夺公权，伯爵爵位本身也于1741年被没收。

en: The O'Cahans (Irish Uí Chatháin, descendants of Cahan) were a powerful sept of the Cenél nEógain, the Northern Uí Néill kindred of mid-Ulster. They originated in Laggan in eastern Donegal and moved east in the twelfth century, ousting the O'Connors from Keenaght in what is now County Londonderry; their lordship of Keenaght and Coleraine became known as O'Cahan's country, and the sept first appears on record in 1138. As vassals of their kinsmen the O'Neills, they held the ceremonial privilege of inaugurating each new O'Neill chief by casting a shoe over his head. Fifteen O'Cahan chieftains fell fighting the Normans at Drumderg, and their castle of Dunseverick was destroyed by Scottish troops during the rebellion of 1641. Most of the chiefs fled in the Flight of the Earls in 1607; Donnell Ballagh O'Cahan was captured and died in the Tower of London in 1626, and the lordship was absorbed into the Plantation of Ulster as part of the new County Londonderry. The harpist Rory Dall O'Cahan may have composed the Londonderry Air as a lament for the fallen sept.
zh: 卡恩家族（爱尔兰语 Uí Chatháin，意为‘卡恩之后’）是北方乌伊·尼尔岑纳尔·欧文支的强族，活跃于阿尔斯特中部。他们发祥于多尼戈尔东部的拉根，12世纪东迁，把奥康纳家族逐出今伦敦德里郡境内的基纳特；其领有基纳特与科尔雷恩的地盘被称作‘卡恩之地’，该支最早见于1138年的记载。作为同族奥尼尔家族的附庸，他们保有一项仪式特权：新任奥尼尔首领即位时，由卡恩家把一只鞋抛过其头顶，以示承认。在德拉姆德格之战中，十五位卡恩首领死于对诺曼人的战斗；家族城堡邓塞弗里克在1641年起义中被苏格兰军队摧毁。1607年伯爵出逃时多数首领离开爱尔兰，首领唐纳尔·巴拉·卡恩被俘后关入伦敦塔，1626年死于其中，领地随后被并入阿尔斯特种植园，成为新设伦敦德里郡的一部分。竖琴师罗里·多尔·卡恩或许正是《伦敦德里小调》的作者，相传此曲原为哀悼卡恩家族衰败的挽歌。

en: Ó Cearbhaill, anglicised O'Carroll, is a Gaelic Irish surname from the personal name Cearbhall, borne by several distinct septs; the greatest of them ruled the kingdom of Éile, called Ely O'Carroll, on the Offaly and Tipperary border until its last chief surrendered it to the Tudor crown in 1552.
zh: 卡罗尔（爱尔兰语 Ó Cearbhaill）是源自人名 Cearbhall 的盖尔爱尔兰姓氏，历史上有多个互不统属的支系；最显赫的一支统治奥法利与蒂珀雷里交界处的埃莱王国，又称埃利·奥卡罗尔，末代首领于1552年向都铎王室投降。

en: The O'Conors (Irish Ó Conchobhair) were the royal dynasty of Connacht in western Ireland, descended from the Uí Briúin and Síol Muireadaigh kindreds. They held the kingship of Connacht on and off from 967 and continuously from 1102 until 1475, and gave Ireland two of its high kings: Tairrdelbach Ua Conchobair, who died in 1156, and his son Ruaidrí, the last high king, who accepted Norman overlordship under the treaty of Windsor in 1175 while retaining Connacht. In 1337 the family still ruled from its Roscommon heartland, but succession under Brehon law went by election among rival kinsmen rather than primogeniture, feeding bitter internal feuds. By the late fourteenth century the dynasty had split into two rival lines, the O'Conor Don and the O'Conor Roe, whose contests weakened it further. Feidhlimidh Geangcach, who died in 1474, was the last fully recognised king of Connacht, though An Calbhach O'Conor Don was still popularly inaugurated as king during the fighting of 1643, before the old Gaelic order was finally broken.
zh: 康纳家族（爱尔兰语 Ó Conchobhair）是爱尔兰西部康诺特的王族，出自乌伊·布里温与希尔·穆里达族群。他们自967年起断断续续、1102—1475年间连续担任康诺特国王，并出过两位爱尔兰至高王：1156年去世的泰尔德巴赫·康纳，以及他的儿子、末代至高王罗德里。罗德里在1175年的《温莎条约》中接受诺曼人的宗主权，但保住了康诺特。1337年时家族仍以罗斯康芒一带为根基掌权；不过按布雷亨法，王位由亲族内部竞争推选而非长子继承，常引发惨烈内讧。到14世纪末，王朝分裂为唐·康纳与罗·康纳两支相争，实力进一步削弱。1474年去世的费德利米是最后一位得到普遍承认的康诺特国王；1643年战乱中，卡尔瓦赫·唐·康纳仍按旧俗被推举为王，但盖尔旧秩序此后不久便彻底瓦解。

en: The O'Dohertys (Irish Ó Dochartaigh) are a Gaelic Irish clan of the Cenél Conaill, the great Northern Uí Néill confederation of Donegal, and kinsmen of the O'Donnells of Tír Conaill. They take their name from Dochartach, who flourished in the tenth century, and were originally chiefs of Cenél Eanna before becoming rulers of the Inishowen peninsula in the far north of Ulster early in the fifteenth century. In 1337 they were already a leading sept among the Donegal clans of Tír Conaill. Sir Cahir O'Doherty, the last Gaelic chief, had fought for the English in the Nine Years' War but rose in revolt in 1608, seizing and burning Derry; he was killed at Kilmacrennan the same year, his rising collapsed, and Inishowen was confiscated for the Ulster Plantation.
zh: 多尔蒂家族（爱尔兰语 Ó Dochartaigh）是盖尔爱尔兰宗族，属于多尼戈尔的北方乌伊·尼尔大联盟岑纳尔·康奈尔支，与蒂康奈尔的奥唐奈家族同族。他们得名于10世纪活跃的多哈尔塔赫，原为岑纳尔·恩纳的首领，15世纪初成为阿尔斯特最北端伊尼什欧文半岛的统治者。1337年时，他们已是蒂康奈尔境内多尼戈尔诸族中的重要一支。末代盖尔首领卡希尔·多尔蒂爵士曾在九年战争中为英格兰作战，却于1608年起兵反叛，攻占并焚毁德里，同年在基尔麦克伦南战死，叛乱迅速失败，伊尼什欧文被没收并划入阿尔斯特种植园。

en: The Donalds, in Gaelic Ó Dómaill or descendants of Dónal and known in English as the O'Donnells, were the ruling clan of Tyrconnell, the kingdom covering most of later County Donegal. Like the O'Neills they claimed descent from the Uí Néill high king Niall of the Nine Hostages, through his son Conall Gulban, whom Saint Patrick was said to have baptised. From Donegal Castle the chiefs, styled The O'Donnell, dominated the north-west and waged a long rivalry with the O'Neills of Tyrone, defeating them at Knockavoe in 1522 and Farsetmore in 1567. They were patrons of the Franciscan friary at Donegal, and Manus O'Donnell composed a life of Saint Columba. In the Nine Years' War of 1593 to 1603 Red Hugh O'Donnell and Hugh O'Neill led the Irish confederates until their defeat at Kinsale in 1601; Red Hugh died in Spain the next year. His brother Rory was made Earl of Tyrconnell in 1603 but joined the Flight of the Earls in 1607, dying in exile in Rome in 1608, and the earldom was attainted in 1614 as the Plantation of Ulster swallowed Tyrconnell. Later O'Donnells served as officers in the Irish Brigade of France, among them General Daniel O'Donnell, who fought at Oudenarde and Malplaquet.
zh: 唐纳德家族，盖尔语作奥·多奈尔，意为多纳尔的后裔，英语中称奥唐奈家族，是蒂康奈尔王国的统治氏族，领地涵盖后来多尼戈尔郡的大部分。与奥尼尔家族一样，他们自称出自爱尔兰至高王九质王尼尔，先祖是据说由圣帕特里克施洗的尼尔之子科纳尔·古尔班。族长号称奥唐奈，以多尼戈尔城堡为中心称雄爱尔兰西北，与蒂龙的奥尼尔家族长期争霸，先后于1522年在诺卡沃、1567年在法塞特莫尔击败对手。他们赞助多尼戈尔的方济各会修道院，马纳斯·奥唐奈还撰写了圣科伦巴的传记。1593至1603年的九年战争中，红休·奥唐奈与休·奥尼尔联手率领爱尔兰联军，1601年在金塞尔战败，红休次年死于西班牙。其弟罗里1603年受封蒂康奈尔伯爵，却在1607年参加伯爵出逃，1608年客死罗马；1614年伯爵领被剥夺，蒂康奈尔随后被阿尔斯特殖民吞并。后来的奥唐奈家族多在法国爱尔兰旅任军官，其中丹尼尔·奥唐奈将军曾参加奥德纳尔德和马尔普拉凯战役。

en: The O'Dowds (Irish Ó Dubhda) are a Gaelic Irish clan of north Connacht, descended from the Uí Fiachrach, who in the seventh and eighth centuries gave Connacht several of its kings before being pushed aside by the Uí Briúin. Their surname, from the ninth-century ancestor Dubda mac Connmhach, is among the oldest recorded in Ireland, the annals noting the death of an Aedh Ua Dubhda in 982. From the eighth to the fifteenth century they were kings of Uí Fiachrach Muaidhe, the coastal country of Tireragh in what is now Sligo and Mayo, and a formidable maritime power in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, ringing their kingdom with some twenty castles. In 1354 Sen-Bhrian O'Dowd temporarily drove the Anglo-Norman settlers out of Tireragh, and each chief was inaugurated at Carn Amhalghaigh near Killala. As patrons of the hereditary MacFirbis chroniclers, they sponsored the Great Book of Lecan, compiled near Enniscrone between 1397 and 1418, which records their inauguration rite; after the medieval kingdom was absorbed into the Kingdom of Ireland, they continued as lords of Tír Fhiacrach.
zh: 多德家族（爱尔兰语 Ó Dubhda）是康诺特北部的盖尔裔爱尔兰人宗族，出自乌伊·菲阿赫拉赫族群；该族群在7—8世纪曾出过几位康诺特国王，后来被乌伊·布里温排挤。其姓氏源自9世纪的先祖杜布达·麦克科纳马赫，是爱尔兰有记载的最古老姓氏之一，编年史在982年就记下了艾德·奥多德的去世。8—15世纪，他们世代担任乌伊·菲阿赫拉赫·穆艾德的国王，统治今斯莱戈与梅奥沿海的蒂雷拉地区，12—13世纪更是令人忌惮的海上力量，并在王国境内修筑了约二十座城堡。1354年，森·布里安·多德一度把盎格鲁-诺曼定居者全部逐出蒂雷拉；历代首领都在基拉拉附近的卡恩·阿瓦尔加举行即位仪式。作为世袭编年史家麦克菲尔比斯家族的庇护者，他们赞助了1397—1418年间在伊尼斯克龙附近编纂的《莱坎大书》，书中保存了多德家的即位仪典；中世纪王国被并入爱尔兰王国后，他们仍以蒂雷拉领主的身份存续。

en: The Falys are the O'Connor Falys, Irish Ó Conchobhair Failghe, the ruling dynasty of the Gaelic kingdom of Uí Failghe, whose name survives in County Offaly. Kindred tradition traced the kingdom to the legendary king Rus Failge of the early sixth century, and from the mid-eleventh century its rulers bore the O'Connor Faly surname, though they were no kin to the O'Connors of Connacht. Their seat moved from Rathangan to the island fortress of Daingean when the Normans arrived, and although they lost ground to invaders they long kept their independence; by the early sixteenth century their power reached the Shannon, and the men of Meath and Kildare paid them yearly black rent. Brian O'Connor Faly, lord from about 1520, raided the English Pale for decades before he surrendered in 1548; he escaped the Tower of London but died in Dublin Castle in 1560. Under the Settlement of Laois and Offaly Act of 1556 the old kingdom was partitioned between the new King's and Queen's Counties and County Kildare, and the independent lordship came to an end.
zh: 法利家族即奥康纳·法利家族，盖尔语作 Ó Conchobhair Failghe，是盖尔王国乌伊法尔格的统治王朝，奥法利郡的名字便来自这个王国。按家族传统，王国可追溯到6世纪初传说中的国王罗斯·法尔盖；11世纪中叶起，其统治者开始使用奥康纳·法利之姓，与康诺特的奥康纳家族并无血缘。诺曼人到来后，他们把驻地从拉森甘迁到丹甘的岛上要塞，虽屡有失地，却长期保持独立；到16世纪初，其势力西抵香农河，米斯和基尔代尔的居民每年都要向他们缴纳贡金。约1520年继任首领的布莱恩·奥康纳·法利数十年来不断袭掠英格兰人的佩尔地区，1548年被迫投降；他曾从伦敦塔逃脱，最终于1560年死于都柏林城堡。1556年的《莱斯与奥法利安置法令》把旧王国拆入新设的国王郡、女王郡和基尔代尔郡，独立的首领政权至此终结。

en: The Farrells render the Irish Ó Fearghail, descendants of Fearghail, whose great-grandfather Angaile gave his name to the lordship of Annaly in the Irish midlands. They belonged to the Conmaicne peoples, and around 1070 the Ó Fearghail and allied tribes conquered the old kingdom of Tethbae, the country that later became County Longford, where they ruled as princes of Annaly with their stronghold at Longphoirt, the future Longford. After the Norman invasion the territory was granted to Hugh de Lacy within the liberty of Meath and an English colony was planted at Granard, but from the fourteenth century English power receded: Edward Bruce sacked Granard in 1315 and the O'Farrells re-established full control of Annaly. They kept their Gaelic lordship through the later Middle Ages until Tudor conquest reached the midlands. Annaly was shired as Longford in 1586, and in the early seventeenth century the O'Farrell estates were broken up in the Plantation of Longford of 1620, leaving the family dispossessed of the principality it had held for more than five centuries.
zh: 法雷尔是爱尔兰姓氏 Ó Fearghail（奥法雷尔）的英语化形式，其先祖费尔加尔的曾祖父安加莱的名字，后来成了爱尔兰中部安纳利领地的名称。他们属于康梅克涅诸族；1070年前后，奥法雷尔联合邻近部落征服了古老的特斯巴王国，即后来的朗福德郡，并以安纳利王公的身份统治那里，大本营在朗福特尔特，也就是后来的朗福德。诺曼入侵后，这片土地被划入米斯特许区封给休·德·拉西，英格兰人还在格拉纳德建立殖民点；但14世纪起英格兰势力衰退：1315年爱德华·布鲁斯洗劫格拉纳德，奥法雷尔家族随即恢复了对安纳利的全面控制。整个中世纪后期他们都保有这块盖尔人领地，直到都铎王朝的征服推进到爱尔兰中部。1586年安纳利被划为朗福德郡；17世纪初的1620年朗福德种植园中，奥法雷尔的地产被分割没收，这个延续了五百多年的小邦主家族就此失去故土。

en: The Flahertys, in Irish Ó Flaithbheartaigh, are a Gaelic Irish clan of County Galway in Connacht, a branch of the Uí Briúin Seóla kindred also called Muintir Murchada. From the ninth century they ruled the fertile plain of Maigh Seóla east of Lough Corrib, but in the 1050s the O'Connors, kings of Connacht, drove them across the lake into the poorer country of Iar Connacht, the West Connacht coast later known as Connemara, where they reigned as its kings. They once governed the nascent town of Galway until the Norman de Burghs, the Clanricarde Burkes, seized it in 1232; the town's English settlers feared the clan enough to pray for deliverance from the ferocious O'Flahertys. Through the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries they remained the dominant Gaelic power west of Lough Corrib, effectively independent of both Dublin and the Burkes. In the sixteenth century the seafaring chieftain Grace O'Malley was married for a time into the clan, and its lordship was finally broken during the Tudor conquest of Connacht. Roderick O'Flaherty (1629-1718), a historian and the last recognised Lord of Iar Connacht, preserved the clan's genealogies in his writings.
zh: 弗莱厄蒂家族，爱尔兰语作 Ó Flaithbheartaigh，是康诺特戈尔韦郡的盖尔人氏族，属乌伊·布里温·塞奥拉族群（亦称穆因蒂尔·穆尔查达）。自9世纪起，他们统治着科里布湖以东肥沃的马格塞奥拉平原；11世纪50年代，康诺特国王奥康纳家族把他们逐到湖西岸的西康诺特（爱尔兰语 Iar Connacht，即后来通称的康尼马拉一带），他们便在那里称王。他们还曾管辖初建的戈尔韦城，直到诺曼人德·伯格家族（即克兰里卡德的伯克家族）于1232年夺取该城；城里的英格兰移民对这个氏族畏惧至极，甚至祈祷上帝把他们从“凶猛的弗莱厄蒂人”手中解救出来。14至15世纪，他们始终是科里布湖以西最强大的盖尔势力，对都柏林当局和伯克家族都保持着实际独立。16世纪，威震海上的女酋长格蕾丝·奥马利曾一度嫁入该家族；在都铎王朝征服康诺特的过程中，其领主统治最终瓦解。罗德里克·奥弗莱厄蒂（1629—1718）是历史学家，也是最后一位获承认的西康诺特领主，在著作中保存了家族的谱系。

en: The O'Kellys (Irish Ó Ceallaigh) were the chiefly dynasty of Uí Maine, anglicised as Hy Many, one of the oldest and largest kingdoms of Connacht, whose lands stretched across eastern Galway and southern Roscommon. Descended in the native genealogies from Maine Mór, the founder of the Uí Maine line, they supplied the kingdom's kings through the medieval centuries; it began as an independent realm and survived as a subject kingdom up to the end of the medieval era, so that in 1337 the O'Kelly chief still ruled this wide territory. Their pride in that ancestry found shape in the Book of Uí Maine, a vast Irish genealogical codex compiled around 1392 to 1394 at the request of Muircertach Ó Ceallaigh, bishop of Clonfert and later archbishop of Tuam, and kept by the clan until 1757. In 1503 the Clanricarde Burkes sacked the O'Kelly castles of Monivea, Garbally and Castleblakeney, and the feud drew Maelsechlainn Ó Cellaigh, king of Uí Maine, into the battle of Knockdoe on 19 August 1504.
zh: 凯利家族（爱尔兰语 Ó Ceallaigh）是乌伊梅恩（英语作海曼尼）的首领王朝；乌伊梅恩是康诺特最古老、最大的王国之一，版图横跨戈尔韦东部与罗斯康芒南部。按本土谱系，他们是乌伊梅恩王族始祖梅恩·莫尔的后裔，在中世纪长期出任该王国的国王。乌伊梅恩早期为独立王国，后来以附庸国的身份存续到中世纪末，1337年时凯利家的首领仍统治着这片广袤土地。家族对谱系的珍视凝结为《乌伊梅恩之书》：这部卷帙浩大的爱尔兰语谱系典集约于1392—1394年，应克洛恩弗特主教、后任蒂厄姆大主教的米尔瑟塔赫·凯利之命编纂，一直由家族保存到1757年。1503年，克兰里卡德的伯克家族摧毁了凯利家在莫尼维、加拉利和卡斯尔布莱克尼的城堡，这场争端把乌伊梅恩国王梅尔谢赫林·凯利卷入1504年8月19日的诺克多战役。

en: The O'Malleys, Irish Uí Máille, were a seafaring Gaelic clan who by the twelfth century ruled Umhaill, the territory around Clew Bay in west County Mayo covering the baronies of Burrishoole and Murrisk. Claiming descent from Maille mac Conall, they were once autonomous under the kings of Connacht and later vassals of the Mac William Íochtar Bourkes, and they lined their coast with castles such as Carrickkildavnet and Carrickahowley, charging black rent even to English fishermen. Their most famous ruler was Gráinne Ní Mháille, Grace O'Malley, born about 1530, who after the death of her father Eóghan Dubhdara took charge of the family's lands and fleets, raiding and trading along the western seaboard. In 1576 she submitted under surrender and regrant, and in 1593 she sailed to London and pleaded before Elizabeth I at Greenwich for the release of her two captive sons and her half-brother. She died about 1603, and Umhaill passed to her son Tibbot na Long.
zh: 马利家族的盖尔语名为 Uí Máille，是擅长航海的盖尔宗族，12世纪时已统治乌马尔，即梅奥郡西部克鲁湾周围的领地，包括伯里绍尔和马里斯克两个男爵领。他们自称是马耶·麦克·康纳尔的后裔，早年在康诺特诸王治下自治，后来成为麦克威廉·约赫塔尔伯克家族的附庸；他们沿海岸修筑了卡里基尔达夫内、卡里卡豪利等城堡，连英格兰渔民也要向他们缴纳贡金。家族最著名的首领是约1530年出生的格兰妮·尼·马耶，即格蕾丝·奥马利；父亲尤恩·杜夫达拉去世后，她接掌家族的土地与船队，在西部海岸四处劫掠和贸易。1576年她按“投降与再封”政策归顺，1593年更扬帆前往伦敦，在格林尼治当面向伊丽莎白一世陈情，请求释放被俘的两个儿子和异母弟。她约于1603年去世，乌马尔随后由其子蒂博特·纳·朗继承。

en: The O'Molloys, Irish Ó Maolmhuaidh from a word meaning proud chieftain, were a Gaelic Irish kindred of the Southern Uí Néill who ruled Firceall, the Fir Ceall or “men of the churches”, a territory in the south-west of the Kingdom of Meath covering much of what is now central County Offaly around Tullamore. As princes of Firceall they patronised its ancient abbeys, among them Rahan and Kilcormac, and in the early thirteenth century one of their kindred served as bishop of Ferns. The family held its lands through the later Middle Ages until the English plantations of the 1550s, when Firceall was confiscated and divided into the baronies of Ballycowan, Ballyboy and Eglish.
zh: 莫洛伊家族的盖尔语名为 Ó Maolmhuaidh，英语化作奥莫洛伊，名字源自意为“骄傲酋长”的词语。他们是盖尔裔爱尔兰人中南尼尔支系的宗亲，世代统治米斯王国西南端的费尔塞尔，即盖尔语“教会之人”，其地以塔拉莫尔为中心，约当今奥法利郡中部。作为费尔塞尔的首领家族，他们庇护拉汉、基尔科马克等地的古老修道院，13世纪初还有一位族人出任弗恩斯主教。家族在中世纪后期一直保有领地，到1550年代英格兰人的种植园运动中，费尔塞尔被没收并拆分为巴利考恩、巴利博伊和埃格利什三个男爵领。

en: The O'Neills, Irish Ó Néill, are the leading dynasty of the Cenél nEógain, the northern branch of the Uí Néill, claiming descent from Niall Glúndub, king of Ailech and high king of Ireland, who died in 919; his great-grandson Flaithbertach was the first to bear the Ua Néill surname. For generations they contested the kingship of Ailech and Tír Eógain with the Meic Lochlainn, until the battle of Caimeirge in 1241 destroyed the rival line and left the O'Neills supreme in Ulster. From 1232 their chiefs ruled as kings of Tír Eógain from Dungannon, and when the Norman earldom of Ulster collapsed in 1333 a junior branch, the O'Neills of Clandeboye, filled the vacuum in eastern Ulster. In 1542 the crown recognised the chief as Earl of Tyrone, but Hugh O'Neill led the Nine Years' War against English conquest, submitting in 1603 and fleeing to the Continent in the Flight of the Earls in 1607, after which his lands were swallowed by the Plantation of Ulster. Dispossessed O'Neills later joined the rebellion of 1641 and served as exiled officers in the Spanish army.
zh: 奥尼尔家族，爱尔兰语作 Ó Néill，是尼尔后裔北支岑纳尔·欧文的首族，自称源自919年去世的艾莱赫国王、爱尔兰高王尼尔·格伦杜布；其曾孙弗莱思贝塔克是第一个使用 Ua Néill 姓氏的人。他们与麦克洛克林家族长期争夺艾莱赫和蒂尔欧文的王位，直到1241年卡梅尔格战役中对手的首领层被歼灭，奥尼尔遂称雄阿尔斯特。自1232年起，其族长以蒂尔欧文国王的身份在邓甘嫩统治；1333年诺曼人的阿尔斯特伯国崩溃后，旁支克兰德博伊奥尼尔趁势控制了阿尔斯特东部。1542年，英格兰王室承认其族长为蒂龙伯爵，但休·奥尼尔发动九年战争抵抗英格兰征服，1603年投降，又在1607年的“伯爵出逃”中流亡欧洲大陆，其领地随后被阿尔斯特种植园吞并。失去土地的奥尼尔人后来参加了1641年叛乱，也有不少人以流亡军官身份在西班牙军队中服役。

en: The Reillys, Gaelic Ó Raghallaigh or descendants of Raghallach, were the ruling dynasty of East Breifne, the Gaelic kingdom that became County Cavan. They sprang from the Uí Briúin Bréifne kindred of the Connachta and were close kin of the O'Rourkes, once their overlords. Backed by Connacht, the Reillys eclipsed the O'Rourkes in the 1230s, and the long war between the two septs ended in 1256 with the partition of Breifne into an eastern Reilly kingdom and a western O'Rourke one. Their kings were chosen by tanistry and inaugurated on Shantemon Hill above Cavan town, and the family developed Cavan as a market centre. Uniquely among Gaelic Irish kingdoms, East Breifne minted its own silver coinage, called Reillys, whose circulation so worried the Dublin government that acts of 1447 and 1456 outlawed Reilly's silver. The Reillys fought off an O'Rourke invasion in 1390 and 1391, and after a rebellion of the 1420s they leaned first on the O'Neills of Tyrone and then on the English crown, whose parliament Maolmordha O'Reilly attended in 1541 under surrender and regrant. In 1579 the kingdom was shired as Cavan. The Reillys joined the rebels in the Nine Years' War, and with the defeat of 1603 and the attainders that followed by 1607 the old lordship was swallowed by the Plantation of Ulster.
zh: 赖利家族，盖尔语作奥·拉莱，意为拉加拉赫的后裔，是东布雷夫讷的统治王朝，这个盖尔王国即后来的卡文郡。他们出自康诺特人的伊·布鲁因·布雷夫讷族群，与曾为其宗主的鲁尔克家族本是近亲。13世纪30年代，赖利家族在康诺特支持下压过鲁尔克家族，两大家族的长期战争以1256年布雷夫讷的瓜分告终：东边是赖利人的王国，西边是鲁尔克人的王国。国王依塔尼斯特里制推选，在卡文镇上方的尚特蒙山就职，家族还把卡文发展成集市中心。东布雷夫讷在盖尔裔爱尔兰人诸国中独树一帜，自行铸造银币赖利币，其流通令都柏林政府深感不安，以至于1447年和1456年两度立法取缔赖利银币。赖利家族在1390至1391年击退了鲁尔克人的入侵；15世纪20年代的一场叛乱之后，他们先依靠蒂龙的奥尼尔家族，后转而倚仗英格兰王室，1541年族长马尔莫拉·奥莱利出席都柏林议会，接受投降与再封。1579年王国被划为卡文郡。九年战争中赖利家族加入叛军，1603年战败，随后到1607年爵位相继被剥夺，古老的领地被阿尔斯特殖民吞并。

en: The Rourkes, Gaelic Ó Ruairc, were the royal line of Breifne and, after the partition of 1256, the kings of West Breifne, the country that became County Leitrim. Their king Tighearnán Ó Ruairc had been betrayed and killed in talks with the Anglo-Normans in 1172, and the succession wars that followed let their former vassals, the O'Reillys, overrun most of Breifne. The battle of Magh Slecht in 1256 left the kingdom permanently split: the Rourkes held the west from their capital at Dromahair, while the Reillys ruled the east. Succession strife between the Dromahair and Carrigallen branches split the kingdom repeatedly between 1419 and 1536. The Tudor crown then tightened its grip: West Breifne was absorbed into the Presidency of Connaught in 1569 and shired as Leitrim in 1583. Brian na Múrtha Ó Ruairc, knighted in 1567, rebelled against English composition terms, fled to Scotland for mercenaries in 1591, was arrested in Glasgow at Elizabeth I's demand and hanged, drawn and quartered in London. His son Brian Óg returned to rule and joined the O'Neills and O'Donnells in the Nine Years' War, swearing loyalty to Spain in 1595. After the defeat of 1603 and the death of Sir Tadhg O'Rourke in 1605, his young sons were declared illegitimate in 1619, clearing the way for the Plantation of Leitrim and the end of the lordship.
zh: 鲁尔克家族，盖尔语作奥鲁尔克，本是布雷夫讷的王统，1256年瓜分之后成为西布雷夫讷（即后来的利特里姆郡）的国王。早在1172年，其国王蒂尔南·奥鲁尔克就在与盎格鲁—诺曼人的谈判中遭出卖被杀，随后的继承纷争使旧附庸赖利家族攻占了布雷夫讷大部。1256年的马斯莱克特战役后王国永久分裂：鲁尔克家族以都城德罗马黑尔据有西部，赖利家族统治东部。1419至1536年间，德罗马黑尔支与卡里加伦支的继承之争又使王国数次分裂。都铎王室随后步步紧逼：1569年西布雷夫讷被并入康诺特总督区，1583年被划为利特里姆郡。1567年受封骑士的布赖恩·纳·穆尔塔·奥鲁尔克因反抗英格兰的和解条款而起兵，1591年逃往苏格兰招募雇佣军，在伊丽莎白一世的要求下于格拉斯哥被捕，押往伦敦处以绞刑、开膛与车裂。其子小布赖恩回国继位，与奥尼尔、奥唐纳家族联合参加九年战争，并于1595年宣誓效忠西班牙。1603年战败、1605年泰格·奥鲁尔克爵士死后，他年幼的儿子们于1619年被宣布为私生子，利特里姆殖民由此扫清障碍，领主政权终结。

en: The Sullivans, Gaelic Ó Súilleabháin, were a Munster clan claiming descent from the Eóganachta kings of Cashel. Driven from their original lands in Tipperary by the Normans in the 1190s, they settled in the mountains and peninsulas of Kerry and west Cork, where they became chief vassals of the MacCarthy kings of Desmond. Two great branches emerged, the O'Sullivan Mór of south Kerry and the O'Sullivan Beare of the Beara peninsula, whose seat was Dunboy Castle on Bantry Bay; with the MacCarthys and O'Donoghues they defeated the Norman FitzGeralds at Caisglin in 1261 and again in 1262, fixing the Gaelic frontier in the south-west. When the chief Dónal was killed in 1563 the lordship passed by tanistry to his brother Owen, who was knighted by Elizabeth I, but in 1587 the young Donal Cam overturned the settlement with Dublin's backing and became The O'Sullivan Beare. He joined the rebels of the Nine Years' War, commanded the Munster army at the defeat of Kinsale in 1601, and saw his garrison hanged when Dunboy fell in 1602, while English troops massacred his people on Dursey Island. That winter he led a thousand soldiers and civilians on a three-hundred-mile winter march to the O'Rourkes in Leitrim, harried at every step. He ended his days in exile in Spain as Count of Berehaven and was stabbed to death in Madrid in 1618.
zh: 沙利文家族，盖尔语作奥·苏利文，是芒斯特的盖尔氏族，自称出自卡舍尔的欧加纳赫塔王统。12世纪90年代，他们被诺曼人逐出蒂珀雷里的故土，迁居凯里和西科克的山地与半岛，成为德斯蒙德麦卡锡国王麾下的首席封臣。家族后来形成两大支系：南凯里的大奥沙利文，以及据守贝拉半岛、以班特里湾畔邓博伊城堡为主堡的贝拉奥沙利文。1261年和1262年，他们联合麦卡锡、奥多诺霍两大家族在凯斯格林击败诺曼人菲茨杰拉德家族，奠定了爱尔兰西南部的盖尔人边界。1563年族长多纳尔被杀，首领之位按塔尼斯特里制传给其弟欧文，欧文受伊丽莎白一世封为骑士；但1587年，年轻的多纳尔·卡姆在都柏林当局支持下推翻这一安排，成为贝拉的奥沙利文族长。他参加九年战争，1601年在金塞尔战败时统率芒斯特军队；1602年邓博伊陷落，守军被绞死，英军又在德西岛屠杀其族众。当年冬天，他率领上千名士兵与平民向利特里姆的鲁尔克家族展开长达三百英里的冬季行军，一路遭到追击。他最终流亡西班牙，受封贝尔黑文伯爵，1618年在马德里遇刺身亡。

en: The O'Tooles, Irish Ó Tuathail, are a Leinster clan named after Tuathal mac Augaire, king of Leinster, who died in 958; his grandson Doncaon, slain at Leighlin in 1014, was the first to bear the surname hereditarily. They were chiefs of the Uí Muiredaig branch of the Uí Dúnlainge and held southern Kildare until the Anglo-Norman invasion of the twelfth century drove them into the Wicklow mountains around Glendalough, with their power centred on the Glen of Imaal. Lorcán Ua Tuathail, archbishop of Dublin at the time of the Norman invasion and canonised in 1225, was born a chief's son at Kilkea. From their glens the O'Tooles and their kinsmen the O'Byrnes raided the English Pale around Dublin for nearly four centuries. By 1500 five great houses acknowledged the O'Toole of Powerscourt as their chief, the sept joined the Confederate Catholics at Kilkenny in 1642, and in the eighteenth century its swordsmen took service in the armies of France and Spain.
zh: 图尔家族的盖尔语名为 Ó Tuathail，英语常作奥图尔，得名于958年去世的伦斯特国王图阿塔尔·麦克·奥盖雷；他的孙子唐康最早世代使用这一姓氏，于1014年战死于利格林。他们本是乌伊邓林格王朝乌伊穆雷戴格支的首领，领有基尔代尔南部，12世纪盎格鲁—诺曼人入侵后被逐入威克洛山区，在格伦达洛一带立足，权力中心在伊马尔谷。诺曼入侵时的都柏林大主教劳伦斯·奥图尔就出生在基尔基尔的酋长之家，他于1225年被封圣。此后近四百年里，图尔人与同宗的奥伯恩人一道从山谷出击，袭扰都柏林周边英格兰人控制的佩尔地区。1500年前后，家族五房共奉鲍尔斯考特的图尔族长为首领；1642年他们加入基尔肯尼的天主教联盟，18世纪族人则多在法国和西班牙的军队中服役。

en: The Oda were a Japanese samurai house whose origins lay in Oda-no-shō, an estate in Echizen Province in what is now Nyū District of Fukui, where their founder Taira no Chikazane is said to have been raised by a Shinto priest after the Taira defeat at Dannoura in 1185. The clan first claimed Fujiwara descent and later called itself a branch of the Taira. Like the Kai and Asakura, the Oda served the Shiba, governors of Echizen, and followed them to Owari Province, where they became hereditary deputy governors, or shugodai. After the Ōnin War the clan split into rival branches based at Iwakura and Kiyosu Castles, while the Shiba lords were reduced to puppets. Oda Nobuhide seized Nagoya Castle in 1538, and his son Nobunaga reunited Owari, subdued the Imagawa, Saitō, Asakura and Takeda, entered Kyoto in 1568 and made himself master of central Japan. In 1582 Nobunaga and his heir Nobutada were killed in the Honnō-ji Incident, and his general Hashiba Hideyoshi, later Toyotomi Hideyoshi, inherited his hegemony. The main line under Oda Hidenobu joined the western army at Sekigahara in 1600 and was dispossessed by Tokugawa Ieyasu; four junior branches kept daimyō rank through the Edo period.
zh: 织田氏是日本武家氏族，发源于越前国织田庄（今福井县丹生郡一带）。相传1185年平氏在坛之浦战败后，始祖平亲真被托付给当地神社的神主抚养；织田氏先自称出自藤原氏，后来又标榜为桓武平氏的支流。与甲斐氏、朝仓氏一样，织田氏本是越前守护斯波氏的家臣，随斯波氏转封尾张国，世代出任守护代。应仁之乱后，一族分裂为以岩仓城和清洲城为据点的两支互相攻伐，斯波氏反被架空。织田信秀于1538年夺取名古屋城，其子信长重新统一尾张，相继压服今川、斋藤、朝仓、武田等家，于1568年进入京都，成为畿内的霸主。1582年，信长与嫡子信忠在本能寺之变中遇害，部将羽柴秀吉（即后来的丰臣秀吉）接过了霸业。1600年关原之战中，当主织田秀信加入西军，被德川家康改易；四家旁支则在整个江户时代保有大名地位。

en: The counts of Oettingen were a high-ranking Swabian and Franconian noble house, tracing their line to the Sieghardinger counts of the Riesgau documented around 1000, forebears they shared with the Hohenstaufen. The family itself first appears in 1147, when Louis, count of Oettingen and a kinsman of the Staufer emperors, received the county around the imperial city of Nördlingen as a fief; as Staufer vassals they built Steinsberg castle around 1200. Between the twelfth and fourteenth centuries they assembled the largest secular territory in east Swabia. In the fourteenth century their marriage politics reached the electoral princes, as Irmengard of Oettingen became countess palatine of the Rhine. Partitions began in 1410 and multiplied the lines: Oettingen-Wallerstein, Spielberg, Baldern and the Protestant Oettingen-Oettingen, which won princely rank in 1674 but died out in 1731. The Spielberg and Wallerstein branches were raised to principalities in 1734 and 1774, and in the mediatisation of 1806 their lands passed to Bavaria and Württemberg while the family kept its titles.
zh: 厄廷根伯爵是施瓦本与法兰克尼亚的显贵世家，世系可追溯到约1000年见于文献的里斯高西哈丁根伯爵，他们与霍亨斯陶芬家族有着共同的祖先。家族本身首次出现于1147年：厄廷根伯爵路易作为斯陶芬皇帝的亲族，受封帝国城市讷德林根周围的伯国；约1200年，他们又以斯陶芬封臣的身份修建了施泰因斯贝格城堡。12至14世纪间，家族拼起东施瓦本最大的世俗领地。14世纪，其联姻政治已够得上选侯级别，厄廷根的伊尔门加德成为莱茵行宫伯爵夫人。1410年起家族不断分家，先后形成瓦勒施泰因、施皮尔贝格、巴尔登和信奉新教的厄廷根-厄廷根等支系，后者于1674年获得诸侯爵位，1731年绝嗣。施皮尔贝格和瓦勒施泰因两支分别于1734年和1774年升为侯国；1806年德意志采邑调解中，其领地并入巴伐利亚和符腾堡，家族则保留了头衔。

en: The Cempoala were the ruling house of the Totonac city of Cempoala, the largest town of Totonacapan on the Gulf coast of Veracruz, whose Nahuatl name means place of twenty waters. Totonac settlers had occupied the coastal plain since the height of the Toltec empire between 1000 and 1150, and the walled city, with its temples, palaces and irrigated gardens, may have held between 25,000 and 30,000 people at its peak. Around the middle of the fifteenth century the armies of Moctezuma I conquered the coast, and Cempoala's rulers became Aztec tributaries, forced to send goods and hundreds of people for sacrifice and enslavement. In 1519 its tlatoani Xicomecoatl, whom the Spaniards nicknamed the Fat Chief, welcomed Hernán Cortés and, at the Totonac town of Quiahuiztlan, concluded the first Spanish-indigenous alliance against the Aztecs. Thousands of Cempoalan warriors joined the march inland that ended with the fall of Tenochtitlan in 1521, and in May 1520 the city itself was the scene of Cortés's victory over Pánfilo de Narváez.
zh: 森波阿拉家族是托托纳克人城市森波阿拉的统治家族，该城是韦拉克鲁斯海湾沿岸托托纳卡潘地区最大的城镇，纳瓦语名意为“二十水之地”。托托纳克人在1000—1150年托尔特克帝国鼎盛时期迁居这片沿海平原，这座有城墙环绕、遍布神庙宫殿和灌溉园圃的城市极盛时可能有2.5万至3万居民。15世纪中叶，蒙特祖马一世的军队征服沿海，森波阿拉的统治者沦为阿兹特克附庸，被迫进贡物产，还要送去成百上千用于献祭和奴役的人口。1519年，其特拉托阿尼希科梅科阿特尔（被西班牙人起绰号为“胖酋长”）迎接埃尔南·科尔特斯，并在托托纳克城镇基亚维斯特兰缔结盟约，这是西班牙人与土著对抗阿兹特克的第一个同盟。数以千计的森波阿拉战士加入向内陆的远征，最终在1521年促成特诺奇蒂特兰陷落；1520年5月，科尔特斯又在森波阿拉击败了潘菲洛·德·纳瓦埃斯。

en: The Tlaxcallan were the ruling Nahua house of the Tlaxcalan polity in the Puebla-Tlaxcala valley. Their tradition remembers Culhuatecuhtli Quanex, the leader under whom a migrant Nahua group driven from the Valley of Mexico founded the hilltop city of Tepeticpac Texcallan. His line grew into a coalition of four altepeme, Tepeticpac, Ocotelolco, Tizatlan and Quiahuiztlan, which united during the fourteenth century and shared power instead of crowning a single king. Ringed by Aztec territory, Tlaxcala was never conquered: from the reign of Moctezuma I (1440-1469) the Triple Alliance fought it in ritual flower wars to take sacrificial captives and imposed a trade embargo, while the nearby city of Huexotzinco shared the same struggle. When Hernán Cortés arrived in 1519 the Tlaxcalans, after fierce fighting, took him as their ally and supplied most of the indigenous troops that besieged and destroyed Tenochtitlan in 1521, earning the polity a privileged allied status under Spanish rule.
zh: 特拉斯卡拉家族是普埃布拉—特拉斯卡拉谷地特拉斯卡拉政权的纳瓦人统治家族。据其传说，首领库尔瓦特库特利·夸内克斯率领一支被逐出墨西哥谷地的纳瓦移民，建立了山城特佩蒂克帕克·特克斯卡兰。他的世系后来发展为特佩蒂克帕克、奥科特洛尔科、蒂萨特兰和基亚维斯特兰四个阿尔特佩特利的联盟，它们在14世纪联合起来，以分权共治代替单一君主。特拉斯卡拉被阿兹特克领土包围却始终未被征服：从蒙特祖马一世在位期间（1440—1469年）起，三方联盟以“荣冠战争”的形式与它交战，掳掠献祭俘虏，并对其实行贸易禁运，邻近的韦索钦科也与其同仇敌忾。1519年埃尔南·科尔特斯到来后，特拉斯卡拉人在激战后与他结盟，提供了1521年围攻并摧毁特诺奇蒂特兰的大部分土著军队，也为自己在西班牙统治下争得盟友的特权地位。

en: The Toungoo were the ruling house of the frontier principality of Toungoo on the Sittaung river, founded in 1279 by the brothers Thawun Gyi and Thawun Nge as Pagan power collapsed. Its best-remembered early ruler, Kayin Ba, was an athi commoner born in 1253 who joined the founders as a prison officer and rose to mayor of the town; in 1325, exploiting the succession struggle in the overlord kingdom of Pinya, he seized power by killing the young governor Saw Hnit and ruled for seventeen years like a sovereign. He repaired irrigation works, attracted migrants from the north and kept a force of 150 war elephants, turning a minor vassal state into a regional power before his death in 1342. His son-in-law Letya Sekkya succeeded him, and the governors broke free of Pinya in 1358, afterwards playing Ava and Hanthawaddy against each other. Reincorporated by Ava in 1470, the house regained its chance when Mingyi Nyo became governor in 1485 and declared independence in 1510. His successors Tabinshwehti and Bayinnaung built the First Toungoo Empire, the greatest power in sixteenth-century Southeast Asia; after its collapse the Nyaungyan restoration ruled from Ava until the Mon revolt of 1740 ended the dynasty with the fall of Inwa in 1752.
zh: 东吁家族是锡当河畔边陲藩镇东吁的统治家族。1279年，在蒲甘王朝衰亡之际，达温基、达温额兄弟建立了东吁城。该家族早期最著名的统治者加因巴是1253年出生的阿蒂平民，早年以狱吏身份投奔建城者，一路升为城主；1325年，他利用宗主彬牙王国的王位之争，处死年幼的总督索奈夺取政权，此后十七年如同独立君主一般统治。他修缮灌溉工程、吸引北方移民，保有一支150头战象的军队，把小小藩镇经营成区域强权，于1342年去世，由女婿列蒂亚·塞基亚继任；历代总督又在1358年摆脱彬牙独立，之后在阿瓦与罕礁瓦底之间左右逢源。1470年东吁被阿瓦重新收服，1485年明吉纽出任总督，并于1510年宣布独立。他的继承者德彬瑞蒂和勃印曩建立起第一东吁帝国，成为16世纪东南亚最强大的势力；帝国崩溃后，良渊王系在阿瓦复辟，直到1740年孟人叛乱、1752年阿瓦陷落，王朝告终。

en: The Xaltocan were the ruling house of the Otomi city-state of Xaltocan, an island altepetl in the lake of the same name in the northern Valley of Mexico. Colonial chronicles such as the Anales de Cuauhtitlan count the Xaltocameca among the Chichimec tribes that left Aztlán under a leader called Quauhtliztac, or White Eagle, while the Historia Tolteca-Chichimeca records them as an Otomi people; the island grew rich on chinampa farming and exacted tribute from neighbouring cities. In the thirteenth century Xaltocan fought a long war against the Nahua city of Cuauhtitlan, and around 1395 Cuauhtitlan's ruler Xaltemoctzin, allied with Tezozomoc of Azcapotzalco and the Mexica of Tenochtitlan, conquered the island. The Otomi ruling house and its people were driven out and resettled at Otumba, Metztitlan and Tlaxcala, while Nahuatl speakers took over the island. After the Triple Alliance overthrew Azcapotzalco, Xaltocan became a tributary subject of Tenochtitlan, paying mainly in woven blankets, and in 1521 Hernán Cortés razed the city during the conquest of the Aztec empire.
zh: 夏尔托坎家族是奥托米人城邦夏尔托坎的统治家族，该城邦是墨西哥谷地北部同名湖泊中的岛屿阿尔特佩特利。《夸乌蒂特兰编年史》等殖民时期史书把夏尔托坎人列入在首领夸乌特利兹塔克（意为“白鹰”）率领下离开阿兹特兰的奇奇梅克诸部，《托尔特克—奇奇梅克史》则记载他们属奥托米民族；该岛依靠奇南帕农业致富，并向邻近城邦征收贡赋。13世纪，夏尔托坎与纳瓦人的夸乌蒂特兰城邦长期交战；约1395年，夸乌蒂特兰统治者夏尔特莫克钦联合阿斯卡波特萨尔科的特索索莫克和特诺奇蒂特兰的墨西加人攻占该岛。奥托米王室与族人被逐，迁居奥通巴、梅斯蒂特兰和特拉斯卡拉，纳瓦语人群随后接管岛屿。三方联盟推翻阿斯卡波特萨尔科后，夏尔托坎成为特诺奇蒂特兰的贡赋附庸，主要缴纳织物；1521年，埃尔南·科尔特斯在征服阿兹特克帝国期间将该城夷为平地。

en: The Yucucui were the ruling house of a Mixtec hilltop polity in the Mixteca Alta of Oaxaca: yucu means hill in Mixtec and Cerro Yucucui lies in the Coixtlahuaca region. Mixtec lordly families intermarried with their Zapotec neighbours, explaining a member of the house holding power at Zaachila, the last Zapotec capital, before its Aztec conquest in 1495.
zh: 尤库库伊家族是瓦哈卡米斯特卡高地一个小米斯特克山顶城邦的统治家族：米斯特克语里 yucu 意为“山”，尤库库伊山地处科伊斯特拉瓦卡一带。米斯特克贵族家族常与邻近的萨波特克人通婚，这解释了该家族成员何以在萨波特克人的末代首都萨奇拉掌权，萨奇拉于1495年被阿兹特克征服。

en: The Ogamo were the oldest-established clan of Hōki Province, tracing their ancestor to a local magnate, Ogamo-nushi, honoured with that title by Emperor Tenji. From their home in Ogamo township of Kume District they served as provincial-office officials at the Hōki capital and early held Iwakura Castle. Through the twelfth century they contested eastern Hōki with the Ki clan of the west. In the Genpei War the head Ogamo Suke Motoyasu took the Taira side: he fought the Ki leader Narimori in 1182 and answered Taira no Munemori's summons in 1184, yet after the Taira fall Minamoto no Yoritomo confirmed his standing in the province in 1192. When Emperor Go-Daigo escaped Oki and raised his standard at Mount Senjō in 1333 the Ogamo, said to have brought three hundred horsemen, joined him, though the family split when Nawa Nagatoshi forced Ogamo Motoyuki's castle to surrender. Under the Muromachi shogunate they became housemen of the Yamana shugo, known as the Hōki-shū, and fought in the Yamana army that destroyed Akamatsu Mitsusuke in the Kakitsu Incident of 1441, after which Ogamo Yukimoto was made deputy shugo of Bizen. In the Sengoku wars Amago Tsunehisa of Izumo stormed Iwakura and the clan fled to Inaba, served the Amago briefly and then the Mōri, and recovered the castle after the Amago collapsed. Motoban, the last head, had no heir, so the family adopted Motokiyo, a second son of Nanjo Munekatsu; when the Nanjo were dispossessed after their defeat on the western side at Sekigahara in 1600, the Ogamo were ruined, their members scattered to other provinces, and their ancient line came to an end.
zh: 小鸭氏是伯耆国历史最悠久的一族，家谱称其始祖是获天智天皇赐号的“小鸭主”。家族以伯耆久米郡小鸭乡为出身地，世代担任国衙在厅官人并借此扩张势力，很早便以岩仓城为居城。12世纪，小鸭氏与伯耆西部的纪氏两大势力长期相争。源平合战中，当主小鸭介基保站在平氏一方：1182年与源氏方的纪成盛大战，1184年又应平宗盛之请出兵；平氏灭亡后，源赖朝于1192年下赐教书，保全了他在国内的地位。1333年后醍醐天皇逃出隐岐、在船上山与名和长年举兵倒幕时，小鸭氏曾率三百骑参战，但名和一方随即攻打小鸭元之所在的小鸭城，元之投降，一族内部应已分裂。室町时代，山名氏就任守护，小鸭氏与其结成被官关系，以“伯耆众”闻名；1441年嘉吉之乱中，小鸭氏随山名军讨伐赤松满佑并立下战功，小鸭之基随后被任命为备前国守护代。战国时代，出云尼子经久攻入伯耆，岩仓城陷落，一族一度逃亡，先后从属尼子氏、毛利氏，直到尼子灭亡后才夺回岩仓城。末代当主小鸭元伴无子，收南条宗胜次子元清为嗣；1600年关原之战中南条氏从属西军战败而遭改易，与其共命运的小鸭氏也随之没落，族人逃散他国，这条自平安时代延续下来的古老家系就此终结。

en: The Ogasawara were a Seiwa Genji family who traced their line to Takeda Yoshikiyo; Yoshikiyo's great-grandson Nagakiyo, born in the mid-twelfth century, was the first to take the Ogasawara name, and his descendants built up holdings that came to cover most of Shinano Province. The clan served as shugo governors of Shinano through the Kamakura and Muromachi periods, and related houses spread into Awa, Bizen, Mikawa, Tōtōmi and other provinces. Ogasawara Sadamune joined Nitta Yoshisada in overthrowing the Hōjō at Kamakura in the fourteenth century and later became a general under Ashikaga Takauji. The family also founded the Ogasawara-ryū, whose schools of archery, horsemanship and ceremony did much to codify the etiquette of the warrior class. After the Sengoku upheavals Ogasawara Hidemasa entered Tokugawa Ieyasu's service in 1590 and recovered the clan seat at Fukashi Castle, later called Matsumoto. Under the Tokugawa the Ogasawara ranked as fudai daimyō, with the senior branch ruling Kokura Domain in Buzen from 1632 and cadet houses holding fiefs across several provinces.
zh: 小笠原氏属清和源氏，谱系上溯至武田义清；义清的曾孙长清生于12世纪中期，是第一个以小笠原为苗字的人，其后代经营的领地逐渐覆盖信浓国大部。镰仓和室町时代，小笠原家担任信浓国守护，同族支流还散布到安房、备前、三河、远江等国。14世纪，小笠原贞宗随新田义贞攻克镰仓、推翻北条氏，后来又成为足利尊氏麾下的将领。该家族还开创了小笠原流，其弓术、马术与礼仪之学对武家礼法的体系化贡献甚大。战国动乱后，小笠原秀政于1590年出仕德川家康，并收复了家族据点深志城，即后来的松本城。德川时代小笠原氏位列谱代大名，宗家自1632年起领有丰前国小仓藩，各支流则在多国领有封地。

en: The Oguni were an Echigo warrior house of Settsu Genji stock, tracing their line to Minamoto no Yoriyuki, younger brother of the poet-general Minamoto no Yorimasa. In the Kamakura period Yoriyuki's grandson Yoritsura became steward of the Oguni estate in Kariwa district, present-day Oguni in Nagaoka, Niigata, and took its name; he marched with Hōjō Tomotoki's army in the Jōkyū War of 1221. During the Nanboku-chō wars Oguni Masamitsu held Tenjinyama Castle for the Southern Court, built Kanbaratsu Castle in 1335 and the next year held Shimazaki Castle with the Ike, Kōchi, Takanashi and other houses against the Ashikaga generals Irobe Takanaga and Kaji Kagetsuna until it fell. In the Sengoku age the house served Uesugi Kenshin, fighting at the first Battle of Kawanakajima and in the Etchū, Sado and Kantō campaigns, but the Otate War of 1578 split it between the Kagekatsu and Kagetora factions. Victory left Uesugi Kagekatsu master of the clan: he imposed Naoe Kanetsugu's brother Higuchi Yoshichi as its adopted head, who took the new surname Ōkuni, and under that name the house survived as senior retainers of the Yonezawa domain.
zh: 小国氏是越后国的武家，出自摄津源氏，始祖为诗人武将源赖政之弟源赖行。镰仓时代，赖行之孙源赖连出任越后国刈羽郡小国村（今新潟县长冈市小国町）的地头，遂以小国为姓；1221年承久之乱时，他随军参加了北条朝时的讨伐军。南北朝动乱中，小国政光据天神山城为南朝效力，1335年修筑蒲原津城，次年又与池氏、河内氏、高梨氏等一同固守岛崎城，抵御足利尊氏方的色部高长、加地景纲，直到城池陷落。战国时代，小国氏侍奉上杉谦信，在第一次川中岛之战以及越中、佐渡、关东历次征伐中屡立战功；但1578年的御馆之乱使家族分裂为景胜派与景虎派。取胜的上杉景胜成为家族的主宰，他把直江兼续之弟樋口与七收为养子强行继嗣，改姓大国，大国家此后作为米泽藩的重臣延续下来。

en: The Ohmućević were a Serbian noble family of the fourteenth century, whose most famous member was the feudal lord Hrelja. First recorded in the 1320s as a Serbian military commander in a Byzantine civil war, Hrelja built a domain around Štip and Strumica in northeastern Macedonia while serving Kings Stephen Milutin, Stephen Dečanski and Stephen Dušan. In 1334 and 1335 he rebuilt the church of the Rila Monastery and erected the stone Hrelja's Tower, still the monastery's oldest surviving building. By the late 1330s his wealth, troops and frontier position allowed him to break away and rule from Strumica as a semi-independent autocrat, formally acknowledging Byzantine suzerainty; he later backed John VI Kantakouzenos, who granted him Melnik and the title of protosebastos. Having again submitted to Dušan, Hrelja died at the Rila Monastery in 1342, shortly after taking monastic vows. The family's later descendant Petar Ohmućević, who died in 1599, became an admiral in the Spanish navy and commissioned the influential Ohmućević Armorial to document his claimed Illyrian ancestry.
zh: 奥赫穆切维奇是14世纪的塞尔维亚贵族家族，最著名的成员是封建领主赫雷利亚。他最早在14世纪20年代作为塞尔维亚军队指挥官见于记载，曾卷入拜占庭内战；在效力于斯特凡·米卢廷、斯特凡·德昌斯基和斯特凡·杜尚几位国王期间，他在马其顿东北部的什蒂普和斯特鲁米察一带建立起自己的领地。1334年至1335年，他重修里拉修道院的教堂，并建起石造的赫雷利亚塔，这座塔是修道院留存下来的最古老建筑。到14世纪30年代末，凭借财富、军队和边疆的地理位置，他脱离塞尔维亚，以斯特鲁米察为首府成为半独立的割据者，仅在名义上承认拜占庭宗主权；后来他支持约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯，获封梅尔尼克和“首席至尊者”头衔。赫雷利亚再度臣服杜尚后，于1342年在里拉修道院去世，死前刚发愿出家。家族的后裔佩塔尔·奥赫穆切维奇死于1599年，曾出任西班牙海军上将，并委托编纂了影响深远的《奥赫穆切维奇纹章集》，以记述其自称的伊利里亚贵族世系。

en: The House of Oldenburg takes its name from Oldenburg Castle on the Hunte in Westphalia; its first historical ancestor, Huno of Rustringen, founded Rastede monastery in 1059, and Count Elimar I is documented from 1091. Vassals of the Saxon dukes, the counts became imperial princes when Emperor Frederick I dismembered Saxony in 1189, and through the thirteenth century they pushed north against the pagan Frisian princes while feuding with Bremen and Muenster, granting Delmenhorst to younger branches. Marriage politics opened a larger stage: in 1423 Theodoric of Oldenburg married Hedwig of Holstein, heiress of Scandinavian royal blood, and their son Christian was elected King of Denmark in 1448, of Norway in 1450 and of Sweden in 1457, ruling the whole Kalmar Union. Christian left the county to his brother Gerhard, and the comital line lasted until Anton Guenther died without legitimate heirs in 1667, after which Denmark ruled Oldenburg from Copenhagen. The Holstein-Gottorp branch, founded in 1544, supplied the Swedish kings from 1751 and, through Karl Peter Ulrich, the Russian tsar Peter III in 1762; by the Treaty of Tsarskoye Selo of 1773 Denmark ceded Oldenburg to that branch, which was raised to a duchy in 1774 and a grand duchy in 1815.
zh: 奥尔登堡家族得名于威斯特伐利亚洪特河畔的奥尔登堡城堡；可考的始祖鲁斯特林根的胡诺于1059年创办拉施泰德修道院，伯爵埃利马尔一世则在1091年已见载。家族本是萨克森公爵的封臣，1189年皇帝腓特烈一世拆解萨克森公国时升为帝国诸侯；13世纪他们向北征伐信奉异教的弗里斯兰王公，同时与不来梅和明斯特争斗，并把德尔门霍斯特封给幼支。联姻政治为家族打开更大的舞台：1423年奥尔登堡的迪特里希娶具有斯堪的纳维亚王室血统的荷尔斯泰因的海德薇希为妻，其子克里斯蒂安于1448年当选丹麦国王，1450年获挪威王位，1457年又戴上瑞典王冠，统治整个卡尔马联盟。克里斯蒂安把伯国交给弟弟格哈德，伯爵嫡系延续到1667年安东·京特尔无嫡子而终，此后奥尔登堡由丹麦从哥本哈根统治。1544年分出的荷尔斯泰因—戈托尔普支自1751年起出任瑞典国王，其成员卡尔·彼得·乌尔里希还在1762年成为俄国沙皇彼得三世；依1773年《沙皇村条约》，丹麦把奥尔登堡交给该支，1774年升为公国，1815年再升为大公国。

en: The Oba were a Sagami warrior house of the Kanmu Heishi Kamakura line, kin of the famous Kamakura Kagemasa. Kagemasa opened the Oba mikuriya, an Ise Shrine manor in southern Sagami near present-day Fujisawa, and had it formally established in 1116; his kin inherited the manor's stewardship and took the name Oba, with the Kajiwara, Matano and Toyota clans counted among their branches. The family served Minamoto no Yoriyoshi and Yoshiie, and after Minamoto no Yoshitomo raided the manor twice around 1144 they became his followers, fighting under him in the Hogen War of 1156. In 1180 the brothers split: Oba Kagechika, who had become a Taira deputy effectively ruling the Suruga provincial seat, led the pursuit of the newly risen Minamoto no Yoritomo and was later captured and executed, while Kageyoshi joined Yoritomo and his line survived as Kamakura gokenin. The clan never recovered its old weight: it was weakened in the Wada conflict of 1213 and the Hoji conflict of 1247, and the Hojo regents' wars largely swept Oba power from the Kanto. One branch, led by Oba Kagetsura, was posted as jito to Bingo in western Japan in 1213 and kept a lordly line there until Sengoku times, when it lost its castle to the Koshi of the Amago domain; other Oba men served the Ouchi and Mori as administrators and continued as Choshu retainers.
zh: 大庭氏是相模国的武家，出自桓武平氏镰仓氏流，与名将镰仓权五郎景正同族。景正开发了位于相模南部（今藤泽市一带）的伊势神宫庄园大庭御厨，并于1116年正式立庄，其族人继承庄园的下司职务，遂以大庭为苗字，梶原氏、俣野氏、丰田氏等都是它的庶流。大庭氏先侍奉源赖义、源义家父子；1144年前后，源义朝两度率众侵入大庭御厨劫掠，事后大庭氏反而成为义朝的从属，1156年保元之乱中，景义、景亲兄弟即以义朝郎党的身份参战。1180年兄弟分道扬镳：已成为平氏代官、实际控制骏河国府的大庭景亲负责追讨刚刚举兵的源赖朝，后来兵败被处死；景义则投奔赖朝，他的一脉以镰仓御家人的身份存续下来。此后大庭氏再未恢复旧日分量：1213年的和田合战和1247年的宝治合战使其连受打击，北条得宗政权的一连串纷争几乎把大庭势力从关东肃清。1213年，大庭景连一支被派往西国备后任地头，在当地筑城延续家名，直到战国时代被尼子氏麾下的古志氏夺去城池；另有大庭族人出仕大内氏、毛利氏担任奉行人，其后代作为长州藩士存续。

en: The Ōgimachisanjō were a Kyoto court-noble house, a junior branch of the Sanjō family of the Northern Fujiwara Kan'in line, holding the rank of a minister house. Their founder was the early Kamakura kugyō Kin'uji, third son of the Sadaijin Sanjō Sanefusa and a Gon-dainagon; because his mansion fronted the Ōgimachi-Tōin street, the line came to be called Ōgimachisanjō to distinguish it from the senior Sanjō house.
