zh: 罗阇沙王朝在13世纪至16世纪初统治东爪哇两大印度教—佛教王国信诃沙里与满者伯夷。王统始于肯·阿罗克（又名斯里·朗加·罗阇沙），他在图马佩尔夺权，于1222年建立信诃沙里。王位经阿纳士帕替一脉传至克尔塔纳加腊（1268—1292年在位），他使信诃沙里成为区域霸主，并拒绝忽必烈的朝贡要求，却在1293年元军远征前夕被谏义里叛将贾亚卡旺杀害。克尔塔纳加腊的女婿罗登·韦查耶先借元军消灭贾亚卡旺，随即反戈击退元军，在多乌兰建立满者伯夷，于1293年加冕。王位经贾亚涅加拉传至女王特里布婆那，她于1336年任命加查·马达为宰相；加查·马达以帕拉帕誓言开启系列征服，1342—1343年攻占巴厘。到特里布婆那之子哈亚姆·乌鲁克（1350—1389年在位）时代，满者伯夷成为统有98个朝贡国、势力自苏门答腊延伸至新几内亚的帝国，1365年的史诗《爪哇史颂》记下了这一盛世。1389年哈亚姆·乌鲁克死后，王位继承战争（尤以1405—1406年的雷格雷格内战为甚）削弱了王朝对附庸的控制，伊斯兰教在爪哇北海岸不断扩散，满者伯夷最终于1527年被淡目国攻灭。

en:
The Raj Gonds were the Gond chiefly houses of central India who adopted Kshatriya, Rajput-style kingship and built the kingdoms of the forested Gondwana highlands. Muslim chronicles first notice Gond rajas in the fourteenth century, and from the 1400s four principal states emerged: Kherla, Garha-Mandla, Deogarh-Nagpur and Chanda. The first great Raj Gond kingdom was Garha-Mandla in the upper Narmada valley, whose king Jadurai displaced the local Kalachuri rulers. Its power peaked under Sangram Shah, who held fifty-two hill forts and ruled from Singhorgarh, and later under the Chandela princess Rani Durgavati, who defeated an invasion by Baz Bahadur of Malwa.

In 1564 the Mughal emperor Akbar sent Asaf Khan against Garha; Durgavati died fighting at Narrai, and the kingdom became a Mughal feudatory before recovering partial independence under Hridayshah, who moved his court to Mandla. Other Raj Gond lines flourished alongside it, notably Deogarh-Nagpur, where Bakht Buland Shah converted to Islam and founded the city of Nagpur in 1702. Maratha expansion ended Gond independence: Garha-Mandla was made tributary in 1742 and annexed in 1781, and the last Gond kingdoms fell to the Nagpur Bhonsles.
zh:
拉杰·冈德人是中印度的冈德首领家族，他们采用刹帝利式的拉杰普特王制，在森林覆盖的冈瓦纳高地建立了一系列王国。穆斯林编年史在14世纪首次提到冈德罗阇，15世纪以后形成凯尔拉、加尔哈-曼德拉、德奥加尔-那格浦尔和钱达四个主要政权。第一个强大的拉杰·冈德王国是讷尔默达河上游的加尔哈-曼德拉，国王贾杜莱取代了当地的卡拉楚里统治者。它在桑格拉姆·沙阿时达到鼎盛，据有五十二座山塞、以辛戈尔加尔为都；后来的昌德拉公主杜尔加瓦蒂王后还击败了摩腊婆的巴兹·巴哈杜尔的入侵。

1564年，莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴派阿萨夫汗攻打加尔哈，杜尔加瓦蒂在纳赖之战中战死，王国成为莫卧儿附庸，后在赫里代沙阿治下恢复部分独立，并把宫廷迁往曼德拉。其他拉杰·冈德支系也各有兴衰，尤以德奥加尔-那格浦尔著称，其君主巴克特·布兰德·沙阿改宗伊斯兰教，并于1702年建那格浦尔城。马拉塔的扩张终结了冈德人的独立：加尔哈-曼德拉于1742年沦为附庸、1781年被吞并，其余冈德王国也相继落入那格浦尔的邦斯勒家族之手。

en: The Randolphs took their surname from a certain Randulf or Ranulf, whose son served as Chamberlain of Scotland, but the family's fame rests on Thomas Randolph (c. 1285-1332), nephew and comrade-in-arms of Robert the Bruce. Captured and briefly forced into English service early in the independence war, he rejoined Bruce, led the daring night escalade that took Edinburgh Castle in 1314, and fought at Bannockburn the same year. Bruce made him first Earl of Moray, with his seat at the heart of the old province around Elgin. He signed the Declaration of Arbroath in 1320, negotiated at the papal court in Avignon and with France, commanded at Stanhope Park in 1327, and from 1329 ruled Scotland as regent for the child David II until his sudden death in 1332. His son and heir Thomas was killed within weeks at Dupplin Moor, and his second son John, the third earl, fell at Neville's Cross in 1346, leaving no male heir so that the earldom reverted to the crown. His daughter Agnes, called Black Agnes, won lasting fame by holding Dunbar Castle for five months against an English siege in 1338. In 1372 Robert II recreated the earldom of Moray for John Dunbar, a grandson of the first earl through his daughter Isabel.
zh: 伦道夫家族的姓氏来自一位名叫伦杜尔夫（Ranulf）的先祖，其子曾任苏格兰宫廷总管，但家族的声名主要系于托马斯·伦道夫（约1285—1332）——他是罗伯特一世的外甥，也是其并肩作战的爱将。独立战争初期他一度被俘并被迫为英格兰效力，后来逃回布鲁斯阵营，1314年夜袭奇袭夺取爱丁堡城堡，同年又参加班诺克本战役。布鲁斯封他为第一代马里伯爵，封地以埃尔金一带的古老省区为核心。他是1320年《阿布罗斯宣言》的签署人之一，曾出使阿维尼翁教廷和法国，1327年在斯坦霍普帕克战役中指挥作战，1329年起出任幼主大卫二世的摄政，直至1332年猝然去世。其继承人、长子托马斯几周后便战死于杜普林沼泽；次子约翰即第三代伯爵，1346年战死于内维尔十字，没有男嗣，伯爵领被王室收回。他的女儿阿格尼丝人称“黑阿格尼丝”，1338年坚守邓巴城堡、抵抗英格兰围城达五个月，由此名垂史册。1372年，罗伯特二世将马里伯爵领重新封给第一代伯爵之女伊莎贝尔的外孙约翰·邓巴。

en: The Rasulids were a Sunni Muslim dynasty that ruled Yemen from 1229 to 1454 from their capitals at Zabid and Taʿizz. The family probably came of Oghuz Turkic stock from the Mendjik tribe, though its own genealogists claimed descent from the Ghassanid Arabs; its name derives from an Abbasid-era ancestor nicknamed Rasul, meaning messenger. The dynasty's founder, Umar ibn Ali, was an Ayyubid mercenary officer left in charge of Yemen when the last Ayyubid prince withdrew in 1229, and in 1235 he won a diploma of recognition from the Abbasid caliph and reigned as Sultan al-Mansur Umar. Under his successors the Rasulid state grew wealthy on the Red Sea and Indian Ocean trade passing through Aden, on customs dues and on palm cultivation, and for a time the sultans even controlled Mecca. Sultan al-Mujahid Ali, who reigned from 1322 to 1363, reformed the land tax, while later sultans were men of letters: al-Afdal Abbas compiled a scientific and agricultural encyclopedia and al-Ashraf Ismaʿil wrote a history of Yemen, and their mosques and madrasas gave Taʿizz a new architectural look. A Chinese Ming treasure fleet visited the court in 1418–1419, but tribal unrest and succession strife weakened the regime, and in 1454 the Tahirids seized Aden and ended Rasulid rule.
zh: 拉苏尔王朝是逊尼派穆斯林王朝，1229年至1454年以宰比德和塔伊兹为都统治也门。该家族很可能出身乌古斯突厥人的门吉克部，而自家谱学家则自称源于加桑阿拉伯人；其名称得自阿拔斯时代一位绰号拉苏尔（意为使者）的先祖。王朝开创者欧麦尔·伊本·阿里本是阿尤布王朝的雇佣兵将领，1229年末代阿尤布王公撤离后受命执掌也门，1235年获阿拔斯哈里发册封，以曼苏尔·欧麦尔苏丹之名独立称王。在后继者治下，拉苏尔国家凭借经亚丁港往来红海与印度洋的贸易、关税和棕榈种植致富，苏丹们一度还控制了麦加。1322年至1363年在位的穆贾希德·阿里改革了土地税；后期苏丹多有文名：阿夫达勒·阿拔斯编纂了科学与农业百科，阿什拉夫·伊斯玛仪撰写了也门通史，他们修建的清真寺和经学院也使塔伊兹面貌一新。1418年至1419年，明朝郑和船队曾到访其宫廷。此后部落骚动与继承纷争削弱了政权，1454年塔希尔王朝攻占亚丁，拉苏尔王朝灭亡。

en:
The Rathores are a Rajput dynasty of the Suryavamshi tradition whose bardic genealogies trace them to the Gahadavalas of Kannauj; the historical line begins with Rao Siha, who established the first Rathore chiefdom in the Pali country of Marwar in the thirteenth century and died in 1273. Rao Chunda gained Mandore as a Pratihara bride's dowry around 1400 and made it the clan capital, but after Rao Ranmal was assassinated in 1438 the Sisodias of Mewar annexed Marwar. Rao Jodha recovered it in 1453 and founded Jodhpur, while his sons carved out Bikaner in 1465 and Merta in 1462, and Rao Maldeo, reigning from 1532 to 1562, made Marwar the strongest power in Rajputana.

Under the Mughals the Rathores shifted between enmity and alliance: Chandrasen Rathore resisted Akbar for nearly twenty years, until Uday Singh accepted Mughal suzerainty in 1583, and Aurangzeb's reign brought a thirty-year revolt in which Durgadas Rathore defended the Jodhpur line. A junior branch under Rao Sonag had already founded Idar in Gujarat in 1257, and Rao Anand Singh reconquered it in 1729. Jodhpur itself came under British protection by treaty in 1818, the leading state among the many Rathore principalities of Rajasthan.
zh:
罗怙罗是奉太阳世系传统的拉杰普特王朝，吟游世系把先祖追溯到曲女城的加哈达瓦拉家族；可考的世系始于罗阇·西哈，他于13世纪在马尔瓦尔的巴利地区建立第一个罗怙罗酋邦，1273年去世。约1400年，罗阇·琼达以普罗蒂诃罗新娘的嫁妆取得曼多尔，并将其定为家族都城；1438年罗阇·兰马尔遇刺后，梅瓦尔的西索迪亚人吞并了马尔瓦尔。1453年罗阇·乔达收复故土，修建焦特布尔城，他的儿子们又于1465年开拓比卡内尔、1462年开拓梅尔塔；到罗阇·马尔德奥在位时（1532—1562），马尔瓦尔已成为拉杰普塔纳最强的政权。

莫卧儿时期，罗怙罗人在敌对与结盟之间反复：昌德拉森·罗怙罗抵抗阿克巴近二十年，1583年乌代·辛格终于接受莫卧儿宗主权；奥朗则布时代又爆发三十年起义，杜尔加达斯·罗怙罗在此期间保全了焦特布尔世系。旁支罗阇·索纳格早在1257年就在古吉拉特建立伊德尔，1729年罗阇·阿南德·辛格将其收复。焦特布尔本家则于1818年通过条约接受英国保护，成为拉贾斯坦众多罗怙罗土邦中为首的一个。

en: The Counts of Ravensberg, known as the House of Calvelage-Ravensberg, ruled a county in eastern Westphalia at the foot of the Teutoburg Forest, first attested in the twelfth century. Their original seat was Ravensberg Castle, but around 1240 to 1250 Count Otto III built Sparrenberg Castle above Bielefeld and moved the court there. The family widened its reach through marriage: Otto III's daughter Adelaide married Landgrave Otto I of Hesse in 1297, while his son Otto IV, count from 1306, married Margaret of Berg, and their daughter Hedwig wed Duke William II of Brunswick-Lüneburg. Otto IV died in 1328 leaving only daughters, whereupon his brother Bernard ruled as the last count until his death without issue in 1346. The county then passed to Gerhard VI of Jülich, husband of Otto IV's daughter Margaret, and from 1348 it was united with Berg, becoming part of Jülich-Berg in 1423 and of the United Duchies of Jülich-Cleves-Berg in 1521. In the Treaty of Xanten of 1614 Ravensberg was awarded to the Margraviate of Brandenburg, which administered it together with Minden until the Napoleonic dissolution of 1807.
zh: 拉芬斯贝格伯爵出自卡尔费拉格-拉芬斯贝格家族，统治着条顿堡林山脚下、东威斯特伐利亚的一个伯国，该伯国在12世纪始见于记载。家族最初的居城是拉芬斯贝格堡，约1240至1250年间，奥托三世在比勒费尔德上方修建施帕伦贝格堡，并将治所迁此。家族靠联姻扩大影响：奥托三世的女儿阿德莱德于1297年嫁给黑森藩侯奥托一世；1306年继位的儿子奥托四世娶贝格的玛格丽特，他们的女儿黑德维希则嫁给不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵威廉二世。奥托四世于1328年去世，只留下女儿，其弟贝尔纳德遂作为末代伯爵统治，1346年无嗣而终。伯国随后传给奥托四世之女玛格丽特的丈夫于利希的格哈德六世，1348年起与贝格合并，1423年成为于利希-贝格的一部分，1521年并入于利希-克莱沃-贝格联合公国。1614年的《克桑滕条约》把拉芬斯贝格划给勃兰登堡藩侯国，此后与明登合组行政区，直至1807年拿破仑战争中被解散。

en:
The Recherla Nayakas, also called the Padmanayaka Velamas, were a Telugu warrior dynasty that dominated Telangana from the late fourteenth century, based at the fortified towns of Rachakonda and Devarakonda. Their chiefs Anapota and Maada Nayaka had served the Kakatiyas before allying with the Bahmani Sultanate; in 1368 they defeated and killed Kapaya Nayaka of the Musunuri line at Bhimavaram and took control of Warangal and the surrounding country.

At first Bahmani clients and rivals of the Reddy chiefs of coastal Andhra, the Recherlas switched sides to Vijayanagara after the Reddys split, and in 1419 shared in the victory over the Bahmanis at Pangal Fort. The sultanate retaliated in the 1420s, capturing Warangal and Rachakonda by 1435 and ending Recherla power; its surviving chiefs sank into scattered local lordships across Telangana.
zh:
隶契罗·纳亚卡人又称帕德马纳亚卡·韦拉马人，是14世纪后期称霸特伦甘纳的泰卢固武将王朝，以拉彻孔达和德瓦拉孔达两座要塞城镇为根基。其首领阿纳波塔和马达·纳亚卡曾效力卡卡提亚王朝，后与巴赫曼尼苏丹国结盟，1368年在比马拉姆击败并击杀穆苏努里一系的卡帕亚·纳亚卡，控制了瓦朗加尔及周边地区。

他们起初是巴赫曼尼的附庸，与沿海安得拉的雷迪首领相争；雷迪一族分裂后，隶契罗人转投维查耶纳伽尔，并于1419年在潘加尔堡之役中联手取胜。苏丹国在15世纪20年代反攻，到1435年连克瓦朗加尔和拉彻孔达，隶契罗的霸权终结，幸存的首领沦为散布特伦甘纳各地的小领主。

en: The Reddi dynasty ruled coastal and central Andhra from 1325 to 1448, rising out of the collapse of the Kakatiya kingdom. Its founder Prolaya Vema Reddi, whose forebears had served the Kakatiyas as army commanders, made Addanki his capital after Warangal fell to the Delhi Sultanate in 1323; his successor Anavota Reddi moved the court to the hill fort of Kondavidu, and a junior branch was planted at Rajahmundry in 1395. At its height the kingdom stretched from Cuttack in the north to Kanchipuram in the south and Srisailam in the west. The kings were noted fort-builders, with Kondapalli and Kondavidu as their strongest citadels, and generous patrons of Hinduism: Prolaya Vema repaired the Srisailam temple, built the Narasimha temple at Ahobilam and is credited with 108 Shiva temples. In 1424 the Vijayanagara Empire annexed Kondavidu, and around 1448 the Gajapatis of Orissa took Rajahmundry, bringing the dynasty's independent rule to an end.
zh: 罗底王朝在1325—1448年间统治安得拉沿海与中部地区，是在卡卡提亚王国崩溃的乱局中崛起的。1323年瓦朗加尔被德里苏丹国攻陷后，先祖世代担任卡卡提亚军将的普罗拉亚·韦马·罗底于1325年立国，以阿登吉为都；继任者阿纳沃塔·罗底把宫廷迁到山城孔达维杜，1395年又在拉贾蒙德里分出支系。极盛时其疆域北起克塔克，南至甘吉布勒姆，西抵斯里赛勒姆。罗底诸王以修筑山堡著称，孔达帕利和孔达维杜是其最坚固的要塞；他们同时大力护持印度教，普罗拉亚·韦马修缮了斯里赛勒姆神庙，修建了阿霍比勒姆的人狮神庙，相传还建有108座湿婆神庙。1424年毗奢耶那伽罗帝国吞并孔达维杜，约1448年奥里萨的加贾帕蒂王朝攻占拉贾蒙德里，罗底王朝的独立统治至此终结。

en: The Saxon comital House of Regenstein took its name from Regenstein Castle, three kilometres north of Blankenburg on the edge of the Harz. Its progenitor, Count Poppo I of Blankenburg, was first documented as a count in 1128 in the service of Duke Lothair of Supplinburg, and his uncle Reinhard, Bishop of Halberstadt from 1107, had endowed the family with estates in the Harzgau between the Ilse and Bode. Poppo's son Conrad was the first to style himself Count of Regenstein in 1162, while another son, Siegfried, kept Blankenburg. After Henry the Lion's fall in 1180 the counts were briefly held by Emperor Frederick Barbarossa's men and then reconciled with him. Early in the fourteenth century they acquired Heimburg Castle, and in 1343 the Regenstein-Heimburg line reunited the Regenstein and Blankenburg lands under Count Albert II, who from the 1330s feuded constantly with the Bishops of Halberstadt and the Abbesses of Quedlinburg and was eventually murdered on the orders of Bishop Albert II of Halberstadt. In the fifteenth century the family moved its seat to Blankenburg and abandoned Regenstein to ruin; it adopted Protestantism in 1539 and died out with Count John Ernest in 1599, whereupon the county reverted to the Prince-Bishopric of Halberstadt.
zh: 萨克森伯爵世家雷根施泰因得名于哈茨山北缘、布兰肯堡以北三公里处的雷根施泰因城堡。其始祖布兰肯堡伯爵波波一世于1128年首次以伯爵身份见诸文献，效力于萨克森公爵苏普林堡的洛泰尔；他的叔父、1107年起任哈尔伯施塔特主教的赖因哈德，把伊尔瑟河与博德河之间哈茨高的大片地产赠予家族。波波的儿子康拉德于1162年率先自称雷根施泰因伯爵，另一个儿子西格弗里德则保有布兰肯堡。1180年狮子亨利倒台后，伯爵们一度被皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的部下拘押，不久又与皇帝和解。14世纪初家族取得海姆堡城堡，1343年雷根施泰因—海姆堡支系在阿尔伯特二世治下重新统一雷根施泰因与布兰肯堡领地；阿尔伯特二世自14世纪30年代起不断与哈尔伯施塔特主教和奎德林堡女修道院长争斗，最终奉哈尔伯施塔特主教阿尔伯特二世之命被人刺杀。15世纪，家族把驻地迁往布兰肯堡，任雷根施泰因城堡倾颓；1539年家族改宗新教，1599年末代伯爵约翰·恩斯特去世，家族绝嗣，伯国复归哈尔伯施塔特主教区。

en: The Reginarids were great magnates of Lower Lotharingia in the Carolingian and Ottonian centuries, taking their modern name from the Leitname Reginar borne by generation after generation. Their likely ancestor Gilbert held the Maasgau in 841, and Reginar I was duke of Lorraine until his death in 916; the family long contested Lotharingia with the Conradines until Reginar III was dispossessed in 958. Two brothers returning from exile then founded the comital lines of Hainaut and Louvain. The Louvain line, also counts of Brussels from 1003, rose steadily: Godfrey I was made Duke of Lower Lorraine in 1106, and Henry I became the first Duke of Brabant in 1183 or 1184. John I the Victorious sealed the house's power by winning the Battle of Worringen in 1288 and attaching the Duchy of Limburg to Brabant. Meanwhile a daughter of the Louvain counts, Adeliza, had married Henry I of England, and a younger half-brother of Duke Henry III founded the House of Hesse in 1264. The Brabant male line ended with Duke John III in 1355; his heiress Joanna married Wenceslaus I of Luxembourg, so Brabant passed to the Luxembourgs and in 1383 to the Valois dukes of Burgundy. In 1337 the Reginarid duke still held court at Brussels and Louvain.
zh: 雷吉纳尔家族是加洛林和奥托时代下洛林的大贵族世家，后世以其世代沿用的族名“雷吉纳尔”称呼他们。家族可考的先祖吉尔贝尔于841年领有马斯高，雷吉纳尔一世曾任洛林公爵，直到916年去世；家族长期与康拉丁家族争夺洛塔林吉亚，958年雷吉纳尔三世被剥夺领地。后来从流放中归来的两兄弟分别开创了埃诺和鲁汶两个伯爵支系。鲁汶支系从1003年起兼任布鲁塞尔伯爵，势力稳步上升：戈德弗鲁瓦一世于1106年受任下洛林公爵，亨利一世则在1183或1184年成为第一代布拉班特公爵。“胜利者”约翰一世在1288年的沃林根战役中获胜，把林堡公国并入布拉班特，奠定了家族的权势。在此前后，鲁汶伯爵家的女儿阿德利扎嫁给了英格兰国王亨利一世，而公爵亨利三世的异母弟则于1264年开创黑森家族。1355年公爵约翰三世去世，布拉班特男系断绝，女继承人约翰娜嫁给卢森堡的文策尔一世，布拉班特随之转入卢森堡家族之手，1383年又归瓦卢瓦系勃艮第公爵。1337年，雷吉纳尔家族的公爵仍在布鲁塞尔和鲁汶理政。

en: The Riedesel were an ancient Hessian knightly family, appearing in documents from the early thirteenth century and serving chiefly as vassals of the landgraves of Hesse at Marburg. Lacking hereditary lands, they lived from fiefs and offices as men-at-arms, administrators and counselors, and early adopted Lutheranism after their Hessian overlords. Most of their lines had either died out in the male line or sunk into the peasantry by the early seventeenth century. The surviving line was that of Melsungen: Hermann II Riedesel, who lived from 1407 to 1463, a knight and adviser to Landgrave Louis, married Margareta von Roehrenfurth, took possession of Eisenbach Castle near Lauterbach and acquired the hereditary office of Erbmarschall of Hesse, giving the house a permanent landed base as the Riedesel zu Eisenbach. In 1680 the emperor raised five male members of the house to barons, Freiherren zu Eisenbach. Its most famous son was General Frederick Adolph Riedesel, who lived from 1738 to 1800 and led a Brunswick regiment in British service during the American Revolutionary War. The family lost its feudal rents and jurisdiction in the Napoleonic upheaval.
zh: 里德泽尔家族是古老的黑森骑士世家，13世纪初起见于文书，主要作为黑森领地伯爵在马尔堡的封臣效力。由于没有世袭领地，他们靠受封的土地与官职为生，充当武士、行政官和顾问，并追随黑森宗主早早皈依路德宗。到17世纪初，家族多数支系要么男系绝嗣，要么沦为农民。延续下来的是梅尔松根支系：赫尔曼二世·里德泽尔（1407—1463）本是领地伯爵路易麾下的骑士兼顾问，他娶玛加丽塔·冯·勒伦富特为妻，取得劳特巴赫附近的艾森巴赫城堡，并获得黑森世袭大司马一职，为家族奠定稳固的地产根基，此后称艾森巴赫的里德泽尔。1680年皇帝册封家族五位男性成员为艾森巴赫自由男爵。家族最出名的人物是弗里德里希·阿道夫·里德泽尔将军（1738—1800），他在美国独立战争中率领一支不伦瑞克军团为英国作战。在拿破仑时代的动荡中，家族丧失了封建租赋与司法权。

en: The counts of Rieneck were a Franconian dynasty descended from the counts of Loon in what is now Belgium. Count Ludwig I of Loon first styled himself count of Rieneck in 1156, and the family built Burg Rieneck above the Sinn in the Spessart around 1170, making the adjoining town the centre of its county. Two shrewd marriages, those of Gerhard III with the heiress of Zimmern and Lauda around 1200 and of Ludwig III with the heiress of Grumbach and Rothenfels in 1243, nearly doubled the county, adding Grünsfeld and Rothenfels. A long contest with the archbishops of Mainz over the western Spessart ended in defeat by 1271; one result was the marriage of Elisabeth of Rieneck, with Steinau an der Straße as dowry, to Ulrich I lord of Hanau, whose family adopted the Rieneck arms. After a family partition Lohr am Main became the county's chief town in 1295, and in 1333 Emperor Louis the Bavarian granted it Gelnhausen town rights. When Count Ludwig V died the same year, having named his daughter Udelhilt his heiress against an earlier treaty with Hanau, an inheritance dispute drew in Mainz and Würzburg and cost the county much of its land. A later partition created northern and southern halves, the southern being lost in 1502; the Reformation reached Rieneck in 1544, and with Count Philip III's death in 1559 the male line ended, the fiefs reverting to Mainz and Würzburg while Hanau inherited the name and arms.
zh: 里内克伯爵是法兰克尼亚的贵族世家，祖先为今比利时境内的洛恩伯爵。洛恩的路德维希一世于1156年首次自称里内克伯爵，家族约1170年在施佩萨特的辛恩河畔修建里内克堡，并把堡下城镇作为伯国中心。两次精明的联姻——约1200年格哈德三世娶齐默恩与劳达女继承人、1243年路德维希三世娶格伦巴赫与罗滕费尔斯女继承人——使伯国领土几乎翻倍，新增格林斯费尔德和罗滕费尔斯。他们与美因茨大主教为争夺西施佩萨特长期较量，到1271年落败；后果之一是里内克的伊丽莎白携施泰瑙城为嫁妆下嫁哈瑙领主乌尔里希一世，哈瑙家族后来还沿用了里内克的纹章。家族分家后，美因河畔洛尔于1295年成为伯国首邑；1333年皇帝巴伐利亚的路德维希授予盖尔恩豪森城市法。同年路德维希伯爵五世去世，他不顾早先与哈瑙的条约而指定女儿乌德尔希尔特为继承人，随即引发美因茨、维尔茨堡均卷入的继承纠纷，伯国丧失大片土地。后来再度分作南北两半，南半于1502年丧失；1544年宗教改革传入里内克，1559年菲利普伯爵三世去世，男系绝嗣，封地归还美因茨和维尔茨堡，名号与纹章则由哈瑙继承。

en: The Roger de Beaufort were a feudal family of the Limousin, lords of Maumont near Tulle, whose fortune was made by the Church. Pierre Roger, born at the chateau of Maumont in 1291, entered the Benedictine abbey of La Chaise-Dieu as a boy, taught theology in Paris and became Archbishop of Rouen before his election as pope on 7 May 1342, taking the name Clement VI. The fourth Avignon pope, he reigned through the Black Death of 1348 to 1350, granting remission of sins to all who died of the plague and issuing bulls that condemned the pogroms against the Jews. A munificent patron who filled the college of cardinals with his kin, he made his brother Guillaume vicomte de Beaufort and in 1348 raised his eighteen-year-old nephew Pierre Roger de Beaufort to the cardinalate. That nephew was elected pope in 1370 as Gregory XI, the seventh and last French Avignon pope, and in 1377 he moved the papal court back to Rome; his death in March 1378 opened the Western Schism, only healed at Constance in 1418. The family's temporal power rested with another nephew, Guillaume III Roger de Beaufort, who received the rich vicomte of Turenne as a wedding gift from Clement VI in 1350, married Alienor of Comminges, served Queen Joanna of Naples as grand chamberlain in 1351 and ruled the Comtat Venaissin as the pope's rector from 1376.
zh: 罗歇·德·博福尔家族是利穆赞的封建世家，为蒂勒附近莫蒙的领主，家族的腾达靠的是教会。皮埃尔·罗歇1291年生于莫蒙城堡，少年时进入谢斯迪约的本笃会修道院，后在巴黎教授神学，出任鲁昂大主教，1342年5月7日当选教宗，称克雷芒六世。作为阿维尼翁的第四任教宗，他在1348至1350年黑死病肆虐期间在位，为所有死于瘟疫者颁赐罪罚赦免，并发布诏书谴责针对犹太人的屠杀。他出手阔绰、任人唯亲，把兄弟纪尧姆封为博福尔子爵，又在1348年将年仅十八岁的侄子皮埃尔·罗歇·德·博福尔擢升为枢机。这位侄子于1370年当选教宗，称格列高利十一世，是阿维尼翁第七任、也是最后一任法兰西籍教宗；1377年他把教廷迁回罗马，1378年3月去世后随即爆发西方教会大分裂，直到1418年康斯坦茨宗教会议才告弥合。家族的世俗权柄落在另一个侄子纪尧姆三世·罗歇·德·博福尔手中：1350年克雷芒六世把富庶的蒂雷讷子爵领作为结婚礼物赐给他，他娶科曼日的埃莉诺为妻，1351年出任那不勒斯女王乔万娜的宫廷大总管，1376年起又以教宗区长官的身份治理沃奈桑伯爵领地。

en: The Rokkaku were a samurai clan of southern Ōmi Province, descended from the Sasaki clan of the Uda Genji line. In the thirteenth century Sasaki Yasutsuna, heir of Sasaki Nobutsuna, took the name Rokkaku from his family residence near the Rokkaku-dō hall in Kyoto, and his line kept the post of shugo, or military governor, of Ōmi. When the Kamakura shogunate fell in 1333 the clan head Rokkaku Tokinobu backed the Rokuhara deputies to the last before surrendering; the family later joined Ashikaga Takauji and the Northern Court, and under the Muromachi shogunate it ruled Ōmi as a shugo daimyō from Kannonji Castle. The Ōnin War of 1467 to 1477 began its decline, though Rokkaku Sadayori and Yoshikata strengthened domain rule, abolished a paper merchants' guild in 1549 to open a free market, and issued the house code Rokkaku-shi shikimoku in 1567. Oda Nobunaga broke the clan on his march to Kyoto in 1568, and Shibata Katsuie crushed its remaining forces in 1570; under the Tokugawa its descendants served as kōke, masters of court ceremony.
zh: 六角氏是以近江国南部为根基的武家，出自宇多源氏佐佐木氏。13世纪，佐佐木信纲的继承人泰纲以京都六角东洞院六角堂附近的屋敷为名，改称六角氏，其家族世代保有近江守护之职。1333年镰仓幕府灭亡时，当主六角时信始终站在六波罗探题一方，战败后归降；此后六角氏追随足利尊氏和北朝，在室町幕府下以观音寺城为居城，作为守护大名统治近江。1467—1477年的应仁之乱后六角氏走向衰落，不过六角定赖、义贤父子仍致力于整顿领国，1549年废除纸商行会、改设自由市场，并于1567年颁布分国法《六角氏式目》。1568年织田信长上洛途中击败六角氏，1570年柴田胜家又攻灭其残余势力；江户时代，其子孙以高家身份侍奉德川幕府。

en: The Rosenbergs, in Czech Páni z Rožmberka, were the mightiest noble house of southern Bohemia and a branch of the Vítkovci clan founded by Vítek III of Prčice. Around 1250 the family settled at Rožmberk Castle and soon after built Český Krumlov, which remained their seat for three centuries; their arms were a red five-petalled rose on a silver field. Peter I of Rosenberg served as supreme chamberlain at the court of King John of Bohemia in the early fourteenth century. Jindřich III led the League of Lords against King Wenceslaus IV, while his son Oldřich II headed the Catholic nobility and backed Emperor Sigismund during the Hussite Wars; Oldřich's daughter Perchta became the original of the family's White Lady legend. Under William of Rosenberg, High Treasurer and High Burgrave of Bohemia, the house reached its last peak: he rebuilt Český Krumlov as a Renaissance residence and commanded the Bohemian army against the Ottomans in 1566. After William died in 1592, his brother Peter Vok was forced to sell Krumlov to Emperor Rudolf II in 1601; he withdrew to Třeboň and died there in 1611, the last of his line.
zh: 罗森贝格家族（捷克语称罗日姆贝克领主）是波希米亚南部最显赫的贵族世家，出自普尔奇采的维特克三世创立的维特科维奇家族支系。约1250年，家族定居罗日姆贝克城堡，不久又修建捷克克鲁姆洛夫城堡，此后三百年间那里一直是家族的驻地；其纹章是银底上的一朵红色五瓣玫瑰。14世纪初，罗森贝格的彼得一世在波希米亚国王约翰的宫廷担任最高内侍。因德日赫三世曾率领贵族联盟对抗国王瓦茨拉夫四世，他的儿子奥尔德日赫二世则在胡斯战争中领导天主教贵族、支持皇帝西吉斯蒙德；奥尔德日赫的女儿佩尔赫塔就是家族“白衣夫人”幽灵传说的原型。在身兼波希米亚最高财政官和最高城堡长官的威廉治下，家族迎来最后一次鼎盛：他把捷克克鲁姆洛夫改建为文艺复兴式府邸，并于1566年统率波希米亚军队对抗奥斯曼人。1592年威廉去世后，其弟彼得·沃克被迫在1601年把克鲁姆洛夫卖给皇帝鲁道夫二世，自己退居特热邦，于1611年在那里去世，家族就此绝嗣。

en: The de' Rossi were a noble house of the Parma Apennines, first documented in Emilia in 1323, whose rise rested on church and signoria. Ugolino Rossi became bishop of Parma in 1324 and built up the family's mountain estates around Berceto, while his brothers Rolando, Marsilio and Pietro were named counts of Berceto by John of Bohemia in 1331. Rolando de' Rossi, born around 1285, dominated Parma from 1322 and ruled it as effective signore from 1328; after submitting the city to the Bohemian king in 1331 he accompanied the future Emperor Charles IV on diplomatic missions, but in 1335 Parma surrendered to the Scaligers and the Rossi were exiled. Rolando ended as a condottiero for Venice and Florence, raiding Scaliger lands as far as Vicenza, and died at Padua in 1345. Under Visconti rule from 1346 the family rebuilt its power from castles at Felino, San Secondo and Roccabianca, and from 1376 it feuded for more than a century with the Pallavicini. Its glory came with Pier Maria II de' Rossi, born in 1413 and called the Magnificent, a condottiero of the Visconti and Sforza who defeated the Venetians on the Po at Casalmaggiore in 1448 and built the castle of Torrechiara for his mistress Bianca Pellegrini. In 1482 a Milanese league led by Gian Giacomo Trivulzio stormed his lands, and he died at Torrechiara the same year, his family's ascendancy broken.
zh: 德·罗西家族是帕尔马亚平宁山区的贵族世家，1323年首次见于艾米利亚的记载，其崛起靠的是教会职位与城邦政权双管齐下。乌戈利诺·罗西于1324年出任帕尔马主教，在贝尔切托一带积累起家族的山地产业；他的兄弟罗兰多、马尔西利奥和彼得罗则于1331年被波希米亚国王约翰封为贝尔切托伯爵。约1285年出生的罗兰多·德·罗西自1322年起左右帕尔马政局，1328年起成为事实上的领主；1331年他把城市献给波希米亚国王，随后还陪同后来的皇帝查理四世执行外交使命，但1335年帕尔马向斯卡利杰家族投降，罗西家族遭到放逐。罗兰多晚年沦为威尼斯和佛罗伦萨的雇佣兵首领，曾深入斯卡利杰领地一直打到维琴察，1345年死于帕多瓦。1346年起维斯孔蒂家族统治该地区，罗西家族以费利诺、圣塞孔多和罗卡比安卡等城堡为根基重振势力，并从1376年起与帕拉维奇尼家族缠斗了一个多世纪。家族的鼎盛人物是1413年出生、绰号“伟人”的皮尔·马里亚二世·德·罗西，他先后效力于维斯孔蒂和斯福尔扎，1448年在波河上的卡萨马焦雷击败威尼斯人，又为情妇比安卡·佩莱格里尼修建了托雷基亚拉城堡。1482年，詹贾科莫·特里武尔齐奥率领的米兰联军攻陷他的领地，他同年死于托雷基亚拉，家族的上升势头就此终结。

en: The Roderick dynasty, known to history as the Rurikids, was the ruling house of Kievan Rus' and its successor principalities. Tradition traces it to the Varangian prince Rurik, who according to the Primary Chronicle established himself at Novgorod in 862; his kinsman Oleg then seized Kyiv in 882, and the line of Igor and Sviatoslav built a state from the Baltic to the Black Sea. Under Vladimir the Great the Rus' accepted Orthodox Christianity in 988, and Yaroslav the Wise, who died in 1054, gave the realm its first law code before his death opened a long era of princely rivalry. The Council of Liubech of 1097 confirmed the split into rival branches, among them the Olgovichi of Chernigov, the Rostislavichi of Smolensk, the Romanovichi of Galicia-Volhynia and the Yurievichi of Vladimir-Suzdal. The Mongol invasion of 1237 to 1240 sacked Kyiv and reduced the princes to vassals of the Golden Horde. In 1337 many scattered Rurikid lines still held Turov, Vitebsk, Murom, Rostov and Smolensk, while the northeastern future belonged to the Daniilovichi of Moscow: Alexander Nevsky's son Daniel founded that line, Ivan I Kalita made Moscow the Horde's favoured tax-gatherer, Ivan III threw off Tatar overlordship in 1480, and Ivan IV was crowned the first tsar in 1547. The death of Tsar Feodor I in 1598 ended the dynasty, opening the Time of Troubles that ended with the Romanov accession in 1613.
zh: 罗德里克王朝即史称的留里克王朝，是基辅罗斯及其后继诸公国的统治家族。按《往年纪事》的传统说法，其始祖是瓦良格王公留里克，于862年在诺夫哥罗德立足；其亲属奥列格随后在882年攻占基辅，伊戈尔和斯维亚托斯拉夫一系建立起北起波罗的海、南至黑海的国家。弗拉基米尔一世治下，罗斯于988年皈依东正教；1054年去世的智者雅罗斯拉夫颁布了第一部法典，但他死后王公纷争的漫长时代也随之开始。1097年的柳别奇会议确认了分疆而治，家族形成切尔尼戈夫的奥利戈维奇系、斯摩棱斯克的罗斯季斯拉维奇系、加利奇-沃伦的罗曼诺维奇系和弗拉基米尔-苏兹达尔的尤里耶维奇系等支脉。1237至1240年的蒙古入侵洗劫基辅，诸王公沦为金帐汗国的封臣。1337年，图罗夫、维捷布斯克、穆罗姆、罗斯托夫、斯摩棱斯克等地仍由众多留里克支系统治，而东北的未来属于莫斯科的达尼洛维奇系：亚历山大·涅夫斯基之子丹尼尔开创该系，伊凡一世·卡利塔使莫斯科成为汗庭倚重的征税者，伊凡三世于1480年摆脱鞑靼宗主权，伊凡四世于1547年加冕为第一位沙皇。1598年费奥多尔一世去世，王朝终结，随之而来的混乱时代直到1613年罗曼诺夫家族登基才告结束。

en: The Rusconi, also called Rusca or Ruschi, were an ancient noble house of Como, attested from the tenth century, who led the city's Ghibelline faction against their Guelph rivals the Vitani. After several of their men held the consulship in the 1190s, with Giovanni Rusca serving as podestà of Milan in 1199, Loterio Rusca was acclaimed Lord of the People in 1276, forced the bishop of Como into exile and defeated the intervention of Ottone Visconti, securing by the peace of Lomazzo the lordships of Como, Bellinzona, Chiavenna and the Valtellina and the counties of Locarno, Lugano and Luino. The family's peak came under Franchino I Rusca, who crushed the Vitani in 1313 and ruled Como as captain-general for some twenty years, but in 1335 Azzone Visconti annexed the city and in 1340 Luchino and Giovanni Visconti took Bellinzona after a long siege, leaving the Rusconi as Visconti officials and feudatories. In this quieter age Giovanni Rusconi, born in Como, was made bishop of Parma in 1383 and built the Rusconi chapel in its cathedral. After the Visconti crisis of 1402 Franchino II returned from Pisa to revive the signoria, failed, and retreated to Lugano; in the fifteenth century the family exchanged its claims on Como for the county of Locarno, which the Swiss Confederation took from them in 1513, leaving only the county of Luino.
zh: 鲁斯科尼家族又称鲁斯卡或鲁斯基，是科莫的古老贵族世家，10世纪即有记载，在城内领导吉伯林派，与归尔夫派的维塔尼家族世代相争。12世纪90年代家族多人出任执政官，乔瓦尼·鲁斯卡还在1199年担任米兰的波德斯塔；1276年，洛泰里奥·鲁斯卡被拥戴为“平民之主”，迫使科莫主教流亡，又击退奥托内·维斯孔蒂的干涉，凭洛马佐和约取得科莫、贝林佐纳、基亚文纳、瓦尔泰利纳的领主权以及洛迦诺、卢加诺、卢伊诺的伯爵头衔。家族的鼎盛期在弗兰基诺一世·鲁斯卡治下：他于1313年打垮维塔尼家族，以统帅身份统治科莫约二十年；但1335年阿佐内·维斯孔蒂吞并该城，1340年卢基诺与乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂又经长期围攻夺取贝林佐纳，鲁斯科尼家族沦为维斯孔蒂的属臣和官吏。在这段沉寂时期，生于科莫的乔瓦尼·鲁斯科尼于1383年出任帕尔马主教，并在主教座堂里修建了鲁斯科尼礼拜堂。1402年维斯孔蒂政权陷入危机后，弗兰基诺二世从比萨返回试图重建领主权，失败后退守卢加诺；15世纪，家族以放弃对科莫的权利换取洛迦诺伯爵领，1513年瑞士邦联又夺走洛迦诺，他们手中只剩卢伊诺伯爵领。

en: The Ruzagi, also rendered Rojaki or Rozagi and called Rusaki in the Bitlis chronicles, were the Kurdish tribal confederation that supplied the princes of Bitlis, a fortress town in the Armenian highlands. In the tenth century the Rojaki defeated the Georgian king David the Curopalate and conquered Bitlis and Sasun, and their principality, established by the late twelfth century, outlasted a long succession of overlords. In the fourteenth century its emirs were vassals of the Kara Koyunlu, ruling Bitlis together with the smaller emirates of Ahlat, Mush and Hinis; the emir submitted to Timur in 1394 and later helped the Kara Koyunlu restore their power. The Aq Qoyunlu needed three sieges in the 1470s to take Bitlis and held it from 1467 to 1495, after which the Motikan retook the town, and Safavid overlordship followed from 1507 to 1514. The Ruzagi backed the Ottoman sultan Selim I and were rewarded with the title of Noble Khans, but when a prince turned to the Safavids in 1531 the Ottomans overran the emirate. In 1578 Murad III invested Sharaf al-Din Bitlisi as emir, the eighteenth Rojaki prince by 1596. Under Abdal Khan, whom Tavernier called the most powerful Kurdish prince and whose court Evliya Celebi praised, Bitlis still kept an effectively independent Persianate court, until the Ottomans ended its autonomy in 1655 and merged the emirate into the Van eyalet.
zh: 鲁扎吉人（又译罗贾基、鲁萨基）是一个库尔德部落联盟，世代出长比特利斯的埃米尔，比特利斯是亚美尼亚高地上的要塞城镇。10世纪，鲁扎吉人击败格鲁吉亚国王大卫·库罗帕拉特斯，攻占比特利斯和萨松；他们的埃米尔国在12世纪末正式建立，历经多代宗主而存续。14世纪时，其埃米尔作为黑羊王朝的附庸，统治比特利斯以及阿赫拉特、穆什、赫讷斯等较小的埃米尔国；1394年埃米尔向帖木儿臣服，后来又帮助黑羊王朝恢复势力。白羊王朝在15世纪70年代连围三次才拿下比特利斯，统治时间为1467—1495年，此后莫蒂坎人收复该城，1507—1514年又转为萨非王朝羁縻。鲁扎吉人支持奥斯曼苏丹塞利姆一世，受封为“高贵的汗”，但1531年一位王公倒向萨非王朝，奥斯曼随即出兵征服埃米尔国。1578年，穆拉德三世册封沙拉夫丁·比特利西为埃米尔，到1596年他已是第十八位鲁扎吉王公。阿卜杜勒汗在位时，旅行家塔韦尼耶称他为最有权势的库尔德王公，艾维亚·切莱比也盛赞其宫廷；此时比特利斯仍是一个近乎独立的波斯化政权，直到1655年奥斯曼终结其自治地位，把埃米尔国并入凡城行省。

en: The Sagae, also called the Sagae Oe, were a branch of the scholarly Oe clan and took their name from the Sagae estate in Murayama district of Dewa province, in what is now Yamagata Prefecture. Their line began with Oe no Hiromoto, first head of the Kamakura shogunate's Mandokoro, who received the estate's jito post as a reward for the Oshu campaign of 1189; his son Chikahiro inherited it and, after joining the failed Jokyu rising of 1221 in Kyoto, retired there. The clan settled permanently in the late thirteenth century, and at the Kenmu restoration of 1333 it fought for the Southern Court alongside Kitabatake Akiie: Motomasa helped drive Ashikaga Takauji from Kyoto but was killed in 1359 during the long war against the Shiba, and in 1368 the disaster of Urushigawa cost sixty-one clansmen their lives. Peace with the Kamakura kubo in 1373 surrendered the northern half of the estate to Shiba Kaneyori, and it was then that the head took the name Sagae and built up Sagae castle. As kokujin lords they later repelled Date invasions in 1479 and 1480 but were ground between the expanding Mogami and Date houses; after their castle fell in the Mogami family war of 1574 they leaned on the Date, until Mogami Yoshiaki overran them in 1584 and the last lord Takamoto took his own life, ending nearly four centuries of rule. Survivors served the Mogami and, after that house was attainted, other daimyo of the Tokugawa order.
zh: 寒河江氏又称寒河江大江氏，出自学者世家大江氏，以出羽国村山郡的寒河江庄为根据地，其地在今日本山形县境内。其祖是镰仓幕府初代政所别当大江广元，他在1189年奥州合战的论功行赏中得到寒河江庄的地头职；其子亲广继承该庄，1221年在京都参与失败的承久之乱后归隐于此。13世纪末大江氏开始在寒河江定居，1333年建武新政时追随北畠显家为南朝而战：元政曾协助把足利尊氏逐出京都，却在与斯波氏的长期交战中于1359年战死；1368年漆川之战惨败，一族六十一人阵亡。1373年与镰仓公方议和，以寒河江庄北部划归斯波兼赖为代价保全本领，当主时氏迁居寒河江乡并开始自称“寒河江”，经营寒河江城。作为国人领主，他们在1479和1480年击退伊达氏入侵，却在最上、伊达两家的扩张之间备受挤压；1574年天正最上之乱中城池陷落，转而依附伊达，1584年终被最上义光攻灭，末代当主高基自尽，近四百年的领主历史就此结束。遗族此后出仕最上氏，最上家被改易后又转仕德川治下的各家大名。

en: The Sagara were a samurai house of Fujiwara descent through the Kudo lineage, taking their name from the Sagara manor in Totomi Province, the region where the game places their home. In 1193 the head Yorikage moved to the Taragi estate in Kuma district of Higo on Kyushu, and in 1205 his son Nagayori was appointed steward of the Hitoyoshi estate, beginning the family's long rule in the mountains of southern Higo. They fought for the Kamakura shogunate in the Jokyu War of 1221, and the plum blossom they adopted as their crest is said to commemorate that campaign. During the Nanboku-cho wars the clan split into a Southern Court branch at Taragi and a Northern Court branch at Hitoyoshi, whose head Sadayori gained the upper hand and made Hitoyoshi the main line; in 1448 Nagatsugu absorbed the rival branch and united the three districts of Kuma, Yatsushiro and Ashikita. In the sixteenth century Yoshishige consolidated the retainer band into a Sengoku daimyo house, and Haruhiro issued the celebrated Sagara house laws in 1555. Pressed by the expanding Shimazu, the Sagara submitted in 1581, and after Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyushu campaign their holdings were reduced to the old Hitoyoshi domain. Under the Tokugawa they ruled the Hitoyoshi Domain throughout the Edo period, and became viscounts after the Meiji Restoration.
zh: 相良氏出自藤原南家流的工藤氏，因祖居远江国相良庄而得苗字，游戏也把其本据放在远江。1193年，当主赖景前往九州肥后球磨郡的多良木庄，1205年其子长赖又被补任为人吉庄地头，开启了相良氏在肥后南部山区的长期统治。1221年承久之乱中他们为镰仓幕府作战，传说家纹梅花即为纪念此战而采用。南北朝内乱时家族分裂为多良木的南朝派与人吉的北朝派，人吉的定赖一系占了上风，确立惣领地位；1448年长续消灭对立支流，统一球磨、八代、苇北三郡。16世纪，义滋压制一族与国人，建立起战国大名的统治基础，晴广又于1555年颁布著名的分国法《相良氏法度》。在岛津氏扩张的压力下，相良氏于1581年臣服；丰臣秀吉九州征伐后，其领地被削减到旧领人吉一地。江户时代相良氏历任人吉藩藩主，明治维新后授子爵。

en: The Sahib Ataids, in Turkish the Sâhipataoğulları, were a short-lived beylik of central Anatolia founded by the sons of Fakhr al-Din Ali, better known as Sâhib Ata, the grand vizier who dominated the Seljuk Sultanate of Rûm after the Parwana's death in 1277. Released from Ilkhanid imprisonment in 1275, Sâhib Ata secured Afyonkarahisar, then called Karahisar-i Sâhib, as an estate for his sons Taceddin Hüseyin and Nusreddin Hasan, who ruled it jointly. Both were killed in 1277 at the Battle of Değirmençay fighting the Karamanid Mehmed Bey and his puppet claimant Jimri, and the line passed to Hasan's grandson Şemseddin Mehmed and then to Nusreddin Ahmed. When the Ilkhanid governor Timurtaş moved against the frontier beys, Ahmed took refuge with the Germiyanids, and after Timurtaş fled to Egypt in 1327 he returned to rule as a Germiyanid vassal. On his death around 1341 the beylik was absorbed by the Germiyanids, ending a state that had lasted barely two generations. Sâhib Ata himself was one of the great Seljuk builders, leaving mosques and madrasas from Konya to Sivas.
zh: 沙希布·阿塔家族在土耳其语中称沙希布帕塔奥乌拉勒，是安纳托利亚中部一个短命的贝伊国，由鲁姆塞尔柱大维齐尔法赫尔丁·阿里（通称沙希布·阿塔）的儿子们建立，他在1277年帕尔瓦纳去世后主导了塞尔柱朝政。1275年沙希布·阿塔获释出狱后，为儿子塔吉丁·侯赛因和努斯雷丁·哈桑求得了当时名为萨希布-卡拉希萨尔的阿夫永卡拉希萨尔作为封地，由兄弟二人共同统治。1277年，两人在代伊尔门恰伊战役中迎战卡拉曼的穆罕默德贝伊及其傀儡吉姆里，双双战死，家业先后传给哈桑之孙沙姆斯丁·穆罕默德和努斯雷丁·艾哈迈德。伊儿汗国总督帖木儿塔什出兵征讨边疆贝伊时，艾哈迈德投奔格尔米扬；1327年帖木儿塔什因父亲埃米尔·楚邦被伊儿汗不赛因处死而逃往埃及，艾哈迈德才得以返乡，却只能以格尔米扬附庸的身份统治。他于14世纪40年代初去世后，贝伊国约在1341年被格尔米扬吞并，这个仅历数代的小国就此终结。沙希布·阿塔本人是塞尔柱时代最伟大的营建者之一，在科尼亚和锡瓦斯等地留下了众多清真寺与经院。

en: The House of Salm was a Lotharingian noble family, possibly descended from Count Palatine Wigeric of Lotharingia and the House of Ardenne–Luxembourg. Giselbert, count from 1036, left the County of Salm to his younger son Hermann, who was elected German anti-king against Henry IV in 1081 and died in 1088. In 1163 the inheritance was split: Henry II kept Upper Salm in the Vosges, seated at Château de Salm near Alsace, while his sister Elizabeth and her husband Frederick II of Vianden founded the Lower Salm line in the Ardennes. The Lower Salm line died out in 1416 and passed to the Lords of Reifferscheid, while half of Upper Salm was inherited by the Rhinegraves in 1475 and the rest by the Dukes of Lorraine in 1600. The Rhinegraves took the Salm name, were raised to princes of the Empire in 1623, and branched into Salm-Salm, Salm-Kyrburg and Salm-Horstmar. Nicholas of Salm won fame commanding the defence of Vienna against the Ottomans in 1529. In the mediatisation of 1803 the princes received former Münster lands around Borken and Anholt, but their new principality was annexed by France in 1810 and mediatised to Prussia in 1815.
zh: 萨尔姆家族是洛塔林吉亚的贵族世家，可能出自洛塔林吉亚行宫伯爵维格里希与阿登—卢森堡家族。1036年起袭封伯爵的吉塞尔贝特把萨尔姆伯国传给幼子赫尔曼，赫尔曼于1081年被推举为对立国王、与亨利四世抗衡，1088年去世。1163年家产一分为二：亨利二世保有孚日山脉中的上萨尔姆，驻于阿尔萨斯附近的萨尔姆城堡；其妹伊丽莎白与丈夫维安登伯爵腓特烈二世则在阿登开创下萨尔姆支系。下萨尔姆支系于1416年绝嗣，领地由赖弗沙伊德领主继承；上萨尔姆则在1475年有一半落入莱茵伯爵之手，其余部分于1600年归洛林公爵。莱茵伯爵沿用萨尔姆之名，1623年升为帝国亲王，后来分出萨尔姆—萨尔姆、萨尔姆—基尔堡和萨尔姆—霍斯特马尔等支系。尼古拉·冯·萨尔姆因1529年指挥维也纳抵御奥斯曼人的防务而闻名。1803年帝国陪隶化中，诸亲王获得明斯特主教区在博尔肯和安霍尔特一带的旧地，但新建立的萨尔姆亲王国先于1810年被法国吞并，1815年又被陪隶给普鲁士。

en: The Sambuvarayas were Tamil chieftains of the Vanniyar community who held the Tondai Nadu country around Kanchipuram, with their hill capital at Padaiveedu. Under the imperial Cholas they governed the small district of Oyma Nadu as vassals; one of them, Edirili Chola Sambhuvaraya, served Rajadhiraja II and Kulothunga III. As Chola, Pandya and Hoysala power crumbled in the early fourteenth century, the family struck out on its own: Venrumankonda Sambuvaraya in 1322 and Rajanarayana Sambuvaraya in 1337 dated their inscriptions by their own regnal years, and Rajanarayana allied with the first Vijayanagara kings against the Madurai Sultanate. The rise of Vijayanagara then proved fatal. Around 1350 its armies defeated Rajanarayana and reinstated him as a tributary, and after his death about 1362 Kumara Kampana annexed Tondai Nadu, storming the fortress of Rajagambhiranmalai above Padaiveedu and slaying the last Sambuvaraya ruler.
zh: 三补缚罗耶尔是万尼耶尔社群的泰米尔首领家族，占据甘吉布勒姆一带的通代纳德地区，以山城波多毗都为都。朱罗帝国时期，他们作为附庸治理奥伊马纳德小邦，其中埃迪里利·朱罗·三补缚罗耶曾臣事罗阇迪罗阇二世与库罗通伽三世。14世纪初朱罗、潘地亚和曷萨拉相继瓦解，该家族自立：文鲁曼孔达·三补缚罗耶于1322年、拉贾纳拉亚纳·三补缚罗耶于1337年开始用自己的王号纪年，拉贾纳拉亚纳还曾与毗奢耶那伽罗初代君主结盟，共战马杜赖苏丹国。然而毗奢耶那伽罗的扩张最终葬送了他们：约1350年其军队击败拉贾纳拉亚纳，将他降为纳贡附庸；约1362年拉贾纳拉亚纳死后，库马拉·坎帕纳吞并通代纳德，攻破波多毗都上方的罗阇甘比兰马莱堡垒，杀死末代三补缚罗耶尔首领。

en: The Samma dynasty was a Muslim dynasty that ruled Sindh from its capital at Samanagar, later Thatta. The Sammas were a pastoral Sindhi tribe counted among the Jats, whose chiefs converted to Islam. They rose against the Delhi Sultanate: the traveller Ibn Battuta witnessed their revolt under Jam Tamachi in 1333, and after overthrowing the Soomra rulers the Samma chief Jam Unar founded an independent sultanate in 1351. Their rulers took the title Jam, meaning king, and claimed descent from the legendary Jamshid. The campaigns of Firuz Shah Tughlaq in 1365 and 1367 briefly forced them back under Delhi's overlordship, but the sultanate later regained full independence. It reached its height under Jam Nizamuddin II, known as Jam Nindho, who reigned from 1461 to 1508; his vizier Darya Khan defeated an Arghun invasion near Sibi, his rule is remembered as a golden age, and the Makli necropolis at Thatta took shape in his time. A succession war followed his death, and in 1519 Shah Beg Arghun defeated the last Jam, Feruz, at Fatehpur and replaced Samma rule with the Arghun dynasty. Related Samma clans remained across the border, among them the Jadejas and Chudasamas of Gujarat.
zh: 萨姆玛王朝是统治信德的穆斯林王朝，都城在萨马纳加尔，即后来的特达。萨姆玛人本是信德的游牧部落，被归入贾特人一类，其首领后来改宗伊斯兰教。他们起兵反抗德里苏丹国：旅行家伊本·白图泰在1333年亲眼见到他们在贾姆·塔马奇率领下反叛；推翻苏姆拉统治者后，萨姆玛首领贾姆·乌纳尔于1351年建立独立苏丹国。其君主使用意为“王”的贾姆头衔，并自称传说中贾姆希德的后裔。1365和1367年菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克两度征讨，一度迫使他们重新臣服德里，但苏丹国后来又恢复完全独立。王朝在贾姆·尼扎姆丁二世（绰号贾姆·宁多，1461—1508年在位）时达到鼎盛，他的维齐尔达里亚汗在锡比附近击败阿尔衮人的入侵；他的时代被视为黄金时代，特达的马克利墓葬群也在此时成形。他死后爆发继承战争，1519年沙贝格·阿尔浑在法塔赫布尔击败末代贾姆菲鲁兹，以阿尔衮王朝取代了萨姆玛王朝。与萨姆玛同源的氏族仍分布在邻境，古吉拉特的阇提奢和丘达萨马便是其中两支。

en: The Sangama was the first of the four dynasties that ruled the Vijayanagara Empire, named after Bhavana Sangama, a pastoral chieftain of claimed Yadava descent whose sons Harihara I and Bukka Raya I founded the empire in 1336. The brothers had served the fallen Hindu kingdoms of the Deccan until Muhammad bin Tughluq carried them off to Delhi in 1327 and converted them to Islam; sent south to restore order, they broke away, returned to Hinduism under the sage Vidyaranya and built their City of Victory on the Tungabhadra, filling the vacuum left by Kampili and the dying Hoysalas. Harihara I, reigning until 1356, absorbed the Hoysala lands after Veera Ballala III's death in 1343, and Bukka Raya I then fought the Bahmani Sultanate for the Raichur Doab while declaring equal protection for Hindus, Jains, Christians and Muslims. Harihara II pushed the frontier to the Goa coast, and the line reached its height under Deva Raya II from 1424 to 1446, whose dominions stretched from Ceylon to Gulbarga and whose wealth drew the Italian Nicolo Conti and the Persian envoy Abdur Razzak to a court rich in Kannada and Telugu poetry. Weak successors followed, and in 1485 the general Saluva Narasimha deposed the last Sangama king, Praudha Raya, opening the Saluva dynasty and leaving the Sangama name attached to the empire's heroic first century and a half.
zh: 桑迦摩王朝是毗奢耶那伽罗帝国四个王朝中的第一个，得名于巴瓦纳·桑迦摩——一位自称亚达瓦后裔的牧人酋长，其子诃里诃罗一世与布卡·拉惹一世于1336年建立帝国。兄弟二人本效力于德干那些覆灭的印度教政权，1327年被穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克掳往德里并被迫改宗伊斯兰教；后来他们被派回南方平乱，随即脱离德里，在隐士维迪亚兰雅引导下重归印度教，在通加巴德拉河畔建起“胜利之城”，填补了坎皮利与衰亡中的曷萨拉留下的权力真空。诃里诃罗一世统治至1356年，1343年曷萨拉国王维拉·巴拉拉三世死后吞并其疆土；布卡·拉惹一世接着为争夺赖丘尔河间地与巴赫曼尼苏丹国交战，同时宣布对印度教徒、耆那教徒、基督徒和穆斯林一体保护。诃里诃罗二世把疆界推到果阿海岸；1424至1446年德瓦·拉亚二世在位时王朝达到鼎盛，版图从锡兰延伸至古尔伯加，富庶的宫廷吸引意大利人尼科洛·孔蒂和波斯使者阿卜杜勒·拉扎格前来，卡纳达语与泰卢固语诗歌盛极一时。其后继者孱弱，1485年将领萨卢瓦·纳拉辛哈废黜末代桑迦摩国王普劳达·拉亚，开启萨卢瓦王朝；桑迦摩之名遂与帝国创业的最初一个半世纪连在一起。

en: The Sanudo were a Venetian noble family, recorded from the eleventh century, whose most famous branch built its fortune on the islands of the Aegean. After the Fourth Crusade, Marco I Sanudo, a nephew of Doge Enrico Dandolo, conquered Naxos with eight galleys in 1207 and went on to subdue most of the Cyclades, founding the Duchy of the Archipelago with its capital on Naxos. His descendants Angelo, Marco II, William I, Nicholas I and John I ruled the duchy through the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries as vassals successively of the Latin Empire, the princes of Achaea and the Angevin kings of Naples, losing many of the smaller islands to a Byzantine reconquest in the late 1200s. The direct Sanudo line ended with Duchess Florence, who died in 1371; her successor was overthrown in 1383 by Francesco I Crispo, whose family then held the duchy until the Ottoman conquest. Other Sanudo branches remained in Venice, producing Marino Sanudo Torsello, a geographer and crusading publicist who died in 1338, and Marino Sanudo the Younger, whose diaries are a prime source for Venetian history around 1500.
zh: 萨努多家族是11世纪已有记载的威尼斯贵族世家，最显赫的一支在爱琴海岛屿上建立了功业。第四次十字军东征后，家族成员马可一世·萨努多——总督恩里科·丹多洛的外甥——于1207年率八艘桨帆船攻克纳克索斯，随后征服基克拉泽斯群岛大部，建立以纳克索斯为中心的群岛公国。他的后裔安杰洛、马可二世、威廉一世、尼古拉一世和约翰一世在13至14世纪相继统治公国，先后臣属于拉丁帝国、亚该亚亲王安茹王朝的那不勒斯国王；13世纪末拜占庭反攻时，公国丧失了许多较小的岛屿。萨努多嫡系在女公爵佛罗伦萨于1371年去世后断绝，其继业者于1383年被弗朗切斯科一世·克里斯波推翻，公国此后由克里斯波家族把持，直到被奥斯曼帝国征服。家族的其他支系留在威尼斯，出了1338年去世的地理学家、十字军宣传者马里诺·萨努多·托尔塞洛，以及日记成为1500年前后威尼斯史重要史料的“小马里诺·萨努多”。

en: The Saruhanids, in Turkish the Saruhanoğulları, were a Turkmen beylik of western Anatolia whose lands covered the Gediz valley around Manisa. Its founder Saruhan Bey, an emir of uncertain Oghuz or Kipchak origin who had served the Seljuk sultans, was sent against the Byzantine city of Manisa and weathered both the Alan mercenaries of the emperor's son Michael and the Catalan Company of Roger de Flor before finally taking the city in 1313 and making it his capital. Saruhan built a fleet and, in alliance with the neighbouring Aydınids, raided across the Aegean and joined Umur Bey's expeditions to Thrace; his eldest son Süleyman died there in 1345 and the grieving founder followed him in 1346. His successors İlyas Bey and İshak Bey maintained the principality and its trading towns such as Menemen and Gördes. After the Battle of Kosovo in 1389 the Saruhanids sided with the Karamanids against the Ottomans, and Bayezid I overran the beylik in 1390. Timur restored it after the Battle of Ankara in 1402, but the Ottoman sultan Mehmed I extinguished the revived line in 1412 and turned Saruhan into an Ottoman province.
zh: 萨鲁汗奥乌拉勒家族是西安纳托利亚的土库曼贝伊国，领有马尼萨周围的盖迪兹河流域。开国者萨鲁汗贝伊的族源尚无定论，有乌古斯或钦察两种说法，他本是效力塞尔柱苏丹的埃米尔，受命进攻拜占庭城市马尼萨；他先后顶住了拜占庭皇子米海尔麾下的阿兰佣兵和罗吉尔·德·弗洛尔率领的加泰罗尼亚佣兵团，最终于1313年攻克该城并定为都城。萨鲁汗建立舰队，与邻邦艾登结盟，纵横爱琴海从事袭掠，还随乌穆尔贝伊远征色雷斯；其长子苏莱曼于1345年在色雷斯战死后，悲伤的老贝伊也在次年去世。后继的伊利亚斯贝伊和伊沙克贝伊维持着这个拥有梅内门、格尔德斯等商贸城镇的公国。1389年科索沃战役后，萨鲁汗人站在卡拉曼一边对抗奥斯曼，巴耶济德一世遂于1390年攻灭该贝伊国。1402年安卡拉战役后帖木儿将其复国，但奥斯曼苏丹穆罕默德一世在1412年终结了复辟的萨鲁汗世系，把这片土地改为奥斯曼的行省。

en: The Satake were a samurai clan of Hitachi Province who claimed descent from the Minamoto: their founder Satake Masayoshi was a grandson of the eleventh-century warrior Minamoto no Yoshimitsu and settled at Satake village in Hitachi. Masayoshi was killed in a rising against Minamoto no Yoshikuni in 1106, and during the Genpei War his son Takayoshi backed the Taira, so the clan was crushed by Minamoto no Yoritomo in 1180 and only readmitted to his service nine years later under Takayoshi's son Hideyoshi. In the Muromachi period the Satake heads served as hereditary shugo governors of Hitachi under the Kamakura-kubō. During the Sengoku wars Satake Yoshishige, nicknamed Oni Yoshishige for his ferocity, repeatedly checked the expansion of the Later Hōjō, notably at the Battle of Numajiri, and his son Yoshinobu submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi at Odawara in 1590 and was confirmed as lord of most of Hitachi. Having sided with the Western Army at Sekigahara in 1600, the clan was transferred in 1602 to the smaller Kubota Domain in Dewa Province, where the Satake ruled as daimyō throughout the Edo period.
zh: 佐竹氏是常陆国的武家，自称源氏后裔：其始祖佐竹昌义是11世纪武将源义光之孙，定居于常陆的佐竹乡。1106年，昌义在反抗源义国的起事兵败被杀；源平合战时，其子隆义站在平清盛一方，因此于1180年被源赖朝击败并没收领地，直到九年后隆义之子秀义才获赦免，成为赖朝的御家人。室町时代，佐竹当主在镰仓公方麾下世袭常陆国守护。战国乱世中，以勇猛著称、绰号“鬼义重”的佐竹义重屡次阻击后北条氏的扩张，沼尻一战尤为知名；其子佐竹义宣于1590年小田原征伐时归顺丰臣秀吉，获封常陆国大部分领地。1600年关原之战中佐竹加入西军，战后于1602年被转封到出羽国领地较小的久保田藩，即秋田藩，此后整个江户时代皆以大名身份存续。

en: The House of Savoy was founded in 1003 around the Alpine county of Sabaudia, then part of the Kingdom of Burgundy, by Humbert I, called Biancamano, whose family held lands near Vienne. Its rise began with a marriage: Humbert's son Otto wed Adelaide, heiress of Turin and Susa, in the mid-eleventh century, bringing Turin and Pinerolo and the western Piedmont into the family's hands. From their castles at Chambéry and the Château de Chillon the counts controlled key Alpine passes and gradually enlarged their holdings. In 1337 the county was ruled by Count Aymon, and in 1416 Amadeus VIII was raised to Duke of Savoy by the Holy Roman Emperor Sigismund. French armies overran most of the duchy in 1536, but Emmanuel Philibert, serving the Habsburgs, won the battle of Saint-Quentin in 1557 and recovered his lands under the Peace of Cateau-Cambrésis in 1559, moving the capital from Chambéry to Turin in 1563. Victor Amadeus II gained the Kingdom of Sicily in 1713 and exchanged it in 1720 for the Kingdom of Sardinia, ruling thereafter as the kingdom of Piedmont-Sardinia, to which Genoa was added in 1815.
zh: 萨伏依王朝于1003年前后由亨伯特一世（绰号“白手”）在阿尔卑斯山区的萨包迪亚伯国创立，当时这里属于勃艮第王国，其家族在维埃纳一带有大片领地。家族的崛起得益于一场联姻：11世纪中叶，亨伯特之子奥托娶了都灵与苏萨女继承人阿德莱德，将都灵、皮内罗洛和皮埃蒙特西部纳入家族版图。历代伯爵以尚贝里城堡和希永城堡为据点，控制阿尔卑斯山的关键山口，逐步扩张领地。1337年在位的是艾蒙伯爵；1416年，阿梅迪奥八世被神圣罗马帝国皇帝西吉斯蒙德册封为萨伏依公爵。1536年法军占领了公国大部，但埃马努埃莱·菲利贝托效力哈布斯堡阵营，于1557年取得圣康坦战役的胜利，并在1559年的《卡托-康布雷西和约》中收复故土，又于1563年把首都从尚贝里迁至都灵。维托里奥·阿梅迪奥二世于1713年获得西西里王国，1720年以西西里换取撒丁王国，此后以皮埃蒙特-撒丁王国的名义统治，1815年热那亚也被并入其领地。

en: The Sayfawa were the royal line of the Kanem–Bornu Empire around Lake Chad, ruling as mai from Njimi in Kanem for nearly eight hundred years, from the eleventh century to the middle of the nineteenth. According to the girgam, the royal chronicle, the line began with the twelfth mai, Hummay, and later tradition grafted its genealogy onto the Himyarite prince Sayf ibn Dhi Yazan to give it an Arabized origin. Under Dunama II Dibalemi, who reigned from about 1221 to 1259, Kanem reached its height: he built a large cavalry force, controlled the Fezzan and the trans-Saharan trade routes in salt, ivory and slaves, and drew the empire deeper into Islam. In the fourteenth century wars with the Bilala drove the court out of Kanem into the former tributary land of Bornu, where mai Ali I Gaji founded Ngazargamu as the new capital, and Idris III Katagarmabe later reconquered Kanem. Idris Alooma, who reigned from 1571 to 1603, made Bornu a leading power through firearms, mosques and Islamic law. The Fula jihads of the early nineteenth century broke the empire, and before long the last mai was overthrown, leaving power to the shehus of the al-Kanemi family.
zh: 赛法瓦王朝是乍得湖流域加涅姆-博尔努帝国的王室，自11世纪至19世纪中叶，以加涅姆的恩吉米为都城，历代君主称“麦”，统治近八百年。据王室编年史《吉尔加姆》记载，该世系始于第十二代麦胡马伊；后世传说又把其谱系接到希木叶尔王子塞夫·伊本·迪·雅赞身上，为家族附会出阿拉伯渊源。在约1221至1259年在位的杜纳马二世·迪巴拉米治下，加涅姆达到鼎盛：他组建强大骑兵，控制费赞及贩运盐、象牙和奴隶的跨撒哈拉商路，并推动帝国进一步伊斯兰化。14世纪，与比拉拉人的战争迫使朝廷撤出加涅姆，迁往旧日的属国博尔努；麦阿里一世·加吉在那里兴建纳札加姆为新都城，后来伊德里斯三世·卡塔加马贝又收复了加涅姆。1571至1603年在位的伊德里斯·阿劳马凭借火器、清真寺和伊斯兰教法，使博尔努成为地区强国。19世纪初的富拉尼圣战摧毁了帝国，末代麦不久被废，权力落入卡内米家族的“谢胡”们手中。

en: The first counts of Sayn, named after Sayn Castle above the Rhine near Bendorf, appear in documents from 1139 and built up a scattered estate across the Westerwald, the Sieg valley and the Lower Rhine. In 1233 Count Henry was accused of devil-worship by the inquisitor Conrad of Marburg before an assembly of bishops at Mainz acquitted him; Conrad was killed on his journey back to Thuringia. When Henry died without male heirs in 1246, the county passed through his sister Adelheid, wife of Gottfried III of Sponheim, to the Sponheim family. Her grandson Gottfried I founded the second comital house of Sayn in 1266, and under his sons the lands were divided in 1294 between Sayn-Sayn under Johann II and Sayn-Homburg under Engelbert I, who received Vallendar and Homburg and whose line inherited the County of Wittgenstein and called itself Sayn-Wittgenstein from 1361. In the early fourteenth century Count Gottfried of Sayn strengthened the Westerwald lands through a deliberate policy of founding and fortifying towns. A feud with Katzenelnbogen ravaged the county in 1462, and around 1560 the counts introduced the Reformation. When the Sayn-Sayn line died out in 1608 its inheritance fell to Sayn-Wittgenstein, and after the Thirty Years' War it was split into the counties of Sayn-Altenkirchen and Sayn-Hachenburg.
zh: 第一代塞恩伯爵得名于本多夫附近莱茵河畔的塞恩城堡，1139年起见于文献，逐步在韦斯特林山、锡格河谷和下莱茵攒起一片分散的领地。1233年，塞恩的亨利被宗教裁判官康拉德·冯·马尔堡指控崇拜魔鬼，最终美因茨的主教会议判他无罪，而康拉德在返回图林根途中被杀。1246年亨利无男嗣而终，伯国经其姐、施蓬海姆的戈特弗里德三世之妻阿德尔海德转入施蓬海姆家族。她的孙子戈特弗里德一世于1266年开创了第二个塞恩伯爵世家；1294年，戈特弗里德的儿子们瓜分领地：约翰二世得到塞恩-塞恩，恩格尔贝特一世得到法伦达尔与洪堡，后者一支又继承维特根施泰因伯国，自1361年起改称塞恩-维特根施泰因。14世纪初，塞恩的戈特弗里德伯爵通过有计划地营建和加固城镇来巩固韦斯特林山的领地。1462年伯国遭卡岑埃尔恩博根家族的仇杀兵祸，约1560年伯爵们推行宗教改革。1608年塞恩-塞恩支绝嗣，遗产落入塞恩-维特根施泰因之手；三十年战争后又分裂为塞恩-阿尔滕基兴与塞恩-哈亨堡两个伯国。

en: The della Scala, known in Latin as the Scaligeri, were the signori of Verona from 1259, when Mastino I della Scala turned the office of podestà into a family lordship, until 1387. Cangrande I, who ruled from 1308, was the family's greatest prince: a soldier and Ghibelline leader who added Vicenza, Padua and Treviso to the Scaliger state and patronised Dante, Petrarch and Giotto. His nephew Mastino II bought Parma and Lucca and for a time made Verona the strongest power in northern Italy, until a league of Venice, Florence, the Visconti, the Este and the Gonzaga defeated him in 1337–1340 and stripped his dominions back to Verona and Vicenza. The later Scaligeri were marked by fratricidal feuds: Cansignorio murdered Cangrande II in 1359, and Antonio della Scala killed his own brother before Gian Galeazzo Visconti drove him out of Verona in 1387. A brief restoration under Guglielmo della Scala in 1404 ended with his death after ten days, and Verona passed to the Republic of Venice in 1405. The family's Gothic tombs still stand beside the church of Santa Maria Antica in Verona, while the celebrated humanist scholars Julius Caesar Scaliger and Joseph Justus Scaliger claimed, probably falsely, to descend from the house.
zh: 德拉·斯卡拉家族（拉丁文献中称斯卡拉杰里）自1259年起任维罗纳领主，家族的马斯蒂诺一世把市政长官之职变成了世袭僭主统治，直到1387年覆亡。1308年起执政的坎格兰德一世是家族最杰出的君主：他身为吉伯林派军事领袖，先后将维琴察、帕多瓦和特雷维索并入斯卡拉领地，并庇护过但丁、彼特拉克和乔托。其侄马斯蒂诺二世买下帕尔马和卢卡，一度使维罗纳成为北意大利最强势力，但威尼斯、佛罗伦萨、维斯孔蒂、埃斯特和贡扎加结成联盟，在1337至1340年的战争中将其击败，斯卡拉领地被削回维罗纳和维琴察。后期家族内讧不断、兄弟相残：坎西尼奥里奥于1359年谋害坎格兰德二世，安东尼奥·德拉·斯卡拉又杀死亲弟，最终在1387年被吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂逐走。1404年古列尔莫·德拉·斯卡拉一度复辟，却在十天后死去，维罗纳于1405年并入威尼斯共和国。家族在维罗纳的古圣玛丽亚教堂旁留下了一组哥特式陵墓；而著名人文主义学者尤利乌斯·凯撒·斯卡利杰和约瑟夫·尤斯图斯·斯卡利杰自称出自该家族，但这一血缘说法并不可靠。

en:
The House of Scarponnois was a Lotharingian noble dynasty named after the Scarponnois, its homeland in what is now the French department of Meurthe-et-Moselle; its branches ruled the counties of Ferrette, Lutzelbourg and Montbeliard and the County, later Duchy, of Bar. The first attested member was Richwin, count in the Scarponnois, who married Hildegard of Egisheim, sister of Pope Leo IX. His son Louis of Mousson, castellan of Montbeliard, Altkirch and Ferrette, married Sophia of Bar in 1038 and inherited Bar, Amance and Sarreguemines, making his house one of the greatest in Lotharingia. Louis's son Dietrich I married the heiress of Montbeliard, and a partition between his three sons split the lands into Ferrette under Frederick I, Bar under Rainald I and Montbeliard under Dietrich II; the Montbeliard line died out in 1148 and passed to the House of Montfaucon.

The Ferrette branch ended when Count Ulrich III died without sons in March 1324. His daughter Joanna, countess in her own right, married Duke Albert II of Austria in Vienna on 26 March 1324 and carried the Sundgau lands, including Belfort, to the Habsburgs; she died in 1351 and her sister Ursula in 1367. The Bar branch, raised to a duchy in 1354, lost its duke Edward and other princes at Agincourt in 1415; Cardinal Louis of Bar then transferred the duchy to Rene of Anjou by the Treaty of Saint-Mihiel in 1419, and with the death of Johanna of Marle in 1462 the entire dynasty became extinct.
zh:
斯卡波努瓦家族是洛塔林吉亚的贵族王朝，得名于其故乡斯卡波努瓦（在今法国默尔特-摩泽尔省境内），家族各支先后统治费雷特、吕策尔堡、蒙贝利亚尔等伯爵国以及后来升为公国的巴尔伯国。可考的最早成员是斯卡波努瓦伯爵里希温，他娶了教宗利奥九世的姊妹埃吉斯海姆的希尔德加德。其子穆松的路易担任蒙贝利亚尔、阿尔特基什和费雷特的城主，1038年娶巴尔的索菲娅为妻并继承巴尔、阿芒斯和萨尔格米讷，使家族跻身洛塔林吉亚最显赫的门第之列。路易之子迪特里希一世娶蒙贝利亚尔女继承人为妻，后来他的三个儿子分家：腓特烈一世得费雷特，雷纳德一世得巴尔，迪特里希二世得蒙贝利亚尔；蒙贝利亚尔支系于1148年绝嗣，领地转入蒙福孔家族。

费雷特支系终结于1324年3月：伯爵乌尔里希三世无子而终，其女约翰娜以女继承人身份成为费雷特有爵女，1324年3月26日在维也纳嫁给奥地利公爵阿尔布雷希特二世，把包括贝尔福在内的松德高领地带入哈布斯堡家族；她于1351年去世，其妹乌尔苏拉逝于1367年。巴尔支系于1354年升为公国，1415年公爵爱德华等宗族王公在阿金库尔战役中阵亡；枢机主教巴尔的路易遂于1419年依《圣米耶勒条约》把公国传给安茹的勒内。1462年马尔勒的约翰娜去世，整个王朝最终绝嗣。

en: The Schauenburg took their name from Schauenburg Castle above the Weser near Rinteln, built or enlarged by Adolf I around 1100. In 1110 Duke Lothair of Saxony enfeoffed him with Holstein and Stormarn, including Hamburg, and the family thus became the leading power between the Elbe and the Danish border. Adolf II rebuilt the Siegesburg at Segeberg, founded Lübeck in 1143 and brought Westphalian and Dutch colonists to settle the Slavic lands. Adolf III lost Holstein to Denmark at Stellau in 1201, but Adolf IV won it back at Bornhöved in 1227 and took the title count of Holstein. From 1261 the house split into the lines of Itzehoe, Kiel, Plön, Pinneberg and Rendsburg, so that in 1337 several Schauenburg counts ruled at once, while the ancestral County of Schauenburg remained with Pinneberg. Its strongest figure was Gerhard III of Rendsburg, who defeated King Christopher II of Denmark in 1326, placed his nephew Waldemar III on the Danish throne and governed the kingdom as regent until he was killed in 1340; his line also held the Duchy of Schleswig from 1375. When the Rendsburg line died out in 1459, the Holstein nobility elected the Danish king Christian I in 1460. The Pinneberg line, which introduced the Reformation in 1559, survived until Count Otto V died childless in 1640; Schaumburg was then divided among Hesse-Cassel, Lippe and Lüneburg.
zh: 绍恩堡家族得名于林特尔恩附近、雄踞威悉河上的绍恩堡城堡，约1100年由阿道夫一世修建或扩建。1110年，萨克森公爵洛塔尔把荷尔斯泰因和施托尔曼（含汉堡）封给阿道夫一世，家族由此成为易北河与丹麦边境之间的头号势力。阿道夫二世重修塞格贝格的胜利堡，1143年建立吕贝克，并从威斯特伐利亚和尼德兰招徕移民开垦斯拉夫人的土地。阿道夫三世在1201年的施特劳战役中把荷尔斯泰因丢给丹麦，阿道夫四世则在1227年的博恩赫沃德战役中将其收复，并采用荷尔斯泰因伯爵头衔。1261年起，家族分裂为伊策霍、基尔、普伦、平讷贝格和伦茨堡诸支，因此1337年有数位绍恩堡伯爵同时在位，祖传的绍恩堡伯国则随平讷贝格一支传承。家族最强者是伦茨堡的格哈德三世：他在1326年击败丹麦国王克里斯托弗二世，把外甥瓦尔德马尔三世扶上丹麦王位，以摄政身份统治整个丹麦，直到1340年被杀；他的支系还从1375年起领有石勒苏益格公国。1459年伦茨堡一支绝嗣，荷尔斯泰因贵族于1460年推举丹麦国王克里斯蒂安一世为君。平讷贝格一支在1559年推行宗教改革，延续到1640年奥托五世伯爵无嗣而终，绍恩堡伯国随后被黑森-卡塞尔、利珀和吕讷堡瓜分。

en: The lords of Schlüsselberg were a high-noble Franconian family, earlier called after Greifenstein, Creussen and Adelsdorf, who from 1219 took the name of their new Burg Schlüsselberg above the Wiesent near Waischenfeld in Franconian Switzerland. Eberhard I of Schlüsselberg, who died in 1243, had the castle built after 1216 on the border of the Bamberg bishopric to secure the road from Waischenfeld to Pottenstein, and his house grew into one of the leading free-noble dynasties of Franconia, assembling a substantial lordship in the Franconian Jura as unwelcome rivals of the prince-bishops of Bamberg. Eberhard II, who died in 1283, founded Schlüsselau Abbey in 1280 with his son Conrad I, while another son, Ulrich, was elected bishop of Bamberg in 1318 though never installed and became bishop of Brixen in 1322. Conrad II of Schlüsselberg, imperial banner-bearer from 1322 to 1336 and twice married into the Nuremberg Hohenzollern and Württemberg houses, brought the family's territory to its greatest extent and founded the town of Schlüsselfeld in 1336. He was mortally wounded at the siege of Burg Neideck on 14 September 1347, and with him the male line died out. The Treaty of Iphofen in 1349 divided the Schlüsselberg lands among the victors, the chief shares going to the Nuremberg burgraves and the bishopric of Bamberg.
zh: 施吕塞尔贝格领主是法兰克尼亚的高级贵族，早先曾以格莱芬施泰因、克罗伊森和阿多尔斯多夫为姓，1219年起改用在维森特河畔魏申费尔德附近新建的施吕塞尔贝格堡为家族名。1243年去世的埃伯哈德一世于1216年后在班贝格主教区边境修建该堡，以护卫魏申费尔德至波滕施泰因的道路；其家族后来跻身法兰克尼亚最重要的自由贵族之列，在弗兰肯汝拉山区建起可观的领地，成为班贝格亲王主教们忌惮的竞争对手。1283年去世的埃伯哈德二世于1280年与儿子康拉德一世共同创立施吕瑟尔奥修道院；另一个儿子乌尔里希1318年被选为班贝格主教但未获就任，1322年改任布里克森主教。康拉德二世1322至1336年任帝国旗手，先后与纽伦堡霍亨索伦家族和符腾堡家族联姻，他把家族领地扩张到极盛，并于1336年创建施吕瑟尔费尔德城。1347年9月14日，他在围攻奈德克堡时受致命伤，男系随之绝嗣。1349年的《伊普霍芬条约》把施吕塞尔贝格的产业分给战胜方，主要份额归纽伦堡城堡伯爵和班贝格主教区。

en: The lords of Schönburg were a noble house of southwestern Saxony, first documented in 1130 with one Ulricus de Schunenberg. Around 1170 they built a castle at Glauchau as an imperial fief and acquired the town outright in 1256; Glauchau remained the seat of their Glauchau line. Over the following centuries they added Lichtenstein in 1286, Waldenburg in 1378, the county of Hartenstein in 1406 and the lordships of Penig and Wechselburg in 1543, holding lands that straddled Saxony, Bohemia and Thuringia under direct imperial jurisdiction. The lordship was split into Upper and Lower Schönburg in 1569, and in 1700 Emperor Leopold I raised the whole house to the rank of imperial counts. From 1740 Saxony took the Schönburg estates under its guardianship and integrated them into its judicial structure within a decade. In 1790 Emperor Leopold II made the Waldenburg and Hartenstein branches princely houses; mediatised to Saxony in 1803 and 1806, the family received two seats in the Upper House of the Kingdom of Saxony in 1831.
zh: 舍恩堡领主是萨克森西南部的贵族世家，最早于1130年以乌尔里库斯·德·顺嫩贝格之名见诸文献。约1170年，他们在格劳豪修建了一座作为帝国采邑的城堡，并于1256年彻底取得该城；格劳豪此后成为其格劳豪支系的驻地。此后几个世纪里，家族又于1286年取得利希滕施泰因、1378年取得瓦尔登堡、1406年取得哈滕施泰因伯国、1543年取得佩尼希和韦克瑟尔堡领地，其地盘横跨萨克森、波希米亚和图林根，直属于帝国司法管辖。1569年领地被分为上舍恩堡和下舍恩堡，1700年皇帝利奥波德一世把整个家族升为帝国伯爵。1740年起，萨克森对舍恩堡领地实行监护，并在十年内将其纳入自身司法体系。1790年皇帝利奥波德二世把瓦尔登堡和哈滕施泰因两支升为亲王家族；1803至1806年间该家族被陪隶给萨克森，又于1831年在萨克森王国上院获得两个席位。

en: The House of Schwarzburg was one of the oldest high noble families of Thuringia, named after Schwarzburg Castle in the Schwarza valley west of Saalfeld, first recorded in 1071. Its first reliably documented member was Count Sizzo III of Kafernburg, who died in 1160, founded Georgenthal Abbey around 1142 and accompanied Emperor Frederick Barbarossa on his Polish campaign of 1157. In 1197 the heirs Henry II and Gunther III divided the lands, and Schwarzburg Castle, together with Blankenburg, became the family seat. The house's most famous son was Gunther XXI, elected German king by a majority of the electors in 1349, only to renounce the crown months later and die soon afterwards. Repeated partitions followed until Count Gunther XL the Rich reunited the family lands, including Frankenhausen and Rudolstadt, in 1538. After the death of Gunther XLI in 1583, his brothers split the county, and the Treaty of Stadtilm of 1599 fixed the two lines of Schwarzburg-Rudolstadt and Schwarzburg-Sondershausen. The Sondershausen line was raised to a principality in 1697 and the Rudolstadt line in 1711, when Count Albert Anton's son Louis Frederick I took the princely title. Both small states escaped the mediatisation of 1806, joined the Confederation of the Rhine and entered the German Confederation in 1815.
zh: 施瓦茨堡家族是图林根最古老的高级贵族世家之一，得名于萨尔费尔德以西施瓦察河谷中的施瓦茨堡城堡，该城堡1071年始见文献。家族第一位可确考的成员是凯弗恩堡伯爵西佐三世，他卒于1160年，约于1142年创建格奥尔根塔尔修道院，并在1157年随皇帝腓特烈一世（巴巴罗萨）出征波兰。1197年，继承人亨利二世与金特三世瓜分领地，施瓦茨堡城堡连同布兰肯堡成为家族驻地。家族最著名的人物是金特二十一世，他于1349年被多数选侯推举为德意志国王，却在数月后放弃王位，不久便去世。此后领地屡经分割，直到1538年金特四十世（富豪）重新统一了包括弗兰肯豪森和鲁多尔施塔特在内的家族土地。1583年金特四十一世去世后，其弟们再次瓜分伯国，1599年的《施塔特伊尔姆条约》确定了施瓦茨堡-鲁多尔施塔特和施瓦茨堡-松德斯豪森两支。松德斯豪森支于1697年升为侯国，鲁多尔施塔特支则于1711年升为侯国，由阿尔布雷希特·安东之子路德维希·弗里德里希一世首用亲王头衔。两个小国都躲过了1806年的吞并，加入莱茵联邦，又于1815年加入德意志邦联。

en: The counts of Schwerin originated in the Saxon conquest of the Wendish lands beyond the Elbe. After Henry the Lion defeated the Obotrite prince Niklot and took the Slavic stronghold of Schwerin in 1160, he enfeoffed his loyal follower Gunzelin von Hagen, first documented as Count Gunzelin I in 1161, and the bishopric of Mecklenburg was moved to Schwerin in 1162. The lordships of Wittenburg and Boizenburg were added in 1203 as Danish fiefs, but King Valdemar II of Denmark expelled the counts in 1208 and ruled the county until they did homage in 1214. Count Henry the Black then struck the most famous blow of the house: in 1223 he abducted Valdemar and his son from the Danish island of Lyoe, held them prisoner in his castles, defeated the Danish relief army at Moelln in 1225 and, by the Treaty of Bardowick, recovered the whole county, which after the Battle of Bornhoeved in 1227 returned to being a Saxon fief. Later generations used the names Gunzelin, Helmold, Niklot and Nicholas, and a younger son, Nicholas, inherited the County of Tecklenburg in 1328. When the elder line died out in 1344 and the Wittenburg branch lost its male heirs in 1357, the counts could no longer resist the dukes of Mecklenburg: the county was sold to them, the transfer being formalized by the Treaty of Plueschow in 1368, and Schwerin became one of the chief titles of the Mecklenburg dynasty.
zh: 什未林伯爵家族起源于萨克森人对易北河以外文德人土地的征服。1160年，狮子亨利击败奥博特人王公尼克洛特、攻占文德要塞什未林后，把此地封给忠仆贡策林·冯·哈根，后者于1161年首次以贡策林一世伯爵的身份见于文献；1162年梅克伦堡主教区也迁至什未林。1203年，维滕堡与博伊岑堡领地作为丹麦封地并入，但丹麦国王瓦尔德马二世于1208年驱逐伯爵、直接统治伯国，直到1214年伯爵们宣誓效忠才得以返回。后来的黑人亨利伯爵干出了家族最著名的一击：1223年他在丹麦吕岛绑架了瓦尔德马父子，囚禁在自己的城堡中，1225年在默尔恩击败丹麦援军，并凭《巴尔多维克条约》收回整个伯国；1227年博恩赫沃德之战后，什未林重新成为萨克森封地。后代反复使用贡策林、赫尔莫德、尼克洛特、尼古劳斯等名字，幼子尼古拉斯还于1328年入继泰克伦堡伯国。1344年长支断绝，1357年维滕堡支又失去男嗣，伯爵们再也抵挡不住梅克伦堡公爵的压力，伯国被出售给对方，1368年的《普吕绍条约》正式确认了这次转让，什未林从此成为梅克伦堡家族的主要头衔之一。

en: Selimbau was the leading river kingdom of the upper Kapuas basin in what is now Kapuas Hulu in West Kalimantan. Remembered locally as the oldest Hindu kingdom in the region with a fully formed court, it was first called Pelembang and founded by Sri Paduka Maharaja Bindu Mahkota, also known as Abang Bindu Mahkota, whose seat lay about two kilometres from the later town of Selimbau. Its rulers passed through twenty-five generations, beginning as Hindu rajas and later converting to Islam, and ranked above the smaller neighbouring Malay chiefdoms of Suhai, Jongkong, Bunut and Silat. In the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries Selimbau traded and fought along the Kapuas within the influence of the Sambas Sultanate, its power reaching upriver toward the Sarawak border. The Dutch colonial government recognised its standing in an 1823 treaty that acknowledged Selimbau's primacy over the smaller chiefdoms of the upper Kapuas.
zh: 塞林包是西加里曼丹上卡普阿斯河流域首屈一指的河畔王国，当地传统称它是西加里曼丹最古老、建制完备的印度教王国。该国初名佩莱邦，由斯里·帕杜卡·摩诃罗阇·宾杜·马科塔（又称阿邦·宾杜·马科塔）创建，王址距后来的塞林包镇约两公里。其王统传了二十五代，初为印度教罗阇，后改宗伊斯兰教，地位高于苏海、宗孔、布努、锡拉特等邻近的马来小邦。17—18世纪，塞林包在卡普阿斯河沿线征战贸易，处于三发苏丹国的势力影响之下，势力溯河延伸至砂拉越边界。1823年，荷兰殖民政府与塞林包缔约，承认它在上卡普阿斯诸小邦中的宗主地位。

en: Al-e Saljuq, the House of Seljuq, takes its name from Seljuk, a Turkic clan leader whose followers converted to Islam around the tenth century and built an empire stretching from Persia to the Mediterranean. A branch of the family founded the Sultanate of Rum after the Seljuk victory at Manzikert in 1071 and fixed its capital at Konya; under Kayqubad I in the early thirteenth century it was the leading power of Anatolia, lining the trade roads with caravanserais, mosques and medreses. The Mongol victory at Köse Dağ in 1243 reduced the Rum sultans to Ilkhanid vassals, and Turkmen commanders carved independent beyliks out of their realm. Kayqubad III was executed by the Ilkhan in 1302, and the last sultan, Mesud II, was murdered in 1308, bringing the Anatolian line of the house to an end; Konya and the other Seljuk lands were then divided among successor principalities such as the Karamanids and Germiyanids.
zh: 塞尔柱家族（Al-e Saljuq）得名于10世纪前后率部皈依伊斯兰教的突厥首领塞尔柱，其后人建立了从波斯一直延伸到地中海的大帝国。1071年曼齐刻尔特战役获胜后，家族支系建立罗姆苏丹国并定都科尼亚；13世纪初凯库巴德一世在位时，它是安纳托利亚首屈一指的强国，商路沿线广建商队驿站、清真寺和经学院。1243年克塞山败于蒙古后，罗姆苏丹沦为伊儿汗国的附庸，突厥首领们在其境内割据出一个个独立的贝伊国。凯库巴德三世于1302年被伊儿汗处死，末代苏丹梅苏德二世又在1308年遇害，家族在安纳托利亚的统绪就此断绝，科尼亚等塞尔柱故地随后被卡拉曼、格尔米扬等后继贝伊国瓜分。

en: The Sen house, whose clan name was Suketi or Suketr, supplied the rajas of the Punjab Hill state of Suket, with its capital at Pangna. Tradition traces the line to Bira Sen, said to descend from the Sena dynasty of Bengal, and every ruler took the surname Sen. Suket's early centuries were spent in constant hill warfare, above all against neighbouring Kullu; Raja Bikram Sen forced Kullu to pay tribute, and the reign of Raja Madan Sen was remembered as the state's golden age, when the smaller neighbouring principalities submitted. Under Raja Udai Sen, Suket acknowledged Mughal overlordship and paid tribute rather than accepting direct rule. The diplomacy of Raja Bikram Sen II carried the state through the Gurkha invasion of 1803 to 1815 and the following years of Sikh dominance with its ruling house intact.
zh: 森氏家族（氏族名为苏凯蒂或苏凯特尔）是旁遮普山丘邦苏凯特的罗阇世系，王都设在彭格纳。按传统说法，其世系可追溯到维拉·森，据称出自孟加拉的犀那王朝，历代统治者都以“森”为姓。苏凯特早年不断卷入山地战事，尤以同邻国库鲁的战争为甚；罗阇比克拉姆·森迫使库鲁纳贡，罗阇马登·森在位时被视为本邦的黄金时代，邻近小邦纷纷臣服。罗阇乌代·森时期，苏凯特承认莫卧儿宗主权，以纳贡换取免于被直接统治。罗阇比克拉姆·森二世凭借外交手腕，使本邦熬过1803至1815年的廓尔喀入侵和随后的锡克称霸岁月，统治家族得以保全。

en: The Serra Bas, also called the De Serra-Bas or House of Bas, were the ruling dynasty of the Judicate of Arborea, the most enduring of the four Sardinian judge-kingdoms, with its capital at Oristano. The line emerged from the House of Cervera after the Treaty of Oristano of 1192, and judges such as Marianus II reunited the realm and briefly held most of Sardinia while the other three judicates fell to Pisa and Genoa. Hugh II allied with Aragon in the 1320s, but his son Marianus IV, known as the Great, turned against the Aragonese and in the Sardinian-Catalan war conquered almost the whole island, leaving only Cagliari, Alghero and Sassari in enemy hands. His daughter Eleanor, regent for her young sons after Hugh III died without heirs in 1383, upheld the revolt and gave Arborea its celebrated legal code, the Carta de Logu. The dynasty's fortunes collapsed after the Aragonese victory at the Battle of Sanluri in 1409 and the fall of Oristano in 1410; Eleanor's grandson Marianus V died in 1407, and the rival Narbonne claim was bought out by Alfonso V of Aragon in 1420, opening the way to the final Aragonese conquest of Sardinia.
zh: 塞拉巴斯家族（又译德·塞拉-巴斯，或称巴斯家族）是撒丁岛四大朱迪卡蒂（法官王国）中国祚最长的阿尔博雷阿的统治王朝，以奥里斯塔诺为都。该支系出自塞尔维拉家族，在1192年《奥里斯塔诺条约》后掌权；马里亚诺二世等法官重新统一王国，一度据有撒丁岛大部，而其余三个朱迪卡蒂此时已落入比萨和热那亚之手。乌戈二世在14世纪20年代与阿拉贡结盟，但其子“伟人”马里亚诺四世转而反抗阿拉贡，在撒丁-加泰罗尼亚战争中几乎征服全岛，仅卡利亚里、阿尔盖罗和萨萨里仍在敌手。1383年乌戈三世无嗣而终后，其女埃莱奥诺拉代幼子摄政，坚持抵抗，并颁布了著名的《卡尔塔·德·洛古》法典。1409年阿拉贡在圣卢里战役取胜、1410年奥里斯塔诺陷落，家族国运随之崩溃：埃莱奥诺拉之孙马里亚诺五世于1407年去世，纳博讷家族的继承权又于1420年被阿拉贡的阿方索五世买下，为阿拉贡最终征服撒丁岛铺平了道路。

en: The Shah house of Sonargaon is the Mubarak Shahi dynasty, founded by Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah, a Bengali Muslim from Noakhali who rose to be chief armour-bearer of Bahram Khan, the Delhi governor of Sonargaon. When Bahram Khan died in 1337, Fakhruddin seized the city and declared himself an independent sultan, making Sonargaon his capital. He defeated and executed Qadar Khan, the governor of Lakhnauti who had marched against him, and went on to take Comilla, Noakhali and Sylhet; in 1340 he became the first Muslim ruler to conquer Chittagong, Bengal's chief port. He built roads, embankments, mosques and tombs, and Ibn Battuta, visiting Sonargaon in 1346, praised him as a sovereign who welcomed strangers and Sufis. He died in 1349 and was succeeded by Ikhtiyaruddin Ghazi Shah, probably his son, who ruled until 1352, when Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah conquered Sonargaon and united Bengal under the Bengal Sultanate.
zh: 索纳尔冈的沙家族即穆巴拉克沙希王朝，开创者是出身诺阿卡利的孟加拉穆斯林法赫尔丁·穆巴拉克沙，他原是德里任命的索纳尔冈总督巴赫拉姆汗的首席军械官。1337年巴赫拉姆汗死后，法赫尔丁夺取该城并自立为独立苏丹，以索纳尔冈为都，建立穆巴拉克沙希王朝。他击败并处死了率军来攻的拉克瑙提总督卡达尔汗，随后攻取库米拉、诺阿卡利和锡尔赫特；1340年，他成为第一位征服孟加拉主要港口吉大港的穆斯林统治者。他修筑道路、堤防、清真寺和陵墓；伊本·白图泰1346年到访索纳尔冈时，称赞他是善待外来者和苏菲修士的君主。他于1349年去世，由很可能是其子的伊赫提亚鲁丁·加齐沙继位；后者统治到1352年，索纳尔冈被沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯沙攻克，孟加拉由此统一于孟加拉苏丹国。

en: The Shah gauda line is the short-lived sultanate of Alauddin Ali Shah, born Ali Mubarak into a Turco-Persian Muslim noble family. After serving Malik Firuz in Delhi he fell out of favour and moved to Bengal, where he became army administrator of Qadar Khan, the Delhi governor of Lakhnauti. When Qadar Khan was killed fighting Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah of Sonargaon, Ali Shah murdered the deputy governor left behind and, around 1339, made himself independent ruler of Lakhnauti while Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq was distracted elsewhere. Bengal was now split three ways, between Ali Shah at Gaur, Fakhruddin at Sonargaon and Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah at Satgaon, and Ibn Battuta called the war between Ali Shah and Fakhruddin a bitter one. Ali Shah moved his capital from Lakhnauti to Hazrat Pandua, but in 1342 he was defeated and killed in battle against Ilyas Shah, who went on to unite the whole of Bengal under the Bengal Sultanate.
zh: 沙·高达一脉是阿拉丁·阿里沙建立的短命苏丹国；他本名阿里·穆巴拉克，出身突厥—波斯风格的穆斯林贵族家庭。他先在德里侍奉马利克·菲鲁兹，失宠后前往孟加拉，担任德里任命的拉克瑙提总督卡达尔汗的军政官。卡达尔汗在与索纳尔冈的法赫尔丁·穆巴拉克沙交战中被杀后，阿里沙杀死留守的副总督，并趁苏丹穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克无暇东顾，于1339年前后自立为拉克瑙提的独立君主。此时孟加拉三分：阿里沙据高达，法赫尔丁据索纳尔冈，沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯沙据萨特冈；伊本·白图泰称阿里沙与法赫尔丁之间的战争十分惨烈。阿里沙把首都从拉克瑙提迁往哈兹拉特·潘杜阿，但1342年他在与伊利亚斯沙的会战中兵败身亡，后者随后统一整个孟加拉，建立孟加拉苏丹国。

en: The Shah taraf house descends from Syed Nasiruddin, a Sufi and soldier born in Baghdad into a Syed family that claimed descent from the Twelve Imams. After the Mongols under Hulagu Khan sacked Baghdad in 1258 he migrated first to Delhi and then to Bengal, joined the Suhrawardiyya order, and rose to be army commander of Sultan Shamsuddin Firoz Shah of Lakhnauti. In 1303 he led the sultan's troops alongside Shah Jalal and his followers in the conquest of Sylhet, which overthrew the Hindu raja Gour Govinda. Sent next against the neighbouring kingdom of Tungachal, whose ruler Achak Narayan had executed a Muslim qadi, he took it without a fight in 1304, renamed it Taraf and was appointed its governor. Buried at Murarband, where his tomb became a shrine, he left a line of hereditary rulers who made Taraf a noted centre of Islamic learning until the Twipra kingdom conquered it, followed in turn by Khwaja Usman and the Mughals.
zh: 沙·塔拉夫家族出自赛义德·纳西尔丁；他是苏菲修士兼军人，生于巴格达的一个赛义德家族，自称是十二伊玛目的后裔。1258年旭烈兀率蒙古人洗劫巴格达后，他先迁居德里，再转往孟加拉，加入苏赫拉瓦迪耶教团，后来成为拉克瑙提苏丹沙姆斯丁·菲鲁兹沙的军队统帅。1303年，他与沙阿·贾拉勒及其弟子们并肩率军征服锡尔赫特，推翻印度教罗阇古尔·戈文达。随后他进兵邻近的图恩加查尔——其君主阿查克·纳拉扬处死了一名穆斯林卡迪，于1304年兵不血刃地将其攻取，改名塔拉夫并受任为总督。他葬在穆拉尔班德，陵墓后来成为圣祠；其后人世代统治塔拉夫，把这里建成著名的伊斯兰学术中心，直到塔拉夫被特维普拉王国征服，之后又先后落入赫瓦贾·乌斯曼和莫卧儿人之手。

en: The Shiba were a cadet branch of the Ashikaga house and traced their descent from the Seiwa-Genji, the Minamoto line of Emperor Seiwa. At the end of the thirteenth century Shiba Ieuji, son of Ashikaga Yasuuji, took the Shiba name, and the family held lands in Mutsu Province in northern Honshū while also inheriting the governorship of Owari. Shiba Takatsune sided with Ashikaga Takauji against Emperor Go-Daigo in 1335 and was rewarded with the shugo governorships of Echizen and Wakasa when the Ashikaga shogunate was founded. His son Yoshimasa became kanrei, deputy to the shogun, in 1379, an office held in turn by his son and grandson. Succession disputes weakened the house by the mid-fifteenth century, and its feud with rival houses helped spark the Ōnin War of 1467 to 1477, during which the Asakura seized Echizen. Reduced to figureheads in Owari, the last Shiba lord Yoshimune was killed by Oda Nobutomo in 1554, and the clan effectively ended with Yoshikane's death in 1572.
zh: 斯波氏是足利家的支流，自称出自清和天皇一脉的清和源氏。13世纪末，足利泰氏之子斯波家氏取斯波为苗字，家族在本州北部的陆奥国拥有领地，同时世袭尾张国守护职。1335年，斯波高经在对抗后醍醐天皇的战事中追随足利尊氏，室町幕府建立后受封越前、若狭两国守护。其子义将在1379年出任管领，即幕府将军的副手，此后其孙、曾孙相继担任此职。15世纪中期，家族陷入继承纷争，与诸家的争斗成为1467至1477年应仁之乱的诱因之一，越前也在此期间被朝仓氏夺取。斯波家在尾张沦为傀儡，末代当主斯波义统于1554年被织田信友杀害，至1572年斯波义银死后，斯波氏实质上灭亡。

en: The Shijō were a court noble house of Kyoto, the chief line of the Uona branch of the Northern Fujiwara, ranked among the urin families eligible for the highest court offices. They took shape in the late Heian period around Fujiwara no Akisue, whose mother had nursed Emperor Shirakawa and whose favour carried him to senior third rank; the house name came from the Shijō-Ōmiya mansion of his descendant Takasue, a trusted minister of Retired Emperor Go-Shirakawa who rose to provisional major counselor. The family's hereditary craft was the culinary art of carving and serving at court banquets, known as the Shijō school, said to begin when Ienari displayed his skill with a carp before Emperor Sutoku in 1140, and they also cultivated the shō mouth organ. In the Kamakura period Takafusa won fame as a poet, and his granddaughter Teishi, wife of Saionji Saneuji and mother of two empresses, was named a quasi-empress and lived to one hundred and seven. The Nanboku-chō wars split the house: Takasuke died fighting for the Southern Court at the Battle of Yawata, and his son Takatoshi briefly seized Kyoto from Ashikaga Yoshiakira in 1353 before falling in battle in 1373. The main line died out in 1567 and was revived in 1575 by a son of the Reizei house; after years of disfavour spent in Sakai he was pardoned in 1601 through Tokugawa Ieyasu, and the Shijō served the court through the Edo period on a stipend of one hundred and eighty koku.
zh: 四条家是京都的公家贵族，为藤原北家鱼名流（四条流）的嫡流，家格属于可升任公卿的羽林家。家族形成于平安后期，家祖藤原显季之母是白河天皇的乳母，他凭这层关系官至正三位；家名则来自其后人隆季在四条大宫的宅邸，隆季受后白河法皇重用，官至正二位权大纳言。四条家的家业是在宫廷飨宴上操刀切鱼的“庖丁道”，即四条流料理，据说始于1140年家成在崇德天皇御前当众料理鲤鱼的绝技；笙也是其家学。镰仓时代，隆房以和歌闻名，其孙女贞子嫁给西园寺实氏，所生两女都成为中宫，本人受封准后，享年一百零七岁。南北朝战乱使家门分裂：隆资作为南朝的公家大将战死于八幡之战，其子隆俊于1353年击败足利义诠一度攻入京都，1373年亦战死。嫡系于1567年一度断绝，1575年由冷泉家出身的家贤改名隆昌再兴家门；他长期获罪蛰居堺，1601年经德川家康奏请才获敕许赦免、重返京都。整个江户时代，四条家以一百八十石的俸禄继续侍奉朝廷。

en: The Shimazu were the warrior lords of southern Kyūshū, whose founder Tadahisa, said to be a son of Minamoto no Yoritomo though probably of Koremune descent, was made steward of the Shimazu estate, then the largest in Japan, in 1185 and shugo of Satsuma, Ōsumi and Hyūga. In 1333 the fifth head, Sadahisa, joined Emperor Go-Daigo's attack on the Chinzei tandai and later fought for Ashikaga Takauji at Tatarahama. On his death he divided the inheritance between his sons Morohisa and Ujihisa, creating the Sōshū and Ōshū lines whose rivalry weakened the house through much of the Muromachi period, until the Sengoku head Takahisa reunited Satsuma and Ōsumi by force. His son Yoshihisa, the sixteenth head, then came close to conquering all Kyūshū, crushing the Ryūzōji at Okita Nawate in 1584, where Ryūzōji Takanobu was killed, and overrunning the Ōtomo lands; the Shimazu were also among the first Japanese commanders to deploy matchlocks and built their campaigns around disciplined arquebus volleys. Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyūshū campaign of 1587 checked them at Nejirozaka, but they surrendered in time to keep Satsuma, Ōsumi and part of Hyūga. Although Yoshihiro joined the western army at Sekigahara in 1600, the clan kept its domains and entered the Edo period as the wealthy Satsuma han, rated at 770,000 koku, and in 1609 Tadatsune invaded the Ryūkyū Kingdom and reduced it to vassalage. As the greatest of the outside daimyō houses, the Shimazu remained masters of southern Kyūshū throughout the period, and in 1789 a daughter of Shigehide married the shogun Tokugawa Ienari.
zh: 岛津氏是南九州的武士霸主，始祖岛津忠久传为源赖朝之子（但更可能出自惟宗氏），1185年被任为日本最大庄园岛津庄的地头，以及萨摩、大隅、日向三国守护。1333年，第五代当主岛津贞久参加后醍醐天皇讨伐镇西探题的战事，后来又在多々良滨为足利尊氏作战。贞久晚年把领国分给儿子师久和氏久，形成总州家与奥州家两支，两家的对立在室町时代大部分时间里削弱了家族，直到战国当主岛津贵久以武力重新统一萨摩、大隅。其子第十六代当主义久进而几乎平定整个九州：1584年在冲田畷之战击杀龙造寺隆信，又攻灭大友氏的大片领地；岛津还是日本最早将火绳枪投入实战的势力之一，以严整的铁炮齐射战术见长。1587年丰臣秀吉发动九州征伐，岛津军在根白坂受挫后及时投降，得以保住萨摩、大隅和日向的一部分。1600年关原之战中岛津义弘虽加入西军，领地却获保全，进入江户时代后成为石高七十七万石的萨摩藩；1609年岛津忠恒又出兵琉球，使琉球王国沦为附庸。作为外样大名中最强大的一家，岛津氏在整个这一时期始终是南九州的主人，1789年岛津重豪之女还嫁给了将军德川家齐。

en: The Shishman were a medieval Bulgarian dynasty of Cuman origin, descended from Shishman, a boyar who held the Danubian fortress of Vidin as a largely independent despot from perhaps the 1270s. He acknowledged Golden Horde suzerainty in 1291 and, after an unsuccessful war against Serbia the next year, ruled Vidin as a Serbian vassal; his wife was a granddaughter of Tsar Ivan Asen II, tying the family to the Asen dynasty. His son Michael Shishman, despot of Vidin, was elected tsar by the Bulgarian nobility in 1323 and ruled as Michael Asen III, the last medieval Bulgarian ruler to bid for Balkan hegemony and to attempt the capture of Constantinople. His wars against Byzantium and Serbia ended in defeat at the Battle of Velbazhd in 1330, where he was mortally wounded. His son Ivan Stephen held the throne only until 1331, when the nobility raised up Ivan Alexander, whose Sratsimir house descended from the Shishmanids through the female line; Michael's half-brother Belaur meanwhile kept Vidin as its despot.
zh: 希什曼王朝是中世纪保加利亚的库曼裔王朝，先祖希什曼是一名波雅尔贵族，可能从13世纪70年代起就以专制公身份据守多瑙河畔的维丁要塞，享有很大的独立性。他于1291年承认金帐汗国的宗主权，次年对塞尔维亚作战失利后，又作为塞尔维亚的附庸统治维丁；他的妻子是沙皇伊凡·阿森二世的孙女，使家族与阿森王朝攀上血缘。其子米哈伊尔·希什曼本是维丁专制公，1323年被保加利亚贵族推举为沙皇，称米哈伊尔·阿森三世，是中世纪最后一位谋求巴尔干霸权、并试图夺取君士坦丁堡的保加利亚君主。他与拜占庭和塞尔维亚连年开战，最终在1330年的维尔巴日德战役中兵败重伤而死。他的儿子伊凡·斯特凡在位仅到1331年，贵族便拥立伊凡·亚历山大即位，后者出身的斯拉齐米尔家族正是希什曼家族的女性后裔；与此同时，米哈伊尔的异母弟贝劳尔仍以专制公身份保有维丁。

en: The Shō began as a warrior band of Musashi Province and a leading house of the Kodama party, one of the Musashi Seven Parties. Kodama Iehiro, fourth head of the Kodama main house, settled at Kurisaki in what is now Honjō and took the name Shō, so that the Shō, the Kodama and the Honjō were counted the three main houses of the Kodama party. His son Ienaga captured Taira no Shigehira at the battle of Ichinotani in 1184 and was rewarded with the Kusakabe manor in Oda district of Bitchū Province, where the main line moved early in the Kamakura period as newly appointed jitō, building Sarukake Castle and growing into one of the strongest kokujin houses of Bitchū while cadets kept the Musashi lands as the Honjō. Under the Nanboku-chō disorders the Bitchū Shō grew stronger under Hosokawa command. In Muromachi times the head house served the kanrei Hosokawa as inner retainers and a cadet line supplied shugodai of Bitchū. Shō Motosuke fought on the Hosokawa side in the Ōnin War, then raised the so-called Bitchū War of 1491 against shugo Hosokawa Katsuhisa and was put down the next year. In the Sengoku age the house peaked under Shō Tamesuke, who allied with the Amago in 1533, took Matsuyama Castle and held half of Bitchū; soon overshadowed by the Mimura, the Shō submitted to Ukita Naoie in 1568, then helped the Mōri destroy the Mimura in 1574 to 1575, and finally left the stage when Shō Katsusuke fell fighting the Ukita.
