zh: 庄氏原是武藏国的武士团，属于武藏七党之一儿玉党的核心氏族。儿玉本宗家第四代家弘定居在今本庄市栗崎一带，改称庄氏，因此庄氏与儿玉氏、本庄氏并称儿玉党三家本宗。其子庄太郎家长在源平合战中立功，1184年一之谷之战中生擒平重衡，获赐备中国小田郡草壁庄。镰仓初期，宗家以西迁“新补地头”的身份移居备中，修筑猿挂城，发展为备中最有实力的国人之一；留在武藏本领的庶流则称本庄氏。南北朝动乱中，备中庄氏在细川氏麾下扩张势力，室町时代宗家出仕管领细川京兆家为内众，庶流还当过备中守护代。庄元资在应仁之乱中从属东军细川方，1491年又挑起号称“备中大战”的叛乱，次年被守护细川胜久镇压。进入战国，庄为资于1533年与出云尼子氏结盟，夺取松山城，领有备中半国，庄氏达到鼎盛；不久便被同族国人三村氏压倒，1568年向宇喜多直家投降，1574至1575年又配合毛利氏攻灭三村氏，当主庄胜资最终在与宇喜多氏的连年交战中战死，庄氏从此退出历史舞台。

en: The Shōni were a warrior house of northern Kyūshū, centered on Chikuzen and Hizen, who sprang from the Mutō family and claimed descent from Fujiwara no Hidesato. Their name began as a title, the junior counselor of the Dazaifu government: Mutō Sukeyori, a Taira commander who surrendered to Minamoto no Yoritomo after the battle of Ichinotani, was appointed to the post and made shugo of several northern Kyūshū provinces, and from his son Sukeyoshi onward Shōni became the family name. Sukeyoshi and his sons led the defense of Dazaifu during the Mongol invasions of 1274 and 1281; his grandson Suketoki was killed on Iki and Sukeyoshi himself died of his wounds, leaving the house the greatest shugo family in northern Kyūshū. In 1333 Sadatsune Shōni joined Emperor Go-Daigo's war against the Kamakura shogunate and stormed the Chinzei tandai's office. When Ashikaga Takauji fled to Kyūshū in 1336, Sadatsune's son Yorihisa welcomed him; a Kikuchi raid killed Sadatsune at Dazaifu, but Yorihisa crushed the Kikuchi at Tatarahama. Defeat at the Chikugogawa in 1359 cost them Dazaifu, and in the Muromachi period the clan was worn down by Ōuchi invasions while one head, Fuyusuke, was murdered by the Kyūshū commissioner Imagawa Sadayo. Driven into Hizen in the Sengoku age, the Shōni were finally destroyed by their own rising vassals: in 1559 Ryūzōji Takanobu stormed Seifukuji Castle and forced Fuyuhisa to take his own life, and a last revival attempt under Masaoki collapsed in 1572.
zh: 少贰氏是北九州筑前、肥前一带的武士家族，出自武藤氏，自称是藤原秀乡的后裔。“少贰”原本是大宰府次官的官职名：原属平家的武将武藤资赖在一之谷之战后投降源赖朝，被任命为大宰少贰，又兼任镇西奉行和北九州多国守护，从其子少贰资能一代起，少贰成为固定姓氏。1274年和1281年元寇来犯时，资能带着诸子在大宰府前线指挥防御，其孙资时战死于壹岐，资能本人也因伤去世，战后少贰氏成为北九州最大的守护家族，达到鼎盛。1333年，少贰贞经参加后醍醐天皇的讨幕运动，攻灭镇西探题。1336年足利尊氏逃奔九州，贞经之子赖尚前往迎接；其间菊池氏袭击大宰府，贞经被杀，赖尚则在多々良滨之战中击败菊池军。1359年少贰氏在筑后川之战中战败，大宰府被夺；室町时代又屡遭大内氏侵攻，当主少贰冬资还被九州探题今川贞世谋杀。进入战国，少贰氏被迫退守肥前，最终毁于崛起的家臣之手：1559年龙造寺隆信攻破势福寺城，迫使少贰冬尚自尽，少贰政兴的最后复兴尝试也于1572年失败。

en: Silat was a small Malay river kingdom in the upper Kapuas basin of West Kalimantan, at present-day Silat Hilir, over which neighbouring Selimbau claimed primacy. Tradition traces its first polity, Jempulin Panjang, to the legendary Babai Becingah, and says Islam came up the Sambas river under its first Muslim ruler, Sultan Acit.
zh: 锡拉特是西加里曼丹上卡普阿斯河流域的马来河畔小邦，在今下锡拉特一带，邻邦塞林包对其宣称宗主权。当地传统把最早的政权珍普林·潘姜追溯到传说始祖巴拜·贝钦加，并称伊斯兰教沿三发河传入，由初代穆斯林君主苏丹·阿奇特引入。

en: The Singapura dynasty ruled the small Malay trading kingdom of that name on the island of Temasek, the future Singapore. According to the Malay Annals, its founder was Sang Nila Utama, also titled Sri Tri Buana, a prince of the old Palembang royal house of Srivijaya, who landed on Temasek around 1299 and renamed his settlement Singapura, Sanskrit for lion city. The chronicle counts five kings of the line: Sang Nila Utama, who still reigned in 1337; Sri Wikrama Wira, whose fortified port beat off a Siamese siege fleet in 1349 and defied a Majapahit demand to submit; Sri Rana Wikrama; Sri Maharaja; and finally Iskandar Shah, commonly identified with Parameswara, the first ruler to embrace Islam. Caught between the rival claims of Ayutthaya and Majapahit, the kingdom grew rich on trade linking the archipelago, India and Yuan China before a great Majapahit expedition sacked the city around 1398. The last king fled to the Malay Peninsula and founded the Malacca Sultanate around 1400, carrying the dynasty's prestige into the new emporium. Much of the story is legendary, but archaeology on Fort Canning Hill and the account of the Chinese traveler Wang Dayuan confirm that a thriving fourteenth-century port stood on the site.
zh: 辛诃补罗王朝统治着淡马锡岛上同名的马来人小贸易王国，其地即后来的新加坡。据《马来纪年》记载，开国君主桑·尼拉·乌他马（王号斯里·特里·布阿纳）是室利佛逝故都巨港王室的王子，约1299年登岛淡马锡，将聚落命名为辛诃补罗，梵语意为“狮城”。该书记载王朝共有五王：1337年仍在位的桑·尼拉·乌他马；斯里·毗羯罗·毗罗，他的坚固港城在1349年击退暹罗围城舰队，并拒绝满者伯夷的臣服要求；斯里·罗那·毗羯罗；斯里·摩诃罗阇；以及末代君主伊斯干达沙，通常被认为就是最先皈依伊斯兰教的拜里米苏拉。王国夹在阿瑜陀耶与满者伯夷两大强权之间，靠连接群岛、印度与元朝中国的贸易致富，约1398年被满者伯夷大军攻陷。末代君主逃往马来半岛，约1400年建立马六甲苏丹国，把王朝的声望带入新的商贸中心。这段历史多有传说成分，但福康宁山的考古发现和中国旅行家汪大渊的记载都证实，14世纪当地确有一座繁盛港城。

en: The name Singhanavati comes from the semi-legendary founder of the Yonok Kingdom, an early Tai polity centered on what is now Chiang Saen on the Kok River. Chronicle tradition makes Singhanavati a prince who led his people south from the upper Mekong and founded his capital there, dating the foundation to the seventh century BCE; the kingdom is said to have patronized Buddhism for generations before earthquake and vassal revolt destroyed it, its people dispersing into successor states such as Ngoenyang, from which Lan Na later grew. Later Thai traditions also connect southern branches of this old northern lineage with the ruling houses that emerged in the Chao Phraya basin. In that genealogical tradition the name is attached to the princes of Lavo, Suphanburi and Ayodhya in the fourteenth century, among them Prince Uthong, who unified the Lopburi and Suphan Buri power centers and founded the Ayutthaya Kingdom in 1351 as Ramathibodi I, and Boromracha, whose Suphanburi line contested the Ayutthaya throne in the decades that followed.
zh: “辛哈纳瓦蒂”之名来自半传说性质的永诺王国创建者。永诺是泰人早期政权，以谷河流域今清盛一带为中心。按编年史传统，辛哈纳瓦蒂是一位王子，率部众从湄公河上游南迁，在当地建都，传说时代可上溯到公元前7世纪；据说王国世代护持佛教，最终因地震与属邦叛乱而亡，部众散入恩央等后继政权，兰纳后来即由恩央发展而来。后世泰国传统还把这条北方古老世系的南支与昭披耶河流域兴起的王族联系起来。按照这种谱系说法，14世纪罗涡、素攀武里和阿约陀耶的诸侯都被归入该世系，其中包括乌通亲王——他整合了华富里与素攀武里两大势力，于1351年开创阿瑜陀耶王国，即拉玛铁菩提一世；还有波罗玛拉查，他的素攀武里一系在随后几十年里争夺阿瑜陀耶王位。

en: The House of Siri Sanga Bo was a Sinhalese dynasty that ruled much of Sri Lanka from the 1220s to the 1590s. Its founder, Vijayabahu III, a descendant of the ancient king Sirisangabo, made Dambadeniya his fortress while resisting the invader Kalinga Magha and recovered the Buddha's tooth relic, around which the restored Buddhist kingship was built. Repeated Pandyan pressure forced the court to move from Dambadeniya to Yapahuwa and then Kurunegala; after a Pandyan army carried the tooth relic off from Yapahuwa in the 1270s, Parakramabahu III travelled to the Pandyan court and secured its return. Later kings of the line ruled from Gampola and Kotte, where Parakramabahu VI, reigning from 1412, conquered Jaffna in 1450 and for the last time united the whole island under one Sinhalese crown. The Kotte kingdom split in the Vijayaba Kollaya of 1521, and Dharmapala ceded it to the Portuguese in 1597. The dynasty's last ruler, Rajasinha I of Sitawaka, died in 1592 without an heir, and his kingdom was sacked by the king of Kandy and the Portuguese.
zh: 西里桑加博王朝是僧伽罗人的王朝，在13世纪20年代至16世纪90年代统治斯里兰卡大部。开创者维阇耶巴忽三世是古代国王尸利僧伽菩提的后裔，他以丹布勒尼耶为据点抵御入侵者羯陵伽的摩伽，并迎回佛牙舍利，围绕舍利重建了佛教王权。潘地亚的持续压力迫使宫廷从丹布勒尼耶迁往亚帕胡瓦，再迁库鲁内格勒；13世纪70年代潘地亚军队从亚帕胡瓦劫走佛牙舍利后，波罗迦罗摩巴忽三世亲赴潘地亚宫廷，争取到舍利归还。其后裔先后在甘波罗和科提立国：1412年即位的波罗迦罗摩巴忽六世于1450年征服贾夫纳，最后一次将全岛统一在僧伽罗王权之下。1521年的维阇耶巴忽之变使科提王国分裂，达摩波罗于1597年把王国让给葡萄牙。王朝末代君主、悉多伐伽的罗阇辛伽一世于1592年去世且无嗣，其王国被康提国王与葡萄牙人洗劫瓜分。

en: The Sisodias are a Rajput clan of the Solar lineage, an offshoot of the ancient Guhila dynasty of Mewar in Rajasthan. They take their name from the village of Sisoda, settled by Rahapa, a son of the twelfth-century Guhila king Ranasimha. When Alauddin Khalji of Delhi stormed Chittorgarh in 1303 the Guhila line was all but destroyed in the famous last stand and jauhar, but in 1326 Rana Hammir of the Sisodia branch retook the region and rebuilt the kingdom, beginning the line of maharanas that ruled Mewar for the next five centuries. Hammir's successors warred constantly with the sultans of Malwa, Gujarat and Delhi; Rana Kumbha, who reigned from 1433, crowned his victories with the Tower of Victory at Chittor, and Rana Sanga built Mewar into the leading Rajput power before falling to Babur at the Battle of Khanua in 1527. Chittor fell twice more, to Bahadur Shah of Gujarat in 1535 and to Akbar in 1568, after which Udai Singh II moved the capital to his new city of Udaipur. His son Maharana Pratap fought on against the Mughals from the hills, losing the Battle of Haldighati in 1576 but eventually recovering much of Mewar. The Sisodias were the last Rajput dynasty to submit to the Mughals, doing so only in 1615, and alone among the great Rajput houses never gave daughters to the imperial harem. Both the Bhonsles, the house of Shivaji, and the Rana prime ministers of Nepal later claimed Sisodia descent.
zh: 斯苏提阿人是属太阳世系的拉杰普特部族，为拉贾斯坦梅瓦尔古老古希罗王朝的分支，得名于12世纪古希罗国王拉纳辛哈之子罗诃波建立的西索达村。1303年德里苏丹阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉攻陷奇托尔加尔，古希罗本支在著名的死战与妇女自焚中近乎覆灭；1326年斯苏提阿分支的拉纳·哈米尔收复故土、重建王国，开创了此后统治梅瓦尔五个世纪的摩诃罗那世系。哈米尔的后继者不断与马尔瓦、古吉拉特和德里的苏丹交战：1433年即位的拉纳·昆巴以奇托尔的胜利塔纪念战功，拉纳·桑伽则把梅瓦尔推上拉杰普特诸邦之首，直到1527年在卡努阿战役败于巴布尔。奇托尔后来又两度陷落——1535年被古吉拉特的巴哈杜尔沙攻占，1568年被阿克巴拿下，乌代·辛格二世随即将都城迁往新建的乌代布尔。其子摩诃罗那·普拉塔普退入山区继续抗莫卧儿，虽在1576年的哈尔迪加蒂战役失利，最终仍收复了梅瓦尔大部。斯苏提阿是最后一个臣服莫卧儿的拉杰普特王朝，迟至1615年才称臣，而且在拉杰普特诸大族中独独不与皇室联姻。后来马拉塔帝国开创者希瓦吉所属的邦斯莱家族，以及尼泊尔的拉纳首相家族，都自称源出斯苏提阿。

en: Siyara was a fortified coastal settlement on the northern Somali shore east of Berbera, named for the Somali custom of pilgrimage to a local saint's tomb. Around 1415 the Walashma prince Sabr ad-Din II, returning from Yemeni exile, made it his first base for rebuilding the Sultanate of Adal.
zh: 西亚拉是索马里北部沿海、柏培拉以东的设防聚落，得名于索马里人朝谒当地圣徒墓地的习俗。约1415年，瓦什玛家族的萨卜尔·丁二世从也门流亡归来，以此为重建阿达尔苏丹国的最初据点。

en: The Smilets were a short-lived imperial house of the Second Bulgarian Empire, founded by the nobleman Smilets, whose family held broad estates between the Balkan Mountains and Sredna Gora. In 1292 he was raised to the throne at Tarnovo with the backing of the Mongol ruler Nogai Khan and crowned by Patriarch Joachim III, his reign marking the height of Tatar overlordship over Bulgaria. He had married a Byzantine princess of the Palaiologos family, niece of Emperor Michael VIII, and around 1297 he married their daughter Theodora to the Serbian king Stephen Dečanski; their son was the future emperor Stephen Dušan. When Smilets died in 1298 amid the invasion of the Mongol prince Chaka, his young son Ivan II succeeded under the regency of his mother, but Chaka seized Tarnovo in 1299 and the family fled into exile. Ivan II spent the rest of his life in Byzantium and died there as a monk before 1330, ending the male line; his sister Marina, wife of the despot Aldimir of Kran, lived until 1355 and was the maternal aunt of Stephen Dušan.
zh: 斯米莱茨王朝是第二保加利亚帝国一个国祚短促的皇室，开创者贵族斯米莱茨的家族在巴尔干山脉与斯雷德纳戈拉山之间拥有大片地产。1292年，他在蒙古统治者那海汗的支持下登上特尔诺沃的王位，由牧首约阿希姆三世加冕，他的统治时期也正是鞑靼人对保加利亚宗主权的顶峰。他娶了巴列奥略家族的拜占庭公主、米哈伊尔八世的侄女为妻，约1297年又将女儿特奥多拉嫁给塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·德昌斯基，两人的儿子就是后来的皇帝斯特凡·杜尚。1298年斯米莱茨在蒙古宗王恰卡入侵期间死去，幼子伊凡二世在母亲摄政下继位，但恰卡于1299年攻占特尔诺沃，全家被迫流亡。伊凡二世在拜占庭度过后半生，1330年以前以修士身份客死他乡，男系就此断绝；他的姐妹马林娜嫁给克兰专制公阿尔迪米尔，一直活到1355年，是斯特凡·杜尚的姨母。

en: The Sohri were the ruling house of the Soran emirate, also called Sohran, the Kurdish principality whose later capital was Rawanduz. According to the Sharafnama of Sharaf Khan Bidlisi, the house descended from Kelos, an Arab of Baghdad who settled among the Kurds of the Ewan district, and its name came from Seng-Surh, people of the red rocks, shortened through the Kurdish word sohr, red, into Sohran. Modern scholarship places the emirate's foundation somewhere between the 1330s and 1430s. Around the battle of Chaldiran in 1514 the Soran seized the country between Erbil and Kirkuk, but in 1535 Sultan Suleiman had Izzeddin Sher, their ruler of Erbil and son of Shah Ali, put to death and gave the city to the Yazidi chief Mir Husein Beg Dasini; Mir Seyfeddin of Soran later won back much of the old territory. The emirate was revived at Rawanduz from 1816 under Emir Muhammad, who built cannon foundries and a large tribal army.
zh: 索赫里家族是索兰（又称索赫兰）埃米尔国的统治家族，这个库尔德政权后期以拉万杜兹为都城。据沙拉夫汗·比特利西的《沙拉夫纪》记载，该家族出自迁居埃万地区库尔德人之中的巴格达阿拉伯人凯洛斯；其名称来自“森格-苏尔赫”，意为红岩之人，库尔德语“苏赫尔”（红色）经简写演变为索赫兰。学界考证埃米尔国建于14世纪30年代至15世纪30年代之间。1514年恰尔德兰战役前后，索兰人夺取了埃尔比勒与基尔库克之间的土地；但1535年苏丹苏莱曼下令处死他们在埃尔比勒的统治者、沙阿·阿里之子伊泽丁·谢尔，把该城封给雅兹迪首领米尔·侯赛因·贝格·达西尼，后来索兰的米尔·赛夫丁又收复了大部分旧地。1816年起，埃米尔穆罕默德以拉万杜兹为中心复兴埃米尔国，开设铸炮厂，建立起一支庞大的部落军队。

en: The Solomonic dynasty ruled the Christian Ethiopian highlands from 1270, when the Shewan noble Yekuno Amlak overthrew the Zagwe kings and set his court at Bete Amhara. Its legitimacy rested on the claim, set out in the fourteenth-century Kebra Nagast, that the line descended from Menelik I, son of the biblical King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba, and so had merely restored the old kingship of Aksum. Amda Seyon I, who reigned from 1314 to 1344, broke the Muslim sultanates of Ifat and Adal in the campaigns of 1332 and pushed Christian rule deep into the Horn of Africa. The long reign of Zara Yaqob, from 1434 to 1468, marked the empire's peak: he centralized government, founded Debre Birhan as a fixed capital and built churches across the land. In the 1530s the Adal imam Ahmed Gran overran most of the empire until his defeat and death in 1543, won with Portuguese musketeers; Oromo migrations then eroded the southern provinces. Emperor Fasilides founded Gondar in 1636, opening a cultured Gondarine age, but after the 1760s the emperors became puppets of regional lords in the Zemene Mesafint, the era of princes.
zh: 所罗门王朝自1270年起统治基督教的埃塞俄比亚高原：这一年，绍阿贵族耶库诺·阿姆拉克推翻扎格维王朝诸王，在贝特·阿姆哈拉立朝。其统治合法性来自14世纪成书的《众王荣耀》——书中宣称该世系出自《圣经》中所罗门王与示巴女王之子孟尼利克一世，因此王朝只是恢复了古老的阿克苏姆王统。1314至1344年在位的安达·塞永一世在1332年的远征中击溃穆斯林的伊法特和阿达尔苏丹国，把基督教统治深入非洲之角。1434至1468年扎拉·雅各布的长期统治是帝国的巅峰：他强化中央集权，定立德布雷·伯汉为固定都城，并在各地广建教堂。16世纪30年代，阿达尔伊玛目艾哈迈德·格兰攻占帝国大半国土，直到1543年在葡萄牙火枪手援助下才被击败身亡；随后奥罗莫人的迁徙又蚕食了南方诸省。皇帝法西利德斯于1636年兴建贡德尔城，开启文化昌盛的贡德尔时代，但18世纪60年代以后，皇帝在“诸王纷争时代”沦为地方豪强手中的傀儡。

en: The Soranzo were a Venetian patrician family, one of the twenty-four case vecchie that claimed descent from the ancient tribunes of the lagoon; family legend derived them from the Roman gens Superantia, said to have fled Altino for Burano in 456. They rose to the summit of the Republic when Giovanni Soranzo, an admiral who had raided the Genoese colony of Caffa in 1296 and served as Procurator of Saint Mark, was elected the fifty-first Doge in 1312 and ruled until his death in 1328. Rich patrons as well as statesmen, the family financed the church of San Samuele and the facade of Santa Giustina in Venice. In later centuries they served the Republic in its Ottoman wars: at the Battle of Lepanto in 1571 Benedetto Soranzo commanded a galley on the Christian right wing and, mortally wounded with his crew wiped out, set fire to his own ship rather than surrender. The Soranzo di San Trovaso branch died out in 1771, while the Soranzo di San Gregorio branch kept its palaces on the Venetian fondamenta until the fall of the Republic in 1797.
zh: 索兰佐家族是威尼斯的贵族世家，属于自称源出潟湖古代保民官的二十四家“旧世家”之一；据家族传说，其先祖是罗马的苏佩兰提亚氏族，456年从阿尔蒂诺逃到布拉诺。家族在1312年达到共和国权力之巅：曾于1296年攻袭热那亚殖民地卡法、担任圣马可行政长官的乔瓦尼·索兰佐当选第五十一任总督，执政至1328年去世。家族既出政治家，也热衷赞助，出资修建了威尼斯的圣萨穆埃莱教堂和圣朱斯蒂娜教堂立面。此后几个世纪，家族成员在对奥斯曼的战争中为共和国效力：1571年勒班陀海战中，贝内代托·索兰佐在基督徒右翼指挥一艘桨帆船，在船员死伤殆尽、本人重伤之际纵火焚船，拒不投降。圣特罗瓦索支系于1771年绝嗣，圣格雷戈里奥支系则在威尼斯河畔宅邸中延续，直到1797年共和国灭亡。

en: The So were the lords of Tsushima Island from the Kamakura period to the Meiji Restoration, most likely an offshoot of the Koremune family of Dazaifu officials, although their own genealogy claimed descent from the Taira. In 1246 Sō Shigehisa crushed the rebel Abiru clan on Tsushima and was rewarded with the stewardship, and in the first Mongol invasion of 1274 the head Sukekuni died fighting with his eighty horsemen at Sasuura. As deputies of the Shoni, the So extended their hold over the island during the Nanboku-cho wars, when they fought for the Ashikaga Northern Court, and around 1408 they moved their main seat from northern Kyushu to Tsushima; after Imagawa Ryoshun fell from power they secured the hereditary shugo post and formally broke with the Shoni in the 1440s by changing their surname from Koremune to Taira. Since mountainous Tsushima produced little rice, the clan built its power on trade and diplomacy with Joseon Korea, maintaining Japanese settlements in Korean ports and weathering crises such as the Oei invasion of 1419 and the Three Ports riots of 1510; the Tenbun treaty of 1547 confined their licensed commerce to Pusan and twenty ships a year. They submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi in 1587, and Sō Yoshitoshi led troops in the Korean invasions while also handling negotiations. Although the clan joined the Western Army at Sekigahara in 1600, Tokugawa Ieyasu spared it for its Korean connections, and under the Tokugawa the So ran the Tsushima-Fuchu Domain and monopolised the shogunate's diplomacy with Joseon after the 1609 Kiyu agreement.
zh: 宗氏是从镰仓时代到明治维新一直统治对马岛的豪族、大名，史家一般认为其出自大宰府在庁官人惟宗氏的支流，但其自家家谱自称桓武平氏、为平知盛之后。1246年宗重尚讨平对马在庁官人阿比留氏的叛乱，受封地头职；1274年蒙古第一次来袭时，当主助国率郎党八十余骑在佐须浦迎战战死。作为少弐氏的地头代，宗氏在南北朝战乱中为足利北朝作战，势力深入全岛，约1408年把本据从北九州迁至对马；今川了俊失势后，宗氏获得对马守护的世袭地位，并在15世纪40年代改姓平氏，与少弐氏斩断主从关系。对马山多田少、稻米匮乏，宗氏的国力建立在对朝鲜的贸易与外交之上：他们在朝鲜港口经营倭人居留地，经历了1419年应永外寇、1510年三浦之乱等断交危机，1547年的丁未约条又把贸易限定在釜山、每年二十艘。1587年宗氏臣服丰臣秀吉，文禄庆长之役中宗义智随军打头阵，又承担对日朝交涉。1600年关原之战宗氏加入西军，德川家康却因其对朝渠道而不予追究；江户时代宗氏领对马府中藩，依1609年己酉约条垄断幕府对朝鲜的外交与贸易。

en: The Sōma were a samurai house of Taira descent through the Chiba clan, named after the Sōma shrine-estate in northern Shimōsa, an Ise Shrine manor that supplied horses to the court. Their founder Sōma Morotsune, a younger son of Chiba Tsunetane, served Minamoto no Yoritomo and rode with him on the conquest of the Northern Fujiwara at Hiraizumi in 1189, receiving the three southern Mutsu districts of Namekata, Shineha and Uda, the coastal Hamadōri country that the clan ruled for more than seven hundred years. During the Nanboku-chō wars the Sōma were among the few Mutsu houses that held to the Northern Court. In the Sengoku age their domain lay squeezed between the Satake to the south and the Date to the north; Date Masamune invaded it thirty times, and the sixteenth chieftain Sōma Yoshitane submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi only at the Odawara siege of 1590. After Sekigahara the new Tokugawa government at first moved to seize the territory but relented, naming Sōma Toshitane a tozama daimyō of the sixty-thousand-koku Sōma Nakamura Domain. Toshitane married an adopted daughter of Tokugawa Hidetada, moved his seat from Odaka to Nakamura Castle, laid out a grid-patterned castle town on the Kyoto model and patronised Sōma ware pottery; his descendants kept the domain through the whole Edo period.
zh: 相马氏是经由千叶氏分出的平氏后裔武家，得名于下总国北部的相马御厨——一处为朝廷供应马匹的伊势神宫庄园。始祖相马师常是千叶常胤的幼子，侍奉源赖朝，1189年随军攻灭平泉的奥州藤原氏，受封陆奥国南部的行方、标叶、宇多三郡，即滨海的滨通地区，相马氏在此统治了七百余年。南北朝动乱中，相马氏是陆奥国内少数始终效忠北朝的家族之一。战国时代，其领地夹在南边的佐竹氏与北边的伊达氏之间，伊达政宗曾三十次入侵；第十六代当主相马义胤直到1590年小田原围城时才向丰臣秀吉臣服。关原之战后，新成立的德川幕府起初打算没收其领地，最终改变主意，封相马利胤为六万石的相马中村藩外样大名。利胤娶德川秀忠的养女为妻，把本据从小高城迁到中村城，仿照京都规划棋盘式城下町，并扶持相马烧陶瓷；其子孙在整个江户时代一直保有该藩。

en: The Spinola were one of the greatest noble houses of the Republic of Genoa, whose wealth rested on trade, finance and land. First recorded with Guido Spinola, consul of Genoa in 1102, the family reached the height of its power in the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries alongside its allies and rivals the Doria. In 1262 Oberto Spinola and Oberto Doria overthrew the capitano del popolo Guglielmo Boccanegra and took joint charge of the government, and Oberto led the Genoese fleet to victory over Venice in 1266 before helping to exile the Fieschi and Grimaldi in 1270. His son Corrado Spinola commanded Genoese fleets in the war against Pisa and served as captain of the people until 1301; Galeotto Spinola held the same office in 1335 and helped throw off the overlordship of Robert of Naples. The family remained central to Genoese politics for centuries, producing eleven doges of the Republic, while Francesco Spinola led the 1435 revolt that ended Visconti rule over the city. Its most celebrated later member was Ambrogio Spinola, a Genoese banker who became Captain-General of the Spanish Army of Flanders and took Breda in 1625, one of the most famous sieges of the Eighty Years' War.
zh: 斯皮诺拉家族是热那亚共和国最显赫的贵族世家之一，财富来自贸易、金融和地产。家族最早见于记载的人物是1102年任热那亚执政官的圭多·斯皮诺拉；13至14世纪，家族与盟友兼对手多里亚家族一同达到权力顶峰。1262年，奥贝托·斯皮诺拉与奥贝托·多里亚联手推翻人民首领古列尔莫·博卡内格拉，共同执掌政府；1266年奥贝托率热那亚舰队击败威尼斯，又在1270年参与流放菲耶斯基和格里马尔迪两大家族。其子科拉多·斯皮诺拉在对比萨的战争中指挥热那亚舰队，并出任人民首领至1301年；加莱奥托·斯皮诺拉于1335年出任同一职务，协助热那亚摆脱那不勒斯国王罗贝托的宗主权。此后数百年间家族始终处于热那亚政治的核心，共出了十一位共和国总督；1435年弗朗切斯科·斯皮诺拉领导起义，终结了维斯孔蒂家族对热那亚的统治。家族后期最著名的成员是安布罗西奥·斯皮诺拉，这位热那亚银行家出任西班牙佛兰德斯军队总司令，于1625年攻克布雷达，那场围城战是八十年战争中最著名的战役之一。

en: The Sponheims, or Spanheims, were a Rhenish Franconian noble house named after Sponheim Castle in the Hunsrück, with an early residence at Kreuznach. One branch rose far above its roots: the retainer Siegfried I inherited great estates in Carinthia by marriage, and his grandson Henry became Duke of Carinthia in 1122, a line that ruled until 1269 and also produced the Bavarian counts of Ortenburg. The Rhenish branch kept the County of Sponheim. Meginhard of Sponheim, through his marriage to the heiress of Mörsberg, added wide lands in the Hunsrück and was the first to style himself count. Count Gottfried III married Adelheid of Sayn, and before 1237 his sons divided the inheritance: Johann I took the rear county around Starkenburg and in 1247 also acquired Sayn, while Simon I formed the front county on the Nahe, seated at the Kauzenburg above Kreuznach. In 1265 Johann's son Gottfried inherited Sayn and founded the second comital house of Sayn, and the front county split again in 1277 into Sponheim, Bolanden and Neef lines. The ruling male line of the Rhenish Sponheims died out in 1437, whereupon the margraves of Baden and the counts palatine of Simmern-Zweibrücken-Birkenfeld inherited the county as a condominium, which lasted until the French revolutionary armies annexed the lands west of the Rhine.
zh: 施蓬海姆家族（又译施潘海姆）是莱茵法兰克尼亚的贵族世家，得名于洪斯吕克山区的施蓬海姆城堡，并很早就在克罗伊茨纳赫设有居所。家族的一支飞黄腾达：侍臣西格弗里德一世通过婚姻继承了克恩滕的大片领地，其孙亨利于1122年成为克恩滕公爵，这支后裔统治到1269年，还衍生出巴伐利亚的奥滕堡伯爵世系。留在莱茵的支系统治施蓬海姆伯国：施蓬海姆的梅金哈德通过与默尔斯贝格女继承人联姻，取得洪斯吕克的广阔土地，并第一个自称伯爵。伯爵戈特弗里德三世娶了塞恩的阿德尔海德；1237年之前，他的儿子们瓜分了遗产：约翰一世取得以施塔肯堡为中心的后伯国，又在1247年获得塞恩；西蒙一世则在纳厄河畔建立前伯国，以克罗伊茨纳赫上方的考岑堡为治所。1265年，约翰之子戈特弗里德继承塞恩，开创了第二个塞恩伯爵世家；前伯国又于1277年分为施蓬海姆、博兰登和内夫三支。莱茵施蓬海姆的执政男系于1437年断绝，巴登藩侯与锡门-茨魏布吕肯-比肯费尔德行宫伯爵以共管形式继承伯国，直到法国革命军吞并莱茵河西岸土地为止。

en: The House of Sratsimir was a medieval Bulgarian noble house whose founder, the despot Sratsimir, held Lovech and married Keratsa Petritsa of the ruling Asen dynasty. Their son Ivan Alexander seized the throne at Tarnovo in 1331, making the Sratsimirovtsi the last ruling dynasty of the Second Bulgarian Empire. Ivan Alexander's long reign brought the empire to its height but also prepared its partition: after his death in 1371 his son Ivan Shishman ruled at Tarnovo while another son, Ivan Sratsimir, kept the separate empire of Vidin. Ottoman conquest ended both, with Tarnovo falling in 1393 and Vidin in 1422, when Constantine II of Vidin died as the last Bulgarian emperor. Kin of the house prospered abroad even so: Helena married Stefan Dušan of Serbia, Dorothea married Tvrtko I of Bosnia, and the exile Fruzhin fought the Ottomans as a Hungarian count, his descendants being recorded in Hungary well into the sixteenth century. Later Bulgarian rebels, including the leaders of the uprisings of 1598 and 1686, claimed descent from the Sratsimir.
zh: 斯拉齐米尔家族是中世纪保加利亚的贵族世家，始祖斯拉齐米尔为洛维奇的专制君主，娶了掌权的阿森王朝成员克拉察·佩特里察。他们的儿子伊凡·亚历山大于1331年夺取特尔诺沃的皇位，斯拉齐米尔家族由此成为第二保加利亚帝国的最后一个统治王朝。伊凡·亚历山大在位期间帝国达到鼎盛，却也埋下分裂的伏笔：1371年他去世后，儿子伊凡·希什曼统治特尔诺沃，另一个儿子伊凡·斯拉齐米尔则割据维丁。奥斯曼人的征服先后终结了两支政权：特尔诺沃于1393年陷落，维丁于1422年失守，维丁的君士坦丁二世成为末代保加利亚皇帝。尽管如此，家族成员仍在海外立足：海伦娜嫁给塞尔维亚的斯特凡·杜尚，多萝特娅嫁给波斯尼亚的特夫尔特科一世；流亡者弗鲁任以匈牙利伯爵的身份继续抗击奥斯曼人，其后人在匈牙利的记载一直延续到16世纪。后来1598年和1686年起义的保加利亚起事者也都自称出自斯拉齐米尔家族。

en: The Stapletons were a knightly family of Yorkshire whose fortunes rose through marriage. Sir Gilbert de Stapleton, who died in 1321, married Agnes, elder daughter and co-heiress of Bryan FitzAlan, Lord FitzAlan of Bedale, and so carried the Bedale and Cotherstone estates into his family; through his own line the Stapletons also claimed kinship with the Balliols and the Bruces. Gilbert's eldest son, Sir Miles Stapleton of Bedale, was a companion in arms of Edward III: he served at the siege of Tournai in 1340, fought in the War of Breton Succession and probably at the siege of Calais in 1347, and was made one of the founding Knights of the Garter in 1348. He later joined an embassy to Pope Innocent VI in 1354, marched with Henry of Lancaster through Normandy in 1356, may have witnessed the Treaty of Brétigny in 1360, and went on a Prussian crusade in 1363 before dying in December 1364, perhaps of wounds received at Auray. By his marriage to the Ingham heiress Joan he also acquired great lands in Norfolk, and the family continued at Bedale and Ingham for three more generations before the estates were split among co-heiresses.
zh: 斯特普尔顿家族是约克郡的骑士世家，靠联姻发迹。1321年去世的吉尔伯特·德·斯特普尔顿爵士娶了比代尔的菲查伦勋爵布莱恩的长女兼共同继承人阿格尼丝，比代尔和科瑟斯通的地产由此归入家族；通过父系，斯特普尔顿家还自称与巴利奥尔家族和布鲁斯家族有亲。吉尔伯特的长子、比代尔的迈尔斯·斯特普尔顿爵士是爱德华三世的战友：1340年参加图尔奈围城战，随后投身布列塔尼继承战争，1347年可能还参加了加来围城战，并于1348年成为嘉德骑士团创始骑士之一。此后他在1354年随使团觐见教皇英诺森六世，1356年随兰开斯特的亨利横扫诺曼底，1360年可能见证了《布勒丁尼条约》，1363年又参加普鲁士十字军，最终于1364年12月去世，或因1364年9月欧赖战役所受的伤而死。他娶英厄姆女继承人琼为妻，又在诺福克获得大片领地；家族在比代尔和英厄姆又延续了三代，之后地产由几位女继承人分割。

en: The free lords of Steinfurt took their name from the stone ford across the Aa in Westphalia, a crossing they controlled before 1129, levying toll on the trade road to Münster. Rudolf II of Steinfurt, first attested in 1155, built the moated castle of Burgsteinfurt that became the family seat. A long feud with the neighbouring lords of Ascheberg ended when that house died out in 1206, leaving Steinfurt to dominate the region. The family's younger sons rose high in the church, winning canonries and provostships at Münster and Paderborn, and with the cathedral provost Bernhard they founded the Hospitaller commandery of Steinfurt. A charter of 1338 already calls the settlement below the castle their town. The male line ran out in 1421, and the heiress brought the lordship to her husband Everwin of Götterswick; from his second marriage descends the later princely house of Bentheim-Steinfurt, which raised Steinfurt to a county in 1495.
zh: 施泰因富特的自由领主家族得名于威斯特伐利亚阿河上的石滩渡口：早在1129年以前，他们就控制了这处通往明斯特的商道要津并征收过路费。鲁道夫二世于1155年首次见于文献，他修建了环水的施泰因富特堡，成为家族的祖居。家族与邻族阿舍贝格领主长期争斗，后者于1206年绝嗣，施泰因富特就此独大一方。家族的幼子们多在教会中腾达，在明斯特和帕德博恩出任法政牧师和总铎；家族还与任明斯特总铎的伯恩哈德一起创立了施泰因富特的圣约翰医院骑士团辖区。1338年的一份特许状已把城堡下的聚落称为他们的城镇。1421年男系断绝，女继承人把领地带给丈夫埃弗温·冯·格特斯维克；后来的本特海姆-施泰因富特诸侯家族即出自其第二次婚姻，并于1495年将施泰因富特升格为伯国。

en: The House of Stenkil is the modern name for the dynasty that ruled Sweden from about 1060 to the 1120s, taking its name from its first king. Stenkil came from Västergötland, married a daughter of King Emund the Old, and inherited the throne when the old royal line died out around 1060; a devout Christian who still tolerated pagan worship, he died around 1066 after a brief war with Norway. His death was followed by civil war between rival claimants named Eric, but his sons Halsten and Inge the Elder both held the kingship, and Halsten's sons Philip and Inge the Younger ruled after them. With the death of Inge the Younger around 1125, the male line came to an end. The dynasty's daughters married widely into the rival houses, so that nearly every Swedish king of the twelfth century, including the later House of Erik, could claim Stenkil blood.
zh: 斯滕希尔王朝是史家对约1060年至12世纪20年代统治瑞典的王朝的称呼，得名于它的开创者斯滕希尔。斯滕希尔出身西约塔兰，娶国王老埃蒙德之女为妻，在旧王室约1060年绝嗣后继承王位；他是虔诚的基督徒，却仍容忍异教崇拜，在与挪威的一场短暂战争后于约1066年去世。他死后，两位名叫埃里克的争夺者爆发内战，但他的儿子哈尔斯滕和老英格先后登位，哈尔斯滕之子菲利普和小英格又相继为王。约1125年小英格去世后，家族男嗣断绝。家族的女儿们广泛嫁入各对立家族，因此12世纪几乎每一位瑞典国王，包括后来的埃里克王朝，都能追溯到斯滕希尔的血脉。

en: The Steno, called Sten in Venetian, were a Venetian patrician house counted among the Case Nuove, the families admitted to the ruling class at the closing of the Great Council in 1297. Tradition claimed an origin in Altino, but the house never attained great wealth or power, and little is recorded of it before its one famous son. Michele Steno, born around 1331, had a wild youth and was nearly condemned for scurrilous inscriptions against Doge Marino Faliero, yet matured into a capable administrator and diplomat. In 1400, after a deadlocked election, he was chosen as the sixty-third Doge as a compromise candidate. His reign saw Venice defeat Francesco da Carrara of Padua in the War of Padua and annex the city, laying the foundations of the mainland dominion, the Domini di Terraferma. Michele Steno died on 26 December 1413 and was buried in the basilica of San Giovanni e Paolo; with no heirs, the Steno house became extinct at his death.
zh: 斯泰诺家族（威尼斯方言称 Sten）是威尼斯贵族世家，属于1297年大议会封闭时被纳入统治阶层的“新世家”之一。传说其先祖来自阿尔蒂诺，但家族从未积累起显赫的财富与权势，在唯一一位名人出世之前少有记载。约1331年出生的米凯莱·斯泰诺年轻时放浪不羁，曾因在总督马里诺·法列罗宝座上题写侮辱性文字而险些被定罪，后来却成长为干练的行政官和外交官。1400年总督选举陷入僵局，他作为折中人选当选第六十三任总督。他任内威尼斯在帕多瓦战争中击败帕多瓦领主弗朗切斯科·达·卡拉拉并吞并该城，奠定了威尼斯大陆领地的基础。米凯莱·斯泰诺于1413年12月26日去世，葬于圣乔瓦尼与保罗大教堂；他没有留下继承人，斯泰诺家族也随他的死而绝嗣。

en: The House of Stuart, originally Stewart, took its name from the office of High Steward of Scotland. Its ancestor Walter fitz Alan, son of the Breton settler Alan fitz Flaad, followed David I north in the twelfth century and was made hereditary steward, with lands in Renfrewshire. His grandson Walter Stewart established Stewart as the family name. The sixth steward, Walter Stewart, married Marjorie Bruce, daughter of Robert I, and when David II died without an heir in 1371 their son inherited the Scottish crown as Robert II, the first Stewart king. Nine Stewart monarchs then ruled Scotland alone, including James IV, who married Margaret Tudor in 1503, and Mary, Queen of Scots, who adopted the French spelling Stuart while raised in France. In 1603 her son James VI of Scotland succeeded to the English and Irish thrones as James I, uniting the crowns. Charles I was overthrown in the civil wars and executed in 1649, but the dynasty returned with the Restoration of 1660. James II was deposed in the Glorious Revolution of 1688, and after the Protestant queens Mary II and Anne, the crown passed to the House of Hanover in 1714 under the Act of Settlement. Deprived Stuart heirs kept their claim alive through the Jacobite risings of 1715 and 1745.
zh: 斯图亚特王朝（旧拼斯图尔特）的家族名来自苏格兰王室大管家一职。其先祖沃尔特·菲茨艾伦是布列塔尼人艾伦·菲茨弗拉阿德之子，12世纪随大卫一世北上，受封世袭管家之职，在伦弗鲁郡领有土地。到他的孙子沃尔特·斯图尔特时，斯图尔特开始成为家族姓氏。第六任管家沃尔特·斯图尔特娶了罗伯特一世之女玛乔丽·布鲁斯，1371年大卫二世无嗣而终，他们的儿子以罗伯特二世之名继承苏格兰王位，成为第一代斯图亚特国王。此后共有九代斯图亚特君主单独统治苏格兰，包括1503年娶玛格丽特·都铎为后的詹姆斯四世，以及在法国长大、采用法语拼法斯图亚特的苏格兰女王玛丽。1603年，玛丽之子苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世又以詹姆斯一世之名继承英格兰和爱尔兰王位，实现两国王位联合。查理一世在内战中被推翻并于1649年被处死，但王朝在1660年复辟。詹姆斯二世在1688年光荣革命中被废，新教徒女王玛丽二世和安妮相继在位后，1714年王位依《王位继承法》转入汉诺威家族。失去王位的斯图亚特继承人又通过1715年和1745年的詹姆斯党起事延续其王位主张。

en: The Stratfords were a landed family of Stratford-on-Avon in Warwickshire whose fortune came through the Church. Its most eminent son, John de Stratford, was born around 1275, studied civil law at Oxford, and became Bishop of Winchester in 1323. He joined Queen Isabella's party against Edward II, helped draw up the charges that forced the king's abdication in 1327, and under Edward III served three times as Lord Chancellor before being appointed Archbishop of Canterbury in 1333. His quarrel with Edward III in 1340, when he resisted the king's attempt to punish him outside parliament, helped establish that peers should be judged only in full parliament; he died in 1348 and was buried at Canterbury. His brother Robert became Bishop of Chichester and also Chancellor of England, and a nephew, Ralph, became Bishop of London.
zh: 斯特拉特福家族是沃里克郡埃文河畔斯特拉特福的乡绅世家，靠教会门路发迹。家族最显赫的人物约翰·德·斯特拉特福约生于1275年，在牛津攻读民法，1323年出任温切斯特主教。他加入伊莎贝拉王后反对爱德华二世的阵营，参与起草迫使国王于1327年退位的罪状，又在爱德华三世麾下三度出任御前大臣，1333年受任坎特伯雷大主教。1340年他与爱德华三世发生冲突，拒绝国王绕开议会惩治自己，推动确立了贵族只能在全体议会中受审的原则；他于1348年去世，葬在坎特伯雷。其弟罗伯特后来成为奇切斯特主教并同样出任御前大臣，外甥拉尔夫则当上伦敦主教。

en: The Strathbogies were a semi-Normanized Gaelic family from Fife, named for their lands at Strathbogie in Aberdeenshire. They entered the highest Scottish nobility when John de Strathbogie married Ada, Countess of Atholl, heiress of the ancient mormaers whose line reached back to the Pictish kings; their son David became eighth Earl of Atholl in 1264. John, the ninth earl, was captured fighting for Scotland at Dunbar in 1296 and held in the Tower of London, then joined Robert the Bruce's rising and attended his coronation of 1306, dying in the English reprisals that followed. His son David sided with England in the Wars of Independence, and the earldom was forfeited in 1314 and granted to the Campbells. David III, born in 1309, married Katherine Beaumont, daughter of Henry de Beaumont, and as one of the Disinherited became a chief lieutenant of Edward Balliol: he won restoration under Balliol's brief kingship and was summoned to the English parliament as titular Earl of Atholl, but was killed at the Battle of Culblean on 30 November 1335. His son David IV kept the claim until his death in 1369 without ever ruling Atholl, which passed first to the Campbells and later to the Stewarts.
zh: 斯特拉斯博吉家族是半诺曼化的盖尔人家族，源自法夫，得名于其在阿伯丁郡斯特拉斯博吉的领地。约翰·德·斯特拉斯博吉娶了阿索尔女伯爵阿达——其家族是可追溯至皮克特诸王的古老莫尔马（凯尔特伯爵）世家的女继承人，家族由此跻身苏格兰最高贵族之列；他们的儿子大卫于1264年成为第八代阿索尔伯爵。第九代伯爵约翰1296年在邓巴战役中为苏格兰作战被俘，关押于伦敦塔，后来加入罗伯特·布鲁斯的起事，参加了1306年的加冕礼，并在随后的英格兰报复中丧命。其子大卫在独立战争中倒向英格兰，伯爵领于1314年被剥夺，转封给坎贝尔家族。1309年出生的大卫三世娶亨利·德·博蒙之女凯瑟琳为妻，作为“被剥夺者”贵族的一员成为爱德华·巴利奥尔的主要副手：他在巴利奥尔短暂称王期间恢复地位，并以名义阿索尔伯爵身份受召出席英格兰议会，但于1335年11月30日在卡尔布林战役中阵亡。其子大卫四世保有爵位主张直到1369年去世，却从未实际统治阿索尔；这片领地先归坎贝尔家族，后来又转入斯图亚特家族之手。

en: The Strathearns were the native Gaelic mormaers, later earls, of Strathearn in southern Perthshire, a line first attested around 1115. Malise I led the men of Strathearn under King David I at the Battle of the Standard in 1138, and the family remained close to the Scottish crown, holding one of the oldest provincial earldoms into the fourteenth century. Malise V succeeded his father in 1329 and also inherited the Norwegian jarldom of Orkney, including Caithness, through a great-great-grandfather. He commanded a division of the Scottish army against Edward Balliol at Halidon Hill in 1333, after which Balliol forfeited his earldom and granted it to John de Warenne, Earl of Surrey. Malise never recovered Strathearn: King David II regranted it to his nephew Maurice de Moravia in 1344, and the old Gaelic line ended with Malise, who died around 1357 leaving only daughters. Through his daughter Isabella, who married William St Clair of Roslin, the Orkney inheritance passed to the Sinclair family, whose son Henry became jarl of Orkney in 1379.
zh: 斯特拉森家族是珀斯郡南部斯特拉森地区本土的盖尔人莫尔马尔，即后来的伯爵，其世系最早可追溯到1115年前后。1138年，马拉斯一世在大卫一世麾下率斯特拉森人参加了斯坦达德战役；此后家族始终与苏格兰王室关系密切，是最古老的地方伯爵世系之一，一直延续到14世纪。1329年，马拉斯五世继承父位，又凭借外高祖父的血统继承了挪威的奥克尼雅尔领地，其中包括凯斯内斯。1333年，他在哈利顿山战役中指挥苏格兰军队的一个师对抗爱德华·巴利奥尔，巴利奥尔随后没收其伯爵领并转封给萨里伯爵约翰·德·瓦伦。马拉斯始终未能夺回斯特拉森：1344年大卫二世将该领改封给他的外甥莫里斯·德·莫里亚，这个古老的盖尔世系到马拉斯时断绝，他约于1357年去世，只留下女儿。其女伊莎贝拉嫁给罗斯林的威廉·圣克莱尔，奥克尼的继承权由此转入辛克莱家族，其子亨利于1379年成为奥克尼雅尔。

en: The Šubić were one of the Twelve noble tribes of medieval Croatia, documented from the twelfth century and holding the county of Bribir in inland Dalmatia. In 1251 King Béla IV of Hungary confirmed Bribir to them as a hereditary fief, and the house rose to dominate Croatian affairs under Paul I Šubić, Ban of Croatia from 1275 and Lord of Bosnia from 1299: he ruled most of the Dalmatian coastal cities, minted his own coin and in 1300 escorted the Angevin claimant Charles Robert from Split to the Hungarian throne. His son Mladen II overreached and was overthrown by a coalition of nobles and coastal cities at Bliska in 1322, after which the Hungarian crown curbed Šubić power. The house endured through several branches: its daughter Helen married into the Kotromanić and became mother of King Tvrtko I of Bosnia, while in 1347 King Louis I granted the castle of Zrin to Gregory and George Šubić, founding the Zrinski line that later led Croatian resistance to the Ottomans. The ancestral Bribir county itself was overrun by the Turks in 1520, scattering the remaining branches into Slavonia and Hungary.
zh: 舒比奇家族是中世纪克罗地亚十二贵族部落之一，12世纪已有记载，世代领有达尔马提亚内陆的布里比尔伯国。1251年匈牙利国王贝拉四世将布里比尔确认为其世袭领地；在1275年起出任克罗地亚班、1299年起兼领波斯尼亚的保罗一世治下，家族势力达到顶峰：他控制了达尔马提亚沿海多数城市，自铸钱币，并于1300年护送安茹家族的查理·罗伯特从斯普利特前往匈牙利登位。其子姆拉登二世穷兵黩武，1322年在布利斯卡被贵族与沿海城市的联军推翻，舒比奇家族的权势从此受到匈牙利王权的压制。但家族仍通过多个支系延续：女儿耶莱娜嫁入科特罗马尼奇家族，是波斯尼亚国王特夫尔特科一世的母亲；1347年国王拉约什一世将兹林城堡封给格列高利和乔治·舒比奇，由此开创的兹林斯基支系后来成为克罗地亚抗奥斯曼事业的领袖。祖地布里比尔伯国本身则于1520年被土耳其人攻陷，残余各支四散迁入斯拉沃尼亚和匈牙利。

en: The Sue were a cadet line of the great Ōuchi house of Suō, whose ancestors, the immigrant Tatara clan, claimed descent from King Seong of Baekje. In the late Heian period Ōuchi Morinaga took the name Migita, and his descendant Hirokata settled at Sue village in Yoshiki district, the site of modern Yamaguchi, and called himself Sue. The family rose as hereditary senior retainers of the Ōuchi: in 1401 Sue Hironaga was named shugodai of Nagato, and from 1432, under Morimasa, the Sue also held the shugodai post of Suō, keeping both offices for generations. Sue Hirofusa followed Ōuchi Masahiro to the Ōnin War and fell at the battle of Shōkoku-ji in Kyoto in 1468, while Hiromori crushed a rebellion by Ōuchi Noriyuki at home and was made shugodai of Chikuzen before being stabbed to death at a banquet by Yoshimi Nobuyori in 1482. Under Okifusa the house served Ōuchi Yoshioki and Yoshitaka in their wars against the Amago and the Shōni. Its last famous head Takafusa, later called Harukata, turned against Yoshitaka and drove him to suicide in the Tainei-ji incident of 1551, ruling through a puppet Ōuchi lord; but Mōri Motonari defeated him at the battle of Itsukushima in 1555 and Harukata killed himself, his main line perishing in the ensuing conquest of Suō and Nagato, though cadet branches such as Sue Takamitsu survived as Mōri retainers.
zh: 陶氏是周防守护大名大内氏的傍流，其祖先多々良氏是自称百济圣王后裔的渡来氏族。平安末期，大内盛长另称右田氏，其裔孙弘贤居住在吉敷郡陶村（今山口市），遂以陶为姓。陶氏世为大内家的谱代重臣：1401年陶弘长被任命为长门守护代，1432年陶盛政又出任周防守护代，此后两个守护代职务长期由陶氏世袭。应仁之乱中，陶弘房随大内政弘上洛，1468年战死于京都相国寺之战；陶弘护则在领国讨平大内教幸的叛乱，以此功出任筑前守护代，却在1482年山口的酒宴上被吉见信赖刺杀。陶兴房时代，陶氏辅佐大内义兴、义隆父子，在与尼子氏、少贰氏的战争中屡建大功。末代枭雄陶隆房（后改名晴贤）原为义隆重臣，因政见反目于1551年举兵发难，迫使义隆在大宁寺自尽，史称大宁寺之变，随后他拥立傀儡大内义长、独揽实权。然而1555年毛利元就在严岛之战中大败陶军，晴贤自尽，嫡流也在毛利氏的防长经略中覆灭，只有旁流如陶隆满等作为毛利家臣留存下来。

en: The Suetsugu were an Izumo kokujin house of the Uda Genji, branching from the Tomita line of the Sasaki clan. Their founder Tanekiyo held the Suetsugu lands in Hōkyō township from the Kenchō era of the mid-thirteenth century and took his surname from them; the place-name itself went back to the ancient Sue-tsuku shrine on Kamedayama recorded in the Izumo gazetteer, and Suetsugu Castle on that hill was later replaced by Matsue Castle. Tanekiyo's sons Kiyomasa and Kiyoshige marched to Kyushu for coastal defence during the Mongol invasion of 1281. In 1333 the clansman Sataka followed Enya Takasada to help Emperor Go-Daigo return from exile in Oki, while Takamune fought for the Northern Court under Ashikaga Takauji, and the house went on to serve the Yamana shugo in the Meitoku War of 1391, Uesugi Zenshū's rebellion of 1416, the Kakitsu Incident of 1441 and the Ōnin War of 1467. Around 1478 Amago Tsunehisa became shugodai of Izumo and their castle passed to him, and the Suetsugu became Amago retainers: Tadasada fought Mōri Motonari at Yoshida-Kōriyama in 1540, Tadafusa served in the defence of Iwami Ginzan from 1556 to 1562, and Sadataka fell in 1570 trying to restore the ruined Amago under Amago Katsuhisa. Suetsugu Castle itself was taken by the Mōri in 1571 and given to Motonari's son Motoyasu, who took the Suetsugu name. In 1607 Horio Yoshiharu built Matsue Castle on the old hilltop while the surviving Suetsugu lost their surname, later settling at Yonago in Hōki, where they took the Suetsugu name again.
zh: 末次氏是出云国的国人豪族，出自宇多源氏佐佐木氏流下的出云源氏富田氏一脉。始祖末次胤清在13世纪中叶建长年间领有出云法吉乡内的末次之地，遂以地名为姓；“末次”源于《出云国风土记》所载龟田山上的须卫都久社，而山上的末次城日后正是松江城的前身。胤清之子清政、清镇兄弟在1281年蒙古袭来的弘安之役中出阵九州，承担海边警护。1333年，族人佐隆随盐冶高贞为流放隐岐的后醍醐天皇回京效力，另一族人隆宗则在足利尊氏麾下为北朝立功；此后家族世代追随守护山名氏，先后参加1391年明德之乱、1416年上杉禅秀之乱、1441年嘉吉之乱和1467年应仁之乱。1478年前后尼子经久出任出云守护代，末次城落入尼子氏之手，末次氏转为尼子家臣：忠定于1540年随尼子军在吉田郡山城与毛利元就交战，忠房参加了1556—1562年的石见银山攻防战，定隆则在1570年为复兴尼子氏随尼子胜久奋战而死。1571年末次城被毛利氏攻落，毛利元就八男元康改称末次元康；1607年堀尾吉晴在旧城址上修筑松江城，幸存的末次族人被剥夺姓氏，辗转移居伯耆米子，后来才恢复末次旧姓。

en: The lords of Sully held the feudal barony of Sully-sur-Loire on the upper Loire from around the year 1000. The first recorded baron was Archambaud, whose line ended in an heiress, Agnes. In 1104 she married William the Simple of Blois, eldest son of Count Stephen of Blois and a grandson of William the Conqueror, who ruled Sully jure uxoris and founded the de Sully line continued by their son Eudes Archambaud. King Philip II seized the castle for twelve years before restoring it to the family. Later barons served the Capetian crown on campaign: Henry II died in the Angevin conquest of Sicily in 1269, and Henry III, Butler of France, died on the invasion of Aragon in 1285. The heiress Marie de Sully married Guy VI de La Trémoille at the end of the fourteenth century, carrying the barony into the La Trémoille family, who sold it in 1606 to Maximilien de Béthune, made Duke of Sully.
zh: 叙利家族自公元1000年前后起统治卢瓦尔河上游的卢瓦尔河畔叙利封建男爵领。最早见于记载的男爵是阿尔尚博，其家族男系断绝后只留下女继承人阿格尼丝。1104年，阿格尼丝嫁给布洛瓦伯爵艾蒂安之子、征服者威廉的外孙“老实人”威廉；威廉以妻权统治叙利，他们的儿子厄德·阿尔尚博一脉延续为德·叙利家族。法王腓力二世曾没收城堡十二年，后来又将其归还。此后的男爵追随卡佩王室出征：亨利二世于1269年在安茹家族征服西西里之役中战死，担任法国司酒官的亨利三世则于1285年在入侵阿拉贡时丧命。14世纪末，女继承人玛丽·德·叙利嫁给居伊六世·德·拉特雷穆瓦耶，男爵领随之转入拉特雷穆瓦耶家族；1606年该家族又把它卖给被封为叙利公爵的马西米连·德·贝蒂讷。

en: The Sunda dynasty ruled the Hindu Sunda Kingdom of western Java from at least the tenth century until 1579, its court moving between Kawali in the Galuh region and the western capital Pakuan Pajajaran, near modern Bogor. Stone inscriptions such as Kebon Kopi II of 932 and Jayabupati's Sanghyang Tapak inscription of 1030 trace the early kings, while the Carita Parahyangan chronicle preserves the later line. In the fourteenth century Prabu Ajigunawisesa held court at Kawali, and Sunda was named among the targets of Gajah Mada's Palapa oath of 1336. The 1357 Battle of Bubat destroyed a Sunda royal party at the Majapahit capital, killing King Prabu Maharaja and the princess Dyah Pitaloka. Niskala Wastu Kancana then rebuilt Kawali's walls and presided over a long peace, and the reign of Sri Baduga Maharaja from 1482 to 1521, remembered as the age of Prabu Siliwangi, was the kingdom's golden age of pepper wealth at Pakuan Pajajaran. As Islam spread along the coast, Cirebon broke away in 1482 and the port of Sunda Kalapa fell in 1527; Banten sacked the capital in the 1550s and extinguished the kingdom in 1579, the surviving court retiring to Sumedang Larang.
zh: 巽他王朝统治西爪哇的印度教巽他王国，至少自10世纪延续至1579年，王廷在东部加卢地区的卡瓦利与西部都城帕库安·巴查查兰（今茂物附近）之间迁徙。932年的格邦科皮二世碑文和1030年阇亚布帕提的桑香塔帕克碑文记录了早期诸王，后世王统则载于《卡利塔·帕拉扬甘》史书。14世纪时，普拉布·阿吉古纳维塞沙在卡瓦利理政，巽他也被列入加查·马达1336年帕拉帕誓言的征服目标。1357年的布巴特事件中，巽他王室一行在满者伯夷都城遭难，国王普拉布·摩诃罗阇与公主迪亚·皮塔洛卡双双殒命。此后尼斯卡拉·瓦斯图·坎察纳重修卡瓦利城防，带来长期太平；斯里·巴杜加·摩诃罗阇（1482—1521年在位，即传说中的普拉布·西里旺义）时代是王国的黄金期，帕库安·巴查查兰凭借胡椒贸易富庶一时。随着伊斯兰教沿海岸传播，井里汶于1482年独立，巽他格拉巴港于1527年陷落；万丹在16世纪50年代洗劫都城，并于1579年攻灭巽他王国，残余王室退守苏梅当·拉朗。

en: The Suphannaphum dynasty takes its name from Suphannaphum, the city of gold, a polity of the lower Chao Phraya valley on the site of modern Suphanburi. Growing out of an older Dvaravati-era center, whose rulers were already sending embassies to Song China in the twelfth century, it was one of the four rival port polities, with Lavo, Ayodhya and Phetchaburi, from whose merger the Ayutthaya Kingdom was formed in 1351. Its ruler Khun Luang Pa-ngua, brother-in-law of the founder Ramathibodi I, became the first Ayutthaya king of the house when he seized the throne as Borommarachathirat I in 1370, defeating the rival Uthong line based at Lopburi. The two houses fought over the crown for two generations: Borommarachathirat's son Thong Lan was deposed in 1388, but in 1408 Intharacha of Suphannaphum retook the throne and the Uthong line was reduced to a noble clan. Suphannaphum kings then ruled Ayutthaya through the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, including Borommatrailokkanat, who strengthened central administration and fought Lan Na, until the succession crises that followed King Chaiya's death in 1546 ended the house's unbroken hold on power.
zh: 素攀那蓬王朝得名于昭披耶河下游、今素攀武里一带的城邦素攀那蓬，意为“金城”。它由堕罗钵底时代的古老中心发展而来，早在12世纪其统治者就已向中国宋朝遣使，是与罗涡、阿约陀耶、碧武里并列的四大港口政权之一；1351年阿瑜陀耶王国正是由这几个政权合并而成。家族首领坤銮帕乌是开国君主拉玛铁菩提一世的姻亲，1370年他夺取王位，称波罗玛拉查铁拉一世，成为该家族登上阿瑜陀耶王位的第一人，压倒了以华富里为根基的乌通世系。两大家族为王位厮杀了两代人：波罗玛拉查之子通兰1388年被废，但1408年素攀那蓬的膺陀罗阇夺回王位，乌通世系自此降为贵族。整个15至16世纪，阿瑜陀耶都由素攀那蓬系君王统治，其中包括强化中央集权、与兰纳交战的波隆摩戴莱洛迦纳；直到1546年猜耶王死后的继承危机，才终结了该家族对王位的连续掌控。

en: The Sutayids were a Mongol dynasty of the post-Ilkhanate era, founded by Emir Sutay, a commander of Ilkhan Ghazan and son-in-law of Hulagu's son Möngke Temür, whom Turkish historians trace to the Sunud tribe. From the early fourteenth century the family held the Diyar Bakr region, with Amid as its chief city, and its fiefs and pastures stretched from the Jazira in the south northwards to Erzurum and Ahlat. Sutay served the ilkhs Ghazan, Öljaitü and Abu Sa'id and died in 1332; his son Hajji Taghay inherited his lands, quarrelled with the Oirats and leaned on the Jalayirids, until he was killed in 1343 by his own nephew Ibrahimshah with Chupanid backing. Ibrahimshah died in 1350, and the family's Iraqi holdings around Mosul were lost in the ensuing fighting; Pir Muhammad briefly recovered Mosul but was murdered in 1351. The surviving Sutayids then took refuge with the Eretnids in Anatolia, where they were known as the Barambays, while the Diyar Bakr lands passed to other Mongol and Turkmen lords.
zh: 速台家族是伊儿汗国解体后兴起的蒙古王朝，始祖速台是伊儿汗合赞麾下的埃米尔，也是旭烈兀之子蒙哥帖木儿的女婿，土耳其学者认为他出自逊尼都惕部。14世纪初起，该家族以阿米德为首府领有迪亚巴克尔地区，封地与牧场南起杰济拉，北抵埃尔祖鲁姆和阿赫拉特。速台历事合赞、完者都、不赛因三位伊儿汗，1332年去世；其子哈吉·塔盖继承领地，与卫拉特人相争并借重札剌亦儿王朝，1343年被得到出班系支持的侄子易卜拉欣沙所杀。易卜拉欣沙1350年死后，家族在摩苏尔一带的伊拉克领地在内乱中丧失，皮尔·穆罕默德一度夺回摩苏尔，却于1351年被杀。残存的速台族人投奔安纳托利亚的埃尔坦纳王朝，改称巴兰姆拜，迪亚巴克尔故地则转入其他蒙古与土库曼首领之手。

en: The Sutherlands of the far north of Scotland traced their line to Freskin, a Flemish knight settled by David I, whose grandson Hugh de Moravia received lands in Sutherland, the land south of the Norse earldom of Orkney and Caithness. Hugh's son William became the first Earl of Sutherland, and the family, first styled de Moravia, had taken the territorial surname Sutherland by the fifteenth century. The third earl fought at Bannockburn in 1314, and Earl Kenneth was killed at Halidon Hill in 1333; his son William, husband of a daughter of Robert the Bruce, was captured alongside David II at Neville's Cross in 1346 and killed in a feud with the Mackays in 1370. The Sutherlands then feuded for centuries with the Mackays, Sinclairs and Gunns of the surrounding Highlands. In 1517 the tenth countess, Elizabeth Sutherland, married Adam Gordon, a younger son of the Gordons of Huntly, and the earldom and chiefship passed to the Gordon line, which defeated a rival claim at Alltachuilain in 1519. The Gordon earls made the clan a stronghold of Highland Protestantism, and in the Jacobite risings of 1715 and 1745 the Sutherlands backed the Hanoverian government, helping to defeat the rebels at Littleferry in 1746. The sixteenth earl resumed the surname Sutherland and was confirmed as clan chief in 1719.
zh: 萨瑟兰家族世居苏格兰极北之地，先祖可追溯到大卫一世安置的佛兰德斯骑士弗雷斯金；其孙休·德·莫拉维亚受封萨瑟兰的土地，地名意为挪威人奥克尼与凯斯内斯伯爵领以南之地。休之子威廉成为第一代萨瑟兰伯爵，家族最初以德·莫拉维亚为姓，到15世纪已改用取自领地的萨瑟兰为姓。第三代伯爵参加了1314年的班诺克本战役，伯爵肯尼思于1333年战死在哈利顿山；其子威廉娶罗伯特·布鲁斯之女，1346年与大卫二世一同在内维尔十字被俘，1370年又在与麦凯家族的世仇中被杀。此后萨瑟兰人与周边高地的麦凯、辛克莱、冈恩等家族仇杀数百年。1517年，第十代女伯爵伊丽莎白·萨瑟兰嫁给亨特利戈登家族的幼子亚当·戈登，伯爵领与族长之位转入戈登一系，并于1519年在奥塔丘兰战役中击败了争位者。戈登家的伯爵们使该家族成为高地新教的堡垒，在1715年和1745年的詹姆斯党起事中等萨瑟兰人都支持汉诺威政府，并于1746年在利特尔费里协助击败叛军。第十六代伯爵恢复萨瑟兰姓氏，于1719年被正式确认为族长。

en: The Suwa were the priest-lords of the Suwa basin in Shinano, hereditary ohori, or chief priests, of the Upper Shrine of Suwa Taisha, who combined religious authority as the living vessel of Suwa Daimyojin with secular rule over Suwa district; their true surname is uncertain, though by the Nanboku-cho age they called themselves the Ji, or Miwa, clan. In the Kamakura period they were gokenin and Hojo housemen, and Morishige, a trusted lieutenant of the regent Hojo Yasutoki, made his house the center of the Shinano warrior league known as the Shinto. At the Kenmu restoration the ohori Yorishige and his son Tokitsugu raised the late Hojo heir Tokiyuki in the Nakasendai war of 1335 and briefly seized Kamakura, only to be defeated and killed by Ashikaga Takauji; the house was rebuilt by Tokitsugu's son Yoritsugu, who served Ashikaga Tadayoshi and, after Tadayoshi's fall, the Southern Court prince Munenaga and then the second Muromachi shogun, Yoshiakira; much of the Suwa faith and mythology was reworked in his time around the kinsman Enchū. In the Muromachi age the soryo and priestly lines split and were reunited by Yorimitsu, and after the Onin war the Suwa crushed the rival Kanasashi of the Lower Shrine and united the whole basin. Their Sengoku independence ended in 1542, when Takeda Shingen had the lord Yorishige murdered and absorbed Suwa; in 1582 Yoritada restored the house amid the chaos after Nobunaga's death, and after Sekigahara his son Yorimizu was enfeoffed as lord of Takashima, the Suwa domain, while a separated branch carried on the ohori priesthood.
zh: 诹访氏是信浓国诹访郡的领主，世代担任诹访大社上社的大祝，既是以诹访大明神依代自居的神职家，也是握有世俗权力的武家；其本姓诸说不一，至迟在南北朝时已自称神氏。镰仓时代它列名御家人，又成为北条得宗的被官，盛重作为执权北条泰时的心腹活跃，使诹访一门成为信浓武士团“神党”的核心。建武新政时，大祝赖重（照云）与时继父子拥立北条遗孤时行，在1335年的中先代之乱中一度占领镰仓，终被足利尊氏击败身死；其孙赖嗣（直赖）先后出仕足利直义、南朝宗良亲王与二代将军足利义诠，重整家势，后世流传的诹访信仰与神话也多在此时由一族的円忠等人重构。室町时期诹访分裂为总领家与大祝家，后由赖满重新统一，并在应仁之乱后攻灭下社的金刺氏，一统诹访一地。1542年战国大名武田晴信（信玄）谋杀当主赖重，诹访一度断绝；1582年武田灭亡、本能寺之变后，赖忠被旧臣拥立即再兴本家、收复旧领，关原之战后其子赖水受封信浓高岛藩（诹访藩），分出的支流则世代承袭上社大祝之职。

en: The Suwaydid were the Kurdish beys of the Emirate of Bingol, also called the Suveydi principality, which grew up around the town then known as Capakcur in the Armenian highlands. Kurdish tribes settled there in the Ayyubid period founded the beylik in the 1240s, and Sharaf Khan Bidlisi recorded a legend that its emirs descended from the Barmakids and had ruled since the days of Harun al-Rashid. As vassals in turn of the Mongols, the Kara Koyunlu and the Aq Qoyunlu, the Suwaydid kept their lands through the region's turmoils. Early in the sixteenth century the Safavids captured Capakcur, but Emir Abdal Bey held the fortress of Hancuk against them, and after his death in 1510 his son Isfahan Bey succeeded him; following the battle of Chaldiran in 1514 the emirs became Ottoman vassals. The inheritance was later split into Genc and Bingol, which fell under the Palu emirate in the early seventeenth century.
zh: 苏韦德家族是宾格尔埃米尔国（又称苏韦迪酋长国）的库尔德贝伊家族，其领地在亚美尼亚高地，围绕当时名为恰帕克丘尔的城镇发展起来。13世纪40年代，阿尤布王朝时期迁入当地的库尔德部落建立了这个贝伊国；沙拉夫汗·比特利西还记载了一则传说，称其埃米尔出自巴尔马克家族，早在哈伦·拉希德时代便已统治此地。苏韦德人先后臣属于蒙古人、黑羊王朝和白羊王朝，在地区动荡中保住了领地。16世纪初，萨非王朝攻占恰帕克丘尔，但埃米尔阿卜达尔贝伊死守汉丘克要塞；1510年他去世后，其子伊斯法罕贝伊继位，1514年恰尔德兰战役后埃米尔们转为奥斯曼的附庸。后来领地被分成根奇和宾格尔两支，在17世纪初落入帕鲁埃米尔国的控制。

en: The House of Sverre was the Norwegian royal dynasty founded by Sverre Sigurdsson, a priest from the Faroe Islands who claimed to be an illegitimate son of King Sigurd II. He took command of the rebel Birkebeiner party in 1177 and made himself sole king after the Battle of Fimreite in 1184, though his quarrel with the Church ended in excommunication in 1194 and a new round of civil war. Under his grandson Haakon IV the civil wars ended and the Norwegian kingdom reached the height of its medieval power; Eric II's daughter Margaret, heiress to the Scottish throne, died on her way there in 1290. The male line ran out with Haakon V in 1319, when the crown passed to his daughter Ingeborg's son Magnus VII of the House of Bjelbo. Through Ingeborg the Sverre blood entered the House of Oldenburg, reaching Christian I, king of Denmark from 1448 and of Norway from 1450.
zh: 斯韦勒家族是挪威的王室王朝，开创者斯韦雷·西居尔松本是法罗群岛的神父，自称国王西居尔二世的私生子。他于1177年接掌叛乱的桦皮鞋党，1184年在菲姆雷泰战役后成为唯一的国王，但与教会的冲突使他在1194年被绝罚，并引发新一轮内战。到他的孙子哈康四世在位时，内战终告结束，挪威王国达到中世纪权势的顶峰；埃里克二世之女、苏格兰王位继承人玛格丽特于1290年在赴苏格兰途中死去。1319年哈康五世去世，男嗣断绝，王位传给其女英格堡之子、比耶尔博家族的马格努斯七世。斯韦勒的血脉通过英格堡流入奥尔登堡家族，最终传到1448年就任丹麦国王、1450年又成为挪威国王的克里斯蒂安一世身上。

en: The Synadenos family, named after Synada in Phrygia, was a Byzantine aristocratic house whose name appears on seals as early as the ninth or tenth century. Its first known member, Philetos Synadenos, served as judge of Tarsus around the year 1000, and in the eleventh and twelfth centuries the family produced a string of military commanders linked by marriage to the Botaneiates and Komnenos: one Synadene was wed to King Géza I of Hungary, Basil Synadenos governed Dyrrhachium in the 1040s, and Andronikos Synadenos held several provincial governorships, including Cyprus, under Manuel I Komnenos. In the Empire of Nicaea the house belonged to the aristocratic opposition against the Laskaris, and it reached its peak under the Palaiologoi, when John Synadenos married Theodora Palaiologina, niece of Michael VIII, and became megas stratopedarches; the couple founded the convent of Bebaia Elpis and left an illustrated typikon portraying the family. Their son Theodore Synadenos was a leading supporter of Andronikos III in the civil war of 1321 to 1328 and later governed Epirus, where rebels held him captive from 1338 to 1340. In the civil war of 1341 to 1347 the Zealots of Thessalonica drove him out of the city, and he died under house arrest in Constantinople around 1346.
zh: 西纳齐诺斯家族得名于弗里吉亚的叙纳达，是拜占庭的贵族世家，其姓氏在9至10世纪的印章上已经出现。已知最早的成员费莱托斯约在1000年任塔尔苏斯法官；11至12世纪，家族出了一连串军事将领，并与博塔内亚蒂斯、科穆宁等大族联姻：一位西纳齐诺斯家的女子嫁给匈牙利国王盖扎一世，巴西尔于11世纪40年代出任都拉基乌姆总督，安德罗尼卡则在曼努埃尔一世·科穆宁治下历任包括塞浦路斯在内的多个行省总督。尼西亚帝国时期，该家族属于反对拉斯卡里斯王朝的贵族阵营；帕里奥洛格斯朝时家族达到鼎盛，约翰·西纳齐诺斯娶米哈伊尔八世的侄女狄奥多拉为妻，官至大营地长官，夫妇还创立了贝维亚·埃尔皮斯修道院，留下一部绘有家族成员肖像的彩绘仪轨。其子狄奥多尔是1321至1328年内战中安德罗尼卡三世的核心支持者，后来出任伊庇鲁斯总督，1338至1340年被起事者囚禁。1341至1347年内战中，他被塞萨洛尼基的狂热党逐出该城，约1346年在君士坦丁堡的软禁中去世。

en: The Tacettinoğulları, or Beylik of Taceddin, was a small Turkmen principality of northern Anatolia counted among the Beyliks of Canik. Its founder Taceddin, a lord of the Canik region, established himself at Niksar in the mid-fourteenth century as Seljuk and Ilkhanid authority faded, and in 1378 he married Eudokia, daughter of the Trapezuntine emperor Alexios III; he fell in battle near Ordu in 1386. His son Mahmud navigated between the Ottomans to the west and Kadı Burhaneddin to the south, accepting Burhaneddin's overlordship while secretly favoring Bayezid I, and after 1398 submitted to the Ottomans. He kept his lands through Timur's invasion of 1402 and the Ottoman Interregnum, but backing the rebel Küçük Mustafa cost him his life in 1423, when his own soldiers killed him. His two sons held on around Samsun and Çarşamba for a few years until the beylik was absorbed by the Ottomans around 1428.
zh: 塔杰丁奥卢又称塔杰丁贝伊国，是安纳托利亚北部的土库曼小邦，属于贾尼克诸贝伊国之一。随着塞尔柱与伊儿汗权威的瓦解，始祖塔杰丁于14世纪中期以尼克萨尔为中心立国；1378年他娶特拉布宗皇帝阿莱克修斯三世之女埃夫多基娅为妻，1386年在奥尔杜一带的征战中阵亡。其子马哈茂德周旋于西边的奥斯曼人与南边的卡迪·布尔汉丁之间，一面接受布尔汉丁的宗主权，一面暗中偏袒巴耶济德一世，1398年后归顺奥斯曼。1402年帖木儿入侵和奥斯曼空位期里他保住了领地，却因支持叛乱的小穆斯塔法，于1423年被自己的士兵所杀。他的两个儿子在萨姆松和恰尔尚巴一带又支撑数年，约1428年贝伊国被奥斯曼吞并。

en: The Ibn Tafrājin were an Almohad sheikhly family of Hafsid Ifriqiya, remembered above all for Abu Muhammad Abd Allah ibn Tafrājin, the power behind the Hafsid throne in Tunis in the mid-fourteenth century. He rose to high office under Abu Yahya Abu Bakr II and became chief chamberlain in 1343, steering the court toward the Marinids, who had become its direct neighbours after conquering Tlemcen in 1337. When a succession murder brought chaos in 1346 and 1347, he welcomed the invasion of the Marinid sultan Abu al-Hasan and then, after the Marinids withdrew, emerged as the most influential of the Almohad sheikhs. In December 1349 he placed al-Fadl Ahmad II on the throne, deposed him the next year and ruled in the name of the young sultan Abu Ishaq Ibrahim until his own death in 1364.
zh: 伊本·塔夫拉金是哈夫斯治下伊弗里基叶的一个穆瓦希德谢赫家族，最著名的成员是阿布·穆罕默德·阿卜杜拉·伊本·塔夫拉金——14世纪中期突尼斯哈夫斯王座背后的实权人物。他在阿布·叶海亚·阿布·伯克尔二世治下高升，1343年成为首席侍从长，并推动宫廷亲近马林人——后者1337年征服特莱姆森后已成为哈夫斯的紧邻。1346至1347年继位谋杀引发乱局，他迎入马林苏丹阿布·哈桑的入侵；马林人撤退后，他成为穆瓦希德谢赫中最有权势者。1349年12月他拥立法德勒·艾哈迈德二世为埃米尔，次年又将其废黜，改立年轻的苏丹阿布·易司哈格·易卜拉欣，以其名义执政，直到1364年自己去世。

en: The Takashima were a samurai house of Ōmi Province, descended from the Uda Genji line of the Sasaki clan. Their founder was Takashima Takanobu, a younger son of Sasaki Nobutsuna, who took his name from Takashima District and held Shimizuyama Castle. His son Yasunobu served the Kamakura shogunate as a distinguished gokenin. In the Shimotsuki Disturbance of 1285 another son, Yoritsuna, fought for the inner steward Taira no Yoritsuna and was made governor of Dewa; he received the Kutsukidani valley, from which his son began the Kutsuki clan, while further branches took the names Nagata, Hirai, Yokoyama and Tanaka. Together with the Yamazaki these houses formed the Seven Houses of Takashima, who dominated western Ōmi. The main line, descended from Yasunobu's heir Yasuuji, whom the shogunate recommended as governor of Etchū, was permitted by the Rokkaku to use the Sasaki surname and held that post hereditarily, so it was also called the Sasaki-Etchū house. Valued as capital-based gokenin close to Kyoto, the Takashima served as shogunal retainers and outer vassals, the Ashikaga shōguns' direct troops, in the Muromachi period and monopolised the guard posts of the twelve barriers of northern Ōmi. In the Sengoku age they came under the warlord Rokkaku together with the Kutsuki and Tanaka, and declined when the Rokkaku were destroyed.
zh: 高岛氏是近江国的武家，出自宇多源氏（近江源氏）佐佐木氏一脉。始祖佐佐木信纲次男高岛高信以近江高岛郡为姓，居城为清水山城；其子泰信作为名门御家人效力镰仓幕府。1285年霜月骚动中，高信另一子赖纲站在内管领平赖纲一方立功，受任出羽守，并分得朽木谷，其子义纲自此称朽木氏；此外还分出永田、平井、横山、田中等分家，与山崎氏等组成“高岛七头”，在西近江扩张势力。继承本家的泰氏一脉经幕府推举任越中守，且世代世袭该职，又得到佐佐木惣领家六角氏许可公开使用佐佐木苗字，因此也被称作佐佐木越中氏。高岛氏因地近京都、军力可观，被视为在京御家人名门，室町时代又作为幕府奉公众、外样众成为足利将军的直属部队，并独占北近江十二关的关守之职。进入战国时代，高岛氏与朽木氏、田中氏一同沦为战国大名六角氏的属下，六角氏灭亡后随之没落。

en: The Takeda were a Seiwa Genji clan of Kai Province, tracing their line to Minamoto no Yoshimitsu; his son Yoshikiyo took the Takeda name from an estate in Hitachi before the family settled in Kai. They backed Minamoto no Yoritomo in the Genpei War, Takeda Nobuyoshi sending an army after Yoritomo's defeat at Ishibashiyama in 1181, and Nobumitsu's service at Ichinotani in 1184 earned him the Constableship of Kai, while his role in the Jokyu War of 1221 added Aki. From these grew the Kai main line and cadet houses in Aki and Wakasa, with further offshoots such as the Nanbu and Ogasawara spreading across the north. In the Sengoku age Nobutora united Kai, only to be deposed in 1541 by his son Harunobu, better known as Takeda Shingen. Shingen built a disciplined army famed for its cavalry, seized Shinano, and fought his great rival Uesugi Kenshin in the five Battles of Kawanakajima from 1553, the bloodiest in 1561. After routing Tokugawa Ieyasu at Mikatagahara in 1573 he died on campaign, and his heir Katsuyori was crushed by Oda Nobunaga's muskets at Nagashino in 1575; the clan was extinguished in Nobunaga's invasion of 1582, when Katsuyori killed himself at Tenmokuzan. Survivors and cadet lines served the Tokugawa shogunate, some as daimyo and others in the ceremonial High Families.
zh: 武田氏是以甲斐国为根基的清和源氏武家，始祖可追溯到源义光，其子义清因受封常陆国武田乡而取此姓，后来一族定居甲斐。源平合战中他们支持源赖朝：1181年赖朝在石桥山战败后，武田信义曾发兵两万五千相救；信光在1184年一之谷之战立功，被任命为甲斐守护，又因1221年承久之乱的战功兼任安艺守护。由此发展出甲斐宗家与安艺、若狭等分支，南部、小笠原等家族也源自武田。战国时代，信虎统一甲斐，却在1541年被儿子晴信放逐；晴信即大名鼎鼎的武田信玄，他打造出以骑兵著称的精锐军队，攻取信浓，并与宿敌上杉谦信自1553年起五次会战川中岛，其中以1561年一战最为惨烈。1573年信玄在三方原大破德川家康后不久病逝于军中，继承人胜赖又在1575年长筱之战中被织田信长的铁炮兵击溃；1582年信长攻入甲斐，胜赖在天目山自尽，武田宗家灭亡。幸存的族人及旁支后来侍奉德川幕府，有的成为大名，有的位列执掌礼仪的高家。

en: The Takō, also written with the characters for Takō 多劫, were a cadet branch of the Utsunomiya clan of Shimotsuke. They began in 1248, when Takō Munetomo, seventh son of Utsunomiya Yoritsuna, settled in Kawachi District, built Takō Castle and took his surname from the place; the castle remained the family seat for three hundred and fifty years. The Takō fought for the Utsunomiya at the Battle of Otomesaka in the Tenbun era, where, though the battle was lost, they distinguished themselves, and in 1558 their lord Nagatomo held Takō Castle against the army of Uesugi Kenshin, killing the Sano commander Toyotsuna during the siege. The castle also weathered two attacks by Hōjō Ujimasa, in 1572 and 1584. In 1590 Takō troops served as Utsunomiya Kunitsuna's deputies in Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign, but when the Utsunomiya were attainted in 1597 the Takō lost their lands with their masters, and some of the clan later entered the service of the Matsudaira of Imabari.
zh: 多功氏（亦作多劫氏）是下野宇都宫氏的旁支。1248年，宇都宫赖纲的第七子多功宗朝进入河内郡，修筑多功城并以地名为姓，此城此后三百五十年间一直是多功氏的居城。天文年间的五月女坂之战中，多功氏虽随主家战败，仍有奋战表现。1558年上杉谦信入侵关东，多功城遭到上杉军围攻，当主多功长朝死守城池，还击毙了敌将佐野丰纲；1572年和1584年，城池又两次顶住北条氏政的进攻。1590年丰臣秀吉发动小田原征伐时，多功氏作为宇都宫国纲的名代从军。1597年宇都宫氏被改易，多功氏也随主家一同失去领地，族人中有一部分后来出仕今治藩的松平氏。

en: The Taku were a local warrior house of Hizen province in northern Kyushu, descended from the Tsukui clan and settled in the Taku basin in what is now Saga Prefecture. At first they kept their residence at Minami-Taku, but around 1193 Taku Munenao built Kajimine Castle, also called Taku Castle, on the summit of Mount Kajimine, and it remained the family seat for more than three hundred and fifty years. Through the Kamakura and Muromachi periods the Taku served among the warriors of Hizen, and in the mid-sixteenth century their lords joined the coalitions of Arima, Ōmura and other Hizen chiefs resisting the rise of the Ryūzōji. In 1544 Ryūzōji Chikaie took Kajimine and drove out the lord Taku Munetoki, and although Arima help restored the family the next year, Ryūzōji Takanobu and his brother Naganobu seized the castle again in 1562, driving the Taku to Suko, and the last resistance of Taku Munetoshi, who sided with the Shōni cause, was broken in 1563. The old Taku house then ended, and Naganobu's descendants, known as the later Taku, took over the district.
zh: 多久氏是九州北部肥前国的地方武家，出自津久井氏，定居在今佐贺县境内的多久盆地。其最初以南多久的馆舍为据点，约1193年多久宗直在梶峰山顶修筑梶峰城，又名多久城，此后三百五十多年间一直是多久氏的居城。镰仓和室町时期，多久氏作为肥前武士团的一员延续家业，16世纪中叶又与有马氏、大村氏等肥前诸将联合，对抗崛起的龙造寺氏。1544年龙造寺周家攻陷梶峰城，当主多久宗时出逃，翌年靠有马氏的支援才得以复归；1562年龙造寺隆信、长信兄弟再度攻城，多久氏退往须古，1563年追随少弐氏一方的多久宗利也被击败，前多久氏的历史就此终结，接管该地区的长信一脉被称为后多久氏。

en: The Talbots were a gentry family established on the Welsh march in Herefordshire and Gloucestershire since the twelfth century, when Henry II granted them lands there. They claimed kinship with the native Welsh princes through Gwenllian, daughter of Rhys Mechyll of the House of Dinefwr, whose arms the family assumed. Richard Talbot, feudal baron of Eccleswall, served as sheriff of Gloucestershire under Edward I, and his son Gilbert became the first Baron Talbot by writ in 1331, after holding office as Lord Chamberlain and Justice of South Wales. Gilbert's son Richard, the second baron, married Elizabeth Comyn, heiress to large estates including Goodrich Castle; as one of the disinherited lords he joined Edward Balliol's invasions of Scotland during the Second War of Scottish Independence. The Talbots survived the upheavals of the later fourteenth century and reached their greatest eminence in the fifteenth, when John Talbot, a famed commander in the Hundred Years' War, was created Earl of Shrewsbury in 1442, making the earls of Shrewsbury the senior line of the family.
zh: 塔尔博特家族是12世纪起在威尔士边境的赫里福德郡和格洛斯特郡立足的乡绅家族，领地由亨利二世册封。他们通过迪内弗尔家族的里斯·梅希尔之女格温利安与威尔士本土王公攀上血缘，并沿用了她家族的纹章。埃克尔斯沃尔封建男爵理查德·塔尔博特在爱德华一世时担任格洛斯特郡郡长；其子吉尔伯特曾任宫务大臣和南威尔士司法官，1331年凭议会召集状成为第一代塔尔博特男爵。吉尔伯特之子、第二代男爵理查德娶了科明家族的女继承人伊丽莎白，得到包括古德里奇城堡在内的大批地产；作为被剥夺继承权的贵族之一，他在第二次苏格兰独立战争中追随爱德华·巴利奥尔入侵苏格兰。塔尔博特家族熬过了14世纪后期的动荡，并在15世纪达到鼎盛：百年战争名将约翰·塔尔博特于1442年受封什鲁斯伯里伯爵，什鲁斯伯里伯爵一脉由此成为该家族的主支。

en: The Tamura were a warrior clan of Tamura district in southern Mutsu, in what is now Fukushima Prefecture, who claimed descent from the early Heian general Sakanoue no Tamuramaro. From the Kamakura period the Tamura shoji house, stewards of the ancient Tamura estate, held the district; it fought for the Southern Court through the Nanboku-cho wars and was destroyed in 1396 after the Tamura shoji rising against the Kamakura kubo Ashikaga Ujimitsu and the Shirakawa Yuki. Leadership then passed to the Miharu Tamura, who built up Miharu castle from 1504 and turned the family into a district-lord Sengoku daimyo holding nearly a hundred thousand koku across Tamura and Ono behind a network of forty-eight fortresses. Takaakira submitted to the Date after defeat in 1541, and Kiyoaki, pressed by the Ashina, Soma and Satake, married his daughter Megohime to Date Masamune to secure the clan's survival. When Kiyoaki died without a male heir in 1586 his retainers split into Date and Soma factions; after the Koriyama campaign of 1588 Masamune installed a compliant acting lord, and in the 1590 Oshu settlement the Tamura were attainted for missing the Odawara campaign and their lands passed to the Date. The house was nonetheless revived in 1652, when a son of Date Tadamune was enfeoffed at Iwanuma with thirty thousand koku as Tamura Muneyoshi; his line moved to Ichinoseki and carried on as a Sendai branch daimyo under the Tokugawa order.
zh: 田村氏是陆奥国南部田村郡的武家，据称是平安时代初期名将坂上田村麻吕的后裔，其地在今日本福岛县境内。镰仓以来，担任庄司的田村家一直领有古老的田村庄；南北朝时它始终站在南朝一方，1396年发动田村庄司之乱，被镰仓公方足利氏满与白河结城氏攻灭。此后三春田村氏取而代之，1504年起营建三春城，以四十八座支城为网络，在田村、小野两地领有近十万石，成为郡主级的战国大名。隆显于1541年战败后臣服伊达氏；清显在芦名、相马、佐竹环伺之下，把独女爱姬嫁给伊达政宗以换取存续。1586年清显急逝且无男嗣，家臣分裂为伊达派与相马派；1588年郡山合战后，政宗安插了听命于己的名代，1590年奥州仕置又以未参阵小田原为由将田村氏改易，领地并入伊达。不过田村家在1652年得以再兴：伊达忠宗之子宗良依爱姬遗言分领岩沼三万石，改称田村宗良，其后移封一关，作为仙台藩的内分分家大名在江户时代存续。

en: The Tanwar, better known as the Tomar, were a Rajput clan whose chiefs once ruled Delhi and built the fort of Lal Kot. In 1064 a branch led by Jhetpal, younger brother of the Tomar raja Anangpal II, founded the hill state of Dhameri in the foothills between the Ravi and Beas rivers; after garrisoning Pathankot the family took the territorial name Pathania. In 1337 its rajas still held this small Kangra principality, the later Nurpur kingdom. The state reached its height under Raja Basu Dev between 1580 and 1613, was drawn into the Mughal orbit, and in 1620 Raja Jagat Singh renamed Dhameri as Nurpur to honour Jahangir and Nur Jahan. It shook off Mughal suzerainty during Nader Shah's invasion of 1739, but in 1815 Ranjit Singh of the Sikh Empire annexed the kingdom.
zh: 坦瓦尔人通常称托马尔，是一个拉杰普特部族，其首领曾统治德里并修建拉尔科特堡垒。1064年，托马尔罗阇阿南格帕尔二世之弟杰特帕尔率一支族人在拉维河与比亚斯河之间的山麓建立了达姆里山邦；家族因驻守帕坦科特而以帕塔尼亚为氏。1337年，该家族的罗阇仍统治着这个冈格拉一带的小邦，也就是后来的努尔布尔王国。1580年至1613年罗阇巴苏·德夫在位时国势最盛，随后被纳入莫卧儿轨道；1620年，罗阇贾格特·辛格为向贾汉吉尔和努尔·贾汉致敬，将达姆里改名为努尔布尔。1739年纳迪尔沙入侵期间，它摆脱了莫卧儿宗主权，但1815年锡克帝国的兰吉特·辛格吞并了这个王国。

en: The Banu Talis were a Hawwara Berber dynasty who ruled the emirate of Bani Walid in the Tripolitanian interior. Their founder was the Kairouan scholar Sheikh Ahmad ibn Talis, who arrived in the Wadi Bani Walid in 1228, whether fleeing a dispute with the scholars and sultan of Kairouan or sent there by the Hafsids. The local Hawwara Berbers and Hilali Arabs gathered around him, and he built his seat at the Ibn Talis Palace, dug three to four hundred wells, and founded zawiyas, so that Bani Walid flourished through trade, agriculture and pottery and drew scholars such as Abd al-Salam al-Asmar. The emirate repelled a Spanish attack on its cultural capital Masalata in 1510 under Sheikh Abd al-Wahid al-Doukali, but the Ottomans proved too strong. The last prince, Ali II, resisted them for twenty-six years until an Ottoman army of ten thousand, backed by local tribes, stormed Qasr Bin Talis in 1603, burned Bani Walid and killed most of the ruling family, ending the emirate.
zh: 泰利斯家族是胡瓦拉柏柏尔人的王朝，在的黎波里塔尼亚内陆统治以拜尼沃利德为都的酋长国。始祖是凯鲁万学者谢赫艾哈迈德·伊本·塔利斯，他于1228年来到拜尼沃利德干河——一说因与凯鲁万的学者和苏丹发生纷争而出逃，一说受哈夫斯王朝委派。当地的胡瓦拉柏柏尔人与希拉尔阿拉伯人纷纷投附，他修建伊本·塔利斯宫作为权力中心，开凿三四百口水井，广建扎维叶道堂，使拜尼沃利德凭借贸易、农业和制陶业兴盛起来，并吸引了阿卜杜勒·萨拉姆·艾斯马尔等学者前来。1510年，酋长国在谢赫阿卜杜勒·瓦希德·杜卡利率领下击退了西班牙人对其文化中心姆塞拉塔的进攻，却终究不敌奥斯曼人。末代君主阿里二世抵抗了二十六年，1603年奥斯曼一万大军在当地部落支持下攻陷本·塔利斯堡，焚毁拜尼沃利德，屠戮统治家族大半，酋长国灭亡。

en: The Tenochcatl were the ruling line of the Mexica, or Tenochca, the people who built Tenochtitlan on an island in Lake Texcoco in 1325. Their name remembers Tenoch, the migration-era chief who led the Mexica south from Aztlán and after whom the city was named, though sources disagree on whether he was a historical ruler or a later myth. After his death the city elders elected Acamapichtli, son of the Mexica leader Opochtli Iztahuatzin and of Atotoztli, a princess of the Toltec-descended Culhua nobility of Culhuacan, and he ruled from about 1375 as the first tlatoani, his island city then a tributary of the Tepanec power Azcapotzalco. His successors shook off that overlordship when Itzcoatl forged the Triple Alliance with Tetzcoco and Tlacopan in 1427 and 1428, and the Tenochca tlatoque went on to lead what is called the Aztec Empire, the grandest of them taking the title huehuetlatoani, or supreme speaker. The line ended in the Spanish siege and destruction of Tenochtitlan in 1521, with the last dynastic tlatoani Cuauhtémoc put to death a few years later.
zh: 特诺奇卡特尔是墨西加人（又称特诺奇人）的统治世系；1325年，这支人在特斯科科湖的一座岛上建起特诺奇蒂特兰。他们的名字来自迁徙时代的首领特诺奇：他率领墨西加人从阿兹特兰南下，城市也以他命名，但史料对他究竟是真实首领还是后世神话人物说法不一。他死后，城中长老选出阿卡马皮奇特利为首任特拉托阿尼，约1375年即位；他是墨西加首领奥波奇特利·伊斯塔瓦钦与库尔瓦坎公主阿托托斯特利之子，母系出自自称托尔特克后裔的科尔瓦贵族，当时这座岛城还是特帕内克强权阿斯卡波察尔科的附庸。到伊茨科特尔在位时，该家族于1427至1428年与特斯科科、特拉科潘结成三方联盟，摆脱了特帕内克人的宗主权，特诺奇的特拉托阿尼们进而领导起后世所称的阿兹特克帝国，最强者还采用“大特拉托阿尼”即至高发言人的尊号。1521年，西班牙人围城并摧毁特诺奇蒂特兰，这一世系告终，末代王朝特拉托阿尼夸乌特莫克数年后被处死。

en: The Tepanecatl were the royal house of the Tepanecs, whose capital Azcapotzalco grew from a lakeside town into the dominant power of the Valley of Mexico. Acolnahuacatl, ruling from 1283 to 1343, married a daughter of the Chichimec lord Xolotl of Tenayuca, moved the seat of the dominion to Azcapotzalco, and allowed the wandering Mexica to settle on Tepanec land and found Tenochtitlan in return for tribute and military service. His son Tezozomoc, born around 1320 and ruling from the 1360s to 1426, turned the Tepanec Empire into the valley's hegemon, holding Tenochtitlan as a tributary, placing his own sons over Coyoacan, Tlatelolco and Tlacopan, and seizing Texcoco after killing its king Ixtlilxochitl I in 1419. His death in 1426 opened a succession war between his sons Tayatzin and Maxtla, and two years later the Mexica of Itzcoatl and the exiled Texcocan prince Nezahualcoyotl, joined by Tlacopan, stormed Azcapotzalco and ended Tepanec supremacy in the campaign that created the Triple Alliance.
zh: 特帕内卡特尔家族是特帕内克人的王室，其都城阿斯卡波察尔科从一座湖畔小镇崛起为墨西哥谷地的霸主。阿科尔纳瓦卡尔1283年至1343年在位，娶了特奈乌卡的奇奇梅卡首领索洛特尔之女，把统治中心迁到阿斯卡波察尔科；他还允许漂泊的墨西加人在特帕内克土地上定居、建立特诺奇蒂特兰，条件是纳贡和服兵役。他的儿子特索索莫克约生于1320年，14世纪60年代起统治至1426年，把特帕内克帝国建成谷地霸权：特诺奇蒂特兰沦为其附庸，他的亲生儿子们被安插到科约阿坎、特拉特洛尔科和特拉科潘，又在1419年杀死特斯科科国王伊斯特利尔索奇特尔一世后吞并该城。1426年他一死，两个儿子塔亚钦和马斯特拉爆发继位之争；两年后，伊茨科特尔率领的墨西加人与流亡的特斯科科王子内萨瓦尔科约特尔联合特拉科潘攻陷阿斯卡波察尔科，终结了特帕内克霸权，这场战事也直接催生了三方联盟。

en:
The Ternate dynasty ruled the clove island of Ternate in the Moluccas, originally as the Kingdom of Gapi. The island's four villages were led by clan chiefs called Momole; tradition says that in 1257 they elected Momole Cico as their first king, with the regnal name Baab Mashur Malamo, and the rulers later took the title Kolano. Clove sales to Arab, Malay and Chinese merchants made Ternate and its rival Tidore the wealthiest polities of eastern Indonesia, though much of their wealth was spent warring with each other. King Marhum became the first Muslim ruler in the 1460s, and his son Zainal Abidin enacted Islamic law and replaced the royal title with Sultan around 1486.

The Portuguese, brought to the island by Sultan Bayan Sirrullah in 1512, built a fort but fell out with the court; after they murdered Sultan Hairun, a five-year siege ended with their expulsion in 1575 under Sultan Baabullah, whose reign carried Ternate's influence to Sulawesi, Ambon, Timor and the southern Philippines. Spain seized the island in 1606 and the Dutch built their own fort there in 1607, dividing the Moluccas between them. Sultan Sibori Amsterdam's war against the Dutch ended in defeat and a vassal treaty in 1683; a British occupation of 1810 gave way to Dutch rule again in 1817, and in 1824 Ternate became the capital of a Dutch residency spanning Halmahera and the New Guinea coast.
zh:
特尔纳特王朝统治着摩鹿加群岛中盛产丁香的特尔纳特岛，政权初名加皮王国。岛上原有四个由称“莫莫莱”的氏族首领统领的村落；相传1257年，他们推举莫莫莱·奇科为第一位国王，王号巴阿卜·马舒尔·马拉莫，后来的君主改称“科拉诺”。丁香销往阿拉伯、马来和中国商人，使特尔纳特与其劲敌蒂多雷成为印尼东部最富庶的政权，不过大量财富都耗在彼此攻伐上。15世纪60年代，国王马尔胡姆成为首位穆斯林君主，他的儿子扎伊纳尔·阿比丁颁行伊斯兰教法，并于1486年前后把君主称号改为苏丹。

1512年，苏丹巴彦·西鲁拉把葡萄牙人引上岛屿，葡人修筑堡垒，却与宫廷反目；葡人杀害苏丹海鲁恩后，特尔纳特人围攻五年，于1575年在苏丹巴布拉治下将其逐出，巴布拉在位时特尔纳特的势力远达苏拉威西、安汶、帝汶和菲律宾南部。1606年西班牙夺取该岛，1607年荷兰人又在岛上筑堡，摩鹿加由此被两国瓜分。苏丹锡博里·阿姆斯特丹对荷开战失败，于1683年签订附庸条约；1810年英国一度占领，1817年恢复荷兰统治，1824年特尔纳特成为荷兰驻扎区的首府，辖地涵盖哈马黑拉和新几内亚海岸。

en: The House of Terter was a Bulgarian royal house of Cuman origin, descended from the Terteroba clan of the Cuman-Kipchak confederation, which had settled in Bulgaria in the migration after 1241. Its first prominent members were the despot Aldimir and his brother George, who seized the Bulgarian throne as George Terter I in 1280. When George stepped down in 1292 the country fell under the overlordship of the Golden Horde, which imposed a succession of puppet rulers until George's son Theodore Svetoslav overthrew the Mongol-backed Chaka in 1300 and restored the dynasty. Theodore Svetoslav's long reign brought recovery: he retook fortresses in the northeast, curbed separatist nobles and even executed the patriarch Joachim III, and left a stable, enlarged realm to his son George Terter II. George's early death in 1323 ended the line on the throne, and the crown passed to the Shishman dynasty of Vidin. Through marriage the Terterids were woven into Balkan politics: Anna became queen of Stefan Uroš II Milutin of Serbia, while Elena was given to the Mongol prince Chaka.
zh: 捷尔捷尔家族是出身库曼人的保加利亚王室，先祖属于库曼—钦察联盟的捷尔捷罗巴氏族，在1241年之后的迁徙浪潮中定居保加利亚。家族最早的显贵是专制君主阿尔迪米尔和其兄格奥尔基，后者于1280年登上保加利亚皇位，称格奥尔基·捷尔捷尔一世。1292年他退位后，保加利亚落入金帐汗国的控制，接连被扶立傀儡君主，直到格奥尔基之子托多尔·斯维托斯拉夫于1300年推翻蒙古人支持的查卡，恢复了家族统治。斯维托斯拉夫在位期间国家得以复苏：他收复东北要塞，镇压割据贵族，甚至处死了牧首约阿希姆三世，把一个稳定且版图扩大的国家留给儿子格奥尔基二世。格奥尔基二世于1323年早逝，家族皇统断绝，皇位转入维丁的希什曼王朝。通过联姻，捷尔捷尔家族也深深卷入巴尔干政局：安娜嫁给塞尔维亚的斯特凡·乌罗什二世·米卢廷为后，叶连娜则被嫁给蒙古王公查卡。

en: The Banu Thabit, also called the Banu Ammar, were a Berber dynasty of the Zakuga tribe of the Huwwara confederation who ruled Tripoli in the fourteenth century. Their founder Thabit ibn Ammar seized the city from its Hafsid governor around 1324 but was murdered within months; his son Muhammad took command in 1326 or 1327 and governed almost independently of Tunis, thanks to Tripoli's trade and Hafsid weakness, until he was assassinated around 1348. Muhammad's son Thabit lost the city to a Genoese expedition in 1354 or 1355 and was killed soon after, whereupon the Genoese sold Tripoli to the Banu Makki of Gabes. The surviving family fled to Alexandria in Egypt, prospered as merchants, and used their fortune to return and retake Tripoli in 1369 or 1370 under Abu Bakr. His nephew Ali then ruled until the Hafsid sultan Abu Faris Abd al-Aziz II arrested him and reconquered the city in 1401, ending the dynasty and bringing Tripoli back under direct Tunisian rule.
zh: 萨比特家族又称阿马尔家族，是出自胡瓦拉部落联盟扎库加部落的柏柏尔人王朝，在14世纪统治的黎波里。始祖萨比特·伊本·阿马尔约于1324年从哈夫斯王朝任命的总督手中夺取该城，但几个月后即遇刺；其子穆罕默德于1326或1327年接掌城市，凭借的黎波里的贸易繁荣和哈夫斯王朝的衰弱，几乎独立于突尼斯，直到约1348年被暗杀。穆罕默德之子萨比特在1354或1355年被热那亚远征军夺去城市，不久被杀，热那亚人随即把的黎波里卖给加贝斯的马基家族。幸存的族人逃到埃及亚历山大经商致富，用积攒的财富在阿布·伯克尔率领下于1369或1370年反攻收复的黎波里。阿布·伯克尔之后由侄子阿里继位，哈夫斯苏丹阿布·法里斯·阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹二世将阿里逮捕，并于1401年重新攻占该城，萨比特王朝灭亡，的黎波里重新归入突尼斯的直接统治。

en: The Thakial, or Thakyal, were the Rajput clan ruling the Bhimber hills of the western Punjab Himalaya before 1400. Their last king, Raja Sripat, gave his daughter in marriage to Chib Chand, a Katoch prince of Kangra, who inherited the Thakial lands and founded the Chib dynasty of Chibhal.
zh: 塔基亚尔是1400年以前统治旁遮普喜马拉雅西段比姆伯尔山区的拉杰普特氏族。末代罗阇斯里帕特将女儿嫁给冈格拉卡托奇家族的王子契布·昌德，后者继承其领地，建立了契巴尔的契布王朝。

en: The Thakur family were Srotriya Maithil Brahmins of Mithila, better known as the Oiniwar or Sugauna dynasty. The scholar Nath Thakur served the kings of the Karnat dynasty and was granted the village of Oini, from which the house took its name. When the Karnat kingdom collapsed under the Delhi invasion of 1324, Kameshwar Thakur, its former chief priest, succeeded to the rule of Mithila in 1325 and established the line that was to number more than twenty rulers. The dynasty moved its court between several villages of the Darbhanga country, building roads, tanks, temples and forts, and became a great patron of Maithili letters; the poet Vidyapati served seven of its kings and two of its queens and composed his Kirtilata for King Kirtisimha. The last ruler, Laxminath Singh Deva, was assassinated by Nusrat Shah of Bengal, and in 1526 Oiniwar rule gave way to decades of strife from which the Raj Darbhanga house emerged.
zh: 他俱罗家族是弥萨罗的什罗蒂亚迈蒂利婆罗门，世称奥伊尼瓦尔王朝，又称苏高纳王朝。学者纳特·塔库尔曾侍奉卡尔纳特王朝诸王，受封奥伊尼村，家族由此得名。1324年卡尔纳特王国在德里的入侵下崩溃，曾任其王室首席祭司的卡姆什瓦尔·塔库尔于1325年继掌弥萨罗，开创了这一脉，此后共有二十余位统治者。该王朝在达尔彭加一带数次迁都，修筑道路、水塘、神庙和堡垒，并大力扶持迈蒂利文化；诗人维迪亚帕蒂曾侍奉七王二后，并为国王基尔蒂辛哈创作《基尔蒂拉塔》。末代君主拉克希米纳特·辛格·提婆被孟加拉的努斯拉特沙刺杀，1526年奥伊尼瓦尔的统治结束，弥萨罗陷入数十年纷争，最终由达尔彭加王室取而代之。

en: The Theemuge, also called the Homa or Lunar dynasty, was the first house to rule the whole of the Maldives: its early king Koimala, enthroned around 1117 as Siri Mahaabarana, reclaimed the northern atolls from Indian invaders and gave the Maldivian throne its name Singaasana, the Lion Throne. In 1153 the last Buddhist king, Dhovemi, accepted Islam through the preacher Abu al-Barakat Yusuf al-Barbari and ruled as Sultan Muhammad al-Adil, after which the old Lunar line became known as the Theemuge dynasty. The islands grew wealthy on cowrie shells and coir shipped to Bengal and the Arab world, and in 1337 the throne belonged to Sultan Omar I, whose family fills the dynasty's later years. His son Ahmed Shihabuddine was deposed and killed in 1347 by his own sister Khadijah, the first sultana of the dynasty, whom the traveller Ibn Battuta found reigning in Malé during his visit in the 1340s; married to her own viziers, she was twice deposed by her husbands and twice returned to power, ruling for nearly thirty years until 1379. Her half-sister Raadhafathi then succeeded her, but the house was running out of heirs, and around 1388 Hassan I of the Hilaalee family overthrew Sultan Uthman Rasgefaan, ending Theemuge rule and opening the Hilaalee dynasty that lasted until the Portuguese incursion of 1558.
zh: 提穆格王朝又称霍马或月王朝，是第一个统治整个马尔代夫的家族：早期国王科伊马拉约于1117年即位，号斯里·摩诃婆罗那，他从印度入侵者手中收复北部环礁，并把马尔代夫王座命名为“辛伽萨纳”，即狮座。1153年，末代佛教国王多维米经传教士阿布·巴拉卡特·优素福·巴尔巴里引导皈依伊斯兰教，以苏丹穆罕默德·阿迪勒之名统治，古老的月族王统此后改称提穆格王朝。群岛靠向孟加拉和阿拉伯世界输出海贝与椰壳纤维致富，1337年在位的是苏丹奥马尔一世，王朝末年的君主都出自他这一家。其子艾哈迈德·希哈布丁于1347年被亲妹妹赫蒂彻废黜杀害，赫蒂彻由此成为王朝第一位女苏丹；旅行家伊本·白图泰14世纪40年代造访马累时，正是她在位之时。她嫁给自己的维齐尔，曾两度被丈夫废黜又两度复位，前后统治近三十年，直至1379年。继她而立的是异母妹拉达法蒂，但王室子嗣凋零，约1388年希拉利家族的哈桑一世推翻苏丹奥斯曼·拉斯格凡，提穆格统治告终，开启了延续到1558年葡萄牙人入侵的希拉利王朝。

en: The Thopia were one of the most powerful Albanian feudal families of the late Middle Ages, first attested among the nobles who made pact with Charles I of Anjou in 1274. As vassals of the Angevin Kingdom of Albania they rose as counts of Mat, and by 1340 they held much of the country between the Mati and Shkumbin rivers, having converted from Eastern Orthodoxy to Catholicism. A romantic legend marks their link to Naples: Andrea Thopia abducted Hélène, an illegitimate daughter of King Robert of Naples, and the two were executed at the Neapolitan court, leaving the sons Karl and George. Karl Thopia, born around 1339, became the family's greatest figure: from 1358 he ruled the central Albanian domains, seized the Angevin port of Durrës in 1368 and in 1385 defeated his rival Balša II at Savra with Ottoman help, though the price was Ottoman overlordship. He was also a builder, founding the church of Saint Jovan Vladimir near Elbasan in 1381. His son Gjergj lost Durrës to Venice in 1392, but the house survived the Ottoman advance long enough to serve Skanderbeg, whose commander Tanush Thopia held the Krujë garrison during its second siege.
zh: 托皮亚家族是中世纪晚期阿尔巴尼亚最有权势的封建家族之一，最早见于1274年与安茹的查理缔约的阿尔巴尼亚贵族名单。作为安茹阿尔巴尼亚王国的封臣，他们起家为马蒂伯爵，到1340年已控制马蒂河与什昆宾河之间的大片土地，并从东正教改宗天主教。家族与那不勒斯的联系带着一段传奇：安德烈·托皮亚劫走了那不勒斯国王罗伯特的私生女埃莱娜，两人最终被诱至那不勒斯处死，留下卡尔和乔治两个儿子。约1339年出生的卡尔·托皮亚是家族最杰出的人物：1358年起统治阿尔巴尼亚中部领地，1368年从安茹人手中夺取港口都拉斯，1385年借奥斯曼之力在萨夫拉击败劲敌巴尔沙二世，代价则是接受奥斯曼人的宗主权。他也热心营建，1381年在爱尔巴桑附近修建圣约万·弗拉基米尔教堂。其子格奥尔基于1392年把都拉斯丢给威尼斯，但家族一直撑到斯坎德培时代——其将领塔努什·托皮亚在第二次克鲁亚保卫战中镇守克鲁亚守军。
