en: The viscounts of Thouars emerged at the end of the ninth century as officers of the count of Poitou, governing the Thouarsais in northern Aquitaine from their castle at Thouars. Probably sprung from landowners around Poitiers, they grew rich on abbey patronage and estates at Bressuire, La Roche-sur-Yon and Poitiers itself, and Poitevin custom let the viscounty pass from brother to brother rather than directly from father to son. Aimery IV of Thouars crossed the Channel with William the Conqueror and fought at Hastings in 1066. Between 1150 and 1230 the family steered its own course between the Capetian kings and the Plantagenets. Its most famous branch entered Breton politics when Guy of Thouars married Constance, Duchess of Brittany, in 1199 and ruled as duke jure uxoris, then acted as regent for his daughter Alix from 1203 to 1206. During the Hundred Years' War the town of Thouars was seized by the Black Prince and later retaken for France by Bertrand du Guesclin. The original line ended with a viscountess who died in 1397, after which the viscounty passed to the House of Amboise and then the La Trémoille, who had it raised to a duchy in 1563.
zh: 图阿尔子爵家族出现于9世纪末，最初是普瓦捷伯爵的属官，以图阿尔城堡为中心，替封君治理阿基坦北部的图阿尔地区。他们可能出身普瓦捷附近的大地主，靠捐赠修道院和经营布勒叙伊尔、永河畔拉罗什乃至普瓦捷的地产致富；普瓦图的习俗允许子爵领在兄弟间依次相传，而非直接由父传子。图阿尔的艾梅里四世随征服者威廉渡过海峡，参加了1066年的黑斯廷斯战役。1150年至1230年间，家族在卡佩法王与金雀花王朝之间自行其是、左右周旋。家族最显赫的支系进入了布列塔尼政坛：居伊·德·图阿尔于1199年娶布列塔尼女公爵康斯坦丝，以妻权成为公爵，又在1203年至1206年为女儿阿历克斯摄政。百年战争期间，图阿尔城先被黑太子攻占，后来又被贝特朗·杜·盖克兰替法王收复。1397年，家族最后一位女子爵去世，嫡系就此断绝，子爵领先后转入昂布瓦斯家族和拉特雷穆瓦耶家族之手，后者于1563年将其升格为公爵领。

en: The Togashi were a military house of Kaga Province who claimed descent from the early warrior Fujiwara no Toshihito. For generations they held the hereditary post of Kaga-no-suke, one of the eight prestigious vice-governor titles known as the Hakusuke, and kept their mansion at Nonoichi; the clan also supplied the historical Togashi Yasuie, the barrier keeper portrayed in the Noh play Ataka and the kabuki Kanjinchō. In the Kamakura period they served as guard officers under the Rokuhara deputies in Kyoto, and a clansman fought for the Rokuhara side against Kusunoki Masashige at Tennōji in the Genkō War of 1333. Togashi Takaie was named shugo of Kaga in 1335, though the governorship later passed to the Shiba for some thirty years until Togashi Mitsunari recovered half the province in 1414 and his kinsman Mitsuharu reunited it. The house's rule ended in 1488, when Togashi Masachika was overthrown at Takao Castle by the Kaga Ikkō-ikki, the league of warrior-monks and peasants that then ran the province. Later heads were kept as figureheads or died in the Sengoku fighting: Harusada was killed by the ikki in 1570 for allying with Oda Nobunaga, and Yasutoshi fell in battle in 1574, after which his survivors served the conquerors of Kaga as minor retainers.
zh: 富㭴氏是加贺国的武家，自称出自早期武将藤原利仁。家族世袭加贺介一职，这是号称“八介”的八个名门次官职位之一，宅邸设在野野市；能剧《安宅》与歌舞伎《劝进帐》中把守关隘、放源义经一行过关的富㭴泰家，便被认为出自该族。镰仓时代，富㭴家在京都担任六波罗探题麾下的篝屋守护人，1333年元弘之乱时，还有族人在天王寺合战中作为六波罗方的武将与楠木正成交战。1335年，富㭴高家就任加贺守护，但守护职后来被斯波氏夺去近三十年，直到1414年富㭴满成夺回加贺南半国，同族满春又将南北两国合并。1488年，富㭴政亲在高尾城被加贺一向一揆攻灭，这个由僧兵与农民组成的盟约势力就此掌握加贺，富㭴家的统治宣告结束。此后的当主或被一揆奉为名义守护，或在战国战火中殒命：晴贞因与织田信长结盟于1570年被一揆诛杀，泰俊于1574年战死，幸存者只能作为小家臣侍奉征服加贺的新主。

en: The Toki claimed descent from the warrior Minamoto no Yorimitsu and through him the Seiwa Genji. In the twelfth century Minamoto no Mitsunobu, a fourth-generation descendant of Yorimitsu, was installed at Toki in Mino Province, and his line took the place as its family name. Toki Yorisada, whose maternal grandfather was the Kamakura regent Hōjō Sadatoki, campaigned with Ashikaga Takauji against the Southern Court, and from the Muromachi period onward the clan ruled Mino as its shugo governors. Toki Yasuyuki held the governorships of Mino, Owari and Ise and fought the shōgun Ashikaga Yoshimitsu for two years from 1389 when the latter tried to take Owari. Toki Shigeyori joined the Yamana side in the Ōnin War and invaded southern Ōmi in 1487. The main line's power was finally broken in the Mino civil wars of 1542, when Toki Yorinari was driven out by Saitō Dōsan. A surviving branch served Tokugawa Ieyasu and was enfeoffed in 1590 as a small-domain daimyō with 10,000 koku, moving through several fiefs before settling at Numata in Kōzuke in 1742.
zh: 土岐氏自称出自名将源赖光，属清和源氏一脉。12世纪，赖光的四世孙源光信被安置于美浓国土岐庄，其后人便以土岐为苗字。外祖父为镰仓执权北条贞时的土岐赖贞追随足利尊氏与南朝作战，室町时代以后，土岐家以守护身份统治美浓国。土岐康行身兼美浓、尾张、伊势三国守护，1389年因将军足利义满企图收回尾张而与之交战两年。应仁之乱中，土岐成赖加入山名一方，并于1487年攻入近江国南部。1542年美浓内战，土岐赖艺被斋藤道三击败驱逐，宗家势力就此终结。存续的一支侍奉德川家康，1590年受封一万石成为小藩大名，此后几经转封，于1742年定居上野国沼田藩。

en: The Tokunō were a branch of the Kōno clan, itself descended from the ancient Ochi family of Iyo Province on Shikoku, in present-day Ehime Prefecture. They took their name from the Tokunō manor in Kuwamura district, held by the descendants of Kōno Michitoshi, who had fought on the imperial side in the Jōkyū War of 1221 and was killed at the Battle of Mount Takanawa. In the Kamakura period the family built Tsuneishi Castle on the heights above the manor as its seat, served as western guards in Kyushu, and Tokunō Michizumi campaigned against the Mongol invaders in 1274. During the Genkō War of 1333 Tokunō Michitsuna raised troops for Emperor Go-Daigo and, together with other Kōno branch houses, defeated the army of the Nagato tandai in Iyo, briefly winning the Kōno headship for himself. When the Kenmu Restoration collapsed he joined the Southern Court under Nitta Yoshisada and was killed in the siege of Kanagasaki Castle in Echizen in 1337. A cadet line later settled in Etchū Province and served the Maeda lords of Kaga as village officers in the Edo period.
zh: 得能氏是四国伊予国（今爱媛县）河野氏的支流，而河野氏出自古老的越智氏。始祖河野通俊在1221年的承久之乱中站在朝廷一方，战死于高绳山之战；他的子孙获许领有桑村郡得能庄，遂以“得能”为苗字。镰仓时代，得能家在得能山上修筑常石城作为本据，族人出任西面武士，得能通纯还参加了1274年抵御蒙古入侵的文永之役。1333年元弘之乱时，得能通纲举兵响应后醍醐天皇，与河野家其他分家联手在伊予击败长门探题的军队，并一度取得河野家督之位。建武新政崩溃后，他追随新田义贞加入南朝，1337年在越前国金崎城的围攻中战死。其一支庶流后来定居越中国，江户时代作为村役人侍奉加贺藩主前田氏。

en: The Tomaras of Gwalior were a Rajput dynasty of central India who held the Gwalior fort and its surroundings from the late fourteenth to the early sixteenth century. They claimed descent from the Lunar line and kinship with the earlier Tomaras of Delhi, but began modestly as Tughlaq feudatories holding the small fief of Aisah. In 1394 their chief Virasimha, rewarded for service at the Delhi palace, received a grant of Gwalior and seized the fort from its reluctant governor, founding the dynasty. His successors fought repeatedly to keep their independence: Kirtisimha backed the Sharqi sultan of Jaunpur against Delhi in 1466, and Manasimha, better known as Man Singh Tomar, bought off Bahlul Lodi with tribute and weathered Sikandar Lodi's campaigns of 1501 to 1508, ambushing the retreating imperial army near Jatwar. A patron of music and building, Man Singh raised the Man Mandir palace inside Gwalior Fort. His son Vikramaditya could not hold out against Ibrahim Lodi and surrendered the fort in 1523, accepting the fief of Shamsabad instead; he died fighting for Ibrahim Lodi against Babur at Panipat in 1526, and Tomara rule in Gwalior came to an end.
zh: 瓜廖尔的都摩罗是中印度的拉杰普特王朝，14世纪末至16世纪初占据瓜廖尔要塞及其周边。他们自称属月亮世系，与更早的德里都摩罗人同族，起家时却只是图格鲁克王朝治下领有艾萨小封地的封臣。1394年，首领维拉辛哈因在德里宫廷当差有功受封瓜廖尔，并用计从拒不让城的长官手中夺取要塞，王朝由此建立。其后诸王为保住独立屡次征战：基尔蒂辛哈于1466年支持江布尔的沙尔基苏丹对抗德里；曼·辛格·托马尔（即曼纳西姆哈）先以贡金买下巴鲁尔·洛迪，又在1501至1508年顶住西坎达尔·洛迪的连番进攻，并在贾特瓦尔附近伏击撤退的帝国军队。曼·辛格提倡音乐、大兴土木，在瓜廖尔要塞内修建了曼曼迪尔宫。其子维克拉马迪亚抵挡不住易卜拉欣·洛迪，于1523年交出要塞，改领沙姆萨巴德封地；1526年他在帕尼帕特第一次战役中为易卜拉欣·洛迪迎战巴布尔时战死，都摩罗在瓜廖尔的统治至此终结。

en: The Toyama of Mino traced their origin to Kato Kagekado, a retainer of Minamoto no Yoritomo who was rewarded with Toyama manor in Ena district, present-day Gifu Prefecture, around the 1190s; his eldest son Kagetomo settled there and took the place name, first appearing in records in 1221 when he executed the court noble Ichijo no Nobuyoshi at Iwamura after the Jokyu War. From their seat at Iwamura Castle the family spread into seven branch houses, the so-called seven Toyama, holding Akechi, Naegi, Iibama, Kushiwara and other estates, and ranked with the Toki as a leading family of eastern Mino; some of its men served the Ashikaga shoguns directly as hokoshu, and Kagefusa fought for the Ashikaga at the battle of Minatogawa in 1336. In 1473, while Saitō Myōchin was away on campaign in Ise, the Ogasawara of Matsuo and the Kiso overran much of the region, though the Iwamura house held its land by repairing its castle. During the Sengoku conquests the Toyama submitted to Takeda Shingen between 1554 and 1556, and Oda Nobunaga married his adopted daughter Lady Otsuya to the Iwamura lord Kagetō; the main houses of Iwamura, Iibama, Yasuki and Akeshō were destroyed in the Oda-Takeda struggle that followed. The Akechi, Kushiwara and Naegi branches joined Tokugawa Ieyasu and fought on the Eastern side at Sekigahara in 1600, distinguishing themselves in the preliminary Tōnō campaign, the Naegi house becoming a ten-thousand-koku tozama daimyo line that survived into the Meiji era as viscounts.
zh: 美浓远山氏的祖先是源赖朝的重臣加藤景廉，他在12世纪90年代受封美浓国惠那郡的远山庄（今岐阜县惠那市一带），长子景朝到任后以地名为苗字，其名首见于1221年——承久之乱后，他在岩村处决了乱党首谋之一一条信能。远山氏以岩村城为本据，分出明知、苗木、饭羽间、串原等支族，号称远山七头，与土岐氏并称美浓东部的名门，室町时代还有人出任将军家的奉公众；1336年，族人景房还在凑川之战中为足利方立功。1473年，趁斋藤妙椿远征伊势，信浓松尾的小笠原氏和木曾氏攻入东美浓，远山诸族连失城池，唯有岩村远山氏凭修缮城防守住领地。战国时期，远山氏在1554至1556年间臣服于武田信玄，织田信长也把养女阿艳嫁给岩村城主景任以结姻好；后来岩村、饭羽间、安木、明照等宗家支族都被卷入织田与武田的争夺而灭亡。明知、串原、苗木三家则转投德川家康，1600年关原之战时加入东军并在东濃之战立功，其中苗木远山氏成为一万余石的外样大名，明治维新后位列华族子爵。

en: The Toshima were a warrior house of southern Musashi, around present-day Tokyo, belonging to the Taira-surnamed Chichibu clan of the eight great Taira bands of the Kantō. In 1023 Chichibu Takesune received Toshima district in Musashi and Kasai in Shimosa for slaying the Musashi deputy Fujiwara no Maeie, and his line took the name Toshima; its birthplace is held to be Toshima in present-day Kita Ward, Tokyo. The clan fought in the northern campaigns of Minamoto no Yoriyoshi and Yoshiie, and Toshima Toshitsune won fame under Minamoto no Yoshitomo in the Hōgen War of 1156. In 1180 Kiyomoto and his son Kiyoshige joined Minamoto no Yoritomo's revolt and became Kamakura gokenin; Kiyoshige founded the Kasai clan, which grew powerful in Mutsu and lasted into the Sengoku age, while the main line stayed in Musashi. In 1333 some clansmen died with the Hōjō at Rokuhara and others fought under Nitta Yoshisada at Bubaigawara. The Toshima later joined the Taira league called the Heiikki, whose revolt of 1368 was crushed by the Uesugi with the Toshima lands confiscated, and afterwards moved their seat to Shakujii Castle. In 1477 the clan head Yasutsune backed Nagao Kageharu's rebellion and was defeated by Ōta Dōkan at Egota and Numabukuro; his brother Yasuaki was killed, Shakujii and Hiratsuka castles fell by 1478, and Yasutsune vanished, ending the main line. Descendants served the Later Hōjō and then the Tokugawa as hatamoto.
zh: 丰岛氏是南武藏（今东京周边）的武家，属于平姓秩父氏一族，名列坂东八平氏。1023年，秩父武常因讨杀武藏介藤原真枝之功，受封武藏国丰岛郡和下总国葛西之地，其后代遂以丰岛为苗字，发源地相传在今东京都北区丰岛。丰岛氏曾随源赖义、源义家转战奥州，1156年保元之乱中，丰岛四郎俊经在源义朝麾下立下武名。1180年，清元、清重父子投奔起兵的源赖朝，成为镰仓殿的御家人；清重另继葛西御厨，开创葛西氏，后来在奥州成为大族，丰岛本宗则留在武藏。1333年，一族有人随六波罗探题北条仲时自刃，也有人加入新田义贞，在分倍河原作战。南北朝动乱中，丰岛氏加入平一揆，1368年平一揆之乱被上杉氏镇压后所领被没收，后来把本据移到石神井城。1477年，当主泰经呼应长尾景春之乱举兵，在江古田原、沼袋被太田道灌击败，弟泰明战死；石神井城和平塚城相继于1477、1478年陷落，泰经下落不明，丰岛本宗就此灭亡。其后人出仕后北条氏，继而成为德川氏的旗本；支流葛西氏则在陆奥一直延续到战国时代。

en: The To were a cadet branch of the Chiba clan, itself of Kanmu Heishi descent. Their ancestor Taneyori, sixth son of Chiba Tsunetane, held Higashi manor in Shimosa, present-day Tonosho in Chiba Prefecture, and took its name as his own. When Minamoto no Yoritomo rose in 1180, Taneyori persuaded his father to join him and joined his nephew Narutane in the attack that destroyed the Taira-appointed deputy of Shimosa, earning rank above his father's. The early heads were known as poets rather than soldiers: Shigetane won the confidence of Shogun Minamoto no Sanetomo, and Taneyuki served four successive shoguns through verse and calligraphy, starting a family tradition of Nijo-school waka learning. A branch of the family later settled in Gujo district of Mino, with Shinowaki Castle as its seat. Its ninth head Tsuneyori, a general and poet who lived through most of the fifteenth century, was driven out of the castle by Saito Myochin in 1468 but won its return through poetry in 1469, and in 1471 he delivered the secret Kokin denju lectures on the Kokin Wakashu to the poet Sogi, making the To famous as the house of the Kokin transmission. In the Onin War the family took the Yamana side against the Mino shugo Toki. Its fortunes faded in the Sengoku age, and in 1559 the head Jokei was overthrown and slain by his own son-in-law Endo Morikazu, who inherited the estates; the Endo became lords of Gujo domain, and their last lord reverted to the To name in the Meiji era and was made a viscount.
zh: 东氏是千叶氏的庶流，出自桓武平氏。祖先胤赖是千叶常胤的第六子，领有下总国东庄（今千叶县东庄町），遂以东为苗字。1180年源赖朝举兵时，胤赖力劝父亲归附，并与外甥成胤一同袭杀了平氏任命的下总目代，后来叙位竟在父亲之上。东氏早期当主多以歌人闻名：重胤深得将军源实朝信任，胤行凭和歌与文笔出仕源实朝等四位将军，奠定了东家世代传承二条派歌学的家风。其一支后来移居美浓国郡上，以篠胁城为本据。九代当主东常缘是活跃于15世纪的武将兼歌人，1468年篠胁城被守护代斋藤妙椿攻陷，他却凭和歌交谊在1469年要回城池；1471年，他向连歌大师宗祇讲授《古今和歌集》的秘传，即古今传授，东氏由此以古今传授之家闻名。应仁之乱中，东氏加入山名氏的西军，与从属东军的美浓守护土岐氏敌对。进入战国后家势衰落，1559年，当主东常庆被女婿远藤盛数攻灭，远藤氏继承其家督，后来成为江户幕府郡上藩的藩主；末代藩主在明治维新后恢复东姓，并受封子爵。

en: The de La Tour du Pin were barons of the castle of La Tour-du-Pin in the Viennois, an Alpine lordship of the Kingdom of Burgundy. Their fortune was made by marriage: in 1273 Humbert I, baron of La Tour-du-Pin, wed Anne, daughter and heiress of Guigues VII, dauphin of Viennois, and ruled the Dauphiné jure uxoris, becoming a vassal of the French king Philip IV in 1294. His son John II and grandson Guigues VIII kept the title; Guigues, celebrated as a fighting knight, defeated the Savoyards at the battle of Varey in 1325, fought for Philip VI at Cassel in 1328, and was killed besieging a Savoyard castle in 1333. He was succeeded by his brother Humbert II, the last dauphin of the local line, whose only son died in childhood. Childless and short of money, Humbert sold the Dauphiné to the French crown in 1349, entering the Dominican Order and later becoming Latin patriarch of Alexandria. From that sale the heir apparent of France took the title dauphin, and the Dauphiné became a royal appanage.
zh: 拉图尔迪潘家族是维埃努瓦拉图尔迪潘城堡的男爵，而维埃努瓦原属勃艮第王国的阿尔卑斯领地。家族的崛起靠的是联姻：1273年，拉图尔迪潘男爵亨伯特一世娶维埃纳多菲内吉格七世的女儿兼女继承人安妮为妻，以妻权统治多菲内，并于1294年成为法王腓力四世的封臣。其子让二世和孙子吉格八世相继保有头衔：吉格八世以勇武著称，1325年在瓦雷战役中击败萨伏依人，1328年随腓力六世征战卡塞尔，1333年在围攻萨伏依城堡时阵亡。继位的是其弟亨伯特二世，即本地世系的最后一位多菲内；他的独子幼年夭折，又苦于财政拮据，最终在1349年把多菲内卖给法国王室，自己加入多明我会，后来出任拉丁礼亚历山大牧首。正是这次出售，使法国王储从此拥有“多菲内”（海豚）的头衔，多菲内也成为王室的亲王封地。

en: The Tozawa were a warrior house of the Ou region, holding estates in the hills of what the game calls Ugo, around modern Semboku and Kakunodate in Akita. Their genealogy claimed descent from the Kammu Taira through Taira no Tadamasa, whose grandson Hidemori is said to have fled to the Shizukuishi manor in Mutsu, submitted to Minamoto no Yoritomo in 1185 and taken the Tozawa name from a village there; historians consider them more probably an ancient local gōzoku, perhaps of Emishi stock and once in the service of the Northern Fujiwara, that adopted a prestigious Taira pedigree. Driven across the Ou mountains by Nanbu pressure, Kanemori moved the seat to the Kadoya valley of Dewa in 1206 and built Kadoya Castle in 1228. During the Nanboku-cho wars the Tozawa backed the Southern Court, sending troops under Gensei for Kitabatake Akinobu's campaign of 1341, before pragmatically turning to the Ashikaga Northern Court in 1356. In the fifteenth century they shifted their seat to Kakunodate, unified the Kitaura district and fought long contests with the Onodera and Ando, completing their rise to Sengoku daimyo. They joined Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign in 1590 and were confirmed at some forty-five thousand koku. Tozawa Masamori sided with the Tokugawa at Sekigahara but was judged half-hearted against the Uesugi and cut back to forty thousand koku at Matsuoka in Hitachi; in 1622 the shogunate moved the clan back to its ancestral region as lords of the sixty-thousand-koku Shinjo Domain, which it ruled until the Meiji Restoration, after which it was made a viscountcy.
zh: 户泽氏是奥羽地方的武家，盘踞在游戏所称羽后、今秋田县仙北和角馆一带的山区。其家谱自称出自桓武平氏平忠正一脉，说忠正之孙衡盛逃到陆奥滴石庄，1185年臣服源赖朝，因居住在滴石的户泽邑而取苗字；史家则多认为他们其实是陆奥自古土着的豪族，可能带有虾夷血统、曾侍奉奥州藤原氏，后来才附会上平氏名门的出身。1206年，兼盛因南部氏的攻势从滴石迁往出羽仙北郡门屋，1228年修筑门屋城。南北朝时期户泽氏效忠南朝，1341年玄盛曾发兵参加北畠显信的战役，到1356年英盛又顺势转仕足利北朝，在乱世中存续下来。15世纪他们把本据迁到角馆，统一北浦郡，与小野寺氏、安东氏长期混战，完成战国大名化。1590年户泽氏参加小田原征伐，被丰臣秀吉确认约四万五千石领地。关原之战中户泽政盛虽属东军，却因攻打上杉氏消极，被减封到常陆松冈四万石；1622年幕府借最上氏改易之机，将其移封回祖地，建立六万石的新庄藩，户泽氏世袭藩主直到明治维新，维新后授子爵。

en: The Trakhan dynasty ruled Gilgit, in the upper Indus valley, for some five centuries until its end around 1810. Local tradition makes its founders the heirs of the Shahreis, the earlier Hindu or Buddhist rajas of Gilgit: a Persian adventurer called Azur Jamshid is said to have overthrown the cruel king Shri Badat, married his daughter Nur Bakht Khatun, and fathered Garg, the first ruler to take the title raja. The dynasty itself was named after a raja called Trakhan, who reigned around the turn of the fourteenth century, and the line was Muslim for most of its history. Under Raja Torra Khan, who ruled from 1421 to 1475, the Trakhan name became fixed; his stepbrother Shah Rais Khan fled to Badakhshan and from there seized Chitral, founding the rival Raisiya line. Later rulers included the seventeenth-century queen Dadi Jawari, remembered for the irrigation canals she built. The last Trakhan raja, Abbas, died around 1810, after which Gilgit was fought over by the rulers of Yasin, Punial and Nagar; the mirs of Hunza and Nagar also claimed Trakhan descent.
zh: 特剌汗王朝统治印度河上游的吉尔吉特约五个世纪，约于1810年终结。当地传说把其始祖接在吉尔吉特更早的印度教或佛教王公沙赫雷伊斯家族之后：波斯冒险家阿祖尔·贾姆希德推翻暴君施里·巴达特，娶其女努尔·巴赫特·哈通，生下的加尔格是首位采用拉杰头衔的统治者。王朝得名于14世纪前后在位的拉杰特剌汗，其家族在历史上大部分时间都是穆斯林。1421至1475年在位的拉杰托拉汗时代，特剌汗之名固定下来；他的异母兄弟沙阿·拉伊斯汗逃往巴达赫尚，又从那里夺取吉德拉尔，另立拉伊斯支系。后期名君包括17世纪的女王达迪·贾瓦里，以修建灌溉水渠闻名。末代拉杰阿巴斯约于1810年去世，此后吉尔吉特被亚辛、布尼亚尔和讷格尔的统治者轮番争夺；罕萨和讷格尔的君长也自称特剌汗后裔。

en: The Trần ruled Đại Việt from its capital at Thăng Long between 1225 and 1400. The clan, descended from a fishing family of Fujian origin settled in the Red River Delta, rose through marriage with the Lý imperial house; in 1225 the strongman Trần Thủ Độ arranged for the child empress Lý Chiêu Hoàng to cede the throne to his nephew Trần Cảnh, who became Trần Thái Tông, ending 216 years of Lý rule. The dynasty's finest hour came against the Mongols, whose three invasions were all repelled, culminating in the destruction of the Yuan fleet at the Battle of the Bạch Đằng River in 1288. Trần rule was a golden age of Vietnamese culture: the first literature in the chữ Nôm script appeared, vernacular Vietnamese entered the court alongside Literary Chinese, and paper money was issued for the first time. Improved gunpowder also allowed the Trần to push south and reduce Champa to vassalage. In 1337 the throne was held by Trần Hiến Tông, but later reigns were troubled by succession crises and Cham counterattacks, and in 1400 the minister Hồ Quý Ly forced the last Trần emperor to abdicate. A short-lived Later Trần resistance against the Ming occupation that began in 1407 ended in 1413.
zh: 陈朝（1225—1400年）以升龙为都，统治大越。陈氏先祖是12世纪初从中国福建迁居红河三角洲、以捕鱼为生的移民家族，靠与李朝皇室累世联姻而跻身朝堂；1225年，权臣陈守度安排年幼的女帝李昭皇禅位给他年仅七岁的侄子陈煚，是为陈太宗，享国216年的李朝就此终结。陈朝最辉煌的功绩是三挫蒙古入侵，元朝军队三次来犯均被击退，尤以1288年白藤江之战歼灭元朝水师、斩获敌舰数百艘最为著名。陈朝也是越南文化的黄金时代：最早的字喃文学在此时出现，越南口语与汉文并用进入宫廷，朝廷还首次发行纸币；改良的火药武器帮助陈朝南征，迫使占城称臣纳贡。1337年在位的是陈宪宗。此后陈朝接连陷入继承危机与占城反攻而日趋衰弱，1400年权臣胡季犛逼迫末代陈帝退位、另立胡朝；明朝于1407年出兵占领安南之后，陈朝宗室一度建立后陈朝起兵抵抗，至1413年最终覆灭。

en: Trâsâk Ph'aem is the first Khmer sovereign known only from the Cambodian Royal Chronicles, a legendary line that takes up the story where the temple inscriptions end after Jayavarman IX around 1340. The chronicles call the founder Chay, a gardener born to a hermit of Phnom Kulen and a Samre peasant woman, whose sweet cucumbers earned him the title Neay Trasac Paem. Entrusted with the king's own spear to guard his crops, he mortally wounded the monarch during a nightly test of his vigilance; the dying king absolved him, and with no heir left, a white elephant was made to choose a successor and singled out the gardener before the assembled nobility. Taking the royal name Ang Chey, he married Candravati, the late king's daughter, and after purging hostile lords withdrew to Banteay Samré. His sons Nippean Bat, who ruled from 1340 to 1346, and Sithean Reachea succeeded him; under Nippean Bat the Thai vassals revolted and broke away from the empire. The tale closely parallels the Burmese legend of Nyaung-u Sawrahan, and the chronicles present this house as the root of all later Cambodian royalty.
zh: 陀罗索迦·跋摩是第一位只见于柬埔寨王家编年史、而无碑铭可考的高棉君主；约1340年阇耶跋摩九世之后，寺庙碑铭中断，传说王统便由此接上。编年史称开创者名叫猜，是荔枝山一位隐修士与萨姆雷部农妇之子，因种得一手好瓜而得到“甜瓜师傅”尼亚·特拉萨·帕埃姆的称号。国王把自己的长矛交他看守瓜园，一夜亲自试探他的警觉，反被他刺成重伤；国王临终赦免了他。由于身后无嗣，众人放出白象在贵族中挑选继承人，白象却绕过群臣选中了这位园丁。他即位后取王名安谢，又娶先王之女占达拉瓦蒂为后，在清洗敌对贵族后退居班迭萨雷。他的两个儿子尼佩安·巴特（1340至1346年在位）和西坦·列查先后继位；尼佩安·巴特在位时，暹罗附庸起兵反叛，脱离了高棉帝国。这个故事与缅甸编年史中良吴苏罗汉的传说高度相似，而柬埔寨编年史将这一家族视为后世柬埔寨王室的共同源头。

en: The House of Trastámara was a Castilian dynasty, an illegitimate cadet line of the royal House of Burgundy, that took its name from the County of Trastámara, meaning the land beyond the Tambre river, held by its founder Henry before he took the crown. During the Castilian Civil War of 1351–1369 Henry of Trastámara, a bastard son of Alfonso XI, fought his half-brother Peter I; after defeat at Nájera in 1367 by the English Black Prince, he returned with French and Aragonese support and killed Peter in 1369, reigning as Henry II. In 1412 the Compromise of Caspe placed the Trastámara prince Ferdinand of Antequera on the vacant throne of Aragon, giving the house both crowns, and its kings later ruled Navarre and Naples. The marriage in 1469 of Isabella I of Castile and Ferdinand II of Aragon, second cousins of the same house, joined the two crowns in a dynastic union; their reign saw the Spanish Inquisition from 1478, the fall of Granada in 1492 and the Alhambra Decree expelling the Jews. With Isabella's death in 1504 and Ferdinand's in 1516 the crowns passed to their grandson Charles V, the first Habsburg king of Spain, while their daughter Joanna remained confined until her death in 1555.
zh: 特拉斯塔马拉家族是卡斯蒂利亚王室勃艮第家族的私生子旁支，得名于始祖恩里克称王前领有的特拉斯塔马拉伯爵领，意为塔姆布雷河彼岸之地。1351—1369年卡斯蒂利亚内战中，阿方索十一世的私生子恩里克·德·特拉斯塔马拉与异母兄佩德罗一世兵戎相见；1367年他在纳赫拉被英格兰黑太子击败，随后借法国和阿拉贡之力卷土重来，于1369年杀死佩德罗，即位为恩里克二世。1412年的卡斯佩妥协方案将特拉斯塔马拉的安特克拉的费尔南多扶上阿拉贡空缺的王位，家族遂同时执掌两顶王冠，后来还统治过纳瓦拉和那不勒斯。1469年，同一家族的堂兄妹卡斯蒂利亚女王伊莎贝拉一世与阿拉贡国王费尔南多二世成婚，两国形成王朝联合；他们治下于1478年设立西班牙宗教裁判所，1492年攻灭格拉纳达，并颁布驱逐犹太人的《阿兰布拉诏书》。1504年伊莎贝拉、1516年费尔南多相继去世，两顶王冠传给外孙查理五世——西班牙的第一位哈布斯堡国王，他们的女儿胡安娜则一直被幽禁到1555年去世。

en: The de Trie were a knightly family of the Vexin, taking their name from Trie-en-Vexin, the present-day Trie-Château, and descending from a younger line of the viscounts of Chaumont-en-Vexin, themselves kin to the counts of Beaumont-sur-Oise. They reached high office early: Galon II was constable in 1085 and Hugues I served as constable of France under Louis VI. The family's rise accelerated when Jean I, lord of Trie and Mouchy, married Alix of Dammartin, sister of the count of Boulogne; their son Mathieu inherited the County of Dammartin in 1262, which his descendants held through the fourteenth century. Jean I of Dammartin fell at the battle of Courtrai in 1302, and the line of counts ended with the countess Blanche around 1400. Other sons served the crown as soldiers and prelates: Renaud de Trie and his son Mathieu III were both made marshals of France, Mathieu III commanding the garrison of Tournai in the opening years of the Hundred Years' War, while another son, Guillaume, became archbishop of Reims and crowned Philip VI in 1328. A later Renaud de Trie died in 1406 as admiral of France.
zh: 德·特里家族是韦克桑地区的骑士家族，得名于韦克桑的特里（即今特里-沙托），出自肖蒙昂韦克桑子爵的幼支，而该子爵家又是瓦兹河畔博蒙伯爵的亲族。家族很早就跻身高位：加隆二世于1085年出任统帅，于格一世在路易六世时期担任法国统帅。家族的进一步崛起始于特里与穆希领主让一世迎娶布洛涅伯爵之妹阿历克斯·德·达马尔坦；他们的儿子马蒂厄于1262年继承达马尔坦伯国，其后代一直保有该伯爵位至14世纪。达马尔坦伯爵让一世于1302年在科特赖克战役中阵亡，伯爵一脉约在1400年随着女伯爵布朗什而终结。家族的其他儿子则以武将和教长出身效忠王室：雷诺·德·特里及其子马蒂厄三世都官至法国元帅，后者在百年战争初年指挥图尔奈守军；另一个儿子纪尧姆成为兰斯大主教，并于1328年为腓力六世加冕。更晚的一位雷诺·德·特里则在1406年以法国海军统帅之职去世。

en: The Tsuchimochi were a warrior house of northern Hyūga province on Kyushu, whose two chief branches, the Agata around Nobeoka and the Takarabe around Takanabe, dominated the region from the late Heian age. They are thought to have split from the Mononobe-line Tabe clan and began as servants of the Usa Hachiman shrine, rising as stewards of its vast estates and as chiefs of Usuki district; in the twelfth century marriage ties with the old Kusakabe house brought them its resident-governor rights. Under Tsuchimochi Nobutsuna at the end of the Heian period the clan peaked as the Seven Heads of Tsuchimochi, holding seven seats from Agata and Takarabe to Obi, and under the Kamakura shogunate they served as gokenin with jitō posts across Hyūga recorded in 1197, totalling 1,436 chō. In the Kenmu wars of 1336 several Tsuchimochi fought for Ashikaga Takauji in Kyoto and were rewarded with estates, from which the Agata main line was formally established, and members later held deputy-governor posts in Hyūga and Ōsumi under the Shimazu. In 1457 the Itō took Takarabe and ten castles from them, and the Agata house, caught between the Ōtomo and the Shimazu, was finally destroyed in 1578 when Ōtomo Sōrin stormed Matsuo Castle and killed the lord Chikashige, ending a house said to have lasted seven hundred years.
zh: 土持氏是九州日向国北部的武家，主要有以延冈一带为中心的县土持氏和以高锅附近为据点的财部土持氏两支，自平安时代末期起称霸当地。一般认为它从物部姓田部氏分出，最初是宇佐八幡宫的社人，凭借担任宇佐宫领地的弁济使和臼杵郡司扩张势力，12世纪又通过与古老的日下部氏联姻，取得其在国司职等方面的权益。平安末期当主土持宣纲在位时一族达到极盛，号称土持七头，在县、财部、大塚、清水、都於郡、瓜生野、飫肥七处各有势力；镰仓时代他们作为御家人，1197年的文书里已记有遍布日向、合计一千四百三十六町的地头职。1336年建武战乱中，数名土持族人在京都随足利尊氏作战，战后受封领地，县土持宗家就此正式成立，后来还在岛津氏手下出任日向、大隅的守护代。1457年伊东氏击败土持景纲，夺走财部城等十座城池；宗家在大友氏与岛津氏之间周旋求存，最终于1578年被大友宗麟攻破松尾城，当主亲成败死，这个号称延续七百年的名门就此灭亡。

en: The counts palatine of Tübingen began as counts of Nagold in Swabia, first documented in the tenth century, and held Hohentübingen castle from at least 1078, when it was besieged by King Henry IV during the Investiture Controversy. Hugo V won the title of count palatine in 1146 for services to the first Hohenstaufen king Conrad III, making him the emperor's chief representative in the duchy of Swabia, with rights of justice, tolls and minting; Tübingen pfennigs were struck from 1185. His son Hugo II married the heiress of Bregenz and added Tettnang and Sigmaringen, while the family founded a string of monasteries including Blaubeuren, Marchtal and Bebenhausen. A younger son, Hugo of Montfort, founded the Montfort dynasty, from which the counts of Werdenberg later branched off. Debts to Bebenhausen abbey eroded the family's power: Gottfried I served the emperor as field captain against Württemberg in 1311, and in 1342 Gottfried III was forced to sell the city of Tübingen to Count Ulrich III of Württemberg for twenty thousand gold hellers. The cadet lines expired one by one, Herrenberg in 1677 and Tübingen-Lichteneck earlier in 1664, while the Montfort line lasted until 1787.
zh: 蒂宾根行宫伯爵家族原是施瓦本的纳戈尔德伯爵，10世纪已有文献可考，至迟在1078年已据有霍亨蒂宾根城堡——那年国王亨利四世在叙任权斗争中曾围攻此堡。1146年，胡戈五世因效力于首位霍亨斯陶芬国王康拉德三世而获行宫伯爵头衔，成为皇帝在施瓦本公国的首席代表，掌司法、关税和铸币之权；1185年起当地开始铸造蒂宾根芬尼。其子胡戈二世娶布雷根茨女继承人，又添上泰特南和锡格马林根；家族还陆续创办了布劳博伊伦、马希塔尔、贝本豪森等一系列修道院。幼子蒙特福特的胡戈开创了蒙特福特王朝，韦尔登贝格伯爵后来即从该支分出。对贝本豪森修道院的债务侵蚀了家族实力：戈特弗里德一世曾在1311年任帝国军队统帅对符腾堡作战，1342年戈特弗里德三世被迫以两万金赫勒的价钱把蒂宾根城卖给符腾堡伯爵乌尔里希三世。各支系相继凋零：黑伦贝格支于1677年绝嗣，蒂宾根-利希特内克支更早于1664年告终，只有蒙特福特支延续到1787年。

en: The Tudors began as a Welsh ministerial family on Anglesey, descended from Ednyfed Fychan, who died in 1246 after serving as seneschal of Gwynedd under Llywelyn the Great. His son Goronwy founded the line seated at Penmynydd, and Goronwy's grandson Tudur Hen submitted to Edward I after the conquest of Wales. For generations the family supplied officers and churchmen to the English crown, but in the early fifteenth century several sons backed their kinsman Owain Glyndŵr's revolt; Rhys ap Tudur was executed at Chester in 1412 and the family estates were forfeited. The dispossessed younger branch produced Owen Tudor, who secretly married Catherine of Valois, widow of Henry V. Their son Edmund married Margaret Beaufort of the House of Lancaster, and their grandson Henry Tudor, born at Pembroke in 1457, defeated Richard III at Bosworth Field in 1485 and took the crown as Henry VII, uniting the Lancastrian and Yorkist claims by marrying Elizabeth of York. The five Tudor sovereigns, ending with Elizabeth I in 1603, ruled through the English Reformation and the union of England and Wales, until the childless Elizabeth left the throne to the Scottish Stuarts.
zh: 都铎家族本是安格尔西岛上的威尔士士宦世家，先祖埃德尼费德·费汉曾在卢埃林大帝麾下担任圭内斯的宫廷总管，1246年去世。其子戈龙维开创了定居彭迈尼德的一系，戈龙维的孙子都铎·亨在威尔士被征服后归顺爱德华一世。此后数代人为英格兰王室出任官员和教士，但15世纪初，家族的几个儿子支持亲族欧文·格兰道尔起兵；里斯·阿普·都铎于1412年在切斯特被处死，家产也被没收。破落的幼支出了个欧文·都铎，他秘密娶了亨利五世的遗孀瓦卢瓦的凯瑟琳。两人的儿子埃德蒙娶兰开斯特家族的玛格丽特·博福特为妻，孙子亨利·都铎1457年生于彭布罗克，1485年在博斯沃思原野战役击败理查三世，以亨利七世之名登上王位，并通过迎娶约克的伊丽莎白合一了兰开斯特与约克两派的继承权。都铎共有五位君主，止于1603年去世的伊丽莎白一世；其间经历了英格兰宗教改革和英格兰与威尔士的合并，无嗣的伊丽莎白最终把王位留给苏格兰的斯图亚特家族。

en: The Tughlaqs were the third dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate, ruling from 1320 to 1414. Its founder Ghazi Malik, a Turkic slave-officer governing Punjab, overthrew the usurper Khusro Khan and took the throne as Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq, building the fortress city of Tughlaqabad before his suspicious death in 1325. His son Muhammad bin Tughluq, reigning until 1351 and still on the throne in 1337, pushed the sultanate to its greatest extent between 1330 and 1335, raiding as far south as Kampili and Dwarasamudra, but his forced shift of the capital and elite to Daulatabad in the Deccan, his failed base-metal token currency and crippling taxes emptied the treasury and drove province after province into revolt: the Madurai and Bahmani sultanates broke away in the south, while Hindu chiefs reconquered Warangal in 1336 and the new Vijayanagara Empire rolled back Delhi's power. The Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta served him as a judge and left a grim record of his punishments and the seven-year famine that began in 1335. His nephew Firuz Shah, who reigned from 1351 to 1388, was a milder ruler who dug long irrigation canals, built mosques and madrasas and failed to subdue Bengal, yet expanded slavery and enforced the jizya on Brahmins. After his death in 1388 civil wars split the nobility, and in 1398 Timur sacked Delhi and massacred its people. The last Tughlaq sultan lingered as a figurehead until Khizr Khan entered the city in 1414 and founded the Sayyid dynasty.
zh: 图格鲁克王朝是德里苏丹国的第三个王朝，统治时间为1320至1414年。开国者加齐·马立克出身突厥奴隶将领，出镇旁遮普，他推翻篡位者库斯鲁汗，以吉亚斯·丁·图格鲁克之名登基，修建了堡垒城市图格鲁克巴德，1325年蹊跷死去。其子穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克继位，1337年仍在位（统治至1351年）；他在1330至1335年间把苏丹国版图推到极盛，兵锋南抵坎皮利和德瓦拉萨穆德拉，但他强令都城和精英迁往德干的道拉塔巴德，又发行失败的贱金属代币，加上横征暴敛，国库空虚，各省接连反叛：南方分裂出马杜赖与巴赫曼尼两个苏丹国，印度教首领于1336年收复瓦朗加尔，新兴的毗奢耶那伽罗帝国步步逼退德里的势力。摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰曾在他手下任法官，留下了关于其酷刑和1335年起连续七年大饥荒的沉痛记录。其侄菲鲁兹沙于1351至1388年在位，为政较为温和，开凿了多条灌溉运河，修建清真寺和经学院，但征孟加拉无功而返，还扩充奴隶、向婆罗门征收吉兹亚税。他1388年死后贵族陷入内战，1398年帖木儿攻陷德里并大肆屠城。末代图格鲁克苏丹苟延残喘至1414年，希兹尔汗入城开创赛义德王朝，图格鲁克统治终结。

en: The lords of Turn, or vom Turn, were among the most powerful noble families of the medieval Valais and held estates reaching into the Bernese Oberland. Possibly descended from a cadet line of the de la Tour family of the Dauphiné, they appear from the mid-twelfth century as vassals of Saint-Maurice Abbey: around 1170 Wilhelm I and his brother Amadeus, Bishop of Sion, are the first documented members, and Wilhelm built or enlarged Gestelnburg near Niedergesteln as the family seat. As lords immediately subject to the emperor they bore the title of Freiherr, and their lands stretched from western Raron in the Valais to Kandertal, Adelboden and Frutigen. Backed by the Counts of Savoy, they fought the Bishops of Sion for mastery of the Valais; Peter of Turn was defeated with the Savoyards at the Battle of Leuk in 1296 and had to grant rights to the valley communes. In 1375 the followers of Anton von Turn murdered Bishop Witschard Tavelli, whereupon the Valais communes rose and Anton fled to Savoy, which bought his Valais estates. In 1400 he sold the lordship of Frutigen to the city of Bern, and he died in exile in 1405, the last of his line.
zh: 图恩领主（亦称冯·图恩）是中世纪瓦莱州最有权势的贵族家族之一，领地一直延伸到伯尔尼高地。他们可能源自多菲内德拉图尔家族的旁支，12世纪中叶起作为圣莫里斯修道院的封臣出现：约1170年，威廉一世与其兄锡永主教阿马迪厄斯是最早见诸文献的成员，威廉在下盖斯特尔恩附近修建或扩建盖斯特尔恩堡，作为家族祖居。由于直属于皇帝，他们享有男爵头衔，领地从瓦莱州的西拉龙一直延伸到坎德谷、阿德尔博登和弗鲁蒂根。在萨伏依伯爵支持下，他们与锡永主教争夺瓦莱的控制权；1296年，彼得·冯·图恩与萨伏依联军在勒克战役中战败，被迫向谷地公社让渡权利。1375年，安东·冯·图恩的部下刺杀主教维查德·塔韦利，瓦莱各公社随即起事，安东逃往萨伏依，萨伏依伯爵买下了他在瓦莱的产业。1400年，他又把弗鲁蒂根领地卖给伯尔尼城，1405年死于流亡中，家族就此绝嗣。

en: The Uanacaze, better known in the sources as the Uacúsecha or Vacúxecha, meaning eagles, were the royal clan of the Purépecha kingdom in the Michoacán highlands, whose half-legendary early lords are recorded in the sixteenth-century Relación de Michoacán. Pauacume ruled as lord of Pátzcuaro, and his son Tariácuri, dreaming a command from the sun god Curicaueri, allied the lakeside cities and from about 1300 built the scattered communities of Lake Pátzcuaro into one state. On Tariácuri's death his kin divided the chief towns, Pátzcuaro, Tzintzuntzan and Ihuatzio, while keeping his conquests together, and his successors the cazonci centralized tribute and pushed the borders to the Pacific at Zacatula by 1460. As rulers of the second-largest state in Mesoamerica they fortified their eastern frontier against the Aztec Empire, whose westward expansion they repeatedly blocked, until the last cazonci Tangáxuan II submitted to the Spaniards in 1530.
zh: 瓦纳卡泽家族在史料中更常见的写法是瓦库塞查或瓦库谢查，意为“鹰”，是米却肯高地普雷佩查王国的王室氏族；其半传说性质的早期首领记载于16世纪的《米却肯纪事》。保阿库梅曾任帕茨夸罗的首领，其子塔里亚库里因梦见太阳神库里考埃里的训谕而联合湖畔诸城，约从1300年起把帕茨夸罗湖周围分散的社群整合为一个国家。塔里亚库里死后，亲族瓜分了帕茨夸罗、钦聪灿和伊瓦齐奥等重镇，却维持了他征服的成果；后继的卡松奇们建立贡赋体系、强化集权，到1460年已把疆界推进到萨卡图拉的太平洋沿岸。作为美索美洲第二大国的统治者，他们在东部边境修筑要塞，屡次挡住阿兹特克帝国向西的扩张；末代卡松奇坦加克苏安二世最终于1530年向西班牙人投降。

en: The Udan stand for the idiquts of Qocho, the Uyghur kingdom of the Turpan basin whose ruling house traced its lineage to Qutlugh of the Ediz clan of the old Uyghur Khaganate. After the Kirghiz overthrew the khaganate, Uyghur refugees founded Qocho in 843, and in 866 Pugu Jun declared himself khan and adopted the title idiqut, meaning lord of fortune, ruling from the winter capital Qocho and the summer capital Beshbalik. From 1128 the idiquts were vassals of the Qara Khitai, until Barchuk Art Tegin killed the Khitan magistrate in 1209 and submitted to Genghis Khan, who treated him as a fifth son; Mongol princesses married into the family for nearly a century. Under the Yuan dynasty Nolen Tekin was named Prince of Gaochang in 1308, but wars with the Chagatai Khanate wrecked the country. Temür Buqa ruled from 1322, Senggi from 1330 and Taipindu from 1332; Ürüg Temür, the idiqut attested between 1335 and 1353, was followed by Ching Temür, the last known ruler. The kingdom had ceased to exist by the 1370s, and Khizr Khoja of Moghulistan forced Islam on the remaining Buddhist Uyghurs of Turpan between 1389 and 1399.
zh: 兀单指的是高昌回鹘的亦都护家族；这个吐鲁番盆地的回鹘王国，其王统可追溯至回鹘汗国阿跌部的骨咄禄。黠戛斯攻灭回鹘汗国后，回鹘残部于843年建立高昌，866年仆固俊自称可汗，采用意为“幸福之主”的亦都护称号，在冬都高昌和夏都别失八里之间理政。1128年起亦都护沦为西辽附庸，1209年巴而术·阿而忒·的斤袭杀西辽少监，归降成吉思汗，被视为第五子；此后近百年间，蒙古公主不断嫁入亦都护家族。元朝时期，纽林的斤于1308年受封高昌王，但与察合台汗国的连年战争使国家残破：帖睦尔普化1322年继位，籛吉1330年继位，太平奴1332年继位；月鲁帖木儿于1335至1353年间任亦都护，其后的占帖木儿是已知最后一位统治者。到14世纪70年代，高昌王国已不复存在；1389至1399年间，东察合台的黑的儿火者强迫吐鲁番残存的佛教回鹘改宗伊斯兰教。

en: The Ueno of Mikawa were a cadet branch of the Ashikaga house of the Seiwa Genji, founded by Ueno Yoshibumi, the sixth son of Ashikaga Yasuuji, who took his name from the Ueno estate in Hekikai district in Mikawa Province and held the stewardship of the Hachijoin manor there. His grandson Yorikane followed Ashikaga Takauji when he rose against the Kamakura shogunate, retreated with him to Kyushu, and won distinction against the Kikuchi of Higo in 1336; he was later made constable of Iwami and campaigned for the Northern Court across western Japan. Though the house held constable posts such as Sado, none became hereditary, and its main line settled in Kyoto as close attendants of the Ashikaga shoguns in the hokoshu guard. In 1509 Ueno Nobutaka was sent down to Bitchu Province to secure the restored Shogun Ashikaga Yoshitane's position, founding the Bitchu Ueno branch. One line at Bitchu Matsuyama Castle was destroyed by Sho Arisuke in 1533, while Ueno Takatomo, who held Joyama Castle in Bizen and backed the Mimura against the Mori, was overrun by Kobayakawa Takakage's army at the Battle of Joyama in 1575. A further branch settled in Bungo as retainers of the Otomo.
zh: 三河上野氏是清和源氏足利氏的庶流，始祖上野义弁是足利泰氏的第六子，以三河国碧海郡上野庄为苗字，领有当地八条院领的地头职。其孙上野赖兼追随足利尊氏举兵反抗镰仓幕府，随尊氏退往九州，1336年征讨肥后菊池氏立下战功，后来受任石见国守护，为北朝在西国扩张势力。上野氏虽历任佐渡等国守护，却未能世袭，宗家留在京都，以奉公众等近臣身分侍奉足利将军，参与幕府中枢事务。1509年，上野信孝被派往备中国，为复职的将军足利义稙巩固地盘，开创备中上野氏一支。驻守备中松山城的一脉于1533年被庄为资攻灭；居于备前常山城的上野隆德支持三村氏与毛利氏对抗，1575年在常山合战中被小早川隆景率领的毛利军攻灭。另有一支留在丰后，世代担任大友氏的家臣。

en: The Uesugi claim descent from the ninth-century Fujiwara minister Fujiwara no Yoshikado. Near the end of the 1200s his descendant Kanjuju Shigefusa was granted the Uesugi manor in Tango Province and took its name as his own; his daughter Kiyoko became the mother of Ashikaga Takauji, tying the family to the new Muromachi shogunate. Through the 1300s and 1400s Uesugi heads served as provincial governors and as Kanto kanrei, the shogun's deputies in the east, and in 1449 they even drove out the lord they served, Ashikaga Shigeuji, becoming the dominant power of the Kanto. The clan then split into the Yamanouchi, Ogigayatsu and Inukake branches, whose quarter-century of infighting ended around 1477 with the Inukake line extinct. In the 1500s the Later Hojo eroded their hold on the Kanto, taking Kawagoe in 1537 and killing the last Ogigayatsu head Tomosada in 1545. The Yamanouchi lord Norimasa then adopted his retainer Nagao Kagetora, who took the name Uesugi Kenshin (1530—1578) and became one of the most celebrated generals of the Sengoku age, famed for his long rivalry with Takeda Shingen. Kenshin's heir Kagekatsu backed the losing side at Sekigahara in 1600 and was moved to the remote Yonezawa domain, where the family ruled as outer daimyo through the Edo period, winning praise for the reforms of Uesugi Harunori after the famines of the 1750s.
zh: 上杉氏自称出自9世纪的藤原氏大臣藤原良门一脉。13世纪末，其后人劝修寺重房受领丹后国上杉庄，遂以领地为姓；重房之女清子是足利尊氏的生母，家族由此与新生的室町幕府结下渊源。14至15世纪，上杉氏世代担任各国守护和关东管领，1449年甚至起兵驱逐自己的主君足利成氏，成为关东最有势力的家族。此后上杉分为山内、扇谷和犬悬三支，相互攻伐约二十五年，到1477年前后犬悬一脉绝嗣。16世纪，后北条氏蚕食其关东领地，1537年夺河越，1545年攻杀扇谷末代当主上杉朝定。山内当主上杉宪政遂收家臣长尾景虎为养子，景虎改名上杉谦信（1530—1578），成为战国时代最负盛名的武将之一，以与武田信玄的长期对抗著称。谦信的继承人景胜在1600年关原之战中站错阵营，被转封偏远的米泽藩，作为外样大名延续至江户时代，并在18世纪50年代的饥荒后凭借上杉治宪的改革赢得幕府的称赏。

en: The sultans of medieval Mogadishu, the leading Muslim city-state on the Benadir coast of southern Somalia, belonged to its first known ruling house, the Fakhr al-Din dynasty, founded when Abu Bakr ibn Fakhr al-Din made himself sultan in the mid-thirteenth century; his brother Omar ad-Din is said to have settled in Harar. When Ibn Battuta visited in 1331 the city was ruled by Sultan Abu Bakr ibn Shaikh Umar, a local Somali of Barbara stock who spoke the Maqdishi tongue and Arabic with equal fluency and kept a court of wazirs, judges, commanders and royal eunuchs. Mogadishu dominated the regional gold trade, minted its own coinage and exported its finely woven toob benadir cloth to Egypt and Syria, while merchants from Cambay and Aden crowded its harbour and Ming treasure fleets called there under Zheng He. The Portuguese raider Joao de Sepulveda bombarded the city in 1542 and extorted a peace treaty, but the sultanate kept its independence until the late sixteenth or early seventeenth century, when the Fakhr al-Din line was replaced by the Persian-descended Muzaffarid dynasty.
zh: 中世纪的摩加迪沙是索马里南部贝纳迪尔海岸首屈一指的穆斯林城邦，其苏丹出自当地已知的第一个统治家族法赫尔·丁王朝——阿布·伯克尔·伊本·法赫尔·丁于13世纪中叶自立为苏丹，开创此系，传说他的兄弟欧麦尔·丁则迁居哈拉尔。1331年伊本·白图泰到访时，在位的是苏丹阿布·伯克尔·伊本·谢赫·欧麦尔，他是巴尔巴拉血统的本地索马里人，摩加迪沙方言与阿拉伯语同样流利，朝中设有维齐尔、法官、将领和宫廷宦官。摩加迪沙把持区域黄金贸易、自铸钱币，把精织的贝纳迪尔布料远销埃及和叙利亚，港内聚集着来自坎贝和亚丁的商人，郑和率领的明朝船队也曾到访。1542年葡萄牙人若昂·德·塞普尔韦达炮轰该城，逼其签订和约；但苏丹国保持独立，直到16世纪末或17世纪初，法赫尔·丁世系被波斯裔的穆扎法尔王朝取代。

en: The Unno were a warrior house based at Unno manor in Chiisagata district of Shinano, present-day Tomi in Nagano Prefecture, and claimed descent from the ancient Shigeno clan; with the Nezu and Mochizuki they were known as the three Shigeno families, and they styled themselves the clan's main line. An Unno warrior appears under Minamoto no Yoshitomo in the Hogen War of 1156, and Unno Yukichika and his son served Minamoto no Yoshinaka as senior captains and fell in battle. Yukiuji, who survived to serve Minamoto no Yoritomo, was ranked among the four great bowmen of the Kanto alongside the Takeda and Ogasawara, and the family extended its power from eastern Shinano into Agatsuma district in western Kozuke. In 1335, during the Nakasendai War, Unno Yukiyasu joined Hojo Tokiyuki's attempt to retake Kamakura; the clan then sided with the Southern Court, and Yukiyasu was killed in 1352 at Kotesashigahara, fighting the Ashikaga alongside Prince Munenaga. Long rivalry with the Murakami clan turned against them: Unno Mochiyuki fell in 1467 and the family lost the Shioda estates, and further fighting, called the great Unno disturbance, followed in 1468; and in 1541 a coalition of Takeda Nobutora, Murakami Yoshikiyo and Suwa Yorishige overwhelmed them at Unno-daira. Munetsuna's son Yukiyoshi was killed, and the head of the clan fled to Uesugi Norimasa and the main line ended; Sanada Yukitaka, who had married into the family, claimed its succession, and the later Sanada lords of Ueda styled themselves an Unno branch.
zh: 海野氏是以信浓国小县郡海野庄（今长野县东御市）为本贯的武家，自称古代滋野氏的后裔，与根津氏、望月氏并称滋野三家，并以滋野氏嫡流自居。1156年保元之乱中，源义朝麾下已有海野太郎的名字；后来海野幸亲、幸广父子担任源义仲的侍大将，双双战死。幸存的三子海野幸氏出仕源赖朝，与武田信光、小笠原长清等人并称弓马四天王，海野氏的势力也从信浓东部扩展到上野西部的吾妻郡。1335年中先代之乱时，海野幸康随北条时行反攻镰仓，此后又与其他北条余党一同投奔南朝，1352年随宗良亲王参加武藏野合战，在小手指原战死。与村上氏的长期对抗逐渐压倒了海野氏：1467年海野持幸战死，盐田庄被夺，1468年又爆发被称为海野大乱的激战，家势日衰。1541年，武田信虎、村上义清、诹访赖重的联军在海野平之战中大破海野氏，当主海野栋纲之子幸义战死，栋纲逃往上杉宪政处，海野宗家就此断绝。入赘海野家的真田幸隆后来继承其名迹，战国时代领有小县郡的真田氏也自称海野氏流。

en: The Urgell were the last comital dynasty of the Catalan County of Urgell, a younger branch of the House of Barcelona ruling from Balaguer in the Pyrenean foothills. When Ermengol X, last count of the Cabrera line, died in 1314, he left the county to his niece Teresa d'Entença, wife of Alfonso, son of James II of Aragon and the future Alfonso IV. Their son James, born in 1321, inherited Urgell in 1336 as Count James I, and the county passed to his son Peter II in 1347 and to his grandson James II in 1408. On the death of King Martin of Aragon without an heir in 1410, James II was one of six claimants to the crown, but the Compromise of Caspe in 1412 elected Ferdinand of Antequera instead. Urged on by his mother Margaret of Montferrat and the nobleman Antón de Luna, James refused to accept the verdict and rose in arms; defeated at Castelflorite and Montearagón, he was besieged in Balaguer and surrendered in October 1413. The county was annexed to the Crown of Aragon, and James died a prisoner at Xàtiva in 1433, the last legitimate male of the House of Barcelona.
zh: 乌赫利家族是加泰罗尼亚乌赫利伯国的末代伯爵王朝，属巴塞罗那家族的幼支，以比利牛斯山麓的巴拉格尔为统治中心。1314年卡布雷拉世系的末代伯爵埃门戈尔十世去世，把伯国留给侄女特蕾莎·德恩滕萨；特蕾莎嫁给阿拉贡国王海梅二世之子、后来的阿方索四世。他们的儿子海梅生于1321年，1336年继位为乌赫利伯爵海梅一世，伯国又于1347年传给其子佩德罗二世，1408年再传其孙海梅二世。1410年阿拉贡国王马丁一世无嗣而终，海梅二世是六位王位竞争者之一，但1412年的卡斯佩妥协方案最终推选安特克拉的费尔南多。在母亲蒙费拉托的玛格丽特和贵族安东·德·卢纳怂恿下，海梅拒绝服从此决议起兵反叛；他在卡斯特尔弗洛里特和蒙特拉贡战败，被围于巴拉格尔，1413年10月投降。伯国随即并入阿拉贡王室，海梅被囚禁，1433年死于哈蒂瓦，他也是巴塞罗那家族最后一位合法男嗣。

en: The Urtsun take their name from the Urtsun valley in southern Chitral, home to Kalash (Kalasha) communities that once held the valleys south of Chitral town. Local Kalash chiefs governed the valley and kept its old animist religion while Muslim rule took hold in Chitral from the 1300s, with the Rais and later the Katur dynasties building the state of Chitral around them.
zh: 乌尔岑家族得名于吉德拉尔南部的乌尔孙河谷，当地居民属于曾据有吉德拉尔城以南各河谷的卡拉什（卡拉沙）社群。14世纪起穆斯林统治在吉德拉尔确立，拉伊斯王朝及后来的卡图尔王朝在其周边建立起吉德拉尔政权，而这些卡拉什河谷仍由本地首领治理，并长期保留旧有的万物有灵信仰。

en: The Utsunomiya were the chief house of Shimotsuke, a Fujiwara Hokke line whose ancestor Fujiwara no Sōen, a temple abbot, won favour through prayers for Minamoto no Yoshiie's wars and became head of Futarasan Shrine, the ichinomiya of Shimotsuke at Utsunomiya. The third head Tomotsuna was the first to bear the Utsunomiya name; Minamoto no Yoritomo called him the finest archer in Bandō, and he fought in the Ōshū campaign of 1189 and the Battle of Atsukashiyama. His grandson Yoritsuna, caught in a shogunate purge, took Buddhist orders under Hōnen and befriended the poet Fujiwara no Teika, patronising the Utsunomiya poetic circle at whose request Teika is said to have chosen the hundred poems that became the Ogura Hyakunin Isshu. In 1333 the ninth head Kintsuna marched against Kusunoki Masashige with a handful of riders, and Masashige, awed by the Utsunomiya name, withdrew without a fight; Kintsuna then served the Kenmu government while his son sided with Ashikaga Takauji. The Sengoku age brought a second peak under the seventeenth head Shigetsuna, who crushed the Ashina and routed a Satake coalition, and his grandson Hirotsuna led the northern Kantō league that held the Later Hōjō in check. The last head Kunitsuna joined Toyotomi Hideyoshi at Odawara in 1590 and received the Toyotomi surname, but was abruptly attainted and exiled to Bizen in 1597; his descendants ended as retainers of the Mito domain.
zh: 宇都宫氏是下野国的名门，出自藤原北家道兼流。始祖藤原宗圆本是寺院座主，因在源义家的征战中祈祷有功，成为下野国一宫宇都宫二荒山神社的座主。第三代当主朝纲首称宇都宫之姓，源赖朝赞其为坂东第一弓取，他参加了1189年的奥州合战，在阿津贺志山之战中立功。其孙赖纲受幕府政争牵连出家，师从法然，法号莲生；他与歌人藤原定家交厚，扶持起与京都、镰仓歌坛比肩的宇都宫歌坛，据传定家应他之请选定百首和歌，即后世的《小仓百人一首》。1333年，第九代当主公纲率十余骑讨伐楠木正成，正成慑于宇都宫的武名不战而退；公纲随后出仕建武新政，其子却转投足利尊氏，一族在南北朝中南北两分。战国时代，第十七代当主成纲带来家族的再兴，他击破芦名氏、大败佐竹联军，把宇都宫氏推上北关东首屈一指的战国大名地位；其孙广纲又联合诸家组成反北条联盟，牵制后北条氏的扩张。末代当主国纲1590年参加丰臣秀吉的小田原征伐，蒙赐丰臣姓氏，却在1597年突然被改易、流放备前国，其子孙最后沦为水户藩的藩士。

en: The House of Valois was a cadet branch of the Capetians, descended from Charles, Count of Valois, a younger son of King Philip III. When the direct Capetian line died with Charles IV in 1328, Charles of Valois's son took the crown as Philip VI under a succession rule that excluded women and heirs through women, barring the claims of Joan of Navarre and Edward III of England. Edward's rival claim opened the Hundred Years' War in 1337, and the early Valois kings suffered crushing defeats at Crécy in 1346 and Poitiers in 1356, where John II was captured, and again at Agincourt in 1415. The Treaty of Troyes of 1420 nearly disinherited the dynasty, but Charles VII, inspired by Joan of Arc, recovered the kingdom and expelled the English by 1453. Louis XI then broke the power of the great feudatories, defeating Charles the Bold of the rival Burgundian branch in 1477, while Charles VIII and his successors launched the Italian Wars from 1494. Later Valois rule under Francis I and Henry II was an age of Renaissance monarchy and Habsburg rivalry, then of the French Wars of Religion. The line ended with the assassination of Henry III in 1589, when the throne passed to the Bourbon Henry IV.
zh: 瓦卢瓦王朝是卡佩王朝的支系，始祖为法王腓力三世之子瓦卢瓦伯爵夏尔。1328年卡佩嫡系在查理四世身后绝嗣，夏尔之子依据排斥女性及女性后裔的继承规则登基，是为腓力六世，纳瓦拉的让娜和英王爱德华三世的继承权主张均被排除。爱德华的争位主张在1337年引发百年战争，瓦卢瓦早期诸王连遭惨败：1346年克雷西战役、1356年普瓦捷战役（约翰二世被俘），以及1415年的阿金库尔战役。1420年的《特鲁瓦条约》几乎剥夺了瓦卢瓦的继承权，但查理七世在圣女贞德的鼓舞下扭转战局，到1453年将英军逐出法国。路易十一随后粉碎大封建主的势力，于1477年击败同宗勃艮第支系的大胆查理；从1494年起，夏尔八世及其后继者又发动了意大利战争。弗朗索瓦一世和亨利二世时期是文艺复兴君主制与哈布斯堡争霸的时代，随后则陷入法国宗教战争。1589年亨利三世遇刺，瓦卢瓦男系断绝，王位转入波旁家族的亨利四世之手。

en: The House of Venier was a patrician family of the Republic of Venice, first recorded in the eleventh century and probably seated at Chioggia before moving to the Rialto; a claimed descent from Vicenza is disputed. After the Fourth Crusade a branch ruled the Greek islands of Cerigo and Paros, while other members held the Dalmatian castle of Zemonico and Sanguinetto near Verona, and a Cretan branch settled in Candia and joined the island's revolts against Venetian rule. The Venier entered the Venetian patriciate in the fourteenth century and gave the republic three doges: Antonio, who reigned from 1382 to 1400, Francesco in 1554 to 1556, and Sebastiano, an admiral of the Venetian fleet at the Battle of Lepanto in 1571 and doge from 1577 until his death in 1578. Cecilia Venier-Baffo, daughter of the lord of Paros, was carried to the Ottoman court and became Nurbanu Sultan, wife of Selim II and mother of Murad III, dying in 1583. The family also produced jurists, ambassadors and vernacular poets, and built the Palazzo Venier dei Leoni on the Grand Canal.
zh: 韦涅尔家族是威尼斯共和国的贵族世家，11世纪始见记载，早年可能世居基奥贾，后迁至里亚尔托；其自称源出维琴察的说法存有争议。第四次十字军东征后，家族一支统治了希腊的基西拉岛和帕罗斯岛，另一些成员领有达尔马提亚的泽穆尼克城堡和维罗纳附近的圣圭内托城堡；迁居克里特干地亚的支系还参与了岛上反抗威尼斯统治的起义。韦涅尔家族于14世纪跻身威尼斯贵族行列，先后出了三位总督：1382至1400年在任的安东尼奥、1554至1556年在任的弗朗切斯科，以及曾在1571年勒班陀战役中指挥威尼斯舰队、1577年出任总督并于1578年去世的塞巴斯蒂亚诺。帕罗斯领主之女切奇利娅·韦涅尔-巴福被掳入奥斯曼宫廷，成为努尔巴努苏丹，即塞利姆二世的王后、穆拉德三世的生母，1583年去世。家族还涌现出不少法学家、使节和方言诗人，并在大运河畔修建了韦涅尔·德莱奥尼宫。

en: The counts of Vianden held the castle above the Our river in the Ardennes and ranked among the mightiest lords between the Rhine, Moselle and Meuse from the twelfth to the fourteenth century. A count named Bertolph is first attested around 1090, probably sprung from the advocates of Prüm abbey. The family reached its peak under Henry I, who in 1216 married Margaret, marchioness of Namur, a Courtenay and daughter of Peter II, Latin emperor of Constantinople. Its independence did not last: in 1264 Vianden became a vassal of the counts of Luxembourg, and Godfrey I fought at the Battle of Worringen in 1288 in the train of the duke of Brabant. When Henry II died in 1337 the male line was nearly spent, and after a brief succession the county passed through his daughter Maria to her husband Simon III of Sponheim-Kreuznach, who ruled it jure uxoris from 1348. Through later marriages the Vianden inheritance flowed into the House of Orange-Nassau.
zh: 菲安登伯爵家族盘踞在阿登山区乌尔河畔的菲安登城堡，12至14世纪间是莱茵河、摩泽尔河与默兹河之间最有权势的领主之一。约1090年的文献首次提到一位名叫贝尔托夫的伯爵，其家族可能出自普吕姆修道院的代官。家族在亨利一世时达到鼎盛：他于1216年娶那慕尔女侯爵玛格丽特为妻，后者出身库特奈家族，是君士坦丁堡拉丁皇帝皮埃尔二世的女儿。但独立未能持久：1264年菲安登成为卢森堡伯爵的封臣，戈德弗鲁瓦一世还在1288年随布拉班特公爵参加了沃林根战役。1337年亨利二世去世，男丁几近断绝；经过短暂继承，伯国通过他的女儿玛丽亚转到其丈夫施蓬海姆-克罗伊茨纳赫的西蒙三世手中，西蒙自1348年起凭妻权统治。菲安登的遗产后来又经联姻流入奥兰治-拿骚家族。

en: The Vijaya line is the restored Cham dynasty that reigned from the city of Vijaya after the Tran occupation of 1312. Its founder Jaya Ananda, a Cham commander born in southern Dai Viet, was first installed as a vassal vice-king by the Vietnamese in 1318; he courted the Yuan court for recognition and in 1326 repelled the army of Tran Minh Tong, restoring Champa's independence. On his death in 1336 his brother-in-law Maha Sawa fought the legitimate heir Jamo for six years, until Jamo fled to the Tran court in 1342 and died there after a failed restoration expedition of 1353. The line's greatest figure was Po Binasuor, king from 1360 to 1390 and the last strong ruler of Champa. He united the Cham lands, took to the sea and sacked the Vietnamese capital Thang Long four times, in 1371, twice in 1377 and again in 1383, after the Tran king Tran Due Tong had died assaulting Vijaya; he also occupied Nghe An and Thanh Hoa. Ho Quy Ly checked him in 1380 and 1382, and in 1390 Po Binasuor was killed by a firearm volley on his royal barge, after which his sons defected to Dai Viet and the restored kingdom's power collapsed.
zh: 毗阇耶世系是1312年陈朝占领后，以毗阇耶城为都复国的占婆王朝。开创者制阿难出身于大越南部，本是占婆将领，1318年先被越南人立为附庸的副王；他遣使争取元朝承认，又在1326年击退陈明宗的军队，使占婆重获独立。1336年他去世后，妻弟茶和布底与合法继承人亚莫争夺王位长达六年，亚莫终在1342年逃奔陈朝，并在1353年一次失败的复辟行动后客死异乡。这一世系最显赫的人物是1360至1390年在位的制蓬峩，占婆最后一位强势国王。他统一占人诸地，从海上出击，曾四次攻陷越南都城升龙——1371年一次、1377年两次、1383年一次；此前陈睿宗攻打毗阇耶兵败身亡，他还顺势占领了义安和清化。胡季犛于1380年和1382年两度挡住他的兵锋。1390年，制蓬峩的御舟遭遇火绳枪齐射，他中枪战死，此后他的儿子们投奔大越，复国占婆的国势随之崩塌。

en: The Vilaragut were a Catalan noble house of the Penedès whose knights served the Crown of Aragon by land and sea. Berenguer de Vilaragut, lord of Subirats and viscount of Omeladès, was an admiral of the Kingdom of Sicily under James II of Aragon; in 1286, during the War of the Sicilian Vespers, he took twenty galleys to blockade Brindisi for three days, raided Corfu and returned to Messina. His daughter Violante, born around 1320, married her cousin James III of Majorca in 1347 and was his queen until his defeat and death at Llucmajor in 1349, when Peter IV of Aragon took her prisoner; she was later freed and married Duke Otto IV of Brunswick in 1353, and left writings of her own. A younger branch settled in Sicily: Ramon de Vilaragut, baron of Tripi and captain-general and admiral of the Sicilian army, married Diana Visconti of Milan, and their son Anthony was born on the island in 1336. Anthony captained the galleys that defended Sicily against the kings of Naples and received the barony of Tripi; in 1375 Peter IV made him governor of Xàtiva, and in 1388 John I named him majordomo and granted him the Valencian baronies of Dosaigües and Alaquàs, so that at his death in 1400 he held one of the greatest estates in the kingdom of Valencia.
zh: 维拉拉古特是出身佩内德斯的加泰罗尼亚贵族世家，族中骑士为阿拉贡王室征战海陆。贝伦格尔·德·维拉拉古特领有苏维拉茨，身兼奥梅拉德斯子爵，在阿拉贡国王海梅二世麾下任西西里王国海军将领；1286年西西里晚祷战争期间，他率二十艘桨帆船封锁布林迪西三日，洗劫科孚岛后返回墨西拿。其女比奥兰特约生于1320年，1347年嫁给表兄马略卡国王海梅三世并成为王后；1349年海梅三世在柳克马约尔战役兵败身死，她被阿拉贡国王佩德罗四世俘获，获释后于1353年改嫁不伦瑞克公爵奥托四世，并有著作传世。家族的一支定居西西里：拉蒙·德·维拉拉古特受封特里皮男爵，任西西里军队的统帅兼舰队司令，娶米兰维斯孔蒂家族的迪亚娜为妻，其子安东尼1336年生于岛上。安东尼曾率桨帆船抵御那不勒斯诸王对西西里的围攻，受封特里皮男爵领；1375年佩德罗四世任命他为哈蒂瓦长官，1388年胡安一世任他为总管并赐下瓦伦西亚的多赛格斯与阿拉卡斯男爵领，到1400年他去世时，已拥有瓦伦西亚王国最庞大的地产之一。

en: The Villani were an old merchant family of Florence, enrolled among the greater guilds of the city. Its most famous son, Giovanni Villani, was born around 1280 and joined the Arte di Calimala guild in 1300; he served the Peruzzi bank as a factor across Italy, France and Flanders, later became a director of the Buonaccorsi company, and was chosen a prior of Florence in 1316, 1317 and 1321, also running the city mint. After attending the jubilee in Rome in 1300 he began the Nuova Cronica, a year-by-year chronicle of Florence rich in economic and statistical detail. The collapse of the Buonaccorsi firm brought him imprisonment in 1346, and he died of the Black Death in 1348. His brother Matteo, born in 1283 and the Buonaccorsi representative in Naples, added eleven more books before dying of plague in 1363, and Matteo's son Filippo briefly carried the work on.
zh: 维拉尼家族是佛罗伦萨的老牌商人世家，名列城中的大行会。家族最著名的成员乔瓦尼·维拉尼约生于1280年，1300年加入卡利马拉行会；他曾作为佩鲁齐银行的代办奔走于意大利、法国和佛兰德之间，后来成为博纳科尔西公司的主管，并于1316年、1317年和1321年出任佛罗伦萨执政官，还主持过城市铸币厂。1300年他在罗马参加禧年庆典后动笔撰写《新编年史》，以逐年记述的方式书写佛罗伦萨史，书中保留了大量经济与统计细节。博纳科尔西公司倒闭后，他于1346年入狱，1348年死于黑死病。生于1283年的弟弟马泰奥曾任博纳科尔西公司驻那不勒斯代表，为《新编年史》续写了十一卷，1363年同样死于瘟疫；马泰奥之子菲利波又短暂续修了这部史书。

en: The de Villeneuve were a knightly noble house of Provence, where their ancestor Giraud de Villeneuve was enfeoffed with the lands of Les Arcs, Trans and Esclans in 1201. The house split into the branches of the barons des Arcs, the barons de Tourrettes and the barons, later marquises, de Vence, and the des Arcs line was raised to the marquisate of Trans in 1505, traditionally counted as the first marquisate created in France. Its most distinguished medieval son was Hélion de Villeneuve, born around 1270 to the seigneur des Arcs and brother of Saint Roseline of Villeneuve. A Hospitaller of the langue of Provence and commander of Manosque, he became the first prior of Provence in 1317 and was elected the twenty-sixth grand master of the Knights Hospitaller in 1319, after the forced resignation of Foulques de Villaret. From Rhodes he reorganised the order's finances following its absorption of Templar property and led it through the 1320s and 1330s until his death on the island in 1346.
zh: 德·维尔纳夫是普罗旺斯的骑士贵族世家，先祖吉罗·德·维尔纳夫于1201年受封莱萨尔克、特朗和埃斯克朗等地。家族后来分为三支：莱萨尔克男爵支、图雷特男爵支，以及旺斯男爵（后升侯爵）支；莱萨尔克一支于1505年被封为特朗侯爵，传统上被视为法国设立的第一个侯爵领地。家族中世纪最杰出的人物是埃利翁·德·维尔纳夫，约1270年生于莱萨尔克领主之家，是圣女罗斯琳·德·维尔纳夫的兄弟。他作为医院骑士团普罗旺斯语区的骑士、马诺斯克司令官，于1317年成为首任普罗旺斯修道长，又在1319年富尔克·德·维拉雷被迫辞职后当选为医院骑士团第二十六任大团长。他在罗得岛主持骑士团接收圣殿骑士团财产后的财务整顿，领导骑士团度过14世纪20至30年代，最终于1346年在岛上去世。

en:
The Visconti were a Lombard noble family of Milan, first documented in 1075 when Ariprando Visconti and his son Ottone signed legal acts in the city; their hereditary title of viscount gave the house its name. The archbishop Ottone Visconti, appointed in 1262, wrested Milan from the rival Della Torre family in 1277 and founded the family's lordship. Teobaldo Visconti had already been elected pope as Gregory X in 1271. Under Azzone, lord from 1329 to 1339, the Visconti took Cremona and Brescia, won the Battle of Parabiago in 1339, and called Giotto to decorate their palace in Milan. Archbishop Giovanni added Bologna in 1350 and Genoa in 1353, while Bernabo and Galeazzo II married their many children into the royal houses of Europe and built the great castle of Pavia.

In 1385 Gian Galeazzo deposed his uncle Bernabo and united all Visconti lands; he bought the title of Duke of Milan from King Wenceslaus IV in 1395, conquered Verona, Padua, Pisa and Siena, began the Milan Cathedral in 1386 and founded the Certosa of Pavia, before dying in 1402. His daughter Valentina married Louis of Orleans in 1389, carrying a claim to Milan to the French royal house. With the death of Filippo Maria in 1447 the male line ended; the short-lived Ambrosian Republic followed, and Filippo Maria's son-in-law Francesco Sforza founded a new ducal dynasty.
zh:
维斯孔蒂家族是米兰的伦巴第贵族世家，1075年阿里普兰多·维斯孔蒂与儿子奥托内在米兰签署法律文书，是该家族最早的记载；其世袭的子爵头衔即家族姓氏的由来。1262年就任米兰大主教的奥托内于1277年从宿敌德拉·托雷家族手中夺取米兰，奠定了家族的统治。此前特奥巴尔多·维斯孔蒂已在1271年当选教宗，称格列高利十世。1329至1339年在位的阿佐内统治时期，维斯孔蒂家族攻取克雷莫纳和布雷西亚，1339年赢得帕拉比亚戈战役，还请乔托来米兰装饰宫邸。大主教乔瓦尼于1350年取得博洛尼亚，1353年接受热那亚的统治权；贝尔纳博与加莱亚佐二世则通过众多子女的婚姻与欧洲各王室联姻，并修建了宏伟的帕维亚城堡。

1385年，吉安·加莱亚佐废黜叔父贝尔纳博，统一了家族全部领地；1395年他从波希米亚国王文策尔四世那里购得米兰公爵头衔，又先后征服维罗纳、帕多瓦、比萨和锡耶纳，1386年动工兴建米兰大教堂，还创建了帕维亚加尔都西会修道院，1402年去世。其女瓦伦蒂娜于1389年嫁给奥尔良的路易，把对米兰的继承权带入法国王室。1447年菲利波·马里亚去世，男系绝嗣；此后出现了短暂的安布罗西亚共和国，最终由他的女婿弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎建立了新的公爵王朝。

en:
The Visconti di Gallura were a Pisan noble branch, separate from the Visconti of Milan, who rose in the service of the commune of Pisa. Alberto held the title of patrician, and his son Eldizio was consul in 1184 and 1185; Eldizio's sons Lamberto and Ubaldo each served a term as podesta. In 1207 Lamberto married Elena, heiress of Barisone II of Gallura, and so made himself ruler of the northeastern corner of Sardinia, with his capital at Civita in the Giudicato of Gallura; in 1215 the brothers also imposed their hegemony on the southern Giudicato of Cagliari. A Pisan faction war ended with their defeat near Massa in 1213, after which their role in Pisa declined.

The Gallura line ran through Lambert, Ubaldo, John and Nino. Nino, grandson of Ugolino della Gherardesca, was driven from Pisa in 1288 and died in Sardinia in 1296; Dante placed his hanged chaplain Gomita in the eighth circle of the Inferno. Nino's daughter Joanna inherited the title and married Rizzardo da Camino, but on her death in 1308 the dynasty became extinct and Gallura passed to the Aragonese.
zh:
维斯孔蒂·迪·加卢拉是比萨的贵族支系，与米兰的维斯孔蒂家族同源而独立，靠效力比萨城邦起家。阿尔贝托拥有贵族头衔，其子埃尔迪齐奥于1184至1185年任执政官；埃尔迪齐奥的儿子兰贝托和乌巴尔多都曾出任公社长官。1207年，兰贝托娶加卢拉的巴里松二世的女继承人埃莱娜为妻，由此成为撒丁岛东北部加卢拉法官国的统治者，以奇维塔为都；1215年兄弟二人又把势力扩展到南部的卡利亚里法官国。1213年比萨派系战争中他们在马萨附近战败，此后在比萨的势力大减。

加卢拉一系先后由兰贝托、乌巴尔多、约翰和尼诺相继统治。尼诺是乌戈利诺·德拉·盖拉尔德斯卡的外孙，1288年被逐出比萨，1296年死于撒丁；但丁在《神曲·地狱篇》第八圈里收容了他下令绞死的教士戈米塔。尼诺之女乔万娜继承头衔，嫁给里扎尔多·达·卡米诺；1308年乔万娜去世后支系绝嗣，加卢拉随后转入阿拉贡人之手。

en: The Vitzthums were an old Thuringian ministerial family, whose name came from the office of vicedominus, the deputy governor they held for the archbishops of Mainz. They first appear in 1123 with Dietrich de Abbolde, a Mainz ministerialis at Apolda. By the mid-twelfth century the family ran the archiepiscopal administration from Erfurt, its members holding the hereditary court offices of cup-bearer, chamberlain, marshal and steward, while Apolda Castle remained their seat, and around 1300 the Vitzthums were the archbishops' stattholders in Erfurt. They acquired Eckstedt in 1249 and split into the Apolda, Eckstadt and Rossla lines. In 1342 the archbishop bought back the vicedominus office, but the title survived as the family name. The Apolda line, to which the Berthold Vitzthum recorded around 1300 belonged, held the castle as a Wettin fief and remained lords of Apolda until 1631. The Rossla branch won notoriety in the fifteenth century as robber barons, with Apel Vitzthum nicknamed the fire-master of Thuringia, while the Eckstadt line rose to the rank of counts and supplied Saxony with generals, such as the Thirty Years' War cavalry general Friedrich Wilhelm Vitzthum von Eckstedt, and statesmen through the following centuries.
zh: 菲茨图姆家族是古老的图林根家臣世家，族名来自他们替美因茨大主教世袭担任的 vicedominus（副主官）一职。1123年的文献首次提到该家族，当时在阿波尔达效力的美因茨家臣迪特里希·德·阿博尔德是其先祖。到12世纪中叶，家族从埃尔福特替大主教管理政务，成员世袭酒侍、内侍、马厩官和膳务官四项宫廷职务，阿波尔达城堡则始终是家族的驻地；1300年前后，菲茨图姆家族出任大主教在埃尔福特的总督。1249年家族取得埃克施泰特，随后分为阿波尔达、埃克施泰特和罗斯拉三支。1342年大主教赎回了副主官职务，但该头衔作为家族姓氏保留下来。约1300年在籍的贝特霍尔德·菲茨图姆所属的阿波尔达支，以韦廷家族封臣的身份保有城堡，直到1631年仍是阿波尔达的领主。罗斯拉支在15世纪以强盗骑士闻名，阿佩尔·菲茨图姆被称为图林根的纵火头目；埃克施泰特支则升为伯爵，此后数百年间为萨克森出将入相，例如三十年战争中的骑兵将领弗里德里希·威廉·菲茨图姆·冯·埃克施泰特。

en: The von Diest were an old noble house of Brabant, named after their seat at Diest, where an Otto von Diest is already recorded around 1099. The family grew into lords of Diest and later burgraves of Antwerp, founding and endowing religious houses across the region: Arnold I helped found Averbode Abbey in 1135, Arnold III gave land to the Teutonic Order in 1229, and Everhard von Diest, son of a knight killed at the Battle of Altenesch in 1234, became Bishop of Münster. Arnold V fought in the Battle of Worringen in 1288 and held both Diest and the Antwerp burgraviate. Although a cleric, his son Johann von Diest inherited the family lands and was made Bishop of Utrecht in 1322. Under the next generations the house reached its height: Heinrich received the Antwerp burgraviate as a fief in 1363, another son Wilhelm ruled as Prince-Bishop of Strasbourg from 1393 to 1439, and Thomas fought at Roosebeke in 1382 and acquired the lordship of Sichem. The direct line ended with Johanna in 1472, and through marriage the Diest inheritance passed to the counts of Nassau, reaching Nassau-Diez in 1708.
zh: 冯·迪斯特是布拉班特的古老贵族世家，得名于其家族所在地迪斯特，约1099年已有奥托·冯·迪斯特的记载。该家族后来成为迪斯特领主和安特卫普城堡伯，并在各地捐建修道院：阿诺尔德一世于1135年参与创立阿弗博德修道院，阿诺尔德三世于1229年向条顿骑士团捐赠地产，1234年战死于阿尔特内施之战的骑士之子埃弗哈德·冯·迪斯特则当上了明斯特主教。阿诺尔德五世参加了1288年的沃林根战役，身兼迪斯特领主与安特卫普城堡伯。他的儿子约翰虽是教士，却继承了家族地产，并于1322年出任乌得勒支主教。此后家族达到鼎盛：海因里希于1363年受封安特卫普城堡伯，另一个儿子威廉于1393—1439年任斯特拉斯堡采邑主教，托马斯参加了1382年的罗斯贝克之战并取得锡赫姆领地。直系于1472年随约翰娜之死而断绝，迪斯特的遗产经联姻转入拿骚伯爵家族，1708年归于拿骚-迪茨支系。

en: The von Geroldseck were a Swabian noble house of the Ortenau, first documented in the 1080s and settled in the Black Forest from 1139, with their seat at Castle Hohengeroldseck near Biberach. Wealth came from silver mining, and the family founded between sixteen and twenty monasteries in southern Baden while serving for centuries as protectors, or Vögte, of the Bishop of Strasbourg. Walter of Geroldseck, who built the family castle on the Schönberg between 1240 and 1250, became Bishop of Strasbourg in 1260 but was defeated at the Battle of Hausbergen in 1262, after which the city became a free imperial city. In 1270 his brother Heinrich married Agnes, heiress of the last Count of Veldenz, and so founded the second comital dynasty of Veldenz. The house split into Upper and Lower lines in 1277 and again in the early 1300s, when the Veldenz branch became independent; the Lower Line ruled around Lahr until it died out in 1426. The Palatinate stormed Castle Geroldseck in 1486, and the last baron, Jacob, died in 1634, leaving an heiress whose claims were overtaken when the Kronberg family took the lordship in 1635.
zh: 冯·杰拉尔德塞克是奥尔特瑙地区的施瓦本贵族世家，11世纪80年代首见记载，1139年起定居黑林山区，家族驻地在比伯拉赫附近的霍亨杰拉尔德塞克城堡。家族财富来自银矿开采，并在巴登南部捐建了十六至二十座修道院，还世代担任斯特拉斯堡主教的护教长官。瓦尔特·冯·杰拉尔德塞克于1240—1250年间在舍恩贝格修建家族城堡，1260年出任斯特拉斯堡主教，却在1262年的豪斯贝根之战中败北，斯特拉斯堡从此成为帝国自由城市。1270年，其弟海因里希娶了末代费尔登茨伯爵的女继承人阿格尼丝，由此开创费尔登茨的第二个伯爵王朝。1277年家族分为上、下两支，14世纪初再度分裂，费尔登茨支系就此独立；下支围绕拉尔统治，至1426年绝嗣。1486年，普法尔茨军队攻陷杰拉尔德塞克城堡；末代男爵雅各布于1634年去世，只留下一位女继承人，克龙贝格家族于1635年接管领地，她的继承权落空。

en: The counts of Beichlingen were a Thuringian comital family seated at Beichlingen Castle, ruling a county in north-eastern Thuringia with further estates along the Hainleite hills, the Kyffhaeuser, the southern Harz and the Goldene Aue, under the suzerainty of the landgraves of Thuringia. From the mid-fourteenth century debt steadily eroded their power: they sold Heringen Castle around 1330 and were forced to pledge out pieces of the ancestral county. Decline accelerated after the Saxon Brotherly War broke out in 1446. In 1448 the heavily indebted counts Gunther and Hans pledged a string of castles and villages to their kinsmen Botho of Stolberg and Henry of Schwarzburg for 22,000 Rhenish guilders, and after Gunther's death in 1454 these lands passed to the two houses in 1457, forming the joint lordship of Frohndorf, which became wholly Stolberg property when Schwarzburg sold its share in 1468. In 1519 Count Adam of Beichlingen sold the remnant of the county and the castle to the imperial chamberlain Hans von Werthern, completing the county's dissolution into the Electorate of Saxony.
zh: 拜希林根伯爵家族是图林根的伯爵世家，驻于拜希林根城堡，统治图林根东北部的一个伯国，还在海恩莱特丘陵、基夫豪森、南哈茨和金色奥厄一带有大片地产，宗主权属于图林根领地伯爵。14世纪中叶起，债务不断侵蚀家族势力：他们约在1330年卖掉黑林根城堡，后来又被迫把祖传伯国的一块块土地质押出去。1446年萨克森兄弟战争爆发后，衰败进一步加速。1448年，债台高筑的京特伯爵与汉斯伯爵以22000莱茵古尔登的债务，把一连串城堡和村庄质押给亲戚施托尔贝格的博托与施瓦茨堡的亨利；1454年京特去世后，这些地产于1457年正式转入两大家族，组成弗罗恩多夫共治领地，1468年施瓦茨堡售出自己的份额，弗罗恩多夫遂归施托尔贝格单独所有。1519年亚当伯爵因债务把残存的伯国和城堡卖给帝国宫廷大臣汉斯·冯·韦尔特恩，伯国彻底解体，并入萨克森选侯国。

en: The Colditz, also spelled Kolditz, were an old Saxon noble family of ministerial origin, named after Colditz Castle on the Mulde, which Emperor Frederick Barbarossa raised to an imperial estate in 1158 as part of the Pleissenland. They served the emperors and the Wettin margraves of Meissen as knights and officials. Withego II of Colditz was Bishop of Meissen from 1312 to 1342 and enlarged his see by buying the town of Nossen in 1335 and acquiring the lordship of Liebethal from the Bohemian crown in 1336. Thimo II, chamber official to Emperor Charles IV and governor of Upper Lusatia and Silesia, inherited Graupen, present-day Krupka, in northern Bohemia in 1341, while Thimo VIII, the emperor's court marshal, acquired Eilenburg in 1378 and the pledge of Pirna in 1379. The family's Saxon seat itself passed to the Wettins in 1404. A Bohemian branch held Graupen until 1557, when Thimo V sold it to the lords of Schoenburg; that line is said to have died out after 1620.
zh: 科尔迪茨家族（又译科尔迪茨）是古老的萨克森贵族，出身家臣阶层，以穆尔德河畔的科尔迪茨城堡为姓；1158年皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨将这座城堡作为普莱森兰的一部分升格为帝国直辖领地。家族世代为皇帝和韦廷家族的迈森藩侯担任骑士与官员。维特戈二世于1312—1342年任迈森主教，1335年购入诺森城，1336年又从波希米亚王室取得利贝塔尔领地，扩大了主教区。蒂莫二世任皇帝查理四世的宫廷财务官兼上卢萨蒂亚与西里西亚总督，1341年继承波希米亚北部的格劳彭（今克鲁普卡）；蒂莫八世任皇帝宫廷大司马，1378年取得艾伦堡，1379年取得皮尔纳的质押权。家族在萨克森的本家领地于1404年落入韦廷家族之手。波希米亚支系保有格劳彭至1557年，蒂莫五世当年将它卖给舍恩堡领主；该支系据说在1620年之后绝嗣。

en: The counts of Gleichen were a Thuringian house of the high nobility, first documented in 1089 as counts of Tonna and seated at the water castle of Graefentonna. In 1130 the archbishops of Mainz enfeoffed them with Gleichen Castle near Gotha, which gave the family its later name and its County of Gleichen. As Mainz Vogts over Erfurt from 1120 to 1290 and the archbishopric's dominant feudatories in the Eichsfeld, they were Mainz's chief agents in central Thuringia, until they sold their Eichsfeld estates back to the archbishopric in 1294. In 1342 they became Vogts of Hersfeld Abbey over Ohrdruf, where they built a compact lordship, and in 1590 they moved their court from Tonna and Gleichen to Ohrdruf and built Ehrenstein Castle. They also held fiefs of the margraves of Meissen and in 1583 inherited the immediate counties of Pyrmont and Spiegelberg. The comital line died out in 1631. A separate younger line, the barons von Gleichen attested from 1418 and seated at Ingersleben and Tannroda, outlived it and in 1732 inherited the Greifenstein estates of the extinct lords of Russwurm.
zh: 格莱兴伯爵家族是图林根的高级贵族世家，1089年首次以托纳伯爵的身份见于文献，驻在格雷芬托纳的水堡。1130年美因茨大主教把哥达附近的格莱兴城堡封给他们，家族后来的姓氏与格莱兴伯国便由此而来。1120—1290年他们担任美因茨在爱尔福特的地方官，又是大主教区在艾希斯费尔德的首要封臣，是美因茨在中图林根最重要的代理人，直到1294年把艾希斯费尔德的地产卖回给大主教区。1342年他们成为黑尔斯费尔德修道院在奥尔德鲁夫的地方官，在那里经营出一块紧凑的领地，1590年又把府邸从托纳和格莱兴迁至奥尔德鲁夫，并修建埃伦施泰因城堡。他们还持有迈森藩侯的封地，1583年继承了帝国直辖的皮尔蒙特伯国与施皮格尔贝格伯国。伯爵主支于1631年绝嗣。另一个1418年始见记载的年轻支系格莱兴男爵则延续下来，他们驻于英格斯莱本和坦罗达，并于1732年继承了绝嗣的鲁斯武姆家族的格赖芬施泰因产业。

en: The lords and counts of Manderscheid were for centuries the most powerful noble house of the Eifel, with their early seat at the moated castle of Oberkail. A Blankenheim line is documented from 1112; its lands were raised to a county in 1380 and passed to the Manderscheid through a female heiress when the direct line failed in 1406, adding Blankenheim to a cluster of Eifel lordships that included Kronenburg, Neuerburg, Gerolstein and Schleiden. In 1457 Emperor Frederick III made Dietrich III an imperial count, and after his death in 1498 the estates, already divided in 1488, went to three sons who founded the lines of Manderscheid-Blankenheim-Gerolstein, Manderscheid-Kail and Manderscheid-Schleiden. The Schleiden line, seated within the Duchy of Luxembourg, ended in 1647 with Elisabeth Amalia, its lands passing to the Kail line and the counts of Loewenstein-Wertheim, and Kail itself died out in 1742. The surviving Blankenheim branch, which from 1699 held a seat and vote in the Westphalian comital college of the Reichstag, inherited the other branches but ended with Countess Augusta in 1780; her Bohemian husband Count Philip Christian von Sternberg then took the name Sternberg-Manderscheid. Compensated with the Swabian abbey lands of Schussenried and Weissenau in 1803, the house was mediatized in 1806.
zh: 曼德沙伊德的领主与伯爵家族是艾费尔地区数百年间最有权势的贵族世家，早期驻于上凯尔的水堡。布兰肯海姆支系1112年已有记载，其领地1380年升格为伯国，1406年直系绝嗣后经女继承人转入曼德沙伊德家族；加上克罗嫩堡、诺伊尔堡、盖罗尔施泰因和施莱登等一系列艾费尔领地，家族势力大为扩张。1457年皇帝腓特烈三世册封迪特里希三世为帝国伯爵。他于1498年去世，此前家产已在1488年分割，由三个儿子分别开创曼德沙伊德-布兰肯海姆-盖罗尔施泰因、曼德沙伊德-凯尔和曼德沙伊德-施莱登三个支系。驻于卢森堡公国境内的施莱登支系于1647年随伊丽莎白·阿马利亚去世而绝嗣，领地转归凯尔支系与勒文施泰因-韦尔特海姆伯爵，凯尔支系本身也于1742年绝嗣。延续下来的布兰肯海姆支系自1699年起在帝国议会的威斯特伐利亚伯爵院拥有席位与表决权，它继承了各绝嗣支系的产业，却也在1780年随女伯爵奥古斯塔之死而终结；她的波希米亚丈夫菲利普·克里斯蒂安·冯·施特恩贝格伯爵随后改姓施特恩贝格-曼德沙伊德。家族1803年获赐士瓦本的舒森里德与魏森瑙修道院领地作为补偿，1806年被陪臣化。

en: The counts of Rietberg ruled a tiny but imperial county on the upper Ems in Westphalia, wedged between the prince-bishoprics of Paderborn and Muenster. Centred on the castle above the town of Rietberg, the territory emerged as an independent county in 1237, with its own militia, laws and coinage. In 1456 Count Conrad V had to surrender that immediacy and hold the county as a fief of the landgraves of Hesse for 600 Rhenish guilders. The Reformation was introduced in 1535 under Count Otto III, but the county was later re-Catholicized, one of the few secular Westphalian lands where the Counter-Reformation succeeded. The male line ended when Count John II died in prison in Cologne in 1562; after his daughters were enfeoffed in 1565, Walburgis married Count Enno III of East Frisia in 1581 and carried Rietberg to the East Frisian ruling house, whose Rietberg line failed in 1690. In 1699 the heiress Maria Ernestine married Count Maximilian Ulrich von Kaunitz and so founded the house of Kaunitz-Rietberg. Mediatized to the Kingdom of Westphalia in 1807, the county passed to Prussia in 1815.
zh: 里特贝格伯爵家族统治着威斯特伐利亚上埃姆斯河畔一个狭小却直属帝国的伯国，夹在帕德博恩与明斯特两个主教邦之间。领地以里特贝格城上方的城堡为中心，1237年成为独立伯国，拥有自己的民兵、法律和铸币。1456年康拉德五世被迫放弃直辖地位，以600莱茵古尔登的代价把伯国改为黑森领地伯爵的封地。1535年奥托三世伯爵在位时引入宗教改革，但伯国后来又被重新天主教化，是威斯特伐利亚少数反宗教改革得手的世俗领地。1562年约翰二世伯爵死于科隆的监狱，男系断绝；他的女儿们于1565年受封后，瓦尔布吉斯在1581年嫁给东弗里斯兰伯爵恩诺三世，把里特贝格带入东弗里斯兰统治家族，该家族的里特贝格支系于1690年绝嗣。1699年女继承人玛丽亚·埃内斯蒂娜嫁给马克西米利安·乌尔里希·冯·考尼茨伯爵，由此开创考尼茨-里特贝格家族。伯国于1807年被陪臣化给威斯特伐利亚王国，1815年转归普鲁士。

en: The counts of Toggenburg ruled the Toggenburg region of present-day canton St. Gallen and neighbouring lands from the thirteenth to the fifteenth century. An older baronial line was named after Alt-Toggenburg Castle near Kirchberg, which was destroyed in 1085 in a feud with the abbot of St. Gallen and was given to St. Gallen Abbey by Count Diethelm in 1226. The comital house is securely attested from the early thirteenth century under Diethelm I, who inherited several local lordships including Alt-Rapperswil around 1200 and took the title of count in 1209; as early as 1187 Werner of Toggenburg had become abbot of Einsiedeln. The early counts contended with St. Gallen Abbey, the bishops of Constance and the counts of Kyburg, and family strife saw one Diethelm kill his brother Rudolf in 1226. The last count, Frederick VII, died in 1436 without male heirs, and the disputed inheritance triggered the Old Zurich War between Zurich and the other Swiss confederates. The family's tombs lay in Ruti Abbey, where fourteen members rested in the Toggenburg vault until confederate troops desecrated the monastery in 1443.
zh: 吐根堡伯爵家族在13至15世纪统治着今圣加仑州境内的吐根堡地区及周边土地。更早的男爵支系以基希贝格附近的老吐根堡城堡得名，这座城堡1085年在与圣加仑修道院长的仇杀中被毁，1226年由迪特赫尔姆伯爵赠给圣加仑修道院。伯爵世家自13世纪初的迪特赫尔姆一世起有可靠记载，他约在1200年继承了包括老拉珀斯维尔在内的数个地方领地，并于1209年起使用伯爵头衔；早在1187年，家族的维尔纳便已出任艾恩西德尔恩修道院长。早期伯爵与圣加仑修道院、康斯坦茨主教和基堡伯爵争雄，家族内讧中，一位迪特赫尔姆于1226年杀死了亲兄弟鲁道夫。末代伯爵弗里德里希七世于1436年去世，没有男性继承人，有争议的继承权引发苏黎世与其他瑞士邦联成员之间的旧苏黎世战争。家族墓地设在吕蒂修道院，共有十四名族人葬于吐根堡墓室，1443年邦联军队劫掠修道院时，墓室遭到破坏。

en: The counts of Wernigerode were a comital house in the Harzgau at the northern foot of the Harz mountains, seated at Wernigerode Castle, first recorded as a fortified residence in 1213. Their first documented member, Count Albert I, came from Haimar near Hanover and appears under the Wernigerode title in a charter of 1121 issued by the bishop of Halberstadt. The family held broad estates stretching from the Oker river to the Grosses Bruch and rivalled the counts of Regenstein. Pressed by the Welf dukes of Brunswick, they lost imperial immediacy in 1268 and became vassals of the Ascanian margraves of Brandenburg, then of the archbishops of Magdeburg from 1381; in 1343 they added former Regenstein lands as fiefs of Halberstadt. The male line ended with Count Henry IV in 1429, when an inheritance settlement of 1417 passed the county to the House of Stolberg. The Stolberg counts ruled it in personal union for two centuries. The Stolberg-Wernigerode line, formed in 1710 under Count Christian Ernest, restored Wernigerode Castle as its residence, accepted Prussian overlordship in 1714, and was finally mediatized, the county being incorporated into the Prussian Province of Saxony in 1815.
zh: 韦尼格罗德伯爵家族是哈茨山北麓哈茨高地区的伯爵世家，驻于韦尼格罗德城堡，该城堡1213年首见记载。家族可考的始祖阿尔布雷希特一世出身汉诺威附近的海马尔，1121年在哈尔伯施塔特主教签发的一份文书中首次以韦尼格罗德伯爵的头衔出现。家族领地西起奥克河、东抵大布鲁赫谷地，与雷根施泰因伯爵家族长期争雄。迫于不伦瑞克韦尔夫公爵的压力，家族于1268年丧失帝国直辖地位，成为阿斯卡尼亚家族勃兰登堡藩侯的封臣，1381年又改封马格德堡大主教；1343年他们以哈尔伯施塔特主教封臣的身份取得原属雷根施泰因的领地。1429年末代伯爵亨利四世去世，男系绝嗣，伯国按1417年的继承协议转给施托尔贝格家族。施托尔贝格伯爵以共主形式统治此地两百年。1710年分出的施托尔贝格-韦尼格罗德支系在克里斯蒂安·恩斯特伯爵治下重修韦尼格罗德城堡并迁回府邸，1714年承认普鲁士宗主权，最终遭陪臣化，伯国于1815年并入普鲁士萨克森省。

en: The Wachi were kokujin lords of Bingo Province, holding Nantenzan Castle at Kisa in Mitani district, and claimed descent from Fujiwara no Hidesato, sharing ancestry with houses such as the Hatano. Their forebear Hirasawa Sanekata followed Minamoto no Yoritomo and received an estate in Mitani district of Bingo in 1192; his son Sanetaka was already suppressing pirates along the Bingo coast in 1211. In the Nanboku-chō wars the family joined the Southern Court partisans of Iyo and the seafarers of Ikuchijima in resisting the Muromachi bakufu, then served Ashikaga Tadafuyu, before Morozane took service with Ashikaga Yoshiakira in 1367. Together with the Eda and other houses springing from the Hirasawa, the Wachi formed the so-called Hirasawa bands, which dealt collectively with the Yamana shugo and fellow Bingo lords such as the Yamauchi. Through the Muromachi period their heads served the Yamana and received generational characters from them. In the Sengoku age they shifted first to Amago Tsunehisa and then to Mōri Motonari. The ninth head Masaharu, once an equal ally of the rising Mōri, entertained Mōri Takamoto at a banquet in 1563 shortly before Takamoto's sudden death; suspected of poisoning, he was confined on Itsukushima in 1568, cut his way into the great shrine's main hall, and was killed there early in 1569. His son was spared, and the Wachi continued as Mōri retainers.
zh: 和智氏是备后国的国人领主，本据在三谿郡吉舎的南天山城，自称出自藤原秀乡一脉，与波多野氏等同源。其祖先广泽实方追随源赖朝，于1192年受封备后三谷郡的领地；其子实高在1211年已负责在备后沿海镇压海盗。南北朝动乱中，和智氏与伊予的南朝势力及生口岛海盗呼应，对抗室町幕府，一度投入足利直冬麾下，1367年和智师实又转仕足利义诠。和智、江田等广泽氏后裔组成的备后国众被称为“广泽众”，共同应对守护山名氏和山内氏等同国豪强。室町时代，和智氏历代当主臣从山名氏并接受其偏讳。进入战国，他们先后依附出云的尼子经久和安艺的毛利元就。第九代当主和智诚春曾与崛起中的毛利氏对等结盟，1563年他设宴款待毛利隆元，隆元归途中暴毙，诚春被疑下毒，1568年被监禁于严岛，他逃入严岛神社本殿拒守，最终在1569年初被讨杀。其子获许继承家名，和智氏此后作为毛利家臣延续下去。

en: The Waga were a kokujin house of Waga district in Mutsu Province, the Waga River basin around present-day Kitakami in Iwate, where the game places their home. Their reliable genealogy derives them from the Nakajo line: Narisue was adopted into the Kamakura warlord Wada Yoshimori and enfeoffed in Katta district, and his son Yoshiyuki moved to Waga around 1220, becoming steward of half the district and taking its name, while a junior branch held the other half from Futago Castle. During the Nanboku-cho wars the kindred split between the courts, the main house and its powerful cadet line, the Onikiri, joining the Northern Court in 1340 to fight their Southern Court kinsmen, the Sususon; in 1401 the Kanto deputy recognised the head Tokiyoshi as superintendent over the whole district, and the main house kept Futago Castle as a regional daimyo until the Tensho era. A succession feud then widened into the great Waga disturbance of 1435 to 1436, drawing in a thirty-thousand-strong Nanbu army along with the Kasai and Osaki, and costing the family its outlying lands in Kami, Shida and Kurihara. Having failed to join Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign in 1590, the Waga were dispossessed and their district became Hideyoshi's own domain; a Waga and Hienuki rising that autumn was crushed, and the district passed to the Nanbu in 1591. A second revolt, the Iwasaki rising of 1600 to 1601, was launched with Date backing while the Nanbu were away at war, failed to take Hanamaki Castle and fell back on Iwasaki Castle; when it fell, its leader Tadachika was summoned by Tokugawa Ieyasu and took his own life on the way.
zh: 和贺氏是陆奥国和贺郡的国人豪族，盘踞在今岩手县北上市一带的和贺川流域，游戏也把本据设在此地。较可靠的家系出自中条氏：成季被镰仓和田义盛收为养子、受封陆奥刈田郡，其子义行在1219至1222年的承久年间下向和贺郡，成为半郡地头并取郡名为苗字，是为和贺氏之祖；其弟义春一系则领有另一半，以二子城为据点。南北朝战乱中一族分属南北两朝，1340年宗家连同有力庶流鬼柳氏转投北朝，攻打南朝方的同族须须孙氏；1401年关东管领下发辞令，承认当主时义的惣领权与对全郡的支配权，和贺宗家居城二子城，以地方大名的体制延续到天正年间。1435至1436年的家督纷争演变为“和贺之乱”，南部氏率近三万大军介入，葛西、大崎等族也卷入，和贺氏因此丧失了在加美、志田、栗原诸郡的飞地。1590年和贺氏因未参加小田原征伐被丰臣秀吉没收领地，和贺郡收为藏入地，当年秋天的和贺稗贯一揆也被镇压，次年该郡转交南部氏。1600至1601年，忠亲借南部氏出征最上之机、在伊达氏支援下发动岩崎一揆，攻打花卷城未果，困守岩崎城，次年城破，忠亲被德川家康召问，于押送途中自尽。

en: The Wakes were a warrior family of Lincolnshire, with estates also in Cumberland; Baldwin Wake, who died in 1282, and his son John, first Baron Wake of Liddell when the title was created in 1295, both earned reputations as soldiers. John's son Thomas, born in 1297, inherited as a child and was ward first to Piers Gaveston and then to Henry, Earl of Lancaster, whose daughter Blanche he married before 1317. He joined Queen Isabella's rising against Edward II in 1326 and sat on Edward III's early council, but fell out with Isabella and Roger Mortimer and fled to France in 1330, returning after their fall. Restored to favour, he governed the Channel Islands, backed Edward Balliol's invasion of Scotland, and later served in Brittany, though he was briefly imprisoned in 1341. Thomas died childless in 1349 and was buried at the Austin priory he had founded at Haltemprice in Yorkshire; his lands passed through his sister Margaret to the earls of Kent and then the Holland family, and the barony itself fell into abeyance in 1408.
zh: 韦克家族是林肯郡的军人世家，在坎伯兰也有领地；1282年去世的鲍德温·韦克和他的儿子约翰都以善战闻名，约翰在1295年受封第一代利德尔的韦克男爵。约翰之子托马斯生于1297年，幼年袭爵，最初由皮尔斯·加韦斯顿监护，后改由兰开斯特伯爵亨利监护，并在1317年之前娶亨利之女布朗什为妻。1326年他参加伊莎贝拉王后反对爱德华二世的起事，进入爱德华三世的早期议会，但很快与伊莎贝拉和罗杰·莫蒂默决裂，1330年逃往法国，直到二人倒台才回国。重获恩宠后，他出任海峡群岛总督，支持爱德华·巴里奥入侵苏格兰，后来又在布列塔尼服役，其间于1341年一度下狱。托马斯于1349年无子而终，葬在他自己于约克郡霍尔特姆普赖斯创建的奥古斯丁修会修道院；领地经姐姐玛格丽特转入肯特伯爵一系，后又归于霍兰家族，男爵爵位本身则在1408年处于悬置状态。
