The presiding image, carved from tharu wood with one foot raised, depicts Vamana swollen into the giant Trivikrama, who appeared at this very place to humble the Asura king Bali by striding over the three worlds in three paces. The temple is also revered as the place where the first three Alvars, Poigai, Bhoothath and Pey, attained salvation, and it is one of the five Panchakanna Kshetrams associated with Krishna: tradition holds the shrine was originally dedicated to Krishna under the name Gopalan, from which Tirukkoyilur takes its name. A further legend tells how the sage Mrikandu performed penance here and was granted a vision of Vishnu in his Vamana-Trivikrama form.
zh: 乌拉加蓝塔佩鲁马尔神庙又称三步神毗讫罗摩神庙，坐落在泰米尔地区提卢瓦那摩罗以南的蒂鲁科伊尔卢尔。庙中毗湿奴以“丈量世界之主”乌拉加蓝塔·佩鲁马尔的形象受祀，拉克什米则称蓬戈泰；这座神庙位列108座迪维亚·德萨姆圣地，阿尔瓦尔圣徒的《四千圣诵》曾对它加以赞颂。神庙最初由中世纪的朱罗人兴建，后经毗奢耶那伽罗诸王和马杜赖纳亚克家族增饰；十一层的主门楼高达五十九米，是泰米尔地区第三高的庙塔。主尊像以塔鲁木雕成，一足抬起，表现筏摩那化身为巨人毗讫罗摩，正是在此地为折服阿修罗王钵利而三步跨越三界。神庙还被尊为最早三位阿尔瓦尔圣徒波伊盖、布塔特和佩伊获得解脱之处，也是与黑天相关的五座潘查坎纳圣地之一：相传神龛最初供奉的是号为戈帕兰的黑天，蒂鲁科伊尔卢尔之名便由此而来。另有传说称，仙人姆里坎杜在此苦行，终得亲见毗湿奴的筏摩那至毗讫罗摩化身。

en: The Umayyad Mosque, or Great Mosque of Damascus, stands on a site sacred since the Iron Age: an Aramean temple of the storm god Hadad, then a Roman temple of Jupiter, then a Christian cathedral under the emperor Theodosius I. After the Muslim conquest of Damascus in 634 part of it served as a prayer house, and between 706 and 715 the Umayyad caliph al-Walid I replaced the whole church with a vast congregational mosque built by thousands of craftsmen drawn from the Byzantine lands and famed for its golden mosaics; its courtyard plan became a model for later Islamic architecture. Both Christians and Muslims venerate it as the resting place of the head of John the Baptist, and it also holds shrines linked to Husayn ibn Ali, while the tall Minaret of Isa is named for the tradition that Jesus will descend there at the end of days. Fire damaged the mosque in 1069 and again in 1479, after which the Mamluk sultan Qaitbay added his namesake minaret in 1488, and the earthquake of 1759 ruined part of its northern arcade.
zh: 伍麦叶清真寺又称大马士革大清真寺，所在之地自铁器时代起便是崇拜场所：先是阿拉米人供奉风暴之神哈达德的神庙，后成为罗马人的朱庇特神庙，狄奥多西一世时期又改建为基督教堂。634年穆斯林征服大马士革后，教堂一部分被辟为礼拜所；706至715年间，伍麦叶哈里发瓦利德一世将整座教堂拆除，征调拜占庭地区的数千工匠建成宏大的聚礼清真寺，以金色镶嵌画闻名，其庭院形制成为后世伊斯兰建筑的典范。基督徒和穆斯林都相信施洗约翰的头颅安葬于此，寺内还有与侯赛因·伊本·阿里有关的圣龛；高耸的尔撒宣礼塔则得名于尔撒在末日降临于此的传说。1069年和1479年清真寺两度遭火，1488年马穆鲁克苏丹卡伊特拜在灾后增建了以他命名的宣礼塔，1759年的地震又毁坏了部分北侧拱廊。

en: Usa Hachiman Jingūji is a shrine-temple complex at Usa in Buzen Province, on the island of Kyushu, dedicated to Hachiman, the deified Emperor Ōjin and tutelary god of warriors. The shrine was founded in the Wadō era of 708–714, the first of all Hachiman shrines, whose prestige came to rank second only to the Ise Shrine. In 779 the Miroku-ji temple was built beside it, creating what is regarded as Japan's first jingū-ji, a combined Shinto shrine and Buddhist temple, and the temples of the surrounding Kunisaki Peninsula became an early center of the mingling of kami and Buddhist worship. In 749 its portable shrine carried Hachiman's spirit to Nara to protect the casting of the Great Buddha at Tōdai-ji. An oracle from Usa was later invoked in the dispute over the monk Dōkyō's claim to the throne under Empress Shōtoku. As the head shrine of the Hachiman cult it mothered branches including Iwashimizu Hachimangū in 859 and Tsurugaoka Hachimangū in 1063. In the sixteenth century it was repeatedly attacked by the Funai lord Ōtomo Yoshishige, whose own wife, the priestess Lady Nata, helped defend it.
zh: 宇佐八幡神宫寺是位于九州丰前国宇佐的一座神佛复合寺社，祭祀被神化为八幡神的应神天皇，即武士的守护神。神社建于和铜年间（708—714年），是日本所有八幡神社的起源，地位之高仅次于伊势神宫。779年弥勒寺在神社旁落成，形成被视为日本最早的神宫寺，即神社与佛寺合一的复合建筑；附近国东半岛的寺院群也成为神佛习合的早期中心。749年，这里的神轿将八幡神灵迎往奈良，护持东大寺大佛的铸造。称德天皇在位时，僧人道镜觊觎皇位，宇佐降下的神谕在这场风波中成为关键。作为八幡信仰的本宫，它衍生出859年的石清水八幡宫、1063年的鹤冈八幡宫等分社。16世纪，它多次遭到府内领主大友义镇的攻击，而义镇之妻、神职奈多夫人曾参与抵抗。

en: The Vamana Temple at Khajuraho, in the Chandela kingdom of central India, is dedicated to Vamana, the dwarf avatar of Vishnu who in legend took three strides across the world to humble the demon king Bali. It was raised between about 1050 and 1075 under the Chandela dynasty, whose kings built the Khajuraho complex in the Nagara temple style during the tenth and eleventh centuries. The shrine stands in the eastern group of monuments and comprises a sanctum, a vestibule, a great hall with lateral transepts and an entrance porch, its outer walls carrying the carved divine figures characteristic of Chandela art. Khajuraho's temples remained in active worship until the late twelfth century; after the Delhi Sultanate under Qutb-ud-din Aibak overran the Chandela kingdom in the thirteenth century the complex was largely abandoned, although the Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta could still visit the shrines around 1340.
zh: 瓦玛纳神庙位于中印度昌德拉王国境内的克久拉霍，供奉毗湿奴的侏儒化身瓦玛纳；传说他以三步丈量天地，降服了魔王巴利。神庙建于约1050—1075年，是昌德拉王朝在10至11世纪以纳加拉神庙风格营建的克久拉霍建筑群的一部分，属古迹群的东群。整座建筑由圣所、前室、带两侧耳堂的大会堂和门廊组成，外墙布满昌德拉艺术特有的神像雕刻。克久拉霍诸庙的香火一直延续到12世纪末；13世纪德里苏丹国的库特布丁·艾伊拜克攻灭昌德拉王国后，建筑群大多荒废，不过摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰在约1340年仍曾到此巡礼。

en: The Sri Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha Temple stands on the Simhachalam hills north of Visakhapatnam in Andhra Pradesh, in the old Kalinga country, and is dedicated to Vishnu in a form uniting his boar and man-lion avatars. Its local legend relates that the devotee Prahlada, saved by Narasimha from his father Hiranyakashipu, asked the god to appear as Varaha and Narasimha together, slayers of the demon brothers Hiranyaksha and Hiranyakashipu, so the central icon is a boar-headed lion body attended by Lakshmi. Except at the spring festival of Akshaya Tritiya, the image is kept coated in sandalwood paste and resembles a linga. The earliest of the temple's five hundred or so inscriptions dates to 1087 under the Chola king Kulottunga I; the present Kalingan-style building was raised by Eastern Ganga king Narasimhadeva I in the thirteenth century and consecrated by his son Bhanudeva I in 1268. Reddy kings, the Odia Gajapatis and the Tuluva rulers of Vijayanagara later endowed it, and Krishnadevaraya set up a victory pillar here during his Kalinga campaigns of 1516 to 1519. Worship was interrupted for forty years after 1564 under the Qutb Shahi sultans of Golkonda until a grant of 1604 restored the rites. Counted among the thirty-two great Narasimha pilgrimage centres of Andhra, Simhachalam was, with Srikurmam, a principal stronghold of Vaishnavism in the eastern Deccan.
zh: 室利筏罗诃·吉祥天女·那罗辛哈神庙坐落在安得拉邦维沙卡帕特南北郊的辛赫恰拉姆山上，地处古羯陵伽之地，供奉合野猪化身与人狮化身为一体的毗湿奴。当地传说称，虔信者波罗诃罗陀被那罗辛哈从其父金席手中救下后，祈求神灵同时显现诛杀金目、金席兄弟的筏罗诃与那罗辛哈两副化身，因此主像为猪首狮身、吉祥天女随侍之形；除春日的阿克夏亚·特里蒂亚节外，神像终年裹以檀香膏，望去宛如一尊林伽。庙中现存约五百方铭文，最早的一方属1087年朱罗王俱卢通伽一世时期；现存这座羯陵伽风格的建筑为13世纪东恒伽王纳拉辛哈德瓦一世所建，1268年由其子巴努德瓦一世主持开光。此后雷迪王朝诸王、奥里萨的加贾帕蒂诸王和毗奢耶那伽罗的图鲁瓦王室相继布施，克里希纳德瓦拉亚在1516至1519年远征羯陵伽时于此立胜利柱。1564年以后，受戈尔孔达库特布沙希苏丹国统治，庙中仪轨中断了四十年，直到1604年的一纸施地令才恢复常祭。它与其他神庙同列为安得拉三十二处那罗辛哈大朝圣中心，并与室利俱利摩一道，是东德干毗湿奴派的主要重镇。

en: The Varaha Temple at Khajuraho, in present-day Madhya Pradesh, houses a colossal monolithic boar of sandstone, 2.6 metres long, honouring Varaha, the third avatar of Vishnu, in a purely animal form. It stands in the Western Group of the Khajuraho temples, raised by the Chandela kings of Jejakabhukti, the later Bundelkhand, and is dated to about 900 to 925, making it one of the oldest shrines in the complex. The myth it celebrates is the boar's rescue of the earth: the asura Hiranyaksha dragged Bhudevi, the earth goddess, to the bottom of the cosmic ocean, and Varaha fought him for a thousand years before slaying him and lifting the earth on his tusks. The great image is carved all over its body with rows of miniature gods and goddesses, while Saraswati bearing her veena appears between the boar's nose and mouth. The shrine itself is a modest oblong pavilion on a high plinth, roofed by a pyramid of receding tiers on fourteen plain pillars and built entirely of sandstone; it faces the Lakshmana Temple and adjoins the Lakshmi shrine within the Western Group that the Chandelas dotted with Nagara-style temples between the late ninth and eleventh centuries.
zh: 克久拉霍的筏罗诃神庙位于今中央邦，庙内供奉一尊整块砂岩雕成的巨型野猪像，长2.6米，以完全兽形的形象表现毗湿奴的第三化身筏罗诃。它属于克久拉霍寺庙群的西群，由杰贾卡布蒂（即后来的本德尔肯德）的昌德拉诸王建于约900至925年，是该建筑群中最古老的神祠之一。神庙所纪念的神话是野猪救地：阿修罗金目把大地女神布德维拖入宇宙之海的海底，筏罗诃与之鏖战千年，终将其诛杀，用獠牙把大地托出海面。这尊巨像通体布满一排排小型神像，猪的口鼻之间还雕有怀抱维纳琴的萨拉斯瓦蒂。神祠本身是一座高台上的朴素长方形亭阁，十四根素面石柱承托层层内收的金字塔式屋顶，通体以砂岩筑成；它与拉克什曼神庙遥遥相对，紧邻吉祥天女神庙，是昌德拉人在9世纪末至11世纪间兴建的那竭罗风格寺庙群的一部分。

en: The Sri Varahaswamy Temple, also called Bhu Varahaswamy, stands on the Tirumala hills at Tirupati in present-day Andhra Pradesh, on the northern bank of the Swami Pushkarini tank beside the great Venkateswara Temple, and is believed to be older than that shrine; the hills are therefore known as Adi Varaha Kshetra, the first field of Varaha. Varaha is the boar avatar of Vishnu, third among the Dashavatara, who slew the asura Hiranyaksha and lifted the drowned earth on his tusks. The Venkatacala Mahatmya of the Skanda Purana tells how the boar came to rest on this bank after the rescue: a tribal hunter, Vasu, tracked him to an anthill, and Varaha spoke through the swooning man to order King Tondaman to raise a temple here. At the opening of the Kali Yuga, runs another legend, Varaha granted this land to Venkateswara, who in return conceded him the right of first bell, puja and food offering, so pilgrims take darshan of Varaha before approaching Venkateswara. The rock shrine follows the Vaikhanasa Agama and was renovated in 1535 by Pedda Tirumalacharya, and the birthday festival of Varaha Jayanti is celebrated beside the tank each year.
zh: 室利筏罗诃斯瓦米神庙又称布筏罗诃斯瓦米神庙，坐落在今印度安得拉邦蒂鲁帕蒂的蒂鲁马拉山上，位于斯瓦米·普什卡里尼圣湖北岸、宏伟的温卡特斯瓦拉神庙旁，相传比后者更为古老，蒂鲁马拉群山也因此得名“原初筏罗诃之地”。筏罗诃是毗湿奴十大化身中的第三化身，即野猪化身：阿修罗王金目把大地拖入海底，筏罗诃将其诛杀，用獠牙把大地从海底托起。《室犍陀往世书》的《温卡塔山志》记载，野猪救起大地后便在这湖岸安息；猎人瓦苏追猎一头野猪来到蚁冢前，筏罗诃借昏迷的瓦苏之口传令，命通达曼王在此建庙。另一则传说称，迦利纪元之初筏罗诃把这块土地让给温卡特斯瓦拉，后者则回报以首钟、首祭与首份祭品之权，因此朝山者照例要先礼拜筏罗诃，再去觐见温卡特斯瓦拉。这座岩石神庙依《毗坎那萨阿笈摩》举行日常仪轨，1535年由佩达·蒂鲁马拉查里亚重修，每年都在湖畔庆祝筏罗诃诞辰。

en: Varanasi, also called Benares or by its ancient name Kashi, stands on the left bank of the Ganges and is among the oldest continuously inhabited cities in India, having been the capital of the ancient Kingdom of Kashi in the first millennium BCE. Hindu tradition holds that the city was founded by the god Shiva, and it is the foremost of the seven holy cities, the Sapta Puri, where death and cremation are believed to release the soul from the cycle of rebirth. Pilgrims bathe in the river from its many ghats, and the Manikarnika and Harishchandra ghats are the great cremation grounds; the Kashi Vishwanath temple, one of the twelve Jyotirlinga shrines of Shiva, is the holiest of its hundreds of temples. Nearby Sarnath was the place of the Buddha's first sermon, and in the eighth century Adi Shankara established Shiva worship as the city's official sect. The Ghurid ruler Muhammad of Ghor sacked Varanasi in 1194 and destroyed the original Vishwanath temple; it was rebuilt under Akbar, only for Aurangzeb to demolish it in 1669 and raise the Gyanvapi Mosque on its site, while the present temple was built nearby by the Maratha queen Ahilyabai Holkar in 1780. The Bhakti saints Kabir and Ravidas were born here, and Tulsidas wrote the Ramcharitmanas in the city. As Mughal power weakened, the Kingdom of Benares emerged under Balwant Singh in 1740 and passed to the East India Company in 1775.
zh: 瓦拉纳西又称贝拿勒斯，古称迦尸，坐落于恒河左岸，是印度持续有人居住的最古老城市之一，公元前一千纪时曾是古代迦尸国的都城。印度教传统认为此城由湿婆神亲自建立，是七座圣城“萨帕塔普里”中地位最高的一座，相信在此死去、火化可使灵魂脱离轮回。朝圣者沿层层河坛步入恒河沐浴，马尼卡尼卡河坛与哈里什昌德拉河坛是著名的火化场；城中数百座神庙里，供奉湿婆的湿婆金庙是十二处究提林迦圣地之一，最为神圣。附近的鹿野苑是佛陀首次讲法之地；8世纪时，阿迪·商羯罗将湿婆信仰确立为城中的正统教派。1194年，古尔王朝的穆罕默德·古尔洗劫瓦拉纳西，摧毁了最早的威斯瓦纳特神庙；该庙在阿克巴时期得以重建，却又在1669年被奥朗则布拆毁，原址建起吉扬瓦皮清真寺，现存的湿婆金庙是1780年由马拉塔女王阿希莉亚拜·霍尔卡在邻近地点修建的。虔诚派圣徒迦比尔和拉维达斯都出生于此，杜尔西达斯也在这里写下《罗摩功行录》。随着莫卧儿势力衰落，贝拿勒斯王国于1740年在巴尔万特·辛格治下兴起，并于1775年转归英国东印度公司。

en: Vazelon Monastery was built in the Pontic Mountains, about forty kilometres south of Trebizond, in the Maçka valley. Dedicated to John the Baptist, it was founded in Roman times, around 270 or 317, making it one of the oldest monasteries of Anatolia. In the sixth century Sassanid raiders sacked it and killed its monks, and in 565 Emperor Justinian I ordered it repaired; Byzantine emperors of the seventh and eighth centuries funded its expansion. After the Fourth Crusade shattered Byzantium in 1204, Pontus became the Empire of Trebizond, whose emperors handsomely endowed Vazelon alongside the other great Pontic houses, and the surviving buildings date from a rebuilding of 1410. It kept authority over the surrounding villages of the Maçka region, and its church was decorated with frescoes of Heaven, Hell and the Last Judgement. Through the Ottoman conquest of 1461 and the centuries that followed, Vazelon remained a centre of Greek Orthodox worship, and its archive, partly preserved in St Petersburg and Ankara, became a key source for the history of Byzantium and Trebizond.
zh: 瓦泽隆修道院建于特拉比松以南约40公里的马奇卡山谷，地处本都山脉。它供奉施洗约翰，始建于罗马时代的270年或317年前后，是安纳托利亚最古老的修道院之一。6世纪时，萨珊波斯入侵者洗劫了修道院并杀害修士，565年查士丁尼一世下令修复；7至8世纪的拜占庭皇帝又出资扩建。1204年第四次十字军东征瓦解拜占庭后，本都成为特拉比松帝国，历代皇帝像资助其他本都大修道院一样厚赐瓦泽隆，现存建筑则建于1410年的重建。它长期管辖着马奇卡地区周围的村庄，教堂内绘有描绘天堂、地狱和最后的审判的壁画。经历1461年奥斯曼征服之后的数百年间，瓦泽隆始终是希腊正教的礼拜中心；它的档案部分保存于圣彼得堡和安卡拉，成为研究拜占庭与特拉比松历史的重要资料。

en: The Vedadri Narasimha Temple stands on the bank of the Krishna River and is one of the Pancha Narasimha Kshetras, the five great shrines of the man-lion god. Its sthalapurana tells that the demon Somakasura stole the Vedas from Brahma and hid them in the ocean, whereupon Vishnu appeared as Narasimha, rescued the sacred texts and turned them into the hill of Vedadri. Five forms of Narasimha are worshipped here, including Vira, Jwala and Yoga Narasimha, with separate shrines for the twelve Tamil Alvars and for the sages of the Vaikhanasa tradition. The temple rose to prominence under the Kakatiya Empire, and the Telugu saint-composer Narayana Tirtha was a frequent visitor. In the nineteenth century the zamindar Vasireddy Muktiswara Prasad Nayudu renovated it, renewing the flagstaff and building a flight of 108 steps down to the Krishna. An annual Narasimha Jayanti festival still draws crowds of pilgrims.
zh: 韦达德里的那罗辛哈神庙屹立在克里希纳河畔，是五大人狮神神庙之一。当地圣传称，阿修罗索摩阿修罗从梵天处盗走吠陀经并藏于海中，毗湿奴遂化身为那罗辛哈，夺回经典并将其化为克里希纳河畔的韦达德里山。庙中供奉那罗辛哈的五种形相，包括维拉、耆婆罗和瑜伽那罗辛哈，另设有十二位泰米尔阿尔瓦尔圣徒以及瓦伊卡纳萨传统仙人们的独立神龛。神庙在卡卡提亚帝国时期声名鹊起，泰卢固圣徒兼诗人纳拉亚纳·蒂尔塔曾常来参拜。19世纪，柴明达尔瓦西雷迪·穆克蒂斯瓦拉·普拉萨德·奈杜重修神庙，更换了旗杆，并修建了108级通往克里希纳河的台阶。每年一度的那罗辛哈诞辰节仍吸引大批朝圣者。

en: Vidisha, the medieval city of Bhilsa in eastern Malwa, is counted among the Puranakshetras, the ancient Jain pilgrimage lands, for Jains believe it was the birthplace of Shitalanatha, the tenth Tirthankara. The oldest shrines in the district go back to the 800s and 900s, when the Pratihara and Paramara schools of temple architecture flourished in central India. At Gyaraspur the rock-cut Maladevi temple, dedicated to Adinatha, and the Bajramath, a Brahmanical Surya temple later given over to Jain images, preserve rich collections of Tirthankara sculpture, while the Pataria complex at Badoh groups twenty-five temples of the same period around a central spired shrine; the Gadarmal temple shelters both Hindu and Jain idols. In the town itself the Bada Mandir houses an image older than its present building, which was raised in a Mughal-influenced style. Bhilsa's position on the northern trade routes exposed it to repeated conquest: Iltutmish of Delhi stormed it in 1233, Alauddin Khalji sacked it in 1293, and Bahadur Shah of Gujarat plundered it in 1532, after which it passed to the Malwa sultans, the Mughals and the Scindias, while the old Jain temples on its outskirts survived the changing rulers.
zh: 毗提舍即中世纪的比尔沙城，地处东摩腊婆，被耆那教列为古老圣地“补罗那契多罗”之一，因为相传这里是第十代祖师湿多罗那陀的诞生地。当地最古老的殿宇可追溯至9至10世纪，正值中印度普罗蒂诃罗与波罗摩罗两大建筑流派兴盛之时。在吉亚拉斯布尔，凿岩而建、奉祀阿底那特的摩罗提毗寺，以及由婆罗门教日神庙改为供奉祖师像的巴阇罗摩特寺，都保存着大量精美的祖师雕刻；巴多赫的波塔里亚建筑群则以一座带尖塔的主殿为中心，汇集了同期的二十五座庙宇；伽达尔摩罗寺更是印度教与耆那教神像共处一殿。城内的大巴达寺所藏神像比殿宇本身更为古老，现存建筑带有莫卧儿风格。比尔沙扼守北方商路，因而一再易主：德里的伊勒杜迷失于1233年攻破此城，阿拉乌德丁·卡尔吉1293年纵兵劫掠，古吉拉特的巴哈杜尔沙又于1532年洗劫此地，此后它先后归属摩腊婆苏丹、莫卧儿与辛迪亚家族，而城郊的古老耆那寺庙在历代统治者更迭中存留了下来。

en: The Vilwadrinatha Temple stands at Thiruvilwamala, on a hundred-foot hillock above the Bharathappuzha river in the Malabar interior, and is dedicated to Rama, the seventh avatar of Vishnu, together with his brother Lakshmana, whose idol is rare in Indian temples. Counted among the Abhimana Kshetrams of Vaishnavite tradition, it is one of the four great Rama temples of Kerala. It was first administered by five Moosad families, the Parasudayavar, who traced their rights to the sage Parashurama; in 392 the Chera king Cheraman Perumal granted its lands to the Perumpadappu rulers, who enlarged the estate and left worship to a twice-yearly assembly called the mahayogam. The temple later passed to the Zamorins of Kozhikode and, after prolonged wars between the two courts, to the kings of Kochi, under whom it remained a leading pilgrimage centre of the region.
zh: 鼻缚陀梨那他神庙坐落于马拉巴尔内陆蒂鲁维尔瓦马拉的一座百尺高丘上，俯瞰巴拉塔普扎河，供奉毗湿奴的第七化身罗摩及其弟罗什曼那，庙中的罗什曼那神像在印度十分罕见。它被列为毗湿奴派传统中的自重圣地之一，也是喀拉拉四大罗摩神庙之一。神庙最初由五个穆萨德家族，即持斧者家族管理，他们把治庙之权追溯到仙人持斧罗摩；392年，哲罗国王切拉曼·佩鲁马尔将庙产赐给佩鲁姆帕杜普的统治者，后者扩大了庙地，并把庙务交由每年两次的大会议主持。神庙后来转归科泽科德的扎莫林，在两邦长期交战之后又落入科契国王之手，始终是该地区首屈一指的朝圣中心。

en: The Vimala Temple stands inside the great Jagannath Temple complex at Puri on the Odisha coast, and although it is only a small shrine beside the main tower, Shakta and Tantric worshippers revere it as one of the holiest Shakti Pithas dedicated to the Goddess. Its central icon of Vimala, the tantric consort of Jagannath, dates to the 500s, while the sandstone and laterite Deula-style building now standing was probably raised in the 800s under the Eastern Ganga dynasty, perhaps on the ruins of an older Somavashi shrine; temple tradition credits the Somavashi king Yayati Keshari with its foundation. The philosopher Adi Shankara is said to have made Vimala the presiding goddess of his Govardhana matha at Puri. Devotees visit Vimala before Jagannath, and food offered to Jagannath becomes Mahaprasad only after it is also offered to her. A sixteen-day Durga Puja culminating in Vijayadashami is held here every autumn.
zh: 毗摩罗神庙坐落于奥里萨沿海古城补梨的札格纳特神庙建筑群内，虽只是主塔旁的一座小殿，却被性力派和密教信徒尊为奉祀女神的至神圣地性力佩特之一。庙中毗摩罗女神——札格纳特的密教法侣——的主像可追溯至6世纪，现存以砂岩和红土岩建成的德乌拉风格建筑约建于9世纪东恒伽王朝时期，可能坐落在索马万什王朝旧庙的废墟之上，庙方传统则将建庙之功归于索马万什国王耶耶迪·凯沙里。哲学家商羯罗据传以毗摩罗为其在补梨所建戈瓦尔达摩特的主神。信徒须先拜毗摩罗再拜札格纳特，献给札格纳特的食物也只有再供奉过她之后才算圣食。每年秋季这里举行长达十六天的难近母节，以十胜日庆典收尾。

en: The Vinayaka Temple, formally the Sri Varasidhi Vinayaka Swamy Temple, is a Ganesha shrine at Kanipakam in the Chittoor district of Andhra Pradesh, about sixty-eight kilometres from the great temple city of Tirupati. Its Ganesha is said to dwell in a well that never runs dry: legend tells of three brothers, one mute, one deaf and one blind, who struck a hard object while digging, saw blood well up and were cured of their disabilities, after which the villagers uncovered the image but could never find its base. The stone temple was founded under the Chola emperor Kulottunga I, who reigned from 1070 to 1120, and enlarged in 1336 by the emperors of Vijayanagara. Piety held that the image was slowly growing in its well, so that ever less of it could be seen above the water.
zh: 毗那夜迦神庙正式名称为室利·瓦拉悉提·毗那夜迦斯瓦米神庙，是安得拉邦奇图尔县卡尼帕卡姆的一座伽内什神庙，距大圣城蒂鲁帕蒂约六十八公里。庙中的伽内什相传居于一口永不干涸的井中：传说有三兄弟分别为哑、聋、盲，挖井时农具撞到硬物，井水涌血，三人的残疾随即痊愈；村民随后发现了这尊神像，却始终挖不到它的底座。这座石庙由朱罗皇帝库洛通加一世（1070—1120年在位）敕建，1336年毗奢耶那伽罗皇帝又加以扩建。信众相信井中的神像在不断长大，水面之上能见到的部分越来越少。

en: The Vishalakshi Temple stands near Mir Ghat in Varanasi, a short walk from the Kashi Vishwanath Temple, and is dedicated to Parvati worshipped under the epithet Vishalakshi, the wide-eyed goddess. Hindu tradition counts it among the fifty-one Shakti Peethas: when Vishnu dismembered the body of Sati, the gem of her right earring is said to have fallen here, so the goddess is also called Manikarni Devi, while Kaal Bhairav is venerated as the peetha's guardian. The Tantric Rudrayamala, composed before 1052, already names Varanasi among the ten principal Shakti Peethas, and the Skanda Purana's Kashi Khanda tells how Vishalakshi appeared as a housewife to feed the sage Vyasa when the whole city refused him alms. Together with the Vishwanath temple, the Ganges and the Kala Bhairava temple it forms one of the six sites of Varanasi's Shastanga yoga pilgrimage. The present building was rebuilt in the nineteenth century by Nattukottai Nagarathar merchants from Tamil Nadu, blending a haveli-like North Indian plan with a small Dravidian gopura, and its chief festival is Kajali Teej.
zh: 宽目女神庙坐落于瓦拉纳西的米尔河阶附近，距迦尸·毗湿瓦纳特神庙不远，供奉以“宽目”为号的帕尔瓦蒂女神。印度教传统将它列为五十一座性力圣地之一：传说毗湿奴肢解萨蒂遗体时，她右耳环上的宝石坠落于此，因此女神又称摩尼格尔尼女神，圣地的守护男神则是迦罗·拜拉弗。成书不晚于1052年的怛特罗经典《鲁陀罗夜密续》已把瓦拉纳西列为十大性力圣地之一；《室建陀往世书》的《迦尸篇》还讲到，全城无人愿意布施时，宽目女神化身为主妇向仙人毗耶娑奉上食物。它与毗湿瓦纳特神庙、恒河、迦罗·拜拉弗神庙等共同构成瓦拉纳西六处“六支瑜伽”巡礼地。现存殿宇是19世纪由泰米尔纳德的纳图科泰·纳加拉塔尔商帮重建的，建筑融合了北印度宅院式布局与一座小型达罗毗荼式塔门，主要节庆为卡加利·蒂吉节。

en: The Vithoba Temple, formally the Shri Vitthal-Rukmini Mandir, stands at Pandharpur in southern Maharashtra on the bank of the Chandrabhaga River and is the chief shrine of Vithoba, a standing form of Vishnu, worshipped together with his consort Rakhumai. A small shrine existed on the site by 1189, and Hoysala inscriptions of 1237 and 1273 to 1277 record royal grants and the building of the present temple, which tradition credits to King Vishnuvardhana acting on the counsel of the devotee Pundalik. From the 1200s the shrine became the heart of the Warkari bhakti movement, whose poet-saints Jnaneshwar, Namdev, Eknath and Tukaram sang in Marathi, and pilgrim bands called dindi march to Pandharpur for the Aashadhi and Kartiki Ekadashi festivals. Much of the standing structure dates to the 1600s in the later Deccan style, and when Afzal Khan moved against the temple in the mid-1600s its priests hid the original image so that the central idol survived.
zh: 鼻多呼婆神庙正式名称为“室利·维塔尔—鲁格米尼神庙”，位于南马哈拉施特拉潘达尔普尔的旃陀罗跋伽河畔，是毗湿奴的站立化身维塔尔（鼻多呼婆）与其配偶拉库迈的主庙。1189年此地已有小型神龛，1237年及1273至1277年的霍伊萨拉铭文记载了王室赐地和现存神庙的修建；传统认为庙是毗湿奴瓦尔达纳王受虔信者本达利克劝化而建。13世纪起，这里成为瓦尔卡里虔信运动的中心，诗人圣徒贾涅什瓦尔、纳姆德夫、埃克纳特和图卡拉姆都用马拉地语为其颂诗；每逢阿沙迪与卡尔提卡两节的十一日，成群的“丁迪”朝圣者便步行赶往潘达尔普尔。现存建筑多为17世纪所建，属后期德干风格；17世纪中叶阿夫扎尔汗图谋毁庙时，祭司藏起原像，使主像得以保全。

en: Wak'a Pukllana is a great adobe and clay pyramid of seven staggered platforms, rising twenty-two metres in the Rímac valley on the central Peruvian coast. Its Quechua name joins wak'a, a sacred shrine of a protector deity, with pukllana, a place of games or rituals. Between about 200 and 700 it was the chief ceremonial and administrative centre of the Lima culture, whose priestly elite built the Great Pyramid to display their power over the valley's fresh and salt water; deep pits in its plaza received offerings of fish and other marine produce, while a walled second quarter housed the administration. Wari materials and an intact elite tomb, the Lord of the Unkus, show that the shrine remained in use under Wari influence until about 1000. After the Wari collapse the Ichma kingdom formed around 1100 and spread into the Rímac valley, keeping old wak'a such as this one in use, and when the Inca absorbed the Ichma around 1469 the shrine entered the empire's network of sacred sites, overseen alongside the great oracle of Pachacamac nearby.
zh: 普拉那圣所是一座由七层错落台基构成的巨型土坯黏土金字塔，高二十二米，坐落在秘鲁中部沿海的里马克河谷。其克丘亚语名称由 wak'a（守护神灵的圣所）与 pukllana（举行仪式或竞技之处）组合而成。约200年至700年间，它是利马文化最重要的仪式与行政中心：祭司精英修建大金字塔，以彰显其掌控河谷淡水与咸水资源的权力；广场上的深坑用来盛放鱼类和其他海产祭品，围墙隔开的另一区则是官署。瓦里文化的遗物和保存完好的精英墓葬“温库斯之主”表明，在瓦里文化影响下该圣所一直使用到约1000年。瓦里帝国崩溃后，伊什马王国约于1100年形成并向北扩展到里马克河谷，继续沿用这类古老圣所；约1469年印加兼并伊什马，这座圣所随之并入帝国的圣地网络，与附近的帕查卡马克大神谕所一同受到管理。

en: Wayna Qhari, often spelled Huanacaure or Wanakawri, is a four-thousand-and-eighty-nine-metre mountain south of Cusco, its Quechua name meaning strong young man, and the archaeological remains on its summit made it one of the most important wak'as of the Inca world. Its sanctity went back to the dynasty's own foundation legend: of the Ayar siblings who came out of the cave at Paqariq Tampu, the brother Ayar Uchu chose to stay on this hill as a stone idol so that he could speak with their father the Sun and intercede for the lineage. The story told how he flew up toward the heavens, returned to tell Ayar Manco that he must take the name Manco Cápac, and then turned into stone with his wings still spread. The petrified ancestor thus became the guardian wak'a of the new Cusco dynasty and a station in the solar ritual landscape around the capital, visited by rulers and pilgrims until the Spanish conquest of Cusco in 1533, after which the chroniclers Pedro Cieza de León and Bernabé Cobo recorded its fame while the shrines on the summit fell into ruin.
zh: 瓦纳考里山（又译瓦纳考里、瓜纳考里）是库斯科以南一座海拔4089米的高山，克丘亚语名意为“强壮的青年”；山顶的考古遗存使它成为印加世界最重要的圣所之一。它的神圣性源于王朝本身的起源传说：从帕卡里坦博洞穴走出的阿亚尔兄弟姐妹中，弟弟阿亚尔·乌丘选择留在这座山上化为石像，以便与他们的父亲太阳对话、为整个氏族祈福。传说他先振翅高飞直上云霄，返回后告知阿亚尔·曼科必须改称曼科·卡帕克，随后便带着展开的双翼变成石头。这位石化的祖先由此成为库斯科新王朝的守护圣所，也是都城周边太阳祭祀景观中的重要一站，历代君主与朝圣者皆来祭拜，直到1533年西班牙征服库斯科。此后编年史家佩德罗·谢萨·德·莱昂和贝尔纳韦·科博记下了它的声名，山顶的诸圣所却逐渐倾颓。

en: The basilica of Our Lady of the Pillar stands on the bank of the Ebro in Zaragoza, the co-cathedral of the city alongside the older La Seo. Tradition holds that on 2 January in the year 40 the Virgin Mary appeared there to the apostle James the Great while he preached in Roman Spain, giving him a jasper column and bidding him build a church on the spot; the little chapel that followed was reputedly the first church anywhere dedicated to Mary, and the pillar and its image were preserved through the centuries of Muslim rule. After Alfonso I of Aragon reconquered Zaragoza in 1118 a Romanesque church arose, and Bishop Pedro de Librana left the oldest written record of the cult. A fire in 1434 forced a rebuilding in Mudéjar Gothic form, which kept the alabaster altarpiece carved by Damián Forment. The present vast Baroque church was begun in 1681 under Charles II; Ventura Rodríguez designed the Holy Chapel that houses the venerated statue in 1754, and Francisco de Goya later painted frescoes on its domes. Saints such as Ignatius of Loyola, Teresa of Ávila and John of the Cross came as pilgrims to the pillar.
zh: 比拉尔圣母圣殿矗立在萨拉戈萨的埃布罗河畔，与更古老的拉塞奥主教座堂并列为该市的共同主教座堂。相传40年1月2日，使徒大雅各在罗马统治下的西班牙传教时，圣母马利亚向他显现，交给他一根碧玉柱，嘱他在此建堂；随后建起的小堂被认为是世界上第一座奉圣母为主保的教堂，石柱与圣母像在穆斯林统治的数百年间也得以保全。阿拉贡国王阿方索一世于1118年收复萨拉戈萨后，这里建起一座罗马式教堂，主教佩德罗·德·利夫拉纳留下了关于这一圣母崇拜最早的文字记载。1434年的一场火灾迫使教堂按穆德哈尔哥特风格重建，达米安·福尔门特雕刻的雪花石膏祭坛屏饰也保留了下来。这座宏伟的巴洛克教堂于1681年在卡洛斯二世治下动工；文图拉·罗德里格斯于1754年设计了安放圣母像的圣小堂，后来弗朗西斯科·德·戈雅又在穹顶上绘制湿壁画。依纳爵·罗耀拉、阿维拉的特蕾莎和十字若望等圣人都曾来石柱前朝圣。

en: Al-Zaytuna, the Mosque of the Olive, is the oldest mosque in Tunis, standing at the heart of its medina on the site of a former Byzantine building, perhaps a church. Tradition ascribes its foundation in 698 to Hasan ibn al-Nu'man, the conqueror of Carthage, making it the second mosque of Ifriqiya after the one at Kairouan; the Umayyad governor Ubayd Allah ibn al-Habhab rebuilt it around 732. Its present form dates to the Aghlabid reconstruction completed in 864 or 865 under Emir Abu Ibrahim Ahmad, whose builders reused hundreds of antique columns from the ruins of Carthage and followed the layout of the Mosque of Uqba. The Zirids added the courtyard galleries and the Qubbat al-Bahu dome in 991. Under the Hafsids, who made Tunis their capital, the mosque overtook Kairouan as the foremost seat of learning in the Maghreb: al-Mustansir restored it in 1250 and its first recorded minaret went up in 1438 and 1439. In 1534 Spanish troops sacked its libraries and scattered its manuscripts, but the Ottoman Muradid and Husaynid dynasties restored its teaching role, and the Bakri family supplied its imams from 1624 to 1812.
zh: 宰图纳大清真寺意为“橄榄清真寺”，是突尼斯城最古老的清真寺，坐落于老城中心，其地原为一座拜占庭建筑，可能是一座教堂。相传它是698年由征服迦太基的将领哈桑·伊本·努阿曼奠基，是伊夫里奇亚继凯鲁万之后的第二座清真寺；倭马亚王朝总督欧贝杜拉·伊本·哈卜哈卜约在732年将其重建。它现存的形制来自阿格拉布王朝的重建，工程在埃米尔阿布·易卜拉欣·艾哈迈德治下于864年或865年完工，工匠们从迦太基废墟中拆用了数百根古代石柱，布局则效仿乌克巴大清真寺。991年，齐尔王朝增建了庭院回廊和巴胡穹顶。哈夫斯王朝以突尼斯为都后，这座清真寺取代凯鲁万，成为马格里布首屈一指的学府：穆斯坦绥尔于1250年加以修缮，有记载的第一座宣礼塔则建于1438年至1439年。1534年，西班牙军队洗劫了它的藏书室，手稿散佚损毁；奥斯曼时期的穆拉德王朝和侯赛因王朝先后恢复了它的教学地位，1624年至1812年间，巴克利家族世代担任该寺伊玛目。

en: Abenakian is the Eastern Algonquian speech of the Wabanaki peoples of northern New England and the Canadian Maritimes, a dialect chain in which Eastern and Western Abenaki, Penobscot, Passamaquoddy, Wolastoqiyik and Mi'kmaq stayed mutually intelligible; its speakers call themselves Wôbanakiak, People of the Dawn Land, and the polysynthetic language packs whole sentences into single words. Samuel de Champlain met Abenaki farmers on the Kennebec river in 1604, and the English word skunk was borrowed from their speech in the 1630s. Epidemics and pressure from English settlements drove many Abenaki under French protection from 1669, when missions were founded at Odanak on the Saint Francis river and at Wôlinak near Bécancour, where Jesuits recorded the Caniba and Arosagunticook dialects in grammars and word lists. Allied with the French, they raided the English frontier through King Philip's War of 1675 and Queen Anne's War, until the Jesuit Sébastien Rale was killed at Norridgewock in 1724 and the Abenaki wars ended the following year.
zh: 阿贝纳基语是新英格兰北部与加拿大滨海地区瓦巴纳基诸族使用的东阿尔冈昆语言，是一条方言连续体，其中东西两支阿贝纳基方言与佩诺布斯科特语、帕萨马科迪语、沃拉斯托基约克语、米克马克语彼此大致相通；使用者自称沃巴纳基阿克人，意为“黎明之地的人”。这种多式综合语能把整句话压缩进一个词。1604年，塞缪尔·德·尚普兰在肯纳贝克河畔见到务农的阿贝纳基人；17世纪30年代，英语的“臭鼬”一词便借自他们的语言。疫病和英国定居者的挤压迫使许多阿贝纳基人从1669年起投入法国庇护之下，法国在圣弗朗西斯河畔的奥达纳克和贝坎库尔附近的沃利纳克建立传教站，耶稣会士用语法书和词表记录了卡尼巴、阿罗萨贡蒂库克等方言。他们与法国结盟，在1675年的菲利普国王战争和后来的安妮女王战争中不断袭击英国边疆，直到耶稣会士塞巴斯蒂安·拉勒于1724年在诺里奇沃克被杀，阿贝纳基诸战于次年告终。

en: Abun, called Anden by its own speakers and Yimbun by the neighbouring Mpur, is a Papuan language of the northern coast of the Bird's Head Peninsula, spoken in eighteen villages around Sausapor in the Tambrauw region. It has no demonstrated relatives: Malcolm Ross placed it tentatively in the West Papuan family on pronoun evidence, but most reference works list it as a language isolate. Abun is a tonal language whose three old lexical tones have shrunk to two, and it splits into four dialects, Abun Tat, Abun Ye and the two Abun Ji varieties distinguished by their use of r or l, which form a continuum of mutual intelligibility. The seafaring Biak know it as Karon Pantai, a derogatory exonym, and long contact with Biak traders and settlers left a layer of Austronesian maritime vocabulary in the language, evidence of the coast's place in regional exchange. The Abun country is bordered by Moi to the southwest, Moraid and the Karon Dori dialect of Maybrat to the south and Mpur to the east. From the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries the Bird's Head coasts were pulled into the Sultanate of Tidore's tribute system, bound by the legendary alliance between the Biak leader Gurabesi and Sultan Al-Mansur, and the Spanish expedition of Luís Vaz de Torres sailed these waters in 1606; Abun villages kept their own speech and customs under this loose, coast-focused overlordship.
zh: 阿本语在母语者口中称 Anden，邻近的姆普尔人称之为 Yimbun，是鸟头半岛北海岸的巴布亚语言，通行于坦布劳地区绍萨波尔周围的十八个村庄。它没有已证实的亲属语言：马尔科姆·罗斯根据代词证据暂时把它归入西巴布亚语系，但多数参考书仍将其列为孤立语言。阿本语是声调语言，原有的三个词汇声调已缩减为两个；它分为四种方言——阿本-塔特、阿本-耶，以及靠 r 和 l 之分的两种阿本-吉，彼此构成互通程度渐变的方言连续体。航海的比亚克人贬称它为“海岸卡龙”，而与比亚克商人、定居者的长期接触为这种语言留下了一层南岛语航海词汇，印证了这片海岸在区域交流中的位置。阿本语地区西南邻莫伊语，南邻莫赖德语和梅布拉特语的卡龙-多里方言，东邻姆普尔语。从15至16世纪起，鸟头半岛沿海被卷入蒂多雷苏丹国的朝贡体系，其纽带是比亚克首领古拉贝西与苏丹阿尔-曼苏尔之间传说中的联盟；1606年，路易斯·瓦斯·德·托雷斯的西班牙探险队驶过这片水域。在这种以沿海为重心的松散宗主权下，阿本村庄保留了自己的语言和风俗。

en: Adamawa is the conventional name for a loose group of eighty to ninety languages scattered over the Adamawa Plateau and the surrounding country of northern Cameroon, the south of Chad, the east of Nigeria and the north-west of the Central African Republic. The largest member is Mumuye; many of the others are small, little-described tongues. Joseph Greenberg assembled them into an Adamawa branch of the Niger–Congo family, though later linguists have treated them as more of a geographic grouping than a true family, some branches lying closer to Gur. For most of history their speakers lived in decentralised farming and pastoral communities between Hausaland and the Bornu and Mandara states. In 1809 Modibo Adama, a follower of Usman dan Fodio, carried the Fulani jihad into these lands and founded the Adamawa Emirate within the Sokoto Caliphate, drawing the plateau's peoples into the world of Muslim cavalry states and long-distance slave raiding.
zh: 阿达马瓦语是对八九十种关系松散的语言的统称，它们散布在阿达马瓦高原及周边地带，包括喀麦隆北部、乍得南部、尼日利亚东部和中非共和国西北部。其中最大的是穆穆耶语，其余多是使用人数很少、记录有限的语言。约瑟夫·格林伯格曾把它们归为尼日尔—刚果语系下的阿达马瓦语支，但后来的语言学家多认为它更像地理分组而非真正的语族，其中有些分支与古尔语更近。在历史上的大部分时间里，说这些语言的族群以分散的农耕和游牧社群生活，夹在豪萨兰与博尔努、曼达拉等政权之间。1809年，乌斯曼·丹·福迪奥的追随者莫迪博·阿达马把富拉尼圣战带入这片土地，在索科托哈里发国之内建立阿达马瓦酋长国，使高原各族进入穆斯林骑兵政权和长途奴隶劫掠的世界。

en: Adharic is the North-Western Iranian subgroup named after Adhari, or Old Azeri, the Iranian speech of the Azerbaijan region before the spread of Turkic. Medieval Arab geographers such as al-Masudi knew it as al-adhariya and found it hard to understand, and the peasant rebels who followed Babak in the 800s spoke its dialects. From the 1000s the Seljuk advance brought Turkic tribes into Azerbaijan, and Adhari lost its majority position by the end of the 1300s, lingering in mountain enclaves into the 1600s before giving way to Azerbaijani Turkic. Its living relatives carry on the same line: Talysh of the south-western Caspian shore in Gilan and Ardabil, which Hamdallah Mustawfi in the 1330s described as a Pahlavi-type tongue and which survives in the quatrains of Sheikh Safi of Ardabil, who died in 1334; Tati dialects such as Harzandi; and Zazaki in eastern Anatolia, whose archaic grammar has been argued to be a relic of Parthian.
zh: 阿扎里克语是西北伊朗语的一个子群，得名于阿扎里语，即突厥语传播之前阿塞拜疆地区的伊朗语，今称古阿塞拜疆语。马苏迪等中世纪阿拉伯地理学家称其为“阿扎里耶”，觉得它晦涩难懂；9世纪追随巴贝克起事的农民就说它的各方言。从11世纪起，塞尔柱人的推进把突厥部落带入阿塞拜疆，阿扎里语到14世纪末失去多数语言的地位，在山地飞地中残存到17世纪，最终让位于阿塞拜疆突厥语。与它同源的活语言延续着这条支系：通行于里海西南岸吉兰和阿尔达比勒的塔利希语，穆斯塔菲在14世纪30年代曾把这一带的语言描述为巴列维型语言，1334年去世的阿尔达比勒谢赫·萨非的四行诗中也保留着它的面貌；哈尔赞迪语等塔蒂方言；以及安纳托利亚东部的扎扎其语，其古老语法被认为可能是帕提亚语的遗存。

en: Afghani is the name used in Persian historical writings for the Eastern Iranian language otherwise known as Pashto, the mother tongue of the Pashtun tribes of southern and eastern Afghanistan and the Peshawar valley. Its verse grew from an oral tradition of short tappa lyrics, with the earliest named poet, Amir Kror Suri, placed in the 700s. The language first acquired a settled written form in the 1500s through Bayazid Pir Roshan of Waziristan, who devised a 41-letter Perso-Arabic alphabet for his Roshani movement and composed Khair-ul-Bayan, one of its earliest prose works; the scholar Akhund Darweza answered his teachings with Makhzanul Islam. Northern and southern dialects differ chiefly in pronunciation, and the 1600s brought a literary golden age under the warrior-poet Khushal Khan Khattak, called the father of Pashto literature, and the Sufi poet Rahman Baba, who died in 1706. Persian long remained the language of courts and government, leaving Afghani as the living speech of tribe and camp.
zh: 阿富汗语是波斯历史文献对今普什图语的称呼，属于东伊朗语，是阿富汗南部、东部以及白沙瓦河谷普什图诸部的母语。它的诗歌源于口头短诗“塔帕”的传统，最早留名的诗人是8世纪的阿米尔·克罗尔·苏里。16世纪，瓦济里斯坦的巴亚齐德·皮尔·罗山首次为它确立稳定的书写形式：他为自己的罗沙尼运动设计了一套41个字母的波斯—阿拉伯字母，并写成最早的普什图语散文著作之一《海尔·巴扬》；学者阿洪德·达尔韦扎则著《伊斯兰宝库》回应他的学说。阿富汗语分南北方言，差别主要在发音；17世纪迎来文学黄金时代，被誉为普什图文学之父的战士诗人胡沙尔·汗·哈塔克，以及1706年去世的苏菲派诗人拉赫曼·巴巴是其中代表。长期以来波斯语垄断着宫廷和政府，阿富汗语则始终是部落与营地之间鲜活的口头语言。

en: The Agaw languages, also called Central Cushitic, are a branch of the Afroasiatic family spoken across the Ethiopian highlands from Lake Tana to Lasta, with Bilen reaching into Eritrea and the eastern Sudan. Their main members are Awngi, the largest, spoken south-west of Lake Tana; Xamtanga in the North Amhara Region; Bilen around the Eritrean town of Keren; and the nearly extinct Qimant, whose Qwara and Kayla dialects were once spoken by the Beta Israel. Agaw speech forms the chief substratum of Amharic and the other Ethio-Semitic languages, which absorbed much of its vocabulary as Semitic spread through the highlands. In the twelfth century Agaw chiefs of Lasta founded the Zagwe dynasty, which ruled the Christian kingdom of Ethiopia from highland capitals until 1270; its best-remembered king, Lalibela, gave his name to the rock-hewn churches, and succession followed the Agaw custom of brother succeeding brother. After the Zagwe fall the Agaw kept their tongues in remote highland districts such as Wag and the country around Lake Tana.
zh: 阿高语又称中库希特语，是亚非语系的一支，通行于埃塞俄比亚高原上从塔纳湖到拉斯塔一带，其中比伦语还延伸到厄立特里亚和苏丹东部。主要语言包括塔纳湖西南、使用人数最多的阿翁吉语，北阿姆哈拉地区的哈姆坦加语，克伦一带的比伦语，以及几近消亡的克曼特语——其夸拉方言和凯拉方言曾由贝塔以色列人使用。阿高语是阿姆哈拉语等埃塞俄比亚闪米特语的主要底层语言，后者随闪米特语在高原扩散，吸收了它的大量词汇。12世纪，拉斯塔的阿高首领建立扎格维王朝，以高原诸城为都，统治基督教埃塞俄比亚王国直至1270年；王朝最著名的国王拉利贝拉留下了以他命名的整岩凿成教堂群，王位则按阿高人的习俗兄终弟及。扎格维王朝覆灭后，阿高人在瓦格、塔纳湖周边等偏远高原地区继续使用自己的语言。

en: Aikanã is a language isolate spoken by the Aikanã people of Rondônia in western Brazil, around the Corumbiara and Tubarão rivers, where they live alongside Kwaza-speaking communities. Also recorded under the names Tubarão, Corumbiara and Huari, it has a subject–object–verb word order and shows only contact-induced similarities with the neighbouring isolates Kanoê and Kwaza.
zh: 艾卡纳语是巴西西部朗多尼亚州艾卡纳人使用的一种孤立语言，分布在科伦比阿拉河与图巴朗河一带，与说夸扎语的群体相邻而居。它也曾被记作图巴朗语、科伦比阿拉语或瓦里语，语序为主宾动，与邻近的卡诺埃语、夸扎语等孤立语言仅有因接触产生的相似之处。

en: A'ingae, also called Cofán, is the language of the A'i people living between the Guamués and Aguarico rivers in the foothills where the Andes meet the Amazon, in northeastern Ecuador and southern Colombia. The name means in the manner of the people, from a'i, person; once linked to Chibchan or other Andean groupings, it is now treated as a language isolate, though it carries borrowings from Tukanoan, Cariban and Quechuan. Inca pressure had already driven the A'i from the cordillera into the lowlands, and in the late sixteenth century they destroyed the Spanish town of Mocoa and forced the colonists to withdraw; the Jesuit Rafael Ferrer, who arrived in 1602, was likewise driven out. Epidemics cut the people from some fifteen thousand to a few hundred, but the language remained the foundation of Cofán identity through the colonial centuries.
zh: 科凡语又称科凡人的语言，自称阿依语，是阿依人的语言，通行于厄瓜多尔东北部和哥伦比亚南部、安第斯山脉与亚马孙雨林相接处的瓜穆埃斯河与阿瓜里科河之间。其名称由意为“人”的“阿依”派生，意思是“按人的方式说的话”。它过去曾被归入奇布查语系或其他安第斯语群，现在被视为孤立语言，但吸收了不少图卡诺语、加勒比语和克丘亚语的借词。印加人的逼迫早已把阿依人从山脉赶入低地；16世纪末，他们又摧毁西班牙人的莫科阿镇，迫使殖民者撤退，1602年抵达的耶稣会士拉斐尔·费雷尔同样被赶走。瘟疫使科凡人从约一万五千人锐减到几百人，但在整个殖民时代，这门语言始终是科凡认同的根基。

en: Ainu is the language of the Ainu people of Hokkaido, southern Sakhalin and the Kuril Islands, and forms a small language family on its own, with Hokkaido, Sakhalin and Kuril varieties; no link to any other family has ever been demonstrated. Place-name evidence suggests it was once spoken farther south in northern Honshu, perhaps by the Emishi, and that the familiar -betsu ending of northern Japanese river names comes from the Ainu word pet, meaning river. The word aynu itself means person. From the 1300s Ainu met Japanese traders and settlers and took in many Japanese loanwords while giving a few in return, among them the Japanese words for sea otter, reindeer and salmon; it also exchanged vocabulary with the neighboring Nivkh. Its classical form, preserved in oral epics, was a polysynthetic language incorporating nouns and adverbs into long verbs, with subject-object-verb order and postpositions. It had no native script and was later written down in a modified Japanese katakana syllabary and in Latin letters, and on Sakhalin it long served as a lingua franca used by Japanese and Russian officials as well as local peoples.
zh: 阿伊努语是北海道、萨哈林岛南部和千岛群岛的阿伊努人的语言，本身构成一个小语系，分为北海道、萨哈林和千岛三个分支，迄今未能证明它与任何其他语系有亲缘关系。地名证据显示，阿伊努语一度通行于更南的本州北部，可能是虾夷人的语言；日本北部常见的河名后缀-betsu就来自阿伊努语意为河流的pet一词。aynu这个自称的含义正是“人”。阿伊努人自14世纪起与日本人接触，阿伊努语吸收了大量日语借词，也有少量词反向进入日语，日语中的海獭、驯鹿和鲑鱼等词即来自阿伊努语；它还与邻近的尼夫赫语互有借词。见于口传史诗的古典阿伊努语是多式综合语，可把名词和副词并入冗长的动词，语序为主宾动，使用后置词。它没有本族文字，后来才以改造的日语片假名和拉丁字母记录；在萨哈林岛，它长期充当通用语，日本和俄罗斯官员与当地各族都借助它沟通。

en: Ajië, also called Houailou or Wailu and recorded as Wai or A'jie, is a Kanak language of the Austronesian family spoken around Houaïlou, Kouaoua and Poya on the east-central coast of Grande Terre, the main island of New Caledonia. It is the principal language of the Wailic branch of the southern New Caledonian languages, which form part of the Southern Oceanic group. Like the other Kanak tongues it descends from the speech of the Lapita voyagers who founded their first coastal settlements in New Caledonia around 1100 BC. James Cook sighted Grande Terre in September 1774 and named it New Caledonia; the Comte de Lapérouse reconnoitred the west coast in 1788, and from 1793 English whalers mapped the Loyalty Islands, though contacts with the archipelago remained sporadic for decades. Ajië had no native script and was carried entirely by oral tradition throughout this period.
zh: 阿杰语又称瓦伊卢语，也记作瓦伊语或阿杰耶语，是新喀里多尼亚主岛格朗德特尔岛中东部沿海瓦伊卢、夸瓦和波亚一带通行的卡纳克语言，属南岛语系。它是新喀里多尼亚南部语言瓦伊卢语支的主要语言，该语支隶属于南大洋洲语群。与其他卡纳克语言一样，阿杰语源自拉皮塔航海者的语言，他们约在公元前1100年开始在新喀里多尼亚沿海建立定居点。1774年9月詹姆斯·库克望见格朗德特尔岛，并将其命名为新喀里多尼亚；1788年拉彼鲁兹伯爵考察了西海岸，1793年起英国捕鲸人测绘了洛亚蒂群岛，但此后数十年间与该群岛的接触仍只是零星发生。在这一时期，阿杰语没有本土文字，完全依靠口传传承。

en: Akei, also called Tasiriki, is an Oceanic language of the Austronesian family spoken along the southwestern coast of Espiritu Santo in Vanuatu and centred on the village of Tasiriki, a name meaning small water from the words for water and small. It is grouped with Wailapa in the Southwest Santo subgroup of the West Santo languages, part of the North-Central Vanuatu branch, and is one of more than thirty languages recorded on the island alone. Scholars sometimes treat Akei not as a separate language but as a dialect of a proposed Southwest Santo language shared with Araki and Tangoa, or describe it as a dialect chain whose varieties at the two ends are no longer mutually intelligible; it is known by many local names, among them Navaka, Marino, Pilipili and Wailapa. The Spanish expedition of Pedro Fernandes de Queirós reached Espiritu Santo in 1606, and after a long interval Louis de Bougainville visited in 1768 and James Cook in 1774, when the archipelago received the European name New Hebrides.
zh: 阿凯伊语又称塔西里基语，是南岛语系大洋洲语族的语言，通行于瓦努阿图圣埃斯皮里图岛西南沿海，以塔西里基村为中心；塔西里基在当地话中意为“小水”，由表示水和表示小的两个词合成。在北中瓦努阿图分支的西桑托语群中，它与怀拉帕语同属西南桑托次语群；全岛有记录的语言超过三十种，阿凯伊语便是其中之一。学者有时不把它看作独立语言，而视为与阿拉基语、坦戈阿语同属一个拟构的西南桑托语言的方言，或称其为一条方言链，链条两端的话已经不能互通；它还有纳瓦卡、马里诺、皮利皮利、怀拉帕等一串地方别名。1606年，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的西班牙探险队抵达圣埃斯皮里图岛；相隔很久之后，路易·德·布干维尔于1768年、詹姆斯·库克于1774年先后来访，库克将这片群岛命名为新赫布里底群岛。

en: Alanic was an Eastern Iranian language, descended from the Scytho-Sarmatian dialects of the Pontic steppe and spoken by the Alans from roughly the first to the thirteenth century. In 409 one branch of the people rode west with the Vandals into Iberia and on to the Maghreb, while the main body settled in the northern Caucasus, where their kingdom survived into the Middle Ages. Byzantine authors preserved only fragments of the speech, yet the Zelenchuk inscription and the report of William of Rubruck show that by the tenth to thirteenth centuries Alanic was being written in a Greek-based alphabet. After the Mongols overran the Alan state in 1240, its mountain-dwelling descendants became the Ossetians and their language evolved into Ossetian; a related dialect, Jassic, was carried to Hungary by the Jasz in the thirteenth century and survived there for two centuries before assimilation.
zh: 阿兰语是一种东伊朗语言，由黑海北岸草原的斯基泰—萨尔马提亚方言发展而来，约在1世纪至13世纪间为阿兰人使用。409年，阿兰人的一支随汪达尔人西迁，进入伊比利亚再转战马格里布；主体则定居北高加索，其王国延续到中世纪。拜占庭作家只留下了阿兰语的零星片段，但泽连丘克铭文和鲁不鲁乞的记述表明，10至13世纪的阿兰语已使用以希腊字母为基础的文字。1240年蒙古人攻灭阿兰国家后，退守深山的后裔成为奥塞梯人，语言演变为奥塞梯语；与之相近的雅西方言在13世纪由雅西人带到匈牙利，在当地又延续了两个世纪才被同化。

en: Albanian is the sole surviving language of the Albanic branch of Indo-European, native to the western Balkans and commonly regarded as the descendant of ancient Illyrian. It splits into two mutually intelligible dialects, Gheg north of the Shkumbin river and Tosk to its south, whose division was probably complete by the sixth century. The language first appears in writing in a Ragusan testimony of 1284, and a Dominican friar noted in 1332 that Albanians wrote their books in Latin letters; the oldest surviving Albanian text, a baptismal formula, dates to 1462. The first printed book was the Meshari, a Gheg missal published by Gjon Buzuku in 1555, followed by Tosk works from the Arbëresh communities of southern Italy. Under Ottoman rule northern Catholics wrote in Latin script, southern Orthodox in Greek and Muslims in Arabic, while the language absorbed many Turkish words; Frang Bardhi printed the first Latin-Albanian dictionary in Rome in 1635, and eighteenth- and early nineteenth-century scholars began devising alphabets of their own.
zh: 阿尔巴尼亚语是印欧语系阿尔巴尼亚语族仅存的语言，故土在西巴尔干，通常被认为由古代伊利里亚语演变而来。它分为两支可以互通的方言：什昆宾河以北的盖格方言和以南的托斯克方言，两者的分化大约在6世纪已经完成。这种语言最早见于1284年拉古萨的一份证词，1332年又有一位多明我会修士记载阿尔巴尼亚人用拉丁字母写书；现存最古老的阿尔巴尼亚语文本是1462年的一段洗礼经文。第一本印刷书是吉翁·布祖库1555年出版的盖格方言弥撒书《弥撒》，此后意大利南部的阿尔伯雷什社群又留下了托斯克方言的著作。奥斯曼统治时期，北方的天主教徒用拉丁字母、南方的正教徒用希腊字母、穆斯林用阿拉伯字母书写，语言本身也吸收了大量土耳其语借词；弗朗·巴尔迪于1635年在罗马印出第一部拉丁语—阿尔巴尼亚语词典，18至19世纪初的学者则开始设计本民族自己的字母。

en: Algic is an indigenous language family of North America, uniting the widespread Algonquian languages with two small languages of the Pacific coast, Yurok and Wiyot. The Algonquian branch once reached from the Rocky Mountains to Atlantic Canada, while Yurok and Wiyot, the westernmost Algic tongues, belong to the redwood coast of north-western California: the Yurok, who call themselves by a word meaning person, hold the lower Klamath River and the shore around its mouth, with villages dating to the fourteenth century, and the Wiyot live around Humboldt Bay, from the Mad River to the Eel River. All descend from Proto-Algic, reconstructed as roughly five thousand years old, whose homeland is thought to have lain in the inland north-west, between the middle Columbia River and the country west of Lake Superior. Russian sea-otter traders reached the Wiyot coast in 1806, and Hudson's Bay Company trappers entered Yurok lands in 1827.
zh: 阿尔吉克语是北美原住民的一个语系，把分布广阔的阿尔冈昆诸语与太平洋沿岸的两种小语言——尤罗克语和维约特语——联系在一起。阿尔冈昆语支曾从落基山脉一直延伸到大西洋沿岸的加拿大；尤罗克语和维约特语是阿尔吉克语最西端的成员，位于加利福尼亚西北部的红杉海岸：自称意为“人”的尤罗克人据有克拉马斯河下游及河口一带海岸，其村落可追溯到14世纪，维约特人则住在洪堡湾周围，北起马德河、南至伊尔河。这些语言都源自约五千年前的原始阿尔吉克语，学界推测其故乡在西北内陆，即哥伦比亚河中游与苏必利尔湖以西地区之间。1806年，捕猎海獭的俄国商人来到维约特人的海岸；1827年，哈德逊湾公司的捕兽人进入尤罗克人的土地。

en: Ambae, in its western form also called Duidui or Nduindui, is an Oceanic language spoken on the volcanic island of Ambae, long known to Europeans as Aoba or Lepers' Island, in northern Vanuatu. The island's name goes back to a reconstructed Proto-North-Central Vanuatu form omba, and neighbouring Mota, once the lingua franca of the Anglican Melanesian Mission, calls both island and language Opa. West Ambae has the principal dialect Duidui together with Walaha, while the north, east and south of the same island use the related but distinct East Ambae language. The first Europeans to record a sighting of Ambae were the ships of Pedro Fernandez de Quiros's Spanish expedition in the spring of 1606, and later missionary contact, above all through the Melanesian Mission, gradually gave the island's languages a written form.
zh: 奥巴语的西部形式又称杜伊杜伊语或恩杜因杜伊语，是通行于瓦努阿图北部火山岛奥巴岛（欧洲人旧称奥巴或麻风岛）的一种大洋洲语。岛名可追溯至构拟的原始中北瓦努阿图语形式“奥姆巴”；曾作为圣公会美拉尼西亚传道区通用语的莫塔语，把该岛和这种语言都称作奥帕。西奥巴语以杜伊杜伊方言为主，另有瓦拉哈方言；岛的北部、东部和南部则通行与它有亲缘关系但彼此不同的东奥巴语。1606年春，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的西班牙探险队首次有记载地望见奥巴岛；后来的传教接触，尤其是美拉尼西亚传道区的活动，使岛上的语言逐渐有了书写形式。

en: North Ambrym is an Oceanic language spoken in the northern part of Ambrym, the volcanic island at the heart of Vanuatu, where it shares the coast only with the small Fanbyak language; several related tongues, among them Vatlongos, Daakaka and Lonwolwol, occupy the south and east. Two main dialects survive, the better-documented Western dialect of Lonhali and the North-Eastern dialect of Wowan, levelled from an earlier five or six as communities moved down to the coast. Its grammar marks four pronoun numbers, singular, dual, paucal and plural, with inclusive and exclusive first person, and splits nouns into directly and indirectly possessed. The island's name is traditionally traced to James Cook, who sailed past it in 1774, although his expedition never actually landed.
zh: 北安布里姆语是通行于安布里姆岛北部的一种大洋洲语。安布里姆是瓦努阿图中部的火山岛，北安布里姆语在北岸只与很小的凡比亚克语相邻；瓦特隆戈斯语、达卡卡语、隆沃尔沃尔语等几种亲缘语言则分布在岛的南部和东部。现存两种主要方言：记录较完整的隆哈利西部方言和沃万东北部方言；随着居民向海岸迁移，早先的五六种方言已合并为这两种。它的代词区分单数、双数、少数和复数四种数，第一人称还分包含式和排除式，名词则分直接领有和间接领有两类。岛名通常被认为源自詹姆斯·库克：他在1774年航经该岛并留下名称，不过其探险队其实并未登陆。

en: Andamanese is the collective name for the indigenous languages of the Andaman Islands in the Indian Ocean, a geographic label rather than a single language family. The attested tongues fall into two genetically unrelated groups: Great Andamanese, a cluster of closely related languages once spoken by about ten tribes across Great Andaman and its surrounding islands, and Ongan, comprising Jarawa and Onge in the south, while the speech of the isolated Sentinelese has never been recorded. The two groups share almost no common vocabulary, their resemblance being limited to typological features such as complex prefixing morphology, and proposed links with Papuan or Austronesian languages have not won acceptance. Contact with outside maritime traders was sporadic and usually hostile, so the languages were almost undocumented until the British founded their first island settlement in 1789, which brought mainland settlers and new diseases and began the steep decline of the Great Andamanese tribes and their speech.
zh: 安达曼语是印度洋安达曼群岛原住民诸语言的统称，是一个地理标签，而不是同一个语系。已记录的语言分属两个彼此没有亲属关系的群体：大安达曼语是一群关系密切的语言，曾由大安达曼岛及周边岛屿上约十个部落使用；翁根语则包括南部的加洛瓦语和昂格语，而与世隔绝的森蒂纳尔人的语言没有留下任何记录。两个群体几乎没有共同词汇，相似之处只限于复杂的前缀形态等类型特征，学者提出的它们与巴布亚诸语言或南岛语同源的假说也未获认可。岛民与外来海上商人的接触零星而常带敌意，因此在1789年英国建立首个岛上定居点之前，这些语言几乎没有文字记录；定居点带来了大陆移民和新的疾病，大安达曼诸部落及其语言由此开始急剧衰落。

en: Anejom, also called Aneityum, is the single indigenous language of Aneityum, the southernmost inhabited island of Vanuatu, and forms its own branch of the Southern Vanuatu group within the Oceanic languages; its nearest kin are the languages of neighbouring Tanna rather than those of Erromango. Aneityum was settled from Tanna around 874 BC, and long isolation gave the language its distinct shape. The islanders were organised into chiefdoms headed by chiefs called natimarid: oral tradition recalls two original chiefdoms splitting into seven, divided in turn into fifty or sixty districts. The first Europeans arrived in 1830, when the brig Alpha landed to open a sandalwood trade, the beginning of the upheavals that would end the island's long seclusion. Anejom had no native script and was carried entirely by oral tradition.
zh: 阿内霍姆语又称阿内蒂乌姆语，是瓦努阿图最南端有人居住的阿内蒂乌姆岛唯一的本土语言，在大洋洲语言的南瓦努阿图语支中自成一支，与邻近塔纳岛诸语言的关系比埃罗芒奥岛的语言更近。阿内蒂乌姆岛约在公元前874年由塔纳岛前来的移民定居，长期的隔绝塑造了该语言独特的面貌。岛民以称为纳蒂马里德的酋长为首，分成若干酋邦；口传传统称最初的两个酋邦分裂为七个，其下又分为五六十个区域。1830年，双桅船阿尔法号为开展檀木贸易首次登岛，欧洲人就此到来，打破了该岛漫长的封闭状态。阿内霍姆语没有本土文字，完全依靠口传传承。

en: Angan, also called the Kratke Range languages, is a closely knit family of Trans–New Guinea languages spoken in the rugged Kratke Range of eastern New Guinea, across the meeting point of the Eastern Highlands, Gulf and Morobe provinces of Papua New Guinea. Its members include Ankave, Menya and Hamtai, the last also called Kapau; Hamtai is the most widely spoken of the family and itself has dialects such as Wenta, Howi and Kaintiba. The family is held together by distinctive shared pronouns and vocabulary, though some classifications treat it as an independent family rather than as part of Trans–New Guinea. In Menya, kinship is expressed through dyadic terms that name the relationship between two people, a device rare both in New Guinea and worldwide. The Angan-speaking valleys lie far inland, and when the Spanish explorer Yñigo Ortiz de Retez gave the island its name in 1545, ranges such as the Kratke were entirely unknown to Europeans, whose reach did not extend to these communities until the colonial era.
zh: 安甘语又称克拉特克岭语，是一组结构紧密的跨新几内亚语系语言，通行于新几内亚东部崎岖的克拉特克岭，横跨巴布亚新几内亚东部高地省、海湾省和莫罗贝省的交界处。其成员包括安卡维语、门亚语和哈姆泰语，哈姆泰语又称卡保语，是该语族中使用最广的语言，本身又分文塔、霍维和凯恩蒂巴等方言。把这一语族维系在一起的是独特而共通的代词与词汇，但也有分类体系把它视为独立语族，而非跨新几内亚语系的一部分。门亚语用二元亲属称谓来表示两个人之间的关系，这种机制在新几内亚乃至全世界都很少见。安甘语诸谷深居内陆，1545年西班牙探险家伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德·雷特斯为新几内亚岛命名时，克拉特克岭这样的山区对欧洲人还完全陌生，外来势力直到殖民时代才触及这些社群。

en: Anishinabe, self-designated Anishinaabemowin, is a chain of closely related Central Algonquian dialects spoken around the Great Lakes and the Ottawa Valley, from the lower St Lawrence westward to Lake Winnipeg and the upper Mississippi. Its named varieties include Algonquin, Nipissing, Ottawa, Eastern and Western Ojibwe, Saulteaux and Oji-Cree, with no single dialect or orthography treated as standard; the neighboring Potawatomi and Menominee share much of its vocabulary through long contact. By the early eighteenth century these dialects served as the trade lingua franca of the upper Great Lakes: a report of 1703 describes them in use from the Gulf of St Lawrence to Hudson Bay, and as the Huron declined during the 1700s Ottawa and other Anishinaabe varieties replaced the Huron language in intertribal commerce. They were written in local Roman alphabets based on French and English spelling and in the Great Lakes Algonquian syllabics, a French-based syllabary shared with Fox and Potawatomi speakers.
zh: 阿尼希纳贝语自称阿尼希纳贝莫温，是一组关系紧密的中阿尔冈昆方言，通用于五大湖周围和渥太华山谷，东起圣劳伦斯河下游、西至温尼伯湖和密西西比河上游。其分支包括阿尔冈昆、尼皮辛、渥太华、东西奥吉布瓦、索尔托和奥吉—克里等方言，没有一种方言或拼写法被奉为标准；邻近的波塔瓦托米语和梅诺米尼语也因长期接触而与它大量共通。18世纪初，这些方言已是五大湖上游的贸易通用语：1703年的记载称，从圣劳伦斯湾到哈得孙湾都有人使用它们；随着休伦人在18世纪衰落，渥太华等阿尼希纳贝分支在部落间贸易中取代了休伦语。书写上，各地采用以法语、英语拼法为基础的拉丁字母，也使用与福克斯人、波塔瓦托米人共用的法文字母大湖阿尔冈昆音节文字。

en: Apma, also written Abma or called Central Raga, is the Oceanic language of central Pentecost island in Vanuatu, standing between the North Vanuatu and Central Vanuatu language groups and combining features of both. Its name is the local word for what or something, and speakers usually call it simply dalekte, the language. It has three living dialects: Suru Mwerani of the south around Melsisi, the most widely spoken and documented; Suru Rabwanga of the central mountains; and the small, sharply distinct Suru Kavian, hard for the others to understand, while the Asuk and Wolwolan dialects have died out. Apma has spread into areas once held by neighbouring languages such as Sowa and Ske, and increasingly mixes with Bislama, the national lingua franca. Europeans first sighted Pentecost in Pedro Fernandez de Quiros's expedition of April 1606; Louis Antoine de Bougainville named the island in 1768 when he reached it on the day of Pentecost, and James Cook followed in 1774.
zh: 阿普玛语又译阿布玛语，亦称中拉加语，是瓦努阿图彭特科斯特岛中部的大洋洲语，处于北瓦努阿图语群与中瓦努阿图语群之间，兼有两者的特征。它的名字在当地语言中意为“什么”或“某物”，使用者通常只称它为达莱克特，即“语言”。现存三种方言：南部梅尔西西一带的苏鲁姆韦拉尼方言，使用人口最多、记录最完整；中部山区的苏鲁拉布旺加方言；以及范围很小、特色鲜明、其他方言使用者很难听懂的苏鲁卡维安方言；阿苏克和沃尔沃兰两种方言已经消亡。阿普玛语已扩展到曾属于索瓦语、斯凯语等邻近语言的地区，并越来越多地混入全国通用语比斯拉马语的词汇。1606年4月，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的探险队首次望见彭特科斯特岛；1768年路易·安托万·德·布干维尔在圣灵降临节当天抵达，便以此为岛命名，詹姆斯·库克又于1774年到访。

en: Apsáalooke-Hiraacá groups the two Missouri Valley Siouan languages, Crow and Hidatsa, the sole members of that branch of the Western Siouan family. Crow, whose native name Apsáalooke means children of the large-beaked bird, a phrase later mistranslated as crow, belongs to the Crow people of southeastern Montana, while Hidatsa is spoken by the Hidatsa of the Dakotas. Their shared ancestor may have been the first tongue to split from Proto-Siouan-Catawban, and Crow and Hidatsa themselves perhaps diverged at some point between roughly 1200 and 1700. They retain much common phonology, vocabulary and grammar, yet are no longer mutually intelligible. Crow showed few dialect differences between its River and Mountain bands. Its grammar treats personal names as a distinct class of noun, each marked by a definite suffix attached to the stem.
zh: 克劳‑希达察语涵盖密苏里河谷苏语支的两种语言——克劳语与希达察语，它们是西苏语族这一分支仅有的成员。克劳语是今蒙大拿东南部克劳人的语言，其自称意为“巨喙鸟的孩子”，后来被误译为“乌鸦”；希达察语则通行于达科他地区的希达察人当中。二者的共同祖先可能是最早从原始苏‑卡托巴语分化出来的语言，而克劳语与希达察语本身大约在1200—1700年间的某个时候分开。它们在语音、词汇和语法上仍有许多共通之处，却已不能相通。克劳人传统上分为河克劳人与山克劳人两支，彼此方言差异很小；语法上人名构成独立的名词类别，词干上要加特定的定指后缀。

en: Arabic is the great Central Semitic language of the Arabian Peninsula. Its older forms, Old Arabic, survive in pre-Islamic inscriptions cut in Ancient North Arabian and Nabataean scripts, among them texts from the centuries around the birth of Christ. In the seventh century the revelations of the Quran were collected in a single codex under the Caliph Uthman, who reigned from 644 to 656, fixing the literary language; by the 700s grammarians had standardized Classical Arabic, the register of poetry, scholarship and Islamic worship across the caliphate. The Islamic conquests carried Arabic from Mesopotamia to the Maghrib and Iberia, where it became a leading vehicle of science and philosophy and supplied Spanish and other European tongues with a large stock of loanwords. Spoken dialects branched into Peninsular, Egyptian, Levantine, Mesopotamian and Maghrebi forms, while the Arabic of Sicily and al-Andalus gave rise to Maltese, the one Arabic descendant written in the Latin alphabet. The Arabic abjad, derived from Nabataean Aramaic, is written from right to left.
zh: 阿拉伯语是阿拉伯半岛的中闪米特大语言。它的古老形态“古阿拉伯语”留存于伊斯兰教之前、用古代北阿拉伯字母和纳巴泰字母刻写的碑铭中，其中不少出自公元纪年前后的几个世纪。7世纪，《古兰经》的启示在哈里发奥斯曼（644—656年在位）主持下汇编为统一定本，奠定了书面语的基础；到8世纪，语法学家将古典阿拉伯语规范化，使之成为整个哈里发世界诗歌、学术和伊斯兰宗教活动使用的语体。随着伊斯兰征服，阿拉伯语从两河流域传播到马格里布和伊比利亚，成为科学与哲学的重要载体，并给西班牙语等欧洲语言贡献了大量借词。口语方言分化为半岛、埃及、黎凡特、两河和马格里布等支系，西西里和安达卢斯的阿拉伯语后来衍生出马耳他语——这是唯一用拉丁字母书写的阿拉伯语后裔。阿拉伯字母是一种辅音音素文字，由纳巴泰阿拉米字母发展而来，自右向左书写。

en: Aramaic is a Northwest Semitic language that arose among the Aramean tribes of ancient Syria, whose earliest inscriptions date to the eleventh century BCE. Adopted by the kings of the Neo-Assyrian Empire from 911 BCE onward, it became the administrative lingua franca of the Assyrian, Neo-Babylonian and Achaemenid empires in its standardized Imperial Aramaic form, carrying trade and government across the Near East from Mesopotamia to Egypt. Written in an alphabet derived from Phoenician, it gave rise to the square Hebrew script and, at Edessa, to the Syriac alphabet. It was the everyday speech of the Jews of the Second Temple period, the language of parts of the Hebrew Bible and the Targums, and of the Babylonian and Jerusalem Talmuds. After the Arab conquests of the seventh century Arabic gradually replaced it as a vernacular, but Classical Syriac lived on as the liturgical language of Syriac Christianity, Mandaic served the Mandaeans, and spoken Neo-Aramaic dialects survived in the mountains and villages of the Near East.
zh: 阿拉米语属闪米特语族西北支，起源于古叙利亚的阿拉米人部落，最早的铭文可追溯到公元前11世纪。公元前911年起，新亚述帝国诸王采用阿拉米语，标准化的“帝国阿拉米语”随之成为亚述、新巴比伦和阿契美尼德三大帝国的行政通用语，承担从美索不达米亚到埃及的商贸与政务。它使用源自腓尼基字母的阿拉米字母书写，方块希伯来字母便由此而来，在埃德萨又演变出叙利亚字母。阿拉米语曾是第二圣殿时期犹太人的日常语言，《希伯来圣经》的部分篇章、《塔古姆》译本以及《巴比伦塔木德》《耶路撒冷塔木德》都以它写成。7世纪阿拉伯征服后，阿拉伯语逐渐取代它成为口语，但古典叙利亚语作为叙利亚基督教的礼仪语言延续下来，曼达语则服务于曼达安教，新阿拉米语方言在近东的山村中留存。

en: Arandai is a Papuan dialect cluster of the Teluk Bintuni Regency in western New Guinea, spoken in the Aranday, Kamundan and Weriagar districts along the Berau Gulf and Bintuni Bay. It groups three closely related varieties, Kemberano (also called Weriagar or Kalitami), Dombano (Tomu) and Kokoda, which form either a small subfamily or a three-member dialect continuum; alternative names recorded for the same speech include Jaban, Sebyar and, confusingly, Sumuri. Within the Trans–New Guinea family, Arandai belongs to the South Bird's Head languages of the southern Bird's Head Peninsula coast. Its speakers live in a sago-and-rainforest country of swampy shorelines that was long tied into the Tidore Sultanate's network of tribute and raiding, legendarily expanded by the Papuan leader Gurabesi. The Spanish expedition of Luís Vaz de Torres sailed past these coasts in 1606, the first Europeans to sight them, and in 1828 the Dutch erected Fort Du Bus on nearby Triton Bay to anchor their protectorate over Tidore's Papuan claims; abandoned in 1835, it left the Arandai shore under loose, indirect Tidore rule for the rest of the period.
zh: 阿兰代语是新几内亚西部宾图尼湾县的巴布亚方言群，通行于贝劳湾与宾图尼湾沿岸的阿兰代、卡蒙丹和韦里亚加尔三区。它包含三种关系密切的变体——肯贝拉诺语（又称韦里亚加尔语或卡里塔米语）、敦巴诺语（托穆语）和科科达语，三者要么构成一个小语支，要么是三成员方言连续体；同一语言还被记录为贾班、塞比亚尔，以及容易引起混淆的“苏穆里”等别名。在跨新几内亚语系内，阿兰代语属于鸟头半岛南海岸的南鸟头语支。其使用者生活在沼泽海岸的西谷米与雨林之地，长期被纳入蒂多雷苏丹国的朝贡与掠夺网络，传说这一网络正是由巴布亚首领古拉贝西扩张而来。1606年，路易斯·瓦斯·德·托雷斯的西班牙探险队驶过这片海岸，欧洲人首次得见此地；1828年，荷兰人在附近的特里顿湾修建杜布斯堡，以维系其对蒂多雷巴布亚属地的保护权。该堡于1835年废弃，此后直到该时期结束，阿兰代海岸一直处于蒂多雷松散的间接统治之下。

en: Armenian forms its own branch of the Indo-European family, native to the Armenian highlands, where the Armenians are already named in the Persian Behistun Inscription of the sixth century BC. Long contact with Parthian gave it a large Iranian layer of vocabulary, with smaller Greek, Syriac and Arabic borrowings alongside it. The decisive event in its written history was the invention of the Armenian alphabet by Mesrop Mashtots in 405, soon followed by the fifth-century Bible translation that opened the classical age of Grabar, the literary language of the Armenian Church. In the tenth century Gregory of Narek carried its religious poetry to new heights, and under the Bagratid and Cilician kingdoms of the eleventh to fourteenth centuries two letters were added to the script as the spoken Middle Armenian entered writing. Grabar long remained the learned standard, renewed in the eighteenth century by the Mekhitarist fathers of Venice, whose press issued the first Armenian periodical in 1794.
zh: 亚美尼亚语是印欧语系中自成一支的语言，原产于亚美尼亚高原；早在公元前6世纪波斯的贝希斯敦铭文里，亚美尼亚人之名已经出现。与帕提亚的长期接触给它带来厚厚的伊朗语词汇层，此外还有少量希腊语、叙利亚语和阿拉伯语借词。它书面史上的决定性事件，是梅斯罗普·马什托茨于405年创制亚美尼亚字母，5世纪的圣经译本随之问世，开启了格拉巴尔，即亚美尼亚教会文学语言的古典时代。10世纪，纳雷科的格列高利将其宗教诗歌推向新的高峰；11—14世纪巴格拉图尼王朝和奇里乞亚王国时期，随着口语形式的中期亚美尼亚语进入书面，字母表又增两个字母。格拉巴尔长期保持学术标准语的地位，18世纪经威尼斯的梅希塔尔会修士复兴，其印刷所于1794年刊行了第一份亚美尼亚语期刊。

en: Arop, recorded as Arop-Lokep or Arop-Lukep, is an Oceanic Austronesian language spoken on four islands of the Siassi chain in the Vitiaz Strait, between New Britain and the New Guinea mainland. It belongs to the Ngero, or Siassi, group of the Ngero–Vitiaz linkage, whose islanders formed the hub of a pre-colonial trading network across the strait.
zh: 阿罗普语在文献中记作阿罗普—洛凯普语，是一种泛太平洋语族南岛语，通行于维蒂亚兹海峡西亚西群岛的四座岛屿，地处新不列颠岛与新几内亚大陆之间。它属于恩杰罗—维亚茨语群中的恩杰罗（又称西亚西）组；西亚西岛民曾是海峡一带前殖民时期贸易网络的枢纽。

en: Arosi is a Southeast Solomonic language spoken on Makira, formerly called San Cristobal, the easternmost large island of the Solomon Islands, chiefly by the communities living west of the Wango River. It first entered European records in 1588, when Álvaro de Mendaña's Spanish expedition reached and named the island, though the visitors wrote down only six words. Its nouns carry no gender marking and divide into simple nouns and phrasal nouns, the latter joined by the preposition i with the sense of of. Compared with the languages of Malaita, Arosi forms few derived nouns, mainly through the prefixes hai- and ha'i- and the nominalizing suffix -ha, and counts on a base-ten system in which the word for one thousand, meru, is the highest numeral term.
zh: 阿罗西语是东南所罗门语支的一种语言，通行于所罗门群岛最东端的大岛马基拉岛（旧称圣克里斯托瓦尔岛），使用者主要是万戈河以西的居民。1588年，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚率领的西班牙船队抵达并命名该岛，阿罗西语由此首次进入欧洲人的记录，但来访者只写下了六个词。它的名词没有性别标记，分为简单名词和短语名词，后者靠表示所属关系的介词组合；与马拉伊塔岛的诸语言相比，阿罗西语的派生词很少，主要通过两个前缀和一个名词化后缀构成。数词采用十进制，意为一千的词是最高位的数词。

en: The Aru languages are a cluster of about a dozen Austronesian tongues, among them Kola, Tarangan, Manombai and Ujir, spoken across the ninety-five low-lying islands of the Aru archipelago in the Arafura Sea. They form an interconnected dialect chain rather than a neatly branching family, and despite lying next to the Central Maluku languages they do not belong to that group. Aru society was built on lineage clans joined in two ritual alliances, Ursia and Urlima, and its trade in trepang, pearls, birds of paradise, sago, tortoiseshell and slaves drew Banda, Bugis and Makassarese merchants long before any European arrived. Portuguese navigators sighted the islands in the 1520s, and the Spanish captain Alvaro de Saavedra charted them in 1528. The Dutch East India Company signed its first contract with coastal villages in 1623 and opened a post on Wokam Island in 1659, after which Islam and Reformed Protestantism each gained small followings. The anti-Dutch rising of the Tidore prince Nuku reached Aru in 1787, when the people of Ujir destroyed the Company garrison, until Banda-based troops suppressed the rebels in 1791.
zh: 阿鲁语是南岛语系的一组语言，共约十二种，包括科拉语、塔兰甘语、马诺姆拜语和乌吉尔语等，通行于阿拉弗拉海上由九十五个低平岛屿组成的阿鲁群岛。它们构成彼此相连的方言链，而非层级分明的语系分支；虽然地理上紧邻中马鲁古诸语，语言分类上却不属于该语群。阿鲁社会以血缘氏族为基础，各氏族分属乌尔西亚和乌尔利马两个仪式联盟；早在欧洲人到来之前，海参、珍珠、极乐鸟、西谷米、玳瑁和奴隶贸易就吸引了班达、布吉和望加锡商人前来。16世纪20年代，葡萄牙航海者望见该群岛，西班牙船长阿尔瓦罗·德·萨维德拉于1528年将其绘入海图。1623年，荷兰东印度公司与沿海村庄订立首份契约，1659年在沃坎岛开设商馆，此后伊斯兰教和归正宗新教都赢得了少量信徒。1787年，蒂多雷王子努库的反荷起义波及阿鲁，乌吉尔岛居民歼灭了公司驻军，直到1791年才被以班达为基地的荷兰军队镇压下去。

en: Aslian is the southernmost branch of the Austroasiatic family and the speech of the Orang Asli, the aboriginal peoples of the Malay Peninsula. Its languages fall into a northern group of the nomadic Semang, among them Kensiu, Jahai and Batek, a central group led by the Senoi languages Temiar and Semai, and a southern group including Mah Meri and Semelai, with Jah Hut and the extinct Kenaboi standing apart. Scholars place the arrival of Proto-Aslian speakers from the Gulf of Thailand region before the rise of Mon power; Semai traditions of settlement go back to roughly 8000 to 6000 BC, and the languages preserve layers of Bornean and Chamic loanwords left by Austronesian settlers who reached the peninsula three to four thousand years ago. Once Malay sultanates formed and Islam spread, the forest peoples were classed as despised pagans and exposed to slave-raiding, so many withdrew deeper inland; their languages remained unwritten, absorbed heavy Malay vocabulary, and survived in scattered swidden and foraging bands beyond the plains.
zh: 土著马来语即亚斯里语支，是南亚语系最南端的分支，也是马来半岛原住民奥兰阿斯里人的语言。它分为三支：北支属游猎的塞芒人，有肯修语、贾海语、巴特克语等；中支以塞诺伊人的特米亚尔语和塞迈语为主；南支包括马梅里语和塞默莱语，而贾赫特语和已灭绝的克那博伊语自成一类。学者认为，原始亚斯里语使用者在孟人势力兴起之前便从泰国湾一带迁入半岛，塞迈人的定居传说可追溯到约公元前8000年至前6000年；语言中还保留着婆罗洲语和占语借词的层次，那是三四千年前登上半岛的南岛语定居者留下的。马来诸苏丹国建立、伊斯兰教传播之后，林中居民被视为低贱的异教徒，常遭掳掠为奴，许多人因此退入更深的内陆；他们的语言始终没有文字，吸收了大量马来语词汇，在平原之外零散的轮垦与游猎群体中存续下来。

en: Asmat is a cluster of closely related Papuan languages of the Trans–New Guinea family, spoken along the southwestern coast of New Guinea on the shores of the Arafura Sea, across a watery world of mangrove forest, tidal swamp and lowland rainforest in South Papua. Its principal varieties are distinct enough to count as separate languages, and their speakers belong to several peoples: Asmat proper, Buruwai and Citak, while the neighbouring Kamoro and Sempan speak languages of the same family although they are ethnically distinct. Life in the tidal swamps is built around the sago palm, whose starch is the staple, together with fish, forest game and the prized grubs of the sago beetle; villages stand on wooden posts above the daily floods, and inland groups build tall tree houses. The Asmat are famed as carvers, above all for the bisj poles erected to honour dead ancestors and warrior forebears, and raiding and headhunting long formed part of the rites that bound their clans. The coast was first sighted by Europeans when Torres passed in 1606, though the Asmat swamps remained beyond outside reach until the colonial era.
zh: 阿斯马特语是跨新几内亚语系下一组亲缘密切的巴布亚语言，通行于新几内亚西南海岸、阿拉弗拉海沿岸，分布在南巴布亚由红树林、潮汐沼泽和低地雨林组成的水乡泽国。它的主要变体差异大到可视为独立语言，使用者分属几个民族：阿斯马特本体、布鲁瓦伊人和奇塔克人；邻近的卡莫罗人和森潘人也说同一语族的语言，但族群身份并不相同。潮汐沼泽里的生活围绕西谷椰子展开，西谷米是主食，辅以鱼、林间猎物和珍贵的西谷甲虫幼虫；村落架在木桩上以避每日潮水，内陆群体则建造高耸的树屋。阿斯马特人以木雕闻名，尤其是为纪念死去的祖先和战士先辈而立的比斯柱；袭击和猎头长期是维系氏族的仪式的一部分。1606年托雷斯路过时，欧洲人第一次望见这片海岸，但阿斯马特沼泽在殖民时代之前始终处于外来者势力范围之外。

en: Atacame, also called Esmeraldeño or Takame, was the language of the Pacific coast of Ecuador's Esmeraldas region, along the lower Esmeraldas River. It is generally counted as a language isolate, with no proven relatives despite proposed links to the Pumé language of Venezuela and lexical parallels with the extinct Yurumanguí; it absorbed words from the neighbouring Barbacoan languages Cha'palaa and Tsafiki but almost none from Quechua. In 1553 a slave ship wrecked in San Mateo Bay and its escaped Africans, led in time by Alonso de Illescas, intermarried with the local Nigua people to form autonomous zambo communities in which the old tongue survived. Around 1800 the traveller William Bennet Stevenson still heard Atacame in the town of Esmeraldas, while nearby Atacames had already turned to Spanish; only a short recorded word list remains of the language.
zh: 阿塔卡梅语又称埃斯梅拉达语或塔卡梅语，曾通行于厄瓜多尔太平洋沿岸埃斯梅拉尔达斯地区的埃斯梅拉达斯河下游。它通常被视为孤立语言：虽有人提出它与委内瑞拉的普梅语有亲缘关系，还和已消亡的尤鲁曼吉语有词汇上的相似之处，但都没有确证；它从邻近的巴尔巴科亚语系语言查帕拉语和察菲基语吸收了不少词，却几乎没有克丘亚语借词。1553年，一艘贩奴船在圣马特奥湾失事，逃散的非洲人在阿隆索·德·伊列斯卡斯等人带领下与当地尼瓜人通婚，形成自治的桑博人社区，古老的语言就在其中延续。1800年前后，旅行家威廉·本内特·史蒂文森在埃斯梅拉尔达斯城仍能听到阿塔卡梅语，而附近的阿塔卡梅斯镇已改说西班牙语；这门语言后来只留下一份简短的词汇记录。

en: Atakapa, called Ishakkoy or Yukhiti Koy by its speakers, is a language isolate of the Gulf Coast, spoken along the marshes and river mouths of southwestern Louisiana and southeastern Texas by the Ishak people, whom the Choctaw named Atakapa, meaning man-eater, for their ritual cannibalism. The first Europeans to meet them were survivors of the failed Narvaez expedition cast ashore in 1528, whose treasurer Cabeza de Vaca wrote the earliest account of the coastal bands. By the seventeenth century the Atakapa were trading fish, hides and salt with the Caddo, Chitimacha and Karankawa across the lower Mississippi region, and French explorers under La Salle entered their territory in 1685. The language existed in eastern and western dialects and was never written by its speakers; a French officer took down a vocabulary at Galveston Bay in 1721, and a fuller French-Atakapa glossary was compiled in 1802.
zh: 阿塔卡帕语是墨西哥湾沿岸的一门孤立语言，使用者自称伊沙克人，本族语称伊沙科伊或尤希蒂科伊，通行于路易斯安那西南部和得克萨斯东南部的沼泽与河口地带。伊沙克人被乔克托人称作阿塔卡帕，意即食人族，因为他们有仪式性食人习俗。欧洲人最早在1528年与他们接触：失事的纳尔瓦埃斯远征队幸存者漂流上岸，队中的财务官卡韦萨·德巴卡写下了关于这些沿岸群体的最早记载。到17世纪，阿塔卡帕人已在下密西西比地区与卡多人、奇蒂马查人和卡兰卡瓦人交易鱼干、兽皮和食盐；1685年，拉萨尔率领的法国探险队进入他们的地界。阿塔卡帕语分东部、西部两种方言，使用者自己没有文字：1721年一名法国军官在加尔维斯顿湾记下一份词汇表，1802年又有人编成一部更完整的法语－阿塔卡帕语词汇表。

en: Atallan is the name given to the presumed language of the Manteño-Huancavilca peoples, the coastal traders of Ecuador's Guayas, Manabí and Santa Elena region whose culture flourished from about 850 to 1600. Scholars have grouped the poorly recorded speech of the Manta and Huancavilca, together with that of Puná and Tumbes, into a hypothetical Atalán family, but only a handful of words were ever collected, so its relationship to other languages cannot be established. The Inca never conquered this coast, and after the Spanish takeover the language died out unrecorded, leaving its classification unsettled.
zh: 阿塔扬语是对曼特尼奥-万卡维尔卡诸族群所用语言的称呼，这些人是厄瓜多尔瓜亚斯、马纳维和圣埃伦娜一带的沿海商民，其文化约在850年至1600年间兴盛。学者把记录极少的曼塔语、万卡维尔卡语以及普纳语、通贝斯语归为一个假定的阿塔扬语系，但后人只搜集到寥寥几个词，无法确定它与其他语言的关系。印加人从未征服这段海岸，西班牙人接管后，这门语言未经充分记录便告消亡，其谱系归属始终没有定论。

en: Awyu, taken in its broad sense, covers the Awyu–Ok cluster, a wide group of Trans–New Guinea families spread through the swampy lowlands and foothills of central New Guinea around the Digul River and across the mountain border into Papua New Guinea. It unites the Digul River or Greater Awyu family, whose members include Awyu itself, Mandobo also called Kaeti, Kombai, Tsaukambo and Bayono, with the Ok family of the border ranges, which counts Muyu and Iwur among its tongues and in broader classifications is extended to take in Aekyom, also called Awin. The two families share much vocabulary through long contact, and whether the resemblance amounts to a true genetic link remains debated; the Ok languages also stand out for dyadic kinship terms naming the relation between pairs of people. Kombai and other Awyu-speaking peoples live in clan territories cut from the rainforest, farming sago and sweet potatoes and raising high tree houses that serve as lookouts and sacred centres. The first European ship to reach these southern shores was the Torres expedition of 1606, but the Digul swamps stayed closed to outsiders until long afterward.
zh: 广义的阿维尤语涵盖阿维尤-奥克语群，这是跨新几内亚语系下分布很广的一组语族，遍及新几内亚中部迪古尔河一带的沼泽低地和丘陵，并越过山区边界延伸到巴布亚新几内亚。它把迪古尔河语族（又称大阿维尤语族）与边境山岭的奥克语族合在一起：前者包括阿维尤语本体、又称凯蒂语的曼多博语、科姆拜语、曹坎博语和巴约诺语，后者包括穆尤语和伊武尔语，分类范围扩大时还纳入又称阿温语的埃基奥姆语。两个语族因长期接触而共享大量词汇，这种相似是否意味着真正的发生学关系仍有争议；奥克诸语还以表示两人之间关系的二元亲属称谓著称。科姆拜人等说阿维尤语的民族在雨林中划地而居，在氏族领地上种植西谷米和甘薯，并搭起高耸的树屋，用作瞭望台和祭祀中心。1606年托雷斯探险队的船只是最早抵达这些南部海岸的欧洲船只，但迪古尔沼泽在此后很久仍对外来者封闭。

en: Aymara, natively called Aymar aru, is the main language of the Aymaran family, spoken across the Altiplano around Lake Titicaca, in the Bolivian departments of La Paz and Oruro and around Puno in southern Peru, with smaller communities in northern Chile. The family, also called Jaqi or Aru, has one other surviving branch, Central Aymaran, comprising the endangered Jaqaru and Kawki languages of the Yauyos valley in central Peru. Its homeland probably lay on the southern Peruvian coast; Aymaran speakers took part in the Huari empire and spread onto the Altiplano after the fall of Tiwanaku, and at the Spanish conquest Aymara dominated most of the highlands south of Cusco, before steadily losing ground to Quechua and Spanish. It was once called the language of the Colla, and the name Aymara was already in use when Garci Díez de San Miguel inspected Chucuito in 1567. The Jesuit Ludovico Bertonio, working at the Juli mission on the shores of Lake Titicaca, printed its first grammar in 1603 and its dictionary in 1612 on the mission press, fixing the language in Latin script. Aymara is an agglutinating tongue with subject-object-verb word order; it shares much vocabulary with Quechua, but most linguists explain the resemblance as long contact rather than common origin. In 1816 the declaration of independence of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata appeared in an Aymara version, translated by Vicente Pazos Kanki, alongside Quechua and Spanish texts.
zh: 艾马拉语母语者称“艾马尔·阿鲁”，是艾马拉语系最主要的语言，通行于的的喀喀湖周围的阿尔蒂普拉诺高原，即玻利维亚的拉巴斯、奥鲁罗两省和秘鲁南部普诺一带，智利北部也有少数使用者。该语系又称哈基或阿鲁，现存另一支为中部艾马拉语，包括秘鲁中部尧约斯河谷濒危的加嘎鲁语和考基语。艾马拉人的原乡大概在秘鲁南部沿海，其先民曾参与瓦里帝国，在蒂亚瓦纳科衰亡后进入阿尔蒂普拉诺；西班牙征服之时，艾马拉语通行于库斯科以南的大部分高原，此后逐渐受克丘亚语和西班牙语挤压。它旧称科利亚语，1567年加西·迭斯·德·圣米格尔巡视丘基托时的报告已经使用“艾马拉”之名。耶稣会士卢多维科·贝尔托尼奥在湖畔的胡利传教区工作，于1603年印出第一部艾马拉语语法，1612年又在传教区印刷所出版词典，使该语言以拉丁字母的形式固定下来。艾马拉语是黏着语，采用主宾谓语序；它与克丘亚语有大量共同词汇，但多数语言学家认为这是长期接触而非同源的结果。1816年，拉普拉塔联合省的独立宣言除西班牙语和克丘亚语文本外，还由比森特·帕索斯·坎基译成了艾马拉语。

en: Bagua, also called Patagón de Bagua, is an extinct language of the Marañón River basin in northern Peru. Only three of its words were recorded; one, tuna for water, resembles Cariban speech, but the evidence is too slight to classify it, and its speakers shifted to Aguaruna and Spanish in colonial times.
zh: 巴瓜语又称巴瓜巴塔贡语，是秘鲁北部马拉尼翁河流域一种已消亡的语言。它留下记录的词只有三个，其中表“水”的词与加勒比语系相近，却不足以判定系属；殖民时期使用者逐渐转用阿瓜鲁纳语和西班牙语。

en: Baguirmi, whose speakers call it tar barma, is the leading name in the Sara-Bongo-Bagirmi group, the main branch of the Central Sudanic family, whose forty or so languages spread from the Bahr el Ghazal in South Sudan through the Central African Republic into southern Chad; the Sara cluster, including Mbay, forms its western wing, reshaped by long contact with Ubangian neighbours. The Baguirmi language itself belonged to the kingdom of the same name founded around 1522 south-east of Lake Chad, with its stone-palace capital at Massenya on the upper Chari. For much of its history the sultanate stood as a tributary of Bornu, whose ruler Idris Alooma conquered it in the campaigns around 1580; under Mbang Abdullah the court adopted Islam, though the countryside kept its older rites, and the mbang Burkumanda later carried Baguirmi arms as far north as the lake in the mid-1600s. Muhammad al-Amin, reigning from 1751 to 1785, threw off Bornu overlordship, but the revival was brief: in 1805 the rising power of Wadai sacked Massenya and carried off tens of thousands into slavery, reducing Baguirmi to a tributary. Through these centuries the language served a state built on the southern slave trade, sending captives, eunuchs, ivory and cotton north to the trans-Saharan markets, while the Sara tongues of the lands raided to the south lived on as the speech of farming villages across the Chad basin.
zh: 巴吉尔米语的使用者自称塔尔·巴尔马语，是萨拉—邦戈—巴吉尔米语群中最具代表性的语言；该语群是中苏丹语族的主要分支，约四十种语言从南苏丹的加扎勒河经中非共和国延伸到乍得南部，其中包括姆贝语在内的萨拉语群构成其西翼，并因与乌班吉邻族长期接触而面貌有所改变。巴吉尔米语本身属于同名王国：该苏丹国约于1522年在乍得湖东南建立，都城是沙里河上游、以石砌宫殿闻名的马塞尼亚。苏丹国在历史上大部分时间向博尔努称臣，博尔努君主伊德里斯·阿卢马在1580年前后的征战中将其征服；姆班·阿卜杜拉在位时宫廷改宗伊斯兰教，乡间却保留着旧有仪式，17世纪中期姆班·布尔库曼达又把巴吉尔米的兵锋向北推至乍得湖畔。1751至1785年在位的穆罕默德·阿明摆脱了博尔努的宗主权，但复兴十分短暂：1805年，崛起的瓦达伊洗劫马塞尼亚，掳走数万人卖为奴隶，巴吉尔米沦为附庸。在这数百年间，这门语言服务于一个建立在南方奴隶贸易之上的国家，把俘虏、宦官、象牙和棉花运往北方的跨撒哈拉市场；而在其劫掠所及的南方，萨拉诸语则作为乍得盆地农耕村落的语言延续下来。

en: Bahnaric is a group of about thirty Austroasiatic languages spoken through the Central Highlands of present-day Vietnam and across the border into Cambodia and Laos, whose internal diversity suggests the branch broke up around 1000 BCE. It divides into North Bahnaric, led by Sedang and Hre, Central Bahnaric with Bahnar, Mnong and Sre, a western group shaped by Khmer rather than Cham contact, and the eastern Cua language. Chamic-speaking peoples pushed between the northern and central groups, and wars with Chams, Lao and Siamese from the twelfth century onward narrowed the highlanders' range, leaving them swidden farmers in the mountains above the coastal kingdoms. None of these languages had a traditional script; they were carried by oral epics such as the Bahnar Dam Noi and by gong-and-bamboo music. In 1771 Sedang and Bahnar warriors, with their war elephants, joined the Tây Sơn rebellion from the hills of Bình Định and helped carry the Tây Sơn brothers to power.
zh: 巴拿语是南亚语系下约三十种语言的统称，通行于今越南中部高原，并延伸至柬埔寨和老挝境内；语言内部差异很大，学界推测该语支约在公元前1000年便已分化。它分为四支：北支以塞当语和赫列语为主，中支包括巴拿语、墨侬语和斯雷语，西支受高棉而非占语影响，东支则只有戈语。讲占语的人群插入北支与中支之间，加上12世纪以来与占人、老挝人和暹罗人的战争，山民的活动范围不断收缩，最终成为居住在沿海诸王国上方山区的轮垦农人。这些语言都没有传统文字，靠《丹诺》等巴拿口述史诗以及铜锣与竹制乐器传承。1771年，塞当人和巴拿人的战士带着战象，在平定省的群山中加入西山起义，帮助西山兄弟夺取了政权。

en: Bai is the language of the Erhai Lake region of Yunnan, centred on Dali, spoken by the people known to Chinese records as the Baiman or, from the fourteenth century, the Minjia. Its syllables are all open and it carries eight tones, split between modal and tense or breathy phonation. Two millennia of intensive contact with Chinese have left its origins disputed: some linguists take it for an early offshoot that diverged from Chinese around the second century BCE, others for a sister language or a member of the Lolo-Burmese group. The Bai were among the founders of the Nanzhao kingdom and in 937 established their own Dali kingdom, which ruled Yunnan until the Mongol conquest of 1253. Using adapted Chinese characters called Bowen, they wrote scriptures and literature in their own tongue, though the script was never standardized and Classical Chinese remained the language of the official examinations under the Ming.
zh: 白语是云南洱海地区、以大理为中心的语言，使用者在中国史籍中称白蛮，14世纪以后又被称为民家。白语的音节全为开音节，共有八个声调，分正常嗓音与紧喉、气声两类。由于两千多年来与汉语深度接触，白语的起源众说纷纭：有语言学家认为它在公元前2世纪前后从汉语分化而出，是汉语的早期分支；也有人认为它是汉语的姐妹语言，或属于缅彝语群。白族先民参与建立南诏国，又于937年建立大理国，统治云南直到1253年蒙古征服。白族人借用汉字创制僰文，用本族语言书写经文和文学作品，但这套文字始终没有规范统一；明代开科取士后，文言文成为正式考试用语，僰文更趋衰落。

en: The Baining languages form a small non-Austronesian, or Papuan, family spoken by the Baining people of the Gazelle Peninsula in eastern New Britain; its members are Mali, Qaqet, Kairak, Simbali and Ura, each tied to a separate clan identity, while the unattested Makolkol to their south-west is extinct, and the family appears distantly related to the Taulil-Butam languages. The Baining are likely descendants of the Papuan populations who held the Bismarcks long before Austronesian seafarers reached the region around 1500 BCE, and they are considered the peninsula's original inhabitants. From the seventeenth century migrating Tolai peoples seized the fertile volcanic north-eastern coast, and together with centuries of eruptions around Rabaul this pressure drove the Baining into the inland mountains that now bear their name. They are swidden cultivators whose staple is taro, and their most celebrated tradition is the night fire dance, called atut in its Qaqet homeland: dancers wearing towering barkcloth masks of the kavat and vungvung types leap through the embers of a fire, in ceremonies originally held to celebrate births.
