en: Church Slavonic is the sacred literary language of the Slavic Eastern Christians, descended from the Old Church Slavonic created in the 860s by the Thessalonian brothers Cyril and Methodius for their mission to Great Moravia, where the Gospels and liturgy were first translated into Slavic in the new Glagolitic alphabet. Expelled after 885, their disciples carried the tradition to the First Bulgarian Empire; the Preslav and Ohrid schools developed Cyrillic, which became the official script in 893, and the liturgy spread to Serbia, Croatia and the princes of Kievan Rus. By the twelfth century the language had absorbed local vernacular features and split into regional recensions, Russian, Serbian, Bulgarian and Croatian among them. Printing came early, with the Glagolitic Missale Romanum of 1483 and Cyrillic liturgical books printed in Kraków in 1491. In Russia the revised Synodal recension of the later seventeenth century served as the high literary language until secular Russian displaced it in the eighteenth century, leaving Church Slavonic to the liturgy.
zh: 教会斯拉夫语是斯拉夫东方基督徒的宗教文学语言，源自古教会斯拉夫语。9世纪60年代，萨洛尼卡的西里尔和美多德兄弟为前往大摩拉维亚传教，以格拉哥里字母首次把福音书和礼拜典籍译成斯拉夫语，奠定了这种语言。885年传教团被逐后，他们的弟子把这一传统带入第一保加利亚帝国；普雷斯拉夫和奥赫里德两大学派发展出西里尔字母，并于893年成为官方文字，这套礼拜传统随后传到塞尔维亚、克罗地亚和基辅罗斯诸公国。到12世纪，该语言吸收了各地方言特征，分化为俄罗斯、塞尔维亚、保加利亚、克罗地亚等地区校本。印刷术兴起得很早：1483年有格拉哥里字母的《罗马弥撒经本》，1491年克拉科夫又印出西里尔字母的礼仪书。在俄罗斯，17世纪后期修订的主教会议校本曾充当高雅文学语言，18世纪世俗俄语兴起后它才退出文坛，只保留在礼拜仪式之中。

en: Chuukese, formerly also spelled Trukese, is a Micronesian language of the Austronesian family, spoken chiefly on the islands of Chuuk Lagoon in the Caroline Islands. It belongs to the Chuukic subgroup, alongside close relatives such as Woleaian and Carolinian. Its speakers descend from Austronesian settlers linked to the Lapita culture, who had established villages on the lagoon's islands by the second and first centuries before Christ; a distinct Chuukese society had taken shape by the fourteenth century. The Spanish navigator Alvaro de Saavedra made the first recorded European sighting in 1528, and Alonso de Arellano visited the lagoon in 1565, after which Spain numbered the Carolines among its claimed possessions, though no real colonial administration reached Chuuk in this era. The language therefore remained unwritten, passed on orally between generations. A striking phonological feature is its allowance of word-initial geminate, or doubled, consonants, retained from the common ancestor of the western Micronesian languages while most sister languages lost it. The older spelling Truk and the newer Chuuk render the same sound.
zh: 楚克语旧称特鲁克语，是南岛语系密克罗尼西亚语族的语言，主要通行于加罗林群岛楚克礁湖的各岛屿。它属于楚克语支，与沃莱艾语、加罗林语等近亲语言同支。楚克人的先民是与拉皮塔文化有关的南岛语移民，在公元前2世纪至前1世纪已在礁湖各岛建立村落；到14世纪，独具面貌的楚克社会已经形成。1528年，西班牙航海家阿尔瓦罗·德·萨韦德拉首次留下欧洲人望见这些岛屿的记录，1565年阿隆索·德·阿雷利亚诺又到访礁湖，此后西班牙把加罗林群岛列入自己宣称的领地，但这一时期并没有真正的殖民管理延伸到楚克。楚克语也因此始终没有文字，靠世代口耳相传。它在语音上有一个醒目的特征：允许词首出现叠辅音，这一特点继承自西密克罗尼西亚诸语言的共同祖先，而多数姊妹语言后来都失去了它。旧拼写法“特鲁克”与较新的“楚克”记录的是同一个音。

en: Ciguayo was the language of the Samaná Peninsula of Hispaniola, in the present-day Dominican Republic, at the time of the Spanish Conquest. Its speakers seem to have predated the agricultural Taíno who occupied most of the island. The tongue was already moribund at contact and died out within a century, remembered only through a few recorded words.
zh: 西瓜约语是西班牙征服时期伊斯帕尼奥拉岛萨马纳半岛（今多米尼加共和国境内）的语言，使用者似乎早于占据岛上大部、从事农业的泰诺人。该语言在欧洲人到来时已濒临消亡，一个世纪内灭绝，仅留下少数有记录的词语。

en: Circassian is the main branch of the Northwest Caucasian language family, native to Circassia on the north-eastern Black Sea coast and spoken by a people who call themselves Adyghe. It exists in two closely related, mutually intelligible literary standards, Adyghe or West Circassian and Kabardian or East Circassian, while Abkhaz, Abaza and Ubykh are more distant relatives. Like them it is an ergative language with a large consonant inventory and an elaborate verbal system. Circassian had no native orthography before the nineteenth century, and Ottoman Turkish served as its literary medium; from the 1820s scholars such as the Kabardian poet Nogma devised Arabic-based alphabets, and in 1830 Nogma and the Russian orientalist Gratsilevsky produced a Cyrillic version, opening the way to writing down the spoken tribal dialects.
zh: 切尔克斯语是西北高加索语系的主要分支，母语区在黑海东北岸的切尔克西亚，使用者自称阿迪格人。它分为关系密切、彼此可互通的两种书面标准：阿迪格语（西切尔克斯语）和卡巴尔达语（东切尔克斯语），阿布哈兹语、阿巴扎语和乌比克语则是更远的亲属语言。与这些亲属语言一样，切尔克斯语属作格语言，辅音众多，动词系统繁复。19世纪以前它没有本族文字，书面场合使用奥斯曼土耳其语；19世纪20年代起，卡巴尔达诗人诺格马等学者设计了以阿拉伯字母为基础的文字，1830年诺格马又与俄国东方学家格拉齐列夫斯基制成西里尔字母版本，为各部落方言的书面化开辟了道路。

en: Kunza, also spelled Cunza or Ckunsa and called Likanantaí or Atacameño, is the extinct language of the Atacama people, whose self-name Likan Antay underlies the Licanantay label. It was spoken across the Atacama Desert and the neighbouring altiplano, in the oasis and salt-flat villages of northern Chile such as Peine, Socaire and San Pedro de Atacama, and across the borders into Argentina and Bolivia. What records survive show a polysynthetic tongue with a decimal number system, and no convincing relative has ever been found, so it is treated as a language isolate, although contact with Quechua, Aymara, Mochica and Mapudungun left traces on its vocabulary. Atacameño culture grew up in the desert oases from about the fifth century, came under Tiwanaku influence, and early in the fifteenth century was conquered by the Inca emperor Topa Inca Yupanqui, who brought the sun cult and Inca administration. Diego de Almagro's Spaniards reached the area in 1536 and it was annexed in 1557; in the eighteenth century Atacameño fighters such as Tomás Paniri joined the great Andean risings of Túpac Amaru II and Túpac Katari. Kunza remained in daily use into the nineteenth century before giving way to Spanish, preserved mainly in wordlists, place names and the speech of remote oasis villages.
zh: 昆萨语又称昆萨、利坎安泰语或阿塔卡梅尼奥语，是阿塔卡马人的语言，今已消亡；阿塔卡马人自称利坎·安泰，利坎安泰一名即由此而来。它曾通行于阿塔卡马沙漠及邻近高原，包括智利北部佩伊内、索凯尔、圣佩德罗-德阿塔卡马等绿洲与盐湖村落，并跨越边界延伸到阿根廷和玻利维亚。存世材料显示，昆萨语是一种多式综合语，采用十进位计数法；学者始终找不到它确凿的亲属语言，因此将其视为孤立语言，只在与克丘亚语、艾马拉语、穆奇克语和马普切语的接触中留下了词汇互借的痕迹。阿塔卡梅尼奥文化约从5世纪起在沙漠绿洲中发展，曾受蒂亚瓦纳科影响，15世纪初被印加皇帝图帕克·印卡·尤潘基征服，太阳神崇拜和印加行政制度随之传入。1536年阿尔马格罗率领的西班牙人抵达此地，1557年该地区被正式吞并；18世纪，托马斯·帕尼里等阿塔卡马战士加入了图帕克·阿马鲁二世和图帕克·卡塔里领导的安第斯大起义。昆萨语作为日常语言一直存续到19世纪，随后被西班牙语取代，主要靠词表、地名和偏远绿洲村落的用语保存下来。

en: Classical Chinese is the literary form of Chinese established around 500 BCE by the classics of Confucius and the Daoist masters. Written in a terse style in which nearly every character stands for an independent word, its grammar was imitated by scholars for millennia as Literary Chinese, the standard medium of government, history, philosophy and poetry across China until the early twentieth century. From the second century CE it spread to Korea, Japan, Vietnam and the Ryukyu Islands, where it long served as the language of administration, Buddhism and elite learning and bound these lands together into the Sinosphere. Conservative by convention, the written language kept its ancient grammar while spoken Chinese evolved, so that mastering it required years of formal schooling.
zh: 文言文是以公元前5世纪先秦典籍为典范确立的汉语书面语，特点是一字通常代表一个独立的词，行文简练。此后两千多年间，历代文人模仿其语法写作，形成古文传统，使文言成为中国官方文书、史学、哲学和诗歌的标准载体，直到20世纪初才被白话文取代。从2世纪起，文言随中国文化传入朝鲜、日本、越南和琉球，长期充当当地行政、佛教与精英教育的通用书面语，把这些地区联结为汉字文化圈。由于书面传统崇尚仿古，文言的语法与不断演变的口语差距日深，须经多年专门教育才能掌握。

en: Coahuilteco, also called Pakawa, was an indigenous language of southern Texas and northeastern Mexico, spoken by nomadic Coahuilteco bands across Coahuila, Nuevo Leon and Tamaulipas. It is usually treated as a language isolate, since the wider Coahuiltecan family once proposed for the many poorly recorded tongues of the region has never been proven. After Spanish missionaries founded the mission of San Antonio de Valero at San Antonio in 1718, Coahuilteco served as a lingua franca among the diverse native groups settled there, and the mission priests learned and recorded it. Most neighboring languages of the region vanished with their peoples between the sixteenth and nineteenth centuries and were never written down.
zh: 科阿韦尔特科语又称帕卡瓦语，曾通行于得克萨斯南部和墨西哥东北部，是游徙于科阿韦拉、新莱昂和塔毛利帕斯一带的科阿韦尔特科游牧群体的语言。它通常被视为孤立语言：学者曾把该地区许多记录稀少的语言归入一个更大的科阿韦尔特科语系，但这一划分始终未能证实。1718年西班牙传教士在圣安东尼奥建立巴莱罗传教站后，科阿韦尔特科语成为定居于此的各族原住民的通用语，传教士也学习并记录了这种语言。邻近地区的大多数语言随其族群在16至19世纪间消亡，从未留下记录。

en: Coptic is the final stage of the ancient Egyptian language, spoken in Egypt from the third century AD and written in an alphabet of Greek uncial letters supplemented by seven signs taken from Demotic Egyptian. Of its regional dialects, Sahidic became the pan-Egyptian literary standard between roughly 325 and 800, carrying the Bible translations and the Gnostic codices buried at Nag Hammadi, while Bohairic, the dialect of the Nile Delta, displaced it as the liturgical tongue of the Coptic Church from the ninth century onward. The Arab conquest of the 640s made Egypt part of the caliphate, and around 700 the Umayyad caliph Abd al-Malik imposed Arabic as the sole language of administration; Coptic remained the everyday speech of the native villages until the tenth century, when the persecution ordered by the Fatimid caliph al-Hakim drove it out of schools, streets and homes. The last known literary work in Coptic was composed in the late 1300s, and the language survived only as a minority spoken tongue into the 1600s, lingering in isolated Upper Egyptian hamlets still later. Thus across 1337 to 1837 Arabic dominated daily life in Egypt, while Coptic lived on above all in the Bohairic liturgy of the Coptic Orthodox Church, leaving a deep substratum in Egyptian Arabic vocabulary and grammar.
zh: 科普特语是古埃及语的最后阶段，自公元3世纪起通行于埃及，书写采用希腊安色尔字母，再补上七个借自世俗体埃及文的符号。它的各方言中，萨伊迪方言约在325—800年间成为全埃及的文学标准，圣经译本和埋藏于拿戈玛第的诺斯替教典籍都用它写成；尼罗河三角洲的布海拉方言则从9世纪起取而代之，成为科普特教会的礼仪用语。7世纪40年代阿拉伯征服后埃及并入哈里发国，约700年倭马亚哈里发阿卜杜勒‑马立克下令阿拉伯语成为唯一行政语言；不过直到10世纪，科普特语仍是土著村庄的日常语言，此后法蒂玛王朝哈里发哈基姆发起迫害，禁止在学校、街道甚至家中使用科普特语，加速了它的退场。已知最后一部科普特语文学作品创作于14世纪末，作为少数人口语的科普特语只延续到17世纪，在上埃及偏僻村落里留存的时间可能更久。因此在1337—1837年间，埃及日常生活已由阿拉伯语主导，科普特语主要借科普特正教会的布海拉方言礼仪存续，并在埃及阿拉伯语的词汇和语法里留下了深厚的底层痕迹。

en: Corachol, also called Cora-Huichol or Coran, is a branch of the Uto-Aztecan family of west-central Mexico, whose surviving languages are Huichol, spoken by the Wixaritari of the Sierra Madre Occidental in Jalisco and Nayarit, and Cora, the language of the Nayeri of the rugged Nayarit mountains. Both show the traits of the Mesoamerican language area and stand closest to the Nahuan languages; extinct or poorly known relatives include Totorame of the Nayarit coast, Tecual, and possibly Zacateco, Lagunero and Guachichil. The Wixaritari trace their origins to the San Luis Potosi country of the Guachichil and took refuge in the Bolanos Canyon among the Tepecano, rising with them against the Spanish at El Teul in 1592 and again at Nostic in 1702. The Cora kept missionaries out of their mountains longer than any neighboring people: a Spanish expedition failed against them in 1716, and only in 1722 did a large force bring them under colonial rule. The wider region had already been convulsed by the Mixton War of 1540 to 1542, when the Caxcanes and their allies tried in vain to drive the Spaniards of Nueva Galicia back, and by the long Chichimeca War that followed; the scattered Zacateco, Guachichil and kindred bands of those wars left little more than wordlists behind them.
zh: 科拉乔尔语又称科拉-惠乔尔语或科兰语，是墨西哥中西部犹他-阿兹特克语系的一个语支，现存两种语言：哈利斯科和纳亚里特西马德雷山区维萨里塔里人的惠乔尔语，以及纳亚里特深山纳亚里人的科拉语。两者都具有中部美洲语言区域的特征，与纳瓦语支最为接近；已消亡或记载稀少的近亲包括纳亚里特沿海的托托拉姆语、特夸尔语，以及可能归入的萨卡特科语、拉古内罗语和瓦奇奇尔语。维萨里塔里人自认源自圣路易斯波托西的瓦奇奇尔地区，后来到博拉尼奥斯峡谷的特佩卡诺人中避难，并于1592年在埃尔图尔、1702年在诺斯蒂克与他们联合反抗西班牙人。科拉人比周围任何民族都更久地把传教士挡在山外：1716年西班牙远征无功而返，直到1722年大军压境才将其纳入殖民统治。更广阔的地区此前已经历1540至1542年的米克斯顿战争，卡克斯卡人及其盟友试图把新加利西亚的西班牙人逐走却终归失败，随后又是漫长的奇奇梅卡战争；那些战争中流散的萨卡特科、瓦奇奇尔等群体只留下了零星的词汇表。

en: Cree, or Cree–Montagnais–Naskapi, is the great Algonquian dialect continuum of the Canadian north, stretching from Labrador and the Gulf of Saint Lawrence through James Bay to Alberta, its nine western and eastern groups bearing endonyms such as the Plains nêhiyawêwin and the Montagnais innu-Aimûn, and distinguished chiefly by their different reflexes of one Proto-Algonquian sound. It grew from a Proto-Algonquian dialect whose speakers left the Great Lakes homeland two and a half to three thousand years ago and split into eastern and western branches around James Bay. A polysynthetic language, Cree folds subject and object into the verb, divides nouns into animate and inanimate genders, and ranks third persons through obviation. After 1670, Cree families armed through the fur trade expanded west from James Bay across the boreal forest and onto the plains, and long contact with French and Ojibwe speakers gave rise to the mixed languages Michif and Oji-Cree.
zh: 克里语又称克里—蒙塔格奈—纳斯卡皮语，是加拿大北方庞大的阿尔冈昆方言连续体，东起拉布拉多和圣劳伦斯湾，经詹姆斯湾西抵艾伯塔，分为东西九支，各自有本地自称，如平原的内希雅威温语和蒙塔格奈的因努艾蒙语；各方言最显著的区别是对原始阿尔冈昆语同一个音的不同演变。它源自原始阿尔冈昆语的一种方言，其使用者在两千五百至三千年前离开五大湖故土，在詹姆斯湾一带分成东西两支。克里语是多式综合语，主语和宾语都折进动词之中，名词分有生命与无生命两类，并借助“另指”区分第三人称的主次。1670年以后，借助毛皮贸易获得火器的克里人从詹姆斯湾向西扩张，穿过北方针叶林直达平原；长期与法国人和奥吉布瓦人接触，又催生了米奇夫语、奥吉克里语等混合语言。

en: Cuicas was the language of the Cuica people, one of the two main branches of the Timoto–Cuica complex of the Venezuelan Andes, whose villages ran from Humocaro in the Lara highlands to Jajó in Trujillo, between the mountains above Lake Maracaibo and the edge of the Llanos. Whether Cuicas and the closely related Timote speech were one language or two is still unsettled, since the recorded vocabularies correspond closely; together they form a tongue with a decimal counting system and no demonstrated link to the surrounding Arawakan, Cariban or Chibchan families, though a few words suggest contact with the Jirajaran languages farther north. Its speakers were the most developed agricultural society of pre-conquest Venezuela: they built stone-faced irrigated terraces on the hillsides, laid out permanent planned villages of stone and timber houses, grew potatoes, ullucos and maize, and traded cacao beans as currency with Arawak and Carib neighbours. When the Spaniards pushed into these valleys the Cuicas received them peaceably, unlike the more warlike Timotes, and the foundation of Mérida in 1558 anchored colonial rule in the heart of their mountains; under that rule their communities were gradually absorbed into Spanish-speaking society, and the language lived on only in remote highland villages, never recorded in anything but fragmentary word lists.
zh: 奎卡斯语是奎卡人的语言。奎卡人是委内瑞拉安第斯山区蒂莫特—奎卡族群的两大支系之一，村落从拉腊高地的乌莫卡罗一直延伸到特鲁希略的哈霍，地处马拉开波湖以南的群山与亚诺斯草原边缘之间。奎卡斯语与亲缘极近的蒂莫特语究竟是一种语言还是两种，学界仍无定论，因为留存下来的词汇对应得非常紧密；两者共同构成一种采用十进位计数的语言，与周围的阿拉瓦克、加勒比、奇布查诸语系都没有经证实的亲缘关系，只有少量词语显示它与更北边的希拉哈拉诸语言有过接触。说这种语言的人拥有征服前委内瑞拉最发达的农业社会：他们在山坡上修筑石砌灌溉梯田，建造布局规整的永久性石木房屋村落，种植马铃薯、乌卢库和玉米，还用可可豆当货币，与阿拉瓦克和加勒比邻族贸易。西班牙人进入这些山谷时，奎卡人友善地接待了来客，不像更好战的蒂莫特人；1558年梅里达建城，把殖民统治锚定在他们山区的腹地。在殖民统治下，他们的村社逐渐被吸纳进西班牙语社会，奎卡斯语只在偏远高地村落里留存，后人得到的记录始终只有零碎的词表。

en: Cuitlatec is an extinct language isolate, unclassified within any accepted family, spoken along the Pacific coast and the Balsas river country of Guerrero, a land the Aztecs called Cuitlatecapan. The name is a Nahuatl exonym built from cuitlatl, a vulgar word for excrement, while the people called themselves a'nelgai. They may have been heirs of the Mezcala culture, and in the late Postclassic their coastal polity centered on Mexcaltepec, a town whose subject settlements included Acapulco and which Torquemada described as ruling eighty leagues of shoreline; the communities of the Balsas basin meanwhile fell under the Purepecha Empire, and the rest were subdued by Aztec campaigns such as Itzcoatl's of the 1430s. Numerous on the eve of contact, the Cuitlatec were agriculturalists who grew maize, cacao and cotton and had the reputation of fierce fighters, and they kept up armed resistance to the Spaniards for more than sixty years while epidemics emptied their towns, Mexcaltepec itself being abandoned by 1580. Colonial records nonetheless preserve the language: the Relacion de Ajuchitlan of 1579 notes local place names such as Tithichuc umo, meaning water with flowers, and the priest Martin de Espinosa y Monzon compiled a grammar of it at Ajuchitlan, where many speakers still lived in the mid-sixteenth century. The surviving wordlists and grammar sketches are all that remain of a tongue once current from the Costa Grande to the Tierra Caliente.
zh: 奎特拉特克语是一门已消亡的孤立语，无法归入任何公认的语系，曾通行于格雷罗的太平洋沿岸和巴尔萨斯河流域，阿兹特克人把那片土地称作奎特拉特卡潘。它的名字是纳瓦特尔语外来名，词根 cuitlatl 俗意为粪便，而当地人自称 a'nelgai。他们可能是梅斯卡拉文化的后继者；后古典期晚期，沿海政权以梅斯卡尔特佩克为中心，臣属村镇包括阿卡普尔科，托尔克马达称其统辖海岸长达八十里格；巴尔萨斯盆地的社群则被普雷佩查帝国征服，其余部分在15世纪30年代伊茨科阿特尔等阿兹特克战事中被降服。初遇西班牙人时人口众多的奎特拉特克人种植玉米、可可和棉花，以善战闻名，他们对西班牙人的武装抵抗持续了六十多年，瘟疫又使城镇空虚，梅斯卡尔特佩克本身在1580年前即遭废弃。尽管如此，殖民文献仍保存了这门语言：1579年的《阿胡奇特兰记述》记下了 Tithichuc umo（意为花之水）等地名，神父马丁·德·埃斯皮诺萨·伊·蒙松还在阿胡奇特兰为它编写语法，16世纪中叶那里仍有许多使用者。流传下来的词汇表和语法纲要，便是这门曾从大海岸通行到热土地区的语言仅存的痕迹。

en: Culli, also spelled Culle or called Ilinga, was the language of the Andean highlands of northern Peru, covering the high country of La Libertad, southern Cajamarca and northern Áncash. It was the tongue of at least three pre-Inca polities, the kingdoms of Conchucos, Huamachuco and southern Cuismanco; the Huamachuco lordship kept the famous oracle of the thunder god Catequil at Namanchugo, a sanctuary later wrecked by Atahualpa and Spanish priests. The Incas conquered the region around 1470 and installed mitmaq settlers, and in 1553 Augustinian missionaries founded the new town of Huamachuco on the Inca settlement. Poorly recorded, Culli survives mainly in word lists, including an eighteenth-century manuscript compiled by Bishop Martínez Compañón, in loanwords and place names such as Huamachuco itself, whose chuco means land; its wider relationships remain undetermined, and Spanish gradually replaced it.
zh: 库利语又译库列语，亦称伊林加语，曾通行于秘鲁北部的安第斯高原，范围包括拉利伯塔德的山区、卡哈马卡南部和安卡什北部。它至少是三个前印加政权——孔丘科斯、瓦马丘科和奎斯曼科南部——的语言；瓦马丘科领主境内有雷神卡特基尔的著名神谕所纳曼丘戈，后来被阿塔瓦尔帕和西班牙神父捣毁。印加人约在1470年征服此地，迁入米特马克移民；1553年，奥古斯丁会传教士在印加聚落的基础上建立了新的瓦马丘科城。库利语记录很少，主要靠几份词汇表留存，其中包括马丁内斯·康帕尼翁主教在18世纪汇编的手稿，另外还残留在借词和地名里——比如瓦马丘科一名中的“丘科”就是“土地”的意思。它与其他语言的亲缘关系没有定论，后来逐渐被西班牙语取代。

en: Itoto Majun, long recorded in Spanish sources as Cumanagoto or Chaima, is a Cariban language of the Venezuelan coast, once heard from the Paria Peninsula westward to the Lake of Valencia. Its speakers called it choto maimuru, the tongue of the people, and although many peoples bore separate names, among them the Cumanagoto, Chaima, Guaiquerí, Píritu and Pariagoto, colonial writers found they understood one another with only dialectal differences. The Spanish built missions among them in the seventeenth century: the short-lived Province of New Catalonia, founded in 1633 and also called the Province of the Cumanagotos, was merged into New Andalusia in 1654. Franciscan friars then studied the language for preaching, Manuel de Yangües completing a grammar in 1663 and Francisco de Tauste printing his grammar and vocabulary of the Chaima and Cumanagoto tongue in 1680. It was long one of the leading Indigenous languages of the Cumaná region.
zh: 库马纳语本名伊托托·马洪，在西班牙文献中又常记作库马纳戈托语或查伊马语，是委内瑞拉沿海的加勒比语族语言，昔日通行于帕里亚半岛向西直到巴伦西亚湖一带。使用者自称其语言为乔托·迈穆鲁，意为“人的语言”；库马纳戈托、查伊马、瓜伊克里、皮里图、帕里亚戈托等族群名称各异，但殖民时代的记载表明他们彼此能通话，只有方言差别。17世纪西班牙人在他们中间建立传教区：1633年设立、别称“库马纳戈托省”的新加泰罗尼亚省存在不长，1654年并入新安达卢西亚省。方济各会修士为布道而研习这种语言，曼努埃尔·德·扬格斯于1663年写成语法，弗朗西斯科·德·陶斯特于1680年刊行查伊马语和库马纳语的语法与词汇。它长期是库马纳地区主要的原住民语言之一。

en: Czechoslovak is the West Slavic dialect continuum of Bohemia, Moravia and Slovakia, flanked by its cousin Sorbian in Lusatia. Its dialects emerged from common West Slavic between the 900s and 1100s, after the Magyar invasion of the 890s broke up the Great Moravian realm, and Czech and Slovak first appear in writing in the 1200s and 1300s; by the late 1300s Czech was used in official documents. The Kralice Bible, printed in Moravia between 1579 and 1593, fixed the model for standard Czech, and the Bohemian diet tried to make Czech the kingdom's sole official language in 1615, only for the defeat of the Bohemian Revolt to open an age of German dominance. Slovak, long written in Czech forms, only received a written standard of its own in the nineteenth century through Ludovit Stur's codification of the central Slovak dialect. Sorbian, two written languages in Upper and Lower Lusatia, was pressed back by German settlement and official discrimination from the 1200s onward, and Bible translations of the Reformation era gave it its literary form.
zh: 捷克斯洛伐克语是波希米亚、摩拉维亚和斯洛伐克的西斯拉夫方言连续体，其近亲还有卢萨蒂亚的索布语。890年代马扎尔人入侵、大摩拉维亚国解体之后，它的各方言在10至12世纪从共同西斯拉夫语中分化出来，捷克语和斯洛伐克语最早的书面材料出现在13至14世纪，到14世纪末捷克语已用于官方文书。1579至1593年在摩拉维亚印行的《克拉利采圣经》奠定了标准捷克语的范式；1615年波希米亚议会试图把捷克语定为王国唯一官方语言，但波希米亚起义失败后，德意志语言随之进入主导时代。长期借用捷克语书面形式的斯洛伐克语，到19世纪才经卢多维特·什图尔规范中斯洛伐克方言，有了自己的书面标准。卢萨蒂亚的上、下两种索布书面语，自13世纪起不断受到德意志移民和官方歧视的挤压，宗教改革时期的圣经译本赋予了它文学形态。

en: Dagan, also called the Meneao Range languages, is a small family of the Southeast Papuan branch of the Trans-New Guinea phylum, spoken in the Meneao Range on the Bird's Tail, the southeastern peninsula of New Guinea. These are the easternmost Papuan, or non-Austronesian, languages on the New Guinea mainland, and the family is the most divergent of the several small groups that make up the Southeast Papuan branch. Its members include Daga, also known as Dimuga, Maiwa, Mapena, Onjob, Kanasi, Ginuman, Dima and Umanakaina, spoken by mountain villages split between the Milne Bay and Central districts. The kinship between them is loose: Ginuman and Umanakaina share only about a quarter of their vocabulary. When the Spanish navigator Yñigo Ortiz de Retez coined the name New Guinea in 1545, and again when Torres sailed the island's southern waters in 1606, these remote inland valleys remained well beyond the reach of the coastal expeditions.
zh: 达甘语又称梅内奥岭诸语言，是跨新几内亚语系东南巴布亚语支下的一个小语族，通行于新几内亚“鸟尾”东南半岛的梅内奥岭山区。它们是新几内亚大陆上位置最靠东的巴布亚诸语言，即非南岛语，也是东南巴布亚语支各小语族中分化最深的一支。其成员包括又称迪穆加语的达加语、迈瓦语、马佩纳语、翁乔布语、卡纳西语、吉努曼语、迪马语和乌马纳凯纳语，由米尔恩湾省与中央省分界一带的山村居民使用。各语言之间的亲缘相当松散：吉努曼语和乌马纳凯纳语的词汇重合度只有四分之一左右。1545年西班牙航海家伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德·雷特斯为新几内亚岛命名时，以及1606年托雷斯驶过该岛南部海域时，这些偏远的内陆山谷都远在沿海探险队的足迹之外。

en: Dagestanian groups the languages of the Nakh-Daghestanian, or Northeast Caucasian, family, a dense cluster native to the eastern Caucasus, from Dagestan, Chechnya and Ingushetia into northern Azerbaijan. Its three dozen members include Chechen and Ingush in the Nakh branch and Avar, Dargwa, Lak and Lezgin among the Dagestanian branches; isolated by highland valleys, they diverged sharply and are noted for elaborate consonants and large case systems, some counting more than fifty cases. The earliest written member was Caucasian Albanian, whose fifty-two-letter alphabet was created in the early 400s for the church of Caucasian Albania and whose line survives in Udi. After that tradition died out, Armenian and Georgian served as literary media; Avar was now and then written in the Georgian alphabet from the 1300s, and Perso-Arabic ajam glosses appeared from the 1400s, while Avar itself acted as the highlands' lingua franca beside the literary idioms of Lak, Dargwa and Lezgin.
zh: 达吉斯坦语指纳赫—达吉斯坦语系，即东北高加索语系的诸语言，是东高加索山区一个密集的语言群，分布于达吉斯坦、车臣、印古什直至阿塞拜疆北部，约有三十余种语言：纳赫一支有车臣语和印古什语，达吉斯坦各支则有阿瓦尔语、达尔格瓦语、拉克语和列兹金语。高山峡谷的阻隔使这些语言分化显著，以繁复的辅音和庞大的格系统著称，有些语言的格超过五十个。该语系最早的书面成员是高加索阿尔巴尼亚语：5世纪初有人为高加索阿尔巴尼亚教会创制了含五十二个字母的文字，其支系遗存于乌迪语。这一传统消亡后，书面场合改用亚美尼亚语和格鲁吉亚语；14世纪起阿瓦尔语偶有用格鲁吉亚字母拼写者，15世纪起又出现波斯—阿拉伯字母的阿贾姆注释，而阿瓦尔语本身是达吉斯坦高地的通用语，与拉克语、达尔格瓦语和列兹金语的书面传统并存。

en: The Daju languages form a branch of the Eastern Sudanic group within the Nilo-Saharan family, spoken in scattered pockets by the Daju people across Darfur and Kordofan in Sudan and Wadai in Chad. They fall into western and eastern branches, a spread that reflects the history of the Daju state. Daju tradition traces the people to the Nile valley, from which they moved west after the Aksumite sack of Meroe in the fourth century; by the twelfth century a Daju kingdom had arisen in the fertile Marrah Mountains of Darfur, the only highland there able to support a large population. War with the Nubian kingdom of Dongola around 1100 pushed its centre deeper into Jebel Marra, and about 1400 the Egyptian writer al-Maqrizi could still describe Taju, as he called it, as a powerful kingdom lying between Kanem and the Nile states. In the fourteenth century the Tunjur overran the Daju dynasty: the king fled west to Dar Sila in Chad with part of his people, while other groups migrated east into Kordofan, leaving the related languages separated in isolated pockets.
zh: 达朱语是尼罗—撒哈拉语系东苏丹语族的一个分支，由达朱人分成若干孤立小片使用，分布在苏丹的达尔富尔和科尔多凡以及乍得的瓦达伊一带。它分为西支和东支，这种分布正对应达朱古国的历史。达朱人的传说称其祖先来自尼罗河谷，在4世纪阿克苏姆军队洗劫麦罗埃后西迁；到12世纪，一个达朱王国在达尔富尔肥沃的马拉山脉兴起，那里是当地唯一能养活大量人口的高原。约1100年与努比亚栋古拉王国的战争，把其统治中心进一步逼入杰贝勒马拉腹地；而到1400年前后，埃及作家马克利齐仍把他称作塔朱的这个王国，描述为夹在卡涅姆与尼罗河诸王国之间的强国。14世纪，通朱尔人攻灭达朱王朝：国王率部分部众西逃乍得的达尔西拉，其余群体东迁科尔多凡，使这些彼此亲缘的语言散成一座座孤立的小岛。

en: Dakhni, also called Deccani, is an Indo-Aryan language variety of the Deccan plateau, born from the Hindustani speech of the Delhi region carried south by soldiers, settlers and traders. In 1327 Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq moved his capital from Delhi to Daulatabad, taking much of its population with him; after the Bahmani Sultanate was founded in 1347 the transplanted dialect became the region's lingua franca and took its name Dakhni from the Deccan itself. Persian, the court language, supplied much of its learned vocabulary, while contact with Marathi, Kannada and Telugu added local words and shaped its sounds. Sufi preachers spread it among the people, and the earliest surviving manuscript, Kadam Rao Padam Rao, was composed around Bidar. From the early sixteenth century the sultanates of Bijapur and Golconda made Dakhni a literary language: Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah wrote secular poetry in it and Ibrahim Adil Shah II composed his Book of the Nine Rasas entirely in Dakhni, and this tradition later fed the rise of standard Urdu.
zh: 德干语又称德卡尼语，是德干高原上的一支印度—雅利安语言，源自德里地区的印度斯坦语，由南征的士兵、移民和商人带到南方。1327年，苏丹穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克把首都从德里迁往道拉塔巴德，整座都城的人口随之南迁，也把北方方言带到德干；1347年巴赫曼尼苏丹国建立后，这种方言成为当地的通用语，并按德干之地得名“德干语”。宫廷使用的波斯语为它提供了大量文雅词汇，而与马拉地语、卡纳达语和泰卢固语的长期接触又增添了地方借词并改变了它的语音。苏菲派教士用它向民众传教，现存最早的德干语手抄本《卡达姆·拉奥·帕达姆·拉奥》便成书于比达尔一带。16世纪初起，比贾布尔和戈尔康达等德干苏丹国把德干语培育成文学语言：穆罕默德·库利·库特布沙赫用它创作世俗诗歌，易卜拉欣·阿迪勒沙赫二世的《九情之书》更是全以德干语写成。这一文学传统后来直接滋养了标准乌尔都语的兴起。

en: Dakota, self-designated Dakhótiyapi, is the eastern member of the Dakota-Lakota continuum within the Siouan-Catawban family, spoken by the Santee and Yankton-Yanktonai divisions of the Očhéthi Šakówiŋ, or Seven Council Fires, commonly called the Sioux; it is mutually intelligible with Lakota, while the more distant Assiniboine and Stoney form the related Nakota speech. The word Dakota means ally or friend. Before the seventeenth century the Santee lived around Lake Superior as wild-rice gatherers and canoe fishermen, but wars with the French-armed Ojibwe through the 1700s pushed them west into Minnesota and then onto the Great Plains, where they took up horses and the bison hunt. Dakota was traditionally written in pictographs used to keep the winter counts, calendars of yearly events painted on hides. John Marsh compiled the first dictionary in 1827, and from 1836 the Pond brothers, Stephen Riggs and Thomas Williamson devised a Latin-based orthography for translating hymns and scripture, giving the language its first stable written form.
zh: 达科他语自称达科蒂亚皮语，是苏—卡托巴语系达科他—拉科塔语连续体的东部成员，由七堆火联盟（通称苏人）中的桑蒂人和扬克顿—扬克托奈人使用；它与拉科塔语可以互通，关系更远的阿西尼博因语和斯托尼语则构成相近的纳科塔语。达科他一词意为盟友或朋友。17世纪以前，桑蒂人住在苏必利尔湖一带，采集野米、划独木舟捕鱼；18世纪，与持有法式火枪的奥吉布瓦人的连年战争把他们向西赶入明尼苏达，继而推进到大平原，他们在那里改用马匹猎捕野牛。达科他语传统上用图画文字书写，用以在兽皮上绘制逐年记事的冬历。1827年，约翰·马什编成第一部词典；1836年起，庞德兄弟、斯蒂芬·里格斯和托马斯·威廉姆森制定了拉丁字母拼写法，用于翻译赞美诗和经文，这种语言才有了稳定的书面形式。

en: Daly is the name given to the cluster of Indigenous Australian languages spoken around the Daly River and the adjacent coast of the Northern Territory, among them Murrinh-Patha, Marrithiyel and Kungarakany. When the first British colony in Australia was founded in 1788, these were the sole languages of the Daly river country. Classed among the non-Pama–Nyungan languages, they share vocabulary and grammar through long contact rather than proven common descent, and linguists have variously treated them as one family or as four or five separate families and isolates. Murrinh-Patha, whose name means ‘good language’, is the best documented of the group: it is written in a Latin orthography and has an intricate verb morphology, while smaller tongues such as Kungarakany belonged to the Adelaide and Daly river country.
zh: 戴利语是对北领地戴利河及邻近沿海一带原住民诸语言的统称，代表语言有穆林帕塔语、马里蒂耶尔语和昆加拉卡尼语。1788年英国在澳大利亚建立第一个殖民地时，它们还是戴利河流域唯一的语言。它们属于非帕马—恩永甘语言，彼此因长期接触而在词汇和语法上多有共通之处，学者对其归属意见不一，或视为一个语族，或拆成四五个独立语族和孤立语言。其中穆林帕塔语的名字意为‘好的语言’，在这组语言中记录最充分，采用拉丁字母书写，动词形态繁复；昆加拉卡尼等较小的语言则通行于阿德莱德河与戴利河流域。

en: The Danao languages form a subgroup of the Central Philippine branch of the Austronesian family, spoken in the lake and river basins of Mindanao in the southern Philippines. Its three members are Maranao around Lake Lanao, Maguindanaon in the Cotabato lowlands and the Pulangi basin, and Iranun on the coasts between them, all descended from a reconstructed Proto-Danao tongue. With the coming of Islam in the early sixteenth century their speakers adopted the Perso-Arabic Jawi script, and Maguindanaon became the language of the Sultanate of Maguindanao, which dominated western Mindanao until Spanish pressure wore it down in the nineteenth century. Iranun sailors ranged the Sulu and Celebes seas as feared raiders in the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries. Under Spanish rule the Latin alphabet gradually displaced Jawi, and the British captain Thomas Forrest published a vocabulary of the Maguindanao tongue in 1779.
zh: 达瑙语是南岛语系菲律宾语支下的一组语言，通行于菲律宾南部棉兰老岛的湖泊与河流流域，包括拉瑙湖一带的马拉瑙语、哥打巴托低地和普兰吉河流域的马京达瑙语，以及两者之间沿海的伊拉农语，三者都由构拟出的原始达瑙语演变而来。16世纪初伊斯兰教传入后，当地居民改用波斯—阿拉伯字母系统的爪夷文书写，马京达瑙语也成为马京达瑙苏丹国的语言；该苏丹国曾长期支配棉兰老岛西部，直到19世纪在西班牙人的压力下逐渐衰落。18至19世纪初，伊拉农水手在苏禄海和苏拉威西海以海上劫掠闻名。西班牙统治时期，拉丁字母逐渐取代爪夷文，英国船长托马斯·福里斯特于1779年出版了一部马京达瑙语词汇表。

en: Dayak in this grouping denotes the Land Dayak languages, the dozen or so Malayo-Polynesian tongues of the Bidayuh or Land Dayaks of north-western Borneo, who live around Kuching and Serian in southern Sarawak and across the border in the Sanggau lands of West Kalimantan. Their dialects, among them Biatah, Singai-Jagoi and the mutually unintelligible Bukar-Sadong of Serian, differ so greatly from village to village that Malay has long served as their common language. The word Dayak comes from Bruneian and Melanau speech, where it meant the interior or upstream people, and Bidayuh itself means inhabitants of the land; European writers later broadened it into an umbrella term for the non-Muslim natives of Borneo. As Brunei built its sultanate from 1368 and stretched its power along the Borneo coasts, the Bidayuh kept to inland river villages, practising rice farming and an animist paddy-spirit religion with harvest rites, while the Bukar preserved the custom of laying out their dead on platforms and hanging trees.
zh: 达雅语在这一划分中指陆地达雅语，即比达友人（陆地达雅人）使用的十余种马来—波利尼西亚语言，分布在婆罗洲西北部沙捞越南部的古晋、西连一带，以及西加里曼丹边境的桑高地区。它的方言包括比亚塔、新加伊—雅戈伊和西连互不相通的布卡尔—萨东等，村与村之间差异很大，马来语长期充当共同语。达雅一词来自文莱语和梅拉瑙语，意为内陆或上游之人，比达友本身则意为土地上的居民；欧洲学者后来把它扩大为婆罗洲非穆斯林原住民的统称。文莱自1368年建立苏丹国并把势力伸展到婆罗洲沿海后，比达友人仍固守内陆河畔村落，种植水稻，信奉以稻灵为核心的万物有灵信仰并举行丰收祭仪，布卡尔人还保留把死者安放在架台和悬树上的葬俗。

en: Dhegiha is the western Siouan branch comprising Kansa-Osage, Omaha-Ponca and Quapaw, each pair mutually intelligible; its name means those who dwell here. Around 1600 its speakers still formed one Woodland group in the lower Ohio River valley. Haudenosaunee pressure in the Beaver Wars drove them west of the Mississippi after 1600, where they split into the historic tribes: the Quapaw, or downstream people, who settled the mouth of the Arkansas River and were met there by Jacques Marquette in 1673, the French rendering their Illini name as Arkansas; the Osage on the Missouri; the Kansa on the Kansas River; and the Omaha, whose Ponca kinsmen split off in the mid-eighteenth century. The Omaha became the first Northern Plains horse people about 1770, and their Big Village, Ton-wa-tonga, dominated the upper Missouri fur trade until smallpox killed about a third of them around 1800, including Chief Blackbird. By then the Osage dominated the country between the Missouri and Red rivers, while the Quapaw were forced out of Arkansas Territory in 1834.
zh: 德吉哈语是苏语族的西部分支，包括坎萨—奥塞奇语、奥马哈—蓬卡语和夸保语，每一对都可互通；德吉哈一名的意思是居住于此的人。1600年前后，说这些语言的人还是俄亥俄河下游谷地的一个林地民族群体。海狸战争中霍德诺索尼人的逼迫把他们赶过密西西比河，共同体在西迁中分裂为后世各支：自称下游人的夸保人定居阿肯色河河口，1673年雅克·马凯特在那里见到他们，法国人把伊利尼语对他们的称呼转写成阿肯色；奥塞奇人住在密苏里河畔；坎萨人住在坎萨斯河畔；奥马哈人的近亲蓬卡人则在18世纪中叶分出。约1770年，奥马哈人成为北部平原最早的骑马民族，他们的大村庄通瓦通加主导着密苏里河上游的毛皮贸易，直到约1800年天花夺去约三分之一人口，酋长布莱克伯德也未能幸免。此时奥塞奇人已称霸密苏里河与雷德河之间，而夸保人于1834年被逐出阿肯色领地。

en: Dinka, called Thuɔŋjäŋ by its speakers, is a Western Nilotic language of the Nilo-Saharan family, spoken by the Dinka people along the White Nile and around the Sudd swamps of southern Sudan, with related varieties reaching into Kordofan. It is really a chain of largely mutually intelligible dialects, among them Rek, Malual, Padang, Bor and Agaar, whose grammar depends heavily on tone and vowel quality; its closest relative is Nuer, with the Luo languages next of kin. The Dinka once lived in the Gezira under the medieval Nubian kingdom of Alodia, from which the language took a sizable Nubian vocabulary; when Alodia crumbled from the thirteenth century they began moving south, and the drift continued from the fifteenth to the eighteenth century after the Funj built their sultanate at Soba in 1504, as Nilotic groups competed for pasture and cattle. The Egyptian conquest of the Funj realm in 1821 then opened the White Nile to traders and slave raiders, bringing the Dinka and their Nuer kinsmen into a harsher frontier on the edge of Egyptian Sudan.
zh: 丁卡语自称通江语（Thuɔŋjäŋ），属尼罗—撒哈拉语系西尼罗特语支，由丁卡人沿白尼罗河、在苏丹南部的苏德沼泽一带使用，相近的方言一直延伸到科尔多凡。它实际上是一条大多可互通的方言链，雷克、马卢阿尔、帕当、博尔和阿加尔等方言的语法高度依赖声调和元音音质；最近的亲属是努埃尔语，其次是卢奥诸语。丁卡人曾居住在杰济拉，臣属中世纪努比亚人的阿洛迪亚王国，丁卡语也因此吸收了大量努比亚语词汇；13世纪阿洛迪亚崩溃后他们开始南迁，1504年丰吉人在索巴建立苏丹国，此后从15世纪到18世纪迁徙仍在继续，尼罗特诸群体为牧场和牛群彼此竞争。1821年埃及攻灭丰吉政权，白尼罗河向商队和猎奴者敞开，丁卡人和与他们同源的努埃尔人被推入埃及苏丹边缘更严酷的新边疆。

en: The Djeragan, or Jarragan, languages are a small non-Pama Nyungan family of the East Kimberley in northern Western Australia, held in the country between Halls Creek and Kununurra that takes in the Ord River and the Bungle Bungle Range. Their name comes from jarrag, the Gija word for language. The family comprises three languages in two groups: Gija stands alone, while Miriwoong and Gajirrawoong form the second group, so close that some scholars treat them as one language; a fourth tongue, Doolboong, is too poorly recorded to place with certainty. When Dutch mariners made the first recorded European landing in Australia in 1606, the Djeragan languages were unwritten and sustained wholly by oral tradition.
zh: 杰拉甘诸语言，又称贾拉甘诸语言，是西澳大利亚东部金伯利地区的一个小型非帕马‑尼永加语系，分布在霍尔兹克里克至库努纳拉之间，包括奥德河与邦格尔邦格尔山脉一带。它的名字来自基贾语中表示语言的贾拉格一词。该语系的三种语言分为两组：基贾语自成一组，米里翁语和加吉拉翁语组成另一组，二者关系极近，有学者干脆视为一种语言；第四种多尔布翁语记录太少，归属尚不能确定。1606年荷兰航海者首次有记载地登陆澳大利亚时，杰拉甘诸语言还没有文字，完全依靠口耳相传。

en: The Dogon languages form a small, tightly knit family of about a dozen languages spoken by the Dogon people along the Bandiagara Escarpment south of the Niger bend in central Mali, with some speakers in Burkina Faso. Their place within the proposed Niger-Congo family is uncertain, and they are often treated as an independent branch; the nearby Bangime language is regarded as an isolate. They are tonal languages with a subject-object-verb word order, and the varieties of the escarpment and the plains, such as Toro So and Jamsay, are often mutually unintelligible. From around the eleventh century the Dogon withdrew from Muslim-ruled lands into the defensible cliff country, and by the 1400s they had reached the Sanga region; their speech preserves the divisions of these several migrant groups.
zh: 多贡语是由十几种彼此关系紧密的语言组成的小语支，由马里中部尼日尔河河湾以南班迪亚加拉悬崖一带的多贡人使用，布基纳法索也有分布。它在尼日尔—刚果语系中的归属尚无定论，常被视为独立的语支；邻近的班吉梅语则被归为孤立语言。多贡诸语为声调语言，语序为主宾动，悬崖区与平原区的方言（如托罗索语和占姆萨伊语）彼此往往不能互通。约从11世纪起，多贡人为躲避穆斯林政权的统治不断退守到易守难攻的悬崖地带，到15世纪已抵达桑加地区，他们的语言也保留了这些不同移民群体之间的分野。

en: Drehu, whose speakers call it qene drehu and which was long known to outsiders as Dehu or Lifou, is a Kanak language of the Loyalty Islands subgroup of Oceanic Austronesian, spoken chiefly on Lifou Island east of Grande Terre. Its ancestors were the Lapita seafarers who carried Proto-Oceanic through Island Melanesia from about 1600 BCE and reached the Loyalty Islands in the course of that expansion. Drehu was traditionally an oral language, and alongside ordinary speech it possessed a separate honorific register called qene miny, reserved for addressing a chief.
zh: 德雷胡语的使用者自称克内德雷胡，外界长期称其为德胡语或利富语；它是南岛语系大洋洲语族洛亚蒂群岛分支的卡纳克语言，主要通行于格朗德特尔岛以东的利富岛。其祖先是约公元前1600年起把原始大洋洲语传遍美拉尼西亚群岛的拉皮塔航海者，洛亚蒂群岛正是在这场扩张中被抵达的。德雷胡语传统上没有文字，除日常用语外还有一套称为克内米尼的敬语，专门用于对酋长讲话。

en: Duau is a dialectically diverse Oceanic language of the Papuan Tip cluster, belonging to the Dobu–Duau linkage alongside Dobu, Molima, Bunama and Galeya. It is spoken on Normanby Island, the southernmost of the D'Entrecasteaux Islands off the eastern tip of New Guinea, above all in the Duau district of the island's southeast. The closely related Dobu speech of nearby Dobu Island serves as a lingua franca across the whole archipelago, while the islanders, who farm yams and taro on narrow coastal plains and fish the surrounding Solomon Sea, take part in the kula, the inter-island circuit of ceremonial shell exchange. The D'Entrecasteaux group was first sighted by Europeans in 1792, when the French navigator Bruni d'Entrecasteaux sailed through these waters.
zh: 杜奥语是巴布亚尖端语群的一支大洋语，方言繁多，与多布语、莫利马语、布纳马语和加莱亚语同属多布—杜奥语链。它通行于新几内亚东端外海当特尔卡斯托群岛最南端的诺曼比岛，尤其是该岛东南部的杜奥地区。邻近多布岛上与它亲缘密切的多布语是整个群岛的通用语；岛民在狭窄的沿海平原种植山药和芋头，在所罗门海捕鱼，并参与库拉圈——岛际之间巡回交换礼仪贝壳的贸易网络。欧洲人最早在1792年望见当特尔卡斯托群岛，当时法国航海家布吕尼·当特尔卡斯托乘船驶过这片海域。

en: East Cushitic is the largest branch of the Cushitic family and, through it, of the Afroasiatic phylum, spread across the Horn of Africa from the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden coasts to the Ethiopian highlands and northern Kenya. It splits into the Highland languages, among them Sidama, Hadiyya and Kambaata, and the Lowland group, which includes Oromo in its Oromoid branch and Somali in the Omo-Tana branch, as well as Saho-Afar, the Dullay languages and the divergent Dahalo of the Kenyan coast. In the fourteenth century the Somali-speaking Ifat and Adal sultanates dominated the trade routes between the Ethiopian highlands and the sea, and the earliest written use of the name Somali appears in an Ethiopian hymn of the early fifteenth century. The long Ethiopian-Adal war of 1529 to 1543 exhausted both sides, and from about 1530 Oromo pastoralists, organized under their eight-year gadaa cycle, began expanding north from the southern highlands, absorbing the peoples they met and carrying Oromo across much of central Ethiopia. While Somali and Afar turned increasingly to Islam and Arabic letters, the Highland East Cushitic peoples kept their place within the Christian Ethiopian orbit, their languages alive in the farming country south of the Blue Nile.
zh: 东库希特语是库希特语族最大的分支，而库希特语族又属亚非语系；它分布在非洲之角，从红海和亚丁湾沿岸延伸到埃塞俄比亚高原和肯尼亚北部。它分为高地语支与低地语支：前者包括锡达马语、哈迪亚语和坎巴塔语等，后者则有奥罗莫语支的奥罗莫语、奥莫—塔纳语支的索马里语，以及萨霍—阿法尔语、杜莱诸语和肯尼亚沿海差异很大的达哈洛语。14世纪，讲索马里语的伊法特和阿达尔苏丹国控制着埃塞俄比亚高原与海洋之间的商路；“索马里”一名最早的书面记录，见于15世纪初埃塞俄比亚的一首颂诗。1529—1543年漫长的埃塞俄比亚—阿达尔战争使双方两败俱伤，约1530年起，按八年一轮的加达制度组织起来的奥罗莫牧民从南部高原向北扩张，沿途吸收相遇的族群，把奥罗莫语带到埃塞俄比亚中部大片地区。索马里人和阿法尔人日益转向伊斯兰教与阿拉伯字母，高地东库希特诸族则留在信奉基督教的埃塞俄比亚势力圈内，他们的语言在青尼罗河以南的农耕地带延续下来。

en: Russian is the North-Eastern branch of East Slavic, descended from the Old East Slavic of Kievan Rus, whose earliest surviving written trace is an inscription on an amphora at Gnezdovo from the middle of the 900s. For centuries writing meant Church Slavonic in Cyrillic, while the vernacular showed its own forms from the 1000s onward. Nowhere is that spoken language closer at hand than in Novgorod, whose birch bark letters of the 1000s to 1400s preserve the conservative Old Novgorod dialect in private notes, complaints and even the school exercises of the boy Onfim, pointing to wide literacy among townspeople, women and children included. After Kiev fell to the Mongols in 1240 the language developed on its own, and with the rise of Moscow in the late 1400s the Muscovite dialect became its centre; Russian and the western Ruthenian written form were clearly distinct by then. Church Slavonic long kept its hold on literature, yielding only in the Petrine age, when the reforms of Peter the Great in 1708 to 1710 introduced a simplified civil script and opened the way for a modern standard built on Moscow speech.
zh: 俄语是东斯拉夫语的东北支，源于基辅罗斯的古东斯拉夫语；现存最早的文字痕迹是10世纪中期格涅兹多沃一只陶罐上的铭文。在漫长的岁月里，书面语意味着西里尔字母写成的教会斯拉夫语，而口语自11世纪起已显出自身的特征。要贴近当时的口语，没有比诺夫哥罗德更好的窗口：11至15世纪的桦皮文献用保守的古诺夫哥罗德方言记下私人便条、诉状，甚至男孩昂菲姆的课业，表明市民——包括妇女和儿童——中识字率相当高。1240年基辅陷落后，这门语言独立发展；随着15世纪末莫斯科崛起，莫斯科方言成为其中心，俄语与西部的鲁塞尼亚书面语至此泾渭分明。教会斯拉夫语长期把持文学，直到彼得大帝时代才退让：1708至1710年的改革推出简化的民用字体，为以莫斯科话为基础的近代书面标准铺平了道路。

en: Eastern Otomanguean is the eastern grouping of the Oto-Manguean family, a cluster of tonal, verb-first languages whose common ancestor was spoken in southern Mexico more than four thousand years ago, perhaps by the early farming peoples of the Tehuacan Valley. It unites five branches: the Zapotecan languages of the Valley of Oaxaca and the Isthmus of Tehuantepec, the Mixtecan tongues of La Mixteca across Oaxaca, Puebla and Guerrero, the Popolocan group of southern Puebla and northern Oaxaca, the Amuzgo of the Costa Chica, and the Chinantecan languages of the northern Oaxaca sierras. Its speakers built some of Mesoamerica's earliest cities: the Zapotecs founded Monte Alban around 500 BCE and carved one of the region's first writing systems, while the Mixtecs, who call themselves Ñuu Savi, the people of the rain, painted genealogical codices on deerskin and under Lord Eight Deer Jaguar Claw united much of the Mixteca from Tilantongo. In the Postclassic period the expanding Nahuas overshadowed these older peoples: Aztec armies defeated the Mixtecs and Zapotecs in 1458 and built the Huaxyacac fortress in 1486 to enforce tribute, while the Zapotecs fought on at Guiengola until around 1500. Both peoples submitted to Francisco de Orozco in 1521, and their lands entered the Marquessate of the Valley of Oaxaca held by Cortes; Dominican friars arrived from 1528, and repeated epidemics reduced the indigenous population by roughly nine tenths within little more than a century.
zh: 东欧托曼格语是欧托-曼格语系的东部语支群，属动词前置的声调语言，其共同母语四千多年前就通行于墨西哥南部，使用者可能是特瓦坎谷地的早期农耕人群。它包含五个语支：瓦哈卡谷地和特万特佩克地峡的萨波特克语支，横跨瓦哈卡、普埃布拉和格雷罗的米斯特卡地区的米斯特克语支，普埃布拉南部与瓦哈卡北部的波波洛坎语支，科斯塔奇卡的阿穆斯戈语支，以及瓦哈卡北部山区的奇南特克语支。使用者建起了中美洲最早的一批城市：萨波特克人约在公元前500年兴建阿尔万山，并刻下当地最早的文字体系之一；自称“雨民”Ñuu Savi的米斯特克人在鹿皮上绘制谱系抄本，并在八鹿“豹爪”王治下以蒂兰通戈为基地统一了米斯特卡的大部。后古典时期，扩张的纳瓦人盖过了这些更古老的民族：阿兹特克军队于1458年击败米斯特克人和萨波特克人，1486年修筑瓦克萨卡克堡垒以征收贡赋，萨波特克人则在吉恩戈拉坚持抵抗到1500年前后。两支民族最终都在1521年向弗朗西斯科·德·奥罗斯科投降，其土地并入科尔特斯名下的瓦哈卡谷地侯爵领地；多明我会士自1528年起进驻，接连不断的瘟疫在一个多世纪里使土著人口减少了约九成。

en: Eastern Tasmanian is the name for the Aboriginal languages of Tasmania's central eastern coast and the hinterland behind it, above all Paredarerme, the language of the Oyster Bay people and of the Big River people of the interior, whose Lairmairrener speech differed little from the coastal dialect. After the Bass Strait was flooded about six millennia before the common era, these tongues developed in isolation from the Australian mainland and cannot be shown to be related to other Australian languages. They survive only in word lists gathered in the 1830s by the government conciliator George Augustus Robinson, including 357 Oyster Bay words and 268 Big River words, in which every word begins with a consonant and the vowel system rests on three sounds. British colonisation from 1803, followed by the removals to Wybalenna between 1830 and 1835, dispersed the communities that spoke them.
zh: 东塔斯马尼亚诸语是对塔斯马尼亚中东部沿海及其内陆原住民语言的统称，其中最主要的是帕雷达雷梅语，即牡蛎湾人和内陆大河人的语言，大河人的莱尔梅雷内话与沿海方言差别很小。约公元前六千纪巴斯海峡被海水淹没后，这些语言在与澳大利亚大陆隔绝的环境中发展，现有证据无法证明它们与其他澳大利亚语言有亲缘关系。它们只靠词表存世：政府调停人乔治·奥古斯都·鲁宾逊在1830年代收集了包括357个牡蛎湾词和268个大河词在内的材料；这些语言每个词都以辅音开头，元音系统以三个元音为基础。1803年起的英国殖民，以及1830至1835年间向怀巴伦纳的强制迁徙，使说这些语言的社群流散。

en: The Eleman languages form a small Papuan family spoken around Kerema Bay on the southern coast of New Guinea, at the head of the Gulf of Papua in Gulf Province of Papua New Guinea. Eleman proper comprises five clearly related languages in two branches: a western branch of Keuru, Opao and Orokolo, and an eastern branch of Toaripi, also called East Elema, and Tairuma. The nearby Kaki Ae language and the Purari language of the great delta farther east have both at times been linked with Eleman, but much of the resemblance is attributed to borrowing, so their place in the family remains debated. The coastal villages of the gulf were the western terminus of the hiri, the Motu trading voyages that carried clay pots from the Port Moresby area to exchange for sago, and an early pidgin form of Motu served as a contact language with Eleman speakers. The Spanish voyage of Torres passed the approaches to the gulf in 1606, yet the sheltered bay and its swamps were not penetrated by outsiders until long afterward.
zh: 埃勒曼语是新几内亚南海岸的一个巴布亚语小语族，分布在巴布亚湾顶端的凯雷马湾一带，属巴布亚新几内亚海湾省。埃勒曼本体包含五种亲缘明确的语言，分两支：西支为克乌鲁语、奥帕奥语和奥罗科洛语，东支为托阿里皮语（又称东埃勒马语）和泰鲁马语。邻近的卡基艾语以及更东面大三角洲上的普拉里语都曾被归入埃勒曼语，但许多相似之处被归因于借词，其归属仍有争议。海湾沿岸的村落是希里贸易的西端终点：莫图人的贸易远航把莫尔斯比港一带的陶罐运来交换西谷米，早期的皮钦莫图语也成为与埃勒曼语使用者打交道的接触语言。1606年托雷斯的西班牙航行经过海湾外海，但这个隐蔽的港湾及其沼泽地带在此后很久都没有外来者深入。

en: Panare, whose speakers call their tongue E'ñapa Woromaipu, is a Cariban language of the Panare people of central Venezuela. They live south of the Orinoco River in Bolívar State, chiefly around the Cuchivero basin, and the name Panare itself is not their own but a Tupí word meaning friend.
zh: 帕纳雷语是委内瑞拉中部帕纳雷人的加勒比语族语言，使用者自称其语言为埃尼亚帕·沃罗迈普。他们居住在奥里诺科河以南的玻利瓦尔州，主要分布在库奇韦罗河流域；“帕纳雷”并非他们的自称，而是一个图皮语词，意为“朋友”。

en: English grew out of the dialects of the Angles, Saxons and Jutes who settled in Britain from the fifth century. Old English produced a written literature, from Beowulf to the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle, and took in Norse words from Danish settlers in the north and east. After the Norman Conquest of 1066 French became the language of the court and the law, and English, spoken mainly by the common people, absorbed a large Romance vocabulary. By the fourteenth century it was regaining ground: the Pleading in English Act of 1362 admitted it to the law courts, and Geoffrey Chaucer wrote The Canterbury Tales in the London dialect. William Caxton's press at Westminster, opened in 1476, helped settle a written standard, later shaped by the King James Bible of 1611 and Samuel Johnson's dictionary of 1755.
zh: 英语源于5世纪起移居不列颠的盎格鲁人、撒克逊人和朱特人的方言。古英语留下了从《贝奥武甫》到《盎格鲁-撒克逊编年史》的书面文学，并从北部和东部的丹麦定居者那里吸收了诺斯语词汇。1066年诺曼征服后，法语成为宫廷和法律的语言，英语主要在平民口中流传，吸收了大量罗曼语词汇。14世纪英语重新抬头：1362年的《英语诉讼法》准许在法庭使用英语，杰弗里·乔叟用伦敦方言写成《坎特伯雷故事集》。1476年威廉·卡克斯顿在威斯敏斯特开设印刷所，帮助确立了书面标准；1611年的钦定版圣经和1755年塞缪尔·约翰逊的词典又进一步塑造了它。

en: Eo Enana, better known as Marquesan, is a chain of East-Central Polynesian dialects of the Marquesic group, spoken across the Marquesas Islands, which voyagers from western Polynesia settled around the twelfth or thirteenth century. It splits into North Marquesan on Nuku Hiva, Ua Pou and Ua Huka, and South Marquesan on Hiva Oa, Tahuata and Fatu Hiva; the Tai Pi speech of eastern Nuku Hiva is sometimes counted as a language of its own. The northern dialects keep the old Polynesian k sound that Tahitian has lost, while the south replaces it with n or a glottal stop and turns the northern h into f. For centuries the language was spoken but not written; the Spanish navigator Álvaro de Mendaña reached the islands in 1595 and named them after the Marquis of Cañete, the American trader Joseph Ingraham visited the north in 1791, and William Pascoe Crook, the first Protestant missionary to settle there, lived in the islands from 1797 to 1799, after which Marquesan began to be recorded in the Latin alphabet, whose orthography marks the glottal stop with the okina and long vowels with a macron.
zh: 埃纳纳语即马克萨斯语，是东中波利尼西亚语群马克萨斯语支的一组方言，通行于马克萨斯群岛；这些岛屿约在12至13世纪由西波利尼西亚的航海者定居。它分为北马克萨斯语和南马克萨斯语：前者通行于努库希瓦、瓦普和瓦胡卡三岛，后者通行于希瓦瓦、塔瓦塔和法图希瓦三岛；努库希瓦东部的泰皮话有时被视为独立语言。北部方言保留了塔希提语已经失去的古波利尼西亚辅音克，南部方言则以恩音或喉塞音替代，并把北部的赫音换成夫音。长期以来它只有口语而无文字：1595年西班牙航海家阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚抵达群岛，以卡涅特侯爵的封号为群岛命名；1791年美国商人约瑟夫·英格拉哈姆到访北方诸岛；1797至1799年，第一位在此定居的新教传教士威廉·帕斯科·克鲁克居住于群岛，此后马克萨斯语开始有了拉丁字母记录，其拼写法用倒置逗号标示喉塞音，用长音符号标示长元音。

en: Ethiopic, or Ethio-Semitic, is the western branch of the South Semitic languages, carried to the Horn of Africa from South Arabia in the first millennium BC and laid over a Cushitic substratum whose words and sounds it kept. Ge'ez, the tongue of Aksum, became its literary and liturgical standard, while the living southern group comprises Amharic and Argobba, the Harari of the walled city of Harar, the Gurage cluster of the central highlands, and the now extinct Gafat; the lost language of the Muslim Harla is thought to be kin to Harari and the eastern Gurage tongues. Amharic, the largest member, was named Lisane Negus, the tongue of the king, and served the Solomonic dynasty restored in 1270 as the language of court, army and trade across the Ethiopian highlands, written in the fidal abugida adapted from Ge'ez. Harari by contrast was the language of a Muslim trading city, recorded in an Arabic-based script and carried by the merchants and preachers of the Adal sultanate. Through the wars of the sixteenth century and the Oromo migrations that followed, Amharic held its place as the lingua franca of the Christian empire, while Gurage and Harari communities preserved their own speech in their home districts.
zh: 埃塞俄比亚语又称埃塞俄比亚闪米特语，是南闪米特语族的西支，于公元前第一千纪从阿拉伯半岛南部传入非洲之角，叠加在库希特语底层之上，并保留了后者的词汇和语音特征。阿克苏姆的语言格尔兹语成为其书面和礼拜标准，而仍在使用的南支语言包括阿姆哈拉语与阿尔戈巴语、围城哈勒尔的哈拉里语、中部高原的古拉格语群，以及已经消亡的加法特语；穆斯林哈拉人失传的语言被认为与哈拉里语及东古拉格诸语同源。成员中最大的阿姆哈拉语号称“国王之语”，是1270年复辟的所罗门王朝宫廷、军队和贸易用语，通行于埃塞俄比亚高原，文字采用由格尔兹字母改造的斐德尔元音拼音文字。哈拉里语则相反，是一座穆斯林商业城市的语言，用阿拉伯字母体系记录，随阿达尔苏丹国的商人和传教士向外传播。历经16世纪的战争和随后的奥罗莫人迁徙，阿姆哈拉语始终保持着基督教帝国通用语的地位，古拉格人和哈拉里人也在各自的家乡守住了自己的语言。

en: Evenki, long known in Russian sources as Tungus and in Qing records as Solon, is the largest language of the northern branch of the Tungusic family, closely related to Even, Negidal and Oroqen. Its speakers, the Evenki, are reindeer-herding hunters of the boreal forest whose ancestors are plausibly sought among the Shiwei peoples of the Greater Khingan range; from the Baikal region they spread across the taiga from the Yenisei and Lena basins to the Okhotsk coast and, under Russian pressure, as far as Sakhalin. Their speech forms a chain of northern, southern and eastern dialect groups, more than a dozen dialects in all, heavily influenced in places by Yakut and Buryat. When Cossacks reached the Evenki in the 1600s they imposed a fur tribute and took clan hostages, while the horse-breeding Solon of the Amur country were incorporated into the Qing Eight Banners and became renowned as frontier troops; Qing scholars also set down Solon words in the Manchu alphabet. Evenki is agglutinative with subject-object-verb order and a vocabulary rich in terms for reindeer and the hunt, and it remained an unwritten oral language, later recorded in Latin and Cyrillic scripts.
zh: 鄂温克语在俄罗斯旧文献中通称通古斯语，清代记载则称索伦语，是满‑通古斯语族北支中使用最广的语言，与鄂温语、涅吉达尔语和鄂伦春语亲缘最近。操这种语言的鄂温克人是北方针叶林里牧鹿狩猎的民族，其祖先可能与大兴安岭的室韦诸部有关；他们从贝加尔湖一带向外扩散，足迹遍及叶尼塞河、勒拿河流域直到鄂霍次克海岸，在俄国势力压迫下更有人远徙萨哈林岛。鄂温克语分为北部、南部、东部三大方言群，方言多达十余种，部分地区受雅库特语和布里亚特语影响很深。17世纪哥萨克人接触到鄂温克人后，强征毛皮贡赋并拘押氏族首领为人质；阿穆尔河流域养马的索伦部则被编入清朝八旗，以边地劲旅闻名，清代学者还以满文字母记录索伦语词汇。鄂温克语是黏着语，语序为主宾动，关于驯鹿和狩猎的词汇极为丰富；它长期没有本族文字，靠口耳相传，后来才以拉丁字母和西里尔字母书写。

en: Fas, also called Momu or Bembi, is a Papuan language of Sandaun Province in north-western Papua New Guinea, near the Indonesian border. It names the tiny Fas family, whose only other member is Baibai, sharing about forty per cent of its vocabulary; an older classification placing Fas among the Kwomtari languages is regarded as an error.
zh: 法斯语又称莫穆语或本比语，是巴布亚新几内亚西北部桑道恩省、邻近印度尼西亚边境的一种巴布亚语言。它是极小的法斯语族的命名语言，该语族另一种成员只有拜拜语，两者约有四成词汇同源；过去曾把法斯语归入科姆塔里语族，这一分类后来被视为错误。

en: Finnic, also called Baltic Finnic, is the westernmost branch of the Uralic family, spoken around the Baltic Sea by the Baltic Finnic peoples. Its two chief languages are Finnish and Estonian; the smaller members are Karelian, Veps, Ingrian, Votic and Livonian, once spoken by the Gulf of Riga. Proto-Finnic was probably spoken on the coasts of the Gulf of Finland, and its dialects began to separate around AD 150, absorbing words from older Paleo-Baltic tongues and later from Germanic, Baltic and East Slavic neighbours, whose Christian vocabulary entered the language around 800. The languages are marked by vowel harmony, rich case systems and consonant gradation, and have no grammatical gender. A literary form came only in the sixteenth century, when Bishop Mikael Agricola created the first comprehensive Finnish orthography on the basis of the western dialects and began translating the Bible; for centuries written Finnic served mainly religion. Under Swedish rule Finnish had no official standing, and after Sweden lost Finland in 1809 the Fennoman movement took up its cause, with Elias Lönnrot's Kalevala leading a revival that carried the language into administration and literature.
zh: 芬兰语即芬兰语支，又称波罗的芬兰语支，是乌拉尔语系最西端的一支，由波罗的芬兰各族在波罗的海周边使用。两大语言是芬兰语和爱沙尼亚语，较小的成员有卡累利阿语、维普斯语、英格里亚语、沃提克语和曾通行于里加湾畔的利夫语。原始芬兰语大概通行于芬兰湾沿岸，各方言约在公元150年开始分化，其间吸收了更古老的古波罗的语言词汇，后来又受日耳曼语、波罗的语和东斯拉夫语影响，后者的基督教词汇约在800年进入该语言。这些语言以元音和谐、丰富的格系统和辅音交替为特征，没有语法性别。书面形式到16世纪才出现：主教米卡埃尔·阿格里科拉以西部方言为基础，创制了第一套完整的芬兰语正字法并着手翻译圣经；此后数百年间，书面芬兰语主要用于宗教。在瑞典统治下芬兰语没有官方地位，1809年瑞典失去芬兰后，芬兰民族主义运动接过了它的事业，埃利亚斯·伦罗特的《卡勒瓦拉》引领了一场复兴，把这门语言带入行政与文学领域。

en: The Formosan languages are the Austronesian tongues of the indigenous peoples of Taiwan, spoken across the island's mountain interior and western plains. They are not a single family: linguists divide them into as many as nine separate primary branches of Austronesian, and Taiwan is widely held to be the original homeland from which the tenth branch, Malayo-Polynesian, later spread across the Indian and Pacific Oceans. Of the roughly two dozen recorded languages, among the largest are Amis, Bunun, Paiwan and Tsou, while Siraya on the southwestern plains served as a regional lingua franca. Traditionally unwritten, several gained a romanized script under Dutch colonial rule from 1624 to 1662, when missionaries compiled word lists and religious texts in Siraya. Long contact with Chinese settlers afterwards pushed many of these languages into decline.
zh: 台湾南岛语是台湾原住民所说的一组南岛语系语言，分布在岛上的山区内陆与西部平原。它们并不构成单一语族：语言学家把它们划分为多达九个各自独立的南岛语系一级分支，而学界普遍认为台湾正是南岛语系的原乡，第十个分支马来—波利尼西亚语族便是从这里扩散到印度洋和太平洋诸岛。已记录的语言约有二十余种，其中使用人口较多的有阿美语、布农语、排湾语和邹语；西南平原的西拉雅语还曾充当区域通用语。这些语言原本没有文字，1624年至1662年荷兰殖民统治期间，几种语言获得了拉丁字母拼写，传教士并用西拉雅语编写词表和宗教文书。此后与汉族移民的长期接触，使其中许多语言逐渐走向衰落。

en:
French grew out of the Vulgar Latin of Roman Gaul, over a Celtic Gaulish substrate whose last credible attestation dates to the 500s and which left its mark in liaison and some two hundred rural words. From the third century Germanic Franks settled the north; their language gave French its name, its stress accent and a large vocabulary of war and lordship, while Norse-speaking Vikings who took Normandy in the 900s added seafaring terms. The result in northern France was the patchwork of langues d'oïl, named for their word oïl for yes, among them Picard, Norman, Walloon and the Francien of Paris and the Île-de-France. The earliest surviving French text is the Oaths of Strasbourg of 842, and Old French became a literary medium through the chansons de geste; after 1066 its Norman offshoot Anglo-Norman ruled the courts of England.

In 1337 the Parisian Francien standard was still only one dialect among many, and Middle French jostled with Latin in law and learning. The royal chancery prepared the way for the Ordinance of Villers-Cotterêts of 1539, by which Francis I imposed French as the sole language of legal documents, and in 1634 Cardinal Richelieu founded the Académie française to fix and purify the language. Classical French then became the lingua franca of Europe's courts, diplomacy and Enlightenment letters, used by Frederick the Great and Catherine the Great and carried overseas by the colonies of New France, yet in 1789 perhaps half the king's subjects still spoke only their regional patois.
zh:
法语源于罗马高卢的通俗拉丁语，底下是凯尔特语高卢语的底层：高卢语可信的最晚记载见于6世纪，它给法语留下了联诵等特征和约两百个乡村生活词汇。3世纪起，日耳曼人的法兰克人定居北方，法兰克语赋予了法语它的名字、重音和大量军事与封建词汇；10世纪占据诺曼底的诺斯语维京人又添上海事用语。由此在法兰西北部形成了奥依语各方言拼成的图谱——“奥依”是这些语言里“是”的说法——其中包括皮卡第语、诺曼语、瓦隆语和巴黎与法兰西岛的弗朗西恩语。现存最早的法语文本是842年的《斯特拉斯堡誓言》，古法语又凭借武功歌成为文学语言；1066年后，它的诺曼分支盎格鲁‑诺曼语统治了英格兰的宫廷。

1337年时，巴黎的弗朗西恩标准语还只是众多方言中的一支，中古法语在法律和学术领域仍与拉丁语并行。国王文书署的发展为1539年的《维莱科特雷法令》铺平了道路，弗朗索瓦一世借此强制法语成为法律文书的唯一语言；1634年，黎塞留创立法兰西学术院，负责规范和净化法语。此后古典法语成为欧洲宫廷、外交和启蒙文坛的通用语，腓特烈大帝和叶卡捷琳娜大帝都使用法语，法属新法兰西的殖民地又把它带到海外；然而直到1789年，法王的臣民中或许仍有一半只会说本乡的土话。

en: Frisian is a group of West Germanic varieties spoken along the southern shore of the North Sea, in the Dutch province of Friesland and in the north-west of Germany; together with English and Scots it forms the Anglo-Frisian branch, and Old Frisian was remarkably close to Old English. In the early Middle Ages Frisian was heard across Great Frisia, a coastal belt stretching from around Bruges to the river Weser, and the Old Frisian of the twelfth to sixteenth centuries survives mostly in legal texts. In the fourteenth century the Frisian lands enjoyed the so-called Frisian freedom: rural communes without feudal lords elected their own judges and fought repeated wars against the counts of Holland. That autonomy ended when the County of East Frisia was formed in 1464 and Saxon troops occupied western Frisia in 1498, after which Dutch replaced Frisian in government, law and the church, leaving it largely a spoken language of the countryside. The poet Gysbert Japiks, writing in Bolsward from 1603 to 1666, revived Frisian as a literary medium, and a broader revival around 1820, led by scholars such as Joost Halbertsma, produced a modern written standard. Of the three traditional branches, West Frisian remains the strongest, while North Frisian survives in Schleswig-Holstein and Saterland Frisian is the last heir of East Frisian.
zh: 弗里西亚语是西日耳曼语的一支，分布在北海南岸的荷兰弗里斯兰省和德国西北部；它与英语、苏格兰语同属盎格鲁-弗里西亚语支，古弗里西亚语与古英语极为相近。中世纪早期，从布鲁日一带到威悉河的沿海地带统称“大弗里斯兰”，整条海岸都讲弗里西亚语；12至16世纪的古弗里西亚语存世文献多为法律文书。14世纪的弗里斯兰地区实行所谓“弗里斯兰自由”：没有封建领主的乡村公社自行选举法官，并为抵御荷兰伯爵的扩张屡次开战。1464年东弗里斯兰伯国建立，1498年萨克森军队占领西弗里斯兰，这套自治制度告终；此后荷兰语取代弗里西亚语成为行政、法律和教会用语，弗里西亚语长期主要是乡间口语。1603至1666年间，博尔斯瓦德诗人吉斯伯特·亚皮克斯以弗里西亚语创作，复兴了它的文学传统；1820年前后，在约斯特·哈尔伯茨马等学者推动下出现更大规模的复兴，新的书面规范由此形成。传统上它分为三支：西弗里西亚语活力最强，北弗里西亚语留存于石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因，萨特尔兰弗里西亚语则是东弗里西亚语仅存的变体。

en: Futuna, more precisely Futuna-Aniwa or West Futunan, is a Polynesian language spoken on the small outlier islands of Futuna and Aniwa in Vanuatu's Tafea group, amid the Melanesian islands of the southern New Hebrides. It belongs to the Futunic branch of Nuclear Polynesian and descends from voyagers who pushed westward out of the Polynesian heartlands after Proto-Polynesian had taken shape in the Tonga and Samoa region some three thousand years ago; its closest relative is the East Futunan of Wallis and Futuna, far to the northeast. Surrounded by the quite different Southern Vanuatu languages of Tanna and Aneityum, the small island communities kept their Polynesian speech intact through centuries of contact. James Cook recorded the name Futuna from Tanna islanders during his 1774 visit, though no Europeans are known to have landed there in this period. Like other Polynesian outlier tongues, Futuna had no writing and lived in oral tradition.
zh: 富图纳语更准确的名称是富图纳-阿尼瓦语或西富图纳语，是通行于瓦努阿图塔菲亚地区富图纳岛和阿尼瓦岛两座小岛的波利尼西亚语言，地处新赫布里底群岛南部的美拉尼西亚岛屿之间。它属于核心波利尼西亚语的富图纳语支，祖先是约三千年前原始波利尼西亚语在汤加和萨摩亚一带形成后向西远航的波利尼西亚航海者；与它关系最近的是东北方远方瓦利斯和富图纳的东富图纳语。尽管被塔纳岛、阿内蒂乌姆岛等迥异的南瓦努阿图语言包围，小岛上的居民在数百年的接触中仍完整保留了自己的波利尼西亚语言。1774年詹姆斯·库克到访时，曾从塔纳岛人口中记下富图纳这个岛名，但这一时期没有欧洲人登岛的记载。与其他波利尼西亚域外语言一样，富图纳语没有文字，存在于口传传统之中。

en: Fwâi, also called Poai, is a Kanak language of the North Northern New Caledonian group, spoken in the commune of Hienghène on the northeast coast of Grande Terre, alongside the closely related Pije, Nemi and Jawe languages.
zh: 法伊语又称波阿伊语，属新喀里多尼亚语群北部北支，通行于格朗德特尔岛东北沿海的延根市镇，与关系相近的皮热语、内米语和雅韦语分布在同一地区。

en: Gaelic, or Goidelic, is one of the two Insular Celtic branches, the other being Brittonic. Its oldest form, Primitive Irish, is first attested in Ogham stone inscriptions from about the fourth century; Old Irish glosses on Latin manuscripts followed between the sixth and tenth centuries, and from the thirteenth to the eighteenth century a shared literary standard called Classical Gaelic served writers in both Ireland and Scotland. Gaelic crossed from Ireland to western Scotland with the kingdom of Dal Riata in the sixth century, and the Picts had adopted it by the eleventh century, while a third tongue, Manx, developed on the Isle of Man with Norse loanwords from the Viking age. In Scotland the court turned to Norman French and then Scots from the eleventh century, and after John Barbour wrote The Brus in Scots in 1375 Gaelic retreated to the Highlands and Islands, where the Statutes of Iona of 1609 forced clan chiefs' heirs into English-speaking schools. In Ireland English conquest and the Treaty of Limerick of 1691 marginalized the language, though Bishop Bedell's Irish Old Testament was printed in 1685. Protestant schools then gave Gaelic a printed foothold anyway: the Scottish Gaelic New Testament appeared in 1767 and the full Bible in 1801, even as English schooling and emigration steadily shrank the Gaelic-speaking world.
zh: 盖尔语又称戈伊德尔语，是海岛凯尔特语的两大分支之一，另一支是布立吞语。它最古老的形态是原始爱尔兰语，最早见于4世纪前后的欧甘文石刻；6至10世纪出现了写在拉丁手稿上的古爱尔兰语注释，13至18世纪，一种称为古典盖尔语的共同书面标准服务于爱尔兰和苏格兰两地的写作者。6世纪，盖尔语随达尔里阿达王国从爱尔兰传到苏格兰西部，到11世纪皮克特人已改用这种语言；第三种语言马恩语则在马恩岛发展起来，并吸收了维京时代的诺斯语借词。在苏格兰，宫廷自11世纪起先后改用诺曼法语和苏格兰语，1375年约翰·巴伯用苏格兰语写成《布鲁斯》之后，盖尔语退居高地和群岛；1609年的《艾奥纳法令》又强迫氏族首领的继承人进入英语学校。在爱尔兰，英格兰的征服和1691年的《利默里克条约》使盖尔语被边缘化，不过贝德尔主教翻译的爱尔兰语《旧约》仍于1685年印行。新教学校后来反而给了盖尔语印刷的立足点：苏格兰盖尔语《新约》于1767年问世，全本《圣经》于1801年出版，但英语教育和移民仍在不断压缩盖尔语的世界。

en: Samoan, self-called Gagana Sāmoa, is a Polynesian language of the Austronesian family, spoken on the Samoan Islands and classed in the Samoic branch alongside Tokelauan and the Eastern Polynesian tongues such as Māori, Tahitian and Hawaiian, with which it shares words such as aliʻi (chief), atua (god) and tapu (sacred). It is an isolating language whose syllables all end in vowels; a reversed comma marks the glottal stop and a macron marks long vowels. Samoan is distinctive for its registers, with a colloquial K-style alongside formal literary speech and the gagana faʻaaloalo, a ceremonial chiefly vocabulary used by orator chiefs under the matai title system. It remained a purely spoken language until Christian missionaries of the London Missionary Society began recording it in the Latin script, distributing an orthography for the language in 1834.
zh: 萨摩亚语是南岛语系波利尼西亚语族的语言，通行于萨摩亚群岛，与托克劳语以及毛利语、塔希提语、夏威夷语等东波利尼西亚语言同属萨摩亚语支，彼此共有酋长、神、禁忌等同源词。它是孤立语，每个音节都以元音结尾，用倒置逗号标示喉塞音，用长音符号标示长元音。萨摩亚语最显著的特点是语体分层：口语中有把特读成克的随意体，另有规范的书面体，以及一套用于仪式的“酋长敬语”，由马泰头衔制度下的演说酋长在典礼和议事中使用。在传教士到来之前它没有文字，直到伦敦会的基督教传教士用拉丁字母记录这种语言，并于1834年颁行拼写方案，它才有了书写形式。

en: Gan is the Sinitic language of the Jiangyou people, spoken chiefly across central and northern Jiangxi and over the borders into eastern Hunan, southeastern Hubei, southwestern Anhui and northwestern Fujian, with the Nanchang dialect as its prestige form. Chinese settlement of the Gan valley began with the Qin campaign against the Baiyue after 221 BCE, and in 202 BCE the Han founded Nanchang as the seat of Yuzhang Commandery, whose growing population gave the language its shape under the Han. When the fourth-century upheaval of the Five Barbarians drove central Chinese refugees south, Jiangxi served as a staging post and the old Gan speech absorbed northern elements. From the Five Dynasties period, 907 to 960, emigrants from Jiangxi carried Gan into eastern Hunan, Hubei, southern Anhui and Fujian, fixing its later distribution. Phonetically it is the closest of the Chinese varieties to Hakka, and like the other Sinitic languages it is written in Chinese characters.
zh: 赣语是江右民系的主要语言，通行于江西中北部，并延伸到湖南东部、湖北东南部、安徽西南部和福建西北部，以南昌话为代表。公元前221年秦征百越之后，中原汉人开始进入赣江流域；公元前202年汉代设南昌为豫章郡治，郡内人口在汉代大幅增长，赣语也在这一时期逐渐成形。4世纪五胡之乱、北民南迁，江西成为中转之地，古赣语由此吸收了北方方言的成分。907—960年的五代时期，江西居民陆续迁往湘东、鄂东、皖南和闽西北，把赣语带到后世的分布范围。在语音上，赣语是各汉语中与客家话最接近的一支；和其他汉语一样，赣语也使用汉字书写。

en: Garawa, also spelt Garrwa and also called Leearrawa, is the language of the Garrwa people of the southern Gulf of Carpentaria country, whose lands ran from the McArthur River at Borroloola east across the Nicholson River into Queensland. When the first British colony in Australia was founded in 1788, the same wider region held the Ganggalida, or Yukulta, of the Gulf coast, the Mingin around Burketown and the Wakaya inland toward Tennant Creek. Garawa itself had a heavy eastern dialect called Guninderri and a lighter western one, and with the neighbouring Waanyi it forms the small Garrwan family; its place within the great Pama–Nyungan family is disputed, for its grammar contains many unusual forms found in few other Australian languages.
zh: 加拉瓦语又称李阿拉瓦，是卡奔塔利亚湾南部加拉瓦人的语言，其传统地盘从博罗卢拉的麦克阿瑟河向东越过尼科尔森河，伸入昆士兰。1788年英国在澳大利亚建立第一个殖民地时，同一广大区域还住着海湾沿岸的冈加里达人（即尤库尔塔人）、伯克敦一带的明金人以及内陆往滕南特克里克方向的瓦卡亚人。加拉瓦语本有偏重的东部方言贡宁代里和偏轻的西部方言，它与邻近的瓦尼语共同构成小小的加拉瓦语族；它是否属于庞大的帕马—恩永甘语族尚有争议，因为其语法包含许多在其他澳大利亚语言中罕见的形式。

en: Ge'ez, or Classical Ethiopic, is the ancient South Semitic language of the Ethiopian and Eritrean highlands, first attested in pre-Christian inscriptions of the early Aksumite period around the fourth century. The conversion of King Ezana in the 300s opened its literary age: the Bible and Greek patristic works were translated on a scale with few parallels in the early church, producing an eighty-one-book Ethiopic Bible in which the Book of Enoch survives complete nowhere else, and the Garima Gospels count among the oldest illuminated Christian manuscripts. Ge'ez also served empire and conquest, appearing on the inscriptions set up in South Arabia when King Kaleb overran Himyar in the sixth century. In time Amharic displaced it in the southern highlands and Tigrinya and Tigre in the north, yet it kept the place Medieval Latin held in Europe, remaining the official written language of the Ethiopian realm into the 1800s. Its fourteenth-century golden age produced the royal chronicles begun under Amda Seyon and the Kebra Nagast, the retelling of Solomon and the Queen of Sheba that anchored the Solomonic dynasty's claim to rule; around 1450 the Fetha Negest was translated into Ge'ez and became the law of the kingdom. The Muslim invasions of the 1500s broke this literary florescence, though Ge'ez remained the liturgical tongue of the Ethiopian and Eritrean Orthodox churches and of the Beta Israel, who also wrote it in Hebrew letters, while its fidal abugida lived on as the script of Amharic and Tigrinya.
zh: 格尔兹语又称古典埃塞俄比亚语，是埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚高原的古老南闪米特语言，最早见于4世纪前后阿克苏姆早期的前基督教铭文。埃扎纳国王在4世纪皈依基督教，开启了它的文学时代：圣经和希腊教父著作被大规模译入，规模在早期教会中罕有其匹，形成了含81卷经书的埃塞俄比亚圣经，其中《以诺书》的完整文本仅存于格尔兹语；《加里马福音书》则是最古老的泥金装饰基督教手抄本之一。格尔兹语也服务于帝国与征伐，6世纪国王卡莱布征服希木叶尔后在阿拉伯半岛南部树立的铭文便用它写成。后来阿姆哈拉语在南部高原、提格里尼亚语和提格雷语在北方相继取代了它的口语地位，但它仍保持着类似欧洲中世纪拉丁语的地位，作为埃塞俄比亚王国的官方书面语一直沿用到19世纪。14世纪是格尔兹文学的黄金时代：阿姆达·塞翁时期开始编写国王编年史，《国王的荣耀》重述所罗门与示巴女王的故事，为所罗门王朝的统治主张提供依据；约1450年译入的《诸王法典》成为王国的法律。16世纪的穆斯林入侵打断了这一文学繁荣，但格尔兹语仍是埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚正教会以及贝塔以色列人的礼拜用语——贝塔以色列人还用希伯来字母拼写格尔兹语，而它的斐德尔元音拼音文字则作为阿姆哈拉语和提格里尼亚语的文字延续下来。

en: Gela, also called Nggela and formerly Florida, is an Oceanic language of the Southeast Solomonic group, spoken in the Nggela Islands at the centre of the Solomon Islands. Its three dialects are very close, differing mainly in a handful of phonological points; the language has five vowels without contrastive length and normally stresses the penultimate syllable. In the later 1800s the Melanesian Mission of the Anglican Church of Melanesia took up Gela, together with Mota of the Banks Islands in Vanuatu, as a language of Christian teaching, and the first Gela translation of the scriptures was printed in those years.
zh: 杰拉语又称恩格拉语，旧称佛罗里达语，是大洋洲语支中东南所罗门语群的语言，通行于所罗门群岛中部的佛罗里达群岛。它的三种方言彼此十分接近，主要差别在少数语音点；元音有五个，没有长短对立，重音通常落在倒数第二音节。19世纪后期，美拉尼西亚圣公会的美拉尼西亚传道会采用杰拉语，把它与瓦努阿图班克斯群岛的莫塔语一同作为传教语言，第一部杰拉语圣经译本也在那些年刊印。

en: Georgian is the principal language of the Kartvelian, or South Caucasian, family, spoken across Georgia and serving as a lingua franca for speakers of its relatives Mingrelian, Laz and Svan. Its written history began after the Christianization of the Kingdom of Iberia in the fourth century, when it replaced Aramaic as the literary language; the earliest inscriptions and palimpsests date to the fifth century, as does the oldest surviving work, Iakob Tsurtaveli's Martyrdom of the Holy Queen Shushanik. Georgian is written in its own alphabet of uncertain origin, whose modern form, Mkhedruli, developed alongside the medieval kingdom, and the twelfth-century epic The Knight in the Panther's Skin by Shota Rustaveli became the classic of Middle Georgian. The standard language rests on the Kartlian dialect, and in 1629 the first printed Georgian books appeared in Rome, prepared by Nikoloz Cholokashvili for Catholic missionaries.
zh: 格鲁吉亚语是南高加索语系（卡特维尔语系）最主要的语言，通行于格鲁吉亚各地，并作为明格列尔语、拉兹语和斯凡语等亲属语言使用者的通用语。它的书面史始于4世纪伊比利亚王国基督教化之后，当时格鲁吉亚语取代阿拉米语成为文学语言；现存最早的铭文和重写本属于5世纪，雅各布·楚尔塔维利的《圣后舒莎尼克殉道记》也是这一世纪的作品，是传世最古的文学作品。格鲁吉亚语使用来源不明的独特字母，今天通行的骑士体随中世纪王国的发展而成熟；12世纪绍塔·鲁斯塔韦利的史诗《虎皮骑士》是中期格鲁吉亚语的经典。标准语以卡尔特利方言为基础，1629年，尼科洛兹·乔洛卡什维利在罗马为天主教传教士编印了最早的格鲁吉亚语印刷书籍。

en:
German is the West Germanic dialect continuum of central Europe, split in the Early Middle Ages by the High German consonant shift: the southern dialects that underwent it became High German, while the Low German of the northern plains and Dutch at the Low Franconian western edge did not. Old High German first appears in runic inscriptions of the 500s, then in the Abrogans glossary of the 700s and the Hildebrandslied of the 800s, and Middle High German of about 1050 to 1350 carried courtly epic and Minnesang. To the north Old Saxon grew into Middle Low German, the lingua franca of the Hanseatic League from about 1100 to 1500 around the usage of Lübeck; when the league faded in the 1600s, Low German sank to a local dialect. The High German of medieval Jewish communities meanwhile fused with Hebrew and Aramaic into Yiddish, attested from the 1100s and written in the Hebrew alphabet.

In 1337 no standard German yet existed. Martin Luther's Bible translation, the New Testament of 1522 and the complete Bible of 1534, was based on the Meissen German of Saxony, then the most widely understood form of the language, and carried a common written form across the Protestant lands; a broadly accepted standard emerged only by the mid-1700s, and until about 1800 it remained almost solely a written language that northerners learned like a foreign tongue. In the Habsburg Empire German was the language of towns, trade and government from Prague to Budapest, while Alemannic, Bavarian, Saxon and Low German dialects filled everyday speech.
zh:
德语是中欧的西日耳曼语方言连续体，在中世纪早期被高地德语辅音音变一分为二：经历音变的南部方言成为高地德语，北部平原的低地德语和西端低地法兰克语边缘的荷兰语则没有。高地德语最早见于6世纪的如尼文铭文，随后有8世纪的《阿布罗甘斯》词汇表和9世纪的《希尔德布兰特之歌》；约1050—1350年的中古高地德语承载了宫廷史诗和恋歌。北方的古撒克逊语则演变为中古低地德语，约1100—1500年间以吕贝克用语为基础，成为汉萨同盟的通用语；17世纪汉萨同盟衰落后，低地德语沦为地方土话。在中世纪的神圣罗马帝国，犹太社区的高地德语又与希伯来语和阿拉米语融合成意第绪语，现存最早的记载出现于12世纪，并用希伯来字母书写。

1337年时还不存在标准德语。马丁·路德的圣经译本——1522年的《新约》和1534年的全本圣经——以当时最易被各地听懂的萨克森迈森德语为基础，把一种共同的书面形式带到各个新教地区；广泛接受的标准到18世纪中叶才确立，而直到约1800年，它几乎还只是书面语，北方人要像学外语一样学习它。在哈布斯堡帝国，从布拉格到布达佩斯，德语是城镇、商业和行政的语言，阿勒曼尼、巴伐利亚、萨克森、低地德语等方言则继续充斥着日常口语。

en: Ghari, also called Tangarare, Sughu or West Guadalcanal, is an Oceanic language spoken on Guadalcanal in the Solomon Islands. Its Vaturanga dialect was used extensively in missionary and liturgical translations, which led the linguist Arthur Capell to describe Ghari as a mission and ecclesiastical language.
zh: 加里语又称坦加拉雷语、苏古语或西瓜达尔卡纳尔语，是所罗门群岛瓜达尔卡纳尔岛上通行的一种泛太平洋语系语言。它的瓦图朗加方言被大量用于传教和礼仪翻译，语言学家阿瑟·卡佩尔因此把加里语称为传教与教会语言。

en: Gimbiyu is the language of the Jaminjung and Ngaliwuru peoples of the Victoria River country in the Northern Territory. The two speech forms are closely related and together form the Yirram, or Jaminjungan, branch of the Mirndi family of non-Pama–Nyungan Australian languages, and Ngaliwuru is often treated as a dialect of Jaminjung.
zh: 金比尤语是北领地维多利亚河流域贾明琼人与恩加利乌鲁人的语言。两种话关系密切，共同构成澳大利亚非帕马—恩永甘语言米尔迪语族下的伊拉姆（贾明琼甘）语支，恩加利乌鲁话常被视为贾明琼语的方言。

en: Gogodala is the main language of the Gogodala-Suki family, a small Trans-New Guinea family of the Aramia River and lower Fly floodplain in Papua New Guinea's Western Province; its sister language is Suki. The Gogodala are canoe people divided into eight clans, whose origin story tells of ancestors arriving in great canoes and who once lived in huge communal longhouses.
zh: 戈戈达拉语是戈戈达拉－苏基语族的主要语言。该语族是跨新几内亚语系的一个小语族，位于巴布亚新几内亚西部省阿拉米亚河和弗莱河下游平原，姊妹语言是苏基语。戈戈达拉人是驾独木舟的民族，分为八个氏族，起源故事称祖先乘大独木舟迁来此地，他们曾居住在巨大的公共长屋里。

en: Gondi, called Koitur by its speakers, is a South-Central Dravidian language of the Gond people, spread across the hill forests of central India in Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. The outsider name Gond may derive from the Dravidian word kond, a hill. Its recorded history is inseparable from the Gond rajas who from the thirteenth century built the kingdoms of Gondwana: Chanda, traditionally founded in 1200, Deogarh and Garha, whose queen Durgavati died fighting the Mughals in 1564. Muslim writers first mention the Gonds in the fourteenth century. Gondi exists in many poorly recorded dialects, among them Dorla, Koya, Madiya, Muria and Raj Gond, and preserves a rich oral literature of wedding songs and narratives. Lacking a common native script, it has mostly been written in Devanagari or Telugu, though manuscripts in a distinctive Gunjala Gondi hand survive from as early as the mid-eighteenth century.
zh: 贡德语是达罗毗荼语族中南支的语言，使用者自称科伊图尔语，散布在印度中部中央邦、马哈拉施特拉邦、恰蒂斯加尔邦、特伦甘纳邦和安得拉邦的山林地带，是贡德人的语言。外人对他们的称呼“贡德”可能源自达罗毗荼语的“孔德”，意为山丘。它有记载的历史与贡德诸王密不可分：13世纪起，贡德人在冈德瓦纳地区建立诸多王国，包括传说建于1200年的昌达、德奥加尔和加尔哈，加尔哈女王杜尔加瓦蒂于1564年抗击莫卧儿军队战死。穆斯林文献首次提到贡德人是在14世纪。贡德语方言众多而记录不足，主要有多拉、科亚、马迪亚、穆里亚和拉杰贡德等，口头文学丰富，以婚礼歌和叙事诗为代表。由于没有通行的本族文字，它多用天城体或泰卢固文书写，不过18世纪中叶已出现用独特的贡贾拉贡德文字写成的抄本。

en: Gorontalo, known to its speakers as Hulontalo, is the major language of the Gorontalo peninsula in northern Sulawesi, spoken by the Gorontalo and Polahi peoples across Gorontalo, North Sulawesi and Central Sulawesi. It belongs to the Gorontalo-Mongondow branch of the Philippine subgroup of Austronesian, and is closest to Mongondow, with smaller relatives such as Suwawa, Bolango and Buol. Its vocabulary carries layers of Malay, Arabic, Portuguese, Dutch and North Halmahera loanwords, reflecting the trade links and the spread of Islam that reached the peninsula before the Portuguese arrival in 1525, when the area was divided among Muslim states including Gorontalo, Limboto and Suwawa and stood under the influence of the Sultanate of Ternate. Five dialects are recognized, and every native word ends in a vowel. Traditionally a language of oral poetry such as the narrative tanggomo and the rhymed tuja'i, it acquired written forms only through Islamic missionaries and Dutch colonial officials, while a Malay-based creole, Gorontalo Malay, increasingly served as the regional lingua franca.
zh: 哥伦打洛语的使用者自称呼隆塔洛语，是苏拉威西岛北部哥伦打洛半岛的主要语言，由哥伦打洛人和波拉希人在哥伦打洛、北苏拉威西和中苏拉威西一带使用。它属于南岛语系菲律宾语族的哥伦打洛—蒙贡多语支，与蒙贡多语关系最近，亲属语言还有苏瓦瓦语、博兰戈语和布奥尔语等。词汇中留有马来语、阿拉伯语、葡萄牙语、荷兰语和北哈马黑拉语言的多层借词，折射出当地的贸易往来与伊斯兰教传播：1525年葡萄牙人抵达之前，伊斯兰已在半岛立足，当地分裂为哥伦打洛、林博托、苏瓦瓦等穆斯林政权，并受特尔纳特苏丹国影响。该语言可分五种方言，固有词均以元音结尾。它传统上是唐戈莫叙事诗、图贾伊韵诗等口头文学的语言，书写形式要到伊斯兰传教士和荷兰殖民官员到来后才出现，而以马来语为基础的克里奥尔语哥伦打洛马来语则日益成为地区通用语。

en: Gothic is the extinct East Germanic language of the Goths and the earliest Germanic tongue attested in any substantial body of texts. Its principal monuments are sixth-century copies of a Bible translation made in the fourth century by Ulfilas (Wulfila, 311–382), the Arian bishop of a Visigothic Christian community in the Roman province of Moesia, who devised a Gothic alphabet for the work and rendered most of the New Testament from Greek. The finest surviving manuscript, the Codex Argenteus, preserves a large part of the four gospels and was kept by the Ostrogoths in Italy. Gothic declined after the mid-sixth century, as the Goths lost their kingdoms in Italy and Gaul and the Visigoths of Spain abandoned Arianism in 589; it lingered as a spoken language in the Iberian Peninsula into the eighth century. A related form, Crimean Gothic, was recorded in the Crimea by the Habsburg envoy Ogier Ghiselin de Busbecq in the 1550s and was still reported in use there during the eighteenth century.
zh: 哥特语是哥特人使用的、已经消亡的东日耳曼语言，也是有大量文献存世的最古老日耳曼语。它最主要的遗存是6世纪抄本，所抄的是4世纪的一部圣经译本：译者乌尔菲拉（武尔菲拉，311—382年）是罗马帝国默西亚省西哥特基督徒社群的阿里乌派主教，他为翻译工作创制了哥特字母，据希腊文译出《新约》的大部分。保存最完好的手稿《银色圣经抄本》收录了四福音书的大部分，曾由意大利的东哥特人珍藏。6世纪中叶以后，随着哥特人在意大利和高卢的王国相继败亡、西班牙的西哥特人于589年放弃阿里乌派，哥特语走向衰落，但在伊比利亚半岛作为口语一直延续到8世纪。它的一支近亲克里米亚哥特语，于16世纪50年代由哈布斯堡使节奥吉尔·格瑟林·德·布斯贝克在克里米亚记录下来，直到18世纪仍有人使用。

en: Greek is the sole living language of the Indo-European Hellenic branch, spoken in the southern Balkans since the third millennium BC. First attested in Mycenaean Greek on Linear B tablets in the fifteenth century BC, it has used an alphabet adapted from Phoenician since the ninth century BC. The archaic and classical dialects were Aeolic, Ionic and Doric: the epics of Homer were sung in literary Ionic, while Athenian Attic carried the works of Plato and Aristotle. After the conquests of Alexander the Great the dialects merged into Koine, the common speech of the eastern Mediterranean, used for the New Testament. Koine became the language of the Byzantine Empire, from 620 its sole administrative language, and grew into the medieval vernacular underlying modern Greek. Under Ottoman rule Greek remained the language of the Orthodox Church and of merchants, with dialects surviving in Cappadocia and Pontus. In the early nineteenth century Adamantios Korais devised the archaizing Katharevousa, adopted for official and literary use beside spoken Demotic in the new Greek state.
zh: 希腊语是印欧语系希腊语族仅存的语言，约自公元前3000年起通行于巴尔干半岛南部。它最早见于公元前15世纪以线形文字B书写的迈锡尼希腊语泥板，公元前9世纪起改用借鉴腓尼基字母的希腊字母。古风与古典时代形成爱奥利亚、伊奥尼亚和多利安三种方言：荷马史诗以文学化的伊奥尼亚方言传诵，雅典的阿提卡方言承载了柏拉图和亚里士多德的著作。亚历山大大帝东征之后，各方言融合为科伊内共通语，成为东地中海的通用语，《新约》即用它写成。科伊内语成为拜占庭帝国的语言，620年起是帝国唯一的行政语言，并演变为近代希腊语所本的中世纪口语。奥斯曼统治时期，希腊语仍是东正教会和商人的语言，卡帕多细亚和本都等地的方言延续不绝。19世纪初，阿扎曼蒂奥斯·科拉伊斯创制仿古的书面语“纯正希腊语”，新生的希腊国家将它用于政务与文学，与口语通俗希腊语并行。

en: Guahibo, also called Sikuani, is the principal language of the Guajiboan family, whose tongues belong to the Indigenous peoples of the Llanos, the Orinoco savanna stretching between eastern Colombia and southwestern Venezuela. It forms a dialect continuum with neighbouring Cuiba, a continuity once broken only when Arawak- and Saliba-speaking peoples settled the riverbanks and later when colonial plantations and towns occupied the same rivers. Its own dialects run from the western Waü to the eastern Parawá, with Tigrero as a transitional form, while Guayabero, spoken by the Guayabero people of the forested margins, is the most divergent language of the whole family. Long contact with Arawakan languages such as Achagua and Piapoco left a layer of borrowed words in Guahibo speech. Through the centuries after 1337 it remained an unwritten language of savanna hunters, fishers and gardeners; from the late eighteenth century the Guahibo and their Cuiba kin faced mounting violence from colonists seizing the grasslands, but the language itself was carried on within the clans.
zh: 瓜希沃语又称西夸尼语，是瓜希博语系最主要的语言，该语系各语言属于亚诺斯草原——横亘哥伦比亚东部与委内瑞拉西南部的奥里诺科稀树草原——的原住民。它与相邻的奎瓦语构成方言连续体，起初只是由于说阿拉瓦克语和萨利瓦语的民族定居河畔，后来又加上殖民者的种植园和城镇占据同样的河流，这一连续性才被打断。它自身的方言从西部的瓦乌方言延伸到东部的帕拉瓦方言，蒂格雷罗方言介于两者之间；而林缘地带瓜亚韦罗人所说的瓜亚韦罗语，是整个语系中分歧最大的语言。与阿查瓜语、皮亚波科语等阿拉瓦克语言的长期接触，给瓜希沃语留下了一层借词。1337年以后的数百年间，它始终是草原猎人、渔人和园圃农人使用的无文字语言；从18世纪晚期起，瓜希沃人和他们的奎瓦亲族面对殖民者抢占草地的日益严重的暴力，但语言本身仍在氏族内部传承。

en: Guhu Oro, also called the Greater Binanderean family, groups the Papuan languages of the northeastern coast of the Bird's Tail, the southeastern peninsula of New Guinea.
