European mariners reached New Guinea early, and the Spanish explorer Yñigo Ortiz de Retez gave the island its name in 1545, yet for centuries afterward outsiders knew only its coasts, and the Koiari-speaking hinterland remained little affected by the outside world.
zh: 科亚里语又称科亚利语或草原科亚里语，是新几内亚东南部的一种巴布亚语言，通行于莫尔斯比港内陆以及亨特河、马斯格雷夫河一带。它属于科亚里安语族，该语族是跨新几内亚语系东南巴布亚语支下的一个小语族，分布在新几内亚的鸟尾半岛。科亚里安语族分为两支：科亚里科支包括草原科亚里语以及亲缘很近的山地科亚里语和科伊塔布语；马纳加拉斯高原上的巴赖支则包括巴赖语、埃塞语（又称马纳加拉西语）和奥米语。科亚里语本部分为西部和东部两个方言群，只在音系和词汇上有细小差别；其使用者与莫图人和科伊塔人的村落交错而居，邻近莫尔斯比港的港湾。欧洲海员很早就抵达新几内亚，1545年西班牙探险家伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德·雷特斯将该岛命名为新几内亚，但此后几个世纪里外来者只了解沿海地带，通行科亚里语的内陆几乎未受外部世界影响。

en: Kol is the language of the Kol people of eastern New Britain in Papua New Guinea, spoken mainly on the southern side of the island in Pomio District of East New Britain Province. It is regarded as a language isolate, though a distant link to the poorly documented Sulka language and the proposed East Papuan grouping has been suggested.
zh: 科尔语是巴布亚新几内亚新不列颠岛东部科尔人的语言，主要通行于该岛南部东新不列颠省的波米奥地区。它被视为孤立语言，尽管有学者猜测它与记录稀少的苏尔卡语及拟议中的东巴布亚语群有远亲关系。

en: Kolopom is the Trans-New Guinea language family of Kolepom Island, also called Yos Sudarso or Frederik Hendrik Island, a low-lying leaf-shaped island off southern New Guinea separated from the mainland by the narrow Muli Strait in present-day South Papua, Indonesia. Its languages are Kimaama, also known as Kimaghama, Riantana and Ndom, together with the more distant Moraori, while the separate Mombum family of the island's south is not part of it. Dutch seafarers were the first Europeans to reach it: Willem Janszoon sighted the island from the Duyfken in 1606 on the voyage that also mapped the Australian coast, and Jan Carstenszoon named its south-western cape Valse Kaap in 1623. Long charted as part of the New Guinea mainland, it was proven an island only in 1835, when Dutch survey sloops sailed the strait and named the island after Prince Frederik Hendrik.
zh: 科洛庞语是科洛彭岛上的跨新几内亚语系语族。该岛又称约斯·苏达索岛或弗雷德里克·亨德里克岛，是新几内亚岛南岸外一座地势低平、形如树叶的岛屿，以狭窄的穆利海峡与主岛相隔，位于今印度尼西亚南巴布亚省。它包括基马马语（又称基马加马语）、里安塔纳语、恩多姆语以及关系较远的莫拉奥里语，岛屿南部独立的蒙布姆语族并不属于它。荷兰航海者是最早到达这里的欧洲人：1606年，威廉·扬松驾驶“杜伊夫根号”望见这座岛，这次航行也测绘了澳大利亚海岸；1623年，扬·卡斯滕斯把岛的西南海角命名为“假角”。它长期被画成新几内亚主岛的一部分，直到1835年荷兰测量船穿过海峡，才证实它是一座岛屿，并以弗雷德里克·亨德里克亲王之名为岛命名。

en: Kongo, or Kikongo, is a tonal Bantu language spoken by the Kongo people along the Atlantic coast of Central Africa, across the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Republic of the Congo, Gabon and Angola, in dialects such as Vili, Yombe, Ntandu and Kisikongo. It was the language of the Kingdom of Kongo before the Portuguese founded Angola in 1575, and it became the first Bantu language written in Latin characters: a catechism translated by Kongo teachers from São Salvador was printed in 1624 by the Jesuit Mateus Cardoso, and around 1648 the Kongo priest Manuel Robredo compiled a dictionary of some ten thousand words for Capuchin missionaries. French missionaries on the Loango coast added further dictionaries in the 1780s. Because countless enslaved Kongo speakers were carried across the Atlantic, creolized Kikongo survives in the ritual speech of Afro-American religions in Brazil, Cuba and Haiti, and fed languages such as Gullah in North America and Palenquero in Colombia.
zh: 刚果语又称基刚果语，是一门有声调的班图语，由刚果人通行于中非大西洋沿岸，地跨刚果（金）、刚果（布）、加蓬和安哥拉，方言包括维利、约姆贝、恩坦杜和基西刚果等。1575年葡萄牙人建立安哥拉之前，它曾是刚果王国的语言。它也是最早用拉丁字母书写的班图语：1624年，耶稣会士马特乌斯·卡多佐刊印了由圣萨尔瓦多的刚果籍教师翻译的教理问答；约1648年，刚果籍神父曼努埃尔·罗布雷多为嘉布遣会传教士编纂了一部约一万词的词典。1780年代，在卢安果海岸的法国传教士又补充了多部词典。由于无数说刚果语的人被掳过大西洋，克里奥尔化的基刚果语留存于巴西、古巴和海地的美洲黑人宗教仪式用语中，并滋养了北美的古拉语和哥伦比亚的帕伦克罗语。

en: Kordofan is the label for a cluster of language groups spoken in the Nuba Mountains of South Kordofan in Sudan, rugged hills that may preserve the oldest linguistic stratum of the region. The groups usually listed are Talodi-Heiban, Lafofa, Rashad, Katla and Kadu; they share a mountain refuge rather than a demonstrated common ancestor, so the name is chiefly geographic, even though most of the groups are assigned to the Niger-Congo family while Kadu is placed in Nilo-Saharan. The Katla languages of the central hills, spoken by the Katla people, form a small family of their own and lack the noun-class morphology typical of Niger-Congo. In antiquity the mountains lay within the Kingdom of Kush, and in the Middle Ages they formed part of the Nubian kingdom of Alodia. The Taqali state arose among the Nuba hills between 1750 and 1780 and kept its independence behind its rocky ridges; although the Egyptians conquered the neighboring Kingdom of Sennar in 1821, their invasions of Taqali failed and the hill country kept its own rulers and languages.
zh: 科尔多凡语是对苏丹南科尔多凡州努巴山区一组语言的统称，这片崎岖山地可能保存着该地区最古老的语言层次。通常列入的语群有塔洛迪—海班、拉福法、拉沙德、卡特拉和卡杜；它们的共同点是同处这片山地避难所，而并非已证实拥有共同祖先，因此这个名称主要是地理性的，不过其中多数语群被归入尼日尔—刚果语系，卡杜语则被划入尼罗—撒哈拉语系。中部山区的卡特拉语由卡特拉人使用，自成一个小语支，没有尼日尔—刚果语系典型的名词类别形态。古代这一带属于库施王国，中世纪时是努比亚人阿洛迪亚王国的一部分。塔卡利邦国于1750—1780年间在努巴群山中兴起，凭借陡峭山脊保持独立；1821年埃及人征服了邻近的森纳尔王国，却屡次进攻塔卡利未果，山地居民保住了自己的统治者和语言。

en: Korean is the principal language of the Koreanic family, spoken across the Korean Peninsula, with its linguistic homeland plausibly in Manchuria; its speakers expanded into the southern peninsula around 300 BC, blending with earlier Japonic-speaking cultivators. Its recorded form passes from Old Korean, the language of the Silla kingdom, through the Middle Korean of the Goryeo and early Joseon periods. Chinese characters reached Korea in the first century BC and long served as the medium of government and formal writing; scholars bent them to Korean grammar through the idu, hyangchal and gugyeol systems, confined to a classically educated elite. In 1446 King Sejong the Great promulgated the Hunminjeongeum, a featural alphabet now called Hangul, designed for common people to learn within days. The yangban aristocracy long disdained the new script as vulgar, yet it spread through popular novels and royal notices, while the language kept elaborate honorifics and speech levels marking rank and intimacy. Chinese-character writing dominated official life into the nineteenth century.
zh: 朝鲜语是朝鲜语族的主要语言，通行于朝鲜半岛，其语言原乡可能在满洲；约公元前300年，说原始朝鲜语的人群向南扩展，与更早的日琉语系农耕者融合。有文献可征的朝鲜语经历了新罗时代的古朝鲜语，以及高丽和朝鲜王朝早期的中朝鲜语两个阶段。汉字在公元前1世纪传入，长期充当行政和正式书写的载体；文人又借吏读、乡札、口诀等方式用汉字记录朝鲜语语法，但这些写法只通习于受过汉文教育的精英。1446年，朝鲜世宗颁布《训民正音》，即后世所称的谚文，这套表音文字旨在让平民数日之内学会读写。两班贵族长期鄙称谚文粗浅，它却借助通俗小说和王室告示传播开来；朝鲜语本身也保留着繁复的敬语和语体层级，用以标示身份尊卑与亲疏。汉字书写在官方生活中的主导地位一直延续到19世纪。

en: Kosraean, sometimes also spelled Kusaiean, is an Austronesian language of the Micronesian Proper group, where it forms a branch of its own, spoken only on the small high island of Kosrae, the easternmost of the Carolines. The island was settled no later than the early first millennium, and from about 1250 its rulers were buried in the pyramid tombs of Leluh, a walled town on Lelu Island whose noble houses governed a strictly stratified, matrilineal society of nobles and commoners. Alvaro de Saavedra made the first recorded European sighting in 1529, and Spain numbered Kosrae among its claimed possessions from 1668, yet no colonial power actually occupied the island in this period. The first Europeans to land were the French circumnavigators of the corvette La Coquille, led by Louis-Isidore Duperrey, who anchored at Okat in June 1824 and walked across to Lelu. Kosraean is rich in reduplication and possessive class words that distinguish a dwelling, a drink or a food owned, and it remained a purely spoken language, with no written record made before the nineteenth century was well advanced.
zh: 科斯雷语又译库赛语，是南岛语系密克罗尼西亚语支的语言，在其中自成一个分支，仅通行于加罗林群岛最东端的小岛科斯雷。这座岛至迟在公元第一个千年初期已有居民；约1250年起，统治者被安葬在莱卢城的金字塔墓葬中，这座莱卢岛上的城邑由贵族家族治理，社会按母系氏族组织，贵族与平民等级森严。1529年，阿尔瓦罗·德·萨韦德拉首次留下欧洲人望见该岛的记录，1668年起西班牙把科斯雷列入自己宣称的领地，但这一时期并没有任何殖民势力真正占领此岛。第一批登岛的欧洲人是法国护卫舰“贝壳号”上的环球航行者，由路易·伊西多尔·迪佩雷率领，1824年6月在奥卡特抛锚，并步行走访了莱卢。科斯雷语有发达的重叠构词，物主代词还按住宅、饮品、食物等所属物的类别区分；它始终是纯粹的口语，直到19世纪很晚的时候才有书面记录。

en: Kra, also called Geyang or Kadai, is the branch of the Kra-Dai family closest to the Kam-Sui languages, scattered along a corridor from western Guizhou and Guangxi through southeastern Yunnan to the Hà Giang province of northern Vietnam. Its dozen or so tongues include Gelao, Buyang, Lachi, Laha, Qabiao and En, most of them small and heavily intermingled with Zhuang, Bouyei and Chinese, so that multilingual speakers are common and many Gelao have switched to other languages. The Gelao are regarded as the indigenous people of Guizhou, descended from the Rau who inhabited the ancient kingdom of Yelang, and the Bo of southern Sichuan, famed for their cliffside hanging coffins and bronze drums, may also have spoken a Kra language. The Bo fortress of Lingxiao was the last southern holdout against the Mongols, falling only in 1288, and in 1573 Ming armies overran the Bo strongholds in Gong County, after which the people disappear from written records. Kra languages had no traditional script, though Gelao singers around Anshun sometimes used characters derived from Chinese to record folk songs.
zh: 仡央语又称卡岱语，是壮侗语系中与侗水语支最接近的一支，沿一条走廊分布：从贵州西部、广西西部经云南东南部一直到越南北部的河江省。它包含仡佬语、布央语、拉基语、拉哈语、普标语、恩语等十几种语言，大多使用人口很少，与壮语、布依语和汉语深度交错，使用者普遍通多种语言，许多仡佬人已经转用其他语言。仡佬族被视为贵州的土著，先民是古代夜郎国的僚人；以崖壁悬棺和铜鼓闻名的川南僰人，所说的可能也是一种仡央语。僰人的凌霄城是南方抵抗蒙古的最后据点，直到1288年才陷落；1573年，明军攻占珙县一带的僰人寨堡，僰人从此从文字记载中消失。仡央诸语没有传统文字，不过安顺一带的仡佬歌手有时会用仿照汉字创制的字符记录民歌。

en: Kru is the cluster of closely related tongues spoken along the coast and forest belt from south-eastern Liberia to western Ivory Coast, divided by linguists into Western and Eastern Kru and including Bassa, Grebo, Klao, Bété, Guéré and Dida; their resemblance to the Niger-Congo languages is disputed, and some catalogues treat Kru as a family of its own. They possess some of the most elaborate tone systems in Africa, and the name Kru, from the people's own word Klao, was spread by Europeans who long confused it with the English word crew. The shore facing these speakers was the Pepper Coast visited by early Portuguese voyagers for melegueta pepper, one of the first West African coasts where European ships traded. Kru oral history records a move from the interior to the sea in the eighteenth century, and from the 1790s Kru men, called Krumen, shipped as free sailors, pilots and interpreters on European and American vessels, including warships patrolling against the slave trade, their forehead tattoos marking them as freemen; Krumen settlements then grew up in ports from Freetown to the Nigerian coast.
zh: 克鲁语是一批亲属语言的合称，通行于利比里亚东南部至科特迪瓦西部的沿海与森林地带，语言学家将其分为西克鲁和东克鲁两组，包括巴萨语、格雷博语、克劳语、贝特语、格雷语和迪达语等；它们与尼日尔—刚果语言的亲缘关系仍有争议，一些目录把克鲁语视为独立语系。克鲁诸语拥有非洲最繁复的声调体系之一。克鲁一名来自当地人的自称克劳，欧洲人却长期把它和英语里的船员一词混为一谈。这些人面对的海岸是早期葡萄牙航海者采购天堂椒的胡椒海岸，也是欧洲船只最早开展贸易的西非海岸之一。克鲁人的口述史称他们在18世纪从内陆迁至海边；从1790年代起，被称为克鲁水手的克鲁人以自由人身份受雇于欧洲和美洲船只，担任水手、领航员和翻译，甚至登上巡查奴隶贸易的军舰，他们额头上的刺青标明自己是自由人，克鲁水手的聚居区也随之在从弗里敦到尼日利亚海岸的各港口兴起。

en: Ktunaxan, also called Kutenai, is the language of the Ktunaxa people, whose bands live along the Kootenay River and around the upper Columbia in the Rocky Mountain region, in present-day southeastern British Columbia, northern Idaho and western Montana. It is usually treated as a language isolate: repeated attempts to link it to the Salishan languages of neighbouring Plateau peoples, or to wider Macro-Algonquian groupings, have not won acceptance. The language is agglutinative, marking much of its grammar with prefixes and suffixes on the verb, and uses obviation and inverse markers to track the roles of several third persons in a sentence. Beside the spoken language, the Ktunaxa also used a signed form for communication between peoples. It had no writing system of its own, and the Ktunaxa first enter written records around 1793, on a map by the fur-trader Alexander Mackenzie; by the 1830s some bands were blending Christian elements, learned through Iroquois intermediaries, into their ceremonies.
zh: 库特内语是库特内人的语言。库特内人的各个群体沿库特内河与哥伦比亚河上游而居，活动于落基山区，即今天加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省东南部、美国爱达荷州北部和蒙大拿州西部一带。学界通常把它视为孤立语言：曾有人试图把它与邻近高原民族的萨利希语族或更大的阿尔冈昆语群挂钩，都没有获得普遍承认。库特内语属黏着语，大量语法功能靠动词前后的词缀表达，并以另指和逆向标记区分句中多个第三人称的主次角色。除口语外，库特内人还使用一套手语，便于与不同民族交流。库特内语没有本民族文字，库特内人最早见于文字记载是1793年前后毛皮商亚历山大·麦肯齐地图上的标注；到19世纪30年代，部分群体已把经易洛魁中间人接触到的基督教元素融入自己的仪式。

en: Kuikúro, also called Amonap, is a southern Cariban language of the upper Xingu in the Mato Grosso interior of Brazil, spoken along the Culuene River by the Kuikuro and, with only dialectal differences, the Kalapalo; Nahukuá and Matipú form the rest of this small southern branch of the family. Its speakers are held to be descendants of the people who built the earthwork settlements of the Kuhikugu region, whose large palisaded villages with bridges, gates and roads set at regular angles had grown up by around 1400, when the upper Xingu supported a dense, interconnected population. Those towns were abandoned some four centuries later, perhaps after diseases brought by Europeans reached the basin, and the people regrouped in the river villages of the multi-ethnic Xingu network, where Kuikúro remained the Cariban tongue of the upper river.
zh: 库伊库罗语又称阿莫纳普语，是巴西内陆马托格罗索州上欣古地区的南部分支加勒比语，沿库卢埃内河通行，库伊库罗人和卡拉帕洛人都讲这种语言，彼此只有方言差别；纳胡夸语和马蒂普语是这个小型南支的另外成员。一般认为，使用者是库希库古地区土城建造者的后裔：到1400年前后，上欣古已出现带栅栏、桥梁、寨门和规整道路的大型村落，供养着稠密而彼此往来的人口。这些城镇在约四个世纪后被废弃，可能与欧洲人带来的疾病传入该盆地有关，居民重新聚集到欣古多族群网络中的河畔村落，库伊库罗语则始终是上游河流的加勒比语。

en: Kuot, also called Panaras, is a language isolate and the only non-Austronesian, or Papuan, language spoken on New Ireland in the Bismarck Archipelago. It is generally regarded as a surviving relic of the older Papuan-speaking population of the Bismarcks before Austronesian languages spread through the region with the Lapita seafarers around 1500 BCE. Kuot is spoken in ten villages strung along the eastern and western coasts of the island's narrow central neck, including Panaras and Bimun, and it has no major dialect divisions. Structurally it stands out as the only Papuan language known to use verb-subject-object word order; its grammar is agglutinative, with two grammatical genders and singular, dual and plural number. Long contact with the surrounding Oceanic languages has left marks in both directions, and linguists attribute certain sound changes in Nalik, Kara, Barok, Madak and Lamasong to Kuot influence.
zh: 库奥特语又称帕纳拉斯语，是一种孤立语言，也是俾斯麦群岛新爱尔兰岛上唯一的非南岛语言，即巴布亚语言。学界普遍认为，它是公元前1500年前后拉皮塔航海者把南岛语言带入这一地区之前，俾斯麦群岛更早的巴布亚语居民留下的孑遗。库奥特语通行于岛屿狭窄中段东西两岸的十个村落，包括帕纳拉斯和比蒙，内部没有大的方言分歧。在结构上，它是已知唯一使用动词—主语—宾语语序的巴布亚语言；语法属黏着型，有两个语法性，并区分单数、双数和复数。与周边大洋洲语言的长期接触在双方都留下了痕迹，语言学家认为纳利克语、卡拉语、巴罗克语、马达克语和拉马松语中的某些音变正是受库奥特语影响而来。

en: Kurdish, or Kurdi, is a continuum of Northwestern Iranian languages spoken across Kurdistan, in southeastern Anatolia, northern Iraq, northwestern Iran and northern Syria. Its three chief varieties are Kurmanji, Sorani and Southern Kurdish; the related Zaza and Gorani form a separate branch, though they too are spoken by millions of ethnic Kurds. The language descends from the Iranian tongues of ancient Media and Parthia: Kurdish words appear in Arabic scholarly works as early as the ninth century, and the thirteenth-century Yazidi Black Book is among its earliest texts. A literary language emerged from the fifteenth century, its classical age running through the poetry of Ali Hariri, Malaye Jaziri, Faqi Tayran and Ahmad Khani. The Battle of Chaldiran in 1514 split the Kurdish lands between the Ottoman Empire and Safavid Iran, whose wars moved the frontier back and forth for three centuries; the Ottomans organised their side into hereditary Kurdish sanjaks under Idris of Bitlis, while Shah Abbas I deported many Kurds to Khorasan after the Dimdim rising of the early seventeenth century. The Kurdish emirates kept their local autonomy until the Ottoman centralising reforms of the nineteenth century. In 1787 the Italian missionary Maurizio Garzoni printed the first Kurdish grammar in Rome after eighteen years at Amadiya, earning the title father of Kurdology.
zh: 库尔德语（Kurdi）是一组西北伊朗语言的方言连续体，通行于库尔德斯坦的山地与高原，即安纳托利亚东南部、伊拉克北部、伊朗西北部和叙利亚北部。它的三大变体是库尔曼吉语、索拉尼语，以及南库尔德语；与之有亲缘关系的扎扎语和戈拉尼语另成一支，但也有数百万库尔德族人使用。学者将这种语言追溯到米底和帕提亚的古伊朗语：9世纪的阿拉伯学术著作已在记录库尔德语词汇，13世纪雅兹迪教的《黑书》则是其最早的宗教文本之一。书面文学语言从15世纪开始形成，其古典时代贯穿阿里·哈里里、马拉耶·贾齐里、法基·塔伊兰和艾哈迈德·哈尼等人的诗歌。1514年的恰尔德兰战役把库尔德人的家园分割于奥斯曼帝国与萨法维伊朗之间，此后三百年间，双方的战争一再改变边界走向；奥斯曼人在比特利斯的伊德里斯主持下把己方一侧编为世袭库尔德桑贾克，而阿拔斯一世在17世纪初迪姆迪姆起义之后，把大批库尔德人迁往呼罗珊。库尔德埃米尔国保有地方自治，直到19世纪奥斯曼推行中央集权改革为止。1787年，意大利神父毛里齐奥·加尔佐尼在阿马迪耶传教十八年后，于罗马印行了第一部库尔德语语法，赢得“库尔德学之父”的称号。

en: Kutubuan is a small family of Papuan languages named after Lake Kutubu, an upland lake set in the mountain forests of the Southern Highlands that drains east into the Kikori River. It has two branches whose speakers face each other across the water: East Kutubuan, comprising Foe and Fiwaga, and West Kutubuan, comprising Fasu, Some and Namumi. The two branches share only a thin layer of vocabulary, so linguists still debate how closely they are related, and both are placed in the Kikorian branch of the tentative Papuan Gulf grouping. The Foe live along the southern shore of the lake and the Fasu along the northern, fishing its clear waters and tending gardens on the surrounding slopes, with villages also standing on its small islands. Long sealed in the rugged interior, these communities were unknown to Europeans when Yñigo Ortiz de Retez named New Guinea in 1545, and the lake was not reached by the outside world until the colonial era.
zh: 库图布安语是一个巴布亚语言小语族，得名于南部高地省山林中的高原湖泊库图布湖，湖水向东注入基科里河。它分两支，使用者隔湖相望：东库图布支包括福语和菲瓦加语，西库图布支包括法苏语、索梅语和纳穆米语。两支共有的词汇很少，亲缘远近一直存在争议，学者把它们都归入暂定的巴布亚湾语群下的基科里安支。福人住在湖南岸，法苏人住在湖北岸，在清澈的湖水中捕鱼，在周围坡地上经营园圃，还有村落建在湖中的小岛上。这些社群长期封闭在崎岖内陆，1545年伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德·雷特斯为新几内亚命名时，欧洲人对它们一无所知，外界直到殖民时代才抵达这座湖。

en: Kwa, in its narrow New Kwa form, is the proposed Niger-Congo branch covering south-eastern Ivory Coast, southern Ghana and central Togo; its name comes from the word for person shared by many of the languages, Akan among them. Its heart is the Potou-Tano group of the Akan, whose Twi and Fante speech joins Ga-Dangme and the Gbe cluster of Ewe, Fon and Aja, though recent classifications transfer Gbe to the neighbouring Volta-Niger branch; these are tonal, isolating languages with subject-verb-object word order. Akan settlements such as Asantemanso existed by the ninth century, and the Bono state grew rich carrying gold and kola north through Begho, paving the way for later Akan powers such as Denkyira and Akwamu. In 1701 the Asante ruler Osei Tutu, with his adviser Okomfo Anokye and the Golden Stool as the symbol of union, defeated Denkyira and built the Ashanti Empire from Kumasi, reaching the coast and the Dutch trade, and overran Bono in 1723. East of the Volta the Gbe peoples, settled by migrations between the tenth and fifteenth centuries, formed the kingdom of Allada and, about 1600, Dahomey on the Abomey plateau; King Agaja took Allada in 1724 and Whydah in 1727, and the slave trade then carried Gbe speech into Caribbean creoles such as Haitian Creole. Dahomey long paid tribute to the Oyo Empire and only shook off that yoke in 1827.
zh: 克瓦语（狭义又称新克瓦语）是尼日尔—刚果语系下一个亲缘关系尚无定论的语支，通行于科特迪瓦东南部、加纳南部和多哥中部，名称来自这些语言中普遍表示“人”的词，阿坎语里也有同样的说法。它的核心是阿坎人的波托—塔诺语组，包括契维语和芳蒂语，此外还有加—丹梅语以及由埃维语、丰语、阿贾语组成的格贝语群，不过晚近的分类多把格贝语群划入相邻的沃尔特—尼日尔语支；这些语言都是有声调的孤立语，采用主谓宾语序。阿坎人的聚落如阿桑特曼索至迟在9世纪已经存在，博诺国经贝戈向北贩运黄金和可拉果而致富，为登基拉、阿夸姆等后来的阿坎政权开辟了道路。1701年，阿散蒂首领奥塞·图图在谋臣奥科姆福·安诺基辅佐下，以金凳子为团结象征击败登基拉，以库马西为都建立阿散蒂帝国，势力直达海岸与荷兰人的商路，并于1723年攻灭博诺。沃尔特河以东，在10至15世纪的迁徙中定居下来的格贝人建立了阿拉达王国，又于1600年前后在阿波美高原建立达荷美王国；国王阿加贾于1724年攻取阿拉达、1727年攻取维达，随后的奴隶贸易把格贝诸语带进海地克里奥尔语等加勒比克里奥尔语。达荷美长期向奥约帝国纳贡，直到1827年才摆脱这一臣属地位。

en: Kwaio, also known as Koio, Welakau or Fataia, is an Austronesian language of the Oceanic branch spoken across the mountainous interior of central Malaita in the Solomon Islands. Its speakers, the Kwaio, live in small scattered hamlets and farm taro by swidden cultivation; their oral tradition holds that the forest was first cleared and clan lands founded between twelve hundred and two thousand years ago. Kwaio society is organised around descent groups and an ancestor religion governed by rules of taboo, called abu, whose language of ritual and sacrifice forms a central part of the tongue. Although Álvaro de Mendaña's Spanish ships sighted Malaita in 1568, the island's highlands long remained beyond European reach, and the Kwaio had no recorded contact with outsiders during this period; their language had no writing and was carried by speech, genealogy and oral lore.
zh: 夸约语又称科约语、韦拉考语或法塔亚语，是南岛语系大洋洲语支的语言，通行于所罗门群岛马莱塔岛中部多山的内陆。夸约人居住在分散的小村落里，以刀耕火种方式种植芋头；口传传统称，林地最早在一千二百至两千年前被开垦，氏族的土地也由此奠定。夸约社会以血缘继嗣群和祖先崇拜为核心，受称为阿布的禁忌规则约束，祭祀与献祭用语是该语言的重要组成部分。1568年阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚的西班牙船队虽然望见了马莱塔，但岛上高地长期处于欧洲人势力之外，这一时期的夸约人与外界没有留下接触记录；他们的语言没有文字，靠言语、谱系和口传知识传承。

en: Kwara'ae is the Oceanic language spoken across the western, central and eastern districts of Malaita, and the largest indigenous vernacular of the Solomon Islands. Its speakers include both the bush people of the interior and the salt-water people of the Langa Langa Lagoon, where feuding drove refugees onto artificial islands raised from coral and sandbars, and where lagoon towns such as Laulasi became centres of shell-money manufacture and an ancestor cult served by priests guarding skulls in tabu houses. Kwara'ae oral tradition tells of a founding ancestor who landed first on Guadalcanal and, led by a magical staff, crossed into central Malaita about twenty generations ago, his descendants spreading through the lowlands. Spanish ships under Álvaro de Mendaña sighted Malaita in 1568, but sustained European contact waited until the chain's rediscovery in the late eighteenth century; Kwara'ae itself remained an unwritten language of ritual, genealogy and daily speech.
zh: 夸拉埃语是通行于马莱塔岛西部、中部和东部的大洋洲语言，也是所罗门群岛使用人数最多的本土语言。使用者既包括内陆的丛林居民，也包括兰加兰加潟湖的咸水居民；部落仇杀迫使难民迁往潟湖，在珊瑚和沙洲上堆起人工岛，劳拉西等潟湖城镇由此成为贝壳货币的制作中心，祭司在禁忌之屋中守护祖先头骨，主持祖先崇拜。夸拉埃人的口传传统称，始祖最初在瓜达尔卡纳尔登陆，约二十代前受一根魔法手杖指引进入马莱塔中部，立下文化规范，后裔随后散布到各低地。1568年阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚率领的西班牙船队望见了马莱塔，但持续的欧洲接触要等到18世纪末群岛被重新发现；夸拉埃语本身始终是没有文字的语言，存在于祭祀、谱系和日常言语之中。

en: Kwaza is an unclassified language, best treated as an isolate, spoken by the Kwaza people of southeastern Rondônia in western Brazil, around the São Pedro river amid Aikanã- and Kanoê-speaking neighbours.
zh: 夸扎语是一种未分类语言，通常视为孤立语，由巴西西部朗多尼亚州东南部圣佩德罗河一带的夸扎人使用，周边是说艾卡纳语和卡诺埃语的族群。

en: Kwerbic, or Greater Kwerba, is a family of close to a dozen Papuan languages in the Indonesian half of New Guinea, centred on the Foja Range behind the north-coast town of Sarmi. Its chief language is Kwerba, of scattered Sarmi Regency villages; Isirawa and Kapauri–Sause are among its relatives, and the group is linked with the neighbouring Tor languages.
zh: 奎尔比克语又称大奎尔巴语，是印度尼西亚所属新几内亚地区的一个巴布亚语族，含近十二种语言，中心在北海岸萨尔米城后方的福贾山脉。代表语言是奎尔巴语，通行于萨尔米县分散的村落；伊西拉瓦语、卡保利—索塞语是其较近的亲属，学者还将该语群与邻近的托尔诸语言联系起来。

en: Kwomtari is a Papuan language of the remote inland country near the border of northern Papua New Guinea and Indonesia, giving its name to the small Kwomtari family, whose links to the neighbouring Fas languages remain disputed. Its verb carries subject and object suffixes and marks mood rather than tense, while nouns have no gender or number.
zh: 科姆塔里语是一种巴布亚语言，通行于巴布亚新几内亚北部与印度尼西亚边境附近的偏远内陆，并因它得名于小型的科姆塔里语族；该语族与邻近法斯诸语言是否同源，学界仍有争议。科姆塔里语的动词以词缀标记主语和宾语，屈折变化表示语气而非时态，名词则没有性、数标记。

en: Kx'a, also called Ju–ǂHoan, is the click-language family of the San hunter-gatherers of the Kalahari and the surrounding drylands of southern Africa, uniting the ǃKung, or Juu, dialect continuum with the ǂ'Amkoe language. Its speakers live in small foraging bands, and the family has no written tradition: its languages were carried entirely by oral performance. They are famous for their click consonants, which include dental, alveolar, palatal, lateral and retroflex articulations, together with tone and nasalization; the reconstructed ancestral speech, Proto-Juu, possessed all five click positions, giving these tongues some of the largest consonant inventories in the world. Kx'a was once grouped with the Tuu and Khoe families under the label Khoisan, but that unity is no longer accepted, and the link between ǃKung and ǂ'Amkoe was recognised only by later comparative linguistics. Before the Bantu expansion, click languages of this kind were spread far more widely across southern Africa; as Bantu- and Khoe-speaking herders advanced, Kx'a speech retreated toward the desert, where it remained the unwritten language of isolated foraging bands through the centuries after 1337.
zh: 卡语又称久—霍安语，是南部非洲卡拉哈里及周边干旱地带桑人狩猎采集者的搭嘴音语言，由空语（又称久语）方言群与安科依语共同组成。说这些语言的人以小型游群为生，没有文字传统，语言全靠口头传承。它们以种类繁多的搭嘴音闻名，分齿、龈、腭、边、卷舌五种发音部位，再加上声调和鼻化；据构拟，始祖语言原始久语具备全部五组搭嘴音，使这类语言拥有世界上最庞大的辅音库之一。卡语曾与图乌、科依两个语系一并归入“科伊桑”名下，但这一归类后来被推翻，空语与安科依语的亲缘关系很晚才由比较语言学证实。在班图人扩张之前，这类搭嘴音语言曾广布南部非洲；随着说班图语和科依语的牧人推进，卡语不断向沙漠退缩，1337年以后的数百年间，它始终是散居沙漠的狩猎游群使用的无文字语言。

en: Lamogai is an Austronesian language of the island of New Britain in Papua New Guinea, spoken in parts of West New Britain Province. Within Oceanic it belongs to the Bibling linkage of the Ngero–Vitiaz branch, together with the nearby Mouk-Aria and other Southwest New Britain languages.
zh: 拉莫盖语是巴布亚新几内亚新不列颠岛上的一种南岛语，通行于西新不列颠省的部分地区。在泛太平洋语族中，它与邻近的莫克—阿里亚等新不列颠西南部语言同属恩盖罗—维蒂亚兹分支的比卜林语链。

en: Lampung is a Lampungic language of the Austronesian family, spoken by the Lampung people of southern Sumatra and neighbouring parts of South Sumatra and Banten. It splits into two main varieties, the coastal Api or Pesisir dialect and the interior Nyo or Abung dialect, while the related Komering speech of the Komering valley is often treated as a separate language. Traditionally it is written in the Lampung alphabet, a Rencong abugida descended from the Old Javanese Kawi script. The region entered written history with Srivijaya: stone inscriptions of about 680 found at Palas Pasemah and Bungkuk mark the southernmost reach of that maritime empire, and an Old Malay inscription of 997 survives at Hujung Langit, after which Majapahit claimed the area. From the mid-sixteenth century the pepper-rich coasts passed under the Banten Sultanate, which monopolized the Lampung pepper trade, and in 1752 the Dutch annexed the region as the Lampong Districts of their East Indies. Through these changes Lampung remained the everyday speech of the river valleys, even as Malay served trade and administration.
zh: 楠榜语是南岛语系楠榜语支的语言，使用者为苏门答腊南部以及邻近的南苏门答腊、万丹部分地区的楠榜人。它分为两大变体：沿海的阿皮语（又称佩西西尔方言）和内陆的尼奥语（又称阿邦方言）；科梅林河谷与它相近的科梅林语则常被视为独立语言。楠榜语传统上用楠榜字母书写，这是一种源自古爪哇卡威文的伦聪元音附标文字。该地区随室利佛逝进入信史：在帕拉斯帕塞马和本库发现的约680年石碑，标志着这个海上帝国势力的最南端，997年的古马来语铭文仍存于胡姜朗依，其后满者伯夷曾领有此地。16世纪中叶起，盛产胡椒的沿海地区归入万丹苏丹国，其君主垄断了楠榜的胡椒贸易；1752年荷兰人吞并该地区，将其划为荷属东印度的楠榜辖区。历经这些变迁，楠榜语始终是河谷居民的日常语言，而马来语则用于贸易和行政。

en: Even, historically called Lamut after the Yakut word lamu for the Okhotsk Sea, is a Tungusic language and the closest relative of Evenki, from which it split only gradually; the two remained barely distinct as late as the 1800s. It is the tongue of nomadic reindeer herders scattered across the far northeast of Siberia, from the Lena in the west to Kamchatka and the Okhotsk coast in the east and from the Arctic shore south to the Aldan. When Russian Cossacks reached the Pacific in the 1600s, its speakers included the Okhotsk reindeer Tungus and the settled Arman group, whose highly divergent speech stood closer to being a language of its own. Even is an agglutinative language with subject–object–verb order and a vocabulary rich in terms for herding and seasonal migration, and it stayed purely oral throughout this period, with no written form of its own. From the 1800s the Evens were counted as Orthodox Christians while keeping many older shamanic practices.
zh: 鄂温语旧称拉穆特语，“拉穆特”来自雅库特语中指鄂霍次克海的“拉穆”一词。它属于满‑通古斯语族，与鄂温克语亲缘最近，二者分化缓慢，直到19世纪仍难以截然分开。操这种语言的是游牧驯鹿牧人，散居在西伯利亚极东北部：西起勒拿河，东到堪察加和鄂霍次克海岸，北临北冰洋，南抵阿尔丹河。17世纪俄国哥萨克推进到太平洋时，说这种语言的人群包括鄂霍次克的驯鹿通古斯人和定居的阿尔曼人，后者差异很大的土语近乎一门独立语言。鄂温语是黏着语，语序为主宾动，词汇中关于放牧和季节性迁徙的词语极为丰富；在本时期它始终没有自己的文字，纯粹靠口耳相传。19世纪起，鄂温人在名义上被算作东正教徒，同时保留了许多更早的萨满教习俗。

en: Laragiya, also called Gulumirrgin, is the language of the Larrakia people, the Saltwater People of the harbour country around present-day Darwin on the north coast of the Northern Territory. When the first British colony in Australia was founded in 1788, Larrakia territory stretched south from the harbour toward Coolalinga, bordered by the Wulna and Warrai, and the Larrakia traded and intermarried with the Tiwi, Wadjiginy and Djerimanga, sharing ceremonies and songlines. Long treated as a language isolate, Laragiya has more recently been grouped with Limilngan and Wulna in the proposed Darwin Region family of non-Pama–Nyungan languages, and it is recorded in a Latin-script orthography.
zh: 拉拉吉亚语又称古卢米尔金语，是拉拉基亚人的语言。拉拉基亚人自称‘咸水人’，居住在北领地北岸今达尔文港一带。1788年英国在澳大利亚建立第一个殖民地时，拉拉基亚人的地盘从港湾向南延伸到库拉林加，与武尔纳人和瓦赖人为邻；他们与提维人、瓦吉吉尼人、杰里芒加人贸易通婚，共享仪式和歌路。拉拉吉亚语长期被视为孤立语言，后来有学者把它与利米恩甘语、武尔纳语归入拟议中的达尔文地区语族，属非帕马—恩永甘语言，以拉丁字母记录。

en: Latin is an Italic language of the Indo-European family, first spoken by the Latins of Latium around the lower Tiber and carried across the Mediterranean by the expansion of Rome. Its alphabet was borrowed from the Etruscans, and between about 75 BC and AD 200 the orators and poets of the late Republic and early Empire fixed Classical Latin, the language of Cicero, Virgil and Caesar, while the colloquial Vulgar Latin of soldiers and settlers spread through the provinces. Between the sixth and ninth centuries regional Vulgar Latin speech broke up into the Romance languages, yet written Latin lived on: Medieval Latin was the working language of the Church, law courts and scholarship across Western and Central Europe, reaching Germanic and Slavic lands that Rome had never ruled. From around 1300 Renaissance humanists such as Petrarch revived classical models, and the resulting Neo-Latin carried Erasmus's satires, Thomas More's Utopia and, in 1687, Newton's Principia. Until the end of the seventeenth century most books and nearly all diplomatic documents were in Latin; afterwards French and other vernaculars displaced it, though Ecclesiastical Latin remained the liturgical language of the Catholic Church.
zh: 拉丁语是印欧语系意大利语族的语言，最初由台伯河下游拉丁姆地区的拉丁人使用，随罗马的扩张传遍地中海。它的字母借自伊特鲁里亚人，约公元前75年至公元200年间，共和国晚期和帝国初期的演说家与诗人定型了古典拉丁语，即西塞罗、维吉尔和凯撒所用的语言，而士兵与移民口中的通俗拉丁语则通行于各行省。6至9世纪，各地的通俗拉丁语分化为罗曼诸语，但书面拉丁语延续下来：中世纪拉丁语是西欧和中欧教会、法庭和学术界的工作语言，甚至传到罗马从未统治过的日耳曼和斯拉夫地区。约1300年起，彼特拉克等文艺复兴人文主义者复兴古典范式，由此形成的新拉丁语承载了伊拉斯谟的讽刺作品、托马斯·莫尔的《乌托邦》，以及1687年牛顿的《自然哲学的数学原理》。直到17世纪末，大部分书籍和几乎所有外交文书仍用拉丁语写成；此后法语和其他民族语言取代了它，只有教会拉丁语继续作为天主教会的礼仪语言。

en: Lavongai, also called Tungag after its principal village area, is an Austronesian language spoken on New Hanover Island, known to its people as Lavongai, and on the neighbouring islets off the north-western tip of New Ireland in the Bismarck Archipelago of present-day Papua New Guinea. It keeps the classic Oceanic equipment of singular, dual, trial and plural pronouns, with separate forms showing whether the listener is included, and marks possession by suffixes on nouns. Its dialects fall into a south-coast group and a western and northern group, though village differences do not impede understanding. The islanders live by subsistence farming and fishing. The first inhabitants of the archipelago arrived in remote prehistory, Lapita seafarers settled the region about three thousand years ago, and Dutch sailors Jacob Le Maire and Willem Schouten made the first European landfall in the New Ireland chain in 1616.
zh: 拉翁盖语又称通阿格语，得名于岛上的主要聚落区域，是一种南岛语，通行于新汉诺威岛（当地人称之为拉翁盖）以及今巴布亚新几内亚俾斯麦群岛中新爱尔兰岛西北端外的邻近小岛。它保留了大洋洲语言典型的单数、双数、三数和复数代词，区分是否把听话者包括在内，并通过名词后缀表示领属。其方言分为南海岸一支与西部、北部一支，但村落之间的差异并不妨碍交流。岛民以自给农业和捕鱼为生。俾斯麦群岛的最早居民在遥远的史前时代到来，约三千年前拉皮塔航海者在此定居；1616年，荷兰水手雅各布·勒梅尔和威廉·斯考滕首次在新爱尔兰岛链登陆。

en: Lega, or Kilega, is a Bantu dialect cluster spoken by the Lega people in the forests and Mitumba mountains east of the Congo River, in the South Kivu, North Kivu and Maniema provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It splits into two main varieties, Shabunda Lega and Mwenga Lega, which are only partly mutually intelligible, and Gengele, a creole based on the Shabunda variety, is counted among its offshoots. The Lega began migrating from the White Nile region, in what is now Uganda, to their present lands in the 1500s, conquering the forest peoples they found there. Their society is ordered by the Bwami association, a hierarchy of initiation grades whose moral teaching is expressed through ivory masks and small carved figures. Lega is also spelled Rega or Leka, and Bembe belongs to the same dialect continuum.
zh: 莱加语又称基莱加语，是一个班图方言群，由莱加人使用，分布在刚果河以东的森林与米通巴山区，即今刚果（金）南基伍、北基伍和马涅马三省。它分为两种主要变体——沙本达莱加语和姆文加莱加语，彼此只能部分互通；以沙本达变体为基础形成的克里奥尔语根盖莱语也被视为它的分支。莱加人于16世纪从白尼罗河流域（今乌干达一带）迁往现地，征服了沿途遇到的森林族群。他们的社会以布瓦米社团为核心，按入会等级层层排列，道德教化通过象牙面具和小型雕刻形象来传达。莱加语亦拼作雷加或莱卡，本贝语则属于同一方言连续体。

en: Lenakel, whose speakers call it Netvaar, is a dialect chain of the Austronesian family spoken along the western coast of Tanna in southern Vanuatu. It is one of five indigenous languages on the island, belonging with them to the Southern Vanuatu subgroup, and shades into the neighbouring Whitesands and North Tanna speech forms through a continuum of dialects rather than sharp boundaries. Tanna was settled around 400 BC by Melanesian seafarers, and its languages developed in isolation until James Cook, drawn by the glow of the Yasur volcano, landed at Port Resolution in August 1774 and gave the island its name, from a local word meaning earth. Whaling ships called regularly from 1804, and the trader Peter Dillon anchored at Port Resolution in 1825, opening the era of sandalwood commerce. Like the other Tanna languages, Lenakel had no script of its own and was transmitted only by speech.
zh: 莱纳克尔语的使用者自称内特瓦尔语，是南瓦努阿图塔纳岛西海岸通行的一种南岛语系方言链。它是岛上五种本土语言之一，与其他四种同属南瓦努阿图语支，并通过连续的方言过渡与邻近的怀特桑兹语、北塔纳语相接，彼此没有清晰的界线。塔纳岛约在公元前400年由美拉尼西亚航海者定居，岛上语言在隔绝中自行演变，直到1774年8月，詹姆斯·库克被亚苏尔火山的火光吸引，在决心港登陆，并以当地意为土地的词为该岛命名。1804年起捕鲸船定期到访，1825年商人彼得·狄龙停泊决心港，开启了檀木贸易的时代。与塔纳岛其他语言一样，莱纳克尔语没有自己的文字，只靠口耳相传。

en: Lenni-Lenape is the Delawaran group of Eastern Algonquian languages, comprising Unami and Munsee, the two close tongues of the Lenape or Delaware people, together with Mahican, the speech of their Hudson valley kinsmen. Lenni Lenape means the original or genuine people, while Delaware is an English exonym taken from the river named after Lord De La Warr. Their homeland, called Lenapehoking, covered the Delaware valley, New Jersey, eastern Pennsylvania and the country around New York Bay and the lower Hudson, where some forty autonomous bands lived by farming, hunting and fishing at the time of contact. Dutch, Swedish and English settlers crowded in from the early 1600s; William Penn made his famous treaty of friendship in 1682, but the fraudulent Walking Purchase of 1737 stripped the Lenape of a huge tract and opened the long series of removals that carried them through Ohio and onward to Indiana, Wisconsin, Kansas, Oklahoma and Ontario. Mahican groups, pressed by the Mohawk, gathered at Stockbridge in Massachusetts from the 1730s, while Moravian missionaries such as David Zeisberger and John Heckewelder gave the language its first stable Latin orthography and compiled its earliest grammars and dictionaries. In 1782 Pennsylvania militiamen killed ninety-six unarmed Christian Lenape at Gnadenhütten in Ohio, deepening the dispersal that scattered the Delawaran languages across half a continent.
zh: 莱纳佩语是东阿尔冈昆语族下的特拉华语支，由莱纳佩人（又称特拉华人）的两种近亲语言乌纳米语、蒙西语，加上他们在哈德逊河谷的亲族莫希干人所说的莫希干语组成。“伦尼莱纳佩”意为“真正的人”，“特拉华”则是英国人的他称，得名于以德拉沃尔勋爵命名的特拉华河。他们的故土名叫莱纳佩霍金，涵盖特拉华河谷、新泽西、宾夕法尼亚东部以及纽约湾和哈德逊河下游一带；欧洲人初到时，约四十个自治的氏族群落靠农耕、渔猎为生。荷兰、瑞典和英国殖民者从1600年代初起不断涌入：威廉·佩恩于1682年订立著名的友好条约，但1737年欺诈性的“步行购地”夺走了大片土地，开启了一连串迁徙，莱纳佩人经俄亥俄一路迁往印第安纳、威斯康星、堪萨斯、俄克拉荷马和安大略。莫希干人受莫霍克人逼迫，从1730年代起聚居于马萨诸塞的斯托克布里奇；戴维·蔡斯贝格、约翰·赫克韦尔德等摩拉维亚传教士则为这种语言创制了最早的稳定拉丁字母拼写法，编出第一批语法和词典。1782年，宾夕法尼亚民兵在俄亥俄的格纳登胡滕杀害了九十六名手无寸铁的基督徒莱纳佩人，进一步加剧了流散，使特拉华语支诸语散布到半个北美大陆。

en: Lewo, also called Varsu or Laewo, is an Oceanic language of the North and Central Vanuatu group, spoken in the eastern part of Epi, a volcanic island at the northern end of the Shepherd Islands in Shefa Province, chiefly around the Varsu and Varmali districts. It is the most widely used language of eastern Epi, although its speakers live in small villages scattered across the island. Its surviving dialects, Tasiko, Lemaroro and Maluba, are the remainder of a much larger number, and many words found in the other languages of Epi are said to have originated in Lewo. Its closest relative is Lamen, spoken at the north-western tip of Epi and on the nearby islet of the same name, with which it shares about four-fifths of its vocabulary, and many Lewo speakers also know Bierebo, the language of the north-west coast. Unusually for an Oceanic language, Lewo marks four grades of spatial deixis, near the speaker, near the hearer, near both, and distant or unknown, where most related languages have only three; it places demonstratives after the noun and has only an indefinite article, leaving a deictic particle to serve as a definite one. Off Epi's southern coast lie the Shepherd Islands, charted and named by James Cook in 1774. Epi itself was once even more fragmented linguistically, but in the nineteenth century the island suffered severe depopulation, and mission influence drew its inland communities into coastal villages and redrew its linguistic map.
zh: 莱沃语又称瓦尔苏语或拉埃沃语，是北中瓦努阿图语群的一种大洋洲语，通行于谢法省谢泼德群岛北端的火山岛埃皮岛东部，主要分布在瓦尔苏和瓦尔马利一带。它是埃皮岛东部使用最广的语言，但使用者散居在全岛各处的小村庄里。现存的塔西科、莱马罗罗和马卢巴三种方言，是过去多得多的方言合并后的残余；据说埃皮岛其他语言中的许多词汇都源自莱沃语。与它亲缘最近的是拉门语，后者通行于埃皮岛西北角及附近的同名小岛，两者词汇约有五分之四相通；许多莱沃语使用者还兼通西北沿海的比埃雷博语。莱沃语的空间指示分四级，即靠近说话者、靠近听话者、靠近双方以及远处或位置不明，这在大洋洲语中并不常见，多数亲属语言只有三级；它的指示词置于名词之后，且只有不定冠词，由一个指示小品词承担定冠词的功能。埃皮岛南方的谢泼德群岛由詹姆斯·库克于1774年测绘命名。埃皮岛过去的语言分化更为严重，但19世纪该岛人口锐减，传教活动又促使内陆社群迁居沿海村庄，重塑了岛上的语言版图。

en: Limilngan, also called Limil or Manidja, was the language of the Limilngan people of the Top End, spoken in the Darwin hinterland around the Mary River on the western edge of the Kakadu country; the name Buneidja denotes the same language. When the first British colony in Australia was founded in 1788, its speakers shared the coastal plain south of Darwin with the neighbouring Wulna, whose language of the Adelaide River is its closest relative, and both are placed in the Darwin Region family of non-Pama–Nyungan languages. Limilngan has a three-vowel sound system, and in local dreamtime tradition the creator being Imberombera chanted the language of each country as she walked south from the sea.
zh: 利米恩甘语又称利米尔语或马尼贾语，是顶端地带利米恩甘人的语言，通行于达尔文腹地、卡卡杜西缘的玛丽河一带；布内贾一名指的也是这种语言。1788年英国在澳大利亚建立第一个殖民地时，说这种语言的人与邻族武尔纳人共居达尔文以南的沿海平原，武尔纳语通行于阿德莱德河流域，是它最近的亲属，二者同属非帕马—恩永甘的达尔文地区语族。利米恩甘语的语音系统只有三个元音；在当地的梦创时代传说中，创世者因贝罗贝拉从海上向南走来，每到一地便诵唱当地该说的语言。

en: Lotuko, better known as Otuho, is the Bari-language of the Otuho people of the Equatorian hills in South Sudan, with the related Dongotono, Logir, Ifoto and Imatong varieties around the Imatong range; in a wider sense the name stands for the whole Eastern Nilotic spread, whose speakers began to diverge in the first millennium BC from a homeland in Equatoria and drifted south through the dry plains of the Rift Valley as cattle-keeping pastoralists. Its sister branches cover most of the region: the Ateker or Teso-Turkana group, in which the Turkana broke from the Ateker confederation and fought their way into the basin of Lake Turkana, occupying it fully by the 1600s, and the Ongamo-Maa group, whose Maasai tongue spread through the Kenya and Tanzania grasslands in the eighteenth century amid the long Iloikop wars. The oldest Maa venture south was that of the Ongamo, also called Ngasa, who reached the plains north of Kilimanjaro in the twelfth century and then lost ground over five centuries to incoming Bantu Chagga farmers, eventually abandoning their language for Chagga. Eastern Nilotic languages thus trace a single southward arc from the Lotuko hills of Equatoria, through the Turkana desert, to Maasai country beneath Kilimanjaro.
zh: 洛图科语更常用的名字是奥图霍语，是南苏丹赤道州丘陵地带奥图霍人的巴里语支语言，伊马通山脉一带有东戈托诺、洛吉尔、伊福托、伊马通等近亲方言；在更宽泛的意义上，这个名字代表整个东尼罗特语群——其使用者于公元前第一千纪从赤道州的故土开始分化，作为养牛的牧民沿裂谷干旱平原向南迁徙。它的姊妹语支遍布该地区：阿泰克尔（特索—图尔卡纳）语支中，图尔卡纳人从阿泰克尔联盟中分离出来，一路征战进入图尔卡纳湖盆地，到17世纪已将其完全占据；翁加莫—马语支中，马赛语在18世纪趁漫长的伊洛伊科普战争扩散到肯尼亚和坦桑尼亚草原。马语族群最早的南下是翁加莫人（又称恩加萨人），他们在12世纪抵达乞力马扎罗山以北的平原，随后五百年间在不断迁入的班图系查加农民面前节节后退，最终放弃本族语言改用查加语。东尼罗特诸语由此划出一条南下弧线：从赤道州的洛图科丘陵，经图尔卡纳沙漠，直到乞力马扎罗山下的马赛之地。

en: Luba, or Tshiluba, is a Bantu language of the Kasai basin in the south-central Democratic Republic of the Congo, with an eastern dialect spoken by the Luba and a western one by the Lulua; together with Kete, Kanyok, Sanga and Luba-Katanga it forms the Luba group of Zone L Bantu languages. Its speakers descend from iron-working communities that had settled the lakes and marshes of the Upemba Depression by the 400s, building dams and dikes for fishing and farming and trading copper wire and pottery. Around 1500 these chiefdoms coalesced into the Kingdom of Luba, whose sacred kings, the Balopwe, ruled alongside a council of elders and whose political model was copied by the neighbouring Lunda. At its height in the eighteenth century the kingdom drew many surrounding peoples into its cultural orbit, while Luba itself remained an unwritten language, its histories and moral teachings carried by oral recitation.
zh: 卢巴语又称奇卢巴语，是刚果（金）中南部开赛盆地的一门班图语：东部方言由卢巴人使用，西部方言由卢卢阿人使用；它与凯特语、卡尼奥克语、桑加语和加丹加卢巴语等同属班图语L区的卢巴语群。说这种语言的人继承了铁器时代工匠的传统：早在5世纪，他们的先民已在乌彭巴洼地的湖沼间定居，修筑堤坝和围堰捕鱼耕作，并以铜丝和陶器贸易为生。约1500年，这些酋邦合并为卢巴王国，神圣国王巴洛普韦与长老会议共同执政，其政体被邻邦隆达人仿效。18世纪王国鼎盛时，众多周边族群被纳入其文化圈；而卢巴语本身没有文字，历史与道德教化全靠口诵传承。

en: Lule is the extinct language of the Lule people of the Argentine Gran Chaco, first met by Europeans in what is now Salta Province and the adjoining borders of Bolivia and Paraguay, from which the Wichí later pushed them south into Santiago del Estero and Tucumán. Most Lules were nomadic hunter-gatherers who also grew maize, potatoes and quinoa, while settled groups on the Andean edge kept llamas and commanded several tongues: the plains Lule used Tonocoté as a lingua franca, and the foothill Lules were trilingual in Lule, Tonocoté and Quechua. Lule is usually grouped with the still-spoken Vilela in the small Lule–Vilela family, though some linguists treat the two as isolates shaped by contact. Its chief document is the Arte y vocabulario de la lengua lule y tonocoté printed in 1732 by the Jesuit Antonio Machoni, who worked among the mission Lules; an earlier Tonocoté grammar written by Alonso de Bárcena in 1586 is lost. Jesuit missions gathered the Lules from 1670 onwards, and the Miraflores mission on the Salado River, founded in 1715, was sacked in a native rising of 1728, rebuilt in 1752, and abandoned after the Jesuit expulsion of 1768. As the mission world dissolved, Lule gave way to Spanish and the languages of neighbouring peoples.
zh: 卢莱语是阿根廷大查科地区卢莱人的语言，今已消亡。欧洲人最初在今萨尔塔省及玻利维亚、巴拉圭毗邻边境遇到他们，后来维奇人把卢莱人向南驱赶到圣地亚哥-德尔埃斯特罗和图库曼一带。卢莱人多为游猎采集者，同时种植玉米、马铃薯和藜麦；安第斯山麓的定居群体饲养羊驼，而且掌握多种语言：平原卢莱人把托诺科特语当作通用语，山麓卢莱人兼通卢莱语、托诺科特语和克丘亚语。学界通常把卢莱语与仍有人使用的比莱拉语合为小小的卢莱–比莱拉语系，但也有语言学家认为两者各自是孤立语言，相似性来自接触。它最重要的文献是耶稣会士马乔尼于1732年印行的《卢莱语与托诺科特语技艺及词汇》，作者曾在传教区的卢莱人中工作；巴尔塞纳于1586年编写的托诺科特语语法则已失传。1670年起，耶稣会传教站开始聚集卢莱人；1715年在萨拉多河畔建立的米拉弗洛雷斯传教站在1728年的原住民起义中被毁，1752年重建，1768年耶稣会被驱逐后遭到废弃。随着传教区体系瓦解，卢莱语最终让位于西班牙语和邻族语言。

en: Luo, or Lwo, is the western branch of the Nilotic family spoken by a chain of related peoples from the marshes of southern Sudan and western Ethiopia down through Uganda and the eastern Congo to the shores of Lake Victoria in Kenya, where Dholuo reaches into northern Tanzania; Alur is its westernmost tongue and the Shilluk and Anuak languages mark its northern end. The Luo languages divide into Northern and Southern groups, the southern varieties close enough to be mutually intelligible. Their speakers began to split from a Nilotic homeland in the Bahr el Ghazal region during the early second millennium, their southward migration hastened by the Muslim conquest of the Sudan. In the mid-1400s the chief Nyikango led his followers north along the Nile to found the Shilluk kingdom, while other Luo groups moved south to become the Acholi, Alur and Joluo. In the early 1800s these languages were still unwritten, their literature carried by oral tradition.
zh: 卢奥语又称卢沃语，是尼罗特语族的西支，由一连串亲缘族群使用：分布范围南起苏丹南部的沼泽地带和埃塞俄比亚西部，经乌干达和刚果东部，直到肯尼亚的维多利亚湖沿岸，其中多卢奥语还进入坦桑尼亚北部；最西端是阿卢尔语，北端则以希卢克语和阿努阿克语为标志。卢奥诸语分北、南两组，南部分支各方言相近到可以互通。使用者在第二个千年的早期从加扎勒河地区的尼罗特故土离散，苏丹的穆斯林征服加速了他们向南迁徙。1400年代中期，酋长尼坎戈率部沿尼罗河北上，建立希卢克王国；另一些卢奥群体则南徙，成为后来的阿乔利人、阿卢尔人和乔卢奥人。直到1800年代初，这些语言仍无文字，文学全凭口耳相传。

en: Macro-Jê is a South American language family spread mainly across the Brazilian planalto and cerrado and into eastern Bolivia, with the Jê languages at its core. Jê itself divides into northern tongues such as Timbira and Kayapó, central ones such as Xavante, and southern ones led by Kaingang; the wider family adds Karajá, Krenak and Maxakali, Ofayé, Rikbaktsa, the Jabuti languages and Chiquitano, while the inclusion of Bororo, Kariri and Guató is still debated. Its speakers kept the interior savanna and highlands even as Tupi–Guarani peoples occupied the coast, so that when the Portuguese founded São Paulo in 1554 the hinterland still belonged almost entirely to Macro-Jê communities. Long contact with Tupi–Guarani and later Portuguese brought layers of loanwords. The family is marked by irregular morphology shared with Tupian and Cariban, a small consonant set, a rich vowel inventory and contrastive nasalization.
zh: 热语广义上称大热语系，是南美洲的一个语系，主要分布在巴西高原与塞拉多稀树草原，东抵玻利维亚东部，核心是热语族。热语族本身分为北支、中支和南支，代表语言有廷比拉语、卡亚波语、沙万特语和坎冈语；更大的语系还包括卡拉雅语、克雷纳克语、马沙卡利语、奥法耶语、里克巴克萨语、雅布蒂诸语和奇基塔诺语，而博罗罗语、卡里里语、瓜托语是否应归入，学界仍有争议。当图皮—瓜拉尼诸族占据海岸时，这些语言的使用者保有内陆稀树草原与高地；1554年葡萄牙人建立圣保罗时，腹地几乎仍全是大热语族群的天下。与图皮—瓜拉尼语及后来的葡萄牙语长期接触，带来了层层借词。该语系形态不规则，与图皮语系、加勒比语系有共同之处，辅音数量少、元音丰富，并有鼻化对立。

en: The Madang or Madang–Adelbert Range languages form a large family within the Trans–New Guinea phylum, spread across Madang Province on Papua New Guinea's north coast, from Astrolabe Bay and the volcanic island of Karkar through the forests of the Adelbert Range. Its two principal branches are the Mabuso languages, among them Amaimon, Mum and Barem, and the Rai Coast languages, which include Maia with its two dialects in the Bogia district; the family's internal diversity is so great that its time depth has been compared to that of Austronesian or Indo-European. Unusually for Trans–New Guinea groups, the inherited pronouns have been replaced, so that evidence for the family rests on shared words such as the reconstructed proto-Madang term for water. The natural harbour of Astrolabe Bay, around which many of these villages stand, was first entered by Europeans in 1827, when the French explorer Dumont d'Urville named it after his corvette, the Astrolabe.
zh: 马当诸语又称马当—阿德尔伯特岭诸语，是跨新几内亚语系下的一个大语族，分布在巴布亚新几内亚北海岸的马当省，从阿斯特罗莱布湾和火山岛卡尔卡尔岛一直延伸到阿德尔伯特岭的丛林中。它有两大主要分支：一是马布索诸语，阿迈蒙语、穆姆语、巴雷姆语都在其中；二是拉伊海岸诸语，博吉亚地区带两种方言的马亚语便属于这一支。该语族内部分歧极大，语言学者认为其分化的时间深度可与南岛语系或印欧语系相比。与跨新几内亚语系的其他群体不同，它继承自古语的代词已被替换，因此语族的认定主要依靠共有词汇，例如构拟出的原始马当语“水”一词。许多村落环绕的天然良港阿斯特罗莱布湾，在1827年迎来首批欧洲人，法国探险家迪蒙·迪维尔以自己的护卫舰星盘号为它命名。

en: Madurese is the Malayo-Polynesian language of Madura Island off the northeast coast of Java, also spoken across the eastern salient of Java and on Bawean and the Sapudi Islands by some ten to thirteen million people. It belongs to the Malayo-Sumbawan branch, which makes it closer to Malay, Balinese and Sasak than to the Javanese of the neighbouring mainland. Madurese was long written in the Javanese script, and after the island's Islamization also in the Arabic-based Pegon alphabet, before the Latin alphabet became its dominant script. Like Javanese and Balinese, it distinguishes three levels of speech, from the most polite register to the speech of close equals. The dialect of Sumenep in eastern Madura, seat of the island's old courts, serves as the standard. Madura was conquered by Mataram in 1624 and ceded to the Dutch in 1743, yet Madurese remained the common tongue of islanders and their migrant communities.
zh: 马都拉语是爪哇岛东北外海马都拉岛的南岛语，也通行于爪哇东部凸出地带以及巴韦安岛、萨普迪群岛，使用者约一千万至一千三百万。它属马来—松巴哇语支，与马来语、巴厘语和萨萨克语的亲缘关系反而近于隔海相望的爪哇语。马都拉语长期使用爪哇文书写，岛上伊斯兰化之后又出现以阿拉伯字母为基础的佩贡字母，近世以来拉丁字母渐成主流。与爪哇语、巴厘语一样，它区分三个语体层级，从最庄重的敬语到熟人之间的口语各有不同。东马都拉的苏民纳方言因旧王庭所在而成为标准语。马都拉于1624年被马打兰苏丹国征服，1743年割让给荷兰人，但马都拉语始终是岛民和各地移民社群的共同语言。

en: Maewo, more precisely Central Maewo and self-named Sungwadaga, is an Oceanic language of the island of Maewo, formerly called Aurora, in northern Vanuatu. It is also known as Peterara, after one of its dialects, and under the names Maevo and Tanoriki. The island's name descends from a reconstructed Proto-North-Central Vanuatu form mwaewo, rendered Nwaewo in the local tongues. Central Maewo occupies the middle of the island, with the related Sungwadia or Marino language to the north and Baetora, or South Maewo, to the south. Europeans first sighted Maewo in the Spanish expedition of Pedro Fernandez de Quiros at the end of April 1606; Louis Antoine de Bougainville saw it again in 1768 and gave the island the name Aurora.
zh: 马埃沃语更准确地说是中马埃沃语，本土自称松瓦达加语，是瓦努阿图北部马埃沃岛（旧称奥罗拉岛）上的一种大洋洲语，也以其方言之名被称为佩特拉拉语，另有马埃沃和塔诺里基等别称。岛名源自构拟的原始中北瓦努阿图语形式姆瓦埃沃，当地语言中写作恩瓦埃沃。中马埃沃语分布在岛的中部，北面是亲缘语言松瓦迪亚语（又称马里诺语），南面是巴埃托拉语（又称南马埃沃语）。1606年4月底，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的西班牙探险队首次望见马埃沃岛；1768年路易·安托万·德·布干维尔再次见到它，并以“奥罗拉”为该岛命名。

en: Malagasy is the Austronesian, specifically Barito, language of Madagascar, and the westernmost member of its family: settlers from the Sunda Islands carried its ancestor across the Indian Ocean around the 400s, and its closest living kin is the Ma'anyan language of Borneo. From about 1000 it absorbed Bantu and Arabic words brought by traders and new settlers, while Malay and Javanese loanwords recall the earliest sea links. It is a dialect continuum spanning the whole island, from the northern and southern coastal varieties to the Merina speech of the central plateau around Antananarivo. Its first writing was Sorabe, an Arabic-derived alphabet used in the southeast from the 1400s for astrological and magical texts, and in 1658 the Frenchman Etienne de Flacourt printed the first Malagasy dictionary. In 1823 King Radama I adopted the Latin orthography of the missionary David Jones, under whom the London Missionary Society opened schools; the first Latin-printed Malagasy book, a Bible translation, followed in 1835.
zh: 马尔加什语是马达加斯加岛通行的南岛语系巴里托语族语言，也是该语系分布最西的成员：400年前后，来自巽他群岛的移民把它的祖先带过印度洋，它今天最近的亲属是婆罗洲的马安延语。约1000年起，随商人和新移民而来的班图语、阿拉伯语词汇大量进入该语言，马来语和爪哇语借词则保留着最早的海上联系。它是一个遍布全岛的方言连续体，北部、南部沿海各有分支，中部高原塔那那利佛一带则通行梅里纳方言。它最早的文字是苏拉贝文，一种源自阿拉伯字母的文字，1400年代起在岛的东南部用于占星和法术文书；1658年，法国人艾蒂安·德·弗拉古出版了第一部马尔加什语词典。1823年，拉达马一世国王采用传教士戴维·琼斯设计的拉丁拼写法，伦敦传道会随之开办学校；1835年，第一部拉丁字母印刷的马尔加什语书籍，即一部圣经译本，问世。

en: Malakula serves as an umbrella name for the Malakula languages, some three dozen closely related Central Vanuatu tongues crowded onto Malakula, also spelled Malekula, the second-largest island of Vanuatu. Linguists divide them into northern, eastern and western linkages and treat them as one coherent group despite the island's extreme fragmentation; a shared trait is the widespread dropping of unstressed syllables, which arose independently in several branches. Their speakers include the Big Nambas of the north and the Small Nambas of the south-central interior, societies known for graded pig-killing rituals and, historically, for shaping infants' skulls as a mark of rank. Europeans first sighted Malakula during Pedro Fernandez de Quiros's Spanish voyage of 1606, and James Cook visited the island in 1774, after which British and French settlers and missionaries made it part of the contested New Hebrides.
zh: 马拉库拉语是对马拉库拉诸语的统称：约三十余种亲缘相近的中瓦努阿图语言，密集分布在瓦努阿图第二大岛马拉库拉岛（又译马勒库拉岛）上。语言学者把它们分为北部、东部和西部三个连锁群，尽管岛上语言极度分化，仍视之为一个连贯的语群；其共同特征是普遍脱落非重读音节，而且这一变化在多个分支中各自独立发生。使用者包括北部的大南巴斯人和南部内陆中部的小南巴斯人，这些社会以杀猪晋阶仪式闻名，并曾以捆扎改变婴儿头形作为身份标志。1606年佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的西班牙航行首次望见马拉库拉岛，1774年詹姆斯·库克到访；此后英国和法国的定居者与传教士相继而来，使该岛沦为列强争夺的新赫布里底的一部分。

en: Malay is a Malayic language of the Austronesian family, native to the Malay Peninsula and maritime Southeast Asia, where it exists as a continuum of closely related varieties, among them Minangkabau, Iban, Banjar and Kutai. The earliest surviving Old Malay text, the Kedukan Bukit inscription of 683, is written in a Pallava-derived Grantha script and already heavy with Sanskrit loanwords, and the maritime empire of Srivijaya carried Old Malay through the ports of the peninsula and archipelago as a traders' lingua franca. The Terengganu stone of 1303 is the oldest known Jawi inscription, marking Islam's arrival and a growing influx of Arabic vocabulary. Under the Malacca Sultanate of 1402–1511 Classical Malay became the region's language of trade, letters and Islamic learning; the fall of Malacca to the Portuguese in 1511 moved its literary centre to Johor, yet Malay remained a lingua franca as far east as the Moluccas. The Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1824 split the Malay world into British and Dutch spheres, whose administrations codified the separate Malay and Indonesian standards.
zh: 马来语是南岛语系马来语族的语言，原产于马来半岛和海岛东南亚，呈现为一群关系密切的方言连续体，米南佳保语、伊班语、班查语和库泰语都在其中。现存最早的古马来语文本是683年的格杜干布吉特铭文，用源于帕拉瓦的格兰塔字母写成，其中已充斥梵语借词；海上帝国室利佛逝随后把古马来语带到马来半岛和群岛各港口，成为商人的通用语。1303年的登嘉楼石碑是已知最古老的爪夷文铭文，标志着伊斯兰教传入和阿拉伯语词汇的大量涌入。在1402至1511年的马六甲苏丹国治下，古典马来语成为地区贸易、文学和伊斯兰学术的语言；1511年马六甲落入葡萄牙人之手后，其文学中心转移到柔佛，但马来语仍是远至摩鹿加的通用语。1824年的《英荷条约》把马来世界划分为英国和荷兰两个势力范围，两套行政体系分别规范出马来语与印度尼西亚语两套标准语。

en: Malayalam is a Dravidian language spoken by the Malayali people on the south-western coast of India, chiefly in Kerala and the Lakshadweep islands. Its name combines mala, mountain, and alam, region. Most scholars derive it from a western coastal dialect of Middle Tamil, which separated between the ninth and thirteenth centuries as the Western Ghats cut Kerala off from the Tamil country and Brahmin settlers added Sanskrit words. The Quilon Syrian copper plates of about 850 are among its oldest inscriptions, in Vatteluttu with Grantha characters, and the Ramacharitam of the late twelfth or early thirteenth century is the first work independent of the Tamil tradition. From the thirteenth century court poetry flourished in Manipravalam, a mixed Tamil-Sanskrit idiom codified in Lilatilakam, while the sixteenth-century poet Ezhuthachan fixed the modern literary language. Its script, Vatteluttu enlarged with Grantha letters, had its own shape by the late thirteenth century, and a Malayalam travel book of 1785 was the first travelogue in an Indian language.
zh: 马拉雅拉姆语是达罗毗荼语族的语言，通行于印度西南沿海，使用者主要是喀拉拉邦和拉克沙群岛的马拉雅拉姆人；其名由意为山的“马拉”和意为地方的“阿拉姆”合成。多数学者认为，它由中泰米尔语的西部沿海方言发展而来：9至13世纪间，西高止山脉把喀拉拉与泰米尔地区隔开，加之婆罗门定居者带入梵语词汇，它逐渐独立。约850年的奎隆叙利亚铜板是最古老的铭文之一，以瓦蒂卢图字母掺格兰塔字母刻成；12世纪末或13世纪初的《罗摩事迹》是最早脱离泰米尔传统的文学作品。13世纪起，宫廷诗歌以泰米尔语与梵语混合的文体“马尼普拉瓦兰”兴盛，《丽拉蒂拉卡姆》一书对其有所规范；16世纪的诗人埃祖塔昌确立了近代文学语言。由瓦蒂卢图字母扩充格兰塔字母而成的马拉雅拉姆文在13世纪末定型，1785年成书的一部马拉雅拉姆语游记被视为印度语言中的第一部游记。

en: Malibú was the language of the Malibú people of the lower Magdalena valley in Colombia, spoken along the great river between Tamalameque and Tenerife, in what is now Magdalena Department. It gave its name to the Malibu group of extinct, poorly documented languages, which also included Mocaná near Cartagena and Pacabuey by the Zapatoza lagoon; only a handful of words were ever recorded, and the word malibú itself is said to have meant cacique, or chief, in the language. Early scholars placed these tongues within the Chibchan family together with Chimila, but later specialists judge that link to rest on no solid evidence, so the classification of the Malibu languages remains uncertain. From the early 1500s the riverbank Malibú were among the first peoples encountered by Spanish expeditions entering the Magdalena lowlands, and their speech died out in the colonial period, surviving only in fleeting mentions by 17th-century chroniclers such as Pedro Simón.
zh: 马利布语是哥伦比亚马格达莱纳河下游马利布人的语言，沿河分布在塔马拉梅克到特内里费之间，即今天的马格达莱纳省境内。以它命名的马利布语群是一组已消亡、记录稀少的语言，还包括卡塔赫纳附近的莫卡纳语和萨帕托萨湖畔的帕卡布埃语；后人只记下了其中零星几个词，据说 malibú 这个词在该语言中意为“酋长”。早期学者把这些语言与奇米拉语一并归入奇布查语系，但后来的研究者认为这一联系缺乏确凿依据，马利布语群的归属仍无定论。16世纪初，沿河而居的马利布人成为西班牙远征队进入马格达莱纳低地时最早接触到的族群之一，他们的语言在殖民时期消亡，只在17世纪编年史家佩德罗·西蒙等人的简略记述中留下痕迹。

en: The Maluku grouping represents the Central Maluku languages, a proposed branch of the Central-Eastern Malayo-Polynesian group of Austronesian comprising about fifty tongues on Seram, Buru, Ambon and the Sula Islands. Its traditional components are the Buru and Sula groups, the East Central Maluku cluster of Seram, and the Ambelau isolate; none of the individual languages is large, and several have already died out. Central Moluccans regard Seram, still called Nusa Ina or Mother Island, as their ancestral homeland. Buru is first named in a Javanese poem of around 1365, and in the 1400s and 1500s Seram lay within the sphere of the Sultanate of Ternate, often ruled through its vassal on Buru. The Portuguese expedition of Antonio de Abreu and Francisco Serrao mapped Seram's southern coast in 1512 and Catholic missionaries followed later in the century. Dutch trading posts appeared in the early 1600s; the Company took Buru in 1658, resettling villages around Kayeli Bay to work its clove plantations, and held nominal sway over Seram from about 1650. The Sultanate of Tidore kept suzerain rights in eastern Seram from 1700 to 1768, and Prince Nuku of Tidore made the island a base of his anti-Dutch rebellion in the 1780s.
zh: 马鲁古语这一划分对应中马鲁古诸语，是南岛语系中东部马来—波利尼西亚语群下拟议的一个分支，约有五十种语言，分布在斯兰岛、布鲁岛、安汶岛和苏拉群岛。传统上它包括布鲁语群、苏拉语群、斯兰岛上的东中马鲁古语群，以及孤立的安贝劳语；其中没有哪一种语言使用人数很多，还有几种已经消亡。中马鲁古人把仍被称作“努萨伊纳”（意为母岛）的斯兰岛视为祖居之地。布鲁岛最早见于1365年前后的一首爪哇诗篇；15至16世纪，斯兰岛处在特尔纳特苏丹国的势力范围内，常由其在布鲁岛的附庸代为统治。1512年，安东尼奥·德·阿布雷乌和弗朗西斯科·塞朗的葡萄牙远征队测绘了斯兰岛南海岸，天主教传教士随后在该世纪到来。17世纪初荷兰商馆出现；1658年荷兰东印度公司夺取布鲁岛，把许多村庄迁到卡耶利湾周围为丁香种植园劳作，并从1650年前后起对斯兰岛保有名义上的统治。1700至1768年，蒂多雷苏丹国保留着对斯兰岛东部的宗主权；18世纪80年代，蒂多雷的努库王子又以该岛为基地开展反荷起义。

en: Malvi is an Indo-Aryan language of the Rajasthani group, spoken chiefly on the Malwa plateau of western Madhya Pradesh and the adjoining parts of Rajasthan. Together with kindred varieties such as Dhundhari, Harauti and Nimadi it forms part of the Western Indo-Aryan continuum that grew out of the early medieval Prakrits, and references to a distinct Rajasthani speech go back as far as the eighth century. When the Malwa Sultanate was founded in 1401, and again after the region became a Mughal province in 1562, Persian served as the language of court and administration, leaving Malvi to the towns and villages and filling its vocabulary with Persian and Arabic loanwords. It has remained largely a language of home, market and oral poetry, with many unpublished works but little standardised literature. Malvi is written in the Devanagari script, while in earlier centuries Rajasthani tongues were commonly recorded in the Mahajani script, a mercantile writing system also used for accounts and financial records.
zh: 摩腊婆语是拉贾斯坦语群的一支印度—雅利安语言，主要通行于中央邦西部的摩腊婆高原及邻近的拉贾斯坦地区。它与敦达里、哈劳蒂、尼马尔等近亲变体同属西印度—雅利安方言连续体，由中世纪早期的俗语发展而来；早在8世纪，文献中就已提到拉贾斯坦一带有独立的口头语言。1401年摩腊婆苏丹国建立，1562年该地又成为莫卧儿帝国的一个省，宫廷和行政长期使用波斯语，摩腊婆语则留在城镇与乡村，并吸收了不少波斯语和阿拉伯语借词。它长期主要用于家庭、市集和口传诗歌，作品多未刊印，也缺乏规范化的书面传统。摩腊婆语采用天城文书写，而在更早的世纪里，拉贾斯坦诸语常用马哈佳尼文记录，那是一种商人记账兼用于文书的书写系统。

en: Manao is the extinct Arawakan language once spoken by the Manaos along the Rio Negro, a great northern tributary of the Amazon in western Brazil; in it the people's own name meant mother of the gods, and from them comes the name of the present-day city of Manaus. The Manaos resisted Portuguese slaving raids and missionary work, attacking the Fort of São José da Barra do Rio Negro and, under their leader Ajuricaba, patrolling the river to stop colonial vessels sailing upstream. The last major war against them ended in the 1720s, when Ajuricaba was captured and drowned himself on the way to trial at Belém while two thousand of his people were sold into slavery. In 1819 the German botanist von Martius encountered the last recorded Manaos band on the Rio Negro, the final attestation of the people and their tongue.
zh: 马瑙斯语是已经消亡的阿拉瓦克语言，曾由马瑙斯人使用于巴西北部大河内格罗河（黑河）沿岸；在这种语言里，马瑙斯人的自称意为“众神之母”，今马瑙斯市的名字即来源于他们。马瑙斯人反抗葡萄牙人的奴隶劫掠和传教活动，进攻圣若泽达巴拉杜里奥内格罗要塞，并在首领阿尤里卡巴率领下巡守河道，阻止殖民船只溯流而上。18世纪20年代，最后一场大战以失败告终：阿尤里卡巴被俘，在押往贝伦受审途中投河自尽，两千部众被卖为奴。1819年，德国植物学家冯·马蒂乌斯在内格罗河畔见到有记载的最后一群马瑙斯人，这也是该民族及其语言最后的音讯。

en: Mandarin is the largest branch of the Sinitic or Chinese family, native to the North China Plain and carried thence across the south-west and northern frontiers, its dialects stretching from Yunnan to Heilongjiang. Most have four lexical tones, having lost the final stops of Middle Chinese while often keeping retroflex initials. The northern speech of the Jurchen Jin and Mongol Yuan, known as Old Mandarin, bore a flourishing vernacular literature of qu songs and drama from the twelfth to fourteenth centuries; in 1269 Kublai Khan had the Tibetan monk Phagpa devise an alphabet for the empire's languages, Chinese included, and the rime dictionaries Menggu Ziyun of 1308 and Zhongyuan Yinyun of 1324 record its sound system. Because the imperial capitals lay in the Mandarin area, a northern koine served officials and the court from at least the fourteenth century; under the Ming and Qing it was called Guanhua, the language of the officials, which the Jesuit missionaries who learned it in the sixteenth century rendered as Mandarin.
zh: 官话是汉语族最大的一支，本出于华北平原，随后扩散到西南和北方边疆，其各方言又称北方话，分布范围从云南直到黑龙江。多数官话方言有四个声调，中古汉语的入声塞音韵尾已经消失，卷舌声母则往往保留。女真金朝和蒙古元朝时期的北方口语称古官话，12至14世纪间催生了曲、散曲和杂剧等繁荣的白话文学；1269年，忽必烈命吐蕃僧人八思巴为帝国各语言创制字母，汉语也在其列，1308年的《蒙古字韵》和1324年的《中原音韵》两部韵书记录了当时的音系。由于历代帝都多在官话区，至迟14世纪起，一种北方共通语便通行于官场和朝廷；明清两代称之为官话，即官员的语言，16世纪来华学习这种话的耶稣会传教士把它译作曼达林，官话一名由此进入西方语言。

en: Mande is a family of sixty to seventy-five languages spoken by the Mandé peoples across West Africa, from southern Mauritania and Senegal to Mali, Burkina Faso, Guinea and Liberia. Its best-known members include Mandinka, Soninke, Bambara, Susu, Kpelle, Dan and the trading language Jula. Linguistic reconstruction places the Mande homeland in the southern Sahara, in what is now Mauritania, around 4000 BC; the stone settlements of Dhar Tichitt there are linked to ancestral Mande societies. Soninke speakers founded the Ghana Empire, or Wagadu, which rose in about 200 and collapsed in the twelfth century, and the Soninke were among the first West Africans to adopt Islam, in about the tenth century. The Manding branch later carried the languages of the Mali and Songhai worlds, with Jula serving merchants on the trans-Saharan trade routes. Mande has a strong oral tradition, and from the spread of Islam its languages were also written in an adapted Arabic script known as Ajami.
zh: 曼德语是曼德各族使用的语族，含六十至七十五种语言，通行于西非，从毛里塔尼亚南部、塞内加尔延伸到马里、布基纳法索、几内亚和利比里亚，最主要的语言有曼丁卡语、索宁克语、班巴拉语、苏苏语、克佩勒语、丹语和经商用语朱拉语。语言学家推断曼德语的原乡在今毛里塔尼亚境内的撒哈拉南部，时间约在公元前4000年；当地提希特陡崖的石砌聚落被认为与古代曼德社会有关。说索宁克语的族群建立了加纳帝国，又称瓦加杜，约于200年兴起、12世纪崩溃，索宁克人还在10世纪前后成为最早改宗伊斯兰教的西非族群之一。曼丁支语后来通行于马里和桑海的世界，朱拉语则是跨撒哈拉商路上商人的通用语。曼德语有深厚的口头传统，而自伊斯兰教传播以来，各语言也用经改造的阿拉伯字母阿贾米文字书写。

en: Mangareva, self-called te reo magareva, is a Polynesian language of the Marquesic subgroup, spoken in the Gambier Islands, whose largest island bears the same name, and closely related to Marquesan and Hawaiian. Polynesians had settled Mangareva by the twelfth or thirteenth century and traded by canoe with Pitcairn to the east; the fourteenth-century migration from Easter Island that closed the age of Polynesian expansion left the two languages sharing much of their vocabulary. Mangarevan is conservative in keeping the r sound that Marquesan turned into a glottal stop. The British captain James Wilson, reaching the islands in the ship Duff in 1797, gave the group its European name after Admiral Gambier. French missionaries who arrived in 1834, aided by a New Zealand Māori interpreter, were the first to write the language, and they rendered its glottal stop with the letter h.
zh: 芒阿雷瓦语（自称特雷奥马加雷瓦）是马克萨斯语支的波利尼西亚语言，通行于甘比尔群岛，其中最大的岛屿也叫芒阿雷瓦，与马克萨斯语和夏威夷语亲缘密切。波利尼西亚人在12至13世纪已定居芒阿雷瓦，乘独木舟与东边的皮特凯恩岛贸易；14世纪从复活节岛迁来的移民是波利尼西亚扩张时代的尾声之一，也使两种语言共享大量词汇。芒阿雷瓦语较为保守，保留了日音，而马克萨斯语把它变成了喉塞音。1797年英国船长詹姆斯·威尔逊乘达夫号抵达，以海军上将甘比尔的封号为群岛命名；1834年法国传教士在一名新西兰毛利译员协助下到来，最早用文字记录这种语言，并以字母赫拼写它的喉塞音。

en: Manoki, also called Irantxe after its principal dialect and Mỹky after its other surviving dialect, is an indigenous language of the Diamantino and Brasnorte districts of Mato Grosso in western Brazil. It shows no convincing link to any established family and is treated as a language isolate, although contact with Arawak, Tupi, Nambikwara and Chapacuran neighbours has left loanwords.
zh: 马诺基语又称伊兰特谢语，名称来自其主要方言，另一尚存方言为米基语，通行于巴西西部马托格罗索州的迪亚曼蒂努与布拉斯诺特一带。它与任何已知语系都没有令人信服的亲缘关系，被视为孤立语，只是在与阿拉瓦克语、图皮语、楠比夸拉语和查帕库拉语邻族的接触中留下了借词。

en: Mantion, better known to its own speakers as Sougb or Sogh, is a Papuan language of the eastern Bird's Head Peninsula in West Papua. The name Mantion, also written Manikion, originated as a derogatory exonym used by the seafaring Biak people and has stuck in outside classifications. Sougb is divided into four dialects and is spoken in the Arfak highlands and the country south and east of Manokwari, reaching the shores of Wondama Bay. Together with Meyah, Moskona and the little-known Irires it forms the East Bird's Head, or Mantion–Meyah, language family, one of the native non-Austronesian stocks of the Vogelkop; like its neighbours, Meyah has taken on a subject-verb-object word order under long contact with Austronesian languages. The mountains and coasts where Mantion is spoken were reached from the fifteenth century by the tribute network of the Sultanate of Tidore, expanded through the Biak war leader Gurabesi's alliance with Sultan Al-Mansur, and the Spanish expedition of Luís Vaz de Torres sailed past in 1606. No European post was planted in this interior in the period, so Mantion society remained under loose Tidore suzerainty and the influence of Biak traders and raiders.
zh: 曼廷语在母语者口中更常称苏格布语（Sougb，亦作 Sogh），是西巴布亚鸟头半岛东部的巴布亚语言。“曼廷”又写马尼基翁，原本是擅长航海的比亚克人使用的贬义他称，却在外界的分类中沿用下来。苏格布语分为四种方言，通行于阿尔法克高地以及马诺夸里以南和以东地区，最远延伸到翁达马湾沿岸。它与梅亚语、莫斯克纳语和鲜为人知的伊里雷斯语共同构成东鸟头语系（又称曼廷-梅亚语系），是鸟头半岛本土非南岛语系之一；与邻近语言一样，梅亚语在与南岛语言长期接触下采用了主-谓-宾语序。从15世纪起，曼廷语所在的山地与海岸被纳入蒂多雷苏丹国的朝贡网络，这一网络借由比亚克军事首领古拉贝西与苏丹阿尔-曼苏尔的联盟而扩张；1606年，路易斯·瓦斯·德·托雷斯的西班牙探险队从附近海面驶过。这一时期没有欧洲人在内地设立据点，因此曼廷人的社会长期处于蒂多雷松散的宗主权以及比亚克商人和掠奴者的影响之下。

en: Manubara takes its name from one of the two members of the Manubaran family, a small group of the Southeast Papuan branch of Trans-New Guinea, spoken around Mount Brown in the Bird's Tail, the southeastern peninsula of New Guinea. The family consists of Doromu, with its Koki, Kokila and Koriko varieties, and Maria, also called Gebi or Manubara, spoken by villages of the mountainous interior behind the coast that would later hold Port Moresby. The two share roughly sixty-three per cent of their vocabulary, marking them as clearly related yet distinct tongues shaped by long separation in steep ridge country. As with the other inland languages of the peninsula, the Spanish coastal voyages of 1545 under Yñigo Ortiz de Retez and of 1606 under Torres never reached the Mount Brown valleys.
zh: 马努巴拉语得名于马努巴兰语族两大成员之一的别名；该语族是跨新几内亚语系东南巴布亚语支下的一个小分支，通行于新几内亚“鸟尾”东南半岛的布朗山一带。语族由两支组成：一支是包含科基、科基拉和科里科三种变体的多罗穆语，另一支是又称格比语或马努巴拉语的玛丽亚语，使用者住在后来莫尔兹比港所在海岸后方的内陆山区村落。两者词汇重合度约为百分之六十三，说明它们虽有明确亲缘关系，却因在陡峭山岭中长期隔绝而各自发展。与半岛上其他内陆语言一样，1545年伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德·雷特斯和1606年托雷斯率领的西班牙沿海航行都没有抵达布朗山的山谷。

en: Manus is the name given to the Oceanic languages spoken on Manus, the largest island of the Admiralty Islands in present-day northern Papua New Guinea, and on its surrounding islets. About two dozen closely related tongues make up the group, divided by linguists into western, intermediate and eastern branches; they shade into one another as a dialect continuum and share distinctive prenasalized trill sounds. The name Manus, or Moanus, originally belonged to an ethnic group of closely related speakers whose coastal villagers built their houses on stilts over the sea. The islanders were seasoned seafarers when the Spanish explorer Álvaro de Saavedra made the first recorded European sighting in 1528, circling the island and meeting natives who came out in canoes armed with bows; he charted it as Urays la Grande.
zh: 马努斯语是对通行于马努斯岛及周围小岛的一组大洋洲语言的称呼，马努斯岛是今巴布亚新几内亚北部阿德默勒尔蒂群岛中最大的岛屿。这一语支约有二十多种亲缘很近的语言，语言学家将其分为西、中、东三支，彼此渐次过渡、构成方言连续体，并共同拥有独特的鼻化颤音。马努斯（亦作莫阿努斯）最初是一个族源相近的族群的名字，其沿海村民习惯把房屋建在海面之上的高脚桩柱上。1528年，西班牙探险家阿尔瓦罗·德·萨阿维德拉首次留下欧洲人发现该岛的记录，他绕岛航行时遇到乘独木舟、携弓箭前来的岛民，可见他们早已是老练的航海者；萨阿维德拉在地图上将其标为乌拉拉大岛。

en: Te reo Māori is an Eastern Polynesian language of the Austronesian family and the southernmost language of that vast family, closely related to the languages of the Cook and Society Islands, the Tuamotus and Tahiti. Its speakers descend from voyagers who sailed from eastern Polynesia, the legendary Hawaiki, and settled New Zealand by about 1350; cut off from their sister languages, they developed six regional dialects among the iwi tribes and a rich unwritten culture of genealogical recitation (whakapapa), oratory (whaikōrero), incantations (karakia), songs and the haka. The language had no script until European contact, which began with Captain James Cook in 1769. Between 1817 and 1830 missionaries of the Church Missionary Society, working with Māori chiefs such as Hongi Hika and the linguist Samuel Lee, fixed an orthography in the Latin alphabet; William Colenso printed the first books produced in New Zealand at Paihia in 1833, and his Māori New Testament of 1837 was the first Bible translation into an indigenous language published in the southern hemisphere. Māori then became a language of worship, newspapers and political meetings, though the rising European population would later put it under growing pressure.
zh: 毛利语是南岛语系的东波利尼西亚语言，也是这个庞大语系中分布最靠南的成员，与库克群岛、社会群岛、土阿莫土群岛和塔希提的语言亲缘密切。说毛利语的人是东波利尼西亚航海者的后裔，他们从传说中的哈瓦基出发，约在1350年以前定居新西兰；与姐妹语言隔绝之后，他们在各部落（伊维）中发展出六种地区方言，并孕育出以口述传承为核心的丰富文化，包括家谱吟诵（华卡帕帕）、演说（瓦伊科雷罗）、咒语（卡拉基亚）、歌谣和哈卡战舞。在1769年库克船长到来之前，毛利语没有文字。1817至1830年间，教会传道会的传教士与洪吉·希卡等毛利酋长及语言学家塞缪尔·李合作，用拉丁字母确定了毛利语的拼写规范；威廉·科伦索于1833年在派希亚印出了新西兰本土最早的书籍，他1837年完成的毛利语《新约》是南半球第一部译成土著语言出版的圣经。毛利语由此成为宗教礼拜、报纸和政治集会使用的语言，不过欧洲移民的增加很快又使它面临越来越大的压力。

en: Mapudungun means speech of the land in the tongue itself; the Spanish called it Araucano or the general language of Chile. Classified by most specialists as an isolate, it was spoken at the Spanish arrival in the mid-sixteenth century across roughly eighteen hundred kilometres, from the Limari and Choapa valleys to the Chiloe archipelago, by Picunche, Mapuche, Huilliche and Cunco groups whose dialects were mutually intelligible enough that missionaries could travel the whole country with this one language. It had no writing before the Spanish, and the Jesuit Luis de Valdivia published its first grammar in 1606; further grammars followed by Andres Febres at Lima in 1765 and Bernhard Havestadt, whose three-volume Chilidugu appeared in Westphalia in 1776. After the Battle of Curalaba in 1598 and the destruction of the seven Spanish cities south of the Bio Bio, Mapudungun remained the everyday language of the independent Mapuche country, while its use retreated north of the river under encomienda labour, disease and mestizaje. Between the seventeenth and nineteenth centuries the araucanization of the Pampa and Patagonia carried the language eastward across the Andes among nomadic peoples, and during the early nineteenth-century independence wars Mapuche bands fought on both the royalist and patriot sides.
zh: 马普敦贡语在本族语中意为“土地的言语”，西班牙人则称之为阿劳坎语或“智利通用语”。多数学者把它归为孤立语。16世纪中叶西班牙人到来时，从北部的利马里河谷、乔阿帕河谷到南部的奇洛埃群岛，约一千八百公里的地带上都有人说它，使用者包括皮昆切人、马普切人、维利切人和昆科人；各方言彼此相通，传教士声称凭这一种语言就能走遍全境。马普切人本无文字，耶稣会士路易斯·德·巴尔迪维亚于1606年出版了第一部语法；此后安德烈斯·费夫雷斯于1765年在利马、伯恩哈德·哈韦施塔特于1776年在威斯特伐利亚分别推出新的语法著作，后者的《奇利杜古》共三卷。1598年库拉拉巴战役后，比奥比奥河以南的七座西班牙城市被毁，马普敦贡语始终是独立的马普切土地上的日常语言；而在河以北，由于委托劳役、疫病和混血，它的使用逐渐退缩。17至19世纪间，潘帕斯和巴塔哥尼亚的“阿劳坎化”进程又把这种语言随游牧族群带到安第斯山脉以东；19世纪初独立战争期间，马普切武装分别在保王派和爱国者阵营中作战。

en: Marathi is the Indo-Aryan language of Maharashtra on the Deccan, descended through an Apabhraṃśa stage from the literary Maharashtri Prakrit of ancient India. Its earliest records are a copper plate of 739 at Satara and, under the Shilaharas, Marathi-only stone and copper plates of the eleventh century. After 1187 the Yadavas of Devagiri switched their inscriptions from Kannada and Sanskrit to Marathi, and by the fourteenth century it was the region's dominant written language. Literature blossomed with the Varkari saints: Dnyaneshwar, who died in 1296, made it a philosophical vehicle in his Dnyaneshwari commentary on the Bhagavad Gita, a tradition continued by Eknath in the sixteenth century and Tukaram, who left more than three thousand devotional abhangs in the seventeenth. From the thirteenth century Marathi was written in the cursive Modi hand for administration and in Devanagari for literature, an early landmark being Thomas Stephens's Roman-letter Krista Purana. Missionary presses at Serampore issued a Marathi New Testament in 1811 and the first major Marathi-English dictionary in 1831.
zh: 马拉地语是德干高原马哈拉施特拉地区的印度—雅利安语言，由古代印度主要文学俗语之一摩诃剌侘俗语经阿帕布拉姆沙阶段演变而来。现存最早记录是739年在萨塔拉发现的铜版铭文，11世纪希拉哈拉王朝治下又出现纯马拉地语的石碑和铜版铭文。1187年后，德瓦吉里的亚达瓦王朝在铭文中弃卡纳达语和梵语而改用马拉地语，到14世纪它已成为当地占主导的书面语。文学随之繁荣：1296年去世的瓦卡里派圣徒迪亚内什瓦尔以马拉地语写成《薄伽梵歌》注疏《迪亚内什瓦里》，使这种语言成为哲学表达的工具；这一传统经16世纪的埃克纳特，延续到17世纪写下三千余首虔诚阿巴恩歌的图卡拉姆。13世纪起，马拉地语行政上用草书体的莫迪字母、文学上用天城体书写；传教士托马斯·斯蒂芬斯的罗马字《基督往世书》是早期印刷的里程碑，塞兰布尔的传教士印刷所又于1811年印出马拉地语《新约》，第一部大型马拉地语—英语词典则在1831年问世。

en: Mari is the Finno-Ugric speech of the Mari people, used along the Volga, Kama and Vyatka rivers in the Mari lands of eastern Russia. Neighbouring peoples long knew it as Cheremis, a name derived from the Khazar word tsarmis recorded in the tenth century, while Mari is the speakers' own autonym. It falls into four dialect groups, Hill, Northwestern, Meadow and Eastern Mari, with Hill Mari and Meadow Mari each carrying a literary standard. The Mari country passed from Volga Bulgaria and the Golden Horde to the Kazan Khanate in 1443, and centuries of Turkic rule left a layer of Tatar and Bulgar loanwords. After Ivan the Terrible took Kazan in 1552 and the Cheremis Wars ended in 1584, the Mari came under Russian rule; the first written records appeared in the early eighteenth century, mostly Orthodox ecclesiastical works produced amid conversion efforts from about 1700. The earliest linguistic studies date to the same period, and the first Hill Mari grammar, the Cheremis Grammar, was printed in Kazan in 1837. Both literary forms use modified Cyrillic alphabets, and like other Uralic tongues Mari is agglutinative and has no grammatical gender.
zh: 马里语是马里人的芬兰—乌戈尔语言，通行于俄罗斯东部马里人故土的伏尔加河、卡马河和维亚特卡河流域。邻近民族长期称它为切列米斯语，这个名称来自10世纪哈扎尔文献中的察尔米斯一词，而马里是使用者的自称。它分为山地马里语、西北马里语、草原马里语和东马里语四个方言群，其中山地马里语和草原马里语各有一套书面标准。马里人的土地先后归属伏尔加保加利亚和金帐汗国，1443年转归喀山汗国，数百年的突厥统治在语言中留下了一层鞑靼语和保加利亚语借词。1552年伊凡雷帝攻占喀山，切列米斯战争于1584年结束后，马里人受俄罗斯统治；最早的书面记录出现于18世纪初，多为约1700年起传教改宗过程中产生的东正教教会文献。最早的语言研究也始于这一时期，第一部山地马里语语法《切列米斯语法》于1837年在喀山印行。两种书面语都使用改良的西里尔字母；和其他乌拉尔语言一样，马里语是黏着语，没有语法性别。

en: Marind is the principal language of the Marind-anim people of the southern New Guinea lowlands, spoken around Merauke and the Bian River in what is now Indonesia's South Papua province. Together with Yaqay and a few closely related tongues it forms the Marind-Yaqai family, now placed in the Anim branch of the Trans-New Guinea phylum. Its dialects include Southeast Marind, Gawir, Holifoersch and Tugeri, while Bian Marind diverges enough to count as a separate language. It was the language of a famous headhunting society whose Tugeri war parties raided neighbouring peoples and the Torres Strait islands, the waterway first traversed by the Spanish expedition of Luis Vaez de Torres in 1606. First systematically recorded by officials and missionaries in the early twentieth century, it remains the living language of the Merauke coast.
zh: 马林德语是新几内亚岛南部低地马林德-阿尼姆人的主要语言，通行于今印度尼西亚南巴布亚省马老奇和比安河一带。它与亚凯语等几种近亲语言共同构成马林德－亚凯语族，现归入跨新几内亚语系的阿尼姆语支，方言包括东南马林德语、加维尔语、福利福斯语和图格里语，而比安马林德语差异较大，已被视为独立语言。它的使用者曾以猎头闻名，图格里武士曾不断袭扰邻近族群和托雷斯海峡诸岛；这条水道在1606年由路易斯·巴埃斯·德·托雷斯的西班牙远征队首次穿行。这种语言在20世纪初才由殖民地官员和传教士系统记录，仍是马老奇沿海一带在使用的活语言。

en: The Markham languages form a family of the Huon Gulf group within the Oceanic branch of Austronesian, comprising about a dozen tongues spoken in the Markham and Ramu valleys and the neighbouring lowlands of Madang and Morobe provinces in northern Papua New Guinea. Uniquely among the Western Oceanic languages of New Guinea, which otherwise keep to the coast, many Markham languages are spoken far inland, in the mountain valleys of Morobe, where they meet the Trans–New Guinea languages of the highlands. They divide into a Lower Markham group, including Wampar, Labu and Duwet, and an Upper Markham group headed by Adzera, itself a cluster of half a dozen dialects. Centuries of contact with Papuan neighbours have left a heavy imprint on their vocabulary and grammar, and linguists have been able to reconstruct their common ancestor, Proto-Markham. The lower river reaches the sea at Markham Bay on the Huon Gulf, whose coasts were first charted by Europeans in the 1790s, when the French expedition of d'Entrecasteaux sailed these waters.
zh: 马卡姆诸语是南岛语系泛太平洋语支休恩湾语组下的一个语族，包含约十二种语言，通行于巴布亚新几内亚北部马卡姆河谷、拉穆河谷及马当省、莫罗贝省相邻的低地。新几内亚的西泛太平洋语言通常只分布在沿海，马卡姆诸语却与众不同，许多语言深入内陆，通行于莫罗贝的山间谷地，与高地的跨新几内亚语言相接。它们分为下马卡姆和上马卡姆两支：前者包括万帕尔语、拉布语、杜韦特语等，后者以阿泽拉语为首，阿泽拉语本身又是一个含六种方言的方言群。与巴布亚邻族数百年的接触在词汇和语法上都留下了深刻烙印，语言学者还成功构拟出它们的共同祖先——原始马卡姆语。马卡姆河下游在休恩湾的马卡姆湾入海，1790年代当特尔卡斯托率领的法国探险队航行到此，欧洲人才首次测绘这片海岸。

en: Marovo is an Austronesian language of the New Georgia group in the Solomon Islands, spoken on the islands of Marovo Lagoon and on neighbouring New Georgia, Vangunu and Nggatokae. Its sentences follow verb–subject–object order and vowel length is distinctive, while its words for local animals resemble those of the related Roviana language yet remain clearly separate.
zh: 马罗沃语是所罗门群岛新乔治亚群岛的一种南岛语，通行于马罗沃潟湖诸岛以及邻近的新乔治亚岛、万古努岛和恩加托卡埃岛。它的句子按动词—主语—宾语的顺序排列，元音长短具有辨义作用；当地动物的名称与亲属语言罗维阿纳语相近，却又明显有别。

en: Maskoy, or the Lengua-Mascoy family, is a group of closely related tongues of the Paraguayan Gran Chaco, whose members include Enlhet and Enxet, once counted as the northern and southern dialects of one Lengua language, plus Guana, Sanapana, Angaite and Toba-Maskoy. They were spoken by forest hunter-gatherers and scarcely written down before the late nineteenth century.
zh: 马斯科伊语又称伦瓜-马斯科伊语系，是巴拉圭大查科地区一组亲缘紧密的语言，成员包括恩尔莱特语和恩克塞特语（二者曾被视为同一种伦瓜语的北方、南方方言），以及瓜纳语、萨纳帕纳语、安盖特语和托巴-马斯科伊语。它们原由查科森林中的狩猎采集者使用，在19世纪末以前几乎没有文字记录。

en: Massachusett is the leading language of the Southern New England branch of Eastern Algonquian, a dialect chain that also covered the Wampanoag of Cape Cod and Plymouth, the Narragansett of Rhode Island, the Pequot and Mohegan of the Connecticut coast, and inland peoples such as the Pocumtuck and Quiripi; neighbouring varieties were close enough to serve as a common second language across the region. The Pilgrims of the Mayflower met Wampanoag speakers in 1620 and made their peace with the sachem Massasoit the next year. Contact gave the language a written form almost at once: Roger Williams printed his phrase-book “A Key into the Language of America” in 1643, and the Puritan minister John Eliot, who founded the first Indian praying town at Natick in 1651, translated the whole Bible into the Natick dialect. His Indian Bible of 1663 was the first Bible printed in North America and made Massachusett the first native language of the region with a body of written literature, used by Indian ministers in letters, petitions and town records. The Pequot War of 1636 to 1638 had already broken the Pequot, and King Philip's War of 1675 to 1676, led by the Wampanoag sachem Metacom, shattered the praying towns and cost most of the peoples their lands; survivors who kept their speech carried it into a long, scattered decline through the eighteenth century.
zh: 马萨诸塞语是东阿尔冈昆语族南新英格兰分支的代表语言，属于一个方言连续体，同一条链上还包括科德角和普利茅斯的万帕诺亚格人、罗得岛的纳拉甘西特人、康涅狄格沿海的佩克特人和莫赫根人，以及波孔塔克人、奎里皮人等内陆族群；相邻分支相近到足以充当全区域通用的第二语言。1620年，五月花号上的移民遇到了说万帕诺亚格方言的人，并在次年与酋长马萨索伊特议和。接触几乎立刻为这种语言带来了文字：罗杰·威廉斯于1643年印行短语手册《美洲语言入门》，清教牧师约翰·艾略特则于1651年在内蒂克建起第一座印第安人祈祷镇，并把整部圣经译成内蒂克方言。他的《印第安语圣经》于1663年出版，是北美印制的第一部圣经，也使马萨诸塞语成为当地第一种拥有书面文学的原住民语言，原住民牧师用它写信、递请愿书、记录镇务。1636—1638年的佩科特战争已经击垮了佩克特人；1675—1676年由万帕诺亚格酋长梅塔卡姆领导的菲利普国王战争又摧毁了祈祷镇，使这些族群大多失去土地。保住母语的幸存者带着它，在18世纪漫长而离散的衰落中延续。

en: Mataco–Guaicuru is a proposed language family of the Gran Chaco, spanning northern Argentina, western Paraguay, south-eastern Bolivia and the Mato Grosso do Sul corner of Brazil, uniting the Mataguayan languages Wichí, Chorote, Nivaclé and Maká with the Guaicuruan group of Kadiwéu, Toba, Pilagá, Mocoví and the extinct Abipón, alongside the Guachi and Payagua isolates.
