The kinship was argued in detail by Pedro Viegas Barros, and shared words with Arawakan and Tupian neighbours place the proto-language in the upper Paraguay basin. The two branches lived the Chaco very differently: Guaicuruan bands were nomadic warriors who, after the Spanish founded Asunción in 1537, took up horses and became frontier raiders, while Matacoan villagers settled along the rivers and lived by fishing, gathering and small-scale farming.
zh: 马塔科—瓜伊库鲁语是为大查科草原提出的一个语系，分布跨阿根廷北部、巴拉圭西部、玻利维亚东南部和巴西南马托格罗索一角，把马塔瓜约语支的维奇语、乔罗特语、尼瓦克莱语、马卡语，与瓜伊库鲁语支的卡迪韦乌语、托巴语、皮拉加语、莫科维语和已消亡的阿维蓬语，连同瓜奇语、帕亚瓜语两个孤立语合为一家。学者佩德罗·维加斯·巴罗斯详加论证了这一亲缘关系；依据与阿拉瓦克语、图皮语邻语的共有词汇，其祖语被定位于巴拉圭河上游盆地。两个语支的查科生活方式截然不同：瓜伊库鲁诸部本是游牧武士，1537年西班牙人建立亚松森后改用马匹，成为殖民边疆的袭掠者；马塔科诸村则沿河而居，以渔猎、采集和小规模农耕为生。

en: Maya denotes the Mayan language family, whose members are spoken across southern Mexico, Guatemala, Belize and neighboring parts of Central America. All descend from Proto-Mayan, placed by reconstruction in the Guatemalan highlands; around 2200 BCE the Huastecan branch, whose language survives among the Téenek on the Gulf coast, split off first, while the remaining languages diversified into the Yucatecan, Ch'olan–Tzeltalan, Qanjobalan, Mamean and Quichean branches represented by peoples such as the Maaya, Itza, Ch'ol, K'iche', Q'eqchi' and Mam. During the Classic period of roughly 250 to 900, scribes wrote a prestigious Ch'olan variety in Maya hieroglyphs, leaving thousands of inscriptions and a handful of bark-paper codices. In 1337 the Yucatán was divided among rival city-states after the fall of Mayapan, and from the 1520s to the 1540s the Spanish conquest brought the peninsula and the Guatemalan highlands under colonial rule. Missionaries then taught the Latin alphabet, and Maya speakers produced a rich colonial literature in their own languages, including the K'iche' Popol Vuh and the Yucatec Books of Chilam Balam.
zh: 玛雅语是对整个玛雅语系的统称，其成员分布在墨西哥南部、危地马拉、伯利兹及中美洲邻近地区。诸语言都源自据构拟起源于危地马拉高地的原始玛雅语：约公元前2200年，瓦斯蒂克语支首先分出，其语言保留在墨西哥湾沿岸的瓦斯蒂克人当中；其余语言分化为尤卡坦、乔尔-采尔塔尔、坎霍巴尔、曼姆和基切等语支，对应玛雅、伊察、乔尔、基切、克克奇和曼姆等族群。约250年至900年的古典期，书吏用玛雅象形文字书写一种尊贵的乔尔语变体，留下数千处铭文和数部树皮纸抄本。1337年时，尤卡坦在玛雅潘城邦衰落后分裂为彼此争战的城邦；1520至1540年代，西班牙征服先后使尤卡坦半岛和危地马拉高地沦为殖民地。传教士随后推广拉丁字母，玛雅人用本族语言写出丰富的殖民文学，包括基切语的《波波尔·乌》和尤卡坦语的《奇拉姆·巴拉姆之书》。

en: Maybrat, also called Ayamaru after its principal dialect, is a Papuan language of the central Bird's Head Peninsula in Southwest Papua, spoken most densely around the Ayamaru Lakes. No relationship to any other language has been demonstrated, so it is usually treated as a language isolate, although tentative schemes have grouped it with Abun and the West Bird's Head languages in a hypothetical Toror family, or with the wider West Papuan stock; its grammar, with two genders, person prefixes and serial verbs in rigid subject-verb-object order, nonetheless resembles its neighbours. Local tradition recognises six dialects, among which Karon Dori is divergent enough to be counted as a separate language by some. The name Maybrat combines mai, sound or speech, with Brat, the hill near the village of Semetu, so the word means the speech of Brat. The Maybrat people live by hunting, fishing and swidden agriculture in scattered homesteads, and their country is ringed by other linguistic worlds, Abun and Mpur to the north, Meyah and Moskona to the east, the South Bird's Head languages to the south and Tehit to the west. While the Vogelkop coasts were drawn into the Sultanate of Tidore's tribute network from the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, and Luís Vaz de Torres's Spanish ships passed in 1606, the lake-studded Maybrat interior remained effectively beyond outside rule, its many dialects carried on in small, self-sufficient kin groups.
zh: 梅布拉特语以其主要方言又称阿亚马鲁语，是西南巴布亚鸟头半岛中部的巴布亚语言，使用者最集中于阿亚马鲁湖群周围。它与任何其他语言的亲缘关系都未获证明，因此通常被视为孤立语言；不过也有试探性的方案把它与阿本语和西鸟头诸语归入假想的托罗尔语系，或纳入更大的西巴布亚语系。它的语法有两个性、人称前缀和连动结构，采用严格的主-谓-宾语序，与邻近语言颇为相似。当地传统承认六种方言，其中卡龙-多里方言差异最大，有时被单列为一种语言。“梅布拉特”由 mai（声音、言语）和 Brat（塞梅图村附近一座山丘之名）组成，意为“布拉特之言”。梅布拉特人以狩猎、捕鱼和游耕为生，居住在分散的家户聚落中；他们的家园被其他语言世界环绕：北面是阿本语和姆普尔语，东面是梅亚语和莫斯克纳语，南面是南鸟头诸语，西面是特希特语。尽管从15至16世纪起，鸟头半岛沿海已被纳入蒂多雷苏丹国的朝贡网络，1606年路易斯·瓦斯·德·托雷斯的西班牙船只也曾从附近经过，但湖泊密布的梅布拉特内地实际上始终处于外来统治之外，众多方言在自给自足的小型血缘群体中代代相传。

en: Meitei, also called Manipuri, is a Tibeto-Burman language of the Imphal valley in Manipur on the India–Burma border, where it serves as the region's lingua franca; the standard form is the Imphal dialect, and smaller communities of speakers live in Assam, Bangladesh and upper Burma. With a written tradition stretching back some two thousand years, it is one of the few old literary languages of Tibeto-Burman, alongside Tibetan, Burmese and Newar. Early works include the ritual coronation song Ougri, possibly older than the Common Era, the first-century epic Numit Kappa and a copper-plate inscription from the reign of King Khongtekcha around 763, while King Loiyumba's legal code Loyumba Shinyen was finalized in 1100. Its own Meitei Mayek alphabet, first attested on sixth-century coins, was used until the Hinduizing king Pamheiba replaced it with the Bengali-Assamese script in the early eighteenth century and fostered Vaishnavite literature such as the Parikshit of 1725. The language keeps subject–object–verb order and remains the sacred liturgical tongue of the indigenous Sanamahi religion.
zh: 梅泰语又称曼尼普尔语，是印缅边境曼尼普尔邦因帕尔河谷的藏缅语族语言，也是当地的通用语，标准形式为因帕尔方言，阿萨姆、孟加拉国和上缅甸也有小型使用者社群。它的书面传统约有两千年，是藏缅语族中少有的古老文学语言之一，与藏语、缅甸语、尼瓦尔语并列。早期作品包括可能早于公元纪年的加冕仪式歌《乌格里》、1世纪史诗《射日》，以及约763年国王孔泰查时期的铜盘铭文；国王罗伊尤姆巴的法典《罗伊尤姆巴辛延》于1100年定稿。梅泰语自有梅泰梅耶克字母，最早见于6世纪钱币，一直沿用到18世纪初；印度教化的国王帕姆海巴改用孟加拉—阿萨姆字母，并扶持毗湿奴派文学，如1725年的《波利克湿多》。梅泰语语序为主宾动，也是本土萨纳马希宗教的神圣礼仪语言。

en: Mel is the southern West Atlantic branch of the Niger-Congo family, spoken on the coast and in the hinterland of Guinea-Bissau, Guinea, Sierra Leone and Liberia. Its largest member is Temne of northern Sierra Leone, followed by Kissi; it also takes in Baga in Guinea and the coastal Bullom and Sherbro tongues, while Gola's place in the branch is disputed. Linguistic reconstruction places the Proto-Mel homeland in the highlands of north-central Sierra Leone rather than on the shore. The Temne trace their own origin to the Futa Jallon, and migrations in the fifteenth century, driven by Fulani domination, brought them south to the Kolenté and Rokel rivers; in the mid-sixteenth century the Mande invasion of the Mane overran their country and grafted new kingdoms onto the older chiefdoms. Portuguese mariners left the first written records: Pereira noted Temne words in memoirs written between 1505 and 1508, and Almada described the country in 1594. The Atlantic slave trade then reached the coast through agencies such as the Royal African Company after 1684, and in 1787 Temne rulers granted land at Freetown for a settlement of freed slaves, which became a centre of Christian missions and literacy in the region.
zh: 梅尔语是尼日尔—刚果语系西大西洋语支的南部分支，通行于几内亚比绍、几内亚、塞拉利昂和利比里亚的沿海与内陆地区。最大的成员是塞拉利昂北部的滕内语，其次是基西语；还包括几内亚的巴加语以及沿海的布洛姆语和谢尔布罗语，戈拉语在该语支中的归属则有争议。语言构拟把原始梅尔语的故园定在塞拉利昂中北部的高地，而不是海岸一带。滕内人自称来自富塔贾隆，15世纪在富拉尼人的压力下南迁，抵达科伦泰河与罗克尔河流域；16世纪中期，曼丁哥系的马内人入侵并征服他们的土地，在旧有酋邦之上嫁接出新的王国。葡萄牙航海者留下了最早的文字记录：佩雷拉在1505至1508年写成的游记中记下了滕内语词汇，阿尔马达又于1594年记述了当地风貌。此后大西洋奴隶贸易沿海上岸，1684年后皇家非洲公司等机构深入此地；1787年，滕内统治者在弗里敦拨出土地安置获释黑奴，这里后来成为基督教传教和当地文字教育的中心。

en: Mengen is an Oceanic language of the Ngero-Vitiaz linkage, spoken in the Pomio District of eastern New Britain, around Jacquinot Bay and in the inland villages behind it. Its varieties form three rather divergent dialects: north-coast Maeng, south-coast Poeng, and inland or Bush Mengen, also called Longueinga, and some linguists treat the Poeng and Maeng groups as two distinct languages. Long contact along Wide Bay has left Mengen features on Sulka, the non-Austronesian isolate spoken farther along the coast. As a member of the Ngero-Vitiaz linkage it descends from the speech of the Austronesian seafarers who settled the New Britain coast around 1500 BCE, the same Oceanic expansion whose related languages run westward through the Vitiaz Strait to the Morobe and Madang coasts of New Guinea.
zh: 门根语是恩盖罗—维蒂亚兹语链下的一种大洋洲语言，通行于新不列颠岛东部波米奥县的雅克诺湾一带及湾后内陆的村落。它的土语分为三种差异颇大的方言：北海岸的马恩方言、南海岸的波恩方言，以及又称隆恩加的内陆“丛林门根”方言；部分语言学家主张把波恩和马恩两组视为两门独立的语言。在宽湾沿岸的长期接触中，门根语的一些特征也影响了更远处沿海使用的非南岛孤立语言苏尔卡语。作为恩盖罗—维蒂亚兹语链的一员，它源出公元前1500年前后定居新不列颠海岸的南岛航海者的语言；同一场大洋洲语扩张还把亲缘语言向西穿过勇士号海峡，带到新几内亚岛的莫罗贝和马当海岸。

en: Min is the most internally diverse branch of the Sinitic languages, centered on Fujian and reaching from southern Zhejiang to eastern Guangdong, Hainan and the Leizhou Peninsula, taking its name from the Min River. Fujian was opened to Han settlement only in 110 BCE, when the armies of Emperor Wu destroyed the Minyue state; its rugged mountains screened the region from the northern migrations that reshaped other southern speeches, so Min alone, with the extinct Shu, keeps distinctions of Old Chinese that the rhyme dictionary Qieyun of 601 no longer records, overlaid on a substrate left by the Minyue natives. The Disaster of Yongjia in 311 brought refugees south, and in 669 the Chen family from Henan planted an administration among the She people. In 893 Wang Chao entered Fujian with an army, and his son Wang Shenzhi founded the Min Kingdom in 909. These waves stacked Han, Six Dynasties and Tang Chang'an layers on the old base, including a literary reading tradition written in Chinese characters.
zh: 闽语是汉语各方言中内部分歧最大的一支，以福建为中心，分布北起浙江南部、南至广东东部、海南岛和雷州半岛，名称取自闽江。直到公元前110年汉武帝出兵攻灭闽越国，福建才对汉人定居开放；山岭阻隔使这里较少受到重塑其他南方方言的北方移民浪潮影响，因此闽语与已消亡的蜀语一样，保留了601年《切韵》已不再记录的上古汉语特征，其下还叠着闽越土著语言的底层。311年永嘉之乱驱使北人南迁，669年河南陈氏父子在畲人之地建立州县；893年王潮率军入闽，其子王审知于909年建立闽国。几番移民把汉代、六朝和唐代长安的语言层次层层叠加在古老底层之上，其中以汉字书写的文读传统便依托唐都长安的口语而成。

en: Minanibai is the name-bearing language of the Inland Gulf family of Trans-New Guinea languages, spoken inland of the Gulf of Papua in southern Papua New Guinea, from the Omati River in Gulf Province to the Aramia River further west. Its branch also includes Mubami and the Hoia Hoia varieties, while Ipiko stands apart as the family's other main branch.
zh: 米纳米拜语是内陆海湾语族中同名支系的语言。该语族属跨新几内亚语系，通行于巴布亚新几内亚南部巴布亚湾内陆，从海湾省的奥马蒂河口一直到更西边的阿拉米亚河。米纳米拜支还包括穆巴米语和霍亚霍亚诸变体，而伊皮科语则是该语族另一个差异较大的独立分支。

en: Misumalpan is a small language family of the Mosquitia lowlands along the Caribbean coast of present-day Nicaragua and Honduras, taking its name from its three branches, Miskito, Sumo and Matagalpa. The Sumo branch comprises Mayangna and Ulwa in the forested river basins, while the Matagalpan languages, Matagalpa and Cacaopera, were spoken in the inland highlands. The languages share one phonological system and drew loanwords from neighbouring Arawak and Carib speakers and, after European contact, from English, Dutch and German traders. From the late 1600s the Miskito, allied with English settlers and buccaneers through the Kingdom of Mosquitia, carried their speech along the coast as a regional lingua franca, and neighbouring Sumo communities gradually shifted to it.
zh: 米苏马尔潘语是莫斯基蒂亚低地的一个小语系，分布在今尼加拉瓜和洪都拉斯的加勒比海沿岸，名称取自其三个分支——米斯基托语、苏莫语和马塔加尔帕语——的首音节。苏莫一支包括林区河流地带的马扬格纳语和乌尔瓦语，马塔加尔帕一支的马塔加尔帕语和卡考佩拉语则通行于内陆高原。这些语言音系一致，并从邻近的阿拉瓦克语和加勒比语，以及欧洲人到来后英语、荷兰语、德语商人的用语中吸收借词。17世纪末起，米斯基托人经莫斯基托王国与英国殖民者和海盗结盟，把米斯基托语带到沿海各地，成为地区通用语，邻近的苏莫族群也逐渐改用该语。

en: Mon is an Austroasiatic language of the Mon people, spoken chiefly in the lower Irrawaddy valley and along the Tenasserim coast in present-day Myanmar, with smaller communities in Thailand. Unlike Burmese and Thai, it is not tonal, distinguishing words by clear and breathy vowel registers. Old Mon inscriptions from the Mon kingdom of Dvaravati in central Thailand date from the sixth to eighth centuries and use a script derived from the Pallava Grantha letters; Mon writing in lower Burma became the parent of the Burmese alphabet. Until the twelfth century Mon was the lingua franca of the Irrawaddy valley, even at the Bamar court of Pagan, where King Kyansittha patronized it and the Myazedi inscription of 1112 was carved in Pali, Pyu, Mon and Burmese. After Pagan fell in 1287 it again served as the court language of the Hanthawaddy kingdom at Pegu; the fall of the restored Hanthawaddy kingdom in 1757 drove many Mon speakers into Siam, and by 1830 most of lower Burma had shifted to Burmese.
zh: 孟语是孟人使用的南亚语系语言，主要通行于今缅甸南部的伊洛瓦底江下游和丹那沙林沿岸，泰国也有小型社群。与缅甸语、泰语不同，孟语没有声调，靠元音的常态发声与气声两种音区区别词义。泰国中部孟人古国陀罗钵地留下的古孟文碑铭可追溯至6至8世纪，文字源出帕拉瓦格兰塔字母；下缅甸的孟文后来成为缅文字母的母体。12世纪以前，孟语一直是伊洛瓦底江流域的通用语，连缅人蒲甘王朝的宫廷也使用它：国王江喜陀大力扶持，1112年的妙齐提碑同时以巴利语、骠语、孟语和缅甸语四种文字刻成。1287年蒲甘灭亡后，孟语再度成为勃固汉达瓦底王国的宫廷语言；1757年后勃固王朝覆灭，大批孟语使用者逃入暹罗，到1830年，下缅甸大部分地区已改用缅甸语。

en: Mongolian is the principal language of the Mongolic family, native to the Mongolian Plateau and carried across Eurasia by the Mongol conquests. It is an agglutinative language with vowel harmony, subject–object–verb word order and chains of suffixes. The oldest surviving Mongolian text, the Stele of Yisüngge, was carved around 1224 in the Uyghur-based vertical Mongolian script, which Genghis Khan's empire adopted from the Uyghurs; the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries also saw the 'Phags-pa script of 1269, Chinese-character transcriptions in the Secret History of the Mongols and Arabic-script glossaries, all recording what linguists call Middle Mongol. Under the Yuan dynasty Mongolian served as the guoyu, or national language, and after the dynasty fell in 1368 the retreating Mongol courts kept the tradition alive in the steppe. Between the seventeenth and nineteenth centuries a standardized written form known as Classical Mongolian emerged, used for the translated Kangyur and Tengyur Buddhist canon, historical chronicles and, from 1686, the Soyombo alphabet, while spoken dialects such as Khalkha, Khorchin and Chakhar, together with the related Oirat, Buryat and Daur varieties, stretched from Manchuria to the Volga.
zh: 蒙古语是蒙古语族最主要的语言，原产于蒙古高原，随蒙古征服传播到欧亚大陆各地。它是黏着语，有元音和谐，语序为主宾动，依靠层层后缀构词造句。现存最早的蒙古语文献是约1224年刻成的《也松格碑》，使用成吉思汗帝国从回鹘人那里采用的竖写回鹘式蒙古文；13至14世纪还出现了1269年颁行的八思巴文、用汉字音写的《蒙古秘史》和阿拉伯字母词汇表，这些文献记录的语言被学界称为中古蒙古语。元朝时蒙古语以“国语”之名通行，1368年元朝灭亡后，退回草原的蒙古汗廷延续了这一书面传统。17至19世纪间，高度规范化的书面语“古典蒙古语”形成，用于翻译佛经《甘珠尔》《丹珠尔》、撰写史书，并在1686年催生了索永布文字；与此同时，喀尔喀、科尔沁、察哈尔等口语方言，加上亲属语言卫拉特语、布里亚特语和达斡尔语，分布范围从满洲一直延伸到伏尔加河流域。

en: Mordvinic is a small subgroup of the Uralic family consisting of two languages, Erzya and Moksha, both spoken in the middle Volga region around Mordovia; they are not mutually intelligible, and the medieval Meshcherian language may have belonged to the same group. The ancestors of the two peoples are distinguishable in the archaeological record from the first century, and the name Erzya first appears in a letter of the Khazar khagan Joseph in 968. Around the seventh century the Mordvins came under the influence of Volga Bulgaria and paid it tribute, and the Mongol conquest of the thirteenth century placed them inside the Golden Horde. In the late fourteenth century Moscow seized the western Mordvin lands while the east passed to the Kazan Khanate, and after Kazan fell in 1552 all Mordvins became Russian subjects. Russian rule brought forced conversion to Christianity, an influx of Russian settlers and serfdom; a joint rebellion of Mordvins, Chuvash and Mari in the seventeenth century was suppressed, after which many Mordvins fled east beyond the Volga.
zh: 莫尔多瓦语是乌拉尔语族的一个小分支，由埃尔齐亚语和莫克沙语两种语言组成，都通行于伏尔加河中游、即后来的莫尔多瓦一带；二者互不相通，中世纪的梅谢拉语可能也属于这一分支。两支先民从1世纪起在考古上已可区分，埃尔齐亚之名最早见于968年可萨汗约瑟夫的书信。7世纪前后，莫尔多瓦人受到伏尔加保加利亚的影响并向其纳贡；13世纪蒙古征服后，他们被纳入金帐汗国。14世纪末，莫斯科夺取了西部的莫尔多瓦土地，东部则归入喀山汗国；1552年喀山陷落后，所有莫尔多瓦人都成为俄罗斯臣民。俄罗斯的统治带来了强迫改宗基督教、俄罗斯移民涌入和农奴制；17世纪莫尔多瓦人同楚瓦什人、马里人联合起义，遭到镇压后，许多莫尔多瓦人向东逃过伏尔加河。

en: Moru-Madi is a cluster of closely related languages of the Central Sudanic family, spoken across the borderlands of South Sudan, Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Its members include Moru, Ma'di, Lugbara, Aringa, Keliko and Logo, and the name Ma'di is also used more loosely for several peoples of Uganda's West Nile region.
zh: 莫鲁‑马迪语是中苏丹语族下一群关系紧密的语言，通行于南苏丹、乌干达和刚果（金）的交界地带，成员包括莫鲁语、马迪语、卢格巴拉语、阿林加语、凯利科语和洛戈语等；“马迪”这个名字也被宽泛地用来称呼乌干达西尼罗河地区的若干部族。

en: Moseten, or the Moseten-Chimane dialect continuum, is an isolate of the Bolivian lowlands, spoken along the Beni River by Tsimane and Moseten villagers; its Covendo, Santa Ana and Chimane varieties remain mutually intelligible. Jesuit and Franciscan missionaries evangelized these communities, and its proposed links to the Chon languages, like shared words with Puquina and Yuracare, suggest contact, not proven kinship.
zh: 莫塞滕语又称莫塞滕-奇马内方言连续体，是玻利维亚低地的一种孤立语，由贝尼河沿岸的奇马内人和莫塞滕人使用，科文多、圣安娜和奇马内三种变体彼此仍能相通。耶稣会和方济各会的传教士曾向这些社群传教；至于它与琼语系的亲缘假说，以及它和普基纳语、尤鲁卡雷语共有的词语，都更像是长期接触的结果，而非已证实的同源关系。

en: Movima is the language of the Movima people of the Llanos de Moxos, the seasonally flooded savanna of the Beni department in Bolivia, where it is spoken in Yacuma Province. It has no proven relatives and is regarded as a language isolate. From the 1670s Jesuit priests moving out from Santa Cruz de la Sierra gathered the peoples of the region into mission reductions along the Mamoré River, beginning with Loreto and with Trinidad founded in 1686; Movima was among the indigenous languages spoken in these missions, where the Arawakan language Moxo served as the common tongue.
zh: 莫维马语是玻利维亚贝尼省莫霍斯平原上莫维马人的语言，通行于亚库马省一带。莫霍斯平原是一片季节性泛滥的热带草原，而莫维马语没有可证实的亲属语言，被视为孤立语言。17世纪70年代起，从圣克鲁斯-德拉谢拉出发的耶稣会神父把当地各族群集中到马莫雷河畔的传教镇，最早的是洛雷托，特立尼达传教站建于1686年；莫维马语是这些传教区里使用的原住民语言之一，传教区的通用语则是阿拉瓦克语系的莫霍语。

en: Mu Ngava, recorded by linguists as Rennellese or Rennell-Bellona, is a Polynesian outlier language spoken on Rennell and Bellona, two small islands south of the main Solomon Islands chain and well outside the Polynesian Triangle. The islands were first occupied by Lapita peoples, with further waves of settlement around the second century BC and about AD 1000; the present population descends from Polynesians who arrived from Uvea, now Wallis Island, before 1400, and oral tradition recalls the voyage of an ancestor named Kaitu'u around that time. Captain Butler of HMS Walpole became the first European to sight the islands in 1801. The language keeps a five-vowel system in which a glottal stop marks lengthened vowels, favours open consonant-vowel syllables, and traditionally orders words verb-subject-object, with reduplication used to form plurals and new terms.
zh: 穆恩加瓦语在语言学记录中称伦内尔语或伦内尔—贝罗纳语，是一种波利尼西亚域外点语言，通行于所罗门群岛主岛链以南、远在波利尼西亚三角之外的两座小岛拉纳尔岛和贝罗纳岛。两岛最早由拉皮塔人定居，公元前2世纪和公元1000年前后又有新的移民潮；今天的居民是1400年以前从乌韦阿（今瓦利斯岛）迁来的波利尼西亚人的后裔，口述传统中保留着始祖凯图大约在那时渡海而来的故事。1801年，沃尔波尔号的巴特勒船长成为最早望见两岛的欧洲人。穆恩加瓦语保留五个元音，以喉塞音标记长元音，多用辅音加元音的开音节，传统词序为动词—主语—宾语，并靠重叠构成复数和新词。

en: Muchik, better known as Mochica and in colonial records as Yunga, is the extinct language isolate of the Peruvian north coast, spoken across the desert valleys of Lambayeque and La Libertad that were home to the Moche civilization from about 100 to 800 and to its Sicán or Lambayeque successor between 750 and 1375. It should not be confused with Quingnam, the actual language of the neighbouring Chimú kingdom, a mistake widespread in the nineteenth century. Muchik had a synthetic grammar built on clitics rather than affixes, with case stacking and numeral classifiers, and its peculiar lateral sounds struck every Spanish cleric who heard it. Documentation began early: a manuscript of 1582 preserves Mochica texts, the Franciscan Luis Jeronimo de Ore included sentences in his Rituale of 1607, and Fernando de la Carrera Daza printed the Arte de la lengua yunga at Reque in 1644, the only colonial grammar, while Bishop Baltasar Martínez Compañón added a wordlist in the 1780s. Quechua and Spanish spread along the coast under Inca and then Spanish rule, steadily narrowing the language's domain; by the nineteenth century Muchik survived only in a few villages around Chiclayo and Eten, where scholars such as Ernst Middendorf raced to record it. Its grammars and wordlists remain the chief linguistic monument of the Moche and Sicán peoples.
zh: 穆奇克语常称莫奇卡语，殖民文献中又叫荣加语，是秘鲁北海岸已消亡的孤立语言，通行于兰巴耶克和拉利伯塔德的沙漠河谷——公元100年至800年的莫切文明，以及750年至1375年继之而起的西坎（兰巴耶克）文化都分布在这一带。不要把它与邻邦奇穆王国实际使用的基格纳姆语混为一谈，19世纪的学者曾普遍张冠李戴。穆奇克语是综合性语言，语法靠附着词而非词缀构建，有格叠用和量词系统，特殊的边音让每一位听过它的西班牙教士都印象深刻。它的文献记录开始得很早：1582年的一份手稿保存了穆奇克语文本，方济各会修士奥雷在1607年的《秘鲁礼仪手册》中收录了若干句子，费尔南多·德拉卡雷拉于1644年在雷凯印行了唯一一部殖民时期语法《荣加语技艺》，马丁内斯·孔帕尼翁主教又在18世纪80年代的图册中补入一份词表。在印加和西班牙先后统治下，克丘亚语和西班牙语沿海岸传播，穆奇克语的使用范围不断缩小；到19世纪，它只残存在奇克拉约和埃滕附近的几个村庄里，米登多夫等学者赶在最后时刻记录了它。传世的语法书和词表，成了莫切人与西坎人最主要的语言纪念碑。

en: Mumeng is an Oceanic dialect chain of the South Huon Gulf linkage, part of the Huon Gulf group of Western Oceanic languages, spoken in the mountain villages behind the southern shore of the Huon Gulf in Morobe Province. Its varieties fall into two clusters, Dambi–Kumalu and Gorakor–Patep–Zenag, whose speakers understand one another only in part, while Kapin may be a more distant member of the same chain. The neighboring Iwal tongue, the most conservative of the South Huon Gulf languages, preserves old counting on hands and feet up to twenty, called one person, and special prefixes that class trees, edible greens, birds and fish. Spanish ships under Yñigo Ortiz de Retez passed this coast in 1545, and the French expedition of 1792 to 1793, in which Jean-Michel Huon de Kermadec served, left his name on the gulf and the peninsula beyond it.
zh: 穆孟语是南休恩湾语链的一支大洋语方言链，属于西大洋语休恩湾语群，通行于莫罗贝省休恩湾南岸后方的山村。它的变体分为丹比—库马卢与戈拉科尔—帕特普—泽纳格两簇，使用者之间只能部分互通；卡平语可能是这条语链中更远的成员。邻近的伊瓦尔语是南休恩湾语言中最保守的一支，保留着用手脚数到二十、称为“一个人”的传统计数法，以及给树木、菜蔬、鸟类和鱼类分类的专用前缀。1545年，伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德·雷特斯率领的西班牙船只经过这段海岸；1792至1793年，让—米歇尔·休恩·德·凯尔马德克参加的法国探险队又把他的名字留给了这座海湾和湾外的半岛。

en: Munda is the western branch of the Austroasiatic family, distantly related to Mon, Khmer and Vietnamese, and is spoken by around eleven million people across eastern India, Bangladesh and Nepal. Linguists derive Proto-Munda from South-East Asia: pre-Proto-Munda speakers are thought to have reached the Mahanadi delta on the Odisha coast by sea around 1500 BCE and then to have spread inland up the river system. The family splits into North Munda, centred on the Chota Nagpur Plateau of Jharkhand, and South Munda in central Odisha; its principal languages are Santali, the largest, Mundari, Ho, Korku, Sora, Kharia and Juang. Head-final and agglutinating, they distinguish inclusive from exclusive first-person plural, lack grammatical gender and make wide use of numeral classifiers. Long the established population of the plateau and adjoining hills, Munda communities came under pressure from expanding Indo-Aryan kingdoms during the first millennium CE and retreated into forested uplands.
zh: 蒙达语是南亚语系的西部语支，与孟语、高棉语、越南语互为远亲，约有一千一百万人使用，分布在印度东部、孟加拉国和尼泊尔境内。语言学家认为原始蒙达语源自东南亚：其先民约在公元前1500年沿海路抵达奥里萨海岸的默哈讷迪三角洲，随后溯河深入内陆。蒙达语分为以贾坎德邦焦达讷格布尔高原为中心的北支，以及通行于奥里萨中部的南支；主要语言包括使用人数最多的桑塔利语，还有蒙达里语、霍语、科尔库语、索拉语、卡里亚语和朱昂语。这些语言动词居句末、属黏着类型，第一人称复数区分包括式与排除式，没有语法性别，量词使用广泛。蒙达族群本是高原及邻近丘陵的老居民，在公元一千纪间随印度—雅利安诸邦扩张而受压，逐渐退入林区山地。

en:
Bohurá, or Mura proper, was the principal language of the Mura family in Amazonas, Brazil, spoken along the Autaz and Manicoré rivers; its sister varieties were Pirahã on the Maici and the unattested Yahahí. Its speakers called themselves Buhuraen, while their Torá and Matanawi neighbours pronounced the name Murá. The language is agglutinative, uses tone and whistled speech, and has a very small sound inventory.

The Mura first appear in records in 1714 on the lower Madeira. After Portuguese slavers raided them, they opposed the Jesuit missions and colonial penetration through most of the eighteenth century with river ambushes. Around 1768 they moved north beyond the Solimões and ranged between the Madeira, Purus and Autaz, reaching their greatest extent around 1774, when government troops burned dozens of their settlements. Weakened by epidemics and Munduruku pressure, they made peace in 1784. In the early nineteenth century they still numbered tens of thousands, but in the Cabanagem revolt of 1834 to 1836 they joined the rebels and suffered heavy massacres.
zh:
博乌拉语又称穆拉语正本，是巴西亚马孙州穆拉语族的主要语言，通行于奥塔斯河与马尼科雷河沿岸；同族的姊妹方言有麦西河一带的皮拉罕语和已无语言材料存世的亚哈希语。使用者自称布胡伦，邻族托拉人和马塔纳维人则把这个名字读成穆拉。该语言属黏着语，有声调和口哨语，音位数量很少。

穆拉人最早见于1714年的文献，当时居住在马代拉河下游。葡萄牙奴隶贩子掳掠他们之后，他们在18世纪的大部分时间里以河道伏击抵抗耶稣会传教和殖民渗透。1768年前后，他们北迁越过索利蒙伊斯河，活动于马代拉河、普鲁斯河与奥塔斯河之间，约1774年势力达到极盛，招致政府军焚毁数十处聚落。在疫病和蒙杜鲁库人的夹击下，他们于1784年议和。19世纪初其使用者仍数以万计，但在1834至1836年的卡巴纳仁起义中，穆拉人加入叛军一方，遭到惨重屠杀。

en: Muscogee, also called Creek and self-designated Mvskoke, is the principal language of the Eastern Muskogean branch, which also includes Hitchiti-Mikasuki, Alabama, Koasati and the now-silent Apalachee of western Florida. It was historically the language of the Muscogee Creek Confederacy of Alabama and Georgia, heirs of Mississippian mound-building towns such as Ocmulgee, Etowah and Moundville, whom Hernando de Soto's expedition met in the 1540s. The closely related Eastern Muskogean varieties were largely mutually intelligible, and Muscogee itself distinguishes tones and nasalized vowels and once had distinct men's and women's forms of speech. Early in the eighteenth century Muscogee speakers moving into Florida merged with Hitchiti-Mikasuki and other groups to form the Seminole. Divisions over dealing with the United States kindled the Red Stick, or Creek, War of 1813 to 1814; Andrew Jackson's victory and the Treaty of Fort Jackson cost the confederacy twenty-two million acres, and in the 1830s most Muscogee and Seminole were forced beyond the Mississippi to Indian Territory.
zh: 马斯科吉语又称克里克语，自称马斯克语，是东马斯科吉语支最主要的语言；同一语支还有希奇蒂—米卡苏基语、亚拉巴马语、夸萨蒂语以及已无人使用的西佛罗里达阿巴拉契语。历史上，马斯科吉语是亚拉巴马和佐治亚一带马斯科吉克里克联盟的语言，联盟的先民是奥克马尔吉、埃托瓦、芒德维尔等密西西比式土丘城镇的建造者，16世纪40年代埃尔南多·德索托的远征队曾与他们相遇。东马斯科吉语支各近亲方言大体可以互通；马斯科吉语自身有声调之分和鼻化元音，还曾有男女有别的说话方式。18世纪初，迁入佛罗里达的马斯科吉语使用者与希奇蒂—米卡苏基人等群体融合，形成塞米诺尔人。对美态度的分歧引发1813至1814年的红棍战争（又称克里克战争），安德鲁·杰克逊取胜后订立的《杰克逊堡条约》使联盟丧失2200万英亩土地；19世纪30年代，大部分马斯科吉人和塞米诺尔人被强制迁往密西西比河以西的印第安领地。

en: Mussau, or Mussau-Emira, is the Oceanic language of Mussau and Emirau, the two principal islands of the St Matthias or Mussau group, the northernmost island chain of the Bismarck Archipelago in present-day New Ireland Province, Papua New Guinea. Together with the closely related Tenis tongue it forms the St Matthias subgroup, which linguists treat as an independent primary branch within the Oceanic family rather than part of the larger western linkages. Mussau itself is a hilly island largely covered by primeval rainforest. The archipelago was reached by the Lapita seafarers, the Austronesian potters whose sites stretch from Mussau to Samoa and who are believed to have spoken Proto-Oceanic, the ancestral language from which Mussau descends, during their spread through Island Melanesia between roughly 1600 and 500 BCE.
zh: 穆绍语又称穆绍—埃米劳语，是穆绍岛和埃米劳岛上的大洋洲语言；这两座岛是圣马提亚群岛（亦称穆绍群岛）的主岛，而该群岛是今巴布亚新几内亚新爱尔兰省俾斯麦群岛最北端的岛链。它与亲缘很近的特尼斯语共同组成圣马提亚语支，语言学家将其视为大洋洲语系下独立的基本分支，而非更大的西部分支的一部分。穆绍岛多山，大部分地表覆盖着原始雨林。早在约公元前1600年至前500年间，制陶的南岛航海者拉皮塔人便到达了这片群岛，其遗址分布范围从穆绍一直延伸到萨摩亚；学界认为拉皮塔人使用原始大洋洲语，那正是穆绍语所源出的祖语。

en: Mwotlap, once recorded as Motlav, is an Oceanic language of the Austronesian family, belonging to the Torres–Banks linkage of northern Vanuatu. It is at home on the island of Motalava in the Banks Islands, with sister communities on the small island of Ra and on Vanua Lava, while Volow, formerly spoken in the Aplow district of eastern Motalava and long extinct, is sometimes counted as one of its dialects. Like the other Torres–Banks languages it descends from the speech of the Lapita voyagers, who carried Austronesian languages into Remote Oceania and settled the Vanuatu islands from about 1200 BCE; centuries of isolation on small islands then produced the dense patchwork of closely related but sharply distinct island languages characteristic of Vanuatu. Mwotlap was maintained entirely through oral tradition, in genealogies, chants and storytelling, for the islands had no indigenous script.
zh: 莫塔拉瓦语旧称莫特拉夫语，是南岛语系大洋洲语族的语言，属于瓦努阿图北部的托雷斯-班克斯语链。它的老家在班克斯群岛的莫塔拉瓦岛，邻近的拉岛和瓦努阿拉瓦岛上也有使用者；曾通行于莫塔拉瓦岛东部阿普洛一带、早已消亡的沃洛语，有时被视为它的一种方言。和托雷斯-班克斯的其他语言一样，它源自拉皮塔航海者的语言：这些航海者把南岛语言带进遥远大洋洲，约从公元前1200年起定居瓦努阿图诸岛；随后小岛之间数百年的隔绝，造就了瓦努阿图特有的语言拼图——各岛语言同源却差异分明。由于当地没有本土文字，莫塔拉瓦语一直靠家谱、吟唱和讲故事的口述传统代代相传。

en: Myaamia, better known as Miami-Illinois, is a Central Algonquian language of the Algic family, historically spoken across Illinois, Indiana, western Ohio and the upper Mississippi by the Miami, Wea and Piankeshaw and by the tribes of the Illinois Confederation, among them the Kaskaskia, Peoria, Tamaroa and Cahokia. Its vocabulary most resembles Sauk-Fox-Kickapoo, while its sounds and grammar recall Ojibwe and Potawatomi. French missionaries gave it its earliest written form: Claude-Jean Allouez composed prayers and a catechism at Kaskaskia in the late seventeenth century, and Jacques Gravier compiled an Illinois-French dictionary of nearly six hundred pages and twenty thousand entries in the early eighteenth, followed by Antoine-Robert Le Boullenger's wordlist of about thirty-three hundred items. Warfare, disease and Anglo-American settlement thinned the Miami peoples after the late 1700s, yet documentation continued: the Miami chief Little Turtle's visit to Philadelphia produced wordlists, one said to have been commissioned by Thomas Jefferson, and a Wea primer for Protestant missionaries was printed in Kansas in 1837.
zh: 麦阿米亚语通称迈阿密—伊利诺伊语，是阿尔吉克语系的一门中阿尔冈昆语言，历史上通行于伊利诺伊、印第安纳、俄亥俄西部和密西西比河上游，使用者包括迈阿密人、韦亚人、皮安凯肖人以及伊利诺伊联盟的卡斯卡斯基亚、皮奥里亚、塔马罗阿和卡霍基亚等部。它的词汇最接近索克—福克斯—基卡普语，语音和语法则近似奥吉布瓦语和波塔瓦托米语。法国传教士最早为它留下文字记录：17世纪末，阿卢埃在卡斯卡斯基亚编写了祈祷文和教理问答；18世纪初，格拉维耶编成一部近600页、收录约2万词条的伊利诺伊语—法语词典，后来勒布朗热又整理出约3300个词的词汇表。18世纪末以后，战争、疫病和英裔移民的拓殖使迈阿密诸部人口锐减，但语言记录并未中断：迈阿密首领小乌龟访问费城时促成了几份词汇表，其中一份据说由托马斯·杰斐逊委托编写；1837年，堪萨斯还为新教传教士印行了一部韦亚语入门读本。

en: Naasioi, also called Nasioi or Kieta, is a Papuan language of the South Bougainville family, spoken in the central mountains and on the southeast coast of Kieta District on Bougainville Island, Papua New Guinea. The family is verb-final, unlike the verb-medial Oceanic languages, and contains words of Proto-Oceanic origin; an older scheme placed it in the proposed East Papuan grouping.
zh: 纳西奥伊语又名纳西奥语或基埃塔语，是南布干维尔语系的一种巴布亚语，通行于巴布亚新几内亚布干维尔岛基埃塔区的中部山区和东南海岸。与动词居中的泛太平洋诸语不同，该语系语言动词居句末，并含有原始泛太平洋语来源的借词；较早的分类方案曾把它归入拟议中的东巴布亚语群。

en: The Na-dené languages are a family of Native North American tongues grouped into two branches: Tlingit on the coast and islands of southeast Alaska, and Eyak-Athabaskan, which comprises Eyak of Alaska's south-central coast and the widespread Athabaskan, or Dene, languages. Athabaskan speech runs from Alaska and the Yukon through the interior of western Canada to Oregon and northern California, with a separate southern cluster, Apachean, made up of Navajo and the Apache languages in the American Southwest. These languages are built around highly complex verbs woven from many prefixes, and several use tone to distinguish words. They were long carried only by oral tradition: the first Tlingit words were recorded by a French expedition in 1786, and Russian Orthodox missionaries later gave Tlingit a Cyrillic alphabet and printed religious works in it.
zh: 纳‑德内语是北美原住民的一个语系，分为两支：一支是通行于阿拉斯加东南部海岸与岛屿的特林吉特语，另一支是埃雅克－阿萨巴斯卡语支，包括阿拉斯加中南部海岸的埃雅克语和分布极广的阿萨巴斯卡诸语言，又称德内诸语言。阿萨巴斯卡语从阿拉斯加、育空沿加拿大西部内陆一直延伸到俄勒冈和加利福尼亚北部，另有一支南方的阿帕切语群，即美国西南部的纳瓦霍语和各阿帕奇语。这些语言的核心是由大量前缀缀合而成的复杂动词，其中几种还靠声调区别词义。它们长期只靠口耳相传：1786年一支法国考察队首次记下特林吉特语的词汇，后来俄罗斯东正教传教士又为特林吉特语制定了西里尔字母表，并用它刊印宗教书籍。

en: Nahuatl is the principal language of the Nahuan branch of the Uto-Aztecan family, spoken in central Mexico since at least the seventh century. It was the tongue of the Mexica, the people of the Aztec Empire, and as their power spread the variety of Tenochtitlan became a prestige language across Mesoamerica, recorded in pictorial codices and, by the last pre-conquest generations, experimental syllabic signs. After the fall of Tenochtitlan in 1521, Spanish missionaries gave Nahuatl a Latin alphabet, and the Tenochtitlan-based literary norm known as Classical Nahuatl produced grammars, chronicles, poetry and administrative records. Andrés de Olmos wrote its first printed grammar, while Bernardino de Sahagún compiled the encyclopedic Florentine Codex with Nahua scribes. In 1570 Philip II decreed Nahuatl the official language of the colonies of New Spain, and the Jesuit Horacio Carochi published a detailed grammar in 1645. Words such as chocolate, tomato and coyote passed from it into Spanish and many other languages.
zh: 纳瓦特尔语属犹他-阿兹特克语系纳瓦语支，至迟在7世纪已通行于墨西哥中部，是墨西加人即阿兹特克人的语言。随着阿兹特克势力扩张，特诺奇蒂特兰方言成为中部美洲具有威望的通用语，以图画手抄本记录，征服前夕还出现了表音符号的尝试。1521年特诺奇蒂特兰陷落后，西班牙传教士为它引入拉丁字母；以特诺奇蒂特兰方言为基础的古典纳瓦特尔语留下了语法书、编年史、诗歌和行政文书。安德烈斯·德·奥尔莫斯写出第一部印行的语法，贝尔纳迪诺·德·萨阿贡则与纳瓦抄写员合作编成百科式的《佛罗伦萨手抄本》。1570年，腓力二世下诏将纳瓦特尔语定为新西班牙殖民地的官方语言；1645年，耶稣会士奥拉西奥·卡罗奇出版了精细的语法著作。巧克力、番茄、郊狼等词便经由它进入西班牙语和许多其他语言。

en: Nakanamanga, also called North Efate or Nguna, is an Oceanic language of northern Efate, the island on which Vanuatu's capital Port Vila stands, and of the smaller islands off its coast, including Nguna and parts of Tongoa, Emae and Epi. Its varieties, among them Nguna, Sesake, Emau and Buninga, are counted as subdialects of one language. The waters and islets of northern Efate were the heartland of the Roi Mata, a chiefly title borne by a dynasty of rulers from the eleventh to the seventeenth century; the last Roi Mata, who lived around 1600, was buried with his retinue on Eretoka island, a site long held sacred. James Cook reached Efate in 1774 aboard HMS Resolution and named it Sandwich Island, after which the area was drawn into British and French rivalry over the New Hebrides.
zh: 纳卡纳芒阿语又称北埃法特语或恩古纳语，是一种大洋洲语，通行于埃法特岛北部——瓦努阿图首都维拉港所在的岛屿——以及其外海的恩古纳岛，并延伸到汤戈阿岛、埃马埃岛和埃皮岛的部分地区。恩古纳、塞萨凯、埃马乌、布宁加等变体都被视为它的次方言。埃法特北部的海域和小岛是洛伊·玛塔酋长的核心领地：从11世纪到17世纪，一个酋长王朝世代承袭洛伊·玛塔头衔；最后一位洛伊·玛塔约生活在1600年，死后与随从一起葬在埃雷托卡岛，该遗址一直被视为圣地。1774年，詹姆斯·库克乘“决心号”抵达埃法特岛，将其命名为桑威奇岛，此后这一地区被卷入英法在新赫布里底的争夺。

en: Nambikwara is the chief language of the small Nambikwaran family, spoken by the nomadic Nambikwara peoples of the Mato Grosso and Rondônia interior of western Brazil, where savanna meets rainforest. The family falls into Sabanê, Northern Nambikwara, also called Mamaindê, and Southern Nambikwara, the dialect cluster usually meant by the name alone, whose varieties differ enough not to be mutually intelligible. Europeans heard of the people as early as 1671, but sustained contact began only in 1770, when Portuguese gold-seekers cut a road through their lands between Forte Bragança and Vila Bela, and the language long remained unwritten. Nambikwara is tonal, distinguishing three tones, and its verbs carry suffixes for person, number, aspect and tense combined with evidentiality, while nouns can be incorporated into the verb.
zh: 楠比夸拉语是小型的楠比夸拉语系中最主要的语言，由巴西西部马托格罗索与朗多尼亚内陆、稀树草原与雨林交接地带的游牧楠比夸拉诸族使用。该语系分为萨巴内语、北楠比夸拉语（又称马曼德语）和南楠比夸拉语三支；单称楠比夸拉语时，通常指后者的方言群，其各方言差异之大，已不能互通。欧洲人早在1671年的一份报告中便提到这个族群，但持续接触迟至1770年才开始：寻找黄金的葡萄牙人开辟了穿越其土地、连接布拉干萨堡与维拉贝拉的道路，而这种语言长期没有文字。楠比夸拉语是声调语言，区分三个声调；动词带有人称、数、体以及时制与言据性相结合的后缀，名词还可并入动词。

en: Nanai, called Gold or Goldi in older Russian accounts and Hezhen in China, is the southern Tungusic tongue of the fishing peoples of the middle and lower Amur, the Sungari and the Ussuri; its close varieties include the speech of the Hurka and Ulch groups, and its speakers trace their descent to the Wild Jurchens of outer Manchuria. The self-name Nanai means people of the land, while Hezhen, the name adopted in Chinese, began as the self-designation of the lower-Amur bands. Early in the seventeenth century these Amur peoples resisted Nurhaci under their Hurka leaders but surrendered to Hong Taiji in 1631, after which the Qing imposed the shaved forehead and queue and Manchu words and customs spread among them, with Qing writers classing them among the Solon. French Jesuit surveyors descending the Amur in 1709 found villagers clothed in cured fish skins and called them the Fish-skin Tartars, for their economy turned entirely on salmon and sturgeon. Nanai is agglutinative with subject-object-verb order and many dialects strung along the rivers, and like other Amur languages it had no script of its own in this period, being written in a Cyrillic alphabet only in later times.
zh: 赫哲语在俄罗斯旧记中又称戈尔德语，俄国境内通称那乃语，是满‑通古斯语族南支的语言，通行于阿穆尔河中下游、松花江和乌苏里江一带的渔猎民族中，呼尔哈、乌尔奇等部的土语都与它相近；操这种语言的人群祖居外满洲，源自野人女真。“那乃”这一自称意为本地人，汉语采用的“赫哲”则原是阿穆尔河下游部落的自称。17世纪初，阿穆尔河诸部曾在呼尔哈首领率领下抵抗努尔哈赤，1631年归降皇太极；此后清朝强令剃发留辫，满语词汇和满族习俗随之深入，清代文献把他们归入索伦诸部。1709年，沿阿穆尔河下行的法国耶稣会测绘人员见到以鞣制鱼皮为衣的村民，称之为鱼皮鞑子，因为他们的生计完全围绕鲑鱼和鲟鱼的渔获展开。赫哲语是黏着语，语序为主宾动，沿江分布着多种方言；和阿穆尔河流域的其他语言一样，它在本时期没有本族文字，后来才以西里尔字母书写。

en: The Napuruna, or Quijos of the Napo basin between Ecuador and Peru, once spoke a language remembered as Shillipanu and known only as guttural, bird-imitating speech. Never written down, it was displaced by Quechua spread through Inca trade and Jesuit missions, leaving only traces in later Napo Kichwa; the Quijos revolt of 1578 ended in defeat and mission resettlement.
zh: 纳普鲁纳人即厄瓜多尔与秘鲁边境纳波河流域的基霍斯人，曾有自己的语言，名为希利帕努语，后人只知道它是模仿鸟兽之声的浑厚喉音。它没有文字记录，随着克丘亚语借印加贸易和耶稣会传教扩散而被取代，仅在后来的纳波基奇瓦语中留下少许痕迹；1578年的起义失败后，基霍斯人被重新安置到传教村落。

en: Natchez is the language, usually treated as an isolate, of the Natchez chiefdom of the lower Mississippi valley, whose ancestors were the mound-building Plaquemine culture, the southernmost heir of the Mississippian world. Some linguists posit a distant link to the Muskogean family, but no wider relationship, including the proposed Gulf grouping with Tunica and Chitimacha, has won acceptance. Its grammar used active-stative alignment and subject-object-verb order, and storytellers kept a special cannibal-speech register for oral tales. Closest to it were the Taensa and Avoyel, fellow Plaquemine descendants, while the Yazoo, Koroa and Tiou were neighbours whose speech is barely recorded. French colonists under La Salle met these peoples from 1682, and Antoine-Simon Le Page du Pratz wrote down Natchez words in the early 1700s; after the Natchez revolt of 1729 and the French destruction of the chiefdom in the 1730s, surviving speakers took refuge among the Chickasaw, Creek and Cherokee.
zh: 纳奇兹语通常被视为孤立语言，是密西西比河下游纳奇兹酋邦的语言；纳奇兹人的祖先属于建造土丘的普拉克明文化，是密西西比文化世界最南端的继承者。少数学者推测它与穆斯科格语系有远亲关系，但包括把它与图尼卡语、奇蒂马查语同归海湾语系在内的更广泛亲缘说都未获公认。其语法采用主动—静态配列和主宾谓语序，讲述口头故事的人还保留一种专门的食人者话语。与它最接近的是同出普拉克明文化的塔恩萨语和阿沃耶尔语，而亚祖语、科罗阿语和蒂乌语等邻族的语言几乎没有留下记录。1682年拉萨尔率领的法国殖民者首次接触这些民族，安托万·西蒙·勒帕热·迪普拉在18世纪初记下了纳奇兹语词汇；1729年纳奇兹人起事，18世纪30年代法国人摧毁其酋邦，幸存的使用者投奔奇克索人、克里克人和切罗基人。

en: Natugu, formerly called Santa Cruz after its island, is the main Oceanic language of Nendö, the largest of the Santa Cruz Islands in the southeastern Solomons, and the chief member of the Reefs–Santa Cruz group; its name means our language. It shares Nendö with two smaller neighbours, Nalögo and Nanggu, and its own dialects include Bënwë, Londai and Malo. Its numerals follow a decimal system built around two sets of five, with six to nine formed by adding a suffix to the words for one to four. The islanders were deep-ocean voyagers, sailing outrigger canoes called tepukei and navigating by wave patterns and the stars. The Spanish explorer Álvaro de Mendaña, the first European to reach them, sighted the islands in 1595, founded a short-lived colony at Graciosa Bay on Nendö, and died there in 1596.
zh: 纳图古语旧称圣克鲁斯语，得名于所在的岛屿，是圣克鲁斯群岛最大岛嫩多岛的主要语言，属南岛语系泛太平洋语族的礁岛—圣克鲁斯语支，在该语支中使用最广；它的名字意为“我们的语言”。嫩多岛上还有纳洛戈语和南古语两种较小的语言与它并存，它自己则有本韦、隆代和马洛三种方言。它的数字采用以两组五为基础的十进制，六至九由一至四加后缀构成。岛民是远洋航行的能手，驾驶名叫特普凯的舷外浮杆独木舟，凭浪形和星象导航。最早到来的欧洲人是西班牙探险家阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚，他于1595年望见群岛，在嫩多岛的格拉西奥萨湾建立了一个短命殖民地，并于1596年死在那里。

en: Ndrumbea, also spelled Dubea or Dumbea and called Naa Dubea in the language itself, is a Kanak language of the Extreme Southern New Caledonian group, spoken in the Djubéa-Kaponé area around Païta near the southwestern settlement of Nouméa. The names of Nouméa and of the neighbouring town of Dumbéa both derive from this language, whose speakers were gradually pushed out of the capital district into surrounding villages. Like its close relative Numèè, it descends from Proto-Oceanic, brought to New Caledonia by Lapita settlers around 1000 BCE. Ndrumbea is one of the few tonal languages in the Austronesian family, using pitch to distinguish words, and it also preserves a series of consonants unusual among the languages of the region.
zh: 恩德伦贝亚语又拼作杜贝亚语或敦贝亚语，自称纳阿杜贝亚语，意为杜贝阿人的语言，属新喀里多尼亚语群极南支，通行于西南部努美阿附近帕伊塔一带的朱贝亚-卡波内传统区。努美阿和邻近城镇丹贝亚的名字都来自这种语言，而其使用者逐渐被挤出首府地区，迁到周围村庄。与近亲努梅语一样，它源自拉皮塔定居者约公元前1000年带到新喀里多尼亚的原始大洋洲语。恩德伦贝亚语是南岛语系少有的声调语言，以音高区别词义，还保留了一套在当地语言中不同寻常的辅音。

en: Duke, known to its own speakers as Dughore or Kolei, is an Oceanic language of Kolombangara island in the New Georgia group of the Solomon Islands; the name Duke itself is an outsider's exonym. Oral history records that the north-west, north-east and south-east of the island once had languages of their own, but those communities were annihilated in warfare in the early 1800s and their tongues died with them; only the south-western Dughore people survived, holding out in a chain of hill fortresses. In the later nineteenth century strong inter-island exchange with Vella Lavella, Simbo and Roviana brought some borrowed vocabulary into the language. Duke keeps the characteristic Oceanic pronoun series, including dual and trial forms, and marks inalienable possession of body parts and kin with possessive suffixes.
zh: 恩杜克语是所罗门群岛新乔治亚群岛科隆班加拉岛上的一种泛太平洋语系语言，使用者自称杜戈雷语或科莱语，恩杜克本身是外人使用的他称。口述史传，岛上的西北、东北和东南曾各有本土语言，但那些社群在19世纪初的战争中被消灭，语言也随之消亡，只有西南的杜戈雷人凭借一连串山寨堡垒幸存。19世纪后期，与维拉拉维拉岛、辛博岛和罗维阿纳地区的密切岛际往来给恩杜克语带来了一些外来词汇。它保留着泛太平洋语言典型的代词系列，包括双数和三数形式，并以领属后缀标记身体部位、亲属等不可让渡的领属关系。

en: Nehan, also called Nissan or Nihan, is an Oceanic Austronesian language of the Green Islands, a small atoll group lying between New Britain and Bougainville in Papua New Guinea. It is spoken on Nissan and Pinipel, where it divides into the Uanuleik and Sirouatan dialects of Nissan and the Pinipel dialect, and gives its name to the Nehan–North Bougainville linkage, the branch of the Northwest Solomonic family that also covers the Tinputz, Buka, Bannoni and Mono tongues, all grouped under Nehan here. Archaeological finds show that the islanders long kept up a pre-colonial trade with Buka, exchanging pigs, pottery and shell money. British and American whaling vessels began calling at the Green Islands for provisions in 1837, the first on record being the Addison.
zh: 内汉语又名尼桑语或尼汉语，是绿岛群岛的一种泛太平洋语族南岛语；该群岛是巴布亚新几内亚新不列颠岛与布干维尔岛之间的小型环礁群。它通行于尼桑岛和皮尼佩尔岛，在尼桑岛上分为乌阿努莱克和西鲁阿坦两种方言，皮尼佩尔岛另有皮尼佩尔方言。内汉语还为内汉—北布干维尔语链命名，这条西北所罗门语系的分支同时涵盖廷普茨语、布卡语、巴诺尼语和莫诺语，游戏把这些语言都归在内汉语之下。考古发现表明，岛民很早便与布卡岛保持前殖民时期贸易，交换猪、陶器和贝币。1837年起，英美捕鲸船开始到绿岛群岛补给，有记载的第一艘是艾迪生号。

en: Nenets is the northernmost language of the Uralic family, belonging to its Samoyedic branch and split into two markedly different forms, Tundra Nenets and Forest Nenets. Its speakers, formerly known to Russians as Samoyeds or Yuraks, moved from southern Siberia to the Arctic coast before the twelfth century and came to occupy the tundra from the Kanin Peninsula to the Yenisei River, living by hunting and reindeer herding. Russian fur traders reached them from the White Sea in the sixteenth century, and in 1601 the trading town of Mangazeya was founded on the Taz River as a base for collecting tribute and pushing farther into the Siberian north. After the sea route was closed in 1619 the town declined and was abandoned in the 1670s, partly after Nenets attacks on its tax collectors. Large-scale reindeer herding, the economy that came to define tundra life, spread among the Nenets during the eighteenth century, while the language itself absorbed loans from Komi, Khanty and Russian.
zh: 涅涅茨语是乌拉尔语族分布最靠北的语言，属于萨莫耶德语支，分为差异很大的冻原涅涅茨语和森林涅涅茨语两种。使用者曾被俄罗斯人称作萨莫耶德人或尤拉克人，他们在12世纪以前从南西伯利亚迁至北冰洋沿岸，占据了从卡宁半岛到叶尼塞河的冻原地带，以狩猎和驯鹿放牧为生。16世纪，俄罗斯毛皮商人从白海方向来到他们中间；1601年，塔兹河畔建起贸易城镇曼加泽亚，作为征收贡赋并向西伯利亚北部推进的基地。1619年海上航路被封禁后，该城走向衰落，17世纪70年代终被废弃，部分原因是涅涅茨人袭击了当地的税吏。18世纪，大规模驯鹿放牧在涅涅茨人中普及，成为冻原生活的标志；与此同时，涅涅茨语也吸收了科米语、汉特语和俄语的借词。

en: Nengone is a Kanak language of the Loyalty Islands subgroup, spoken on Maré Island and the smaller neighbouring island of Tiga in present-day New Caledonia. The word nengone itself refers both to Maré and to the language spoken there, and is popularly connected with a native word meaning to ask or to question.
zh: 嫩贡语是洛亚蒂群岛分支的卡纳克语言，通行于今新喀里多尼亚的马雷岛和邻近较小的提加岛。嫩贡一词既指马雷岛，也指岛上所说的语言，民间词源把它和当地意为询问、提问的词联系起来。

en: Nepali is the principal Eastern Pahari language of the Northern Indo-Aryan zone, originally the speech of the Khas people and known in its early form as Khas Kura. It grew from the Middle Indo-Aryan Prakrits and Apabhramsha vernaculars of the western Himalayas, taking in words and sounds from the surrounding Tibeto-Burman languages. Its home was the Sinja valley, heartland of the Khasa Kingdom that flourished between the tenth and fourteenth centuries, and the earliest known Nepali inscription, at Dullu in Dailekh, dates to about 981. After the Khasa realm broke up it lived on in the hill principalities and was carried eastward by Khas migrants into the Gandaki basin. Its rise began in the sixteenth century under the Kingdom of Gorkha, and when Prithvi Narayan Shah unified the hill states into the Kingdom of Nepal in the later eighteenth century, Gorkha speech, as Nepali was then called, became the language of court and administration and a common tongue between the country's many peoples. It is written in the Devanagari script.
zh: 尼泊尔语是北印度—雅利安语区东帕哈里组最主要的语言，最初是卡斯人的语言，早期形式称“卡斯库拉”。它由喜马拉雅西部的中期印度—雅利安俗语和阿帕布拉姆沙口语发展而来，并从周边的藏缅语言中吸收了词汇和语音特点。其故乡是辛贾谷地，即10至14世纪兴盛的卡萨王国的核心地带；已知最早的尼泊尔语铭文刻于代莱赫的杜卢，年代约在981年。卡萨王国瓦解后，这种语言在各山地土邦中延续，又随卡斯人移民东传至甘达基盆地。16世纪，廓尔喀王国兴起，尼泊尔语开始走向制度化；18世纪后期，普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿统一各山地土邦、建立尼泊尔王国，当时被称作廓尔喀话的尼泊尔语随之成为宫廷和行政语言，也是国内众多民族之间的通用语。它使用天城文书写。

en: Nicobarese is a group of about half a dozen closely related Austroasiatic languages spoken across the Nicobar Islands, a chain in the eastern Indian Ocean northwest of Sumatra. The most widely used of them is Car; the others include Chaura, Teressa, Nancowry, Camorta, Katchal and Southern Nicobarese, while the Shompen of Great Nicobar's interior speak a closely related lect. The islands were known to maritime peoples early: the name Nakkavaram appears on a Tamil Chola inscription of 1050, the Persian navigator Abu Zayd al-Sirafi described them in the ninth century, and both Marco Polo's account and Zheng He's charts mark them. Organized European contact began when the Danish East India Company claimed the islands in 1754 and administered them from Tranquebar as the Frederiksøerne, but malaria wrecked the Moravian mission on Nancowry and forced repeated abandonments between 1784 and 1834, so the islanders and their languages were only lightly touched by outside rule in this period.
zh: 尼科巴语是一组约六种关系密切的南亚语系语言，通行于印度洋东部、苏门答腊西北方的尼科巴群岛。其中使用最广的是卡尔语，其余还有乔拉语、特雷萨语、南科里语、卡莫尔塔语、格恰尔语和南尼科巴语，大尼科巴岛内陆肖姆彭人的语言则是与它们相近的一支。群岛很早就为航海民族所知：1050年的泰米尔朱罗铭文已出现“纳卡瓦拉姆”之名，9世纪波斯航海家阿布·扎伊德·西拉菲曾记述这些岛屿，马可·波罗的游记和郑和的海图也都标注过它们。有组织的欧洲接触始于1754年，丹麦东印度公司宣布占有群岛，以特兰奎巴为管辖地，称其为弗雷德里克群岛；但疟疾摧毁了南科里岛上的摩拉维亚传教站，并迫使丹麦人在1784至1834年间数次放弃，因此在这一时期，岛民及其语言受到外来统治的影响还很有限。

en:
Nigerian covers the Volta-Niger branch of Niger-Congo, once classed as the East Kwa languages: Yoruba and Igala of the Yoruboid group, Edo, Igbo, the Nupoid speech of Nupe and Gbari, and Idoma, all tonal tongues of southern Nigeria. Its oldest urban centre was Ile-Ife, a Yoruba city-state by the fifth century BCE whose Ife Empire flourished from 1200 to about 1420 and produced naturalistic brass and terracotta sculpture. In the fifteenth century the warlike Oyo Empire, ruled by the Alaafin from Oyo-Ile, displaced Ife as the leading Yoruba power and made Dahomey its tributary; under Fulani pressure and civil war Oyo collapsed after 1800, and Egba refugees founded Abeokuta in 1830.

Benin's Edo speakers traced their state to the Ogiso kings of Igodomigodo around 900 and to the Ife prince Oranmiyan, who introduced the title Oba; Oba Ewuare, from 1440, enlarged the kingdom and fortified its capital Edo, the Portuguese arrived in 1485, and Oba Esigie repelled an Igala invasion early in the next century while royal casters made the Benin Bronzes. The Igbo lived in republican village assemblies under the priest-kings of Nri, and Igbo-Ukwu has yielded ninth-century bronzes; the Aro Confederacy of Arochukwu later sold Igbo captives to the ships of the Bight of Biafra. On the Niger and Kaduna rivers the Nupe kingdom arose in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries under Tsoede, titled Etsu; its ruler adopted Islam about 1770, and the Sokoto jihad overran it in the 1800s, installing a Fulani dynasty at Bida.
zh:
尼日利亚语涵盖尼日尔—刚果语系的沃尔特—尼日尔语支，旧称东克瓦语，包括约鲁巴语组的约鲁巴语和伊加拉语、埃多语、伊博语、努佩人和格巴里人所讲的努佩语组语言，以及伊多马语，都是通行于尼日利亚南部的声调语言。最古老的城市中心是约鲁巴人的城邦伊莱伊费，早在公元前5世纪已经立国，其伊费帝国在1200年至约1420年间盛极一时，留下了写实风格的黄铜和赤陶雕塑。15世纪，尚武的奥约帝国在阿拉芬统治下以奥约伊莱为都，取代伊费成为约鲁巴首强，并使达荷美称臣；1800年后，在富拉尼人的压力和内战中奥约崩溃，埃加难民于1830年另建阿贝奥库塔。

贝宁讲埃多语的居民把国家源流追溯到约900年伊戈多米戈多的奥吉索诸王，以及引入“奥巴”王号的伊费王子奥兰米扬；1440年即位的奥巴埃瓦雷扩张疆土、设防首都埃多，葡萄牙人于1485年抵达，奥巴埃西吉在16世纪初击退伊加拉人的入侵，宫廷匠师则制作了贝宁青铜器。伊博人以共和式的村落议事会自治，精神上奉恩里的祭司王为权威，伊博乌库还出土了9世纪的青铜器；后来阿罗丘库的阿罗联盟向比亚法拉湾的贩奴船供应伊博俘虏。尼日尔河与卡杜纳河之间的努佩王国于14至15世纪在措埃德治下兴起，他采用埃楚的王号；约1770年努佩统治者改宗伊斯兰教，19世纪初索科托圣战席卷该国，在比达立起富拉尼王朝。

en: Nimboran is a small independent family of Papuan languages spoken west of Lake Sentani, in the Grime and Nawa river country of Jayapura Regency on New Guinea's north coast. Its members include Namblong, also called Nimboran, Mekwei, Kemtuik and Gresi; their reconstructed pronouns set them apart from the neighbouring Trans–New Guinea families.
zh: 宁博兰语是巴布亚诸语言中一个独立的小语族，通行于新几内亚北海岸查亚普拉县、森塔尼湖以西的格里姆河与纳瓦河流域。成员包括又称宁博兰语的南布隆语、梅奎语、肯图伊克语和格雷西语——格雷西语即这一文化所使用的语言；其构拟代词与周边的跨新几内亚语系语言明显不同。

en: Nimoa, also called Rifao, is an Oceanic Austronesian language spoken on Nimoa and neighbouring islands of the Louisiade Archipelago off the eastern tip of New Guinea, in Milne Bay Province of Papua New Guinea. With Sudest, the language of nearby Tagula or Vanatinai Island, it forms the Nimoa–Sudest family of the Kilivila–Misima linkage within the Papuan Tip branch, which groups about sixty Western Oceanic languages; the Tagula people of Vanatinai speak Sudest, the other member of this same small family. Most Papuan Tip languages have adopted the verb-final word order of their Papuan neighbours, but Nimoa, Sudest and the Kilivila island languages keep the older subject–verb–object order typical of Austronesian. The Spanish expedition of Luís Vaez de Torres first sighted Tagula and its neighbours on 14 July 1606, charting them as Tierra de San Buenaventura.
zh: 尼莫阿语又名里福语，是一种泛太平洋语族南岛语，通行于巴布亚新几内亚米尔恩湾省、新几内亚东端外海路易西亚德群岛的尼莫阿岛及邻近岛屿。它与邻近塔古拉岛（又称瓦纳蒂奈岛）的苏代斯特语共同组成尼莫阿—苏代斯特语族，隶属巴布亚尖端语支下的基利维拉—米西马语链；该语支包含约六十种语言，塔古拉人说的苏代斯特语正是这个小语族的另一名成员。多数巴布亚尖端语言受邻近巴布亚语影响改用动词居末的语序，但尼莫阿语、苏代斯特语和基利维拉诸岛语保留了南岛语典型的主语—动词—宾语旧语序。1606年7月14日，路易斯·巴埃斯·德·托雷斯的西班牙探险队首次望见塔古拉岛及邻近岛屿，将它们绘入地图并命名为圣博纳文图拉之地。

en: Nisa is a Papuan language of the eastern shore of Cenderawasih Bay, once called Geelvink Bay, in the Indonesian province of Papua; Nisa and Anasi are its two dialects. It belongs to the East Geelvink Bay family of about a dozen tongues, whose best-known member is Bauzi, a language of the inland villages reported to make use of whistled speech.
zh: 尼萨语是印度尼西亚巴布亚省极乐鸟湾东岸的一种巴布亚语言，尼萨和阿纳西是它的两种方言。它属于约含十二种语言的东极乐鸟湾语族，其中最知名的是鲍齐语，通行于内陆村落，据记载还使用口哨传话的方式。

en: Nivkh, long called Gilyak in Russian sources, is the language of the Nivkh fishermen and hunters of the lower Amur, the Amgun basin and the northern half of Sakhalin, and stands as a language isolate, or the small Amuric family on its own. Its varieties form a dialect continuum split among the Amur and the Sakhalin coasts whose extremes are not mutually intelligible, and no link to any other family has been demonstrated; words resembling Ainu, Tungusic or Korean are treated as borrowings from long contact rather than evidence of kinship. The Nivkh have lived on the river and the island for thousands of years, trading with Ainu, Japanese and Chinese neighbors until Russians first reached the Amur country in the 1600s. The language is agglutinating with subject-object-verb order, uses attributive verbs in place of adjectives, and is marked by consonant lenition, where the final sound of one word changes the opening consonant of the next. It had no script of its own and was carried by oral tradition, only later being committed to paper in a modified Cyrillic alphabet.
zh: 尼夫赫语在俄罗斯旧文献中长期被称为吉利亚克语，是黑龙江下游、阿姆贡河流域和萨哈林岛北部以渔猎为生的尼夫赫人的语言，属于语言孤岛，本身即独立的阿穆尔语系。它的各方言构成一条连续体，分布在阿穆尔河沿岸与萨哈林沿海，两端彼此不能互通；它与任何语系都未能证明亲缘关系，那些与阿伊努语、满—通古斯语或朝鲜语相似的词，都被视为长期接触产生的借词，而非同源证据。尼夫赫人在河畔和岛上已生活数千年，与邻近的阿伊努人、日本人和中国人贸易往来，直到17世纪俄罗斯人首次进入阿穆尔河流域。尼夫赫语是黏着语，语序为主宾动，没有形容词而以定语性动词替代，并有显著的辅音弱化现象：前一个词的尾音会改变后一个词的首辅音。它没有本族文字，靠口传延续，后来才以改良的西里尔字母记录下来。

en: North Dravidian is the northernmost branch of the Dravidian family and consists of three languages: Brahui, Kurukh and Malto. Brahui is spoken in the highlands of Balochistan, around Kalat and Quetta, more than fifteen hundred kilometres from the nearest other Dravidian speech, and is commonly regarded as a relic of a Dravidian presence that once stretched across north-western South Asia before the spread of Indo-Aryan languages, its speakers perhaps holding the region since the second millennium BC. Much of its vocabulary comes from Balochi, an Iranian language that reached the area only around the year 1000, and Brahui is written in the Arabic script. Kurukh, the language of the Oraon, and its closest relative Malto are spoken far to the east, on the Chota Nagpur Plateau and adjoining parts of Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Odisha and West Bengal, Kurukh being written in Devanagari. All three keep a Dravidian grammar beneath large Indo-Aryan and Iranian vocabularies.
zh: 北达罗毗荼语是达罗毗荼语族最靠北的一支，由布拉灰语、库鲁克语和马尔托语三种语言组成。布拉灰语通行于今巴基斯坦俾路支斯坦的卡拉特、奎达一带高原，与最近的其他达罗毗荼语相隔逾一千五百公里，被视为达罗毗荼语曾遍布南亚西北部、后因印度—雅利安语扩张而退缩的遗存，其使用者可能自公元前两千纪起便留居此地。它的大量词汇来自伊朗语俾路支语——后者约于1000年前后才进入这一地区；布拉灰语采用阿拉伯字母书写。库鲁克语是奥拉昂人的语言，与亲缘最近的马尔托语一起通行于东方的焦达讷格布尔高原，以及今贾坎德、恰蒂斯加尔、奥里萨、西孟加拉等邦毗邻地带，库鲁克语以天城体书写。三种语言都在大量印度—雅利安语和伊朗语词汇之下，保持着达罗毗荼式的语法。

en: North Ethiopic groups the two living North Ethio-Semitic tongues of the old Aksumite world: Tigrinya, spoken in the highlands of Tigray and Eritrea, and Tigre, spoken across the western Eritrean lowlands, the Red Sea coast north of Zula and the adjoining parts of Sudan. Both are close kin of Ge'ez, which remained the language of writing and worship while Tigre and an early form of Tigrinya served as everyday speech and long went unwritten; Tigre may have been the main vernacular of the port of Adulis, and the sixth-century traveller Cosmas Indicopleustes already mentions a people called the Tigrētai. One of the earliest attestations of Tigre is a fourteenth-century Arabic and Ethiopian word list compiled for the Rasulid ruler of Yemen. The two languages are distinct despite their similar names: Tigrinya, written in the Ge'ez fidal script, has been the tongue of Orthodox Christian highland communities under the Ethiopian crown and the Eritrean lordship of Medri Bahri, whereas Tigre splits into many dialects, among them the Dahalik of the Dahlak islands, and its Muslim speakers commonly used Arabic as their lingua franca. The wars of the Adal sultanate and the Ottoman seizure of Massawa in 1557 bound the coastal Tigre country to the Red Sea Islamic world, while the Tigrinya highlands stayed within the Christian Ethiopian orbit.
zh: 北埃塞俄比亚语概括了古老阿克苏姆世界的两门现存北埃塞俄比亚闪米特语言：通行于提格雷和厄立特里亚高原的提格里尼亚语，以及通行于厄立特里亚西部低地、祖拉以北红海沿岸和苏丹邻近地区的提格雷语。二者都是格尔兹语的近亲；格尔兹语始终是书写和礼拜用语，提格雷语和早期提格里尼亚语则作为日常口语，长期没有文字。提格雷语可能曾是阿杜利斯港的主要土语，6世纪的旅行家科斯马斯·因迪科普卢斯特斯已经提到过一个叫提格雷泰的民族。提格雷语最早的记录之一，是14世纪为也门拉苏里王朝统治者编纂的一份阿拉伯语—埃塞俄比亚诸语词汇表。两门语言名字相近却截然不同：提格里尼亚语用格尔兹斐德尔字母书写，一直是埃塞俄比亚王权治下和厄立特里亚梅德里巴赫里领地内东正教高原社群的语言；提格雷语则分成许多方言，其中包括达赫拉克群岛上的达哈里克语，其穆斯林使用者通常以阿拉伯语为通用语。阿达尔苏丹国的战争，以及奥斯曼帝国于1557年夺取马萨瓦，使沿海的提格雷地区并入红海伊斯兰世界，而说提格里尼亚语的高原仍留在基督教埃塞俄比亚的势力范围内。

en: The Gallo-Italic languages are the Romance vernaculars of northern Italy, Piedmontese, Lombard, Emilian, Romagnol and Ligurian among them, with Venetian often added to the group; they also reach southern Switzerland, the French Riviera and the microstates of Monaco and San Marino. They descend from the Vulgar Latin of Cisalpine Gaul, resting on a Celtic substrate and carrying a Germanic Lombardic superstrate left by the Lombard invasions of the sixth century, and Gallo-Italic colonies planted after the Norman conquest of Sicily around 1100 survive as language islands in Sicily and Basilicata. The vernaculars long served local administration, but from the fifteenth century literary Tuscan, championed by humanists such as Pietro Bembo, displaced them from writing, a trend encouraged at the Sforza court of Ludovico il Moro in Milan. Local literature nonetheless endured: Carlo Maria Maggi standardized Milanese spelling in the seventeenth century and created the stage mask Meneghino, Carlo Porta carried Lombard poetry to its height before his death in 1821, and in Venice Ruzante, Goldoni and Gozzi made Venetian the voice of celebrated comedy while the republic made it a Mediterranean lingua franca.
zh: 高卢—意大利语是意大利北部的罗曼语族地方语言，包括皮埃蒙特语、伦巴第语、艾米利亚语、罗马涅语和利古里亚语，威尼斯语也常被划入这一群；它们还传到瑞士南部、法国里维埃拉以及摩纳哥、圣马力诺两个小国。这些语言源自山南高卢的通俗拉丁语，底层是凯尔特语，又带有6世纪伦巴第人入侵留下的日耳曼伦巴第语上层成分；1100年前后诺曼人征服西西里后迁入的高卢—意大利语移民，在西西里和巴西利卡塔形成语言岛并长期存续。这些地方语言长期用于当地行政，但从15世纪起，彼得罗·本博等人文主义者推崇的托斯卡纳文学语把它们逐出书面领域，米兰卢多维科·斯福尔扎的宫廷也推动了这一趋势。尽管如此，地方文学仍然延续：17世纪卡洛·玛丽亚·马吉规范了米兰方言的拼写并创造了舞台面具梅内金，卡洛·波尔塔在1821年去世前把伦巴第诗歌推向高峰；在威尼斯，鲁赞特、哥尔多尼和戈齐让威尼斯语成为著名喜剧的声音，威尼斯共和国也使它成为地中海的通用语。

en: The Nubian languages belong to the Northern Eastern Sudanic branch of the Nilo-Saharan family and are the ancient speech of the middle Nile, spoken in southern Egypt and northern Sudan and carried into the Nuba Mountains and Darfur by Hill Nubian and Midob communities. After the conversion of the Nubian kingdoms in the sixth century, Old Nubian became a literary language written in a Coptic-based alphabet; manuscripts and inscriptions from the eighth to the fifteenth centuries survive from the Christian kingdoms of Nobatia, Makuria and Alodia. The Arab conquest of Egypt in 641 opened a long frontier, regulated for centuries by the Baqt treaty, and after the Christian kingdoms collapsed the Funj made Soba the seat of their sultanate in 1504, under whose rule Arabic and Islam steadily advanced. When Egyptian armies conquered the Funj realm in 1821, Nubian was already retreating up the Nile: by the nineteenth century it was largely confined north of Korti, though Hill Nubian speech still held scattered villages in Kordofan and the Nuba Hills.
zh: 努比亚语属于尼罗—撒哈拉语系北东苏丹语支，是尼罗河中游的古老语言，通行于埃及南部和苏丹北部，并由山地努比亚人和米多布人带到努巴山区与达尔富尔。6世纪努比亚诸王国皈依基督教后，古努比亚语成为用科普特字母变体书写的文学语言，8世纪至15世纪的手抄本和铭文留存于诺巴提亚、穆库拉和阿洛迪亚三个基督教王国。641年阿拉伯人征服埃及，开启了漫长的边境，双方靠《巴克特》条约维系数百年；基督教王国崩溃后，丰吉人于1504年以索巴为都建立苏丹国，阿拉伯语和伊斯兰教在其治下持续推进。1821年埃及军队攻灭丰吉政权时，努比亚语已沿尼罗河节节后退：到19世纪，它大体只保存在科尔提以北，但山地努比亚语仍守在科尔多凡和努巴山区的零散村落里。

en: Numèè, also called Kwényi or Kapone, is a Kanak language of the Extreme Southern New Caledonian group, spoken at the southern tip of Grande Terre around Yaté and Mont-Dore and on the offshore Isle of Pines, in the Djubéa-Kaponé customary area. Its speakers, like all Kanaks, descend from Lapita communities that brought Proto-Oceanic to New Caledonia after 1000 BCE. Numèè forms a close pair with Ndrumbea, the language of the Nouméa region. Although Numèè has been called the language of Nouméa, the capital's name most likely comes from Ndrumbea, once spoken on the site of the city.
zh: 努梅语又称克维尼语或卡波内语，属新喀里多尼亚语群极南支，通行于格朗德特尔岛南端的亚泰、蒙多尔以及近海的松树岛，属朱贝亚-卡波内传统区。与全体卡纳克人一样，其使用者是公元前1000年后把原始大洋洲语带到新喀里多尼亚的拉皮塔社群的后裔。努梅语与努美阿地区的恩德伦贝亚语是一对近亲。尽管努梅语曾被称作努美阿之语，但首府努美阿的名字更可能来自曾通行于城址之上的恩德伦贝亚语。

en: Nuuchi-Nuwuwi is the Southern Numic group of the Uto-Aztecan family, carrying the related speech of the Ute, Southern Paiute, Chemehuevi and Kawaiisu across the Great Basin and the Colorado River country, from southeastern California into Colorado. Its main body is the Colorado River Numic dialect chain: Ute, whose speakers call their tongue núuchi, meaning 'of the people'; Southern Paiute; and Chemehuevi, who call themselves Nüwüvi, 'the people'. Kawaiisu, spoken around the Tehachapi Mountains, is a separate close relative. Like the other Numic languages it descends from Proto-Numic, whose homeland linguists place in the southern Sierra Nevada about two thousand years ago; a slow Numic expansion then carried these dialects eastward through the deserts, giving them their historic range by around 1000. Its speakers lived by hunting and gathering in small mobile bands, moving between mountains, river valleys and arid basins.
zh: 努奇努乌语是犹他-阿兹特克语系的南努米克语支，承载着犹特人、南派尤特人、切梅惠维人和卡瓦伊苏人彼此相近的语言，通行于大盆地和科罗拉多河流域，分布从加利福尼亚东南部一直延伸到科罗拉多。它的主体是科罗拉多河努米克方言链：犹特人把自己的话称作“努奇”，意为“属于人的”；另有南派尤特方言，以及自称“努武维”、意为“人”的切梅惠维方言；特哈查比山区的卡瓦伊苏语则是与之相近的独立亲属语言。与其他努米克语言一样，它源自原始努米克语，语言学家把其原乡定在约两千年前的内华达山脉南部；此后一场缓慢的努米克扩张把这些方言向东带过沙漠，到1000年前后形成了历史上的分布范围。说这种语言的族群以狩猎采集为生，分成流动的小群体，辗转于山地、河谷与干旱盆地之间。

en: Nyamwezi, or Kinyamwezi, is a major Bantu language of west-central Tanzania, spoken across the plateau region called Unyamwezi, around the modern towns of Tabora and Singida. It forms a dialect continuum with Sukuma, its close northern neighbour, while Konongo and Ruwila are sometimes counted among its dialects. The name is Swahili, meaning people of the moon or people of the west, and covers five related groups, the Kimbu, Konongo, Nyamwezi, Sukuma and Sumbwa. Nyamwezi oral tradition places their arrival on the plateau in the 1600s, where they lived in a mosaic of small chiefdoms and turned from farming and fishing to long-distance caravan trade. By 1800 their caravans carried Katanga copper, ivory, wax and salt to the Swahili coast, and by 1825 Arab and Indian merchants had followed the trade routes inland to Unyamwezi.
zh: 尼亚姆韦齐语又称基尼亚姆韦齐语，是坦桑尼亚中西部的一门主要班图语，通行于名为乌尼亚姆韦齐的高原地区，即今塔波拉和辛吉达一带。它与北方近邻苏库马语构成方言连续体，科农戈语和鲁维拉语有时也被算作它的方言。其名称来自斯瓦希里语，意为月亮之人或西方之人，涵盖基姆布、科农戈、尼亚姆韦齐、苏库马和松布瓦五个亲缘族群。按口述传统，尼亚姆韦齐人于17世纪来到这片高原，在众多小酋邦并立的格局中务农、渔猎，进而转为从事长途商队贸易。到1800年，他们的商队已把加丹加铜、象牙、蜂蜡和盐运往斯瓦希里海岸；到1825年，阿拉伯和印度商人也沿商路深入乌尼亚姆韦齐。

en: Nyasa is the name given to the group of Bantu languages, roughly Guthrie's Zone N, spoken around Lake Nyasa, the present-day Lake Malawi, and the lower Zambezi: its chief members are Chewa, also called Nyanja, Tumbuka, the Malawian Tonga and the Sena group, including Nyungwe. Their speakers trace their roots to the Bantu pottery of Katanga dated to the 400s, and Chewa clans began settling the lake shore in the 1200s. From the early 1400s the Chewa built the Maravi Empire, whose kalonga kings ruled central and southern Malawi on tribute in ivory, and which in the 1600s, under Kalonga Muzura, stretched from the Luangwa River to the Zambezi and traded cloth and iron to the Mozambique coast. After succession disputes fragmented it in the 1700s, its languages kept spreading among farming villagers, and the name Chewa was first written down by the Portuguese officer António Gamitto in 1831.
zh: 尼亚萨语是对尼亚萨湖（今马拉维湖）周边及赞比西河下游一组班图语的称呼，大致相当于格思里分类的N区；主要成员包括切瓦语（又称尼扬贾语）、通布卡语、马拉维通加语，以及包含尼永圭语在内的塞纳语群。说这些语言的人可追溯到4世纪加丹加的班图陶器文化，切瓦诸氏族于13世纪开始在湖岸定居。自15世纪初起，切瓦人建立马腊韦帝国，卡隆加国王们以象牙为贡赋，统治马拉维中南部；17世纪在卡隆加·穆祖拉治下，帝国疆域从卢安瓜河延伸至赞比西河，并向莫桑比克海岸输出布匹和铁器。18世纪继承纠纷使帝国瓦解，但这些语言仍在农耕村民中扩散；1831年，葡萄牙军官安东尼奥·加米托首次记录下切瓦这一名称。

en: Nyâlayu, or Yâlayu, is a Kanak language of the Extreme Northern New Caledonian group, spoken at the northern tip of Grande Terre and on the outlying Belep islands. It descends, with the other Kanak languages, from the Proto-Oceanic of Lapita seafarers who settled New Caledonia around 1000 BCE. Nyâlayu has two dialects that are not mutually intelligible: Pooc, also called Haat, spoken on the Belep islands north of the main island, and Puma, or Paak, spoken on the northern coast around Poum in the west and Pouébo and Balade in the east.
zh: 涅拉尤语又称亚拉尤语，属新喀里多尼亚语群极北支，通行于格朗德特尔岛北端和外海的贝莱普群岛。它与其他卡纳克语言一样，源自约公元前1000年定居新喀里多尼亚的拉皮塔航海者的原始大洋洲语。涅拉尤语有两种彼此不能互通的方言：普克语又称哈特语，通行于主岛以北的贝莱普群岛；普马语又称帕克语，通行于北海岸，西起普姆，东至普埃博和巴拉德。

en: The Nyulnyulan languages are a small non-Pama Nyungan family of the Kimberley coast of northern Western Australia, centered on the Dampier Peninsula north of Broome and its neighboring islands and sounds. They divide into a western branch, including Bardi, Jawi, Nyulnyul, Jabirr Jabirr and Nimanburru, and an eastern branch of Yawuru, Warrwa and their kin; the members are so close that several were mutually intelligible. Bardi, spoken by the sea-oriented Bardi people at the tip of the peninsula and on the offshore islands, is one of the western languages. When European ships first reached Australian waters, beginning with the Dutch landing of 1606, these tongues had no writing and were maintained entirely by oral tradition.
zh: 纽尔纽尔诸语言是西澳大利亚北部金伯利海岸的一个小型非帕马‑牛雅语系，中心在布鲁姆以北的丹皮尔半岛及附近岛屿与海湾。它分为东西两支：西支包括巴尔迪语、贾维语、纽尔纽尔语、贾比尔贾比尔语和尼曼布鲁语，东支有亚武鲁语、瓦鲁阿语等；各语言关系极近，有几种还能互通。其中巴尔迪语由面向海洋的巴尔迪人使用，通行于半岛顶端和外海岛屿。1606年荷兰人首次在澳大利亚登陆，此后欧洲船只陆续到来，而这些语言始终没有文字，全靠口耳相传。

en:
Occitan, or lenga d'òc, is the Romance language of southern France's Occitania, also spoken in Monaco, the Occitan valleys of Italy and the Val d'Aran in Spain; its name comes from òc, its word for yes, descended from Latin hoc, which Dante used in De vulgari eloquentia to mark it off from the oïl languages of the north. Its main dialects are Limousin, Auvergnat, Languedocien, Provençal and Gascon, and Catalan, counted as an Occitan dialect until the late 1800s, remains its closest relative. Rooted in the Latin of Gallia Narbonensis of 121 BC and barely touched by the Franks, it produced one of Europe's earliest Romance texts, the Boecis poem of around 1000 to 1030, and became the vehicle of the troubadours, whose love poetry made Occitan the first prestigious vernacular literary language of medieval Europe; it was the mother tongue of Eleanor of Aquitaine and Richard I of England. The Albigensian Crusade of 1209 to 1229 broke the power of the Counts of Toulouse and drew Languedoc into the French crown's orbit.

From the 1300s Occitan steadily lost status, and the Ordinance of Villers-Cotterêts of 1539 confined all official business to the king's French. Across 1337 to 1837 it nevertheless remained the everyday speech of town and countryside across the south, in dialects such as Gascon and Provençal, but with no place in administration, education or print and no single written standard, while the French Revolution deepened its decline by treating every patois as a threat to national unity.
zh:
奥克语自称“奥克语”（lenga d'òc），是法兰西南部奥克西塔尼亚地区的罗曼语，也通行于摩纳哥、意大利的奥克山谷和西班牙的阿兰山谷；它的名字来自表示“是”的òc，源出拉丁语hoc，但丁在《论俗语》中正是以此把它同北方的奥依语诸语言区分开来。它的主要方言有利穆赞方言、奥弗涅方言、朗格多克方言、普罗旺斯方言和加斯科涅方言，而加泰罗尼亚语直到19世纪末都被视为奥克语的一支，仍是它最近的亲属。奥克语植根于公元前121年设立的那尔波嫩西斯高卢的拉丁语，几乎没有受到法兰克人影响；欧洲最早的罗曼语书面作品之一、约1000—1030年的长诗《博埃提斯》就用它写成。后来它又成为游吟诗人的载体，他们的爱情诗使奥克语成为中世纪欧洲第一种享有盛誉的俗语文学语言；阿基坦的埃莉诺和英格兰国王理查一世都以它为母语。1209—1229年的阿尔比十字军摧毁了图卢兹伯爵的势力，把朗格多克纳入法兰西王权的轨道。

从14世纪起，奥克语的地位不断下降，1539年的《维莱科特雷法令》又把一切公务限定为国王的法语。但在1337—1837年间，它仍是南方城镇和乡村的日常语言，以加斯科涅、普罗旺斯等方言的形式活着，只是在行政、教育和印刷中毫无位置，也没有统一的书面标准；法国大革命进一步加速了它的衰落，因为革命者把一切土话都视为对国家统一的威胁。

en: The Oghuric or Bulgar languages are the earliest branch to split from the Turkic family, marked by sound correspondences such as r where the later Common Turkic languages have z, and Chuvash is their only living survivor. They were carried by the steppe confederations of the Onogurs, Bulgars and Khazars, and Oghuric served as the lingua franca of the Khazar state. After Old Great Bulgaria broke up in the seventh century, one group of Bulgars under Asparukh reached the Danube and eventually adopted a Slavic language, while the followers of Kotrag settled the Volga and Kama rivers, built Volga Bulgaria with its capital at Bolghar and adopted Islam in 922. The Mongol invasion of 1223 to 1236 destroyed that state and carried its Bulgar language into the Golden Horde. Volga Bulgar speech then lived on in Chuvash, while the extinct Bulgar itself and the poorly attested Khazar survive only in fragments and loanwords, including the early Turkic borrowings found in Hungarian.
zh: 乌古尔语又称保加尔语，是最早从突厥语族分离出来的分支，标志性特征是用 r 对应后世通用突厥语中的 z，楚瓦什语是这一支仅存的语言。它曾随奥诺古尔人、保加尔人和可萨人等草原部落联盟传播，并作为可萨汗国的通用语。7世纪旧大保加利亚解体后，阿斯帕鲁赫率领一支保加尔人远至多瑙河畔，最终改用斯拉夫语；科特拉克的部众则定居伏尔加河与卡马河流域，建立以保加尔城为都的伏尔加保加利亚，并于922年皈依伊斯兰教。1223—1236年的蒙古入侵灭亡了这个国家，保加尔语随之被带入金帐汗国。伏尔加保加尔语后来以楚瓦什语的形式延续，而已经消亡的保加尔语和记载稀少的可萨语只留下残篇与借词，匈牙利语中的早期突厥语借词即来自乌古尔语。

en: ʻŌlelo Hawaiʻi is a Polynesian language of the Austronesian family, closest to the Marquesan and Tahitian tongues with which it shares the voyaging traditions of Eastern Polynesia. Voyagers from the Marquesas settled the Hawaiian archipelago from roughly 300 CE, and later arrivals from the Society Islands and Samoa-Tonga shaped the language as it evolved in isolation, its small inventory of five vowels and eight consonants carried in genealogical chants (mele), prayers and oral histories rather than in writing. Captain James Cook's arrival in 1778 opened the European phase: explorers jotted down word lists, and the Hawaiian youth ʻŌpūkahaʻia, who reached New England, inspired the American mission whose first company sailed in 1819 and landed in 1820. The Protestant missionaries devised a Latin-script orthography so simple that adult literacy spread within a generation, schools multiplied across the islands, the first Hawaiian-language newspapers appeared in 1834, a printed vocabulary followed in 1836 and Adelbert von Chamisso published a grammar of Hawaiian in 1837.
zh: 夏威夷语是南岛语系的波利尼西亚语言，与马克萨斯语和塔希提语最为接近，同属东波利尼西亚的航海传统。约从公元300年起，来自马克萨斯群岛的航海者定居夏威夷群岛，其后又有来自社会群岛和萨摩亚-汤加的移民，语言在隔绝中逐渐演变，只有五个元音和八个辅音的简约音系，靠家谱吟唱（梅莱）、祈祷词和口述历史而非文字传承。1778年库克船长到来，开启了欧洲接触的阶段：探险者陆续记下词汇表，流落到新英格兰的夏威夷青年奥普卡哈伊阿促成了美国传教事业，第一批传教士于1819年启程、1820年登岛。新教传教士设计了一套十分简易的拉丁字母拼写法，成年人的读写能力在一代人之间普及，学校遍布各岛；1834年出现了第一批夏威夷语报纸，1836年印出词汇表，阿德尔贝特·冯·沙米索又于1837年出版了夏威夷语语法。

en: The Omotic languages are a group of closely related languages spoken mainly in southwestern Ethiopia, around the Omo River, with a few reaching the Blue Nile highlands of southeastern Sudan. They fall into four branches: Damotic, or North Omotic, which includes the Gonga and Ometo languages, along with Dizoid, Mao and the southern Aroid group. Most linguists treat Omotic as the most divergent branch of the Afroasiatic family, though its unity is disputed and some place Mao and Aroid outside Afroasiatic. The languages are agglutinative, use postpositions and subject–object–verb word order, and many, such as Bench, have complex tonal systems. Some were written in the Ge'ez script, which gained its vocalized form around 330 in the kingdom of Aksum; early nineteenth-century European scholars first described the northern tongues under the name Gonga and classed them with Cushitic.
zh: 奥莫特语是一群亲属语言，主要通行于埃塞俄比亚西南部的奥莫河流域，少数延伸到苏丹东南部的青尼罗河高地。它分为四大分支：达莫特（即北奥莫特，包括贡加、奥梅托诸语）、迪佐伊德、马奥，以及南方的阿罗伊德。多数学者把奥莫特语视为亚非语系中分化最深的一支，但其内部统一性一直有争议，也有人把马奥和阿罗伊德排除在亚非语系之外。这些语言属黏着语，使用后置词，语序为主宾动，本奇语等多种语言还有复杂的声调系统。其中一些语言用吉兹字母书写，该字母约于330年在阿克苏姆王国发展出元音化形式；19世纪初的欧洲学者最早以“贡加”之名记述北方诸语，并把它们归入库希特语。

en: Opata, whose speakers called it Teguima, is a Uto-Aztecan language of the inland valleys of northeastern and central Sonora, closely related to the neighboring Eudeve language with its Heve and Dohema dialects; the more distinct Jova is usually counted as a third Opatan variety. At Spanish contact in the mid-sixteenth century the Opata were the most numerous people of Sonora, living from about 1350 to 1550 in independent irrigation statelets of multi-story adobe towns along the Sonora, Moctezuma, Bavispe and Aros rivers, growing maize, beans, squash and cotton. They fought off Francisco de Ibarra's expedition of 1565, but introduced epidemics broke up the statelets into small rancherias. Jesuits led by Pedro Mendez opened the first mission in the Opateria in 1628, and by 1688 twenty-two missions stood there; the Opata became allies of convenience, supplying soldiers for Spanish campaigns against the Apache and assimilating faster than the Yaqui or Tarahumara. They joined the general Indian rising of 1740 alongside the Yaqui, Mayo and Pima, and after independence rose again in 1820, when three hundred Opata warriors routed a thousand soldiers and destroyed a mining town near Tonichi before their leaders, including the Eudeve Dorame, were captured and executed; another chief, Dolores Gutierrez, was executed in 1833 after joining Juan Banderas. By the early nineteenth century most Opata were bilingual and Spanish was displacing their tongue, which is known chiefly through missionary vocabularies and grammars.
zh: 奥帕塔语是犹他-阿兹特克语系的语言，使用者自称特吉马，通行于索诺拉东北部和中部的内陆河谷，与相邻的埃乌德韦语（含赫韦和多海马方言）关系极近；差异更大的霍瓦语通常被算作第三种奥帕塔变体。16世纪中叶西班牙人初来时，奥帕塔人是索诺拉人口最多的民族，约1350至1550年间生活在索诺拉河、蒙特苏马河、巴维斯佩河和阿罗斯河沿岸，以多层土坯城镇组成独立的灌溉小邦，种植玉米、豆类、南瓜和棉花。他们击退了1565年弗朗西斯科·德·伊瓦拉的远征，但欧洲人带来的瘟疫使各小邦瓦解为零散的小村社。1628年，佩德罗·门德斯率领的耶稣会士在奥帕特里亚建立第一个传教区，到1688年已有22处；奥帕塔人成为西班牙人的权宜盟友，出兵协助对阿帕奇人的战事，同化速度也快于雅基人和塔拉乌马拉人。1740年，他们与雅基、马约和皮马人一道参加印第安人大起义；独立后又于1820年举事，三百名奥帕塔战士击溃一千名西军并摧毁了托尼奇附近的矿业城镇，最终包括埃乌德韦人多拉梅在内的首领被俘处决，另一位酋长多洛雷斯·古铁雷斯也在参加胡安·班德拉斯起义后于1833年被处死。进入19世纪时，多数奥帕塔人已通用西班牙语，母语被不断排挤，后世主要靠传教士留下的词汇表和语法书了解这门语言。

en: Oriomo, or Eastern Trans-Fly, is a small independent family of Papuan languages spoken on the Oriomo Plateau west of the Fly River, in the Western Province of Papua New Guinea, close to the border with Indonesian New Guinea. Its members are Bine, Wipi, also called Gidra, Gizrra and Meriam, better known as Meriam Mir, the tongue of the eastern Torres Strait islands of Murray, Darnley and Stephens and the only Papuan language spoken on Australian territory. Mid-twentieth-century classifications by Stephen Wurm placed the family in a Trans-Fly-Bulaka River branch of Trans-New Guinea, but later scholars such as Malcolm Ross and Timothy Usher treated it as an independent lineage, Usher adding the neighbouring Pahoturi languages to a wider grouping. The island homes of its Meriam speakers lie in the strait first crossed by the Spanish expedition of Luis Vaez de Torres in 1606 and sailed by James Cook's Endeavour in 1770, on the voyage that opened eastern Australia to Britain.
zh: 奥里莫语又称东外弗莱语，是一个小型的巴布亚语独立语族，通行于巴布亚新几内亚西部省弗莱河以西的奥里莫高原，紧邻印度尼西亚新几内亚边界。它的成员包括比内语、维皮语（又称吉德拉语）、吉兹拉语和梅里亚姆语（通称梅里亚姆·米尔语）；后者通行于托雷斯海峡东部的默里岛、达恩利岛和斯蒂芬斯岛，是澳大利亚领土上唯一的巴布亚语言。20世纪中期斯蒂芬·武尔姆的分类把它放在跨新几内亚语系的外弗莱－布拉卡河语支中，但后来的学者如马尔科姆·罗斯和蒂莫西·厄舍把它视为独立语系，厄舍还把邻近的帕霍图里语言并入一个更大的分组。梅里亚姆语使用者居住的岛屿正处在托雷斯海峡上：1606年路易斯·巴埃斯·德·托雷斯的西班牙远征队首次穿过这条海峡，1770年詹姆斯·库克的“奋进号”再经此地，那次航行使英国打开了澳大利亚东部。

en: Oriya, or Odia, is an Eastern Indo-Aryan language spoken on the Bay of Bengal coast in the Indian region of Odisha, descended from the Magadhi Prakrit through the Odra Prakrit and shaped by long contact with tribal and Dravidian tongues. Its earliest records are ninth-century inscriptions mixing Odra Prakrit with Sanskrit, and the first full Old Oriya inscription, the Urajam record of the Eastern Ganga kings, is dated 1051. The language is written in the curved Odia, or Kalinga, script, a Brahmic abugida whose rounded letters developed for writing on palm leaves. Old Oriya gave way to Middle Oriya from the fourteenth century, the age of the temple chronicles of Puri and of Sarala Das, who retold the Mahabharata in the vernacular; the five poets called the Panchasakha followed with devotional works such as the Odia Bhagabata. By the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries court poets such as Upendra Bhanja and Dinakrushna Dasa had carried the literary language toward its modern form, while the related Halbi variety served traders farther inland.
zh: 奥里亚语是印度东部奥里萨地区、孟加拉湾沿岸的东印度—雅利安语言，由摩揭陀俗语经当地的奥德罗俗语演变而来，并在与部落语言和达罗毗荼语言的长期接触中形成了自己的面貌。它最早的记录是9世纪混用奥德罗俗语与梵语的铭文，第一篇完整的古奥里亚语铭文是东恒伽诸王留下的乌拉贾姆碑，定于1051年。奥里亚语用圆转的奥里亚文（又称羯陵伽文）书写，这种婆罗米系拼音文字的字母之所以多弧线，是为了适应在贝叶上书写。14世纪起古奥里亚语让位于中古奥里亚语，那是普里神庙编年史和用方言重述《摩诃婆罗多》的诗人萨拉拉·达斯的时代；此后被称为“五圣”的五位诗人又写出《奥里亚薄伽梵歌》等虔信作品。到17、18世纪，乌彭德拉·班贾、迪纳克里希纳·达斯等宫廷诗人已把这种文学语言推向近代形态，而与它亲缘相近的哈拉比话则在更深的内陆充当商人的通用语。

en: Oto-Pamean is the central Mexican branch of the Oto-Manguean family, a group of tonal languages divided into Otomian, comprising the many Otomi varieties and Mazahua; Matlatzincan, with Matlatzinca and Ocuilteco of the Toluca valley; and Pamean, the Pame and Chichimeco Jonaz tongues of the San Luis Potosi sierras. Its speakers are among the oldest settled peoples of the central plateau: Otomi voices were heard in Teotihuacan and in the Toltec city of Tula, and around 1100 the Otomi city-state of Xaltocan dominated its neighbors until Mexica expansion made Otomi lands tributary to the Triple Alliance and drove many communities eastward into Hidalgo and Puebla. During the conquest the Otomi of Tlaxcala joined Cortes against the Aztecs and later led the colonial settling of Queretaro and the Bajio, while the encomiendas of the 1530s and the later Indian republics shaped village life. The nomadic Pame, who call themselves Xi'oi, and the Jonaz of the Sierra Gorda held out longest: they were swept into the Chichimeca War of 1550 to 1590, and the last sierras were reduced only by soldiers and Franciscans in 1742, with the missions secularized by 1770. The game's grouping also folds in the related but distinct Manguean peoples, the Chiapanec who ruled Chiapa from the tenth century and the Chorotega who migrated as far as Nicaragua and Costa Rica, whose languages died out under colonial assimilation.
zh: 奥托帕梅语是欧托-曼格语系在墨西哥中部的语支，属声调语言，下分三组：奥托米语组，包括众多奥托米方言和马萨瓦语；马特拉尔辛卡语组，即托卢卡河谷的马特拉尔辛卡语和奥奎尔特科语；帕梅语组，即圣路易斯波托西山区的帕梅语和奇奇梅卡-霍纳斯语。使用者是中部高原最古老的定居民族之一：特奥蒂瓦坎和托尔特克名城图拉都有奥托米人，约1100年奥托米城邦哈尔托坎一度称雄邻邦，后来墨西加扩张使奥托米土地向三方同盟纳贡，许多社群东迁到伊达尔戈和普埃布拉。征服时期，特拉斯卡拉的奥托米人加入科尔特斯一方攻打阿兹特克，后来又主导了克雷塔罗和巴希奥地区的殖民垦殖；16世纪30年代的委托监护制和此后的印第安人共和国塑造了村镇生活。自称希奥伊的游牧帕梅人和戈尔达山的霍纳斯人坚持最久：他们被卷入1550至1590年的奇奇梅卡战争，最后的山区直到1742年才被军队和方济各会士平定，传教区则在1770年前世俗化。游戏的划分还纳入了近亲但各自独立的曼格语支民族：10世纪起统治奇亚帕的奇亚帕内克人，以及远徙尼加拉瓜和哥斯达黎加的乔罗特加人，他们的语言都在殖民同化中消亡。

en: Pahari, meaning the speech of the mountains, is the Northern Indo-Aryan dialect continuum of the lower Himalayas, running from Nepal through Uttarakhand and Himachal Pradesh into Jammu. Scholars divide it into eastern, central and western groups: the central group includes Garhwali and Kumaoni, while the western, often called Himachali, includes Kangri, Dogri and many smaller hill tongues. Mountain valleys kept communities apart, so each district developed its own variety, linked to its neighbours by gradual dialect shifts rather than sharp borders, and some western tongues such as Kangri and Dogri even developed tonal contrasts. These highlands were long ruled by small Rajput hill houses, among them the Katoch rajas of Kangra, whose fort above the town of Nagarkot held out against every attacker until the Mughal army of Jahangir took it in 1622. Pahari languages are written in the Devanagari script and draw on the same Middle Indo-Aryan heritage as the plains languages below them.
zh: 帕哈里语意为“山里人的话”，是喜马拉雅低山区的北印度—雅利安方言连续体，东起尼泊尔，经北阿坎德和喜马偕尔，西至查谟。学者把它分为东、中、西三组：中段包括加尔瓦利语和库毛尼语，西段又称喜马偕尔诸语，包括坎格拉语、多格拉语和许多更小的山地土语。山谷把各个社群彼此隔绝，每个地区都发展出自己的变体，相邻变体之间以渐变相连，没有截然的界线，坎格拉语、多格拉语等西段语言甚至发展出声调对立。这片高地长期由拉杰普特人的小邦统治，坎格拉的卡托奇王族便是其中之一，他们在纳加尔科特山上的堡垒屡攻不破，直到1622年才被贾汉吉尔的莫卧儿大军攻取。帕哈里诸语以天城文书写，与山脚下平原上的语言同承中期印度—雅利安语的遗产。

en: Pahoturi is a small independent Papuan language family spoken along the Pahoturi River south of the Fly River in Papua New Guinea's Western Province, just west of the Oriomo languages. Its eight varieties, among them Agob, Idi, Ende and Kawam, form a dialect chain, while the Idzuwe variety is no longer spoken.
zh: 帕霍图里语是一个小型的巴布亚语独立语族，通行于巴布亚新几内亚西部省弗莱河以南的帕霍图里河一带，就在奥里莫语分布区以西。它有八种变体，其中包括阿戈布语、伊迪语、恩德语和卡瓦姆语，彼此构成一条方言链，而伊祖韦语变体已经无人使用。

en: Paicî is a Kanak language of the Austronesian family spoken in a band across the centre of Grande Terre, the main island of New Caledonia, in the communes of Poindimié, Ponérihouen, Koné and Poya in the North Province. It belongs to the Central Northern group of the Northern New Caledonian languages, themselves a branch of the Southern Oceanic group. Against the unusually dense consonant systems of its neighbours, Paicî keeps a relatively small consonant inventory but possesses a strikingly rich vowel system: ten oral vowels and seven nasal vowels, with distinctions of length and tone. The language traces its roots to the Lapita voyagers who began raising coastal settlements on New Caledonia around 1100 BC, bringing an Austronesian tongue that in time diversified into the island's thirty Kanak languages. Europeans learned of the island only later: James Cook sighted Grande Terre in September 1774 and gave it the name New Caledonia, the Comte de Lapérouse surveyed its west coast in 1788, and English whalers charted the Loyalty Islands from 1793, but ships called only rarely for the next half century. Through these centuries Paicî stayed an unwritten language carried by oral custom.
