zh: 派西语是新喀里多尼亚主岛格朗德特尔岛中部一带通行的卡纳克语言，属南岛语系，分布于北部省的普安迪米耶、波内里旺、科内和波亚四镇。它属于新喀里多尼亚北部语言的中北语支，后者隶属于南大洋洲语群。与邻近语言繁复的辅音系统相比，派西语的辅音数量较少，元音系统却格外丰富：有十个口元音和七个鼻元音，并区分长短和声调。派西语的源头可追溯到拉皮塔航海者：他们约从公元前1100年起在新喀里多尼亚沿海建立定居点，带来的南岛语后来分化为岛上的三十种卡纳克语言。欧洲人很晚才知道这座岛：1774年9月詹姆斯·库克望见格朗德特尔岛，将它命名为新喀里多尼亚；1788年拉彼鲁兹伯爵测绘了西海岸；1793年起英国捕鲸人绘制了洛亚蒂群岛的海图，但此后约半个世纪里只有很少的船只到访。在这漫长的岁月里，派西语始终是没有文字、依靠口传习俗的语言。

en: Numu-Monachi groups two closely related languages of the Western Numic branch of the Uto-Aztecan family: Northern Paiute, whose speakers call themselves Numu and which was once also called Paviotso, and Mono, or Monachi, divided into Western Mono and the Eastern Mono dialect of the Owens Valley. Northern Paiute bands lived across the arid Great Basin of western Nevada and the adjoining edges of Oregon, Idaho and California, while Mono speakers occupied the Mono Basin, the Owens Valley and the southern Sierra Nevada. Linguists believe Numic-speaking peoples spread outward from a homeland near the southwestern Great Basin during the centuries before European contact, replacing older languages of the basin. Both tongues are adapted to a mobile desert way of life, with rich vocabularies for local plants, animals and water sources. Outside contacts remained sparse until British and American fur trappers such as Peter Skene Ogden and Jedediah Smith crossed their territories in the 1820s.
zh: 努穆‑莫纳奇语包含犹他‑阿兹特克语系西努米克语支下两种关系很近的语言：北派尤特语（使用者自称努穆，旧称帕维奥措语）和莫诺语（莫纳奇语，分为西莫诺方言与欧文斯谷的东莫诺方言）。北派尤特各群体生活在内华达西部干旱的大盆地及俄勒冈、爱达荷、加利福尼亚交界地带，莫诺语使用者则分布在莫诺盆地、欧文斯谷和内华达山脉南段。语言学家认为，在欧洲人到来之前的几个世纪里，说努米克语的族群从大盆地西南的发源地向外扩散，取代了盆地里更早的语言。这两种语言都适应流动的沙漠生活，拥有丰富的本地动植物和水源词汇。直到19世纪20年代，彼得·斯基恩·奥格登、杰迪代亚·史密斯等英美毛皮猎人进入其领地，外界与他们的接触仍然很少。

en: Palaungic, or Palaung-Wa, is a group of nearly thirty Austroasiatic languages, among them Wa, Blang, Lawa and Palaung, also called De'ang. They are spoken in scattered mountain pockets across the inland borderlands of Myanmar, present-day Yunnan in China, Laos and Thailand, centred on the rugged hills between the Salween and the Mekong known as the Wa corridor. Their speakers are swidden-farming highlanders who hold these ranges as their ancestral land; around 1229 the Wa were driven out of Kengtung and were later defeated by King Mangrai of Lan Na as Tai-speaking principalities expanded. None of these languages had a script of its own, and literate speakers wrote in Chinese characters or in Shan with the Shan script. In the early nineteenth century Palaungic speech survived chiefly in remote highland valleys ringed by Tai and Burmese states.
zh: 佤德昂语又称佤—德昂语，是南亚语系下近三十种语言的统称，主要包括佤语、布朗语、拉瓦语和德昂语，零散分布在缅甸、中国云南、老挝与泰国交界的内陆山区，核心是萨尔温江与湄公河之间被称为“佤走廊”的崎岖山地。说这些语言的是从事轮垦农业的山民，自古将这片群山视为故土；1229年前后，佤人被逐出景栋，其后又在傣语政权扩张中被兰纳国王孟莱击败。这些语言都没有本族文字，识字者或用汉字，或使用掸语和掸文。到19世纪初，佤德昂语主要存续于偏远的高山谷地，四周环绕着傣族和缅人政权。

en: Pali is a Middle Indo-Aryan Prakrit, preserved as the sacred language of Theravada Buddhism and the tongue of the Tipitaka canon. It descends not from Vedic Sanskrit but from a hybrid of several regional Prakrits from around the 200s BCE, partly Sanskritized, with a western dialect base and lingering eastern Magadhi features. Long carried orally, the canon was first committed to writing in Sri Lanka in the first century BCE. After centuries of decline on the island, the scholar Buddhaghosa revived Pali learning in the 400s with the Visuddhimagga and his commentaries. Pali inscriptions in mainland Southeast Asia may begin as early as the 300s, and the oldest surviving examples, carved in present-day Burma, Thailand, Cambodia and Laos, date from the 400s to the 700s. A renaissance that began around the Pagan kingdom in the 1000s then carried the language through mainland Southeast Asia as dynasties sponsored Theravada monasteries, and the 1300s brought new Pali works of poetics modeled on Sanskrit forms. Never a vernacular in this period, Pali served as the scholarly and liturgical lingua franca of Theravada lands, written in local scripts such as Burmese, Khmer and Sinhala, and poured thousands of religious and learned loanwords into those languages.
zh: 巴利语是中古印度—雅利安语的一种俗语，作为上座部佛教的圣语和《三藏》经典的语言保存下来。它并非吠陀梵语的后裔，而是约公元前3世纪（前200年前后）几种地方俗语的混合体，经过部分梵语化，以西部方言为基础，又留有东部摩揭陀语的痕迹。经典长期口传，至公元前1世纪才在斯里兰卡首次写成文字。在岛上经历数百年衰落后，5世纪（400年代）的学者觉音以《清净道论》和他的注疏复兴了巴利语学术。中南半岛的巴利语铭文最早或可上溯至4世纪（300年代），现存最早的一批分布在今缅甸、泰国、柬埔寨和老挝，年代为5至8世纪（400—700年代）。11世纪（1000年代）起于蒲甘王国一带的巴利语复兴，把这门语言带到整个中南半岛，诸王朝纷纷扶持上座部寺院；14世纪（1300年代）还出现了模仿梵文形式的巴利语诗学新作。在这一时期，巴利语并不是任何地方的口语，而是上座部佛教地区的学术和宗教礼仪通用语，用缅文、高棉文、僧伽罗文等各地字母书写，并向这些语言注入了数以千计的宗教和学术借词。

en: The Pama Nyungan languages form the greatest family of Aboriginal Australia, covering almost the whole continent save pockets of the northern coast. At European arrival about three hundred such languages, grouped into three dozen branches, stretched from Cape York in the northeast to the southwest corner; the family name joins these two extremes, pama being the northeastern word for man and nyunga the southwestern one. Typical members such as Warlpiri build words entirely with suffixes, mark grammatical relations on dependent words and have no gender. The ancestral tongue, Proto-Pama Nyungan, may have been spoken only about five thousand years ago in the Gulf Plains of northeastern Australia, from where it spread across the continent, replacing or absorbing older languages. All were oral languages, and the first missionary grammars were written down only in the early 1800s.
zh: 帕马‑牛雅诸语言是澳大利亚原住民最大的语系，几乎覆盖整块大陆，只有北部沿海还散布着若干其他语系。欧洲人初到时，约有三百种帕马‑牛雅语言、分属三十多个语支，从东北的约克角一直延伸到大陆西南角；语系名称正是两端的合称：东北话里称人为帕马，西南话里称人为牛雅。典型的帕马‑牛雅语言完全依靠后缀构词，语法关系标注在从属成分上，也没有名词性别。原始帕马‑牛雅语可能迟至约五千年前才在澳大利亚东北部的海湾平原一带使用，随后向外扩散，取代或融合了更古老的语言。这些语言都没有文字，最早的传教士语法书出现于19世纪初。

en: Panche was the language of the Panche, a warrior people who held the warm lower slopes of the eastern Magdalena valley, in what is now south-western Cundinamarca and north-eastern Tolima in Colombia. The Panche lived in a loose confederation of subgroups and were frequent enemies of the highland Muisca to their east; their culture can be traced in the region from about the year 300, with migrations from the Caribbean coast around the year 1000. Their language is almost unattested, so linguists treat it as unclassified, some proposing a Cariban connection, and the seventeenth-century friar Pedro Simón recorded that panche meant cruel or murderer in the people's own speech. Spanish forces under Juan de Céspedes and later Hernán Venegas Carrillo overran the territory after the founding of the New Kingdom of Granada, and the Panche population collapsed under conquest and disease, taking its language with it.
zh: 潘切语是潘切人的语言。潘切人是一个善战的族群，占据马格达莱纳河谷东侧温暖的低山坡地，即今天哥伦比亚昆迪纳马卡省西南部与托利马省东北部一带。潘切人以松散的部落联盟形式生活，常与东面高原上的穆伊斯卡人交战；其文化在该地区约可追溯至300年，1000年前后又有来自加勒比海岸的移民迁入。潘切语几乎没有留下文字记录，语言学家因此将其归为未分类语言，也有人推测它属于加勒比语系；17世纪的修士佩德罗·西蒙记载，panche 在他们自己的语言中意为“残忍者”或“杀人者”。新格拉纳达王国建立后，胡安·德·塞斯佩德斯及后来的埃尔南·贝内加斯·卡里略率领西班牙军队征服了这片土地，潘切人口在征服与疫病中急剧减少，他们的语言也随之消亡。

en: Pano denotes the Panoan family, a branch of the Pano–Tacanan stock spoken by indigenous peoples across western Brazil, eastern Peru and northern Bolivia. Its roughly three dozen languages, among them Shipibo-Konibo, Kaxinawá, Yaminawa and Matsés, form a network of closely related dialects and remained unwritten oral languages through the colonial era.
zh: 帕诺语即帕诺语系，是帕诺—塔卡南语系的一支，由巴西西部、秘鲁东部和玻利维亚北部的原住民使用。该语系约有三十余种语言，包括希皮博—科尼博语、卡希纳瓦语、亚米纳瓦语和马塞斯语，彼此方言相近，在殖民时代始终是没有文字的口头语言。

en: Panzaleo, also called Shillipanu, was a pre-Inca language spoken around Quito and Latacunga in the Ecuadorian highlands by the Quitu people and neighbouring groups before the Spanish conquest. The early chronicler Pedro Cieza de León mentioned it in 1553, and words and endings from it were recorded in the Relaciones geográficas de Indias and later collected by Jijón y Caamaño and Paz y Miño. It was already poorly documented and died out in the seventeenth century, leaving its classification uncertain; a proposed link to Páez rests on weak evidence and may reflect contact rather than common origin.
zh: 潘萨莱奥语又名希利帕努语，是西班牙征服之前基多和拉塔昆加一带的前印加语言，由基图人及邻近族群使用。早期编年史家佩德罗·谢萨·德·莱昂在1553年提到过它，《西印度地理志》记录了其中的一些词汇和词尾，后来希洪·伊·卡马尼奥和帕斯·伊·米尼奥又做了搜集。该语言留存的材料很少，于17世纪消亡，谱系归属没有定论；有人提出它与帕埃斯语有亲缘关系，但证据薄弱，所谓相似之处更可能来自语言接触而非共同起源。

en: Paumotu, whose speakers call it Reo Pa'umotu, is a Polynesian language of the Austronesian family, spoken across the more than sixty low atolls of the Tuamotu Archipelago east of Tahiti. The islands were settled from about 1150 by voyagers from the Society Islands, and the atoll-dwellers' habit of moving between reefs gave the language seven dialect areas while keeping it close to Tahitian, though Paumotu conserves velar sounds such as k and g where Tahitian uses a glottal stop. Ferdinand Magellan's crossing of the Pacific in 1521 made the Tuamotus the first Polynesian islands seen by Europeans, but early contacts were fleeting and changed local life little. In pre-Christian tradition the Pa'umotu chanted hymns to Kiho-Tumu, the supreme creator, and this oral literature preserved the language through the centuries. In the early nineteenth century missionaries based in Tahiti began evangelizing the atolls, bringing the Latin alphabet and a stock of Christian loanwords and starting the translation of scripture into Pa'umotu.
zh: 保莫图语的使用者自称 Reo Pa'umotu，是南岛语系的波利尼西亚语言，通行于塔希提以东、由六十多座低矮环礁组成的土阿莫土群岛。这些岛屿约在1150年由来自社会群岛的航海者定居，岛民往来于各环礁之间的游动生活，使保莫图语形成七个方言区，同时又与塔希提语十分接近；不过保莫图语保留了 k、g 等软腭音，而塔希提语在相应位置用喉塞音。1521年麦哲伦横渡太平洋，使土阿莫土成为欧洲人最早见到的波利尼西亚群岛，但早期接触都很短暂，对当地生活影响甚微。在皈依基督教之前，保莫图人吟唱赞颂至高创世神基霍-图穆的圣歌，口述文学借此把语言传承了数百年。19世纪初，以塔希提为基地的传教士开始到这些环礁传教，带来了拉丁字母和一批基督教借词，并着手把圣经译成保莫图语。

en: Pemon is a Cariban language of the Gran Sabana, the open upland of Bolívar State in south-eastern Venezuela, and of the adjoining borderlands of Guyana and the Brazilian state of Roraima. It falls into three main dialects, Arekuna, Kamarakoto and Taurepang, and belongs with Macushi to the Pemongan group of Cariban tongues.
zh: 佩蒙语是加勒比语族语言，通行于委内瑞拉东南部玻利瓦尔州的格兰萨瓦纳草原高地，以及圭亚那和巴西罗赖马州接壤的边境地带。它分为阿雷库纳、卡马拉科托和陶雷潘三大方言，与马库希语同属加勒比语族的佩蒙语支。

en: Penutian is a proposed, long-debated language phylum uniting many Native languages of western North America, from California through Oregon and Washington to British Columbia. The name was coined from words for two, pen in the Wintuan, Maiduan and Yokuts languages and uti in the Miwok and Costanoan tongues. In the early twentieth century Roland Dixon and Alfred Kroeber launched the hypothesis around five California families, Yokuts, Miwok, Costanoan, Maiduan and Wintuan, and Edward Sapir later expanded it to include Oregon and Plateau peoples such as the Chinook, Kalapuya, Coos, Takelma, Alsea, Molala, Klamath-Modoc, Sahaptin and Nez Perce. The broader unity remains unproven and may partly reflect borrowing between neighbours, though smaller groupings such as Utian, joining Miwok and Costanoan, and Plateau Penutian rest on firmer evidence. From the 1770s Spanish missions uprooted the California Penutian peoples and their languages, while Chinookan villages on the lower Columbia became fur-trade hubs where the trade language Chinook Jargon took shape.
zh: 佩努蒂语是一个提出以来一直存在争议的语系假说，试图统合北美西部从加利福尼亚经俄勒冈、华盛顿到不列颠哥伦比亚的众多原住民语言。其名称取自这些语言里“二”的说法——温顿语、迈杜语和约库茨语中的 pen，以及米沃克语和科斯塔诺语中的 uti。20世纪初，罗兰·迪克森与阿尔弗雷德·克罗伯以约库茨、米沃克、科斯塔诺、迈杜、温顿五个加州语系为核心提出该假说，爱德华·萨丕尔后来又把它扩展到俄勒冈和哥伦比亚高原的奇努克、卡拉普亚、库斯、塔克尔马、阿尔西亚、莫拉拉、克拉马斯‑莫多克、萨哈普廷和内兹珀斯等族群。更广义的亲缘关系未能证实，部分相似处可能只是邻族间的借用，不过米沃克与科斯塔诺合并的乌蒂语支、高原佩努蒂语支等较小分组已有较扎实的证据。18世纪70年代起，西班牙传教站瓦解了加州佩努蒂各族及其语言；而哥伦比亚河下游的奇努克村落成为毛皮贸易中心，贸易通用语奇努克混合语便在那里形成。

en: Permic is the Uralic branch spoken west of the Ural Mountains, whose living members are Komi (Zyryan) and Komi-Permyak in the Vychegda and upper Kama basins and Udmurt (Votyak) on the lower Kama and Vyatka. Like other Uralic tongues they are agglutinative with rich case systems, though they lack vowel harmony. The name Perm goes back to the word Perem in medieval Russian chronicles, first denoting the forest country bounded by the Pechora, Vychegda and Kama rivers and the Urals, and only later its non-Russian inhabitants; that country was incorporated into the Russian state in the late fifteenth century. Permic holds a special place in Uralic letters: in 1372 the missionary Stephen of Perm created the Old Permic alphabet, called Abur after its first two letters, blending Cyrillic and Greek forms with native Komi tamga marks. It wrote the medieval Komi tongue for the Permian church until the seventeenth century, when the Cyrillic alphabet displaced it.
zh: 彼尔姆语是乌拉尔语系的一支，通行于乌拉尔山脉以西，现存成员包括维切格达河与卡马河上游流域的科米语（旧称兹梁语）、彼尔姆科米语，以及卡马河下游和维亚特卡河流域的乌德穆尔特语（旧称沃佳克语）。和其他乌拉尔语言一样，它们是黏着语，格的体系繁复，但没有元音和谐。彼尔姆一名源自俄罗斯中世纪编年史中的佩列姆一词，最初指伯朝拉河、维切格达河、卡马河与乌拉尔山之间的森林地带，后来才用来称呼当地的非俄罗斯居民；该地区于15世纪末并入俄罗斯国家。彼尔姆语在乌拉尔文字史上地位特殊：1372年，传教士彼尔姆的斯蒂芬以西里尔字母、希腊字母和科米本土的塔姆加符号为基础，创制了古彼尔姆字母，并按头两个字母称之为阿布尔。它用来书写中世纪科米语、服务于彼尔姆教会，直到17世纪被西里尔字母取代。

en: Persian, known to its speakers as Farsi, is the leading Southwestern Iranian language of the Indo-European family, native to the region of Fars in southwestern Iran. Its recorded history falls into three stages: Old Persian, written in cuneiform under the Achaemenid kings and attested as early as the Behistun Inscription of 522 BC; Middle Persian, the Pahlavi speech of the Sasanian Empire; and New Persian, which arose after the Arab conquest and was first written in the ninth century in a Perso-Arabic script. The Persian revival of the ninth to eleventh centuries under the Samanids and Ghaznavids, followed by the Seljuk conquests, spread New Persian from Khorasan across the Iranian plateau and beyond as a language of administration and letters. It became the first tongue to break the Arabic monopoly on writing in the Islamic world, and its classical canon, crowned by Ferdowsi's Shahnameh and the poetry of Rumi, Saadi, Omar Khayyam, Nizami, Attar and the fourteenth-century master Hafez, was read from Anatolia to India. Persian served as a language of bureaucracy and culture at non-Iranian courts too, among them the Ottomans, the Delhi Sultanate and the Mughals, under whom it became the official language of northern India. In 1337 it was already the lingua franca of the entire Persianate world, and it kept that standing through the Timurid, Safavid and Mughal centuries; under the nineteenth-century Qajars the dialect of Tehran rose to become the basis of the standard language.
zh: 波斯语在母语者口中称法尔西语，是印欧语系伊朗语族西南伊朗语支的主要语言，故乡在伊朗西南部的法尔斯地区。其有文字记载的历史分为三个阶段：阿契美尼德王朝诸王用楔形文字书写的古波斯语，最早可追溯至公元前522年的贝希斯敦铭文；萨珊王朝以巴列维文书写的中古波斯语；以及阿拉伯征服后兴起、9世纪起改用波斯-阿拉伯字母书写的新波斯语。9至11世纪，萨曼王朝和加兹尼王朝治下的波斯复兴，以及随后的塞尔柱征服，把新波斯语从呼罗珊传播到整个伊朗高原及更远地区，成为行政与文学语言。它是伊斯兰世界第一种打破阿拉伯语书写垄断的语言，其经典以菲尔多西的《列王纪》为首，还包括鲁米、萨迪、欧玛尔·海亚姆、内扎米、阿塔尔以及14世纪大师哈菲兹的诗作，读者遍及安纳托利亚到印度之间的广阔地带。波斯语也在非伊朗人的宫廷中充当官僚与文化语言，例如奥斯曼、德里苏丹国和莫卧儿；在莫卧儿治下，它成为北印度的官方语言。1337年时，它已是整个波斯文化圈的通用语，并在帖木儿、萨法维和莫卧儿诸世纪保持这一地位；19世纪恺加王朝时期，德黑兰方言崛起，成为标准语的基础。

en: Pijao was the language of the Pijao, a constellation of federated chiefdoms in the Colombian Andes, spread across the Central Cordillera between the snow-capped massifs of Huila, Tolima and Quindío, and through the upper valleys of the Magdalena and Cauca rivers in what is now the department of Tolima. They never built a centralized state: at the Spanish entrada of the 1530s they were organized in two leagues, one on the upper Magdalena plains grouping Coyaima, Natagaima and kindred communities, and one in the mountain forests. Their priests, called mohanes, led an animist ritual life centred on rivers and mountain spirits, with idols of gold and wood. The conquistadors met ferocious resistance, and the so-called Pijao wars dragged on for some eighty years into the early seventeenth century over control of the Magdalena, Saldaña and Cauca waterways, ending in defeat, conversion to Catholicism and widespread mixing with Spanish settlers. The Pijao language was only fragmentarily recorded and has never been convincingly assigned to any language family; it died out as the surviving communities adopted Spanish.
zh: 皮豪语是皮豪人的语言。皮豪人是哥伦比亚安第斯山区一群结成联盟的酋邦，分布在韦拉、托利马和金迪奥等雪山之间的中科迪勒拉山脉，以及马格达莱纳河与考卡河上游谷地，主要在今天的托利马省境内。他们没有建立集权国家：16世纪30年代西班牙人入侵时，皮豪人分为两个联盟，一个是上马格达莱纳平原上以科亚伊马、纳塔盖马等社群组成的联盟，另一个由山林中的各部族组成。他们的祭司称“莫安”，主持以河流与山神为中心的万物有灵仪式，供奉金质和木质偶像。征服者遭到了顽强抵抗，为争夺马格达莱纳河、萨尔达尼亚河和考卡河水道而进行的“皮豪战争”断断续续打了约八十年，一直延续到17世纪初，最终以皮豪人战败、皈依天主教并与西班牙移民大量融合告终。皮豪语只留下零星记录，语言学家始终无法把它可靠地归入任何语系；随着幸存的社群改用西班牙语，皮豪语最终消亡。

en: Ping, or Pinghua, is the Sinitic speech carried by the earliest Han settlers of Guangxi, where it is still spoken along the old route from Hunan, with related varieties in southern Hunan and northern Guangdong. Han migrants entered the region in the first millennium, and the name is traced to the Pingnan Army, the Pacify the South force that the Northern Song general Di Qing led into Guangxi in the 1050s to crush the rebellion of Nong Zhigao; its soldiers settled on the land and their speech became the Pinghua of later times. Long contact with the Zhuang peoples made it a regional lingua franca and loaded it with Zhuang loanwords, including the final particle used in commands. It falls into two largely unintelligible branches, Northern Pinghua around Guilin and Southern Pinghua around Nanning, the latter distinguished by four separate checked tones. Pinghua is written in Chinese characters.
zh: 平话是广西最早一批汉族定居者带来的汉语，沿自湖南入桂的古道分布，在湘南、粤北也有相近的支系。汉人在第一个千年里陆续迁入这一地区；平话之名相传来自北宋将领狄青在1052—1053年南下平定侬智高之叛的平南军，士兵留驻屯垦，他们的话便成为后世的平话。由于长期与壮族相处，平话在部分地区充当通用语，并吸收了大量壮语借词，连祈使句的句末语气词也借自壮语。它分为互不相通的两支：桂林一带的桂北平话和南宁一带的桂南平话，后者以四个分立的入声调为特色。平话使用汉字书写。

en: Pohnpeian is a Micronesian language of the Austronesian family, the indigenous tongue of the island of Pohnpei in the Caroline Islands. With Pingelapese, Mokilese and Ngatikese it forms the Pohnpeic subgroup, whose closest larger relatives are the Chuukic languages to the west. Its speakers descend from Lapita voyagers who settled the island long before the rise of Nan Madol, the artificial-islet ceremonial town built off Pohnpei's eastern shore from the eighth or ninth century. Under the Saudeleur rulers, who held power from about 1100 to about 1628, and the more decentralized nahnmwarki chiefships that replaced them after the invasion of Isokelekel, Pohnpeian society was strictly ranked; the language itself preserves this in a high register called Meing, with special vocabulary used toward people of high rank. Spanish navigators reached the island early, beginning with Alvaro de Saavedra in 1529 and Pedro Fernandes de Queiros in 1595, but Pohnpeian remained unwritten until the Russian expedition of Fyodor Litke recorded a short vocabulary in 1828.
zh: 波纳佩语是南岛语系密克罗尼西亚语族的语言，为加罗林群岛波纳佩岛的本土语言。它与平格拉普语、莫基尔语、恩加提克语共同组成波纳佩语支，关系最近的大语支是西面的楚克语支。波纳佩人的先民是拉皮塔航海者，他们早在南马都尔兴起之前就定居此岛；南马都尔是8或9世纪起在波纳佩东岸外修建的人工岛礼仪之城。约1100年至约1628年绍德雷尔王朝统治此地，伊索克勒克入侵后取而代之的是更为分权的南姆瓦尔基酋长制。在这套等级森严的社会里，波纳佩语本身也留下了印记：它有一种称为“梅因”的敬语层次，对地位高的人说话要使用专门词汇。西班牙航海家很早就到过此岛，1529年阿尔瓦罗·德·萨韦德拉首开其端，1595年佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯又来造访，但波纳佩语长期没有文字，直到1828年费奥多尔·利特克的俄国考察队才记录下一份简短词汇表。

en: Pondo is another name for Angoram, called Kanda by its own speakers, a Papuan language of the lower Sepik River in East Sepik Province, northern Papua New Guinea; the speech of Maramba village counts as one of its dialects. It belongs to the small Lower Sepik family, once known as Nor–Pondo, whose other branches are Murik and Kopar at the river mouth and the inland Chambri and Karawari–Yimas tongues, the latter including Yimas, famed among linguists for its elaborate verb morphology. The Pondo languages and Kopar share distinctive first- and second-person pronouns built around the sound p, which set them apart from Murik, and some classifiers place the whole family with the Ramu languages, though this remains disputed. Like their neighbours, Pondo villagers live in the Sepik's vast swamp basin, where the river, with no delta at all, runs straight into the Bismarck Sea. The first European known to sail this northern coast was the Spaniard Yñigo Ortiz de Retez, who in 1545 named the island New Guinea, though the Sepik waterways themselves stayed hidden from outsiders for centuries afterward.
zh: 庞多语是安戈拉姆语的别称，说这种语言的人自称坎达；它是巴布亚新几内亚北部东塞皮克省塞皮克河下游的一种巴布亚语言，马兰巴村的话是它的一种方言。它属于规模不大的下塞皮克语族，旧称诺尔—庞多语族；该语族的其他分支有河口的穆里克语和科帕尔语，以及内陆的昌布里语和卡拉瓦里—伊马斯语，后者中的伊马斯语以繁复的动词形态闻名于语言学界。庞多诸语与科帕尔语在第一、第二人称代词中都带有标志性的p音，与穆里克语不同；部分分类学者把整个语族与拉穆诸语归在一起，但这一做法仍有争议。与邻族一样，庞多村落位于塞皮克河广阔的沼泽盆地中，这条河没有三角洲，直接注入俾斯麦海。已知最早航行于这片北海岸的欧洲人是西班牙人伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德·雷特斯，他于1545年将这座岛屿命名为新几内亚，而塞皮克河水道本身在此后数百年间仍不为外界所知。

en: Portuguese grew out of the Vulgar Latin of the Roman soldiers and settlers who reached western Iberia in the third century BC, over the older Gallaecian and Lusitanian tongues. After the Germanic invasions of the fifth century the speech of the northwest developed into Galician-Portuguese, first written in ninth-century documents and famed across the Christian kingdoms as the language of lyric song, including the Cantigas de Santa Maria. Muslim rule from 711 left several hundred Arabic words in its vocabulary. When the County of Portugal broke away from Galicia and its kingdom was recognized in 1143, the common language began to divide: the southern form became Portuguese, while Galician stayed under Castilian influence. King Diniz decreed in 1290 that Portuguese, not Latin, should be used in official writing, and the royal chancellery adopted it six years later. The Cancioneiro Geral of 1516 closed the Old Portuguese period, and Fernão de Oliveira printed the first grammar in 1536. Carried abroad by the age of discovery, Portuguese became a lingua franca of trade and missionary work in Africa, Asia and Brazil, and left behind creole communities from India to Malaysia.
zh: 葡萄牙语由公元前3世纪进入伊比利亚西部的罗马士兵和移民所说的通俗拉丁语发展而来，底层是更古老的加莱西亚语和卢西塔尼亚语。5世纪日耳曼诸族入侵后，半岛西北部的口语演变为加利西亚-葡萄牙语，最早见于9世纪的文书，并以抒情诗歌的语言闻名于各基督教王国，《圣玛利亚之歌》便是其中代表。711年开始的穆斯林统治为它留下了数百个阿拉伯语借词。随着葡萄牙伯国脱离加利西亚、其王国地位于1143年获得承认，这门共同语言开始分化：南方的形式发展为葡萄牙语，加利西亚语则长期受到卡斯蒂利亚语影响。1290年，迪尼什国王下令官方文书使用葡萄牙语而非拉丁语，六年后王室文书署正式采用。1516年的《诗歌总集》标志着古葡萄牙语时期结束，1536年费尔南·德·奥利维拉印行了第一部语法书。随着地理大发现，葡萄牙语传到海外，成为非洲、亚洲和巴西贸易与传教活动的通用语，并在印度到马来西亚一带留下了多个克里奥尔语社群。

en: Powhatan, also called Virginia Algonquian, is an Eastern Algonquian language of the Algic family, formerly spoken by the Powhatan people of the Virginia tidewater around Chesapeake Bay. It is closely related to Unami, Munsee, Nanticoke and Massachusett. Powhatan had no writing system, and it is known almost entirely from two wordlists taken at first contact: John Smith recorded about fifty words between 1607 and 1609, and William Strachey about five hundred in 1610 and 1611; Smith also reported a Powhatan pidgin, of which almost nothing is known. The English settlers who founded Jamestown in 1607 depended on the Powhatan for food and had to learn their language, and English borrowed more words from Powhatan than from any other indigenous tongue of eastern North America, including moccasin, tomahawk, raccoon, opossum, hickory, persimmon, hominy and terrapin. After the uprising of 1622 and the colonial wars that followed, the Powhatan communities were broken up and dispersed, and their language gradually fell out of daily use.
zh: 波瓦坦语又称弗吉尼亚阿尔冈昆语，属阿尔吉克语系的东阿尔冈昆语族，曾是切萨皮克湾畔弗吉尼亚潮汐地带波瓦坦人的语言，与乌纳米语、蒙西语、南蒂科克语和马萨诸塞语关系密切。波瓦坦语本无文字，后世对它的了解几乎全靠欧洲人初到北美时记下的两份词汇表：1607至1609年约翰·史密斯记下约50个词，1610至1611年威廉·斯特雷奇又记下约500个词；史密斯还提到一种波瓦坦混合语，但详情已无从查考。1607年建立詹姆斯敦的英国移民在粮食上依赖波瓦坦人，不得不学习他们的语言；英语从波瓦坦语借入的词比从北美东部其他任何原住民语言都多，莫卡辛鞋、战斧、浣熊、负鼠、山核桃、柿子、玉米粥和水龟等词都来自波瓦坦语。1622年波瓦坦人起事及其后的殖民战争打散、驱散了波瓦坦各部，波瓦坦语也逐渐退出了日常生活。

en: Puquina, also spelled Pukina, is an extinct language once spoken around Lake Titicaca in what is now Peru and Bolivia, with its range reaching into northern Chile. It is often linked to the people who built the city of Tiwanaku, and at the time of the Spanish conquest several highland groups, including the Chiribaya, still spoke it. Its genetic classification remains uncertain: a distant relationship with the Arawakan languages of the Amazon has been suggested but never proven. What is known of the language rests mainly on one colonial document, the Rituale seu Manuale Peruanum printed in 1607 by the Franciscan Luis Jeronimo de Ore, together with scattered glosses. As Quechua and Spanish spread through the southern Andes, Puquina retreated and ceased to be an everyday language in the centuries after the conquest, leaving a substrate in local speech around Arequipa, Moquegua and Tacna. Much of its vocabulary survives in Kallawaya, the secret mixed language of Bolivian travelling herbalists, which pairs Puquina words with Quechua grammar. Early writers also applied the name Puquina to the unrelated Uru language, a confusion that still complicates the sources.
zh: 普基纳语是一种已消亡的语言，曾通行于今秘鲁与玻利维亚交界处的的的喀喀湖周边，使用范围还延伸到智利北部。它常被认为与修建蒂亚瓦纳科城的文明有关；西班牙征服时期，包括奇里瓦亚人在内的若干高原族群仍在使用这种语言。它的系属仍无定论，有学者推测它与亚马逊地区的阿拉瓦克语族有远亲关系，但始终缺乏确证。学界对普基纳语的了解主要依赖一份殖民时代文献——方济各会修士奥雷于1607年印行的《秘鲁礼仪手册》，以及零星的词汇注释。随着克丘亚语和西班牙语在安第斯南部扩散，普基纳语在征服后的几个世纪里日渐萎缩，最终不再作为日常语言使用，只在阿雷基帕、莫克瓜和塔克纳一带的口语中留下底层痕迹。它的大量词汇保存在卡拉瓦亚语中：这种由玻利维亚游方草药郎中使用的秘密混合语言，以普基纳语词汇配上克丘亚语语法。早期作者还常把毫无亲缘关系的乌鲁语也称作普基纳语，这一名称上的混淆仍困扰着相关研究。

en: Pumé, long known to outsiders as Yaruro, is a language isolate of the great Llanos grasslands west of the Orinoco in Venezuela, spoken along the Meta, Apure, Cinaruco and Arauca rivers. The people call themselves Pumé, meaning real human, and their tongue pũmɛ̃ mãɛ̃́, the language of the Pumé; Yaruro was the name used by neighbouring peoples and taken up by the early Spanish explorers who crossed the plains in the sixteenth century, and it carries a mocking undertone in the local languages. Pumé society splits between river villagers who garden, fish and hunt, and the nomadic Savanna Pumé, who move camp with the dry and wet seasons and live by bow-and-arrow hunting and gathering wild tubers. Filippo Salvatore Gilii already treated the language as an isolate in his Saggio di storia americana of 1782, and later linguists have only tentatively suggested distant links to the extinct Esmeraldeño tongue or the Chocoan family. Missions and ranch settlements long remained thin on these floodplains, so most Pumé bands kept their language and mobile way of life throughout the colonial period.
zh: 普梅语在外界长期被称为雅鲁罗语，是委内瑞拉奥里诺科河以西辽阔亚诺斯草原上的一门孤立语言，通行于梅塔河、阿普雷河、锡纳鲁科河和阿劳卡河沿岸。普梅人自称 Pumé，意为“真正的人”，称自己的语言为 pũmɛ̃ mãɛ̃́，即“普梅人的语言”；“雅鲁罗”本是邻族对他们的称呼，16世纪穿越草原的早期西班牙探险者沿用了这个名字，它在当地语言里还带有一点嘲弄意味。普梅社会分为两支：沿河而居、务农捕鱼兼狩猎的河居普梅人，以及随旱季和雨季迁徙、靠弓箭狩猎和采集野块茎为生的游牧草原普梅人。菲利波·萨尔瓦托雷·吉利在1782年的《美洲史论》中已把普梅语视为孤立语言，后来的语言学家也只是谨慎地推测它与已消亡的埃斯梅拉尔达语或乔科语系有远亲关系。传教站和牧场在这些泛滥平原上长期稀少，因此在整个殖民时期，大多数普梅人群体都保住了自己的语言和游居生活方式。

en: Punjabi is an Indo-Aryan language of the Punjab, the land of the five eastern tributaries of the Indus, whose name comes from the Persian Panj-ab, or five waters. It belongs to the northwestern group, is closest to Sindhi, and is unusual among Indo-Aryan languages for its lexical tones. It grew out of the Prakrits and their Apabhramsha descendants, emerging around the 7th century and stabilizing by the 10th; its earliest surviving writings are the vernacular compositions of Nath yogis from the 9th century onward, and Amir Khusrau in 1317 called the speech of Lahore Lahauri. Muslim rule brought a heavy influx of Persian and Arabic vocabulary, and medieval written Punjabi was carried above all by Sufi poets such as Baba Farid and Bulleh Shah, while the Sikh gurus used its related Sant Bhasha in the Guru Granth Sahib; Waris Shah continued the vernacular tradition in the 18th century. It was written in several scripts, chiefly the Perso-Arabic Shahmukhi and the Indic Gurmukhi, though Persian, not Punjabi, remained the language of administration under the Mughals and the Sikh Empire, until the East India Company dropped Persian for governance in 1837.
zh: 旁遮普语是印度—雅利安语支的语言，通行于印度河东部五条支流流经的旁遮普地区，其名来自波斯语，意为五河之地。它属于印度—雅利安诸语的西北组，与信德语关系最近，还以词汇声调著称，这在同语支语言中并不常见。旁遮普语由普拉克里特俗语及其后继的阿帕布拉姆沙变体演变而来，约7世纪成形、10世纪定型；现存最早的文字是9世纪以后纳特瑜伽修士的方言诗作，1317年阿米尔·霍斯陆把拉合尔一带的口语称作拉豪里语。穆斯林统治使大量波斯语和阿拉伯语词汇涌入，中世纪的书面旁遮普语主要靠巴巴·法里德、布勒·沙阿等苏菲诗人传承，锡克教祖师则在《古鲁·格兰特·萨希卜》中使用与它相近的圣徒语，18世纪瓦里斯·沙阿延续了这一方言文学传统。它曾有数种书写系统，主要是波斯—阿拉伯体系的沙木基字母和印度体系的古木基文，但在莫卧儿帝国和锡克帝国治下，行政语言一直是波斯语而非旁遮普语，直到1837年英国东印度公司下令停止以波斯语理政。

en: Purepecha, often called Tarascan in older Spanish sources, is a language isolate with no proven relationship to any other language, spoken in the highlands of Michoacan around Lake Patzcuaro. It was the tongue of the Purepecha Empire, which according to the Relacion de Michoacan took shape around 1300, when the Uacusecha leader Tariacuri united the lakeside communities from his base at Patzcuaro. Under his successors the state expanded to Lake Cuitzeo, the Toluca Valley and, by 1460, the Pacific coast at Zacatula, and through the fifteenth century it fought repeated wars with the Aztec Empire. At the Spanish conquest the ruling cazonci Tangaxuan II submitted peacefully, but his execution by Nuno de Guzman turned the region into a forcibly governed province; the bishop Vasco de Quiroga then founded hospital towns such as Santa Fe de la Laguna where Purepecha speakers kept a degree of protection. Franciscan friars gave the language a Latin alphabet, and Maturino Gilberti printed a grammar in 1558 and a dictionary in 1559, followed by the grammar and dictionary of Juan Bautista de Lagunas in 1574. The colonial literary record also includes confessionaries, land titles and chronicles, and the language survives in several lake, highland and canada dialects.
zh: 普雷佩查语在较早的西班牙文献中常称塔拉斯科语，是一门与其他语言都没有确定亲缘关系的孤立语，通行于米却肯州帕茨夸罗湖一带的高地。它是普雷佩查帝国的语言：据《米却肯记述》记载，约1300年，瓦库塞查人的首领塔里亚库里以帕茨夸罗为基地统一了湖畔诸社群。其后继者把国家扩展到奎采奥湖、托卢卡河谷，并在1460年推进到太平洋沿岸的萨卡图拉；整个15世纪，普雷佩查与阿兹特克帝国战争不断。西班牙征服时，统治者卡松西坦加胡安二世和平归顺，但他被努尼奥·德·古斯曼处死，当地遂变为受武力统治的行省；主教巴斯科·德基罗加随后建立了拉古纳圣菲等医院镇，使说普雷佩查语的居民得到一定庇护。方济各会修士为它引入拉丁字母，马图里诺·吉尔贝蒂于1558年出版语法、1559年出版词典，胡安·包蒂斯塔·德·拉古纳斯又在1574年推出语法和词典。殖民时期的文献还包括告解手册、地契和编年史；该语言分为湖区、高地和卡尼亚达等多种方言。

en: Pyemmairrener, or Northeastern Tasmanian, was an Aboriginal language of northeastern Tasmania, spoken around Cape Portland and Ben Lomond. It is attested only in word lists recorded in the 1830s by George Augustus Robinson and his son Charles, from which later scholars reconstructed the language and its name.
zh: 皮艾梅伦纳语又称东北塔斯马尼亚语，是塔斯马尼亚岛东北角波特兰角和本洛蒙德一带原住民的语言。它仅见于19世纪30年代乔治·奥古斯都·鲁宾逊父子记录的词表，后世学者据此构拟出这种语言及其名称。

en: Qiangic is a cluster of Sino-Tibetan languages spoken in the mountains of western Sichuan and northern Yunnan, along the eastern edge of the Tibetan plateau. Its members include Qiang, whose speakers call themselves Rma, the Gyalrong languages, Muya or Minyak, Pumi and, in some classifications, Baima; the extinct Tangut language of the Western Xia state of 1038 to 1227 is also placed here by many linguists. Peoples labelled Qiang appear in Chinese records from the Shang oracle bones of the second millennium BCE as pastoral tribes on the western frontier, who drifted south-west as Han power expanded. By the Ming dynasty the name belonged to the highland communities of the upper Min River. Qiangic languages stand out among the languages of China for their elaborate verb morphology and pronominal systems, and most have no established written tradition of their own.
zh: 羌语支是汉藏语系的一组语言，通行于青藏高原东缘的四川西部和云南北部山区，成员包括使用者自称尔玛的羌语、嘉绒语、木雅语、普米语，以及在部分分类中归入该支的白马语；许多语言学家还把1038年至1227年西夏国已消亡的西夏语列入其中。被统称为“羌”的人群在公元前两千纪的商代甲骨文中已有记载，他们原是西部边境的游牧部落，随着中原王朝向西扩张而逐渐向西南迁徙，到明代时，“羌”这个名称已专指岷江上游的高地族群。羌语支语言以复杂的动词形态和代词体系著称，在中国境内的语言中相当少见，其中大多数没有自己成熟的书面传统。

en: Quechuan, called runa simi or people's language by its speakers, is a family of related languages whose homeland lay in central Peru and which had already spread across much of the central Andes long before the Incas, possibly carried in earlier centuries by the expansion of Wari. In 1337 it existed as a patchwork of regional varieties spoken by peoples such as the Wanka, Chanka and Chincha, while the Incas of Cuzco were still only one small Quechuan-speaking chiefdom; the Cuzco variety carried a strong Aymara substratum. From the 1430s the conquests of Pachacuti and his successors turned Quechua into the official lingua franca of an empire stretching from Ecuador to central Chile, planting Kichwa in the northern highlands and linking subject peoples from Quito to Tucumán. After the Spanish invasion of the 1530s Quechua kept its role as the common tongue of the Andes: the crown recognized it, friars used it for evangelization, and Domingo de Santo Tomás printed the first Quechua grammar at Valladolid in 1560. Its standing collapsed only after the great Túpac Amaru II rebellion of 1780, when the colonial government banned public use of the language and proscribed Quechua books, though the independence era of the early nineteenth century brought a short-lived revival.
zh: 克丘亚语被使用者称为“鲁纳西米”，意为“人的语言”，是一族互有关联的语言，发源地在秘鲁中部，早在印加人崛起之前很久就已扩散到安第斯山脉中部的广大地区，其早期传播可能与瓦里帝国的扩张有关。1337年时，它已是由多种地区方言组成的语群，使用者包括万卡人、昌卡人、钦查人等族群，而库斯科的印加人当时还只是一个说克丘亚语的小酋邦；库斯科方言带有浓厚的艾马拉语底层。15世纪30年代起，帕查库特克及其继承者的征服把克丘亚语变成帝国的官方通用语，帝国疆域从厄瓜多尔延伸到智利中部，基奇瓦语由此被植入北方高原，把从基多到图库曼的各臣服族群联系在一起。16世纪30年代西班牙入侵后，克丘亚语仍保有安第斯通用语的地位：王室承认它，修道士用它传教，多明戈·德·圣托马斯还于1560年在巴利亚多利德出版了第一部克丘亚语语法书。它的地位直到1780年图帕克·阿马鲁二世大起义后才一落千丈——殖民当局禁止公开使用这种语言并查禁克丘亚语书籍，只有19世纪初的独立时期曾带来短暂的复兴。

en: Quingnam, also called Chimú or the fisherman's language, was the language of Chimor, the kingdom that arose on the desert coast of northern Peru around the year 900 with its sprawling adobe capital at Chan Chan. As Chimú conquests advanced, Quingnam became the official tongue along the coastal valleys from the Jequetepeque and Chicama rivers south to Paramonga and the Chillón valley near Lima, used alongside Mochica in the north and a coastal Quechua dialect in the south; its reduplicating place names still mark the region. The Incas under Topa Inca Yupanqui absorbed Chimor around 1470 and moved mitma colonies about the empire, but the language survived into Spanish times, when friars wrote grammars of it that have since been lost, leaving little beyond a numeral list, proper names and scattered words, and chroniclers complained of its obscure, slippery pronunciation. Epidemics, forced labour in mines and plantations, and the magnetic pull of the new Spanish city of Trujillo beside Chan Chan broke its transmission, and Quingnam was extinct by 1763. It is distinct from the better-known Mochica to its north, though some scholars group both, together with Sechura and more dubiously the remote Cañari and Puruhá tongues, in a wider Chimuan family.
zh: 金南语又称奇穆语或“渔人语”，是奇莫尔王国的语言。该王国约于900年在秘鲁北部沙漠海岸兴起，以土坯铺展的大城昌昌为都。随着奇穆人的征服推进，金南语成为从北部的赫克特佩克河、奇卡马河谷向南直到帕拉蒙加和利马附近奇永河谷一带沿海谷地的官方语言，在北方与莫奇卡语、在南方与沿海克丘亚方言并行使用，当地那些叠词构成的地名仍留有它的印记。1470年前后，图帕克·印卡·尤潘基治下的印加人吞并奇莫尔，并把米特马克移民群迁往帝国各处，但金南语一直存续到西班牙殖民时代；当时修士们曾写过它的语法书，可惜均已散佚，最终除一份数词表、人名地名和零星词汇外所剩无几，编年史家还抱怨它发音含混拗口。疫病、矿山和种植园的苦役，以及昌昌旁边新兴西班牙城市特鲁希略的强大吸引力，最终打断了它的传承，到1763年金南语已经消亡。它与北方更为人知的莫奇卡语并不相同，不过有些学者把两者连同塞丘拉语，以及更牵强的、远方的卡尼亚尔语和普鲁瓦语一起，归入一个更大的奇穆语族。

en: Rajasthani is the Western Indo-Aryan language group of the arid lands of Rajasthan and neighboring Malwa, Gujarat and Sindh, embracing Marwari, Mewari, Shekhawati, Harauti and several other varieties, with a literary standard built chiefly on Marwari. Its roots lie in the Gurjar Apabhramsha, whose grammar was described by the Jain scholar Hemachandra, and a distinct Rajasthani speech is noted in sources from the 700s, although a shared linguistic identity crystallized only in the 1700s. Old Western Rajasthani, also called Dingal, was the medium of Charan bards, who composed heroic couplets and court chronicles, while a second style, Pingal, blended it with the Brij Bhasha used by the Krishna poets. Long written for trade in the Mahajani script, whose optional vowel marks leave much to the reader's context, Rajasthani later shifted to Devanagari in India and to a Perso-Arabic hand among the merchants settled in Sindh.
zh: 拉贾斯坦语是西印度—雅利安语支下的一组语言，通行于拉贾斯坦及其邻近的马尔瓦、古吉拉特和信德一带，包含马尔瓦里语、梅瓦里语、谢卡瓦蒂语、哈劳蒂语等多种变体，文学标准语主要以马尔瓦里语为基础。它源自古吉拉特阿帕布拉姆沙语，耆那教学者金月曾为这种俗语编写语法；早在8世纪的文献中已提到拉贾斯坦一带有独立的语言，但共同的语言认同到18世纪才形成。古西拉贾斯坦语又称丁格尔语，是查兰吟游诗人创作英雄双行诗和宫廷编年史的媒介；另一种平格尔文体则把它与黑天诗人使用的布拉杰语相融合。拉贾斯坦语长期用商人的马哈詹尼字母记账，这种字母元音符号可有可无、多靠上下文推断，后来在印度改用天城文，移居信德的商人则使用波斯—阿拉伯字体。

en: The Ramu languages are a family of about thirty Papuan tongues spoken along the Ramu River and the neighbouring waterways of the Sepik–Ramu basin in northern Papua New Guinea. The Ramu rises in the Kratke Range and runs some 640 kilometres north-west to the Bismarck Sea, and for millennia its villages have drawn food, transport and their whole way of life from the river. Classifiers commonly join the family with the Lower Sepik languages in a wider Ramu–Lower Sepik grouping, though Ramu itself remains one of the least documented language groups of the basin. Its branches include the Ottilien family and the lexically divergent Grass languages, of which Banaro shares remarkably few cognates with the rest of Ramu speech; Rao and Aruamu are among the other riverine languages of the group. European ships first reached this coast in 1827, when Dumont d'Urville charted the nearby Astrolabe Bay, while the Ramu villages themselves stayed beyond outside reach for decades longer.
zh: 拉穆诸语是一个包含约三十种巴布亚语言的语族，沿拉穆河及巴布亚新几内亚北部塞皮克—拉穆盆地的邻近水道通行。拉穆河发源于克拉特克岭，向西北奔流约640公里注入俾斯麦海；数千年来，河畔村落的食物、交通乃至全部生活方式都取自这条河。分类学者通常把该语族与下塞皮克诸语合并为更大的拉穆—下塞皮克语群，不过拉穆语族本身仍是盆地内记录最薄弱的语群之一。它的分支包括奥托利恩语组和词汇分歧很大的格拉斯诸语，其中巴纳罗语与拉穆其他语言的同源词少得出奇；拉奥语和阿鲁阿穆语也是该语族中依河而居的语言。欧洲船只最早于1827年抵达这片海岸，迪蒙·迪维尔测绘了附近的阿斯特罗莱布湾，而拉穆河畔的村落与外界隔绝的时间还要再长数十年。

en: Rapa Nui is an Eastern Polynesian language spoken on Easter Island, the isolated southeastern outpost of Polynesia, whose first recorded European visitor, the Dutch explorer Jacob Roggeveen, landed on Easter Sunday in 1722. Within Eastern Polynesian the language stands somewhat apart: its grammar most closely resembles Marquesan, while its sound system is conservative like that of Māori, retaining consonants that related languages have lost, and most of its vocabulary descends directly from Proto-Eastern Polynesian. Before that contact the islanders may have recorded the older form of the language in rongorongo, a system of glyphs cut into wooden tablets in alternating lines and mastered by a small literate elite who treated the tablets as sacred. The glyphs are undeciphered, so the older spoken language survives chiefly in chants and oral tradition.
zh: 拉帕努伊语是通行于复活节岛的东波利尼西亚语言，而复活节岛是波利尼西亚东南端与世隔绝的前哨；1722年复活节当天，荷兰探险家雅各布·罗赫芬首次有记载地抵达该岛。在东波利尼西亚诸语中它自成一支：语法上最接近马克萨斯语，语音却像毛利语一样保守，保留了亲属语言已经丢失的辅音，词汇大多直接继承自原始东波利尼西亚语。在与外界接触之前，岛民可能曾用朗戈朗格文字记录这种语言的古老形态：这套刻在木板上的符号采用往返换向的行款，只有少数识字精英能够掌握，木板也被当作圣物。这些符号未能释读，更早期的口语主要保存在吟唱和口传传统之中。

en: Rawa, also recorded as Erawa or Erewa, is one of the Finisterre languages, a family placed within the Trans–New Guinea phylum and spoken in the rugged Finisterre Range of north-eastern Papua New Guinea. The range rises as a steep barrier between the Ramu and Markham valleys to the south and Vitiaz Strait to the north, and Rawa itself splits into two dialects, Rawa and Karo, used on opposite sides of the mountains. It is one of the largest members of its family alongside Wantoat and Yopno. Comparative work ties the Finisterre languages to the neighbouring Huon languages: a small closed set of verbs takes pronominal object prefixes, some of them clearly cognate across the two groups, which linguists take as strong evidence of common descent. The coastal waters immediately below these mountains, the Huon Gulf and Vitiaz Strait, were first entered by European ships in the 1790s with the French expedition of d'Entrecasteaux, while the high valleys of the Rawa remained far longer untouched by outside contact.
zh: 拉瓦语又记作埃拉瓦语，是菲尼斯特雷语群的语言之一；该语群属跨新几内亚语系，通行于巴布亚新几内亚东北部崎岖的菲尼斯特雷岭。这条山脉横亘在南侧的拉穆河、马卡姆河谷与北侧的维蒂亚兹海峡之间，形成一道险峻屏障；拉瓦语本身也因山势分为拉瓦和卡罗两种方言，分别通行于山脉两侧。它与万托阿特语、约普诺语并列，是该语群中使用规模最大的语言之一。比较研究把菲尼斯特雷诸语与邻近的休恩诸语联系在一起：两语群都有一小类封闭动词带代词性宾语前缀，其中一些前缀明显同源，语言学者视之为共同起源的有力证据。1790年代，当特尔卡斯托率领的法国探险队首次驾船驶入山下的休恩湾和维蒂亚兹海峡水域，而拉瓦人所在的高山谷地与外界隔绝的时间则要长得多。

en: Refaluwasch, meaning people of the deep sea, is both the self-name of the Carolinian people and their language, a Chuukic member of the Micronesian group spoken on Saipan and the other Northern Mariana Islands. It forms part of a dialect continuum reaching back to the Caroline atolls, and is closest to Satawalese, Woleaian and Puluwatese, sharing roughly four-fifths of its vocabulary even with Chuukese. For centuries its speakers sailed the sawei tribute route to Yap, until the wars of the Spanish conquest of Guam broke the habit; the navigator Luito reopened the sea road by reaching Guam in 1778, and Carolinian canoes were again trading at Talofofo Bay in 1788. On Guam the official Luis de Torres studied the language between 1795 and 1797 and mapped its dialects, leaving the earliest written records. In 1815 a typhoon ruined the atolls of Elato and Satawal, and their chiefs Nguschul and Aghurubw led about 900 people in 120 canoes to the then nearly empty island of Saipan, where they founded the village of Arabwal and made Refaluwasch the language of the Northern Marianas' newest community.
zh: “雷法卢瓦什”意为深海之民，既是加罗林人的自称，也是他们语言的名字。这种语言属于密克罗尼西亚语族的楚克语支，通行于塞班岛和北马里亚纳群岛其他岛屿。它是一条延伸回加罗林环礁的方言连续体的一部分，与萨塔瓦莱斯语、沃莱艾语和普卢瓦特语最亲，即便与楚克语也有约五分之四的词汇相通。许多世纪里，说这种语言的人沿着“萨维”朝贡航路前往雅浦，直到西班牙征服关岛的战争打断了这一传统；航海家卢伊托于1778年抵达关岛，重新打通海路，1788年加罗林独木舟又出现在塔洛福福湾做买卖。1795年至1797年，关岛官员路易斯·德·托雷斯研究这种语言并梳理了它的各方言，留下了最早的书面记录。1815年，一场台风摧毁了埃拉托和萨塔瓦尔环礁，两位酋长恩古舒尔和阿格鲁布率领约900人、120条独木舟迁往当时几乎空无一人的塞班岛，在那里建立阿拉伯瓦尔村，使雷法卢瓦什语成为北马里亚纳这个新社群的语言。

en: Rejang is the Austronesian language of the Rejang people of south-western Sumatra, spoken on the cool Barisan slopes of Bengkulu in five dialects that run from Lebong and Curup in the highlands down to the Pesisir coast. It stands apart from the other Malayo-Polynesian languages of Sumatra: linguists link it instead with the Bidayuh languages of Borneo and place it within the Greater North Borneo group, fitting the Rejang tradition that their ancestors crossed the Karimata Strait from Sarawak and followed the Musi and Rawas rivers into the interior. The language long had no standardized writing. The Brahmic Rejang alphabet, also called Kaganga and kin to the Batak and Lontara scripts as one of the Ulu scripts, served chiefly for formal High Malay and for ritual texts, medical incantations and poetry, with the earliest surviving examples dating from the mid-1700s; the Latin alphabet came into use for Rejang itself only in modern times.
zh: 拉让语是苏门答腊西南部拉让人的南岛语，通行于明古鲁一带凉爽的巴里桑山坡，从高地的勒翁、朱鲁到沿海的佩西西尔，共有五种方言。它与苏门答腊其他马来—波利尼西亚语言关系疏远，语言学家反而把它和婆罗洲的比达友语联系起来，归入大北婆罗洲语群；这与拉让人的起源传说相吻合：祖先从沙捞越渡卡里马塔海峡，沿穆西河和拉瓦斯河深入内陆。拉让语长期没有规范文字。婆罗米系的拉让字母又称卡干加文，与巴塔克文、隆塔拉文同属乌卢字母群，主要用于正式的高级马来语以及宗教仪式文本、医咒和诗歌，现存最早实物见于18世纪中叶；拉丁字母直到近代才用来书写拉让语本身。

en: Reo Maohi is the Tahitian language, the leading member of the reo Mā'ohi, the Polynesian tongues of French Polynesia, and an Eastern Polynesian language spoken chiefly on the Society Islands. Closely related to Hawaiian, Māori and Paumotu, it was for centuries a purely spoken language, carried in oratory, song and the recitations of the traveling arioi society; when James Cook arrived in 1769 the Tahitian navigator Tupaia dictated lists of island names that the Endeavour's officers spelled out phonetically in English. Tahitian also reshaped its vocabulary through pi'i, the sacred name taboo: words resembling a chief's name were replaced, so that the old word tū for standing gave way to ti'a under King Tū-nui-ē'a-i-te-atua, grandfather of the Pōmare dynasty. In 1797 Protestant missionaries of the London Missionary Society landed from the ship Duff; Henry Nott, working with King Pōmare II, and John Davies fixed an alphabet of five vowels and nine consonants, Davies printed the first Tahitian book, a spelling book, in 1810, and the translated Bible became the text through which many Polynesians first learned to read.
zh: 毛希语即塔希提语，是“毛希诸语”（法属波利尼西亚诸波利尼西亚语言）中最主要的一种，属东波利尼西亚语群，主要通行于社会群岛。它与夏威夷语、毛利语和保莫图语亲缘密切，在漫长岁月里只有口语，靠演说、歌唱和云游的阿利奥伊社团的吟诵传承；1769年库克到来时，塔希提航海者图帕亚口述的一系列岛名，由“奋进号”上的军官用英语按发音拼出。塔希提语还通过名为“皮伊”的神圣名讳禁忌不断更新词汇：凡与首领名字相近的词都要替换，例如在波马雷王朝的先世图努伊埃阿国王在位时，表示“站立”的 tū 就被 ti'a 取代。1797年，伦敦传道会的新教传教士乘“达夫号”登岛；亨利·诺特与波马雷二世国王合作，约翰·戴维斯等人确定了由五个元音和九个辅音组成的字母表，戴维斯又于1810年印出第一本塔希提语拼字课本，而译成塔希提语的圣经后来成为许多波利尼西亚人学习读写的启蒙读本。

en: Romanian is the easternmost of the Romance languages, descended from the Vulgar Latin of the Roman provinces along the lower Danube, whose spoken forms, after the Roman withdrawal from Dacia in the third century and the Slavic settlement of the Balkans, developed into Common Romanian between the sixth and eighth centuries. By the tenth century this had split into a northern branch, Daco-Romanian and Istro-Romanian, and a southern branch, Aromanian and Megleno-Romanian, while Slavic speech supplied a large share of its vocabulary and Old Church Slavonic long served religion and the princely chanceries. Romanian itself was first written in Cyrillic letters in the later fifteenth century: the Hurmuzaki Psalter was copied around 1500 and Neacșu's letter of 1521 is the oldest precisely dated document. In 1780 the Transylvanian School printed its first grammar in Vienna, opening an age of re-latinization, school texts and a standardized literary language.
zh: 罗马尼亚语是罗曼语族最东边的一支，源自多瑙河下游罗马行省的通俗拉丁语。3世纪罗马撤出达契亚、斯拉夫人入居巴尔干之后，这些口语在6—8世纪发展为共同罗马尼亚语；到10世纪，它分化为北支的达科-罗马尼亚语和伊斯特拉-罗马尼亚语，以及南支的阿罗马尼亚语和梅戈来诺-罗马尼亚语。斯拉夫语为它提供了大量词汇，古教会斯拉夫语则长期用于宗教和王公文书。罗马尼亚语本身在15世纪后半叶才开始用西里尔字母书写：《胡尔穆扎基诗篇》约抄成于1500年，1521年的《尼亚克舒书信》是现存最早、年代确切的文书。1780年，特兰西瓦尼亚学派在维也纳印行第一部罗马尼亚语语法，开启了重新拉丁化、编写学校教材和规范文学语言的时代。

en: Rotokas is a Papuan language of Bougainville Island in Papua New Guinea, and the main member of the Rotokas branch of the small North Bougainville family, which also includes the Eivo language and the more distantly related Keriaka and Konua; an older scheme placed these languages in a proposed East Papuan grouping. It is spoken in the centre of the island and splits into Central Rotokas, Aita Rotokas and Pipipaia dialects. Central Rotokas holds one of the smallest sound systems known anywhere, with only six consonants and five vowels and no phonemic nasals, while the Aita dialect keeps nine consonants including nasals. The language is verb-final and is written with a twelve-letter Latin alphabet. The first settlers of Bougainville reached the island in the remote Paleolithic past, and Austronesian seafarers arrived in the second millennium BCE; the first European to land was the French explorer Louis Antoine de Bougainville in 1768, after whom the island is named.
zh: 罗托卡斯语是巴布亚新几内亚布干维尔岛的一种巴布亚语，是北布干维尔小语系中罗托卡斯语支的主要成员；该语系还包括艾沃语以及亲缘较远的克里亚卡语和科努阿语，较早的分类方案曾把这些语言归入拟议中的东巴布亚语群。它通行于岛的中部，分为中部罗托卡斯、艾塔罗托卡斯和皮皮帕亚三种方言。中部方言的音系是已知最小的音系之一，只有6个辅音和5个元音，没有音位性鼻音；艾塔方言则保留了包括鼻音在内的9个辅音。罗托卡斯语动词居句末，使用一套12个字母的拉丁字母文字。布干维尔岛在遥远的旧石器时代即有人类定居，南岛语航海者在公元前第二个千年抵达；1768年法国探险家路易·安托万·德·布干维尔成为第一个登岛的欧洲人，该岛便以他的姓氏命名。

en: Rotuman, self-called Fäeag Rotuạm, is an Austronesian language spoken on the remote island of Rotuma, north of Fiji, whose people were shaped by settlers from Samoa, Tonga and the eastern Polynesian islands, leaving the language heavy with Samoan and Tongan loanwords. In the seventeenth century Tongan forces occupied Rotuma until the islanders overthrew them in a single night of uprising. The language is famous among linguists for its metathesis: the final vowel of a word swaps places with the consonant before it, producing umlaut, diphthongs and long and short forms of words, and unlike most of its Pacific neighbours it follows an agent–verb–object order. Its Latin-script spelling marks the glottal stop with a turned comma and uses special dotted vowels. The first confirmed European sighting of the island was by Captain Edward Edwards of HMS Pandora in 1791, while he was searching for the Bounty mutineers.
zh: 罗图马语（自称费亚格罗图姆）是南太平洋孤岛罗图马岛上的南岛语，该岛位于斐济以北。岛上居民融合了来自萨摩亚、汤加和东波利尼西亚诸岛的移民，使这种语言吸纳了大量萨摩亚语和汤加语借词。17世纪汤加军队曾占领罗图马，最终岛民在一夜起义中推翻了占领者。这种语言令语言学家着迷的是它的音位交替：词末元音与紧邻在前的辅音换位，由此产生元音变音、双元音以及词的长短两种形式；与太平洋多数邻语不同，它采用施事—动词—宾语语序。它的拉丁字母拼写法用倒置逗号标示喉塞音，并使用带点的特殊元音。欧洲人首次有确证地望见该岛是在1791年，当时皇家海军“潘多拉号”的爱德华·爱德华兹船长正在搜寻“邦蒂号”哗变者。

en: Roviana is an Oceanic language of the Northwest Solomonic branch, spoken around the Roviana and Vonavona lagoons on the north-central coast of New Georgia in the Solomon Islands. During the 1800s it was carried along the inter-island trade and raiding routes of the New Georgia group and became a trade language and a regional lingua franca, used in particular for Christian teaching among the neighbouring island communities. Its grammar is marked by syntactic ergativity, with verb agreement tracking the ergative argument of a transitive clause, and its yes-no questions differ from statements only by a rising intonation.
zh: 罗维阿纳语属于泛太平洋语系的西北所罗门语支，通行于所罗门群岛新乔治亚岛中北部沿岸的罗维阿纳潟湖和沃纳沃纳潟湖一带。19世纪，它随着新乔治亚群岛的岛际贸易和远航路线向外传播，成为贸易语言和地区通用语，尤其用于向邻近岛屿社群宣讲基督教义。它的语法以句法作格性为标志，动词一致关系追踪及物分句的作格论元；是非问句与陈述句结构相同，只靠升调区别。

en: Rufiji-Ruvuma is a group of closely related Bantu languages spoken in the belt between the Rufiji and Ruvuma rivers in southern Tanzania, with related varieties reaching northern Mozambique and the southern end of Lake Malawi. It joins the Rufiji or Matandu cluster, including Matumbi and Ndengereko, to the Ruvuma cluster of Yao-Mwera and Makonde, together with Ngindo, Ndendeule and the Ngoni language of the Songea area. Matumbi, called Kimatuumbi by its speakers, is heard south of the Rufiji around Kilwa, where its neighbours Ngindo and Ndengereko are its closest kin. The Yao tongue, the most widely travelled of the group, was carried west by caravan traders who exchanged ivory and grain for cloth and weapons with Arab and Swahili merchants on the coast; around 1830 Yao groups began settling toward the southern shore of Lake Malawi, taking their language with them.
zh: 鲁菲吉‑鲁武马语是一组关系相近的班图语言，通行于坦桑尼亚南部鲁菲吉河与鲁武马河之间的地带，相近的分支还分布到莫桑比克北部和马拉维湖最南端。它把以马图姆比语、恩登盖雷科语为代表的鲁菲吉（马坦杜）语群，与约奥—姆韦拉语、马孔德语组成的鲁武马语群归在一起，还包括恩金多语、恩登德莱语和松盖亚一带的恩戈尼语。马图姆比语的使用者自称其语言为基马图姆比语，通行于鲁菲吉河以南的基尔瓦一带，与邻近的恩金多语、恩登盖雷科语亲缘最近。语群中传播最远的是约奥语：商队商人带着它西去，用象牙和谷物同海岸的阿拉伯、斯瓦希里商人交换布匹和武器；1830年前后，约奥人开始向马拉维湖南岸迁徙，也把语言带到那里。

en: Rukwa denotes the Rukwa group of Bantu languages spoken around Lake Rukwa and the southern end of Lake Tanganyika in southwestern Tanzania, comprising Fipa, Pimbwe, Rungwa, Safwa, Nyakyusa, Nyiha and Mambwe-Lungu among others. The Fipa of the Ufipa plateau built centralised chiefdoms ruled by dynasties of iron-smiths, who traded their iron for woven cloth.
zh: 鲁夸语指鲁夸语群，是通行于坦桑尼亚西南部鲁夸湖周边与坦噶尼喀湖南端的一组班图语，包括菲帕语、平布韦语、隆瓜语、萨富瓦语、尼亚库萨语、尼哈语和曼布韦-伦古语等。乌菲帕高原上的菲帕人建立了集权酋邦，由世代冶铁的王朝统治，以铁器交换织物。

en: Rumu, also recorded as Rumuwa, Kairi or Dumu, is a Papuan language of the Papuan Gulf lowlands, spoken in the Kikori district of Gulf Province around the lower courses of the Kikori, Sirebi and Tiviri rivers, where mangrove forest and freshwater swamp meet the rainforest. It belongs to the small Turama–Kikorian family named after the Turama and Kikori rivers, yet within that family it stands apart as a divergent branch, its pronoun forms pointing toward a link with the wider Trans–New Guinea stock. It is not to be confused with the unrelated Porome language, which also bears the name Kibiri in older sources. The Rumu-speaking villages lie on a river network that carried trade and marriage ties between the gulf and the peoples of the interior. The coast beyond the delta was first seen by Europeans when Torres sailed past in 1606, though the Kikori swamps themselves remained unvisited by outsiders until long afterward.
zh: 卢穆语又记为卢穆瓦语、凯里语或杜穆语，是巴布亚湾低地的一种巴布亚语言，通行于海湾省基科里县基科里河、西雷比河和蒂维里河下游一带，那里红树林、淡水沼泽与雨林相接。它属于以图拉马河和基科里河命名的图拉马-基科里小语族，但在语族内部是一条分歧很大的支系，其代词形式显示它与更大的跨新几内亚语系存在联系。它不应与没有亲缘关系的波罗梅语混淆，后者在较早资料里也叫基比里语。卢穆语村落所在的河网承载着海湾与内陆诸族之间的贸易和联姻往来。1606年托雷斯航行驶过，三角洲外的海岸第一次被欧洲人看见，但基科里沼泽本身在此后很久仍无外来者涉足。

en: Ruthenian is the South-Western branch of East Slavic, descended from the Old East Slavic of Kievan Rus and carried after the Mongol sack of Kiev in 1240 through the western Rus lands that fell to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. Its speakers called it ruska mova or prosta mova, the simple speech, as against Church Slavonic, while Latin records named it lingua ruthenica and its chancery form is called Chancery Slavonic. From the 1300s the grand-ducal chancery in Vilnius shaped it on a Polissian dialect base into the Grand Duchy's official language, and all three Statutes of Lithuania, of 1529, 1566 and 1588, were written in it. Francysk Skaryna of Polotsk printed a twenty-three-book Bible at Prague between 1517 and 1519 and opened the first printing house in Vilnius in 1522, the earliest printed books in an East Slavic vernacular. The Union of Lublin of 1569 drew Lithuania into the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, and the grand duchy gave up Chancery Slavonic for Middle Polish; the nobility Polonised, but the Orthodox peasantry kept the old speech. The Cossack rising of 1648 under Bohdan Khmelnytsky showed how far Ruthenian had drawn apart from Muscovite Russian, whose letters now needed translators. By the early 1700s the common tongue had split into a Polonised early Belarusian and a more Church-Slavonic early Ukrainian, both becoming separate standards by the end of the century, while the Carpathian highlands kept their own Rusyn vernacular.
zh: 鲁塞尼亚语是东斯拉夫语的西南支，源于基辅罗斯的古东斯拉夫语；1240年基辅遭蒙古人洗劫后，它在并入立陶宛大公国的西部罗斯诸地继续发展。使用者称之为“罗斯卡莫瓦”或“普罗斯塔莫瓦”，意为“简单的话”，与教会斯拉夫语相对；拉丁文献称其为鲁塞尼亚语，其公文书面形式则称“秘书室斯拉夫语”。14世纪起，维尔纽斯的大公国官署以波列西耶方言为基础，把它打造成立陶宛大公国的官方语言，1529、1566和1588年颁布的三部《立陶宛法令》都以它写成。波洛茨克人法兰斯克·斯卡利纳1517至1519年在布拉格印行二十三卷本圣经，又于1522年在维尔纽斯开办第一家印刷所，这些是东斯拉夫口语最早的印刷书籍。1569年卢布林联合使立陶宛并入波兰立陶宛联邦，大公国放弃秘书室斯拉夫语、改用中古波兰语；贵族纷纷波兰化，信奉东正教的农民却仍说旧语。1648年博格丹·赫梅利尼茨基领导的哥萨克起义，显示出鲁塞尼亚语与莫斯科俄语的差距之大——莫斯科来的信件已需译者才能读懂。到18世纪初，共同口语分化为波兰语色彩较浓的早期白俄罗斯语和教会斯拉夫语色彩较浓的早期乌克兰语，到18世纪末各自发展为独立的标准语，喀尔巴阡山区则保留了卢森尼亚土语。

en: Kinyarwanda, the national language of Rwanda, is a Bantu language of the Rwanda-Rundi dialect continuum, spoken also in adjoining parts of Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Tanzania. It is fully mutually intelligible with Kirundi, the national language of Burundi, and its other varieties include Rufumbira in Uganda and Kinyabwisha in North Kivu. Its speakers include all three of the country's peoples, the Tutsi, the Hutu and the hunter-gatherer Twa: Hutu farmers settled the hills around the year 1000, cattle-raising Tutsi moved in from the 1400s, and the centralised Rwandan kingdom grew up around the Gasabo hill between the fourteenth and sixteenth centuries. As the court expanded, Kinyarwanda spread with it, carrying the royal oral traditions and historical poems recited from memory rather than written, since the language had no standard orthography before the colonial era.
zh: 卢旺达语是卢旺达的国语，属班图语的卢旺达-基隆迪方言连续体，也通行于乌干达、刚果（金）和坦桑尼亚的毗邻地区。它与布隆迪国语基隆迪语完全互通，其他变体还有乌干达的鲁丰比拉语和北基伍的基尼亚布维沙语。说这种语言的人包括该国三大族群——图西人、胡图人和以狩猎采集为生的特瓦人：胡图农民约在1000年进入丘陵地带务农，牧牛的图西人自15世纪起迁入，而集权的卢旺达王国于14至16世纪在加萨博山一带兴起。随着宫廷扩张，卢旺达语也随之扩散，承载着王室口述传统与靠记诵而非书写流传的史诗经篇；在殖民时代之前，这种语言没有统一的文字。

en: Ryūkyū is the collective name for the indigenous languages of the Ryukyu Islands, the chain stretching from Amami and Okinawa south to Miyako, Yaeyama and Yonaguni; together with Japanese they form the Japonic family. Proto-Japonic settlers reached the islands in the first millennium, and long isolation let their speech diverge sharply from the Old Japanese of the mainland, so that the six recognized Ryukyuan languages, split into northern Amami-Okinawa and southern Miyako-Yaeyama groups, are not mutually intelligible with Japanese or with one another; Okinawan shares only about seventy-one percent of its vocabulary with standard Japanese. Under the Ryukyu Kingdom the Shuri dialect of Okinawa served as the regional standard. The court wrote in kanji and hiragana borrowed from Japan: a royal tomb inscription of 1501 survives, and from 1531 the court compiled the Omoro Sōshi, twenty-two volumes of ancient songs set mostly in hiragana, while distant Yonaguni kept its own set of glyphs. In 1609 the Satsuma Domain of Kyushu conquered the kingdom; official documents then moved toward classical Chinese, though poetry and song continued in the Shuri dialect. The languages kept archaic Japonic features lost on the mainland, including subject-object-verb order, mora rhythm and an old verbal inflection for focused clauses.
zh: 琉球语是琉球群岛各本土语言的统称，这串岛链从奄美、冲绳向南延至宫古、八重山和与那国；它们与日语同属日琉语族。说原始日语的定居者在公元1千纪抵达群岛，长期的隔绝使他们的语言与日本本土的古日语显著分化，因而公认的六种琉球语分为北琉球的奄美—冲绳组和南琉球的宫古—八重山组，彼此之间、与日语之间都不能互通，冲绳语与标准日语的词汇重合度仅约七成一。琉球国时期，冲绳的首里方言是全区域的通用标准。朝廷借用日本的汉字和平假名书写：1501年的王陵碑文仍存于世，1531年起朝廷又编纂《思草纸》，这部二十二卷的古代歌谣集主要以平假名写成，偏远的与那国岛则另有一套自造符号。1609年，九州的萨摩藩征服琉球国，此后官方文书改用汉文，诗歌与歌谣仍以首里方言创作。琉球语保留了日本本土已经消失的古老日琉语特征，如主宾语序、音拍节奏，以及焦点从句的古老动词变位。

en: Sa'a, also called South Malaita or Apae'aa, is an Oceanic language of the Austronesian family spoken on Small Malaita, the island off the southern tip of Malaita, and on nearby Ulawa in the Solomon Islands; like most Oceanic tongues it follows a subject-verb-object order. Austronesian seafarers settled Malaita between five thousand and thirty-five hundred years ago, and the speech of the south-eastern coast and Ulawa developed in village-based isolation into Sa'a, one of the many closely related languages of the Solomonic chain. The first Europeans to sight Malaita were the Spanish expedition of Álvaro de Mendaña, whose brigantine Santiago recorded the island in April 1568; after that the Solomons vanished from European maps for two centuries, and regular outside contact resumed only after the chain was rediscovered in the late eighteenth century. Sa'a had no script of its own and was maintained by oral tradition.
zh: 萨阿语又称南马莱塔语或阿帕埃阿语，是南岛语系的大洋洲语言，通行于所罗门群岛马莱塔岛南端外的南马莱塔岛以及附近的乌拉瓦岛；和多数大洋洲语言一样，它的基本语序为主谓宾。约五千至三千五百年前，南岛语航海者定居马莱塔，东南沿海与乌拉瓦的语言在以村落为单位的隔绝生活中演变为萨阿语，成为所罗门语链中众多近亲语言之一。1568年4月，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚率领的西班牙探险队乘双桅船圣地亚哥号首次望见并记录了马莱塔；此后所罗门群岛在欧洲地图上消失了两百年，直到18世纪末才被重新发现，外来接触随之恢复。萨阿语没有自己的文字，依靠口传传统延续。

en: Saharan is the game's grouping for the Nilo-Saharan vernaculars of the eastern Sahara and the Lake Chad belt, from the Tibesti mountains to Darfur and northern Nigeria. The Saharan family proper takes in the Teda and Daza speech of the Toubou clans, Zaghawa on the Chad-Darfur border, the Naba tongue of the Bilala, and the Kanuri-Kanembu continuum around Lake Chad; the Maban tongues Maba, Masalit and Runga of eastern Chad form a separate but related branch. Arab writers such as Ibn Qutaybah already noted the Toubou and Zaghawa in the 800s. Kanembu served the empire of Kanem, founded around 700 at Njimi, whose Sayfawa rulers adopted Islam in the 1000s and whose mai Dunama II Dibalemi controlled the trans-Saharan routes to the Fezzan in the 1200s, and it was later set down in Arabic Ajami script. Around 1380 the Bilala drove the Sayfawa from Njimi and ruled Kanem until the 1500s, while the court re-established itself in Bornu: Ali I Gaji founded Ngazargamu in about 1472, and Idris Alooma carried Kanem-Bornu to its peak in the late 1500s as court Kanembu merged into the Kanuri people. Farther east, the Maba under Abd al-Karim overthrew the Tunjur in 1635 and built the Wadai sultanate around Wara, whose Kolak rulers made Islam the state religion and shook off Darfur's overlordship before 1700.
zh: 撒哈拉语是游戏对撒哈拉东部与乍得湖地带诸尼罗—撒哈拉语言的归并，范围从提贝斯提山到达尔富尔和尼日利亚北部。严格意义上的撒哈拉语族包括图布人诸部使用的特达语和达扎语、乍得与达尔富尔边境的扎加瓦语、比拉勒人的纳巴语，以及乍得湖一带的卡努里—卡嫩布方言连续体；乍得东部的马巴语、马萨利特语和伦加语则属于独立但相近的马巴语族。早在9世纪，伊本·古泰白等阿拉伯著作家就已记载图布人和扎加瓦人。卡嫩布语是加涅姆帝国的语言：该国约700年以恩吉米为都建立，赛法瓦王朝的君主们于11世纪皈依伊斯兰教，13世纪的君主杜纳马·迪巴拉米控制了通往费赞的跨撒哈拉商路，卡嫩布语后来也用阿拉伯阿贾米字母书写。约1380年，比拉勒人把赛法瓦王朝逐出恩吉米，在加涅姆独立统治到16世纪；王朝宫廷则西迁博尔努，阿里·加吉约1472年兴建恩加扎尔加穆城，伊德里斯·阿卢马在16世纪末把加涅姆—博尔努帝国推向鼎盛，宫廷卡嫩布语也逐渐融入卡努里语。更东边，马巴人在阿卜杜勒·卡里姆率领下于1635年推翻通朱尔人，在瓦拉一带建立瓦达伊苏丹国，科拉克王朝立伊斯兰教为国教，并在1700年之前摆脱了达尔富尔的宗主权。

en: Sakao, also called Nkep or Nekep, is an Oceanic language spoken on the northeastern horn of Espiritu Santo, Vanuatu, around Port-Olry and Hog Harbour. Foreigners and linguists named it after the small offshore island of Sakao, which its own speakers call Ladhi. It has two dialects, the northern Port-Olry dialect and the more conservative southern Hog-Harbour dialect. Although closely related to its neighbour Tolomako, Sakao has undergone such drastic sound change, probably within the last thousand years, that the two are mutually unintelligible: Sakao permits unusual consonant clusters and builds long polysynthetic words, while its pronouns distinguish singular, dual, paucal and plural numbers. The Spanish expedition of Pedro Fernandes de Quiros made the first recorded European landfall on Espiritu Santo in 1606, and Louis de Bougainville and James Cook revisited the island in 1768 and 1774.
zh: 萨卡奥语又称恩凯普语，是瓦努阿图圣埃斯皮里图岛东北角、奥尔里港与霍格港一带通行的一种大洋洲语。外来者和语言学者以近海的萨卡奥小岛为它命名，而使用者自己把该岛称作拉齐。它分为北部的奥尔里港方言和较保守的南部霍格港方言。萨卡奥语与邻居托洛马科语虽为近亲，但可能在最近一千年内经历了剧烈的语音演变，以致两者无法互通：萨卡奥语允许罕见的辅音丛，并能构出很长的多式综合词，代词还区分单数、双数、少数和复数。1606年，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的西班牙探险队首次有记载地登上圣埃斯皮里图岛，布干维尔和库克又分别于1768年和1774年重访该岛。

en: Salishan is a family of more than twenty languages spread across the Pacific Northwest, from the coasts of British Columbia, Washington and Oregon inland to Idaho and Montana. It falls into the Coast Salish branch, including Lushootseed, Halkomelem, Squamish and Saanich, the Tsamosan and Tillamook branches on the outer coast, the isolated Nuxalk enclave on the central British Columbia coast, and the Interior Salish branch of the Fraser and Columbia plateaus, among them Secwepemctsín, Lillooet, Okanagan, Spokane and Flathead; Salish itself was originally the self-name of the Bitterroot Salish of Montana. The languages are famous for polysynthesis, agglutinative word-building, ejective consonants and reduplication, and some scholars argue they lack a strict noun-verb distinction. Coastal villages such as those of the Fraser estuary go back thousands of years. Spanish explorers entered the Strait of Georgia in 1791 and George Vancouver surveyed the coast the next year, while Simon Fraser descended the Fraser River in 1808; fur-trade posts from Fort Vancouver in 1824 to Fort Langley in 1827 and Fort Nisqually in 1833 then drew Salish-speaking peoples into the Hudson's Bay Company trade network, even as northern raiders and introduced epidemics struck their communities.
zh: 萨利什语是一个包含二十多种语言的语系，分布于太平洋西北地区，从不列颠哥伦比亚、华盛顿和俄勒冈的海岸一直延伸到爱达荷和蒙大拿内陆。它分为海岸萨利什语支（包括卢舒特西德语、哈尔科梅莱姆语、斯阔米什语和萨尼奇语等）、外海的察莫桑语支和蒂拉穆克语支、不列颠哥伦比亚中部海岸孤立的努哈尔克语“飞地”，以及弗雷泽河与哥伦比亚高原的内陆萨利什语支（如塞克维佩姆克语、利卢埃特语、奥卡纳根语、斯波坎语和弗拉塞德语等）；“萨利什”本是蒙大拿比特鲁特萨利什人的自称。这些语言以多式综合、黏着构词、挤喉辅音和重叠构形著称，有些学者还认为它们没有严格的名词与动词之分。弗雷泽河口等地的沿海村落已有数千年历史。1791年西班牙探险者进入乔治亚海峡，次年乔治·温哥华测绘了这片海岸；1808年西蒙·弗雷泽沿弗雷泽河顺流而下。此后，从1824年的温哥华堡、1827年的兰利堡到1833年的尼斯阔利堡，一连串贸易站把说萨利什语的族群纳入哈德逊湾公司的贸易网络，与此同时，来自北方的袭扰和外来疫病也不断打击他们的社区。

en: The Sama or Sinama languages form the Sama–Bajaw group of Malayo-Polynesian tongues, spoken by the Sama-Bajau, the boat- and shore-dwelling sea peoples of the Sulu Sea. Its members include Northern, Central and Southern Sama, Pangutaran Sama and Mapun of the Sulu archipelago, Yakan and Abaknon of the southern Philippines, and the West Coast and Indonesian Bajau of Sabah, Sulawesi and the eastern Indonesian islands, where the boat-dwelling Sama Dilaut are often called sea nomads. Although once classed with the Philippine languages, lexical evidence traces their origin to the Barito region of south-eastern Borneo, making them a sister branch of the Barito languages and of Malagasy within Greater Barito. The Sama-Bajau are thought to have taken shape around the Zamboanga Peninsula by about the year 800, and seaborne groups spread to Basilan, Sulu, Borneo and Sulawesi from the tenth century, before the Tausug arrived in Sulu in the thirteenth. They traded trepang, pearls and shark fin to China, accepted Islam by the sixteenth century and usually wrote their languages in the Jawi alphabet; the chronicler Pigafetta of the Magellan expedition already met people who made their dwellings in boats in 1521. Under the Sultanate of Sulu the Banguingui Sama served as crews and raiders alongside the Iranun in the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, and most Sama-Bajau also spoke the coastal trade languages wherever they settled.
zh: 萨马语又称锡纳马语，是马来—波利尼西亚语系下的萨马—巴瑶语支，由苏禄海以船为家或傍海而居的萨马—巴瑶人使用。它包括苏禄群岛的北萨马语、中萨马语、南萨马语、潘古塔兰萨马语和马蓬语，菲律宾南部的雅坎语和阿巴克农语，以及沙巴、苏拉威西和印尼东部诸岛的西海岸巴瑶语与印尼巴瑶语；其中居于船上的萨马迪劳人常被称为海上游牧民。萨马语曾被归入菲律宾语言，但词汇证据显示它起源于婆罗洲东南部的巴里托地区，是大巴里托语群中巴里托诸语和马达加斯加语的姊妹分支。据考订，萨马—巴瑶人约于800年在三宝颜半岛一带形成，10世纪起乘船扩散到巴西兰、苏禄、婆罗洲和苏拉威西，早于13世纪进入苏禄的陶苏格人。他们向中国出口海参、珍珠和鱼翅，16世纪前皈依伊斯兰教，语言通常用爪夷文书写；1521年麦哲伦船队的记载者皮加费塔已见到以船为屋的人。在苏禄苏丹国治下，18至19世纪初的巴兰吉尼萨马人曾与伊拉农人一道充当水手和劫掠者；无论迁居何处，多数萨马—巴瑶人还兼通当地的沿海贸易语言。

en: Sámi is the Uralic branch spoken by the indigenous Sámi across Sápmi, the northern belt of Fennoscandia from central Scandinavia to the Kola Peninsula, in ten or more languages of which Northern Sámi is the largest. Proto-Sámi took shape near the Gulf of Finland in the last millennium before Christ and spread north and west during the Iron Age, reaching central Scandinavia by about AD 500; as it expanded it absorbed the speech of older Paleo-European hunter-gatherers and took in Germanic loanwords. The languages fall into western and eastern groups separated in places by sharp boundaries, while more southerly varieties died out under the advance of Finnish and Karelian farming settlement, Kainuu Sámi disappearing in the eighteenth century. Written Sámi began with Protestant missionary work, when the Swedish and Lappish ABC Book appeared in 1638 with prayers and catechism in a regular Sámi form. Knud Leem published the first grammar in 1748, and in 1832 Rasmus Rask's reasoned Sámi grammar provided the phonemic notation on which the later Northern Sámi orthography was built.
zh: 萨米语是乌拉尔语系的一支，由原住民萨米人通行于芬诺斯坎迪亚北部的萨普米地带，范围从中斯堪的纳维亚延伸到科拉半岛，包含十多种语言，其中以北萨米语使用人数最多。原始萨米语在公元前最后一千年形成于芬兰湾附近，铁器时代向北、向西扩散，约在公元500年抵达斯堪的纳维亚中部；扩散过程中它吸收了更古老的古欧洲狩猎采集者语言，也借入了日耳曼语词汇。萨米诸语分为东、西两组，部分语言之间界限分明；更靠南的一些变体则在芬兰和卡累利阿农耕聚落的推进下消亡，凯努萨米语便于18世纪消失。萨米语的书写始于新教传教活动：1638年问世的《瑞典与拉普识字课本》以规范的萨米语形式收录了祈祷文和教理问答。克努德·莱姆于1748年出版了第一部语法书，1832年拉斯穆斯·拉斯克的萨米语法又提出音位记写法，后来的北萨米语正字法即建立在其基础之上。

en: Sanskrit is the classical Old Indo-Aryan language of South Asia and the sacred tongue of Hinduism, as well as a language of Buddhist and Jain learning. Its oldest layer is Vedic Sanskrit, the language of the Rigveda, whose hymns were composed between 1500 and 1200 BC and preserved by a rigorous oral tradition. In the mid-first millennium BC the grammarian Panini codified Classical Sanskrit in his Eight Chapters, after which the language changed little. Epic Sanskrit carried the Mahabharata, the Ramayana and the dramas of Kalidasa, while the vernacular Prakrits became the later Indian languages. It had no script of its own, being written in Brahmi and later most often in Devanagari; from the fourth century its inscriptions reached Southeast Asia, where Brahmic letters fathered the Khmer and Javanese scripts. Long after ceasing to be a mother tongue, Sanskrit remained the link language of religion, scholarship and courts, and the Benares Sanskrit College, founded under British rule in 1791, sustained its traditional teaching.
zh: 梵语是南亚古典的古印度—雅利安语言，是印度教的神圣语言，也用于佛教和耆那教的学问。它最古老的层次是吠陀梵语，即《梨俱吠陀》的语言；其中的颂诗作于公元前1500年至前1200年之间，靠严密的口传传统保存下来。公元前第一个千年中叶，文法学家波你尼在《八章书》中规范了古典梵语，此后这种语言变化甚微。史诗梵语承载了《摩诃婆罗多》《罗摩衍那》和迦梨陀娑的戏剧，民间的各种俗语则演变为后世的印度语言。梵语没有专属文字，先后用婆罗米文和后来最常用的天城文书写；从4世纪起，它的铭文传入东南亚，婆罗米系字母在当地孕育出高棉文和爪哇文。早在不再作为母语之后很久，梵语仍是宗教、学术和宫廷的通用语言；1791年英国统治下创办的贝拿勒斯梵文学院，延续着它的传统教学。

en: Sao is the name given to the language of the Sao civilization, which grew from local Iron Age cultures around Lake Chad and the Chari River in the second millennium BC, taking clear shape in the last centuries before Christ. No Sao inscription or text survives, so the language is known only through its Chadic-speaking descendants; the game places it among the Central Chadic group. The Sao lived in walled city-states ruled by divine kings, working bronze, copper and iron and leaving terracotta figures and funerary urns, and their cities long resisted the empires of Kanem and Bornu. Between the ninth and fifteenth centuries these states were at their height, but in the sixteenth century Bornu expansion and conversion to Islam ended Sao as a separate culture. The Kotoko, who founded their own kingdom in about 1500 and speak the Lagwan and other Mandage languages, are regarded as the inheritors of the Sao city-states.
zh: 萨奥语是对萨奥文明所用语言的称呼。萨奥文明在公元前第二千纪于乍得湖和沙里河流域由当地铁器时代文化发展而来，在公元前最后几个世纪定型。萨奥语没有铭文或文本传世，只能通过说乍得语的后裔了解，游戏将其归入中乍得语支。萨奥人居住在神王统治的城墙城邦里，能加工青铜、铜和铁，留下赤陶人像和骨灰瓮，他们的城邦曾长期抵御加涅姆和博尔努帝国。9至15世纪是这些城邦的鼎盛期，但到16世纪，博尔努的扩张和伊斯兰教的改宗终结了萨奥作为独立文化的存在。科托科人在约1500年建立自己的王国，使用拉格万语等曼达格语，被视为萨奥城邦的继承者。

en: Scandinavian, or North Germanic, is the Germanic branch of Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Iceland and the Faroe Islands. Its speakers became distinct from other Germanic peoples around AD 200, and the earliest stage, Proto-Norse, is preserved in runic inscriptions cut in the Younger Futhark. Out of it came Old Norse, the common language of the Viking Age, which Norse settlers carried to Iceland and the Faroes around 800 and, as Norn, to Orkney and Shetland; in the eleventh century it reached from Vinland in the west to the Volga in the east. Medieval speakers still called it the Danish tongue, and it was written in the Latin alphabet in manuscripts holding the Poetic Edda, the Prose Edda, the Icelandic sagas and skaldic verse. West and East Norse gradually diverged, giving Norwegian and Icelandic on one side and Danish and Swedish on the other, with Gutnish of Gotland apart. After the Middle Ages the Hanseatic towns flooded the continental languages with Middle Low German words; the Reformation brought printed Bible translations, while the political unions of the age, from the Swedish break with the Kalmar Union in 1523 to the end of Denmark–Norway in 1814, sharpened the separate standards. The island Norn died out around 1700, while Icelandic kept closest to the ancient tongue.
zh: 斯堪的纳维亚语又称北日耳曼语，是通行于瑞典、丹麦、挪威、冰岛和法罗群岛的日耳曼语支。说这些语言的族群约在公元200年前后与其他日耳曼人分化，最早阶段称原始诺斯语，留存于用后弗萨克如尼文刻写的碑铭中。由它发展出的古诺斯语是维京时代的共同语言，诺斯定居者约在800年把它带到冰岛和法罗群岛，又以诺恩语的形式传到奥克尼和设得兰；11世纪时，它的使用范围西起文兰、东抵伏尔加河。中世纪的使用者仍称之为丹麦舌，当时已用拉丁字母抄写手稿，留下了《诗体埃达》《散文埃达》、冰岛萨迦和吟唱诗。西诺斯语与东诺斯语逐渐分化，一侧形成挪威语和冰岛语，另一侧形成丹麦语和瑞典语，哥得兰的哥得兰语则自成一支。中世纪以后，汉萨城镇为大陆诸语带来大量中古低地德语词汇；宗教改革带来了印刷的圣经译本，而这个时代的政治联合——从1523年瑞典退出卡尔马联盟到1814年丹麦—挪威联合解体——又促使各书面标准进一步分化。海岛的诺恩语约在1700年消亡，冰岛语则最接近古老的诺斯语。

en: Seeptsa, also written Seeptsá, is the native name of the language better known as Cholón, once spoken by the Cholón people of the Huallaga River valley in northern Peru, around Tingo María and Uchiza in what are now the Huanuco and San Martín regions. Together with the closely related Hibito tongue of the same area it forms the Hibito–Cholón, or Cholonan, family, and some linguists place the poorly recorded Culle and Chachapoya languages in a wider Cholonoid grouping. Franciscan missionaries were the first to write it down: a seventeenth-century Arte y Vocabulario has been lost, but Pedro de la Mata's eighteenth-century Arte de la Lengua Cholona survives, and Bishop Baltasar Martínez Compañón included a Cholón wordlist in the codex of Peruvian life he compiled between 1782 and 1785. The surviving grammar lists both Cholón and Hibito villages, suggesting the two tongues were close and perhaps mutually intelligible. As mission settlements and the Quechua and Spanish languages advanced up the Huallaga valley in the colonial period, Cholón steadily lost ground, until the faith and daily life of its speakers were carried on in other languages.
zh: 塞普察语是乔隆语的本土自称，曾由秘鲁北部瓦亚加河流域的乔隆人使用，分布在今瓦努科和圣马丁地区的廷戈玛丽亚、乌奇萨一带。它与同一地区关系密切的希维托语共同构成希维托–乔隆语系，亦称乔隆语族；部分语言学家还把记录稀少的库列语、查查波亚语归入更大的乔隆语类群。最早记录这种语言的是方济各会传教士：17世纪的一部《乔隆语技艺与词汇》已经散佚，18世纪德拉马塔所著的《乔隆语技艺》留存于世，马丁内斯·孔帕尼翁主教在1782年至1785年间编纂、记录秘鲁风土的图册中也收录了一份乔隆语词表。传世语法同时列举了说乔隆语和希维托语的村庄，说明两种语言十分接近，或许可以互通。随着殖民时期传教定居点的建立，以及克丘亚语和西班牙语沿瓦亚加河谷推进，乔隆语的使用范围不断缩小，其使用者的信仰与日常生活逐渐改由其他语言承载。

en: Senegambian, also called the North Atlantic branch of the Niger-Congo family, covers the languages of the western Sahel and Atlantic coast: Wolof around the Senegal river, Serer in the kingdoms of Sine and Saloum, and the many dialects of Fula, whose pastoralist speakers spread from Senegambia east across the Sahel, together with the Jola, Balanta, Manjak and Tenda tongues farther south. Unusually for Niger-Congo languages they have no tones, and the Serer-Fula-Wolof group marks grammar through consonant mutation and noun-class suffixes. The Wolof founded the Jolof Empire, at first a vassal of Mali, which became independent about 1360 and dominated the country between the Senegal and Gambia rivers until its defeat at the battle of Danki in 1549. Fula-speaking scholars carried their tongue across the western and central Sudan: earlier Fulani jihads built the Islamic states of Futa Bundu, Futa Tooro and Fouta Djallon between 1650 and 1750, while the scholar Usman dan Fodio, born in 1754, founded the Sokoto Caliphate in 1803 and wrote more than a hundred works in Fula Ajami, the Arabic-based script long used for these languages.
zh: 塞内冈比亚语又称尼日尔—刚果语系的北大西洋语支，涵盖西非萨赫勒西部与大西洋沿岸的诸语言：塞内加尔河一带的沃洛夫语，锡内、萨卢姆等王国的塞雷尔语，方言众多、随游牧民从塞内冈比亚向东传遍萨赫勒的富拉语，以及更南边的乔拉语、巴兰塔语、曼贾克语和滕达诸语。与多数尼日尔—刚果语言不同，它们都没有声调；塞雷尔—富拉—沃洛夫这一组还以辅音交替和名词分类后缀标示语法关系。沃洛夫人建立的沃洛夫帝国起初是马里帝国的附庸，约1360年获得独立，称雄于塞内加尔河与冈比亚河之间，直到1549年在丹基战役中战败。讲富拉语的学者把这种语言带到西苏丹和中苏丹各地：1650至1750年间，更早的富拉尼圣战建立了邦杜富塔、富塔托罗和富塔贾隆等伊斯兰国家；1754年出生的学者乌斯曼·丹·福迪奥于1803年建立索科托哈里发国，并用富拉语的阿贾米文字——长期用于这些语言的阿拉伯字母体系——写下上百部著作。

en: Senufo is the Atlantic-Congo branch of some fifteen closely related languages spread across northern Ivory Coast, southern Mali and south-western Burkina Faso, with the isolated Nafaanra tongue in Ghana. Long grouped with the Gur languages, it keeps their suffixal noun classes and aspect-marked verbs but uses a three-level tone system and, like its Mande neighbours, subject-object-verb word order; centuries of contact with Bambara and Jula traders have left a heavy layer of Mande loanwords. The old town of Korhogo was already a Senufo centre in the thirteenth century, and from the fourteenth century Dyula merchants moving out of the Mali Empire founded trading towns such as Kong on Senufo land. The Senufo took shape as a distinct group in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, and in the north they formed the backbone of the Kénédougou Kingdom around Sikasso. In 1710 the Dyula leader Seku Watara built the Kong Empire on the same ground, a loose commercial state whose power ran along the trade routes as far as Sya, taken in 1737; Muslim traders settled in Senufo towns under its rule, though most Senufo kept their ancestral religion.
zh: 塞努福语是大西洋—刚果语系下的一支，包含约十五种亲属语言，分布在科特迪瓦北部、马里南部和布基纳法索西南部，另有孤立的纳法拉语通行于加纳。它长期被归入古尔语群，保留了后缀名词分类和动词体标记，但采用三级声调体系，并像邻近的曼丁哥语言一样使用主宾谓语序；与班巴拉语、朱拉语商人的长期接触也给它留下了大量曼丁哥借词。古城科霍戈在13世纪已是塞努福人的中心，14世纪起，从马里帝国迁出的朱拉商人在塞努福人的土地上建立了孔格等商业城镇。塞努福人作为一个独特群体形成于15至16世纪，北方的塞努福人构成了以锡卡索为中心的凯内杜古王国的主体。1710年，朱拉首领塞库·瓦塔拉在同一片土地上建立孔格帝国，这个松散的商业国家沿商路扩张，于1737年攻取西亚；在其统治下穆斯林商人定居于塞努福城镇，但多数塞努福人仍保留着本土信仰。

en: The Sepik or Sepik River languages form a family of about fifty Papuan languages spoken across the Sepik river basin of northern New Guinea, in the grasslands and swamps that stretch from the river's upper reaches to its delta on the Bismarck Sea. The grouping was established by the Australian linguist Donald Laycock and takes its name from the great river that binds the region together. Its best-known members are the Ndu languages, including Iatmul, the most thoroughly studied, and Abelam and Boiken, each with tens of thousands of speakers; other branches include the Yellow River, Ram and Upper Sepik groups, to which Abau belongs. Sepik languages tend to simple phonologies with few consonants and a vertical vowel system in which vowel height rather than frontness carries the contrasts, and most distinguish masculine and feminine genders on nouns, classifying even inanimate things by shape and size. After the Portuguese first reached New Guinea in 1526 and the Spanish gave the island its name in 1545, coastal contacts grew, yet the Sepik interior remained beyond outside reach, and its peoples lived in villages built along the river and its tributaries, relying on fishing, sago and the exchange networks of the basin; their languages remain the chief marker of identity among its many small communities.
zh: 塞皮克语又称塞皮克河语，是巴布亚诸语言中的一个语族，约有五十种语言，通行于新几内亚北部的塞皮克河流域——从河流上游一直延伸到俾斯麦海河口的草原与沼泽地带。该语族由澳大利亚语言学家唐纳德·莱科克划定，因贯穿全区的塞皮克河而得名。其中最著名的是恩杜语支，包括研究最充分的雅特穆尔语，以及各有数万使用者的阿贝兰语和博伊肯语；其他分支还有黄河语支、拉姆语支和阿鲍语所属的上塞皮克语支。塞皮克诸语言音系通常较为简单，辅音不多，元音采用以高度而非前后位置区别意义的纵向元音系统；多数语言的名词分阳性、阴性，连无生命事物也按形状和大小归类。1526年葡萄牙人首次抵达新几内亚，1545年西班牙人将该岛命名为“新几内亚”，沿海接触日渐增多，但塞皮克内陆始终与外界隔绝；各族群沿河及支流而居，以捕鱼、西谷椰和流域内的交换网络为生，语言始终是众多小社群之间最重要的身份标志。

en: Serbo-Croatian is the western South Slavic language of the western Balkans, spoken across Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia and Montenegro in a chain of dialects. Early medieval Slavic migrants brought it into the region, and by the ninth or tenth century the speech had divided into the Kajkavian and Chakavian idioms of the northwest and the Shtokavian dialects that later became the prestige form. Its oldest surviving texts, from the eleventh century, are in the Glagolitic alphabet; medieval writers also used Cyrillic, Latin, the earliest complete Latin-script text being dated 1345, and an Arabic-based script among Bosnian Muslims. From the fifteenth century the Ottoman conquest uprooted whole populations, and Shtokavian spread with the migrants at the expense of Chakavian and Kajkavian. In the early nineteenth century Vuk Karadžić rebuilt Serbian Cyrillic on phonemic principles and Ljudevit Gaj devised a matching Croatian Latin alphabet; the name Serbo-Croatian itself was coined by Jacob Grimm in 1824.
zh: 塞尔维亚‑克罗地亚语是西巴尔干的西部南斯拉夫语言，以一连串方言通行于塞尔维亚、克罗地亚、波斯尼亚和黑山等地。中世纪早期的斯拉夫移民把它带入这一地区，到9至10世纪，当地口语分化为西北部的卡伊卡维、查卡维两支，以及后来成为优势方言的什托方言。现存最早的文本出自11世纪，用格拉哥里字母写成；中世纪的书写者还使用西里尔字母和拉丁字母，最早的完整拉丁字母文本可定于1345年，波斯尼亚的穆斯林则使用一种以阿拉伯字母为基础的文字。15世纪起，奥斯曼征服造成整族整族的人口迁徙，什托方言随移民扩散，挤压了查卡维方言和卡伊卡维方言的空间。19世纪初，武克·卡拉季奇按音位原则改造了塞尔维亚西里尔字母，留德维特·盖伊则设计出与之对应的克罗地亚拉丁字母；“塞尔维亚‑克罗地亚语”这个名称本身，是雅各布·格林在1824年提出的。

en: Shawnee, self-designated Saawanwaatoweewe, is a Central Algonquian language of the Algic family, closely related to Mesquakie-Sauk and Kickapoo. Its speakers' precontact homeland probably lay in southern Ohio, where some connect the Shawnee with the Fort Ancient culture that flourished along the Ohio River from about 1000 to 1650. In the seventeenth century the Shawnee dispersed across Ohio, Illinois, Maryland, Delaware and Pennsylvania, and later scattered again into West Virginia, Kentucky, Indiana and Illinois. A polysynthetic, mainly agglutinating language, Shawnee packs much information into its verbs, distinguishes animate from inanimate nouns, and most often places the verb first; it is written in the Latin script, though no single orthography has become standard. The Shawnee fought a succession of wars to hold their lands, from the French and Indian War of 1754 to Tecumseh's War of 1810 to 1813, and under the Indian Removal Act of 1830 the United States began moving them west of the Mississippi, carrying the language into Missouri and Kansas.
zh: 肖尼语自称萨万瓦托维韦语，是阿尔吉克语系的一门中阿尔冈昆语言，与梅斯克瓦基—索克语和基卡普语关系密切。肖尼人接触欧洲人前的家园大概在俄亥俄南部，有学者把他们与约1000至1650年间兴盛于俄亥俄河沿岸的古堡文化联系起来。17世纪，肖尼人分散到俄亥俄、伊利诺伊、马里兰、特拉华和宾夕法尼亚各地，后来又再度散居西弗吉尼亚、肯塔基、印第安纳和伊利诺伊。肖尼语是多式综合、以黏着为主的语言，大量信息压缩在动词之中，名词分有灵与无灵两类，语序通常以动词居首；它使用拉丁字母书写，但始终没有形成统一拼写法。为保住故土，肖尼人从1754年的法国—印第安战争到1810至1813年的特库姆塞战争接连参战；1830年《印第安人迁移法》通过后，美国开始把他们迁往密西西比河以西，肖尼语也随之带到密苏里和堪萨斯。

en: Sosoni-Kusiutta is the Shoshoni speech of the Great Basin, the Central Numic member of the Uto-Aztecan family, heard across Nevada, Utah and Wyoming and up to the Snake River plain of Idaho. Its speakers call it Sosoni' ta̲i̲kwappe, or more generally newe ta̲i̲kwappe, 'the people's language', and it divides into Western Shoshoni, Gosiute — the Kusiutta bands of western Utah — Northern and Eastern Shoshoni dialects, each attached to groups named for their staple foods. Its nearest kin are Timbisha, spoken near Death Valley in California, and Comanche, whose speakers remained a Shoshoni band until around 1700, when they moved out onto the southern plains and their dialect slowly ceased to be mutually intelligible. All descend from Proto-Numic, whose speakers began spreading out of the southern Sierra Nevada roughly a thousand years earlier. Shoshoni was traditionally an unwritten language, carried in oral narrative and song.
zh: 肖肖尼‑库西乌塔语是大盆地的肖肖尼话，属犹他-阿兹特克语系的中努米克语支，通行于内华达、犹他、怀俄明，北至爱达荷的斯内克河平原。使用者称之为“索索尼·泰夸佩”，更笼统的叫法是“内韦·泰夸佩”，意为“人的语言”；它分为西肖肖尼、戈休特（即犹他西部的库西乌塔群体）、北肖肖尼和东肖肖尼几种方言，各与以主食命名的群体相联系。它最近的亲属是加利福尼亚死谷附近的廷比沙语和科曼奇语：科曼奇人本是肖肖尼人的一个群体，约1700年迁入南部平原，其方言才渐渐与肖肖尼话互不相通。这些语言都源自原始努米克语，其使用者约在一千年前开始从内华达山脉南部向外扩散。肖肖尼话传统上没有文字，靠口传叙事和歌谣传承。
